How she had that premonition, who knows. Poor Roy. He seemed such a nice friendly man. I said, have a nice day and walked back to where I'd parked outside the gate. The campground had lots of dry camping spots, and the toilets were working. I decided to camp at the other secluded area away from the campground and booked online accordingly to find there were 7 spaces for that night and 19 spaces available for the following night. Auckland Council. I would change your hosts if I were you. I have given a 1 star rating for Moanie. However, I would give a 4 star for Roy, the park, toilet blocks, and the beach. Far too many judder bars as per usual would be the only downfall along with the wife lol.

We were unable to stay there, even though the website indicated that 86 free spaces were available. I called the council, and they informed me that the website only updates once a night at midnight. Unfortunately, they couldn't provide an alternative location since all the gates lock at 7 PM, and they are unable to open them manually.

We went camping at Te Haruhi for the first time last week after living on the coast for over 15 years and it was our best experience ever camping. Great spacious areas to set up camp and for kids to run and play, amazing bird life all around the tent, farm animals, gorgeous beach and hiking trails with glorious views. Thank you
Lovely beach and bay. Grassed campground area for shade. Restrooms, picnic tables. Views of Auckland.
The beach is calm and clean. They are groups of black gooses. I’m here driving at Toyota Land Cruiser Prado. This place is suitable for camping. The weather is slightly raining with 18°C.

Shakespeare Beach is not only a "beach" but there is also great campsites here, so close to the beach, toilet and ample of space for the kids to play. For current pricung check Auckland council's website. I would gladly spend a couple of nights here, just a note it does get busy during weekends and public holidays.

Lovely beach. Very nice views around and very peaceful. Good for the people to stay away from crowdy city. You can put tents in there, organise BBQ and picnics. Plenty of parking, washrooms everything there. Might need to take food and drinks because I can't see any shops nearby. You can see lamb and beef farms just in front. What a beautiful place ❤️❤️❤️
Beautiful and very clean beach. The water is clear and calm. It has a park along with beach and there is a big changing room and toilets aswell. Perfect spot to relax during summer holiday ❤️
A nice calm beach, great place to camp with beach easy walking distance.
A very wonderful and beautiful park. There are a variety of birds and wonderful views. I recommend visiting it. I had a lot of fun with my family 🥰

Stunning Auckland scenery on foot! Its diverse, well-maintained, and clearly signposted tracks cater to all fitness levels. Check tide times for Pink Beach. Facilities like toilets and picnic areas. Tips: Wear sturdy shoes, check weather, bring water/snacks/sunscreen, respect nature (no pets inside sanctuary).
Pink Beach
Nice walk to the beach
A serene walk to a small waterfall in a beautiful setting. Plus well worth the trip as wood pigeons live there and with some luck you can see them up close.

There is plenty of parking, no toilets or bins. It's a short 5 to 10-minute walk to the base of the waterfall. Definitely go after it's rained, or you'll be disappointed by the flow of water flowing. You can do the loop walk or just walk back the same way.
Beautiful picnic spot! This is a very well kept Regional Park, the volunteers did an amazing job.

Good carpark with ample space before the entry onto the track. If you need a break from the sun, Waterfall Gully offers some shade and respite. There you will find a nice path that winds through with boardwalks and a few steps. Keep an eye on an eel that likes to appear in the stream and can be sited from the little bridge. It’s an easy walk, with footwear cleaning stations and predator gates to enter the bush. You can continue up to the viewing platform, for probably another 5 minutes. On the way to the carpark, there is also a beach with toilet/shower/changing facilities.

Never knew this place existed, what a fantastic way for us to be able to see native birds in their natural habit. Its an absolute privilege that anyone can visit this spot, so please take care of it. Follow all instructions when entering to protect the environment and take any rubbish back with you. We saw wood pigeons, Tui birds and fantails on our short walk its absolutely amazing! The waterfall would have to be the Icing on the cake.
We enjoyed our walk. 5-10 minutes walk to see the water fall. Parking is in the front. There's another 30 minutes track but we didn't have time to do it. Will come back and try next time.
Hard to find by the small roadside but surprisingly quite big sports park soccer and tennis. Like hidden park

Crum Park in Auckland is a unique, delightful spot for outdoor activities. Nestled in the residential area of West Auckland, it offers a serene environment for hiking, running, and walking. The park’s bilingual signage adds a unique touch. It’s a great place for families with a playground and picnic tables. The park also hosts various sports, like football, tennis, basketball, and netball, which makes it a vibrant community hub.
Well kept grounds and facilities. Little short on parking space. I added a photo for all you soccer parents to find out which field is where.

Beautiful park, nestled in the foothills of the Waitakere’s and very pretty at this time of year. There’s quite a few fields and a playground. The only fly in the ointment is the horrendous parking. But that’s no different to any other sporting ground in NZ.
good place for kids to play foodball, but full of car on the side of road.

One of the OG local spots the bros and myself would come to during our highschool era, aged 15-17. We were all broke, had no vehicles, completely lost and clueless and completely bumming it. Definitely wouldn't catch myself down there nowadays. Nonetheless, some golden memories were made down there and wont be forgotten
Small but well built. The entrance is from the carpark, the shortcut down a driveway is a misleading wrong way.
Good little reserve. Quite a good playground for kids
Nice spot
Ordinary
Super nice park with playground, several sports fields, toilets, a nice circuit to walk, run, or for little kids in their bikes. Good parking allocation and well-maintained sports fields.
Great park with good facilities and is in a convenient location (close to the bus stop and supermarket). Well maintained with plenty of car parks.

Sunnynook Park has a whimsical bike/walking track; perfect for prams, toddlers, kids learning to ride, or a shaded running spot. The size of the park allows for much to be explored with two playgrounds, sports fields, a skate area, and a perimeter path. The parking on both entrances is ample as well as council facilities, rubbish bins, water fountains. This could be a park you could lose hours too, a great venue for a family celebration, picnic between friends, or space for the kids to run their energy out.
What a difference, the before and after look is amazing. Wonderful park and sporting facilities
Lovely park for walking. Awesome sports fields with amenities. Outdoor exercise equipment and 2 playgrounds suitable for all ages.
Good walk with the dogs and the kids love it 😀
Peaceful walk amongst mature trees in the heart of Albany. Both four legged friends and two legged ones enjoyed the easy and refreshing walk. It’s not a long one and very easy.
Beautiful place for walking and cycling
Delightful little reserve to walk sunshine or rain. The dense forest area protects from rain. Take chicken feed pellets with to feed the ducks and Pukekos.

At first appears to be nothing more than a big open field, but secret paths reveal a small mountain bike trail and winding paths through pine bush along a small stream. A nice place to visit with dogs off lead. Worth a visit for sure.
Wonderful little store with an amazing variety of products including fresh and frozen food and household essentials. A true neighborhood gem. Love the Curry Burger! 😋

Bhanas is the type of store that makes you feel like you are really apart of a community, with everything you need, along with a petrol station attached, the Bhana family and their staff are always good for a laugh and a yarn. These guys ruly look after their customers
Always such wonderful service from the Bhana Family. Best shop keepers ever top notch service.
Best little grocery store in town. Lovely family operation. The backbone of the community. You're what we need when we need it!
The Bhanas are a wonderful family, their store is a foundation of the Awhitu community, and great takeaways too!
Played cricket against visiting Australian Veterans. Great day had by all, facilities are great as well as the caterer's.
Beautiful grounds, lovely club rooms. I watched some awesome women's cricket here!

Lovely food, clean toilets and reasonable priced. The look& feel seems vintage old,so could do with an interior designer and modern makeover. The bar was professional, but was not friendly and didn't smile even once the entire time.

Excellent experience booking clubrooms for a 21st Birthday party (which we were very lucky to hold whilst in Level 1 of Covid 19 restrictions). The KCEC were extremely accommodating and a pleasure to deal with .. from point of contact to the end of an extremely successful celebration. The bar staff were awesome, the clubrooms decorated up beautifully, the gas fireplace was appreciated on a chilly evening, the atmosphere exactly as we hoped! MOST OF ALL THE CATERING WAS NEXT LEVEL. Gill from TWO FAT CHEFS (the resident caterer) did an OUTSTANDING job catering for the function. She was amazing to deal with and her food and service for our 21st was incredible! Huge THANKS to everyone .. you helped us create a very special and memorable occasion!
Attended an 18th birthday here. Great space for a big crowd. Kitchen was ample and toilets are clean. Parking available at the venue too.
The best in karaka

They have different varieties of vegetarian and non-vegetarian food with hot and cold beverages. There is a nice seat inside the shop. There is room for parking outside. In taste the food seems to be average and the price is on a higher side

Beautiful cafe with beautiful employees! They are the nicest people! The employees know how to welcome customers ! The coffee is outstanding and the foods are yummy! Above all I love the friendship they give me every time I go there! Great Cafe! great customer service! delicious food!

First time coming here after driving past a few times each week Would give 10 stars if I could ! ! Came in Thurs 10th July midday for some takeaway lunch & coffee , staff ( 2 x young women ) were friendly & made The Best Flat White ! Had a sausage roll which was Excellent and could tell was made in house Definitely stopping in more I’m an ex barista (15yrs experience) and generally have high expectations but mostly receive below average coffee So it was awesome to receive an amazing Flat White from the Barista at Karaka General Store & Cafe Thanks so much
Nice place food is consistently good. Staff are great. Always make sure to stop in here when i’m in the area

Nice spot out in the middle of Karaka. Half a dozen parks. Cabinet food available as well as menu to order from. Coffee, milkshakes available. Hot chicken wrap was delish and hubby enjoyed the sausage roll, however, the panini was toasted to death and the sausage rolls were luke warm out of the hot cabinet. Got mine reheated. Some of the items a bit pricey ($45 for a coke, milkshake, 2 sausage rolls, chicken wrap and panini), but was worth a first time try.

After leaving Auckland with the rental car, this was pretty much the first gas station we came across which had this restaurant. The restaurant offered quite a lot of food, though the prices for main dishes are on the higher side. The food was quite delicious, and the portions were huge. Recommended for a quick food stop.

I stopped off for breakfast at the start of a new road trip. The place was not too crowded and the service was swift and friendly. I chose the "Bacon breakfast" which is just regular bacon and eggs-with more bacon. Delicious. Nothing too fancy, but a good spot to start the trip from.

Delicious food, Good prices, Very generous portions, Kind staff who are very hospitable. Very helpful with food allergy needs. Clean and calm environment, music is kept at a nice level. Definitely will be coming back.

We had breakfast, plenty variety, plus cabinet food. Lots of tables and space. Food was generous in portions and cooked to perfection . Staff friendly. Place was clean. We would come here again. Well priced.

Great range of food and drinks, good range of cabinet food and kitchen menu. good service with friendly staff. Good coffee.. short wait time for the food to come out and presentation looked good. Highly recommend.

Tables all have spilled coke on them. Trash not cleaned up. Tables sticky. Floors sticky and oily. It’s a dump and they need to clean it and have more staff keeping it clean. Unbelievable how the standard of McDonald’s New Zealand continues to decline.

I know you're hungry. You must be to be thinking of stopping here. Don't. Okay? Please just trust this review and ALL the other reviews saying the same thing. It's a gross setting. Just stay hungry for 15 minutes longer and stop elsewhere. My photos say it all. If you're a visitor to NZ please don't think that this place is a reflection of what you'll encounter elsewhere.

Loved my visit today (8:20am 08/07/25), the manager was in an infectiously good mood. Blonde guy, didn't catch his name, name tag might have started with L. Would happily go out of my way to be served by him again.

Convenient spot on the motorway out of Auckland for a quick snack. Kiwi burger was average, meat was dryer than the usual maccas patty. Same dryness with the crispy almighty chicken burger which was also average. Fries weren’t crispy either. Good coffees. Service was fine. Over flowing rubbish bins made it hard to dispose rubbish without touching the lid / bin.

Such a busy maccas, so it's expected that everything won't be perfect, so leniency for this review is applied. Review based on arrangement of the burger, sauce applied, and service. - Big Mac 6/10 Burger was OK but was arranged on an angle, rushed made. - Double cheeseburger 6/10 Arranged as it should, none of the Diced onion added, though - French fries 4.5/10 Soft, no crunch. No salt added
Lovely spot for a good coffee and treats. N child friendly.
I spend about 2 hours with my daughter (18mths) here every Saturday morning. One of the most chill and child friendly cafes I've been to. Surprised not more people know about it!
I really wanted to like this café... The lady was lovely. The 3 cheese sando was OK but coffee needs some work. 😭 Flowers are a bit weird, they could go...

The drinks are not the best, the matcha doesn’t taste like actual matcha. The lady forgot the order of the people who were in front of me and she also forgot my friend’s order. The atmosphere is nice and relaxing but could use air con. Most drinks are pretty expensive too.

A coffee shop refused to provide WiFi for its customers. I saw a person using WiFi. That girl said that person was staff and WiFi was only for staff. I was skeptical. Could it be because I am a Chinese in work clothes?

Very clean and new place. Staff were all very friendly and welcoming. We didn’t get any napkins at our table though and had to steal some from a free table next to us. The food menu was quite unique with some standouts like biang biang noodles and Korean-style fried chicken waffles. They had their own take on the big breakfast with whipped feta and curry seasoned potatoes which were quite nice. Scrambled eggs were slightly undercooked, there was still some translucent egg white bits in it but that may be personal preference. Their fries that went with the burger were really good, crispy exterior and fluffy interior. I appreciated that they had matcha latte on the drinks menu, one of the better matchas I’ve had. Overall everything was tasty but the prices are slightly higher, and the portions were ok. They’re just starting off so maybe there’ll be improvements in the future.

Dropped into Park Green Cafe & Bar for a quick coffee and was seriously impressed. The place is brand new - just opened a few days ago, I believe - but it’s already ticking all the right boxes. Bright, clean, and spacious, with plenty of seating both inside and out. The staff were welcoming, and the cabinet food looked fresh and inviting. The full menu also looked really tempting. We only stopped in for coffee (a cappuccino and a flat white), but couldn’t resist adding a veggie savoury scone to the order. First, the coffee: smooth, strong, and exactly what we needed. As for the scone—wow. I wasn’t sure what to expect, but it was unlike any savoury scone I’ve had. Warm, fluffy, loaded with cheese, and a subtle hint of spice or chilli that gave it a perfect little kick. Served with butter, it was absolutely delicious. I know it’s “just a scone,” but honestly, it was next level - and it’s got me really excited to come back and try more from the menu. Impressive start for a brand-new spot. Looking forward to our next visit!

Wow the food is delishhh , highly recommend the pancakes ! I have never ever had pancakes like these and I was amazed, crispy on the outside and so fluffy and light on the inside. Every bit of food we ordered was perfectly cooked and packed with flavor! , we are definitely coming back !

Our networking group had the pleasure of holding our first meeting at Park Green Café and Bar this morning, and we couldn’t have asked for a better experience. The staff were incredibly accommodating—nothing was too much trouble. The space is warm, inviting, and filled with natural light, making it the perfect setting for a group gathering. The food was well presented, the coffee was hot, and the service went above and beyond. You can really tell the team takes pride in offering a high level of hospitality. Highly recommend this café—great atmosphere, great people, and a great addition to the area!

Lovely new cafe, got out well done. Had poached eggs on sour dough with a trim latte. Eggs dish was lovely, well presented and got the spot! Coffee was yummy too. Plenty of outdoor seating walkers like us with dogs!

There was a fly in the warmbox, stay in there for more then 2mins, and the stuff on duty didn't use correct PPE when they try to remove the fly, and they didn't follow the right hygiene process publish by the city council, which is remove and waste the food which the fly had stayed. Can't imagine the next person who had that cake. Is affected my mind for a long time , I mean is a nightmare.. was disaster
Got a vanilla latte with coconut milk, made beautifully 🩶
Ordered coffee but wasn't ask for my wild bean loyalty card so didn't get the points. When I asked why the shop assistant assumed I won't have a card. Very poor service. Pie only just warm.

Worst toilets ever... women's cubicle has no basin and was filthy. Flat white was just ... cold and tasteless. Floors dirty and the counters sticky. Petrol price 20c more than other stations. What used to be a favourite is no longer. Take another 20 minutes or so down the highway.
Good service, cafe, hot chocolate, muffins, sandwiches, tart, fruit salad etc

This is hands down the BEST roast place I’ve ever had! It’s well worth the price. I had leftovers the next day and it was still amazing, the meat didn’t taste weird at all. Bbq pork was so good and they have best crackling compared to anywhere else. I’ll definitely be back again.
Called in after a late job, heading home didn't feel like cooking so Ned's Roast was the perfect place to stop. Great service an yummy food.

Disclaimer: I was an employee here. Have worked and eaten at other Roast Shops at other places as well. Probably one of the best roasts in Papakura if not Auckland. Personally I love their fried chicken, easily the best ones I've had! Although they switched owners, the food is still great and pretty much the same as always. Would recommend to anyone who wants a quick bite or something inexpensive to fill their stomach! Aaron
Below average.. The not even one quarter of meat, was so dry. With the pork and the lamb. Crackling was cold didn't look fresh at all. Medium x4 $96.00

I've tried several roast shops in my time, and this has to be one of my favorites. Everything is well seasoned and flavourful, and the gravy is perfect. Someone else said it, and I will agree that if you get the meal and like crispy potatoes, get them in a little bag instead of on top, but this true of most roast shops. The couple that own this shop are nice and pleasant to deal with. If you want the good stuff, go early because they do sell out. That's how good food works.

I've eaten here a few times and have always been impressed. The menu is good, with plenty of delicious options, especially the lamb shank and the Sunday roast dinner. Both are absolutely outstanding. Highly recommended!

Excellent food and service, good serving size, cooked as requested. We had a big group, they ran out of sirloin steak and pasta but the second pick was still yummy. Highly recommend a meal here. Puddings just as good, difficult to finish after a main meal.
Stayed here in the camping grounds for 1 night. Wasn’t too bad toilets and showers were nice and clean, meals were delicious honestly best battered chips I’ve had!!!

A well established Drury local bar. The original building was established around 100 years ago and it has operated as a bar continuously since then. It is a local landmark. There are a range of bars, a bottle store and good kitchen services offering a range of menu items. There is also an associated motor caravan park..

Loved this place. The vibe was what made it so iconic . Dim lighting, vintage wall hangings, antique furniture and fittings, interesting quotes and all that made it resemble a pub from the 70s in rural Ireland . Definately worth a visit with friends to chill a friday night thru

Small no frills sushi cafe. 3 tables for two people. 1 table with stools for 3 people. Reasonable menu selection. $24 for bento box. $22 for the spicy pork bowl with rice. (Not really spicy) Bento box didn't include miso soup. It was ok. Not great, not bad.
Beautiful and fresh takeaway sushi 🍣 will definitely visit again if I’m in the area ☺️
I always buy too much sushi when I go here that is absolutely amazing and so delicious

The bomb diggity dot com SUSHI Fresh, Clean, Exceptional Service and such a beautiful family. Hands down my favourite sushi. You know it’s great sushi when the Yellowfin Tuna and Salmon are incredibly fresh and melts like butter. I could go on about this place all day. I’d eat it every day if I could.
Bought Avo and Salmon sushi, 2x pieces were barely edible, dry rice and salmon.
best food 😋 yummm

From the moment you step into Curry and Craft Indian Restaurant, you know you’re in for a treat. The soft, ambient lighting and modern, rustic décor immediately set the stage for a memorable dining experience. The staff greets you with genuine warmth and offers a menu that feels thoughtfully curated, rather than overwhelming. Staff were very friendly and helpful, their service was top notch and their timing of each course was perfect. We loved this restaurant in our area as there was no other good restaurant in this area who can provide good service and better customer service. Highly recommended for anyone in the area looking for a memorable dining experience!

It was Amazing experience of having dinner at this restaurant.. the food was top notch , service was amazing and quick, staff was very nice and presentable and polite. Also restaurant is very spacious. Worth each cent spent on food, would highly recommend who is looking for genuine food.

I uberordered butter chicken and onion bhaji. First time trying onion bhaji. On its own... hmmm. But they added a dipping sauce... OH WOW. Yum. Butter chicken... meat tender, gravy plentiful and delicious. Just right... mild. Generous serving, enough for lunch tomorrow. Thank you team so much. I loved it so much I had to share. xx

Delicious Indian cuisine in Karaka—our favorite neighborhood restaurant! The food quality is consistently excellent, and the service is warm and friendly. There are outdoor seating. Parking is available on site.

Busy corner but lots of off road parking. Not the friendliest welcome. Minimal conversation whilst taking order. Food looked decent size. Not freshly battered. Chips went cold fast. Okay but not great fish n chips. Might go back to check the curries though.

Yummo! Ok so I love it when Indian fooderies use the thigh or leg meat for butter chicken instead of the breast (which seems dry even when coated in sauce). Thank you Spice Junction! Juicy chicken pieces, great portion size, awesome ratio of chicken to sauce. Naan was on point and the Chicken 65 was satisfyingly spicy! Will definitely Uber order again!
Lovely place with great staff and beautiful food right near the water just off the motorway. Fresh fruit icecreams are great too.

Last time I was there 30yrs ago..and my gosh..absolutely lovely staff (owners) and they're lovely personalities. The tables beautiful set. Especially as you walk to see blossoms orchids (unreal) but gave class to the big room. The food dinner $35 per person eat as much you like...gosh if I stayed to Papakura..I'd go to Ruby every Saturday pm to rest and snack and try delicate foods 😋 Thankyou for absolutely lovely Birthday as well 🎂

Starts at 6pm Unlimited Buffet Eat all you can All you can eat Bottomless Smorgasbord Good amount of variety. But i think something is missing, like dim sum/siu mai. hopefully they include bottomless fizzy drinks too. Add tomato sauce and aioli for the chips too maybe? And have some chili garlic sauce available too The place very neat and clean

Very delicious Cantonese food. No msg and no animal fat. The corn soup is freshly sweet. Though not traditional Cantonese style, all food are tasty. The owner said the restaurant has been running for 52 years.

I highly recommend it for lunch. The lunch special is fantastic value, the food is delicious, the facilities first-class, and the service wonderful. I recommend you order a pot of jasmine tea with your lunch. It doesn't cost much, and it is superb. We don't live in Auckland, so will probably never get the opportunity to dine there in the evening. That's a pity, as I'm confident it would be a great experience.
Amazing to know this restaurant has been opening for 50 years! What a legend! Very friendly and kind service. Clean and kind. Reasonable price and good variety of food for a buffet meal.

Ever since visiting Northern Thailand for myself, I grew the love for Khao Soi (curry noodles) which is not commonly around in a lot of Thai restaurants here in Auckland. When I saw that Wild Orchid had Chicken Khao Soi on their menu, I got super excited and asked them if they could make a vegetarian one for me with tofu and vegetables, they responded so quickly on Facebook and were so accommodating to my dietary requests. Even as a take away the Khao soi was super delicious and flavourful with the right amount of spice for when I asked for medium and even gave me extra chilli in case. The crispy noodles for the topping were also delicious. Thank you again Wild Orchard Thai, I definately will be back and might also need to dine in next time 🙏.

I got Uber for Lunch and decided to try something new. I am not the fussiest of eaters, I too know how to cook a Pad Thai. I usually get it from Thai Sizzler but I decided to try this restaurant. I was not happy. It's like the cook stuck maybe a tablespoon to cover and coat the rice noodles. There was no lemon or anything and I don't know what the purpose of the little tiny portion of salad did. I loved the curry puffs though - I was disappointed. I won't be back.

Wild Orchid is a Thai restaunt at 1/6 Averill Street in Papakura. It's been there for twenty-four years, but we found it only yesterday when we called in to get lunch. We had no idea what we had been missing for years! Go there. Eat there. Damn, it's wonderful. Lunch will set you back about twenty dollars per person, so pricing in the middle range. We paid about 38 dollars for two meals. Two stunning, superb lunch meals. Thai lunches usually are very good indeed, and now usually cost about fourteen to fifteen dollars per person in most suburban Thai restaurants. But Wild Orchid is a quantum jump above your usual Thai offering. Their food is in the top range, and well worth the price difference. Today, my wife and I both chose Thai curries. She chose a chicken Panang, I a roast duck red curry with red grapes and pineapple. Both curries contained plentiful quantities of perfectly cooked vegetables, and were served in beautiful blue lidded bowls alongside plates of fragrant jasmine rice. How good? Great Thai curry sauces have the quality of gourmet soups. When I finished eating my meal, I raised the curry bowl with both hands and drained the remaining red curry sauce. There's only one other Thai restaurant in New Zealand whose curries are good enough to make me want to do that. The service is as good as the food. A pure pleasure. They'll see us back again. P.S. their website is www.wildorchidthai.co.nz You can check out their lunch, evening and takeaway menus there.

Food came in hot, which was great! Ordered Massaman curry and it was okay. They gave lots of meat and veggies which was nice. Sauce was not as thick as I would've expected and beef strips made for chewier bites. Some of the potatoes were undercooked so were still a bit tough. Overall, it's okay. Money bags were tasty. Delicious filling.
Some of the best snapper I've had in a restaurant, and the chicken larp is fantastic. Lovely atmosphere and service

Went there with a friend. The owner was sooo lovely! She made us feel very welcomed. Together we ordered the tom yum goong, the green curry and the chicken satay. Everything was very yummy and definitely recommend it!! Thanks for the yummy food and the amazing service!!

Absolutely disgusting got home and found a hair in our rice when i called to let them know the lady told me once the food came out the don't know where the hair comes from. when i explained i didn't want anything i just wanted to let them know incase someone else had the same issue she hung up on me. Gari puffs were stale, basil chicken tasted like cleaning product and the pad thai tasted like sweet chilli sauce. if i could give it less then a 1 star i would!
We ordered prawn fried rice. The rice was way too soggy and prawn was fishy and smells. I hope I don't get sick from it. Customer service was good
Highly recommend the Gai Yang chicken dish! The sauce is chefs kiss! They had the sweetest ladies serving us our dishes. Great place to eat out at and catch up with friends and family.

Unfortunately the green curry had very little meat. There was two to three times more vege than meat. Same with the pad grapaw. Barely any meat :( Good customer service but I have to mention the rice is also basmati and not jasmine (which isn’t included when you buy a dish) . Thai dishes normally goes with jasmine rice don’t they? Not basmati.

Navpreet and Amisha served us; me and my wife loved their service and interaction with us. Good to see happy faces behind counter serving good food! I went for the Chilli cheese potato and my wife tried the Mushroom Baconator burger, both were great! Told the team that my wife loves your Hot chilli sauce and they gave us some extras which complimented our dinner experience 🙌 Good going team wendys! 🙌😊

Went drive thru around 2.15pm on a weekday. Service was great. But my cheeseburger patty was really really thin 😲 Crispy chicken burger was great but the cheese burger was not worth it tbh. Check photos for proof!
I don't know Wendy's but your baconator is a little chewy. It was good but I expected it to be great, I will try again maybe it was a miss for me this time.

This establishment was extremely clean and tidy and the recent renovations have really made this place feel great! The staff brought the food to the table and there is also a self service area for sauce, or ketchup as the Americans would say. I enjoyed the option of having a baked potato or nachos rather than just fries for a side. The milkshakes are thicker than Nicki Minaj.

Great service and food, even though we had a technical issue with our order staff sorted it easily 👍 restaurant has had a little upgrade, so it was clean and tidy bathrooms were clean but a little dated.
Highly recommend their Kebabs and the Baklava I rate the Kebab 10/10 and 9/10 for the Baklava.

Been regular here for my chicken or lamb kebab combo....as always their taste of food, service, food quality and portion remains the same......value for money plus the food is a bomb. Their garlic sauce is extra ordinary out of the world. Best kebab shop for me in Auckland. Thank you for always serving me with love and good quality tasty meals. Very highly recommended them...

I called to order from you for the first time in a long while, I want to thank the young girl her took my order very polite 💕I want to thanku for the best food I've had in lang time the lamb kabab was oozing with lots of lamb it was so delicious 😋 The potatoes wedges melting with garlic sauce 🤤 was so delicious and I'm so full I couldn't even eat it all I had to give it to my family to share Thankyou again for an excellent meal with awesome service will definitely be back to sit and eat 😁

After hearing about the unique flavors at Galaxy Pizza, I decided to visit and try it for myself. As someone who is quite particular when it comes to food, I must admit I was thoroughly impressed by the delicious pizzas. The flavors are truly one-of-a-kind, and the ingredients are spot on. To top it off, the staff were incredibly friendly, making the whole experience even better. I’ll definitely be coming back, and I highly recommend Galaxy Pizza to all pizza lovers!

Best loaded pizza, filled to the edge. They don't scrimp on the deliciousness. Our favorites are butter chicken with extra jalapeños, or the pesto chicken with extra mushrooms. Yum. Thanks team, you make a mean pizza.

If you’re looking for delicious food that’s bursting with flavour and culture, look no further than Satay Noodle House. This family oriented restaurant offers a warm, welcoming atmosphere that instantly makes you feel at home. The dishes are absolutely tasty—authentic, rich, and cooked with care. You can really taste the love and tradition in every bite. The team here is incredibly friendly and helpful, always going the extra mile to make your experience enjoyable. Highly recommend for anyone who appreciates good food and a genuine cultural experience. A true hidden gem! To the team…keep up the amazing service and serving us the yummy delicious food.
We thought the food lacked flavor and was overly sweet. The fried foods, fried rice, and pork belly were better than the other items.

First time dining in and I loved it. The ambience gives “family home” vibes. Absolutely loved it. The workers? Awesome service. We had - Wontons Spring rolls Thai Curry Prawn dry rice noodles Beef dry egg noodles Pork chops on rice Everything made to order and absolutely delicious. The pork chops were my least favourite but still yum. My absolute favourite was the thai curry and spring rolls! We will definitely go back and take our kids with us. Family owned business! You can tell they take so much pride and love what they do.

Tried the half chicken satay and half garlic chicken on rice today...the satay is alright but would be so much better with friends veges. Have had a few other things here before and they were mostly soo good, especially the wontons. But the garlic chicken rice was really bad. Way too much soy sauce, it's all I can taste. Definitely can't taste any garlic

by far the best I’ve had in the South! From the very first bite, I could tell this wasn’t your average canteen food. The satay chicken were bursting with flavor – a perfect blend of creamy, nutty satay sauce with just the right hint of spice. The noodles were cooked to perfection – not too soft, not too firm – and every bite was packed with that comforting, savory taste you look for in a great satay dish. The fried rice was equally impressive. Light and fluffy, not greasy at all, and full of well-balanced seasoning. Each spoonful had a mix of fresh vegetables and perfectly cooked rice, making it a complete and satisfying meal on its own. What really impressed me was the consistency and quality, especially for a canteen setting. The portions were generous, the food was served hot and fresh, and the overall experience felt like a hidden gem worth talking about. If you’re ever nearby and looking for something hearty, flavorful, and affordable, I highly recommend trying the fried rice and satay noodles here. You won’t be disappointed

I and my wife went for coffee multiple times and the consistency remain same . Its awesome and strong coffee and always pretty. EVOM makes really good coffee . She is always happy , smiling and greets you . Cafe is very cozy and very clean as well. Must visit .

Highly, highly recommend! Personally think it's one of the best cafe's in Papakura! Good prices for some plates as they have big servings. In the heart of Papakura is a pleasant surprise. Once you close the door behind you, you will find yourself in a different world. It has a good atmosphere and obviously the restaurant of choice for the local community. The food was good but had expected a little more for the price. The restaurant service was superb. It definitely helped with the atmosphere, having the door closed to the main road. Very peaceful. We didn't have a reservation, we arrived closer to 2030hr and were seated immediately. The service from the staff was welcoming and friendly. The food came out quickly but didn't feel rushed. The portions were good, not too big not too small. One of the hosts also made a recommendation for a side dish to go along with our mains, this was much appreciated. The layout is spacious and it doesn't feel like we were sitting in on other groups'conversation. Will be back again

Red Earth Restaurant on the main street of Papakura is truly a hidden gem. From the moment we walked in, the ambiance was warm and inviting — the perfect setting for a romantic date night or a special evening out. We began our meal with the Seafood Chowder and the Firecracker Prawns. Both starters were absolutely delicious — the chowder was rich and comforting, while the prawns delivered the perfect balance of spice and flavor. For our main, we chose the Hanging Lamb, served with fries and a garlic roasted red wine sauce — simply divine. The meat was tender and packed with flavor, and the sauce elevated the dish beautifully. And then came the showstopper — Sticky Date Pudding with Ice Cream. The presentation was stunning, and the taste... unbelievably good. It was the perfect sweet ending to an unforgettable meal. A big shoutout and heartfelt thanks to Naummu, Shiva, Janaiya, and Bella — each of them made us feel incredibly welcome and provided outstanding service throughout the evening. Highly recommended — if I could give more than five stars, I absolutely would. Compliments to the chefs and the entire team at Red Earth. We’ll definitely be back * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

I had one of the worst food experiences ever, and I feel compelled to share it so others don’t have to go through the same. I had ordered a veg pizza, very clearly expecting a vegetarian meal – only to find bacon on it when I opened the box at home. My partner don’t eat meat, and this was not just a mistake—it was a serious violation of dietary preferences and values. When I went to the place to report it, expecting at least a sincere apology and some accountability, I was shocked by how casually and rudely the staff responded. Instead of owning up to their mistake, they blamed me, saying: “How would I know you didn’t put it at home?” What kind of logic is that? Why would any customer add bacon to a vegetarian pizza themselves and then complain? There was no empathy, no responsibility, not even the slightest attempt to make things right. Just a cold, dismissive tone that made it clear they didn’t care about customer satisfaction or basic respect. I felt not just disappointed but honestly insulted. Food is personal—whether it's for religious, ethical, or health reasons—and when a place disregards that, it’s not a small issue. They didn’t just mess up an order; they ruined my meal, ignored my concerns, and showed absolutely no professionalism. Shameful behavior. I would not recommend this place to anyone who values food safety, customer service, or basic human decency. Please be cautious if you have dietary restrictions. I hope no one else has to go through something like this. I would like to get a call from this place owner :)

Beautiful place, nice food, having a catch up brunch for my girl’s birthday with her friends. Function dining room is great.

The arancini balls were filling and absolutely delicious! To be honest, I got a bit full just from eating those alone. They were large and packed with flavor. The chicken Japanese curry was also tasty, though I wish there was more chicken, there was so much rice and curry that it felt like there wasn’t quite enough to balance the dish. The pork belly noodles were okay, but the pork was a little tough. Overall, it was a lovely evening and a great opportunity to try their dinner menu, as we usually visit for their lovely breakfast. Bonus it’s dog-friendly!

Food was delicious. I ordered the melba breakfast which came with eggs of your choice, bacon, sourdough slice, hash brown, mushrooms. My partner had the Angus beef burger and fries. The customer service is good, didn't have to wait long. Our order was taken, drinks arrived shortly after and then the food arrived. I like the ambiance of the whole cafe, perfect for a morning breakfast with friends and family. Definitely would come here again 👍 FYI the parking could get tight around peak hours as they have a sign at the entrance advising customers not to park by the mc Donald's.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Always a great experience! Every time I’ve gone into Subway Karaka on Harbourside Drive, the staff are always smiling and welcoming. The service is consistently awesome – quick, friendly, and efficient. It’s clear they take pride in what they do. Definitely one of the best Subway stores around!

Looks like they cut corners on the app orders. It's better to deactivate app orders if that what you are going to serve. When I asked to speak to the manager, the staff said they are overseas. Are you kidding me??

What a disgrace! My elderly parents went in here on the afternoon of the 4th of March and had a terrible experience. When they entered there was no staff member at the counter but they could hear what sounded like an argument out the back. When a staff member came out they didn’t say a word to my parents and didn’t give them a chance to choose what bread they wanted and just grabbed whatever was on hand. When it came to toppings again they didn’t ask and put a minimal amount of random toppings and didn’t ask what sauce, just put a random one on. All the while they barely spoke a word to my parents. The food was very poor and the service was pitiful. Do better Subway Karaka!

Highly recommend not to go to this subway. Asked for grilled wrap.The lady took out foot long. Barely puts ingredients. Spinach leaves I had to ask thrice if I could have a bit more. Each time she put 2 spinach leaves.Each of those ingredients they only put 2 each. I have been to other subways and have noticed they put a generous amount of ingredients. This is the worst subway I have been to. Very poor customer service. Not going ever again.
Good food Great customer service, he is very nice and polite person I am very appreciate Hardik.

Usually this place is great, always correct food and helpful staff. Today i was very hungry and unfortunately my McChicken (with extra bacon and cheese i paid for) did not have bacon, and somehow did not have any lettuce??? by the time i got to my burger i was halfway home and thought it would be stupid to drive all the way back just for some lettuce and bacon. not very happy about that. How do you miss lettuce in a McChicken, thats like the basic recipe
Very quick service n clean. Suggest checking ur order on pick up to make sure u get everything u paid for

Stopped in for breakfast, very new upmarket McDonald's with great dining a private room is available for functions it is quite small though it also has an indoor playground for the kid's the resteraunt was clean and was quite busy at this time my order was prepared in a reasonable time overall it was a nice experience with a hard working team! thank you, Karaka McDonald's 😊
This store is kids friendly, there’s playground, kid’s chair on site. Mc cafe is available here. Overall is good, just need a bit more attention to the cleanness.
I know I know, it’s McDonald’s they always mess everyone’s orders up but come on dude… even I can read that 😂

The best pizza hut in town!!!!! Kuljinder is the best guy and makes you feel soooooo welcome at his restaurant. If its not the taste of food, it’s his kindness and genuineness that brings people into his store.
Could always be better ingredients but the team at karaka give excellent service every time. Always hot and ready on time. Recommend to all

1st time I have visited this Pizza Hut. Very handy location to Motorway whether you are heading North or South. Plenty of places to park or stop in the area. Good Pizza, friendly team, overall a positive experience.

Rude staff. Overcooked pizza, under cooked garlic bread. Missing order notes and charged for. 35min wait in store after making online order 40min prior. However people were able to walk in make a big order and then receive within 20-15min.
Amazing customer service last visit, some issue with order and Price sorted it all out for me.

Came here after being lured by reel of ig food influencer. Did not disappoint. The seafood platter was scrumptious and salivating. Was confused by the meat inside the fried croquettes, turns out it's crab in white sauce. Everything was beautifully cooked and presented, I suggest if you are a seafood fiend, it's worth the drive out to Karaka to experience it yourself. The restaurant itself is comfortable and new(ish) since the hotel only opened in 2022. Very glad I braved the rain and traffic to taste such an exquisite dinner!

We booked a table for two and specifically requested the seafood platter for two. We also ordered starters. The food was fantastic and came out promptly. The service, however, was disappointing. It started off well, with our waiter arriving quickly to take our orders. We waited a little for drinks, but it wasn’t too bad. A few minutes after our food arrived, the waiter came by to check if everything was fine, then left. Unfortunately, we never saw him again. Even after trying to wave down another waiter to order more drinks, no one attended to our table. The restaurant wasn’t busy, with only a few other tables occupied. In the end, we couldn’t even order dessert. So we went to the till paid and left. Your easily lost another $100 worth of sales from us on an already $200+ bill

Had to wait 5 minutes to be seated at a table that i booked. People were sitting there drinking. Absolute rubbish. Very disappointing. Who puts melted cheese on a crayfish tail. Seafood chowder was yellow water with one half of a cocktail mussel.. The size of my finger nail. Prosciutto was so overcooked that it bounced off the plate and flew across the room. Might be a good place to stay if you are traveling for work. If you want fish and chips takeaways dressed up as fine dining cuisine. Then this is the place to go. You even get a waiter wearing a full suit. But not to worry! There is a McDonalds drive through directly across the road at the main intersection.

A Truly Special 75th Birthday Brunch at the Hilton! Our recent experience at the Hilton brunch buffet was nothing short of wonderful, especially as we were celebrating a significant 75th birthday with a large group. From the moment we arrived, the staff made us feel incredibly welcome and went above and beyond to make the occasion memorable. A huge highlight was when the staff gathered to sing "Happy Birthday," which added such a personal and heartwarming touch, making our celebration feel extra special. The food selection was truly fantastic, offering something for everyone in our diverse group. The younger members of our party were particularly delighted with the Eggs Benedict and the delicious corn fritters – a definite hit! Overall, the Hilton brunch buffet proved to be a great spot for a family celebration. We highly recommend it for its warm atmosphere, attentive staff, and excellent food. We'll certainly be back!
We ordered the seafood platte, which is beautiful, the taste and freshness are great , we really enjoy it, but the fries were bad, is very dry you can see from the photos and we didn't eat it.
Compared to any other branch I've been, the serving size of meat to rice is small - by a long way Also lots of cartilage, not impressed.

This was the last time I ordered from here. I’m not sure what ingredients they use, almost every instance I get stomach issues (unlike when bought from other branches). They either have a poor food hygiene or something worse. No wonder there are so many bad reviews.

Hello I just placed a order on Uber eats I paid 22$ for Katsu chicken dragon roll just to get 70% rice 20%veg and 10% chicken, I literally had to eat with my hands because they gave no fork no chopsticks or napkins we all know how messy things get with dragon rolls it’s got sauce all over it so it’s a must for cutlery cheers!

Delighted that they have opened in Karaka. The sushi was so fresh and delicious. I have a very serious avocado allergy and the staff was so careful, they put on new gloves took out all clean unused equipment to prepare and roll my sushi and they even cut it by hand so as not to get any avocado traces in my sushi. The staff is so friendly and helpful, can't wait to stop in again and get another salmon roll!

I had high hopes when this branch opened but ive become more and more frustrated by their tactics. They constantly provide average rude service here and they hide both the sushi of the day and the half and half of the day behind the counter probably an intentional tactic to try and make people buy more expensive sushi packs. They wont make you up any Sushi after 7pm yet they are open till 8pm and they will also try to upsell you to a dearer pack whenever they can. Also on some occassions the Sushi seems not fresh as though it has been refrigerated/frozen then brought out when needed.

Not impressed - this is usually my go to kfc. Ate here Sunday and I had a gut feeling my zinger patty felt off (uncooked) The chicken piece-chips etc were all fine. My gut hasn't been right since, please trust your instinct people.

Went here tonight to pick up dinner. Placed my order and was asked to wait out the front. Was told one of the items I ordered wasn't available and I could swap for another option or if I didn't mind waiting they were cooking a fresh batch. I Opted for the fresh batch. The whole interaction from drive though to getting my nice hot meal was pleasant. Destiny your customer service is awesome.

I would personally like to thank the Manager on tonight she was beautiful in every way, even though it was super busy on drive through and inside restaurant she still showed amazing service to us and was very apologetic to us customers waiting for our orders, I watched her take orders for when people didn’t know how to order on the machines, to help deliver customers orders out fast in restaurant and ensuring she didn’t miss anything and then walking out with orders for drive through, she also was making sure the restaurant was clean, asking customers that were waiting if they were okay or if they would like a seat, I could hear her asking customers if they were enjoying there food and if they were happy. I was very impressed on how well she managed everything while being so busy. Because of you Destiny I will be back and hopefully you are on because your customer service was amazing very friendly, helpful and polite. Best Manager I’ve seen at Karaka 😊 it is worth the wait if you destiny are serving and packing our orders 😁 be prepared to be satisfied with the most exceptional customer service.

I just had an absolutely fantastic experience at KFC Karaka Yesterday! From the moment I walked in, I was impressed by how spotlessly clean the entire restaurant was – a truly welcoming sight. My food was served quickly and, most importantly, it was piping hot and delicious, just how KFC should be. What truly elevated this visit was the outstanding customer service. The entire team was friendly and efficient, but I must give a special shout-out to Supervisor Laxmi. She was incredibly attentive, professional, and genuinely went above and beyond to ensure everyone had a great experience.

This KFC started off awesome and then fast declined. Tables aren't cleaned or checked that it is decent for the next customer coming in. We used to like dinning in but prefer now to sit in our car or go home. Staff aren't very friendly either.
Nice and clean branch. The staff was friendly. However I felt totally shortchanged. The crispy burritos seemed had no meat at all which was very disappointing!

I have been coming to this taco bell for a while now. However, Today, i noticed that quantity of the crispy chicken tacos is not the same as it was last time. The stuffing was not enough. Overall, it was a bad experience.
Fast service. The location is convenient, with plenty of parking and easy access to State Highway 1. Good spot for a quick and tasty bite.

Great night out with the family for the first time trying Taco Bell, and it was fantastic. we ordered nearly everything on the menu and loved it. Chips, hot tacos were fresh, and drinks were refills! They even had music you could queue yourself on the digital jukebox.

First time and actually enjoyed it! Loads of parking, easy to access from motorway. Plenty of seating. Counter and kiosk ordering available. Decent prices and sizes of portions. Good flavours. Self serve drinks that include frozen options. Lots of options for appetite levels and spice styles. Added sauce packets are great spice!

Fast and easy service. Excellent and very presentable 💯 Taste was exceptional 😋 The place itself was very clean n tidy! Keep up the good work guys. 2 chicken waffles plus 500ml beer n caramel latte. Worth around 88 bucks not bad at all 👏💯💯

Great place for family dining in Karaka :) We went for dinner and ordered a variety of stuff. Food was decent, portions were large and it was delicious. They still had a fair amount of selection for cabinet desserts which was handy. Will be keen to try their breakfast/lunch offering next time.

Urban Soul Café offers a welcoming atmosphere and friendly service, but when it comes to keto options, the menu leaves much to be desired. For those following a keto lifestyle, the choices are minimal, and the breakfast options, while decent in taste, are on the pricier side. The café could benefit from expanding its keto-friendly offerings to cater to a broader audience. Overall, while the ambiance and service are commendable, the limited keto menu and average value for money might not make it the top choice for keto enthusiasts.

I got a couple of coffees and a tiramisu brownie from Urban Soul this morning. Coffees were good, nothing to complain about. But the brownie was a disappointment. The creative idea of tiramisu on top of the chocolate brownie was great, the reason I bought it in an impulse to begin with. The brownie was dry and hard. Maybe they were left overs from yesterday…? It was just off putting and I could not enjoy the brownie. In to the bin it went. I went in the morning so cannot make detailed comment about atmosphere, however the place looked open and spacious.

We were here last night for our team dinner. We were well looked after by a young man that waited on us. Food around the table was rated between an 8 - 10/10 I had the brisket burger and fries and the meat was super tender and the fries were really good. I even ordered a takeout of the fries. Service was fast and impeccable. The atmosphere was chill and the area was kept warm with the heaters. As a team we highly recommend others to check it out.

Cinnamon, Indian Eatery & Bar is a hidden gem that brings authentic Indian flavours to life in a warm and stylish setting. We celebrated our father’s 85th birthday here and the dining experience was amazing. A special mention to Ankit, the manager, whose friendly and professional service truly elevated the dining experience. He took genuine care in ensuring guests felt welcome and looked after, and his knowledge of the menu is incredibly helpful if you’re unsure what to try. We tried Lamb Sheekh Kebab, Chicken Tikka, Fish Tikka, Dam Ka Chicken, Keema Mutton and they all were flavoursome. My niece and I enjoyed a cup of their Masala Chai, and it was the perfect finish – fragrant, warming, and made just the way chai should be. Highly recommended.

A truly memorable experience at Cinnamon! From the moment we walked in, we were welcomed with genuine warmth and a beautifully inviting atmosphere. The ambiance was both cozy and sophisticated, perfect for a relaxing evening or a special occasion. The food was absolutely phenomenal — every dish was packed with flavour and cooked to perfection. The butter chicken and garlic naan were standout favourites, and the vegetarian options were just as rich and satisfying. You can really taste the authenticity and care in every bite. What truly impressed us was the exceptional service. The staff were friendly, knowledgeable, and incredibly accommodating. We mentioned — very last minute — that we were celebrating a friend’s birthday, and they quickly arranged a delicious cake without any fuss. It was such a thoughtful touch and made the night even more special. Cinnamon has won us over completely. Amazing food, top-tier service, and a team that genuinely goes the extra mile. Highly recommend for any occasion!

Enjoyed a great dinner here on a Friday night. The menu was extensive and the dishes we ordered were excellent, well prepared and presented. Food was well priced and the service was attentive. The interior design is good, and lighting subdued. The restaurant is compact and was busy so noisier than I would have liked. It is part of the established commercial and retail precinct at 75 Hingaia Road, so there is plenty of off street parking.

We had takeout and the butter chicken was exactly how I like it, not too sweet and not too tomatoey either, it was perfect. The vindaloo was okay but I’ve had better and the biryani was really good. The garlic naan however, didn’t taste fresh even though we did have to wait a while for our order. There wasn’t much of a garlic taste either, it was hard and stale unfortunately. I did bring a heat bag with me so everything could stay fresh so it wasn’t a case of it being “takeout”. I would still go back but hopefully it’s better next time.

We had a fantastic experience at Cinnamon, Indian Eatery & Bar! The ambiance was warm and inviting, creating a great dining atmosphere. The food was absolutely amazing—full of authentic flavors and served in generous portions. The service was excellent, with friendly and attentive staff making sure we had everything we needed. A great spot for Indian cuisine—I highly recommend it!

We got the beef don lunch special which includes miso and the Korean fried chicken to share. Lovely people that seems family run and place is nice and clean. Food is tasty maybe Korean style Japanese which is a win-win 😎

Best place we ever had sushi from. My fiance and I have been getting sushi from other places and this place is better. Always fresh ☺️. It's our go to place every Saturday morning but haven't been back there since before Christmas last year. We shall be back soon
The teriyaki chicken was delicious - perfectly cooked chicken and flavorful teriyaki. Service was quick. My husband enjoyed his Katsu curry as well. Good place to eat for a quick and filling meal.

Korean/western style sushi. Too large and featuring cream cheese, dmoked chicken sweet sauces and all kinds of stuff we've introduced to destroy sushi 😅😭 I felt sorry for the lady serving as the manager seemed mean. It's something to eat if you find yourself stuck in this bizaar new-build McMansion area but I wouldn't recommend it.

The sushi is tasty but the value for money on the meals is not great. $23 for a salmon salad which is about half the size with less salmon and no egg compared to seven poke in the city. Best bet is to stick with the sushi pieces else you will need to get 2 meals (I'm not a big eater but was left wanting more)
Chinese food here was hot and fresh. Absolutely delicious and satisfying. Love the crispy wontons with the sauce on the side, this place is a great option for dinner. 😊😁

Love love love this takeaways. Their spring rolls remind me of the ones i use to get at my high school when i was a teen 🤤🤤 fish is soooo good! The honey chicken, and curry beef are my absolute favourites to get from there 🤤

Brought the Chicken Fried Rice, Steak Chow Mein, Sweet & Sour Pork, Egg Foo Yong and Chips for 4 adults and 3 kids! Everything was delicious as always (tonight’s food though .. was on point 💯😍). Verges we’re nice n fresh meats were juicy and we had leftovers for lunch tge next day .. possibly one of thee best in Auckland 🥰

This has been my favorite Chinese takeaway since i was a kid, I started coming here when I was 13, I am 26 now and their food is still just as great! I absolutely love the Chicken stir fried noodles. Their deep fried food is also really good and with an amazing batter! My favorite are the spring rolls :) The staff are just awesome, friendly and extremely hard working. 5 Stars 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
Ordered chicken fried rice and damm, it’s nice. Large portions, juicy chicken, lots of other ingredients and flavourful rice. People working there were also positive and friendly. Would go again!!

It is just a hidden gem in papakura , we tried the veg burger that had a yummmm paneer tikki and it was freshly cooked and soo tasty. Kids also loved their kids burger. Most affordable price and such a humble person. Must visit with family and friends.
We loved the souvlakis , kebab combos..fresh n tasted so good 👌 my boy loved it.. thanks. Will be back again
Best kebab in Auckland

Sorry but the fish has an after taste like bad medicine to it. I couldn't finish the whole $17 special. The saving grace would be the vanilla smoothie and chips but still felt it wasn't worth it for the whole experience.
A devoted customer to previous owners cheeseburgers and chips. Made an effort to come on here to say to the new owners well done we'll be back. That was value for money and tasted just as good.

I've lived in rosehill my whole life and this was my takeaway to go. Chip portions are quite small and fish is overbatted. Would recommend their cheeseburgers as they are worth ya buck. Overall not bad

This is my local fish & chip shop. I dont eat here often but when i do i usually get a burger and chips.Their burgers are delicous, reasonably priced and quite big. Their chips are ALWAYS hot, crunchy on the outside & light & fluffy in the middle. I personally would not get the fish because the batter they use is thick & its to heavy for me. They also dont have eftpos BUT they have the best burgers and chips in Papakura ib my opinion.

The owner has been serving his local community for years. His fish is cooked properly and the batter is not uncooked dough like many others in REWA and KURA. I can't stand the uncooked dough of the batter, its freaking garbage. However, this has not happened at Rosehill Takeaways that I know off. Others may have a different experience, but as a new customer I wish I had found him earlier. $5 chips can feed 4 adults, and they are tasty. Imagine $10 or $20! His combo deals are fair. The only snag is he has no eftpos and accepts cash only. But, the dairy is more than happy if you buy your drinks from them and get cash to pay for your chips.

We recently had Masala Vibe Catering for Shri Sukhmani Sahib Paath ceremony at our new home, and we couldn’t be happier with their service! From start to finish, everything was handled with such professionalism and care. The food was absolutely delicious — fresh, authentic, and full of flavour. Our guests are still talking about how amazing everything tasted! The team was punctual, well-organized, and very respectful of the occasion. They managed everything seamlessly, allowing us to fully focus on the ceremony and spend time with our guests without any stress. Masala Vibe truly brought a special touch to our event, and we are so grateful. Without a doubt, they are the best catering service in Auckland for traditional events. Highly recommended — we will definitely be booking them again for future celebrations!

Absolutely Outstanding Food & Service! Whenever we plan a party, delicious food is always our top priority — but finding great quality food in NZ, especially from restaurants, has often been disappointing. That changed when I came across Masala Vibes on Marketplace. The food presentation caught my eye, and after speaking with Amita, I was confident in my choice. She’s incredibly polite, listens carefully to customer needs, and truly cares about quality. When the food arrived at our home, the real magic began — every single guest raved about it! It was not just good, it was 1000 times better than any restaurant we’ve tried. Flavorful, authentic, and beautifully presented — Masala Vibes exceeded every expectation. Thank you, Amita, for making our celebration so memorable. Highly recommended to anyone in NZ looking for exceptional food and service!

Absolutely loved the food! Great taste and good portion sizes. I had a quick chat with one of the team members about pricing, and they explained everything clearly and politely. Really appreciated the transparency. Looking forward to ordering again — and thank you

First of all , I wanna thank masala vibes to cater my cute family get together on a short notice. The homely food, professional presentation and cooperative nature of the team make them a desirable and deserving candidate for appreciation. First choice for my next event. Kudos to the team keep up the good work.

Amita and her team are very professional. The food was very tasty. Everything we ordered was neatly packed and delivered with care. All my guests loved it. We catered a fully vegetarian menu for the event . Can’t wait to try the non vegetarian options. Will definitely order again!

One of the tastiest burger I have ever had. I tried their noodles burger and kulcha – both were absolutely delicious. The noodles burger was outstanding, bursting with flavour and spices that instantly reminded me of India. The kulcha was amazing too – soft, perfectly stuffed, and served fresh. Prices are very reasonable for the quality and portion of food. Highly recommend this place for anyone craving authentic Indian street food vibes. Great food, great taste!

Very yummy 😋 and delicious food, Value for money Burger and chaat yum yum Sister i am sorry to put this review: Your service these days are pathetic, your timings are wrong, at least update your operating hours or answer your phone. Me and my friends come all the way from Flatbush. SHAME. 😡
Great taste and lot of food variety 😋😋. Moreover the prices are very reasonable. The service and presentation is outstanding. Very fond of the yummy and delicious taste by Grazeyard 🙌🏻😍
Great food , Specially the fish fry and chicken soup reminds me the taste in Punjab 😋😋. Keep it up Grazeyard 👍🏻
Great taste and fantastic service!! Good quantity at an affordable price.
Food is awesome. Loved their dabeli/Sev Puri/Dahi Puri/Bhel. Dabeli is a must try dish. It’s a great place to chilli with outdoor sitting. Highly recommended place to try.
All the dishes were delicious, and they serve the best Kacchi Dabeli in Auckland. The owner was also very welcoming.
Good place to chill with friends .. Sandwich and kulfi must try 😋🤤
Amazing food and service. Delicious food with flavor of India. Specially Sevpuri was really tasty. Will definitely come back. Thanks.
Awesome food. Highly recommended. Dabali is a signature dish and a must to try. All other dishes are as super good.

Bought 5 samosas and 4 bread pakoras with masala choose and 1 kg moti chuur ladoo. Samosas were ok and choose as well but the bread pakoras were like made out of plastic so hard and old you would not serve them if you are in your senses. Pls stop taking customers for granted🙏🙏🙏
This has been our go to place from last 3 years now. Every time the food never fails the standards. Feels like home…

I ordered 2 servings of garam gajrela via Uber eat and this store sent me small pieces of microwaved Gajrela barfi. When I called at the store to enquire, their staff said that their gajrela is finished that's why they sent me gajrela barfi instead. This is not their first time Punjab express is messing up with orders. My suggestion to them is either improve or close this pathetic shop.
The best kulfis ever, the service is always soo good. Staff is super nice. The best things are the fresh jalebi, samosas and kulfis. Highly recommend.

I recently visited Punjab Express Papakura and, for the first time, I saw such a friendly staff there.There is a lady with glasses who really impressed me – she is extremely hardworking, very fast at her job, and has excellent communication skills. Her dedication and efficiency made my visit a wonderful experience.

I rarely leave negative reviews, but I feel compelled to share my recent experience in the hope that it leads to improvements. I placed an order with Select Pizza based in Papakura, but unfortunately, my experience was far from satisfactory. The delivery arrived over 45 minutes late, with no communication or update regarding the delay. By the time the food arrived, it was lukewarm at best. What was more disappointing was the quality of the pizza itself. The crust was undercooked and soggy, the toppings were unevenly spread, and the cheese was poorly melted — it felt hastily assembled and lacked any care in preparation. It certainly didn’t reflect the standard I expected from an established business. Mistakes can happen, but the lack of both prompt service and food quality on the same order is unacceptable. I hope the management takes this feedback seriously and puts steps in place to ensure better quality control and more reliable delivery in the future. Until then, I won’t be ordering again.

Normally get on Uber. Won't be getting at all now after ordering and picking up from shop. Very arrogant service, took over 40 mins which is Normally only 30mins to your door via Uber. Order thin and crispy but got normal pizza base. I don't recommend and will never be going back to Select pizza ever. Very poor.
Had a best pizza here with a great Indian touch. Google has the option of 5 star only but would give them more than 5💫 we loved it
Great Experience , great food , definitely recommend if you want to go somewhere for a late night feed and chat :) , great prices too was $12 for 2 large pizzas

Yesterday I oder pickup spicy vegitarian pizza 🍕 that was not good at all after one or two slides pizzaa I leave over there. It was just waste of money. No good in taste waste of money. I leave pizza over there. Not recommended at all.

Ordered dinner for two with mash potato & baked chippies.(noticed theyre baked because they were not full of oil) Was delicious the ribs were falling off the bone lots of sauce got a free garlic bread which was lovely and soft i would order again

Bloody rip off they advertise for buy one shake then get the second for free then they only full the containers 1/2 way potato was cold ribs were tasty but by god they will be getting a visit from me Not thg kiwi way not at all

Had to rate these 5 star. First time trying and saw the reviews after I already ordered so wasn't expecting much. Very surprised at how delicious the food was. Got 4 Peri wings, 4 Hot and Spicy, Curly Fries and Ranch. Came with free Garlic Bread. Wings are on par, quality wise with Nandos, just flats and drums. Cheap enough, Around 38 dollars. Will be ordering again! Surprised that people rate this place so low... 🤷‍♂️

If you haven't been before (like us), the location in Papakura is collection at a Pizza place. No actual Robs and Wings sign :) The chips weren't very nice but the ribs were AMAZING. Juicy, tender, fall off the bone kinda ribs. Will be back for the ribs again definitely. My favorite was the maple ribs. My hubby enjoyed the BBQ ribs. They were both delicious! We enjoyed the wings too. Although they were more like nibbles which isn't a complaint. We had the Buffalo wings. They reminded us of the Sals Pizza wings. Overall, enjoyed our meal. We will be back again to support this local :)

Ordered on Uber eats. Chips were warm, undercooked and stale tasting. Ribs were okay, nothing amazing. Chocolate mousse was completely rotten, covered in a slimy film and stunk out my kitchen. It has to have been sitting outside for days - will not trust the hygiene of this place ever again.
Love this place. Worth it for a big family meals.
We've been coming here for some time now, enjoy their roast pork on rice and wonton noodle soup
Try their bbq option I love the duck and pork belly on rice it amazing with the duck sauce 😋
Not worth the $ to get food here not always hot just warm food ppl pay money for hot healthy food not warm. So expensive too!

These guys are a rip off I ordered 4 items from them on Uber eats only to recieve 1 item. So I called them up for my refund only to recieve nothing back. I will pay your store a visit if I don’t get my refund back

Adding fruit as a background flavor to the butter chicken is the worst thing to do I don't feel like I'm having butter chicken at all. What ever extra ingredient your using don't do it it's destroying the meal itself. I can't comment on anything else the fruit flavor is just too strong in this

💯My New Favourite spot 👍🏻 for hands down “THE BEST CURRY I.. HAVE EVER EATEN”💯 Im So happy to have stumbled across Turmeric & decided to try what was on offer. absolutely blown away at the value “$19.99 for curry rice and bread” for the quality of the food I received they could charge $28-30? just for the curry alone. It was Everything an authentic delicious Indian meal should be.. I’m excited to try much more! 🤩And I’m return tonight for MORE! .. two nights in a row .. Yum! 🤤 I was Immediately impressed with the aroma of fresh 🌶️spice as I walked in.. an Excellent Sign that this will be a good spot for a curry all fresh ingredients made lovingly by hand in-house “just like how mum would make it 😉 Yum! The pleasant welcoming helpful & polite host greeted me like a friend he hadn’t seen in far to long 👍🏻 💯🙂 When I saw the menu I wanted to order more food than I had the money to pay for.. I was having difficulty choosing one over the other and I had to have that delicious looking fresh mango lassi he kindly assisted by making my order to suit the amount of money I had available to spend. “Very kind indeed” and that lassi was mine! Yum! “There are so many Indian food places in papakura and “none” of them are any good!” 🤩🤗🤤TRY TURMERIC!🤤🤗🤩 If you’re disappointed there’s 💯% something wrong with “You” ….because it’s not the food! 😂🤣

I have always enjoyed dining in and taking takeout from your restaurant several times over the past three years. The butter chicken is consistently delicious. I even recommended your restaurant to my family, and we celebrated my birthday there last night. They all agreed it was the best Indian restaurant they have ever been to. I apologize for any miscommunication and inconvenience regarding the number of people and table arrangement, but I appreciate the staff's willingness to rearrange the tables so we could all sit together. Thank you :)

Do not get the butter chicken, it was disgusting and too God damn sweet.... it was the worst thing I've ever put in my mouth (I am a very fat man who eats lots of food). However, what saved my meal was the Biryani as it was nice and spicy. Even though the butter chicken was crap, I believe this place can serve up other better dishes.

Cozy little place with good music, atmosphere, and amazing food! This is a regular for me as I am very picky with taste in Indian food and personally, this place is IT for me🤗 Whether Uber Eats or pickup, food is always delicious, hot and keeps me coming back for more! Affordable prices, lots of choices and great deals on the menu! My go-to is their Masala Dosa or the Goat Curry 🤤 Amazing service always ❤️

Prices were good👍 mince and cheese pie 10/10 Quiche 8/10 I went there around 11am they had already run out of steak and cheese😭 maybe I should've asked incase there were more out the back? 🤷‍♀️no paywave though. Next time I go back in gonna get roast pork in a bun 😏

Cheapest bakery in town really yummy food best sausage roll I've tried everywhere in kura n taks and here is the go cheapest fried chicken and $10 roast pork rolls combod breakfast $11 kiwi breakfast and $16 for big breakfast wichnis in picture Big portion of bacon highly recommended this place yummy and awesome friendly couple will definitely be back
Bought a Steak Cheese Bacon pie from here yesterday! SO YUMMY! will be making this my papakura local!

Had a steak and pepper pie from here yesterday, initially I thought the pastry was quite dry/stale and temperature was warm but not hot. Was hungry and not many places open over the break, ate it anyway, woke up in the middle of night with stomach cramps and diarrhoea, and this morning have felt nauseous. If the owner sees this, turn up your heating cabinet! And don’t sell old pies!

Friendly service, you can tell they put love into their food. The chicken rolls are off the hook yum and well priced, unlike these other greedy bakeries that charge an arm an a leg for food. Their kiwi breakfast was yum too, decent portions and well priced for what you get. Overall I give it 5 stars, probably one of the better food places in papakura, in terms of taste, customer service and pricing. Love this place.

I thought I’d try something different. I had a 3 curry combo. Don’t ask me what I got as I couldn’t pronounce or remember what he said they were. Overall it was a good meal for $17. If you like vegetarian Indian food then I’d recommend trying here. Parking can be an issue unless you park across the road in the supermarket car park. Service was a little slow.

I had an incredible dining experience at Mithaiwala Papakura. The food was absolutely delicious, with authentic flavors and perfectly balanced spices. The Butter Paneer was a standout—so rich and flavorful!
