I tried the Chole Bhature and it was quite good. The ambience was calm, with soft background music creating a relaxed setting. Service was decent, though not exceptional. Overall, Mithaiwala is a good budget-friendly spot for a casual dine-in experience.

PLEASE DONT BUY SAMOSA Note: Another user had similar review a month ago. And I experienced same today, thus will warn others with my detailed review. PLEASE DONT BUY SAMOSA. They were stale…..I am usually not the person who complains on a public platform but despite complaining nicely over phone first time, they said they will replace. Asked if they going to reuse same material as that will be smelly too….They assured no we will fry fresh ones with fresh material. I waited 20 minutes. They gave 2 complimentary samosas too…. Came back home with hope these will be all okay. But to my shock they were smelly again and stale. Same material reused and fried to give illusion to customer as if they getting replaced good material. But not. Had they told me on call - they will replace samosa with other item due to entire batch being stale it would have been better. But nah they did not live upto keeping their promise SO NOT going again to this shop.
Came first time Ordered samosa chat and chilli cauliflower Samosa chat was so bad. So much yogurt and cold. No red red chutney Cauliflower was old and sogy. Should be crispy Tata bye bye

Your usual late night stop for a decent takeaway meal at a reasonable price. Definitely brought back the nostalgia of Club Raro in Papatoetoe and trying not to twist your ankle walking down the stairs to have a feed at Lil Abners. Also a good place just to get a roast chicken meal (that's not deep fried or battered).

Probably wouldn’t recommend the chicken, tasted like last night and an un-washed oven. I grew up with brothers who heated up leftover chicken from last night, for dinner and this is what it reminded me of. The chicken also had traces of blood dripping so it looks like my chicken was put back onto the rotisserie at the bottom, to be heated again, while fresh/raw chicken was cooked over the top of it. The chicken isn’t fresh at all - order was made at around 5pm and this is what we got. We’re new to the area but definitely won’t be back.
Just had the meatball roll, if i wasn't worried about putting on weight, it would be at least 3/4 per week. Great flavour 👍
I love this place. I ordered the mixed nachos and Me Meal. Fresh and taste amazing. Chips are 😍

Hands down this place makes the best chicken kebabs around 😍 always sooooo yummy and juicy, heaps of sauce and salad as well as the tasty chicken. Never fails to satisfy. Also the best hotdogs in my opinion. Goes well with kebab and chips. Yum✨🩷

Had special No.4 Fish a bit over done unfortunately. Chips good, Potato fritters, very small, I seldom find a sausage I like, I prefer crab sticks perhaps? At least nothing was oily. I'm sure I had it better here before.

Was a great day out with family. There are some amazing animals here and you're pretty close. There are a few empty lots, but I'm guessing it's getting harder to get or replace animals, birds and reptiles. In all it's a very nice Zoo.
The best fish and chips in Papakura best snapper combo I've had in ages yummy as! And the fried bread!!! Highly recommend 👌
Called in here Wednesday 3 July 2024 for 2 piece of fish (hapuka), 3 mussels & crab stick $14.60. Nice n crispy batter & fish was fresh.
Such a great place to go if you want fresh snapper. We drive from botany just for a decent snapper meal. Fantastic customer service
Loved the eggs bene, heaps of sauce 😋 My daughter got the banana pancakes & bacon and loved it. Really good sized portions, great value for money, lovely staff. Definitely going back 😁
Great food, very basic but worth the money and yum. A bit of a crazy customer in-store and the staff handled it calmly and professionally and still provided quick and good service

I had the mince and cheese pie, which was a little too peppery for my taste and could of used a little more cheese but was still OK... The Muffin was really nice, light and fluffy... I liked that the milkshake was served in a glass... I liked that my Aunty's coffee was served with a pretty design...
Gotta be one of the best spots in Papakura. Great coffee, and awesome kai at great prices. We love it here - it's a Kura staple!
They have a variety of hot foods as well as ready made food that you can take home/back to work to heat and eat.

I always have a great experience at Denny Kebab in Papakura. The food is tasty, but what really stands out is the service. The staff are very friendly and respectful, especially the Indian staff – they are always polite and kind, not just to the customers but also to the delivery drivers. I really enjoy the positive interactions every time I visit. It’s clear they care about people, and that makes all the difference. Highly recommend! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I’ve been eating here for years highly recommend i usually get a kebab or chicken salad combos first time trying burgers absolutely delicious

I ordered the super Kebab which contains lamb, chicken & falafel. Portion size was massive & contains quite a lot of chunky meats & only a bit of veg. The kebab was slightly dry & tasted quite bland, maybe it needed more sauce. I did not see a shawarma vertical rotisserie in store, the meat was grilled/reheated on a hot plate. Service is quite slow so probably best to order a head if you're on a lunch break.

Order arrived faster than estimated arrival time. Kebab was a good size and packed with delicious chicken, fresh salad and sauces. Loved how moist the inside of the kebab was without making the wrap soggy. Wedges were also soft on the inside and crunchy on the outside.
Went with family around 9.40pm lovely customer service... Everything ordered was up to the mark. Highly recommended...

This afternoon I rung and placed my order which cost 51.77 ,the male who answered the phone said give 20 minutes..that was fine.got there with plenty of time so I thought.paid at counter to having to wait seem like another half an hour. I noticed there were racks with food sitting in them and about 2 people sitting waiting then another 3 came in ordered and went out. I've always known this place to be good service but after the long break from take outs thought yes Blue Pacific the place to go. We'll I was wrong. When someone places an order it is usually in the warmer but when I arrived there were nothing. The 2 people who were there got served first then was my order. I am disgusted wasting my money on cold food. The chips looked yuck and the oil that cooked the food was gross. There were 2 workers behind the scene and the place did not look busy. It was when the 3rd person came in from the back my order was done up. Everything I ate was horrible . I will not go back there ever again , I will try my luck with grumpys next time. Blue pacific my grades for yous is appalling the whole service was. I wasted my money on horrible food. Improve your services and change the oil.

I've come here for the last 2 years and the fish are fresh and the customer services always been great. I used to go to Grumpy's but I left because the quality had gotten worse. They don't tolerate rubbish from people good, on you keep up with the great service.

If not not feeling the urge to cook at home or you just want a great easy meal why not call into the local fish n chip take aways great service friendly and definitely good food try them you'll make this place you go to take aways
One of my favourite takeaway shops. Good fish, burgers are ok too. Mussels are normally fat. Parking can be an issue. The old shop is now part of the countdown car park so I usually park there.

Really nice Lady gave my daughter a toy for Christmas. Food was aswell good. Only fault I would say is best to call in and order before heading there. If you order on arrival wait can be a little while. But overall good takeaway.
Fantastic fried chicken momo with Spicey tomato/chilli sauce. Service very fast and friendly as well
Absolutely delicious and great service by the awesome friendly guy in the kiosk.
Tasteless Vegetarian Momos
Pocket friendly restaurant run by amazing couple. Food is delicious. I used to often go here for my quick meal.

Just ordered from delivereasy 2 udon tempura seafood soups lastnight and a bento box it was disgusting the soup tasted burnt the batter was dark and burnt and the rice and chicken katsu in the bento box was very old tasting also again the katsu chicken was a darker colour like it was overcooked I was very disappointed as a spent over $80 for this

HIGHLY RECOMMEND coming here! You will not be disappointed. Food is always fresh and is thee best! They've been here for a good 10+ years and honestly support your local. Go and check them out, you will not be disappointed.

Amazing food. Had the lunch special for 16,90$ with everything U want. Fish, pork, chicken and shrimp. It's plenty and delicious. My partner had a chicken teriyaki rice bowl and I must say it tasted like back in Japan. Unbeatable price for the quality. The atmosphere wasn't as good as it could be. Renovate and make it more Japanese style and it would be THE place to go get food. Japanese owners as well not like most other places so U get the real deal.

Popped in for a quick lunch on Saturday. Sushi was fresh and most options were only $1 a piece, a few $1.5 and $2. Only thing I did notice was that no dish was supplied for the soy sauce so I wasn't able to mix my wasabi. Would visit again.

food was SO good. everything was good. shocked by how good the fries were - absolutely jaw dropping. everything on the dessert menu is such a slay - my fave was the sesame ice cream. lovely ambience, had a lovely dining experience. photo attached for proof that everything was DEVOURED

What a wonderful place in the heart of Papakura. The food is delicious, presented in a wonderful way, and the atmosphere is great. I am so happy to have stumbled upon this gem of a place in Papakura, and I keep recommending it to all my friends!

We loved all the food, they were slightly smaller plates, tapas style and made for sharing. Everything tasted fresh. The prawn tempura was so light and crispy, while the inside was hot and fresh. The kaarage chicken was the same, very succulent on the inside, not dry at all. Beef yakitori had a nice char on it, making a nice smoky beefy flavour. Pork belly was so juicy with a thin crispy skin. The sauces complement each dish nicely, and the drinks were tasty, too. The only thing that was kinda standard was probably the dumplings, that being said it just didn’t stand out to me among all the other delicious food. The other thing that I didn’t quite like was the music. It sounded like clubbing music with very heavy bass beats and was quite loud. The staff were very friendly. I would take my friends to eat here again.

What a hidden gem in the area. Was quite skeptical about the food at first but the food was cooked to such a high standard. Scallops were cooked to perfection with really good seasoning. Wagyu Yakitori was amazing with the sauce. The tempura prawns were perfect. To my surprise the Salmon aburi sushi was quite mid as it was probably the easiest dish to nail. Would be back to try the grilled octopus as I avoided ordering it lol

A hidden gem blending Kiwi and Japanese flavors, this low-profile restaurant impresses with its creative fusion cuisine. The cocktails are a bit pricey but worth every sip. While the food shines, the staff could be more patient and enthusiastic in guiding guests through the menu.

This will be the third or fourth time that we've had bad experiences with Hanua Lunch Bar! First I had a ham sandwich, when I took a bite into it, a cockroach came crawling out of it. Second, one of my mates drank an expired milk chocolate from 2 years ago and today I opened up 2 snickers bar just to find out it has mould on it. Disgusting! That Lunch bar needs another rating check!!!!

You can self serve here and there is always food all over the counter. I've been in several times it's always the same. Go early morning they have a great selection. Watch what you buy. I've often had food from here that's really dry.
Wonderful service and good food. Best coffees in town. Good value for money.
Simply the best. Staff are lovely and food is still amazingly cheap despite the poor economy in nZ
The food is cheap and high quality with friendly customer service. Personally their coffee is a must buy - I definitely recommend 10/10

Great food, great value! Had a lovely meal at Ohana Bistro at the Papakura Club. The prices were excellent, the food was tasty and well-presented, and the customer service was outstanding—friendly, fast, and welcoming. Highly recommend for a relaxed and affordable dining experience.

First visit for us as we didn't know if you needed to be a member of the club to eat in the restaurant, but if you ask at reception, it's not a problem. The fish of the day, terakihi, was super fresh and a delight to eat. The deserts are just divine....good food, reasonable price, definitely on our list of places to go back to.

Located inside the Papakura Club, this catering company also serves food to dine in customers on certain days. Would recommend checking the Papakura club Facebook page for accurate dates. Food was great and the price was decent. It's located in a quiet no frills centre where retirees lawn bowl.
Great food with friendly service - the Thursday night buffet is amazing
Carvery was devine and the staff so friendly and courteous. Definately recommend

Food carts generally represent good value for money and great tasting authentic food Sorry, but the serving size for $17 is not even enough for 1 person - stranger tasting gravy also, very overpowering. Not asking for a massive portion, but as pictured this is not justified for the price. Extra star given for good service and friendly team.

Yummylicious food with excellent service. Small business but excellent service. Humble and very friendly staff. Food is always fresh and yummy. Have tried most of there dishes without any regrets. Has become one of our regular places for yummy food. Must stop on the way home.❤️❤️❤️

My husband and I tried for the first time we got the lamb madras two roti’s and a mango lassie Portion size is great. We were able to share and very authentic flavours and watched the food be made fresh We will definitely be back. The price was also great. Definitely your authentic northern Indian food

I had the privilege of experiencing Pji’s services, and I must say it was an outstanding experience. The quality of the chicken was absolutely impeccable tender, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. Pji's work ethic is second to none; they approach everything with precision and care, ensuring every task is completed to the highest standards. Their professionalism and dedication to cleanliness are truly admirable, creating a welcoming and efficient atmosphere. Whether it's the work or the nature of the person, everything about Pji exudes excellence. Highly recommended!”

Very fast and food is always freshly cooked! Nice and happy staff once you come in you'll see him smiling and greeting you ☺️ super thumbs up to you 👍 keep it up and we'll keep on going back 😁 great chef I have ever seen. He's doing excellent job
Yummy go there quite often always fresh fish and chips nice burgers
Well priced. Hit the spot, nice fish n chips.

This is the best place we have ever tried in Papakura for Fish n chips even the hotdogs were yum. Light and crispy batter cooked to our liking 1 hour before they were due to close. Reheat the next day was nice too. Not usually a fan of fish n chip reheats but this place cooks are awesome.

Best fish & chips in the area. Batter is light and crispy, fish is white and fluffy also best potato fritters in town. Prices are very reasonable and the the owners are kind, accommodating and always give extra pieces of fish or potato fritters from time to time 😉

New owner. I don't normally stop at this takeaway but was in a hurry. Opted for fish and chips. I was pleasantly surprised. The fish was nicely battered and fresh and the chips were real nice. Could tell the oil was clean. 2xfish and 1 scoop chips $9.00. Not bad.

We have been coming here for breakfast for a while now and let me tell you, their breakfast is soooo good. I have eaten from their breakfast menu; Amritsari Kulcha with Masala Chole Amritsari Puri with Chole & Aloo Sabji Masala Chai Fish Amritsari All of them are so delicous man, the fish is lightly fried and so delicous with the spices and the insides flake apart so tender and juicy. The tea is delicous, very concentrated with flavors and not too sweet. The Masala Chole & Aloo Sabji come with so many small condiments that make the dish tastes delicous. You feel so full afterwards. Coming here almost every other weekend. The service is good, the gentleman in front of the register is attentive and informative, we pointed at pictures in the wall and he told us what's in it, when it's served things like that. 9.5/10

I've had takeaways from here and I'm so impressed with the food and service. I've only been here twice, but there will be many more visits to come. The large option on the menu will feed 2 people. The portions are generous, the flavour is amazing and the rice is beautiful, absolutely love it. If you are craving Indian food, this is the place to go to 🙌🏽
Excellent authentic North Indian food. I love seeing so many Indian dishes. The people who serve are really the most humble people.

I visited this place last night for dinner, and I must say, it offered an authentic taste of food! I absolutely loved it. The staff was incredibly helpful, and the service was outstanding. The food was cooked perfectly, showcasing their authentic style. We ordered Chole Kulcha and Chicken Dum Biryani, both of which were absolutely delicious. The flavors were rich, and the aroma was simply heart-melting. As a foodie, I highly recommend this place for its authentic taste in every dish. Additionally, the manager was very welcoming and took the time to explain how they prepare their dishes fresh. I appreciate him sharing that knowledge! I'm definitely locking this place in for authentic food. Swad Amritsari truly lives up to its name for real taste! Looking forward to trying more dishes on my next visit! 😋

Wow, ordered as a takeaway and changed my mind when I walked to dine in. Beautiful, very neat and I was served professionally & respectfully. I will definitely bring my family here for a dinner or lunch. A nice nearest place for butter chicken..wow so yummy and loving the way it was served. 10 stars for this new place.

Wow, awesome customer service and the food was yum az. Got the fish n chips, banoffee, some kekes, fry bread and a lil bowl of prawn with avocado. Mean munch…forgot the name of the place because it’s changed now…I’ll definitely be back again. Might be a wait guys because there was only one lady I saw….I missed out on the other stuff like lu and stuff…but next time…chur guys.
Fish Burgers 🍔 are the Best I've had. Egg Burger ... Just like My Husband likes it. Nicely Toasted Buns, Homemade Sauces 😋 Cakes etc... If she doesn't have it Suggest it 😊
Was so excited to try Cross Street Takeaways. Google says they close at 10pm. Got there at 9.30pm and they're not even open. Please update your operating hours.
Got the family pack, thanks it was a really good deal and yum 🤤 will definitely be back again! Sorry no pics it was too good
They have nicer chips. And their cheese burger, Pattie are massive, worth it. 🤣

Garlic naan was good. Butter chicken was smelly .. chicken tasted raw.vomited after having few bites. Never going back to this restaurant. Waste of money . Food sotting int the kitchen going in the bin

I tried the Tawa Chicken, and it was absolutely delicious! The flavors were amazing, and I really enjoyed every bite. The staff service was also excellent—very polite and attentive. I would definitely recommend everyone to visit The Chef of India at least once and make sure to try the Tawa Chicken. It’s a must-try dish and highly recommended!

It was fun to eat today's food. Ate all the restaurant , but today for the first time the chef of India restaurant's had the best and most delicious food. The best service and environment is also the best. Butter chicken, goat handi and tawa chicken 5/5 stars. I highly recommended this place

Came in at lunch, had the Chicken Do Piaza. The owner’s service was wonderful and polite. The mum had her kid there but they’re peaceful and quiet. I wanted medium-hot and they delivered. $14.99 for curry, naan, rice, and drink? Amazing. All the flavours were adequately salted and spiced. Happily come back again.

I have ordered chicken 65 it turned out to be raw and not properly cooked and the naan has too much ghee n oil in it I’m disappointed and wasted my money not something I wanna go for again .i have to throw it away

This is the best sushi shop ever, they are so friendly always greet with a smile and make such effort to make the customers feel welcome. There sushi is fresh and they make their teriyaki chicken rice Bowles to order and its all so good ! Go here no where else ! Best sushi shop !
Always good service and the best sushi in papakura
Beautiful, organized and clean space, friendly hosts and fresh sushi
Friendliest Sushi place ever! Food is fabulous

Always our go-to sushi in papakura for our whanau. We always turn up out of the blue and ask if they can make us a big platter and without hesitation the provide. The customer service is next level. The cleaniness of the store is always great. The food is always amazing. Highly recommend. Nga mihi Mr Sushi keep up the Awesome mahi.

Beautiful pork roast for dinner tonight. The best crackle I've had from any roast-shop 😋 decent size and comparatively good prices. Tender and tasty meat, flavoursome gravy that didn't make my potatoes soggy, nice crispy tateys 👌

Ordered these today via Uber Eats. Meal arrived a bit late but it was okay. Pork and veggies were cooked perfectly but would be nicer if it had a bit more seasoning. The potatoes were really good though. The batter was a bit peppery- I liked it! Had a taste of the pork skin but didn't finish it because some parts were a bit soggy already. Bubble tea was delicious. Really nice, firm pearls. Cheesecake was average. The jam on top was a bit too tangy for my liking. Overall, it's okay. A bit overpriced.

Got the pork roast the cracklings were sooo good and not to fatty and the roast was really nice they use a darker gravy and that was super flavourful and the pork was moist and price is fair portion is great ! Will be back

I get a roast from this place now and then and its a nice roast, well cooked and they serve it with a nice pork crisp on the side. They’ve never done me wrong in any way. The atmosphere can do with abit more of a welcoming renovation and the people can smile a little, just to make the customer feel welcomed, other than that i have no real complaints. I mean im really only there for the food after all -so overall good.
Rude customer service and yucky food. I'd rather go to kiwi roast or travel to brandys roast in manurewa.
Ordered chicken chow mein and it was barely warm. Flavour was very bland and it was 95% fried noodles and 5% chicken. Very dissatisfied and disappointed. Not worth the price.

Just moved back to papakura and super happy to find this place has moved in recently. Papakura really needed a Chinese BBQ takeaway. This place is just as good as the ones I was going too out west. I got half roast pork and half roast duck.
Was one of the only places open when I looking for pork on rice. Good for the area. Price was good considering the size. Staff friendly and restaurant was clean and tidy.
Wonton soup is good, I love how the bok choy is quite soft, seems healthy
Authentic Chinese BBQ. Nice friendly owners, good food and great price. Will definitely be back.

I just bought a 18dola family combo and the x4 fish was raw the potatoes fritters were half cooked the crab sticks were disgusting and the size of my pack was like a 5dola hot chips size. Very disappointed. I won't be going back.

I went there today, quality of chips and fritters is tiny as i asked for $5 chips and got $3 worth and it's gross now, the lady there also has bad customer service please go find another job if you are unhappy to serve customers,.. yuck fish n chips never going back there again. not worth the money the quantity and quality taste is not worth your hard earned money. If you want repeat customer show respect in the food you make for your customers we ain't animals to eat your scrap foods is what ours looked like today..

Definitely our new go to fish n chip shop! Fresh fish, fresh chips! fresh oysters! And they drain the oil out of the food really good too so its not all paper and grease like some places! Prices are really good too! Awesome! Please don't change!
It used to be my favourite Fish & chips not now. Toasted cheese is done with chesse slice half cooked not nice at all.. i took a photo but can't share it. Shop needs a good clean too.
The fish and chips is so good!! Plus the prices not too bad and they have affordable combos. They also sell raw fish, raw mussels, kina, oysters 😋😋 Highly recommend this takeaways 😁

Naan is good. Rice is rice. The butter chicken though was extremely sickly sweet (think sweeter than Fanta) I could only finish half and my heart is racing…… could have just been my lot tho 🤷🏽‍♀️ will I come again? Probably. Will I get butter chicken again? Nah…

Got a mild butter chicken and a cheese garlic naan. Butter chicken is average, the cheese garlic naan is doughy, not cooked properly and I can’t taste any cheese whatsoever. A bit disappointed after paying $15 for the chicken and $5 for a naan. Overpriced naan as I’ve had far better for less $$. All said and done still a little better than the Indian restaurant down the road.
Best ever Indian food ever had in Auckland, really tasty and authentic food. Thanks Cheff

Trustworthy Reliable Food Family Restaurant, Amazing Customer service, Outstanding Super Amazing Food, I am Happy and Greatful to support your family Business, Blessing upon Blessings Papakura Curry Mahal on 74A Clevedon Rd Papakura, I recommend all my friends and family to Papakura Curry Mahal

I like chicken Tikka and goat curry and fish pakoda chili chicken and paneer kdahi nd staff also very good. I never had taste like papakura curry mahal in whole Auckland I would like to go again and again

Love this hidden gem of a place! The food is absolutely delicious. Cooked my chicken teriyaki and katsu on the spot (freshly cooked when ordered) and it was the best. The staff members were very friendly and courteous. My daughter ordered the sushi and said it was the best she has had (and she's tried many sushi shops). We parked across the road in WW (Countdown) car park and it was a short walk to the shop. Easy access. Tables and chairs to sit on if necessary, but we chose to takeaway. Will definitely be back again and a again.
Amazing ramen at such a good price($18) I always add an egg (already ate half before I took the photo) the broth is delicous and the service is incredible!
Very nice food. My young daughter says the best sushi in the whole world.

Tonight I picked up the most disgusting two meals of takeout it has ever been my misfortune to smell let alone attempt to eat. The katsu chicken was slimy as if it had been cooked 3 days ago then microwaved. The chicken noodle soup looked and tasted like canned chicken with noodles that disintegrated when you touched them with your chop sticks.
Partner was very happy with her beef pho, she was delighted with the taste.

Our go-to and favorite restaurant when craving for Indian cuisine. We have been going here at least every other week and we just love it because the service is great and the food is delicious. If you’re around Papakura you definitely have to try it.
Food was 10/10 & the waiters were very polite and helpful. The meat in our mains was cooked to perfection, the mango lassi cocktail was so good too!

This place never ceases to amaze me with their stupendous service, quality of food and atmosphere. Their Rara chicken is the best. Fish is awesome. Lot of variety in the menu. The service is quick. We went there as a big group and were bit late in finishing our food. There was no hint of any annoyance on staff’s faces. I have been to other places and they literally kick you out at closing time. There is plenty of parking at the rear of the restaurant as well as in front. The drinks menu is good. Staff is courteous and helpful. Would keep going back in foreseeable future. Thanks for an awesome evening with my friends.
Very disappointed with my meal Ordered lamb madras, taste nothing like a madras. Over seasoned with salt. Literally ate 2 bites had to throw it away Won't be recommending this place

I've been ordering from here for a while now, and it never disappoints. The consistency in taste is remarkable – every dish is always packed with flavor, just like the first time I tried it. This time,we had the Kadai Paneer and Goat Curry for takeaway, and both were absolutely delicious. The Kadai Paneer was perfectly spiced, and the Goat Curry was tender and full of rich, aromatic flavors. There are so many Indian restaurants in the area, but this one stands out as the best. Highly recommend it for anyone craving authentic, top-quality Indian food!"

Papakura resident? 💛 Recommending a great spot for Korean cuisine! The restaurant is very clean and has a spacious layout, making it ideal for dining with family or a group of friends.🫂 The Korean side dishes (banchan) were fresh, flavorful, and generously served — a great start to the meal. For mains, I highly recommend the Kukbap (soup with rice) which was hearty and comforting, and the Korean dumplings, which were perfectly cooked and full of flavor.⭐️ Overall, a satisfying dining experience with a welcoming atmosphere and authentic flavors. Would definitely come back! 😙

Living in Weymouth makes it hard to have Korean food as no place nearby fits my taste. Accidentally found out there was a Korean restaurant a bit south from my house, gave it a try with a friend then it became my go to spot for me and my partner ever since. We took other friends here as well and my partner’s family. The parents are not familiar with Korean food but they love it.

A small unassuming shop but a must try in papakura. Limited menu specializing in soup, perfect for winter. The steamed kimchi dumplings also a standout. Attention to detail like providing warm water to drink instead of cold since it is winter.

Had the sundae and the beef bone hangover soup. Both are really good and full of ingredients. The ambiance of the place is very tidy, spacious and has a minimalist feel which I like. The price is not too expensive, highly recommend coming here for some pretty homely type of food.

Found this place incidentally while browsing Google Maps for a dinner option last night and was surprised to see it was a gukbap place, as didn't expect to find one in south Auckland. Decided to give it a try after seeing the highly rated reviews, and I'm so happy we did! The sundaeguk, korean sausage soup, was a real highlight and easily the best one I've had outside of Korea. My husband enjoyed his beef bone hangover soup, and we also ordered the steamed kimchi mandu which you can tell is handmade rather than store bought. The whole meal tasted very homely rather than the usual punchy flavours you might typically find at other Korean restaurants, but it tasted closer to what we've eaten in neighbourhood restaurants in Korea. The place looks quite unassuming from the outside and can be tricky to spot if you're not looking for it specifically. The interior of the restaurant is plain but clean, and the owner was very polite and friendly. We will definitely be regulars from now onwards!

A hidden gem!!! Gorgeous little restaurant in Papakura. Lovely authentic feeling decor and delicious sushi selection. Bento and ramen are amazing!!! Friendly service from the lovely couple who run the shop. Definitely recommend adding this one to your must visit list!!

Great place for decent sushi 🍣 🍱 Friendly staff. A little small space to dine in but people mostly take away sushi. Tried variety of sushi this time and quite satisfying. Will try hot food 🍲 next time.

Little Tokyo Sushi is a charming, cozy spot run by two friendly elderly owners who make you feel right at home. We tried the spicy pork donburi, which was flavorful and satisfying, along with sides of takoyaki and shrimp that were perfectly cooked. The shop may be small, but the atmosphere is warm, and the music sets the perfect mood for a relaxed meal. Their excellent customer service and attention to detail made the experience even better. A lovely place to enjoy a comforting, authentic meal!

Great quality food at affordable price. Tried chicken Sushi, they are fresh and very delicious. Donburi was fantastic too.. they added double egg, fresh salad and chicken was juice. Loved it. Thanks guys!!

We love this place! The reviews made us try their food - and definitely did not disappoint. Would recommend the chicken Katsu & Beef Donburi.The place is kept clean and the owner is friendly. Good price & great food. Ps. I had a bite of the beef donburi before taking the picture. 😂
The sushi I had here was very tasty and delicious 😋 The lady made the sushi fresh for us, and it reflected on the sushi. It was a lovely meal for sure

This sushi shop in papakura has to be one of the best, so fresh, so delicious. They make fresh to order…The tuna was fresh, the size was huge! Nice and saucy rice wasn’t dry, so delicious… I ordered the salmon too- and I’m loving this sushi so much haha Can’t recommend this place enough. I’ll so be back! The drink selection was impressive with everything from hot and cold coffee to c&c lemon ☝️☝️☝️

Best sushi we've ever had! Big portions, soft and moist rice, affordable price, tasty sauces, made fresh to order in under 15mins. Kiosk for easy ordering. My kids ate it too fast so I didn't get a chance to take a photo, but everything looked exactly as it does in the menu pictures :)

Thick salmon slice with outstanding teriyaki sauce, on big bowl of delicious rice decorated with vege salad. enjoy much each of the luxuriant bite of fresh salmon!! Simple combination, great taste. Price is cheap and size is big , good enough for a young adult. Also ordered a Wagyu Beef Don, for family. Can see the photo of the generous content of beef and tasty Japanese rice (vinega treated as advertised?) Finally, the sashimi (raw fish) , I bought a mixed pack with Maguro , which is usually termed as more higher grade than Salmon, after tried ( with self provided sauce and wasabi ) I still prefer Salmon , The thick slice and fresh oily bite.

They have a sign about having a "special sushi rice vinegar" and they are right, you can really taste it in the handroll sushi. Haven't had such delicious sushi in a long time because the vinegar is typically lacking. That being said, when we went in everything was being made to order, so it was a bit slow but well worth the wait (and everything was clearly fresh). I'll probably stop by whenever I'm in papakura town. They are also generous with the serving and not stingy with the salmon and fillings like many places. Hope you guys keep up the quality 👍

This was my first visit to Delicious Korean Chicken. After seeking wonderful reviews, I decided to pay a visit. My time of visit was at 7pm and a lot of parking was available along the footpath. I was greeted by a lady, chose my order, paid and I got my takeaway in 10 minutes. The food was very delicious. You can sit at Delicious Korean Chicken to enjoy your meals but there is limited seating like 2 small tables with two chairs each. I believe the family pack is a bit pricey when I compare it with K Chicken in Hamilton but I like this food so the price didn't bother me that much.

Almost had a near miss end of my meal. Bought chicken rice meal tonight i was the 2nd last order and lady on the phone asked me if i could make it in next 10 mins as the shop closes at 8. That states the obvious as they cooked my meal in a hurry and get this raw or partially cooked fella in there. Had a small bite and instant regret to swallow the raw chicken. Hope i make it to the next morning. Disgusted feeling. Ironically, there food had no issues in past
The chicken was so crunchy and not greasy. Perfect texture and perfectly cooked. The Korean hot dog I had was also delicious, they almost tasted like donuts. Extremely delicious would come again!

Came here to try the korean fried chicken. We ordered the crispy fried chicken and also the sweet and spicy fried chicken. The guy there said 10 minutes wait, but we waited for over 30 minutes and see people who came after us receiving their orders first. Afterward it was found out that he had mistakenly placed our order as completed without having dealt with it. Afterwards he still had to ask us for the order details a few time and still got it wrong at the end. So service here is definitely really bad, part of the reason is that the other workers doesn't seem to really know what to do except their own station and the guy ended up having to do too many things which is not possible as he is getting things wrong. However despite the rather disappointing service, the original crispy fried chicken boneless was very good, just the right crunch and the thigh meat was super tender and moist inside, very delicious just like the name. The sweet and spicy sauce was actually just ok for me, I would rather have the kokodak version. The chips, coleslaw and radish was as what you normally get, nothing outstanding. Portion was decent even for the small cup size and pricing is very good. I think slightly cheaper than other shops. Overall despite the bad service, the shop does indeed serve as their name suggest, delicious korean fried chicken.
Great, chicken and great portions, fast service and friendly people, recommend to anybody. Price is also good. Love this place a diamond in the rocks. We've found a hidden gem!

This place needs closing. It is disgusting, chicken cooked with a flashlight, no seasoning or flavour AT ALL. The best and worst thing about my visit was the girl doing what she thought was a good deed and giving me an extra wing for free, I wish she didn't bother. But her heart was in the right place.
Little amount of chips in a big box. chicken is not even warm. only 1.9 km driving,when I got home the chicken is between warm to cold and so oily!
Telling you right now, the biggest chicken pieces. Literally big and nice. Would recommend doing butternut honey flavour on big pieces of chicken but other then that amazing!!!
Really tasty chicken, good portion size, and great service. Will definitely go again.
Just tried today, love the coating and the popcorn chicken so tender. The people who run the place are soo friendly.

Had breakfast on a Sunday. Ordered the big breakfast, mince on toast and kids nugget meal. Food was fresh, hot, delicious and portions were also generous. Also, our son had so much fun playing with their young kid as well.... that made it more enjoyable because they were so kid friendly. My coffe was so good, and my husband also enjoyed his lome milk shake. They even gave our little one a complimentary kid size milk shake. Highly recommend

The Hunua Eatery offers a convenient stop for coffee or breakfast, but my recent visit left me underwhelmed. I ordered coffee and a keto breakfast, and while both were passable, they fell firmly into the "average" category. Neither stood out in terms of taste or quality, especially when compared to other keto options available in the Pukekohe and Papakura region. The overall experience was further dampened by the appearance of the cabinet food options, which didn’t seem particularly fresh, and the tables, which were a bit greasy. These factors gave the impression of a lack of attention to cleanliness and presentation, which detracted from the otherwise pleasant atmosphere. On the positive side, the women at the counter was polite and welcoming, which was a redeeming feature of the visit. While The Hunua Eatery might suffice for a quick coffee or meal, those looking for high-quality keto options or a standout café experience might find better alternatives in the surrounding areas.

The staff were very lovely people, polite and pleasant. I had lunch there yesterday, tue 27th, I couldn’t believe the incredibly generous portions, tasty and so much food, I do hope you’ve costed that out and charge accordingly. I really liked this lovely family and wish the success with all my heart. Karen 😊

Delicious meals, hidden gem. Clean and tidy, food had good presentation and tasty, enjoyed the two menu options and good choices of cabinet food. Also good prices. Will definitely be back with friends and family
Loving their big breakfast！ big value to share for two person. their almond croissant are very fresh😍😋

It's now called the Hunua Eatery: Cafe & Bakery. Everything we tried was delicious and very hearty portions! From the coffee and sweets to the main dishes, it was all great. We'd definitely come back again! Thank you! 😊
It is under new management and it's called "Hunua Eatery" now. The variety of choices in their menu is impressive. I was stocked to find a Keto-friendly option there!
This is an awesome place to hang out. Food tastes amazing and well made. This place is well worth considering to grab a bite or to have a meal with the fam.

This review was long overdue. If you're looking for authentic Indian flavors that taste just like home, this is the place to be! We are frequent visitors, and each time we're here, the food never disappoints. The samosas are perfectly crispy with a flavorful filling, and the chole bhature is rich, hearty, and full of taste. The poori sabzi is always served hot and fresh, and the pani puri offers a delightful burst of flavor that's both refreshing and satisfying. The quality of the food is consistently excellent, and the service is friendly and efficient. Whether you're a long-time fan of Indian cuisine or trying it for the first time, this restaurant is a must-visit. Highly recommended for anyone craving authentic, comforting Indian dishes! 💜

Good food and authentic taste of India , sweets are very good and dal makhni is exceptional, must try for any vegetarian. Chef is really good and is always there to make any changes to the order of required.
Good food, cleanliness 0 Dining area smelly with sticky floors, toilets terrible. Please give the shop a good clean along with the toilets 🚽
Very authentic home made food. Really enjoyed roti instead of naan. I recommend their Thali.
Great food. The Roxana Thali was really tasty. Good atmosphere and service.

Awesome little place. Been to 6 other kebab places all over Auckland and this is the best tasting one I've had so far Try the Cajun chicken. Very difficult to find one this good in Auckland The lamb was amazing too Great price to meal ratio. Very worth it

Friendly staff from the middle east Iraq the food looks good and clean, professionally made crafted with love and perfection. Lovely design and atmosphere would recommend this place and come again! ;)

I had a great experience at Flame Kebab. The food was fresh, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. The kebabs were especially delicious – juicy and well-seasoned. The staff were kind and welcoming, and the service was quick. I highly recommend Flame Kebab for fresh, tasty food and awesome service. You won’t regret it! 🤩
Highly recommend this place to anyone looking for quality food and great service. Will definitely be coming back! Prices are great too compare to others

Very solid kebab place, reasonable price and the lady was pleasant. The rice was seasoned, the chicken and lamb were well-seasoned and honestly quite nice compared to other kebab places as it had a greater level of complexity. My one criticism is the lamb being a bit tough/chewy, thus, causing a diminished mouthfeel, otherwise the meat was excellent. The salad was like any other kebab places, this, acceptable. The hummus, however, was incredible, I’m not knowledgeable on good hummus but I’d presume it was house made, regardless, Flame Kebab’s hummus had me desiring for more. Overall, a solid kebab place, might comeback if I’m in the area.

I had the pleasure of having lunch at Mama Sila’s new restaurant today in Otahuhu and cannot recommend it enough! From the moment I walked in, the staff greeted me and my team with warmth and smiles, creating a friendly atmosphere. The restaurant's ambiance is bright and impeccably clean, adding to the overall pleasant dining experience. The buffet lunch offered an impressive array of delicious options including all my favourite Pacific island dishes. At such an affordable price, it's definitely worth every penny!! The food was consistently replenished which meant there was no waiting time. I cannot wait to come back and have dinner here the next time I’m in Auckland 😊

We had the honour of being served by an amazing catering and loving company. Mama Sila took care of us personally with appointment and last minute changes, they accommodated to us during our funeral process. Food five 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟, it was tasty, delicious and full of flavour, it was presented and cooked well. Service 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟, we had a front table in which they served and topped up main buffet regularly, they smiled and made sure we weee all ok. Value for money 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟, they will work and accomodate to any budget, and comparison to others Mama Sila out shines the rest, all go here for catering and restaurant needs, we will be using her again, with love from our family, Tapuosi x

11 of us dined at Mama Sila restaurant in Otahuhu last night. I have to say the service was exceptional! We were welcomed by a lovely waiter who I found very helpful and approachable. This gave a promising first impression. The place is well set up with quality furniture. It was very busy throughout the night. There is a large floor with ample dining space. Upon being seated, we were immediately served with water and offered beverages which was nice. There is a nice bar which serves mainly fizzy drinks, but no alcohol or sugar free drinks. Now the food was the highlight. They had a buffet station, the cold salads served in large kava bowls which I found really creative and impressive. They had a large variety of food which you don’t often find in buffet restaurants these days. Every island dish you could think of. The dessert was divine! All in all i absolutely loved Mama Sila. A quality restaurant. It was a pleasant experience. My only critique is the dining floor could do with some paintings on the large walls that seemed bare or maybe Pasifika designs, that would give it the complete touch. Directly behind where we sat was a curtain but on the other side sounded like a busy kitchen or workers, at one point sounded like a chainsaw going which got a bit noisy, maybe a wall there could do. Definitely need more options for beverages, sugar free drinks and alcohol would be nice and payWave option would be helpful but they do have bank transfer options as well which was good. All in all I was very impressed.

Recently have had my sons 21st & mama sila hosted the catering, got a lot of amazing feedback from my guests about the food! They enjoyed every bit of the food served an nothing went to waste. Thank you mama sila for catering for my sons birthday! Highly recommended an the seafood was on point🤩 staff were so polite despite a lil hickup getting through to the hall but they were all amazing an also cleaned the kitchen when they were done🥺 can’t thank you enough! Thanks again mama sila an the team!

Do not recommend this place. The only positive thing is the food and that is if it has been filled. Slow restocking the food. Staff are so rude and do not care about their customers. Don’t recommend for big event/group, not enough room and no air con. Bad experience here. I did a whole review about our experience and it was deleted, along with other negative reviews.
My mum and I had the most lovely time. The meals were exceptional! They not only looked incredible but tasted DELICIOUS The service was amazing, and we’ll definitely be back.

Wowing easily, I never expected to see a such stunning resturant Bar around hunna. Map showed a bit strange way but once driving top of hill alot of woows coming up. Rabbits running around, jungle beside, excellent farmers view. Friendly waitress with warm welcome. Yummy cocktail and yummy foods. Stylish decorative with organised tables and wine glass on them playing a nice harmony on your eyes. Thanks guys

Went for the seven course degustation menu and it didn't disappoint. Great quality food and service with a nice setting. There are indoor and outdoor options. Also thanks for having us right by the big open fireplace - it was a big bonus.😍 My favourite dishes are the lamb rump, market fish and the scallops. Hopefully will come back again over the summer months. Cheers guys.😘

Outstanding dining experience at Vin Alto tonight. The service, food, selection of wine, and the ambiance of the restaurant, particularly the wood burning fire, was impeccable. Kudos to the chef there, BEST lamb I have ever tasted,..faultless! Cannot recommend enough. It’s 10 stars from us! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Must visit! Beautiful food & scenery. Set menu is well balanced and worth every cent. The staff are lovely, very accomodating! Very hard to get a Uber or taxi out so you will need to book a ride in advance. Indoor and outdoor area for all seasons! Highly recommend this place for a date night or any celebration.

Beautiful little vineyard. Came with a group of 9. The service was attentive but quite slow in terms of getting our drinks and food. The food itself was okay, nothing mind blowing. Especially the fish tacos, everyone who ordered the dish on our table all said something was missing - a sauce or something to add some flavour. The wines were also okay, nothing mind blowing. Lots of potential but didn’t get any wow factor like other vineyards I’ve visited.

Had a fantastic experience at John Hill Estate. The setting is beautiful and peaceful—ideal for a relaxing meal. The food was delicious and well-presented, and the chocolate torte was a standout—rich, indulgent, and the perfect way to end the meal. Service was excellent thanks to Arbie and Richard, who were warm, attentive, and made us feel very welcome. We also really enjoyed their Pinot Gris—crisp, refreshing, and a great match with the food. Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for great food, excellent wine, and genuine hospitality in a lovely location.

My partner surprised me with a late Valentine’s Day dinner here on Sunday. The food was so good and the wine flights were amazing! We really enjoyed the staff and the atmosphere. 😊 The prices were decent. A little gentle feedback: We’d love to learn more about the wine selection, we ordered two flights and felt a little lost. My partner is vegetarian and was confined to a choice between pizza and antipasto, so maybe a few more options for vegetarians! Other than that we had a great experience, and we’re so excited to come back.

Came here just this morning for brunch! They serve a Filipino Breakfast with rice and the food was amazing, and the crew was really lovely! They served us with smile on their face and professionally. The Manager of the Restaurant was really accomdating . And the place is really lovely. Will definitely comeback and highly recommended. We also met the owner of the Estate and he is really a great person.

My wife and I enjoyed a nice dinner at John Hill Estate this past weekend. The atmosphere is very lovely, with a beautiful vineyard view, and a nice interior. The service staff were very friendly, and made us feel welcome! The food itself was good, but didn’t blow me away. My wife really enjoyed the fish and chips, and my BBQ pizza was alright. The price was pretty good though! My wife said she would absolutely go back, and I certainly wouldn’t mind giving it another go! The major highlight is the ambience of the restaurant!

What a fantastic hidden country spot for evening dine in or enjoy a drink in sunny weather. We received an impressive customer service from entrance till leaving the bar. Food was amazing. We ordered Korean Fried Chicken and three meats pizza with a glass of wine which actually was more than enough for two people. Flavors are hard to beat. Highly recommended. Thank you very much you guys will see us again
such a great please to visit! i tried the pork belly burger and strawberry margarita and they were both delicious. the owners were lovely and welcoming. i will definitely be back 😊

Amazing food! We tried the butter chicken masala and the beef tacos, and were amazed by how delicious both dishes were, especially considering the variety of flavors and types of cuisine. The ambiance is also lovely, warm and cozy, and the staff are very kind. We’ll definitely be coming back!

Really disappointed by our experience here. The portions were exceptionally small and really lacking in flavour. Even though it was really quiet, service was sporadic, with a big gap between the first meal to arrive and the last. The kids pancakes also contained coffee for some reason, which I found particularly odd. The worst part about them was how dry they were though. Not worth making your way out to but it is one of the only restraunt options in the area.
Amazing food, so inviting and warm the service was really good came to even check on us the food didn’t take long at all clean and tidy

Clendon Subway, thanks for delivering the goods once again! Always delivering fresh food, always positive, friendly and providing customer service excellence at all times! We have never been disappointed! Thanks Taran for always going above and beyond! Appreciate you n the team! #Twins

I had a fantastic experience at subway thanks to the lovely lady working behind the counter.she greeted me with a warm smile and was uncredibly polite,patient, and professional throughout my visit. She listened carefully to my order made helpful suggestion and prepared everything with care and attention to detail. Her positive attitude and genuine kindness truly made my day. Its rare to come across someone who takes such pride in their work and treats every customer with such respect and courtesy.she is a real asset to subway give amazing lady a raise Thanks!!!!

Was served by a young lady who’s name started with a G the other week who was working on her own, it was busy but she got through everyone fast. I have been to other subways but this has been the best by far. She packed my sub so nicely perfect amount of salads and sauce it was perfect. Definitely coming back here more often.

Had subway here one morning this week i was in a rush but the young lady who seemed to be the only one working at the time served me and was so fast and accurate with my order. Her service was one of the best I've ever experienced. Definitely one of the best subways I've eaten.

First time at this subway. I dont usually go here because its in clendon. Such a bad suburb but i really wanted subway for lunch. The tall Indian guy Taran's customer service next level. Made u feel welcomed and greets u with a smile. Order was correct and was ready nice and quick. After being seved from him I forgot I was even in clendon lol Deserves a payrise 💪🔥 awesome work mate 👏
Says they open at 11am standing there at 10 past 11 and still not open. The lady inside won't even look at me when she comes to the front and quickly walks to the back

Chicken nibbles cooked to my liking 👍 Tender and juicy and the skin is nice and crispy and very lightly battered. The chips yummm Thick and soft on the inside and lightly crispy on the outside. And awesome customer service 👌
Ordered combination fried rice for dinner.. very disappointed. Fried rice was horrible🤮previous owner was good never had problems with them. They made their food nicely n presentable.
This takeaway is one of my favorites in my life and there is a shop next to the takeaway store and to top it all off at the end of weymouth rd is a park residential area close to the beach/whaf
Food tasted like Oil more than anything else and made me spew. The new owners need to up there game!

Over here, it's all about the money - not the customer, not the food quality. It's very important to match your receipt with your order. "7 out of 10 percent" you've been well overcharged, particularly when placing large family orders. Always check the underside of your burger buns for "mold". Often complaints for "short grey hairs" cooked in the batter, (taken 3 battered fish back to shop untouched and still reasonably hot) for proof. They just say "sorry" because it matched the shop owners hair when he opened it out of the batter to inspect. This has happened before! Replacing it with a refund underscores the making and care of producing low standards with disregard to food safety regulation compliance. "A Certificate" display is issued at the time of inspection. After that, monitor and auditory, is notified to proprietor for next inspection. Yep, and "at times," it's a deterrent to appease the trust of customers' delight in food quality. After appropriate reporting, I finished with the shop- period. South Mall is further, but so much better than this.

Food is so delicious especially there mini pineapple pies 😋. Customer service is A+ and food is always hot and so delicious. Highly recommend. To the Otara and Clendon Evelina stores well done keep it up

I'd usually come through to Evelina's for their Keke Mamoe and Mamoe.... However, on this occasion that I had come, the Mamoe had No Flavor, was tough to eat, and oily. The Keke Mamoe was salty and the Pineapple custard tarts were more breading than filling. I used to come before because they were good, but on this occasion, I was not happy with the experience.

My aunt bought a pineapple pie for us in Otara, as I cut a piece I noticed the cream and custard was off, looked like it was sitting there for a week. Money wasted, I kindly suggest that staff inspect the food items and recommend storing the pies in the refrigerator rather than in the glass cabinet, especially on hot days. Pancakes also burnt- nothing new
Great food selection, always hot and ready to go. Pork buns are delicious, especially the panikekes 😉 Great Samoan cuisine!
Best keke mamoe in Auckland, Beautiful soft and crunchy panikeke and great service. Overall my opinion best Polynesian food store I’ve been too. 😊

Service and food here is top notch and me and my partner will always come here for our lazy can’t be bothered to cook nights and we always know we will get the best feed with our well spent money. The cooks puts so much love into making our feed and has the upmost kindest service we have come across, they create an environment that will make you always be happy to come there for a feed. I would recommend this to everyone because they deserve that praise. Well done guys keep it up!!

The absolute BEST kebab shop I’ve ever tried, and it’s only down the road! Forget fusion and every other kebab place. The food here is always amazing with pretty good portion sizes too. Much respect for the bro here because every time I’ve been here, he’s been the only person working and providing a delicious meal with a friendly attitude. I definitely rate and recommend this place to anyone after a good kebab.
Service was top knotch bloke greeted us with smiles and we left happy food was amazing and portion was great

My family & I are regulars here & no matter the price the food here is amazing. Customer service is awesome & the young man that owns & runs this business is outstanding. He always makes us feel welcomed. I highly recommend trying out this place out, they make the yummiest kebabs in South Auckland. We wouldn't go anywhere else.
Always enjoying grabbing a bite to eat here the mixed kebab meal is great kashish is always efficient and great cost for a Combo xxx go there
Fresh Fish at reasonable prices. They also clean and fillet fish onsite. Make sure to try their fish n chips, one of the best!

Best fresh fish and fish and chips beats Toby’s by Miles fish is soo fresh as is the chips and you get free lemon wedges plus the batter is to die for great value for money highly recommend also not as expensive like Toby’s shit
Great place to buy the freshest seafood around Never disappoint

Worst Fish and Chips shop. Food is not fresh. Bought a family pack, there were about 4-5 mussles. As soon as we opened our take away, we smelled stink. We got a bite from a mussles, water was running out and it was a off smell seafood. Fishes are not fresh either. If you dont want to get food poisoning, Dont eat here.
My local fish shop. What more can I say. Mussels are usually larger than paknsav next door
Come try it out your self, professional pizza chefs, iam happy with anything from them 100%
Good and clean atmosphere in store. Staff is very friendly and welcoming.
Brotha Harry who served us had very good customer service and had a great sense of humour 👍

The staff were super friendly and made me feel welcome from the moment I walked in. The service was fast, and the food was fresh, hot, and delicious—especially the pizza, which was cooked to perfection. The place was clean, and everything was well-organised. Special thanks to the team for making every visit a great one. Keep up the great work! Definitely my favourite place for pizza 🍕🔥

text: The man in the front harry was great to me and my family with wonderful service

One of the best Chinese takeaways I’ve had in a long time! The food was hot, fresh, and full of flavor — you can really tell they use quality ingredients. The portions were generous, and everything was packaged neatly. I especially loved the egg fried rice — absolute perfection. Ordering was easy, and the staff were super polite and efficient. This place has definitely become my go-to for Chinese takeaway. Highly recommend!

Bought crispy roast pork, chicken nibbles and chips. Crispy roast pork was not crispy and it was heated in the microwave right in front of me. If it was not for the bad weather, I would have gone to another shop. Chicken nibbles were ok, nothing exceptional, but not bad. Chips were warm but soft and soggy.

If I could give 0 stars I would. The fried rice was flavourless and bland, the egg foo yong was as dry as a desert sandal, and I don’t think the pork was even pork. Absolutely horrible, I won’t be coming back here again!

You sold me a raw chicken that was still bleeding VERY DISAPPOINTED!!!!! Lucky I checked before my children ate it PLEASE DO BETTER !!! your lucky im too heavily pregnant to come back and get my money back
The best flavourful wonton soup in the south! I've been gatekeeping for awhile but now ready to share :-) you won't be disappointed!
Fantastic curry! Fresh, generous portions, quick service. Owner is warm and polite. Will return!"

2nd time here and enjoyed the Chicken Tikka however not a fan of the Lamb seekh kebab - pls lessen the food colouring in both dishes hoiii my lips💋🙊were a brighter shade after my meal that took a while to rid lol. I've ordered a large Lamb Saag some months ago at a decent price with a great portion serving🙌🏽 Thx again for having such a gud & affordable option of Indian food in the area🧡🤍💚
I really appreciate this place—the staff is friendly, the food is great, and the service is top-notch. The butter chicken is so good, it’s my go-to whenever I’m craving it!🫶

Perfect for children me n my son ordered this yesterday and HE DID NOT disappoint wasn't to spicy and he also gave me n my family of 4 some hand sanitizer I recommend this place FULLY! Great price also.$21.00 with a garlic naan thank you man enjoyed it to a TEE I'll be back 😊

Absolutely amazing. The customer service we got from both of them was so welcoming and the food was just YUUUM !! We had the Korma and Rice,Butter chicken and Rice, Pakora and Cheesey garlic Naan. The amount we got we were amazed definitely alot and we could eat it all but will definitely be back for more 😊😊✌️

I tried the steak and egg roll combo, the bun was nice and soft the meat was delicious I forgot to take a photo of my meal sorry guys. The chips were nice and crunchy, had the right amount of salt. Uncle tried the chicken burger, he said the chips were yummy and wanted more lol the chicken he said he wasn't expecting a process chicken but it was still nice to have.
Amazing owners, I always come here and they are always welcoming, delightful food & drinks, never too pricey, is fast, just a great place to get food. Highly recommend!
Honestly I don’t know what the reviews are on about the food is great, we always get the Bahn mi from here and it’s amazing !!!!! Awesome flavor and freshness

Rubbish fried rice, feels like will get sick. Never saw any Chinese takeaway using old/cooked chicken for friedrice. Should use fresh chicken and cook at same time for friedrice. Will Never recommend this shop. I should have trusted the other reviews.
Got the 10 nibble & chips plus bubble tea. Unfortunately the nibbles taste off along with the chips being so stale. But overall there tea bubble tea was so good 😊
Yummy Pork Rolls. $10 only or $15 combo. There's also a 3 option meat, lamb, chicken & pork. So so good.

I use to always come never had problems always enjoyed. Last night I took my 2 year old son here for his dinner haven’t been in ages but knew this place as nice food ordered small lamb roast he ate the lot he was loving it but then all night he spewing up the roast in his sleep had a sleepless night then all morning had the shits and still going it’s nearly lunchtime as I’m writing this post. Given him fluids and fruit still kakaring out the roast from last time just real liquidy like water from the water and fruits iv given him. Last night went thru 2 sheets and 4 blankets covered in spew and kaka . Usually shop is good but please be more hygienic and careful with the food I wouldn’t want that to happen to myself let alone my 2 year old son .I know this shop can get busy but when I ordered it was completely fine no rush only 2 other customers in the shop at the time . Please be more on to it when handling food
I travel 20mins each way just to get my money's worth, this place just piles on the meat n veges, very reasonable prices and quality is perfect. Been my Fav roast shop for 13 years now. Love it.

The service is always immaculate! The staff here are very friendly and welcoming. Would highly recommend their roast meals. Meat is always tender & full of flavour! The roasted veges and gravy are also delish! Would highly recommend the Roast Roll for a meal on the go! Soft bread roll packed with meat of your choice, salad and gravy🤩 By far the best Roast Pork outlet I’ve tried to date!!

We are big fans of brandy’s roast I spend 200-300 weekly here on uber eats and in store trips the lady and old man are lovely people but my trip today was very unprofessional I was served by the guy with long hair who claimed to be the owner he was very rude like we was bothering him he charged me extra for no reason and claimed that the prices went up sadly you lost me today as a customer brandy please have a talk or make some changes with this disrespectful fake owner I came between 1:30pm - 2:00pm
Love the meat patty in their fish burger, I also add an egg and cheese and ohhhhh it definitely hits those taste buds. I like my hips underdone and they're spot on 💯

Recommended to me by a local. Freshly fried fish and chips, absolutely amazing. Price is also fair for the large portion size. Though I wish the staff were knowledgeable about what the slushie flavours were instead of just "red, blue and purple". Drink size is very small too. Also no cutlery is given so had to bring it home to eat.

Just spent $17 on fish burger with chips and drink. Chips tasted stale, and who puts a meat patty in a fish burger? if I wanted a hamburger I would have said hamburger. disappointing first and last time il be at this takeaway.
After the hour wait.. Can't be that great
Just your run of the mill fish n chips,but done fresh! Fish was fresh,crispy batter,chips were crunchy and seasoned with a chefs kiss! Cheap and flavorful

Highly appalled at this stage. Would have been no stars but had to do one at least so that I can post this. Recently started getting chicken and chips from there. I loved their chicken nibbles. But then it just started getting bad each time even to the point where we ordered $8 extra chips with the chicken and chips packs and still looked like it was $3 or $4 worth. Now that wasn't my biggest issue. I could have actually lived with that. My biggest problem started the last two times, we had found a fly on one of the chips and then next time after that there was a fly on the chicken. We assumed it most likely dropped when we opened it up. Unfortunately I didnt take any photos for proof. But today's one has really put me off from going back there!! As you can see in the photo, there is a fly egg on there. You can even see that this was actually stuck onto the chicken itself. That's just outright disgusting!! I would not recommend this place at all anymore. Auckland council needs to check this place asap. Very unacceptable having flies or fly eggs in any food. I wish none of that had happened because I really did enjoy the chicken nibbles and chow mein from there. So please avoid this place if possible.

We live locally so this is our local takeaway. For a few years we’ve noticed some changes to the portions and we’ve generally been ok with the changes. However, it’s been getting ridiculous. We ordered their $20 special and $20 chicken fried rice. I think that’s suppose to $3 chips. Altogether there were 30 pieces of chips (my mum counted). Pretty ridiculous. So please know that if you’re ordering her to always buy an addition of $5 chips.

Wouldnt buy takeaway here to feed my dog tbh. Brought chicken nibbles and fries. The fries were a joke maybe $2 chips and chicken nibbles were burnt. They wrap the food in one layer of paper, and u burn ur hands from the hot grease. They overcharge everything from mayo/tomatoe sauces very small tubs for $1. Too bad its the only FAC in our area, but i will take a 10 min drive to browns road to get decent food and at resonable prices.

What a rip-off takeaway! Where is a good takeaway in rewa that has a better combo deals & also has nice fish & chip. You keep that up with that price, mate, and then surely you won't have that many customers 🤦‍♂️

Experience has not been good unfortunately. It happened a few times so hopefully after this review the service improves. The price we paid for the chips was a total rip off. $4-$5 chips should at least feed 2 children but in our cases it didn't. They continued to do the same after my son pointed it out about the quantity compared to price. Will try another takeaway

Ordered from Clendon MacDonald and they absolutely messed up my order, and I mean even the burgers weren’t made right. My Big Mac was made with cheese burger buns, not to mention half the meal missing. & don’t use they are over worked they took ages to get my order done.

Visit Date & Time: 28 May at 1:00 AM I had a disappointing experience during my visit. The staff were rude, and one woman claimed to be the manager, but she was not wearing a name tag and refused to provide her name when I asked. Additionally, she was not wearing gloves or a hat, which raises concerns about hygiene and professionalism. Overall, I was not satisfied with the service provided and expected a much higher standard.

Decent enough / does the job when we're tight on time & kids are ravenous 99% of our orders have at least one thing missing or the wrong sauce / burger etc / our order modification was completely disregarded (add almond milk/no ice/ no salt and so on) Customer service isn't horrible. They're still moderately fast even during peak hours with long lines Could be (and have experienced) worse at other locations

The spv is the one I believe was the one serving us. No name tag an just wear a hoodie She didn't ask our member or apps then we can't get point after we paid the meals. She should ask before hand... The ice cream also melted And this is less than 1 min from order... Bad experience Dirty playground area too
Service if having to go cou ter is on the slower side however other than that it is a great Mc Donald's has a nice little play area clean toilets and we always enjoy going in very.tidy store

My friends and I went here for the first time last weekend to support one of our friends' parents who were in the band. What a vibe! Thank you for having us. It was a highlight of our year so far. Great music, atmosphere and friendly members/community. Will definitely be back!

My happy place 😄 My parents were founder members and I had many happy times at the cosi, starting with the teenage club on a Thursday night, Sunday night kids discos, the hilarious yearly raft race and many more. Now, it’s Friday night raffles to catch up with my parents, their partners and friends ❤️

Love it here at the Weymouth Cozzy Club, is also home for... Maranga Fanau Charitable Trust Amazing group of Kaimahi "people" who gift their time and energy to the Manurewa Community I have had the pleasure of assisting Ringa Wera "kitchen" Our Elderly Group meet on Friday mornings 10am, for shared Line Dancing followed by light healthy Lunch💜 So many happy faces enjoying each other, and sharing this wonderful space
Could do with some TLC. However it's comfortable members and staff are very welcoming.

Such a shame went to watch the country club & wanted to have dinner there, feel we should have gone to Manurewa RSA first!! The specials were sold out & only menu food left which comprised of burgers, toasties, chips & steak meals, The steak could have been a schnitzel, it was that thin! As there were 7 of us it took nearly an hour to wait for our disappointment. Maybe better planning could help when something is happening at the Club.

BEST CHICKEN IN REWA! If you are craving for a chicken, try this store along roscommon road. Tasted like home fried chicken, chips are crunchy as! We always buy on this store, and they never disappoint us. Reasonable price, clean place, good staff. 🍗😍
I like the chicken thighs there and plus only 1 bone makes it easier to eat. But it is a little expensive.

Usually go to nockeys for chicken nibbles and chips but went here today! Far much better. Chicken nibbles were so tasty and fresh and chips were also very good, fresh and crispy!! Will be returning much more often!! Yummy food, good price, and freshness on point!!
Old chicken and chips shouldn't even be served if you pay for it. Never coming back worst fried chicken experience I may have ever had.

Haven't been here since the year it opened. Different staff now. I remember the first guy had his mates in the kitchen when the owner wasn't there lol. Anyways I'm pleasantly surprised it looks the same as it did in 2015 since I last came here. Still looks new! Food is the same and price is right. Good quality except the chips. THE 🍟 ARE THE BEST. I alone couldn't finish the large $5 chips. They were still crunchy when it cooled down. No where else that I know of makes chips like this.. consistently. Haven't been here in over 6 years and TNC Fried Chicken cracked the code of consistenly making great chips.

We ordered a spicy pepper paneer pizza with no peri peri sauce but we got the pizza with the sauce instead. When called after getting home, to get a replacement, we were told that we have to bring the mistaken pizza back and get a new one. Few of our friends already had that pizza and there were only few slices left. I went and gave the pizza in store, the lady who was most likely a manager (Indian), made faces and told so you are basically asking for a new free pizza. When I told her that this was not our mistake and what was gonna do with the pizza like warm it up and sell it someone else i guess. After making faces and arguing with she finally made the pizza. Another thing that over the phone she said the pizza will be ready but it still took like 15 mins after I got there. While I was standing there and waiting for the pizza, the same indian lady was talking to her staff about me mentioning that these indians want free food that's why they do this. Okay, you wanna talk behind my back go for it I really don't give a damn about it but atleast maintain some professionalism. Using the words like F word and B word towards your customers is not really a logical and ethical thing to do. Would recommend to train her again I guess.

Been going there regularly. Took a break and visited yesterday. It was whole new team. The pizza was 👌. Cooked right, toppings were done right what not, the pizza looked beautiful and was delicious. Keep it up guys.

Editing my review from 2 yrs ago We ordered 3 pizzas as in photos today and I tell ya, they were delicious 😋 These were the $5 pizzas that tasted like the gourmet range😆😉 The pizza qualities have definitely improved and I'm one happy customer! "Quick service but the cheese pizza was meh! You need it goggles to find the cheese" This review was done 2 years ago.

Pizza not cheesy enough, chips were overcooked, given old fries. Ive worked in the Hospitality industry for 30 years and I know good quality fries and food. You need more improvement on the filling, topping and sauces. ⭐️⭐️

Their meltzz is not worth the money, one side was just tiny than the other, should be equal and should be the same as your slices of pizza? I'm guessing when its delivered orders you make them like that and when it's not you make them presentable like your photos? mmmm
Fried chicken flavour was ok but an oil change will make it perfect, had a burnt aftertaste. Chicken fillet burger was tiny for $12 nice bun though. Waited over 20mins and still got cold as chips.

Worst food ever. Butter chicken is gross, gave the place another chance and got chips, potato and gravy and 2 chicken fillet burgers. Burgers were overly salty way too much salt taste like the ocean and only had lettuce mayo chicken and bun, 2$ cheese burger at McDonald's is better then that, chips were very below average and soggy and salty, and the potato and gravy!!!! They gave us JUST GRAVY. 5$ for a gravy that tastes like a gravy powder mix and water. Disgusting. Threw it in the big, not worth the money, don't recommend at all.
Butter chicken was way to sweet all I could taste was brown sugar 🙄 and their was only about 6-9 pieces of chicken 😓 I'm abit disappointed 💯
Brought fish and chips taste like rotten fish can do better if the charge for food aleast provide quality food

Bala's Country Fried Chicken Shop serves the best Veg Burger I've ever had! The crispy, flavorful patty and fresh ingredients made every bite a delight. Friendly service and quality ingredients make this my new favorite spot. Highly recommended!
First time trying new owners, must admit we enjoyed our dishes. Definitely will come back to try other dishes. Good customer service too. Thank you

Ordered some fried rice and egg as sides for our dinner tonight.
