Probably the worst I have had, I don't know if it's the oil they use or what but the egg taste like soap and the rice has a weird taste too. The guy that served us was really nice, so i feel bad putting this up but it was just inedible.

The food was so good in my opinion! considering I'm a very picky eater, the portions are very generous and the egg noodles/ Egg foo young are by far one of my most favorites I've tried! Will definitely be coming back for my next fix! Super happyyy

Sweet n sour pork and fried rice was not good at all it was dry and I’m not a fan of the hard carrots, batter and sauce. Duck was lacking flavour but char siu pork on rice was the best I have had from the clendon area it was thick and juicy. Will be back for bbq on rice menu only.
Delicious pork and rice aswell as other dishes bought good size portions.
Delicious, authentic Thai food with great service. The food was full of flavor, good portion, and the staff were super friendly. Also love the presentation. Highly recommend!

I ordered through uber eats a $60 order at 4:45pm. We Did not get delivery until 7:30pm 2 and a half HOURS!! Insane!!! I had to call the store twice to see if I was going to get my order. They said they had taken the order and were making it. I rang after an hour and a half the first time, I was told it would be 10 minutes. I then rang again half an hour later making this 2 HOURS wait time already. They said yes it is cooked and will be coming now. Another half hour went by and I finally received my order!!! This was passed on to 2 Uber drivers over time as the restaurant had not made my order to be picked up. Over the phone they told me they had an event on and were extremely busy. So why take the order, it was only 2x dishes and a appetiser. I have never waited this long for an order, the food was warm not hot and this was the worst experience I have ever had. I thank the Uber driver who was not at fault. In my opinion Natcha Thai were unprofessional, did not care or have any regard for their customer waiting to eat. I will never get food from them again, and will be sharing my experience with everyone I know. No apologies, and still did not bother to fill my order after the first phone call from me.

Loved it! Great food and friendly staff. Service was great too and the food didn't take too long to be served. We managed to get in on a quiet Sunday afternoon. The kids enjoyed the food too which was a bonus. Great find tucked away in the heart of Conifer Grove. They do dine in, takeaway and Uber Eats deliveries. Dine in depends on the Covid restriction protocols as normal. Give them a try, you won't be disappointed.

Beautiful tucked away place. Amazing service, nicest yellow curry and gari puffs I’ve had in Auckland hands down. Everything was lovely. The man who served us was quick, polite, checked on us and the food. Def will be back.

I ordered on Uber eats and didint get any rice I wouldn't go back to this place as it was advertised and extremely expensive to not enclude rice especially in a densely populated area not good enough. Plain greed

Absolutely avoid ordering from UberEats here—hands down the worst customer service. I placed an order at 11 PM, and it wasn’t completed until 12 AM for just five items. It’s not even peak hours, so there’s no excuse for it taking an entire hour to prepare five items at a gas station. If it were McDonald's or KFC, I could understand, but this is just ridiculous. I called multiple times for an update, and no one bothered to pick up. The staff clearly needs better training, and if they don’t enjoy their job, they should find something else.

Always love this Gull for their thick shakes. Maybe slightly expensive but they are the yummiest. And the variety is huge. You used to be able to go inside all night but I think some idiots who caused them problems have made it that way and now you have to go to the night window. Gull is the best place if you are in need of something in the middle of the night that most other gas stations don't provide.

Useless & Absolute rip off this place! Especially on Ubers. Tried to contact them multiple times regarding my uber order. they don’t even answer. Don’t buy from here waste of your money, adding extra bs costs . NEVER AGAIN

The range of hot food here is amazing, the pie warmer is stacked full of so many different flavours and I highly recommend the hotdog on the stick. Great store here, always really clean and looked after with super friendly staff. James Ashwin Kakapo Business

Ordered from here on door dash didn't even receive my 9.90 banana smoothie, and also did not receive my 1.5 l coke that cost 7.50, nor did I get any replacement for it didn't even get contacted by the store, and no refund. So disappointing😑

This place used to be our local years ago but we stopped coming because they became very stingy on their portions. Pieces went up and portions went down. We decided to give them another go last night and the quality has completely gone downhill now. They used to have the best fried rice, now they use a cheap rice that is not as nice. The sweet and sour has like fish batter on it, never had anything like it before and the wonton soup did not taste like a wonton soup at all. The flavour was so bland and it had black pieces through out it, it looks like the Teflon coating of the pot. Sadly I won't be supporting this local place anymore. Pretty expensive for cheaply made food.
The fish tasted stale and off.The wontons in the soup tasted off.The chow mein was fine.Disappointed with the food

Loved the sea dog and corn fritter but the fish I ordered with it had a bone that I discovered after taking a bite which spoiled my mood. Also yes I found it costly.. the good thing about this experience was the location atmosphere and the friendly kiwi girl at the counter who took my order

VERY EXPENSIVE. FOOD, just adequate, fish smelled like it was old, or frozen and thawed in the sun. Never Again!!! Chips $4.50 a scoop And it's a very small portion. It's worth my while to travel an extra 6km to get a decent feed, and the shouting at each other in Chinese just topped it off. Goodbyes to Moor Park Takeaways. 🤮

I had given this f&c shop 3 chances on different occasions. I have lived in the area for quite some time now the third time tonight I had given this f&p shop a chance to redeem from my previous 2 times I was dissatisfied. Sure enough it was the same experience I went through from my first 2. The fish had a lot of batter than fish. The taste was tasteless. Overall it was way too oily that killed it the most. I can honestly say at this stage I won’t be ordering anything from there. Even I stay just 5min drive away. I rather travel for good food than go here. That’s on facts. I hope it changes over time and maybe I will give it another chance. But to support local with my 3rd bad experience I tried and it failed.
Ordered on line Price was excellent Food so delicious ( Fish , chips , and hot dog ) I hungry for them and this is the next day lol. Will definitely order again !
Good food, good price. The place burnt down last year and now all the kitchen is new :) good bonus I guess.
Friendly and great service. I would recommend them.
Absolutely love this place. Excellent service with the ultimate tasting fresh food
Ordered 1 fish, hotdogs, chips and was charged $8. Owner could have pointed out the $7 deal that had the above and 2 wonton
Great little course, on a beautiful day. Friendly staff in the office and bar. Will be back im sure.
Great food! Will definitely be returning to try more of the menu. Lovely staff too.
Beautiful course. Lots of fun!

Wednesday evening meal, fresh pan-fried Gurnard and a salad. I really liked both, complimented the kitchen. The salad was spectacular, fish cooked to perfection. Price was $19 I think. A couple of steinlagers latter and dinner done The steak burger was reported as great The sausages, mash and peas also great Check out the desert plate!
This is a great little golf course. Has practise areas, club rentals, etc.. beautiful course hidden away.
Pleasant place. Cakes and muffins are reasonably priced but have got smaller recently. Coffee often only luke warm... ask for it to be hot when ordering. Can be chilly here in winter.

This place has really turned around! I was not expecting much but wow!!!! We had the beef burger with chips. The chips were absolutely delicious and the burger was so good! We all enjoyed it. One thing I must say though is you should probably warn people that the sauce in it has a kick. I personally loved the spice but my partner found it abit spicy (he doesn't have good taste buds haha). My dad loved his ribs too. We are all looking forward to coming back and trying more. The prices are quite good too and the saff were very friendly and easy to chat with. They made us feel very comfortable. Have since been back and the roast nights are amazing!
Plenty of parking, food portion was quite generous. Decently priced.
Had a big breakfast and it was delicious. The serving was hearty and was like a home made meal away from home. The coffee was exceptional.
Good hot chips, coffee and pizza. Have a selection of beers that my friend enjoyed and I did enjoy my coffee. The girls who served were lovely and I will definitely be back sometime again.

This is the amount of chips they give with order C. 3 fish and 3 hotdogs for this amount of chips ? The owners from years back were amazing . Now the new owners give you 5 pieces of chips 😂 . Also the fish batter is soggy and hotdogs batter tasted like hard rubber.

This place used to sell amazing fish. But recently changed hands and the fish is sadly not great they taste precooked ,frozen then recooked. The batter isn't very nice. The portion sizes for chips wasn't the greatest before but it's even less now ,we orderd a $25 meal and a kids $8.50 meal and this is all the chips we got. Burgers are still the same though.
Best fish and chips in South Auckland. Everything tastes fresh and not overly greasy. Lucky to have this as my local chippy.

We have been living locally over 20yrs and have had at least 3x owners for this Fish & Chips shop. Current owner will be the 4th and absolutely love the food. Service is great! Will be amazing to buy the shop next door which has been closed for many many years and put some chairs and tables there to sit down and eat. Current shop is small considering you have more customers than I've ever seen before. Keep up the amazing work! Ngā mihi Sally T
Ordered the $28 combo. They were generous to give an extra fried fish fillet and potato fritter to the meal. Their deep fried chocolate is also a must try with the cinammon and sugar.

Very dissapointing, please use fresh chicken. i know full well the chicken in the sweet and sour was expired off. I really enjoyed your take out but the chinese has just ruined it also chow mein has way to much sodium msg or soy sauce it was beyond salty. Fried rice was tasteless bland. The only nice thing out of the lot was the egg foo yong. If i could give a negative star i would

One of the worst takeaways I’ve had. The chips and potato fritters were tasteless, and the fried rice was a letdown - it didn’t taste like traditional fried rice and it didn't have vegetables. The sweet and sour pork was just okay, but overall, it didn’t feel worth the money.
Reeaaaally good fish and chips, some of the best have had. Nice and clean as well. Way better under the new ownership
Good food, new owners doing well, on atmosphere, magazines to read and good seats, Thankyou
Best chips in the area. New owners have made a big difference.
The kumara and vege filo pastry was absolutely tasteless and stale. Also, I have never eaten such a bad choco fudge which was also stale. Never visiting again.
This is one of the best cafes ever. The food was delicious, and the coffee was awesome .

Stopped in for a cuppa and a bite with a friend. Didn't appreciate finding plates with chips to serve food, left it at the counter. Pie was good, fancy coffee decorations. As for the date muffin, I first thought it was out of date, instead it was probably in the oven too long. As for serving it with margarine, yuk, I'm a butter only person. Needless to say, muffins is not their best option. Perhaps I caught them on a bad day, might stop over again if I'm in the area.

Had a steak & cheese pie and a banoffee slice. Staff were friendly and warmed the pie, which was nice, though it wasn’t very fresh. The pie filling was jelly-like with a five-spice flavour that never works for me, minimal cheese, and a thick base. The banoffee slice was overly sweet with little banana or toffee flavour. Pleasant atmosphere overall, but the flavours and textures could use some fine-tuning.
I love this place, spinach and onion with black paper on top of the sandwich. They guys are making wonderful meals for us.

Located just inside the Woolworths entrance on the left. We ordered 2x Hot Meals and if it's over $39 at lunch time you get 2x Coca COLA drinks for free. Other times, there are different Combos. We had a Chicken Katsu Don and Tonkatsu Pork Ramen. Kake Udon and a sushi pack. All were good value for money and freshly made.

Actual best sushi shop in the land. The curries are top tier, the sushi and fried foods are always fresh and crispy, the store is always tidy and well prepped, and the staff are very kind and friendly. Very vegan friendly!
My fav sushi stop. Love the fresh and delicious food. Great team nice and friendly.
Thank you for accomodating my request for making me a tuna ball even though it’s not on the menu

Great place for sushi and a bite of Japanese food. There is a a la carte menu here which you can order from the kitchen. Also sushi is available here on display which you can pick your own to go. Can’t go wrong. Price is fair and food is great. There are a few vegan options but you will need to ask. A lot of vegan sushi available too.

Absolutely amazing food! The starters were a burst of flavor—especially the sandwich dhokla and Manchurians, which were super yummy. But the star of the show was the undhiyu—simply stole the limelight! The charcoal paneer was a delightful surprise. Tastes just like 100% ghar ka khanna. Loved it!
Wow I have no comment food was amazing service was best just wow
food and service is awesome, you definately gona enjoy, I enjoyed lot 🙏

I ordered the food many times from Maharaj Kitchen. It reminds me the taste of Indian restaurants food in India which I hardly get here in Auckland. The delicate balance of sweet, sour, and spicy in dishes like theplas and undhiyu is truly a culinary masterpiece. The vibrant flavors and aromatic spices of Gujarati, Indochinese and Punjabi cuisine create an unforgettable experience. Highly recommended anytime.
I would recommend catering orders for awesome and finger licking Gujarati food. No doubt, food is really tasty. Good option in south Auckland.

This small yet Prosperous venue sells not only Fried chicken, but is also a dairy, I've cream and milkshake parlor. Has a few carpark spaces - maybe for 5x cars. Service could be bit better they make you wait to be honest, and at times areas need to be wiped down especially the keypad when you paying for things. NASTY!!! 5/10

Best Samosa I've had anywhere... big, full of flavour full of filling I have never come across a Samosa close to what they sell here... Happy to travel out of my way just for them.... Huuuuge Ice Creams too, friendly and welcoming staff
Best chicken burgers ever should go down n try it for yourself

The food is over priced and bland. I bought a large curry and rice, I counted 3 small pieces of lamb and a bone : $17.50 $17.50 + a drink $20. For $5 more I could have gone to a restaurant. I was a loyal customer and will not be returning.

Mouth watering food. Prices are slightly higher but value for money. I have had chicken curry and roti. Both were freshly made. I've also had chicken and chips. Good quantity of food and freshly cooked. This is my go to place now.

Great experience I had a large order but, no stress still yummy pizza and the kids enjoyed the loaded fries they went down well. Pizza I ordered a few and the crust was 👌. Pizza toppings was good to see they covered nearly every bit of the pizza no skimming on the kai. The Burger wicked the HMC juicy chicken and delightful sauce for days just great. The wait was just what I expected since I had a large order and great service would recommend.

the most incredible pizza!!! I can’t imagine going to any other place for pizza now it’s that good. So many flavours to choose from & you definitely get your money’s worth. Yet to try the burgers but I’ve only heard good things about them too! Lovely service every time aswell :))

The food was delicious! We ordered two standard pizzas; Supreme and Hawaiian. Both had a nice crispy base and full of toppings. The toppings were quality and flavourful. The service was as friendly :) We can’t wait to come again as we live just around the corner. Definitely try this place out you won’t be disappointed and you will want to come back for more. Plus we got a free can of drink with each pizza. Can’t comment on the atmosphere as we didn’t eat in. However it was much better than nearby take away shops which are usually dirty. It was clean outside too ^_^

Best Pizza & Service we’ve seen. The pizza was outstanding, with a delightful balance of fresh, flavorful toppings and impeccable cooking that brought out the best in each ingredient. The team provided exceptional service, combining friendly and professionalism to create an enjoyable and memorable experience. Highly recommend to everyone.

First of all, customer service is amazing. The team are very friendly and super helpful. Food was fresh and delicious. Exactly what I was craving. Look forward to trying out the other items on the menu.

Update 25/06/2025: I look forward to try their unique weekend special. Must try the Chicken 65, snacks and new items they add on Fridays and Saturdays. Go to place for their homestyle meals and when you are missing Kerala food in Auckland! I also enjoy their IndoChinese food 😋 Enjoyable and tasty Kerala meals. Biryani, Pothichoru, Appam and Puttu are highly recommended. Had the Sadya yesterday which was a delightful experience 👍

Heaven Indian Kitchen was referred to me by a friend, and I placed my order via phone. The guy who assisted me, Jojo, was kind enough to guide me about the menu options and took my order. Due to the current circumstances, I was unable to make it before 2:30, but he assured me he would come and deliver it to the restaurant if I arrived after 2:30. That was a kind and respectful gesture. However, I made it to the restaurant on time, and before going in, I needed to cancel two of my phone-ordered items, and he was more than happy to do that. My orders were: 1) Chicken Biryani and complimentary Chicken 65: A decent Kerala-style chicken biryani with long-grain basmati rice. It had four full eggs inside, along with a separate small pickle box, four papadums, and raita. It was more than enough quantity to share with four adults and had generous chicken pieces. Kids will enjoy it because it's not too spicy, with a mild flavor. There is nothing to complain about with this biryani. I liked it and definitely recommend it to others. It's much better than any other Kerala biryani I've tried at other restaurants. It's not outstanding, but it's a good option. The complimentary Chicken 65 was good. You can't expect a big box of Chicken 65; it's a small box with limited pieces. Definitely good Chicken 65, not too dry; the pieces were still juicy and tasty. My elder child loved it. 2) Chalakkudi Pork Fry: I must say, I've had a much better version of pork fry before. So, I won't say it's special, but it still tastes good, and I liked the big, chunky fat pieces. It even tasted better when I had it the next day. I will recommend having it if you visit this place; it will not disappoint you. In total, I paid around $58 for the biryani and $22 or $23 for the pork fry.

This place is my family’s favourite…. The food is delicious every time. And the staff are very helpful and lovely…. Due to not being Indian sometimes we want to try new dishes but are hesitant but the staff are very helpful and honest…. 10/10 from us

One Star Review: Absolutely terrible experience. The goat was bland, chewy, and had zero salt or seasoning — completely flavourless. To make it worse, the biryani came with raw vegetables mixed in, which made it taste even worse. Total waste of money — I wouldn’t recommend this place to anyone looking for real biryani. Avoid at all costs

Tried the Ona Sadhya after seeing a Facebook post. The ordering and pick-up was easy as, and the food was absolutely delicious. We are definitely going to check out other items in their menu sometime soon.

I cannot confirm all the negative comments I have read in the reviews. We have ordered Palak Paneer as well as Daal Tarka together with Nan and Dahi. Every thing had a fabulous taste and fresh masalas as well as ginger. A kind Sardarji is owner from Amritsar and the food was quite authentic.
A real humble staff, great food taste and great pasture..for better food experience please visit Shere Punjab Restaurant.

Mango Lasi we brought today. Was to see that the staff made it fresh. But disappointed after tasting. All I could taste was refrigerator taste / odor in mouth as if the pulp was not kept in the fridge with a lip closed.
Got 3 butter nun with chicken and Alu Gopi dish . 2 of the butte nun was black !! Food is okay . Not coming again .

I’ve had food from many different restaurants but Shere Punjab Takanini is a big let down. The guy at the counter was very unwelcoming, had zero customer service skills, full of arrogance and made it feel like he didn’t want customers coming there. The curry tasted okay, but the rice had a weird taste as if it was just old and reheated. Naan was of poor quality, full of holes. I recommend going elsewhere for Indian food if you actually want to be treated like a customer and have quality food.
Under staffing, long wait. Bad coffee. Bad food. What more can I say accept go somewhere else for your lunch 😉
Wild bean always has great coffee. Especially when it's your free loyalty one 😃
Usually busy in the early morning, but never wait too long. Good hot coffee.
Ordered a coffee It came out like hot milk Sent it back and watched him poor to another cup and top up with more milk Absolute class thanks Paying good money for that sort of treatment

I just stopped in on my way to work to get a mango e2 and there was none in the fridge and I could clearly see the there was excess amount on the shelves in the chiller behind the display fridges. I kindly asked the woman who was behind the til in the black shirt if she was able to get me 1 please. She persisted on telling me that they do not sell mango e2 they only sell green e2 which yes you do sell green e2 two different flavours in fact, one being apple and the other being mango. The only reason I can think of why she refused to help me let alone believe me was because she was too lazy. To follow this up I phoned to complain of the utter rudeness I had just experienced and of corse the same lady answers the phone (she was the only lady of Indian decent working in the store at the time i visited) which made her easy to identify...as I am talking she then hungs up on me. So first she doesnt believe what i seen with my own eyes but then blantantly lies to me to then cut me off. Absolutely the worst customer service I have had in years. I would never recommend going here to anyone. Instead I would highly recommend the small dairy across the road whom at the time were having full renovations done in their shop not only helped me to locate exactly what I asked for but wished a great evening with a smile as I left!

Nostalgia Overload!! Jalebis and Potato Puffs are exactly how they are back home in Karachi Pakistan. Chai is served in a cute chenak and the dahi baras were a surprise. (I don’t usually like them but theirs is really good) Papri chat was the only thing that did not make me smile but it wasn’t bad..just not as awesome as the other stuff were. Highly recommended! No picture but my kids LOVE the peas pulao here! The service is very very good as well.
We went there for lunch on Monday. The food was just awesome. We ordered abit too much but it was worth it. Best place for best vegetarian food.

The meals were exactly as described online and tasted just like home-cooked food. I had dinner here with my family while traveling back to Hamilton, and we were all very pleased with the experience. I will definitely be returning in the future.

We had a lovely lunch at Novelty Takanini today! The food was fresh and delicious, and the service was absolutely top-notch. Sneh looked after us with such warmth and care — her friendly attitude really made our visit extra special. Thank you for a great experience! We’ll definitely be back. 😊

Tried this place for the very first time and it was worth the price and time. We tried veg hot n sour soup, South Indian platter, veg momos, ras malai and falooda ice cream. It was amazing overall. Very timely customer service and well spoken staff members. Restaurant was busy with People dining in and people waiting on takeaway orders but still we were looked after by the staff lady called NISHA their in a friendly and timely manner. I would also recommend their cakes 🎂and pastries 🍰 all are eggless and very delicious. I ordered chocolate mud cake 🎂 for my sister’s birthday along with the special instructions since she’s allergic to cream topping on the cake. They followed the instructions very well and did cross Checked with me for any cream layering inside to be done or not while preparing the cake 🎂 very satisfying and fruitful experience on the very first visit. Looking forward for the same 😊keep up the great work team 👍🙌

It’s been years since I last had Popeyes—the last time was back in Panama—so when I spotted this gem, I knew I had to give it another go. Let me tell you, it absolutely lived up to the memories! The fried chicken blew my mind all over again. It was exactly how I remembered it: crispy on the outside, juicy and succulent on the inside. Every bite was packed with bold, savoury flavour that hit all the right notes. It’s that perfect balance of crunchy coating and tender meat that’s so hard to find elsewhere. Popeyes really knows how to do fried chicken right, and this visit just confirmed it. The overall experience was great too. The service was efficient, the staff were friendly, and the food came out hot and fresh, just the way it should. It was such a good reminder of why Popeyes has the reputation it does among fried chicken fans. The only downside I noticed was the price. Compared to other fried chicken spots, it did feel a bit on the expensive side, especially for what you get portion-wise. That said, the quality of the chicken and the nostalgic, satisfying flavours made it worth it for me this time around. If you’re a fried chicken lover—or just someone chasing a bit of comfort food nostalgia—Popeyes is a solid choice. I’m already looking forward to my next visit… though maybe next time I’ll be a bit more prepared for the prices! All in all, an awesome spot to relive some great food memories and enjoy some truly delicious fried chicken.

Another great alternative My children beckon me to go to this fast food restaurant. They told me that it was a new chain that had just invaded Auckland. I have heard of its reputation and it is good to try new things. We weren't very crowded while we were there. The place is well-lit and looks very clean. We placed our order though we did not receive it as fast as we thought, the staff came out to apologize for the delay which I felt was a great gesture. I was quite impressed with the staff's manners and friendliness. Good job. The chicken was well done. Though the marination is a little salty to my liking, it was flavourful. It was crispy to bite into and then juicy on the inside. I particularly prefer the wings as it was a little spicy. I am not a fan of the biscuits but the gravy is nice. Sadly, they do not have salad or something for the health-conscious bunch. The French fries are not the best nor the mashed potatoes. Overall, I prefer this restaurant to other fast-food fried chicken restaurants because of the chicken. It was "finger-licking good." Hehe...

If you follow paul saladino you know that tallow is better than seed oil. So Yes it's my preferred choice and I wish u guys were a bit closer to me. Food was tasty, chicken was well cooked whilst being moist so can't be faulted. 👍

Such an amazing experience. We went for my sister's birthday and ordered a whole lot of food, probably making the staffs job so hard. Mohsin went above and beyond! And when he heard it was someone's birthday came out again to offer a treat on the house. The space was tidy and a cool vibe and amazing customer service. The food was amazing, tasted fresh like it wasn't processed at all. We can't even describe it. Everyone wants their birthday here now! Even the vegetarians. Thank you Mohsin. 10000/10! Great experience.

Visited in the afternoon on Waitangi Day on the way home to Hamilton. I was excited to finally try Popeyes as there had been so much hype around it - I would say it was well deserved! Ordering through the kiosk was simple and my food did not take that long to arrive. It was hot and my order was correct. I had the tenders with mac and cheese, gravy, chips, and a drink. All the food was absolutely delicious, I loved the cajun seasoning in gravy and on the fries. The chicken itself is not especially unique; it is hot, juicy and tasty, but the sides are really where it’s at. I thoroughly enjoyed my meal and left satisfied. Next time I would be inclined to try the chicken sandwich.

I never received it. The Uber driver obviously couldn’t find my place as it’s a new subdivision but he also didn’t give a number so I couldn’t even phone him to see where he was. Was really brassed off. He obviously dropped it to somebody, but not to me. So I can’t offer my advice as to how good the meal was. But previously, when I have ordered from the same place, it’s always been great. Good food and always well packed and still hot. So no problems with the food, just the delivery of it.

You n Me Sushi❤️❤️❤️ The Katsu Chicken bowl is scumptious and yes you can add more Chicken😱🍗 Always friendly customer service! The menu includes rice triangles, sushi and Donburi bowls Deliveries available

Normally I would rave about this place as it is often our go to sushi but after buying a seafood salad and chicken and rice today it falls from the top of our list. The chicken and rice amazing and son loved it but the seafood salad had one prawn in it and that was it. Lots and lots of coleslaw but only one prawn. I am disappointed and it is only the chicken and rice my son got that has me posting this as a 2 star.
It doesn't matter you buy 5 pieces or 10 you will get 1 soy sauce and have to buy another for 10 pieces for takeaway. Strange understanding for the staff
Ordered through uber eats and another driver accidentally took our order. The store were awesome and left a note in the bag explaining the mix up

We visited after seeing a promo on Instagram by @foodiestable. The team was really friendly, but unfortunately the food didn’t live up to expectations. The Yokum burger had a nice chargrilled flavour but was let down by small bones throughout the chicken. The Double Up burger had nice flavour but was underwhelming with lack of salad and sauce. The fish looked good but had a strange gummy texture and lacked flavour even after we tried cooking it more at home. Potato fritters were a bit of a joke, teeny weeny, overcooked, oil soaked and with paper-thin potato on the inside. The onion rings were okay nothing great, nothing bad, just standard and the chips were the same although a bit dry. The most disappointing part was the $10 Oreo shake. It did have bits of cookie but poured like milk (you can see in picture) and had absolutely no thickness so just tasted like sweet, watery milk. We couldn’t drink it and ended up throwing it out so it was a waste of money. We’re locals and had hoped to find a new regular spot, but this experience left us disappointed and unlikely to return.

Ordered a charcoal chicken,2 pueces of fiah and chips,plus another lot of fish and chips. This was through uber eats. The chicken was very ordinary,looked like one from countdown,the chicken was pink in colour,not appetising at all. The extra lot of chips ordered was not received. When informed about the missing order,they were quick to admit this and apologised but no solution was given. I was promised a refund for the missed order,till date,not received. Overall a real bad deal and i would not recommend this place.

The lady who works here has served me twice now, and both times she has made incredibly small ice cream cones. Her English is terrible, even though I understand that people don’t always speak English well. However, this was beyond bad. She also doesn’t push the ice cream down into the cone, so it falls out and lands on the ground. Used to be really good when the other servers worked there regardless of English service was still amazing

So delicious! We came in, service was great super friendly staff. The flavours in the steak and cheese roll was so delicious! Perfect hangover feed or if you’re feeling like having a real hearty feed. $48 for everything in the photo plus an extra can of drink that’s not shown. Their special sauce on the mixed meat on rice was delicious- a sweet n chilli with mayo mix. Yokum burger yum but the fav was the steak and cheese roll! We’ll be back thanks Grill n thrill! 🫶🏼

Absolute must try spot, super friendly people and humble personality , great menu and food tastes incredible and amazing quality- tried the tandoori chicken and chicken kabab. hands down one of the best tandoori chicken I've had in years. Highly recommended😊😊 keep rocking Cheers!
Tried Papa's Chicken and wow,super crispy and packed with flavor. The chicken was juicy and just so good. Honestly couldn’t stop eating. Highly recommend if you’re around!

The sauce is simply incredible, adding the perfect amount of flavor to the crispy chicken. The crispiness of the chicken lasts for a surprisingly long time, making each bite just as delicious as the first. The portion size is quite generous, making it a great option for sharing among 2-3 people. Pairing it with a cold beer would be the ultimate combination. Overall, this dish comes highly recommended for anyone looking for a tasty and satisfying meal. Don't miss out on the opportunity to try this amazing chicken and sauce combo.

Been here about 3 times, all times were great. We got 1 half boneless seasoned chicken and 1 half boneless sweet and sour chicken. We also got some rice cakes and we got to pick between coleslaw or radish as we got a whole chicken. Food was great and quick. The seasoned chicken was the best, it was crunchy, hot and a little bit spicy. The sour chicken was also good but not crunchy and more on the soggy side but we expected it would be like that. 1 half chicken was able to feed two people. Definitely come here!

Korean Chicken? I was intrigued when I first saw the reviews. Someone is the most crisp chicken she ever had, and that really enticed me. My family we love food and we love to eat. One of our favourite Korean eateries is actually Bonchon Chicken, and why we love Bonchon is because of a Korean friend we knew. Her fried chicken with sauce and sesame is out of the world. Bonchon chicken does not even come close to the chicken she cooked. One huge bite into the chicken, the sauce oozes out of my mouth, and with the beautiful crunchy noise, it makes. At Papas, the chicken is not as Crispy as I expected, but the sauce is fine. Mixed with the fried, it can be quite appetising. I like the fried rice cake, but the coleslaw and potato wedges are... The restaurant can be a little pricey, but it can keep my children happy.

Had the soy honey and the cream onion chicken with some wedges. All the chicken pieces was perfectly crisp and are tender. The soy honey was mildly sweet and savoury. The cream onion came separately in a tub with raw onion and some cream which was like a yogurt, which was nice, as raw onion is not for everyone. The original chicken was really nice too. The wedges was crispy on outside and mashy inside. Overall will come back again.

Feels like a scam — disappointing chicken biryani Ordered chicken biryani through Uber Eats and was shocked to find only 1 or 2 very tiny pieces of chicken in the entire dish. this is completely unacceptable. Feels like a rip-off. Don’t get scammed — avoid ordering from here if you’re expecting a proper meal.

If you’re in South Auckland and love Indian regional food, don’t miss Beema’s Kitchen in Takanini. This place serves the best Andhra food I’ve had in Auckland—hands down. I’ve only ever ordered through DoorDash (way too many times), but every dish has been consistently spot on. The poori is perfectly made, idly is soft and drenched in ghee, and the punugulu with sweet ginger chutney is seriously addictive. And their moong dhall payasam is perfect. You can tell the food’s made with care and attention to authentic flavours. A must-try if you’re looking for something beyond the usual. Can’t wait to visit in person one day!
Very yummy food! I loved my Lamb Biryani & Chicken curry. Little expensive but worth it.
I ordered Uber eats yesterday for lunch, I had leftovers today when i was eating i noticed a black little piece of hair. The food is no doubt amazing but i wasn’t happy with what happened.

Delicious Poori & Chicken Curry at Bheema Bheema serves an outstanding Poori and Chicken Curry that is packed with authentic flavors. The poori is perfectly golden, crispy on the outside yet soft and airy inside, making it the ideal companion to the rich and aromatic chicken curry. The curry itself is deeply spiced, with tender chicken pieces simmered in a flavorful, thick gravy that has just the right amount of heat. The combination is comforting, satisfying, and a true delight for Indian food lovers. If you’re craving a classic, well-executed dish, this one is definitely worth trying!

Tried the butter chicken kebab and it was one of the best kebabs I’ve ever had!! Well priced and flavourful. The woman behind the counter was very friendly and quick. Thanks for great service and a delicious meal.
Amazing food with a taste that was perfect Owner is delight and offers great service

Fantastic food and top-notch service! I recently ordered from Mr. Kebab Takanini and was blown away by the quality of the food. The vege pizza was absolutely amazing—perfectly cooked with fresh toppings and a delicious crust. And the kebab was on point, packed with flavor and paired with crispy hot chips that were the perfect side. Every bite was full of goodness! Highly recommend this place for anyone craving tasty, hearty food. Will definitely be ordering again soon!

Please do not waste your time coming here! Visited here for the first time yesterday. Excited to try a new food place. Yuck food & Absolutely appalling customer service from the guy with the black hair and beard. Very rude, not welcoming and always talking in his headphones to someone on his phone. He was also extremely unsanitary while handling the food. I ordered a pepperoni pizza, large chips and 2 cans of drinks. Waited patiently for my food for over an hour!! He purposely served 2 customers that came in and ordered after me but they received their food before me? The store was not packed at all, I was the only one waiting at the time. And there were no delivery orders being made or picked up. So why so long? I’ve never been anywhere they take over 40mins to heat up what was old fries and a frozen pizza base up. I went up after he served the people who received their food before me to ask if my order was ready and he mumbled very rudely yes I’m making it. After an hour and a-bit of waiting for my food I finally receive it. How disappointing.. the pizza was burnt, base was stale and it was not what I had ordered. The fries were not fresh, overly cooked or tasted like they had been re-fried and just loaded with a tonne of seasoning to try take away from the burnt yuck taste. I went back up to tell him that this is not a pepperoni pizza as I could not find any pepperoni just burnt cheese, which he then tried to gaslight me and tell me yes it is, it’s underneath, go look. Underneath where!?? It was only until someone else I was with tried the pizza that we found it was bacon/ham on the pizza not pepperoni! I took my pizza back up to him, showed him, this is not pepperoni this is ham! Not what I ordered and not what he said it was. I asked for a refund and left. He really should have given me a refund for my whole order, time wasted, disgusting food and terrible customer service. I will never come back here and advise everyone to not waste their time or money coming here.

Shop owner was friendly, upbeat and polite. Food was fresh, chips chicken salt was 👌🏾 We had just eaten at another store over from this and had a totally opposite experience so will defs be back here. Thanks Mr Kebab!

The large kebab on rice comes in such a small container, the same size container as the chips. Picture next to my hand (regular sized female hand) for reference. Despite ordering online, they said they were under new management and that we shouldn't have ordered from their website because they haven't changed it over yet so we had to wait for them to make the whole order. We got home to find the order instructions were missed so order was wrong and contained olives, jalapenos and onions. The chips were inedible. They were so salty and wet from condensation which you can see in pictures, even though we live 6min drive away. Feel really ripped off tonight to pay $39 for two small kebab on rice and chips to go in the scrap bin.

Nah, sorry... But you need to put some more quality effort to make my money. Had lamb on chips, never seen meat like that before. Completely dried up and seems it was lying there for ages. Just ate it because i was hungry. Just the amount of sauces made it eatable, and the chips soggy as.
The food was delivered it was cold, the meat tasted stale. It looked nothing like the pictures. We could not even eat it. I would never order this again.

"I'm obsessed with Takanini kebab and fried chicken. The flavors are incredible, and the quality of the meat is top-notch. I've tried the lamb, chicken, and veggie kebabs, and each one has been perfectly cooked and seasoned. The staff is friendly and attentive, and the service is always quick. The prices are very reasonable, especially considering the generous portion sizes. My favorite is the mixed meat platter - it's a must-try! The combination of juicy lamb and chicken, crispy veggies, and creamy tzatziki sauce is absolute perfection. Highly recommend for a delicious, satisfying, and affordable meal. Can't wait to come back!"

I'm not sure how they have an A grade food safety rating. I ordered chicken kebab and immediately regretted doing so. The salads on display were dry, wilting and looking old. The guy who made the wrap picked all the salads with his hand... no gloves in sight. It was disgusting and unhygienic.

My friend took me to this place, had most amazing Indian curry experience at Pizza & Curry House. I ordered the Madras Fish Curry and Fish Pakora and it was love at first bite! The flavors were incredibly authentic, transporting me straight to the homeland. Huge thanks to Chef Parm for the expertise and care that clearly goes into each dish. I'll definitely be recommending this place to everyone, If you're looking for a great Indian takeaway, look no further. Try the curries - you won't regret it!!!!!

I ordered the malai chap from Delight Pizza and Curry House, and it was a complete disappointment. For the price I paid (over$11), I expected a decent portion and good flavor — but what I got was bland, dry, and barely edible. Honestly, it wasn’t even worth $2, let alone what they’re charging. The texture was off, the seasoning was almost nonexistent, and it tasted like it had been sitting around for a while. Totally a waste of money. Would not recommend this dish at all. Save your money or try something else if you decide to order from here.

I recently ordered the Malai Chap from Delight Pizza and curry house in Takanini, and honestly, it was a total waste of money. The flavor was bland and completely underwhelming — nothing like what you’d expect from a proper Malai Chap. The texture was off too, almost rubbery, and didn’t seem fresh at all. I had high hopes, but this was really disappointing. Definitely not worth the price, and I won’t be ordering it again.

Honestly, I had high hopes when I ordered the Malai Chaap from Delight Pizza and Curry House, but it turned out to be a huge letdown. It looked decent in the pictures, but the taste was just not it. The texture was weird—chewy and not fresh at all. The “malai” part, which I thought would be creamy and flavorful, was just oily and bland. There was barely any seasoning, and overall it just tasted flat and unappetizing. I kept trying to give it a chance with each bite, hoping it would get better, but it didn’t
Food was always fresh and hot. We liked the Garlic Naan, Curry and all other food that we order. We have tried a Pizza once too, it was perfect. Give it a shot guys. Friendly staff too.

We got 'served' by a lady who was quite standoffish & made us feel like ordering was a bit of a burden lol Ordered x2 lunch time specials with butter chicken- chicken was bland but hot chips were great hence the 2 stars for food! Atmosphere was super quiet, we killed a spider on the seats before we sat and noticed leftover water jug on the other seat table... Hopefully the other foods on the menu are great unfortunately we won't be back though.
We ordered Chicken Noodles, chicken malai, and chilly chicken - all of which was scrumptious! Tried for the first time and it’s beyond our expectations. Hidden gem indeed ❤️‍🔥
Tikka masala and chilli chicken is too good. Loved it !!

To be honest. You need to actually put some chicken in the butter chicken, not just sauce. Bought butter chicken on chips x3 and there was 3 tiny pieces of chicken in each and a small portion of chips with sauce. Not worth $10, sorry. Nice friendly staff though and it's a nice shop. Just a shame, on the portions for me.
Great little place. I had a butter chicken and a naan and it didn't disappoint. Really clean, friendly staff and pricing as what you would expect. Good value though. Would definitely recommend.

If you’re in South Auckland and craving authentic Punjabi flavours, look no further than Sardar Sweets in Takanini. Their Punjabi Thali is hands down one of the best I’ve ever had! Each item on the thali bursts with homemade, traditional taste. The sabzi (veggies) were full of flavour, the dal was rich and comforting, and the roti came out hot, soft, and fresh. One highlight? The crispy bhatura — perfectly puffed and golden! Not oily, just right. They also serve a tangy, refreshing buttermilk (chaas) that instantly takes you back to a dhaba in Punjab. Cold, spiced well, and served generously — a real nostalgic touch. To top it off, the thali includes a delightful sweet (mithai) which balances the spices with just the right amount of sugary bliss. But the real star for me was their Aloo Paratha — creamy, crispy, and stuffed with delicious spiced potato filling. Served with curd and pickle, it’s a full meal on its own! The portion sizes are generous, prices are fair, and the staff are warm and friendly, which makes the experience even better. I’ve been here a few times and the consistency of flavour and service is what keeps me coming back. Highly recommend this place if you’re looking for true Punjabi comfort food in Auckland!
The best thali and Samosas you'll get in Takanini. The people who run this place are very kind and friendly. The food tastes fresh and yummy. Good value for money too :)
Best Indian food . I have ever had in south Auckland. Great Service by friendly staff. Much appreciated

bought 2 sabjis they charged me $20 each! For that price, I expected at least enough to serve a couple of people, but the portions were tiny and barely enough for one. I ordered daal and paneer, but honestly, the value just wasn’t there. Also, it feels wrong to play Gurbani all day if you’re going to overcharge people like this. It sends the wrong message and comes across as hypocritical. Very disappointed won’t be coming back.

Food and customer service were awesome. I am restricted with my diet as I don’t eat onion and garlic but family was hungry so stopped by to try. When I ask if there is anything without onion and garlic the employee replied I can choose anything from the menu and they can make it and they did. Very satisfied with food and customer service, will return for sure

I have ordered two cake back to back week. But it was very good. Actually I thought butterscotch will be boring but everyone loved it. And another week I ordered chocolate cake and it was on the spot idea. But cake was really good and fresh. Everyone was happy.

I recently ordered a gender reveal baby shower cake from Bake & Beans Takanini for my Friend, and it was an absolute masterpiece! From the moment I placed my order, the team was incredibly attentive, taking the time to go through every detail with care. The craftsmanship on the cake was beyond perfect — every detail, from the baby shoes to the cute decorations, was stunning and on point. The "Oh Baby" topper and the pink/blue theme made it extra special. 💙💖 I went with their cookies and cream flavour on their recommendation, and it was the best decision — incredibly moist, creamy, and packed with flavour. Everyone at the party was raving about it! This was my first time ordering from here, thanks to a friend's recommendation, and now they've officially become my go-to cake place in Auckland. I’ve honestly never seen a cake with such top-tier detail and amazing taste. Massive shoutout to the bakers — your work is next-level! 🙌 1000% recommended to anyone looking for quality, creativity, and flavour all in one place!

I've been a loyal customer of Bake & Beans Takanini since the day they opened, and they’ve consistently delivered top-notch service. Their pies and puffs are packed with flavour, with a wide range of meat and vegetarian options—something you rarely find elsewhere! But what truly sets them apart are their fluffy, creamy, and incredibly fresh cakes. The Cassatta and Butterscotch are easily the best I’ve ever had in New Zealand, with a unique twist that makes them unforgettable. I'm honestly surprised when I see any negative reviews, because every visit has been an amazing experience for me. Their pies are always hot and fresh, and the quality is unmatched. This place is truly a hidden gem. They also offer a huge variety of treats—too many to list! And the best part? The prices are super affordable. A slice of cake is just $5, whole birthday cakes start at $50, and their pies and puffs are only $4–$6.50. Definitely worth every cent. Highly recommend checking them out—you won't be disappointed!

**5 Stars!** Absolutely delicious! The cake was moist, rich in flavor, and beautifully decorated. Every bite was a perfect balance of sweetness and texture. You can really tell it was made with care and high-quality ingredients. It not only looked stunning but tasted even better than expected. Everyone at the party couldn't stop raving about it—definitely ordering again! Highly recommended!

Absolutely blown away by the Frozen-themed cake from Bake and Beans! It was a showstopper for my daughter's 5th birthday – the attention to detail, from the intricate snowflakes to Elsa’s flowing dress, was just magical. The cake not only looked stunning but tasted amazing too. We ordered the eggless cake version, and it was moist, flavorful, and fresh. The double-height tiers gave it that extra wow factor, and it easily served our guests. Highly recommend Bake and Beans for anyone looking for custom cakes that truly bring your ideas to life!

This place is too good. They serve the best pani puri and dahi puri. No doubt. Tandoori momos are not to be missed. If you craving for a good chaat place, this is it. Food is amazing. Even their presentation was really good. Loved all the items.

We had the Tandoori Momos and Aloo Tikki Chaat from Chaat Hut Takanini, and they were absolutely delicious! The flavors were perfectly balanced, and the presentation was amazing. The kind owner also let us try Dahi Puri and Pani Puri, and they were just as good—fresh, flavorful, and full of authentic taste. Highly recommend this place for anyone craving quality Indian street food!

Really excited to try more from chaat hut next time I ordered pani puri with samosa chaat and tandoori momos. ... All of them were really delicious . Pani puri is a must try .. presentation is enough to make you happy . Pretty good space for dining In

The food was awful—lacking flavor and authenticity. Definitely not worth it. The service was fine, but the seating was not great, making the overall experience even less enjoyable. On top of that, there was a deal advertised on Facebook for **$5 unlimited pani puri**, but the terms were not clearly mentioned. When we got there, we were told that each person had to order a separate dish to avail of the offer. If you're looking for good Indian street food, I’d recommend looking elsewhere. I appreciate the effort the restaurant is putting into bringing Indian street food to Auckland. Wishing them all the best!

Best customer service , incredible food....enjoyed my unlimited panipuri today with my daughter (her first time). I have never seen my daughter enjoying so much, even tried to compete me.....lovely vibe....forever my go to place....thanks for the great chat. We are absolutely coming back for more chaat.

I ordered two pizza one veg and one peri peri chicken plus garlic bread. After seeing garlic bread it was really hard to find difference whether it is actually a garlic bread or something else. Base was totally burnt. Lake of ingredients on pizza. Overall dissatisfied. Hope management will look on this matter and train staff accordingly.

I’d like to share a wonderful compliment for the incredibly friendly Izzy at the Takanini store. She crafted the most delicious pizzas I’ve had in a while, especially the The Lot pizza, the toppings were perfectly arranged like a piece of art. The thin crust was baked to perfection too. when made with love, they truly stand out. Keep up the awesome work—you’re a star!

Very disappointing experience. The garlic bread was completely burnt, and the pizza had no sauce on it—even though I paid extra for that. On top of that, the customer service was poor and unhelpful when I raised the issue. Definitely not the standard I expect from Domino’s.

Worst experience ever, DO NOT get delivery from here!! I ordered A value pizza box with churros for delivery. These guys didnt follow my delivery instructions and chose to leave my food on the cold ground. When opening my food i discovered ants all over the food!! And the cherry on top? My churros were burnt!! Never order food from here, I have gotten sick because of their food.

Third time ordering from Dominos Takanini. Their pizzas were cooked perfectly & were delicious, can't complain for the price. Definitely good value for money & great customer service by staff. Best to order online and pick up. Can’t go wrong with this place.

The best bunch (branch) I have been living in NZ for a few years St. Pierres Sushi is one of the eateries I always patronise for a quick and delicious meal. I have gone to many different branches but today, I came to the branch in Takanini where I was impressed with the service. The staff are friendly and positive. The smiles on their face brightened up the place, and treated customers with respect. It makes dine-in pleasant. I particularly enjoyed the tuna sushi and I realised not all the outlets have Tuna sushi. So my meal was enjoyable. We were there at 2pm +. So I hope the management will take note of all the staff working during this period and commend them on their good work.
Freshly made. These guys are amazing. Very clean and tidy place aswel. Highly recommend people as I always go here myself. 💯 👏
We went at 3pm and there was absolutely nothing left very sad, but st Pierre's in manukau never fails 🥰

Remembered why I won't here again. Thought I ordered a $13 Salmon Sashimi (with sauce). They gave me the bland, tasteless salmon I remember them for, and then wanted to charge me $0.60 extra for a squirt of mayo. Come..on... so stingey. No thanks, you lost a customer for that (and your tasteless salmon).

I wanted to change don buri meal to katsu chicken so I politely asked if the lady can make one for me. The chubby lady in specs said no they can't make it. So I took the teriyaki don buri meal instead. Later a customer came and asked to change to katsu, the nicer lady said they can do it and she started preparing. I told her I wanted the katsu and she said they can always make it. Better sort your standards and don't tolerate lazy staff!!

Thursday date night, Food was super quick & hot sat down, ate and drank all under 35min bc the food & drinks was delicious. Amazing, cheerful service from the Asian bartender Sweet service from the long haired blonde/ fair young lady. She checked in on us and asked if our food was good. She was very patient & welcoming. Great atmosphere, slightly loud but appears to be many happy customers all around.

Absolutely fantastic service and beautiful food from this place! Seated within minutes of entering and given water and menus straight away! Staff were very friendly and helpful. My friend and I ordered from the QR code menu online and I got the chicken schnitzel and she got the lamb. That carrots that came on the side of my dish were extraordinary and the beer battered fries were amazing as well as the schnitzel itself! My friend said the lamb was some of the best she’s ever had and it looked amazing too! Beautifully presented and huge portion for the reasonable price so much so I got to take some home for later! The music was pleasant, the whole place was clean and I couldn’t recommend the food enough. Great place with great staff.

We had a date night with dinner and drinks here and loved it. The restaurant itself is beautiful with such a fun atmosphere. The staff were so friendly and helpful and we wanted to say a huge thank you to the chef who went out of their way to accommodate our requests for vegetarian options. The thai beef salad was really delicious and our vegetarian burger was great! It was pretty pricey but a very good meal and fun experience. :)
Great food and great customer service, guy that served us was very attentive. Definitely going back!

Update - since I posted the review someone got in touch and apologised. Do appreciate them taking the time to look into it so have updated my rating. Hopefully our next visit will be a much more enjoyable experience. A bit of a mixed experience here. Came here a few months back and food and service was good. We returned last Sat for dinner and were waiting to be seated. The manager rolled his eyes when we came in. They were fully booked which is totally fine but there was no need for that attitude. We went to the thai place instead and had a lovely meal.
Never had to wait... They served me straight away. The drink wasn't the greatest thou.. didnt like it. Extra hot sauce wasnt the hottest.. 9/10 overall

Independence Day Extravaganza: Salty and Sassy! Ladies and gentlemen, gather 'round for the epic tale of two inspired girls, celebrating independence with style, sass, and a whole lot of salt! From the moment we laid eyes on that sumptuous platter, we knew this was no ordinary meal. The fries? Crispier than a pop star's high notes. Everything was seasoned to perfection—by which I mean MEGA SALTY. Water? Oh, they've got it, alright. Enough to hydrate a desert. USE IT!!! 💧💧💧 The ambiance? Stunning wooden tables that made us feel like we were on a rustic retreat—except with more detritus seating. We felt transported to Mexico without the scorching heat. The cold drinks were as refreshing as a dip in the ocean, perfectly complementing the freshness of the salt (yes, you read that right). We didn't leave much behind because everything was just THAT good. If you're looking for a feast fit for independent women (or anyone, really) and a dramatic dining adventure, this is your spot. Viva la independence and pass the salt!

Order no 141. I ordered thighs with large peri peri fries. The thigh pieces were not the normal size. It seemed they had halved 1 piece into 2. I get these from other.branches and this was way too small to be normal sized thighs. They were really burnt with black charcoal all over. The branch doesn't have a contact detail to contact them to complain and have return the meal to get another. This is the second time I ordered the thighs have the same issues. The first time I thought maybe they were extremely busy or had a new staff member cooking so I just decided not to do anything. But this happening again is not ok. The branch needs to improve or they will continue loosing customers. I really hope they improve as I want to continue using their service which is closer to me. Friendly staff and attentive staff as always though

Every time I visit, I find that the cutlery has a bad smell. We’ve requested the staff to provide sterilised plates, but they simply respond that everything is clean and that there’s nothing more they can do. Today, I visited again and we literally had to use our Coke to rinse the plates and wipe the spoons ourselves. On top of that, the chicken was undercooked. It seems the staff are either too tired or just ignoring basic standards. It’s clear the cutlery isn’t being properly washed with dishwashing liquid—otherwise, it wouldn’t smell so bad. My family and I are very disappointed with the overall service. I sincerely hope someone takes this matter seriously and looks into it.
Had a great meal here Saturday 1st February Young lady that served us was exceptional we actually loved the suggestion of mixing sauces Thank you Nando's Takanini

The fish and chips meal presented a mixed experience. The Snapper fish was a highlight, with a nice and soft interior encased in a crispy coating, though it leaned a bit on the oily side. The fries were generally enjoyable, offering a pleasant texture, but fell short on seasoning. Overall, it's a decent option, especially if you're craving classic fish and chips.

ORDERED : 1x Salt n Pepper Squid 3x Fish bites 3x Squid rings 1x Snapper & Chips PRICING: Total $49.00 Snapper was fresh, Squid was tasty. As you can tell by the pictures everything was slightly overcooked hence the dark tones of the food and chips. Not a deal breaker. Service was lovely. Area was clean. Will come back again.

As soon as we walked in we were greeted by Kyle who was super kind! He was very friendly and helpful when we were trying to decide what to order. Thank you Kyle! We ordered 2x Snapper Meal Boxes = $21.40each. Beautiful fish as always & fresh crisp salad! Bathrooms are also very clean! Restaurant area is also clean & great open space to enjoy classic fish and chips!

First of all, this LJs has a condiment section with knives, folks, napkins and sauces. I’ve never seen this in other LJs, in fact they charge extra for a small sauce tub. We ordered the LJs double fish burger meal that comes with two little John burgers combo. Awesome customer service as our meal came really quick. Clean facility. Overall good experience.
We enjoyed the set combo's we ordered, prawns,mussels perfectly cooked along with sauce, it's on, first time my family dine in, it was worthed. Thank you to the staff on shift.

As a local we visit this town centre everyday and enjoy using the facilities. Today we had our 2 year old play at the kids park and had a minor incident where our kid hit her head inside the tunnel which has a concrete finish. Suggestion to have a soft rubber coating inside and on the edges, similar to the one outside to avoid any further major accidents. (attached photo for reference) Thank you.

$85 Parking fine! Incurred when I was spending money, trying to shop locally, . It was not busy. Plenty of spare parking spaces. I walked straight into the hairdressers and was seen right away - which shows how busy it was. Will be even less busy because we won't be back

Great outdoor mall with heaps of shops. Massive variety store with heaps of cool things in it also. Parking is extremely tight and patience is needed as cars can not get in and out of parks without taking up the whole road.

A busy shopping centre with a warehouse outlet and a number of other brands and a BNZ branch. The centre has a mix of commercial and retail tenants. There is also a bar and restaurant (the blacksmith). The parking area is often congested but I've usually found a park.
Nice place for Shopping in Takanini. It has medical centre Clinic Path lab Eating places Cafe And much more Nice little shopping centre within walking distance from Takanin Newly build suburbs

The size of the burger is amazing, truly hunger buster and justify the pricing. This was my first trip and I am coming back for more and will try all the burgers. One minor feedback the fries should be seasoned more, salt was missing.
Great Carl’s Jr in Takanini. Has carpark and free wifi. Price is fair and cheaper than Mc Donald’s.

Drive Thru was a breeze / service pleasant. Food; Onion rings were amazing, perfectly crunchy and fresh Fries a bit old maybe ? as tasted stale so may have been sitting a while Chicken tenders DRY.. we both took a bite of one but it was too dry & flavorless to want more Portobello burger 👌🏾 Oreo Milkshake & Sundae 👌🏾 Raspberry drink 👌🏾 Would defs try again but probably something else as there's a decent park around the corner worth enjoying after eating too
Cheesy bacon Criss cut fries missing the cheese. Pre ordered online for times sake only for them to start making the food after I arrived, yet somehow still cold?

I ordered the Jim Beam Bourbon Big Angus double & a strawberry thick shake. One of the patty's in the burger wasn't cooked through & felt cold so l removed it. The thick shake was really good though. Wait time through drive thru was quick as it was empty during lunch.... Maybe that's saying something!. l probably won't be rushing back anytime soon after this experience but l'm willing to give them another try sometime in the future.
Served by two ladies by the name of Aman and dalina super fast in their service, Come and check it out

I visited this pita pit today for lunch and ordered a vegetarian wrap. While preparing my wrap, the staff member had just served another customer a meat wrap. As the meat was being toasted, she began assembling my vegetarian sandwich without changing her gloves. Additionally, she placed both wraps side by side on the same surface before wrapping the meat wrap in fresh paper, while mine was wrapped using the same paper that had touched both items. I also observed that she used the same gloves to transfer tomatoes into another container while I was waiting for my wrap to be toasted. This raises concerns about hygiene and cross-contamination. Regardless of whether you order a vegetarian or meat wrap, the shared handling of ingredients compromises their integrity. If you have any dietary restrictions or allergies, I would advise caution when going here, as it is unclear what has come into contact with different ingredients.

We spent around $91 on Sunday afternoon and when I received my order I got disappointed with my order which they launched the new Korean Gochu it’s cost $18 but it’s only worth like $8 chicken salad bowl.

Ordered a kumara lentil rosti salad bowl. When I got home I found that there is only kumara in there? I guess they ran out of rostis. Would have been nice to know as I would have changed my order. Definitely not happy with just plain kumara. Also ordered rice with it, not sure how much there usually is but there but after mixing it all up there is maybe only a pinch or two worth of rice. Barely noticeable.
I love coming to this pita pit! The ladies here are awesome. The quality is always on point and service is really professional

The lady was very kind and took the beef stock out of the Tofu don for me to make it vegan. It was delicious and the portion was surprisingly large for the price. Much better value for money than fast food chains next door. I will be coming back.
Food was delicious. So many choices to choose from. Customer service was okay. They have seats outside but they need to keep them neat and clean.
I ordered don buri with extra chicken but so disappointing quantity is so less bento bowl is better

I have been a regular happy customer for a long time. Always fresh and delicious with kind customer service. They have end of day special deals and I often bought eel nigiri pack, I had no problem with it. Below commented customer maybe didn't wash hands?

With over a decade in the Takanini community, our visits to this sushi restaurant have been consistently delightful. While other sushi places have come and gone, nothing surpasses the friendliness and helpfulness of the staff during our visits. The dining experience is smooth, and we always feel well taken care of. Grateful for their excellent service—truly another gem in the community's sushi scene!

Great service at this eatery in Takanini. I ordered the marinated chicken salad dish with falafel on the side. Meal presented exactly as described - not pretty, but full of flavour. Chips were slightly over cooked but the aioli was on point. Only one guy on taking orders & cooking, did a great job. Meals are very affordable.

Nice food and great portions. I got the pasta and pizza bread and the servings were huge. Share size bowl for pasta which is good if you have a big appetite or like to share. The garlic bread was one of my highlights! Cheesy and delicious. We also got the fish n chips and calamari. Calamari wasn’t great and the fish was average but the service made up for it. Very friendly staff.

Won't say it's the best but it's still decent. Ordered cranberry chicken. With peri peri sauce. $17.50 total. It had very thin base. My pizza was kinda yellow i don't know why? Taste 8/10 Store area clean 10/10 Service 10/10 Would I recommend others to visit ? MAYBE
Great customer service and food is always fresh and tasty! Love the chicken rice with fried egg! Sorry I’m so hungry already taken a bite!

Taste of pizza was yuck... They told wood oven pizza but are cooking on gas.. half uncooked pizza. Chicken was also cold as it came straight out of chest freezer. Not recommended at all as we went there with the reference of the friend but still I was disappointed. 0 out of 5 stars should be given for food taste and quality.

Got my simple order wrong to be very honest. Waited like 15mins at first then waited another 10mins on top. Pizzas were made great tho. Id highly recommend you listen and check the order with customer before making Pizzas.

Look at this pizza, how disgusting, not sure who trains these people to make pizzas, all crust and burnt. Staff very rude and argumentative, poor customer service, when showed them the pizza responded by saying this is how we make it. DONT EVER GO THERE, you will waste your money and time for this awful pizza.

One of the best pizza hut shop ever. They aways put extra stuff in the pizza and always fresh. Never disappointed from this shop. They always listen to the customer’s requirements and fulfil them as well. They always drizzle sauce on my pizza without asking if I forgot to add via online. I really recommend this pizza hut shop.

Great pizzas with every visit. We come here most Saturdays and the food is top notch. Awesome customer service, staff are friendly and pizzas are ready on time. I've legit never had a bad experience here, good food all around!

Pizza Hut Takanini more than just good food—the service stands out, too. The team is always courteous, quick to assist, and genuinely welcoming. The pizzas are consistently tasty, with a great crust and generous toppings. It's a reliable place to grab a bite and feel well taken care of.

Worst Takanini Subway. I will never go back. The guy started using the same gloves to do my vege order after touching the meat. I had to tell him are you going to change your gloves. He said why. I said because you just touched meat and now your touching my vege subway.The quantity of food was disgraceful. I told the lady. The amount of salad and cheese you putting on is not enough. Still she didn't do anything about it. No customer service skills from her and the male staff. They make your monies worth. I spent about $50. I was so disappointed with the food. Thier quality was crap. It's not cheap anymore. But atleast they should put decent amount of salad. I would recommend you to think twice before going to this store. I hope their manager messages me or head office. I just read other reviews, i thought i will edited. Same story with other customers. These people working at the store are useless and maybe the manager is useless too not sorting out these issues. Im really pissed off. This is the first time I have had this experience. I recommend Manukau Super Centre store. They are great. Tell them to go learn from them.

I order veggie pattie. I paid $15.30 not enough salad. They only put little salad. Using same knife and gloves. According to subway they not meeting requirements and putting less salad . Which is not good for restaurants and loosing customers. Never going back. Never recommend

Avoid this subway at all costs. Every time I have visited, I have had a horrible experience. The first situation was that I was being overcharged. I pointed out the menu price advertised within the subway, but they advised their system has the correct price. They refused to refund me until I mentioned the fair trading act, as they blatantly misled me. The second time I had visited, we order a combo. Instead, they charged us for each item separate which resulted in a big cost increase. Again, they did nothing to rectify this situation. The final time I have visited, I ordered something off the menu. At the end, they told me they did not have a vital ingredient as they no longer did it. I said that it is advertised, so they shouldn’t advertise a sandwich which they do not have, or they should inform the customer when they first order the sandwich. Instead, they did nothing to rectify the situation. I will never return to this subway. I highly recommend everyone avoid it at all costs. It’s horrific.

This Subway is normal in that it is clean and orderly. But this is the most tight fisted outlet I have been to. All the fillings are at least half the size as any other store but at the same price. Yes that means value for money is a fail. Do not recommend at all.

I am subway lover and have had subways at many stores. It was my bedest experience with Takanini store (southgate). These guys don’t do filling. Seeming they are selling breads only. When I told them you are doing proper felling, guy replied with attitude you can ask for more. When customer is paying you full value of money provide them right service. I ordered 3 foot longs and ask to cut and wrap separate. They said they will charge for 6 6inch. Annoying. I recommend everyone to use any other store so they will know the value of customer

Best fish shop in Auckland! 🙌🐟💯 Fresh, hot and perfectly cooked fish & chips plus an amazing range of seafood. I regularly drive over 30mins to eat here. The batter is so crispy and the affordable portions of $5.50 snapper are generous in size and melt in the mouth amazing 🫠❤️‍🔥 The people are friendly and give excellent advice too. Sometimes the hot food is a bit slow - but it’s always worth the wait 💯

Fish and chips was average. Batter was quite thick however tasty and crunchy. The portion was large and chips was nice and crunchy. Battered scallops was $2 dollars for 2 pieces and they were nice. There was a parking in the front and service was good.

Haven't had a bad experience yet. Usually have what I'm after and is fresh. Have travelled through heavy traffic sometimes but that's cos I'm impatient and don't realise I'm travelling during school finishing times. Other than that. My sister and I enjoy our kaimoana from there 😊

Heard lot about this place, that they do great fish and chips. Today for the very first time buying a portion of fish and chips wasn't great. Lack of taste nothing wow about it, plus the oil clean so it tasted awful. I had to throw away half of it as I couldn't take it any more. Not recommend 😕
Fresh products, Fresh fish, love the cold selection Rawfish, Oyster & Kina pots, Half Shell Oysters & The fish & Chips are great, lovely crispy batter. Will always return
I love Burger fuel 🍔 🍟 My favorite Burger to get from here is the American Muscle (single/double patty) along with chips dipped in garlic aioli sauce😋 thats the best part 👌
Great place to pre-order and collect including vegan options, but not exactly a great atmosphere to sit and eat inside. Very tasty vegan burger! And a practical box to hold it in while eating
Food good quality, staff friendly and efficient. Atmosphere tables looking tired and at end of their life, chairs need a major upgrade however the wall seats are nice.

Hmm Used to be so good. Seems the quality is dropping lately. I tried maybe 2 months ago and wasn’t happy but didn’t leave a review thinking it’s a one off. Tried today again. Spud fries have absorbed so much oil almost like fries from a cheap takeaways. Maybe fries were re fried? Maybe over fried? Not sure . Hope this place bounces back. Given this place used to be very good, I’ll still give 4 instead of anything lower.

Flavorful and delicious as always. Clean and tidy area with sitting available outdoors aswel. Excellent and quick service, my order was ready in 8mins Best C N CHEESE EVER! BRUH THE KUMARA FRIES WERE TOO GOOD TO BE TRUE! Keep up the great work guys 💯 🔥 Id highly recommend people to try this if they haven't.

Ordered Sals from uber eats, The driver didn’t have any stops on the way. But the pizza turned out to be cold and burnt from the bottom. I tried complaining on uber eats but that didn’t work. The pizza was cold and stiff and burnt. Not the type of pizza we normally get. 🥲

We visited Sal’s Takanini on a busy Saturday night, and we were truly impressed by the amazing service we received. Despite the hustle and bustle, the staff remained incredibly patient and attentive to our requests. They were efficient in keeping the place clean and well-organized, which made our dining experience even more enjoyable. On top of that, they were genuinely kind, respectful, and welcoming. Big thanks to the team for their professionalism and warmth.

One of the worst experiences I’ve had ever. First of all the wait was half an hour for me to pick up the pizza. I paid $22 for this horrible service and food that I was hesitant to eat.
