Is the meat filling enough? I don’t think it is justified for the pricing. Looking at the cross section of the pizza, haven’t eaten food that’s less flavourful than this crap. The garlic knots were left stale in the glass box and heated for a couple of minutes which burned it and the worst thing was that I got uncooked dough in between. To top it all off, the person at the store was in their own world putting on air pods and talking to someone. Never going back!

I really didn't wanted to post this but had to. I ordered 3 Garlic knots and I was standing close to the counter and was on phone but could see what's going on in the back. The guy dropped few of the knots on floor by mistake which is ok as we all make mistakes but instead of making new ones he went on a packed the order with the same knots and handed over to me as he thought I didn't see the whole thing but i unfortunatelydid. I threw them in rubbish bin outside the store. Wanted to have a chat with him but was in a real rush to get somewhere. I love getting food from here so hope somone can look into this.
We had a half & half pizza from two super friendly guys @ Sals Takanini Thanks to both of you for taking my special request, pizza was Soo good & made our evening. Thanks again & highly recommended.

We regularly order lunch from Tank Salad in Takanini for our office gatherings, and they never disappoint. The customer service is outstanding—especially the two lovely ladies who work in the mornings. They’re always calm, patient, and incredibly helpful. I often place large orders in advance, and they’re always made perfectly. Even when I’ve had to give them short notice for 15–20 salads, they’ve managed it beautifully and always have everything ready on time. The salads are fresh, delicious, and consistently high in quality. Thank you to the team at Tank Takanini for making every order a smooth and pleasant experience! Excellent Service and Delicious Salads – Highly Recommend!

Love the Tank Smoothies and Salads. Unfortunately the staff on today (04/02/25) were not helping each other out. The Indian female stood at the counter playing around with the kiosk (not taking anyone’s orders) while the other two (Maori/Pakeha) and Indian male (with head covering) proceeded to make all the orders - there were about 5 of us in there ordering atleast 2 things or more each. Hygiene needs to be improved, I watched the male staff rub his nose with gloves on and then proceeded to continue making salads. Had a lovely dinner here for my daughter's 19th. The service was excellent, food was delicious and fresh and hot. We ordered drinks and our food followed soon after. I was admiring the decor and love the colours. Had a nice welcoming vibe. Not too noisy and very friendly staff. Highly recommended.

first of all, very clean, tidy, good seating set up, family-friendly environment. If you have babies that require a high chair, your best option is to be seated at the low tables. The food was amazing as always as I've been there a couple of times, always a good experience and good service. My go-to desert is the sticky date pudding as per photo attached.
Reliable place for dinner that has a range of seating options. They have a good kid's menu and the staff are helpful. They are easily able to accommodate large groups.
A good child friendly local spot in Takanini. Good sized portions and flavourful. Decent spot for locals to have a laid back meal and catchup with friends and family.
Yum food, great service. My brisket was a little dry and stringy but the wonderful gravy saved it. Seafood chowder good, but not exceptional.

I visited on Saturday evening and had the small roast pork meal. The serving size was just right, and everything was nicely seasoned. The potatoes were delicious, the peas were perfectly cooked—not mushy—and the gravy was full of flavour. The pork roast had good flavour too, but it was slightly dry and a bit chewy, which was the only real letdown. The pumpkin was the part I liked the least, but it wasn’t bad—just didn’t stand out as much as the rest.

First time trying this place today. Good customer service bad food. Not only did it almost cost $30 for a medium combo and 3 cracklings. The Cracklings was beyond salty. One scoop of gravy and a few pieces of potatoes, kumara and pumpkin. I had already paid and so it was too late to decline the order. But I would never go here again.

Hopefully was just a bad night to come but meat was fatty in both meals and chewy, potatoes were ok, kūmara I wasn’t sure was even kūmara 😅 was hard and not cooked same with the pumpkin…. Wasn’t cooked was so hard. Crackling was disappointing too mega salty more than should be. I hate a disappointing dinner grrrr especially when you spend $50

Ordered the lamb sandwiche combo with gravy and mint sauce as they had run out of rolls. The sandwiche was delicious, the mint sauce is soooo delicious. The meat was nice and moist .. i would have given 5 stars but the owners were getting a bit angry at me taking pictures after I asked.

First time to try this place in takanini, i appreciated their fried chicken, honestly!Also ordered pork roast, hoping to get the crackling but nah, it's all pork meat, potatoes and peas. It's also very hard to communicate with the vendor too, not sure if it's because of the mask though.

I was trying to call the branch today to complain about my order, no one is picking up the call. I ordered Almighty Texan BBQ without bacon, but it ended with the bacon! It was such disappointing when you want to eat but the order is not correct!!! Be accurate next time and be nice and friendly too🙄

Fast and efficient! Went around 6.38 pm. -Drive thru- Great service and my food was ready on time. My combo was freshly made and my fries 🍟 were on point 💯! Thank the stuff working at that time. Keep it up.. 👍👍

Poor service.poor quality . I don’t. Like to give negative review to business bcz we all struggle in hard time . But these fast food fail last it quality of my last 4 visits. First time Trying Takanini Macdonald's . My honest REVIEW . The environment was all clean and neat . I came through drive thru the operator was OKAY . I received a very warm welcome however I felt like the operator was rushing with my order by continuously saying "ANY THING ELS , ANYTHING ELSE " No suggestive selling was done neither my order was repeated back to me . Reaching upto sec window I was just given my order with confirmation with my order and NO SERVIATES IN THE BAG . Apartment from all that MY FOOD WAS 10/10 . Highly recommend this Thai food restaurant! The food is absolutely delicious and the staff is super friendly. We had a wonderful dining experience with our family and the service was top-notch. The atmosphere is cozy and inviting, making it perfect for a family dinner or gathering. Don't hesitate to try it out - you won't be disappointed!

Lovely eatery nestled in the corner of Takanini somewhere. The premises is modern & chic, so comfortable & vibrant. Our waitress was very lovely & so helpful. The food was pleasant to the eye & came out so quickly! Everything tasted delicious, however there was no dressing on the salads & it seemed like the same flavours on majority of our dishes. Lunch time deals are very affordable, would def go back to try other dishes.

The food is amazingly good. The staff are awesome. I admit I generally come here in the middle of the day during the week as it’s quiet and I can just enjoy the music and eat very good food without the atmosphere being too loud. But these guys have jagermeister on tap!!! What more could you want.

Oh my goodness, the service here is absolutely fantastic! They greeted me as soon as I stepped through the door and were super friendly throughout my visit. The staff were all really helpful and attentive. And let me tell you, the food was absolutely delicious! It arrived quickly and was so tasty. I had a wonderful time!

The SatPad Thai Gung was awesome. Service was exceptional. Atmosphere is more directed to younger generation as music was really loud. However overall this is a very nice place for a meal out with a loved one or just hang out with your friends. All of the staff that we met were very polite and willing to go the extra mile.

Customer service was excellent, everything was done with a smile. Food was exceptionally good, we got the ribs and they were so tender and flavourful as were the chicken tenders. As a vegetarian I was happy they had great options for me, the burger was amazing will definitely be coming back to try more. The atmosphere was tranquil and we throughly enjoyed our dining experience here. The diner itself gives an old school American diner vibe.

🤤 this is our second time visiting and Oh.My.God. we had to try the pizza with cheese sauce in the middle and got fried chicken AND fries. Fries have a secret seasoning 😍 chicken is bomb and soooo moist sweet spicy and so good we saved the left over sauce. The pizza was fresh and authentic cheese sauce in almost asked for more 😅. The service was amazing I didn't ask her name but Saturday night she wore glasses and was awesome! Made the experience sooo lovely! Overall atmosphere cleanliness and smiling happy customers made it such a lovely experience! Will be back over and over. 🩷🧡

Wow. Just wow. There was nothing to fault. Food was bold and full of flavors. Service was impeccable. Drinks were next level. An all round great experience. It is an American diner type place, but not cliche. Go here if you crave something different from the average Auckland restaurant experience.

Today we tried the new sizzling cheesy chicken waffle at Good Luck Club and 10/10 would recommend. The hot plate with the melty, bubbling and sizzling cheese on top of the crispy fried chicken made for a fun and unique experience. You’ve definitely never had a chicken waffle like that. This was my third visit. I’ve also had the baked loaded potato and the southern fried half chicken before, both total flavour bombs and worth going back for. The place has a laid-back, American-style diner vibe, super friendly staff, and food that hits the comfort spot every time. Definitely one of my go-to spots when I’m craving something hearty and delicious.

We recently visited this restaurant and was blown away with the quality and quantity of their dishes. We ordered fettuccine pasta and was absolutely delicious. Honey soy chicken was juicy and full of flavour. Staffs were friendly and very attentive. Highly recommend to anyone who craving delicious meals. I will definitely be back!

Our regular local. Never disappoints. Staff are always so accommodating and friendly, food/drink is always cooked and made fresh, tastes so good. My go too are the Eggs Bene, cafe club brekky, blueberry pancakes, tropical smoothie, large soy caramel latte. A+++
Nice eggs Benedict with Smoked Salmon, my favourite!👍
The food is really nice and fresh cook. The staff work so hard and friendly. One of the best coffee in town should have a try if you come to Takanini. :)
Don’t be confused by the name, because they did renovation. Very nice stuff and good is delicious! Highly recommend!

Hash browns and creamy mushrooms...my gosh so good!!! Had a yummy brunch here, server was friendly but i had to repeat myself a few times for a choc frappe and she kept saying ice coffee....nice place to catch up with friends or stop by for a bite.

Good food and excellent value. Recommended but they do get very busy at lunchtimes so plan ahead.

The portions are generous, the food is delicious, and the Vietnamese coffee is authentic. Friendly service is a huge plus. I'll def be back.

Stopped by after a shop at the warehouse - was surprised the place was still opened as it was 6:30pm. We decided to dine in and have our dinner - I had Wonton soup which was delicious for this cold night. Kids had hot chips, wontons and Bahn mi. Nice for a night out and quick dinner stop. I like that it closes at 8pm during week days.

Everything was fresh and hot. I reallt enjoyed my pork vermicelli and the fried rice was a hit too. The only thing was the pork on rice was very plain and the crackle on top wasn't salted so tasted like nothing. Other then that we enjoyed our meals and the food came out pretty quick too.

I was pleasantly surprised with the food here. The big breakfast was so good. Usually when I see ciabatta on the menu it’s always hard to cut but omg this was the best, so buttery and so soft! The cabinet food was also great, classic NZ cream donut. I will be going back :)

We truly appreciate the kind gesture of the provided service. The attention to detail was quite remarkable and made a positive impression. Your willingness to assist was evident, and we thank you for the effort. The overall experience was very enjoyable, and we are grateful for your help. We look forward to the opportunity to engage with such lovely service again in the future.

I've been coming here since they opened a few years ago and I was very excited to finally eat halal fast food and to this day I still go here. The food is 10/10 but the customer service beats it. Very nice employees who will drop what they're doing to take your order and help you. I recommend coming here

We recently ordered takeaway from Mini Siam in Takanini and were really impressed with both the food and the service. We tried the Thai Cashew Chicken and the Pad Prek Khing, and both dishes were packed with flavour and cooked to perfection. The Cashew Chicken had a beautiful mix of textures—crunchy cashews, crisp vegetables, and tender chicken, all brought together with a deliciously savoury sauce. The Pad Prek Khing was rich and fragrant, with just the right level of spice and generous portions of meat and veggies. You can really taste the freshness in every bite. The lady who took our order was so friendly and helpful—she made the whole experience even better with her warm and welcoming attitude. It’s always nice to be greeted with a smile, especially when you’re picking up food after a long day. Another big plus is the parking—there’s plenty of space available, which makes pickup quick and hassle-free. The portion sizes were also very generous, and you could tell the ingredients were high quality. Nothing felt rushed or cheap—just good, honest Thai food made with care. Overall, Mini Siam is definitely a hidden gem in Takanini. If you’re looking for fresh, tasty Thai food with great service and easy parking, we highly recommend giving them a try. We’ll definitely be back!
Massive portions of inedible food . Not recommended for vegetarians . Tried it today as it had great reviews , may be different experience for meat eaters

Update 16/11/21: After having ordered from multiple Thai places down South, I'd say, Mini Siam offers the BEST foods! Ordered the Massaman curry today and it was absolutely delicious! Big chunks of beef and potatoes, and the beef was very tender. The curry was very flavorful and rich. Dish might be good for 2 people. Note: the meal doesn't come with rice. Also ordered rice on the side for $2. Rice was perfectly cooked. Enough rice for 1 person. Update: Oct 2021- Ordered Tom Yum soup (small) and Pad Thai and again, both are very delicious! Really big portions! And was so surprised to see 2 jellies for free ❤ Thank you!

We ordered via Uber eats but ended up throwing it away because we just couldn't stomach the pad thai. Pad Thai - 3.5/10 Texture of the Noodles was horrible. Super overcooked and gluggy. Somehow there seemed to be no sauce (must've completely soaked into the noodles) so it was also really dry. Strong fishy smell and taste (like they accidentally dropped the bottle of fish sauce in) but also a burnt taste from something (I think maybe peanuts). Tofu satay - 6.5/10 Peanut sauce was yum but overly sweet. Nice having tofu on a kebab stick but it was really tough, chewy and leathery. Feel like we wasted our money here. Disappointing.

The Namtok waterfall beef salad is hands down the best in all Auckland. I have this dish everywhere (I literally mean everywhere North, East, West, City central and South)I go, and Mini Siam makes it the BEST. The beef is super tender and delicious.

Great first experience. We had been waiting on this shop for so long. We ordered online but went into the shop and was surprised with the staff being very friendly yet being under the pump could still be very engaged, smiling and happy.
The fried chicken is by far the best I have tried in Auckland!! The chicken is so juicy and the taste is so good. Must try!!

Wonderful team — friendly, all smiles, and very accommodating. Generous portions of fries and chicken, and the flavour and seasoning are spot on — absolutely delicious! Ordered fries, OG crispy chicken, and churros. One area for improvement would be the doneness of some chicken pieces as this is critical for this food category. A few seemed slightly undercooked, and it was a bit tricky to tell whether it was just extra juicy or not fully cooked through. Perhaps using more consistent cuts or slightly smaller pieces might help ensure they’re cooked perfectly every time — making it easier for customers to confidently say, “It’s juicy, not undercooked!” I hope this is received as a constructive suggestion, as my overall experience was still very enjoyable. I love Korean fried chicken and am genuinely happy you’ve opened here in Takanini. Looking forward to coming back again!
I had the seasoned chicken bowl with rice and it was delicious! The boneless chicken was moist and perfectly seasoned. The music was too loud for dining in, but the food was excellent.

Tonight was our first time trying Munch! Ordered online, quick and easy. I got there just before the estimated time and it literally got out as soon as I got there. Nice and hot! I didn't know if it would be enough for my kids and I but holyyyyyy, the portions are huge! Generous toppings (sour cream and onions). Definitely coming back. Delicious!

Excellent way to end easter. The service was great and our breakfast tasted extremely delicious 💯 🔥

Food is always great, and i love the atmosphere whenever i go dine in. It's one of my go-to places for food. Highly recommend. PS. Remembered to take photos after I had already started digging in 😅 It was that good.

Congratulations, your crew described the French toast breakfast perfectly. It was presented well, it tasted great and we walk away very satisfied. The picture on your menu doesn't represent the actual food presented to us, 100% better in real life.

We ordered Amritsari Fish Fry, which was absolutely amazing! It was crispy, perfectly spiced, and packed with flavor. To my surprise, the owner was incredibly kind and gave me a serving of Tawa Chicken for free, which was a wonderful gesture. The chicken was perfectly cooked and full of rich flavors. Highly recommend this place for anyone craving great food and good customer service.

Thus place is fire man. So good the food. So much flavour and not overpowered by Chilli. You can taste the garam masala the hardi. All of it blends so well. My favorite is the Mutton Peshwari Tawa Mutton & the Desi Chicken Fry. Been coming here for a while now and 💯 coming back again.
Will not recommend this place. Food was too salty. One roti was burnt and the other was half cooked. Will not recommend this place. Not worth the money.

recently visited Sing Chicken at Walter’s Road, Takanini, and had an amazing experience! The food was absolutely delicious—fresh, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. You can tell they put a lot of effort into maintaining authentic taste and quality. The service was friendly, and the overall vibe of the food truck was great. Sukh at Beach Pizza Takanini consistently delivers excellent customer service. He is professional, attentive, and ensures every order is prepared with care. His friendly attitude and efficiency create a welcoming atmosphere that keeps customers coming back. A valuable asset to the team.

⭐☆☆☆☆ – Disappointing First Visit Visited Bikaner Express Takanini for the first time today, and unfortunately, it was a pretty underwhelming experience. Ambience: Not inviting at all. It’s a sweet shop, but they were out of 1kg and ½ kg sweet boxes. How am I supposed to carry sweets without proper packaging? That’s honestly quite shocking and unacceptable for a place that sells sweets. Cleanliness: The drink fridge was almost empty, and the glasses had stains on them. Not a good sign. On top of that, there were no other customers around, which says a lot. Service: The one saving grace was the staff member who served me. He was polite and seemed genuinely embarrassed about the lack of boxes. Credit to him, he deserves better support from management, and I hope he helps bring about some improvements. Overall: A disappointing visit. I’m giving one star only because of the staff member’s attitude. Otherwise, this place really needs to step up across the board, ambience, cleanliness and basic customer convenience.

We stopped by Sumthin Dumpling in Takanini and were honestly blown away by how good everything was. The place has a clean, modern vibe with friendly staff and quick service. It’s perfect if you’re after a casual but seriously satisfying feed. We ordered the Great White 6-pack, Prawn Dumplings 8-pack, and a side of fries, and each item delivered on both flavour and freshness. The Great Whites were incredible — crisp on the bottom, soft and chewy on top, and packed with juicy filling that had just the right amount of seasoning. They’re the kind of dumplings you crave again as soon as you finish the last bite. The Prawn Dumplings were just as impressive. The prawn filling was fresh and generous, wrapped in a delicate dumpling skin that was silky without being too doughy. And here’s where it gets even better — they have a great selection of sauces on the side, from tangy soy-based options to spicy chili oil and even a sweet sauce if you’re into that. You can mix and match to suit your taste, and it really takes the experience up a notch. Even the fries were worth mentioning — golden, crispy, and not greasy at all. They were perfect for snacking while we waited for the rest of the food, and they came out hot and crunchy, not soggy like you sometimes get elsewhere. Overall, Sumthin Dumpling is a gem in Takanini. The dumplings are legit, the sauces are a bonus, and the whole meal felt well worth it. We’ll definitely be heading back to try more of the menu. Highly recommend if you’re in the area and feel like dumplings done right.

For the money it was good. Chips a bit soggy but all tasted good. $11 2x fish, hot dog and chips. Very friendly service. Thank you
The food is really yummy! So fresh and tastes really good!
Ordered from here a couple of times and unfortunately tonight will be the last time I order take out from here. I almost finish my soup and in the bottom laid a maggot 🤢🤮

Loved the shawarma here, especially paired with the mayo—it tasted great. I also ordered the butter chicken with butter naan. I really liked the chicken, but the naan was a bit too thick for my taste. Overall, a decent place to have Indian food.
The fact that I hadn't even paid for my food yet, and he allowed me to sit and enjoy my meal and he was such a delight to deal with and then the taste of real food made with love was heaven.

Very disappointing. Placed an online order at 1:07pm for 2:00pm pickup, paid fully with all money debited from my account. Arrived at 2:00pm only to find that my order hadn't been received ! Staff refused to start cooking until my order appeared in their system at 2:07pm. Then waited until 2:40pm to receive my order. Staff made it look like my problem although it's their computer systems at fault. Very poor customer service with no apologies, no discount or extra naan to show their regret. The food was average and not worth the hassle. It is a shame to see such poorly trained staff and their attitude towards customers. I will not return to TANDOORI TWIST and urge everyone to stay away and support businesses that have their internal processes and basic customer service sorted.
Awesome Indian style curries! Last week we tried Rara chicken was seriously one of the best I've ever had. Today we bought punjabi chiken is really very mouth watering.Highly recommended
Incredible Goat Curry, Tandoori chicken is also very authentic. Been twice and will be going back

I wish I could rate this place 0 stars, one of the worst fish I have ever had. One of the worst customer services ever. Fish was absolutely raw wasn’t cooked at all fries was undercooked. When I went back to give them a feedback the owner herself started shouting in her language I couldn’t understand what she was saying. Didn’t apologise no refund nothing she offered. Ruined my day visiting one of worst shop ever in town. If you want to get treated like me then visit this shop you are gonna get excellent service lol.
Nice fresh food. Tasty and delicious

I am new in this town, thought of trying their fish n chip. Im regretting having their soggy undercooked fish and sausages. The lady was very rude wasnt welcoming at all! Ruined my day 🥲.Will never be back again
love the garlic chips there. they over batter chips with garlic butter which my family loves the burgers are even cooked to the best of its quality's chips are always hot and ready
Watch out for the old owner lady when you visit this shop, worst customer ever. Very rude staff. fish was soggy and undercooked. Will never be back again.

Got 3 potato fitters 3 fish 3 hotdog 6 nuggets and 5 dollars chips was $40 and the potato fritter was rotten and the chicken nuggets tasted like fish I’m guessing the nuggets was rotten to do not recommend

Overpriced - I was shocked at the price for a couple of hotdogs, they don't let you order a certain $ of chips it's set at $5 a scoop lol good grief. However, the man who served me was smiley and lovely.

What has happened to my all time fave fish n chip shop same owners had an incident with payment through eftpos sorted within nearly 2 hours🙄 the attitude behind it horrendous just wanted to argue with me without even looking into what I was saying mind you I wasn't even yelling🤦‍♀️ and the food 😨 the fish use to be my fave I think the batter to fish ratio speaks for itself yea nah no never going back someone recommend a better one now thanks
Chips hardly cooked. Not nice at all

A surprising find on the way home, quality dishes with good options to make your dollar go a little further. Friendly staff/owners who take time to assist with your order. Excellent experience, my Sunday afternoon go to for quick and easy.

Totally worth making the trip from central Auckland for a meal in this cosy restaurant. The food was simple yet delicious and you can tell it’s made with great care. The service was truly amazing; warm, attentive and the food came very quickly. I would recommend Volare and look forward to coming back. My standout dish was the penne lope.

Totally enjoyed our meal here that I’ve got my work place to approve coming down for our company event! Everything about the place reminds me of my time in Italy - ambiance, music and of course, the food by an Italian chef! Great job all around from the owner, the chef and his crew, and polite staff. Definitely one of the best restaurants this side of the city! And with free parking!!!! We will be back after our office event! ps: And you must have the affogato! 🤩

Excellent dining experience. The staff were very attentive and accommodated our requests and adapted the special of the day to our group's desire. Wine selections was outstanding and the deserts were delightful and generous. If you like a Limoncello after dinner I highly recommend trying their home made version - guaranteed to impress. Highly recommend a visit to Volare for a great dining experience.

A beautiful selection of Italian dishes with plenty to choose from, along with an extensive drinks list. The entrées were stunning, a perfect start to the evening. For mains I got to try the prawn and chorizo risotto, potato gnocchi, and fettuccine al pollo, and you could tell fresh ingredients were used, the flavors were just WOW! I would definitely come back. We were seated upstairs, which perfectly accommodated our group of 20. The service was absolutely fantastic, the staff were incredibly accommodating and helpful throughout the night. I would highly recommend this place!

I went here for a family dinner and the atmosphere was very pleasant. The staff were very friendly and even let us use the massive pepper grinder for fun and photos. The food was quite lovely. My dad especially enjoyed the calamari, very well cooked and tender. All the seafood we ordered were well-received. They were fresh and the seasoning didn’t overpower the natural sweetness of the seafood. The pizza base was not the best, as it was kinda floppy which wasn’t great. The pasta was tasty with lots of flavour. The menu was quite extensive and there still lots of other options I would like to try. Overall quite an enjoyable experience. Good for families.
Worst fishing chip shop, bought $7 chips and got what looks like $4 chips don’t waste your money here it’s a ripoff and they are ripping off the hood

Absolutely disgusted at the hospitality, We are locals always visiting this fish and chips shop 1-3 times a week. We went in Saturday evening our meal come to $77 once we paid the card declined, after checking the bank we were $2 short, I explained we had 5 kids playing up in the car screaming for dinner it’s $2 short it’s going to take 1 hour for the $2 to transfer if I left my drivers licence would you be happy to let us off the $2 just so we could feed our children and in a hour I’ll be back to pay the money. I was already embarrassed that the card declined, then declined $2 even though I was willing to pay $75 and leave my license. Majority of the story is whanau, know your worth! spend your money where your going to be looked after, bussiness is bussiness yes but without customer consumption there is no such thing. We come to this place knowing it’s expensive, but knowing we’re doing our part supporting small kiwi businesses rather than cheap giant food companies. Rosemead do better! look after the community that looks after your bank account.

This is hands down one of the best fish and chip spots in Auckland! From the very first bite, you can tell they use fresh, clean oil—none of that heavy, greasy aftertaste you get at other takeaways. The customer service is absolutely top-notch; you’re always greeted with a warm smile. Let’s talk about the food: the fish-to-batter ratio is perfection—thin, crispy batter wrapped around the juiciest, most succulent fish. It’s melt-in-your-mouth amazing! And the chips? Oh, the chips are a revelation—golden, crunchy, and seasoned just right with a light sprinkle of salt. This place deserves a solid 10/10! If you haven’t tried it yet, you’re seriously missing out. Get there ASAP—you’ll thank me later!
Me and my babies always get food here. Never had any issues once with the food or anything. Overall, a pleasant experience.
Not Bad Fish'n'Chips, nice & crispy batter.

We celebrated our daughter’s 1st birthday at Patiala Rocks, and it couldn’t have been more perfect! The staff were incredibly attentive and went out of their way to make us feel special. The ambience, food, and overall service were spot on. Thank you for making such a big day so smooth and joyful. We’ll definitely be back!

Went in early, about 5:30pm. There were 4 of us adults and we ordered kadahi chicken, murg makhni (indian style butter chicken); palak paneer and kadahi paneer. I ate and really enjoyed my Murg Makhni and tasted the other dishes which were all tasty and full of flavour. These all came with rice. I also ordered garlic Naan which was good for soaking up the sauce. The prices were amazingly reasonable with decent sizing (worth the price). I will definitely be eating here more in the future - to me this is a win-win.

Tried their buffet for the first time and enjoyed all their offering! A mix of vegetarian and non-vegetarian option, including fish, lamb and their delicious butter chicken! Attentive service and warm atmosphere. At $24.99 per adult, best value buffet you can have in Auckland👍🏼

Great selection of vegetarian and meat dishes. There was a selection of 4 appetizers as well as 4 mains and a meat and vege noodle option. The cheapest buffet you will get for the different flavours you can experience. We went with our family with 3 kids and they had a bit of everything with our youngest sticking to the staple butter chicken... 3 plates of it!!! The neverending naan bread was another plus! We will be back for another experience with our extended family. Highly recommend!!!

I ordered food from Patiala Rocks on 18th May 2025 , Lamb Rogan Josh, Chicken 65, and Naan. The flavors were beyond my expectations absolutely delicious! I enjoyed it so much that I visited again on 25th May. This time, I tried the Biryani, Goat Curry, Garlic Naan, and some drinks. Once again, the food was outstanding ! rich, authentic, and unforgettable. The atmosphere at Patiala Rocks is warm and welcoming. The staff and the owner were incredibly friendly, helpful, and supportive, which made the experience even more enjoyable. It’s a perfect place not just for great food but also for great vibes. Free parking is an added bonus, and the pricing is very reasonable for the quality you get. I'm officially a big fan now! Thank you, Patiala Rocks, for such a wonderful experience I’ll definitely be back again. 😊

Ordered take-away for Tamariki new year; saw the good reviews and thought it would be really good. Bought what’s r commended in the review- lemon chicken on rice and sweet sour pork , plus fish and chips. All of the food was just ok, or even not as good to my preference. I guess this is the preference of the local neighborhood but probably not for real Chinese food. Anyway, the portion is huge and food was made quickly.
The best fish and chips i’ve ever bought! The fish was fresh and cooked to perfection, I got one kids fish meal and one kids hot dog meal so worth the price. We will definately be back 💯

Had takeaways on Friday night - lemon chicken on fried rice (in bowl) and sweet & sour pork. We really enjoyed both - couldn’t pick a fave. Pricing is standard for takeaways these days (in terms of fried rice, chow mein, curry etc options). There’s a 2-sided takeaway menu - I’ve attached photos. They also do toasties, burgers, fish & chips etc. We will definitely frequent this takeaways shop again.
Fish and chip was very cheap! Chow mein’s nodle was very interesting. Food served really fast and quality was also nice!

I found out about this place cause a person told me they drive 45 minutes to get their Chinese so it must be AMAZING and it is... If I'm in the Area I go here... I get the Combination Fried Rice... So tasty and fresh and big portions...(P.S-i add Mayo, so not usually white and creamy)
It was very underwhelming for me. I mean there are tons of cheap sushi places everywhere, and this place is one of them. However, the rice was pretty dry, and the sushi was so so average.

This place is getting an A+++ from me and I highly recommend them to everyone to try out their yummy Sushi 🍣 😋 so worth it to buy from here because they put their love and effort into making the yummiest Sushi around good portion sizes of everything in it from the cream cheese, veges, meats, fish. My favorite is always the Cream cheese, Avocado & pineapple just so delish thanks for taking my order over the phone today. Some big places like St Pierre's Sushi I use to buy from are so Stingy with their portion pieces, and they never have the Cream cheese, avocado and pineapple. ありがとうございます Thank you so much Sushi bay you ladies, guys are the best! 😊

A hidden little Sushi Gem! Nice variety of interesting sushi pieces, made very well & super delicious. The Ginger, Seaweed Salad & Miso were all made perfectly! We ate inside and it was very clean and comfortable. 5 Stars!!
Best fresh sushi in Manurewa, great selection… it is a hidden little gem
Really nice and good quality. A pity about the no have plates policy, just eat from the take-out trays while on the premises. Definitely an oxymoron moment for me.

Came with no booking, so only got some of the pantry food to go, but it was superb! Cinnamon rolls were heavenly, and there was a wide range of other sweet & savory options. Also tried the quiche and pesto wheel, both great (pesto wheel was a bit greasy though)

Oh my goodness! Where to begin? Sin in a Bun is a must if you are visiting! It's so good! Foods are amazing too - Cheese Scone Benedic and Hey Gorgeous Bowl 🥗 Tea options are nice, too. We tried Indigo Punch tea, and it has a blue colour, and if left longer, it turns purple 💜 The portions of Hey Gorgeous Bowl are enough for two peeps, and so is Sin in a Bun. The prices are good for the food portions too 😍 There are lovely sheep 🐑 and alpacas 🦙 outside. Lovely space for indoor and outdoor dining 🍽 The staff are friendly 🤗 Perfect for weekend getaway from busy Auckland 🥰 Would love to come back here again!

I took my Mum to Farm House Cafe for their Mother’s Day high tea and it did not disappoint! First and foremost, we had the Lovely Lana hosting our table and she was an absolute gem and she made our incredible experience even better. The hightea itself was delicious - every course was spectacularly beautiful and truly delicious. It was so lovely to see the chef have fun with flavours and new takes on old dishes. A true talent. What a perfect experience to celebrate Mother’s Day- we have already discussed that this will be our new Mother’s Day venue.

The best cinnamon rolls I have tried in Auckland! Reasonable price Very accommodating and friendly staff And good food!! Tried the ultimate best cinnamon and the baby potatoes with brisket. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Our new favourite brunch date location.

ONLY ONE WORD TO SAY… MISMERISING. Beautiful and amazing location. Cafe location is certainly the plus point for anyone to visit this cafe at least for once . Make sure your phone or camera is charged so you can lock in some amazing scene. Coffee is really good but do ask for it to be hot . Otherwise its going to be luke warm . Strong but just warm . Food was below average . Very strong italian seasoning in mushroom and the scone was very blend in taste. Mushrooms did taste flavourless and watery . Eggs were done really well . I would highly recommend you to try small items from cabinet than anything from menu as it’s a long wait and its certainly not worth waiting .

The staff were lovely, the weather was slightly cloudy, twilight adjacent vibes. The atmosphere was very warm and welcoming with very interesting historical photos and a Guinness book of world records (perfect entertainment). It was the best place to stop in after our walk at omanawanui. The food was great and the prices were the best. Will be back 😋

The staff are genuine and welcoming, with no upselling tactics. Coffee is crafted to European standards (a latte is distinctly different from a cappuccino), and the flat white matches the quality you’d find at Costa or Pret. I didn’t sample the food, but I noticed a table of four nearby with well-portioned dishes and impressive presentation for New Zealand standards. Disclaimer: My reviews reflect my genuine experiences: good, bad, or exceptional. Five stars are reserved for service that exceeds expectations. With nearly 500 reviews written, I don’t nitpick over trivialities like a $5 overcharge or a bitter coffee. As a former reviewer for The City Guide weekly, I base my feedback solely on the quality of the experience.

Best Pies in West Auckland. Cute shop with many tables inside and a large courtyard area outside. Always busy with customers. We had the homemade pies and coffees. It was all very tasty. I saw the fish & chips (generous portions). Really friendly team. Very quant place. Hot food, ice cream, coffee and more.

I was talking to someone who works here, and this place had been in the parker family since 1888. It's really awesome to hear it still in the family. Alot of history on the walls, vintage stuff everywhere, and love the vibe of the place. Nice outdoor are with plentiful seating, so ke and my workmates came for lunch. - Steak cut fries 10/10. These came with the burger for an extra $5, and they are done perfectly if you're into thick cut like me. Fluffy potato inside and crunchy exterior. Salt added. I'm assuming these are from agria potatoes, nice color. - Kiwi burger 8.2/10 The Workmate said he could have added an extra pattie, however the the salads are fresh, and the onions ring were a good size and the right amount of sauce. - Big Alf burger 8.6/10 Other workmate said he was really satisfied for the burger, loves pickles, and was happy for the price he got for it. - Grand Alf burger 9.3/10 This was mine, and it didn't disappoint. Just like the others, the bun was toasted, and I felt a decent amount t of bacon. It was so hearty, I felt like I didn't need the chips! Great value, and I was really happy. - Brownie w/ caramel sauce 7.5/10 This was good, not as moist as I thought, but the caramel on top was bloody yum. The service was outstanding, too, friendly and welcoming local kiwi ladies, that can spin a few good yarns, and if I'm ever these ways again, I'll definitely get lunch here.

I was struggling to find a good Fish n Chip's shop over the weekend. Surprisingly, Alfred's served an amazing FNC. The taste was clean and fresh. The chips were amazing, crunching on the outside and soft on the inside. Their BLT was also surprisingly tasty and yummy. Just one critic, the prices were a little high but then again, the quality did compensate for that.

We had a short stop at this restaurant at London Gatwick Airport. Incredibly friendly staff combined with very good quality of food. We also had the opportunity to meet the manager who was extremely friendly and dedicated. The coffee was one of the best we had in London. We can absolutely recommend this place. The prices were extremely fair and lower than all the others you are used to from the airports.
Great people wonderful service recommended to all passing through

Great hotel. Stayed here for a work course and was fantastic. Staff friendly, helpful, professional and engaging. Great systems and processes re check in, airport transfers. Restaurant & conference staff wonderful & amazing catering options. Easy commute to and from airport while accommodation had comfortable, clean & modern rooms - with heat pumps to keep you warm in winter. Great venue - would definitely stay here again 😊. Many thanks for a great conference experience.

Great location. Friendly and helpful front desk staff. Our flight was delayed by 12 hours and they were really accommodating and arranging an airport pickup for us. Room was clean and very comfortable. They got a friendly hotel cat that would walk around the front door to greet customers!

Wonderful hotel when flying into/out of Auckland! Lovely staff members, all around! Fantastic shuttle service. Very comfortable, clean & nicely appointed rooms. We very much enjoyed the comfortable lounge for a relaxing drink . The restaurant offers well prepared food in a comfortable setting. Highly recommend the scotch steak.. well prepared tender steak nicely pared with fresh veg and potatoes. The suggested Shirah paring was a delicious match. Wonderful service by restaurant staff. Can’t wait to return next holiday ! Well done!

We attended a 4 day Gospel convention, stayed 4 nights. Absolutely wonderful venue. Excellent rooms and meeting rooms. Staff at front desk are awesome. Welcoming and friendly. Massive carpark and well lit walkways. Highly recommend this establishment.

We stayed here for one night as we were flying out early the next morning. Check in was easy, they kept our car keys, ready for us on our return. Nice friendly staff. Room was nice and clean, very comfy bed and pillows, quiet. The shuttle service to the airport was good there and back. Will stay again one day.

Felt like we were on holiday already with the tropical vibe. The service and food was so good at dinner we went back for brunch the next day. Special mention to the amazing manager, Unique Chandra and the Chef for taking care of our special requests. We will be back!

Outdoor area was lovely and parking right outside so easily accessible however that was really the only thing that was good about this place. Our first time here and sadly will be our last. We were a group of about 8 and every person ordering different meals and we all had issues. Most of the food tastes like it’s from the supermarket or you could’ve just made better yourself at home. The sharing platter for two is definitely not enough to eat for 2 people. We literally got less than 10 chips in a small bowl. Same with the coleslaw, 4 tiny pieces of dry pork belly, about 5 or 6 chicken nibbles and 4 tiny little ribs. All for $70 - All the meat was dry. One of this chicken dishes was literally just a chicken leg served with a gross hollandaise tasting sauce and dry mashed potato. One of our group ordered a scotch fillet and was given a sirloin with a runny sauce. Lamb pizza looked and tasted like a Pizza Hut or dominoes pizza with a some feta sprinkled on top. We are all very non picky eaters and every one of us had issues. Most of us never turning dessert down either and we were that put off by the food we didn’t even order dessert. The two of our group who did said they tasted worse than the stuff you buy from the supermarket. The wait staff were okay. We were also charged for a dessert and hot drinks we didn’t purchase so had to ask for that to be taken off our bill. Overall really below average experience and for the prices being charged the chef and menu should definitely be looked into. The platter looks better in my picture than it was, don’t be fooled. Lol Would not recommend.

This pub is in a superb location right next to the Ibis hotel. They do food at all hours of the day right when hungry guests arrive. The Ibis has no eatery so it must be a gold mine. Szimpla also do breakfast starting from 7am. It's also quite family friendly.

The first time I walked into the place, I felt like I was back in the Island, the feel of a warm tropical vibe of interiors is absolutely love.. Food also was wonderful, worth your $$ and presentation and services very happy. I definitely come back again. Note: I hope you have live band. It would be a nice touch in the outdoor/undercover garden area😍🌺

I dined here 3 separate evenings on a work trip to Auckland recently. I was really impressed with the attentiveness of the staff, very welcoming upon entry and really good at coming back to take orders in a timely manner. The food was to a great standard too, the fettucini, onion rings, chicken burger (holy smokes that chipotle sauce was good) & BBQ ribs were all really, really tasty. The chefs nailed the textures and the serving sizes were good too. Great beers available, 10/10 do recommend 🤙 Will be back when next in town, thanks!

If you are dropping your loved ones off at the airport and are looking for a quick snack as a reward on your way to or from the airport please just go into the airport itself and use that Mcdonalds. Staff were rude. Food came out stale and uneatable. Their hot chocolate tasted like warmed up milk and their chicken nuggets were as hard as cardboard. DO NOT RECOMMEND.

This is the worst McDonald’s I’ve ever been in to. The men’s bathroom is dirty and the toilet seat is broken. It doesn’t look like it’s been cleaned for months. Unfortunately the restaurant is no different. There was not one clean table to sit at with old food on tables, upholstery and walls! The staff seems to have just given up. They were a couple of spray bottles and rags on two of the tables giving the feeling at the customer was expected to clean their own tables. I know this place is primarily a drive-through for the airport but the restaurant had quite a few people inside and unfortunately the outside was cleaner. I highly recommend you don’t dine in at this restaurant or even a drive-through considering their cleanliness issues.

We visit this McDonald's a lot as it is close to home and over the past few months we have been experiencing food which is not to a very good standard. We are regularly getting fries which are old and stale, burgers which have old patties and are poorly put together and frozen cokes which only fill half the cup or have been premade as they are half melted. We used to love the soft serve from this restaurant however of late they have started to resemble kiddie cones.

The worst flatwhite you will get in Auckland served by an angry looking staff. Terrible start of a day. :( Discusting to see an outside chair left so dirty. Please clean it, and this is not meeting the health and safety standards.

Food was good, service was fast but I had to wipe down my own table before use. The coffee ordered for two people was too hot and overflowing out of the cups. I also ordered to dine in but had my food provided in a paper bag.

We went there just yesterday for an early dinner as we had an early flight this morning. The lovely waitress pulled out our chairs, brought water to the table etc. We ordered a certain type of sandwich which they did not have available, but she got the kitchen to make up a club type toasted sandwich instead. It was amazing!! Wonderful service, nice quiet ambiance, very impressed ☺️☺️☺️

We had a breakfast at Jetpark Auckland today morning and we loved it!!! The service was amazing, as soon as we ordered we were served our food within 5-10 minutes. Gagan was so helpful and made sure to serve us with a smile and meet all of our requests. We are definitely going to be coming back!

We had our last supper before flying back to Tokyo. Our expectations were actually low, but you can get proper kiwi cuisine here. It can get a little pricey, but overall if you’re looking for a place to eat around this area,I highly recommend it.
The service and food is excellent! Steak, chicken , morrocan beef burger is so good. Best was the black Forrest dessert.

I don’t understand the negative reviews. We had a really great dinner with large portions and very fresh ingredients. The service was excellent, very fast, and the staff was friendly. I can definitely recommend eating here if you’re staying at the hotel anyway

Chips dry as. Seems very old.. To the point where it's just the skin.. No more potatoes. Coleslaw was weird.. Thicker.. Slightly slimy? Hard to describe.. Just wasn't the usual texture.. Wasn't nice to eat. Chicken thigh was so small. Won't be having kfc again anytime soon.
The location is pretty convenient on the side of the main highway to the airport and its always clean and tidy inside. Service can be inattentive but what can you expect from fast food chains.

Not being a Ken but some constructive feedback. * A poster out side saying no dining but the dine in is open. Misleading customers. Was about to turn back when another person walked out and said it was open * ordered a 12pcs wicked wings bucket and 2 large chips. They were so stale , hard and dry. Not fresh at all. Had to ask for a new set of chips. We were given a new fresh chip later. * The new chips we got was overloaded with salt. Didn’t want to return them as it will either go into wastage or fried again for another customer so dusted off the excessive salt and had them. * The wicked wings was a little dry but not an issue was happy with them. Saving the cost by reusing things is not the ideal way. I would consider this as worst KFC chips I had from all the other branches. First and last time at this branch. Service was good. Only the food was not good.

Chicken was dripping with oil and overcooked. Gravy was watery as. Chips were soggy and overly salty. All the things nobody wants with their KFC. Tried this store a few times and every time is so disappointing. There’s definitely something wrong with the procedures here for the food to be so different to other KFC stores.

Durty as place! It's a shame that this is what visitors from the airport have to walk into. I had to remove a cockroach from my childs leg inside the shop. Wanted to have a feed with us. ALL tables were dirty. Changed my eat-in to take away. Floor is dirty toilets are disgusting! Worst KFC experience EVER! Pops wasn't even cooked properly. Still raw inside. No man! What a waste of a good business! You need better management and better owners to run a mint location business like this.
Loved our stop here! The manager/owner was so sweet. Got their English muffin breakfast and it was delicious. 10/10
Order egg Benedict, it’s quite disappointing, they used cheap materials like ham and bread but price is not cheap,long black coffee is not made properly turn out murky. I won’t come back
Love the happy staff, always superior service here. Also a bonus getting my free coffee's on my loyalty card. Great quality of breakfast...even when we takeaway. 🫶🏽

I absolutely love the girls and guys that work here. The coffee is amazing (especially with a flavour shot) and the food is always super fresh. Whether you’re just looking for a quick coffee to go or a good long sit down, this place is perfect.

It’s such a warm welcoming place to have a beautiful meal. I really enjoyed spending time with my sister and loved the atmosphere^^ The food was yum I loved the sweet potatoes it was soo good. Couldn’t help myself to stop eating it lol. And as for the croissant 🥐 it was delicious. And that lil bun thing ( IDK the name) Sorry but It was so dry:( I couldn’t bring myself to get a second bite, It wasn’t my favourite at all. 👎 However, The staffs are all kind with a beautiful smile on their faces💌🫶 I would definitely recommend this place🫶🎀 🤗

Staff were friendly enough, food was good but the bathroom needs redoing. Sink was in my face literally . I’m not a big person and I struggled with the placement. The store was also filthy. Standing to pay and all I could see was spilt food down the front and what I could guess was built up dirt and black grime on the surfaces and card machines. Yuck.

Front of house is friendly , I always used to order via app and collect it later , always has a great experience, but unfortunately when I was about to order online again it’s showing temporarily closed don’t know why .
I ordered a chicken sandwich, it was very filling and very tasty. The bread was toasted and crunchy

Externally, the place looked like it was closed, at 8pm, no signage to indicate they're open except for an A5 size sticker on the glass, and that's if you have bionic eyes. The OPEN sign doesn't work, but the joke is that the DRIVE THRU sign works, but it's no longer used LOL. Internally the place looked like a run down American Diner, lighting fixtures 5 out of 9 worked, ceiling fans did nothing to cool the interior down, if the heat pump was on that too couldn't keep a Penguin cool. But alas, the food is just the same as all other Subways Great. I guess that's the mentality of Upper Management, as long as the money keeps rolling in stuff the Dining Experience.

Wow, thank you to Jason who is the owner of this restaurant for responding to my issues on opening times. Your quick response to rectifying this is awesome. Your kind gesture was totally appreciated by my whole team and they wish to thank you as well. We will definitely be using the online ordering app to place future orders.

AMAZING! Their torpedo sandwich filled with succulent chicken cranberry, bre and many more magical things, literally made my day! And their white chocolate rocky road 🤤 i could eat 12! I use to walk past this place on the regular and I am SO glad I finally tried it. Such a beautiful atmosphere with lovely staff and gorgeous fresh food! A must if your in the area 🥰 will be back to try more!

We had the absolute pleasure of having The Orchard Juicery & Kitchen cater our staff lunch, and it was nothing short of outstanding. From start to finish, the experience was seamless. The food was fresh, vibrant, and bursting with flavour, you could taste the quality in every bite. Highly recommend. Thanks team 😊
Tasty food and great fresh juices. Friendly staff and a nice atmosphere.

Terrific, unexpected cafe in the middle of the airport industrial area. Their coffee is on point, strong and flavoursome, and they take dietary requirements in their stride with a range of healthy brunches and treats if you want to indulge. I seriously didn't exact to find food this good in this location, and have been known to travel from east Auckland for weekend brunch here. Terrific. The paleo brunch is outstanding, with a mix of flavours and textures to impress you. Go. It's good.

The most delicious breakfast sandwiches EVER and amazing smoothies. Super friendly staff. And, very affordable! Can’t say enough great things about this place, it’s well worth a stop if you’re anywhere near the airport.

My go to whenever I want a good brunch or lunch. The owner is very friendly and always greets us with a smile. Comfortable seating, good for small team lunches. They have good coffee too. It's good to have a place like this to go to. Oh and my favourite is their creamy mushroom! 😍

Third time is a charm! First two times I attempted to come they were closed due to family commitments. Decor is beautiful, feels very private inside and modern. Food is fresh and hot, and the coffee is excellent - a perfect mix.
Nice coffee, friendly staff. Food and coffee were served fast.
Very chill and relaxed place to have a late breakfast. Loved the toasted muesli and the flat white was pretty good.

We were looking for a brunch place while travelling through New Zealand and came across this place on Google Maps. We were incredibly impressed and satisfied with the food and service. I got the Brioche French Toast which was light, fluffy, and balanced, and my wife got the mushroom and spinach omelette which was fantastic. The ambience was great as well - we got the window-side seats with the lovely and soft armchairs, and the music playing was lighthearted and happy without overpowering the conversation. Overall one of the best brunch spots I've come across - simple but they do what they do really well.

text: We were recommended this cute pub on the corner for dinner by our hotel near the airport and were each given 'postcards' for a 10% discount on drinks. Driving in at first thought was, this looks a cold place in the hope they had a fire, which there was, a small gas one in the centre of the room that somewhat failed to heat the size of the beautiful large space. Outdoor heaters provided for those who wished to sit outside. We were promptly served a few tables away from the fire and our waitress noticed we were cold and offered blankets while we waited. The menus had a cute envelope touch to them that had me singing the postman pat theme song. Food was delicious and generous portions. Pays to read menu fully as my mum ordered a lamb pizza and hadn't read chilli flakes in the ingredients which made for a very spicy meal! Onion bhaji's were the best I've ever had! Toilets were decorated in retro memorabilia. Overall a pleasant dining experience.

I was staying nearby before heading off overseas and felt like a steak as in Thailand mostly tough. Finding out that the local pub had Monday night steak night I gave it a go. Wow for $25 I received a lovely steak and great service by a Filipino waitress who was very accommodating. Well done to the team.

I was quite happy with our overall dining experience here, we had a nice private area booked for our table of 8. The service was quite prompt. Prices quite reasonable. Wasn't busy Sat night so we were able to happily take our time and with the bunch of starters we ordered we struggled to finish our meals. starters- ordered were the jalapeno poppers, buffalo chicken nibbles, spinach & feta vol au vents, margarita shrimps. Mains- butter chicken rice bowl, butchers fave steak Standouts: Cajun calamari w/ lemon & sweet chilli, cheesy garlic bread Mrs montgomerie beef burger (I switched out the fries for the butchers fave steak meals sides, got the best of both worlds!) House-made lemon lime & bitters
I really like that atmosphere because it’s pretty calm and relaxing for me after a hectic day at the work. I do get here but I need , low carbs beer as well as feta thi Curry my favourite.
Reallyoved that they leaned into their theme, it was overall very cute. Food was tasty and we had troubles finishing our portions because they were good sized.

As we walked in the place had been sprayed with way too much bleach on the tables it was a bit sickening mixed with the usual sushi smell. Team behind the counter where short with their words and smiles must have walked in on a bad day... food was good as always.
Great service and fresh sushi. Staff are very friendly and there’s ample seating for you and friends/family to dine in.
Teriyaki salmon w/rice; inedible.. extremely salty just like the sour-faced woman working there.. best left to the original sushi-makers (Japanese).. quality and beauty..
Sushi is always fresh here. The staff are always willing to make a fresh batch or to order if need be. Opens quite early in the morning or you can pick up lunch. Abundance of parking too.
Selection limited, you can't really choose the sushi you want, feels like a get what your given vibe. Taste is OK, presentation is good, price is alright? although selections are limited to packs.

Ordered chicken korma and butter chicken at Shamiana Manawa Bay. The butter chicken tasted great, but there was hardly any meat in it. The rice looked like it was just thrown onto each plate, and everything just looked messy. They’re using paper plates now, which didn’t help the presentation. The person who served us barely spoke—hardly any communication at all. Disappointing overall.

Had a vegetable Korma Combo, on a busy Sunday afternoon. Honestly the worst, most tasteless vegetable korma - I have ever had. Packed with celery & taste was overwhelming, not cauliflower ir broccoli in my playe. Assuming its to do with seasonal prices, as celery is dirt cheap and Caluiflower is higher, but at the detriment of an overpowering flavor, this is extremely disappointing. Combo should have been $18.99 - instead I was charged $21.99 (price of a meat combo) and had to argue about it. Before deciding it's not worth it and not wanting it to ruin my dad, so walking away. Atmosphere in the food court is very good I would never visit again and do not recommend

Chopped cashew nuts, raisins, very fragrant from the coriander and large chicken pieces. Served with some little bit of yogurt on the side. I don't muck with my order but order the norms which is the butter chicken. thank you for the lovely meal at Manawa Bay. Lovely staff.

I visted shamiana manawabay recently.Excellent customer service and helpful male staff who served me paneer curry combomeal. I ask him to change my drink twice but he didnt mind. Its excellent customer care. Food is also yummy.positive atmosphere.

Great Service! Visited recently and was really impressed with one of the lady staff members—she was kind, polite, and very helpful. Her friendly attitude made the experience much better. Thank you for the great service!

Soul Origin has a solid concept—but it falls flat on execution. The build-your-own meal model, with tiered portion sizes and ingredient selections, sounds like a great idea—if the portions and quality matched expectations. Unfortunately, they don’t. The protein portions are sliced so thinly they feel more like a garnish than a main component. I’d honestly rather pay extra for a reasonable serving than be left hunting for the meat in every bite. Visually, the food looks appealing. But once packed into the container, it becomes clear that the more desirable ingredients are doled out sparingly. In the Greek salad, for instance, the feta and olives were so minimal it felt like eating soggy cucumbers and tomatoes. The pasta with chicken? Just pasta, with barely any trace of chicken—and not much flavor either. Across the board, the selections lacked seasoning and balance. Sauces might’ve saved the day, but even those fell short. As for the pastries, they were far too sweet and lacked nuance. All in all, a disappointing first—and likely last—experience.

As mentioned by another reviewer, the salads look appealing when selecting from the options on the cabinet display, but it’s mostly carb/salad based and few pieces of the meat/alt meat/toppings.

We had a really enjoyable experience at Needo Pasta at Mānawa Bay and would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a quick, satisfying, and tasty bite while shopping. We ordered the macaroni pasta and a side of mojo sticks, and both were spot-on. One of the things we appreciated most was how customisable the pasta was. When ordering, you get to choose your pasta type, sauce, and any extra toppings or proteins, which is perfect for those who like to tweak their meals to suit their taste or dietary needs. We went with the classic macaroni paired with a creamy cheese sauce, and it was delicious—rich, warm, and full of flavour without being too heavy. The pasta was cooked to just the right texture, and the portion size was generous enough to leave us full without feeling overstuffed. The mojo sticks were also a great addition to the meal—crispy on the outside, soft and cheesy on the inside, and served with a tasty dipping sauce that added a nice zing. They were the perfect snackable side, and while they’re great for sharing, we honestly could’ve eaten a whole box ourselves. The service was quick and efficient, even though the place was quite busy during lunchtime. Staff were polite and helpful when we had questions about the menu, and everything came out promptly and nicely packaged. You can tell that Needo Pasta puts some thought into the overall experience—everything from the quality of the food to the way it’s served felt well done for a food court-style setup. For a food court outlet, it’s definitely a step above the usual fast food offerings. The ability to customise your meal, the comforting flavours, and the decent value for money make Needo Pasta a standout among the dining options at Mānawa Bay. Whether you’re after a quick lunch, a post-shopping carb fix, or just something warm and cheesy to make your day better, it’s well worth a visit. We’ll definitely be going back to try some of their other pasta combos!

Hopefully they will have more options in the future. We ordered Margherita and Honey Glazed Bacon Pizza as well as Carbonara and Bolognese. We also had Mozzarella Sticks and Tiramisu. Serving is good portion. Food is fresh and tasty. It's good Italian fastfood option but nothing outstanding. Will I come back? Definitely.
It is licated at the food court. Order via self service screen. Great fresh made pasta. Portion not excessively huge.

Lunch today was at Needo in Manawa Bay, a spot I’ve visited several times, along with their Commercial Bay branch. Every visit has been consistently delightful, especially when it comes to their pasta. This time, I went for the Pomodoro with macaroni pasta, topped with extra mozzarella and parmesan. What I truly appreciate about Needo is their consistency—every visit delivers the same high-quality, flavourful experience. On top of that, their efficient ordering system and quick service make the whole experience seamless. Definitely a go-to spot for a satisfying meal!

This was a first time experience for me! I trully am not a pasta person but after seeing all the hype people put into talking about it, I HAD to try! Yes, I love pasta now! They DID NOT DISSAPOINT! I actually spent over $30 on this as I was greedy with all the cheese🤤😅 Nevertheless, I could not finish it and had it for dinner later on 😂 Big thumbs up to the amazing team who served me! Staff were so friendly and welcoming even though we arrived close to closing time. Food was delicious, definitely preferred the fried dumplings instead of the steamed! Portion sizes were a little small for the price, but still yummy and will be back.

I had a small bowl of self selection of meat, noodle or rice and vegetables. I had BBQ pork, cost $14.90. Nothing wow - it was average. I also ordered a bowl of prawn noodle soup. Okay, first time I've struggle to finish any soup from an Asian restaurant - the broth was very salty. Cost $19.99. Plenty of free parking, 2min drive to Auckland International Airport. Tidy, spacious and simple decor. Overall average 2.5 rating.

We came across this lovely bar and the staff with a very welcoming smile was very kind even though it was near closing time. Thank you! These guys were the best! We came right on closing and they were kind enough to stay open for us. The noodle soup and fried rice were amazing, such good flavours, healthy, fresh and generous portions. And lovely service and interiors/atmosphere. Thank you so much :)

We recently dined at Tran's Vietnamese Kitchen in Mānawa Bay and were thoroughly impressed by the authentic flavours and warm hospitality.​ BBQ Pork Belly on Rice The pork belly was perfectly grilled, boasting a smoky char and tender meat. The accompanying rice was fluffy, and the dish was well-balanced with fresh herbs and a tangy fish sauce.​ Grilled Lemongrass Chicken on Rice This dish was a standout. The chicken was juicy and infused with lemongrass, offering a delightful citrusy aroma. Paired with jasmine rice and a side salad, it was both hearty and refreshing.​ Caramelised Pork Belly on Rice A rich and savoury delight, the pork belly was melt-in-your-mouth tender with a sweet glaze that wasn't overpowering. The pickled vegetables provided a nice contrast, cutting through the richness.​ Spring Rolls Crispy and golden on the outside, the spring rolls were filled with a flavorful mix of pork, mushrooms, and vermicelli. Served with a homemade fish sauce, they were an excellent starter.​ The staff were attentive and knowledgeable, ensuring a pleasant dining experience, making it a perfect spot for both casual lunches and intimate dinners.​ Overall, Tran's Vietnamese Kitchen offers a genuine taste of Vietnam in the heart of Mānawa Bay. Highly recommended for anyone seeking authentic Vietnamese cuisine.

A M A Z I N G 🫰🏼 First time to try out Pho and I really enjoyed it! Food was HOT and refreshing 🤤 Love their little sauce & spice tray in front so you can help yourself to many more options. Best Vietnamese cuisine ever! Great fresh healthy food made with love & passion as I ordered lemongrass chicken with rice & fresh salad & pickled veges & fried egg on top made it more delicious. No long wait time I was impressed with great service & found a nice table overlooking the bay. A remarkable mall to visit as the food & shopping is so good😄❤

The Mannaway Bay Food Court near the airport offers many restaurants with different flavors from different countries. The prices and portions are normal, and the waiting time for the meal is not too long. There are also many seats for diners, and there are also several baby seats. It is still difficult to find a seat during the peak hours of 12:00-14:00. It is recommended that if you are not too hungry, you can find a time before or after the peak hours to eat. Go shopping during the peak hours and don't indulge in the rush of people. Some high seats provide USB ports for mobile phone charging, or New Zealand three-pin sockets for laptops, which are really convenient for passengers and provide a comfortable place to rest, replenish and charge. A tip for passengers: this is a self-service meal. After eating, please pack the plate and food and take it to the plate collection car for the cleaning staff to deal with. In addition, if you are a passenger preparing to board the plane and carrying a suitcase, you can go to the bathroom next to Exit A of the parking lot. There is a paid temporary luggage locker. Leave your luggage in the locker before going shopping.

"Disappointing Service Experience at Te Kaahu, Pullman Hotel Auckland Airport" (I can't see the review I wrote last week, so I'm rewriting it now.) I have been a loyal guest of Pullman Hotels in various countries and have always appreciated their high standards. However, my experience at Te Kaahu, Pullman Auckland Airport, was deeply disappointing due to poor service quality and lack of professionalism. 1. Disruptive Cleaning During My Meal. Shortly after I started my meal, the staff began vacuuming and mopping the floor around my table. This was disruptive and made it difficult to enjoy my meal, as I had to pause eating until they finished. It created an unwelcoming atmosphere and felt inconsiderate towards diners. 2. Ignored When Ordering Tea. After finishing my meal, I wanted to order tea but was left waiting for a long time with my empty plate. No staff approached me, and I had to actively call someone over to place my order. This lack of attentiveness was frustrating and not what I expect from a high-end hotel restaurant. 3. Asked to Vacate My Table Without Clear Justification. As I was drinking my tea, a staff member told me I needed to leave because the table was reserved. However, when I asked what time the reservation was for, I received inconsistent answers—first an already-passed time, then “in 15 minutes,” and then “in 10 minutes.” The explanation kept changing, which made the situation confusing and unprofessional. At no point was I informed of a time limit when I was seated. 4. Unnecessary Questions About My Plans. During my meal, a staff member asked where I was heading, what time my flight was, and how long I planned to stay. This level of questioning felt intrusive and unnecessary, as I was simply dining and not occupying a lounge or special seating area. 5. Limited Seating Options and Unhelpful Resolution. When I offered to move to a nearby seat instead of leaving, the staff said they needed to check with the manager. Upon returning, they told me I could not sit anywhere else and had to move to the bar, without offering any alternatives. This inflexible and impersonal approach to problem-solving was disappointing. -A Message to Pullman Hotel Management As a frequent Pullman guest, I have always appreciated Accor’s commitment to hospitality. However, this experience at Te Kaahu did not reflect the level of service I expect. Staff should be better trained in customer service, communication, and handling guest needs with professionalism. A simple apology and a more accommodating approach would have significantly improved the situation. I would appreciate knowing what steps have been taken to improve service quality at Te Kaahu. Has additional training been provided? Have service policies been reviewed? Despite this experience, I still value Pullman Hotels and hope to see improvements in their service standards.

I had a fantastic experience at this restaurant! The food was absolutely delicious — fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented.I especially want to mention Jaskaran for their outstanding service. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Absolutely Amazing Experience at The Flaming Tandoor! We had an incredible dining experience at The Flaming Tandoor in Papatoetoe! From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere was warm and inviting. The food was absolutely delicious — every dish was rich in flavor and beautifully presented. Highly recommend this place if you’re looking for authentic Indian food with top-notch service. We’ll definitely be coming back!
We went their first time and We order Butter chicken , chlili chicken and noodles so delicious. Yummy food .We will definitely come back. Best prices

From the moment we walked in, the service was outstanding-friendly, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. Every staff member we interacted with went out of their way to make us feel comfortable and well taken care of. The food? Absolutely amazing. Highly recommend this place if you're looking for a memorable dining experience with top-notch service and incredible food. We ordered an iced coffee and were surprised to find cinnamon sprinkled on top. While it wasn’t bad, it would’ve been nice to be asked or at least informed beforehand. A quick recommendation or heads-up next time would definitely improve the experience. We will definitely come back for more

Thank you very much for the food and the area that was booked and reserved for me and another person. Food was delicious and would totally recommend Melba to anyone looking for a venue to relax and enjoy with good company, enjoying good quality food and drinks. Cheers

I just want to thank you for going above and beyond with your customer service. Beautiful atmosphere overall and the food was on point. I had the Melba breakfast and my niece had the Farmers feast. Exceptionally neat and tidy within this establishment. They pride themselves for being presentable. The food was great and reasonably priced. Friendly staff. If you're craving authentic New York-style pizza, Sal’s is the place to go! The pizza is always fresh, cheesy, and full of flavor. Definitely coming back — great food and even better service! 🍕👏

Staff were very friendly and checked on me twice while I ate my meal. The pizza was one of the nicest I've had for sometime however I was disappointed at the price and the amount of mushrooms used. I ordered a half size pizza with Cheese, Pepperoni and Mushroom only with no sauce on the base at my request and a 330ml can of Pepsi. Total cost was $37.00. Next time I will have the full-size pizza as this would be better value for money.

So good, That i feel cheated by the mass produced, Low effort pizzas i’ve had for 40 years of my life I don’t want to oversell Sals, But the truth is, It was the best pizza i ever had… And my mate from Pennsylvania, She told me to come here - Said it tasted like back home Much love from Taranaki, Amazing start to my visit to Manukau

Salz isn't just pizza; it’s the real deal.
We love Sal's Pizza, and the staff at this location were perhaps the nicest we've ever had. Thank you!!!
Nice selection of Asian food, staff were really friendly
Great food variety. Food prices have increased since the a few months ago we had a dine-in here. But overall a good place for dinner.

Best part was the side dish raita chilli garlic Naan and King fisher

“Absolutely loved the experience at Chawala Restaurant! The service was genuinely impressive — staff were attentive, polite, and made us feel truly welcome. It’s a cozy place with a warm atmosphere, perfect for a relaxed meal. Highly recommended for both food and hospitality.

Absolutely delicious! The cheese is perfectly melted and golden brown, creating a rich, creamy texture with every bite. Your pizza is absolutely amazing! From the beautifully crisp yet airy crust to the rich, flavorful sauce and the perfectly balanced toppings, every bite is a masterpiece. Amazing and friendly service from Sagan. He is very professional and has an amazing smile. Thank you an awesome customer service. I will definitely revisit this store very soon. From Gayleen
