I recently visited the BurgerFuel branch in Manukau, and I have to say, it was an overall great experience with just a few things worth noting. First and foremost, the quality of the food really stood out. The burgers are clearly made fresh to order – you can taste the difference as soon as you take the first bite. The ingredients are vibrant and full of flavour, and nothing feels like it’s been sitting under a heat lamp. The patties were juicy, the sauces were well-balanced, and the buns held up nicely without getting soggy. One thing I appreciated in particular is that their chicken burgers are made using free-range chicken, which is a big plus for me. It’s good to know that they’re making more ethical choices when it comes to sourcing their ingredients, and it definitely adds to the quality and taste of the meal. You get that clean, tender bite that’s hard to find in fast food. The staff were friendly and the service was quick despite it being a busy time when I went in. The place was clean and had that classic BurgerFuel vibe – edgy, modern, and well-kept. It’s a cool spot to grab a bite, whether you’re eating in or taking it to go. That said, the only downside for me would be the price. While I understand you’re paying for quality and the use of free-range meat, the burgers are a bit on the pricey side compared to other burger joints in the area. You’re easily looking at over $20 for a burger and fries combo, and that’s before any drinks or extras. So it’s not the kind of place I’d visit on a tight budget or for a casual everyday meal. But for an occasional treat or if you’re after a burger that’s a cut above the rest, it’s definitely worth it.

I would rate this experience lower than one star if it were possible, but since I have to give at least one star to submit my feedback, I will. I would like to share my experience with the app (order meal) in hopes of highlighting some areas for improvement, particularly in customer support. I encountered challenges while trying to resolve an issue with a meal I ordered through Order Meal, specifically regarding a refund. My main request was for a refund, but I struggled to communicate effectively with the representatives. During my calls, I found it difficult to understand some of the agents, which added to my frustration. The first representative I spoke with was unable to provide clear explanations, and unfortunately, our call ended abruptly. I was initially assured by Select Pizza that the refund would be processed through Order Meal, yet Order Meal informed me that my refund request had been declined by Select Pizza. This back-and-forth has left me feeling confused and disappointed. Unfortunately, I was disappointed with my order. I ordered three pizzas, and two of them didn’t resemble what was advertised. The taste was also not what I expected they seemed burnt and lacked flavor. I specifically requested a cheese and garlic pizza with prawns, but it wasn’t quite right. Additionally, I ordered wedges which tasted undercooked, and the sour cream and apricot sauces seemed to be past their expiration. My experience has been quite unsatisfactory. Additionally, I was advised by a representative at Select Pizzia to wait for a manager's response. However, being told to call back on Thursday after a week feels unreasonable, especially since I was simply seeking a refund and not another pizza. I hope that by sharing this feedback, improvements can be made to enhance communication and customer service.

This is the steak burger I got. It was so not worth the money or wait for it. I have had other burgers here but finally I get it that I should never buy them, here is the worst. Others are patties nd that was more like a schnitzel. Thanks for the food I didn't starve lol

The spring rolls are the star of the vermicelli dish! Fried upon order and tasted yum. The dipping sauce is not spicy at all, and there are condiments at the counter. The bubble caramel was too sweet for my liking. They also offered discount on the sushi near closing time (I went there around 5:10pm). I had a friendly chat with the Vietnamese staff, they are cool ☺️ Thank you for your kindness, food and service ❤️
Very nice little eatery. Simple and delicious food and fair portions, too. Loved their lamb on rice and dumplings. Would recommend this spot for a yum bite!

Nami Sushi never disappoints, I can see one person complaining about the English of the old man. You knew his English isn't that great it doesn't take that long to go down stairs to make a pre order yourself physically, or even speak clear or with basic words. It doesn't cost to be kind, if you don't like the place then why go back. Anyways, I love this family operated business. I am always greeted with a friendly kind smile from the family. Food is prepared fresh and hot, my favourite go to is always the noodle salad, and the Bahn Mi. I like the seating area as it's always nice and clean to sit in. If you're wanting to have lunch or dinner in a quiet seating come here. Decor and the presentation of the store is beautiful and always clean. Thank you Nami Sushi always putting on a friendly smiley face for us customers.

I used to visit here for my lunch. Now I don't have much time for my lunch so I ordered from ubereat. Food was always tasty with good portion. Ubereat delivered the food to my house was super fast, within 30 minutes after I placed the order. Food was still hot when I received. I ordered grilled pork with yellow rice, which was so amazing. Pork was well marinated. Highly recommend

This has been my go to whenever I want a cheat meal during the week in the last few months when I discovered them lol! I do have to say though that their fried spring rolls are the best I’ve ever had ! That’s why I always go back. I had their Bahn mi too the other day and it was amazing ! I’m a big fan of Vietnamese food and this place is deffs my favourite place ! I always recommend these guys to friends and family and they never disappoint ! Nice seating outdoor and indoor. Always a nice place to go to tbh! Keep up the good work Team 🥰

2.5* not particularly flattering at all.. Ordered the most popular recommended bondi burger meal and was very underwhelmed with both taste and quantity for price @$19. Fries were the best thing. Would not order again in a hurry if at all

Excellent food. Perfect service and generally a relaxing and worthwhile experience. Come in and meet Dushal and Sarab, the most wonderful team who are committed in serving you to the best of their abilities even uptill the last minute of 8pm on a busy Thursday evening 🥰 these two don't back down from a smiley and welcoming service even in exhaustion. Definitely recommended to food lovers 😊 I'm a regular and will be for a very very long time 🫡

I would say that… the experience was extremely disappointing from start to finish. Shortly after eating, my stomach became upset — which is never a good sign and raises serious concerns about food hygiene. The portion sizes were shockingly small for the price, and the meal came out almost completely dry, with barely any sauce. When we politely asked for more sauce, we were told it would cost an additional \$2 — which felt like a slap in the face considering the already poor quality of the food. To make matters worse, the chicken was undercooked and lacked any flavour. It was rubbery in texture and clearly not prepared with care. Overall, the food was well below standard and left us feeling not only dissatisfied, but unwell. I would strongly advise others to avoid this place. Absolutely not going back.

This is the final report I submitted in Auckland, and it’s worth cherishing because the concept is excellent. It’s something essential for your burger shop. The location is great; you have a good shop where customers can grab fast food that is actually quite healthy. The staff are friendly, so keep up the good work! Sterling Arnet Kakapo Business Sales

I remember when these places were everywhere in Auckland, now there aren't many left. I have always liked the Bondi burger (with chilli of course) and enjoy the fries. This particular place is usually steady in customers, and pretty good in service.

Salad was pitiful. A tiny amount of lettuce and carrot. The server was difficult with the customer before me when all she asked for was to swap the rice for fries which it clearly says is an option. Meat and rice was good which is the only reason I didn't give less than 3 stars, but I would have expected more for the large size I ordered.
The salads weren’t even Turkish salads the meat was cut really small and we found a hair in our food would never come back here

Might as well call their kebabs salad wraps because thats mainly whats in them. Not fit to be called kebabs. Absolutely pathetic. Its a wonder they're still operating. Hope they get shut down soon and replaced with something better. I wish I could give you zero stars. Your restaurant is an insult to doner kebabs, you should be ashamed of what youre serving!

Had dinner here a month ago and the chicken on rice was delicious with excellent service. Went home satisfied and eager to return. We returned today and ordered 2 Kebabs because they ran out of rice with a side of chips. The server was on his phone on loud speaker while I was trying to order. The kebabs were soggy and salad inside was dissapointing pretty much just lettuce. Side of chips were disgusting super soggy that taste like it had been sitting pre cooked for ages. Extremely dissapointing considering how wonderful my first experience was. Whoever worked this shift around 4:30 5pm he has let this place down today.
What a waste of money. My kebab was cold and you can count the number of meat on it. Never again would give it a negative rating if possible

I was quite hesitant to order here after reading some of the reviews but l tried it anyway. Glad I did as the lamb kebab was pretty good & for $14 it's awesome value for money. The staff who served me was also very friendly and had great customer service. The adjacent building is currently under construction, theres no sitting area so only good for takeaways.

Against my better judgement I went there for lunch despite the already bad reviews. I was greeted by someone who clearly harboured a deep abiding passion for... well, whatever the polar opposite of actually making kebabs might be. The only thing drier than this person's welcome was the chicken and the rice I was served. The salad, to its credit, tasted fresher than the rest but not by much. An overloaded quantity of sauce was then deployed, possibly in an effort to cover the otherwise rather uninspired flavours beneath.

This place seriously needs to improve. Such a good location , can easily be the centre of a eye if only they did good customer service and improve quality of food. Lamb meat was cold and dry and seem to be cooked a day ago, heated and served. Luttuce soggy and stale old, salads full of white onions and barely corrots. Chicken is dry and tasteless Over priced wrap $17.50 charged extra for cheese and hummus. Staff training new team member was not incouraging and sounded rude. Seem like she herself was frustrated and didnt want to work there. She kept taking off the same gloves and putting them on for new orders. We have been coming here from a long time however from past few years the quality has detoriated.

One of the best kabab. Excellent customer service. Never seen like that kind of customer service in whole auckland . She makes very tasty kebab and very friendly customer service . Lady staff over there very friendly and generous towards customers. Very helpful staff i never seen in whole Auckland .

Wouldn’t recommend everything was slapped together, meat was dry then drenched in sauce! The chips were mashed. Tried adding salad to see if it’ll make a difference but yeah nah! Won’t be buying from there again😬

Went to Kreem cafe Manukau with a friend to celebrate her birthday - my coffee arrived in a badly chipped cup so I asked for a new cup which the server did but about 5 minutes later the same server bought out my lunch on a plate with two big chips! My lunch was a very small serving and the salad was limp and very uninspiring - definitely not value for money. I have been multiple times before and have never before experienced this - can only assume the cafe has changed hands. Very disappointing and it needs to be pointed out that chipped crockery is very unhygienic. Will not eat her again.

First time dining at Kareem Cafe with my colleagues, and it exceeded our expectations! The food was absolutely fantastic, and the prices were incredibly reasonable compared to other places. Plus, the menu had so many delicious options to choose from. We'll definitely be back – highly recommend!

For a packed place the food is average at best the burger was a couple of processed patties with way to much sauce, I don't get the carrots on the burger. Big breakfast was OK. Coffee wasn't nice either quite bland

I recently visited Kreem Cafe in manukau, and while the food was okay and the location had a nice spot to sit, the service needs some attention. Our server was good, but the order taker seemed distracted, focusing more on other things than attending to customers. With a bit more focus on customer service, Kreem Cafe could elevate their overall experience.

Except the Thursday cooker omg fish batter was rubbery i was not happy and left a lil disappointed i wont be stopping in on Thursday. They also just placed the pickled onion on top of salad no effort. I do recommend putting prices on their menu board because whos to know what they charging. The prawn noodle is delicious. Small size just $9

I ordered the teriyaki chicken on rice and this is what I got. The rice was inedible as you can see in the photo, it was very clumpy and sticky. And the amount of chicken I got was 1/4 of what I usually get. It was as if they were the leftovers from someone’s meal. I normally share this with someone else and will be full but was still starving afterwards.

The workers here are super friendly and kind and the food here is super value for money. The Chicken Katsu Donburi is super tasty and is filled to the brim with crunchy and juicy chicken. Overall it’s a lovely place to go and is a must try when you’re in the area .☺️
We love their chicken katsu bowls and with chips always fresh and tasty! Sushi is affordable. Great staff and always accomodating to our preferences. Love supporting this favourite local 👌🏾

Had my first Mr Katsu from Manukau. I bought the Katsu bowl for $13 and a 6 pack of small salmon sushi for $6.99. Portion size for the katsu bowl was great, lots of chicken and plenty of sauce and mayo. It tasted amazing, nothing fancy to it just rice, slaw, chicken and their sauce. The salmon sushi was fresh and delicious. Can’t knock it, although parking was pretty bad outside.

Only found this place a month ago but loved it ever since! Cute little store tucked away "hidden gem" if you will. The food is always packed to the brim no matter what you get, great value for price, great taste for price... $1 sushi, $13 Large bowls of food who are we kidding in this acconomy 🫶 customer service is great! Will be my forever go to for sushi and reccommendation to others

We recently stopped by this café for brunch and overall had a pleasant experience. We ordered the Eggs Benedict ($25) and the Spinach Hunter ($26). Both dishes were fresh, well-prepared, and nicely presented. The poached eggs were spot on, and the hollandaise was smooth and flavorful. The Spinach Hunter had a great mix of sautéed vegetables and eggs that felt hearty yet light. While the quality of the food was definitely there, the portion sizes didn’t quite live up to the price. For meals in the $25–$26 range, we expected slightly more generous servings or something extra to make it feel like good value. The same goes for the coffee—although it was smooth and enjoyable, it was over $6 for a medium, which felt a bit steep. What really made the visit enjoyable was the setting. The café has a lovely, modern atmosphere with a sunny seating area that’s perfect for a relaxed brunch. There’s also ample parking right outside, which made getting in and out super easy. Overall, it’s a charming spot with great ambiance and fresh food, but the pricing could be better balanced with the portions
The avocado smash and the bacon and egg slice was very good. The food was very fresh and full of flavor. The coffee was really good as well and the wait wasn't very long. Will definitely go back!

It’s a tiny drive into the cafe. Drive slow you can zip right past it. Delicious Altura coffee. Lots of food options both in the cabinet and on the board. About 5 or 6 tables outside great on a sunny day. If there’s any left when you get there try the cheese scone !!!

Outstanding coffee, food and service today at the Artisan in Wiri. Loads of parking outside makes it the perfect place for a work meeting or business lunch, had to grab a quick savory to take away with me as well. Highly recommend to all. James Ashwin Kakapo Business Sales

Bulgogi Double Cheese Burger This mouth-watering burger features two smashed beef patties marinated in Bulgogi sauce, topped with cheddar, onions, and butter garlic mushrooms, all in a golden bun. A must-try for Beef Burger Lovers! Southern Crunch Burger Southern fried chicken, crunchy gherkins, coleslaw, and special white sauce come together in a soft golden bun, offering a perfectly balanced and delicious experience. For the Chicken Lovers! Loaded Beef Bulgogi Fries Crisp fries topped with tender beef topped with cheese, Bulgoli Sauce and jalapeños create a harmonious blend of flavours and textures. A winner side dish! Conclusion Ziggle delivered a lunch experience that hit the spot for sure. We will definitely return.

I have never tasted wonderful chicken before! Their fries are amazing! And the burger tastes like it came from burger king itself! I would say the service was a little slow since almost no one would go there, which is understandable. But I totally recommend!!

We tried the bulgogi loaded fries & the bulgogi double smash burger! I think this may have been the best smash burger we’ve ever tried!! Honestly so good, the wait time was less than 10 mins and it was just delicious. Cannot wait to go again 😋

Denny’s Manukau – The Go-To Spot After a Night Out 🍔🍟🍝🍨 If you’re looking for a solid feed after a big night or nursing a hangover, Denny’s Manukau hits the spot! We ordered a bit of everything – Sirloin Steak with salad & fries, Fettuccine Carbonara with a side of garlic bread & salad, Coconut Prawns, Buffalo Wings, Premium Burger with fries, Tuna Melt, the Salmon Denny’s Benny, and a mini plate of cooked mushrooms on the side. And of course, we couldn’t skip the jug of Raspberry to wash it all down! The portions were decent and the food came out fast – just what you want when you’re tired, hungry, or craving comfort food. It’s nothing overly fancy, but everything tasted good and hit the spot, especially for a late-night or post-party feed. Dessert was the cherry on top – we got the Chocolate Hot Fudge Churros Sundae, Hot Fudge Cake, Banana Split, and a single Sundae. Sweet, rich, and perfect for sharing (or not 😅). Denny’s Manukau is definitely that trusty, go-to place when you need something filling, familiar, and open. Whether you’re wrapping up a night out or just need a hearty feed, this is a reliable option that’ll sort you out. 👍

My sister and I did ask to move to a brighter table as the lighting was a bit dim for my elderly mum to read the menu, and they were more than happy to help. Thank you for a great evening.

If you’re in Flat Bush and looking for real, flavourful Indian food that hits the spot, this small family-run restaurant is worth a visit. It’s a humble place — just a few tables and a simple setup — but it’s clear from the moment you walk in that this place is all about the food. We ordered two classics: butter chicken and shahi paneer, along with fresh naan. The butter chicken was creamy and comforting, with just the right mix of sweetness and mild spice. The chicken itself was soft and cooked perfectly. The shahi paneer was equally delicious — rich, smooth, and full of flavour, with tender paneer cubes that soaked up the gravy beautifully. The owners are Punjabi, and you can taste that North Indian home-style influence in every bite. There’s a depth to the spices and a balance to the flavours that you don’t always find in bigger, flashier places. You can tell they cook with experience — and pride. The portion sizes were decent — not massive, but definitely enough to satisfy — and the prices were fair, especially for Auckland. It’s great value for money considering the quality. One thing that stood out was how busy it was. While we sat in, there was a non-stop flow of Uber Eats and takeaway orders. The kitchen was buzzing, and the phone didn’t stop ringing. Clearly, this place is a local favourite. If you plan to dine in, it’s worth calling ahead or showing up outside peak times — it fills up quickly. Parking can also be a bit of a mission, since it’s located in a busy block with lots of shops and shared parking. It might take a few laps to find a spot during dinner time, so give yourself a little extra time. Service was quick and friendly, even with how hectic it was. The food came out hot and fresh, and the staff were warm and welcoming — just like you’d expect at a good, family-run Indian joint. All in all, this is one of those hidden gems that locals know and love. It’s not fancy, but it’s reliable, authentic, and packed with flavour. If you’re after solid Indian food — especially North Indian/Punjabi style — this little spot in Flat Bush is definitely worth a try. Authentic Punjabi flavour, fair prices, and a busy, welcoming vibe. We’ll be back — maybe for takeaway next time!

Chicken korma was outstanding. Given the high quality of the food and the generous portions, Punjabi Kitchen offers excellent value for money. Super thrilled I can get them delivered to my work through UBER EATS. Please JESTERS still waiting to see when you bring out the Rhubarb & Custard 🥧🥧💗💗💗💗

The spud deluxe was undercooked and genuinely had like barely any filling. The other one was super plain tasting and they both fell apart when trying to eat them. On top of that when I walked in the lady was in the middle of making some pies and was using her bare hands without any gloves. Then obviously was touching the EFTPOS machine etc and straight back to the pies. It was quite off putting. Definitely will not be returning.

I used to come here all the time for my pie cravings before work. However recently I’ve come back and the pies tend to burst 2 bites in and make a mess everywhere as the top pastry isn’t laid onto the bottom well enough.

Bought the 3pc quarter pack and replaced the regular chicken with Hot & Spicy ($1.20 extra to swap)... got 2 wicked wings and the H&S two wing piece instead, so four wings pretty much. How do you mistake 2 big pieces of H&S chicken with two small wicked wings?!? Honestly gobsmacked as to how you mistake the Wicked Wings for H&S, was a letdown to see when I opened the box for dinner after work. Food was still great tho, so props to the cook but still... i wanted my big H&S not 4 wings.

Dear KFC Manukau, This is 3rd time so no other choice then putting a review. 1. Last year so i can't remember the date but when i complaint about the quality of chicken on counter after a argument it was replaced. 2. Last week I order one lunch snack with spicey chicken paying extra but ending up with regular but I did not bother. 3. Today again same order and found the best burger in the world with lots of sauce and lettuce. I'm sure KFC did not run out of lettuce and sauce.
Bought two tower burger got home one burger two pieces of chicken other one only one piece of chicken try to phone no answer not happy at all

I ordered a 20pcs wicked wings, large gravy and a 1.5l coke but the coke didn’t arrive. I want a refund for this one. It’s clearly indicated on the order that I ordered a coke but it didn’t arrived and when I’m trying to call them they’re not answering and just keeps ending the call.

This is now our new local KFC and it always hits we have only been here a handful of times but the food is always fresh and hot. Tonight after a day of work my family and I dined in and received amazing customer service from Andrew (5:20pm Friday 20th June) he was very nice and polite. Thank you ☺️

Tonight we ordered the regular Korean BBQ bowl, small bowl & smoothie combo (Greek meze bowl & Choco nana smoothie) which came w cheesy garlic pita. Over-all rating so-so Happy with portion size & smoothie however the Greek meze bowl was missing haloumi which I feel was the main component. lacking that element let the dish down big time 👎😞

I had an excellent experience at Pita Pit! The food was fresh, flavorful, and made just the way I like it. The ingredients were high quality, and everything was prepared quickly without sacrificing taste. What really stood out, though, was the outstanding customer service. Cemila went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect. She was friendly, professional, and genuinely welcoming. It’s rare to come across someone so attentive and enthusiastic—it made the whole visit even more enjoyable. Highly recommend this location, especially if Cemila working. I’ll definitely be coming back!

Been on the road for a while and craving healthy food. Pita Pit didn't let me down. Had a Ancient Grains and Feta salad served up by a very helpful young Indian guy (sorry don't remember your name). Delicious.
Regular size was actually small, and katsu chicken was oily and felt like eating masala. Definitely not recommended every other pita pit in city and in other places are perfect except this one.
They offer great food and friendly service. The chicken wrap is a must-try—tender, flavorful, and sizzling with every bite. Highly recommend!

Ordered Bbq chops via Uber eats and the chops were paper thin, dry and sparse. Terrible quality and ended up getting a refund. Sausage undercooked and the coleslaw was swimming in cheap mayo. Do not recommend at all. Menu photos totally deceiving. #Gag

Went here the first time. Ordered a nice seafood pizza. Asked if they have Tabasco, I was surprised, yes they have. Very nice, friendly and helpful staff. The pizza was very yummy and crispy, very enjoyable. Will come back for sure.

Hands down, the best pizza in town! The crust is perfectly crispy, and the toppings are always fresh and flavorful. I had the Rara Paneer , and it was amazing—loaded with just the right amount of cheese and a rich, savory sauce. Every bite was a delight! The service was friendly and fast, and the atmosphere made it the perfect spot for a relaxed meal. Definitely coming back for more!

I had a great experience at this place! The pizza was absolutely delicious — crispy crust, fresh toppings, and just the right amount of cheese. The staff were super friendly and made me feel welcome from the moment I walked in. I especially loved their chicken hot shot. The place was clean, the service was quick, and the prices were reasonable. Definitely my go-to pizza spot from now on!
Delicious pizza 🍕 I got the butter chicken and cranberry chicken. The bread is so soft and perfect. Customers need to be a little more patient.. the owners (I presume) are doing fantastic.

Not to be dramatic, but I've had such horrible experiences in other Subway branches in Manurewa and Manukau that I visited this one as a final chance before I swore off Subway forever. And then I found this gem. I go once a fortnight (payday treat!) and the service (quality and speed), the food quality, and environment are consistently on point. With the new renovations, it's an even brighter and more welcoming space. I tell my family to only go here if they feel like Subway

Quick and easy service. First time iv visited this store at this location and I wasn't disappointed at all. 💯💯 Served by SALIM. Packed my sub extremely well. The store was very clean and tidy. Highly recommend this store to others.

I am really thank full the girl who serve me at 10:30pm, i know its a closing time. I called at the store and I requested to her, can you please make footlong veggie petty. She really made for me on very sort notice i was really appreciated and thank full to her for being a very kind and for that effort what she did. She served me as normal customer as she might did for everyone's but some time your small effort (your very tiny step) make someones day special, Its my bad i didn’t know her name (to mention in this review) but I hope she got understand after reading this review. Thank you so much :)

Went in the other day and found out the store had recently been renovated, the store looks amazing, customer service was really good, the staff were smiling and accommodating to my dietary needs and we even had a good conversation! Walked out with a free cookie in celebration of the reopening of the store. Definitely recommend going here. This is my new favourite Subway!

I love me some subway. But maybe I shouldn’t be going to this one. It doesn’t take a lot to empty the bins. It might be difficult to scrub the tiles, but if you do it the tiles don’t look so filthy. I can’t fault the food.

The lady called Jessie that served me and Bento bowl was extremely rude. Starting of with yeah, what you want? then continue to cut me off while I was trying to explain my order. She even let an Uber guy cut in in the middle of my order. I had to stop him and said do you mind waiting? Im in the middle of explaining my order 🤷‍♂️ not sure why they allow that to happen, especially when a customer is always valued as important? Or at least that what I've always be taught. Very poor service in my opinion Food was also warm,not hot

So, breakfast at St Pierres and Bento Bowl in Manukau City. For a franchise mall eatery, it was ok. Food was not overcooked, and expected portions were exactly what the photos depicted. Service was polite and delivery time just under 7 minutes. Small attempt at an upsell, but not pushy. Limited seating as most customers are to go. Mall can be a noisy place during peak hours. Priced average for deluxe Bento. It fed 2 adults. Overall, it was a satisfactory experience.

We love St Pierre's Sushi and everywhere we went they always had a great variety on display. At 2pm this branch had almost nothing in display so my friend and I have ordered something to be made. We've been told to wait about 7 minutes so we were just in front of the shop waiting for the order to be ready. After 15 minutes we went and asked if its ready and they said that the order was ready long ago and waiting for us to pick it up. Well, we were just there and waiting foe them to let us know when it's ready. That was quite disappointing.

Oh. My. Gosh. The food here changed my life. I was so sick of eating burgers and chips and was craving some Asian food. This place hit the spot! We were reading the menu when we were approached by Alf (I think that was his name!) who offered us taste testers. He offered us crispy chicken and katsu chicken which were absolutely delicious. After what felt like a week deciding on a meal (all options were so very tempting!) we decided to order some rice paper rolls, udon noodles with extra noodles and the katsu chicken don. We.were.blown.away. How is this store not famous across the world?!?! The food was quick to come out and the portions were large. Alf walked over to the table and placed our food in front of us, going above and beyond. He was super approachable and had the best customer service. It’s not just this store, but all Sushi + Bento Bowl stores that we ordered from - they were super friendly, quick and were easy to talk to. We would know, after our meal we ate at Sushi + Bento Bowl at least every second day after this experience. I wish I was lying… We begged them to open a store in Australia, so we will see how things go. 🤞🏼 You can literally order anything off the menu and it would be a win-win situation. You won’t be disappointed. Thank you Sushi + Bento Bowl Manukau and Alf! We will see you when we return…unless you meet us in Australia first… Much love 🥰

Went over an hour before they close - they only had a few packs of sushi left to choose from. There’s a sign saying they will make it fresh if we ask - We asked. They rudely said no they aren’t making anything else for the rest of the day. The sushi we got tasted old and the salmon sushi tasted sour? Still had over an hour before they close and they started packing the chairs away so no where for people to sit and eat? Rude staff, poor service, yuck sushi.

I hated noodle canteen in Australia but for some reason i decided to give this one on thomas road (flatbush) a chance! I have only ever tried 1 dish (no20) chicken chow mee noodle… now 8 months later i am a regular! I am writing because this particular dish is TASTY!!!! I see bad reviews but wonder if they are actually talking about the same place.. i mean it looks like a fast food place, and THATS exactly what you get in regard to service! I am that guy, to watch the clock and the chief literally has my food ready faster than kfc,mc donalds… or even pizza hut a few steps down! But yea… nice and hot (not talking spice)! Rated low for atmosphere ONLY because i visit when it’s quiet! But HIGHLY recommend!

First time trying from this location since we moved. Ordered 6 meals 2 were curry laksa and had leaked out into bags . They tasted terrible.So watery think they forgot the coconut as there was no hint of it anywhere Tofu in it tasted weird. Honey soy chicken had an odd taste batter was undercooked. My local Noodle Canteen in New Lynn were 10/10 👌 Sad we cant get the same quality of food out this way. Definitely dont recommend only good thing was the friendly customer service over the phone. Disappointing Dinner and a total waste of money!

My son ordered uber eats for me and it was disgusting. I’ve never had bland wonton soup in all my life and to add insult to the wontons itself tasted off. Hopefully I don’t get sick or my partner as he is yet to eat the honey chicken noodles. Thank the heavens the pork buns were good but I’m guessing they don’t make them thereselves. Never again completely sticking to Manurewa Noodle Canteen. 🤬
Ordered 2x noodle dishes, and it was soupy and watery. Less veggies & meat mostly noodles, wont be coming back here again

Ordered a #4, #10 & #16. No flavour, very bland & was more a soup. We struggled to eat it because of how tasteless it was. This was supposed to be our dinner after a long work & school week but sadly no. Instead we had spaghetti on toast which was more enjoyable. I will not be returning.
Nice big fish burger, packed with ingredients. A bit difficult to eat but that’s just because the fish piece was so big!
Cutting corners, fish was cut in half long ways, unlike the other LJ’s i’ve visited (see my other photos), which made the Hoki invisible and tasted just like batter. Feel Worst LJ’s i’ve visited.

I ordered through Uber Eats the Snapper & Chips meal. I was sent Hoki & Chips, if you can even call it that. It was pieces of hoki the size of fish bites inside thick batter. Disgusting. This order cost me $32.00 to have it delivered. I don't mind paying the uber eats fees but to get a disguised meal is not on. Disgusting service LJ's Manukau 🤬🤬🤬 I'll be bringing it back to you tomorrow and I want a refund

Fish burger l had was pretty good & chips were nicely seasoned. Not really into fish burgers but this was definitely 10 times better than a fillet-o-fish from maccas. Staff were great, shop was a little busy but they managed to get food out promptly.

The New Zealander fish burger looked amazing in the pics so we ordered two large combos. The burger was delivered to our table and presented beautifully. The chips were nice and crunchy with lemon pepper seasoning, and it came with a 600 ml soft drink of your choosing. The fish had a delicious crumb on it which I loved and the bun bread was very fresh. It was delicious 😋 and costed approx $30 per combo upsized to large ($60 order) - bit pricey in my opinion. Side note: I would’ve given a 5 star rating but when my partner saw one of the men who was preparing the food, wipe his nose with his palm (nasty!!!), I was put off after that and was close to requesting a refund and leaving) but we didn't, so he called him out on it and the man said, "yes but i wiped with the side of my palm?" (cringey moment! So what? You do not use any part of your hand to wipe your nose when you are preparing or cooking food, that's 💯 unacceptable!!!) Bad enough noone there wears gloves. So People, please pay close attention to how food here is prepared and cooked, I'm sure if they've done it once, they've done it a thousand times, and we shouldn't have to tell someone to blow their nose or wash their hands and use hand sanitizer and put on gloves when you're preparing food, right!!! His colleague took over for him after that, and he went to operate the till even tho we saw no more customers enter the restaurant the whole time we were there. There was only a couple dining in besides us. Conclusion: Food ☆☆☆☆☆ Quality & Presentation ☆☆☆☆☆ Hygiene standards/practices ZERO-they have no standards Atmosphere ☆-basic/no frills Professionalism ZERO Customer Service ☆-At least someone was serving

Great customer service ordered 2 happy meals & a fillet o fish when I got home I realised there was only half a slice of cheese in my fillet o fish reading the current reviews on here is crazy is McDonald’s in Manukau on a tight budget smh.
Way too much sauce, and not sure what was going on with the patty???

Horrible, My partner got a deluxe cheeseburger meal and the burger had a literal piece of the mop they use on the floor stuffed inside his burger… he said it tasted like chemicals and was really tough to chew. he has been throwing up for 30 minutes now.

Error no paper for Receipt didnt work for self service kiosk so I used another self service kiosk order 96 flashed on screen no receipt again though , still got charged twice on visa. Slow for dine in customers, they prioritize drive thru or uber.

Staff we're very rude, all because i asked for no milk in my hot chocolate 😤 The lady was saying this will be the last time we ever do this. I was saying to her, how rude, then i told her this will be the last time i ever come here, cause it was my very 1st time in manukau mackas.

My first visit and I will definitely go again. I ordered the Honey Roast Chicken on Rice which was beautifully cooked with the chicken pieces melt in your mouth tender, not a crispy, chewy bit of gristle found. The rice was fried and the sauce had mixed through perfectly for my taste. Good size portion was still enough for dinner again tonight. 5/5 from me. I also tried the Cheezie Weezie. Great comfort food and I’m pretty sure it was made with Tartare Sauce so had a nice zing. No tomato sauce as standard A bit lacking in cheese and would have been better in a cardboard box as most of the cheese I saw seemed stuck to the paper and got binned. You definitely need a fork and napkins for this one. Not so sure it was worth the $10 but still hit the spot. 3.5/5 for that dish, I just wasn’t up to the messyness, even if that’s meant to be part of the charm/experience. Nice clean looking shop with a wide selection of dishes. Staff were pleasant and service was fast. Reasonable prices for a good amount of well made, tasty food prepared by someone else so I didn’t have to. Thanks Everglad.

Got steak burger snapper chips today All disappointing steak burger came with a meat pattie +some meat ,burger soggy once i got it home to eat didnt taste like steak, fish dry batter not cruchie chips not good wouldnt go back , this place used to be really good must have new owners all good things comes to a end. Indian food next door top notch great food value for money .
I’d suggest you check your bill closely had them try and overcharge me and even as I am showing Them their own menu prices they still having a hard time with it
Absolute rubbish don't waste your time just chuck your dollars in the bin. Food swimming in oil
Great food. Quick service but only got 2 scoops of chips for 12 dollars !

We have been here twice so far and we will definitely be coming back! Amazing food, friendly service and the atmosphere is romantic and comforting. We highly recommend the steak and the pear+halloumi dishes !!

Tried the breakfast buffet today $35 pp. All their selections are pretty decent. The items I especially liked were the mango sago, hash brown (runs out very quick) and their smoothies. Can't really go wrong with any choices and the latte that I ordered was pretty good too. Definitely recommend the breakfast buffet even if not staying at the hotel.

First time dining here for lunch today and I'm impressed. Food was delicious - kaarage chicken burger was juicy and huge, the pork belly was cooked to perfection and the potatoes was delicious. The service was attentive and very professional and the atmosphere and environment was clean and had a high class feel. I'll be back again some time soon

Good food but boy, don’t came here with a small birthday cake to celebrate a birthday - they won’t let you eat a piece… even though we had wines and dined, we were told that we couldn’t have the small (10cm) birthday cake that I bought for my boss for his birthday as it could contain “allergens” (ridiculous excuse as it was gluten free (funnily enough and store bought in a clear, small carton) and the restaurant serves products with gluten, eggs, lactose and fish … so not sure what other allergens would be in a cake and it was not even going to be sent to the kitchen or served to other diners 🙄 That put a dampener on the celebrations - couldn’t even bring us a fork for him to have mouthful.

This was my second time in Ora bistro through First Table booking. The food was excellent and we enjoyed it thoroughly. The staff were extremely friendly and brought out the dish quite quickly. We will definitely be back and try the other options on their menu.
I ordered a kg of pork belly and when I got home to check it, it was full of just the fatty part with no meat in the food. Unless you like pure fat and no meat, then DO NOT EAT HERE.
Coming here for years now and the food is consistently of great quality and tasty! Friendly owners too
Hong Kong original Chinese bbq duck and pork, great Chinese food . For Chinese takeaway you can't go wrong, if basic dinning in you need there are a few tables
I regretted it when I ordered and the staff was cleaning her teeth with their hands. The meat is cold, the rice is cold, and the dishes are cold. Meat is cooked below normal.

One of the best places for a hearty meal. Portions are big so you'll end up getting full on one plate (so try not to eat with your eyes unless you're a big eater lol) Service is fast, atmosphere is comfortable although very small. Still nice to sit in & eat.

My photo does no justice but this is the best fish n chips takeaway in South Auckland. The crinkle chips are my fav (you can request straight chips), they are cooked perfectly 👌🏽 the fish is always fresh & the batter is light & crispy. This pack was $9 for 1 fish, 4 potato fritters & $4 chips. The chicken nibbles are also top tier & their chicken burger ❤️

Grabbed the $16 special, hard and fast dinner happs lol Fish portion is huge! Greasy but man can’t complain..was good for size lol Chips, tasty and crunchy! Sausages: not bad at all ! If you’re in the area, try it!

Great local takeaway . Love their fish which is usual a good size portion and tastes great. They offer 3 sorts. Generous size portions, yummy chips . Always throws in an extra potatoes fritter . Large menu to cater for everyone.

We have had takeaways from here a few times. The quality is definitely inconsistent. Last night we got 2 packs mixed. We all felt unwell and our 3 yr old threw up. It's the only food we all ate the same. There were different fries in each pack and everything was overly greasy. The oil definitely needs changing as the food left a bad taste in your mouth .. we didn't eat all the food as it was such greasy crap! Not recommended.

It was good service and the food was lovely but the fish was real delious the best best fish i have ever had it is well worth geting your take aways from them i will now only go to diorellas take away to get my stuff

We ordered the lamb shanks and the t bone steak. The lamb shank was chewy and not pleasant to eat. The T bone steak was desired by my partner. Both meals were quantity-wise generous but lacked quality. We did get the meals in a timely manner - within 15-20 minutes. Facilities were clean and overall aesthetically pleasing. Location is prime also.

Graduation Dinner at Texas Smokehouse Manukau – Mixed Experience We came to celebrate a family friend’s graduation dinner. Originally, we had booked at Broncos Steakhouse, but due to a power outage, we had to make a last-minute change and ended up at Texas Smokehouse, which was just down the road. Our group ordered a variety of meals. I, along with two others, ordered the Chicken Pasta – it was creamy, but sadly lacked flavour and seasoning (not even salted!). My sister had the Beef Brisket Salad, which she said was just “alright.” We also ordered some shared plates for the table: • Salt & Pepper Squid: Not crispy at all, tasted bland and like it had been reheated. • Garlic Bread: Honestly my favourite! It was hot, fresh, and tasted like it had just come out of the oven – delicious. • Loaded Fries: Served piping hot and full of flavour – a solid choice. • Chicken Wings with Salad: Pretty average; nothing special, but edible. Customer service was friendly and helpful, which we appreciated, especially with our sudden change of venue. Would I come back? Hmm… maybe, maybe not. It was an okay experience overall – some hits, some misses.

Absolutely lovely. Rich smokey-flavor, exactly how we love them. Sticky yummy fun sauce, with the typical fall off the bone meat, ribs. Fries to boot. I had the oysters, half deep fried, half fresh xx That was my puku, ɓusted with pure Texan Smokehouse style. I'm running back asap 😋 Definitely one for the workmates xx Then again, kids dine free 🥰

Wasn't expecting much after reading the reviews but the food was actually really good. I had the beef short rib and it was tender and flavourful. Hubby had the Tomahawk which was cooked to his liking. Kids all enjoyed their meal. The staff were friendly and attentive. Couldn't really fault anything though I definitely went in prepared to haha.

When I booked, no one mentioned there would be a function happening in the main bar, which made things loud and disrupted the whole atmosphere. We were seated in a room next to the bar that was dirty and felt like an afterthought. The service was average, not rude, but not particularly friendly or attentive. The food was also just average and definitely not worth the high price tag. Overall, I left feeling really disappointed. For what they charge, you expect a decent meal and a better experience.
I got a pizza for pickup and the service was nice and on time. I ordered a small and it was enough for two people. The pizza was delicious!

DO NOT ORDER FOOD FROM HERE IF YOU VALUE HUMAN LIFE. I might've exaggerated but I ordered some lamb rogan josh which tasted pretty good until I woke up the next morning with a really bad sore stomach, and diarrhea. I thought it was just the spice until I reheated it for the second night, and it happened again but much worse. The reviews already have low stars so consider this review a nail-in-the-coffin. Don't spend your money here.

Very poor, ordered lamb Tikka masala and butter naan via Uber eats... Lamb Tikka masala was full of uncooked onion , meat was very chewy ( may be old), rice wasn't complementary ...butter naan was ok but has unpleasant tasting butter spread over it may be they used ghee instead. Only good part was food came hot, kudos goes to the driver. Food went straight to the bin, I will never order from this place, it ruined my taste altogether... Guys please avoid at any cost.

Asked for Indian Style Medium to Hot Butter Chicken. OMG. I think they put 3-4 spoon of Red Chilli Powder. Never had that spicy food ever. Called and complained. Chef said to be Indian Style butter chiken is like that. I was like. I had eat Butter Chiken in India all my life and never had that butter chiken. Took 2 days to get my stomach back to normal.

Ordered via Uber and man it was bad. The Garlic Naan and the Roti was in the same tinfoil wrapping. 80% of the lamb was bones. Uber also advertises that the "curry" I got came with rice but the special that I ordered did not.
Great price for the portion given. Chickens and chips were both fresh, chicken was very juicy. Very nice customer service. Basic, cannot go wrong.
Great food and experience. Customer service was lovely. Food was cooked when ordered meaning optimal freshness. Chicken was very tasty and it was good value for money. Thank you very much!
Yum fresh chicken. Friendly kind staff and fast service!
Ordered through doordash. Food got here quick and chicken and potato gravy was still hot! Nice and fresh chicken and chips. Overall great service, delicious food and very good price 😀 👍
Great chips and chicken for value. Staff are also very respectable and generous. That alone will make me come back.

Despite the neighborhood resembling anything but Gangnam in Seoul I enjoyed eating here. You won’t leave hungry that’s for sure. Really enjoyed the thin cut lamb shoulder, and the East Asian adjacent Japanese beers.

Good food and service were good. Customer service was attentive and organized. Waiting staff keep food top up and service areas were clean and tidy. Choices of cooked and raw food were also good. Space wise did feel tight and overwhelming when very busy with customers. Parking plentiful overall very good

Very good meat options and the fried chicken tasted amazing!! Very fresh and juicy. The staff were very on to it and always had the food refilled! I found that other places I had been were very slacked in this area. I liked the different ranges of sauce that they offered also. I didn’t have dessert but it is very limited and it didn’t have my mouth watering at the sight. The service was very welcoming and friendly. For the atmosphere I’d say it could be better the floors felt slippery and the cutlery were not polished or cleaned properly so I just ate with my hands but that was alright, the plates were clean and so were the food areas. The bathroom was also reasonably clean too which was great! Overall the experience was good considering how cheap it is! But there’s areas that need improvement. Thank you!

Heaps of option to choose from but I wanted prawns but there was none so decided to eat all the food I got first. When I finished I wanted someone to change the oil paper on the grill which I’ve already used twice but I literally couldn’t find any one available. I was pretty full so I just left. The price was $38 since today was a public holiday day. I definitely didn’t eat worth the price but I saw other people did. The place is quite bustling with little staff.Hope you get more hands soon.

This is my local Korean BBQ. Never had an issues here and always leave satisfied. A lot of food options (including taro with cream) and when we go they are cycling food out steadily so there haven’t been long wait times, if ever. Service is exceptional, always friendly and attentive, which keeps us coming back. Thank you!

It was one of the finest restaurants i have found after a long time. Authentic Rajasthani food served here. This is a 100% vegetarian restaurant. The taste of the food was very particular, price wise, and reasonable with respect to the environment and service they provide. The quantity of the food is really good. Must try this place with your friends and family. The staff is very respectful and friendly. Try their rajasthani thali. They do serve snacks and sweets aswell.

Amazing food and amazing service !!! By far the best chole bature I’ve eaten in Auckland and the masala dosa was sooo delicious too! We got a complimentary jalebi, and I don’t usually have more than a bite of jalebi- but I finished the entire thing!! Thank you so much. This is def a place to try can’t wait for our next meal to try all the items on the menu. Thank you :)

First time to dine in and The food was delicious! I loved the samosa chaat and manchurian. Packed with flavor. The chef (i assumed) came out and asked everyone hows the food, that kind of customer service explained their good reviews. Recommended💯

Tried indian restaurant after so long. Food is nice. Tried south and north food. South Indian food lacking character, can't say what exactly is missing. North Indian items were good. All food item were nicely presented. Staff were amazing, engaging with customers, which not usually happens. Overall great experience. Would definitely visit again.

Love the vibe, best dosa in the town ❣️ trust me I never ever had this much crisp dosa. it taste so good 😊 must visit and the Sahi panner tastes exactly Sahi panner . Food quality level is high. The give us complimentary tea 🫶🏼 . Pure rajsathni vibe
Superb. Succulent food and delightful service. Funny little place but a great place to eat. A real surprise- thanks for a great dinner!

Robbers Burger in Manukau has become my go-to spot for a consistently great meal. Every time I visit, the quality of the food is top-notch and reliably delicious, which is something I really appreciate. The staff are always friendly and welcoming, making the experience even better. It’s clear they take pride in what they do, and that positive energy shows in both the service and the food. My personal favourite is the Prime Chicken with Cheese – it’s always cooked perfectly, packed with flavour, and incredibly satisfying. If you haven’t tried it yet, you’re missing out! Whether you're a regular or visiting for the first time, Robbers Burger delivers both quality and great vibes every time.

Just a really really good chicken burger They grill fresh tenderloins - nothing is pre cooked, the bun is also toasted on the grill Just executed and cooked really well, simple flavours but so yum. Juicy and fresh, have been 3x and it's consistently Good.

I went in today & sandy + his lovely wife was so welcoming when I walked in. The food reflected their lovely hospitality. I had their prime beef burger & wow, it was delicious! I would definitely recommend this fast food again & AGAIN. Thank you Sandy 🤍

Robbers Burgers never disappoints! Juicy, flavour-packed patties with fresh toppings and perfectly toasted buns. Great value, fast service, and an overall top-notch burger joint. Definitely a go-to spot!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Jeepney Filipino Restaurant is an absolute gem in Manukau City! As someone who loves exploring authentic Filipino cuisine, this place exceeded my expectations. The ambiance is warm and welcoming, with a nostalgic vibe that reminds me of the traditional jeepneys in the Philippines. The staff are friendly and attentive, making the dining experience even more enjoyable. Now, let’s talk about the food—because it’s the star of the show! Here’s what I ordered and my thoughts on each dish: Fish Escabeche : The fish was cooked to perfection—crispy on the outside and tender on the inside. The sweet and tangy sauce with bell peppers and onions complemented the dish beautifully. It’s a must-try for anyone who loves seafood! Filipino Spaghetti : This was a delightful twist on the classic spaghetti. The sweet-style sauce with hotdog slices and grated cheese was rich and flavorful. It’s a comforting dish that both kids and adults will love. Sizzling Sisig : This dish was a flavor explosion! The sizzling plate brought out the smoky aroma of the chopped pork, which was perfectly seasoned with lemon, chili, and onions. The crispy edges and creamy texture from the egg made it irresistible. Jeepney Fried Chicken : Crispy, juicy, and packed with flavor! The chicken was marinated well and fried to golden perfection. It’s simple yet so satisfying, especially when paired with their garlic rice. Sio Mai : These Filipino-style steamed pork and shrimp dumplings were a great starter. The filling was savory and well-seasoned, and the wrapper had the perfect texture. Dipped in soy sauce and lemon, they were a delicious bite-sized treat. One of the highlights of the meal was the Halo-Halo, a traditional Filipino dessert. This refreshing treat combines shaved ice with a mix of sweetened fruits, jellies, and beans, topped with leche flan and ube ice cream. It’s a delightful way to end a meal, providing a symphony of textures and flavors that dance on the palate. Overall, Jeepney Filipino Restaurant is a must-visit for anyone craving authentic Filipino flavors in Auckland. The food is hearty, flavorful, and made with love. I can’t wait to come back and try more dishes from their menu. Highly recommended! 🇵🇭✨

Had a superb experience here during our stay in Ramada! The ambiance was welcoming, with modern decor and great layout. The service was exceptional, thanks to the manager who personally ensured our dining experience was flawless. Highly recommended for anyone looking to enjoy a memorable meal! 😋 Plus, the music is awesome too!

Stopped by Uncle Man’s in Manukau for lunch and decided to mix things up by ordering a variety of sides to share instead of individual meals. It was a great choice—we got to sample four different dishes, and here’s how they stacked up: - Chicken Dumplings – 10/10 Absolutely fantastic! Juicy, flavourful, and pan-fried to perfection, served with a delicious chili oil. A must-try. - Chicken Satay – 9/10 Tender, beautifully cooked skewered chicken paired with a rich, flavourful peanut sauce. Nearly perfect! - Mix of Veg & Chicken Curry Puffs – 7/10 Tasty filling, but the pastry was a bit dry. A dipping sauce would have made all the difference. - Bergadil – 5/10 These deep-fried mashed potato and chicken patties didn’t quite hit the mark for us. The texture was different—almost soggy—and the chicken flavour was a bit too chicken-y. Probably wouldn’t order again. - Teh Tarik – 10/10 This sweet milk tea was simply amazing—smooth, creamy, and incredibly satisfying. A definite highlight! Overall, it was a delicious and enjoyable lunch, and I can’t wait to return to try even more from their menu!

Good service have lots of options for vegetrian either smashes is too good. Good option in Celevdon

Totally delicious food by local Super chef, we are in the hospitality industry and for sure this chef and Owner really knows about flavour and deliciousness. A real touch of Kiwi, the real New Zealand come on down
An unexpected find and a proper hidden gem in Piha! Great staff and vibes all around, the flavours of the food will definitely make sure we stop by again!

Fresh Flavours at the Piha Bowling Club! Since reopening, the talented new chef Dhruv has been delighting members and guests with his delicious meals with options for smaller and larger plates. He’s been taking on board your feedback and refining the menu with a fresh, flavourful approach that’s already making waves. It’s such a treat to have new energy in the kitchen – always served up with a smile! Come down and taste what’s cooking – you won’t be disappointed!

It is a perfect refuge on the rainy day, Warm and peaceful place next to the beach. Local people sitting cusually with music from 80s'. The restraunt is a bit hidden in the Piha bowling club, not along the main road. The roasted fish is fresh with smoky flavour, chick drums very crispy, I usually don't like too salty and fried food like this but it match the weather so much! The highlight is the cheesecake, so rich and creamy! The sugar and the cheese just balanced perfectly, not too sweet at all. My vegan friend also enjoyed her kumara and risotto. Great kai / food. The menu is concise but everyone was happy with the choices. The tomato salad (the last of the heritage tomatoes) had a wonderful gazpacho type sauce poured over it - totally delicious. And the aged Kingfish crudo was fun and tasty - with its black cuttlefish cracker and pickled radish. Aged steak, half organic chicken, salt baked kūmara main with wonderful sides of crunchy beef dripping fried potatoes with kawakawa and roast zucchini with crunchy buckwheat. Two desserts - caramelised white chocolate with caramel foam and berry sorbet, and a pretty macadamia semi-freddo with a pretty biscuit, sorbet and crunchy bits. Lovely focaccia at the start with a chicken lollypop snack and an aged masterstock broth.

I came for dinner with my partner and we had one of the best dining experiences in our life. The food was absolutely delicious and flavors were very thoughtfully put together. Fine dining sometimes can come with very small portion sizes, but we left being fully happy and satisfied. The services was so friendly and welcoming. We would come any time again for a special dinner.

My husband and I ate here for our first night in New Zealand. We had the Wednesday night’s Trust the Chef menu. All of the courses complemented each other, service was wonderful and the atmosphere was perfect on a warm summer evening. The cocktails were made with fresh pressed juices. It was obvious how much time and care went into the preparation of each element of each dish.

Exquisite food and service. A complimentary beef broth to die for with dipping bread. My fiancé booked our engagement party here under the festoon lights and the staff were so personable, they felt like one of the whanau. The slow roasted soup is heavenly here and we loved the giant carving knives. Thank you so much for the wine bottle gift on our departure! Very special.

I’m evaluating this restaurant on my personal “fine dining” scale. I would have given them a 5, but for a restaurant of this quality, they slipped up on service. We were a party of 3 for lunch. Be advised that the à la carte menu is extremely limited. One of us ordered a steak (300 g), while the others ordered the “Chef’s Surprise” 3-course meal. The server who took our order asked us to wait while she check with the chef if that was okay, because “normally” the entire table had to order the 3-course menu together—but we were granted permission to proceed. This is a totally unnecessary intrusion into the dining experience: this should be determined by the staff in advance amongst themselves, and the guests not bothered. If this is the rule (which I do not recommend), the table should be informed up front. The second, and more egregious, service problem arose when our main courses were delivered. The person who ordered the 300 g steak was served a 150 g steak, so we asked for what was ordered. The server removed that steak and left that person sitting with only her side order of fries, while the rest of us still had our mains. The correct procedure in this instance would have been to at least offer to take all the food back to be kept warm while the missing steak was prepared, given us an intermezzo for service recovery, and then brought everyone’s (correct) mains back together. The meal was unpleasantly disrupted. I have two minor quibbles with the food (5 stars): firstly, it’s no “Chef’s Surprise” if all three items are directly from the à la carte menu; secondly, all three courses had a crunchy component, which made that element seem a little forced.

We waited over 35mins for our food and then the chips were so oily we didn’t eat them. The young guy serving was arrogant.

We’d previously avoided Laingholm takeaways since moving here a few years ago because the few instances we tried it was expensive, young and inexperienced staff and the food being overwhelmingly disappointing. This was our first time trying since the new owners and I’m guessing they’ve listened to their reviews. We ordered 1x Smokey bbq burger, 1x spicy chicken, $5 chips & 2x crab sticks. It came to $32 and was ready within 15 minutes. We’ve tried all the burger places in the area and this one will now be our go to. The Smokey bbq burger tasted like it was actually done on the grill to get that Smokey flavour, good amount of bacon and the condiments complimented the burger (not overpowering). Both burgers were fresh like a homemade burger and the chips, could have been more (like the good old days) but they were salted nicely with the right amount of crunch. I’d definitely recommend checking these guys out again. Staff was really quick and pleasant too.

This is hands down THE GREATEST fish and chips I have ever experienced! ✨ Foodie Review: Indian Express – Māngere’s Hidden Gem! ✨ Went here on a lunch date and wow – what a stunning little spot! As soon as we stepped inside, we were greeted by a beautiful and cozy atmosphere that set the mood just right. Indian Express is a true hidden gem tucked away in Māngere – and the food? Absolutely delicious! We ordered a feast, and every single bite was packed with flavour. The Chicken Korma with rice was rich and creamy, the Prawn Masala had the perfect spice kick, and the braised chicken with cashew nuts was a standout – so tender and full of flavour. We also had garlic naan bread (so soft and garlicky!), beef spring rolls, crispy fries with tomato sauce, and another side dish that we didn’t catch the name of – but loved every bite of it! To wash it all down: two Heinekens, a refreshing mango lassi, and ginger beer – the perfect combo to balance out the spice and richness of the food. Everything was served hot and fresh, and the portions were generous. Honestly, every dish we tried was a winner. The flavours, the presentation, and the atmosphere made this one unforgettable lunch. Highly recommend this spot if you’re in South Auckland and craving authentic Indian flavours. We’ll definitely be back! 😋

Okay I didn't take any photos cause I was so into it but when I tell you this is the best hangi I've ever had in the 5 years of living in Auckland 👏🏼👏🏼👏🏼 seriously the stuffing the pork the chicken the veges alll on point 😩😩😩😩😩😩😩😩 I'm so satisfied with the kai I had and hangi buckets omg how convenient ?
