Chicken nibbles are awesome.. Great crispy yet not oily batter.. Got a platter plate of sweet and sour what I thought was pork but it was chicken.. Had a weird after taste in the sauce so after a few pieces no one ate it.. Fu young was very nice as was rice and noodles.. Over all good portion size for the money and will go again but defiantly no sweet and sour
Asked for no peas on chicken fried rice and it came loaded with them... Chicken was verrrry chewy to the point of disgusting.... Wouldn't recommend at all

I tried their chicken nibble packs and they were delicious, but the chips are mediocre, soft and not crispy, and a very small portion of it. The chicken chow mein in its plastic casing appeared to be a large portion but upon inspecting the dish, it was 90% cauliflower, a couple of diced chicken pieces, onion, carrots and broccoli, was disappointed, wasn't worth the $15.
Birthday Girl was surprised with breakfast. Gladly % STARS A buffet of freshly cooked options which the owners will overfill your containers of your choice for you to enjoy. Gladly 5 STARS
Good food good prices great for a quick dinner or lunch. Very freindly staff and one of the best takeaways in the Mangere area.

The staff here are very friendly and provide great service. I bought chicken wings from this place. Although I waited for around 15 minutes, it was worth it because the wings were freshly fried. The just-out-of-the-fryer chicken was incredibly juicy and had an excellent texture. However, one area for improvement is the flavor — the seasoning didn’t quite penetrate the meat, possibly due to a short marinating time or mild marinade. Overall, it was a great food experience. I’ll definitely come back again and hope the wings will be even better next time.

I recently visited Chicking and had a great experience. The food was fresh, flavorful, and served hot. I especially enjoyed the broasted chicken—it was crispy on the outside, juicy on the inside, and seasoned just right. The menu has a nice variety, including rice meals, wraps, and sides like fries and coleslaw. The service was friendly and fairly quick, even during busy hours. The restaurant was clean and well-maintained, with a comfortable seating area.

Excellent place with amazing food. The taste was absolutely awesome. The service was outstanding, especially from Mr Nikhil who was incredibly polite, attentive and genuinely welcoming. His friendly attitude and professionalism truly enhanced our experience. I highly recommend Chicking Mangere to everyone. It is a must visit spot.
One of the best experience that we had recently. The lady in front farin done a great job got the food fast and fresh. Special thanks to Alfred as well.

I recently visited this store , and it was fantastic! The aroma of freshly cooked chicken was irresistible, and the warm atmosphere made for a perfect dining experience. I tried the spicy chicken, which was crispy, juicy, and packed with flavor. The sides and sauces complemented the meal perfectly. The staff was friendly and attentive, making the visit even more enjoyable. If you love chicken, this place is a must-visit. Highly recommended!

One word: BEAUTY! We ordered x2 Poly Bins for my mother’s birthday event. It was delivered hot, fresh & smelled delicious. And to top it off it definitely was delicious. Super satisfied with what we received. And there was plenty more left over. Definitely recommend.

Tidy little takeaway with good customer service and great quality chinese food. Chips are a highlight for me, they are perfectly cooked and salted and the steak fried rice tastes good too. Burgers are ok, gotta eat them before the bun goes soggy from the sauces! Recommended!
Nothing flash but easy to get to fast services and fresh hot food. Batter is a bit thick.

Rude customer service and the food, such as the potato fritters and the fish looked and tasted like reheated food from the day before, the chips and sausages were the only freshly cooked food, they use to be good, looks got lazy or they got a new cook.

I came here once for hot chips , first time I had it I was shocked at how crisp and crunchy yet soft inside. I thought maybe lucky timing. I now go back non stop for chips cause they are still the same crunchy with the best amount of salt. They are definitely the BEST chips I've tasted and if you don't believe me, try for yourself .

I'm from out of town, was passing through Mangere, spotted the takeaway and stopped to get a feed for the family. First, was very impressed at how clean the store was. Ordered a usual amount of food that we get from the takeaway back home, around $30. Oriental's prices were about the same as back home. But the amount of food they gave me was enormous. About twice as many chips as I was expecting! And they were good chips too. Very generous portion sizes.

Great service and great food. Got the guy at a time they were busy but that did not make any difference to the great service and food they have. Thank you guys! We will be back again. Highly recommend to anyone who enjoys a good kebab.

Brought kebab on uber eats . came soggy , dry meat , my food was already pre mixed . stingy on veges . sauce taste foul and old . never buying here again . thanks for wasting my $38.90 on your disgusting food
I love the service and food. Had an amazing experience. I would recommend that you should visit once .
Best quality food and service was awesome highly recommended for good quality food👍👍👍
The food here was so good also everything was fresh the service was excellent i definitely recommend👌
Chicken Summer rolls It is delicious with its unique sauce. Very appetizing, The chicken wings are crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, very tasty

The food was awful. I had the chicken nibbles, which was dry chicken coated in thick batter and cooked in a horrible tasting oil. The fish was also disgusting you could tell it was not fresh. Also cooked in the same gross tasting oil. But the worst offender was the roast pork was over cooked and so dry that I had to throw it out. Sorry not going back ever.

Fried Rice was so dry - not fresh. Asked for new rice which they made but they mixed the old rice with new rice, noodles were too oily. Sweet and sour and Chow mein was Alright. The Shop is Clean and tidy - customer service was great.

HORRIBLE QUALITY! I ordered the roast pork on rice and these guys need tips from sun tasty down the road from there because their roast pork was so over cooked dry and tasteless! The chicken nibbles was so over battered it was disgusting never buying from here again.
I got the lemon grass chicken on rice. The lemon grass chicken is nice,crispy and tender, the rice is fresh and moist. The pricing is good. Would reccomend

Best chicken and chips in Mangere town center.... Travelled from The awamutu 22/11/24 just to relive having the best chicken and chips from when living in south Auckland... My son said the best he's ever had ...cooked and flavor wise .... And still great 👍 service Thank you ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐
Best chicken & chips in Mangere & south auckland , awesome customer service and always happy with amazing Manners but the food here is 100% worth every money

I love this place ! I go at least 3 times a week. The atmosphere is so cool traditional Japanese style! My favorite is the portions but mostly if you love 1. SALMON 2. Crunchy juice chicken and 3. crème brûlée then you just have to try their surf and turf Salty sweet "caramel sushi" it's salmon and mayo with toasted sugar on top filled with moist crunchy chicken katsu avocado lettuce cucumber capsicum sushi THE BEST IVE EVER TASTED...They even sometimes have real crab leg sushi, raw tuna options. Their seafood bowls are massive too and I love their miso! When I have time I always love dining in.

I bought a Katsu Donburi and 6 pieces of sushi, and it was sooo good, amazing food quantity, the size of sushi was so big and the donburi was bussin and it only cost me less than 25 bucks. I recommend this place, its cheap, friendly and delicious. Staff was so kind aswell, much love to the people working there.
Best Sushi place in Mangere. So cheap and Food is in big portions. Chicken Teriyaki and Chicken and Chips is BEST. 👌

I paid $12 for 8 piece salmon and Avo and same price for 2 piece Eel Nigiri + 4 piece salmon Nigiri with mayo and seared. Also had the chicken Don katsu. Rice was overcooked/mushy and really bland which ruined the overall taste of the sushi and the katsu bowl. I tried seasoning with soy and even salt but it just wasn't quite right. Other ingredients were fresh and lots of salmon in the rolls but the Katsu bowl had very little apart from rice and chicken and chicken was really dry. Cool Japanese themed location and Really friendly service too although a little pushy. Not bad for Mangere town centre but would I go again, probably not 🤷🏽.

ngl this place is insane for a sushi shop, probably the best out of all sushi places in Mangere. The artwork and decorations make it feel like im in Japan as soon as I step foot, best overall atmosphere and food portions, I recommend the dragon roll, the things bigger than my whole hand. Must try if you're in Mangere mall

Go to place for pizza, always delicious every time. I recommend the bbq chicken & butter chicken pizza, usually would take 15mins. They do kebabs, burgers, chicken n chips & ice cream which are all so good but I’d prefer pizza rather than other big pizza joints. Friendly people and great customer service!

The food is magnificent, I highly recommend their chicken meals, very delicious, delight and always fresh as they cook it right when you order it, I also recommend their ice creams especially passion fruit if you want strong flavours and mango if you want a balanced out flavour and ice “cream”

Completely abysmal service. I've never felt the need to review a food joint before, but these guys screwed me over. I do not eat mayonnaise for ethical reasons, or at least hadn't for 6 years until yesterday (3rd June) at 3pm. I asked for BBQ, mint and sweet chilli sauce in my falafel kebab, and the only sauce that I received was mayonnaise. I had to throw it in a rubbish bin after taking a few bites and seeing/tasting the mayo. Whoever made that kebab should not be working there.
Really good biryani I've been eating here since last year and still taste the same

I had an amazing experience at this restaurant! From the moment I walked in, the staff was incredibly warm and welcoming, making me feel right at home. 😊 The service was quick and friendly, and the food was absolutely spot on! 🔥 I ordered the Chicken Curry Combo, which came with rice, naan, and a drink, and every bite was packed with flavor. 🤤and the fried rice I ordered on the side was just as delicious! 🍛👌 Everything was cooked to perfection, and you can tell they put real care into their food. If you're looking for a place with great food, great people, and a great atmosphere, this is it! completely recomended ✨

Favorite place in the town center tugged away on the east side of the mall. Best salmon donbouri in town and soup. They stay opened from level3 lockdown. Will buy sushi from here everyday/time 😋 nomnom🤗

Indeed this is one of my go to places when I'm in Mangere, and it's taken so long to post a review.. I so Love the customer service they provide and how they embrace their kindness with the community 😍 Love the texture and just how fresh their sushi is.. my mum is indeed a fan of their prawn tempura ☺️ First time having coffee there this Saturday..Bonus thing is they had soy milk in stock which was awesome.. And what can I say my soy Carmel latte was on point 💯. Thank you so much for providing such amazing service 🤗🤗

My favourite sushi place 🍱 in Town Centre. Customer service is 10/10 - For only three people working, you guys are beyond amazing and I can tell your food is made with love. Your Always serving fresh, tasty, and delicious food. Keep up the good work! #KatsuRegular
Very nice staff and food. Found it a bit expensive though.
The staff is friendly and taste is not bad.

I’ve used their kiosk touch screen and unfortunately it’s unmatched to their menu board.I approached the lady and explained what I’ve ordered.She responded me in a rude way that I’m wasting her time.She didn’t even check what’s on their self ordering touch screen before murmuring.To think I’ve paid the right price.Had bad customer service.To the owner please update your machine.

First time trying, got there 40mins before closing time so they weren't cooking anything fresh. They offered a tray that was already filled with food and wrapped in foil but because of the rona, i declined and selected the $27 tray with 5 choices of what they had left in the warmers. White rice, Lamb chop suey and Beef chow mein was filled to the brim! They happily reduced the price from $27 to $22 but they have an eftpos surchage so it came to $22.60. After trying the food, i found the white rice was a little dry, the lamb was more fatty than meaty and the beef looked a little strange upon closer inspection, but other than that the food tasted fine and im pretty happy i got my moneys worth. Not my first or second choice but you can get a decent feed for what you pay for.

If I could give 0 stars I would. Food and basic hygiene are very bad. My Family have seen the cook use a tea towel to kill a cockroach and then use that same one for cooking absolutely disgusting. When my family told them their response was we can put free food in for you. That's how you know only for the money and NOT safety of their customers. Absolutely appalling. I don't even know why people still eat here though.

Have ordered from them several times and we enjoyed their food but today we ordered some wonton soup and fish n chips and it wasn't up to their normal standards. Fish and chips wasn't cooked throughly and soup wasn't all tasty not enough stock or soy sauce so unfortunately thats why there's only 2 stars.

Very expensive and small proportion. I Ordered the family tray ($58) through Uber Eats, but the food didn’t taste freshly cooked, more like the food that sits on the counter. Very disappointed in the quality the sweet and sour pork was very hard. I wouldn’t recommend this place unfortunately.
Friendly place and fresh food

My mum and I and my husband and I have been here. On several occasions but this is the last straw. Order a ham cheese and tomato croissant. A cheese scone and a grey earl tea. The croissant was disgusting. Ham was cold though I asked them to heat it up. It took about 20mins to “toast” and by the time the croissant came. It was hard and unappetising to eat. I only took 2 bites and didn’t finish it. My mum didn’t finish her cheese scone either. Ok. I will not go there again.

This coffee shop is a true gem! my sister and my whole family visit the coffee this week. alhought the weather is bad.but the atmosphere of the shop is warm and inviting, with stylish decor and plenty of cozy seating. The staff are always friendly and attentive, making every visit feel personal. Most importantly, the coffee is outstanding — rich, smooth, and perfectly brewed. Whether you're looking for a quiet place to work or a casual spot to catch up with friends, this café is an excellent choice !!!

Had came to the place yesterday to have a nice brunch meal after my appointment. When we have ordered our food , I was disappointed at the small portions for 3 meals. Especially when you’re paying $24 or more . If you don’t want to waste your money just buy from their cabinet .

In an area that's very much about fast food, this cafe was a nice find. The service was welcoming and friendly and I quite enjoyed the chicken BLT. The chicken is nicely spiced and theres a decent amount of bacon. The only downside is the mayo. It would have been 5 stars had the mayo not been the sour stuff you get in bulk from wholesalers. A simple egg mayo or garlic aioli would take this to another level.
It had been far too long since our last visit! The food remains exceptional, and the service is still top-notch. The entire menu is delicious, but the eggs benedict section is bloody good.
Lady gave me a chicken thigh it tasted old & it was small & dry the fries seasoning tasted weird Won’t be back.

Chicken takeaway in the centre of Mangere town centre in the corner. Saw that it was packed and so many people were devouring their food so thought to grab me and my daughter Dinner (B) 3 thighs and fries $17.50. Forgot to take a photo this time but found the chicken super greasy and have this weird after taste then usual and fries just didn’t taste as your usual fries so I’m guessing it’s the oil they fry their food in. Still eatable but I don’t think I’ll be buying from them again. Service is 10/10 lovely couple and dining area just needs a little bit of love and care and clearing their overflow storage all left in front house.
We love there food its delicious and hot and fresh and there chicken thighs are bigger than anywhere else in Auckland
Nice chicken and chips shop, friendly people and owner.
Awesome food.

After craving burger King for so long today i decided the award myself with nice brugerking meal, after taking the meal drive thru, with the 1st bite i realised that i got the shitest burgerking meal ever ! The beef was dried ! Hard ! Over cocked and Cold !!! everything was cold even the fries ! Omg i was so pised off !
Very bad experience i bought food on 19 april the lettuce was rotten and food was cold it was not even busy please dont serve food like this keep your standard up

If there was a star for zero I would absolutely give that the burgers patties were burnt that is disgusting. Would you feed your kids burnt stuff?? I have photos and will be reporting this further to food safety. Absolutely appalling I will never ever go back there

We stopped at Burger King Mangere on our way to the airport for a quick lunch, but unfortunately, our experience was less than satisfactory. After placing our orders, we waited over 15 minutes with no sign of our food, while we noticed that more than 20 vehicles were served via the drive-through and Uber Eats pickups. After 20 minutes, we still hadn't received our order. When we asked a staff member about it, they gave us a blank look and walked away without addressing the situation. Finally, after approximately 23 minutes, our order was ready at the counter. Generally, we've had good experiences with Burger King, but this particular visit was disappointing. We hope this location can improve its service in the future.
Meals was always hot and freshly made chips . We also didn't have to wait very long.
Great service. Tasty, fresh and hot food. Must try fish n chip and chicken chip. Loaded fries also awesome.
food is delicious, amazing atmosphere and great service definitely worth coming back
Very delicious food in the town. Will visit again specially for the finger licking yummy munch fries ..

Went here for my second time today & tried the Chicken & Chips box, loved it! Filled with flavour & was generously filled. I didn’t purchase their homemade wedges but was given some to try & would go back to try them properly !!
Chicken burger and loaded fries combo is too good, value for money.

Perfect place close to the airport to stay for a night even if you have an early flight in the morning. Free shuttle service is very generous and the rooms were kept clean. While there were stains in the carpet and staff could come across as passive at times, definitely worth your money.

The sheets were not changed prior to our arrival. We informed the front office staff, but no one came to address the issue. Ultimately, we retrieved the sheets ourselves and changed them. The only reason we didn’t leave for another place was because it was late and we had an early flight the next morning.

Happy 3 beers for $20 Wedges were so good Stayed here on a number of occasions. This time would be the only time I would say the cleanliness could do with some work. Dust and shower needed a bit of a clean

Really happy with everything. Especially airport shuttle service late at night. Food was so good, staff were really lovely and accommodating. Room was clean and restful. I'll continue to use for future accommodation. Thank you so much.

Room was quite old and not really clean, also I have problem with hot water tap in the bathroom that water turn brown colour as in the last picture. The window not well sealed so water from the rain came inside the room on the carpet. The door double lock was broken. Service is very good👍 Food in their restaurant is very delicious especially the Butter chicken with rice.👍 Location and shuttle service is very convenient too.

Went to have dinner here last night as it was the closest thing to our hotel, seen mixed reviews and went anyways our experience was great friendly man greeted us we had lamb roast of the day that was awesome perfectly cooked for my liking and my partner had the seafood platter he really enjoyed that not super cheap but thats to be expected now days, was great thanks Guys
Great food! we got the veg burger that came with fries, lamb Rogan Josh, a beer,and apple crumble. all were great! the service was fast,efficient and very nice. restaurant very clean and spacious
Had lovely meal there last night. Fresh tasty ,presentation appealing hamburger and chips and roganjosh lamb was amasing..definitely worth..little bit pricey..

Great food! Very tasty and extremely friendly staff. Also has a small bar attached. As reviewed by other this is a bit of a secret place probably not known to everyone nearby. Great option for those living in nearby motels without kitchen. They also have breakfast ( both continental and cooked) starting from 7 am. Try it!

Give them a 5 to get the ball rolling. Service was very attentive, but there weren’t many in the restaurant, however we were eating early. Food was to a high standard, all of us enjoyed the meal. Small bites chilli chicken was delicious but I’d say a little pricy at $20 for what was about 5-6 pieces. Highly recommend the butter chicken sauce on the chips, we got two bowls! All that got curries enjoyed them too. Decor is nothing special, being inside Airport Kiwi Motel/Hotel but if you can look past that it’s worth trying out!
Amazing service and food! Highly recommended value for money
A young highschooler was such a good worker and he helped out and even gave me free food(tasty meat🥩 ❤️😍)!, he should work there more, such a good guy!
This high schooler working there offered free meat... very tasty mmmm

I did a uber order, came pretty quick as I only live down the road lol, ordered 6 meals which were very nice by the way😁 then surprised with a free chop suey... thank you guys 🥰🤙💛 highly recommended 😊
This is my go-to for Chinese in South Auckland. Food is so tasty, consistent and cheaper than most. Not a fan of their deep fried menu or burgers. Chips are nice though.
Bought a chicken roti for lunch. Took a few bites, i look at my roti and spot a long piece of hair. Disgusting!!!
Nice customer service, affordable meal deals for a large group, food is ok. I bought 6 different pizzas, but they almost tasted the same. I couldn't really differentiate, which is which
Food is very delicious especially chips with butter chicken sauce.

They were grade D at one stage - Their chicken is disgusting, their chips was too salty. The place is a filth, one time a fly was flying inside the food warmer and the lady there handwaved it out and didnt even throw out the taros this fly had been sitting on. I will never buy from here again
Chicken was cold, fish was over fried and the fries were okay.

By far the best Holiday Inn we've stayed at. The staff were all very welcoming and friendly and the buffet breakfast was fabulous. A welcome experience after a long flight from San Francisco. Thank you
Food took between 1-2 hours to arrive. Ridiculous. Expensive, average food too! The Four slices of garlic bread below were $18!!!

This place is shocking - absolutely avoid. Our medium rear streak came out like a barbecued jandal, packet mashed potato and gravy, and peas boiled so long they lost their green and were best suited to someone with no teeth. Kids got a meat lovers pizza, after wondering why it was taking so long a staff member walked through the restaurant carrying a domino’s box, the $35 pizza was from the $5 value menu! The kumara chips (also from domino’s) were missing aioli and when asked they served tartare sauce. Wildly disappointing meal for $155 - I’m sure we would’ve got a better meal from Waikeria prison.
The restaurant was cozy enough to enjoy the buffet with family ,and stuff was very friendly. The buffet was compact dishes , but very tasty.
Went to this restaurant as part of hotel accomodation included breakfast. The food quality was extremely pathetic. Not fresh and had terrible taste

Not one to post poor reviews, but since this restaurant has only a captive audience of hotel guests, it’s worth warning them off of this place. We wondered why there were so many people in the lobby having food delivered…. We ordered an inedible burger—we suspect the whole thing was microwaved since even the vegis, tomatoes and lettuce included, were hot. The Caesar salad, well, the picture is attached here. Salad more brown then green. Also warm as a salad shouldn’t be. The only upside is that kids eat free if you are staying there and you order an adult meal. Unfortunately that assumes you would feed you child this “food.”

We were not staying at the Holiday Inn, but were looking for a robust meal at a reasonable price. Our meal was delicious and generously portioned. It was well presented and the service was prompt. No complaints!

The service here is very friendly and fast. My husband had the burger and fries. It was very big, but fell apart because it got soggy. My Caesar salad was pretty good. I added smoked salmon. It was also large. My only complaint would be how hard the croutons were, making them difficult to eat. The beer selection was a little limited.
Ordered a medium rare steak, but it came out well done. Sent it back, and the replacement was somehow half well done, half medium well. Also, the vegetables served with the steak were raw.

Nice open spaced out venue with a variety of seating options. The staff were very down to earth and friendly. Rumpus was a convenient location for us as we stayed in the airport inn, the menu however was pricey.

Ordered a pie and drink off of uber eats and it only came with the pie. After selecting the pie there are “add ons” like how you would for a combo at Maccas but didn’t even show that there was a drink. So I got charged for a pie AND a drink but only got the pie. Disappointing

Quite possibly the worst customer service I have received in my entire life. Trying to fill up with diesel and key pad on pump faulty Despite bringing this to their attention refused to come onto forecourt to assist. Assistants pictured needs be fired or moved on if on short term contract.

When coffee was made the service was unfriendly and negative. When making coffee didn’t ask how much sugar and when advised about the sugar the coffee was already made and sugar didn’t dissolve properly as intended to. Also when drinking it- felt gritty and sandy. DO NOT RECOMMEND!!
Worst coffee ever have in my life ...
BP- Wild Bean, Mangere. Just got a coffee on the run. No wait time, staff were friendly. Busy little spot but staff always nice.

I wasn’t a customer today, but I had a small emergency. I was running in the nearby forest while my mum was walking, and we got separated. It was already getting dark, and I didn’t have my phone with me—I was really worried. I ran into this store and the lady was incredibly kind and warm. Without hesitation, she let me use her phone. I’m so grateful for her help and generosity. Thank you so much!
Banh Mi so good I forgot to take a pic until the last bites. Generous portions, unbeatable price, lovely people, will definitely be back!
Enjoy their Bahn MI’s. Wish they had it everyday instead of just Saturdays. Good Mango bango and ice coffee too.

It’s my third time getting food from here and I’m always happy with what I get. Their fat chips are really the best I’ve had in Auckland. Tried their dessert drink “Mango Bango” — I hope I remembered the name of it correctly. It’s sooooo good!!! I love this shop! Thanks guys, keep it up!

Great coffee, great food & great people! What more could you ask for? Also, I tried their boba drinks and definitely recommend the brown sugar one and taro one! My fav is the caramel with coffee jelly - it's to die for!
A hard pass from my Family on this place! We got a $20 & $10 special and the results were shocking, highly disappointed! You could get more in the central area.
Have been going here got years great people great food x

Terrible experience with this catering place and we only went with them a 3rd time due to no other catering services being available (food menu does look good, don’t get me wrong). Would be lovely if the workers showed love and smiled while doing their jobs especially considering the large amount that is spent on their service. Do better please. It’s not like people want to be in that position.

I don’t typically write reviews, but this experience felt especially frustrating. When you provide services. Make sure you’re giving these people their moneys worth and serve with a smile. That is all we ask for.
Had Parker Polynesian Catering for my 21st Menu 5 Iis the best So Yummy So many options multiple menus to choose from Absolutely recommend !!

Sour food, sour faces, sour service. Setup and placement can be deceiving. If in business to rush, push, jump with the intention to be confrontational at the smallest request, then please don’t operate. Food was YUCKY 🤮, please find alternative catering company.

I was given the run around from day 1 because I wanted a roasted pig. I went by the store end of October, told to come back 1st Dec, went back and the store was not open. Rang to be told they had already placed their order, they recommended that I buy a pig and they would roast it, rang and left messages on their cellphone and messenger and got no reply for hours. And when i did get a reply i felt like i was dealing with 3 different people. Communication was so disappointing, I would not recommend their service!!!!.

Had an amazing meal today! The butter chicken was creamy and delicious, the naan was perfectly soft, and the pizza was fresh and cheesy. The staff were super friendly and attentive, and the service was quick and welcoming. A great dining experience overall!" 😍🍕😋😋😋

I ordered the Pizza Chicken Taka Tak and really enjoyed it. The flavours were bold and well balanced – a nice mix of spice, savoury chicken, and cheesy goodness. The chicken was cooked perfectly, really tender and tasty. Overall, the pizza was great. I’d happily order it again.

Menu has a great variety and everything we ordered was packed with flavour. The place has a welcoming feel and you can tell the team takes pride in what they do. Really happy to see something like this open up nearby. Will be back soon!

Absolutely amazing experience at Royal Indian Cuisine! Newly opened and already a favorite — the food is incredibly fresh and full of flavor. Portion sizes are generous, and the customer service is honestly 10/10. Everyone was so welcoming and kind. Highly recommend if you’re after authentic Indian food done right!

I had an amazing experience at Royal Indian Cuisine in Mangere – especially with their Royal Pizza, which was absolutely delicious! The flavors were rich, the crust was perfectly baked, and the toppings were generous and tasty. It was one of the best pizzas I’ve had! I also tried their Butter Chicken, Naan, and Papad, and every dish was full of authentic Indian flavor. The Butter Chicken was creamy and flavorful, and the naan was fresh and soft – just perfect. What made my visit even more special was the complimentary papadums they gave me – such a kind and thoughtful gesture! It really showed their warm hospitality. The service was friendly, and the food came out fresh and hot. Don’t know what people are on about leaving one star reviews. My partner and I stayed here for one night. The room is spacious and clean (I am a clean freak). Didn’t really hear any loud noises like what other people said (could hear people talk though). It’s simple and of great value.

Really pleasantly surprised with my stay. Rooms were very clean, comfortable, crisp clean king size bed. Gorgeous friendly and helpful staff. The convenient bus shuttle to the airport took a load of of my mind. Price I paid was more than affordable. Definitely recommended. 😊🪻😊

Since this store got a new owner, I've noticed a significant improvement in customer service. Especially when I placed an online order for 18 platters, the owner personally drove them to my office. I am so appreciate
what in the false advertisement on uber app😂 and the food tasted very stale . Ugh waste of money, first & last time ordering from this store .

I always get a chicken kebab meal from here no complaints at all. Today I tried the beef and cheeseburger and it was yum. Everything was fresh, well put together and balanced. Prices are very very reasonable. Highly recommend for quick bite.
10/10 food was amazing. thank you guys so much. Definitely recommend ☺️ hope to hear from you’s about the free pizza hahahahaa
Their kebabs and pizzas are best. Best customer service. Always serves with smile. Must try

My first time eating here, and I swear I had a bad experience cause tell me why my kebab meal has no meat on my chips I don't why but sad that I have to pay for the large meal but there's hardly any meat on it tsk

Toby’s seafood has the best affordable seafood that is fresh and clean. I love their fried fish which starts from $3 per fillet, we also tried their raw mussels for $9 which was so yummy. The place is clean but slightly fishy if you are sensitive to fishy smell.
Food is so hearty, delicious, perfectly salted & always fresh/hot. Love the battered mussels, pot fresh mussels & raw fish!! My fav go to shop for fries items

The food was delicious, and portions are great value for money. The staff were quick and attentive and not as rude as I've experienced before. Overall, this visit did not disappoint as it was a busy Thursday afternoon, and not a table was empty.
Great memories from the old FOODTOWN and this great, I think family run firm, surpasses those memories. Some hard case diners often in residence - live entertainment.

If you want a good decent meal of Snapper then this is the place for you. $18 snapper meal, 2 fillets, fresh as, chips, 2 eggs and salad. Now if that's not good value I don't know what is! I've never been disappointed with my meals there, but buying seafood to take away like mussels and kina is more expensive than my other fish shop I go to at Mangere Town Centre.

Absolutely looooved our 3 course meal today @ Dine In. I am a student @ mit & booked my family in for a 3 course meal and everything was top tier!!!! Loved the food, loved the service by Riviera top quality service, staff made sure we were taken care of throughout our meals!There was nothing to fault! Amazing affordability🥳

Excellent food for the price you pay. I would have gladly paid more for the lunch. Remember people the students are in training and are really doing an EXCELLENT job so just a bit of patience is good for their morale😊👍

It was my first time and I really enjoyed myself. The students did an excellent job serving and the high tea items were just right for our big group. Absolutely loved the savouries and the sweets were divine.

17AUG17 1:18PM Really up to a three and a half stars rating because this is a training restaurant for hospitality students and chef school students in Manukau Technical Institute of Technology. Had three great coffees in a row and service by students was attentive and engaging.
Beautiful a good place for a lunch with friends, students will serve you and they are awesome.

I had a fantastic experience at Lucky Star Yum Cha! The customer service was exceptional, with staff being friendly and attentive throughout my visit. The prawn dumplings were delicious—perfectly cooked with a flavorful filling and a delicate wrapper. It was a great meal overall.

An old school style yum cha restaurant in the heart of Papatoetoe. The interior is old and they serve traditional Cantonese cuisine. It is very local. The food is cheaper than other yum cha places in central Auckland. The taste and portions are good, especially the shaomai and congee. Worth to check out if you are in the area.

No doubt in terms of food delicious this is a 5 stars Cantonese restaurant! Although it's a bit away from the city that makes no discount on their food presentation and the quality. I really enjoyed the food here, every time! The owner Tony is with great personality to be friends with Highly recommended.

Food is really good here, service is fast. Best to come early when it opens as it's not as busy or noisey. Also don't wait and look for waitresses when trying to find food. Go up to the front counter make your order My four dishes, prawn hargow, pork suimai, BBQ pork rice noodles roll and pork spareribs came to $30.60, amazing value and probably the cheapest in auckland

Please update your hours on Google Maps! Drove for half an hour to get there today (Tuesday) and it's closed, very disappointed. It says open on Google map. The dimsum are great. Price are fair. Highly recommended. Just the online info are not up-to-date.

I always buy Lil Abner's and their food is delicious but recently I ordered twice and received dry wrap, barely sauce put it also the chips are tasteless no salt at all. Tonight, I went in person to see and saw Indian staff's preparing the meals (a female and a male). Kindly serve food in proper way. Paying $20 for dry kebab and saltless Chip's Not Worth It.

This take away is fantastic The food ordering is worth the wait as it does get busy Rotisserie chicken is not always seen at most outlets. Which is one of my favorites with chips. Seadog has always been another favourite of mine with extra sauce . There is no dining in Just order personally or phone order Street parking 🅿️

A great fan of Lil Abs... but today I bought a whole Chicken n Chips and salad... the chicken was dry as.. the salad was hard from thier cooler... been sitting at least couple days... chips cold... not impressed at all... come on Abs... really

Edit: 2024 as they now are not as good as rhey used to be. They no longer have the same crinkle cut fries, their current ones are horrible, the only redeeming thing for the fries is they use the same tasty chicken salt, have attached photos of their new crinkle cuts. The kebabs here are nothing special anymore, the chicken taste like the bad parts of chicken on a roast chicken, while they put way to much mayo in the kebab as well. Choice Food bar kebabs a couple of stores down taste better than them now. Yokum burger is not bad, depends on if you like the sound of this below, its basically minced chicken with stuffing mixed together with mayo, wrapped inside an egg and put into a burger.

It was my first time visiting Auckland to visit some relatives. We stopped by this place late at night and has now become our favourite go-to in Papakura! Fantastic service and tasty food. Thanks guys!

Good place to go for a few games of pool. Staff were welcoming and friendly. Live dj (DJ STRAIGHT-ABOUT) is good at keeping the crowd happy and an awesome guy to talk to. Plenty of car park out back and restrooms are nice, clean, and tidy. Food selection has a decent amount of options that I found fairly good priced. The platter was a good variation of deep-fried goods that tasted good for what it was. Has karaoke nights, couple pool tables, dart boards, small stage area (karaoke area) and plenty of bar tables, bar stools, table and chairs for a few crowds. Big screen for sports and had the good old slots area.

Really nice venue … we had a party a month Ago .. it was the one of the mean night in my life unforgettable experience.. we would love to go back again for any other part in the future thanks guys once again 5 star
Was genuinely surprised with the atmosphere and how spacious it was. The back area was also spacious. Pepper squid was perfect both times bartenders are great overall nice bar.
Service very poor, food is ok for the price, drinks arw too expensive
Food is fantastic here with great atmosphere. All the chicken starters were so good. Will be coming often

I stopped this Bk today evening and was pleasantly surprised by overall vibe. The dining area was so clean and tables were so tidy and I even saw staff wiping surfaces regularly, which shows they care about cleanliness. Good job Bk east tamaki keep it up.

I just visited this branch today around 7 pm and had great experience. The staff was so friendly and got my order out so quickly. The food was so hot and fresh. The restaurant was very clean and had a nice atmosphere, will definitely come back.

A good place for a tasty takeaway meal. We had the restaurant to ourselves; there were no other diners. It is difficult to talk about service because there isn't really any, but a wave or acknowledgement as I left might have been nice. I struggled with the ordering kiosk, I had to go back to the beginning numerous times to get the order right. The burger was packed with good tastes; the meat pattie filled it well. The lime thickshake was very thick, I almost needed a spoon.

At Burger King, Ferina's outstanding cleaning skills shine through as she keeps the dining area spotless and welcoming for customers, ensuring a pleasant experience while maintaining the high standards of cleanliness that the restaurant is known for. Her attention to detail and dedication to hygiene not only enhance the overall atmosphere but also contribute to the restaurant's reputation for quality service. So she deserves a raise 😁
I really enjoy the atmosphere of this burger king. There are good workers especially one named Ferina. She had outstanding service and I appreciated her upbeat attitude

Our 10 year old wanted to try Popeyes after seeing an NBA star on YouTube who loves this place 😆 So we came here not really knowing what to expect, we were pleasantly surprised with the menu range and selection available. Prices were pretty good, cheaper than what it normally costs us for KFC. My son and husband enjoyed the Mac & Cheese, it wasn’t cheesy enough for my liking. I loved the potato & gravy, I liked the herby flavour, but my boys didn’t really like it. We all enjoyed the chicken and the chips were good too. Overall, my husband still prefers KFC but my son and I would be happy to come here again without him 😅

Had high expectations for this place! Went through the drive through at 3pm on a Monday Afternoon. We were the only people in the drive through and the inside was empty. Somehow it took around 15 minutes to get our food. The lady at the drive through couldn’t hear us and asked us to repeat, when repeating our order she cut us off before confirming our order. Was a bit taken aback by that. Keeping an open mind though. We opened our food to be shocked at the size of the regular mac and cheese, literally only 3 mouthfuls worth and actually not even worth at $4.90. Just overcooked pasta and a bit of sauce. The chicken in our Deluxe Sandwiches was massive and was the best part of the entire meal. With them being Deluxe sandwiches we were expecting Bacon in them, which there was none. Disappointing as we paid more for the bacon. The lettuce in the Sandwiches was floppy, looked obviously days old and was only the tiny stem pieces of the lettuce. Not worth it.

Decided to give this place a go after soooo many people made it pretty known that it's "disappointing." I went through the drive thru around 11am-12pm this morning, there were no cars but inside had a few people enjoying their meals. I got one of the deluxe sandwich's which was actually pretty tasty & great quality in size. I also ordered the Mac & cheese, Cajun fries a biscuit and a side of buttermilk ranch. Honestly the Mac & Cheese is genuinely basic considering it's obviously pre-made & put away in a heating area, but I understand fast food industries for that so it really wasn't too much of a disappointment, but you could make better at home of course. The fries & burger go really well with the buttermilk ranch 🤤 but the biscuit isn't too much of a hype. Honestly just an average circle bread that's heated. It's not too bad but some of my honest opinions should also be considered. I do recommend giving these guys a shot! The service through the drive thru was also a good experience, the lady was real patient & kind. Even at the window, two ladies handed my order, very kind team! (Mind the photo, I totally forgot to take a picture of the food outside of packaging.)

Overall pretty good. Chicken is nice (tenders, classic and spicy wings), the meat is tender, juicy and has a lovely crust Deluxe spicy Burger is well balanced, nice touch with the pickled cucumber. Chips are super crispy and have a nice spice.
The cleanliness was on point, workers were constantly wiping the tables down. The food was fresh and cooked well. When it’s done right Popeyes is really good.

The atmosphere of the restaurant was really nice and would be good but we only visited the cafe. The quality of the food was standard I’ve included photos of the eggs Benedict and the eggs on toast as well as the trending fruit cakes. The fruit cakes were not what I was expecting as it was mainly just moose and a filling not a cake or sponge. They were also really sweet.

Absolutely loved the Spider-Man cake we ordered for our son’s birthday! It turned out even better than we expected—beautifully designed and full of detail. Our little one was over the moon, it truly made his day! We were referred by a friend and so glad we went with this bakery. The taste was amazing too—moist, fresh, and not overly sweet. Great quality at a very reasonable price. Highly recommend giving them a try!

Was a nice place ...looking abit dated. Food was good... not a fan of rose flavor which most of the slices tasted like at dessert. Loved the Lasagna and the lamb patties, great range of middle eastern foods. Cake/dessert display cabinet looks great didn't try any of it thou.

I stumbled across this Restaurant on social media and was impressed by the Menu so I made a booking this evening for my birthday, this is the old Vietnamese Restaurant. We were greeted pleasantly at front Counter and a Window display of Beautiful Cold Cabinet Desserts & Celebration Cakes. We were given plates to help ourselves to the 90min buffet which is such a great Idea to minimise waste & dishes. What a Beautiful selection! Absolutely loved it and so much flavours, Our highlights were the, Butter fish, Butter Chicken, Lamb, Charcoal Chicken, Paneer, Je'era Rice, Babaganoush, Hot Tea, Sandalwood. Excellent value for $39.95 per person including Drinks, Hot Tea, Desserts & Ice cream,Chocolate Fountain, so many great dishes. Lovely decor & very warm. I really hope you get Diners who appreciate this cuisine. So much better than these Westernised eateries lol. Absolutely fantastic, we will return with our Sons. Papatoetoe is so lucky to have you. Best wishes Team & thank you to The Chefs! (Thames Coast, Coromandel)

My family and I enjoyed the variety of dishes and all were super delicious! The food were topped up often and served at perfect temperature. The only slight downfall was the seating arrangements, chairs are placed everywhere and you are often blocked off and have to squeeze past tables and chairs to make your way to the food but, it’s a popular place so it’ll always be like this. Will still be back for more 😊
Reached here not open as advertised Wasted my time

BEST IN THE BUSINESS!!! We came across Moala's Catering at a family funeral few years back and ever since we've never looked elsewhere. They catered my fathers funeral reception for 400pax, everyone LOVED the food - Nice and fresh 100% recommend. The catering team are so awesome, the ladies are always smiling when serving and doing what they do best! Malo aupito, Moala Catering

We had a funeral the other week and short notice my mother and aunt booked king moala catering. It's been a week since than and everyone is still talking about the food. Everything was absolutely delicious! The flavour was in everything, every dish was perfect to a T! I know this won't be the last time our family uses them. Can not thank them enough for giving our family a beautiful service after sending off our aunt, who BTW would have RAVED about the food.

Have booked with King Moala catering twice and at both times, food was delicious, service exceptional and smiles throughout service. Have recieved several compliments and have referred family and friends. Our go-to catering company.
We had King Moala cater our son’s first birthday and it was amazing. Everything was delicious and served with a warm smile. Highly recommend King Moala! Thank you very much.

Hours say open online, when I go or call the man always says its closed, Its annoying! If yous cant have your business open then shut down. Food isnt even all that I just come for one thing too, Dont recommend & the man is actually rude

1 star. Atmosphere was cosy although there was no table to dine in quietly. We both ordered milk teas and they were warm like they had been in a heated room for a couple days; wasn't fresh at all. The boneless chicken was also dry and stale. Service was below average; scrolling his phone while we asked him about what Chicken flavors they had. Oberly priced for poor food quality. Tried it once, won't return or recommend to others.

Disgusting. Disappointed. Dumb. Those are the 3 words I have to describe how I feel and how the person handled my food. I literally said on the ubereats not to make sure that the food was not soggy, but crisp. What do you give? REFRIED, SOGGY, STALE fries. What is wrong with you??? On the note it said I was not having a good week yet you go do that. I'll take my craving elsewhere. I feel bad if it was a lazy worker that decided to be inconsiderate but if you're the owner that did this then shame on you. The only decent thing was the packaging, sprite 2 pieces of chicken the rest was weird on the inside.

The food is a bit pricey. We ordered boneless fried chicken Sweet Corn and Parmesan Cheese Flavor and Honey Soy Flavor. The chicken was good but quantity is too small. Service was quick as well. We called in to order ahead and we were told order can be ready in 5 minutes. Packaging is quite impressive.I love their reusable purple bag. Might come back to try their bubble tea as I was told they were good. There is free parking just outside the store.

Stumbled on this place yesterday and wow I'm impressed from the service to price and overall the food was hot, fresh and delicious. I ordered a lunch special with chicken/cabbage dumplings it came with crispy hot chips and a side salad. For an extra $1 add on I got a can of drink and sauces are extra and the sweet soy was my go to. Will definitely be back affordable delicious and local to me!
Cosy place...lovely place to visit. Food is yum and the service is amazing 😍 Different kind of sauces to choose from. Id suggest it to those who love fried chicken.

This is the most delicious food I have ever eaten. I came all the way from wellington just to come here for dinner, and it didn’t disappoint. It was the best sweet and sour pork I have ever eaten, the Bami Gorang was absolutely delicious. In the precious concept of time, I have never spent my time more wisely coming to this fine restaurant. Would recommend
This is our local takeaways and we’ve enjoyed their services. Bought my last meal here tonight. Wonderful couple, I always mention about his haircut, and that’s our usual banter. Will miss them

Was passing through, don't usually order from here but thought to try it out. $11 for 2 scoops of fries.. it wasn't even half the potion I would get for that price at my local takeaways, crazy won't be coming here anymore. However, the fries were tasty and delicious 😋.

We drove 8 hours to get here from Wellington, to the one and only New Horse Takeaways, and it was single-handedly the greatest and most important journey ever undertaken by my person. Peak Chinese foodstuff consumption, quick and speedy service, and they even have free off street parking. The satisfaction I had upon tasting the sweet nectar that is New Horse Takeaways sweet and sour pork knows not a single bound. I will return to this fine establishment as soon as humanely possible.
Food is very average. It wouldn’t be my go to if I was hungry for some Chinese takeaways but would def eat it again if I was give it. Not the cheapest either, specially for the area.

My first time ordering from there last night. I had ordered chicken chow mein and omg it was best I've had in a very long time. It was so good, lots of chicken and veges and the sauce and noodles was on point 👌💯 I had called the order 10mins prior to showing up and it was ready in about 3 mins of me arriving. It was also very affordable too. Definitely going back there again 😁
Coackroach crawling in the box that food was in 🤮 only means this place has them! Never coming back it’s put me off eating what i got

Their sweet and sour pork was by far the worst we've had in Auckland. Believe me, we've been to many chinese takeaways these past 4 days. If you're gonna come here, just come here for the other "goods", that seems to be why everyone else comes.

Basic math skills definitely need to be reevaluated due to disappointing service being short changed. One of my horrific experiences I asked for a $20 item plus a $1 can of drink and a lighter. I handed over $40 in cash (x2 $20 notes) and in change I was given back $10 note??? How does a $1 can of drink and 1 lighter cost $10? Very poor math skills. Especially with their ethnic background. Very dissatisfied.

Awsome family owned business knowing the shop since high school and still remember my face… open late than the normal chippy if you were finishing work late or coming home from a long drive..tastes like it did when I was in my uniform amazing!!! Will continue to go there if I’m passing through.

The food was quite good and flavorful. I ordered the goat biryani, which tasted great, although it only had two pieces of meat. I also tried the chicken lollipop and the chicken biryani thali—both were delicious as well. However, the experience was affected by the poor attitude of the person taking the order. His communication came across as rude and dismissive, especially when he said it would take 20–30 minutes, as if he didn’t care whether we stayed or not. There was a noticeable lack of hospitality, which was disappointing. Overall, while the food was satisfying, I would recommend opting for takeaway rather than dining in, due to the service experience.

We purchased the family pack Goat Biryani, Chicken 65, and five Mango Lassis today. While the Mango Lassi was excellent—one of the best we’ve had—the rest of the meal was disappointing. The Goat Biryani didn’t taste like traditional biryani and contained very few goat pieces, barely enough for even one person. The Chicken 65 portion was generous, but the flavor was overly tangy. If you're looking for amazing Mango Lassi, this is the place to go, but we wouldn’t recommend the Biryani or Chicken 65. However, for authentic and delicious biryani, we recommend Gorkha Eastern Beach or Paradise Takeaway—they’re the best.

Went for dine in at Biryaniwala. Ordered the meal at the counter and we were told food will take 30 minutes. So we happily waited. When served after 30 minutes, the plate looked good but the food was not hot. Lamb biryani was abysmal. It literally had 2 pieces of inbone lamb meat. Food courts have better biryani’s. Other meals we bought were also not hot and not tasty. I won’t go here again. I won’t recommend this restaurant.

Yesterday, we ordered a family pack chicken biryani along with two rice kheer. Unfortunately, one of the kheers was spoiled—it had a sour taste. Thankfully, I did a quick taste test before serving it to my guests, otherwise it could have caused serious health issues. As a milk-based dessert, kheer should be handled with extra care to ensure it’s fresh and safe to consume. I hope you take this feedback seriously.
Amazing vegeterian and non vegeterian options available.. love the keema dosa.. must try.. in veg, we loved the gobi manuchurian and noodles.. l😊

We had a 9th birthday here with a big family, and it was awesome. The atmosphere was lovely, the place was clean and tidy, and the food was great—we ordered 5 or 6 platters. Staff were very friendly and helpful. There are toilets available, but unfortunately, no baby changing facilities.

Work lunch for a farewell. Staff were helpful and friendly. Loved the decor inside outside through back entrance is very laid back and the front part very pretty with all the gorgeous mosaic light fixtures etc. Even the plates are pretty. Plenty of different menu options to choose from but not too overwhelming. The lovely waitress also recommended some dishes to my colleague. I had the falafel plate for a starter, falafel were nice and crispy on the outside and fluffy on the inside. The hummus it cake with and salad all went perfectly with the hot garlic bread/pita. For main I ordered the mixed charcoal grill plate again everything was delicious and fresh. Everything had that yummy charcoal grilled taste and the white sauce was divine I forgot to ask for just white sauce coz I can't do spice. Salad was flavorful and all the meat was amazing my fave was the chicken and the lamb cutlet. My other workmates lamb plate looked divine as well big chunks of tender lamb. I have tried Khanz fusion buffet which was good but definitely will be back to Khanz Restaurant again to try more of their dishes.

Love the Karhai here and next in line the charcoal platter. Nihari is not consistently good. Has been amazing twice and not so good the other two times. Great service and very sweet servers who don’t complain. We are a group of 6 adults and 6 kids who always go here together and no one ever raised an eyebrow. Also pics come out great here hehe

It was a good dining experience, one of the good Mediterranean dishes we have eaten here in Auckland. Definitely will come back and bring my friends here. If you like big servings then you are good with the platter menu.

The ambience of the restaurant is very authentic, creating a pleasant dining atmosphere. If you prefer to sit inside, I recommend booking a table in advance. Otherwise, you may be seated at the back where they serve shisha, which might not be ideal if you're with kids. The food was good, with decent portion sizes for the price you pay.

I don’t know what has changed from the past reviews, but the lamb curry my partner came home with tonight was delicious, plenty of meat pieces in the curry amazing taste full of lovely flavours. We will definitely come back again ☺️
I would never ask anyone to buy from there, bhajiya was full of flour and taste less and the bara was so hard can't even chew.
Usually the duck curry is good. But tonight I found a long hair in my food. Made me throw up! Never going back unfortunately
$19 for lamb curry. It only had 4 pieces of lamb and 2 were just bones and 1 was mostly fat. There was more potatoes than meat. Definitely would not buy from again. Not worth it.

Pathetic service. Ordered vegi fried rice but found a piece of chicken. What kind of joke was it, it is our indian festival diwali and my whole family was vegetarian. Seem like these kinda people don't bother just make money. Please people don't trust their food. This was my last time with them. Not happy at all.

Patiala House is a standout when it comes to authentic Indian cuisine. The food is consistently delicious, full of rich flavor, and clearly made with care. What makes the experience even better is the team — the staff and owners are incredibly warm, welcoming, and genuine. At Simply POS, we’re proud to be the EFTPOS and Point of Sale provider for such a wonderful establishment. It’s a privilege to support a restaurant that not only delivers amazing food but also creates a truly comforting atmosphere for its guests.
First time, came because of the most stars. Food was hot, asked for not hot. I got chicken masala, rice and riot.
Superb indeed.Aloo Parantha was awesome in Taste and Quantity. Shabnam Ji and team 👍

Review: The service was exceptional—staff were attentive, friendly, and made sure every detail was perfect. The food was absolutely delicious, with rich, authentic flavours that truly captured the essence of Indian sweets and snacks. Every dish was well-prepared, fresh, and beautifully presented. The ambience added to the overall experience, making it a great place to enjoy a memorable meal. Highly recommend for anyone looking for quality service and authentic, flavourful food!

Woo..... Have no words to explain . First time in Auckland experience at indian takeaway with such a delicious food and great service. Highly recommend. According to prices way too high in taste and quality. 💯💯💯💯
Fiji 🇫🇯 take away shop selling Fiji Indian and Chinese food + Sweets 🍛 🍚 🐔 Price range from $12-$16 for small to medium size dish ✅️ also does Uber eats.
Very friendly staff thanks 🙏

The mango gummies looked very old and very expensive 8 dollars for it and peach ice cream for 8 50 disappointed but I searched up how much it should be it should have been 4 dollars even on the tiktok it said 4 dollars dont go here these people are ripping you off
Clean n well organised store Layouts makes shopping easy and enjoyable..definitely my go-to grocery store from now on.
It certainly is a Shopping Mart. Not very big but if you're looking for Dubai chocolate with kafa, it's there $21.
Excellent shopping experience! Store offers a wide variety of high-quality products.

A lovely man sells delicious BBQ in the evenings, with generous portions that remind me of Fiji. Some photos from his fb page.

Quantity and price wise this was a steal… but the food itself was bland, no marination on any of the meat, no seasoning either, all you can taste is blood from the meat, chops was hard… barely could chew it… it was just put on the bbq bare and cooked without any marinade.. Most tasty bbq, will definitely come back for more

Just got served by the lovely Oscar in drive-thru! Beyond Excellent customer service by him....needs to be made a trainer or manager to train staff on service. Thank you so much Oscar,God bless you!

Wow cant use toilets unless u purchase and i definitely didnt get great service Onion rings were drenched in oil

Love this mcdonalds. I feel the best we've been to compare to all the others. We only use the drive thru btw. I wish they had a playground for the kids. Food and fries always taste fresh. love getting my coffee/meals and also my littles snack bundles from here. service is great

If you're craving authentic North Indian flavours right here in the neighbourhood, Ambarsariya Café and Restaurant is the place to be. I’ve visited a few times now, and every visit leaves me wanting to come back again. The absolute highlight for me is their crunchy, crispy kulcha—it’s nothing short of outstanding. The outer layer is golden and crisp, but once you bite in, the soft, flavourful filling hits just right. It's a nostalgic burst of Punjab in every bite! This time, I tried their patty kulcha, and wow—next level delicious. It's creamy, crunchy, spicy, with perfectly balanced masalas layered inside. You don’t just taste it—you feel it. The flavours stay with you, like a warm memory from home. They also serve hot, crunchy samosas—served fresh, with just the right amount of kick. Paired with their chutneys, it’s hard to stop at one. And don’t miss their hot chocolate—surprisingly smooth and rich, it’s a perfect sweet ending to the meal, especially on a cold Papatoetoe day. Yes, the food takes a little time to arrive, but that’s only because they make everything fresh to order. And honestly? It’s so worth the wait. When the food hits the table, hot and fragrant, you’ll know you made the right choice. Every dish brings you closer to the streets of Hindustan—you’ll be reminded of roadside dhabas, home kitchens, and late-night snacks from back in the day. The vibe is simple and casual, and the team always greets you with a smile. The owners clearly take pride in delivering authentic taste with heart. Whether you’re stopping by for a quick bite or sitting down for a full meal, you’ll leave with a happy belly and warm memories. Highly recommend it to anyone in South Auckland looking for a true Punjabi food experience. Try it once—you’ll be back for sure!

If you're craving rich, authentic Punjabi flavors - especially their signature paratha, amritsari aloo tikki chat —this place is worth checking out.

We recently dined at New Soul Korea restaurant and had a great experience overall. We ordered the sweet and spicy chicken as well as the stir-fried pork, and both dishes were full of bold, authentic Korean flavours. The sweet and spicy chicken was crispy on the outside, tender on the inside, and generously coated in a sticky, well-balanced sauce that had a nice kick without being too overwhelming. It hit that perfect spot between savoury and sweet. The stir-fried pork was also a standout, with tender slices of meat cooked in a rich sauce and served with fresh vegetables that added both crunch and balance to the dish. The portions were quite generous, and we left feeling full and satisfied. The presentation of the dishes was clean and appealing, and the service throughout our visit was polite and efficient. The staff were attentive without being intrusive, and the food came out relatively quickly despite the restaurant being fairly busy. One thing to note is that the prices are a little on the higher side, especially when compared to more casual Korean eateries. However, given the quality of the ingredients and the overall dining experience, it still felt worth it. The restaurant itself is modern and cozy, with a relaxed atmosphere that makes it suitable for both casual meals and small group gatherings. Parking was not an issue at all — there’s ample parking nearby which made getting in and out very easy, especially for a busy area like Botany. All in all, it is a great spot for those looking to enjoy well-executed Korean comfort food with a bit of flair.

Mexicali Fresh is probably one of the best chains for Mexican food in New Zealand. I'm consistently impressed with the quality of the food and the prices are pretty decent. The ambience of this particular restaurant is really nice. The portions are quite large as well - I had a mini Macho Burrito and that was probably more food than I needed. The regular size must be massive.

We are huge taco/mexican foodies. Today we chose the Bandito $19 (ish) and a chicken (hard/corn)Taco (1 spicy, 1 Mild) $7 each. The Badito had a generous portion of beef barbaco with an extra side of about 12 corn chips on the side. With the fresh salad, yum. And the 2 warm hard shell chicken tacos, yum. The spicy one is very spicy if you're not really a 'heat' person. If you are, it's like a mild spicy. That came with an extra side about 5 corn chips. Service was good. Good value for money. Cute little Mexican vibe restaurant. Overall was a good experience, would recommend to others.

Ordered (from bowl'd) -the Korean bbq, kids chicken donburi, middle eastern kebab (be better W/falafel as advertised) bowls- regular portion sizes were good & filling. found mango, banana smoothie different in taste & appearance like a diluted version

I have never been disappointed greater than this afternoon. Absolutely below standard prep for any lunch whatsoever. I oukd take away the only star I had to unfortunately include for this Pitapit franchise store in Botany junction. I was amazed to find big chunks of veges with roots in the salad, with no almost no sauce, no ingredients to be found in the salad bowl as per my online order. This is money wasted and a lesson learnt. Please be very aware of the food you order with this store. I have attached my receipt and pictures as well for the store owners to ponder upon. Quite shameful 👎. I was highly disappointed and let down with a brand operating under PITA-PIT umbrella at such below standards and with a substandard customer service. Absolutely Gutted !
Customer service today was absolutely amazing compared to last visit 😊 Loaded wedges are delicious! Fresh salads for the wraps 👍

Probably the freshest fast food in Botany Hub - fresh, tasty, quick assembly. Overall a good deal for lunches or light meals. Service could do with another person in busy times, but on the whole they do pretty well. Closes annoyingly early though.
I love pita put but this is definitely the worst one. The portion sizes are disappointing and theres almost no sauce. Unfortunate as other pita pita are so good :/ i hope they change their service.
Omg.. $18 apricot chicken super small and don't think it worth that much. $11 pepperoni look even bigger. All bcos of the dessert, otherwise back to pizza hut. Hope will be better next time.

Very disappointed with the food handling standards here. I ordered a vegetarian pizza, but the staff used the same gloves, utensils, and prep area as they do for non-veg items—without any care for cross-contamination. This is not just careless, it’s highly disrespectful to vegetarian and vegan customers who follow strict dietary choices for ethical, religious, or health reasons. There was absolutely no separation in food prep, and no staff member seemed trained or concerned about this issue. If you’re vegetarian or vegan and expect even basic standards of hygiene and respect, this is not a safe or trustworthy place to eat. I sincerely hope they improve their training and food safety protocols—this level of negligence is unacceptable.
Accidently order from them and not pizza hut. When a 7 year old says ewe this is dry az dad you know it's rubbish it tasted like cardboard. Also looked like a 3 year old cut it

Unfortunately I continually get shafted at this store. Ordered chips with gravy. Got about half a handful of chips with gravy. Not worth $5. My pizza last time came without the sauces and one had a weird herb I never asked for. Complete disappointment. But it's the only store I can order from in my area. On the plus the malt shake and ice creams were delish. Bout my only positive right now.

The service was extremely poor. Our delivery took over an hour to get to us, and when it did, the driver dropped our food on the ground and didn't say anything. The pizza was undercooked so badly that it was still raw in the middle of the bace when we called. they sent out the order again, but this was more undercooked than the last. When I took the food pack to the store, the manager walked away when I was showing him. This has not been the first time we have had issues from domino's and will never oder from them again.😡🤬😡

Tank has always been my go to for something healthy that’s delicious. Their Thai Beef wrap is glorious and I’ve had it for the last 3 days. I prefer this over the salad bowl. I don’t like shaking the bowl to mix it as not everything is equally distributed like how it use to be when they use to mix it prior to packing it. Anyhow, I highly recommend the wrap and my go to mango smoothies is always primo
Great service. Store is kept clean and they close at 8pm which is so awesome when you need a fresh smoothie late in the evening. Plenty of parking.

I always visit Tank Juice in the mornings after my workout, and I just want to say how amazing Raj is! She always greets me with a smile and makes my day with her friendly attitude. Her customer service is absolutely top-notch — she remembers my usual order and always makes it with care. It’s rare to find someone so genuine and professional. Big thanks to Raj for always being so kind and making my visits so enjoyable!

Usually, I have a great experience at Tank—especially when I’m served by the two lovely Indian ladies who always do a fantastic job and are super professional. However, during my recent visit, I was served by a different staff member (a young man) who appeared visibly unwell. Shortly after having my drink, I began feeling really sick, and I suspect he may have been unwell while preparing my order. Please ensure that all staff handling food and drinks are in good health and not working while sick. It’s a matter of customer safety and hygiene. Thank you.

The clerk was not skilled at her job. We left temporarily after placing our order, and did not ask her to wait for us to make it. We thought we would just take it and go back to work. After eating for about 15 minutes, we came back and it was still not ready. She said she was very busy. In fact, the customers in the store were not so busy that she could not make a drink in 15 minutes. We seriously suspected that she saw us leave and made drinks for other customers in advance. In the end, we had to wait for more. Very bad experience, will not come again.

Got the full island bbq plate & loco moco. Not as good as last time (few months ago)as the ribs were way overcooked and dry. The fries usually are so consistent and crispy, but were cold and limp. Meat patty was overcooked and drowned in gravy that was just salty and tasteless at the same time. Chicken wings were surprisingly tender and flavorful. Mac n cheese and coleslaw were consistent and as good as I remembered. Overall not too keen to come back for a while if consistency is lacking on a $25+ meal.

It's been nearly 2 years since we have been back. We thought we were at the wrong place as it looks like new owners not too sure. Anyway I ordered the steak and creamy mushroom plate. Looking at the other reviews on here for this same meal I must have been lucky as I enjoyed my meal, I had no complaints portions were massive the Mac was creamy and the chips was more then a scoop of chips you get at your local. Steak was done as requested (well done) not dry but juicy and not chewy. Worth the drive coming from out west as we do thank you!

I ordered the Patty's on rice and the sirlion steak, the patties were very dry and the gravy was not tasty at all. The Sirloin was not even a Sirloin cut, it was extremely tough, I did not even finish half of it. I would not recommend this place. Employees were nice though.

Meat was very nice and well cooked I’m typing this and eating my $25 plate worth the money and highly recommended to everyone that loves BBQ will definitely come back again for round 2 😂❤️❤️❤️❤️ keep it up guys love your work

Purchased a Kahlua meal with fries and can no normal coke available only option coke zero and no tissues considering the burgers gonna get messy the shop needs a do over. fries are crinkle fries. 27 something for my meal with no tissues and no coke. But comes with a fork lol

I placed an uber eats order at 12:12am, it’s now 1:39am. For-goodness sake it’s laundry liquid, cheese and jelly. What’s taking so long? Why does it take 100 years to pack an order? Why does no one answer the phone? Im so annoyed. We pay for the convenience, when no convenience is given. This is NOT an uber eats problem, this is whoever is on shift at this time. Get new workers.
