Ordered a drink hotdogs and wedges costing $32.27 UBER EATS and didn't receive the sweet chilli sauce and the sour cream which was $5.50 worth of the bill. Uber Eats is not showing my order so I cannot respond to anyone over this. What a way to ruin someone's meal!.
I've been waiting for my order for about an hour and a half, It still hasn't arrived?? worst store on uber ever.

'Wouldn't recomend coming here'👎🏼💀 Customer service doesn't deserve any stars. Rude & very dismissive when ordering at the window, aswell as rolling their eyes when ordering. They use to do walk ins, But only allow certain people to walk in now. The worker who served us @1:30am on 18/10/24 needs training with his customer service skills! Won't be coming back here if this stupid service continues. Definitely doesn't deserve any stars!!! 👎🏼👎🏼👎🏼

Feedback on Chennai Platter Experience Dear Team at Novelty, I wanted to share my recent experience with the Chennai Platter I ordered. While the dosa was reasonably okay, the rest of the items were quite disappointing. The uttapam was dry and lacked sufficient toppings, and both the idli and vada tasted stale and unappetizing. Additionally, the chutney provided was watery and barely enough for a single idli, and the quantity of sambar was also inadequate considering the platter included dosa, uttapam, two idlis, and two vadas. Overall, the quality and presentation did not meet expectations, especially for a place of your reputation. I hope you will take this feedback constructively to improve consistency and ensure a better dining experience for your customers in the future.

Very disappointed with the experience last night. The pani puri was stale — both the puris and the aloo filling lacked freshness and taste. The aloo tikki was the biggest letdown: it was cold, completely drowned in yogurt, and had no real flavor. It looked more like a yogurt dish than a tikki. Later we ordered aloo kulcha , same story. Won’t be coming back.

Poor Taste now gave us One or two days old Barfi , which have weird taste, Never come again. Even after tasting i went there again and ask them that i think so this is different sweet but they said it’s same.
Snacks are mostly made fresh which is good. But feel it’s expensive compared to the sizes. Staffs are friendly and welcoming.
I found hard and burnt plastic in my kachori. Very unhygienic. I will not buy anything from NOVELTY !

I had heard & read good things about this café & because it's close to my home, I had to try it. A friend & I popped in for a quick but relaxed coffee break. It wasn't so busy which made me feel more at ease. While my friend parked I proceeded into the café. I ordered a Mocha & a scrummy Muffin (warmed up!) There is plenty of indoor seating but I noticed the table needed a clean. That aside it was comfy. My friend joined me & a nice time was had. However, I need to go back to the start of this visit. I was the only human standing at the counter while the two staff busied themselves with all things cafeteria. I made a decision on what I would order and waited to be acknowledged & served. While waiting, a woman and a man soon entered the café and stood beside me waiting to order their treats. Now, at this point, the female staff member turned her attention from activities at the counter to serving us. I stood there, first in line & I was somehow unseen. The female staff member spoke directly to the woman next to me, acknowledged her presence & asked for her order. I stood there seemingly invisible to the naked eye, and began to feel a wee bit perturbed. But the woman next in line, pointing at me, stated that I was there waiting to be served. I then got an "Oh, yes.. what would you like?" This left me feeling not so great. Not so welcome. The coffee was really good. As was the warm muffin. But I'm not sure if I'd return for a follow up coffee break. Perhaps. We'll see.

Popped-in for a coffee whilst waiting for someone at the Ormiston Hospital. The staff were friendly and the whole place was spotless. However, the coffee was awful - very, very bitter. It makes me sad that so many cafes don't select decent coffee or when they do, they don't take the time to set-up their grinders and espresso machines to get the best from the ingredients they're using.
Excellent food and friendly team. Coffee made to perfection here. Spacious seating including outside seating too.

Its a hidden gem in Flatbush. The food,service and location all is top class. I am Mocha connoisseur so I can assure you that its the best Mocha you can have anywhere I know. It is the only place they make Mochacchino the way it is made in Italy and UK. Try it .. Say Mo sent you..
Great little cafe, really friendly service, awesome coffee and food - highly recommended
Good food lunch special is good value for money
I had very nice meal from here recently. Really enjoyed it and happy to go again.
Yummy food I ordered chicken korma, delicious and great price too, $20 for curry, rice, drink and bread! Great service too.. thoroughly enjoyed my meal and will come back again soon👍🏽
My go to local Indian takeaway, have been using them since pre-Covid and have never had a bad meal yet.

First time customer for this spot here in Flatbush and definitely not the last! They did not disappoint with the Indian style butter chicken combo and kids butter chicken meal, we were absolutely pleased with our meals🤌 highly recommend this place and we look forward to dining in/takeout again soon

DISGUSTING FRYING OIL!! probably1 week old oil .Trust the other reviews!! Extremely oily poor quality chicken burger, doesn’t even have tomato in it. The fried chicken is so brown and dirty oil fried . I should have trusted all the other negative reviews and never gave this place a chance avoid this place . you have been warned.

One of if not the worst chicken and chips experience. $26 for chicken fried in leftover oil, way too greasy and the amount of chips served with it was RIDICULOUS. Also got pork on rice as the lady who was serving us recommended it. Sat in the restaurant contemplating why we spent so much money on such bad food. I’ve always been grateful with what I eat, but this is so bad I HAD to write a review on it. The first red flag should’ve been the $26 for 20 chicken nibbles and the empty restaurant. PLEASE LISTEN TO ME WHEN I SAY DO NOT SPEND YOUR MONEY HERE!

One of the WORST roast shops i’ve ever eaten at genuinely, while i was ordering the lady was talking to me with her mouth full of food which was disgusting i then paid for my order and got charged an extra 40 cents i asked her and she said there was a surcharge fee, she showed me where it was which was literally below the efptos machine where i couldn’t not see it at all. During that whole interaction of talking to her she was being incredibly rude. I got my food and sat and ate in my car the chips were very stale and the chicken burger felt old i felt like it was such a waste so i went in and complained aswell as i brought the food back which i had eaten 3/4 of the burger and 6 chips. She offered no resolution and said she couldn’t do anything because i had “gone and ate in my car” i didn’t even want a refund i just wanted to give feed back, honestly she didn’t seem to care at all. One of the worst customer service.
Do not order a roast meal and expect to get sliced meat on roast veg. They shred all the meat and scoop slimey fatty shreds onto soggy veg. $80 for 3 very very disappointing and wasted meals.

If I could give this place a negative rating I would. I am someone who naturally supports local food spots over the big chains easy. This has to be the worst food I have ever eaten from any small business. What was sent was not what I ordered. Old cuts of meat. Hard carrots. Old rice, horrible. Dissappointed is an understatement

Fo Guang Shan Temple is a serene and beautiful place to visit. The temple grounds are peaceful, and the architecture is stunning. Remember to dress respectfully (shoulders and knees covered). A great experience where you feel welcomed from any walk of life. The vegetarian cafe offers delicious food be sure to check the opening times of the cafe and be aware that it can be very busy at times.
A very calm and tranquil place to visit. The fully vegetarian cafe has delicious food even for a regular meat eater. The gardens are lovely and the have regular exhibitions.

Impressive temple to pay a visit if you are in the area. Not much going on as we visited on a weekday and it was quiet. Be sure to wear clothing over the knees as I got told off by staff nicely multiple times which was annoying as I was wearing long shorts. They do not provide any coverings so recommended to wear pants.

A stunning and iconic temple with breathtaking views. The atmosphere is peaceful and deeply spiritual, making it a great place for reflection and meditation. The architecture is impressive, and the surroundings are well-maintained. Take note that a proper dress code is required—smart casual attire with long pants, as shorts are not allowed. A must-visit for those seeking tranquility and cultural enrichment!

The Guang Shan Buddhist Temple in Auckland is a truly peaceful and welcoming place. The grounds and facilities are exceptionally well maintained, creating a serene and inviting atmosphere for all visitors.
Love the food. Would recommend Malai Tikka & Amritsari Fish, Food is good. Do visit.

It’s allright. I ordered take away from here for the first time and they missed my order note which was very disappointing. I ordered Indian style butter chicken with bones and paid $22 for that but it was boneless when we got home and started eating. I mean it was one thing that we were looking forward to but in vain. Food was average, like you get in any other Indian takeaways. You get better cheese nans and chilli chicken elsewhere. Not coming here again.

A good takeaway spot! Will rate the food 2.5 out of 5 only because sometimes it is really good and other times the curry seems like they are old curries just heated up in the microwave. I only go there because it is close by to where I live. Entrees are generally better than curries.

The food is very substandard. The taste and quality both looked compromised. we paid 85.90$ for our meal for family of 4 . The breads were burnt and thick. Butter chicken was sweet and very watery gravy. No taste not even mild. Saagwala chicken was more of some old canned saag not cooked also properly. Noodles were very oily . Malai chicken was floating in cream gravy. Since there was no manager /owner around and got to know doesn't come often so I had to explain all this to the lady who takes the order. She started giving me an explanation of - what mistakes I did while ordering food. I told her butter chicken was very sweet and she is saying - it was kiwi style butter chicken- So it's not a Menu problem but my problem to ask for Normal butter chicken. Overall - Unhelpful staff, Oily and tasteless food, Watery gravy, small chicken pieces.

Delicious food, so fresh i can taste fresh ginger in dish which i love, good and fast service. Chef needs to clean his apron. A few seating options, made more for takeaway than dine in as you get plastic cutlery and plates. Yum and well priced.

I went through the drive-thru at Botany McDonald's around 3 PM on a Sunday, and everything was absolutely excellent. I spoke to the team member at the speaker around 3:05 PM, and by 3:07 I was driving away with my order — incredibly fast and efficient service! Both of the staff members at the windows were friendly, professional, and made the experience smooth and pleasant. The food? Unbelievable. I ordered the BBQ Bandit small combo on the app, which was hot, fresh, and perfectly cooked. The fries were crispy and just the way I like them. And the real surprise? The Barbecue Bandit burger — I tried it for the first time, and it was amazing. Packed with flavor and cooked to perfection. Huge shoutout to the team working that afternoon — you made my day! Will definitely be coming back. 👍👍💯💯 Highly recommend. Check photos.

Ordered from drive thru around 30 minutes ago. The lettuce in my burger was awful—wilted, soggy, and definitely not fresh. I was too tired to go back for an exchange, but this really shouldn’t have been served in the first place. The staff need to pay much closer attention to the quality of what they’re putting into the burgers.

Why has management not stepped up to sort the quality issues coming out of here, been average for years. Burgers falling apart and packed upside down in bags and the state of the milkshakes we received… both should be large and the same flavour, looking pretty different to me.
Short asian girl was nice and friendly. Provided napkins and ketchup. Sorry about hot chocolate spill 😥 I think the pickles on my two cheeseburgers were on the sour side like 7.5

15/03/2025 look at how your employee prepared and packed the burgers. Every dollar we spend in your store was a hard earned money only to be served a food like these. Considering McDonald's is an international food chain, but customer service and food handling and preparation SUCKS!

Amazing range of pizza, friendly and courteous staff. They equally have vegetarian friendly items on the menu. We tried Sweet As (Vege) pizza from their gourmet range and Spicy Italian 🔥 from their regular range. Additionally, from the sides we had garlic pizza bread, Kumara and jalapeno bites. The food is fresh and tastes good. I will try their burgers on my next visit 🙌

Always went past this place. Never once have I thought it would turn out this great. 💯 extremely fresh and tasty pizza . Full of flavors. Crust was just the way I wanted it to be. Highly recommend 👌👍 The seating area was very clean and tidy aswel. This place is very underated and needs to be more appreciated 👏 Keep up the great work guys

Really disappointed with the burgers there lately. Ordered a chicken burger today and there was a volcano of apricot & aioli sauce, that was all over both my hands and I couldn’t take any photos. The onions are cut so big now - I’ve noticed it’s only when certain workers are there it’s like they don’t care for their job or the quality of the food. This is not the first time in the last 3-4 months but I’m really disappointed with the consistency of this happening. Last week I ordered a pizza with aioli sauce and there was a THICK layer of it on which was sickening. I also got commented on because of the way I order my burgers simply removing 2 ingredients. I don’t appreciate the judgement? Please bring back that original quality!

First time here. The beautiful female staff member (I didn't catch her name) that served us was very resourceful and knowledgeable describing pizzas and recommended pizzas for my young children which was great as I didn't need to think too much after a long hectic day at work. My family and I are definitely coming back. Keep up the awesome mahi all And to the girl who served us, we need more people like you in this world. Thank you so much. AAA+++

Got the spicy prawn pizza...perfect spice level!! Reasonable prices, good portion sizes and good service from the young lady serving. Friend ordered a beef burger w/pineapple but im yet to taste how they are.
Ribs were absolutely rubbish, burnt first and foremost, then you only get 3 pieces. Also ordered butter chick and hot chilli pizza, with extra cheese…. Wheres the extra cheese…?

Situated within the doors of the Dawson Road Supervalue supermarket, have ordered from here several times, but my latest visit was not to their normal standard, 2 stars given simply for the quality of the pizza, and for how the manager handled an error made by one of its staff members, who gave away my pizzas to another customer, while I was there waiting patiently. In past visits have seen staff members repeat orders and check receipts before handing over the order, but on this day, the staff member turned around 4 pizzas in hand, the other customer calls Yip..and the order was handed over, at this stage I looked at the staff member, knowing very well I had ordered well before this other customer, who then asked what my order was. Realising his mistake manager was called..all communication between them in Hindu, then an offer of apology, pizzas remade, and a free drink for my troubles.

Bloody rip off. Charged me for 2x "14 (xxl) and sent 2 large, munted chicken but incorrect flavor. Doordash driver said .. "pizza store say they don't have right now". No replacement or compensation...

Really bad. I ordered first time via Uber eats from here and it will be my last. Their chips were oven baked and half of them were burnt and raw with 0 seasoning. Atleast put some salt. I ordered potato bites but they gave me potato wedges instead, again half raw and burnt. Pizza only had toppings on one side, one side was only cheese and sauce. Chicken pieces on the pizza were minuscule. Taste was average. Waste of money. Better pizzas are available at a better price.
The pizza was so bland, the onion rings tasted a bit good it just needs more flavour but it was better than the pizza. Overall the food was underwhelming.

Probably one of the best burgers I've had in a long time, Customer service was great, down to earth, prompt and attentive. A little on the pricey side, but what isn't these days. I personally thought is was well worth the drive and purchase. Better then maccas or burger king for around the same price but your definitely not left hungry here that's for sure. Burgers are massive, chips size massive, with the perfect dipping sauce to match too. IF i had to be picky, maybe more drink options, but we're not picky and we're very happy we visited. Overall would definitely recommend to anyone thinking of trying this place out. Cheers team

Great burgers and tasty shakes. The tallow fried fries were disappointing, like the tallow needed changing and quite expensive. Restaurant also quite dirty. Tables and benches could use a wipe. There's a few tables to eat in

My burger in the photo below was absolutely perfect I devoured and vacuumed it into my mouth in great succession and the homemade aioli was a chefs kiss, drowned my burger and chips with it. However, it is 4 stars because I wish there was a selection for better sesame buns they feel supermarket instead of restaurant quality but I quickly brushed it off as the rest was godly. Also I didn’t take a pic of this one but my friend had a Keto burger and wished they made the fried egg more runny as it just tasted like plain white egg. So I wish they had the option available for that. Alittle on the expensive side though which is expected for a millennial burger joint however after trying many others this is worth the price. Highly recommend
Ordered kiwi burger and it was super yummy. The patty has lots of beef flavor, the sauce’s acidity provides good balance, the bun was tasty too. Recommend for a quick bite in the region.

I LOVE THE AIOLI TUBS! Lasted one day and worth every dollar 🤌 Also the Dubai shakes pop off 😮‍💨 absolutely stunning! Dubai waffles are nice just the waffle in general needs some love kinda taste like the supermarket ones but that’s just my opinion. Beautiful customers service, welcoming, generous and quick.

We have been to pizza inn before and enjoyed it, but I was very happy to see they have a new ormiston branch. This one is more of a restaurant, more seats and tables to bring your friends and family. The service was great ,staff were very friendly. The food was hot and delicious. Also loved how the cheesy garlic bread came with a dipping sauce. Was perfect to clense the pallet and eat more. Great spot.
The store is very clean. Helpful and friendly stuff. Pizza base was thick and soft not like some other alternatives. Will visit again.

Update 21/07/24 - Order Buffalo Chicken Pizza, Mac and Cheese and Pepperoni Twisters. I was the only customer, turned up at 12:30pm and had to wait 35 mins for my order which is a ridiculous amount anount of time to wait for pizza. Buffalo chicken is ok, reminds me of Pizza Huts old one. Mac and Cheese is average, the herbs on top ruin the flavour for me. Pepperoni Twisters are 100% not worth $10 for two, so small, not much cheese and flavour inside isnt great. Prob wont be going back again after that long wait time when im the only customer, cant imagine how long the wait time is with other customers Old Review Below Order the Alfredo chicken and Fettucine Chicken Alfredo pasta. Both taste really good. The pizza taste creamy and flavourful and has a good amount of ingredients on it. The pasta also tasted good, a little too much herbs though, maybe half of the amount of herbs would be better. Just need it a bit more creamy and then it would be perfect

Just recently Googled for pizza place and this pizza place popped up on google with 4.8 star rating it was my first time so i went ahead and placed an order for pizza on July 10th 2025. everything went well with placing the order, got an email confirmation as expected but to my disappointment, it never got delivered, and when I called them up, all they said to me was they never received my order and the person I talked to on the phone didn't had access to admin level login to get more information about my order. I got really frustrated and embarrassed as I was planning to share this meal with friends. the person on the phone went on to saying that he was the only person in the store which from my perspective is a major health and safety risk being the only person in store. To my utmost disappointment, they didn't got in touch with me until I had to call them back to sort out my refund. would've at least expected them to act swiftly and as a kind gesture offer some sort of discount. Still waiting for my refund to come through. Sorry pizza inn ormiston, the pizza menu looks great but the customer service I got from pizza inn ormiston was very very poor. Don't think I'll be ordering any pizza from here no more. A very bad first time experience.

Lovely new spot in Ormiston Rd! Their pizza is absolutely delicious and huge. The crust is perfectly crisp, the toppings are fresh, and every bite is a delight. Must add the cheese crust.. its super good! Also, my personal fav pizza is their Taco pizza. So unique and really tastes like taco.

I recently ordered pancit bihon, crispy pasta, and bangus sinigang through Uber Eats. The flavors were fantastic and really reminded me of home-cooked meals, showcasing the authenticity of Filipino dishes. The portions were quite generous, which was a pleasant surprise. I would definitely consider ordering again in the future.

OMG this place is amazing. I have a Filipino wife, we have been together for half a dozen years and I am constantly trying new and exciting foods and flavours as there always seems to be a gathering going on for some occasion or other. Now, always there is home cooked food at these gatherings and it is always made with love and is fantastic...So... when ever we go to a Filipino restaurant I have not enjoyed the food as much as when my wife or friends cook, as it doesn't seem to have the love added to it that makes it amazing. We discovered this place two weeks ago and gave it a try and WOW!!! Loved everything we had and it was during the week and had many opening specials, so cheap and delicious. Went back tonight and the opening specials were all over 😭but I still enjoyed an amazing, tasteful, delicious meal made with love, and so what if it cost a little more than the opening specials, very reasonable prices and well worth every cent. I loved it, I'm a Big Kiwi bloke that loves his food and this is the only place I will now go to for a Filipino feast. Don't tell my wife but I think some of the dishes here may be better than hers 🤫🤣 If you are in the area get down here and give it a go!! If you're not in the area, make the trip, it's well worth it!! You will not be disappointed and you will come back again, as I will again and again. Ten stars !! Lovely staff !! Great Chef and so so friendly, as I've come to expect from the truly blessed Filipino people. Thanks for a lovely evening and see you again very soon.

This place is AMAZING! This is now my favourite Filipino restaurant! The food surpassed all my expectations! Granted we only ordered 3 dishes but they couldn't compare to any other Filipino restaurants in Auckland. Crispy pork hock (pata) was delicious, crispy, meaty. Pork sisig was spicy and tasted amazing. Pinakbet was also nice and vegetables were fresh. And of course, white rice cooked to perfection. Love, love, love it. Although the location is hard to find because it's by a petrol station, the inside of the restaurant was very vibrant, bright, and very welcoming. Love it! Would recommend to everyone and would definitely come back again!

Had been a regular customer of HomeCooked - Elliott Stables so was super thrilled when they open their ormiston branch which is nearer our place. Had an amazing brunch with the family. We've ordered the best seller grilled pork bbq skewers, liempo bbq, longganisa silog, bam-i and turon for dessert...and the rating is 10/10. Prices are reasonable, lovely ambience and all of the staff are so friendly and caring ... a PERFECT showcase of Filipino hospitality. We will be looking forward to the live band. All the best HomeCooked Ormiston 👏 and thank you for the lovely dining experience.

The food was okay overall. I ordered yesterday the halo-halo was really good! The crispy pata was a bit hard. The pancit was just okay, there was barely any meat in it, unless that’s just how it’s usually served. The sisig tasted good, but the portion didn’t seem enough for 2–3 people as was agreed. I appreciated the added lumpia, but the wrapper was quite thick, and my kids ended up not eating it. Customer service was really good, friendly and responsive. Just wish the food matched the same level. I forgot to take photos of the food though.

Wow, pleasantly surprised to get such great fried chicken from a fast food chain! The chicken was fresh, crispy, and huge, and I even got an extra piece (maybe they thought one looked a bit small). The staff at the counter were friendly too. Good on you guys! Keep up the great work! Just look at that generous amount of chicken and fries!

Wow just when food couldn't get any better, the ultimate double toastie combo, DELICIOUS cold drink, great size chips, 2 chicken straps and one of the best toasties I've had in a long time in fact ever. It was like a giant dim sum but better, tastier and so filling,I could only eat half, worth the wait for awesome food and really friendly service today! And an A rating, Recommended 💯

Highly recommend this Chicking! Came here for a late dinner and dined in with our 6 children and always leave fully satisfied. Lovely bright and clean facilities. We got a mix of Spicy and Original Burgers and Chicken and would rate the chicken better than KFC! Massive pieces with lots of flavour and good crunch. The wait can sometimes be a little longer than other fast food places but I am more than happy to wait for tasty food. The staff on this evening also had the best service Ive experienced in a long time, anywhere! Thank you, keep it up! 😊👌

I went around lunchtime and it was a little hectic. Kids rushing everywhere, a queue of people and busy staff. It took quite a while for my food to come, but they gave me some extra stuff to make up for it, and I was in no real hurry. I have had the chicken a few times before, and quite like the difference in seasoning compared to other places.

Hi Rukhsar and team, I picked up dinner from Chicking Ormiston last week, and it was absolutely delicious! The service was excellent, and I really appreciated the friendly way you interacted with customers. Keep up the great work — I’ll definitely be back again!

One of the best Filipino restaurant that my partner and I enjoy. The food here is very tasty, has excellent food quality that captures the Filipino taste. The atmosphere here is so great too. The staff are amazing very friendly, and approachable. They have excellent customer service. Although not much parking on its location, you can easily find a parking near love asia or hulucat. On busy days, you might have to reserve a table and order in advice, as it may take up to 25mins for your order. However, it's worth the wait as I said, food here is amazing.

Swak na swak! All boxes ticked for this Filipino restaurant. Excellent service, they even called me to pre order. Portion is only good for one person, meals are with rice - generous serving. They are not cheap but not too fancy. Love the presentation of their crispy pata, made me missed home - Cebu. Halo-halo is huge - with an innovative utilisation of a disposable glass jar. Well done guys, highly recommended 👍
Authentic Filipino food, delicious and staff were accommodating. Review update: came back here once again. Food were delicious and the staff accommodated us even though they close at 7pm on Sundays.

I love Filipino foods though, but the dishes I ordered here today was so regretful. The beef and pork both tasted too strong like “gamey”… I consider cooking methods significantly impact meat's perceived flavor.

I started to like and crave for their food whenever I attended a friends gathering/occasion they always have Nathalias catering and they expanded, and open their own restaurant which is great. Eventhough we are from West Auckl, location is not always a problem for us 🤣. We can travel a distance just to eat Filipino food. One of our fave were; Batangas Lomi (noodles), Filipino spaghetti (my son fave), Krispy kare kare, veggie lumpia. You can also book online for table reservation to make it easy, or call them for takeaway.

Staff there are very friendly. I like the choices and flavor of food there. They also give you free rice or drink if you spend over $25 and sometimes free cucumber salad. The interiors is a lot nicer now after the recent renovation.

Decent choice of ‘toppings’, good dry stir fry flavors, done quite well. Compared to the one I had in Albany I do wish the condiments sections had a bit more. However the meat selection is grand! Bit on the pricier side to what I’ve had so far but yum choice nevertheless. Can’t go wrong with dry pot!!

Pick the ingredients you want in a bowl, then put it on the scale. Choose your level of spicy and either dry pot or soup base. You pay by $ per 100g. There are a lot of variety to choose from and the ingredients look fresh. If you order a certain amount, you can choose a free drink or bowl of rice. They also sell other dishes like dumplings or BBQ skewers. Excellent service too

First time i had dry pot. Many choices of tofu, mushroom, beans and others to choose from. Then you measure and give it to them for cooking dry pot. Pretty fast cooking as well. It tastes so fresh as all the ingredients are fresh. Highly recommend this place to everyone.

The muxu pork is really good and their bbq's. The hot pots has a strong taste of Sichuan pepper which overpower the soup taste --- the spiciness has (1-3) levels to choose where I think is the amount of pepper 🌶 relies. Everything else is tasty and worthy of $$👍

Amazing staff who went over & above throughout the whole night. Venue & decorations were fabulous. Food was divine - so much to choose from, entree options were next level fantastic. Love Asia you are an amazing restaurant to have a function at
Great spacious place, lots of variety and flavour. Pad Thai was good. The Korean chicken on point and the beef rangdang a bit soupy but mild favour with very tender meat!

Had a good dinner there. Chose to have their rare beef and beef stripe pho vermicelli which was a good portion. My fried had the same and asked for fresh cut chilli that apparently was really spicy. The price was decent, $22 per bowl. They gave us plain water and food was served pretty quickly It was quite a busy night and you could hear other tables talking. The music played were also really catchy

This is our go to restaurant since moving south of Auckland from North Shore when looking for Chinese restaurants with an ambience. I like to eat in a busy place where you seem to share the joy of eating together with tables full of people. Very busy and always lots of people but quick to serve food. We always just get a platter.

The food for the event on deck area was amazing! Even the grazing table food options were amazing filled with chicken kebabs, vege spring rolls the best bao buns and so much more. The main foods included fried rice, sweet and sour and these fried kūmara stick things that were delicious. The staff were also very lovely and super mindful of refilling the food! Such an awesome venue for our small party of 40 guests. Even the decorations took a lot of pressure off our hands and allowed the family to be more present on the day then running around trying to sort things out. Shout out to Amy she runs a tight ship and made the experience over all amazing 😊

One of the best Korean BBQ spots in Auckland, hands down. They use charcoal grills instead of gas, which gives the meat that extra depth of flavour. Their selection of premium meats is impressive, and the meal comes with a generous range of complimentary side dishes — from kimchi and silky steamed egg to even crab! Fabulous and friendly service, they consistently check in to ensure you are satisfied with the experience. A must-visit for any Korean BBQ lover or anyone curious about Korean cuisine.

Tucked in a shopping complex in Botany junction this is an excellent place for a family day out for dinner. The concept of cooking your own meat on a charcoal bbq is not new but always serves the purpose. The food choices are good. Tastes good. Some Korean wine also available. The cubicles are however small and the table fills up quite quickly with all the complementary items they serve with the meat. Love the ambiance. Parking is not a problem but can get busy over weekends. Service is great and staff is courteous and helpful.

Poong Ro Korean BBQ Restaurant offers quality and tasty food at a reasonable price. The range and quality of meats and sides are done very well. And the Korean Fried Chicken is very juicy, crispy and delicious. Overall this was a lovely experience for me and my family and a must try if you’re ever looking for a KBBQ restaurant. 😊

Quite interesting to have a kbbq grilled on charcoal since most of the times they do it on electric or butane. It definitely enhances the flavour of the meat. Their KBBQ menu is quite confusing at first. They also have a lot of rules about it. The quality of the meat is average for the price. However, you will definitely get full from it. I tried their squid meal and all I could taste was the spiciness of the dish. I can handle my spice but this one is just tasteless. You can try it once but I wouldn’t come back here.

Authentic Korean charcoal BBQ experience. Order a selection of meats, minimum one per person, so you can get refills for the sides (Not all types). You can taste the quality of the meats and it's not frozen. Lots of side dishes and the fried chicken is pretty good too. Bookings essential and time limit may apply, depending on how busy it is. Excellent service.
I walkabout a lot and today, saw this magnolias alongside a road. Awesome.

I’ve been here several times, and the food has always been flavorful and delicious. However, this time, the rice was quite hard and felt like it might have been from the previous day. Overall, everything was still good, but I hope the owner ensures fresh rice in the future.

You get a free drink over $30 I think. Not cheap but the food is pretty decent They have seafood for selection and lots of hotpot food Service is ok and they serve the food pretty quickly Taste wise I wish there could be one with numbing but not spicy. Too bad that’s not an option

A great selection, super delicious and friendly staff! We had dry pot which is called "Xiang Guo" with minimum spicy, the owner even gave us 2 free bowls of rice and 1 free self-select drink ! The place is nice and clean. "You don't need a silver fork to eat good food" True! the place is light and clean. I almost cry tears for every bite since we only had last dry pot meal 6 years ago.
Food is great! Food delivered quickly. Atmosphere is good on the warm months. But o my... it was freezing on a cool autumn evening.... there is no heaters and insulation there...

The boss n staff are very friendly they make you feel welcomed. You get to choose your own igredients including live paua n clams. You can choose stir fry or soup n can ask for rice. Very tasty but a bit salty.
The Food taste is excellent.
Came here for a friend’s birthday dinner with a group. Good food and fast service, especially since we had prechosen our meals in advance.

Had lunch here, teriyaki chicken set meal. Very good taste, healthy and delicious food, you can tell it is carefully cooked. The shop is a bit old, but it is still relatively clean and comfortable. Recommended. Will come again. Just a little bit hot.
I loved the food at the lunch hour. And they were happy to include dinner menu options if needed. I was very happy with dishes that I ordered!:

Quality food, good variety in dinner boxes, food is well presented. Ambiance is peaceful and quiet - such an underrated place! One might say that portions are smaller than other places but to be fair the variety and quality of food makes up for it. We are always full when we leave. It’s a place where you can sit down, take your time and enjoy really good food. Perfect after a busy day of work. We wish we found about this restaurant sooner.

Me and and my wife are regular here for dinners , food & service is always good Apart from my last visit , it literally took them over an hour , definitely more than an hour for Just 2 x meals . They should have informed us about the delay in bringing the order , We waited patiently and asked after almost 30 minutes, and we were told that it would take another 10-15 mins, but took more than 30 mins after we checked for our order It literally ruined are plans after dinner and the whole mood was gone. Not appreciated at all ! They need to inform if customers if there is going to be a long long wait !!!

Great value, tastes decent. We ordered 2 rice dishes (2 combination meat rice & long beans rice), fried chicken, half a roast duck, and a drink for $70 total (4 people). Complimentary Chinese tea if you dine in. Duck tastes great but very boney. Roasted pork was good too.
I ordered the Fujian style fried rice and the fried beef hor fun. The food was good! The beef hor fun was a bit salty, though. Portions are big, one plate can easily feed two people

I pass by this place every day on my way to work and finally decided to give it a try for an early dinner. It's not a big place, but there were a few tables available when we walked in and within the hour, it was completely full. The food was delicious, and the staff were super friendly. Definitely planning to come back again.

This is a good Chinese restaurant been here a few times with friends and every time enjoyed the food. It a small place so seating is limited. Food has always been enjoyable and service good as well. Love their hou & sour soup and their Home Tofu was brilliant. I would recommend it!

Ordered a few dishes, including sweey and sour chicken. I have to say, it was the worst S&S chicken as there is no chicken and is full of deep-fried flour, as you can see in the photo. Even the biggest piece didn't have the chicken... I won't be eating here ever again.
Very slow to make coffee. Seem more interested in talking to each other than serving customers. Will fill up elsewhere next time.
Coffee is good, tables are grubby.
The coffee isn’t good
Front staff was ok ? Not much welcoming might be busy that’s why, ordered 8 takeaway samosas , samosas were served warm but taste was good, received order within 7-8min.

I recently tried their lunch special thali, the taste was very good. The quality of the food was nice and served a fulfilling portion at a reasonable price. Rotis were served freshly cooked. Staff is very respectful and friendly. Definitely recommended to eat here with your friends and family.

Super restaurant in it’s own right! Definitely recommend a visit for anyone around.. I’m just a bit sad there’s no meat but their vegetarian options are incredible! A bit pricey but definitely matches the quality.

Dining at Mithas Restaurant was an unforgettable experience, and I have to give special recognition to Chef Saurav Handa for his incredible culinary craftsmanship. I had the pleasure of trying the Amritsari Kulcha, and it was hands down one of the best I’ve ever had—even better than what I’ve tasted in Punjab itself! The kulcha was perfectly crisp on the outside, stuffed generously, and had that authentic, comforting flavor that immediately transports you to North India. Chef Saurav’s attention to detail and passion for authentic Indian cuisine truly shine through in every bite. You can tell that each dish is made with care and a deep understanding of flavor and tradition. The accompaniments—chole and chutneys—were equally flavorful and balanced, elevating the entire experience. The ambiance at Mithas is warm, inviting, and stylish without being over-the-top. The service was prompt and courteous, and the staff made me feel genuinely welcomed from the moment I walked in. It’s rare to find a restaurant that delivers on all fronts—flavor, presentation, service, and atmosphere—but Mithas does it effortlessly. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for authentic Indian cuisine with a gourmet twist. Chef Saurav Handa is truly a master of his craft, and I can’t wait to come back and explore more dishes from his menu!

I’ve never been such a regular at an Indian restaurant before. Their highlights are aloo paratha (best I’ve ever had) , pani puri, and Maggie. Excited to try more. Some days I go here 3x a week. Prices are great and the taste in food quality won’t disappoint. (I sound a little too nice or a little too adverty, but it’s a genuinely review, absolutely in love with this place)

We have been to khanz alot but first time going to this location. Very nice vibe and food tasted amazing. The steak portion was big compared to when I tried it years ago at pap. The Ferrero Rocher cake slice was yummy and good value. Service was a bit slow and they mentioned being busy when the place was relatively empty but we went before dinner rush and it picked up from there.
Food was well presented & tasted good, service however was awful to say the least , limited staff number ,very slow & inattentive, hopefully they can hire more to pull the service up.
Delicious dinner, will definitely be back again. Has only been open a few days so some minor wait for the food ~30 mins but worth the wait!

We have just returned from a beautiful dinner here. We share one of the mixed platters and it was absolutely delicious. Meat cooked beautifully. We were a group of 5 and all of us loved it. Feel like the service could have been better, but given they’ve only been open 4 days, I’m sure that will be ironed out. definitely worth a visit

Very nice place to dine with family. Everything was ok. But some room for improvement. The food was good, rice portion very good but more meat on the rice and some nice music won't harm..but overall good not great.
Nice staff. Good service. But the music was too loud, a club level of loud for a place where you would like to have some chats and conversation with your group.
Ita a great place for a nice dinner and shisha. The staff is very friendly and curious. On top of that variety of Shisha Flavour, definitely a recommended place
First time dinning in was great 👌🏽👌🏽 loved the environment and the playlist was on point and the food was nice to tinder enjoyed the evening….Great job team

Ha! This place is awesome. Definitely coming back for the food. The service was really good. The host was just chill and looked after everyone and gave space to enjoy your time in private. The cocktails were below average. $45 for Shisha. Dinner and drinks $100 for two.

Words cannot explain how amazing this place is! The shisha is the best I've had in all of Auckland and dare j say New Zealand! And the food from Tarka is on a different level! The gentleman who runs this spot knows this stuff! Professional, attentive, best customer service, kind and engaging! If you love shisha or wanna try it, this is the spot!

Tarka Restaurant in Botany is a fantastic spot for Indian cuisine, offering bold flavors and a lively atmosphere. I recently ordered Paneer Tikka Masala, Chicken Tikka Masala, and Dal Makhni, paired with Cheese Chilli Naan, and I must say, the food exceeded my expectations! The Paneer Tikka Masala was rich and creamy, with perfectly cooked paneer that absorbed the flavorful gravy beautifully. The Chicken Tikka Masala had the right balance of spice and smokiness, with tender, juicy chicken pieces. The Dal Makhni was smooth, buttery, and slow-cooked to perfection—just the way it should be. The Cheese Chilli Naan was a standout! Soft, stuffed with just the right amount of cheese and spice, it complemented the curries perfectly. Every bite was indulgent. Beyond the food, the service was fantastic—the staff was attentive, friendly, and made great recommendations. The atmosphere was lively, making it a great place to dine with family or friends. While the prices are on the higher side, the quality and taste make it worth it. If you’re looking for authentic Indian flavors in Botany, Tarka Restaurant is definitely worth a visit! Highly recommended.

We chose Tarka to celebrate my husband’s birthday and thanksgiving celebration on Easter Sunday - from planning to communicating with Harsimran, it was clear and precise. We had a few questions but he was very accommodating. We were very well looked after on the day of the event (one staff was looking after us sorry didnt catch his name) but it was a lovely place to hold the even overall not to mention it was lunchtime. Cant forget to comment on food of course - we had both non veg and veg meals, all of them were very tasty we couldnt have had enough of it! Our guests also raved about the food. One thing to note though was the bathroom upstairs - if they could pay more attention to it as being first ones to get there it already had some smell and could be cleaned better. Aside from that, wonderful experience and enjoyed celebrating our little event there! Thanking Harsimran and his team.

I've been here on every visit to Auckland, lots of seating. The menu is extensive. I love hot curries so always order indian hot, they were almost spot on but I feel they weakened the spice level. The flavour of the curries are great nice sized portions too.

We love the food — it’s always delicious — and the staff are consistently kind and helpful. We’ve held a few functions here and would highly recommend them. They’re always willing to accommodate in any way they can, whether it’s saving a cake delivered early or opening the doors for the decorators.

We had a wonderful experience at Tarka Botany — the staff were genuinely warm, the bright upstairs space felt inviting, and the curries were generous and full‑flavored (I recommend the Goat Special and Chicken Malai). They hosted our family birthday beautifully with a full set‑up. That said, spice‑levels seemed toned down compared to expectations, and the consistency can vary — one visit the chicken was a bit chewy and the biryani was underwhelming. A fresh bowl of rice and tighter kitchen management would elevate the place. Still, for its ambiance, event‑hosting and mostly solid food, the food is very tasty it's a highly recommended spot

I have very bad experience with this restaurant i just ordered Indian sweets that quality and quality quantity is very bad i gave them 0 star pls don’t try there restaurant they are fake I also order Rad mlai I didn’t get anything I have very bad experience with them and the gulag jamun size is very small

Been supporting this store for many years now. Since it’s changed hands their quality and service has dropped heaps. Bought a mutton Dum Biryani takeaway and when I got home the food had a dead fly (see attached) embedded. I immediately called to let them know. Took the food back and the lady manager (no people skills) was hesitant to take it back and said she has to let the cook make the call. He came out and saw the dead fly and said to me “that’s ok I can give you more”. As if I would ever eat from there again! I refused and requested a refund. The manager said we can’t refund electronically but we can give you cash. She gave me $15.50 and I had paid $19.90 for the meal. When I pointed out the error she said “no sir the meal was $15.50” so I showed her the transaction on my bank App and she just opened the till and gave me the rest of the refund. No apology no acknowledgement and absolutely zero care for their customers. Will never support this business again! It’s a shame cos I’m sure they would have been affected with Covid but they don’t care and can’t even get the basics right…
Quantity was not enough, i ordered food via uber eats and didn't mention the quantity of gulab janum i got just 3 in one box without rasmali .

Loved our experience here tonight, been here a couple of years ago and Miss 5 asked to go to an Indian restaurant to celebrate her birthday. The staff were amazing, kind and super friendly. They let us keep the cake in the kitchen and even displayed the cake or is, got the knife all nicely wrapped up and even put a happy birthday song while we cut the cake. All and all we loved our dinner and as my oldest says " I could eat this all day" we ordered lamb madras, scolab and butter chicken as well as lamb in butter chicken sauce with peshwari bread.

Disappointed with food taste, City Raviz tastes amazing but this one sucks. We ordered Chicken Malai Kebab and they were completely tasteless. Fried Rice were completely bland and felt like boiled rice with little bit of chicken and color. This was my 1st experience with RAVIZ Botany branch and i am not going back. They should change Chef asap or improve their taste.

A well-deserved 4 stars(maybe a 4.5 even). First time here, and it didn't disappoint. Loved the ambiance, lighting, and the food. The steaks were cooked to perfection, and the drinks were well made. The wait time to order was a bit long(1 behind the bar and the other on tables), but I can't fault anything else. Will definitely be back!

Been a long week work wise so we decided to stay local and support the hood. Ex Rib House corner eatery now called Melt being the venue. Wings with sauce tasting like hoison and honey (could be wrong) and buffalo wings with ranch dressing both sharing plates were really tasty. Onto mains which consisted of 3 steaks, a chicken burger with chips and a full rack of pork ribs shared by two. One steak returned for a few minutes more on the grill. Ribs easily coming off the bone and great sauce. Basically all meals satisfying. Had to cancel one dessert as it took too long to appear. Now a sent back steak and a dessert that failed to appear while unfortunate wasn't a deal breaker. The meals were enjoyable and staff pleasant. Was quiet when we arrived and pretty busy when we left. Nice job guys.

My wife and I went on a date here last night and were pleasantly surprised with our experience. We both loved our burgers. She got the Greek Lamb Burger and I got the South Westerner Chicken Burger! The burgers were larger than we anticipated and were ready very quickly. We loved the flavours! We also got the wings to split and that was probably the best part of the meal. I’ve never had wings that fell off the bone like these ones did. They were deliciously tender and I will totally go back to get them again! This place is well worth a visit and I highly recommend!

I suggest not booking a function here (in the downstairs area.) We Booked and paid for 66people for a birthday celebration downstairs, but the venue only catered for 50 people. So there was not enough food to go around. The managers had issues communicating throughout the entire booking process. We were all cramped in a small space. No seating for most guests. Although the food was ok. The service wasn’t great at all. It would probably be best to dine here alone/small group of people. Otherwise I believe they would show proper hospitality if you were to book in the upstairs area or If you’re planning on spending large amounts of money. We paid $42pp for the buffet + dessert option. We didn’t have a tab. And paid a $500 booking fee.

Went for lunch and it wasn’t busy. Ordered the tasty platter and the ribs were well cooked and we get to try their different sauces. Thought the spiced will be spicy but it’s not. We also had chicken wings and the sauce is nice. Overall, they have nice sauce but it’s the meat is not marinated. Still looking for a place where they marinate the meat. If you’re looking for good ribs, this place is a must.

Looking for a spot that ticks all the boxes? My Kitchen is a gem! The venue is stunning, the vibe is warm and welcoming, and the food—absolutely next level. If you're a fan of Love Asia, you'll find My Kitchen a strong contender, offering the same mouthwatering flavours but at a better price point. The soup dumplings are a must-try and were an instant hit with my wife and me. While I love Love Asia’s pork belly, My Kitchen serves it up cheaper and with even more generous portions. It's fantastic value for money without compromising on quality. Skip the crowds, enjoy the flavours, and treat yourself. Whether you're a local or just visiting, My Kitchen deserves a spot on your list. Go ahead, Whānau—your taste buds will thank you!
Had dinner with my family and we were very satisfied. The place was tidy and had a great ambiance! Will definitely come back next time. ❤️✨

Everything we ordered was very delicious! Milk tea was also very nice (personally prefer milk tea with a stronger tea taste than milk taste, cause I get too nauseous from too much milk and this place made it how I liked it!). There was also a cute robot delivering the food! The staff were also quite friendly! Would definitely come again.

Loved the food there and lots of options available. Ranging from soup, rice, noodles and more. They also have a variety of bubble tea and desserts. It does get quite busy so be prepared to wait for some time. Service is friendly and we didn’t have to wait long even when it was quite packed.

Had the braised pork rice set and the traditional pork mince rice. We also ordered an entree of the steamed soup pork buns. The braised pork was just ok, I felt was not the authentic type, meat was a bit tough, so I will not order this again. The pork mince rice was excellent and melts in mouth and full of savoury flavour. The soup dumpings was also amazing, big, juicy and just the right taste. For me I would have liked the meatball slightly more tender but my wife prefer it this way. Overall, nice food, fair price will come back.

The 🌧️ rain pours and the wind 🌬️ is determined to blow even the big backs over 😂. And what better way to warm oneself then to a lovely warm bowl of Noodles soup made with Love ❤️. My sister and I enjoyed the pickled cabbage and beef soup and her a braised beef soup . And not without the pork and chives dumplings. We are met at the counter to a lovely women who waits patiently for these big backs to decide from the mouth watering menu. We take a seat in some brown stylish leather seats and within 5-10 minutes our meal is served. You have the option of a mild yet delicious chilli oil and rice vinegar to elevate the flavours of the piping hot soup. And yes these noodles are hand pulled with a great show of the gentlemen as he makes the noodles. I recommend and suggest if you aren't a big eater, one bowl between is enough with dumplings. It was so yum. We went again the next day 😆. God bless you guys and thanks for the delicious food

These noodles right here are my guilty pleasure, I’ve been a loyal customer for years! If I’m happy, sad, confused, excited, traveling or just come home you’ll find me here with my bowl of A8 Youpo noodles! This is the wide noodle dish 🤤🤤 I’ve been to other branches recently to check it out and they’re either not the same or not on the menu, so keep that in mind if you want to give A8 a try 👍🏽 I’d recommend the A2 if you’re wanting a noodle soup, the braised beef is so tender and delicious 😋
First time visiting this branch. We loved the food! We left feeling satisfied.😋 soup is not too fatty just right, the lamb skewer is to die for and my son loves the dumplings!
Wonderful noodle restaurant, my 2yo daughter enjoy it just like at home! They soup is amazing as well!! 😋😋 10 stars Update new meal beef on rice are wonderful 😋😋😋🥰🥰🥰🥰

Traditional hand-pulled noodle house 🍜Healthy, clear, warming soups with delecate flavours and tender ingredients. Great range of authentic dishes and a few favs for pan-asian foodie fans 🍛🥡No liquor licence but fast friendly service and canteen style eating in a clean and relaxed environment. I took a peek behind the counter where the man himself pulls these gorgeous creations - it's such an artform. The lustre on the dough was mouth-watering. Be aware if you scare easy as every so often a giant 👊WHACK👊 sounds out as the dough is slammed down against the counter before being twisted and pulled to perfection 💞 Love this place.

Hubby likes to get his Friday night roast dinner. We ubered tonight to get the pork roast deal. I ordered a bubble drink. Disappointed. It was literally at least 2/3 ice! And cost me $9.20. I've had them before and it wasn't like this. I think they are trying to recoup money from their discounted roast meal on uber. Not getting it again. You're better off getting your drink elsewhere. Also, the balls break getting stuck in the ice so you dont get to enjoy them. Feeling very ripped off.
Ordered the pork on rice with chicken .. generous size however the pork tasted old , odd smell from the soy sauce . Bubble tea was ok

This place has gone downhill in the last few months. The roast meals used to be their main offerings. The service was excellent, they used to ask what sauces you wanted, and if you wanted the potatoes in a separate bag to keep them crispy. Recently the menu has widened to be burgers, salads, and the place has just become a factory line. They seem to count the numbers of each type of vege. Last time there were no sauces added. Probably new owners , won’t be going back.
Roast Hut is amazing! I ordered the medium pork roast on UberEats and it was freshly cooked. The pork crackle was perfect and everything else was cooked just right. I would give it a 10/10 rating.
Their crispy pork skin is the bomb and my new fave is their black pepper beef on rice which is such a flavorful and balanced meal. Highly recommended.

Food is amazing!!! Portions are huge. There is so much meat it can't fit and it is fresh with lots of flavors. Chips are fresh and salted perfect. We even had the kebab on rice and kebab on chips. All 3 meals are great you can't go wrong. I honestly don't know why the ratings and other comments don't match up. We've eaten here 3 times in 1 week, all good experiences. Try it for yourself. You're welcome.

THE BEST PLACE FOR KEBAB IN BOTANY!! The food was delicious and the lady who served us was very helpful in picking sauces! We got 3 large serves and i would highly recommend this place...💯💯🙌 Also we loved how they had few outdoor tables and chairs.
Thank you for the yummy food! My daughter really love it! Asking meat meat meat I want meat lol 😊

I don't understand the kebabs, they aren't wrapped in a circle, they seem to be just folded over in half, very odd to me. And all the sauce over the chicken just doesn't seem like any kebabs anywhere else. Not sure about the other food available , it may be very nice, but the way the kebabs fall apart just doesn't work for me. I see someone reviews it as the best in botany which kind of makes me wonder if they've actually tried anywhere else.

Tried Aladdin Kebab for the first time and it definitely won’t be the last! I had the kebab both as a wrap and on rice – and both were absolutely delicious. The meat was tender and full of flavour, and everything tasted fresh. A great first experience.

Disappointing Experience – All Dosas Taste the Same! We ordered three different types of dosas: • Mysore Masala Dosa • Hara Bhara Masala Dosa • Maharaja Dosa Sadly, they all tasted exactly the same — plain potato sabzi inside, with no noticeable difference in flavor, ingredients, or spice level. The only thing that changed was the name and the price. When we brought this to the manager’s attention, all they said was “sorry.” No explanation, no attempt to make things right. Overall: Not worth the money. If you’re expecting variety, flavor, or something special, don’t waste your time or money here. Please be aware — don’t fall for fancy names.

$17.99 WEEKEND B’FAST BUFFET - I have only tried their buffet. Dosa Plaza delivered and served a classic variety of South Indian breakfast. They have Vegan options too. My partner and I enjoyed the breakfast spread. All of the dishes had taste to it, idli wasn’t sour, and the consistency of their chutneys and sambar were good and not too thick or watery. They were how they’re supposed to be. 👌🏽 My favourite was their peanut chutney, sambar, vada and kesari. Their poori & dosa texture (which was served very thin at first) and to change their coffee to a paper cup instead of plastic was very well and humbly received by the person who was managing the restaurant. Plenty of seating area, the price is simply incredible for the food served, the waiter here had a lovely smile and was ready to assist all around. A nice choice to dine in as a family for breakfast over the weekend. Let’s give them a fair chance to deliver and support local businesses. 😊

Third class food, using corn flour in making Sambhar, alloo is smelly, how many corners can you cut????? Bloody shameless all Indian restaurants serving crap food they gave no conscious and dignity. Its not sambhar but bloody South Indian flavoured Gravy it is🤬 Idli has foul smell. Shameful!

Such creative food with plenty of options! I've already been there five times, and I love trying something new each visit—everything is absolutely delicious. The restaurant is spacious and beautifully set up for dining in. Highly recommended! If you’re a fan of dosa, they make the best in Auckland.

I'm hoping that the owners are reading the reviews that the irate consumers have left. Along with one paneer onion uttapa, I ordered three masala dosas. I had to ask them to check and let me know if the prices were reasonable given the amount of potato sabji in the masala dosa. Fortunately, the man serving us understood and went back to the chef, they redo it and added little more sabji which was tasteless. The onion paneer uttapa was undercooked and contained small, plain chunks of paneer, as if someone had added them as a favour.

Absolutely packed with flavour — the loaded spuds are next level! Generous portions, fresh ingredients, great price, and fast, friendly service. Spudfull is comfort food done right — a must-try in Ōtara- Auckland!

I swear I couldn't finish my meal because my plate was just so jammed packed 🤤 Flavours 🔥 Spuds 🔥 Service 🔥 Presentation 🔥 Combinations 🔥 I work just around the corner from this place & I've been contemplating on buying it for months. I'm so glad I finally made the move. My work mates also enjoyed it as much as I did. Looks like we walking back up at least once a week 😂

The store is amazing, u get the most delicious n portion-satisfying food, warm n welcoming services. Creamy chicken mushroom is a must-try, flavourful cheese, juicy corn n crispy fried onion mixing gives u the best taste. Had the tacos too, let him know that if u want it dripping cos the owner was considerate n didn’t want ur shirt to get dirty.

First time trying & can say it was so flavoursome and delicious!!! We’re huge fans of Spudbros in the UK so when we heard about this, we couldn’t wait to try it. Definitely will go back again, 10/10🤩 And the worker there was lovely and very welcoming.
Incredible. Such a good amount of food, so filling and delicious. Got the chicken and mushroom. Was absolutely 🔥 dude was a legend too

We have always loved the fish and chips here, but our recent visits have been quite disappointing. They have definitely changed the type of oil they use and the quality of food has definitely gone down. After reading recent reviews, the ownership has changed, which explains the difference so wont be returning.

I orderd lemon chicken, n they gave me some artivial flavoured syrup separately which ddnt even taste like lemon and dry chicken and rice. The chicken was not even cleaned properly,, Worse food experience in NZ o far,, 0/5

This place has gone downhill for sure. All staff are rude and most dont even understand english. The beef stirfry consists of 80% broccoli, possibly more, cant even find the meat. The sweet and sour pork is mostly flour coating and the sauce tastes horrible. The chips were old and stale. If you're going to hike up the prices, at least make quality food.
We’ve been coming here for years. Their fish, chips, sweet & sour are our mains. The chips are so crispy and it always tastes so fresh and it’s not oily and greasy.

I experienced one of the worst customer service incidents with the lady in the attached image. After being loyal customers and frequently ordering from this business, we received a shocking level of service. We ordered three dishes and paid for them, only to have the packages rip and the food spill everywhere. Instead of apologizing for the situation, she gathered the mixed and contaminated food from three different dishes and put it into another bag, along with the spilled contents. When I asked her to at least clean it up and provide a fresh replacement, she argued with me.also she was trying to charge me again for the Sauce after I asked to give me another one . I will never come back to this place and will be sharing this experience across all social media platforms. This business clearly does not value its customers or their satisfaction. Avoid this place at all costs!

Worst creamy Paua I've tasted barely any Paua that it taste like cream on chips. The steak in the chop suey was burnt and dry. The potato salad was alright but all round wouldn't recommend the poly dishes

They call them selves choice kai I highly doubt they stand up to the name I have ordered creamy paua burger steak and chips omg where was the paua I mostly seen sauce and to even say spear it on the steak steak was like thin as did not enjoy the meal and was definitely not worth the money will never be ordering from here again no thank you

Always ordered on uber eats & food has always been great!!! Finally went into the store and ate, service was great 100%! Husband and his wife were amazing people so kind & spoke openly with respect! Love the food, food was hot, filled with so much flavour & didn’t have to wait long. Great service over all!

The food here is so good, I can see myself picking food from here regularly. It’s great to have a quick bite for a tea time snack or for a good meal. The service of the staff is very professional yet homely. It’s great for some munchies after a good swim or run. Highly recommend eating from here cuz it reminds me of food made in my hometown.

I had such a lovely experience at Choice of Kai! From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere was incredibly friendly and welcoming. The food options were fantastic, offering a great variety that caters to different tastes. But the absolute highlight for me was the homemade Biscoff cheesecake—honestly, it was just wow! So delicious, rich, and full of flavour, and the presentation was beautiful too. You can truly tell it was made with care. I absolutely loved it and can’t wait to go back!

It's our first time, it was for a birthday party, live band was so awesome we enjoy and loved it alot, food was also delicious and fresh, totally recommended for small party, family functions or any occasions, it's our new venue to look at when we have our next celebrations. Customer service from one of the waiters and the Band, was so good, beautiful decor and settings.

Bad experience with them, i will never ever use this catering. Service was terrible and had to pick up the food ourselves after we agreed on the time for drop off. Only 3 hours my son birthday and food arrived an hour before closing. Missing some off the menu items, wasn’t reimbursed for those things that were missed. It was my first time using catering and you assume it’s meant to be stress free. But nope I was embarrassed my guest had to wait for the food. If you are the owner of this catering the decent thing to do is reply to my message and take ownership for your faults.

Did not want to do this but I have no choice because im sick of all the back and forth lies from them. Booked my sisters wedding with talimanao but 2 months before the wedding we had to cancel as our family members had offered to cater. the full price of the catering was $16,000 and we had paid her $13,500, upon cancelling she had informed us that we would receive - refund of $11,500 on the 18 of November which was literally 8 days before the wedding come the 18 of November we contact her and she tells us that she does not have the money for us. 3 days later we contact her again and she tells us she has only got $3000 for us. Day before the wedding come and we contact her about the money and she tells us to wait a few more days then she will get the money to us. Long story short it has now been 1 month and almost 2 weeks since the wedding has finished and still we have not got our full refund back and she keeps giving us specific days and time she will come and give the money but she never turns up unless we go to her then she postpones when she will give the money. So sick of going back and forth with her we just want our refund because she still gets to keep $2000 of our money as her deposit. HIGHLY DO NOT RECOMMEND BOOKING IN WITH THEM.
