They wouldn’t pick up their calls, turned off their mobile phones and as a result most of our guests left without food! So embarrassing! Especially for an island funeral with no food because the caterers decided to come hours later with no notifications! To add on top no apologies for the delay, dropped off food and left!! What a way to send off my uncle with his family/guests leaving without food! Would you provide this type of service to your family members talimanao? I don’t think so. How worst can you get? Why provide a service if you can’t deliver!! Yes the worst catering company out! Not reliable! Quick to respond when it comes to money!!! but when it’s to deliver they turn up late and turn off all communications!! Beware!! We will be spreading the word of mouth of how bad your service is!! I would recommend Mama Silas Catering as since then we have been using them. Not talimanao!!! A joke!

This place is amazing. I’m sitting in here at the moment while writing this review. Obviously food caters for the island community but not limited to. The live band playing is incredible. I think it’s worth every dollar you pay for. The venue is a little run down but the vibe itself makes up for it. Definitely would be back given the opportunity. Well done Talinanao. 5 star from me 😊😊😊

Amazing service and sushi once again. Bruce is a very genuine customer service orientated man. Extremely friendly as his wife and staff. He remembered me from many visits 10+ years ago. You don't get that anywhere else.
I order this and request for wasabi and soy sauce the woman who take my order kinda rude says it’s already inside , but when I check it no soy sauce and a little bit wasabi only 🥲
Called to ask what time they were closing, hung up on me after telling me. Called back to make an order and as im telling the lady my order she screams KEVIN! KEVIN! Then hangs up on me again.

I’ve been coming to the botany junction shop since I was 6-7yrs old I’m 20 now so that’s a long time all I have to say is best sushi hands down i only eat Bruce lee sushi because the other sushi places don’t taste the same every time I come to the shop I always get recognised and the workers always treat me with respect thank you for the best sushi n customer service !!!
The best sushi 🍣 in town! Botany Bruce Lee sushi Has been my go to for the last 15 years and it has never disappointed! A+ customer service and food. Thankyou Bruce and team! - Jason

Loved it so much! If I could eat it everyday I would! Lols. I was on holidays from Brisbane & I was wanting roast veg without all the mahi so I popped in for veg but ended up getting the bbq pork on rice & dammmn it was yummy ! I think I ordered the same thing 3x that I was there! Honestly so yummy I wish we had something like this here in Bris!

Love this place! Always great food consistently. We used to live nearby and came here often. We live quite far away now but still pop in for a good roast when in Otara. Love those crispy golden potatoes and Joanne's friendly chat. I highly recommend this establishment.

Brought 2 medium pork meals and fish and chips. Very happy with our dinner tonight. Another visit to Tasty roast. Brought for $17, 3 fish, 3 hot dogs, 3 sausage and $3 chips. Good feed for our small family. Great service as well.

Prices are good and the service is friendly and fine, but it would be very nice to see some basic redecorating done. Sometimes the roast beef has been chewy but roast pork has generally been quite good. It is good to have the family business service available in this area.

I don’t know about the best crispy pork but it’s better than some. Keeps changing, one day you’ll get crispy skin the next you get soft skin ( I assume microwave reheated) pork rolls ok but needs salad to balance the fatty off cuts of pork
As usual they make their food with love. I love going and having some healthy food in this little takeaway in east tamaki :) I have also added the new menu as there is a price difference, can check.

The restaurant offers an affordable lamb kebab priced at $12, though the meat appeared dry and lacked the expected quality. The ambiance could be improved, as flies were present inside. Consider revisiting the takeaway options.

When we first tried Taza's they pretty much only served every kind of Kebab you could ever want and the most perfect whole chickens. The kids love kebabs. Now, they have gone a step further with their menu and added southern fried chicken and are doing the meal packs as well. The burgers and chips they do are real burgers and chips in every sense of the word. To die for!!! Give it a go you won't be disappointed. Oh yeah, almost forgot... Very affordable. Enjoy people x

I don’t Recommend! we ordered fried chicken & chips smashed it back, Chicken looked Cooked but I think it was Contaminated, me & my Partner woke up the next day with Food poisoning. We won’t be returning.
Very cool and nice place, food is perfect you have to try this, the best place in South Auckland

First time trying and it was great hot seasoned chips and chicken, beef kebab on rice yum and the biggest beef burger was tasty. Well priced also, il be back again and i hope it’s the same! Downfall is the tables not wiped and flys
Butter chicken was terrible barely any chicken and the sauce was the worst I’ve had by far
Lamb shanks were cold. Even the bone was cold. Probably needed more time to defrost.
Don’t waste your money on this place! Extremely terrible service.
Niceeee food and

The food is bomb and it was masssive esp them sausages never seen anything like it 😂 !!!! The food was still hot when it arrived and I must say that was one of the best combinations we had!!! Yall need to try it (massive mix grill) , I ordered through uber but didn’t know how to rate on there 😂 omggg the mushroom sauce is the best in the game 🔥

I placed an order for two Grilled NZ Rump steak combos through Uber Eats last night. The total cost of the order was $82, which I found to be excessive given the quality of the food. The steaks were overcooked and chewy, and the mushroom sauce lacked flavor and tasted more like gravy. Overall, the quality of the food was not satisfactory. Never again
Their flow burger is one of the best burgers I have had in a while. I get the feeling this place is going to blow up
Just had a chicken combo. Chicken smelt and tasted like fish, disgusting. Never again

To be very fair, I loved their fried rice the first time I bought from them which was why I returned for more. I also tried some other dishes which were not too bad. I thought I found my go-to place for takeaways but the second time I got them, the rice was slightly hard but still tasted decent. Third time, rice was overcooked and soft and tasted bland. This time, just looking at the colour of the rice was enough for me to know how it was gonna taste. I tried it and sure enough, it tasted really sad. Never going back again. 2 stars only because of their service. Staff was really friendly and nice.

Very good price with generous portion. Interior is clean and tidy. I would recommend trying their porridges and snacks. My personal favourites were vegetable pancake and pork pancake (韭菜盒子 and 豬肉餡餅), the fillings were really tasty.
My poor teeth, just chewed a big rock in a fresh beef onion steamed bun

The wonton soup was not good and I’m not a fussy person but I was so shocked at my soup, there was absolutely no effort made, wontons were basically empty, mostly the wonton itself with a tiny bit of meat, the soup was bare, would not recommend it, the server was super nice but I have to apologise, I will never be returning again. ADDITION: I spoke to a friend because I needed clarification and she explained that this is a more northern style wonton soup which is how they are regularly made, so will change from 1 stars to 2, it’s definitely a preferred taste

mixed feelings as the staff are very lovely and courteous. Food is also lovely which i come often for the seaweed soup and pork buns. however the last time i came and bought soup, i noticed green microplastics in it, and for sure it was from the green chopping boards they use to cut their food up. i highly recommend moving onto wooden chopping boards. got put off from buying their other food items.

Best pizza for miles! Always hot, fresh and tasty. Lots of delicious toppings and ready on time. Fast delivery or plenty of car parks available for pickup, either park right outside on the street or park around the back and use the second entrance to the store. Also: if you haven’t tried the Unholy Donut, you are missing out!
Very expensive don’t bother getting the garlic bread. It’s no good. Get it from Domino’s but the pizzas are good. Very good. Don’t bother with the garlic. No one can be Domino’s garlic bread.
Delicious pizza! Staff were friendly and ensured my pizza turned out perfect (I was told they made it again because it wasn't cooked properly the first time)
Food and customer service has always been good, establishment has changed ownership and the quality has still remained excellent

Hells pizza used to be delicious. This was the last time I had one. No difference to low cost fast food now. This place felt dirty, bathroom had broken tap and no running water! What once was a great brand stopped evolving and now is on the way out. RIP Hells Pizza. Sad and disappointing.
Delicious! Best Indian food I've had in NZ. Reminded me of the authentic Indian food in India. Friendly service with a smile. Highly recommended and we'll definitely be back.

Had driven past multiple times and thought I would try a takeaway. Was pleasantly surprised, food was good and freshly prepared. I tried the banquet for two to taste a number of dishes. Would definitely recommend it as an option, lots of tasty food. Will definitely be back to try some other dishes😊

We went here tonight for dinner for the first time. Food was delicious service was awesome, the place was clean and the vibe was just perfect. The prices was good as well. I had the butter chicken and garlic Naan and my partner had the Karachi chicken and Naan bread plus we got some sweets. Needless to say we left there very satisfied and super FULL :) A definite must try people! We will definitely be back!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Absolutely Delicious! We had the best cholle bhature we’ve ever tasted in Auckland at Punjab Express! The flavors were authentic, the bhature were perfectly fluffy, and the cholle were rich and full of taste. Prices are very reasonable, making it great value for such high-quality food. The service was friendly and quick too. Highly recommend visiting if you’re craving real Punjabi/Indian food, we’ll definitely be going back again soon. Thanks for the amazing experience! 🙏

We had dinner and got the Special Banquet for 2 which is good value for money at $44 Which was chicken tikka, pakora with yummy tamarind chutney, 2 non vege curries with plain naan. We selected (mild) butter chicken and goat curry both very good. We also ordered a garlic cheese naan which was yum. We ate in and Food was quick to come out and premises was clean and nicely decorated. Good to know we have a good local indian restaurant in the neighbourhood. Def recommend!
The food is so good here, definitely worth the money. Love the special dishes for $10 every week! Have tried the fried chicken & chips, a few dishes, home made dumplings as well. So yuuuuuum！
best shrimp soup rice noodle soup I ever have, must try. And don’t miss the chicken wing, so so so juicy and tasty! Yummy !

Food Review: The Fish noodle soup, Prawn Noodles, and Chicken Wings Here Are Simply Amazing! I recently visited a hidden gem of an Asian food, and after just one try, I’m hooked! Their fish noodle soup has an absolutely divine broth—rich, flavorful, and slightly milky, perfectly complementing the silky smooth rice noodles. Every bite is pure enjoyment. The prawn noodles are just as impressive. The broth is so rich and deep in flavor, as if it had been simmered for hours. The prawn essence is intense but not overpowering, and the noodles soak up the soup beautifully, delivering layers of taste with every mouthful. If you love seafood, this is a must-try. And I have to mention their fried chicken wings—an unexpected highlight! The crispy skin is fried to perfection, giving a delightful crunch, while the inside remains juicy and tender. They’re marinated just right, bursting with savory goodness, and paired with their special dipping sauce, it’s simply irresistible. In summary, this place is on another level. From the broth to the ingredients and cooking techniques, everything is executed flawlessly. Absolutely worth a visit—I’ll definitely be back!

5 months later We gave them another chance which gave us surprise. We tried the burgers and we were amazed by them. It is better than McDonald and even those burger shop. I tried Chicken special with fries and drink for $12 and my husband tried deluxe burger. May be because the shop has changed the owner so it is getting better now. Hope it keeps it up. ———————————————- Small portion costing $15. It used to be my common takeaway but the prices have gone up so many times and become unreasonable. Even worse the noodles is so salty. Will not go back anymore.

A tiny shop but cooks great dishes. I find their food a little on the salty side but the taste is great. Large portion and fantastic value for money. The service is very friendly and can be a short wait during peak hours. Although prices has risen from a year ago, certainly hope their prices remain as I think it's priced just right and they will continue to flourish in this price range. Recommended.

If you're craving a taste of Hong Kong, look no further! This cafe nails the authentic experience. The steam rice rolls were perfectly executed, the milk tea rich and creamy, and the lemon coke exactly as I remember it from my trips to Hong Kong. Beyond the food, the staff were incredibly friendly and welcoming, the menu offered a great variety, and parking was a breeze. All this at reasonable prices – highly recommended!

Was really excited to see this restaurant opening in Flat Bush. But after a few visit, i still can’t pick anything that really stood out, the food was pretty average imo. They said their BBQ pork’s their signature dish but I would not recommend it at all as it’s wayyyyy too fatty. I’d say 90% of it it’s fat. Though their milk tea’s quite nice.
Baked rice was delicious with lots of cheese and sauce. Beef rice noodles stir fry could have been better using thinner rice noodles. It was too thick this time. Fried rice needed more ingredients.
Clay pot rice is ok,but cold dish (fish skin) taste weird and may not be real fish.
Friends gathering here. Nice food & fast service.

Absolutely amazing home cooked meals! They cater to your daily lunches and dinners and also take party orders. The cutlets and chutney I got today were delicious. The dahi vada were great too. I have been eating their home cooked meals since 2020 and highly recommend it 👌 to everyone. Thankyou Nainy kitchen 😊

Naina always provided best ‘ghar ka khana’ (home cooked food). It’s always top-notch ingredients and the taste is excellent! Prices are reasonable and it has consistently been great tasting food for the numerous times I have ordered. I will only be ordering from her as I know it will always be fantastic and healthy food unlike what you get elsewhere which is drenched in oil. Thanks Naina :-)

Thank you for serving us with your service and yummiest delicacies while our Kitchen renovations were going on. It’s been completed now. We will continue to use your services.
Delicious homemade food. We ordered for the first time and will surely be going back. Thank you so much for your services.
Love their food ! Yummy and healthy
Unmatched atmosphere, highly recommend.
Very welcoming people
lovely munch
Very helpful staff ! Great coffee. It can get really crowded between 3:30pm and 6:00pm .
don't order uber eats from this place. They cancelled my order straight away and i was still charged.
Always friendly service at Wild Bean.
Morning starts with wild bean😊
Just got my petrol

Thank you Sam's Kebab for serving up some incredibly delicious cheeseburgers. The burgers were huge with fresh salad, and bursting with flavor. Hello all. I was absolutely dumbfounded upon tasting Sam’s Kebab, my friend had gassed this place up so I just has to try it !! AND THIS DID NOT DISAPPOINT, like everything was seasoned to perfection, the meat was nice and juicy. For the price of $18 i think the mixed meat on chips with cheese and a drink is very divine and extremely exquisite and worth it. I recommend this place 10/10. Thanks for having us Sam’s Kebabs.

Have dined in three times since it's been under new management and each time it's been consistently delicious and left feeling full and satisfied. Generous portions, yummy food and friendly staff. Will definitely be back again. Favourite kebab and Afghani food eatery in Ormiston 👌🏼

Real pizza thats quality and affordable. Staff were friendly and helpful, there are seats if you want to eat in and wooden cutlery to use. Flavour of both the pasta (cooked perfectly) and the pizza 🍕 were on point. Highly recommend.
These guys make the best pizza in my humble opinion, no really you have try their pizza, unbelievably delicious.

Absolutely delicious! We ordered the Margherita pizza, Butter Chicken pizza, and Chicken Alfredo pasta — and every dish was packed with flavor. The wood oven makes a real difference — the Margherita had that perfect balance of crisp crust, fresh tomato, and gooey mozzarella. The Butter Chicken pizza was a standout — just the right amount of spice. And the Chicken Alfredo pasta? So creamy and satisfying with generous portions of tender chicken. Highly recommend for anyone craving authentic wood-fired goodness and bold flavors. Will definitely be back!
Amazing fantastic tiny pizza. And real delicious loaded fries. So good. Great service

ABSOLUTELY DELICIOUS!!!! 😋 Oh my goodness so delicious I could eat here everyday. The pizzas are so fresh and have this beautiful crispy, almost nann bread crust. Toppings are so fresh and tasty. The staff are super friendly and welcoming. The establishment is so clean and tidy. I could write paragraphs about this place. I'll simply say thank you for making us the most yummy pizza and fries and thank you for making us welcome 🙏

Wonderful experience at Zana, humble polite and helpful staff, very knowledgeable!! Yummy food and great portion. Also, reasonable price. Right opposite to town center with plenty of free parking on street. The staff recommended great dishes and clean tidy place even during busy peak hours. The portion of plate is enough for two if you are not big eaters. Best Thai Halal place in Auckland!!

In celebration of mother's day this year, I decided to treat my family to an amazing delicacy from Zana in Ormiston. With them, it's never a miss. Tasty, crunchy, well seasoned snapper fish in garlic sauce. This is my second time here, and I'm most certain it's not the last. Thumbs up, Zana Ormiston!!!

"5/5 STARS! I recently had the pleasure of celebrating my friend’s birthday at ZANA restaurant in Ormiston, and I must say, the manager and team exceeded all my expectations! Not only was the food DELICIOUS and HALAL, but the manager's exceptional service, attention to detail, and kindness made our experience truly unforgettable! The manager worked with me to plan a surprise birthday celebration for my family, and they did a SPLENDID JOB! The decorations, cake, and special birthday touches were all perfectly executed! And the best part? The price was VERY REASONABLE! We were blown away by the quality of food and service we received for the price! I highly recommend ZANA to anyone looking for a fantastic dining experience! The manager and team truly go above and beyond to ensure their guests feel welcome and valued! Thank you again to the manager and team at ZANA for making my friend’s birthday celebration so special! Will definitely be back!"
Had ordered takeaway last night from here and the food was amazing. Have found my favourite Thai food spot.

Excellent atmosphere. Great customer service. Manager comes personally to the table and asks if we require anything else. Hundred percent HALAL. Delicious food. Wide variety of food options to choose from. Accommodating on dietary requirements as well. Overall we had a great experience and cant wait to come back! :)

Me and my partner decided to give this place a try. Around 7:45 PM we've arrived as we decided to have dinner, it's Thursday as of the time I'm making this review and on their Google Map timetable, it states they close at 9 PM but then later we're told it was 8:30 PM, it felt rather rushed and misleading and a lot of rushing in terms of eating our food. I'd recommend fixing that if possible, thanks! In terms of service, we are happy with their overall communication for both the menu and what would be best recommended for our dining experience. We went ahead and got a milkshake and a chocolate milkshake, both were delivered in a speedy and manner, both tasted very amazing! For our mains, we decided to get porkchop and fried rice and a butter chicken with rice and bread. They both were really amazing, definitely recommend! I'd definitely recommend this place, I've seen some reviews that you'd think would affect your overall service and experience, but it really doesn't seem to be that way, I'd personally give it a try if it's your first time as there is always a first for everything!

Friendly service. Walked in for breakfast at 9am and no other patrons were there. Ordered coffee, no complaints. Overall, the food disappointed. Big breakfast was good but cant say the same for everything else we had. Mince on soggy toast was not nice, microwave heated salmon bagel with soggy lettuce and tomato, almond croissant also microwave heated as it was so chewy the toppings fell off when biting into it as a knife couldn't cut through. Glad we didn't pay full price. If this remains the standard, we defintely won't be back.

Had the best creamy mushrooms I have ever had! Food was so delicious, my partner had the eggs Benedict and said it was so yummy. Staff are really friendly and welcoming. I will definitely be coming back!!
The craziest freakshake like a candy house that satisfy all your sweet cravings. Love the cozy and casual dining ambient. We tried the unicorn and salted camarel. It was yummy!

Me with my Husband and Daughter, been here at Ormiston Cafe and Bistro for First time. What made us very impressive at first as friendly manner of a Waitress attending us and giving us a table of Three. Going through the Menu, we ordered kids Fish and Chips, Garlic Prawns, Auckland surprisingly knowing by the Attendant telling us about special dish, Dumplings and for which what I wanted but was not in Menu. We happily ordered Chicken Dumplings as well. Very beautifully served Hot Chocolates, those creating with name, presentable. Food we had was so delicious, and of course, worth. Loved it. Definitely will come here again. Keep up this amazing job.

It was my first time trying a burrito, so I was a bit nervous, but the staff member was so kind and explained everything to me and even helped me choose from the menu. Thanks to them, I really enjoyed my meal. My first burrito was a success! Huge thanks to the staff member working on Friday, July 4th at 2:30 PM – you were incredibly kind!

For lunch, we stopped by California Burrito in Ormiston and were thoroughly impressed. The menu offers a great selection, the staff were efficient and helpful, and the food was fresh and full of flavour. We ordered the Quesadilla with beef mince, the Burrito with Cali Chicken, and a side of fries. Everything was served hot and tasted delicious. It’s a fantastic spot for a quick and satisfying meal — definitely worth a visit!

Got a burrito combo and nachos. Food was mean. Guy was a g as it was my first time there. Burrito was well balanced with beans cooked right and well wrapped! Fries were well seasoned and hot even after taking home. Nachos were decent too Highly recommend as a local mexi spot.

The server was nice, very polite man and the physical appearance of the location was nice it drew my attention, that’s why I thought I’d try it. I even texted my boyfriend super excited that I may have found a new food spot, sending him pictures of the menu and the interior. I wish I never did. I wasted my $24 honestly. If it was Ubereats, at least I would’ve gotten my refund. Instead today for whatever reason, I did takeaway, and didn’t even bother opening the box because the guy had rolled the whole bag up to go and my uber was already arriving. When I got home and opened the bag, the chicken burritos I got looked like someone shredded chicken in a blender with sour cream and seeds then loaded it on a tortilla with cheese from the ground. Then I thought don’t judge a book by its cover, try it. It was equally as bad. It had so many onions, it was more wet than saucey. Like seriously, the chicken was LITERALLY wet there (a clump dropped out the other end of the taco and I picked it up to squeeze it and it was all this wet liquid leaking out). It was disgusting. Honestly the only thing I enjoyed was the Jarritos cola. It was great, but if I just wanted a cola, I would’ve just gone into any other store.
What a lovely place to have burrito! It was tasty and delicious. The couple was so welcoming and amazing. Definitely going there for our next burrito craving. 🥰

Hired event centre for gender reveal. Agreed to pricing and food menu, then they put price up after we agreed to hire the venue. On the day of event entrees came in paper plates and no plates for 8 guests on each table to eat in. When we asked for plates they gave 1 extra plate for the table of 8. Entrees had 4 pieces of satay chicken and 4 pieces of fried chicken. Not enough for each guest on the table. We shouldn’t have to leave the event and ask for what should be done but we had to as guests were complaining they didn’t get any entree. You pay so much for an event and they only had 1 staff there doing everything. Dinner time came and guests were waiting, food was not ready. Had to call the owner and ask what’s going on and then he came down from his restaurant to help out. Dinner was finally served but then again only with small entree paper plates and a few big paper plates. Had to ask for more plates so guests could eat dinner. We had asked for fried fish for entree too which came out at dinner time very cold. So all of the fried fish was taken back. We had asked for ice cream for dessert and we weren’t given that either. When we called owner to compensate money back, he said he has to pay staff and all that. But did not care our event was ruined and we did not get 2 items from what we agreed on after he had increased the price. Very unprofessional, we had events here before which was quoted for a cheaper price and we were provided with proper plates. Don’t know why they hire out places when they don’t have staff or proper utensils the same as every other event provided by them. Don’t recommend and will never go back to Zana again. 👎👎

Very poor "customer service". Had a reservation made, when we arrived it was already full and no tables were available for us. Was told to sit at an empty booth with no table and waited for staff to attend. 4 times we approached staff to see if they were able to clear a table for us, and not one staff member was helpful or able to assist us. We ended up leaving. Very disappointing as we were looking forward to a halal iftaari buffet. We will not be returning and will not be recommending to anyone!
Did not get what i order and the drinks where left out when the food arrived would not recommend
Delicious food and my order got delayed and he threw in 3 drinks 2 burgers boneless chicken and steak on chips at his own cost what a guy!
Food was so amazing and staff was so friendly n awsome must recommend place

Our first time trying Pizza Boys, we normally order Pizza Hut or dominoes but we’re always disappointed so we decided to order from here and honestly one of the best decisions made. We ordered the “Monday & Tuesday” Deal 2 Large Pizzas for $32.00 so worth it! Creamy Bacon and Mushroom Pizza - this was cooked to perfection! The crust was so crisp and cheesy, exactly how you’d imagine a pizza. It was so good. Banana & Caramel pizza - this was interestingly delicious, again cooked perfect, not overcooked or undercooked. something we haven’t had before so everyone should at-least give it a try! We will be back and would love to try other flavours!

Had a mishap with my first order from here as I was given the wrong order and hence didn't enjoy it. But I was offered a free pizza to make up for the mistake which was amazing service. I ordered Hot and Sour Chicken Pizza this time and it was super tasty, will be returning with that standard of food and service 😊

Amazing Pizza & Top-Notch Service! I’ve been to PizzaBoyz Flatbush five times already if not more, and every visit has been fantastic! The food is always fresh, delicious, and made with care. This time, I had the pleasure of meeting Rana, who made my pizza’s, what a great guy! His customer service was outstanding, and he ensured everything was perfect. The quality and consistency keep me coming back, and I’ll definitely be ordering again in the future. Highly recommend this place if you’re looking for top-tier pizza and amazing service!
Butter chicken pizza is amazing! Quality pizza not like the others! Wings and garlic bread were awesome!

I recently had the pleasure of dining at Pizza Boyz, and I must highlight the exceptional service provided by Staff Rana. Not only was he incredibly professional, but he also delivered excellent customer service, making sure our experience was top-notch. What truly stood out, however, was his culinary skill—his pizzas were absolutely delicious! The combination of great service and fantastic food made our visit truly memorable. I highly recommend Pizza Boyz, especially if you’re lucky enough to have Rana taking care of you.
Delicious food, big portions, well priced, fast service, great spot, highly recommend! Pictured is the cucumber salad, kungpao chicken, beef dumplings - very yummy!

Lovely light and airy, modern restaurant. Amazing Chinese Food, cooked with love and pride. Best Eggplant dish I have ever had, eggplant in garlic sauce on rice. Other dishes were beautiful as well. Lovely waitress, very helpful and accommodating. This must be one of the best Chinese places in Auckland. We will come back when visiting. Sadly we live in Wellington, a long way to drive.

Visitor in NZ, was looking for veg dumplings. Came after lunch session and staff were eating their meal. This did not stop them from being very accommodating. They told me that all boiled dumplings are made in same water stock, so pure veg steamed will take another 15mins. I was happy to wait and I wasn't disappointed. Thank you very much
Decent northern Chinese food. Dumplings could be more flavoursome. Pork very nice. Basic kind of decor. Worth a visit for a decent meal.

New place in the neighbourhood for Chinese cuisine. Dishes are quite big portion and price is reasonable. We had the dumpling which had really soft dumpling skin and nice filling. The soup is a bit bland though. We had the 炒饼 which is also a bit bland.

Came here today for lunch. Ordered the crispy chicken combo. The chicken cooked to perfection. Crispy on the outside and deliciously moist when you bit into it. Fries did not disappoint😊👍🏻. The lady who served us polite and friendly, excellent customer service. Highly recommend this place. 😊⭐⭐⭐⭐🌥stars.😋❤

The food here was average. The burger was cold and flavourless and the epic fries were unfortunately pretty sloppy. Overall not a very satisfying meal and probably will not be ordering from here again.

I do really love better burger like the salad one cheap but tasty also the onion rings .y daughter and 2 kids always going there .The 1.lady and a guy also are nice staffs I can't say nothing at all smoothly good and nice Better burger .
We ordered Spicy chicken burger and cheese burger Veges were crunchy and fresh, filled all the way! Staffs were very friendly Perfect weekend lunch for us😊

Came here for late lunch with my brother today and OMG it was devine! the food was fresh and hot while being really well seasoned. The restaurant was calm and didn’t feel rushed, and as we were leaving the employee offered us a free drink refill which wrapped up the experience perfectly! i’d defiantly visit again and recommend to others, so delicious!

Coffee is quite good, very cute cafe overall. However the food wasn’t great. The cake was 100% from frozen and tasted like freezer-burn. At $5.50, it’s pretty appalling. Even my toddler wouldn’t have it. They’d be better off tripling the price of a supermarket cake. It was also very old and the dollop of icing had crusted. The bagel was just okay, very thin and crispy. Not the fluffy bagel I’d wanted, more like toast.

If you’re going just for coffee or drinks, it’s a decent choice but definitely not for dessert. The tart crust was hard and dry, and the filling was nothing more than thick, sticky jam. I wouldn’t recommend it for dessert.

The food was absolutely divine! I wandered in by chance and couldn’t resist ordering , the display and interior were just too tempting. The service was top-notch, with a lovely gentleman who made us feel so welcome. Portions are great too ! I highly recommend this spot. P.S. The strawberry matcha is a must-try! 🤌

Lovely Cafe in Ormiston. It was a rainy day when I went don’t was fun looking out their large windows. I bet it’s even better on a sunny day. The food was interesting and resonantly priced. Their kids hot chocolates are little bear cups. The place was clean and well presented.
A busy cafe. Welcoming, attentive staff. Quick service. Modern, uplifting ambience. Delectable food and coffee. Plenty of parking. Ticked all the boxes.

It's not often that the food you order is exactly what it looks like in the sample models. This is what you get at Mighty Hotdog. We ordered the Half &Half and Half & Half Potato. One with sugar coated and one without. I liked the sugar coating, but suit yourself

This place is really well presented. I’ve always wanted to try it. It also has the mighty singing booth next door. It all looks really fun for what it is. You order your food on the tablet and await your order. People don’t appear to take your order. This is where the strangest thing happened, I was loading my order up on the tablet and someone came out and told me not to order because they have no dough. I asked why they were open, they didn’t respond. Poor explanation and poor service. I’m still hungry.

This was my 2nd time at this store. The first time the eftpos machine was down and i couldnt purchase anything. Today we purchased 2 hotdogs and popcorn chicken. The hotdogs were as expected. The popcorn chicken was way too salty, almost double salted. We ordered via the kiosk but could see a guy prepping food inside. He was using his phone and watching videos and then without washing hands went onto prepare our food and then carry on watching the video afterwards. I expect better hygiene at a a food store, disappointing.
SO GOOD. Literally said "Omo omo" I'll take a better photo next time.
I went yesterday and even closing time they not rush and soooo yummy hotdogs! 😋

Trans Kitchen in Ormiston offers super fresh and affordable food all at a reasonable price. The lemon grass chicken is always a go to for me because of the beautifully cooked lemongrass chicken, the fragrant salad and rice , and the warm and delicious soup. The portion size is very value for money and is a must try when in the ormiston area🥰.
Ordered fried noodles today but surprisingly, the chef forgot to remove plastic from the food properly. I normally order from this place. Never go back again

First time to be here; friendly and accommodating staff. Price is reasonable for the quality, though serving size is a bit let down. Waiting time is also around 10-15mins which is quite long considering it wasn't a busy day, the summer rolls we reckon had too much rice noodles on them but the dip is to die for! So much room for improvement in here!

They rang my order number so I grabbed the tray. It was my first time eating there so didn't know what my food will look like or realise that they gave me the wrong order. The other customer then proceeded to think I stole their order and gave me bad looks which just made my experience bad. The ladies working there didn't look sorry at all and was even smiling. I liked the food but sadly I won't come back.
Friends and I went out for lunch here. Absolutely loved the food. We ordered the lemongrass chicken and rice. Prawn and Pork Spring rolls. Definitely highly recommend Trans Kitchen.
Great Chinese food and lovely owners. Always good quality and great taste. The bun is the most yum ones and would love to recommend to more people.
A small food place in the neighbourhood of Flat Bush. Serves nice steamed buns and hot soy milk. Price is reasonable and portion is decent. The guy at the counter is super friendly too!
Awesome Chinese food 👌 but bit of a language barrier due to some of the employees non speaking English that's the only down side beside that choice.
Very nice food with really nice people. Their buns and their cooked dishes are all very good
Great place for Maya and krshiva, and I to chill on a Sunday. We love it. The staff speak god English, so, no hassle at all in communicating.
Wasn't too busy when came in for dinner - small dining area. Food came around quickly and hot!! Quite authentic tasting Filipino food also. Would definitely go back for more :)

Newly-opened Filipino restaurant with the usual suspects of Filipino comfort food. Their dining area is a bit small but staff are very accommodating & you have the option to sit at the foodcourt when all the tables in the dining area are taken. Our server was Julian and his service was impeccable. He made sure to let you know when you can expect your food as it’s made to order, none of that “heat & eat”stuff.

Front staff super friendly & helped me understand the menu list. The food came out in 5 minutes or so and was super delicious. The meat went well with the rice and the salad was really good. I got 2 plates which came to $51. (Public holiday prices)
It wasn't busy this evening. Got served straight away. Food was enough and we all thought it was delicious.

Cosy and wholesome food. Good portion size, we shared an entree and had a main each and were very full afterwards. Will come back to try more of the menu. Service is a little slow as they were quite busy for dinner time

If you like fried chicken like me, then Kokodak is the spot! Made fresh to order so your meal is piping HOT & so fresh. I ordered boneless chicken combo with onion sauce on the side, the sauce was delicious & it also came with freshly sliced raw onion rings. Only downfall is limited amount of seating right outside the establishment BUT there is heaps of seating not too far away at the food court. Highly recommend this place.

My favourite Korean Chicken in Auckland!!! Whenever we are near Botany we will always stop here. Chicken is fried perfectly with just enough batter and sauce. Crispy on the outside and juicy inside, cant ask for more. We have tried almost everything in the menu. Its always a mission trying to decide what we want because everything is so tasty~~

I ordered the boneless chicken, half Garlic Soy and half White Onion and it was next level delicious! Perfectly crispy on the outside and tasty, juicy and succulent on the inside. The portions were generous as well. The new owners of this branch have made noticeable improvements and are super friendly and helpful, they recommended my new favourite flavours... that was a hit with the whole family! This will now be my "go to" for my Korean Fried Chicken fix! Highly recommended :)

New owners took over and honestly, it's some of the best chicken I've ever had in Auckland 😍😍😍 The chicken was crispy but still tender and juicy. I'd recommend getting the plain chicken and ordering a few of the sauces so that you can try a variety - white onion dipping sauce was our favourite. I'm a stickler for hot food and the hot/spicy sauce is flaming HOT. Will have to get it again next week 🍗
Lovely Chiken, lovely people!! Chicken is very crispy and yummy. I takeaway Creamy onion, Original crispy, Soy garlic and Spicy one. They all good! Spicy one is very spicy so be careful.

Another fantastic dinner at MooMoo! The food was absolutely delicious, and the service was friendly and attentive. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, making it a great spot to relax and enjoy a meal. Everything was spotless from the sparkling clean toilets to the well-maintained tables. Consistently impressed every time we visit!

Cute little BBQ spot, the time that we went in to dine was mid afternoon before school finished. It was nice a quiet. The meat and fries were really nice, sad that when we had asked to swap the fries to mash, that, they didn't have any left when it wasn't even that busy. The Mac n Cheese was bland, and the pasta was also overcooked and mushy. It tasted more like boxed Mac n Cheese. The Slaw was also quite bland, not much flavor to the sauce, and green apple was the only thing I could taste.... The atmosphere was really chill. I would suggest though, for the high tables with the high seats, that maybe installing rails either under the seats or under the table, or just something that guests can rest their feet on when their sitting on those stools.

We dined here on a Saturday night with our family, sat outside and it was really nice. Between the lot of us, we were able to try a lot of the menu and really enjoyed it. Our only note was that the wings can be a little spicy, so from a bunch of us with low spice tolerance - be warned 😂 The staff was lovely and very accommodating. Highly recommend for groups or even just couples/a few friends would be really nice too.

Very nice staff. Asian lady was very helpful and kind. Thank you. Got the $45 Wagyu. And illusion drink $20. I liked the Macncheese and the chips but the meat was a 4/5 for me. Maybe it's just me but I'll have to try some other items on the menu before I can fully say.

Just love eating at MooMoo portion is very very generous food is incredible and friendly staff finger licking wagyu beef brisket burger just melts in your mouth just perfect one of the best burgers in ormiston must try burger! came every week for this burger and also other dishes like nachos, short ribs, pork ribs and more and $8 beer nothing can go wrong every menu we tried was just perfect and delicious oh and the brownies are sooooo good

Ordered a tofu don on the 14th of August. It was way too oily. And could use more veggies and less rice. Not the best value or flavor for the price. However, before this incident, we have purchased tuna nigiri as well as some sushi from this place, and they have been nice.
The food is always the highlight, especially when it's served in the actual ceramic bowl instead of takeaway packaging. The spicy pork donburi is my favorite dish.
Sushi are not the cheapest but the range, presentation and taste makes it very appetizing. I see a lot of people order from this place and definitely not a bad choice.
Fresh big portion and wide range of choice. Strongly recommend Unagi(Eel) Don. Spicy Pork Don is amazing as well!

Ordered: A. Chicken miso ramen. 2⭐. Had a weird taste. If you want ramen, better go get Daruma instead, 2 stores away. That qas much better. B. Prawn skewer- 5⭐. Yummy and great crunch. C. Chicken satay- 4⭐. Flavorful and clean.
Worse ever Indian Food, poor food quality. Bad service and staff communications very bad. Portion small and not worth your money don’t bother going there!!! Waste of money!!!
Food was delicious and creamy...we really enjoyed food out there...staffs are friendly and ambience was pleasent and neat. Would definitely recommend...delicious food to enjoy...!
Foods : Quentity and price are reasonable . Food are testy . Customer service needed to improve. Recommend.

Brilliant Samosa chaat and Chole Bhature. Absolute spot on with spices and quantity. Bread pakoras had vast flavours mashing in your mouth all together without any one flavour over powering. Recommend all three dishes. Editing my review to 3 stars from 5 on June 2022 after long closure of restaurant. Chef is changed and restaurant now serves non veg options. Disappointed to say the curries are very watery and Ghee is used too much on every aspect down to naan bread. Chole Bhature also not the same anymore as the chick peas were too hard and not cooked well.
I've enjoyed everything I've had from Madras. It's so great having a good Indian restaurant in our neighbourhood. Love that it's all vegetarian too!

Terrible experience—every time I come here, something has changed. Now they’re saying Katsubi doesn’t serve teriyaki beef anymore. I always customize my bowl with chili powder and sauces, but this time the staff took them away. When I asked why, she said people make a mess. So they’re happy to take your money but don’t want you to actually enjoy your food? I’m done—won’t be coming back to any Katsubi locations to eat dry, bland food.

Katsubi is one of my favorite fast food places, however, this branch has terrible customer service. Today was the third time I arrived 30 mins before their "closing time" and everything was packed away. The staff just sit on their phones, not worrying about their customers. Either get time management or change your closing time on Google.

Katsubi Ormiston has officially lost my support after tonight’s experience. I came in for a quick meal, but were instead met with the worst customer service we’ve encountered in a long time. A young white girl working there, with a noticeable mole near her lip, was incredibly rude from the moment we walked in no greeting, no eye contact, and a clear attitude like she didn’t want to be there. Her demeanor was cold, dismissive, and frankly, unprofessional. To make things worse, the man working alongside her completely ignored us and kept speaking loudly across the counter like we weren’t even standing there. No hospitality, no respect, no basic courtesy. We left feeling more frustrated than fed. A business is only as good as the people running it, and based on tonight, this place is running on fumes.

Katsubi - omriston Bought it 1630 on 28/12 Ordered 3 bowls and all three didn't have enough sauce. The amount of meat in the bowls were not the same as the other katsubi restaurants. Seems like they are giving out less sauce and less chicken. Also less vegetables aswell. For $21.99 that's not a great value anymore.

ORDERED - Udon and chicken soy. Won't go much into it, tasted ok but the attitude from the fairly young Pacific Island girl(20s?) Was like we interrupted her time on her ph. She was huffing and puffing. We are not Katsubi experts and just were asking about the menu she was short and just fed up. Well we won't be coming back again. TASTE: was good though, but the taste wore off.

Absolutely wonderful people, delicious food, food portions, and good prices. We've had lots of Indian food, including a long trip there, and this ranks up there for some of the best Indian foods one can enjoy without going to India itself (and even in India this ranks up there). Excellent spice use and unique twists on classics make it a fun adventure to try old favorites! Very highly recommended!

This has got to be one of my top fav Indian restaurants. I ordered the lamb madras with garlic & cheese naan. Man hands down... best curry I have had in a long time. The food arrived nice and hot and the garlic cheese naan was fresh and you can actually see the cheese pull. At the end the staff gave us some dessert, I forgot the name of it but man it's that syrup ball one and it was so yummy. 10/10 recommend. Portion size is big, 1 curry enough to feed 2 people, lots of gravy and meat. Nice local spot, nice and close and wonderful customer service👏 👍

An unforgettable dinner experience! Went there around 8 o'clock today with my whole family for dinner, and we had the most wonderful dine-in dinner at Bollywood Indian Restaurant. From the moment we walked in, the warm ambiance, elegant Bollywood-themed decor, set the perfect mood for the evening. The staff were extremely attentive and made sure we felt right at home. The service was prompt, friendly, and professional throughout. As for the food – absolutely delicious! Every dish was packed with authentic flavor, perfectly spiced, and beautifully presented. The butter chicken melted in our mouths, the biryani and dosa were rich and aromatic, and the garlic naan was soft and fluffy. You can truly taste the love and tradition in every bite. It’s the perfect place for families, couples, or even a relaxing solo meal. Highly recommend this gem for anyone craving real Indian cuisine in a lovely setting. We’ll definitely be back again soon

I definitely recommend this restaurant! The food here is really delicious. Butter Chicken and Cheesy Garlic Naan are my favorites. They are next level! 🤤😍 I've tried their Masala Dosa and most of their Lamb choices and I also love them all! 🤍 Their Gulab Jamun is so fresh and mouth-watering! I just recently discovered this Indian restaurant with my friends, and since then, I've kept coming back. The ambiance is very cozy too, and most especially, the warm welcome of Vinay and Radhika makes the dining experience even more special. Aside from the delicious food, their exemplary service will make you go back. I am not Indian, but I feel at home every time I eat here. This is now our new go-to Indian restaurant! You'll definitely see me back! 🤍

This has become our go-to place for our Indian food fix, even though we don't live in the neighbourhood. Every curry we've tried, we can't fault. The Dosa is the best in town/NZ. Friendly service. Well done and keep up the great job 👍🏼

Handmade wheat noodles are everywhere, but handmade rice noodles? Not quite. Tender and silky smooth, combined with nice choice of vegetables, aromatics, and sliced meat. They also have a bar with selections of toppings that goes well with their delicious house-made broth noodles, leveling up texture and flavour. Authentic flavours. Close to Ormiston residential, great for lunch visit before your weekly grocery spree.
I had the braised beef noodles, really delish. The beef & broth had such a nice flavour. Crispy duck and the fungi was really lovely as well. Spent ages there and had such a nice long lunch.

"Rainy days are simply perfect with a plate of sizzling stir-fried noodles and the sautéed preserved pork slice with hot chilli pepper! The combination is absolutely heavenly - the chewy noodles soak up all the delicious flavors, while the savory cured meats add that special umami kick. Every bite warms you up from the inside out, making it the ultimate comfort food for gloomy weather. 10/10 would recommend this amazing pairing to chase away the rainy day blues!"
Excellent food with new promotion menu! Great service and nice atmosphere. High recommended 👍🏼👍🏼

The stir-fried pork rice noodles were really delicious — the flavor just keeps getting better! They also offer a nice variety of free side dishes, which was a great surprise. And the staff was super friendly and welcoming. I’ll definitely be coming back again! I really enjoy it！！

Food quality is same as any St. Pierre sushi.. ordered a few rice balls for my family, noticed that I didn't have any serviettes in the pack. Couldn't find anything on the store front so I asked from staff and they gave me ONE.. I asked for some more and they gave ONE more... WOW! This isn't the St. Pierre sushi standards that I'm used to.

We had dragon rolls, salmon nigiris, salmon rolls and teriyaki salmon on rice for lunch last Saturday. It was the worst St Pierre food I’ve had. The avocado of dragon rolls was very firm and definitely underripe…….. The avocado was not ready to eat. Can’t believe staffs put underripe avocado in the dragon rolls. And rice in sushi and teriyaki chicken were hard and dry………. Sushi rolls were fall apart and in a bad shape…,,,, My family were enjoy St Pierre Sushi in botany, Mt Wellington and St Luke’s store. But I have to say Ormiston St Pierre was terrible experience for us…….
delicious but way too stingy on the edamame. literally got 6 😭
Excellent service as always. 💯 👏
Great staff and great food as well. Customer service goes a long way, and your staff clearly know that by their professionalism.

Lovely serene place to eat NB: this is a temple with the cafe attached. There is a dress code, both men and women have to cover your limbs. Skirts & pants with sleeved shirts/t-shirts. Very reasonable priced totally plant based menu. Vegetarian & vegan only with gluten free options as well.
Lovely experience within the temple and welcoming staff in the cafe, was a really nice experience

Fast service, reasonable prices, large portions and great location. Some of the best vegetarian food I've had. Have tried the roti curry, laksa noodles and wonton noodle soup so far and all have been delicious.

An amazing vegetarian cafe housed inside the Taiwanese Buddhist temple. As a vegan, there were so many delicious options to choose from, whether you wanted a full meal, snacking foods, or both. Really enjoyed the 'meat' options as they were so flavourful, and our meals were all generous enough to leave us feeling pretty full and satisfied. We visited on New Years Day, which was a busy day but there were still lots of seating options inside and out, and our meals were also promptly served. There is also plenty of space for parking. I'd suggest a visit to the temple too as the grounds and temple itself are beautiful. Highly recommend for a mid-day meal!
I came here for lunch after praying at the temple. Food tastes great. Not only can you get Chinese food, but also food from southeast Asia. The restaurant is clean and price is reasonable.
Delicious tasty food there were 14 of us and we were full. Will definitely come back!

Exceptional, friendly, calm service. Accommodating, and portions were decent. Fried flat noodles were one of the best, fresh, wok-hot, gluten free ones we've had! Plus!!! The toilets were the best- the utmost cleanest, freshest we've ever used in a Chinese restaurant. Ample parking, convenient nearby shops, and a park across the road. I brought a friend who've never tried steamed fish on soy sauce and she was impressed. Recommend to support this place. Thank you!

This place does some dishes well and some can be improved. The service is reasonable but improving with some new hire that understands English better than others. Although prices has risen, some dishes still has great value. I like how the taste doesn't come from too much sauces. Some noodle dishes does contain "wok" flavor and this brings the dish another level. Best to call and book a table on weekends or you might find yourself disappointed.

We went there for a dinner takeaway only. The place was so busy, a lot of family had dinner there. Once you enter, you can smell the delicious chinese food, so tempted. The waiter was nice, friendly, and explained some menu that we asked. We ordered chicken prawn fried rice and pork with XO sauce. Waited about 30 mins, and it worthed for delicious comfort food

It’s rare to find a Chinese restaurant that can prepare vegetarian style dishes and still make it tasty but New Garden does it so well! My family and I are always coming over here. The dishes we always order are the eggplant dish and the stir fried long beans. However our new favorite is the lamb chop. So tender and juicy! I can just order this and have the sauce over plain rice. Make sure to give this place a try if you’re craving Chinese food the next time!

Best Indian pizza. I am a regular, I eat almost at least twice every week. Pizza club chappel road is very consistent ever since . I have been ordering from this branch almost 4 years now. I would like to appreciate the staff out there specially front house girl name- AKSHITA for the perfect service as she makes sure everytime my pizza is well done. And also there's never been delay with any of my orders ever. Hope you guys maintain consistency in the future too. Thanks.

I recently visited Pizza Club 🍕. The pizza was average — nothing special, quite bland to be honest. What really ruined the experience was the girl at the front. She was extremely rude and lacked even basic customer service skills. Even when I call the shop, she puts me on hold without saying anything. I understand the shop can be busy, but she doesn’t know how to speak properly or respectfully. If they don’t remove her from the front, I’m not coming again. Very disappointing experience overall.
Worst pizza I have ever tried Add lots of hot sauce I can’t eat hot pizza I told it’s totally bland Without asking me she add lots of sauce Girl has not customers service skills She is so rude!

Very disappointing. Pizza wasn’t even crispy. Spicy garlic bread didn’t had stuffing at all Only filled with spicy sauce, pinch of cheese and a little onion. This is not the standard of pizza club I know..!! I always eat pizza from pizza club. But chapel road pizza club is the worst. I had multiple bad experiences in a row. One time, i was charged for adding extra onion on a pizza, which was strange because i always request extra onion but never ever charged for it. Nit sure if the owner or workers are changed here. But honest, the worst experience. :(

We've been regular customers of Pizza Club on Chapel Road and have always enjoyed their pizzas, especially the Spicy Paneer Pasand. However, today’s experience was quite disappointing. We placed our order online, which mentioned a 25-minute prep time. We arrived slightly early to ensure we got the pizza fresh, but unfortunately, it was already cold when handed over. Even worse, the taste was far from what we’re used to. The pizza lacked flavor, and it honestly felt like eating plain pizza base with a few bland paneer pieces scattered on top. Definitely not the quality or experience we’ve come to expect from Pizza Club. Hoping this was just a one-off, but it really let us down today.

Absolutely delish! Have tried other stores in the area but they were all over priced for ho hum food. This place is our new fav, chinese food was fresh and full of flavour, chicken nibbles were delish (could do with some flavoring but the outside is so crispy like kfc hot and spicy texture minus the flavour) The chips are delish and don't taste like old oil. Great selection of little family meals or fried food specials and well worth it. Overall yummy food, great service, clean place from what we could see and a phone that didn't stop with phone orders and even though we ordered inside the wait wasn't that long at all. Their bami could do with a bit of extra heat as it was just like a normal noodle dish but with curry colour and the sweet and sour could do with a touch more sauce when its on its own as it dried out quickly which made it all clumpy although when we reheated it the next day it was nice and moist. That is our only critic BUT we had to search really hard to find something wrong with it as we genuinely enjoyed our meal and we will be back again. Thanks magic chef team :-)
Best honey chicken!! There's is super crispy. I literal couldn't stop myself I ate half of it before getting home 😂😂 Fried rice is yum too. Best combo!!
Service was amazing! Police people. Chicken nibbles were very bland. Weird after taste to them especially with those prices.
First and last time here Bland food, the meat in fried rice was old. The lady unfortunately got our order wrong, we ordered steak chowmein and got chicken. Called to let her know and she hung up. 🫠
Food is always nice and fresh. We love their Beef in black bean. Chicken 🐔 nibbles the bomb 💣

Absolutely fantastic experience at Sham Grill Botany! We tried the chicken grill plate and freshly made falafel patties with bread — both were absolutely delicious. The meats were juicy and perfectly spiced, and the falafel was crisp on the outside and soft inside, clearly made fresh. The bread was warm a perfect match. Portions were generous and everything tasted authentic and full of flavour. The staff were friendly and welcoming, and the service was quick. One of the best spots for Middle Eastern food in East Auckland. Highly recommended — we’ll definitely be back!

Birthday Dinner at Sham Grill We went to Sham Grill in the evening for dinner to celebrate my daughter’s birthday, and it turned out to be a truly wonderful experience. From the moment we arrived, we were warmly greeted by the staff, which made us feel very welcome. We placed our order and waited around 25 minutes, but once the food arrived—it was absolutely breathtaking. The presentation was beautiful, and the portions were generous—definitely worth the money. The atmosphere was so lovely and relaxing, with soothing music playing in the background, adding to the experience. We took so many photos, and the staff even helped us capture a beautiful family picture, which we really appreciated.I would highly recommend visiting Sham Grill. The food is delicious, the service is excellent, and the ambiance is perfect for any special occasion.

We went there for dinner with friends. The staff were welcoming and friendly. We ordered different dishes and the food was good and delicious. We had three issues only, the first one is that I ordered mixed Arabic shawarma plate. This plate comes normally everywhere with chicken shawarma wraps plus beef shawarma wraps, in my case they mixed the chicken and beef in the same wrap which was confusing and unexpected. The second issue was that they forget my daughter’s order and after a while when we remind them they brought it but it was wrong order. The third issue is the pricing, the food was overpriced for this kind of food and the restaurant quality as a place and service. Regarding the sides we tried hummus it was so yummy, creamy and tasty. The environment was nice the vibes were good.

This is the best Turkish food i have ever had. The baklava is the best i have found in Auckland in a long time. The service is friendly, the food is hot and fresh. It is a little bit on the pricey side, but it is so worth it. I will definitely be back again. This week, i got the chicken on chips, chicken was beautiful and not dry, and the chips had the perfect amount of seasoning. Last week, i had the chicken on rice, and that was amazing, too.

We recently visited Sham Grill to try their Middle Eastern fare and had a mixed experience. We ordered the shawarma and chips, and while the food was tasty enough, we found it a bit pricey at $20 per shawarma. For that price, we were expecting either a larger serving or something that really stood out, but it felt fairly standard. The biggest letdown was the wait time. Despite the restaurant being nearly empty (only one other table was occupied), it took around 20 minutes for our order to arrive. With such a quiet kitchen, we expected things to move a lot quicker. It made us wonder how long the wait might be during peak hours. On the plus side, the service was friendly. The staff were polite and welcoming, which made the experience more pleasant. Also, parking is fairly convenient—just across the road in the park’s parking lot—so getting there isn’t a hassle. Overall, Sham Grill has potential. The food is decent, the place is clean, and the staff are nice—but the long wait times and slightly steep pricing might make it a “once in a while” visit rather than a regular go-to spot.

We recently held an event at Waitakere Resort and were impressed by the stunning forest surroundings and beautiful views. The rooms were spotless and well-maintained, and all the staff were exceptionally friendly, doing their best to support all our needs. The meeting room was lovely, with large windows overlooking the scenery — a perfect backdrop for our gathering. If there is one area for potential improvement, it would be the meals, which could be enhanced to match the high standard of the venue and service. Overall, a wonderful place for events, with an unbeatable natural setting

Did the winter package which comes with 3 course dinner and continental breakfast with one night stay. Will give a quick summary in ratings. Food taste : 5/5 Food quantity : 2/5 you will definitely be hungry so order some fries Room : 2/5 very old and I didn't like that the body wash comes in a ketchup package type that absorbs water and makes it not friendly to use. Breakfast : 3/5, quite a small selection for continental although their pastries were yummy. Overall, still enjoy the remote location with very nice scenic view and fresh air. But the hotel style is old and not really good with the room ammenities. Also dinner quantity is so small but the chef is excellent. Their mull wine also delicious.

Hi Jibin, We would like to thank you for making our stay at the Waitakere Resort & Spa so enjoyable. The rooms very comfortable & spacious. All very relaxing. We had a lovely view from our private balcony across the forest very peaceful. Our 6-course meal was exceptional. Hightly recommended it. Beautifully presented. All your staff were very professional & friendly. We also enjoyed the walks around the resort. About a 1 hour round trip. We can't thank you enough for making our stay so enjoyable and will certainly recommend your hotel & food to our friends. Jane & Paul

One of the best high teas I have ever had, and I have had a more than a few. The food was fantastic, contemporary and very well priced. The views are superb even on the rainy day we had. Expansive views and atmospheric. The buildings are well kept and are charming in a retro kind of way.

What a gorgeous spot to dine and stay, watch the sunrise over the city from one's comfortable bed, watch the twinkling lights of the city overnight. Stunning healthy bush surrounds the property. Food, absolute delicious. Just more vegetables please 🙏. NZ isn't generous with vegetables cooked or raw, in restaurants. Breakfast was scrumptious! Lots of fruit.
Great views and fantastic food. They were very happy to accommodate for vegetarian person on our booking
Great food and great service. The waiter was very kind and helpful.
The food was wonderful, such high standard, beautiful presentation and quality. Delicious and would highly recommend…

We stayed at the Waitakerie Resort and Spa for my birthday and part of the package was the dinner. What an experience! We had pre-dinner drinks in the lounge area, hand-delivered to us and then we had a set dinner menu in the Park Restaurant. We got to choose from options, and I can honestly tell you, everything was amazing! We loved everything we ate and heard young people at the next door table saying how much they couldn't believe how yummy their dinner was. If you haven't been - go! The view is amazing, the staff are simply whiz people that move so fast to serve you, you can't believe it, and the food is amazing!
Food was wonderful and the staff friendly and attentive. Atmosphere was quiet suggestion beautiful view of Waitakere forest.

Trying to find somewhere for a birthday brunch/ lunch on a Monday is near impossible. Trying to cater for six which includes a semi veggie that loves spice, an older fussy eater and someone with multiple food allergies makes it even harder. The Olive Kitchen and Bar was most welcoming with an extensive menu to suit all. Booking online was easy, finding the location was easy. The views are AMAZING. The staff were extremely friendly, the service was excellent and very prompt. A nice environment, we sat inside and were able to talk and enjoy our food. The food?? The food was exceptional, seafood platter, beautiful steaks cooked perfectly, great pizza and huge delicious burgers.Yummy cocktails, a good selection of beers and great coffee. The only disappointment was we were too full to try a sweet treat. Maybe next time. Definitely will be back and highly recommend this West Auckland gem nestled into the bush of Scenic Drive.

Had a fabulous lunch today here. Sigara borek starter with sweet chilli sauce and yogurt was the best I've had since London. The main was grilled snapper with mash potato, roasted vegetables and aioli. A substantial meal but delicious.I had a mocktail of virgin Pina colada. A medium flat white rounded off the meal. The service was excellent. I complimented the chef.Total cost $71 so not cheap -but as a treat well worth it.

Excellent food!! Wonderful service! They have own several awards as well. Very clean and tidy. No much longer wait. They have a variety of options. Their pina colada is best we had so far!! Coffee is good too. Their french toast is good as well, but they can improve it to best! Will surely go back when I am in auckland. They have halal meat, and they make food halal on request.

I found The Olive Kitchen and Bar more suited as a bar for drinks and casual hangouts, especially with its Mediterranean-style menu and retro, open-concept vibe. It feels inviting and the service from cashier to waitstaff was good. However, when it comes to food, the menu isn’t very family-friendly. While they offer a variety of pizzas, other lunch or dinner options are quite limited. The pricing leans towards the higher end, but the food temperature and taste for most of what we ordered for our group of four were only average. A special note to the Olive team: we tried your all-meat platter, which was suggested by staff as a hearty meal for four adults, but it didn’t meet that expectation. It would help if the menu included portion sizes in grams or pieces to avoid confusion and better set expectations.

Food here was decent. Got the vburger with the hash brown patty that worked well. The fries looked good but were less fluffy than I was expecting. We had ordered a starter but it never showed up to the table unfortunately (update: when we went to pay the server apologized because he didn’t end up putting it in the system). Drinks were tasty. There was a good deal for where you could get a free house wine or beer for free with a burger.

Only one person working during a busy time, wait was an hour. The chips were burnt, soggy, too much salt, inedible. The burger was slosh and the potato fritters were cooked on the outside and raw in the middle. Unfortunately with new owners, I would not recommend to anyone.

I use to like coming here but I cam around August last year and it had gone downhill the chips are dry and hard now. I've just been back again today to give them one last try and to ask if they are indeed under new management which they are and have been for 6 months. They also give only a small amount of chips for the money the last owners gave more. I will not return.
New owners. Not very good with understanding English and forgot part of my order. Chicken is different but still tasty. Potatoes aren’t as tasty with dry coating. Don’t have popcorn chicken anymore.

What used to be Sams kitchen is now no longer. New owners, same menu , lower quality food. Garlic chips was the go to when going to Sam’s kitchen and when the new owners came along and I got a garlic chips it wasn’t even close to how it used to be done. It was dry, barely any garlic butter, and the portion size was minimal. Sad to see Sams kitchen quality food be replaced by mediocre food.

Amazing crow very good food tasty and delicious I’ve seen a lot of people complain about the English but you guys just gotta go easy explain what you want slowly and pretty sure you’ll get what you want.Good luck for new owners

By far the best fish n chips in all west and central Auckland amd the best I've ever had. We've tried all others with ratings 4.5 and higher with hundreds of reviews and they're all hit and miss or mostly inedible on a regular basis. These guys were was fantastic. They really deserve the 5 star rating. Definitely eating here every Wednesday and Friday.
Chicken nibbles tasted bad! First time customer. So convenient yet so close to home! Sad to say won't be returning. Service was great 👍 Wish I could say the same thing about there chicken nibbles.
Best roast potatoes! They always give us more than we order. Lovely people

My friend and I, long-time patrons of this once-beloved fish and chip shop, recently had a lunch experience that disappointed us profoundly. Under the new management, the establishment seems to have taken a regrettable nosedive in quality. Our meal began with a hint of promise as the chips initially tasted good. However, that optimism was short-lived as we quickly detected an unmistakable flavor of old, rancid oil. It became evident that the owner, who we found less than agreeable, had opted for subpar cooking oil, tainting what should have been a satisfying dining experience. To add insult to injury, we both ordered milkshakes that proved to be a substantial letdown. Not only were they disappointingly lukewarm, but it was clear that the establishment had chosen the cheapest possible milk. The lack of quality and attention to detail in the beverages further underscored the downward spiral of this once-reliable fish and chip shop. The recent change in management has taken a toll on the overall atmosphere and standards of the place. What used to be a go-to spot for a reliable meal has now become an establishment that we, regrettably, won't be revisiting. It's disheartening to witness such a stark decline in an eatery once a staple in our dining choices. As if the culinary letdown wasn't enough, our post-meal experience in the restroom was equally unpleasant. The effects of our lunch seemed to linger, leaving us questioning the establishment's hygiene standards and overall cleanliness.
The best wonton and spuds! Burgers are fantastic too.

Went for dinner last night (Thursday 13th July); it was fantastic and staff did really well given looked almost a full house. Really good to see the support and I hope it continues. I had the fish and chips (fish is FRESH South Island Blue Cod in a perfect batter) which was awesome. Wife had Chicken and Bacon Fettuccine which loved!Cudos to the chef and staff. Toby's definitely provide the perfect Restaurant (and bar) experience in Titirangi / West Auckland. There is an outdoor area as well which is perfect for taking your dog(s).
Always good here. Friendly and good service. Can cater to big groups. Reasonably priced as well.
Couldn't fault it (except for the fact they ran out of creme brulee 😊). Good service, great food and nice to support local. Would definitely return
Lovely food, although the chips aren't as good as they used to be. The meals we had were lovely though.

Wow! My Partner and i celebrated our anniversary here on Friday. It was a great place , we really enjoyed the food and drink options available. The food was amazing and service was really fast! Staff were very friendly and great at their jobs! The prices were great also ! Thanks for having us! Will definitely reccomend.

I had the worst pizza experience ever. It felt like I was eating rubber—half-cooked and half-raw. The slices were so poorly made that the toppings fell off as soon as I tried to pick them up. It was incredibly disappointing. I highly recommend the franchise head office inspect this location, as the quality of the pizza is unacceptable. The place wasn’t even busy; I was the only customer, and still, the pizza was a disaster.

Just ordered through Uber eats got a slimy old salad supposed to be ceaser and a cold pizza for $40 will not get food there again. Called and just told my feedback will be given to the manager and they will call back. Yuck!
Everything always tastes good, service is always fast. Love the fact that hells has so many vegetarian options as well.
Great pizza good service. not a dine in place here,
Team always very friendly, store very clean and tidy service always great .Great work to parth and his team aaa++++
Went this place friday afternoon and food was absolutely delicious. Staff was so nice and lovely. Thank you for the food and coffee. You are amazing.

If you go to New-Zealand you have to stop at Titirangi village kebab. It is the best kebab in the world. The chicken on chips is soooo good. I recommend it for everyone. Service is so good. And the cook master is a master…
Perfect for the night with your family. We were having a chicken dish. Loved the presentation and the taste. Thankfully we had a great time with you.

Brilliant, fast & healthy kebabs served in relaxing decor with great service! The chicken kebab is decent - a little dry but the sauces and fresh salads make it juicy. They make shish (which I prefer) but not in wraps. They have a cute little bar inside which is amazing!! You can stop for a cozy beer and bite. The view is beautiful- not just the forrest but the steezy graffiti art too! The service was the BEST!! Such an awesome guy behind the counter who was really attentive, fast, kind and professional.

The absolute best Kebab restaurant I've ever been to. Ever since my first kebab here I have never been able to eat them anywhere else. You can truly taste the freshness and quality in every dish they serve. You will be full after 1 but will want another just to continue experiencing the flavours. The owners and staff are all super friendly and welcoming and down to earth, it makes for such a lovely atmosphere to walk in to. The decor is also such a perfect touch to this great place. Family friendly with outdoor seating, perfect on a nice day. They also do takeaway. It is truly the best place to exist in the Titirangi Village and one worth traveling for.
Food is good prices are good and service is amazing ! No matter how many times me and my whānau get food from here the quality never changes ! 💯

After having lots of recommendations from friends and locals, decided to try this place, disappointed really. Fried rice really lacked flavour and the sweet and sour pork was more batter than pork, the food wasn't bad, but i wont be recommending
Chips and potato fritters. Hot Dog very sad with paper attached to the batter and not enough tomato sauce

Went to Auckland overnight and found this little place, busy as and can see why, great tasting food, plenty of large veges and meat .Great prices, has to be the best Chinese we have had since I can Remember and that's a long time. Awesome 👌
Very nice prawn egg fooyoung, combination fried rice and wontongs.
Great drinks and food . The milkshakes were great super filling . Would recommend coming here super cosy and cute . The staff are so nice and welcoming . Great prices. 10/10

Titirangi again! The cafe is just right at the corner exceptional location. Coffee is good I enjoy it. Tried the lunch special, Red Wine Scotch Steak, not bad actually. $25.5 a bit pricey for a lunch but once in a while loving yourself isn't bad.

Really friendly staff and new owner (Mani) makes us all feel so welcome and comfortable . Sifo (Barista) from Turkey and his coffee is of very high standards, he makes it to your tastes. Food is reasonable prices and chef does a good job :-)
