Lovely little spot to stop for breakfast. Fresh food, great service, lovely coffee and buzzy atmosphere. They have ready-to-take items to picnic with and some lovely wines and beers on offer. We sat outside and had a lovely time. The staff are very attentive, warm yet professional.

Not sure what happened but my experience here not great. The eggs meant to be over easy were not and mushrooms were overcooked and rubbery while the rosti was as a crispy outer while the inside was mushy. Overall the food was underwhelming and even the coffees were warm and not hot. Sorry The HC.

Meat calzone was a great pick to change it up from a typical pizza. Pizza dough 'banbinos' were advertised as pizza dough balls with herb butter which were exactly as they said, yet I was still hoping for something a little extra in flavour for them kind of like if you get garlic knots on the side at a Sal's, they feel unique enough from your pizza to have them as a side. All in all still, that calzone was exactly what we wanted and would stop in again for it.

Firstly - food is fantastic. We come back repeatedly for the pizza alone. It’s genuinely mine and my husband’s favorite pizza place out west. Secondly - the customer service at the street feast location is remarkably subpar. I have worked in hospitality for more than a decade, I know what bare minimum service looks like and the customer service here is worse than bare minimum. I don’t want to be snarky. I mean this as genuine feedback to improve the overall experience. I hope the owner appreciates that. The staff need to greet customers. We’ve been more than 8 times and not once have we been greeted. We approach the till and nothing. They completely ignore us. Pretend we don’t exist. Never any smiles. Never any warmth. No kindness or service of any kind. The staff truly stare blankly at us and punch the order through without a word. I promise with more focus on the service this spot would thrive. I am at the point of not returning again because I’m so appalled by the consistent lack of warmth by every. Single. Server. For the staff - you will enjoy your shifts more if you fake it till ya make it. Even faking a smile for a customer will bring your own mood up over time. A simply “hey guys!” In your fakest customer service voice will go a long way. Keep up the fab food, but please for the love of all things good work on your customer service, or hire people who are more chirpy/capable of warmth at the till xoxo
Our family hired out his portable truck for a function, great dude and even better pizza. Definition recommend.
Stumpys pizza are goated asf, top fellas fr fr. Would recommend, I like their salty sea pizza or whatever it's called, truly the meal of champions. Top service, epic pizza. We love to see it.
Asked to place a order, the lady was sitting down eating and asked me to come back in 10 minutes. It seems like you have to wait 10 minutes utes to order a pizza.

Very nice atmosphere and service. I chose the window seat with the bush scenes, next view for brunch. It wasn't too busy around 11am and plenty of seats to choose from. Love the decorations and they serve great food.
Good food, the place is cozy and cute, staff is nice. A little bit pricey but it’s worth it. They have vegan options.
Delicious food, great service and a lovely atmosphere set among the trees in Titirangi. Good value for money also.

This place will do if you just want coffee. Great venue beautiful inside and out.I ended up getting a hockey pokey latte (would order again) and the chicken schnitzel (wouldn’t order again) it is overpriced for half a chicken breast (dry), chips and salad. Service from the waiter was amazing asked for feedback and served everyone with a smile 5 stars to him. Management -2 stars as he couldn’t take feedback about the food and was just rude.

Just had an incredible experience at Deco Eatery in Titirangi – and I had to share! From the moment I walked in, the warm ambiance and stylish decor set the tone for something special. The food was absolutely delicious – beautifully presented, full of flavor, and made with fresh, quality ingredients. Every dish was a treat! The service,The staff were friendly, attentive, and genuinely cared about making the experience memorable. Whether you're after a relaxed brunch, a cozy coffee stop, or a classy lunch spot – Deco Eatery is the place to be. Highly recommend and definitely coming back!
Absolutely fire food would 100% reccomend 🔥🔥
Best fish and chips for sure. The Chinese is delicious and if you love burgers, you can't go past the super burger...brimming with everything!

Although price is good unfortunately me and the family find the Chinese food incredibly bland. We tried the chicken fried rice , sweet and sour pork and beef chowmein . There was practically one tiny noodle in the chowmein. And overall each dish was as bland as bland gets. A waste of almost $50

Was our first time coming here. Combination fried rice was great but the chicken oyster was very salty. That won't stop us from coming back though. I've heard the won tons are the best so that's next on the list.
Our favorite place for fish and chips! The food is consistently great, reasonably priced, and the team is always friendly. We couldn't ask for more!
Have tried multiple curries from the Curry Zone and can’t fault any of them. We get their curries every couple of weeks. Our favourites would be the Korma, Madras, Jalfrezi and Bhuna.
Nice butterchicken and garlick naan. A bit too sweet for my liking but still very nice.

Butterchicken looked and tasted like it came from a jar and the Naan was doughy like it hadn't been cooked enough and the garlic on it seemed like it had been smeared from a crushed garlic jar which proceeded to make it soggy. Really disappointing as I have gone here before and it was nice but this was yuck and a waste of money.
Does anyone know if the old owners have opened a curry place anywhere else their curry was the best I've ever had

First time to buy dinner from here. Don't be put off by the smell when you walk in, it needs a bit of update but it sports an A listening. I wasn't disappointed with the food but I was a bit disappointed with the portion size. A little bit slim on the meat side given the price 😂. But it was tasty and I will go back but maybe not for a couple of weeks I'll have to save my $$.

Delicious food, I had the big breakfast and the chorizo was one of the best I ever had in a cafe. The scrambled egg was fluffy and bacon was generous. Chef came out and made me special sauce because of my allergy. What a hidden gem. Will be back.

Tucked away in Titirangi is a gem. Once your past finding a carpark it looks small from the front It's a Tardis, long and narrow with good seating and a great vibe. The coffee was fantastic ( oat flat white ). Just an excellent Bacon Bennie. Totally recommended.

This is a lovely little cafe , tucked at the back of a car park on Titirangi Rd, town centre. Even though hard to find it was well patronised during my visit with nearly every table taken. I had a Americano and it was full of flavour. I ordered a big breakfast, really enjoyed my meal, the eggs were delicious and the sausages very tasty. I was able to order gluten free toast with my meal and the menu had good options for vegetarians etc. Service was friendly and I would come back here again.

Delicious breakfast here with my partner and son. I got the avocado smash and my partner got the bacon butty. We were super happy with both - the cabinet food looked good too! The staff was very friendly. We arrived just after 8 and it was super bustly by about 8.20.

Good food, though quite pricey and parking is a nightmare! Most of the parking nearby is reserved for other places or very short term. It took me about 15mins to find parking and I ended up having to park over 5mins walk away. Hardly any vegan options, though they did substitute a hash for the feta and the egg with the avocado toast. It was $26.

Just had the most amazing lamb roast at Ambrosia. Tender generous portion of lamb, just the right amount of veges and the most incredible gravy I've ever tasted! It was the Sunday special and it comes with a drink, and at $22.50 was phenomenal value! There was also a variety of cakes and desserts that we tried and they too were very yummy. Will definitely be going back soon to try some other items from the menu.

Today was the second time visit Ambrosia since last time we had a great time there. We always visited the old Thai chef in the same spot. The new restaurant Ambrosia continued the tasty food…Both time ordered the meat lover plate and ciabatta bread dips. It was tasty and big portion. Especially love the oil sauce on the bread, so unique!! The wine was nice too. Also, fairly reasonable price to make you really satisfied and happy in expensive Auckland! Another amazing thing about them, it’s they open the whole day time!!! When you are looking for restaurant around 3:30pm, Ambrosia is always there for you.

We had a wonderful waitress and the food was relatively good however there were items on the menu not available as they didn't have certain ingredients. We were only informed of this 10minutes after we had ordered. There was an exceptionally long wait for our meals and they arrived separately (there were only 2 of us dining together and another table when we had placed our orders).
My first experience dining at Ambrosia was very elegant and different it had a wonderful decor the food was average overall the baby potatoes could have been better but everything else was excellent
Just had an amazing meal, the food was fantastic, taste, portions and service was great and location overlooking Titirangi, highly recommended

iTi has inviting and peaceful atmosphere. Friendly service. We booked our table through First Table. The mushroom benedict was a favourite, perfectly cooked mushrooms, though the spinach was a-bit salty. The mushroom arancini was absolutely delicious. The beef burger was hearty unfortunately, the patty was burnt. The beef taco was a great. I’d recommend making a reservation and coming to enjoy the cozy atmosphere and tasty dishes for yourself!

The Southern Fried Taco was super delicious! We also tried the Vege Burger and the Lamb Pappardelle, and they were both really good. The Jalapeño Poppers were definitely spicy 🥵, but tasty too! And don’t forget to try their dessert, it was the perfect way to end the meal.

Amazing food. Amazing service. I booked through the “first table app” for something new and different. If it wasn’t for the “first table app” I wouldn’t have discovered this little gem. I wasn’t expecting such delicious food. Very tasty and comforting food. I highly recommend this place to my friends and family. I hope to be back again for the cream brûlée because it was to die for. The only down side is it’s noisy depending on the day you go, parking can be difficult and the bathroom is not maintained properly but other than that the place is perfect.
First time at this cafe. A great find. Excellent service. Delicious food & a reasonable price. Go for brunch you won't be disappointed

This place is very lovely and very attentive, if you’re seated outside you have a small blanket waiting for you just in case you get cold ☺️ the staff are quite lovely and very attentive to you, they want you to have the best time, would 100% return I recommend getting the garlic bread with mozzarella cheese and also check out the wagyu
Delicious food (chicken nibbles and potatos are a fav), great prices and such friendly staff. Lovely man always smiling. Highly recommend 👌
Chicken Nibbles $1.20 each... Baked Potato $1 each...

my mum used to buy me a baked potato from here when i was kid as a little treat. they are delicious, and painfully nostalgic. when i walked home from school with mates we would always swing by for a hot dog or a spring roll paired with a sugary beverage from the supermarket. i cherish memories of getting abysmally stoned and ordering my personal go to (two potato fritters, hot dog with sauce, and a spring roll) and absolutely never being disappointed. during some of the lowest points in my life i was truly saved by this establishment. i love this place dearly, and it holds an incredibly special place in my heart.

Delicious food. The roast potatoes are so good and the chicken is the best chicken EVER. The lady there is so kind to me and my friend who are regulars. I love it. However the cheese toastie wasn't great, but i don't care because the chicken is SO GOOOOOOD

Got a $12 chicken chip pack with 5 chips .Even though this was 9 years ago ,I'm still not over it ,hence ,never went back . Previously been a customer since I was a boy ,now retired . Keep up the bad work .

Food is good for the price. wontons 12 for 12 are good better than most! Hoki $4.50 also better than most. Only down side they are closed on Sunday. Food not undersalted like most places tend to do nowa days also.
My boys and I always enjoy their fried chicken. So friendly every time too!

my experience was absolutely appalling. the food that i received tasted like hand sanitiser , and the potato fritters had no potato just batter full batter, and all chips were undercooked. When getting served the woman was super rude and thought she knew best by charging extra than what her sign said. also didn't appreciate touching my food and her not using gloves after touching money.
Verry yum food, lady at counter very nice

Ordered a combo and received a a different meal changed by cashier as their wasn't any chicken avaliable. Instead the replaced it with fish. Spoke on the phone which she yelled at me and said come here and get your chicken then proceeded to hang up

Excellent little take away joint in titirangi village. We got a variety of items to try out a bit of it all. Both burgers were really yummy and freshly made, the fish was fried really well and so fresh on the side (a tad too oily though), and the wedges were delicious. They are two vegan options too which is amazing! The prices are really good and the portions are also well sized - this fed 4 adults for $52 and we were quite full after. Will definitely be back!
The burgers rock, but tonight I went for a simple fish and chip meal and was not disappointed. Great chips and batter indeed forbthe soul. Keep up the great work guys.

A massive appreciation for the team taking on the feedback we placed and executing it like stars. We came and got both a fish burger and soul burger, fries, fried chicken, mussels and both a cheesecake and brownie. The burgers were massive, made with fresh ingredients and pulled together with really quality ingredients and protein. The fish was golden, crunchy and fresh. The beef and bacon were smoky and flavoursome. Chips were golden, fluffy and salty. Fried chicken doesn’t even need a breakdown as it’s out the gate and you are a fool not to try! It’s in the name but all of the batter has ‘soul’. Our advice would be to order in advance to save you a wait but perhaps that only goes to show people are continuing to come back. Check in on their socials as well for specials as they have some epic deals. Cheers Ben and team! 🎣

Hands down the best fish burger in Auckland! We drive all the way from Takanini to come here and it's worth it every time 🥴🤤. Pictured is: -Fish burger w. Egg+cheese -Fried chicken and slaw -Potato fritters (thiccc 👌🏽) -Whittakers Choc Brownie -Oreo cheesecake The kai here is always yum with fresh seafood, thick fish and light crispy batter. The order pictured we added egg and cheese (do 👏🏽 it 👏🏽... Don't be silly) and they are just monsters. Pickled onion gives it such a freshness and the tartare sauce is yum. Spoon next to the burger so you can see how big these things are and pic of the beautifully fried runny egg. The desserts are yum too. The brownie is rich and fudgy with crunchy edges and has lots of Whittaker's chocolate. That's one thing I love about this place, they don't ever seem to skip on quality of ingredients and load their Kai up. Aside from the great food, the guy who owns this place is such a down to earth, lovely person. I don't know him personally but my partner and I have both had such cool interactions with us. When I've had my hands full with an upset baby, he's carried food over to my car and helped us with the doors. Love hearing te reo Māori being used proudly in the shop and on the phone to customers too. Feels like walking into a cousins shop. Last side note is that I love their packaging too, it makes it feel a bit more special and keeps things crispy for a long time (e.g. drive from Titirangi to South Akl). Go get some Kai and take it down to one of the beaches and go for a date 😍. It's little gems like this that make me a chub because I'm so happy to support small businesses that are so passionate about what they do and just want to provide a great experience for people. Ngā mihi Soul Batter team 🥰👌🏽

We ordered online about a month ago and it was delicious! Burgers were massive and we got extra fish and onion rings as we were last order of the night! The vege burger as so yummy! Thank you for the generosity! We will definitely be back again 👍🏾
Very budget friendly service with great food and atmosphere. We normally order takeaway away but had dined in first time and the staff was very efficient and friendly. Keep up the good work.
My partner and I love this restaurant. The food is so tasty and people so kind. We just had amazing coctails here. I highly recommend Passionfruit margerita! Yum 😊

This place is great!!! Everything is delicious with reasonable prices. Better yet, they have quite a few vegan and vegetarian options. And I just love how they can make things very spicy or very mild for you. Highly recommended to go with friends and family. Or even by yourself. Enjoy!
We ordered second time using ubereats. Packing was done carefully to avoid any spills. Food taste was also good. Naans can be a bit thinner. Curry quantity was a bit small. Overall 4/5.

Dine in, what a beautiful meal, generous portions, friendly service- Best butter chicken we have ever tasted. Had fish also cooked to perfection, super fresh. Cant wait to come back. Great prices, value for money.

Not bad - good quality, fast and fresh! We ordered via Uber Eats and it arrived cold (could be delivery, could be restaurant, could just be delivery Donburi) … but no denying it was fresh, quality ingredients and really well made rice. The sauces were heavy handed and cloying - like way too sweet and no rice left clean. The proteins are a bit small but the prices are decent. Generally a healthy fast choice.

I have eaten here a few times in the past and the food has been amazing and fresh. Tonight however, disappointed and frustrated receiving 2 orders of burnt chicken for my son and I. Tried breaking off burnt bits to salvage meal but the entire thing was just inedible

Not the best, not the worst. First time trying their new menu. Our favourite, pork belly soba w/ bone broth has now been replaced with oil noodles in tonkotsu broth. We asked for it with rice on the side instead and they were happy to accommodate. Unfortunately the broth was too salty and lacked a fully bodied flavour. Pork belly serving was generous.

Surprisingly found this lovely Japanese style restaurant. Not only wild selection of Sushi they are selling, Ramen, Dumplings, Rice Bawls are also on their menu Prices are friendly Foods are delicious I ordered the crispy squid at the end it was fantastic! Highly recommended.

I ordered the grilled salmon bowl as I have many times over the years. To say the standard has dropped is an understatement. The absolutely minuscule amount of salmon for a $21 meal is just disgusting.

Delicious kebabs. Goods thing take time to make, so we had some moment to appreciate the appetite, but when food turned out it was so so good. You do not usually expect too much from meat on rice, but this one was really great. And. We tried baklava there. Ended up buying one more to go.

I absolutely LOVED the food here! It's so flavourful and delicious, i can safely say i don't have leftovers because i devoured the food. Seriously, my son is a picky eater and he ate everything too! Thank you so very much! We will definately come again :😀
What an amazing experience. The missus picked up our telephonic order. I tried out the chicken kebab wrap and lamb works souvlaki on chips cheese. The food was to die for. Complements to the chef.

Wonderful Turkish food in Titirangi. It takes a little time to prepare meals typically 20mins but well worth the wait for outstanding meals. Friendly staff. I have been many times already and will happily drive far out of my way to partake. Heartily recommended.
Just ordered a lamb kebab, the kebab had nice and generous fillings. Full of flavour and meat was cooked perfectly. Very tasty ....Highly recommend.

Food was mostly pretty good, but we ordered from the screen and they still managed to get the order wrong. We paid for sides of guacamole and chipotle aioli, neither of which came, and the fried chicken was dry without it. Decided on takeaway as the atmosphere in the street feast isn't very relaxing.

I have been living in New Zealand for a few months now, I am originally from Michoacán, in Mexico. I have been craving some good Mexican food for a while, and my Mexican friends told me that I must try their tacos here. Sincerely, it did not disappointed since my experience find good Mexican food here hasn’t been a huge success. I love the flavors of the meet ( I had, the pork carnitas, Chicken tinga and beef birria) I only missed the spicy salsa and the after cry. Also, the chilaquiles side was really good and specially I was very excited to see and have the Cotija cheese, since I am from Cotija. Overall, I felt home for a little while!

The portions are very generous, I tried carnitas, birria and crispy fish, my favourite was the crispy fish, very tasting and refreshing. Overall the tacos are delicious, but if I could recommended a couple of improvements I would say there is too much meat in the tacos which make them hard to handle, and the sides are pretty big for a side. The service was outstanding and the tacos very recommendable.

I’m from Torreon Coah. Tacos here are very good. I often come to Titirangi to make a small hike so then I can treat myself with Mexican food after. I have tried tacos mainly beef and pork carnitas (my fav), the tortillas are good and thick made of corn. There’s also chicken tacos. Guacamole and totopos (chips) are perfect to complete the meal. Fried chicken is also very tasty with the right crispness to it. I think I would like to see tacos al pastor in the menu and a spicier sauce available for those of us who appreciate the spice, maybe something with chipotle taste. Gorditas or lonches of carnitas could also be a good option to have. In any case I love coming here, the taste is excellent, and I can’t wait to come back :)

I’m from Veracruz, Mexico and miss Mexican food every day. I had the birria & carnita tacos, as well as the chilaquiles. The portions were great and I struggled to finish them, definitely the best sized tacos I’ve tried so far in Auckland. The carnitas are not what I’m used to, but were still very delicious and had Mexican flavours. The salsa macha was so nice. I’ve never tried tacos with beans in them the way we had them today, but I’m aware every region is different, I can’t complain though because it tasted really nice. I like my chilaquiles quite drenched in sauce, but these were still so nice, such a big portion as well. I’m going to be biased and will definitely recommend visiting Veracruz, specially the little towns. I’m very skeptical when trying Mexican restaurants in New Zealand, but I will definitely be coming back whenever I get a craving for the flavours from back home. Thank you for having us ❤️

Used to be a massive fan of Jo Bros burgers, however was very disappointed tonight, they have lost a loyal customer. The food truck was at beerspot Morningside and sliders were the only burgers on the menu. 2 beef sliders with fries or 2 chicken sliders with fries, $20 each. We bought one of each and had a slider each. The beef slider was literally a meatball sized patty, sauce and one pickle. No salad. At least the bun was fresh and the meat and sauce tasty. The chicken slider looked better and had salad but the chicken barely had any flavour. The serving size of the fries was pretty underwhelming. Very disappointed overall for $40, for what is usually a great standard.

last two times I've been a little let down tbh . tonight I had more tendon than chicken in my burger . ill eat the bones in any situation but when I get a burger I dont want to be chewing on bits . also very dry

Had a great experience at Jo Bros Burgers! The food was very good, but the service really stood out, especially from the blonde teenager that had a mullet. He was quick, friendly, and easy to talk to, which made the whole visit better. It’s always nice when staff actually seem to care. Definitely worth a visit!

I just love their burgers. My favourite OG with small shoe string fries and $1 chicken wings. The burger is great, the bun is nit soggy and the beef patty is not greasy but full of flavour. The whole food-court has a lovely atmosphere with great bar.

Tried one of their wagyu burgers at the new super cheap auto store opening. Burger was tasty but didn't have much filling , it was free so I suppose that makes up for it. Maybe some beetroot or an egg would have elevated it.
Love the vibe at Stripe. Really artistic. Food was average. Coffee was good! I love the cup they are using. The decoration of the cafe is amazing. Can see locals come here often.

Came here for Brunch today with my NZ family. Coffee and food were great. Fantastic place to stop for food on the way to or from Piha beach of so inclined. The menu could do with a re-design but the staff were very friendly. #titirangi #piha
Best coffee in Titirangi, beautiful building, quite unique. I went in winter, the space was very warm which I liked.
Awesome food and coffee.. I'll definitely be back next time I'm in Titirangi!

Our favourite spot in Titirangi Village! The coffee is always perfect, eggs benedict are sooo good and the atmosphere is relaxing. They’ve been adding new furniture to the place recently, but keeping the rustic feel of the place. The staff is always very nice and welcoming.

I came here with mum a couple nights ago and we were very suprised with how good our food was. I got two roast rolls with one being beef and the other being pork. The size of the roll with the amount of meat and gravy on the rolls was quite alot more than I was expecting for the price which made me quite happy. Mum got some veggies and mash potatoes and that was quite good too. The bro working that night even offered to make vegetarian gravy as mum is a vegetarian. We will absolutely be coming back with the cheap prices and quality food!

1 Lamb roast dinner, 2 Chicken roast dinners and 1 beef roast dinner, everything was spot on. This was not my first time at Titirangi Roast and it certainly wont be my last. Food was delicious, cheers to the team at Titirangi Roast. See you again soon.. Dave, Park Road.

Ordered Sweet & Sour Pork, Egg Foo Young and Plain Fried Rice. Taste was good and also the portion was good too. If you only talk about the portion size, I believe this is a lot more than any other dish such as Thai, Indian, Korean or Japanese take away.

First time there was satisfide with the portions and the fish there are very big and the sausages. we thought we could finish it but we got more than we asked for. The asian man and lady are very humble especially the lady i dont think the man understood me i think but there cool as. Was very happy with the food there its going to be our new local fish n chips shop. The place is a good spot to feed a family and the beach is around the conner asweol as new world to get essentials for a feed. Chuur

Me and my partner shared the fish meal because the portion is good for $15 .Came with 2 fish, salad and some nice crispy chips . We also ordered 2 cheese burger it was a generous amount of cheese . However the fish didn’t taste fresh. They had the uncooked battered fish stored in a glass display cabinet next to the counter . And the dining experience was ok because we had our dog waiting in our car while we dine in and we didn’t want to eat at a park on a cloudy windy day . A customer rudely telling off the staff they should wash their hands. Now I think they don’t wash their hands when preparing the food. They don’t wear gloves either.

Green Bay takeaways have a large menu of both Chinese and European food. Always very good and fresh. One of the best and most consistent takeaways I've come across. They have an A cleanliness rating and are open every day. Highly recommended.

Poor Customer Service, did a phone order and they got it wrong and then got annoyed when I said I hadn't ordered 3 burgers only two. So the woman at the counter was extremely rude about me not wanting to pay for a 3rd burger I didn't order. Like calm down it was your mistake and I ain't paying for it! Prefer the old owners personally as their food was also of better quality in saying that, the food there now is not too bad.
Our little takeaway has been our local and we can’t go wrong perfect food for any session

This is definitely our go to place for our indulgent Chinese takeaway cravings. The servings are just huge - case in fact the Kings Special Fried rice was good for 3-big-eater servings 😋. The black bean sauce stir fried veggies was very hearty and meaty - which seems to still be an understatement. Great value for money and even a greater flavourful journey.

Thank you to the lovely couple who own King of Kings. They have become a precious part of our BHB community. Delicious food, very generous portions, A+ cleanliness and always a warm smile and friendly greeting. The home made wontons are the best in Auckland (in our opinion- we've tried plenty!) and homemade spring rolls are also excellent. Our favourite is the wholesome wonton soup. Nothing more comforting on a cold night- packed with wontons and veges. Divine food- made with love. Thank you! (Plenty of Vegetarian options available)

First time here in yrs. Use to be great. So now $18, Steak chop suey gets you overcooked brocolli and cauliflower. 3 bits of carrot and onion and 2 beans. A small portion of not the tastiest steak. No mushrooms. Nothing else. So poor. Will show photos to owners.
Excellent chef for Chinese food cooking, portion is fair. and l enjoyed your food as always after a tired day!
A pretty busy local restaurant, definitely recommend making a reservation in advance, especially on weekends! Friendly service and tasty food make it worth the visit.

The first time Nepalese restaurant experience was great. Had steamed momos and biriyani and some masala chai. Will try chilli momos for next time as it is recommended. Biriyani was yum! The sunset view from a window in the bathroom is a bonus! So beautiful! The old male staff was great service. Will come back again.
Maharaja banquet for two. Loved it so much. Food delicious and friendly staff. Highly recommend this place. Lots of people though grabbing take away.
Loved the food and their service. We ordered Vegetarian food and it was delicious with authentic flavors. Chilli momo, thukpa and jhol momo are a must try.
Amazing chilli chicken! The gravy is so flavorful! 👌 100% recommend

Thought I'd give this spot a five star as I see a lot of bad reviews for this place giving it an unfair star rating on Google. This place is great dunno what people are complaining about. They have some really cool different pieces you can't get from a st Pierre's for example. Yummy snapper and sweet n sour chicken pieces.

I decided to try this place and ordered a chicken teriyaki donburi. Unfortunately, it was disappointing—there was barely any salad, the chicken portion was small compared to similar options at the same price, and there was no teriyaki sauce in the rice. Lesson learned: always check reviews before giving a place a shot.

i wanted to get something but the vibe wasnt it…… i was all smiles and ended up leaving perplexed… first off i didn’t know you could just get/grab the sushi’s or snacks yourself but it didnt have to be told in a rude way 🥲 i originally wanted to order smth else but itll take 10 mins and i cant rlly wait that long since i was only on a lunch break but i just ended up getting the teriyaki chicken snack thing. it was decent but there was little chicken amts. I like the rice though. idk if ill ever go again as it didnt feel welcoming to come in nor buy
Their food is amazing. I get a regular teriyaki chicken Don buri with extra chicken and veges and it is so fabulous. Still hot when it gets to my door. Highly recommend.
Had some nice sushi when I went in there this morning. All items in my picture cost me $19 total.
The worst takeaways we have had. Disappointed as they had been good in the past. We are unsure what’s in the fish cakes, dark drown in colour, it’s not fish.

It was decent. I don't know how shops do not season their chips with anything after deep frying. The fish, potato fritters and fried sausage were delicious but they needed to be complimented by a few chips with at least a modicum of seasoning on them, either table salt, sea salt or chicken salt I don't mind but please use something. But other than that the product was well presented and reasonably priced. 3 stars.
In my 66 years on this earth I've never had a worse takeaway. Overcooked burnt spring roll..way undercooked warm sausage and the greasiest chips...and NO salt. It was absolutely horrible 😢😞

Can tell that the fish n mussels are fresh. First time to order from them. Really enjoyed the meal. Highly recommend them.. It may hve lacked a bit of seasoning, but that's ok, as we can easily add seasoning at home.

Only recommend the battered mussels and fish. Smoked fish is dry and tasteless, chips are not great which is a pity as you want to buy fish and chips from the one place, I go elsewhere for chips. Was surprised that cheese is an extra cost on a toasted sandwich.

Made 2 trips today for a very good reason FOOD WAS ABSOLUTELY AMAZING!!! Today we got the small plate of ribs and chicken meal.As first timers here meat was beautifully cooked juicy and saucy. Portion was perfect too, absolutely nothing I could fault We also managed to try the Spam Musubi which I loved too the side sauce that comes with this was something special. We headed back for round 2, as we wanted more so got the large ribs plate for $28. This plate is a beast once again no fault ribs was perfectly cooked !!! The only downside is they are now next door to us so will be here more often 🤣 Thank you for the delicious meals #supportyourlocal

Have always wanted to try this place when they were situated on great north road in Glen Eden. Even better they have relocated 2 houses down from me on West Coast road. Where to start..... Amazing food. Well cooked, meat well marinated. Taste = exceptional. Ordered the Chicken & Ribs mix. Everything on point. Thank you for the awesome food. We will be regulars now you have moved next door. Keep up the awesome service.

I tried this for the first time on Sunday at Te Atatū South Park during an NZAFF tournament. Zac (hopefully spelt write) was friendly and very helpful in getting our order sorted even before opening while waiting for some ingredients to arrive and it was well worth the wait. The meals were huge, we got the mixed large beef ribs and chicken and a small katsu chicken. The sides went perfectly with the meats, the katsu chicken was crunchy, delicious and had a beautiful sweet salty sauce which I put over everything. The chicken in the combo box was packed full of flavour and so tender, I'm glad thighs were used too. My favourite, holy crap those ribs, as Pretty Deadly from WWE would say "Yes Boy" those ribs had so much favour and had my favourite part (the combination of the marinade, meat and fat which just melted as soon as you bit into it). I would highly recommend this place and I'm keen to get more, for my mother and myself one large meal could fill us both for maybe two meals if not one a a half. I'd still get a large and a small so I have a whole small ribs to myself 😊 Considering that, the price and the quality of this food it's well worth it.

The hubby has been wanting to try this place for a while and today was his lucky day. Fast and efficient service the food was super tasty. Definitely a must try when you’re out West Auckland just check their times though because we were passing through and not from those ways. Great tasty Hawaiian BBQ.

4.5/5 stars, got a mixed chicken plate. The katsu was very crunchy and delicious and the bbq was very good, good marinade and portion sizing for even just the $18 plate. My only complaint would be the rice was a bit mushy but the side mac was fairly decent. Reminds me of L&L bbq in the states, very similar.

I absolutely love this place! To the point where I had them cater my wedding. Their katsu chicken bao bun never makes it home as I am smashing it in the front seat of the car while it's hot and fresh, overloaded with chicken and packed with flavour. As far as I've gotten through the menu, it is delish, healthy enough, packed with flavour and a generous portion for the price. Plus the staff are always wonderful. Highly recommended to friends and whanau
Exceptional food - super healthy and full of flavour. Staff were lovely and the inside is set up nicely.

Best pork belly baos out! I've been waiting for this respawn ever since the owner moved from Holly's cafe and its still as good as then or even better. The spicy squid was juicy deliciousness too and generous portion of the actual squid as opposed to other places that just serve mainly rice. The loaded dumplings were good but laska flavour is prominent so will probably just get the normal ones next time. Only a few seats if you want to eat in which we did and parking right outside which is good. I'll be back to try some other dishes.

We used Baywok for a 50th birthday function been our local takeaway and catering company . the food was outstanding, customer service was incredible even delivering our platters during the event ! all our friends , family and clients couldn't stop talking about how great the food was !! we ordered spring onion pancakes with beef brisket, kfc chicken balls, bao buns and meat skewers catering for 50 plus people. I can't rate you guys enough ! thank you

This place! I am not one to rate highly unless your genuinely good! Price point, amount of food, flavour, variety! BayWok hits it all. I absolutely have been loving ordering their Coconut Chicken Salads and just tried their Chicken Bao Buns. Yummo!

Suburbs kitchen did catering for an event for us, absolutely nailed every component. Super professional, delicious and the set up looked incredible. Thanks again for making it such a stress free event!

My wife and I recently visited Ricksha restaurant. We had a wonderful experience. The ambiance and vibe of the restaurant were amazing. For cocktails, we ordered the Hummingbird and Lemonade, both of which were excellent. For starters, I ordered the Vada Pav, which gave off a complete Maharashtra vibe in both taste and presentation. Then came our main course — Lasooni Palak Paneer — and I honestly don’t have words to describe how good it was. Hats off to the chef who prepared it with a full burst of garlic flavor. I really loved it because it was made with fresh spinach, not canned. It looked and tasted absolutely amazing. For dessert, we had Moong Dal Halwa. The moment I tasted it, I realized it was made with pure desi ghee. I couldn’t stop myself and ended up eating it all — it was that delicious, with perfectly balanced sweetness and flavor. Once again, thank you to the chef and the front-of-house staff. We will definitely be coming back!

Last night, we went to Ricksha for the first time — and what an experience! ☺️ We absolutely enjoyed it. The atmosphere was incredible with such amazing vibes all around. It truly felt like a fun night out. A big shoutout to Neel — he sings so well! 🎤✨ His voice added so much to the evening. We had an awesome time with friends and shared lots of laughter. 🥰 The hukka flavours were a hit with my friends 💐, and the starters stole the show. We especially loved the Achari Soya Chaat — mouth-watering and packed with flavour! 😋 The Patta Palak Chaat was also delicious and crisp. The main course was okay — I’d say average in taste. But honestly, the overall ambience, music, and energy more than made up for it. 😍 Definitely a place worth visiting if you’re after good food, live music, and fun vibes with friends!

Beautiful ambience and delicacies. Ordered Chicken 65 authentic taste. Quantity and quality Must visit with family or with large friends group. You can see from the pics the sitting area and deck place.

What a fantastic evening at this beautiful outdoor venue! The ambiance was relaxed yet vibrant, with soft music playing and a live rugby match adding to the experience. The shisha was top-notch, and the food was absolutely delicious — a must-try! Highlights include the crispy Indian gol gappas, flavorful aloo palak chaat, authentic vada pav, rich dal makhani, and the perfectly spiced dhaba-style tawa chicken. Even the butter roti and naan were perfectly cooked — soft, warm, and fresh. Highly recommend for a great night out with friends!
Good food, ghee roast chicken and lamb bhuna were quite good. Biryani was average. This was a five star review until they asked me for a $1 to pack a small leftover box.

Remember the good ole days where on a Friday, you'll pick up fish and chips from your local takeaway shop? This is one of those places. Run by a lovely Asian couple, we came around in the evenings after braving 40 minutes of traffic to get their fish and chips. From the looks of it, they maybe sell fresh fish during the day but the metal and glass cabinets were empty come the evening. Menus are printed and handwritten in chalk on the wall. From the looks of it, they're usually busy out back cooking so when you come in, tap the old school bell on the counter top and the gentleman comes out to serve you pretty quickly. There is an old dilapidated couch in the waiting area, reminiscent of one of those couches that you would crash on your friend's place while hanging out or after a night of booze. And also the quintessential picture/diagram of different fish hanging on the wall. Food was pretty darn good, although our bad for the long drive home and the chips becoming a bit soggy. Batter was seasoned well (along with the fish), was not overly battered, and the fish was cooked well and flaked when broken apart. Chips were also seasoned nicely, not dumped on with salt and you could taste the potatoes through it. Good place, wish it was a bit closer so I could call it my local!
Delicious reasonably priced food. We loved our hoki, mussel fritters and chips. They also have fresh fish in the chiller out back I think as someone bought some while we were there
Good old fashioned feed of fish n chips. Decent portion sizes. The fish is fresh and chips crunchy. Highly recommend

Great fish and chips, affordable price. The batter is just perfect, crunchy and not too thick. Fresh made when you order and the fish always taste fresh. It's a family owned business and we love to support local business, much better value for money than other fast food options.

Sadly we have noticed a change and not for the better, oily fish, less than a teaspoon of sauce per burger and hotdog and $6 chips Is ridiculous... More like $2-$3 chips. Customer service is pretty bad too, We are looking for a new local unfortunately.

Takeaway only. There's a few seats and a bit of space to wait, and there's water in the corner. Place was neat and tidy, presentable. Food is good - one of the few places that actually does proper/Thai spicy. Portion was good for the money. Just one pad kee mao lasted me 3 meals. Pad Thai was as I remembered it when they used to be at Mt Albert, if not better - not too sweet, not too sour. It wasn't overly saucy, and very flavourful. Pad Kee Mao was order as spicy (Thai spicy) and it tasted amazing.

[Chill Out Fried Rice] Very recommended, it has a nice wok and authentic Thai flavor. The pork strips had a small amount of chewy meat/fat which I had spit out but other than that I really liked it. Definitely will be ordering again in the future. It also has a little bit of spiciness.
Amazing Thai place. Dishes full of flavour. Great portion sizes. Friendly and fast service, even during busy times ordered made very quickly. Would recommend kiwi medium level of spice.
Ordered red curry, was absolutely delicious! $20 per Serving + rice, size was more than enough for one meal. Very nice and friendly service. Only about a 10 minute wait. Will definitely return😁

I absolutely love chill out, have been eating here for many years. I just wish they would completely remove or revise their chilli/spice options. After making the mistake a few times I only order mild now. Made the mistake of asking my husband to order from here and he picked medium ( thinking it would be similar to Indian take out spice level). The food was literally laced with red chilli and we had to throw it out as it was completely inedible. I can’t imagine how how the others would be. Please look at your spice levels again.

First time here and wow! Very clean place everywhere you look. The food looks fresh and tastes great! My son loved the sushi! And I loved the chicken and chips! Highly recommend it, we will definitely be back ❤️

Great service, clean, nice decor, but the sushi is not at all good. The rice is thick, firm and dry without flavour - seemingly no rice wine vinegar. The ingredients are generally fresh but not good quality - the salmon was stringy and didn’t taste sashimi grade and the eel was rubbery, almost re-hydrated with a slimy, unpleasant sauce. Most things are deep fried or covered with too much sauce (I think I tasted salad cream!). The pieces were far too big - I’d rather have smaller, higher quality portions. Can’t complain for the price but we won’t be back.

You need to try this place if you haven't already! My partner and I highly recommend it to everyone we know. The food is excellent, the service is amazing, the price is great for what you get, and the portions are big! My partner and I usually get the teriyaki salmon and chicken katsu donburi. The ingredients are very fresh and balanced with the fresh salad. The sauces are very flavourful. We've tried other items on their menu and their sushi and they are all excellent. We'd say their sushi is some of the best we've ever had! The service is also amazing - the staff are very friendly and always have a smile on their face. It feels as though every order is very important to them. They also always remember preferences we have (e.g. not liking onions). This place is so good that even when we moved out of the blockhouse bay area to about half an hour away we still try to go regularly. We would give them more than 5 stars if we could!

[Half & Half Combo] Honey Butter & K-Sweet & Sour. Chicken was crispy and had nice flavor. The sweet and sour was very nice but with the Honey butter, it would be good if the flavor was more buttery as I could only taste sweet. Home made pickle was nice, coleslaw was just a typical mayo coleslaw, and you will definitely need more ketchup. Overall it was good, I would go back time to time.

Best sushi/ Best chicken lives up to it’s name. Absolutely love this spot! 5/5 would recommend trying all their dishes! Thank you for the delicious opening. Their sushi is always fresh, the Korean soy fried chicken is already on my list to reorder, and the donburi’s were delicious, not often you get such a tasty bowl from top to bottom. My new weekly! ❤️
Ordered a Mixed kebab. The portion was large and tasted yummy. The mixture of salad and hummus along with BBQ sauce was exquisite. Would definitely recommend 👍

The best Kebab’s I have ever had! Lovely owners (husband and wife) so happy and friendly. Very clean place and food always made fresh to order. I had the Falafel Kebab and oh my goodness it was so delicious!!! I could eat it every day 😂😂😂
The food is amazing. The Hawaiian burger was delicious and kebabs on chips omk just beautiful 🤍 definitely worth it
Awesome food. Could have been a bigger kebab. But full of meat.

Popped in for a quick coffee and a slice of cake. Very tidy premises and the owner/ barista made a lovely cup of Java. I liked the matching decorative china wear, it added to the ambiance. The laying of cup & plate and placement of cutlery by the owner as seen was a classy touch.

Great service and fresh food at KFC Royal Oak! The chicken was crispy and fresh as expected. The real standout was the customer service. They went the extra mile by giving us free chips during a short wait, which was much appreciated. Pavan, in particular, deserves recognition for his excellent service – he was attentive and made our visit better. Excellent job by the team, and I will absolutely be returning.
Good service and decent food quantity compared to south Auckland branches.

Was extremely disappointed with the staff’s behaviour. The level of customer service was shockingly poor- staff were making rude comments, using inappropriate language, and even throwing order boxes onto tables before serving us. It felt disrespectful and unprofessional, and I genuinely felt uncomfortable being there. This experience raises concerns about the quality and safety of the food being served. I hope the management team takes this feedback seriously and addresses the behaviour of the staff involved.

Such an amazing team! So friendly and always make trip worth it!! Food is always amazing and the team always go the extra mile whenever I come through Also one of the cashiers there payal Does such an amazing job and gives the best customer service

Has been the local for years - a lot of the new kids working drive through are rude and lack customer service skills completely. Will now go to royal oak over lynfield. They got pissed because we asked for chips in seperate box like other kfc places and we could hear them complaining and gave us old cold chips. A no would have been better. Horrible service.

A FREE LEGO Exhibition with great coffee! We only wanted a large bucket of coffee and the Chilli cafe delivers smooth, hot and strong.☕️👍 We didn’t have brunch but the reviews do look good and the deserts looked appealing, perhaps I’ll try the caramel with chocolate cornflakes next time I call in 😀 A massive selection of LEGO if that’s what you and the kids are into.

I recently visited this place for a short break with friends. While the atmosphere was suitable for catching up, the food and service were somewhat lacking. The muffins we purchased were dry and tasteless, and the coffee was just okay. Unfortunately, the staff could improve on their customer service. Despite these issues, I appreciate the casual vibe that makes it a good spot to meet with friends. Let me know if you'd like any further adjustments!

Lamb shank was delicious. Seafood pasta, could use larger portion of "pasta", not very filling. Pepper Squid entree yummy. Service was very friendly and efficient. Too brightly lit. Sports bar ambience is distracting. They should seperate restaurant from sports bar.

Food was good, coffee was nice and hot as asked for....food came out fast. Only issue for me was that there were muffins sitting on bench top uncovered the whole time we were there and visible to those dining in.
I enjoyed my food, service is good. Atmosphere was quiet, clean, and entertaining. Flavourful, and loved the display of food on my plate.

Extremely disappointed on their sorry state! The place is in complete disarray, and the pizza I received was nothing like what a Godfather pizza should have been ( see comparison of actual pic vs advertised by dominos). I counted handful of tiny pieces of meat with barely any veggies. It was a pathetic, embarrassing attempt at what’s supposed to be a pizza. When I provided feedback, their response was 'Thank you so much for letting us know,' I Don’t even want to start on the second pizza!!

My recent visit to mount roskill Domino's Pizza left a very positive impression. The quality of the pizza—crisp crust, flavorful sauce, and a generous amount of fresh toppings—was excellent, and it’s clear the kitchen is dedicated to consistency and taste. Service and Delivery: The service was prompt and courteous, with the delivery arriving on time and the order perfectly packaged. In particular, staff member Maulik went above and beyond by ensuring that every detail of the order was correct and even offering friendly recommendations. His attention to customer satisfaction made the experience truly memorable.

I recently ordered a "Cheese Burst Crust" pizza from a reputed Domino's store, expecting the quality and taste they are known for. However, the experience was far from satisfactory. The crust, which was supposed to ooze with cheese, had very little or no cheese at all. It felt like I was eating a regular pizza with no added value for the extra cost. To address the issue, I went back to the store to show them the pizza and express my disappointment. Shockingly, the staff's response was dismissive. They claimed, "This is how we make all our pizzas." This explanation was completely unacceptable and unprofessional for a brand of Domino's stature. As a loyal customer, I expect better quality and accountability when there’s a clear deviation from advertised standards. This experience has left me questioning whether I would trust Domino's with my next order. A simple acknowledgment of the issue and a corrective measure could have salvaged the situation. I hope the management takes feedback seriously and ensures that customers receive what they pay for—a proper Cheese Burst Crust pizza with the promised quality! Very disappointed. Would not recommend until they improve their quality control and customer service.

Garlic prawn pizza was suppose to have baby spinach in them but it’s dumped with loads of tomatoes and loads of grease when usually my pizza never turns out like this it’s been two times they’ve been doing this and price isn’t worth it when you give customers a shitty pizza do you job next time or else I’ll have to come into the store and ask for a refund.

Honestly a pretty tragic Dominos. Ordered a Pepperoni “Deluxe” and it came with an average of two pieces of pepperoni per slice. Contacted them via their website three times over a week, with no response. Had the same issue with my previous order, but thought to give them another go… won’t be back again.

I brought my family there and can't wait to return. The place is clean and the food is amazing. The kids' menu is delightful too. I am definitely coming back—100%! The atmosphere is wonderful, the staff is fantastic and there's a wide variety of both menu items and cabinet foods, all in generous portions. Overall, it was a truly great experience.

My wife and I visited Melba Café in Hillsborough for our Saturday brunch. We usually just pass through the area, but this time we decided to stop, and we were glad we did. The café has a warm, inviting vibe and is nicely set in the heart of Hillsborough. It was already fairly busy when we arrived, with the best seats taken. We ordered: The Smash with Creamy Mushrooms – Served on sourdough with avocado, corn salsa, and a rich mushroom sauce. Fresh and flavourful. Hills Chicken Waffle – Crispy fried chicken on a fluffy waffle, topped with maple butter. Sweet and savory, and very satisfying. Flat White (Medium) – Smooth, well-balanced, and nicely made. Island Breeze Smoothie – A refreshing blend of mango and pineapple. Light and tropical. The staff were friendly, though service was a bit slow, we had to follow up a couple of times to get everything. It seemed to be a busy hour, so hopefully just a one-off. Overall, we really enjoyed the meal and would definitely recommend this café if you’re in the area!
Great local cafe. They offer great specials and happy hour. Choice of complementary still and sparkling water. Cocktails were refreshing. Free parking at the back of the building.

Okay, let me tell you about our Valentine's Day dinner at MELBA Hillsborough – it was absolutely fantastic! From the moment we walked in, the ambiance was spot on; plenty of space, which is always a plus, and just a really nice vibe. The food? Seriously top-notch. We started with the Arancini balls, Ceveiche, and fried chicken, and wow, everything was so yummy and fresh. The portions were really generous too, which we appreciated! We washed it all down with their Ginsboroug and Rosie Hills cocktails – perfect start to the evening. For our mains, I went with the Grilled hallumi salad and my partner got the Hills chicken waffle. I have to say, that Grilled hallumi salad was amazing! Perfectly grilled, and the whole salad was just delicious. We were so full, we almost skipped dessert, but we couldn't resist! We missed out on the special coffee desserts, but went with the Banana filo on recommendation, and it didn't disappoint. It was so yummy – light, tasty, and the perfect way to end the meal. But the real highlight? We were lucky enough to be hosted and served by the owner, Kamal, himself! Such a lovely person, and his customer service was truly 100/100. He made us feel so welcome and special. Honestly, we're already planning our next visit to try their breakfast and lunch options. This place is a gem! Highly, highly recommended! You won't be disappointed.

Such a nice place! The ambience and decor is lovely, and the service is good! The menu is pretty standard cafe style meals, and the food overall, is pretty good. My group got the mushrooms on toast, the house smoked salmon eggs Benedict and the fritters. The portion sizes were reasonable and the food filling, and freshly made.

Been here after the change of ownership. The new owners have taken this to the next level. I cannot find words to describe our experience this evening. Needless to say the Chicken Mirchi is out of the world. Please take time to give this a try. I assure you you will not be disappointed. The hostess Rupinaa was outstanding. She took such great care of our table. Can’t speak enough about our pleasant experience.

After a long busy week, we finally got a chance to have dinner out with our family—and we’re so glad we chose Curry O City. We were tired and just looking for a nearby place, and decided to give Indian food a try. What a pleasant surprise! The atmosphere is clean, welcoming, and comfortable—perfect for a relaxed family dinner. The staff were friendly and attentive, making us feel right at home from the moment we walked in. Now for the best part—the food. Everything we ordered was absolutely delicious, with rich flavors and generous portion sizes. Even our parents, who can be quite selective with food, really enjoyed it. Sometimes the best experiences are the ones you don’t plan—and Curry O City was definitely one of those unexpected gems. Please guys, keep up your good work and continue your food quality every day! We’ll definitely be back.

The chicken tikka was absolutely delicious full of flavor and perfectly cooked. Compliments to the chef and the staff for their warm and attentive service. Highly recommend visiting at least once.You’ll definitely want to go back again! 🍽️👏

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ An Absolute Gem for Curry Lovers! Curry City Restaurant is hands down one of the best dining experiences I’ve had. The food is bursting with authentic flavours, perfectly spiced, and beautifully presented. Every dish feels like it’s made with care—from the rich butter chicken to the tender lamb rogan josh, everything is cooked to perfection. The service is outstanding—friendly, fast, and attentive. The staff make you feel welcome from the moment you walk in. The ambiance is warm, clean, and inviting—perfect for both casual meals and special occasions. Whether you’re a fan of spicy curries or creamy delicacies, Curry City has something for every palate. Highly recommend it to anyone who loves Indian cuisine. I’ll definitely be back soon!

What a find! The presentation matched the flavors!. Amazing blend of spices with generous portion sizes. A full range of both vegetarian and chicken lamb and fish dishes. Authentic Marsala Chai.... one of my favorites. The Chef's Specials moved it into a very special meal. I recommend Indian Butter Chicken and the Tandoori Prawns....... a nice hidden spicey treat! Very moorish. The staff were great. Worth a visit. Excellent value.

Being a Subway family our teens enjoy any opportunity to grab a quick bite - Our usual fave, a footlong Chicken Classic toasted on Wheat Bread🙌 Whilst the food is guaranteed to be delicious what was disappointing here was the 2 ladies serving. Not sure if it was just that time of the day (1:30pm) but they certainly lacked smiles and clearly no idea about good customer care. Bright lipstick and No smiles🤷🏻‍♀️ When we get this kind of vibe we tend to just walk straight back out but decided to give them a chance. Unfortunately it didn’t improve and in fact got worse as they prepared our 3 Footlongs. Whilst the store had a nice warm feel on entry, the only let down were these 2 staff members either not sure how to smile or just unfamiliar with good customer service. Please do better - also no idea about how to use the Reward dollars on our SubCard. If this isn’t posted nothing will improve.
As always service was extremely fast and kind. I ordered a platter very last minute and they had it done in 10mins highly recommended

Very disappointing service. As soon as I entered the store, the staff told me it would take 20 minutes, even though they only had one large order. I was shocked, especially since I just wanted one toastie. When I expressed my concern, the staff member responded very rudely. Not the kind of service you expect from Subway.

I don’t normally give poor reviews but today i m too sick and ordered subway from here and didnt get any suaces instead of i have been asked for 3 suaces. It’s too dry sub and couldn’t eat properly and even have to spend more money to eat something else. Never suggest to anyone.

The guy who served me probably wins employee of the month alot for saving this branch $ because usually the footlong i get has 4 slices of ham. He did just 2 slices and opened them up to cover the whole thing lol.

Food was amazing! This guy really knows how to make fried chicken AND with his own secret recipe! If you want affordable, good quality fried chicken and service with a smile, this is the place for you! The food is not too greasy and the burgers are decent size and delicious with a good range of choices!
Absolutely phenomenal! From the first bite to the last, these burgers were an explosion of flavor. The patties were perfectly cooked—juicy and tender. Highly recommended for Peri Peri burger.

Firstly the man was awesome he was super friendly. Secondly the food was soooooo good we ordered a periperi burger and a hot and spicy burger and it hit the spot as we took bites into it. We also ordered chicken, wings, stripes and chicken tikka kebab, the chicken pieces was big, juicy and well cooked. And lastly it was cheap, if people are looking for good food according to their budget than I would say this place is the one. Overall I would give this local business 10000/10. Will definitely recommend others and will surely go here again and again.
The burgers were really tasty, the sause was very unique and flavourful. You could also tell the chicken had been well marinated. Would definitely recommend the peri peri burger+fries+strips meal.

We ordered a peri-peri value meal, High 5, 5 nibbles plus basic fillet burger and OMG!!! All I have to say is that the food is absolutely delicious and the portions are so big I couldn't even finish my value meal but you want to go back for more!! Highly recommended and absolutely affordable 👌 please give them a try

This place has got vibes! The staff are really cool - chill and friendly but they get your order exactly right. It’s a really cute caravan with a lot of soul. My partner really enjoyed his meat and chips. I ordered the falafel and sadly it was a bit dry and greasy and also not my kind of flavour profile. Their falafel is heavy on the Indian spices and lacks the herbaceous qualities of traditional Mediterranean falafel served in places like Lebanon or Greece. I prefer the fresh, greener variety with parsley, coriander, dill and even mint with the background flavours of cumin… this lacked that fresh herb quality. I was really craving good falafel so didn’t really enjoy mine, but I’ll be back to try the chicken kebab because the service was so good and I’m sure the chicken will be great.

Our initial experience with the whaikowhai kebab was exceptional. The quality of the food was outstanding, sharing photos of our order. We suggest considering the patties as a burger option. In summary, the meal was delicious.

Edit: Why would a customer lie about pick up times? The order took an absurd amount of time to prepare and the fact you are lying about that and other details in my review means I'm going to reduce your rating to 1 star. If you want to try a great kebab I would highly recommend Shefco Middle Eastern Cuisine, 827 Dominion Rd. Order took 40mins to prepare with no other orders ahead of us which was odd. The hummus was runny and about a tablespoon of it (could barely scoop it up) and the rice was a shorter grain and sticky. Glad we tried it but wouldn't return again, a fairly bland kebab I wouldn't recommend

Ordered kebab on rice 3 times, the first time when I arrived she said they'd only just got the order, there was no rice cooked and it would take a while, so she asked if I wanted kebab on chips instead which was fine, took 25+ mins for them to make the food, decided to give them another shot, and it was fine, I went today for the third time and again when I arrived at the time that both the email and text told me it would be ready, she said she's only just got the order and it would be a 10 min wait. The food is fine, but not good enough to justify waiting constantly. Will not be going back
Solid kebab spot with friendly staff. Their beef burger was insane!

I had ordered dinner from Taj flavours. And the Food was so delicious and truly price worthy. Service is great and order was ready on timely manner. This Chef Ashish is really got perfect making on the dishes he got. I recommend this place for fresh and tasty food.
New to the area and found our new favourite place to get the best meal. Ordered twice now and loved it both times. Really good food, highly recommend.
Staff were knowledgeable about which items on the menu were gluten free (all curries plus others). Great tasting and value. Will order there again.

An absolutely Heavenly food I have had after lonnnnngggg...time..just close ur eyes & order by your finger tips on the menu ..not gonna regret for sure...my whole family loved it ..mouth watering & relishing..mainly fresh taste people wud like to have on their plates...thanks Aashish ( chef ) & team..🥂
Delicious, generous quantity of paneer and tandoori rotis were quite soft. Will order again to try indo Chinese dishes. Thank you chef 😊

Great food but sometimes inconsistent with flavour. The Hui Kee Special Seafood Fried Rice and Pad Thai is great but consistency is an issue. The won tons are good and we had the best fish and chips in a long while from here but the next time it wasn't as good, same as for the fried mussels and chicken nibbles - better the first time. If Hui Kee can be more consistent I ain't going to any other takeaway lol The couple who run Hui Kee are good too.

I got Pack 2 with 2 Hoki, 2 Sausages and $2.50 chips for $14 + an extra pineapple fritter for $1.40. Overall the food was a little average, not the best but not the worst, pretty yummy pineapple fritter though! I was impressed by the service they had, you place your order then wait in the car and they’ll bring the orders out!
Good place for feed on a budget food is okay. I like the people that own it their service to me is great! Not much of an atmosphere up in there.

Second time I've bought lunch from here. Their lunch special is very well priced for what you get. Awesome flavours on the fried rice and wontons were good. A little too much wrapper for me, but can't go wrong with the price. $9 for the fried rice lunch special and $5 for a dozen wontons. This was enough for 2 people. The owners were very apologetic as it came out at around 15mins, as opposed to around 10.. no big deal. Happy to wait for good food for a good price!
Special 1... Fish big but floury, good potato fritter & chips...

Really good service, but the food wasn't the same and both my partner and I got stomach problems but we won't blame them as we also bought food from other places. Looking at my photos, it is nuked. Lacking salt and pepper and had a nuked feeling, especially as the salad was sad! I'm disappointed, but may be because of a lack of customers might give crap food?

Chips were dry, tasted like they had been sitting in the warmer for a while. Chicken burger was nice though. When you order from the kiosk you can't select no ice for your drink that's not an option but it should be. Don't like ice in my drink.

Absolutely terrible experience at Wendy’s Hillsborough. The staff was shockingly rude — after placing an order, they told us not to come to the store because “they have to rest.” Excuse me? It was during business hours, and they were clearly just being lazy or unwilling to serve customers. They were sitting around, not doing any actual work, and had zero knowledge or professionalism. This is completely unacceptable for a food service business. If your staff wants to “rest all day,” maybe shut down the location instead of treating paying customers with such disrespect. We won’t be coming back — and I’d recommend everyone else stay away from this branch as well.
Great location nice and friendly staff members. Food is a bit slow but claimed to be made to order. Restaurant is very clean and you don’t need to ask a code to use it. Great environment

28 minutes of waiting time for just 12 pcs chicken nuggets and 2 drinks when there's nearly zero customer inside the restaurant and drive thru. Is this not outrageous? All they can say is sorry and blame the notification malfunction. A dessert or some sort would be more appropriate as an apology for making a customer wait half an hour.

Popped in for a med lamb meal. I've been here before and had a good experience. Unsure why I haven't been back... Well portioned, tender lamb and vege drizzled with gravy. Premises is well organised and clean. Thats right! Service is relative to your melanin levels.. why I never went back. Thanks

Got argumentative with me when I pointed out they didn't add mint sauce as I asked for, instead of just offering to put it on, his response.. 'how can you see' Also don't sell crackling Don't reccomend, much better roast places with better customer service near

Went to get some lunch, came back with snack I guess. Taste was okay but portion is way too smaller for the price, $17 for small chicken roast meal- basically two potatoes, a kumara, a pumpkin and a spoonful of peas n carrots which is fine but chicken was not even half of a quarter ; few pieces shredded. Felt like fine dine price for takeout!!

Roadt Cuisine Takeaway is our go to roast shop. Their roast meals are always good. Their fried chicken is delicious. And we always have a few extra cheeky roast potatoes to eat in the car on the way home. If you haven't already bought from them before, go check them out.

Been going to this place for years and it's still one of my fav spots :-) I highly recommend the lamb or beef meals!! Pictured: Medium lamb meal with 2 extra potatoes, small combo meal (2 fried chicken and 4 potatoes)

Not the best sushi - but average for the ‘lunch stop in’ NZ style. They are open later than most so you can still get a good selection after 3pm. The sushi is very western style and not particularly tasty but it is affordable and the seating is nice. The selection is really good and the service is also good. It’s a decent spot to stop for a quick feed.

My kids absolutely love this place! We’ve been coming here for over 10 years and still can’t get enough. It’s become one of our weekly go-to spots. The food is consistently fresh and delicious, and the prices are way better than most sushi bento places in Auckland. Easily one of the best-value Japanese cuisine spots in the area. Super friendly and service too, honestly, couldn’t ask for more!

I ordered the 'Salmon Teriyaki Bento' for $28.30, and given the price, I expected at least decent quality. The menu described it as including 'miso soup, salad, rice, deep-fried (dumpling, vegetables, and prawn), sushi, and sashimi.' However, as seen in the photo, there were just two tiny, paper-thin slivers of sashimi—maybe 1/2 teaspoon worth. Does that even count? It felt misleading. The 'teriyaki salmon' was bland and dry, with a meager amount of sauce that had no flavour. The tempura was soggy, and the kumara tempura was half raw. The dumplings were completely missing. An absolute rip-off. Avoid.

Yummy yummy yummy sushi, this place always satisfies when I order from this restaurant. The fried chicken sushi pieces are the tastiest I’ve ever had. This place is going to make me very fat ahehehehehe.
Had the pork katsu bento box. Plenty of food and flavour. Would recommend.

Beautiful family friendly pub. Great service and great prices - we took full advantage of happy hour and the kids had a blast on the old school arcade machine while we waited for our order. Delicious food.

It’s a great sprawling old school pub to grab a pint. Lots of seating options including a beer garden, massive bar so you won’t be in line for long, some cozy tables to chat at and some good music. It’s a bit run down and dingy, sure, but it’s an alternate to the industrial warehouse hipster craft beer and $22 smash burger bollox that dominates the scene. Loads of parking, pool tables and a decent pint of Guinness. The staff are great - chill, friendly and helpful. It even has an AC⚡️DC pinball machine. Can’t speak for the food but it’s not why I come.

Have just been there for lunch and weren’t disappointed. Welcoming staff, food was tops and my pint was perfectly poured. Dickey’s is gearing up for St Patrick’s day. I might have to call in for another pint.

nice enough place , needs a renovation update.. " but if you want a pigs ear beer 🍺, then you can't go wrong hear-a..." has a pool table & other games. small toys kids section... & available for hire.

Love this pub - so spacious and family friendly. We booked out a space for our family to gather before Christmas and we loved the atmosphere, the food and the ease of service. Great expereince and we'll definitely be back.

Most recent experience: friendly guy behind the counter. Order was ready pretty quickly. Just the toppings were ridiculous, ordered three pizzas and it was like eating plain bread with some tomato paste. Very stingy with the toppings sadly. First experience (with images): Made a web order. Order was ready within 15 minutes of placing order. We haven't had pizza hut in years due to how bad our past experiences were. Hope restored tonight as the pizzas were well made. Good amount of toppings, tasty overall.

You'd think after countless phone calls of getting your order wrong in order to rectify the issue and find out what's wrong they'd pick the store phone up. Going to take this up with management as it's unfair to have a number listed on google and over a 2-3 hour period not take a single call. Thoroughly disappointed!!! Will definitely be taking this matter further and see what comes of it and whether the issue gets rectified.
Had no issues here, food was ready on time for collection. Pizza was well made, good toppings. Tasted great.

I was ok that 5 pizzas might take a little while on Sunday night but the online information was broken and I couldn’t follow what was happening, they were still making the pizzas when I got the text they the pizzas were “heading your way”. I live less that 5kms away but the pizzas took 25 mins to get that distance. The pizzas were nearly cold. Not great this time.

I ordered a big new Yorker with a San Francisco base. Instead I was served a regular base and when I raised the issue, the staff worker told me I was mistaken when it was clearly not what I had ordered. I told them that I had the San Francisco base just the other night and that this was just the regular base. They responded by telling me I "should just eat it anyways because I will enjoy it" . Stingy on the toppings too. There are some slices with no meat at all. I've uploaded a photo of what I had today vs what I had recently at another store. Clearly different. Mistakes happen but poor handling with zero effort to rectify the issue.

Birthday Cake and Chicken pakora were just delicious. Both were freshly made. Cake was soft and moist. Chicken frying instructions were easy and simple to follow. Both the cake and chicken were packed professionally. Entire family loved it. I will no doubt buy it again

We bought masala fish fillets, and everyone in the family loved them. Owner communication is great, along with excellent service. Food is really fresh and well prepped for heating and/or cooking at home. Would definitely order again from here and highly recommend it to everyone.

We bought the chicken pakoras, fish fillets, and orange almond cake — and absolutely loved them! Everything was finger-licking good. The food was clearly freshly prepared, and the chicken pakoras were especially easy to cook at home. The owner’s instructions were simple and clear, making the whole experience hassle-free. We’ll definitely be buying again!
The Nankhatai's were the most delicious treats I've had in a long time. Will surely get them again.☺️
Loved Karishma’s orange cake - soft, moist and flavourful! Prompt and professional service :) Definitely recommend!

Did a take out from this place. I ordered a spicy chicken burger spicy wings and chicken combo and we had french fries potato and gravy and coleslaw as the side dishes. the chicken was really good, crispy crunchy and really nice but the flavour of the spice in it was a different kind of flavour though it was okay. Coleslaw was creamy and nice and little sweet but good, the french fries were really good, crunchy and nice. overall it was pretty good and we all enjoyed the food.
The service was really good but the quality of the fried chicken was average at best.
THE BEST PERI PERI CHIPS IVE EVER HAD IN NEW ZEALAND!, MUST TRY, GE FRIES ARE CRISPY WITH BEAUTIFUL SEASONING, and melts in your mouth
Chicken Souvlaki was good, perfectly cooked chicken and the special herb is must try. Chips seasoning was good and the portion was big.

Good place for halal food especially Fried chicken and burgers. A must try place for spicy crispy chicken if you like spicy. They have both options available normal and spicy. Ahmed is really nice and humble. Gave us great recommendations for burgers. If you are around do give them a try.
