NEW UPDATE: NEW OWNERS, FOOD AVERAGE Fine Food Takeaway has new owners who have stuck with the same menu but are producing some bad food! We wanted to find out if the new owners were any good so ordered the number 4 special for $17: three fish, three sausages, three potato fritters and $3 chips (+ extra $3 chips). POSITIVES sausages were nice (although one of them looked funny) and the hot chips were great especially with the chicken salt! NEGATIVES Fish and potato fritters were the worst we've ever had! The fish the last owners made were way better, the fish and potato fritters this time had the worst batter ever and was undercooked😡 then as you can see on the photos the shapes and sizes were not consistent so please don't go here for fried fish or potato fritters!!!
Found a bug in the chips really put me off. Looked like a baby cockroach 🤮
This is what "normal chicken nibbles" look like. When confronted was told nobody has ever complained and that this is normal.

This is our favourite takeaways in the area. Its doesn't look too fancy from the outside but the value is great and the food always comes out looking fresh and crisp. The oil must get changed regularly as it always looks a light colour. We normally get one of the combos which gives you loads of food for the family and leftovers for the next day.

I just got fried chicken & chips here. I thought it looked odd but decided to give it a try. Ewww, I wouldn’t even give it to my dog! It doesn’t taste like chicken, it tastes like duck. It looks like it was precooked a long time ago, then she just threw them in the frying pan in an attempt to hear it up. The inside is very cold still and the “chicken” is hard like duck meat 🤮🤮 Never again! I’m waiting for my daughter to get out of school so I can return it. It’s so bad it doesn’t even deserve a star! I DO NOT RECOMMEND.

Brilliant staff and great chicken wings. The kebabs are a little hit and miss, but mostly hit! The first few times I ate there they were perfect - exactly what I asked for with succulent chicken and specific fresh salads. Last time though the chicken was awful - I think it was the dregs at the end before a fresh rotisserie… they were small, dry, oily chicken gravel. That has only happened once though. Generally speaking these guys are friendly, fast and fresh.
Fantastic service. The burgers and chips was yum the chicken thighs was too hard to bite into as though the coating had been too overcooked maybe? The wings were ok

I grabbed some food from this place today. The chicken nibbles were tasty, the regular fries were alright and the curly fries were way too salty for my liking. The place was really clean and the staff was decent. The service was just okay and parking was easy to find.

This place has the best chicken that I have ever tried from their fried chicken drum stick to their awesome kebabs and best of all their spicy chicken burger. Mango lassi is so fresh and yummy too. Place is neat and tidy. Staff are nice and helpful. Overall experience is great. Highly recommend 👍
The customer service was very poor, with staff exhibiting a bad attitude. It felt unwelcoming, which overshadowed the food. I wouldn't recommend it based on my visit.

I have visited this amazing spot countless times, and I can confidently say it's the best takeaway in the area! The Fish and Chips, chicken nibbles, Egg Foo Yung, Beef Brisket, Sweet and Sour Pork, and fried rice/noodles are all top-notch and consistently delicious. The friendly business owner always adds to the welcoming atmosphere. It’s a place I love returning to almost every week.

I always order the chicken nibbles here, so this review is purely based on their chicken nibbles, but they are delicious. The portion is generous and price is great. There is this 'sweetness' to the nibbles that I find delicious. Honestly, they don't always turn out great (like the coating not covering the chicken, or chicken itself was small), but so far, 90% of the time, it's been fine.

Very good food here at this popular Roskill South takeaway! Sometimes it's not on point but 9/10 it is very good. The Chinese meals are always great particularly the steak chow mein, as well as the crinkle-cut fries, chicken nibbles and spring rolls (a family favourite). Service is always great, very good people. Plenty of parking and also a table in the takeaway to eat your food if you can't wait or if you've decided to escape the family and treat yourself!

The best takeaways ever had. Chips are always nice white cooked with fresh oil and crispy. Chicken fried rice, Chow Mein always have allot of meat and range of veges. Sweet and sour chicken tastes great. Won tons not too oily and great portion and crispy. Chicken burgers are thick and crunchy. And best of all, they have the best priced deals. Family feast feeds 4-5people under $45. Lovely service and clean shop. This place deserves an award. Awesome place to treat your family on a budget with quality food.
Wow. Great food. We had combination Egg Fu Yong and Mapo Tofu. Massive amount of food and it was very delicious. We'll be definitely come back.
Very good fish and chip store, good prices and the best curry spring roll in the game. Don't go to McDonald's come here for your salty fixations.
Special No.7... 1.5kg... Good feed!
My first time here tonight and is now my favourite takeaway shop. Love the sweet and sour fish sooo good! Not drenched in sweet sour and heaps of fish, plenty to share.
Best chinese takeaway ever, tried most of the food, all tasted good. Recommend their BBQ pork fried rice, chicken nibbles and their chicken burger
Totally unhealthy but goes with type what a chinese and fish and chip shop brings ahha. Good prices and well cooked, nice service very solid cheap fish and chip shop!

My favourite sushi place! Always good food and even better service, thank you I will always try to go back when I can. We brought classic salmon sushi, always delicious chicken teriyaki sushi and my favourite the fried prawn! Also tried the prawn dumplings - very good! I'll be back soon Sushi Plus!

My daughters' favourite place for their sushi cravings. The price is very reasonable and the owner is very friendly. It is Hillsborough neighbourhood most favourite sushi takeaway shop. If you haven't tried their sushi, I would highly recommend you to try it. You will not be disappointed!
Such a cute, quaint little hole in the wall. Support your local biz vibes. The sushi is yum is a plus too

Of all the foods I’ve had, this is definitely sushi. Wish I could pick and choose my own though. I would love to write a 200 character review about this place but the sushi is not good enough nor is it bad enough. (Hoping this got me to 200 characters for the bonus points)
Great little sushi shop i stopped in for lunch the sushi was super fresh and tasty I had the salmon and avo the lady at the counter was super friendly definitely recommend visiting if ur a sushi fan
Food is pretty nice, especially the chips, wonton soup and spring/curry rolls 🙌🏼 chips scoop is pretty small though.
Food was tasteless, dry chicken if you want really bad Chinese food order from them. Wonton noodle soup no flavour only 4 wontons. I could go on and on about pour quality

Just go to Hong along takeaways down the road... My hot dog was under cooked My squid rings were under cooked My donut was over cooked Everything was far too oily. Spring roll was good but you can get much better just a few streets over.
The chilli Chicken is always so tasty. Singapore noodles were good.
Probably one of the best hot chips I've had 👌

Had a fantastic takeaway meal last night, the meal was very tasty and a great price point. The staff were also nice and friendly. I would highly recommend this restaurant for your takeaway curry, great mild butter chicken 👏🏻

New to town so I thought I'd check out my new local Indian restaurant. Thought the price was awesome and the young girl behind the counter was really nice. Sadly the butter chicken was a miss for me. After reading the reviews I had high hopes but it was really watery and could tell costs were cut and this reflected in the flavour.
Yesterday tried their veg noodles, it was really yum😋 and price was reasonable. Highly recommend if you are looking for great indian food in town.
This place is great and has become our go to for repeat takeaways! Service is friendly and quick. Meals are good portions, extremely tasty and great value.
Delicious food, huge portions and excellent service. Definitely going to be a regular for us! The momos and goat biryani were the highlights for us.

Got delivery - they delivered a chicken saagwala instead of the lamb saagwala that I ordered (and unfortunately I have an allergy to chicken). The other dish Butter Lamb and the naan were nice enough, but we wouldn’t go here again.

Recently found this place that replaced the Fish n Chips & Chinese Takeaways on Frederick Street. Friendly people but best of all is the food produced. Worth a visit & a wonderful tasty addition to break up the other takeaway options in the area. Highly recommend as they’re consistent with the food & Naan produced.

Exceptional culinary experience! This Indian restaurant exceeded all expectations. The flavors were authentic and exquisitely balanced, showcasing the chef's mastery. The ambiance was inviting, and the service impeccable. Each dish was a delightful journey through India's diverse cuisine. A must-visit for anyone seeking an unforgettable gastronomic adventure.

Mouth watering dishes, friendly and efficient staff. We were on our way to the airport and stopped by this place for a quick bite. We requested the staff to fast track as we had a flight to catch. Despite rush hour, they served our dishes quickly. 5 star rating for this place, extremely impressed.
Best butter chicken I’ve ever had. So good I am low key addicted they make it perfect every single time! Naan is always amazing and fresh. The staff are professional and kind.

This is the best cafe ever! Food and customer service is amazing. What our family absolutely loves about this cafe is their very generous portions. The food presentation and taste is always consistent. Family favourites and highly recommended are the Bacon Hash, The Feast, Pies and Chunky Fries.

All the staff are very friendly and welcoming and take their jobs seriously. The place is clean, tidy and has a great atmosphere. I usually eat in the separate area upstairs which is a more quieter , away from the hustle and bustle. Also there is a great little spot for young children to play while you eat. Their french toast dish is presented beautifully and very satisfying as it comes with bacon as well. Our favourite is the potato hash, it's a very generously sized dish with varying textures and tasty complementary flavours. Their blueberry cheesecake is the perfect balance of real fruit, textures and richness and flavour. With amazing customer service to boot - This is a Onehunga Gem!

I had a wonderful experience at this café. The food was delicious, and the staff were exceptionally kind and welcoming. One standout feature was their well-equipped playroom for kids, which allowed parents to enjoy their meals in peace. Highly recommended for families!

We had pies from the cabinet for lunch they were heated in a microwave so they went soggy, not really acceptablegiven they were $8.90. The coffee was burnt but the spicy chai was good. The service was fast and friendly.

A lovely café and eatery nestled in the charming streets of Onehunga. Really enjoyed the upstairs spot by the window, where could see the sweetgum trees basking in the sunlight on the old street. The café has a tranquil atmosphere with its old street and buildings, making it the perfect setting for a leisurely brunch on a laid-back afternoon. The downstairs and upstairs spaces create a peaceful environment that makes for a relaxing visit. Highly recommend stopping by! Don’t make it too busy !

Staying at an Airport Hitel, thought I'd go out and get takeaway Fish and Chips. Got the Snapper and Chips. Outstanding. Best value fish and chips I've had in a long while. Well done to those running the business 👏
Very delicious Oyster Fry

Short of one star because we waited half an hour for $8 chips and 2 burgers xD kinda disappointed with the cheeseburger though. Was expecting fresh lettuce, beetroot and tomatoes like other takeaways... But they ain't like other takeaways so it's ok. Lovely service though :) This is $8 chips and the veggie burger. Other than that, it was nice for a change
Good customer service and decently priced with awesome specials! The fish and chips tasted great! The batter is done well. 7/10

Good customer service, food was alright, thought it would've been better but I think I'd prefer the other fish and chip place. Idk, maybe I should've got fresh fish and got them to batter it. Update 10months later Very greasey

Best prices ever! Best fish so far, although this last time, there was way too much oil on everything and the batter was overdone even though we asked for underdone fish. The chips barely had flavour, but still okay. The sausages, mussels, crab sticks & hot dogs were awesome! The raw fish was a bit fishy this round, but the fortnite before when I tasted it, the raw fish was the best ever. Maybe because we went close to closing time, some things didn't taste as good as the first time.. but, I would still come back here, just earlier in the day.

I absolutely love coming here, such a gem in the bridge and a great takeaway and the seafood is also delish! My favourite is the $9 Fish Burger Combo which is an absolute must however they do have great takeaway deals which are not overpriced. It can get pretty busy after 3pm and especially during weekends, the wait time can be around 10-20mins. One thing I have to say is one of the staff there can be pretty rude, she’s a young woman with a brown-copper hair colour and her attitude towards customers can be a bit harsh which I do understand it’s busy and tiring but she shouldn’t be so rude. However the older woman with short hair and glasses is always a very nice woman, love her!
I come here every time I’m in Auckland cos it truly is the best! Fresh seafood & delicious hot foods, yum!
Normally this place would be my favourite but after driving 40 minutes to buy food that was literally soaked in oil, everything was soggy and made me feel nauseous, so disappointed
Raw fish was solid, creamy and a nice meaty fish. The chips were the nice crispy kind, the fish in the burger and the fish of the day were nice and flaky, chicken salt on the chips! Perfect match

One of My All-Time Favourite Local Cafés! Coronation Restaurant & Café has easily become one of my go-to spots for breakfast, brunch, and everything in between. Whether it’s a casual catch-up, a birthday brunch, or just a chill morning with friends and family, this place always hits the spot. Their Jug of Raspberry and L&P are always refreshing—perfect to share at the table and super thirst-quenching. I love their shoestring fries with aioli—crispy, salty, and seriously addictive. I’ve tried quite a few dishes over time: • The Chicken Pasta is rich and creamy with a more saucy texture—comforting and full of flavor. • The Chicken Burger and Steak Burger are both mouth-watering and satisfying, especially paired with fries. • The Chicken Caesar Salad with a side of ciabatta bread is a fresh, lighter option I love. • And the Eggs Benedict with salmon—perfectly poached eggs and smooth hollandaise, a brunch must-have! Overall, Coronation Café serves that feel-good, home-style food I crave. The vibe is always welcoming, the service is lovely, and being local just makes it even more special. I’ll definitely keep coming back!

The staff are friendly and attentive. They clean the tables very quickly, before the birds attack. There is a lot of space inside and outside. The coffee is awesome! The pineapple slice was good. When I ordered my steak they asked how I wanted it, and I said medium. It came out very well done. It was very off putting. I liked the side order of veggies. My friend said her shank was fine.

Despite the photos, the meal was mediocre. I had the sirloin steak ($26.90). The steak was rubbery and unseasoned, eggs were burnt on the bottom, salad tasted like nothing but lemon juice. Only good thing was the portions. Quite disappointed. The restaurant is also full of flies, it's disgusting.

Came in for lunch and regretted afterwards. Service was ok. Lunch menu and price can find elsewhere tad cheaper and better flavour. Seafood basket was a let down, little bite size bits of fish, small prawns, squid rings, a mussel or oyster? And some chips and sauce some were burnt. Grilled chicken on rice was bland and chicken was overcooked dry. Kids nugget meal, expensive 4 nuggets and chips. Butter chicken tasted mediocre. Prices didn't match the quality and flavour. Can get better elsewhere for less the price here.

This place is perfect if you tryna impress someone. They have such a generous amount of food, some would say it’s a lot but I cleared my plate. The food filled me up for the entire day, fair warning you may have a food coma if you aren’t prepared. The service was great and pretty fast, perfect speed for how hungry I was. The atmosphere is chill and there’s also seating outside. MSG connoisseur, this is your place. If you enjoy a lot of flavour you need to try them out. I’m not talking bout salt n pepper. We talking real flavours and deeply marinated. You will defs enjoy. My friend also stands by the mushroom vegetarian burger shes a local here and supported them for years. So vegetarians TRY IT OUT. Ordered: Lamb burger with fries. Mushroom burger & chicken burger. Side note: Some may be skeptics because of what their health rating used to be but they’re doing very well now and have an A. Give this family business a chance, you won’t regret. And if you do, then at least you tried something new for the experience.

Yet another good find from the good old entertainment book. Food and drink were very good friendly service with a smile and quick for the amount of customers they had in for lunch. Bacon was a particular highlight Smokey and good quality. Will be back next time I’m in the area.

I do like this place, but the food is just so average. Service is great, and the coffee is good. But the food really lets it down. It's so very basic and cheaply made. And that would be fine, but if it was cheap, it's not. For $30 for a full breakfast, I'd expect more than watery mushrooms, frozen hashbrowns and the 90% bread sausages.. It would be our go-to local if it had better food..:(

Had heard great things about this place and on arrival, loved the vibe, the outdoor area, the variety on the menu. Ordered a ham and cheese omelette which was divine. Super reasonable pricing, lovely food, great coffee, friendly staff. I will be back again.

Lovely food! It’s always fresh and hot. Corn fritters are a favourite of mine - they’re packed with goodness and come paired with a lovely relish. The coffee is more than halfway decent (excellent in my opinion) and I’ll admit, I cannot resist their gingerbread men. The staff are friendly and always provide quality service.

Treat yourself to the Big Brekkie. A slight upgrade from the usual mixed grill, in the Mangere area. Comes with a gourmet pork sausage (gf), creamy mushroom (nice and light), bacon, eggs (any style), wholegrain toast with butter and tomato. A decent sized plate of brekkie goodness. Others dishes to try are their Omelette and Beef salad 👌 I've ordered a few times now. Lovely staff and great service.

Absolutely love coming here, grabbing a pizza and playing some pinball! Epic hosts a huge variety of modern pinball machines, all in great working condition. There is also a Big Buck Hunter and a Daytona, if pinball isn’t quite your thing! The pizza is absolutely top notch, and their gluten free bases are the best available in Auckland. They also offer dairy free/vegan cheese which is the nicest, meltiest vegan cheese I’ve had. I cannot recommend the sausage party pizza enough! Sooo many drink options, too, and not just beer! The beer is definitely great, but their selection of gin, bourbon, and other spirits is also fantastic. Plenty of seating, indoor and outdoor. Good vibes with the big neon cowboy. Will definitely be back for more pinball and pizza fun!

The staff were amazing and the venue itself was cool, but unfortunately the food and drink were disappointing. The $30 pizza tasted like it was made with budget ingredients—comparable to something you'd find at Pak'nSave. I'm definitely spoiled when it comes to quality, but if I'm spending $60 on two pizzas, I'd expect at least one of them to be decent. Sadly, both tasted cheap, as if everything was made with the lowest-grade products. Quality is always noticeable, and even the beer missed the mark—it was far from enjoyable. For comparison, the beer at Good George Brewery is miles ahead. It's disheartening to see how often New Zealand misses the mark on basics like this. In countries like Germany or Belgium, beer gardens and halls pride themselves on delivering exceptional beer. Here, it felt more like drinking dog piss. To be blunt, I’ve had better frozen pizza from the supermarket. It's disappointing, but if more Kiwis had experienced truly great beer or authentic Italian pizza, they'd realise just how subpar this offering really is. I had a great time but I'll never return unfortunately but I do recommend it if you got nothing else to do in that area.

The best brewery in Auckland. Bit of an effort to get there. Using public transport get off at The Papapa and walk through an industrial area for 10 minutes. Once there enjoy the great beers on tap from pale ales to some pretty special IPA's at reasonable prices. And do not forget the pizzas! Very large and very tasty. Dog and kid friendly so well worth whiling away an afternoon here. Recommended.

Late review from a visit last Friday (23rd June). It's been way too long since I was last here. I arrived around 3, just before the after work crowd started rolling in. Was made welcome by Luke, Wendy and Paddy (and the rest of the team) and quickly got into the new IPA (Snakes) that was on tap. Numbers steadily increased and included workers from the area, families, people celebrating a birthday, people collecting riggers to take home and a few dogs. The atmosphere is relaxed and welcoming, the music is solid and not too loud. The beer is outstanding. I sampled a few more taps through the evening and a couple of cans from the well stocked fridge, before ordering a pizza. My "Epic Loves Bacon" pizza arrived and I ate the whole thing by myself. Easily the best pizza I've had. Fresh ingredients and a great thin base. I finished the night with the latest release (tap room only) of the excellent Captain Springs Imperial stout and then grabbed some take out to take home with me. Meet some new people, caught up with some old friends and had a great time. I'd been to about a dozen bars and venues in Auckland over the past couple of days, some of them I rate really highly. The Epic taproom was easily my favorite. If I lived in Auckland, I'd make this place my local. In lieu of that I should get here more often and if you are reading this I recommend you check it out.

One of my favorite places in Auckland 💯 Close to Mt Smart to grab a couple of beers before the game. Family and dog friendly. The gourmet pizzas are next level. Staff are awesome, friendly and professional ☺️ There's plenty of space indoors and a cool garden bar. And at the end of every month the Epic House Band rocks the place!!! Place is a vibe 😎💯

"Sims Kitchen – Where Nasi Lemak Feels Like a Warm Hug from Home" You know it's legit Malaysian when the sambal makes you sweat and smile. 😅 Located in Onehunga with plenty of free parking (thank you, food gods), Sims Kitchen is a cozy little spot that brings Malaysia to your tastebuds. Most of the seating is indoor, unless you fight for that one lonely outdoor table like it's a Lucky Draw prize. 🎁 Price-wise? A bit on the atas side, but when that nasi lemak hits your soul and the sambal burns through your stress, you won’t regret it. 🔥🍛 The kuew teow goreng is solid, but here’s a pro tip: only ask for “extra spicy” if you’ve made peace with your tongue. 💀🌶️ Portion is decent for one hungry human—not really for sharing unless you’re on a diet or lying to yourself. The uncle and auntie who run the place? Super friendly. The kind of people who make you feel like you're eating at your favourite neighbourhood warung back home. Feels like home away from home. Just with Auckland rent. “Logan was here.. Still wiping sambal tears of joy… and a little sweat!” 😅🔥

Excellent food except I always feel the portion of carbs (rice or noodles) is always smaller compared to some other shops but the taste of the food always makes you keep coming back. Friendly and accommodating staff. A very good place to eat.

A little bit expensive given the location and portion size, but still quite tasty! Unsuspecting exterior, easy to order electronic kiosk, pretty quick service, good variety of house made typical Malaysian drinks too!
Amazing authentic Malaysian food! Highly recommended. Crispy fried chicken is delicious. Shrimp noodle (harmen) was super flavourful.

I love their boneless fried chicken. It’s crispy outside and so juicy inside, although it’s a bit expensive $11 for this size. The prawn noodle soup was so yummy. I like their soup, it’s so rich. My fried kuey teow was a bit overcooked as it became bitter. Next time I will try their laksa noodles.

6 inch was only a 4 inch sandwich.. the staff was putting Avocado on Avocado toastie like a little portion of butter on the bread.. had to ask 2 times to put it at least as per the procedure. Usually visit this branch for subway sandwich as it is near to the workplace l, earlier too had bad some experiences here due to the new staff everytime. But today was like ignored yet told twice.

This place is quiet after 5pm, although on the couple of occasions when I visited there has only been one staff making online orders & youd have to wait for them to finish, perhaps having two staff on, when I ask for more lettuce just seems a task for the staff member, I only have a few other toppings & due to cost well I want to get my moneys worth!

WARNING: DO NOT ORDER FROM THIS STORE. Made an online order for 12.30pm 01/08/24. Called the shop to confirm my order but was told it didn't exist, they advised someone would get back to me. Didn't hear from anyone by 4.30pm at which point the event I ordered the food for had been and gone. Called the store again and was this time told to come and collect my food, despite lunch having been and gone. Still haven't received my food or a refund of $76.20, nor have I heard back from anyone.

The last 2 visits here in the weekend I get told it's closed. First, it's a Sunday, and the sign says they close at 2pm. I get turned away 30 minutes before closing time. Second visit, Saturday I get to the store 2:28pm and again get turned away before closing time which is 4pm... apparently, they close early because it's a long weekend (no sign that says that in front of the store) guess customers like me will have to make the trip out here and find out upon entry. Won't be coming back to this subway since they like to go home early.
The ingredients are not fresh and the service is very fast. I don't see any problems with the store. Whenever I order take-out, it is always fast and accurate!

Great place for a family dinner, especially on Sundays where Kids Eat Free. The Kid's Meal is free with a Full Price Meal. You can watch sports while dining and there is an outdoor playground and trampoline for the kids. Good variety of Meal options from Burgers, Steaks, Pizzas to Salads. Ample Street parking nearby

Came here for my sons 21st. We ordered varied things. Photos for reference.. one thing matters for us, SERVICE and good home had a young lad who suggested one thing that made my dinner 💯.. he suggested with our steak to order the mushroom sauce, we did and we think, THIS SHOULD BE A COMPULSORY MENU ITEM.. well done for a great night of food.

Was an enjoyable experience, nice vibe, staff were nice and attentive! As a fussy eater I was confused at having to take pickles and tomatoes out of the burger as the BBQ one I ordered didn’t say it included them, but then realised it was a different burger😅 one of the staff was awesome in bringing me some bacon to make up for it though! The espresso martini was a little watery but my bf enjoyed his cider and pasta, thanks!

Great food and excellent venue 🙌 However, downside is the customer service. Besides one waiter being the best, the rest were just horrible. Seriously need to establish a front desk to help out with your service - especially for new comers and peak time. As first timers, as soon as we got there, we didn’t have anyone assist or direct us to our reserved table - we had to look for workers to ask. I also called a waiter for some assistance after looking for staff for help, she completely ignored me, so I went to the bar keeper instead for some help. He was no help either. Later on, as we went to pay, we went up to the bartender, and again he was no help - he had decided to serve others who came after us without even serving us first, just because some woman came up to the counter and was making some noise about not being served. It was really unfair and frustrating. Luckily, we’re not Karen’s and we’re patient enough to wait. Needless to say, compared to every restaurant I’ve been to, good home by far has the most terrible customer service. I would only ever go there for their food, and hopefully by then - they’ve levelled up on their people service 🙂

Popped in here for lunch as my sister wanted to try. Greeted + seated right away. Every staff member we engaged was so friendly, super lovely. Go the girls! ✨✨ We were pretty hungry so we got a few things to share; the chicken fettuccine, salmon poke bowl, garlic bread, + the chicken burger. Portions were super generous, appreciated the hot chips were proper pub style chips, + to drink we got a cider each! Can happily say everything was delicious. Would come back here for sure.

Brilliant thai food and exceptional service to go with it. Lovely, lovely staff - willing to recommend their favourites and make sure you have a great dining experience. Pictured here.. We had tom yum fried rice and crispy pork stir fry basil (with extra prawns).... Totally delicious. Very reasonable cost for the quality - thanks team!!
The service was amazing, and the vegetables were fresh. Taste good
Tasty food and friendly staff. Reasonable price as well. Go-to shop if you are in the area and want some Thai food.

A decent spot for Thai food at an affordable price. The flavors are good for a casual meal, though the Pad Thai was a bit too sweet for my taste. Overall, it’s a solid choice for everyday Thai cuisine.
Great food, great people. Very affordable! Definitely underpriced for what you get. Little piece of Thailand in the heart of Onehunga. Love this place!
The subway was tasty and service offered by Hardik was also excellent. He’s very attentive. We will surely visit again.

I know u guys not caring about the reviews but i just want to say the customer service was too rude the guy was too rude. Not even smiling. Worst experience. I think i just wasted money on subway. Very very very bad disappointed experience. Plz don’t go there.
Ordered from Uber eats, worst subway ever. No effort or care when making my sub didn't add half the veges ordered or toast the bread. Chicken was cold, shocking.
Good place to eat your sub during the shopping time. The staff has excellent customer service

Prices have doubled over the last couple of years and the fillings shrunk by at least 33%. The bread itself less dens than before indicating a reduction in overall ingredients. Essentially you are paying 130% more for something that is inferior to what it use to be. These large chain stores have all lost touch with its customers. Support small businesss instead

Came here with my wife for a lunch date with a first table reservation. The Landing is an old school bar with a gaming lounge. The ambience and decor are dated, but a historic experience for visitors to the Onehunga area. Staff are friendly and food was served quite quickly and not at all busy so nice and quiet. The food is average and offerings of surf and turf. We ordered the scallops, garlic bread, prawns, fettuccine carbonara and fish and chips. The scallops were nice but a bit cold and overcooked. The prawns tasty, cooked well in garlic and butter. The fish and chips cooked from frozen and chips under-seasoned and weren’t very crispy. Finally pasta was bland and sauce watery and tasted like it was zapped in the microwave and garlic bread was good. Glad we came as a first table reservation as only paid half price as the food overall was underwhelming so wouldn’t recommend.

Wonderful Mother’s Day Experience We had a fantastic time celebrating Mother’s Day! The staff were warm, attentive, and made us feel truly welcome. Service was smooth and professional from start to finish. The menu is always excellent with no long waits. The food delicious with great portions, and beautifully presented. Highly recommend! A++++

We hired their hall for a function last night. Service was excellent, staff were very helpful. Even when our decorator let us down with the cutlery they jumped in and helped free of charge. The bar attached was useful and we didn’t need to worry about the drinks. Cost of the bar was also very reasonable in fact quite cheap actually. Would definitely recommend them and use them again. They allowed us to do our own catering which was excellent so we were able to cater own crowd. Overall very happy. We accommodated 50 people seated.

I recently visited with my family on MOTHER DAY and we had an absolutely amazing experience. Despite the restaurant being packed, the service was exceptional friendly, fast, and very professional.The food was outstanding and beautifully presented. Every dish we ordered was full of flavor and cooked to perfection. A special mention goes to the SCOTCH it was perfectly done and one of the best I’ve had in a long time OMG THE MUSHROOM SAUCE just yum. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, making it a great spot for a family outing. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for quality food and top-notch service. We’ll definitely be back!

First time there and its a hidden gem! Had a farewell gathering and food was delicious. Reasonable prices so eager to visit again. Funny how you drive past this but never stop in, next time it'll definitely be a stop.
Fresh, flavourful sushi with friendly, welcoming staff!

I always enjoy going here. You won't be disappointed by the food but I think the seating could be better. Not a biggie but with your back to the food it feels kind of weird. But then again the food makes up for it. Well done 👍
Beautiful sushi made fresh throughout the day. Good miso soup and friendly staff
Favourite place to get sushi! The flavour is awesome and the staff here are friendly. The sushi isn’t too expensive and fairly priced. You won’t be disappointed!

Try the spicy chicken don bury 😋 👌 my all time favorite when ever I'm in the hood ordering. Order is always ready when I collect and place order over the phone. Decent portion for the price and I'm always full after it. Just wished they can make it alot more spicier 😂😂
Nice and clean, food was amazing, looks like I'll be visiting more often 👌
LITERALLY THE BEST SUSHI PLACE IN SOUTH AUCKLAND ! So much to choose from , i love everything about this place ! i have been here for about 3 years now , definitely my go to for breakfast/lunch . 😍
Not the best sushi but the people are chur
I like this type of sushi. You can choose different item. It is not sold by a fixed package.

Felt like sushi for lunch and happened to drive past and see the sign so popped in, I had chicken teriyaki summer rolls/prawns/crab sushi and wow this all blew my tastebuds away. Delicious and highly recommended, never had anything like it before. Super friendly staff look forward to coming back again!!

Overall experience 9/10 Food 10/10 Chinese lady behind the counter was grumpy that served me! A smile to the customer goes a long way!! Other than that very clean and a lot of seafood options. Definitely be back in the future!!

I was constantly told to check this place out. Village Fishery did not disappoint! Fish of the day and chips (combo) for $6? Fish well cooked coated with a thin fluffy batter. The Chips were crunchy sprinkled with chicken salt. Affordable for everyone, tasty and located in a spacious place with lots of parking and sitting.

This is my new go to fish and chip shop. Fish of the day and hoki both at $3, an affordable add on to any combo (also reasonably priced). The fish batter was light and fresh, not too oily. The chips were nice and crispy. You can add your choice of salt. The burger was also delicious. I opted for the trevally raw fish and it was 10/10. Tons of parking, and ample space to dine in. Would highly recommend this spot.

Mangere Village Fishery is now my go to spot to get my fish n chip fix 🤤. I saw some people post on tiktok and so I thought why not try it for myself and boy oh boy the people don't lie. The fish is cooked so fresh and steaming hot. I love how the batter is just perfect, not too thick like other fish n chips shops where the batter literally takes over and you only get a little bit of fish lol. The chips are nice and crunchy and you get to choose what salt you want eg chicken salt etc. The combo prices are affordable, not gonna break the bank. Also a Nice spot for a little date to the bridge and have a nice little picnic there while looking at the sea 🌊 😊. Definitely recommend 10/10 can't go anywhere else and friendly staff 😀
It was the first time visit here. Got fresh salmon and octopus sashimi. Very thin cut but $7 each was not bad. Will try other menu next time.

Always love popping in here even if it’s just for pork crackle and some potatoes! Yummy roasts always and their rolls are really good, I noticed they pack it with a lot of meat which is great! Been coming here since I was a kid and always been the same and never changed!

I ❤️ THIS TASTY OLD ROAST SHOP , I WOULD GIVE YOU GUYS 💯 STARS JUST FOR ROAST SPUDS ALONE , THANKS ALSO FOR YOUR FRIENDLY SMILES & SERVICE AND THE OLD EXTRA SPUD , CERTAINLY MEANS A LOT THESE DAYS, BLESS YOU BROTHERS
Portion sizes are poor. Got a pork roll. Minimal meat. Tiny bit of salad. Extremely overrated. Purchased from Brandy's roast Mangere Bridge
Best roasts! Just like grandma used to make with the most delicious gravy Generous portions :)
Yummy, best roast ever

Our new go to since moving into the area, and absolute favourite takeaway by far! Honestly we have it atleast once a week on takeaway night and the quality never disappoints! Have never had a bad meal from here. Have raved on about it to friends and family also. Support local! Thank you for your quality food! ✨
First time coming here and OMG the best fish n chips I’ve ever had 👌 the fish was crispy 🫰🏾 and chicken nibbles OMG the best 🤤 this is now my fav place to go too 🥳
Mine and hub’s favourite local spot for fish and chips and especially chicken nibbles. The chicken nibbles have a tasty marinade in a crunchy batter. They’re so juicy and just friggin delish!
Couldn’t help myself, FINALLY Found the Perfect Fish NChips yummmyy , check them out 💯❤️

This place is the way fish'n'chips used to be when I was growing up! Great value and in house batter! Check out the photo, it is an $8.80 special; 2 fish, 2 hotdogs, 2 potato scallops and chips. Feeds 2 of us! (Please don't take this off the menu 😂) We also had their Singapore noodles and it was great too, it was 4 good sized servings. But there is one negative thing, having them only 700m away means my waist line is growing! 😂😂

Terrible. Just Terrible.... $10 for a lava cake the size of a mini cup cake. When I received the food the icecream had melted and tipped in the box. This has to be the worst I've experienced using uber eats the cake tasted literally like cocoa butter flour and sugar. Wouldn't recommend to anyone
The two times I've ordered from this place through ubereats, the desserts were stale and the milkshakes just off the mark. Learnt my lesson, won't be ordering from here again. Do better.
Cheap slices from supermarket with a big mark up on it lol
Cupcakes were tasty but a little stale
Excellent .. Certainly would have it again

I have tried several pastas on the menu and they are all incredible! You can taste the high quality ingredients and is so rich in flavour. The portion sizes are well worth the price and quality of food is amazing! I have had a lot of pastas in Auckland but this place far exceeds my expectations! You won’t regret trying the food here. The customer service is exceptional and they really take special care with each order. I have ordered online as well and the food is always delivered hot, I am never disappointed. Make sure to try the desserts too they are amazing. The banoffee pie and New York cheesecake are delicious. I highly recommend this place!
Wow, just wow! Placed an order with them on uber eats and man! Best pasta I’ve had in a while, it was creamy, a generous serving and wasn’t skimpy on the meat! It’s an easy 5 stars from me!
Delicious! One meal is enough for 2 people. Massive portions. Comes with garlic bread too. Never disappoints

Food is absolutely delicious but the BIGGEST DOWN FALL IS THAT YOUR COOK(S) CANT READ OR BOTHER IN FOLLOWING INSTRUCTIONS!! Plus What your advertising for all your deserts it says "Served with fresh cream" You ALWAYS leave out the "FRESH CREAM" I expect that when I order n never got it NOT ONCE 3rd time to many is not on!! I had to ring in about my pass order's getting chili flakes when I instructed in their notes: Please NO CHILLI FLAKES Ty!! But I got them twice in each order!! I spent $80 to over $200 I expect my cooking instructions to be met n what you advertise is true not false!! PLEASE YOU NEED TO DO BETTER READING SIMPLE ENGLISH INSTRUCTIONS IS CRITICAL TO YOUR BUSINESS... Or else Auckland Council and Consumers.

Ordered on uber eats. Thought I was getting Italian food. Woodfire pizza? Was not what I received the dough was RAW had not been in a woodfire oven. Order butter cream pollo pasta. What you get is butter chicken pasta. Pollo is Italian, very misleading.
Order chilli chicken pizza but got pizza with buffalo sauce. you guys for real ? Change the name and don’t fool people. That is not chilli chicken pizza.
First time trying. Had a pasta dish with meat balls and pepperoni Pizza, was sooooo good! Really underestimated this place. Will be back again with the kids!

I've never done a review before but honestly I had too!. The two males that work there consistently make/cook the best pizzas I have ever tasted by quite a lot. Both very nice guys and the shop looks very clean. I watch them make my pizza and it comes out looking amazing ever single time, 8 minutes too 😮 10/10 boys. Regards Perry

I wasn't sure if I should try this place due to some low scores but ordered 3 pizza and I'm impressed. 1. $36 for three pizza is great value. 2. The large pizza is a decent size. 3. Cooked well and generous toppings. The bad review comparing to Domino's must have been employees because I think Black Box deserves 5 stars.

Been here for years. The owner is super awesome and is very friendly. I looked afger them while on the job at night. And they looked after me. I appreciated everything they did for me. Thank you again! Even when I'm not working. I will be bacl if I am in the area!
Love the food there and the one curry combo is absolutely amazing will be back again very soon. Would recommend
Best butter chicken and garlic naan combo

Authentic Chinese cuisine and kiwi favourites. The happy chicken is nice addition. Chef specials are outstanding, with chilli chicken, and won ton soup a favourite. The chicken and corn soup, egg goo young and sweet and sour dishes are also good. Generally less than 15 minutes from order.
Yay I just love the snacks they sell here, today I got a kiwi milkshake. Remember them, so hard to find now , see pic
Childhood favourite. Really generous portion sizes. Probably the best fried fish in Auckland, always a family go-to.

Fish and chips arrived soggy and drenched in oil. The combination chow mein was unpalatable with dry meat and prawns, paired with a bland bitter sauce reminiscent of burnt charcoal. While the chicken nibbles were passable, they were too salty. Overall the dining experience was a disappointing disaster.

Ordered and paid full price for Snapper with chips but I was given a wrong fish. It stinks. Called to inform the proprietor but she started to argue and didn't accept their fault. Untrustworthy place to buy especially fish and chips. Sorry for this but had to add to review. Hope they'll be honest about their product in future.

Overall, my experience at this 4-star burger spot was good, though there were a few things that could have been better. The positives definitely stood out—the buns were soft and fresh, the lettuce was crisp, and the burgers were clearly handmade, which gave them a nice, hearty feel. The service was friendly, which made the experience pleasant, but sitting outside did have its drawbacks. You have to contend with bird poop if you sit on the patio, as birds fly in and sometimes land on your table, which was a bit off-putting. In terms of flavor, the burgers themselves were tasty, though I felt they could have used a little more seasoning to really stand out. Also, the veggies were stacked high, almost as if to make the burger look bigger, but it didn’t add much to the overall taste or texture. While I wasn’t blown away, it was a solid meal, and I think with a bit of tweaking, it could be a standout spot. The friendly service and fresh ingredients are worth mentioning, and it's still a nice place to grab a burger if you’re in the area.

Food for 2- Double cheese burger, Double Mushroom Melt burger, fries & loaded fries, water, apple & feijoa smoothie 👌 I was not meant to be there because I’m meant to be on a diet and we planned to eat something else elsewhere but we stopped and it was so good. Too good actually. Swapped fizz for that smoothie 👍 choice. I’ve missed coming here. Always yummy food, always full from a combo, good place n good people ✅
Brilliant juicy burger & friendly service! Sat outside on this lovely day. Keto adaptation of my burger was offered, easy!

Best burger joint in Māngere hands down. Deliciously cooked, fresh every time. Quick service, friendly customer service each time. Greeted before you enter the door - the owner doesn’t forget your face either. Have been coming here since 2020 and I’ll keep coming.
I love the food and the staff are very friendly I can't wait to try other items on your menu. Would recommend to try the double mushroom burger 10 out of 10 would recommend

5/5 chill, clean, relaxed service, they were quick to serve and give what we needed. Could see them observing. My daughter dropped tomato sauce on the table they were quick to help. Great food, service. Clean 5/5 I'm a sucka for hygiene. 2nd time I've eaten here with people. Will be back.

Hello, I hope this message finds you well. I wanted to share some feedback regarding my recent visit to Lucky Cafe Mangere Bridge for morning tea. I ordered the creamy chicken pie, but unfortunately, it was quite disappointing. The chicken had an unpleasant texture, and the pie itself was very dry, which contradicted the "creamy" description on the display. I brought this to the attention of a staff member, showing them the dry pie, but they simply looked at it and walked off without addressing my concerns. I even went back to the counter to reiterate that the pie was not nice, but received the same response. This lack of engagement and resolution was quite disheartening, especially as I had hoped to enjoy a pleasant morning tea with a blind and deaf person. I wanted to bring this to your attention in the hope that you can take steps to improve the quality of your food and customer service. Thank you for taking the time to read my feedback.

This was a perfect stop after our early Auckland arrival! We ate incredible omelets, french toast, the Lucky Delight, and a hot chicken pot pie! The doors were open to the outdoors- and they were just setting up for the day. They were the perfect place to help out a local business, eat well, and relax with hot tea, coffee and incredible breakfast! Everyone should give them a try!

Big portions and value for money is good 👍 Had a lunch here with work mates, ambience outside was cool though there pigeons coming for some food to eat kinda puts me off. Delicious 🤤 food and they do accept pre order hence that has saves us so much time to travel to and from work place which is Papatoetoe, highly recommended and will surely come back 👍

If you're keen for a hearty no frills, big breakfast, perhaps straight out of your sleep in or Saturday footy, then look no further if you're around māngere bridge. Well priced and classic taste to expect. Nothing fancy, just a good meal that'll satisfy the hunger without being a stomach filler. Everything we had was tasty! Chips were seasoned well and the kids smashed these. Steak was cooked great but you gotta have it for the mushroom sauce (a bit steep but hey the steak was cheap enough). Feijoa smoothie was on point! Busy when we got there but got good seating inside for our family. Will come back here again as wait times were also good.
Heard about this place alot so I went and visited. Generous portion, and quick meal preparation by the chef and switched on staffs. Enjoyed.
First timer and this place will be our go to for a yummy and affordable meal 🥰☺️ Will definitely come back for the lamp black pepper sauce 😁

MANUREWA STORE: We had dinner at the new store on the corner of browns road and Russell road today. Beautiful food, service and atmosphere, the staff were friendly and welcoming, the portions were extremely filling, definitely recommend to all 💯💯 thank you 🙏 we will see you again 🙂

I love this place, been coming here a long time with my family since I was in intermediate, now I’m full time working and I love coming here after work or on a nice evening with my partner every now and then! Love the workers, very honest and the food is sooooooo goooooooooooooooooodddd like really, just look at it man!!! 😍🤤🥰 quick and efficient too especially for how packed they can be ! 10000000/10000000
Always busy with a huge menu covering authentic Cambodia/Thia cuisine, breakfast staples, and western favourites. Friendly staff and good range of drinks and dessert slices 🥳

The Mangere Bridge Takeaways is honestly the best. Their Loaded Fries and Potatoes especially. I come here multiples times a week. Their staff are always so lovely and also provide the best service. Come down and show them some love!

Support your local! Me and my partner love coming here, seeing friendly faces, ex and current student from local schools. The food is the best and a great value for money. Highly recommend, (staff always chuck an extra potato or two) 😊

Came here for lunch. The lady owner was very friendly, saw a hard working family. The past owner may have gone so the old comments may not applicable. The chicken was very nice and fresh. So did the fries. You had to buy for the sauces just be aware. Overall it’s not bad and I’ll be back for more!

Just had the best fried chicken in the area 💯 As soon as I wiped my oily hands I just wanted to jump on to say a huge thank you for feeding our whanau tonight with the extra chicken and potatoes. We absolutely love this place and they never disappoint!. Caring and welcoming staff even though the day was done. Best spot in town ❤️🥰

I recently tried Mangere Bridge Takeaways, and I have to say, it did not disappoint! The fried chicken was crispy, juicy, and packed with flavor—easily some of the best I’ve had. The fish burger was also hands down the best I've had, with fresh ingredients and flavour. Fries - top notch! Service was quick and very friendly, and the food was hot and fresh. The portions were generous, and the prices were reasonable for the quality. If you’re craving delicious food, this is definitely the place to go. I’ll be back for sure! Oh and the ice cream and milkshake to top it off was definitely a great finisher! Kids loved it! Highly recommend! 🍗🍔🔥

We celebrated a Family Birthday dinner here. They kindly swapped us to the window seat. Table staff were lovely and food was served in good time. Extra chocolate for the birthday boy! A small drinks menu but the wine is good quality. Generous portions at reasonable prices. Will return.

Local neighbourhood cafe that is a old house remodelled. Interior is nice with outdoor seating. Coffee was not very good. We ordered a Mocha with less chocolate (Bowl size) and the result was a milk drink with little coffee taste (and no chocolate taste). Told the staff about it and they brought it back and then returned it. It was the same cup with coffee added to it... The coffee is already like warm by the time. 3rd time lucky we ask for it to be replaced with flat white and unfortunately it wasn't good as well. Food - we ordered the Fried Chicken burger and the chicken was nice but the rest was the burger was average. There was coleslaw and a slice of pickle. We also had the egg benedict with fried chicken which has hash brown at the bottom and this was nice.

Amazing foods and great coffees, plenty of selections from the cabinet. Staffs are super friendly. Outside area is pretty nice with bean bags and small kid playground, nicely shade. We had a really great experience here. Highly recommended.

To be honest, the food we ordered were really good. Enjoyed very much. But, coffee was.. well, a bit below average… for me. Since I’ve been looking for really good flat white in Auckland and tried so many of them.. uhhmmm… They could probably have done better with milk. Should have mix a little touch of cream in as well. It’d make a total different coffee experience.😆 I guess the staff were a bit short handed. There were way too many customers than what two or three servers could handle. But, nothing really bothered me. Easy for me just to go to counter and order myself.(just used to do that. And faster than just waiting for a server to take my order!!!) Well, I am definitely going back for more food though!! Waffle was great. But, a bit cold when I got it. And Butter milk chicken in it, wow! So good! It was pretty easy chilled Sunday morning breakfast. Chilling out and enjoying the Sun. And seeing all those dogs and families enjoying their time as well. Just pretty cool!

Unplanned visit to The Gaff Cafe & Eatery turns into our new favourite breakfast eatery 😍 Excellent service from staff upon arrival and throughout our visit. We ordered -The Big Gaff , Chilli Scramble , Strawberry Shake and a Taro latte ..All of it was Absolutely delicious!! 3 days later and my husband is still going on about the Strawberry milkshake lol

If you’re looking for a delicious kebab, excellent baklava, flat breads, and an amazing selection of bulk Middle Eastern food, this is your place. If you’re going to Mount Smart stadium or on the way to or from the airport, stop off here to get yourself lunch, snacks or specialty items for your pantry. The staff are warm and welcoming, and they make a great coffee!

The food is good especially the quantities of serving but the lady needs to learn how to listen to customers. She doesn't listen to a complete sentence and acts before anything is asked. A simple order becomes a big issue with her. Happened with me several times. She is rude and inhospitable.

I have been there a few times, every time the unwelcoming and frustrated staff and their tired and sad faces makes me very uncomfortable. I was once given the fries of another customer, they fried it again and gave it to me. Absolute horrendous thing to do. Can't trust their hygiene and food quality. A lot of food is kept uncovered and open on the payment counter. People coughing and sneezing on that food. Really disgusting. The 'No F's given' attitude make me wonder that this business is just a side hustle for money laundering. To the owners - Please uplift your attitude and hygiene. And you have a great business to run.

Pita House is the OG Kebab joint nestled amongst Onehunga's commercial district. The family owned and operated business is authentic to the word, not only will they serve you the best kebab you've ever eaten, you can also stock up on all you middle eastern groceries and their inhouse Pita breads which are often still warm in the bag from coming off the conveyor belt. I Love this place, love the people & will always travel near or far if the temples screaming for a delicious meal.

🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 Best Lebanese store in Auckland. Finest Middle East ingredients. Selection is superb. Staff are wonderful and welcoming. You'll find Syrian Olive oil soap here with organic Bay oil. This is Auckland's best source for pure organically made soap. Pure A grade quality Pakistani oils of almond, clove and nigella seeds. The Sri Lankan bulk black tea is first grade pickings. This is a seriously impressive emporium. Best kebabs in all of Auckland made by a cook with major skills. You get the REAL and GENUINE kebab here.
Burgers and sammies are awesome, taste great and are jam packed. My go to spot in Penrose.
Absolutely the best trading lunch bar in Aucks,!! By Far

This is hands down the best lunch bar in Auckland!! I make a point to go there every time I head that way (which I wish was more often) and I've never been disappointed! Amazing service every time, and the food is to die for! Highly recommend

what can i say really good food well worth it yummy rolls and sammys too you get your moneys worth i definitely recommend coming here if you are ever out these ways the people that own the place are lovely ive been coming here for years now ever since ive been working in this area thanks jimmy youre awesome mate iykyk
The butter chicken just melts in your mouth and it tastes sooo good

the sushi looks and tastes foul it’s not fresh I ate one piece and won’t be back here. It’s a shame because St Pierre’s at other locations are really good however these guys just give you yesterday’s sushi through the window in a bag where as at other locations they only present fresh sushi and you select the one you want.

This is our go to spot everyday for lunch with my coworkers, never disappoint on every visit. Everything always tastes so fresh & yummy. It’s always a 5 star for every visit. Workers probably sick of seeing our big back faces everyday at the drive through haha 😜

Went in as always, great customer services. Never disappointed when receiving my made order. The young lady who always makes my rice balls, thank you so much. You are always really welcoming and make the best rice balls ever 🤤

Great location and they do drive through. Staff is fast at making sushi on request. Bento choices are nice. Fried spicy chicken was a a bit dry. Busy during lunch time. Toilet is clean, well maintained.

Breakfast/Brunch on the go! After church dropped at this place for hot ramen due to cold weather, never failed us. Value for money is their best offer. Fast service and welcoming staff. Health and safety instructions are visibly installed. Tidy staff with apron and hair net/cap on. Keep it up guys. See you around 👍
Best bakery ive been to in a longtime potato top pie curry roll and most food here is priced good and taste wow workers are very friendly peacefull place and good parking highly recommend

Highly recommend the Biscoff cheesecake that they make! Affordable and delicious. Also, am not sure if it is a permanent menu item so defo go there as soon as you can to try it. (p.s; it was waay better than any of the Auckland Night Market ones!) ;-) :-P
BEST COFFEE IN ONEHUNGA AND EXCELLENT CUSTOMER SERVICE :)
Amazing customer service 👏 Amazing people Nice food and the coffee ☕️ is Next leave 110% Love ❤️ This Place Achu
Good prices and service Above average food Thanks team
Had a really well priced Sunday special boil up that was cooked and flavoured perfectly and served with freshly made fry bread to top it off!

Quiet, warm environment. Thai beef salad was delicious, fresh and plenty for one person. Could share with another but you won't want to. Thank you Jason and Tukemata family for a lovely dining experience. We'll be back

Just had an amazing meal at the onehunga club. Really impressed!! We got the $20 wings and were SHOCKED by the quantity and flavour! Best wings around. I got the spaghetti Bolognese which was really high quality, much better than you'd expect from a small club kitchen.
The food is delicious with a nice loving scent. But it is not only loved by its taste and scent - the service is also really quick. Everything is very welcoming and there are lots of nice people.
Best Steak in entire area!!! Homemade bread is exceptional. Jason the owner trained chef and hands down it shows.. A must try..we will be back real soon!!

Fast service, good quality food, decent portion size, extensive menu and reasonable prices. It is cafe decor rather than restaurant but is always clean and tidy. It's only 30 minute parking on the mall but plenty of free parking on the side streets.

Not the most fancy place, but the service was friendly and the food is your typical cheap and easy tasty asian! Careful though, they use real chili in the salt and pepper squid! Standard tasty lemon chicken! Pretty decent $2/pp charge for tea, sweet corn soup, AND rice! (Calculated on the excess charges above the dish price)

NEGATIVES: I rarely give bad reviews, but unfortunately I had to post this, in hope that someone else doesnt go through similar experience. Paid $18 for 3 bbq meats and rice (which is standard imo). Portion size is 👌. My disappointment, is the food. It was taken off the display hook (which was cold at the time) and cut up, then put into the microwave🤦🏾‍♂️. The place wasn't busy for a Friday night, so I shouldve seen that as a red flag. As expected the food was dry, cold in some areas and didnt make me want to finish it 😔. Maybe this is a better place for lunch, but my experience for food here, was negative. POSTIVES: Reasonably priced. Lovely family atmosphere and service. Just disappointed tonight, didnt do justice. Photos: 1) what was served 2l what I left remaining😔
Was very yummy we have just moved into onehunga Also they gave us free corn and chicken soup, will definitely be coming back
Great little food bar takeaway on the South very end of Onehunga main Street. Love the way they give complimentary chicken corn soup.

Very good value Chinese food. I go here at least once a week at lunchtime. Always ordered BBQ pork and roast pork on rice ($16 at the time of writing) - never disappoints. Picture has my hand in it for reference on their portion size. I feel that the portion has shrunk a bit since I first went here but it's still good value.

Very fast, maybe cause we went in during public holiday. Friendly owners. You get served tea and corn soup for free. And refill for tea. Which is really nice service. We ordered salt and pepper squid, fried green beans, and wok fried veges… and pork on rice. Yes all very good flavor :)

First time trying Kongs Kitchen! We ordered a wonton noodle soup and duck on rice. Wow. Everything was beautiful! So affordable and delicious! Wonton noodle soup: the best in Onehunga. Period. Broth is clear as it should be and tastes like something that will heal your soul. Slightly peppery and full of depth. The wontons were delicious! Very fresh porky flavour and the noodles were super bouncy and chewy, not soggy at all!!! Duck on rice: absolutely delicious. Duck was served with white rice, cabbage and drizzled over with a beautiful sauce. I wish I had taken a photo before I ate but i literally inhaled the food as soon as it arrived My new fave spot! I wish I knew about this spot earlier!!

Used to be Kong’s. Now it’s called Happy BBQ kitchen and all the prices went up a little. Tried Combination fried rice, black bean sauce beef rice noodles and sweet and sour pork. I give 9 out of 10 for fried rice and sweet and sour pork. But, maybe, 3 or 4 for black bean beef.. doesn’t really have the strong black bean sauce flavours.. it’s just too plain. Maybe try next time something else. Really want to try lemon chicken and kung po chicken. :) Pretty good portions too!!! I will definitely come back again!!!! Yay!!!

I think it’s called Happy BBQ Kitchen now, but literally the best salt and pepper tofu I’ve ever had. The seasoning and the batter is so good and such a big portion! If you’re a vegetarian seriously come here and get the salt and pepper tofu, I’ve eaten a lot of this in my time but this place has the best I’ve ever had

We visited Rusty Morris in Onehunga and tried the $100 Rusty Platter. While the serving size was generous, the food itself didn’t hit the mark. The pork belly was overloaded with hoisin sauce and dried shallots, making it far too salty the balance just wasn’t right.The mac and cheese had zero flavour, like it was just there to fill space on the plate. The coleslaw was just average nothing fresh or zesty about it, just… there. For a platter at that price, you expect a bit more thought in the sides too. The garden bar setting was really nice to start with pretty and relaxed but as more people came through, it got claustrophobic quickly. Service was meh. Not rude, but not welcoming either. A simple smile would’ve gone a long way staff looked absolutely miserable. It doesn’t cost a thing to smile and it really shapes the experience.We were watching the game out there, but the music kept cutting in and out, which just made it awkward. It honestly felt like whoever was assigned to the garden bar wasn’t paying attention we had to ask multiple times for dirty plates to be cleared. Final verdict Pretty place, mid food, forgettable service. Rusty Morris has potential, but right now it’s giving “style over substance.” They could easily improve by: • Smiling (seriously, just smile) • Playing music consistently • Checking in on outdoor guests • Improving the seasoning and balance of their food Until then, it’s a 2-star experience nice to look at, but not worth rushing back for.

Went for the first with my partner for dinner (02/08/25) to celebrate my birthday & let me tell you everything was top tier🤌🏻 from the food to the service😍 the girl who served us treated like royalty from when we walked in to when we walked out, she constantly checked in on us to make sure everything was fine even though she was busy - she even catered to our every need with a smile🥰 loved the food but especially their dessert😍 this place is definitely a must try! Cause no doubt we will be going back for sure!

Family lunch after mini golf here was an absolutely wonderful experience! The staff were friendly, the ambiance and cleanliness was just perfect! Menus were clear and easily read as was drinks list. The friendly waitress took our drink orders, that came out promptly! Our food order was taken and it was delivered to table in a reasonable time frame. It was nicely presented, nice and hot and absolutely delicious, we actually ordered more as a couple more friends arrived, no problem what so ever. We explored the outside area, saw the actual “RUSTY MORRIS MINOR” And facilities! Excellent!! I would recommend to all my discerning dining friends to take a drive to Onehunga, and a visit to this establishment, and to sample the wonderful delicious food and super service! Arthur C. Charlton West Auckland

Lovely spot in Onehunga which us locals were glad to finally try. The drinks were nice and refreshing, the morris minor platter we had was just right for 2 adults and 2 kids. Pricing is reasonable and has a nice covered back yard area to enjoy drinks and food. Service was nice and fast. Pop in here when you’re in the area.

I had my 40th at The Rusty Morris and it was the best venue for it. The food was so delicious, the bar staff were so helpful and polite. The garden bar was so open and bubbly. It was so easy to organise everything when I booked via online booking and communication with all the details was awesome. I have another 2 special birthdays coming up this year that we are hoping to have here as well. Everyone was talking about how much of a cool vibe it’s was at The Rusty Morris and they definitely plan on returning for lunches and dinners with more people. Can’t wait to go back!

We are in the middle of shifting houses, so cooking is not easy. We decided to get takeaway from somewhere close to the house since it was rush hour (5pm). The closest takeaway shop was this, and we decided to get fried rice. The lady at the counter said rice would take time to get ready and suggested to order chow mein. We got chicken chow mein and steak and veg. As you can see in the picture, they stuffed it with cauliflower in both dishes, and there were only 2 pieces of steak in steak and veg. Basically, we paid close to $40 for cooked cauliflower. I do not recommend trying this place.
Family always coming here, very nice food and very lovely staff too. They’re always very welcoming. Looove their fried rice and chicken nibbles too, they also have such great wontons!

This is two scoops of chips and one fish. The fish was very greasy, I unfortunately wouldn’t recommend. The chips weren’t the best and the portion was very small. This meal pictured cost $10. I was also charged an extra 47c just for using my eftpos card.

Good people but batter is often undercooked, chips are 'meh', and in general its the most expensive in the area. It's our local and it's still the last resort, sorry. But at least it's always empty, so there's no long lines. 🙁
Disappointed with the fish and mussels , it was like eating more batter then the fish or mussels 🤣 other than that , great chips and burger
Excellent food, best Mossaman curry takeaway I've had in ages.
The best prawn and coriander dumplings I have ever eaten.
Undercooked food can poison you

Food here is what you crave for when thinking about Chinese takeaway. 👍 I ordered classic combination fried rice, everyone’s Sweet and sour pork and my favourite pock chop with spiced salt. They were yummy enough to satisfy your craving and even bring back nostalgic memories.😄 Happy that I live nearby this restaurant. Food’s good, lady at desk is kind and friendly! And funny enough, every time you put an order, you’d get an answer “10 mins”. 🤣🤣 No matter how much your orders are, it’d only take 10 mins. I just love it. ❤️ Go and grab some nice classic takeaways when you taste bud is sick and tired of having burgers and pizzas. You Will Never Regret👍👍 Note: when having pork chop with spiced salt, have it at restaurant. You wouldn’t get the nice crispy pork chop by the time you get home.
The food was delicious, prepared fast , reasonable pricing and staff are very friendly. The bathroom is quite dirty though so that put me off a bit. Otherwise, very happy with everything else :)

This restaurant takeaways has a simple kitchen style dining area with absolutely amazing food!! Lovely helpful and friendly service. We had the most delicious plate of salted prawns and a plate of green beans with minced chicken. Great choices. We can't wait to go back and take friends.

We ended at the restuarant by mistake. So glad we did the girl who served us lovely and friendly. Nothing was too much trouble. When you look at the outside you would never expect the food to be like it was. We had the prawns with salt plenty of prawns so yummy also the green beans with minced chicken so yummy too the food was very reasonably priced and good value. We will be going back in the near future. You can never tell a book by it's cover
Great store. Very friendly staff. Excellent range of items on the menu. Dining in can be done if you don't mind a casual dining experience
Lamb of god and the doctors order was 💯 GOOD!!! Would definitely come back!!! You should add milk shake to your menu!

Some of the best burgers I have ever had. The quality ingredients paired with the way they cook the beef lead to a very delicious meal. Their loaded fries are also delicious and not overpriced, like in many other places Finally the prices are excellent as well.

Without a doubt, it was the most exceptional burger I have ever had in Auckland. We opted for the GO NUTS burger and loaded fries. The burger had an incredibly delicious smoky flavor and the buns were something truly special. As for the fries, they were absolutely delightful. I owe a huge thanks to my friend for recommending this place!

Awesome burgers! Good quality good value. Great selection, everything looked so good it was hard to make a decision! I like the garden area out back and the blankets are a nice touch. There were no spring onions on the loaded fries, but otherwise good. Will be back soon to try a different burger!
Awesome little burger joint right off the street. Decent portion for price. In general, all awesome burgers all around. Definitely recommended. 🌟⭐🌟⭐🌟

The crispy out layer does not feel oily and the meat texture inside still soft and juicy. That is outstanding from usually seen Deep Fried chicken. A variety of sauce to choose to suits your choice. I love garlic taste. Last time visit , I was lucky to try the Curry chicken nibble . The lady boss told me new product.
The Korean chicken was very yummy. The lady was very nice. Awsome service.
Clean& fresh, so tastey. Flamen spicey!
Delicious chicken and excellent service
Such a amazing experience i had They make sushi whatever i want in the menu Owner is so kind lovely smile :)

I loveeee Sushi , absolutely love. However this place takes yummy to a whole new level, generous portion size for price. Delicious and fresh, large size pieces. Most of all amazing owners. I love these guys! 11/10. This place makes St Pierre’s look amateur. Please come and support this local business. They deserve everything. Polite, friendly and kind owners that make tasty sushi, what more could you ask for.
Superbly well priced fresh sushi. Especially like the 50% off deals you can get 30 minutes prior to closing :)

Love this place so much that I’m actually reluctant to share this gem! BEST Sushi bar I have ever been to in nz so far I can HIGHLY recommend spicy pork don and beef. The new owners' service is good as well.
Used to be mu favourite place but price went up and I can count the meats in lol (taste still yum thou - just need to order 2 bowls for me now)

Visited here for the first time with my sister for lunch and it was so good, we had the BLAT with fries it was so delicious! and the sauce with the fries 👌 yum. And the chocolate brownie, dangerous 🤤 10/10. The staff are so kind, calm and friendly. Our meals came fast too, food was fresh. My sister and I are so very glad we came here! Thank you for the amazing customer service. To the staff here, you're doing a great job! Highly recommend and we will be back! 😃

Very family oriented. Always our favorite cafe in onehunga. Our kids love the fruit bowl, pancakes, milkshakes & kids meals that have hot chippies in them. My husband and I love the chicken livers, pumpkin soup, smoothies and so much more that we always come back. Friendliest staff, very accommodating & would highly recommend this be your next cafe to visit. Bless 🙏🏻

Cafe Tran has a good selection of dishes on offer and at very reasonable prices. Ordered a Steak Burger and Chips ($21.90), which was prepared to perfection. Nothing was oily or overpowering, but just right flavours to compliment the dish. My better half ordered an Eggs Benedict ($19.90) which had very nice flavour and not too small in size.

Kind atmosphere when you walk in, six staff members when I counted. Paid $45.00 for blueberry pancakes and creamy mushrooms on toast. Mushroom: a bowl of watery 'cream' a few mushrooms, SLITHERS of bread around the top, so thing you couldn't put anything on top, worse when I got into the dish was the slimey soggy bread in the bowl (see photo) Pancakes: I asked from the get go if they were made fresh, the teller assured me yes they are, we premix the flour but the cakes are made fresh to order! LIES the pancakes were yellow, had one blueberry in each and were as stiff as cardboard, honestly were inedible even soaked in syrup and cream, even the bacon seems microwaved (see photo) I went up to the till to give the teller feedback, he looked at me "oh" and with a nonchalant tone said "I'll let the chef know" to think I spent nearly $50 in today's economy to eat something so drastically under pah in general let alone a cafe in middle Onehunga. Do not give business to this place and kid yourself you had a good experience to justify wasting your money. Southmall Manurewa better quality at the classic cafe.
Great range of food to choose from, mince on toast was delicious the poached eggs cooked perfectly. Lovely service

Bakehaven Café – A Local Favourite That’s Hard to Pass Up! 🍝🍳🥤 Bakehaven Café in Onehunga has always been one of our go-to spots—it’s a solid, fast, and local place where you can grab a quick bite and satisfy those cravings. I always order the Chicken Pasta, which used to be so good—creamy, rich, and perfectly cooked. Lately though, I’ve noticed the pasta hasn’t been cooked quite the same. Still tasty, but not as spot-on as it used to be. Hoping it gets back to that original goodness! My family ordered a bit of everything: the Old Style Mixed Grill (a classic!), another Chicken Pasta, a side of chips and wedges with sour cream, and we finished it all off with three cans of Rockstar Tropical Punch to wash everything down. 🔥 It’s a place that’s quick, convenient, and familiar—definitely one of those local stops that’s hard to drive past. Just hoping they bring that pasta magic back!

I wanted to share my experience with you. The staff was really friendly and provided great service. I tried their mixed grill, chicken melt, and a smoked fish pie. The old mixed grill was perfect for a quick breakfast on the go, and the chicken melt was good, but I wish there was more chicken in it. Overall, it was a pleasant experience.
Nice little cafe. A fluffy for my two year old granddaughter, she loves it! Plenty to choose from their food cabinet!
Food wasn't great at all... coffees seem to be the popular thing but yeah. The pic says it all
Got a steak and cheese pie from this place and it was delicious, I would visit again. Pricing is reasonable and there is a lot of options.
Litter in front.Clean up.

Good Dog Bad Dog – Flavour Heaven in Every Bite 🌭🧀🧅 Dined in and were greeted by the loveliest staff – super welcoming and made the whole experience even better. And now… let’s talk about the food 😮‍💨🔥 We went all in and ordered: • Mac and Cheese Dog x2 (yes, it was THAT good we had to double it) • Prawn Hoagie – fresh, juicy, packed with flavour • Corn Dog on the side – golden, crunchy perfection • Creamy Mac and Cheese (cheese pull was elite) • Crispy Onion Rings – crunchy on the outside, soft and sweet on the inside Everything was a textural dream — crunchy, cheesy, juicy, soft, and so full of flavour.
