Every bite had us doing the happy food dance. 🕺 Highly recommend if you’re after comfort food with serious flavour. We’ll be back for round two… or three. 😋

The name of the place could sound a little ominous, as if the food is potentially good or bad, but so far I haven't been disappointed. I have visited this place once before, and been to another branch, and it's always pretty good. Messy, but good. Previously I have gone for the hot dogs, but this time tried a hoagie -namely the fried chicken. It was a big sloppy mess and I loved it. I chose the combo, and appreciated the larger drink as the chicken had a nice, spicy kick.

The food was mediocre. Ordered the classic hot dog and fries. Could have easily bought better elsewhere. The customer service was good, but I got some cold chips in with the fresh ones. It tasted like a hot dog, but a standard sausage sizzle would have beaten that easy. I would have tried something else but thought to start off simple - first impressions. Anyway, all-around good effort, but they need to work on that one. This review is for Onehunga.

My favourite is their fried chicken sweet saucy nuggies (sweet & spicy)or Og, Philly steak and cheeseburger (yumm 😋). The staff is friendly and professional, always serve with smile. The fried chicken quantity is good, though thier sandwiches/hoagies taste good but size feels a bit less though fillings are good. I have been going this place quite often as the staff is friendly and food tastes great 😋👌.

25 update* the fries were crunchy & well seasoned, found the single beef bulgogi hoagie not as good this time around, but maybe last time it was the double ..? So would need to go back for that one. The Mac & cheese quesadilla was quite good w/ the slice of bacon in it Had to try, had the chopped cheese which was a bit like a big Mac and whopper in 1 and the dirty dog- a hit with the tangy sauerkraut and spicy sauce, both gud in different ways !

SLABS Pizza – Onehunga 🔥🍕 Last-minute feed turned into a flavour-packed win! We were in Onehunga and decided to finally try the famous square pizza from SLABS — and wow, it did not disappoint. We went for the Chorizo Combo with a side of fries and dipping sauce. My sister and her friend grabbed the Angry Hawaiian and Meatball – all came hot, cheesy, and loaded with flavour. The bread? Soft, bouncy, and just the right chew – holds the toppings perfectly without getting soggy. The meat was juicy and seasoned right, every bite was a yes. We all had different sodas to wash it down, and honestly, it hit the spot. Definitely more than just a snack – it turned into a solid dinner. SLABS, you’ve got some new fans. 👏🔥

🔥 Slabs Pizza - Onehunga 🔥 Just had the thickest, freshest pizza straight out the oven at Slabs Pizza and I’m still thinking about it! The toppings were on point packed with flavour, not stingy, and somehow got the seal of approval from my super picky 10-year-old (he gave it a solid 10/10 which never happens). We dined in, and I have to say, the vibe was unexpectedly dope. The owner was really lovely and welcoming — you can feel that family vibe in the space, with his kids’ drawings on the wall and framed family photo (loved that personal touch). And the music?! As a hip hop head, I didn’t expect to be biting into cheesy, loaded goodness with Redman Tonight’s da Night bumping in the background. Like… pizza, fries, and great hiphop Say less! Great portion sizes, super fresh ingredients, cool energy we’ll 100% be back. If you’re in Onehunga and want pizza that hits different, check out Slabs. No regrets!

Exceptional service by the owner. We are locals but had not tried this pizza joint and we have been missing out! Delicious fries and Italian sausage pizza with a nice soft thick base that is very addictive. You will definitely be hooked to go back! Price reflects the quality pizzas and service. Highly recommend.

Slabs rocks. After too many Doordash orders my partner and I finally sat in for a meal. It cannot be overstated how good this pizza is fresh out of the oven. Throw some hot honey on and enjoy with a cold beer and you're enjoying one of the best food experiences Onehunga has to offer, and in my opinion the best pizza in Auckland. Never change, Slabs!
OMG yes! So so good. We had not discovered this place before and my goodness we will be back! Awesome service and the pizza was to die for. The potato and mushroom rocked.

Such a wonderful addition to Onehunga! I’m yet to try the Parnell branch so I can’t compare this to that, but from the moment you walk in you feel at home. Everything is beautifully presented, there is merchandise for sale, and a HUGE window looks into the kitchen next door so you get to see pastries being made on the spot. Coffee is available in black only but if you have the taste for it, highly recommend! Certainly smelt good. This is on the pricier side but you’re paying for authentic French products that are of the highest quality. I’ve not had a chance to go back yet but Michael made us feel really welcome.

Such a cute shop ! Nice atmosphere, ample variety of desserts and savouries and the cherry on top is the Coffee to go with. A place where I would love to visit occasionally ❤️ A suggestion would be to add few more benches outside as people would love to sit outside on a nice day for sure ! Definitely will be back again though and would love to see more benches outdoor.
An amazing pastry shop you must visit! Everything is absolutely delicious, especially the almond croissants. A big thank you to Hayley for her warm welcome and her ever-present smile!

Beautiful and delish desserts that I definitely want to go back for again. The flavour comes with layers that’s very surprising in a lovely way. We were there only 20 minutes before closing, but the staff was super patient and friendly—she even offered to check in the back and grab some desserts out of the fridge. Thank you!
My new favourite spot in Onehunga! Michael and Hayley are the best, they’re so kind and they always welcome you with the biggest smiles. The pastries are so good- it’s my weekly tradition now.

They are very average for a roast shop, just brought a pork roast that was not cooked well - chewing a pork roast is not good. On top of that they charge for payWave while they charge top dollar for meals that are crap. My second experience at the worst roast shop on Auckland !
Would come back for their roast potatoes over and over again. Crunchy and golden on the outside, essentially butter mash on inside. Really lovely service from the couple that run it! Support local :)

This is a really nice roast place - I've tried others and they don't measure up to this shop. The meat is always nice and soft, the potatoes are always quite delicious and fluffy (other places sell waxy potatoes, and they're just not as nice) and they use a really light gravy that has a pleasant taste (some other places use a really heavy gravy that has a chemical aftertaste). Food prices are through the roof for everyone, but it's still a really good kai for a reasonable price. The guy who serves is always happy and friendly too, so it's a pleasure to go here. Try them out!
Love to support local but you're paying for a small what you pay for a large at Greenwoods Corner. $23 for a small lamb roast 😪

Try the Chicken Sandwich it's MEAN! I go here once a fortnight and the bread is always fresh as. The place looks a little bit tired but you didn't come here for the ambiance, you came for deep fried chicken and roast potatoes

Absolutely loved this place! The food was delish – full of flavour and beautifully presented. What really made the experience stand out though were the stunning gardens. Walking through felt like being transported to Thailand – surrounded by authentic Thai statues, colourful tuktuks, and magical fairy lights. A perfect spot for a relaxing meal with a great atmosphere. Highly recommend!

Hands down the best curries in Auckland. The yellow curry is my favorite curry ever and this restaurant does not disappoint. Curry puffs are the best I have ever tasted. Welcoming, friendly service, lovely atmosphere and the walk down to the restaurant is picturesque and very beautiful. Would gladly dine here again.

Glad we acted on the recommended suggestion to try out the truly authentic flavours, friendly service and traditional setting and welcoming ambience that this hidden gem has on offer, neatly tucked off the road from plain sight and true to their name. Experience the discovery of the delightful, delicate lighting, traditional displays and decor, as your arrival meanders through an outdoor / indoor maze-like garden-path through the restaurant into various pockets of dinning location options; either completely under the open sky or under the “rustic” roofing. All the staff are extremely friendly and welcoming, service is prompt, courteous and on point. The auroras that drift through the open air will tantalise and explode on your senses, but, guaranteed each mouthful will excite your tastebuds as you enjoy each spoonful, till the very end. We were not disappointed and will most definitely be making a return on our next trip to Ōtāhuhu.

Very nice place to eat! The food is quite similar to Thai cuisine, and everything was absolutely delicious. The staff are very friendly and approachable. Big compliments to the chef Dan! – amazing job!
We had a wonderful family celebration here last night. We had the set menu and everyone enjoyed it, the staff were so good, and the venue was magical.

Giving them 5 stars for the food, even though the coffee was nothing extraordinary, simply because the chef’s special was absolutely worth it. It was really good and came in a generous serving size. The interiors, though, kind of reminded me of a school or office cafeteria from the '90s. Service was friendly and surprisingly fast.

Highly recommend their fried chicken wings. I would drive 30 min just for them. They have a very extensive menu - there's something for everyone. Not too expensive either! Limited parking but wheelchair accessible. Fast service too.
Came for a birthday lunch for 10 it was delicious. Did not wait long for the food, family-friendly service very busy on a Sunday afternoon

First time here. Came from West to check this place out. Very nice food. No complaints, good service. Awesome enviroment. Will be back to dine again.. When you order food enough to feed a family of 5 and you manage to punish this with 2 adults, leaving nothing on the plate goes to show the quality of each dish.

Haven’t been here in years. The place is just how I remembered. Food good, plenty of options constantly busy with people. Parking still an issue but worth a lil inconvenience. Staff attentive and friendly. Place looks a lil run down but super clean and tidy.
The food was tasty and well-seasoned. Prices were reasonable for the quality. Staff were friendly and attentive. Will definitely come back!

Food is delicious but RIDICULOUSLY overpriced. $25 for grilled pork and rice. Chaska Indian Restaurant stands as a beacon of authentic flavors and culinary excellence, and my recent dining experience there left an indelible mark on my taste buds. Nestled in the heart of South Auckland- @Otahuhu, this establishment has earned a well-deserved reputation for delivering a culinary journey through the diverse and delectable landscape of Indian cuisine. The star of the menu, without a doubt, is the Aloo Paratha. Served piping hot, the unleavened flatbread envelops a spiced potato filling that strikes the perfect balance between comforting and flavorful. The crispy exterior gives way to a soft and seasoned interior, making each bite a revelation of textures and tastes. It's not just a dish; it's a celebration of simplicity and authenticity. Chole Kulche, another standout on the menu, showcases the culinary finesse of the chefs. The chickpeas are cooked to perfection, with a medley of aromatic spices infusing every morsel. Paired with soft, pillowy kulchas, it's a symphony of flavors that transports diners to the bustling streets of North India. The Bhature served here are a culinary masterpiece. Puffed to golden perfection, they are the ideal canvas for the robust and flavorful Chole. The crispiness of the bhature complements the richness of the chickpea curry, creating a dish that's both indulgent and satisfying. The Biryani at Chaska is a triumph of spices and skill. Each grain of rice is infused with the essence of the aromatic blend, while the tender meat or vegetables add a layer of succulence. The balance of flavors in the biryani reflects the restaurant's commitment to maintaining the authenticity of this beloved Indian dish. No visit to Chaska is complete without indulging in their Lassi. Creamy, frothy, and perfectly sweetened, it serves as a refreshing counterpart to the robust and spicy flavors of the main dishes. It's evident that even the simplest of beverages are crafted with meticulous attention to detail. Beyond the culinary delights, the ambiance at Chaska exudes warmth and hospitality. The attentive staff adds a personal touch to the dining experience, ensuring that every patron feels not just like a customer, but a welcomed guest. The decor seamlessly blends modern aesthetics with traditional elements, creating an inviting atmosphere that complements the culinary journey. In conclusion, Chaska Indian Restaurant is a culinary gem that beckons to those in search of genuine Indian flavors. The Aloo Paratha, Chole Kulche, Bhature, Biryani, and Lassi are not just dishes; they are a testament to the dedication and passion of the chefs. Whether you're a connoisseur of Indian cuisine or a novice eager to explore its rich tapestry, Chaska promises a gastronomic adventure that transcends the ordinary and leaves an everlasting impression. It's more than a restaurant; it's a celebration of India's culinary heritage.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Consistently Creamy Butter-Chicken Bliss in Ōtāhuhu I discovered this place a month ago, and I’m already planning my third return visit—yes, it’s that good. What makes it stand out? Reliably perfect butter chicken. While other “big-name” spots hit or miss, here every serve is velvety-creamy, gently sweet, and packed with flavour—every single time. Amazing value. A full combo for just $22 feels almost unreal in today’s economy. The portions are generous enough for leftovers (if you can resist polishing it all off in one sitting). Lamb saag done right. I asked for mild and got exactly that—aromatic spinach gravy, tender lamb, no rogue chilli surprise. Next time I’ll bump it to medium because the flavour balance is so spot-on. Garlic-cheesy naan heaven. They don’t skimp on garlic or cheese; this naan could be a meal on its own. Pulling apart those gooey layers is pure joy. Immaculate space & service. The dining area is spotless, and the staff answer every question with patience and a genuine smile. Orders are taken quickly, double-checked, and delivered hot. Verdict If you’re in Ōtāhuhu and craving Indian, skip the inconsistent chains and head straight to the Butter Chicken Centre. Value, consistency, and flavour are all off the charts. I’ll be back soon—probably for another Lamb Saag (and definitely another cheesy naan)

The bento bowls are decent. I tried the chicken katsu curry on rice during my last visit, and it was good.
Super delicious and very nice lady running it.
Spicy pork dish, very delicious and lady who works there everyday is so lovely!

Ordered the mixed Seafood Ginger for $18 and was disappointed with the portion size, which was lacking to say the least. Spice level and flavour was good, but the size and seafood selection was below average.

Traditional Thai Sizzlers in Food City Otahuhu is one of the more popular food places and they serve delicious sizzling plates of meat on fresh vegetables. I particularly like their prawns rolls and also the mussaman chicken curry. Recommended!
This is the best value Thai place in Ōtāhuhu one of my favourite places to visit. I recommend the Honey Roasted Pork Fried rice

Thai Noodles at Food City Otahuhu is my absolute favourite food place for Thai fried or soup noodles. I absolutely adored their Chicken Pad Thai and the Chicken Thai Fried Noodles and Tom Yum Noodle Soups are amazing too! Highly recommended!
Fantastic service and yummy Thai food
Tasty food, great service and good value for money. I’ll be back!! Yummo!!

Have been going to the Otahuhu Mason Ave foodhall for over 20 years. The Thai noodle is always consistent and eventually replaced the same shop but at the Albert St foodhall. A+ food hygiene and their chicken pad Thai is the best!
Best Pad Thai in the city, no question. Have told MANY people who all can't go back to Pad Thai from other places once having tried it from here. Affordable, fresh, and portions are generous.

Goat curry with bones was so delicious, liked it so much. Hot and spicy went well with garlic bread. Nice welcoming and always smiling gave a comfortable atmosphere.

Took my mum and gran for an early Mother’s Day lunch on Friday and the one thing we were all craving was good Indian food. This restaurant hit the spot and beyond. Incredible food, amazing atmosphere and lovely staff. 100% recommend and I will be returning.
Amazing experience from start to finish. Greeted by friendly staff who took our order fast. Food came out quick and was incredible. 10/10
Amongst one of the best Indian food places in Auckland. Their naan 🫓 bread are super soft and highly recommend. Thank you Namaste Restaurant will definitely return 😁

First time at this restaurant and picked up a takeaway. Staff were pleasant and friendly fly the dining in had a nice atmosphere and clean. The food was very good. I had chilli momos and the best I have had and my partner had dhal tardka with a plain naan. The request not to butter on the naan was successful as this is often ignored. He enjoyed his food and is a fussy Indian eater. Would recommend. Cost $$
Very nice food and coffee, and the service is very very good too, really like here

Absolutely love this cafe, great location, easy parking and the staff are all really lovely and super friendly. The food is good and the coffee is fab. Great selection of cabinet food and an extensive menu. Lots of tables and a nice setting whether you decide to sit inside or out, always clean and tidy too 🙌🏻
Very nice friendly staff and good coffee and pastries

Coffee was great especially the cold coffee. It was delicious! The Cajun chicken salad was good and the Moroccan grilled chicken on pide was huge and delicious. The chips were just as we like it - chunky and crunchy on the outside. Great place for a quick lunch. The place wasn't crowded with lunch crowds.
Lovely coffee, fast friendly service, lovely and clean. Highly recommended.

The sushi here is big sized, fresh, yummy, and a huge selection of flavours to choose from! This sushi is made with love!💛 The cabinets of food is presented so well! Very clean inside, lots of seating and a couple of BBQ tables outside. This best part is the delicious sauces on the sushi!🍣 I live in west Auckland but will stop here everytime I'm in E.T. The staff are very friendly and always smiling. 😊 Priced so well here, do stop in and try!

Not my style of sushi - the maki is HUGE, like giant hockey pucks…. everything is deep fried or covered in sauces, it’s extremely westernised and there isn’t a single delicate thing about it. The staff are super talkative and super nice (almost aggressively so) but this is essentially a sushiesque tuck shop in an industrial area designed for big feeds. They seem to have a loyal following and are doing well in the ‘big, fatty, fast and cheap feeds’ niche they have carved out. So all power to them. If you want quality sushi that is in any way traditional I would avoid.

Perfect and our fave go-to for sushi, beautiful food here, and by far the most affordable sushi in Auckland. The staff here are so inviting and respectful to their customers, always smiling saying hello and thank you. They also have the best prices in auckland 5 star always
Sushi comes in nice big rolls. Rice is nice and sticky. Decent sushi. Ladies always welcome you into the shop and farewell you.
My go to in East Tamaki. The owner very delightful. Workers are nice too. Rice rolls fantastic. Same owner on Cavendish drive branch. The best sushi joint by far.

Quite different taste from Japanese dishes. Though I took a seafood ramen, the soup did not have any tastes. It did not have a value for NZD13.50. However it was a big volume each dish. So if you are a big eater, it may suit u.
Ate the beef bulgogi, I enjoyed everything thank you
My go to is their rice & salad bowl with crispy pork & chicken katsu. Service friendly & efficient. A good cheap eat.
Great value for money. I had a whole bowl of chicken and veggies for 12.90. Very friendly service. A great affordable healthy option.

Delish food & great service! Stopped in for brunch with the bro. Nestled amongst Highbrooks Business community & accessible. Good portions & serving size of meals all at reasonable prices. Joined the Loyalty programme as well 🙌 See you again soon Olea team🤙
Amazing food, Amazing service, Amazing hidden Cafe with great ambience (perfect for dates and for family). The rest of the team are just the best, especially Minh who makes the best coffees!

Pretty nice Cafe at the Highbrook business district. The decoration inside is well done and tables are well spaced out. We had the Egg Benedict with Korean Fried Chicken, it's more like the other way round. The KFC was nice and crispy. Thai beef salad was not too bad but could do with a bit more colour and vege variety liek tomatoes, capsicums. Kumara fries were good but I think it's the supermarket kind.

Incredibly family friendly cafe - kids eat free on weekends, colouring in kids menu, plenty of high chairs, kids play area and the food from kids menu was actually delicious and even instagrammable! On the normal/adult menu we really enjoyed the mushroom truffle risotto. The other dishes were ok.

Will rate on last visit as we do use as close to work. Food is good, portions good. Menu has changed a member of our party normally has the steak and that's gone from the menu. We took overseas guests waitress was not friend did not make eye contact and seemed annoyed will taking our order.
The tatty exterior doesnt justify the cleanliness of the inside. Great service with a smile. Love their chips.

Beautiful owners, son on piano, once upon a time xx We've been visiting for years, mum in Ponsonby, would travel over especially. Best whole battered mussels x10 pk is our draw card. Your peace, your calm while we've ever been in your presence. Thank you for your beautiful service xx

Food was affordably priced and extremely value-for-money in terms if taste vs price. There is no indoor seating except a couple of chairs to wait as the store caters primarily to takeaways. Chips were great!

Very popular takeaway shop always busy. People use both phone orders as well as walk-ins. Food is delicious, well prepared, and not over cook . Parking is limited as they share it with a busy fish shop next door.
Best Otahuhu fish and chips shop love it service is great parking is OK given it's location food is delicious and even during its busy hustling hours they keep everything and everyone flowing

Great place to get kava and island vegetables including taro.

Had the lu sipi and marinated lamb flap with Manioke. Was good, Lu was nicely marinated in coconut cream and taro leaves, lamb was soft n tender. Lamb is lamb flap(common with all Lu sipi). Manioke was beautiful, nicely slow cooked. Atmosphere is great too, lovely staff too.

When I tell you this is the best custard pudding I’ve ever had I really mean it because swear I could eat ten in a row And a special thank you to Katrina and her mother, they are the creators of something truly special and we at Simply POS Ltd are proud to be working with them to provide EFTPOS and Point Of Sale solutions The shop is so cute and clean and it’s just so welcoming, definitely recommend to anyone
First time eating at Eli & Beth’s kitchen and it was amazing! The curry was a hit! Service was amazing and atmosphere too! It’s a must 🤝🔥
Cracka tongan cuisine and amazing dessert 🔥

You can get a whole Chinese roasted suckling pig here. Not cheap but absolutely delicious. Young pig tender, not fatty and marinaded to perfection. Everyone enjoyed it and hardly any leftovers. Can't wait to get another one.

Add the red sauce flavor and the meat is perfect The duck is the same timed to retain moisture and succulent taste. Their chicken is the same very white full of moisture. So what didn't I like if you can put up with the tiled floor being slippery at times. Lee Hong is hidden in Otahuhu township Apart from these my fav dishes they cook a very wide range of Chinese dishes
Excellent service and the crispy pork, honeyed BBQ pork and the spring onion was delicious.
Great portions. I can definitely understand how the lady struggles with her English but she is there working alone most of the time. Just be happy she is working and not closed

I love Taco Bell Ōtāhuhu! Every time I visit, the service is excellent—the staff are always friendly and welcoming. The food is consistently high quality, and tonight’s crew really stood out. Very clean and neat. Toilet and waste management beyond my expectations. Great service!!! Way to go Taco Bell. Highly recommended and surely will be back here, so close to home 👏👏👏 Back to this lovely place with colleagues for lunch, great service.
Order #8104, we had come through the drive thru experience amazing customer service and very polite Thank you Minal for your positive attitude you have really made our day

We've had at dinner at least three times from Flava, it's conveniently close for us especially when we can't be bothered cooking. Best roast pork on rice in NZ. The chili is nice and hot, the spring onions give an extra bit of flavour. I haven't tried much on the rest of the menu because it is too good

Steamed Chicken and Duck is amazing too Highly recommend eating here and if you order your meal, make sure to get extra side of spring onions ! The best!
The dish (pork on rice with spring onion) is absolutely delicious. Will return eventually.

First time going to this Kokodak branch in Ōtāhuhu. Where it’s located is almost hidden so we parked across the road then walked inside. It’s suitable for online orders but you can still dine inside. I think there was about two tables inside but they really utilised the space. The place is nice, tidy and the food was delicious. Service was good. 😊

Despite being small place it's still warm and welcoming. Two beautiful ladies were great. So far best korean fried chicken burger, it was actual chicken thigh not some processed one. Chicken was crunchy and juicy at the same time pickles and coleslaw was complementing each other and they have offer on burger combo till 15th April. Will come back for it.

Amazing food, cooked to order and ever so fresh.The staff are really friendly and will happily accommodate amendments,nestled in the centre of Otahuhu it’s well worth a visit.Best Korean Chicken I have had in NZ.
Best Korean fried chicken I have had and it’s in the neighbourhood! Great taste and very generous portions. Totally going back again and again!
Super yum, good portion and I esp love the salad sauce 😋😋 highly recommended

Went here for a family event. I cannot tell you how amazing it is to have an island buffet in the heart of south Auckland. That, in my opinion is top tier and close if not better than valentines and Fortuna. Since being there I have recommended them to family, friend and work colleagues. They seat up to 150 so if you’re wanting to book an event you can do that too. They also do oysters and roast pork on Sundays. Highly recommend! They also have a catering service we used for our wedding back in 2015 so I am so happy I can now dine in store.

First time dining here, 7pm sitting, great selection of food, dessert, coffee/tea, well displayed food which was hearty & delicious. The staff were all attentive & friendly, the tables were cleared as people finished eating which was great, the buffet area could accommodate more room for foot traffic, it was reasonably priced per person, overall it was a pleasant & good experience.

Yummy kai, big tables available, lots of variety. Perfect if you want lots of different dishes at a great price. Price was really reasonable at $39.99. Prawns were fabulous. No oysters were available the day I went but perhaps they do on others like the photos. Regardless of that, it was worth it. I’ll be back!

Not many options of food to choose from. And its food we occasionally cook in our own home. The dessert was OK. Still had to wait for cakes since they ran out quick. The carpark out side is tight so be careful when coming out of carpark. Not enough toilets when a place is catered to many people.

Went here for a family gathering after seeing them online for a while and had a good feed. The turkey tails were the best hot food. Compared to all the buffets in south Auckland I’d say this one is the hands down cleanest. They were always wiping down near the buffets and cleaning the dessert area. Also a plus was that this is one of the only island food buffets in Auckland that are opened to eat in. The only negative to mention is that the front of house lady was very unfriendly. She didn’t smile or make our family feel welcomed. My elderly family tried to make light with her and say some jokes but she would look at them with a side eye them or look down on her phone to avoid speaking. I understand work gets tiring but that’s a real negative for the business having someone who looks angry as your front of house - just a polite recommendation as we liked the food but would’ve enjoyed it more if the front representative for your company was more inviting, welcoming and kind

Okay, so last night was my first real experience at this place, as Ive been there when I was younger with my parents, and let me just tell you, the specials are humongous 😂 My family ordered the steak and Porl meal with salad and fries and honestly its a meal fit for a king and affordable only $15. If you want a great and very generous portion this is the place to go, of course there is a lil wait because of the meals being freshly made but its worth it. Glad to say we have a new fav place to go, Golden King yous have outdone yourself Thank you for thw delicious meal and hospitality.
Best steak and pork chop meals EVERERR.

What I enjoyed most about this place has to be the meals I have had here . Pork and taro meal and the pork chop salad n chips. It was delicious This place can be busy at lunch time as it is a popular place. Service is ok There is no rest room There are seating available to dine in.
$14 for Pork / Steak or Chicken with chips + salad. Very tasty & great prices. Nice variety of choices. $2 canned drinks.
Still one of the best places in otahuhu.. I could move anywhere in Auckland and still drive all the way here.. They have good prices too even with the increase..
Food is very good and staff and freindly . Nice clean little place as its recently open for service.

WOW!!!!! Congratulations guys and welcome to Otahuhu, I'm so happy we finally have a cafe with a delicious menu. I spent about $90, it was so worth it. Nice spacious seating area betwn the tables, nice wide seats. Our table culd have done with another wipe down but that didn't ruin our whole experience.I WOULD HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!!!

I came here while visiting Auckland. I was hungry and my GPS took me here. The pies here are amazing, beautiful buttery pastry and generous fillings. On par with Fairlie ones. This Cantabrian was impressed 👍

The breads are all freshly baked and lots of choices of food for quick and easy bites. Their chicken pies are one of the best and they run out quick. Do nit go for the one from freezer if they run out. The fresh ones in warmer are the best ones. Spacious in side for dine in and clean too.
First time and it was just what I needed B25 and B31 Grilled beef steak avo cheese salad was yummy Eggs bene was perf relax and eat 👌 I'll be back

Change of process for preparing a toasted foot long isn't well received. Chicken not warmed through well. Double toasting to warm it causes the bread to crumble. Service team was excellent 5 stars.

Great location and easy to access from the main road. The restaurant was quiet and not busy when we visited which was great as our food came out within 10 minutes. Unfortunately, staff didn’t get our order right as we requested mild for all meals and were given all spicy dishes regardless food was flavoursome. Staff were friendly and provided prompt service.

My work mates and I went decided to try this place out , because of all the good reviews we've been reading about plus from friends and family . We enjoyed it the food , the portion size is great . The braised pork noodle soup I had had the right amount of spice and it was very flavorful. We also ordered steam pork and cabbage dumpling, and was 🤌💯 a good mixture of chili oil with oyster sauce . Pricing is very reasonable . And their taro bubble tea is pretty good 💯
Great Xi'an food for a good price. Very tradition. Can definately recommend the chicken mince and the two topping noodles. Also recommend the wide noodles!
First time here, it was ok. Maybe next time will dine in. The food was good.

Absolutely loved our experience at West Delhi Food Cart! We tried a variety of dishes and every single one was bursting with flavour. The Malai Chicken, Tandoori Chicken, Seekh Kabab, Chicken Tikka, and Malai Soya Chaap were perfectly spiced and grilled to perfection. The Tawa Chicken Tikka Masala with soft, fresh naan was the ultimate comfort food, and their chai was the perfect way to end the meal. The food reminds you of proper Delhi street-style flavours — bold, authentic, and made with love. They’re also open till late on weekends which is great for a late-night food run. Bonus: they have a $9 weekend menu which is super value for money! Highly recommend this food truck to anyone craving delicious Indian food. Will definitely be going back soon!

West Delhi Food Cart in Ōtāhuhu serves up delicious, authentic Indian street food - ex west Delhi literally. From tandoor delicacies to crispy samosas and flavorful chaats, every bite is packed with spice and taste. Friendly service, great portions, and a must-try for Indian food lovers. Open late—highly recommend!
One of the best chicken tikka roll I had in Auckland. Service was great too. And the best thing is they are opened till late on Friday and Saturday. Would definitely try more of their food.

Had an awesome time at this food truck! The food was seriously delicious — I tried the Tandoori chicken, Bhuna goat, and butter chicken, and they were all amazing. The flavors felt super authentic and totally satisfying. Definitely recommend checking this place out, and plan to come back to explore more of their menu. If you’re into good Indian street food, you gotta give it a shot!
Amazing food, service and atmosphere. Highlights for us were Butter Paneer and Goat Curry. Very fresh and authentic Delhi style food. Home away from home.
Awesome place $10 membership food is delicious staff and customers are very welcoming beers cheap and family’s are welcomed love love love ❤️
The people here are down to earth, family friendly atmosphere, great Bistro eats, reasonably priced
Very good customer service nice and clean place. Very nice meal.
Good bar very friendly convivial
Very friendly staff & patrons felt very welcome.
Fantastic service from Jess! She was quick, kind, and served with a warm smile. The food was delicious! Highly recommend the #6 pasta and any of their Pizza! - it's a must-try!
Food was great, wait time wasn’t too long considering how packed the place was. Our server Ava was so lovely. Overall great atmosphere would definitely be the new local.

Served by Jess and had a great experience with a group of friends. Food and portion sizes for the mains were great. Variety of cocktails. Wish the dessert was a bit bigger for the pricing though. Other meals order were also delicious 🙂 Pictures: Flamed pork and wagyu brisket meatballs on Fettuccine. Citrus panna cotta for the dessert.

Love Good Brothers. Food always good. Atmosphere is great and service was mostly geeat apart from them not letting me use my reward points after I asked to use them. That is okay though, I can use them next time. If you want a good feed that is between fast food and gourmet, Good brothers is the place! Fish and Chips were awn!!! And Chicken Pizza is the best!!

First time visiting and I was overwhelmed by the food menu (in the best way possible). Everything on the menu sounded so yum, but I opted for the Italian Meatball Soup and was not disappointed! Was very filling, the meatballs were a good size and the soup had plenty of them! I did wish I had ordered garlic bread to dip with. 10/10 would order again! Staff were really lovely and kind! Food came out relatively fast (considering there was a massive group of us). Would go back to try other dishes and desserts!

Our go to whenever we have birthday celebrations, especially when there's a few of us. The food comes super fast, and always fresh! The kids absolutely love their sushi and food! Service is always friendly too with free hot tea served. Can't recommend more!

I've been here a number of times & the food + service is consistently good. Last time we came here, I was obsessed with the Karaage chicken and prawn tempura. We always order the beef tataki & it never disappoints We actually ordered so much food we couldn't finish and had to take it home! First time trying the sukiyaki and was pleasantly surprised as well

We tried the Japanese food at Nishiki and wow — everything was sooo yum! Every dish was packed with flavour, fresh, and beautifully presented. The vibe was cozy and authentic, and the service was lovely too. We’ll definitely be back for more. Highly recommend if you’re craving quality Japanese food!

absolutely incredible !! the food was delicious and so affordable. sashimi extremely fresh and creamy. you order your dishes off an ipad and service is LIGHTNING fast. such a comfy cozy vibe, you could come here alone, on a date or with a group of friends with BYO wine!! can NOT WAIT to come back. :)

Expensive and nothing special. There are better Japanese restaurants that offer more quality food and for cheaper. I was waiting for my rice for 15 minutes after my main arrived and had to go check up on it. How can you guys forget about our order when we are one of the few customers there? Beef tataki not presented well and was expensive for the price (8 tiny pieces for $16).
Flounder and chips only $16.50 so worth the money and crumb fish for gluten free people. Worth the money.

This is our go-to spot whenever we’re craving fresh seafood that’s also reasonably priced! The quality is always consistent — the seafood tastes fresh every time, and the portions are generous. Their salads are also surprisingly good — fresh, flavorful, and the perfect side to any seafood dish. The staff are friendly, and the place is always clean and well-maintained. Definitely one of our favorites in the area. Highly recommended!

Usually pretty good but today, waited 40 minutes and the fish had a strong chemical taste and smell. Tried to put lemon on it but nothing could mask the taste or the smell. Chips and fritters were good.

Been coming to this place for a while fantastic fish & chips ,fish is fresh & cooked prefect,good staff,i got 2 snapper & chips came with a drink for $22 was whole it so good highly recommend this place
The best seafood place I go for fresh seafood and cooked food too, they have the best sashimi, fish and chips and scallops.

Great food – I always enjoy my meals here! This place has become my go-to spot for a tasty and satisfying meal. There’s just one thing I wish they would improve: the drink options. They don’t offer Coca-Cola, Sprite, or Pepsi in cans – only bottled versions, and the taste just isn’t the same. It would be great if they could offer canned soft drinks as well. Other than that, love the experience!

great lunch with a few mates today and the place was excellent.. chicken cooked too perfection. Service provided was exceptional. Fires were crispy asf 🔥👌 Worth every penny hands down the best 💯 Keep up the great work team 💯

This is a very spacious Nandos that can really get busy on weekends. Service has always been good. There can be a bit of a wait sometimes as many uber orders are done from this store. But we've always had a nice experience dining here.

Food is great, nothing to say because it is Nando’s. Service was also superb. Went for two days in a week. Second day I found the chips not that crispy enough and they immediately replaced with a new bowl. Not long waiting and quick service in the counter was also good. Only thing is it is crowded in the evening. But that crowd adds the atmosphere!

Nandos Botany is my favorite branch of nandos coz they always serve big n flavorful chicken and addicting ketchup but today I feel sad they serve small chicken n not much bbq sauce on it and they even change the ketchup for fries. I hope they bring back botany nandos food before.

First thing we all noticed on entering the restaurant were the smokey fumes from the teppanyaki tables. As we were ordering a la carte, thankfully we got seated a distance away from the teppanyaki area. Staff were friendly and service was quick. Ordered 2x Teriyaki Salmon Dinner Boxes (Miso, rice and dipping sauces included), a Grilled Eel Donburi (with Miso) and Takoyaki. All meals were presented attractively and for the price, they were a decent serving size. Unfortunately a couple of items in the dinner box was average - the prawns in the gluggy sauce had congealed, and the pieces of sushi that were not rolled firmly and had unravelled. Overall a good Japanese restaurant chain.
Great place for a special get-together. Yummy food. Great service. Awesome chefs with teppanyaki skills. The serves are filling; do not eat for at least 6hrs if you want to fully enjoy your food.

The theater is great, entertaining but it's way over priced for what you get. Plus, I'm not a fan of eating my meal in bits, that is, the vegetables, then rice and lastly the meat. I prefer it together. The tempura banana for dessert was a huge let down. Dennys does a banana fritter way better and cheaper!
We enjoyed our dinner here, staff were really friendly.

A pleasant & entertaining dining experience with humorous Justin, the teppan chef Our party had 2 scotch steak sets, 2 Hoki Fish sets &, one salmon fish set All meat & fish mains are fresh A satisfying dinner for all

Returned to East Tamaki's Sri Mahkota after a 2 year gap and understand there has been a change in owner or chef. The food was OK, though a bit on the bland side. That said, I prefer that over overly intense flavours without clear character. Unfortunately, I would not go out of my way to frequent it, given the number of other options nearby. However, I would not be against returning if a friend suggested it.

The new owner took over recently and look a $35 big fish soup noodle is so small!! Very unhappy. This photo capture half of the portion. Definitely not enough for 2 people....which work out $17.5 for this???? Taste is not as rich too...
A lot of food!!! But very very tasty food!! We had to box them to take home!! We will be back soon!!!

Went in the beginning of 2024 so understandable that many suppliers weren't operating, sadly a lot of options on the menu were not available as the staff informed their ingredients have not been delivered. Food tastes nice and is your usualy Malaysian options. The roti came out fresh and crispy and not oily. Service was friendly and overall environment very clean.

Our latest visit here was Thursday 23/6/22, a little bit disappointed the rice served was uncooked, you can taste the hard grains which my son also noticed. They are not as fast to serve as they used before we waited for almost half an hour for our first dish to arrive. As usual at the end, you're offered some food that you might want to buy extra which I don't mind, but too late to realized I must have got ripped off for 1pc of ma-chang for $9 *********** I always wonder how she (order taker) remember all your orders right and not get confused when she's not taking notes?🤔 eating here is a breeze, food is served quick even when it's their peak hours.

One of the worst hot chocolate in the world. Tastes like water with sugar and only 2/3 filled. The manager explained because I ordered the cheap chocolate 😟 She said, they just push a button and can’t do anything.
Service was pretty quick but its probably cause theyre cutting corners. I stg maccas cant decide if they want to make a burger 90% lettuce or have 1 solum piece of lettuce lol.

Food was alright. My burger was very untidy (maybe packed in alot of rush) . My fries were fresh. Service was excellent from both windows. The drive thru was very clean and tidy. Overall great location and Excellent service from the team.

I ordered a small coke and they gave me like a brown sparkling water, it was half empty and had no ice. My friend ordered a cheese burger with no ketchup, no mustard, and no pickles. Guess what they gave her all 3.

Order 2 choc mcdip ice cream which was melting and not made properly then ask to staff for exchange as staff was not following any hygiene instructions. Like not wearing gloves and touching her dirty t-shirt, cleaning their dirty hands with their clothes not using any hygiene please use basic health and safety precautions at workplace. And talk politely with customers. Very bad experiences

Went for yum Cha. Pretty yum! Shumai juicy and lots of prawn. Squid tentacles crispy and flavourful. Waiters speak some English but didn’t seem to want to bring us some stuff we ordered for takeaway? Also no yumcha trolley, they come out on platters. Would go back, pretty equivalent to lobster palace and the other yum Cha place on chapel road. $110 for 3 of us.

They are open quite early for Yum Cha, so it is best to go earlier than at 12pm. Usually there is a bit of a wait, as the restaurant is not big. Most tables are suitable for 4 people, with a few that can sit more. They bring out the food on trays, instead of trolleys and the selection is limited to your more traditional dishes. Still very tasty, but no special dishes

A pretty nice yumcha place with reasonable prices. We went on a public holiday, it was busy but no wait time, we were seated immediately. Everything was good, nothing incredible but was overall tasty. The highlight would be the steamed yellow cake rolls, not too sweet, very fluffy with a little bit of saltiness from the filling in the centre. The bathroom was not very well maintained though. It wasn't disgusting, but only half of the toilets and basins were working, the others just had tape around them. Was about $130 for four adults, which I found ok, considering it was a public holiday. Good place to eat with friends. Just don't all go to the bathroom at once.
The Chinese cuisine here is really good. All the dishes we had were top quality and 100% tasty. Service was very good with the waitresses being very attentive and polite.

Quick service. Pleasant staff. About 15 tables. Please reserve a table if you are a large party. Hot house soup was served to all customer & we had a tasty lotus soup. Prawn fishball was a lovely sight. It was freshly made and has a springy bite with natural sweetness. Sweet & sour pork was crunch coating and tender meat on its inside. A surprisingly crispy tofu coating with soft melting centre. The tofu is a must have recommendation. Fried French beans with salty marinated pork mince was slightly over salted. Rice was served in a refillable pot. Complementary coconut milk cooked with sago & bits of pumpkin was delicious. A good place to dine

Good and service is good. But if you’re intending on eating in the restaurant bring a jacket! They keep it absolutely freezing in there. In the height of summer I’m shivering eating in here. Pro tip - have a thermostat on your wall to adjust your aC to 21/22deg. Otherwise very good KFC

Was 5 star but food quality is not of their required standards for a longstanding customer who looks for the better outlets To be fair I didn't have the hot n spicy this time. Last visit it was superior. Last Monday the potato and gravy was tasteless and the eleven herbs and spices were absent. To end up the original coleslaw is sadly missed.

I loved coming to this KFC even though I have one 2 minutes away from my place because their chicken is always juicy but this time around I saw the new product they were selling and I wanted to try it out $5.99 for this yuck thing definitely don’t look like the pictures the sauce wasn’t even spread out evenly.

Just had the chicken wings and a Zinger burger tonight—absolutely delicious! The wings were juicy and perfectly crunchy. Honestly, it tastes better than before! Service was great too, and I got a cool keyring. 😊🍗
Ordered 10 price hot&spicy boneless. The size is half of other store I thought I got chicken nuggets

Pick your own Sushi in Botany. Lots to choose from and it's all very fresh. The pieces are big in size as well and good value for money. Grab a box or plate then grab it with thongs. There are other options made to order, such as Katsu or Donburi or the Bento Box. Friendly service with a smile

Delicious, fresh, and a large selection of sushi pieces — I like how you can choose all your favourites to mix and match! They also have some yummy hot food on offer. Plenty of seating so you can sit and eat if you prefer. Good value for money too 👍🏻
Everytime i eat here, i crave it shortly after lol. The sushi rice is so creamy and perfect. Fresh seafood and veges. Friendly staff and peaceful atmosphere
Ended up getting food poisoning 😶 bug maybe because of public holiday don’t know 🤷
Love it here, love the service and the food is always fresh. Can tell they take pride in there business.

DONT ORDER ONLINE. The prices are higher online compared to if you order it the restaurant. Partner placed an order online, I show up to pick up my order. Turns out my order was never received and they could not even verify that they received the payment. They would not give me the food, and they kept giving me the phone to talk to their boss to claim I’ve already paid. Feels like a huge waste of time and bad service.

Ordered some classics! This is a childhood favourite of mine and after 10 years I came back after moving to the shore. Tasted so good (as a Chinese person) I can recommend. The portions were big and balanced. Gave generous portions of rice. Prices are also appealing. Would come back again!

The fish I ordered was not fresh at all. It tasted fishy after one bite. The waiter took away most of the rest. When I paid the bill, they even asked for money. I was very disappointed! I will not go there again.
Taste great with big portion for lunch and dinner. The drink is nice and the speed of serving is very fast. A quality restaurant that I like to visit regularly.
A small cosy Chinese restaurant with good size servings, delicious and reasonable. No fancy trappings but good service. Enjoyed our meal here.
Nice vibe, went for Karaoke one Saturday

Unfortunately nothing on their Facebook page on the food they serve is correct...from the Facebook page we went and were told the menu they gave us was the only food they serve 😳 OK so what happened to the burgers, steak, egg and chips and other meals you put on your Facebook page? We didn't enjoy the food that we could order from the very small menu and it wasn't that nice we left most of it on the table and went home to cook more food. We used to own a restaurant ourselves and this was very disappointing especially after the food they posed on their face book... Also if you look deeper into them, they have like 3 or 4 Facebook pages😳🤔🤔🤔
Why does this place never open on time? It is now 11.35 on a Saturday morning and there is nobody in the place. This is not the first time I have sat in my car outside for over half an hour.
Good place to stop for a quick sud and reasonably priced. The locals are easy to chat to and have a laugh with. I was served by Sunny with a smile, who was polite, welcoming and friendly 👌💯 😊

Great as they let you pre-order for lunch so you can have a nice lunch on a work day quickly. Menu needs an update/change every now and again we have stopped going as no specials and never anything new. Smoking area can sometimes means restaurant also smells of cigarette smoke too.
Nice staff and cabinet food is as expected of a chain store. I had a tea which was brewed from a tea bag. Reasonably nice place to spend a lunch hour at.

I have often seen this place on the way to work, but don't have a long enough lunch break to explore. I went in on the weekend for breakfast and it was really nice - although I was the only person there at the time. The service was friendly and quick, and the food excellent.

My number one and top cafe in Tamaki Makaurau. Every time I’m in Auckland, it’s a must for me and my family to visit and dine it at Gloria Jean’s at East Tamaki 3 or 4 times a week. The food is absolutely delicious and always fresh. Can’t say enough about the staff, they are super awesome and very friendly. I recommend this cafe to everyone near and afar. This is my go to and happy place in Auckland. Cheers to the staff.

Service was great, but this food is incredibly overpriced. Paid $13.90 for about the smallest punnet of mediocre chicken pesto pasta I’ve ever had. Rest of the menu looked nice, but think about taking out a second mortgage. Lovely atmosphere.

I am very disappointed to say that our experience here was horrible. We went here in East Tamaki, and what we ordered, a korean chicken wrap, was almost completely empty but loaded with lettuce. I couldn’t taste any chicken but lettuce, the way it was displayed is false advertisement clearly and when emailing them, they offered a free coffee voucher, which they never sent lol and it solves nothing in this case. Please check ur food whats inside when ordering here
Been wanting to come here for ages and the wait did not disappoint! The menu changes regularly and is full of flavourful variety. The BBQ "pork" bun was my favourite, not oily and perfectly steamed.

Cafe is part of the supermarket, small and basic with a check-off menu for easy ordering. Food is all vegan, and is mostly Chinese with a couple of Western/NZ options (such as crumbed "sausage" and chips). The staff are very friendly and want to make sure you are looked after. The supermarket is essentially a vegan Chinese supermarket rather than a Western supermarket so perfect for Chinese ingredients/meals but likely not the place you would do your full groceries. Important to note: The whole business only takes eftpos NO Visa or MasterCard, even if they are debit cards. So if visiting and only have these cards there is a service station nearby with a BNZ ATM you can get cash from if needed. Perfect place for quiet cheap vegan meal if you like mock meats 😁

I was looking for Malay sweet soy sauce (Habhal kicap manis-i tried four different supermarkets in North Shore but to no avail) and was recommended to visit E-pacs. Apparently, it's a renowned Asian supermarket, especially in South Auckland. Ended up leaving a whole bunch of other sauces and snacks that are rarely seen in the usual Asian supermarkets (a lot more instant kl chilli ban mian, indomie flavours, frozen Yong tau fu and the sweet sauce and etc). They also have a dedicated section of frozen vegetarian products and vegetarian dry goods (vegetarian bak ku teh spice pack, etc). Also, I think it's the only place with frozen carrot cake and chwee kueh. Stocked next to it was a bottle of caipo. They certainly put some thought into the merchandising. Love it! *do try some of the kueh they have selling at the counter. these are usually cash only, but the cashier can cash out for you, and the kueh is quite good. **plenty of parking ***cafe was closed the two times I've visited. Pity. ****Google maps will lead you to the wrong location. Enter by Nandina Ave. *****staff are really friendly and happy to help.

This is the best vegetarian/vegan restaurant/grocery. It has more vegan things than you can even try. There are mock meats that I have only ever seen in Indonesia. The Singaporean hawker food is out of this world! I’ve never had Singaporean hawker food that is vegan. A must try.
Has the largest selection of vegetarian/vegan items in Auckland. Everything is meticulously labelled for those who are vegan, lacto-ovo vegetarian, and those practice Jain vegetarianism, and etc.

I don’t know how anyone can give them less than 4 stars! Very friendly and attentive staff (the best in any of the Indian places I’ve been). The restaurant is still spacious and clean. The food was full of flavour and deliciousness. It is not as hip and innovative as “1947” in town but overall I would recommend the restaurant and will be back.

Not sure if there chef has changed or what. But the food. Mmm is very tasteless. Chicken made me sick , and even found hair in my food. Was so disappointed because last year there butter chicken was the best I ever had. But after that no matter what we had. Even if it was the butter chicken, it was terrible. The saag panner was my partners fave. He has now said we will never order from this place again. Sad to say. You were my most fave place to eat.

went there yesterday, food was absolutely delicious, mouth watering, kids loving it so delicious can't get enough of it. definitely recommended it's a good place for any soughts of function. Friendly service ❤️

The service very nice and above my expectation. Meals veg and non veg was as expected as I tried lunch specials. Location and ambience same as previous owner had with couple of Punjabi touches. Will try again in few day with family and friends
Good food friendly staff , main courses could be better marinated and more tender.attentive and fast service.small and cosy restaurant.

Absolutely the best Lebanese food in Auckland! I first discovered this gem at the Clevedon Market, and I’ve been hooked ever since. Now that they’ve opened their own restaurant, it’s even better! The flavours are authentic, the ingredients are fresh, and the hospitality is top-notch. Definitely worth the visit — you won’t be disappointed. I forgot to take picture of our shawarma and falafel but we also got some treats so find picture below

Definitely the most authentic and the BEST shawarma and falafel in NZ. They have a wide range of dips and snacks that you can buy . The owner was very friendly and gave us the Zaatar man’ouche for free !! Huge space for large gathering’s and great ambience ..This is going to be our go to spot for sure !HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!
yum!! good value and tasty shawarma!! friendly service, definitely will be back! only takeaway for now but i cant wait for the restaurant side to be open!
Its the most amazing Lebanese food you can have in Auckland.. AAA.. Garlic Dip - Toum.. is a must try...

Just had the most delicious meal with my family! We ordered four shawarmas, drinks, fries, fresh bread, and some crispy flatbread — and they even gifted us a free hummus! Peter was absolutely incredible — so friendly and welcoming. The service was top-notch, the food was packed with flavour, and the atmosphere was beautiful with Arabic music and olive trees setting the scene. Can’t wait to come back once it’s fully done up and hopefully host some events there too!

Paldo Korean Buffet offers a diverse array of traditional Korean dishes, providing a satisfying dining experience for both newcomers and aficionados of Korean cuisine.​ Food Quality and Variety The buffet boasts a wide selection of dishes, including bibimbap, bulgogi, noodles, and cold dishes. Guests can enjoy both cooked food starters and BBQ grill options. The self-service format allows diners to customize their meals to their liking. However, some patrons have noted that certain dishes could be replenished more promptly during peak hours.​ Ambiance and Cleanliness The restaurant features high ceilings, greenery, and luxurious seating, creating an inviting atmosphere. The establishment is well-maintained, ensuring a pleasant dining environment.​ Service Staff are generally attentive and friendly, contributing to a positive dining experience. That said, there have been instances where service could be more proactive, especially in guiding first-time visitors through the buffet process.​ Value for Money With lunch priced at approximately $18 and dinner at $28, Paldo offers reasonable rates for an all-you-can-eat buffet. The variety and quality of food justify the cost, making it a worthwhile option for group gatherings or family outings.​ Final Thoughts Paldo Korean Buffet delivers a commendable selection of Korean dishes in a comfortable setting. While there's room for improvement in service consistency and dish replenishment, the overall experience is enjoyable and represents good value.

I’ve been here more than five times, and the experience has been consistently great. They always keep the buffet well-stocked, and there’s just the right amount of variety to choose from. The meat is fresh—which I really appreciate—and the staff are always attentive and friendly. The only minor downside is that they don’t accept PayWave 😅. My partner and I forgot our card a couple of times and had to drive back home. But overall, I really love Paldo!
East Auckland no1 buffet for Korean bbq. Excellent customer service and food is amazing. Price is only 40 dollar. If U wish to treat a family for meal. This is no1 shop.amazing
Great variety, decent price and the staff are amazing. We had so much fun grilling our own meat.

I believe they are well-known and are very popular because it's already a queue there before it opens for dinner. My first visit, a big fan of Korean BBQ so I can't wait to have a good time there I must say they do have a good selections of all you can eat items. From the cold dishes to hot ones, from the famous Koreab appetizers to meats and seafood for BBQ, literally they have everything you want It definitely worth the money you paid, however, I mean, in terms of the taste, mediocre, I wasn't really impressed though. Also I've noticed that they don't really refill every item, everyone gets 90 minutes to eat, so perhaps cost concerned?

We celebrated our daughter's 18th birthday at the restaurant.The manager,Harman was very attentive to our choice of menu and his suggestions were great too. We were allowed to decorate the place and he made space for dancing too. We met the owners,Vandana and her husband and they are such lovely people. Everyone enjoyed the food and had a great time🎊🎉💃🕺 Thank you Vandana and team at Bay Leaf & Beyond for making my daughter's birthday a memorable one🙏

We ordered from Foreshore, circa a little over 2 weeks ago. Upon eating our chicken lollipop I discovered the meat was raw. Instead of posting a public review straight away, I contacted the restaurant about it to handle it privately, as we are frequent customers. Due to me getting mucked around via emails, I've decided to share my experience publicly now so everyone is aware. I was informed that Ti Rakau branch was sold to a new owner and that they would be in touch. To date, no one from this branch has reached out. Sadly, I find the handling my complaint rather egregious, given that eating raw chicken would have made us serverly ill.

We loved Foreshore and with new management, the food isn’t the same anymore. We ordered one hot and one medium hot butter chicken. We received two medium hot butter chicken instead. The chicken tasted burnt, lacked of flavours and I found a sharp metal piece in my curry. This has ruined my appetite mid way through my meal. Very disappointed as Foreshore was our favourite place to go for amazing Indian Restaurant.

Decided to have Indian lunch after watching a documentary about Indian cuisines. We have ordered here before and knew that their food was amazing. It was my first time to order lamb biryani, chicken rara and tandoori platter. Usually I order the one I'm most familiar with (which is butter chicken) but today I wasn't disappointed with my lunch. It was very flavorful and everything tastes authentic. There's only 2 of us in the house but we got leftovers for dinner and tomorrow's lunch. Let's all support Nz businesses at this tough covid times.

The board that can be seen on the street advertises lunch specials. However when I sat down to dine in i was told the special is only on take away. $22 dollars for a vege curry with no naan or drink. Curry was flavorless. Cutlery was dirty. Menu had food stains and food crumbs. Bad experience overall. Wouldnt recommend.

I have been coming here for years, and the portions are big. Very good service and affordable for the sizes. They recently added new menu items. I definitely recommend the chicken wings, though the other fried dishes taste very nice

I enjoyed some delicious roast pork with noodles! The food was pretty good, and the prices were reasonable. Plus, the portions were generous. It had a casual food court vibe, and the service was great.

Ladies were lovely. This review is a little old . Had forgotten to do it due to being busy & distracted. Unfortunately saw some uninvited guests or whatever it was amongst my roast pork on rice. Took pictures. As soon as I took this back I was offered a refund. Very sad cos it was fine the last time. Keep an eye out just incase. 😁

Serve fast piping hot meals and wide range of menus to choose from the wall. Affordable price and large portion. Our favourite would be #56 Braised Eggplant wt Roast Pork on Rice. So yummy! Although sometimes you'll see the ladies at the counter looking 'not in their best mood' but that doesn't effect the quality of the food. Duck and Roast Pork equally good.

📍 Lee Hong BBQ & Takeaways 🐮 Mixed Vegetables Beef Rice Taste Rating: 🌕🌕🌕🌗🌑 🏮Review🏮: The portion size is larger than expected, making it suitable for a filling meal. I thought the flavor would be salty, but it was actually alright! Cleanliness Rating: 🌕🌕🌕🌑🌑 Service Attitude: 🌕🌕🌕🌑🌑 Willingness to Revisit: 🌕🌕🌕🌑🌑 This restaurant is located near Chinatown in the Botany area. Inside, there are several different restaurants to choose from. After looking around, I settled on this one, but it's optional whether to try it or not.
Came here midday on a Thursday 12th june. Place is clean which is a huge factor for me. FOOD WAS FRESH 👏 The two ladies were fast and efficient. Overall good service

Ordered from them through Uber eats and they forgot my pepsi max that I ordered. Still charged me and I put a negative review. No drink and no refund. Just got a reply saying they will do better next time. Not good enough. How about they drop off a drink as I am just down the road. Being in retail that is what I would do, I understand mistakes happen but take ownership and rectify with a solution.
Just had lunch, both the ladies were so lovely and friendly. Such an welcoming customer service, will visit again😀😊

“Fresh and Delicious!” I love Pita Pit! The ingredients are always fresh, and the variety of options lets me customize my meal exactly how I like it. The staff is friendly and quick, even during busy times. The pitas are flavorful and filling, but still feel like a healthy option. My favorite is the chicken with all the veggies and BBQ sauce—absolutely delicious! Highly recommend for anyone looking for a quick, tasty, and satisfying meal.
This is the best pita pit in Auckland. We go out of our area which already has a pita pit just to come to this one. Staff are friendly, generous portions. You get your money's worth here.

They were hiding sushi with bad avocado under the good avocado. Took a bite just to make sure it wasn’t oxidation and almost threw up cause it tasted like rotting avocado. Had to throw away 5 pieces, extreme waste of $12.

Staff were rude and argumentative when questioned about the kids combo. We have gotten the kids combo from this store before but for what ever reason staff today yelled and argued that the promotion was over. We went to another store and HELLOOOOOOOOOOO kids sushi combo asked staff they said it’s available at ALL STORES …. Except Botany Town Center seems they just can’t be bothered 😕

The standard of sushi and the service here has dropped markedly. My brown rice avocado and salmon 8 pack was not fresh. The rice was cold, (and it was only 11.30am when I got this) always an indication that it's not fresh, the avocado vey pale but worse was the salmon. Definitely NOT fresh, very dark flesh, not at all appetizing and there were crunchy bits in the sushi. The service here has also declined. The staff seem to think it's ok to yell at each other in Chinese, even to other staff behind me having a coffee. Very unprofessional. I will post photos soon.

Average sushi, you can definitely get better quality sushi at other places for a similar price. Sushi value of the day tastes like it was made the day before, very dry rice and old tasting. Quite expensive considering it is mostly rice.

Fast service and many different options to choose from. The place is very clean, tidy and has good ambience. The biggest issue was the ratio of rice to filling in the sushi rolls as it seemed like there was an overwhelming amount of rice packed into each roll, overshadowing the delicate flavours of the fillings. The rice was also excessively sticky compared to other branches. The salmon looked a bit odd as it was extremely white in colour compared to some other sushi packets.
Has always been good quality for the years I have bought from them.

Disappointed with the food and service I received on the evening of 18/07/2025. I paid almost $20 for a meal and when I asked for a little extra pineapple they said I have to pay $2 for 2 extra pieces of pineapple. I asked how many pineapple pieces do you get normally and they said 2 pieces only. When I selected other vegetables they gave less than table spoon serving of each. The male person serving me was very rude and unkind. Disappointing services and not value for money.

Probably the only noodle canteen left that hasn’t changed from when it first opened. The quality of the food was great, generous with the meat. Good substantial meal that tasted delicious. Food came out fast and the restaurant was clean and tidy. Staff could do with more manners.
Big portion sizes and made pretty quick! Tastes delicious too😊

Can’t rate atmosphere cause we ordered on uber eats but the food arrived really fast so good service. There is too much baking powder in the batter used to cover the chicken and left a bitter dry taste in every bite. Had a really bad first experience and will not be buying anything from them again. The fried wontons also tastes kind of weird. At least the sauce and noodle were good.

This Pizza Hut has the absolute best customer service, credits to the lovely man who is often on the front counter. He has served me multiple times over the last year and he is the most friendly, helpful and kind person. One time I went in and wanted to pay for majority on cash and the rest on my card which was only $1 approx but this generous man pulled out his wallet from his pocket and swiped his own card and said don’t worry about it. This was the kindest small gesture, I was so blown away. I called tonight and wanted to make a small change to my delivery order that I wasn’t able to do online and he made sure it was done for me, no stress, no difficulty. He is a real asset to your company and I wanted to take the time to leave a review and share how wonderful this man is. Pizza is always top notch even when being delivered. Highly recommend Pizza Hut Botany.

Ordered online and was given a time for pick up. To stand in the store for over half an hour after that was unacceptable. Appreciate that you’re busy, but if that is the case, then give realistic pick up times. Whilst waiting it seemed that every door dash or Uber was ready on time to the frustration of a lot of people awaiting pick up. Won’t be back.

Been a loyal customer at this store for some time now and I must say it is one of the best in auckland , from the customer service to the last bite of the pizza this store has you covered on quality and affordability. Thankyou for looking after My pizza needs much love and respect .

Been regulars for a minute now, although we may not always order in, when we do it always feels familiar and it's always a nice visit. Always loved the vibe from the lady at the counter, she's super cool, hard worker, always greets and conversates w my children 😊 and we always love our pizzas when we do pop in 🙂✌️ can't forget the lava cakes 😂

Terrible service. Ordered pizzas online to pay on pick up got here to be told that they weren’t even made and that she confused me for someone else and didn’t make it til we got here. No point using the app if they are not going to acknowledge the request. Understand that some people order and not pick up but then don’t make it an option.

I absolutely love Japanese food, and Daruma Ramen is the best I’ve had so far in Auckland. We’ve been here so many times — it’s become our go-to place for dinner, and it never disappoints. The food is consistently delicious, authentic, and comforting. The service is always excellent, and I especially love the robot food server — such a fun and unique touch! The place itself is modest but very comfortable, which makes it even more welcoming.

Found the miso tonkatsu ramen to be mostly noodles and not much else. Miso soup wasn't that nice, old tasting perhaps which meant the miso tonkatsu ramen also not that great. The portion is a decent size and the noodles themselves are fresh. Not a great atmosphere, no windows, although robot bringing the food adds a little to the atmosphere. Rest of family happier with their food and it looked better. Avoid the miso ramen I would say. Don't think I'll go back
Delicious ramen I have ever had. First time to try a food here. Price is so reasonable. Love their service. Food was so delicious and a nice environment. Enjoyed a hot hot soup 🍜

We came just for a quick, humble feed but were still underwhelmed. The food was passable at best. The atmosphere is a cramped, crowded canteen-style eatery with cheap furnishings, decorations and cutlery… which would be totally fine if the food was good. Sadly, everything was awful. The ramen was the real disappointment though - a cloying, ill-textured puddle of blah with oversized fried chicken balls. Everything we ate was too sweet and/or strong yet with a shallow depth of flavours. The portions were also quite small for the prices (not that you’d want them any bigger). If it wasn’t a Monday we would have gone to ‘House of Ramen MEN-ICHI’ right around the corner where they serve delicious food at a cheaper price with bigger servings. Head there instead.
Very small amount of food. Credit card payment 2% surcharge. Everyday some dish half price is nice.

We recently purchased a butter chicken dish priced at $22, it contained just 4-pieces of chicken in the sauce. Basically we bought a bowl of source? The quality felt very disappointing and not worth the price at all. If the dish were priced at $25-$26 but included generous and high-quality ingredients, I believe people would still be willing to purchase it for the superior value.

An absolute disgrace of quality in food. Salty yet no flavour. This is most certainly my last time I’ll ever buy anything from this place. The staff seems to have a long yarn which seems due and of more importance then actually attending to the customer.

I ordered butter chicken and there was only 3 small piece chicken were inside and sauce was too wattery. Compare other indian restaurant in different shopping mall is much better. Also the Lady Who serve, never greet customer and keep throw a dish withinfood, folk and spoon. Never come back

I think this is not worth your money. The butter chicken tasted veeeery sweet. This isnt even butter chicken anymore. This is literally maple chicken. And just to say, paid 22 dollars for 4 pcs of chicken thats burnt.
Bought the goat curry but the meat was scarce, more bone than meat. Gravy was good though. Not sure if I will return as $22 is a rip off

Absolutely horrible service and I do not recommend. Recently I have visited and ordered 4 tanks for me and my family, while going through my drink something very hard came into my mouth and it was a plastic piece from idk what but expecting it to be from one of those plastic scoops. As seen in photo it was a very big piece and as soon as we noticed we all stopped drinking our drinks and complained through the customer service as we got it for takeaway. Got a refund for one drink but they said they are pretty sure other drinks would have been fine so they wouldn’t refund. I don’t know how you expected the others to keep drinking their drinks after seeing a big piece come out of a drink. This could have led to a serious health issue if I just swallowed it. Only posting this now as I was also disappointed with how Tank handled this process. Very disappointed as a long time tank fan.

Hands down, worst tank salad I've ever had. I feel ripped off. There is absolutely no guacamole! & no onion. Plain corn, not charred. Very bland 👎👎👎 I didn't put any special requests or changes. I would have gone back to tell them, but it wasn't til i drove all the way home & opened it that I saw. And they put the dressing only on the tortilla chips only. Who wants soggy chips?! I could have made better at home.

just wanted to say thank you for the smoothie I ordered day before yesterday in the evening.It was fresh, well-blended, and tasted great. I appreciate the quick service and attention to detail. Even only one indian lady was working and giving good attention to all customers. Thank again

In one of the drinks we ordered there was a piece of white plastic. It looked like it might’ve broken off a piece of equipment or scoop or something. Very dangerous and we were lucky we didn’t swallow it. Staff aren’t particularly friendly here and are very slow. Their stations don’t look that clean either. We made a complaint but nothing was really done except giving us a refund. Wouldn’t recommend coming to this branch at all - this place needs some management work.
I ordered the raw Lean’n Green salad with extra avocado, but it was very dry, with the dressing unevenly distributed. However, the Mega Green Smoothie was delicious.

Thankfully the food is still yummy as it’s always been. We’ve been coming to Lone star for years and it’s great that the food still tastes the same post pandemic. The waiters were lovely, made ordering our food and drinks easy and came to check in and see if we were enjoying the food. Shout out to our waitress Rachel for taking good care of me and my mum.

We came for a dinner on Sunday night. Atmosphere was chill as there wasnt much customers around. Staffs were friendly and amazing on services. Ordered pork ribs and taco, we don't prefer typical pork ribs with soft meats drenched with sweet BBQ sauces and the chef nailed it!
