Ribs were cooked perfectly, the sauce used was mainly smoky with mild sweetness. Prawns in taco tasted fresh and they blended well with the coleslaw. Straight cut potatoes were not oily and lightly salted. Overall, one of the best dining experiences we ever had. Will definitely visit again:))
Food and service was amazing. We were served by Rachel, and she was super friendly and helpful. We will definitely be coming back!!!

Came to botany lonestar in my black 2001 C5 corvette, 5.7 Litre V8 ,right hand drive which is actually very rare if you know about old school American cars which are usually left hand drive! Ribs were very good. Thank you to our server Jack!
Had booked an order online - takeaway. Very poor packaging leaked inside the bag. I love Lonestar didn’t expect this from Lonestar. Not worth it. Terrible shocking! Never again.

Been here 3 times in the last 3 months lol for birthday dinners and lunch. Yummy delicious tasty variety of food. Seating comfortable, plenty parking. Good customer service. Usually, go New Lynn, Royal oak Epsom sometimes Manukau. But since we came here, this branch is our preferred one when we feel like genghis khan. Thanks 😊

Always get good value for money from here, there’s a lot of options to choose from. The cooks are always very fast when cooking your meal, and there’s a great range of salads available. The pancakes and ice cream are a nice sweet treat at the end as well. The only thing is it can get pretty overcrowded in here.

♿ 🚻 There is wheelchair accessible access limited parking . My group was there early 6pm when doors were open. To get a parking near venue come early. The restaurant is large in size great for large groups. Spacious enough to move around freely . A large variety of sides.. I had butter chicken and tuna 🍣 to eat with my main meals meals 😋 . Seafood choices were fantastic with fish fillit as my favourite. No need to rush even when there's a lot of people. I found the food fresh and delicious. Staff promptly clearly your plates from your tables. Most definite good value for your money.

My sister and I ate there tonight as it was my Birthday. I can honestly say it was excellent food. Yummy, tasty, clean, well-lit, friendly service with a smile. I would recommend you all to enjoy Mongolian cuisine!

It was good- desperately needs automatic sauce dispensers for sauces as it’s time consuming to ladle them when the line moves fast. Not enough options for dessert and no bottomless drinks which is disappointing. Not clean either- windows are dirty. Wouldn’t recommend.

It was busy on a Friday night, but the food was made in good time and cooked fresh. When I asked about a missing box of spud fries, no issues and it was resolved quickly. The $12 kids meals are good value and you can just pay extra to swap the drinks. Check out the "Specials" as it's good value. Excellent quality and value

We received wrong takeaway order tonight. Lucky we live near the area. When we went back and told to the staff that they gave us the wrong order and the staff apologise and we got the right order. I think the staff should be careful and before attentive when they serving food especially if people live far away. It's not good to receive wrong food and the food are not cheap either. But the food was great and it's worth it. But unfortunately, we had our food bit cold due to the issue.
$9.70 for mango shake, not even 3 quarter full. Kumara fries less than half a box, soft and soggy. very disappointed.

Give hiring team a raise. The FOOD here is consistently AMAZING, staff are continually friendly. I hope they continue to hire great staff, makes the experience stand out 😊 Burgers are juicy and always made fresh ! Chips and ailo is to die for

Had a Bastard Burger and Kumera fries - could only eat half. Piping hot, delicious, quality ingredients. LOVE the extra thick, quality serviettes wspecially! Store clean and tidy; loved the jazz music playing and love the outdoor seating option.

First time here for Yum Cha but definitely not the last. No wait for a table & little wait for our Kai to start coming. I loved that we could quickly scan & order and that the online menu had photos of the dishes & was available in English. We ordered 8 different dishes which cost in excess of eighty dollars. Service was efficient & friendly. Our table was clean & the restaurant was also clean.

Unfortunately did not have the best experience, waited a long time for each meal to arrive. Each meal took about 15mins, it wasn’t a busy night but there were a couple of big families which could have caused the delay. By the time the next meal came our food became cold or we finished it because we were so hungry. Some dishes were tasty but definitely overpriced for the portion size. We ordered the sweet and sour pork regular $22 - as shown in the pictures, the bowl was bigger than the portion of food. It was tasty but so disappointing. Very deceiving!!! The spicy chicken had more chilli than chicken pieces and only skin parts. Again very small portion for the cost. The crab fried rice was $36 as you can tell from the image the bowl is deceiving. Maybe enough for 2 people. The dimsum was not as tasty as the other spots we have been too! Must say the sweet and sour was very nice. Other meals were average and pricey. Highly recommend the sweet sour and get the larger size even if it’s just 2 people. You’ll probably get about 8 good 8 good pieces with the regular 😂 Guttered we didn’t enjoy it because it’s so close to home and we’re hoping to make it our regular dimsum spot but maybe another time might be better experience?

Conveniently located with plenty of parking in the vicinty of the restaurant. Nice and clean, new, modern looking restaurant. Friendly staff. Most of the food we ordered was good, especially the sesame balls, coriander + shrimp dumplings. The prawn rice rolls however, had an unusual taste & the prawn at the ends of the rice rolls were cold.. fancy looking desserts at the counter area. Overall a good dine in experience. We paid ~$85 for 3 people
The food is sooo goood especially the Prawn Dumplings. Service was good didnt take long gave our order in and good came out. I will definitely go back here again

First time here for our Secret Santa Lunch, the food was amazing, efficient service, shortest waiting time on food, staff were very accommodating, table was cleared, excellent & friendly customer service, spacious, reasonably priced, spent just over $300 for 4x people.

Ordered A Limo Box over the phone and the indian lady there was taking my order then when I was still ordering she hung up on me. Man she pissed me off I rung up again and said to her you hung up on me what service is that??? Dannemora Pizza Hut you need to train your staff in how to work under pressure and be serviceable to everyone. Practice your customer service skills too.

We’ve been regulars at this Pizza Hut for a while now, and the staff here truly make every visit feel special. They always greet us with a smile and have taken the time to remember not just our names, but even our pizza preferences! It’s that kind of personal touch that keeps us coming back. The service is consistently friendly, quick, and attentive. Huge thanks to the whole team—you’ve turned a simple pizza outing into something we always look forward to. Keep up the great work!
Very helpful staff and customer service with a smile. Didn’t wait long at all. Ordered the Limo, was excellent.
This is my local Pizza Hut. The ppl here are friendly, it’s a standard pizza still delicious. Their new Kit Kat range is interesting

My family ordered 6 pizzas tonight, pick up was for 5.30pm- didn’t get order close to 6pm and what a disappointment the pizzas hardly any toppings on them or next to nothing…not hot soooo disappointed - Hawaiian pizza just more or less the base only as you can see in the picture, we have had many pizzas from here, and always been so good so not sure what’s happened here… $65 for our order but what a waste of money…. What happened to your food and your service

One of the best subs iv had in awhile. The size and quality was impressive compared to other subway stores around auckland now days. Excellent work and id highly recommend others to this subway in botany. Also the place was very tidy.

Today, my mother and I visited the store to get our usual Subway order. However, we had an upsetting experience with one of the staff members. When we requested the white strip chicken, we were instead given buffalo chicken. When we pointed out the mistake, the staff member responded rudely, insisting we had indicated the wrong item. She then raised her voice and made comments that felt emotionally distressing. Unfortunately, the interaction seemed to be influenced by bias related to our race, which was deeply hurtful. We hope that this staff member can receive appropriate training on respectful customer service and cultural sensitivity to prevent similar situations in the future.

One star for service! This is the saddest footlong I've ever eaten in Subway 😟 This was my first time at this branch. I’ve visited and eaten at different Subway locations, but the service here wasn’t what I expected. At other branches, when I buy a Subdog footlong, I can choose my own bread, veggies, and sauce. But here, —even if I asked— staff said they only offer white bread, onions, and pickles if buying only subdog. When I asked to add for some olives, the staff gave me a few but sneered at me! Talk about being rude 😏

Most of the employees do a good job with putting enough salad in the sub. However, 1 lady really makes no effort and barely puts 3 slices of tomatoes and cucumber in a foot long. I'll ask for her name the next time but don't let her get away with it if you go in store to order. I was graceful the 1st 2 times I noticed, but today I just told her to put sufficient amounts. She barely did even then. @Subway - you have increased your prices and your employees have reduced the quantity. Please train your employees to not be stingy with salads. The customer is paying a lot for what's currently offered.

Worst service and poorly made sandwiches. I saw their Subdog thing being advertised in the store so I decided to get one. What a regret, looks nothing like the ads. There were jalapenos or something in the photos but I got none so I questioned the staff, they said it's not recommended to have them! The heck I didn't even get the option to choose??? Absolute dogs**t service here. I also sent a formal complaint two weeks but have had no reply.

The food is good, and the staff are friendly. The karaoke is very loud where it feels like your ears are going to explode. They have a nice space out the front and a huge room at the back for karaoke and functions etc. There's also a slots room near the bar. My last few experiences wernt the best and I am a local, I will update if my experiences change.
First timer, nice place, 👍 clean, friendly staff and the food was great 👍
Great atmosphere. Friendly staff. Big meals!
We go for karaoke Friday it's easy going the system isn't bad and you don't have to wait too long for a jam. Staff is pleasant and the DJ's play some good jams.
Very cool little pub, makes you feel like your in England...2 X Sirloin steak meals for $30

Can someone tell me do they really have cocktails????? 😅😅😅I’ve seen the reviews photos and very interested in their cocktails even it shows 4yrs ago. But the staff told us they do not have cocktails even a menu. Pls change ur sign on here don’t misunderstand other people anymore
Great bar like going back to the 80s ,raffles jukebox pool table and friendly people
Such a warm friendly bar manager . Happy to keep the beers flowing while listening to the duke box and catching up with friends after a hard days work. This place has the hum.
Popular locals bar in East Tamaki. All the standard attractions, juke box, pool, TAB etc. Limited parking outside. Happy hour.
Nice and friendly bar. We are really enjoyed our jug of beers and playing darts there

Bought a regular salad bowl. Serving was half the normal serving in other branches, I asked the lady to add more salad and she said it was more than enough - it was like 3 tablespoons. Lady was so rude, asked for my receipt and she said she couldnt find it in the trash. Ive contacted Subway’s customer service and advise they will send a replacement voucher but never did.

Small portion sizes, cold food and incorrect following of instructions. If you're holding a promotion and I'm pointing to the poster on the window, that should give you clear understanding of what I'm after. Better luck at a different chain resteraunt!

We ordered in store only to realise at paying the 6inch was $4 more compared to other stores / their online order system? For Example 6 inch Pork Riblet - $12.20 or Footlong $16.70 On the app the same Sub is $8.50 or $13.60 for the footlong. How are they marking up their in-store prices compared to every other store, very disappointed and completely ripped off.
Pricing is insane $12.20 for the cheapest 6 inch, it is $4 cheap at any other subway. They also don’t do sub of the day. I would avoid this subway
Veg subs and toasties are usually around $4 more expensive compared to other options. Just a heads-up—the owner tends to charge extra, so please double-check the pricing.

Saw this new place popped up so decided to give it a try. The fried chicken is really good, especially the cream onion one. The sauce isn't too sweet and chicken isnt too oily (unlike some other Korean fried chicken). Would give it 5 star if they had chicken pieces rather than just chicken wings. Overall quite good. Probably will come back again in future.
Surprisingly generous lunch portions of delicious sushi. Was great for lunch small place, better to take away BUT... excellent parking. Defo a plus for in and out lunch 😊
Food is yummy and service is great! My kids loved the sushi! And I always enjoy a bowl of hot ramen soup in the cold weather.

Finally found a hidden treasure place in the east of Auckland!! Toshi Sushi... The super-size filling sushi, beautiful hot dishes, reasonable price, and the taste are fantastic. You can choose from a variety of sushi as you like. I strongly recommend that you come and try it.

The food is great! They are bigger than other places and the fillings are fresh and so good!! They have variety of sushi and meals like Poke, Donburi and salad so highly recommanded!! Apperently Uber is available so try uber as well!!

This place is THE PLACE. If you’re craving sushi this IS THE PLACE. Food? MOUTHWATERING. Service? SUPER KIND SUSHI LADIES. Atmosphere? COZY, LOCAL, SUSHI ATMOSPHERE. The ingredients are super fresh, the taste is immaculate, the workers are the sweetest people on the planet. If you want sushi, this is THE PLACE

California prawn is amazing!! 2025 update- I no longer work in the area so I visited after a couple of years and the California prawn is still one of the best in Auckland. Great service, the staff are happy and smiley. Tried the katsu chicken sushi with sweet chili sauce and it was amazing. Plenty of parking out front.

Fantastic spot for a quick sushi fix 🍣🍱🍙🍛🍜 Excellent range, good quality ingredients, great prices and delicious miso! Loads of parking and they have really made the effort to make it nice to dine in. Unexpected haven in an industrial area for some good food.
Fresh food, lovely staff, wonderful shop
At a time when prices are high these days, The food here is cheap and delicious. For less than $20 a meal, it's a lot and fresh.It is a restaurant that I always eat when I visit around here.

This place is such a hidden gem, which if I'm being honest I wanted to keep hidden - but that's being selfish. The atmosphere, the cosy décor with thoughtful touches, the food, the service, just everything! They serve a diverse range of foods, including authentic South African dishes like bunny chow, biltong and vetkoek, packed with flavour and served in generous portions. There's something for everyone. The coffee art is adorable, so skip the takeaway cup and enjoy it there. It was my sister’s birthday when we visited last, and they surprised her with a slice of cake on the house. The service is always warm and personal, and as a local who’s been here multiple times, it never disappoints. Prices are very fair for the quality, and it’s perfect for a relaxed brunch or a catch up with friends. Must visit!

They offer a great selection of South African snacks and delicious homemade biltong — a real treat if you’re craving authentic flavors. The front desk lady was super friendly and helpful in explaining everything to us. The meals were unique and full of character.

Probably the first time in New Zealand where the coffee is served and stayed hot the whole time..the very reason I always prefer a takeaway cup. The Bunny Chow was excellent and so was the chicken and mushroom pie..the service was awesome too!! Definitely recommended and will surely come back..

Had a wonderful Sunday brunch here, the staff were absolutely amazing so friendly and happy, was busy but the food wait wasn’t too long. Mocha was best I’ve had in a long time with a cute picture on the top!! Grabbed some Durban curry biltong and a few SA grocery items!!! Will be coming back to try their bunny chow!!!

Such a hidden gem!! Been several times for brunches and lunches, and they never disappoint. Such lovely kind staff, and delicious food and coffee. Food and coffee is always consistent which I love, and the atmosphere is clean, modern, spacious and tidy. Highly recommend 👍🩷

It's 50/50 at this place, I've been coming here for the last 9months. Burgers, wedges and chips are worth it, containers are good except for the macaroni can give you a sore stomach and you'll need to use the loo asap *myself and my co workers have had this happen. Wouldn't recommend the sandwiches as they often taste old of have little filling or the pirs as they are just Irvine pies in a different bag for $4 🤦🏾. The toasties are good. The butter shicken is just hot tomato soup* beware you may also get crook from this. Coffee is good 40% of the time. The customer service could be better, it has improved since this last lockdown. Also they do sell cigarettes although they have a sign claiming they don't *only packs of 20s

The sandwiches were soggy and small with little fillings. This was from the 6 different sandwiches I saw for 5.50. The hot chips I bought had a fishy taste to it to presume it was cooked in a used oil. Wouldn't recommend and definitely not returning.
I was hungry so I ordered a lot of food, and it surprisingly came out at a very lower price than expected, the pies were nice, but the chicken burger is definitely a must try.
The spicy chicken burger is top tier for a lunch bar burger, worth a visit.
Nice family service. Good pies.

Usually I follow suggestions given by customers and as I was near 9 Bows I decided to give it a go. What a great choice! By the decorations, I am supposing that this is more Korean than Japanese, because of the wonderful menu and the internal sitting design. Order and paid in advance from the counter and waited roughly 15min. Loved the garlic Korean fried chicken set, with some pickles, salad and fries. Lots of parking when I arrived at 11.30. Quite interesting books to read while waiting. Will come back again hopefully soon. Thanks for the great service!

Found this place through a Google search. Realised when I got there that it's technically two restaurants in one. We ordered from both menus and were quite impressed with both the quality and the quantity of food. I really appreciated the fact that the milk and fruit teas came in glasses rather than plastic cups. Will definitely come back here in the future!

A nice little hidden gem in the industrial area. This place offers a wide range of Japanese and Korean food. From teriyaki chicken to Korean fried chicken and healthier options such as poke bowls. Portion is fairly generous, great value for money. Taste is great, though the Korean fried chicken can get quite spicy - so be careful when you’re ordering!

Discovered from Tiktok (where i’m finding most of my food rec’s these days) and it was 10/10 👏🏼 we got the honey butter chicken and garlic soy and they were both divine. can’t wait to try the spicy next time! The waffles fries were also lovely as well as the prawn dumplings. I will be back!

Been once so far. Super fan of both Korean and Japanese cuisine so I loved the menu! It had great options for the whole family - healthy poke bowls, indulgent donuts, sashimi, noodles, and more. They also had a lot of drink variety, including coffee - which is my jam. Definitely going back to try more options.

Love trying new spots that offer Korean fried chicken. The platter here was great and all the flavours were yum too. Was suprised at how cheesy and yummy the corn was too. Great spot, heaps of seating and friendly staff

So I ordered Uber eats from here and man was I disappointed 😂 the shoestring fries cost $14 for a really small portion and it was stale. The boneless kfc chicken I ordered was mostly chicken skin 🤦🏾‍♀️

Great lil spot... definitely worth giving it a try. If you like spicy chicken, ask for "extra spicy" 😉. The vibe and ambiance is warm, welcoming and friendly. The retro decor is real cool too. From Japanese Bowls to Korean Fried Chicken, it's a spot that's bound to be one you come back to.
Ordered on Ubereats. The food was rancid, stale, and tasted like it was gone off..smelt really bad too. Really disappointed and disgusted! Food safety a big NO NO. Felt sick after just 1 bite

Dined in and the fried chicken was cold and tasted old. It definitely had been sitting for a while. Teriyaki Salmon "salad" was only shaved cabbage swimming in a watery sesame dressing. The fish itself was definitely old and tasted rancid. Would not recommend at all.
Great food variety , friendly owner
Really nice hot chips, so fresh yum

My wife and I would come here nearly everyday when we were still working in Auckland. The owners are really awesome people. He learnt exactly what we wanted over time and when we walked in he'd have my Hawaiian Chicken Burger, a toasty and a Samosa all ready to go. Their food was always amazing and really well priced. Will definitely be back when we're up in Auckland again. All the best mate!

Good fried chicken. Burgers and chips are very good. My favourite is the steak burger. They have a selection of sandwiches, cakes and slices aswell as salads. Pies, breakfast buritos and sausages aswell as fried rice, dumplings and full on meals like korean bbq with rice, presented in giant size bowls. Recommend you try this place if you like your fried chicken or dumplings.
Support local! I can deff recommend the steak burger, chicken burger and also the BBQ rice meals are very good. Price will make to order too. Very well priced.
Good pies i recommend the steak and cheese, chip's/fries are good to. A bit expensive on some of their food items, compared to other takeaways!
Great food and price, perfect for a quick meal from a lunch bar.

The new owner is an absolute machine. Good food selection, drinks. The prices are much nicer than most. With an ever expanding menu so people don't get bored of the same food like the locals. The grilled chicken salad is amazing. For breakie at 7am is darn good. Less costly than Coffee Club and is near identical quality. On the Ciabatta and the bacon just works. Considering how mediocre some of the local lunchbars have ended up now, easily make this place a one stop for a good time. At 7 in the morning, you just want your food and coffee, no glaring accents, annoying motion sensors or be reminded where the bin is constantly.

My go to lunch bar in East Tamaki , there is a new owner and they have definitely changed the scene with great foods and even better service. PS: for all my South African brothers and sisters … they make Vetkoek and Mince here and I highly reccomend, I was blown away on how good it was. (Was going to add a photo but got to excited and it’s gone)
This place is great for a cheap and cheerful coffee, egg sandwich, even curry! We recommend.
Been there twice and have not been disappointed. Truly a hidden gem with wonderful people.

Really enjoyed the new breakfast menu, i have tried Dosa with Paya, chicken biryani and Mutton curry- All of which i highly recommend. the food AMAZING you could taste the freshly ground masala, compared to other places the food was clearly organic with no nasties added. There were so many more delicious options on the menu i was just too full to try them! Will keep coming often

We arrived at 2.30pm and the cabinets were rather bare, which was a tad disappointing as we travelled there specifically to pick up some sushi having seen the photos on Google, and arrived an hour and a half before closing (4pm). They do make sushi to order, but we weren’t keen for a long wait. I understand the ‘lunch economy’ set up - but they don’t compensate by offering discounts for having to eat the left overs. Other places combine the pieces they need to sell into packs and offer generous discounts (like Sushi World in East Tāmaki - where we drove to next).
Went here because Wolfy’s next door was packed, had the katsu lunch box and the miso ramen. Delicious! The lunch box was huge, everything was fresh and delicious. Fast and friendly service
The packaging is so terrible, all my soup are running out. No more soup with my udon
The best teriyaki chicken on rice in the world! If u find better elsewhere come and tell me, I'll firmly remind you that you are wrong. Staff are also cute

Run by a friendly family of Koreans, they serve a great range of delicious Japanese lunch cuisine. Slightly expensive, but their donburis are very well made; otherwise a buffet range of sushi can be selected in-store. Would recommend!
Effective services. We have the Bento. The ingredients are fresh, the set has good variety. Yummy.
Pretty good. Cater more towards takeaway, so no water unless you asked.
Bento box was awesome, miso good too. Would recommend!
Nice little Sushi place tucked away behind the main rd ..clean & tidy shop Sushi reasonably priced
Beautiful day for sushi

The best lunch bar in industry area. We chose the best time to go which was surprisingly not busy but wonderful, friendly service and the food was fresh. Can't go wrong with fresh burgers and fresh fries 😋 🍔🍟

It's a little bakery/food bar in the middle of an industrial estate, catering mainly to the working crowd. The food is pretty good, and the service is friendly. The main drawback is timing your visit so there's still plenty of food there. It's very popular, so there's often a queue.
Needed a nice quick lunch. Big burger and tasty too. Thank you.
Great place if you want a quick bite. Ordered a chicken burger that was hot and fresh. Good taste.
Good service, delicious food, hot food available, and many options of food to choose from. Good coffee The location was good. Open early.

Perfect place for dinner, party, functions, drinks and food. Friendly staff. Plenty of parking. Spacious sitting and separate halls options for DJ and celebrations. Awesome service by manager, Parul, thanks to her to make our dinner special every time we go to gymkhana.

Second visit: been 6 months and we attended another function here last night We were Initially served Luke warm chicken in the starters (1st batch) 2nd batch was hot, nothing was great Fried fish was so orange it looked like it had radiation, the Manchurian was like eating glue flour balls, rest of the starters left nothing to desire. Mains: horrible tasteless dishes, I tried everything except the goat Under seasoned, no flavour and full of food colouring. Pretty hard to get a dhal wrong… even that was terrible. 1st visit: Food was ok, nothing to sing home about, the Manchurian looked like rasgulla syrup, not sure what that was all about and the fish was very over battered Mains only lamb and naans were tasty, the other dishes were below par

Held a birthday at Gymkhanna in Botany on a Saturday. Amazing food, plenty for the guests. Service at bar was great as well. Definitely recommend to hold an event. P.S cleanest toilets I've seen at a venue 😅😂

I came here last week, when ordering food I was told by the waitress to write my own order down???!!! The staff should be able to know the menu if they are being hired without the customers having to write down their own order and hand it to the waitress. She was also was not very friendly. First time coming here and I did not enjoy the customer service at all.

The restaurant has an ambience of its own which create’s the Raviz a bit different from others. And the staff is very dedicated and also very careful towards their work. My partner is allergic to nuts and we told the staff about it, they made our food but nut free and really good and also would always love to go Raviz. Kuddos to the team.

First time trying out Afghan food, it was actually not too bad at all! We had the 3 combination Meat with Nan which was great, I reckon the Nan is slightly thick. but I would prefer the sauce to have slightly have more flavor. Desert, I had an oreo milkshake, 10/10! Love it!
Great service and very nice traditional food. Just one downfall is that the lamb needs to be cooked a little bit more. But overall very nice experience with the entire family.

We were quite disappointed with the experience. The food was tasteless, and it was clear that the plates used were not washed properly. The presentation online, especially on TikTok, is misleading — it definitely didn’t live up to the hype. I wouldn’t recommend this place. We also visited the toilets, and they were not up to standard; there were health and safety concerns, including broken mirrors that hadn’t been fixed. Very poor customer service. The only good thing is there portions were decent.

The food is good no doubt but today I’m here to post about the quantity of sauce and salad they provide. Are you kidding? You just give me this much for 3 wraps and one kebab meal with 2 extra kebabs???? I even mentioned it in the instructions that please provide some more as we are 4 people. You are charging so much for the food please provide the condiments as per the price you charge!!!!!!!!

had an absolutely wonderful experience at Kabul house Restaurant! From the moment I walked in, the warm and inviting atmosphere made me feel right at home. The staff were incredibly welcoming, attentive, and professional — they truly went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect. The food was simply outstanding! Every dish was beautifully presented and bursting with flavor. You can tell the chefs put genuine care and creativity into each plate. Whether you're after a casual bite or a full dining experience, Kabul house delivers both quality and comfort in every bite. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a memorable meal and excellent service. I'll definitely be returning soon!

I celebrated my birthday last July 10 at Korea Top BBQ. I asked if they offer any birthday discounts—even though I knew it’s not really a common thing here—but to my surprise, they offered me a private room, since I made a reservation three days in advance. The customer service was outstanding—the staff were friendly, attentive, and very accommodating. And the food? Absolutely amazing! Everything was so flavorful, fresh, and genuinely authentic. The meat was tender and well-marinated, the side dishes were plenty and delicious, and the overall dining experience was worth every dollar. I highly recommend it—especially if you're celebrating something special!

We had our club’s half yearly function at a newly opened Korean BBQ buffet in eastern suburbs finally, the eastern suburbs have a solid all-you-can-eat option. The restaurant is newly renovated, with great ventilation and air purifiers, which really help keep the smoke down and the space comfortable. The meats are mostly fresh cuts and they also offer seafood like shrimp and squid. There’s a fun ramen machine with Shin Ramyun and a shaved ice machine with canned fruits and syrups — nice extra touches that everyone enjoyed. The sushi is classic Korean-style with a good variety and overall, the dining experience was enjoyable and hassle-free. The Korean manager was so friendly and welcoming , we really loved their service. It’s definitely a welcome addition to the east and far more convenient than driving to the North Shore.

Had the pleasure of checking out 'Korea Top BBQ' last night. Decent food. Nice aesthetic to it. Clean and tidy. Friendly staff who were always happy to check in and keep thibgs going well. It was quiet as we went on a Tuesday night not long after they opened. Would definitely go again!

Great place for people who are Westernized! Korean Top BBQ offers a fantastic dining experience with a variety of delicious options that cater well to those who enjoy Korean flavors with a Western-friendly touch. The selection of meats is excellent, well-marinated, and high quality, ensuring a flavorful barbecue experience. The main foods are plentiful and consistently refilled by the attentive staff, who are always on top of keeping the table stocked. The service is fast and efficient, making sure that customers never have to wait long for anything. The atmosphere is lively and welcoming, perfect for both first-timers and those familiar with Korean BBQ. Whether you’re grilling cuts of beef, pork, or squid, or indulging in the various hot dishes available, there’s always something satisfying to try. There are shaved ice for you to make and customize to your own taste. And also has a station to make your own ramen too. Overall, it’s a great spot for groups, families, and anyone looking to enjoy a fun and interactive meal. Highly recommended!

It's great to have another KBBQ place in East Auckland. Korea Top BBQ definitely have top quality bbq meat. The cooked food is also great, especially the k chicken. I can see most people enjoying the bingsu, but for me, the bbq choices are the best for this restaurant. Highly recommended.

I am surprised that this restaurant has no reviews because it is very yummy! Lots of good Chinese dishes. The salted yolk soft shell crab is great if you like salted yolk, the beef is good too and the spicy chicken (口水鸡). The dishes are large size and the soup was very big. The restaurant has a good design and very spacious. It is well kept up and extremely clean. The aircon is very nice. Staff super friendly!

The ingredients are fresh, the taste is good, the environment is good, the hygiene is good, and the service is especially good! The private room is large and luxurious and you can sing! The hall can hold banquets! ! ! Highly recommended! ! !

We were there to celebrate our friend KD's son's first birthday, and what a night it was! The ambience, the arrangements, the food . everything was absolutely top-notch. Truly, what a vibe! If you're looking for that classic Delhi party vibe right here in New Zealand, this is the place to be."

I wanted to take a moment to express my sincere appreciation for the outstanding service provided by Ramandeep Kaur Dhillon during my visit to Jack N Jill last night. Your attentiveness, professionalism, and warm smile made our dining experience truly memorable. Your ability to anticipate our needs and deliver prompt, courteous service was impressive. The way you handled our requests with a smile and a positive attitude was truly commendable. Thank you for providing exceptional food service and making our evening at Jack N Jill so enjoyable.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Absolutely loved our experience at Jack n Jill in Auckland! The vibe and atmosphere are amazing – warm, stylish, and perfect for a relaxed meal. The food was top-notch – every dish was packed with flavour and beautifully presented. From starters to dessert, everything was delicious and fresh. The service was equally impressive – friendly, attentive, and made us feel truly welcomed. Highly recommend this spot if you’re looking for a great dining experience in Auckland!

Firstly, great thumbs up for the live music though It would pay to invest in better speakers and perhaps a sound engineer as you are doing disservice to the singers. Service was somewhat poor as they seemed to struggle to cater for a large table. Foods ok but at the prices advertised, it is on the high mark. Ended up with hardly any food. Ripoff

Service - Staff is a bit insensitive. Lol, few of them were having sheesha (which is great, but sometimes customers need some attention) Food - Food is very very over priced for the quantity served and no rice is served with it. Only curry served in small bowls. I ordered rum, it was just 10 ml lol two teaspoons may be!! Atmosphere - Cold, staff advised us to keep the doors open. Dont waste time, find something else, there is plenty to choose in Auckland these days!

It isn’t what it used to be… There seems to be a change of ownership. Hells Pizza Botany used to be amazing with friendly staff and tasty pizza but not anymore. The pizza base tasted stale and the toppings and sauce were minimal. Hells pizza never used to be like this. Had been coming here for over 10 years but I won’t be back.

The wait time from ordering to picking up the pizza was short, and the service was friendly. The pizzas were well-cooked with fresh ingredients, which I appreciated. However, both pizzas tasted a bit bland, perhaps the base sauce was missing, too light, or the seasoning just needed a boost. A little more flavour would’ve made a big difference.

I thought school lunches were bad, today mine came from Hell (Botany Downs). We placed an online order for work and I was impressed when it was delivered at the time we asked. Although the Delivery Driver ended up at the wrong building entry, the food was hot and smelt yummy! Everyone enjoyed their pizzas and I was the only one who had ordered the Chicken Demon pasta. Unfortunately when I removed the foil covering from my meal, my first question was "where is the rest of the pasta"? (see photos). I thought I was doing the right thing by contacting the store immediately/ directly and asked if there was an email address or someone I could send my photos through to, because my meal didn't look right. But I was told that they didn't need to see my photos but that this is what it is meant to look like and there was nothing that could be done. The Staff member who I was speaking with, was apologetic but couldn't do anything without authority from his Manager. He said he would contact the Manager for advice on how to handle this one and call me back within the hour. He called back and said the Manager said they couldn't do anything for me. When they prepared this meal, the pasta is all on one side and they have to spread it out in the tray, so there would be gaps in the corners of the tray because the food may not have been spread out enough. This feedback was given to me even though THEY HAD NOT SEEN THE PHOTO OF WHAT MY PASTA MEAL LOOKED LIKE. If you see the photos, it looks like someone has scooped out part of the meal right? So no pasta lunch for me today and I had pretty much wasted my money to be honest. Food is in the bin now, I couldn't eat something that looks like someone else has taste tested first. Then no joy dealing directly with Hell Pizza Botany Downs either. So here I go with my Google review and other reviews that I will post anywhere & everywhere else, because the way this was handled was poor service 100%. p.s we spent about $100 on this online order. Tax Invoice# 58965813
The owner was extremely rude. The pizza had no cheese, no toppings and burnt.disgusting! Absolutely dry bread. Learn how to treat your customers better lady.
Fast service, friendly staff. my order is ready under in12 minutes. We always get the Lust Deluxe as it really taste delicious.

Amazing place to dine in. Lovely seating area , comfortable chairs and person that served us was friendly, attentive and caring . The drinks and food were yummy . Each curry tasted different, chef's spices are top notch . Came to celebrate Dads birthday and we had a great feed . Thank you at team Raja's 🙏. Parking is also great if you got elderly parents that can't walk far . Top rating cos they deserve it .

This Indian restaurant offers rich, flavorful dishes at very reasonable prices. The curries are aromatic and full of depth, and the naan is fresh and soft. Every dish is well-prepared and satisfying. The service is excellent—friendly, attentive, and fast. A great place to enjoy authentic Indian cuisine without breaking the bank. Highly recommended!

I visited this place for the first time. First thing to admire is the lady who accommodated us. Very pretty and caring. I enjoyed my meals. The tastes were up to my craving taste buds 😋. Lovely ambient. Thanks to the whole staff for putting in such efforts.

I love this place so much! The food is authentically delicious, the atmosphere is wonderful, and the staff is super friendly and welcoming. I felt bad when we last dined because we didn't realize that they were closing for the afternoon! But the lady that served us was accommodating 😇 The food was splendid and the Naan bread was freshly cooked. I can't get enough of this restaurant. Will definitely be back for our family dinner and or date night. Thank you 🩷
The food was delicious! The server/front of house was pleasant and even made recommendations of food to try for next time Nice and clean too
Good service and good looking food. Tasty !!!

Food is average. The main problem is the service. No one clean the tables so I have to do it myself. When asked them to help they said they are too busy. Close to work but unfortunately I won’t go back again.
It's very authentic sichuan food in botany mall
Bad review cost me $40

Ordered 1 doz wings and large coleslaw with Uber eats tonight. The size of some of the wings were literally the smallest I’ve ever seen. They supposed to be basted in their famous spicy seasoning but instead it was more like drenched in spicy oil. The presentation was not very appearing either. The coleslaw tasted like any other prepacked slaw from the supermarket with some mayo. Sorry but next time I will rather kfc it to satisfy my fried chicken cravings. The extra star is for very fast Uber delivery.

This is mostly intended for the mangers or owners. We ordered a fairly well rounded selection, we had -pulled pork burger -beef cheeseburger -spicy chicken burger -wings -chips But this has left us wishing we cooked this all ourselves The pork burger didn't have much of a BBQ (or any) flavour to it, the beef cheeseburger had tough chewy patties when they're supposed to melt in your mouth, the chicken burger had the flavour of old fry oil, the chips were not crisp and had no salt, the wings were nibbles and had NO seasoning at all. Its disappointing because there is SO. MUCH. POTENTIAL. HERE. Add BBQ seasoning to your pulled pork Cook your beef patties for less time or add breadcrumb and egg to make them less chewy/more foolproof Change out your oil or have a separate deep fry for the chicken burgers, Add literally any seasoning (Cajun, salt&pepper, kfc, chicken salt, anything) to the wings Cook the chips at a higher temp and actually salt them. These are simple items, please work on making them as best as you can And you'll have some 5☆ food on your menu.

Ordered via Uber Eats. The hoagies were small, burnt, under seasoned and looked nothing like the photos. They weren't cheap either! Really disappointing and won't be ordering again. They get two stars instead of one because the chips very really good.

Food was really bad, burger bun was dry and burnt. The bun top was even a different bun to the bottom, like they didn't have enough buns to go around. Chicken burger was dry and overcooked. Burger bun was visibly burnt, is there no quality control?? Chips, trash, overcooked and oily, just gristly Pulled pork burger was dry Congratulations, one of the worst eating experiences in years.

Worst Chicken wings I've ever ordered. Wings are so tiny presentation is bad.. and the price is too much! Home cooked or chinese takeaway is even better than this. Not worth it. Not recommending this restaurant.

Asked for all salad EXCEPT onion and jalapeño. Instead this $17 hard dry chicken kebab was loaded with onion. NO SALAD. absolute joke. I would have taken it back had I not driven back to work. A refund would be good at this point as it obviously ended up in the trash.

I am a big big fan of kebab. I always prefer eating chicken on rice or no carb kebab. Being health conscious I always eat healthy whenever I am out so kebab is one of the option. I wouldn’t say it was one of the best but nevertheless it was good. I always go to taza. In Wellington I have numerous kebab place that I go to but now I have another kebab place, now in botany. Thank :)
A young skinny Indian man served me with the worse skull sour face! Aged mid 20s We are customers and we don’t owe him for buying food! In fact, without us he won’t have a job!

Hi, I did send a message via your website Contact Us form but have received no reply so here goes with the review. We placed an online order on 21st March for delivery 11:45am that day - total about $80, which included a $11.60 delivery fee. I received a phone call from the store at 11:47am to say the Driver who was meant to deliver to us, had taken the wrong order and so my order was still at the store. They asked me if I had details for the delivery driver and to ask them to return back to the store to pick up the right order. Told them that no, I don't have any details. So they were going to arrange for another Uber driver to pick up my order for delivery. At 12:06pm, the store called to say our order had just been picked up and delivery would be in about 10-15mins time. I then get a phone call from the Delivery Driver at 12:25pm and then received my order around 12:30pm So not only was our lunch break over by then but unfortunately the food was cold and unappetising. We requested delivery at 11:45am, so our food would have been made about an hour before it was actually delivered to us :(. I would have expected that we would get SOME compensation for their error and/ or even our food being remade so that it would be enjoyable? But nothing .....

Wow I wished I looked at the reviews before ordering. Horrible food and the service was trash. The guy openly sneezing all over my food while preparing it! $27 for something I could make better at home.

The food is consistently fresh, and they never cut corners when it comes to ingredients. For a mall location, and in terms of customer service overall, this store really stands out — it’s some of the best service I’ve experienced from any fast food brand. The lady at the counter is always attentive to my requests and ensures my food is prepared exactly to order. This store truly represents the brand at its best.

I kindly ask please to be clear about the sizes of the meals you are suggestively selling. Especially when you do not differentiate clearly between a regular and large meal which can be misleading to a new customer and keep suggesting a larger meal which costs more. Meals tend to get cold upon serving, not sure If it's the atmosphere or the timing of service affects this.

It's been a while since I visited an LJ's. It's always pretty good, though I do usually go for the same thing - basic fish n chips. The service here is quick and friendly, and the food well cooked, although I probably had too much as usual.

This was a delicious meal. The seafood platter was thoroughly enjoyed. The server was patient and helpful with our requests. The food court was clean and we easily found a table. We have been here several times and not been disappointed.
Delicious food but was more happy with the service that we received last Saturday 14th of June, from the young man that was working that day. Thank you and great job.

Commons in Botany Centre is a fantastic spot for a memorable meal—whether it’s a date night or a casual hangout with friends. The restaurant’s stylish, intimate ambiance sets the perfect mood. Highlights: 🍤 Weekend Seafood Boil – A generous platter of fresh prawns, mussels, crab, and more, served in a rich, flavorful broth. The garlic bread for dipping? Absolute perfection. 🍔 Spicy Beef Burger – Juicy, thick patty with a delicious kick, paired with a soft brioche bun. One of the best burgers I’ve had! Seafood boils needs a bit to prepare, which was advised by the staff. It is totally fine for us. Highly recommend for seafood lovers and burger enthusiasts alike!

I've been coming here for a while now, and what keeps me coming back is the consistent quality of the food. The steaks are always well-prepared, the pasta is perfectly cooked, and the cocktails are amazing. What really stands out, though, are the smashed potatoes — honestly, some of the best I've ever had! The staff are friendly and very accommodating. The only downside is the wait time for food, which can be a bit long even when it’s not busy. That said, the food is definitely worth the wait.

Fried chicken was nice and juicy, flavourful and easy to eat due to the tenderness - sauce wasn't too heavy too Friendly service and good atmosphere, music playing and sports streaming on the screen but not too loud so doesn't overpower any conversation! Which is quite rare to see at these kinds of establishments... Grab a few drinks and the bill could add up quite fast though...!

#fastfoodfriday and #foodiebumz crews checked out the old Cock 'n' Bull now trading as Botany Commons. Staff were friendly and food was fine. While I wouldn't call it an amazing dining experience I would definitely say we had nothing to complain about. A nice variety tonight with medium rare and well done steaks to seafood Spaghetti and pork belly. An all round pleasant evening. Nice job Bottany Commons 👍🤙 2nd visit tonight 1/8/2025... meals were lovely and I would've loved to have had some sticky date pudding however no staff returned to check if we wanted any. Ah well

We really enjoyed the food and the cozy atmosphere on a cold winter’s night, but unfortunately, we left feeling discriminated against. I hate to pull the “brown card,” but tonight it felt necessary. We were the first to arrive but the last to be served. We finished eating before others, yet our table wasn’t cleared until we got up to leave. While we understood it was a busy night and gave the staff the benefit of the doubt, it was hard to ignore that we were the only two brown girls in the room and seemed to receive noticeably less attention than everyone else. It’s a lovely place for dinner, but I share this in the hope that no other brown sister or brother feels the way we did tonight.

I enjoyed the food We had chicken & chips with a large rice. The meal was tasty; the rice being perfectly seasoned. It was a food court - so it’s very difficult to fairly comment on the atmosphere. I would buy this food again. So thumbs up here.

HALAAL Beautifully seasoned juicy chicken Really very tasty. Friendly service. Had the lemon pepper chicken Kabsa rice Loaded fries Baklava All if it was delicious. Portions are large. Very happy overall. Would make the trip to botany center to have it again.

Great customer service and definitely a place to enjoy grilled or fried chicken. The taste was spot on and the quantity was great too. Would highly recommend this place if you're after a delicious bite in the heart of botany town center. They are located in the main food court and are Halal certified. Will surely visit here again. Thank you so much for the delicious food and the delicious sweet treat ☺️🙏🏼

I really want to shout out if are looking for some yummy chicken in East Auckland.They are superb and have great customer service. I was served by Vikas and what an amazing guy he is .I really appreciate his great customer service along with Lucky who is behind the counter .Keep it going guys 👍🤟🥇.

We ordered some wings from this place expected something crispy as was shown on the menu board but instead we got something that looked like roast chicken wings that had been deep fried. The chicken was so bland no taste at all the sauce was decent but that's the best I can say about it we couldnt even finish it. About 1 hour after eating me and my wife felt terribly sick and had to run to the toilet.

I absolutely 💯 love their pork belly Banh Mi and Beef Pho. Very tasty, full of flavors, so hot, where you have to blow your food to cool it, which is top notch to enjoy on a cold rainy day, this made my day and I love it so much. This would be my favorite place in Botany to get the taste of Vietnamese!

Absolutely AMAZING! The service is INCREDIBLE! Always extremely friendly, happy people serving you, super helpful and kind. Their food is always very fresh and tasty. Definitely one of my favourite take aways!
Never order dish like this. Not tast like lemongrass.Chicken was so white. Maybe they use different coking way. Never come back.
I had a crispy pork baguette and it was delicious! Was so fresh highly recommend
There are fly eggs on the meat slices.⋯⋯

Ordered this beef noodles and asked for extra meat but there definitely wasnt extra, the juice was also not soicy at all as what we were used to maybe its new owners now, and the lady could have had better people manners, will be finding another spot this was always our go to

Ordered the Spicy Fried Bowl with Mixed Veges, bland chilly oil with no flavour. Pickled Vege with Pork on Rice Noodle, bland soup base, no flavour. Wonton Noodle soup, bland soup base, no flavour. Wontons tasted like they were cooked from frozen. I should of checked the reviews before I ordered. Not recommended to spend your money here

The lady who served me was either mad or unhappy, I couldn’t really tell with her big mask. The she did not greet or thank the customer. Why work here if you are not willing to?Very average food quality for the price. No napkin or cutlery served on delivery. Not recommended at all, very disappointing. Will never be back.

I was intrigued by the food pictures since it looked nice but in reality, it's a big let down. There was very little meat on the noodle dishes and it was not as appetizing. The whole bowl was filled with noodles and that's it. You're better of to get their rice dish which was somehow decent at least.
Delicious food, not spicy enough for me but well suited to western taste... Give them a try you won't regret the flavour sensation! I added extra chilli to my dish.

Disappointing experience due to staff behaviour. I ordered a half-and-half hotdog and was customer #56. There was only one staff member, a young woman, working at the time. Before us, customer #55 was waiting, and we stood right next to him, waiting for our turn. Shortly after, customer #57 placed their order. After she called out #55 and handed over their order, we waited a bit longer and then saw her call out #57. No new customers had arrived yet. It didn’t make sense. I approached the counter and saw that she was wearing earphones and talking loudly on the phone while doing nothing. I asked politely if #56 was ready, and she casually said, “Oh, you didn’t get it? I’ll make one for you,” and turned around—still on her call. There was no apology, no acknowledgment of the mistake, just continued chatting on the phone while preparing the hotdog. When I received the food, I said, “Excuse me, but don’t you think you should apologise if you forgot our order?” She claimed she had called #56 but that someone else must have taken it. That’s simply not true—we were standing right there the whole time, from when she called #55 to #57. My husband was with me as a witness. Only then did she finally say sorry, but as she turned around, she sighed loudly in frustration. This kind of attitude from a customer-facing staff member is completely unacceptable. It was a frustrating and unpleasant experience that ruined what should’ve been a simple, enjoyable visit.

The best corndog I’ve ever had in Auckland! Big portion — I was already full after having just one. Crunchy and cheesy, and the Korean spicy sauce was so good! There was only one staff member in the store, but I didn’t have to wait too long. He was quite busy but still had a good smile and a great attitude. Will definitely try other options next time!
Not a big fan of corn dog but have coming back to this because this is the best corn dog I’ve ever had in Auckland. The guy is so friendly and the service is excellent.
I ordered Sweet n spicy popcorn chicken 13 nzd.. but the quantity is too less . Taste is just ok. Not satisfied.

I do not appreciate the inconvenience of my uber eats order from this store. First of all why was there ketechup all over my fries and corn dogs and why were they in one tiny container. I poliety called the place but the lady kept not picking up leaving my confused. If you are going to run uber eats at least do it correctly and not leave my corn dogs burnt and trying to cover your mistake up with ketecup to hide the burntness of it. Remake it and do better. This is a one star for me. Horrible experience as I have paied more than $20 for that order and not get a refund. Next time be a bit more careful.

As a former Maccas employee I completely understand the struggle 👍🏼 Went through the drive Saturday afternoon got my drink and I was told wait in the car park for the rest of my food. No parks in site and proceed to drive around for 20 minutes. Found one, went inside and then proceeded to waited for an employee and Explained the situation, however got asked if I had a receipt which I didn’t get and got ignored. Left unhappy with the service and no food.

I’ve been living in New Zealand for over 20 years, and the female manager at this McDonald’s is by far the most unreasonable person I’ve ever encountered in customer service. I simply asked to swap the Happy Meal toy, and she flatly refused, started arguing with me, threw items on the counter, and showed an extremely bad attitude—as if I had done something wrong. This isn’t the first time either. Her rude behavior happens regularly, and it makes the whole experience unpleasant and stressful. It’s very disappointing, especially for a family-friendly place like McDonald’s.

Came here requested specifically for no pickles or onions in my burger, yet they still added so much of it. Second when i ate my burger i had found plastic glad wrap inside of it. Lastly to top it off the burger was cold. it wasn’t busy so idk why it was made so badly

customer service was not the best, rude worker at the window where we received our food. Didn’t look interested to be there so no clue as to why he would work there. 12:35 am was when we went through drive thru and when we got home the burger looked disgusting, looked like the the burger was rushed and we were the only ones in the drive through.

Ultra packed, I watched as a nice mum and her daughter got a 5 star service and got their food instantly but when I got to the counter I had to wait for 10 mins until they saw me and even then they treated me like scum. The food was smaller then a pencil actually a scam

Great that we could try Corner38 using First Table, giving us 50% off selected menu items. Warm welcome when we entered, fast & friendly service. Stand out dishes were Beef Cheek Curry - full of flavour, Satay Chicken Skewers, Honey Pork Ribs which were juicy and fall off the bone. Little disappointed with the Pepper Calamari which were thickly-crumbed so the delicate calamari taste was absent. The mulled wine was perfect for a chilly Winter's night. We would return but would stick with the larger dishes as they were ideal for sharing.

Our First Visit – Lovely Experience! This was our first time dining here, and we had a wonderful experience. The staff were very friendly and welcoming from the moment we walked in. The food was delicious, and the portion sizes were just right for sharing (bigger share) — perfect for us as we’re not big eaters. The atmosphere was great too, with a comfortable and inviting environment. We’ll definitely be coming back!

We booked via First Table, securing a 50% discount on food (though it's important to note this doesn't apply to all dishes – always check!). For entrees, we opted for the lamb skewers and coconut prawns. Both were tasty; however, the lamb was slightly dry. The Obama Bao Cha, a Vietnamese dish featuring pork skewers, spring rolls, and rice noodles, was beautifully presented. The Smokey Duck, a creative take on Peking duck, was equally impressive in its visual appeal and flavour. The thoughtfulness put into the plating of both dishes was evident. Service was friendly and efficient, with staff readily available to answer questions and offer assistance. Overall, a great place for a post-shopping meal or a pre-movie dinner. We highly recommend checking it out!

It was our first time to this place - it did not disappoint! On the menu it says their dishes are designed to share, so we ordered two mains. The Beef Cheek red curry - very tender, the curry was creamy and has a fine balanced spice to it. I found the beef cheeks was a bit too salty for my liking, but perfect to mix it with some rice. The Obama Bun Cha - it was very different to what I had imagined. The pork belly skewers was well cooked, full of flavors. The meat balls was great as well! My favorite was the deep fried spring roll - very crunchy and full of flavors! The portions was good - we felt pretty full afterwards and had to skip on their dessert.

Food was ok, I mean loaded fries could be better with the name in general where 8 pieces of overcooked small pieces of pork belly wasnt the best. Also the sticky fried chicken was average, the stir fried pad thai chicken was average as well - could do with more flavor! The indoor seating was lovely, atmosphere nice and lovely interior decor. Food could do with some improvements. The customer service was great, was greeted, seated, served with reasonable time for food and beverage orders.
Burger was delicious! Got the california burger during their 2 for 1 deal for Tuesdays and Wednesday of July 2025. Very happy
The best onion rings I ever get. Customer service is always so friendly - Rahul is incredibly helpful with what to try. I absolutely adore coming here.
Burgers are really good. And I was happily surprised with their great offer : buy one, get one free every Tuesday
Tried the great American grand with onion rings french fries and mountain dew it was delicious and cannot wait to try again and enjoy it more
I ordered Wisconsin w.Cheese 14,90 with curly fries. The bun is big and it falls apart, the meat just doesn't taste good, I couldn't eat it all. The servers were very nice, the place looks clean.

If you're craving tender, crispy, and absolutely delicious fried chicken, Nene Chicken Botany is the place to go. The store is bright, spotless, and offers a huge menu with something for everyone. We had the flavoured boneless chicken, and it was perfection! Crispy, well-coated, and packed with flavour. Honestly, we were sad when it was all gone! The portion sizes are generous too. We also tried the burgers, which came with massive, juicy chicken thigh pieces and loads of flavour. The cheesy fries were next level. Can’t wait to come back and see the awesome team in action, thank YOU!
The chicken+brown rice are really yummy. Its taste is the best the I ever had in Auckland. The manager named "Sonu" is really nice and helpful. I will definitely go back again.

Blown away by the service at Nene Chicken Botany. The manager Karan didn’t just acknowledge my food allergies - he genuinely cared. Took the time to explain everything, adjusted my order, and even offered samples unprompted to make sure I felt confident in my choices. That level of thoughtfulness is rare, and it made the whole experience unforgettable. Massive respect.

$39 for this?! Disappointing Went there at 9pm, got home, opened the box, went straight back. Staff said that the portion for boneless original chicken is 650g. Does that look like 650g to you? They said that one sentence and left. No apology, no refund, no nothing. This is so disappointing because I’ve always had an amazing experience at Nene Chicken. Would not recommend to anyone anymore.

The pricing was friendly for students and was a perfect place to dine out after school. The proportions were very generous and gave all 6 of us a full stomach and a memory to be cherished. The service was very friendly and welcoming as well which made our experience even more special.

I ordered the Assorted Sushi pack, Seaweed Salad, Tempura Vegetable Pancake and Seared Scallop Nigiri via Uber Eats.10/10 for taste and affordability. You can tell the food was made with love and attention. Thank you Sushi Sushi 🙏 Highly recommended 👌

Popped into Sushi Sushi at Botany Mall today for a quick snack and grabbed 3 rolls: crab, crispy chicken, and chicken. The staff were super friendly, and the place was spotless, which was awesome to see. They’ve got a solid variety of options, so there’s plenty to choose from. Only thing I wasn’t a fan of is that the prices on the counter for the food and sauces haven’t been updated. It looks like they’ve recently gone up, but the signs still show the old prices, which can be a bit confusing. Other than that, it’s a solid spot with great food and service. I’d definitely go back!

I visit this sushi shop once or twice a week. Today, the rice was undercooked, and then I informed the front staff about it. Staff was willing to offer a refund, but I refused as this was not my intention. Hope it won't happen again as the price has gone up after xmas and rice is so important to sushi. How come the staff didn't check it before making sushi ?

I had sushi w my son here, and while we were sitting we saw one of the employees coming to check on the rubbish, she put her hands on it open and shut, turned on her toes and went straight back to the kitchen using the same gloves, and then right into the rice sushi to make more delicious and full of bacteria sushi 🤮I spoke to the manager in charge and she was looking at me like I don’t know what do to… I don’t come back.

Really yummy and fresh, tastes better than Bruce Lee sushi, like I’m not left feeling so greasy after it. Sadly some sushi rolls aren’t packed to the ends though. Been there a couple times now, service was really lovely and then sometimes just average.
My second time trying different dishes here and it’s amazingly good. Reasonably sized portions and fast service.

Super quick service and delicious food! All three main dishes were prepared in around 5 minutes, which was impressively fast. The food was very tasty and the portion sizes were satisfying. The location is convenient—situated between two main car parks and right next to Starbucks, making it easy to grab a coffee on your way out. The layout of the restaurant is a bit unconventional—it's set up in a long row with two lines of tables, which might seem odd at first. However, this design actually helps spread out the crowd and reduces noise, making for a more pleasant dining experience. There’s no scenic view, but overall, it’s a great spot for a quick and tasty meal.

ordered double roti canai w/ curry mutton. X2 ketchup size containers -I kid you not !! 😆 and a slightly bigger container of mutton.. for $34.90 that is not value for your money & frankly quite laughable & a bit of a joke. Curry laksa chicken wasn't the best I've had either (not a fan of the taste of this coconut curry soup), portion was more decent & for price @ $29.50. The special Nasi Goreng w/ fried chicken was the best dish out of the 3 overall did not exceed my expectations 😞 over priced

“Disappointing and Frustrating Experience” I ordered the C14 rotti meal for dinner, which looked amazing in the photos – layered and perfectly crafted. However, when the meal arrived, it was nothing like what was shown in the picture. The rotti was flat and plain, not at all as depicted on the menu. I asked the staff why it didn’t match the photo, and the response was incredibly rude. The server said, “They made it now, you have to have this,” as if there was no room for discussion. Eventually, after some insistence, she took it back to the chef. We waited another 10-20 minutes, only for her to return with the same rotti, claiming it had been remade – but it was exactly the same as the first one. The attitude of the staff was appalling. Instead of addressing the issue professionally, they were dismissive and unhelpful. It’s clear they have no understanding of customer service. I won’t be returning to this restaurant, and I do not recommend it to anyone looking for a good dining experience. The food and service were a major letdown.

Malaysian Restaurant in Botany Town Centre. Not as big as the Sylvia Park or City stores. Can get busy at times and sometimes there's a bit if a wait for the food. Food quality is generally good and portion size is large. They are happy to explain their ordering system for first timers

worst coffee. i gave it four chances. often lukewarm. last time i ordered a mocha. they made a trim flat white when noone claimed it they dumped some chocolate on top right in front of me and called it a mocha. i never asked for trim
The coffee hits the spot on some days, on most days they just overheat the coffee.. which makes it undrinkable for a while

I must have been daydreaming and forgot to pay for my gas and inadvertently drove off! How embarrassing! Went to another BP who pointed this out to me. Clever CCTV system that captures registration So they were really good about it and of course I paid up Thank you BP fanshaw street
Best coffee. Just the perfect strength and temperature
Fab coffee, don't forget to get you cup for refills. Safe yourself some money Thanks Wild been Botany

First time eating here. We ordered sweet and Sticky boneless. Okay, so it was extremely dry chicken with zero "glaze" and actually it's very spicy. I cannot tolerate any spice at all so it's inedible for me personally. So not sure where the sweet or sticky part comes in. Called up and didn't really get anything out of the guy except he'll "pass it onto the boss". He was nice enough but extremely disappointed. Never be returning.

Perfect for a boutique fried chicken shop. Great vibe , good service and food is really good. It's not a place for fine dining, but it's definitely a budget fried chicken joint. I had the loaded fries and chicken. I'll go back for it .

I went with my friends for their $20 all you can eat special and it was well worth it imo. The chicken was served 6 at a time per person and was coming out blazing hot from the fryer. So hot we had to wait a lil bit for it to cool down xD. They served them off their tray so they weren't laying around and there were more than enough as they would come back to see if we wanted more. They even had to ask if they wanted us to drop more in as we were nearing being full lol really good service :). They weren't fussy at all with the amount we ate at all and id say we had a decent amount! The sauces came in little pots and the honey soy one was really tasty. We tried several all pretty good sauces (you ask for the sauces one at a time per person although they were really chill about it). I'm glad it was super fresh and really tasty. The chicken breading was crispy and the chicken it's self was super tender and juicy, perfect honestly. Unlimited sauces to try from and the 'nibbles' were drums and wings (flats). The pieces were huge. I think this special is only on sometimes but imo if you like chicken I think it's worth it and possible to eat your moneys worth xD. Def would come back for this special. Also super friendly staff very attentive and kind. They also gave us free water :). If you wanted other stuff like drinks or chips you could order it additionally this unlimited chicken was only chicken :). Great value for money considering one meal in Auckland is now basically $20 lol and this was unlimited. You also have 1hr to dine and they were pretty lax on this as well luckily we were there for maybe 1hr 15mins Thanks for a great time would highly recommend! :D

I really like this one. I've been here many times and always enjoyed it. The chicken portions are large, and they are always cooked fresh. The fries are also fresh and crispy. This means there is a bit of a wait for the food, but it's worth it. One day I should probably venture past my usual basic combo.

First time here. Burgers are so big and taste fresh. The buns are lightly toasted. I couldn't finish the single wicked chicken burger I ordered. Friendly staff and great service. Will be going there again for sure.

Sumthin Dumpling Botany offers super tasty dumplings at a reasonable price. The decor was very warm and inviting and the service was pretty good. My only critique is that the fries were a little under seasoned , but other than that a must try !!

Craving dumplings and obviously my thought went straight to Sumthin Dumplin. I always went to the city location but its nice that a store is open near home as well. Friendly staff and I believe the owner is the one that served me that night. He's friendly and have great customer service 🙂. Overall the dumplings are cooked perfectly, nice juicy and crispy on the bottom. Also did I forget to mention the design of the restaurant is like bomb? Total basketball vibes 10/10 🫶 coming again!

It’s closer to a 3.5-star rating than a full 4. The place offers some great options, and I tried the OG dumplings with chili oil. They were okay, but the dumplings had too much dough, and the filling didn’t quite justify the price. I’ll be back to try the cheese and beef dumplings next time.

Sumthin Dumplin Botany is a must-try for anyone craving inventive dumplings. The vegan Monk dumpling stood out with its earthy tofu, shiitake mushrooms, and bok choy in a spinach wrap is nothing short of creative, while the Great White dumplings bring together chicken and a medley of white and shiitake mushrooms. This mix gives a gentle, mellow chicken taste that’s perfectly balanced by the savoury, slightly woodsy mushroom notes offered a perfectly balanced mix of chicken and mushrooms. The crispy chips with unique sauce were an unexpected highlight. Each dish delivered fresh, creative flavours—making this spot a refreshing upgrade from typical dumpling places. Great service and lots of parking.
First time trying this, I got the chicken dumpling with sriracha mayo honestly it was just ok. I don’t think I’ll be going back to this place, because I’ve definitely had better.

Fresh ingredients, friendly staff, and super clean vibes. My sub was made perfectly – packed with flavour and care. Fast service and a great place to chill or grab a quick bite. Easily one of the best Subways around! 🥪💚

We visit this Subway regularly as a family, and it’s always a wonderful experience. The staff are incredibly welcoming, generous, and consistently friendly. The service is fast, the place is clean, and the food is always fresh and made to high standards. It's clear they take pride in what they do, and it keeps us coming back. Highly recommended!

I’ve been to Subway Botany Town Center a few times now, and it’s always a great experience. I usually get the Buffalo Chicken Footlong, and the food is consistently fresh, delicious, and generously filled with meat and salad—just how a sub should be! The staff are friendly and welcoming, especially the owner, who always makes the effort to say hi whenever I pass by. It’s those small gestures that make a big difference and keep me coming back. Definitely recommend this Subway if you’re after great service and quality food. I’ll absolutely be back again!

They always have the best service! Sweetest couple running the show, the sandwiches are so well made and they’re so generous with the salads and sauces! The man running the show is the nicest and always always makes you smile. It’s definitely one of my weekly pit stops for a delicious sub👍

I've been going to this particular spot for a past couple of years and I've never been disappointed. Food always tastes fresh and a good portion of salads and dressings and its made with such good care. They keep the place clean and tidy and pay attention to hygiene. Everyone who works here is super friendly and always greet me with a big smile! I highly, highly recommend them!!

Came in a Friday night at 6pm and the restaurant was pretty empty with only a few tables occupied. Ordered via the kiosk. We ordered a Kid's Beef Burger Combo and a Double Cheeseburger Combo. They have a drink fountain to fill your own fizzy drink. The food came out pretty fast and was tasty. I did find that the burgers have too much sauce and can get a bit messy when eating it. The fries were bit oily and salty

Thought we'd test out this highly reviewed burger joint whilst in Botany and overall very satisfied. Pricing is fairly average. The food was made with quality, delicious ingredients and presented well. Very happy with the amount of chicken received. The loaded fries had a pickle flavored burger sauce and they added bacon, removed onion and mustard, per my request. My daughter rated her cheeseburger a 5/5 and my partner rated his burger 5/5, appreciating the quality of bacon in his bbq bacon double cheeseburger. Would definitely purchase again!

The food was excellent! I ordered the cheeseburger and it was so tasty! The cherry on top was the special sauce. The service was good. The chefs were fast to cook my food. The atmosphere was really medium. I was surprised to see that we could see the chefs cooking. 10/10 restaurant!

Best burgers I have ever had. Best customer service, the boss there is always friendly and catering to us. We always come in late at night after the gym and there is nothing better than visiting this place. Staff always have a smile on their faces and treat every customer nicely. Food is made with maximum love. Burgers are fat, juicy and perfectly seasoned. The fries are always crispy and fluffy. Boss always hook us up with an extremely generous amount of our favourite secret sauce without us even having to ask. Our orders always come out extremely fast and we never have to wait long at all. I would 100% recommend this place to everyone. It is a much better option compared to the subway or the maccas next door and much more filling. If you don’t believe me, just take a look at the photos below.

Yummy food, and I loved having the option of having lettuce as a burger bun instead of bread. But the highlight was the guy who served us! He was so happy and smiley and gave us so much free stuff and bent over backwards to make us happy. From ice cream and drinks to free caps, it was very fun!

Went through the drive through on the 7th of August around 10pm and ordered a le burger beef meal for the boyf and he absolutely loved it although I ordered 10 piece nuggets and spicy chicken chips. The spicy chicken chips were so good but the nuggets on the other hand were depressing! I’m not one to complain about food but I was so unimpressed. They were cold and were not crispy at all and had zero flavour and that’s not like BK at all. The girls who served me were so lovely the only problem I’m having is with those nuggets! Please fix them!

Recently got two whopper combos. They were the same combos- burger,fries, drink- except one was a medium combo and one was a large combo.
