On Uber they charge you $7.50 to go large combo( $5.50 for regular if you want a combo). Want to see what you're paying for? The large drink was ONE OUNCE larger, the fries were EIGHT GRAMS larger! Check the photos to see what 8 grams of fry looks like. I weighed the fries and we emptied out the ice from our drinks and put in a measuring cup. Can we all say what a rip off! They just put more ice in the large cup to deceive us into thinking we got more drink. 🤨 i have to say i was surprised by the drink. Our two combos came to just over $41! We haven't been there in many months maybe even a year or more. Hubby says he won't be in a hurry to go back. Fast food no longer cheap food. Eat at home, or at least dont go large.

If you decide to go here (id recommend anywhere else!!), then fully check your drive thru orders before moving your car away from the window!! This review is from what happened to me years ago. But also was more than once, & years apart, which makes it worse. At least twice this place has left whole items out of my drive thru orders (the times i recall they left a whole large burger, 1 time a fries). Despite me contacting them each time to resolve the issue, they refused to compensate me for the missing items which they had charged me for. I had made the mistake of driving home before looking in the bags. They should also make sure they are completing & packing orders correctly. So I'll never go back. I also make sure anyone I'm with who is tempted to go will go elsewhere so they won't get ripped off like I did.

My kids and I have been a regular customers at this store, but after today’s experience we definitely aren’t coming back here again. Management surely needs to look at their staffs customer skills. We have had few bad experiences in the past but today’s was definitely the worst. Name was called to collect the order from the front, had to ask the for cups for our drinks, then had to ask for the lids, then I had to ask the attendant for the Sunday, to which she just said it’s coming. She started serving other customers, after few minutes I asked again for the Sunday, she replied yes it’s coming just wait. After few minutes I had to interrupt her serving other customers and ask for the Sunday again, to which she said there’s some issue with the machine it’s coming in a very rude voice. I asked her can I see your manager, she then just rolled her eyes yes and laughed in my face. Manager came out and I explained what has happened. She did apologise and said she would speak to her. I then again had to ask for lids to the drink. By this time the burgers and chips were cold, on top of eating cold burgers, the patties were burnt. Very unpleasant taste, I would highly not recommend this store to any1. It’s not worth spending your money.

WORST BK EXPERIENCE EVER - AVOID BOTANY LOCATION! 1/5 stars I'm still fuming after my disastrous visit to Burger King Botany. The staff here are absolutely atrocious! They seem to be more interested in chatting amongst themselves than actually doing their jobs. I waited in line for ages, only to be ignored by the staff when it was my turn to order. When I finally got their attention, they got my order wrong. And to add insult to injury, they had the nerve to charge me EXTRA for a glass of water! The service here is non-existent. It's like they're not even bothered to try. I've had better experiences at a school cafeteria. And the worst part? It looks like BK is paying them to just stand around and talk all day. I mean, who gets paid to slack off like that? I WANT A JOB LIKE THIS!!! Can someone please hook me up with a gig where I get to do nothing and still get paid? AVOID THIS LOCATION AT ALL COSTS. Unless you enjoy being ignored, overcharged, and served by staff who clearly don't care. In that case, be my guest.

I had a great experience dining at this Vietnamese restaurant. The highlight was definitely the noodles — the bowl of beef pho was full of rich, aromatic broth and generously topped with tender slices of meat, fresh herbs, and crisp onions. It was both comforting and flavorful without being too salty or oily. The chicken dish was also well-executed — tender, juicy pieces served over crunchy bean sprouts and drizzled with a fragrant soy-based sauce. The balance of textures made it very satisfying. What stood out just as much as the food was the service. The staff were genuinely friendly, welcoming us warmly and checking in throughout the meal. They made the whole experience even more enjoyable. If you're looking for authentic Vietnamese comfort food served with a smile, I’d definitely recommend this place!

Saigon Garden is a beautiful little family-run Vietnamese restaurant that really delivers on both flavour and hospitality. The staff were so warm and welcoming — it felt like being invited into someone’s home for a comforting, home-cooked meal. I ordered the dry noodle with grilled chicken, pho with grilled pork and spring roll, and lemon tea — and every dish was spot on. The spring roll in particular was a standout: super crispy on the outside and packed with flavour on the inside. The grilled meats were perfectly cooked, tender, and full of smoky, savoury goodness. The broth in the pho was rich and fragrant, and the lemon tea was refreshing and balanced. You can really taste the care and quality in every bite. It’s clear the family behind Saigon Garden take pride in what they do, and it shows in both the food and the service. Highly recommend this place if you're after authentic Vietnamese food in a cosy, welcoming atmosphere. I’ll definitely be back! 🥢🌿

Had a pleasant meal here. Great parking convenient location. Food was cooked perfectly. Subtle flavour for the fish noodles. Crispy refreshing bun. $3 iced Vietnamese coffee with meal purchased was great, though I thought there was too much ice.

Brisket pho was perfect for a cold winter day. Broth was absolutely stunning not greasy, generous portion of brisket without too much fat. Value for money. Vietnamese coffee was only $3. The staff are really friendly, excellent service.

Great Vietnamese spot right by Woolies! Starting with their food, we got the lemongrass chicken with vermicelli and rice with a side of spring rolls. The portions were decent and definitely a pleasant surprise for the price point. The chicken was tender and flavourful and isn’t too overpowering like how most lemongrass chickens can be. The nuoc nam is also great and the service even better. Definitely a great spot and choice for when you want a hearty Vietnamese meal and even better after your grocery shop!

The customer service are too direct and straight forward and no smile. Customer services elevate the experience especially in a gorgeous place like this. Food is average and portion size is way too small compared to other cafes. Only 2 toilets available at the cafe. Cafe has a huge potential to succeed and do well as it’s aesthetically pleasing. Will not return unless we have a child.

Came here for lunch while the kids went to play at the playground. Ordered the french toast, chicken salad and the kids pasta meal for the kids together with coffee. Food was pretty good and well priced. Kids liked the pasta while coffee is pretty good too. Great option if you have kids and want to have a nice "peaceful" meal while the kids play.

Quite expensively priced food. Mango smoothie wasn’t that great however did enjoy the scotch fillet sandwich although the expensive price. Not somewhere I would go every day however a nice treat being joint with the kids playground where you can let the kids run wild while you enjoy some food. The pizzas are small for the price you pay. Best to eat elsewhere after children are done playing

Beautiful place, but they are very overpriced. Meals are small. The bao buns also had the thinnest piece of pork I have ever had. Tasted fine, but I would have expected more. The kids' meals were probably the best.

☕️🍟🍕Food was nice, my son ordered chicken pasta (white sauce) and he really likes it. Good portion of food serving and we enjoyed and love it. They have lots of food selection for kids and adult who got dietary restriction. Place were neat and clean.

Wish there was a zero or a minus rating for food & service. We ordered burrito box meal, dinner for two (large) and quesadillas combo (large) - Absolutely tasteless, flavorless and disgusting. Wraps filled with few pieces of chicken and cheese, I am sure we make better ones at home at much less price. Check out the chocodilla pic - wrap with Nutella 🧐 forgot to take the picture for the rest of the food but managed to get one at least Don’t waste your time, money and appetite!!!!!!

Pro tip #1: Get the crunchwrap supreme. Pro tip #2: You can get unlimited fire/mild sauces for free, so get as many as you can to level up your food. (I prefer mild, which is enough) I don't know how they make the cheese in the wrap so gooey and creamy at the same time, but this is the second time I got the crunchwrap supreme and it's still just as good. A layer of beef, veges, and cheese (almost like a lasagna) wrapped in a soft yet not too chewy tortilla flatbread. I got the Big Crunch Box, but the hard shell taco is just a meaningless addition, and you don't need any more mince besides the crunchwrap supreme. (I wish they'd make soft shells with bigger pieces of meat but that wouldn't be cheap) All in all, the crunchwrap supreme was great as always, but this time it wasn't sealed as well as the one at Sylvia Park. I'd assume whoever put it on the pan got lazy and didn't cook the wrapping enough, so they lose a star there and for the well-seasoned but cardboard textured fries. Staff were friendly and the atmosphere was great.

Waited 8 to 15mins on the drive thru window! We were the only car in the drive! The food came but it was alright but not great. The order was wrong! The manager said he was short of stuff but i could see 5 people standing around! Dont recommend anyone! Airport taco bell stuff and the food was 100 times better then this place!

Don’t get the churros, I made a big mistake. They were really bad, stale, and the chocolate sauce tasted awful. We spent $13 on desserts only and asked for a cup of water, but the staff said we had to pay for it. We mainly wanted it for our child. The food is good, but the service and dessert side of things aren’t as good as you’d hope.

So, I only bought dessert from Taco Bell today. I bought two churros with chocolate sauce and a bag of cinnamon twist. The Churros are not churros, it was a wrong texture, overcooked and discussing flavour of old old old oil they've been fried in. And the chocolate sauce was so little it's barely enough for 1 churros! So it was an epic fail 👎👎👎 Cinnamon twists chips they have an old flavor to it, so all went into the rubbish bin. Another epic fail 👎 👎 👎 So it's was waste of money because of unedible dessert 😭 Shame on you Taco Bell 🔕!

CSR advised hot wings run-out. Friday 7pm. Very quiet in store. Order the normal chicken. After 12 minutes one person advised they got some wings. Another wait for 20 minutes. Finally got the hot wings. Not sure where those come from all of a sudden. Unfortunately 15 out of 25 wings from the baby chicken. Few of them got marination rest Just dry fried and taste wired.. absolute rubbish..end up going to KFC and throwing Chicking-Wings in rubbish. First time in botony store.. worst experience ...Not recommended..

The worker was so welcoming and nice as well as the food was really yummy that was a good price and didn't take that long to serve. I highly recommend going here and trying Chicking as it is a great place to eat fast food because everything is really good.​ When you order, the people who work there are nice and fast, so it's easy and enjoyable. They have lots of different foods to choose from, so you can always find something you like. The food at Chicking tastes amazing every time. Their fried chicken is super crispy on the outside and moist and tasty on the inside. Even their side dishes, like the coleslaw and fries, are made well and go great with the chicken. They use fresh ingredients to make sure everything tastes good.

My first time visiting this place and dinning in to eat was absolutely amazing experience!! Apart from any other chicking places I’ve visited and ate from.. I wasn’t disappointed at all after eating here Everything was good especially the customer service. The food was tasty and enjoyable!! Will be going back sometime soon 😇 I highly recommend ✌️
He's being racist to me you got me a small chicken strips any small amount of chips and I ask for mild and he got me spicy I'm going to report him

Had a great experience at Chicking Botany—delicious food and a clean, cozy atmosphere. The service was excellent, and Fariha truly made a difference with her polite and professional approach. She’s warm, attentive, and made us feel right at home. Looking forward to our next visit!

It’s sad and quite unfortunate that we came to this place , the place is dirty the food is yuck , me and my daughter we could not eat the food so we just left, and wasted our money on the food we couldn’t finished. It taste worst like leftovers food from days!!!

Big meal, cheap price. A lot of dishes around $12 dollar, roast duck, BBQ pork, roast pork ...eat . Perfect for the family gathering and price reasonable. Noddle are nice especially for the fries noddle. Good place to visit. VH
author_name: 紐西蘭吃喝玩樂 Vincent in New Zealand

text: The fried noodle and Lemon chicken were the best. But the restaurant environment was not very clean, and kitchen tools were lying around on the tables in the dining area which made us hesitate a little to go in. Other than that, they served good food and were affordable prices.
Easily one of the best Chinese restaurants in Auckland. Everything is always awesome. Staff are friendly and extremely helpful and always look after you. Gotta get the duck!!

Salted fish egg plants is very gluggy and dry. Not your familiar taste of your typical Cantonese dish. The char sui and crispy pork that were served seems to taste like left over from the night before. It doesn't taste fresh like the ones you buy from taiping. Based on other people reviews, it seems they have a habit of serving left over meat. If you compare the photo of the egg plant dish with another review from two years ago by Leon yang, you can see the difference between the two. Very disappointing and a very poor attempt in Cantonese cuisine.

We had an exceptional dining experience at Chen Kee! The food was outstanding, with traditional Cantonese flavours shining through. We ordered the special tofu dish, crispy prawn balls, beef brisket soup, and the mouthwatering mix platter of roast pork and duck - all incredibly fresh and reasonably priced. We had plenty leftover for takeaway! Our waitress was an absolute sweetheart, making our meal even more enjoyable. The service was genuinely friendly and attentive, a rare find! Ignore the suspicious 1-star reviews; they seem malicious. Chen Kee's authentic Cantonese cuisine and top-notch service truly impress. We'll be back!

Bought a couple of takeaway from here today. The taste is plain average. The BBQ pork is super fat. The duck looks like from two different duck. Very small portions. The seafood fried noodle is super expansive but taste bad small portion. Will not recommend anyone go here for lunch takeaways. Will never go back again.

If you want some nice wantons? This is the place. Their wantons are sized perfectly with shrimps and pork, and the soup base is one of the best in NZ. Light, umami, seafoody, and you can see the shrimp roe they’ve used. The cured meat rice was packed with flavour and satisfying. Good value.

Traditional Cantonese Cuisine Wonton soup noodle - very smooth bite size wonton, noodle is crunchy, clear broth well balance good example of this classic dish. And yes they have yellow chives in the soup! Stir beef “hor fun” rice noodle - lots of wok hey, steaming when it served, although a bit oily. Might come again for Chinese bbq

A friend recommended this place to us and this was the second time we visited the eatery for takeout. Amongst other dishes, my husband wanted to try their BBQ pork and when he ordered, he specifically asked for a piece of lean BBQ pork. And we asked to have the BBQ pork takeaway as a whole piece as we like to slice it at home to the thickness our kids prefer. So we couldn’t assess the fattiness of the pork on the spot. When I got home I found out 70-80% of the pork was fat, which is the opposite to what we asked for. Their Bbq pork is made with pork belly ( 五花腩) and our piece was mostly just fat. I cannot give that to my son. When I separated the fat from meat, there wasn’t much left for my son to consume. It is disappointing, as the whole purpose of getting take out was to have a chill evening. I ended up having to make another meat dish as a protein top up for the family. I’d wish I had taken better photos. I understand some people enjoy having their Bbq pork with some fat. But our cut was unacceptable as it was unreasonably fat and most of it ended up in the waste bin. I have relatives who own restaurants and I ran this pass them, they said it is poor ethics to even roasting this piece of fat and selling it to their customers knowing that it is too fat for anyone to consume. For those who are concerned about fatty bbq pork I suggest not going to this place

One of the more interesting Sushi Trains in Auckland. They’ve got a wide variety of things to take off the train and you can order anything that’s not there direct to your table. The venue was kept very clean, although I was there at opening at 11.30am, so this is expected. The staff were never far if you needed to order off the menu. It can get a little pricey if you get too excited pulling things off the train onto your table. It’s a great experience.

Service was 10/10, quick response, quick delivery off the menu, drinks. We sat in the booth, just walk in an pick a seating space. Absolute fun an exciting. Japanese alcohol was like a light larger. Spent $192, for 2 adults 1 child. Overall exciting fun experience, our 8 year old loved it,so did we.
Went to sushi go round with family, to treat ourselves definitely enjoyed it. Will be coming again next time. Highlights were definitely the kina and aburi garlic salmon and scallops sushi so yum 😋

We felt like we wanted sushi with a twist so this is where we went. A bit pricey but fun getting the sushi off the conveyor belt ourselves. The food was fresh, though portions were small. You could also order off a menu if the item you want wasn’t on the belt. There were quite a few staff around but they kept bringing food to us that we didn’t order, must be some miscommunication there. Overall kinda fun but not gonna go back anytime soon.

Came here at lunch on a Sunday. First time and was good seeing this place and trying it for the first time. Some good food here, not a lot but still ok. The price suits the amount on here. Have to keep an eye on what you want it can add up at the end.
The food was deliciously testy & authentic. This Schezwan Fried Rice was delicious and the Daal had a real home made taste. I highly recommend this place to everyone who loves Indian food dishes :)

This is written out of out of love & care, to help improve...towards a great future: The food was v good, EXCEPT one fatal flaw/accident/whatever...on the Lamb Saagwala: possibly an accidental input of too much salt, it was too salty, I was overwhelmed. Retiree here, who has dined everywhere around the world, so am fair! May I suggest, pls keep saltiness perfectly average & balanced, & provide salt & pepper shakers at the table. Problems solved, for posterity!

If you’re looking for a delicious, satisfying snack, the vada pav here is an absolute must-try! Crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, it’s packed with flavor, and the green chilies they serve on the side really kick it up a notch. I love how the flavors come together perfectly, making it the kind of treat you crave again and again. Their methi malai chicken is another standout – rich, creamy, and bursting with aromatic spices. It’s so comforting and pairs wonderfully with their Tandoori roti, which is always perfectly baked. My husband, Gagan, knows this place well, and every time he brings me the vada pav, I’m reminded of how great their food is. This place never disappoints, and it’s definitely become a favorite for both of us! Highly recommend giving it a try!
Ordered a chicken biryani mild to medium. It was super spicy and not fresh. Not recommended.
A perfect blend of kiwi butter chicken with the authentic Indian style, at a pretty good price too.

Vietnamese and Korean fusion. The Spicy Beef Pho was excellent, with the right amount of spiciness. We also ordered the Wonton Pho and both broths were on the sweet side. As well as the Seafood Fried Noodle and Spring Roll. It was not that busy on a Friday night and found parking outside
Love this place in East Auckland. Nice and Cosy place has the best Beef Pho and Spring roll vermicelli in town. Highly recommend for a chill night out.

A delicious fusion of Vietnamese pho. A clear broth instead of the authentic traditional style. Lots of veggies are used to cook the broth, refined and layers of flavors. The toppings are great - soft and tender pork chip, char grilled shallots and beef. Spicy beef pho is yum. Definitely will come back and try other items.
An Asian fusion restaurant serving Vietnamese dishes combined with Korean flavour and ingredients. Clean and flavorful taste in soup. Somewhat difficult to find parking at lunchtime.
My husband and I ate there on April 1. I really loved their Photune Spicy Beef Pho and Photune Spicy Seafood Pho! I will definitely come back again! The ambiance was so good and quiet!

The vibe’s mint real Instagramable spot with a great atmosphere. Staff were super friendly, and the portions? Massive. Pretty good bang for your buck, decent portions and top-notch quality for around 20 bucks a feed. The food was top notch. the marinated pork ribs just melt in your mouth. You’ll be hanging out to come back for more. The braised pork trotters were full of flavour. that broth was something else. Don’t skip dessert either big serves again, and the choccy and mango ones were bang on. If you’re into good food and solid value, definitely worth a visit. Get amongst it! Well.. Dagu Masarap talaga!!! Promise

Went there first time for dinner with a group of family members on last week. The restaurant was quite accommodating and partitioned a kind of private room for us. You pay when you order. There is a corner where you can help yourselves of cutleries, bowls, chopsticks, water and tea. We have ordered multiple dishes to share and most of them were delicious. You can get an extra portion of the 'rice noodle' free of charge for the rice noodle dishes in soup. The Thai boba tea shaved ice (dessert) recommended by the staff was particularly good. Packed of people and would recommend to make a reservation in advance. Good value for money and would love to go back again to try other dishes.
Reasonable price with the free extra rice noodles options but the meat portion is a bit small (look at the picture. Only a spoon of beef slices). Nice environment. Roughly $23nzd per person
It is a yummy food place for rice noodle lover. Food portion is quite good. Taste is good. Price is reasonable. Place is clean including toilet. Highly recommend for food.
Very tasty price is good portion is good would come back and try all other dishes 4 start on the atmosphere is because of people smoking outside and the door is always open

It’s a very beautiful location, no doubt. Very unassuming. The pricing is reasonable. The drawbacks for me were the unpolished cups with lipstick. I also ordered eggs bene with salmon. They entered my order as bacon. At least I wasn’t overcharged.
A very good experience overall good service and a well presented tasty meal and a good Roma coffee.

Kind staff beyond compare. Beautiful outdoor space. Years of exceptional service, coffee and kai. No request is too much trouble. Reviewing as having travelled extensively over recent weeks, I am looking forward to coming back to the LTC, where there’s always a cheeky marshmallow waiting for their littlest fan!

I had an amazing experience at Limetree Cafe in Auckland. The ambience was absolutely beautiful, surrounded by lush greenery and a tranquil stream with ducks. The setting alone was enough to make the visit special. The service provided by Amanda, Amanda (x2), and Grace was exceptional. Despite the cafe being full, they were incredibly efficient, taking our orders with precision and ensuring that we were well taken care of throughout our meal. Speaking of the food, we tried the big brekkie, bacon hash stack, and coffee. The dishes were delicious and well-presented, living up to our expectations. The big brekkie was hearty and satisfying, while the bacon hash stack had a perfect blend of flavors. Overall, Limetree Cafe provided a delightful dining experience with its serene ambience, attentive service from Amandas and Grace, and mouthwatering dishes. I would highly recommend a visit to anyone looking for a memorable meal in a picturesque setting.

First time dining here and it was a terrible experience. Found hair in the mushrooms, showed staff but they denied seeing it even though it was clearly visible. They replaced it, but there was hair again — this time we put it on tissue to show, they still denied it and claimed it wasn’t theirs because they don’t have black hair. Asked for a refund as we no longer wanted the food, but they started yelling and refused. Rude and racist behaviour — never going back.

Went back for the grazing platter & burgers. All still delicious. Grazing platter; everything on the platter was tasty. I would definitely go back here. The service was excellent and the food arrived in good time. New pic added - still delicious & well worth a visit.

I'm rating this place as 4 stars for two reasons. It's def a must try on the way! Me and my family went there to have dinner a few days ago and we came out really happy with our experience. The food was delicious, the staff 10/10, our waitress was super friendly, very attentive and the chef as well. Both served us as if we were kings. I'm a vegan, so I usually always expect a vegan fatty burger or some alternative in the menu, which I couldn't find here. But, a big But, the staff handled it really well, and offered fixed alternatives. If there was a strong and solid option for vegans in the menu, this place deserved 5 stars. Thankfully everyone enjoyed! Hope to come back soon:)
Nom nom nom we will enjoy eating our way thru the menu here

My man and I stayed in Beachlands, NZ, during our trip to Aukland. As we traveled to and from Aukland to our Airbnb, we frequently passed The Stables in Whitford. One evening, we decided to stop in for dinner and was pleasantly surprised by the friendly and accommodating staff, the Michelin award worth food and top tier drinks. I'm sure the locals are well acquainted with this establishment. It a 45 min drive outside Aukland, but we'll worth it!

Great place, ordered the crispy pork salad, bit of a let down. Was crumbed pork schnitzel cut into pieces, which didn't taste very fresh. Have been there previously for platters which were alright. Service was great when I took my family, but was slow the third time ( Neville )

Ordered the tempura oyster, curly fries and oyster fritter. Tempura oysters was very delicious, crispy and the oyster was very fresh. The oyster fritter was my first time trying and was mot bad. Goes well with the buttered bread but I wish they had given the fritter a little char. The curly fries was quite generous with the serving size. Overall delicious, but wish they add a little bit of salad to tone down the oil. Was quite thirsty and the oiliness made me not feel so well afterwards. However I stil enjoyed my meal here.
Fabulous Food, Outside eating area , Fresh Oysters were Delicious a Oyster Lovers Spot for sure
The oysters are simply fabulous!! Creamy juicy and a nice size. A good price too!
Lovely food, al fresco dinning, friendly quick service. They have a shop where you can buy your oysters and smoked salmon too.😋 Busy little place.
Amazing food and best place on a nice day. Freshness guaranteed

I'm generally not a fussy eater, especially when it comes to Thai food. But that was a horrible dining experience and I don't think we will be back. The mixed entree & tofu was cold & hard. The red curry beef was not fragrant as I know Thai curry to be. Of everything we ate tonight, the plain rice was the best. So not impressed.
Cozy, nice decorated restaurant. Delicious meals and fresh ingredients, highly recommend the steamed fish boat special

I've been to a few Thai places and I would have to say this is thee best... flavor, great quantity, nice service, gotta say this is my favorite Thai restaurant ☺️ This dish is called Medium(heat) Chicken Pad Ped with plain white rice.

Nice tasty food with a wide selection. Team are friendly and food was done fast and came out hot. If you’re not from Glen Eden may be hard to find. It’s the entrance near the ATM machine at the Glen Eden shops. Go up some stairs and they have pink walls. Can’t miss it then. Nice and tidy inside, has table service and take away.

Love the food, have been their customers for years. Takeaway orders served fast and always on time. Fabulous food, lovely staff. The parking for pick up is not the best, but pretty much always have a spot on Friday-Saturday nights. I have never stayed for dine-in but saw people quite frequently arranging big dinners with their BYO.

We have had a LIMO pizza before from a different store and it was good. So ordered another one last night. Absolutely abysmal. All base, no topping. Virtually no cheese at all. The onion rings and wedges were good though.
Restaurant is kept clean and tidy, however there is no one to welcome. We had to call the attention of the crew to place the order.
Amazing service fast and great food 1000% recommend to anyone nearby who needs a good selection of pizzas

Guys having no words to express this place is so decent and all the young guys doing so well. They are fast accurate and offcourse upto date in their work. They are working in a system 1 guys in making 1 guy in cutting and 1 guy in counter for taking orders and all are helping eachother there is good coordination between them which makes there work easy and offcourrse less waiting time for customers.
Best pizza hut in Auckland. service 10/10, very kind staff. pizza 10/10, (best is pepporoni.) Always quick service :) Me and my friends love it there and make it a ritual to get pizza from there.

A fantastic experience at Bodega Eatery! The food was absolutely delicious and the portion sizes were just right. Everything came out within 20 minutes, which was great. What really made our visit though was the staff – they were incredibly lovely and so welcoming, especially to our furry friend who joined us for coffee. Highly recommend!

Popped in for dinner plenty of parking available which was great nice private setting where you feel your not even in west auckland. We were seated right away, ordered drinks and decided on the steak meal. You have a choice of Salad or veges which is good as I was craving some veges that day. Steak was well done which is what I asked for the roasted veges were crispy too and not oily like mostly places. Reasonable pricing nice atmosphere place very clean.

It was a good sunny day and Bodega was the best place to have lunch. Food was great, service was fast and friendly. Great menu with lots of choices. Meat ball pasta special for today was just too good . Plenty of parking available.

The location = top notch away from the road, quiet on a farm kind of mixture vineyard setting. Awesome location for a relaxing lunch or dinner. Ordered the steak. Cooked perfectly, the size was alot smaller than most places I've visited for a 250 - 300g fillet. Service was quick, felt welcomed. Will return go try other menu options also being a glen eden local.

This is a hidden gem in West Auckland. Set down a winding tree lined driveway 🌳 away from the main road and amongst beautiful old buildings is Bodega Eatery ✨️ A gorgeous Mediterranean inspired restaurant lies in the midst of an old vineyard 🍇 and has the elegance of a beautiful villa 🕍 With inside or outside seating and an extensive menu including tapas, burgers 🍔 pasta 🍝 pizza 🍕 steak 🥩 salads 🥗 sharing platters 🧀🫓 and magic cocktails 🍹 We chose delicious dishes from the tapas menu and we were delighted by the sumptuous flavors of the panfried chorizo woth mushrooms and garlic, the potato bombas filled with mouthwatering mince, cheese and potato, lightly crumbed and fried 👌 perfect polenta chips with creamy aioli and panfried chilli prawns 🌶🍤 everything was simply sumptuous 🤤 finishing off with a rich, thick Italian hot chocolate ☕️ and although it was busy, the staff were super attentive and the whole atmosphere was pleasant and relaxing ☀️There was even large board games on the lawn for children 🧩 Will definitely be back and sure to book a seat under an outdoor umbrella overlooking the lush rural setting with a glass of rose in hand 🍷 Bodega has fast become my new favourite place to meet up with friends 🧡

After coming once before, we have come back as a family with higher expectations than the last time. We cannot express the absolute wonderful experience at Katmandu. The beautiful decor around the restaurant adds to the identity of the restaurant and the culture too. This restaurant deserves all the praise that they receive and will receive in the future. The food is quickly prepared and served with absolute excellence. I wish to thank the owner for the opportunity to experience such cuisine. To possible new customers, my family and I urge you to visit and experience Kathmandu for yourself.
Has delicious food, wonderful service, we had a great time here. Highly recommend to those who love Nepalese and Indian food🙏👍️👍️
Great food and service. We usually get takeaways but decided to dine in this time, would recommend.
We consistently get delicious meals from here! The curries are flavoursome. The vege pakoras (photos) are a winner! Highly recommend this place! PS: the chocolate naan are just soooo good!
Great food, great value. Kathmandu kitchen was a pleasant surprise for us!

It was a bit of a hit and miss. I always see the place and decided to try it today. I liked that it was open early, it's convenient for someone who works night shift. I ordered the fish deal which is fish, chips, and a drink for $6. The fish was tasty, nice and thick. Good skin, not oily, and about 10 chips. For $6 you can't really expect too much. I ordered an additional egg burger. The egg was cooked perfectly, nice and runny. The patty was thin, but fine. The burger bun was soft and fresh, but that caused the whole burger to fall apart and it was very messy and difficult to eat. It took quite long to receive my order, even though I was the only person in shop. But then again if it's freshly made, it will take a bit of time. Did I enjoy it? It was good enough for the price. Will I buy here again? Maybe, but I won't be rushing back.

To be fair • the place was clean, • the guy who served me was friendly, • the fried breads were big and fluffy so props for that, ❌ but the oil could’ve been drained better. •The battered fish was nicely cooked, ❌ but I wasn’t a fan of the fried bread batter they used and it took forever to wait for 1 piece of fish. •Now the raw fish? 🐟 ❌ Massive letdown.! Terrible standards for a well known company. It was basically fish in milk. No flavor, no, spring onion, cucumber, tomato, or lemon! Just plain and disappointing. Shameless to charge people $7 for a tub of milky fish water with 5 tablespoons of fish! Cut it out! I’ll be sticking with the Bait Shop at Māngere Bridge. They never cut corners on quality or skimp on ingredients.
The fish I got is plain disgusting but the chips ok. Mediocre as far chips go. I would only come back here if nothing else was open. Maybe it would be healthier to starve tho.
Absolute rip off. $25 for 10 oysters NOT even a dozen ! One of them turned green by the next morning - good god. Prices don’t make sense.

Toby’s Seafood Massey : I ordered battered mussels and a fish n chip combo with sausages. The battered mussels were absolutely next level. Best I have ever had. Fat, juicy with all the juices contained in the batter. Just what I was craving for. since moving to NZ. Wanted real fish n chips from a business that cared about the quality of food they produce. Yay, I have final found a great fish n chip shop. Looking forward to trying everything else on the menu💯❤️🕺🏽🎶🎉🔥

Disgusting, absolutely disgusting...Ordered two takeaways and paid. Then observed a large amount of food sitting on a stainless steel bench (next to an open waste hole) with flies flying around and on the food. I took images and the female became very abusive and was speaking rapidly to her 4 other male cooks in a foreign language. I was told to stop "filming" and felt threatened. Eat here at your peril...I have reported this to the Auckland Council as I see they have an A grade for food hygiene AND there are diplomas on the wall for having passed food hygiene standards! You have to be kidding...this is disgusting and should be a D FOLLOWED UP BY AUCKLAND CITY COUNCIL INSPECTORS: I attended a site visit to Noodle Canteen on 20/03/2024 as a result of your complaint. My inspection revealed breaches of the Food Act. As a result enforcement action was taken in the form of an improvement notice. This noticed will be followed by the business and a follow up inspection will occur to ensure compliance. "A" grade has been removed and replaced with a "D" grading by Auckland Council Inspector
The best noodle canteen. Love the combination soup, tasty broth and mixture of meats cooked perfectly. Perfect for my cold and this chilly weather. Noodles also very tasty, will try more dishes😋😋
Very fast but food is not good. The noodles aren't mixed through well and the flavours don't taste authentic. The Kuai Teow had no sauce and serving sizes are too big and expensive for one person
Delicious Chinese food and vegan, gluten-free bubble tea 🧋 😻 Welcome to BYO bottle and straw for zero-waste drink 👌🏻 Quick and friendly service, will definitely come again!

Ordered 2x honey chicken on noodles. It was like all the flavour was missing and they forgot to add the vege. The pieces of chicken were tiny and very small portions overall. They weren’t busy. We were the only customers. Absolutely will not be back.

The best Malaysian-style fish fillet curry laksa I have ever had. My friend dines here often and he highly recommended I try their food, it was my first time. Our conversation was cut short once the food arrived, there was no time to talk but eat and enjoy every mouthful as my taste buds were having a party! Inside the cafe it's rather small and intimate, I counted 20 seats available inside, they have tables outside but it's too cold to be dining outdoors in autumn and winter is just around the corner. It wouldn't be ideal if you were after a space to have private and confidential conversations because nearby tables and customers can hear you. The staff are friendly, polite and helpful and I will be back for more curry laksa. Thank you for a delicious, mouth-watering experience.

Located on the railroad of Glen Eden station. a bit run-down, overdecorated creating a weird atmosphere. Unexpectedly, we couldn’t enjoy food at all because we were busy shooing away many flies and even found a thick, short, black hair in the rice. They should work on food hygiene and pest control.

I can’t believe I haven’t reviewed this Malaysian restaurant yet! It’s the only Malaysian spot in the area since I moved here, and it has never let me down. The staff is always kind, and the food is consistently delicious. I can’t pick a favorite dish, but I’ve had many Nasi Lemak and Seafood Curry Laksa—both are amazing!

Generous portions ensure delightful satisfaction without breaking the bank. Meals are so substantial that they can easily last for two days. The convenient location makes it easy to stop by. The staff provides exceptional service, creating a welcoming atmosphere. It's a true value for a satisfying dining experience.
Food was good. We ordered hainanese chicken rice, nasi lemak beef, roti canai and tofu salad. Overall was really good. Place was a little old and small but still okay. Service was average

Honestly the best fish & chips I’ve tried out west! The fish is fresh & they are massive. Has a little crunch to it which I love and the chips are on and they aren’t stingy with the portions. Comb 5 is the go so worth it! 6 fish, 3 scoops of chips, 3 hot dogs & 2 1.5 drinks which was a total of $51.00. The photos I took don’t do justice haha so deffs try it out!
Really good 👍 impressed, fresh fish, crispy chips, good portion size esp loaded fries! Burgers good too.

The food was nice and portion size was okay. The chicken pieces was yummy but they don’t sell them anymore which sucks. The service was really good! The burger and seafood was yummy too. If the burger could have more seasoning on the burger patty that would nice. Lovely owners :) wish them all the best!
One of the best fish I've had in awhile, better than most fish in Glen Eden. Good size fish too, nice and crispy batter 👍🏽. The chips was fine, standard but still fine. Hope it stays like that.
Great chicken . Loaded wedges were tasty and crisp I prefer less mayo though. The fish and chips and sausage were lovely and fresh. No photos sorry we ate it all.

The best Duck cashew stir fry I have tried. I also always get the chicken satay skewers as no one else makes them the way they do. The portion sizes are generous and fairly priced. 10/10 highly recommend!!

The best out west! Pad Thai Glen Eden is go to when craving Thai food. They are consistent so I know I am in for a tasty meal no matter what I order. I have always had my meals takeaway, though the dining area is nice and clean, making a wait (if there is one) feel comfortable. Quick, easy, and friendly takeaway service.
Very nice local Thai takeaway. Dined here too. Great fast service with friendly staff. Lived up to it's recommendation. Parking nearby.

New to the Area of Glen Eden, Found this place via Google. Chicken satay skewers were on point. Ordered the beef Pad Thai, my thoughts were average. Standard pad Thai. Would like to try other food choices on the menu.

Well I have had a lot of different Thai food over the years and pad Thai glen eden is the best this far!! Quality food at the best price! The chicken, prawn, broccoli dish is my favourite! Chef’s special ask at counter! Great for the gains lol

We have had their indo chinese offerings and have ALWAYS been wowed. The taste is consistently the same! The quantity is great. They make their sauces inhouse from scratch and they are absolutely heavenly! Especially the schezwan sauce and the bombay chutney. Absolutely amazing! The indo chinese food is authentic and we highly recommend. The pricing is vwry reasonable. We had the egg fried rice and vegetarian manchurian. We have also had the chicken lollypops. The food was phenomenal! The staff has astute attention to detail, they are very hospitable and passionate about their cooking and ensuring their customers have a great experience. We hope more people will find out about this gem and give it a go! We will definitely be going back time and time again! Thank you team Bombay Kitchen. Big Kudos to all of you 🙏🏻

Such a pathetic place. Due to sudden unplanned power outage, we decided to visit some restaurant for lunch, and after finding some better reviews, reached this place. Paid 60$+ for 3 naan, 2 curries and one small non veg platter. Almost every other nice restaurant would cost similar for the mentioned food but the service, quality etc sucks here. I mean the food was not presentable, I believe I never had such a worse food experience throughout my life, such restaurants should be closed, they are a curse to food. Chicken or Lamb Samosa had 80%potato, goat/lamb curry had taste of every spices in a very non uniform way, rice was not of a good quality and many more. Would never recommend to any one. 0 Stars.

I had an unforgettable experience at Bombay Kitchen in Auckland! I tried the Masala Chicken and Naan, and both were absolutely amazing—rich, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. The spices were spot on, and the naan was fresh, soft, and delicious. But what made this visit truly special was the atmosphere. I sang a Hindi song for the kitchen staff, and they joined in! We all sang together and had such a great time—it felt like a real celebration of food, culture, and connection. Not only does Bombay Kitchen serve incredible Indian food, but they also have the kindest and most welcoming staff. If you’re looking for a place with amazing food and even better vibes, this is it! Highly recommended!

Just Wow! I am a convert, their food is authentic and amazing, The price is very good and the food portions are large, The Butter Chicken Hot is yum, The Cheese and Garlic Nan bread is delicious and the Chicken Tikka is amazing, I have also tried the Mango Chicken, it was good, I can see that I will have to work my way through most of their menu! Thank you.
Highly satisfied with the order. Quick service and great taste.

Great local F&C/Chinese takeaway. Good price great quantity. The family plates are a good option. Chicken nibble and chips also good choice. Chips are fresh and crisp. Have been going to this location since moving into glen eden area.

Best fish an chip takeaway shop on Bruce McLaren road. Worth ringing up and making an order! Very crisp crunchy chips well seasoned and salted. Crisp crunchy batter on all deep fried food. Exceptional flavor on chow meins.
Just bought the $12 special, Two huge pieces of fish. 2 crab sticks and chips, Delicious and good portion sizes compared to other takeaways

The fish is so delicious, the batter is crispy and the fish is fresh. The chips were crispy, not too oily, or over cooked and you can tell it's clean oil. The hot dogs were also delicious and crispy on the outside, not too oily or soggy even with the sauce! My only complaint was $2 chips wasn't a big portion but I get it, chips are expensive. Really yum, we'll be back!
Hands down the BEST chips out west! Crunchy on the outside and fluffy on the inside, the oil isn't old and it has a beautiful nutty flavour, SO GOOD!!!! Will not go anywhere else for hot chips 😍👍🏽

Chef billy is turning out well executed meals and very decent prices . Chicken breast in coconut sauce was very good . Accommodated the other halfs changes to her steak meal . Daughters fish n chips was great Real nice hearty food . Bang for buck 10/10 Bloody impressed Thanks Dion

I took my grandson (or did he take me!) to the RSA for a night of karaoke and dinner. There's something special about Glen Eden RSA, and being in a friendly place where everyone is having a great time. The boy was stoked and all set to sing but in the face of such excellent voices, decided not to. Kei te pai. We ordered fish and chips for dinner. I'd heard fantastic reports of Chef Billy Tauata but never in all my years have I enjoyed fish and chips more (and I've eaten in Yorkshire the home of f&ch). Superbly succulent fish, the crispiest batter I've ever eaten, delicious chips and salad - tino reka for sure. No reira Matua Billy, Na to kai tino pai i tino motuhake to māua māua huihuinga. Nga mihi nui ki a koe me te ringa wera. The lovely barman even carried our drinks to the table - what service is that?? For a relaxed, no-hassle, light-hearted evening, forget the city's snooty $200 snack dinners and stay local, you will NOT do better.

Decided to try this roast place out as we normally go to Stanley’s roast I got the pork roll and a lamb roll today which is $7 per roll if you upgrade to a combo it is $9.50 and you get a can of drink from the coke range with two potatoes which is cheap compared to a roll at Stanley’s roast The pork was good but small what I would recommend is using a roll that is less thick as my roll today was mainly bread not much pork inside as it is chopped up very small same goes for the lamb roll, apart from that pricing here is much cheaper then other places they also have an A grade which is proudly on display at the front most places you have to look around for the grading will have to come back next time and try the roast meals

Their pork and chicken rolls are good value and very yummy too. The only problem is it's unclear when they are open or closed. I often go there to find that the shop is closed. The prices quoted are very old and need to be updated. Still no idea when they are open or closed

Roast shop with a good range of meals, rolls, and fried chicken and potatoes. Good bundles and friendly owners. The chicken is good and fresh, not too oily and they usually ask you what pieces you want. Prices are good. PayWave is available.
Old potatoes! Tasted so not like a potato. Maybe replace your cooking oil or buy fresh potatoes. Binned the whole bag! So disappointing!

Unfortunately, the pork meal and lamb meal I bought were full of days old and cold potatoes. The veges tasted old as well, not too impressed with the meal I had as I barely finished it. The only thing that tasted fresh was the meat really. Although the food was disappointing, the service and attitude of my server was good he was very nice.

Best kebab restaurant ever..! Kind and honest staff.. Now let’s talk about the food—absolutely delicious! Every dish we tried was full of flavor, freshness, and beautifully presented. The [kebab roll], was a standout, perfectly cooked and packed with taste. It’s clear that the kitchen team puts a lot of heart and effort into every plate they serve.. If you’re looking for a place with great service and even better food, I highly recommend this spot. It’s definitely worth visiting again!...

When you read these reviews and they say this is the BEST, believe them! I recieved my food at around 3:15am through UberEats and because of my previous experience purchasing kebabs from other stores, I half expected the chicken to be dry or the Veges to have lost its freshness and I really didnt expect much effort into the preparation, but I was hungry so i was going gonna accept whatever I got. But after trying (and devouring) everything I ordered which was A Chicken Kebab, Chips, and Chicken & Rice ( for the hubby ) everything was delicious and spot on! The chicken, the vegetables, the rice, the wrap, ALL Fresh tasting and flavorful. The vegetables still had its integrity, the chicken was flavoured well and though a few tiny little dry bits, the rest was nice and moist. The rice for my hubbys chicken and rice was the best ive tried from a kebab store here, along with the Hummus and Vege it came with. They were really generous with there sauces and in the ingredients they used which I LOVED and last but definitely not least, the Chips! They were seasoned well, and still had a cruch and freshness to it, despite traveling 12 mins to get to my place. Serving up 5/5 food at 3am in the morning really deserves a 10!

Tucked away a real gem, full of hard working staff with big hearts. They have a wonderful food for the needy charity initiative and the food they make is fresh and delicious! Thanks so much guys for making the world better! One kebab at a time! Long may they run!

I got kebab on chips that’s overpriced the same amount of quantity I can get it for $18 when you guys are charging $21 and your guys food stained is not there at all got food poisoning as well now need to go home from work after eating your guys food your stuff is not even wearing glove cross contamination happening over there and also birds walking around in your shop chips is soggy meat quantities way less really unhappy with you guys’s food don’t even have fork to give to your customers …. I’m really not happy with you guys service today that I got
Hands down the best Authentic Turkish food in Auckland. If I could eat here everyday I would, definitely recommend the chicken Kebabs and chicken on rice, the rice is seasoned so well

At present this has to be one of, if not the best fish and chips in West Auckland. The value and quality you get is hard to beat. It reminded me of all the old Croatian owned fish and chip shops that used to litter the city I got the $9.99 combo today which had 3 small pieces of gurnard, 2 potato fritters and chips - outstanding. Props to the owner!

Had the most amazing experience here last night. As someone who can’t have gluten all I have wanted is some fish and chips and this place did not disappoint. We ordered some normal stuff from my children which they also said was amazing. I was very impressed how everything gluten free was kept seperate from the other stuff. The service was amazing. I can’t wait to go back. Below is the gluten free fish and chips.

Just had ordered delivered by Uber Eats and feeling utterly ripped off and disappointed. Photo of potato fritter size against a teaspoon. So small and just hard crunchy inedible batter hardly potato. Then the "King" prawns at $2.50 each also also compared to teaspoon. Way too much salt piled on and sausages plus hotdog were tasteless. Fish badly overcooked. Sorry but just wouldn't order again or recommend. Great you have such a huge menu but maybe just do less and make it appropriate price/quality.

Placed an order on Uber eats, got it delivered to Ranui and the food was still hot and fresh. Well seasoned wedges, beautiful pieces of crumbed hoki, and a great hotdog on a stick, very nice batter which wasn’t too thick.
Great fish burger. I went for the snapper. It does not beat the ones you’d eat in the Coromandels, but in West Auckland, this is fantastic.
Food came fast and food was fresh. I had French toast with bacon and it was delicious. Good price. Tables were very clean. Went at 8am on Monday and there were not many people there.

The best chicken and chips ever. We always order the A11 special. 3 pieces of chicken with half cooked chips and 4 dim sim lol Best place for breakfast or lunch. Clean restaurant with plenty of seating. Friendly staff. Highly recommend because the food is as good as their customer service.

Seems to be a local favourite. Breakfast/brunch/lunch options cooked to order. Also a range of pies/sandwiches/slices and cakes. Offers a range of hot/ cold drinks as well. Diner-ish type vibes, looks a bit tired. This place could be something really special with a bit of a touch up. Have been here a few times now, some times food tastes better than other times. The breakfast pancakes, super filling, recommend.

I love coming here. Their food is amazing! It's always fresh and tasty. They have a great menu to choose from. There is about 15 different $4.50 lunch boxes. They also have ready made food-to-go including sandwiches, pies, chips, chicken pieces, chips, kebabs, etc. They also have a good range of baked goods.

The cafe is great place for getting a quick snacks. The food is always fresh and not and delicious. I took butter chicken pie and it was delicious. You can dine in too. Plenty of places to seat and eat. Hot and cold drinks are available as well. Totally loved the service and will definitely try again if I go in this area. Highly recommended

Efficient and friendly, found portion size of fries to be very generous and good value. Cheese burger was on the smaller size but tasty and came in it own packaging which was good for transporting. Parking limited out front so can be challenging during busy periods.

Only gave 2 stars for the burgers and (lack of) chips. The butter chicken is inedible, it's horribly sweet, dark brown, looks and tastes nothing at all like butter chicken. Tried to fix it with lemon, didn't work and now cooking dinner for my daughter on takeout night. Can't be bothered driving back down there and won't be going back
Great butter chicken an nan bread good prices an great service
Just recently moved to the area so thought I'd try here, good prices and portion sizes! Really great and friendly customer service too, will definitely be back!

I love this place , it has been consistently good ever since i started going here when the new owners took over, the service is always great too. Homemade potato fritters are top notch and always something new to try.
Best Chinese food out West. Chips and fried food also good. Best Spring rolls. Very lovely people.
Yummy burgers and chips. Staff are so lovely. Nothing much to look at in terms of atmosphere, it's Hendo 😊 Thank you for serving our community 👌
My take-out soft noodles not much seasonings plus steak tomatoes on fried rice!!🤨
Probably the best value for money in these parts of west Auckland. Food is palatable portions are generous.

Yum!!! Got beef fried rice, was delicious! and wontons, they were so good! Great amount of meat, not oily and great crunch! Drove from Henderson to Kumeu and was still hot when I got home. 100% recommend, exited to try more :)

Ordered lamb roast on DoorDash So delicious! Perfect amount of gravy, meat is super juicy and flavoursome veggies are cooked perfectly. Perfect for me as a uni student, it reminds me of home. Definitely a comfort meal❤️
What a pleasant surprise! Traveled from south Auckland to taste the roast chicken, and I was utterly amazed! The potatoes were fantastically cooked. I definitely recommend it.

Best roast shop in the west. First came here about 13 years ago and its good to see they are still the same owners and the food is consistant everytime. My goto choice is the small pork meal and the #1 snack pack. The fried chicken is a must try.

Absolutely rude and a roll full of Grissly fat, asked for crackling and he gives me a soft piece I said can I please get a crunchy piece, he then trys to tell me it's all the same, it was right in front of me, he reluctantly gave me a replacement, I have to say I've put up with the rudness especially his wife, babling in her native tongue under her breath, but no more there's plenty of other roast places, got to learn customer service counts for a lot. Sort yourselves out. DISGUSTING SERVICE.

I used to get potatoes and gravy and was a pretty frequent customer. The prices were not consistent so decided to query him about it, got yelled at and told to get out. Customer service is at an all time low. Wife tried to help and explain to me what was going on but the man kept shouting at me. Will never be back again.

A hidden gem in Gleneden, if you are after tasty fried kchicken look no further. Dined here for dinner as first timers after reading reviews and now we understand why this place has a high rating. Very friendly customer service. We were welcomed with big smiles and served right away. Sushi was 100% tasty and the fried chicken with mini hashbites were the best I have had. Flavour and coating was just too good, you know the chicken is good when you dont need to add the side sauces on. Prices very reasonable too. With a wide range to try. I would definitely recommend this place. Can't wait to come back and try out the rest of the menu. Thank you for the beautiful food❤️
they sell such amazing food, the prices are so good for the portions you get, i definitely recommend this place to everyone. This is 100% worth the money thank you so much for the perfect meals❤️

Really amazing foods with reasonable prices! We can enjoy real Japanese st. Donburi. They were very friendly and kind when we went into the store. I will visit again 100%!!!! I strongly recommend it!!! Their atmosphere is very cozy and warm!!! And we can choose various side options ❤️

Local to glen eden. Found this place via Google. My decision to visit this place was due to the positive reviews left by previous customers who experience this business. Ordered the beef pho and 2 x korean fried chicken. I believe one was snowy cheese and the other honey and soy. Apologies if incorrect. Food was perfect, the couple who run this place are lovely, friendly and very welcoming. We dined in. Food was served within a matter of minutes nice and hot. Compliments to the team here at Sushi & pho. We will be back to enjoy other options on the menu.

Craved for beef pho and this restaurant so far is the best place to go to in West Auckland (Glen Eden)! I do agree that the beef pho they served was really yum and had a decent amount of beef in it with noodles, perfect with sriracha & hoisin sauce. 😊 The staff and food service was really nice and fast too. First time coming here tonight and will try the other dishes next time.

Terrible experience with Glen Eden Takeaways. Went to pick up my order, and the older Asian man working there told me it wasn’t their shop — even though it 100% was. The name matched, the location matched, everything. I double-checked the order and called the number listed… and he answered the phone. Same guy. Instead of clearing things up, he told me not to come back and insisted again that it wasn’t their shop. Extremely unprofessional and honestly just rude. If you mess up, own it — don’t confuse and blame the customer. Won’t be coming back.

Service is good 👍 Friendly smiles. Unfortunately food is disgusting. Being here twice First time was average? Second time worse! Parking is terrible unless you park out the back of the shop, cause there's plenty of parking spaces out the back. The front of the takeaway A little dangerous cause traffic is in your face. Ain't going back to this takaway no more .. Prices are reasonable Shame bout the food quality 👎

Best value cheap Fish and chip takeaways in Glen Eden. Chicken nibbles 10/10 Fish 10/10 ( for the price, never had a bad fish) Burger value 10/10 (considering price) Hidden Gem in Glen Eden, cheap as chips for everything..Great value, best fried chicken nibbles in the area and cheap eats fish, chips Burgers.

ordered food waited 30 mins and they gave my order to someone else by accident , the person they gave it to then brought it back opened saying it wasnt their order , the shop swapped it out and then re wrapped it and gave it to me , all the food was cold.

Man I love that this place is open late that’s really handy! Sometimes the lady miscalculates the price sometimes. And I can’t seem to get a decent amount of chips ever ! It feels like a total rip off in that sense we even tried buying 10 scoops of chips (about $4 each) and got them to wrap it separately just to see how big their “scoops” where and I swear they must of used a teaspoon 🤣🤣

The restaurant was nice, clean, and tidy.. The menu looked delicious, and there were plenty of tempting options.. However, the chicken I ordered was a bit cold and not as enjoyable as I had hoped.. The fries and biryani rice were okay..

I had a great experience overall. The food was delicious, well-prepared, and served fresh. The service was prompt and courteous, and the staff were friendly. I would definitely recommend this place to others and look forward to visiting again.
I came here with my son for the first time and the service great. Unfortunately the fries came out undercooked. Chicken was ok.

I had an excellent experience thanks to Damini’s outstanding customer service. She was friendly, helpful, and went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect. Really appreciated her professionalism and positive attitude. Highly recommend!

Not happy with the poor service and staff not aware of their deals. Had to ask the staff 3 times about the deal and had to explain it to him in Hindi as he didn't speak English that well. They prioritizeed their time on online orders and uber orders more while patrons had to wait 20+ minutes for their meals. Plus I had to go back and double check with them again as they had my order written wrong on the receipt. Don't think I'll be going there anytime soon.

I was skeptical by judging this takeaway based on its look from the outside. I was intrigued by the amount of people who flocked this place everytime I drove past. Being judgemental without trying food from here I finally managed to stop and purchase a few items. I have been back a few more times to ensure that it wasn't first time fluke or beginners luck that the food was good. It actually is. Best chips in glen eden hands down. I refuse to go anywhere but here for the chips and cooked meals eg: fried rice and chow mein.
Wonton soup I received, Was perfect! flavour of the soup, drank most of it first, perfectly cooked wontons those were delicious. Ordered on deliver easy, pleasantly suprised how great it was 😊

I bought the insanely priced $28 BBQ pork chop suey and it made me feel sick all night! The staff weren't particularly nice acting like I was just more business rather than a valued customer, it also seemed like they barely spoke English😕. The place itself is super off putting, I obviously should have trusted my instincts. It's grimey, there's almost no seating for while you wait and to top it all off- there's a rather unpleasant odour emanating from the kitchen. NOT a good experience, luckily though I wasn't robbed waiting outside the store for almost 40 minutes, the surrounding area gives off bad vibes. I definitely won't be coming back here, BEWARE NEW GOERS, YOU'VE BEEN WARNED!

The most delicious wonton soup EVER and your large trays @ $68.00 should increase price to $70 truly worth it, some may moan, but they know it's yummy, yummy, yummy, they will pay extra $2 bucks your hard work and delivery on service 5 stars. Please move to Ranui. If I win lotto I will buy you a premium space and gift full ownership to you.

1. Fast service take away, 10 min 2. Perplexed screen and hand sanitizer available for customer to use. It shows they care 3. Both Chefs are friendly and they smiled to me. I was treated with kindness and respect. 4. Mr Chef informed that they offer additional service, can call my mobile while I wait in car. No bother, I waited in store and watched. 5. Watched them Chefs cook, they were incredibly putting a lot of passion and effort in it. 6. Meal, non greasy. 7. Definitely recommend you all to buy food hear 8. Notice board for customers with food allergies and their cleaning services. 9. It is an " A Grade" Takeaway 10. Excellent overall.
author_name: The Blue Eyed Nanny ten Hoorn Boer

text: Had a life-changing feed at Glen Eden Food Bar with my mate Dimitri. The food was so good we nearly cried—fresh, packed with flavour, and made with serious love. Check the photo: that massive smile on Dimitri’s face isn’t staged, that’s the look of a man who’s just discovered heaven on a plate. He was laughing like he just unlocked a new level of happiness. 10/10, absolutely coming back for round two.

Couldn't fault my first two meals from this place...fish n chips were good as were the donuts, spring rolls and pineapple fritters. By far some of the most flavoursome chinese Ive had in recent weeks. Last night I wasn't impressed by my fish n chips at all and threw it out. Everything was way over cooked. Hopefully they sort it out soon or another ones gona bite the dust.

Worst experience I’ve ever had and I never leave reviews but man come on guys if you make the food properly not just for quick bucks you will have people coming back to order. Im beyond shocked at the quality and the quantity!!! Well I ordered roast pork on rice, the pork was so thinly cut hard and dry like pork had been reheated so many times or burnt absolutely no juice no taste nothing, rice was so dry and packed to the top for $17. Bbq pork special $10 most pieces were mainly fat nothing compared to pictures from previous reviews.

First time, as I’m not around here… Throughs to pop in and try this place out… 1. Take too long for my food to get ready. One person came after me and they did her one first , before my food. 2. There was not much meat in my order. 3. The fish and chips, no thank you…

New to the Glen Eden area and found this place via Google. Ordered the 2 x burgers and chips with half duck and half KG BBQ pork. The Burger I ordered (standard pattie & lettuce) are basic but to the point and fulfilling. Good fresh lettuce soft bun. The Duck was brilliant, BBQ pork could do with a little more effort but above average. Have been here twice in the last week. Will become my regular for Duck and BBQ pork. Keep up the good quality food and service.

Incredible experience. The best Italian food I’ve had in a long time. The staff were so friendly and accomodating, the restaurant was humming with other guests having a great time and the food was outstanding from start to finish. Every dish we had was so flavourful that I can’t possibly decide which was best. I can’t wait to go back and try other things on the menu because there was so much to choose from! I knew we were going to be in for a treat but I didn’t expect it to be this good! If you live further away it’s definitely worth the trip, you have to tick this place off if you enjoy Italian food (who doesn’t?)

Excellent establishment. Family owned business I'm assuming. Felt very welcomed here from entering the front door, to being greeted & seated, explanation of specials right through to entire service. Have not felt this standard of attentiveness in hospitality for a very long time. Glad to have visited this establishment being a local of glen eden. Will definitely be back here with our family to share the experience. Entrees were speechless, mains were cooked perfectly. We ordered steak with cheese sauce and walnuts (unable to spell or pronounce properly) but it accompanied the meat 100 percent. We also enjoyed the dessert we had. Probably one of the best places I have reviewed over my years of visiting different establishments around NZ. La Rosa Resutaurant = Top Notch punching above and beyond expectations. The benchmark of hospitality service 💯

Great restaurant. Been here maybe twice and enjoyed it both times. The service is really great and the staff are willing to help. The food is also delicious and I would recommend the chocolate caramel cake with the ice cream or something like that for the dessert. It was DELICIOUS!
Celebrated our wedding anniversary and did not disappoint. Every food is delicious and the customer service is superb. We will surely recommend and come back again ❤️❤️

The food is amazing, from the appetizers to the desserts. There isn’t a single dish I’ve tried that I wouldn’t want to eat again and again. The service is always impeccable and one of a kind. I must say, this is definitely a place you NEED to experience. Certainly my favorite restaurant in New Zealand.

First time to visit Thai Chawa. I ordered a red curry (lamb) amd two Pad Thai, one Lamb and one Beef. All meals were presented beautifully and full of authentic Thai flavour. My red curry came with some white rice. My only negative was that I thought that there could have been more meat in the curry. That aside the food was delicious and well priced. Pictures are attached please excuse my thumb in the red curry shot!

Our go to place for halal thai food — hands down the best place for tom yum soup (my fav!) and tom kha (my husband’s fav!). Occasionally we try different things on the menu — they also do some Indo dishes — and we’ve liked everything we’ve tried so far. The staff are so friendly and smiley, we love coming here.

Nice little place that we had our dinner at. It’s newly opened and the food is awesome. The service was fault less and so was the food. We had the Tom yum soup, the chicken fried rice and the pad Thai. My 18 month old (very fussy eater) loved the fish cakes. Thanks and we will be back soon. Just told my parents so they are going for dinner today aswell.

Delicious Thai and Indonesian food with a reasonable prices. It is a good combination of asian popular menu. There is a lot of parking lot. Friendly service. There is more option for vegetarians menu. Delivery option should be coming soon. Have a go!

I recently dined at the new Thai restaurant near my house, and I was thoroughly impressed! The food was outstanding, with authentic Thai flavors and fresh ingredients. It’s a fantastic addition to our neighborhood, and I can’t wait to return for more. Highly recommended!
One of the nicest sushi stores I've been to, it is excellent the selection is so nice !!!!! Everything is so good

The food was wonderful. However, My finger got stuck while sliding the sushi door. That decreased my experience A LOT. My partner asked the owner to make the sliding door slower. The owner said I'm the first one. Meaning it's all my fault, I'm too clumsy, their attitude pissed me off a bit. They did offer me a bandage, that's nice. Just be careful when opening the sliding door, it's too fast too smooth. It will take me a week at least to heal. I can't give a good review after my injury no matter how good the food is. Sorry.

Such an amazing sushi shop with all those yummy gourmet sushi! All sushi are fresh and delicious! Love the Salmon Avo sushi, Grilled Prawn sushi, and beef spring Roll! Will definitely come back and try different flavours.

I was in the area and wanted to eat something healthy. Looked up sushi places nearby and found this one. Unbelievable. They have such an exquisite array of sushi that I’ve never seen before. The presentation was stunning, some of the sushi is made with black rice which is very healthy, portions were large and prices were very fair for such masterpieces. They tasted divine too. I loved the little egg pockets. YUM!!! I’ve never been impressed with chain sushi stores, so this takes the cake by miles. Thank you to the friendly owners for chatting to me as well.
A very different selection of Sushi. I travel from New Lyn to Glen Eden. The seafood in the tofu bag is delicious. Always fresh. So many different choices.
Had a yum pork roast roll combo via Uber eats. Great crackling, yum potatoes and not soggy at all. Only downside was I don't think mine had apple sauce.

If i could give it more stars, I would. My partner and I love the pork roasts, i get the medium and my partner gets the large. Excellent size for us, it is so filling, sometimes we save some for later. I love pork crackling but sometimes it can be quite hard to eat but here at the Glenmall roast, I can eat it all, not too hard and not to limp but just right. It's that yummy, that we eat it hot or cold. Love it

I always enjoy going to Glenmall Roast. Their food is absolutely delicious. I've never had any issues whatsoever. Their prices compare well with other roast places. I can appreciate that they weigh the food to ensure exact portions and that you don't get more or less every time you go. It ensures consistency. I would like some carrot in the mixed veg, although peas, corn, pumpkin, kumara, and potatoes are plenty of veggies. I love that they keep the pumpkin skin on. It's yum and so healthy for you. Their roast potato has a gorgeous crust and are soft and fluffy inside. I don't like that they only open at 5pm on a Sunday. That's crazy. We all want a lovely Sunday roast at at 12pm or 1pm. It doesn't make sense to open so very very late on a Sunday. When the lady dishes, she puts gravy on everything. The gentleman only puts gravy on the meat, even though I ask him to put gravy over everything. This is only a small complaint. They are both very friendly. I love their food and go at least three times a month. It seems they gave the place a little bit of a spruce up and have installed a lovely aircon for people who want to eat in.

Guy who served me seemed agitated and rushed while taking my order so I had to re tell him my order the whole time he made it. When making my pork sandwich he didn’t even cut a full slice of the pork off so hence why my sandwich is not even full of meat. Everything was warmish not even hot. Will not be back thanks

Not sure what to say about this place...went to buy some roast and saw them weighing the meat and that was it I just walked out. Sorta put me off...never seen that before. Can't comment on the actual food sorry.

Not like how it used to be ... Didn't feel welcome dno if it was bad timing or if something happened but the dude looked really annoyed when we placed our order. We came here awhile back and loved it . But now.. jeez I dno what happened ... The food quality has gone real bad... Tasted like it was cooked in old oil , chicken didn't have that nice kools taste. All round bad ... The lady that gave us the food when we came back to the door was very pleasant tho.
I got takeaway, the chips taste like the oil is weeks old. I got a chicken burger that the chicken was burnt to a crisp and thrown together with no care. The gravy was nice

Most delicious chicken and chips. Chicken is so juicy, tender and crispy. The chips is so flavored and crispy. Best takeaway chicken and chips I've eaten. Staff member is so friendly too. Best service and food. Would definitely go back and spread it to my friends.

Kool Chicken is certainly in the world of fried chicken. Their expertly seasoned and perfectly cooked chicken sets them apart from major brands. KFC has no chance against kool chicken. I think Kool Chicken delivers a taste that's both warm and unforgettable. What truly makes Kool Chicken special, was the lady who was working at the counter, she had genuine kindness and I could tell had a commitment to the community. From the moment you step inside, you're greeted not just by delicious food but also by warm hospitality, she is truely a gem. With every bite, you can taste the care and passion that goes into each dish, making Kool Chicken a must-visit destination for anyone craving both great food and a great experience. Thank you so much

Mediocre. The chicken was quite dry, but the coating was nice. Chips were nice, but i had to wait 16 minutes for an order of chips and chicken. Surely this is the most fundamental item on the menu of a chicken 'n chips place? Someone came in after me, ordered, got their food in about 6 or 7 minutes, then i had to continue waiting for another 8 or so minutes.

I may be wrong, but I think this is the last Kools Chicken in all of Auckland. There used to be one in Don Buck, but it has since become a Thai takeaway. They have the best seasoned chips. I would say it's on par with KFC's chips if KFC would seasoned their chips properly, not just seasoned the top of the chips once they're in the box. The chicken is nice and juicy. Most of the time you will get them fresh off the fryer. Please for the love of all that is holy do not close shop!
This is the best fried chicken and chips in the whole of Auckland.
All ways come here for the cheap chicken toasties.... 2 for 5bucks

Update: 6 Aug 2025 I have to update my review. The food is still good, but it is NEVER available. I went just after 10am (when they open) and was told they are still busy cooking and it will take 20 minutes. Two days later I went after 11am and there were maybe 2 options and it will take 20 minutes. Today I went at 12:30 and there were 4 options and they said it will take 20 minutes. So not only are they not providing food, but they are also lying about when the food will be ready. I asked if the food might be ready by 6pm and they just stood grinning like a bunch of clowns.
