Don't bother coming before at least 5pm! I don't know why this place is getting so much hate. As far as take aways go, it is not better or worse than most other places. Their food is perfectly fine. Some are better than some of their other food, e.g. the egg omelette is really good, but the chicken curry was a bit salty (personal preference). One or two times when I came they didn't have food a lot of food choices, but once was early in the morning and once was late at night, so fair enough. There's a place to sit and have your food. Parking might be a problem as those nearby is for the fruit & veg. But service is quick, so you can pop in and out quickly. The staff have always been nice. Today it may have seem like she was ignoring me, but they were starting to fry some food and had to check on the food not to burn it, so I get it. At the moment they have a 50% off special so yeah!

I don't understand why this place is ranked so low. The food is surprisingly cheap for the amount of servings you get. It's all seasoned really well and good whole foods the service is really friendly. Honestly my go to when I. In glen eden.

We ordered the $23 meal deal, 3 fish, 3 hot dogs, 4 potato fritters and chips. The chips were ok but the fish, hot dogs and potato fritters were very oily, dry, over cooked. Left a horrible taste in the mouth. Not going back there. Waste of money of $23 which could of been put on something else more better 🤮🤢

The food is usually good but not last night. Placed a phone order. The sweet n sour pork was DISGUSTING! It was like they dished up from the buffet out the front, rebattered and refried it. The pork was so over cooked it was like jerky! Time to find another Chinese takeaway! Oh and there was fk all meat in the combination fried rice n combination chowmein. The chowmein was full of brocoli and cauli but not much else! DISAPPOINTING!

If there was an option for zero stars on the food I would give zero. We spent $90 on a table full of food between only 2 of us. The Kumara was rock hard and dry, and I mean to the point where I couldn’t even finish 1 slice of it. The green banana was even worse. The fries were stale probably were in the cabinet overnight! The Lu sipi couldn’t taste any coconut cream. The only item I had that was somewhat near eatable was the flounder, but it was cold and the skin was sagging almost like it was air fried or something, not fried in oil. They had a place for us to sit but they made us put down a paper to cover the whole table as if we were little kids who would make a huge mess!. Just felt cheap all round. Definitely not worth $90!! Take your money elsewhere. I grew up in Glen Eden all my life and every takeaways there is fine. This new place is just NOT it.

$30pp buffet is well worth it, great service and the place is clean, but the table is very small and when you request for a bigger table, they say but that’s for 4 people sits.. true.. but… iykyk 😂 food is freshly made, and there’s ice cream too. Also they provide gloves for eating the fried chicken with hands, which is very thoughtful.

Worst take away food ever! Spicy tteokbokki had only 3 shrimps in it and wasn’t good. And the seasoned fried chicken tasted so old. I don’t recommend this place to anyone! Would have given 0 stars if i could.
I went to the buffet last week which was one of the best I had ever eaten. They had 3x different types of fried chicken and many different items. Highly recommended! Can’t wait to go again 😊

I went for their $30 buffet and I'm a bit divided. There was a lot of food options. The restaurant is much bigger than what it looks from the outside and I was pleasantly surprised by the big selection of food on their buffet. Although there was a lot of food choices, none of it was a stand out that I wanted to go back to it again and again. All the food was perfectly adequate, but not incredibly memorable. I was a bit disappointed by their chicken, which is supposed to be their speciality, given their name. The soy chicken was better, but quite sweet. I liked their coleslaw, kimchi, pickled veg, and sushi. It was fresh and tasty. There was a white soup which I couldn't identify, but was nice. The chef keeps bringing and filling the food, ensuring everything is fresh. There are four ice cream options for dessert. Will I recommend it? Yes. For $30 you're getting a lot of options and will definitely find something to like. Will I go again? Yes. But maybe not soon. I was very upset by another family who wasted so much food. The food they left behind was double than what I ate. It's just disgusting! People should be charged extra for wastage.
I ordered seasoned chicken nibbles, but only got the drumsticks (no wing parts).

This is a review worth reading. My lack of planning is no one else’s responsibility but my own. The potential of being late was great and I was going to have to cancel my order. I had an understandingly mad teenage boy in the car- but these people were the utmost of legends and had us on our way in no time! Outstanding customer service and care- I would like to apologise and thank you all once again. Now on to the food, the chips - I’m a huge fan of hot, crispy and salty goodness and it’s so hard to find nowadays- but these chips were so delicious- the salt is drool worthy, the crisp and ratio of chip - 10/10 The kebab - it happily satisfied the teenager who then gorged on the chips and onion rings. His only problem was that both ends were open - watch for drips! 9.78/10 from the teenager. His Nutella milkshake? Loved it, haven’t heard such slurping in years! We will be back, thank you so much for being understanding.

Awesome food. Good customer service. Big potion size and unbeatable prices. Foods are made fresh from the scratch. Therefore it will take quite a bit of time. Be prepare for the wait or order before you come. Overall food experience is on point. Keep it up 👍🏻😇

Great place for lunch. One thing to note is that this is not necessarily fast food! They do take time to make the meals (~15 mins) but it’s absolutely worth it because so much of it is fresh and made in house. Some of the sauces are delectable, and the lamb in particular is super flavourful, tender, and juicy. I’ve never had kebabs quite like I have had here, as none of the meats are processed, and it shows in the final outcome.
The meat is marinated extremely well. Should be a hit kebab spot for West Auckland and beyond 😍

YUM! EAT HERE! Great food, wonderful people, chill spot! I loved it, all the sauces are homemade and you can tell! They guys here made me a kebab with their own sauce mix and it was just so delicious. I was even grateful that the aluminum foil was durable and I could eat every last bit of my kebab. Also good price for the area 🫶

Ordered a buy 1 get 1 free classic cheese on UberEats & was very impressed. They're very generous with the cheese, the base was crispy on the bottom and not too sickly like a lot of other pan crust pizzas. The small pizza is more than enough for one person. Keen to give their other flavours a go!

Doordash order - Couldn't find information on how small a small is, but for $20.90 each(normally) I'd expect something more. The size of a small is as big as my hand spread. The taste of the butter chicken pizza was average. Wouldn't buy this flavour again. But would like to try another flavour in the future if they look at adjusting their pizza sizes or prices. I think some improvements could be made here hopefully this feedback can help :)

Have been here many times and the pizza is always so good! I generally always get the butter paneer as it’s my favourite. Freshly made, a bit spicy, and super delicious! The other vegetarian flavours are also very good, and a really good selection of options! Highly recommend!

Super delicious and affordable pizza. Way better than the three main pizza chains we'd usually go for. More cheese. Fresh toppings. More flavour. Nice base. Everyone was happy and surprised to actually have fast food that tasted good!! Will definitely buy there again.

I recently visited Pizza Boys in Glen Eden, and I couldn’t be more impressed! The pizza was absolutely delicious, with a perfect balance of flavors and a crispy crust. The staff were super friendly and attentive, making the whole experience even better. The store itself had a great vibe—clean, cozy, and inviting. Will definitely be back for more. Thanks for the great service and fantastic pizza!

I ordered a mc spicy burger and was really disappointed — it was cold, and the lettuce was clearly old and wilted. Definitely not the quality you'd expect from McDonald’s. Won’t be coming back to this location unless things improve.

Was the first Georgie Pie in NZ... Foodtown (Countdown/Woolworths) still next door... Founded in 1977 with 32 locations, sold to McDonald's in 1996 who converted 17 to McDonald's & sold the other 15, ceased operations in 1998... McDonald's relaunched the Steak Mince 'n' Cheese pie 2013 & Chicken 'n' Vegetable pie 2014 in most of its locations but discontinued in 2020...

. If you're looking for a quick and satisfying lunch, this McDonald's location is a fantastic choice. As someone who works nearby, I've made it a regular spot for lunch, and it rarely disappoints. The environment is welcoming, with a clean and well-maintained seating area that offers ample space to enjoy your meal comfortably. Whether you're dining solo or with a group, the layout ensures a pleasant experience. The food is consistent with what you'd expect from McDonald's – classic menu options prepared reliably and served fresh. It's perfect if you're craving familiar flavors and need something quick during your lunch break. The service is efficient, which is crucial during a busy workday. Overall, it's a great spot for a casual meal with the convenience and quality that McDonald's is known for. Whether you're on a tight schedule or just looking for a convenient place to grab a bite, this location is highly recommended.
Forgot to give me my full order(drink from meal). Waited in drive thru from 9:05-9:25. 20 mins for drive thru for cold fries and no drink just my burger n ice cream.

Pacific islander lady who looks like a manager (she wears the grey uniform) is so rude and has terrible customer service. I will find her name out and write another review. She served me last night in the drive through. Stuffed 2 combos in one bag. She gave me the bag and as she dropped it into my hands it ripped. I asked for another bag and her response was "it wasn't ripped when I gave it to you". I said "yeah it ripped when you dropped it in to my hands". She then responds "well I can't put it another bag for you but I'll give you a bag to do it yourself". Her tone and unbothered nature was so rude. I will finding out her name and escalating this further. Another friend of mine had a similar experience asking for salt and sauce, her response was we've run out completely. She didn't even wall 1 metre to have a look. People like this think they can treat people rudely as though they work for Forbes 🙄 I hope she gets a warning and disciplinary action if necessary.

Living in New Zealand for almost 10 years this is my first time to visit Denny's. Don't laugh at me please 😂 It's actually very value for the money you pay, the portion is big enough to feed your stomach. One nice family style restaurant.

Had breakfast at Denny’s New Lynn with a 14 year old. It was just what you’d hope for - friendly staff, yum breakfast, pretty good coffee. The food was reasonable value, generous portion and tasted good. Coffee wasn’t amazing but all up not bad. Pretty good choice for your morning breakfast.

We got served not long as we walked in. Got to table. Got given knife and forks . My girls fork had some type of lipstick texture on it. Food menu didn't look yummy. Whole place felt dirty. Decide for price we walk 2 mins and go to cleaner, yummy place for same price

Just finished dinner at dennys New Lynn now. Honestly enjoyed the food. The service needs attention though. 3 staff on the floor to seat and host a full restaurant. Service lacked checking on tables at all, took 25 mins to receive our 3 cokes. no one attended to us so that we could order. The meal was nice and when we finished we piled up our plates on the side ready for collection and ready order a desert to accompany the meal. The manager Bosco attended the table next to ours 3 times while our plates were pulled high and failed to attend to us or recognize our need, his eyes were averted and didn't want to know. After waiting for 15 further minutes we had to leave the restaurant due to no service. Whether there was a staffing issue or they purposefully run the restaurant without enough staff to handle the tables and families they serve ot has an effect on your patrons that expect a decent coverage. I think in future I may visit another site as I've been a local here for years but the lack of effort makes me question why they deserve my support.

It was midnight and I was so hungry so I went to give this restaurant a try. And I was so happy they have the vegetarian option as well^^ I got the pumpkin soup with some chips. And let me say I don’t like pumpkin at all but I couldn’t think of anything else to get. And guess what I liked it it was yum:) As for the chips it was okay but It was mid cooked and a bit hard to chew:( But other than that everything was great;)

The soft shell crab was perfectly crispy and paired so well with the fresh herbs and dipping sauce. The grilled beef with green curry was tender, juicy, and the coconut flakes on top added a perfect crunch. The tom yum soup was a comforting bowl of spicy, tangy goodness—packed with tofu and veggies. And the papaya salad? So refreshing, with a perfect balance of sour, sweet, and spicy. Service was friendly and the atmosphere warm and inviting. Highly recommend if you’re craving authentic Thai flavors with a modern twist
Very friendly staff and amazing authentic thai food!! We got the green curry, pad thai and another type of sizzling noodles and everything was so flavourful. Will definitely come here again 🥰
Very very good. Fresh ingredients and authentic Thai taste. 100% we will be back

Unfortunately the food did not hit the mark. The yellow curry was by far the best and the rice was great. The chicken wasn’t great. The rest was good. The curry puffs were burnt on 4 of the 8 and had an intense char flavour overpowering the curry puff. The 4 that didn’t have this was very nice The roti was inedible, as tough as it comes and of all the this tried probably the worst of this type The cashew nut lacked flavour and the chicken just wasn’t really hitting it, a very fatty type. The sauce had no punch. The veges were fresh and well cooked - the best part of the dish was the veges. The biggest disappointment and thing that let a lot of this down was the crying Tiger starter. $21 for well done steak when it’s meant to be medium rare (like yes I expected it to cook a bit further in the container but there was absolutely no blood, this was definitely over done and I would have sent this back if dining in) - no to mention the heap of gristle on this steak also. I have attached a photo of someone from a year ago, very beautiful, to ours tonight…. Was looking forward to this and sadly got very let down. The 2 servers were polite, took the order on the phone well and had nice greetings and farewells. The restaurant looked pleasant and seemed like a nice place to dine in with 2 bars and plenty of drink for those wanting to dine in. Parking was all good, spot right outside and plenty of spots around. Easy access. Just sadly very much missed the mark again. If I come back and there’s a better experience I will be updating the review

A cute little joint! I personally really enjoyed the green curry that came with some fried chicken which were less salty to balance the curry that's more flavourful. Eating the chicken, rice and curry together really hit the spot for me! Topped it off with some tap beer which went great with the meal. The lady who served my table had a constant smile on and was professional. I'd like to visit again and try other things, too!

Booked in lastnight for a late lunch today table of 9 to celebrate 2x birthdays, place was nice and empty when we walked in. Served right away and given menus Conner was very attentive and made sure we had what we needed. Food was quick and spot on as well as drinks kids enjoyed their meals. Music Playlist had alot of great bangers that we sang along to. The staff made sure bday cakes came out on time and joined in to sing happy birthday. Thank you for making today special for my mum and daughter will be back again to try other dishes.

The old lonestar once upon a time now the above Bar & Restaurant. Good food, excellent service. Waiter was awesome very attentive. Apart from chips being oily everything else was excellent. The staff were awesome. Nice spot away from the riff raff of new lynn. Plenty of parking and ample space to dine. Clean facility. Will be back to celebrate more birthdays here Thank you 💯

Went for the $30 Sirloin special on Wednesday nights, this is on the window as you enter, definitely my suggestion would be to put it on the website. Delicious medium cooked steak and I could taste the flames from the grill too. Matched well with a Cab Sav too. The pinnacle moment was when the amazing head waiter brought out a gluten free small birthday cake. Highly recommended, support local

Owner was so welcoming and very attentive. Asked about any food allergies or intolerances straight away - one of our party is Coeliac which is why we originally came. They went above and beyond to accomodate. We didn’t feel like any thing was sacrificed because of needing to be no dairy or gluten….could enjoy having a normal restaurant experience. The food was delicious and generous portions too. We will be back!

Easily one of the best restaurant meals I've ever had! Went due to the reviews about them being safe for Coeliacs and I am so glad I did. Every single part of the meal (stuffed chicken breast) was perfectly cooked and seasoned, the cocktail was gorgeous, and the dessert was divine! The prices were also more than reasonable for what you got. The staff were also so lovely, very friendly and helpful without being overbearing and checking on us constantly. Would recommend The Attic to everyone, and I will definitely be back!

We love the food in new Lynn Nando’s restaurant. Always great food, hope a new guy working in the reception. He is so rude and with elders for a simple request asked to cut the chicken pieces. I ordered the whole chicken and requested to cut 8pieces. He start with a loud noise saying I cannot do it. Management need to look into this bit carefully and try not to put on the first place of communication to , it may effect to customer to direct another outlets.

I remember when you used to get a decent sized whole breast of chicken in a Nando’s burger - this thin slice didn’t even cover the whole bun. It didn’t taste flame grilled, it was more subway quality chicken than Nando’s. What happened to this chain?
3’d we came here 💕🥰🤣I love this placeb it makes me feel like I am back Home 🥰💕🥰🤣In South Africa 🥰🤣🥰and the food is awesome thank you
Very good restaurant Delicious food Nice Shisha Amazing service
Great place. Awesome food. Great customer service. Parking available.

Bunga Raya has easily been the best dining experience I’ve had during my time in Auckland! This Malaysian family-style restaurant absolutely nails it on every level. The food was simply outstanding—every single dish we ordered was packed with flavour and cooked to perfection. The chicken curry was rich, hearty, and perfectly spiced. The award-winning XO squid was a real standout—spicy, balanced, and incredibly moreish. Even the coffee pork chops, which sounded a little unusual at first, were tender and surprisingly delicious—the flavours somehow worked together beautifully! Beyond the food, what really made the experience special was the hospitality. The owner personally came over to chat with us and made us feel like family. It wasn’t the usual scripted service—you could genuinely feel the warmth, like talking to a beloved auntie who just wanted to make sure you were well fed and happy. That personal touch made the entire meal even more memorable. The homely, welcoming atmosphere combined with the incredible quality of the food made for a truly standout evening. It’s rare to find a restaurant that delivers both exceptional dishes and such a heartfelt connection with its guests. If you’re looking for a real taste of Malaysia with genuine hospitality that leaves you smiling, Bunga Raya should be at the very top of your list. I can’t wait to come back and try even more from their menu!

Ate at Bunga Raya today. We walked in and was lucky to get a table as the restaurant was already busy on Friday night. Very friendly service they even brought plastic plates and cutlery for our toddler without us even requesting it. We tried the Roti which was served with an exceptional curry sauce. Mee goreng was great. We got the normal version so kids could eat it so I'm sure the spicy version would have been out the park. The star of the show was the XO chicken. It was just too good. Service was super friendly and the food came out fast. Prices are on the high side around $36 per portion but in my opinion it is worth the value.

We had an excellent weekend lunch; reservations are highly recommended. The Hainanese chicken , Bunga Raya eggplant and KL fish are exceptional choices. The service was outstanding, with the staff readily accommodating custom requests. This is among the finest Malaysian restaurants we have experienced.

From Google, this looked homely and promising, but afer trying it out, I can't recommend this place for dinner unless you are super rich and come in a big group. You also need to book beforehand. If you don't, like us, you get put right at the seat next to the toilet and kitchen, where people keep coming in and out and it's super distracting, not to mention unpleasant. I can't count the number of times the waiter accidentally bumped my chair or shoulder. Service wasn't great, the waiters were extremely judgemental, and it felt like the whole place was judging you for everything you did. Food is OK but very overpriced. You get decent quality but not without compromises. We ordered a Wat Dan Hor which looked promising but most of the prawn was extremely overcooked, making it very dry and stiff to chew. The rice noodles were quite oily and had a bitter taste, and whole thing felt like there was too much msg or salt, leaving you feeling bloated and thirsty. It cost $36, and at that insane price, you would expect absolutely no compromises. The rest of the dish was good. Tea is also not free, it's $1 per person, and I feel that at that price point and with how diluted the tea is, it should have just been free. You get no choice in the matter either, they just give it to you and charge you. In the end we couldn't eat the remaining rice noodles because they were so oily and bitter and we started feeling ill. As we were leaving the waiter quipped: "Hah, you can't even finish the plate? Pathetic." Wow, I've never encountered such service where someone would say that. Maybe the reason we couldn't finish it was because there was something wrong with the dish? It also felt like we were getting rushed out - the moment we put our utensils down, they came over and said "are you finished"? They weren't particularly busy that night and it wasn't like all the seats were filled up, so that felt unnecessarily rude. We came as two people, and each dish was $30-$60, which we didn't expect and couldn't afford, so we only ordered one to share. None of the dishes come with rice, so it'd be whatever the cost of the dish, say $40, plus the cost of rice, which is like $4 each. You'd rack up a $100+ bill quickly even if you just come as two people. When we asked for only one dish, it immediately felt like there were laser eyes from the waiters on us. If you don't spend money, expect to be judged and rushed out. Obviously, this place is rated quite high and is popular, so maybe we're just not the target audience. The two waiters were visibly much nicer to the big groups of people spending money on a lot of dishes, talking friendly and making jokes, while for us we were given the cold shoulder even though we did nothing wrong. What I can say for sure is, there are Malaysian restaurants with better service, price, and similar quality in taste. Maybe the lunch menu is priced better.

We are from Karaka and was visiting West Auckland to check out the new track in Titirangi, randomly found this place with my mate. The food here is top notch, great flavour and auntie recommended the XO Chicken which is really really good! She told us that dish won an award recently how cool. Will definitely come back to try more dishes 😁

This Vietnamese restaurant comes highly recommended, if you want a quick delicious Vietnamese meal. The food quality is great, portions are generous, and the service is both efficient and quiet, and very quick! The restaurant is spacious, offering plenty of indoor seating. I visited with my brother for dinner, and we both ordered the Lemongrass Chicken with rice. The chicken was tender, and the portion of rice was perfect to leave us feeling satisfied. This place never disappoints!

What we ordered: Lemongrass chicken on rice and Egg noodle soup with lemongrass chicken. They serve quite fast. The portions are big and the prices was good. They’ve had the same menu now for many years and a lot of people still come here for dinner/lunch. Its nice you get soup on the side with rice. And bean sprouts for your soup. There are also condiments on the side. I love adding chilly on my soup. Gives it a kick.

I've just lived here in Auckland for 5 months.. prior to that, I lived in Melbourne for 12 years. I have tried tens of Vietnamese restaurants and I can say that this place is my top three list. Their pork chop was absolutely delicious and I really recommend that you should try it. I also had a bowl of noodles soup and it was tasty too. I will definitely come back to try another dishes.

Lovely food, bit pricey for some dishes. Have been 4 times and will go back. Spring rolls both summer and fried are very yummy. Vermicelli salad delicious and chicken wings are so yummy. We all enjoy this place, just check the prices before you order

- Pork belly on rice 7/10 It was enjoyable, rice was OK, bit too much ratio wise for the quantity of pork you get. - Mixed seafood on rice 7/10 Once again, the work colleague says it was OK, and he had to add chili out of the jar on the table as it lacked flavor. Service was blunt.

Staff members are friendly, attentive, and helpful. They'll listen to your order carefully. Dining area is clean, and the decor is very hell-ish. However, having plenty of uncovered windows makes the ambiance a bit too bright for hell feeling, but it does gives better feeling, happier and more friendly feel - at least for me. If you need to go to the toilet, you can ask and they'll usually let you use staff toilet. They've really improve on their timing, especially for their delivery orders; they are now beating their estimated arrival time more often than not.

Ok thought I'd give this store 1 more chance, this time I found way more hair in my donut than ever I had to pull bits of my food i don't even want it whoever is either making the cinnamon mix or the dounts needs to either wear more covered clothes or shave first this is yuck and very poor hygiene. Never again this time! I would like to share an unfortunate experience I had yesterday at the McDonald’s in New Lynn. I went there for dinner and ordered a coffee and two sandwiches, requesting table service. It quickly became clear that I was being treated differently—possibly because I am an immigrant or because I am Black. The woman who took my order refused to bring it to my table, even though I had requested that service. She fulfilled other customers’ orders before mine and then, from a distance, gestured for me to get up and collect my coffee myself. I have no problem picking up my order at the counter, but it was the way she prepared the coffee and the look in her eyes that made the situation painful. There was a clear sense of disdain, and I could feel the rejection and disrespect in her actions. Throughout the experience, I kept speaking to myself, trying to remain calm and understand what might have caused her behavior. Perhaps she was extremely tired, or maybe someone had been unkind to her earlier. Maybe she wished she were somewhere else, or perhaps she was going through something difficult at home or in her relationships. I truly tried to feel empathy for her, despite the deep pain of what felt like discrimination. Whatever the reason, the feeling of being dismissed or looked down upon is something that stays with you—it touches the soul. And I wouldn’t wish that experience on anyone. In the end, we are all human beings. Whether we are customers or staff, managers or employees, it doesn’t matter. What matters is the respect we owe one another simply for being human. Thank you for taking the time to read this. Sincerely,

A Taste of Home at Gold Ribbon Restaurant – A Must-Try for Filipino Food Lovers! Gold Ribbon Restaurant is an absolute gem for anyone craving authentic and delicious Filipino food. From the moment you walk in, the warm and welcoming atmosphere makes you feel at home, and the food truly speaks for itself! Their Palabok is a standout – perfectly cooked noodles topped with a rich, flavorful sauce, chicharrón, and fresh ingredients that bring out the traditional taste of this well-loved dish. Every bite is a burst of umami goodness! The Dinuguan is another must-try. The pork is tender, and the savory, slightly tangy sauce is cooked to perfection, just like how it’s made back home. It pairs wonderfully with their freshly steamed rice. But the real star of the show is their Ube Cake! Soft, moist, and with just the right amount of sweetness, it’s no surprise why it’s their most famous dessert. The ube flavor is rich and authentic, and the creamy frosting makes it absolutely irresistible. Overall, Gold Ribbon Restaurant delivers an amazing Filipino dining experience. Whether you're Filipino or just someone who loves good food, this place is a must-visit. I’ll definitely be coming back for more!

The carpark entrance is little confusing if you've never been, space is very limited, and it's on a busy main road.

Food was great. We had bulalo steak, pork sisig, ube cake, & halo-halo. Wanna try their recommended crispy pata & liempo BBQ next time. We were a bit disappointed with the Fiesta Halo-Halo. While they were generous with the ube ice cream, we noticed that it lacked nata de coco, which was a letdown.

If you’re craving authentic Filipino cuisine, I highly recommend this place! The food is absolutely delicious, capturing the rich and comforting flavors of home. The staff are warm and accommodating, making the dining experience even more enjoyable. Plus, the service is efficient, with minimal waiting time for food. A must-visit for anyone looking to enjoy great Filipino dishes with excellent hospitality!

Excellent Ube Cake — 5/5 A lovely Philippine restaurant in West Auckland. It offers a variety of traditional Filipino dishes and desserts. Among them, the standout is the Ube Cake, with its elegant purple color and a subtle coconut aroma. The cake itself is soft and fluffy, while the frosting is rich and buttery, perfectly complementing the flavors of purple yam and coconut. On the other hand, the fried chicken with mushroom sauce and rice, as well as the seafood and vegetable sour soup, didn’t leave much of an impression.

I asked the lady behind the counter what the large pork meal comes with she said 4 roast potatoes, one pumpkin, one. kumara, peas, roast pork, and crackling. I ordered one large portion to take away with extra crackling. Hello, when I got home, there were only 3 roast potatoes and no crackling with the meal. The pork was somewhat dry, and lack any seasoning,which I find unbelievable for a fatty meat.) The pumpkin and Kumara was like steamed. The best part of the meal were their peas. I guess boiling frozen peas, you really can't go wrong. Can you . Total meal price including $3 for extra crackling $ 25:00 maybe they should change the name to Stanley's steam.

10/10 for their Pork buns & popcorn chicken. Drove through Glen eden and thought to give them a try. Heard they have delicious pork buns. Ordered 1 to try and couldn’t resist so bought another 5 to take home. Also their Popcorn chicken is super delicious, they are juicy diced thigh pieces that I had to buy 3x to take home also. Such a hidden gem with low prices and great food quality. My pictures aren’t the best but I had to take a photo before I devour it. Hehe. They have a dine in area very clean and the staff their are friendly. They are a Roast shop would definitely be stopping there again when I’m in the area.

I went for dinner with a group of friends a few nights ago and it was decent, but three of us got food poisoning after. We ordered the scotch fillet, fish and chips, and BBQ ribs; they were all cooked well so it was probably a cleanliness issue. Other than that, the staff were friendly, but the music was a bit too loud so the waitress couldn't hear what we were ordering and we had to shout across the table.

Took my mum there for a mother's day meal. There was a 21st happening inside so we were sat outside. The food didn't take too long to come out and when it did it was piping hot. The food could have been a wee bit better seasoned, but overall it was good.

We had our annual Christmas Eve dinner celebration at Black salt. We had a few requests and changes a few weeks before the dinner and they were quick to respond to me. The food we had was great. We had fried cauliflower and squid to start. Sirloin, lamb shanks, tagliatelle, Cajun chicken sizzler. We also had for dessert sticky toffee pudding and the cheesecake. Everything was really flavourful and tasty. The waitress was especially nice and very attentive to what we needed. Thank you for a lovely evening
Good food and good friendly service, salad was a little bland but all the other dishes were good. Nice atmosphere and nice outdoor area.

We went on a Wednesday night without knowing it's the quiz night. Great atmosphere! Good place to have a fun night with friends. We ordered Prawn curry, Lamb Shank, BBQ Ribs and Double Rock as well as onion rings.

I dined here for a bday celebration and I was really impressed. The starter platter was huge and the tandoori lamb chops were some of the best Indian I ever had. The main portions were generous and the paneer naan tasted incredible. They gave us complimentary poppidoms with chutney and riata which were a really nice accompaniment. Service was super attentive and the owner even came to say hello at the end. He told us how their recipes haven't changed in about two decades, and how they use no MSG or sugar. In a world where service standards are declining these guys really do shine. Definitely coming back.

I purchased a butter chicken meal and a Naan bread. Probably the worst curry I have had. I think I was given a Korma and even then it was not good. My Naan was burnt and didn't taste good at all. I'm really sad that this has been the experience as I was expecting so much better going from the reviews online.

The flavors here are absolutely incredible! I tried their signature curry, and my partner had the Butter Chicken—both dishes were bursting with flavor and made with fresh, high-quality ingredients. We’re already planning our next visit to explore more of their tempting menu. To top it all off, the customer service was outstanding—friendly, attentive, and perfectly timed. Highly recommend this place!

I’ve been dining at Little India for over 10 years, and it continues to be my go-to spot for authentic Indian cuisine in Auckland. Hands down, it's the best Indian restaurant in the city. The food is consistently flavorful, beautifully presented, and made with high-quality ingredients. The service is warm and attentive, making each visit feel welcoming and personal. The atmosphere is charming and inviting—perfect for a casual dinner or a special night out. Little India offers not just a meal, but a complete dining experience that keeps me coming back time and time again.

The dining experience at this restaurant was truly delightful. 【Starters - Paneer tikka】 solo crispy 【The Butter Chicken 】was rich and creamy, with a perfect balance of spices that made it irresistibly flavourful. 【The Lamb Curry 】was tender and succulent, offering a depth of flavour that was simply unforgettable. 【Prawn jalfrezi Curry 】was equally impressive, with fresh, juicy prawns swimming in a luscious, aromatic sauce. 【The Cheese Salad】 was a refreshing and unique addition to the meal, providing a nice contrast to the richer dishes. 【The Mango Lassi 】was the perfect palate cleanser, bursting with tropical sweetness. The assortment of naan breads was a treat in itself. 【Naan】The Cheese Naan was soft and gooey, the Garlic Naan had a wonderful aromatic kick, and the Butter Cheese Naan combined the best of both worlds, offering a buttery, cheesy delight. The portions were very generous, and each person only needed to spend less than 30nzd. The atmosphere of the restaurant was beautiful and serene, with a relaxed vibe that made the dining experience all the more enjoyable. The service was attentive and thoughtful, ensuring that every need was met with a smile. Overall, this restaurant is a gem for anyone looking to enjoy quality Indian cuisine in a comfortable and welcoming environment.

I bought two “ Caesar salad meals” from tank as you will see in the picture there were four bits of ham not bacon as should be in a Caesar salad and two minuscule bits of chicken and half a boiled egg. I felt ripped off at $16 apiece. I could not take it back as I was going into work. Not going there again

Honestly, I was there last weekend, ordered two blue spirulina smoothies… I ordered at 11:40am and didn’t get my smoothies until 12:04pm… not only was the wait time shocking but watching two employees try to clean all three blenders at one time and then make bulk batches to serve 6 orders at one time, the way these smoothies are made makes me want to never come back to any tank again. The drink asks for coconut milk, vanilla, banana , strawberry and blue spirulina… what I got was a hefty serving of vanilla ice cream and blue food colouring with normal milk. Now we’re not lactose intolerant but if I was, that’s poor advertising for what’s in the actual drinks. When you say vanilla you expect extract or bean… no ice cream? And coconut milk is pretty standard these days. What happened to first come first serve? There were people waiting long before I ordered too and was served at the same time I was. Two employees… poor poor poor service and quality. Complaining or calling them out on what’s been put into my drinks would have probably taken a whole year to even been addressed. This whole site needs to be reevaluated and managed better. And frankly, clearer descriptions of what’s put into your drinks would also be good. I didn’t ask for food colouring.

I recently visited the Tank Juice at LynnMall, and I was quite disappointed with my experience. I ordered an Up-Beet, but there was no beetroot in it, which is the main ingredient! The taste was way off from what it usually is—it felt like I was drinking just carrot juice. The balance of flavors was completely missing, and it didn’t taste fresh or enjoyable. Definitely not what I expect from Tank Juice, especially for the price.

Ordered a Beef Thai Salad from here via DoorDash. Took them more than 15minutes to confirm the order from their end which delayed the delivery. When I got it, salad was dry, not mixed well and salad portion was smaller than how they usually are. Box wasn’t as packed as usual. Not happy with this service especially when I paid $20.20 for the salad alone. I definitely don’t recommend this Tank Branch. This store deserves 0 stars.

After using the touch screens to order, I stood and waited while a long line of people who came after me ordered in person and got their drinks and salads first. When I did eventually receive my smoothie, it was totally liquid, like drinking almond milk, not a hint of smoothie consistency. But I’d waited so long I couldn’t stand the thought of waiting even longer to complain and get it remade. Will not be back.
Perfect food, perfect coffee, excellent service by the whole team, love the vibe there, a little area for kids to play with toys, whenever we are around, we always grab our breakfast from there only
Everything is great! Especially the French toast and hot chocolate is so good and comfort! I will definitely come back to this cafe again some times! 🩷
Great place for coffee and food. Best chips in Auckland! Haloumi sandwich which and beef burger 🔥 (sorry ate it so only photo of left over chips)

Brilliant food -)) our local haunt !! Super friendly staff / bestest Scrammy eggs !! Coffee for champions-) … Cinnabons to fight for lol actually every things is scrumptious!! We don’t go for brekkie anywhere else!! .. come here and taste your selves -))
Good atmosphere and breakfast food. The loaded fries were very loaded and delicious. Staff were accommodating on a busy morning. Coffee had a nice flavour, just wish they had some latte art!

Not happy at all with this order. Do better, please. Ordered 4 combos for my family w UberEats and each combo was supposed to be clearly marked instead we got a bunch of scribbled, crossed-out numbers that looked like a 2, a 3 with a 1 next to it, or maybe a 4? Who knows! I had to open up every single sub just to figure out who’s was who. Here's a thought...if writing numbers is too hard, maybe just write the name of the sub?? Like “Sweet Onion Chicken” not that complicated. On top of that, I ordered 2 cookies with each of the 4 combos (so, 8 cookies total) and every single one was wrong. Not one right cookie in the bunch. And to top it off, I also paid for a separate 6-pack of cookies that we never even received. Honestly, this was frustrating and disappointing. When you’re ordering for a family, accuracy matters. Subways looked like they were thrown across the store and packed how it landed.

I've come here twice and once in the morning once in the evening so I experienced both start and the end of the shift. and I had a good experience both the time but, my experience specially today was incredible the vegetables and all the food was very fresh and it tasted really nice. the staff her name was Sally she was very good she a toasted my Patty really nicely and overall I found it like really nice and clean. I've seen some negative reviews so hopefully I wont have similar experiences like those people when I go next time because I'm really looking forward to make this my go-to Subway because it's closest to my house it's clean the staff was friendly and yeah it's a good Subway overall

Believe me this is “the worst” subway store I have ever visited. This store people(all Chinese Ladies)can’t even make a good cheese garlic toasty, forget about the sandwiches, well I have ordered couple of times☹️. Rubbish Rubbish Rubbish 😡 If ask to add some more olives, she will put 3-three more olives in the footlong sub😠 They just want to kick you out asap from the store.😡

WORST SUBWAY! Not deserving of this 1 star. If you like burnt cookies, dry hard bread and chipotle quesadilla with no cheese and huge veggie chunks then this is the place to eat. Most annoying thing is when I bought it up they looked at me like I was crazy especially when I said where is the cheese and can I get the veges chopped up finely in the quesadilla. What a disappointment to Subway Franchise!

Nice atmosphere, great service and fast service, there are around more then 16 people's can seat, nice and clean place, very friendly, i went see service girl she from north in india nice and friendly, car parking available in mall parking

Two friends catching up. I was last here, 15yrs+ ago. Nice and tidy. 6pm dinner reservations on a Sat night. Not very busy. We ordered the steak and had salt'n'pepper squid for starters $20 (we shared, and the amount was just right). We didn't finish the squid, not sure why, though. Steaks ordered medium rare and medium well - cooked to perfection. All up, we spent about $113, including a couple of fizzy drinks. Overall rating - no real issues, just, I don't know what it is, but nothing too exciting or standout - meaning would I rush to come back? Or recommend it to others? no, not really. If you want okay-ish, then maybe Bricklane.

Decided to have lunch with the kids today a group of 7 of us walked in without a booking we were seated right away which was great. The gentleman who served us was fantastic he was kind enough to let us know what the wait time for food was going to be as there was a private function going on at the same time. He advised it could be a wait of up to an hour for food which we didn't mind. We managed to get our order in quick and the food came out quicker than expected. My steak was cooked well done like I asked for the rest of the table meals looked very good. I would say the ribs meal quantity wise is mega which is a positive for big eaters. Also ordered 1kg of mussels with the curry coconut cream sauce which were so good they were devourded quickly. Overall for the 7 of us, 2 kids meals and 6 adult meals + drinks and 2 deserts was about $350+ which is reasonable. The waiter also had us sign up for plus points card which was a bonus as we were able to accumulate points to spend at participating stores. Thank you again will be back to try the rest of the menu.

Required a bite to eat before an appointment in New Lynn and came across Bricklane Restaurant and Bar. Was really looking for a cafe so did not have a big budget. The weekday menu was quite economical which suited us. Sat in the outside seating area taking advantage of the sunny late autumn day.

My fish & chips were quite good, though the fish portion was small for the price ($30). My partner did not enjoy their bbq pork ribs - I tried one and agreed the fat wasn’t well rendered enough and it was what I’d call ‘flubby’ (it wasn’t that Deep South, slow, low, crispy and slightly chewy but juicy you’d hope for) and the sauce that was poured over didn’t have much of a depth of flavour - just sweet. The vibe of the place itself is a bit… stale I would say. Hotel lobby in feeling. Very busy with a lot of retirement age clientele. The staff were ok, obviously over-stretched and flat. In general, overpriced and probably won’t be back.

Beautiful place simple interior but cute hood seating area in and out .staff very professional welcoming and helpful. The food 🍱 was very good but as a vegetarian I think there should be more options .overall nice experience

I had a great experience at Pizza Hut today! The food was fresh, hot, and full of flavour—especially the apricot chicken and Buffalo chicken. A big thank you to naidu for the excellent service—he was friendly, professional, and made sure everything was perfect for our table. The place was clean and the atmosphere was comfortable. Highly recommend this location. Great team and great food!

Bought limo pizza today for kids and there were no chips or hash bites given with the limo pizza! Wasn’t until we got home and opened box that we noticed only 3 square pizzas. Annoying. Not worth driving back for. Level up!
Best customer service appreciate theys guys hard work my usual pizza service, keep up the great work guys, Highly recommended best pizza hut shop I've been too. Thanks guys

For the food, I believe there is like toppings, which is unfortunate. However, the pizzas taste good! Service is great! The people are nice and communicate with you, assuring you get what you want with your pizza. Like no sauce sometimes hahahA. The atmosphere is chill and there isn’t any trouble going around.

I went to the Kelson Pizza Hut because the Lynnmall Pizza Hut was closed, but I had an unpleasant experience. I ordered a hot and spicy veggie pizza, but it turned out to be more like a classic cheese pizza. Also, the corners lacked a sufficient amount of cheese. First and last time visit.
Lots of sushi selection and reasonable prices. Egg and salad are added at home. Fried chicken on rice, small one is $ 6.
I love the sushi,it's always fresh,the staff is really friendly
Love their sushi, fresh, well sized and priced and amazing customer service. I live out south now and always make a point to stop and grab some when out west 🖤
simply the best salmon sushi and service I've experienced so far
Really nice sushis for a treat. it's clean and tidy and just around the corner from us. we'll be back

DONT ORDER SOUP (OR ANY DISH WITH SAUCE) TO TAKEAWAY! IT WILL ALL END UP IN THE CAR, ON THE SEAT OF THE BUS, OR ON THE FOOTPATH BEFORE YOU GET HOME EVEN WHEN KEPT UPRIGHT! THE CONTAINERS DON'T SEAL, THE PLASTIC BAGS LEAK, AND THE PAPER BAGS TO CARRY AWAY EVERYTHING GET WET AND LET GO! I asked them about it and they assured me it wouldn't happen again. IT DID! NEVER AGAIN!!! I am furious and will request a full refund!
Chips are fresh hotdog on a stick is good fish is nice but battered chicken nibbles??? Never seen this before. I ordered 10x nibbles - probably throw it away now.

Ordered from Uber eats as I have a sick puppy so couldn’t leave home to pick it up myself. They don’t have any descriptions on Uber eats and maybe my fault for not calling them to reconfirm that the chow mein found elsewhere which is stir fried noodles with meat and veggies is what they were offering. Anyways paid $25 for a box of sauce, bbq pork and lots of veggies with a very tiny soggy noodles. The two stars are for the wontons which were fresh, delish and definitely worth it. I did call them post receiving the order and they just said get a refund from Uber. Doesn’t make the whole fact that dinner is now a soggy chewy mess and not what I wanted ok.

Went online looked at the menu and worked out how much 4 cheeseburgers, $4 chips and a chicken fried rice... it came to $29.50.. get there and I'm charged $39.50! The cheeseburgers are pittiful and $5 (instead of $3.50 like on their website menu!) each, $4 chips is $2 chips making them double the price as anywhere else.. and at that price the dry fried rice works out to be $15.50!! Definitely not worth the price.. even the fried rice was nothing to rave about
My absolute favorite local always on point fresh and friendly service
Have been here multiple times and it’s really good! Authentic food and still quite affordable. They also have really good vegetation options, my favourite are the tofu bun and pad Thai.

Talk about a great local spot! Chop chew takes their best takes on South East Asian flavours for all to enjoy. Shared a range of items here with my little family and enjoyed every bite. The service was fast and friendly. But the food was even better with good portions for its price range. Will continue to try the rest of the menu knowing it is just a drive away. Don't skip this one guys!

Really tasty 😍. Had the Thai flat chicken noodle. The temperature, taste and portion was perfect. I loved it. I enjoyed the dumplings it was very tasty, the texture was nice. Also they have a lot of vegetarian option as I got the vege dumplings. So delicious. Thank you Chop chew, will definitely buy again 🙂💖
This place is a hidden gem! Excellent service with a smile, food presentation & deliciousness an A++, atmosphere delightful, very colourful, clean & tidy. Keep up the great work & we will be back! 🍜

Great new little Vietnamese place recently opened.. Food and taste was awesome and the pricing very good... Staff were friendly and we will be back again. Very happy to have a local Vietnamese restaurant close by. They are not on uber eats yet.

Beautiful food, especially the vegetarian options. Homely and welcoming environment, even though the decor is still sparse. It's great to finally have a handy local for delicious Indian cuisine! Thanks for all the papadums!
Third time eating from this restaurant. Each time the food was awesome. Lovely dining experience with our little family today, our boys loved it. Thank you team👍🏻

I tried vada pav at this Mumbai restaurant and it was really nice and tasty. The flavour was so good – crispy and spicy, just like how real vada pav should be. The place was clean and the food felt fresh and safe. If you love street food, you should definitely try it.

Had an awesome family meal here - I am a vegan and was well catered for with a delicious Chana masala while my family had a chicken korma and lamb Rogan Josh. Food was very authentic and amazing flavour! Great personal service and enjoyable experience all round. Highly recommend.

Great food. Managed to smuggle a few beers in as theres no license on the joint. Does a good job a providing a curry for the fellas on a friday. Would go back. Owner promised us kingfisher strongs on tap next time we head there.
Best pork buns out West also the steak and pork rolls are 💣💣💣 *update* pork and steak rolls still the best considering how cheap they are , also the chips 💣💣💣.
The food was really delicious, the steak and egg roll is highly recommended. Great customer service, would come again!!

I had this for dinner tonight ,it was the most delicious and under rated place ! There hot chips are the most delicious the seasoning they have on them ..you can’t beat it ! The roll was even better ..please go visit this place .i wish they had one in every suburb..amazing 10/10
all 5z, very good service, cute lil shop nd good food

Would like to give a shout out to this company as I done a phone order and they misunderstood my order, and I gave them call about it. He took the time of his day to come to my work to drop off what I actually ordered with something extra. Really appreciate that, I've come to this place 3 times so far and have never been dissapointed

This morning we were there for some pork buns and the woman serving us had made some free coffee. Their customer service is excellent 🥹 I love this store and have been since highschool. Definitely check out the hot food section!

Haven't been here in so many years but my dad walked in with food bought from here and it was delicious!!! The Sapa sui, panikeke, taro, chicken curry the whole lot was bomb! Food tasted like it was all made with love.

It's been a while since I bought any food from this shop so again was happy with a few treats I grabbed. The taro and fish with coconut cream was fire, the fried pork buns were good and the panikekes were good too. Oh and the nice lady that served me gave me the fish treat for free - fa'afetai lava!
I would buy from here just for the service alone so nice and friendly. Food was delicious and worth every cent. Will be going back.

I started coming here to get some Keke and curry when I was visiting my friend in Kelston. The shop owner is always nice and the foods are cheap as, when I feel like a snack I always get Keke. Too bad they don't open weekends or evenings

I had heard a lot about Lucky Gs and their reputation as the best burger spot in New Zealand, so my wife and I decided to check it out. It's located near Kelston Mall, and there was plenty of street parking available, so we had no trouble finding a spot. It was Sunday afternoon, and the place was buzzing with people dining in and grabbing takeaways. The interior looked amazing. Lots of cool decorations and photos that gave the place a great vibe. The staff were super friendly and enjoyed what they did, which made the atmosphere even livelier. As for the burgers, they lived up to the hype. My wife had the Little G - a tasty, smaller burger that wasn’t too juicy but still really flavourful. I went for the burger with jalapeños and loved the spicy kick. We added a combo for $7, and the potato chips were perfectly cooked. Overall, we enjoyed our visit and can't wait to come back and try more of their burgers!

Small and mighty. We loved Lucky Gs when they were in Onehunga and we love them in Kelston. The thigh guy was awesome and bigger than i was expecting but be warned if you're as white as me, the mild will be hot. The chips are out of this world. Salty and a little bit sweet. Perfect. The atmosphere is fantastic. Tony and the team are so upbeat and friendly. I've never wanted a pink bucket hat so badly.

The hype is real. Best Burger I’ve had in my life. I had Jimi’s triple burger. Everything about it was amazing, the meat was stunning, the bun was melt in the mouth and the burger sauce couldn’t have been better. So happy I went here. To top it off the service is second to none, super friendly and professional, the place was spotless. Will be back soon.

Solid burger, and great service. The retro arcade game was cool, too. I had the Twice as Nice burger. It was solid, but just a little short of spectacular for me. My son had the Thigh Guy. It was also the same, very nice, but not quite all star. The chips are very basic shoestring, they are 2/5 stars. The crew in there were really friendly, a great vibe. I'll definitely come back when I'm in the area.

There's a reason why these guys are ranked so highly on Google - best smashed burgs in Auckland! The patties are just so tasty and the staff are the friendliest bunch. Restaurant is small but cute and the fries and shake were also pretty good. This is now going to be our go-to for smashed burgers!

Really love this place. We live out of Auckland, so it's becoming a regular stop when we visit family. Wonderful staff and always friendly. Food is wonderful, and I really enjoy it everything even if im not sure they give great recommendations. We only get takeaway but would definitely dine in. The place is always quiet when we come. Honestly, I love it being quiet because it's a more personal experience, but I really hope more people come to support this amazing business. Keep doing that you are doing it's amazing place.

First time doing pick up and staff friendly and atmosphere very appealing. Will definitely be dining in soon. We picked up the classics - Pad Thai and Green curry. Both very generous sizes with good proportions of protein and so much flavour. Looking forward to trying out the other options too. Highly recommend.

Had the king prawn pineapple fried rice and also our favourite Thai dish which is the sweet and sour fried whole snapper. The fried snapper was quite good, definitely above average. The fish was a bit bony and the meat was not super fleshy but there was still enough meat on both side for sharing between 2 if ordering 2 dishes. However the price is pretty good for this dish. The fried rice was just average for me, I feel there wasn't enough wok flavour and also flavour didn't blend well together. On top of that although the presentation was not bad, it made it hard to eat the rice when it is fitted in a pineapple. So I felt if it was hot and straight on the plate would be better served. Staffs were all nice and service was good. Price is also reasonable, will definitely be back to try other dishes.

A cozy restaurant with a calm and inviting atmosphere. The staff were friendly and service was fast. We ordered chicken pad thai and pineapple fried rice which arrived hot and very fresh. Best pad thai I've had!

Interesting approach to spice - it’s all mild but you are provided with this corner of each container of hot, sour powder, kind of like sumac, that is delicious and proper sets the dishes off on fire. The Pad Thai was quite good - no real smoky wok hei really (my bugbear) but the tofu was excellent. The Pad See Ew was good but the noodles were SO gluey .. they could have had more bite, been a little thinner and been more supple. Overall not bad.

We are vegetarian family, the curry we got was something chicken, may daughter was supposed to take that curry to work for lunch.. and realised it’s not paneer. 3 days chasing to speak to a manager for no response. Staff blaming one another. Zero

Beautiful place, with great food and very good portion size, But the most respected and made it worth was the Service by the young man, he was very respectful, helpful and made sure we enjoyed our meal. Would highly recommend them for ur next gathering, family outing etc.

Tried this place on doordash last night. Am a fan of trying different indian restaurants but this one was above and beyond. Ordered a lamb saag and chicken korma with sides. The meals were the best we have had in a long time and the chili garlic Naan was a winner. Not just pieces of bread but arrived pizza sized loaded with cheese and garlic and chili. Best I've ever had. The poppadoms were perfect. Highly recommend trying this place at least once. It's now going to be our regular
I ordered lunch special for myself. It was butter paneer and naan. I loved it nice taste as well.
The Food is very delicious and every time i went they never disappointed me. Best place to try Indian food and 100% will recommend.

Absolutely loved this Vietnamese cafe! The spicy beef noodle soup was rich, flavorful, and had just the right kick—perfect comfort food. The chicken fried rice was beautifully cooked, full of fresh ingredients and perfectly seasoned. And the salted coffee? A must-try—smooth, bold, and balanced with that delicious sweet-salty foam on top. Cozy atmosphere, friendly staff, and authentic flavors. Highly recommend!

Newly opened but the facility looks dated. Unlike other Vietnamese restaurants, there is no sauce or dressing on the table. Their soup has a light, clean taste. Spring rolls have generous fillings. Super friendly staff here deserve praise.

We ordered a special beef pho, stir fried beef pho noodle soup and a special summer roll. The broth was light, wasn't too salty and packed good depth. I completely demolished my bowl (broth and all) and didn't feel thirsty afterwards, good sign this place doesn't rely heavily on seasoning or msg (no I don't hate msg). The owners were really lovely, happily guided my partner through the menu on items that were or could be made gluten free/low gluten. I had and thoroughly enjoyed great conversations and service from both owners, especially Zoe. If you choose to support local businesses, check out these guys. They are patio are at what they do and pride themselves on their food. Note that the restaurant is on a busy road so much of the traffic noise does come in. But otherwise, the seating areas are spacious and facilitaty is clean. I would happily visit again!

I drive past this restaurant almost everyday on my way home so I thought why not try. This place has the best wholesome food, So good for you and super delicious the chsrgrilled pork is insane the mix of sweet and smokey flavors have me wanting more 🤤 the pho and noodle soups are divine as well !! Super awesome service and will definitely be back for that PORK

We throughly enjoyed our dining experience. The food was sooo good! We are so happy to have this local to us, especially when I’m always crazing pho or a nice Vietnamese salad! Thank you so much Lixiri’s Kitchen! #SupportGlenEden

Although the owner is lovely, the food was less so. Mee Goreng with almost no noodle, and what noodle there was it was the dried stuff you get in a bag with heaped veges and meat on top, so had gone soggy. As soon as I tried the meat something seemed off or a little rancid. Dogs getting the rest.

The worst food ever. OMG..ordered a cheese burger and chips. Chips undercooked, pale, and limp.. Cheeseburger had over grilled cheese, which made the cheese crispy and unpleasant...he smallest piece of lettuce and a little 1=4 peice of tomato..no T sauce. I had to throw it out..please be warned

Warning! Do not go here! This place is a joke! I ordered a snapper fish and chips When I got home it wasn’t snapper, 3 small pieces and small fries for $34! What pissed me off more was the fish wasn’t snapper! Thieves! This owner was a sweet talker but really a sweet talker thief!
Disappointed experience. Can not accept why I have to wait for half an hour for the fish & Chips while people after us were served first. The food tasted terrible!
Friendly staff, excellent food. Particularly good roasts.

I just had a lovely roast here. What you you get for $16 these days at a cafe is no where near as satisfying as a roast! The pork was succulent. The vege were cooked fresh in the wok in front of me and the broccoli still has crunch. Roast beetroot, potato, kumara and carrots. Nice hunk of crackling. Partner said the homemade pork bun was also delicious.

Quality overall was bad but I bought a chicken sandwich and there was more deep fried crust than chicken itself. Far too much on their chicken in the display cabinets also, so I guess this could have been expected. I hope you improve quality in the future

When the takeaways were allowed to open. I brought a roast. When I got home and opened the container, the peas were different shades of green (meaning, old cooked peas were mixed with freshly cooked peas. I was shocked that the lady heated my meal up in the microwave???I left half my meal for the morning. When I went to eat it for breakfast, my food was off!

This little takeaway does it all and for cheap ($8.50 snapper and chips) Roast, Thai, Chinese, burgers, fish, pork buns, noodles and even pies. The lady owner is very energetic, positive and friendly. Very lucky to plachave this as our local.

I'm surprised to see so many negative reviews. This is your classic no-fuss takeout. The lady behind the counter is friendly and direct. It's always busy, with lots of regulars (just like me) that come back for their favourites... in my case, the chicken chow mein!
Best kebabs in west! In my opinion. Fresh ingredients, and bigger portions than the others I've tried. I'm a vegetarian so can only speak for the falafel kebabs/meals.

Use to always go here by far the nicest hummus and the meat is good too. What lets the meal down is when u order kabab on rice/salad and chips. What u get isnt a salad at all...lettuce, carrot, onion and 1 half a slice of tomato. Cmon the kebabs look nothing like that yet u call it kebab on wateva u order. Not cool
Good place for late night munchies ordered falafel kebab was pretty good
These guys are amazing! The food is fresh, made fast at a great price and service Highly recommended!

We placed the order over the phone and the lady who answered the call could barely understand the order, I kept repeating myself, either she wasn’t listening or didn’t understand English clearly and then when we went to pick up which she told us would be ready in 15 minutes, the order was not even ready and we had to repeat the order again only to miss out on one order and my son had to go and order again. We are regular customers and this is the first time we encountered such hopeless service..

My very first visit out of curiosity turned out, not a bad one actually. We have same style Mongolian BBQ all you can eat in Taiwan with decades of glorious history. So I know what it is already before I go Their buffet selection is not many but it's okay, eventually customers are here to enjoy the live cooking BBQ. Exactly how do we enjoy the BBQ here? Easy. You pick the meat or seafood that you want, go with the veges that you feel good fit for the meat or seafood, then go to the source bar to select the source and spice that you favourite, finally give it to the chef, then just wait for quick 1-2 mins, your Mongolian BBQ is done. The best part is you get to play around the seasonings and the spice every time, so you know what is the best for you. Bonus point, the chef makes really good pancakes, ask for one and add on a few scoops of ice creams with toppings, OMG, heaven! It's very cheap, not even $36 per person ‼️

I like this concept of choosing your own meat, vegetables, sauces, spices, etc, and having it cooked on the big hot plate. It's pretty easy to navigate, even if it is trial and error with the combination you've made up. Separate hot food is available as are salads and other side dishes. Dessert is great, they make really good pancakes, with different sweet sauces to accompany and an assortment of ice creams and toppings. The lady serving was very accommodating and friendly. The buffet dinner was $33.90 per adult. Enjoyed our dinner here in the relaxed atmosphere and would definitely recommend Gengis Khan New Lynn.

I booked with Gengis KhanNew Lynn for my daughters first birthday and absolutely loved everything. It was a perfect venue to host a small family gathering using the private function area which was at no additional cost. The space was perfect for us to celebrate her away from the public area. We got to decorate the room how we wanted and it turned out perfect as we have envisioned. The food was good and the customer service from the manager was so really warm, welcoming, friendly and accommodating. I highly recommend this restaurant 🥰

Really enjoyed Gengis Khan. All you can eat - grab the fresh meats, veges, sauces, spices in a bowl and hand to the cook who will stir fry your selection. Go back as many times as you like. Finish with desert of cooked on demand pancakes and ice cream etc. Suitable for solo to large groups. Licensed and BYO wine only. Make sure you go hungry!

This establishment is rough around the edges like a lot of places in West Auckland, but don't be fooled by the outershell of this place. Lovely workers, reasonable pricing, tidy, and my boys came home very full! It's definitely a hidden gem.

This is my go to place for breakfast and meals . Excellent service and great food . Always hygienic and quality is surely above excellence.This is the best Samosa in Auckland no doubt . I highly recommend Mumbai Chaat .
Excellent food and service with friendly staff. Ordered kathiyawadi thali with baingan bharta and bajra roti. Will visit again
I regularly order for a large group. Great value for money. The Thalis are our favourite. Friendly family staff. I totally recommend this
“Pav bhaji was buttery, pani puri tangy, and sev puri crispy – absolutely won my heart!” New management
Amazing food. Yumm yummy. Their ragda patties is superb and amazing customer service by new Management.

Came with low expectations but actually really enjoyed the food. The coffee was good too. The pleasant surprise for me was that my salmon smash avo rosti had chili flakes sprinkled on top! It made my breakfast very exciting! Thank you

Came in today 9:45 am paid meatball spaghetti 9:50 am , meal came around 10:23 am Half hour cook 1 meal? While business not busy at all And meatballs in the middles is cold, not even warm, is literally COLD I’m rush to go city work. So I asked staff re cook or re heat up for me put in takeaway box When I arrive office 11:05 am , open it and eat it, finally I can see why is cold meatball, cause still raw in the middle This unacceptable waited half hour, re heat again, still raw
Ordered a mocha that turned out quite watery and lacked flavour. Also waited around 30 minutes for a simple egg on toast. The atmosphere is nice, but the service and quality could definitely improve.

Went in as it seemed like since there was hardly any customers it would be quick as we were hungry, Asked the lady about the deal they have basically on a billboard and she instantly became rude to me and was acting as if I was below her. Food was terrible. French toast decorated like a 5 year old made it, blt was dry as they didn’t add any sauce. The bread was toast not a toasted sandwich. Bread also looked exactly like the $2 loaf you can buy. Nothing special and they don’t know how to make coffee. DO NOT WASTE YOUR TIME.

I love Avondale coffee club the people that work there are so lovely .love the meals and just love to relax there I'm a VIP to look out for my knitted dolls I have Been leaving there for customers to take for free a random act of kindness ...love from Susan

Had an amazing experience! The smoky mix of vegetables and paneer was absolutely delicious—flavorful and perfectly cooked. Definitely try the Kadhai chicken with bone and ask for it to be smoky—it’s a game changer( we had )Kudos to the talented chefs, Ravi and Pramod, who truly know their craft. Each dish had its own unique touch, showcasing their specialties and skill. Highly recommend!
I ordered Garlic Nan and Chilly chicken for my guest,and the Nan was burned and tasted very bad, also the Onion and Capsicum in chilly chicken were spoiled and chicken tasted stale.
Oh my god my kids love this restaurant food ! Boss is very nice to give my children some extra food. Highly recommended! Local best Indian food! Authentic Indian cuisine

Alright, Bollywood Xpress. Listen up, folks! We've got pocket-friendly rates on the menu, none of that Sandringham pricing that'll have your wallet shedding tears. Whatever, let's dive right into flavour and texture! We're talking Samosa Chaat! Two golden samosas, fried to crispy perfection, tangy tamarind chutney, drenched with cool yogurt, and a sprinkle of spices. Sweet, spicy, & sour all doing the tango in your mouth. It's a flavour dance party. Then, enter the Delhi-style Butter Chicken—chicken pieces luxuriating in a creamy tomato-based gravy, like they’re chillin’ in a jacuzzi of flavour. You catch a subtle whiff of smokiness, adding depth, and those fenugreek leaves? They bring a unique touch that elevates the whole experience. And let's not forget the ultimate wingman, the Garlic Naan. This bad boy is all about that perfect char, slathered generously with garlic goodness. Swooping in to save the day, ensuring no drop of that velvety butter chicken gravy goes to waste. In conclusion, Bollywood Express sets the stage for warm ambiance in your mouth and it’s those special touches that keep me coming back for more. Oh, and if you’re feeling vege, hit that Matar Paneer! Support local.

The food was terrible to taste. The chicken fried rice was like pulao, the manchurian chicken was spoilt. Travelled from Henderson to pick up the food and then had to go back to Blockhouse Bay to return it. While I got a refund, I will never ever go back there and I don’t recommend this place to anyone. Absolutely ghastly 🤮

This place is tucked away from all the hustle and bustle in the industrial area. The atmosphere is really inviting and they had the heaters running to keep you warm well you enjoy a FIVE star meal. The platter for four feed five of us. Super succulent and flavourful smoked goodness. Highly recommend this wonderful place. Can't wait to go back in summer and hopefully fit in some desert. Thank you to our lovely hostess and the amazing Chef ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Recommended by a colleague. Unfortunately did not meet or exceed my expectations. I have been to several BBQ places throughout NZ. Reason for my rating. 1. Quantity We ordered the $155.00 platter. Serves 3 - 4 people. Upon receiving this platter, it definitely feeds 3 - 4 people entree size plates not proper full sized BBQ meal as I would've expected having been to places like Kikas Brazilian BBQ in Henderson who's platters would double in the portion and quality & also the price being $109. 2. Service. Didn't really feel welcomed upon entering facility. Customer service could do with a few lessons on customer focus and communication. Great venue great atmosphere. Lovely interior decor and exterior eating area. Keeping in mind this review is my own personal experience with my family. Your own experience may differ and have a different dining perspective. Hoping in the near future WHAT a BBQ smokehouse review and improve for catering family sized platters at a reasonable price that reflects quantity. Happy to pay 155.00, just show us $155.00 worth of meat 🫡. Taste and flavour on point, moist succulent, tender meat. Just missing the generosity for those who love eating meat and heaps of it!!
Excellent BBQ, a meat lovers dream. The ribs were our favourite, we couldn’t finish our platter, and the best side dish is the potatoes. Friendly people and nice casual atmosphere. Lots of parking.

This place was absolutely Amazing. There was plenty of space inside and outdoors. Kid friendly as well, plenty of games for the kids to enjoy whilst waiting for your food. The food didn’t take that long either it was ready within mins and was sooo delicious. Was an excellent choice to spend our 11year wedding anniversary dinner here. Staff were great and friendly. Loved and enjoyed our dinning experience so much.

What can I say - start to finish a brilliant experience. The bbq is an impressive bit of kit and staff only too happy to show off whats being prepared and how. The food was phenomenal itself and the service was spot on. The playlist however was an unexpected star of the show, as a Scot in Aotearoa it was a pleasure to hear banger after banger while enjoying good food, drinks and a sunshiney setting. Superb!

I can't say enough nice comments about my visit to Columbus inside Manukau Mitre 10. The coffee was brewed to perfection. Thanks to their barista. The food was prepared beautifully and served in quick time. The staff even took the time to say thanks as we left.

I had a very very very terrible experience of customer service here. I understood it is a bit late to order some foods around 3:30pm. So I just ordered a cup of coffee for takeaway. I waited for 2-3 minutes in front of counter ( no customers) and the man showed me an anger face. I thinked that’s ok I just want a coffee. Then he “throw ed” the coffee on the table, say nothing, and keeped on his tidy jobs. So cool! It is the first and last time i will be there!

Really nice setting I always go to the one in new Lynn I would always take my dog spotty for a cup of tea but unfortunately the coffee has not been the best is the guy that's making it uses the milk over and over it's rather stale but in the past it has been the best place to go unfortunately the times that I have been there people have complained about my dog so I no longer frequent this place and choose to go to deer deer coffee roasting bar in Glen Eden but the setting among the plants is rather nice
Yummy burnt cheesecake, not the usual cheesecake that a cafe usually have, made it pretty good. Coffee is nice, friendly staff and ambience is okay.

♿ A good setup with the table seating stool sitting or standard table seating or out side the store inside mitre 10 next to playground where children can play and you are there by them . Ordered decaffeinated mocha and a scone orange and date Also the delicious carrot cake 🧇 Cabinet food has been getting better with fancier cupcakes etc.. Service is ok.

Random Sunday cruise looking for lunch. Everywhere seemed busy I remembered coming across a restaurant while browsing on the new lynn RSA website. Decent food, good size portion. No complaints here. Steak was cooked perfectly. The BLT was top notch. Nice and quiet place for lunch on a Sunday. Will need to try the roast nights as well. Will be returning.
These people should be allowed to make dog food let alone human food. The kids burger was burnt, the bun was like cardboard, all the chips were cold. Terrible, horrible food. Avoid like the plague
