Went here with the family and it was super delish, ordered the lamb shanks and it was so tender. The sides you help yourself once your recieve your meal and there were good side choices available. Prices are reasonably cheap. Tea and coffee also available

Semi regular here. Haven't been for a few months. No more lamb shanks. No Sunday roast. Ordered food upon arrival. Another person in the group who arrived half an hour later had their meal arrive about 15 mins before ours. I was told this was because one of our orders included a pizza and was pointed to the person who was only just making them. Three medium rare steaks for the group - all came very rare and with lots of gristle. One of the desserts wasn't available and I was offered a cheesecake instead which I liked the sound of. Two small cubes of cheesecake and a spoonful of icecream. Something has gone terribly wrong with the restaurant.

There is zero service when we were there today. We made a reservation online and were only told that they never received it and never accepted bookings online. If that is the case, they should have disabled the online booking option in the first instance. Then we waited for 20 minutes at the counter to place an order, only to be told that the waiting time for food is an hour..she could have informed us all that time while we were waiting. We get it that the place is busy and under-staffed, but the lady at the counter was so dismissive and cold. The worst experience ever. We will not come back!

There’s a 1 star review below that cracked me up. Someone got mad over the cook wiping their face and forehead (with a tissue) whilst cooking. Mate you wouldn’t last 5 seconds eating outside of NZ 😂 Anyway, just came to say the food was great (had a curry). The service was fine. Not anything to rave about but they were quick and efficient.

Good spot for a quick lunch. The Hainanese Chicken on rice my partner had he said was good. I enjoyed my chicken sandwich. The baguette was soft and freshly made and enough fresh vegetables with nice lemongrass flavour.

I ordered the chicken and vermicelli dish from here and it was so delicious! A little bit spicy but not too overpowering. Staff were very friendly and pleasant and the food was ready within a few minutes. Plenty of seating indoor and outside the restaurant.

Everything at Vietnamese restaurant Hansan (New Lynn) was🔥🔥🔥 The appetizer, mains, service and atmosphere was top-notch! Had spicy prawns & rice, then combination beef soup and chicken satay skewers for home🥳

When I was in Vietnam there was a lot of delicious food with fresh herbs and lots of flavour, but I don’t remember eating the sort of food you find so often in NZ Vietnamese restaurants that is so full of sugar and little flavour otherwise. Here in Auckland it seems to be hard to find Vietnamese people cooking what they would eat back home and I think we are all poorer for it.

We had a celebratory lunch with my best friend 🧡 Brett our waiter welcomed us with a warm and friendly smile. He soon approached to take our order, I wasn't quite ready, however after asking him what lunch meals was Bodrum Kitchen Brickworks New Lynn renowned for or were popular dishes most ordered by their customers, Brett recommended the Bodrum Feast with the succulent chicken skewers. We ordered two servings of that along with a mango passion dream mocktail and a mango smoothie. Patricia aka Paty brought our plates of food to us with a smile that lit up the room. The Turkish food was delicious, mouth-watering, and flavourful. We enjoyed our lunch and drinks so much, that we mentioned we would be returning soon. We loved the modern decor, there was plenty of natural sunlight inside the restaurant, the food was delicious and healthy and to top it all off we had exceptional customer service from both Brett and Paty. Thank you for being attentive and hospitable. We appreciate you both and compliment the chefs, we loved your food 🫶🙏
Very nice place to go for dinner or brunch. Nice food. Friendly staff. Lovely atmosphere. Love the blue discs over the bar.

Good attentive fast service. Clean modern with nice decor, Food and coffee wasn’t anything special. It is really a Turkish themed cafe. It was slightly off the mark and wasn’t either authentic Turkish food of typical cafe food. Particularly odd ordering a lamb pizza, the waiter couldn’t describe the pizza base or style. $25 for pizza and an additional $5 for the cheese? ($30) Always assumed cheese was a key ingredient but apparently it is an additional option? I wouldn’t go back if there were other options nearby.

My husband and I visited Bodrum Kitchen New Lynn for the first time ever on 20th November. The staff were so helpful and friendly from the moment we walked in. We were served within minutes of us being seated, and our food and drinks came out quickly. We were so impressed with the service. The food was delicious, we could not fault our meals. Fresh, tasty and filling. Great portion sizes too. The drinks were great. The atmosphere was divine. Such a bright yet cosy space. Lots of room and tables so we didn’t feel crammed in with other customers. We will 100% be back.

Food was great, I loved their take on a kiwi big breakfast. It was delicious, and the service was excellent - really helpful and made me feel comfortable. A nice place to catch up with friends and family will be back to try the mezze platter.

Not from this area and was first time to Cleaver and Co. Waitress was very attentive, and service was fast. Four of us shared the calamari, which was cut into the largest pieces I've seen in a restaurant. Was tender and cooked to perfection. Probably the best calamari we have had ever. We had 2 brisket, spare ribs and a cheeseburger parma. Good portion sizes and tender. Too fill for dessert. We will be back.

Had a beautiful lunch here yesterday - my third visit in as many months and finally managed to get some pics for this review. Appreciated the correspondence from the venue and the service / staff. Although the food took longer to reach us compared to our other visits which were super quick, I know its because you were waiting on our late arrival orders so they'd all come out together, so thank you for that. Food was delish as usual - special mention to the tenderness of the pork ribs, brisket & the squid. Only one improvement suggested to boost the platter to next level, adding some pork belly / crackling for a bit of crunch. Portion size is perfect - each time we've had leftovers to take home. The creamy sauces are gold - would buy those by the bottle if you sold it. Really like the printing out orders (what's still outstanding) so people can easily see and pay for theirs. Some of our group are already planning their next visit. Wish we had one on the North Shore.
Tuesday $30 Steak night…. Love it! Staff are always friendly, didn’t have to wait too long, steak cooked how we ordered it, Mojitos are delicious. Thank you Cleaver & Co New Lynn

I have been coming here for many years since they changed tack ages ago. I might not come for a few months but I’m recognised and well looked after. The food is always amazing and the craft beers are a sea of goodness in otherwise bland New Lynn. Always a classic and great place to chill. Hope it never changes!
Thoroughly enjoyed our meal! Everything was delicious! I would definitely recommend!

Staff and service were really lovely. 5 stars! Food was okay, but personally found the pricing a little steep for what i got. Have been in multiple times over the past couple years since moving to the area, but only ever got food from the cabinet (Which is great). However, this morning i thought id get a cooked breakfast. Mince on toast w/ additional hash brown ($3) tomato ($3) and 1x egg ($2.50, the foh person gave me a .50 discount.) when the food arrived the bread was fresh but only slightly toasted, the mince was full of Veg (which i liked) but was really apparent, that it was just left over pie filling taste was okay, but texture was pretty gelatinous. The portion size of the additions seemed a little unbalanced vs the cost. For instance at $3 each i got 1/4 of a tomato. The hash brown the size of half a deck of playing cards and a fried egg the size of a disposable coffee cup lid. Spent a total of $28.20 (including a small coffee that was good) see pic. All in all, i’ll still recommend taste and still support it, i just think (personally) that i’d adjust expectations to reality when it comes to the cooked dine in menu. 👍🏽
What an amazing little shop! I branched out and got the chicken, cranberry & Brie pie. Absolutely delicious!! Super fresh pastry and filling was perfectly balanced.

Tasty Cafe & Bakery in Avondale is a popular eatery that I've often visited in the last few years. The overall impression I get is that this is a great place to buy food from or dine in with family and friends. The array of pies the bakery creates is unique and never disappoints! I went for the new Cambodian fish curry pie and hot chips and it was a great combo! The pie pastry is always on point, the curry flavour infused with lemongrass (I think) is unique and flavoursome and the hoki fish melts in your mouth! Also the hot chips were crispy and tasty! Great pie and hot chips and I'll be back again for more!

This local bakery is family owned. The staff are wonderful. Polite and always smiling. The food is good, with the usual bakery delites, especially the steak and cheese pies, which I think are fantastic! If you are in the area, stop in for a great coffee and pie. You won't be disappointed😊
I had the plum sauce and duck pie. My partner got the award winning mince and cheese pie. OMG, they were absolutely incredible! Best pie that I've ever had. Staff are very friendly too.

14 years now and still our favorite local Chinese Takeaway! Great people! I love how they do my fish and my granddaughters have always loved their food! Our favorite is the steak, ginger and spring onion (has broccoli, carrots, cauliflower etc as well) - so good and healthy! Can be busy at dinner time so maybe phone your order in but depending on what you order, it is normally ready in 10 to 15 minutes. 🥰
Very good value, fast service as well. Ate here a couple times during the 2 months I stayed in NZ. The fish & chips are pretty decent I'd say. Would recommend.
Good value, reasonable quality, nice people, pretty quick and a good range of asian and western food, and they are open quite long hours!

We've been visiting this place for years, consistently, authentic and tasty Hong Kong Chinese takeaway food. I recommend the strip streak and spring onion, and sweet and sour pork. Also, throw in a couple of spring rolls normally and it tastes delicious.
Great all round takeaway. A regular. Food good. Staff not outwardly hospitable but part of the charm. Generous portions.

We stumbled across this place by accident but were pleasantly surprised! The lady at the counter was super helpful and offered to let my partner try a small sample of the curry first, as he's extremely sensitive to spices (but loves Indian food). The food was prepared with care and made with my partner's spice sensitivities in mind, and the lady at the counter was helpful and patient with our questions. We also got good recommendations as we weren't sure what to order. The food was amazing with great flavour and texture, and good value for money to boot. We spent $45 for two people and were stuffed with leftovers to spare. Thankyou very much for serving us!
Friendly staff. Yummy food. I told them specifically that I do not handle spice well, while my partner loved Spice. They were extremely accommodating and gave us extra chillies and sauces.

"The dish of the night for me was the soft buns, buttered potatoes gravy, and lemon salad – it was cooked to perfection, moist, and bursting with freshness. From the subtle Indian accents of the staff to the impeccably balanced flavors of each dish, this place speaks volumes through its food without needing to say much at all." Must try, Recommended to all Food Lovers.

Best Jai Jalaram Khaman is a fantastic spot for authentic Gujarati vegetarian food in Auckland. The flavors are rich and traditional, with dishes like pav bhaji, dahi puri, and vada pav standing out for their freshness and taste. The food is prepared without artificial additives, which makes it even more enjoyable. The service is warm and friendly, adding to the overall great experience. While the seating is limited, it’s a perfect place for takeaway or a quick meal. If you're a fan of Gujarati cuisine, this place is definitely worth a visit!

"I have to say however, that the dish of the night, ordered by me, was really good soft herbs, buttered new potatoes, lemon salad. Cooked to perfection, moist and full of freshness, From the beautiful accents of the discreet Indian staff, to the spoon-licking, perfectly balanced dishes. This place has a lot to say, without saying too much at all. New Menu with changed prices.

Good place to come for takeaways but not much to support eating there. Friendly owner, which is always nice. Roast meat was very tasty - generous portion, gravy, vegetables etc If you are eating there you won't get a plate or a knife. Meal will come in plastic container with a wooden fork. There's definitely room for an extra table inside, quite strange no plates or proper cutlery. Wouldn't take much effort to make this a more enjoyable experience for people who want to eat there ...

~$10/Person We tried the small beef meal, lamb roll, and a fried chicken and potatoes. The food was very yummy although the oil did taste a bit old and the fried food was slightly soggy as it wasn't a busy day. The owners were very friendly :-) Overall still a great place and would return to again if I was in the area
Best roast in akl. The couple here are lovely and the food talks for itself.
The owners are very nice and friendly. The portions are pretty generous and the price is reasonable. Their roast taste amazing very well seasoned not too salty or too bland. Highly recommend trying.

I’ve been coming here with my mum since I was a little kid and Angelo’s Roast Blockhouse has never once disappointed, beautifully golden and crispy potatoes, generous portions of the chicken and lamb in the roast meals as well as veges and that beautiful gravy! The rolls (pork) are my absolute favourite! Tonight’s dinner was a large lamb roast meal for hubby, a large chicken roast meal for myself and a small chicken roast meal for my daughter! Hubby said “why would anyone make a roast at home when you can go to this place” I 1000% agree!

Subway has always been my go-to option for a quick and satisfying meal, but unfortunately, this visit was quite disappointing. But on 13/07, at 9pm I ordered a Three Pepper Chicken Footlong, and the quality was far below expectations. The staff member on duty did not provide good service. The sub had very little sauce, despite my partner clearly mentioning the sauce choices. The cheese portion was minimal, and the bread was over-toasted, making it difficult to enjoy. Additionally, the veggies were insufficient, which made the overall sub dry and unappetizing. I usually enjoy Subway meals and have had great experiences in other branches, but this time was genuinely upsetting. I hope you can take this feedback constructively and ensure better quality and service in the future.

With Subway today to get myself a foot long and a 6 inch for my partner. The staff were friendly and efficient. Also got offered 3rd sauce to try which was nice. My local go to for a quick lunch Sterling Arnet Kakapo Business Sales

This was the best subway I have had in a while. The woman behind the counter lastnight 23/3 had good customer service and was not stingy I. The salads like I found at Ponsonby subway. A decent amount of salad and sauces, the bread taster very fresh and the cookies also. Thanks for the great sandwich.

I ordered 3 footlong Pork Riblet last Friday night at store. To be honesty, the sandwiches are not bad. After I have scanned my subcard and asked the staff if it’s successful. She confirmed and said the points will be on my account, but it takes time. Then I found the points is not there in 3 days. I came back on Monday and asked the same lady. She said no idea and can do nothing to make up for it. Really disappointed at the way they treated customers and dealing with complaints. I am a regular customer of this branch. Now, I swear I won’t come back unless they sort it out.
The $9.00 foot long deal starts at 6:00pm now. The young woman behind the counter got slammed with orders but she did a great job 👏

I came all the away from Auckland to Christchurch to visit my friend. I was searching on Google a good restaurant with authentic Indian tastes and suddenly curry kingdom pop up on my phone screen. Highly recommended this place. Had a great customer service and excellent food. Especially tandoori chicken!!!!

Decent curries, and friendly staff. Comfortable seating, easy access from the street with parking across the road. We had the Rogan Josh and Goa Fish Curry. Both were tasty but not amazing. The garlic nan was a nice addition. Worth coming to if you’re after a decent and reasonably priced curry.

Posted prices on the store front are not honoured and they will try to charge you more. The prices they try to charge you aren't posted anywhere inside - that extra $1.00 matters. It's just bad faith. This was the dosa menu on the front of the store. Kesari is $6.99 and they wanted to charge me $8.00. He was going on about a complimentary size - bro how is it complimentary when you're paying and it's the same size as $8.00. Just absolutely terrible.
Amazing food! Very friendly staff with good service! They also have good prices, especially the daily butter chicken deal. Highly recommend.
I tried best dosa in all over the Auckland the taste was too attempting and the sambar was also too good the thickness was perfect Thanks to chef for giving great food

Great service but fairly average sushi. Caters to a takeaway quick snack or lunch. The quality of the ingredients and balance of flavours are lacking a bit but it’s a good affordable option in a hurry.

The food at Sushi Bee is amazing, full of delicious flavors and delightful tastes. We thoroughly enjoy our regular visits to the shop, which is ideally located on a main street with ample parking. I would highly recommend anyone looking for some quality food to pop into Sushi Bee.

One of my families go to for sushi and it’s just up the road. I always ask her to make a fresh batch of salmon, cream cheese and avo sushi and she makes it quick with big chucks of salmon aswell. Always tastes fresh, my also loves their katsu don, especially because of the big portions

Love her sushi. Some places don't get the filling to rice ratio right but hers is always perfect. Around $1.70 per piece. Freshly made and if you want something you don't see she will happily make it for you on the spot. Sushi bee and St Pierre's are my go to's for sushi.
Almost nothing available at 1:30. Five pieces in the cabinet. Flavour of the salmon was strange and didn’t taste fresh.

UPDATE 17.02.25 Tried to visit the store today (6.20pm) to discuss what happened lastnight and how to get a refund - the store is completely closed! Signage out saying open, no one on site and doors are locked. IF THE STORE IS SHUT WHY ARE YOU STILL ALLOWING DELIVERY APP ORDERS AND TAKING PEOPLE’S MONEY?! Domino’s head office please do something about this! Placed a delivery order tonight at 9.40pm with expected delivery by 10.05pm. It’s now 10.30pm and the app has been sitting on “your order is being made” for the last 40 mins. Have tried to call the store multiple times for an update with NO answer . Is my order coming??? Have had no communication of what’s going on and with the store listed to close at 11pm I doubt they plan to still deliver my dinner. Service here is terrible. Will happily update this review if anyone bothers to get in touch with me and explain. Going to bed hungry now.

I order 2 pizzas . I order 1 chicken cranberry but I got chicken Camembert pizza which got bacon on it . I don’t eat bacon so I called them back it was their manger Vinitha who attend my call and I ask him I have ordered chicken cranberry but I got chicken Camembert with bacon on it , In reply he said we don’t have chicken cranberry in menu so i assumed that you ordering chicken Camembert . Does that make any sense ? Instead of saying we don’t have chicken cranberry he just assume that I want chicken Camembert because chicken Camembert is on menu . That was dominos manager Instead of accepting his mistake he was blaming me .

First off, don’t order from Uber Eats because the lady who delivered our food had opened the chicken wings and eaten one. The box was open and you could see one of the five wings were missing from the saucy indent. Disgusting. In any case, the food is not great - the Hawaiian has ham that is overly salted and MSGd and spongey. The pineapple is sugary and sad and the cheese is cheap plasticy glue. The wings flavouring is also just overly sweet and they aren’t crispy - this pizza is so full of preservatives it’s barely food. But maybe I just don’t like Domino’s

Few times, weeks apart have gotten a pepperoni pizza from this branch, and it always comes soaked. Very greasy, it makes me sick. Used to order from New Lynn branch before they made deliveries strictly from the nearest one, but I don't even trust New Lynn branch anymore because last time I walked in, it was just 2 new, young guys who put cheese sauce on my periperi chicken, instead of periperi sauce. Standards have dropped.

When I got there at 10:30, they immediately told me the shop was closed, with a "now cooking" sign turned on. Despite that, they showed me attitude, which was very disappointing. Later, I ordered online from the same store, but the pizza they made was so bad I couldn't even eat it. Did I pay them less to deserve such poor quality? They also mentioned staff shortage, but is that my problem? Very disappointing experience overall! would never recommend from that shop !!!!!!!

Staff members are friendly, patience, accommodating, and work fast. Queue can be long at times. The staff members tried their best to fulfil the order fast and accurately. The food are cooked well, up to McDonald's standards. The drive thru lane is behind and around the Z shop, and they have 2 waiting bays at the end of the drive thru line.
Make sure your items have all the ingredients before leaving!! And your drink is the one you asked for!! And don't come after hours, they won't serve you even though it's open 24hrs!!

Friday ordered a simple Mac attack combo and a serious angus combo at the drive thru. Received 2 fillet of fish burgers, and for the serious angus had no idea what we were given. Few weeks prior, same order and the serious angus was something entirely different aswell.
Another one of the rare Best team serving here. Excellent customer service even though in a tough busiest time doesn't matter day or night 100% satisfied Keep it up team
It mostly focuses on the drive-thru, but overall, the food is good and fresh. Don't forget to have your Macca's app ready to earn points!
What a fantastic place and bunch of people. Such a worth while endeavor. Very very cool.

We’ve been regulars at your place for a while now and usually love your pizzas – they’re consistently made close to perfection. But this time, unfortunately, our order really missed the mark. The dough was unusually tough and too thin in the center, making it hard to enjoy. The toppings were also way less than what we’re used to – the whole pizza felt like it was made by a first-time baker, which was disappointing given the high standard you usually deliver. Just thought we’d let you know as loyal customers who genuinely enjoy your food and service. Hope this was just a one-off and things are back to your usual quality next time.

Ordered 2 pizzas with 2 sides for delivery. What was meant to be a half hour wait ended up being over an hour. I only live a 10 minute drive away and it’s a Sunday so traffic and travel time should not have affected wait time. My gluten free pizza had so much bare base. Half the amount of toppings I would expect on a pizza from here. Looks like very little attention was given while putting it together. Very disappointing

“Caution: Desperation zone.” Saw this bold little sticker outside a completely unrelated pizza place. If your crust is really that special, why try so hard to convince everyone else? Maybe spend more time perfecting the pizza making and less time policing the sidewalk.

One of the best pizza huts I’ve ever been to. They are super busy but their customer service is always on point and their pizzas are made to perfection. I’ve never had a problem with the vegan cheese pizza they make for my daughter who’s allergic to milk. She’s never hived up that means it’s not cross contaminated. Thanks guys and also Ritu who served me today!
Best quality and most consistent Pizza Hutt in the area. Americano w San Francisco base pictured.

Delicious burgers and great service! Just had a meal at BurgerFuel New Lynn and it really hit the spot. The burgers were fresh, packed with flavour, and cooked perfectly—especially loved the juicy patty and their signature aioli (seriously addictive). The staff were super friendly and helpful, and service was quick even though it was fairly busy. The whole place was clean and had a good vibe. Also appreciated that they use natural ingredients—you can really taste the quality. Bit on the pricier side compared to fast food, but totally worth it for the quality you get. Highly recommend if you’re in the area and craving a proper gourmet burger. Will definitely be back!

Amazing service and kind staff. I didn’t know what to order as I wasn’t very familiar with Burger Fuel, but the woman at the counter didn’t hesitate to help me out to try and figure out something that I would actually enjoy. She was very patient and didn’t rush me at all. And the food was amazing! I ordered the Bacon BBQ Roadster with a side of kumara fries, and it did not disappoint at all. It was a tad bit pricey, but would definitely go again.

The food was pretty good, with each dish thoughtfully prepared and full of vibrant flavors that left a satisfying impression. The service was equally commendable, as the staff were attentive, friendly, and made sure to check in regularly, ensuring we had everything we needed throughout the meal. The atmosphere also played a big role in enhancing the experience, creating a comfortable and inviting setting that complemented the delicious food and excellent service.

In general, the place is good. Sometimes, the music is way too loud, and you can't talk, which can be frustrating if you are eating with friends/family. The toilet is a bit scary 🫣 The lady working today was terrific and has excellent customer service, but she is not there that often and the other staff is not 1/10 as caring about their jobs 😁

Staff members are friendly, attentive, and courteous. The burgers are generous in size, well cooked and well made. The burger also made fast but without compromising its quality and flavour, and keep brought back memories of why I love Burger Fuel. The sides and aiolo are still as good as they used to be.

Absolutely amazing pizza! Fresh, hot, and packed with flavour every time. The crust was perfect, the toppings were generous, and the service was quick and friendly. Domino’s New Lynn has definitely become my go-to spot for a delicious and satisfying meal. Highly recommend to all pizza lovers!

Friendly, courteous, accommodating and attentive staff members. They try their best to make the pizza as you ordered ready by the requested pick up time. Some time is much busier than others, so you might want to give some leeway. For less busy one, the pizzas will be ready on time. Parking at the front of the shop can be challenging, but plenty of space at the car park behind the shops.

They got my order wrong. Vegetarian should be thin and crispy but they did ham and cheese thin and crispy on stead. No attention when making an order. I had to drive all the way back there to complain and they did not even apologised, they took my wrong order back and told me to wait for a new one 🙄. Costing me petrol and time. They should Pay more attention as the place was almost empty, only 2 other costumers and they still managed to get the order wrong. Imagine if the place was packed and lots of orders. No excuse for their mistake at this point. The reason why I order online is so I don’t have to wait. I had to go back and wait for a new order.

Very disappointing to find that we've never had a bad experience with dominos up until now. The pizzas weren't even cooked and the base was full of flour. The garlic cheese scrolls were also under cooked. It took way too long for food to be delivered to us under cooked and as if the pizza base wasn't even rolled out properly. Utterly disappointed about everything right up to the delivery service. We don't expect much but we do expect our pizzas cooked and somewhat presentable. These pizzas are not even eatable. So disappointed

Visited the store recently and wasn’t too happy with the hygiene. When I arrived, one of the staff was cleaning the floor with a brush. When he saw me, he put the brush aside, greeted me, and asked for my order details — all good so far. But then, without washing his hands or changing gloves, he went on to fold the pizza box using the same gloves. Luckily, he didn’t touch the pizza itself or I would’ve just left it there. Also noticed his gloves were ripped, and the store had a weird smell overall. Definitely think the staff could use a bit of food safety and hygiene training — not the best experience.
No good store when it comes to Door dashing. Placed an order for 16 piece pack 8 original 8 hot n spicy paid $97 which included delivery etc to receive 8 spicy chicken only. No good at all.
Fast services with car park. Clean spacious.

To the two workers (Drive thru guy and the lady at the til) who served me lastnight before closing ... twice lol THANKYOU THANKYOU THANKYOU for blessing our stomachs with more than what I ordered 🥹 Didnt even realise it til I left. Hope to see them again in store to thank them for their kindness!

Today I ordered chicken online from KFC New Lynn but accidentally selected the wrong pick-up time—1 PM instead of 6 PM. Realizing the mistake, I called the store, and the lady I spoke to assured me that it wouldn’t be a problem to have the chicken ready at 6 PM instead. She told me to come in at 6 PM for a fresh order. When I arrived at the store at 5.30 PM, I was surprised to see my order already ready. The staff simply retrieved the two buckets of chicken from the warmer. This raised some concerns, but I hoped for the best. Unfortunately, when I got home, I noticed that the receipt still showed the pick-up time as 1 PM. As feared, the chicken was cold, soggy, and tasted like it had been sitting in the warmer for hours. I tried calling the store to address the issue, but the phone was left ringing for 10 minutes with no answer. This lack of responsiveness, combined with the poor quality of the food, was extremely frustrating. I’m really disappointed with this experience. The chicken was soggy, dry, and far from the standard I expect from KFC. This incident has made me seriously reconsider ordering from this location again.

Bought a snack burger today at 12:58pm Friday 8th February at KFC new Lynn. The lettuce was very brown(definately not fresh) and there was hairs entwined in the burger. Needless to say I did throw out the burger because it was very unsatisfactory and disgusting. KFC New Lynn please do better when it comes to your hygiene standards. I would give a zero star rating however on google you can only post with a minimum one star rating

I love their bento bowl especially their teriyaki chicken 😍😍 the staff are lovely and very friendly. I like how they have the loyalty card and I always end up getting free sushi from here when I get to my 10th order from them.

This franchise is shaming St Pierre brand. They using cheap and not fresh fish to make sushi. We trashed $100 worth of sushi because the fish was smelly paid charged $17-$19 each box for take way sushi you can do much better than that. We will never buy again form you and make sure ours family and fitness keep away from your business. Also repeat to council make sure this business owner treat consumers health and safety seriously. Shame on you !!!!

Racism and open discrimination. If you’re anything but East Asian, don’t apply to this place. Saw a notice at st Pierre’s lynmall outlet posting a job ad for staff and went to drop my resume. Was told quite rudely by one of the staff that they are not hiring and to look elsewhere or apply online if I want to. The job posting specifically mentioned to apply within. Next time just add a disclaimer that you’re not hiring south Asians or any other race aside from East Asian. Serving racism with a side of bento here! Will never patronize these places that openly discriminate again!

One of the bigger shop of the sushi chain, and one of the old ones too. Offers not just sushi but also seafood such as prawns and oysters. Although they are away from the food court, they are provide tables and seats for customers; though non-customers often use them. The staff members are efficient, thought might not be as friendly as other shops. Their prices in general are getting a lot more expensive that they used to.

DO NOT BUY FROM HERE!!!!!! I recently brought Salmon sushi from here and the Salmon was discoloured. Instead of the bright pinkish colour you would expect your salmon to be, their Salmon were parts brown. I confronted the staff and they informed me all their salmon is that colour, showing me there bowl of salmon they were using. I feel sick after consuming one sushi as It tasted off, then I found that all my sushi had discolouration. DONT GO HERE, Save yourself and your money!! 🤮🤢🤮🤢

Absolutely 1000% the best fish n chips in auckland !! Real whole potatoe fritters next to zero grease on the paper REAL BACON on burgers and toasties flavorful won tons fresh fish ... my favorite burger the bacon and egg burger with extra bacon is hands down the best burger in auckland . I'm a big guy and have eaten out everyday for years as I work on the road and this place is in my eyes #1 for fish n chips !!!
Updated Specials Menu... Got No.1... Free Lemons...

Wow! At first I was a little skeptical about buying takeouts from here but I swear once we tasted it, this has got to be the best takeaways we have eaten in a while. Food tastes fresh, veggies aren't soggy, it's crunchy and fresh, the flavours are amazing. Will definitely be back. 😁

It's my favourite takeaway. I grew up with it as it was local and now it is my preferred takeaway. My favourite are the beef or chicken curry in rice. I also love love their wontons! Would highly recommend.

This place is run by a lovely Asian couple (and sometimes help by their daughter now).. I have been buy food from them for more than a decade now and it is beautiful food 🥡 👀 .. I love their bacon and eggs and egg burgers, cheeseburgers, and green curry chicken, very tasty, and very healthy. Good quality food. Great value for your money. 😋👍🍔🍟
Great little local. Extremely reasonably priced, quick and friendly service. You do get what you pay for though, as the fish and chips wasn’t quite as I expected. Would definitely go back.
Delicious, classic eggs bene, perfectly cooked. Great coffee and super friendly staff. Recommend.

Great hot breakfast with good quality fresh ingredients and reasonably priced. Eggs and mushrooms were cooked exactly how I liked and little sausages were delicious. Usually comes also with Baked Beans but opted for Hollandaise. Staff friendly and accommodating. Service excellent. Busy corner cafe with a cheerful atmosphere with the locals enjoying some friendly banter. Will visit again. Thank you! 😃👍

First time in this cafe, we loved it, the Benedict's were just perfectly cooked, the hollandaise sauce was delicious, lot of mushrooms for me! The only thing is that we found the muffin a little bit over sweet, but appart from that, was just perfect 😊👌
Great food at a very reasonable price, and always lovely service!
He likes men toow
this place is so PROOO im own it
You will never be disappointed with the food. So delicious and authentic. This place will be my first option for food.
I had a very nice experience and they have good customer service, wouldn't mind having it again.
Good quality food with great taste and service.
It's delicious, and I will order it again.
delicious food ..highly recommended…🤤🤤🤤

I initially ordered food on uber eats from here. After tasting it , it didn’t disappoint. The very next day I went down in person to order another Greek chicken kebab - So good! The best part is the bread/wrap. The owners and service 5/5 stars as well. Not really for dine in vibes so don’t expect to sit inside and eat with music and decorations. Street food type of vibes I would say, convenient and tasty.
[Mix on Rice] Recommended if you like the meats on rice. Fresh veggies and nice meat flavor. 666 grams.
Shakeel makes an awesome mixed kebab.. I had one and had to go back. I will be back and highly recommend.
It's a food truck so not a restaurant. Food is tasty and service was fast. Gave me a lot of sauce and I like that.

Best place for wraps, burgers and falafel, specially if you are a student,the owner is super friendly and the portion and the taste is really very good. I will definitely recommend this place to everyone ❤️❤️🙏🏼
I got tomyum seafood rice noodles and my husband ordered beef stir-friednoodlese! Both of these were so delicious!! They accept cards and chefs are friendly! We will definitely come back soon!

The place was very popular for mid-week lunch. Char Kuey Teow was delicious and very authentic. Also had 100 plus and Sarsi in the fridge. Order came fast. Place is small but tidy and clean. Definitely coming back.

Got takeaway of the Fried Rice Noodles with Thick Egg Gravy & Combination Meats. I would say it is worth the price of 15$. I am surprised to found squid and a prawn. The sauces and the noodles were ready seperated with chilli in soy sauce as well, which is very generous of them. Definately worth trying out this affordable store! I seldom leave good reviews but id really like to give them the credit for providing good meal for affordable price.

We’ve been coming here for Chaw Keow Tiao and other Malaysian delicacies since Mr Lai opened this business more than 20 years ago. It is consistently one of the best places for Char Kew Tiao, if not the best. Now it is run by new owners and the quality is as good, if not better. Top notch Malaysian noodles place!

The Char Kway Teow today had a great wok hei (wok aroma)! The noodles were perfectly stir-fried with a smoky, flavorful taste, just like an authentic Malaysian-style dish. The portion size was generous, and the price was very affordable. Definitely a must-try for anyone craving a taste of Malaysia! Will be back for more.

I have been going to the store for a very long time now, never have I come across an issue before until yesterday. I ordered all vegetarian pizzas and later we found that they put chicken in our veggie slingshot pizza. When my sister called that same night upon discovering the mistake, she called the store to let them know what had happened. We also mentioned we don’t want any free pizza but it’s their responsibility to prepare food with extra awareness. The lady who answered the phone was at first thinking we’re only doing this for maybe free pizza and didn’t believe us. Upon us sending a photo we got a not so meaningful apology. Very poor on how you deal with complaints. It’s not like your pizza is $5, customers are paying $20+ dollars, be abit more considerate and perhaps educate your staff on customer service.

Pizza Club offers delicious vegetarian pizzas that truly stand out. Their service is top-notch, and the staff is friendly and attentive. They also have some great combo deals that provide excellent value for money. Overall, it’s a solid choice for anyone looking for a good pizza joint.

Rude and arrogant staff- I am going to the Avondale branch for its open and even we have nearby pizza club but choose always Avondale, always great pizza, this time it was not as usual so I called for feedback - not for refund not for anything else just for feedback to let them know, lady at phone was rude do not want to listen her words are- “Bring it here I will decide “ she can't take even feedback. Pizza club management teaches staff how to talk or take feedback. Donot be arrogant with popularity.

"I would like to express my satisfaction with Pizza Club Avondale. I can't say enough positive things about them. They offer a fantastic selection of large and small pizzas that cater to various tastes. The staff particularly Divy and Yesha were incredibly friendly and approachable, helpful, and observant. They are always careful about my order details and never miss out on the requested changes. I have tried other stores a few times and found that Pizza Club Avondale is my go-to restaurant all the time. It has Good food and wonderful service, and I highly recommend it to others."

Prices up, quality down, skimping on ingredients. Got their iconic tandoori chicken pizza with half the usual quantity of chicken they usually put on. Tasted like a bland fast food pizza. Another great business on its way to becoming average. Sad.
Sev Usal taste wasn't that great. It felt like a watery dish, and the stuffing wasn't enough. Everything else at this restaurant tastes well. This dish is not recommended
After a long drive from Palmerston north we were looking for a vegetarian Indian place to eat in Auckland, Atithi’s was just great. We ordered two different thali which i really enjoyed.

Very Disappointed with the Food Quality I ordered samosas and one vegetable bread pakoda yesterday from Atithi Restaurant and was extremely disappointed. The bread pakoda was served cold I specially told him to hot and the samosas were clearly frozen — the filling inside was still cold and frozen when I bit into them. It felt like the items were not freshly prepared at all. Definitely not the quality I expected. This was a complete waste of money, and I won’t be ordering from here again
I was assuming it was panjabi samosa, so I gave it a try. It’s not Punjabi samosa, but the filling was quite nice and spicy. I had Samosa after ages. Overall, good food and good quality

Amazing place for Indian snack and mains. Parking is shared and off street parking available most of the time. Location is good as it with all other food outlets. The staff is very respectful and you can taste the care they put in preparing the food. Value for money and food is fresh.

The food is delicious and the place is very spacious and has a good ambiance. The food price is reasonable too. Almost all the dishes has authentic Indian taste and spicy(hot). It'll be great if they work on their service etiquette like service water and glass when new customer comes and giving them menu. You have to do it own your own which is bit disappointing.

Terrible customer service. After the food we had to wait more than 10mints at the counter to pay. No one doesn’t care or ask to help. There was guy at the counter and he was somehow angry with the kitchen staff and slam a set of order dockets just in front of us. He was ignoring us all the time while we standing up to pay for the food. The food quality is really average and you will have to wait 30-40 minutes for foods to arrive. Even after some of the items we ordered didn’t receive and they forgot it somehow. We will not go there ever again.

Jan 2018 Nice collection of Indian fast food, friendly staff, lots of options for tasty vegetarian meal, no overly spiced Indian food unless you ask for it May 2018 The worst experience we had for last 2 visits consecutively Food quality is worst and service would be better in some of the takeaways then here. I have posted photos of rice I got where you can see it’s made from Broken dust of rice and it looks like too gluggy. Would not be recommending again.

Food and quantity served is good for the price. Location is also convenient given there is a decent sized car park at the rear of the restraunt. The restraunt is well maintained and presented. Ambience and overall vibe could improve. Customer service and waiting time needs some major upgrade. Staff members could be more welcoming and smiling. Sometimes customers are left waiting and are even required to enquire around their order.
I had such an amazing time! The food was absolutely delicious and the service was incredibly friendly.

Good quantity and quantity food. We went for chat only, samosa chat was good size, and panipuri was authentic in test, loved Rasmalai as desert, and highly recommend to try Rasmalai at least once from this place Good service and waiting time were reasonable for weekend lunch timing. Music and lighting added quality to time spent here

I recently bought an Aloo Pyaaz Kachori from this shop and was quite disappointed. There was barely any masala inside — just a thin layer of haldi and a few potato chunks. I showed this to the staff and the manager, but they simply said they source the kachoris from a vendor and can’t do anything about it. When I asked for compensation or a replacement, the manager refused and kept arguing instead of trying to resolve the issue. They run the shop under the name Bikaner Wala but the taste doesn’t match authentic Bikaneri flavours — it’s more like Gujarati or South Indian style, which is not what you expect when buying a Rajasthani kachori. Not recommended if you’re looking for real Bikaneri taste. Only the samosas here are worth trying — they’re actually good.

Incredible Start to the Day – Chole Bhature Perfection! I had the pleasure of being the first customer of the day at Bikanerwala Mt Roskill, and I was seriously impressed. Even though I walked in right as they opened, everything was already fresh, hot, and perfectly prepared – a true sign of their professionalism and dedication. The chole bhature were simply outstanding – the bhature were light and fluffy, and the chole was bursting with authentic North Indian flavor. It’s easily one of the best versions I’ve had in Auckland. The staff were friendly, welcoming, and super efficient, making the experience even better. It’s rare to find a place that nails both the food and the service right from the moment they open their doors. Highly recommend this spot – I’ll definitely be back for more! Special thanks to Vatsal

Service and Ambience is good but quality and taste of food is not up to the mark. I won’t complain about the price as everything gone up. They are in the business for long , should have been figured out the taste of Indian food what customer likes .

Absolutely SHOCKING!! Let's not talk about the food and about the pricing. Yes i understand inflation but this place is a total rip-off. Plenty of veg restaurants in the vicinity and some run by families and the food is a lot tastier and cheaper. The lady behind the counter wasn't very professional and not at all friendly. The people behind the counters have all sorts of things on their shirts and cloth especially they are wearing black coloured cloths so when they get curry stains its very evident.. not at all clean .Avoid if possible! Wouldn't be going back here... if i could give "0" rating i would have done that. Man like the food presentation and taste... nothing is good. Their sweets counter glasses hasn't been cleaned in decades I swear. If you really want to eat from Bikanervala please... please go to the Henderson branch way better. Henderson one is way CHEAPER !!!

I have been here a couple of times now. And every time, these guys impress me with the quality of food they serve and their service. I was here with a couple of workmates a few weeks ago for lunch, to enjoy a meal from Western India. Their food is absolutely authentic and delicious. The staff was very friendly too. Their Parathas, Dhoklas and sweets are a must try especially Jalebis! The portions are great too and so is their take away packaging! I would highly recommend them! :) Cheers
We are regulars here at Roops. Love their snacks, jalebi and chat. Takeaway is very nice, there is room for improvement with dine in.

Location: It's close to the shopping area on Richardson road. Parking: Roadside parking available just outside the restaurant. Value of Money: This place offers a good range of home taste food at affordable price. Seating: This place is primarily a take-away place and not much attention to the interior of the restaurant. They have 4 Rajasthan style seating - huge tables and heavy chairs. Service: Service is slow and you need to be mindful when you order as the next item you order may take longer. Taste: We ordered a variety of items including 2 thali's and the food was very close to taste at home. Overall impression: A good place to enjoy or take away home-like cooked food at affordable cost but would recommend ordering ahead.

You can't get better Jalebi than this place in all of Auckland. It's just amazing. They have some nice Gujarati thali as well. We loved the authentic Gurjarati flavours. You will have to wait for Jalebi on festival here, but the wait is worth it.
A tiny homemade Indian (especially Gujrati) food shop. It’s a combination of best quality and great service. Really recommended if you’re in love with home made food.

@flavourandcuisine (insta and tiktok handle) Follow me for more such reviews We recently dined at Narmthong Thai Restaurant and had a great experience. We ordered Thai red curry, fried tofu with peanut sauce, spring rolls, and another Thai curry. The food was full of authentic flavors—especially the red curry, which was rich and aromatic. The tofu was perfectly crispy and paired so well with the creamy peanut sauce. While the prices were a bit on the higher side, the taste and quality made it worthwhile. A solid spot for Thai food lovers!

I have been here a few times but never posted a review before. Lovely food. Very tasty and flavourful. Spring rolls, curry puffs, prawn Penang curry, spicy fried rice, pad Thai and steamed rice. Portion size was meh but this is not your regular Chinese takeaway so don’t expect the same. Overall great food and good service

Not everyday the food looks exactly like the pictures in the menu and not that really matters but it tasted as amazing as it looked. I had the penang curry and golden prawns. The portions were a decent size and value for the price. We went for an early dinner so there wasn't a lot of other people but the atmosphere was relaxed and warm.

Actually, I was a little disappointed when I got home and opened the takeaway bag. The container the meal came in wasn't even half full, the meal was small, like child meal small. And it was a main dinner meal.... Really! Service was good, as I ordered it on the bus home from the city, and it was ready when I walked in the door. However, the restaurant was empty so that should have been a sign. Taste was like anywhere else, same same, and I ordered mild, which it was. The fried egg was well fried. To think of it, should have fried my own when I got home, for the price you pay. Anyway... Skip.
Food was good however service was poor. Two of us didnt get cutlery until half way through the meal despite asking multiple times. Looks like they were heavily understaffed

I ordered the chicken pizza last time, and it was absolutely delicious! The crust was perfectly baked—crispy on the outside and soft inside. The chicken was juicy and well-seasoned, and the toppings were fresh and flavorful. Everything was balanced just right, and it arrived hot and on time. Definitely one of the best pizzas I’ve had in a while. Can’t wait to order again!

I love the service and approach of the staff . Very patient with customers , and then suggests good choice . I bought 2 for 12 deals 6 pizza , must say they were done so well with topping and taste . Love it

This is definitely a restaurant I frequent. Very good pizza with amazing price! Only $12 you can get two large pizza and that’s enough for two adults. Every time I don’t want to cook or get home late I just buy two pizza. I am very grateful that there is such a store near where I live. The waiters are also very friendly and will tell you approximately how long you will have to wait for your pizza.

very prompt service by owner/ staff...ordered tamdoori prawn & chicken pizza for family...they surprised us by giving complimentary garlic bread being first timer...what else...thanks select pizza team..
I really enjoyed the pizza! 🍕 It was fresh and had a generous amount of toppings. The service was quick, and the staff were very friendly. Overall, a great experience!

Ordered their Golden Cups ($8 for 4 cups which is the minimum order) and half a chicken ($13) which I wasn't expecting to be battered and deep fried. Everything was delicious and would order this again!

I recently discovered Richardson Road Takeaways near White Swan Road was under new Management and have already enjoyed a few delicious Chinese dishes, all consistently great quality, generous servings, full of fresh vegetables, chunky tender meats, tasty sauces and very light on the oil. Especially love the crispy wontons (clearly cooked in clean oil) and served with appears to be an amazing housemade sweet n sour sauce. Extensive menu options with excellent meal deals for all tastes and budgets. Always is busy so a very popular with the locals. The staff are friendly and professional. The kitchen, floors and walls are all clean and tidy. Definitely my new "go to" local takeaway for a hot, tasty and quick meal anytime. 10/10 Thank you!

Ordered chow mein and got a whole takeaway with only veggies and meat and few small pieces of noodles. I'm just confused on what happened but I just made rice to go along with it since it tasted fine.
I ordered Chinese spc package, black bean sauce and spicy squid. All is good and they cooked very fast.
Love this place!! Just got toasties, fish, chow main, fried rice. Always good food, totally recommend it- don't drive past without trying something. Tu make!!

Came since we were students till now we have two kids. Foods always good and fresh. Sevice always good, especially to kids. One of the best Chinese restaurants in Auckland. They even provided complimentary dessert. Highly recommend.

Absolutely delicious! We ordered the dry-fried green beans, Tianjin-style sweet and sour pork, and the three-delicacy buns. Everything was full of flavor and cooked perfectly. The pork was crispy yet tender, green beans had that perfect wok hei, and the buns were juicy and satisfying. Great service and cozy atmosphere too—will definitely come back!

Yong Fa Restaurant offers truly authentic Northern Chinese and Tianjin cuisine. We ordered several classic dishes, and each one really captured the nostalgic flavors of home. The lamb spine hotpot had a rich, hearty broth with tender meat, complemented by red dates and goji berries – perfect for warming up in winter. The century egg with tofu was light and refreshing, dressed with soy sauce and sesame oil, a typical Northern-style appetizer. The sizzling beef came in a generous portion, with tender slices well-coated in a flavorful sauce. The Tianjin-style flatbread, scallion pancake, and fried cakes were all spot-on – crispy outside, soft inside, with great texture. The steamed buns were plump, juicy, and wrapped in delicate skins, very close to the authentic northern taste. Overall, if you’re craving Northern Chinese flavors, especially Tianjin dishes, this place is highly recommended. The portions are generous, the flavors are reliable, and the setting has that down-to-earth, old-school Northern charm – perfect for gatherings with family and friends.

It’s truly impressive that Yong Fa has been serving the community for over 20 years. Beyond its long history, the restaurant consistently maintains a high standard of cleanliness and customer service — and of course, the food is absolutely delicious. The canteen is spotless, the staff are polite and professional, and the chef is a true legend who has dedicated half his life to perfecting his craft. In an age where many places rely on pre-mixed, artificial ingredients, it’s refreshing and heartwarming to see Yong Fa still committed to real cooking with real materials, delivering authentic flavors that remind me of home. Thank you for keeping tradition and quality alive.

This is a wonderful Chinese restaurant. the Guo-Bao-rou here is the most authentic and delicious one I've ever had. It's my favorite. Superb cuisine, warm hospitality, stylish setting—every bite delighted us. Truly memorable and worth returning for!
Yummy pizzas, delicious snack box loaded fries. Fave is with garlic aloli, BBQ and plum sauce.

Worst service by the white gals and the Chinese girl totally ignored the customers waiting to order. When i asked the white girl as refused to give me her name can we get some service she turned around and yes “wait will you” . I said excuse me! She said “bro i finishing other orders! Wow!! The rudeness was at a different level. I ordered 4 snack boxes chicken and lamb and she refused to give me lamb ! Only beef. I told her we do not eat beef. I told her we come here every week. She then said ok lamb but the lamb frozen .
This store was the best store I have ever tried before but when I came now I ordered pizza with the last money I got on me and it was thin and burned and it tastes bad

TL;DR: Pizza poorly packed enough to leak, not once but TWICE. On top of which the pizza was somewhat cold at this point and absolutely flavourless, for a $15 pizza. Usually this place has been decent in the past but it seems like owners may have changed recently, if not multiple times. I just wanted to get dinner on Father’s Day and was disappointed with the poor service I experienced. I ordered two pizzas which I picked up and one of the boxes was soggy from the bottom but I thought it would be manageable. Within about a 2 minute drive away, the pizza box leaked through onto my arm, leg and seat. I went back to see what could be done and the guy serving me just had a blank expression on his face. Him and his coworker seemed to have no idea what to do and I wanted to just leave, so I asked for the pizza to be put into another box. The pizza was thrown into another box and this time put into a paper bag to “sort out” the situation. As I was irritated at this point I quickly left with the poor excuse for a fix. I got home to give my Dad this pizza only to see this disappointing excuse of a pizza and box. If I ever return to this shop, I hope for some remuneration and some better service because this experience basically ruined my evening.
No 1.5L drinks this has happened several times soo slack, don’t ever offer some small fries over a drink 🤦🏾‍♀️

It’s St Pierres so it’s not going to be authentic, high quality sushi but for a stop in lunch spot it’s a decent price, relatively healthy sushi option with fresh ingredients. It’s one of the better branches of the franchise. The staff are nice, it’s clean, it is what it is. I wish St Pierres in general were a bit more generous with the avocado (their idea of double avo is just what regular avo should be. Not a tiny smudge) and it would be great if they provided better quality wasabi and ginger - but over-all you can’t complain. The daily specials are good.

I ordered a made to order sushi pack with chilli oil and there was very little chilli oil added. There was only one soy sauce packet and they did not include any ginger or wasabi. This store always cuts back on there condiments.

St Pierre's Sushi are big and quite filling. They taste good but have too much rice. However, their Mochi are amazing, and the texture is so great😋 They are the best I have had so far, particularly the Matcha flavour! Overall, good price and fast service.

Have anyone spotted the Japanese mayo? I ordered the Avocado junkie. Hardly see the mayo in there. When I checked with the chef she said she did one line. The responded wasn't respectful manner and couldn't seen any friendly service from her.

Absolutely disappointing. Brought 2 platters & the Presentation was terrible. Looked like it was rushed. I wasn’t informed that they were out of stock of some ingredients, but fillings were replaced with what they felt like adding. We’re paying for what you see in the pictures. Never going to St Pierre’s Mt Roskill again.

I just wanted to share that I had a delicious lamb kebab today with garlic yogurt and sweet chili mayo. The fries came in a cute little package, which was a nice touch. I think I'll ask for no tomato sauce next time, as I had a bit too much. Overall, it was a really enjoyable experience. 👍🌟
Pleasant service. Awesome portion sizes and tasty! 5 stars for curing my hangover

I have never a kebab as huge as this one. Not only it was huge, it tasted amazing. Couldn’t finish the whole thing and even after having half of it, it was bigger than my palm. The service was great and the staff were super friendly. Hands down the best kebab in Auckland. Worth it!
Food was steaming hot and super tasty we got chicken kebab and chicken on chips. I would definitely eat here again Guy behind counter was really nice 👌

From Kebab Sensation Stoddard Road we brought kebabs, burgers, hot chips and drinks for late lunch and weren't disappointed! The food was great - big portions, full of flavour and well made. The only issue was the kebabs partly fell apart because they were not toasted long enough. Other than that great service and overall experience - will visit again!

I ordered Subway online at 6 PM, expecting the order to be ready by 6:30 as promised. My friend and I waited patiently in the car until then. When we got inside, the store wasn’t busy—only two people ahead of us—but we still waited an additional 15 minutes while they were served. When it was finally our turn, we were told our order hadn’t even been started yet, which was very disappointing considering we had already waited 45 minutes. To make matters worse, when we asked for a bag, the staff simply handed it to us empty without putting the food inside. Very disappointed .

Absolutely terrible experience. Went there a week ago to buy a sub and their damn eftpos machine malfuncted. The money left my account and they still refused to give me the food, then even after showing them the purchase they said their boss would contact me later that day to resolve it and give me the money back. I called twice again since last weekend and still no follow up. Called again today and no one is doing anything about it. Such poor service and all this over less than $10 is insane. Not even a call or apology about the situation. Still have not received a refund for it. INSANE and such cheap behaviour from the staff. Do NOT recommend.

Poor service, lazy workers, bad attitude, always make people repeat themselves because they don’t pay attention to what the customers are saying, forgot some ingredients and only gave the outside wrapper with no inside wrapper and sticker to seal the wrapper. Only gave two options of cheese when there was clearly three options. Was missing a sauce from the options list and wasn’t bothered to go get it from the back. Just lazy. Asked for any drinks when there was one right in front of him so obviously wasn’t using his eyes. Didn’t even give a smile at the begging of the service. Manager was no help. If it is a customer based role then the workers there should really find a different job. They make it hard for us to order a simple meal. This isn’t the first time that store has bad customer service and it will definitely be the last time I’ll ever go there. Not worth it. You can go to a different store with the same food but better service. The service is part of the experience and it’s not a good look on the company when the workers continually just don’t give a damn. Maybe there needs to be a formal complaint but that won’t do anything so why bother. Not impressed. Servers need to do better.

Very bad experience today 30/04/25 bread was old and very dry they dont even close the sub properly and no sticker on the sandwich wrap didn’t even put it in the bag just gave me the wrap covered in a paper without any sticker on it i have to ask for the bag very unprofessional staff thats how i feel like i wasted almost 28$ i don’t recommend this subway to anyone.

Would give zero stars if I could. Cross contamination everywhere. Unhygienic practices. If I had not already paid online I would have walked out. Staff has zero customer service training and a total disregard to any hygiene or cross contamination procedures. Touching lettuce and tomatoes after touching bacon. Not changing gloves between customers. Not following any of subways operating procedures. Don't go here if you have any allergies, intolerances or dietary requirements

I ordered two burgers, but I don’t know why only one of them came with a bun while the other didn’t. I can provide a photo. I don’t understand why this happened—if you were out of buns, you should have informed me in advance instead of saying nothing. This was really disappointing.
Decent. Coffee was a bit bitter. Service is swift.

Decent food, alright service, but the only thing I didn't enjoy was the atmosphere for the workers. It seemed like one of the managers (black shirt) was being quite nasty to her coworkers. Yes it was busy at the time, but it just seemed unnecessarily mean. I used to work at McDonalds for about 3 years and I was never treated the way this manager treated her colleagues. Thank you for serving me, please be aware of who you are hiring.

My Kiwi Burger combo overall was very good. The drink seemed watered down, the fries were a tad cold and the burger was good but lacked flavour. However, the customer service was very good especially the hassle-free order and receiving my food on time.

WORST McD's in NZ. Do not eat here. Several times things have been missing from our drive through other. The last time, a chicken nuggets was missing and my chicken wrap had a hair embedded in it. I called several times. First was told my order number doesn't exist. Then that my receipt number doesn't exist. I contacted the manager, Jemimah. After a week of "investigations", she said nobody that night had long hair, she checked cctv. So basically blaming me for the hair. It's been four weeks nearly, three phone calls, six emails, a complaint via McDs App and still nothing. I was promised a refund voucher but this did not materialize. Absolutely appaling service! Unbelievable.

What a find! This place is an absolute gem💎 The lightest fluffiest wood-fired breads I’ve ever tasted and they are $1 for two. The mana’ish lamb will blow your mind - a light soft flatbread with minced seasoned lamb with what I think are tomatoes and onions - it has the most beautiful delicate yet rich flavours which are perfectly balanced. The falafel is crispy yet so soft inside - served piping hot. My favourite though is the Dolma - soft rice and spices made with beautiful olive oil and vinegars. The vine leaves are lush. The hummus is a little smooth for my liking but it’s the Lebanese style. You can get gorgeous Turkish coffee here too. This really is the best Lebanese food I’ve ever tasted. The cafe itself is humble - canteen style with local community feel and the staff are nice. It’s spotlessly clean and they have little touches like iced water and napkins on the table which I love. Everything is fresh and hand made. They also have a huge range of sweets, pastries and Baklawa of course! It’s my new favourite eatery on all of Auckland. The one star reviews I’ve read are all from people who come here and order westernised English food (why?) or rude people who are impatient and misunderstand the style of café. Ignore them and check this place out.

Not recommended and extremely disappointing, I wasted my money and time with family.. - cafe was not busy. - not enough staff to clean, serve, take orders and cook. - they took a lot of time to serve and most importantly person serving asked what I ordered when she almost got the food trolley near to our table. - food absolutely disappointing. - coffee we ordered was not warm to have it. - when I went for second order, person taking kept me waiting while she entered one of item the ordered as she received phone order. - it took a while for the second order to come and forgot to serve us extra bread, I had to remind them when we left our tables. - glasses, forks, spoons, plates, knifes where not washed well. We had to change it. - they could not accommodate big family, we had to arrange tables and chairs as serving female panicked. - I had to give one star as unable to proceed with my review and they even don’t deserve it. - I wasted my $160 for 7 people. - they used same gloves to clean tables and serve food.

We got the buffet and it was ALL delicious. Seriously, every dish I tried was so good. Loved the chicken curry and the green beans in the tomato sauce. Baklava and the other rice pudding (unsure of correct name for it) dessert were soooo yum too. Really reasonable price for delicious and warming food that really tastes like it’s been made with love! Can’t wait to come back

If you want biscuits, keep in mind that the biscuit box is very heavy. Its sides are already double-layered, and when you close the box, there’s an additional flap attached to the top part, which makes the side triple-layered. I haven’t seen any box like that. Then, when I went there, only the large 1 kg boxes were available, while I only needed half a kg. I don’t want to pay for such a thick box on the price of biscuits which is not a very good value for money.

I was quite disappointed with the quality of the buffet. The food lacked flavor, and overall appeal. I believe the quality of the food should be significantly better. I strongly recommend that serious attention be given to improving the variety and taste to meet the expectations of your guests.

Ordered Ribs & Wings. Overall it's a 3/10 for me definitely not worth it. Feels like the meat and chicken was pre-boiled then cooked on order. Meat didn't fall off the bone as it supposed to it was more stuck on the bone.🤦‍♂️ Very disappointing for an expensive dish🤮

I doubted ordering from this eatery after reading the reviews yet I went ahead anyways and I do not regret it at all. The meat fell off the bone and the marinade was so tasty (especially the maple flavoured ribs) people tend to review places more if they’ve had a bad experience. This place is good and I would recommend

Not a bad place. Pizza is good. Ribs are ok, just like hell pizza style, baked and drowned in sauce. Although I remember this place having the meat fall of the bone which did not happen last 2 orders Chips could do with an upgrade as it was tasteless

We ordered ribs, mash and chips via Ubereats. Spent $80+ and food was no way near worth this money. Drowned in sauce and ribs still dry when sauce is all removed. Chips, I'm confused?! Is it baked or air fried? Tasteless! Mash potato!? Salt all on the top & not pleasant to eat at all. Overall, food was very very disappointing. Spending so much for dinner and not able to finish. More then half leftover!

We were hoping this place would be okay. Our general rule is if its busy, they must be okay. Should have followed our rule. I have never ordered a rack of ribs and received 4 individual ribs. Advertising and charging full prices for a rack then giving individual ribs and off cut ends is false advertising and a rip off. The ribs were also tough and drowned in sauce like it would hide the fact there are only four. The chips were burnt and unseasoned and the nibbles were not fully cooked. Don't order food from this place.

We have seen J’s many times but never tried. Glad we did today, lured in by the Entertainment Book App! Delicious spicy beef noodles (they could adjust to mild for us which was perfect), deep fried tofu and fried buns with condensed milk. Lovely Taiwanese cuisine. Parking was easy at 7.30pm, and was relatively quiet on a Wednesday night

The food portion is big and filling. The salt pepper pork rice is yum and come with a few small vege dishes. Just top up $5 for Taiwanese dessert. The dessert with yam/taro paste is so goood!!! There’s also many books and entertainment for my little one.

Had the Taiwanese braised mince noodles and also the salt, pepper and chili fried pork on rice. The noodles was simple, but the mince on top was quite yummy. The pork was very good, the side dishes are just ok and the rice was little bit too wet but still not bad. Price is very good here and portion large. The dessert coffee jelly is my wife's favourite and reminds her of her childhood. Spacious place, will come again.

For me milk tea here is the best. Good service, nice staff, food was brought out quickly. The food is a lot for one serving. It will taste better if they heated it longer. Parking right in front of the store is very convenient. Taste of tea: 10/10 Taste of food: 8/10 Service: 9/10 Price: 8/10 Ambience: 7/10 Toilet: 5/10

I was surprised with the portion size and the extra sides the food came with. I was only expecting the popcorn chicken on rice but it had 4 extra sides, which were all tasty. Cheesecake was really delicious. Bubble tea was average. It didn't have any ice. I automatically assumed there would be ice if I ordered a cold drink. Overall, it was good.

It feels like you’re being served just the flour, not an actual samosa. The outer layer is barely fried and tastes more like raw dough than a crispy snack. Totally unhealthy and far from what a proper samosa should be. Really disappointing.

Terrible service, food, and very rude. I only ordered one item and he had overcharged me. He told me the price on the singular item but charged me a higher one. I was very quick on the paywave so payment went through before I could stop myself. I was going to say something but he ignored me and walked straight to the back. I decided to let this one go as it was only a few dollars. I have also had different staff ignore me and serve the people that just walked in despite me being first in line. They seem discriminatory to people that want to communicate in English. Food is also not good and tastes old/expired. I made the mistake going there a second time today after my first bad experience.
Value for money, good service, and a wide range of sweets & snacks 😋

Racist Staff, Very Rude, Waste My Time I came to try this Indian veg place! BIG MISTAKE! Staff looked at me like I don’t belong. I asked if the curry had nuts, he just say “okay okay” like he don’t know any other English. I say “no nuts,” he still gave me nuts. What if I allergic? They treated other Indian speaking customers nice, but to me—ignored, rushed, laughed. I wait long, food wrong, no sorry. So rude, so disrespectful. Felt like racism. I come to eat, not to be insulted. Never again.

Extremely disappointed. We ordered a few items and not a single one lived up to the bare minimum of expectations. Samosas = uncooked + tasteless potato filling, Pyaz kachori = Dripping in oil and empty inside, Bread pakora = tasteless potato filling and could actually taste uncooked Turmeric in it.

I recently visited Shivani Restaurant and ordered their Bhalla Papdi Chaat, but I was quite disappointed. The dish lacked several key components—no coriander at all, and it was just served with yogurt, green chutney, red chutney, and some sev. It felt very plain, missing the rich flavors and textures that make this dish special. Honestly, I’ve had much better Bhalla Papdi Chaat at local takeaways for a lower price. Apart from that, I’ve also noticed a decline in the quality of their thali. The boondi raita was so diluted that it felt more like lassi rather than thick yogurt. The sweet dish was extremely dry, making it unpleasant to eat. What really shocked me was the crusted bread slice served with the meal—who serves that with a thali? Additionally, I was once served a dried-out jalebi, which was a huge disappointment. Another major concern is the water bottle’s lid—it is shattering into small plastic particles that might be contaminating the water. This is a serious health hazard, and the restaurant really needs to address it immediately. On a positive note, the staff is very friendly and welcoming, which is one of the reasons I have been a regular customer. However, I sincerely hope that Shivani Restaurant takes feedback seriously and improves the quality of their food and hygiene standards. There’s definitely room for improvement!

SHIVANI RESTORANT’S product quality is consistently outstanding, exceeding my expectations every time. It’s South Indian Manu and Sweet are my favourite food. We frequently arranged our party on SHIVANI MT Roskil food is so yummy and fresh and any of Sweet made by Deshi Ghee I was completely impressed with their professionalism and customer service.

Friends must try Indian food. Staff is awesome specially Ram Singh, soft spoken and excellent hospitality. Cleanliness is more than expectation in any Indian restaurant. Perfect place for family get togethers.
Shivani restaurant has really tasty food, and the sweets are especially good. The staff is friendly, and it’s a great place to enjoy a meal.
Ordered Dahi Bhalla that arrived without yogurt on doordash, how can you miss Dahi(yogurt) in Dahi Bhalla where that's the primary ingredient Money wasted

Well...hmm I'm not a fan of this one. From my prospective Hunan cousine supposed to be hot, spicy, a bit salty, a bit oily and with heaps of chillies. They seem to be very mild or should I say "compromised"? I'm not saying they are not delicious but thet simply are not good enough for me to return. My expectations to Xiang series dishes are yummy enough making me nonstop eating rice. Unfortunately, this is not the right place for me. But if you are looking for any Chinese restaurant this is the venue for you. Service was actually not bad you definitely can enjoy a meal.

Wife been to this place numerous times and whom recommended hence we went together. I cannot understand why all the teapots look so filthy and dirty but the owners still using them? They look disgusting. Food was chinese country taste and not cheap. The owner did give you what you want but he never say thank you. Will I return? Probably, but not in the near future.

Would recommend for a large group, delicious Hunan cuisine. The beef dry pot is very delicious and the cow stomach is treated well, removed of any funny smells. The beef is tender and the pepper is aromatic. The chicken was good with spicy sauce, and although I remain undecided about how I feel about the stinky tofu - it’s definitely towards the type of dish rather than the cooking itself. Other wise very good experience. The service was great, quiet staff who were very polite and attentive!
Food was alright, probably because my partner got what he wanted lol.
