Dined once 2 wks ago, food is delicious. However, I ordered the same spicy steamed fish as takeaway 2 days ago. It gave me diarrhea last night. So the food hygiene is a problem the restaurant needs to pay attention.

Started coming here earlier in the year, and wouldn't think of cooking a roast when there is so much value for money at Marco Polo Roasts on Dominion Road. Pop in and get a choice of Pork, lamb, beef, chicken, and vegetarian meals ranging from small, medium and large. They also have other offerings of burgers, rolls, desserts and cold drinks. I have been here at different times of the day, with different staff and have found the service efficient and friendly. Don't cook the Sunday, roast pop down, and meet the friendly, owners who always make you feel welcome.

Update: I called to inform them that my order was incomplete. They mentioned that I hadn't selected the option with vegetables. I checked my order, and that was indeed the case. Upon reviewing the webpage, I realized it is misleading. The main description and the accompanying picture include the vegetables, which makes it seem like you are either adding or not adding an extra portion of vegetables. The interesting part is that I didn't have to explain to them what was going on. It makes me think that the problem is known, and they haven't done anything to fix it. Origial: Generally, the food is very good, but today my order was incomplete. I ordered lamb shank, and they forgot to add the sides.

Million times drove last and first time went in. The roast meals were very nice, both beef and pork. Ordered 2 large ones and enough for 2 adults and 2 kids. Gravy is yummy. Price wise very good. No aircon is a flaw but this one can easily be amended? Overall very satisfying

Try and come here once a week, especially in the winter. I use to get a pork roast, but now I go for a pork roll, can't eat as much as I use to. And then I have room for an apple crumble and custard, which is always superb. Staff are always welcoming.
Yum! The lamb shank was tender and delicious. The staff were friendly and made the experience even better. Highly recommend.

I ordered sliced pork with salted fish and fish congee. The food was good. It's typical Cantonese home-style cooking. They have a variety of desserts and herbal soup which was so cheap. The ginger milk custard was so good. Love it!!! ❤️

definitely one of my faves in Auckland, recommended to people to love and appreciate a traditional Cantonese health meal. Some favourites here I’ll be coming back for! They give such big portions for prices that havent changed for 10-20 years👍🏼👍🏼👍🏼🙏🏼 I’m sure their regulars love it for that reason. The menu is so big you’d need to come a few times to try more things.
Delicious food with fair price. My family’s choice and can be a daily meal place
Great place for a comforting meal! The staff are very friendly and welcoming. The soup was delicious and came out quickly. Will definitely come back!

Love this place! Been going here with my parents since i was small and the food is just so homey. we got the milk and ginger one as a dessert after having dinner on dominion road and it was just the perfect dessert. I find it really helpful that the menu also mentions what each dessert is good for. the one i ordered is good for complexion and it was so yum!! totally recommend for anyone who’s in the area!

The best Korean BBQ! Great food, friendly staff. My girlfriend been there a couple times and she invited me to go there yesterday because she loves this place. And now it turns into my favourite place too. Thank you for the heart shaped soju cap! Really sweet of you guys and it made our day. :D

Booked for 8 people at 7.30pm. Very cozy and relaxed spot which is surprising as some Korean bqq buffet places can be super hectic but maybe we were just lucky for the day and time we booked. Quality meat and delicious sides. Very helpful and considerate staff. The decor is a fun American style garage theme. Good spot to bring friends and family.

Thank you so much for hosting our many dinners and then my daughter’s 18th Bday. It was an awesome time as always, only down side was sooooo hot with many stoves but they did their best as we ended up booking out the restaurant. Thank you again John and Staff amazing!

There are variety of meat available here. Only the chicken was marinated. The beef are tender and nice. There should be more choices of food. There was no ventilation or exhaust fan or duct/pipe like some other Korean BBQ restaurants, so there was a strong smell in the room. The lighting was kind of dark. Also the non stick BBQ mat is something we never saw before. Ideally I would say the meat should be cook on a metal surface. The chopsticks are made of melamine rather than metal which should be safer to use with high temperature.

Amaaazing food!!! Beautiful atmosphere! The team there are very hospitable and also checking on people to make sure everyone’s happy! They also gave my family FREE drinks as a kind gesture! Highly recommend taking your family, friends, even just for dinner.

I came here for the First Time with my Daughter. A Beautiful Dinner for her 20th. It was a Yummy Food Selection. We Enjoyed our Time there. My Second Time there,was with All my Beautiful Girls. An Early Celebration for my Girl,who will turn 13,in a Few Days. There was a Different Selection of Food. We got $5 Cups that had Endless Refills. Thank you for informing me about that. Me and my Girls enjoyed that. We Loved the Music there. Food was Lovely. Thank you.

Overall experience Four**** from 12x adults and 5x children. Buffet is from 6pm-9pm. Good food, drinks, music and pool table. Lots of space inside and car park front and back of building. Definitely worth the money $25 adult and $10 children (2-12yrs).

Service is great, fairly new restaurant offering buffet menu. Bookings are essential as seating area is quite small and is filled up quickly w/large groups. If your finding a cheap place to eat then check out Richardson. They have pokies as well as a TAB. Lots of parking infront of building as well as out the back.
I love this place. A one-stop place for awesome Chinese food. Excellent food, affordable price and a great bar. Friendly staff. Highly recommended.

Food was great , cook to order. U had a list and u tick off the box's between 2 ppl. So if it says choose any 5, that's between 2 ppl and food staff was friendly , chef was very knowledgeable where the ingredients came from. We enjoyed the food very much. 4 star cause we ordered banana cake. But gave us carrot cake instead. Unfortunately they ran out of banana cake and didn't tell us. We also ordered chicken wings cause my partner enjoyed them. But for 4 wings at $12.50, I find that I bit pricey for 4 chicken wings. Highlight of the dinner was the seaweed soup. It's very tasty full of flava. These pics photo u see are for two ppl for one plate

Generous portions, tasty Halal-friendly menu, and great value. Fish is fresh with crispy batter when done right, though chips can be hit-or-miss. Still one of the better spots in Mount Roskill for a quick, filling meal.
4x Fish, 4x Potato Fritter & Chips... Greasy & some kind of Spice in the Batter...??? 2 Stars = Disliked it...

AWESOME DELICIOUS AND FRIENDLY. I highly rate them. I have had many wonderful experience here. First time I came I was little dissapointed cause spring rolls have meat inside and didnt know (im pescaterian) This would be a positive for others :) ... But I kept going back and I love this takeaways. The man there is very hard working and friendly. Bless them. Check them out. Im a regular there now and have to stop myself from going sometimes because its too good. Jazakallahkheer.

By luck first timer here by chance. My dumplings were delicious good portion and tasty and the person at counter was friendly and the rest of my food was equally good reasonably affordable I will return back and taste other items :--)
Ordered food via Doordash, request allergen be removed. but arrived cold and lethal with food allergen. Doordash support hopeless too!!!

The passion behind the owners of this place is the first thing that you notice when you walk by this place. My first time here and we did have to wait 20minutes but that's because they had a lot of people ordering. The fish was cooked to perfection and the chips were solid. Nothing fancy just your expected and loved kiwi fish and chips. The prices are great though. Definitely come here for a cheat meal.

Great to see this legendary takeaway open again! The food just hits different compared to others especially the cheeseburgers which are always lit! We got the cheeseburgers and fish and chip deal with the famous tartare sauce all over! Thanks, Tom and all the best to Cindy in her recovery! We'll be back (in Arnold Schwarzenegger voice)

Late night takeaways... Combo F... Very disappointed based on the reviews & ratings... Had high hopes on the Cheeseburger... Beef pattie was the cheapest & worst you can buy... Cheap processed cheese melted on top bun was excessive & had plasticised ruining the tomato, coleslaw & tomato sauce... Buns were thick & undergrilled... Sorry, one of the worst Cheeseburger I've ever had from a takeaways... Potato Fritter batter burnt... Chips were good... Very disappointed based on the reviews & ratings...

Every experience here delivers, the family behind WSFB keep this place clean, and dish out fish and chips that are crispy, golden, seasoned and fresh! I couldn't recommend this place more. Would go as far as saying they do the best hot chips I have tried in AKL from a F&C shop

They are open again! Under new owners but the menu is still the same. We arrived to a queue of people waiting & observed the original owner training the new owners on how to cook our favourites. We had Special C (2 seadogs with cheese & onion & chips for the grand affordable value of $12). They are still the best at seadogs imo. Please support and be patient with new friendly owners as there was a 25min wait. Or better to phone in your order

The Coffee Club offers plenty of seating and a decor that gives a fresh, inviting feel. The portions are generous and the taste is good overall. I ordered the Eggs Benedict, but one of the eggs was overcooked. However, the berry smoothie was absolutely delicious!

Nice place to take breakfast. You must try blueberry pancake with a long black coffee. Took some extra time to make it though. Atmosphere was great. Girls are really friendly with their service. It’s great place to eat and relax in the morning and evening . Good vibes .
Nice and quick breakfast Food was on point No issue loved it They just need to keep clearing the table pls

Dont blame the bad reviews here, service wasnt great at all, staff dont look to happy to work. Their club breakfast is a total waste of money and deff not worth $25!! Requested for sunny side up for the eggs and got fried on both sides. Eggs bene with mushroom was nice though so bravo to them. Dont get the choc frappe, it tasted watery and comes with no cream. I remember coffee club being one of the most top places but it not that way now for sure. Only visited here for lunch w/family member. Wont be back thats for sure.
Very good one. Best for coffee and breakfast. You will love it.

This shop serves a great burger, has an amazing team, and offers a warm, welcoming vibe! The staff are friendly and helpful, with a big smile on their face and we truly appreciate the effort you put into supporting young people as they start their careers—especially in a country where the cost of living is high and opportunities can be limited. Thank you for that. That said, I’d like to offer some honest feedback in the spirit of helping this fantastic franchise continue to grow and improve. The cleanliness of the space—especially the bathroom—could use a bit more attention. Here are a few suggestions: • Deep clean the entire area regularly • Upgrade the hand soap quality (ideally foam) • Replace the toilet lid/seat • Use bleach regularly in the toilet to ensure proper disinfection and hygiene • Ensure the bathroom is maintained throughout the day—for example: add a sanitising spray for a pleasant scent, keep hand tissues available, and consider adding hand sanitiser in the common area With these improvements, you’ll be offering the best Burger Fuel experience in this country. Thanks again for the great food and for creating such a supportive, friendly environment for your team. I’ll definitely keep coming back :)

The staff was really amazing and welcoming, Delicious and Unique Burgers: Customers love the variety and originality of the burger options. The gourmet touches, like unique sauces and premium meats, set BurgerFuel apart from typical fast food joints. Fresh, High-Quality Ingredients: The freshness of the ingredients, especially the meat, is a standout feature. Many reviewers highlight the taste of the beef patties as being especially juicy and flavorful. Generous Portion Sizes: The portion sizes are generally considered to be quite generous, with hearty servings of fries and big, satisfying burgers. Great Customer Service: The staff at the Mt. Roskill location are often noted for being friendly and attentive, contributing to a positive dining experience. Clean and Comfortable Atmosphere: The location typically gets positive feedback for being clean and offering a casual yet comfortable environment to enjoy a meal. Vegetarian and Vegan Options: Many customers appreciate that BurgerFuel offers plant-based alternatives, making it a great spot for a variety of dietary preferences. Quick Service: Though it’s a popular spot, the service is generally fast, making it a solid choice for both dine-in and takeaway

Family and I were passing through the area last night and the kids were hungry. We stopped in at Burger Fuel Mt Roskill for dinner. First time at this location and what an amazing place, the staff were great and very professional! The food was served very quickly, so the kids did not even have a chance to get bored waiting. We had fries, shakes and BBQ Roadsters...everything was lovely and the shakes were something else👌 The only suggestion is that the relatively new style doofers (part of the zipper box) are a bit deep and bulky...the originals are much tighter and nicer to use.

Really wish I could give this burgerfuel a higher review. Uncooked fries that were impossible to eat and lettuce leaf burger with one leaf of lettuce. For 24 dollars for the burger incredibly disappointing.

Wonderful Experience! I had a truly great time at this restaurant. The food was delicious and carefully prepared, and the atmosphere was warm and inviting. What made the experience even more special was the excellent service provided by Marina. She was kind, attentive, and always had a lovely smile. Her professionalism and friendly attitude really stood out and made me feel welcome. Thank you so much, Marina, for your outstanding service — I look forward to coming back soon! Highly recommended!

Nestled in the vibrant heart of Auckland, Spice Traders is a culinary treasure that promises an unforgettable dining experience. Being an Indian here in NZ I love being here it gives me vibes as if I'm at my home in India and enjoying my favourite meals. From the moment you step through the doors, you are greeted with the warm, inviting aromas of authentic spices and a welcoming atmosphere that sets the tone for a delightful meal. The menu at Spice Traders is a testament to the rich and diverse culinary traditions of India. Each dish is expertly crafted using the finest ingredients, ensuring that every bite is a burst of flavor. Whether you are a fan of spicy curries, tender tandoori meats, or flavorful vegetarian options, there is something to satisfy every palate. The chefs clearly have a passion for their craft, as evidenced by the exquisite presentation and balanced flavors of each dish. One of the standout features of Spice Traders is their impeccable service. The staff is friendly, attentive, and always ready to provide recommendations or accommodate special dietary needs. Their knowledge and enthusiasm for the cuisine add an extra layer of enjoyment to the dining experience. The ambiance of the restaurant is both elegant and comfortable, making it an ideal spot for any occasion, be it a casual lunch, a family dinner, or a special celebration. The tasteful decor, combined with the soothing background music, creates a relaxing environment that enhances the overall dining experience. In addition to the dine-in experience, Spice Traders also offers convenient takeaway and delivery options, ensuring that you can enjoy their delicious offerings from the comfort of your home. Their commitment to quality and customer satisfaction is evident in every aspect of their service. Spice Traders Auckland is more than just a restaurant; it’s a culinary journey that transports you to the heart of India with every bite. If you’re looking for an exceptional dining experience with top-notch service and mouthwatering dishes, Spice Traders is the place to be. Highly recommended!

♿ Wheelchair parking and park outside store and the shopping parking lots. lots of parking to find The store was clean and tidy 🅰️ Grade store . Baby chair No toilets In store dining available or take away. I ordered the lamb RoganJosh (mild) Comes with rice and bought roti and the $6 yoghurt drink is really nice . I dined in. I enjoyed the meal filling and happy experience service and the food.

Ordered Semi Veg Manchurian, Paneer Makhani, and Kadai Paneer — all dishes were absolutely delicious and packed with authentic Indian flavors. Great portion sizes, rich taste, and well-cooked. Highly recommended for anyone looking for real Indian food experience!

Delicious Indian food here. We ordered Lunch special and it was worth the price. Lamb rogan josh had nice flavours. Ample parking around. Clean place and good staff. Will go again to try other menu options as well. Everytime we go it's just delight. They have lowered prices of biryani which is awesome. Adds to the value.

Disappointed & poor value for money.. This was an expensive lunch with nearly no meat, and I didnt order a vegetarian. I paid $16.50 for the "Lunch Combo with drink" 4 small pieces of butter chicken, a smattering of rice, nice naan bread & I was fleeced on my '$2.50' drink, actual cost $4.50. After ordering and paying, I thought maybe I read the lunch special combo incorrectly, so I checked the large poster in the window. When I questioned the staff member she informed me that the drink in the combo was a smaller size. Which confused me, as I wasnt asked what 'size' drink i wanted?!? I had clearly asked for the "Combo with a drink" Its fair to say, not off to a great start. I held out hope for the meal though. Strike II, shocker... 4 tiny pieces of chicken. I thought maybe I was being punished for questioning the cost. So I asked, I'm not shy. The $12 COMBO lunch only ever comes with 4 pieces of Tegal chicken less than 80gms!! Damn, not a mistake. This is the standard... So the positives, clean and tidy, not busy at all so no wait times, 1 nice staff member offer water at the table. There are plenty of choices for Indian on Auckland.... dont choose this one.
hands-down, the most delicious samosas in the country!!
An absolutely amazingly Tasty Food...no matter what but last 10 years & so on ordering samosas & stuff.. never had any health issues...always fresh & tasty ..thanks TF Team..keep up ur hard work..

The team at Tasty Foods supported us to fundraise for a water polo trip to the World Champs. They were easy and efficient to deal with, and our huge order was ready on time, boxed up, 6 separate invoices generated. Best of all, the samosas were delicious! Thanks team, we will definitely use you again!
Great place to get your home style Indian/Gujarati snacks. They also do larger orders and catering.

I have only purchased butter chicken samosas and veg samosas from these guys. I have to say that they were both awesome, freshness and taste. their farsan (homemade is also very very nice). My friend had purchased some recently and it was fresh, crispy and delicious.

Very delightful service from the owner! We ordered four pieces of fish for two people — the fish was absolutely fresh. I personally loved the chicken sausage as well. 👍🏻 Great for takeaway, especially if you’re driving — parking’s a bit limited.
Got the whanau together for lunch. Amazing food. Freshly made. Great flavour with a crunch. Peaceful atmosphere. Uncle was super lovely and gave us an awesome deal.

Reply to the owner: Thanks for the reminder of the chicken sausage. I’m sorry for the typo. DO NOT order the squid here! It’s not fresh and is probably from frozen package, for there’s a weird chemical taste in it. Plus, 5 small pieces of squid for $5.99 is way too overpriced. Fish and chicken sausage are okay. Fish seems fresh. Chips are obviously from frozen package too. Few of the chips were still hard inside where they were served. Moreover, I don’t recommend to dine in here because there are too many flies!

I had a fantastic experience at this fish and chip restaurant—everything from the food to the service exceeded my expectations. The fish was incredibly fresh, with a light, crispy batter that wasn’t greasy, and the chips were golden, thick, and perfectly seasoned. The staff were warm and attentive, creating a welcoming atmosphere that made the meal even more enjoyable. The portion sizes were generous, and the prices were very reasonable for the quality of food served. It’s clear they take pride in what they do, and it shows in every detail. I’ll definitely be returning and would highly recommend it to anyone craving classic, well-made fish and chips.

Nana’s Fish House is a fantastic local gem! The fish was incredibly fresh with the perfect crunchy batter – absolutely delicious. The kids loved it too, which says a lot! Portion sizes are on the smaller side, but honestly, the taste and quality more than make up for it. One of the best fish and chip spots around. We’ll definitely be back!
The fish is fresh and tasty. I am very happy

So yummy, stopped by yesterday to try it out. Got the beef burger combo, chicken and chips combo and chicken kebab combo. Delicious and tasty 😋. Lovely customer service from a very happy friendly lady, many many many thanks 😊.

very tasty/crunchy burger I had it after long time..very fresh & more sauces options to make it bit fusion style according to your taste buds. very friendly staff & fast service. definitely coming back for more..they offered free coke can with that..thanks guys..

I had the chiken nibbles and fries they were so crispy and hot I liked them nice to have them in this rainy season she made them fresh so yummy and good friendly service thanks for the lovely service and plz dnt read the bad feedbacks it's few people who perpersally post bad reviews about halal stop it guys she dnt have to be Muslim to sell halal food .
If I could give zero stars, I would. I found a hair in my food – absolutely disgusting and unacceptable. Not recommended at all.

We have seen this place when passing by So finally we made a stop to grab a bite for dinner The store is well set clean and tidy We got the basic bustard burger and a honey crunch chicken burger , also some fries It was well packed in a cardboard box The burger had lettuce, onion , sauce, and the chicken patty The burger bun was fresh and soft It was well made , and taste was ok , just was over salted in the burger as well as the fries The fries were soft and oil free Service was friendly and efficient You can also get rice kebab wrap kebab ,vegetarian burger Sides ,drinks Also does Halal for those who require this Happy to try something else in future

I bought a double classic cheese burger(hot) , beef hotdog, and a regular side of chips. The burger was quite delicious, well packed, and worth its money. The beef hotdog was average in taste, and the menu mentioned we could add our favorite toppings in the hotdog. It looks like they forgot to add. You can choose to eat in as they have space for 6-8 people. I will definitely try other items from their menu as they look appealing.

I might be a little harsh with the review after 1 try and ordering takeout within there first week. I will be back to try something else but for now its a 3. Why, it took 30 minutes for my order to be ready. First week woes possibly. I ordered the Cheesy Delight Beef Burger and chips. The chips were yum. Probably, one of the best within the local area of fish and chip, takeaway shops. Yum! The burger, yuck. I'm not sure why, but it was wrapped in tinfoil, in a box, and it was a sad looking mushy burger when I opened it up. It wasn't wrapped very long once it was handed to me. Within 2 minutes of leaving the shop I had opened it to eat and it did not look appealing. It was a steamed burger. This is why I have only give 3. To the owners/chef, please do not wrap it in tinfoil. That is not keeping it warm, it is steaming it into a soft mushy burger. Yuck! I'll be back to try again in a couple of weeks.

Hands down one of the best burger joints I’ve visited in Auckland! I tried the Cheesy Delight Beef Burger, Double Classic Chicken Burger, and both the Chicken and Beef Hot Dogs on Chips — every single item was packed with flavour, cooked fresh, and incredibly satisfying. The Cheesy Delight was rich, juicy, and lived up to its name — absolute perfection for cheese lovers. The Double Classic Chicken Burger had tender, well-seasoned patties with just the right crunch and spice. And the hot dogs on chips? A must-try! Generous portions, loaded toppings, and seasoned fries that hit the spot. The store is clean, bright, and welcoming with quick service and a great vibe. Definitely recommend Bull’s Burgers if you’re after quality food and a proper feed!

First time trying bulls burger. On paper the place sounded amazing so was very eager to try it. I ordered the heavy hitter and had a try at some of the fries. The burger was overall very fulling packed with lots of meat. The bun was a little stale and dry, would love for them to substitute to a buttery brioche would heighten the texture so much more! Not a big fan of the sausage that was used, it didn't really add anything other then texture. The salami was all placed to one side of the burger which was disappointing as I had to open the burger and rearrange it myself. The lettuce pieces were a bit slimy, some crunchy fresh shredded lettuce would've been allot better!. Fries had a good seasoning, but a few of them were quite soggy and it was eaten as soon as the food was received. Overall not a bad burger, worth the try and with a few improvements could be a great place to come on the regular!
Bull's burger sells the best halal burger in Auckland. Burger petty was filed with solid beef and spices were balanced. I enjoyed it. I wish them all the very best!

Very good experience! The Pakistani food was full of flavour and freshly made. The service was friendly and quick, and the atmosphere was nice and welcoming. Highly recommend PK Street Food for anyone craving authentic Pakistani dishes. Will definitely come back!

Disappointing experience at the food truck. Waited an hour for Goat Kadhai & Shawarma, but the food didn't live up to the hype. The staff were friendly, but the dish was oversold. I've had better options elsewhere, so won't be recommending.

Before going here go with a full stomach. They took over an hr to make the food. The Chapli kebab and samosas were burnt from the outside and not cooked inside. He would have used high heat. The paratha is the packed supermarket ones which again was not cooked was so soggy. And the chicken that took me xtra long to be made was so oily you couldn’t taste the food.
Huge portions. Spice level is great. Very tasty. Great value. Order is Chicken 65 + noodles combo

One of most Authentic Pakistani food gem, super customer service, anday wala burger was best, we had peshawari chapli kebab-one of the best taste and portions are value for money. Definitely recommend for quality food with reasonable prices.

We got goat curry from here and it reminded me of homemade curry. However there was a lot of oil in the curry but I understand that the curry demands oil. A little less oil would have been perfect. But regardless of that the taste was great. I can recommend it. we definitely going to try other items.

I ordered goat curry - it was very good. The goat was cooked perfectly to melt off the bone. The new owner explained his concept of fresh ground spices and homestyle cooking, and you can really taste the difference :)

Owner is very welcoming and passionate about the restaurant. If you want the best dish catered to your taste, I highly insist asking the chef for his recommendation, as he is actually flexible to make what might suit your spice level etc. We were recommended the Bhuna chicken and Goat curry - which were absolutely delicious. Pair this with fresh piping hot buttered naan, and every morsel melts in your mouth. The Gulab Jaman at the was also a great fresh touch. Can't wait till the interior work is finished all the best

Ordered chicken noodles and goat curry. Reminded me of the taste back home with authentic spices. The owners were very welcoming and the taste was very home made. Would recommend every one to have a visit and try this place out.

An authentic curry house situated sneakily in Stoddard. Perfectly secluded for a good get away bite. I have been there this Sunday and ordered the Tandoori and Saag chicken dishes with garlic naan and roti. I was very impressed and the tandoori had a strong flavor and you could tell it was done with some real passion. Nice and hot and very very flavorful. The Saag was very good and went superb with the rotis and the naan. Also nice and spicy. I cook curries at home ALOT, so I have a real appreciation for people that use and make their own curry mixtures from dry spices. These were some fresh as curries.

Location = 5/5 Parking Plenty(Shared Building/Parking) Overall Service = Great 5/5 Food/Presentation = Good 4/5 What i ate = Veg Thali (refer picture) 3 roti, 3 curry, rice, pickle, papad. Good 4/5 Drinks = Masala Chai 5/5(amazing flavour) $ 3 Bill Value = $10 $ for 1 Negative = Chapatis/Roti too rubbery and hard - 2/5 Suggestion = try different recipe for chaptis - previously they were quite popular for soft chapatis but they have been using machine to press lately hence the rubbery texture. Review Ranger Over all Rating = 4/5
Best home made and healthiest food cooked by a family. Very authentic.

One of best Indian vegetarian food eatery , u can best Mumbai style vadapav , spicy samosas, bread pakoda, Gujarati patra, khaman , different curry , thepala , roti , Indian tea . Very reasonable price . Located inside premises of lotus super market. So always busy , also u can order on Uber eats
If you want to try Mumbai style vada pav this place provide authentic Mumbai vada pav.

I love to eat everyday from home made food. I start liking veg food now, even i am non vegetarian because i love the taste of home made food. My favorite items are samosa vada pav and palak paneer. Highly recommended. Pakistani must try once then you'll forget butt karahi nihari charga bryani all.

Finding a good pizza place can be a real treat for anyone looking for a satisfying meal. The aroma of freshly baked dough and melted cheese is enough to make your mouth water. When you walk in, the friendly service and warm atmosphere instantly put you at ease. Ultimately, a great pizza place understands that delicious food and exceptional service go hand in hand. It is a delightful treat that many people enjoy. The crispy crust and melted cheese create a satisfying texture. Various toppings allow for a wide range of flavor combinations. Indeed, it is a simple pleasure that brings people together.

Pasand Pizza on Richardson Rd is an absolute gem! The flavors are authentic, and you can really taste the quality in every bite. The pizzas are perfectly cooked, with a deliciously crispy crust and fresh toppings. I highly recommend their special pizzas – each one is bursting with unique flavors that keep you coming back for more. They also offer their famous tandoori chicken, as well as butter chicken with rice, which are both must-tries! The owner, Brother Marghoob, is a very humble and respectful man. He previously owned the well-known Tandoori Hutt on Stoddard Rd, and Pasand Pizza is his exciting new venture. Please support his new business – you won't be disappointed!
Ordered chicken pizza, tandoori wings and a crispy chicken burger. Chicken burger not pictured because my dog is naughty
Great local pizza place, quick and tasty food. The prices are great. Will definitely try it again
A delicious pizza. Handmade base, nice crust, delicious toppings. Definitely going again. Friendly customer service.

H M Bakery on Penney Ave Mount Roskill, is a good little bakery with a great wide-range of food especially hot chips, fried chicken and potato-topped sausage! I brought a steak and cheese pie this time around and it was still a good all-round pie - good pastry, good amount of steak, and nice flavour!
Have been coming here over 10yrs, food is always consistently good. Pies are super yummy, the chicken rolls, slices, gingerbread man. Yum!!!
Traditional kiwi bakery with good selection of pies rolls and cakes. Resonably priced.
I'm a regular, who is let's say particular about where I buy food, for quality and hygiene. Pies are great,(butter chicken is the best), friendly service. Coffee is better then most cafes in the area
Fav local bakery, best butter chicken pies in the area. Coffee is also better than most places for its price. Overall good munchiess, reasonable prices too.

Authentic South Indian Food in Mt. Roskill — Under $17 per person ! 🥳🤩 This new gem in Central Auckland serves up authentic South Indian goodness that hits every time! The Mysore Masala Dosa, Idli, and Ghee Pudi Mysore Masala Dosa are my go-tos — all under $17 and packed with flavour. ☺️ Bonus? It’s 100% vegetarian (with vegan options!) and the hosts are the kind of warm that makes you feel right at home. 😇 I’m here weekly — and you’ll want to be too! Highly recommend ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️

Me and my friend had this dosa yesterday, and it was absolutely amazing! 😍 The dosa was perfectly crispy and golden, with a delicious masala filling inside. It had the right balance of spice and flavor – fresh, hot, and truly authentic. We also loved the coconut chutney that came with it – smooth, tasty, and a perfect match for the dosa. Every bite was satisfying, and we both really enjoyed it. If you’re a fan of South Indian food, we definitely recommend trying this. One of the best dosas we’ve had in a long time! 👌😋
Best dosa ever tried in Auckland, must try their Mysore masala dosa , halwa , filter coffee . Pure vegetarian restaurant

Mysore Dosa is located in the same complex as Lotus supermarket. The food took around 20 minutes to arrive. We had 1 Butter Dosa, 1 medu vada and 3 butter masala dosas. The place itself has zero atmosphere or ambiance but the food makes up for it. The dosas were crisp and lovely, however the filling in my dosa was really less (see picture). The chutney and sambar were also very tasty. All in all good stuff. Sorry it was a typo not 29 minutes but 20 minutes.

We had idli and Butter masala dosa yesterday at this new South Indian spot in Mt Roskill, and honestly, I was impressed. The idlis were soft, the chutneys and sambar tasted fresh and authentic, and the dosa had the perfect crunch with just the right amount of spice. I’ve seen a few people mention that the ambiance isn’t great – and yeah, it’s a simple setup. But here’s the thing: there are so many places that look fancy but serve average food. This place is the opposite – no frills, but the food speaks for itself. It’s a new business, and they’ve clearly put their heart into getting the flavours right. Definitely going back – and if you love real South Indian food, you should try it too. Cheers,

It is a restaurant recommended by a teammate. The platter is a big portion. The rice is cooked very good, BBQ lamb and chicken are delicious too. Tried the desserts too which are creamy and sweet. Overall it is a nice eating out.

Nice relaxing ambience; not crowded and tables are well spaced for relative privacy. Food is generous and tasty. Service was reasonably prompt but quite impersonal. Despite category of “restaurant”, customers must go up to the counter to order for everyone at your table. There is no personalised service as such. If you’re fine with that, this is a good place to have a meal and chill🌷
Highly recommend had an Owsome time out Charlie bro’s social club ! Love the food Just absolutely the best

First time here last night with the famz and wow the food and service is amazing!!! The meat is flavorsome and tender, dips, bread rice and chips all the bomb! Mad props to the cooks!! We will defintely be back more and more!
Delicious food!! Busy but great armosphere!! affordable. Would come back again!
Very good kebabs, o the Adana burger too. Freshly made in a delicious sesame bun with nice sauces.

Who would’ve thought kebabs and chips out of a gas station would be one of the best kebabs in Auckland? Well it’s true. Had the lamb roll combo with mint chilli yoghurt. The lamb was freshly made on the grill so it takes a bit of time, but certainly worth the wait. The chips were well seasoned and crispy- honestly the best chips I’ve tried in a while. Don’t judge the book by its cover - give this place a go!
Tasty kebabs with big portions and good sauce. It's inside a gas station and only takeaway. Parking is hard to find, but the food is worth it. Very busy place.
It's all about the kebab. Deliciously cooked meat that falls apart. Great portions and amazing value for money. Just a small takeaway shop, not a place to sit down and eat.

Tasty Kebab on Stoddard Road Mt Roskill was very good! It was not your traditional doner kebab but the way the mixed kebab was created with the addition of mint chilli sauce was great - nice flavours especially the pleasant chilli taste! Reasonably priced and filling.

I stopped at this place for a quick snack on a rainy evening. The open kitchen seemed nice at first, but I noticed the chef was preparing food without a cap or gloves. A bucket was on the floor, probably catching water from a leak. When I used the washroom, I saw a rat in the back area, which was flooded and filled with overturned tables and chairs. The hygiene was extremely poor, and the overall vibe was far from relaxing. I left immediately and went to Spice Traders opposite instead. Would not recommend this place based on cleanliness and atmosphere.

The owner is the chef and he cooks marvellous food. This is amongst the top 10 indian restaurants for me. It does not have the pretence and appearance of a fancy restaurant but the food is great as the owner runs a tandoor and his tandoor chicken is to die for(without the colour). Just his love to his craft and amazing food. Support a local!

Poor experience. No parking in the evening due to residents, and the area feels unsafe for kids. The shop has a dull vibe with visible hygiene issues like roaches. No wonder a big brand like Dosa Plaza left. Not recommended for families.

This owner-run gem offers authentic Indian flavors with a personal touch. The food is rich, flavorful, and perfectly spiced. The service is warm, and the ambiance is inviting. Highly recommend the fresh naan and curries. A must-visit for Indian cuisine lovers!
The service is attentive, and the atmosphere is inviting and warm. Definitely my fav spot to get authentic Indian cousine. Specially lunch combo worth for its price.

Our late-night dinner at The Egg & Herb was an absolute delight, especially for an Indian egg lover like myself. Their menu boasts an impressive selection of both vegetarian and egg dishes, making it easy to find something for everyone. We sampled the Australian Fry, Lemon Pepper Omelette, and the unique Angoor Rabdi egg dish. The Lemon Pepper Omelette was perfectly cooked with a beautifully balanced flavor profile. The Australian Fry was, quite simply, mouth-watering. But the standout was undoubtedly the Angoor Rabdi egg dish – masterfully prepared with a harmonious blend of spices and fresh green garlic, making it an absolute must-try. The accompanying Butter Pav was incredibly soft and proved to be the perfect complement, balancing the richness of all the dishes. If you're an Indian egg lover, especially a fan of Surti egg, The Egg & Herb is a destination you cannot miss. Highly recommended – we will absolutely be visiting again!

The Best Taste in All of Auckland! If you're craving flavour packed egg dishes, Egg and Herb is the place to be Known for their incredible variety of egg based items and a few top notch vegetarian options, this spot truly delivers on taste like no other in Auckland. Their Paneer Bhurji is one of the best vegetarian dishes you’ll find soft, spicy, and full of authentic Indian flavour. Among the egg dishes, the Egg Paplet is a clear winner a rich, savoury dish that’s bursting with flavour and unlike anything else you’ve tried. And don’t leave without trying their Angoor Rabdi a heavenly dessert with juicy mini rasgullas dipped in creamy, chilled rabdi. It’s the perfect end to a perfect meal. Whether you’re a hardcore egg lover or looking for a tasty vegetarian bite, Egg and Herb will leave you wanting more every time. Highly recommended! 🔥🍳🥘
It's new in the town, my wife told me about this, I thought let's give it a try and trust me the best egg dishes I have ever tried in entire town, You must visit once 😋.
I ordered 2 eggs dishes and they both are superb and test is 10/10. I recommend visit and try eggs you will definitely like it. Best in the Auckland.
Great place for vegetarian meals with plenty of tasty options. The Paneer Gotalo is a must-try — so delicious! Authentic Surti taste that really hits the spot. 😋🍽️

If you're in Auckland craving authentic Indian street food, the Indian Street Food Truck(Taste bite by Akshit) is a must-visit! This hidden gem brings the vibrant flavours of India right to the heart of the city. The menu is a fantastic mix of traditional favourites like crispy samosas, flavorful chaat, and mouthwatering dahi Bhalla Each dish is packed with bold spices and fresh ingredients, offering an authentic taste of Indian street food that’s hard to beat. The service is quick and friendly, and the truck has a great vibe. Whether you're a fan of spicy food or prefer something a little milder, there’s something for everyone. If you're looking for a tasty, satisfying meal on the go, this food truck delivers every time. Highly recommend giving it a try! 🌟 JunctionGJ5 – Experience the True Flavors of Surat in Auckland! 🌟 If you’re craving authentic tastes from Surat, JunctionGJ5 is the place to be! I absolutely loved their Nutella and brownie waffles topped with creamy ice cream — warm, gooey, and indulgent. Unique treats like Cold Coco Brownie, Khakhra Pizza, and Collegian Bhel add a creative twist to the menu, making every visit a new experience. I’ve often smelt the delicious aroma from this place as I drove past but never stopped in until tonight. I’m really glad that I did! Service was excellent from the very warm but not in your face welcome, to giving you just the right amount of time to look at the drinks menu and having the food appear promptly nice and warm. On that note the food was excellent. To me it’s a mark of an excellent curry house where they can give a mild curry that is tasty and not salty. I was very pleased with my lamb korma. Not only was it very delicious each piece of lamb was lovely and tender. Rice came with the meal and I also got a garlic naan which was perfect. A lovely crispy bottom with just the right amount of fluffiness on top so that the garlic actually gets embedded into it and doesn’t fall off. We also got the onion bhaji. Lovely, crispy, caramelised onion mixed with just the right amount of spice. Wasn’t oily or had clumps of spice like at other places. Would definitely get again. Also the Hada Bhada kebabs had a great taste although they were a bit dry. For drinks, I had the Chadhat passion. It was like a strawberry mango lassi without the tangy after taste you normally get. Would highly recommend. Finally, atmosphere was great. Big large tables easily fits all the platters and very high back chairs create an intimate atmosphere at each table. The tables are also not crammed together like at other places which helps creates a cosy and private atmosphere at your table. The downsides are really the limited parking out the front and the portion sizes. The curries were $15 and on that basis were well worth it but if you have a bit of an appetite you would be best advised to get an appetiser as well as it is smaller to compared to other places in the area. If you’ve gotten this far, it probably won’t surprise you that I really recommend that you try this place out. It is definitely my new curry house going forward.

Epic spot! Stumbled on this place after doing the coast to coast walk in Auckland and it absolutely hit the spot. We ordered the Mammoth and the Titanic sandwiches with chips. Both were some of the best toasted sandwiches we’ve ever had. The owner was also so friendly and nice too, really enjoyed ourselves. Will definitely be back. Thanks guys!
Quality has gone down steeply? I remember having really good fish n chips from here! Chips were not cooked & hard. Fish snapper was half the size it used to be? Disappointed!
1 Fish & Chips... Will try the Fried Chicken next time...
I bought black abalone and cherries. The boss lady treated me to watermelon. I have been eating fish and chips for many years.

I ordered online, 12:31pm estimated pick up time. So I went in at 1:03pm (lunch break) thinking it would have been ready. Got there and was told they are still making my garlic bread. It wasn’t busy (in store) so I was thinking maybe they forgot. I didn’t leave store till 1:15 and my break is almost finished

I just came from my practice at school, then I wanted pizza because I thought it would take 10-15 minutes. But no, it took them 35 minutes to make my food. ( it woulve took longer if I didn't ask. ) The service is so disgusting, I went to ask if my pizza is ready and the worker just looked at me and kept talking to the other customers but me. Finally I got his attention and then asked me what the name was and just walked away without telling me how long or if it was even ready. This service is so bad, good was good but all the pepperoni was on one side and half the pizza didn't even get pepperoni. I only got 1 pizza and it still took 35 minutes for my order.

One of the best Pizza hut in Auckland for sure.! The pizza is of the best quality. Made with so much love and care. I come here even if I am in the north shore only because of the way these guys make the pizzas. Perfectly filled with veggies and cheese. Not too less not too much. Very very happy with the pizzas here! I liked them so much I had to go and ask these guys names to mention them. The staff Anbu & Sam and others working there make sure to only provide quality pizzas nice and hot.
Popped in today and ordered cheese pizza, peperoni pizza x2 chips, seasoned chicken wings and drink. Good customer service, quick and the shop is nice and tidy. Thanks.

nice boy at the counter! Guys at the back looked busy yet got my order fast and it quality was great. Especially love their new Kit Kat treat!!!!! Thanks Royal Oak Pizza Hut will continue to come here!!!!

I didn’t expect much, but the food was surprisingly delicious. The Yakiniku Beef Bento and Chicken Sauce Katsu Bento were $48 for both, and they were neatly packed within 10 minutes. There was street parking nearby, so pick-up was easy and convenient. I’d be happy to order from here again next time.

Truly a bento gem. We had the eel bento, tempura prawns, beef udon and miso soup. The eel bento and tempura prawns were the highlights. Tempura was crisp and not too oily, the eel seasoning well balanced. The restaurant fills up pretty quickly so we were lucky to grab a seat as there weren’t too many.

Very fresh, everything in the bento is perfect. However it’s the first time I’ve had a bento without miso soup. The shrimp katsu side dish was really nice. There are very limited tables inside (5 tables).
So pleased to see Takashi back in the neighbourhood. Fresh flavours, nice portions, great menu options. Look forward to going back soon.
Beautiful Japanese food. A favourite for locals, highly reccomend

1 star because I ordered from Uber eats of a chicken soup that they had advertised. When I received my meal and it looked nothing like what they advertised. I call it false advertisement and will make a complaint to Uber eats. I spoke to the manager but try to play it off. I just wanted a refund.

Good homely food and nice ambience. Tried their Dahi puri, Dabeli, Peri Peri Paneer Sandwich and Egg gotala. Dahi puri is extra ordinary in taste. Loved it😋. All other items are good in taste just the Egg Gotala was bit salty. Other than that it is a must visit place to try egg and veg dishes👍

Avoid Go Indian cuisine trading on Uber eats as Golden Fried take aways at 557 Mount Albert Rd, Royal Oak, Auckland 1023, New Zealand, Auckland 1042. The ￼fish & chips quantity is very small for $25.99 BUT worst of all the tiny fish pieces are poor QUALITY. They were inedible, tasted freezer burnt and off.

We had a wonderful dining experience. The ambience was absolutely lovely - warm, inviting, and with just the right touch of coziness. The soft background music created a relaxed atmosphere, perfect for enjoying a meal with your family. The food was equally impressive. Every dish was delicious, with fresh ingredients and well-balanced flavors that left a lasting impression. Overall I highly recommend!👏
Amazing service and delicious food. Highly recommended place to visit. Veg sandwiches was extremely delicious 😋.

Cheapest butter chicken & rice I’ve come across thus far & definitely the tastiest! The butter chicken is so rich and delicious, cheesy garlic naan is immaculate! My meal was so flavourful! For sure my go-to place for butter chicken and naan breads!! May I add that my meal was cooked fresh and stayed hot for a while. So good! The couple are so sweet too ☺️
Food quality is very bad and owner Behavior is very very bad Very very very bad quality Unprofessional chef’s and Staff

I had Kadhai chicken and rice from this place and the food was amazing! The service was fast and the food was hot when I received it. Props to the owner and family for their good work and good food! Will definitely order again. :)

The food I ordered through Uber Eats was completely tasteless. When I called the restaurant, the phone attendant was extremely unprofessional and rude. This kind of behaviour and terrible food quality make this place one I would never recommend.

text: Ordered via ubereats. I was very impressed with what I received 🙂. The packaging 📦 was great! It kept the food moist and at a good temperature👌. The portion sizes 😍 blew me away! I couldn't believe how much chicken there was. Talk about value for money🤑 and it tasted very good. I enjoyed the whole meal. I will definitely recommend spending your hard earned dollars on a good kai here👍 thank you 😊 Happy New Year!

I have been there last week as i was passing by i needed lunch. We entered in the store but there was no greetings from staff😐. Moreover, staff was busy doing his work for at least 5 minutes and didn't ask what we want. Overall very rude service wouldn't recommend going there.

I had a terrible experience at this Subway location. The customer service was extremely poor, the staff acted like they couldn’t care less about the customers. On top of that, they don’t offer the “Sub of the Day” and refuse to accept any of the promotions or offers that Subway is providing, When I asked why, they simply said,We’re a different franchise,It’s disappointing and feels like a rip-off compared to other Subway locations. Definitely won’t be coming back here again.

Not the best Subway by any stretch of the imagination. Service is slow and the staff are disinterested. They’ve also removed the Sub of the Day from their offerings. Disappointing all round. Hamish Dorrington Kakapo Business Sales

Just thought I would express my disappointment with the customer service experience I had at your Subway restaurant recently. Now my sub was pretty good yesterday however the Customer Service is appalling, First of all certain breads weren't available so I had to ask which breads were available and I could not hear as her tone was very low so I had to get her to repeat herself which seemed a chore for her and a hard task. I get that some people aren't the most pleasant or rub you the wrong way n everyone has their off days, but get a clue! In this industry you want a good experience with your customers. I'm a reg customer here not sure I want to return. Not the first time I've experienced this here from a worker 😔 I strongly recommend you give them proper training on their attitudes if you'd like more business.. service with a smile

Popped into Royal Oak for lunch as was nearby. My order was fast & delicious tender chicken & beautifully topped up steaming hot potato & gravy was silky soft. Chips were good dipped into gravy. One of the best stores great food great staff who all deserve a job well done. As happy customers keep coming back as customer care is paramount☺

Was absolutely delicious! Fries were fresh and hot with a generous amount of salt. The chicken was perfect. However, I would give it a 5 star if the coselaw had tasted better. It tasted completely off and looked to see the expiry date to be the next day. Overall, a 4 star works out. Strongly recommend coming to this KFC!
Didn’t know it was possible but I was given a hollow chicken burger patty and the chips had no salt. Couldn’t even eat it, was quite disgusted. Unfortunate because I usually like kfc.

It's not bad. It's what you expect. But sometimes the drive through line takes forever. I've been coming to this KFC for over 20 years now... I feel old. Service: 3/5 Food Quality: 3/5 Food Quantity: 5/5 Environment: 3/5 Price: $10-20pp
The times I’ve been here they had the best wicked wings. Piping hot and large. Can’t complain the lady accommodated to my request too.

I mean there are probably a few worse places around…. If you really tried to find them. You can tell right away from walking in that this place is just run down and nobody cares for it. The lady was rude. The posters on the wall look like they are 20 years old. Then I spotted the kitchen. Raw meat sitting in the open defrosting in a sink. Huge containers of uncovered, pre cooked, room temperature rice. And as expected I couldn’t find any food safety rating on display. Good was OK. But not sure if I’m going to eat the chicken in this dish. Have some pride and respect for what you do. Noodle Canteen need to sort this place out.

This was my go too place when I lived near by and thought I would see whether the Combination Egg Foo Young and special fried rice was still a hit for me, Yes most definitely is still two of my favourite dishes. Thank you for the quick delivery and delicious hot food💜

Ordered the Nasi Goreng and Sambal Fried Rice. For both dishes, there was slightly bit too much rice compared to meat. Both dishes here were $13.50 each. Have tried the Honey soy chicken and wasn't impressed. Tasted artificial, bland and had hardly any chicken in the batter. Would suggest avoiding this dish here if you already have another preferred Noodle Canteen store.

I ordered 3 dishes and first my son found a piece of hair and I said it must be his hair and then I found another long piece of hair in my meal, threw over $50 of food and never going back! The lady was also very unpleasant and looked unhappy and disinterested in serving anyone.
I ordered Honey Chicken get in a Bowl of Noodles approx 1 month ago Royal Oak 10/10. Since bought another 3/10 must be diff cook.nothing like 1st order no sauce,diff noodles. Wont buy again.

I can't understand the bad reviews... I order here regularly and it's the best salads I've had from any pita pit! The best green smoothie out as well. Always a good portion and friendly but focused staff
I go to this pitapit weekly! It's amazing! She makes pitas an bowls like no other!. I don't understand the bad reviews as I have never had any bad experience from here. 100% recommend this pitapit.

Spent $30 on one halloumi sandwich and you guys put 3 shreds of halloumi inside?? Where’s the rest? Also cooking red onions INTO the egg I haven’t eaten in three days and this made me regret trying. The owner said that this is how all the sandwiches come and denied a refund, instead offered me another one of these gross meals. False advertisement, he wanted me to bring it to him also to prove it to him it was terrible. I usually like this place I’m so disappointed. It’s in the bin right now :(

Oct update Again happy with my Mexicano pita today, was delivered promptly. Well worth it ! That has set me up for the day, delish. Love this pita pit ! Thanks team happy with my pita today, best pita pit in years ordered the Chicken fala & teriyaki chicken pitas. Just like how I remember it. good size portion.
Delicious healthy food option. Catering available. Good customer service and clean restaurant.

Best pub ever and the local. Shadow Boxing burger is amazing. Beers are cheap, staff are super friendly and community focussed. Always have a game on multiple TV's. Other customers are friendly and is just a great pub to have a few beers at
Good location. Plenty parking. Reasonable prices. Owners are a young down to Earth couple.
Reasonably food and drink price. Come there for the coffee few times. Staff treat friendly and gave me a loyalty coffee card. Great customer service.
Fantastic atmosphere, reasonably priced food and drinks, friendly staff make this bar a top-notch choice!
I have been here couple times since opened. Very nice food menu and good customer service! Support locals! 😊

Almost every dish is quite tasty.The fish pate is very special and delicious which is out of my expectation. After tried the lamb ribs , we found out why this course is strongly recommended by clients. A wonderful night!
Fabulous evening. Service was friendly, food was interesting. Chose the Chef's choice so didn't know what we were getting. Great cocktails!
Popular place and busy. The staff was excellent and friendly. I had the chicken schnitzel and my friend had the pork belly. Jimmy's draft was quite enjoyable.

Shared an amazing meal here with close friends. Enjoyed delicious cocktails and a variety of selections from the menu. The beef was melt in the mouth, perfect. Staff were friendly and attentive. Definitely recommend a special meal here to friends, and will be back again.

17082024, we went for dinner at Little Jimmy, driving past so often, it looked so cozy, the menu looks great online and the online presentation is great. So, expectation are high. From the moment we entered, everything was what their profile promises, warm, eclectic, busy, tidy, super friendly. Connor made us a couple of cocktails; fantastic. The bar area is inviting to have a drink and chat before dinner. We choose 3 small dishes and a desert, Elephant Hill shiraz as company. Excellent service, available when, needed, quiet friendly, smooth. We highly recommend to visit once be warned it could become an addiction!!!! Team at Little Jimmy keep up the great hospitality. We will be back for more!!! Thanks for hosting a lovely evening!!!!

🌟A Hidden Gem for Families and Fur - Friends!🌟 Just had to share my absolute favorite coffee spot! This place is a total winner for families and pup - lovers alike, and here's why: Inside, it's all warm, bright and the outdoor area, pure magic for dog owners! Every four - legged friend we've met here is as friendly as can be. Absolute heart - melter moments 🐾. The coffee is a visual AND taste treat—gorgeous latte art that tastes as amazing as it looks, with that perfect, cozy aroma that just wraps you up ☕. The food? Oh, don't even get me started. The sandwiches are crispy on the outside, juicy on the inside. The full English breakfast is a heaping plate of fresh, deliciousness. But the show - stealer for the little one? The fruit pancakes with ice cream! Sweet, but not overly so, and they've got my kid practically begging to come here every weekend. The staff? Total rockstars. Patient with the kids, kind to the dogs, and always on top of things—whether it's tweaking our outdoor seating just right or refilling drinks pronto. They feel less like staff and more like friendly neighbors who’ve got your back. Every little detail, they nail it 💯. This isn't just a coffee shop anymore—it's our family “go - to”. Whether it's a family outing, a pup - walking pitstop, or just craving some great grub and joe, this place delivers. Can't wait to go back—and you bet we will, again and again ！

Incredible value for your money. I enjoyed a delightful lunch with my parents and we were blown away by the speedy service and delicious food. My parents opted for a hearty breakfast, while I savored a flavorful beef brisket with noodles. The prices are great and the laid-back atmosphere adds to the experience. I wholeheartedly recommend this place.

A Hidden Gem on Mt Eden Road! I recently visited Orvieto Cafe on Mt Eden Road and was, once again, absolutely thrilled with the customer service. I ordered a slice of carrot cake, and while placing it on the saucer, the front edge of the slice broke slightly. To my surprise, the kind owner brought over an extra cookie as a thoughtful gesture to make up for it. It’s little moments like this that really set a place apart. The atmosphere is always warm and welcoming, the staff are genuinely friendly, and the food never disappoints. No wonder I keep going back🫶Orvieto Cafe truly knows how to make their customers feel valued. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a cozy spot with great coffee, treats, and top-notch service 🥰

Orvieto is a great place to visit. They’ve changed a bit over the last few years, but my most recent visit was definitely the best yet. I ordered a chicken sandwich with fries—it was packed (in a good way!) and super filling. They also have a great range of other options on the menu. I tried the garlic chilli prawn pasta as well, and it was absolutely delicious. Overall, a really satisfying experience!
Good, decent food at a reasonable price. The service was quite fast. It wasn't anything revolutionary, but the French toast was well made and well presented.

Recommended to us by our local AA driving trainer. Good large servings with free unlimited miso soup or green bean sweet soup. Lots of locals eating here so it has community approval. Good taste and we will be back to try other dishes.. Thank you..

Food was average in taste. Portions were ok, not really big. Place is really cramped, and cutlery is dirty. Food came quickly, but dishes are not cleared. In my opinion, price is 20% on the high side for the food quality and portions. Overall, not a enjoyable experience and ŵould not come back. I think other Google reviewers have overrated by a lot. This is more like a budget student eatery, but charging more. Need to park across a busy road. Only 3 or 4 carparks on the street in front. No off street parking.
taste good and had free suop, waiting a while but still have a good time.

The dining experience at this establishment is quite pleasant; the food is delicious, and the staff is friendly. The service is consistently prompt, with dishes served promptly. While we frequently opt for takeout rather than dining in, the small diner only has a handful of tables, occasionally requiring share a table with others. I believe the overall layout of the place could be improved for a more comfortable dining atmosphere.

I have been to this restaurant twice and each time myself and husband enjoyed it. The food is always delicious and generous portions, if you dine in you get to enjoy their miso soup. This has become a regular for me, definitely recommend to everyone to visit here.
I had the lamb works on rice, super tender meat, deliciously fresh salad and piping hot rice! Definitely recommend for a great quick dinner
I ordered the lamb on rice. The salad was beautifully fresh, the rice was boiling hot and the lamb was really nicely seasoned. I would definitely visit again.
The chicken souvlaki on rice at Royal Kebab is delicious! Perfectly seasoned, with tender chicken and flavourful rice. A very satisfying meal indeed! Hamish Dorrington Kakapo Business Sales
Got the chicken souvlaki, combo w/ added hot chips & drink. From recommendation, not too spicy at all, perfect hot weather Very happy w/ the customer service
It's almost made of lettuce and salad. Bearley to find chicken pieces . You can't control catching the sandwiches 😅🥲

Well-made terakihi burger, so good and fresh only problem is burger didn't hold together, but that's it. Chips were thick and Hot. Prefer a burger & chips combo like this as opposed to other takeaway meals. Appreciate how wholesome it is, the quality and the price 👍 keep up the good work !

Great classic fish n chips. Exactly how we imagine it to be, nice and fresh, not too salty and super hot! Great portions too! Definitely enough for two people. Deep fried mars bar was also went down a treat

The fish was fresh and delicious. Chips were great too. All a bit too oily though & would have preferred slightly longer draining of the oil. Waiting time was ok & portion size is ok. Customer service is soso.
Fish & Chips were great! Had the gluten-free option and was pleasantly surprised. Will definitely come to try the NGF menu next time!

Had lunch here with my daughter and husband today! Fish - fresh, fluffy and not oily! Perfect! Chips - crispy, fresh and fluffy Fried mussels - my favourite! Portions were large we couldnt finish our food, warmed up for tea and it was still amazing. 10/10 recommend! Havent had good fish & chips in a while!
Very bad experience got take away felt like having frozen parotta and it’s definitely reheated parotta still don’t know why they took 20 mins to prepare the food because it was just reheated ones.
Booked in for Onam lunch. Food and variety was great. Servers are very friendly. My first ever time for onam lunch and it was worth the money I paid.
This restaurant is a decent choice for Kerala cuisine. I love the Parotta and Varutharacha chicken curry. The tea is also quite good. I visit here frequently, as the service is consistently good.
Lots of coconut flavors in the curries unlike northern indian cuisine. The porottas was very good. Didnt particularly like the mutton briyani.

Best authentic Kerala restaurant in town!! Tasty food and worth the money spent. Quantity was also generous! Miss similar restaurants in Melbourne (except Coconut Lagoon which is almost 1hr drive from our place)

Good service and quiet restaurant. I’m a regular there. Often takeaway Cheese Garlic Naah, that’s my favorite. It will be well-packed and cut into pieces as I requested. Highly recommend. Also, Lamb Curry is my must have if I dine-in.
Tasty food! The chefs special chicken curry was amazing. Naan is smaller than other places and more crispy keep that in mind when ordering

Loved the food and the music. We had their special PANEER Angara and Daal Tadka, Pani Puri, Mushroom starter which came perfectly roasted (never experienced such perfectly cooking with either raw overcooked being my prior experiences). Thank you, Maulick and team and wishing you and the team the very best for your new Papatoetoe branch. Cheers

I had an incredible dining experience at Bhojan ! The food was absolutely outstanding, from the starters to the desserts. Every dish was bursting with authentic flavors and prepared to perfection. The quality and taste truly exceeded my expectations. The attention to detail and the warm hospitality made the experience even more enjoyable. If you're looking for amazing food and a memorable dining experience, Bhojan is the place to go. Highly recommend! 5/5 🌟

“One way ticket to Bhojan plz! And make it snappy!” From the second we entered this beautifully appointed hidden gem, we were taken care of with utmost care. We were quickly seated, table set with a request for what refreshments we’d like - 2 kingfisher, 1 hazy and a crisp glass of Savvy b. No more than 2 minutes later our drinks were flying from the bar to our spacious table of 4. For starters the table got 2 servings of sev puri and some complimentary poppadoms. For mains an assortment of vegetarian and chicken based curries - all EXCEPTIONAL! The ease of everything from seating to service had conversations flowing, drinks drunken and a night we wouldn’t change for anything! Bhojan - WE WILL BE BACK! 😋
Worst kebab. Wouldn't visit again. That's large and salads for name sake. Chicken also micro waved.. not flamed cooked. And doesn't taste fresh

Was just driving backhome and just saw this place accidentally cause i thought i never see this before and im a fan of kebabs but this one is really amazing…. Specially the chicken i love it and will definitely found my new fav and closest kebab house in hillsborough/mt.albert rd and will definitely gonna recommend to my friends and everyone👏👏👏
Terrible portion sizing! What a large meat on chips looks like
Have visited a couple times over the last week, really impressed with the friendly staff and the variety of options / ability to modify food orders. Nice place to grab a comforting meal to go :)

I recently visited Signature Kebab and Chicken in Hillsborough and tried their Vegetarian Tosti — and it was a delightful surprise! The tosti was perfectly toasted, with a crispy golden crust and a warm, flavorful filling that was both satisfying and well-balanced. The veggies were fresh and well-seasoned, and the cheese melted just right, making each bite comforting and delicious. The place had a welcoming vibe, and the staff were friendly and quick with the service. It's great to see a spot that offers solid vegetarian options alongside their usual menu. Definitely worth a visit if you're in the area — especially if you're craving something simple, tasty, and vegetarian-friendly!

Was here for a Sunday morning for dim sum brunch. The food, service and atmosphere was wonderful. Food portions are delicious, sizeable and good value. Service was quick and efficient. Turning around tables so that I can get a seat within 15min. Food carts are e moving to ensure food are available quickly. This is fast food. Atmosphere was noisy but that is the beauty of it.
It’s always our family gathering place! Good service and the food is so yummy! Pecking duck and Deep fry Taro Basket, Prawn and pineapple are MUST EAT dishes everytime 😊

Our Chinese New Year celebration at this restaurant was a delightful affair. The restaurant itself is spacious and comfortable. We particularly enjoyed the roast duck, special tofu, and special pork – each dish was delicious and expertly presented. The staff were friendly, helpful, and added to the overall positive atmosphere.

Pretty good selection of yum cha specialty foods. They push trolleys around quite frequently. Recommend you book during peak time , you only get an hour to eat . Credit card surcharge of 2.5% Toilets not the cleanest.

Well, I don’t often leave reviews but our experience just now was shocking! I can only assume based on the other ratings here, that dine in is better than takeaway! Looking at the menu, I was very surprised with the cost of each dish. After a bit of research, there were a few comments saying helpings were large. So we ordered a chicken and vegetables, entree dumplings and spring rolls. Super disappointed with the amount of food for $80! Dumplings and spring rolls were okay albeit pricey. But the chicken and veges, at $45 was a joke! Basically all Asian greens and a little chicken. Watery and average tasting tbh. Won’t be ordering from here again.

Waiting an hour for pick up and received this kind of food. Please choose your food and restaurant wisely. Steel wool in my food. Not sure what happened but have to figure out one last time before I order. Serious doubt with recommendation

Ordered a 6 piece chicken combo and only received 5. The chicken thigh was so raw the blood had made a puddle on bottom of box. Also one of the chicken pieces fully smelled like smelly fish idk why a chicken restaurant would have any food item smelling like fish l think they tampered with the food. I asked them for chicken thigh pieces instead of just small little drums when l ordered from them before and they came back with this. Inedible food with an extra piece missing and food smelling like smelly fish... They're called "What The Cluck Three Kings" on uber eats DO NOT EAT HERE ITS DISGUSTING!!!

I must say that the food served here is just superb. Along with superb food the hospitality of Chef Anil and Chef Bijender is also superb. This restaurant opens at 5 pm and stays open till 1.00 am (night) from Sunday to Thursday and from 5 pm to 2 am on Friday and Saturday. I will definitely visit here even ever I feel like eating Indian style Street food. Keep up the good work guys...

Yummy food i say!! Palak paneer is always delicious and the naan at 3am always served hot&fresh. My go to place when im craving biryani. Always a hit and they are so affoardable with chicken & chips combo. Good portions too!!! ✅🙏🏼The surroundings could be cleaner and the enviroment indoors could do a upgrade i guess.
One of the best place to eat something new and taste as per name really taste of india one of the my favorite place after 12 AM must visit and highly recommend

A bright and vibrant cafe with lots of floral decoration. Spacious with many tables but it does get busy still. It has a good selection of savoury meals including salad, pie, bread rolls, filo pastry and sausage rolls...as well as a good selection of sweet including cakes and cookies. Reasonable price. Good coffee.

Busy cafe in the industrial area of Mt Roskill. Even though it was busy & the cafe was full, we were able to order from our table via QR code & the wait time was minimal, very impressive! Our meals were nice & hot, cooked to perfection. The housemade old fashioned lemonade was icy cold & fizzy as, sweet & sour 😍 The mocha dbl shot was there flavour wise, but not as hot as I like it. Would definitely come back again & try other dishes, esp the cabinet food - looked delicious!

Kreem Bake & Cook Where Breakfast Dreams Come True 🍰☕ Went here today (5th Aug 2025, 10 AM) and man… even on a weekday this place is packed like they’re giving away free gold bars. People were waiting for tables, but lucky for us they’ve got plenty inside and outside. They’ve got cakes, buns, pastries, and a bunch more to tempt you into breaking your diet before you even sit down. I had one of the best mocha and pastries I’ve had in a long time in Auckland. Pastries cost around $5–$7 each, but totally worth it quality and taste on point. The shop’s cosy, nicely decorated, and has table service. The vibe is great, but yeah… a little noisy. What can you expect? Crowds don’t whisper when they’re happy. Staff are super friendly, toilets are clean, and there’s plenty of free parking right outside. Looks like I just found my new breakfast & tea spot. Might even bring a sleeping bag next time. ☕️🥐 "Logan was here… left with a mocha buzz and pastry crumbs on his beard."

Friendly staff, always Plenty to choose from for both sweet and savory tastes. Delicious cabinet food ready to go. This place is always pretty busy, and for good reason. Tables inside and outside available with weather coverage for the damper days. Highly recommend you make the stop if you're in the area. Treat yourself!

Visited with my gf and we ordered: - Beef sausage roll - Beef Enchilada - Bread and butter pudding slice - Soy flat white - Almond flat white This all came to $37.70 which was very good value for the size and quality of the food. Very tasty and reasonably generous size portions. Nice decor and friendly efficient/fast service. Highly recommend - will definitely make the effort to come here again.

What an absolute steal for 8bucks, a serving so big it’s hard to finish. Genuinely might be the best deal in Auckland portion wise. The chips also stay very crispy compared to most places. Get the 8dollar meal guys.

This takeaway counter offers incredibly generous portions for the price. The food is always fresh and prepared quickly. The staff are friendly and efficient, making the whole experience pleasant. I highly recommend this place for a satisfying and affordable meal. It's definitely one of the best takeaway options in town.

Disappointed. I have just been up to get takeaways and at 12.00 there is no sign of it being open despite website saying it opens at 11.45am. No lights on, no furniture outside no people in sight. So could you please adjust your opening times online. Surely you need to be there at least an hour before opening to prep food, and heat the oil etc? I must say when you are open to customers your food and prices are amazing.

The best value, the most tastiest and most well seasoned chips i have chucked down my gut in a minute. They were not too soggy but also not too dry - bloke knows how to man a deep fryer. $5 for chips and a hot dog on a stick (with sauce ahuhuhuhu). The best chippy in town.

Very budget friendly, generous quantity, wide variety of fast foods, we bought fish and chips that were also served with eggs and salads it was really fulfilling and tasty, lots of variety food items to choose from, packed drinks available..

A very nice, small sized and family operated eatery serving authentic Indian food. We had lunch here and were pleasently surprised by the quality of food. All the dishes served had different tastes (instead of the usual same curry base served in many Indians restaurants) and were well prepared. 100% vegetarian menu is a USP for them. The sweets are also fresh and well prepared. Few tables are available for dining in. Parking spaces are limited on the adjoining streets. The location is easily accessible. Prices are at par (better in some cases) with the bigger similar Indian restaurants. Very highly recommended.

Bikaner Chaat is a true gem for chaat lovers! Their offerings are a perfect blend of authentic flavors, fresh ingredients, and just the right amount of spices. The crispy golgappas, tangy papri chaat, and mouthwatering aloo tikki are crowd favorites. Each dish bursts with the traditional taste of India, bringing a nostalgic charm to every bite. The staff is friendly, and the service is prompt, making the experience even more enjoyable. If you’re craving a chaat experience that hits all the right notes, Bikaner Chaat is the place to go!

Great little restaurant, with a great family team. Really enjoyed the food here after someone recommended this place to me. So far one of the top places I've been too for Indian street food dishes! Great pricing and service. See my photos for sizes of portions and menu. Therw is plenty off street parking incl a few spots right in front of the restaurant.
