Great food, best Indian cuisine I’ve had in Aotearoa New Zealand. We discovered this gem by pure chance and had to go back again the next day it was so good! The prices are really good too, especially for the quality. We will be coming back time and time again I’m sure. PS can highly recommend the Chhole bhature (see photo of chickpea curry)

Today we tried their chole Bhature which were extraordinary big in size with apt quality and chole were very delicious and mouth melting with pickled onions. The spices were moderate and taste was like home cooked food. The samosa was also medium spicy and crispy. Do try if you have not yet!.
Amazing food, very unique, recommend trying this very underrated

Amazing customer service, great food with good prices.I recommend the lamb chops, tasted great, fries were cooked perfectly, crunchy on the outside and soft on the inside. Salad was phenomenal with a hint of pomegranate sauce. I will be a regular customer here. Amazing food!
The only Authentic Moroccan cuisine in Auckland … A Master Chef runs the spot ..
Very good food Every one should visit
Was excited to Tried this new place but wasn’t happy with portion size or the sauce used. Meat quality was fine but lacked in quantity. Not worth the price.

What a great little place. I hope they can scale it big one day and be everywhere because I can't have enough of the Mediterranean chicken! Slow cooked to perfection and the spices on the rice is just🤌🏾. The Souvlaki is quite fresh which is surprising because they're generous with the sauce. Good balance of juicy meat and vege. Favourite local place for me at the moment. Would recommend!
The customer service was good. Only one lady was working at the time, and she made it taste amazing. Highly recommend the souvlaki
Hands down some of the best food I’ve had to date, perfectly balanced flavours & food was cooked to perfection! Highly recommend this place, a must try for anyone visiting!

Delicious food! Arguably the best kebab on chips in Auckland . Not the usual thin shaved dry chicken but chunky and juicy with amazing Mediterranean flavours ! Perfectly cooked fries and complementing sauces !

Thanks to Spanian, I am still in search of a good Kebab spot! I have had sahara grill twice now and I must say, this place comes close. First time I had a mixed Souvlaki with large chips. 2nd time I ordered chicken meat on rice. The souvlaki was freaking good! The meat pieces were pretty big and the sahara in-house made sauce went perfectly with it! The souvlaki was the reason why i went back for more. Chicken meat on rice was also very good. Chunky chicken pieces over some tasty yellow rice and salad. I will say this, get the lamb over the chicken, the lamb here is undefeated! The chicken is ok but i have had better chicken elsewhere as it is chicken breast. If it were chicken thigh, might make this place the spot to go to, but for lamb, this place is my go to for now!

Yes, I know it's a fast food joint. The service was pretty average, and the food was...just ok. my salad had freezer burn, so they might want to QC on a daily basis before sending out their food. On the plus side, their bathroom was above average in cleanliness for a fast food place. pleasantly surprised.

50 minutes. For a SMALL bacon cheeseburger combo to be served at this establishment. If you’re going through the drive through you’re sweet. They’ll prioritise you over anyone actually stuck waiting inside. Made me 20 minutes late to kick off. Churrrrr

Was disappointed my food wasn't even hot. Not alot of care went in to making my burger. Staff not overly friendly. 2 staff just sitting at tables on there phones. If it's there break they should have a staff room. Doesn't look good to the public. My table was even clean.
Best Wendy’s ever. Speedy service and the burgers hit different. Would recommend sizing up on the drink (trust me).
Great food fresh burgers and yummy. Nice located in royal oak next to the paknsave. Great parking spot, nice aircon and glare at environment
I am very pleased that Aiko's sushi offers options for vegetarians like me. Highly recommend!

I ordered a platter for my son's birthday party and he absolutely loved it! Their platter looked delightful and they were very tasty! Best place to order a yummy sushi platter, would come back for more on other occassions.
It's a good choice for people who love sushi.
Convenient, affordable, and great for a quick sushi fix
Impressed by supermarket sushi quality.❤️❤️❤️

Very good value, authentic Taiwanese food with generous portions. Good quality home made style, wholesome food. My daughters could not finish had to take away leftovers. Drinks and deserts were very well priced at $5 or $6. Free soup and water. Service is prompt and efficient. Definitely worth coming back. Off street parking fits about 8 cars. Seating, tableware and utensils are basic and tidy. It is a regular lunchroom for workers in this commercial area.

RIB MEDICINAL STEW HOTPOT - recommended dish. Generous portions of vegetables, meat and fish balls inside. The medicinal stew soup has heaps of umami, and it makes you going for more constantly. Very affordable Taiwanese home cook style restaurant. Just over $20 for a hotpot set that would leave two people full. You can tell this place has delicious food from the amount of people dining in!
Great place for a cheap lunch. Great options with some free items like soup and tea. They also have bubble tea.

This is one of my favourite restaurants in Auckland. The food is fantastic and authentic! I can tell they spend lots of time and effort on cooking. The staff is friendly and helpful. I will definitely come back again and frequently! Highly recommended to everyone!

Hsiu Yuan Food Co is truly a hidden gem. I’ve been coming here for the last 30 years, and every visit still feels like a little trip home to Taiwan. The food is incredibly authentic, rich in flavour, generous in portion, and full of heart. You can really taste the care in every dish, and the value for money is amazing. Right now, they’re offering handmade Zongzi (rice dumplings), available in white or purple rice, with meat or vegetarian fillings. I tried them recently and they were absolutely delicious. Soft, savoury, and so comforting, just like the kind you’d find at a street stall back in Taiwan during Dragon Boat Festival. Highly recommend this spot if you're looking for real Taiwanese home cooking that nourishes both your belly and your heart.

Today I bought vegetable samosa and Naan .Food were very tasty and upto the quality. Very friendly staff and they proposed the best combination to us. Very cost effective and I highly recommend this place for those who wish to taste Indian food flavours. For a weekend eat-outing , this is the economical and tasty food plcace for a family.
Curry was watery, no gravy, meat was dry over cooked, they do not ask how spicy would you like your curry ? Naan bread definitely not fresh!
Love butter chicken and naan. Price is affordable and portion is good. Vegetarian option is not bad too.
Best butter chicken in Auckland, taste is perfectly balanced and naan bread if crunchy and nice.

The food is some of the best Indian food I've eaten. The manager is an Indian man who showed some of the best customer service I've seen, asking how my day was and making a small conversation. The portion sizes were large and the price is affordable for what you receive. I'm surprised at how few people there were at the store as this Indian food was better than most Indian food served at expensive restaurants.

I went back after having good memories from a few years ago, but honestly, it was disappointing. Even though it was in the morning and the place was nearly empty, the food took a long time to come out, and the drinks only arrived when we were almost done eating. The food itself was just ok, so I don’t think I’ll be coming back anytime soon. But if you’re simply looking for a quiet café to have a chat, it’s not a bad option.

Food & service was ok some of the rice in the bibimbap tasted like it wasn’t cooked through and the taste was not that great. Their fries and Ice matcha was good though. Overall it’s an ok place, clean and tidy. Dishes on tables are cleared as soon as customers leave which is good.

We hold our business strategy meetings at Oak Eatery, Royal Oak because it's a central meeting location. Wendy was able to suggest some healthy food options from their menu and she recommended we try their tropical and berry smoothies. The smoothies were delicious and refreshing 😋 I'll come back and order the smoothies again. I tried the Morrocan chicken on eggs benedict; it was nice, but I might try something else next time, perhaps the smashed avocado on toast. And my friend had the smoked salmon hash benedict and she enjoyed it. It's a great spot because it's central, convenient, open plan and spacious so it's great for work meetings during breakfast/brunch/lunch and there's a private meeting room that is free to use. Thank you, Ken and Wendy for your help, the meeting space and hospitable 🫶😀

The food was good/average. The menu had a nice selection. The cabinet was filled with nice looking stuff. We ordered the pancake tower, the big oak breakfast, an coffee frappe and a tropical smoothie. The Big Oak Breakfast was a little of a let down. The sausages weren't very grilled, the bread was too thick which was too soft and not very toasted, the parsley topping that was on top was so concentrated on the placement that its all that you could taste. There wasn't anything sauce wise, and no baked beans- so it made the meal feel quite dry. The rest of the food on this big breakfast was okay, but it is a little pilled up on top of each other- it would be nice to have it more spread out. The pancake tower was a little different than you might expect. The tower was of two thick pancakes. the presentation made me think of a souffle pancake- but its actually more cakey, and slightly on the dryer side. The compote and mascarpone were lovely. The seasonal fruits were a good selection. While it tasted good overall the texture of the pancake might not be for everyone- personally I liked it. The coffee frappe was good, with a nice strong coffee taste. The tropical smoothie was very refreshing with a nice zing from the pineapple. Overall it was average for price, the meal was filling, and the staff were nice. The only thing I might add is the tables are VERY sticky! Please take some time maybe before or after hours to thoroughly clean the table tops- it adds to a better experience

Usually not one to leave reviews however our latest experience was very disappointing. Eek! Ordered two dishes and both dishes had items missing from it that were listed on the menu. Ordered an eggs Benedict on house made hash, however there was no hash and replaced with sourdough bread! The other dish we ordered was a big breakfast and the beef mince and mushrooms were left off the dish and I don’t think they substituted it with anything (unless they gave more of what they did put on the plate). When I went up and asked, they said “oh yeah, we don’t have that”. I asked why didn’t the waiter tell us beforehand when we were ordering, they said she forgot. Probably won’t be coming back for a bit, which is a bit unfortunate considering it wasn’t always like this. :( p.s. place was half full
Great food and great prices. Thank you for dinner. It will not be the last time.
First time eating a BBQ pork bun with vegetables ( peas,carrots,corn)in it and the tiniest amount of pork in there.Very disappointing.😩
Quick service and good price.
Good Customer service. Friendly staff. Food is excellent with spice levels. Specially Tandoori Chicken pizza has awesome taste.
I got 2 9inch pizzas for like $20 on door dash and ate every single morsel of each of them. They were the butter chicken ones. Nice asf.
# dangerously delish & hot from the oven Melting goodness Fresh Pizzaboyz epic 1st time ! new recommend # Hillsborough # Carlton St Spicy Beef & Chicken Cranberry 🤭
author_name: A L Y S I V E R S O N

text: amazing food, i’ve been here multiple times, and their food is consistently good. love the beef and kransky pizza, and the curly fries are comforting and warm. i showed up around 10 minutes early, the man at the counter was super kind and asked me to wait just a little longer. the food came out approximately at the exact time i ordered it to be.

Tried Pizza Boys on Hillsborough Rd instead of our usual Hell Pizza. Both my wife and myself were disappointed with the food, which seems in contradiction to other reviews. The jalapeño cheese poppers were not very crispy and many had leaked their cheese, it would also be recommended to mention that they contain sweetcorn as like myself some don’t like sweetcorn. The curly fries were soggy and not a very nice taste. The pizza was average, quite salty and I paid more for a xl larger pizza and it was smaller than my wife’s pizza. Maybe we caught them on a bad day, but probably won’t go back again to confirm either way.
Absolute delight of a place. We had the $25 all you can eat. All fresh food packed with flavour and amazing to eat.

The quality and taste of food good, as was the portion size. The price, economical, the dine in experience, great as there was music playing matching the ambiance. The host was able to explain the dishes and their cooking style on a call when getting take-out. Definitely recommend for delicious Indian chaats, starters, mains.

We have been to Chatori Gali both as a couple and as a big group about 5 times so far. The quality and taste of food has been consistent at all times. Our recent visit was for to try their Chaat Buffet as a group of 13. Everything was tasty. loved their papdi chaat, dahi vada and Vada Pav the most. Although, not part of buffet I love their parathas. They taste home cooked. Only suggestion will be to think of a better way to serve pani puri during buffet to reduce wait time. Overall a great place to eat tasty food and very reasonable prices. Definitely will recommend.

My daughter was asking for pani puri and we found this place. We ordered Pani puri, pav bhaji, papdi chaat, idli sambhar and overall bill was around 35 dollars. Food was amazing, really tasty and service was quick too. If you are craving for Indian street food, do give a try to this place.

I am sharing my experience with chotari galli . I am the regular customer. I like the food , My parents came from Australia . Last Thursday we have a plan to go for a dinner . we check the timing but its shows close . I called and someone pick my call and he said its open till midnight. It takes 30 min from my house . we go and see its close and we call again and he said sorry its close today, and i said you told me its open today and he said i forget . we are very disappoint for this service. we are the regular customer and we go first time with our family . This was my very bad experience.

Donut burger was mindblowingly good - recommend going for Hot if you handle spicy food. Extra hot is tolerable but not as tasty. Tenders were thick and juicy. Mac and cheese were great - not your basic m&c. Coleslaw was great - not too sweet, not too sour, just right. Highly recommend the donut burger.

Let's start with the negative because it's better to end on a positive 😂 1: atmosphere got a generous 4 I mean it's in an old food court BUT this doesn't take away from the food! 2: why is this not a franchise?! It needs to be 😋 Positives 1: food was freeeesh and hot and crispy!! One of the tastiest fried chicken tenders I've ever had and delicious sauce to match (we got comeback sauce & ranch). Chips had a yummy salt on them too. We got the Nashville deluxe burger & added cheese (prob should've added bacon too not sure if that's an option) we got mild and it had the perfect amount of spice! Very tasty lunch super filling. Please bring a store closer to Pukekohe, although I don't mind the drive, closer would be better 😉

The Tender Box, ordered at the heat level just below their spiciest "Dare Devil" (based on standard tiered spice scales like Normal, Medium, Hot, and Dare Devil), delivered a noticeable but manageable kick. The spice hit with a warm, tangy tolerable burn that lingered without setting my mouth on fire. It’s tailored for those who enjoy a bit of heat but aren’t chasing a sweat-inducing challenge, which feels in line with tastes that often lean less extreme. The tenders themselves stayed crispy and juicy, and the spice coating didn’t overpower the chicken’s flavor. it’s a safe but satisfying choice, though Dare Devil might be the move for a real test. Paired with a creamy dips, it balanced nicely. Would order again but might go full Dare Devil for a bolder experience!

This place is epic. Amazing chicken, top notch Mac n cheese and awesome chicken tenders. I’m not usually a fan of chicken tenders in a burger over a chicken fillet, but they’re so crispy and a good amount of heat, so can definitely appreciate these burgers. Highly recommend.

I came here on a random Thursday but I did make two bus rides just to try this plc out. Defs worth the trip! The place is inside the foodcourt and it definitely seems new. The self-kiosk by the counter is a great touch and perfect for introverts or for those who prefer little social interaction like myself. I did visit FOR the mozzarella sticks however it was sold out. Oh well, will have to come back for sure! I j got a simple Loaded Mac n Chicken Fries and added extra comeback sauce on the side. However I didn't really need it bcos they go crazy on the sauce and it was extra creamy with the macaroni and cheese. I think the chicken portion was decent too and it was a perfect snack size for 1 person! I even got a soft drink and the total came upto $16.40 (which is crazy good and even cheaper without all the additions I made) I like that you can change up the spice level for the chicken burgers and tenders so I'll make use of that when I return :)
Good cheap option, nice sushi but did not taste fresh, the rice was bland.

Im a happy-go-lucky guy who's always on the hunt for great food at even better prices! Luckily, I stumbled upon this amazing sushi spot that's become my go-to destination. The prices are absolutely terrific, and the options? Endless! From classic rolls to unique creations, everything I've tried has been downright delicious. If you're a fellow sushi lover like me, do yourself a favor and give this place a try. You won't regret it!

Ordered their combo deal from uber eats. Chicken was tough, noodles had 5 strands in them, the rest was tasteless. Not impressed and would not recommend. Makes you wonder if the food was left out all day.

Ordered a mixed starter thing, claimed to be an assortment of the snacky type food ... Received what felt like old sushi ... 12pc of it ... Not the snack type food that was stated in the description . Chucked both of these containers out, as one was maybe some sort of fish ? The other set was chicken or pork, I tried one of the rolls and it was just dry and overcooked and not enjoyable at all . Ordered the jumbo prawn box, photo showed prawns and prawn sushi which the prawns were good the sushi was salmon which nobody ate. The salad that comes with it, is a coleslaw mix no dressing and was a tablespoons worth. The udon soup that came with it ,tasted weird . So wasted that too. Chicken sushi my partner ordered was average. The only good thing that came from $70 worth of food was the miso soup. After seeing on Uber eats everyone's positive thumbs up etc and what looked like great food and great quality, I'm annoyed that we have wasted so much money and food. Have put a complaint in with Uber eats, I definatly wouldn't recommend this place if your ordering online as they just give you sloppy seconds and what seems to be left over after the day. I don't like to complain on food places but I've never not enjoyed anything from a plate, there's normally something to enjoy but this whole order was a waste of money !!! $70 and the cheap cup of miso soup was the only thing worth consuming.

Enjoyed our first order of prawns 👍😊 The battered snapper cooked so well and big chunky pieces 😁 a hit with added Korean sauce 🎯 so yum Went back third visit requested salmon sashimi in poke bowl, pricey for quantity minimal salad considering rice was not added and salmon had a bit of an unusual after taste
poor service. Waited for 20 mins for uber order and when asked no ans was given and staff ignored asked question. Please train them or hire someone who can reply to questions asked.
Great service. Credit to Taylah
Chili oil scrambled egg - a nice attempted variation. Not too spicy and soft melt in mouth egg with additional flavor. Croque Madame - generous portion and crispy toast. Good place for brunch.

Perfect place for your morning coffee. Friendly staff, really good coffee and a gas fireplace - exactly what you want on a cold morning. I didn’t try them - but all the snacks and slices looked homemade and I bet they are yummy 😋 Something to try next time.

The little cafe that could! 😀 Stopped here on our coffee and cake tour of the North while heading south from Auckland on our way to Hamilton. We were happy first and foremost to find this establishment open. It seems that many local small businesses were also closed for the Friday after having the 1st and 2nd off. Service was prompt and professional, and happily accommodated a special request at what seemed like a busy time. Food and drinks arrived very quickly, and exactly as ordered - special request and all. Coffee was perfect. Cake was delicious and fresh. If we lived locally this would definitely become a favourite place to get coffee and cake.

I went to little urban recently, and it was really amazing. The place felt cozy and welcoming from the moment I walked in. The people working there were super nice and knew a lot about the food. They helped me pick some great dishes. Everything I tried was delicious, and you could tell they put a lot of effort into making the food just right. The menu had a lot of different choices, so there's something for everyone. The portions were good, not too big or small. Overall, little urban 🔥 is a fantastic place. The food, service, and atmosphere all make it a place I'd recommend. I'm looking forward to going back and trying more tasty dishes.
Lovely local café very popular, food delicious coffee hot and service friendly n professional..

We ordered the Wat Tan Hor and Two Meat (Roast Duck and Roast Pork) Combination Rice to share. Good sized portions and reasonably priced. Food came out fast and the lady came around to top up on the Chinese tea. They have tables for up to four people and also a couple of bigger tables

Rice was nice but had bone fragments in it. Chicken was tender. Duck was just bones, no rich brown sauce that's it's cooked in on rice. Wontons looked extremely juicy and plump, filling was smooth, with a nice mouth feel. Unfortunately, there was no flavor , soup was hot water with a splash of sesame oil, and cabbage was sweet and fresh. Sad meal

We love this place. If you want delicious and reasonably priced Chinese, look no further! We had a mixed stir fry noodle dish and wontons. Heaps for two people - $27. Affordable, friendly staff, free Chinese tea and yummy food - what more could you want?! 😋
Walked passed a trillion times and finally went in. Food ok less salty. Price average. Service was tremendous! The business was very good as the crispy pork sold out while we ate

Ever wondered who decided to hang ducks - heads on and roasted, BBQ pork with the reddish/pink tinge and other mouth watering meats in a row by the restaurant window; don’t have the answer to that, but it was sure a master stroke of marketing❗️Visited this humble eatery in Royal Oak with family recently and recommend it to those who are after some affordable and delicious Cantonese food that come in large portions. My highlight of the night was the Steamed Whole Fish🐟, with a small amount of soy sauce, ginger and spring onion added - the light seasoning brings out the sweetness of the fish & this is how you best cook fresh seafood and let the flavours of the primary ingredient shine 👏👏.
Great little spot dogs are filling, pickle is taste and food came out fast. I would 100% bring the kids back again.
It's not bad for what it is. The super spice chicken was not spicy at all, which was disappointing. But it was tasty and I enjoyed it.

We wanted to check them out to see what the hype was all about. I've had Korean hotdogs before and these guys are pretty good. The chocolate Korean dog was 10/10 the others were between 5/10 and 8/10. The Kids really like the food here.
LOVE IT, Honestly the best! !!My Korean obsession of wanting to try one of those hot-dogs has been satisfied. Love the mighty hot-dog place at Royal Oak NZ and will be coming again soon! 💛🌭

Nothing wrong with the location, decor, or seating as it just fine and the self-service sauces were helpful. But, compared to other Korean hotdogs I've had, this just isn't hitting the mark for me personally. It's still okay, but the hotdog sausage itself isn't doing anything for me and the potato outside is so-so even with sauces. The cheese filled ones I'd say are better and the chocolate ones are definitely worth of splitting with someone bc those are so (deliciously) sugary. Overall though, I think I'm looking for the korean hot dog and double batter that is fluffier and lighter overall - like more refreshing than savoury.

Really disappointing. I’ve been a huge fan of Sal’s, but this was the worst slice I’ve ever had. It was dry, flavorless, and had almost no sauce. The only staff member there was wearing airpods and looked like he couldn’t care less. This experience completely changed how I feel about this place. Not coming back.

Enjoyed our pizza order, pepperoni and Buffalo. We also ordered hot and original Buffalo chicken wings with ranch and blue cheese dip. It was all good but hopefully Sal's would give us a full tub of the dip next time as we noticed it was only filled halfway unlike before. Also a suggestion, maybe they should not include celery sticks that are not fresh. It doesn't really look appealing. We really like fresh Vegetables. Thanks Sal's Pizza Royal Oak!
Delicious pizzas and garlic knots and unique interior design. Clean restaurant and excellent customer service. Favourite aesthetic is the parmesan shaker and tall nyc building wallpaper and live TV.

Was ignored for 2 min at the counter despite the order being ready and waiting on top of the oven. The person before me had the same experience. The pizza was supposed to be a double pepperoni (topping) but had less toppings than a single. Average experience overall

Sal’s never disappoints and has quickly become my go-to pizza joint. The Royal Oak store is great and the staff there really know what they’re doing. Thanks team! Hamish Dorrington Kakapo Business Sales

This is myself and my partners favourite place to get katsu curry. It’s delicious and addictive. We highly recommend the tofu katsu curry with extra tofu, it's my partner’s go-to and a fantastic option for vegetarians. I also like the prawn katsu curry but honestly all of them would be good! The service is amazing and the person who answers the phone is always so kind and friendly. We go so much he knows our order once he hears us. Highly recommend this place!

The salmon teriyaki donburi was tasty and made with fresh ingredients with a generous serving of salmon and bonus egg. Efficient service with complimentary Japanese tea (roasted corn which was a very nice flavour). Highly recommended.
The service is really good and I enjoy the hot tea. Hope to visit there with friends next time
Awesome food and service! The staff are very kind. The food, especially salmon, is very fresh. Chicken fried udon was not salty and tasted healthy. Super recommend for family dinner time!

Went here for a catch up with my brother looking for somewhere delicious in Royal Oak and gotta say it did not disappoint. In fact one of the most delicious little cheap and easy Japanese restaurants I’ve been to Auckland. Will definitely be back, so good. Yum, try the fried noodle..

Love the steam rice. Mushroom chicken is smooth and taste like home. All customers were welcome with awesome warm Chinese tea. Almost every other table ordered Sticky Rice in Lotus Leaves, must come and try next time

It says "emperor's soup" in Chinese so soup is the must to order. With plenty of selection of Cantonese foods and deserts you can have it all in one meal. Very light flavor, I bet it's pretty good for body healing. Great location besides Royal oak mall, easy parking.

Nice little restaurant located in the busy Royal Oak shopping complex. It has been here for years, came here long time ago and thought I should give it another try. Should be husband and wife running this place, their restaurant's name in Chinese is actually "Emperor's soup" so I ordered the soup to try out. It is really good taste of the soup, no doubt about it. However, the beef stew rice I ordered was way too salty!! I haven't tried the other dishes but you should really avoid this. Price wise it's the usual drill, not too expensive. Recommended to come here for the soup!!
Authentic home cooked Chinese food. We couldn't figure out what region it came from - it was mostly steamed - but quite an interesting - and affordable - experience.
The food was pretty good here though I probably wouldn't go so far as to say it was amazing. You get good value for your money so it's definitely worth a try.
Change of name but still the best toasted sandwiches
Closed. Gone.

Panda Noodles is one of the best Chinese eateries I've been to in Auckland! Very few Chinese food places have both excellent Chinese dishes and European takeaways like Panda Noodles. BBQ pork fried rice, Chicken egg foo Yong and honey chicken noodles are amazing! And the Chicken deluxe burger and steak and egg burger are some of the best burgers I've ever had! Excellent service from the lovely lady with a big smile and friendly nature and atmosphere is great too, very welcoming and nice set up for dining in. This is now our official go-to takeout now, and we can't wait to go there again soon!

We ordered the Singapore Fried Noodles, Fried Kaui Teow and 20 pcs Chicken Nibbles. Not a fun of the Fried Kaui Teow. The Singapore Fried noodles was ok but we were looking for the usual Singapore Fried Vermicelli taste, their Singapore noodles lacks the curry flavor. The Chicken Nibbles are bang for the buck. Crunchy and doesn't lack flavor. We air fried the left over nibbles for dinner and air frying it made it better. Will definitely come back to try other noodles and definitely the nibbles will be our new go to.

Pretty awesome place for a quick dine in or takeaway. I just googled place to get fried rice and was so happy I did checked this place out which was conveniently located where I am. Ordered combination fried rice, crispy chicken bits and bbq pork buns...man it was so delicious 😋. The lady at the counter was very friendly and had the best smiling face I have seen today. Will definitely be back to sample more of what they have to offer.

I have recently moved into the area and came to this place due to its google reviews and they do not disappoint. Everything that I’ve ordered so far (combination fried noodle, prawn fried rice, chicken nibble and chips) I’ve enjoyed! And with my first visit I was blown away at the customer service. Highly recommend. Thank you for the yummy food

Panda Noodle is hands down one of my favourite takeaway spots – a true hidden gem! I've been a regular for a while now, and every visit confirms why I keep coming back. The food is consistently fresh, flavourful, and generously portioned. Whether I’m craving Honey chicken fried rice, Hawaiian Chicken burger, or one of their tasty rice dishes, everything is always spot on. The staff are warm, friendly, and remember your usual order – it's those little personal touches that make a big difference. Service is quick and efficient, even during busy times, and they always manage to keep the quality top-notch. If you’re looking for delicious, comforting food with great service and value, I can’t recommend Panda Noodle highly enough. Support your local and give them a try – you won’t be disappointed!

This restaurant has the most freshly cooked meal’s without any preservatives and msg. Their Briyani was first class and my kid loved the cheese naan with lamb curry ❤️ Keshab was awesome with his hospitality and service towards customers even it’s my first time here this beautiful service and delicious food making up to visit this restaurant frequently in future. Thank you for the good food and service
We’ve been coming here for over 20 years. Always 10/10 Food Service Ambience
Fantastic. Great value for lunch. $19 for delicious butter chicken (I recommend between medium and hot spice level!) and a basket of garlic naan. Would definitely return!

Wow amazing experience I would say ! This is the 2nd time we visit curry leaf after so many years and the food is so delicious, the table setting, music , atmosphere and how the food is presented all very good 😊 Mango lassi is ok a bit too creamy Nann bread garlic also very yummy The Lamb shank is so tender and good size portion, the lamb madras medium also delicious, the duty manager is super friendly and great customer service, would definitely visit soon in our dine out
One of my most favourite Indian restaurant, love the food ambiance and service by Keshav, always smiling and food is too good. Do try when you are in Onehunga, you won’t get disappointed.

Smaller restaurant than some. My bastard came with lots of lettuce stalk, and no Avacado. I only get the blasted bastard for the healthy avocado so a bit sad about that. Interesting enough it made it easier to eat with no slimy green stuff causing the rest of the ingredients to slip out. Ellerslie can be hard to get parks but was parking right outside today.
Great service, friendly staff. My order arrived under 10 minutes. Vegan options. Good, fresh food.
$7.90 for a carton of half filled kumara chips is diabolical, let alone two, and unfortunately common here. I love burgerfuel but this is such a rip off
A fantastic branch of Burger Fuel after original Ponsonby. Well cooked. Enough sauce. Super clean premise. Very polite staffs. Family welcome space. Highly recommend to all. 100 thumbs up.

Good BurgerFuel. Food is pretty good and service is always top notch. Bit more pricey but for what you're getting it's worth it. The beef burgers are always worth it but the chicken burgers can be hit and miss. The Kumara fries however are the best you can get anywhere. Been having them since I was a kid and will always love them.

Wow ! After such a long time I had a great vegetarian burger… Quality and Quantity both were great… definitely it’s worth to try their burger.. also want to mention staff is very welcoming and friendly…. See you soon guys ♥️😊

I had the best experience at burger Wisconsin Onehunga yesterday , their focus on the deliciousness on burgers and quality of ingredients are top of notch . The patty was perfectly cooked , juicy and flavorful. Front house staff were friendly and helpful . Thank you keep up the good work will be visiting soon again!
Nothing fancy atmosphere wise, BUT the food more than makes up for that! Burgers were fresh, juicy and so delicious!
Burgers just weren't good. The fries were unsalted, but they put salt packets in the bag so it seems like maybe this is deliberate.
a Proper Real Burger Experience! the portion was quite large not those smashed burgers trending now

Generally, we are pleased with the food offered by this vendor however, the dumplings were not fried and were absolutely stuck to the box and paper it was served in which ruined it. They were still incredibly gooey - very disappointed
Second time buying the family tray and it didn’t disappoint. Especially the sweet and sour tasted so good it’s the best sweet and sour I’ve eaten

Best Chicken Wings Out Onehunga and surrounding areas, all three flavours are great especially the curry wings (photo), Juicy and succulent everytime and hardly or ever dry. The burgers here are generous with their portions & the fish is always battered to perfection & the fries are always salted perfectly! everything is always fried till their just the right crunchy! My go to always ✨☺️ + reasonably priced considering its in central auckland, you can feed the whole family for less than what you pay for a bucket of chicken at other places 👀
Disappointing, absolutely the WORSE wonton's ever. All shell with half a teaspoon of overdone dry filling!

I ordered the chicken fried rice, chicken chow mein, and the $15 combo, which included fish, small chips, a hot dog, two fritters, and a sausage. The food was hot, which I appreciated, but unfortunately, everything tasted quite bland and lacked flavour. The vegetables in the chow mein were undercooked, which didn’t help the overall experience. I usually love Chinese food , the kind that makes you go "mmm" and "ahhh, that's so yum", but this didn’t hit the mark at all. I won’t be returning. Maybe it's just me, so you might want to try it for yourself, but personally, it’s a no from me.

Unfortunately our food wasn’t the best. We order French toast x2 and one with bacon. Bacon didn’t look cooked at all. The Brioche toast was like pancakes and not toast and covered in so much butter. I won’t be coming back to this place as I’ve not got a tummy bug from the food.

It’s very good. You need to pay attention to the roadside parking space for 30 minutes. There is a parking lot behind the cafe. The food is delicious and large, and the clerk is also very enthusiastic. The coffee tastes good. We all like it very much. It is suitable for children and has children‘s meals.

The food here is always great, but the service can be very slow, especially on weekends. It feels like the café is consistently understaffed, and the staff seem overworked and stressed. I really feel for them—they're doing their best. Might avoid weekends next time. Hope the owner can consider hiring more support for the team.
Microwaved, chewy, bland, $7 at it best, definelty not worth the $12 tag, good customer service and ambience, hopefully their menu food taste better

What a lovely place. From the moment we walked in we were made welcome and given a menu straight away. Our server was very attentive and makes a decent coffee too (definitely a bonus). The staff are so kind too - I witnessed 2 of them helping an older gentleman into his chair. The food is lovely and hot. On our most recent visit we had creamy mushrooms and a breakfast buttie. I loved how the house rosti was shaped like a birds nest. The house soda is also very refreshing. I am definitely going back.

I came here for breakfast with friends . I had the Big Breakfast which was delicious. I also had a flat white coffee . The service was average unfortunately very abrupt in manner not particularly friendly and obliging. The atmosphere was good with tables outside with views of the Main Street and Ellerslie community centre .

Absolutely furious with the experience at this Columbus Coffee. I called ahead and was told they do free birthday coffee. Drove all the way there on my birthday, only to be told I need to show the voucher on the app—which was nowhere to be found. I showed my ID clearly proving it’s my birthday, but the staff still REFUSED to honour it. Instead, I was told to call customer support, which goes straight to voicemail with a message saying it’ll take 48 hours to respond—seriously? The Philipinal staff had the nerve to say I could take my ID and try another store for my “free” coffee—what a joke! Do they expect me to waste more time and petrol just to maybe get a coffee elsewhere? To make things worse, I NEVER received the 2-for-1 voucher when I first downloaded the app, as promised. This is pathetic customer service, and I’ve had enough. Columbus Coffee is blacklisted permanently. I’m telling all my friends and family to avoid this brand entirely. Absolutely disgraceful

Been here,a few times now. Lovely and Bright Ambiance. Love the Art Surrounding their Walls Inside. Beautiful Set Up. Kind and Welcoming Smiles. Fast and Efficient Service. I Loved the Big Breakfast. My Daughter Loved her Kids Meal,whatever it May of been. Thank you Columbus Coffee in Ellerslie.

The food tasted good, staff were nice, restaurant was clean and had cute decor and atmosphere. But what is this wrap... the first half was more full, but still had an empty part at the end. Maybe if I hadn't had it toasted in a panini press it would have looked different, but for $12.50 its quite disappointing to see how empty it is.

I ordered a pork taco for lunch - $24. The few bits of pork that were in the taco were fat, it was just disgusting. It was meant to have coleslaw it was just a bit of cabbage. Very disappointing, will not be returning. Feel ripped off for a meal well below average!

“Onehunga Domino’s: Better Than the Reviews Say” Despite all the one-star rants, my experience at Domino’s Onehunga has been nothing but chef’s kiss. Food? Always hot. Timing? Always spot on. Order accuracy? Never missed a beat — even the extra chili flakes show up like VIP toppings. This branch might not have dine-in tables (yup, takeaway only — no romantic pizza dates here), but hey, there’s plenty of free parking right outside, and that’s half the battle won already. Been here a few times now, and not once did I walk out angry or cheese-deprived. If this is the “bad” branch, then I must be getting lucky every time. 🍕 "Logan was here… and got extra chili flakes like a boss."

I’ve ordered from Domino’s Onehunga multiple times and they never disappoint. The food is absolutely excellent – always fresh, hot, and full of flavor. You can really taste the quality in every bite. The service is outstanding too. Staff are friendly, efficient, and clearly care about getting things right. And the delivery driver is awesome – always punctual, polite, and professional. It’s the kind of experience that makes you want to keep coming back. Highly recommend this branch – they’re doing everything right Am New Technologies Penrose

Worst experience! I ordered Spicy Garlic naan pizza and found no spring onions on it (mentioned in the description that it comes with spring onions), pizza was cold and dry. The store is getting worse with every passing day… I literally want my money back this time as this has happened multiple times but I never made a fuss about it!!! Just wasting my money everytime only to give this store another chance.

I just picked up the world's worst cheesy garlic bread. The bread was not even cooked through. First bite and you can taste the dough.😳 It's a fast food pizza chain that is supposed to know their garlic bread. I was thoroughly disappointed. Simply terrible. 🤢Used to be my go to place to get garlic bread and cheesy garlic pizza for kids .no more 😠

Ordered pizza at 11, scheduled to be delivered at 11:45. The pizzas arrived 50mins later than the scheduled time and both were wrong. I ordered two vegan pizzas, one to be thin crust. The wrong pizza was made thin crust, and also had bacon on it, along with pineapple and mushroom (completely wrong pizza). Not the first time the order has been made incorrectly from this store, but this one takes the cake and deserves the review. Onehunga store is always lax. I’d recommend Mt Eden store any day of the week instead
We order the spice bag and the shepherd’s pie. The portions were good and the food was delicious

I visited this pub for lunch and was pleased to see they had Guinness on tap—a great start! I ordered the jalapeño balls and a sirloin steak with mushroom sauce. The steak was perfectly cooked, and the mushroom sauce was outstanding—definitely the highlight of the meal. The staff were all kind and attentive, which added to the overall experience. Highly recommend this place for a relaxed and delicious meal.

We moved to Auckland only a couple months ago, but this pub has already become our go-to spot. Very cozy but lively atmosphere with plenty of TVs to watch matches. Very friendly and efficient service. Food is quite good and filling too. We’ll definitely be back!

First time here and we loved it. Food was delicious and piping hot just the way we like it. Steak was amazing perfect color on the inside . Service was lovely as well, staff were very attentive and came to check up on us throughout our meal which was great. Price is very reasonable for generous portions. We will be back .
Big servings sizes, really good flavour and an awesome first table experience. The chicken and mushroom pie is highly recommended. Would come back.
We had a company party there. Decent food and atmosphere. Especially loved the seasonal drink- which was Mulled Wine. It was just the way I like it.

We went to the Union Post for a very nice atmosphere and location. Me and my two boys all ordered the Sunday roast chicken, and the chicken was the most driest, I never knew you could make chicken so dry! And it had an awful taste like old overcooked chicken. Lucky for the Chinese takeaway next door as we were still hungry so grabbed a piece of snapper each. It turned into an incredibly expensive dinner! Usually I give 5 stars for this place but they had a shocker in the kitchen last night!

Sunday roast here, very good. Lamb tasted good, all the roasted veges are good and the big yorkshire pudding, crisp outside, honestly cant go wrong ordering this. Cheeseburger, very average, meat was dryish and although burger was decent size, quality wasn't there for the price. Drinks were kinda pricey but overall if coming here for a social event and happen to be on a Sunday. Get the sunday roast.
Occasionally, you find a pub where you can just tell that the staff just really care about what they are doing. Super friendly, great atmosphere and more importantly a really good burger.
Excellent! This shop is impressed with attentive service, nice atmosphere, and delicious food. The appetizer and main course were standouts. Overall, it is recommended.

Such a beautiful restaurant resided on the top of the hill of Cornwall park. The coffee and food is amazing! Both the presentation and the taste 10/10. It’s well priced and delicious. The European guy server was funny and friendly. We enjoyed our lunch here very much. Highly recommend!

Relatively busy Saturday lunch time, table of 7 - drinks took 15mins (fizz & coffee) no access for prams on second level so we carried pram up, also made it hard for two 80yrs olds to get up there as lower was full. Food was ordered took 35 minutes for it all to come out (fair, it was busy) missed one plate of food - took another 15 mins for that one.. 2 x sides were missed - had to ask two waiters for that. The extra maple syrup & side of tomatoes took so long to come we had practically finished eating. French toast was nice but as stated - lacking syrup. would be great if maple syrup was offered on side. All in all, food was mediocre, mushroom toast was gigantic serving, sloppy stracciatella and cold food. 2 out of 7 of us enjoyed food, rest will not go back. Would expect better from a high end Bistro in Cornwall Park.

We went to the bistro today. We tried the duck spring roll, eggplant schnitzel, and market fish, and honestly, everything was even better than I expected (and I already had high hopes!). About the duck spring roll, I almost missed it at first because “spring roll” was written in big letters, but “duck” was in smaller text. So glad I spotted it because it was absolutely delicious—juicy, flavorful, and paired perfectly with the pickled veggies on the side. Definitely a must-try! Even though duck was really good, my favorite was the eggplant schnitzel. It felt so light and healthy, and the sauce wasn’t too much. I loved eating it with the chickpeas—such a good combo. The market fish was amazing too. Everything on the plate just worked so well together. looking forward to the next time.

I ate at the bistro with my family recently and found the food to be delicious. However the service at the establishment was sub par, our orders took 40 mins to come and the waiter come back to ask us what our orders were 20 mins after already taken it. For a high class establishment, I did expect more and while the staff were polite, it was annoying to see other people who arrived later than us recieve their meal whilst we waited. Not sure I will come here again anytime soon.

Best🥩🍔Juicy crispy steak, creamy potatoes, jammy french toast, cheesy burger! Everything is done to perfection. 🍰 The attitude of the owner is rather arrogant, so only come if u have a reservation or else u may be booted. Other than that, they have delicious food.
I was hesitant to make an order of special fried rice when I saw bacon, but it was great! Just like the classic takeaway taste, Generous Portion size, good selection of meats and nice wok hei.
Love this place! Had the most delicious Benny with chicken and cranberry! Chocolate banana cake! 5 stars!

Local takeaway. Ordered over $100 last night for the family. Mom and wife love the chicken burgers. The fish were nice size pieces. The egg foo young too much peas and carrots. Squid rings were nice, oysters were ok. Banana not sweet enough. Garlic chips smell super nice. Service: 4/5 Environment; 3/5 Presentation: 4/5 Food Quality: 3/5 Food Quantity: 4/5 Price per person: $20
Very floury batter on the hot dogs. Chips meagre for $4 (see photo) fish bland not fresh, like it was frozen and heated. Would not recommend or ever go there again. Was not worth $28.

This is my local, and I've had great food and service there, consistently. I recommend the classic triumvirate: chicken chow mein, combination fried rice, and sweet and sour pork - delish, and lots of veggies.
Jaspreet Kaur is the BEST, absolutely made my night! Was so lovely and kind. I’m in LOVE!!!!!!!! Whatever you’re paying her is NOT enough! Give her a raise right now!!!

I had never been to Charlie baxters but took a chance and it has become one of my regular spots since. Jaspreet is the friendliest bartender I have had the pleasure of being served by. She was engaging, chatty, very helpful with drink selection. When she is on duty, I could not recommend this bar enough!!

Super lovely bar! There’s space out back to sit outside during the summer months. The staff are super friendly, I got to taste the cider before I got a pint and they even custom made me a poutine! Would definitely come back.

Good selection of beer but tastes like the metal taps they came from. They forgot our pizza order and then it was doused in basil sauce. Cheese and tomato sauce should be star of margarita pizza. Very poor selection of non alcoholic drinks (yes it's a bar, but think of the sober drivers). Only saving grace was the store bought Jalapeno poppers they served.
Jazz was the most amazing host , she was so welcoming and the best server I’ve ever had. She deserves a raise and should the highest paid bartender of all time.

On a recent business trip to Auckland I stayed in Ellerslie where I found central + kitchen in the business park. I enjoyed my breakfast enough for a second visit soon after. On the first occasion I opted for the Smashed Avocado and on my second visit I chose the Creamy mushrooms on Sourdough with a poached egg. The food was tasty, fresh and well presented. The service at the counter was quick and helpful even though they were busy on both mornings. If you are near the Ellerslie business park at Great South Road then a stop at central+ kitchen is a great option for breakfast or lunch

I only ordered cabinet food but everything was delicious. There was a good variety of choices and would love to return to try some more. Would’ve preferred if the prices were displayed. Edit: This place used to be one of my favourite cafes so I gave it a five star review but I think management has changed so quality and standards of food, service and everything have dropped. Tables used to always be full but now it’s not busy at all. Food was boring so I didn’t even bother taking photos. So the uploaded pictures are from 2 years ago.

To start off, I'm actually surprised that this place ever gets any bad reviews. Everything about this place is great. The food is very good, with high quality ingredients. It also came out really fast which I can appreciate for a to go order! I've tried many things in their menu and bakery - no complaints at all. Staff was really nice and kept the place running smoothly which is impressive considering how busy they get. Lots of professionals from the area seem to come here to do business meetings or just grab a bite to eat so I know it has to be consistently good to attract that kind of clientele. Honestly I feel that Auckland needs more locations like this. Their Coffee is also delicious. Give this place a try.

Went on a Saturday morning. Plenty of free parking. Love the fresh flowers on the table. Service was attentive and flawless. The menu is pretty standard Kiwi Café fare. Chai latte looked and tasted beautiful, the eggs Benedict were good as well. Slices from the cabinet were taken home to my kids and scoffed within minutes.
The food was delicious. A great variety to choose from. Quiet when I arrived but all tables full by lunchtime. Staff friendly and helpful. Would go there again if I was in the area.

I could not rave about this place enough. Every time we get takeaways we always end up here! The sweet and sour chicken is my absolute favourite. Portions are HUGE and such good value for money. I made the rice at home but their fried rice goes so well too. Best takeaways around Onehunga 🫶
Literally one of our favourite takeaway places! The foods is delicious and portions are generous, we always order their sweet and sour chicken and wontons. Their stuff is friendly too
Good fish n chips. Very fresh! At first I thought $11 was too much for one piece of (regular) fish and an order of chips, but it was worth it!

Hi we are sorry to say we think we may have placed an order at your takeaways by mistake last night and picked it up in Rothesay Bay where they had lost our order so we reordered …. We had no idea there were 2 Dragon horse takeaways 😫 A good idea to stop this happening again could be to say the area of your shop before your takeaways name , when you answer the phone ? Good luck stopping this happening again.
They service and food was okay. But quantity was not great. I spend $33 on a combo which included $3 chips so I asked to add another $3 but it looked like one scoop of chips.

I’ve ordered from Hell Pizza Ellerslie a few times without issue, but last night was a disaster. Both my partner and I woke up in the early hours with a serious stomach bug—body aches and other symptoms I won’t go into. This was really bad. I’m not usually one to leave negative reviews, but this experience has left us feeling awful. I’d like an explanation for what went wrong. I’ll be reaching out once I’m feeling better, but after this, I don’t think I’ll be ordering again. The lamb shank tasted off and something didn't seem right about it. I'm really disappointed.

Been to a fair few Hell Pizza branches this one was a tad… off? Still great recipes and tastes but I got Th Beast which is the same amount of dough stretched thin but you are charged a little extra for toppings… well they must have missed that memo because I had a few bare patches. My partner says his pizza was also so not the best example of hell pizza he’s had. Some communication issues with orders and names also. Overall still good pizza made quickly but just a tad lacking.
Pizza good, but long wait considering it was a phone order. It was Friday 13th, possibly extra busy.

Can I just say! I order frequently from this branch and you guys are THE BEST! Your delivery people are always the loveliest people I have ever met and always come down my long driveway. Uber eats will always wait in their car but Hells always delivers straight to the door. Thank you to your super friendly delivery team!!!!

We have been getting Hells Pizza from this store for many years and they used to be amazing but slowly going downhill. The last pizza we got was probably the worst pizza I have ever eaten. The bbq sauce we had ordered was non existent and there was almost no sauce on the base making it dry and it tasted like cardboard. It put us off pizza completely will definitely think before ordering again.
Lovely place, delicious food and good service! They serve delicious $15 lunch deals and their curries have always been delicious. 👌🏽
Excellent customer service and divine hospitality. Delicious food and unique Indian interior design. I ordered the $15.99 lunch special mild butter chicken meal.
I highly recommend this restaurant. The ambiance is welcoming, clean and tidy. The staff are so nice and friendly.Thank you Urban India Ellerslie.

One of the best Indians we’ve been to in Auckland. Ordered a Mixed Platter for 2 and Chicken Saag. Both were excellent, the naan bread was also cooked perfectly. Service was attentive and friendly. A really enjoyable experience.

Indian restaurant in Ellerslie. A real gem of a restaurant. Can't fault any aspect of this place. The food was delicious, fresh and tasty and the service was very good. We were a party of 11 and all our meals were made within a reasonable time from ordering. The decor really adds to the experience. I look forward to going back when I'm in the country and in the mood for great quality Indian cuisine.
The customer service was good. The burger tasted tasted ok.

This place is a joke. For $8. This is what I got served today. The lack of service or food quality shows that people who work at McDonald’s don’t care! I would have expected a bed of greens and have the courtesy to spread the mayo.

Ordered breakfast combos, and waited and waited and waited over 10 minutes for our food, while 2 others who ordered after me got their food before me, granted their ordered was small but seriously I thought first in first served, when I said I had waited over 10 minutes next minute food was ready. Not happy, previous times I have had items missing off the order, but because I had driven home, just couldn't be stuffed. Seriously McDonalds you need to be better

It was early hours 6:25am, misty of the Kings birthday(holiday) The parking terms and rules upon entering in the dark was not seen. We had coffee not the greatest McCafé coffee and some breakfast. The staff never mentioned once that we were in a parking enforcement area and that there was a time limit.A few days later we received a penalty fine in the mail, which I am appealing.I would not recommend going there unless you are picking up something on the go.

Swung by here and what I noticed was the 2 young lads at the drive through has lovely smiles. The burger was the best I had but fries could improve. Dont often go Maccas so to actually enjoy it was a treat

I ordered pizza this afternoon. I found a scrubber in it. This was quite concerning, as I did not expect such an item in my food. I understand that mistakes can happen, but food safety is very important. I wanted to bring this to your attention so you can look into the matter and ensure it doesn’t happen again. I would appreciate it if you could address this issue and let me know how you plan to prevent such incidents in the future. I look forward to your response.

Shout out to the guy (sorry didn’t get your name) working all alone today 11:30am at Pizza Hut Ellerslie… Dude was all alone but had all the orders ready on time and worked with such efficiency and speed. That guy deserves a raise or at the very least pay him double the wage for doing 2 people’s work today. All the stars for that dude!!! Mad respect 🙌

Wish I had read the reviews prior to ordering. Funnily enough I had a similar experience to a recently left review which the branch had replied to and said they would address - clearly not? Got home to find the pizza flavours were incorrect. Spoke to the manager over the phone who said to come back & they’ll have the correct pizza ready… only to arrive at the agreed time to find they had forgotten to start making it. On top of that the chips were cold & stale. Nice enough people but clearly very little care is put into their service

I have had a very enjoyable experience with the food at Pizza Hut. The pizzas are consistently fresh, flavorful, and well-cooked, with a great balance of toppings, cheese, and sauce. The person rahul is very nice . Thank you

Last night i have been served by Mr. Rahul at Pizza hut (Ellerslie). I got great customer service experience first time ever in food chain restaurants. Thanks, all pizza hut team.. doing great hard work. Much appreciated.
We ordered delivery from here tonight and it was SO DELICIOUS. The lamb korma was the most tender meat. The dal Makani was thick and full of flavour. Can't wait to order again. Thank you !

I just ordered online this afternoon my gosh the food was bloody amazing and the Naan bread was the best I have ever tasted. Butter chicken was amazing too. My new go to place I will be recommending this restaurant to all my family and friends 100%. Black Pepper Restaurant in Onehunga you rock.
We ordered delivery, mild butter chicken and medium biryani. They got the spice level mixed up. The Biryani was okay and the Butter chicken was too sweet.

We came here for dinner recently and were thoroughly impressed. The small restaurant was very cozy and the staff very friendly. We had a hard time deciding so ended up sharing two meals. Though the portions did not look very large they were very filling and tasted great. Between two of us we still had enough left over for lunch the next day. The naan bread was probably the best I've had in a long time - cooked to perfection and both crispy and soft as well as full of flavour. The best part was that the prices were reasonable and probably considered cheap. I would definitely recommend this place and will certainly be returning!
Our fav place, food is always so fresh and hot, customer service is so lovely

Lapi was super tasty and it had generous sesame paste sauce. But the skewers were a bit too oily even we requested less oil. Skewers were deep fried and then grilled and we all felt way too greasy after eating. And the chives were literally soaking in oil. Service was friendly and nice tho.

Pro: Tasty food, affordable price compares similar restaurants in Auckland. A large range menu may let you think most food are not going to taste good, but they are actually above average. Con: been 2ce and both around 1 hour wait. I ordered through online menu with allergy request, but they still gave me something with nut allergy, which can be lethal.

First time trying this restaurant. Parking is at the One tree hill school and a short back to the back entrance of the restaurant. You can only have lunch from the set foods as the rest is only night time. Serving of food show and served other tables before us event when we can first.
They are specialised more to bbq skewers, taste quite good. Other hot dishes not that bad too. Owner came from china so food quite authentic. Ambience quite cozy and quiet. Waitress is friendly.

Outstanding! I had such a lovely meal here. The food was excellent with just the right amount of flavour and an extra zing for those taste buds. The staff greeted with a lovely smile as soon as I walked in. Service was fast and efficient. They have a wide variety of oriental food to offer. The menu was diverse and very reasonably priced. Will surely visit again! Thank you!

Online order made well over 1 hour in advance for a collection at 1:30PM, didn't get order made until 1:41PM with a drink not completely full and like other reviews extremely light on the fillings. Half my lunch break wasted waiting on an order which should've been ready to go. Not too impressed.
Used this a few times now, the ingredients are fresh, and I love the salad bowls with extra proteins. Staff all smile... such a simple things and makes a difference.

Update - you can now choose as many filings and toppings as you like. However the service here is still extremely slow. I have ordered online multiple times now and they have forgotten our toppings. The pick up time is also wrong, we were supposed to pick up or order around 12:20 but they only started making it when we had arrived. What's the point of online ordering when you have to wait even longer? I used to go here regularly for lunch. Unfortunately they have recently updated their menu and have got rid of all the good veges like mushroom, corn, green capsicum. You can only choose 5 fillings now (cheese counts as a filling too). Very disappointed by the new menu. The attached photo is what you get now for $8.50. Felt very sad for my partner whose pita pit was even smaller than mine.
Awesome fast service and fresh tastey food. The place was so clean and tidy. Wait time was low too.

Friendly bunch! As always, tasty, fresh and filled well. Informative also! New to area and will be back for more! Been back again and again, best pita pit been to hands down. Clean as, let me order bang on or after closing, store's aim is [To Please]!
It was really fantastic smoothie that I ordered and no wait at all. Even good taste overall of smoothie. Definitely come again. Thank you for good service.

They have really great healthy option for smoothies and wraps. The Mango Zest and the Tropical one are my favourites. They are quite quick to complete the orders. The self serve kiosk is really easy to use and frees up the staff to prepare the food. There are a few tables around from the food court.
Loved both the flavor🥤🧋. Thank you team dressmart for such a amazing & fast service 🙌
I enjoy the tank smoothies here not to much hassle just a slight wait as this is a popular place Tropical my go to smoothie. Also you can make your order on the App and save a lot of time waiting.
Love buying healthy options here.

Had a very good experience at spice traders onehunga mall. Food was very tasty and fresh, specially mater paneer was mouth watering. Butter naan was soft and freshly made. They even top of our curry 2nd time without any extra charge. Highly recommended when you visiting dress mart.

I had an amazing experience. The food was absolutely delicious – fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. The service was outstanding; the staff were friendly, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. From the moment I walked in, everything felt warm and well-organized. Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for a great dining experience. Will definitely be coming back again and also special thank to this restaurant chef he make awesome curry

Food was very tasty, portion size was more than enough 😋, combo of rice, naan, curry and drink is really priced very sharp. Services was with a smile. Manager, chef and serving staff were all smiles and ready to go extra mile, hats off to the chef who said to me that he will make fresh veg biryani there and then in 5 minutes as the counter stock got finished.
The food is amazing & they offer a friendly service with recommendations to fulfill the taste buds. Highly recommend for anyone to have a delicious Indian meal.

Food was very tasty, portion size was more than enough 😋, combo of rice, naan, curry and drink is really priced very sharp. Services was with a smile. Manager, chef and serving staff were all smiles and ready to go extra mile, hats off to the chef who said to me that he will make fresh veg biryani there and then in 5 minutes as the counter stock got finished. Amazing...

The service from Ahbi (think that was his name) was absolutely amazing! Best service I have had anywhere for a very long time! Cheerful, helpful and just a pleasure to deal with! Great work, we will be back!

Watch them they like to chuck a extra dollar on here and there hoping knowone notices. And told me i was wrong and then she found out i wasn't. Usually im not this petty but it adds up when your getting it every day. And they aren't the only branch doing it

If I could give a 0 I wouldn’t hesitate to give it… Me and my friend we usually buy from this subway in the mornings and it’s good most of the times.. but today we bought it in the afternoon around 2:50 pm and I am soo disappointed with the sub.. There is just not much veggies or no proper sauce.. The worst I’ve ever had..

Bad service . Had too keep asking for more topping . asking 3x on the ones I wants a joke and this is the result. If you want people to return . Maybe give them a decent portion I'm not asking for oversize . But if you see what I have then minus 2x the veg you'll see how thin it would have been. .costed $14.20 only worth $5
Easy option for food during my busy day. Fast and friendly service.
We’ve been eating here for many years. Been away over three years just back to Auckland. Had to come here for a taste. Still excellent kebab. Considered best in Auckland. Recommended.

Our family favorite kebab shop, we always eat there whenever we are shopping at Dress Mart either passing by the area. We ordered 2 med chicken on rice combo, 1 lamb wrap combo, 1 lamb salad and 1 large lamb on rice. Lovely food and always fresh. One of the best kebab we ever had in Auckland. Place looks clean and tidy. Thank you, can't wait for our next visit!

We've been going to this place for over 15 years. Same friendly owners too and remember us. Chicken on rice is my fav the sauces and presentation so yum. We'll sometimes make a special trip from Glendowie to go there. You won't be disappointed.
I ate first time but it's was yummmm, awesome, delicious 😋🤤... mouthwatering After ate one salad bowl I bought another I love it, will visit again
Great lunch experience at Wellington. The staff member was friendly and efficient, preparing an order for 8. The student discount is also great. Halal.

Excellent pies. We tried their Guiness cheese steak pie, which was infused the taste of Guiness beer, amazing taste, and chicken creamy mushroom pie, crunch and creamy. Their chicken kebab was soft, tender and aromatic. Love them. This is a very busy shop.

Found this beautiful pie place, and tried their wagyu red curry pie 🥧the size of pie was big, they do have a a large variety of pie, you can always go for regular ones like mince and cheese and they are phenomenal as well… once you enter the shop you’ll be greeted with number of awards frame on wall, and giving you a brief idea that the pie are gonna be better…i tried some sweet delicacy like pistachio filled donut but sadly it was too cold and i couldn’t taste it any better…

Now, first time here. Came before of the many good reviews. So the likes, their was a line waiting, a lot of pies to chose from, didn’t have to wait, the pie that I chose today was a CREAMY PAUA and mocha coffee.

I’ve heard good things about these pies, so I gave it a go. The different fillings sounded good, they looked good and there was a queue of costumers, so I thing it was great. Got the pies went to one tree hill for a family picnic and when we tried them, it has been disappointing to find that there was a huge amount of gravy and only two pieces of meat in em. My wife couldn’t even find a mushroom hers.

French patisserie didn't have enough focus with the French vibe of baked goods or coffee ,pie pastry too thick julgy with pie being luke warm & not much flavor overly priced. Hadn't been offered serviettes when purchased. Dessert had a rhubarb & apple & a blueberry custard tart was OK, but for its size of a mallow puff, it was too priced . Seating needs to be screened off too much foot traffic walking past looking annoyed with space.

Best Japanese food that I’ve ever had in Auckland, the ingredients are so fresh and the crunch and spiciness of the spicy don chicken was so good, the veggies are also cut so perfectly and it meshes excellently with the rice
Loved the food and staff are so nice A big meal affordable

Amazing food, the sushi here is really nice but the cooked dishes are also well worth waiting for. Strangely I had written a review in the past with photos and it has disappeared. If you like sushi, this will be your new favourite for sure!

If I could rate this place a 0 I would. I have had severe food poisoning for two days since eating their katsu bento box. The chicken tasted odd and the rice also tasted very old and hard. I have been violently spewing for 2 days. Never again will I eat here let alone Japanese which was my favourite cuisine.

Ordered spicy chicken don. The Chicken was warm on the outside and cold in the middle. I asked them if it was made fresh and they talked amongst each other for 10mins in Asian before putting it in the microwave.

Excellent, fresh, reasonably priced, lots of options. I hadn’t been here in years (until June 2018) and now we’ve been 5 times in 2 weeks. Staff are lovely, fast and really onto it - love the smoothie jars too!

Loved my Manwich Loved my Beef Noodles,but needed a bit more sauce. Nice Experience Lovely Atmosphere Good to see all the nice n fresh vegetables. So Healthy n Yum. Kind Worker Quick n Efficient,with my Food. Will definitely be going back for more asap Thank you heaps.

Terrible place, do not go! I specifically asked for Almond Milk and they put Dairy Milk in the smoothie with a sarcastic and rude note on the side. This is not only rude but un-safe. Avoid going here. VERY very rude staff and extremely difficult to communicate with. There is no ownership of their mistakes, and they do not take any responsibility when they make the order incorrectly, their response involved shouting and swearing through the phone when I requested that a new order be made.
friendly staff and kids love their smoothies, would be good to have some more hot food option going into winter. recommended place for salads and juice/smoothies.
Bread is stale. I will no longer buy a sandwich here. More often than not the bread is stale. Such a let down as Habitual Fix have previously provided fresh quality ingredients.
Right next to the laundromat so you can watch the game and do your washing, plenty of parking and nearby to dressmart, yet to try the food but they have good selection of beer and a pool table
Too good to go in. I dont live in onehunga but popped by to see a friend... All good though
Found out what a pint was from this place. Had good food especially for the price. Staff were nice, patrons were friendly and had a good calm vibe.
$20 for a beer, nachos and onion rings, pretty good value for money. Not top quality but the price makes it worth it. Obviously is a bar so top quality food isn't what you go there for.
Had a enjoyable time, beer and a steak feed hit the spot. Had a tap on the pokies and a punt on the TAB. Great service and friendly staff.
Very nice, pork on rich and good quantity! Sweet and bit spicy
Stopped in here passing by, food reasonably priced. Tasted great, good selection of food. Lady behind the counter was lovely, will happily stop back in here on my way past again.

All spoilt chicken kebab. Old samosa are sold here. Mixing old fries with new ones. Had a severe stomach ache and dizzyness. Very worst place to buy any food. So sad I can see the Island people getting food here.For god sake please do not buy anything from this shop. You are wasting your money and health. I am going to email commerce comission for their unethical business practice. Thanks for reading my review

Spent $30.70 on a box of food, only to have opened up the 2nd sourcream pot and check the 3rd and found mould on container lid and a very bad smell. Before realising what I had eaten I was halfway through the 1st pot of sourcream with wedges and a steak and chese pie when I felt sick. I thought it was my tastebuds so I ate a caramel slice with a banana both bought from this lunchbar. Still felt sick so thats when I checked the rest and drove back to store to get a refund but it was closed. Never buying from there again.
Good Coffee and nice selection of both Hot n Cold food..

I had a lovely experience at Cornwell Park Cafe! The coffee was rich and smooth, brewed perfectly – just the right balance of strength and flavor to start the day. I also tried their avocado toast with bread, and it was fresh, vibrant, and satisfying. The avocado was creamy and well-seasoned, sitting on nicely toasted bread that had a great crunch. The presentation was simple yet inviting, and the overall vibe of the cafe was cozy and relaxed. A great spot to enjoy a quiet breakfast or catch up with a friend. Definitely recommend if you’re in the area!

Freezing cold after mini golf on Tamaki drive, we needed Hot drinks and a warm place urgently! We got that at Cornwall park cafe! Lovely wait staff, great coffee and snack foods. It was getting close to closing but the young guys had not come down from exploring one tree hill and we waited in the warm until they returned! It was not warm enough to savour the icecream stand,but have done so in summer whilst flying model gliders with the kids! I would recommend CORNWALL PARK cafe and surrounding area to anyone wanting a nice drink and snacks fantastic friendly service and reasonably priced. Arthur C. Charlton west Auckland NZ

We enjoyed our visit to this beautiful Cafe when we visited Cornwall Park. We managed to get a table inside which was lucky as it was so busy. They have table service or you can order and pay at your table by scanning the menu code with your phone. They have a great selection of dishes to suite everyone’s taste. You can enjoy a light meal, a small sweet treat or a larger meal. They have great coffee which you can enjoy seated or takeaway. They even serve wine and beer!! The service was absolutely incredible and there were so many staff which meant meals were served fast with a smile. I highly recommend this cafe if you are in the area. The atmosphere is amazing!!

I would give this cafe a solid 4 star rating. Location is beautiful, service well organised, food arrived quickly even on a very busy day. Food is good quality. I wish my poached eggs were served slightly hotter, but they were poached very nicely. I could easily recommend this cafe to a friend. I have been here twice and would come back.

A nice cafe located in the heart of Cornwall Park. The food is good but the reason why I rated low is because they forgot I ordered fish and chips. The lady even showed me the receipt that I didn’t order it, and I pointed out where it was ON THE RECEIPT. 🤦🏻 I get that it was busy though.

Small Japanese restaurant selling fusion sushi and a couple other options (lunch boxes, donburi, curry and udon). Staff are lovely, food is not bad, but just overpriced for what you get… $21 for prawn tempura curry rice and $21 for chicken katsu udon. Very small piece of chicken katsu.

We had takeaway lunch from Haru Sushi. Quality and amount was excellent. Great customer service and really nice and clean shop. We had the Teriyaki Chicken Lunch Box, and sushimi tuna, and salmon, very large pieces. Would highly recommend this place.
Number 1 sushi spot!! Love love love this place. Food is always fresh fresh and delicious and staff are so lovely 10/10 recommend
Best sushi I have ever tasted. The freshest you will find anywhere. Lovely staff too. Very friendly and kind.
