I must say this sushi really exceeded all expiations. So fresh and a really good range to choose from. I tried the chicken & avo + the salmon sushi and they were great picks. I’ll be coming back for sure. James Ashwin Kakapo Business Sales
Decent Mexican food, kind of cold when we had lunch. We could split the bill to individuals (which was nice).
Really great food delicious 😋 choices 😋 great service happy atmosphere 😀. Good place for group catch ups .Thanks Mexico 🇲🇽 will be back 🙌 😍 😎 👏
$25 Lunch deal is good! Items from the menu are hit and miss. Make sure you check the total when you pay. These guys have consistently over charged us by few dollars lol

This restaurant is fantastic! The food is absolutely delectable—fresh, flavorful, and cooked to perfection. Every bite feels carefully prepared, making for a truly enjoyable meal. The interior is really cool, with a unique atmosphere created by the sheer amount of art covering almost every inch of the walls. There's always something interesting to look at. The staff are friendly and welcoming, adding to the great experience. It’s typically not too busy, so you can enjoy your meal in a relaxed setting. The restaurant is reasonably large and well-maintained, making it a comfortable place to dine. My only small critique is that their horchata in particular is a bit sweet for my taste. Overall, definitely worth visiting!

The staff was absolutely amazing. Served us food with a smile. All the girls were sweet and made us feel very welcome. Went there for my partners birthday and it was packed on a Monday night. The service was quick and the food was amazing. The non alcoholic drinks that we tried were super tasty.

Service was polite fast and friendly. Some patrons supporting the venue, but overall quiet at the time we were there. Several variations available and orders are made as requested. Food was fresh and sandwiches were prepared on the spot. Menu offerings not exactly the same as elsewhere on the planet but still as tasty.
I usually get a good consitent experience in all subways, however, this time, they barely put any of the fresh ingredients in my subway.

Subway, get less for more. Unfortunately, this subway is the closest to my office and home, and I am quite the fan of a good sub and some cookies. Staff here have always been pretty skimpy on the salads, which as a meat-eater usually doesn't bother me. I'm fairly good with numbers, not only has there been a pretty significant price increase recently, you may also notice over a period of visits, prices fluctuate regardless of getting the exact same sub every time. Previously my usual sub has set me back between $16-$18, today we hit a new goal at over $20, just the sub. The server sprinkled barely a handful of lettuce on a foot-long, threw the rest of his handful back in the tub, same for the carrot and other salads ( pretty sure there's more salt & pepper in the sub than carrot.. ), he then casually screwed my receipt into a ball before pausing and asking if I had wanted it - I left the store with my sub, accepting the sore feeling of being robbed. If you can help it, avoid this store like you'd avoid thieves There's an awesome bakery just down the road, windows covered in award stickers, great pies and all here. There's also Gone Burger around the corner next to pizza hut, they're open late, they make their own buns, and the food speaks for itself, amazing stuff.

Wow, the team at Subway in Ellerslie were great. I had ordered catering and made an error in the ordering, they were so incredibly helpful when I realised what I had done. They went out of their way to get things right for me. I am very grateful for their service.

Honestly the worst subway I’ve been to. As soon as I started seeing 4 pieces of spinach and a crumb of carrots being placed on my sub I was instantly regretting it. And when I saw a coke was $5.20 I went elsewhere to finish my lunch. Will definitely avoid this place at all costs.
I really want to say this station have changed from normal station to a good one. New payment system for 24/7 fuel. A new Subway in the station is a great bouns.

Last month while fueling up here the trigger doesn't lock so you have to stand there holding the handle. Tried to wash my windscreen, but were no wash brushes or buckets. Yesterday fueling up again and the pump handle was covered in diesel. Tried to wipe my hands, but no paper towels in dispensers. I went through the car wash and all of the parts that should be spraying wash or wax product nothing comes out. I tried to call them as I was leaving to let them know its out of product, but no one answered the call.

Always have a great experience at this Caltex in Penrose. The staff are efficient, and provide great customer service. The station is always clean, well-stocked, and easy to access. The pumps are well-maintained, making refueling quick and hassle-free. The convenience store has a good selection of snacks and essentials, which is super handy and really decent coffee. Definitely my go-to spot for fuel in the area. Highly recommend!
It’s a very busy Gas station. Cheap fuel. Nice customer service. ATM here and toilet. Subway inside. Looks clean. Carwash here.
We had Best experience at this place. Serves you best coffees. Loved it. Very friendly team working there.

We stayed in 107 overall the room was great. But the door frame and windows leading out to the garden area need to be thoroughly cleaned including curtains. There is lots of mould on the door and window frames and curtains. Was meaning to say something to reception on check out but was in a rush and forgot 😅

Great Easter Sunday special buffet lunch. For those that booked in for the night “We enjoyed our stay here as a family of four. Was so nostalgic being back to stay as we haven't been prior to the first lockdown in 2020. Wellingtons restaurant for lunch and breakfast was perfect! Delicious food, friendly prompt service from staff. Rooms were clean and cosy. Great place for a weekend staycation close to home. Thanks for having us!”

We stayed one night here and found it disappointing. The rooms are dated and run down, a noticeable old musty smell when we walked into the room. The doors creak, the external balcony doors barely open, mold stained grouting in the shower, the phones didn't work, no instructions on using anything etc. We booked a cot and 4 occupants. We arrived to no cot in the room, not enough towels for everyone to shower. Multiple trips down to reception to get what we needed. For a "4 star hotel" there was no attention to detail. We woke up to ants swarming the bathroom and our stuff in there. Breakfast buffet was underwhelming, poached egg was raw white jelly - undercooked and inedible. Barista coffee was good. Restaurant staff were upbeat and welcoming but found the hotel staff to be lacklustre. issues were raised at checkout and a free coffee offered which was nice but we won't be return customers. Over all service here was lacking and the facilities are run down. not worth the cost

What a space!! Good size rooms great bathrooms, very clean and tidy. Amazing view from our room. Perfect location for us. We enjoyed two nights here. Buffet breakfast was great. I am a motel manager and can be quite picky but was really pleased with this place. My only negative was when we checked in I had my credit card and I.d on the counter and while I was reading my check I'm slip the man serving me picked up my credit card and put my payment through. This may not bother some people but I didn't like it.

The minimal furnishing, the faint musty smell and dull carpet evoke sense of age and potential wear and tear as soon as you step into the room. However, it is relatively clean and the bathroom appear to be recently renovated, which was a relief. Happy with the overall conditions.

Lovely helpful staff, rooms are well presented and very clean with comfortable beds. Lots of parking available and great location, not far from Go media stadium. Our go-to place to stay when visiting the area!

My Family and I stayed here and found the room to be good quality,great value for money. My children were not accepted here though because they are Autistic. The receptionist was helpful. The bathroom/shower was high quality. But the guests were judgemental and hated Autistic Children and never cared about my children and lot of guests have no right to be judgemental towards our children. They don't realise that I knew the Owner and complained about the guests. My family and I are now in a Brand New Home now and I will never stay there again. My rating is 3 out of 10. But the Owner was very diplomatic and allowed us stay at her other Hotels.

Stayed here multiple time and will continue to do so. Never had any issues, rooms are always clean. Some rooms do get a bit of traffic noise but not enough to be an issue at all. Staff have always been friendly and helpful. The location suits us well for our quick visits to Auckland

We had a lovely stay. The staff were all really helpful and super friendly. The rooms were spacious, clean and comfortable. Location was perfect for us and was really easy to catch the train to the stadium and into the city. I definitely will be staying again. Thank you.

What a lovely place to stay in Auckland. I’d highly recommend utilising the restaurant at the hotel, their food is delicious 😋 I stayed here for two nights for work and I’d definitely come back again when I’m next in Auckland! 👏🏼😊

One of my absolute favorite burger joints in Auckland! I’ve been coming here since 2017, and it has never disappointed. This place always delivers with juicy, flavorful patties, fresh ingredients, and perfectly toasted buns. The quality has remained consistent over the years, which is why it has become my go-to spot whenever I want a kickass burger. Highly recommend it to any burger lover!

Not too bad but I didn’t love it. Tasty enough but the Patty was a bit mushy honestly and on the smaller side. Bun was fine but barely toasted if at all. Decent amount of cheese. Got the classic cheese burger. Not my favourite but not bad. Mid.

The music playing is amazing. I made it to this restaurant, enduring my sleepiness and hunger. And the moment I ate the mexican, my stomach jumped up and my consciousness was awakened. I don't like spicy food, but the hamburger was so delicious that I ate it with gusto. It took me about 3 minutes to finish eating, but it felt like 10 seconds.

I recently visited this local burger joint after being away for a couple of weeks, craving a good burger. I found the place through a referral and was eager to give it a try. The atmosphere was cozy and comfortable, reminiscent of a mom and pop establishment, which I really appreciated. Parking was a bit limited, and there were only a couple of tables to dine in, but it seemed more geared towards takeout, which I understood. The staff was extremely friendly and welcoming, and the menu was clearly displayed on the wall. We ordered loaded fries, a mushroom burger, a chicken sandwich, and a calamari and jalapeno burger. The loaded fries looked appetizing, and I asked for the bacon to be substituted with ground beef. However, I was a bit disappointed to find the bottom layer of fries bare. The burgers were decent, but the buns fell apart as we ate, which affected the overall experience. The chicken sandwich was crispy but a bit dry; however, the fries were delicious. Overall, I enjoyed the ambiance of the place, but based on my experience, I may not recommend it specifically for their burgers.

i found this place through recommendations from people on reddit, and i followed them on Facebook. i was impressed with their weekly special burgers so i missioned it over there. i ordered the standard cheeseburger with extra pickles and added red onion, and a chips with aioli. there's a table outside the shop so i sat down to eat in. they bought my food out to me which was good. the portion of chips was great for $4, an overflowing chip cup in a bag, nice fresh fries. i liked that they had four choices of seasoning for the chips, and their aioli was great. the burger was okay, it is better than you'd expect from a takeaways shop, it was good but i wouldn't call it amazing. for the price it was fine, meat patties a good size, and being an onion lover i liked the sauteed onions on it. however there may have been a miscommunication as i didn't get any extra red onions on it. the added pickles were there and great pickles! i felt it was a bit heavy on the sauce, and the bun is a standard supermarket/tiptop type bun. the prices are pretty reasonable so im not faulting them on their food, just giving my thoughts. i liked how many options they had, from hot dogs to fish n chips to burgers to marinated rawfish and more. something for everyone. i think it's a good place for a reasonably priced feed, but if you're looking for something really special, go elsewhere (and spend more money haha) cheers to the team at big jays
Beautifully presented and prepared burger! Nice to see people taking pride in their work. Had a double quarter pounder at Maccas Lunn Ave a few days ago and it was dry as and inedible.

Hands down my favourite Burgerfuel store to go to for dinner. The food is always fast, fresh, and top quality. The service is amazing every single time, and the store is always so clean. Keep up the hard work, you guys rock!
Great burger, friendly service at lunchtime. Nice little outdoor seating area Plenty of free parking close by

The service was great, the lady who served us at the counter was very nice. However, the food did not match the service, The burger was delicious, but unfortunately my daughter got extremely sick the next morning from eating their hot chips. She’s only 1, so she was awake spewing all morning this morning. I’m not too sure what that could be, if it was the oil that the chips were fried in or the potatoes themselves, or someone cooking could’ve passed something through the food. But I’m very sad that this is what has happened, as I was very happy with the service the store.

Never get order right. Food is always late and we are never told. Chips are barely full. Staff are rude. Above comment was left a month a go. We stopped getting Bfuel from this franchise as they were a total let down. Decides to try again. AGAIN, staff are just rude and act like they don't want to be there or care for customer service, food was meh and again chips barely full. As a worker, how can they be happy with the job they are doing. They shouldn't be getting paid. Also, lettuce in the burgers are hard and rotten. Mt Wellington Bfuel really need to get their act together.

Unfortunately, the quality of the food, service and overall experience was pretty average compare to the last time I was there a year ago. I was super hungry but I haven't even finished the meal. The salad was noticeably old. Not coming back.
Toasted pita was stale. Grain salad was old, soggy, with brown cucumber. Burger was cold with no filling. No check backs from staff.

My husband and I went to eat at Nando’s Sylvia park today and for the first time we’ve gone ahead and tried to order using the QR code online ordering and we’ve been waiting for an hour and no order ever arrived. There were people who were eating in front of us and have left. I went to the counter to ensure that our online order was received. The manager an Indian guy check his computer to check my order and told me “it will come” that was like 45 mins ago. Over an hour later most of the people have left and there are few who have arrived and when I noticed that they are getting their orders. I reached out to a waiter and told them that we’ve been waiting for over an hour now for our order. The waiter cannot explain and just told me to wait for their manager. The manager came to me and told me that he knows that we are waiting for our order for “half an hour” I told him no it’s not only half an hour! It’s over an hour! My husband decided to just request a refund to eat somewhere else but the manager told us that It will be a long process and will take more time. Okay. I work with payment processing company and I know how refund process works, it will not take long to issue a refund to an order but refund from merchant to card issuing bank and from the bank to customer do take longer. I decided not to argue anymore and I do not want to make a scene, we ask him how long do we still have to wait for the chicken and they told us it will be another 20 minutes! He said if we want they have a burger available if we cannot wait anymore. He didn’t even ask for what our order was and offered us a burger to replace our order?? my husband doesn’t eat burger and we order a whole chicken with 4 sides and he is offering a replacement for a burger??? They close at 9:00 and it was already 8:47 pm so if we will have to wait for our order we will be the last customer to finished. They totally ruined our valentines dinner! My husband was upset and hungry and I told the manager before leaving that this is a really bad experience for us.I told him that my husband came out from a heavy job/work and is really hungry and to have him wait for over an hour only to find out that our food is not yet ready or not even being made., You know what the manager’s response??? He said that He’s also working overtime and haven’t had any break. He is still trying to reason out their mistake!!!! They are able to service the new customer who made an order at the counter now he is trying to reason out now with us that he is tired that’s why they missed our online order! Too bad that we’ve been their customer for a long time we were even there last week. My husband choses Nando’s over other resto every time we eat but with this is a really bad experience. I will be sharing this experience with our friends and post it in social media. 14/02/2025

Ive been eating here regularly and never have i had a sadder looking chicken than this. I went to two different nandos this week before coming to sylvia and always gotten the most delicious looking chicken, this just look like it was tossed around the football field. This is disappointing, not coming back here again.
The chicken tastes so good and nice! Every bite was packed with flavor and cooked to perfection. Highly recommend this place for anyone craving delicious chicken. Will definitely be back.

I had late lunch here with my family. The service here is perfect 👌 we got seated to our table straight away, orders taken when we were ready and food arrived in no time. Staff are very friendly and attentive. The food is so delicious! I had the chicken schnitzel with mash potato, coleslaw and gravy. *chefs kiss 🤌* I like the vibes and atmosphere in the restaurant. There's outdoor and indoor seating. There are big tv screens playing rugby so I can imagine when there's a game on how packed it would be. 100% would come back to have lunch or dinner.

Wholesome Lunch Date at Garrison Public House 🥂🍝🍕 Spent a lovely afternoon with my hubby at Garrison Public House, and it was everything we needed – chill vibes, good food, and great company 💛 We were greeted by the loveliest staff and felt right at home. To kick things off, I sipped on a Bikini Bottom while hubby went for a Tower of Export Gold – and of course, I had to try his too 😄 I also had a refreshing Long Island Iced Tea… cheers to that! 🥂 For mains, I had the Fettuccine Carbonara – creamy and satisfying, though I do like mine a touch more rich (still hit the spot though 🍝). Hubby went for the Winter Harvest Spaghetti – earthy, hearty and perfect for a cold afternoon. We shared sides of Salt & Pepper Squid (crispy, tender, yum) and a Margherita Pizza that was hot, cheesy, and oh so moreish 🤤🔥 Such a wholesome, delicious afternoon. We left full, happy, and already planning our next visit.

There are not many places where you go out to a bar , cafe or restaurant that can tick all the boxes. Great Atmosphere, great customer service and great food. A few nights ago we tried Garrison Public House. We were greeted warmly at the desk by Cameron who welcomed us and showed us to our table. He explained the menu and the meal deals that were on offer and gave us a few moments to decide. He very quickly put our drinks order in and another one of the friendly staff delivered our drinks and took our meal order. Cameron delivered the meals and as he place them down he explained what each meal was and then checked if we would like another drink. The meals were beautifully presented and you can tell by this that the Chefs take pride in what they do . Both meals hit the mark so to speak . Cameron stopped as he was walking by and asked if we were happy with everything, which we were. The meals were of a good size which unfortunately didn’t leave any room for dessert. This was a great all round display of excellent customer service. 10/10 to Cameron and his staff. Well done.

We dined here last week and had an amazing time. The atmosphere is great, the food came out quickly and was delicious. The portion sizes were also very reasonable and our server George was extremely helpful in suggesting some great drinks and dishes and overall just had a great vibe. It’s a great casual spot that’s inbetween the city and other suburbs!

Poor service and worst place to eat at Sylvia Park. The quality of food is terrible. We’ve ordered this dish previously but this time the garlic prawns had the flat bread soaked in the sauce. The flatbread was soggy. We understood that due to Easter rules, we had to order food with drinks however, after ordering food, the bar refused to take a drink order. Lastly, we finished eating and were waiting on dessert. However they had forgotten about this. The guy in the kitchen noticed we were looking around for the waiters and he got someone to serve us. The waitress said they’d forgotten but would be getting it ready now. After it was ready, the waiters again had disappeared. Again the guy in the kitchen saw us looking around and he quickly brought it to us.

The food arrived hot, fresh, and full of flavour exactly what you want from a good Chinese spot. Been here a couple of times, my go to is the sweet and sour chicken, egg fried rice, and a scoop of chips, and every dish was perfectly cooked. The chicken was crispy on the outside, tender on the inside, and the sauce had just the right balance of tangy and sweet. The rice was fluffy and not greasy, and those chips? Addictive so crispy but not burnt inside was soft and tender. Excellent! Portion sizes were generous, and everything was well packaged. Staff were friendly and polite when I called to place my order, and delivery was quicker than expected.

This is your classic local fish and chip spot with friendly service and a simple vibe. We keep coming back mainly because the chips are really yum—sometimes it’s the basics that matter most 😊. The fish is decent, but I personally prefer their burgers, which are always satisfying. Prices are a little on the higher side, but with the way things are these days, it’s understandable. All in all, it’s a solid go-to when you’re after some comforting takeaway.
These guys do the best deep fried chips, the oil is always clean and all their fried food 10/10 every time. All their other dishes are decent and well priced too. Favourite fish & chips.

Does this look like a spring roll??!! We got these gigantic deep fried wanna be spring rolls. They filled half of our plate and also our arteries. It would of been nice to know they were not actually spring rolls...

First time coming here, and all I got to say is WOW! The food is absolutely incredible. Although is was a bit busy but good atmosphere when I arrived, but it was worth the wait, food was piping hot, not to mention the spring rolls, super big! I did look at the reviews before coming here, and I saw some reviews about the spring rolls being too 'big', so I wanted to try the spring rolls for fun. Best purchase ever, pretty affordable as well, $4 for a big fat spring roll, super flavorful and fresh. Even the fish and chips were divine, chips were nice and crunchy and the fish has a crunchy and light batter. Also friendly workers that were so kind and helpful! Will definitely coming back again especially for the spring rolls.

If your looking for the best fish and chips this place is the best. Always fresh and fried to perfection. Crumb fried snapper is a must try as well as the curly fries. Tried the rolls today and the steak and onion was so very yummy....highly recommended. Oh and their prices are so reasonable.
The food was fresh, and I had the Sweet and Sour Pork burger wow, it was amazing! Definitely worth the price. The shop was clean, and the staff were really nice.
Love this place! Always clean and no smell like a lot of fish n chip places have. Owners are lovely and the food delicious. Just had the most amazing chicken satay burger! Forgot how good they were!
Its got some of the best chicken out there. Good customer service and even better chips, also super fast.

Ordered the Fry Me Up cheeseburger and two fish with garlic chips. The fish was the best part, crispy and not over battered. The burger was okay, the meat patties used are the sausage type meat so don't expect real mince patties. For nearly $10 this was a little over priced for the quality. Nice fresh vegetables though. Would recommend as a quick, no fuss fish and chips.

This little gem offers not only mouthwatering dishes but also incredibly reasonable prices. Every plate is a culinary masterpiece, infused with the rich flavors of Sri Lankan spices and prepared with an authentic touch that captures the essence of Sri Lankan cuisine. The talented chefs behind these tantalizing creations truly deserve our applause. Moreover, the staff members are incredibly friendly, making your dining experience all the more enjoyable. As you wait inside, you're serenaded by the melodic tunes of Sri Lankan music, immersing yourself in the culture. Oh, and let's not forget their delectable range of short eats, including scrumptious fish buns, delightful fish rolls, and a variety of other tempting treats. If you're someone who craves exceptional food at affordable prices, this place comes highly recommended. It's a gastronomic adventure that won't disappoint!…..

Good little Sri Lanka authentic restaurant located in Mount Wellington with reasonable price. It is hidden in Commissariat Road. Very clean and tidy and offers Uber Eat option. Unfortunately they close at 7pm. Must visit if you are in the area.

A hidden gem, probably due to its location; a bit isolated. A small and nice place, value for money, great food in that range.. Had Egg roti and chicken curry during lunch for mere $14, worth it.. The menu is extensive and would love to try some other delicacies soon..
My favorite is Chicker Biryani!

We’ve visited many Sri Lankan takeaways and restaurants around New Zealand, and I have to say that this one offers the least value for money in terms of portion size. The experience was disappointing, and we won’t be returning. Additionally, the food (Chicken Kottu & Chicken Lamprais) was cold and just okay.

It’s a favourite go to place for lunch for me and my younger one. The staff are friendly, food is fresh and awesome. The ambience is right and the place is clean and lively. It’s a fantastic option for meals and the location is handy with ample parking. Highly recommended.

Always a great experience when visiting any St Pierre's Sushi outlet. Their new vegetarian menu is great! What a selection! If you are looking for a quick and healthy bite, highly recommend St Pierre's Sushi!

If I could give half a star I would. Its 3:40pm and they are nearly out of everything. I ordered teriyaki chicken on rice... I complained in the store because of the lack of chicken but because I paid already I could not just leave it... Oh my word, got home and it is spot the bit of chicken. There is sauce, rice and an excuse of chicken. Really??? How disappointing.... St Pierre's Mt Wellington
Like all other St Pierre Sushi stores it has delicious and fresh sushi always,friendly staff and decent prices

Always a positive experience for me going to the st Pierre’s store. I work in the area and occasionally get the sushi of the day ( and always offered to make something up as well) the team are very friendly. Sushi is always on point !

I ordered two classic vegetarian pizza with san Francisco base, which are amazing and s fresh. I think it is the first amazing pizza I had in pizza hut ever.. Base is good and the amount of topping with cheese are perfect. But staffs were busy and forgot to give me feedback recipient to receive a free pizza next next. Staff asked me tp put feedback on the Google review then give me free pizza when I m in store next time. my name is Lina. Thank you. keep good work guys.
A long time ago I did not ate a good pizza, in addition to a fast and very attentive service, Great service from Rahul $ Parth… thanks you guys!

The few Pizzahuts open until 11pm to give students who want to save money a chance to fill their stomachs. Eat it right out of the oven, the cheese stretches well. (The pizza in the picture is "Americano") The service attitude is very good and social.
Came in yesterday, was my 21st birthday, received this. I don’t like leaving bad reviews but this was just sad lol
Always reliable and tasty! Pizza is hot, fresh, and loaded with toppings every time. All the staff is really friendly and the service is fast. Easily one of the better Pizza Huts around.
Lovely workers. Been coming here for a while and Simran, Sahdya, and Jant and are all amazing and super fast!

Not impressed, with Subway Sylvia Park. I ordered a veggie patty footlong and expected a proper feed, but what I got was a bit of a disappointment. The veggies were barely there—just a sprinkle, really—and the cheese? Only three slices instead of the four I paid for! Come on, we were expecting a decent food here, so the quality ought to match. I would say its just ripping off your money. Think twice before placing your order. :(:(:(

I wanted to use my loyalty barcode to collect points, which I know needs to be scanned before payment. The lady at the counter told me I could scan it after the payment, which I questioned because I’m a regular customer and know the process. She ignored my concerns and proceeded with the payment anyway, causing me to miss out on my points. Not the kind of service I was expecting! Edit: Yes my bad - it was inside the mall. 2 Indian ladies were working.
Everything very good and fresh nd the main thing ur staff girl Rupam so good she always behave very friendly . Thanks
Stingy on avacado and more interested in baking bread than serving customers. Handled dirty bread trays and food with the same gloves.....

Thank you so much for your lovey customer service Mary from Tank based in Mt Wellington! 1st thing in the morning and she's made sure I was looked after and my Nutrablast was delicious. I get this drink often so I'm grateful it was so good on top on the awesome customer service! Thanks again Mary!

I order at this branch often and always order the same smoothie (Rawsome greens). I've found the taste changes each time and my most recent smoothie was highly disappointing. The smoothie had an overpowering taste of unripe banana and I couldn't taste anything else that should be in there. I was left with a dry bitter taste in my mouth but forced myself to finish it as not to waste (as it's not cheap). I strongly suggest a better look at your quality and quanity management as well as staff training. Unfortunately I will no longer visit this branch in future.

I ordered on uber eats at about 10:30am. Didn’t realise they weren’t open till 12:00pm due to it being a public holiday. That being said, why was it an option before opening time to order now-not schedule an order, order now. They took my order…before being open?? Then the driver got sent there to pick it up and informed me it was shut. I googled and yup, they’re shut. Why waste both mine and the drivers time like that? Why accept an order you can’t make? Also couldn’t cancel the order with Uber eats because it was more than two minutes after it had been ordered. So I would’ve been charged with the order and had nothing as per their cancellation policy.

Kia ora, WOW FACTOR!! First I would like to give a big thanks to Natalie and Stephanie and apologies if I have got your names spelt wrong. The short lady with the hat and the Asian lady who both served me on my visit to Mt Wellington Tank a week ago. I live in Botany and I have got to say, these ladies make the best best best smoothies! and I am really fussy where I go to get a smoothie. The texture was thick where it actually looks and taste like a smoothie and the wraps are the BOMB the Thai chicken wrap was just awesome. A trip from Botany is well worth driving that extra mile to be served the best ever well made smoothies at the Mt Wellington TANK. These ladies are so welcoming. They greet with such enthusiasm and kindness as soon as the door opens. I am now a regular customer that appreciates these ladies for going the extra mile on preparing my order that day and the SMOOTHIES they taste the original when TANK first opened, with flavour, taste, thickness and KIWI. Keep up the fantastic work ladies. I am one happy customer. Excellent team effort to Natalie and Stephanie.

I always visit Mt Wellington Tank Juice and have an amazing experience! From the moment I walked in, the vibe was fresh and welcoming. The staff are always friendly and helpful. Thank you Mt Wellington Team.

I ordered a standard pepperoni pizza from Sals Mt Wellington . They sell these for $45 I usually get Sals every other week however won't be going back as they seem to put less and less pepperoni. The next time I order, I think there will be 2 slices. I won't be risking it. What a rip off
A decent Sal’s outlet in Auckland with plenty of parking. It’s also convenient, with many stores nearby.

I’ve been to this one for a few times and it’s been my go to pizza place for the last five years. The food has always been amazing and they maintain a very high standard. The staff are super friendly and helpful. I couldn’t recommend this place more!!! My personal favorite is the pepperoni, they use very fresh ingredients and the pizza base is cooked to perfection every single time! Highly recommend to all!!!

Very good pizza in downtown Wellington. It's New York style so you have a nice thin crust with large floppy slices. They have several great options with good toppings as well. I could take or leave the garlic rolls but they weren't bad by any means. Great stop for some good NY style pie
Great NY style 🍕. Good service & beats. 🎧 Worth the visit.

Came here today with my family for a nice family lunch, not too pricey but it was worth it. The food, service and atmosphere was amazing. We dined in and the seating was great. The toasted burritos 🌯 were yummy as😋, fresh ingredients and the guy who served us gave us excellent service, thank you team 🎉🎉.

I’ve been coming to this place for a while now, and it never disappoints! The food is consistently amazing, but the real star here is the manager, who makes the BEST burritos I’ve ever had. Every bite is packed with flavor, perfectly balanced, and so satisfying. The service is always friendly and welcoming, making me feel like a valued customer every time. If you’re looking for authentic, delicious Mexican food, this spot is a must-visit. Highly recommend!”
Very delicious 💯 Got myself a LAMB BURRITO BOWL. Very healthy and filling. Full of flavors. 🫡🫡 Great service and very tidy sitting space. Highly recommend others. 👌

Well I am so surprised I am buying regular bowl and that guy was putting everything so little that my box looks very empty i ask him to put more lettuce and more salsa ,he charged me extra for salsa. Also I stopped Uber eats with them because it comes half empty everything they put its so little even in larger size .please do tell your staff the guy who's bit taller as the other guy is nice to make it what customer paid for as it is very disappointing.

You can make way better at home. Not to mention, I got no chicken in my chicken borrito. Although they do state on their site that they donate one meal for every meal ordered. However, please ditch the apple added in the salsa and add a touch of hot sauce.

Ordered spicy intestines noodles. Took more than 30mins to arrive. And there were only 7 small pieces of intestines for $22.90. Not worth it at all. Skip this place. If there is a rating for 0 stars I will give 0
Amazing quality food. Big portions and lovely sides come along with it. Friendly staff. An absolute must try if you are in the area
Authentic Taiwanese cuisine owned and operated by Taiwanese. Their portions are good and taste is good. A regular spot for us after church.
Great service and food tastes great and feels like eating a nice hot home cooked meal. The restaurant is clean and tidy with nice subtle background music.
Food here is great and served hot and on time. Milk tea and egg tart was our ultimate favorite! You guys must try it :)

For staff Sandeep - I don't usually go to Subway but thanks to you I can come everyday, the way you treat your customers it's very overwhelming 💞 and the patience you carry with that gorgeous smile to serve, the subway you make is just perfect and just because of you one day I really craved for a sub and when I came there you were not around so I decided to come another day when I can have a sub that's made by you. I really appreciate your wonderful service and customer care. Hope to see you more often in Subway Sandeep
Quite clean and very fresh . Loved the way an indian guy (sing i guess was his name ) makes sandwich very beautifully. Well spoken and very interactive . Good job done . See you soon .

Thank you so much for the wonderful service with a beautiful smile Sandeep, I'm glad to have you for making my subway when I'm there, you just make my day with all your constructive hardwork and positivity. Hope to see you around more my friend. You do an amazing job. Lovely customer service.

Unprofessional borderline rude service, my partner ordered a kid's sub for our child, they didn't listen to the order and made a 6 inch with the wrong meat. Despite telling the staff the order was wrong they didn't fix it and laughed at us when trying to explain. Left feeling embarrassed, not sure what's going on here subway.

I visited this place during my lunch break and ordered a chicken Caesar wrap after seeing it on the menu, where all the ingredients were listed — including bacon. Due to religious reasons, I don’t eat bacon, so I specifically asked for it to be left out. I explained my request to the staff member, but as she started assembling the wrap, she still added bacon. I reminded her that I had asked for no bacon, and although she removed it from the top, she left some on the cheese underneath. I had to ask her again to remove it properly and start the wrap from scratch. The menu clearly listed all the wrap’s ingredients, but she kept asking me what I wanted, which left me unsure if she even knew what was supposed to go in it. When it came time to pay, she didn’t say a word — she just entered the total and stood there, without even telling me the amount or saying thank you. It felt like she was upset that I asked her to remake the wrap. The wrap said it would have mozzarella cheese in it but it wasn’t even offered to me.

Sweet as spot if you’re after a proper feed of Malaysian kai! PappaRich at Sylvia Park is the go-to now since the city one shut down. Mean selection on the menu – we’re talkin’ over 160 options, from classic nasi lemak to creamy laksa that’ll warm your puku right up. The roti’s crispy as, and you can even see the chefs whipping it up through the open kitchen – bit of a show while you wait. Service is choice too – friendly crew and that buzzer thing on the table makes ordering a breeze. Portions are decent, aye – you won’t walk out hungry. Prices are fair, especially for a mall joint. If you’re after a quick bite or a chill feed with the mates, this place hits the spot. Chur PappaRich – you’re doing it right!

Tastyyy chicken and sauces. Yummm. Chicken is just so simple and light, yes soo delicious. Cereal prawns are delish too, though it’ll be better if they can serve it - shell off. Drinks are delicious too, say milk tea and lychee soda. Overall, this also one of my go-to rice place in the area.

Generous servings and quick service. I really like filling out the order form and pressing the button for the waiter to collect. Drinks were yum the food was ok. Pricing was good and lovely atmosphere.

PappaRich Sylvia Park offers authentic and rustic food that’s full of authentic flavours. Located just next to the movie theatre, they offer great service , food and atmosphere. Overall a wonderful experience😊

Food tastes good. Char kway teow tastes like the Malaysia version. The Nasi lemak portion is huge. Can be shared by two people. Ice kacang is not to standard. Not enough syrup and it stays hard till the last bit. Not enjoying the ice kacang. Upon serving the ice kacang, the finished plates were not taken away despite our table being full. We need to put them on the next table ourselves. I am surprised that this basic service is not done. There were a few times that I heard the noticeable sound of menus being put aside roughly. Probably not intentionally but small care like this could make a difference in a good atmosphere restaurant.

Had 1 burger combo and wrap. It was 10am in the morning, only 1 customer before me. Cooking time for 20min. Is this real?? Staffs moving so slow. Food, they dont know how to cook steak. Ruined my breakfast.

Disappointing Customer Service a This review is to express my disappointment with the customer service I received at Kiwi Grill. The staff seemed overwhelmed and inattentive. I specifically requested minimal cheese sauce on my loaded fries, but my request was disregarded. Despite acknowledging my preference, the staff member continued to drown the fries in sauce. Unfortunately, due to the lack of communication, my order required a remake. This kind of situation is easily avoidable with better listening skills from the staff. Overall, my experience was hampered by the inattentive service. I hope [Restaurant Name] can address this issue to ensure a smoother experience for future customers.

I ordered steak egg and chips, macroni cheese pasta and bacon and eggs benedict it was so delicious. Food was well cooked as I desired. Moreover, I have no words for presentation it was superb.I really appreciate to whole team of kiwi grill who served this amazing food.

food was very tasty 😋 Wednesday, my friend and I got loaded fries from Kiwi Grill, and it took quite a while. But I noticed a person in a black t-shirt who wasn't helping the other staff members. The person in the black t-shirt was speaking rudely. I’m not sure who he was — maybe he was harassing them. I kept watching all this for about 10 minutes. If I ever meet their staff, I’ll ask them who that person was who was speaking to them so rudely. They can even file a harassment case against him.

Absolutely delicious food, sticky pork belly buns were so tender and melt in your mouth. More than happy to cater for dairy free, and even remade a burger at one point just to be sure. Lovely staff, excellent food, thank you very much! Will be back again soon.

I ordered a full-sized Pineapple Paradise juice and had been drinking it around the mall. It tasted fine, maybe a little too orangey but okay nonetheless. It wasn’t until I was almost finished that I found a whole rubber piece of the blender/juicer in my drink!! Yuck! How does something this big going into a cup go unnoticed?! I always seem to have bad luck with my drinks at Tank, but this takes the cake…
Ordered a vege garden - got a hint of ginger and the rest was just full of carrot. Paying almost $12 for a juice with just carrot and ice is ludicrous.

I was the only one in line and took my order… they continued cleaning up and doing dishes. Once my drink was finally served, I was extremely shocked by how small the small size was, it was the size of my thumb and I paid $8.70 for ts. i understand we need to make a profit in this high cost world, but this is diabolical! ts pmo
I had one of my favourite strawberry lush. The staffs were very friendly and quick to make smoothies. Served drinks with a smile 😊 Recommend to all.

I recently visited Tank at Sylvia Park, and I had a wonderful experience! The staff was incredibly friendly and welcoming, providing excellent service from start to finish. I tried one of their smoothies, and it was delicious—perfectly blended and full of fresh flavors. The selection of raw juices, smoothies, salads, and wraps is impressive, and everything looked so vibrant and appetizing. The staff took the time to ensure my order was just right, and I appreciated their attention to detail. The atmosphere was clean, bright, and inviting, making it a great spot to relax and enjoy a healthy meal or snack. I highly recommend Tank at Sylvia Park for anyone looking for fresh, healthy, and delicious options. I'll definitely be back!

Complete garbage, the meat tasted like it had sat there in the warmer all day, even worse the chicken tasted foul, although the chicken was coated in sauce the smell was still quite apparent. The salads were the most disgusting thing I’ve ever seen, the peas and corn were slimy, mesclun was rotten and mushy, cabbage and carrots had hints of black. Completely inedible, for this price there are so many better options out there. Don't spend money here to get yourself food poisoning.
Myself and my wife just love the ramen. Full of meats and meaty taste

One of the worst KATSUBI's I've' been too. There was hardly any meat to choose from, I was supposed to choose 3 different options, had to choose with what they had on display. (SHOCKING)! They can close this branch, TOTAL RIPP OFF! 🤮🤮🤮🤮🤮🤮🤮🤮 P.S - 1 STAR rating!

I go here often for lunch and I do generally enjoy the food, however agree that the price is unreasonably expensive for what you get. The salads can look limp at times and their meat portion sizes are rationed too much in my opinion, but taste-wise the food is delicious. The staff appear grumpy all the time and in a rush and never smile and greet the customer, but this doesn't bother me as my interaction is at most 20 seconds then im off enjoying the food. Obviously they have room to improve.

Absolutely terrible. Got an order of Spring rolls. They are old and cold. Absolutely disgusting. Utterly inedible. They then wasted 15 mins of my time fumbling around trying to "refund" me. I've just walked away. This place is an absolute disaster

A friend and I purchased 4 pizzas, 3 garlic breads on 17/02/25. As the order was running late and it was for a party we didn’t check til we got home. Loaded hot dog pizza had no hot dog, Mr Wedge had no ham, chicken supreme was a mess. None of the 4 pizza were cut properly. We have tried filling in the feedback form twice now with no response. Won’t be recommending for parties or work celebrations ever again. Suggest they check the pizzas new staff make before handing over!

We used to order from here every Friday but the last couple of years we've had more bad pizza's than good and I'm sick of complaining to the store. Usually we have toppings missing or extra ones we didn't order or they have been transported upside down. Tonights dinner looks like they kicked it all the way here. We shouldn't have to eat our pizza's with a fork!

Whenever I’m not in the mood to cook, I just hop online, order from the nearest Domino’s, and the staff has my pizza ready right on time. It’s super convenient, tastes amazing, and the prices are really reasonable!👍👍
Great place for pizza. The workers are very friendly and the pizza was perfect. Highly recommended!

A very pathetic way of serving I can say. Have never Aimee this kinda service from dominos. Have bought pizza many times just today acted casual to see how stipid staffs can think of customers. Burger was good but the Coke is bad. They gave you half a glass of ice and your coke diluted badly make the drink tasteless. Probably staff needed some training on how to make good soft drinks!?

Quaint venue, a bit dated but fullfils it's purpose. Could use a refurb but don't fix something that ain't broke. The manager served us well and food is very decent. Not oily. Place is clean and rated A.

Incredibly slow service. Waited ages when it turns out our burgers were sitting on the wrong tray the whole time. Staff just didn’t communicate to each other. Then get our burger and there is no meat patty in it and fries and burger are stone cold. Not good enough.

Took my family to Wendy’s Mt Wellington. Ordered the classic beef burger combo. What I received was a huge disappointment, the beef Pattie was so thin, dry, tasted livery, and obviously cooked A LONG time and HELD before it was served, it was inedible and the fries were cold and tasteless and the sauce station was a mess, no tomato ketchup available.
