15/05/25 12:00 Brother sounded Māori but was white-ish. Amazing costumer service. Food was too good, had to write a review! Fav place now😂💯 Get the mushroom baconator melt or whatever it is!

The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, perfect for catching up with friends or getting some work done. The staff are consistently friendly and attentive, and the service is fast without feeling rushed. The coffee is always on point — rich, smooth, and served at just the right temperature. Their cabinet food is fresh and the menu options are delicious. A great local spot that never disappoints.

The person taking orders blonde European woman. Acted like she could not be bothered. Not welcoming, no response to my greeting. Snub like attitude and no thank you given when interaction was over coffee takeaway was served to me she looked up and down to me. And coffee was too hot I had to ask for a sleeve:

I am actually very shock by how dirty the baby high chair was, I have never seen the paper towel so dirty after wiping down just the high chair table with my own disinfectant whenever I go out with my toddler, the paper towel in the photo was the dirt after the second wipe… We went early in the morning, and I am pretty sure no one has use that high chair before us, which looks like it was never properly wipe down for a long time. The dough in the bacon and egg pie is undercook as per photo, my flat white and croissant is mediocre. My husband does find his egg omelette and hot chocolate decent. Service is minimal and silent even though the cafe was not busy. I would not return.

Today we had lunch there,toasted cheese pineapple sandwiches they were very poorly thrown together,presentation was very poor? Coffee good,muffin good, but my brazilian chocolate was shocking considering i was charged over $8.00 which i wouldnt have worried had it been nice,or yummy. As a visitor to Auckland,you need to up.your game. PS the staff were friendly.

What an awesome spot for a quick treat whilst completing the weekend DIY shopping. The staff were super friendly and fast, will be stopping in again soon to try a full breakfast as the meals everyone was eating looked fantastic. Highly recommend. James Ashwin Kakapo Business Sales

Hey everyone! I just wanted to share my experience at this amazing Mediterranean restaurant in Auckland. The food was absolutely delicious, and the service was top-notch. The staff was friendly and welcoming, and they made sure we had a great time. The prices were also very reasonable, so you can get a great meal without breaking the bank. I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone who’s looking for a tasty and memorable dining experience. It’s definitely a place that you can take your friends or family to, and it’s sure to impress. I can’t wait to go back again soon! Cheers!

We’ve been wanting to try Mediterranean food for quite some time and was browsing through goggle review and found this place. It was a good experience as the food we have had was excellent. Lunch plate chicken was good specifically the chicken itself. And Lahmajun we did not expect much initially but it has a pretty unique flavor. For the Turkish coffee and Turkish Delight , I didn’t enjoy it particularly as I feel like the coffee taste as normal black coffee.

Had a really nice time here. The atmosphere was relaxed and welcoming, and the staff were attentive without being overbearing. You can tell they care about the details—everything from the way the dishes are plated to how smoothly things run. The food had a lot of flavor without trying too hard, and I appreciated the balance in the menu. Would definitely come back if I’m in the area again.

I ordered the Cherkez chicken — it was beautifully roasted with a delicious charred flavour. The salad was well-seasoned and added just the right acidity to balance the meal. The creamy walnut tarator was absolutely to die for and truly elevated the dish. This restaurant is popular for large group celebrations. They served our group well, though it did get a bit chaotic during payment, so I recommend organising a group list in advance to avoid anyone being overcharged.

Thank you team at Casablanca Sylvia park for making my mum’s mother’s days so special. Food was delicious and amazing. Special thanks to the head chef Arunesh, the store manager and the beautiful waitress for the amazing service. Will surely be back.
Ridiculously over priced $5.80 for a microwave pie. $5 for a stale sandwhich. Not going again even if its my last option!
Love this place, best pork on rice in town, only open weekdays. Got to put the soy sauce on.
Great and cheap lunch meals
Pretty average.

A Tasty Tuesday Night at Mt Wellington Night Market 🍴✨ There’s something magical about the Mt Wellington Night Market on a Tuesday night — the air thick with the mist of sizzling flavours, the laughter of families weaving through food stalls, and the excitement of not knowing which delicious bite you’ll try next. It’s our kind of night out — a family tradition of “eat and walk,” and we absolutely love it! This time, our foodie journey started with a hot, fresh, and cheesy batch of chips from Potato Corner — oozy, crunchy, and downright addictive. Next, we devoured a juicy BBQ chicken leg, perfectly grilled and served with creamy mashed potatoes on the side. Talk about comfort food at its best! We couldn’t resist the smell of hot mini donuts — fried fresh, rolled in sugar, and gone in seconds. Then came one of my absolute favourites: crispy prawn toast, packed with prawns and served with a sweet and spicy chilli sauce that made every bite a crunchy, satisfying joy. To finish the night on a sweet note, I treated myself to a heart-shaped Dubai chocolate — rich, smooth, and just the right amount of sweet. Every bite was a little piece of heaven. It was such a delightful night, filled with laughter, flavour, and family fun. If you haven’t experienced this vibrant night market yet, you’re missing out on one of the tastiest nights Mt Wellington has to offer. ❤️

"A little crowded, a lot of delicious!" So, I hit up the Mt Wellington Night Market, and let me tell you, it’s like a treasure hunt – but instead of gold, it’s full of Asian food stalls. Located below Countdown in the basement, it’s got everything from dim sum to grilled lamb (yes, grilled lamb – it’s a thing), bubble tea, and even a stall with phone accessories (because why not?). I did spot a vegetable shop too, selling bananas and some other veggies – very useful if you’re in the mood for healthy snacks after gorging on bao and grilled goodness. Speaking of which, I picked up 3 red bean and pork bao for $6 – not a bad deal if you ask me, considering they went down like a dream. The place can get a little crowded, but it's manageable – just a few extra elbows here and there. Plenty of tables and chairs to chill and eat, and bright enough to keep you from falling asleep in the food coma you’ll inevitably be in. Toilets? Yeah, they’re there, but don’t expect a five-star spa. It’s more of an “I can deal with it” situation. All in all, if you're looking for good food, great vibes, and some quirky finds on tuesday's, this is the place. Just make sure you bring an empty stomach – unlike me, who was too full to try everything! "Logan was here.. Grabbed some handful bao's"..
Just arrived for first time. This market should be open till morning. No night life in auckland. But this place quit good. Seems like street food corner. Enjoyed.
Nice food. Different kinds of foods here. Customer service ok.

Wet night but still bustling. Unfortunately no filipino food stall around. Heaps of food to go around, customers enjoying their fingernails in one corner, other doing their shopping for some stuff. Food really yummy and delicious. Highly recommended 👍 Revisited this place for more filipino food, like it here

Went on a Sunday night, and it was quite quiet which was nice. The menu is nice and simple and is cheaper compared to other Korean Chicken places in East Auckland. I had the DELICIOUS Soy Honey Garlic boneless (Highly recommend) and my Aunty got the Crispy Chicken on rice combo. The wait time was only around 10 minutes which is good. The portion sizes are GREAT! I got so much chicken and chips which I ended up having to pack to take home. They may be slightly understaffed as there often wasn’t anyone at the front counter and I could see that the lady taking my order was quite stressed. But nonetheless the service, food and atmosphere was great. Highly recommend!

This food is to die for! I always get the seasoned chicken but it’s all amazing! The service is amazing, my friend and I regularly come here and when we popped in after a while because of school, they greeted us and said they noticed we haven’t been in lately. I love when servers take note of regular customers ❤️. When we aren’t coming in person, we’re ordering, honestly my comfort food now!

What an absolute surprise this place was! Delicious food and incredibly friendly staff, even with only a takeaway meal. Meals were a very decent portion sizes and so fresh. Boneless chicken was thigh so perfect juicy pieces and so flavourful! Would 100% go back if I wasn't an out-of-towner! Sorry no photos.. was gone too quickly!!

Doubled recommended! The staffs were super friendly and chicken so good. I ordered crispy chicken and seasoned chicken (mild one for my toddler) both were really good even it gets cold. I will definitely come for them.

Fantastic food! The owner is super friendly and kind too! I don’t know what more I have to say about the Korean Chicken here. Heaps flavour, taste and quantity too!👍🤣 I started going this shop because of my wife. But, now I am the big eater! Soy honey and seasoned are superb! Normal fried chicken is also good too!!! Gotta try them all!!!! Tried so many different shops by farI this one is the best in Auckland. Enjoy!!!

I took my dinner home and was very disappointed to find the chicken was not cooked properly. It was raw in the middle and completely unacceptable. I called the restaurant right away, and instead of taking responsibility, I was asked if I was sure the chicken wasn’t cooked. I ended up speaking to three different people and had to explain the issue over and over again. It felt like a complete waste of time and money. No real apology, no solution, just a frustrating experience all around. I won’t be ordering from here again. Will taking this further!!

Amazing chicken place I actually can't complain about this chicken restaurant they honestly give kfc a run for there money. I brought the drum stick combo and they were juicey and amazing, my small family swallowed the whole bucket. Massive let down was the 6 hot wings for $15 even though they gave me 1 extra I was heavily disappointed as the heat was not as it was made out to be. Highly recommend to anyone to try this place but stay away from the overpriced not spicey wings

Great Spot for a Quick and Tasty Bite! Stopped by Alif on a whim, and I’m so glad I did! This place is perfect if you’re craving something quick, affordable, and seriously delicious. The menu has a great variety from burgers and fries to kebabs, rice dishes, fresh salads and milkshakes. I had the chicken, and it was hot, fresh, and full of flavor. The fries were crispy and seasoned just right with a good sauce on top, and the milkshake was the perfect complement. You can tell the ingredients are fresh, and the food comes out fast without sacrificing quality. The staff was super friendly and efficient, and the place was clean with plenty of seating. It’s casual and laid-back, ideal for quick stops, grabbing food on the go, or hanging out with friends. Definitely adding this to my go-to list for fast food done right. Highly recommend!

My go to spot for lunch always hits the mark the meals are consistently delicious , the mango lassi is on another level so refreshing and full of flavoured,staff are always welcoming and friendly which makes the experience even better. xxx

Crispy perfection! The fried chicken was cooked just right — crunchy, juicy, and seasoned beautifully. The staff were kind and quick with our order. First-time customers, don’t think twice. This place delivers!

I'm normally not one to complain & just eat what's given to me but I payed $68 for this! My honey chicken was fully mushed & full of water from the steam when I got home, literally had to peel the batter off because yuck!! & Fried rice, I know it's supposed to have a little burnt taste from the wok but mine was burnt, burnt. No taste at all just tasted burnt. Fish and chips tasted old like it had been sitting and then fried again and dished off to us. My husband also had the steak n egg burger and they literally just gave him a bun, egg and a slice of bacon with no steak hahaha, he just ate it cause he was starving. We would of taken everything back but we live in point chev.

Friendly Staff sorry to say terrible food… wontons over cooked and dry, sweet and sour pork over cooked and no sauce… and not enough vegetables in the chow mein and had a weird flavour ended up binning the lot hugely disappointing.. hungry and money down the drain
Nice food and relaxing atmosphere. Prices are reasonable.
I love their deep fried wanton and fried rice, is so so yummy. The wanton filled with yummy meat and vegetables. Should try it out

I buy there at least twice a week and always order chicken fried rice because it's delicious and about $2.50 cheaper than across the road. The owner and his wife work as a team, and though she is capable of managing the cooking, mostly he does it The owners are always pleasant, too, have no hesitation in greeting each customer
The customer service was good, my online order was ready for me to pickup, no waiting. The whopper tasted amazing 😊
My burger tastes off, the lettuce is brown, was given the wrong sauce for my nuggets and wrong drink, would give 0 stars if that was an option

Terrible service for delivery, pay an extra $1.20 for dipping sauce that never arrives, have received Kings nugget box with nuggets missing and what looks like the burnt food from the bottom of the fryer. Uber eats bags are sealed so we cannot blame the driver. These meals are for my kids which makes it all the more disappointing. Do not recommend.

Seriously… what is with this burger king… they are the slowest to serve. They don’t do codes via drive through yet their site says they do and got told to email burger king about it… Have to repeat things 3 times and my order which should have had 2x6 nuggets only had 2x3 but still got charged for 2x6! Absolutely ridiculous for a burger king. Can’t see why this one should continue to be around.
Chicken nuggets were worse than supermarket bulk frozen. Ice cream tasted like it had too much water and not enough cream. The chocolate milkshake tasted weird. Basketball court was nice, though...
Ordered online and got the Dinner Box 3 spicy 3 original. Came hot and fresh. Real crunchy, moist and full of flavour. Will order again for sure.

If you're craving fried chicken that’s crispy to the last bite—even without being spicy—this place is a must-try! Honestly, it's way better than KFC. What really makes it stand out is that it's 100% halal and super clean, which gives peace of mind while enjoying the food. And don’t get me started on the spicy fries—absolutely addictive! 🔥🍟 Highly recommended!

I did a huge catering order before they opened today, for collection at lunch time. The food was fresh, ready on time, tasty and the team were so wonderful. They helped me take my order to the car, had receipts ready, put it all in boxes for easy transport and went over and above. The work team commented on how yummy it was.
I absolutely absolutely love their spicy chicken burger. My must have each time I go towards mt Wellington. Love their chicken and burger. So crispy

Best fried chicken around. I got the spicy chicken burger combo and 5 spicy wings. The food is all made to order so give some time for it to be prepped, it’s worth the wait. You can taste when food is reheated, has been sitting around or poorly made - this isn’t the case here. The spicy burger was juicy and succulent with fresh lettuce, onions, mayo and buns. The fried chicken wings were crunchy, juicy and spicy - not overly oily. Best I’ve ever had. Chips had a great seasoning salt on them as well. Portions might be on the smaller side for some, but I would rather spend money on good food instead of being disappointed with the quality. You pay for what you get and this is really good food! Will definitely be back to try the kebabs too!

Not really into Katsu but we tried the mixed sushi and it was delish I've never had chicken crispy sushi so yum and the other Salmon and vege lots of fillings. I had crispy chicken Ramen. Delish and hubby had Don burri chicken he loved it. Great service will we go back again YES.

Wasted money to only recieve more chips then chicken, $18 so not worth it rip off no taste no where near Mr katsu manukau, they jam pack with chicken ,salad n chips n heaps off sauce the only reason we came here because the line was too long at Mr katsu manukau, never again staying loyal to Mr katsu Manukau! Crispy chicken w japanese curry was gross Will never come bk
Just wonderful! Clean, beautiful and delicious, just like handicrafts.
I absolutely adore it and keep coming back for more. It’s simply fantastic!
Really tasty food and affordable prices, happy to have tried it, I’ll definitely be back!

Last time I ordered kadhayi chicken and it was very tasty. Thinking that in mind today I ordered butter chicken and it felt like I am eating any sweet dish (too much sugar was there) and no taste as well. If customer has mentioned butter chicken should be hot. Chef should have sense to understand customer’s taste

Disappointed to say the least. The last 3 times ordered takeaway. From placing the call to picking up Always 10min max. And ready wen arrive. Unfortunately that's shows in the food it's not freshly cooked and only ever like warm to eat. Some would say takeaways that are popular among customers ie butter chicken are precooked and microwaved when ordered. Chicken biryani a favorite of mine is plain and again chicken precooked. Yet they used to be Amazing. Maybe different cook? It's a shame when we live so close 😔

I visited here and decided to try their Indian food, even though I’d read a few negative comments about it beforehand. I’m so glad I didn’t let that stop me, because it turned out to be one of the best choices I made. I ordered the Palak Paneer, Butter Paneer, and Dal Makhani—and honestly, all three were absolutely delicious. The flavors were rich and authentic, and everything tasted fresh and perfectly cooked. I was genuinely impressed and enjoyed every bite. Sometimes ignoring the reviews pays off, and this was definitely one of those times!

Rude customer service and rude behaviour by front staff when picked up an uber order as a driver. He took ages to prepare the order. I saw no one was using the Gloves in the kitchen while preparing the order. One of the guy prepairing the dough with his naked hands for the naans which is no food and safety at all. Will not recomend to anyone. 👎👎
Worst Indian food I have had in NZ. Tandoori was burnt, meat in the curry was half cooked, size large is actually regular size, and lollipops were too rubbery. Will never recommend this to anyone.

A colleague mentioned us that there’s a Filipino restaurant in the corner of the complex. Good thing that we tried it. I took the Pork BBQ and it tasted really well and also in generous serving. My Manager took the Bangsilog and loved it too. We also came back after an hour to order take away - I got myself taho and she had the Pork bbq meal. Will definitely be back and try other menu. 😊
We had the pork sisig, barbecue pork, lumpia and halo-halo. Food was delicious and service was excellent. Heaps of parking available as well so very convenient to dine in.

We got the pork sisig, beef kare-kare, lumpiang shanghai, and the halo-halo for dessert. Everything came out quickly and the dessert was well-timed. Great portions, reasonable price. Would definitely come back next time I’m keen for home cooked Filipino food!
Food is good especially the pork bbq No problem with parking space and they’re accepting walk-ins

Ordered here for takeaway last night. Chicken bbq was great! However, Pork bbq is a bit of disappointment. The one we got last night was thinly sliced pork belly with mainly just pork fat, and the skin was so tough you cant even chew it. Pork Siomai was similar to the packed frozen ones from asian stores. The sauces (vinegar, siomai garlic sauce and soy sauce) was very very good! Service can be better. The food took very long time to arrive considering it wasn’t even peak hours yet. The cook can be heard talking on the phone with someone about his business and whatever whilst everyone was waiting for their food to arrive. Once he’s done on the phone, all the food started to arrive, on by one.

Our Sunday morning ritual without the Teens had us stop by this CC @ Lifestyle Sylvia Park. Have been here before and enjoyed the experience - today there was a new staff member being trained, not the same hospitable service likely more nerves trying to cope with familiarisation of the till and all. Hopefully this improves cos we will have to change our Sunday routine and head back to our fave CC @ Lunn Ave. Tried the Smashed Avo, Pumpkin, Tomatoe, Beetroot relish & egg on Ciabatta, lovely presentation an interesting mix of flavours. I ended up enjoying my husbands Scrambled Eggs on Ciabatta (Build my own Brekky) with sausages. Simple & tasty. Our meal would’ve been nicer if it started off with a genuine smile from this staff member like how it normally is from staff who have been there a while. Hoping this feedback is taken and learnings are observed after watching her with other customers. A word of advice to the newbie “Every customer should receive the same genuine caring service not just selected ones young one.” A smile can go a long way.
Ordered the 'fluffy pancakes'. Dont, just dont. Overcooked and dry. Asked the lovely waitress, is this normal. She said yes, thats how the chef makes them. Sorry about that. Wont eat there again :(

Exactly as you would expect from the Chain. Good location Loads of parking Friendly staff We opted for the seats at the back away from the door. Cosy and warm, while able to enjoy some nice hot drinks. The ambiance was nice and easy to talk and hear each other.

Coffee club is one of the best cafe chains. The preparation is awesome. The menu consists of mixture of vegetarian and non vegetarian dishes. I particularly like the club sandwich which is a must have. The vegan ciabatta is also great. This time we tried french toast and it was good. The giant fluffy pancakes are awesome. I like the way they have planned the seating area both inside and outside. Outdoor seating offers some sunshine on a sunny day. The staff is courteous and understands your order fully. Our coffee was exactly how we wanted and at the time we wanted. There is plenty of parking available around the carpark. One of the best things is their cafe membership which offers 20% discount. It is well worth.

Being mothers Day, I was aware it was going to be busy. Drove to 2 Coffe Club locations, and both were busy, 40 min wait on food, so we returned to our local Mt wellington coffee club and we are never disappointed. Great service, delicious food, didn't take long, atmosphere is quiet and intimate. Should if came here in the fordt place. Thank you 😊 🙏

Excellent service from the smiley lady serving. Had the K-BBQ Toastie. Barely waited 10mins and she served our toastie it was yummy and still hot especially on an overcast day. Definitely check them out when at Sylvia for a quick bite.

Delish!! Tried for the first time today, staff were friendly and helpful - happy to answer questions. Ordered 3 combos and they came out quite quickly, all cooked to perfection. Crispy and yum! So recommend!

I go to Sylvia Park a lot but this was the first time I noticed this sandwich place. It is not visible from inner mall side. They have a self order screen and my husband and I selected the sesame chicken toasties and they were DELICIOUS!!! Definitely going back there again
Tried korean spicy chicken toastie for the first time. Skipped maple syrup as i want to keep it spicy. Taste was awesome and it was so filling... must try
Came here for lunch whilst on holiday. The food was absolutely amazing. So fresh and hot would definitely go back

My partner and I tried the Vadapav and we loved it! The vadapav was crispy, flavorful, and perfectly spiced. The soft pav and tangy chutneys were a great touch. If you’re in the mall, definitely stop by for a satisfying, delicious snack!

Just tried Nukkad at Sylvia Park and I’m seriously impressed! The food is full of flavour and feels like a true taste of Indian street food, with a fresh, modern twist. I had the chaat and a cup of their masala chai, both were absolutely delicious. The team was super friendly, and the service was quick even though they were quite busy. It’s got a great vibe too, perfect for a quick bite during shopping. Highly recommend if you’re looking for something tasty and a bit different!

I love Nukkad! I'm always here during my lunch breaks at work, the staff are super friendly and the food they serve is absolutely delicious. It's very hard to find authentic indian street food, so I'm so happy have found Nukkad.
Must say that I had the best Pani Puri in New Zealand. The staff was very polite. Worth to visit and try other menu items. Cheers
Looks like a little red coffee cart Is actually a food treasure hiding in plain sight Delicious hot food cold food spicy food all sorts of amazing flavors And great chai too boot

It was my first time visiting this restaurant, and the experience was amazing. The staff were very busy but still made an effort to provide the best service possible. When we asked about the menu, they patiently explained everything in detail. While we were looking around for sauces, she noticed and kindly guided us to the sauce area. The food was delicious, and the atmosphere was warm and inviting. I would definitely come back.

Good to have a yum cha place in Sylvia Park, this one is pretty standard in terms of taste but the presentation definitely stands out a bit. I really like the addition of shaved ice on the menu. Service was good, and the food came out quickly as well. They do get quite busy on weekends and there was at least a 10-20 minute wait, so we went during off peak hours to avoid that.

The food we had was SO tasty. Staff were friendly. The pork and shrimp sui-mai was delicious. Deep fried prawn dumplings were also so so good. The sweet and sour pork is probably the nicest I have ever tasted. The crispness of the pork along with the sweet/ spur sauce took things to a whole new level of yum!!! I am not sure of the spicy beef dish my son had but he thoroughly enjoyed the meal. I was surprised that the meal was also not over priced. I would recommend trying a few dishes and sharing like we did. All in all a lovely meal out.

Not enough staff to serve customers on weekend lunch time. Ordered tea but not given tea/water nearly every time, and need to ask the staff a few times in order to have tea. The staff are busy working to serve the customers, the issue is not enough staff. Must have to check the bill because orders are sometimes missed while can found in the bill. They have large table to serve group of customers.

Went for dinner with my family, nice place and pretty straightforward in terms of their ordering system. They give you a piece of paper with sections to order from and you write down the number of the item and the quantity that you want and then they take it to the kitchen. That or you can scan the QR code and order too. The food came out pretty promptly and was all good and filling. The drinks were nice and refreshing also too. Would definitely recommend if you're looking for a place to share with friends and family.

This eatery knows nothing about customer experience. I ordered a tempura udon noodle soup. I ended up getting a prawn tempura with its head still on. The tempura was cold. And to make matters worse, they only had a flat wooden stick as spoon. I couldn't even drink my soup properly. If you want your customers to enjoy eating your food, at least think about whether the eating utensils are actually practical enough for them to eat your food! Won't ever be buying anything from there!

Very fresh salmon (it’s really fresh) and freshly cooked rice! Not chilled or taken from the fridge with dried rice and just defrosted fish like most of sushi makers do… Very yummy! Comparing with sushi from botany town food court, “st Perrier” from Pakuranga sushi, and “mr Lee” from Botany junction. Ps - on the photo there are Chicken Yaki Udon and Miso soup.

Ordered two sushi balls (triangles?): tuna mayo and teriyaki salmon. Their tuna mayo is totally delish but wasn't a fan of the teriyaki salmon one - I'm not a fan in general of teriyaki sauce as it's a tad too overpowering so I won't be ordering this particular one again and the salmon was sparse. Staff member who served me was polite but in terms of interaction somewhat transactional. Yes, this is a kiosk in a food court but some small talk would've been nice - it wasn't busy at all or perhaps branches should have self-service kiosks if staff would rather be transactional! Good location.
Food = 5/10 Service = 9/10 The food looked good but wasn't that tasty. The mall was packed so we thought to grab this quickly but it wasnt as pleasant as i imagined.
Had the salmon rice sandwich thing in the morning for breakfast. It was actually tasted pretty good and good amount of grilled salmon with some sweet soy ish based sauce.

Have been there about 4 times. Usually served by the guy and he has been lovely. It is pricey for what it is. Very basic tiptop type ice cream. Single scoop is $6.40. The eftpos machine says no surcharge but it always shows on my bank statement as $6.52 and the shop is registered as Pitapit Westcity which is a bit weird. Today, I was served by a lady and she didn’t scoop it properly. Usually you would put a little ice cream in the cone so it sticks but this was just wobbling on top. The ice cream ball fell off the cone right by the shop as soon as my daughter tapped it with her tongue. I showed it to the lady hoping she could put a bit back on the cone for the kid and all she said was “Would you like to pay for another scoop?” I said “I don’t think I should as you didn’t scoop it properly to begin with.” She did not even say “sorry” or “sorry I can’t do that” and just said “No!” very angrily. This whole place is expensive, dodgy and unfriendly. Do not go.

Shake Paradise is honestly such a good spot the ice cream actually tastes real and fresh not that fake sugary stuff you get at other places their shakes are thick and full of flavor and the fruit flows are perfect when you want something light but still sweet staff are super friendly too they make you feel welcome even if it’s your first time you can tell they put effort into everything tried their winter menu and the sticky date pudding with ice cream was unreal warm soft and just hits different in cold weather definitely recommend this place over any of the big chains once more people find out about it it’s gonna get packed for sure go while you still can without waiting in line

I went there to try it out, and I asked how big the single scoop was, the worker pointed at the photo on one of his signs; a nice round scoop that surpasses the height of the cup, but i was served with about 2 tablespoonsof ice cream. If I'm paying almost 7 dolllars for a scoop, I expect something worth my money.. I would also like to point out that as I was talking to the worker, there were flies touching the ice cream cones that were out in the open the whole day. I was really hoping that this would be a great place to get ice cream, but unless they do better, I wouldn't recommend.
Bought 4 different flavours (goody goody gum drops, cookies and cream, mocha fudge and pistachio and only 1 tasted half way decent. Will not give it a second visit.
Awesome customer service, very good taste, and rich flavor ice cream. Must try once.

We came here for my daughter’s birthday celebration and had a fantastic experience. The food was delicious with plenty of options to choose from. The place was clean and well-kept, and the service was top-notch. A big shoutout to Virginia—she was so warm and welcoming and really made our day extra special. We’ll definitely be back for our next event. Highly recommend!

Dropped in for lunch with my family. We were immediately greeted and taken to our table. The staff are nice, friendly and attentive. The price range for the food is like any other restaurant around $20- $30. The food was nice but I thought it didn't have much seasoning or flavour in my opinion. Tho the herbed butter that was on top of the chargrilled ribeye was bomb. Overall it was pleasant and atmosphere was nice. 6/10 overall experience

We had a wonderful experience here and I want to especially commend Ramizah for her outstanding service. From the moment we walked in, we were greeted warmly and made to feel genuinely welcome. The team was attentive without being intrusive, always ready with a smile and quick to accommodate any requests. Our server was knowledgeable about the menu, made great recommendations, and ensured that everything arrived promptly and just as ordered. It’s clear that the staff takes pride in what they do and works well together to create a relaxed and enjoyable atmosphere. Excellent service really elevated the whole dining experience. Kudos to the entire team — you made our visit memorable. I’ll definitely be returning and recommending this place to friends and family.

Our waitress, Virginia was so friendly and personable. We felt well attended to. She gave excellent recommendations on the food and engaged with us in conversation. Very welcoming. We will definitely be back. Food was great too 😄.

An Impressive vibe and buzzing venue for our Italian flavours Family date night catch-up with hungry teens. The Artichoke Spread & Garlic Pizzas as entrees didn’t last at all. My new fave is the Espresso Martini (on Tap) The Soft drink size jugs are solid and enough for our family. Good size portions of food, delicious and tasty. Definitely good value as well as - awesome service, loving our new local. Being residents of Mt Wgtn for years over 48 years, it’s nice to have options down the Terrace Lane without having to travel too far. Thanks to the lovely Maggie and the team that made our evening special. Bonus is the Star Social Rewards, definitely will be back!

While there prices are reasonable, the burger not so much. Unfortunately, the burger patty was undercooked and had to get a new one made. Also, if they used proper ketchup for sauce instead of the cheap tomato sauce, it would make the burger 10x better.
I've absolutely loved my burger, it was very flavorful. Easily one of the best burgers I've ever had.
The worst nuggets taste. The quality is poor I ordered burger n it had angus patty was tasteless. Not recommending to anyone.
Best burger I've ever had i will definitely be coming back and what wonderful friendly staff the waffle was amazing aswel
Food was amazing the first day they opened, second time was not that good, chips weren’t good either. Hopefully third time will be a charm…..

Honestly, the best food I've had! I was filled with so much happiness when we left. Henry is amazing, and the chefs definitely know what they're doing! Everything was fresh and delicious; I couldn't fault anything. This will be our new spot for sure!!! Thank you for the amazing experience (carlene and adam) 😁

the first Vietnamese spot I visited during my trip to Auckland, and I had high hopes walking in. First impressions were great. The aesthetic was spot-on—trendy, vibrant, and clearly inspired by Vietnamese culture. It had a modern, welcoming vibe that made it a nice place to settle in for a meal. Service was another highlight: the staff were friendly, attentive, and really accommodating, making sure we were well looked after throughout our visit. However, when it came to the food, things didn’t quite live up to expectations. I ordered the pho, and while it was decent, it wasn’t anything that stood out—and at $30 for a bowl, I really expected more. The portion size wasn’t particularly large, and the flavour, while good, wasn’t anything memorable. For the price, it just didn’t feel like great value. A couple of my mates ordered the dry pho and said their dishes were a bit better, so it might have just been my choice that missed the mark. Maybe some of the other menu items shine a little more. Overall, VietFlames is a nice spot if you’re looking for a cool atmosphere and good service, but based on my experience, the food quality and value could definitely be improved—especially if you’re used to more authentic or heartier Vietnamese options elsewhere. I’m still glad I gave it a go, but next time I might try something different off their menu or check out another Vietnamese place around town.

The Vietnamese food here is delicious and prepared in a fusion style. The portions are generous and the prices are reasonable. The food was served very quickly. However, a few dishes were a bit salty for my taste, so I recommend ordering some rice or rice noodle on the side. The staff were friendly, and the restaurant was clean. I’ll definitely come back

Nice spacious seating and chairs were comfy. Fast service from when we placed our order. You have to order by scanning a barcode and choosing your meal through a link and then paying the bill before you leave. Loved the prawn and chive dumplings I would def order those again. Decent portions and good flavours.

A Hidden Gem on Sylvia Lane, 5/5 Experience Dined in for lunch on Wednesday, 23 July 2025 What a fantastic dining experience! Tucked away on Sylvia Lane, this Vietnamese restaurant is a clean and inviting hideaway that makes you feel welcome the moment you walk in. We were greeted warmly by the head waitress, who led us to a cozy corner table with leather seats tucked just far enough from the main dining area to feel a little bit private, which I really appreciated. We ordered seven dishes and were absolutely blown away: Prawn & Chive Dumplings: Hot, tender, and packed with flavour. Perfect for a cold winter’s day. Ocean-Kissed Salmon: Delicately salted and beautifully balanced with herbs and veggies. Lemongrass Chicken Curry: Comforting with the added twist of kumara confit and bamboo salad. Shaking Beef: My standout dish. I asked for it medium rare and it arrived absolutely perfect. Melt-in-your-mouth tender and rich in flavour. Papaya Beef Medley: Fresh and zingy, with that unmistakable Vietnamese herb-and-pickle crunch. Tropical Prawn Fusion: Light, refreshing, and lifted by the passionfruit dressing. Mango Pana Cotta: I don’t usually order panna cotta, but this one was heavenly. Creamy, coconutty, and absolutely unforgettable. We shared one between three people, and I’m pretty sure I only got one spoonful before it disappeared. I’ll be ordering one for myself next time! To drink, we had the sugarcane juice refreshing, all-natural, and full of pure goodness. At the end of our meal, I had the pleasure of chatting with Chef Jayson, who, along with his wife (our waitress), runs the restaurant with real heart and soul. He shared how passionate he is about creating quality food for his loyal customers, and it shows. As he said, “When you do what you’re passionate about, it doesn’t feel like work.” From food to service to atmosphere, this place is exceptional. 5/5 from me, and I can’t wait to return.

We had a great time there- girls night out. Highly recommend the Kong tap beer! The Asian Smoked Fish was delicious and well plated. The experience was great, end with a big smile from Rohit 😆 thank you guys!

The staff and food were exceptional. The pork ribs were perfectly crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, with a hint of spice—definitely among the best I've had in New Zealand. The chicken and pork bao buns were light, fluffy, and packed with flavor. The yellow curry was expertly prepared, with vegetables that melted in your mouth and a rich, delicious curry. The Peking duck had fantastic flavor, though the large-cut pieces made it a bit tricky to assemble and eat. The customer service was outstanding and truly couldn’t have been better. 10/10 would highly recommend, get the ribs you won't regret it.
Excellent service from Ramizah and the Master Kong crew. Dishes were full of flavour. Perfect meal for a cold winters night. A+ food and service. We’ll be back again. Thank you 😊

We’ve ordered 4 dishes and they were all superb in taste! Thai yellow curry shouldn’t be missed when you visit there - i would say this is my best pick. The thick sauce blends well with the crispy chicken on top that’s so juicy and tender with the crunchiness for every bite😋

Lovely Asian street vibes, the food was not too bad, nothing that wows you. However it is on the pricey side for what you get. We ordered 3 dishes from the ‘Snack’ section and a lemon lime n bitters and it came to $70! You can get decent Asian flavours and very filling for half the price elsewhere. The corn ribs were quite nice, love the chargrilled taste, but 6 little pieces for $19 is not worth the price. Same with the bbq chicken on skewers, meat is tender and not overly salty. But not $22 worth for 4 short skewers. Last one we got was the popcorn prawns, can definitely skip it! Batter was too thick, not authentic Taiwanese flavours and again should not be $23 for the amount you get. Lemon lime bitters was nice though. If you are all about the vibe then maybe it’s a good place to get together but we definitely won’t be back

3/5 stars. Service was average. The food is fairly decent, there wasn't much to choose from and some of the items were not available. I had the chicken katsu curry, my friend had the pork ramen. Portion sizes were small. I couldn't ask for more curry in my meal because it wasn't available. Average experience nothing too outstanding and the price is ok i guess.
Nice place but not so good foods. Chicken Katsu is covered with very thick flour and it wasn’t hot and not crispy, but at the same time the chicken is so dry.

Big and spacious restaurant located in the Dining Precint on Sylvia Park. Service was good and overall restaurant was tidy and had nice ambience. In terms of taste, I did find it a little more on the bland side.
Very popular restaurant, some of the things weren't available on the menu which resulted in a small selection. Broth was alittle salty for our liking but the salmon sushi was very good

The dining experience was disappointing overall. The menu consisted primarily of deep-fried fast food options with limited variety. The pricing was particularly unreasonable - paying $11 for just 11 yam fries felt excessive for such a small portion. Complete rip off. The service was equally problematic. Despite multiple reminders, our fries didn't arrive until after we'd finished our main courses. Similarly, our drinks came out halfway through the meal, and only after we had to follow up about them.

The Grove Dining District is not just one restaurant, but an area with around 15 restaurants located around the center of Sylvia Park. Thank you for always having various shops open from morning until late at night.

This was our second visit and we were equally impressed. Service fast and friendly, chicken was wholesome and the burger actually looked like the image on the screen, full of fresh salad and both beef and chicken burgers were delicious. Chicken tenders were huge and could have been shared.

Very first time trying , I always walk past this place , can’t believe I’ve just tried it now. Came on a Thursday around 3pm wasn’t busy at all , ordered on the kiosk. Waited around 10 mins. I got the cheeseburger combo and fried chicken on the side. It was delicious! Burger was hot and fresh , chips & chicken were hot & fresh too! Definitely will be coming back here! Staff were very friendly aswell 🙂‍↕️❤️

Came on a Tuesday lunch time and it was not very busy, lots of available tables. Ordered at the kiosk and sat down. The food was prepared quickly and I was alerted to pick it up by the buzzer. I ordered the Cheeseburger Combo. The burger was freshly made and the chips were tasty and hot.

Bad experience with my order at the Sylvia park better burger. As you can see with the photos my food was all burnt which is why I gave it a low rating. The ponsonby better burger joint buffalo wings are cooked to perfection especially on a night out.

I ordered a cheeseburger combo. I was disappointed by the size of the beef patty. I think it should be bigger.. I wanted to try the passionfruit mountaindew but it was pure soda, no flavour.. I also went to the toilet and there was no soap and toilet paper..

Margaritas were aesthetically beautiful but didn't really taste as how we ordered them to be, but was still okay. The fried chicken...juicy and moist but can't really tell apart the chipotle mayo and jalapeño mayo. They both tasted like regular mayo. Not spicy at all despite having 3x 🌶🌶🌶 on the menu.

Pretty decent place to meet up with a few mates, have some drinks, and share a few plates. Chicken platter had some tasty options, and was only slightly too dry but it was okay still with the dry rubs or sauces. Chicken burger looked massive. Quesadillas were only okay, the beef cheek one being the better one. Jalapeno poppers were way better and more real than any others I've ever had. But buying individual tacos and trying all 3-4 of them was definitely the best option. Got a couple buckets of Coronas with limes and then the margaritas. Drinks naturally get expensive very quick. They did have a virgin sangria too if you're not looking to drink. We didn't opt for the different tequila tasting flights this night, but perhaps a future day. As for the place itself, wish the seats were a tad more comfortable. As for the ambience, walls were absolutely covered with art and framed images which did lend a good themed feel to the place.

Popular place with amazing decor!!! Authentic Mexican flavours and recipes. Love the Mexican fried chicken and the small tacos were delish!!! Service was great from start to finish, friendly, great smiles and advice. Feed me for $40 per person was great value and a great way to be introduced to the cuisine. Definately recommend!!!

I've been to a few Mexico branches and this one did not disappoint either - well, apart from the magic chicken which was a little dry, but their margaritas made up for it. The service was exceptional and vibe/setting better than the rest. If you're up for a little casual but exotic night out with friends and family this is a good one to go.

Came to celebrate my hubby's birthday here with the whole whanau. Grandkids love the chicken taco, enjoyed their drawings, celebrant enjoyed his superb braised pork belly with perfect presentation. Service was great and food not so bad. Will recommend this place. 👍

We ordered the cheese platter and olives. For the main we got the La Famiglia which you choose a pizza and pasta, and chips to share. Between the three of us girls, this was the best selection paired with a white wine. The hospitality was awesome very friendly and welcoming. Toilets within the restaurant were clean and user friendly for wheelchair. Would be a returning customer thank you for the amazing hospitality!

Celebrated a birthday here last week and had a great experience! We ordered dessert and asked if they could write "happy birthday" on it and they happily did. Service was excellent, and the food portions were generous. Their coffee is just $4 on weekdays if you order before 12 noon. The only downside is that the food is a bit pricey. Overall, still a great spot for special occasions!

We had a great experience here. Customer service was awesome! They made the experience that much better. Food was absolutely delicious. If it the fries came out hot I definitely would’ve given it full star rating. My wife loves Italian and we would most definitely recommend this place to people that enjoy Italian food!

Absolutely loved my experience at Baci! The atmosphere is warm and inviting, and the vibrant fuchsia and yellow color scheme was cheerful. ❤️The staff were incredibly friendly, making the whole visit feel extra welcoming. Even the food had this comforting, almost friendly quality to it (if that makes sense!). Can’t wait to come back!

had a lovely time here for a company farewell dinner! firstly the atmosphere was amazing, the heat lamps provided a nice ambience, but was also functional during the cold weather. the candles were a nice touch and the architecture, walls, trees and vines were a beautiful touch to replicate a nice venue in italy. the food was quite nice and the pizza was a good portion size. the fries were delicious and our individual dishes were well portioned and yummy. i had the ribs and they fell apart off the bone and was tender, complimented with the acidic slaw that cut through the fat. my only critic is that the bones were quite large in comparison to the meat, but i’m sure that varies from rack to rack. however, my highlight of the night was the service. all the staff were highly attentive and the front of house lady was so kind and hospitable. she even offered us free garlic bread on the house for our table. we shared a few laughs with the waitresses and manager. thank you so much Baci for an unforgettable night! will definitely come back in the future :)

Absolutely loved my visit to Taco Bell Sylvia Park! I ordered the Chicken Quesadilla and Cantina Bowl combo, and it did not disappoint. The quesadilla was perfectly grilled with a generous amount of tender chicken and just the right amount of spice. The Cantina Bowl was fresh and packed with flavor — the mix of rice, beans, veggies, and guac hit the spot. I also got a side of large nacho chips and a Coke Zero — classic combo. The chips were warm, crispy, and went great with the dips. Service was fast and friendly, and the place was clean with a good vibe. Will definitely be coming back next time I’m at Sylvia Park. Highly recommend if you're after a quick, tasty, and satisfying meal!
Always get to buy the Crispy Chicken Double Combo. Tastes so nice and Service by Staff is always on point. Good variety of food options they have to chose from. Highly recommend them.

I had the beefy cheesy and it was yum, however Mr Fun Police (White guy with glasses) came and told me to get out cause I was harmlessly basketball shooting my paper bag into the bin. It created an awkward atmosphere and made me feel very unsafe and uncomfortable in the store. Not sure this is how you should approach loyal customers. I’m really not impressed. Please consider tweaking your hiring process.

The chicken wrap was alright, but the chips were quite stale and cold. However, my main disappointment was not with the food, and rather the subpar customer service experience. Unfortunately, my friends and I were greeted unwelcomingly, and the guy with the glasses made for an uncomfortable experience when he told my friends to leave after throwing a paper bag into the bin. Such a minute thing for such an adverse reaction was unwelcome and disappointing.

Finally we went in after passing so many times. Food was dearer than Maccas and kfc. It is also different to the Taco Bell in the USA. If you don’t know the food very well you wouldn’t know who ordered which. Everything was presented on the same tray. I agree with other comments, the restaurant and tables were very dirty, no one doing the lobby. I guess customers can help themselves to wipe the tables?

Having no idea they close in ten minutes I walk in and ask if I can still be served - after realizing their closing time inside. The staff were polite and kind, I had the late shift staff, 2 lovely ladies served me and another cleaned the beautiful fast food store. They left this place spotless and I was able to take immaculate photos. This is the second time I made the mistake of coming so late, both times I've been met with kindness, patience and welcoming. On the last day of February, I was feeling really low on the inside. You really made my day. I was shocked reading all these stupid reviews. Most people have nothing better to do than complain about KFC and McDonald's to get free food. Having worked in the fast food industry, no matter how many staff you have on board, or how many times you've cleaned the tables. Their job is to touch up after you, not mop, clean, collect all your trash and on the odd occasion need a hazmat suit, because some hooligans can't keep their children from going on the floor. Others have images of how messy and poorly they're eating. Check yourself before you wreck yourself. Leave these teenagers alone and get a life).

Camped outside the doors for when it opened g and my chips were still cold and unseasoned? and my cheese was unmelted on my double deown. Be mindful guys. The 3 Indian staff working kept chatting instead of making my meal.. took about 10 mins just to make my food when the store was empty and the Islander guy gave me funny looks while handing my food like rolling his eyes like he didn’t want to be at work I almost got up there and punched him g Only good part of my experience was the funny Indian guy with the big poofta haircut He stink out the restaurant like old spice cologne though my eyes were watering

I bought the 6.99 chicken popcorn box and tell me why the box was near empty. Like my brother in Christ I had such a tiring day today and I pay bloody 7 dollars for some fries and buggies and I barely get anything?? Tell me why the staff were yapping in the kitchen instead of focusing on orders cus I wasted like 25min of my 30 min lunch break. So disappointed,what a rip-off

This is the worst KFC! The worker was not paying attention to their job, just standing and talking. I asked for no salt on the chips. But I got salty chips instead. Chicken is dried and uncooked. Not coming back here again!

Rather quite appalling to see all the reviews being one to two stars although, the staff attitudes really do need to change. If it weren’t for the nice cleaners there working hard, would’ve been a 1 star. Extremely rude to customers and the food wasn’t great, the proportion of the salad to the chicken was quite off, too much chicken and little salad underneath. Not worth 10$

Disappointed in their Fish. The batter was undercooked and didn't look nice at all. $5.50 per fish and we got 6. They don't know how to cook battered fish. We got potato fritters and they were good better. Donk know why they can be see different sorry but won't be going back there.

Quality of food is severely sub par sadly. Fish fillet was soggy and no flavour - I believe the deep fryer is severely under temp which prevents it from cooking the batter well. They have proper wok to cook with, but I ordered with a fried rice noodles but it was bland and had no wokhei flavour.

I waited 70 minutes to come home with horrible food! I paid $62.00 for uncooked pork, noodles with curry powder thrown on them and black hair found in my Chinese food. Save your time and money and purchase from somewhere else! I didn’t want another one cooked for me I just wanted a refund and I would’ve been happy.

2nd time coming back! 1st time I got chicken and chips! Highly disappointed, thought I’d come for the 2nd time and try their fish and chips, it’s so oily chips are not nice like they need to change their oil! Had to wait nearly an hour just for this!!! Definitely not going back there

Kiaora. Been a loyal customer for 30 plus years. Always great tukka, but as the world progress with the likes of Uber Eats, these people have lost focus on real customers. Forget phone orders, cause you still wait 20>30 valuable minutes. Whilst waiting yet again, how about posting an "A Grade" health certificate, and looking at the disgraceful, dirty facade and front counter. Regain your core focus on good kai.
My first order from this branch (tonight) was delicious with fresh toppings and a perfectly made pizza base and sauces. It was made and delivered in under 20 minutes too. Highly recommend.

Ordered via Uber eats, Pizza club has a special deal Buy 1 get 1 free for their Chicken pesto pasta, sounds good, food arrived in very small take out boxes-enough to feed a small child. Barely any chicken pieces. My box had 1 piece & & 3 tiny shaved pieces! 3 stars for flavour & colourwise, nice pasta, although more chicken would of been nice & Pasta barely filled to the rim 🤦🏽‍♀️. 1 star for the very small boxes & whatever leftovers that was put in them.

every time I recommend pizza club that’s true and I like pizza club, but honestly, I’m giving the review, I called Mont Wellington pizza club and I give order to store person on call, He told me tandoori slingshot pizza is $23 which is the correct price ok but I don’t wanna normal chicken in slingshot pizza I wanna tandoori chicken in Slingshot pizza. The store parson told me it’s gonna be $3 extra for tandoori chicken so first time I am facing this issue only mt Wellington branch that’s why I give a honest review next time I never think to come back this store specially thank you pizza club mont Wellington branch owner😊

Went to order chicken wings and paneer....probably a 30-40 order and 4 staff there....guy tells me in very broken English to use the electronic kiosk. I don't use self-serve and don't use kiosks. Told him that, and he didn't give two shits. Yet they will take phone orders. Left without food.

I absolutely loved the tandoori chicken pizza at Pizza Club! The blend of smoky tandoori flavors with the gooey cheese and crispy crust was a delightful explosion of taste. Each bite was a perfect balance of spicy and savory, and the generous toppings of tender tandoori chicken, onions, and bell peppers made every slice a true treat. I'll definitely be coming back for more of this incredibly delicious and unique pizza creation!
Great place. They weren't open for dining just online orders but they encouraged us to dine anyway. Lovely caring personalities. Food excellent 👌 service exceptional.

They serve 5 star food for dine in and for takeaway this is what you get. Absolutely stale veges and only filled with mushrooms and broccoli. And its not that they are giving you takeaway food price cheap… its still the same. What a shame … added pic of green curry and rice. Who would want to eat that.
Good quality Thaifood and very fast service. Good lunch deal. Thank you.

Food was fine but I wouldn’t get the papaya salad. There was too much lemon. Customer service was poor. She wasn’t nice to us when we ordered our food or seemed judgemental until we paid for our food and she was nice. Otherwise everything else was nice. A little on the pricey end.
It's amazing place to have lunch and dinner. High standard taste and very kind staffs. Very pleased to have meals here.

Stopped by for dinner because the restaurant name suggested Vietnamese cuisine, but surprisingly, none of the staff were Vietnamese. The young female staff member with a ponytail who served us had an unwelcoming attitude. Our food took a long time to arrive. The 'Hu Tieu' was actually made with Pho noodles, not the correct type, which was disappointing. Most of the ingredients seemed to be frozen rather than fresh. The Banh Mi was just okay, lacking authentic Vietnamese flavor. The grilled chicken with broken rice (Com Tam) was average at best. Pros: The noodle soup bowl was large, and the Vietnamese 'La Voi' herbal drink was warm and quite good.

I remember the days when this place was absolutely buzzing (especially at their original location a few steps away). There was always a queue of people waiting at the door. Not sure what happened but the food is quite disappointing now. There is no love in their food anymore although their menu is still the same. The simple pickled cabbages were inedible. Pork was dry and overcooked. Soup was bland. So very sad. Oh, they have a robot delivering food to the tables now though!

We had dinner there. We were surprised at how big the restaurant is. The menu was more complete compared to Hansan Newmarket. The service was quick, and the delivery robot was cute. We had spring rolls, pork satay vermicelli, and stir fry beef with rice. It was delicious 😋 We enjoyed our dinner very much.

DONT TRY BUFFET ! I felt ripped off . It says all you can eat and the lady just sent random meals and when I asked for more she did everything possible not to send the dishes out . It's not order what you want more she sends whatever . The food was ok somethings nice fresh others been sitting a while and just really crap food. I'm only talking about the buffet style not the food off the menu Read other reviews about service and it's correct its not good at all. I only came her after seen on social media how great the buffet was and it really isn't what it seems .. I suggest trying MR HAO that was really nice and better value
Such a great wee gem, glad I found this place will definitely be back, food flavours are outstanding and service was awesome, loved the robot server playing music when it brings the food out.

So underrated! This is the best value Peking Duck in Auckland. You do need to call ahead and order for the duck but it is worth it. The other mains are also super tasty and portion sizes are huge. The food comes out pretty fast. Very authentic- my Chinese families favourite place. The interior is quite bare but it’s worth overlooking for the food.
Excellent Peking duck and amazing hot food dishes. The chef comes out to carve the duck at the table as part of a dinner and show. If you are in Panmure make sure to stop by and try it out!

If you’re craving Beijing duck, you definitely have to visit this place. The owner is from Beijing, so the taste is truly authentic. It gave me a real taste of home, even in a foreign country. I’m really grateful.

We had special lunch here with three dishes which are 9.9NZD each. Really good deal for us cos it’s some warm and comfort dish to remind our childhood family food. My partner has been to this restaurant for more than 10yrs and he felt sad the business is not going well like before. We shout out for them and want them to serve the community for longer time. Sometimes simple is the best so no need to expect more and just come to have a nice lunch.
The duck is OULY $68 including three dishes plus the pancake and source, which is enough to feed two people. Other dishes like spicy pork ribs and golden spinach are delicious!!!
Delicious pizza! Big range of options to choose from and the flavours are so appetising. Best to order ahead, as it can get very busy in weekends and night time.

Have been a loyal customer here for over 5 years, I have known multiple owners of the store in these years and and have always had great service and any mix ups have been sorted no issues, after having the dominoes app not work and didn’t seem to have put my order through correctly I had one occasion of not collecting this order.. I have since spoken in store about the mix up and even paid for the uncollected order and have ordered multiple times since… I am now still refused orders through phone call to pick up and make online orders, I must now order over the counter which destroys the purpose of takeaway food, rather disappointed and will no longer order here… 5+ years of regular Buisness down the drain….

Quite disappointed by the order I placed tonight. I didn’t think that adding Cheesy Crust and Garlic Cheesy crust for $3.99 & $5 would make the “Large” pizzas basically turn into small pizzas. You’d think that paying extra for a special crust wouldn’t mean the pizza in itself would be a whole lot smaller. Paying an additional $4 for an Extra Large Pizza is quite disappointing when it turns out to just be the equivalent of a large pizza at other restaurants. I also paid $5.20 for EXTRA prawns on the Garlic Prawn pizza and got basically 1-2 prawns per slice (as per the photo). Extremely disappointed, and thought that I’d give Domino’s a try again since they were under New Management. My mistake, I’ve just been let down again 😕

Ordered my pizza with double paneer here and got the normal amount of paneer, which in itself isn't a problem, but when i approached the staff about it, they said, " it is double paneer ". I order this exact pizza 3-4 times a week between New Lynn, Blockhouse Bay, and onehunga stores. so I know what double paneer looks like. Very unprofessional behavior by the staff and would suggest everyone in my circle to avoid this store
I think it said change in management a couple of months ago. So i tried but the same cost saving on toppings. Still disappointing Pics attached. Ordered under same name on the date of this review

Service was good, portions are good value for money. Only let down was the food just didn’t taste as good. Fish burger desperately needed seasoning, fried rice had no flavour at all. I’m sure the fish and chips are good as long as you ask for extra seasoning or any seasoning at all

Huge portions, tasty foods, quick service. Down the road in panmure on the busy queen road. i ordered on phone for a fish burger less than $7 and HUGGGE asf fish and soft bun, my partner got the $20 sweet n sour pork+ fried rice and they didn’t not skimp on the pork, it had more sweet n sour pork than rice!!!! The pork was fresh and delicious. Definitely going to be back many times!
Absolutely delicious. The chips were good and the batter on the fish was flakey. This is my favorite takeaway shop in Panmure, the owner is awesome and he has a strong work ethic. 😄

Hi there peoples. This place used to be good back in the days but unfortunately this takeaways has changed big time. The prices on the menu are such a rip off! and the quality of the food is tasteless and he’s quite stingy with the portions that he gives us all. Talk about day light robbery this chinese is ripping people off left right and center. Crap food and crap prices. What a robber!
Got some real nice fish n chips from here. A great place for instant food if you love asian food.

I had a great experience at this noodle shop during my recent visit. The service was incredibly fast and the staff were friendly and welcoming. I ordered the hotbox and pork fried rice, both of which were delicious and served in generous portions. I also appreciated how accommodating they were with dietary needs. I'll definitely be back for more.

Ordered Chicken Fried Noodles added Cashew Nuts on top.. Great Service.. Average Food… Would be nice to have food in rectangular containers instead of round..The gravy sits at the bottom and in the end you end up with heaps of Sauce at the bottom that should be mixed already 😈
It is a takeaway restaurant. Prices ranges between $17 and $22. The food is well-made with good ingredients. Do not expect a fancy place. Day to day place to eat.
Lovely as food! Big portions too. Staff were very friendly and fast.
Went there to get takeway noodles after doing some grocery shopping and the serving speed is insanely fast! Portions are huge and delicious! Excellent service with super friendly staff.

The food was amazing and so flavourful. A bit of a wait for the food but it was worth it. The staff are so friendly, they even took my 2yr old and showed him around the restaurant while we finished eating our meals. Would highly recommend. 😊
great food service and atmosphere will surely go again

A thoroughly enjoyable dinner with different flavours and served nicely hot fresh out of the wok. The Thai fishcakes had a crisp outer and bouncy bite. They were delicious with the sweet chilli sauce. The spring rolls were crisp and crunchy but the filling was a little bland in flavour so sauce was needed. The tofu Tom Yum soup was light and filled with tofu tomatoes mushrooms and vegetables. It had just enough heat to give its own taste. The more spicier Panang vegetarian tofu curry differed from the slightly sweeter duck red curry. Both were super tasty though the Panang curry was creamier. With great 'wok-hei' to give the high heat toasty flavour of the roti, it was the best I've eaten for a while. Finely layered roti came with the peanut dipping sauce which was very moreish. The beef Thai salad was refreshing and tasty. A good size serving too. A tasty and flavoursome dinner. Again my eyes were more hungry than my stomach so had to pass on the dessert round. A banana fritter would have round off the dinner so will have come back soon. The staff were very friendly and polite, quick to fix a menu selection and prompt meal preparation. Being early diners it was quiet on arrival but it soon filled up. The food must be good because there was a steady stream of online delivery meals too.

Really tasty curry but portions were surprisingly small for $20+ a dish. Even though the portion of curry was small, it didn’t come with enough rice. The fried rice was bland and the beef was very tough. Again, quite a small portion for what is literally rice and frozen veges tossed in a wok.
this place is really nice. honestly the staff and waiters are so friendly. fairly sized portions and cheap

Well made juicy burgers especially the hamburgini that I got which had such a great toasted bun and well cooked and juicy meat. Also the burnout ( the chicken burger) was a great balance of meat and veges and it was pretty great overall . I would have preferred thicker chicken meat on the burnout but I still think it was fine. The service was good and this place has a great aesthetic and vibe

I just had burgers this morning from this store. A staff was so friendly and kind. And it took just 10mins to receive them, burgers were also tasty and juicy. Fries are crunch and I love them. Lastly, he gave a free Alioli fries coupon for the next order. I will definitely revisit it soon :)
Really well made burgers that we had. And the staff member was very courteous and cheerful. Highly recommended and will be back again .

Felt for the two female staff members who were under the pump and doing their best to get orders out and serve customers. They did an amazing job though. Food was hot and tasty. Will revisit again when I'm in the mood for a burger.

These guys are outstanding- man their food is amazing and they are so hospitable. There is a reason why this is considered one of the best burger joints in NZ - it all comes down to their food and their amazing staff!! Viva Pakuranga !

Visited Subway recently here and had a great experience. The staff were very friendly and professional. I asked them to grill my sub, and they did it perfectly crispy, warm, and full of flavor! Everything was fresh, and the service was quick too. Definitely coming back. Highly recommended!
YO whoever made my sub today you’re the goat fr ty so much was 11/10.
Was served by named Chloe and her service was horrible
The customer service here was great and my sub was delicious. Meatball Mondays! !!!

Got to our favorite Subway at 18.40 for the girl to tell us no more customers she was closing. customers before us they got through but we argued with her she doesn't close till 7 it even States clothing 7. So closing was in 20 minutes it would have only taken a few minutes to make us a Subway so we went away hungry. This was not the first encounter with this person she's a very unpleasant person to deal with. No problems of anyone else.

Called in here for lunch and loved what I ordered which is their steak sandwich that comes with potato skins, it is the best steak sandwich ever! Not to mention how its cooked medium rare, it is amazing! The restaurant is spacious and clean, customer service is also excellent.

Thank you for an unforgettable birthday dinner! Porterhouse Grill is an unforgettable dining experience that exceeds expectations in every way. From the moment you walk in, you’re welcomed with a warm, inviting atmosphere and impeccable service that sets the stage for what’s to come. The restaurant’s elegant yet comfortable setting creates the perfect backdrop for a meal that is nothing short of spectacular. The highlight, of course, is the food. The signature Porterhouse Prime Rib steak is a true showstopper—perfectly cooked to your liking. It’s tender, juicy, and packed with flavor. Paired with expertly crafted sides, each bite is a testament to the restaurant’s commitment to excellence. The variety of other offerings, from seafood to poultry, is equally impressive, with each dish expertly prepared and beautifully presented. What truly sets Porterhouse Grill apart, however, is the attention to detail. Every aspect of the dining experience is thoughtfully curated, from the wine selection, which features a wide range of both local and international labels to the desserts that offer a perfect sweet finish to the meal. The staff is knowledgeable, attentive, and genuinely eager to ensure your experience is flawless. Whether you’re celebrating a special occasion or simply indulging in a luxurious meal, Porterhouse Grill delivers on all fronts—combining exceptional food, top-notch service, and a welcoming atmosphere to create a dining experience that is sure to leave a lasting impression. A true gem in the culinary world!

Visited Porterhouse Grill and tried the steak and chicken schnitzel. The steak was well-grilled and definitely the highlight of the meal—no complaints there. Unfortunately, the chicken schnitzel was overcooked and quite bland, and the sauce didn’t really complement the dish. Service was just okay—not particularly warm or attentive, but not bad either. The restaurant has a fancy feel to it, but the lighting was a bit too dim for my taste, which took away from the overall atmosphere. Price-wise, it’s reasonable for the steak, but considering the quality of the other dishes, there’s definitely room for improvement. Might come back for the steak, but would skip the schnitzel next time.

My scotch fillet was delicious! Mashed potato and mushroom sauce were also great - happy with the portion sizes. My partners NY strip was a good portion size but overcooked (ordered medium, and got well-done) which made the steak a bit dry. Had to rely on the mushroom sauce. Service was lovely and attentive.

We haven't been there quite awhile since the road work. We have an early dinner around 5:30pm, there were only 4 table of customers. Not busy. Our steaks were well cooked, so juicy and yummy. However, since we started to eat, we appreciated the waitress attention, but seriously need to be appropriated. They constantly asking nicely to take our dish away, even we haven't finish and obviously still eating. They even given out the dessert menu while we still having our main. At this point, half of our mood had gone. Once our dish had finally taken away, the waitress again, constantly asked when r we going to order, this time even ask how long we will take to think, 15 mins or 20 mins? This is unacceptable. There were only 4 table of customer, not full house, why kept rushing our dinner. Be fair, the food is good, but I will never come because of this service. Sorry but not sorry.
Fair prices and great service! Food was tasty and generous portions (We had the burger combo wich comes with fries and a can of soda for $16). We will definitely be back soon. Thank you!
Great service. Amazing food. Been a several times. Happily take family. Family friendly within reasonable hours. Kids love it and they loved the food. Thanks so much for the hospitality.
Called in here for a HYOKETSU, taste like 🍋 lemonade for $11.50🤔🤔🤔

ORDERED: 1x Rump steak, Med-well with fries & salad 1x Pork Belly with salad and dollop of aioli 2x cans of Coke Zero PRICING: $55.00 Service was GREAT and served with a smile and conversation. The atmosphere was great with music in the background, sports on the TVs and general public loving this setup. Its our first time here to try the lunch. We will come here again 10/10.

Was really empty the day we went, not just in locals but even the vibe where it honestly different really feel like it had any personality; drab? We weren't there when anyone was performing on the stage to see what that experience may have been like. Was a pool table too and TAB betting next door. Standard beer selection. Not saying it doesn't look clean, but nothing to draw me back.
Why they are so cheap? I wonder if they will make money cos the food is so big quantity and tastes so great! The owner he is very nice and offers some free drinks. They should have more customers!

We been to Jian Xiang restaurant for many years. We normally come here every few weeks. The sour pork vegetable soup is our must go dish. The pancake is crispy and tasty. We normally come here for dinner. The price is very reasonable. With all the inflation during Covid lockdown, the owner is still maintaining low price. We can enjoy the dinner for four less than a hundred dollars. Well done.
I ve order tofu on rice through doordash. It came with chicken is not mentioned in the description. I am vegetarian. No dinner for me tonight and its a waste of money. It should be mention it.

The outside and inside decor was mininal. Menu with photos look presentable. Prices were reasonably cheap. Serving portions were standard. Food was tasty :) it was our first time there it was good to support locals. Will be bringing new people to try different dishes next time.

The restaurant did not adhere to the dietary requirements and allergens stated. This is a safety issue. I ordered the Stir Fried Tofu with Chilli dish from Uber Eats because it is stated to be vegetarian（ 素菜料）under the menu heading. I had also explicitly written in the instructions in Mandarin and English that it is to be completely vegetarian ( 完全素食) When the order arrived, there were meat pieces in the dish. I called the restaurant only to be informed that it is beef. This is a serious issue, and I hope the restaurant can be more cautious with future orders. I do not recommend this restaurant to vegetarians.

A hidden gem in Panmure. A vast array of flavors, with patient and friendly staff who will help you sample different flavors. Amazing pricing as well. Would definitely recommend for a snack, whether it's for you or for the family.

Delicious popcorn place with a lot of savoury and sweet options! I was struggling to place the order online so called through to the store - Alli was friendly and professional, he delivered my order same day and even included some freebies :) Highly recommend Amaize for some quality popcorn

This is a reason to visit Panmure, such quality popcorn for the price and the selection is amazing. Has to be the best popcorn I’ve eaten. Highly recommend visit here to try flavours. Lovely man running shop.

Such good popcorn! Cute little store and the owner was lovely, he let us try a whole bunch of flavours before we picked what we wanted which was helpful because there were so many options and they all looked delicious. We went with Peri Peri and Churro Caramel and both were so yum. Will be back again for sure.
