Yum! Ordered online for delivery, picked lots of different flavours to try. All have been great but I especially like the jalapeño! Would be cool to have a mix of the jalapeño and the cheese flavours! Definitely will order again!

First time at a Fillipino restaurant, and was really good, something different, but liked the flavours, friendly staff that explained everything so we could choose, and my favourite was the pork with shrimp paste and the quail eggs, but we had a fish and a tofu dish also, which were both good :)

It’s a must try for anyone visiting in Kalye Manila. We had the crispy pata and it is cooked to perfection. Also, if you love pork, you will also love their sisig! And the sinigang na bangus is a very comforting dish! The service is friendly, warm and inviting!

Celebrating daughter’s birthday with family and friends. Our experience at this restaurant was nothing short of exceptional. From the moment we arrived until we left, we felt welcomed and pampered by the food and the service. I highly recommend it! Kapampangan taste! The staff here truly cares about their guests. They were attentive, courteous, and polite. They made us feel like VIPs.
Their meal sets are satisfying and value for money! I love their palabok. Sulit!

Me and my husband went to Kalye Manila and the food was great! Service is also excellent. I recommend the bangus ala pobre and their ube cake. We really love how the cream complements the ube flavor. I will recommend this to my friends.

Pure vegetarian food, a large variety of dishes to opt. Owner is in the business and provides good service. Comparatively large dining area, hygiene and clean. They also have a 300 person capacity hall to cater for weddings or any other functions.

The gentleman that served us was very helpful & made sure or meals were good. Servings were small so it's good to get a few dishes. The down side of having a few different curries is the price does add up. The place is very clean & would recommend to vegans and vegetarians as they have nice dishes & are -Vegetarian Society Approved-

Yummy 100% vegetarian food. Very clean 'A' grade food certificate with plenty of parking. Friendly staff. Also the hall is available for hire. Visit the Hare Rama Hare Krishna Madir too. I think Uber food delivery is also an option. Must visit for Indian Authentic food in Auckland not too far from Sylvia Park in Mount Wellington.

The best thing for a cold and wet winter's day is good food and cosy conversation with a good old friend 🗣😋 Govinda Restaurant has very tasty, fresh, soothing food, prepared in the Sattvic way (meaning pure essence). Sattvic foods are thought to be pure and balanced, offering feelings of calmness, happiness, and mental clarity 😌☺ It's not overly spicy or salty or oily, just good food 🍛🍲 We finished off the meal with some beautiful masala chai ☕ There is a banquet hall for hire for weddings and parties 💍🥳 Attached to the restaurant is the Bhakti Centre, which is also a temple 🕉🕉
Amazing vegetarian and vegan food and lovely service. All dishes were super tasty and we loved the kachori. Will definitely come back many more times to get through to whole menu

Absolutely perfect experience at Burger King in Panmure! We dined inside, and everything was spotless — super clean with plenty of tables available. The service was fast and friendly, and the food came out quickly and warm. We tried the Lee Burger for the first time and were blown away — it was absolutely delicious! Definitely a must-try if you’re visiting. Even the bathrooms were impressive — very clean and well-maintained, which you don’t always see. Also, a bonus if you're into sports: the head basketball courts are right here too, making it a great spot to hang out before or after a game. Highly recommend — we’ll definitely be back. Check the photos please
I ordered an Uber from this store, and they delivered a burger with a moldy bun. I had already eaten the other one I didn't look closely. I hope that one isn't moldy.

I’m so upset. I went to this Burger King around 9 at night to get some late dinner, I ordered a X-Large bbq rodeo combo, I got served by 2 teenagers. They brought me my food super fast. I ate it all and not long after that I got food poisoning. I was spewing and on bed rest for 2 whole days. I’m so disappointed

I just want to give a massive shoutout to Taran and the team at this Burger King. The service and food quality are absolutely exceptional. The fries are always hot, the team is always smiling, and nothing is ever too much trouble. I go out of my way to come to this particular Burger King because they’re simply the best. Thanks to Taran and the crew, I’ll be a happy returning customer for years to come. Keep up the amazing work!

Will not be coming here ever again!! My 2nd bite I spat my food out because I was chewing hair (disgusting) yet just to see in my Whopper that there was a long black hair. Whoever made this needs to pay more attention instead of rushing making the burgers. Please be mindful! We are humans not animals, Thank you

Second time in seven days trying this restaurant and I really wish I’d known about it sooner. So far I’ve tried the prawn chow mein, sweet and sour pork, black bean combination on rice, seasonal vegetables with garlic sauce and their wontons. Absolutely no complaints. I’m not even usually that big on Chinese takeaways but the service and amount of meat and vegetables is great, sauce is tasty, portion size is generous, service is outstanding. Wontons have crispy deep fried wrapper and actually have a good serve of meat in them!! Looking forward to my next meal with them to try some more dishes.

Decent and good value for money. Didn't taste much msg there so that's good, yet still very tasty. Family enjoyed it and hearty servings. Owners very thankful to customers. Service is good. I just found food a tad oily and the place is abit dated. Otherwise I'll recommend this place.

Been to this place for few times and love the food. Today the waitress at the front gives us a face that doesn’t want to serve us and impatient when we place the order. She should change her attitudes if she want to works as front of house.
What we ordered was satisfying! Worth a visit for some tasty, no-frills eats
The crispy skin pork tastes good. However there are a lot of bones in it which seems quite doggy as price is similar to the other restaurant but they don't have bones. The lady's attitude is poor.

I ordered a"Chinese Style" lemon chicken rice, but it only came with chicken, plain rice, and a slice of lemon — no sauce at all. I’ve never had anything like this before. Definitely don’t order it. And it costs $17.50?????Very disappointed The restaurant said they added a bit of lemon juice on the rice. But seriously, who eats plain rice with lemon juice?
Very delicious. Highly recommend 👌
Very nice place here, food was well balanced and delicious. 👍
Staff were super nice! I got a banh mi it was delicious, really filling, and at an affordable price.

The Malay fried noodles were delicious. The sushi was also delicious, and the most important thing is that it was not expensive at 9.9 NZD. There were salmon and avocado sushi, fried shrimp sushi, and fried chicken sushi, which were super nice.

Ordered a Party Combo A online, paid and it was ready to pick up at the requested time. Plenty of parking and you can eat in or takeaway. The chicken was tasty and not dry. There are lots of flavours to choose from, so will definitely come back and try the other flavours next time
We ordered a range of fried chicken dishes from this shop Great food and great service, portion sizes huge, Thank you we will be back.
My son loves this amazing chicken and fries for children box . Actually he asks me everyday . Wonderful taste and very healthy oil. Thank you

At OK Chicken in Pakuranga, it's not just about the incredible flavours – the staff are super accommodating and nice too! From the Sweet & Spicy Chicken to the Cornflake Coated Chicken, Jalapeno Mayo Chicken, and TteokBokki, every dish is a winner. I'll definitely be coming back for more!

We went there to get takeaways for lunch. The staff out front is very accommodating and friendly. She is very attentive and made sure she got our orders right. I love that they have option for Crispy Chicken Skin. I was disappointed however that the Spicy Hot Cheese was not spicy at all but it still tasted good. I guess I have really high tolerance for spicy food but if you are not onto spicy food this flavor will suit you. I love their sauces. The chicken are really good. Rice cakes are also nice because they are seasoned with the same flavors. Their rice serving is also good value for money.

We got the half n half and asked the lady at the counter if the sausage is chicken but after taking a bite I knew straight away it was pork and not chicken. Even the smell was not chicken but in fact pork. The sausage was also really pink and chickens sausages aren't pink. This is really miss leading as there are customers as myself that don't eat pork.

Not my first visit, but my first review. The menu is a little more involved than you might expect from the name - quite a selection and variety of "hot dogs" with multiple options of coatings and sides. The basic dog is pretty good, but the mozzarella is a favourite.

We had a mighty feeling with mighty hotdog Pakuranga branch. Came in 15mins before closing time. Two staff were welcoming and friendly, served us with utmost customer service unmindful of time constraints. The description was just right - mighty indeed. Has good value of money, will definitely be back with my mokos soon 👍

I was intrigued by this as I've seen a few places like it pop up, so I went it to try it. The cost is pretty reasonable for what you get and I enjoyed the one with potatoes on the outside. I like the self-serve sauce bar as well. For a quick snack or small meal this hit the spot.

Nice Korean Hotdog with different filling and style and you can choose your own sauce. Staff really friendly and shop clean and tidy. only take away provided. local in Pakuranga area should try this Korean Hotdog.

Came here on a Saturday night and it was quite busy. If you have a big group, it's best to book ahead. Some dishes like Peking Duck need to be pre-ordered. We ordered a variety of Canton dishes. The food came out steadily and was tasty. Excellent service and clean environment. Plenty of parking outside
Great location, friendly staff, most importantly delicious food! Def will be back 😋
Very nice dumpling & soup with great customer service. Would recommend for all to try yum

Got the beef rice roll hot pot and the large dumplings! Both very tasty and authentic. Very generous with meat portions in the large dumplings. The hot pot hit the spot on a rainy, cold night. Very bright and spotless restaurant. Spacious. Has all the condiments. The chilli oil was pretty unique on its own. Forgot to take a photo of the large dumplings (5).
Very delicious and clean interior, would highly recommend this restaurant or for both dine in and takeaway!

We ordered the Pork, Prawn and Chives Dumplings (Pan-Fried is extra $1), Pork and Pickled Cabbage Dumpling Clay Pot and Braised Pork Clay Pot Rice to share among 2 Adults and 2 Kids. The portions were good size and value. The food is tasty and not too salty, which is good

Amazing food. A refreshingly new restaurant. Food is amazing. Simple fillings but so good (if you want to be adventurous try the cheese dumplings I guess?? 😂). Nothing I would classify as a “Steal” but definitely worth the price comparing to the portions. I would recommend adding jug options for drinks when they become more popular though, the singular drinks are nice but so overpriced (only overpriced thing in my opinions. Purely based off comparisons you can get a Large version of the same thing for $8 at Gongcha with Student ID Discount and they’re selling the same drinks for $10 which is a bit much (their size cups is somewhere between a medium and large I would say). Other than that, the food is amazing and the variety of sauces is definitely nice. Feels like a street vender or eatery you can find in the rural parts of China, really excellent (except prices with the drinks 😅)

Yummiest dumplings ever! Super juicy and flavourful. Also have the best chicken noodles. They even have a sauce station for you to make your own dipping sauces for your dumplings! Lovely service and people. Definitely check it out 💛
The most lovely service you can ask for and unbeatable food

Just accidentally cross by this new Chinese Restaurant in Pakuranga (Kentigern Plaza) yesterday. They make fresh dumplings. It’s juicy on inside. I order some foods to try, the taste was amazing as I can’t find anywhere in Auckland. the shop is neat and tidy and the staffs are so lovely. We come with 3 people can’t finish our food. It’s too much. It’s delicious. Our tummy are all full. Absolutely will come back. Highly recommend 👍👍👍

ORDERED: 1x Large Pork Pita Pocket - $10.50 1x Small Lamb Pita Pocket - $8.50 4x Potatoes - $0.70 ea 2x Feijoa & Apple Smoothies - $5.80 Well first time here, and walked in and kind of didnt expect too much. but Was I wrong. The taste was fresh and the portion of the large pita pocket was just surprisingly big. The smoothies were delicious and they chucked in pork crackling as well. We will definitely come here again. The best experience is to come and and be surprised by the quality. The service was good looks like a family business. Thank you team Charm Roast

This place reminds me home. The food is perfect, always in the best condition. their staff are so friendly too!!! They always remember what I like and give extra every time 🥹 so recommend roast pork meal with extra crackling 🤤

I had an appetite for a roast so ordered up via uber. A generous serving (probably too much) of roast pork - a bit soggy on the crackling, but that's delivery for you. I feel it's good value anyway. Pretty speedy in terms of preparation too.
The 4 roast lamb sandwiches we ordered, the meat was tough and chewy and the sandwiches had mostly these undesirable meats in them. Portions not worth the price as well, 👎🏽.

Best customer service I've recieved in a very long time. Helpful and friendly. For that alone I will go back. I'm someone who truly believes that the servive you recieve makes the food taste better. I ordered food to feed 30 people 2hrs before pick up and it was all ready. Nicely packed and fresh. Everyone enjoyed the food. Thank you.
So good

We ordered the Mini dumpling and soft drink combo, Prawn, vege and pork wonton in red chilli oil and the Vermicelli soup with seasoned duck blood, gizzard and coriander. The food came out quickly and was so tasty. Good value for money too and there was a good amount of people coming to the Pakuranga Plaza Foodcourt just to eat here

My favourite place to get fresh dumplings from at an affordable price! This dumpling & Coke (you can choose from their Coke range) combo never fails to disappoint. Dumplings are made fresh & full of so much flavour, it is a very filling combo for under $11! The soup dumplings are served hot, they’re soupy & so tasty. Great foodie spot in Pakuranga plaza.

Scallion noodles are soooo good! The mini dumplings in the cup are what I came for and they’re tasty but I preferred the noodles with the chilli oil at the counter 😊 everything we tried was delicious. This place is definitely worth a visit if you’re craving something yummy, filling & affordable!

I recently visited this restaurant, and it was absolutely fantastic! The dumplings were perfectly crispy on the bottom and juicy on the inside, with just the right amount of filling. The flavor was rich and savory, and the skin had the ideal thickness—not too thick, not too thin. The service was also top-notch. The staff were friendly, attentive, and made sure everything was to our liking. The restaurant itself had a cozy and clean atmosphere, which made the dining experience even more enjoyable. I highly recommend this place to anyone craving authentic Shengjian. It’s definitely worth a visit, and I’ll be coming back for more!

This little shop is only 1 of 2 in the Pakuranga Plaza. Serving handmade dumplings. They are simply divine. The mini dumplings are beautiful as well. Pan fried and steamed delicious. Staff are friendly, even with a language barrier. Their food is nothing short of fabulous. I am a regular customer now, and plenty of space to sit. There is not much choice for dumpling fillings so hopefully they will add more to the menu. Do check them out, they are a lovely decent priced little kitchen.

I always write positive reviews. But not today. I’ve been going here for years. Now a days I don’t even want to come here Becasue of the horrible service. On the website it says it opens on 9am. And I come about almost 10am and it’s not even open. I got a delivery and I waited for 15 + minutes to get my food and it’s not even busy. I HAD TO CALL the number to get their Attention of staff: and they started to set up the front when it was over 10am and they meant to OPEN AT 9am. They always at the back. I watch customers wait for 5+ minutes waiting to order and these NO ONE to server. So they walked away. I got a sub from here once few months ago and I got Food Poisoning. I never felt so sick and I always get the same sub. One of the staff there I’m not sure his name. But his always wearing ear pods well serving customers. Honestly I think that’s just rude. The people that work there should be wearing hair nets for food health reasons. I get that they wearing caps but that’s doing nothing. I love getting subway and this is closer to me. Now I WONT BE COMING back. They need a Boss or something to look at the cameras to see what’s going on and put stuff into place. I understand that it’s a GHOST TOWN at Pakuranga Plaza but u need to put an act on.

To be completely honest Pakuranga Plaza is not the best place to get subway because of the employees that they have, the customer service is actually pretty horrible. I've been going to the Pakuranga plaza subway for around 4 years because it is the closest place to me, but if there was a closer one I would go there because Pakuranga is not the best place to go. My experience that I had with an employee was not the best since he dropped my sub on the floor and wanted us to pay for 2 subway's instead of one! (since he made 2) in my opinion we shouldn't have to pay anything for it and my dad actually had to step up and tell the employee that he will not be paying for 2 subways when we were only getting one, and this was unacceptable in my opinion but ever since he got fired it has been better, but even though he has gotten fired I won't forget that moment since 1 employees actions can affect the shops review. The new employees are better though but they seem highly clueless of what they are doing when serving customers from my experience.
Orders twice from here off DoorDash and they always forgot something and don’t close the bag!!!
The staff member named Kevin is very rude towards the customers. I don’t recommend this place at all.
They serve rubbish subway not recommended total waste of money and also time

Incredibly rude - as a regular I've been going there to grab a quick bite to eat. I could take the waiting, being ignored and the brusque manner of talking. What finally sealed the deal was when I asked for a plastic bag for food they had given me in a paper bag so that it would not leak they refused. Won't be going there again. Clearly they don't care about customer service

What an excellent place to buy food. I bought 2 chicken korma and 1 butter chicken both made me want more and more. Delicious food, fresh naan and cheaper than other places that I've eaten. The staff their is fair and very well trained. If your good to them there good to you. Definitely recommend this place to everyone. Must go. Delicious food and great service.

This place is revolting, the plates were dirty the chicken was tiny and the butter chicken was watery and so sweet. Took one bite and complained and they refused to give my money back and instead argued with us. Really rude and bad service
Very tasty chicken tikka masala and the best garlic naan I've had. A great curry at a good price. Recommend it!

My partner and I just had their butter chicken & garlic and cheese naan and my gosh was it good! We are definitely going back again and I recommend you guys should give it a taste. Serving sizes and pricing was also very decent.

food is very good. Fish amritsar is very good. Main course is also good but thoda spicy jyada ho gaya otherwise all good. I liked it and my wife liked as well. I will now recommend others as well. I wish and pray to God that your business will flourish . Take care and God bless you all. I will recommend this place

I recently tried the chicken biryani at BH Indian Cuisine, and it was a flavorful experience. The biryani was aromatic and well-cooked, with tender pieces of chicken and just the right amount of spice. The portion size was generous, making it great value for the price.

The dry chili chicken was soooo amazing! Full of heat and flavor how I like it. The chicken isnt battered and deep fried but they were soo tender and had the perfect blend of spices! I could eat it over and over!

The best lamb kebab I’ve ever had in Auckland. The portion was so good, the sauces weren’t generic tasting, I got the garlic yogurt and sweet chilli and it tasted home made? It wasn’t over powering the kebab. The vegetables were fresh and the meat was so tender, fatty and tasty. We also get our weekly meat here and the price is amazing especially for the quality. We have always gotten fresh chicken & steak from here and it’s always good.

Every time I’ve been to Pita House the flatbreads are fresh and tasty. They warm them for you in the oven while you wait. The herbs and spices are delicious and service is pleasant. There is also specialty and exotic grocery items to try

Pita House, is a truly wonderful shop; just like it's sister business in Pakuranga. Totally recommended for Lebanese and Syrian and Turkish supplies. Authentic, genuine and value driven supplies. Very good imported foods of great quality. The best olive oil soap in New Zealand is sold here.
Always happy with their foods and Service. Been shopping here for nearly 5 years. Strongly recommend.
Good customer service. Kebab tasted good.

Honestly, this is a hidden gem in Pakuranga that I’ve somehow never discovered since now (I’ve lived here for like 8 years…) Got the combo and wow is it worth it The charcoal spicy chicken burgers were delicious, the bread had a hint of sweetness and chicken was crispy. Just amazing!! Only thing I disliked was the chicken, lacked a little bit of salt or maybe even sugar (the spice mostly just covered everything so maybe without spice it’s perfect? But that means giving up the spice 😂) The Kimchi rice balls were delicious too, crispy and soft on the inside. This one scores a bit lower because of the kimchi, wish there was more or like a small clump in the middle (there was like 2 pieces sticking out on the side), also it is sour (probably aged for a long time (kimchi), not really spicy. Personally prefer sweeter more crunchy Kimchi, but if sour and soft is your favourite then go for it. Regular size is big enough, definitely over ordered. (Good, but too much food!) Drink was pretty cheap and the combo came with a LOT of fries (like 2x large McDonald fries 😂), not a fan of shoe string fries but they were crispy and lightly salted (I had chip salt at home so it was fine. If you like lightly salted then it’s perfect) Got to show this place more love, it’s a bit difficult to get in as it’s a left turn off a busy road and likely to be missed. Took a while of searching on google search (if you don’t know the name). Would try other stuff next time!! It was around $25-ish but I definitely ordered too much.
We love this place. We tried all fried chicken flavours, they were so delicious and amazing! The spicy burger and Peking Tacos were very tasty as well. Highly recommend!

Bao bun spicy burger, always check your lettuce mine was black around the edges so I pulled it out, Not a fan of the shoestring fries 3⭐ tops for both items. The bao buns are delicate so be careful, they crack & fall apart. Will give another try but ask for salad on the side so they know they can't hide old lettuce in your food!
I think this is the greatest Korean fried chicken in Auckland. The inside of the shop isn't the fanciest but the food is exceptional and great value. Fantastic family treat.
Not your ordinary fried chicken takeaway. They have three flavours: Japanese, Korean and Chinese. The portion was very generous. The sauce was full of flavour.

A Culinary Journey: Cantonese Yum Cha by Day, Chew Style Delights by Night This Chinese restaurant offers a delightful dual experience. Lunchtime brings the bustling energy of Cantonese yum cha, with a wide variety of dim sum to choose from. While incredibly busy, the efficient service ensures a smooth and enjoyable experience. Evenings transform the space into a haven of Chew style cuisine. The menu is extensive, offering plenty of variety. We were particularly impressed by the generous portion sizes and the overall quality of the food. The Chew style duck is a must-try – a standout dish that perfectly showcases the restaurant's culinary expertise. Friendly and helpful staff complete the picture, making this a highly recommended spot for both lunch and dinner.

Good food and good service You have to order on a piece of paper before the food gets pushed out on a trolley to your table Didn’t take too long for food to arrive and they all tasted good Lots of people so try to come earlier or be prepared to wait a bit

I am not happy with the customer service and I am going to put a complaint with dispute tribunal with all the evidence I have got. We went there for lunch and I request for tap water since we have a 2 year old kid and I am myself pregnant who avoids tea. When I paid, i got charged for tea fee. I asked the counter why I got charged for tap water, she said tap water is not free and therefore i got charged. She gave me $2 back for my son since he is under 8. We went there a few times with other families (ordering tea since others want it so we just go along but did not really drink any), and my son has always been charged for tea. Only now I know kids are not charged for tea/water etc. The menu states nothing of tap water charge. This is obviously against the consumer act and the fair trading act since we paid for something not declared explicitly anywhere. It may be a small amount of penny but I will follow with the case. If consumers go easy, they will keep doing it.

We came on a Wednesday night for dinner, as this place is always busy in the weekends for Yum Cha and dinner. The food came out quickly and was really good value for money. The portions are big and the food tasty. Service was good. Parking can be challenging here if it's full. You order Yum Cha via an Order form and they bring it to you.

Recommend to book as it can get busy around midday as you are only allowed 1 hour to eat. Trolleys are pushed around full of food and frequently. A bit of hit and miss on some items.. steam pork buns were great , but str fries beef ho fun didn't have any wok hei , for $23 I would have expected it. Overall ok.. Not enough parking so better to eat earlier.

If you’re looking for bold, unforgettable flavors on wheels – Scoopers is a must-try! Their Mango Chicken is a perfect blend of sweet and spicy, with juicy chicken tossed in a creamy mango glaze that hits all the right notes. It’s refreshing, rich, and totally addictive. But the real star? The Tandoori Chicken Tikka Wrap – smoky, perfectly charred chicken pieces wrapped in warm naan with crisp veggies and a tangy chutney. It’s got that authentic tandoori punch, but in a super satisfying handheld wrap. 🚚 Whether you’re a spice lover or just hungry for something different, Scoopers brings big flavor in every bite. Friendly service, fast turnaround, and portions that leave you smiling. No wonder these wraps are their best-sellers!
What a fantastic find! Great selection of food, really good coffee, and fabulous service - easily 5 stars!

Great little place to pick up coffee and a quick bite for lunch or break! Lovely friendly service with a smile. We love supporting local family businesses like this one! Highly recommend the brownie slice 😋

10/10 Amazing customer service especially the food is really yummy! I always buy here every breakfast or lunch and I already tried every single food she sells and they taste heavenly! Highly recommended! ✨
great food awesome service
Lovely owners. Always greet you with a smile. Great selection of yummy foods that will not break your budget. Love the Chicken and Fried Rice for 7$ only.
They've always got really good food at great prices.
Great Food n service. Owners Kevin and Lin helpful.
If you want healthy, Very few options here..
Great lunch place for Buckleys

Queens road Panmure. Is a good place to have a meal There is 120 minute parking and heaps of spaces. There is fine in or use the tables on the extra large footpath. Look out for more reviews on Queens road Panmure. Highly recommended. 😊😊😊 Queens road have add some awesome boards to highlight their eatery's.
It is generally a good place to have a bite to eat .

The food was delicious and with generous portions and fresh ingredients. The staff were friendly and attentive, creating a welcoming atmosphere. The service was prompt, and the ambiance was cozy yet vibrant. Highly recommended for all who like Indian food and you can order online/ phone call and tell your preferences🥰👍

Every time I’ve visited, the food has been nothing short of exceptional. The flavours are authentic, everything is freshly prepared, and there’s an impressive variety of options to suit everyone. What truly sets this place apart is the team. The chef is always smiling, and the front-of-house staff are warm and welcoming. I always recommend this spot to my friends, and I can’t recommend it highly enough!

We came with the whole family to celebrate our parents birthday, and it honestly couldn’t have gone better. The staff were welcoming and attentive without being overbearing, and they went out of their way to make the occasion feel special. The food was beautifully presented and full of flavour, clearly made with care. It’s rare to find a place that nails both the service and the atmosphere, but this one really delivered. We left full, happy, and grateful. Would absolutely recommend and look forward to coming back.

I tried their family combo deal, and it was fantastic—great taste and incredibly affordable at just $75. No restaurant can beat that price! It easily fed my family of five. The owner was super friendly and even let me pick any curry from the entire menu for the combo. The food, especially from the tandoor grill, was amazing!

Excellent. All food was outstanding, very tasty and one of the best!! The size portion was extremely good, and price was very good. I had the chance to walk through the kitchen and it was so clean! The service provided from Vikash was pure class. I dined in, highly recommend also halal. (First time i am posting a review for a food place, thats how good it was).

PROFESSIONAL INDIAN CUISINE is an absolute gem for Indian cuisine enthusiasts! The flavors are exceptional, the service is top-notch, and the experience is simply unforgettable. From the warm welcome to the tantalizing dishes, every aspect of this restaurant exceeded my expectations. Highly recommended for a truly authentic and delightful dining experience!.
Food was good however let down by the naan bread, tasted like it was sitting the whole day and reheated in microwave upon order. 3 is generous. Ate most of it bcus grateful🤣

I've bought from this store around 10 times now. Can confidently say that this is one of the best Indian food options in East Auckland. Consistently tasty, with generous portions of protein in each meal. The gravy doesn't seem too rich or fatty, and the Naan is always superb. More people need to know about this place.

I recently visited "Professional Indian Cuisine" and had the Butter Chicken. It was absolutely delicious! The flavors were rich and the chicken was perfectly cooked 😋🤤 I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a great cuisine.

Love going to Nakeeb Bhai’s takeaway whenever we can. The food has always felt like eating at a high end restaraunt but with the comfort of home. I personally love the naan because it isn’t thick and half cooked like the takeaway naans you get but is closer to authentic naan. For the reviews who have been saying it isn’t “naan” it may just be because they’re used to the fake and superficial naan geared at the western audience 🤷🏽‍♀️ the butter chicken tasted closer to home taste as well opposed to the bulk made fake butter chicken you get in the malls. Love our meal everytime and recommend this to everyone

Checked the reviews and thought I'd give you a shot. But $47 for this is ridiculous. Container of rice wasn't even full. Rice was ok but nothing special, as little amount of meat as you could put in there. Spring and pork rolls were below average. Positive was quick service though. But sorry, the price was out the gate. I won't be back... Atmosphere was a bit drab, totally empty, but if the food and price was good it'd be fine!
This little haven of Thai food is next level based in Panmure. If you ever get the chance to visit get there guys. Thanks Chang Thai team

Ordered Pad Thai and dined in. Was very satisfied with the dish and didn't need the lemon which usually severed at other places. Lots of chicken pieces and some bean sprouts with eggs. Portion was good and happy with the taste.

I have been here a few times and the food is always delicious. Tonight I ordered the Chicken Pad Thai, Curry Puffs and Satay Chicken. The Pad Thai, as always, is tasty the blend of flavours is so good. The Satay chicken is very tasty, especially the peanut sauce and curry puffs were packed full of flavour and very mild. The owner and her little kids always provide great customer service, she's very nice. Highly recommended!!
It was wonderful, the beef pho was huge and a generous serving. I had to take away the rest. But the highlight was the Vietnamese coffee. Beautiful, perfect contrast to the super hot beef phó.

Ordered for takeaway. Even though the food were consumed after 20 mins, fries were still crunchy. The snowy cheese fries was particularly good, generous seasoning. Onion rings was also good but a bit oily. Overall quite satisfied and will come back and try the other fries with different seasoning.

Ordered two chicken burgers, onion rings, and chicken. The onion rings were super burnt and was super stuck to each other. It is quite inedible as it was very bitter. If I saw this in store I would've demanded a refund or for it to be remade. Chicken burger didn't look like the photo at all. The advertised photo showed chicken "patty" being coated with the yang yeom sauce, but what i received was a dry piece of chicken in my burger with a dash of sauce. I ordered for pick up at 1pm, and I had to wait well past 1.15pm to have my order ready. The whole point of ordering online for pick up is to pick up on the time the customer selected. Not for them to start cooking at the selected time. Questionable and borderline bad experience.

Ziggle in panmure offers delicious and tasty food at a reasonable and affordable price. The burgers were quite tasty , but I would say that the double bulgogi burger is more of just a tasty beef burger rather than bulgogi. The onion rings were tasty and light and the honey butter fries were super tasty . Overall a lovely experience and a must try !!

Amazing burgers. Super delicious. The takeaway itself has 2 tables inside for eating. Very tidy . My combos were both cooked perfectly and chips were crisp. Keep up the great work guys. See you guys again 💯

Looking for some food around the area before bible study at church just across the road. At first glance I thought this place was like some typical fish and chips owned by some palagis but then I heard “ASAP” By StayC blasting through the speakers and then saw “Bulgogi” on the menu and was shocked, this place is Korean I was like dayummmm I know them Oppas and Noonas make sum good food and it in fact was amazing bruh W food, W music. Bruh and as soon as I left, they played my jam “Whiplash” by Aespa I was like noooooo why I gotta leave now 😭 Nah but yo the chicken is bussin

A big thank you to my friends who brought me here for the first time, it's absolutely a great experience! Asian hospitality Friendly staff Very tasty Malaysian Chinese food. Fish head noodle soup is amazingly made in here. Crispy prawns is also highly recommended. The venue is small, business is so good, customers are coming nonstop. I'm a total stranger to Panmure but I should be coming back to discover more delicious food here. 👍👍👍

Haven’t been back here for a while, but finally came back for dinner. The wat dan ho was good g ood portion and tasty. However, the curry chicken wasn’t quite right this time. The texture was grainy, and it tasted like it came from the bottom of the pot. Hopefully it was just a one-off as it tasted much better on a previous visit.

Fine Malaysian cuisine. Didn't make a mistake choosing it. Food naturally tastes delicious. Not salty nor msg tasting. Even had a take away. Generous servings too. I would recommend and would come back. Service is fine. Though we received a slight frown when we asked for a slice of lemon with the fried rice. Anyways, a good find.

This restaurant comes highly recommended for those seeking authentic Malaysian cuisine. It's our family's favorite spot, offering a trip down memory lane with dishes like Fried Carrot Cake. The service is impressively quick, prices are reasonable, and portions are generous. The chef hails from Kuala Lumpur, and the staff is exceptionally friendly.
The food at the Malaysian restaurant is fairly average in taste, with generous portions. The only downside is the slightly outdated ambiance, which could benefit from a refresh.

First time customers and very satisfied. The restaurant is big and spacious. Very clean kitchen and quick friendly service. The kebabs are nice and simple, filled with good quality ingredients and juicy flavorsome meat. Really tasty food that even our toddler enjoyed. Will definitely be back.

Terrible pizza. Ordered a "mixed sausage" pizza off UberEats. Contained a measly single precooked sausage worth of sausage, was not a "mix". False advertising, no effort at all. At least the crust was edible. Thankfully only paid $4 for it due to UE One promo. Paying full price would be robbery.

I work in Panmure, love kebabs and Queens kebabs really do it for me. I order mostly via Uber eats but today was my first visit in person. Beautiful establishment. Lovely furniture for those dining in and I was captured by the ceiling and wall ornaments. The food was amazing. I almost always get the mixed kebab with yogurt and BBQ sauce. Nice assortment of vege adding to the abundance of color and texture. Highly recommend to all to dine in. Staff are lovely, keen to chat and offer great customer service. I felt at ease and comfortable whilst waiting for my order. Please support local businesses during these testing times. 🙏 please respect the mask and qr code check in at the counter or the entrance door. Stay safe and be nice to everyone. Merry Christmas and Happy New Year everyone.

Door Dash Order: Missing Lamb Kebab extra meat. Loyal customer no more. Kebab missing from order. Rang so I could pick up. Man basically accused DDash driver of stealing it. Didnt want to know about it. Said make a complaint. I told him bag was sealed with staples. Not tampered with. Will never order Queens again. Have been customer for years first issue. Bye

My local Kebab shop. I have been going here occasionally for a number of years, and it's always good. My usual go-tos are the chicken on rice, or chicken kebab. The food is fresh, and the place is cosy, not too flash. It's never empty and seems popular.
Lovely atmosphere and delicious food! 🥰 We ordered the roast chicken kottu, and it brought back the authentic flavors of Sri Lanka. Excellent service—keep up the great work! 👏
We got a lamb kottu, the lamb curry put into the kottu smells old because of that we had to throw it away. Dont buy the kottu from this place.
Bought a roast chicken kottu for 25$ today, not happy with the quantity at all. Taste wise you can just taste the cabbage on it. Really disappointed. Does it worth 25$ ???

I had the pleasure of dining at Walawwa. The food is absolutely amazing – rich, flavourful, and authentic! Every dish I tried was bursting with spices and fresh ingredients that really captured the essence of Sri Lankan cooking. The service was friendly and making the whole experience even better. Whether you're a fan of Sri Lankan food or trying it for the first time, Walawwa is a must-visit for anyone craving an unforgettable meal. Highly recommend!

The buriyani dinner order was very well coordinated by Udara. He gave excellent service on phone and in -person throughout my conversations answering all my questions pleasantly. He was reliable and communicated well with the chef too. The guests loved the food. Since there were vegetarians, we were provided with well balanced vegetarian dishes as requested. The rice was authentic SL muslim style with a tasty mix of spices and ingredients. Portions were generous and the chef + Udara provided an extra Malay achcharu which was a nice surprise. It was well packed as well. Thanks! :)
Incredible food and hospitality by the owners. Warm meal of pho and great vietnamese coffee!! Came here 3 days in a row for their snacks as well.
The food was amazing! Deep flavours & good ambience,,hospitality was superb as well!

Just finished eating and can confirm this place is incredible!!! The pho was a delicious and authentic rich broth with plenty of meat. My family got a number of delicious and authentic viet food and were not disappointed would definitely recommend. (my younger brother says to get the fries and can confirm they were such a perfect wind down snack)
We have nice time here. The food so yummy. I want to let u guys know because they do very good job. 💯
Awesome hidden gem in Panmure! Food was amazing, restaurant was very clean, really gave a nice home vibe. My favourite combo is banh mi & cp coffeeeee so niceeee. Pho also was gooddd

First time at Panmure RSA tonight and we WILL be back. Such a good vibe ❤️ Meals were lovely, real value for money and the Karaoke entertainment was next level. Awesome AWESOME singers. Highly recommend this venue for a great night out ❤️

Below is an update on my previous review now I have amended my review as it feels things have gotten even worse so I have changed my previous review from 3 stars to 1. After a long break from coming here due to issues such as the RSA being closed when it should be open, poor communication and unpredictability of beer and food availability me and my friend decided to come in to collect our cards and see if things had improved and see if itwould be worth renewing our membership. Unfortunately when I arrived a rude (possibly slightly inebriated) lady called Margarette refused me and my friend entry because we were wearing shirts with no collar, she said she was the secretary and makes the rules. I have come on numerous occasions in similar attire and both me and my friend's have never been told of this, I recall numerous others wearing similar attire, even their photos on Facebook show people who won raffles collecting their prizes in far less formal T-shirts than we were wearing. There is no sign at the RSA or rules on the website stating any issue with this type of attire. Our t-shirts were clean and of nice dress and have never been an issue at other restaurants or even at Sky City. What's the point of being a member if when they do decide to actually open they won't even let their members in. After this experience I am seriously reconsidering continuing my membership after this experience.

It was a while back, but cannot forget the hospitality both the bar staff and the veterans there gave us outsiders. The layout is also nice and big, with dart boards and pool tables I think I remember. Tables had really cool fishing and other gear inlaid under the resin coating. Get your Lion Reds here haha.
The lady staff who opens the shop on Thursdays has a really bad attitude problem.Doesn't have any respect for the customers at all.
It may be small but the atmosphere is great. The staff and members are friendly. Love the food. Really enjoy Friday night karaoke.
We go to Pin Yue every week. It's pretty good food, and good value (especially the "on rice" meals). It's like the cheap old places that used to be in Dominion Road, if that is what you like...

So this quaint little place is not where you'd bring your first date, but if you're after a cheap lunch meal, you'll be hard to beat this joint. We had spicy beef noodle soup and eggplant/chicken on rice. Portions were very generous, food was very tasty but best of all, it was only $15 and $16 respectively. Hard to find cheap n good places nowadays in Auckland. Total bill for 4 is $60. The dishes did take some time to arrive and on an uneven basis though. What's also good to note is that the clientele is really multi cultural with Erupoeans, Pasifica and Asians all mixed in a relatively even proportion. The lady server speaks good English and they cater to food intolerance by helpfully suggesting dishes that are suitable. So this is not your run of the mill Chinese restaurant from this aspect. Will return.

Time seemed to stand still at Pinyue. The restaurant decor and the food were just so nostalgic for me. The authentic taste of Chinese food is hard to come by in a cosmopolitan city. The chef must be determined to maintain the taste despite the diverse backgrounds of the customers. The staff is so friendly and thoughtful. One suggested to give me a knife to cut the big piece of pork chop. However, I didn’t need it as the meat was so tender and it melted into my mouth. Reasonably priced.

Had lunch here and really enjoyed it. $13 gets you a generous size bowl of Dan Dan noodles, soup, minced meat and vege. Free hot Chinese tea. Friendly and helpful staff. Definitley worth coming to if you're around Panmure and want a delicious and hot bowl of noodle soup. Restaurant is licensed, so if you're not working there's a few choices of alcoholic drinks.

Ordered crispy Sichuan chicken 辣子鸡丁 for $18 dollars. The server came out with the food and said Kung pao chicken to me. I told him I ordered Sichuan chicken. He said this is Sichuan chicken. I questioned the server and the receptionist twice that this is not 辣子鸡丁. Receptionist told me that this is the shanghai way of cooking. They then had a discussion with the cook and decided this was 辣子鸡丁. Paid for it amounted to 22 dollars. I told them the menu said 18 dollars. They said it was old menu and forgot to take it down. Dubious and downright cheating. I didn't want to make a scene but I'm warning you guys to not patronize them. See the Pic for yourself if that was 辣子鸡丁. It's neither crispy nor contain peppercorn.
The rice noodles were very delicious and I enjoyed my meal very much. Also the portion size was huge for such a low price! The lady who served us was really nice and helped us choose what to order.

very generous amount within affordable price range; a place quickly became my regular spot when i don’t know what to eat but don’t wanna cook. always add a fried egg on top for extra $3 and it’s so yummy!! heaps of street parking outside, however cos it’s one man operated so pretty much self service only 😅
Use your cellphone to translate, but this has THE BEST taro balls I've ever tried & LOTSA Beef noodles or Tofu etc variety... THE BEST!!!
Good meal

Pros: Excellent service, generous portions. I ordered the large spicy pig intestine rice noodle dish. It was so filling that even a smaller eater wouldn't be able to finish it. The pig intestines were perfectly cooked, tender and flavorful. Cons: Perhaps because I prefer a lighter palate, the rice noodle broth was a bit salty, perhaps with too much salt. But that's just my personal preference; others might find it just right.

As a pie lover, this steak and cheese pie is definitely above average. Flaky pastry, tender steak chunks, and a rich, thick gravy that packs flavour. The cheese is a nice touch—melty and creamy—but could use just a bit more to really hit the mark. Still, a solid, tasty option I’d happily have again..

This lunch bar is full of all sorts of goodies, Dim Sims,toasted sandwiches,pies, chips all the good stuff. I love there burgers they are not big tall ones dripping with sauces, tasty and easy to eat.

This place is quite cheap for the food served and ideal eating place for lunch. Mostly, it caters to a nearby workforce, so it is impressive that rates are kept on the lower end. This makes having lunch here on a regular basis wouldn't put a dent in your pocket. Nice one!

Limited range and food really oily and old and i brought a pie today and it was burnt and also the fried stuff is too oily and i ended up with food poisoning and vomited a few times after eating, would not come back again
Nice and friendly atmosphere. Very pleasant service and delicious food.
I've always enjoyed their breakfast 🍳 here. Recently came here for Mother's day for breakfast. Totally beautiful and yummy 😋. Good bonding time with my family and the service was great 💯

We had our Xmas lunch here for work for a group of 8 & the food was 👏. Great buffet menu and staff are so attentive. They also have a great view of the Basin... This is well worth your money but I would say the menu would most likely benefit professionals or adults, I wouldn't recommend it for kids as there isn't anything for kids to really eat besides desert as a mother myself (I couldn't my kids eat anything here), however best for a group of adults friends to attend and there is a bar onsite so you can consume alcohol while you eat

Had a lovely quiet dinner Buffett with hubby. It wasn’t busy at all when we entered at 6pm. Place was clean & tidy. Plenty of food. We had a lovely table at the window looking out onto the lake. Customer service was great. Our first time here. Only criticism is that it was costly though, $132 in total dinner for two people.
The pork belly was incredible. Staff and atmosphere are amazing. Visiting here for work and would definitely recommend for both corporate and family visits.

Place of good food with nice environment and one side lake. There are hips of car parking. There entrance are very wheelchair and strollers friendly. They have lots of entrance and entry options. This is the great place for buffet or party or conference with staying in there hotels. Staffs are very friendly and helpful. They just cleaned the tables within seconds. You don’t worry about used plates. All staffs are very responsive. They will give you super first for your services.

Absolutely blown away by our experience at Denny’s! From the moment we walked in, we were greeted by a staff member whose energy could light up the whole restaurant. He had such a warm, welcoming vibe that instantly made us feel at home. Not only did he seat us with genuine care, but he also made sure every detail of our order was spot-on- no confusion, no mix-ups, just precision and good vibes. The food? Absolutely beautiful. Every bite was delicious, and I don’t say this lightly- I LOVED IT. You could tell it was made fresh and with love, and the presentation was just the cherry on top. What really stood out though was this gentleman’s customer service. Despite juggling other tables and handling orders, he still made the time to check in on us, making sure we were happy and had everything we needed. That level of attentiveness is rare these days. He truly elevated the whole dining experience. If I could give more than 5 stars, I would. Denny’s, you’ve got a gem of a team member there, hang onto him! 👏🍽️✨ This is my 5th time coming back for my french toast meal + premium burger, and I will come back everytime because this plave never fails me❤️ compliments to the chef and staff :)

Ah Denny’s, the old classic. They still do the free birthday meal! 🥳 Such a great, extensive menu with all the dishes we know and love!! Today we went for a round of Oreo Shakes, chicken and chips and the Premium burger with chips (not for the faint hearted!) Our food was delicious and didn’t take too long to come out. The staff were friendly and attentive. We visited at lunchtime on a Saturday and were a little sad to see it was like a ghost town. Denny’s is still awesome after all these years! And like the signs in the bathrooms say… “probably your best family restaurant in town!”

Tonight's service, food, and general experience were one of the best of the evening! Food service was fast, waitresses were friendly and accommodating, food flavours met our expectations, and generally, that drove us to give the rating 5 stars. Thank you again. Keep it up, and we will keep coming back 👍

We went early morning so it was very quiet. I took my son for his birthday so he dined for free and wow food was really good our waitress was Jessica very nice person and she had very good customer service. My kids and I walked in there and we rolled out lol my favourite was the Apple Pie dessert and the surf and turf meal.

Had the breakfast and the food was very average, the eggs were cooked well though. Service from our waiter was great. The interior has seen better days feels a bit drab and in need of a freshen up. The prices were quite expensive for what you get. I would recommend spending a small amount extra and going somewhere that uses better quality ingredients if you are looking for a decent breakfast.

We had our Chinese New Year dinner gathering here. Food was great and fast delivery to the table. Hence it was Chinese New Year dinner, most tables were full and few small table available for casual walk in. Some hit and miss. They forgot our rice and it seems they short of staff. Overall it was a good experience to dine here.

I think the meal was quite oily and more expensive than similar meals at other places. They bring you tea when you sit down but do not inform you that it will be charged at $1. Additionally, the staff engage in noisy conversations.

Always busy and full house restaurant. Famous with their reasonable price of lobster ($158 today). Even my North Shore's friends came to here, to have their famous lobster! But be prepared for the loudness of the busy restaurant. Everyone chatting loudly.
One of my favourite to go place for dinner, Love their Peking duck, crispy skin, duck meat is always tender and juicy...price is reasonable. Good serving..
Lunch is pretty good, dinner is tasty but expensive. Nice interior, terrible service. Bathrooms are not the worst I've seen, but not great.

I ordered an Ice Mocha after my walk. Usually when I ask for Ice Mocha (at different places), it’s cold milk with coffee and added chocolate flavour (liquid consistency) like an iced latte but what I got here was a Frappe. I DID NOT ask for Mocha FRAPPE nor a MILKSHAKE. When I placed the order, the staff were lovely and all smiley. The moment it was delivered to me, I gently asked I didn’t request for frappe? Isn’t it supposed to be watery? And there was no smile, with a plain face the same person responded ‘ This is Ice Mocha’. I live in the same neighbourhood and have visited this cafe for coffee a few times. I was disappointed. It’s a very cold morning but I just wanted something cool after a long sweaty walk. Frappe is a worst idea, because the staff wasn’t approachable I ended up just taking the drink home. It’s interesting to see how faces change the moment money is paid. This was $9 and I did not enjoy it.

Packed but expected. Food was delicious and was presented so beautifully💐Iced chocolate frappe was a 10/10. I also visited the general store right next door & it bought back nostalgia😍Definitely recommend and would come again!!
A great place to have a relaxing breakfast! Good presentation and even better tasting! Coffee come out quickly and so do the meals! All in the relaxing environment next to the Lloyd Elsmore parks.

Presentation of the food here is on point. You can’t fault it for the price you pay. I appreciate its location as a part of the Howie historic village. It fits in well. They take their cleanliness seriously as tables were constantly being cleared. While it was quiet when I turned up it became lively soon after. They serve a decent breakfast at a decent price.

Mother’s Day was so good here 🌸🌸 really great experience. Food and drinks came so quick! Prices are so good and it was so so yummy. Been coming here for years - my favourite place to brunch in Auckland.

Pizza was great but don’t order the waffles haha it was burnt, didn’t look like the photo at all, and tasted horrible. I don’t normally leave reviews but was so keen for my (very) little dessert 🥲 - also the sauce on the side apparently isn’t included

I’ve tried quite a few pizza places around East Auckland, but Pizza Club Pakuranga stands out every single time. Their pizzas are consistently fresh, loaded with toppings, and cooked to perfection. The crust is just the right amount of crispy without being too dry, and the cheese—melty and generous! You can tell they don’t cut corners on quality. What really makes this place special though is the customer service. The team is friendly, welcoming, and always happy to customize your order. Whether it’s a quick pick-up or a late-night craving, they never disappoint. Highly recommend the Butter Chicken Pizza and the Meat Lovers – both are packed with flavour. And if you’re into spice, their Peri Peri options are next level! If you’re in Pakuranga or anywhere nearby, do yourself a favour and give Pizza Club a try. Great value, amazing taste, and a local gem worth supporting!

Perfect pizza night! The crust had the ideal texture and the flavors were spot on. The customer service was equally impressive — friendly staff, fast service, and great attention to detail. Highly recommended!

This was my second time at Pizza Club Pakuranga, and the pizzas didn’t disappoint—especially the butter chicken and Chicken Slingshot, packed with flavour. Crust was perfectly crispy again Thanks for such a delicious and beautiful dinner

If you want different then must try these guys. Indian flavors Tandoori and butter chicken pizza are always the hit but they have lots of nice flavors to choose from. Their pizza base is quiet filling and bready too but not the best for some for the same reason. Service ia typical and can be improved and has no sitting inside. There's a bench outside and not the best to hang out in cold rainy times. The restaurant is nice but atmosphere needs lot of work otherwise happy to continue going to buying take away pizza. It has enough parking too but on busy times they get full too.

Woah this place is absolutely appalling. Cheese burger no cheese. BBQ sauce for my nuggets but the nuggets were swapped for a sausage mc muffin? Stale BLT buns that makes a thud sound when you bang it against the table. I ordered a Mc Cafe Hot chocolate but I watched them pour the McDonalds hot chocolate into my mc cafe. I was watching The Asian lady picking big chunks of egg shells out of the scrambled eggs that she was making. It was horrid. I WOULD NOT!!!!! RECOMMEND THIS BRANCH TAKE THE EXTRA FEW MINUTES TO DRIVE TO BOTANY OR PANMURE.
First time trying out Mccafe's Piccolo Latte, such a disappointment, it tastes like a weak Flat White, the portion is so tiny I would have enjoyed a cup of Flat White instead. What a rip-off!

This branch of McDonald's has been inconsistent bad throughout the years. I've had take away order missing a whole burger in the meal before. Breakfast is always bad, look at the photo of the muffins, who wants to eat that, plus it's not hot as should be, it's barely warm, at best room temperature, coffee no good as well.

Whoever was working on Saturday 26 April 2025 at 1.45am made the BEST CHEESEBURGER AND QUARTER POUNDER I have had in YEARS! Also the fries were fresh and well salted for a change. Best experience at maccas in a while. Give a raise to whoever was working at that time 👏👏👏👏

Good Mc to bring family and kids, it has a small playground and satisfies the small ones. Parking is large and shared with other restaurants. Plenty of seats, clean and in order. Went there at 21:15 and the drive thru was too full and ordered inside instead. Service was reasonable slow due to the car’s ordering first.

Surprisingly good affordable brunch, great coffee, and some of the best Eggs Benedict on this side of town. Small and friendly, cheap and cheerful cafe. Food is really good for the price, with healthy paleo option a nice surprise. Check out their special home made dumpling omelette!
Excellent little café. Great coffee and food. Perfect for breakfast

This is one of the best local Cafe in Highlandpark, perfect coffee to satisfy my taste bud，food are well prepared with high quality ingredients, Tina's excellent service always make me feel so warm and want to come back again and again. I love the sandwiches, the light taste just suitable for a charge up meal after my workout! Highly recommend👍👍👍

Stopped in on Mother's Day. Place wasn't busy which is a plus in my opinion. Service was good. Ordered a BLT and the bacon was crispy and the tomato & lettuce was fresh. Vanilla Frappé was only okay. Would go again
Very good restaurant and cafee, variety of food and drink,there is a big carpark next to the kitchenette.

Can’t speak highly enough of my lust deluxe pizza which came out on a beautiful thin stretched crust, always a sucker for their prawn horns and corn nuggets. Really friendly staff, our A+ food was ready just before the estimated time as well which I rate. James Ashwin

I don’t visit this store often, but I ordered the pizza with meatballs this time. My child asked me why it looked different from before when order from a different hell pizza shop—did someone else eat our meatballs? There were only one or two meatballs on each slice. The owner is really good at cutting costs. I won’t be coming back.

Filthy dirty disgusting store. Dead bugs everywhere, rubbish from outside blown inside and left because the 1 staff member on was to busy sitting down talking on the phone. Stools and lean to, disgusting you can scrape the dirt off the chairs. I did try to communicate with Hell before posting this. But the guy was full of lies. Domino's is better value for money and some of Hell pizzas look like Domino's pizzas! Hell has gone to hell.
Actually my 6 year old is a big fan, he prefers Hell Pizza over the other competitors. Also the staff are young and understand the 6 year old customer requirements

I called up the day before their famous $13 double pizza (Halloween) day to ask about how busy it would be if we scheduled an order for lunch (in order to make an appt for our group later). Staff were helpful on the phone. On the day we got served quick when we went to pick up, and needless to say the pizzas looked and tasted fantastic. Extremely filling! The dough was nice and chewy with flavour, and sprinkled with what I think is semolina which gives it that extra flavour. The toppings were plentiful and were spread evenly. It looked so good (and was good). Lots of vegetarian choices too. Last time we ordered from Hells was 10 years ago, and I have to say that I sure know why now their pizzas cost as much as they do normally!

Weather was hideous so we had pizzas delivered. Large pizzas were just slightly bigger than a small individual pizza. Paid for double toppings on each pizza. Could not tell the difference between three different pizza as the toppings were practically non existent. Only bbq sauce on one pizza gave it away! Worst pizzas I’ve had the misfortune to order…DON’T DO IT! Photos added so that you can play spot the ham and pineapple, then spot the chicken (it’s an expensive version of the Find Wally game)

On the 26 of July at 3:58 ,2 pizzas (Hawaiian and Pepperoni) were delivered to my house , I opened the box to find 1 of my pizza slices switched out for a small one (you can clearly see in the photo) so I called the place up and an Indian woman answered the phone .i explained my situation and she started to give me attitude and told me to come to the shop when I asked for a refund or a new pizza (she didn’t say anything about bringing the pizza in) I end up going down with my little sister and we ask to talk to the manager and the woman who was on the phone comes, so we re explain the situation and she said that the manager dropped it off (a white asian male in normal clothes dropped it off) when she clearly is the manager and she was trying to get out of it. She went around the corner and grabbed another co-worker (she said he was the manager now)and then we start arguing then I try to explain to him about the pizza slices switched and he wasn’t understanding,but then they started to ask us to go back home and get the pizzas WITH ATTITUDE !!!! Absolutely loved my experience at Pizza Hut highland park. The service was fast and friendly, and the staff made sure everything was just right. The crust was perfectly crispy on the outside and soft on the inside—just the way I like it. The restaurant was clean, and the atmosphere was relaxed, making it a great spot for a casual meal. I also appreciated how easy it was to customize my order. Definitely coming back again soon. Highly recommend for pizza lovers

Ordered online. Received Good customer service. The food was decently made. Large Detroit Pizza 2/5 Chicken Cranberry Mozzarella Stuffed Crust 3/5 Large Beef and Onion 3/5 Southern Style Chicken Bites 3/5 Garlic Bread 3/5

Pizzas was yummy! Bought pizzas from other Pizza Huts in tge past, this one do stand out in terms of the taste of the pizzas. Staff busy, but friendly enough. Interior not nice at all, no atmosphere to speak of, yet still clean. But hey we just wanted a warm, delicious pizza on time and that is what we got.
Ordered two takeaway dishes, one of which was the honey pork - the portion was very small, especially for the average price of $30 per dish. I found it quite overpriced and not good value for money.

A nice hidden gem in Pakuranga. Enjoyed every dish we had here. But if you ask me what’s the one dish you have to have, then it has to be the honey pork fillet. It has the perfect caramel glaze on the outside and yet, the pork fillet is still very soft and tender. The deep fried milk is also a must try - pre-order is required for this dish though. Booking is strongly recommended as it isn’t a very big restaurant and often there are no availability on weekends. Parking can also be a struggle and you may need to find a parking on the residential streets nearby.

I've been wanting to try this Macau/Cantonese restaurant for a long time and when I finally did, it didn't disappoint. It pays to pre-order the Duck, which has more skin than meat pieces. There are options for the second course. The roast pork was really tasty too. Good size dishes, but not huge. Unfortunately the Tofu Fa was sold out. Excellent service and food came out quickly
It's a decent local Chinese restaurant. Although the lemon fish is mediocre, other dishes fine Great Chinese food, the special order roast pork was one of the tastiest in Auckland.

I've been to this restaurant many times. Food n service is excellent. Their roast pork is superb - must try! Love their steam fish n clams They serve complimentary soup before your order, n surprisingly, the soup is awesome.

When I’m craving roast duck, I don’t mind traveling all the way from the North to the South — that’s how good this place is. So far, it’s the best roast duck I’ve had. The skin is crispy, the meat is juicy, and the flavor is really well-seasoned. If you’re planning to get half or a whole duck, it’s best to pre-order a day in advance to make sure you don’t miss out — it tends to sell quickly. I also had the roast pork today. It was still tasty, but the portion I got had a bit too much fat for my liking. I usually prefer a better balance between fat and meat. Overall, still a solid meal and always worth the trip!

Long established canton barbecue place, perhaps best roast duck in Auckland. Super friendly staff, and serving great food in very affordable price. Roast duck, soy sauce chicken, char-siu, all recommended.
I absolutely love this establishment. The service is great! The food is some of the best I've had. The roast duck, brisket, and soya chicken on large noodles is 🔥. Highly recommend 👌

This place is super busy but I was doing takeaway , I had the roast pork and bbq pork on rice and went back the next day for the duck and soya chicken on rice It’s cooked real good and my favourite was the duck and soya chicken I can see why it’s so busy, it’s good

Extremely local literally on my doorstep. This plain little establishment often has a long queue outside for dine in or take out! Welfare offers a range principally of barbecue , roasted chicken, duck, pork, with rice or noodles. They also offer soup dumpling . My dish tonight was the bbq pork on rice with vegetable at $13:50! Generous and delicious and fantastic value. The place was fairly full at 6:00 pm. I was the only European which is pretty normal and a good indicator for a genuine ethnic establishment.
Nice enough. Good is fresh. Sandwiches are nice. They also have soy chicken, ribs and lamb shanks. Will hit the spot if your hungry.
Really good roast meals at this place. Happy to recommend them.
Tasty roast with good flavours. Potatoes and meat were well seasoned. Gravy was delicious. Would have liked a lunch combo option or salad in the roll but overall very happy with meal.

Don’t come here. My roast was cold, even the small meal isn’t cheap $17 I expect it to be hot and fresh. Mine was stone cold. I called them up to ask for to replace it for a hot fresh one they said no! Bad customer service will never be back I’m sure there are plent better roast shops around!

Disappointed again. Been a year since I'd been hoping it would be nice. I was wrong. Pork under cooked. Gravy had so much cornflour/thickener and tasted terrible. Kumar just boiled and still hard. Peas and carrots undercooked. Potatoes were great. Definitely be sticking with charms roast from now on

Our first and only time we will ever order here, we have never had such an awful experience. We ordered through uber eats, 2 chicken curries, 1 vegetarian. The chicken in BOTH of the curries was pink. Not only that but as shown in the third picture there was also an unknown meat in the chicken korma that was NOT chicken. On top of the uncooked chicken and unknown meat the vegetarian curry and garlic naan was just flavourless and simply inedible. We do NOT recommend ordering from here, I wish we read the reviews first. Please do better, it’s so dangerous serving uncooked chicken as you should know being a restaurant…

Recently I visited New Zealand, I had the chance to dine at Pahadi Pearl Indian Restaurant and it was truly an amazing experience! The food was not only delicious but also hygienically prepared and full of authentic Indian flavors. I tried their Butter chicken Garlic Naan each dish was cooked to perfection and bursting with rich, traditional taste. The spices were well-balanced, the presentation was beautiful, and the aroma made the whole experience even better. The restaurant has a warm, welcoming atmosphere and the staff were incredibly friendly and attentive. If you're in New Zealand and craving real Indian food, I highly recommend Pahadi Pearl. It's a must-visit for anyone who loves genuine Indian cuisine❤️

Absolutely Disgraceful - This Is NOT Biryani! I’m furious after wasting my money on what Pahari Pearl dares to call "biryani." Let me make it clear : this was not biryani. It was just plain spiced rice with dry chicken cubes thrown in. There was no layering, no aroma, no flavor depth just a salty, confused mess of ingredients pretending to be a dish. Whoever is behind this travesty the so called chef and owner needs to go back to India and relearn what biryani actually is. This is culinary fraud, not food. You're insulting the heritage of one of the finest dishes ever created. Either learn how to cook biryani properly, or stop robbing people in the name of it. Pathetic and shameful !!

My meal was soo fresh and tasty ! I had the classic butter chicken and rice with some tandoori prawns and it’s a definite must try! I dined in as well and received such lovely, quick and friendly service. I could tell other customers were enjoying their meals too by the look of empty dishes. No doubt Pahadi Pearls will continue doing their best! Thank you for your great service

Ordered goat curry, they gave me lamb. And even after saying that its lamb n not goat, they didnot actioned anything. Toilets were pathetic. Quantity of food was like a fine dine in restaurant but taste was just ok. Nothing great photo attached to show its lamb pieces

Fish (snapper) - 8/10 nice and fresh, batter not too greasy. Cheese burger - 10/10 so much salad and had 2 Pattie’s with a lot of cheese. Very well worth the price. Chips - crunchy outside, soft inside, not too greasy -10/10 Donut - added a lot of cinnamon sugar just how I like it and cooked very well still light and fluffy -10/10 I’m very fussy on fish n chips so I am not over exaggerating on my scores. Service was very friendly and they provide the food quickly for how busy they are. Found my new regular fish n chip stop!! Thanks guys :)
Good chips, average fish, big hot dogs. Ridiculously small donuts. Good price. $22 for family of 3
Best local fishnchips from Botany to Howick. Great chips & snapper always fresh & generous portions. Friendly service & take phone orders.

We ordered no.6 package from Reel Catch. Their selected fish was poor quality the batter was at least 2/3 of the size of it and fish meat non existent. Price -online menu is old and the meal cost us another $20 more than expected. I would be happy to pay this if it was good -but the fish was not worth it. Good size hotdogs, chips are average. Left with grease in belly and not much food. Unfortunately we won't be back and are moving on to the next fish shop.
Well deserved 5 stars. we could not fault the food, very tasty and cooked to perfection. their batter is excellent. well priced, we will definitely visit again.

I've eaten here more than five times now and out of those five times my chips was seasoned only once. Serving time is fast but id rather wait a bit longer and get a bit more quality out of the food. My burger barely had any sauce or chicken on it. Please season the chips.

Staff can give good service if you deal with them one on one. Food generally fresh & tasty although wraps sometimes a bit messy. Restaurant can be messy but the staff quickly put it right if you let them know

WARNING TO ALL CUSTOMERS!!! - Average 30+ min wait time, even when you order online prior, you will end up standing around for another 20. - Kiosks don't work. You can make your order on them, but staff will not get your order, so your food won't be made until you ask them where your food is. Don't know why they just don't turn the kiosks off if they don't work? -They will prioritise delivery orders over the people standing right in front of them. - Front of house is too busy helping other staff to give and take orders. - Food was missing from my order too. Would rate 0 stars if I could. Management needs to hire more staff because this place is a circus.

I have been often told about the poor quality of the local Pakuranga KFC. However, when I finally had the chance to visit the location, I was surprised by the experience. The food was good, and it came out fast. Restaurant was very clean and staff were friendly. Shout out to Arjun for helping me decide my order.

Absolutely terrible experience at this KFC. The staff were noisy, shouting and laughing as if they were at a party—not a restaurant. It was clear they had no respect for the customers trying to enjoy their meal. When I asked for ketchup, they casually said they were out. I asked for any other sauce, and they told me I had to pay for it. Zero customer service, zero professionalism. I will never come back, and I strongly advise others to avoid this place completely.

Shoutout to Heath absolute legend. Always brings good energy, works fast, and treats customers with respect. You can tell he takes pride in what he does, making sure orders are right and service is smooth even when it’s busy. He’s the kind of worker that makes you want to come back. Friendly, reliable, and just on point every time. If you’re going through Carl’s Jr and Heath’s on shift, you’re in good hands.

It was really very rude behavior of the staff and Manager on duty on Monday evening around 7pm. Ordered 3 burgers and sides including onion rings and the onion rings were old and reheated again with full of oil. I ask with manager but she was not interested to deal with customers. So bad experience. Even asked spicy but she told, we can only make this much spicy. Please think twice to visit CARL'S JR. PAKURANGA. If you want fresh go any other place. Avoid rude, misbehaving and rough staff and oil filled reheated old food items in Carl's Jr. Pakuranga.

Ordered 2 burgers and cheesy fries through door dash from this store found a baby cock roach inside the cheesy fries just running about. I threw out the entire order. thanks for keeping me hungry tonight. Will definitely never eat/ order Carl’s jr ever. Thank you Pakuranga.

Food was okay. I got a single memphis and my bf got portobello double. The cheese on the fries wasn’t melted and looked different from the advertisement :( fries was also soggy and didnt seem fresh. First time trying, its okay, but def wont be coming back.

Only fast food place where you can be burgers like this (image) in a little over a minute. Speed was so fast in drive through. Literally pulled up and got order. The fries changed though, I’m not sure what happened but the fries (especially cross cut) were so good, but now it’s just soggy and ‘doughy’. Burgers are still great though. Also 16.99 for double Angus is.. questionable. In their defense it’s the closest diner style burger you can get from a fast food place in 1 minute so I really can’t complain 😂

I ordered whooper. I found a problem at home. Patty was burn out(on picture) I drove to change by car again Staff was not kind. She changed new burger. But it was vegan burger. (On picture) I do not recommend here.
Chips were not cooked through, and chocolate milkshake tastes of expired whipped cream. Dated and cold store. - went in to order and take away.

This restaurant must be the worst location across all Burger King sites. On entrance the floors had puddles on them, no signs out, exceedingly slippery. The slope down into the toilets' from the entrance door causes you to slide along the floor uncontrollability. I ordered at the kiosk, dine in, which resulted in your staff packing it into take out bag.
