I requested a tray when collecting my order - 4 times the staff member did not understand what a tray was, even when pointing at one above the take out bags. She then placed the hot order on the cold shelf to wait while she got a supervisor. This supervisor then ask me three times what the problem was, I responded that I would like a tray for my dine-in order. Eventually this was understood and the now cold meal plonked in the middle of the tray. The Hawaiian burger was not cut as advertised, there was no ketchup included in the meal or offered. Ad the disgusting state of the restaurant tables - dirty with sauce, graffiti, broken and with chairs missing padding - I wonder how this restaurant passes any kind of inspection. I suspect nothing will come of the comments I have to make considering the generic responses afforded any negative reviews. 15/04/24: no response other than the generic “copy and paste” of all reviews and a generic email about “getting in touch once they review things” - guess that sums up Burger Kings care for customer service, safety and hygiene.

Standard Burger King. Sterile dining area. Used to have a TV playing clips of adventure sports, which livened up the place a bit, but that is now gone. You almost get the impression the staff are scared of the customers, as there is very little interaction or attempt at customer service.

Date: Wednesday 21st May Time: 8.50pm Beware, the Indian supervisor will lie to you about staff discount not working we know he is lying because straight afyer he said that, we went to another BK and it did work. This is not the first time he has lied about it. So annoying!
Ordered butter chicken and chicken korma combo with garlic naan for takeaway. Both meals were great, however garlic naan was tough and dry.
Great Indian restaurant. Loved all the curries we tried.

Had a dinner with my family. It was first time to hav one there. Staff was kind and polite! The food we ordered was shahi panner, prawn butter masala, Tandoori chicken and garlic&cheese naan and plain one. All meal served was well prepared and lassi was also yummy. Will visit agin.
Great taste of food. Had chilli chicken and cheese naan. The quality of food is top level and delicious. Best in the town 10/10.
The staff is extremely friendly! We ordered three different curries, and all three were delicious. I particularly enjoyed the cheese garlic naan, super soft. Highly recommended to everyone!

I visited Mandarin Palace Seafood Restaurant recently and tried only their dim sum, and I must say it was delicious. The variety was impressive, with all the dim sum staples like har gow, siu mai, BBQ pork buns, and cheung fun freshly prepared and served steaming hot. Service was efficient, and the food came out quite quickly even though it was fairly busy. Prices were reasonable for the quality and portion sizes. Overall, it was a satisfying dim sum experience. I can’t comment on the seafood/main dishes yet, but I’ll definitely return to try more.
Nice staff and great service but served us raw chicken everything else was cooked well

Would try somewhere else next time Ordered takeaway from here because the website said free delivery over $100. Then vit a text saying we had to pick up because they don't offer it anymore but no discount. Food was done on time and fairly tasty but mixed bag (lamb chop and tension great, spring roll oily, BBQ pork "sides" below average and $18). And actually pretty expensive all round with most mains at $42. I can eat in downtown for less so why would I go here?
food are fresh out of the kitchen , serve within 15 minutes
One of the best chinese food / yum cha I have had. Loved the rice rolls and Coriander dumplings. The egg tarts were amazing as well👌
Terrible service is terrible food. Stingy portions. Do not support this business they treat you like dirt. Trust me, go anywhere else. This mcdonlds is the worst in nz.

Just came in 10 mins to close and they were already fully closed pretty much, if you’re actually unable to purchase anything from here 15+ mins from the store you should change the closing hours on google so people don’t bother coming after 8:45 also the guy was very combative when I told him he tried to tell me it was already 9pm which it absolutely wasn’t. I usually have good experience here but it’s so annoying when businesses falsely advertise their trading hours which wastes time and costly fuel. Also I go to the Subway at Botany Town Centre they are serving right up till 9pm like it says on their trading hours
Ordered online for pickup. Came into the store to collect at the scheduled time, staff werent aware of my order, so they made it straight away. The food was ok.
I love it. Subway is the best, I go almost everyday. You don't understand my love for subway, nobody does. I NEED IT I LOVE IT GIVE IT TO ME
Always love coming here, best service and always have my gluten free wraps ✅😀

Fantastic spot for a great night out! The food at 123 Palm Bar is fresh and delicious, and the atmosphere is lively and welcoming. Whether you're in the mood to play darts or book a billiards game, there's always something fun to do. The staffs are friendly. Highly recommend for a casual hangout or a fun night with friends!

Beautiful food at reasonable prices, unfortunately it took over 40 minutes for us to get three mains and there were only two other tables dining so was a bit of a let down, but the food was amazing so would certainly return and recommend. Menu is varied and good, no drinks menu anywhere so you have to guess pricing. The only other negative is the flies... Everywhere! Needs some fly control at this place.

Plenty of parking and really lovely staff in this pub/restaurant/lounge. I find the “African” theme a bit uncomfortable - it’s more American in menu and style. The tables are beautiful solid slices of wood but there aren’t really any comfy spots to sit - with the exception of a large corner sofa that I wouldn’t risk skin contact with. The food is okay - well prepared but the quality of the chicken was a bit disappointing. You need free range flavour for hot-stone skewers, or at least leg meat. The retro shrimp cocktail, however, was excellent. Really enjoyed it. There is a good selection of beers and ciders on tap, good prices across the board, outdoor seating and a pool table so a lot to like. BIG points for having real peace lilies! Love plants and hate plastic ones 🪴🌿 All round decent pub.

Price: great Food: Quality and alot of flavour Staff: Friendly Service: Fast service This place is really underrated and needs recognition for their good food Booking was with my husband at 7pm on a Saturday night Actually love the stone grill steak with fresh veggies with pesto based flavoring over the top absolutely delicious and the potatoes top with balsamic vinegar flavoring. Absolutely delightful $28 id say that's a great bargain . This is a must try Garlic bread was 🔥 Thank you so much to all the staff and the chefs for making our evening a good one . 2nd visit tonight at 7pm with my cousin on the 29th of March and still exceeds my expectations thank you again to the chefs and the wonderful staff for another lovely night of food and great service appreciate it so much .

Love the food here, they deserve more acknowledgement for their food. Great price range. The mussels are delicious Can't go wrong here. Maybe if they add on seafood chowder then it will be a home run..

Regular customer - came in last week to pick up a garlic prawn thin crust pizza. I got there within 10 minutes of ordering - it was not cooked properly the dough was disgusting and the pizza was cold - lady said Manager not here - absolutely disgusted paid nearly $20 and nobody could be bothered to get back to me when I called.
I really like the highland park store staff are always accommodating with their customer service. Cooking time is great dont have to wait for long for one's order.

I wish Google had negative stars to give for their service & food. I have been an old and regular customer of Dominos highland park. I always order Vegetarian pizzas / Scrolls but today I ordered some pizzas for kids party & realized that they don't clean the cutters instead use same cutter for non-veg and veg pizzas. Upon raising the issue with the staff, I was told that we should be calling them while placing the order. Its a common sense that vegetarian pizza should be cut be different cutter. I had to throw the vegetarian pizza which was for my family after what I caught at their premises. Very disappointed with Dominos !! Dominos has lost a brand value and loyalty from me.
I loved the food. The pizzas were so fresh and I have never had a better or tastier pizza before. The people were so friendly as well. We will make sure to come back again.
My favorite pizza is classic creamy chicken , very fast cook and nice amazing pizza!(also a lot meat on it)love it!

Awesome spot! Tried the noodle soup, garlic butter crawfish, and the vermicelli with fried tofu and shrimp paste. Everything was packed with flavor. The vermicelli dish was seriously a bomb! Food came out fast, service was great, and the place looks really cozy and welcoming for a family dinner. Definitely coming back!

The Pho here is really good, the broth is very flavourful, and the herbs give it a very fresh flavour. The crispy pork was very tasty and crispy, especially when in a Banh Mi. The prices are very reasonable as the quality of food is fantastic. This has become one of my preferred Vietnamese restaurants

In love with in this Vietnamese restaurant. They served best Pho, best pork chop rice. They provide you wonderful ambience to have your lunch or dinner. It is overall very comfortable restaurant that you want to dine in. I come here N times, it is my ‘go-to’ restaurant whenever I craves for something soupy 👍🏻👍🏻

The chicken fried rice was decent but underwhelming. It lacked salt and could definitely use more spice to bring out the flavors. The overall taste was a bit bland. Would’ve been much better with proper seasoning.

One of my favorite places in Auckland for lunch and dinner. Their hot pot is perfect size for small groups of people. Soup paste is nice. It's sweet and sour. They have dessert occasionally - black rice yogost, salted egg sponge cake and sugar cane juice. Ask the staff on the day for these.

I specifically called to check if i can dine in the restaurant without being a member. I was told by staff over the phone that was no problem. When i arrived, i was told by a lady at the sign in counter it was members-only. When i advised I had called to check before coming there, the lady said 'probably new staff'. When i suggested they should let the new staff know about their policy, the reply was 'yup ill let them know'. no apology, no acknowledgment ive wasted time and petrol because of their error.

What a great club. Lots of facilities and well used by the locals/members. I had calamari from the bar snack menu and they were so delicious! Soft as butter, served with a fresh green salad. There could have been a little less batter, but overall, a great dish. An hour of pool playing after dinner ended on a great note 🙂
Great place. Highly recommend joining the club, especially if you have a young family. There is loads of events they do that make it worthwhile. The restaurant food is awesome as well.
Delicious salmon meal from the menu - compliments to the chef. Generous wine measure too. Sometimes waiting staff need to be called but always pleasant & willing to help once alerted.
First time visiting with a friend who is a member. Loved it, nice setup, sports section and full size snooker table. and Food was awesome

Came here for lunch and to watch the UFC as we usually do, and we are never let down. We love the nachos, good feed for $24! The staff are always polite and friendly to talk to, food is always on point, and lovely atmosphere. Thank you, we will be back!

Decided to try Apple Jacks again since I hadn’t been in a couple of years. Really quiet despite the nice atmosphere and interior. The service from the male Waiters and Staff was great and friendly, and the food although we had just had entrees, was still delicious and reasonably priced. The table was quite sticky, which I thought was strange. And what slightly let me down was when paying, the young girl asks us what table we were at, expecting us to know even though the tables don’t have any numbers on them. Then after we payed and I thanked her, she casually replied “All Good” without really even looking at me or acknowledging me which I found rude. She just tried to hurry us up and move on to take the payment for the people behind us. Overall nice experience, but let down by the service of some of the young girls. What I think some of the young waitresses need to remember is that it is how the service ends that leaves the lasting impression.

Steaks ordered were cooked perfectly. Rib platter was nice size. Wedges crispy and inside perfect. Wings little bit on the small side however tangy sauce was great. Onion rings 👍. T's brisket burger succulent and polished off enthusiastically. Make sure you get cheese with the garlic bread. You won't regret it. Apple crumble is a visual delight. Nice dessert. Not a large range of ice-cream however we were told it would be expanding. Mocha's 👏. Wait staff were lovely and had an answer for every question... I like that. At 6pm on a Friday it was unusually quiet. Maybe it rocks on Saturday and Sunday. A Visually appealing and large venue that I hope gets the patronage through the doors. Well done Applejacks. 👏

Great atmosphere, great food. Everything well prepared and fresh! Try the crumbed mushrooms, delicious! 10/03/23 We went for a burger tonight expecting the good food and atmosphere we have been used to, but no, the music was overwhelmingly loud, the menu has been changed, no more crumbed mushrooms or the delicious chicken burger we where expecting, don't know if ownership has changed but it's not the same at all. Very disappointed.

Never experienced the tap ginger beer in the bar, taste so fresh 🤩 Today ordered Garlic Loaf, Chicken Fettuccine, kids cheese burger, the family were entertained. Recommend the Chicken Fettuccine, how can the chef cooked it so juicy👍love it.
Great place for homemade food.
Very good for spices....ect....
Delicious!
Great service and tasty food.The sweet and sour pork excellent.Good value for money
Large portion in a reasonable price! Tasty and great food. I will come back again and recommend it to my friends too. Good location and have a lot of car parks. 😀
Great local. Been coming here for years. Beside their fish & chips, love their sweet n sour, chow mein, black bean & fried rice options. Very tasty, reasonable prices.
Splendidly surprised this takeaway was good value and quality compared to most f&c takeaways . Fish was yummy and not just batter. Tasty and fresh will def go back. Specials were good value !
Awesome local fish and chip shop. Been there for a long time. Great couple who own and run the place.

Taste wise, it’s decent. Less heavy and weaker in terms of taste than other restaurants. However, I love their Durian Mochi, they put an abundant amount of Durian in it. Second favourite was the rice porridge. The location is a little far though, and the seating area is a bit packed for our group of 8. Got to try all the dishes, would still go again if others wants to go.

Although the restaurant name suggests Vietnamese cuisine, they also serve delicious dim sum. Crunchy prawn dumplings, flavorful pork siu mai. Their char siu / durian / thousand egg pastry are also very yummy. Good location for weekend yum cha.

Overall food is good. I loved their siu mai with a taste of mushroom. Next time I might try their pho P.S. their tea was quite nice. Downside: no private parking space, limited off street parking, only outdoor space for dining
Delicious dimsum but owner is from Vietnam. Highly recommended

I love the food at this place. The taste is so good, and the prices are very affordable. I highly recommend trying the yum cha and bao dishes. They offer a variety of yum cha options to choose from, which is great for trying new things. The atmosphere is cozy and welcoming, making it a perfect spot to enjoy a delicious meal with friends or family.
Poor service!! It was 3 people inside and made me wait for 5 minutes to get a service.
Half an hour later..... Still waiting for the coffee
The food here is fantastic. Authentic flavours, big portion and great quality. I got 2 noodle dish and they were really good. Spring rolls are nice and crispy, best flavour.

Nice and easy local Vietnamese restaurant. The service was very friendly, although we did not expect high-end authentic food as the prices are very affordable. It's a nice place to dine for quick Vietnamese food. There is plenty of parking.

Great tasting Vietnamese food in a small Restaurant. Simple menu to choose from, appetisers, rice and noodles dishes. You can add extra meat, rice and noodles for a extra cost. The prices are a little steep, but you do get a good size portion. Parking around the corner, not in front.

Absolutely loved my experience at Viet Hoa. The food was incredibly fresh and full of authentic Vietnamese flavor. This is a true gem for anyone craving delicious, comforting Vietnamese cuisine. Highly recommend!
The food was delicious, with generous portion sizes that really impressed me. The staff were friendly and welcoming. I highly recommend this place!

I’ve been here a few times now, can I go there and not buy anything probably not this is how good this place is they have good service the drinks taste good I never thought I’d be a bubble tea kind of guy but halucat has changed me Sterling Arnet Kakapo business Sales

I loved their bobas ever since we came here with my husband. I loved this branch more than others coz they make my perfect slushy but today they gave us a tasteless milk tea and chocolate slushy. Too far to go back.
One of the best bubble tea shops in Auckland! I’ve been here a few times and I am always impressed by the taste of my drink. The workers here are also very friendly!

Hulucat is always my go to for Bubble Tea in East Auckland. They have a good variety of drinks, including ones suitable for kids. Drinks are made fairly quickly and you can takeaway or drink there. They have tables and seating, as well as some board games. Friendly service and they do a stamp card system

Refreshingly good, quenched my thirst. Location clean, modern and inviting. Customer service friendly and quick. One of the better places that’s serves tea and the like. A little pricer than others but worth it.

Response to owner: The fact remains: your business sold a gift voucher without following *your own procedures*, yet you refuse to honor it, conveniently claiming it was never issued. This isn’t just poor customer service—it’s outright deceptive. Your response also suggests that you retain ownership of vouchers and "review proof of purchase at your discretion." In other words, you’ll happily take people’s money while arbitrarily deciding whether they actually get what they paid for—because, of course, anyone receiving a gift voucher is expected to have the original receipt. What a convenient way to avoid accountability. Looking through other reviews, there appears to be a pattern of shady business practices across multiple fronts so I guess it’s not surprising of this business. Why would anyone trust a business that refuses to honor its own transactions? A gift voucher is supposed to be a simple, hassle-free gift—not an ordeal filled with accusations and excuses. If you truly cared about customer service, you’d be fixing this issue, not gaslighting customers into believing they’re responsible for the failures of your business and staff. Review: My partner and I went to this location to redeem a gift voucher we had received over the holidays. When we went to pay, we were told the voucher was "very old" and had been issued the previous year. We had no idea, as it had no issue date, expiry, or any other details. The cashier initially said we could use it for biltong, but after making a phone call, they informed us it was not valid—despite no expiry information being stated. This is poor business practice. They had no issue taking money for the voucher, but when it came time to redeem it, they refused. They also refused to give back the voucher. We will never shop here again.
Nice shop with lots of goodies. Bought chili dry wors and tennis biscuits. I came to get Cobra floor wax which I use for craft purposes. All round good experience.
Purchased 160g biltong but found a significant portion was just fat and not edible. Biltong with some fat would fine but this was two large strips of pure fat. Quite disappointing.

Got $59.67 worth of original Biltong it’s really bad ! Waste of money not dried up still red inside and not much favour we live out west to late to go back to return this , what a waste of money very disappointing . The meat is not properly cured it’s still wet and red inside, probably needed a few more weeks to dry up .
Got my biltong fix today, the lady inside was super helpful and let me try a few before buying! Can’t wait to try the cafe on Harris road! Thanks team

I had a busy day, and felt like some basic takeaways. It's been a while, but I feel a single scoop of chips doesn't go as far as it used to? The service was fine, with the kids manning the counter for the parents, and the food was okay, if a bit pricier than I remember. Just your basic chip shop.
Love this lil local. Over the phone, no confusion with my order's and they are always so polite.
We come here often. Friendly takeaway. They're popular. Maybe only factor is the greasy chicken n chips, that's all..
Good food, decent prices but you may find yourself waiting a long time on weekdays around 6 and 7.

Ordered battered sausages, we received no batter, the potatoe fritters were so thin they were nearly see through, the $8 chips was about a $5 worth, We called and complained but they did not budge. Disappointed

We booked a seat for 30 about two weeks ago. The owner, Anna, reassured us that she would make a private place for us to sit for lunch together. The Food was delicious. Andy and the crew patiently took our requests and yet never stopped checking us if we needed anything. It's a very affordable and lovely venue. We definitely will come back. Thank you so much for your hospitality and great service!

Food is amazing! We walked in but we were accommodated as if we had a booking - service is excellent. Very busy at the kitchen, the chef took time to greet customers and check how the food is. We loved the Kerabu Tofu - crunchy exterior of the silk tofu added a layer of texture that will leave a party in your mouth. Will definitely go back to try out other dishes in their menu. Highly recommend to go and try this local restaurant.

Right beside the Z station on Pakuranga Highway - across the road from KFC. — The most delicious Malaysian food and great service from friendly staff. Excellent atmosphere in a beautiful setting. We enjoyed all of the dishes, the highlights being salt & pepper squid and the golden pillow (chicken curry inside a baked loaf) - note, you do need to pre-order the golden pillow when making your booking. Looking forward to our next visit!

Now a Malaysian restaurant with authentic tasting dishes. You need to pre-order some dishes such as Golden Pillow and Hainanese Chicken. We had the Golden Pillow, Kampung Tofu, Dry-fried round beans, Beef with combination vegetables and Golden prawns without shell. Food came out reasonably quick and very tasty. Indoor seating has Air-Con.

Visited this place for the first time on Wednesday. Ordered one dry fried hor fun and one with soup. The noodles were fresh but tasted ordinary. Unfortunately, we could hear the boss loudly scolding the staff while waiting for the food. We felt uncomfortable and would not patronize again.

Luna Tea offers Chinese Malaysian food, as well as Bubble Tea for takeaway during lockdown. Food was very tasty and still hot after I got home. You can ring ahead to order and pay when picking up. Their advertised hours may differ during lockdown, so I suggest you to ring ahead before ordering online on their website
One of the best if not the best family owned Malaysian Restaurant in the area! The food is definitely a 5 star!
A great place to have Malaysian meal. The milk tea also nice. Good portion and good price.
cheapest malaysian food in the area but cheap has cheaps reason. its alright but dont have high expectations

Genuinely surprised at this eatery. The chef is really into little details and finessed in his cooking. Hainanese chicken rice. You wonder how there are stores across the ditch that uses it as a namesake for the store name and just ends up being just doable. The chicken is sufficiently cooked over here and flavourings are god tier. Would definitely give them an unofficial Michelin Star. Try the place out and you'd may think what the other places put so little efforts to spoil a famous dish.

One of the things I really enjoy from this place is their cold dishes — super flavourful and refreshing. I usually take away the sliced beef tripe, potato strips and tofu. It’s a great combo — the texture, the seasoning. Simple, tasty, and perfect as a light meal or side dish. Always hits the spot!
Food was good and yummy, but the service was a bit slow seemly due to under staffing, also waiting staff members kept speaking Contonese to us even after we explained we didn't understand that.
Nice chinese cursine
The duck meat is full of hair, and the mud in the dish is not cleaned, so I give a bad review.
This place is rough. Dry old sushi in the cabinet, ~20$ if you want something fresh. Avoid.

Went there Saturday afternoon and placed my order for one sushi roll. 15 minutes goes past and I hear them cleaning in the back which I thought was odd since there was many other people waiting. I then ask how long it is going to take and she said the rice is still cooking…another 15 minutes so nearly 30-40 minute wait.. I said I wanted a refund and that they should inform people of this before ordering. Especially with their prices also being more then other places
Sushi roll is ok, but don’t order the rice dishes! Teriyaki chicken rice is so tough and full of greasy mayo.
Omg! Can you tell this is salmon donburi? Absolutely unpaletable! It is roten! I have been bruce lee customer for years and this order from this branch just killed the reputation!
Stingy portions compared to the other chains. Tasted a bit off as well

Picked up a mean feed from here for Mumsy Day 2025❤️‍🩹 located in a nice suburbia spot out Pakuranga, it has a neat dark interior setting and you're served by a lovely bunch of folk. We all enjoyed our hearty & tasty meals🤤🙌🏽 my bad missed a pic of the tasty & meaty brisket burger as it was attacked asap😁

Situated in a quite street tucked away from Pakuranga shopping Centre is this gem of a lil food shop. I was looking for BBQ food that didn't break the bank and I tell you what this place is the place to go. Not the best dressed place and staff were good but not very talkative but I tell you what when you trey the food, the food does all the talking needed. I ordered the all for one and one for all the the portion size is defs not 1 person size which is great 🥰 my family all ordered burgers with a combo and even with the 6 dollar combo price you won't be disappointed 😊. Iff your ever in the neighborhood stop by and try my review for yourself, you won't be disappointed.

On the bright side the meat tastes good, I liked the flavour. I took brisket, pork ribs and chicken. The drawback, at least for me, is that the meat wasn't as tender and soft as I expected. It wasn't undercooked for sure, but felt like it could use another couple of hours sitting in the BBQ. The brisket was kinda chewy and was far from falling apart on fibers. Same with pork, which didn't slide from the bone. But again, those were my expectations, hence rather subjective. No complaints about the flavour.

As a huge fan of smoked meats, I had to try this place. The offset smokers out lead me an optimistic smoke trail to the front door. Had the pork ribs and brisket. Very well cooked, and not overly smoked, good choice of wood used for the meats. Brisket had good bark, was subtle, well seasoned. Some slices were a bit tough, may have been sliced againest the grain. Ribs were full of flavour, sauce was a bit sweet for me, but pork needs a sweet BBQ sauce. Service was decent, got my order within a few mins. Interior could do with a bit of a love, but when the food is that good, I would still go back

Been coming to Smokey wheels ever since they opened. Top notch food cooked perfectly every time. Big portions that leave you feeling content for the remainder of the day. If you haven’t tried these guys out, you’re missing out!! They also do catering, and we’ve used them a few times, best catered food I’ve ever had!! You get more than you pay for and only the best cuts 👌🏼👌🏼 Keep up the good work guys!! 💯

Update: I was not happy with the service, and the owner took the step and apologized. I hope to improve Hi, I. I used to order before 2 years the food was delicious today , I ordered chicken biryani again, and I am disappointed because first, the meal portion is small. The amount of the chicken regarding the price is small, which will not be enough for an adult this size of chicken enough for kids 😑 😒 and second, unfortunately, the chicken was not cooked will.
Excellent northern Sri Lankan taste, specially the lamb curry and goat curry. Reasonable price with excellent family like service. Coming here for few years now, love this place
Just AMAZING FOOD. You may have to wait but you are waiting for the REAL & AUTHENTIC food. Worth every penny. The owners feed you with love and passion. Must visit if you are in Auckland.
Spicy Sri Lankan food. Great it you are a spicy food fan. I found it a tad too spicy. But great for people who like that sort. Excellent prices
Very good meals we had. Very flavorsome. Would have liked the fried chicken to have had bigger and more tender chicken pieces., otherwise great value for money paid.
The chips here are the best I've had in a long time. Old fashioned crinkle cut, crispy and not oily at all. Very impressed!
Great takeaway for Chinese! Staff are lovely and they do the BEST wontons! Great sized dishes too. Everything we've had we love.
Good customer service. Food was ok

I'm currently in high school and know the owners, I've been going ever since the start of my intermediate days, always going after school to grab a quick feed with my mates. The food is very nicely priced with great proportions, and they treat their regulars well with some extra pieces! I used to order 2 potato fritters and get 4 during my intermediate days as a little boy. Very honest business and honest family.

I'VE TRIED AFEW DIFFERENT DISHES ON THE MENU HERE AND ALL WERE QUIET TASTY ENOUGH ,, THE HOMES IS FAST & FURIOUS WITH A FRIENDLY SMILE ,,,, SUPER QUICK & EFICIENT , COOKS THE FAMOUS CRINKLE CUT CHIPS ,, 1O / 10 $HOT G

Went to Mumma Parks to try some Korean food the space is nice and cozy and good for small groups. It’s a place where you should buy dishes to share with other people and eat family style so you can try different things. I would say this is about a 4 out of 5 stars because it feels like you’re eating at someone’s house in terms of the food nothing amazing but a lot of good things

I ordered three items: the squid and pork belly mix, a pancake, and a serving of fried chicken. I placed the order over the phone and picked it up at the store. They charged me a total of $145, which is way too expensive. What’s more, the prices listed on their Google menu are significantly different from the in-store prices—completely inconsistent. Take the squid and pork belly platter shown in my photo, for example—can you believe it costs $70 NZD? Normally, a similar dish at other Korean restaurants would only be around $30–40. This place charges almost double, and even at that price, the portion size is really small. As for the taste, I can only say it’s absolutely not worth the price. Overall, this is the least cost-effective and least tasty Korean restaurant I’ve ever tried.
Located in highland park , Mama Parks is a small and cozy restaurant that offers delicious food and a lovely atmosphere. If you’re in the area make sure to stop by this hidden gem 💎.

I loved this place. Overall the food was good, and the amount of serving was more than enough. Also the service was wonderful. The mood was really nice. The waitresses were really kind. I'm gonna come to this place again :))

Mama parks always has the best food! We had a big group dinner here and the owner was very accommodating and kind. The shop however is a bit small so i’d recommend coming with a smaller group. The food however was so good!! We got a range of dishes like the half half fried chicken which was sooo good and juicy. The budae jjigae was soo good and warmed us up from the windy weather. The other food we got was really nice too and came very quickly. Overall i’d definitely recommend this place if you’re wanting some yum korean food !

Good food, excellent Karaoke - the system looks newly upgraded and there are many latest songs inc Bruno Mars Dying with a smile, Malay songs, Korean songs etc. We went during happy hour $25pp includes $25 worth of food and 3 hours of karaoke room. Great selection of food and they were delicious and good portions. Easy, free parking. The ladies toilet when we went was a let down - it looks clean and nicely presented, however there was a really bad smell from the toilets - maybe the sewerage system was faulty - i had to cover my nose with my shirt when inside - a mask would have been a lifesaver.

Reviewing Karaoke only. Came here for "Happy Hour" on a Friday night 6pm to 9pm. Their phone number has issues, so we just turned up and there were rooms available. Although it may pay to book if you can. Reasonably priced for 3 hours and you can order food, which is added as part of your total minimum charge. Song selection is not bad.

Very friendly and accomodating staff, karaoke system is OK to use but was much better onced we starting using their youtube app for songs not showing on their main system (PS: make sure to have "karaoke" in your youtube searches to get the lyric displayed music videos). Only negative was the sewage smell in the main reception area but karaoke rooms had aircon to prevent it lingering in there. Overall fun experience, would definitely go back.

Ordered the Beef rice noodles payed $23 for a container of bean sprouts, burnt beef, no flavour and no noodles maybe the bean sprouts was the replacement, also cold. The inside of the place smells like urine from the second the doors open , staff is very unwelcoming

Used a grabone coupon and mentioned it to the staff when booking a karaoke session. The staff was making up rules when we got there instead of stucking to the terms and conditions of the coupon, it was so weird. But he let us stick with the terms of the coupon after some light arguing. Definitely don't recommend going unless you're ready for hostile staff.

If you're craving Chinese food, this restaurant is a great choice. They even offer lobster, and the portion sizes are generous. The food tastes excellent, and the owner is very accommodating, offering customization to suit your preferences.

Nyonya Seafood Restaurant In Highland Park offers a variety of delicious Asian dishes. The food came relatively quick , considering we booked during weekend dinner time. The staff were friendly and helped us if we were in need of anything E.g. extra plates, hot water or tea, extra utensils. The food was done very well and came to the table Hot , fresh and full of flavour. Overall this was a lovely experience and a great way to end off the week.😊

⭐⭐ ⭐ Inconsistent Quality The first time I came here, I had the roast duck rice, and it was really good. That convinced me to come back for a second and third visit, trying the Peking duck, seafood, and vegetables. Unfortunately, the food tasted different each time—and not in a good way. It actually felt like it got worse with each visit. Probably won’t be returning.

Food service and prices were absolutely amazing only issue was/is its an hour drive from where I live haha iwish they were closer to my home the Golden pillow is the most amazing curry and bread combo

Those food bloggers really overhype restaurants-they either don’t have taste buds or get paid to say the food is good - I ordered the golden pillow - the chicken tasted like it wasn’t fresh and the bread - advertised as fresh fluffy fry bread was probably just heated in a microwave and definitely not fresh- what a waste of $48 - ok byeeee (as that food bloggers would say)

I visited Men Ichi for the first time with my friends, and it was such a great experience! I haven’t had ramen or Japanese food in ages, and trying it here really brought back memories of the real taste of Japan. The flavors were so authentic and comforting. The staff were super friendly, looked after us with big smiles, and made us feel so welcome. The food quality was perfect—absolutely loved it! If you miss Japanese food, want to try it for the first time, or are planning a trip to Japan, Men Ichi is the perfect place to get a feel for the real Japanese atmosphere. Highly recommended!

Authentic Japanese ramen although I’ve never been but imagined this is what it would be like. As soon as we stepped in greeted by all staff including the chef’s. Service was attentive and food services quick. Food was really delicious and couldn’t fault the entire experience.

Authentic tasting Ramen in East Auckland. Menu offers a variety of flavoured soup bases, with options of adding extras such as bamboo shoots, pork, egg and even extra noodles. There are other side dishes such as karage chicken or takoyaki balls. Excellent service and you don't need to wait too long for the food.
Our new favourite Ramen place, best ramen we’ve had !! 😌, super nice atmosphere and everything is super authentic, staff are lovely and the food is amazing
The waiter is very considerate and the food is delicious.

Lanzhou hand-pulled noodles, fried noodles, soup noodles, dumplings, Chinese dishes and cold dishes. Lots of options available. The noodles are good value for money and the soup broth is not too salty. You can add extra toppings or noodles, if it's not enough. Parking can be a problem at times, as it's below Mandarin Palace
Fried dumplings, Braised Beef Noodle Soup, Fried Chicken and Stir Fry Noodles are absolutely delicious!

Not good, ordered vegetarian dish. Tasted fishes and bland, watery. The door said open, went in no customer and staff. We called out, and they said they were open. Place was dirty, cutlerys dirty. The chili oil was uncovered.
The food was great. We had the Lanzhou hand pulled noodles and it was great 👍. Loved the food. 👍

I was in the area on a Monday and this place was open so I decided to grab some akeaway from there. It is located under Mandarin Palace on Aviemore Drive so it can be easy to miss. The place is quite large with q few tables around. It was also self service for water and cutlery. I ordered the fried jelly noodle with vegetable and the pork dan dan noodles. You can see them hand pull the noodles on order. The jelly noodle was interesting with a firm texture. It had vegetables and egg and was quite nice. It was a nice place for a meal and most of the items were under $20.
An Authentic Gatsby experience! Very very tasty! You won’t need anything else after a half! The lads there know their stuff. If you want something to crunch the craving hit them up!
Authentic Durban Bunny Chow (Curry) Fantastic food, friendly service. 100% Recommend!!

My wife had seen an add on Facebook and how great the bunny chow looked. We're on the shore so I had to drive almost 70km return trip. Happy wife, happy life! 😋 On a serious note, the food was really authentic. Great customer service. Generous portions. Everything was fresh. The food was really tasty and flavor full. #foodie #yum #

Ordered slap chips and oxtail curry. Oxtail just fell off the bone it was so soft and so much flavour. Slap chips on a roll made me feel like I was home again. Highly recommend Zane and his team. Super friendly and awesome service 🤩
The food and service at Yumza Grill is fabulous. The curries are delicious and the price is really good! I will definitely be back for more!

We booked a table via First Table, so was able to get a good deal for a table of 4. We ordered the Pan-Roasted Lamb Rump and Butcher's Cut Steak. The food came out quickly and it was very tasty. Basalt is nicely layed out, with one corner for dining, another area where you can watch live sport and have drinks. As well as an upstairs area with music

I came in to Basalt on Saturday with my family, and I have to say that the service was incredible! Although fairly busy, our server, Finlay was still giving myself and my family top-notch service! Props to him! Food was wonderful and a nice atmosphere. Highly recommend. Thank you Finlay for making our night so special!

Walk in diners we were delighted to be able to get a table. We were served by the lovely Emma who was very helpful, proactive and friendly. Delicious gluten free chicken and bacon pizza made my day, while hubby enjoyed the meat lovers pizza. Rare to get such a tasty gluten free treat. Atmosphere was comfortable and hospitable. Fantastic Thanks Basalt.

We had a fantastic dinner at Basalt on Saturday night, made even better by the excellent service from our server, Finlay. He was friendly, attentive, and made great recommendations. His genuine hospitality added a personal touch to the evening. Thanks Finlay!

Rude server and don't bring water to the table even asking two times, third time was the charm. The other server was marginally better. Food is ok for the price, I would save yourself the trouble and not go.
Absolutely fantastic restaurant in Howick. We enjoyed every time we visited there. We like especially their special sauce on the fried noodles. Definitely try it!

Honestly one of the worst customer service experiences I’ve ever had. The owner was unbelievably rude like, not just having a bad day rude, but actually mean for no reason. It felt like I was bothering them just by being there. No hello, no smile, just attitude from the moment I walked in. I get that not every place is going to be friendly, but this was something else. Food was passable but not worth being treated like crap over. Plenty of other spots with better vibes and better service. Won’t be coming back.
Very “Cha Chaan Teng” style restaurant. Quick fix for Hong Kong milk tea, fried noodles, spicy and pepper pork chop.
The food here is very tasty and a must try. I’ve been coming here since I was a kid and am thoroughly impressed with the food. An absolute classic and a must try .
My go to local Chinese eatery, busy during peak hours but food is almost Goku like instant transmission. Sizzling beef and the salt and pepper braised fish is always ordered without fail

Me and my colleagues had a birthday dinner here, and it was such a lovely evening. The food was amazing and authentic Thai surely, I want to confirm it as a Thai person. The place was nice and crowded, so I’d definitely recommend you to book a reservation in advance if you don’t wanna wait a long time for the table. The staffs were nice and understood that we did truly want Thai food in a Thai version for Thai people, not like some restaurants where they water down and make it too sweet to satisfy those who are not Thai and cannot handle the spicy food.

We tried the banquet A or B, the food were delicious, but nothing too special. I reckon, best to just order different individual meals than ordering 3 course menu from the banquet. I didn't find it super worth it for the price.

The best lunch buffet that is affordable and great flavours for sure. The staff are so friendly and caring. Their Sunday lunch buffet is what attracted me to the restaurant, pretty authentic Thai food without adding any fushion element to it!

I would say definitely one of the nicest Thai restaurants I have tried in NZ. The crab meat fried rice is amazing. The raw prawns goes perfect with the home made sauce. The oysters were amazing as well. After finishing the meal, I ordered separately the take away for Crab fried rice and raw prawns to get my partner to try

Great service over the phone. When I got there it was very busy. Took the food home and started eating the first tray of food. I asked for a mild. The first dish they gave us was an Extra Hot. It burned our mouths and made our eyes water. I can handle an Indian medium or maybe Hot in the right day. But this was beyond that. The second dish was ok. Got the spice level right but was lacking in flavour. The rice was also very sticky and like something you expect to get out of a 1 min Uncle Ben’s from the super market. Not the flagrant and fluffy Jasmin rice you expect from a Thai restaurant. I’ll try this place again in the future. But not I need to go and get a Pizza as we couldn’t eat half our meal.
Fantastic food and great service. Highly recommend

I’ve been here twice now, and my second visit was undoubtedly disappointing. The waitstaff were incredibly rude and unprofessional. They walked around whispering things like “Do you need more water?” and when customers (understandably) didn’t hear them, they pulled judgemental faces and shrugged in a passive-aggressive way. It made the whole atmosphere really uncomfortable. I came in a large group, and as someone who also works in hospitality, I understand that big tables can be stressful. But treating customers like an inconvenience is unacceptable. Even if the staff felt ignored or overlooked, that’s no excuse for such unkind and dismissive behaviour. The actual shop was quite nicely decorated with cultural items. But after being treated such way, I definitely won’t be coming back.

Thai Restaurant on the main street of Howick. Good selection on the menu, with curries, stir fry, pad thai, salads etc. The entrées combo is good value and the curry puff pastry was really fluffy. They also have a kids menu, but not of Thai options, more nuggets and fish. Good size portions, but price on the higher side. Rice is $3 per person

Beautiful tom yum soup 👌 Great service and a warm, welcoming atmosphere. The stir fry was a little on the sweet side… could use more vegetables, more spice and SO much less sweet - but still good. The meat is good quality too - none of that takeaway only, flat, dry ‘sad chicken’… the meat from what I had was juicy, tasty and hopefully free-range. It is very expensive compared with most - but quality is worth cost.

We were invited by my sister for a lunch at this restaurant. She has been here several times and we now understand she likes it here. A great selection of dishes to choose from. Some of us had one of their options from the set lunch options incl. a drink. And two ordered from the entree options. The service was prompt and friendly and all of our chosen meals were very good.

Walked in on a sunny Saturday afternoon to a spacious dimly lit restaurant busling with connusiers. The food was very decently priced and very yummy and flavoursome . They were generous in the quantity served. Try their Thai dragonfruit summer drink as well. Must visit
Price is reasonable, large portions and tastes good. It’s open all day long but only takes cash or bank transfer.

Winter is the perfect time for a noodle soup. A simple noodle 🍜 soup with wonton, pork honey, or beef combination is a perfect comfort food. Wonton came with prawn filling and bean sprouts. Beef combination topping with dry noodles 🍜 such as beef brisket, beef tendon, beef tripe, and beef spleen was so delicious.
I would say great portion of meat / noodles. Good value for money. Only thing is that the beef brisket was a bit lean .
Very traditional Cantonese flavour.Went there four years ago with my friends.Back today with my hubby. He likes it very much,it’s his hometown flavour. I like the red bean smoothie.Yummy yummy!

Wanted to have something warm on a cold night so we came here for soup noodle but they don’t have heater in the restaurant so it was quite cold especially when customers walked in/ leaving. Ordered soup wonton noodle ($10) and beef brisket noodle ($11), they have one of the best egg noodle dish in Auckland. Noodles are chewy and thin, wontons are so big and wrapped with generous ingredients. Milk tea and french toast were just ok, their french toast taste a little bland and dry. This place is a little bit old and you might need to share the long table with others when it gets busy, they only accept cash and bank transfer (no eftpos). Not a fancy place but definitely a place to have a delicious egg noodle that doesn’t hurt your wallet at all. Food: 🌕🌕🌕🌕🌑 Price: 🌕🌕🌕🌕🌑 Ambience: 🌕🌕🌕🌑🌑 Service: 🌕🌕🌕🌑🌑

Genuine beef noodle soup. Decent portions and good value for money. Stinky tofu OK, but not really stinky enough. My younger daughter's love pork and chicken cutlets. Nice chewy noodles. Will be back.👍 Back 1 year later and still good. Prices have gone up, but portions are still a decent size. Beef noodle soup was really tender and good flavours, "stinky" tofu had no flavour. Still good value.

Wholesome eats-taste of home if you’re looking for something simple and nostalgic. Some rice set dishes even come with little sides and the best is the scrambled egg and tomato-most sentimental iconic dish of childhood is it not?? Iykyk. Yum broth full of flavour, decent portions, fair prices, clean and cosy eating setup and kind staff. Been last year and this year-consistency is there. Nothing fancy but they do a simple meal well.

Authentic Taiwanese cuisine. I've been coming here for many years and the food is consistently great tasting. Sides dishes are a must and if you are game, try the "Smelly tofu". Choose from a variety of noodle or rice dishes and they also do Bubble tea, which is ok

We have visited here many times already, while the restaurant keep their food standard in Epic mode everytime. The beef noodle is iconic delicious. A Other dishes like fried chicken so tender and juicy at the inside, just distinguished from others which fried to very dry interior. Also a lot of traditional dishes like fried tofu, dumplings , and tw bendo (lunch box) sets. Highly recommended.

Very average food, quite pricey for that portion too. Will visit Hsiun Yuan or Royal Horse if we are craving for Taiwanese Cuisine. Customer service is really bad, the waitress with a red watch strap was so rude, no smile no greeting, didn’t even place our food properly and just walked away. Not going to return again. What we ordered: Shredded chicken on rice Chicken fillet with garlic Crispy pork chop set Food: 🌕🌕🌕🌑🌑 Price: 🌕🌗🌑🌑🌑 Ambience: 🌕🌕🌑🌑🌑 Service: 🌗🌑🌑🌑🌑

It's been a long time since I last visited one of these places, and the burgers are as huge as I remember! The price reflects that, of course but they are very very nice. No problems with the quality for me. This place is not really designed for eating in, though there is a table, it's a very small establishment. The service was friendly and the food arrived pretty quick.
My new fave burger place. they have beaten Burger fuel in my opinion especially the size of burgers and the patty flavor is much better. I just hope they get some better Aioli
This is my sacred Burger palace All the patties are cooked from fresh All the burgers are cooked with love Super juicy and delicious that will make you forgettable If you live in Howick you must come

Pretty sad. Haven't been here for awhile. Average burgers and luke warm chips. Couldn't find my order... hahaha.... young guy behind the counter said it had been a long night, I was there at 6 pm, they open at 4:30. Not going back. And don't bother with an apology.

Placed order at 17:20 for 18:30 pickup.. at 18:30 was told 10 min... 19:00 asked for a refund... can't do refund, pls come back and we do EFT.. 19:10 finally got order......better alternatives in the area..don't waste your time..

We celebrated Valentine's Day here. The place was fully booked. The service was nice. The food was so delicious and served quickly. The wine price was reasonable, so there is no need to BYO. We enjoyed the night. They gave us a box of roses chocolate for completed our special night. Thanks for this sweet thing.

Amazing experience tonight which to give context to , I visited La Padella for the first time when they were still at Highland Park and I had an awful experience on that occasion and never went back. (Over 10 years ago) Fast forward to this evening and it was divine. Excellent service. Great food (I requested off menu & BOY did they deliver) and attentive service. Now I feel like I’ve been missing out all these years. Thank you La Padella for an amazing meal. I will be back repeatedly
Busy restaurant. Big menu selections. Service was good but flavor was ok. Will still go back though.
Excellent restaurant and friendly staff. I don't bother leaving reviews but their chicken dish, Pollo Capri is out of this world. A flavour explosion. I am very impressed!

Fantastic food, great atmosphere, with top notch exceptional service by the young lady hosting us. We went in as a group of 18 and the whole experience was faultless. Highly recommend for a quick, quiet, delicious meal or large group celebrations. Paul and his team were extremely welcoming. Definitely going back soon to try other dishes.
Great tasty food. Hong Kong Western Restaurant style. 香港茶餐廳口味. I like the taste very much. I have come for dinner several times.
pretty good hongkong food probably the second location i know where u can get near authenic hongkong food
Tasty
Hong Kong style comfort food at reasonable prices. Nice milk tea too.
Food are delicious. My favourites are the fish fillet rice stick soup and baked pork chop with tomato sauces. I always come here when I crave for HK style food.

Steamed pork buns and pan fried pork buns were all nice, quite enjoyed. but we ordered fried Shanghai noodles and small wonton soup, were very disappointed, cabbages were more than noodles and cabbage still tasted raw, the wonton soup have no favours at all. But the rest dishes were all good. By the way, the restaurant should clean the toilet more often!

Ordered the Suzhou braised meat noodles, Sichuan noodles with peppery sauce and Shanghai fried noodles. Good size portions and the flavours are really unique and delicious. Reasonably priced noodles. Went back the following night and ordered dishes to share. Booking is essential at night time and I suggest to go early at 5.30pm. Less people and less wait time
A brilliant experience. Quality food and very tasty
10/10 wonderful food. Make sure you try their chilli oil and soy sauce with every dish it takes it to the NEXT LEVEL. Love this place. Super affordable. Fast service. What more do you want.

this restaurant has legit Shanghainese home dishes. I've been there twice to taste hometown flavor. The air dried pork belly in the yanduxian soup was excellent, I lingered around the aftertaste after going back home. drinken fish fillet was very competitive to some restaurants in Shanghai. Standing out aroma of rice wine and tender fish fillets got a big attention. And drunken chicken was legit too. The braised pork belly I had last time was out of gate, this is actually a usual dish in most Chinese restaurant. However this place got the unique flavor of east China. Almost every Shanghainese signature dish I tried here can be scored 9-10 out of 10. Staff here were nice but usually crazy busy, so help yourself if you can.

Pretty descent food, quick too, arrived pretty late for dinner at 9.06pm and they still welcomed us for dine in. Served tea, and food came in 15 minutes. Cold chili oil chicken was really good and the noodles, man they were good!!! I think it’s hand made.
Served authentic Thai cuisine. Good ambience and friendly customer service. Serving portion is good for sharing as well.

Reasonably priced, staffs are busy always, toilet is old and not very clean, food is nice and can be quite spicy. But the space is too small, when you're sitting down , the people at the back table can easily squash into you. Very very tight space, when you try to get out, it's not so easy. Might be a bit of wait if you didn't make a reservation. But still worth a try.
very good food it has really good prawn with the coating of like i forgot but its really good
Great food we come here very often, good for regular intake for dinner, economical and cost friendly

This place is all about handmade noodles. Varieties to choose from the menu. Portions are generous, prices are reasonable, and service is quick. It’s a great spot if you’re craving something warm, filling, and a bit different. Definitely worth a visit for noodle lovers!
Very nice food. We tried Xianjin lamb fried noodles and Chicken with chilli. Good portion size and value for money.

The quality of the experience is all about ordering the right dishes. Ordering outside the westernised classics (sweet and sour chicken etc) is the way to go for fresher, lighter dishes with well balanced flavours and hand-made noodles & wontons …. we were unimpressed when we had delivery but dining in we ate really well (see difference in pix). The place is undoubtedly run-down and I doubt anything has been redecorated or renovated since the early 90’s, but it’s clean and the food is affordable, generous in portion and quite delicious (if a little over sauced & seasoned). It’s a comforting cheeky feed after a late night. It’s a relaxed atmosphere with a chill vibe. The chef really knows how to handle tofu, deliver wok hei & sumptuous noodles. Glad we came back to give it another crack.

Best sweet and sour chicken I have ever had. Just enough thick sauce, chicken lightly coated in a batter, generous bite size pieces, not overwhelmed with pineapple. I was pleasantly surprised. Lots of room in the container I thought could of filled it up for the price.

Hand Pulled and Cleaver Sliced soup noodles are highly recommended, especially the ones with a 👍 on the menu. Other options such as cold dishes, dumplings and skewers also. English and Chinese menu differs slightly with the Chinese having a few extra dishes. Great taste and good value for money

Unlike what others seem to be saying, we had no problems with the food and the service was extremely friendly. The only thing that got me a lil bit is that the whole place just seems a lil run down/ dirty. Definitely glad we still went and tried though the food is amazing

Very authentic Chinese northeastern food!! Crispy fried pork with sour and sweet sauce is a must-try! Chinese salad is also great with its special spicy and mustard sauce. The northeastern style soup of fragmented cabbage with pork is delicious as well! Will come to this place again ;)

Absolutely authentic northern Chinese food. Honestly there’s no better place in Auckland with Harbin food. It’s always busy, better to book first. Sometimes not easy as not everyone speaks English there , but 100% worth it . My favourite Chinese restaurant for sure
I will recommend if you are looking for a North china’s food.
No English menu. Pork tasted terrible, it was so smelly that I felt like I was standing right in front of a butcher
Overall the food was good but the seasoning was generally spicy so it is not really kid friendly. The small plates allow us to try different dishes, which was a good experience.

Great food. Unique stools to sit on at the table but comfy. Warm sake was delicious on a cold night. We've been several times and will definitely be returning. We booked as we were a group of 4 but we've just walked in as a group of 2 and easily got a place at the counter seating area.

I have been coming to Ken’s Yakitori for more than 25 years starting with the city establishment. The quality persists and the prices still reasonable . I visited the Botany branch which has more of a Family clientele and a quite different bib as is to be expected suburbs v city. Like the city it soon fills up. We had the mixed player of chicken thigh , chicken mince balls , prawn , and beef. Plus a plate of chicken livers and other plate of chicken thighs all marinated and cooked to order over charcoal. We accompanied the bbq items with gyoza fooled by a desert of green tea ice cream. Total bill $46 . We got a table straight away at 6pm but by 7pm the place was full with people waiting. So a reservation is recommended most nights.

Pretty legit 日本 yakitori 🔥 Taste the flames. The food is fresh and respectfully, delicately handled with a great deal of talent. The sauces are well balanced and the presentation is mouth watering. The decor and locale is a little basic. It’s an intimate, low key evening, but the quality is there. The staff are cool and the dishes roll out of the kitchen impeccably. The sake and beer menu could be wider but in general this is a hidden gem. Perfect for a date or a quick “hungry but not sure how hungry” small plate stop. Loved it and will be back.

I used to frequent this restaurant with my family for more than 10 years when I lived in the area. I recently came back to the area with my fiancee for a date, everything was just as I had remembered. The food tasted the same and the atmosphere is still great. I'm glad they have been able to survive the pandemic and hope they keep making the food I love.

This restaurant serves delightful traditional Shanghai-style cuisine with dishes priced between $25-$30. The portions are quite reasonable and the thoughtfully designed menu, which features enticing images, makes ordering a breeze. The taste can vary based on individual preferences, but overall, it’s a fantastic dining spot. It is an A-grade hygiene certificate and offer plenty of parking. I highly recommend giving it a try.

Would not recommend and would not return again. The person who took our order was rather uncooperative. After having ordered sweet sour pork, hot and sour egg plant in clay pot, lamb with ginger and onion on sizzling plate, beef with black pepper sauce on sizzling plate and asking if they can start with these and we'd order more later, the person ordering had said three times "we'll just order these first" and the guy taking the orders replied with "it's better if you order everything". A second member saw this and literally had to parrot we'll just order these first. We added steamed seasonal whole fish with ginger and hot and spicy tofu with pork mince after. The sweet sour pork was good as was the lamb, I'd recommend both dishes. The beef wasn't as tender as what we'd have in other restaurants on a sizzling plate. The tofu and egg plant dishes were bad, it's actually two of my favorite dishes and I didn't touch it after a first taste. The only thing the tofu had was spice, and the egg plant had no fragrance at all. (Direct translation of the Chinese is fragrant fish eggplant). The good thing was they offered free refill with the rice. The bad thing was the rice was too hard and was not fragrant rice. It was probably one of the worst plain white rice I've had in restaurants for a very long time. Usually you'd get very good white rice in restaurants, which will enhance the flavour of their dishes. This is not one of those. I took a bite and thought this is horrible, it's too hard and it is the worst rice I've had in years. Btw they don't offer free soup or dessert unlike many others in Meadowlands. Would not recommend this restaurant.

Authentic and tasty Shanhainese cuisine. They’re quite busy during weekends, so booking is recommended. Their soup dumpling (小籠包) and pan fried buns (生煎包) are really tasty - especially the soup dumplings, reminds me of Din Tai Fung. Most other dishes are OK, some of them such as the deep fried chicken in tofu sauce was a bit of a hit and miss.

This restaurant is always busy, so booking is essential or try your luck like we did at 5.30pm. We managed to get a table and the restaurant quickly filled up by 6pm. The owner recommended a few dishes and it didn't disappoint. The flavours are unique and authentic Shanghai cuisine

Nice place to taste transitional Shanghai food. The steamed pork bun （小笼包）is must try food. I really like its thin skin, and juicy pork mince filling. Spring roll is dressing with crunchy and crispy outer and filled with mixed veggies and pork.

We have been coming here for many years and we absolutely love this place. The black bean noodles, spicy seafood noodles and their dishes are all on point 👌👌 Not only their food is amazing, but they also provide excellent service. This is one of the best restaurants in Auckland.

The black bean noodles is authentic and taste very good. The owner told us they make the noodle fresh every day, which make the difference! The fried rice is well cooked. Not sticky, well seasoned! The owner is also a very nice and sweet Korean lady who host us well. She also greeted us on the way out!

Visited here at 7pm on a Saturday and we were left with only 3 dishes available out of their menu book. They were what we wanted anyway so couldn’t complain. Food was good and are big portions. Staff was welcoming and attentive.
I love this place. The black bean noodles, spicy seafood noodles and pork dish were all amazing.One of the best Korean style chineses restaurants in Auckland.
The best Jaengban Jjajangmyeon in Auckland👍🏻 level 2 Jjamppong is deliciously spicy too. Great service.

Ordered 2x butter chicken, and lamb briyani. There was a long black hair in the butter chicken 🤢🤮. Very hesitant to refund, and only a partial refund at that. Wouldn’t be surprised if the returned meal added to the pot and resold. Won’t be returning!

What the..? These guys have completely dropped the ball. Used to be decent but now everything is disgustingly sweet. Both curries tasted like they had 3+ tbsp of sugar, and even the raita was sweet! Look up raita online - the recipes do not contain any sugar, let alone enough to get even a hint of sweetness. Naan tasted very doughy. Authentic curry this is definitely not! Unfortunately they've gone the way of many other bad Indian places and added sugar to everything... Yuck! Not going back here again :(
Fantastic food, and great staff. All our dishes we will order again

This was hands down the worst Indian takeaway Ive had the misfortune to eat! The mixed platter was average apart from the kebab which was a shrivelled dry lump. The real issue was my chicken Madras. I ordered medium hot. My friend ordered mild butter chicken. The madras was so mild and lacking in flavour that I had to pour on salt and tamarind sauce to choke down the few mouthfuls that i managed before giving up. The butter chicken tasted like a sweetened tin of tomato soup, and yet had somehow more flavour than my hot curry?? I can not believe how many glowing reviews this place has! I will never be back.
Kindness is not something you can put a price on, the staff are friendly and they let you use their facilities even if you aren't paying The food both looks and smells amazing too!

Has become our regular pizza place for 2 years now - Service from the whole team is always top notch and never had any issues with any order. I had an issue with picking up my order when we first moved to the area and they went the extra mile to make sure I received it. Quality of their food is always high! Decent amount of toppings, never missed any extra sauce requests, no burnt crusts. The most friendly team as well

Our family have ordered from Pizza Hut Howick numerous times now and have been really pleased with the consistency of our order everytime. We don't live locally (25min away) and ordered by chance while passing through the area, but will continue to order from here because we feel the quality is worth the drive. Thank you Pizza Hut Howick, keep up the good work!

This has to be the worst fast food establishment in NZ. Avoid this place. Order from Highland Park if possible. And if its not, order an hour early. Every time I order from here they are always late. I waited nearly an hour for my pizzas. The staff kept telling me "just a few more minutes" for about 20 minutes. I got 2 Cokes that I didnt ask for as compensation.
Been a regular for the past 3 years, never had a messed up order or a bad order, never been disappointed. best pizza hutt team

There were 20 people on Friday night waiting for their pizza... unlike the local Domino's this place has no monitor that indicates the progress of your pizza and no one manning the counter to manage expectations. The pizza itself was good but the experience of getting it out the door was arduous.

From the moment I walked into Subway, I was thoroughly impressed. The atmosphere was delightfully serene—an unexpected oasis of calm, thanks to the absence of a crowd. It made the dining experience feel all the more personal and refined. The service was exemplary. The staff were courteous, efficient, and genuinely attentive, ensuring my order was crafted with precision and care. Their professionalism elevated what could have been an ordinary visit into something truly memorable. As for the food—absolutely divine. Every bite of my sandwich was a harmonious blend of freshness and flavor. The ingredients were vibrant and crisp, and the bread was perfectly baked. It was, without exaggeration, the best Subway meal I’ve ever had. An outstanding experience from start to finish. Highly recommended for anyone seeking quality food in a peaceful, welcoming setting.

I had a great experience thanks to the friendly girl KRUSHNA working behind the counter. She was polite, attentive, and made my subway just the way I like it. Her positive attitude and warm smile made the visit even better. It’s always nice to see someone who genuinely enjoys their job and takes care of customers with such professionalism. Keep up the great work!❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️

The Subway brand is great but the customer service in Howick is shocking. I've been in twice in the last week on my way to work and left both times empty handed. The first time the staff member said hello then proceeded to fill all of the bins. No acknowledgement, no offer of service -so I left. The second time I entered, the employee was walking to the back room. I waited a few minutes hoping she'd come back out. She didn't. So I called out several times. No acknowledgement. So I left. I usually don't leave reviews but it's a large company with a good reputation that's being let down by poor staffing choices.

Best Subway I’ve been to. Top notch service. Krushna & Jot is a 10 out of 5 in customer service. There are 2 more staff whose name I couldn’t remember that I also need to acknowledge who are stand outs in customer service. Sorry Supinder, I missed your name. You’re definitely a 10 out of 5 for customer service. You’re the 1st person I spoke to & have shown me a superb customer service. You’re always smiling & friendly to customers. Thank you!

Lady working there would not stop talking while our food was getting cold. I asked for 6 inch and then she proceeded to put meat on a foot long but I didn’t say anything as I didn’t want it to go to waste. Barely any topping choices, she barely toasted it and meat was a gross colour, stale and freezing cold. Price was absolutely appalling for the food we received. Hate this store, will not be going back and this lady should be confronted as I have seen multiple reviews complaining about a lady that seems to be the one we experienced. Disgusting food, DO NOT GO HERE.

I had an excellent experience at Domino's Pizza in Howick! The staff were friendly and efficient, making the ordering process smooth and quick. The pizza was delicious, with a perfect balance of toppings and a crispy crust. It was hot, fresh, and delivered in no time. I also loved the variety of options on the menu—something for everyone! Whether you're grabbing a quick bite or ordering for a family meal, I highly recommend this location for great service and tasty pizza. Will definitely be back for more!
It's a takeaway pizza place, what more can I say. Orders come out at the stated time, so no unnecessary waiting. Pizza tastes nice and sides are good too.

Last Friday this store was super busy when I arrived. This was not an issue as the staff and manager were awesome and the service was superb. I did not have to wait long for my seven pizzas. When I got home the general consensus was that the quality of both the pizzas and sides was outstanding. Well done team! I will definitely be back!

Ordered for delivery and wait for 40’, they call me to pickup myself because they don’t have any drivers today.$16 pepperoni with lots of pepperoni and look at the photo, chicken with still got feathers on.I been with Pizza hut for long time and today my kids want to try Domino’s,Frist time will also be the last time.

It supposed to be open and my pizza ready by 10:30pm. Instead, closed door and minus $xx from my account. Commerce commission loves to deal with stuff like that. Avoid this place by any means. Hey, if you are the owner, I do not need your silly excuses below my feedback.

This was our second visit and the quality of the food didn't disappoint. Had guests from the Philippines and Holland and they were quite happy with the food and friendly service. As I understand it, Ginger is a popular place among the locals in Howick. With their consistency in serving good food, hard to imagine them falling out of favor.
Great food, service and would definitely recommend the food matching. All meals were beautifully presented and everyone was impressed with the flavours. We'll be back!

This was my first time here and Food was so good. The wait time was really fast aswell. I had the lamb sagwala and lamb madras, it was so good. This place is nice and cosy and service was very good in my honest opinion. I will definitely be Coming back here again in the future. Thank you Gingers
We purchased the groupon deal to have a curry evening at the ginger indian cuisine.Absolutely the best curry in Auckland. Great service. We will be regulars 👍
Strongly recommend this place! Very understanding friendly staff, we paid only 29$ for dinner. Thank you really appreciate
Mocktails, especially the watermelon & apple sour, were so delicious!! The burger and fries were amazing too and in my opinion good value for money. Service was lovely and cleanliness was great too.

Went for a cheeky cocktail. Beautiful friendly staff who served you with a smile. Cocktails were delish. We have been here before for dinner and the food was just exquisite. Not the cheapest but definitely worth the money! Can be very noisey at peak times as the place is quite small. Will need to park down the road and walk there - not very far and mostly covered for your walk to the bar depending on where you park.

My husband and I were just going for a drive after having just landed in Auckland. We found The Corner and were quite happy. A good selection of beer on tap and good food. We ordered the fishermans basket, we were slightly surprised that it didn't come with chips, but it was still really tasty. If I was serving I may have mentioned this and asked if we wanted to order chips too, but hone3this is such a small niggle. The service was great, and a comfortable vibe.

In my very humble opinion this is one of the nicer places to enjoy a cocktail in Howick. There is their special cocktails menu but they will also make old favourites. Their black forest Expresso is my go to. The menu has something for everyone on it. We normally order a number of their sides and share because there is a lot of yummy stuff and we want a bit of everything. I highly rate their fries, perfect texture, served hot and crispy. They also have their blackboard special. Worth looking at these before the menu because they are normally pretty good. Overall a great place. I have been a number of times and will continue to go. If I was going to give it any criticism, they occasionally close early. We have been inside and they have turned people away at 9pm. I am not sure if the reasoning but it’s a bit weird to turn someone away that wants to spend money in your establishment.

Excellent customer services and cocktail experience. The bartender/waiter turned the heater on outside which was nice of him. Toilets needed a bit of a clean. Chef was not on site so could only order finger foods which was ok but would’ve loved a meal. This is not anyone’s fault. Apart from this, lovely place to have a few drinks n a nibble.

Great coffee & portion size for food. The chicken salad is very chicken heavy which would’ve been great if the chicken wasn’t so dry and sauce/dressing is a bit heavy. The croutons were amazing though. Eggs were cooked well, although one of my friend’s egg was a little more cooked than preferred. Service was okay, they don’t really acknowledge you when you come in, one of the waitresses wasn’t really helpful/attentive (tried to get her to provide extra cutlery when she delivered the coffee) but the other one was. Sitting outside along Picton Street is not the best (loud and dusty) when the bus stop is about 5 - 15m away.

Great place for breakfast. Prices were reasonable. They were out of mushroom but made up for it with bacon. The place was bustling at the time and food came reasonably quick considering how many people there were. The mural on the wall outside is pretty cool. The food was very well prepared and delicious. Presentation was on point. This place is worth a stop. I’ll be back.

Love coming to this cafe in Howick. Amazing omelette made by chef and the coffees are too good! Barista has great people skills & very friendly. Great service overall. Highly recommend this place if you’re in the area.
Good food, good vibe. Quite surprised with the chilli scramble and it was definitely delicious. Something different and I loved it. This cafe is a must try.

This is one of my favorite Local cafe in Howick, it is kids friendly, all the food are nicly designed and prepared. They use high quality ingredients, healthy any satisfying! Lucky me and my daughter won a gift bag yesterday, look at what we have got here, i can see and feel the people here are running the business with their heart! Big thanks! 👍👍👍👍

Ordered two standard size pizzas, a Bacon and a Chicken one. As well as a Lasagne between two adults and a child. The pizzas were really tasty and had ample amount of filling on a thin crust. The Lasagne was spot on and the sauce was delicious. Great atmosphere with music playing in the background. There were lots of people ordering takeaways, as well as dining in

Visited Minos on a Friday night and were lucky to get a table, as most were already occupied. Our server greeted us within minutes of being seated, and the manager on duty kindly recommended a few dishes — each of which exceeded our expectations. We started with the prawn cocktail; the dressing was light, refreshing, and perfectly balanced. For mains, we ordered a half-and-half pizza: one side Mexicana and the other marinara. While the Mexicana was my personal favorite, my partner devoured the seafood-packed marinara. We also tried the bacon and chicken fettuccine, which was an absolute 10/10, and the prawn linguine, which stood out for its bright, citrusy flavor and fresh ingredients.
