To end the night, we shared a passionfruit and peach cheesecake — a delicious, indulgent dessert and the perfect way to wrap up a fantastic meal. It was my first time at Minos, but certainly not the last. We’ll definitely be back!

Had a birthday lunch for 15 people last weekend for a birthday. Loved everything about it. The service was fabulous and everyone loved the food. We had pizza and pasta dishes and some desert. Lovely little restaurant. Will definitely be going again. I

Great little pizza place with atmosphere and really friendly and accommodating staff! The new owners have done a fantastic job and make incredible pizzas. Their gluten-free options are a bonus. The Greek salad is delicious, and the moussaka is creamy, rich, and packed with chunky mince and the best aubergine ever. Located in Howick, Minos has been serving East Auckland with top-quality Mediterranean, Greek, and Italian food for over 20 years and we are so lucky to have them in our neighbourhood. Authentic goodness and yummy food in a casual, comfortable space.
The food was amazing and what’s better than that was the excellent service from the team. The staff Maka was so good and helpful and for sure will be back soon

Can't go wrong here, great value for money since their small size isn't really small! :) Packed to the brim as you can see in photo, good balance or rice/noodles and topping (maybe the beef noodles could have had a bit more meat)

Had fish and chips ordered gurnard said they had it then when we got there had to have snapper dissapointing. We also ordered chinese from there as we usually do every couple of weeks. Food is superd fish was delicious

Best Chinese takeaways in East Auckland. My favourite is the Prawn fried rice, but other dishes like the chop sueys and steak ho fan are good also. The portions are big and value for money. Can be busy at times and best to phone order before and then pick up afterwards.

This is the best food I have ever eaten, every night I get three large dishes and devour all three in one sitting because it is so good I just can not stop Their Lemon Chicken is always cooked perfectly and tastes divine They always say 15 minutes pickup and it is always bang on time never disappoints 11/10 would recommend thank you much very
A great place for your Friday takeaways 👍👌very good family meals
Among the best sushi places I've been to. Wonderful owners, great relaxed atmosphere and delicious, affordable sushi. Love that it's kid friendly too ☺️
Wow! What a great change! Definitely been busy this long weekend Great new look and the sushi always greater :)

My favourite sushi place. The selection is great, the food is fresh, and the prices are downright reasonable, even lower than I would have expected in 2024. The service is excellent, and they are generous with the condiments.

I come here every time i can, i must say this is the best Sushi place i've ever tried, every piece is so fresh and yummy and best of all they always remember my appetite for ginger. The owner is super generous with their ginger. It just makes lunch so much more enjoyable, thank you!

Howick Sushi is the only sushi place I miss during these lockdowns. Their Seafood salad is my absolute favourite and the tuna triangles are amazing too. The kids and I always choose to go to Howick Sushi over all the other options for the best flavour and freshness.

We chose Good Home as the venue for my Dads birthday and we’re very pleased we did. They went the extra mile with decorating the table for us so it looked really great when we arrived. The staff were really friendly and the service could not be faulted. We had a large group and all the meals came out together. Due to the size of our group we had a smaller menu but there was still plenty of choice and the food was great. Well done Good Home Team!!

Was really disappointed tonight. Myself, my friend and his partner planned to come here for dinner on Wednesday night and were really looking forward to it. We get asked at the door if we are here for drinks or dinner and tell the waitstaff we are here for dinner. The lady then asked us for our ID’s? Something that I’ve never experienced before when coming to this restaurant for dinner, or any local dining restaurant for that matter, especially considering we weren’t going to be at the bar or had planned to drink at all. My friend and I handed over our ID’s, however since his partner held an overseas ID we were refused service and asked to leave. This seems like a ridiculous policy for what locals consider to be a family restaurant, not even being able to even come here for a meal without the need for ID? Even on a Wednesday?? It was my friends partner’s first time in NZ and a pretty poor first impression for him. We will not be returning here again.

One of the worst food experiences we’ve had in a long time. Wedges said came with bacon but looked and tasted like luncheon, dry hard cheese and cold. The Aricini balls were flavourless and had no sauce so very dry. Don’t bother wasting your money here. No love is put into the food at all! Waste of time and money. Would recommend getting a new chef and some better music!
Another lovely meal. We enjoy their menu and nicely presented meals. Had seafood risotto and it was tasty and generous. It’s a great local.

Such a great atmosphere here, it’s a great place to chill and relax with friends and the food was delicious. The staff here are very friendly and welcoming, I would recommend it to anyone who wants an evening out. Great value for money.

Visited the place for dinner yesterday after being recommended by a friend. We ordered the best sellers indicated on the menu. Started with the crunchy chicken bites, which was great. Unfortunately, the Malay fried rice was kinda disappointing in terms of novelty and flavor. The stir-fried noodles with seafood was a little bland but okay. The milk tea shake we ordered tasted a bit weak in terms of sweetness. On the other hand, the service there was great! The atmosphere was light and not crowded.

I used to visit this place frequently with friends about five years ago, and I remember their pad thai being exceptional. However, during my recent visit, the pad thai seemed to be missing something and left an unpleasant aftertaste. On a positive note, my husband enjoyed his meal, and you still make the best taro milkshakes!

Always a quick meal unless specified in the menu. The tea food make for happy children. Mapu Tofu and fried rice in the picture. Wheel chair friendly. Plenty of options. Love the menu/ordering via tablet.

Good place to grab a casual bite. Decor is vastly improved after the reno. Extensive menu with good tea options. The teas I found to be excellent. Definitely a must have. The food is OK. Inexpensive too. The service is quite bad I found. Staff have a very glum demeanour and very uncommunicative. Food came out quickly enough. Parking is a major hassle with a lot of restaurants nearby it can be a absolute mission.

Considering I have been here over the years, not once had I found any crawlies in my food. Tonight I ordered the cartilage fried chicken, half way digging into it, I had spotted a dead fried fly, this goes against health and food safety regulations, which I will be reporting. The staff were apologetic, and were understanding, however this is disgusting, I understand that you can’t prevent flies etc and things can happen, however there are food safety protocols that need to be followed. PLEASE START CLEANING YOUR EQUIPTMENT. Other than that the food is still a good late night snack, just won’t be for me anymore. I hope Momo tea improves from here on out and serves customers foods properly, at the end of the day we are still paying customers.

Eight local ladies went there for dinner. Most ladies were really disappointed with their meal. Despite discussing the heat of each dish with the waitress 6 out of 8 found the heat was way excessive. Dishes that were acceptable were the well known Butter Chicken. My Chicken Tikka Marsala which I often choose, at an Indian restaurant, and love was very short on meat. Sadly 8 local ladies now will not return. May I suggest that our waitress be more helpful and knowledgeable. Really big missed opportunity.

I have been always a fan of indian restaurant and i love all the spices it has to offer! Oh well, this is a first time to eat here since it was a venue for a friend's 1st birthday. It was a great place to be! Friendly staff, food was authentic and has all the checks on my list! Would be happy to come back. Their mango ice cream and goat curry was a hit!
Went for a dinner here - amazing food and a lovely service. The restaurant was quite spacious and plenty of room for a baby stroller! Would highly recommend the Paneer Tikka and the Indian lemonade.
Very good experience and food was very nice, definitely recommend to all. Mango lassi was amazing and fresh.

Very filling cuisine with a wide range of options to choose from. Well organized and welcoming staff with fast service. Great food presentation and a very clean environment.. M U S T try Bolliwood's Bhindi do payaza as well as their Bolliwood special!.. Bolliwood is definitely on my highly recommended list. 😊

A small cozy & family owned fish &, chip shop which has been around for more than 20 years. Friendly service We were recommended the fresh gurnard fish. We ordered three crumbed gurnard & one battered gurnard, two portions of chips and half dozen of fried onion rings The fish was fresh, firm & moist inside The chips were nice & were fluffy inside They have a fairly large menu too which include oysters, mussels, spring rolls, etc The fish & chips are far better than those chain fish & chips outlets
Food is yummy. Chips 🙌🏾 tasty & crispy. The lady is lovely too great sense of humor. Decent prices. Thank you botany seafood takeaways.

I couldn't really understand what the lady was talking about when I tried to placed an order over the phone. I ordered Special A. Fish tasted like pre-frozen. Crabsticks were just okay. Chips and sausages were alright. Potato fritters were good. The batter was crispy. Slightly oily. Fast service. Overall okay.
Been getting my takeaway fix from here for over 13 years still rated number 1. Never been a problem, hasband and wife team. They you.
GREAT ON ALL ASPECTS OF A GREAT TAKE AWAY! THEY LISTEN TO YOUR LITTLE ADDED REQUESTS EG. CRISPIER FISH BATTER! HIGHLY RECOMMENDED AND A FEW FRIENDS ARE ALSO HAPPY CUSTOMERS!
Authentic HK style food, relatively cheap price and good quality. $20 for their beef brisket is definitely a bargain. Milk tea is good too.

I bought the Beef briskets from Home taste and heated it up as the brilliant staffs taught me and mixed it with their steam rice roll. It was the best food I have had in a long long time. The steam rice roll was soft and just so good 😊. The briskets clear broth with some steam rice roll is the perfect combination. This is a must try 💯👍👍👍👍👍
Delicious cheap authentic Hong Kong Street food!!

Their Chung fin is very tasty although their trading hours are quite questionable. They don’t open later for dinner. When you come here to buy food past 5pm you will have to pray they still have the food you want
My favorite Hong Kong style food is here! The taste of food is amazing, a large variety of HK style food/ snacks, affordable price, staffs’ attitude is great as well! 真正家的味道！
Ordered spicy boiled beef w/rice noodle. Very big portion and pack of flavor. Lots of ingredients as well, there are eggs, fish ball, bean curd, bean sprouts in addition to beef. Highly recommended

For the price, no complaints about the food quality and generous portion. Staff very friendly too. 1 downside is that their menu is in Chinese and English translation is wrong, but if you can get past that, this is a great place

Good variety of vermicelli noodle soup options that are reasonably priced and enough for one. Very tasty and service is pretty fast. Other menu options are ok, but I come here for the noodles. The menus are only in Chinese and the restaurant is not big. Parking available right outside.
Portion was huge and taste was decent. Restaurant was a bit too warm, but everything else was great.

very nice southwestern Chinese rice noodles big portions at a good price, with rich toppings and seasonings. The owner is very attentive and friendly. Great customer service provided. Overall highly recommended.

Unexpected Gem – Comfort Food at Its Best! I stumbled upon Best Chef on a cold and rainy day, and I have to say—it was an absolute surprise in the best way possible. I wasn’t expecting much, but wow, this place totally won me over. The Chinese noodles were the first thing I tried, and they were epic! The flavor and texture instantly reminded me of the kind of comfort I usually only get from a really good bowl of Vietnamese pho. That’s a big compliment coming from someone who’s picky with noodle soups! What really stood out was how unique the broths were. The pumpkin broth was something I’ve never seen before—it was sweet, savory, and surprisingly light. It added such a creative twist to the dish without being overpowering. But the highlight of my meal had to be the chicken broth noodles. They were absolutely perfect: warm, flavorful, and deeply satisfying. It honestly felt like the kind of meal that just hits the spot when you need it most—especially in gloomy weather. The staff were friendly, and the food came out quickly, which is always appreciated when you’re hungry and cold. You can tell there’s a lot of heart put into the cooking here, and the presentation was clean and simple, letting the quality of the ingredients speak for themselves. If you’re after a hearty, affordable, and unique noodle dish that brings both comfort and flavor, I’d highly recommend giving Best Chef a try. I’ll definitely be coming back to explore more of the menu!

Good food good vibes. They let you have one-off aprons to use just in case you need them. They also provide hair ties for those who need them too. Good portion for the price you pay. My friend got the pumpkin based with two chillies and it was too spicy for her. So choose your spice level carefully. I had the one with tofu and it was very filling

So yummy! Best Asian South East Style Food. So tasty that I nearly bite my tongue off. My girl friend enjoyed their dessert most. Very well done dessert in such a good price. Highly recommend. Would definitely be your regular.

Yeah I love it! Rice noodles with soft Tofu is absolutely yummy! I can't help clean the entire bowl. 😂 Inexpensive, delicious, with all ingredients you can imagine to go with the rice noodles. It is just wonderful. I am a total stranger to East Auckland, but this place is so worth to come back. Highly recommended.👍

My sister found a delicious noodle place and took us to try it. I had high expectations because the restaurant was recommended by people around me, but it also lived up to my expectations. First of all, I was surprised big portion and I was surprised again that there were so many ingredients like soft tofu, meat, and vegetables in the noodles, and the spicy taste was similar like Korean-style jjamppong. It is not too greasy and tastes better than other Chinese-style noodles. The staff was friendly and the place was neat. we avoided lunch pick-time and grabbed a table so we could eat it without any problems. The owner gave us free dessert. I think it's because my sister comes often. We're not used to Chinese food, so we often hesitate to order something we can't eat it because of the scent and taste, and sometimes we can't eat it if we make a mistake, so we just try and eat what we know. This dessert was jelly-style and We really enjoyed it. Thank you for your good service. We will definitely visit again soon.

We've been wanting to go here ever since they started opening with their version 2.0 and we finally visited them last weekend. As expected, it's jam packed, we were lucky to find an empty spot since a couple just left. Once again, our expectations have been exceeded! Our travel from the West side to Howick was all worth it! The first food we tried was pork belly. It's so delicious and perfectly cooked! The meat is so tender and juicy! It came with corn and salad. Second is ISAW which is definitely one of the reasons why we went here! It definitely tastes delicious plus the sauce that came with is just perfect! The feeling is like you're really eating real streetfoods from the Philippines in a classy way! Both of our kids loved the tender juicy hotdog as well! Me and my wife both ordered crispy sisig topped on java rice separately and it came with a delicious sauce. The serving was so generous and the price is very reasonable too!Lumpia was so crispy and I remembered we were able to eat everything just for few minutes! We even heard the guys sitting on the other table "Sobrang panalo dito pare, mura at masarap pa!" We would like to try Takoyaki next time as was sold out when we went there. We will definitely be back here once again! BALTAO is definitely one of Philippines' finest! Congratulations again guys and we wish for your continuous success!

Found this filipino restaurant through Facebook which only opens every Saturday. Decided to have dinner with family to celebrate my daughter in law’s success. Arrived 6:15pm, ordered 3 pork bellies, 4 pork ribs, 2 kwek-kweks, 2 squid tentacles, 1 siomai, 2 cups of rice, and 3 Turons initially for 7 adults and 3 children below 10 years old. 20mins later we had our rice, kwek-kwek, squid tentacles , siomai, 2 sisig bao, pork ribs and belly. Thought that was all we ordered however advised we are still awaiting for 5 more pork belly/ribs hence ordered again 1 kwek-kwek, 2 fried chicken and 2 fish balls/mix. Bought soft drinks in can outside which we have all consumed. At 8:10pm our 2 pork ribs arrived at 8:15pm our 2 pork belly followed. At 8:20 we decided to cancel one more pork ribs as still cooking. Food is truly great but the purpose of having food is to feed. Almost 2 hours of waiting for us to have a proper meal is just insane and ridiculous. Am just wondering how they could kept us waiting when they knew we ordered our meal at once. Not coming back to this place ever nor recommend to friends.

The place is inside a karaoke bar so its a bit tricky to find if its your 1st time. However, i loved the ambience of a backyard bbq/street food market. Sitting is limited so make sure you come early, not sure if they do advance booking. Our food was served within 15-30 mins so average waiting time. Staff was accomodating, Ordered chicken karage-freshly cooked and crispy breading, isaw-a bit small for 3 dollars but yummy sauce and tender, pork belly and sisig (no picture) - taste and serving okay but its no fun a considerable portiong of burnt meat. Probably will come back and i know they will keep improving. + points, they do have live music some days i heard.

Three thumbs up! Being a (somewhat lol) connoisseur of international (if you know me, you will know my travel history) cuisine and yes, street food, I let my taste buds do the reviewing. Food wise, Baltao and Co has captured the essence of Filipino street food! Quick, easy, simple and friendly. (Want a soft drink (what you kiwis call fizzy drinks)-there’s the bar where you can drink to your hearts content). It heralds memories of my time in the Philippines where we would hang out at literally the kanto (steer corner) and pick at the bbq, fish balls, pork belly, etc for hours, talking the evening or night away. Yeah, I had to wait a bit, but that’s part of the charm of Baltao. The experience of what organized-chaos is. I’ve been back several times for the good ambiance and better food. If you’re looking for first class service, this isn’t the place for it. If you’re looking to experience Filipino street food culture, you’ve come to the right place.

The staff was overwhelmed with customers when we were there last week which took my order to arrive a long time. I hope they can upgrade their order processing to avoid long lines. BUT! Their food definitely made up for the long wait. We had the ribs, melts-in-your-mouth pork belly, skewers, and turon which are all 💯👌! It satisfied our street food cravings!

I finally got to eat at this place again after they moved! I used to go to their old location several times, so I was excited to try it at the new spot. I was so eager that I only remembered to take photos halfway through eating. To be honest, the taste isn’t as good as the old store, but it’s still within an acceptable range. The shrimp rice noodle rolls, crispy fried pieces, and congee were all decent. It’s nice to have them back!

A real value for money restaurant! It is located upstairs and shares the same entrance as the massage parlor. Parking spaces are marked. We tried the pan-fried dumplings, two types of Congee and two types of thin rice rolls. We picked the ones that were popular or recommended on the menu, as indicated by the thumps up. The food is not oily or salty
New location in Meadowlands, parking is no longer an issue. Same great taste!

The Eatery is located on the 2nd floor beside a massage place which is accessible via the stairs. Easy to miss the entrance as the massage place's graphics are much more prominent. Had the mushroom chicken rice which was light on the palate but not bland. Service was quick and friendly, and the dining area exudes a warm and cozy atmosphere to it. Would visit again.

We visited the place because highly recommend by friends, especally for Rice Roll and congee. Unfortunately, they are out of congee at the time we visit, So we have order the Rice Roll with Three Sauce, and couple bowls of nooidles. the Rice Rolls was taste so good. I sure I will come back for the rice roll and try the congee.

Everything was amazing, the staff was really friendly, boss seems like a really good guy. The decorations and atmosphere really brings you into Beijing. I loved the bbq with the veggie platter. Meat quality and flavour is spot on! Would recommend to everyone.

Very welcoming, staff member was very pleasant, we went for lunch, best choice that we choose, cucumber salad a must, taro and kumera balls absolutely delicious, had to fight for last ball lol, would we return absolutely.
Very different Chinese style bbq! Clean and tidy environment! Delicious food, especially love the cold small dishes! Never miss this good restaurant!

The best roast ever eaten in Auckland, every meat is so fresh. I love the butterfly meat recommended by the boss, grilled beef, grilled lamb, and the pocket cakes made by the shop themselves, which are delicious when eaten wrapped with meat.👍👍👍👍👍

The place is sooo inviting. It is clean and organize. The menu comes in a paper and you will tick the box of whatever you want. All that is written there is for you to bbq except the appetizers. All that we ordered tastes good maybe because of how they seasoned and marinated it. They used a special charcoal for their bbq plate maybe that is why the meat is being cooked perfectly. And the staff is wonderful and very helpful. We will definitely come back. We ordered spicy beef, beef short rib, spicy chicken, pork intestine, prawn, enoki mushroom, lettuce and rice.

This restaurant has become one of my go-to spots! The portions are always generous, and the prices are reasonable. I’ve been here several times with both family and friends, and each visit has been a satisfying feast. The Spicy Beef Brisket is a must-order for me every time — tender, rich, and packed with flavour. The food is consistently good, the service is friendly, and the atmosphere is casual and welcoming. Aside from individual meal options, they also serve large main dishes that are perfect for sharing, which makes it great for group dining. It can be pretty packed at times, so be prepared to wait a little during busy hours.
Loved this restaurant! Good value for money and very generous for the amount of servings. Staff are friendly. Been there twice only but already on my top list ... keep it up!

Edit: used to come here for dumplings but they don’t serve them in their evening menu. Moving to 3 stars as the menu is heavily reduced in the evening. Some of the best dumplings I've ever had! Juicy and well cooked on the inside, soft outside which isn't soggy, with a good crunch from being pan fried. The pancakes are very well made - not too thick and not too thin so they don't rip when filled with the meat and veg. Food is fresh and flavourful, with friendly service and a nice and clean setting. Definitely will be coming back again!
Number One! 😁 Double-cooked pork slices were great and crispy, beans were nice and very garlicky, and the hand roll tasted good and savoury.
Very nice food, service was fantastic, feel comfortable to dine in.

The taste is good. However, I should say the restaurant is not trustworthy. I've been there twice. It is because of a payment-in-advance promotion for the first time. The promotional price is lower than normality, but the staff said the food for promotion is out of stock permanently. I quite understood their situation after lockdown and accepted the cheaper replacement, although unfair and a bit like a scam. Then, I booked a takeaway after my first experience because I'd like to support the local business. However, after my husband picked up the meal, I found they charged him more than the published price. We contacted the manager, and he agreed to refund to our bank account. Up to now, several weeks passed but nothing happened. The manager didn't reply to us anymore, text or phone call, even if we reminded him several times. Although they provide yummy food, I won't be there in the future. I don't think they are honest, to be frank.
The skewers are all delicious, and the dumpling soup is large and delicious, with the fragrance of vegetables. It’s not very spicy, I recommend medium spicy, the squid is delicious

The bases I bought on Taobao were all better than those in the store, and the sauces were only soy sauce, vinegar and peanut butter. They also cost me two yuan a serving. The ingredients are expensive, stale and taste rancid, which really refreshed my understanding of hot pot.

Simple, but authentic tasting Hong Kong food. They have a large variety of opinions on the menu, such as fried noodles and rice dishes, as well as baked fried rice and toast. They also have Combos, including a drink on the whiteboard, but it is only written in Chinese. Great value.
Baked pork chop on rice with tomato sauce and baked chicken on fried rice with Portuguese sauce. Very tasty. Authentic Hong Kong food. Would recommend.

Most authentic HongKong style Cafe - 茶餐廳 in Auckland. Their hot milk tea tastes exactly like the ones you get in HongKong. I would also recommend the french toast - light and fluffy as you can see in the picture, other places often make it very flat and soggy. Agree with the other reviews, service can be unpleasant sometimes, in particular when they’re busy and hence I’ve given it a 4 star. Other than that, strongly recommend if you’d like to get a taste of authentic HongKong food.
Hong Kong style cafe, good authentic food, reasonably priced. Again, decor is nothing to write home about. Baked Portugese chicken rice was my favourite.
Lovely hong kong style food! Not easy to find now in auckland

This was our first visit here and we will definitely be back. The service was excellent and the food was good. We ordered a beef & rice dish which came with a broth type soup. Rice paper rolls with prawn & I think pork. The noodle soup had lots of combination meats - with great depth of flavour. The portion sizes were generous.

15th july 2025 we were recommend to try beef bone noodle soup last time we visited so we had to try and it was absolutely delicious I had the rare beef and beef ball and this also very good 8th july 2025 can't get enough of this place we tried pork bone noodle soup and this was top-tier and banh mi is so good bun is crispy and soft 17th june 2025 came back again sooo good this time i was able to get the banh mi absolutely best banh mi perfect in all way I got the same delux beef noodle but without tripe. owner is super friendly. 13th june 2025 I think I found my fav Vietnamese noodle shop in east this place is clean friendly staff and food is delicious and price is good and spring roll is so tasty this place get full pretty soon so be quick to get your seat diffinatly coming back here

Visited the place two years ago and was not impressed. Heard some good words lately and decided to re-try - it was delicious. Pho broth is well-balanced between bone, spices and herbs and very comforting. Ingredients are rich and fresh. Noodles are a bit soft in my taste but overall would give 8/10. Lemongrass pork up w/ vermicelli. Love the pork chop, crispy and perfectly seasoned. Solid 8/10 There are beef/pork bone pho which comes with a big meaty bone. Would love to try on next visit.

We didn't mind to drive 40km each way to dine there. There's a reason, nice food, friendly services, reasonable prices and a clean environment. The catch is the parking and queue; gotta be there early.

Beautiful Pho. It was nice to enjoy Pho, Spring rolls and my all time favourite Banh Tam Bi at this Vietnamese Restaurant in Howick Auckland. The Baguette 🥖 also packs some crunch and in general, this is a warm Pho shop with a home made touch. As I am leaning to healthier meals now, I would prefer more lettuce or some fresh bean sprouts to go with the Pho… aids in digestion 🤷‍♂️

Noodles with Soup, Dried Noodles, Cold Dishes and other unique Xi'An flavours like Lamb Soup and Cumin Lamb Chinese Burger. The portions are decent and the taste is ok. You may need to add some vinegar etc if you find the taste a little light. Order through the App after scanning the QR code
Delicious! This is one of the best chain meat stores. Their noodles are nice too. But I love the meats. Service: 4/5 Food Quality: 4/5 Food Quantity: 4/5 Presentation: 3/5 Price per person: $10-$20
Hand-pulled Noodle Soup & Dumplings...
We enjoyed delicious food and they had a large portions. Ordering is easy to use scanning code due to the covid.
First time buying here because our place was still closed...what a waste of money...food was disgusting...no taste...and almost no meat....just pasta...I DO JOT RECOMMEND this place

Can't ask for more! This is my favorite Korean restaurant in Auckland. They offer a wide variety of delicious and flavorful dishes with generous portions. The staff are lovely, but since it's likely the most popular Korean spot for many, it can get quite busy. Be prepared to wait or book in advance if you're planning to go for dinner.

The absolute GOAT to out-goat all goats for korean food. I literally can't stop myself from eating here pretty much every time I remember it exists. The side dishes are delicious, and the food is so flavorful and perfectly made. If you're seeing this review, this is your sign to stop by and try some of the spicy stir-fried pork with rice or the stir-fried bulgogi but ask for it to be made spicy as well. You're welcome! c;
They do have unlimited side dish and self-serve water / tea. Overall, it’s a nice place. The bulgogi is also good as it has more meat than vegetables.

Yearly update 3 years and counting-still consistent as the first day I ate it. Yum. No one does the bbq dishes better than this place. Best Korean I’ve had hands down in Auckland. Something about the sizzling BBQ sauce is different to most places where it’s just hefty gochujang. I feel likes it’s thicker, tastier almost more nutty and it never disappoints. Decent portions as well plus a decent variety of sides. Efficient service as well, only place I’m always keen on going multiple times!!! Last three pics are from previous visits -happy to say I see great consistency in the quality of food in all the visits I’ve had so far!
Love the amount of food with its price….super yummy! The unlimited refill of sides (literally😊) it’s not a big place but good enough for small group of friends to dine in🤤
If you like Thai street style food, Thai Licious serves a delicious variety.

Beautiful authentic Thai food made with a lot of love! Excellent service constantly on the floor helping, the food and drinks came out together within a matter of 8 minutes. Food was family friendly with adjustable spice levels. Such a lovely family run restaurant, I will definitely be back here soon.

if anyone wants to have a great lunch or dinner in a Thai restaurant in East Auckland this is the right place for this. Exceptional quality food, absolutely amazingly courteous service and generous portions. Highly recommend to anyone. This is our new favourite place.

This is our go-to Thai restaurant! We've tried several Thai spots around Auckland, but this one stands out for its excellent quality, reasonable prices, and outstanding customer service. We always recommend it to friends visiting Auckland and make sure to bring them here. We loved it so much that we even hosted my baby shower at their Somerville branch in April 2024. The staff were incredibly accommodating, and our guests couldn’t stop praising the food! Our favourite dishes: Pad thai, Yum Pork Belly, & Fish in the Garden 😉
Great and fast food - and the price was alright and the service was pretty fine as well

Came here for dinner on recommendation of a friend. The taste is really good, although there are not many varieties, but the taste of everything is not bad. Malatang taste is relatively good. It is recommended that you consider the spicy taste when ordering. Their chili is not spicy, but it can make the taste of the food more layered. recommend.

Warm and cute restaurant! The owner is really nice and friendly to all the customer. Food was tasty and reminds me the taste of my hometown. Decent size and reasonable price. Definitely recommend to give a try.💖😌
Friendly staff and the food is really delicious. Sauces are really traditional tasting. Will definitely be back again.
I just love the authentic flavour! Especially the squid sauce and chicken!!!
Yummy food. Very clean Premise Highly recommend
very tasty canton roast meats! generous portion and staff are always friendly and welcoming, even better price! Excellent soy chicken. Definitely would be back!

Tasty Hong Kong style barbecue. Recommended. Soy sauce chicken is tender and juicy. Delicious barbecued pork! Nicely seasoned, succulent and crunchy, totally different from other barbecue store. Price is very cheap - $12.99 for a meat dish on a bowl of rice, comes with a free drink as well for promotion period.

Roast duck and soy sauce chicken, super juicy and yum! We were originally going to order 3 individual meals (for 3 adults and toddler) but the owner suggested we get 1/2 a duck, 1/4 chicken, veges, rice, noodles and that will be more than enough and she was right, $55.50 and we were so full! Highchair available and food came pretty quickly. Will be back to try their BBQ pork and roast pork (had sold out). Try this place when you are in the Meadowlands area, great service and authentic HK roast meats.

BBQ Meats on Rice or Noodles. You can choose 1, 2 or 3 Kinds of Meat between Soy Chicken, Roast Duck, Roast Pork or BBQ Pork. The portions are great value and the portion of meats is big. Small Restaurant with only a few tables though. They currently have an opening special until 15th September giving you 12% off the bill

Definitely worth the price. Great quality food. Noodles were chewy, pork was great. Food not too salty. Portion is good enough for one. The lunch special comes with either a drink or dessert. Would definitely visit again coming to this area again.

Cold noodles, beef tribes in chilli sauce is highlight. Grill garlic, mushroom is juicy and tasty. Good value and atmosphere for a night chilling out with friends for beer and barbecue. Didn’t take photos of all food, $80 (w/o alcohol) feed 3 adults easily.
too good,deserves repeated visit am not a troll or boss invited guest,just a random visitor
Nice selection of dishes. We tried most of it and finished them all thanks to my best mate who helped me :)
Very delicious skews (beef, chicken, mushroom, eggs, pork) + fabulous fried rice
WENT HERE WITH THE BOYS, 7 OF US, BANGIN FOOD.... GOOD VIBES.... 30 BUCKS EACH WICKED.

Eden Noodles Howick is a great place for tasty and authentic Chinese food. Their Zhong dumplings are full of flavour, with a delicious sweet and spicy sauce. The braised pork noodles and beef noodles are also really good, with rich broths and tender meat. The staff are friendly and welcoming, making the whole experience even better. If you love noodles or just want a great meal, this is a place worth visiting!

I had an amazing experience here! This was my first time trying Chinese food, and I had no idea what to order, the store manager was incredibly helpful in guiding me through the menu. She recommended some fantastic dishes, and everything I tried was absolutely delicious. The food was flavorful, fresh, and exceeded my expectations. What truly stood out was the outstanding service—friendly, patient, and genuinely welcoming. I felt well taken care of, and that alone makes me want to come back again. Highly recommend this place to anyone looking for great Chinese noodles and top-notch service!

Delicious noodle dishes, served as generous portions with very prompt service and in a tidy, comfortable and well-lit restaurant. This is one of my favourite food spots! The Spicy Beef on noodles never disappoints; flavoursome and warming, and the various Sichuan dishes are authentic and tasty.

First time to Eden Noodle, can you believe it!? It didn't disappoint and it's no wonder why it's so popular. We had quite a few noddle, side dishes, dumplings and wonton and they were all quite nice. They are spicy though even if you ordered the mild version. The dry version of the dumplings are quite nice with a little sweet taste. Quite a few type of noodles to choose from and I think they are all freshly made.

Decent noodles and portions. We ordered one large kumara noodle, one medium dumpling and one medium wonton between 3 people and still had left overs. Food was good, but definitely better at the Dominion Rd branch.

An absolute delight dining in this tiny restaurant out in East Auckland. Upon arrival, we were greeted by a friendly voice. We ordered a clay pot of rice and cucumber pickles. Both were very yummy. The menu has many different dishes and desserts. The restaurant was full with patrons. We will certainly return for more dishes especially in this cold winter.

Best stone rice pots I’ve had. Authentic stone pots, yummy selection, generous portion, super tasty!! Efficient service, atmosphere I rated well cos it’s your typical ‘messy’ but hearty Asian congregation table layout for a feed. Always satisfied with the stone pots, special shout-out to salted fish and pork. Won’t be disappointed! Consistency in the dishes is always spot on as well, have been a few times now and still happy with the food each time. Best congee and rice dishes as well, love panda kitchen!!

My friends and I had plans for a delightful weekend dinner, but our experience at this restaurant was anything but enjoyable. Despite making a reservation for 7:00 PM, we arrived to find no table available for us. Despite inquiries, no one seemed interested in addressing our concerns. We were left waiting for nearly half an hour before finally being seated. While the appetizers arrived promptly, the overall quality of the food was just okay. Considering the service, I don’t think it’s a place to recommend.

First time trying here. I love claypot rice so definitely tried it here. We had the claypot chicken and mushroom, claypot salted fish with pork and also salted fish with eggplant on rice. My favourite was the claypot chicken and mushroom, the rice was nicely separated but good texture. The mushroom and chicken adds good flavour to the rice and also tasted good themselves. The claypot pork was not as good, the pork texture I feel was the wrong type of pork, probably would be better using pork belly, as well as the salted fish was too bony but I quite like the saltiness. The eggplant salted fish was not bad also, but I feel lacking sauce and for this dish the salted fish was not salty enough, therefore I am not sure if there are multiple batches of salted fish in this restaurant. Anyway I still quite enjoy my meal here and price is ok.

The food was super tasty and worth the price! The service was also excellent but was slightly lacking in atmosphere as the place is relatively tiny and tight, so I had to share a table with others. Nevertheless, I will be back again.

Prices here are very cheap for the big portion you get. They serve both Northern and Cantonesr style foods. Food comes out fast, except the claypot rice takes much longer which is expected. The sweet and sour pork was the highlight. The portion was large and the slices of meat were thin and very crispy! The sauce was lightly coated and wasn't overly sour or sweet. The lady at the counter was very friendly and had good service. Overall restaurant was very clean but the lighting felt a bit dark and was getting a bit stuffy. It's a great place for a quick meal with very reasonable prices.

Great value for money. Their menu is huge and has so many varieties to choose from. From rice to noodle dishes to have on your own, to dishes to share, appetisers to drinks, they have it all. The portions are big. All the dishes we ordered were tasty, except the dumplings and takoyaki, which were a little bland

One of the hidden gems in Auckland that serve really good Asian/Chinese food, as well as bubble tea and other drinks. We’ve been loyal customers since 2017 when it was still Magic Tea. The place is clean, they have friendly staff, and the owner of this restaurant is always lovely. Our favorites are their sweet and sour pork, yang chow rice, and wonton noodle soup. The food quality has not changed, freshly cooked and delish!

Got food through Uber Eats today and everything was incredible! Top notch food. We ordered the fried potato and chicken and it had a really good amount of spice in it. The fried pork tenderloin was crispy and flavorful. Then the seafood with fishcakes was also delicious. Highly recommend.
Best Guo bao Rou! Clay pot chicken rice was great, forgot to take a photo though. Well, the price is getting increased..!
We love bbq is using charcoal, it will let the food taste very good 😊. The boss is very nice and kind. Definitely will come back again.

Not the authenticity flavour of SiChuan hotpot, but I really enjoyed it. This is the hotpot for everyone, it may look red, hey don't worry, not spicy at all! All those ingredients are freshly prepared, they go along with the soup of the hotpot. Chinese BBQ is a highlight! I love everything we ordered, lamb, chicken, pork tripe.... yummy! Rarely to visit East Auckland, luckily I have some friends to show me where to eat.

I normally don’t like Chinese for my taste because of spice? But first time i enjoyed Chinese food wow! Never eating lamb but i tried lamb skewer and was really good maybe fresh young lamb.? And hotpot also great yummy. Making own sauce also yummy yum
full of favourite and very fresh meat . Great BBQ Place .friendly service . Highly recommend !
Very nice, authentic Chinese restaurant Food is excellent, very attentive staff Highly recommend restaurant!
This restaurant is very warm and delicious. I also like to take away the whole smoked chicken and sausage, as well as the cake. Highly recommended!

Came in for a Friday lunch and asked what their specialty was - the tomato beef noodle soup. Along with the noodles we ordered the Cold Pot Pork; the region specialty (think extra crispy sweet & sour pork). Food arrived pretty quickly and were all very tasty. The noodles were a big portion and plenty for two or someone who was very hungry. There was plenty of beef with deep fried soy beans which was a nice touch. Staff are super friendly and the space was nice and clean. Can’t wait to come back.

Very nice and unusual Chinese food in Auckland. Thoroughly enjoyed everything the family ordered and would go back to try other items on the menu in a heartbeat. If you are looking for something unusual and not the run of the mill Chinese food in Auckland, give this place a try.
Newly opened restaurant. Great service & cozy environment, food was commendable with reasonable prices. Recommend the noodles. However I hope they have an english menu
I got severe gastro after having their food. I had to go to emergency hospital that night.

I used to come here often, but after moving far away, I stopped visiting. Today, I passed by and was so happy to see the restaurant still here! The flavors are just as amazing as before—authentic and delicious. Definitely a place worth returning to again and again!

Absolutely love this place, been coming for years now, can't find the spice and fragrance anywhere else at this value. I've traveled overseas to Taiwan, Melbourne, Hong Kong, and not one place holds a candle to this. Always order the spicy beef noodle soup max spice and fuqifeipian with a bottle of water. I come here weekly pretty much to the point I'm such a regular I don't even need to voice my order anymore.
Generally awful except for the wontons.. we only sampled a half dozen dishes though. The place seems nice & clean.
authentic chinese food, although not much chongqing style. enviroment is super clean, reasonable price and great taste. recommend
Have gone to this place for many years. Offers great noodles and rice noodles, clean environment, good service

One of the best fried rice out east, juicy prawns and flying fish roe aplenty. The sweet and sour pork is different (good) to the traditional canton sweet and sour, it has strawberries! All the dishes are tasty and well presented. I would say it's not fusion like Daisy Chang but more so a different take on traditional Cantonese cuisine. Free Soup and Dessert a bonus.

The chicken dish, grandma / grandpa chicken is delicious, very tender, order in advance or they often run out. Highly recommend trying that one. Eggplant was also decent. The fried pork ribs was dry and tasteless, I would not recommend and would not order that dish again. There's a free soup as entree and free dessert as well which helps round out the meal nicely. When in season, the silk melon dish was also very good. The cheesy prawn fish with noodles is also a nice contrast. Would recommend.

Excellent taste. Turned away for oily Chinese dishes. Sweet sour fish has many fresh fruits like pineapple, grapes and tomatoes, which make the sourness complex and various. Good appearances and good balance of sweet and sourness. Dry fish and chicken fried rice is definitely top of its kind. Fried rice is not that easy I could taste shrimp oil, salted egg and dry fish which made the rice rich in flavour.

Trying this place out first time last week, Tony Kitchen impressed us with its delicious "home made style" food and good customer services. Haven't had tasty cantonese food for a long time! Really enjoyed their soup at the start and dessert.

Perfect food and very nice stuff. Have been here before , but just common, not as today! The curry dish is so yummy, spicy and creamy.L, served with big piece of briskets, I definitely recommend you to come! Beef soup noodle !ops, what I can say is its so big! Super big bowl. I am sure in here, two dishes can share with 3-4 persons. In addition, here is ver my clean❤️ A good choice to grab your lunch. Hope my recommendations can help you . Everybody enjoy

Loved the food, it's fresh, delicious and prices are reasonable. Tried the cumin and lamb with buns, sizzling black pepper beef, salted fish and eggplant casserole, hot and sour soup, salted egg yolk prawns all very delicious and the xiaolongbao very authentic Skin is thin and meat is juicy.
Superb, couldn’t expect better. This is the best restaurant EVER!!!! Everything was perfect like the food and staff.🫶🥖🥰
Hidden gem! Loved all foods I ordered. Fresh, tasty and good value. Will visit more often.
The place is full-packed and yet the service is still fast. Delicious food.

Its my local Shanghai restaurant go-to in Meadowlands. Food is pretty good and reasonably priced. Restaurant is average size and is often busy. So I tend to order takeaways via Wechat prior to picking up the order. I would definitely recommend the sweet and tangy pork strips, salted egg yolk prawns and spinach in broth. Some dishes are not in the standard menu, but are written in the whiteboard. Closed on Wednesdays!

A delightful place to have a good lunch. The place is clean, service is friendly and meals are just nice to our pallette. The special beef pho give you a mixture of all the beef pieces instead of a single or dual selection. I would have love if the noodle was thinner and smoother. The vermicelli was smooth and texture just nice. The sweet sour sauce was good. The wantons was firm and cooked just nicely with clear chicken broth. The good thing is I don't taste excessive use of msg in their soup base which could make or break a dish. The summer roll is much better than the deep fried spring roll. Overall was a great food, great place and great environment and will definitely return. Be prepare to wait for a table at peak times.

Fab stuff! Lovely staff, pretty standard menu with all the classic Vietnamese staples, generous portion for the cost and tasty! Will definitely leave you feeling well satisfied if not a bit stuffed to the brim!! Great substitute for try it out though - the latter does have more of a punchy flavour. Both the raw beef noodle soup and grilled beef vermicelli were more soft in their flavour. But for the cost and portion that definitely beats all other Vietnamese cuisines at this minute! Overall can’t go wrong!! Friend chicken was also v tasty, little bit bland but the cronch is good.

It was a simple menu and delicious Vietnamese food. We had rice with lemongrass pork chop and dry egg noodles 🍜 with lemongrass prok chop. It served quickly and in a good portion with a good deal. We like it and surely will be back and try another food from the menu.

We ordered the Cooked Beef Noodle Soup, Special Hue Spicy Beef Noodle Soup, which wasn't actually that spicy and Stewed Beef Brisket Noodle Soup, as well as deep fried spring rolls and deep fried chicken wings. It took a bit of time for the food to come out, but it was worth the wait. Good value for money and big portions. Clean tidy environment

We popped in here for a quick dinner. The restaurant is bright, clean & tidy. The staff are friendly & courteous and service was prompt. We ordered fried spring rolls and lemongrass chicken with vermicelli. All tasted fresh & delicious and good value for money. Each table had available a variety of condiments and there was a self-serve urn of Chinese tea. Looking forward to returning to try other menu items.

Windross House is truly a hidden gem. Nestled by the beach in Cockle Bay, it offers a perfect blend of exceptional food, intimate atmosphere, and great value for money. The historic charm of the building adds to the overall experience, making it ideal for date nights, family celebrations, or even just a quiet dinner away from the crowds. The food is consistently amazing—thoughtfully prepared, beautifully presented. It’s the kind of place you’ll want to keep coming back to—and recommend to friends who appreciate a special dining experience Highly recommended.

Exceptional Dining Experience! Delicious food, beautifully presented, and bursting with flavor. The service was flawless—attentive, knowledgeable, and genuinely welcoming. Windross House Restaurant is a must-visit for anyone seeking quality cuisine and top-tier hospitality. Highly recommended!

We had our wedding here and absolutely loved it! Thank you to Juliana, her husband and their team for everything, much appreciated. The food, the venue, the service is amazing. If you're looking for a place to enjoy a lovely meal by beach, or host an event check out Windross! Our family and friends loved it and we can't wait to come back. Thanks again 😊

What an absolutely beautiful venue!!! Our meal was amazing and totally delicious. The homemade lemonade is also a real treat. My husband and I were extremely impressed with the whole meal, and the view was just stunning. We will certainly be back again soon.

Wow. Seriously wow. Hats off to the owners of this fine establishment. The service is on point. The food is brilliant and so are the drinks. We went from entrees, to mains, to dessert to cocktails and a couple of bottles of wine. The evening was fabulous with great service and the food was fresh and tasted great. Go and try these guys out!! Went here again tonight. And cannot fault a single thing again! Great stuff. Will be back in the near future again.

The only reason I’d ever return is to use the golf facilities—everything else was incredibly disappointing. We paid $30 per person for breakfast, which was a joke. The buffet included only scrambled eggs, overcooked bacon, hash browns, a bowl of yoghurt, and some old fruit. There were two juice pitchers, both completely empty the entire time, and no one came to check on us or offer coffee. No water, no juice, no ice—just basic, poor-quality food and zero effort. Dinner was just as underwhelming. The skewers were okay and the bread with dip was decent, but the chicken main was inedible-under-seasoned, weird texture. The gnocchi was bland and mushy; we couldn’t eat more than a bite. Plated poorly The room was cold, outdated, and poorly maintained. Dirty bath, stained pillows, and we found both a cockroach and a huge spider inside. Only three pillows for two people, no table, and extremely uncomfortable beds. The walls are paper-thin—we listened to crying children through the night and were woken at 6am by noise from next door. No room service, no water or ice station, and when we asked for a plate or cutlery to enjoy our own food, we were told no. Housekeeping arrived at 5pm, while we were trying to get ready, and staff were rude and dismissive throughout our stay. While the golf course was in good condition, it’s run separately with no accommodation packages available. Overpriced, poorly run, and not worth the money. Avoid unless you’re only there to play golf.

We had a great stay & wished to extend unfortunately we have to come home for other plans. The room, bathroom area & all contents were great, spacious & clean as well. We would love to visit in the near future & allow enough time to explore the golf area & outdoor area more. Pleased with great thanks 🌺

Cleaning and maintenance: The room itself was nice but there were a couple of dead bugs on the bathroom floor upon arrival. And some of the lights didn’t work. Service: The breakfast buffet had a good variety. Great cocktails and lovely service from the bar. The views outside the main building were amazing. One recommendation to the front desk staff: please provide your guests with information regarding transportation if they do not have their own vehicle. I was new to the area and was not informed to book a taxi since uber is not always available or reliable from that location. Transportation: If you do not have a car, you may have to walk a while to the main building. That is dependant on what room you are staying in. I recommend Vish who provides taxi service and lives in the area. He saved me from missing my flight home. - Contact details are available at reception.

Very Disappointing Experience – Not Worth the Money Our experience at this place was honestly quite terrible, especially when it came to service and how we were treated as guests. We had booked a 9-hole golf session with a cart, and even had an email confirmation from the reservations team. But when we arrived, we were told we hadn’t booked anything. Even after replying to the email and showing proof, it felt like we weren’t being taken seriously. Throughout our stay, it seemed like we were being micromanaged—particularly as two brown women. The way the staff acted around us, especially with the golf cart situation, was very uncomfortable and borderline discriminatory. The villa itself was not up to standard. There were no basic utensils in the room—we had to use our hands. The fridge wasn’t cooling properly, and the door wouldn’t close unless we forced it shut. The whole place felt old and not maintained well. Breakfast was also a letdown. My partner went to ask a waitress about coffee mugs, and the staff member let out a loud, dramatic sigh before saying, “OMG I have to now get a coffee mug.” Totally unprofessional and unnecessary. At checkout, there was no one at reception. I had to go into a room marked “staff only” and find someone to check us out. Overall, the staff were rude and unhelpful. I had even called earlier in the week about the golf cart issue and was told I’d get a call back. It’s now Sunday, our stay is over, and no one ever followed up. We had to go up and down just to get a golf cart, which was ridiculous. Honestly, it felt like we paid just for the view and not for the actual service or quality we expected. The worst part was the attitude of the staff. They were arrogant, unhelpful, and refused to take responsibility for anything. Instead of trying to make things right, they just argued. Would not recommend. Definitely not worth the price.
Rooms need maintaining, Taps were noisy and the walls are thin we could hear the neighbours all night, overall would stay again if we were gonna play golf. The restaurant food was delicious.

Tee bookings on Mondays and Tuesdays are cheap as chips. Course conditions hella good nowadays and the views on a good day are beautiful. Burgers and beer after the round is absolutely amazing. Thanks to the friendly staff at the pro shop, super welcoming.

Rydges is a magical place. We were visiting from North Carolina joining a tour but looking for a 2-day golf get away before we met up with our group. The resort surpassed every expectation. Our villa was lovely, meals were perfect and the golf was spectacular. The staff and managers were more than friendly offering rides into town, rides to the marina and Lance even offered his card to us to call him if we needed anything. We were pleasantly surprised at the hospitality that we received from everyone including Zia and Bridget and others. We hope to come back again sometime soon.
Love staying here. You can see magnificent views & feel amazing resort atmosphere. The restaurant is ok as I reviewed a few years ago.

Mixed feelings about this course. The greens and the fairways are amazing and the layout and overall course grows on you. It’s also great they cut the rough quite a way in else it would be too hard. The main negative is around the vegetation removal and lack of native trees… especially on the front 9. All in all we enjoyed the round. Loved the greens.

Enjoy my time there. Great RnR retreat. Food was great. Hot as well. I saw the reviews that it wasn't a good food experience. So we decided the next 3 nights we will eat here. Our accommodation was deluxe twin villa with 15% off , $20 daily credit & $25 breakfast per head so came about $238 per night a $150 bond beforehand if no damages. Nicole was very helpful in getting the best deal I booked deluxe villa but needed a extra bed & she suggest twin deluxe villa with no extra charge. The staff on arrival was Fantastic keeping it contactless but also very Helpful, friendly Hosts. Our room phone didn't work so we used our phones for any room service. The 2x double beds are like 2x queen beds. Plenty of room. The villa #4 itself was awesome. Height and width of place was huge. Bathroom took 1 half of villa very modern & spacious. One lil thing was air con. Looks out of date. But it's still working why change it 👍 1st night on the menu which says level 3 menu. we ordered supreme chicken,cheese burger,lamb ribs,steak medium rare, banoffee pie, chocolate cake. Steak looks good medium rare & hot going to warm good enough to set then eat. Size was small but thick. Maybe 250g but good portion. Supreme chicken was authentic Asian. My partner said it took her back when she little. Must be a southern style dish. Cause she's from there. Lamb ribs (lamb flaps)was 👍 had raw veges & dipping sauce. Complimented each other. Ribs Well Marinated taste great that I ordered 2x the next day. Suggestion slow oven bake. So it falls off the bone. 2 desserts you can taste the individual flavors & the crust was crumbling. The cheese burger. The Pattie needed more time. Ate it anyway cause it tastes Great. There's breakfast & other items which I pic below they all well portioned & enjoyable to eat. Coffee was on point also. Partner had latte with splash of caramel shot. I had the regular latte. Hope this helps someone looking for a quick getaway around Auckland. Since boarders are close for travel.
The fish is fresh, and the batter is light and crispy (tempura batter), not oily. Good size portion. Chips were ok. Portion is value for money.
Highly recommend Sweet and sour pork and combination fried rice. Will definitely try something else on my next visit

Kowloon is my local and I am now on the hunt for a new local. I gave Kowloon their third and final chance as the previous 2 times were also poor. I was let down a third time. My piece of snapper was the consistency of mucus. As I picked it up the “fillet” fell onto the plate. Leaving a slimey goop of “fish” on the plate, and the entire batter crust in my hand. I then deemed it inedible as the slimey slop which was supposed to be fish stared back at me. Snapper is a treat and a high quality fish so having this bad experience was simply disappointing
Terrible food. A waste of money. So called Hawaiin burger is slop and all our other burgers had brown lettuce. Chips are soggy. Tiny curry roll. Very disappointing
Kowloon have upped their potato fritter game!! They also do the best fried rice. Kowloon Special Fried Rice is a must order!
Excellent! Real good Indian food. We had lamb Rogan Josh and the chicken tikka. Both hot. Excellent naan too. Best takeaways we had for along time. Will definitely be back!

Absolutely delicious restaurant quality Punjabi food made fresh to order. Quick and courteous service and fair prices. We will definitely be back to try more from this shop. Best takeaway food I’ve tried in West Auckland.

They charge extra for food and never provide what you've paod for. Always missing items. On top of that I once found a stone in their rice. When I told them they didn't even apologise. Please don't bother going to this takeaway place. They are definitely not worth your money.
I got the lunch combo which comes with a can drink. The food was very tasty and fresh. I really appreciate how affordable it is. The man who took my order was very fast. Thank you

So I went here today to get a kebab not realizing it had closed down, was disappointed but hungry so I grabbed a $11 lunch combo. Wow. I didn't feel like butter chicken at the time but it was really really good. Decent size, quality was on point and it was a great price. Ended up glad I had got this and not the kebab. Also everything tasted fresh and was piping hot. A+ Quality food.
This place used to be a childhood fave, just went back today after a long time and it was disappointing. The seafood I ordered weren’t fresh also very tiny and dry.

This place has changed ownership and the quality has gone downhill. The fish and chips are soggy and unappealing. We have returned a couple of times to gauge on whether improvements were going to happen (every shop has bad days right) but no consistently, overpriced and substandard food. Won’t be back again. Thank you
Fish tastes great, so succulent, staff friendly as well and fast service
RIP OFF!! - Absolutely day light robbery!! Smallest $10 chips (3 scoops @$3 + $1) in the history of fish n chips. Bloody rip!
This meal was disappointing the fish was flaky and fell apart the seafood was microwaved then deep fried disgusted with the food

It was immediately clear that this restaurant takes flavor to an entirely new level. Each dish showcased a unique blend of spices, creating a symphony of tastes that kept us eagerly anticipating the next course. The precision in balancing flavors was truly impressive—each bite felt carefully crafted and full of intention. The atmosphere was the epitome of comfort, elevating the dining experience to something truly special. Without a doubt, this was some of the finest Indian-inspired cuisine I’ve ever had. A memorable experience from start to finish.
An amazing local restaurant! Great service, super Friendly and helpful. Food was very tasty and servings were more than enough and well priced. Would highly recommend

Food was extremely average for the price. Welcoming and greeting could've been so much better. Staff members were more or less friendly but customer service needs some serious upgrade in my opinion. Wait time can definitely improve. Ambience and overall vibe can also improve. Overall I'd say a very average experience for the price.

Did a take away very average food- I think they have had a change of chef as they were good before as Goat curry pieces weren't cooked properly so hard to take meat of the bone, Kofta in Malai Kofta didn't seem fresh and were pretty hard seemed frozen ones been put in hot gravy. Spent $100 odd on food seemed waste not going back.

Authentic Indian flavors and warm hospitality! The food was delicious, with generous portions and excellent service. Cozy atmosphere and reasonable prices make it a great spot for a night out. Highly recommend!"

Had the most amazing home delivered meals last night. I was so impressed. All the mains were so tasty and the calamari, prawn and cauliflower starters were mouth watering. If you've not eaten here in a while I recommend giving them another try. I'll definitely be getting my home delivery from them again soon.

Chapati is a beloved local favourite we’ve enjoyed for years! Hermon and the front-of-house team always warmly welcome us, making each visit special. The dishes are consistently comforting, full of rich, authentic flavors, and best savored hot and fresh from the kitchen. The chefs clearly pour their passion and hard work into every curry, regularly surprising us with incredible specials. This place truly feels like home—without a doubt, one of the best Indian restaurants we’ve ever visited. Highly recommended!

Okay so its time to share the best kept secret in West Auckland. The secret is not just that this legendary long standing Indian restaurant does a $30 buffet on Saturday night, the secret is not that staff are super friendly and its a gorgeous environment the real secret is that they change the items in the buffet regularly! Yes no same old thing each time you can go every week and enjoy your tasty favorites plus try something new. Its fresh and delicious. Hubby highly recommends chicken pakora and the dahl. I know my steak man going for vegetarian option that is how good it is. I recommend the chicken malai. Its only Saturday night from 5:30pm, pay when you go in and make sure you book as its popular for a reason! And sshhh - its a secret remember......

We love chapati and go there everytime we want Indian food. We take visitors there. Usually they are pretty generous with servings but this time the Naan was small and thin and meal portions smaller. Not quite enough. Otherwise the taste excellent.

1/ Been a while since we’ve been here for dinner, but standards are still high, a very enjoyable inexpensive dinner for 2. 2/ Another enjoyable dinner for 2, as the steady stream of customers proved. A highly recommended West Auckland restaurant.

Amazing food, great service, nice atmosphere. I ordered the Japanese dinner box and glad that I did. My guest ordered the deluxe set menu (beef steak). The only downside is there's no online menu for dining in, only an online menu for takeaways; which is different to dining in. Great job Yaruki Japanese Restaurant - Henderson
Great place to eat, authentic Japanese feel, price/product ratio is amazing, definitely recommend

What an amazing gem with excellent service and amazing food. The food was authentic and fresh and very well prepared and presented. There is street parking and even thought the restaurant is compact it can cater for heaps. You don’t need to book and can just walk in. Take away is also available but Its nice to sit down and soak in the vibe.
One of my favourite Japanese spots! Great menu and everything I’ve tried so far has been delicious and filling.

Had a meal in Yaruki sometime ago. The restaurant was pleasant and seating was comfortable. Service was friendly and the food was tasty. There was a good selection in their menu. We will definitely be back to try other dishes available. If you love Japanese food you must try Yaruki. Recommended.

It has been years since we dined here. Fabulous evening. Excellent food and service, very popular place. The entree Calamari Alla Griglia and Rossi as pictured was so tender and beautiful cooked. Pork Marsala was delicous. The Pepperoni steak incredibile. No room for dessert but the Tiramisù looked devine. Will definitely be back.
Quaint little family run restaurant tucked away in Henderson main street. Food was flavoursome and staff super friendly. We really enjoyed it here.

I was here Friday 19 April with a group of 12 from West Wave. The food was fantastic. I had the best pizza in about 20 years! Also a great atmosphere and lovely staff. I forgot to take the photo of the ice-cream after I had eaten ⅔ of it already.

Such a neat place to experience first time tonight with a group of us getting together. Atmosphere was warm/can be too hot. However quite loud but hey you get that when a restaurant is packed with people lol. The service was good only issue here was had to wait for a while to pay for my meal as the lady was doing something like I thought took forever. The lasagna is definitely interesting as I've never had a lasagna with ham in it and it's sweet too and was shocked at how little mince there was in the actual dish. Overall 7 and a half outta 10. The Spaghetti Bolognese was the worst and disgusting! Complete waste of money! The lemon lime and bitters was overly sweet too much syrup! The tiramisu cake was horrible no coffee flavour it's very small for $15 rip off! Everything that I've tried has lacked flavour and definitely not authentic here. I would pay same prices elsewhere that is actually upto good standard of food.

Always usually been good. But ordered slow roasted pork belly with cherries. (Not jam) and had to ask for steak knife. Tough and chewy, no crackling in sight. Very measly vege...like could they spare? Not sure will revisit. Honestly..no crackling? Prices are high!!⁸ Seen yr reply. Yes..not standards of Onslow or Botswanna, but guess yr new owners in Henderson! So rude and cant handle negative review? You will go far. Wont be recommending!

Ordered Kumara Rosti bowl and paid $25 through uber eats to only get a bowl filled with carrot and negligible amount of all the other veggies or the Rosti, not a single sight of tomato (obviously they are expensive). Carrots are the cheapest so they just fill the entire bowl with it, there was no decent amount of other vegetables or pickles, entire bowl of carrot. Horrible experience, never going to order from PitaPit westcity. Zero quality, clearly sitting there to make money and provide a horrible experience. Paid $3 extra for avocado, was added less than one spoon.

Just bought the chicken falafel salad and it is so yummy. Truly delicious and full of all my favourite ingredients. The falafel in particular was absolutely devine . I will be back for sure. Lovely service from friendly staff. I’m sad to see that the previous owner is being a total jerk on Google but the rest of us can see what’s happening and won’t take it out on the new owner. Keep up the good work guys. A message to the new owners, I think you really need to work on getting your own Google account for this shop. The previous owners aggressive comments should not be able to continue. A message to the previous owner….really? Move on man, you really are embarrassing yourself.

I'm glad to see that Avi no longer owns the Pita Pit shop. He was the worst manager, and it's true that both he and his wife were always ready to fight. There was a complete lack of hygiene at the shop, and the vegetables were never fresh. Avi treated both the staff and customers terribly. He did not give pay to his staff, unjustly keeping their salaries from them. but we chose not to retaliate, leaving it up to karma. And indeed, karma did its work, resulting in the shop being closed for the past two years. You're commenting falsely on people's feedback to tarnish the new owner's reputation. Your are saying to everyone that need some love, I think you need some love from all of us😂 you are not worth of one star either🤬

The best place to eat healthy. I've had great time eating and chatting with the staff there, the boy who works there is my favourite. Love it keep up the great work Raj! I'm coming for another coffee soon 👍💪

The only thing I've ever bought from here is a Malaysian laksa a few days ago and it tasted pretty good for $16. The quantity served could've been better. Staff members are kind and welcoming. Service delivery is quick. Overall seemed to be a decent place for Asian takeaways etc.
Clean store friendly owner and staff. Great food highly recommended
Of all the noodle places around this one has to be the most consistent in terms of food taste. Thats why I go here.
Yes they have good food and the service is great.

Hi there, I’m so sorry but I really did not enjoy your food. The chicken was so processed or cooked I couldn’t even remember what sort of meat it was it was unrecognisable. I ended up just just eating the noodles and it was so sad because we spent $60+. Also the worst pork bun I’ve ever had. So soggy and tough. My husband tried it and was surprised and didn’t want it either so the dog ate it. :( the other 2 meals were fine. But nothing special. I’m so sorry we really tried to love this restaurant but probably won’t try it again for now.
Great food , very fresh , filling and tasty Served with a smile and great hosts . This is my type of place music is perfect, clean and had a good vibe. I recommend to all AAA++
Outstanding Banh Mi. Pork, chicken, delicious all round. Fresh, flavourful, as spicy as you like.The team are friendly and knowledgeable, easy going, make an effort to mix and match. A great Bun Mee
The staff are so lovely & really friendly. As for the food, top notch! Definitely recommend anything they serve. A fave, for sure!

Super fresh, tasty, quality Vietnamese/ Kiwi food. Healthy alternative for takeaways. Recommend any of the pork options as the salad and Bahn Mi are delicious. Had the steak tacos, which are light,spicy, and flavourful. The Vietnamese chicken nibbles are scrumptious and crunchy, with an amazingly zesty dipping sauce.

Exceptional Catering! 100% recommend hāngi, Bun mee rolls, grazing platter (anti pasto). Affordable, delicious food. Great communication and friendly staff. Prompt service too. Thank you so much Bun Mee Kiwi for making our event awesome.

Celebrating our lovely daughter’s 6th birthday—and her very first birthday party—at this restaurant was the best decision we could have made! From the beginning, Rachel, the owner, was incredibly helpful, patiently answering all our questions and guiding us through the party planning process. The staff was beyond kind, making sure everything ran smoothly. The delicious buffet for adults, the fantastic kids’ menu, and the amazing outdoor playground made this place truly special. Everything was just perfect for us! A huge thank you to the staff for warmly accommodating 20 excited kids! If anyone is looking for the perfect venue for a child’s birthday party, I highly recommend this place!

Great place for Breakfast, Brunch, Lunch. Loads of parking. Indoor and Outdoor eating areas. Really big playground for the kids. They have a bar station and wide open restaurant space. The food is tasty and the coffee is delicious. Team are fast and friendly. One of the better places to eat in West Auckland.

The food was smacking good! The eggs were perfect, the breakfast burger was juicy and oh the hot chocolate on a cold morning was amazing! 😍 Would recommend this place, the ambience is amazing as well! The staff are super friendly and welcoming! 🤩🤩🤩

Hine was a superstar she gave us amazing service this morning, fantastic energy for first thing in the morning. Kids had a blast on the playground. Our food was really yummy and great value, will definitely be back.

We went on a Sunday and they were pretty busy. There was only outdoor seating available when we first arrived but the manger offered us a table inside once one came free, which we really appreciated since it was quite windy. It was pretty noisy because I think there was a children's birthday party going on, but with the huge playground outdoors, the kids were kept occupied and it wasn't a problem at all. We all enjoyed the food. We got a burger, laksa, hotcakes, prawn spaghetti and the big breakfast. I can't fault them on anything as everything was well done and delicious. The food was on the more expensive side, but the portions were quite generous.

Nice warm welcome with smile Clean and tidy store Asked for veggie sub, loved to see them changing gloves and using clean knife to cut it Staff so nice and respectful Love the service and food Definitely need more of this kind of staff at all food outlets

Stopped in for brunch. Staff are lovely. We had the whole place to ourselves which was nice 😊 our sandwiches were yummy too. Hubby got buffalo chicken and I got the meatball sub. I also got the tropical smoothie, was nice. Thank you Subway 😊

I had stopped coming to this store because of very arrogant and racist chinese girl. Had bwen there twice before and the server did not even look at me while taking thw order. She made me smile by her customer service skills and by being a good listener. I now prefer that store as near to my house and ofcourse because of Guri. Thanks

When we walked in there was nobody else waiting but the young man serving was obviously doing an Uber Eats order, he didn’t say a word to us at all even at least to say do we mind waiting, so I thought this is very impolite and we left without ordering. This has been the 2nd time this has happened at this store.

I was very hungry this afternoon and saw the subway while I was driving so thought let me have subway for late lunch and one of the guy was working and he was very nice . I think I never have this delicious subway before . Salads were fresh too I loved it . Thank you

This is the first time I have ever left a negative review and the reason I am doing so is because Ive had a bad experience all 3 times I have visited this particular tank (and only this one) There was a young boy ordering before me on the touch screen, when it got to the payment method he wanted to pay cash so asked the young Indian lady if he could order and pay cash at the counter, However she said they didn’t have enough change to take cash payments so he left and didn’t get his juice.
