Pretty good place to get juices and smoothies. Got one of their protein smoothies and it tasted really good. I would also recommend one of the orange drinks(I forgot what it was called)Overall this place is pretty good though I have not tried the food here yet so I am unsure about how the food is here. Wait times are pretty good and most of the time you do not have to wait very long as pretty quickly you get your drink or food. However when I ordered it ended up taking longer than usual for some reason. Usually quite a few people ordering here.

Poor customer service and lack of product knowledge hygiene is extremely bad. Indian girl refused to make me double beet and orange 🍊 juice. Although after manager approval other girl made me wrong order. Poor Hygiene & Health and Safety issue. Touching the cup with their clothes. Putting an empty cup on top of dirty key board. High contamination risk.
Bought a mini drink from here. Customer service was fast and nice. Tank is inside the mall.

Thank you T for making my day and for sparkling brightly with your stars 🌟 on your face. You looked beautiful. I went to TANK Westcity to buy a Nutra Blast protein smoothie for my close high-school girlfriend, who is a hard-working mother and provider to her family, and a couple of Caribbean smoothies for me and my friend's 7-year-old daughter. T gave me a special Mother's Day offer that made our Smoothies not only taste delicious and healthy but also more affordable on my bank account. It was an unexpected and pleasant reward/discount for showing love, honour, respect, and kindness to the hard-working Mothers in Aotearoa, New Zealand who work tirelessly for their families, friends, and communities. You're a great representation of TANK Westcity Henderson, T and I appreciate you ❤️💜🫶 Thank you to TANK for the recognition and acknowledgement of the importance of motherhood. Keep up the great work 👏❤️🫶

Came here a couple of times. Service was very friendly. Food was tasty and serving was generous. Good selection. The prices were affordable. The inside was well lighted up and pleasantly decorated. Good family environment and spaces. Sitting was comfortable. If you are a fan of Indo Chinese, Fijian or Indian Cuisine this place is strongly recommended.
Friendly staff. Good food. Prices are reasonable 👍 ❤️ Very clean 👌 They also take orders for large events.

Unplanned visit for dinner. Our server was very helpful and friendly. Needs to do a bit more training in food, drinks available. We ordered platter and onions. Honey Chicken chilli, chilli chicken and prawn friend rice. The prawns fried rice was incredibly bland, prawns way overcooked. Dish wasn't finished. The chicken was beautiful and tender. Well presented and nice on the palette. We were the only people in there, table cleanliness could have been a bit better. But prices were ok. And the service was great. Solicited for not speaking up at the time, but we were on a tight schedule.
First time in their restaurant for dinner and food was just exactly as you expect. Nice ambience and great food.
Too good… best curry I’ve tasted around west and very cheap … the duck curry and lamb curry is out of this world

I was craving for Thali and this restaurant popped up on google. $18+ for 2 curry thali as per photo with veg and non veg. Great food for its price would come back again. Would appreciate if it was an Indian Sweet as per description, got given a vanilla ice cream for dessert and much better if it was an Indian Sweet like Gulab Jamun. Chana Masala needs more working

I recently had a quick lunch at Delhi Heart, and while the service was prompt, the food was a bit disappointing. We ordered Desi Chaat and Indo Chinese fried rice with soup. The chaat was lacking in flavor, especially the chat masala, and had an off-putting old taste. The fried rice was also a bit of a letdown, as it was brown in color, not the white color shown on the menu. Overall, the place was okay for a quick bite, but I wouldn't recommend it if you're looking for high-quality Indian food.

Rana sir was too nice. This place is a gem and the food is made fresh! Very flavorful and good on spice level as well. Kid friendly as well and the taste was yummy. Establishment is older but it makes it up with familial feel. The price was competitive & affordable with the service being fairly quick. HIGHLY RECOMMEND - for locals and tourists alike.

Have dined in and ordered online before. Both experiences we've recieved consistent delicious flavors and great quality of food. Today we dined in, the customer service and experience is always 5 star. The prices are very reasonable, our full order cost $54 for 2. We appreciate the hospitality from the team at Delhi Heart, Henderson.
Great food, awesome service and reasonable prices. Thali is one of our favourites.

Google searched steak and stumbled across this placed. Reading some good feedback and photos to accommodate our decision to check this place out. Meals were generous, good size portion, cooked perfectly. No complaints. Thank you to the chef woman who looked after us. Will be back on Wednesdays this time for steak night. Suggestion: to change the dressing on the salad. Tasted like really strong perfume which wad over powering the steak taste. Apart from that all good no other issues to report.

This place is cool clean and quiet just. just called to order and it was so fast though serving is fine good for 1 person in a $$. they have billiards. to enjoy bar area your choice if u want to eat, drink or have some fun.

Excellent 10/10. Awesome atmosphere and very friendly staff. The steak was cooked perfectly and the dish was superb. Sad I didnt take any photos of our meals however had such a great experience I deem it worthy of a review. Thanks to the team at Wood Brothers Henderson.

Came here for dinner and drinks on a Saturday. The place was pretty quiet, so the service was quite fast. Food was absolute delicious. The beef, bacon and cheese burger was hearty and full of flavour, quite filling! Basil pesto chicken was on the smaller side, but tasted amazing and was hot. There is a pool table which is a good activity to keep you there for a while.

Oh my gosh one of the best places to eat 😍! The staff were really friendly and the quality of the food was amazing! I ordered scotch fillet steak with a salad and my friend ordered the same but with fries. Both dishes came out perfect and both steaks were cooked perfectly. The dumplings we ordefed we fantastic and the garlic bread was tasty! We also ordered kumra fries which were to die for! Again lovely food and lovely service!

I recently decided to try out L and L Hawaiian BBQ. I was concerned with the many negative reviews but decided to try them out. I purchased a T bone steak (with garlic butter) and a banana split for dessert. I was only only one purchasing food the entire time that i was there. The establishment seems to be more a slot machine and gambling hub. The lady who served me was friendly and the food came out quite quickly. The steak meal comes with a salad (which was nice and fresh and I enjoyed) a fried egg and some fries. I actually enjoyed the meal. The steak while on the smaller side was tasty. So in closing the steak meal was nice. Would I return for another meal? Probably not it's just not the ambience that I was looking for.

I popped into L & L for a bit of lunch and a pint. I had the spaghetti bilognese priced at $9.90 at was not disappointed food was delicious and a good amount. Beer was only $7.50 for a pint and I washed it down with a 12 year old Glenfiddich. Staff were friendly and welcoming I would recommend this to my friends.
Food are not that great here tbh. All our beef steaks smells bad. They don't take credit cards here but they have an atm with very high charges. 😔

Food wasnt that great so wouldnt go here again, service was good though, dining area was so cold there werent any heating for those dining in, theres a pokies section for the gamblers and that seemed to have more bums on seats than the actual dining area.

No exaggeration, this was the WORST dining experience I’ve had in Auckland. I’m not sure if they have the leg to label themselves L&Ls, because that was far from the real thing. It almost seems like they’ve stolen the name and used it promote their mediocre pub food. The meats had an off taste and foul odour, and majority of the meat itself was fat. The sides tasted like it had been sitting for days and the rice came very minimal and room temperature. In total two meals came up to $60 and both guests could barely finish our meals willingly. I couldn’t tell what meat I was eating due to the off taste and the meat being over cooked. I saw that there were numerous negative reviews on this place and I gave them a chance, hoping that the experience override those opinions. Instead, I felt shame for whoever’s running this place. to serve food like that to paying customers, you would have no pride in your business besides maintaining the slots and live games tucked away in the corner of the restaurant. Service was decent but there is a lot of work to do in the kitchen.

This was my first time placing an order here. I got a won ton egg noodle soup, crispy fried squid, pork rolls, curry puffs, mango sticky rice dessert for delivery and the only thing missing was my drink they didn't send a replacement. Also I feel like my order was rushed The Won ton egg noodle soup is very bland there was no seasoning not even salt. The egg noodles are also thicker than the one displayed on the menu. The crispy fried squid was overcooked but it was still tasty I was pleased with the portion size of it Pork rolls were my favourite the flavour the crunch and paired with sweet chilli sauce is delicious I'll be ordering this again. Curry puffs are nice they taste just like a samosa but the pastry is a soft fluffy flakey crust. Mango sticky rice with coconut milk was very salty and sweet. It's a nice treat but was too salty in my opinion plus not enough coconut milk

We had bought the green Thai curry and as you can see by the picture it looks off and tastes off. The cream looks coagulated with water at the bottom. The curry puffs were tasty. The vege spring rolls were okay. The pad Thai was way too sticky and tasted like sugar. Hospitality was good.

I've been coming here for years. I love the stirfrys like sizzling duck and garlic and pepper chicken/ duck. The owner is a lovely guy and almost always there when I pick up my order. The food is made quickly and very tasty. The atmosphere is more like a cafe than a restaurant but it's nice with nice comfortable seating and big tables. Thank you for consistently making yummy food!

Called in and ordered the Tuk Tuk Pork Rolls and Pork Pad See Ew to takeaway. The food was produced within 15 minutes. The 4 piece Pork Rolls with sweet chili sauce were cooked well, delicious with crispy and chewy wrappers. The Pad See Ew was good, but a little too sweet for my taste and lacked the smoky 'wok hei' flavour that I look for in foods tossed in a hot wok. Portion sizes were adequate for the prices.

I ordered pad see ew and it was yummy, better than most stir-fried flat noodles in Chinese restaurant (yes, they are similar). The staff turned on the heater for me when he saw me grab a warm jacket from my car. It was sweet.

Consistently terrible service and consistently giving short change in the hope that the customer doesn't notice. In particular the female attendant. (Happened 3 times now) It’s the closest petrol station to my house but I will not go there again. Mobil and Waikato down the road have cheaper petrol prices most of time these days anyway. No idea why people queue up here on their "cheap" petrol days when the prices are better just down the road. Oh and the way they make you go in and pay first - unlike nearly every other petrol station in Auckland - is super annoying! Yes we get it. The very occasional person may steal gas - but that's what security cameras are for. You are creating extra hassle for your customers when they want to FILL their tank, and in the process losing them. I guarantee you lose more money by doing this than the very occasional theif, as customers go elsewhere. (like me)
I had a disappointing experience here. Not only are the prices unreasonably high compared to similar businesses, but they also sneak in a surcharge for using a credit card

It's a good little service station with a nice selection of food and beverages. They even have a self checkout area where you can scan and pay yourself. Saves waiting in a long queue. Plus it's just up the road from Henderson valley park.

On the run out west and had to stop in for a hotdog on a stick and a flat white. Such a wide range of warm food to choose from, the staff are really nice and everything stocked and presented well. James Ashwin Kakapo Business Sales

Big shout out to this Station and reminding me why I stopped coming here. Tried using the self Service pump and it won’t read my card and no pay wave option at the pump Went to use the other pump to fill my tank right up and then go into the store and pay but the pumps not working so I went into the store to ask can I fill my car up, I just get told pumps are on prepay, so I asked how do I fill my car up as the pump wouldn’t read my card and now I’m coming in here to ask to fill my car right up, I just get told again the pumps on prepay. All I want to do is fill my car up and they made it so difficult and not very helpful Should’ve gone to the new Waikato one just down the road
$18 for 5 fish & scoop chips - more like 2 scoop chips- fairest price across AKL region. Then tonight before Easter long wknd 2025.
Best in the West for a reason. Excellent customer service. Have been a long time customer of this family-run business. 100% would recommend their fried chicken nibbles and chips.
Yeah came up to food bar and then they said they were closed for no reason. Arrogant service guy just tried to push me out of shop.

The sweet n sour pork was very poor, too much flour or corn flour in it the meat smells old,and very dry bbq pork noodles was awful, the meat smells old and no seasoning at all, the chicken chow mein was just a mixture of over cooked veges with no seasoning, the chicken was so hard, taste old, they were just adding everything together with no flavour very disappointed, i spent $97.00, it was a waist, i will never go back there again and i won't recommend this place to anyone that is looking for a real tasty meal.

To be honest the chips are good but everything else deep fried isnt that great. Service is awesome but wouldn't order any chinese food and Ive been going here for many years and it hasn't really changed much. If your looking for a meal thats affordable then great but if your looking for a really tasty meal I would find somewhere else. Just my own honest opinion.

If you haven't tried this pizza place yet, you're missing out! Seriously, come give it a shot – you won't regret it. As someone who hates cooking on weekends, this place is a total lifesaver. The food comes out super fast, but it's absolutely delicious. Exactly what you want when you just wanna relax. A huge shoutout to Dev and his team, too! They were super friendly and efficient, making the whole experience smooth and enjoyable. You can tell they really care about their customers. Fast + tasty + great service? That's the winning combo for me. Will definitely be back – probably next weekend!

Ordered simple delivery meal 2 sides 2 pizzas, over 40 minutes late called branch to see if its on its way or cancelled. Extremely rude staff if i ever gave such poor service in my job i would immediately be called in by HR for improvement. Cannot give picture or rate the food as over 45 minutes now and nothing. but can safely predict the food will be cold at this time.
Pizzas were both undercooked and burnt. Chips were very oily, and undercooked. Need to use clean oil. Would not recommend.

Here's a tip, if you're going g to offer seating tables, CLEAN THEM UP. Dominoes make great pizzas where ever you go. But the tables here had weeks of crusty yuk. Takes a couple of minutes to wipe down a table or two

Had an issue with our order. Rung and the duty manager went above and beyond to fix the problem. Replaced our order and hand delivered it. Delicious. Thank you. Rare to find such exceptional customer service and great food. Highly recommend !

I’ve been here multiple times now, and every visit has been consistently great. The staff are absolutely amazing—genuinely no notes at all. They’re always friendly, quick, helpful, and understanding. On my most recent visit, one of the team was especially lovely and gave us two sauces when usually you’d only get one—such a small gesture, but it really stood out and added to the positive experience. The food here is delicious. No matter what I’ve ordered, it’s always been fresh, well-prepared, and really tasty. The chips, in particular, are always seasoned perfectly—crispy, golden, and full of flavour. One of the things I appreciate most is how fast the food comes out. Even during the busiest lunch rushes, I’ve never had to wait more than about 15 minutes. It’s clear the kitchen is efficient. Pricing is definitely something to note—it’s not that cheap. You’re looking at $20 or more for a proper meal, but I do think the quality and service make it worth it, especially given how reliable the whole experience is. All in all, it’s a place I’m happy to keep coming back to. Great food, excellent service, and a wonderful team.

If you want quality and quantity head to LJs. We got the mega kiwi feed for $32.90 as pictured big john burger was very tasty chips cooked exceptionally well to perfection. One recommendation I would have is to replace the hoki bites with prawns instead, as you already get a fish in the burger itself. This meal does not come with a drink which is fine I would pay this meal at this price again delicious thank you ❤️

Honestly one of the best fish and chips I’ve ever had in New Zealand you’ll won’t regret the prices are so affordable and their staff and service 10 out of 10 and most importantly they’re locally owned support small businesses support kiwis

Just place an order for takeaway, I ordered seafood platter for 1 person.. 1 scallop,1hookie nuggets,1 prawn,1squid rings,1 crabmeat and chips.. Not worth the price, scallops batter is raw and creamy inside,its uncooked and the mussles too,, Squid rings is raw, Im working in a restaurant too but we always make sure our food is cooked in right temperature in a right time, Im pregnant and im craving for seafood but I crave in a wrong place... I was so very disappointed..
Bought the Captains Pack - 8 pieces and chips. Fresh and delicious. However, chips are not enough. Can only eat it with 4 pieces of fish. Would be great to have more chips.

The manager who always works friday mornings is so friendly and good at what she does her customer service is outstanding. She makes sure her team gets orders out as fast as possible so people are not waiting long. And she actually talks to customers while given them their orders not just yelling their number and calling it a day. Well done.

good spot for a quick meal. The service is usually pretty fast, and the staff are friendly. The restaurant is clean, and you can tell it’s well-maintained. It does get busy during peak hours, but it’s still a reliable place when you’re craving fast food. Definitely one of the better McDonald's locations around!

Didn't expect to get better food and service in the toilet next door: Ordered approximately 8pm. Order staff were abrupt to the point of rudeness; rushing through the order despite the fact I was the only customer present. The burger was falling apart upon opening the box and was exceptionally greasy, and the fries were cold. The order had been taken wrong, but given the vibe of the serving staff member, keeping it seemed less of a hassle to try to fix it with him. I don't usually give negative reviews. This was an unpleasant experience. Cannot recommend.

Top notch customer service from Luma. Been to this Mcdonalds a few times and she never fails to have a smile on her face coupled with a positive attitude. She thanks customers for waiting patiently when orders take a while which shows she genuinely cares and she treats everyone respectfully.

Disinterested Sunday morning staff dragging their feet with little attention to detail is really off putting. No courteous smiles or acknowledgement from the young man. From the other reviews I’ve just read it appears as the Manager of this particular chain needs to pay more attention to customer service and better staff training.

Very disappointed with my order. The food was not fresh — burgers, nuggets, and fries were soggy and cold. I ordered a hot chocolate with full cream milk but received a completely different drink that had a strawberry-like topping and a strong syrupy smell. I had no idea what it was, and ended up dumping it. Also, no straw was provided for the Coke. Overall, a frustrating experience. I won’t be ordering from this store again.
The food was fresh and tasty. The staff were kind and fast. The place was clean and nice. My order was right, and everything was good.

Always a bad experience with fully serving fries or meals . This isn’t a first , it happened like a lot. Buy large and medium but get served for medium or small amount. This includes ice creams or flurry’s it’s pricy yet we would want proper amount in it for the price. For serious Angus it’s a gourmet burger yet the lettuce seems to have hard stems . Like it’s suppose to be good classic for expensive . Plus if this keeps happening why take our money first and then serve like poorly . We all work our backs off in this cost of living crisis to receive meals not properly . Like I understand busy times etc but Atleast serve meals for customers who pay properly who come during the day for dinner , lunch and breakfast. We expect to have meals after hard working days 😮‍💨

Went through the drive thru around 2am on Saturday morning 02/08/2025. There was a young Caucasian lady with burgundy hair at the first window and a young Asian (?) lady at the second window. I just have to say how impressed I was with the service especially at that timein the morning. I was greeted warmly, my order was taken in a cheerful tone and not rushed like so many places tend to do. I really appreciated that. I was given my food with a smile. The food itself was excellent and most importantly the fries were hot. Keep up the great work 💛

Went through the drive through and half the order was packed. Had to ask again for the drinks. The fries had human hairs so the grandkids couldn’t eat them. Tried calling and no one answers the phone. The first and last time going there.

Although the service is incredible and atmosphere is great too... I'm sorry to do it but the food is just not it. I grabbed some Paifala and it was thick & tasteless. Almost like a jelly instead of custard! Pork buns are barely filled and it's filled some other cut of pork. The Panipopo was bland & again super runny, not sure if any coconut is used!

I was a regular customer at this store for my lunch and the recent few times I have been there to buy fresh lamb buns so I go in early to get them and instead of giving me fresh ones they intentionally switch out the fresh lamb bun and gave me their overnight refried reheated buns that was hard. I Tolerated the bad customer service for good food and I can say I will never go back to this establishment again. A business that does not appreciate regular customers

Service & Atmosphere is okay, seemed stress when I arrived. I placed an order two days before to pick up at 8am and they were half an hour behind schedule. Customer almost walked out with my order while I was sitting there because of the lack of communication between customer and person at front shop. Bulk orders when you pick up its best to Byo polystyrene chilly bin or an aluminium tray for your food or else it’ll come in an old box 🤮 they will only put foil on the bottom of box and top to cover the food. Food: Panikeke & Keke puaa is nice but my only issue is that the panikeke is the size of a golf ball 🤦🏾‍♀️ imagine buying 200 panikekes that size 😂 I havent tried anything else from there. Not hating just hoping for better service and quality of food. I like that we can text our bulk orders through 👍 Faafetai Lava

Very rude lady never in my life I experienced the level of rude the food is below average atmosphere was dirty and the service just threw me way off soo soo rude ignorant .I hate these bad reviews but this one takes the cake will never be back do not recommend

Only thing missing from here is Faiai Elegi, their keke mamoe was yum, hot and fresh out of the oven. All sorts of samoan food available here from hot food/snacks & breakfast meals like koko alaisa (Coco rice) Something for everyone to eat.
It was an amazing experience for us. The play area was very good the kids loved. We did have a great time with our friends. The restaurant looks really cozy and relaxing.

The playground is the only reason I’m giving this place a 3 star. It’s a great space and the kids always have a good time. The restaurant is another story. Whoever they have working at the front counter needs to be immediately moved to the back of house. She is not very welcoming and always looks as though she does not want to be there. The food is average, a bit bland and not good value for money. The cocktails were decent, I’ll give them that.

I had a deeply disappointing and upsetting experience at this restaurant. Upon arrival, I was told that they were “too busy” to take my order and that I would have to wait 40 minutes before I could even place one. I politely offered to place my order in advance and wait the required time, but this reasonable request was firmly refused without explanation. What made the situation worse was the visible displeasure and unwelcoming attitude of the staff at the front desk, which could clearly be seen. I had driven 40 minutes specifically to dine at this restaurant, and the treatment I received was not only unprofessional but also left me with a strong sense of being discriminated against. This was one of the worst dining experiences I have ever had. I will not be returning, and neither will my family or friends. No one deserves to be treated this way.

I’ve only recently been able to finally check this place out, I heard the food is amazing, and I was not disappointed. Everything in there was halal but we ordered a bunch of vegetarian food. I highly recommend the vegetarian dumplings they were delicious! The kids (3 year old and under 1) had a blast in the playground. We were not able to try the theatre yet but we had an awesome time through and through. We just had to purchase tickets for the kids to be able to play on the playground, and we found out about that later 😅.
Great event to attend The restaurant looks amazing too Will try next time though

I like coming to this shop. It's conveniently located with other shops and has parking right out front. The staff are always friendly and work very hard to ensure there is always a fresh variety of veg and non veg sushi. Their prices are very reasonable. I like buying the half and half, or the daily choice. They have a new promotional wrap which is made from soy bean instead of seaweed. It compares in taste, but is a bit softer which compromise the structure of the sushi a bit, but it's actually quite good.
i bought this soup today all am I asking add some extra spring onions that’s after she give me . And I find out is non seaweed at all in the soup.

I haven't tried this place before and I love sushi so I thought I'd give it a try since my usual spot was closed. The place was nice and semi clean. Staff were nice as well. The food was a wee bit pricey but I thought the price must reflect the quality. Sadly, it did not. There was heaps of rice and a thin layer of chicken ($17 for rice). The sushi I got wasn't a great either. Weird combo and the soy sauce was overpowering. It really didn't hit well. Probably won't try it again.
Great food. Tidy clean and well presented place. Bit annoyed that only got 1 stamp on loyalty card when I should have been given 2. 1 per meal. Won't be back to this branch again
Good food great location and clean restaurant. Service can be improved.

I’m not sure where all the 1-star reviews are coming from because my experience here has been nothing but positive. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming—I love it! My partner and I arrived early one morning before opening time, and Paul was incredibly friendly, allowing us to wait inside and even taking our order early. The lady working there was also very kind and helpful. While English is clearly a second language for the staff, any communication barriers were handled patiently and with great friendliness, which I truly appreciated. As for the food, it’s clear it’s made with love. The sushi is fresh, well-prepared, and absolutely delicious. The customer service from both Paul and the lady made the experience even better. I will definitely continue to visit and highly recommend this place! ❤️
Lots of vegetarian options. Tried vegetarian Bento box. Very nice and delicious. Definitely visit here again.

Awesome place to get food, weather it’s getting late and you’re passing by or don’t have much on you. You wouldn’t really notice it from the street, but it’s definitely a place to pop into! Relaxing music, chill atmosphere and cool dude cooking & serving! Definitely gonna be coming back, 100% recommend checking it out.

Delicious food and a really really lovely man making food fresh for you. Couldn’t recommend more! Absolutely love the teriyaki salmon and kastu chicken bento box! Great hours! Great service and people! Great food! Great place all round 10/10 ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Always great service here from the family that runs this place, working tirelessly on the daily! And their food has that home made feel. I reckon the place needs more specials to attract customers and perhaps myself as I drive past here daily. Nevertheless you won't be disappointed with the food here.

Great food and staff, really love the quality of the muffins and the banana cakes are lovely. Staff always make sure to greet me with a smile and are very friendly. much better than the bakery next door and fair and reasonable prices

Really nice staff who were very welcoming, food was really nice too with one of the best bacon egg muffins I've ever had and the fish roll had a really nice texture; to top it all off everything was a good price too. I'll definitely be going again to buy more.

Quick snack has a good variety and good quality food. I entered the store and the lady greeting me was incredibly kind and had a welcoming smile. The food was displayed really nice and prices were easy to read. I bought a steak burger and a muffin, I have to say it was one of the best I’ve ever had and will definitely be returning.

Despite the fact that the cashier was very nice, I wouldn't eat here again if someone paid me to. The bacon and egg burger I bought tasted bland, stiff and as if it had been made a day or two before hand. I put it in the bin after a couple bites.

I showed up 5 minutes before they were closing, but their hospitality really got me. although they were packing up they made sure to serve me and not rush me, and how could I forget how delicious the bakery food is from them. A must try!!!!

First time visit to Re Burger. The service was slow but the gentleman serving was very friendly and helpful. I bought the Squad Goals share meal costing $109. It comes with 6 burgers, fries, Aioli and Tomato sauce, and 4 drinks. I will start with the only negative, the amount of fries was not enough to serve 4 people, they were however crispy and delicious. Now onto the burgers; There were two beef burger, two chicken and two spicy chicken burgers. The beef burgers have to be the best beef burger I have EVER tried, Si juicy with all the sauces and the beef was amazing. Let me compare this to a McDonalds Big Mac. Well actually there is no comparing them whatsoever! RE would score a 10 out of 10 for this burger. Now onto the chicken burgers, They were super crispy and just as amazing as the beef burger. These also score a 10 out of 10!. We are all super full after this meals and I totally recommend RE Burgers as the best I have ever tried and that is saying something!
It’s was the most delicious burger I had in a long time. It was soooo yummy, juicy and filling. :)
Food was so good! Fries were crispy, burgers were nice and sundae was very very good!! Staff were extremely friendly. Would definitely make the long trip to come especially to this place again.

My wife dragged me to Re Burger to try their vegetarian options, and I was pleasantly surprised by their Impossible burger. While I wouldn't call it a gourmet experience, it's definitely a decent meal. The Impossible meat patty has a reasonable texture that resembles a beef burger. It's not going to fool a dedicated carnivore, but it does the job. The seasoning is rather mild - could use more punch to give it character. Not bad, but not particularly memorable either. I appreciate that they offer several vegetarian choices beyond the standard garden burger most places throw on the menu as an afterthought. My wife has tried most of them and seems quite satisfied. For a casual burger joint, they've put in more effort than most for the non-meat crowd. The atmosphere is typical fast-casual - nothing special but functional. The music is too loud, which makes conversation difficult. We usually get takeaway instead of dining in, which works better for us anyway. The location is convenient, and finding parking is never an issue - always a plus in my book. The staff are consistently professional and friendly without being over the top. They get the job done efficiently, which I value. Re Burger isn't going to win any culinary awards, but it's a reliable option when you want a decent burger that happens to be vegetarian. My wife is more enthusiastic about it than I am, but I'm happy enough to go there when we need a quick meal that satisfies our vegetarian requirements. It's good for what it is - a casual burger place with better-than-average vegetarian options.

I had an amazing experience here at reburgers. The customer service was top notch, maintained eye contact, smiled and spoke with care. In all honesty I’ve never thought the loaded fries was going to be good but it ended up being outstanding and delicious. Tried the burgers and omg it was just amazing! This store has so much potential and I hope this store gets more and more customers!

Today the Maori lady that served us was good very helpful. Not her fault the food wasn’t up to standards she takes orders only. Ordered a Mega breakfast more like Mega Disappointment. The steak is not good quality thinly sliced asked for medium rear it was well done. Due to the tray it’s served in not very big my eggs are on top each other guarantee your bottom egg is broken. The sausage is absolutely disgusting not sure what animal! Long story short don’t not buy the steak meal waste of Money $24 If you want a decent breakfast meal I highly recommend go to Pecks Bakery Glen Eden Glenmall Pl. you get a real Plate with stainless fork knifes.

Popped in for dinner at the mall tonight and decided to go for kiwi grill went for the steak meal you have a side choice of chips and salad, rice and salad or double salad Opted for the chips & salad large meal for $21. Time wise I did not wait too long which was great meal arrived chips were nice and hot Reason for the 3 stars is the quantity of steak and chips in the meal I had more salad then anything. Steak was average would need to try the ribs next time. Also you get paper cutlery trying to cut a steak into pieces with this is like trying to cut metal with a scissors.
Don’t buy. The steak portion used to be good size now it’s the smaller than a slice of bread and thinner cardboard. Don’t wast your money.

Very unprofessional staff. I waited 15 minutes just to place an order. One person was on the phone, and the other wasn’t even paying attention. Poor customer service, won’t be coming back to Kiwi Grill.
Ordered a lettuce salad and just got lettuce ONLY. lol No dressing. Couldn't believe I paid 6 for just lettuce. wow Just wow.

I used to love getting butter chicken from this place. Now not too sure. My butter chicken tastes very salty strong. Rice is dry and so is the bread very dry and half of the bread was abit hard to eat.

Ordered some buttered chicken to go today and nicely said to the lady serving, that last time I brought from here I got so much sauce and only 4/5 pieces of chicken. She very rudely!!!! said and showed me the spoon - look one, two, three, four, five, six pieces of chicken!!!! I said didn't need to be so rude, I was talking about a recent purchase last week. She then slapped my order on the bench then ignored me. If I hadn't alreadly paid in advance, I will of told her I would take my hard earned money to a business with manners!

My wife and I are regular patrons of the West City food court and over the many years coming here have seen various owners and businesses come and go. I would hazard a guess that the ones which have gone is because they lack the understanding of the principle requirements for a successful business in hospitality, which are good food and good service. Clearly the new owners of Shamiana also lack this understanding. I expect hot food to be hot… not lukewarm. If I want lukewarm food, I’ll eat at MacDonalds. The staff in general don’t understand the concept of good service and have been frequently rude to me to the point where I won’t be coming back. They would do well to train their staff properly if they want to last.

We order samosa chat, front lady was so polite and explained well what goes inside chat when we asked , can’t believe samosa chat was so delicious, I have tried so many samosa chats in so many different restaurants and takeaways in past but never had taste like this, I believe other food is delicious as well, will come back soon to try other food as well. 😊
I just got the worst curry ever. The Butter chicken was so sweet it was inadable and the chicken was horribly dry. It went into the bin . Not at all how it used to be. Total waste of money.
Amazing coffee and great service. Very yummy food as well! Thank you for making my day.
Love this place! They provide heartfelt service, delicious coffee, and designs cute teddy bear hot chocolates :)
It was a happy time with fragrant coffee in a peaceful haven.
I liked the flat white Hot choclate was ok but i would comeback for flat white :)
Lovely coffee and great service
Amazing Katsu Don Buri! Haven’t found someone make it better than these guys. Hidden treasure for sure!
Pretty good sushi spot with nice staff. Got a lunch deal for 17.50$ which was reasonable for the portion given. Also, they have discounted options closer to closing times in the late arvo.
Their Donburis are probably the best I've had and their sushi are always fresh!
Fresh ingredients, great taste, reasonable prices, great staff. Highly recommended!

I occasionally stop here and pick up sushi 🍣 when I feel like a good sushi for lunch or dinner . I usually buy a combo which is about $14.00 you can purchase elsewhere depending on which other place you may go to..slightly cheaper for same amount or extra pieces of sushi.

Tried the Double Overload Lomi Pork at Papa Ben’s and it was amazing! The bowl was packed with all the good stuff.crispy chicharon, tasty meatballs, eggs, pork liver, and thick noodles in a super flavorful broth. It was super filling and delicious. The place has a chill and cozy vibe, perfect for hanging out. The staff were really friendly and gave great service. You can tell they care about their food and their customers. Definitely coming back soon!

Its located beside the Westcity cinema. we love the overload Batangas lomi, my son like the chicken-spag. If you miss and wants to find another Filipino food restaurant, this where you need to go in West Auckland. Spacious place, not too crowded, big servings, they have condiments. Clean restaurant, child friendly place.

It has got to be the worst customer service ever! Imagine getting in the store to start your order and be greeted by a very impolite, impatient, very unfriendly lady in the front counter. We travelled all the way from South Auckland to West City Mall to try their Batangas Lomi and other foods. We were initially standing there at the counter looking at the menu, when the lady stood in front of us looked unwelcoming and did not even bother greeting us at all. Ignored it at that instance, my husband shyly but politely asked about the differences between their lomi options. The lady looked irritated and had to get my husband to repeat it back to her as if he just asked a very stupid question. We told her we can’t have the squid and if there’s an alternative, she said none. We opted to get the overload one instead, she seemed irritated and responded in a rude way “regardless of what size, you can’t have any other toppings”. Wow! Our first time here, would probably be the last. Would not recommend it to friends as well. Overall, disappointed and unhappy with our experience. ——- As per their response to above’s comments, wow! The lomi that we keep coming back. Savoury and good match with their nice pork crackling. Even we're far to the place. Hope they'll ooen close to central soon 😂. Thanks for satisfying our lomi cravings. 😋

Probably the most authentic Loming Batangas that you can find in Auckland. Also tried their Beef Pares and it was also good. Their staff/crew are all friendly and accommodating. Will definitely come back to try the other dishes in their menu.
Love their smoothies n shakes. We got mango banana smoothie n thick banana shake from here.
Fast, clean and super fresh. Thank you. 😊
Visited today. Staff were very friendly and welcoming. Since I am vegetarian, helped me pick the right option and customised it a bit. Definitely will go again.
And educated staff members
Ordered for pickup. Perfectly toasted and wrapped. One of the best I've had from the franchise

The quality of the burgers here is genuinely impressive and definitely a highlight. However, the experience was let down by a significant issue with the redemption process for promotional offers. As an AA member, I planned to use the "buy a burger, get drinks and fries free" deal. Seeing the staff were very busy, I used the self-service kiosk for efficiency. It was only after completing the order that I learned the offer is exclusively redeemable at the main till and is not supported by the kiosk. This "till-only" limitation wasn't clearly communicated at any point during the kiosk ordering process, which was quite frustrating. While I can't fault the food, I strongly recommend that management either integrates all offers into the kiosk system or makes the redemption requirements much clearer to prevent customer disappointment.

I'm not one to write bad reviews, but this place really sucked. It was empty and I can see why. I ordered an OG burger combo and added pineapple and bacon along with purchasing some dipping sauce for my chips. After 14 minutes (remember... Empty) my buzzer went off and the Indian lady at the counter said "here" and pushed the tray towards me. The $1 sauce was merely a squirt into a small container that didn't even last for the chips I had. The burger had tinned pineapple and one strip of bacon added. Flavorless and not worth the extra price. The coke... Was room temperature, like legit you can not make this stuff up. I'd never be back and felt like I was sitting in a closing down business... Probably not wrong.
Bought 2 o.g double smashed cheeseburgers. Both had plenty of ingredients and sauces. Tasty and filled my belly

The order was very slow and the waitress did not know how to enter the Lunch special and tried to charge me too much. The fries were under cooked and not hot, I chose the KISS Chicken burger, It was tender and very tasty. I would rate it 3.5* if it was available

Very disappointed in our dinner last night from here ordered on ubereats and it took over and hour and half to get to us. Order wasnt ready for the uber driver on time. And then when it finally was ready it was cold by the time it got to us. Not very pleasant eating cold burgers. Would've been very nice burgers if hot.

I had a really disappointing experience at this cafe. I asked if I could pick which almond croissant I wanted from the display, and the staff member responded, "This isn’t a pick and choose situation," in the most dismissive tone—then just walked away. Seriously? It’s a bakery item, not a lottery. I wasn’t asking for anything unreasonable, just to choose the one I preferred (as people often do at bakeries). The rude attitude completely ruined the visit. If customer service isn’t a priority here, there are plenty of other places with good pastries and basic respect. Won’t be coming back.

The food was served warm and fresh. Meals ordered was scrambled egg with toast and Omelette w tomatoes, mushroom and onion. My partner said the omelette was amazing. The scrambled egg was moist and tasty. Coffees were cappuccino and flat white , both coffees were very well made. A few things that could been a little better is adding another slice of toast to the omelette one was not enough for my partner. The toasts are considerably small. The flat white was a little tepid, however it didn't take away from the experience and flavour of the meals and drinks.

Terrible service. And just as Terrible food. I also noticed a lady next to us with a young child having breakfast, by the looks the husband came to meet them with some Sushi. The owner came out and was very aggressive, and kicked them all out. I felt pretty bad due to the lady and kid didn't even start their breakfast. Do better! I personally will never go back!!

I had some shoe shopping to do, finished that and noticed it was lunch time. Thought I would treat myself and noticed I was parked close to “GLORIA JEANS” so having never frequented this area before, thought nice and clean, nice ambiance! I will treat myself. Well service was excellent a young woman took my order for a Ham, cheese and tomato toasted Croissant and a chilled Diet Coke. Took coke and number to a nice quiet table and quite quickly my super delicious croissant was bought out! I was very impressed with attractive and efficient waitress. I would recommend “Gloria Jeans” to anyone wanting a nice relaxed lunch with wonderful management and wait staff! Arthur C, CHARLTON West Auckland .

Visited the Gloria Jean's Café at Vitasovich Avenue, but unfortunately had a disappointing experience. One male staff member (Asian appearance, wearing glasses) was very dismissive and showed a rude attitude when we asked for help. He was also seen treating other staff poorly, which created an uncomfortable atmosphere. It’s unfortunate because the rest of the team seemed kind and professional. I hope the management takes note, as this kind of behaviour can seriously affect customer experience and the reputation of the café.

Have ordered selection of menu items via UberEats and each time they’ve arrived fresh and tasty, and reasonably priced. And a lovely staff member on the phone that helped with some menu queries. Thanks!

Tiger Sushi has quickly become one of my go-to lunch spots. The staff are friendly and welcoming, and very quick to serve you. There's a great range of pre-made sushi options available in the cabinet, as well as made to order food. Everything is fresh with good flavour.
I'm happy with the dish and reasonable price. Also, their sushi looks 🍣 nice.
Absolutely delicious, very friendly staff, really well priced for the amazing food.
Delicious food, great pricing, can’t recommend it enough!
Food is okay. Nothing amazing, but it’s a food court buffet, so pretty much what you’d expect. Would be nice if the food was kept hotter.

Simply disgusting reheated super old and oily food. I hope they get closed off as they are literally playing up with people’s health. The buffet looks appealing but it’s a trap as non of the dishes are fresh and tasty. The lady at the counter just want you to pay and keep staring at people getting food to make sure they should not take enough. DO NOT ORDER FOOD and go somewhere else!

Buffet looked great, but that's as far as it goes, no people skills from service staff member at all. Meat was all tough across the range of dishes and the soup was absolutely tasteless. Do not recommend this place at all.
Staff is friendly and helpful. Food is okay, a bit salty. $14.9 for small plate.

I would give zero star if I could, 1 star is far too generous! The buffet looks appealing from afar but don’t get fooled, the food is absolutely disgusting. Soaked in oil, no flavour, ate 3 bites and started to feel sick. Makes you wonder how hygienic is their kitchen. I spent all day feeling sick, I wish I had checked the reviews before going there, shocking that they’re still opened with this many disappointed customers.

Absolutely disgusting customer service. Only one worker who disappeared for 10mins with no sign! Worker decided to argue with the customer who was waiting. Lost so many customers because the store was left unattended, mall staff were also looking for the workers. Did not seem to care that the customers were not happy, just went back to looking at his phone.
Kebab meat was shaven incredibly thick, chewy and relatively bland. Sauces were flavourless. Chips were REVOLTING - change the oil in your vat! Definitely won’t be back.

The best chicken on chips I ever had! The quality was great. Chicken was fresh and crispy chips. They served me pretty quick although they were super busy. Great customer service as well. I recommend trying this place out!! 😊

I feel bad for the old man working alone but at the same time he shouldn’t be touching the kebab wrap with no gloves when serving. Also always charges me 10c more than what it should. 10c is nothing but I always buy kebab here and those 10c end up piling.
Got a M chicken salad, container was barely half full and bits of burnt chicken. Other dishes we got didn't have generous portions at all

I have been here a few times now, and had the Double cheeseburger, the Yeehaw, and now the Aucklahoma. This place knows how to make great burgers, they are a good quality tasting meat, and smashed with a perfect lace crispy edge. on top of this, they are one of the rare places that does crinkle cut fries, I am a big fan of these, so it was great to see some. Definately worth a visit and one of the better burger places out there,

Had this on my to go list for ages and finally went. Let's just say it exceeded my expectations. The environment there is amazing. Feels like you're ordering from a punk venue. Lots of unique decorations and food does not disappoint. The Buffalo sando was juicy with soft buns. The loaded fries should be called the mountain fries with the generous portion. If you want to support local and get a good value meal, I'd highly recommend this place.

I don’t often review but this was highly disappointing. Was expecting more based on the previous reviews but there’s smash burgers and then there is paper burgers. The “patty” is paper thin, the slice of cheese was thicker than the meat patty. We had a cheeseburger and a double cheeseburger with the double patties barely looking like a single burger. Literally eating a bun with some lettuce and sauce. Crinkle cut chips were overcooked and dry inside, inedible, blatantly obvious as soon as you opened the box so I’m surprised they still served them. Unfortunately won’t be returning.

A cool burger place, come and support them! I had the Aucklahoma burger with fries. I think they have changed their burger buns from sesame top (from previously reviewed photos) to a brioche type. The bun didn’t support the burger and was very soft/mooshy. The smash burger patty was great…..and that was about it. The fries would have been some of the crispiest and best I’ve tasted, but they were over salted. The dill/mustard/mayo dip was delish! My wife had the double simply cheese burger….that was 10/10. I feel you need to get two burger patties with these burgers….so make them doubles 👍

Food was faultless came all the way from kaitaia starving and definitely didn't disappoint. Loaded fries were 9/10 good flavour and chips were some of the best I've come across definitely not to heavy on the season as some people state. Mrs got the buffalo sando was tasty but didn't compare to the aucklohama triple that was 10/10. definitely recommended spot!

Absolutely the best Sushi place in New Zealand by far! Flavour is on point! Fillings are such perfect ratio to rice! Nice large pieces! The price is fantastic! I hope they never never never close shop!! That would be a crime and not a world I’d want to live in. The owners are so friendly and genuine too!
All the staff members are friendly and attentive. Food is on point at all times. Highly recommended to all sushi lovers 🥰

My favourite sushi store in Waitakere, West Auckland suburb. If you're ever in the neighbourhood, then check it out. You will not regret it. The sushi here is made with love by Kim and his wife Grace and each bite is so flavourful, an explosion of flavour in your mouth 😋 The store is small and intimate but like the saying "good things come in small packages" meaning the small size store is not a good indicator or reflection of the amazing food. Thank you Kim & Grace for the best sushi 🍣 out Westside 🥰🫶

Have ordered ubereats from this place a couple times now and their sushi is always on point!👌🏽have bought other items like their teriyaki chicken and prawn baskets, deep fried chicken triangle and the kakiyake pancake and its all been delicious and fresh. Thank you for your tasty enjoyable food👏🏽🔥🥰😋

Been coming here since 10 years ago since I arrived here in New Zealand. I used to walk from home, come here. Enjoy my day off from pushing trolleys at the supermarket. And enjoy to eat their sushi. The quality of this sushi shop never goes down. Owner greets you when you came and thanks you when you left. They even better than the franchised competitors. Their sushi is tastier. I can't imagine Railside rd. Without Ko&Ki sushi. Thank you for great sushi experience whenever i come.

The Stone Bowl Pho is truly authentic and delicious, absolutely amazing. We also tried the Stone Bowl Beef Vermicelli, and both kids and adults enjoyed it equally. It’s definitely worth the price at just $25.90.

First time trying this place and loved it! Got the Stone Bowl Beef Noodle and appreciated the option to add it certain quantities of onion, coriander, garlic chilli etc based on preference. Great value for money and delicious 😋 Was too excited to get a picture before digging in. Free to use fooseball tables are a cool touch too 😎

It’s deeply disappointing — and honestly, shameful — that as a Vietnamese person coming to support a Vietnamese restaurant, what I received in return was such disgraceful and disrespectful treatment from the staff. Yesterday was a special day off for my family, and we chose this place hoping to enjoy a good meal together. There were 4 adults and 6 children in our group. At exactly 10:11 AM, we placed our order: 4 bowls of pho, 4 coffees, and meals for the kids. By 10:40 AM, a staff member brought out 4 bowls of pho on a cart. Strangely, she only served 2 of them to our table and took the other 2 to the table next to us — a group of 3 who arrived and ordered after us. As a result, only 2 people at our table were eating while the other 2 just sat there watching — and the same thing happened at the other table. This was not just poor coordination — it was complete disregard for fairness and common sense. Even worse, two more customers came in after that, ordered two bowls of pho, and were served before we received the remaining 2 bowls for our group. I brought this up with the staff and was met with nothing but indifference and ridiculous excuses. Their response? That we needed to “understand” because the restaurant was busy. We waited nearly an hour — until 10:57 AM — for our last two bowls of pho. An absolutely unacceptable delay. Let me be clear: if you’re coming here with more than two people, don’t bother. Unless you enjoy being ignored, mistreated, and left hungry while paying premium prices, stay far away from this place. And to top it all off, when I voiced my frustration to the manager, he didn’t even offer an apology. Instead, he repeated the same line — that we had to understand. Not a shred of accountability. Not even basic courtesy. This was one of the worst dining experiences I’ve ever had. I will absolutely never return. And unless they make serious changes to how they treat their customers, I’ll make sure everyone I know hears about this disgraceful experience.

Blow up thing at the door is annoying. The price we paid vs what we got really wasn’t worth it. The flavour was nice but the portions weren’t as big as you’d think for the price. And the toast was cold by the time it got to the table. Wouldn’t recommend

Can guys serve faster, not everyone has time to wait. Egg are burnt should be a bit bitter, should do it better next time. No dish has a delicious taste, especially the smell of Pho is like the taste of Pho package sell at the supermarket. Hue beef noodle should add more seasoning and colourful, not attractive. Also check your QR code, can't open. I do not know how long the restaurant has been opened, but need to improve

I recently visited KFC and had a pretty satisfying experience. The staff was friendly and efficient, and my order was ready in just a few minutes. The chicken was crispy on the outside, juicy on the inside, just as expected. The fries were hot and well-seasoned. The restaurant was clean and well maintained. Would definitely come back for another bite.

I had the pleasure of meeting a Nepali person. He was so kind and friendly, which made the experience even more enjoyable. The food was also delicious—full of authentic flavours. It was truly a great experience overall!

best kfc out west i reckon. the girl who took my order was friendly as and very clear. she recommended a more affordable option for exactly what i wanted. she’s always so friendly when she takes orders and i think it makes it a better environment for the customers.
Amazing experience! The customer service was great, with a friendly environment and top-notch food quality. A big thanks to the staff and store manager for making my meal so enjoyable!

Amazing experience!I really love the customers service especially to April she look really motivated to her work specially when she's taking my orders she always smile to all the customers even if the customers was rude when it take orders.I really love the wicked wings in this store I make sure to come back again😊
Got the Roti for lunch, good amount of meat for 12 bucks, very tasty, mine was the slow cooked beef. Pleased with price and portion
Bad Meat quality - chicken smells and old stock or frozen. Has got a blackish mark on chicken. Meat is not fresh

Ordered Char Kuey Teow. Misleading menu and not something I would call Char Kuey Teow. The noodle is weirdly rolled, thick and stir fried without getting the sauces infused and you don't get to taste the actual dish. Chicken, prawn, bean sprouts and chives are good combo but not helping if you add onion slices and cucumbers? You can be fancy on altering the dish but please don't overdo and spoil the real dish which can be simple, authentic and tasty.

Food taste was very good but the quantity of chicken is not sufficient even if you get a large size order. Eg. Salt and pepper chicken. Lot more rice in comparison! They could balance this out a bit with more chicken!
Got the chicken laksa, taste great with the slight kick like an authentic laksa should and still sweet, really worth the $18.50 for it's portions if not more
Place may look dated, but the food is delicious.

The restaurant was so dark, lights were basically non existent. As soon as we walked in we could smell a pungent sour foul smell. On top of all of this we were waiting at the reception for ages, no staff came out so we didn't get the opportunity to try any of their food.
Delicious food, friendly service.
I ordered the braised pork belly on rice for 18 bucks, huge portion size, so fresh and delicious, nice workers and very clean restaurant. Definitely coming back ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Very delicious,love it would go back there again!

Really, really hard to review this place, so here goes…ordered our food at 12.30, so somewhat during the lunch rush, though I would point out it was midweek. We ordered a rice bowl, wok tossed beef and fresh spring rolls. The beef bowl was okay, though the beef was dry. The spring rolls were good, bit heavy on the noodles. However, the rolls cost $9.50 for two. Too expensive for what they are. The biggest issue was the 45 minute wait for our food. Far too long.

First time trying beef pho. Normally a Chinese wonton noodle soup person. Had to try Vietnamese version of a soup/broth with noodles. Beef was plentiful, soup was hot. First impression, not bad would like to try elsewhere to compare difference in taste. Was offered Chilli to accompany pho but declined. Maybe this is the key to the pho giving flavour/life to this dish. Generous 4/5

The bao were soft and fluffy although the crispy pork was more crumbed, but still tasted good. The Bahn mi roll tasted good too, the baguette lightly crisp on the outside but soft inside. The pho was delicious. Dining tables could have done with a good wipe down. Overall a good dining experience
Hand a lemon grass chicken salad, absolutely brilliant! Great portion and great price too. Will return :)

Bought a crispy pork Bap & 2x Pork n Prawn Rolls. Crispy Pork is not traditional Crispy Pork but boiled pork which is then crumbed and deep fried. Was extremely disappointed and when I went to complain the guy gave this look of feigned confusion like he didn't know what I was talking about. I would not recommend this place for Crispy Pork Bao. Needless to say that experience put me off the rest of my food.
Good crunchy fried chicken place. Got some tasty sweet garlic chicken n corn dogs too. Very tasty 😋

Absolutely love this place. Would go here all the time when I can for lunch. I would definitely recommend the chicken on rice. Oh and by the way their honey mustard sauce is amazing, you just cannot get enough of it. It pairs so well with their chicken and salad. The sweet and spicy chicken is fantastic as well as the other one besides original. The sweet and spicy is just perfect. Not too spicy and still has a crunch. Getting the 300g box of chicken is also a pretty good thing to get when you’re there.
Not going here again. Bad experience with the servers. Chicken was not good, too hard like rock. I feel like they were serving food from the day before. Also not worth it for the price.
Soy garlic chicken bites tasted delicious. Ladies working behind the counter were friendly to give samples of other chicken flavours.
great food

Don't get me wrong. I love me a Katsubi. Just not happy with how this branch is advertised to open at 10am but they can't really sell you anything until after 11am. Either that or we've been unlucky three times in the last year. The place is not conducive to waiting because it's next to Macca's and they're busy at that time. I wish they'd update their business hours on Google Maps or better yet open on time. 🤷🏻‍♂
$23 and get a few pieces of chicken.so over priced.come on katsubi stop ripping people off full the bowl up.$23 for rice and a few vegies
unable to get food due to not having any available 1 hr before closing. if you want to eat from there make sure you go 2 hours before closing time.

The service here is the best service I had in this mall. The food is delicious and convenient. I’m just so happy that there is a business in this mall that provides normal customer service. It also seems to be the most edible thing in this mall. Well done Katsubi!! Thank you for the amazing service!!

I will never eat there again and don't recommend it to anyone at all!! I ordered Teriyaki chicken (red bowl) and it was more sweet than a bowl of candies! The chicken was extremely sweet that made me nauseous. The sauce on the salad was also too sweet. Very unusual and very unhealthy.

Brace yourselves, food adventurers! I stumbled upon Ziggle Henderson from a friend's dinner invitation, and let me tell you, it was a culinary mission accomplished! Our reunion dinner turned into a full-blown flavor explosion. The burger? A symphony of textures and tastes. The fries? Perfectly bronzed, each one a crispy delight. And the honey chicken? Goodness, It was a sweet, savory, and slightly spicy masterpiece, all thanks to the wizardry of the Korean chef! The vibe was immaculate, thanks to the dynamic duo running the show. The welcoming lady was an absolute ray of sunshine, and the charismatic gentleman chef clearly knew his craft. The music? Let's just say it was so infectious that my friend almost broke out into a full-blown K-pop dance routine! We were there today, Tuesday, July 29th, from 6 to 7 pm – prime time for maximum enjoyment. Every single bite, every moment, was worth its weight in gold. Ziggle Henderson isn't just a restaurant; it's an experience. The food is top-tier, the atmosphere is electric, and the service is impeccable. Seriously, if you're looking for a dining adventure, this is your spot. A massive shout-out to the sweet lady and the chef for making our evening so unforgettable. Consider this your official invitation to go and get your taste buds ready!

Tried Ziggle after seeing all the glowing reviews and had high hopes, but sadly it didn’t live up to the hype for us. We ordered the Beef Bulgogi Loaded Fries, Ziggle’s Chicken Burger, Southern Crunch Burger, Onion Rings, and Boneless Southern Style Fried Chicken. The “Beef” Bulgogi Fries had no beef! What we assumed were beef strips turned out to be mushrooms — no heads-up on the menu, and for a beef dish, that’s a big miss. The Boneless Southern Style Fried Chicken didn’t hit the mark either — the coating had this overwhelming single spice note (couldn’t even tell what it was), and overall it just felt off and underseasoned. The Chicken Burgers were decent — edible but not memorable. Just your standard burger, nothing that made us say “wow” or want to come back for them. Only saving grace? The Onion Rings. Super crispy, golden, and actually delicious — the only thing I’d recommend. Might have just been an off day, but based on what we had, we were disappointed. Would love to see some consistency match the buzz.

ziggle ziggle ziggle😭😭 love it here! the food is exquisite and the service is amazing 🤩 i remember my phone ran out of battery and they were kind enough to let me borrow their charger 😁 i suggest trying out the ziggle chicken burger, its damn delicious 😋 my go to place now lol

Great food and always great service the only problem I find when ordering from here is the quality of the burger buns, they always seem to be fine or really stale & dry which honestly makes them hard to swallow. I’m not sure of its a quality issue with your supplier or if the store simply doesn’t rotate their stock enough however, if you’re charging premium prices for a burger you should expect decent burger buns.

Food is good. The burger combo comes with lots of chips. The girl who was serving this evening has really good customer service. I had a terrible day and it was nice to see her positive interactions with all the customers. This level of service doesn't go unnoticed ❤

After hearing many good reviews about this restaurant, last week my partner and I visited this place for the first time. It was worth going. We ordered veg chilli momos, veg chowmein ,veg tingmo shyapta and darjeeling black tea. Every bite was tasty. Food was fresh and delicious. Will definitely go back to try jhol momos and thukpa next time. Owner/manager was super friendly and warm.

This place serves One of the most authentic Nepali food in Auckland. :) never fails to tickle the taste buds. Great quantity and quality. Although, I’ve noticed that when the main chef and his wife are not around the taste is not maintained by the temporary chefs. But that hasn’t stopped me from going back, as the main chefs are not away for too long anyway! Highly recommend their - Momos (all kind), and the chicken chilli, goat curry!

What an amazing place!!! After so long we get the authentic flavours of Darjeeling Momo’s 😍😍😍The shafaley was so good I found the Nepalese taste of it in New Zealand!!! The pickles they served with it has got the very local taste which was too good i even can’t describe on my words! The environment was nice and calm with slow smooth music. Oh yes!!! Chowmein was great as well. We really enjoyed the meal. Thank you very much for your great hospitality Dai & Bhauju!!! Will visit soon. And try remaining dishes on our next visit!!!🇳🇵🙏❤️🙂🙂🙂.

Best dumplings ever!! Took me back to my time in India. Momos was recommended from a tik tok video and my friend was telling me about it when he came to visit. Shafaley was my favourite it was the first time I ever tried it and the chutney was to die for 😍 The atmosphere was calm and had nice traditional music placing quietly. Will definitely be a regular customer when in Auckland again.

Visited Momo junction for lunch today, ample parking around so a big thumbs up. Nice cozy interiors with a friendly staff, so another big plus. The menu is small and simple and they've covered everything important :). Their Momo's were one of the best I've had outside of Darjeeling. The jhol momos was something new; loved the jhol/curry that came along. Impressive chutney/achar to go with momos too...esp the hot chili one. Pork momos were just like they make back home. Pork Shapta with Tingmo was fantastic...Tingmo went well with jhol too haha. Def coming back to try their momos. Hope they add alu dum waiwai and chhyang soon 🙏🏻🙏🏻. Edit: visited again sometime back. This time tried their chowmein. It was superb as expected. Also ordered Shafaley (fried meat pocket)...bit heavy as they are deep fried. Perfect for a cold winter night or maybe hangover cure :)

What a find! The Chicken Katsu Donburi (Large) was $11, it is simply delicious. The chicken is super tender and the mayo and sauce is scrumptious. The Lady and Man serving were very friendly and welcoming too. I will be back again that is for sure. Totally recommend this restaurant

Chicken Katsu is the best I've ever had. Chicken is tender inside and there's a beautiful crunch to it too. They don't skimp on portion so you get your moneys worth! Always stopping by when I'm out west!
The katsu had a bold, flavorful taste with a perfectly crispy coating. The portion size and quality matched the price. I recommend checking this place out for a tasty and affordable meal.

Ordered online, quick n easy. Went to pick it up and was welcomed by a lady n her cute son, it would have been nice to dine in but takeaway it was. Crispy chicken n Japanese curry was delicious and the chicken n chips was soooo yummy, well everything we had was yummy. I would definitely go back for seconds n thirds. 頂きます (Itadakimasu) Thank you for the yummy meal.
Without a doubt the best Katsu chicken I have had. Super tender! Generous portion size which in this day & age seems to be few and far between.

Daaku Kebab is place to get your kebab fix. The stores a bit grubby, had lunch with a few sparrows and a pigeon. I was the only person here when eating at 1pm. Tables and comfortable seating. Friendly staff. The salad ingredients looked like they could have used a bit of a refresh. The highlight of coming here was the mixed kebab on rice meal. It was really tasty - generous portions of well flavoured meat, rice/salad/hummus all yum. If you’re not bothered by sparrows and some not so fresh vege, the food itself was really good as far as a kebab on rice meal goes. All up 6/10. Not the cleanest place but food was good!

Great place to go, this is my go 2 place all the time, especially when I finish work late. Everything here is fresh, I had the Lamb burger last night and loved it. This is a must try if you haven't 💯. Had a few and can't be bothered cooking, check this place out, I believe they are open till 3 am. Friendly staff, Very clean and tired place, dine in or takeaway

After paying for my order (chicken low carb) I saw a fly in the lettuce. For reference there’s a (dirty) sink in store for you to wash your hands in before you eat. I went to sit on the chair next to the sink waiting for my food and I saw a cockroach walking around in it. Definitely put me off eating the meal…safe to say I won’t be returning.

Ordered the meat loaded fries...those were great....BUT the garlic bread sucked...horrible...just a roll with minimal butter...very little butter and nothing garlic about it. Had to add my own butter! 0/5 for that!! Dominos would have been better.

Today I ordered food through Uber Eats, but the Coke No Sugar was missing from my order, and the chips were very cold and not edible. Please ensure orders are checked properly and the customer’s request is followed correctly. I hope this can be improved in future service.

Went for lunch and was surprised at the huge portions- could have easily been shared. Loved the flavors, and all ingredients were fresh too. Snuck home with a box of baklava as well at the end. Great value for money and will definitely return for dinner some time. Staff was friendly, and wait time was reasonable considering the quality of food served.

My love of Persian/Central Asian food was fulfilled this evening. Ive been coming here for bread for a while but have never had time for to sit down for a kai. That changed this evening and I couldn't have been happier. Their Mantu and Koobideh is without rival in New Zealand. Highly recommend
First time here, food was amazing. Probably the closest I've had to genuine middle eastern food in New Zealand. Highly recommend eating in, chef is amazing.
If you really want to taste a great food with exceptional presentation, please visit this Place. I visited once and now I come here more often. The food is amazingly good!!!

This is my first time experiencing Persian food. Wow! excellent grilled skewers they are fresh and tender served with rice, seasoned just right. The lamb has been smelled well. Great! Dizi stew slow cooked in a stone crock pot with lamb pieces is stewed until tender. You should be careful when eating stew, it will have small bones in it. Here's a cozy restaurant, impressively decorated ceiling with vibrant colors, convenient location easy to see. Staff enthusiastic and helpful. I will be back.

This hamburger steak shop has a unique charm. I visited with my partner to enjoy a special lunch in Henderson. I ordered the original set with fries, and my partner chose the spicy creamy set. The sausage was a bonus. For the original, the sweet and savory sauce paired perfectly with the steak, enhancing its flavour. Surprisingly, the fries were exceptional and complemented the steak wonderfully. I thoroughly enjoyed the meal. The spicy sauce wasn’t overly hot but had just the right amount of kick to highlight its flavour. Both dishes were delicious. The set prices were reasonable, offering great value compared to the average lunch cost these days, which added to the satisfaction. The space was small but clean, and the staff were kind and friendly. Highly recommended!

I had an amazing experience! The staff were incredibly kind, making the visit even more enjoyable. I ordered the Original and Spicy Creamy options, and both were fantastic. The Original had a slightly sweet flavor, which might not be for everyone, but I still found it delicious. The Spicy Creamy, however, was on another level—absolutely incredible! I’ll definitely ask for extra sauce next time because it was just that good. I can’t wait to go back! Highly recommend this place to anyone who loves hamburger steak.

I ordered the Original, Tomato, and Spicy Cream and was incredibly impressed with both the food quality and service. Each dish was exceptionally delicious. The chips I ordered as a side was outstanding—the seasoning was amazing...! Yum! I typically don’t finish chips when I order them as a side, but these were so good that I couldn't resist finishing every last one. I’ll definitely be returning! Love the chips 🍟
The food was full of rich flavor, and I ate until I was completely satisfied. The French fries were also incredibly delicious. The sauces here are fantastic! I will definitely come back.😉

This is the first time that I have visited a Japanese hamburg steak in NZ. We ordered the original hamburg and the creamy spicy hamburg. We also ordered additional sausage, egg and some fries on the sides. The original hamburg steak was very good, quite authentic and the hamburg patty was tasty and good texture. The creamy and spicy hamburg, the taste was just OK for me, I feel it has some Korean fusion in it with a similar sauce to the Rose sauce (tteokbukki sauce with heavy cream). The sausage was quite average to me, so probably wont order that again. The fries was amazing though, every fry was crispy and flavour was great. Overall very filling meal that we couldn't finish all the food that we ordered. Will come back just for the original hamburg steak.

Treasure Kitchen Henderson offers a cosy atmosphere and super nice staff who greeted and seated us immediately. They were very helpful in identifying vegetarian options. We tried the curry with roti and the vegetable tofu on rice. The curry had good flavor but was a bit sweet, which chili oil helped to balance. The roti was really nice and flakey! The vegetable tofu on rice was bland and the vegetables seemed a bit "sad," again needing chili oil to improve the taste. Despite the lovely service and prompt 15-minute food delivery, I wouldn't return for the food.

The food is authentic. It took quite a long time for our order. The waitress did let us know that it would take 20 minutes. I purchased Takeaways. Number 50 Pork Belly and Salted Fish. $24.90 Honey Chicken number 37 $21.90 Number 2 Curry Puffs $9.50 Number 5 Thai Fish Cakes $9.90 and finally Salt and Pepper soft shell Crab $11.90. I asked for mild for the chicken dish and Medium for the two Pork dishes. All were hot. Ok for my Son and I but not for my daughter. I confirmed twice about the heat too. The honey chicken meal had a small amount of chicken. The Pork Belly meals had plenty of meat! The Salt and Petter Crab was the stand out for me. I just returned (08/08/25) and had Malaysian Chicken satay for an entree and Claypot pork belly for the main. The sauce for the chicken was a bit bland. I was hoping for satay sauce. The claypot pork belly was authentic with plenty of pork belly and flavour.
Beef Rendang & Sambal Chicken on Rice... Good Value Deals of the Day Menu... Hainan Chicken Rice & Ice Kacang...

The food was surprisingly big for one person. It was good size with cheap price. Pad Thai was quite really good, near authentic. The fried wonton and the sauce was perfect! If I'll crave for Thai food, I will definitely come back again. :)
