Ordered from here, food was ok. The pad thai was great but didn't think much of the haka braised pork or milk buns. Pork lacked flavour and didn't melt in your mouth as it should. Needed about another half hour cooking with the addition of some more flavours...and as for the milk buns they were just too yeasty.

Awesome Fried chicken and Korean style Hotdogs!! Fried chicken was crispy outside and juicy inside. Must be made of thigh meat, not breast. Well done!! Hotdogs also looking nice, tasty sausages coverd with chewy bread part. Perfect!! Many reviews already said that owner lady's kindness and fantastic service. So I won't mention it.

Your go-to stop for Korean fried chicken — and don’t miss out on their hotdogs! The owner is friendly and generous, making every visit feel warm and welcoming. The chicken is always crispy on the outside, juicy on the inside. Much better than KFC! Their hotdogs are a hidden gem — crunchy, cheesy, and totally addictive. Perfect for a quick lunch or casual dinner with friends and families. Definitely a local favorite worth coming back to again.

I’ve had Korean hot dogs before, but this place is next level! The hot dogs were perfectly crispy on the outside, soft and chewy on the inside, with the perfect combo of sweet and savoury. I tried the Kumara and Potato Hotdog, and it was amazing. On top of that, the owner was super kind and sweet, which made the experience even better. I’ll definitely be back soon!
Best Korean chicken and hot dogs here I normally would go night market but now I've found this spot where it's not only so much tastier but also bang for your buck !! Owners are also so lovely 🌹

the food was delicious and fresh 🍗 and even the soda can was great; cold and crisp! 😊 i really enjoyed it! and the service was nice and quick. you can also doodle something while you wait for your food and leave it there which i thought was a cute thing! i drew a cat lol
Wow! First time getting sushi from here today as just started working in the area and all I can say is AMAZING! So fresh and clean and lots of great options! Will definitely be back for more.
Bought a sushi salmon Bento for a friend. He loves it. Come with miso soup like in a coffee cup. Doesn't have to wait long even during lunch time on Friday.
Delicious, fresh, very good prices, friendly staff. I always swing by if I’m going past it. Vegan options.

I've been living around here for agesss and somehow had never stopped in. What a mistake! I could have been eating delicious Japanese food at really affordable value. The food was really fresh and good. I'll be back for sure. ps: the staffs where the nicestttt
I love all from from Maki Yaki, Food was so nice and very yummy, anytime I came to Henderson I always visited them. Highly recommend.

I had a wonderful dining experience at this Indian restaurant with my family. From the moment we walked in, we felt incredibly welcome. The customer service was top-notch—friendly, attentive, and genuinely hospitable without being overbearing. The food was equally impressive. Every dish was bursting with authentic flavors and beautifully presented. The spices were perfectly balanced, and you could tell everything was made fresh. We especially loved the dosas and tandoori chicken was absolutely delicious! We did get some goat biryani for takeaways as they are best in town. It’s rare to find a place that delivers both exceptional service and incredible food, but this restaurant nailed it. Highly recommended for anyone craving high-quality Indian cuisine and a warm, inviting atmosphere. And a special mention must go to the Irani Chai. A heartfelt thank you for the complimentary chai—it felt like royalty in a cup. Truly a memorable touch that elevated the entire experience.

The taste and portion size were great. The Tandoori chicken was moist and juicy, crispy corn was just amazing and soup had the perfect balance of flavors, naan was super delicious went well with crispy prawns. I just hope they maintain the level of flavors every time I visit.
Great food and great value for money. The staff were friendly too. Loved their chicken 65 Dosa. Will go there again!

I used to order my lamb biriyani from fusion feast but they've removed it from the online menu so I ordered a biriyani from here & I'm so glad they took it down otherwise I would have never discovered these guys. The Lamb biriyani 10/10 I can't get enough. The portion containers are generous. Chicken Korma is so thick & delicious it pairs well with the Nan bread. It's not mild it's got heat at the perfect spice level. Gulab Julam is a nice sweet treat aswell thanks guys I enjoyed ordering from here I will always order my biriyani here from now on
I love the food. The restaurant’s owner is so friendly, and the food is authentic.
This is no doubt the best subway, Friendly staff, fast service, fresh ingredients. Even got given a free cookie!
I normally place my lunch order on my way home from my meetings and pick it up. The service is always quick. The staff are always friendly.
Great Subway location! Easy on and off the motorway or for those living/working in the area for a quick, tasty and healthy kai.

Horrible Service!! Wasn’t greeted upon being next in line, was just asked “what do you want?” In an annoyed tone… Indian lady with the name that looked like Kiana or something along those lines. Then my whole sub fell apart when trying to open the wrapping. I get the same sub every time and this was the worst sub I’ve ever eaten. My toastie also had half the cheese on the outside of the box… I get people have bad days but this is unacceptable! I’ll never be back to the subway on Rosebank road!! Such a shame my new job is 5 minutes away…
Experienced of bad attitude from the Indian lady in store.She not a good to talk the Costumer

Pathetic, mean, unprofessional customer service! We placed an online order at12 pm for pickup at 12:45. We reached store at exactly 12:45pm and the staff had no clue about the order. Only After showing the online receipt they start preparing. Our order was regular hawain Hulihuli with some extra stuffings that we paid for but the order this person on duty made was missing all the stuffings and the size was small not regular. Even after complaining about that he never bothered to correct his mistake or apologized…at the end we had to leave with the same wrong order.

I just want to say a big thank you to the lovely young lady who works at Pita Pit Rosebank Rd. We love your customer service. You are always so friendly and welcoming, and great to chat to. Plus you always make the best pitas. We've had the Mexicano two days running - yum. Happy to see you are back trading. Long may that continue.

Staff friendly. Ordered a large salad bowl, ended up getting large bowl with the same amount of salad as you would in a medium bowl. The quantity of veges they put in my salad was way less for a large bowl. I eat the salad bowl almost everyday at my work near New market so I know the quantity was terribly less for this branch. Not going back

Beyond hopeless doesn't begin to explain pita pit rosebank roads service. Second time I've been turned around by the manager due to the fact that she's too 'busy' to serve you for the next 20 mins or so cause her co worker hasn't shown up. Had one customer in front of me and another pita on the grill. Excellent customer service, told the customer behind me she wasn't going to serve her either until co workers turned up. Magnificent management, should get the sack. Went down the road to subway instead.

I went in yesterday for the first time and received the best customer experience ever. I believe her name was Paris please see to it that she get a raise as I will be a regular customer ONLY because of her excellent customer service.

Second time ordering from this place via uber eats and both times the pies came stone cold. If you're selling frozen pies don't advertise them on the "hot food" section.. horrible, won't be ordering from here ever again.

Staff professionalism too low my partner was picking up uber order and one customer without any reason asked what are you looking at she replied but customer was still asking staff didnt intervened and behaved same asking her what uber rude staff and staff while preparing order was using phone and been busy havent said thank you in reply.
Purchased hot food from here and it was horrible. All of it was hard as a rock and hardly edible, tasted like it had been in the warmer for days. Extremly dissapointed
I was doing uber eats, I got the order but the staff was so disrespectful
Given cold food after asking if it was hot and over charged terrible night staff
Best coffee, we had to order twice. And the food!!! Well presented and delicious. I had the omelette, highly recommend.
The brother and I past this place and through we'd grab a coffee. Then we spotted some of the food so had to try. Awesome food and excellent service.

Great local cafe. The food has been consistently good over the many years that it has been open. You can always get a table here and the tables are always cleared and clean. Staff are super friendly, helpful and knowledgeable of the menu. I love the decor and it has a calm, cool vibe.

To be fair, the kitchen food are good here, but not the service. We visited here for lunch on Sat and it wasn't busy. Many tables were available but they cannot arrange a table for 9 people. No friendly service here if you want to grab and go. This cafe was good before but not anymore. We can pay the same amount of money to buy better service, food and atmosphere in New Lynn or Mt Albert area.

♿ wheelchair accessible and parking 🚻 ♿Toilets The venue here is modern with a nice atmosphere lots of space .. child seating is available. The table was a good size not a tiny table like some cafes have. A nice place place for a coffee ☕ and meeting up with friends 😊. This cafe accepts reservations . Service was standard.

First time there today thurs. What an interesting old place.food cooked on a coal range.the chef was so friendly. Food delicious.and relax after lunch to an ice cream and movie. In a real theater.would recommend this place to any group for an outing 100% fantastic

Another most enjoyable experience, thank you Clint! Although it was a miserable day outside, the atmosphere inside was warm and welcoming. The roast meal was up to the usual standard and enjoyed by all, the movie was great and we even enjoyed an ice cream while viewing! This was our fourth year in a row and we will definitely come again!

Enjoyed a very good movie before moving into the dining area for a delicious roast meal. Our host gave a very interesting insight into his family's history regarding the Ryder's museum and the collection of many Auckland relics of great interest which would otherwise have been lost for ever.
FAYE Walker from the Wonders club came yesterday 11th June and had the best roast ever!! 😋 loved the Movie too! Many blessings for the experience.
Lovely place to go to for a laid back evening with friends. Has buffet dinner and you get to watch a movie as well. I’ve been here every year for the last 4 years.
Best pies out and double happys 🤤 very friendly
Outstanding food and service, excellent little lunchbar
Good spot for lunch if you're in the area, standard pricing
Nice people good toastie and steak rolls and the bomb
Nice hot chips. Will cook to order

This is a ghost kitchen primarily tailored for delivery apps like Uber Eats. The pickup experience is bizarre and involves blindly navigating the hallways of a commercial building with minimal signage. The food I received was very mid. Likely acceptable if you’re taking advantage of their 2:30am closing time (when nothing else is open for delivery), but otherwise quite unimpressive. My order came with a free can of V with a note that reads “Here’s the free drink for you! If you loved it, please leave us a good review on the platform, it means a lot to us!” The freebie was appreciated, but unfortunately the lacklustre quality of the food is reflected in my 2 star rating.

Absolutely loved my experience at Burdogs! The staff here are incredibly friendly, welcoming, and full of good vibes—it really adds to the atmosphere. The food is top-notch too—everything I tried was fresh, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. You can tell they care about quality and service. Definitely one of my favorite spots now. Highly recommend checking it out if you’re in the area!

Lovely customer service. Affordable :-) Grateful for the free drink. Unfortunately the food was too salty. We ordered the loaded fries with crispy chicken and the mince dog, we couldn’t eat it in the end it was far too salty.

Honestly glad I bought food here most generous people I have met even got a free coffee on the house honestly. Going to uber from here again, I love the burger super juicy and my favourite kind of chips which are similar to maccas ones love it

5 star burgers all day long. When you are looking for a tasty burger worth every cent, this is the place to go. Full of flavor every bite and in my opinion better tasting than anything the big burger restaurants sell. Wish I knew about this place sooner

Accidentally ordered for pick-up instead of delivery & decided to drive there at 2AM 😭. Have to say it was worth it in the end as it was a fun and interesting experience looking for this place. They gave me an extra drink & I “had” no choice but to give a review just for that. Will definitely come again 😼😼

It was supposed to be a midnight snack. Ordered beef and onion dumplings with egg fried noodles. Very flavourful and satisfying. Big portions worth the price was so hungry so I forgot to take photos but was also gifted this refreshing V flavour with a cute note😊 thank you! Highly recommend 😍

I was starving at 1 a.m. and decided to give this place a try out of curiosity. To my surprise, the food was prepared and delivered super quickly, and it tasted AMAZING! When I received my order, I was impressed by how well everything was packaged—the food was neatly arranged, and the bag was sealed perfectly. The flavors were beyond what I expected for a late-night meal. This place is definitely going to be my go-to midnight diner from now on. I’m absolutely in love with the food here!

It was 1:30am and decided I’d try something new on Ubereats and give this place a shot. I only ordered one item and they were kind enough to throw in a freebie. The drink I ordered was amazing and better than expected. My drink last me no longer than 2 minutes it was that good. Will definitely order from here again.

Tasty food and lovely service， definitely worth a try! really enjoyed the pepper beef rice, and thanks for doing my request for extra cabbage! Dirty fresh milk is always my go to, but I tried the creamy taro this time and loved it too. Cheers team!

Order a few cheese burger combos off uberEats since there was a "Buy 1, get 1 free" deal but now I know why... I don't think anyone would want to pay full price for that. The burger was dry and flavourless. Not to mention the massive slice of onion that made it hard to chew through, I don't know if that's just lazy food prep cutting but it ain't it! The fries were actually good but that's all that saved the meal. Won't be coming back.

I read all the “made with fresh meat, not frozen” etc and realised they write this as they seem to cook the patties way in advance. Stone cold. Not even warm showing it’s not made to order. Someone well and truly over seasoned the meat today. The lettuce etc was fresh which was the only nice part. But the stale, cold meat patty that was extremely chewy just destroyed the whole experience

We ordered through Uber eats tonight for the first time and holy moly! Whoever made those double cheeseburgers, 10/10. The meat was perfectly cooked, it was assembled sooo neatly and my wife and I both sat there and went woah.. it actually looks like the stock photo. Of course it’s not going to be delivered piping hot ( it seems people really struggle understanding that there isn’t an oven in the delivery cars ) loaded fries were great, burgers, great! We will definitely be back, thanks a bunch guys :)

Got 1 plus 1 uber eats deal for salad burger. The bun was cold and literally without any sauce. After reading all the fake reviews realized it's the case every time. They need to heat the bun and add bit more sauce to make it better. Not worth the money.

We ordered the cheese burger and fries off door dash. If I could I would give a zero rating! Chips were warmer than the burger itself. Patty was cold, bread stale. Was like the burger was 5 days old. Disgusting. Preaches about fresh ingredients … yeah right! Don’t even waste your money here. Yuck
Nice tasting burgers. Initially got the order wrong, but the guy in the kitchen was really good about it. Great service, and ultimately really tasty food.

Mission to try and find the place at night, poor signage and no information on the website saying it was a tiny kitchen in a big building at rear of drive. Patties ordered were burnt. Fish and broccoli burnt and dry. Would be better off ordering from the local takeaways. Feel ripped off knowing we would have got better quality elsewhere. Won't be back

Very average burgers. Buns were not the best, they tasted kind of stale and the patty was tough. I've had good burgers from the Ponsonby restaurant but this was definitely a let down especially cause I was expecting a good burger for the price.

ordered for pickup; a fish burger and a double beef and cheese burger cooked to well done, the fish burger was very fishy smelling, either overcooked or not fresh fish and drowning in sauce, and the beef burger patties and buns were badly burnt, inedible and also smelled/tasted fishy, the curly fries, kumara fries and shakes were all good. will not be returning as this is not an actual burger burger but a cloud kitchen that they are operating out of to test the west auckland waters. i have eaten at Newmarket plenty and will happily go back there any day, but would not recommend this branch to my westie whanau.

$80 of food orderd. Burger ok but crazy over priced for what you get. Brocolli was boiled, meaning it was ridiculously watery. Chargrilling the brocolli afterwards to add color won't get rid of all that moisture. $18 for popcorn chicken (all of 10 pieces) of avg chicken. Massively over priced for quality of food. Stick to your local fish and chip store.

So happy we can get seafood boil out West n it's up the road. We've been traveling out South to get our seafood boils. Thanks to Google I spotted Havoc Seafood Boil. I just had to try it and it was well worth it. Got the medium tray for 2-3 people, totally worth it for 3 people. Seafood chowder was delicious n I didn't expect the fry breads, that just made it even better, so good. Mac n cheese and steak&chips was yummy. Sauce is delicious but some more garlic would have been perfect, but other than that just straight delicious & worth it. Nga mihi nui for the kai.

Ordered for pick-up, and the process was super smooth! Easy to collect, and the seafood boil exceeded expectations with generous portions and amazing flavors. Plus, thanks for the free chocolates—such a sweet touch!
We ordered 2 boils from here and we loved the food. It was very tasty and the portion size was perfect for my whanau and I. Will recommend and order again.

I've ordered here a few times so delicious very yum and great service only thing is it's not consistent you're lucky to get 1 or 2 eggs and corn lol I also ordered extra sauce and it tasted nothing like the one drizzled over the seafood hope you see this and plan on putting a clear description of how many of items are in per trays pretty sad driving all that way to pick up from South Auckland only to get home with a big smile own my face and be disappointed because no eggs sausages corn or not enough of it not sure if I should order for Mother's Day

I got the prawn boil it was sooooo dam good 😍😍😍🥰 the prawns are big and perfectly cooked , potatoes were my absolute favorite! They were also cooked to perfection 👌sauce is FAB! Definitely recommend! Over all beauuutiful and satisfying 😌

⭐☆☆☆☆ Worst experience ever – Absolutely unacceptable customer service I placed an order for a Beef Biryani Family Pack today afternoon through the Ordermeal app, which was directly linked from the Engineers Cafe official website. The restaurant’s website clearly states their operating hours as Monday to Sunday, 11 AM to 11 PM, and the Ordermeal app also showed pickup available until 9 PM and delivery until 10 PM. I scheduled the pickup for 7 PM and made full payment through the app. However, when I arrived at Engineers Cafe at the scheduled time, to my shock, the entire shop was closed. I tried calling the contact number provided—it rang two or three times and then went unanswered. I even sent a text message, but received no reply. Minutes later, the phone was switched off. There was absolutely no communication from the restaurant informing me of the closure or any issue with the order. This was not only disappointing and frustrating, but a complete waste of time, energy, and money. I made a trip specifically to pick up the food, only to be left standing outside a closed shop. It’s shocking that a business can operate with such carelessness and show zero accountability towards its customers. The lack of basic courtesy or responsibility to notify customers about unavailability or closure is unacceptable. As a regular customer on Ordermeal, this is the first time I’ve had such a terrible experience, and it’s unfortunate that it was caused entirely by the negligence of Engineers Cafe. This level of unprofessionalism reflects very poorly on the restaurant management. Strongly urge others to double-check before placing an order here, and I sincerely hope the restaurant takes immediate steps to improve their communication and customer service standards.

I ordered Fried rice and Chicken roast from Engineer’s cafe and the whole experience was genuinely satisfying. The packaging was solid and the food arrived hot , neatly packed. Highly recommended for both quality and service. I’ll definitely be ordering again.

We ordered beef fry ,biryani and chicken 65 from Engineers Café for our function, and it was amazing! The biryani was full of flavor, and the chicken was perfectly cooked and spicy. Everyone loved it. Great food and great service — highly recommend! The best catering service

I recently ordered food for a function, and it was absolutely scrumptious. I had the chance to try the chicken biryani, duck roast, appam, and cutlet, and every dish was delicious. The customer service was excellent. Ordering process was incredibly convenient. I highly recommend this place for anyone looking for authentic Kerala food with good service.

I recently tried the south Indian food at Engineers cafe and it was amazing! The flavors were authentic, rich, and so well-balanced. The spices were just right, giving each dish a depth and warmth that felt like true south Indian home cooking. Favorites were the Fried rice and chicken roast which were perfectly cooked and bursting with flavor. The Appam was soft and fresh, and the Mutton stew added a perfect touch. I highly recommend it to anyone craving genuine south Indian cuisine – absolutely delicious!

Went to the new location in the CBD area. Got the Burger Set which was plenty of food and great for those who want a little bit of everything. Chicken was cooked to perfection and the fries were delicious! Definitely will be returning!
Ordered on uber eats the smash burger was flavourful and tasty as well as the maple soy chicken good size portions for the price 😌🫶
Had loaded fries and a half n half chicken box. food was fantastic definitely going back for the burgers next time.

Really loved the place, just tried it not long ago and I'm telling you I'm impressed on how love is put on to my meals. Chicken burger is absolutely beautiful and soft also crunchy. Definitely will be back again
We just spent $150 here on Uber eats and we do not regret it 🤌😍 was absolutely delicious!!!
Super spicy 🥵 Awesome! Very delicious!

Lovely friendly honest staff and very reasonable prices too. Infact when I told the owner my burger was too cheap she still refused to take extra money for it . They work very hard to please they're customers and I look forward to the fresh food when I get the time to go down there. The food is popular and made fresh to order if you are able to phone ahead.
hmm pretty cheap pricing, with adequate taste. i recommend for local industrial workers.
Good customer service and a friendly environment
Hands down best food 10/10 ever tasted
Love stopping off for a snack here. Always greeted upon entry with lovely service. Not usually what you’d expect from your usual bakery. Fluffy hot pie and a can starts the day right

Felt welcomed & great customer service but unfortunately the food was a let down. I have never had an oily sausage roll (double happy) in my life - had to chuck it out. It seemed to have been fried in oil to hide that it wasn't freshly baked. The paper bag itself was drenched in oil too. Won't be returning any time soon
Lovely & friendly service everytime we come here. Yummy food too!

Food is lovely .. Best mocha I’ve had in a long time and their pies actually have filling unlike some places The customer service is outstanding from start to finish I would go here just for the friendliness experienced alone

Great service and you can clearly notice the pride and the time they put into making their food. Fresh and tasty. Their pies snd pastry has such a lovely thick crust. My husband's addicted to their fried chicken.

The food is delicious, great ambience, love the decor and the people are just as amazing. We live on the opposite side of auckland, but followed the food because we used to go to berlinchen in town! Great weekday deals and the weekend breakfast is on point!
What a lovely welcoming and family friendly place. Great food which the kids loved and a homely atmosphere. Great beer with chilled stein glasses, a nice touch. Highly recommend.

Went here for my birthday dinner and it was lovely! I anticipated this visit for months already and I can't believe how good it was! Many have passed by this restaurant without realising it due to its hidden nature on an industrial road. But once you come here, you'll leave feeling all satisfied. The food was delicious and the atmosphere felt cozy. Also the owner was so nice to check up on us and ask if we enjoyed the food. 10/10 would absolutely recommend coming here again for lunch or dinner with friends/family.

Incredible experience from start to finish! The service was a perfect 10/10 – attentive, friendly, and professional. The food, simply amazing and beautifully presented. What truly made our afternoon was the owner – so warm and welcoming, he made us feel right at home. I’ll definitely be coming back and would recommend!

A hidden gem in Avondale. We can’t say enough good things about this nicely decorated German cafe. We all had our best German brunch at Mitten Drin. The food was incredibly tasty with large portions. The staffs are really friendly and provide good service. You get try German dish for both lunch and breakfast. We were so hungry forgot to take pictures so only took picture of a Bavarian breakfast. And their large size coffee literally means large size. All the coffee lovers like me will love that. This place is very welcoming relaxed with homely vibes. The food is German with affordable price, the beers are German and friendly staffs will make you to visit this place again
Impressive lunch bar clean and tidy a large variety of food available from hot chips to tasty egg burgers A rating for thete store. Table seating indoor and also out door.
What a great find on rosebank road, nice crispy chips and soft inside. Great cheeseburger for a takeaways.
The best cheap food on Rosebank. Lovely owners. Bacon and egg rolls are great. All the usual lasagne squares, fish, chips etc done well.

I wasn't expecting much from the outside, thought it was the usual Lunch bar but was real suprised to find out how clean and tidy it was inside. Lots of range of food, and I agree with all the good past comments too. Real happy to come in as I forgot my lunch today
Paywave is FREE! Cheapest food on rosebank road for us regulars. Fast convenient food for all tradies. Healthy stuff too, but not veg or vegan orientated. Sell vapes etc
Cute cafe, delicious food! Fantastic Vietnamese food and my husband enjoyed his meat pie

Visited Columbus Coffee Avondale with my wife for brunch and had a great experience. I ordered the Big Breakfast — the bacon was perfectly cooked, eggs were beautifully runny, and the mushrooms and sausage were super tasty and well done. My wife had the mushrooms with pesto on ciabatta bread — absolutely delicious! Full of flavor and a definite highlight. The interior was so pleasant, and with the sun shining through, it made for a peaceful and relaxing brunch vibe. Great food, lovely atmosphere — would definitely come back again. Highly recommend!

Food here is amazing and decently sided and priced. I love their french toast in particular. Always easy to get a table and the tables are kept clean and clear. Food comes out quickly and staff are super friendly

newly renovated with nice and comfy chairs and tables. coffee was nice and perfect temperature for cold weather outside. Good variety of food options including vegetarian. I would definitely go back again.

I ordered a sandwich and specifically asked for it toasted, but instead, they just put it in the microwave. The bread came out soggy and wet—not at all what I expected. I also ordered a flat white, and it was served way too hot. Anyone who knows coffee understands it should be around 60°C to taste right and avoid burning the milk. Since the old owner left, the quality and attention to detail have gone downhill. It’s not the same café anymore. I’ve stopped going, and many of my work colleagues have done the same.

The food complements the coffee beautifully at this cafe. My new favourite spot for a relaxing weekend morning Coffee — their Croissant was fresh and hearty, and was indeed satisfying together with the hot coffee. Surely coming out back again, happy customer :)

Wish I had of read the reviews before even ordering from this place! Nah not nice chips looked and tasted old, fish burgers were not it! dont even know what kind of batter that was. Fried rice was a big 👎🏾😕 was a strange taste. Tried to eat it but naaaah, too bad i can't take it back and get a refund!! definitely won't be back here again waste of $$$ and we're still hungry lol🤦🏽‍♀️

Terrible food, everything looked like it was cooked in old oil and needed changing. Ordered the 10pack and 1/2 dozen nibbles, nibbles were hard it seemed like they were double dipped and was not pleasant to eat, we had to remove the hard batter. Chips were ok but the fish was so floppy/soggy it was horrible. Threw away our order and will not return to this paticular takeaway.

This is more than $15 worth of chips. Hand for size reference. How disappointing. First time ordering from here and grateful they accepted our order despite nearly closing but this is not acceptable. Would rather be rejected than be ripped off.

The chips taste old or expired. The cheese burger was not good at all, but the fish wasn't to bad. Never going back again. Please read the reviews and try to improve. People are spending there hard earn money on this shitty food.
Gross and disgusting! Everything is burnt!!! Some of the chicken nighets were so over cooked they had nearly no chicken in them 😡 Definitely will not be going back!!!!
Worstest Custmer service and not a good place to have food...
Worst customer service ever, wont go again.
Very good pastrami salad sandwich

I visited Thornlow Takeaways for the first time today. I went there because of the 4.4 Google rating, Firstly the need to update their menu price list its really out of date! I went there because of the reasonable prices. The prices are double that of the posted menu so that was disappointing. I purchased the $28 family special, he fish was nice and fresh and tender, the chips were good too but not a very big serving. I also purchased a Chicken Kebab roll, It was actually delicious. I don't think I would return as its too pricey for a family in my humble opinion. It was pretty greasy
The chips are great, the fish on the other hand was not, chewy and a bit hard, kind of made me question if it was still ok to eat
Delicious crumbed fish and chips! The chips could have been slightly crispier but they were yum :)
Overpriced for a fish and chips shop. Not that great
Classic kiwi style takeaway with great service, friendly staff & tasty food. Prices are reasonable, food is ready on time, hot & fresh. Highly recommend!

The food is unexpectedly really delicious for a hidden gem near home. I can still taste all the flavours, perfectly balanced in taste. The pricing is also very affordable, I'll be back to try the other menu items.
The best wee gem in the West..!! Found this place a few months ago & It never disappoints. Such fresh, authentic Vietnamese food with super lovely people running it. Can't recommend enough!

The chicken noodles pho was absolutely delicious. Really lovely. The rolls was also good with the peanut sauce. The ladies were very warm n friendly, they even served us tea when we did not need it due to soup dish. A great place to enjoy a meal.

Really good pho and bun Bo hue. Great service also. If you are a westie, u don't need to drive to other side of Auckland to get good pho anymore. If u are not a westie, u need to come here to try it out! (pun intended)

It's a cute little authentic Vietnamese restaurant. A little disappointed with the pho broth but that might be because the cooking is from a different region of VN than what I'm used to. The grilled pork rice dish was delicious and so filling. The coffee was amazing.
Love the steak and cheese pie only part that let's them down is i have had pies that are cold think they need to rotate them or get new pie warmer other than that its a good pie
Deliciously fresh cheese scones which they had no problem heating up for me
Best staff ever and foods were so yum suggested 100%

It was my first time to try Choco cheese cake here and it was really awesome! You should try!!!!!!!!! I highly recommened it!! And staff is kind and it is clean!! Yuummmm!!!🤤 and the price is reasonable I think!! That's why i will visit again soon!!
Had two mince and cheese pies, wasn't the best. One bite and I knew, maybe I'm just used to good pies? One in Te Atatu south next to countdown is always good so will just get them from here :)

HunchMunch 236 Great North Road, Glendene, Auckland 0612 *0/5 Stars - Disappointing Experience at Hunch Munch in Henderson* After hearing great reviews, my partner and I drove from South Auckland to Henderson to try Hunch Munch. Unfortunately, the experience was a letdown. Upon arrival, we noticed a busy atmosphere with people waiting for their orders. Inside, I was shocked to see the dirty state of the place. Flies were buzzing around, and I managed to capture a photo of a couple lingering around the area. The grill, benches, and floor were all filthy. To make matters worse, I stood there for a while before anyone bothered to take my order. Considering the poor management and unsanitary conditions, I'm glad I didn't end up ordering anything. The owners seemed overwhelmed, struggling to keep up with orders. Needless to say, we won't be returning. *Not recommended due to cleanliness and management issues.*
Best value for money tacos, comes with so much meat stacked in it. 100% recommend trying the tacos here, the burgers are good to, highly recommended

First timer here and i must say the food here did not disappoint! We ordered the three idiots and brisket melt and we loved it. Brisket melt was massive I needed to share it with my partner. Looking forward to try other menus. Should've taken a photo but we enjoyed the food we didnt care 😆 Highly recommended.

Had a few friends and family recommend this spot. If you look at the space, it's not too inviting and feels like a so-so food spot. The food itself is actually pretty good. It's not the most amazing presentation, but it's a lot better than what you would expect. The flavor is great, and I think the value is actually pretty good for what you get. The team working at the shop are welcoming and friendly. I personally don't eat carbs, but the next time I'm out for a cheeky treat, I'll be back for another dirty burger. Thanks, Hunch Munch team. I am pleasantly surprised.

Probably the best tasting Tacos I’ve had in NZ, and unbelievably the most value also. As a die hard fan of Toko’s Tacos, I was shocked at how good these were tonight. I couldn’t fault them at all. The staff are super friendly too and you can tell that they put love into their cooking. The food was even better than the pictures, which is super rare these days. Even down to the sauces and accompaniments within the dish… onion, fresh coriander and spice. These were so awnn!! Can’t recommend them enough

We got 3 pizzas, chicken tandoori, beef pepperoni and margeretta. The pizza base was really good. There was definately more than one pepperoni on the pepperoni pizza 😂. The staff was polite and helpful. They could improve their dine in services but it was clean, affordable and tasty

Just had meal delivered by Uber Eats. Pepperoni pizza on special for $20 had one (yes you read that right - one!) piece of pepperoni on the whole dried out overcooked pizza. Then $18.99 for spicy wings and you get 8 tiny ones which works out at $2.37 each. Got a BBQ plate and all meat was overcooked and rubbery with dried out chop suey. Are you having a laugh? Utter rip off. Never again.

A hidden gem in the Glendene Village, Beach Pizza has some delectable delights sure to satisfy everyone's taste buds!! I had 2 pizza's both on Cauliflower bases (keto fans will love this) and I absolutely loved them. Coming in as my first favourite is the Basil and Pesto Chicken Pizza on Cauliflower base. A close second was the Cranberry Chicken Pizza, also on the Cauliflower base. I loved how fragrant and intense the flavours were in both pizzas. Even my Dad who doesn't really like takeaways asked for seconds!! Pop in and give Beach Pizza a go, especially the pizzas I had!! Really looking forward to our next pizza night with the fams just so I can have these again!! Great customer service and swift too! Whether you're dining in or taking away, you're sure to have a satisfied tummy. Chandu and the team are salt of the earth good people making great food, so pop on in and give them a try. I'm so glad I did!! And yes, their prices are very reasonable!!Win win!!😊💯
It’s really the best pizza place in Auckland. We ordered vegetarian zesty pizza and cheese garlic bread and we asked Deep to make it spicy and he made it really tasty. Thanks for the good service.
Thank you Chandra for supporting Blue Star with our Mental Health Awareness Week pizza lunch, the team are in love with your pizzas and are sure to order again for another meal!

I was pleasantly surprised by this roast shop. Ordered a few roasts, the meat was good quality, and the portions were generous. The owners were friendly and helpful with my requests. Would definitely order again and recommend it to others.

always order from here & today just ordered beef roast meal via uber eats as I usually do & I added into the notes if they could put gravy into a separate container, got the meal with no gravy or the apple sauce I had added on. the meat is super dry and taste old like it’s from yesterday. very disappointed

Purchased 2 pork rolls and a chicken roll. prices are higher than the online meny, The man serving was very friendly, The rolld were nice with plenty of meat but the rolls are very small and the prices too high

I have been getting my roast meals from here for a long time. Ken and his wife are a lovely couple who always remember me and my meal choices - I suspect they remember all their loyal customers! Food is always fresh, tasty and well cooked and served up with a generous helping of gravy. Price is very reasonable. If you are in the area and looking for a satisfying meal option I highly recommend you try them out. The photo is of the large vegetarian meal.
I ordered a roast lamb meal from Uber Eats and was sent roast beef! The vegetables were nice though. Didn't fancy beef smothered in mint sauce so it went in the bin.

The Cheese Naan is for real! Took some of the sisters UberEats, and love the butter chicken. Especially the Naan. It makes the difference when your cheese naan is what they advertise it is. Big thumbs up
Alright service for been late at night.

Extremely Disappointed – Burnt Food & No Accountability I ordered two burgers from this place yesterday, and I was honestly shocked at the quality. Both burgers were burnt black—completely inedible and bitter. How can you serve food like that and still charge full price? For a place that sells $15 burgers, the least you expect is that they’re properly cooked. To make matters worse, I tried calling multiple times for over half an hour, and no one picked up. Eventually, I went to the store to place my order in person, and even then I asked the staff why they weren’t answering calls. I was told they were “busy,” but I saw the person just on their phone—not even attempting to check or respond. I also tried calling again the next day to give feedback, and again, no response. No call back, no apology. This was a terrible experience—not just with the food, but the complete lack of service and accountability. I don’t usually leave reviews, but this needed to be said. Can the owner please share a direct contact number or email address so I can raise this with them personally? I really hope this is taken seriously and not ignored like the calls.
chicken is amazing! went for the all you can eat wings. totally worth it when with a group. only downfall is that it's a tight squeeze.

The chicken here is freaking fantastic! Absolutely recommend trying the fried chicken skin and the boneless chicken in either the maple soy garlic/lemon pepper flavours. The Headquarter, Big Classic and Smokey BBQ burger are really good too. 10/10 would recommend ordering from this store. Yum!
Really nice burgers and chicken nibbles! Option of fried chicken skin is also tasty. Highly recommend!

YUM YUM YUM!!! We do love our fried chicken and were excited to see a new place opening up so close to home. We tried them for the first time last night and were left very happy! I got the chicken salad which was so good. That dressing! Yum. I'll go back just for that! I also got the classic burger coz, lets face it, the salad wasn't going to cut it on its own haha. Both were delicious. My husband had some spicy wings and the spicy burger and was completely satisfied. The staff are super friendly. They'll know me by name soon enough :) Good quality and tasty food. A nice addition to our neighbourhood.

Travelled 60 mins from east Auckland to west Auckland and back home just to buy this amazing authentic Butter Chicken ❤️ Love both Indian style and Kiwi style Butter Chicken ❤️🍗 price is super affordable and the taste is just booomb! Love it 😍 wish to have a store here in Howick toooooo.

Ordered 2 curries online - they didbnot come with rice. I called the store and they said you have to order rice separately. It does not say this on their menu and every other Indian restaurant I have been too that is the norm. Would be nice if they could state that on the menu. Feeling ripped off. $46 on 2 curries and 2 naan with no rice.
js ate the chicken korma 5 minutes ago and was the best thing ive ate in my whole life 🥹🫰🏿
I had Butter Chicken. It was good, not extraordinary. A bit too sweet. Still I was hungry, it was good to eat. Poetry?
The best Butter chicken I’ve ever had in my life all the curries are Very good, highly recommend

Saw some reviews going on about salt. Each to their own I guess. I thought everything tasted pretty good. Good value for money too! My only complaint would be the black bean beef wasn’t as “black-beany” as other places I’ve been. Still fine though. If you’re in the mood for some decent Asian food this is honestly a safe choice. There’s also options for fish and chip meals too.

The honey chicken noodles are good value for money and tasty (except quite salty). We told the guy over the phone that we wanted a dish with lots of fresh veges and he suggested we order chow mein. We were really disappointed with our chicken chow mein. It was super salty but didn't really have any particular flavour at all. I think the veges were all frozen because the texture and taste of them was mushy like when you overboil frozen veg at home. My Dad (who normally is keen on any leftovers or free dinners😂) wasn't even keen on it so the entire thing went to waste. Would come back for the honey chicken noodles but nothing else.

Food is ok, a little bland and overpriced now. $18 for a main or two for $32, typical Chinese food set for New Zealand, no spice or heat. Displayed is our sweet and sour pork and Lemon chicken. It looks good but was tough and over cooked.

As nice as Noodle Canteen but a little cheaper. Food and menu is about the same as other places. People are nice and friendly. Food tastes good and portion size is excellent- could easily leave some for lunch the next day.

Chicken nibbles are delicious as always. We haven't been here in a while. Overall quite disappointing. Avoid sweet n sour pork like the plague. It's awful. Overcooked, hard, doesn't taste fresh. Chicken fried rice was bland.

Nice, quiet place for lunch or dinner. First time dining here. Normally come for a quick poker machine fix.Glad to have taken time to try steak off the menu. Well presented, cooked perfectly. No complaints thank you for great steak cooked to perfection.

First time visiting Westie Bristo for dinner - we were greeted nicely by the waiter, service was excellent. Food was cooked nicer than some fancier bar n restaurant places I’ve been too. Overall our experience was great!
Went for dinner and the food was top notch! The ambience was spoiled by the very loud music they had playing but that won't deter us to go back for another meal!
Went here using First table. Excellent friendly service. The food was fresh and enjoyable.

We found this little gem through first table. Bought our children here for a treat. People say it lacks environment but forget that it’s a bar and bistro not a 5 star restaurant. The game was playing, good back ground music! The variety of food is amazing, very cheap compared to other places we have been to and such a cool sight being able to watch the chefs cooking our food. Delicious food and great service. We will definitely be back!! Don’t be fooled by the nachos photo, all the mince was underneath the chips (looking like a nice grilled pizza 😍), chips on top so it wouldn’t get soggy! How good!
The party platter was wonderful. It was a taste I wanted to eat every day. It was more delicious and touching than what I had in Korea. I really recommend it and make sure to try it

When you first see this little collection of shabby, dank shops in car park peppered with trash and surrounded by seagulls you would be forgiven in thinking any sushi coming from this block will get you very sick… but this small haven is actually OK. It’s not a great atmosphere, it’s obviously westernised, “quick stop” sushi but it is surprisingly good. Not great, but good. It’s clean, the staff are professional and it has a decent selection considering.

Hate to be a bummer but I work around this place and have beenore than 5 times now want to support our local, however each and every time the quality is bad and doesn’t taste fresh. Rice can be hard and taste old and fish isn’t fresh. 2 star
Best Sushi in Avondale by far. Beautiful fresh Salmon always. Incredible fried chicken and miso soup. Great prices!

Will not be back... Raw chicken in my chicken skewer. Below average sushi, the chicken sushi and the tuna sushi that I tried were pretty bland and had to add a fair amount of soy sauce to eat them. Could be just my taste preferences though, I know others that enjoy this place and eat here weekly.

Just had a $5.80 katsu chicken sushi pack, and a $16 family pack - both delicious!! Looking forward to trying the $32 fried rice and sweet and sour pork tray next time! Fish was fresh, everything tasted good, service was extremely welcoming and friendly
Fried rice,fried noodles and noodles soup are so good and easy get to delivery or pick up. The foods was yummm.

If I could give no stars I would, WORST fish and chips ever. This was a $16 order. A scoop of chips ($4) 2 spring rolls half the size of normal ones, a fish the size of a small potato fritter and a cold crab stick. Disgusting waste of money. The spring rolls were literally just green veggie dont even know what it was but no meat or anything. Yuck yuck yuck!!
food is so delicious,looking forward to order again
Seems like new owners with new menu. Great food. The fried rice and sweet and sour pork was great and very flavorful. Very friendly staff and will def come back 😀
My family and I ordered fish burgers from here and got food poisoning! 🤮 🫩 (I’m lying in bed sick as I write this, just thought I’d warn others) First and last time we will order from here.

My second time at Avondale Takeaway's highly recommended. 2× super burgers were amazing plenty of meat (meat pattie steak and bacon with the usual egg etc). A serve of chips and 6x battered mussels and a hot dog. Had fish from this place a few months ago, very good. They are reasonably priced.

I know it was 10min before closing time but if they want people to return then it's good to treat all take aways the same, my package was saturated in oil and the fish was greasy. Won't be coming back here again I'll stick to green bay double the size fish and chips and bang for ya bucks!!

Bought lemon chicken and sweet and sour pork and if you want thick as batter with a hint of the meat with no flavour, this is your place. Drowning in their respective sauces which is why they get two stars. I can use it for a homemade dish tomorrow night.

Tonight I went there for the first time and I have to say the chips? Perfect. The fish perfect and my tastebuds for the super Burger ? Well I’ve never tasted such anything like it before. This place is perfection in every aspect of the word.
Great Service. Prices were good. Egg burgers were delicious. Smaller fish portion to what I'm used to, same with the chips. Oversalted , slightly overcooked but tasty overall.

Quite disappointed at the store after it has changed the owner. Been getting the fried rice here since 2018 yum chow fried rice , and now the fried rice does not taste as good as the old one, they halved the amount of meat that they put in the fried rice and also lack of FLAVOURS!!!!!!
Ordered snapper and got this. Do not recommend.

Brought Fish and chips the fish peices were a little bigger than a Fish finger in the past they were a good size. I know prices have gone up but I'd prefer to pay more rather than a tiny portion and I'd prefer tehey told us they reduced the size. I predict these new owners wont last a lot of people complaining about this
Great service with a friendly smile. Good food and reasonable pricing. Wishing continued success for the owners!

Great roast meals! I had the beef and pork meals. I would say this is the best I've tasted out west so far. They also have fried chicken meal options and other usual takeaway menu items. Nice cozy spot, didn't expect such a good roast from this tiny space. Pricing is also good, well worth the spend. Fast and friendly service, always a pleasure visiting.

Great Mr Chips, chips cooked consistently well. Agree with everyone else's though. Lady needs good customer service training. She made this customer feel that she was doing us me the service for taking my order. Lady customer is KING$$!

I've lived in the area for around 15 years now, and this is my fave place for hot chips and roasts! The burgers are great too, and it's all good value for money. Interestingly I see some people have commented on the owner, however we absolutely LOVE chatting with both owners when we drop in! They clearly work hard and are often rushed trying to get meals out during peak times, but we find them lovely to talk to! Thanks T & J!
Top shop, the food is sooo nice, the service is awesome and the people there are always welcoming and nice he always give you extras.
Service was appaling. Lady seemed to be in a bad mood, they really need to take a look at themselves in the mirror. Food however was tasty and actually tasted fresh.

Got a massive feed for the fams spent about $100 for 10+ people , good price for the amount we received.fish, chips , hot dogs , wontons and potato fritters. Everything tasted fresh and delicious. Best fish and chips I've had in forever. Can't wait to go back.

Portion size on the fish and chips was very small. After removing the batter, there wasn't even enough fish on his fillet to feed my 2 year old (we bought 3). And while I understand fish is expensive, and they want to make money, $9 for basically a lump of fried flour is outrageous. So outrageous I went back and showed the owner the pictures. She simply shrugged her shoulders and talked around in circles. My suggestion, go anywhere else
Best wonton soup, chips are so crunchy and tasty. Fresh oil. Best takeaways . And really yummy crispy chicken burgers
We got a prawn fried rice for $22. Taste wasn't bad however, felt there were hardly any prawns. It's a bit over priced.
Sweet sour pork is amazing, and you must try their crispy chicken burger!!

There is a lack of Burmese food in Auckland, Moe Palae' hits the spot. Recommended to try the tea salad, great example of the dish. Flavours unique to the cuisine. Worth stopping in for a meal. Note to the owners: Entrée / Appetizers are still coming out after the mains. I.e. the tempura set. As winter approaches in full force, you may want to look into heating of the dining area. Didn't seem to be on when we came in for dinner and it was cold to sit and have dinner.

Food was so delicious! It was a nice combination of nostalgic taste with a refreshing twist. The dishes were light yet flavourful and clean on the palate 😊 It was our first time having Burmese cuisine but it definitely won't be our last!

My first Burmese restaurant. Hard to describe the flavours - different to Thai or Vietnamese yes. I was going to say delicate. But the chili powder wasn’t - yet still different. You are just going to have to try it.
Excellent food, everything we ordered was fresh and absolutely delicious! The service was great and super friendly too. More people need to know about this place! Definitely coming back to try more!

Great place, unique cuisine, atmosphere is light and bright, staff were equally pleasant. Food was nice and came out reasonably fast (we were in a part of 15) They gave us a free desert as well! Pricing is about $22-30 for a mains.

A lovely spacious place with indoor and outdoor (covered) seating. Wonderful attentive service. Was offered sparkling or plain water on arrival while waiting for my coffee. Plenty of room to discuss work ideas and nice selection of food both in cabinet and from the kitchen. Update may 2024 this is one of the best pea and ham soups I have ever tasted . Healthy and so warming for a cold day. August update... a new couscous vege and haloumi salad. Great value and very delicious 👌 ✨️ Highly recommend the poached eggs on walnut toast. A lovely breakfast or lunch.

A huge shout out to Trinity of Silver for the lovely breakfast. They have an awesome kids corner, dog friendly and super affordable kai. A great spot to work from or to have meetings. They are on the corner of the Mt Albert shops, parking is either on the street or a short walk from either of the public car parks off New North Rd. I was curious so looked it up, Trinity of Silver has been operating since 1999 - which is probably why I don’t remember a time without it in the “terminus” as my granny used to call it. Grab your coffees on the way to the train or have a cheeky brunch or two.

Excellent coffee shop, I've been here several times, and the staff are always polite, friendly, and helpful, the place is always kept extremely clean as well. Their coffee is excellent and well presented. their food is even better, the presentation of which is always impeccable and the food is always delicious. Great value for price. I highly recommend this cafe. Additional note, the free glass of water and refills with a meal is an excellent idea.

What a lovely cafe. With indoor and outdoor seating space. Two of the old people hopefully the owner are trying their level best and giving the lovely service. Very much friendly and courteous. Very quick service. Coffee is amazing. Great ambience.

Amazing food and service. My 3 children have all got Coeliac Disease and they were so accommodating with the menu for them. The food was delicious and the staff are always so friendly and happy. Coffee is excellent to.

Hygiene:(-1/5) The veggies weren’t cleaned probably had a worm on it which was super disgusting. And the some cleaned bowls still got oil stains on them. No wonder they got E grade. Food:(4/5) Their pastries and hot pot were always nice but tonight’s hot pot and BBQ were too salty. Service:(2/5) When we got back home, we found out that they overcharged us a lot and when we paid they didn’t even show us the exact food that we ordered and just told us the money we needed to pay.
One of the best place in Auckland for dumplings.Great Northern Chinese flavour food. Fast and friendly service, very cheap prices.Recommend to anyone.

My go-to place for frozen dumplings 🥟🥟. Making these delicate things at home from scratch can be labour intensive and messy, but ohhh those precious memories of making dumplings with mum and grandma back in the good old days❤️. Whether you are a transitional pork&chive person or a chicken lover, they have it all - including variations of pork, prawn, chicken and vegetables. My favourites are: Fish&Chive and Pork&Cabbage.👏 Boil them for a healthier option or pan fry them for some crispness (1 bag is enough for 2 ppl) - google if you want to know how to make them to perfection; and don’t forget the dipping sauce!👍
Nice people....Great and wholesome food.....to be honest I over ate but it was worth it

A nice chinese fried food takeaway place; and their prices are quite reasonable. Their staff members are practical and efficient, though borderline impatient. Better make your choices fast, otherwise, she'll be annoyed. Their snacks are that good, hence the high rating.

One of our go-to spots whenever we’re craving Thai food! We always order the Thai Style Braised Beef Hot Pot with Tripe. it’s our favorite. The portion is generous and easily feeds two people. The broth is super flavorful, rich, and comforting, and the beef and tripe are perfectly tender. We also tried the Pad Thai, and it was really good — nicely balanced flavors.
Great authentic tasting Thai food. Spicier than your usual neighborhood restaurant, closer to what we've had when we visited Thailand. A bit cramped for larger groups, but for 4 or less a great spot.
Great good. Excellent value for money with generous portions as well. Staff were friendly.

This family-run Thai restaurant since its days at the Mercury hotel food court back in 1999. The pad Thai here is delightful, not sickly sweet with a great balance of sour, sweet and savoury. Let's talk about their beef hotpot – it's a sensation! With every spoonful, you're greeted with a comforting herbal warmth that's perfect for those chilly evenings.The appetizers are always a hit, freshly made without leaving that greasy mouthfeel. I highly recommend trying the Mixed Entree and the Pork Spare Ribs – they're simply irresistible. As for mains, the Sizzling Prawns is a must-try, huge juicy prawns in a sticky savoury and sweet sauce. With its consistent quality and friendly service, this restaurant continues to be my go-to spot for affordable Thai cuisine.

Long wait for meals to arrive, and when they finally did after waiting almost 30mins, 2 of the 5 dishes were wrong....trying to explain to the female worker was a mission as she kept smiling and looking confused as what i was trying to explain. The older man came out and explained to him what we ordered he then fixed the problem and made what we asked for.....by the time we got the correct order the rest of the group had already eaten their meals....overall the food was nice, but sauce in the ribs stir fry was too overpowering....the restaurant is quiet small so not suitable for large groups over 10 people...

The service is so poor and the staffs don't even have the courtesy to add little cheese and veggies. However, when asked to do that they still put so little cheese and say that you will be charged extra. This has not happened only once but a lot of time. Serviettes, they always give only one serviette and when buying a footlong they never pack it in the bag. I bet everyone else experiences this but doesnt wanna speak about it. I really hope this improves not only for us but for everyone .

This isn’t a one time occurrence. This has happened multiple times and today just tipped me off. The staff never put enough of the ingredients in the subs. Always have to be reminded extra and as soon as we get to a decent amount of ingredients they ask whether i’d like to be charged extra. Absolutely horrible service. I ordered a chipotle quesadilla not knowing there was no meat, i proceeded to ask whether there was meat and if they could add any, this was before she put it in the press. Hearing there’s no meat i decided to change my order to a ham and tomato baffle but she said she would not serve me as i’m not buying the sloppy mess they called a quesadilla with barely any reasonable amount of ingredients. If you can eat somewhere else, this subway is rubbish

I went with my friend to this subway. The customer service here is terrible and the subway didn't even have enough ingredients in it and is definitely a waste of money. I also asked for serviets and they treated it like a scarce item that is very rare and only gave us a couple even after we asked for more. Even as we were leaving we heard a person saying they will never eat at this subway and this was the last time. These points need to be improved or they can expect a big loss of customers if they keep it up.

This is by far the worst steak and egg I ever had for breakfast in my entire life. Who would want to eat a microwaved egg and the steak wasn't fresh at all. I would rather pay $5 than $12. The server didn't look like he knows his stuff either. No butter was available either.

Terrible service, terrible food. Whenever I order I HAVE to tell them extra veggies because they never put enough. Even after telling them that they still sprinkle the veggies like salt and tell me they’ll charge me extra for a respectable amount of cheese. These guys. Really need to step up.
Staff friendly and well service

Waited 1 hour 30 minutes for first dish to arrive, which was the smelly tofu (6 small pieces for $12, quite a rip off). Around 2 hours of waiting our 2 mains came, the portion size was average and there was not a lot of meat, the mains were filled with celery and onions. Rice was $4 a bowl???!! There was no service to be had, I was told which table I could go to, and I got the cutlery, plates and water myself. Plates and bowls were all chipped. 3 other tables also complained about the wait time but there was no rush, the owner/chef didn’t really care. This place is a overhyped as they were on a TV show which probably has made them delusional in delulu land… Had to move my car from P120 cause it took so long, very poor experience. Total cost for 2 was $104, taste was average not worth the wait.
Absolutely love this place, it’s the most authentic Hunan cuisine in Auckland. Chef is literally a master, food was delicious (and very spicy)!! highly recommend the fish 🐟

Nice Chinese food and big portions. Reasonably fast response time as well. Food was served within 10-15 mins. Smoked pork with bamboo shoots was great; And also ordered a stir fried chicken item - Dong'an Chicken. Fairly good. One can also try their smelly tofu.

This restaurant serves tasty food that both my husband and I enjoyed. Hunan food is very spicy but they happily toned it back for my husband, who can't handle too much chilli. The menu is very porky but I don't like pork so we tried various other options instead. The smelly tofu entree was suitably pungent and came topped with hot chilli. It was too hot for my husband but just right for me so I hoovered it all up. We also had hot and sour pickled radish, dong 'an chicken and stir fried chicken. All were lovely. The owner was friendly and interested to know what we thought of the food given we were the only non Asian patrons. The only negative - and it's not a big deal - is that the owner was busy in the kitchen when we arrived and it took quite a while before she noticed us standing at the counter. But we didn't mind too much and would happily eat there again.
Absolutely delicious with an amazing chef – highly recommended!

Do you want some good food without emptying our pockets. . We landed at 9:15 pm. It’s a Papa and Mom shop by an elderly couple. Absolutely great. They’re not speak much. You have to pay before you eat, otherwise they won’t start cooking your food. We got the spicy noodle beef soup. The quantity was great. We tried the fried pork bun.. absolutely delicious. . Please don’t look at the any of the other standards by Western Society restaurant culture. If you are hungry and you want some good food this is the place.. . If the ventilation was kept a little more open, I think that would have been great . . They have menu in English and Chinese restaurant on the side .

Hidden Gem! These days with the amount of food reviews and social media posts, restaurants that have the "Hidden Gem" accolade have been diluted. Similar to the raro drinks we were served at primary school. However, this is not the case with this restaurant. Although the interior has seen better days, the most important element (the flavour) still manages to shine through. I Ordered some of the pork buns with low expectations and I was very impressed. The quality of these buns are unmatched and I think it is pobably one of the best in Auckland. It was freshly fried and still extremely succulent on the inside. The middle houses a chunk of pork surrounded in a modest amount of broth. When you combine the meat, breading and soup. This makes it quite a incredible experience. The crunch from the breading followed by the seasoned meat in the middle was spectacular for a cold winters night. I would highly recommend this place for some pork buns if you ever have a craving. Notes: The chef didn't understand much english but the "English menu" is a life saver. Previous reviews mentioned that they do not take cards. This is not the case. They take credit cards and paywave. (Along with cash)

Our takeaway order was as prepared very quickly. Food was very average. Noodles bland and everything very greasy lacking any fresh ingredients. Felt like some bought noodles chucked in the wok with some pre-made sauces with no effort put in and that’s it. At least you get a lot of meals out of it since the greasy food fills you up very quickly. Wouldn’t go there again.

Ordered for takeaway, fast service, great food, we order the wontons, deep fried buns, fried rice and spicy meat and tofu noodles. The noodles were delicious, my partner was so hungry that he at the other dishes before I can even take photos. I really enjoy the noodles.

The owner is a kind old Shanghainese. Their Shengjian mantou/pan fried buns are very authentic flavored , as well as the fried noodles taste tummy! When we miss Shanghainese snacks, we'll definitely come here again.

The food was nice here. I bought chicken fried rice and other stuff. It was big portions and very affordable prices. The food came very fast. Nice customer service. Heaps of table and chairs inside. Open till late.

We recently tried Mt Albert BBQ noodle house and ordered the Beef Fried Rice Noodles, Honey Garlic Chicken, and Deep Fried Hot and Spiced Beef. The portions were generous, making it great value for the price. The beef noodles were flavorful and perfectly cooked, while the hot and spiced beef had a satisfying crunch and a nice kick. The honey garlic chicken was a bit on the sweeter side, but still quite tasty. Overall, it’s a rare find with quality dishes at an affordable price. Definitely worth a visit!
Very good customer service. Price has increased but quality of food and portions are still holding up.

Customer service is excellent. They are patient, polite, and welcome. They listen and explain their food to us well. Food price is cheap and it is served with huge portion. I have never finished all of food by myself. I always ask for containers to take it home. Parking is on the street and it's a bit difficult as you have to do parallel and it is near traffic lights.

I’m a delivery driver, and I’ve noticed that the young man at the front of this restaurant consistently treats delivery workers poorly. Yesterday, when I came to pick up an order from them, I politely asked if I could use the restroom just for 1 minute. He replied, “Go to the public toilet. It’s for customers only.” I don’t think he understands that delivery drivers represent the customers they serve. On top of that, the staff grudgingly handed me the parcel in a very rude manner, without saying a single word. This kind of treatment is really disappointing.

Had the triple C, & chicken boss, flavours great on both but the chicken to bread ratio is way off, needs at least 50% more chicken. Back in the day the chicken portions were probably twice as big. Had the beef boss too, good size pattie but tasted dry and looked grey, can't recommend that unfortunately.

Simple done well. Burger tasted delicious especially with that tasty relish, fresh lettuce and crunchy chicken tenders. Curly fries were crispy and the blue cheese sauce was good. Really tasted like blue cheese. The drinks though, I didn't like very much.

This is the OG of good Burger chains! Haven't been for ages but glad I did. The burgers are so fresh and yum! I know there are so many pop up and mobile "smash burger" joints that are way trendier at the moment, but the ones I've tried aren't as good nor consistent as Burger Wisconsin. I was a bit worried that it looked quiet and just one worker, so get in there and support them. It would be a travesty if they disappeared! No burger chain comes close!

It was a busy night and they were understaffed. They missed a burger we ordered. We got home and were disappointed. Contacted them about the issue and haven't heard anything. This was several months ago. Won't be back.

This was my first time trying Burger Wisconsin and wasnt dissapointed! Although slighty on the higher end of the price scale, i would say it was worth it, especially for the portion sizing. I ordered 2 burgers, 2 Gingerella drinks and a side of onion rings and the total cost was just under 50 bucks. The produce used in these burgers was super fresh and the patties very flavourful and meaty. Parking can be quite difficult here as there is only a few spaces outside so keep this in mind on your vist.

we order from this store for delivery to new windsor and every time it arrives super fast, well earlier than the estimate, and still so hot I can barely hold my slice. absolutely amazing. delicious and generous toppings.
Serves warm food with smiles. The manager Karan is very friendly and professional

This place is hands down the best pizza-hut in auckland. The staff is super nice and are always friendly. The food is always amazing and it is in a convenient location. I have become a regular because of all these reasons. Simply just love the place!
Founded 1958 in Wichita, Kansas, now over 20,000 locations around the world...

The only place I get pizza from these days and just the absolute best - crispy, hot and perfect amount of toppings! The San Francisco Sourdough is perfection! The lady who always serves me is also so lovely and just makes it a 10/10 experience 🍕 ✨

We had a birthday dinner for my mum and the food and drinks were amazing. I had the passionfruit mocktail which was out of this world! Tried a variety of dishes and enjoyed all of them. The pork was succulent, the octopus was soft and delicious. Fish burger and truffle fries with Parmesan to die for. This is a beautiful restaurant atmosphere with excellent food and drink options and would highly recommend

We couldn't be more thrilled that we chose to celebrate my husband's significant birthday at NOMAD restaurant. Phillip, the owner, went out of his way to in helping us select a relevant menu to suit the occasion ( in this case, continuous platters), all while taking into account various dietary requirements of some invitees. The afternoon went better than we could have hoped for. The food was continuous, plentiful, delicious and, to quote our two vegans from Melbourne "the vegan pizzas were the BEST we have ever tasted". We can't praise the staff highly enough. They went out of their way to make sure everyone got their share; placing platters on the appropriate tables, ensuring guests had beverages of their choice, cleaning away empty plates before bringing fresh platters. I especially appreciated how the staff communicated with me all through the event. This ensured that guest had plenty of food and drink and thereby a memorable experience. Our guests were equally as delighted as we were. If it all sounds too good to be true, then this time it was! Thank you to NOMAD and your amazing staff (a special shout out to your chef) from us all.
Went with our two young kids for early dinner. They ate most everything but they use pepper on kid items so ask them to remove if not wanted

Great re-introduction to Nomad under the new management of Phillip & Kevin. These guys are keen to establish Nomad as a hospo go-to for Pt Chev locals & anyone further afield. Really appreciated the improved customer service experience & the pizza we ordered was yum. Highly recommend.
We had a great dinner at Nomad. The Beef Cheek was the best meal I have had anywhere for a long time, truly excellent!

We had a really enjoyable meal at this Thai restaurant and will definitely be coming back. From the moment we arrived, everything was easy and convenient – there’s plenty of parking available at the back, which is always a big plus. The food was clearly freshly made and arrived at the table hot and full of flavour. We ordered the cashew nut chicken and the grilled pork salad. The cashew nut chicken was packed with crunchy vegetables, tender chicken, and just the right amount of sauce – not too sweet, not too salty. The grilled pork salad had a great balance of smoky, spicy, and tangy flavours, and the pork was perfectly cooked. What really stood out was the value for money. The portions were generous and the prices were fair, especially considering the quality of the ingredients and the care put into the cooking. It didn’t feel like a rushed or reheated meal – everything tasted fresh and well-prepared. Overall, it was a great experience with delicious food, friendly service, and convenient parking. Whether you’re popping in for a quick bite or sitting down for a relaxed dinner, this place is worth a visit.

Looking for somewhere to eat tonight in Point Chevalier my friend suggested Sweet Chilli Thai Restaurant in the Great North Road in the block of shops by the zebra crossing. I noticed besides the friendly staff and the clean fresh decor the tantalising aromas emanating from the rear kitchen. I ordered pad Thai and was not disappointed. Fresh, quick, and flavourful, I savoured every bite. I am not a local to this area's food scene but I already know that with the reasonable prices and delicious plates on offer this will soon become a favourite. Highly recommended since 2016.

Never noticed this place before however when walking past, the smell of delicious food pulled us in. The food was fantastic, we had Chicken Green Curry, Thai Style Gao Pad Chicken and one other dish my partner can’t remember the name of. All were so good! The guy serving us had good chat and made dinner really enjoyable. All washed down with a Chang beer made for the perfect dinner. Well priced. Heaps of locals picking up takeaways show it’s really popular so will definitely be back.
$15.50 lunch menu. Wholesome vibe, great portions, super yum. Go and support!
International group dining at nearby Auckland Zoo. Pulled my phone out - read the reviews and had the most enjoyable chicken Green Curry. Superb.
One of the best pita pits I have been to. Salads taste fresh and they dont skimp out on ingredients. Staff are quick and making the pitas. Only thing is it's a bit cold in there in the winter

Ordered take away and food was yummy. Service was great. Yes that’s right under Uber eats this place has many names apart from pita pit, such as bowled and egged. Not sure why, but pita pit is what you can after all.

I was suspicious when the food I ordered from 'EGG'D' on Uber Eats arrived in a Pita Pit bag... After some rudimentary investigation - I discovered the address of this 'EGG'D' was in fact... Pita Pit. I feel very mislead, not only by the very name of the establishment, but by the product pictures. Now I have egg on my face. Please let me explain: There's two things. What I ordered. And what I got. Sure - I was lazy. I'm the first to admit that. Instead of getting up, I chose to remain in my room playing Hogwarts Legacy (it's amazing) on the Playstation. I chose to get Uber Eats and ordered a "warm brioche bun with fluffy scrambled egg, grilled halloumi, smashed avocado, grilled onions and sticky chilli jam". I chose this. I knew I was potentially in disappointment's firing line. But I didn't quite expect it to be the absolute (pita) pits. First of all - not warm. Second of all - if that's fluffy egg then crucio curse me down until I grow some eyes 'cause I'm clearly blind. Third and finally - I get that people take product photos but this thing had a full blown Vogue shoot and I would've been happier with a ham sandwich from Hallensteins.

Purchased 2 chicken and bacon salads @ $22 each and was so looking forward to lunch. Little expensive but it’s not often we buy. Incredibly disappointed, as there was SO much sauce. It drowned out any freshness or flavour of the salad. Perhaps it should be part of the service to ask about how much sauce or offer to put in a container. Both my friend and I could not finish it had been sometime since I had returned to Pita Pit, so won’t be in a hurry to go back. Very disappointed.🫣😟

I ordered 2 falafel pitas , one with instructions extra crispy, however i was told on phone it was for a pick much earlier and pitas were made long back. My mum was at the shop at 6.20pm to pick it up. We live 3mins away from ptchev. When mum came home i saw our pitas fell apart as they were made much earlier. The only good part was the filling.
