Definitely disappointed with the service and i wont go back to pt chev anymore. I only got an apology with a giggle .Had my and mums dinner ruined. I had similar experience with old management.. I would rather drive to Newlynn.

I recently ordered from Hell Pizza Mt Albert and had a solid experience overall. The pizzas are creative and packed with interesting flavor combinations—definitely a step above your typical takeaway chain. The menu is inventive and caters well to different dietary needs, with gluten-free, vegan, and vegetarian options available. Service was efficient and friendly, and the pizzas arrived hot and ready to eat. If you’re looking for a fun, tasty, and reliable pizza option in Mt Albert, Hell Pizza is definitely worth a try.

Have a friend from NZ back home who was adamant that we tried Hell pizza when we visited NZ. We ordered the double size (an American medium) gluten free crust on the gluttony pizza for $26. All of the specialty pizzas are based on the 7 deadly sins. I could see the chef clean the pizza cutter with a paper towel rather than wash with soap and water but I didn't have a lot of other options as a Coeliac. Pizza smelled like a Hawaiian pizza but I didn't actually see or taste any pineapple once opening the box. The toppings were pretty sparse for a pizza called "gluttony." The crust was thin, which is fine because it's gluten free. The lack of toppings would have Americans outraged if this place opened up shop over there. It wasn't bad, but it was mediocre for a pizza. They also have dairy free cheese available at no extra charge. While the pizza is ok, it's not worth writing home about, let alone suggesting to others to eat. I'm rounding up to 3 stars for being able to accommodate dairy free, vegetarians and even vegans on their menu, as well as having gluten free non pizza meals available. Visited February 2023.

So tasty! Love the burger pizza with the vegan meat - it’s nice to have some tasty options to share with omnivores, vegetarians and vegans alike 🍕 ✨ can’t go wrong with the stretched base and there’s a great selection of veggies. Always cooked on time and hot, delicious 👏🏼
We ordered the Serpent pizza, prawn horns, spirit pasta and wedges. Always delicious. Friendly service. Definitely recommended

Thanks to your mail drop yesterday i found your pamphlet and used the free delivery code on it and boy am I happy I did. Incredible pizzas last night guys, big praise from the whanau who enjoyed the large greed pizza and my snack pizza was hot, delicious, juicy and succulent very tasty. The delivery person was great too, nice and pleasant with manners and left the order where it was instructed thank you MOUNT ALBERT store, pic is the snack pandemonium

Tried Nepalese food for the first time at Timmur in Auckland and it was absolutely amazing! The dishes were full of unique and authentic flavors that truly impressed us. The service was excellent, warm, attentive, and made the experience even better. I also loved the Kukhri rum, a perfect touch to the evening. We’ll definitely be coming back and highly recommend this gem to anyone looking for a delicious and memorable dining experience

We were surprised with the size of hte restaurant. Very spacious indeed! The owner was very attentive and very friendly. Feel like we met an old friend. The foods were great as expected for the price we paid. We had a good time. We will definitely return to never before tasted dishes. Highly recommended!

I had authentic Indian & Nepalese curry for the first time in a while, and it was so delicious I ended up eating too much 😂 The curry was amazing of course, but the tandoori momo and garlic naan were especially good!

My first time dining at Timmur. Amazing food great flavours. Recommend canon shots and the momos chucking dumplings and special house spicy sauce. Topped off with friendly polite service. Definitely 💯 recommended.

I have seen this place on chasing a plate and me and my friend decided to try this wonderful place. The food is very flavourful and a great introduction to Nepali cuisine. Definitely worth trying. Coming back again

Score: 78/100 Tonight BBQ is a hidden gem when it comes to Chinese BBQ. The portions are incredibly generous, and the quality of the food far exceeds what you'd expect for such affordable prices. The flavors are on point, making it a standout choice for anyone craving authentic BBQ. However, one thing that struck me as odd was how quiet the restaurant was, especially considering the high-quality food it serves. It's a bit of a mystery why this place isn't more popular—it truly offers outstanding value for money. If it gained more recognition, I’d be curious to see how much busier it could get. I highly recommend giving it a try—you won’t be disappointed!

Guys. Most underrated place but the food, the atmosphere was so lovely. It’s so affordable. In comparison to Gogo, i like this place more. I regret not going here before, but now i know what should i do🤩 must go. Must try: numbingly hot chicken if you’re a spicy lover.
Food is amazing; however, the host did not know how to speak English, making it very hard to communicate while ordering food. We received a free drink because we ordered the bundle menu.

We always drive pass this place and finally tried it out. Very spacious when you walk in and nice n tidy. Side dishes were yummy, loved the cucumber salad probably one of the best I've tried at a Chinese BBQ restaurant. I would have to say the BBQ pork belly screwers were a bit dry & small slice's, however the warmers on the table was good to keep them warm. Prices were reasonable & food was yummy, so I would come back. Thank you for the feed.

Check out this new eatery! We had a great lunch there today. The place is clean, tidy, and has a nice quiet atmosphere. The service was excellent; the young lady who took our order was friendly, and the chef personally brought out our oysters, which was a nice touch. We ordered two mains and some oysters, which were steamed and topped with garlic, spring onion, and vermicelli—absolutely delicious. We also tried a few skewers, including chicken knee, chicken feet, gizzards, and an extreme spicy chicken nibble. The spicy chicken is seriously hot, so beware if you’re not into heat! Overall, our meal came to $60 for two people, which is quite reasonable. There’s also parking available at the back. We can’t wait to go back and highly recommend giving this place a try!
Sushi is always fresh and everything tastes delicious. I've been here a couple of times and the quality of food and service are always 👌💯 Staff are very friendly and smiley.

Went with my friends to have some japanese food. So i tried their Tuna sushi and salmon sushi. Taste was very good. My friends ordered chicken donburi (not halal). Staff is very kind and helpful. Thank you. 😊
Good option to have you lunch at United offer free miso soup for customers

The sushi was bomb but I ordered a salmon terakaki was horrible, didn't even taste like teriyaki and the salmon was not tasty. The sushi is amazing and the service was great but I'm only giving 3 starts for the donburi. Would honestly like a refund for it.
Good quality for a reasonable price. Friendly staff.

It’s a best value and delicious takeaway in this area. The food is still hot when you get it. The fried food is crispy on the outside and soft inside. The chips are the soft tasty I like. It’s recommended to order the fried noodles, they're crispy with sauce, the vegetables and meat are not stingy. I ate it at noon, and went to buy it again for dinner. This store looks unremarkable, but it is really worth a special trip to try.

Just yum! I got the drum sticks n potatoes!! So soft n chicken was juicy. Also got the meat n rice from their new menu. For the price n freshness you can't beat GREEN JADE. The guy at the front taking orders is quick n efficient too. 10/10

Yum! Went on two separate occasions and both times got the $17 special, to my surprise both times I got given an extra potato fritter. Their Chinese BBQ is on the expensive side. And they have a shocking amount to staff working there, shows how popular this takeaway is.

My go-to Chinese takeaway when I'm back home, budget friendly, can feed a big bunch of coconuts for a good price. Love the sweet and sour wontons here. I get the sauce separate from the wontons. There are great options with the trays of Chinese and doing half and half on a tray. Efficient service from the young fulla at the front. Defs get it in ya!

[BBQ Pork Fried Rice] & [Vegetable Cow Mein] Typical Chinese takeaway food. As you can see the photos, the amount of food they give you is quite generous. However, there was no flame flavor. You know that taste when you cook the food in the wok with the crazy heat you get that charcoal/fire flavor. Overall it was ok.
Delicious Kai/ food and awesome kawhe/coffee. Owners are so friendly and always greet with a smile. 100% recommend.

Best little spot in Avondale for a kawhe & kai. This is our regular spot especially on Thursday where they have their mates rates deal. BEST toasties!!! Friendly and welcoming kaimahi ☺️ 10/10 👌🏽 Great energy & vibes 💯
A great place to get an awsome meal with a hot drink, very friendly and service focused!
Ol’ Mate is one of the best coffee spots in West AKL (let alone AKL as a whole!). Great staff, grilled sandos, Supreme Coffee, and viiiiibes 🤙

Easy 5 Stars. High marks on the design, so cute, totally adorable. The colour scheme is perfect: bright and happy. Coffee is great, and the sandwiches are incredible, a whole meal in one sandwiches, yummy flavourful Samoan delights. This is a treat of a cafe, and the girls running it, do it proud.

I recently visited Indigo Restaurant in Avondale, and it was a fantastic experience. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, with a modern touch that perfectly complements the authentic Indian flavors they offer. The staff were attentive and friendly, making the whole dining experience feel special. The menu had a great variety of vegetarian options, each dish bursting with rich, aromatic spices. The flavors were perfectly balanced, and the portions were generous, making it a great value for the quality. The naan and freshly made rotis were a standout, perfectly complementing the curries. Overall, it’s a must-visit if you’re looking for delicious, authentic Indian cuisine with excellent service. I’ll definitely be coming back!

From the moment we walked in, the warm and inviting atmosphere made us feel right at home. The food was absolutely exceptional, with each dish bursting with fresh flavors and beautifully presented. The service was attentive and friendly, making our evening truly memorable also all staff nature is awesome. Thanks for brilliant services.
Excellent service and atmosphere was amazing full chilling Indian vibes with a perfect test of Indian food must visited restaurant

Ordered Masala Dosa for takeaway. They charged $18 for the quantity you can see in the photo (especially the sambar & chutney). This is not a restaurant which is value for money. The taste is also very mediocre. Won't recommend this restaurant at all

Finally visited Indigo after all the hype we got from our friends and relatives. Owner was friendly and accommodating. But when asked for Unlimited Pani puri he said, it’s only available outside the restaurant, where the table next to us were given special service and they were enjoying it inside. We ordered quite a few dishes. Food was amazing. Ambience was great.

Excellent spot for a Saturday morning coffee and brunch and quite well priced. We had filter coffees, the chilli eggs & omelette and a side of hash sticks. Everything was delicious. Little bit of a wait for food but it was super busy and everything is prepared fresh so not a big deal to us. Highly recommend.

I had heard such great things about this spot and the recommendations did not disappoint. If you’re looking for a cozy, comfy cafe - this is the spot. I asked the chef for recommendations and the chilli fried eggs absolutely hit the mark (however I don’t think you could go wrong with any of the options). Each element was cooked to perfection with a flavour balance that was considered and complimentary. Will definitely be back for more 🌶️🍳👌🏼

To summarise my experience. No flat whites are available here, only filter coffee. Bohemian, hippie,hipster, perhaps homeless. Felt a bit like a cafe, trying to be vegan whilst serving 🥓 bacon 🥓 Yours sincerely Karen 😆. But seriously, my wife and I have eaten in restaurants and cafes all around the world. Maybe the chef was having a bad day 🤔. Sadly, we won't be going back.

This place is amazing. Everything from the food, service, decor, cutlery, crockery, all of it. So bloody good. I'm from Melbourne, a place known for great cafes. I'm travelling throughout NZ and this has been my most favourite, standout breaky! Well done and thank you.

Took a while to get my meal but worth the wait. Everything made from scratch. Best cafe meal I've had in a long time. And the filter coffee was just right. Also took home a couple of cheese scones - sooo good.

Really delicious food specially the pav bhaji, perfect blend of all spices, freshly cooked very tasty and well presented. Overall a good meal and great value of your money, will certainly be ordering back. They also do catering for the events and parties they cook on the same day for you which is exciting as you can get the fresh food & real Indian flavour from your dishes.
Really delicious test, authentic india flavour in Vadapav, also order some Panipuri which just remind me india street food, Highly recommend very fair price.
Awesome Vadapav. Very different than usual. Perfectly Indian taste. Pavbhaji is great and buttery as well. 10 out of 10
Was a great experience...People who reading this, give it a try....Their food items are authentic and full of flavors. Good quality, Good price..💯
Nice and very tasty
It's absolutely declicious! I've ordered the ribs meal 3x on Uber Eats - highly recommend :)
Excellent service , love the steak dishes I recommend the service and food quality 🫡

If I could give these guys 6 stars I would. Hands down the best burgers in Auckland, I’ve been to pretty much all of them now. It literally puts me in a great mood for the day every time I come. The owner is a great guy and ensures you’re well looked after! This is the Cowgirl such a well balanced bbq burger so so tasty!

First time here. Flavourful burgers, meat patties juicy. Ordered the Cowgirl double combo. Would recommend for this burger to slightly lay off the BBQ a touch was overpowering the patty flavour. Onion rings were crisp inside the burger. Would re visit to try other burgers on menu. Quick efficient service with a smile. 💯

Can't believe I forgot to do a review for you guys. My friend that moved away demanded we come here for a meal. He said "it is the best burger I've ever had in my life". I was skeptical but now that I've been craving this all the time I'd tend to agree. This is the best burger I've ever had in my life also. Thank you the fantastic people that run the place.

Love this place. The way they do it is just how I like my burger! No fuss but full of flavour. Staff were also very friendly and accommodating. One of the best burgers I’ve ever had. Highly recommend Baby G burgers.
We had two cheeseburgers and one Oklahoma Dreamings. They are super delicious. The patty is juicy and well-seasoned and the size of the burger is decent. Definitely coming back again for more

Parking 🅿️ outside entry but can get busy as a bakery and laundry share. No bathroom no dining in just stools to sit and wait for orders. There is a surcharge on paywave. I ordered the chicken drum stick breast and chips with the butter honey sauce. Big size portions and hot big chips or wedges. Delicious 😋

Most of the staff members are attentive, friendly, and patient. They are also kind, accommodating, and friendly to children. The chicken pieces are crispy, flavourful, and quite moist. Definitely more reliable than the nearby KFC. They have parking spaces but can get really busy and occasionally double parked. Sometimes it takes awhile to wait them making the chickens and the fries. They do tell you how long will it take so that you can decide.

Customer service was an A+. Lovely lady. I had the lunch box special. 1 thigh, 1 drum stick & chips for approx $10. The chicken was full of flavour, fresh and well cooked. The hot chips are my fave, so much salted chicken flavor in them. Careful if you're prone to gout, though, lol. Overall I would recommend 👌 Edit: Went back couple days later... I guess it depends on who you have as the cook? Definitely not as good as the first experience.
Had the chefs special burger with chips both were delicious I just wish they were a little more generous on the spicy sauce but allgood

6 piece Pack, 4 drums & 2 thighs & chips... Skin was crumbly, greasy & had some weird curry spice... Mouth had that baking soda aftertaste... Had high hopes from the ratings but 'Totally' disappointed... Sensational Chicken still the benchmark...
Really nice people who run the place. Cheap prices and very good food. Ginger Fish and curry chicken is recommended 👍

Unfortunately the chicken nibbles were extremely salty. 😕 for $36 for a whole tray of 40 I deeply regret this purchase. A bit of a drive to return it. 😩only because Shens takeaway was closed today I decided to try this place. Sorry but these were not good. Just need to adjust that saltiness of the chicken nibbles because it's way too much salt.
I love this place. They've recently raised their prices and they're still a bargain. 20 pack chicken with chips for $19. Their deals are affordable and quick service.

No disrespect, but by far the worse takeout I've ever had. Ordered fish&chips and sausages. Including a tub of fried rice, sweet&sour pork, egg foo yong, 1 lamb flap. -Fish was mostly batter. -Chips were drowning in oil. -Fried rice tasted old -Sweet&sour pork barely had any meat and was hard. -egg foo yong tasted like raw egg and was soggy. -lamb flap was chewy and hard to swallow. This place needs attention and improvement. This would prevent losing customers. I will not be returning.
I ordered chips None of their chips are uniformly cooked.Hardly find any long chips all are broken bits short sized .Not happy at all

Small takeaway very Chinese and polynesian delicacies chicken pieces fried flounders, lamb shank if you enjoy then this is the place. it's a nice place to stop in and check it out reasonably priced it's not full dining place .. Just 2 small tables if you want to eat in.

Home to the best lamb ribs in Auckland. A close friend recommended this place to Me and I have been coming for years. The prices are so reasonable it’s not even funny and they are a family owned business so you know they are in it for the long run. Sterling Arnet Kakapo Business Sales
Pork belly is tender and melts in your mouth and pig head and lamb pieces are the best
We always keep coming back for our fave take aways. Love the food, love the service!
A reasonably good takeaway outlet friendly staff limited parking and on a busy main street. Prices affordable
The best island food eatery in West Auckland. Great service and awesome community-focused atmosphere 👏

I WISH I COULD PUT A LOWER SCORE BUT UNFORTUNATELY I CANT. firstly these are the rudest people you will ever meet and the worse food you could ever eat. Also whoever was driving their truck needs to learn how to drive properly. Almost killed me and then flipped me off

♿ A good samoan polynesian store to buy the cooked and baked foods 😋 Popular place to get your island style lunches or dinner. Fish tail pork kebab curry etc Pork buns taro and bananas green or cooked. They also provide catering service's I buy the panikekes and chop suey always satisfying.

The bestest Palusami eva!, Super Awesome service always greeted with a smile. My dad's to go place for island food, he passed away almost a year ago, and I find myself traveling from the Northshore for my Daddy treats from here more often then usual....its that super Delicious, I have to take it easy cos I've put on not pounds but Kg's 🤣🤣 ummmm! I think I better go visit again this wkend lololol, gonna pre order so not to miss out hee hee

This morning I was craving for my favorite food so I popped in to my favorite store and was greeted with the aroma of the islands and of course the beautiful ladies cooking and serving there,the beautiful samoan girl with gold tooth and long lashes smiling and ask me what I wanted to buy,I smile back and ask for two serving of salt beef,and four bananas and my favorite dessert of pineapple cream pie,she kindly packed my food and sed thank you please come again and have a beautiful day 🌞 I got home blessed my food and thank the lord for everything,I ate my food and went back to sleep 😂😁cos that's how delicious the food was ❤️I can't wait to visit my store again 😋

Missing my mums island cooking I popped down to Malu's and sure enough got more then my money's worth...Salads, Turkey, LAMB chops, and THEIR INFAMOUS LAMB BUNS and tropical punch with many more options like Pancakes, Curry, Taro all the island staples!! I LOVE THAT THEY ALSO SELL FRESH RAW KOKO &ISLAND SNACKS STRAIGHT FROM MY HOMELAND OF SAMOA. The ambience is family friendly and quick, clean service with a smile !! Highly recommend😘🍹🥩🍗

Bought a yummy roasted half a Pig Head and a piece of Taro. It was so delicious the crackle was crunchy and tasty. The fat trickled down my throat no worries the cheek meat was exquisite 👌 😋. I will return yum yum 😋.

If you love your island food this is the place to come to My dad's favorite place to buy his island style cravings Green bananas taro with coconut cream chop suey , lamb flaps ,fried flounder..Small intimate store 2 Small table's to sit.
We stop here occasionally for some Pasifika kai. The lamb flaps and boiled banana. Yummm

Never thought I would leave a bad review but this place is absolutely atrocious. Terrible food, couldnt even eat it properly the taro, green banana and chop suey all tasted so off- ended up just binning it

Went to Frat’s after quite a long time & was amazed to see they’ve introduced some new combo deals for Sunday to Thursday! Prices have dropped too! 2 pizzas with chips and drinks for just $55, and 3 pizzas for $70. That’s a great deal. We tried their Nutella pizza, the chicken and artichoke pizza, and the mushroom and ricotta pizza. All were absolutely delicious!

Tried three different pizzas - Hawaiian, Puttanesca, and Salami. Each one was absolutely delicious and had a perfect crunch! The Hawaiian and Salami were especially outstanding, simply too good! 👍 5/5

This what my garlic bread looked like ABSOLUTELY 0 cheese or garlic it’s just straight sourdough. Pizza was nice but not worth 27$. The atmosphere is average I was going to sit down and saw a moldy lemon in a basket. Not great.
Very yummy sourdough pizza, tasty itself by using sourdough based and topping is just amazing divine tastes. Best pizza in Auckland so far. Love it

Pizzas were good, the basic selection can be added to with extras. Would not recommend as a dine in venue. The benches have very thin cushions covered in crumbs. The toilets are clean. They are more set up for takeaways.
Staff here is really friendly. Some Customers were being rude though just because its too long of line and staff was not performing on superhuman level. give dem a break.
Great place. As part of the wider nerwork works the best when you're commuting a lot.
End your coffee cravings from here
Great Mocha

Never judge a book by its cover, or a banh mi by a poor photo! Banh mi Delights Avondale in Auckland is my last stop on my Banh mi adventure of NZ, and with changing plans comes a quick google search and a random Banh mi lunch stop. I wasn’t sure what I was going to get but the recent reviews seems pretty good. And for good reason, packed with punch this was. Lemongrass beef with extra chilli and my tastebuds were singing. Glad my plans changed. 👏
I've been meaning to try this Vietnamese food caravan for a while now, so clad today I did. I had the beef Banh MI and wow! It was great. I can't wait to sample more of there menu. Yummy!!

The beef noodle was better than most with a pinch of spiciness but a bit pricey at NZD 17. The rice spring rolls were a bit chewy but portion were bigger than most @ NZD 10. The stall is a not in a shop lot but operated as a food truck with only 1 small table with 2 chairs for dine in.
Very delicious and cheap bahn mis. Perfect amount of sauce and has a nice kick too. Highly recommend 👌🏼
Delicious pho, probably the closest i’ve tasted in NZ to the pho I had in Vietnam and the service was wonderful. The lady was so sweet, can’t wait to come back for the bahn mi

We came here for dinner and again for lunch. The restaurant was not too big but has a pleasant environment. Their service was good and friendly. As for the dishes they were tasty and of good serving. From the photos, there are two small dishes and they were complimentary and they tasted good too. The prices were very reasonable. We will definitely be going back for the other dishes. No problem parking.

I enjoy the dumplings here more than all the other places in Auckland. Great flavour in the filling and cooked to perfection. The chefs really focus on quality and it shows. The non dumpling dishes are also all great. Great flavour and well seasoned. Not BYO though

Excellent online order system, easy parking, reasonable price and generous portion but sadly too salty for me. As it’s next to Lim Asian supermarket, it has convenient location but I personally don’t like the strong smell from the butchery in front. Update: shredded pork with garlic and spicy pork dumplings were good whereas mapotofu was very oily and watery.
So many authentic northern Chinese dishes! Loved them and enjoyed the service! Their buns are a must try!

Fantastic flavours!!! LOVED the spicy braised lamb noodle soup and really enjoyed the juicy fried pork dumplings! Yum - can’t wait to try more from their menu :) Really nice decor and friendly staff ⭐️

When craving for your comfort food. Authentic Filipino Dish. Ambience isn't that bad. Price seems affordable Great for group or family diners. Staff are very kind. Live band on Fridays and Saturdays (wife and I went Sunday so was a bit more quiet at the time which was my preference). They're not easy to find though, use Google direction. We had Sinigang na Bangus and Sizzling Pork (Pork Sisig), not bad.

Homecooked in Auckland was the first restaurant me and my husband dined at during our very first visit to New Zealand, and it set the bar incredibly high. From the moment we walked in, we were greeted with warm smiles and an ambiance that felt both cozy and inviting—a true reflection of the name "Homecooked." The menu offered a delightful array of options that catered to different tastes while focusing on wholesome, home-style cooking. We were impressed by the freshness of the ingredients, which was evident in every bite. Each dish was thoughtfully prepared, with flavors that were comforting yet sophisticated. It felt like a home-cooked meal but elevated to restaurant quality, which is precisely what we were hoping for. The service was impeccable. The staff were attentive without being intrusive, ensuring we had everything we needed to enjoy our meal to the fullest. They were also very knowledgeable about the dishes and were happy to make recommendations, which we truly appreciated as newcomers to the area. One of the highlights of our experience was the dessert—a perfect way to end our meal. It was clear that the chef put as much love and care into the sweets as they did into the main courses. The dessert was not just a treat for the taste buds but also beautifully presented. In terms of value for money, Homecooked delivered. The portions were generous, and the quality of the food made every dollar spent feel worth it. It's rare to find a place that strikes such a perfect balance between quality, service, and price, but Homecooked managed to do just that. As our first dining experience in New Zealand, Homecooked left us with a lasting impression and set a wonderful tone for the rest of our trip. We can't wait to return and would highly recommend this gem to anyone looking for a meal that feels like a warm embrace from home, no matter where you're from.

A bit on the pricey side but that's expected, portion was a bit small. We ordered sisig $19 (single) - there's too much onion mixed in; kare-kare $26 (single) - peanut taste was there but too soupy; turon - was too small for $12. Plenty of parking outside.
Poor customer service, not sure what went wrong why the lady serving us looks upset. BBQ 10/10 Sisig 6/10 (they made the egg fried and it’s a bit oily) Crispy Pata 10/10 Sinigang 8/10 Kare Kare 8/10
we ordered pansit for take out. unfortunately, some of the shrimp was already spoiled 😒 you can tell by the taste. Also, "ate" on duty is not happy serving us, she was like 🤨.

Ordered through ORDER MEAL. My order was not even ready because his phone screen is broken and could not see it! How can you operate if you don't have the basic tools to see the order!!! Food is always yummy, but service is terrible! No compensation or apology for having to wait 25mins after my original pickup time, I ordered kebab on rice, they had no rice, so he asked what I wanted instead, I asked what are my options if no rice, he replied chips, I said well obviously chips since that is the only option!!! Horrible service

Proper delicious kebab spot 💯🔥 Great service, succulent meats, luscious sauces and healthy salads all served in generous portions with beautifully balanced flavours. Hot, crispy, tasty food late night and served with a smile. Such a great place, such good food.

Welcoming and friendly customer service, delicious and fresh meals served!! I thoroughly enjoyed my chicken on rice with my chips. Stayed Nice and hot right up until I reached home. Reasonably priced as well.

Ordered a lamb kebab combo on Uber Eats today and they forgot the chips and drink. Uber refuses a refund for these items. Kebab was good but shit service so won’t order again as they can’t get a simple order right

Awesome food truck in the heart of Mt Albert. I got the chicken kabab combo with fries and soft drink for $20, a good deal, full of flavour and big meals. Friendly service and fast. Will definitely be back, highly recommend!

After a late night session at Paradice ice skating it was 11 pm and we were looking for a good place to eat, came across this shop and it was absolutely delicious, great customer service, affordable food, delicious. I wasn’t expecting too much as it was almost midnight but I have to say the smash chicken burger was the best chicken burger iv ever tasted. We ordered a smash chicken burger and a strawberry milkshake and I'm not even joking the strawberry milkshake was the best iv ever tasted I don’t usually like strawberry flavour drinks but it was very good. I very much recommend.
Best Indian style burgers ever! Huge variety of food, good quality and portions for the price. Will definitely be coming back 🤗🤗

Lovely hidden gem in Avondale. This food truck is truly amazing. Big fan of the biryani and samosas. Lot of vegetarian options that are delicious. Nice fresh food and the flavours and spices are just the best. Also, very friendly and fast service. Excellent food stop after a rough working day. Highly recommended!

Very cheap and good food! They gave a generous amount for just $10–12, which is great value. The biryani was especially tasty — flavorful and well-cooked. Definitely a solid spot if you're looking for good food without spending much

Small food truck just past the Avondale/Mt Albert intercetion. Only 1 carpark I front of the bus stop. A quick grab on the way home. Was well worth it! Service was good and the food was delicious! Especially the spicey curly fries! A must try!!! The Tandori burger and Beef burgers were awesome! Nice for something a little different from the usual burger take out. Worth a try as a yummy quick grab or late night munchies! 😋 👍

I like the food and service here, just that the location is surrounded by a few homeless people. Otherwise, just like any other Cantonese restaurants, I love the dishes here. Very abundant and large portions for sharing. My favourite dish this time, will be the Tofu Caserole.
Very busy restaurant. Had lovely dinner there. Nice business owner. Food was pretty good.
Comes with food on carts, which is always nice. Good quality; not the best place in Auckland, but don't hesitate to go if you're in the neighbourhood. The half eaten photos are a sign of quality.

The Yacht Chinese Restaurant in Avondale used to be much busier, often packed with Chinese tour groups enjoying their meals. While the crowds may have thinned, the restaurant still offers a decent experience, particularly for yum cha lovers, though it’s not without its shortcomings. The yum cha here is good and meets expectations. The variety of dim sum on offer is what you would expect from a Chinese restaurant of this caliber, and the flavors are satisfying. The dishes, such as the har gow (shrimp dumplings) and siu mai (pork dumplings), are well-prepared. However, while the quality is there, I found that the pricing leans toward the higher side, making it not the most affordable option for regular dining. One thing that stood out during my recent visit was the lean pork congee with century egg (皮带瘦肉粥). Traditionally, this dish is served with fried dough sticks (油条) on the side, adding that nice crunchy texture to complement the smooth congee. However, when we ordered it, we noticed that the dough sticks were missing. When we inquired about it, the waitress informed us that they simply don’t include them. It seemed a bit unusual, and I couldn’t help but wonder if this was a cost-saving measure. Congee without 油条 feels incomplete, so that was a bit of a letdown. Overall, the dining experience was enjoyable, though not exceptional. The restaurant does a good job of maintaining its standards, but small details like missing traditional elements can impact the experience. Since I live quite far away, it’s hard to justify returning frequently, especially with the slightly higher prices. If you’re in the area and craving some decent yum cha, The Yacht is a solid option, though be prepared for a slightly higher bill than expected.

Very nice Chinese food!! 😋 Good service from our friendly waitress. Robbie the manager was also very friendly. We ordered four courses. The stand-out course being the Braised Lamb with Ginger and Spring Onions on a Hot Plate. 😋 Their signature Pork Dish was also nice. We look forward to dining here again soon!! 🤗

LOVE IT! And will definitely come back! I believe what makes this store special is the hospitality of the staff. They teach their customers how the dishes are eaten. Trust them when they say to mix their Elote and cilantro to their tacos. It elevates the tacos' flavor profile on a different level! They definitley know how to make diners enjoy and experience their awesome food at its best! Thanks bros and all the best! Rad!🤙🤙

I went into Tokos Tacos and expected good stuff. I was surprised and got excellent! The taco Thursday special chicken tacos where tender with just the right amount of spices, then when you add the hot sauce that comes on the side it explodes to something even better. I also tried the Birria meat taco and it tasted amazing, the meat melted in my mouth with the delicious sauce that made it go to the next level. To top it off I had a Mangoritta that was a mix of sweet and citrus that hit the spot every time. The staff where very welcoming and nice to deal with, that made the great food even better! Best tacos in New Zealand and the best I have ever tasted!

Broke boy tacos got nothing on these guys! No cap! Came all the way from South Auckland with the boys to get birria tacos and they were onnnn. When they suggest the fish tacos, make sure you get it. Trust me, the fish tacos are heaven sent!!! If you think the foods good, their hospitality and service is way better. Family owned business and they know what they’re doing. Come down and support your local small business. Get the elote as well—you won’t be disappointed. For the toko, you have got to get a store to South Auckland for sure! I’d be in every week and more traffic for sure in SA! Ofas boys!

Loved this place! My partner and I got the fish and birria taco meals, plus the elote (mild) on the side. First off, the hospitality and friendliness of the workers made us feel very welcomed, and the food was served within a few minutes. The tacos were so delicious, flavourful and just the right level of crunchy, especially when combined with the spicy sauce (had a pretty substantial kick!) and dipping broth. A bit messy to eat, but that's what you get when you order tacos. The elote reminded us of corn cheese with a bit of a kick to it, and was great to have alongside the tacos. Overall, our only downside was that after we had finished all the food - we wanted more! We would 100% recommend if you want to indulge yourself in a hearty meal, so you should definitely pay these guys a visit - just make sure to order extra!

The staff are so nice here, absolutely amazing customer service. Came all the way from Sydney and they are the best tacos I’ve ever had I always tried the elote and the serving size was amazing for the price and was the best I’ve had too. Highly recommend will be coming back again!!

I find the guy that cleaned the fish extremely annoying because he never cleans the scale of the fish probably, sometimes he just threw the fish towards you like he hates his job dearly bur fish is fresh but wont go there because of the guy that cleaned thw fish
There butcher horrible.They do not know how to cut and clean the fish.They throw the fish.zero customer service.please tell them to do well and nice 😈
The customer service is bad but the fish and seafood sold are quite fresh. You can still find other shops with similar items that are cheaper. Go there if you don't have a choice.
Fresh fish with great price. The lady with the short hair at the counter is so friendly but the fat old man in the office is a bit loud
Phenomenal noodles all around. The spicy lamb noodle is one of the best dishes I’ve ever had in Auckland!!
Spicy lamb cumin burger with coriander and chilli. It's more like a thick pita. Decent amount of lamb for the price. It's not huge, but it's enough and definitely tasty. It's not very spicy either.
Best spicy noodles in Auckland, love the oily taste. Arguably the best spicy noodles in Auckland. Deeply underrated. So flavourful . The flavor is just so deep and addictive

I'm very (very) partial to Xi'an cuisine as it is my hometown cuisine and I used to come here all the time but they've been surpassed by so many other newer joints! Maybe I didn't order their signature dishes but the latest time I tried them they failed to match the competitors' offerings! Nice homely feed if you are nearby but the spicy beef noodles didn't taste spicy at all and the soup base was rather bland. The prices aren't really any cheaper than other places and they don't accept credit card payment.
Good cold noodles (Liang pi), the same as I remembered from the same restaurant 16 years ago. Good value at lunch special with a big glass of soy milk

this is what i needed at 2AM packing for my flight. i ordered meat on hot chips plus hot chips with butter chicken & dayum is it good. eating rn while giving this review cs damn. are y’all hiring for a food taster 😭🙏🏽

Disappointing. The chicken was not at all “flame grilled kebab” style - it tasted like it was boiled then covered in too many flavours and reheated after being on a skillet a bit. The spices were like Cajun - too sweet and saucy with a powdery taste… which isn’t what you want from Kebab meat. You want to taste the flame and for the chicken to be sliced off the stick and flash fried before being served. Not reheated after being in a saucy tub. It was like the ‘flavoured chicken’ you get in packets from the supermarket - the flavours were overpowering. The chips were also very soggy. We didn’t finish it.
Food is so fulfilling and no compromise on the quantity at a reasonable price - we had vegetarians options and they were equally yummy
I ordered through uber. My drink never arrived. So missed off. Waited 1 hour to get my food and can't get the full order. Seriously.

My local. For over a year now normally Uber eats it but have now moved even closer so going in store now. The Chicken on rice is full of fresh salads, generous serving of humus and sauces. Chicken is juicy and delicious. Seen a couple bad reviews but I would say would’ve been an off day. I guess they work till 2am every night they work hard. But for me they’ve never let me down my favourite kebab place in Auckland.

Solid mixed meat on chips, lamb on chips, lamb kebab and chicken kebab. Meat was tasty, kebabs were full of meat and lots of fresh salad. Garlic yoghurt sauce lacked the usual garlicky goodness. Chilli sauce had a good kick. Big portions. Jalapeno bites were decently spicy. Friendly staff.

Friendly, patient and accommodating owner operator, and the shop opens until early morning. The kebab is full of flavours, and nicely cooked. Whether it's a wrap or on rice, they are all yummy and must try. Prices are reasonable and portion is not too bad. Parking in the evening is definitely a challenge.

Honestly the food was good but I was hungry and in a hurry, and couldn’t finish my samosa because the bottom half was still frozen. That was a little frustrating but the top warm half was good at least. I did love the baklava and the prices were fine.

Absolutely delicious food! The shawarma I had was full of flavour and the chicken and lamb was tender. The wings for me are my favourite, it’s consistently perfectly cooked, has a smoky flavour along with the sauces of hot chilli and garlic yoghurt which pairs really well with the wings. The chef can guarantee that if you don’t like it you eat get to eat for free. Excellent customer service, support the brother at the store! Can’t wait for my next visit, I highly recommend the wings to everyone 🙌🏼

Place was open late and into earlies of the morning. Was very cheap but I got what I paid for. Sauces were meh and the chicken didn’t really have a taste. Convenient as everything else nearby was closed. Quality is definitely reflected in the price.

I Tried the Chicken Korma and it was pure comfort in a bowl. The chicken was tender and the sauce was rich, creamy, and perfectly balanced with mild spices. Not too heavy, just the right touch of sweetness and warmth. A must-try if you love creamy curries

Restaurant Review: Sages, Pt Chev! My friend and I were on the hunt for some authentic Indian food, so we decided to try Sages in Pt Chev. The restaurant boasts a nice, clean environment, and we were greeted warmly by a friendly waitress with a smile—always a good start. I ordered the Chicken Vindaloo with garlic naan, while my friend opted for the Matter Methi Malai with cheese naan. The Matter Methi Malai looked delicious at first glance, but to our surprise, it contained scrambled paneer, which wasn’t mentioned on the menu. When we brought this to our waitress's attention, she was quick to apologize and confirmed with the chef that it had indeed been added. Thankfully, neither of us had a paneer allergy, but it was concerning that this important detail was omitted from the menu. As for the Chicken Vindaloo, I must say I was quite taken aback. It resembled a Manchurian soup with chicken rather than the rich, spicy dish I had anticipated. It was a far cry from what I expected when ordering a vindaloo. On a positive note, the cheese naan was exceptional—possibly the best I've had in Auckland! Overall, I left Sages feeling disappointed. While the ambiance and service were commendable, the food did not meet our expectations, and the miscommunication about the paneer was concerning. Unfortunately, I don’t think I’ll be returning to this restaurant.

The Fish Tikka was soft, juicy, and had a nice smoky flavor. The spices were just right — tasty but not too strong. The mint sauce was fresh and cool, and it went really well with the fish. Light, delicious, and full of flavor. A great choice if you like fish!
Best narm bread out ,& butter chicken 100% would come back again a
Really good food! The butter chicken was delicious and full of flavor. Garlic naan was soft and tasty. Great place to eat — I’ll definitely be coming back.

This place offers somehow authentic Cantonese food in the nearby suburb, food is good (not great), rice dish a bit salty and desert is a bit too sweet. But it offers steam healthy option, which is not easily available in the area.

Their business is always good！Restaurant is well established, staff speaking Cantonese, their soup is quite nice and ready for your choice. Daily special set menu is another good choice. Food is delicious of course.

We had lunch at this restaurant today. It's was just a small Chinese restaurant but pleasant and spacious. Ther service was as expected. The food was tasty. We enjoyed the lunch. We will definitely return to try other dishes. If you intend to have some simple Chinese food, we recommend that you drop in to this restaurant.
The food was decent but not as “Hong Kong” style as the restaurant name suggests. I would recommend the Chinese soup though!
Braised Beef Brisket Noodle Soup $20...
The food was amazing, if you're looking for the Italian food without going to Italy then this is the place. I can't wait to return.
A wonderful pet friendly, homely feeling place to eat. 😊 If you haven't tried this place yet, then trust me when I say you need to. ✨️

Beautiful setting. Great vibes and the service was wonderful. I had the fettuccine and beef cheek gnocchi and omg was I impressed. I had the chance to meet the owners and how amazing was she and her husband 10/10 restaurant.. Highly recommend. Thanks Papas eatery can’t wait to visit again 🙏🏽😌

Food was YUM. Gayle and her husband are fantastic. Great pizzas. Good portion sizes. We spent quite a bit on food but that’s because it was a special occasion and also because we’re Polynesian. Overall experience was excellent. Highly recommend.

We were really looking forward to trying this place after hearing good things, but unfortunately our experience didn’t quite live up to expectations. The pizza bases were much thicker and soggier than we’d hoped — especially disappointing since we came in craving that classic crispy Italian-style base. One of our pizzas was also overwhelmingly salty, to the point that even a salt lover would find it hard to enjoy. The pasta had a similar issue with saltiness, which really overpowered the flavour of the dish. We also had a small mix-up with one of our orders — not the end of the world, so we didn’t make a fuss, but it did add to the sense that the service was a little off. We tried to get the attention of staff for some extra drinks, but felt like we were being overlooked, which was frustrating. That said, the setting was lovely and the menu has some great potential. With a bit more attention to balance in the food and attentiveness in the service, I think this place could be excellent. We’d love to give it another go down the track, in hopes of a better showing.

Can't believe this was the first time I'd been here but was here for my colleagues birthday dinner and the food was just great! Fish, sizzling beef, tofu, chow mein, dim sum, sweet and sour pork and also ordered a chicken dish but can't recall which one specifically. The only dish I didn't like was the tofu but am not a fan of tofu in general anyway so this was not surprising for me. I had rice and of course BYO and I bought one of my favourite inexpensive wines (Brown Brother Dolcetto and Syrah). Can't quite recall how much the corkage is but think it is NZD3.00 per bottle. Our table was upstairs (I had no idea there was seating upstairs) and there's also tables on the balcony upstairs. I brought a cake and candles for the birthday boy. You need to book a table in advance unless you want to wait and there is a time limit if it is busy and it was on the Friday that I was there. Good location and the restaurant was a residential house so you're essentially dining in a former bedroom or in our case a former living room! Waitresses were great and took care of us.
Went to try this cafe as recommended by a friend. We ordered deep fried squid, lemon chicken, sizzling black pepper lamb, special Maggie sauce king prawns. Food was nice.

Used to come to Canton cafe when I worked in Auckland city area 20 years ago. Glad to see that it is still operating. I believe I always ordered roast pork and beans curt on rice back in the old days $19. Big portion but the bak choi vege was too big, should chop it down. Braised roasted duck owith preserved cabbage on rice noodles also great.
One of the best place to get Prawns There chilli black prawns are just delicious. My regular place to go

Another happy visit to Canton Cafe my go to place in NZ. Over 20 yrs & still relish the king prawns in black sauce. Superb taste, consistent cooking over well over two decades & I also recommend the same with tofu & hapuka with their black 🌶️ sauce. That sauce is just pure magic for my taste buds, The sizzler chicken was a visual delight, ( see the steaming in the photo) Must not forget piping hot green tea to begin with & the proverbial 'now get going' plate of fruits at the end. Service with a smile & my compliments to all your lovely staff, you are a credit to Canton Cafe @ Kingsland! I hope my grandchildren too will enjoy your food! Live long & Prosper!!

I've been coming to Tiffen for years because the food is excellent, the family run business super friendly and welcoming, and I never feel rushed. Great variety of dishes always fresh and punchy with flavour. Still my favourite Indian restaurant in Auckland.

Absolutely superb! We spent a wonderful couple of hours here. The decor was wonderfully authentic and the service was excellent regardless of being very busy. The food was awesome, full of flavour, hot and presentable. Thanks for a great night.

We have tried a lot of Indian eateries in Auckland and this one has become one of our new favourites. The chicken korma and butter chicken were both very tasty. The level of service was great. Highly recommended
CLEAN. CLEAN. CLEAN. DELIGHTFUL. FABULOUS FOOD, WONDERFUL warm lady front of house. OMG. My most recent meal was the vegetarian Goan Paneer - sensational.

Descent beautifully decorated Indian restaurant, good service, nice location. Taste is modified to suit Kiwis. Chefs should be wearing their cap all the time. Enough of items in menu to choose from, including good numbers of vegetarian dishes. Friendly staff, reasonably priced.

I came back to Banzai today, and once again, I was blown away by the quality and flavor of the food. Everything is consistently delicious and beautifully presented. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, with relaxing background music that adds to the experience. The lovely couple who run the place truly make it special — their kindness, smiles, and dedication create a sense of home. I discovered this gem last year, and it quickly became my favorite restaurant. I’ve brought many of my friends here, and the food has always been perfect. My absolute favorites are the melting salmon and the perfect miso soup 😍 Highly recommended for anyone who appreciates authentic, tasty Japanese cuisine with heart.
Cozy place with delicious food. We ordered tuna shushi, and it was so amazing that we didn't have time to take a picture. Also, we ordered a Japanese curry, soba noodles and miso ramen

As always the food was amazing, so delicious. Subtle and flavoursome at the same time! We shared some scallops, tofu salad and miso soup with soba noodles/vegetables/salmon. Attentive service and always a serene smile from the chef and his assistant. Banzai has big heart and soul.
Great Japanese on Dominion Road ! Everything is fresh & good. Don’t recommend the karaage chicken though, average. I think it’s from packet.

Great authentic Japanese restaurant. Plenty of choice on the menu. Small store and intimate atmosphere. Staff were friendly and very efficient. All the dishes except the sushi came very quickly and we're great. The sushi was hand made to order and the most delicious sushi I've ever had, just melted in your mouth!

Great place for hanging out with friends with delicious Indian meal. For me, i found it too dark from ambience perspective. Toilet is a bit of a disappointment. Service was good, and the staff was very friendly and polite. If ordering tea, remember to state your choice of sugar.

This place has great food, but it's a hole in the wall, almost literally. It opened at noon and you have to go down this long hallway with bottles hanging. You sit on rickety wooden crates, there are 3 different rooms or sections. See if you can get the one in the back it's very laid back. We tried almost Eveything, I'd say you have a hard time finding something that you don't enjoy. Try the thumbs up if you're looking for Pepsi or coke.

Me and my fiance are here to get married and my sister took us out here. Firstly I have to commend Sammy, he's FANTASTIC, gave us amazing service, and also extremely knowledgeable about the NZ food scene in general so amazing recommendations all around. Next - the FOOD OH MY GOD SO GOOD. If you see all my pictures you'll notice half the plate is gone, that's because everyone grabbed all the food before I even remembered to take a picture. Seriously - visit this place, you won't be upset. I think in total we spent $140 NZD to stuff 6 people to the brim. Super worth every penny.

The restaurant was definitely a find. It serves good South Indian food - dosas and idli and even rawa (semolina) dosa. The masala dosa tasted great. Clean and crisp taste. The masala (the potato and onion filling) was well made too - though I thought it could have a little more of it. The papdums with dips was a great touch in the menu - and they were running a special on that, at half price! The quality of papdums they used was good too - not the poor quality thick ones often found in NZ. The yogurt dip with cucumbers served with the dish was very satisfying. The samosa chaat was pretty good too - just the right portion size, and priced well. The samosa tasted good for a change. The place is located in the Sandringham stretch of shops, and thus parking is a bit of a pain to find close by. It isn't a problem if one is willing to walk for 5 mins. The guy running the restaurant - Sammy (spelling?) - is very involved with the place, and ensures that everything is in order. He is friendly, gave good suggestions based on what I wanted, and was a pleasure to interact with. Hia father started this restaurant decades back, and it was the first Indian restaurant in that stretch. He also showed me and the other customera around the newer part of the restaurant at the back - which has more of a lounge atmosphere. I'd definitely recommend this restaurant for good quality meal in an informal setting.

The worst place to spend your hard earned money , me and my wife went to this ugly place , to disappoint ourselves , they served us kawan frozen paratha on the name of cheese and garlic paratha, chilli chicken for entree costs $20 and is less than 100 gm portion, I can tell as I am a chef for 15 years, roti was tawa style and clearly was cooked way in advanced , they keep their roti’s pre-made for whole day , I know this , coz we make roti in India for big community dinners and ,keep their rotis cooked for long time , found the same texture as the roti is from last night. I wish I had time to see the owner and ask why they are ripping off people without any shame with such a confidence .

Good food, good service the open mic left a lot to be desired was just way too loud for the amount of people in the space and … singers were sorry mate some people just shouldn’t. But ribs on Thursday was AMAZING!!! Staff are really friendly, polite and helpful. Awesome place if you have big eaters. lol drinks aren’t too bad price wise either Otherwise our family had an amazing dinner. Will definitely go again.

Fantastic restaurant, friendly staff and very generous. I had the nachos very tasty. I wanted to try the tacos but they ran out, they felt bad and gave me extra chicken wings (sooo delicious). My partner and friends ate bottomless ribs and they found it to be amazing, The ribs were not too saucy so they tasted every bit of the meat juicy and tender. We also played the arcade games available there It was very fun. Would dine and hang out here again. 😁

The Kingslander is a classic local spot, and we dropped in on a Thursday night to check out their all-you-can-eat ribs deal for $30 per person. I came with three mates, and it’s safe to say this place knows how to set the right vibe. The first round came with fries and garlic bread—tasty, but pretty filling upfront! Thankfully, the rounds after that were just ribs, which helped us pace ourselves a bit better (though we still got full pretty fast). The ribs themselves were tender, well-seasoned, and falling clean off the bone. They paired perfectly with a few drinks. The venue is spacious and has a rustic, timeless charm. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ If you're a seafood lover, 928 Eatery on Dominion Road, Mt Eden is an absolute must-visit! It’s not just a meal here—it’s a full experience. The menu is focused and straightforward: fresh seafood is the star of the show. Don’t expect a long menu with lots of options—this place is all about premium, quality seafood done right. We ordered the combination seafood pot and a king crab, and both were absolutely amazing. The seafood pot was full of flavour and generously portioned, perfect for sharing. The king crab was fresh, meaty, and cooked to perfection. What really stood out, even beyond the delicious food, was the exceptional service. Honestly, it was the best service we’ve received at any restaurant in a long time. The staff were incredibly friendly and knowledgeable. One staff member even helped us cook the seafood combination pot at our table, which made the experience even more enjoyable and memorable. It felt like we were being hosted rather than just served. We also tried the Paua fried rice, and it was a delightful surprise—perfectly cooked and rich in seafood flavour. Every dish felt thoughtfully prepared, highlighting the freshness of the ingredients. Another bonus is the free parking lot behind the restaurant, which is a rare find in this area and makes visiting even more convenient. We had a wonderful night with lots of fresh seafood, great conversation, and warm hospitality. Highly recommend 928 Eatery if you want an authentic and satisfying seafood experience in Auckland.

I recently visited Manee Thai Restaurant for dinner, and overall, it was a pleasant experience. Based on previous reviews, we knew that arriving at 6 PM meant we had about an hour to dine, which was perfectly fine with us. Upon arrival, we were seated at the big table, which felt welcoming and cool. By 6 PM, the restaurant was already about two-thirds full, showing just how popular the place is. The fact that most of the customers weren’t Thai really shows how well Manee Thai has captured the hearts of the local Kiwi community. The prices for the food were reasonable, on par with other Thai restaurants in the area. However, the one notable thing about the food was the saltiness. While I do appreciate bold flavors, I found that most dishes were quite salty—so much so that it became the dominant flavor. If you love salty food, this may not be an issue, but for those with a more sensitive palate, it could be overwhelming. The Tom Yum soup, which I was particularly looking forward to, was a bit of a letdown. It seemed to have been adjusted to cater to Western tastes, lacking the authentic balance of sour and spicy flavors that I enjoy in traditional Thai cuisine. We also ordered extra rice, but all of the rice came in one large bowl, which made it unclear if the extra serving was included or not. In terms of atmosphere, the restaurant is clearly popular and has a lively, bustling vibe, which many will enjoy. For a first-time visit, it was a good experience, and I can see why so many Kiwis love it. However, if you're not a fan of salty food, you might want to consider trying another place for a more balanced flavor profile. All in all, Manee Thai is a solid choice for those who enjoy hearty, flavorful Thai food with a bit of a Western twist. I’d recommend it for the ambiance and experience, though be mindful of the seasoning!

I rarely leave negative reviews, but my experience at Taiko Kingsland was so terrible that I feel compelled to warn others. I dined there on the 26th of January and ordered a variety of dishes as pictured. The next day, I was hit with the worst food poisoning of my life. I spent three days violently ill with vomiting, diarrhoea and fever and had to be given IV fluids. I’ve read media reports about food poisoning cases at Taiko Ponsonby, but I dined at the Kingsland location during the same period and ended up with the same symptoms. I believe it was the same virus, and it’s alarming that both locations seem to have been affected. After this experience, I have no intention of returning and strongly advise others to consider the risks before dining here.
