Very friendly owner. Delicious food and reasonably priced. A great option for takeaway

Good generous servings. Friendly service. Only criticism is water from the peas and carrotts aren't drained properly. Fills up and soaks my potatos and waters down the gravy. This has happened both times I've got a meal from here. Would come more often otherwise.

What can I say.. chicken that's better than KFC, roast better than my grandma's.. Nothing feels better on a winter night than popping in here for a hot meal. Best food in west, south, north, and east auckland. The rest of the world? Undetermined.

Visiting Auckland from Australia and I had to make two visits to Blue Rose. Best pies I’ve ever had and the mango smoothies are to die for. We had the Pacifica Benedict and it blew me away, a nice big portion of crispy skin pork belly that was melt in your mouth. My first time having taro and lu’au and I will definitely be having it again. The staff were lovely, the service was attentive but not smothering, and they were happy to answer any questions we had about the menu. The dining area is casual and comfortable, it feels like having lunch at a friend’s house. Will definitely be going back as soon as I can.

Blue Rose Café – Mixed Experience but Still Some Gems Blue Rose Café in Sandringham used to be one of my go-to spots, especially for their unique and delicious pies – the hāngi pie was a personal favourite. Sadly, the quality and amount of filling in the pies has gone down over time, which is a bit disappointing. That said, their sausage rolls are still solid, and the koko Samoa cupcake is an absolute standout – rich, flavourful, and a must-try if you visit. A mix of highs and lows, but still worth checking out for some of their specialty items.
Really large and unique pies with a delicious and generous double filling and an amazing filling-to-crust ratio. Super friendly staff! Always happy to come back.

Always love this place! We had the island plate,(generous portions of succulent pork belly, luau and kalo) oka, palusami/luau omelette, palsami/luau pie and soy latte-and the take away koko cup cakes -that was divine!Thanks Lenny, Robbie and staff!

Went to try their palusaumi pie and it was delicious. Thick chunky filling without being too salty. I also tried their Oka raw fish. Could have used a little more salt, but was still nice. Easy to get to from the cbd with a bus stop a few meters away

My partner and I have been going to this place to get takeout for years and we love it! The food is amazing, portions very generous and affordable, the staff are always super friendly, and it's definitely the most value for money takeout you can get pretty much anywhere! The takeout is cold so you have to heat it yourself, but its 1000% worth it.

Arguably one of the best places in Auckland to get well made veg food at reasonable rates. All the staff members are friendly and welcoming but my shoutout to Gurvinder for always going out of her way to help people👍🏻

I have been a loyal customer of Shubh but can't handle the smell of urine in their restaurant. There is no ventilation and it smells very bad. They should close the toilet for public if they can't fix the problem. It is a very unpleasant experience for the customers. I mentioned twice to the staff already but decided I would no longer be going.

I’ve been a loyal customer of Shubh Restaurant since 2016, and I can confidently say they offer consistently high-quality food at an incredibly affordable price. It’s rare to find a place where the prices have remained so reasonable while others keep raising theirs. Shubh Restaurant truly stands out for its genuine pricing and delicious food. Highly recommend it to anyone looking for great value and taste

Don’t order from here from any home delivery apps as they don’t mention it that the food come directly from out of the fridge and delivered cold Restaurant is supposed to mention this the food is not hot or warm

I recently had the pleasure dinning , and their fried rice left me thoroughly impressed. The flavors were perfectly balanced, with each grain infused with spices that truly captured the essence of Indian cuisine. The vegetables/meat were fresh and cooked to perfection, adding both texture and flavor. The portion size was generous, making it excellent value for money. The presentation was inviting, and the aroma was irresistible. The service was equally commendable, with the staff being attentive and courteous. Overall, this dish was a highlight of my dining experience, and I highly recommend it to anyone looking for authentic Indian flavors.

We always get food from Bawarchi, couple of times a month at least. It’s always pretty good but today we had ordered Indo Chinese chicken fried rice. My partner had it and got sick, I smelled it and it’s pretty bad so throwing it away.

I recently visited Bawarchi Takeaway with two friends, and I must say, it was an absolute treat for the taste buds! We ordered the Chicken Biryani, Mutton Biryani, and Goat Biryani, and each one was perfectly cooked. The quality of the biryanis was top-notch, and the quantity was more than enough to satisfy our hunger and hearts. The flavors were balanced, with each grain of rice cooked to perfection and the meat tender and flavorful. We also tried the Chicken 65 and Chicken Manchurian, both of which were absolutely delicious! The Chicken 65 had a perfect crunch and a spicy kick, while the Chicken Manchurian was a perfect blend of tangy and savory. The curries were another highlight. Every bite was a reminder of how fresh and well-prepared the dishes were. You could really taste the quality of the ingredients used. Overall, Bawarchi Takeaway did an amazing job delivering great food with great taste. Whether you're in the mood for a flavorful biryani or craving some hearty chicken dishes, this place has you covered. Highly recommended!

Omg look at this Naan bread , you guys be the judge, seriously, whoever cooking this should throw out in the bin , and the one who is packing this , seriously what the heck are you saving for , is it hard to do the Naan bread , and tell how do you guys feel if you got a family dinner and when you open up and see this , are you happy to serve to the family members, seriously............... not professional at all

The food was great, and the atmosphere was equally enjoyable. However, the service left much to be desired. It felt as though customers were not welcome. I would recommend that the staff make eye contact and speak respectfully. When we returned to pick up our order, one of the staff members, while working, simply said, “Food is not yet ready,” without even looking at us. It felt quite disrespectful and dismissive
The South Indian food was quite enjoyable, and while the service was initially a bit lacking, it noticeably improved on my next visit.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5 A Taste of Home at Venky’s! Tried the Veg Thali and it was absolutely delicious — felt just like a home-cooked South Indian meal! Every item on the plate was packed with flavour, fresh, and comforting. Perfectly balanced spices, great variety, and served with warmth. Highly recommend for anyone craving authentic, home-style South Indian cuisine in Auckland. Will definitely be back!

Come here if you want delicious, pungent and affordable Indian food. We had the fried chicken curry, the special combo meal (non veg) and the punugulu. The combo meals are definitely the way to go - lots of food and variety for a small amount of money. The fried chicken curry was delicious but I’d recommend getting some sides to go with it.

The quality is very poor, service even more sad! Hair on the food, simply a very disappointing experience. Once upon a time the idlys used to be really nice and edible. No more! A very sad place. Unhappy with my decision. Never again. Waste of time, energy money and sad to not be able to even enjoy it. Stale food! Do not waste you’d money here.

We have been visiting this restaurant a few years now but the food standard has dropped drastically . Although placing orders a big challenge and slow but we still visited this restaurant with friends . Couple of times previously we have been served non fresh vegetables (okra) so we stopped going there . Some friends wanted to meet up here so tried again and they served staled vegetables again. I complained but he just denied. I didn’t enjoy the meal and felt uncomfortable . My friends arrived later on and they were served with a different vegetables.
Went in for early dinner on the whim and so glad that we did. The food was amazing, especially the desserts, they are divine. Great atmosphere and impeccable service. Would highly recommend.

We visited for lunch and weren’t welcomed by staff until we went to the bar and made our presence known. The girl that eventually served us was lovely and made sure we were taken care of. We had the shepherds pie, calamari, pint fries and wings. Unfortunately the shepherds pie lacked flavour and was predominantly potato and the calamari wasn’t worth what we paid. The staff did mention that they had some recent changes to their menu, so maybe we caught them on a bad day because everything was very average and pricing for the calamari and wings were quite dear for the portions. We visited at 12.30pm when they just opened so the atmosphere was quiet and dead, but regardless nice and clean.

Went for the Sunday Roast for Lunch, although it was a long weekend, so it was a bit quiet, that expected which dampered the atmosphere, but we had good company to make up for it😊. The food tasted really good. Yorkshire was also fluffy and not doughy. Portion sizes were great, but I felt like it could have done with more meat, I felt the plate was filled a lot more with the potatoes and veg, and everything else, and it left me wanting more of the star of the dish, being the lamb and pork roast. 😉

Went to take my mum out for lunch and tried this place , we had been here tasting burgers as part of their burgernation entry and wanted to try the roast It was amazing , I’m not always a fan of roast beef but this was perfectly done , I paid extra and got the double meat which was pork belly as well Had peas, carrots , pumpkin , gravy , potato and Yorkshire pudding as well All in all not worth making yourself and $30 is a good price which is only slightly more than some roast takeaway shops near me but massively better quality Will definitely go back
Great service. Not just pub food. Really great food. Excellent value with a great selection of beers and wine.

Recently, I checked into this small shop with my friends. Although the store is small, But the taste is not discounted at all! The staff were very warm and patient Told us we'd wait a minute and took pictures in the car We ordered three dishes, and each dish was delicious.

Great spot for a late-night takeout! The portions are huge, and everything is cooked fresh with that perfect wok flavor. Loved the Surf n Turf Noodles and Works Fried Rice—so flavorful! Staff are super friendly, and ordering ahead saves time. Will definitely be back!

Great portion sizes and excellent value for money! The fried rice is flavorful without being greasy, making it a perfect meal for workers and students looking for a satisfying and affordable option. Highly recommend!

The service is excellent, the food comes out quickly, and the presentation is beautiful. There are plenty of parking spaces and it's very friendly to working people. I'll definitely come back. I love Thai food and the slightly spicy flavor suits me perfectly.

This Thai restaurant is right near my home, and I can't believe I had never tried it before! I decided to give it a shot over the weekend and was surprised to find it quite busy. I ordered a **Prawn Nasi Goreng**—the portion was huge, and the rice was packed tightly into the bowl. It was super fragrant! I also got the **Crispy Pork Belly**—the pieces were large, and the sauce mixed with the fried rice was incredibly delicious. Finally, I ordered a snack: **Satay Skewers**—chicken skewers coated in rich satay peanut sauce, absolutely amazing! The restaurant even offers a **keto menu**, so it's great for those on a diet or into fitness. I'll definitely be going back again!

I buy takeout on line...often red curry and sometimes with chicken satay (a rich peanut sauce and tender chicken) or a vege tofu dish. The whole menu looks delicious! I love the flavours and they are such lovely people - it's a pleasure to go there. It's a very small and simple seated area if you eat in.
Definitely will add this restaurant to our list. The lady is so nice she heard me coughing and offered me hot water and they made heart rice for us. Lovely dinner made my day!

$43.98 for Pad Thai, Beef Curry with no rice and Spring Rolls, takeaway. The Spring Rolls were $5 so we thought they would be huge or many. We got two tiny ones, equating to $1.25 a mouthful, woefully disappointing. The food was overpriced and simply, not worth it, the beefy curry was devoid of beef and obviously pre cooked and simply dumped in a watery curry sauce. Won’t be going again

Got recommended this place by a friend and with the thought of supporting our local small businesses, four of us decided to eat in, theres only three tables and we took two lol. Lucky there werent any others eating in as it would be very cosy. We ordere green chicken curry, red chicken curry, pad thai, spring rolls curry puffs, tom yum soup and man was it fast coming out of their small kitchen. My fav is green curry and pad thai chicken of course. Was in and out in less than an hour which worked out good cause theres not alot of 60 min parking opposite. Highly recommend. Thanks Thai Hut.
Just orderd via delivereasy and was really impressed! Definitely the best Thai food I've had in Auckland.

When you want nutrients and not the carbs! This is the place with plenty variety. Still want the carbs? Go for it. I had the omelet with mushrooms and took a little longer than I expected. May be a one-off staffing issue. But quality was great.

I am absolutely delighted with this! My schedule often makes it challenging to prepare dinner, and your service has truly been a lifesaver! The food is absolutely wonderful! Breakfast, lunch, and dinner are all covered! I opted for the 3x daily keto meal pack, which was all prepared for me, and I am thoroughly impressed! Eliminating the stress of grocery shopping and meal preparation has been such a relief! This was my first order, and I intend to continue utilizing the excellent service you provide!

A perfect place if you want to know the nutrient value of your order. Almost every menu shows its calorie along with carb, protein and fat amount. Also food itself is delicious yet clean taste too (not a fan of intense sauce). Parking is free if you dine at the cafe. It would be good if they can play around with the menu time to time though.

What a fantastic place! As a keto person walking into a cafe with all ingredients and macros displayed on EVERYTHING was very exciting for me! It is wonderful to have a cafe like this that caters for anyone with special dietary requirements. The atmosphere/parking was great! The food was amazing. I went with the egg wrap and cheesecake and loved both very much - I can see myself returning back here A LOT!!!!! Thanks Liza for the amazing service👍

Really impressed with the food at this place. They have a huge range of healthy options and the atmospheres really nice with all the plants. The protein bowls we ordered had a good portion size and tasted delicious with lots of flavour. Would happily be visiting again in the near future!

I attended the brewery tour. It was really informative, the host was very knowledgeable and did a great tour. We stayed for dinner after the tour at burgernauts which was great. Highly recommend the cheese burger fries and the burgers were great to. The tasting board really allows you to try the vast selection of beers.

Urbanaut Brewery and Tap Room, a fantastic experience! As someone who appreciates good vegetarian/vegan options, was impressed with their offerings. It's not always easy to find a place that caters so well to plant- based diets. It's true that the food isn't fast food, so don't expect the a quick bite. The dishes are clearly made with care, and the flavors are amazing. The space itself is open and inviting, creating a relaxed and enjoyable atmosphere. The staff were all incredibly friendly and helpful, which really added to the positive vibe. And of course, for the beer lovers, this place is a must-visit. They have a great selection of brews, making it the perfect spot to try something new with some amazing food. I highly recommend Urbanaut!

My friends and I did the brewery tour recently. All up it was about an hour. It was informative and interesting. It was one of the better brewery tours I’ve done. The team members were super friendly too. We were able to sample some of the beer too. The Copacabana IPA was a highlight! Had the classic smash burger and some chips afterwards - both were delicious.

Been a couple of times now. You eat with your eyes here - the food always comes out looking amazing! Tried the Butter Chicken Burger when it was on as a special for Burgernation. Saucy, tangy, and easily one I could’ve gone back for seconds. The smash burgers are on point too. Plenty of beers to choose from! My go-to is the Passionfruit Guava Sour - can’t go wrong. The place is a vibe, especially being right in the middle of a working brewery. Staff are super friendly, and the best part - it’s dog friendly.
Always a great experience eating here, amazing vegan food, good beer, impeccable playlist, and this time they had delicious mulled wine 😍 perfect for a rainy day.

I have probably been here 20+ times from the past 4 years and they keep getting better! The atmosphere feels like you are in china, its lively, smells amazing and the food is outstanding. If you are a fan of charcoal bbq this is the place for you!! They have the best chicken feet, hand made noodles and charcoal bbq oysters I have had! PS: they only take bookings for a table of 7 and up. Might be a queue on the weekends too but its worth it. Dont forget to have Tsingato with your skewers!

Been going here for years! $1.20 for lamb skewers and the rest range from $1.20 to about $3.00 per skewers. Very filling, tasty seasoning, good service and atmosphere and a great dining experience overall. Love it. 4/5 stars 🌟

This is my go-to spot for a chill catch up with friends where I know the food will always hit. Because I am travelling rom South Auckland I tend to aim to arrive at the restaurant by 6-6.30pm because anytime after that on a Thursday/Friday or in the weekend is going to have a line down the stairs. Order: cucumber salad, dumplings. Skewers: Sausage (not the thin kind), pork belly, Chinese buns, beef balls. I’ve tried chicken skin, wings, beef trim, lamb trim etc but it’s not my preference.

If you're looking for an affordable and quick meal after a night out, this place is the spot! The food is not only cheap, but it also comes out super fast. The BBQ skewers are absolutely delicious, with a wide variety of meats, including pork trotters. The unique ingredients make for an exciting and flavorful experience. Whether you're craving something different or just want to enjoy a satisfying meal, this spot is perfect. Plus, they’re open until 3 am, making it an ideal stop after a night of drinking! Definitely a place to check out.

Had a group booking here and was thoroughly impressed considering the entrance isn’t the most inviting. The range of food was great, the affordability was excellent and the taste was excellent. Various meat skewers, a dessert and a beer ended up costing me $30. I will be back!

Really busy for a Tuesday night and staff were struggling to keep up with the orders. It took 30mins for 3 tapioca puddings to be made and they forgot our Bingsu order so we had to re-order which took another 20mins. Bingsu had barely any toppings and when we asked for more they had us pay for it. Tables weren’t being cleared and uber drivers were coming back saying they were missing/had the wrong items. Wouldn’t come back to this location.
@flavourandcuisine insta handle Follow me for more such reviews. Love the coconut sago and mango snowflake. I think i visit this place every other week and love my late night desserts.
The food was good, but the waiter looked glum. He was washing dishes very loudly, constantly slamming things, and even cursing to himself while serving customers at the counter. 🤬 Very rude!

This has been one of my favorite dessert places since university- that was 10 years ago! I love the traditional approach, grass jelly desserts are not too sweet which is perfect for my taste! Prices are reasonable and staff are always nice. Highly recommend!:)
I'm really disappointed with my strawberry waffle takeaway order. Despite driving 35 minutes to collect it, the waffle didn't have any strawberries on it. Not what I was expecting!

An unforgettable culinary celebration! We took Sam to New Flavour for his birthday, and it was nothing short of a feast fit for royalty. The duck—oh, the duck!—was the undisputed star: succulent, rich, and bursting with flavour in every tender bite. It arrived steaming, glistening like a crown jewel, and disappeared just as quickly. The entire experience was elevated by the vibrant atmosphere and warm, attentive service. And then came the photo—a perfectly timed snap that captured the laughter, the food, and the pure joy of the moment. It wasn’t just a meal, it was a memory stitched in spice, sizzling pans, and celebration. A triumphant tribute to friendship and flavour. Sam couldn’t have asked for a better birthday. Neither could we.

Absolutely delicious! Four of us attended for my dad's birthday and loved the food, atmosphere and staff. The staff were so friendly and even held the door for us when we were leaving. Will definitely be back 😁 Thanks again!

Arguably the worst chicken fried noodles I've had for $20. They charge a surcharge of 2.5% for paywave and credit card transactions. They even charge you extra for takeaway boxes. You are expected to approach the counter for everything viz water, cutlery etc. Didn't feel welcomed at all. Definitely not at all impressed with their customer service. Food was extremely average for the price. They had only one variety of noodles (thick noodles). Honestly I've had so much better for a lesser price elsewhere. Will never be going back neither will I recommend this place to anyone else.

More or less wound up here on Accident since everywhere else was full on a public holiday. Best mistake I ever made. Food was incredible and portions were excellent. We even had a 10% Holiday Surcharge and still spent less than $20 per person (we weren't able to finish our food and had to take a dish home). If I had to recommend just one dish, I'd go with any of the dumplings. They're quite literally the best dumplings I've had outside of China. The noodles were also excellent
Genuinely the best birthday ever. They printed a photo and then handed out a fun microphone. I will 100% be back for my next birthday! 💪 (look at our fire photo🔥)

Delicious sizzling steak with perfectly cooked pasta and fresh vegetables. The portion is generous, and the side soup, fruit, and Coke complete the meal. Friendly service and cozy atmosphere make it a satisfying dining experience. Will definitely come back again!
Delicious food and great service! The staff were friendly and the place had a nice, relaxed vibe. Everything we ordered was tasty and fresh. Highly recommend My Kitchen — we’ll definitely be back!

I visited for a late lunch on a weekday, and it was quiet. The spacious upstairs and downstairs areas were great for dining. We ordered via QR code and enjoyed traditional Taiwanese dishes that were not only delicious but also offered good value for the price.

My Kitchen on Dominion Road is a decent spot if you're after a quick and budget-friendly meal, especially if you're vegetarian. They definitely have some good options on that front. While the flavours of what I tried weren't exactly my favourite, I can't fault the speed of service and how lovely the staff were. So, overall, it's an ok experience – good for a no-fuss, affordable bite, just maybe not a place you'd go for a flavour explosion
We've been here before, and the food is truly amazing. We brought our friends along, and they absolutely loved it!
This is a cute little place with delicious food! The portions are very sizeable and are definitely worth trying! The rice cakes were to die for! The service was very good too, felt very welcomed

Golden Steamboat offers an extensive menu that's likely to satisfy during your visit. We sampled a variety of dishes and were impressed by both the flavors and the prices. Many of the main dishes, perfect for sharing, are under $20, with most falling between $20 and $40. The portions are generous for the price, making it an ideal spot for groups to share meals. The food is well-seasoned, with many dishes offering a spicy kick. My personal favorites were the Sichuan-style spicy chicken (large portions, perfectly cooked, with a crisp coating) and the fried noodles. The spicy and sour soup was also excellent, delivering a sharp flavor I enjoyed, though it may not appeal to everyone. The food arrived in about 15 minutes, which was reasonable given the busy atmosphere. The staff were friendly and patient. Self-service water and tea are available, and the bathroom, while clean, is limited to just one. Note that you’ll need to climb a flight of stairs to access the restaurant, so it may not be accessible to all.

We decided to try this place after asking some diners who were just leaving if they enjoyed there food. Nice clean premises with an eclectic decor. We were seated with menus & hot Jasmine tea. So hard to choose from the beautiful pics in the menu! We ordered two types of fried dumplings, a pork dish and a beef dish. Food came out fast, nice big portions and full of flavour! Absolutely delicious!! Thank you will return soon.

My go-to Chinese restaurant on Dominion Rd when I want a good meal with a group or with my partner. This restaurant is has consistently great quality food and lovely, attentive service. I love sitting upstairs in the colourful booths too! The Slobbery Chicken, green beans and dumplings were delicious last time I went. You can tell that the chefs really care about the food quality and they have seasonal specials. Highly recommend!!

My favourite place to eat in the world! I come here for my birthday every year, for graduation dinner, for special occasions - it's always perfect. Staff are fantastic. I love the snow needle & cucumber salad, squid tentacles, black pepper beef, everything is delicious

Great value for money, incredibly fast service. Food came out around 7 or so minutes after ordering! My personal favourite for dishes was the green beans with pork mince and the chilli chicken! We also ordered some chicken fried noodles and combination noodles which were both yum but nothing exceptional. The cucumber salad was nice and fresh and helpful to cut through the spice!! All in all great experience would 100% recommend for anyone wanting to eat out on dominion road

A Hidden Gem on Dominion Road We’ve passed by Spicy House countless times and finally decided to step in – and what a delightful decision it was! This small restaurant has its unique charm: it’s compact, bustling, yet incredibly well-organized. Despite the busy atmosphere, the efficiency and attentiveness of the staff stood out. There were five staff members at the front counter, ensuring every request was promptly addressed and tables were swiftly cleaned and turned over for the next guests. One of the most striking aspects of Spicy House is its diverse clientele. It’s arguably the only Chinese restaurant in Auckland where you’ll find more non-Chinese customers than Chinese, which speaks volumes about its broad appeal and the quality of its food. Speaking of the food, it was absolutely delicious. The flavors were rich and authentic, and the beef was particularly noteworthy – tender and perfectly cooked. Each dish we tried was a testament to the culinary skills of the kitchen staff. The prices are reasonable, offering great value for the quality and portion sizes. Overall, our experience at Spicy House was fantastic. The combination of excellent service, delicious food, and a welcoming atmosphere makes it a standout on Dominion Road. We will definitely be back to enjoy more of their delightful offerings. Highly recommended!

Rubbish food. Waste of money 💰($45) "I was disappointed with the quality of the food. I ordered spicy veg fried rice and got mild, and I asked for spicy food, and overall, the taste did not meet expectations. Then I called them they said bring food back.Went back there, got the replacement of extra hot veg fried rice, which I can't eat, thinking they got frustrated with complaint and put rice in fried chilly not chilly in fried rice. hope the restaurant improves its quality standards.

I’ve been to Spicy House many times, and it’s always a solid choice. We always order the Chili Chicken, which is delicious—flavorful, spicy, and satisfying every time. The place can get pretty busy, but the service is quick, which is a big plus.

Very good quality at a reasonable price. Everything we ordered is on point. I especially enjoyed the sparerib in secret sauce, intestine and sweet and sour pork. White rice comes free when you order. The place is small and has few tables so you have to plan ahead your visit when coming.

Not only the best tacos in the country (they are) but also the best service I've ever encountered. You'll only have to go once before they remember you by name forever. I always feel like I'm being greeted with seemingly infinite joy and positive energy. This is how you get punters coming back! Don't miss utter gem.
Best Taco in town ~ Auckland’s best 🌮 Must Try 👉 Chipotle Chicken (Food-truck at a company event, didn’t spend money)
Best tacos in town. It’s fresh, juicy, dripping, melt in your mouth kinda flawless. 😍

These are the most authentic tasting, fresh and unbelievably tasty tacos. Once you’ve bought the kit, they are so quick and easy to make, the hard work has already been done. I made the mistake of thinking I could microwave the tortillas like the supermarket ones but they must be put in the pan and it was so worth it, they come out hot and crispy. Love them.

I must have been living under a rock because I cannot believe that i’ve only tried their food now (at an event) and I swear to god it was BEST tacos I’ve ever had and served by the loviest people I’ve ever met. Literally a party in your mouth, looking forward to trying their kits.

Full of mouth favourite. great special china Changsha Cuisines . Good level of serivce. Just a-bit salted side. Definitely need to match with rice . Recommended for people who love spicy and Chinese food

Ive been to a lot of Chinese restaurants and was recommended to this place by my mum. I can honestly say it is now probably one of my favourites places to go to. Food was excellent and service was friendly and efficient. You have to order the fried duck, really tasty.

This is infact one of our favourite restaurant. Have been here several times, usually for dinner. It was just a simple restaurant but pleasant and spacious. Service was friendly. Food was tasty. Our group like the dishes. Will definitely revisit the restaurant again.

On my two visits to this restaurant , i have tried sliced pork belly and spicy pork . Also the spicy sliced beef. I would say the dishes are spicy but not over spicy. They all taste really good with wok hei over the spicy pork and the sliced pork belly cut is tender and well marinated. The spicy beef chii oil is so tasty. They are one one the best hunan dish we have ever tried. The price is reasonable as well.
The food was absolutely amazing - perfectly cooked and had so much flavour. Good size portions. friendly service. Well worth of money. Definitely visit again.

I recently dined at Kiss Kiss and was thoroughly impressed by the quality and flavor of the dishes we ordered. Our selections included the sticky ribs, chicken-fried skins, bang bang noodles, pork belly salad, and French fries. Every dish was exceptionally tasty and well -executed. The standout for me was the sticky ribs— beautifully tender while still maintaining their structure. They were so delicious that I would gladly return for them alone. We also sampled one of their cocktails, opting for the coco mango flavor. It was rich, flavorful, and generously portioned with alcohol—an excellent complement to the meal. Overall, this was one of the most memorable dining experiences I’ve had in some time. Kiss Kiss is well worth a visit, and I would confidently rate the food 5 stars!

An Explosion of Flavour – A Must-Visit! Kiss Kiss absolutely delivers when it comes to bold, flavour-packed food. Every dish we tried was a knockout – no frills, no gimmicks, just incredible taste. The ingredients are clearly top quality, and the way they’re put together is nothing short of magic. It honestly felt like an explosion of flavours in my mouth – every bite was exciting and satisfying. The dishes speak for themselves, and they speak loud. If you’re after food that hits all the right notes, this is the spot. Highly recommend

Our go to place if we are good thai food. Sticky ribs and pad thai still best of quality and generous serving. Staff service was awesome thanks to the amazing manager Lorenzo. Will keep coming back and will spread the word to our friends/guests to try this resto.

Such a cool spot on Dom Road! Friendly service, great vibes and a great selection of Thai fusion dishes. Some of our favourites were the bao buns and Thai pork ribs! Their new dishes like the pad krapow was also delicious😊
This is a very cool place to eat. Great atmosphere, great food, cool layout, friendly service. Great vibe. Our wedding anniversary dinner.

Web site changed the order, when we ordered it, Took more than an hour to arrive, couldn't come down the driveway, and then it was different again when we got it, meat bingo had sickining amout of pesto and was over cooked, and the tikka pizza had uncooked sauce and toppings.. the chips were nice
Really nice place and always friendly. Good sizes and pricely competitive with bigger brands. Always great to grab something on the way home.
Love it. Wide variety of choices. Lots of vegetarian options.
Olives pizza on Hobson Street is better

I ordered a butter chicken pizza just now and paid extra for chicken but the ingredients were really less veges too small pieces of chicken and that too less. Really not happy with the making also spreading butter chicken sauce on top instead of spreading on the base but i added chesse sauce and they put the chicken sauce on top of the pizza and the flavour got mixed no logic why they did that. Now have to order something else. Ruined my day🙁.

⭐ 1/5 Raw deal, literally. I was genuinely looking forward to this – a little pay day treat, something to savour. Instead, I got served a soggy, undercooked slab pretending to be pizza. Base was doughy like someone gave up halfway, cheese barely melted, toppings limp and sad. It was less pizza night and more culinary crime scene. For the price, I expected a slice of joy, what I got was a half-baked disappointment. Literally. Do better.

Ordered a giant glazed donut to give it a try since people have been recommending it. Instead of letting me know that it was sold out and asking if I’d rather have something else or a refund, they gave me another type of dessert. If I had the choice, if I was GIVEN a choice, I would’ve asked for the bloody refund to save my bucks. Called them up to ask what’s going on and that I got the wrong item, the bloke over the phone sounded apologetic enough. I’ve been working in hospo for over 5yrs that I understood where he was coming from and didn’t wanna stress him out more. But it doesn’t take long to let your customers know that an item of yours is sold out and to suggest your solution for them. Would’ve appreciated the choice rather than it being made for me. Just expected a bit more from a big and well known franchise.

This has been the worst experience I’ve had at a Domino’s. They can’t fulfill orders correctly, and the staff is very unprofessional. When I asked politely if I could pay extra for a small amount of oregano and chili flakes, the staff responded rudely and made inappropriate gestures instead of just saying no. This was completely unacceptable. The branch also doesn’t provide basic things like tissue paper or hand sanitizer, which shows poor hygiene and management. Overall, the staff didn’t take responsibility or show any customer service. I strongly recommend avoiding this branch.
Quick and easy to order takeaway. Staff are always friendly. Pizzas are tasty. Just not really the place for romantic dinner!

Takeaway Indian snacks. Purchased samosas, a little oily and small compared to other places. Flavour ok. Pakoras =,very stodgy and dense, wouldn't recommend them. When I make these at home they are light a fluffy, not like golf balls. Burning, good, not too sweet and nice and tasty.

Vegetarian Sweets & Snacks on the front of the shop stopped my car, I had to take a look inside. A fantastic discovery, with sweets of all types. I left with savory snacks of Samosas, Pakora & Khachori, all were yummy with just the right amount of spiciness for me, medium.

Lady at the front desk was rude and un welcoming, she straight away said "I am closing at 4:30 " Before checking as to what we needed, she thought we were there to dine in, in business you don't assume but asked as to what customer wanted. We wanted to buy few things but just picked one item a d left the ace. My wife liked snacks but I am not going to visit this place again, you lost a customer for ever.
Awesome staff, tasty snacks. BEST place to go for Indian goodies.
Pre-ordered sweets for our wedding. Picked up and it was all ready to go, everyone loved it! Best gulab jamun you can get

One of the most delicious and memorable meals I have had for a long time! The lovely wait person knew exactly how we should order and she was bang on. Four of us shared a few dishes and each one was just so good - fresh, nutritious, flavourful and authentic. It was cosy and comfortable and catered well for all dietary needs including excellent vegan choices. We will be back!

The two of us loved our experience at Petra. Excellent service, phenomenal food. We ate so quickly it was so good. The cardamom milk tea was so comforting and delicious and the semolina was absolutely unique and the best dessert I’ve had.

A fabulous family business! The young women who were looking after us were so lovely and helpful. They made the experience so special and the service was exceptional. The food was delicious, the hummus was very creamy. Will definitely be back!!!!

It was my first time trying their restaurant and oh my days! firstly the staff were the most lovely people and wanted to give us the most genuine and enjoyable experience, as well as just having a good laugh! Let alone the FOOD!! IT was amazing, my friends and I thoroughly enjoyed the cozy atmosphere combined with the delicious food. We had the best time! Thank you to the team!

This food was unbelievable. So delicious!! And the service was outstanding, the wait staff were so warm, friendly and helpful. If you want traditional Jordanian cuisine, go to Petra Shawarma. Definitely coming back

This is our favourite weekly treat! Easily the best Thai in Auckland. They are so affordable, quick and friendly. The service is so good and the food is amazing. We’ve tried different dishes and they are always amazing!

Wow! What an awesome find! This is easily the best Thai restaurant in Auckland. Our favourite mains are the Pad see ew and Green curry, both are always so delicious and fresh. Highly recommend their money bags as an appetizer! Everything is cooked to perfection. The owners are amazing and so friendly. We also called on Top Ten to cater for an event, and they went above and beyond for us. Their portions were generous and the price was great too. Thank you!

We have just moved in round the corner and had all the family over for dinner. Ordered alot of food to take away and it was ready to pick up on time. food was some of the best thai takeway ive ever had and lots of flavour and good portion sizes, We will make this our new regular and so handy.

Amazing food! We did a big order for our company lunch and we were blown away how delicious EVERYTHING was. It was great as they did catering sizes of everything we were after. Such great value and quality of food. The owners were so lovely to deal with when ordering and on the day we picked up. They were great to accommodate dietary requirements. We even received a complimentary fruit platter which was a treat! The garlic rice was a favourite in the office and we are so happy there is leftovers for tomorrow!! 🤩 We all wish we could order from Top Ten Thai every time we have company lunch. We will be back soon! 🥰

Best pad Thai we had in NZ so far. The couple is welcoming and the environment complements their food. Best part- they accomodate your dietary requirements ( we asked for that and they confirmed while taking order and at the time of receiving food. We wish you all the best and for sure we will be visiting you frequently.

Pretty good cantonese style food, wok hei is excellent in the fried rice. Got the family meal pack, sweet sour pork, chicken fried rice and beef chow mein for $45 plus 1 curry rice rolls and spring roll for $3. 20 each. Tip.. Bring your own bag for the akeaways otherwise they charge you 50c or $1

Place was very clean, service was acceptable, took a while to get served and I was the only one in the place, took even longer to get my food, could hear the Uber Eats application going off, so guess I was dumped down the priority queue, would go back and try again though
Always my favourite to have takeaways from. Would really recommend their dumplings, chicken fried rice & beef chow mein☺️
Paid for $8 for chips and this is what we recieved! This is appalling. Response back from owner was that it’s a dollar a gram and I said well I won’t be buying from here ever again.

The $20 dollar pack is such a good deal. The nuggets, hot dogs and wontons are so delicious and cooked well. I love the deep fried chocolate bar too it is sooo good. Definitely worth the money, hygiene is also good. I see the cook clean his pan every time which is probably why your food taste so nice and fresh😮‍💨. 10/10

Overall 5/5. The staff are nice and recommended us to combine the popular marinated prawn and salmon salad together, since ordering both would be too much for 2 of us. I’d recommend this salad if you love raw food. Seafood Tom yum hot pot is amazing, $42 and generous portion size, tasty soup with full of fish, prawn, squid and vegetables. The stir fried pork mince on rice is kinda a specialty at Kiin, unique dark soy sauce flavor with a bit crispy & crunchy, so good with rice. The place is clean and tidy, also super busy even after 2pm, better book your table if u wanna come at a peak time.

Authentic little Thai restaurant on Dominion Road. Love their Tom yum soup, prawn twisters and Tom yum wonton. It's like eating Thai food in Bangkok. I like how they have kept the original flavours and spiciness as sometimes I find some restaurants "localized" the food to suit local tastes at the cost of losing it's authenticity. If this is what you're looking for, then it won't disappoint. The crab meat fried rice is also nicely cooked and good value for money as the portion is huge with lots of crab meat. The pad Thai and curry puffs were a little disappointing though, I've had much tastier pad Thai and curry puffs in other Thai restaurants. The curry lamb shank is next level. The aroma of the curry and tenderness of the lamb makes this dish unbeatable but be warned, it is quite spicy. Stir fried minced pork with basil is another must-try. Overall, the food are all well beyond expectations (except for pad Thai). Not 5 stars because i think there's room for improvement in their service level. There are only 2 waiters/waitresses and they are not very attentive. We had to ask them a few times for water and clear the plates to make room for other dishes etc.

Six of us went there and ordered 2 starters and 6 main dishes. Each of us paid around $30 which is really reasonable. All the dishes looked great and yummy although Pad Thai & papaya salad could be better flavour wise. Very clean restaurant with friendly services. Definitely recommended. You may need a booking as it is always busy there.

I had an amazing experience. Despite being quite busy, the staff were incredibly kind, and our food arrived surprisingly fast. Every dish we ordered was absolutely delicious. The flavors were so authentic and enjoyable that they made me want to visit Thailand just to experience more Thai cuisine!

I have been here many times but just have a chance to drop off love and appreciation... The food here... every dishes tastes athletic, delicious and every taste has a great impact on my heart... It means so much when you live so far away from home... This restaurant makes me feel like home. Thank you. Furthermore, high quality ingredients that I can easily notice and the homey chef who is always put not just skill and effort but caring and kindness. ❤️❤️ ขอบคุณมากๆคะ

We ordered a Croque Monsieur, Croque Madame, spicy chai latte, cappuccino, and an almond croissant. The chai latte had a hint of ginger — it was tasty. The almond croissant was crisped in the oven, unlike most cafés where it's just served on a plate. We bought a lemon meringue for our tea break. We'll definitely go back again.

Really grateful that there is such a nice cafe near the rocket park with my bubba. Authentic french id say since the cashier is french and they have so much variety of food choices. I had tried their croissant and pies are both great. My brunch this time is truffle creme mushroom sandwich.

enjoyed brunch on a Saturday noon, the atmosphere is good, and its always crowded yet easy to find a place to sit, the parking could be a messy affair at the back on NW or off street carparks.. speaking of food it stands out for good quality and good service by the staff.

My boyfriend said that the pastries and the food were amazing, unfortunately I couldn’t try the pastries since I’m vegan but I asked if they could make anything vegan and they made this delicious pumpkin, peas and avocado. Would be amazing if they could make some vegan pastries but I understand that it is harder/expensive. We recommend this place!
Love this place. Friendly and attentive staff. Great selection of food, coffee and desserts.

Very disappointed with the service at KFC St Lukes Westfield on July 11, 2025, around 2:28 PM. My wife and I ordered takeaway, but the food was prepared for dine-in. When I politely asked if it was supposed to be takeaway, the staff member glared at us twice with an angry expression, making us very uncomfortable. Can you believe your KFC staff behave this extremely rude and unprofessional. When I asked why she looked so unhappy, the manager came over blaming us for not saying earlier it was takeaway when the staff prepared the food But how we know It was our order ？？？What ？even if it was my mistake for choosing dine in ，how can i believe that your staff glared at me like i am doing something unforgivable ？Excuse me ！？ The restaurant was not busy, and even if there was a mix-up, that does not excuse the staff’s behavior. We were polite the whole time and didn’t deserve to be treated this way. Not what we expected from KFC .Ridiculous！Train your staff and your manager as well ！
Poor service, long wait time. Chips made were stale and over cooked. Replaced chips with no issues much fresher and crisp. I blame management not staff for staffing numbers.
The original chicken was pretty bland. it seems like they forgot to add the spices. It's not like it used to be. I probably won't bother buying KFC again
Food is always good quality, Staff are friendly, always very fast
Great service and food was fresh sangam and manisha out stand service working as team together the graveyard was smooth and tasty some outlets are lumpy
The spicy chicken was sooooo authentic, not only the ingredients but also the cooking method. The best spicy chicken I’v had in Auckland! Grilled fish and beef were good too!

Juns Grill Fish in Auckland Domain is one of the best seafood restaurants I've ever visited. The place was spotless, and the staff were incredibly welcoming. The food was not only delicious but also very affordable, with generous portions. I was impressed by their extensive menu that even caters to vegetarians, making it a perfect spot for everyone. Highly recommend!

Food:(5/5) We had the mild spicy grilled whole fish which was literally the best that I’ve ever had! Fish was deep fried so the skin was so flavourful and a bit crispy and the meat was so tender inside. We also ordered some extra veggies and meat to put into the pot which were so delicious with the fish soup. The cold dish was also very tasty. Service:(5/5) Family owned little restaurant, cosy and accommodating. The lady owner was super friendly. Highly recommended this little gem for grilled fish!
The food is really delicious and enjoys the service, spend really good time with friends.

I believe it offers the best grilled fish in Auckland. Initially, We were a little worried that the food would be a disappointment because of the littile reviews. To my surprised, every dish we ordered is yummy and we love this restaurant! The service was friendly and the dishes warmed my heart.
Haven't been here for awhile but still a great place to have some really nice foods. Awesome place to celebrate a birthday 🎂
Gets bizy other than that mad cooking makes a big difference to the food and even having suggestions on wat types of food to grab helps too. Loving it

I have no complaints when dining here gengis Epsom . Even when busy I still enjoy the food and the quality , it's always a pleasure to eat here , my recent visit the kumura fries , and Fish Bao were a highlight super delicious , food was always getting topped up , dessert is always a treat and the pancakes always hot sweet and yummy. Thank you to the staff , cooks and team. Loved it. Highly recommend.

Absolutely loved the staff there they were kind and very helpful. We had a lively service as there was a group of us there for a birthday. The manager and the staff aloud us to put the cake in the fridge until we were ready to do the cake. The also gave us a knife and also helped us sing happy birthday to my mother in law.

Celebrated mums birthday here, the Owner and staff were very accommodating and friendly. The outside covered area he set us up in was perfect for our group. Food was solid 👌🏽 Highly recommend this spot.

Ordered online for pick up, the Thai red duck curry was amazing! My partner seems to enjoy his crispy pork with rice. The mee goreng was average, not sure if it’s the right noodles to use for mee goreng, was soggy. Prices are competitive for the area and portion generous.

Can't recommend this place enough!! The staff here are so kind and the food portions are massive and very affordable!! I haven't had a portion this big in ages. I didn't think anyone did them like this anymore. My partner is quite a big Māori guy (he eats a lot, haha). 9 times out of 10, when we eat out, he's not full. But we had left overs for lunch! The food also taste great too and looks beautiful.

Love Wok n Noodle! Always great taste and have consistently lived up to the hype. I've had takeaway and dined in many times over the years. The pork belly is a constant favourite and the whiskey duck is another.

Have been here several times now. The food never disappoints with taste, presentation and time getting on the table. The ambience of the shop is warm and inviting. And the staff are welcoming and attentive. I would recommend this place to anyone after comfort, Thai food.
Absolutely amazing food with very awesome staff working will most certainly be making it a main place to eat whenever I return to Mt Eden
Great place to enjoy yumcha. It is located in Auckland CBD, huge variety of food to choose. Lovely staff, and very fair price. Their dimsum was made freshly, and the desserts were also great.

I went for yamcha with my colleagues yesterday. The place is nice and offers private rooms for added privacy. I recommend making a reservation and arriving early, as there can be a long wait if you're late. We had a 90-minute dining limit. However, the service was quite disappointing. We experienced a situation where the waiter served us food we didn't order; they simply dropped it on our table and noted it on the order sheet. It's important to inform them if you receive something you didn't request. I recommend trying the spicy fried chicken and the roasted pork.
Food is delicious and they still have carts 🛒 to let you select the dimsum you want. But they will try to put dishes in your table if you don’t know how to say no. Sauces is self serve.

This could be my most favorite Yum Cha spot in Akl. Highly recommend! Very attentive staff, great food & it was busy when we visited during lunch time. Favorite items were the baked oysters, century egg Congee, Turnip cake, Taro puffs, pineapple custard buns & the greens. All food was delicious & the tea was a nice touch 😋👌🏾✨
One of the better Dum Sum restaurants in Auckland. Authentic in food taste and service. Recommend!

Not only is the food at Sake Nippon Bar delicious, but the portion sizes are ideal. We ate a range of dishes, but my personal favourite was the chicken katsu. The chicken was fresh, flavourful and crunchy. The service is excellent. Food is served promptly. The atmosphere is conducive to conversation. However, on other occasions, it has been quite loud.

I had a nice visit to this Japanese shop! What really stands out are the great vibes and super friendly service. The prices are fair, which is a big plus. If you're after a wide range of dishes, you might find the menu a bit limited, and the food is on the basic side. But for a relaxed atmosphere and good value, it's definitely worth checking out.

Love this place. Have been coming for years. If you are wanting to enlighten your senses book now. Sapporo on tap up first. Then jump into the menu and order everything. Then order some of their delicious sake. Finish with the homemade basque cheesecake, it is heavenly light and delicious. Thank me later

Introduced by a mate of mine. Walked in around 7ish on Friday and the atmosphere was pretty cool. It wasn’t busy busy. But, got busier later on. First ordered Draft beer wasn’t really tasty(too thin). Shoulda order bottles instead! Tried Cold and warm sake and highballs.. pretty average. Food-wise.. not so perfect. Tsukene skewers were the best. But, the rest were… hmmmm, not sure if I order next time. The Staff were super responsive and super kind!!! I guess this place is for me to just chill out with a few mates for a quick beer and a small snack. I’d love to go back once again to see if I change my review on this spot.🤔
We’ve been eating here for many years. Return from over two years overseas and have come back to have a meal. Everything still taste the same. Menu reduced, however, still yummy. Recommended.

This is one of my and my partner’s favorite Vietnamese restaurants. The food is always delicious and authentic, and the prices are very reasonable. Whether we're looking for a casual meal or a comforting dish, this place never disappoints. It’s our reliable go-to spot whenever we’re unsure of where to eat. Highly recommend it for great Vietnamese cuisine!
Fabulous! Food is so good, huge servings! Service is great, very friendly and super quick.

Came here on New years Eve. I'm so glad they were open, too. Food was delicious and served within minutes of ordering. I love the layout and size of the premesis. Staff was also very helpful and professional 👍 served us with a genuine smile 😊 unlike some places. Thanks and will be coming back again and again 🤗

Paid NZ$22 for 1 pan fried chicken with lemongrass and rice noodles, and NZ$21 for 1 pan fried pork with lemongrass and egg noodles. The pork was soft, tender and flavourful, tasted just like Singapore pork satay. The chicken was soft and tender but not as tasty as the pork. The lemongrass was not cooked with the chicken but left on top. The egg noodles were springy. The soup was nicely flavoured, not overpowering like miso soup. Service was friendly and efficient. Ambience was relaxing with soft background music.
This place has been around for 10+ years. I haven't been back for such a long time but but quality essentially stays the same. It's always a solid quick meal with a Vietnamese inspired cuisine.

It’s been a long time since I’ve eaten in such a delicious Japanese restaurant. The decoration of the restaurant has a Japanese atmosphere. The owner will come over to introduce the meals one by one, and will also introduce today's special menu. The food is delicious and it’s a restaurant worth going to again

Had the tanto sushi lunch that happens once a month for around $60+ pp. The experience was very authentic and was one of the best authentic sushi that i've had in NZ. Most of nz sushi is Americanised and sweet and although taste good I still prefer the just fish with rice. All the dish here had a lot of natural taste to it but taste very delicious. The sushi ingredients was fresh and I especially love the sweet potato tempura. The tempura reminds me of a place in Japan where they focused on the item being fried to bring out its naturalness and the batter was just a light batter that doesn't overwhelm whats inside. The sweet potato tempura was the best and had really nice texture. Overall very enjoyed the meal and experience and highly recommend for people to treat themselves and come here.

This little Japanese restaurant offers such lovely sashimi. The prawn and scallops were so tasty. The staff were so very nice and food was served quick. They offer great quality rice which makes such a big difference to the food. Price was very good. I would recommend coming here for special occasion or just to treat yourself.
Top quality ingredients and attentive staff make this place worth a dedicated culinary trip. Absolutely recommend!

It was our second time visiting Tanto and I'm really glad we decided to come again for another very enjoyable dining experience. The atmosphere is cozy and elegant, relaxed and unpretentious. The owner is a very welcoming and gracious host. The food is a good balance of traditional Japanese dishes tuned just right to western tastes so everyone will be able to find something appetizing whether they're re familiar with Japanese food or not. And don't miss out on the desserts! The sesame tiramisu with matcha ice cream is a delicious and unique treat, highly recommend. Definitely one of the better Japanese restaurants I've visited in NZ!

This was the highlight meal of my trip. I had been hankering for crepes since before I arrived! A few earlier attempts at scratching this itch had been underwhelming (and what is it with banoffee crepes in NZ!). This little cafe is in a beautiful suburban area of Auckland not too far away from so descent sized green spaces. And doggo friendly (back deck area). There are both inside and outside seating options. We choose outside which is at the rear and sheltered by plastic screens. Crepe options here are truly drool worthy. Of course, my heart was set on one without Nutella but really liked the toasted coconut idea... no problem at all ... homemade caramel and toasted coconut crepe coming up! And it was delish! My cousin had the egg dish option and also agreed this was the best breakfast of the 2-week trip (perfectly made, generous and tasty!). I also ordered a hashbrown as we were curious as to the difference between hashbrown and hash cake ... see photos. Both perfectly golden and yum. I will definitely be seeking this cafe out again next visit!
This place was excellent - food was great - we really enjoyed our morning here. We sat outside on the deck which was very pleasant. Food was as delicious as it looks we will be back!
Great coffee and meals, wonderful customer service and lovely warm environment!!
Crepes and brunch food is consistently delicious. Service is okay, the folks do their job well but never smile. Been ordering here for 18+ months now, happy to keep coming back 🙂

The food and service are the stars here. The coffee was brilliant. The portions are generous and taste great. The decor is plain, but it is an open space with huge sunny windows. Definitely keen to return, convenient parking in side road.

Felt as very unique and authentic place with nice design and heaps of thematic details. The food was served quickly and beautifully presented. We were met at the door by a very welcoming man with a cool sense of humor (might be the owner). And again food was just amazing especially paella. The fire place is on top of everything. Really nice to sit next to the fire during the meal Thank to the staff
First time tried Spanish restaurant. I ordered slow cook lamb, was absolutely yummy. Also, the dessert is worth to try.
Food was delicious and slightly better than expectations, highly recommend the tapas. The service was good and attentive. Awesome ambience too. Would definitely be visiting again.

I had such a great experience here! I accidentally broke a glass (so sorry 😅), but the staff were incredibly kind and understanding. They changed our table without any fuss and even brought out fresh food for us. The service was amazing, and the atmosphere was super cozy and welcoming. It’s rare to find a place that treats customers with so much care. I’ll definitely be coming back — highly recommend!

Relaxing atmosphere with Spanish vibes. Feels like I was teleported to Spain. On top of that, we had good food. I recommend the paella and the cordero (lamb). We shared as well a liter of sangria, which we really enjoyed. Although the food was filling, we had some desserts and theä churros were super yummy. I highly recommend them as well as the tiramisu. The service was excellent, too. The prices are a bit higher but with the quality of food, I reckon it is fine. They have big tables as well perfect for big groups.

Only realised this after travelling home. my fault for not checking

To my surprise, I overheard from the next table that there has been a change of ownership. No complaints here, seems like they’re carrying on the tradition of good tasting Malaysian food.

We went here on a Friday afternoon and the food was indeed flavorful and with right portions. The place was fully packed and it is certainly popular to locals. The service is friendly and efficient, with staff despite the busyness is eager to recommend dishes and explain the ingredients if you're unfamiliar with the menu. The wait times during that visit was long, but I can’t blame the staffs as it was a Friday evening and everyone wants to eat and have a good time. One thing to consider though is the parking especially during busy hours. Otherwise food was great and authentic!
The best Malaysian food in all of Auckland! Big fan of the Malaysian style sweet and sour pork, be sure to try an ice cold Orion lager on tap. James Ashwin Kakapo Business Sales

Joyful Restaurant, Epsom, Auckland** I had been looking forward to dining at Joyful Restaurant, given its reputation as a 30-year-old establishment in Epsom, Auckland. Unfortunately, my experience today was far from joyful and left me deeply disappointed. I feel compelled to share my experience in detail, as I believe it reflects significant issues with both the food quality and service. I pre ordered the Chinese herb duck, which was decent but nothing extraordinary. The real letdown came with the pre ordered black fur BBQ pork, which was recommended by the lady boss. When the dish arrived, I was shocked to see that it was almost entirely fat with very little meat. I politely brought this to the lady boss’s attention, and while she acknowledged that it was fatty, she insisted it was still tasty. I tried a few bites, but the texture and overwhelming fattiness were so unappetizing that I couldn’t finish it. It felt like a waste of money and left a bad impression. To make matters worse, the service was excruciatingly slow. We waited 45 minutes for our initial dishes to arrive, which is already excessive for a restaurant that wasn’t particularly busy. After realizing the BBQ pork was inedible, I ordered a lamb dish as a replacement, hoping it would salvage the meal. However, it took another 40 minutes to arrive, bringing the total wait time to nearly an hour and a half for a complete meal. This level of delay is completely unacceptable, especially when the food quality doesn’t justify the wait. The lamb dish itself was average—nothing special to write home about, and certainly not worth the extended wait. By the time it arrived, I had already lost my appetite and just wanted to leave. The entire experience felt like a waste of time and money. For a restaurant with such a long history in Auckland, I expected much better. The combination of poor food quality, slow service, and lack of accountability (defending a dish that was clearly subpar) was deeply disappointing. I truly hope Joyful Restaurant can address these issues and regain the trust of its customers. As it stands, I cannot recommend this place based on my experience today. There are far better dining options in Auckland that deliver both quality and timely service.
Our all time favourite. Their lobster and steamed orange roughy fish is a must eat and best in town!

Had a wonderful meal here at Joyful Chinese Restaurant. The staff were attentive and provided excellent service, and the dining area is well kept and comfortable. The menu had a large range of choice and we found the food to be authentic and really tasty. In particular, our vegetable dishes were superb, perfectly cooked, not oily, nicely seasoned and beautifully presented. The restaurant has been going for 27 years. It was really great to talk with the owners, who are friendly and take great pride in their service to customers and the food they serve. I recommend the tasty food at Joyful Chinese Restaurant.

Visited here with friends and family while on vacation for lunch. Highlights include shrimp scampi specialty and lobster yi mein. Dad especially enjoyed the poached pork liver, said it was very tender (perhaps not to everyone's tastebuds) The ginger scallion steamed fish was extremely fresh and tasty! Loved the mei gan steamed tofu- just like homemade. The friendly owner greeted every table and talked with all of us. High recommend! Would love to come back!

Had a birthday dinner with 10 friends last night. The food are great. I am from Canton. The Cantonese food here is the one of the best Chinese restaurants in Auckland. The service are very nice and friendly. My husband’s non-Chinese colleagues love the dishes too. The peking duck is so good. I love the sauce so much and no one take photos( lol). Last night the restaurant was full house, so the space was a bit small for a big table. next time I might choose lunch time to come or dinner in weekdays.

Had a wonderful meal here with my son. We both appreciated the gorgeous historic building and the delicious food. My son had the pork ribs and I had the chicken. The meat was very tender and juicy and the sauce tasty. The only improvement would be to serve the meals on heated plates. Other than that, we were both really happy with our dining experience at Sen.

This is a return visit, I was here with a group of friends. The food was good and it was a warm city atmosphere. The waiter had to be flagged down several times to get drinks and order dessert. It was not busy. He needed to be more aware. I had the duck it was tender and found the sauce a bit sweet. My friend who had the beef cheek curry loved it. The chocolate dessert was ok, but little dry the ice cream saved it. The espresso was incredible and worth a return visit.

Great food with a nice ambience! We got the shaking beef, chargrilled chicken and salmon curry. Beef was juicy and tender, chicken paired well with the peanut satay sauce. Salmon curry was an interesting combination, it wasn’t bad but both have distinct flavours so I felt like they did not blend but this was expected. Service could be a little bit improved as it felt a slow but we were in a group setting so we could just chat away.

I had a great experience at Sen Vietnamese Kitchen for a group dinner. The ambiance was inviting, and we had good-sized portions to share. I particularly liked being seated at the mezzanine level. The food was tasty, although the braised pork was a bit salty for my liking. Overall, the service was excellent, making for a lovely evening!

Loved it!! Flavours were delicious and authentic. Everything tasted so good! Really enjoyed the beef pho, spring rolls, beef cheek curry and passionfruit prawns. The staff were lovely and great service. The ambience was nice but on the darker side, the only downside was the tables weren’t quite designed for larger groups as they put together two round tables for our group of 7 so it was a bit awkward.

had an amazing experience at this burger place in Mt eden! The portions were huge and the food was absolutely delicious. The staff were all women on the day I visited — they were incredibly friendly, welcoming, and made me feel very comfortable. The place was also very clean and well-maintained. I really enjoyed my visit and would definitely come back. Highly recommend!

BurgerFuel is hands down one of my go-to burger joints here in Auckland, and for good reason! I'm a regular, and their CN Cheese Burger is consistently outstanding – seriously, it's a flavour bomb every single time. The patty is always perfectly cooked, juicy and packed with that delicious beefy taste, complemented by the melted cheese and fresh ingredients that make every bite incredibly satisfying. And let's not forget the fries – they're just as impressive. Crispy on the outside, fluffy on the inside, and seasoned perfectly, they're the ideal accompaniment to their amazing burgers. Whether I'm grabbing a quick bite or settling in for a proper meal, BurgerFuel never disappoints. It’s the kind of place where you know you’re going to get a quality feed that hits all the right spots. If you haven't tried their CN Cheese Burger with a side of those fantastic fries, you're missing out!
Best fries in town. Crispy, hot fresh. Consistently so. My favourite place for fries and burgers. Order on the app and food is available by the time you pick up.

Our server (guy in the blue hat) I believe his name was Steven or Stefan. Was lovely and very attentive to other customers. He served us and others with a smile. We came on Wednesday night for 2 for 1.

It's my go to for dinner often. Reasonable price, fresh food, huge portion, extremely delicious, with their mouth-watering sides. I also participated in one of their burgerfuel competitions and they gave away 3 free burger coupons for my efforts in participating. I just love 'em very much. The staffs are also very friendly at all times given the fact that it's one of the busiest places.

The old lady provided us a sweet and lovely service, she is really nice and attentive to family with young children, not just for us but for other families with young kids dinning there. We were dinning with our 3 year old toddler, and we just let him sit in a regular chair, she was a sweet to offer us a solid seat cushion to make sure my toddler can eat comfortably. The food was authentic and nostalgic for my husband. Very well priced. Don’t expect fancy decor or posh service, this place gives a vibe of going to eat at your grandmother’s house.

Friendly service, lovely interior decor and lighting with ultra fast serving time, decent prices and portion sizes! Sizzling beef came out very prettily, strong pepper smell. Tender vegetables and chewy beef-not the softest but definitely not tough by all means. Just the right amount of flavor without needs for accompanying with rice. 7.5/10 Salted duck not too salty just right, tender meat. Pretty tasty and needn't accompany with rice. 8/10 Fried bread crisp upon bite but I find it a bit too thick and bread like for my taste. Had it with the sweet soy bean milk which was average, just your run-of-the-mill sweet Soy. 6/10 Beans had a very strong when brought over and smelt delicious. The mixture accompanying the beans were fabulous and chicken was good as it contained flavor and was not bland. 8/10 Meatball soup fresh watery soup flavor, the meatball was extremely tender and falls apart when spooned, taste was delightful, recommend! 8.5/10 Steamed buns juice was hot, the perfect blend of savory and sweet, the meat soft and succulent and the wrap in no way overpowers the taste of the bun. 8.5/10 Fried bun filled with similar soup to the steamed buns but less amount, pork filling was again succulent. This time the bun amount was more but that's a given for the type of bun it is. The bottom is crispy and topped with sesame and added a lovely crunch to the bun. 8/10

Came here for lunch sometime ago. Was pretty quiet on this day. The restaurant was pleasant and sitting was comfortable. However on this day an elderly lady was serving us. She was not able to speak English and needed the man inside the kitchen to come and take our order. Presumably he was the cook. Except for the duck dish the others were reasonably eatable. The duck dish was not good at all. The meat was so hard. I could not even chew it. This dish is definitely not recommended. If you are keen to try I strongly advise that you order freshly cooked dishes and not ready made cold dishes.
Food is delicious. The old couple are very nice.
What a gem! Fantastic, fresh food, the dumplings were to die for. Would wholeheartedly recommend!
Prawn toast and Tom yum soup were delicious. Thai fish cakes were tasty. All other dishes were ok however our steamed fish and roti were particularly oily and unpleasant. Staff very friendly.

Lovely restaurant and helpful staff. However it took 90 minutes plus for our food to arrive. Seasonings are quite mild and bland, but maybe we should have asked for Thai seasonings. Price is $30+ for mains.

Pretty much perfect here, great venue, authentic dishes, good spacing between tables, well lit, menu range. Friendly and attentive staff that periodically pass by to check up on you to make sure that all your needs are fulfilled.

The food, ambience, and service were excellent and prompt! The staff was warm and friendly, adding to the overall pleasant experience. The only downside was the off-street parking, which can be a bit tricky at times. However, the delicious food and welcoming service more than make up for it. Highly recommended!

I discovered another lovely Thai restaurant in Epsom. I visited with a friend last night and it still has that same charming vibe. The place is clean, has a fantastic atmosphere and offers great food at reasonable prices with attentive service. For appetizers, we tried the soft shell crab, a seafood platter for two, and Thai fried chicken, all of which were delicious. But you absolutely must try their black pepper fish—it's on another level. I can't wait to go back.
As expected a good pub experience with your favourite Belgian beers available and a few food specials to tempt. The lunch staff were cheerful and efficient.

Must-Try Mussels Spot in Auckland 🥂🦪 If you’re a mussel lover, this place is a gem! Fresh, juicy, and cooked to perfection.The creamy garlic sauce with bacon & cheese — paired with a cold beer or crisp white wine, it’s the perfect chill-out meal. Highly recommend if you’re in the Mt Eden
Absolutely amazing, cosy place, delicious food (mussels absolutely divine) great choice of beers, super friendly staff, reasonable prices. If you're in the area don't miss it! Thanks guys!

I’ve had better burgers at McDonald’s. Literally the worst burger I’ve ever had. I took colleagues from overseas here and it was embarrassing how bad the food was. This was on Wednesday - $15 burger night - hopefully they don’t serve those burgers to people paying full price. I didn’t even care about the cost as work was paying but really felt like a burger. The tiniest piece of ‘buttermilk’ fried chicken imaginable, on a stale bun with some sticky sauce and not much else. One colleague had the (full priced) steak and didn’t say anything about it so hopefully that wasn’t as bad. The chips were the highlight but there weren’t a huge amount of them. Service was pleasant. Beer was good (pretty hard to get that wrong). Have been coming here for many years for the mussel pots and will stick to those if I come back in future.

Always a good time, the scouts and dark beers on tap are absolutely delicious. The food is on mark and so if the service. This lovely gem.of a place has become a regular haunt for our family. Keep up the great work guys. Thanks
Yum as. Nice coffee, delicious cake. NI e atmosphere. Not cheap. $10.50 for a slice of cheesecake, but it was a good-sized piece, and the best I've tasted for a long time.

BEST CAFE EXPERIENCE! My husband and I popped into this cute cafe by chance and we had the most amazing lunch. Beautiful natural flavors. Great frappe. Great coffee. Excellent service (table order). Good value for money (main lunch meals between $15-$25). Definitely recommend if you are travelling through or a local to make this your new spot.

Visited this cute cafe on Valentine’s day, and despite the bustling atmosphere, the manager and waitstaff were attentive and extremely personable. Food was delicious and had generous portions. Thanks for the experience :)
Great service very welcoming staff. Dog and kid friendly. Ordered the toasted sandwich with a matcha drink where both were tasty.
an amazing place for brunch! service and food was so lovely and the atmosphere is very nice. beetroot relish with the eggs bene was an amazing touch

I recently visited Burger Wisconsin in Mt Eden, and it was a great experience! The burgers were fresh, juicy, and full of flavor, made with quality local ingredients. There were plenty of options to choose from, whether you like classic or unique flavors. The staff were friendly and served the food quickly. The place had a warm and welcoming atmosphere. If you’re in Auckland and want a delicious burger, Burger Wisconsin Mt Eden is definitely worth a visit!

Burger Wisconsin knows how to treat their vegetarians right! The veggie burger was delicious – full of texture and taste, and not overly greasy like some places. It was fresh, filling, and felt like real comfort food without the guilt. Will definitely be back for another one!

Very average burgers despite being big. Service was good but hygiene questionable. Got there just after 12pm. A little grossed out by the fact that the person prepping, cooking, and serving at the counter was the same person AND they were not wearing gloves. I paid by cash so let's hope they washed their hands before making the next order. On the flip side, the burgers were slightly above average.
