Idk what people are saying about the size, but the grand size are big burgers compared to their competitors. The beef burgers are more worth it than the chicken ones though. Their naked chicken (just grilled chicken breast) definitely seemed a bit smaller in comparison. Having said that, although they had somewhat sufficient protein and the buns were big enough to hold things together, the seasoning was poor and the sauce was lacking. They are definitely the least greasy burgers you can probably get though given they are grilled instead of cooked on a flat top, and you can tell they were made with care. It was 2 for 1 today, so about $20 for two large burgers is very good. However, they are probably not worth appx. $20 for one as you can get much better burgers for less from non-chain stores these days.
Great selection of burgers. Small and big so will suit your appetite! I love that they aren't in brioche buns too....very filling and good sides too!
Best and biggest burgers in town I've tasted

Such a great little kebab spot. Went in for a late night kebab and chip sesh and was absolutely delighted by the Cajun chicken wrap with the little parsley leaves in there. Staff were really friendly and kind, even though it was near to closing. The atmosphere is quite magical with all the beautiful lights and whatnot and it honestly put me in a better mood. What a blessed place. Thank you.

This place used to be very good, cheap and nice people. So sad it is not anymore! I was in a rush to get some more rice for group dinner, I didn't expect that they charged me $20 for only two containers of plain rice! Only for plain rice! They even didn't fill up the container. I am so disappointed! I used to go there quite often before. Not recommend anymore!
Best Afghan burger and Sheeryakh ever!!
Been a few times now but unable to try the sheryakh ice cream as sometimes randomly its closed or when its open its not available.
They have just added new afghani icecream stall that is handmade and super delicious! Very nice alongside their kebab and mixed meat on salad 👍 worth the visit, and kind owners too 😊

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Gina’s Italian Kitchen The food at Gina’s was absolutely delicious and on point! The pizza was really tasty, and the pasta was the bomb – full of flavor and cooked perfectly. The staff were super friendly and helpful, which made the experience even better. We’ll definitely be coming back! Also, don’t skip dessert – it’s a must-have!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Gina’s Italian Kitchen Chilled vibes, great service, and seriously good wood-fired pizza and pasta . Staff were friendly and the food came out quick. Perfect spot for a casual night out. Will definitely be back! 🍕🇮🇹

A colleague recommended Gina’s so I thought going there for my birthday would be ideal. The staff were friendly and helpful. The food was amazing - food coma at the end!!! I would gladly return to try other menu items

Love coming here for a pizza. The pizzas are delicious and light. The outdoor garden area is a perfect spot to enjoy your meal, and it’s great to know they’re dog-friendly, so you can bring them along. It's also a fantastic place for drinks, with a great selection to choose from. Whether you're enjoying a casual meal or having drinks with friends, this place never disappoints!

Happy faces come from good food. A friend from Poland visited and took her with other peers to Gina’s before the flight offs. Had a chance as well to chat with the cook while he’s on break. Our genuine smiles signifies of our satisfaction with the quality of food, happy service and beautiful outdoor garden atmosphere. This restaurant definitely gives you an authentic Italian taste!

I order Uber eats the other night and got the Massaman curry. Upon opening up the rice, there was a long black hair in the rice? That was absolutely disgusting! 🤢 Food hygiene and prep is so important so this is prevented. Get your staff to tie up their hair and wear a food neat.

This review is well overdue! You guys are hands-down my favorite place for Thai Takeaway - it’s just DELICIOUS. I order at least once a week (usually through Uber eats) and I honestly can’t praise you enough. Great food, great price - always a winner.
Great service, very friendly staff, authentic Thai cuisine. Very recommended.

Tiny little shop on Dominion road, you can miss it if you don't pay attention to the green signage. Not expected any only looked for a place to have my dinner after my clinic appointment. Staffs are extremely friendly, great service great hospitality. First time here so simply ordered the menu on the wall, and that was my best decision to make. Tasty Yummy Very authentic Thai flavour I will come back for sure, absolutely a hidden treasure. Highly recommended.👍

Little gem in Mt Eden. This place doesn’t look fancy but the food is really good. We like to come here if we are looking for some decent Thai street food. One of the best thai milk tea in Auckland. Highly recommend this place if you are after some authentic thai food. Food: 🌕🌕🌕🌕🌑 Price: 🌕🌕🌕🌗🌑 Ambience: 🌕🌕🌕🌕🌑 Service: 🌕🌕🌕🌕🌑

Great place to hang out. Staff is lovely and super friendly. We had such a great time in this hidden spot ( its down the alley). Food is really good too. They have great selection of draft beers and whiskies. We will be back 😍❤️

Proper little Irish pub with friendly staff, a pool table, weekly pub quiz and loads of cozy corners to sip a pint of Guinness. It’s a bit dank and sticky but it’s part of the charm. In the heart of the posh, preened, suited and booted retail soullessness that is Newmarket, The Claddagh is a haven of a drinking hole.
Great little Irish pub, been coming here for years. Called in again Friday 23 January 2025 for a nice cold Guinness pint 500ml $14👍🇮🇪🍀😋🍺 & again 2 July 2025, now $15.

A great Guinness pour. Cover photo makes it look much worse than it is. Its a pub, with a great pint, neat location and slightly down at heal interior. But its coy. Basic pub food (not eaten here though).

Very friendly bar staff and a cheeky dog running around makes it feel like a family pub. I had steak and was reasonably priced and good quality. I was the only person I. At 4pm on a Thursday afternoon but it soon filled up with a good mix of business and social customers.

Ordered online for pickup and my Karaage Curry with rice was waiting hot. It was so delicious and for 23$ it was pretty filling. The chicken was tender and the sauce had a mix of spice and richness I haven't had for a while. Their is a small seating area inside.

Such polite staff. There's a small bar so as the name suggests, it's best to take the food away since the eating space is almost nonexistent. Food seems expensive for the taste and portion, it's alright for a quick fix.

The food was bussin, absolutely delicious! The cook's food was bursting with flavor, perfectly seasoned, and clearly made with care. The bro solo'd it tonight busy with delivery orders and was just overall clutch.
Yummy fresh and delicious, I had a salmon salad it was so fresh and flavourful!

Rice Kitchen is a great Japanese takeaway! The staff are very friendly and welcoming, and the place has a cozy atmosphere that makes you feel comfortable while waiting or dining in. The food is delicious too, definitely recommend checking it out!

This is the best chinese takeaway in Auckland. We order the steak chow mein, pad thai, sweet and sour pork or chicken, plain fried rice and pan fried pork dumplings. The kai is always fresh and not greasy and quick. They work hard and the people serving are always friendly. When we have shared it with guests they always ask where we go and say it's so delicious. Thank you Diamond :)
Yummy, delicious, and fast. The fish only cost you five dollars and quite a big one. However, they don't accept Paywave, so please remember to bring your debit card here.

I ordered the special fried rice and was very disappointed. It was full of chicken and only tiny pieces of pork. And very tasteless. I'm comparing tonight's food with food bought in the past. It was several years ago so I'm assuming the chef has changed. Maybe you need a new cook. Definitely not worth $25.
We had the sweet & sour pork, combination fried rice and some deep fried wontons. So so good! Great service too. Highly recommend this place!
Stopped in for a prawn chow mein a few weeks ago. The dish was well cooked, but a little on the bland side - not much flavor. Had crispy noodles (not my favorite but still ok) and veges were fresh.
I have ordered a veggie pizza from their store and it was so delicious. Customer service was Also amazing. I think this is the best pizza I had. Everything was so perfect and yummy.

We order a double burger pizza and one portion of chicken tenders. The pizza is hand-made and made with plenty of nice ingredients. The chicken tenders are really juicy. Nice service and nice dining experience.

When I entered the restaurant, the floor was noticeably sticky like it had not been washed for a very long time...there were no other customers when I visited, so it was very quiet. The pizza was ok but not fantastic. For the snack sized pizza I paid $12.50. To be honest，I would rather buy 2 classic pizzas from domino's for $10 & i would get at least twice the size of pizza. Domino's tastes better too. Sorry hells pizza... I'm not likely to return.

Ordered the wrath pizza. 1 pepperoni per slice. 1 olive per slice. Tomato barely in the pizza. You order hells because it supposed to get a better product than dominos and Pizza Hut. Not the case, next time will do domino’s, cheaper and better. So disappointing.

Hello Pizza is always our top choice out of the three franchises. Ordered three pizzas for my kids tonight after their sports—everything was made to standard and ready on time for pick-up. The shop is now under new ownership, and the new owner was friendly and welcoming. Definitely coming back again!

Pathetic experience for a regular dominos customer. Got given a burnt pizza and i called in to come back and return it. Got a call from manager that cheesy crust are just like that. I have been getting the same crust from a while and never had a pizza like that. Mistakes happen but to cover it up is even worse. Then telling us that oh all the pizzas are coming like that. Well stop making pizza them in that crust if they are coming burnt. Lame excuses and trying to do a heated argument. Store needs to get a duty manager all the time as clearly they said no manager on duty when manager called me on the phone to return back to the store.

Ordered online a not complicated order at a what should be busy prime time for dinner night, and just before it was pretty much due to be delivered they canceled the ENTIRE order....we then ordered from a different dominos exact same order, no issue & super fast delivery. I'd have thought being in Mt Eden, a foodie area, they would be more onto it, but from its low rating & very mixed reviews I guess not. Beware!!! You may be left hungry lol....

Today, I went to pick up an order from a customer. While I was there, someone who works at the restaurant asked me to get a bag to keep the food warm. I stepped out of the restaurant to get my bag and returned to collect the food. As I was packing the food into the bag, the staff member at the counter, in a very harsh and disrespectful tone, told me to verify the order. I replied, "Please wait, I will verify it after I finish placing the food into the bag." However, this person rudely and aggressively pulled the food out of the bag and loudly shouted at me to leave the premises. Since my phone was on the counter, my hand accidentally touched the screen and the order got verified automatically. Later, this same person responded to a Google review and then messaged me directly on Messenger without following any proper social media communication guidelines. I want to clearly inform all my friends and contacts to never visit such restaurants, as they lack basic customer service, hospitality, and human decency. Moreover, it is concerning that they misused the information I left behind by contacting me directly, which I consider a form of harassment and intimidation. I intend to file an official complaint against this individual with the appropriate authorities

Pizza was ok; base could have been better. Maybe slicers need a regular clean as I could taste something unusual in my hawaiian pizza. Customer service was fantastic. Waiting time was 5-6mins which is quite good.

The last few orders have been a fail. When we ordered prawn pizza last weekend and got chicken and mushroom! Sadly I don't eat meat so that went in the bin. We got 2 vouchers so thought to use it last night 13 April and ordered 2 x garlic prawn pizza's- one thin base and one classic crust. Both pizza's arrive thin base!! Then one of the pizza's has chorizo pieces and mince meat and bacon bits on it along with the prawns which I DID NOT ORDER! Again my husband had to eat my pizza I don't eat MEAT!! And all I get is a generic message and another voucher which I don't care about! Never using Mt Eden Domino's again!

Firstly, I have been to Yokoso Sushi many times in person. DO NOT order from Uber Eats. Ordered the "Deluxe Bento" and it was anything but. The portion size of the bento box itself is completely a size smaller than advertised. The tempura consisted of one small fried gyoza, one small fried spring roll, a slice of tempura carrot, and two panko fried ebi. Sorry excuse for tempura. The rice and chicken katsu was half the portion as advertised in the photo of the menu item in Uber Eats. Two pieces of sushi was placed in the other half to make it look like a larger portion that it actually was. One of the sushi pieces was so thin it could not stand on its own and was barely wider than a thin slice of orange (not even a wedge). The other piece was a side piece. One of the nigiri was just katsu and the other was a thin slice of some seafood, couldn't even tell what it was. The third photo with the black bars on the sides is what was advertised. Compare that to what I got. Look at the difference. I didn't even bother taking a photo of the tempura because there was a single piece - the carrot. The salad was just cabbage, some edamame and noodle carrots. The only thing accurate in the whole bento was the four slices of salmon and an extra soy sauce. And they didn't even give me my miso soup! Charging $30 ($35 on UE) for this is a complete rip off. I appreciate the state of the economy isn't good, but what I got was a complete misrepresentation. Never going back again and never ordering Yokoso Sushi from Uber Eats again. Edit: Regarding the response from the business about the bento box size, their own photo shows a bigger bento box (that they use in restaurant) than the one they used for takeaway, meaning the takeaway SERVING is smaller! The size of the box is irrelevant!

You know when you are craving good sushi? Of all different varieties? With lots of yum vegetarian options? This is the place to go. All the sushi is gorgeous, delicious and fresh. As we ate there, the chefs bought out at least 4 more plates of fresh sushi. It’s the best sushi place in Auckland, hands down. Thank you yokoso!

Decent food, good selection, nice staff. One of the better sushi cabinet spots as it doesn’t run out of options at 2pm. It’s cozy and has table seating with dark wood in a ‘sake bar’ decor style. A little worn but still nice enough. The rice in the cabinet maki was a bit dry but the seafood and avocado were very fresh.

We went here tonight and didn’t know they were actually already closed until after we left and saw the hours outside the door! Such friendly service and super fresh delicious good quality food for such great value. Will definitely be back :) (sorry for coming in past closing time - our tummies were grateful to be full)

Great variety of sushi, v colourful. If the one you are after is not there, ssk and they'll make it for you. All the Bento boxes are good. We've been here multiple times and it is always good. Will be back.
The pizza was fresh and amazing. The staff was very quick with our order even though the 2 groups before us ordered a large amount. Overall everything was great 😊

No sign of a bin instore so I left it on the unattended counter. Then in the speed of light he arrives at the counter to say excuse me sir bin outside, I said I don’t see any (because there is none) and he just keeps saying yes outside, outside. If I had known that leaving any rubbish on the counter would induce such a rapid response to the counter I’d have done it when I walked in to order. Food Good. Needs a Bin.

Food is consistently yummy and hits the spot every time. My go to is the BBQ base pepperoni pizza and it never disappoints, full of flavour. The staff are always welcoming and friendly which makes it even better 😊

Ordered 3 pizzas (first time from this location - Newmarket). Some sort of gritty non stick sandy-textured has been added to our sal Francisco bases. It made the pizzas all but unedible. We’ve been getting pizzas from Pizza Hut on Dominion road for many years, and never had this experience. A great pity, as we were looking forward to getting Pizza Hut closer to our new home. Manager at Newmarket has indicated that is how the pizzas are made and should be across all Pizza Hut branches…

Most of the time it’s really good, but every 3rd or so pizza order, there is literally no cheese, even when I order extra cheese. I paid an extra $3… for this… I wouldn’t even call this regular cheese 🙃

I recently visited this restaurant with my family, and overall, it was a great experience. The location is convenient, and parking on the road was manageable. The restaurant had around 7 to 8 families dining at the time, and the space was well-maintained. However, the tables for four felt a bit small. The staff was highly professional and attentive. We ordered both starters and the main course together. The starters—Pickled Paneer Tikka and Tandoori Soya Chaap—arrived within a few minutes. Both were delicious, though the portion sizes were smaller than expected. The main course took a bit longer to be served, and I had to follow up on it. For the main course, we had Butter Naan, Garlic Naan, Lasoon Palak Paneer, and Malai Kofta. The food was authentic and flavorful, and we all enjoyed it. While the menu options are somewhat limited, the quality of food and service made up for it. Overall, it was an excellent dining experience, and we will definitely visit again.

We had our first dinner at this Indian restaurant and were genuinely impressed by the entire experience. From the moment we walked in, we were warmly welcomed by Mini, who looked after us throughout the evening. She was incredibly friendly, attentive, and made our family feel right at home. Mini went above and beyond to ensure we had a great time — her food recommendations were spot on, and each dish she suggested was absolutely delicious. It’s clear that customer service and hospitality are taken seriously here. The atmosphere was inviting, the service was top-notch, and the food was full of authentic flavour. We left feeling happy, satisfied, and already planning our next visit. Highly recommended — we’ll definitely be coming back!

Everything i drive pass this restaurant will see pack of customers at the premises, made me wonder if this is a good Indian retardant. Tonight we felt Indian cuisine so drove straight to “Indian Lounge Mt Eden”…..not surprise!!!!! You are great!!! Good flavour Refreshing Pani Puri!!! Surprisingly good Samosa!!! And really great lamb korma on flavour and spice. Really great atmosphere Fantastic staffs Highly recommend to all.

Exceptional experience. Best Service mini was amazing as always. Cheerful and delight to have her around. Drinks were really good and great food with lovely jazz music. To be honest food tastes good when the service is great by amazing staff

We recently hosted our baby shower at Indian Lounge with a group of around 50 guests, and the experience exceeded all expectations. From the moment we arrived, everything was thoughtfully organized, and the atmosphere was warm, welcoming, and perfect for a celebration. The Indian buffet food was an absolute hit with everyone — every dish was bursting with flavor and beautifully presented. A few standout favorites were the live counter Aloo Tikki Chat and Soya Chaap. A special thank you to Lovepreet for handling our large group with such kindness and genuine hospitality. Their attentiveness made sure everything ran smoothly, allowing us to truly enjoy the occasion without worry. We highly recommend Indian Lounge for both small meals and large events, and we’re so glad we chose them for our celebration.

I have attended Scarlett Slimms and Lucky twice over the past few weeks. The first time I attended was for my birthday, which I had booked for myself and friends for the 18/07/2025. I had booked the table around a week in advance to ensure an excellent experience for everyone. We arrived on time to be seated at a table that could barely seat 4. They had also had an incident with the seating and had placed blankets on the seats as the were wet. When 4 of the 6 arrived, we could easily tell the seating was not sufficient. I requested a different table, which was arranged when possible. It was obvious to everyone that this should have been sorted before we arrived. This was not a great start to my birthday celebrations. When the drinks eventually arrived everyone was shocked at how they tasted except for me as I had ordered a drink which they just needed to put some gin in a glass and provide a premade tonic to add in. After my first drink I ordered a Passionfruit mojito which was so overly sweet and quite strong on the alcohol. Unfortunately even a simple lemon lime and bitters drink was too difficult to make. We had ordered food at the same time as drinks and waiting patiently for food. After 15 minutes we were advised that those who had ordered fish and chips could not have them as they had run out. Those who had ordered had to rush to order new food as by this point we had already being at the premises for around 30 minutes. When the food finally arrived everyone was disappointed with the food. Those who had ordered sliders noticed every order had the same sauce on it. We hadn't been advised they had obviously also ran out of sauce. The person who ordered ribs advised it was so overly seasoned they could not finish it. The person who ordered Spaghetti could only eat a few mouthfuls after giving up as it was so bland, pasta overcooked and was not enjoyable. One of the people who had originally ordered fish and chips ended up with fries. I had ordered the pork sliders and fried chicken. The chicken itself was over fried and dry, the sliders were haphazardly put together, dry meat and everything had the same sauce. Afterwards most of the group went to have takeaways. We were requested to give the venue another try and attended yesterday on 27/07/2025. We ordered the cheese and Spinach dip with bread and the pulled lamb sliders. We ordered simple drinks which came from a can/bottle. The Spinach dip was not a dip. The "dip" was a Spinach saagwala. We needed a fork to put a lot of Spinach onto the bread. I would never order your "dip" again. The pulled lamb sliders were also terrible. The lamb was so dry and tasted like lamb kebab oddly enough. The sauce was alright and the bread was interesting for a slider. They didn't have the green edition red bull which was on the menu which is not hard to acquire. The Bundaberg ginger beer was lovely. I will not be trying Scarlett Slimms a third attempt. Please focus on improving your food and having the right items. Please also focus on having staff which can provide a great service, being questioned when I showed my voucher was quite uncomfortable.

Delicious food. Great portions size. Ribs were soft and juicy. Fish and chips were great too. Only complaints was it was really loud. So wouldn’t reccomend having a date here, maybe drinks with friends. Also they only have high tables so slightly uncomfortable. Servers were very kind tho. Not many gf options.

Amazing food! Highly recommend. Underrated. Visitors from Melbourne. We walked in randomly off the street with the family on a Friday night. Honestly, being at the end of the street, this was our last choice. We were lucky to have get a table. FOOD WAS AMAZING!! Looks like most people here were for Friday night drinks but we HIGHLY recommend the food. Ever was on point and pricing is very fair. Portions was VERY generous. Thanks for taking us in 😅🙏 ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Terrible experience! The staff had an extremely bad attitude, showing obvious impatience when we started ordering and even displaying a discriminatory expression. What’s worse, they took away our food and drinks before we even finished, while other customers were not treated the same way. This was the worst restaurant experience I’ve had in Auckland. Absolutely not recommended!

We came to this place recommended by a daughter to have a “sharing bowl” of cocktails… sounded a great idea, but when ordered it didn’t come out in a bowl (even though still described as a bowl) because they only had one bowl. Felt a little cheated out of $35 because didn’t really want a carafe and glasses. Had a few jugs of beer and glasses or rose with some snacks and $200+ later left thinking cool place but a huge let down and we didn’t achieve the main goal of going there for a cocktail bowl… staff super friendly however

We held our wedding at The Garden Shed and couldn't be happier with our experience. The venue was absolutely stunning—perfect for photos—with a magical atmosphere and exceptional food. Khem and his team were fantastic, always ready to help and incredibly attentive throughout the night. Nixon was a true pleasure to work with, ensuring every detail was handled flawlessly. We highly recommend The Garden Shed for any special occasion.

Today we celebrated 4 Birthday and one big OE trip for my grandson! We Were all blown away by the decor and ambiance! We were graciously welcomed by freindly staff and seated at a suitable table. Drinks ordered and delivered, then orders taken then once prepared served to table. Nice and hot and presented nicely! Absolutely delicious! I would wholeheartedly recommend “ THE GARDEN SHED” as a place to my discerning diners who want a total experience! Arthur C. Charlton west Auckland NZ

The Garden Shed is a fantastic venue for your next event. I recently hosted a birthday for a friend - in the garden area out the back. The venue is gorgeous, with plenty of space, and an enchanting atmosphere. It was not damp and was completely bug free. Portion sizes are large, between a group of 12 we shared about 5 meals, including the farmers and garden board platters. The food was flavoursome and of high quality - I cannot recommend their terracotta bread enough - fresh baked in house in a cute little flower pot. If you enjoy ambient lighting, fantastic food, and eating your dinner amongst a garden - I highly recommend planning a visit.

This place is a little slice of heaven in the heart of Mt. Eden — so tranquil, with stunning surroundings to enjoy. We had a wonderful lunch in a beautifully set-up space. Everything felt peaceful and serene, with welcoming staff and a truly gorgeous setting. And the food? Absolutely amazing. Looking forward to coming back soon!

First time here. We come here for dinner and glad we booked. Beautiful place to eat. We love the character to the restaurant. Good menu and food. Would recommend and come back again to try the breakfast menu next time.

We had our wedding at Mantells on 2 May 2025 and we could not have wished for a more perfect day. From the moment we met Jane, she was so approachable, organised, helpful, and kindly attended to each detail which gave us confidence that we were in capable hands. On the actual day, Johnny took over as our event manager and he was equally incredible with his warm hospitality and tireless work behind the scenes to ensure the ceremony and reception transitioned effortlessly. As a bride about to head down the aisle, Johnny was one of the first faces I saw and he had such a calming nature about him which helped me not want to pass out from nerves. We had accepted that the courtyard likely wouldn’t be an option as it had been raining all day with thunder and lightning. But less than an hour before the ceremony, the skies cleared and the Mantells team (with their many years of experience with temperamental Auckland weather) pulled together a full courtyard setup so quickly and beautifully. We were blown away. The beauty of the venue in itself exceeded everyone’s expectations, but what makes Mantells exceptional is the flawless service. The wait staff were professional and attentive, and honestly, the food was exquisite and a memorable part of the evening. We’re still receiving comments from guests saying it was one of the best weddings they’ve ever been to. A huge thank you to Mantells for making our special day an unforgettable one.

As a wedding photographer, Mantells Mt Eden is one of my favourite and most recommended wedding venues. There really isn't anything else like it in Auckland that has the European/Tuscany vibe like this. They have various indoor areas that make for great photos before the ceremony or for portraits of the couple. The indoor outdoor flow is great, and on a nice day guests have a lot of space to move about. The venue itself feels very cosy and has a great ambiance, especially with the outdoor fire and the candles. I always feel that the staff are really welcoming and accommodating. Now for the food. It is amazing! As a vendor, I have tried the food at many wedding venues, and I can honestly say Mantells serves some of the best i've ever eaten! I don't like eggplant, but somehow, they made it the tastiest thing on my plate! For bridal portrait photos, you don't really need to go offsite and can have these photos around the venue quite easily. But there are some good locations close by (such as Mount Eden) that are good options to easily sneak away to. Highly recommend Mantells Mt Eden and I personally can't wait for the next wedding I get to photography at this venue!

We were guests at a friends wedding at Mantells on Friday 2nd May, 2025. The venue is tucked away and private, has great indoor outdoor flow and ambience that makes you feel you are somewhere in Europe. Johnny Mantell and the staff are professional, welcoming and friendly. The food was exquisite and well presented. I totally recommend their pork belly!! I would highly recommend Mantells as a venue for any function and special occassion. Thanks team 🤙

Gosh! We had the most gorgeous day at Mantell’s! I couldn’t think of a better place to have our special day. We had some many tell us it was the best wedding they went to and I couldn’t agree more. The food was spectacular, the service was out of this world and the level of attentiveness to make our day special made all the difference. Francois is an absolute treasure, he is so patient, detail oriented and sooo organised!! We didn’t have to worry about a thing on the day as he had it handled. Just wow, I can’t recommend the Mantell’s mt Eden team enough! Thank you Thank you thank you for such an incredible day!

My mum had organized a wedding reception for my husband and I as we were coming back to Auckland as newly weds. My first reaction when I saw the venue - stunning! Tania and Francoise were so pleasant to organize with. They are super flexible and help make our evening very special ❤️ thank you Mantells for a dreamy reception.

A lovely little spot with extra seating on the second level and outside. All I had was a coffee. Their food in the display and on their menu looked quite appetising, which I look forward to enjoying on subsequent trips. A pleasant atmosphere that would be great for catchups and some time to yourself.

Discovered this amazing space today and there is a spacious area upstairs, with a relaxing atmosphere and it is somewhere I'll go to again in the near future, to sit and work whilst enjoying a treat. A couple of people had their laptops out and were clearly there for a while. It is a great spot for a quick coffee and delicious treat too, as well as for meals.
We loved iPress. Our service was absolutely fabulous. It was a peaceful environment, and we didn't feel rushed at all. Drinks and food were unbelievably delicious.

Food and coffee just tastes better when it’s up a flight of stairs. With added sun and a good view of the 27W bus, really gives atmospheres its 5 star. Eggs on toast was great for the price but nothing to write home about, yoke explosion was there but could’ve been larger. Cranberry jam was a good answer but nothing the one I was looking for. “Latte excellent, and presentation [was] exceptional” - Maxim, Produce Automobile Conductor.

A Cozy Spot To Start Your Day Right If you're looking for a cozy spot, iPress is the place! With its charming two-storey setup, there's a perfect nook just waiting for you to relax, sip your coffee, and enjoy a delicious breakfast. This is perfect spot to make your morning a little brighter. Highly recommend :)

Food was as close as it could get to authentic Italian!We loved the chefs special ravioli with truffle sauce and hope that is something they add to the menu, the meatballs were on point and a good portion size. It would have been nice to be given a bit more bread to scoop the yummy sauce as Italians do. Service was quick and friendly, we loved it and look forward to coming here again!

Agreed to what most of the people say, pastas here are fresh and this place really lived up the hype. Upon arrival we were greeted and directed to our seat. We arrived just after the peak service at around 8pm, on a Friday, but the place is still relatively full. Food came in quickly after ordering and they are just as good as how most people would describe them here. Every single dish was on point and we cannot wait to try more!

Pasta & Cuore is a gem! The food is simply outstanding – especially the Spaghetti Gorgonzola with blue cheese and walnut. It’s rich, creamy, and absolutely delicious – easily one of the best pasta dishes I’ve had in a long time. The service was warm and attentive, and the atmosphere had a cozy, authentic charm that made the whole experience even better. Loved everything about it – will definitely be coming back for more!

Pasta & Cuore was such a treat. You can tell the quality of the pasta from the very first bite. It’s great to see it being made fresh in-house, and even better that you can buy some to take home. The venue is very tidy. No complaints from me. While it feels to me that it would be better suited to smaller groups (up to four), although we did see some larger tables when we were there. We had the Spaghetti all’Amatriciana and the Tortellini in Brodo. The latter was a touch under-seasoned for my taste, but still flavourful overall with some perfectly cooked pasta. The tiramisu was a great way to top off our meal. It was beautifully presented, and I really liked the punch of coffee in it. Well worth a visit!

Went here for lunch and had a bowl of pasta and a coffee — both were delicious. The pasta was super fresh, you can tell they make it in-house, and the sauce was simple but really tasty. Nothing over the top, just solid, well-made food. The coffee was strong (in a good way) and went well with everything. The place itself is small and cosy, with a nice relaxed feel. Not too loud — just a good spot to chill and eat properly made food. Staff were friendly and helpful, and it didn’t take forever to get served either. Would definitely come back, maybe for dinner next time.

Nice and friendly staff and tasty meals. However, the environment is not really impressed me, dirty walls and chairs. Not clean cups, yellow water (don’t know why) and coffee tasted not nice. Hopefully they will improve the hygiene issues

Beautiful cafe that really holds up to its name. Staff are kind and attentive. We witnessed a birthday where staff brought out a cake and stayed to sing happy birthday. Super cute! Cold brew was delicious as were the meals we chose and beautifully presented. Special mention to the Japanese curry. Incredible depth of flavour and glossy - would have that for every breakfast if possible.

This is one of my favorite cafés in the area—great portions, beautiful presentation, and consistently delicious food. No wonder it’s always busy on weekends! Highlights: 🍳 Bacon Kimchi Omurice – Perfectly fluffy scrambled eggs with a savory kimchi and bacon filling. Absolutely addictive! 🥩 Wagyu Beef Bún Mì Noodle – The beef is incredibly tender, and the tangy chili sauce ties everything together. A must-order! 🥗 Soba Salad with Salmon – Fresh, crisp veggies and generous portions of flaky salmon. A refreshing and healthy choice. Friendly service, vibrant atmosphere, and dishes that are as tasty as they look. Highly recommend for brunch or lunch!

I absolutely love the Rocket coffee RAD cafe serves - I had the most perfect flat white I’ve had in a long time. I ordered the mushroom on toast because of the truffle oil, and it didn’t disappoint. The ambiance was lovely - a real comfy and rustic set up. I would highly recommend 🤩
Such a lovely café! The coffee was rich and was topped with adorable latte art. The food was also really tasty. Highly recommend :)
Best gluten-free wrap! Really appreciate the server, Prashant, for being patient and attentive to my allergens. He prepared the wrap carefully to avoid any contamination. Excellent service! Thanks

Best subway I have ever been to. I eat subway more often than I would like to admit and this is by far the best one I’ve been too. They actually place everything evenly on the sub and show care when making it. Fantastic service from everyone that works there. Highly recommend!!
Very happy with my two catering orders today. Was perfect for my needs and delicious. Great service too. Thank you.

This is the most cleanest subway I have ever been to in NZL. All staff are very efficient and reliable. The hygiene standards in the outlet is outstanding. The Eden Quarter Subway shop has truly raised the flag for its brand, loyalty, effectiveness and satisfaction. I give my 100% recommendation to Eden Quarter Subway and I thank all staff at the shop for their great input and service. Well done and keep it up!
Great subway, the staff are awesome, particularly the lady working yesterday (26/1/24). She was so awesome, kind and helpful. Would really recommend this subway, it's a good one

Without any plans came here for a quick dinner. Jiangnan cuisine is somehow a little different from your ideas for the Chinese food. It's originally from Eatern China where you may have heard of the city Shanghai, Nanjing and Hangzhou that particular areas. Famous for Xiao Long Bao, the small and juicy steamed buns It tastes sweeter than other regions of China, it also symbolises the region is wealthier because they have the ability to consume sugar in the past. Using plenty of sugar, enjoying dark soy sauce, and vinegar, not a fan of spicy and chilli you can feel it when you have a bite. The classic spring onions oil noodles, sour and spicy soup and braised pork belly with preserved vegetables are the three signature foods that I ordered. Not bad, up to the standard, the only issue is the portion is big for only two people 😂 Yet the price is not economy so it is suggested to have a table of people to enjoy more food with less cost.

We came to this restaurant for lunch by chance as our usual place was closed. But we were not disappointed. We ordered two simple dishes, Steamed Pork with Preserved Vegetables and Braised Seasonal Vegetables in Broth. Both dishes tasted great. So if your are around this area and like to have some Shanghainese food, I recommend Su Zhe.

We order for pick up, food quality and taste was mediocre, and prices are expensive. The only thing good about our order was the dumplings, the prawns tasted a bit funny, and the beef dish was too salty and the vege dish was heavily oiled, There are better, well price and more authentic Shanghainese restaurants along dominion, therefore we won’t be returning.
Authentic Shanghai cuisine. The food is fast and tastes nice. The price is not the cheapest, but the portion is large. Will definitely visit again.
The food here is absolutely amazing, every dish exploded with flavors in your mouth. The duck omg the best ever.. Awesome service. Had our Christmas work lunch here.

Had lunch here today and really enjoyed it. The restaurant was clean and tidy, the staff were attentive & friendly & they worked together well as a team. I had a wrap for the first time & it was delicious, (highly recommended the steak Chipotle melt) the steak itself was tender & full of flavor. my friend had the same as a sub & said it was also delicious. Walked out feeling totally satisfied. Happy we went.

Thought of having a subway for lunch. Ordered 2 6inch and one wrap. Indian guy putting cheese in a very stingy way, hola I am paying $16 for a wrap and then turn comes for salads. Girl at the counter with rude face no customer ethics and duck looking tbh. She shouldn’t be working if not happy. Shows that’s someone has put a gun and making her work. She is put totally no salad at the name of showing of they offer salad. She didn’t put onions, cucumber was like no anyway. While pouring sauces it was spilling way. Owners really need to consider this and think about their business who they hiring. If people are unhappy to give good customer service and getting what they paying for. It’s totally rip off the way they making subs. It’s never come from me. Previous staff was good I pass by always, but this time was the last time.

This must be the worst subway I have ever been to, the staff are super unfriendly. I asked for some olives on my foot long subway and they literally put 4 little rings of olive and when I asked for extra they only put another 2 olives? This is ridiculous and I will never go to this place again unless the staff are changed.

Weird subway place… last three occasions tried to order an Egg and Cheese sub and had a different person each time tell me a different thing - one said it was frozen and couldn’t make it, another said they run out, one said they weren’t trained on how to make it, etc. Another subway nearby has no problems making it.

TLDR; I recommend the one on dominion road guys, service/prep is way better and they have more items in stock. I came in 45 minutes before closing. The guy who served me had quite an unwelcoming tone when speaking to me and the other customers, seemed rushed and dismissive as if he’s just trying to get the order over and done with. I understand how tired one must be towards the end of the shift but that should not reflect in their attitude towards customers. Got to the salads section and only after asking was I told that they only have 3 salads (tomato, lettuce and cucumber - technically there was enough cucumber slices left for one more sub lol and there were customers behind me too). Understandable since they will close soon, but I feel like that disclaimer could have been mentioned at the start of the order so that I could just go somewhere else, cuz it was too late to cancel the order and I paid $15.90 only to have 2-3 salads in a sub. Just something to reflect on in customer service for future, cuz that was a waste of money. Oh, and they didn’t even seal my sub properly with a sticker, so it was tearing apart halfway through my commute 💀 yikes. Do better guys.
The pizza test is really good &warm. I ordered a 1st time delivery but it was really worth it

Very disappointing experience. The staff have no sense of professionalism and completely ignore the customers. I called out several times and was completely ignored. Basic respect and listening to the customer should be expected, but unfortunately, that was missing here. I do not recommend this place at all. Young lady and old man 3:40 Pm Wednesday

So I tried to order a pizza, only to be refused service because my $5 had a small bit of tape on the note. Absolutely pathetic. Then when I pulled out a "normal" five dollar bill, the lady said she wasn't accepting that either. That's not the way to treat a customer who had been visiting your establishment for years. I'm hurt and upset with the way I was treated by this female staff member, dark hair, dark eyes, I didn't get her name.

I would like to take a moment to sincerely commend Yogesh Dave for his outstanding service as a delivery driver. Over time, I’ve interacted with many delivery personnel, but Yogesh truly stands out for his professionalism, reliability, and consistently courteous demeanor. He handles each delivery with care and attention, ensuring that packages are delivered securely and on time. Even small details — like placing items in safe locations when I’m not available — reflect his thoughtfulness and commitment to doing the job well. It’s rare to come across someone who combines efficiency with such a genuinely respectful and positive attitude. Yogesh is a credit to his profession, and I deeply appreciate the level of service he provides. Thank you, Yogesh, for going above and beyond.
Thanks Yogesh for delivering my pizza on time. He waited for me as-well at my apartment lobby. very polite and friendly

one of the best burger places I've been to! absolutely I will be coming here again and again! perfect flavors and my drink was nice and strong lovely service and nice staff made it all the more better!

Ralph’s never misses. I’m sitting out the back eating a burger right now; the burger is perfect, cooked well and flavours balanced. The vibes in the little courtyard are great, good tunes and open air. The staff are all lovely. This has made my night. It’s raining and there are children crying but such is life. 5/5 can’t wait to come back.

Service is great and the food is ridiculously good. Wings, burgers and curly fries are all insane hence why it's become a weekly ritual to head here, no better way to blow off steam after a long week. Great selection of beers and cocktails also (even have choccy nippys!). Bonus points for the peach chilli margarita. Overall highlights are the orange chicken wings, any of the burgers and the curly fries.

Who’s got the juice? Ralph’s got the juice!! Do you know what GOAT stands for? Let me tell you.. Consistently the best burger & wing spot in the country - simples as that. Double smash, buffalo wings & ranch and Lïon Rouge is my order.. honestly just say less. Impeccable stuff
This place is 10/10 in absolutely every aspect. By far the best buffalo wings I’ve ever had in my life and the best burgers in NZ. The best vibe and the best staff every single time.

What a disaster of a Pita Pit. I ordered online, said it would be 10 minutes. We got there 5 minutes late and I still had to wait another 10 minutes. 95% lettuce in both of our pitas, the onion and mushroom I asked for grilled was completely raw. My mango and banana smoothie tasted like tropical juice with a weird consistency. There was a guy moving around the kitchen all the time with jandels on.. in a kitchen?? The worst experience I've ever had at a pita pit.

The food and service were fine, and I've always enjoyed Pita Pit in the past. However, I had a disappointing experience with the state of the customer bathroom, which really affected my confidence in the overall hygiene of the store. After ordering and paying for my wrap, I used the bathroom and was immediately concerned by how unclean it was. I understand it was a Sunday and the location is close to the CBD, which can make things busy—but the condition of the bathroom made me feel uncertain about eating the food I had just purchased. There were several hygiene issues: a hair resembling pubic hair next to the flush button, an unclean sink, two empty soap dispensers, an overflowing bin that seemed to contain clothing, and noticeable dirt around the light switch and door lock. It didn’t look like the bathroom had been cleaned in quite a while. It appeared that only one person was working, which I can understand might make it difficult to keep up. However, following the lunch rush, there should be a system in place to ensure the bathroom is checked and cleaned—especially during hours like 2–3pm when things might calm down a bit. I genuinely love Pita Pit, but this experience made me question the overall cleanliness and food safety practices. Cleanliness, especially in customer-facing areas like bathrooms, is a reflection of how much a business values its customers’ health. I hope this is taken seriously so others don’t have the same experience. I hate to write this, but if I had seen the state of the bathroom beforehand, I wouldn't have ordered food. Unfortunately, I won't be returning to this location, and I hope this review helps others make an informed decision. Everyone deserves to feel safe and confident when they choose to eat out.
Best team members on here. Very polite and accommodating Thank you Sudeep for last minute changes with our salad wrap. Our falafel wrap was so Yummy.

Can't even begin to describe how disappointed I am. Last night I ordered a pita bowl and when I received my order there were a couple things missing - garlic and herb, grilled capsicum and toasted seeds were all missing. The lettuce was pink (stale/off) and the beef was burnt. The whole meal was inedible, and I had to throw it away. Called the store today and the manager said he couldn't/wouldn't do anything about... Worst experience ever, definitely wouldn't recommend

Ordered through UberEats yesterday for my lunch and fully checked what was in it seemed like a great deal, ordered with a Garlic Bread once arrived I ate the Garlic Bread first since I was starving I straight away I started eating the cheeseburga but apparently it was extra extra Spicy like you could see how much hot chilli sauce was in my roll. Half way couldn’t breath so I chucked it in a bin. Since I am allergic to chillies. Emailed the HO but no reply I took couple of photos to prove that instead of Ketchup they put Hot Sauce on my roll. No good wish I could give 0 star.
Ate here three times over the course of my weekend stay. Absolutely fantastic experience each time with both food and service.

We love this Cafe for its casual easy atmosphere and spaciousness overlooking the racecourse. There always seems to be free parking available too. The staff are friendly and there's a great array of food: from fresh counter food, sandwiches, pies, salads, quiche to amazing looking burgers, toasties, and yum hot chips. It has changed hands over the years, and the current owners deserve to succeed with all that they're offering. Today we were looked after by a lovely member of staff Tina, who went out of her way to organise that the kitchen make us some lush ham and salad club sandwiches. Enjoyed a beer with our lunch as well.
Enjoyed a perfectly cooked steak on Wednesday quiz night. The quiz by Believe it or Not is top notch too, one of the best presented and organised I've been to.
Roy was dedicated to ensure we enjoyed our visit. Buffalo wings were popular and the pizza/burgers huge. Great parking and plenty of space to meet up

Good place to have a beer and hang out. Slightly on the expensive side. They do have TAB and Gaming machines so if you're bothered by that, not the place for you. Well maintained though. I would go back again.

Really delicious tasty, fresh and healthy lunch. Generous portions. I had the chicken kebab on rice. Very friendly staff - let me have the lunch value special even though I got the day wrong. Would definitely recommend and will come back and recommend to others.
Small place but have good options to eat. I ordered veg falafal. The taste was good. The salad was fresh. The space was clean and staff was very helpful.
This was the best food I've eaten. The prices are good, portions are great and the flavour is AMAZING 10/10 HIGHLY RECOMMEND WILL BE BACK SOON We devoured this in exactly 12 minutes!
Very clean, bright yellow premises. Amazingly generous chicken fillet burger, which was just what I needed after a big exercise day. Nice potato wedges and aioli too. Apple tea was sweet and hot:)
Delicious food, good service (allowed me to order a special workday meal while on weekends) and the atmosphere is amazing with comfy seats though not many still is good.

If you're looking for amazing Thai food, Thai Village Restaurant in Remuera is a must-visit! The restaurant is beautiful with a warm, welcoming atmosphere, but the real star here is the food. Everything I ordered was so flavorful and authentic—it honestly felt like I was back in Thailand. If you love spicy food, don’t miss the Spicy Raw Prawns—super fresh and packed with that perfect Thai heat! My absolute favorite dish was the Deep-Fried Fish with Chili Sauce—crispy on the outside, soft and fresh inside, topped with the restaurant’s special sauce. Paired with jasmine rice? The best! And for dessert, you have to try the Sticky Rice with Custard and Coconut Ice Cream. It’s sweet, creamy, and just melts in your mouth. So good! Highly recommend this place for anyone craving real Thai flavors and great vibes.😊🫶

OMGGGGGGGG this restaurant was just amazing!!! Friendly staff, so accommodating, food came out super hot and fresh and didn't have to wait long, it's BYO wine too which was awesome but they had alcohol available too. The food was DIVINE, Beef pad Thai was mind blowing, so was the prawn curry, the salt and pepper squid and freshly cooked fish, I'm finding it hard to pick my favorite but the flavors in these dishes were just beautiful!! Also had nuggets and chips etc available for the kids! Traveled from Auckland and visited this place as we were passing through and I'm DEFINITELY coming back. Highly recommend. 10/10 for me.

Tasty massamum, nice vermicelli soup, tasty flaming roast chicken. Nothing was spicy (except the marinated raw prawns, which were very spicy), so I think you need to ask for it to be spicy. Beautiful fitout!
Exceptionally good quality food. Great place to eat and have a good time. Friendly staff.
Authentic Thai in heart of Remuera for decades. You must come and taste it yourself. Best in town.

A great little find. Everything you want from a local bistro bar. Friendly service, great local atmosphere, nice interior mood, and great solid food. Not the usual pub fish and chips/burger nosh but some gastro delights. The Korean cauliflower was exceptional, the chicken schnitzel was super crispy (the best I’ve had)…ever. Good wine selection. I like a member of the staff comes around and checks if you need anything and empty plates and glasses simply disappear without asking. Wonderful, so why do so many places it it so wrong when the Corner does it all so seamlessly. Well done team.

Awesome local pub to have casual delicious dinner at and catch up with friends. Staff are all very welcoming and brilliant. Particularly Emily and Sarah who are legends! Butter Chicken and Chicken Schnitzel are sensational. 🔥🔥🔥

An absolute gem of a local and one I’d recommend travelling for. We come here with our young kids, after work drinks and date nights. It’s a great spot, very well priced, delicious food and brilliant friendly service.

We came here when our local friends had dinner plans. The food was super disappointing. Boa pork bun was dry and tough. Fish and chips was almost no fish it was pretty much a joke. Tartar sauce looked like it had been sitting out. It looked like two chicken fingers instead of fish. New server was working hard.

Great spot, friendly and attentive staff. Benny and Emily have been on the last few times ive been in, both lovely and know how to mix a good drink! The freeze dried fruit garnishings are also delicious.

I appreciate the culinary experience, which is exceptionally flavorful and visually stunning. My inaugural visit was a delight, and I found the establishment to be pleasant, intimate, and welcoming. The meals are reasonably priced, with generous portions. I will definitely return and highly recommend this establishment to acquaintances. The service is warm, friendly, and attentive.

We reserved a table on a Sunday night, as we had a large group. Luckily we did, as the restaurant was quite busy by 6pm. Parking can be challenging when the other businesses are open, but the waitress said we could park there at night as they were closed or more parking at the back. We ordered Mee Goreng, Fish Fillet Soup Noodle, Hainanese Chicken, Handmade Tofu, Egg Fried Rice, Veges and Round Beans. Excellent value for money and very tasty

A delicious, lively evening! On Saturday night, our group of 11 snagged dinner early at this popular spot—and wow, what a treat! I ordered the Nasi Lemak with beef rendang with blue rice. I asked the staff about the colour, and they explained it’s traditional—though we couldn’t confirm the source. Everyone else loved the famed char kuey teow, and our friend finished every last drop of their fish‑fillet noodle soup. The restaurant was becoming full and our early arrival was a smart move to beat the crowd. We can surely recommend this already popular place.
Love their food so much that I lost count how many times I've been there. One of the best Malaysian restaurants in Auckland. Highly recommended.

First time visitor based on a colleague’s recommendation. I told staff and asked what to have. Ended up with the Chicken Laksa. They absolutely nailed it. Beautiful flavours and a good but not crazy spicy kick (I do like 🌶️ and wanna say it’s a mild to medium… realistically though, it’s probably a “Kiwi medium to hot”). I’ll definitely visit again to try their other offerings.

Delicious Japanese food. Ordered the sizzling set menu w beef, you can tell everything is very high quality! Loved the variety. The attention to detail and service is also great. A lovely place to hang out with family on the evenings/weekend. I also got a side of seared salmon and it was one of the best in Auckland (even I can’t recreate it and I own a blow torch!).

We went there for my dinner birthday celebration, I booked online which is recommended most especially when you are with a baby or group since the place is not that big. We had a fabulous time and happy tummy ☺️ The manager was exceptionally accomodating, able to guide us through the menu and gave us extra freebies. If you want to try every meal, its best to order bentobox. The bentobox Sashimi was delicious and fresh. I recommend also to try the Takoyaki, Soft sell crab, bentobox teriyaki chicken 🫰🙌🍸

Amazing food and amazing service here! I love the variety you get with the teishoku’s and the eel sizzling plate. Even the side dishes are quality and delicious. The tempura was light and crispy - one of the best I’ve had, Eel portion was generous and well cooked. The waitress was so friendly it made the experience even better 😊 highly recommend eating here, truly a hidden gem.

Such an amazing experience and great food! I got the sashimi platter and it was so fresh and the selection of fishes were amazing quality. We also got the tempura which were so light and crispy and came with amazing homemade sauces. The customer service was excellent! I was shocked how amazing and how welcomed I felt and enjoyed my visit here eating at Haru Eatery. This is one of the best Japanese restaurant I’ve ever been and I would definitely come back :)

Had dinner at Haru on Sunday night. Not too busy. Staff were friendly and attentive. Food was good. Love how hot the tempura was when it came out. The beef steak was nice and tender. Unagi was delicious. Sashimi was fresh. Overall a very delicious meal. Will definitely return to try other dishes.

This is by far one of the best McDonald’s locations I’ve been to. The staff are always friendly, polite, and genuinely seem to care about their work. The atmosphere is clean, welcoming, and well-maintained — you can really tell the team puts effort into keeping everything tidy and running smoothly. Service is consistently fast and efficient, even during busy times. It’s clear that customer experience is a priority here, and it makes a big difference. Great job to the whole team — it’s always a pleasure to come here!

“Parking’s Easy, Burger’s Meh, Vibes? McDonald’s.” Dropped by McDonald’s Greenlane for a dine-in session — yep, skipped the drive-thru like a rebel. Parking was easy thanks to the massive Countdown lot (and a few McD’s own spots), so no parking rage today. Inside? Clean and bright, but a bit crowded and noisy — classic McDonald’s chaos soundtrack. I tried the Hawaiian burger for the first time… tasted okay. Not amazing, not terrible — just vibing in the “meh” zone. But hey, let’s be real, McDonald’s tastes 97.5% the same everywhere. It’s comfort food, not gourmet. Toilets? Clean. Chairs and tables? Ehh... not so much. Let’s just say I wiped mine down like I was prepping for surgery. Still, it hit the spot. Fries were hot, Coke was cold, and the experience? Classic. “Logan was here… wiped the table, ate the burger, survived the noise.”

Probably one of the best McDonald's we have been to. We have been to this particular McDonald's on a number of occasions when visiting Auckland. It's always clean, tidy, and well maintained. Even though there are currently renovations taking place, the staff continued their friendly and efficient service and cleaning. Details are important, and we watched one cleaner even line the chairs back up nearly after customers left. I wish all McDonald's restaurants were as particular. Well done, Greenlane branch.

Drive through was not too busy for lunch. Cheese burger was good not to much sauce. The fries were hot and fresh which was a lovely change. I had to wait for my coffee about 6 minutes in the car park and when. It arrived it was wrong. The store was under renovations so no atmosphere.

Service was fast and friendly. Order placed at the self-help screens before taking our number and finding a table. Food arrived very soon after. Freshly made and exactly as ordered. Lots of seating available, toilets and kids play area... All on the lower floor. Parking available but limited. Thumbs up all the way! Update: 06 July 2025 Refurbishment and renovations in progress - limited seating available inside and drive through still open. Great things to come!
Yummy food and big enough size of the dish. The price is not cheap when compare to other Chinese restaurant. Location is one of the reason to come here, right on the main road, close to motorway.

It’s not bad, but just average service and dishes aren’t cheap. Food is just ok too. Came on my best friends birthday and dined upstairs. Nothing really stood out. Quite crammed feeling inside Service: 3/5 Presentation: 3/5 Environment: 2/5 Food Quality: 3/5 Food Quantity: 3/5 Price per person: $25-$50 1 Like, 0 Comments

This latest visit was very frustrating. They don't do half the menu anymore. Staff were having lunch and watching movies. Nobody thought to bring us tea. When asked for it, the tea was brought in a glass rather than a little tea pot. Asked to replace as weren't able to drink. No single use chop sticks available. Chairs are filthy. My dish wasn't bad, but wife's soup had dirty bok choi in it. Overall, not a great experience.

I used to work for a wine company and delivered wine to the back of this restaurant where the kitchen is. I was absolutely disgusted at how dirty the kitchen was. A worker was half way through a cigarette on arrival, he was literally smoking IN THE KITCHN were all the food was being prepared. There were duck feathers all over the floors and walls that looked like it hadn't been cleaned up for weeks. Dirt, grime and a pungent smell coming from every direction. Would not recommend eating here at ALL!

This used to be a good place. Gone downhill recently. GF called in for a fried rice dish. $14 for mainly rice and a little bit of chicken and 17 peas plus one hair. She rang to let them know it wasn't up to standard..they didn't give toss...water off a Peking ducks back. Also noted it's lost it's A grade now a B. Not surprised.
Ordered takeaway for dinner. Love their fish (fish can proof is very big 😁）chicken nibbles and BBQ on rice! Definitely will go back again.

The portions are very generous which surprised us. The snapper pieces are quite thick. Worth the $10 each. They also gave us 5 large chunks to make up for one. Ordered one fried oyster and got two small ones which was nice. A scoop of chips was enough for the five of us to each get a handful. The “atmosphere” is what you’d expect of a classic nz fish n chip shop.

Chicken nibbles were okay. The fish looked like it was dumped raw in pieces into a bowl of batter, scooped out with a ladle and dumped into the oil to half cook. Batter was still wet inside and the potato in the fritters were half cooked too. Not very appetizing (my cat wouldn't even eat the fish) and neither were the chips. Sorry to say they were the worst fish and chips I've had in my 50 years of life. But at least the Uber driver delivered our "food" while it was hot.
Best Chinese BBQ in remuera!! The workers are the nicest and always give generous portion sizes. The meet is always made in the yummiest way and well packaged for takeaway.

Staff is very friendly, polite, and efficient. They recently did a bit of a remodel, but overall the vibes are cute-little-hole-in-the-wall neighbourhood-takeaway-place. I used to get the pan-fried crumbed snapper and hot chips — all the time. My fiancé and I loved it. One of our top faves. Sadly, they changed their menu and we really miss the crumbed fish! Good thing we like BBQ as well because their new menu is great! We love the classic fried rice, fried noodles, and sweet and sour pork.
For the quality and portion size, the prices were very reasonable. I would definite Highly recommended for anyone looking for a high-quality, relaxed dining experience. I’ll definitely be returning!

Ordered a takeaway on a Monday night. Even though Shahi is our local Indian we usually go elsewhere but we decided to give them a try & the food was really delicious. We ordered Butter Chicken, Chicken Tikka Marsala & Lamb Rogan Gosh. Will definitely order again.
Great meals, from starters to mains, the food was fantastic, very tasty, the spice level was on point, as was the service, and nice cold Kingfisher.
Amazing food, everybody was very happy with their meals. Very polite and helpful staff, and a nice ambience. Felt very authentic. Highly recommended!
Authentic food,lovely ambiance and great service…Worth every single penny ❤️❤️

Walking down Remuera I saw this burger place that I was eager to try. The menu is simple and I like the veggie options and chose the Hemp one. What a fantastic flavor! I tasted like real meat, with jalapeños and cranberry sauce. Great combination of ingredients. Gotta try the other real meat ones, they all look amazing!

I've been here two times already, and it just keeps getting better. The service is top - notch. The staff are not only quick but also super helpful, making every visit a delight. And don't even get me started on their delicious Bugers.

No shame to the people who worked there but to charge $25 for burger and chips and are made to wait 20 minutes when no one is the store you would half expect to receive a half decent meal and not a crabby patty. Definitely did not look anything like what was advertised

The burgers are amazing first time we tried the vegetarian and fish burger. Both weren't a disappointment but I prefer the vegetarian best. The chickpea falafel patty was just beyond measure to a beef burger. I did change the cheese in the burger to cheddar cause camembert felt a bit too much. Spicy satay sauce that goes with it just gave it that extra hit with out failure. I'm not a burger fan but I'm telling you this burger was the best vegetarian burger I've ever had! And have found a new favorite.
Ordered a chicken cabbie. Used to get 4 or so chicken tenders, I got 1 reheated bit of chicken and 1 small red onion. It was bloody terrible

Large pizzas when thin crust selected. The crust is wonderful, crisp, thin, flavorful, and not simply made of white all purpose flour. Full of toppings. I like the gluttony pizza. The lust is too sweet. The vegan pride is also good, although I think the dough is a bit sticky. Overall good quality but quite expensive, as even thin crust costs more. Very quick preparation.

Don't ever come to this place,No one cares about your order. I was waiting more than 30 minutes. They are doing their own work. And we came back without ordering.This is the worst service I ever had in Auckland. I wonder why they open the stall for customers

Misleading delivery information on the website. When ordering the site says it will be an ETA of 40 minutes from the Remuera branch over 90 minutes from the Ellerslie branch, even though Ellerslie is actually 7 minutes closer to my house. The delivery took over 1 hour and cold!!!!

Served a gluten pizza when I ordered a gluten free pizza! After calling the Remuera branch, I was hung up on the first time and told the second time that a manager would be in contact with me. I have not heard from the manager but have been sent a voucher from said store. Why would I repurchase from a store that poisoned me the first time? Having voiced this via email, I have still had no reply. Do not order from the Hell Remuera. All the other branches take note of your dietary requirements.
Went there n Easter Monday as my local one was closed. One person managing the entire store and it was busy. Still he was polite and nice
Good tasting Malaysian cuisine. Price a bit on the higher side. Large portions so makes up for the more expensive pricing.

From the moment we stepped in, the ambience at Sri Mahkota set the tone for a great evening, warm, inviting, and charming. One of the more unique touches was being handed a menu to fill out our order ourselves. That said, there was a bit of confusion with our order despite submitting it in writing. Another server brought us the wrong order. Thankfully, our wonderful server Trin handled it with grace, ensuring everything was sorted. As for the food, most of the dishes were absolutely delicious. The Chicken Rendang, Nasi Goreng, and Chicken Satay stood out with bold flavours and great execution. The Mee Goreng, however, was a bit too oily for our liking. Overall, a great spot for authentic flavours, a lovely atmosphere, and kind service, just a few tweaks away from being perfect.

I had the pleasure of Lunch at Sri Mahkota on last Saturday , and the experience was truly delightful. The highlight of the meal was the fish head soup—absolutely fantastic! The flavors were rich and well-balanced, making it one of the best I’ve had. The service was warm and welcoming, and the overall atmosphere added to the enjoyment of the evening. I highly recommend Sri Mahkota to anyone looking for authentic and delicious cuisine. Thank you for the wonderful dining experience!

Sri Mahkota in Browns Bay isn't just a restaurant, it's a beachfront oasis. This haven serves a captivating fusion of Chinese and Malaysian flavours, and we embarked on a nine-course exploration. Our journey began with a textural delight – coconut Nestum Fried Prawns. These crustaceans, cloaked in a golden, crunchy nestum batter, were a symphony of sweet and savory notes that danced on the tongue. Sharing the spotlight were the Stew Pork Trotters, melt-in-your-mouth tender and steeped in rich, savory braising magic. The remaining dishes were a supporting orchestra, each adding its own unique melody to the experience. The Four Seasons, presented a medley of contrasting textures of roast pork, roast duck, pig's ears, and char siew – a delightful exploration of textures and flavours. The vibrant Yee Sang, a raw fish salad, offered a refreshing counterpoint, while the Steamed Blue Cod was the picture of delicate perfection. Stir-fried Kai Lan added an earthy counterpoint, and the comforting foundation of Fried Rice provided a familiar backdrop. Steamed Scallops, simply prepared to allow their natural sweetness to sing, completed the savory ensemble. The Hainanese Boiled Chicken, a comforting staple, was a perfect foil for the bolder flavours, its silky texture and clean taste a testament to the chef's touch. Sri Mahkota's beachfront setting elevates the entire experience. The food, a symphony of textures and tastes, is more than commendable; it's a delicious escape. Here, you can linger over good food and company with the sound of the waves as your soundtrack, creating memories that taste as good as they feel.

I went out for dinner tonight at this amazing Malaysian restaurant. It's been around for a while and their food is always top-notch. My favorites are the coconut nestum prawn, mee goreng, chicken satay, and Creamy Fish Fillet. The place is spotless and the staff provide excellent service.

This place is amazing. It's been going for years!! I come back every time I'm back in NZ. The guys who run the store are friendly, kind and remember me each time. Yummy chicken satay on rice (my go to) and healthy portions!! I layer on the hot chilly and hummus.

Kebab Serai in Remuera truly offers the best kebabs in Auckland. The combination of succulent chicken served over aromatic rice, accompanied by a fresh and crisp salad, is nothing short of divine. …A special mention goes to the baklava, a dessert that never disappointed. was impressed by the passionate food of the young owner from Afghanistan. I am very satisfied with the price, quality, and quantity. It’s the best kebab in this area. The future of this friendly and lively young man looks very bright.”
This restaurant checks many important boxes, cleanliness, service, and fresh ingredients, but still has room to improve in the flavor side. It’s a solid choice for a casual meal, takeaway
such a cute place with amazing food. i always get lamb with mild chilli and mayo kebab. its my comfort food store 💕
this is the best kebab in New Zealand. if you coming to auckland you must vist the place. value for money

Tons of chicken items, and less fish choices that I’m used to. The rice was a bit too vinegary for my taste, but the fried prawn roll was delicious. Restaurant felt clean and arrived nice, but I prefer more seafood choices.

This is an awesome Japanese restaurant serving fresh and delicious sushi that is different to other factory type places. The restaurant is clean, great service by Kevin and his partner and the food is handmade fresh. Reasonably priced and great lunch option.

Incredibly fresh sushi here. All really good standards - cleanliness, quality and presentation. The teriyaki udon was super tasty with a good amount of chicken and noodles. Also the Broth was amazing.. not oily and thick like others. A well put together gem. Definitely worth spending your lunch money here
My favourite lunch in the area. Go early for the best selection!
Great casual lunch or dinner spot. Solid, reasonably priced food

I have visited Sahana Restaurant a few times, but my last experience was extremely disappointing. Despite there being fewer than four occupied tables, the staff seemed overwhelmed and disorganized. It took them 20 minutes to serve idlis at a South Indian restaurant, which was unexpected. The chicken lollipops were poorly prepared, with a thick fritter-like coating that looked unappetizing. When we requested extra sambhar for our three idlis, we were told we would have to pay extra, which felt unreasonable. The manager was not only rude but also visibly exhausted, likely due to the lack of staff. One person was juggling Uber orders over the phone while also serving customers in the restaurant, which only added to the chaos. Overall, it was a very disappointing experience. The food quality was far below what I had enjoyed on previous visits, and the service left much to be desired.

Food was amazing. Fresh and full of flavour. The goat briyani was amazing - soft briyani rice packed with the flavours of the tender soft meat and masalas + it was an unlimited briyani thali offering that made it even better. Service was phenomenal too - we arrived near closing to dine in but the staff never rushed us and told us to just enjoy our food.
A takeaway snack but We will come back tondine in because the food was amazing. Indian cuisine the way it should be. Fresh real spices and flavors that made me want to order more.

Great ambience, exceptional service and food that reminds you of home.. SAHANA is a wonderful option to check out if you're around Auckland CBD and yearning for some great South Indian taste.. Will be back again soon!

I just wanted to extend my deepest thanks for the exceptional service we received during our recent visit. We had a group of 25 guests, and every single one of us left with nothing but praise for the beautiful experience you provided. From the moment we arrived, we were welcomed with warmth and professionalism. The service was outstanding, the food was absolutely delicious, and the environment was simply beautiful—a perfect setting that made the entire occasion truly memorable. Please pass on our gratitude to the entire team. The attention to detail, the friendliness of the staff, and the overall atmosphere created an experience we’ll remember for a long time. Truly, it was a gathering filled with beautiful food, beautiful people, and beautiful surroundings. We look forward to returning again soon and will happily recommend you to others.

I want some afternoon coffee and snacks and ventured in; this place is not well-known or well-mentioned, probably mostly for travelers staying in the hotel, but what a great pleasure! Long opening hours, decent coffee, nice small bites like this pork belly skewers. I love especially the good-quality water from the tap, sitting outdoor all by myself with gentle breeze, oh heavenly!

A great way to commemorate ANZAC 25 with a beautiful Breakfast with whanau after another memorable Service @ Auckland Domain. The delightful selection, presentation and wholesome tasty kai is certainly worth checking out. Thank you Emily your customer care sincerity & genuineness was absolutely felt. See you again soon e te whanau! Definitely value for money 🙌
We had duck breast and nori salmon and both were delicious. Thank you 🙏🏻
Very nice restaurant Buffet on Saturday only $69pp Food variety is average, love their Dessert bar and service. Would come back again!

We are a family of 37 who enjoyed the buffet breakfast. Lots of variety and the customer service was excellent- thank you for welcoming us with open arms and making our day very enjoyable! Highly recommended!!!!! Thank you Sonny for being a top host and for booking us in. Also to the kitchen staff who were very friendly and helpful.

The carrot cake and almond cake with chocolate and pistachio was epic. My friend had the hot salmon bagel which was delicious but i Can't say too much about the service. Ordered a coffee with my treats that did not come. Seems the gentleman didn't add this to my order and on top of this there was a transaction charge which I wasn't aware about too.

I needed catering at short notice and the Kosher Deli absolutely surpassed my expectations. Super quick response even with less than 24hrs notice to place my order and the food was beyond - everyone in my office commented on how exceptional every part of it was, both in appearance and taste.
