We had struggled with the closing of our in-house cafe, so super stoked to have found such an great option so close to work! 100% would recommend for any catering you need and I’ll definitely return to try their coffee and the rest of the menu.

Tried their fresh bagels for the first time today. I was blown away! I thought I would never find bagels in NZ that are close enough to the ones I had in New York. So happy I discovered Sam’s bagels!!!

Absolutely love it here!! I had the latke Benedict which was so delicious, the best brunch I’ve had in NZ. The coffee is amazing quality and the perfect strength. Everything is so freshly made to order with fresh salads, pastries, bagels and bread available on the counter. The outdoor garden area is also incredibly beautiful and would be amazing to sit outside in the warmer months. Such friendly and accommodating staff would highly recommend travelling that extra bit outside the busy cbd to come here. Everything tastes like it’s made with a lot of love, the perfect mixture of comforting home style cooking and restaurant style profession and presentation.

Literally the best bagel I have ever tried In Auckland (maybe my life too). The bagels made by Sam are much different to what you know your Americanised bagel to be. Usually you’d expect bagels to be dense and a bit hard, but the fresh bagels from here are soft and chewy and more Bread like - in the best way possible. They’re busy at lunch but quick service. Definitely a great spot for bagels!
Great Coffee and Food
Amazing coffee!
Good service

Attention ROCC: I've visited the Greenlane KFC store several times and each time has left me disappointed. The chips always taste stale like cardboard and are clearly not fresh. The chicken i got today was tough and dark in colour, as if it’s been cooked in old oil or kept past it's proper serving time. I was not given any napkins with my order today and on multiple occasions, I had to ask for a paper bag just to keep my food warm. These should be standard with any takeaway meal. Overall, the service and food quality at this store are consistently poor. I won’t be returning, you’ve been warned.

Had been to this drive through many times after a long working day for grabbing my dinner. Observed a while, there was a person always smile and served well with enthusiasm and such a breath of fresh air! Dave always very friendly and have a friendly smile greeting with me. Made me feel welcomed!! Great service from the team and Dave specially!

There's a middle-aged new guy working here that has drastically improved customer service and experience. Please keep him on! Friendly, efficient, accomodating. Even the staff around him seem to have improved with his presence

I always go to this KFC and about time I drop a review! Absolutely love the customer service from the team! Never had my order wrong and it’s very clean inside out. Parking facilities are good and they have upstairs and down stairs sitting as well. Friendly staff and management. ++++

Nice location, parking is a bit strange as it shares drive way to drive thru. Restaurant is clean toilet is clean. The kfc common problem still exist here: they are fully staffed but service is always slow. You don’t have to make burgers like other places, and chickens are already in the oven. Why are you guys so slow, and always slow?!

Bought a Chicken Biriyani last night for myself and received a tomato rice with a few chicken pieces, tasted more like a butter chicken curry mixed with rice. I’ve had buriyani’s here a few times already and never had it like this.

"I recently had the pleasure of trying [namaste dehi]'s Indian cuisine, and I was blown away by the flavors and aromas! The food was authentic, delicious, and expertly prepared. The standout dish for me was the Butter Chicken - rich, creamy, and full of flavor. The Naan bread was perfectly cooked, and the Basmati rice was fluffy and fragrant.The service was also top-notch - friendly, attentive, and knowledgeable about the menu. If you're a fan of Indian food, or just looking to try something new, I highly recommend [namaste delhi]. The quality and taste of the food are exceptional, and the atmosphere is warm and welcoming. *Must-try dishes:* Butter Chicken, lamb ,fish curry indian style,Naan bread, Basmati rice.

Best Indian food in Auckland at great prices. Fast service eating in or takeaway, but limited seating for dining in. We prefer to get takeaways and they are always fast, good portion sizes and very yummy. The biryani and butter chicken are awesome.

Just ordered and the chicken jalfrezi tasted the same as the mixed veg dish i ordered. Both were frozen vegetables. The tandoori prawn was good. I love good curry bit this wasn't it. I couldn't eat the mixed veg.
We ordered butter chicken and mango chicken to share between three adults. The food was delicious. That was a perfect amount of food for three people. Thank you for a delicious meal.
Been my favorite cafe since moving near by 1 year ago. Love the food and coffee. Such a good spot.

An excellent little cafe under the ABB building, just walking distance from home. So enough to just turn on the washing machine and walk here to try it out. I love the ancient stone walls outside the racing club, in stark contrast to the high way traffic. At first, disappointed by the lack of paper to go with my latte, then delighted with spotting a yellow-body black-tailed heli to take off inside the club. Back to the cafe, the wall artworks are parts of a bike, perhaps, tour de France theme. Latte is pretty good, albeit not the best locally. What has really impressed me with the smashed avocado, is a touch of caramelized bread taste I have never got from elsewhere. The sourdoughis just of the right hardness and crispiness, coupled with the right running egg. Sure, will return. Better to hang my washing out in a beau day!

Nice place very warm and modern. Food and drink was average. I had a Ham cheese and onion omelette, pretty tasteless but if you like lots of onion this is the one for you (see pics) Mr had the Delight Breakfast again average, budget pre cooked sausage was not a hit. Coffee and hot chocolate not very hot. $41 for the lot, probs won't be back

We ordered the big breakfast, and smashed avocado. Mochiato with Oat milk. The food was beautifully presented, and tasted even better. Great serving size, not huge but the quality was excellent. and the coffee had a nice strength and flavour, the perfect cup! The place was very clean, staff lovely, not too busy and varied seating, easy parking and nice location. Could do with more street signage

Amazing food here! Was super quiet but had a nice range of breakfast food which we tried and enjoyed! Definitely would say its worth a try, we used Zomato Gold but would happily pay full-price for what we got.

This place gets it right. Super fresh fish cooked just right with real chips and an ol world experience of eating fish n chips in the shop at a lovely stainless steel table that's shining on our arrival. Lovely seafood cooked well. And great customer service too. Highly recommended.

Fish is always fresh with great batter, chips are rarely generous in portion but are cooked well and crispy, however I must say that the dumplings were the singular worst dumplings I have EVER had in my life! Can't actually believe that a place as expensive and "premium" as this would actually serve such utter crap as what we received tonight. We ordered beef dumplings which sound good on paper but were disastrous in person. For $17.50 we received a mere 6 dumplings which were comprised of the thickest, glueiest, nastiest dumpling wrappers imaginable along with a coarse, fatty, flavourless beef filling inside. These inedible non-delicacies were served alongside small pottles of soy and chilli sauce (which were fine) along with an absolutely revolting side of supposed Asian "salad." The whole combo was thoroughly NASTY. I highly recommend avoiding this grotesque offering if ever ordering from F&C in future. Their spring roll, which we have also had on the odd unfortunate occasion, is equally as gluggy as the dumplings. Same with the "fish cake." In conclusion, if you're wanting standard fried fish, no worries as their selection seems to be quite good for this, but anything else on the menu... AVOID!!
Just landed from Canada. This was my first meal. Great fush and chips. Crispy. Tasty. Friendly staff. Great location. I'll be back. Yum!

Have eaten here multiple times, first time using Uber eats. Very disappointed, food was cold (delivered to one tree hill) and side of chips ($4.50) had either been eaten or bad portion size from the shop. Won’t order through Uber again.
The best fish and chips in Auckland. Super clean, amazing service with friendly staff. Highly recommend.

Discovered after the delivery guy hurriedly passed to us. The cheese volcano was spilt all through the box and leaked over everything and the churros came with no sauce absolutely no sugar on and were so dry they turned to dust when we tried biting into one. After seeing the comment below from dominos- 3 times I contacted the store in regards to this and 3 times I was assured someone would call me back. Nobody got back to me.

The staff and delivery service is great. Pizza is always good. The onion rings I got were very burnt and inedible as they had gone hard. The chicken bites were also hard and cold. Bit disappointing really.

very modern nice place. i had an amazing pizza but even better service from a young man named lalith (i think that’s the spelling) he was extremely patient and polite and very helpful. great young man. great pizza

Sorry for the poor rating, but my experience wasn't pleasant with your food this week. I had ordered Frank's Red Hot Chicken Wings but got a bland version of that with really small wings and a side of garlic aioli. The Meat Lovers pizza also seemed to have some toppings missing.

I wouldn’t normally rate a delivery order but I have to say I was really impressed with the timely delivery and delicious pizza. First time ordering the peri peri chicken on the thin crust, and it won’t be the last! The contactless delivery was also well done.

But delightful little cafe in the middle of car dealership road. Everything was fresh and delicious. But the scones and pies really stood out. The eggs Benedict is one of their most popular dishes and lived up to its reputation definitely yeah nice little place to meet friends or grab a quiet bite. The current menu has changed from the ones previously posted, so not all of the dishes are still available. They've added some excellent Vietnamese options as well replacing some of the other breakfast and brunch items.
Xin chào! Hello! What a lovely breakfast, great spot for a date or a cute breakfast! Highly recommend the bac xiu Vietnamese coffee and Eggs Benedict 😍🔥 Cảm ơn! Thank you!

This place serves Western food and drinks as well as Vietnamese dishes with northern Vietnamese flavors. The food here suits my taste. Delicious! The drinks are also great. They decorate the cozy space, look neat and clean. Friendly and helpful service. Thank you! I will be back.
Ordered a hamburger. They gave us a chicken burger. Burger was microwaved and the bun was very hard as result. Ordered smoothies and those were fine. Used hands they did not wash to handle buns.

Food and coffee was sadly extremely disappointing but they said they are getting a new chef so we probably just came at a bad time when they are trying to make do with no proper chef and new staff. They didn’t have pho which is what we came for so we tried vermicelli which turned out to be nothing like the menu at all, coffee was not as good we what we can make at home, the pie seemed like it was microwaved or something, quite soggy but tasted good. People were friendly and trying their best but the place definitely need some work🥲🥲

We got Uber eats from here.The order presented poor value for money. The calamari portion consisted of 8 pieces for $26. The lasagna, while having a satisfactory flavor, contained a minimal amount of mince meat. Contact with the restaurant regarding these issues was not productive.

I visited this fancy Italian restaurant in Epsom with my close friends for dinner after one of them recommended it, as I wanted to have pizza near the CBD. The restaurant was easy to find. I ordered a medium-sized special combination pizza, which perfectly matched my appetite. The portions and flavour were both satisfying. My friends ordered lasagna, beef steak, and chicken steak, and they all loved their meals. Although the portions were a bit small for them since they have big appetites, the overall experience was great. The staff was friendly, making our dinner even more welcoming. The restaurant had delightful warm lighting and a big indoor pizza oven that added to the cozy atmosphere. I highly recommend this place for anyone looking to enjoy Italian food with family and friends.

Wonderful food wonderful service Five star for the best Italian food in the town Ordered Fettuccine satte soldi Garlic prawns Pizza special 10/10 for food and drinks Will come soon for sure✌️✌️ Cheers guys!!

Went without a reservation, they seated me immediately even though it was busy. Such polite and attentive wait staff. My drink came quick. Starter within 15 mins. Main another 15 minutes after that. Food was amazing! The fettuccine was perfect 👌 flavour wise as well as the pasta being immaculate. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming. Would recommend to anyone! Thanks for a wonderful meal.

LOVE THIS PLACE! My fiance and I are regulars and have brought both our families here many times for different celebrations. The food is amazing and the staff are lovely. Always great service and a lovely atmosphere. The garlic king prawns are so good! I order this dish every time and my fiance always gets the fettuccine sette soldi cos he loves it. Every dish we've tried we've enjoyed as they've always been tasty. 10/10. Highly recommend.

The Burger King in Epsom offers a decent experience overall. The staff are really friendly and welcoming, which makes the visit more enjoyable. It’s always nice when the team takes the time to be polite and helpful. The food is alright—nothing extraordinary, but it does the job if you’re after a quick bite. Everything comes out as expected, and the place is clean and organized. If you're in the area and looking for a standard Burger King experience with friendly service, this location is worth stopping by.

The ones I got from BK on the North Shore were always packed full, but this one isn't even close to a regular large fries. I asked them about it, and they just said it's the correct portion — yeah, right.
Very busy at lunchtime in school holidays but staff doing a great job. Good burger, bathrooms clean and tidy.

Super busy area due to a popular Mobil, better to get in here through the back entry. Always had great service here, the BK app points functionality is currently down here though, but staff are more than happy to assist on the counter (despite a big rush). Me and my brother often come here for dinner and we've not been neglected as dine in customers which is impressive, shout out to the team. Drive through experience has been solid too. Just a lot of cars that come in and out of your surroundings, take caution if you're an anxious driver lol.

This was the first time I went to Burger King. Since that visit I've used the Drive-Thru service several times. I rarely do Fast Food dining or takeaway food. Usually when I do McDonald's is my go to, however Burger King I have discovered is far superior. The are very good and the service was fast and efficient. I thoroughly recommend Burger King Epsom if you're looking for a decent and good value meal.

Nice place to eat, with good HK style food. Good service and good level of noise: not too loud, not deadly quiet. It is popular with families though, being so close to schools and the local library, so your mileage may vary. There isn't much parking, so you'll need to either find a side street to park in or catch the 30 bus to get there. My main complaint is pricing; it's very expensive for what you get. Expect to pay ~25$ for a mid-range meal. I used to go here a lot 5-10 years ago but not anymore since they've raised the prices so much. Also, they use peanut oil to cook so if you're allergic I would avoid this place

Great experience! Is very hard to find a good, reliable Hong Kong style restaurant in Auckland now days. The food, service and proportion are good. For $23 a meal with drink, is very expectable. Strongly recommend! Keep up the good work, will definitely visit again.
We ordered Japanese style salmon soup rice for $28, the food is way different from menu, and salmon is very very little! Will never come back again!!

Located at the heart of Epsom, in front of a motel. This restaurant no longer doing yumchar. Food was average, price wise not cheap. Parking is a pain. Some traditional Hong Kong style dish not available. We will not be back

Hong Kong style family restaurant, if you don't pay attention to it you probably will miss it when passing by. The first building of a motel complex on Manukau road, not many seats inside, offering outdoor seats too . $29 lunch special goes with a soft drink, sounds not really a good deal among all Chinese restaurants, but I think to the similar name contains with Hong Kong, this one is okay.

Overall, perfect! • Beef and Beef Tendon Noodles — 5/5 • Braised Pork on Rice — 5/5, highly recommended • Simmered Pork Ball with Rice — 5/5, highly recommended • Pan-Fried Chicken Leg — 5/5 • Deep-Fried Chicken Drumstick with Rice — 3.5/5 This is a completely authentic Taiwanese restaurant. The beef in the beef noodles is incredibly tender and flavorful. The noodles are chewy and smooth, and the beef broth, which is soy sauce-based, is light with a hint of sweetness. For the braised pork on rice, the combination of minced pork, minced mushrooms, and rice is simply perfect. The simmered pork ball with rice is a must try— the meatball is super soft and well-seasoned. Every bite is juicy and packed with flavor. As for the pan-fried chicken leg, it’s juicy, crispy, and super tender as well with a subtle smoky flavor that makes it irresistible. You should plan to have dinner early as the restaurant closes quite early in the evening. Transportation: You can reach the Remuera Shopping Centre by taking Bus 75, and the restaurant is located nearby.

There are less than a handful of Asian food options in this area. This one is tucked away in the mall. Orders wonton soup for lunch. The soup was more on the bland side and had lots of pepper which overwhelm the whole dish. Wontons were decent size but the fillings didn't have a good marinade.

If you’re in search of an authentic Taiwanese beef braised noodle soup 牛肉麵, this place is it! We are so happy to have found the Tree Cafe after craving for Taiwanese cuisine for such a long time. Their soy milk was also perfect, it was not too sweet and full of flavour! The side dish of pickled cabbage was tasty as well. Friendly service and nice atmosphere. The only downside is that the parking can be somewhat challenging, as there is limited space for the mall customers.
The food tastes good and provides a good service. I like the atmosphere and enjoy the environment.
Great Taiwanese food, very authentic and delicious! Owner/operators are very friendly.

We came for their truffle lunch special and found everything exceptional. Each mouthful was a flavour sensation, with use of both classic and creative cooking. This is our first time dining and we were surprised the interior is actually far more spacious than the storefront appears, with warm muted interior tones. The truffle lunch was excellent value for the quality and presentation of ingredients, and we now hope to return and try the rest of their menu. Thanks for a great dining experience.

I had an amazing experience at Siso Restaurant with my friends! From start to finish, everything was just perfect. The food was absolutely delicious, every dish we tried was full of flavour and beautifully presented. The drinks menu was impressive too, offering a great selection of both alcoholic and non-alcoholic options, all crafted with care. The team was incredibly professional, welcoming, and friendly, which made the atmosphere even more enjoyable, (especially Oscar, manager)We felt truly looked after. Highly recommend this place, we’ll definitely be coming back. Thanks again 😀

Delicious and beautifully presented food. Portion sizes and prices were great for what we got. The staff were very friendly and helped recommend a few menu items. Went with family a few weeks back. Highly recommend and will definitely come back in the future. Got the prawn linguine, the market fish with clams, oxtail pappardelle, freshly shucked oysters, the crispy calamari, and potato fries (not pictured).
First visit of hopefully more! Lovely wine, absolutely stunning food, great service. I recommend the flatbread and humus dip as a perfect combo. The flatbread is to die for, cant wait to try more.

guys We really like it ！！I chose this place because I want to celebrate my birthday today ✨Firstly, it has excellent service. Secondly, every dish is something we really like! 🔥 Thank you, staff members. We will come frequently

Nice dinner in fusion of Hong Kong and Singapore style. Satay is juicy and mussels are very fresh. Even the satay sauce is homemade which you cannot taste the same elsewhere! Will dine in again for the chef really loves cooking!

Yummy Hainanese Chicken Rice with Tomato Chicken Soup, Pad Thai, Tasting Braised Fish Maw and Sea Cucumber as well as Hong Kong style Milk Tea. 😋 The owners are sooo friendly and they can prepare any foods you like by pre-ordering.

Fully recommend this eatery! We had Hainanese chicken rice and wonton noodle soup. They taste really good and authentic. The owners are very friendly and attentive. First time visit and will definitely return 👍🏻

Delicious, authentic flavours from both Singapore and Hong Kong. Lovely hosts with awesome service from Chef Danny, Fanny and Karen. Clean, comfortable dining area, great dessert as well. We will definitely visit again. 😃
Authentic Singaporean and Hong Kong cuisine, very delicious dishes, outstanding friendly service. Must visit again. Highly recommend to stop by when in Remuera. Family friendly. This is real gem.

It was all a messy course. Tuna cebiche, which came out as Start, is Amuse bouche, the best for stimulating appetite. The sashimi plate and hot food plate I received after that impressed me. Each sauce was interesting. But the staff didn't give us a description of the food. Then I received the absurd main, and the taste and shape of beefmain were the worst. The other fish main were the best. Lastly, I hope you pay more attention to the cleanliness of the wine glasses. The wine glass smelled like a rotten mop, so dessert wine couldn't taste it. It's one of the cheap courses I've been to, but even that was the worst for the service and some food. If visit there is the next one, I expect to eat a single dish that I was satisfied with.

We had the wagyu lunch set and pork tonkatsu lunch set. For $39 each, you are getting quite a lot. The steam rice is of generous portion and fluffy. I would recommend giving the wagyu beef a pass. Go with the other protein options (pork, grilled fish or tofu). The wagyu was a bit chewy and lacks the marbling you expect in a wagyu. Deco and ambience was good. Service was OK. The junior waiter come across as inexperienced.

Excellent Japanese restaurant nestled away next to Thai village and new world. Presentation was definitely one of the highlights. Sake served in an interesting container. Food was really good too. Highly recommend the lamb ribs. It's a little spicy but perfect with a little rice.

Well worth a visit. Wonderful food with a great beverage list. Standout for us was the Hokkaido Scallop. Sashimi was good but not the best. Chawanmushi was delicious. Sirloin steak was tough and not recommended however the teriyaki chicken is a must try. Atmosphere was great and service was friendly.

A hidden Japanese restaurant located off the main street, offering an authentic taste while serving quality food. The lunch set is pretty good value in my option. Service could have been better. The staff wasn’t rude or unfriendly, or terrible enough that I wouldn’t revisit. It’s just that they seemed rather disorientated when it came to placing our meals onto the table. Given that our lunch sets were served on trays, they could have come over to the table to make room for our food or have another staff member to help shift things around. The waiter was juggling the trays trying to make it fit and placed them on uneven surfaces. We had babies and older kids, so some of our hands were preoccupied. It’s quite anxious to see (we helped where we could of course). Would have been great if the tempura had a bit of variety even though it was just two pieces. The salad was missing the colour of a small tomato. Otherwise it would have been perfect!!! 🤗 Just a little feedback on areas for improvement.
Local sushi store, food tastes really good! Also the store is run by a sweet lady! Store is tucked away in Remuera, go try it out :)

For me to eat healthy and quick meal that’s the best choice. The shop is clean and friendly owner who make fresh food everyday, I always recommended to my friends. Why don’t you come and give it a try .
Great lunch spot for a quick takeaway. There is a wide variety of sushi to choose from and I have always had a great experience. :)
nice

Two years ago, Spiga was the place where we had our first date. Now, as a married couple, we returned for lunch, and it was just as wonderful as we remembered. The cozy atmosphere, delicious food, and exceptional service made it a truly special experience. Fungi Pizza was absolutely incredible—hands down the best fungi pizza in Auckland! The crust was perfectly crispy, and the mushrooms were so fresh and flavorful. We were so impressed that we asked the staff where they sourced their mushrooms. They were incredibly friendly and took the time to explain everything in detail, which made the experience even more enjoyable. We can’t wait to come back and create more beautiful memories here.

Authentic Italian cuisine with incredibly fresh and delicious food. The chef and the staff were all wonderful. It was an excellent dining experience and a fantastic place for gatherings. Highly recommended!

Nice dining environment and service however, Beef cheeks and mushroom tagliatelle tasted good but way too salty. Also very disappointed about my special black truffle dessert. The biscuits are not crunchy enough so very hard to bite! Not worth it!!!!

The Funghi pizza was the standout for our carbohydrate starved party. Service was friendly and professional although slightly slow on offering a refill of beverages. I found the space a little sterile and truth be told the general vibe was also a tad pretentious. Overall the food was good though and well priced. Inversely, The biggest negative for me was that the drinks were overpriced.

One of the best meals I've had in a long time. We have been searching for our go-to Italian restaurant in Akl for ages and we've definitely found our place. Spiga is the perfect balance of elegance, decadence, comfort, and authenticity. The people are lovely and their passion/love shine through in every dish and glass. We will definitely be back for more.

Awesome place for a fancy pie. I'm usually a local bakery type of guy but every now and again, I'll indulge in something fancy. Pies were awesome, sides were decent, atmosphere of the restaurant in chill, and customer service was amazing! Will visit again and would highly recommend.

Great menu and drink selection to pair with your meal The service was fantastic, and we really loved the restaurant's decor. It looked stylish and welcoming. The only downside was that the venue felt quite cold when we arrived for an early dinner around 5:30pm. We had to keep our jackets on at first. The restaurant had been open since 4pm, and thankfully, it had warmed up by the time we left. Other than that, we really enjoyed our visit and would happily come back again.

What a great little place in the heart of Remuera! Found on TikTok earlier in the year and was waiting for winter to come try the delicious pies. Lovely warm atmosphere with attentive staff. Food was outstanding and homemade with great flavours to try. Too full for dessert so will be back to try. Couldn’t recommend enough!

A very lovely evening enjoyed with friends here! Service was excellent with both the bar and wait staff being attentive and friendly. Food was great! Warm home cooked feel but packed with flavour. Great wine selection as well. Highly recommend!

Went to Pie & Pinot on the first weekend after opening and it didn’t disappoint! The pies all looked excellent and took inspiration from traditional pub pies from some great spots in London. As a Brit now living in Auckland I have to say my pie was the best I had since living here. The pulled pork was flavoursome with a good kick from the jalapeño combing nicely with some great mash! All of the wine is from suppliers across New Zealand which is great and they also have Stella Artois and Guinness on tap. The decor is fresh and bistro like with excellent service provided by all. Pie & Pinot is a great addition to the Remuera food scene and I will be back very soon!

At long last: the perfect eggs Benedict!! Wow. Kumara hash, beautiful crisp exterior, very generous portions. Hot, delicious coffee that was strong without scraping off your insides, yay!! I live out near Matakana, but if I am ever in Remmers then this is a Must.

Cute little cafe with a tempting menu and cabinet options. I had an awesome spicy chai and the pancake stack was the best I've had in years! Very happy and will definitely be visiting again. Lovely service and vibes, my only note is that the chairs could be a bit more comfy.

the coffee was absolutely stupendous it really made my toes crinkle and fold. to start i ate the famous almond croissant it was very yummy and srummy in my tummy. the waitress was also really nice to my crippled daughter even giving her extra food on the house!

One Vicky Ave Coffee offers a delightful coffee experience. Their coffee is superb, with a rich and inviting flavor that keeps me coming back. The staff is exceptionally attentive, always ready with a friendly smile and eager to assist. The ambiance of the cafe is incredibly pleasant, providing a cozy and welcoming atmosphere that's perfect for both catching up with friends or enjoying some peaceful alone time. With soothing lofi music that perfectly complements the cafe's atmosphere. It's the kind of place where you can relax, enjoy great coffee, and lose yourself in the charm of the surroundings. It's a hidden gem in Remuera, and I highly recommend it to anyone seeking a great cup of coffee and a warm, inviting space.
I really rate this cafe. Epic coffee at a good price and the owner was really friendly. Thank you kind sir! Hamish Dorrington Kakapo Business Sales

Recently we tried this kitchen. We loved the variety of dishes. Unfortunately the beef curry spice level was too high and feel like it could be adjusted to cater to different tolerance. No one enjoyed it as it was too spicy for our taste

Seetha's kitchen is good for me as I was hunting for homemade food and hoppers for sometime and now l found this place, the service is good and of course the food is great, they even offer to change the day of pick up for me as l was unable to pick up the order l placed two days ago. Anyone who likes home cooked meals should give it a try
the food was delicious n the service was amazing. if ur looking for tasty homemade food this place is perfect

What an incredible place to eat!! The food is absolutely delicious and the service was honestly astounding! I really cannot recommend it enough - the girls loved the smoothies and the staff were fabulous with the kids! Thank you! We will be back!!

Absolutely recommend Re Burger Remuera! The staff were amazing, super friendly, fast, and generous. They even gave us a free serving of fries and checked in to make sure everything was great. The serving sizes were huge, and the menu had plenty of delicious options to choose from. The atmosphere was cute and cozy, and everything felt like great value for money. Will definitely be coming back! 🍔🍟
First time came here. The food was so good! Chicken tenders very yummy!! Second of course is the burger. Service is good and will definitely be going again!

Came here for the first time, and amazed by the quality and service. The service was unexpectedly good and quick. The burger was really yum, true to the size shown on the tab while ordering. The staff is very friendly as well! It’s a must try place if you’re checking reviews to decide to come here!

Grabbed a burger here and was seriously impressed! The burger was high quality with fresh ingredients and great flavour. The chips were perfectly cooked and well seasoned. Awesome spot for a satisfying bite — highly recommend!

Came in to this Wild Bean just after lunch time and pie Warmer completely empty with only a a few strange flavor pies in it and not a pie in the oven even being prepared. Asked if anything was being cooked and told not for a few hours... staff should be switched on enough to keep pies in the pie warmer when that’s the main food item in the cafe. I drove out of my way to come here for a pie, disappointed. only bigger disappointment was to go out of my way to another wild bean only to get the same!! Keep your stock up especially around lunch time!

I walked in this morning and ordered a flat white takeaway. The staff took my order and stood behind the counter looking at his phone instead of making the coffee for me. I asked him to make the coffee asap because I need to go to work. And he refunded coffee money back to me instead of making it! What a HORRIBLE attitude! This is the most ridiculous cafe I’ve ever been! Your customer service skill is zero and I don’t know how someone like this getting a front house job in a café. If I’m the owner I’ll expel you immediately! How rude!!!
RUDE Guy
Caitlin was our waitress tonight and she was phenomenal. Amazing job tonight Caitlin its people like you that make people keep coming back 💯🔥

We had dinner on Tuesday night. It was a quiz night and so busy. The deal of the day was $5 slinder. We had drinks and fingers food and also enjoyed the quiz night. The food was good and served quickly.
Really great food and staff were super friendly and courteous. Highly recommended and will be back again.
Great bar! Best lager selection I have found in Auckland so far!! Food was unreal and you get a proper portion on chips. Will definitely be back!
Went with group of friends for dinner, served by Catlin. Best service ever🥰🤩highly recommended. They do Quiz Night weekly. Seems like so much fun🤩

Garlic bread with cheese..Just stick to garlic..yr choice of cheese..served on white dish.. Chicken Taco with chips Chicken nice chips abit overdone.. Served on a chipped black plate.. Large blueberry pancake with Mascarpone ..blue berries and maple syrup.. Large pancake alrite with a mould in the middle..Mascarpone on top with cubes of Anzac Biscuits not crumbled Could have done with more Fruit Berry Compote Served on a white dish.. Get rid of white dishes Going back to the 50s.. Nice English Tea.. Such a disappointment.. No sign up to say Discount with Gold Card Aint going back..
had an yummy lunch, good portions and moreish seasoned chips, highly recommend. good sized drinks and very yummy!

Food was delicious all day breakfast menu reasonable prices. Staff were friendly and service was quick was a busy morning public holidays Queens birthday. Dining area is very spacious lots of seating and car parking

The Food was disgusting. It was cold bacon was half cooked. Wasn't placed on the plate as you would've expected..My sisters Eggs Benedict was disgusting it was all cold. The lady that served us was rude as if we were going to run away...their were 4 of us. It's not like it used to be at all... Sorry to say

Exceptional hospitality, lovely, attentive & super friendly. Highly recommended- I have been to quite a few coffee clubs in Auckland & by far the most loveliest experience I’ve had. If your looking for great service, good food & amazing vibes - this is the spot 💗 Love Jess ☺️

I've visited this restaurant a couple of times and always meant to write a review but their delicious food just slipped my mind. I had the pleasure of dining there again tonight with my wife and I must say the place consistently meets high standards. The service was excellent and the seating was both nice and comfortable. My children absolutely love the sushi too. Plus, the prices are reasonable, there's plenty of parking and the atmosphere is wonderfully clean. It’s a great spot to enjoy a meal.

The service was really efficient and fast. Food came out almost instantly. The food was amazing, we got the karaage and katsu chicken for our mains. Then we got the oyster and mussels as our entree. Highly recommend this place to anyone from the neighbourhood keen to get a really yum Japanese style feed 🤙🏽
Really good service , food and drinks at this excellent Japanese restaurant.

I had a fantastic lunch at Hokkaido Restaurant & Bar on Sunday! The food was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. Every dish showcased authentic flavors, and the attention to detail in the preparation was impressive. The service was warm and attentive, making the experience even more enjoyable. Whether you're looking for a relaxing meal or a place to indulge in quality Japanese cuisine, Hokkaido Restaurant & Bar is definitely worth a visit. Thank you for the wonderful lunch

We frequent this place few years back and visited again last weekend after a long while. The servings seem to have reduced big time. We ordered more than our usual as we have missed this place but surprisingly wasnt feeling satisfied (portion wise). The taste is consistently good, however, not good enough for the price you are paying. I love their Beef Tataki. The rice seem to be sitting in an oven for a while as the top part is hard! The pork katsu is dry, thin and over cooked. We left a little bit disappointed.

OMG! How did we not find out about this place sooner?!!! It's so close to home and plenty of free parking available nearby. This is a local hidden gem and such a great restaurant for genuine Italian food. The restaurant is very tastefully decorated and was absolutely spotless! Staff were very welcoming, and they went out of their way to ensure that we enjoyed our dining experience. We have never had better garlic pizza bread, as it just melted in your mouth. We both had a prawn cocktail for our entree, which was so packed full of prawns and scrumptious. I was beginning to get a bit full after all this, but I got halfway through an entree size calamari that was also tender and delicious. This is now going to be our new favourite place and if I don't overdo the garlic bread again, perhaps I will even get to try the desserts, too!!!

Lovely restaurant!!! Came with family and a moko. Generous portions of pasta, price is reasonable. Reservation of table is well taken cared. Kids meal is even enough for an adult. Gelato was real good. Entree were superb 👍👍 Quick service and friendly. Highly recommended 👏 keep up the good work guys

Nice atmosphere and delicious grilled steak. The eye fillet was perfecty cooked and the sauce was very good, definitely a recommended dish. There was a nice atmosphere and the place was cozy and tidy. I feel bad for the staff because they seemed to struggle and couldn't keep up. My choice of drink was not available and it took a while for the staff to let us know. The same happened with the arancini. We were only told 20 minutes after we ordered our food. The waiter was very friendly and tried hard at least but I was left with the feeling the uber orders were the priority.

It's my local go to restaurant! Love the food, tap beer and wine. Has a kids menu which is great and value for money plus have colouring books and pens to keep them entertained. Never get bored of the food as you can select a different dish each time they are all good. I love the pizza and garlic pizza bread to.
Busy Saturday night and service was still good. Food was quick and tasty as always. Portofino are always consistent.

Great little gem - the food tonight was delicious (25th April 2024). Not going to lie, this is my first time ordering from this place and I was not disappointed. Great first impressions, food portions are big enough for two/three people. We bought the sweet and sour pork, pork soft noodles, BBQ pork fried rice, crab sticks, pineapple fritters, spring rolls and hot dogs. Crab sticks were really tasty and the pineapple fritters were nice. BBQ Pork fried rice was really tasty, not dry nor too oily. Great food overall. Definitely recommend to try. :)
Good service. Food tasted good 👍

Have ordered from this place a couple of times now. It's the best value priced Chinese takeaways I know in Auckland right now. The sweet and sour pork was good. Loved the fried rice. The shop was staffed by two sweet ladies who were fast courteous and provided good service.
Great value for money!! $12 for 12 wontons and 2 potato fritter!!! Fat and juicy wontons Fr. best takeaways in ellerslie deserves more business. Go to Friday night dinner.

Have lived in Mt Wellington my whole life and only ever got takeaways from barrack rd and redsun, tried Everyday Takeaways and it is now our favourite, the fish and chips are soooo yummy, crispy chips and fish is always perfect, and not so oily like redsun. Tried there chinese food also and was all delicious. Have only ever seen one lady serve us, lovely lady.

Cool vibe, chilled wine & hot fire. A great wine bar with warm and friendly service from our Shri Lankan waiter Andrew. Will post more once we have enjoyed the cuisine. Looking forward to classic Sunday roast this weekend.
Sunday Roast was fantastic! Had the pork roast incl crackle with potatoes, gravy and all the trimmings. The pork was moist and full of flavor. Great wines too. We will be back. thanks Meadow Team

Had an amazing experience at Meadow! The food and drinks were absolutely delicious, plus the service was top-notch—friendly, attentive, and welcoming. The outdoor courtyard was the perfect spot to relax and enjoy the sun. I have added a couple of photos below from my last couple of visits. Can’t wait to come back! 🌿✨
Got the wagyu burger and truffle fries. Fries were great but burger was under seasoned although the size of the patty was great. Crepes were delicious. Food took quite a while to come.

I had breakfast with my family here this morning. The food and coffee were excellent. As were the smoothies and breakfast cocktails. The food was all fresh and cooked with skill. The layout is great - open air and warm. The staff were great too- friendly and attentive without hovering too much. Best dining experience I’ve had in Auckland and my favourite mixed grill ( sausages and relish to die for). We will all be back to try their dinner options and cocktails. Hope this team stays together and keeps delivering this exceptional dining experience for a long time to come.
Fabulous Banana Smoothie 🍌🍌🍌 Bananas contain serotonin, which can help increase the level of happiness hormone!!!

Sooo good! We tried a lot of different vegan salads and the Acai Bowl. Everything tastes amazing. Great prices for what you get. The owners are really nice. We already came back a couple times and will definitely visit again before we leave Auckland.

Rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (5/5) I recently discovered this amazing family-owned healthy cafe, and it's a true gem! Here's why I love it: Healthy Variety: They offer a fantastic range of nutritious options, including gluten-free choices. Family-Friendly: Perfect for families with a diverse menu to please everyone. Fresh and Friendly: Ingredients are fresh, and the staff is incredibly welcoming. Don't miss out on this wonderful spot—support local and enjoy delicious, healthy meals! 👪💚 #SupportLocal #HealthyEating Maria chueva Meadowbank Auckland
Friendly service and excellent prawn rolls. It is great you can buy them individually.
Great place! Very healthy and good food for absolutely reasonable price. The Acai is so good! Definitely a 5 star place!
We ordered veg Biryani and it was very good in taste. If anyone looking for Veg food and good services this is a best place.
Very good restaurant for authentic Nepalese n Indian cuisine. Highly recommended
Very tasty and fresh food. Reasonable price and the manager is very friendly . Overall excellent and highly recommended if you are visiting to food in meadowbank/st john area.
Ordered delivery. Very tasty food, especially the onion bhaji which was a very generous portion.
Good portion size and tasty, more so than other food courts in large malls.
Coffee excellent. Didn't try the food but it's clearly very popular so I'm guessing it's good.

One of our favourite breakfast places! The coffee is incredible, and the breakfasts are perfectly cooked and presented! The prices are good. The service is exceptionally quick, and the staff friendly and helpful. Wonderful place to eat, drink and relax!

The staff were very nice. We ordered the Filo Chicken and Mochacino Oaty. The food was nice enough, obviously the filo wrap was made off site however the side salad was dressed on site and quite nice. The Columbus App is a bit of a headache to setup, we ended up getting a loyalty card and tried transferring it to the app but it generated its own card number so we lost all our rewards for the visit. You are better off sorting out your Columbus app before you get to the cafe and enjoy free hot beverage with a meal and buy one get one free for signup.

Our coffee group of about a dozen retired males have frequented Columbus at Mitre 10 in Stonefields on a weekly basis for about 16 years. We are always greeted by the super-friendly staff at our reserved table and always enjoy prompt service. The date scones are pretty special too.

It's hidden within Mitre 10. Great kind service. I would recommend for family with kids as there is playground in front of shop and boxes with toys inside coffee shop. They have breakfast and lunch menu with good amount of choices. Our meals tasted great. Definitely recommend and come again even if you don't go shopping for Mitre 10.
Food is impeccable! I always get The Garlic Prawns, and I’ve tried four different noodle canteens in Auckland and the Lunn Ave one is by far the best!! Highly recommend if your in the area

I ordered sweet and sour pork with noodles, the food tasted okay, however minutes after finishing eating I felt nausea, I feel so bad right now I don't feel like eating at any noodle canteen ever. However the food was cooked fast, but again, the quality was terrible.
Beautiful rice noodle dish tonight, number 3 on their menu. Asked for extra chilli, was so good!! Best one in years, think there are new wok chefs.
Usually quite good. Food is prepared well and the portions are great. Some inconsistencies from time to time but nothing major to complain about.

We attempt to try out many of the food outlets - here is one we stumbled unto because my daughter said she had had enough of eating chips and chicken 🤭 she wanted something different and it was noodles. Now we eat instant noodles at home most times but noodle at noodle canteen is super! Our fave so far - honey chicken noodle! We've been twice already 🥰👏

The best sweet and sour chicken around. Really enjoy the dishes on offer here. We love the portion sizes, the efficiency and the service. This is our regular despite not being our local. It’s worth the drive

Really tasty! I always order the Nasi Goreng, and it’s consistently full of flavor. The smoky aroma from the wok gives it that authentic Asian taste I love. There were only 2 or 3 times when the flavor was a bit off — maybe due to a different chef — but overall, it’s one of my go-to dishes here. Highly recommend!

Got takeaways from here so can't comment on service or atmosphere! Singapore fried rice with pork, Satay chicken, sweet and sour pork, pad Thai and wontons were all really AMAZING! I'd travel to get takeaways from here

We have ordered food from this takeaway since they opened the doors. The chicken chow mein with soft noodles was terrible tonight. The dish didn’t smell or taste fresh the noodles were dry and obviously tossed in soy sauce and the vege was not fresh at all. I doubt it was cooked in oil as the food was just warm, not oil tossed hot. My guess is that it’s changed ownership. We will not be ordering from them ever again instead we will go back to where it started..The Diamond takeaway in Epsom.
The servings are generous and delicious . Service is fantastic . The owner sets out to provide the best food!

Back again and just had to share the corn fritters are great here. Nice fresh salad topped with corn fritter, bacon with avocado. Right amount of sweet chilli sauce. Corn fritter nicely made right corn to batter ratio and the bacon in between with crispy bits on the ends. Will be back for these again. Have been frequenting this place for coffee and the occasional breakfast for a few weeks now. Was feeling hungry so stopped in for the eggs benedict and added 2 hash browns. Job done! Exactly what I was looking for. Set for the rest of the day now. Eggs cooked perfectly. Good helping of bacon all on toasted sour dough bread topped with bene sauce. Nothing to complain about here. I've also had the OT breakfast here and if you're hungry then thats a great option. Staff are always friendly. Always smiling and wanting to help. Cafe is an open area. Lovely in the summer and is still OK today tho it is wet outside. Happy to recommend this one to those that work, live or traveling in the area. I'll be back. Thanks Open Table
Eggs Benedict ŵ pulled port 🤤 and chicken burger chips option. Sizes were good price was good. Staff were lovely ♥️ nice little hidden gem

A wonderful local Cafe with excellent coffee and cabinet food (nice scone). Very nice to have a cafe of such character locally with friendly service. Proper large coffee size and not weak because of it. Sat 1pm.

We ordered from the printed menu. The coffee was good. The creamy mushroom was nice - not too heavy and lots of pepper which is how i prefer it. The poached egg was cooked well, not over done. The salad appeared to have come from a bag and there was little of it on my plate. The chicken burger with fries was terrible - the chicken patties were dry, thin, and tasted as if they had been microwaved. The sauce was obviously from a bottle, not homemade. The salad appeared to have come from a bag, which is fine, but not expected for a cafe meal. The bread was fine, a brioche bun, nothing exciting but one of the best parts of the burger. The fries were shoe string size and were overcooked in stale oil. Next time i will try ordering off their specials menu.
The atmosphere was chill and fresh vegetables.

I visited around 12 noon on a Sunday, and the place was bustling, I’d say about 85% full. I ordered a large almond cappuccino and a Hummingbird cake from the cabinet. The wait times were noticeable. Despite the cupcake not needing any prep or heating, it took around 12 minutes to be served. When it arrived, I snapped a quick photo, and just before slicing into it, I noticed something unusual. I brought it back to the counter, and to their credit, the staff replaced it straight away. After that, it was another 7-minute wait before the coffee arrived. Taste-wise, both the cupcake and the cappuccino were okay — I’d rate them about 3 out of 5. Overall, the service was polite and responsive, but the timing and flow could use a bit of work, especially during peak hours. Still, it’s a decent spot if you’re not in a rush.

I've seen this while passing several times, and finally managed to make it in for breakfast. The staff were very friendly, and though the place was quiet, it was pretty steady. I went for the bacon buttie, which was delicious but smaller than I expected, and next time I might add a side. I finished up with a cheese scone, which was also great.

My Husband and I had a lovely experience at Charlie and George. We ordered the Eggs Benedict and a flat white, and everything was spot on. The bacon was perfectly extra crispy – just how we like it – and the hash brown was clearly homemade, not the frozen kind, which was a great touch. The eggs were beautifully cooked with nice runny yolks. The coffee was smooth and well-balanced, making for a perfect pairing with the meal. The atmosphere was warm, inviting, and relaxed, making it a great spot to unwind. Highly recommend for a weekend brunch or a cozy coffee catch-up!
Best place for good breakfast and also lunch, they got variety of foods and beverages for you to choose from. Highly recommended and will definitely be back 👏🏻

Lovely cafe in a nice location. Coffee is good, can be better. Delicious eggs bene. Presentation of fluffy can be improved. Nice surroundings for kids to hang out. Overall good experience, will be back.

Service was so bad that our party of six all noticed that the staff were slamming plates down and heavy handedly collecting the cutlery. The lettuce wrapped chicken burger I got was a little depressing. The vibe was decent for a Wednesday evening, and there are really good daily specials, but this was a pretty mediocre experience between the food and the service.

I have been coming here for some time,band thought I had already made a review, but maybe not? I come in most Fridays for my end of the week dinner and drinks, and really enjoy the atmosphere, menu and service. I'm not sure if I have a set order yet, but I have yet to regret trying something. Sometimes there is music, but it's never intrusive and just generally a nice place to relax.

Food was great when it came. Bit frustrated tho coz we asked for three chicken curries ordered with two being extra mild and one mild. When they came they told us they just did three normal mild. Just seemed like they didn't care that two of us can't handle too hot. Love the venue but need to feel valued.

We love this place and have now been here several times. The staff are very friendly and the chef's always give me a waive now as we arrive. I love their different daily specials, and we've been several times for steak night. Always too full for desert, but I will get there one day.

Came in the other night ordered the steak. The meal was good. Salad dressing was nice. But the steak was like a rubber sand shoe. Wasn't enjoyable at all. But the staff and atmosphere is a great place

Heard somewhere that this shop was one of the best. Don't live close but decided today I would do a quick detour to pop by and try it out. Expectations were high based on reviews, and I can safely say they were met. Chips are great and the crumbed fish was very fresh and tasty. Also, finally a fish and chip shop both me and the wife agree is good, so now I'll need to drive over there to get dinner on fish and chip nights.

Superb oysters!!! Also got snapper but remember to order some sauce to go with it. Had quite a long wait on a Friday night, but everyone was friendly and their food is just so good so can’t complain lol

First time visiting Chip' N Dayal's and it didn't disappoint. After hearing so many positive comments I completely agree that the food and service is incredible. Was greeted with a lovely smile on arrival and made to feel welcomed. Well prepared tasty and fresh food, which delivers on all levels. If you like a spicy kick I highly recommend the spicy snapper bugger.
I love this place. The chips aren't soggy and floppy like many others. They are crispy and crunchy. Fish is fresh and sweet. Crunchy and freshly made batter. The hoki combo is great value.
I came here a couple of weeks ago. The food was amazing, and the staff were super sweet. I would highly recommend the burgers and the pineapple rings; I ordered 4 and ate 3 of them in one sitting!

Delicious and authentic One of the best Nepales n Indian food I’ve had—rich flavors, great portions, and very friendly service. The atmosphere was warm and inviting. Highly recommend for a tasty, satisfying meal☺️☺️ Best place for events

Glad they had lunch specials available, since $25-28 for a curry dish with rice only is a little bit pricey Easy to book for large groups and great tasting food! A bigger variety of flavours compared to other restaurants so a good chance to try them out~

Lovely food and staff here. Enjoyed the Butter Chicken/ Chicken Korma. Chicken was cooked beautifully. Very attentive staff. We went later on in the evening so there weren't many people there. Lots of space to hold larger groups.

Excellent food and atmosphere. We went for a dinner and it was amazing. We then booked a birthday party. The food is amazing especially the vegetarian manchurian, garlic chicken and their curry village special chicken. I have had plenty of restaurant secret recipes dishes but this one was great. The service is amazing. Very accommodating when we moved around few items during the party. There was continuous supply of snacks and mains. My guests were very happy. The staff is super friendly and courteous. The seating plan was nice. I liked the ambiance. Plenty of parking available around. There is ramp for wheelchair access.
We had a Mataa paneer and lamb vindaloo and they were both amazing! So delicious! They even gave us complementary naan as well as poppadoms. Thank you for great service and we will be back

First time dining at Thai On Lunn. Service was fast and food came out fresh and hot. Good portion and good value for money. They always came around to check if our food was okay and if we needed anything else. Clean and tidy restaurant with a positive atmosphere. We will be bring a group of friends back to this restaurant just because of our first time experience. We ordered Chicken Pad Thai and Chicken on a hot plate with sweet and sour sauce served with coconut cream rice which was a great combo. Dessert was Chocolate mud cake with a side of vanilla bean ice cream and whipped cream and also banana wrapped in thin pastry (fried) with vanilla bean ice cream. It’s a BYO with an $8 fee for corkage

Above averaged Thai place you probably won't notice when driving/walking pass. Very tasty, great quality, fast serving and quiet and comfy environment. Portion for lunch meals might not be enough for hungry bears but perfect fit for refreshing meals. Curry has good amount of vegetables in comparison with some Thai places serve curry in chicken.
Food was amazing overall, very tasty and good local Thai with some nice touches of authenticity. Staff was super friendly and nice. Would definitely recommend this place !

Thai on Lunn is one of my go-to spots—I visit them frequently, and they never disappoint! The food is always tasty and full of flavour. You can really tell they put a lot of effort into every dish. The service is consistently excellent, especially from Bee, who is always welcoming and attentive. She really makes the dining experience special. Highly recommend this place to anyone who loves delicious Thai food and warm, friendly service. I’ll definitely keep coming back!
I really like the spicy taste that goes straight to the top of my head，although my husband doesn't!😄

Asked for a 6inch sub of day and the female staff behind the counter looked at their sub of day menu. It was clearly a pizza melt sub for Friday. They made the sandwich then when it was time to pay for it she said "sorry sub of day is pork" .. didn't explain what she was talking about properly and charged me full price for the 6inch pizza melt instead of the sub of day price. Either dishonest or misleading advertising instore or both and I had to pay for their "mistake"/lie. How ridiculous. Not coming back and I wouldn't recommend this branch to anybody because they have prob misled lots of people already

I really rate this Subway. The team are super friendly and give excellent service, and the meats and produce are always really fresh. Pork Riblet on Italian Herbs & Cheese is my go to and it never disappoints! Hamish Dorrington Kakapo Business Sales

Completely frustrated with this Subway branch. I ordered a sub and clearly asked for three specific sauces. Not only was I charged extra for no reason, but when I picked up my order, there wasn't a single sauce on it. Since I wasn’t there when it was made, it’s obvious the guy working there was either lazy or sneaky. Terrible service – avoid this place!
Three pepper chicken now noticeably smaller and tastes noticeably worse but costs more.. nice 👍 Good staff though.
On time with my pick up order. Good way yummy and had decent amount of fillings

I ordered a salad bowl and asked the store not to put rice in it due to allergies. They told me they would not put rice in saying they would add extra vegetable stating they could only put extra cabbage and carrot in instead, which i agreed to but apon recieving my meal found out they had ignored my request and filled it with rice anyway, then they ignored my callback to find out what had happened I wont be eating here again

Horrible customer service. Stood waiting to be served for ages being ignored by two employees. Told twice to use the kiosk even though I want to pay cash and told them that. No "hello, we will be with you soon". This was just after 10 in the morning. Understood that they were busy with an online order. Doesn't take two people to continuously attend to that and ignore their customers that are in store. Left without being helped or buying food. Reading other reviews about this shop, I wonder why the owner doesn't do anything about this.

So disappointed that they’ve taken away the gluten free pitas and just gone to boring wraps which are fricken $18!! Absolutely ridiculous. Service ladies were rude as. Super duper slow. They toasted my wrap then pulled it out of the toaster it fell to pieces so they just scrunched it up and shoved it in paper absolutely vial. Not even toasted just huge chunks of cheese. Waste of $18 probably won’t eat it has completely put me off.

Our local store makes the best chicken pita in all of Auckland but you’ve also got to be sure to try out their new Egg’d menu. Had an awesome ‘the Benedict’. Best of all is that the staff are always laughing and happy. James Ashwin Kakapo Business Sales
[Egg'd Benedict] Poorly scrambled eggs. Look like just flat fried eggs. Big disappointment compared to the one I got first time.
Ordered a sushi platter for a birthday. Very disappointed with the amount of fillings. Hardly any meat or veg.

Stopped in here for lunch on a cold wet and windy day. I ordered the shrimp cocktail and chicken on fire with a nice miso soup. Dined inside, was delicious and peaceful. Will be back again thank you team :-)

The sushi here has gone way downhill. Had this 3 times recently and the quality has been terrible. The salmon sushi I got recently had pieces with a sliver of salmon and similar sized pieces of avocado (some bruised). The bigger pieces of salmon tasted odd, and on closer inspection looked like it was frozen as the salmon meat is a different consistency to fresh salmon. The portions are also smaller and rice is not quite right, a tad hard and not packed correctly. Seems like a change in ownership/ management, maybe the same people as the Mt Wellington St Pierre's which is even worse.

I really like the great service, friendly staff and that this shop is always clean and tidy. Also, if there is an item that is not ready made and available to buy at the time, then they will make it for you, no problem and straight away. 👌
Nice local sushi place, always friendly and efficient!

Normally good. This time chips were half full and wedges were more like a kids portion, with only enough sour cream for 2 wedges really. Especially since they are premium priced, was bit off. Chicken Burger had less chicken in it this time round. Slightly disappointed as have a lways enjoyed our occasional takeAway from Charcoal burger.

Ok it was a little while ago I was here.. and have been meaning to write a review. The burger looked exactly like the picture, and tasted even better. If Michael Douglas came here for a burger on a bad day, he would leave with a smile. (IYKYK)
It was the most delicious burger I've ever had at a local restaurant. And, the people running the restaurant were so kind and polite 😊
Meat on chips was the most average I’ve ever had, and the proportions were so poor, barely any sauce, meat or chips for the price paid. Would not eat here again.
The burger was about three times the size of the ones at other places. Very friendly service and affordable price.

Great and tasty breakfast, nice outdoor area too. Easy to do your walks and runs in the wetlands or playround at the golf course and then have a great food. The new pancakes were awesome! We will come again!

Winstone's Cafe Bar Bistro is a cozy and inviting establishment located in the heart of Auckland. Known for its relaxed atmosphere and friendly service, it’s a great place to unwind and enjoy a meal or drink. The menu offers a variety of delicious dishes, from hearty breakfasts to satisfying lunches and dinners, all prepared with fresh, high-quality ingredients. Whether you're in the mood for a gourmet burger, a healthy salad, or a decadent dessert, Winstone's has something to satisfy every craving. The bar also features a good selection of wines, craft beers, and expertly made cocktails. With its charming decor and comfortable seating, Winstone's Cafe Bar Bistro provides a welcoming environment for both casual dining and special occasions.

I came here many years ago and felt that the menu was very basic, I think they have a new chef because the menu has changed and the specials are really good. The food was delicious and the price wasn't too bad either. I really enjoyed the fish and chips and biryani. There's lots of seating.
Great atmosphere to enjoy a drink and a meal.

The waitress forget my meal, just a simple toast! I asked twice, they are saying food is coming. Then they told me the chief forgot my meal. They make me hungrily wait for 30mins with no apologise at all. This is my frist time be here. I will never come back again.

I recently visited the Tank on Lunn Avenue and was really impressed by both the product and the service. I ordered the Brew Me Up smoothie, and it absolutely hit the spot. It had a rich, smooth coffee flavour with just the right balance of creaminess and energy. It's perfect for a mid-morning pick-me-up without feeling too heavy. The staff was friendly, efficient, and genuinely seemed to care about the quality of the drinks they were making. The store itself was clean and well-managed.

I went thru the reviews before visiting the store but went anyways and im glad i did. The staff is very polite. It was my first time trying Tank juice and im hooked. I asked for advice on which flavor i should go for and whats the top selling one. The service was quick and convenient. It is a great post workout snack fr.

Awful service, waited over half an hour for 2 smoothies, customers came after us ordered and left before us, staff couldn't care less. 1 drink contained nuts (health nut protein) and another contained diary (mango zest)... the person drinking the nut drink cannot drink dairy (lactose intolerant) & the person drinking the mango drink is allergic to nuts, as if this wait time was bad enough, when they eventually made them they put the smoothies in the incorrect labeled cups... very dangerous, its a good job i went back to check! Absolute terrible service, unsure how this store got the "2024 store of the year" if this is the level to compete with I worry!

My husband ordered our usual—two Gym Junkie juices and a Strawberry Fields, which is meant to include strawberries, apple, and orange only. The Strawberry Fields is for our daughter who has multiple allergies, so we’re always careful with ingredients and have ordered this particular combo many times before without any issue. Unfortunately, shortly after taking a sip of her drink, my daughter started developing hives, and her face & chest began to swell. I immediately gave her antihistamines as prescribed by her doctor. Thankfully, she didn’t have any trouble breathing, and I didn’t need to use her EpiPen, but she was very uncomfortable and irritable from the nonstop itchiness on her face and chest. This was her face just minutes after I gave her the antihistamine. We’re very very disappointed this happened, especially since we rely on consistency and accuracy with orders due to her medical needs. We kindly ask that staff to be extra mindful and double-check ingredients when preparing drinks—especially for customers with allergies. Mistakes like this could have serious consequences.

Online ordering means no queues and fast, easy pickup as the store does get very busy sometimes. Only quirk is not being able to customise combos online (e.g. no onions, no salt etc.) like you can if you order individual items.

One of my favorite lunch places. The sushi is freshly made or if you want something more, the bowls of ramen or donburi are generous and so tasty! The staff are friendly and welcoming. Either eat in or takeaway. Well worth a visit.

I just discovered this little place and I will definitely be back! I have eaten Teriyaki Chicken Donburi more times than I can count but yesterday I had possibly the best ever here. Lots of perfectly cooked, succulent and delicious chicken, loaded with also perfectly cooked veggies, over plenty of rice that had just the right amount of sauce. I was asked if I wanted spicy and was advised, if I could tolerate a little spice (I can), it was the tastier choice. Great advice! There was a slight bite to the dish which improved the overall flavour without being so spicy you couldn’t taste anything else. The place is tiny and mostly set up for takeout. There are a few tables along one side but with very uncomfortable furniture. When I’m in the area I prefer to eat in during a break from shopping so more comfortable seating would have been nice. But that’s my only negative. And I like that they have longer hours than the other Japanese place in the area. Loved this little spot, can’t wait to go back!

Fabulous place for sushi, great range and hot meal options as well ranging from dons to yakisoba! Rate their dons, hefty portion for a good cost and delicious in quality. Team is awesome and a group of lovely people who serve with care.

The place itself was nice, modern colors. I had high expectations therefore, for the food. With the nice TV menu and layout. I had the chicken katsu curry. It wasn't bad, it wasn't the best either. I felt like the curry sauce was microwaved and not freshly prepared. You know that microwave effect, when a thick liquid hardens at the surface. It was that way. The katsu was a bit dry. So 4 stars for the location, 2 stars for the katsu. However, I will give the other donburi meals a try in the coming weeks.

Sushi tastes great but bought end of day sushi when store closed in 5 minutes and paid $16.40 for it. Thought it was quite a rip off for end of the day sushi, St pier would have been cheaper and fresher. Pretty unhappy with service :(

The food here is delicious but is a bit pricey, I believe the meal I ordered was around $17.00 if I’m not mistaken. Definitely a good meal to have for lunch or an early dinner but I would recommend ordering extra if you are feeling peckish. The staff here seem friendly and the store was clean from what I could see which is always a bonus. Well done to the team at this branch.

Premium Korean Fried Chicken! Original fried chicken or choose between one their sauces. Seasoned, Soy Garlic, Hot Spicy, White Onion or Supreme. Bone in or Boneless, Whole or Half Chicken. They also have Combos and other sides. The chips have seasoning and the Cheese Dogs are worth trying.

Hot and spicy realllyy hot! Love it, we had whole chicken the portions are quite big, maybe next time we will go with the half portion for 2 of us. They do not replay to the phone tho. :( EDIT: we ve been here very often as we live very close and we like fried chicken; lately has not been good. The rice is extremely over cooked, the chicken is not crispy, super soggy, the portions are getting smaller and smaller every time. Today I also found a hair in my rice (see the pic). Not coming back ever again.

Got my chips and chicken open it up bam no seasoning on my chips just plain old potato nothing else. Went back asked for some seasoning bro said no the lady said yes proceeds to sprinkle like rationining level spice on my chips. Am very sad Am very upset I cry to sleep :(

Yummy food 🍲💕. Parking infront. Lots of sun 🌞☀️. Outdoor sitting. Pet / dog 🐶🐕 friendly and reasonable price. Good customer service and also power point available to charge your phone, tablet or laptop 📱. Only thing I would suggest is provide water for customers.

I recently visited this restaurant, and I must say the service was truly outstanding. The staff were very attentive and the food arrived at our table in a remarkably short amount of time. However, I found that the dishes lacked a certain authenticity in flavor. Unfortunately, the pork I ordered had a bit too much fat for my liking, which detracted from the overall experience.
The food is good but a very small portion for the price. Excellent service and very tidy environment. 5pm.
The roast pork was crispy, and the spring rolls had a generous portion size. The coffee was also quite authentic💚
First and foremost customer service was excellent very welcoming and friendly Meals arrived very quick and all tasted great Great atmosphere Will definitely be back here again in the future!

Impressed with the service! The staff are very friendly and welcoming. I ordered the grilled pork served with rice — the portion was huge and definitely great value for the price. They also mentioned that new menu book is coming soon , featuring which photos of the food , which sounds great , looking forward to trying more dishes. Highly recommend !
Decent food 👌🌮 🍔 love the outdoor as I can bring my furbaby 🐕. Ofcourse plenty of parking 🚗 in Lunn Avenue. Fast service. Inside the restaurant looks good. Will visit again for those Taco deals ✅️

The nachos were not free. We got the voucher after purchase. Just using the pic as a reference. Why, taco bell always lets me down but I keep returning hoping it’ll be better because I love Mexican and some days, you’re just in a rush! Three stars because the staff here are awesome and so lovely. Less two stars cause food is gross. Needs more salsa and fresh lettuce for that feeling of a healthy bite! The biggest lol is the cheese from the tube. Not drippy like the pic at all 🤣 it’s just so bad. Or did they miss the cheese altogether and the white stuff is sour cream? In any case, it’s bad food.

This place has sadly downgraded …. They use to have the best food , now everything is old and stale. Had one person , poor him, looked miserable and made the food look miserable too. I spent $14 on this order and pretty much had nothing in it. Took one bite and was like no thanks Was a real let down. This was literally all I got, I asked for extra lettuce it was less then the original amount. It was one of the bowl meals The fries won’t cooked properly, it was raw inside 😔…. Really upsetting
I ordered the loaded nachos won’t be doing that again. table spoon of meat a teaspoon of salsa, a teaspoon of sour cream and a teaspoon of avocado. This is a joke 95% of my meal was chips.

The food was delicious for sure. The speed is not bad. The drinks are good too with strawberry or vanilla flavours. We also like the outdoor dining area. There are not too many tables indoor. There should be enough toilets for everyone. The only complaint I have is that there are litters on the floor which doesn’t look nice.

New kid on the block. Sister restaurant from Japan and the quality doesn't disappoint. Pork Katsu set was very nice with tender pork and fragrant rice. The price was very good as well at under $20 for a pretty good size set. Chicken katsu egg don was very nice with good flavours and good amount of eggs. Plenty of choices on the menu to choose from, we want to try the curry don next time.

Not sure if the kitchen was understaffed or the chef was just slow, but the food took way too long to come out. The taste was decent, but the long wait really tested my patience. While Katsu Katsu has more of a modern, trendy vibe that’s great for couples or friends, this place feels more family friendly it’s the kind of spot you’d bring the whole family to. I don’t think I’ll be returning to this branch, but I might give the other location a try sometime

Daruma ramen no more and replaced with Katsu-Tei. I ordered pork Katsu the first time when I visited and the pork was a bit dry. Another establishment does better pork Katsu. Which was a bit of a let down. But the 2nd time visiting I ordered the Gyu sirloin steak Katsu and to my surprise it was done beautifully! Wife had the chicken Katsu with egg on hot plate. The Katsu itself was great but there was a burnt taste with the egg. Perhaps overcooked with the sauce on the sizzling plate? Not sure. Overall it's a good experience and will visit again.

Food was delicious. We ordered the: - pork miso udon - tofu miso udon - egg plant - chips - matcha ice cream dessert Atmosphere is lovely until it gets a crowded, the open space and way it’s designed becomes a noisy when crowded Service was alright, staff who took our order struggled with the menu - when ordering miso udon they said it wasn’t an option (despite being on the menu). We got the order through in the end and the option for miso udon was, indeed, available.

Loved this Japanese katsu place! Newly opened, replacing the old Daruma. The kids set menu was great, includes chicken/pork katsu, rice, chips, edamame and jelly. The kids really rated it and finished the whole thing! Adult pork and chicken katsu sets great value just under $20. Everything delicious. Staff were lovely and welcoming of our little ones (we had 4 under 5). Will be back for more!
There have been improvements over the years in staff. Quite good Ice Coffees better than a lot of cafes. Just need more cleaning then this branch will be quite good. Sat 7pm.

My double cheese burger was nice, but the fries were overcooked. A kids' playground inside the McDonald's. Even a room for a small birthday party or business meetings. Nice and clean . Heaps of parking outside.

Terrible service. Asked for fresh fries and patty in my burger for which I was made to park and wait. Which I was happy to do despite being in a hurry. I was still bought an old hard fillet burger and cold fries. It wasn’t until I had to stop at red lights by the store and tried to grab a bite of the food and found it to be terrible
Im disappointing... Train your staff probably... Service was poor and food was the worst 😞

Ordered the Angus Hawaiian and the beef patty, was cold, thin looking, dry and no flavour like it had been cooked over 2 hours ago. Need to improve this 10 fold as beef is a national icon of Maccas NZ
