Loved their Pizza s on offer. We had BBQ Chicken Pizza with some fries and it was so delicious. We will be back again for sure to try their other options.

Tried out this pizza joint and it was really delicious. The service is great and their pizza deals were really good. Ordered the taco pizza, cheese, maxi meat pizza, onion rings and garlic bread all were really tasty a nice pizza base and good amount of toppings. The taco pizza is so yummy quite surprising with lettuce on it. A clean pizza place good seating space inside and easy parking at this location.

We ordered 2 beef pizzas as part of a value meal and 1 separate chicken pizza. The beef pizzas had maybe 3 pieces of beef per slice and it was basically a cheese pizza. The chicken pizza regular size was tiny. Called back after pick up to mention the lack of beef and they weren’t interested until mentioning a google review. You can definitely find better pizza.

You can have a delicious well top filled pizza here Better not to miss pepperoni twisters, even better than its pizza. Well salted crispy chips too. Clean tables and well behaved servant called Meddy, We enjoyed our dinner dined in and quenched our pizza Hunger.

I don't know what's going on with this place. Feels like it's under new management? The pizza here used to be REALLY good and set itself apart from its fast food pizza competitiors with thoughtful details. But recently, it tastes like bad frozen pizza from the supermarket. Pretty disappointing 😞.

This is our 5th dine in here in Meadowbank Pizzeria. And oh my goodness! The pizza is the best! You will instantly felt full after 2 slices of it. Also, their pasta is extremely delicious, the ingredients are a lot! Its such a generous toppings and I always recommend this to my friends. Must visit pizza when you are in Remuera. We ordered Greek Special and Coriander beef! My favourite is greek special!

We are so glad that our accommodation was right next door to this amazing little pizzeria! HIGHLY recommend all the food, but especially the fettuccine and tandoori gourmet pizza. You can tell everything is fresh and they are so generous with their portions and toppings. Thanks again!! We will definitely be back!

We live nearby, so we decided to give the restaurant a try. We dined in and ordered a pizza and two pastas. Both pastas clearly tasted defrosted, and the restaurant didn’t even try to hide it. Pretty sure we saw the meal taken out of the freezer and heated it in the microwave. As expected with reheated food, the dishes were piping hot, and the pasta was soggy and overcooked. The pizza wasn’t much better, especially for a place that specialises in Italian food.

In the effort to support local we tried this spot and so glad we did. 300% better than the pizza chains, honest. You're not going to get real neopolitana pizza but then you wnt at the chains either. Do yourself massive favor and check them out. You won't be a ordering from Dominos or Pizza Hit again ... good value which is also part of the experience. So happy Im a local.

Came to Meadowbank Pizzeria for dinner tonight. Got a Gormet Special pizza. It was amazing. probably one of the nicest pizzas I've had since going to Italy. Anchovies, capers amd olives were plentiful, and the roasted garlic made the whole thing pop. Would definitely return here next time I'm in Auckland.

Very fresh and traditional Cantonese style yum cha dishes available, the pho is good too. I regularly have the pork chop lemon grass rice noodle soup and the steamed spare ribs in black beans sauce. Very affordable price.
My son and I come here almost every Fridays to get their siu Mai, dumplings and won ton Viet style soup, super delicious , great value for money 💰 many options to choose from to suit your budget
Part of the Hasan group but unfortunately misses the authentic flavour. Rice was very gluggy on my lemon grass chicken so I knew when they bought it out that it wasn’t going to live up
Came here to the meadowbank branch to try the prawn spinach dumps and steam black bean ribs and was bloody delicious 😋
Enjoyed my quick lunch here with a wonton bbq noodle soup. The soup is so good, with the noodle in it, excellent match. The meat in the wonton can be better.

My first visit to the new Weber store was absolutely fantastic! This shop is a true paradise for BBQ enthusiasts, offering the complete range of Weber grills and accessories. The friendly and knowledgeable staff went above and beyond to assist me, making the entire experience even more enjoyable. I was tempted to buy everything in sight! If you’re a BBQ lover, this store is an absolute must-visit. Highly recommended!

Fantastic evening spent with a great bunch of people. A really neat course but incredibly fun 3 hours . Well worth the time to come to this even if you’re coming g solo. Thanks to the team at BBQ Central Weber Store for hosting such a great session.

I have just been to the Weber Store this afternoon, and what a wallet decimating future this place is going to be. I justify it by reminding myself there are worse vices I could indulge in. Met up with Jason who took the time to talk me through my options, which nicely led me to buying a new Summit. The store is amazing, and Jason's service was above and beyond brilliant. His time and patience helping me out was simply fabulous.

A colleague and I had the pleasure of attending a Weber masterclass event here last night and had the best time! I was blown away with how much you can actually get out of your Weber and the technology these days is incredible. If you’re at all considering a new BBQ I’d highly recommend paying a visit. Jason and the team there are passionate about the products and will be able to point you in the right direction so that if you do end up buying, it’s only going to be something that’s perfectly suited to you. Thanks a lot guys. Hamish Dorrington Kakapo Business Sales
Very friendly staff, lots of grills and barbecues options and an amazing selection of YETI products!
Best authentic Japanese cooking - just like I would get back in Japan, my home country! Great value for money. Great variety. Beautifully prepared and cooked - the family's favourite place to eat.
This most delicious sushi like in Japan! Highly recommend!
Of course, the taste is not as good as real Japanese sushi, but it is certainly fresh sushi that is handmade every morning. It is quite good for sushi in a mall food court.

I know this place and eat here regularly. Japanese sushi by a Japanese family who care about their quality products. Not as cheap or maybe as fast as some chain stores but if you want excellent hot meals cooked freshly to order and real authenticity give Midori Sushi Bar a try.
They used to be good not anymore lately which is a shame, don’t order sashimi. The salmon slice is so thin that is even thinner than the top of a salmon sushi. Not happy with it.

Have came here twice now and both times have been pretty disappointed with the food. Lamb is very tough and gravy thin/watery. The roast potatoes taste like they have been put in the deep fryer and so have a old/rancid oil taste. Serving size is generous but you would hope so for the price…
They are always very friendly, the meals are a good size, and they pack the container totally crammed full of roast veges with gravy, on top of meat. Everything is tasty and fresh!

My partner enjoyed her meal, but I have a few minor complaints. Staff are friendly, fast and efficient. However, meat was a bit tough, gravy was a bit bland, and pork crackling didn't taste right. They should also be a bit more generous with meat portion, considering the price.
Ordered medium lamb roast which was filling and tasty. Lamb was nice and tender, potatoes were nice. I felt like it lacking a little salt hence the 4 stars. Overall nice roast place
Really good roast place! Had a pork role and it was honestly one of the best we've had and quite large!

Indian food is something that I always want to bring my kids to try. But we were afraid that it would be spicy. Today, on my birthday date, I have decided to have Indian cuisine as my birthday meal. All the curry was made with mild spice level which my kids thoroughly enjoyed. It is very good value with the portion given. I have ended up take away the leftovers. The service is very warm and welcoming. I am sure that I will be back and become a loyal customer.

Their biryani lamb was absolutely amazing! Perfectly balanced flavors, beautifully presented, and cooked to perfection. It's a must try for anyone visiting Khana. Special thanks to the lady who welcomed us to dine in even if it's too late already. We'll come back again 😇
One of the best Indian cuisines in New Zealand! Delicious food, very affordable prices, and I highly recommend everyone to come and try it for themselves.

I can’t believe I’ve been sleeping on this place - really sweet eatery with delicious authentic food! Right now they have some great deals on, so we got the royal feast for $50 for two people, and it certainly felt like a royal feast. It definitely feels a cut above your standard Indian place - I especially loved the lamb saag curry, the selection of sauces and the chicken cutlets which were soooo creamy and buttery. Fantastic vegetarian options available too. The owners were super nice and it’s a lovely space. Support local!

Curry club night again. In the burbs of meadow bank. The actual mains on the menu were limited but a few dishes not on the menu which I’d recommend trying. Shared a couple platters for entrees between 5 of us and had three curries. The chef does a great job. Personally I found medium hot to be a little more like mild (versus other curry houses) so if you like it spicier maybe have a dish or two hot. NZD 52 each including a couple of drinks each.

Yesterday, I had one of the best pizza experiences at Pizza Hut! I ordered a vegetarian pizza, and it turned out to be absolutely delicious. The pizza was perfectly cooked, topped generously with fresh vegetables like capsicum and jalapeños, and beautifully drizzled with flavorful sauces that added just the right amount of kick and creaminess. Every bite was a burst of taste, and the cheesy goodness was simply irresistible. A special shoutout to Sandeep Singh, who served me with such professionalism and friendliness. He made sure the order was perfect and even suggested some great toppings that truly elevated the flavor. The service was quick, the pizza was piping hot, and everything about the experience was just top-notch. Highly recommend this Pizza Hut location if you’re craving a delicious vegetarian pizza. I’ll definitely be back for more!

We ordered a large number of pizzas from Pizza Hut Meadowbank for our school fundraiser. UG was awesome to deal with, the pizzas were delivered on time and still hot. I would highly recommend. It’s also our family’s go-to place for takeaway pizza.

Wish I could add a photo to my review... usually my orders are fine but today I ordered a Hawaiian but was given a pepperoni with the tiniest amount of cheese... very disappointed by this, will look at going somewhere else for lunch now Update to add: submitted a formal complaint almost 1 month ago (27th May) and haven't heard anything. Was told.it would be 3-5 business days, not good enough PH

The best Pizza Hut in New Zealand. I have been to more than 20 Pizza Huts and ko one is like these guys. Amazing Pizza, way better quality than other Pizza Hut locations and excellent service. WELL DONE Pizza Hut Meadowbank team. Thank you from Goran
Fantastic, pizzas are great! Also I accidentally ordered for the wrong day and they helped me move it with no problems.

First off, crab sticks. Is it real crab or fake crab? I will never know. Does it taste good? 5/10 really oily, can’t taste the crab, old oil? I ate some more and honestly 3/10, saving factor was that it was crunchy. Second - chips 7/10. Not enough lemon pepper seasoning, paid an extra $1 for shoestring fries only for it to not be crispy. Main component: Fish SUBPAR, FLAVOURLESS, & OILY. Tried the tartare sauce to save it, the WORST tartare I’ve ever had, what did they do to the poor condiment? It tastes horrible D; 1/10 Money? gone ✔️ ($30) Unsatisfied? uh huh ✔️ Leftovers? yep ✔️ Arteries? clogged ✔️ Overall 1/5, no napkins either ;(

This was honestly one of the best fish and chips shops I've ever been to! First of all, the chips were absolutely fantastic—crispy on the outside and perfectly fluffy on the inside. The fish was equally amazing, fresh, and cooked to perfection. Secondly, the staff were incredibly friendly and welcoming, which made the experience even better. A big thank you to them for making our visit so enjoyable. Lastly, the cleanliness of the shop and the overall ambiance really stood out. The environment was warm and inviting, making it the perfect spot to enjoy a delicious meal. Overall, this place is a true gem, and I can’t wait to return!

Read the reviews & saw the Fire Service truck outside one night when driving past. First impression was how clean the place was. The owner was friendly and the service was prompt efficient and finally the food is worth going back for. Chips were cooked perfectly. Crispy exterior, fluffy interior& not greasy. I ordered the crumbed prawns which were beautifully cooked along with the squid rings and crab sticks. I’ll be trying the burgers next and ordering online as suggested by the owner next time. Great to finally find a good Fish n Chips shop in the area.

The fish and chips were fried beautifully. Batter or crumbs were offered for fish. Fish is fresh. Wedge of lemon. Choice of type of fries on some of the choices of meals, no oily grease residue on the bottom of the packaging. Way better than average but you do pay a premium for it.
Top service!! Chips and fish were BEAUTIFUL!! Excellent presentation !! Highly recommend 👌
Not sure why these guys have such a low rating. I got a large roast pork meal and was super happy. Good portion and yummy flavour. Crackling super crispy !

Tried this spot for a roast and was pretty disappointed. The lamb was dry, which made it tough to enjoy, and to top it off, I found a hair in my food definitely not what you want when eating out. The portions were decent, but the overall experience left a bad taste. Hope they improve their quality and hygiene. Nga mihi

Tasted fine but disappointed with the portion size. $12.50 - or $15 on UberEats as my partner paid paid... (not including delivery and driver tip...). Photo of a small roast beef meal before anything was eaten - two pieces of potato, one kumara, one pumpkin, four chunks of carrot and the rest was peas. It looks like there was a bit of meat in that photo, but there wasn't that much at all, particularly when compared to the roast shops in my local area - Glen Innes/Glendowie (Roast World or Ashby Roast). Unfortunately, those places were closed on the Monday of Auckland anniversary weekend. Container wasn't even full to the top - not great value for money when other roast places out there actually fill the container. Go elsewhere if you're hungry.
The food was so disappointing, and lacked flavour. I had a small chicken roast meal, and it was bland. Potatoes were a little overcooked as well.
The best roasts in our area. Generous helpings and very yummy!
I love coming after school for a quick snack. staff is always so welcoming and polite. sometimes my dog comes along, waits outside and we both enjoy at the park. 10/10 would recommend

Not a bad spot for takeout sushi. They are open until five and had decent options (unlike most places running out of everything at 3pm). The food is just OK. Nothing amazing - doable if hungry. The staff are lovely though.

Sushi & Sushi is a new level in sushi. This is the first time I have ever seen a sushi sandwich and let me tell you that the chicken katsu sushi sandwich was 10/10! Form an orderly line and make your way to sushi and sushi now to try this piece of culinary genius. James Ashwin

This is simply the best Sushi in Auckland; added to this genuinely lovely owners - Joseph & Mary ( incredible human beings) and supporting staff ..10 out of 10 every time, consistently good..just love this place, I wish the owners all the very best, they deserve it :) Just have to add, this team keeps delivering day after day..what a delight to be served with great food and by wonderful ' soul of the earth' people....highly highly recommended...food is excellent - keep the great work going 💕💕👍👍👍👍

Real sushi by Japanese owners' hands-on. I've been coming here occasionally for years and always good quality and super friendly service. I love the chicken salad. There's an awesome sauce included, which makes salads yummy 😋. Nice selection of drinks but could be wider. Have never tried thier miso as they are so polite they never push any sale. Absolutely lovely to come here. Some seating inside and outside. Good parking.

Great place to come to for an affordable lunch. Friendly owner and good selection of rolled sushi, nigiri sushi, miso soup, Chinese spring rolls, bento boxes, rice donbure and udon soups. Definitely worth coming to for a quick and easy lunch if you're in the local area.

High quality sushi at reasonable prices, and great service! The salmon and prawn is especially delicious - definitely worth checking out. The cherry on top is their use of cardboard and plates instead of single use plastics!
Best Sushi in Auckland tasty smokey and deliscous
I've tried all the sushi places in the area, and this is the best one. Owner is friendly and the place is kept tidy and clean. I eat here almost every other day.

A small restaurant with only a few tables. As such this may give us a wrong impression that this shop is one of the common so -so Japanese restaurants we see all around us! This shop is run by a couple who are friendly and most of all, very good at what they should be doing! A rare proper sushi shop that is properly hand-made by people who are confident and experienced. Not ridiculously dry or too firm sushi we see often at coveyer-belt type sushi shops! Moist with good flavour with right amount of seasoning for the rice! Most menu they serve is far and far above average and at the top level. Must try!
Good customer service. I was welcomed with a smile. Decent waiting time. Ordered the 2 pizza 2 side deal. The food tasted ok, slightly better than pizzahut and dominos.

Such a better experience than the cheap box stores. Real amount of toppings made with care. These pizzas fill me up more and taste so much better. Today's experience was extra good, cooked to perfection and a perfect balance of toppings sauce and cheese. Whoever was working today A++

I recently ordered the Italian pizza from Pizza Boyz, and it was absolutely delicious! The crust was perfectly crispy, the sauce was flavourful, and the toppings were fresh and generous. You can really tell they use high-quality ingredients. The service was fast, and the staff were friendly. I’ll definitely be coming back for more. Highly recommend Pizza Boyz Ellerslie to anyone craving tasty pizza!

Thank you so much for quickly supplying 20 large pizza for my son's 21st last night. The pizzas were all delivered fresh and hot! This is the first time that I have ordered in quantity just off reviews but felt there was zero risk with the number of positive reviews that your store has earnt. The ingredients were fresh and plentiful, on a delicious crust - my sister said to let you know that she really enjoyed the salmon and feta pizza. I did pop in to give you a heads up that a large order was coming through and appreciate that you were able to prepare in time.

This place is AMAZING!!! It offers great service and constant 5 star pizza's. it's fast to make you food and surprisingly local! Deepinka was a wonderful cashier who gave me and my friends an extra garlic bread, and a coke with our fries! I've also heard from others that it sometimes gives out free pizza's!

This place isn't fancy but the food was delicious (though some dishes were a bit peppery for me...that being said, I have sensitive tastebuds for pepper). The staff were very nice and (as strange as it sounds) the cutlery was stunning! Will definitely be back!

Ordered the Pad Thai lunch special $17.50. Comes with vegetarian spring rolls. Spring rolls crunch and taste good. Pad Thai dish good portion size and overall satisfied with taste and dish. Look forward to trying curry lunch special next time.
Down to earth, simply delicious. We have been back 3 times since we have found this place. It's not easy to find, it's at the back of the main shops. This is definitely our new local favorite.
Been here atleast 5 times. Always pretty consistently solid thai food. My go to for thai in the Mount Wellington/Ellerlsie area. Chicken Macadamia meal is the best.
I've been twice. Mainly a takeaway place with only a few tables to sit. Great food though, if you ask for hot you will get Thai hot which is great 👍

It's been a while since I've visited this place. And by that, I mean years. Probably pre-pandemic. It's not a flash place, but I don't expect too much from a roast outlet. The food was okay, and the wait wasn't too long. I went for a sandwich because they had run out of rolls. In hindsight, I could have gone for a combo.

Read others comments as well. Paid for a meal and the guy cut the meat thin, small slices as well as the crackle. What are you being stingy? Potatoes were very dry too, hardly any peas and carrots, one pumpkin, no kumra. Other places like Chucky Chicken in Mt Wellington or the roast place on Pakuranga Rd near Chemist Warehouse are 5 out of 5. Not this place.

Brandys roast just of the mt Wellington highway is reasonably priced with lots of dinner options and combo meals including various sides and drinks. The staff were really friendly and the service was quick they offer take out our in house dining. Quality food at a reasonable price
Bought a large roast pork. Pork tough and chewy. Potatoes tasted dried out and old. Kumara hard and gross. Pumpkin dried out and peas uncooked. 21 dollars.
I ordered here and got very sick after eating the fried chicken. No food hygine and was off work for 1 week. Do no go there at all, if this place is still opened please beware
Superb place, a lit of options for having a sit . Stylish design, tasty food, great customer service .
The food is great and varieties of options to choose from. The shop is located in the food court area of Sylvia park shopping mall.

The food is great BUT! they charge me $1 dollar for a swirl of Mayonaise on my salmon on rice and the lady on the counter at the Smart Sushi Sylvia Park Food court area around 12pm (friday) is too rude and NO customer service dont know how to smile dont know how to greet and dont understand half I'm saying. I work in a retail store and I know what I'm saying she made me feel unwelcome. I wish they can train her again or probably get her fired.
This is the best Sushi in the area as far as I am concerned. The managers are really friendly and the place is spotless and a lovely environment. Lovely fresh food - can't beat it!

Fresh and flavoursom. Great selection, great presentation and dining area. Friendly staff, very pleasant and unexpected discovery. Much better atmosphere than Lunn Ave, well worth the small deviation !!

I have visited the Pakuranga store many times, and decided to try this one. Different layout and decor, but still same good quality. I went for my toastie and fries combo, with no complaints. It's a step up on price from your basic bakery fare, but I think the quality rises to match.

Great little bakery with top-tier pies on offer. I opted for the steak, bacon and cheese on this occasion and I couldn’t fault it. The staff here are super friendly as well. Thank you kindly! Hamish Dorrington Kakapo Business Sales
Great little cafe 🎂 ☕️ 🍟 🥧🍰🍮 milk shake , smoothie. Clean and friendly staff. Coffee, muffins, chips, chicken, savoury, pie and more 🩷

My family have bought pies and cakes over the last 2 years. Initially we were very impressed with quality of the pastry and filling for steak, chicken, mince, potato top pies. Recently prices have gone up, and quality has dropped off a little. The pastry is heavier with slight drop off in filling. Bacon in bacon and egg pie was bland. Mince and cheese is still good. Still reasonable value, but nothing special.
Great bakery in Stonefields. Tasty sandwiches. Has hot food options, great coffee, ice blocks and even sells bottles of Anchor milk which comes in handy when you don’t want to pop to the supermarket!

I was their regular customer for years. But I didn't go back after they changed hand about a year ago. I worry that they are not as good as it was. We eventually went back last week. And tastes didn't change at all!! Highly recommended their beef ribs

Second time going to Big Fish. This time my friend and I both ordered the grilled salmon on salad and it was excellent, no complaint whatsoever. Most importantly, the staff that served us was incredibly friendly, welcoming and just super positive in a very genuine way. Great place for a catch-up with friends and family or a date night. Recommend.

This restaurant in Stonefields is located in a quiet and upscale area. I visited here with my dear friends, as we visited here several times before. We adore this place for its consistently excellent service, delicious food, and warm atmosphere. This evening, we ordered Karaage chicken as a side dish, then separately ordered Beef Bulgogi, Spiced Salmon, Dragon Roll, and Pad Thai Chicken. Additionally, we ordered some fizzy drinks. Everything was fantastic as expected. We were able to enjoy good conversations and have fun thanks to their delicious flavours. Making a reservation is recommended. I definitely love to visit this place again, and I highly recommend it!

We were planning to grab lunch at this place today, but thanks to a traffic jam on state highway, we didn’t roll in until 1130. When we finally got there, I was a bit bummed because they didn’t seem to have vegan options on the menu and we wandered around a bit, debating if we should find something else. After chatting with the staff, we found they could whip up a vegan lunch based on the menu. We ended up ordering vegan fried rice and seafood noodles. The atmosphere is great, and the staff were super friendly. Overall, it was a bit an adventure but a great experience. I’d recommend checking them out, even if you have dietary restrictions, just talk to them and they might be able to made some great suggestions for you.

My experience was quite disappointing overall. Parking is convenient and the restaurant is clean, and the ingredients used do seem fresh. However, the service was very slow even though it wasn’t busy, and the food was overly sweet for my taste. There are plenty of positive reviews, so perhaps I’m just not the target customer.

Its been a while I havent had a great burger. Tried Chosen bun and I believe this is one of the great burger in Auckland! Service is amazing and price is on point! Chips was great its golden, not soggy, the burger patty itself very flavourful and juicy. Service is excellent very attentive and nice person will served you. Thank you very much! 🙏

I recently visited and found the experience didn’t quite meet expectations. The burger had very little meat, it was on the dry side, and I couldn’t pick up much of the flavours I was hoping for. My burger was meant to include jalapenos and chilli jam for a bit of heat, but the sweetness of the jam came through more than the spice. Overall, it was different from what I anticipated. I won't be returning. Sorry guys.

I haven't been here in a while, but it's always good food. A little different from the usual burger places, a little bit fancier, but worth it. Would recommend one plate of fries between two, unless you're really hungry. Today seemed a little slow, quite a few customers, not many staff. Not sure if that's normal, but there was a bit of a wait. Not fast food, but worth it.
Food was good and came promptly. Suprisingly we were the only ones in the restaurant. The place was cleaned and well setup.

Amazing burgers here! I tried both the Guac Star and the Big Smoke and both were really interesting and tasty takes on burgers. You could tell the food was made there and not just frozen patties. Though I didn't eat it, there's a really nice relaxed vibe here. I'll definitely be back to try some of their other burgers!

The coffee was amazing, very nutty and chocolatey. The food is also great, the hamburger uses chicken thigh which makes it very juicy and delicious. The fries are also great, very crunchy! The baked Spanish eggs is very flavourful and savoury, a very heart warming dish indeed, great if you’re looking for something that’s soothing and hot✨✨
Great brunch place! Friendly staff and delicious food (eggs Benedict and avo toast were perfect) 🤩

Has a couple of vegan options. I ordered tofu scramble. Was pretty good. Giving a 4 because I like when I order something it comes already made not me having to assemble it. I also don’t like having to go up to the counter and order/prepay because it takes away from conversations with friends.
Stopped here for a quick lunch and was not disappointed! We had creamy mushrooms and avo on toast with perfectly cooked egg. Tasty sides. Very nice coffee. Will definitely return. Thanks guys😊
Such a fantastic cafe! Yummy menu and cabinet options, plus they make a fab hot drink. Very friendly staff and overall nice vibes in there. Try the chicken wrap - it’s top tier!

I don't have any options to upload my photos, what a shame. Absolutely fantastic food, huge portions making it excellent value. Chicken was tender and juicy, the coating was light and flavourful. Multiple spice levels for everyone, extra sauces can be bought (the maple was delicious). Kids menu available. This is a professional home business with council rating easily seen from the front door. Online ordering system set up, you even get alerted when your kai is ready.

I work on the construction site next door and spotted this place today. Grabbed a fried chicken and chips meal — super tasty, clean, and really good value（only 13 dollars) Definitely hitting this spot again!
Excellent food with great taste, decent prices & incredibly generous portion sizes. Such a local gem in Stonefields that I’m sure we’ll be having again!
Real nice, good quality food. Good and fast service. Would definitely recommend and will be back again! 😊
This is soo good!! I'll definitely be coming back.

I went in and purchased two meals. My friend and I were in there, as we always are. There’s one staff member who consistently has an attitude, but I always chose to be nice and assumed that’s just how she was. Today, I politely asked, “Could I please have a little extra salt?” She looked at me and my partner, didn’t even open the chip box, and then started aggressively shaking salt all over the bench and into my food, saying, “Is this enough salt?” The amount of patience I’ve had over time with this staff member—always using my manners—I can tell you now, I’m deeply offended at how we were treated. Was she just having a bad day? Honestly, I don’t care anymore. I have always used my manners, even when I didn’t want to, and I should have been treated with basic respect—especially considering I spent over $45 on just two meals.

Went through the drive through and ordered chicken. I asked for specific pieces which they accommodated however when I got to the window they said they had no chicken and I would have to wait 5 mins for.them to cook fresh chicken. What?

Drive thru looked quiet so shot through only to be told AGAIN to park up out front where there were other customers waiting. This has been happening alot lately…technically to their system our order has been fulfilled but we are waiting atleast another good 5mins out front of the store. No servettes or cutlery given and the packs had the most driest crappiest pieces of chicken. If a customer is gonna get a pack atleast give them one decent piece

Chicken was very small and dry, asked for a chicken thigh as one of my pieces but didn't get one. Only ended up eating a drumstick which was barely edible, gave the rest to my dog. Bread roll and can of coke were the only things I enjoyed. This has happened to me twice before and from the Glen Innes store aswell. Only gave 2 stars because delivery was quick and driver was friendly, would've only been one. Do better!!!
Terrible service! do not give them your money. Constantly gets orders wrong and then gives paying customers attitude when asked to correct.

I consistently receive incorrect orders, even when I pay for extras—they’re never included in my meal. I went back to address the issue, but the staff completely ignored me. Very disappointing service.

Honestly, I don’t even know why I ordered again from this place. A joke is an understatement, the first time I ordered from UnerEats I got two cheeseburgers, and I kid you not!!!!! They sent these without the buns, so tell me why I’ve just ordered again and have received a Big Mac with only one meat paddy. Lollllllll my partners burger didn’t even come with the meat. This place is an actual rip off. Crap service, crap food, crap management.

Terrible service, always delays at the drive thru. And tonight we paid for a large McChicken combo and received a small chips… and no chicken on the burger! Won’t be going back. Second visit equally bad. Ordered & paid extra sauce on chicken burger… got NO sauce on chicken burger!

I’ve ordered from this location multiple times, and it’s consistently disappointing. The food is always carelessly put together. The chicken wrap came completely open, with the chicken missing its coating. On another occasion, the burger arrived with a piece of the bun missing. I asked for a replacement, and they did exchange it — but honestly, that was the last straw. Every single time I order from here, there’s always some issue. I won’t be ordering from this McDonald’s again. They clearly don’t care about quality or customer experience.

First time here and last. Total waste of money. Ordered large fries - only half full/ just about cold and to top it off no serviette. Management should be doing much better, obviously they don't give a crap about standards and customer service. One of the worst McDonald's I gave been to. The other negative reviews say it all. Not sure how this sort of mismanagement has been allowed to continue. Shameful.

#### Atmosphere Marsic Bros (Marsic Fish Shop) offers a warm and inviting atmosphere that immediately makes you feel at home. #### Service The service at Marsic Bros is commendable. The staff is friendly, attentive, and always ready to assist. Orders are taken promptly, and the wait time is reasonable, even during busy hours. ####. Food Quality The fish and chips are exceptional, The chips are thick-cut and cooked to perfection, offering a satisfying crunch with every bite. #### Variety Marsic Bros offers a good variety of fish options, allowing customers to choose from different types of fish. #### Strengths - Exceptional fish and chips - Friendly and attentive service - Clean and inviting atmosphere - Generous portion sizes - Good variety of fish options overall from my 10 years of experience, this shop is highly positive. I would definitely recommend Marsic Bros to anyone looking for a satisfying and enjoyable fish and chips & different types of fish.

This was the place to go in GI, boasting it’s beautiful selection of fresh seafood and fish and chips to rival the best fish and chips in Auckland: it’s certainly lowered it’s standard over time, in an attempt to serve the changing community by removing their burger selection to now only offering their attempt at a gourmet fish burger. Today after years of not going I popped in for a nice piece of fish and scoop of chips and grabbed some garlic mussels. Let down but what did I expect. Fish was awfully small t o bites and it was gone. Chips were just awful and their mussels more rubber than mussel and they were smoked this morning. Disappointed again: will never recommend even to my enemy.
Awesome fish & chips! Very fresh nicely cooked Staff and service was great too

I love visiting Marsic Bros Fish Shop to buy both fresh and smoked fish and roe. The delightful smokey aroma makes me want to stay all day, and their products are second to none. Well worth the trip over to G. I. and their service is impeccable.

Amazing! 😍 Honestly the loveliest local chippy I've ever found. Fresh is super fresh and everything looks delicious. Was cheap too! 90c for deep fried mussels and $4 for fish. Only been once and thought about it ever since. Yum 😋

Yucky pizza, worse than frozen pizza! Pepperoni had barely any pepperoni on it. Terrible communication, order was showing delivered 30 mins before it finally arrived. An hour and a half after ordering. Food arrived cold, I've honestly never seen pizza this bad before, cardboard. Don't waste your money here they need new management or to shut down. This isn't the first time they've mucked us around and given rubbish food.

Second time I order from them and my order arrives EXTREMELY late. I placed my order at 6:30 pm, using uber eats. It says on the app that the acknowledged my order at 6:41pm. My order arrived at 8:10pm!!!!! And it arrived cold with the base a bit soggy. This is soooo frustrating. I had 4 little children waiting for ages.

Got 2 family size pizza's.....mega pepperoni and beef and onion, they were delicious, the crust was perfect and had the right amount of toppings on them. The service was fantastic, nice and friendly, had a good chat with the guy who served me. Highly recommend going to this branch at Glen Innes, far better than the mediocre and inferior pizza hut
I love having Domino's pizza in our area! A favorite when having extended family visiting. From basic pizzas to more lavish toppings. Love the chips and garlic bread too.

Wish I could give a one star. We ordered delivery, received the food cold, and then was told that we had to take the pizzas to them for a refund. Absolutely ridiculous. Don't ever buy from these frauds.

It's been years since I had been to Turo-Turo. Food was good, simple and tasty, the restaurant clean and well maintained. The current owner is also the chef took over the place in 2019. Do stop there for a meal next time you're in GI. We'll need to head back to try the crispy pata...

The place is not that big so might be crowded when the cafe is full and not that fancy. We ordered the Joyful Chicken Spaghetti meal and Joyful Fried Chicken. They were generous to give us 3 pieces (missed from the picture) of the fried chicken instead of 2. Chicken was juicy, delicious and have that hint of a taste from Jollibee fried chicken. I haven’t tasted the spaghetti but my sister in law said it was nice. Halo Halo Deluxe is good for 2 people sharing. Overall all experience is excellent.

To be fair my sisig was quite nice but everything else we ordered wasn't. The longganisa on the longsilog was poorly seasoned and the texture of the meat was odd. The siomai was also poorly seasoned. We were going to give their halo-halo a go but they ran out of ube ice cream. The cafe is cosy and clean albeit a little bit run down. The exterior does not much for the imagination and could do with a little pimping. Although, the waitress was courteous and attentive and the prices are relatively cheap, taste and flavour does come first and unfortunately Turo-Turo is lacking in this aspect. It does have a huge potential and I would love for them to revisit their menu or rethink their menus.

If you want authentic Filipino food, Turo-Turo is a place to go to. This place isn't big, but is quite popular during lunch hour especially in the weekends so might need to wait for a bit to get a table. Their food are quite nice, especially like their crispy pata (pork knuckle) it tasted very similar to the German version of the pork knuckle. But instead of serving it with sauerkraut they serve that with a soy-vinegar sauce which also have the same effect of cutting down the greasiness of the pork fat. Another favourite is their joyful chicken (deep-fried chicken), it tasted similar to one of the fast-food chain but it was crunchy and not as oily, the gravy on the side tasted like from that chain too. Worth mentioning their ube (purple yam) ice-cream, it was quite nice has an interesting aroma. Interesting little Filipino restaurant.
Such a quaint little place! It's a bit hidden around the corner of a set of shops. Very good serving sizes for the price, highly recommended.

Probably be my last time getting a feed from here Raw fish 4/10 - bland and watery, fish was fresh Fried bread 10/10 Fish 3/10 - taste old and all the fish in the pack were the side of a potato fritter. Chips 3/10 - Soggy Customer service 10/10 Overall not a good experience with the food!..

Our usual go to Toby’s store is in Otahuhu, however it was so packed there today so we decided to ride out to Glen Innes Tobys. The customer service from the staff was very poor. Did not make me and my family feel very welcome as we had ordered and ate inside. Very rude attitude and vibe we were getting from the staff. A smile can go a long way especially when you have paying customers coming in to spend their money in your store. Don’t take on a customer service job if you can’t be bothered to show some kindness to the paying customers. Food was awesome but won’t be going back there again.

Fish beautifully fresh but batter soggy. Chips soft - no colour and not crisp. Was meal cooked in Microwave? Sorry guys but very disappointing after several recommendations from friends. Meal only took 4 mins from placing order (in house) to receiving it. Possibly too quick. Very busy with takeaways and many people crowding around. Perhaps overwhelming for staff who were otherwise very cheerful and helpful. Sorry guys - wont be returning or recommending to others.

During our recent visit to Toby's Seafood at the Glen Innes branch, we were delighted by the quality of our meal. Although the kina pots were sold out, we thoroughly enjoyed the snapper meals, raw fish, and fried bread. The fish was exceptionally fresh and cooked to perfection, maintaining the high standards we've come to expect from Toby's Seafood, based on our experiences at their Otahuhu and Manurewa locations.

Only place I come to for fish n chips, batter is thin. More fish than batter. Hot dogs as well! Batter is thin. Fried mussels are on 👌 fresh. Overall I come cause the batter is thin and not over bearing like most places and always fresh. Customer service is 10/10.
Wonderful Team! Always welcoming and looks after us genuinely when we order. Beautiful smiles, keeps us ordering regularly.
The staff at Glen Innes Pizza Hut are always so kind and friendly. Even remember me when I come in to pick up my order. Awesome Team here😃

Pizza Hut Glen Innes serves up tasty pizzas at attractive prices, especially for combo deals. Many customers praise both the flavors and friendly service on pick‑up orders. However, inconsistent experiences—particularly with delivery delays and cleanliness—have affected satisfaction for others
Great dinner tonight. Everything was cooked well, and the chips weren't super soggy like they have been in the past. I think they forgot the bbq sauce on one of our pizzas. But pretty good overall

Needs improvement. Even one star Is generous but only put it because google requires me to. Got my order wrong. Gave me a completely different pizza to what i ordered. Could barely hear the bro taking our order.
The food was good for St. Pierre's branch Plenty of parking, and tables for indoor dine in area
Spacious with lots of parking. Great service. Wonderful food. We ordered the Salmon Bento Bowl with Katsu. Recommend and would return.
Really enjoy coming here , whether to eat in or take away. The menu is always fresh and rhe service is impeccable. 5 stars from me.
Awesome food, very nice friendly staff,you feel healthy when feasting at sushi house. Top of the list of places to dine. Beautiful Asian girls is a bonus too. 😃
Every few packs of sushi I get is almost half the size of the container.

Was such an amazing time getting a lovely pork roast. I would really recommend anyone to go and have a try. For me it’s almost like a weekly Friday night dinner because of its lovely service as well and the food to complement it.

⚠️ Avoid This Place! Ordered takeaway chicken and it was rotten and smelled awful. Clearly not fresh or safe to eat. Extremely disappointed and concerned about food safety. Do not risk your health—I strongly warn others not to eat here.

Absolutely loved the roast meal here! The meat was tender and cooked to perfection, with a beautiful golden crust. The highlight for me was the gravy—it was rich, flavorful, and tied everything together so well. The vegetables were fresh and perfectly seasoned, and the portion size was generous. Definitely one of the best roast meals I’ve had in a long time. Highly recommend for anyone craving a hearty, comforting meal! The photo speaks for itself.

Unfortunately this place is not the same. Takeaways we got today were very hard & dry. Fish tasted & smelled too fishy & was rock hard! Chips were like they were twice fried. Plus didn't get our extra sausages we paid for. The roast meal that I only got meat & kumara (as asked) still charged me $20 almost and its so tiny. Only thing that tasted good though. So disappointed. You've lost a long time customer now. Been coming here for over 15 years. 😞
tasted amazing and gave us a lot of crackle will definitely come back again! the person who gave us the food was very nice too.

Ordered dine in on a Tuesday night at about 7pm and they were hilariously under staffed, big queue of uber drivers, who along with drive through customers always get priority. Food was decent tasting, very sloppily thrown together, but this establishment cannot be classed as a fast food restaurant as I could’ve made my own burger faster than that. At some point after we got our food someone who must’ve been a manager arrived, as she really got things moving in the kitchen and it was good from then on. Ordered an ice cream for the road and that took only a few seconds. Use drive through or be ready to wait. Dining area was spacious and quite nice.

I ordered this on the 2nd of July at about 540-550PM. Been to busy to make a review. Went through drive through ordered a combo. I ate the burger in the parking lot and it tasted funny I turned on the lights and saw the patty was super soft and red. Completely under cooked I felt so sick. Walked inside the lady who served me in drive through was nice & really apologetic the manager said sorry once but didn’t really seem to care too much about it he asked what burger it was and said he’ll make a new one I said no I really don’t feel like eating anymore and feel sick. I asked for a refund which he processed I paid $20 for the meal/burger combo but he only refunded the burger despite my whole appetite being ruined that night. Very disappointed every time I think of Carls Junior now I feel spoke vomiting

Disgusted... Ubereats order with my kid that I have barely seen in a couple of weeks... And the order was stone cold, very wrong (beef instead of chicken, missing sauces, double burger as wrong size single etc). Cost me $77 via Uber who refunded $33. Called the store and complained... Offered to add my name to the book so I can get it again next time. Not that that helps... O ly to hear an Indian sounding fella in the background ask the person on the phone what he was doing... The guy on the phone said "dealing with a complaint" and the indian fella said "that's why I don't answer, hang up". What a disgrace of a a store.

Got a really good deal with the bundler. The grilled patty give you a different taste to the hamburger. The loaded fries is really rich. The only issue is the drink, at least my sprite was quite bland. The service was quick though. Once I ordered they served it in a few minutes. Clean space and clean bathroom.

Best burger chain that I have tried here in NZ. Their burger patty is flavorful. Every bite is so good!!! You have got to try their Jim Beam Burger, take note that this is on the sweet side but it works perfectly. If you want something basic, try the Famous Star. You won't regret it. You can skip their sides. Fries and onion rings are so so. Service was quick and the place was clean.

Bought Steak chow mein. Generous on vegetables. Steak not tenderized unfortunately. Steak tough thick. Would have been a delicious meal if meat was tender instead of hard out chewy Baking soda and cornstarch good tenderiser .
Pros: Good price Great taste and flavor Generous serving Cons: A bit of a wait time for the order to be ready. Recommended: Deep Fried Wonton ($1.00 each) Egg Fried Rice ($14.00 per order)

Expensive and not worth it, the fish batter is ass, fried rice is plain and had no taste or flavour as well as the chewy steak. Fried chicken nibbles was plain. No love in the food don’t bother or waste your money here won’t come back or recommend. Time to retire

We are out of towners staying in Panmure. I had a hankering for some chips. The chips were crunchy and delicious. Decent enough portion and I loved the sweet and sour pork. Will eat here again before we leave for sure.

This couple have been around for many, many years and are still here providing yummy food. This is one of our family favorites, your welcomed with a hello and a smile, just like any other takeaways/fast food places there prices have risen, but if you take into consideration the cost of everything these days, it's more then fair AND there food is YUM! 100% WORTH IT and we are picky haha. Sweet and sour pork (the bomb) egg fu Yong (the bomb) steak chow mein (the bomb) also there burgers and chips. Thanks for being such lovley people always looking after us, Pete - Jess & Family 😀

The Chinese food I got just before had no gravy, was dry the fish was frozen the whole $110 worth of food I got was disgusting. We waited for 45mins and it was cold. The chips were oily I honestly can't say it enough but that was so gross. When I took it all back and I mean every plastic container of food they gave me plus the fish and chips they gave me oh we don't know why u think it's yuk pak n save that's where we buy our frozen fish. Asked for a refund only got $30 back they were rude as he'll.

Unfortunately 1 star the fish/ chips and sausages my friend brought today was disgusting. Chips tasted like they were sitting there most of the day , fish had a strange smell to it and tasted like frozen fish that sat defrosting all day. Sausage was the same. Only semi decent thing was the sweet & sour.
Amazing fish and chips. Chips perfectly crunchy and soft inside. Great portion of chips. I ordered ½ scoop of chips. Fish was delicious and crunchy too. Perfect for a clear day at the beach.

Ordered special #6 : 2 fish 3 potato fritters and half scoop for 9$ - i took this home and poured it out into a mixing bowl and added Tomato sauce myself. Great portion (the half scoop is enough for maybe 2 people) Chips -were really nicely cooked - in line with the existing reviews suggesting that the technique here is very good. Battered fish - was a good portion - a shame that the fillet included the grey part of the fish that tasted gamey, Potato fritters- A new take on potato fritters, small, round and thin, they are crunchy with a good creaminess in the middle. I think this potato fritter is better than the traditional hash-brown shaped fritter which is basically just eating boiled potato after getting through the batter. I would recommend anyone to try the Fish and chips here - great value and taste

Not one to usually share my thoughts when they are negative, but when we orders a variety from the whole menu (rice, fish, burgers etc.) and all dishes were dissapointing, I felt I needed to add my thoughts. These were the soggiest, blandest takeaways I've ever ordered. I hope this was just a bad night...

The food was great at first but the second time it felt old, i couldn't eat it all due to stomach cramps.pork dry and chewy, the vegetables felt mixed with the old. They had soo much food in the smorgasbord sitting there i wonder what they do if they dont sell it all.
Better than expected. Was shopping next door at Mad Butcher and pooped in to grab a quick bite. Service was top tier. Lamb and cabbage is so good. Hot chips as well.

The staff is decent they’re fine but the food is never fresh and taste like it’s been sitting there for days ordered the sweet and sour pork and idk what I bit into but tasted so funky and was squishy.

Very very extremely rude staff especially the old fat lady, every time I go there they are rude particularly towards the Pacific island customers. Bad customer service they act like they don't want customers at all. Never supporting that business. When I went to pay for my order she didn't look at me but shouted at me "9 dollar!" while she looks at her phone and I was just infront of her face. Sometimes I wish that place would shut down tbh or change the management. The hygiene standards are very questionable and I will be reporting them for not using gloves while handling food. No wonder why people get sick after eating their food.
So disgusting, the end of chinese TA for me 🤢🪰 please be careful next time ordering from them, check and make sure its safe to consume.
Loved the whole taste of flavors! We had a Teryaki Chicken with everything and sweet Thai Chilli, and honey mustard , and garlic aoli sauces! Yummy! We had a footlong and shared it!
Its ok but nothing special. Had a bit of a wait to get served and honestly couldn't complain about the atmosphere as there isn't any.
I had a very nice wrap in this place and looks clean too

Usually it is the sub maker that really makes the subs great. Manoj and Jano are the two people that make the absolute best subs. Subs cut perfectly, right amount of salads with such precision. Will always come back for more if these guys are still around
I bought Italian BMT foot long and six inch last Wednesday for Coldplay concert. Store service is really good and food tastes very yummy as usual.
The food in this restaurant is quite pleasant but the lady worker has very bad service, discriminates against Tongans, asks unnecessary questions, and looks down on islanders. Very Very disappointed.

Found this quite by accident. We had a B Meal Box (2 chicken pieces & chips) & a D Meal Box (1 chicken piece & chips). Changed the D around and had a marinated thigh & swapped the chips for roast potatoes. Also on offer were lamb flap, taro & rice highly unusual for a roast shop. I should also note that the marinated chicken is basically Chinese soya chicken. Again quite unusual. I'm a bit cagey about giving out 5 stars but these guys have the range and accommodating staff... What's not to like? My partner liked it so much, she's insisting that we go back again next week. Can't give them a better endorsement than that.

Quite disappointed as they have a high rating.. I had the small lamb, which is more expensive than the rest anyway.. however the lamb was so fatty, the vegetables are basically the frozen ones you buy from countdown, not fresh.. and 2 out of 3 potato's had gone off and were brown throughout.. I also asked for a side of crackling, which they said they didn't have.. although I could clearly see it in the tray at the front.. Extremely disappointed.. and expensive for what you get.. One positive.. the gravy was nice
Everything was going well untill i found out One of my chickens were raw, chips could've been seasoned better didn't taste any saly. I am hoping I don't get sick but already feeling a little ill
Left rubbish and food at tables. Staff should make an effort and keep area clean so customers who wish to dine and eat instore wouldn't have be grossed out 😶😬🙄🙄

Memory foods: my younger sister ordered a banana fritter with ice-cream for $5, so I got me 1 too... We sat at the table in awe at our serving, umm it was soo yummy we really enjoyed it, it took us back to our childhood days. Thank you so much, we will be back.😊

Chinese food taste good. Love the fried rice. Only problem i have and have noticed it twice, is they clean too close to the food with a dirty rag. Better to order than to buy from their already prepared food in the warmer.
Best takeaways in GI 💚 never disappoint. Highly recommend 👌
Friendly service, Food is way too salty for my liking otherwise decent, would visit again

I bought $9 menu , including chicken leg chips and coke for my friend. Also bought myself $10 deal. Unfortunately we found fly inside chips and chicken menu. It was embarrassing. Because I bought for my friend. I don’t recommend it. I bought food on Thursday. They are liar. But I didn’t know take away shop name. I went to check the name on Sunday.

Ordered a lamb kebab and chips from DoorDash at around 3am, obviously not going to expect the best of the best kebabs at early hours of the morning but the food we received was so ridiculous. There was literally 4-5 finger pieces of meat in the lamb kebab, sauce galore with wilted veges and it was cold and uncooked. It was literally a lebo bread with crumbs of meat wrapped into foil. Cold as. Definitely not considered a kebab. And the chips were also a finger full and cold. When the food arrived it was small enough to fit both items into a bakery pie bag. I thought we didn’t get our full our order the portion was that small. We drove to the store because we weren’t going to accept all that for $30. The guy when confronted made it so difficult because he seemed to not believe we had just ordered from him even though we gave the name and brought everything back and had the DoorDash order. He said another staff member made it and left already (it was 3:30am) he wasn’t keen on giving a refund but offered to make the food again. Said no because we don’t trust he’ll make it any better and there was no meat out, just old chicken sitting at the back. He said he wouldn’t give the refund because he didn’t make it and they don’t do refunds. After a little strong worded confrontation we got our money back but had to get that far. Could’ve saved your refund and ingrediants if they just made it properly the first time

By far the worst food experience ive ever delt with in my life. I ordered off Doordash x2 yokum burgers, x2 meat on chips, x2 thickshakes, x2 donut combos & x2 canned drinks It took 1 hour and a half for the food to finally arrive i dont live far at all im based in East auckland (not from there though) once it was delivered i checked and was so disappointed!! Instead of the food i ordered i got 2 cheese burgers that look like straight outta maccas tasted old, 2 dried az meat on chips with extra chips that were undercooked and soggy, 2 thickshakes absolutely watered down!!! Disgusting! Got the donuts nothing was wrong with it except they were both missing 1 donut each?? As for the drinks i only ordered 2 cans but got 3 cans and 1 bottle of sprite??? I expected better this was by far just the lowest of the blow!!! The employees here must be an absolute joke!!! Still jokes on them having to work slave hours 🤣 making terrible orders purposely for free only to have their customers get refunds, now that experience made me learn why southside always has the best food💯 DONT ORDER FROM HERE UNLESS U WANT FREE FOOD AND A WHOLE AS REFUND, COME ON G I DO BETTER

Worst experience ever – complete waste of time! I went all the way to Daku Kebab to pickup order through Uber Eats, but these guys closed well before their listed time without any notice. I was literally standing outside while the app showed them as “open.” No signboard, no update, nothing. Totally unprofessional behavior. Don’t waste your time or fuel coming here – they clearly don’t care about customers. Will never recommend or return.

My partner just ordered 2x lamb kebabs and 1x "chicken onion and cheese toastie" from here on uber eats and received an absolute joke of a meal, barely any meat at all on the kebab or "toastie" (2 burger buns with a couple of red onion slithers + a hilariously tiny amount of chicken). We tried to call the store but there was no number for the store relating to the order (wonder why lmaoo)

Ordered through Uber eats. I’d say the food was really good. Delicious which I really enjoyed. The portion is also good, delicious option and also took advantage of their deal on Uber eats 😍🥰 the buy 1 get one free. Cheese burger was too good to be $7 honestly worth my money and I’ll definitely order again. Thank you Daaku Kebab
Very delicious traditional Hong Kong, Guangzhou neighborhood style. The portion is big enough for me. The elderly staff team is very enthusiastic and humorous.
Food was okay but we both think it’s overcharged.

Delicious food! You can't go wrong. My faves are crispy pork, pancake duck, homemade BBQ pork buns, sizzling pepper steak, sweet and sour pork (even gluten free batter!) and garlic seasonal veges. Larger area upstairs with to host a small party.

Good quality food in an old canton atmosphere. Portions have shrunken to half from a year ago. Have found a better alternative at Ellerslie village. Folks who live there will know which Chinese eatery I am referring to - Golden Dragan BBQ - large tasty portions with a $20 discount on an otherwise $80 bill at this takeaway. Have given up on this smooth talking service. Yeah I agree with other customers comments - the lady boss is extremely rude and made a snide remark when I told them that their portions have shrunken. My advice is to go somewhere else and hopefully their attitude will change. They have upgraded to opening only 5 days a week now hence half the portions served.

Ordered three dishes, two of the dishes ordered was cold, customer service was not friendly and rude as they made a remark in their language (Chinese) after we didn’t go ahead with one of order. Won’t be going back there again.

Wow the chicken burgers here are absolutely beautiful. Really decent pricing too! Tender (like lucky chicken from Wellington if you ever tried that) and juicy. I love their potato chips too and chicken nibble here. We have come back many times and typically like to try new things so that speaks volumes. A favourite and recommend to all. Lovely staff and owner. 10/10 quality!

One of the most delicious (and huge) Korean-style hamburgers I’ve had! The fried chicken is just on another level, not oily at all, crazy crunchy, tender and full of flavor! Also delicious buns (brioche I think), loved the slaw salad and the mayo dips are 🔥. I’d prefer these over other hyped places. 👀

Now this is a fried chicken burger… The Jerk Chicken burger from Little & Kitchen has my whole heart and I can’t express that enough! - no seriously this earns a 10 Coming in at the number🥇spot for chicken burgers the JCB earned an extremely rare 10 out of 10! This score automatically places this joint at the number🥉spot for my Local Legends scoreboard This is definitely my top fried chicken burger recommendation in Auckland. The portion size is amazing with a whopping 2 massive fried chicken breasts and all the little extras on top. The seasoning on this piece of art is like a renaissance painting on the roof of my mouth. I can’t express my emotions when eating this tasty morsel - I nearly cried. Me and my fiancé often come here to grab a takeaway dinner to bring home as it makes the dining experience more palatable. Highly recommend: 8.5/10 Chicken Burger score: 10/10 My order: Jerk Chicken Burger, hand cut fries, and a coke zero.

I've never had burgers quite like this before so I was quite intrigued. I had the bulgogi burger and got to try the Dakgangjeong Burger and both were great. The fries were nice and big. They were crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. Though we didn't eat in, I really like the relaxing vibe. Will definitely be coming back to try some different burgers!
I love hot and spicy chicken burger ! 👍 And I tried the Jerk Burger, Bulgogi fries and kids meal. Highly recommend !! They’re the best.
Absolutely delicious sweet and sour pork and chicken chop suey!! Everything was full of flavor and cooked to perfection. Definitely the best takeaway spot in Auckland — a must-try!
Every time I order from these guys, the food is consistent, fresh, fast, and generous! Service is friendly and quick. The fu yuong is exceptional!

Our only Chinese takeaway for going on 20 years now I think??? Our family order (for 3) is chicken chop suey, plain fried rice or plain fried soft noodle, chips and if we have a guest we add sweet & sour pork. Left overs for lunch next day - teenage will even have reheated plain fried rice for breakfast and definitely for lunch.
Steak black bean on fried rice and chicken soft noodles are awesome. 27$ for 2 dishes is more than enough for 2 people)
Pleasantly surprised at how good the food is. Had the $35 combo takeaway for staff lunch and everyone enjoyed it

Very enjoyable experience. Staff were friendly and food was great. Not very crowded too so you can enjoy your food and company without too much disruptions. The portions are just right and plating was cute. Would love to visit again.

I volunteer here every Monday. The food is delicious, customers are super interesting and friendly and the other volunteers are also amazing. They do so much good for the community, feeding those in need, helping people who wouldn't usually talk to others and combating food waste. Come in and pay if you can so other people who can't pay can eat!

Wow, this place is awesome! The idea is that each day, a menu is created using perfectly good food that would otherwise go to waste. The idea is to create meals that reduce food waste. There are always 3 courses and is a pay-as-you-feel set menu. There is always a vegetarian option. No alcohol for sale, no BYO. I loved the community vibe and friendly atmosphere. Will definitely be telling friends and family.

Healthy, hearty, and hopeful. Love and appreciate the inspiring and impactful dining concept. The way the long tables are laid out connects neighbouring humans alike, all walks of life. The menu creatively changes to reduce food waste and every bite was packed with flavour. Would definitely recommend

What a cool experience. Visited tonight and blown away by this awesome charity. Food was well above what I expected for a 'koha' service, dishes brought out quickly and everything we tried was flavourful. The best thing without a doubt was the service, from the time you step inside until you leave, service staff were on top of their game and the friendly banter was the icing on the cake. Recommend bringing the whole whanau and remember to book in if there are 6 or more of you. Nice little treat for those on low income. Expect to share a table with others as leaving patrons make way for new ones. Clean and tidy settings and good background music while you dine. Well done, hope to see more of these popping up around the place.

Been loyal to St.pierre & Bento bowl for a year now but after eating at James'sushi, I ripped St.Pierre loyalty card😂😂. Food is really good at very reasonable price, excellent service. Totally recommend to dine in. Thanks to Chef 👏😁
Friendly service and fresh delicious authentic food highly recommend come give them a visit ignore the roadworks
Had the tofu donburi — really yum and a good price! Friendly and fast service.
Highly recommended for ramen especially my favourite 😍 beef ramen noodles.
The staff are very friendly, and the Tofu Donburi is superb! I am vegan and I can reliably get a good plant-based meal here, but they have a wide range of other dishes, too.
Absolutely loved their chessy garlic naan and samosa, best one l’ve ever tested hot and fresh ❤️🥰 we also had the butter chicken and mango chicken perfect
Butter Chicken Combo, the butter chicken was so yum and the naan was very fresh and perfect. It’s great to be able to get good curry near home.
Egg Fried rice is too good. Yummm
The food is amazing and the service also
Excellent butter chicken I have never had butter chicken like this anywhere
Friendly and awesome staff members, excellent selection of food and great coffee. I wouldn’t go anywhere else for my coffee fix and dose of sugar!
Really great coffee! Good price too. Perfect for students studying at this campus.
Extremely good consistent coffee at good prices!! Always study here because of it
Great service, lovely people :)
recommend cappucino

Loved their Chicken Biryani and Chicken Noodles - right level of spices, not too oily and good portion size. Happy to see Indo-Chinese fare available in my neighborhood. Friendly service; there was a slight mix-up in our takeaway order. They drove to our house to deliver the missed order and a little extra. That's the nicest thing one can do for a customer; will be visiting again for sure.

Had the best fried chicken and chips from here! So moist, tender, and flavourful. I tried the vege samosa as well and was very satisfied. Recieved some sauce as well which was sweet and delicious. Looking at the menu today, it will definitely be back for curry and naan! Can't wait.

Delicious food, generous portions and very well priced. There was a small mistake with our takeaway order but as soon as we let them know the lady drove to our house to deliver what they had missed - thank you for going that extra mile, we appreciate it very much!
Had the chicken chilli momos and steamed momos! So flavourful and delicious. Mango lassi is also the best lassi I’ve ever had. Definitely recommend. Lovely people, great food, service and so clean!
Top tier takeaway! My favourite spot in the area. Friendly owners that are passionate about their food and you can see that in the quality of dishes they serve.
Avoid this place. Their fancy AI ordering system does. not work. You end up sitting there while 5 cars pass through in the other lane. Go to Mc Donald's, they have real people to take your order.
Worst service. went to pickup uber order. they have mentioned on the app to walk into the store. and when went to knock on the door I was asked to come through drive-thru.

I was trying to find a zero star for this place just had the WORST BURGER EVER not busy and our food was dry and old chips limp and cold an absolute disgrace I don’t know how an employee could even hand over a meal like that!!!!!

Overall a great service and dining experience. Big fan of the frozen drink flavours (sour orange and mystery). The front server (Callum) was friendly and amazingly helpful. He helped me understand the menu and was a pleasure to speak to🙏🙏
Korean fried chicken were horrible, looked nothing like picture and were hard. Service was like the server needed a personality. Overall disappointed
Freshly made fish and chips with not too much salt. Reasonable owner with good prices 👍
very nice food and its halal. Dairy and a takeaway together is really brilliant we got food some snacks and chips for a reasonable price. Cheap food for kids that go to school.

Great service, clean, good priced items. Definitely go back if I'm in the area. Huge apologies for the 1 star in regards to my 2degrees top up. Luckily I didn't throw the top up number away and now it worked.. 5 days later. Edited my star ratings. Thanks again.
Friendly proprietors offering good service and the takeaways isn't too bad although it's a shame they couldn't add more to the offerings on their menu.
Awesome local been there for years.
Yummy food, all sorts of different food and at an algds price too
Charming little food joint. Cheap hearty eats and very kind staff. We ate a huge portion of spag bol ($12) and a large tandoori chicken pizza ($15) and both me and my son were stuffed. Come thru

I seriously recommend the tortellini alla panna! it was super delicious, a very comforting and soothing meal, especially if you’re feeling under the weather. The people here are the sweetest, and you’re always greeted with a warm welcome 🍝

Great food joint up the road in GI, chefs are awesome people (awesome service too) always made sure we were happy with our food! Really enjoyed their Tiramisu after my meal of the Fettuccine Pollo, yummy!

A hidden gem in the back streets of Glen Innes. Euro Food hub offers a good variety of food options at reasonable prices. Dine in or takeaway with great friendly service - will visit again 😁 so why not check it out & support local small businesses.

Hubby and i frequent there the past few months for their wonderful aromaticity smell of coffee. Friendly staff with good service. Love the food. My only concerns is water bottles needs a good clean up. Even if I'm thirsty there I won't drink it. Very nice place.

Where do I start.... Delicious food and amazing service, served with a smile : ) Food was fresh, delicious and perfectly seasoned. Over the months our friends have developed a close steady friendship with the owner, Chan. This little hidden gem is going to become one of our regular restaurants/cafe to come to, not only to get a delicious plate of food, but to have an enjoyable chat with the staff at Columbus Coffee. I highly recommend this hidden gem to everyone who enjoys a friendly chat, just a cup of coffee or a hot meal.
Dropped by here first time today. Coffee was good but food was unappealing. It was too simple, too small. Cabinet food looked better though. Their customer service was just average.

Thank you to the lovely staff member who let me take the glass bowls with keto cheesecake away. Really appreciated that! I will return them to you soon. They were delish and so was the peanut and choc slice.

Friendly greets and was seated down for a Family of 7, 5adults and 2childs. Tables were x3 pushed together to cater for us.. Children praise how friend the lady owner was to us and free Fluffy drinks with their bfast. I enjoyed my bfast and the rest of the family. 4 Stars****

Felton Kitchen make some seriously good pies, we have been coming here for years and can never stick to one flavor as they are all so good. Such good ingredients, the pastry is really light which is much nicer than your typical bakery pie. Couple favorites are the butter chicken, steak and cheese + the chicken and mushroom. The owner is very friendly and I highly recommend trying this place next time you’re nearby. James Ashwin Kakapo Business Sales

The most unsuspecting little place to eat around St Johns. You would drive past without evening noticing them. But if you’re looking for great coffee and a very affordable but great quality brunch, make sure to stop by. Support your locals people, and don’t always look for the fancy decor as we used to do. There is something very homely about smaller establishments.

Found this gem as i was passing through the street and decided to give it a go! Cheap prices compared to other cafes with great taste and presentation, also ordered french toast which was well put together! Kind service from the ladies! Keep it up.
Best little coffee shop in the area. Great food and Betty is lovely! Highly recommend

Really nice cooked breakfast. It took a little while to arrive but that was because it was cooked from scratch with care and attention. The quality of the food and ingredients was really good. The place itself is pretty bare and basic, but also spotlessly clean. The owner was happy for me to move a table outside next time I go so I can bring my dog along. I went to the Columbus Cafe up the road the weekend before and was really disappointed with a similar breakfast. If your looking for a nice breakfast and good coffee from a friendly host go here. Especially go here over Columbus.

**⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Amazing Platters at Faan Tong!** I ordered three platters from Faan Tong—inari/sandwich/mini burgers, fried foods, and fruits—and each one was absolutely delicious! The sushi was fresh and beautifully presented, the fried foods were crispy and perfectly seasoned, and the fruit platter was a refreshing and perfect combination. The quality and variety were outstanding, and the portions were generous. The service was also quick and friendly. Highly recommend if looking for fantastic catering. Will be back and try more.
Love the $7.99 8 pieces sushi 🍣 😋 weekdays deal ✅️ friendly staff. Small and convenient on Merton Road.

I came across this sushi restaurant today and really amazing. Among the many sushi，I like salmon with avocado sushi because I can feel and see the ingredients are very fresh. Another takoyaki must be tasted, the flavor of the sauce with octopus are wonderful. All in all it was a great experience and I will be back.

I think this place has potential and I wanted to leave a few comments for the owner's to improve their business. I ordered the chicken katsu, and although the chicken was fantastic, the cabbage was far too thick and bitter. They need to go to other Japanese restaurants and see how cabbage is prepared there. Also the business NEED to play some ambient music, it is eerily quite and people will be more drawn to come in with inviting music. It would also be beneficial for them to rearrange the sushi display somehow so people can see when they come in from the front what they are selling OR have brighter LED lighting to make the food stand out and look more palatable. Otherwise we enjoyed the food and might come back to try a few other things.

Love their Salmon and Avocado sushi. Too late I only discovered them towards the end of my time at my workplace. Will miss my sushi fix! I always make comments to them how good their sushi is but I notice that starting a nice conversation with the owner (i think) seems to be a hassle for her as her response always turns out cold and unfriendly.

Really great food!! And best thing is they’re local. I have lived in India and NZ and am fussy about curries but their food is delicious! Quality and great prices for what you get. Lovely people too - I wish you and your business every success. My husband and I have been multiple times already - we have had kadai chicken, butter chicken with garlic naan and the mango lassi was great too!

Delicious! A very nice change after the previous shop in this location. Very friendly service and the food is simply delicious. Genuinely might be the best Indian food out of anything I tried in 16 years in New Zealand. Have been here three times and will be sure to return.

Love this place. Tasty meals, generous portions. Butter chicken (comes with rice) and a garlic naan ($26 all up) comfortably feeds two people and never disappoints. Friendly staff - service with a smile :)

got home to 2 of the worst curries we’ve ever had took them back to find out they use microwaved frozen vegetables everything‘s cooked somewhere else it was absolutely horrendous. Worst curry I think I’ve ever had. Why do people use frozen vegetables frozen meat and think it’s acceptable to sell it to the public and call it fresh

I visited Spice Traders St. John's for takeaway food for the family's Friday night meal. Excellent four dishes. Very good pricing. Excellent service. Made a dish that was not on the menu too, on request....looking forward to the next visit....will post photos of dishes following next visit.... my wife and son are discerning with food too, and they too thought the food was very good. Long may this be 😊

We ordered the Teriyaki Lamb Plate - one we swapped out the rice for chips and the other we added the Kalua Pork.
