Awesome service, food for the most part was amazing only let down being the coleslaw had no mango in it and tasted like the packet ones from the supermarket. Apart from that the marinade on the meat was amazing, meat was cooked beautifully and juicy. The Pork was pulled beautifully and had so much flavour and wasnt too dry.The mac salad was delicious. Glad we visited. Will be back again

Twice I've had Island BBQ this week and omg the food is just amazing 🥰 Wednesday I had the Full Island plate , that was amazing 🤩 tonight I had the same thing but swapped the rice for fries and added Kalua pulled pork , now that pork was so delicious 👏🏼🤗 keep it up Island BBQ 💜

I ordered a rump steak medium-rare, but it was cooked close to well-done. (The piece on the left in the photo was the closest to medium-rare, but most of it was like the one on the right.) When I asked the staff member if this was his idea of medium-rare, he responded with an attitude that made it seem like I was the one who didn’t know the difference. I gave up and left. He was on the phone the entire time while cooking. I definitely wouldn’t recommend this place to anyone who cares about how their steak is cooked.
Our experience was delicious and reminded us of our time in Hawaii! We thought it was great value for the price also - heaps of food!

Changed location and the food went with it. Mac n cheese used to be creamy now it's just a pasta salad that has no taste whatsoever!? The steak is cut into pieces which kills the flavour big time not worth $34. Only thing still solid was the fries, guess I won't eating them ever again. This is the G.I store, I used to get it from the Otara one. Damn shame man

If you like doughy pizza with crispy edges this is undoubtedly the best pizza I have had in New Zealand. The portions were generous and the ingredients were fresh and plentiful. My wife and I liked the music, decor and the staff were friendly and helpful with special order requests. Two thumbs up!!
What a pizza! Beautiful! Crispy edges and bottom, tasty sauces, generous toppings. First time dining and won't be our last.

The pizza dough was very fluffy on the inside and crispy on the outside which I loved it. However, the topping lacks too much. Very little cheese, few pieces of chicken, few pieces of chopped veges. I could taste the bread as the main part of the dish and almost felt like this was bread at the bakery, not a pizza. I mean if you think like this as bakery bread, $4 for a piece? Very good but if I think as a pizza, I would rather recommend the chef to reduce the size of the pizza and put more toppings. Because $32 for a pizza sounds like a gourmet but the toppings on top are too poor. Especially the butter chicken pizza I could not taste chicken…But again the dough was real nice and the staff was friendly and I could see him putting in lots of effort. Overall I see lots of potential here so I hope they find a solution!
Amazing Pizza...The crust so perfectly crispy and the cheese sooo soo soo good. We had Four Cheese Pizza and am going to come again and try other varieties. Must Try...

First time here - the dough and the crust were great and very edible! I went pepperoni and felt the toppings were a little on the light side - just wanted a bit more pepperoni TBH. The cheese was delicious. Hawaiian was very good. I'll go again to try a full size pizza and see how that goes. Great concept.

Spring rolls are delicious, dumplings are delicious, sandwiches are amazing, and the atmosphere is stunning. Staff have great service, and it is a bit unfortunate that they recently upped their prices, but overall, it's worth stopping into. Some of their bowls are more than worth the price.
Quick and easy, yummy and friendly, perfect for a cool rainy afternoon

I mean to receive x5 Chicken Satay Skewers, Rice and pickled carrots topped with delicious homemade sauce, nuts and spring onion for only $16.90 is a win for me, not to mention fresh ingredients used, friendly staff, clean restaurant. Be sure to check it out you won’t be disappointed.

Super tasty food at affordable prices. The staff here are friendly and lovely. There's a little area at the front where you can eat but this is mainly a takeaway store. We had the Cambodian beef curry with egg noodles and Vietnamese pork chops with rice. Both dishes were yummy and quite filling. Would definitely come here again!
The rolls are pretty cold; however, the stuff inside is very crunchy. I really like the vinegar dipping sauce.

Terrible experience! I received a completely burnt pizza with no flavor at all—just a bitter, overcooked mess. And, also they gave me an expired drink! How can a food business be this careless? When I called to complain, there was no real effort to fix the issue. Extremely disappointing. I definitely won’t be ordering from here again!

Walked past the place while looking for food. Was heading to another place that had a higher rating but the smell was too good to pass up. Went here instead and was not let down. We ordered the 3 pizza deal and received a free cheese pizza! Wonderful customer service and fantastic taste! Pizza was cooked well and had a kick to the spicy options. Thanks so much for the great food! Will be coming back 👌

Excellent customer service! They didn't have an item i ordered, so they made jalapeno bites to replace it but i dont like jalapeno bites so they refunded the cost of the item and gave me the bites anyways, GG. The pizzas tasted fine nothing special.

I've seen this here for a while now and decided to try it out. The pizza is comparable to other similar chains. I had the Satay Chicken pizza and really enjoyed it. Was everything you'd want in a pizza. Prices are slightly better than other options. Will definitely be returning.

I recently ordered BBQ wings and pizza from this place and unfortunately, it was a disappointing experience. The pizza lacked flavour, definitely not up to par with what I was expecting. As for the wings, they were tiny, almost laughable in size.Definitely not worth the $12 I paid for them. Overall, it was not a great value, and I won't be coming back anytime soon.

Ordered the combo meal with Chicken Tika Masala and Garlic Nan bread. Food came out fresh and tasted authentic. Nice and clean seating inside and the person serving me was cheerful and kind. Would come again and try other curries next time.

The best Indian I have found in East Auckland. We tried the butter chicken combo. The flavour was delicious and more authentic than most (less sweet). Chicken tasted great and it was super fresh. We will definitely be back

Amazing food, fast service and friendly staff. Also, amazing deal. I got the combo deal for 2 which was about $55. Got 2 full curries, 2 full rice containers, 3 pieces of butter Naan and got a 1.5L drink too. AMAZING deal for quality, tasty food. Will definitely come here more regularly. Some places hold back on the rice, Naan and sometimes the amount of chicken you get with the curry. But not this place, you get what you pay for and a little more :) Thank you 😊

Our new go-to Indian spot. My husband and I eat here almost every week, and we would go more often except my husband is embarrassed to be ordering so often 😅. Everything we’ve had here is such high quality. Lamb bhuna is honestly one of the best I’ve ever had. Great value, portions, open late, friendly owners. What’s not to love? Oh, and they make almost anything dairy-free on request. Our favourites are: bhuna, aloo paratha, and samosa chaat, but honestly- I think all their dishes hit the mark. ♥️
Friendly, affordable and hospitable place to eat. We frequently come here, it’s local to us. Love the goat curry. Kid friendly too.

Crispy teriyaki Onigiri with cheese 🤤🤤☺️☺️. Fresh salmon sushi is cut thick and bouncy to chew (iykyk), everything we tried were so scrumptious and made with love. We finally get a decent sushi place in GI, thank you Sugoi Kitchen. We'll be back for more!

Little sushi store with a selection of freshly made hot meals too (donburi, udon, lunch box). Everything we ordered was so delicious and great value for money. The owners are so kind and sweet. Definitely our new local go-to sushi store!

I cannot recommend this place enough, it’s got the best sushi this side of Auckland. The ingredients are super fresh and the salmon just melts in your mouth. There’s also a fried chicken teriyaki with cheese dish that was out of this world! Will definitely be swinging by again the next time I’m in Auckland!
New sushi shop, really fresh and delicious sushi, the salmon was much bigger than normal shops! The ladies were great, even gave out free miso soup as part of opening specials.

Very fresh salmon, the staff is adorable and the place is very clean. The first time we went there, my little one dropped his plate with his favorite 🍣 and promptly they provide him with fresh ones. Second time they realized how much my son loves sushi and they gave some special courtesy to him. I highly recommend a stop in the store and to get some delicious and yummy Japanese food.

This is honestly one of my favourite places to eat. The mixed charcoal platter is always so fresh the meat is so juicy and the sauces are so damn good. The service is also great the people are lovely and always consistent. Highly recommend!!!

This place was one of my favourite places to eat at until today. Usually have the mixed charcoal platter but thought today I'll try something different. I went with the grilled fish. Fish was looking and tasting amazing and almost finished my fish until I opened the fish's mouth to see a fly 🪰 in there cooked also 🙃🤦🏽‍♂️ This to me is a BIG BIG let down. I returned it to the store where the chef said he'll give me a free complimentary meal to which I declined as this was the best he could do. The food here is amazing and the staff are friendly BUT with that fly... I won't be buzzin back unfortunately. 😪👋🏽
Amazing food. Quick service and friendly. The chicken was probably my favourite so far of all the different places I’ve eaten at over the past year. Highly recommend this place!

Today I had the absolute pleasure of visiting Khan’s Takeaway Restaurant on Morrins Road, and I’m still thinking about the food hours later! From the moment I walked in, the experience was top-notch – warm smiles, fast service, and most importantly, incredibly flavourful food. I ordered the Spicy Chicken Biryani and the Butter Chicken, and both dishes were beyond amazing. The biryani was packed with bold spices, perfectly cooked rice, and juicy chicken – it had just the right level of heat to satisfy spice lovers like me without overpowering the dish. As for the butter chicken – it was heavenly! Creamy, rich, and perfectly balanced with tender chunks of chicken – it’s easily one of the best I’ve had in Auckland. The food was so delicious that I couldn’t stop at just one plate. I ended up ordering two extra servings to take home – that says a lot coming from someone who usually doesn’t double up on meals! But it wasn’t just the food that impressed me. The service was exceptional. The two lovely ladies working there were so friendly, welcoming, and genuinely caring. They were polite, attentive, and made sure every customer felt at home. You can really tell when food is made and served with love – and this place had that warm, homely touch. The prices were very reasonable, the portions were generous, and the restaurant was clean and well-organised. Whether you’re dining in or grabbing takeaway, they’re quick and efficient without compromising quality. If you’re in the area or even if you’re not – make the trip to Khan’s Takeaway. It’s a true hidden gem for lovers of authentic, flavour-packed Indian cuisine. I’m so glad I stumbled upon this place – I’ll definitely be coming back, and I’ll be bringing friends and family along next time. Thank you to the wonderful team at Khan’s – your food made my day! 🙏❤️🔥

Had uber eats from here today. Just as good as from the main restaurant. Love the charcoal meats and the creamy hummus. The yellow rice was grainy. Not super big fan of the pita bread though, that was hard not feel fresh at all.

An honest and raw review of this place. Went there with my hubby and toddler in tow. Drove a good amount of distance to try their lomi so I was expecting a good dining experience. The place is very welcoming and the atmosphere is clean and inviting. The service was great and friendly. We ordered the jumbo lomi and the pancit/lumpia combination with fried rice. They don't have fried rice and the ladies were apologetic. Of course, no big deal, we can eat the steamed rice. My toddler gobbled up the pancit and lumpia the minute it arrived. I tasted it and it was delicious. It was $31.99 with drinks, it was good, but I thought they could have put more on the plate? But overall it's delish so that's okay! Now I go to the lomi. The reason why we went there.. It was packed with everything which made me very happy. For $28 I think that was decent. What I didn't like though was how bland the soup was. I have to constantly put soy sauce on it but I still couldn't taste the lomi flavour I was used to. BUUUUT I believe this was based from a Batangas lomi recipe, one I am not familiar of, so I kept an open mind and enjoyed my food. I'm not saying it wasn't good, it's just different from the other lomis I has tasted before so my review on this was relatively neutral. It's still delicious and I could taste the freshness of it, not one that was microwaved. Overall, I'm still giving a 5. Great place, good food, homey atmosphere and best of all, support our Filipino businesses!! :-)

The atmosphere was great and there’s a good variety of food on the menu. I highly recommend the Halo-halo! Best halo-halo I’ve tasted in NZ! 💕 Although it was really busy when we were at the restaurant, I think the staff handled it well given the circumstances.

Kabayan Bistro offers tasty and authentic Filipino food. The restaurant was nice and tidy, the staff were nice and the overall atmosphere was very warm and welcoming . My only criticism is that the portion sizes were a little small for the price.

Must try authentic Batangas Lomi and Kabayan Fried Rice! Good silog meals and combo meals come with either pancit canton or guisado. Halohalo and leche flan for dessert!! Exceptional "Filipino Hospitality", come here if you want authentic Pinoy food and feels. Salamat
Absolutely amazing experience. The food was so good and the staff were friendly. The ambience feels like home. I highly recommend this place for great food.
Ordered mixed meats on chips. Service was great, food came out in a timely manner. Recommend and will return.

This place is perfect if you’re looking for a snack late at night. I ordered chicken on chips around 10:15 PM and for $16.00 it was definitely worth it. The staff at this location were friendly and helpful, good customer service on their part. The location is far from myself but I do hope to return soon.
Place wasn’t for me. Could see sand flys around the kitchen and flies amongst the front counter. Overall didn’t appear fresh or clean. The food tasted alright.

Honest opinion NOT WORTH A CENT TBH!! my aunty an I come to order burger and chips and nah Made us feel sick. Yous own the shop in G.I the owners before yous where the best since they left hasn’t been the same
Don't waste your money here. Rude staff. Disgusting food. Terrible hygiene. Just gross all around. I can't believe people are rating this place higher than 1 star cos if it's not even worth that.

I’m a local always buy double cheese chicken burger but tonight first time ever the burger is disgusting 🤢 it’s always that one worker. 6.20pm 24/Sat/25 We got the same burger that we ordered morning early hours in the morning & that was delicious as always but tonight I got my family to take a bite just to make sure I’m not over reacting & yuck 🤢 Wanting to take it back but to far. Very poor. Utterly disappointed ☹️. Burger went straight into the bin. Wasted my money.

Amazing place.. The effort to serve great food here is beyond all expectations the loaded fries are great and fully loaded.. I show up ten mins before 4am and he is still happy to make me some food. You won't be disappointed if you eat here.. I Will definitely be coming here regularly.. 👌👍😍💯

Tasty American style burger with smash patty and yummy sauce. Didn't try the fish burger or fries but they got the thumbs up too. Glad this place was open late and we were able to sit in to eat. Plenty of parking when we visited. Few other local places open late on the same strip so might check those out next time.

Ordered 4 pieces of chicken combo. Chips was nice, chicken tasted old and reheated and they tried to mask this by adding spices and flavour to it which they failed. Wont recommend. Wont be trying this place again.

The food here is great I really enjoyed it. It is affordable, and really yummy. The American beef burger is so good - the flavours are perfect with the bbq sauce and onion rings and crispy beef patty. I loved it. The grilled chicken has such a nice smoky charcoal flavour too. I've already been back twice in one week haha!

I had a rather dry omelette with hard, cold uncooked tomatoes. Partner had the Belgium waffle which was good except for the uncooked fried egg. Not sure how you can't see the white of egg is translucent aka not cooked. Its rather disappointing when you can cook something better at home. Coffees were good.

The aroma of freshly brewed coffee drew us. Best coffee ever! Wish we had known this hidden gem before. Fluffy was absolutely delicious and so well presented. Will be back to try some breakfast and cabinet items.

Hats off to the staff and owner for making this place the best place ever to have coffee and food and most importantly to make me feel the truest, elusive, sweet and unmatchable Kiwi Spirit. I am over the moon happy to have discovered this lovely café. Highly recommended.
Excellent coffee, one of the best I have ever had been coming here since last 5/6 years and love it. Great vibe and great service :)

I organise a monthly coffee morning for a group of women and Merchants has become our "go to". We like the easy parking but also enjoy the great coffee and delicious bakery. Try the orange almond cake or a toasted cheese scone. The owner and staff are very pleasant and friendly.

The owners are so incredibly kind and welcoming. I was stranded on my way to the airport, my cell phone plan had run out of data and I was unable to book or look up the bus or taxi info. They called a taxi for me and we had a wonderful conversation while we waited. I wasn't able to try their food, but their drinks were delicious, and I hope to come back for more food! (I'm super delayed in creating my review, this occurred 28/4/24). Thank you again for all your help, I couldn't have made it without you. I did make my plane (I ran through the entire airport😅) and made it home!

We found this hidden gem today! Food is delicious, and the cocoa products are unbelievable! There is so much to try. We will come back to try every single product. Finally, a place with real and yummy fresh fruit juices. We loved the service, very friendly and cosy! Thanks, amigos. We will see ya next time!

This place is the best and most authentic Mexican restaurant in New Zealand, hands down. The Mexican owners are super friendly and helpful. They can recommend the best dishes and tell you all about the history of Mexican cuisine. As a Mexican myself, I can say that the beef taco is amazing, but the hot chocolate is the real star of the show. Thanks, Maria and José, for the delicious food and great conversation!

I'll have to add photos on my next visit but I've been looking for Mexican food that tastes authentic and this hit the spot, it tastes like home! The salsa for the enchiladas was spot on, the meat for the beef taco was so soft, juicy and had so much flavor! The hot chocolate was incredible. 10/10 recommend, you won't regret it.

Went here on the weekend, owners are so lovely came out and told us what the best things on the menu were! HIGHLY recommend beef tortilla best thing on the menu, meat was so tender and everything there is so fresh, including there fresh juices! Can’t wait to go back
Fantastic local takeaway. Great selection of food, very quick service and good pricing. The superwok burger is a must.
I really recommend combo 11. It's so delicious
The wings at SuperWok are a Michelin quality delight that leaves you craving more
Chicken wings are amazing. Crispy coating, juicy and tender. Good price. Well done

I'm just reviewing the chicken wings. As far as I am concerned they don't sell anything else. I am addicted to Super Wok chicken wings. Light coating, deep fried, salted, no sauce, cooked perfectly. Just yummy. Well done Super Wok. Well done.

I had a pleasant experience at this restaurant today. The beef and sushi was excellent, very flavourful and pleasant to the mouth. The service by Sophia and Lucas was excellent and commendable as they were extremely friendly. If you’re in the area i would highly recommend.
Food was delicious and service fast. It was a little crowded but was obviously a popular location. Bookings a must.

A place we have visited many times. It’s what you’d expect from a NZ Japanese restaurant. Out of the things we ordered, I liked the seared tuna the most. Sushi roles weren’t very fresh. The location of the restaurant is good though, you get a good view of half moon bay. The ventilation inside the restaurant was really bad, very hot and stuffy.

A true hidden gem overlooking the marina in Half Moon Bay. My friends and I had a dinner there, and we were pleasantly surprised by the warm ambiance, attentive service, and delightful cuisine. Among my personal favorites were the Tuna Tataki, Sashimi, and Teppan Yaki dishes. Each was prepared with care and beautifully presented, offering a truly enjoyable dining experience. While our meal was mostly delightful, there were a couple of minor points worth mentioning: - Some dishes, like the edamame and sukiyaki, seemed to lack a bit of seasoning. I particularly enjoy edamame with a touch of salt, and found the sukiyaki a tad too sweet for my taste. - Additionally, it would have been convenient to have an extra set of chopsticks or tongs available for preparing raw meat on the Teppan Yaki grill, especially for the chicken. Overall, it’s a charming family-owned restaurant worth exploring, with a cozy atmosphere and delicious food.

Sashimi was very fresh, strongly recommend this. Sizzling prawn would be nicer if they had more yum yum sauce on it. I was disappointed with the tempura, as this was not Japanese tempura batter… more like the batter from fish and chips shop. Service was fantastic. Really friendly and attentive waitresses.
We have been going here for 25 years. The cheese onion and potato balls are epic. Unfortunately they are now using crinkle cut chips 🙁

This is a take out place. Patronise a few times, and their special Horse seafood noodles are a little too salty, whereas their fried rice is acceptable. I prefer their dishes on rice, it is the best amongst the rest.
Had the fish n chips tonight after seeing good reviews. Unfortunately mine was so over cooked I ended up throwing them out.

Second time going here and it will be my last as I can't deal with places that are inconsistent. First time we got fish burgers and they were great but today we got them, my partners was fine but mine was disgusting. Tasted so fishy and I swapped with my partner and he spat it out and threw it away. Such a shame because they are decently priced as well.
They are usually pretty good but today they gave me burnt chicken and chips, and the guy would’ve knowingly given it to me, in that case this was a scam

Always have a fantastic experience here.. Great staff, atmosphere and food… Churros were amazing!!! And the Margarita Tree was a real treat sharing with friends. Highly recommend all things Marina Cantina

Firstly amazing food and really good portion sizes for price, cocktails were sooo good especially the black Doris magareta... What let this place down is service, the 3 waitresses (young) were more interested in talking with each other/kitchen staff then checking on the two tables in at the start of the night. I had to wave the empty water bottles for a good 2 minutes before I caught their eye...I would have had more than one drink if the waitresses checked in after food was delivered. Would suggest putting on someone more mature to develop/lead the team. Otherwise food and drink is very good if you don't mind average service.
Great little place for a cheap feed. Definitely try the loaded fries and black Doris plum margarita. Friendly staff and fun atmosphere

Lovely staff and the burger was absolutely fantastic. Highly recommend their house beer and red wine sangria. Great value for money and definitely worth coming to your ferry early so you can stop here.

Great atmosphere, beautiful tojito drink and excellent customer service skills. The justification behind the 2 star was twice, our dishes were brought wrong. We asked for no jalapeños with the loaded fries and we got the dish with. This was okay and we continued to eat the dish. But then one of our dishes they brought was wrong. They were very apologetic and made our correct dish in record time. The vege dish was very rushed we thought and the pulled pork tortilla could've been made by an amateur chef. They did shave some dollars off our total and again, were sorry for what had happened throughout our dine-in experience.

Wow oh wow! Upon arrival greeted by friendly staff. Prompt service without feeling rushed at all. Manager on duty was very pleasant and impressively remembered our entire order (which you can see from the photos was no small order). Starters all arrived (four dishes) within 10-15mins. Tuna went down a treat! Vibrant presentation - beautifully done. Easy on the palette, a standout dish for us. A little less seasoning on the squid would have been nice - in saying that - one of the best squid we’ve had. Partner had the poke bowl which she enjoyed, portion was generous and full of flavour! I had the pan fried fish which was beautiful. Overall a lovely experience & left very happy with our meals. Service was great from start to finish. Will certainly be recommending to others and returning again soon. Thanks team! Note: Their menu is Halal minus the chowder.

Lots of food, but pricey. Would be better to have smaller helpings at a lower price. Coffee came with a cute anchor on it, but it was cold. They offered me another which was slightly warmer, but still cold. Surely you use a thermometer in the milk when you heat it up?? Lovely location and recommended to us by others.

Been a while since I last visited. Pretty good food but is a little pricey for what you get. Beef rib pappardelle was the best dish we tried. That said, nice to sit outside by the marina on a sunny day. Actually, their fries and potatoe skins are simple snacks to enjoy with a drink without costing a fortune.

I grew up at half moon bay marina so returning here in an always special. Grangers was pleasant and the service quick and efficient. We had to move from our original table because of some rather noisy drunk patrons but it wasn’t a problem. The setting and atmosphere was very nice and the views of the marina delightful. Food was of a very high standard and well presented with all three of us enjoying the experience. Recommend.

We came here for a family Birthday lunch. Our waitress was beautiful! Smiley, warm and attentive. Our margarita cocktails, with coconut, were so delicious! Very well mixed! Our meals were scrumptious! And don't get me started on the incredible chocolate desert!

ordered the family A special and a bami goreng. It was more than enough to feed my family of 5 and it was delicious. They were very generous of the portions and the service was great. I ordered on the phone. Staff was polite and it was ready quick while the food was also fresh. Love their food especially the chinese dishes. I definitely reccomend.

Very disappointed. ordered combination soft noodles last night. 2 lil pieces of pork, 3 lil pieces of chicken,2 small as shrimp. all noodles chopped up in2 lil bits with couple shreds of carrot and onion. $20. never again and tasteless.
Best jumbo burger ever! So tasty! My 6yr old daughter also loved her cheeseburger and says you deserve a medal 🥇 delicious mushroom bites. We will be back ! 😀
Food was yummy chips not too oily and were nice and crunchy . We ordered 3 burgers and chips reasonably priced. Staff were lovely would definitely have again next time we go to the beach
Can’t go wrong with Mobil Corner. Best fish in chips in east auckland and the chicken fried rice is 10/10

My husband and I attended Bucklands Beach Yacht Club Open Day today, 18/2/2024. It is the first time we have been there. We enjoyed the beautiful view overlooking the amazing yachts at the restaurant there. Live music was fantastic and the singer John Kempt really played the guitar so well that he could actually make the guitar sing! We loved his voice and the way he skilfully played the guitar. We also enjoyed the wine tasting there and met a lovely couple Victoria and Michael who are real estate agents at Ray White. The membership fee is only NZD80 for new members. We highly recommend you to join their membership if you live in Half Moon Bay area.
Great food, enjoyed with Wife and Mother-in-Law
Great facility, view over marina, good food and full bar. Recommended

Great place, the visit wasn't long but the overall atmosphere was very acceptable. I wish I could live there. We found a house to rent but it didn't have a garden so the deal didn't go through...but the place is great.
Nice club house ,great outlook. Good restaurant.

I was part of a wedding party of 13. I ordered Prawn toast, a small bowl of Pork Tom Kha soup (no plain rice) and Pork fried rice as well as a Thai iced coffee. Portions were really good. Food tasty. Service was good

Marina Thai offers wonderful food, service, and atmosphere. The food came out quick and fresh to the table and were greeted by a lovely smile from the waitresses. The atmosphere at the Marina is always warm and welcoming and is perfect for a nice Sunday lunch . Overall a wonderful experience and a must try 😊
Absolutely delicious food and amazing service! We dined outside and the view and atmosphere was also very amazing. Their menu has lots of delicious options too.

Some of the best and most authentic Thai food we’ve ever had. The best service by jobs and his lovely family, always so accommodative and friendly. I highly recommend going there the ambiance is lovely! Just don’t double think it! Go!!

An excellent choice by the marina overlooking the boats. The outdoor seating, if you are visiting in the daytime, is a treat. The food is very good. The service is acceptable. We had bit of mixup in our order a couple of times but the server was apologetic. We go there very often and will keep going back. There is plenty of parking available around. As mentioned there is indoor and outdoor seating. We generally order pepper chicken which comes on a sizzling platter. Variety of mocktails and cocktails. Price is reasonable.

It was always a pleasant experience to dine at this little gem at Half Moon Bay Marina. Coffee always perfect , food always nicely present and delicious. Friendly service and good indoor and outdoor vibes.

Nice cafe with good food. The cafe is quite cozy and they make the yummiest chai latte. The seafood chowder is pretty good but i feel like the quiches could be a bit more flavourful. Either way very nice cafe for a quick meal :)

If you need a new spot to try then look no further cause Cinnamon Cafe is where it at!!!!. I have been to many cafes and trued many dishes but today I tried the prawn linguine pasta and might I say that felt like the most homely delicious meal ever. Music was good vibe was please but the food was blimin DELICIOUS. Compliments to the chef and staff there, definitely will be back.

Great food, strong delicious cafe, friendly and competent staff. The only down side to this nice cafe is the size of it. Tables inside are always busy. If you're enjoying a sunny day...outdoor area is great. Recommended!

A good, well kept local cafe, with reasonable prices & a decent range of food. Very popular with the older local crowd as a gathering place and coffee spot, but with a higher quality menu than your standard tearooms. Reasonable cabinet food & a great pace to meet a friend. Outside is good on a sunny day.

They have a variety of sushi options and you pick your own. Each type is individually priced and labeled below the cabinet. Price range can be quite significant. The traditional ones like Salmon and Avocado or Salmon Nigiri (Inside cabinet) are cheaper price compared to other fancier ones they have in the front cabinet

This sushi place was one of the best sushi places I have ever been to. The food taste fresh and the flavors taste astronomical. The customer service was also excellent. Would recommend, I will be going to this place more in the future

Self serve or order sushi shop. Definitely better than some of the other local sushi shops. Great to buy and eat at the marina if you are into that. Close to local beaches too if you want to buy then go chill at the beach.
It was a great experience! It is very clean and the sushi is delicious and their service is nice too.
Pretty good. I'd go more often if the slices of fish on the nigiri weren't so thin.

A Familiar Favorite Faces a Change This cafe has always been a go-to for its friendly atmosphere and quick service. We've enjoyed many meals here over the years, but recent visits have revealed a slight dip in the quality of the food. The presentation and overall appeal seem less appetizing than before. Despite this, the cafe retains its vibrant energy and rapid turnover. It remains a popular spot, bustling with activity. While the food quality has declined somewhat, the overall ambiance and quick service are still strong draws. We'll continue to visit, hoping for a return to the previous culinary heights.

the french toast that I got was super delicious and the presentation was INCREDIBLE. i also want to add that the food came out super quickly and the female waitress that served us was lovely. Unfortunately my cappuccino was super bitter and it came out about 10 minutes after our other food and drinks so not sure if it was rushed when they realised they hadn’t made it and that’s why it was bitter? The milk was done well though. Only other downside was the lady at the counter who took our order took 5 minutes to understand my friend’s request asking for just the mince and the sourdough for his ‘mince on toast’ due to allergies. He kept repeating that he couldn’t have the egg and corn chips etc and just wanted the mince and bread, and she kept giving him weird looks and asking him again if he wanted the tomato, egg, corn chips etc while a line was building up behind us which was a bit stressful. Overall though it was a nice brunch and the location right by the water is lovely.

Nice location, busy cafe on the weekend during lunch time. Some language barriers when ordering and giving feedback to staff members, but easily resolved. Coffee wasn’t great and some attention to hygiene (cutlery) is needed. The food is nice, decent portion size for the price.

I was out for a (very) long walk along the Rotary Walkway one Sunday morning, and managed to find myself at the Marina. In much need of food, I chose to refuel at this cafe, and did not regret it. I went for the fish and chips with a banana smoothie, and it hit all the right spots. It was a pretty large serving, and it barely touched the sides - I was so hungry. The cafe itself is very nice, with comfortable seating and a peaceful atmosphere. The view of the Marina is pretty good, too.

We had brunch there. It was so busy, a long queue. Just after we paid, the lady said the waiting time was about 30 minutes. Luckily, the food came quickly, and it was delicious. We had an orange juice, cappuccino, big breakfast, and chicken waffles 🧇 A nice food with a perfect view of marina for a brunch date 😊

I am so glad that I found King Kong Food and they have my favourite Hong Kong Style Siu Mai and they are all handmade with love. Their siu mai is amazing, they have the fish paste style siu mai and they are slightly chewy and the flavours were spot on. Highly recommend!

King Kong Siu Mai has seriously the best Siu Mai in Auckland, hands down! Their soy sauce is on point, like it was made just for these dumplings. I ordered a ton of packs to share with friends, and let's just say they were gone in 5 minutes. Crazy addictive! Definitely recommend checking them out.
The best Hong Kong street style fish Siumai i ever had in New Zealand. Don’t forget to eat with the handmade sweet soy sauce. It tastes amazing.
Tasty! Hong Kong style's siu mai, recommend for dim sum lover!

So delicious! This is my first time trying fish siu mai, a street snack in Hong Kong. I will want to eat it again after trying it! The texture is so chewy and sizzling that you will accidentally eat one after another!

Best filipino grilled inasal and frilled liempo in auckland. Value for money, big serving, and absolutely delicious! Mang Joe and staff is super friendly. Will definitely be our favorite for inasal and grilled liempo cravings. 💯

Mang Joe's Chicken Inasal in Farmcove, Auckland is an exceptional dining establishment that is definitely worth visiting. The restaurant offers authentic Filipino cuisine, with its signature dish being the mouth-watering Chicken Inasal. The food at Mang Joe's Chicken Inasal has received widespread acclaim, with many customers raving about the delicious flavors and generous portions. The chicken is grilled to perfection and served with a variety of sides and condiments, creating a meal that is both satisfying and flavorful. In addition to the food, the atmosphere at Mang Joe's Chicken Inasal is also a standout feature. The restaurant has a casual and welcoming vibe, with friendly staff and a relaxed setting that makes it a great place to enjoy a meal with friends or family. The value for money at Mang Joe's Chicken Inasal is also noteworthy. The portions are generous and the prices are reasonable, making it a great option for those on a budget. Overall, Mang Joe's Chicken Inasal is a top-notch dining destination that offers delicious food, excellent service, and a warm and welcoming atmosphere. If you're in the mood for authentic Filipino cuisine or simply looking for a great dining experience, this restaurant is definitely worth checking out. I highly recommend it and would give it a 5-star rating.
Mang Joe's chicken inasal is very tasty! The chicken is soft and tender. Trully a delight to anyone. Will come back for more.
I love Mang Joe Inasal.. it tastes similar to Mang Inasal back in Philippines. Totally recommend.
Really love their authentic chicken inasal and Liempo.

Enjoyable egg burger: had the necessary lettuce, tomato, tomato sauce, patty and egg, nicely grilled buns too, burger came out streaming hot, non greasy. Hot dog was also crispy. Service with a smile, happy with this find, will gladly return to try out other menu items. Would recommend.

Super expensive and low quality. I try to support local, but they have loyalty to their customers. For $39 we are better off with pizza that we are full and will have left overs. They have claimed inflation, but no one else has this low quality and quantity for $6 chips.

Got fish and chips from here cost me about $40 for two fish and chips with two cans of drink and a couple of wontons.... Too overpriced.. The fish tasted so old I couldn't stomach it. Chips were flavourless.. had to vomit after ....definitely will not be returning
$6.50 for this？？I'd rather go MCD nearby

Service was good- Ordered fish chips and 2 potato fritters ($16), chips ok, fish dry and fritters look liked they had been reheated few times. Last time for me, anyone know quality fish n chips shop in Pakuranga?

We uber this food from this restaurant for the very first time and it’s really disappointing.! Haralyi Chicken tikka was toooo salty and pink from inside totally uncooked, photos attached.! gravy just tasted burnt garlic with no taste of spices.!
I had one of the best momos here. Especially the chutney was so mouthwatering. Kathi rolls are another thing one can try 👌🏼

A delicious plate of stir-fried noodles, loaded with crunchy vegetables and coated in a savory soy-based sauce. The noodles are well-cooked with just the right texture and a hint of tangy flavor from the added sauces. Great portion size and satisfying taste, perfect for a quick and comforting meal.

New Indian restaurant so decided to try it out. First impression was not the best but I’m happy that I went back!! First time I went I ordered their chicken momos which tasted like a mouth full of soggy dough… the curry I believe was chicken tikka masala, no flavour… but I supposed the salt was balanced out by the over-salted fried naan- However, second visit I ordered the Prawn taka tak and it was amazing!! Medium-hot and so flavourful whilst not being too salted. Looked not the mist smooth curry but wow was it smooth!! Only downside was the “prawn” from the “prawn curry” as it was overcooked that it was slightly rubbery. Also ordered a mango lassi, unfortunately had to send back the first one because it had what I can only describe as sand with a stinky smell… but staff was amazing and gave me another one right away! Honestly, not my cup of “mango” as it was way too sweet but if you have a sweet tooth then go for it!! Overall I will be coming back as I live close but if it wasn’t proximity I likely wouldn’t be coming back. Few great dishes but too many “meh” or “needs work” dishes. Hope they can improve and become more popular though!! ✨⭐️ Also staff is so kind and patient, that was definitely a win!
Food was delicious and staff like friendly good service

I had my first visit to Sal's Pizza with my family, and it was such a great experience! We ordered the "5 Boroughs" large pizza and the half cheese pizza, and let me tell you – they were HUGE! The pizzas were fresh out of the oven and absolutely delicious. On top of that, the gentleman who served us was so friendly and welcoming. A big thank you to Sal's Pizza in Highland Park for making our meal so memorable.

The pizzas are so delicious and their Buffalo chickens. Their black garlic and pepperoni pizza is always 10/10. Very simple but very delicious. Customer service is amazing. The one guy working made sure our dine in experience was comfortable. Asked if we needed cups etc... nice to eat at a place where a customer service actually cares and on top of that the food is amazing. Definitely come back again.

Went for lunch, second day in a row! I had the pepperoni and meatball special pizza of the day. The pizza is beautifully prepared, cooked to perfection,, and the staff are very friendly and look after the customer well. This is without a doubt the best Sal’s I’ve had for a very long time. You can tell they really care about their pizza and quality ingredients I’ll be back for more!

Great food and excellent service! I 100% recommend Sal’s – the pizzas definitely lived up to the hype. The flavors are spot on, and the atmosphere makes for a fantastic dining experience. You won’t be disappointed!

I think I’ve visited every Sal’s Pizza store in Auckland and can say hand on heart that Highland Park have the best pizza, the bases are perfect with a little bit of crunch and all their pizzas are a home run. Great staff and service, try the buffalo chicken pizza next time you’re there and thank me later. James Ashwin Kakapo Business Sales

Really bad experience, disappointed on the specialty dishes, the pancake is not even crisp, and the sauce tested spoiled, kind of sour. Really worried about the food safety. When the question asked, the owner just said that’s what they do, and blamed the customer don’t know anything with insulting tone. What a day.
This is the best place to have dumplings in Auckland, this is for sure, I have also tried their wonton soup, superb!

Hadn’t been here in a few years and was after some Zhajiang noodles. Firstly, will say their pancakes are the star. These aren’t to be confused with western pancakes, these are more like pastry like buns that have been pan fried with a lovely crisp to them. They have a variety of sweet and savoury versions with the plain being my favourite. They have these nice layers and a moorish texture. Back to what we visited for - the noodles were sadly too salty and didn’t taste like it was fried. The noodles were also bit over cooked. Not horrible, just not the best. We also got the steamed pork & cabbage dumplings. The dumpling wrappers were really nice. The filling was okay at first but then became too salty. It may just be this province likes their food more salty. Would highly recommend the “pancakes” and would come back for these. Pretty decent sizes and a good snack or meal if you grab a couple.

Very upsetting experience. I came here on June 7 around 11:30 AM with my two young children while pregnant. One dish (noodles) was undercooked, so I politely asked for a refund. Although the refund was processed, the staff became extremely angry. Two people came out from the kitchen yelling at us loudly in front of my kids, saying things like “If you don’t like the food, don’t order it!” in a very aggressive way. My 2-year-old was terrified and cried. I felt deeply unsafe and feared they might get violent. I had to leave the restaurant carrying my crying child. This is unacceptable behavior, especially toward a pregnant woman and children. I will never come back.
Beautiful food, beautiful people and very beaut prices! Amazing customer service. I’d like to gate keep, but I guess I’ll share one of my favourite places to chill and eat.

They came to our workplace with their Mobile Kitchen. Everyone (18 of us) enjoyed the lamb-curry-bunny-chow!! Will highly recommend them. Excellent chow, friendly couple, and I would not forget this special lunch. Well done, Picklelicious!

This Bunny Chow was one of the best I have ever had with generous amount of meat however what set Picklelicious apart was the service they heard my name and once and remembered it which is generally a good benchmark on a business. Thank you for a great lunch and service

Our first time here and we were very pleased with the ambience, food, staff and prices. The place filled up quickly with customers, but it didn't slow down the dishing out of food. The owner was walking around talking to the patrons and the wait staff were quick in attending to tables and bringing out orders. It was very very windy and cold outside, but with the windows closed and the heat pumps on, it very pleasant inside. Will definitely visit again, but maybe in summer when the weather permits us to sit outside and enjoy the beach!

The food here is alright..the squid wasn't crispy but taste is there. The lamb souvlaki is a bit dry but the mashed potato that came with it was excellent . The fav dishes were creme brulee and king prawns. Nice atmosphere by the beach and lovely staff

Zabr'one at Bucklands Beach is our local go-to for pasta. The way they make it really suits our family’s taste, and we keep coming back for that. To be fair, we have not tried many of the other mains outside the pasta range — lol. The entree in the photo (crumbed risotto balls and fried chicken) was average. Still, it is a nice spot overall, and great for a stroll along the beach after dinner — maybe not so much in winter though.

This place seems very over rated. Starting with drinks, $18 mocktail we'd expect a tasty drink with lots of fruits elsewhere but here it's just pale colored sugar water, couldn't finish the water melon mocktail, was like it was made with a supermarket brand cordial. Beer selection poor, didn't even bother. Pasta has a hefty price but lacking in flavor. Creamy cheese sauce in al fedo lacking in cheese. Marinara although a pleasant tomato flavor left lacking in other flavor and seafood contents esp for $37. Wagyu Burger was ok, think almost Burger fuel quality. Fries were dosed in salt like someone forgot to screw the salt lid on. Inedible and cold. Service friendly but inattentive with drink left empty for most of meal. I was able to witness the chef barking orders at the attendant with face over my food, since it had been sitting a while. Was hoping it wasn't my Burger... It was... Toilet stinks of stale urine and with the pleasure of people opening the door into the back of your head as you wash your hands. Would be nice just for a beer on a summer day on the outdoor seats. In winter it's cold, with doors open, bring your jacket. Overall, falls short of expectations. No one at the table wanted to return.

Although did not take a lot of pictures, and just to have a coffee chat with my friend, we enjoyed the food and coffee a lot. Especially we loved the service provided by Tamara, the nicest girl with a beautiful smile all the time. She was enthusiastic, friendly and offered all the help we needed. The other girl was also really nice, checked on us occasionally to make sure everything is alright :) we also ran into someone’s birthday and they sang a beautiful birthday song to the birthday girl. The atmosphere was really good and it has a fantastic sea view. No matter it’s a bar, a coffee shop or a restaurant, it was doing really good.

Fresh snapper??? Where ??? Sorry but was dry and fishhy azzzz manurewa fish and chips are better like gummmonnnn X2 Steak and egg burger was alg but steak was rubber egg was nice 5$ Chips were okay Not spending 42$ there again Please change ur fresh snapper sign to 2 week old frozen snapper
My partner who is very picky with fried rice said it's the best fried rice she's ever had!! I think so too! Full of flavor and super tasty!

Local Fish and Chips and Chinese takeaways. I always order the special combos displayed on the wall for good savings. Chinese food is good value as well. Best to call ahead and order on the phone for pick up later. Open at Level 3 lockdown and can make an order on the spot and wait also

I wish I looked at the reviews before buying from here 🙃 I had the same issues.. bad cooking oil, yuck batter on the potato fritters and fish, the chips were so bad even the seagulls didn’t eat them 🥲 ordered an American hot dog then after waiting 15 minutes the lady says they don’t make them anymore. So I ask for a chicken burger instead, she asks me to pay the extra. Allgood.. but I took one look at it and couldn’t eat it... my partner had one bite and said it was terrible.. won’t be back!!

Good standard service 3 stars Second time I have eaten here & 2nd time I've gotten sick - note Im not good with preservatives & oily fatty foods but can & do eat regularly chips fish burgers. My partner works in hospo & told me chips not fresh either out to long or possibly refozen. To be fair Pic of chips is when they where cold but they weren't appealing hot either.
They deserve more attention. Both indoor and outdoor dinning option, big portion noodle soup, clean environment and food taste awesome! Come try it for yourself.
A little Vietnamese restaurant tucked away in Highland Park, food is reasonably priced with generous portions. Their spring rolls are a must-try!
Food and service was great. I've finally found somewhere local to get a tasty curry chicken with rice thats on par(if not better) than Vietnam Cafe. I'd give 5stars but the flies were pissing me off.

Newly opened Vietnamese Chinese Fusion restaurant, tucked in the corner of the car park. They have seating indoors and also an outside covered area. They have Vietnamese Pho, Spring Rolls, Vermicelli, as well as Fried Noodle dishes and Rice Dishes. The portions are a good size and good value. Food came out fast and clean facilities
We had the crispy pork soup and the combination meat on rice and it was amazing! Service was excellent and the food came out quick. Already planning on trying the Banh Mi next time.

A cosy spot for lunch/dinner that always leaves me satisfied. My favourites include the miso and teriyaki dishes, the chicken is tender and pairs perfectly with rice. The gyu tataki and miso dengaku (fried tofu) are also must-orders. Combined with the lovely service and ambient atmosphere - Nishiki Highland Park has quickly become one of my favourite food spots.
A nice Japanese restaurant for gatherings — I ordered the mackerel and fried chicken cutlet set meals. The food was delicious and generously portioned. Definitely worth recommending!

Beautiful seating areas with a tablet at each table for you to order food through. Choice of indoor or semi outdoor tables. Clean interior, and the outdoor tables have candles and fairy lights. Nice food and light flavours. Free parking lot outside, and a tea shop nearby. However, I will say the restaurant did a huge menu change a while ago. It was better before.

Popped in for a quick bite to eat before going to the movies. Restaurant has a relaxed vibe, staff are friendly & the food (you order food & beverages on an iPad at your table) is prepared quickly and tasted delicious. We would definitely return again.

Order by iPad which is really convenient because you can see what each meal looks like, pretty efficient with bringing out the food. Food portion is very good for the price you pay, some might find the curry a little bit salty (I like it personally) but they give plenty of rice to go with it. Overall a happy experience and will be back

Came on a Friday night and the place was filling up with diners at 6pm. The restaurant was a lot bigger than I imagined and there are more tables at the back around the corner from the bar. Modern decor and clean environment. We ordered the Duck Breast and Lamb Shanks for mains, as well as a Seafood Chowder for entrée and a side of Fries. Excellent service and tasty food.

Great food and great location. There is a good selection of food and lots of seating. However the wait for the food is long and the decor seems budget basic... the previous theme could have stayed for another two or three year's. Hopefully they sort the slow service, I'll be going back for the food and view.
The staff is friendly and the food ingredients are fresh and delicious. I had a pleasant dinner and will visit again. Thank you.

We absolutely love this place! The pasta and pizza are always fantastic, and we had to try their new dessert options. The mango slice with macaron was exceptional, and the ganache chocolate paired with ice cream was a perfect combination.

Upon arrival there was no greeting from any server as they were filling up the fridge behind the bar. Coffee nice. Food slightly unimpressed. Pizza had a burnt bottom and hardly any mushrooms with my lunch, the French toast with banana could have been grilled a bit more. Very dark corner of the restaurant we were seated in would have loved to be placed near the window as the front wasn’t very busy at all…

Can not recommend enough! The food is amazing, great value for money and the coffee is always consistently delicious. Very celiac safe with lots of gluten free options and staff are knowledgeable about cross contaminations etc Must get the garlic mushrooms.

Service was good, the food was good, sitting outside was great. I really like that it is a little cottage turned into a cafe / tearoom. Really homely and warm. Not going to win any awards but this is the sort of place that becomes your local spot for breakfast where you always feel comfortable.

A cute café situation out of a cottage in Howick, such a nice setting. There is a surprisingly large amount of space both inside and outside for seating. The food is simple but done well without anything unnecessary added. I'd particularly recommend the French Toast for a delicious meal. Service was exceptionally prompt, with food delivered and cleaned up quickly.
Lots of lovely made-on-the-premises food, both cabinet and menu, including Gluten Free, etc. Lots of indoor and outdoor seating. Ample parking outside on the street.
Scones are amazing, light and taste lovely toasted with apricot jam ... yum! Hubby had a big breakfast was very tasty. Will be back again. Thank you.
Was an awesome new years eve ball.. Can't wait to go back..
Great meals at sensible prices

Went for lunch, menu prices are really good. We ordered fish and chips, really enjoyed was a lovely meal. Staff there are very good & efficient and easy to talk too. Thoroughly recommend this place and will go back again.
Great venue! Great interior. Excellent lighting, great dance floor. Attended a private function there. Good parking at rear. Lovely character building too.

Fabulous friendly environment, great food, entertainment and people. Recommend a visit. Good to know the RSA is open to the public. Love their development idea of apartments above the new RSA as very handy to Howick shops - great idea!

Fresh delicious fish. Supple. Overpriced though - $30 for three snapper and a handful of chips. The fillets were large as requested, but with the chips at $4.50 - that’s $8.50 each. Good service… fast. The batter was a little gluey and floury but overall not a bad feed.

Got a crumbed Snapper and chips. The fish was fresh, flaky and juicy. Crumb was nice and crunchy and so were the chips. $14 👍🏼 As I am a big eater will have to get extra’s next time. Would definitely recommend.
If I could give a 10 I would,I ordered fish and chips for 2 and curry roll, absolutely delicious and crispy and still hot, I will definitely order again and highly recommend it, tyvm
What you would expect from a typical neighbourhood fish and chip shop. Good food. 👍

Decided to give it another try after more than a year. The place seems to have revitalised! Brighter and more items on offer. Also looks like it’s run by new family/owner. Tried the set E. Fish was plump and still juicy and a bigger portion than the last I tried. Their signature crunch is still there. The potato patties have also grown in size and even more crunchy than I remember. Definitely deserved to be a separate offering by itself. Even the chips seem much lighter and crunchier than last year! Kudos for making me look forward to revisit again.

Warm greeting and great service throughout our dining experience but.... Food didn't quite hit the mark. It was definitely edible but for the cost, the flavors were very 2 dimensional. Birria goat taco was lacking depth and flavour and served with lemon as opposed to the traditional lime, white onion and cilantro. Consomme or "birria broth" as it said on the menu just plain. Patatas were slightly undercooked so a little hard. We had both the chefs nacho tray and patatas. It was the same beef, soft, lovely and colorful just a bit plain for a $45 nachos. The sliced beef tortillas off the specials menu was okay but the ham/bacon in the beef mix not quite there. Most flavoursome item was the kids popcorn chicken taco. The rest was underwhelming. Mocktails lovely. Again, service was choice. New chef and new menu coming so may try again in the future.

We had dinner after work. It was busy but easy to find a car park. For drink, we had frozen margarita and strawberry margarita. It was so delicious. For food, we had pork belly strips, beef quasadillas, lamb fajitas, pork tacos, and beef tacos. It was beautiful.

Great spot for large groups. Saturday lunchtime the place was almost empty. Tried multiple different dishes. Guacamole and chips are definitely a great start, loaded potatoes and Hot Queso won't also disappoint. Fried chicken was completely dry like someone forgot it in the fryer and then served it. Tacos are nice, won't surprise but won't disappoint. If you like sweet drinks the frozen margaritas are great choice for you (lemon lime I think was the best one) The biggest disappointment is the dessert. For $14 you get 2 small churros with a small scoop of ice cream...a bit steep for 2 pieces of less than 10cm of fried dough. Overall great place for outing but still needs a bit of work to be amazing.
Great vibe and environment, great service...friendly staff. Some delicious food can recommend the pulled pork, chicken tacos. Brisket had some good flavor!! Jalapeño poppas have some kick. Good stuff
Thank you to the whole team for making my daughter’s birthday so special. She was over the moon. We had great experience.

Been here a few times now. The food is quite nice and authentic. Fish tastes fresh. Service is friendly. Reasonable prices. It's fun to get a mix of different dishes and share. Doing this was $100 for 3 people with drinks.
Japanese food is of good standard and quality and justifies the more high end price point. The food comes out very quickly. Plenty of parking. In the weekend it recommended to phone booking

Miyuki Japanese restaurant offers tasty and authentic Japanese at an affordable price. The staff are always friendly and welcoming and the atmosphere is always very warm and inviting. Whether your celebrating a special occasion or just looking for a nice and affordable place to eat, Miyuki Howick is an excellent place to eat😊

Went for Friday dinner because we were craving for Japanese foot. I enjoyed the salmon roll, the beef was flavorful and the fish was soft and juicy. There were a group of friends having their dinner and drinks there so it was kind of noisy but I guess it was understandable because it was a Friday.

I recently dined at Miyuki restaurant, and the experience was delightful. The food was delicious, with the sushi and tuna standing out for their freshness. The egg chicken katsu was flavorful, and the broth was perfect for a chilly day. Although the teriyaki eel was a bit too sweet for my taste, it was still enjoyable. Overall, the prices were affordable, making it a great value for the quality of food served.

We went to Daisy Chang’s for dinner last night and had such a wonderful experience! The food was absolutely delicious – every dish was packed with flavor and beautifully presented. The service was just as impressive, with a team of lovely, attentive staff who made us feel so welcome. Overall, a fantastic dining experience and we’ll definitely be coming back again soon!

For the first time in forever we had some decent good service again. The food was brilliant, especially the red meat. Everyone was friendly and i think it was the owner that came past the table twice too. I hope they will keep up the good service. The menu with the meat worked well for us as South Africans and the kids being more kiwi by now enjoyed the asian food. I could get everyone happy! Other restaurants can learn from this team, well definitely go again. Cute place with lovely decor too! Good food and service is rear, mostly is just acceptable! Thank you for your email the day after too! WOW, i am not impressed easily...

This was our very first experience at Daisy Chang. Food is truly amazing. Very nice, clean and full of flavours . The waitress was very helpful and recommended some easy to share dishes. Must try their homemade lemonade. Will definitely bring my other friends to come and try. 😊😊

Amazing place! Food is absolutely delicious and the service is always really good. Kids love it! The only place we go where the kids don't want to order the fries cause they'd rather eat the main dishes. Today we got drunken noodles, gang pao chicken, Korean fried chicken and stir fried pork belly. Highly recommend and we will be coming back a third time.

Loved it. The food was amazing- we had prawn dumplings and braised beef. Both great, the beef was cooked to perfection, juicy, flavourful, tender but crispy too..Well priced for the quantity. the service and ambience were also amazing.

Super accommodating despite not having a booking. Staff attentive but not over bearing. Restaurant is intimate with a small kitchen you can see and watch your food being made. Food was good but pricey, however the quality makes up for this. Has no toilet or place to wash your hands which I didn’t like as you had to go around the corner.

After hearing amazing things about this place (and being a big fan of pizza) I just had to try it for myself! I got a Capri pizza, which was delicious! Lots of toppings and full of flavour. I did find it strange it was cut into quarters, not 8ths, but that’s just me. After seeing reviews for the Nutella calzone I also had to try that out. My goodness… so much Nutella! I’m pretty sure they put an entire jar of Nutella in that thing 😂 it was great as it lasted me a few days, no way could I scoff that down in one night 🤣 Looking forward to coming back and trying more flavours of pizza. The staff were also lovely!

Great pizza, fresh fries, and excellent service! I was surprised at how quickly the pizza was made—less than 10 minutes. It was lovely to watch it go into the oven right in front of us, and my curious 10-month-old loved seeing the chef in action. We’ll definitely be back to try more from the menu. Cheers!

My apologies for the photo quality—I don’t usually write reviews for takeaway. This place came highly recommended by a friend who lives in Howick. When I arrived, the pizzaiolo greeted me by sliding a pizza in the oven while tilting his head, signaling that someone would be over to help me shortly. Following Chelsea's recommendation, I ordered the Spianata, Nutella Calzone, and Tiramisu. I have to admit, the prices are on the higher side. However, if you’re looking to splurge a little, I’d suggest Posto as a go-to pizzeria over the chain stores around here. Leaving with two pizza boxes and a Tiramisu, the pizzaiolo reminded me to take good care of his precious dessert, cautioning me not to stack it on top of the hot pizza boxes. It was remarkable that, even while busy, he took the time to ensure his food was transported with care. The Spianata had those classic leopard spots, a true mark of a wood-fired pizza. The crust was light, and the ingredients blended perfectly. As for the Nutella Calzone, it’s filled with a ridiculously generous amount of hazelnut chocolate. It's insanely sweet—one slice would satisfy any sweet tooth! The Tiramisu had just the right touch of Amaretto for a light kick without being too boozy. The mascarpone was smooth and buttery, with no tanginess, and the cocoa dusting wasn't bitter. Overall, Posto is a hidden gem and a must-try for anyone who craves good pizza and appreciates quality. Remember to support local!

Amazing experience seeing the pizzas being made in the open kitchen. So clean you could eat the pizza off the floor. Warm friendly service but most importantly, the pizzas are a knock out. Will be back!
Food amazing & very good value for money. Generous portions & authentic. Sahil the manager most obliging & accomodating, deserves to succeed. Highly recommend.

Absolutely loved the food at Kebabiyas! Everything was fresh, flavourful, and well-prepared. I tried the mixed platter and the chicken wrap both were packed with authentic taste and generous portions. The meat was juicy and tender, and the sauces were delicious. Staff were friendly and quick with service. A great spot for anyone craving quality kebabs in Howick. Highly recommended I’ll definitely be coming back
Fresh, flavorful kebabs with juicy meat and perfect seasoning. Generous portions, tasty sauces, and quick, friendly service. Great value for money — highly recommended!

The chicken is on the verge of inedible due to the heavy handed cumin,salt & cardamon. The hummus, isn’t hummus - it’s thick, tepid tahini. Everything is over salted. Honestly - it is not at all good. I was disappointed. The system of digital order is also awkward. Not impressed.
We've been coming to Kebabiya for years for the meat on fries, but recently ordered the honey butter fried chicken for a party and everyone loved it! The owner is always super friendly too :)

Amazing Authentic Food! I had a great experience at this restaurant. It was my first visit, and I went with two friends. There’s plenty of parking right next to the restaurant, and the place is spacious enough for more than 20 families. The restaurant has beautiful decor, and the service was excellent. I’m a vegetarian, but my friends, who eats non-veg, also really enjoyed the food. The portion sizes were good too. We ordered: • 3 Lemon Lime drinks • Green Salad • Murgh Biryani • Paneer Lababdar • Daal Makhani • Masala Papad • Lachha Parantha • Kadhai Chicken • 2 Butter Naan The total bill was around $140, which was worth it for the quality and taste. We loved each item and will definitely visit again. Highly recommend trying this place!

Biggest issue is the lack of staff. On Mother's Day weekend, there was a group that just sat down in the nearest table and didn't get any acknowledgement until one of the group members finally had to stand up and call someone to take in their order after 30 minutes. They forgot items a lot. That is understandable when it's busy but being greeting and seated is so important at a restaurant.

An improvement from the previous restaurant, however the owner/manager needs to learn customer service is important. Under staffed with 3 servers only, taking orders, pouring drinks and cleaning. After spending well over $200 on dinner I was refused a cup of tea because "they were too busy".(The restaurant was half full) I have seen many restaurants come and go from this location. I hope the owner does not let his current success cloud his decisions. An enjoyable evening spoiled by the refusal to take an order for a cup of tea. When asked about this he said he was not bothered by my disappointment.

I can only say good things about this place. Te waiters were super kind, the food was awesome as well as the more than fair price. My wife and I come often to this place and it has been always fantastic!

oh my goodness I cannot rave enough about the food at this restaurant!!!!! Absolutely DELICIOUS!! If you go you have to try the lamb chops 🤤 although everything was outstanding! The cocktails were so delicious!! The staff were friendly and great at recommending dishes and the restaurant was clean and well decorated!! We will be back for sure!! 🤤
The food was super tasty, fresh and vibrant. The service was quick, fast, easy. And the atmosphere was nice, cozy, and warm. Overall a lovely experience and a must try!☺️

I ate here twice. The first time, I had beef nachos. It was 12 noon, and they had run out of sour cream. They came to my table to tell me, and we agreed to sub it for guacamole. It turned out very nice. The following morning, I returned and ordered bacon and scrambled eggs. I'm sorry but I did not like it. The bacon was murdered! The rashes were extremely dry and impossible to cut with the knife. The scrambled eggs were overcooked and rubbery. I didn't finish it. Almost uneatable. I definitely wouldn't order them again. Coffee is good enough but not memorable. Thank goodness the nachos were ok to help me give a half decent review.
My first time and everything was amazing. Friendly staff, and delicious food. The egg bene with salmon on hash cakes was good. Great coffee too.
Very nice busy atmosphere, service was very kind. Felt very welcome. Food was also amazing. Eggs were cooked perfectly and tasted great. Display of the food is also very fancy. Will return
One of the most amazing places I've eaten at here in New Zealand! All of their food came out looking as yummy as can be! Definitely big on presentation quality and flavor quality!

Good place for authentic Chinese cuisine. Tastes good and served quickly Their pork knuckle is delicious Lamb soup is really nice too Had them as leftovers the next night and still tasted amazing Service is good and they check on how your meal is going which is nice
I went with friends who wanted to try this place. I ordered spicy prawns, and it was delicious. My friends also said their food was tasty. The staff were friendly, and the service was good.

We came here first time with my family tonight. We ordered pickle fish soup, spicy prawns, cumin lamb and fried rice. The food were delicious and affordable. The staff here always pay attention to the customers and they serve food fast. We recommend it to anyone likes Chinese food.👍🏻

1st time at this venue, they have quite a large varied menu with typical Chinese dishes. We didn't book but were able to get a table easily as we were an early walk in, staff were very friendly and helpful and both our dishes, the black pepper beef and pork belly hotpot, were delicious

It was by chance that I happened to pass by this store and I was curious to see if it was the same as the one on Dominion road. I was so happy to see that they opened a new location so close to where I live and where I can bring my whole family. This place offers so much more in terms of space and variety. I enjoyed dining here and will be back again! I loved the food everything has such amazing flavour and super fresh. I bought my family here for the first time and they absolutely loved it. We got vegetarian dumplings, egg fried rice , beef noodle soup, spicy egg plant, garlic chicken. All dishes were cooked to perfection. However I noticed there was a table of people who were not dining but observing and taking notes with a laptop and staring at everyone who dined, I thought it was a little strange that they’d do that in the middle of the restaurant and gave an unpleasant vibe. The staff though, were wonderful they forgot a few things like my drink and sauces but they are still learning so nothing that can’t be improved. I would suggest they have a station for soy sauce and chilli sauce and larger bowls for sharing as they only had tiny bowls for us to share the soup. All in all I had a great experience and I’m sure it will be even better next time
Busy popular place for locals to catchup! Had a big breakfast, very yum! Friendly hard working owners! Cafes are backbone of local business!

Nice place. Good indoor and outdoor area. Friendly staff. Busy. We went on a sunny day so could sit outside with a dog and no hassles. And great value for a place of this quality Only problem is finding parking on a busy day. But that is a Howick issue, not this cafe
Love the food here. Ive been many times and everything has always been delicious. Prices are very reasonable and service excellent. Best cafe in the area in my opinion.

Now this cafe opens at 8:00, we can go there after the gym for a quick breakfast & coffee. Very impressed - the coffee was just right (nice and hot, and good quality). The food was pretty good too. Nice ambience, and north facing. We'll definitely be back again.
Sanjay and Mika always so welcoming. Great food and coffee and reasonable prices.

Sushi is fresh and delicious. I ordered some platters but wanted a couple of customized ones to suit the party I was hosting. The owner was happy to help and give suggestions, and the platters were perfect. Highly recommend!

Went to Aunt Lee for some Japanese food randomly on a Friday night. They have this promotion going which is $13.99 for some Don and noodles dishes. It was my first time there and I think the food was average to be honest, but for its special price, I guess it’s acceptable. I ordered the Korean beef Don and it has some thin sliced beef, rice and salad at the bottom. Won’t pay more than $13.99 for their food I would say.

Kind of pricey, I found the food to be pretty mediocre and over saturated with sauces and did not taste Japanese at all. The kitchen area the back was visible and I do think it needs some upgrade in hygiene. It was also freezing cold inside, wasn’t overly welcoming eat in experience on a cold winters day.
Aunt Lees have been a favourite for years now 😁 the fried prawns sushi so good and filling.

Best Fried prawn sushi I’ve had by far ! Always fresh too 🤤 even my son enjoys it I’ve been coming here once a week (most of the time) for a year and each time it’s been great and each time my son always asks me to bring him some home too lol ! The staff are so super lovely and friendly will highly recommend this sushi store thank you

So glad we decided to try The Roast Kitchen. We booked a table, we were the only table, six of us, but there was no lack of customers. (Note sit in area isn't huge so best check if you intend to dine-in) We had a great meal, we tried the pork, lamb and of course beef with Yorkshire pudding, what a treat! Delicious. All the meat perfectly roasted and crackling crackled. Btw all the photos loaded by Roast Kitchen are true to form. Thank you for a great 👍🏼 Saturday Roast 😉 Next visit Lamb shanks.

Firstly, this is the nicest & cleanest roast shop I've ever been in! The man and woman serving were super friendly and welcoming. My partner got a pork roll, chicken thigh and crispy but soft on the inside potatoes which were a 10/10. I opted for a small chicken roast meal, and swapped extra veggies for less chicken - which they were more than happy to do! I almost regret it now because the chicken was DELICIOUS. Crispy, juicy and so flavorful. We will definitely be back in the near future.

I absolutely love this place! Brilliant food, hearty and cooked to perfection. I just made a sneaky Uber order and The Roast Kitchen sent me a free apple crumble with a Merry Chirstmas note attached! Meety Christmas guys thank you so much.
Great quality spot. Had a decent sized order, some was off menu pure carnivore diet. No issues getting that sorted.
Best Roast place. The food is just lovely. I have been there a few times now. They give you plenty and you can eat in or take away. Well worth the 30 min drive there and back.
Best sushi around - love the sweet potatoes! Favourite sushi is the pumpkin one & also the seaweed sushi. Great friendly service every time.
Top quality sushi, great value, and selection. Service is very friendly

Really lives up to its name - very Yummy sushi! The variety of sushi here is truly unique, and we have never seen such good quality sushi elsewhere. The sushi is packed to the BRIM with filling, not just rice. The fried goods are not too oily and are perfectly crispy, and all for a reasonable price too. Customer service is also wonderful. We will definitely frequent this place!

We love the variety of fresh sushi here — have visited quite a few times since we moved to Howick. The staff are very friendly too and even made up a quick sushi selection for me when they had only just opened. A+
Really Yummy Sushi in Yummy Sushi！ Friendly staff！ 5 Star recommend.😊

We came here as a very large group with no booking and they kindly accommodated us with out a fuss. They food came out quick and was delicious. The waitress were constantly checking if we needed anything. Everyone loved their meal and we will 100% be back.

We were lucky enough to walk in with no reservation and grab a table outside in the sun tonight for dinner. The food was all incredible, so fast and so yummy. All the staff were great, super friendly and helpful! Will definitely be back again ☺️

We had some pretty good, authentic tasting Italian food here. It wasn't too crowded for a Saturday night. It took a little while to be served but once the fuss came it was great. In common with many places in NZ, but not all, a damn surcharge was placed on my credit card. Not good.
