Came back to Portofino in Howick and it was definitely as good as I remember. The drinks are amazing and the food is delicious especially the calamari. The service is first class as well. Highly highly recommend this place for a nice dinner out.

My wife and I really enjoy the atmosphere and service here. We order all the time, usually one of the breads or a couple of pizzas for takeaway. They are a bit on the expensive side, as are all the Portofino restaurants but this place is definitely the best in Howick when it comes to pizzas. The servers are great as well as the store manager, good work guys!

I had the Sunday Roast which comprised lamb and mint jelly, with roasted potato , kūmara, pumpkin together with brócoli , peas and long beans. The meat was ample and tender , the gravy rich, the vegetables not over done but cooked to perfection. At $20 for a small as shown in the photo it was exceptional value and I confess I struggled to finish the plate. I have been before and the large was simply way too much for me. A good selection of tap beers and I chose the Panhead IPA to accompany my meal. Good pub fare not pretentious but tasty and served promptly in good surroundings.

Outstanding pints of Guinness! 🍀 I spent 15 years in the UK so I know my pours and pipes. The decor is proper pub - loads of heavy wooden features, stained glass, cabinet curiosities and a lush crackling fireplace. The service is a bit all over the place but warm at heart and the regulars seem really at home. Sports on the screens and a hearty looking menu. The price of the pints will exclude my humble custom on the regular but when I can I’ll be back. 🥃

A band was setting up when we walked in to meet someone for a drink. A few diners. A few locals by the looks of it. We sat at a corner booth to were semi private to talk without being interrupted. Very pleasant visit.

Great place in Howick for a drink and a meal. Staff are friendly and great atmosphere. Parking is plentiful around the premise. They have various specials for different days of the week. Particularly love their Steak Night on Thursdays. Generous servings and very well priced. Ask for rare if you like your steak medium-rare.

Heard so much about the Steak & Guinness Pie that we had to try it out. Hubby had the large one, me the small. Both did not disappoint and both were ample servings. Flakey puff pastry sealed over the top of a bowl of steaming hot steak filling, served with crispy beer battered chips and a green salad. Tasty and very well-priced. Great pub, awesome staff.

This is my favourite place to grab sushi. You are always welcomed with the friendliest service, and presented with very fresh and tasty food. The chicken katsu sushi has always been our go to, as it is filled with fresh ingredients. Also appreciate getting the dumplings on the side too, really fat and juicy and full of flavor. 😇✨

Generous portions, friendly service and fresh ingredients! Great place to stop for a bite. There are a few seats inside but it’s more of a pick-up and take away spot so we prefer to take to the beach (3min drive). There is a limited selection of drinks (no Diet Coke or Coke Zero) but a wide range of healthy, fresh dishes. Worth a stop!

Sushi available for takeaway during lockdown. Party platter has a good variety of sushi and is good value for money. There are other options on the takeaway menu as well. I tried the bubble tea drinks, they were ok. I would recommend, sushi was fresh and tasty. They are open to special requests, so it pays to ask
Great food made fresh to order. 2 tables to sit at in the restraunt, however this place is great for takeaway. We got the chicken roll and a katsu curry! Highly recomment
The meal was extremely delicious. Dumplings were my favorite

Came in for breakfast and the amount of time it took for the eggs and pancakes to arrive given there was like 5 other people there is ridiculous- incredibly slow The scones weren’t fresh like they claimed they were toasted and not soft and fluffy - and $7 what a rip off. Almost 30 minutes for kids eggs on toast -what the actual. And the Oreo pancakes Took longer- definitely not returning here- best to ask - how long will the food take before ordering if you are planning a quick feed to start your day.

Great value and yummy! I felt like scrambled eggs and this did not disappoint. I got the eggs done your way (scrambled) and it was served on a bed of spinach with fresh herbs on top. A lovely rye bread with a side of butter. Great coffee too. Would come again.

We had the Chicken pasta which was quite nice and with good ingredient but the portion was on the small side. Also had the Biscoff Muffin and that was OK, very dry and crumbly. Service was slow though even though it was almost empty at the time. The fries took forever to come.

Awesome cafe in Howick. We ordered the Beef croquettes, Salmon Eggs Benny and a simple Cheese Toastie. All came out hot and at the same time. All were delicious, especially the Croquettes. My only negative was a few things I originally wanted were not available. We will be back
Amazing food, drink and service. Helpful friendly staff. Delicious crunchy fries. Nice vibe.
Love their food ,really friendly service ! All the sushi is fresh and so delicious. Definitely recommend to anyone.
Katsu bowls were delicious and made fresh. Huge portion too so definitely value for money.
Staff are rude, I would highly recommend aunt lees sushi around the corner instead they’re tastier too
Good food and friendly staff. Thanks
Great food & great friendly staff !

We ordered Veg. Schezwan rice & noodles, Chicken Schezwan rice & noodles & Veg. Manchurian. 5 items for $ 93, The quantity is good but the flavours are lacking. cuisine was Chinese, yet the fried rice tasted like biryani, and the noodles were plain and white. There was no egg in non-vegetarian foods. They are not making meals; they are simply combining a few ingredients here and there. Would not recommend it at all. Please check photos before ordering anything from here.

It's my favorite indian food place. The food is always nice, quick service, good deal price and friendly hospitality. BYO wine, but they also have the wine and beer selection menu. We had chicken tikka as a starter. Main dishes were butter fish, mango chicken, lamb rogan josh, and cheese naan. It was so delicious.

We had lamb biryani and Rogan Josh. Both were excellent. As a biryani hunter I can tell you it’s better than paradise biryani. Both meals had good amount of meat too. We will be back! Keep up the good work.

Food is always excellent our only go to Indian Restaurant in Auckland cant beat their butter chicken & Lamb Rogan Josh. Last night was nice to have Bhawani meet and greet us on a Monday night, with a big bright smile which is a must when you walk into a restaurant you noticed the warmth and welcome which always is a nice touch....Thanks Bhawani you should always be at the Front of House !!
One of the good authentic Indian restaurants in Howick. Loads of veg and meat variety to choose from. My favourite has been Mushroom Saag and Kadahi Chicken. Naans are super soft and freshly made.

Absolutely the best pasta inAuckland. Every pasta is packed with flavour and clearly made with real care – honestly, it puts most sit-down restaurants to shame. Just one wish: please open a proper dine-in spot! This food deserves to be enjoyed fresh, on a plate, with a glass of wine (or two). Takeaway’s great, but it’s simply not the same.
Absolutely stunning food, that you think about days later! Super yummy and authentic 💜💜💜

Food is fresh & made to order - so yummy! Portion size is spot on too. Bacon Cabonara is delicious! 😋 - perfect pasta, with the right amount of creamy sauce, bacon, mushrooms, seasoning👌😍 My man enjoyed his Chips & the Chimichurri Burger too - which they made to suit his taste buds coz he doesn't like pesto or pickled cucumber - thank you for that Amphora 😉 Looking forward to trying more of their lovely food.
Food was really tasty....I'm gonna tell my friends....you can see them making your food which I like
The best fish and chips

A bit disappointing as it was recommended by a friend. Fried rice was mediocre. Sweet & Sour pork was far too sweet and pork was tough. Combination soft noodles were very oily and bland. Best part was the 5 free deep fried wontons I got for spending over $37! Probably won’t go back.

HORRIBLE SERVICE AND FOOD IS DISGUSTING. I’ve never seen a takeout so overpriced with food so underwhelming. I ordered a sweet n sour pork as well as a serving of eggfuyong, and the total came up to $32. The eggfuyong is served as a flat salty omelette pancake on a PAPER PLATE. Lady was rude.

Best Wontons I’ve had in a long time! Great value, quick, chips were crispy & tasty, natural without food colouring (which I love). Chow mein was tasty with plenty of garlic & Broccoli, generous size portions and the family value packs made it quick to order by phone.
Great service, always serve with smile. Fish yum but little abit too oily, fried rice ok, taste great, rice little bit hard, overall great. Great price too.

Pricing is unbelievable for what you get - generous portions and very tasty! Dishes are well prepared and they have set specials to choose from. Many asian styled dishes and standard takeaway items to choose from. This place is a must try for those cold nights where you don’t feel like cooking or just want some comfort food without it being too greasy and heavy. You’ll also receive some free wontons too over a certain dollar spend!
Jeff is so lovely and makes incredible food! We've tried all the spring rolls & they are all delicious. My fave is the corn cheese - 10/10. Our favourite friday night treat!!
Loved the food! The massive spring roll (30cm!) was super crispy and delicious. Friendly service and great value—can’t wait to come back!

What a great idea! And the quality across the range of flavours is stunning. I can’t decide my favourite. The family all choose different favourites and shared. All flavours hit hard! Also the yuzu drink was so delicious! Thank you for the hospitality Jeff.

Had a great experience, went out with some friends to grab a bite. Was for sure amazing had been hearing bits and seeing lots online, was so worth it, definitely worth the drive. Amazing customer service, meet by the owner who is a lovely person who sharing his passion with the community

The spring rolls were so good, and the owner was so lovely to chat with! We got the apple pie, butter chicken and the KBBQ one and omg the apple pie one was sooooo good. It would be so good with some ice cream. Please don't make it limited edition, I'd miss it so much. The kbbq pork one was super good too! Tasted like the spicy pork you get at korean restaurants. My family gave the butter chicken a 10/10, they said it was super yum and tasted so much more authentic than they expected. He has a bunch of Korean snacks and candy too, we got the green grape candy he said was his favorite and honestly, its probably my favorite too now lol 10/10 would go again. Super keen to try the other flavours like corn cheese and japchae, can't wait to see new flavours come in too!
Ordered 1/2 size of fish and chips but a bit disappointed caused qty. less than before and too oily this time. Good price $5.5
First time in and we, our family of three, were impressed by the portions and flavours. Try this place for yourself and I imagine you won’t be disappointed.

Hard to get really good Chinese stir fry, but the dishes we tried from Wok were better than others we’ve tried in the area. Ordered beef with ginger and spring onions and chicken and veges. Beef in particular had a generous portion. Would definitely recommend.
Good value for money. Decent fusion Chinese food, do not expect them to be traditional tasting.
Eat there at least 3 times a week, quick cheap and tasty meals at budget pricing. The owners are vrey friendly too so that is a bonus.

This would have to be my most disatisfying roast meal i have ever eaten, the food was dry and tasted like it had possibly been sitting there for days. Just to topoff such a poor experience they charge more than normal prices.... would not recommend to anybody, do yourself a favor and go to the supermarket for a frozen meal rather than going to this place. Ended up throwing meal away about a quarter of the way through.

Ordered the large portion of roast beef the kumara is chewy and dry as not fresh at all, roast beef pretty much tasteless, with $28 I presume I was given a small portion wouldn't mind that because the food is disgusting anyway. not recommended.

Meat was really disgusting made me feel sick, tasted old. Yorkshire pudding microwaved and chewy and tough. If you’re gonna charge $23 for a medium make it worth the money. Gravy was so watery no flavour just heaps of pepper. Threw a lot of it in the bin.

This used to be my favourite roast spot until a couple of months ago where I got totally ripped off, they had run out of roast pork and I agreed to have roast lamb which was horrible bits and pieces, the potatoes were shocking did not get any pumpkin and for $30 I would’ve expected more so I have not been back!! do yourself a favour there’s one in Pakuranga and one and Howick they are both better value

Ordered a pork roll from uber eats horrible bread tasted like it was over heated in the microwave it was chewy and pork had no flavour and had way too much pepper for some reason worse pork roll I’ve ever tasted way over priced paid $19 should be $5
Egg fu Yong was good and friendly service but the fried rice was awful. Burnt, dry and no taste. Possibly the worst I've had in 20 years... Disappointing.
Large portions and good taste.

This is a local favourite in the area and I see why customers love coming here. The food is always cooked with high standards and the menu offers both European and Chinese traditional meals. Great value for money especially with kiwi 'Friday Night' traditions. Famous for their prawn cutlets and other delights. You can ring your order in for a pick up and you're instantly welcomed with a warm smile and food packaged neatly. I am very glad I found this place, it has become a great 'Go To' place to satisfy the takeaway cravings.
Never again. Ordered snapper.....not sure what we got but it wasn't snapper. Sweet and sour pork wasn't the best. Very sad for a pre Christmas treat.

Second visit to the store love the fresh vegetables and presentation of the dishes but the chow mein noodles so disappointing it was the fat almost biscuit noodles. What happened to being given a choice missed the proper egg noodles? I will go back but I will not be caught again

Ordered via the App, but there are no combo options online. Might need to call if you want a combo deal. We ordered a Butter Chicken, Chicken Korma, Beef Vindaloo and a Fish Masala for Mains. 4x Butter Naans and 8x Chicken Tikka Starters to share between 4x Adults and 3x Kids. It came with 2x free rice too. The food is such good value and tasty

I love it here. Their meal for two deal is such an incredible bargain! So filling and always consistently good! My boyfriend and I frequent this spot on a weekly basis. He’s even driven all the way from West Auckland where he stays just to get his East India fix. Lovely people, incredible food, awesome deals :)))

Amazing place. The Lamb Briani is soooo good. Try it with some Garlic Naan. Best is that they know how to tone down the spice. We palangi can't always handle true Indian spice, and they know how to make it flavourful without lightning your mouth on fire. (They can do that too, if you want)
Literally the worst chicken korma I’ve had in Auckland. It’s so sweet and lacks any curry flavour at all. Garlic naan has barely any garlic. Will never come back.

They increased the price by approx 15% throughout their menu. Who does this during a severe recession? Nowadays, they have reduced their portions of meat. Barely 4 or 5 small pieces of meat in one serving. Lots of rice given. No plastic utensils given. No napkins. Will ask hubby to find another Indian takeaway next time.

Nice fresh clean salad bar ingredients, The wraps look to be made in house, Nice chicken although the rotisserie didn't look too be running, chicken was being cooked on a hot plate. Still quite good. The result: a tasty fresh tasting kebab. The lamb is average though, like a luncheon and doesn't taste that great. The chicken seems more real. Will be back. Hopefully rotisserie running next time.

Great food, decent price, more suitable for takeaway, because they only have 3 bar stools to sit (a bit wobbly from loosen screws). All of us ordered small size, chicken rice and lamb kebab, definitely more than enough. Sorry didn't take any food photos. They cut the meat and store in containers but did heat them up on the hot ppaye for our orders. The Beetroot yoghurt was great! Will go back again!

Used to be amazing. Now $20 chicken salad has become a joke. Salad is fresh but now small and chicken is not what you would expect for that price. From great to very average. Not great value for money

**Food Quality** The ingredients were good and fresh, ensuring a high-quality meal. The portion size was satisfactory, offering good value for the price. **Ambiance and Cleanliness** The place was clean, but it lacked enough space for dining in, making it more suitable for takeaway. **Service and Staff** The staff were friendly and provided good service, adding to the positive experience. **Issues** One downside was that the paper used to wrap the food stuck to the bread, which was not fun and detracted from the overall experience. **Value for Money** Given the portion size, the price was reasonable and matched the quality offered.

The large All-In and Mixed Meat Kebabs were tasty, not overtly salty, and pretty large in size. The Lamb on Rice was also flavoursome and beautifully-dressed. Amazed at how a humble little corner shop could serve such sumptuous meals of generous helping, and at such reasonable prices. 10/10 would buy again.

Had my mums 60th last year (just figured out how to do a google review). Best place ever!!! Let us bring our own food, play our own music. We had pretty much full range of the place. Friendly staff, everyone was so impressed. Will definitely be there more
Great place to go for a game of pool after work. Looking a bit tired now days. Food has been hit and miss so we skip it now. Hopefully the new owners will turn things around.
Great bar with awesome food and friendly staff. Live music every week and plenty of big screens to watch sports on. Top notch spot.

$20 something dollars for this vege burger few bits of lettuce tomatoe and onions and the chicken burger had stale bread bun and the mushroom sauce tasted like old socks my daughter said NOT at all impressed for the price wont be back

We attended a 50th Birthday function here. It was a very large crowd and the staff handled everything like champion's!! They kept the food and drinks flowing all night, the diverse bar staff were very friendly and efficient, they had good food and their door staff were also very welcoming. Decor was very "sports bar", with plenty of seating, large screen for watching games, really enjoyed the pool tables and had a variety of seating options. All round great experience 👍

First time visiting. It was so nice to meet the previous owner who is Ara-Tai Cafe in Half Moon Bay. The atmosphere is nice and it's not too far from home, so it seems like a great place to brunch. The food is delicious and I'm planning to bring a friend.

Great place that accommodates the whole family. Food and drinks were amazing and vibes were great. The sauce on my burger was to die for. Staff was very friendly and the kids were happy to be playing outside on their scooters. Definitely going back again.
Delicious breakfast, good service. A bit odd that dogs are allowed through the restaurant to outside restaurant; particularly for people with dog and fur allergies or phobias.

Pleasantly surprised. All food was beautiful. First time our very large family including kids finished everything on our plates. Milkshakes , iced coffee and hot drinks were actually delicious . Have never heard comments about drinks by some family members .. but today I did ! And top notch service. All staff were so attentive to everything. Highly reccomend! Thank you team made our family members birthday brunch Even better 🙂

Fabulous place with great selection of Beer, Cocktail and food menu. Deliciously tasting food with good portion sizes. Lovely staff who provide great service here. Seating can be outside or inside. Best place in the area compared to Pine Harbour eatery and Bar opposite side. Don't go there and only go to Pepperjacks. Other places are super loud music noisy. We loved local Manaia Beer, Happy hour cocktails and food here. Surely will visit again if we are near this area.

I've been ordering from Dominos Beachlands for quite a while now and I've only ever had a good experience! Maybe on the very rare occasion with a delivery something like a drink might have been missed but they always make it right and bring the missing item asap or offer a refund on it... I've never had an issue with my pizzas and I've ordered hundreds of them over Dominos Beachlands lifetime and every staff member plus the owners are very friendly and welcoming even delivering in the worst weather conditions and on many days that other business are closed nothing but love from me for the Domino's Beachlands team.
Very anger worker, no respect and patience. Food was good but didn’t feel happy nor safe. Will be going to Pizza Hut!

From order to delivery, the communication was spot on as we are camping at the regional park— clear updates, accurate tracking, and prompt arrival. The driver was polite and professional, and the pizza arrived hot and fresh, exactly as ordered. Great service all round!
I ordered classic cheese pizza and they gave me very thin crust cheese tomato gravy pizza most of the sides were burn

Quite possibly the worst food and customer service I have ever recieved from a store, staff and owner. We received undercooked pizzas. When returning them to the store (after paying for delivery) I was confronted with "we're to busy to sort this now, we can look into it tomorrow" "it's not possible for it to be undercooked" "we need to investigate, can look into a refund tomorrow". NO! My pizza was undercooked, tacky and soggy in the middle. What amazed me is if you can quite clearly see that the pizza dough is undercooked, why would you not apologise for the error and offer to recook them? End of story everyone is happy. But that wasn't the case, instead I was made to feel like an idiot, I had to fight to be listened to and get a refund for something that very obviously wasn't edible, No I won't be buying from them again.

Busy and they need more staff to clean and clear tables. All the tables were dirty or sticky and needed wiping. Coffee was good but took ages. Food was counter food, the cooked breakfast looked good. Just need to invest in another head count and the guests would have a better experience. Friendly staff and nice atmosphere 👌
Lovely place to eat, but it took a long time to get food out to us. And forgot two coffees. Will go again.❤️
Very nice Cafe. Excellent for those brunches of afternoon coffees. Spacious and clean. Staff are friendly and efficient. Heaps of parking. Only gripe I have was the menu was very limited.

It was honestly the worst breakfast dish I have ever had. I have gone to so many cafes previously and this is by far the worst. I ordered avocado on toast and not only was the bread just plain toast that is easily purchased at the supermarket, but the poached eggs were so sour because it was overcooked in vinegar. The avocado spread on the toast were the pre-made avocado spreads found at supermarkets. I am beyond disappointed, they do not know how to cook.

Love the roasted mushrooms with polenta chips. Nice coffee too but the staff could use some customer service training like smiling friendly faces behind the counter & coffee machine, not looking like you really don't want to be there, even if it is true and, how to service tables...Service 101 never reach over customers to deliver food & beverages or to clear away.

Pizza Hut has replaced Beach Pizza, located right next to Joe’s Barbershop. Very happy with our meal from here, great pizza at good prices. The chips are really yum, almost as good as Skyhorse chips! Service was friendly and quick.

Newly opened store. Pizza Hut is always a solid pizza outlet. Their phone seems permanently engaged/not hooked up, but it was easy to just walk in and order. I couldn’t order online because there was no option to change the sides on the Limo Pizza. Only fries were selectable. Overall a good experience. I’m sure this will be a welcomed addition to the community.

I wanna share one of my experience. I have ordered some of the things from the pizza hut Beachlands. The staff was so cooperative and even they helped me out get my pizza. The pizza was hot and the service of the staff was very good. The store was clean. At last I liked the beachland store of pizza hut.
Really good service got my pizza on Sunday and it took only 6 minutes really good and fast
Absolutely delicious! Easily one of the best pizzas I’ve had in a while.
This is the best Korean chicken I've had in New Zealand. There are many different types and the fried chicken is the best, so any flavor is delicious. I highly recommend it.
Wow! Just wow! Got the Korean spicey 1/2 chicken. It came as massive boned out pieces of crispy chicken perfectly cooked with an amazing hot 🔥 Korean sauce. Not too hot, just spot on! My new go to
First time order Takeaway chicken, it’s Nice! truly same as the Brand. Highly recommend!

Bangin’ crunchy Korean fried chicken with authentically earthy, spicy & saucey PUNCH 🥊 Go hot - cause the hottest ain’t that hot - it’s PERFeCT🔥 The staff are friendly, chill professional and fast. All the little touches are considered - perfect packaging, wipes, toppings and they gave us a free crunchy chicken taster - so good you get hooked on their chook and gotta get some. Classy service 🤌 We loved stopping in for a bite by the beaches.

I highly recommend this place. Their chicken is crispy, tender, boneless, non-greasy and seasoned perfectly. The additional of the sauces make it even tastier. Honey soy garlic was my favourite. 'Mu' in the menu (which is a radish pickle) goes soooo well with the chicken. Slaw was nice too. Staff was friendly and there are lots of parking. I'm definitely going back again!
Bad experience. Cold order Over paid for garlic chips = 1 pump of sauce Recommend - Skyhorse around the corner

Best place for burgers on the coast. Always packed full of flavor and decent salad. Staff are always so lovely. Recommend calling in advance on a Friday to avoid the que which just goes to show how good their food is as the locals are always lining up for friday/Saturday night takeaways.

We love our burgers and when we saw the name burger shack we thought these guys would know a burger. Unfortunately not. Mexicano chicken featured a deep fried battered wafer thin slice of chicken that we couldn’t eat. Tasteless. My works burger was equally tasteless with thin processed patties . We gave it one star as chip portion was generous and they were hot. We won’t be back.

If I knew the garlic chips were chips with a dollop of garlic margerine on top I wouldn't have ordered them, but I enjoyed them nonetheless. For the burger I would prefer if they put a bit more cash towards quality and then charge more, it was well prepared and fresh just the beef was a tad too similar to factory patties for my taste. Everything else was good.

We got their fish and chips and usually in all fish and chips takeaways u get some kind of sauce and atleast half a lemon but there was nothing in our takeaway. We went to the beach and it was like eating unsalted version of F&C. It was okay bcoz we were hungry but didn’t really enjoy it. 3 stars.
Always surpasses my expectations. Still good value and so tasty
Food was very nice and fresh. Good prices for fish and chips.
Good price, good hot dis, delicious donut, chips a little oily.
Another fabulous meal from sky horse takeaways, lovely food, generous proportions, great value for money.
Cannot get enough of the bbq pork wonton soup 🍜

Everything was fantastic, from the start with the papadams (not too salty), to the Pakoras (so flavourful), the Onion Bhajis (yum) and our main curries. They were prepared to our requested level of heat and just the right amount of sauce for our excellent naan bread and rice.

Ordered takeaways. After an hour waiting still no food. When we inquired they could not tell us where our order was. The guy we spoke to, was rude, didn't care and told us to ring the manager who wasn't even in the restaurant. Wanted to support local but won't bother again. Will stick with my normal in the future which is Foreshore in Maraetai.
Great food with amazing staff and we eat always there and highly recommend
Great food

We came after a local, family members recommendation. The prices were reasonable and the menu was full of interesting combinations of culinary delights. Not only was the food well presented it was extremely flavoursome. Served quickly and still pipping hot. We had a glass of nice, quality house wine, Served in a nice large wine glass. Just what we needed for a birthday dinner treat. We travelled a long way from home but will definitely make the trip again with the whole family. Thank you to the hosts and staff.

We recently moved to Beachlands and had several good value meals there and all of them were nice and tasty. Some of the pastries offered are very nice and the New York Cheese cake really stands out . The roast dinners on Sunday night are a nice home cooked experience, very tasty and again excellent value. The service provided is unobtrusive and nothing is too much for Sudeep always very friendly and helpful. All I can say “never judge a book by its cover”!!

Fantastic that they have vegan options alongside other foods, so everyone can have a great meal together. Vegan pizza was super filling and everything very well priced. Sweet options in the cabinet included a few vegan options too, which was great. Pic of the last of the pizza before it was all gone!

We can't say enough good things about this restaurant. We ate there more than any other place in Beachlands. Food was always great. Nice atmosphere and friendly staff. We travel the world full time and this place had some of the best Lamb Rogan Josh I've ever had. My wife loved the Salmon Risotto dish as well. As you can see by the pics, we ate there a few times. Well worth the visit if you're hungry and in the area.

I was very disappointed with the quality of food as their reviews were fantastic. I ordered a calamari salad & I had to leave the most of it. Was a chef different on the night we visited? I must say that a butter chicken dish was great though. I recommend you to order Indian dishes in this restaurant.

Great location by the ocean. Health & safety concerns no hairnets or gloves for preparation of meals. Taco chicken wasn’t cooked well. I was in Sunkist to Celebrate 🎊 Canada 🇨🇦 Day On July 1st 2025 Beachland Auckland. Ordered cocktails, appetizer and Main( Taco shrimp, fish and chicken). Called the waitress Lily and Manager Sarah showed her but for them didn’t seem BIG deal. Took off Chicken Taco off my bill. Thai food next door was much better and tasty. Highly recommended to try it and great customer service .

Heads up check to make sure your meal is cooked properly before taking a bite. Went to 🎉celebrate🎊Canada 🇨🇦in Sunkist Beachland Auckland NZ. Had few cocktails and Taco (Shrimp, fish and chicken) shrimp and fish Taco was good but chicken wasn’t cooked properly. Waved Waitress Lily showed her and spoke to Manager Sarah. They were not Really concerned just took off chicken Taco off our bill. It was our second time eating there and personally it’s my last time.

Great atmosphere. Sometimes service is a little slow but more often than not very good. Some dishes better than others. Muscles not so great - many but dry. Not much sauce. No bread. Suggested to buy a loaf of garlic bread which is overkill for one

Wow, the "Steak Night" was fantastic. Normally my wife does not allow me to order steak, as 99 times out of 100, the chef does not know how to cook it, or it has not been aged, or the thickness is inconsistent I.e thick at one end and thin at the other. And I complain about it. However, I was pleasantly surprised as the friends I went with talked the restaurant up. We got there around 7 pm, and the place was buzzing, a really good atmosphere with locals obviously supporting this restaurant. The steak was spot on, asked for medium rare, and received a good sized portion of a very tender medium rare scotch fillet with mushroom sauce. Fries and a fresh garden salad finished of a simple but great meal. Yes, i took the time to go and thank the team in the kitchen for a great meal. My friends tell me Taco Night is also well worth going to, so I reckon my wife and I will have to make the journey North from Hamilton to do just that. 100% recommend this restaurant. Oh, one of our friends is celiac, and they were able to cater for her with GF fries and GF Salt and Pepper squid.

Went here for dinner on 19/3/22. Great local eatery. Lovely service. Loved the Garlic Bread entree. Ordered a Beetroot and Feta Salad which was nice. My desert was also nice, was impressed with The presentation of the Cheesecake 😁 Also the Cosmopolitan I got was yummy. Had to order two!! 😅👍
Weekend well spent! Delicious food and a beautiful view overlooking the marina—couldn’t ask for more.

The weather was wet, windy and cold. The good and service was great as was our company. We had lots to talk about with our friends that we had not seen for a while. The wooden seats became too hard but mostly it was a cold place as they wanted the doors open to the tables outside in the covered in area. Therefore we asked for a heater to be put on but it did little use. We will therefore only go back when the weather is better.

5 stars for Pine Harbour! Every dish was incredible. Wonderful and friendly service from everyone working at the restaurant. The XO Chilli Fried Rice was the star of the show - it will blow your mind! What a fantastic restaurant with great views! Doggies are allowed in the outside area!

Disappointing when a group head out for dinner as visiting from Christchurch. Service was average apart from one of the waitress she was lovely . Misleading looking at the menu for the lamb shank which was not what i had imagined when it arrived to the table , the food was bland minimal serving for the dish , maybe a teaspoon of mash if you are lucky . Items on the receipt were not to what was ordered IE we didn’t have a milkshake but was charged for this . $292.00 for the bill the owner is rude she was not even interested in what we felt about the service she was just there to collect the pay check at the end . WILL NOT BE BACK AND WILL NOT RECOMMEND THIS RIP OFF PLACE

Edited Oct-2024: I’ve been here a few times now, for dinners and lunch. My favourite dish is the XO Fried Rice - it’s got a spicy kick to it but is totally delicious. One of the best fried rice dishes you can get locally! The crispy pork on the small plates menu is super yummy, and the miso glazed salad on the side is mouth-wateringly good!! The mussels (also on the smalls menu) are great, make sure you get garlic bread to mop up the yummy green curry sauce at the bottom of the pot. The beef massaman curry is amazing, as is the roti bread 🤤 The ribs are tender and yummy although the sauce may be different to what you’re used to - it’s still good though. The location is stunning (you can’t beat it on a nice day) and the staff are always attentive and friendly. Nice to discover another good local eatery!

Friendly, helpful (and beautiful!) waitress. The chef came out and spoke to us and explained the menu. Our meal was superb, wish they made Butter Chicken like that in Napier! My friend LOVED his hot Lamb Nawabi. I enjoyed watching the Bollywood dancing on the big screen. Large portions so we could take some home. Thank you Urban Spice, we loved it!

Large and clean eating area, there is a large TV so I was watching some Indian music videos (always a good time). The portions sizes I was happy with and the flavour are probably the best you are going to get in Auckland. Well worth the visit!!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ A Perfect Spot for a Celebration & Authentic Indian Delights! I recently booked Urban Spice in Beachlands for my twins’ birthday party, and I couldn’t have been happier with the experience! From the moment we walked in, we were welcomed with warm hospitality and a cozy ambiance that made us feel right at home. The food was absolutely delicious—every dish was packed with authentic flavors, from the rich curries to the perfectly cooked tandoori. The menu offers a fantastic variety, and everything we tried was fresh and full of flavor. What truly stood out was the exceptional service—the staff was incredibly friendly, attentive, and made sure everything ran smoothly. Whether you’re dining in or ordering takeaway, Urban Spice delivers a top-notch experience. Highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for quality Indian cuisine in Beachlands. Thank you to the Urban Spice team for making our celebration special—I can’t wait to come back! Navneet

We had a great meal tonight. The food was delicious and generous and full of flavour. The staff were friendly and attentive and nothing was too much when the kids spilt their drink. Thank you Urban Spice, we will be back again. .
Fantastic food and a great atmosphere. Very friendly owner and extremely helpful. Looking forward to our next visit when we drag the rest of our family along.
Pretty good food. Portions are small though and we have been twice and both times our order has been incorrect. Best to check before leaving the store.

I would suggest you avoid the previous negative reviews. This place is perfectly good for a cheap and easy take away! We ordered on the phone and the food was ready quickly, hot and was decent quality. Not anything to complain about and friendly service. :)
Small but hygiene shop. Amazing foods. Taste good. Not pricey. Mostly takeaway but a few tables available for diners in. Try again next time.
Fantastic spicy fried tofu and ditto veggie fried rice. Fast and efficient service and not expensive. Do it! 😊
We ordered a chicken cashewnut meal. Food was absolutely horrible. No sauce no flavour. We didn’t eat this and had to throw it out as it looked microwaved. do not recommend at all!

As an Italian, this was the best pizza I had in Auckland. Same as you would get in Italy, easy to digest and fair price. The dessert menu is great with all homemade dishes. Didn't try the pasta or appetizers. The owners were really nice as we had a chat after dinner. 100% recommended.

Absolutely worth the trip! Even though I live far from this restaurant, I’ll definitely be coming back. The food is simply incredible, with authentic Italian flavors that stand out in every bite. The atmosphere is warm and inviting, and the staff go above and beyond to make you feel welcome. It’s a true gem, and I’m more than happy to make the journey to enjoy it again!

I have eaten a lot of good pizzas in Italy and in NZ, but this might have been the best I have eaten in my life. I tried the gatto e la volpa and can't describe the feeling of how good it felt. Topped it up with a great tiramisu after. Bravo ragazzi keep up the good work💪

Pinocchio is a must-visit for authentic Italian cuisine! I had the Pizza Prosciutto e Funghi, and it was perfect—light, crisp crust with fresh, flavorful toppings. For dessert, the profiteroles were divine, with velvety cream and rich chocolate sauce. Great food, cozy atmosphere, and excellent service—highly recommended!

Italian food isn’t my favourite, but that aside it was a very good experience. I found the staff very helpful and the premise very clean. I did turn up when it opened at 5pm. The food was well presented and delicious. It’s a very good venue. Cleanliness was a plus here.

Subject: Feedback Regarding Incorrect Order and Delivery Experience Dear Domino’s Team, I am writing to share our recent experience with your store, in the hope that it can help improve your service and staff training. A few days ago, we placed an order for our daughter’s birthday celebration. We ordered a chicken and vegetarian pizza, and while the delivery arrived on time, we were disappointed to find that one of the pizzas was a Meat Lovers pizza instead of chicken. As we do not consume beef or pork for religious reasons, we could not eat it. We contacted the store immediately to report the issue and requested the correct pizza. To your credit, your team responded quickly, and we were appreciative that you sent a replacement pizza along with some chips as a gesture of goodwill. However, the second part of the experience was unfortunately distressing. When the delivery driver arrived with the replacement, my daughter answered the door. The driver insisted on retrieving the incorrect pizza before handing over the new one. My daughter asked him to wait at the gate while she went to get it, but he followed her up to the doorstep, which made her feel uncomfortable and intimidated. Once she handed the pizza back, he asked who would be paying for the chips. My sister then stepped in and explained that the chips were part of the compensation offered by the store due to the original mistake. Surprisingly, the driver then began asking whether we were going to leave a Google review. He repeated the question multiple times, which felt inappropriate and unprofessional. I eventually came to the door and told him politely that whether or not we leave a review is entirely our decision. My sister called the store afterwards to report the delivery driver’s behaviour, but the response from the staff was not very helpful. She asked for the contact details of someone in higher management, but was told they didn’t know. We understand that it was a busy and difficult day with poor weather conditions, and we appreciate how hard your staff work. Mistakes can happen, and a simple apology would have been more than enough. We genuinely want to support local businesses during these challenging times, but it’s important that your staff, especially delivery drivers, receive appropriate training in customer service. Thank you for taking the time to read this feedback. We hope it’s taken constructively and that steps are taken to ensure similar issues don’t occur in the future.

Went in an hour ago and ordered the nibbles and chips pack which are now $19 they were $12 and gradually price started rising as my daughter went in to order it and it's the same quantity as the $12 packs were. I would not even rate this 1 star but had to make an entry to put my review in. This is shocking!!

Food is okay not a fan of their nibbles... they have different varieties of food to order from... fish & chips, Nibbles, burgers you name it. My favourite meal to order is their $7 combo which is 2x Hamburgers and Chips. I go there just to order that LOL
Been awesome for YEARS! Still the same old Aunty taking orders for the last 10yrs or more and the food is always yum! Interior is lack lustre but it has its own charm

I've been going to silver Bell since I was a teenager and I'm now 35 years old. The woman who owns the place is one of the most emotionless people I've ever had to deal with in a takeaways. She doesn't smile, she doesn't speak to you, she judges you if the self service is over filled slightly. The food is good which brings me back.
Delicious!!! Best Chinese takeaway out west hands down iv moved further out but will always travel for this food!!! 10/10 crinkle cut hot chips 👌🏽
Since I was a kid,many years later not much has changed, Best fish & chips store out west,food comes with memories 🤗 always good service, West siiiide

Been a customer here with family and friends all our lives. Good family that run it. Very clean, and affordable. Big fan of their Chicken fried rice. Its not BURNT like some outlets we have been too over the years, they cook to order NOT REHEAT their food. They always remember their long time customers which is really good. We always come back - highly recommend them!!!!🥰❤💯💛💥💚💢💙💫💜👍😘 Great family that owns the superette next door too #Greathardworkingpeople🤗👌

The food is always fresh and hot, tasty, wait time is good. Cool that they have Chinese smorgasbord as it's getting hard to find them these days. I've eaten here for over 4 years and never gotten sick. Same owners over this time.... support the local fish and chip shop before a big corporation! Happy eating!

This place is my go-to spot everytime I’m in west Auckland! Chicken nibbles always bomb asf, love the fries and THE GRAVYYYYY, I be drinking it like it’s nothing!! This was my childhood takeway! Forever coming back just to eat all those nibbles! This store better not shut down ever! It’s been up for years even after moving out of town! I love this place so much, yall don’t even know how much it means to me! :) #bigbackhome
Not going there again. The chips, nibbles & potatoes was dry & taste like it was refried!! Terrible I want my money back!!!!

👎👎👎 to $17 fish bites and chips special no.7 🙅‍♀️🙅‍♀️🙅‍♀️ The fish fell apart like it was old, the batter was thicker than the fish. Chips looked like the oil needed changing, and the ratio of chips to fishbites didn't balance. Far more batter on the fish than there was chips. Customer service was patient with me, but the food wasn't enough to entice me to return.
Chicken had weird smell. Second time. Went an told the old lady to eat. She said no no, Must have turned vegan for cooking food like that. Got money back but not going there again,

If this is the place that I think it is...My go to place for wings and chips. For $13 you get 15 wings? and a scoop of chips. May not be healthy, but by god I love them. They also sell a bunch of other things like roast chicken, roast potatoes, lamb ribs and popcorn chicken, but every time I go there I seem to gravitate over to wings and chips. I actually want to give this a 4.5 start because sometimes the wings are cooked slightly too fast. Give it an extra minute or two to make it more golden brown. Other than that...see you this weekend!

Waited 45 min for mixed mini kebab and a 3 piece pack the place wasnt busy so im not sure why the long wait. The only reason i gave 2 stars was because the food is nice otherwise it would be a 1. those wait times are way to long
Friendly staff and great service. Their broast is the best in Swanson, West Auckland
Amazing kababs, must try chips! (generous with the chicken salt 😊)
Bit over zealous with the chilli other wise good
Excelent service and yammy food...

Called in for a takeaway dinner. I was the only customer at the time, so service was prompt. Ordered a large mixed meat meal on salad, with mint satay and garlic yogurt dressings. Humus came with the meal, and sliced gherkins were included in the salad (a nice touch). Overall portion size was good. Meats were tender with good ratio to salad. I would have given 5-star rating for the meal, but it was let down slightly with indistinguishable flavours for the dressings and an overall sweet taste which was due to sweetened gherkin slices being used in the salad, whereas sour gherkins slices would have been better imo.

Very yummy burgers and spicy fried chicken. The burgers (Premium Beef and Spicy Chicken Fillet) were juicy, well cooked and tasty. The spicy fried Chicken was juicy, hot and yummy. We enjoyed the Creamy Mango Boba as well. Highly recommended!
Amazing customer service and the chicken was soft and tender but crisp and a hint of spice. Felt welcoming and friendly. Would love to cone back🥰

Amazing food, fried chicken in all forms. Popcorn, strips, wings and thighs - Crispy chicken fillet burgers w/spicy options & beef options too - Kebabs are great size and heaps of options for topping and meats w/Fish & Paneer - Meat on Rice w/pop corn chicken as an option - Sides of Potato n Gravy, Slaw & Bread rolls - Family packs from $17.90 - $53.90 - Best spot in HENDO!
Used to affordable place to eat out, I can make the same quality at home why would bother to buy from her. Very easy to cook chicken nibbles and kebab at home
Found melted gum smushed to the lid of my butter chicken shown in photo below , food tastes good but their hygiene is highly questionable.

I used to order food here a few years ago and the quality was always great. We ordered dinner tonight and it wasn't very nice. The chicken tika masala was VERY sweet, like they must chuck a heap of sugar into it, which tasted disgusting. You can't taste any other flavour. The vege korma used to be various veges cut and put into the curry. Now it's frozen mixed veg. Really disappointing at the food here used to be excellent

Absolutely amazing! Staff are great and nice, food is FANTASTIC! We found this takeaway otw to buy pizza but we decided to try the butter chicken and bought 1. The amount of chicken is A LOT, soup and naan were also yum. For its price it’s SOOO worth it! We inhaled the food and went back to buy two more and we about to inhale them again :))

I should have read the reviews first. DO NOT ORDER FROM HERE. Had the worst butter chicken; asked for medium and it had no spice what so ever, and was really watery and not the typical orange colour - this one was more yellowy. Rice was also overcooked, mushy and sticky. How does one mess up rice? The only thing I enjoyed was the naan, but won't be ordering just for naan Was so bad, I didn't finish it and it went into the bin. So sad wasting food, but when it's like this....
The service here is amazing the staff are fast and friendly but most of all their butter chicken is so delicious. And top it off their all day deal $10 is amazing price and filling.
The chinese sweet and sour pork and chicken chow mein was excellent. Can't fault this at all, highly recommend.
These guys have been here for ages! Great food good prices. Thanks for keeping us all fed!

Nice shop was clean place to site while waiting didn't take long from order to serve. Hawaiian burger was good pattie was very thin but was only $5.50 taste good. Potatoe fritters were really big very happy with them fish was nice good size fillet.
Always grab my fish burgers and the 7$ special from here. They are great. Highly recommend. Chicken nibbles are yum too.
I don’t pay $20 to get a container of food barely filled.

Been living in Australia for 8 years, finally went home for a taste of good food! Can't believe the owner still remembered me !! The food really hits the spot. Egg foo young, chicken chow mein and BBQ pork fried rice tray is 💯 money for value. See you in June !! 😁

Below Average. Was our go to for years for the love & care they used to put into their food. Progressively gone down hill. Gave the benefit of that doubt over past 18mths but has become clear there is no love or care no more in the food cooked & served. Tasteless, unappetizing & expensive. Sorry but our love, care, loyalty & custom will too be no more.

Really disappointed!!! As an environmentalist that they advertise having a bin in store to compost ALLLL the coffee cups ... but they have NO Bin. Don't Advertise something and claim to be environmentally caring when your obviously noT
DONT ORDER ICE CREAM FROM HERE THEY DONT EVEN BOTHER TO GIVE A REPLACEMENT AND THEY HAVE ANYTHING IN STOCK!!!!
Coffee excellent and muffin big and nice
Poor costumer service. Encountered a very rude woman at the counter tonight. I don’t think she enjoys her job that much. 🤮

I had an absolutely amazing experience at Pocha Chicken. From the moment I walked in, the staff were welcoming, attentive, and genuinely friendly — 100% service all the way. The food was phenomenal. The Korean fried chicken was crispy, juicy, and perfectly seasoned. Every bite was packed with flavor, and the sauces were spot-on. You can tell they really care about quality. The atmosphere was vibrant and cozy at the same time. Whether you’re out with friends or just grabbing a casual dinner, the vibe is energetic but still relaxed. Overall, Pocha Chicken delivers a full package — excellent service, mouthwatering food, and a fun, welcoming atmosphere. Highly recommend and definitely coming back!
The food is served quickly and tastes great. Although it is located in a gas station, the taste is better than many professional fried chicken restaurants.

Parking was easy as it's inside a gas station. But disappointing experience. Would avoid going if I were you. There are many better options available so don't waste your money here. Waited 35 minutes for my chicken and it was 30%~40% skin with batter. And the large option was smaller than expected. It's a minibox. If you like meat, this place is not for you. I ordered the creamy onion and had no flavour at all. The Jalapeno sauce was really good but like the creamy onion, it had too much chicken skin+batter and it felt disgusting after some point. It's a shame because the staff was kind but the food was terrible. I wish I didn't go there 😢

I placed an online order at 12:40 and was told it would be ready by 12:58. We arrived on time, but the food wasn’t ready. The staff member said it would be another 10 minutes, but it was clear she had just started cooking—our order took more than 20 minutes from when we arrived. I specifically ordered plain rice cakes, but was given rice cakes with sauce. When I politely questioned it, she insisted she couldn’t change the recipe. I’ve ordered plain rice cakes before—both at Mt Wellington and through Uber Eats—and never had an issue. To make things worse, we got home and found the wrong chicken was packed—we ordered honey soy sweet but were given something else entirely. The chips were soggy and tasted like they’d been reheated. Overall, the food was disappointing and the customer service was just as bad. This experience was a complete waste of time and money. Definitely won’t be ordering from here again. Stay far clear from this place.

The chicken was nice tender and juicy. But rhe garlic and butter overpowered the taste of the chicken. It was still really yummy, the fries were perfect and the sauce was amazing. It was just the chicken being overpowered by the garlic and the butter, maybe if there was less butter. The flavour would be balanced but there was just too many flavours being combined eliminating the natural taste of the chicken.

The salted caramel frappe is super tasty! This icy cold drink has just the right mix of sweet caramel flavor and a little touch of saltiness. It tastes amazing and you'll want to keep sipping it. The friendly staff member who hands it to you with a big smile makes the whole thing even better~

Disappointing Experience with Food and Uber Eats Order I'm extremely disappointed with my recent visit to GAS Brick Street. I waited for 2 hours for a chicken bowl, which was unacceptable. To make matters worse, I also tried to order through Uber Eats, but they failed to refund an item on my order. The customer service was horrible, and it seemed like my concerns fell on deaf ears. As a customer, it's frustrating when businesses don't prioritise timely service and accurate order processing. If you're considering visiting GAS Brick Street, be prepared for long wait times and potential issues with food orders. You might want to explore other options in the area.

Just like to mention the wonderful customer service i always receive from a certain employee (Helpy) I hope the name is spelt right...lol Always greets with a warm smile, friendly and courteous. keep up the good work..!
Customer service was very good and efficient very good workers on tonight thank you JD for the experience bro keep up the good work

i go to this gas station every week and ima big fan on chocolate , and brick street gas station sells a snickers frappe for a good price for the taste of the drink , and the idea of a snickers frappe is very nice.

I went to this restaurant with my family and friends for birthday, ordered some pastas, pizzas and others. The service is pretty great especially the food is amazing! I would go there again someday! ☺️

La Porchetta – A Must-Try Hidden Gem! 🍝🍰 From the moment we arrived at La Porchetta, the vibes were warm and welcoming—like stepping into an upgraded version of Denny’s, with cozy, homestyle dinner booth seating that makes you want to settle in and stay a while. We kicked things off with an Iced Chocolate and a jug of L&P—so cold, crisp, and refreshing. The perfect start to a meal! My girl ordered the classic Spaghetti Bolognese, and let me tell you, she absolutely loved it. You could see it in every bite and every smile 😋 I had the Pollo e Avocado—a creamy, rich, and oh-so-satisfying pasta that hit all the right spots. It was so fulfilling I didn’t think I had room for dessert… but of course, dessert happened! We shared a slice of Mango Cheesecake, and honestly, mmmmmm is all I can say. It was smooth, rich, and literally melted in my mouth—like a tropical dream. La Porchetta has officially earned a spot on our list of favorite go-to places. I’ll definitely be back with family and friends. Amazing food, relaxing vibes, and a menu that leaves you craving more. Highly recommend! 🙌

April 2025 We had lunch with a close friend and her toddler. Both Jo and Anshul made sure it was a memorable first-time dining experience for my friends. La Porchetta Henderson has a children's $3 pack with crayons and colouring in pictures. That was well received. And then the warm and friendly smiles from Jo as she shared with us what popular pasta dishes were ordered the most and as she kindly took our order. My friend said she felt right at home because of your warm hospitality Jo. The food is great, however, it's people like you Jo that make it a memorable experience and you get repeat customers coming back for more. Keep up the amazing customer service. ♥️🙏 March 2025 We celebrated my mother's birthday with my family. Thank you to duty manager Anshul and colleague Raed who provided exceptional customer service and were very attentive to our requests. We appreciate you both and your team's efforts to make it a special celebration for us 🫶👏

Have frequented this joint since few years. Pasta and pizza are delicious, very good vegan options although a bit pricey so we keep it for special occasions only. Staff are friendly. Do try spinach pumpkin pasta always a favourite.

Ah La Porchetta, what happened? We’ve been relatively frequent customers for years and have had usually good service, until now. Steak asked medium, came so rare the cow mooed, mash cold, veggies solid and seemed to have been steamed for a hot 30-seconds. Drinks came out one by one with about two minutes between them, just bring all at once. Also, our lovely server was a trainee, no problem, but it seemed as if everyone was a trainee. The duty manager seemed lovely and really trying, but another lady (who I presume was another manager cause she seemed to berate the duty manager when we went up to pay ) stood by the host stand, hands behind her back and remained there lazily and emotionless for the majority of our dining experience. Also, if you take plates away half eaten, maybe check as to why. No check ins on how the food was, no questions about if we wanted Desert or extra drinks. Then when we went to pay, no question on how the food was. Either you know it wasn’t good and don’t want the complaint, or you think it was good. I don’t know what’s more concerning. Thanks team.

Great place to hang out with friends and family. this place is also a family licensed bar, great friendly staff. They also cater to every occasion, Have your next get together at The Hanger, watch live sports at the bar. they have lots of seating space both inside, outside and upstairs. They also have lots of parking available and off street parking.

We went to The Hangar for dinner to celebrate my wife's birthday. One of my kids has lots of allergies, which I advised at booking time. I was pleasantly surprised when the waitress, when greeting us said she already checked with the kitchen and suggested the plates were safe. The food was delicious, the service quick and the ambience super relaxed. Definitely recommended.

Tge staff were nice and friendly and the atmosphere pleasantly slightly quieter than we've known in the past, but the food was average. The beef for the Thai beef salad and steak sandwich had quite a bit of gristle and tough. Generous portions though.

Extremely impressed with both the service and quality of food. Steak was cooked exactly how it was requested and everything else was perfect. Incredible meal for $25 and drink prices were extremely reasonable too! Great atmosphere with TVs playing live sport, music going and pool tables available. Will be back for sure.

I highly recommend this bar restaurant, one of the most iconic in the Henderson/Te Atatu areas. I visited with my colleagues after a team event and found it perfect for group bookings. We enjoyed a fantastic selection of beers, pizzas, and finger foods. The bar is equipped with numerous TV monitors everywhere, making it ideal for watching live sports like rugby, cricket, or football with friends and colleagues over drinks. I even watched the previous Rugby World Cup final here with my partner, creating unforgettable memories. The atmosphere is relaxed and family-friendly, the staff are kind, and the venue is spacious with outdoor seating available. I highly recommend this bar for drinks, as well as for lunch and dinner with friends or family for a great time together.

We had the best customer service experience from Zach who took our order and then patiently helped me navigate my BurgerFuel app to claim my "Club Goods" rewards. You're the best! Our meals were delicious which Ali helped cook and prepare. You made our dining experience are delight. We appreciate you both. Keep up the amazing work 👏🥰
Superb, as always. Vibes immaculate, new Wild Heart special was stunning, the team were on point. Hard to believe the girl on the grills was new - she was a natural. Slingin burgers with ease ✈️🍔⛽️😮
Pleasant service from the whole team and good food. Stefan served us, polite, and great attitude. We did wait a little longer than usual but they were busy so that was okay.

Just had the most stunning food at Burgerfuel Henderson. Shout outs to the chefs and fantastic service also from the Saturday night team. Honestly just gutted there were so many empty seats. It's really great to eat such good kiwi food. Becoming a regular here, especially with their app deals.
Was absolutely buss as per usual, would highly recommend 10/10 (always get lucky when I take the missus here)

It’s Wendy’s, the taco salad is fantastic value, my burger patties were a bit dry, bringing the experience of the burger down, and the loaded fries looked a bit sad. Otherwise though the drive through was extremely quick, the food was prepared fast and the price is actually decent.

Went there to try out Wendy’s for the first time, me and my husband got ourselves ice cream and large fries which they mistook for large sprite, I corrected the OT person but she denied it rudely. Had to pay extra just to get the fries we wanted, that I’m not frustrated about. Personally I understand how it feels to work in fast food, but if the branch wants to gain more customers the best its staff can do is be more respectful. Thank you for this first experience.

This Wendy's restaurant has a big and modern space. It the most beautiful i have seen in Auckland. The food is the follow their standard, so no much to add about it. Also you have a big parking loot structure on this one to park. The toilets are clean. But you must request a pass key to use them. Maybe that is the reason to it to be kept clean.

Just went to Wendy's today and bought a family combo meal for $35. They tout using the freshest of ingredients, just had a look at the lettuce that my youngest bulled out of his burger! Take a look at the quality of the lettuce! It was brown and well and truly dead. What will they try to do to redeem my trust? So far crickets! I must update you since my origional review done several years ago. Their latest Milkshakes are creamy and mouth watering, I especially love the Mint Flavour! Way better than McDonalds. I have just added pictures of the Chickenator too. Its a double chicken burger.

We really miss and enjoy eating here especially with their tasty burgers + fries and generous sized drinks! Can’t beat the baconator mushroom melt 🤤 The Wendy’s here are very clean and tidy, nice to have table service too which was great. Thanks Wendy’s Tat South, will see you when we come back for visit in 🇳🇿

We dined in on a Wednesday night at 6:30pm for Dinner . The ambiance was average . The acoustics were not great for quiet conversation. The restaurant was approximately half full. The service was polite . It didn’t take long at all to get our entree of Vegetable Spring roles then the main . I had sweet and sour pork with additional rice my friend pad Thai , again both meals arrived in a timely fashion and were delicious.

I arrived at Thai Peninsula at 7:30 pm on a Wednesday night and was pleased to see plenty of tables available. The staff promptly greeted me, assisted with parking validation, and seated me immediately. The service was incredibly fast; my food arrived in under 15 minutes from the time I ordered. The food itself was delicious, and the portion sizes were just right – generous without being overwhelming. The staff were friendly and helpful, contributing to a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere. While the restaurant has a slightly upscale feel, it's not pretentious. Even dressed casually in shorts and a hoodie, I felt completely comfortable. I especially recommend Thai Peninsula for vegetarians and vegans. They offer a wide variety of plant-based options. Overall, it was a fantastic dining experience, and I'll definitely be back.

After reading the many reviews I noted comments about the use of sugar and the excessive sweetness of the various dishes. I had stir fried mixed vegetables with pork and ginger plus white rice. The meal was overly sweet for my liking which did confirm previous patrons. There was plenty of pork in the meal,there was plenty of ginger which I liked, my only other adverse comment was the size of the onion pieces which too chunky and large and should have been cut smaller to ensure more even cooking. My wife had the Pad Thai which was also too sweet for my liking, however my wife was not overly concerned about it. Previous patrons have complained about the cleanliness of the toilets, this was certainly not not the case as I found that they were spotlessly clean.

I did Uber for thai noodles pad thai. Absolutely far far away from what real pad Thai recipe is. So much sweet Thai chilli sauce which has no relevance to original recipe of Pad Thai. It has so much sauce that all I can taste is sauce. Like Indian Maggie noodles made in tomato ketchup. If the chef doesn't know the recipe he should try restaurant called De Grand Thai restaurant at Epsom or white wong's Newmarket. You will know what real Pad Thai is.
Definitely would go again. The chicken rice dish was average, the pad Thai was nice, the money bags was nice but the deep fried squid was probably the best I've ever had.

Great restaurant and excellent quality food. We were here with a group tonight and had a great time. The seasoning of the meals were perfectly flavoured. And a first for me was that Chiko shows you the deserts from a tray with the real deserts on it. Awesome!

We have been here a few times. Today we ordered cassava chips, chicken liver pate, and my favourite ox tongues for ontray. Catch of the day/snapper and Angus beef tenderloin filet for mains. We were so full after on tray, so took home the mains. Shared dessert Eton mess. It’s our favourite restaurant in Henderson. Great service and clean environment. Highly recommended. Cheers
We really enjoyed the new lunch menu offered with obento boxes! My brother was in happy land with his lamb meal as well.

What a surprise! We came to check out this restaurant after seeing the reviews, but we didn’t have high expectations.. But wow, their food was amazing. We order the deconstructed sushi and the lobster bisque, and both were out of this world. The “sushi” was interactive and delicious, with fresh ingredients. The lobster bisque was packed with flavour and tasted exquisite. Both beautifully presented. The service from the lady was fantastic, whom we later found out was Chiko! We’ll be back to try the rest of the menu for sure..

We are so surprised that this restaurant located in west instead of CBD. The presentation and service they provided even more impressive than those fine dining restaurants. We are served by a Japanese lady who was super friendly, patient and thoughtful! The owner puts little green plants in between table to keep a bit privacy from different group of clients was so smart and sweet. Little fresh flowers on every table gives you romantic and luxury feeling. One thing that needs to be highlighted is they don’t serve any alcohol drink. I also like this ideas. I wish the seafood bowl can have bigger portion and the dish can be little hotter to be served.

We’ve been to Punjabi Kitchen on Lincoln Road many times now, and it never disappoints. The food is consistently full of flavour, portions are generous, and the service is always warm and welcoming. You can tell they put real heart into what they do. Easily one of our favourite spots for authentic Indian cuisine in West Auckland; highly recommend!

Had lunch at Punjabi Kitchen today – and it was a real taste of home! The food was flavorful, fresh, and full of authentic Punjabi spices. ✅ Naan was perfectly soft and fresh ✅ Dal Makhani had that slow-cooked depth ✅ Generous portions & quick service Friendly staff and cozy atmosphere made it even better. If you’re craving real North Indian food in Auckland, this place is definitely worth a visit! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Will be back soon!

I used to buy from you guys every two weeks ..just today I went there again to buy chicken biryani and fish pakora..the fish pakora pea flour was uncooked also there was no salad and it was packed in cheap paper bag..I went all the way from cbd..by the time I reached home it was dry and not eatable ..please look after your customers before you lose all your valid customers..don’t be just money hungry..not coming to this place anymore..humble request for the owner please look into this matter.you need to educate your staffs about best customer service..I will also share this review with the Henderson community page.

After only having take out for many years from Punjabi Kitchen we finally dined in mid week for a friends birthday. Food even better 'in person' with everything so fresh / fluffy / crispy with confident spice and flavours. Great service. Overall a great value night out when prices are soaring everywhere else. Was a little chilly in the restaurant so make sure you have an extra layer in winter.

My recent visit to Punjabi Kitchen on Lincoln Road was nothing short of exceptional. From the moment we arrived, the welcoming ambiance and inviting atmosphere set the stage for an unforgettable dining experience. The food was outstanding—each dish bursting with authentic flavors and perfectly prepared. Every member of my family thoroughly enjoyed their meal, making it a truly memorable occasion for us all. A special mention must go to Jasmin, our server, whose service was impeccable. Her attentive and warm approach elevated our experience tenfold, adding a personal touch that made us feel truly valued as guests. Punjabi Kitchen continues to uphold high standards in both cuisine and service, and I commend the team for their dedication. Well done—keep up the fantastic work!

I tried many Indian eateries here in Auckland and found the pure real Indian authentic taste. Their thalis are best however Pani Puri is not as expected. Overall value for money with great service and cleanliness. Also ample parking space available.

I will fall short of words to compliment this restaurant. I always exit with contented face from this outlet. So happy to get pure vegetarian menu at reasonable price. Yummy delicious food and the best service by our robo-friend “Kettybot”😀

Really loved the momos here. Tried steamed and schzwan and both were really delicious. Pav bhaji was uninspiring, but the chowmein noodles were good. So not all dishes are good, but some were great. They have a bit serving food which was quite novel. Good selection of Indian sweets and desserts, crowded on weekends and holidays but plenty of parking. Best thing is everything is vegetarian so plenty of choices
I had this Kadi rice today and this did not have kadi inside- the bowl was only filled with 4 big fritters. And no staff on the floor to complain about . Not coming back.

I travelled approx 8km to henderson store just for a cup of masala tea and paid $4 for cup and see what I got. It's a big time ripoff of money for that half cup serving. Never buying off from them again.

This is their only branch that is not so good. Staff is pretty rude and sushi isn’t as fresh as in other locations of St Pierres. Pls avoid Lincoln road location if you don’t want to be disappointed!!
Staff friendly and helpful and my niece and nephew say they make the best sushi
The best st.pierres store to come to. Friendly service Add extras where other stores refuse to Clean area Always has the better taste than other places.
Alm kind of sushi available, best brand of sushi in NZ.
Great taste and fresh. Main aunty is pretty angry and likes to yell at her workers in Japanese but that adds to the vibe of the place

The Chicken Enchilada was the most delicious – full of flavor and really satisfying. The Bacon and Egg Croissant and Beef Parcel were tasty too, though a little on the greasy side. The Chocolate Hazelnut Tart was quite sweet, but perfect for sharing.

So disappointing. I’ve frequented this place since it opened and recently lots of changes. Firtsuthe portions are much smaller than before and prices are higher My favourite the bacon frittata now has a few tiny pieces of bacon and I got one small dollop of cream cheese. It’s a shame that it’s gone this way Over priced and under delivered Coffee isn’t great either unfortunately it either the new barista or a different brand

An all time favourite. Always an amazing choice of foods that never fail to please in both size and flavour. I've heard there are other branches of Kreem but there is something special about the location on Universal Drive.... I'll be back

Food is good lots of choices and the servings are more than enough. Service is quite hectic if full house and so is the wait times as well. Though you have the option to use the QR menu to order and pay or you can use the counter to order.

Big cafe sit. Indoor and outdoor dining. Plenty of food options both sweet and savory. Wide range of salads and cooked menu items. Can place order at the counter or through your phone by scanning the QR code at the table. I have been twice and both times it's been packed. Popular place. The food is delicious. There are many items I am keen to try and look forward to coming back.
I love this subway, especially this one on universal drive. Been going there for years. Awesome staff, tasty fresh food. Clean and tidy and they got a new facelift inside the store. Looks better now.

Worst subway in Auckland - do not waste your money here, disgusting inside and awful customer service. Ordered a simple jaffle toastie, the cheese wasn’t melted/was still cold and the bread was burnt on the outside. Asked them to re toast, so the cheese would melt/be warm and was told that they “can’t do this as it’s not the procedure at this subway but can put it back in the sandwich press” so she put it back in the sandwich press (after touching this she put it directly back into the press - gross). Once she gave it back, it was still cold in the middle and now even more burnt on the outside. She refused to do another & argued continuously with me. Rude service and rude people, not to mention gross food -0000
The Indian lady was so arrogant and wasn’t even bothered to smile. She had an angry look while preparing my order for no reason. Not going there again 👎🏿
Worse subway I’ve been to in New Zealand. They hold back on everything not enough sauce, salad and meat. Would not recommend at all. Rude servers aren’t a good addition to the poor sandwiches.

I visited here Sunday 16 March and ordered a B.M.T. foot long. The bread was hard and stale. When I phoned them they said they would get back to me and they didn’t. I phoned today and the staff member told me her boss said there was nothing they could do. I will be certain to share my horrible experience with all my friends and family. Needless to say I’ll never ever visit them nor any Subway again.

This is one of my cousin's go to spot to grab a meal in the weekends. So for a first timer such as myself. I found the place is to be so cozy, spacious and so convenient. The food is worth the $$, trust me!!! Coz the burgers and chips in Fiji come no where tbh...honestly, truth be told. The quantity is ridiculous and comes with unlimited fizzy drinks of choice! Dont get me wrong, Fiji has a longggg wayyy to come to get to the level of fast food selection, delivery, service and the mode of payment available I was just 😳 fr fr!! The patties are blurry twice the thickness. Ugh and the buns farrr out. The fizzy drink selection in terms of flavours is crazzyyy. That was a satisfying meal and the good thing about the location, its next to a gas station. Self-service and payment option at your finger tips

Pleasant staff but it took so long for my small order!! The staff were overwhelmed and clearly catering to Uber eats etc over customers in store. From entering the restaurant to leave took nearly 25mins and I only ordered two small burgers and a small fries, take away. First time here, so was disappointing.
Just wanted to leave a review because Maria provided amazing customer service, at the checkout, something that seems to be gone these days. Thank you!!! Food was nice and well presented.

Unfortunately the worst CJ’s in Auckland. Food is always cold and real slow to come out. even when dining in at off peak hours. May also be understaffed. In the drive through they always ask you to pull forward to the road and wait so that the sensor at the service window turns off and it thinks they’re more efficient (came straight from an employees mouth when I asked why I had to move if there were no cars behind me) real frustrating tbh with you. 15min wait time for cold food is the only consistency here. Tasty…… but would taste better FRESH & HOT.

Well decided that I'd choose them for bornday Kai... got onion rings box 6.99 for 4 onion rings and chips that left raw spud taste in ya mouth the food is something of a dive waste of gas and put me off Carlos Jr for anyone who thinks that would be a nice dinner chips the dog sniffed and turned it's nose against so. . Thanks for the memory of never eating here again
