As a top Google reviewer and professional influencer, I can confidently say that Texas Chicken Henderson sets the bar high for fried chicken in Auckland. From the first bite, it’s clear that this location has mastered the art of perfecting fried chicken, offering an unparalleled experience for fried food lovers. The fried chicken at Texas Chicken Henderson hits all the right notes—crispy on the outside with a golden, perfectly fried crust, and tender, juicy meat on the inside. The chicken is consistently well-seasoned, with the right balance of spices that complement but don’t overpower the natural flavors of the meat. The texture is sublime, with just the right amount of crunch, and the meat stays moist and succulent. One of the standout aspects of Texas Chicken is the consistency in the quality of the frying. The chicken is cooked to perfection every time, with no greasy aftertaste, ensuring a pleasant and guilt-free indulgence. The focus on achieving just the right crispness while maintaining the juiciness of the chicken sets this location apart from other fast-food chains. While the fried chicken is undoubtedly the star, their sides also deserve praise. The biscuits, which have a slightly sweet flavor, are a perfect accompaniment, and the fries are crispy with just the right amount of seasoning. The variety of dipping sauces adds an extra layer of flavor customization, making each meal feel special. The staff at Texas Chicken Henderson are friendly and efficient, making the dining experience smooth and enjoyable. Whether you’re dining in or taking out, the service is quick without compromising on food quality. The restaurant is clean and well-maintained, offering a comfortable environment for a casual meal. In conclusion, Texas Chicken Henderson has earned its spot as the top contender for fried chicken in Auckland. The attention to detail in the cooking, the consistently great flavors, and the excellent service make it a standout choice for anyone craving high-quality fried chicken. Whether you’re a local or just passing through, this place is worth the visit.

Okay, so the spicy chicken actually has a pretty good bite to it. The chicken portions are larger than some of the competition, and overall the food is good - though some of the fries were a little overdone. I think they were a little busy, as it was a holiday weekend, so the service was a little slow, but not too bad.
very nice crispy chicken and the carolina reaper sauce really burns and has so much flavour

Young white kiwi lady opening the store today sat 26 july was fantastic, amazing, beautiful customer service. Bulk orders coming in to open the store but she worked very well under pressure with positive customer experience. She could be the manager wearing black shirt but she deserves great compliment. We need young competitive leaders like her. well done👏🏻
Much better than the 'other' oily food shop 😋

A good place to eat. The food is overall good and just as good as some of the other food places around that area. The chicken and roast pork is deliciously good. The beef noodle is just as good. The wonton Soup, although no photo that is not too bad, give it a try it's far better than other ones I've tried. Customer service is okay. When dining in the food is nice and hot when served, and I like the complimentary tea, you are served before your meal arrives. That's always a good thing. A good thumbs up for me.

After all these years this rest is still holding strong. It used to be very expensive but right now $20 a take away meal looks reasonable. If u buy bbq take away alone it’s expensive. Food taste very yummy. The fly and the hair in the food are normal. Everyone has that. Overall I recommend this place to everyone
Old place but man we love their dry noodles with the bbq meats 🙌🏼

Could not be bothered cooking tonight so gave this place a try. $40 or so for these beautiful large portioned meals(enough to feed 4 people). Pork was delicious, fried rice had delicious wok taste with bean sprouts (I love bean sprouts in my rice). Thank you for the great service I am so glad I stopped in. Will be back.

Staff are super friendly and attentive, will constantly refill your tea when dining in. Cost to portion ratio is very generous. Upon revisit: There was a fly dead in one of my sweet and sour fish on rice dish, which is of course unpleasant. An unlikely occurrence but it happened. The meal was replaced and remade.

Stopped in for a morning pick-me-up and was genuinely impressed. The coffee is excellent—rich, smooth, and made with care. But the real surprise was the breakfast: fresh, flavorful, and far better than you'd expect from a casual café. The eggs were perfect, the the mushrooms succulent, and everything arrived hot and fast. Staff were warm and efficient without being overbearing. If you're after a proper start to the day, this place nails it.

16/05/2025 Unfortunately it is a real put-off coming here if you get fined $65 for exceeding parking time limit in the tiny carpark out back. Will hesitate now to recommend to friends and family. Have been here a couple times, this time impressed with the delicious beef burger and fries. It was amazing 🥰 The Trio is always good. The food was beautifully presented too ❤️

Love coming here for coffee and brunch. The food is really well seasoned and flavorful. The coffee is very smooth and a tad milky which is my personal preference. Really well priced, we always leave feeling full and satisfied 🤗

Love their coffee! Ordered some mocha and chai latte 🤤 their egg benny with salmon is 👌🏻 french toast is delicious but would be better to have 2 slices of bread instead of just one and half 🤔 quick and efficient service. Will need to try out their other food on the menu 🥰

I am a regular at this cafe and have tried more than half of the dishes. The overall quality has been satisfying! The cafe offers a diverse range of menu items, from simple breads to noodle soup. The coffee is also delicious, at least in my opinion. I enjoy chilling, eating, and drinking while chatting with my friends here. Highly recommended for those who frequent Lincoln Road.

Man! This is the best Sals restaurant I’ve ever been to. I normally go to Westgate but as they didn’t open till 4pm today, Lincoln Rd was the nearest one to get lunch from. This will be our new location going forward. I’d happily drive the extra 10minutes to support this store. Firstly, walking in I immediately noticed how extremely clean and tidy the restaurant was. From the toilets to the kitchen, it was immaculate. Once inside we were greeted straight away by all 3 of the staff members. All 3 of them welcomed us in and amaze sure we were okay. As we had done an online order, they advised us that our food was delayed by 3 minutes. Not a problem at all. But they insisted we accepted 2 drinks on the house for the inconvenience. I told them it was okay and 3 minutes was not a long wait but they were persistent about giving us the drinks. Man, these guys were so nice and accommodating. You could tell they took pride in their restaurant and were serious about customer service. I honestly can’t praise their service enough. 10000/10. Lastly the food. Frick man, I’ve had so many inconsistent and underwhelming Sals Pizzas in the past, but these guys deliver on taste, quantity and quality. This is the first Sals I’ve been to that actually gives you a fair amount of cheese without you having to specify or ask beforehand. The pizza was perfect for my liking. Good cheese pull, cooked well enough for a crispy base and golden topping without burning it. Also the garlic knots were top tier. My son said they were the best he’s Ever had! And he’s super fussy too. Overall, I am more than impressed. I look forward to our next order from this store. As for the staff and owners… I wish you the greatest success moving forward. You are the type of restaurateurs that should be glorified. I hope you gain many more customers from my review and that you continue to set such a high standard for other Pizza chains to aspire to. God bless

Amazing pizza, one of the best Auckland has! They don't skimp out on the ingredients, and everything tastes fresh and delicious, hot out of the oven! Very friendly and welcoming staff, with good hours in case you get a craving for good pizza a bit later into the day.
Highly recommended! The over all experience was amazing. The food was great, also, all staff are kind and friendly. Store is clean and tidy too. Kudos team. 👍

Absolutely awesome! Easy parking. Staff are incredibly friendly and welcoming, feels like home. highly recommend the Buffalo wings and the Brooklyn pizza. Flavours are so authentic, brought back memories of my days in NYC!
Absolutely delicious! 🍕 Tried the pepperoni and it was amazing. The place is clean, service is quick, and the team is so welcoming. Will be back soon!

They completely messed up my order last night. The staff was inattentive and overlooked important details in my Uber order. I had specifically ordered a Falafel Salad along with an oat biscuit, but they failed to include the biscuit. While this might seem minor to some, it was truly disappointing for me. The staff really needs better training and should be much more attentive to their service.

I love going to this subway because of the service. Every time i have been i get served by this young indian lady !!, she is so sweet, always serves with a smile and perfection. love getting my subs made by her.

Disgusted at the food The arguing between ladies that work there Then being charged for heaps when I only ordered a chicken classic roll One lady growling the other Infront of me Lettuce was brown and yuck When I asked for extra topping she looked like she was paying for the toppings Only gave 3 capsicum and 4 shriveled up gherkins All in all my dinner was disgusting and I'm not happy with the service at all .... This is the second time I've been to Lincoln road Auckland subway and this has happened .... Your meant to encourage customers to come not scared them away with this nonsense .... Makes me not want to come back at all .... Lincoln road Auckland opposite Pak n save .... Alderman drive

Formerly 5 star, original review below + picture. New staff have no attention to detail, rushed, cheap and don’t spread ingredients out, pretty average sandwiches compared to what they used to be - really not good enough! Delicious, great friendly service, listened to instructions 5/5

I went to this subway 131 Lincoln road today. And very disappointed with the services. This was the cheesy garlic toastie we have for today with the standard amount of cheese. I asked for more and the boss said it is the correct formula, you pay extra if you wanted more cheese.... But this was not looking even near to what they have advertised in the picture... I did not enjoy it as it purely almost like eating the bread with no flavor at all as the garlic sauce given was very little too..….
The chicken was nice. I got boneless and original – both tasty. Went through the drive-thru. Customer service was nice and friendly. Good stop for a quick meal.

paid $100 and this is what i get? a soggy and cold burger & chicken? i was looking forward to eat a hot and crispy chicken as i was craving, very disappointing!!!! this is my second time trying kfc in this branch! same service, same cold and soggy food!
Spent over $100 came home opened our chips half bloody empty and no salt or flavor at all very dissatisfied

I had an amazing time at KFC! Juicy and delicious, the chicken had the perfect amount of flavor.The staff were very welcoming and made sure everything was ready. The dinner was served quickly, and the establishment was pleasant and clean. I will surely return, especially for my favorite dish, mashed potatoes with gravy.

Ordered online. When we got to the store, we waited a further 1h 10 minutes after the time it said it would be ready. Was told twice it was ten more minutes away, but it wasn't. We understand how hard the fast food industry can be however, this wait time isnt acceptable. We also observed a lot of people slip on your flooring as they were coming and going.. Food was alright. A bit on the colder side which im assuming is due to the wait, but it was yum. Server lady kept saying sorry for the wait and was nice.

The big breakfast is seriously big!! The service is impeccable. We went on ANZAC day, all the staff were so lovely and attentive. Great bright/sunny atmosphere, lots of parking. Coffee also really good. Defs one to add to our “go to” list.

What a great little find. We both got eggs Benedict and were pleasantly surprised how amazing they were. They also have this unique coffee bowl offering which we took advantage of! The service was excellent, the woman who served us was beyond friendly.

Breakfast date with my sister. My sister is a regular here and I wasn't convinced as Sierra Airport area is not great. 1 coffee, 2 breakfast meals and a mango smoothy aprx $61. Henderson however, a completely different experience. Love the atmosphere, choice of indoor or outdoor dining. Not alot of space which is a good thing I think. Plenty of parking! You can order off menu or purchase from food warmer. The winning token are the staff - looks like a family owner and operator. Great vibe, friendly and quick service. All day breakfast and all day lunch available. Adding this place for future visits.

This may be my favorite cafe in NZ. The food is incredible (I always get the B.L.A.T.) and the coffee feeds my soul. I recommend the long black! The only thing better than the food is the service and kindness of the staff. I wish I could rate it higher.
First time here today with my family and we are definitely visiting again!! Excellent service from the staffs 👌🥰 to the food 😮‍💨🤤 100/100 ! Thank you Sierra team ! 🫶🏼 keep up the good work.

Ordered uber eats and delivery was delayed by almost an hour. Since they use their own drivers my order location was not gps. Tried to call store for update or location but they could not provide one. My order arrived cold. Bloody useless.

Ordered from their delivery service and got a thumb sized piece of hard plastic on the pizza hidden under the toppings, my sister bit into it and it cut her gum. I emailed hell pizza to complain WITH PHOTO EVIDENCE but to this day i havent received any response for 2 months now. So unacceptable that feedback isnt even being checked! Unless theyre ignoring it intentionally. Im hoping this bad review will get a response!

Our local Hell's - Always a favourite for plant based (vegan & vegetarian pizza. Never have to be concerned about cross contamination. Food is consistently of a high standard. Disappointed the seed base was removed. Timelines of online paid orders are unfortunately never ready for collection at the scheduled time. The staff are always friendly but usually you have to wait additional time after the scheduled pick-up time.
I love Hellz. But the last order I got was horrible. The ribbs were burnt and to a crisp, the pizza was dry and bland. What happened, they use to be so good. Now after that order I'm not going back.

Extremely disappointed and deeply concerned with our recent experience at Hells Pizza Henderson. My daughter has a severe dairy allergy and made it very clear, three separate times, when ordering that her pizza needed to be gluten free and vegan. Despite her clear communication, the pizza she was given was Gluten free but not dairy free. She only realised the mistake after she had already eaten it, when she noticed the box said "not dairy free." She immediately called the restaurant, hoping they would take the situation seriously. Instead, they casually confirmed it was not dairy-free and offered to make her another pizza, even after she told them she had already eaten it and would now likely become seriously ill. To top it off, the staff simply responded with, “OK, have a great day.” No apology, no concern, no effort to take responsibility for what could be a life-threatening mistake. Food allergies are not a preference. They're a serious health risk. This kind of carelessness is unacceptable, and we won’t be returning. I hope the restaurant reviews its food handling procedures and trains staff to take allergy warnings seriously before something worse happens.

I never leave negative reviews but I have to in this case - this was $28 ‘yakisoba’ I ordered from Moto via Uber. It is literally some sort of maggi noodles with questionable chicken and I had to throw it out. Don’t make my mistake, go elsewhere for noodles. The tempura was fine.

We go here semi often and the staff always greet us when we arrive. In the past we have sat at a particular table and they seem to have remembered that each time we've been since. Kind of nice. They food us great and brought to the table quickly. We recommend then if Japanese food is what you are looking for.

We wanted something different from our normal restaurants and found Moto. Nice little, quiet restaurant. Good service and food came fast. Be prepared for your main to arrive before you are halfway through your starter. Food was great. Good wine list to cover most. Will definitely return.
Amazing ambience, extremely friendly staff, and delicious food! Highly recommend their meal sets!

This restaurant saved us 😉 we were supposed to have dinner in the city but the weather was horrible and it was very chilly, so we opted to eat somewhere nearby. We went to a couple of restaurants that were pricey and we ended up in the area where Moto is. We haven’t eaten here yet, so we decided to give it a try 👍 We sat at this slightly private area, ordered beef yakiniku, salmon sashimi, and dynamite roll and everything was SO GOOD 🤩 even the side salads were 👌 Food was served quick as well which is fab because we were so hungry and ate everything in minutes 😆 Highly recommended and will definitely be back! 💕

We were here for lunch Saturday and we were the only two here at 12.30. Fast service and really good food - we had the sizzzling steak and it was a generous portion. Price was reasonable and we got a takeaway curry too but although it was very nice it didnt compare to the sizzling dish! Premises are clean and tidy.

My wife and I were very glad to come across this restaurant. The restaurant was very clean and comfortable, ample parking, the service was very good, the food looked and tasted delicious. It had a steady flow of Uber drivers. Highly recommend the hot (spicy) sizzling beef platter, but the red curry chicken and peanut garden chicken were also great.

This restaurant is not located in the most inviting area but it was a nice surprise to see a clean and tidy area inside. Two of us ordered pad thai and sizzling beef which came with rice. Very large portion. Both tasted good. I don’t think the ingredients were the top quality and but very reasonable for price they charge. Most main dishes are in the range of 16-20 dollars. Very cheap for dinner. They also have 14 dollar lunch specials which seem like good value.

Went on mothers day for dinner this year and we had a lovely waitress called Niu? New? Sorry i didn't get her spelling but she was lovely. We had a large group of us and they moved the tables to accomodate. The waitress was super patient in taking all of our orders including the kids, and the food was delicious. They catered to a family member whose allergic as well :D The food came out one by one and it was piping hot which was great! And it was really tasty with great portions - kudos to the chef who kept the food good quality and good portions and delieverd to our big extended family. I would recommend going here again :) I gave it 4 stars as there is no dessert options and the drinks are the usual sodas like coca colas and fantas etc so nothing unique. The atmosphere isn't a resturant-like as such but but when the heat / smoke from the food is there and the conversations are going on the place gets cosy and due to the good food we would definitely return :)

Saturday night Thai food. Food was really nice however portions were a bit small. Order a few vegetarian and vegan dishes, staff were very good and asked are we vegetarian or vegan. Service was not the best as it took a very long time to wait and get an order, when the staff member arrived they proceeded to take a phone order prior to mine. The restaurant was fairly busy and had an ok vibe. I'm terms of the food itself given the price the portion was ok. The taste however was really nice, I enjoyed it and would definitely go again, however this time I will note to call and place an order rather then wait in line.
Food here is always yummy. The staff are young but there very welcoming and respectful Never had anything below 5 stars come out of there kitchen. Highly recommend

Had order delivered. Delivery guy was great. Food was the best KFC we have had in a long time. Chicken was moist and coating was crunchy not soft. Potatoe and gravy were nice and hot. Coleslaw was really nice.Aioli wrap tasty. Smaller than in their picture.

Visited:29/05, 10 PM Order: 2x Quarter Packs Disappointing—chicken was overcooked, nearly burnt, with unpleasantly harsh crispiness and off flavor. Service:Fast and friendly. Usually better food quality😢

I arrived very late on Waitangi evening. The ladies in store were so friendly, helpful, efficient & when I needed to feed the kids, after a long day travelling today. 5⭐️, definitely recommend! Enthusiastic and helpful, even late at night on a public holiday… They all need a pay rise! Love your work!🤙🏼 Happy staff=happy customers!

I was still at the store at 9:30 pm to be confronted by a number of pollination female service staff their unprofessionalism was beyond imaginable I would never even dream about KFC being run with such unexperienced no customer service skills staff please fix this ass KFC is not going to do well with hiring people as such. The worst KFC out West Auckland

We are celebrating my wife's birthday tonight. Made prior appointment before go. Not so many people today. Didn't have to wait for a long queue to get our dishes cooked. Food is really good. Value for money. Only my wife complained of less variety of dessert.

Kid friendly. Food was great, cocktails are Immaculate. The service at this restaurant was a 11/10. Honestly love the staff here. One lady served us and she was super helpful. I highly recommend giving your money to this restaurant 🩷
Good food, eat what you like, it will get fried for you on the large platter. nice desert an pancakes made on the spot.

Went there last night and to be honest it wasn't how it used to be. Sum of the food was ok and thats pretty much the gist of it. Sauces were all watered down too much so u really couldn't make anything very tasty. You could also smell the frozen meat thawing and that wasn't very pleasant. The cooks were ok and was going to have sum pancakes until I saw one of the cooks pull out sum already cooked ones and put them back on the heat with a little oil. When u ask for that kind of price you have immediately created and expectation and unfortunately in my case it fell short.

I just love this place! I love that you are able to choose fresh ingredients, with your own selection of oils and spices, and have it prepared to perfection in front of you, served hot and fresh. I absolutely love love their seafood chowder and their soft garlic bread. It's so good. I could eat only that and be happy. There is a big selection of vegetables, which I really like. There's also a huge selection of different meats, which most people will appreciate. There is ready prepared food, and a good selection of salads. For dessert you can have hot cakes and ice cream. The staff are very friendly and attentive, and keep clearing the tables.
Great prices! Great food! Great service! Thanks Shen Team!
The food was delicious hot tasty and satisfying thank you so much

I ordered a mussel fritter and a paua fritter. The paua fritter looks like charcoal and tastes like fish bait. What a waste of food. Maybe they could prepare the hot chips to be a bit fresh too because they look and tasted like it was from yesterday's batch. Customer service was good other than that food preparation and quality. Sorry, but it's a no for me.

I been coming here for years. My go to for Western Chinese food. I especially like the chicken thighs as they be big and juicy! They cover the basic Pacific islands food and roast meals as well. It can get really busy at dinner times. There is another Shens in avondale but the quality of food is majorly different! Ready made food on display. Finest Western Chinese in west auckland! Try for yourself and see what I mean. They also cater for big groups/families.
Unbelievably amazing!! Huge portions for a great low price and super friendly staff

First time I tried this place. Was very clean and Very delicious food. Would definitely be going there again. Chicken fried rice was delicious with a lot of chicken chunks. Fried chicken nibbles was fresh and batter was very crunchy. Pork bun tasted as good as the one I had previously at Stanley roast Kelston. Cost was reasonable will definitely be going back when in town.

Ordered wonton noodle soup via uber eats. Comes with about 7 or 8 large pork wontons with good flavour and well cooked (firm cooked meat texture vs jelly meat mushy like some others. Broth isn't anything amazing but is fine and veges were fresh.
Quick service ~ 10min wait Delicious food that tastes fresh There is a reasonable amount of parking right outsider the takeaways.
The food here is good! I don’t know why but I’ve always avoided this place… The honey chicken w/ fried rice will have you hooked. Nasi goreng is alright too, but not spicy enough lol. Give them a go.

Really clean kitchen and it is run by husband (chef) and wife. I tried their 9th dish on the menu : 3 in 1 Mixed Chicken Fried Rice, Combination Chow Mein (Pork & Beef), Egg Foo Young . Perfectly cooked juicy and taste with good quantity of crunchy vegetables (carrot, onion, broccoli, cauliflower). The chef cooks simultaneously 3 dishes on 3 woks and he is an artist with precision the way he adds spice to food. The best part is food wasn't oily, taste, good quantity, generous amount of meat and even after eating more than half of the meal doesn't feel too heavy on the stomach as it is not oily. Great customer service. Will return back to try rest of the menu.

We stopped by Taste Bakery and Roast in Henderson this morning and picked up a selection of pies: steak and cheese, mince and cheese, bacon and egg, and the smoked fish. The pastry on each pie was very flaky, just as you’d hope, and they were generously filled. While a couple of the pies could have used a bit more cheese—perhaps just a batch variation—they were still tasty. One thing that really stands out here is the sheer variety of flavours on offer; the cabinet is packed with options, so you’re truly spoilt for choice. The mince and cheese pie was a highlight, with a gravy that had a distinct flavour—different from any other mince and cheese pies I’ve tried. Everything in the display, from the pastries to the roast foods, looked freshly made and inviting. The staff were excellent too—super friendly and helpful, which made the visit even better. Parking is a breeze thanks to the large lot, so no worries there. If you’re a pie lover, this spot is definitely worth checking out. Don’t forget to catch the Steven Setu review video playing as you walk in—it adds a fun touch to the experience!

I had a pork roll combo. It was okay it chose not to have the salad, which was lettuce and carrot. I passed on that and just went for the roll, pork, gravy, and apple sauce. The roll was long and a decent size but tasted a little stale. I have had better roast rolls from out west, unfortunately not from these guys. I also tried a bacon and egg pie, and I wish I hadn't. It was late in the day when I ate this. The pastry was nice and crunchy, like as it should be, but... the filling just didn't even meet me halfway. It was dry and almost tasteless, which put me off. I might try a steak n cheese or a mice and cheese pie if I am ever in the neighbourhood again, but I've got choices. Other than that, the place is clean. The sammys look nice, but I'm not sure if I'd try one. They have won awards for some pies, and so far, I wouldn't award them one for the bacon and egg pie, but they have one. Maybe if I was really hungry, I wouldn't go here. Eat better and go down to Subway, Better luck next time, 2/5 for me. Happy eating, people.

🌕🌕🌕🌕🌑 🥧Taste Bakery & Roast 📍 B11/192 Universal Drive, Henderson, Auckland 0610 I recently visited Taste Bakery & Roast in west Auckland They won the so many Awards and it’s easy to see why. I tried the bacon and egg pie, it’s silver award of 2024. The bacon was crispy on top and had shredded bacon at the bottom. The egg was a bit dry, but it was still tasty. I also tried the roast duck pie, and it was incredible! The duck was juicy and flavorful, and the cranberry sauce was delicious. But the creamy sauce inside was a bit too rich at the end Overall, I quite like bacon and egg but I am not the fans of duck pie. I rate this bakery 4 out of 5, and definitely recommend and want to try other pies next time

Hands down one of the only places worth travelling to for a mince n cheese pie. They won the 2024 prize for best mince n cheese pie in NZ, and this award was totally warranted. Soft and flakey pastry. Perfectly seasoned mince. Gooey cheese. Exactly what you’d want in a pie!

We came in search of the recent award winning pies. Wow they did not disappoint, flakey cheesey and perfectly made. I'm not a huge bacon and egg pie fan, but my partner loved it all the way through. I had the mince and cheese which was pretty good, the cheese was a nice touch but I found the filling a little too sweet for my liking. Overall some amazing pies.

I have no idea how these guys are still in business. You would've thought that after all these years they would've updated their menu, look and taste. Unfortunately not. Their dishes lack any flavour whatsoever. Even the simplest dish...the chicken fried rice lacked flavour. I had to re-cook the dish and add more seasoning to it before my tongue can taste anything. Their lemon chicken also has no taste besides the taste of bitter lemons. Ordering those two dishes was enough for me to stay away.
Beef and black bean had a weird taste. Not returning.

We had this once, and now have it every week. Absolutely love the fresh salad we get with our chicken/mixed meat on rice. Once you start, very hard to stop. Amazing service when we go in or order over the phone.

I quite enjoyed the food last night. The bread for the kebab was toasted well and was traditional turkish bread. The kebab was also a really good size. The lamb on rice was tasty and not too salty, spiced really well and thoroughly enjoyable. I look forward to returning to your establishment.

Idk if it’s changed owners or what but the quality ain’t the same. Use to come here because the meat was less processed but now it’s exactly like the other hundred options of kebabs. Staff were awesome but the food just wasn’t it.

Tried this kabab shop for the first time tonight and was really impressed with not only the quality and taste of my kabab, but also how clean the place was, how friendly the staff were and how fresh the food was. Highly recommend

Absolutely love their mixed meat on chips. Salad is always so fresh and sauces are so tasty. Definitely satisfies your hunger and is relatively priced. Been buying from here for a year now and won’t go anywhere else.

12-11-2024. 8:00 pm. Really frustrated with this branch. My boyfriend ordered super supreme with garlic stuffing. The guy in front of the counter couldn’t even understand what he’s saying. It’s supposed to be super supreme pizza but we got this cheese pizza. So disappointed. This is our dinner and we only got this cheese pizza. Please hire someone who can understand kiwi accent. Please. Thank you

Great experience! The pizza was hot, fresh, and loaded with toppings. Staff were friendly and the service was fast. Definitely coming back again! "The pizza was good but the delivery took over an hour. Staff was polite when I called, but I hope delivery improves next tiime
Ordered by Uber , always get amazing taste, highly recommend.

Ultimate taste & Quality is good. I was given my order on phone call . I went there within 10minits and my order was already ready , thank you for your quick service...... The staff are Maintaining Hygienic rules. I love to come again..........

Absolute joke. How can such a big company like Pizza Hut be so inept on such a basic level? Staff and delivery drivers either don't care or aren't very smart. Order pizza online at 1600 for 1830 delivery. Turns up 18 mins late, cold and not the San Francisco style like ordered. Don't waste your money or time with these clowns.

Its same shop as Bikanerwala, not sure why they named it differently. Same food, same kitchen, same shop but at a higher price..think twice before you go.. You plan to be awake till 10:00 PM just to realise Gangadhar hi Shaktiman hai!!
It's a really great option for late night and most important they are pure vegetarian We tried Chai and Paratha it reminded us being back in home country late night fun...
We tried two times their food and it was so amazing that we will come again and again…. So must try da night market….

Pho Bien is our family’s go-to spot whenever we’re craving the flavours of home. Both my wife and I are Vietnamese, and we eat here one or twice a week. We’ve tried many Vietnamese restaurants around Auckland, but this is by far our favourite. The food is delicious and tastes very close to what we grew up with in Vietnam. What I especially appreciate are the generous portions and reasonable prices — a big plus, especially with rising living costs. Our personal favourites are the grilled pork chop on rice or vermicelli, the deep-fried spring rolls on vermicelli, and the classic Beef Pho. My wife also loves the wonton noodle soup, which is full of flavour as well. The stir-fried egg noodles with either seafood or beef are another great choice — though I usually ask for a bit less oil to suit my taste.

Pho Bien offers a truly stand-out service experience! The girls working there are absolutely amazing – so chilled out yet incredibly efficient and attentive. In my opinion, the service truly outshone the food. They have clearly marked vegetarian options on the menu, which is always a plus. Our food came out quickly, within 15 minutes. The pho was definitely the highlight of the meal – probably the best dish of the night. The pancake was a bit on the oily side but tasted okay, and the $8 veggie side was decent but not remarkable. Convenient self-service water and condiments are a nice touch. Come for the fantastic service, stay for the delicious pho!

Dec 2024 edit: Staff has since gotten more professional and friendlier. Food is average, decent range. Service was disappointing, maybe a lack of experience and inattentive. Food was served while the waitress was holding her own food that she was munching on. Tables are sticky in between customers, they do minimum work to clean up. Seating arrangement is tight, cramped and on an uncomfortable hard wooden chairs.

We like the Deep fried wonton, Deep fried spring roll. They got big serving. Good for sharing. You don't need to wait for long with your order even on weekends. They got self-service condiments. They offer vegan, Gluten free diet on their menu. Ample parking available on the site.
Delightful food. Had the noodle salad and a steam boat. Highly recommend trying. Delicious coffee ☕️

This place rocks!! Friendly guys, superb food and superb prices!! The single Fat Chicken Bacon burger is huuuuuge and tastes amazing. We will definitely be back. Support local and go try these guys out!!

PSA: If anyone reading this is researching from Uber AVOID AT ALL COSTS! 🤢🤮😡 Below sub-optimal quality. Received order through Uber eats. The burger patty was raw, the chicken wings are absolutely saturated in old cooking oil and the curly fries were all minced up with loads of old black potato. I figured I should avoid considering their Google reviews appeared fake and their social media uses stock photos... Very disappointed

Had a Smashed beef burger. Would highly recommend this place. Decided to have a three patty burger and just managed to finish it. This combo is great value for money. Chips are shoes string fries, fresh oil with enough salt where you can choose to add more to your liking. Burger has a good sauce and pattys have a good seasoning. Drinks are Coca-Cola range as well as pepsi.Will be coming back to try more of the menu. Has a little table if you want to eat instore

We ordered the $65 family meal and each item was so delicious! The 6inch sub was my favourite (beef and bacon). Definitely value for money: 3 burgers, 1 sub, 1 large fries, 2 sides, 1 large drink bottle, and 1 thick shake. We also ordered loaded fries because the large fries was not enough for 4 adults, but overall it was still a low price for the quality food you receive, with friendly service too. Will gladly visit again!

Not sure how long these guys have been open but they're amazing. I ordered the double beef with bacon combo and the double chicken with bacon combo. Burgers were soo big I couldn't finish it, super tasty, fries were shoe string and were pretty good. Price I fair and taste is great can't wait to try more on the menu

Every time i come here, food quality gets better and better. All the dishes r reasonably priced, in some cases i feel like it’s a steal! Definitely recommend everyone to come and try this only Bangladeshi cuisine restaurant in New Zealand. I will highly recommend this place over most Indian restaurants without any hesitation. Will keep on adding pictures and recommendations the more i visit this place.
Food amazing ingredients and delicious 😋. Real Bangladesh menu. Good value for money. We will come back to try other dishes and some special seafood dish.
Great Bangladeshi food! Great ambience inside. Very happy to encounter such amazing food here in New Zealand. Staff were very friendly. Prices are good.

Boishakhi is a hidden gem for anyone craving authentic Bangladeshi flavours. We tried the Fuchka (10/10), Kala Bhuna beef, and Shahi Kheer—each dish was packed with rich, traditional taste and absolutely value for money. The Kala Bhuna was especially outstanding—tender, deeply spiced, and cooked to perfection. The Shahi Kheer offered a perfect sweet ending to the meal. Warm, courteous service added to the overall experience. Highly recommend for an authentic and satisfying Bangladeshi dining experience.

Came to visit Auckland for the holidays and found this hidden gem! Boishakhi is an authentic Bangladeshi restaurant and pretty much everything we tried here tasted just as good as the real deal! For people who have not tried Bangladeshi food before - think of it as 100 times better than Indian food (trust me on this). For my deshi folks, you have no excuse not to try this place, if you like "real" Bangladeshi food. Also, the staff and service are top notch!!! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Would definitely visit again and recommend it to family and friends, who live in the area or are visiting!

initially we came for the Vietnamese restaurant next door, but then we saw this restaurant is full of people and it’s mostly Korean people which we thought must be authentic. We ordered the set menu, big portion, great pricing and delicious food! Service was very good too, the place is clean and there’s plenty of car parks.

Golden Castle (황금성) has undergone changes since its previous name and management, so we decided to visit and see what’s new—and we were pleased with our experience! We booked a table for six on a Friday night, and despite the busy hours, service was quick. The staff were attentive to our requests and questions, and the food arrived promptly—within 10-15 minutes, even during peak time. We mostly ordered large plates to share, and there was plenty to go around. Our go-to dishes did not disappoint: the spicy chilli garlic chicken (깐풍기), sweet and sour pork (탕수육), Jjamppong (짬뽕)—a must-try for seafood and spice lovers—Jangban Jjajang (쟁반짜장), perfect for sharing, especially with guests new to Korean cuisine, and Ohyang Jokbal (오향족발), flavourful five-spice pig’s feet. The portions were generous and satisfying. Whether you’re already a fan of Korean cuisine or looking to try it for the first time, Golden Castle is a solid choice and well worth a visit!
Great Korean/Chinese food! Classic 짜장면 (Black bean noodles) and 탕수육 (Sweet and sour pork) and the 찐만두 (Steamed Dumplings) are all very good and great portions! 🍜🥟🔥

My husband and I took our 3 teenage grandchildren for lunch here before heading out to the movies. We shared three dishes which was a good serving for all five of us. The food was fresh and very tasty. We all loved it and will defintely go back to try other dishes - all the food coming out of the kitchen looked wonderful. It was busy but we were served quite quickly - and the bill was cheaper than taking them to the normal "fast food" places.

First time having a dinner here. Order several dishes to share with my family. Taste great, good portion, parking friendly. Booking is necessary to ensure the seats because the shop becomes full in the prime time. My recommendations here are dumplings, seafood nurungji, jaengbanjjajang, yangjangpi, jjambbong and any fried dishes!!!

The food here is unlikely but delicious!! 🤤 We really enjoyed (much to our surprise) this fusion of Italian and Korean. Pleased our discerning teenagers who loved the Papa fries (loaded) and the rose chicken. The mala Was incredible! This place is totally under the radar - a hidden gem on Lincoln Road. Try it - you won’t regret it!

Firstly the owners are lovely and the restaurant has such a cute cozy fit out. For the price you couldn’t ask for more. Great portions, crispy schnitzel, good sauce. Really lovely hearty flavours overall - only wished they had more mushrooms in the spaghetti. Will be back to try the fried chicken!

Amazing food! We ordered the Rosè Hamburg Steak and the Schnitzel with Creamy Pasta—both were full of flavour. The service was also excellent and very welcoming. Highly recommend visiting and trying anything with the Rosè sauce. Also pretty big portions!
Amazing food! The owner is so nice and kind. Offered himself to take a photo of us. Creamiest pasta I've ever had.
Seems they don’t pay attention to food presentation. Super simple but tasty. Great price is a big plus. Clean, cozy atmosphere with fast service. Convenient parking. Recommendable.
Been going here for sometime and thought I'd do a review. It's always a treat to come here. Food is very good especially the soups. Always value for money. Service is very lovely. Thank you.

Very nice service. A friendly gentleman served me tonight. I ordered a takeout fish roe soup, and he kindly included a complimentary side dish, which was a pleasant surprise because many Korean restaurants don’t offer side dishes with takeout. You can also tell from the generous portion of the side dish that they weren’t just doing it perfunctorily. Btw, I like their rice. Affordable prices and decent food!👍
The food always tastes amazing when me and my partner eat here. Highly recommend

Very disappointed with their service, we four people ordered 3 courses, there were two main meals, however they just offered 1 set of side dishes to share. At least 2 main dishes should come with 2 set of side dishes, and when we asked for the refill, they refused. Never come back! . . Are you seriously with your attitude?? Well, nothing wrong with us. I was wondering how many dishes would you like us to order for 2 adults and 2 kids? 8 or all of the options on your menu? We just ordered what we needed, we wouldn’t want anything to be wasted. If we weren't dining at the same table, you would at least provide two side dishes. Moreover, we've ordered at least two main courses. We didn’t ask you to refill all the dishes. It was just the bean sprouts which kids loved, but you refused to refill them. Also, according to what you've said, we're entitled to one reasonable refill. We hope your restaurant can pay attention to this issue and resolve it.
Good simple korean food, bibimap was nice and the side dishes were a nice addition. Atmostphete is very comfy feels like you are in someones home and the staff was very nice. +++korea

The food was absolutely amazing and truly irresistible — it exceeded all our expectations! You guys really nailed it. The Tikki Chaat and Jalebi were the highlights of the event. All our guests loved the food and were genuinely surprised to see that Novelty could do live catering at events. I’ll definitely be recommending you to our group. You can expect more catering requests from our side for sure. !!

The food was absolutely delicious! Every dish was bursting with flavor. I was incredibly impressed with the quality of the ingredients. You can really taste the freshness. The atmosphere was warm and inviting, and the staff were incredibly attentive and friendly. 10/10 stars for their chaat range.

I initially came here for Kaju Barfi for my daughter who loves Indian treats. Novelty’s Kaju Barfis were so good. We came back here a few days later to get more. That’s when we met Gunveen, the wife of the owner. She recommended a few treats for us including Gujia, a classic Holi sweet. We ended up getting some takeout for dinner that night. All were delicious, but I have to say that their Daal Makhni was the best that I have eaten!!

Wonderful experience at Novelty Restaurant! They serve delicious Swaminarayan food with no onion or garlic. The Aloo Tikki was crispy and tasty, and the Chhole Bhature is a must-try! Clean place, friendly staff, and great food. Highly recommend for anyone looking for pure vegetarian meals.
Wonderful Novelty special thali. And aloo paratha was just like homemade chatpata. Chum chum / rasgullay were soft as butter 😋juicy dhokla. Thank you and keep up the good work.

Absolutely inedible peri peri chicken and worse still, appalling service! Waited 35 minutes and wasn't advised it was going to take longer than 15 minutes. Upon cutting the chicken it was pink and bloody. Phoned to complain and they tried to convince me it was safe to eat. The manager would not provide a refund with the only solution being they could cook me a replacement. I don't live close, not willing to wait again and not willing to risk my health. Will not be going back.

I'm sorry to the ones who didn't have a good experience here but for me it was; Great Value and Delicious Food. First time trying and I'm impressed, I ordered through Uber Eats and got an amazing deal—thanks to a 20% promotion, I got nearly $74 worth of food (plus delivery) for just $41.50. I received two chicken toasties (one aioli and one ultimate) both were hot, filling, and absolutely delicious. The two chips were fresh, crispy, and perfectly salted. The two potato and gravy sides were creamy and comforting, perfect for dipping chips. The two chick pop chicken were nice and well-seasoned, but the standout for me were the six spicy chicken tenders—tender, moist, and packed with flavor. They were hands down the best part of the meal. If you like spice then this is the place. I don't know how long their standards will last, but for now, they're high. I truly hope they stay at this peak for many others to enjoy. If you use uber eats, be on the watch for promotions and give this a try. I can't talk for all locations only this one. Overall, incredible value for the price (when using promotions) everything arrived hot and satisfying. Highly recommend! P.S I would choose this over kfc and texas, because yikes kfc hasn't been good in awhile, and over texas because of the spice factor.

Tried this place with my husband for the first time and absolutely loved it! The hot wings and wraps were bursting with flavour. Just perfect for anyone who enjoys a good kick of spice. Everything was freshly cooked and full of taste. We’ll definitely be back for more!
Great service. Always made fresh for my order. Definitely one of my favorite fried chicken place to go. Definitely recommend this Chicking.

This little place was amazing awesome welcoming shop to enter then being served with prompt customer service that was great and my chicken was beautifully cooked so delicious I would recommend to come try this place out Thank you's so much 👍
Got these for my team yesterday. They were awsome, taste super fresh and how they shape the platter amazed all of us. Great job Aiko sushi. 🥰🥰🥰
Never tried any better sushi than this place. Highly recommended
Best bang for the buck! Hunger box combo is a really good deal. Dumplings and buns are super tasty. Will definitely come back.

$39 Hunger Box, broooo so good. For this price and the variety say less. Super tasty and quick service, we even had leftovers to take home. My partner wanted to get the bigger box but this size was alg for us 2. The spring rolls are huge and you get 2 coke cans. Great value, we’ll be back for sure!

My family and I went for dinner last night.We ordered the $39.90 Share platter which had Buns,spring rolls,chips and dumplings. They were all absolutely delicious!!! We had some food from chicken place next door but wished we had bought more from Mr Bun. The buns were amazing.Beef and cheesy,yummmm!!!!Everything was fresh and crisp not to mention super juicy and tasty Atmosphere was nice n friendly service. I highly recommend. We ended up buying 2 bags in support and my boys had some when we got home...They also said they were yummm!!!Will be back for sure🥰🤌

If you enjoy steamed dumplings, this place is a must-visit! The dumplings are classic, incredibly juicy, and packed with flavor. Don’t miss the pancake—it’s a staple of Northern cuisine. The beef noodle is also highly recommended; the noodles have a delightful bounce and are richly flavored. The restaurant is clean and features lovely decor.
Relaxed and kind. Free egg drop soup, which was a nice surprise on a cold day. First time here and hospitality has won me over, before the food,, so it’s nice already.😊

The biryani had the best balance, great balance for someone who can't handle spices The Manchurian had the best flavour. The chicken 64 grows on you. At first I thought it was mid, but now I'm heaving it in

Ordered lamb Biriyani via uber eats and requested for double masala or spicy. I have to say that this meal turned out pretty good. This is the first time I’m trying here and it’s quality food. Biriyani I got was neither under spiced nor over spiced and it was well balanced with enough masala. There are lot of places in and around Auckland that serve Hyderabad Biriyani but the taste and consistency is not the same every time. Hope this quality and taste continues in the future. Will definitely be back soon to try other dishes.
Our go to place for excellent food. Enjoyed the Biryani and Tandoori Chicken

I must say, I was thoroughly impressed! From the moment I walked in, the staff greeted me with a warm, welcoming attitude, which set the tone for a great dining experience. The service was prompt, attentive, and friendly, making sure we had everything we needed throughout our meal. As for the food, it was absolutely delicious! Overall, I highly recommend this for anyone looking for great food and excellent service. I'll definitely be returning for more!

This place is good the chef who make the food is friendly and kind I ordered the butter chicken so many time from this places I give it 5 start one time I order the lamb Biriyani was warm not to hot but I can't complain about it much the service is good I recommend this paces.
Last time got burn rice today fried rice like half kg salt

Service was great, very good customer service . Food : I've had bad experience before. But have stepped up the game and was nice. Would have liked the meat to be a little more juicy but over all good experience. Thanks and will definitely be back!

Better tacos than in Mexico!! The staff are always extremely friendly and give the place a good atmosphere. Price is very fair considering the size and quality of the food. I usually get the nachos which are my favourite and yet to try they’re delicious looking burgers

Been a regular over here through the years and have seen it be a hit or miss (mostly a miss) but my recent experience was so off putting I will never be coming back. The mince in the nachos had burnt hard grease bits in it and as if that wasn’t bad enough, they gave it to me bare with just cheese and sour cream - no salads, no guacamole no nothing, even though that’s literally what it’s supposed to come with. It looked like someone took a dump in it and then slapped a load of watery sour cream on top. The mexi fries were stale af and looked like it was cooked well before I even placed my order. We also ordered the chargrilled corn and chicken quesadillas and it came with no corn and just packed on chicken inside with cheese, it was a mess all falling apart. I figured they ran out of guacamole and salads since it wasn’t in my nachos but was surprised they somehow had it in the box for the quesadillas like what?!! You’re kidding. This experience was absolutely the worst and I’ve never been more disappointed in a meal top to bottom. It’s not hard to follow a simple recipe that has been there for YEARS! Imagine if McDonald’s just stopped putting meat in their burgers for some orders - the missing ingredients are literally STAPLES for the meal how can someone miss putting it in? It’s not an extra addition added it’s what’s advertised on the menu. I tried calling the store over and over again but no one answered. Uber eats had to rectify YOUR mistake. Get it together Lincoln Rd and train your staff to know how to cook the damn meals on the menu or don’t advertise as such.
This was $7.90 worth of “mexifries”, the fish taco was actually a grated cheese taco with one fish nugget on top, let’s just leave it there.
Really nice food. With a holiday surcharge it was expensive, but I got a huge meal and the serving staff were delightful. Would definitely return. Recommend this place.

It's Friday night - Takeaway night. A friend was feeling under the weather with a sore throat and he suggested a nice hot beef noodle soup would be ideal to combat the cold symptoms on a cold autumn evening, so I Google-searched Chinese beef noodle soup 🍜 and I came across this gem! What a find! I was most impressed that the noodles were cooked in front of you, the freshest you can get. I can just imagine a street food stand in China 🇨🇳 selling this to the locals. A couple were dining in the restaurant and were waiting for their order, I asked if they were repeat customers and they replied "Yes" and before I could ask what they would highly recommend, the gentleman said A2 Braised Beef Noodle Soup. So that's what I ordered and after devouring it, I agreed with the other reviewers that this Braised Beef Noodle Soup is the most flavourful and tasty soup I've ever had. The braised beef was tender and I removed all the fat from it, the noodles were soft and delicious and the beef broth was spectacular 😋 I will go back and order this again. If you're looking for authentic Chinese beef noodle soup, then look no further! I would highly recommend 金味德西区店 Jinweide Beef noodles Thank you for your delicious beef noodle soup. 谢谢你美味的牛肉面汤.

I recently dined at a Chinese restaurant not far from my house and had a remarkable experience. The restaurant served hand-pulled noodles that were perfect, with a fantastic texture and flavor. The rich soup that accompanied the noodles added depth to the dish. In addition, the dumplings were a true delight, bursting with delicious flavors. The array of delectable side dishes was a must-try complement to the meal, providing a well-rounded dining experience with their enticing range of choices.

They specialise in beef, particularly the slow cooked beef - so definitely give that a crack. It’s incredibly tender. The beef sandwhich in the picture and the little bowl of beef chunks were melting in the mouth. Dumplings were also soft and juicy - very nice. I’d definitely eat there again.

The noodles themselves are probably the best we've ever had in New Zealand. They have a great texture to them and you can taste how fresh they are by how they absorb the soup. I often add chili oil and vinegar to my noodles but these did not need anything extra at all. Everything is seasoned to perfection. On top of this, we visited just before closing. We insisted to takeaway but the staff were so welcoming and even encouraged us to feel welcome to sit and eat. We have been here a couple of times now and they are even better than when we first visited.

If you’re wanting a place serving hand made noodles, you’ve got to try Jinweide Noodles on Lincoln Road, Henderson. When you enter you’re greeted by lovely staff and a welcoming atmosphere and then the aroma hits you! We got braised beef noodle soup and the broth was so good! It was hot, the noodles were just delicious and the beef just melts in your mouth. You get to choose what sort of noodles you want (I’m glad I took photos of the chef sharing his masterful technique and skills) and have a range of pickled condiments to choose from. The kids got dumplings and chicken noodles and were full! A nice night out with the kids and a nice change from fast food joints and takeaways! It’s quite a small space for seating and parking can be scarce on a Friday or Saturday night so get in early if you can. We’ve been here before and will definitely keep going back!

Called in here on a Friday night after a round of bowling as I wanted to try one of the Teapot cocktails. Originally asked for the margarita but had no tequila. The barmaid was prepared to run to the liquor store to get some, but the weather was terrible, and I'm not that fussy, so I went with a Mojito. Teapots hold more than they look and was refreshing after a big feed. Was a quiet evening, so we enjoyed the outdoor area to ourselves for most of our time there. Nice atmosphere and very relaxed.
Awesome spot👍

Friday 4 February 2022 9pm I'm giving 3 stars because the food was great. We got the Wisconsin with cheese and the Vegan Boss , both very nice. But our $5.50 chips were like 50c worth. I got 13 chips . Pretty sad that. Plus the Filipino lady was very very abrupt and I couldn't finish my order properly as she kept telling me the cost. I had to tell her I haven't finish yet Soooo annoying She kept saying ' nah not really enough when I asked for curly fries. Felt like she was annoyed because I changed my mind. The man cooking the burgers was really friendly... Keep him and sack her...

Dry, tasteless and full of gristle. I asked the cook if the meat paddy was freshly cooked. It was very very very dry. Worst $70+ spent on our meal. Disappointing, especially with the fond memories of your then amazing Glendene Branch. Will not be back with my family.

Burger Pattie’s was half the size of the burger bun, smaller than a McDonald’s Petrie and smaller than the palm of my hand. It was also over cooked and chewy on the outside and still pink in the middle

Nightmare of a burger. Ordered the double burger with extra cheese and got an incredibly dry burger with no cheese. Tried to save it by adding my own cheese but the bun disintegrated when I moved it, impossible to hold. The bun was so stale that it just fell apart.

We ordered almost $100 worth of food via uber eats. Took ages. Everything arrived stone cold and soggy. It would have been sitting in a room temperature for quite some time prior pick up. Including the milkshake. The burger was choking hazard dry and tasted like nothing. I won’t bother again.

We visited Mr Lobster’s Private Kitchen a few weeks ago with a group of family and friends (there were nine of us). We made a booking in advance and were seated at a large table with a lazy Susan, which made sharing easy. We ordered a range of dishes from the menu—everything sounded amazing, and each dish had its own unique flavour. The standout for us was definitely the Peking duck. The crispy skin, juicy meat, and the combination with the wrap and veggies were just perfect. We also really enjoyed the green beans, roast pork, spicy chicken, and BBQ fried noodles—they were all packed with flavour. The only downside was the slow service. It seemed like dishes were being made and served one table at a time, which is understandable, but with so many other groups there, it meant we waited over 30–40 minutes before the food started arriving. A bit longer than we’re used to, even at busy places. That said, once the food came, it was worth the wait—just something to keep in mind if you're heading there during peak hours.

Always busy here. But we were able to get a table without waiting long. They are very efficient and courteous. The food is well prepared, presented, delicious and generous. Price is a bit on the high side but again generous servings. Ordering is a breeze with the QR code system and you know what you are paying for. Just make sure tea charging is for the right number of people. I have to say again they are very efficient!

We have been several times for yum cha and once for dinner. The staff are very friendly and speak English. For yum cha you order on an app which has pictures and is in English and Chinese. They do have a physical menu but encourage to order on the app. There is no trolley service. Food is very tasty and a great variety. Pictures only show the few items we had. Highly recommend yum cha. You must book. The carpark can get busy but u can register your car with the restaurant to avoid getting towed or a ticket. Dinner is also very good with great service.

A regular lunch spot for us! Food here is absolutely top notch, our favourites would be the Peking duck and special fried tofu! I had a birthday dinner here the other day and each of the servers were so helpful with our cake and even sang me happy birthday 🥹🫶 Particular shout out to the young man working on the Monday evening 😊 Just remember to put in your car plate number into their computer system before you dine!

I have been your customer for long time and this was second time I received only 1 Egg Tart when I ordered two. Last time I did not bother complianing about it but this time is unexceptable. Never refund back never ring about it. Check your order properly and I hope you do something about it this time. Also I orderred Prawns Rice rolls but you gave me wrong one. I ordered this many time and what given was not what it looks like. Omg, this is really unexceptable. 2 mistakes happened today. So careless.

The cook is cool he is always smiling. The Kuet Teaw is so yum it pairs well with the mango pomelo sago from Cha+ next door... I will buy another tonight, tommorow and forever i'm obsessed... also very fast service.
Excellent food, absolutely delicious and very friendly as well!
Absolutely delicious meals! I had my fave seafood keow teow, mixed entree and hubby had his staple seafood laksa. We are a long way from home, glad to have found this gem of a Malay restaurant!!

Exceptional Malaysian Dining Experience! I recently had the pleasure of dining at a Malaysian restaurant for the second time, and I must say, it was an incredible experience from start to finish. exceptional food and impeccable service. The flavors and aromas that permeated your the air as the dishes arrived at my table were truly captivating. The chefs' mastery of Malaysian cuisine was evident in every bite. Highly recommended !

This place was my friends favourite from Food Alley, so she was keen to get her fix before heading out of Auckland. We arrived there at about 6.10pm, both got carparks but please beware... it fills up fast & gets crazy. We were the first customers, so our food did not take long to arrive. So full of flavour! Despite the hustle & bustle out in the carpark, it was so quiet in store eating, it was bliss! Don't forget to try the condiments station. You can also order off uber.
Wonderful food, they offer catering for certain events. 10 out of 10. Delicious, beautifully presented!
Love the food, portions are generous & service is always great.

Support yah local 💜 We had a small unveiling for our parents headstone yesterday and to top it off we had the best feast put together by the awesome Tutuila Sagote Pepe Isaaka and family down at PINTS Kitchen Henderson our children were over the moon. Why go to a boring restaurant where your kids are screaming when you can enjoy great food and a few drinks while your kids are out of your hair enjoying a game of bowling ☺️☺️ makes sense right! The platters were super massive we didn’t even end up ordering what we wanted as the ones that came out were well over expectation. Great hospitality great food book your next event there 💯 thanks again team
Very long wait for a simple meal unorganized staff lazy as well
Awesome place and Food was great.

Tried their $25 Large pizza deal with 2 sides. Ordered chicken tandoori pizza with Onion rings as side. Pizza is very good in size, fully loaded. Good quality and quantity pizza. Good customer service. Gonna try other pizza ranges for sure.

The pizzas are so good!. We have tried the Pepperoni & Meatball pizzas so far. Very flavourful and a large size for the price. Great alternative to the main stream pizza joints and fast becoming a firm favourite! The customer service here is also lovely. Genuine smiles and excitement, very welcoming atmosphere (which is quite rare nowadays). Look forward to our next visit. Keen to try other items on the menu

Amazing first time experience, glad I choose to go in and order. These guys were so welcoming, and I appreciated the time to explain the menu. Highly recommend especially for some good food and great service!

You can smell the pizza as soon as you enter! It’s amazing! Their service is good, and let us close the doors when we decided to eat at the shop. We will definitely go again. The pizza bread is really good, cooked just right. They are pretty generous with the toppings too. We ordered Italian and pineapple & chicken
This place is amazing! BEST PIZZA SPOT OIT WEST! Totally recommend, my friends and I got a smoky BBQ, cheese Garlic bread and loaded fries and everything was soo good! We will come back for sure!!
Delicious food for a great price. I had rice noodles with braised bone, the meat is very tender, the broth is rich and full of flavors. Plus great service, highly recommended.
Spicy squid and Maotai-flavor potato beef brisket are my lunch with my friends. The taste is not bad, the environment is great, and it is quiet. Will come again next time.
The pork soup broth was delicious 😋, good generous amount. I really enjoyed my meal with the side dishes. A fantastic spot for great food.

solid spot for a hearty meal. Their signature rice noodles with beef are comforting and flavorful, with a rich broth that hits the spot. The portions are generous, so come hungry. The staff are friendly, and the service is quick, making it a great choice for a satisfying lunch or dinner. The only downside is that it can get a bit busy during peak hours, so be prepared to wait. Overall, it's a great place to enjoy authentic Chinese rice noodles.

Have been to this place many times including Dagu in other locations. The atmosphere was always pleasant and comfortable. Service was friendly and fast. To date all the choices selected were tasty and portion was good with a free bowl of noodle. Keen on noodles? Try Dagu. Recommended.

Order from jimijimi X cha+ all the time on Uber eats and was very disappointed to receive this fried squid today… for $12 they used to make a bigger/better portion of this. Milk teas are always great 👍🏻

Changed my review to five stars cause this place is actually good. They’ve provided me a way to get in to resolve the matter. I appreciate that and will be back. Genuinely recommend the chicken bento here and their ice teas are amazing I usually get the coconut milk tea.

I walked in and the server just stared at me until I said hello Ordered my food and said have here and she said okay 10min I sat down and waited 25min so I went and checked and the lady said yeah your food here There it was sitting there in a takeaway bag I said "oh I've been sitting here waiting for 25min why didn't you bring it to me?" She said "sorry" The food was cold, the salad boring Terrible service and for the price I'd expect better food, might have been better if it was warm
Had delicious fried chicken here and bubble tea! Space is small but they give you cute reusable bags!
They focus more on bubble teas (which are really nice), I usually get the chicken with rice and salad, which is a decent size and tastes good.

Barely any meat in the biryani. It was just rice cooked with meat pieces that were over cooked. The curry was absolutely sweet even when we asked for a medium. Will not order again. It’s funny how the restaurant responds to an honest review. We are not here to argue, just need to let others know about what we experienced.

I had dinner there this evening and, unfortunately, found a long black hair in my lamb korma 🤮. This happened right at the end of my meal, which I had been enjoying until that point. When I brought it to the staff’s attention, I was told the chef is bald—as if that rules out any possibility of hair ending up in the food. I have brown hair, and if there were even a chance it was my own, I wouldn’t have raised it. After inspecting the hair carefully, I can confidently say it wasn’t mine. I simply expected better food hygiene and a more professional response. Unfortunately, this experience has put me off entirely—I won’t be returning.
Had a great experience at restaurant. The food was amazing and the staff was lovely. Would recommend anyone to come here. 10/10
Great portion . And amazing food . Hands down my favorite curry place of all time . Amazing work .my go to is spicy butter chicken but all there food is delicious.
Amazing food, great service, highly recommend. My favourite Indian place anywhere in Auckland.

Usually the night team is on and It looked like a completely new set of workers, but tonight and another time they messed up an order. I ordered a burger with extras in it only for it to come without what I asked for (twice as this happened on a previous occasion. Not to mention one of the other burgers I ordered looked like a sad piece of work, I’d compare it to someone who really hates their job and slammed together the quickest burger you can think of. Everything else was fine but the main meal should at least be done right.
Macca’s been on point! Every time I go, it’s fresh as – chips hot, burgers stacked right, everything bang on. Love using the coupons too – always a good deal and heaps of them. Solid feed every time!

I visited around 8:30-9pm on Saturday 10th of may, Disappointed with my experience. First, at the second window, the staff member dropped our Happy Meal on the road and didn’t even offer to replace it. Instead, she asked us to look inside and check if it was still “alright.” It fell on the ground — you should replace it, no questions asked. Second, I asked to swap the burgers in the $33 Share Box and was told by staff that no swaps were allowed. I was sure you could swap three of them for any favourite burger (just not the cheeseburger) — and turns out I was right. Not impressed with being told the wrong info so confidently. Just left feeling let down by the service overall.
Always love McDonald's, I always visit this store, bcz I work next to it. Always fast service, quick food, friendly staff.

Absolutely disgusting!!! Ordered a combo and only after nearly finished with the fries, we realised there is a strand of hair, attached to it are 2 small pieces of white stuff. Looks like dough? We threw up instantly. Angry and disappointed. If it was just a piece of hair, we would have ignored it but this is next level of sickness. For the sake of your health and well-being don't go here. Or dine at your own risk! Shocking!!

Critical Food Safety Failure: Repeated Allergy Risk! My recent online order from Pita Pit Te Atatu, explicitly vegetarian due to an allergy, shockingly contained a full orders worth of chicken (in addition to falafel). Which has led to debilitating illness. This isn't an isolated incident; a month ago, we experienced severe cross-contamination from this branch. Despite assurances then that staff would receive further training, this latest error proves otherwise. While I understand checking my order is an option, a reputable establishment like Pita Pit shouldn't require "babysitting" to ensure basic food safety for declared allergies. The gravity of food allergies cannot be overstated; like nut allergies, they can be life-threatening. For a food establishment to repeatedly fail in managing declared allergies, especially after prior notification, is unacceptable and dangerous. I strongly advise against ordering from Pita Pit Te Atatu if you have any dietary restrictions or allergies, as the risk to your health is demonstrably high. I have already contacted the Pita Pit head office and are waiting on a response.
Tidy store. On various occasions we were late and they let us dine in. So accomodating. Team carefully listens to the selection. Our pita was yumm. Thank you so much
Staff need better food handling training. Ordered 2x chicken pitas and the meat was still cold after the grill.
Ordered loaded wedges and got home to realise that the wedges were still frozen and hard on the inside

Been a regular here for a while but had different (new?) staff today maybe that's why the quality and service was down as it's usually top notch The issues: 1. Wedges were undercooked 2. No hot sauce on the pita which I specifically asked for 3. No dipping sauce with the wedges 4. No bag - was given the pitas and wedges in hand. 5. Pitas lacked favours, full of lettuce. Hope it improves next time I go there otherwise will have to cross this place off my list.

Only one staff taking, making and giving order. She was nice in under pressure but should short out staffing issue in busy hours. I had to wait extra for event order then showing on app and missed first half of it
Pizza was really good, made on time and person behind counter was really friendly. Would happily order from here again when in need of a cheap snack.
This is the last time i get pizza from you guys got a chicken and bacon ranch with cheese burst. Where's the cheese burst?

I ordered a vegetarian pizza which was ready in less than ten minutes, only cost $7 (I couldn't make a pizza at home for that price), tasted good, was more than enough for one person, and the staff were friendly and professional. I'd go back.
The new owners here are really making an effort, the pizza is the best domino’s I’ve had for a while !

I’ve had an excellent experience on my last three visits to Tank. Most recently the female staff member was flat out completing an uber order and getting ready to close the store but still did mine, and advised me about combo deals for next time, which I appreciated. I find the staff friendly and helpful, just busy.
I would give the lovely girl who made my order a million stars for amazing customer service, patience and efficient service!! Great job and thankyou for being so kind 😊
say open at 9am .. I got there and shop still closed, and I arrived at 9:20. Not the first time too :/ just wanted my strawberry lush
For some reason wasn’t able to order online but when I went to the store it was open but the tank website says they don’t open until 4 pm

Not a fan of the new packaging - everything was dumped in a bowl without it being mixed. Everything was dry and I nearly choked on a crisp because they weren’t broken into smaller pieces. You’d have to go home and actually mix and break everything yourself before you can eat the meal.

I was thoroughly impressed! Their seafood menu is exceptional, featuring a wide array of fresh and delicious options. For those who prefer non-seafood dishes, they also offer a fantastic selection that doesn’t disappoint. What truly sets the Hightide apart is their unbeatable prices. I’m confident you won’t find such high-quality food at such an affordable price anywhere else. Don’t miss out on their dessert menu either—it’s the perfect way to end a delightful meal. Highly recommend!

Celebrated my birthday with my family here tonight. Food was amazing. My Surf & Turf was so delicious that I ate everything on my plate for the first time ever. Compliments to the chefs. The staff also blessed us with a beautiful dessert. That TIRAMASU!!! OMG is to die for. Its gotta be the best I've ever had. Highly recommend it. All and all a lovely stress free, chilled evening. Quick Service, and a very cosy and comfortable. A massive thankyou to my children, my family, the staff of High Tide, and the Te Atatu Boat Club.
Came down for my mother’s birthday ! So glad we did! Food was great, tummy’s are full n happy 😊 awesome service
Pricing on these menus are incredible! Hidden gem in Te atatu 🚢

Thank you for the great service. The food was great, and your speed of service was 5/5. That surf & Turf was so good with the scotch filled cooked to perfection. Lets not forget the tiramisu desert that melts in your mouth. To die for. Thank you so much for your great hospitality. I definitely will be back with the whanau again for more 😁
Got the Souvlaki Wrap which was nice and spicy. The Chips could’ve been seasoned with chicken salt but they were still decent. 4 stars.

I think there was a spoonful of meat in the super kebab I bought. I was searching for it. Very disappointed. Seems like the price has gone up but the quality is poor. Will think twice before buying from here.
5 stars for the mixed on rice! So tasty & a decent serving of salad. First time trying this place due to stumbling past it. We will definitely be back!
Great food, however the worker making my kebab was not wearing gloves.

I ordered a chicken kebab and asked them to put more of the garlic yoghurt, mint sauce and sweet chillies sauce, got home started eating it and finding out there was hardly any garlic yoghurt, mint sauce and sweet Chilli sauce in my kebab and the chicken was dry. Very disappointed especially when they charge $18 for the kebab. Never going back again.
Super nice food! Super friendly staff willing to do the extra mile every time! Coffee is better than most coffee specific places! All at a great price! 6/5 stars
Best cream donut ever, had the passionfruit one. The hot chips looked good too. Super friendly staff. Coming here now everytime I visit from Australia.
I love the food and drink here!❤️ They deserve to have 10⭐️ Love it The bubble tea way better than GC🫶🏻
One of the best and most consistent Bakery on the Peninsula.

Absolutely love the food and the people are so helpful and easy going. If something isnt there all you have to do is ask and they will generally make it if they can. Not badly priced and they have just increased their range with boba tea, frappes and ice cream. My go to bakery!!

My partner and I just moved into the area and ordered the sweet and sour pork on chow mein the night we moved - and it was amazing! We got lucky after a big day of moving with a delicious meal from a local.
