We ordered the same again recently and it was equally delicious, also awesome portion sizes for the price and really friendly guy. Thank you! We are stoked this is our local!!

Recently came across this place, and though we'd try it. Overall, a pretty solid place to grab lunch! There was some nice variety in both the smorgasbord, and the menu. We ordered bento boxes (where you can choose from a range of meats/vegetables and fried rice/noodles); it made for a very easy and filling meal. We also ordered pork chive dumplings which were fresh, crispy on the outside, and delicate on the inside! (would recommend) This place is worth a visit if you're looking to grab some good lunch that's also good value.

Ordered off uber eats, unfortunately, I paid $100 for 2 chowmeins and 1 half duck and yet all that come was a pile of bones with some fat on it, and the chowmeins had almost zero meat was basically just noodles all very dry. Would not recommend.
Best place. Really enjoyed vege tofu rice bowl
Ordered honey chicken through Uber Eats received pork. Stomach cramps began 20 minutes after eating. I do not recommend

When I think of a café that does the essentials really well, this one comes to mind. The food, the presentation, the professionalism, the warmth, the vibes reminds me of everything a great café should strive towards. The prices were also wallet friendly but the food and drinks still maintained a quality equal or even better than some major cafe chains. Well done, highly recommend for accessibility and space too. Would come here again.

2nd breakfast visit, food is outstanding both fresh and flavorful not to mention portions are generous. Can be a struggle getting a park but you can park on the side street or walk over from the supermarket, well worth the short walk and you will need to walk off the food when you're done as I was full. Will be back as there are plenty of options yet to try. Honorable mention to the girls behind the counter as service with a smile is always a plus, thank you for a lovely breakfast.

Eggs benedict was nice, a little bit more tang for me on the hollandaise. Quiche was spinach and cheese was very tasty. Beef and cheese, meat was pulled beef a little on the salty side but that's to taste as I don't eat that much salt. All in all a very good experience.
Never seen such brown bacon looks like it has been in the fridge for weeks and then deep fried and served up to me Stay away from here

I’ve been coming here for years and I’ve never been disappointed. Beautiful views, amazing food, friendly staff and high quality ingredients. Reasonably priced too! Highly recommend this wonderful cafe for anyone who is in the area.

Haven't had decent Chinese since The Flying Horse Chinese in Takapuna. First time and Wow everything was fabulous. Great taking the order on the phone! We had wontons & dumplings that were huge and full of meat with a decent tub of sauce! Fried rice, S&S Pork, Chicken CM very tasty and great servings. Definitely coming again!! Well done!

Looveee the sweet and sour prawns and the chicken nibbles!! Very delicious 🤤 coating is not oily or greasy at all! Big portion fried rice enough for 2 people. Food worth the price. Will try dumplings next time and burger 😌
Top notch takeaways there is good reason why they have been in business for so long and is always busy wouldn't hurt them to add beetroot to their shopping list though.
Good food, but they don’t take credit card or payWave which was not communicated when placing a phone order.

The best in Auckland City! Fresh vegetables, fresh meats, and generous portions with a good amount of meat. Experienced, old-school chefs who know how to cook! Best of all, their consistency is unmatched. Whether it's a month later or a year later, their food is still perfect. Thank you, Happy Alright!
Without a doubt the best fish and chips in West Auckland. Delicious fish, awesome batter. Great burgers and primo buns. Primo kumara and normal chips.
Had fish n chips hoki. Potatoe fritters, spring roll and crab stick. Batter was nice n thin. Fish was good, thin but good. Spring roll had a good flavor but was flat. Overall good place.
Awesome fish and chips. Must change the oil often as both the chips and the batter were very good.

Chips are precovid serving sizes, coming from the CBD I expected half of what I got for the price. The chicken burger is a good run for the money in terms of taste. Looks basic but the garnish is mad good
Best takeaway steak burger I've ever had in my 28years of life! So yum and the quality of the steak is juicy tender and good quality. Big 👍z up to the chef keep it up 🙌🤤

Got double beef and fries and the fries were peeeerfect. I am always on the search for great fries and they really were good. Super crunchy and fresh. Almost like beer battered. The burger was great as well. The patty had great flavor and the lettuce tasted fresh. The slightly spicy pickles really rounded up the flavors. Glad that I won't have to go too far to look for a good burger
Restored my faith in local burger joints! Online ordering was straight forward & burgers & chips were delicious - high quality ingredients making the difference!

Hawaiian chicken burger is my absolute favourite. I've ordered it 6 seperate times going in store and delivery and each time it’s been just as delicious I highly recommend. Lunch time is best time to order as it’s not busy. Love the fresh ingredients and the fries are so good.
Big Bang Burgers is currently my favourite takeaway shop, the fries are the best I’ve ever had! The burgers are amazing and staff are always friendly, food is prepared fast etc. Definitely recommend!

Wow, amazing. I had the gluten free Hawaiian chicken burger, from the 1st bite it mounted in my mouth. Chips are amazing to. Did a fantastic job, food is so tasty, and great size burgers and good price. We found our new local food place. Highly recommend going and trying them out. A++++++++++

Have been here several times and have always loved the food and service. Went here tonight with friends and was very disappointed. Have always ordered the prawn and scallop “buddy” dish. On our recommendation our friends and us ordered the “buddy” dish. tonight there were half the number of prawns and scallops (have always got 6 scallops and 6 prawns) and my serving had no cashews. I told the waitress I was disappointed, she said she would tell the manager. From that moment on there was no further contact We will not be returning. A little customer service would go a long way

Worst service ever. Made an online order for 6:30 pick up. Arrived at 6:20 to pay and wait for the order. At 6:50 after waiting 20 mins, asked how far til we got our food to take away, was told 5 mins. Another 20 mins later asked again - at 7:20 asked if our order could be cancelled as we’d been waiting nearly an hour, which they obliged with half hearted “sorry” - if you can’t cope with online orders plus run the restaurant, disable to service. Waiting an hour longer just to pick up a takeaway isn’t acceptable. It was a small and straightforward order so there’s just no excuse. Rubbish service, and we won’t be back

Restaurant is absolutely beautiful with a romantic feel to it. Perfect for date night. Delicious food and they come round and top up your rice! Service is very friendly. Recommend the Thai fried rice!

The first time I can order a rare item from the Thai restaurant in Auckland, I get the same taste as I had it in Thai. My fish and seafood were so clean and fresh. It highly recommended here, if you want to have the original taste as Thailand.

Staff are very friendly and restaurant itself really gives a Thai feel with the background music and decor. The food is presented well and appetising but hard to compete in flavour and quantity with so many Thai food options within a suburb away which are a bit cheaper. Still a good experience.

When I found out that the other shop was temporarily closed, I was bummed til I googled and found this! The bibimap was thinner than usually but bigger in diameter and they’re tasty as!! They have outdoor dining with three tables and chairs with shade form the sun depending one when you go! Nice and quiet area! Lots of parking right outside with a park across the road to chill! Lovely staff and very accomodating! Wish they had more range tho but great tasting bibimap nonetheless! I especially like the Gojujang Chicken one! (Pictured) That hits different!

♿ wheelchair accessible Parking and entry 🚻 toilet A small size store with self service and or order your own personal choices I came in for take away and ordered the Steamed dumplings 😋 $6.50 for 6 Tofu donburi $18.50 Pork katsu $16.90 dine in doors or dine outdoors or take away. Nice service 😀
Best sushi in Auckland 👍 Always return here
Fantastic sushi and sashimi, always fresh. Friendly service and reasonable prices. Recommended.
Sushi was 90% rice with almost no filling, Salmon avocado rolls have almost 0 avocado

Arrived at Mr Illingsworth around about 4.15pm, plenty of tables available. We ordered Eye Fillet Steak with chips and salad and Scotch Fillet with chips and slaw. The Eye fillet was tough and was sliced (I assumed this was supposed to make it look more than it actually was) the salad was basic and the chips were nearly lukewarm as the Garlic Butter didn’t even melt. The Scotch Fillet was also tough, chips barely lukewarm and the slaw unappealing like it was out of a store brought bag. Third time we have dined there, there won’t be a fourth.

We like the vibe of this place. It was very spacious and good TV screens. Perfect for a sports event. The food could have been slightly better. We thought it was a little bit oily but maybe it was just the dishes we had. The staff were very nice. Very spacious place toilets for clean, though they didn't have a baby changing room. But overall all good.

About my / our 5 th visit here in last 2 months. Really good pub food, staff are all excellent and very personable. Nothing complicated and executed well. Will be back every time I’m back in Auckland/ TeAtatu Cheers

Nice open plan dining. They have table service. Stools and tables near the bar. Outside area with DJ on the weekend. The team are very friendly and service is great. The food is tasty and good servings, especially the Fries (best I’ve tasted). Beer and Wine are chilled. But best of all is the Deserts. They were delightful. Very tasty and great portions. Anton who works there is so friendly and helpful. Definitely will be back and good for work function.

We had a lovely Sunday lunch here with friends. The food was great, especially the fish tacos. The staff were absolutely fabulous! Only dropped it down a star on atmosphere because it was quite cold inside. Having said that it was an awful day outside so maybe that was the influence there.
Excellent night out great food and people. Food was delicious
Well...I ordered my favorite rum shank. Wow! Outrageously yummy!that I wanted to eat..made my day... Thank you very much! lovely to find out new favorite restaurant today.

Went for a family members birthday. Food was excellent. In particular the sauces, out of this world!. Service was good despite being super busy. Only feedback for improvement is to buy a fresh pack of kids pencils, and perhaps add a one or two side dish options or kids meal options to the menu, also the tables are wobbly!

Ettu is an absolute gem! We love the welcoming local vibe paired with consistently high-quality food. Murray is a fantastic host who makes every visit feel special, and Mark, the chef, never fails to impress with delicious, flavorful dishes. We rarely venture off the peninsula to dine out because we know we have something truly special right here. Highly recommend Ettu to anyone looking for a top-notch local experience!

Great place to dine with nice ambience and great service. Everything Ive tried from here has been delicious from entres to mains. But what I will say from my last visit was I was a little surprised at my plate of beef cheeks. I have ordered this dish many times but this time it was different, it was served in a small bowl on top of mash with sauce and that was it. Are you serious? It use to come here at least twice a month so I know how it was and what it was like and it wasnt like that. That richness needs something to cut it like a pickle or veg otherwise you will feel like its missing something...and to me it was. Other than that everything you order everytime has been delicious. Could you please put up some recent piks of your food so we can actually see what is on offer. Thanks...Ill be returning soon
Food is yummy, need more sauce on kebab, not a huge range of sauce available either
The team at Haddads are a friendly group who are always happy to see me. Te Atatu Burger is my go to. Burgers have plenty of filling, chips are crispy and well seasoned.
Ordered fish and chips and fish tasted like it was a store bought frozen fish , also got 2 deep fried mars bars and they had peanuts in it where mars don’t have peanuts 🤷‍♂️

Really great place to grab a quick bite, love there steak sandwiches and loaded fires! There chips are good not too soggy and just the right amount of crunchy. If you have coin try out there retro street fighter game.

A go-to place for me and my partner, I always get the kebab combo and it’s the best as usual! Portion of the kebab is a bit small (used to Australian kebab sizes) but it’s very filling and honestly my favourite from here! Best kebab shop I’ve had out west so far.

If i could give 0 stars i would, i bought their $22 deal of 20 chicken nibbles & chips just to arrive home to check chickens were too crispy & fries literally less than a $2 chips. I bought 4x of this deal🤦🏻‍♀️ Please do better if you want customers to come back because as for me and mines it’s our first and last.

Ordered fish, chips, battered hot dogs & chicken nibbles. The nibbles were the best part. Everything else was 🥴 Chip scoop size was rubbish. The chips were soggy and floppy. The fish. Like the chips had the same problem. Straight from the freezer into some batter & thrown in the deep fryer. I immediately regret ordering from here. I got them confused with DOUBLE HAPPY Takeaways when ordering online. So went to double happy and they said I was at the wrong spot. Drove down to the peninsula thinking I’d give these guys a shot. Never again. Secretly wish I didn’t collect my order from here as I have been feeling queasy and yuck after eating their stuff. If you want good fish and chips. DOUBLE HAPPY takeaways. These guys make a lacklustre effort and it shows in the taste and quality of their fried fish & chips
Absolutely terrible. Does not even deserve one star. 17.50 per dish. The chop suey tastes like boiled water and the sweet and sour pork was sugary batter ! Theiving mongrels !
BUGS IN THE BATTER, LITTLE BLACK WINGS AND LEGS AND BUGS ALL THROUGH OUT EVERY THING BATTERED😾
Food was fantastic, great quantity n great quality. Excellent n quick service [had it brought to us]. Nice chunky chips, burgers were brilliant with a very nice fish. Definitely keen to go back again
I’ve just traveled to the Peninsula and tried the chicken katsu with chips for the first time. I was pleasantly surprised! For just $14.50, I got a generous portion, and it tasted fantastic.

Food are delicious!👍……nice prices! I saw my classmates eat their food, so I went here. I payed $9 got 2 big chicken sushi and 1 box fried chicken. The size very well. If you work or study around here, this would be a place you can go always. And don’t need wait long time, because some food are ready to eat in this restaurant.

Chicken katsu was really nice, freshly fried and not too thin like most places. Good portion size for the price which is for me is filling enough to be content. Will come back and try other menu items.

This place is so good. Their lunch special is generous. I had the teriyaki salmon, and it was delicious. The portion of salmon is generous. I gave the atmosphere 3 stars, but only because it's a takeaway shop. There is nothing inherently wrong with this place. There were 9 of us eating in, and we filled the place up! The staff is friendly and helpful.

One of my all time secret favourite places to eat out in West Auckland. I’ve been coming here for years and the staff are amazing! The dragon roll and salmon cream cheese is my go to! Quality food all the time, you won’t be disappointed! Also try their beef don, so fresh and made with love! I drive all the way from Mangere to eat here!

Very disappointed!! Especially when you spend $120 for bland & absolutely tasteless food. We ordered the Fish Thai green curry, chicken fried rice, steak chow mein, wonton soup, chips, nuggets, deep fried wontons & home made dumplings. Fish Thai green curry: Very bland tasting Thai dish, no seasoning at all & barely any fish! Probably only had 4 pieces total which were tiny & the rest was filled with plain boiled rice & loads of vegetables. Chicken fried rice: Chicken was dry & overall a very bland dish. Just tasted like plain boiled rice, no soy sauce or love whatsoever. Steak chow mein: Again a very underwhelming dish, little to no steak, packed with veggies & the sauce was very bland. Wonton soup: I wouldn’t even call it a soup, it was just plain old hot water with wontons, broccoli & meat floating in it. Most tasteless wonton soup I’ve ever tried. Had to add my own fresh chilli & sauces to give it some life. Chips: Old chips, tasted like they had been reheated or fried again as they were stale & very oily. Only pleasant items were the deep fried wontons, generous meat filling & crispy. Also the homemade dumplings were delicious & surprisingly had seasoning. To the reviews saying this is the best or one of the best Chinese spots in Auckland have no tastebuds. An absolute waste of money & calories lol
I absolutely love coming here. The food is always Amazing. Freshly made and they don't take long. Exceptionally clean every time. The best Chinese in Westmere.
Happy Takeaways is my faimlya go to for cheap eats. The food here is really good and dirt cheap, staff are super helpful and it dosent take long for your food to be ready. Couldnt recomend more!

Best Chinese in Auckland. Our family have been going since they opened in the 70s I think. My whole life it has been our go to and has never changed. Exceptional food and lovely family owned business. Can't recommend enough.
Went there to grab Dinner around 7pmish. Was packed with people waiting for food. And the chefs where going hard cooking fast. Surprisingly our food came out fast and it was very tasty.

This is a nice community cafe, my family and I have been coming here for years. New owners now but the same quality food and service is present. Thank you to the team for providing a good place to eat and unwind in the neighbourhood.

Had lunch here today for the first time. When entering I didn’t feel any warm welcome. Instead, I was given a menu only. Unappealing interior & wobbly outdoor chairs. Got creamy mushrooms which was tasty and my partner had a big breakfast which was disappointing. It was unenthusiastic and not even as big as its name. However their coffee was good.
Lovely tasty food, reasonable priced and very friendly staff. Went there first time two weeks ago, randomly and enjoyed it a lot. Good tasting iced coffee aswell, also Gluten-free options available.

This is the second time I go to The Corner Cafe. I had a keto omelette with spinash, salmon and mushrooms. It was very tasty, and a good size, considering I was quite hungry. My colleagues had other meals that were also nourishing, and fair price. The ambience was quiet, we could talk. The staff was, friendly, the toilet was clean. Street parking. A place to go back.

Lovely, adorable cafe with friendly staff, cozy environment, and tasty food. I got the corn fritters with bacon and my mum got scrambled eggs with tomatos and chorizo. Very yummy and perfect portions.

The best breakfast and coffee I’ve had in a very long time! The staff were incredibly friendly, accommodating, and offered great suggestions. The coffee was exceptional — smooth, rich, and perfectly brewed. The food was beautifully balanced, introducing fresh flavours I hadn’t tried before. Highly recommend this spot if you’re after something special to start your day!

Breakfast of the year. So refreshing to find a place that takes so much pride in delivering an experience of tastes and flavours you wouldn’t do at home. Coffee excellent. Portions generous. Plating considered and overall experience memorable. Thanks team, we will be back often.
Wow! I'd never heard of Russian pancakes, and I swear I don't want to hear about them any other way. The experience was wonderful. I highly recommend the desserts.

Lovely cafe with a novel and great looking menu. We had the Russian pancakes which was well balanced and delicious. My only complaint is that the $8 optional addition of bacon was just one piece of streaky bacon!! That is pretty stingy, 2-3 is the norm elsewhere. Staff were lovely and the cabinet food looked great too.

I wasn't expecting too much, but Yes the food was impressive. I ordered the beach breakfast, and was very impressed with the way it was plated and tasted. Everyone else with me, had different dishes, and were all very happy. Well done to the kitchen and wait staff.

The service was impeccable - we were served by a lovely girl, who seemed shy but was great at her job :) The atmosphere was phenomenal, I didn’t realise the hidden gem was their backyard sheltered seating - it was pretty neat discovering that. My food was delectable - I have never had bacon cooked more perfect in my life. The ratio of everything was well-balanced, the eggs were poached beautifully. The sausages were divine, and the coffee art was incredible. I wish I could give half stars, because there was only a minor detail missing in my entire experience - which was the potato in my big breakfast. A hash brown substitute would have been delightful as part of the original dish, and some hollandaise on the side - but I guess that’s more of a preference thing - and I could have easily asked for those modifications. I would definitely recommend Twisted Tomato to anyone who finds themselves out that way, or live in the area.

First time visiting this cafe. Highly recommend. The food was exceptional, beautifully presented, high quality and good portion/value for dollar. We had the ham off the bone toastie and the eggs Benny, plus the berry muffin, which was divine. All of the servers were amazing, not only to our table but across every table in the cafe. Great experience, left me feeling the need to write this review, where usually I wouldn't bother to leave one.

Had a fantastic meal at Twisted Tomato! The falafel bowl was fresh and full of flavor, the Cyprus burger was perfectly cooked and delicious, and the kids’ waffle was a big hit with our little one. The service was friendly, and the atmosphere was relaxed and welcoming. Great spot for a family meal or casual lunch—highly recommend!

My reviews are very one sided because once I like something I ONLY order that one thing… for this cafe its Halloumi and pea fritters. OMG the best thing you will ever taste. It comes with a bit of salad on the side but for a fritter it has a lot of taste ! They sprinkle different spices on top which I really enjoy but if you are not a huge fan ask staff to take it out. This place can get pretty packed with locals coming in - so just be aware it can get noisy :-)

We loved everything about having lunch at Twisted Tomato today. Friendly staff, good selection of drinks (very hard to beat their classic chocolate shake!) and delicious food - we had the Poke bowl and the pork belly salad. Both were super tasty. Definitely would recommend this place as a great place to come for a bite to eat and a drink. 10/10 ⭐️

Worst roast shop and takeaway I’ve ever had! Seriously don’t eat here. The beef and lamb was odd, beef tasted like liver and lamb tasted like a mineral. I’ve never had anything like it. Peas were soggy and floury. The potatoes were rubbish, pumpkin and kumera was firm in the middle and seemed like they had been steamed. The gravy was like salty water.
Just had a fantastic pork roast here! Super delicious.

Lunch time for a hot pork filled roll. No salad available for the roll, stale bread but nice pork and token crackle. Service: no smiles or even a greeting and abrupt at every point. I won’t go back and wouldn’t advise others to spend their hard earned there. If you want my money at least be pleasant to me.

New owners, i have been twice in the last 2 months both times they forget to add apple sauce to the roast meal. I asked to put gravey on the bottom of the container before placing food in, they look at you weird, i just like it this way really simple request to ask. The meat was dry and pumpkin cold, not good like it use to be.
This used to be THE BEST for roast potatoes. Something has changed - undercooked, less golden - not as good as they used to be EDIT: it’s because there is new owners and they are clueless

Terrible experience tonight drive through all round. The lady at the drive through was rushing us through our order. So much so, when we got to the window, she had split our order of two meals into two separate orders. When she gave us the bag of food, she shoved it so much the bag ripped and I had to cradle it to get it into the car without the food falling out. When we got home, the drinks (sprite) were flat and not cold, the zinger burger box wasn’t even in a box and the burger was almost coming out of the packaging. Half the meat was missing off my drumstick, and the meat remaining had no coating. The chips were soggy, but I’ll get them a star as they did put extra seasoning on. Our chicken, bun and burger was all luke warm so we had to put it in the microwave to heat it up. The only thing that was good was the potato and gravy. All in all, extremely disappointing and overpriced meal and will not be returning.

wanted to provide feedback about my recent visit to KFC Pt Chev. Unfortunately, I felt that the service from the team members could be improved. His name is Sasanka Dillini It seemed like they were struggling to attend to customers' needs efficiently. I hope you can provide additional training to enhance their customer service skills." Plus they give me 8 piece chicken and asked for 10 pieces and lot of seasoning on the chips .Disappointing experience at KFC Pt Chev. The staff seemed completely clueless and uninterested in serving customers. Long wait times and poor service. Definitely won't be back."

ENOUGH IS ENOUGH...‼️ 😡❌❗🚫 Hands Down, Point Chev KFC is consistently the worse branch in Auckland..! The Lady at the window can barely speak English and the food.....my word!!! (scroll down to pics) RIPOFF, BURNT, OR DRYER THAN your dad's jokes!! Literally taste like Burnt Oily toast..!! They don't allow you to choose 3 sides, None of their Family sized buckets come with Coleslaw, You have to buy that seperate! This place is a joke.!!! The quality is absolute rubbish..! I get better fried chicken at Green Jades Takeaway in Avondale.!! Even the drumsticks at Green Jades are a lot bigger ..! If u want KFC "DRIVE PAST POINT CHEV KFC AND GO TO AVONDALE OR NEW LYNN"!! you can thank me later. Note: pics are 2 days old. Drumsticks were the size of a TABLESPOON..! 😳😤😡 I put it next to a chicken wing for comparison. Potato n gravy was mainly gravy and they hardly filled the damn container. Wicked Wings were oily and burnt. coleslaw was all water no slaw U get my point! Prices do not reflect quality and quantity or undersized and underfilled products. I want my money back!!
Large chips - got home and looks like someone tipped a small size into a large box ! Not got enough when you pay for an upsize!

The staff was friendly and observed suggestive selling of products. Asked for some customisation they were very happy to serve our meal.. the quality was perfect and accurate order was packed very quick. I would recommend more visits to the store

I absolutely love Tanwa. It's the best Thai I've found, and it's right up there with Francesca's for the best takeaway meal in Pt Chev. Always so fresh and flavoursome. Hint: It's worth paying extra for the crispy pork.
The food was great, and the portion sizes were just right. We packed it up and headed to Coyle Park to relax in the evening. -11/12/2023

The team went above and beyond to make sure allergies were catered for (a gluten free, egg free vegetarian) and that person was thrilled with what they got. Thanks so much for the amazing customer service
Very satisfied when buying food here, delicious food like when I traveled to Thailand, reasonable price.
Very poor Thai beef salad. Very little meat, over salted and not good flavor. No attempt to reverse transaction. Not going back!!
Wood fired pizzas are a rare find these days. Highly recommended if you're in pt chev.
The wood-fired pizza was so delicious that after finishing one, we immediately ordered another.
The best pizza in Auckland by far and good value. The taste is leagues better than Napoli Contemporanea or the other pizza restaurants in Auckland.
Owner is great! He's the cook and a character. Food awesome and deserts special. Place feels like you descovered a hidden gem.

I had an unfairly bad customer service, which made me very disappointed. It all started when the chef tried to charge me 28.5 for a 27.5 pizza. Not much, but why? After I pointed that out, he tried to bullshit me saying it is paywave surcharge, despite me paying debit & inserted. He promptly promised me a cash refund, but probably got angry with my "pettiness". He made me wait extra 5-7 minutes for my pizza (it was just sitting boxed in his prep area). He explained it: "the other guy came before you, so I couldn't release your pizza earlier" (mind blown). He then painstakingly counted 10x10c coins and gave me. Money is money but it did look like a further attempt to humiliate me. The pizza turned out average with a lot of soot on the bottom. On top of it, the wait was 35 minutes instead of "good 10". Alas, I can not recommend this place..

6 Aug 2025 bought 2 pieces of fish $5 chips and a steak burger. When I got home, opened up the paper and was disappointed at how barely cooked the fish was as both were soggy and the batter barely covered both pieces so I put both pieces in the air fryer to try and brown them but gave up. Fish was tasteless The fries were ok

Last night I bought fish and chips here. They were the VERY BEST that I can remember having! Chips wonderful, fish excellent. The staff were friendly and helpful (giving drawn instructions for the beach detour) and their prices were good value too. One of Auckland's best kept secrets!

Crispy, flaky, juicy!! I had came here a couple months ago for a quick take away and these fish & chips at Gourmet Wok blew my mind! Service was fast. The fish was lightly battered and cooked to perfection! The fries were the best I’ve even had! There’s something delicious about where these potato fries came from. What surprised me was the fried oysters and mussels!!! It was also lightly battered and the flavor of these fried oysters and mussels really came through and it was super juicy! I’d come back again for more!

A small family run takeaway in Pt Chev, we’ve been ordering from Gourmet Wok for years. This time we ordered our favourite items, fish, chips, sausages and sweet & sour pork. The food is always great, fresh and crispy. Great value for money and fast service.

This place is take out only and has been in the area for over a decade! Cute little mom and pop shop. Fast service and the food comes out so crispy each time! I typically get their fish and chips because of how thin and crispy the fish is!

Best franchise store in Auckland I have tasted by far. Appearances from the outside are deceiving. The inside was immaculately cleaned, the lady serving was beautiful and the pizzas were to die for. The base wasn't too thick and was cooked to perfection. The toppings were generous even on the value pizzas and tasted delicious. Will definitely be returning!
Thank you so much Domino's Pt Chev for making me the perfect valentines day pizza 🍕 😍🥰 it came out better than expected! You guys are awesome 👌

Please be aware of ordering from here, we ordered a couple of traditional pizzas with a few sides via online for pick up. Timeframe on order was good, just wonder why such a short timeframe 7mins? Ok, so when we arrived back home, opened the pizza boxes, we just realized by the looks of the pizza, it looked liked what we ordered looked a lot like the $5/$6 pizzas from the value range but with the extra toppings to make it look like the traditional pizzas we ordered which was not what we expected. Have a look at the pics attached. You’ll see the meat lovers pizza looked like the value beef and onion pizza, and the creamy chicken mushroom pizza with no chopped spring onions looked like the cheesy garlic pizza, notice the difference, it’s just the toppings from the traditional pizzas slopped on top of the value pizzas. It felt like we’ve been ripped off, some sort of con going on there. Just be careful when it comes to ordering the traditional or gourmet pizzas online or in store, it may look too good to be true. Otherwise, might as well just order the value pizzas just to be on the safe side.

I am very impressed with the excellent service and pizza preparation by Satnam Singh at Domino’s Pt Chev. Satnam is genuinely polite, calm, and professional when taking orders, making the customer experience truly pleasant. He listens carefully to customer requests, which many other dominos pizza places tend to ignore, and ensures the order is prepared just the way you want it. Because of Satnam’s dedication and attention to detail, Pt Chev has become one of my favourite Domino’s stores, second only to Domino’s Quay Street. The quality and taste of the pizza here are far superior to many other outlets, thanks to team members like Satnam. I highly recommend both customers and store management to acknowledge and appreciate Satnam’s great service. I’ll definitely be returning because of this positive experience. Keep it up, Satnam!

Pizza was late. The photo shows the difference in toppings from slice to slice. They forgot my chips. When the chips came back 20 mins later they looked like this and were stone cold. The drivers were both super nice however but come on dominos pt chev, do better.

The food was extremely disappointing as it was cold, soggy, and dry. The drive-through kiosk area was also in a filthy state, showing a clear need for improvement. Initially, I wasn’t planning to leave a review on Google but after receiving a follow-up call and some vouchers as compensation, I decided to share my experience. The call itself was pleasant and the representative was apologetic, which I appreciated. However, the vouchers can only be used at specific locations. With a McDonald’s just two minutes from me, it does not make sense to travel elsewhere just to redeem them.

Staff are EXTREMELY rude and arrogant. The burger had sauce spooged on one side of it and the rest in the corner of the box. Management must not be doing their job properly to maintain standards. Really poor form.

Car park availability are a bit of hit-and-miss at the front and side area. Parking spaces behind the drive-thru are now for staff only. Speed have improved a lot hence waiting time has reduced. However, I do like how they fry the mozzarella patty as it's still quite thick and I can still taste the mozzarella rather than just the taste of deep fried batter. Their morning coffee are often really hot and can scald your tongue. Staff members are friendly, patience, courteous and awesome.
Can not be Mc Donald’s without sauce on the burger and in your bag

Pretty good as Maccas goes. Decent layout, plenty of parking. Best part is the play area which is outdoors but sheltered which means it doesn’t smell awful like the other Maccas play areas. Machines were working but the points code scanner didn’t work.
Absolutely delicious burgers – juicy, flavorful, and cooked to perfection! The service was just as impressive – fast, friendly, and welcoming. Can’t wait to come back!

I enjoyed my first visit. Will be back to try more from the menu for sure. Had the Vampires Hate Garlic burger (-tomato, +patty)... It was GREAT! Washed it down with No Sugar Kombucha. Which was weird for me but still went down a treat. Thank you. 5 stars for the atmosphere, even though major Roadworks are currently happening, I totally forgot it was on during my meal. Thanks again. A 30min break from work well spent. All the best.
Frankly the burger I got was quite sad for $22. It was limp and did not feel crisp and full of fresh flavors like you get at high end competitors burger joints. Wedges were good though.
We tried Bells aloha burger and loaded fries; both were amazing and really fresh tasting. Highly recommended and we’ll definitely be back to try some of the other burgers. Keep up the good work :)

Amazing burgers! We don't live nearby, but we'll drive all the way here again just for these burgers. Great sizes, variety of options to choose from, fresh ingredients and a friendly customer service. It is one of our go to spots now. Due to roadworks, it was tricky to find it at first but actually it's just right next to Domino's Pizza so until roadworks are done it's easier to set your gps to dominos. It also has barista coffee (kofeya coffee), ice cream and baklava. Highly recommend!

Owner or manager very rude! And flippant I had been a regular till today! I walked away annoyed and frustrated and not order! I popped in today to get the same order I had done many a visits and her saying I don't know I don't know! And I'm trying to explain ...the only extra I ever ask for is Avocado! And I pay the extras! Youn ne sushi you've lost this local chevvy! Customer
We tried the Tuna & Avocado sushi. Not fresh at all. There were more onion then tuna so taste even like vegetarian sushi. The worst tuna sushi ever tried.

Sushi was good, but service is lacking and cleanliness is always an issue - full rubbish bins, unswept floors, tables left with rubbish unwiped for ages, despite the place not being busy. They seem to regularly be out of tofu which is frustrating.
Ordered a vegetarian sushi and got fish instead. Lady was also rude Not worth coming all the way to Pt Chev for this
Best price for fresh sushi so far

I've been here quite a few times, and I am always impressed about their quality and service. Absolutely brilliant food! I couldn't even pick one dish to say that's the best, everything is great here. The portions are big and reasonable priced. I only wish they could open another restaurant in North Shore 🥰 PS: The name of the restaurant could be misleading because it is a mix between Mediterranean and Middle Eastern food, best of the 2 worlds.

Excellent food. Nice quirky place. The young lady who served the table was very gentle and kind. We ordered eggplant puree with naan bread for entrée and it was delicious. The lamb shank with mashed potato and rib beef and both meals were superb. It's a shame they don’t have beers but it goes with their tradition. Recommended!

My first encounter with The Greek House was through the convenience of Uber Eats, and let me tell you, the quality and authentic taste of their dishes shone through the delivery process. It was so impressive, in fact, that it inspired a second visit – this time in person – and I'm so glad I did! Stepping into The Greek House is like being transported straight to a cozy taverna. The ambience of the restaurant is truly delightful, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere that enhances the dining experience. It's the kind of place where you can relax and savor your meal. While the food is undoubtedly the star, it's worth noting that fresh, delicious Greek cuisine takes a little time. Be prepared for a roughly 20-minute wait for your order, but trust me, it's well worth it. Plan your cordingly so you can fully enjoy the experience without feeling rushed. Beyond the fantastic food and inviting atmosphere, the staff at The Greek House are truly commendable. They were consistently helpful and friendly, adding to the overall positive impression. While my initial delivery experience was great, I wholeheartedly recommend visiting The Greek House in person to fully appreciate the ambience and enjoy the complete dining experience. From the delicious, authentic flavors to the welcoming atmosphere and friendly service, The Greek House has certainly earned a spot on my list of favorite local eateries. I'll definitely be back!

I can't believe we haven't discovered this place before. Literally 5 minutes from home and honestly, some of the best greek food I've ever had. The flavours were incredible, really large portions, really reasonably priced and such lovely people. If you haven't tried this place, book it in. And it's worth travelling for if you don't live around the corner. 😉 We'll definitely be back!!

I’m a returning customer and it’s for a good reason. Value for your money with huge servings! The food is five star - get the Mandy (half a chicken for $25 in Auckland!) and the Kebab platter (this can be shared for $40!). All the ladies were friendly and knowledgeable about what’s good in the menu if it’s your first time. Finish your meal with the best backlava in NZ.

Lunch with friends. We chose our favourite salmon bagel. Excellent. 'Cept cutting the rock-hard bagel was a problem. We asked for a steak knife. Still didn't do the job. Didn't think they had an electric saw. Next time we'll ask that it be stacked on soft toast.

Popped in for a quick bite and was pleasantly surprised! The coffee was smooth and well-made, and the egg and pickled onion roll was super tasty — simple but packed with flavour. Great little spot with a relaxed vibe. Will definitely be back!
I got the bacon pancakes and a chai latte! Chai was goos, pancakes were also good but it was very expensive. I paid $35 for pancakes and $6.50 for the chai!

Thought to check it out as it seemed very popular with the locals. Pretty standard food, atmosphere, nothing too special about it. Prices were on the slightly higher end of 20s mark, personally didn’t feel the menu was special or unique enough to justify the cost.

We visited the cafe on recommendation from our Airbnb host back on a trip in November. We came across a picture of our meal and decided to leave a review because it was one of the best coffees and breakfasts we’ve ever had. So good we’re still talking about it several months later. Please check this place out!!
Definitely one of the best Thai food we had in New Zealand! Highly recommend the tom yum goong and pad thai :) amazing authentic flavours at decent prices. We left happy and satisfied!

I would say ESARN ROCKET can cook authentic Thai Street Food! We ordered Hot & Sour Pork Bones Soup เล้ง, Som Tum Thai ส้มตำไทย and Spicy Pork Liver Salad ตับหวาน. All are delicious, perfect combination of lime juice/ fish sauce and all other ingredients. These make me feel like "Wow! I don't need to fly back to Bangkok to eat these menus anymore!" Well done to the team!

Fantastic place to get delicious Thai food. We really enjoyed the papaya salad, pork larb and beef salad. Loved the hot and sour pork bone soup - can’t think about of anywhere else I’ve seen that. Medium spice was more like hot - might be a bit much for someone who doesn’t like spicy food. Definitely the place to come for authentically flavoured and delicious Thai food! We loved the outdoor seating which was fine for well behaved dogs. Two things worth noting: -They’re weren’t licensed yet last time we went. This may have happened since then, but when we were there it was no alcohol. -I love coconut water as an alternative to alcohol, but wish they had coconut water without added sugar. The 500ml can had 38.6 grams of sugar, and ingredients confirmed sugar added.

We ordered a lot of food for four people yesterday. It was super delicious, and their service was really good as well. The prices are very affordable compared to most other shops. I really recommend it.

Easily the best Thai I’ve had in Auckland. Brilliant little spot in Westmere and well priced. Don’t serve alcohol at the moment but have an interesting mix of other drinks. Would love in they served an ice cold Chang with this spicy line up!

We stopped in for lunch and were really impressed. The food is classic comfort food done right. The cheeseburger dog was juicy, the bun was soft good quality bread. The mac n cheese dog had a very generous portion. The chips were crispy and golden, not at all greasy. We were all really full after one dog. There was a good selection on the menu, enough variety to suit different moods without being too overwhelming. Prices were very reasonable, especially for the quality of the food. What really stood out was the service. The guy serving us was super friendly—welcoming without being overbearing. He was happy to chat when we ordered but then gave us space to enjoy our food, which we really appreciated. It's a great spot if you’re after tasty, unfussy food at a fair price with excellent service. The design is really cool too- Really neat burger joint theme. Definitely recommend checking it out!

Just had a wonderful meal at Good Dog Bad Dog! Really yummy and reasonable prices. Very quiet for early on a Saturday night, but this secret is bound to get out once others discover it! Staff very friendly and helpful; the food came quickly, and was the right temperature, & delicious. I highly recommend the Chopped Cheese ($14.50). The fries were a little salty for me, but one tray at $9 is more than enough for 2 people!

Our family stumbled across this place on accident but over the last 22 days and 6 visits - it’s become our favourite family spot. We live in Manurewa and travel to support Michael because his food is delicious, he has amazing customer service and there’s so many things on the menu to try. We’re big fans of the chilli cheese dog, Philly cheese steak, fried chicken hoagie, mac & cheese and fried Oreos.
Stopped in for lunch today. Amazing food with generous portions. Attentive and friendly staff. We got the Philly cheesesteak, Taco Hoagie and some deep fried oreos. Yum!

Best Hot Dog I've had... ever. And great value for money. I had the special Buldoggy and Hashbites, way for than I thought I'd get and perfectly crispy on the outside. My friend had deep fried oreos. They were yum but if your not getting ice cream with them they need some sort of dipping sauce like salted caramel, chocolate or maple syrup. But this place might be a regular visit. The atmosphere could be made better but with cleaner tables and a cushioned bench seat.

We were all hungry for fish and chips. We made our phone order. Paid and collect our kai. Found a table a seats under tree. Opened our packet. The fish was nice, but the batter was awfully hard and dry. 2 Stars for fast service.
Great bang for your buck! Such a great burger for the price & size. BEST Kumera fries and decent size “small chips” feeds both me & my partner. Love how it’s family run. They add sauces too!

This use to be our go to place but has recently really dropped in quality especially recently when our family got some beer battered fish and chips. The serving is must say was a fair size but the batter was pretty bad and abit tough and probably fried in old oil and was just not a great experience at all. I missed what it used to be before.

Edit: came back again thinking they would've changed, the same again really oily I even asked for it to be well drained, will never be coming back again. The fish & chip shop in sandringham is far superior than this one. Flavours are nice BUT instead of rushing to get the food out quick, take your time and put out better food. I was there on a busy Thursday night and they were rushing the orders out and I got home to a SUPER OILY fish and chips. As you can see in the photos I got a paper towel to dry my fish, quite disappointed really!
These are simply the best fish and chips in Auckland. The portion size is good. The crumbed fish is to die for and the pricing is spot on.
Best tamago katsu Don, I've had outside Japan. Just the right flavour combo for a boy from Osaka.
Not worth of the money , the ratio between rice and sushi filling is horrendous I ordered 3 types of Sushi for lunch and all i had was huge amount of rice in it

My spouse loves this place. They got out of the hospital and the first thing they wanted was to order the udon through UberEats. It's their favourite udon in this city. I also enjoy the salmon teriyaki and chicken katsu donburi and we always get several miso soup as they're quite good.
Best sushi in Auckland in my opinion, great pricing easily affordable. My recommendation is the tuna onigiri, i feel like i can eat them non stop.

First time here, I ordered a Teriyaki Tofu Don (rice bowl) - being vegetarian I am limited when it comes to decent amount of Japanese food so this is my regular go-to order. However it was VERY disappointing so 70% of it ended up in the rubbish. Need to pick up your game guys! I think I'll stick to St Pierre's Sushi + Bento Bowl for now.. ❤️

Great place for Chinese dishes - fried rice, Chow Mein, Tofu, Prawns, noodles, won ton soup, sweet n sour pork etc This place doesn't look exciting from the outside, but the food is great. Really good selection of all the Chinese dishes you're craving. Indoor tables and seating aren't flashy but perfectly functional. Best Chinese I've eaten in ages 😋

I read about this place and was keen to try it out. I finally got to try it on the weekend and was not disappointed. I'm definitely coming back to try some of the other dishes and maybe get some hot chips from here.

I love this Chinese takeout for their hot chips. Are always golden crispy and well drained. In my opinion they do the best chips out of our three local Chinese takeaway because of the golden crispy crunch the chips have. Smaller portioned but best quality. I also tried their spicy sliced pork belly on white rice with vegetables as it was a recommended dish under reviews on their website. Have tried the same dish at Mt Albert & Mt Eden. They do not compare to this place and the way they do it. My favourite dish is the Chicken Rice Noodles dish. It’s so satisfying as a comfort food. And the servings sizes of these two dishes are worth the price. The owners are friendly. I hope they will stay open for as long as I am here. The others just don’t seem to compare.

Finally I've found a right place for to-go in the area. Chinese food with rich flavour, generous portion, fresh ingredients, good customer service, most affordable price, etc. A huge car park for free at the rear where is accessible next to KFC. Love spicy pork belly & chicken fried rice noodle most. Just hands down. You should try various kinds of authentic Chinese food, not just ordinary Chinese takeaway food. Dine-in available but not in a fancy setting. Thank you guys for making extra spicy as always.
Really nice food, always hits the spot and of a high quality. We usually order the special fried rice and kung po chicken - it’s absolutely amazing! Must try!

Fresh, tasty food at a reasonable price. I had a mixed vegetable stirfry with chicken, which was succulent and tender. Helpful service, especially regarding my requirement to be gluten free (the Hungry Time used gf soy sauce in my stirfry). The place was clean and I appreciated the fact that the music was nice and quiet in the background, but it's not really the kind of place you go to for its decor - it's all about the food.

Delicious for a Thai styled curry laksa. Definitely sweeter than a normal Malaysian flavour and aspects. Tonnes of prawns (7) Chilled atmosphere with music at a perfect level. Clean and quick which hits the spot!

Stopped by to have some lunch with my mum & sister. The food is so good, came out quite speedy and definitely worth the price. Good value for your money. We will be returning tomorrow and definitely will become regular customers. The counter clerk/waiter was professional and patient.

[Chicken Fried Rice] & [Chicken Pad Thai] Both fried rice and pad thai were yumm! Especially with the fried rice you can taste the flame/charcoal flavor. Both dishes are recommended. Also I think they are using chicken breast which I love it as I don't like fatty meat.

We’re regulars at Hungry Time, and I can confidently say it’s the best Thai takeaway I’ve ever had! As someone with coeliac disease, finding safe and delicious options can be a challenge, but they cater to my dietary needs perfectly. It’s such a treat to enjoy a satay stir-fry - something that’s often not gluten-free at other Thai restaurants. The team is always friendly, and the menu offers a fantastic selection for a range of dietary needs. We feel so lucky to have such an amazing local spot - highly recommend!

Girls who are running this place are the nicest people to deal with, always so welcoming and helpful! This place is also the best burger spot in the area! Their burgers are so delicious and yum! Worth 100stars! Love loaded fries and boneless chicken too! Will be back for a bite this and following weeks for sure!
Love this bar . I had several games of pool with random people in there . Food was good atmosphere was good bar staff very good at there job love it
Heards 80s to earl 00s music and loved that. Great local and the fried chicken place attached is convenient and tasty
Very good service , staff are friendly too , yet to try their hamburger
Atmosphere is amazing as well as the staff. Had a great experience with the head chef watching him cook his meals, freshly made & presented as a 10.

Really loved discovering this place. Service was excellent, food was hot, tasty and served fast. Beers were cold and refreshing to wash down a hearty meal. Will definitely be coming back....Loved every bite!
Burger used the real meat, not from the frozen. The taste was good and the chicken Korean fried boneless was good too.

These must be some of, if not the best fries I have ever had. Perfectly crisp on the outside and so soft and fluffy on the inside with an amazing seasoning all over. The burger was so good, the chicken so well cooked full of flavour and juicy, diced red onion so you got that sweet sharp taste evenly throughout instead of big hits with onion rings. The sauce was different and complimented the chicken well and the coating was so crispy and light, not oily or heavy. Even the burger buns were fantastic. There seemed to be a lot of delivery pick-ups going on so we had a bit of a wait however the staff behind the counter were very friendly and it was well worth the time.

Lovely staff, got greeted and checked up on even got our photo taken by them, great vibe and lots to do here like darts pool and karaoke. Food was pretty good no complaints maybe just a bit pricey for the portions.
Amazing yummy food.tried them for the first time and were blown away by the flavours and freshness.please give them a try!good value for your buck.loved it.Thank you Back to the Kitchen

There's a lady that sometimes serves us on the bar on Blues night... She is super friendly with a fantastic attitude and I just wanted to say thank you to that girl, your hospitality makes the experience for me so lovely, I've been going here for the last few months and just started bringing my partner along too. I noticed the guy that is usually on the bar was really friendly to my partner, though he's never that friendly with me lol... not really sure why that is. So far, we've ordered a few meals... the buttermilk burger but the bun was burnt and dry, did not enjoy it at all. The mushroom/onion pizza is not great either, mostly just leaves an onion taste in your mouth for the rest of the night. We've also ordered the chicken pizza and the prawn twisters, which were YUM AS and we will definitely be ordering them again. The beer prices are awesome! The Auckland Blues Club is a must-see, $10/person every second Wednesday.

Decent bar. Times have changed not many people go out drinking which makes the experience of such place difficult to properly gauge a rating but average place. Pokies, pool tables outside area in front to drink.

Changed now to Harleys. Food smell there smelt good except noone was eating? Saw a guy looking at a menu, then after no service saw him and 2 others walk out. Tonight alot of young ones sitting on seats in the pokies area on their phones (no drinks just taking up space), people complained they can't play the machines because of them, security were playing pool, 1 bar person, dirty glasses, beggers were inside! I think I made a mistake going there on a benefit night, and I will not go back! I went there last week and it was good but it was in the afternoon and I think it has a better clientele in the daylight hours.
Quiet spot, centrally located and atmosphere was decent.
Hi thr well it was good food and energy. Would recommend to others

Went there for dinner and a quiz night. Very well run, easy parking, excellent food at reasonable prices. My friend was staying there and says the rooms are the same high value. Special commendation to the lady at reception. I have mobility issues. She guided me to the elevator...AND...when I got out, she was waiting at the top of the stairs to direct me to the restaurant. How good is that?

Outside is very dated or quirky. Our room was surprisingly modern and light. Good bathroom, comfortable beds and good air conditioning. Rooms are not very soundproofed. Having a small indoor pool was great. Unfortunately as we were preparing for bed my wife spotted a cockroach on her bed which was rather off putting! As well cleaning was not complete - the shower glass had been wiped but not rinsed or buffed and was smeary. The floor was the same - you could write your name on it. Shame as the room was quite nice otherwise and the price was good.
Stayed here for 6 nights. It's great value for money. Not far from Auckland City. But the best thing about this place is the staff. They were all amazing and nothing was too much trouble.

This has to be my new favourite hotel in Auckland. I booked it as we were getting back from an overseas holiday and wanted somewhere to stay the night before driving 6 hours back home. I got a good deal on it, and then when we were absolutely shattered from having no sleep the night before the girl on reception let us check in early and was so kind. Not sure of her name but she had these little hearts on her cheeks. She was awesome. Then when we got into our room which was right by the pool the air con had been on and so it was amazing to come inside from the boiling day outside. Normally hotels can be pretty noisy during the day but the room was surprisingly soundproof and we could barely hear anything! Room was so clean, super modern including the bathroom. Can't wait to stay here next time we're in Auckland. Thank you so much.

My 3rd stay here. Love the location, the rooms are clean and modern, and the staff lovely, and I had a tasty meal in the restaurant. Just a really bad choice of room. I'd been on the road since 5am, had a busy day and put off the rest of my plans til the morning as I was too tired to continue. I thought I'd have a nana nap and recharge before dinner. But this wasn't an option due to the roadworks literally outside my window. Opted for plan B, an early dinner and early night. Wasn't to be either. I got used to the road noise only to be woken by kids running around over head and later someone trying their key and pounding on my door with someone else telling them loudly there's someone in the room, trying to convince them they had the wrong room. Sliding doors banging around midnight ?wardrobe? 4.30 am crying child, so I got up, showered and am wondering what to do for the next 4 hours before my appointment, at 8.30 Ironic really. I turned down the offer of free accomodation and thought I'd treat myself to a motel and restaurant meal so I could carry on refreshed
Maja the bar tender was fantastic! Such a lovely girl to make the other gals feel welcome at chapel!!! Love her! Please promote maja to the best bar tender!!!

We strolled the strip and out of all the bars in the area, this one was home. The vibe was perfect and staff was inviting. The outdoor seating was great to soak up the ponsonby street life. Food was decent and drinks were stiff. What more could you want?

The place was nice, the staff in the reception or recieving area was nice and food is okay. However, our waiter was kinda rude to us. We went for a good time and left feeling bummed about it. We kinda just left cause we thought, he was having a bad time but nonetheless it ruined the night for us, that's why I'm giving it a three star.
Good selection of booze and cheap cocktails, go to place on a Sunday afternoon for the renowned Sunday Session! Take photos and have a laugh, just don't feel offended by the decor.
Always reliable. Wonderful staff who were cheerful and onto it on New Year’s Eve. We don’t eat here but food seems mostly ok for pub fare. A fabulous local.

Went here to celebrate a birthday, but unfortunately the experience was disappointing from start to finish. The atmosphere was chaotic—we were seated right by a door that constantly slammed as people came and went, and we were stuck between a loud group and another table who ended up leaving after their complaints to staff were ignored. We eventually had to move ourselves just to enjoy a basic conversation. The food was overpriced and underwhelming. My southern fried chicken was cooked well enough, but completely lacked presentation. My friend’s beef salad was even worse—overcooked beef tossed on top of what looked like a bagged salad with a few crispy noodles thrown on as an afterthought. Cocktails were also overpriced and incredibly average. Chairs were hard and uncomfortable, and to top it all off, we watched staff scraping food into a rubbish bin in the restaurant dining area. Completely off-putting. Some staff were friendly, but others seemed disengaged and more interested in chatting with each other than helping guests. To make things worse, it’s dog-friendly in the most unhygienic way—dogs walking right through the restaurant to get outside. Yuk. What was meant to be a special celebration turned into a big letdown. I would not recommend this place and definitely won’t be going back. Such a shame.

Amazing food and a good range of drinks 🍸 😋 Regular musican Ricky performs every Thursday with a mixture of Latin American and English songs to add to the atmosphere. The space is very open and spacious with outdoor seating at the front and back, as well as plenty of indoor seating. A great spot for locals in the area, but also a great spot for a drink or two to enjoy the relaxing environment and some good music. 10/10.

A good suburban pub type eatery. Good beers on tap and drinks list. The menu is short ish with four categories; snacks/sharing, pizza, burgers, single plates. They do pub staples. And each night have a less expensive, special. Had fish and chips, and Southern Fried Chicken. Chips were slightly overdone, the chicken a little salty, and the slaw was excellent. Big portions, and good service.

Stumbled upon the Malt House yesterday. Excellent staff. Catered to my coeliac needs. Food was fabulous. Kids were given colouring which was a great way to pass the time while waiting for our food. Was so good yesterday, we came back today. Highly recommend!

Delicious chicken wings. Crunchy, saucy, meaty and have a great deal on them every Friday. Delicious coffee too for those Sunday mornings. Pizza was so-so, crust and ingredients could be improved. Good choice of beers, nice staff and nice seating outside.

I absolutely had to stop in because I was craving the Salmon & Herb Hush Cake. This café sits along the road with a lineup of deli-style meals and a menu you’d expect from a full-on restaurant. I used to walk past it all the time, but the other day when I ordered a flat white, I spotted the Salmon & Herb Hush Cake in the cabinet and couldn’t stop thinking about it. I promised myself I’d make time to come back...and I’m so glad I did. There’s only outdoor seating available, but it’s not bad at all. What really stood out to me was how friendly and genuine the staff were; just top-notch service that really leaves a good impression. I dropped in during the morning, and it honestly set a great tone for the rest of my day. It might not look like much from the outside, but once you’re in, you’ll be surprised by how extensive the menu is. And the Salmon & Herb Hush Cake? It’s basically a full-blown Eggs Benedict—and a generous one at that! You won’t find anything like it for just $15 anywhere else. Highly recommended!

Every item on the menu is so delectable that you need to be a little patient as I have never been in when it is not busy. Your taste buds will thank you for your time. The staff are always bubbly and friendly and helpful.

The salad bowls here are quite good. We also bought 2 frozen packs of chicken broth. They get a little busy during lunch hours. Coffee was good too. They make whole cakes which you can order off the website. The only place in Auckland we found that does hummingbird cake.

Discovered the Ripe Grey Lynn “Mothership” about a year ago now and I am continually impressed by their delicious and nutritious food. The selection and seasonality of their salads is second to none! The customer service is excellent, with staff always happy to point me in the right direction in terms of food choice and other recommendations. Seeds and sauerkraut are a must!!!
Lived just over the road from this place for about 6 months now. Staff are really friendly and genuinely the best coffee I’ve had in the city.

Absolutely loved my visit to this BurgerFuel. The food hit the spot, the vibe was great, and the team behind the counter made the experience even better. There’s something special about places where the people genuinely feels human.
Yummy chips and burger. Aoili so nice I could eat it by itself. Toilets were awful.
The burgers are juicy and flavourful! CN Cheese and American Muscle are my favourites.

I believe this is where BergerFuel originally started. Until now, I had only visited other locations and hadn’t yet made it to Ponsonby. I’m so glad I finally got to visit BergerFuel Ponsonby today. I could see the care and time that went into preparing the food, and when the burger arrived with its impressive size and presentation, it made the experience even more enjoyable. This isn’t just fast food—it’s a masterpiece worthy of a restaurant menu. I savored every bite while watching the hustle and bustle of people and cars passing through Ponsonby. To all the staff, thank you for the wonderful meal. I am deeply grateful to each and every one of you.

Absolutely awesome experience! The food was delicious – perfectly cooked burgers with amazing flavor and fresh ingredients. The staff were super friendly and welcoming, which made the visit even better. Highly recommend if you’re in the area and craving a great burger!

All 5 star Perfect atmosphere with nice music, specifically open areas are lovely. Welcomed by very polite and nice staff, very well designed outdoor area, fair prices in compare of some restaurants in that area. We ordered calamari which was a perfectly fried one, outside crispy inside tender and little juicy, just as good as it could be, then a 250gr Scott fillet steak with black garlic and chips plus a BRB hazy ipa, I had the day off so luckily we popped in there during happy hours and beers were 10 NZD and all shared dishes were 10 NZD as well. The taste of the steak was otherworldly, out of words, exceptional quality and super cooked, which definitely shows the expertise of the chef there. Best steak I've had in New Zealand in the past year. Much recommended, steak was 42 NZD, calamari was 17 NZD in normal hours.

Went on a Sunday morning for breakfast. Staff were super kind and had excellent customer service. The seating area was very cozy and food was delicious! The big breakfast was especially good, everything went so well together. Prices were reasonable also :)
Fabulous birthday lunch. We had Wagu dumplings with hoisen sauce, fish tacos with pineapple salsa, prawns with chorizo and gorgeous lamb ragu.
Manager sorted out some bloke who was wasted, entertaining to watch. Staff dealt with our fun dietary requirements well, was a good laugh and good service!

This is the busiest club in Auckland so far. The music and ambiance are good. Drinks are on a bit of an expensive range. All the young crowd comes to enjoy the music on weekends. Staff and gards are very respectful and Although few improvements are what they can do is some ventilation, when it gets crowded, the place becomes smelly and suffocating. Also, their bathroom needs some exhaust and cleaning.
We set outside and had coffee and breakfast. In the outside area are some heaters and the coffee and food was great
Amazing little cafe with awesome coffee and service, super friendly. Thanks guys - Rory from Naked Marketing

*Updated 12/5/24: Actually today's experience was very good, keep up the good work! *Updated 28/5/23: Again, had to send the bread back as the eggs on the toast makes it soggy, and was short 1x rasher of bacon. Sigh *Updated 11/11/22: Tried Bambina again and surprise surprise, noisy AF and eggs on the toast = soggy toast. Poached eggs were cold. The coffee was good. However, my friend's salmon was inedible. It was meant to be with noodles, but only had a tablespoon of it. The "broth" was just lime juice. To say the balance was off suggests there was balance to begin with, but this was just sour. The addition of salt was not enough to augment it. Suggesting that the issue was not with the food, but with her palate, is clearly indicative of complacency. An apology from the waitress was better received, but we are struggling to find any other merits.
Not bad. Busy. Prices OK
Bacon and eggs with 5 grain toast. Delicious. Great coffee. Top notch service. Did not disappoint.

Very tiny place but extremely crowded guests. The food is really good. Better make a reservation because mostly people come in a big group. The space between the desks is so small. The service is very fast.
I have enjoyed eating here several times. I love it. I always order 3 courses. The duck skin is lovely and crispy and the soup and noodle heavenly. Parking is no problem too. I do recommend this.

Love their food most especially their Pecking duck, so don't miss this out. The restaurant looks old outside but it doesnt matter since you came there to satisfy your palate right 🤣. We went there on weekends for Mother's day celebration so it is advisable to book your reservation. They got parking for customers at the back of their restaurant and also off street.

Deeply satisfying to see entitled joyless reviewers having a terrible time and giving it bad reviews. Don’t come back. Leave us to celebrate special occasions over epic Peking duck with our friends & family at the last of the old school Chinese restaurants.

You can have the Peking Duck, 1, 2 or 3 courses. The sesame pockets for the 2nd course is worth a try. This restaurant is famous for the duck, but I found the other dishes average. The deep fried squid and the prawns were very oily and heavily battered. The mix vegetable dish was overly salty, whereas the beef ho fan was bland. Chicken cashewnuts was ok. The tofu dish we ordered was very good and on par with others restaurants. Service was excellent and plentybof on street parking

I loves this eatery. The waffles are great (I asked for no chocolate sauce), the bog breakfast was worth the price (crispy, well-cooked streaky bacon and great herb and pork sausage). And the coffe is expertly done. All the staff were lovely to all patrons, and service was efficient. If I lived closer, I wpuld come more often--but definitely a spot I would bring my visiting families and guests to. Thank you all for the lively food and amazing first impression!

I had an amazing experience at The Brunchery! The coffee was absolutely the best I’ve had in a while – rich, smooth, and perfectly brewed. The highlight, though, was the crushed avocado. It was incredibly fresh, creamy, and seasoned just right. A perfect dish to complement the coffee. The atmosphere was cozy, and the staff were friendly. I’ll definitely be coming back! Highly recommend!

1st time back to Brunchery since new ownership and it's AMAZING. Beautiful food and incredibly friendly, helpful staff. I had the chilli scrambled eggs and hubby the Hangover Breakfast. Great coffee too. Lots of different spaces to sit and loads of parking out back. We'll definately be back !
Lovely cafe! Easy to find and friendly staff. I had the pancakes and they were delicious! Not too sweet and very pretty. Will visit again next time I’m in Auckland.

We had an amazing experience at The Brunchery! The coffee was absolutely spot on perfectly brewed. It was very busy as Mother’s Day but they found us a table. The atmosphere was cozy, and the staff were friendly. I’ll definitely be coming back! Highly recommend! Solid 10/10z

My partner and I visited Jervois Steakhouse on a busy Friday around 1:45pm—and from the moment we walked in, we knew we were in good hands. The ambience is warm and inviting with classic steakhouse charm—leather chairs, rich brown tones, curated art, and a glowing fireplace that adds just the right touch of comfort to the upstairs space. Now let’s cut to the chase—the steaks? Absolutely divine. Absolutely worth the price. We shared the mighty 800g T-Bone and a perfectly marbled Scotch Steak. Both were cooked to perfection and packed with deep, satisfying flavor. The hollandaise and mushroom sauces were the clear standouts—rich, velvety, and the perfect complement to the steaks. But the real surprise? The Wagyu fat roasted kumara. Sweet, smoky, and finished with whiskey caramel, pecan, and feta—it stole the show. Honestly, it might be one of the best sides I’ve ever had. The potato gratin and seasonal greens were also excellent, but that kumara… unforgettable. We paired everything with a couple of bold reds that brought it all together. Dessert was a crème brûlée and a classic affogato—simple, satisfying, and just the right finish. Service was outstanding—genuinely warm, knowledgeable, and perfectly timed despite the lunch rush. Our waiter went above and beyond to make sure that we were comfortable. His recommendations were also excellent! In short: top-tier food, flawless service, and an atmosphere that feels effortlessly polished. We left full, happy, and already planning our return.

Would strongly recommend this place to anyone looking for some delicious steak, everything they presented was amazing. The fish grills, sides, starters and the drinks. Top Notch! Definitely coming back for more, loved the service by Alex, made us so comfortable for the evening. The manager Bevin was also very welcoming, overall service was splendid!!

This is the best steakhouse I’ve ever visited fantastic atmosphere and perfectly cooked steaks. I had the rib eye and the wagyu scotch fillet, both incredible. Even the entrées and sides were delicious. The service was outstanding; the staff clearly know their craft. I’ll definitely be returning.

Experience from start to finish has been absolutely great. Special thanks to Julia, the hostess, for keeping the kitchen's last order open for us until we arrived. Julia is very social and friendly and makes you feel welcomed at the restaurant. The ambience and environment of the restaurant are amazing. Service was outstanding, amazing explanation about meat selection and side, and desert selection Serious compliments to the chef and the staff. It's absolutely amazing. I'm definitely returning. 💯
The ambiance is so cosy, the staff are warm and nice, and the food is amazing, I have ordered an entree (scallops) and a T-bone steak, so good

It is our first time to dine in here, We love each and every dish. Focaccia bread was warm and perfect for starter. Mac and cheese truffle pasta was must order if you like cheesy and truffle. Market fish cooked nicely and salsa make good balance. Last one our cannoli we enjoyed very much as a chocolate lover pistachio gelato was good too. Very friendly staff and service. Worth what u pay and recommended.
Loved the food. Thoughtful, creative, and delicious!!! The effort into the food prep is outstanding. Staff were super helpful, efficient and friendly.

We visited Andiamo and ordered the Maritozzi Brioche Buns with Parmesan Custard and Ōra King Caviar, a dish that looked exquisite in their official Instagram post. However, the actual dish we received was noticeably different from what was advertised. 1. Portion discrepancy – The Instagram post showcased three buns, while we were served only two. There was no mention of a portion change, which felt misleading. 2. Ingredient inconsistency – The caviar in the promotional photo was larger and more vibrant, likely Ōra King salmon roe. However, what we received had much smaller, less visually striking fish roe, which to be a different ingredient altogether. 3. Quality issue with the brioche – The buns had a strong sour and alcoholic taste, which is unusual for a properly made maritozzo. This suggests either over-fermentation or improper dough handling, leading to an unpleasant experience. While a mild fermentation note can be acceptable in brioche due to the use of yeast, the overwhelming acidity and pronounced alcohol-like flavor suggested over-fermentation or improper dough handling. Additionally, the texture was far from the soft, airy, and slightly sweet profile expected of a properly executed brioche. We brought this issue to the restaurant’s attention, hoping for some insight into whether this was an intentional aspect of their recipe or a potential flaw in preparation. Unfortunately, the staff who do our payments; the lady with the black blazers; was dismissive and visibly impatient, offering no explanation or acknowledgment of the concern. While the dish was ultimately removed from our bill, the lack of engagement or willingness to address a fundamental issue in their baking process was disappointing.

We went there for lunch. And in hindsight didn't order well. We ordered from the sharing menu, thinking that these were dishes to share, the were the size of side plates. Cesar salad which was average, squid which was tender, but plain. Cod and crab meat balls which we didn't like at all. We also had some oysters and fries, sadly no wow factor for anything. What was delicious was the afigato and Tiramisu to finish. Service was good and friendly, maybe some guidance with the menu would have helped

Hands down one of my favourite “higher end” restaurants in Auckland. All the food is amazing but the macaroni and cheese is an absolute must have! We also got the margarita pizza and calamari - both were delicious! The maritozzi brioche buns were the only item that we didn’t enjoy. But highly recommend everything else!

I went here for my birthday a couple weeks ago and had the best service and even better food! everything about this place was amazing & I will definitely be coming back! Shout out Hugo & the rest of the team that was on the night absolutely loved!
