Warm and friendly family run restaurant serving traditional European dishes. The atmosphere is clean and stylish with elegant low lighting and plenty of space. The staff are absolutely amazing - their son and daughter were working that evening and were so attentive, charming, professional and quick. The food was quite good, perhaps a little pricey for the style and scale but well executed. My fish was a little overdone as hot vegetables came served on top of it which kept it cooking past the perfection it no-doubt left the pan in. Very tricky with a thin and delicate white fleshed fish. The chef was very kind to carefully consider allergies and alter the dishes.

Recently opened restaurant in Ponsonby, been twice now to try it out — once for dinner and once just for drinks — and both times have been fantastic. Delicious food, great drinks, well thought-out refit, friendly and genuinely welcoming staff. Looking forward to many more visits and hoping this becomes my new favourite place. Recommended.

I wasn’t expecting much when I walker in, just another Ponsonby place - but I was wrong. The space felt calm, unforced. And the service completely changed the night. Archie was warm, effortless, and genuinely attentive without ever hovering. It’s rare to feel that looked after without it feeling like a performance. Because of them, I felt genuinely attended to, and I started to imagine taking myself back, with friends, family, and definitely someone I’m trying to impress! The attention to detail stood out. It wasn’t just service, it was genuine care and great service. That’s what made the night feel special and separated from the mess of other start-up restaurants. I am endlessly grateful for my service tonight and I hope that my waitress gets the praise she deserves in the teams Thank you.

LOVED it. Luke just knows what he's doing. Delicious.Tasty food. Such an appealing menu. Loved the crispy cauliflower tuna tartare divine fabulous calamari awesome steak. Staff lovely so helpful and charming. Archie is a treasure. We will be back, often.

The mini iPads are totally horrible for ordering the food. Have been there with my parents and they couldn’t read anything from the menu, and that actually kind of embarrassing for them, that we had to read the menu for them.

We went to this restaurant on the recommendation of my partner’s sibling. It was quite busy, and although we didn’t have a reservation, we managed to get a table. We ordered takoyaki, okonomiyaki, grilled rice balls, yakitori, sashimi, and salad. Ordering was easy as it was done through a touchscreen system. The food took a while to arrive, but I thought the taste was good. I hadn’t had Pacific saury (sanma) in a long time, so I ordered it and was happy to enjoy it again. However, there were too many scales left on the fish. I didn’t eat the skin, but the scales stuck to my throat, which was a bit of a struggle on the way home. Despite this, I’d like to visit again as they offer a wide variety of Japanese dishes.

Been our family go to for years - but you have to know what to order! Highly recommend the Salmon or Tuna Namaharu (rice paper roll) - it’s a must try. Beef Tataki, Chikuwa Mayo, and Salmon Ikura Don are some of our favorites. It’s BYO as well.
Amazing restaurant! Food was outstanding! Very fast and great value for money! BYO wine service is a major plus as well! Highly recommend! One of my favourite places in Auckland to have dinner!
Price and portion are both reasonable, and the food was excellent. Food was served a little slow but that makes sense considering how busy they were. Recommended!!

Absolutely loved my experience at Hell Pizza Grey Lynn.The pizzas are creative, delicious, and made with high-quality ingredients.The staff were friendly and the service was quick, even during a busy evening. The vibe of the place is cool and quirky, which adds to the fun dining experience. Highly recommend if you're in Auckland and craving a unique pizza! Will definitely be back.
The staff is great and the pizza is delicious.
Pizza was just fine. Nothing worth ordering again or commenting on. Had the mischief so maybe just ordered an odd flavour
Very tasty food, decent prices, and very friendly service. It made for a nice visit.
They have seemed to put less of the topics on all the pizzas compared to the last owners. I am never going back here

Popped in for Turkish coffee and Apple Tea - a staple in Türkiye - on a wet afternoon in Auckland. I don’t think you go there for the atmosphere, but for the friendly service an authentic flavours. It was a haven at 4.00pm on a wet Friday!

This place has recently become a take out spot and moved location just slightly. It used to be a sit down restaurant and was a Ponsonby favourite for over 20 years! 🌯🥗 The menu hasn’t changed though - the falafel is really good 🧆 … crispy and crunchy on the outside yet moist and flavourful inside. The tabbouleh is also delicious 👌 Everything is fresh and lovingly made from scratch (with the exception of the flatbread itself). The atmosphere is relaxed and the same guy still makes the food - he’s a gem. There are still a few seats but it’s not a dine in atmosphere anymore. You can still get great flavours for a decent price.
Superb mixed kebab. The meat is excellent but its the salad that sets it apart, super fresh with delicious dressing and herbs. I work down the road and my mate and I go at least once a week.

Really good service and location; on the whole our meal tasted good. Our mains could've done with dips as it was a tad dry so will do this next time I dine here! They also didn't have the dessert I wanted so hopefully I'll be able to try it next time.

We are genuinely excited to see that the Turkish Cafe has re-opened, just up the road from their previous building. While the owner has some work to do in relation to seating and ambience, I'm just so pleased to see the cafe up and running again. Last night's meal was delicious, promptly delivered and generous in terms of portion size. We have enjoyed consistently excellent food at very reasonable prices at the Turkish Cafe. It is one of our favorite options if eating out.

Jervois Rd Wine Bar + Kitchen delivered an exceptional dining experience that exceeded all expectations. From start to finish, everything was flawless. We started with the lemon pepper calamari, which was perfectly tender and seasoned to perfection. The truffle fries were indulgent and had just the right amount of truffle aroma, making them impossible to resist. The wagyu beef sliders were a highlight – juicy, flavorful, and served with a delightful balance of textures. The mains were equally impressive. The wagyu brisket was melt-in-your-mouth tender and packed with bold, rich flavors. The lamb cutlets were cooked to perfection, beautifully tender with a touch of smokiness. The goat cheese croquettes were a creamy, crispy delight that added a perfect complement to the meal. To top it all off, the pomegranate sour was a fantastic choice – expertly mixed, refreshing, and a great pairing for the food. Every dish was presented beautifully, and the flavors were nothing short of incredible. The service was warm and attentive, and the atmosphere of the bar was cozy and inviting. Jervois Rd Wine Bar + Kitchen is a true gem, and we can’t wait to return for another memorable dining experience! 5/5 stars. Highly recommend!

My party of 4 came here on the First Table deal. My companions got the wagyu beef brisket and the prawn fettuccine. I got the lamb cutlet. My companions enjoyed their food. The wagyu was really good, the prawn fettuccine although quite oily but still tasted good. Unfortunately my lamb cutlet was a disappointment. It came with three tiny cutlets and each cutlet was more than 50% fat and hardly any meat. I asked if this was normal (I know it isn’t because I’ve had lamb cutlets at multiple places and none like this) and I was told this is normal and that the fat is edible? Yes, of course the fat is edible but am I paying to eat lamb or fat? Needless to say, I left angry, hungry and disappointed. I’m glad I came here on First Table because I’m definitely not going to pay full price for this hideous lamb cutlet. I wouldn’t return.

Really enjoyed this. The service was friendly and attentive. All the food were really tasty with the highlights being the lamb cutlets and the fried chicken. The only criticism is the pretty average accompaniments to the mains which were the same.

Had a wonderful evening with my family on Friday night, the shared plates we got were amazing so compliments to the Chef. The live soulful/R&B sounds of Thomas Stowers and Betty-Anne were as I remembered back in the day. Ben McManus from the beginning your communication was excellent, you made me feel at ease reassuring a great night and that you delivered, your warmth professionalism and attentiveness to us was on point. Only one thing is wish it was a bigger venue however thank you again …we will be back😊

The Wagyu beef brisket was too dry despite being slow cooked and the potato gratin was cold. We ordered two lamb cutlets, one was ok and the other was raw so we returned it. This was after waiting more than half an hour after the starters. Having said that, the truffle shoestring fries were really good. So was the calamari, it was so tender.

I ordered some satay chicken which came raw. I immediately called back and was not even offered a refund. Emailed photos through to Winnie as requested but I did not hear back. After following up for a week I gave up. Terrible customer service and even worse chefs.

Wouldn’t rate it. Pretty flavourless and very below average. Wasn’t cheap either! Food has some very strange flavours and tastes. Made me feel a bit uneasy. Called before ordering as had a question and staff were friendly, so that’s was positive. Wont order again.

This was the most revolting green thai curry we have ever had, such an unusual, burnt plastic flavour. Inedible. Disappointed, it was horrible. Ordered on uber eats. Definitely would not order from here again. Yuck.

I ordered spicy tofu noodles that was totally wasted because too much pepper and when I complained to staff he is aa Chinese boy his behaviour was very rude he argued with me and shouted on me so I personally recommend to all dont go there thanks
Very Tasty. The thai green curry was great! Good fresh veges. Nice to have free delivery.

We had the special truffle course, and it was exceptional. I love truffles and have tried several truffle courses at various restaurants, but this was one of the best — they really brought out the flavour of the truffle beautifully. My partner has some dietary restrictions, and the team created a beautifully tailored course menu for us. The food was consistently sophisticated in flavour, with elegant presentation. Every staff member was friendly, and the service was refined and professional. Cocoro continues to be one of my absolute favourite restaurants in New Zealand.

We had amazing dinner here we did the à la carte menu. The sashimi was fantastic possibly one of the best in Auckland. If not New Zealand. The steak was amazing. The staff were really friendly and helpful and all around great restaurant. I haven’t been for awhile. It’s nice to see they haven’t dropped their standards.

I enjoyed an amazing meal here. I was so impressed with the presentation, careful and considerate pairing of flavours and quality of ingredients. If you have an OS bank card, and have troubles with the website booking email the team for alternative payment options.
Amazing time Amazing foods Amazing staff and chef. As a Japanese I am so grateful to dine in this restaurant and tasting authentic Japanese foods. I’d love to come back for special occasions.

Finally visited Cocoro on my birthday and it didn’t disappoint! The best Japanese restaurant I’ve been to in NZ and it isn’t even close. Made me feel like I was dining in Japan again. I was particularly impressed by the sashimi dish and the dessert. The texture of the dessert was multi-layered and really rich, and of course it was delicious. The service was excellent too, the wait staff were patient and explained every dish in detail. Great dining experience, highly recommended!
Since 1997... The Italian Job is also a 1969 movie starring Michael Caine...

One of my favourite Italian restaurants ❤️ please go and give it a try. My favourite dishes are any pasta with the four cheese sauce, vitello ai funghi, and the garlic bread. The tiramisu is to die for 🤤

I was quite excited when we arrived and was given a small bowl of fresh Parmesan flakes and a bottle of olive oil. Thought this was the real deal! We ordered the Minestrone and tomato soups as entrees, but was disappointed when the minestrone didn’t have any beans or pasta in it and the tomato soup and minestrone base tasted like watered down passata. We shared a pizza which tasted like a frozen pizza base and was very underwhelming. The staff were friendly and it was a lovely atmosphere, but we will not be returning.

If you're looking for the best local Italian restaurant, this is it! The atmosphere has an authentic old-school vibe that feels warm and welcoming. The staff are incredibly friendly and attentive, making the entire dining experience enjoyable from start to finish. The food is outstanding – from traditional pasta dishes to hearty mains, everything is cooked to perfection. And the pizzas? Simply amazing! Perfectly crispy crust, fresh toppings, and just the right amount of cheese. Whether you're out for a casual meal or celebrating a special occasion, this place never disappoints. Highly recommend it to anyone craving authentic Italian flavors!

Wonderful Pizza! Probably the best I have ever tasted and that says a lot because I am very critical when comes to pizza. The pizza bread entree was served up rather quickly and was a delicious surprise while enjoying our chilled beers. Fredo, the host was very friendly and made sure we were given a great dining experience. The staff where nice and saw to our orders expediently. We dined at the tables outside, which was great during early evening. Inside the restaurant there was a more intimate dining room and a couple extra areas for even more privacy. Ask for their Italian Wine and beers, export quality. 5+ Stars in suburban Auckland.

Dante’s – A Slice of Italy in the Heart of Auckland If you’re on the hunt for the best authentic Italian pizza in Auckland, look no further than Dante’s. Crafted by the talented Chef Kevin, every bite takes you straight to Naples – fresh ingredients, perfect crust, and bold, traditional flavours. We had what can only be described as the best pizza in Auckland. The standout? The Carne Pizza – loaded with perfectly seasoned meats and baked to wood-fired perfection. But don’t stop there – the Bella Stacciatella is a creamy, flavour-packed delight. And don’t even think about skipping the Arancini balls – crispy on the outside, rich and cheesy inside – they’re the perfect appetizer to pair with an ice-cold Peroni Beer. The combination is simply unbeatable. The atmosphere is warm, the service is spot-on, and the food? Unforgettable. Must-try combo: Carne Pizza + Bella Stacciatella + Arancini balls + Peroni Beer = Heaven. Grazie, Chef Kevin – we’ll be back!

After an awe-inspiring visit to the Auckland Sky Tower, my family and I took a relaxed 30-minute stroll and came across Dante’s Pizzeria in Ponsonby Central – and what a brilliant find it was! I ordered the Spaghetti Pomodoro for dinner, and it was hands down the best pasta I’ve ever had. The dish featured a rich San Marzano Tomato DOP sauce, perfectly balanced with garlic, a touch of chilli, and a generous sprinkle of parmesan. Every bite was packed with authentic Italian flavour – simple, fresh, and absolutely delicious. My siblings were equally impressed with their pasta selections. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, and the staff were friendly and attentive. It felt like a little slice of Italy right in the heart of Auckland. When I visit Auckland again, Dante’s Pizzeria will definitely be on my list. Highly recommended for anyone craving for genuine Italian cuisine in a vibrant setting.

Dante's Pizzeria in Ponsonby is one of the best spots in town for sourdough pizza. The base is light, well-cooked, and has a nicely puffed rim that we really like. Toppings are fresh and balanced, with simple, authentic flavours done right. We had the Truffle, Funghi & Pancetta and the Diavola (both excellent). Always a solid choice when craving proper Italian-style pizza.

Had a very delicious and absolutely authentic DOP Pizza. The only i have seen since years where the dough can "rest" for 3 days to develop a flavor which makes this juwel almost likewise out of space. Thanks guys, have very enjoyed it. 🍕

This is the recommended spot for pizza and pasta in Ponsonby, located inside Ponsonby Central. I have been here a few times for their signature pizzas, which are always delicious. Last Saturday on breezy sunny day, I went for lunch with a close friend and had the chance to chat with the owner. He suggested trying their pasta, as I hadn't before. We ordered two pasta dishes and some garlic bread on the side. Both pastas were excellent, with subtle flavours that suited our tastes perfectly. The garlic bread was a great complement to the meal. I can confidently say they excel not just in pizza but in pasta too. Good and kind services by staffs too. Highly recommend for anyone looking to enjoy quality Italian food.

Great hidden gem in Ponsonby. Luckily the patrons on the street recommended we go in. This is worth a visit great story of restaurant origin. Coffees large and a bit milky for my liking by good flavour. Eggs and Sourdough perfect. Employees all really friendly, welcoming and attentive.

Excellent service and food. Meals came out quite quickly. The big breakfast had generous portions. Their hash browns are probably the highlight of the experience. The oats were wholesome and vegan options available for those who require it. The menu is limited but excellent. Coffee goes down just as well as the food. The freshly squeezed apple juice is perfectly balanced. I highly recommend this cafe to anyone after a fussy breakfast.

The vibe here is amazing, super cosy and well put together. It’s a great spot to hang out or catch up with friends. As for the food, it was fine, definitely not bad, but nothing to rave about either. The presentation could use a bit more attention to detail. Overall, a nice place to be in, but the food didn’t quite match the atmosphere.

Very cool place! Check out the shops history written on the wall out the back, dates back to 1900! A very nice nod to the properties past! A Great back indoor/outdoor area with plenty of tables. Service was quick and friendly. Coffee was perfect and food beautifully presented and very tasty. Would highly recommend
The staff provided exceptional service, delivering our orders in under 10 minutes despite a busy crowd. The environment was comfortable and relaxing, and the food was delicious and well-prepared.

I must say best Murder Burger is the best burger joint I have ever tried. Came tonight to have dinner with family n friends. Excellent customer service, amazing food quality n cozy environment. Must recommended!!👌 Thanks Again Murder Burger 🙂 will see you again ans please open store in South Auckland please

Have heard alot about the Murder Burger from friends in NZ so visited it. But didn’t like it at all. Burger breads were extremely dry. Chicken patty was bland. Dressing not up to the mark. Only thing I liked there was waffle.
Bought a burger from uber eats. The wait time was more than 1 hour! And it was not tasty at all and did not have the tomato, veggies and the extra beetroot I bought. Not recommended.

Visited Murder burger after long time. First time On this new location. Enjoyed the burgers and fries. Friendly staff!! Would love to visit them again. Open until late. Fresh Patties, yummy buns, great choice of shakes and Ice creams.

Unexpectedly Murdered (By Flavour) So I’m walking out of work, absolutely starving, craving something greasy, hearty, and glorious - which, let’s be honest, is a rare combo. It’s a Wednesday night, 9 p.m. - my hopes are low in Auckland city, where everything decent seems to shut the moment you start to feel human again. I stumble upon “Murder Burger.” Yes, that’s the name. I wasn’t concerned. Quite the opposite… I was intrigued. Murder me, I thought. Murder me with carbs. The smell hit me first. Next thing I know, I’m ordering the spicy jalapeño burger, trying to act casual. OMG. Disrespectfully tasty. But here’s where things escalated. I finished that burger and, before I knew what was happening, I’d ordered a second. No regrets. Cero. Nada. Anyway, I came in alone but left full, happy, and mildly obsessed. The staff was ridiculously friendly and fast - like, unsettlingly efficient to be by himself. In a world where people only write reviews to complain about portion sizes, I just wanted to say: this place? Solid 10/10. Go. GET MURDERED. You won’t regret it ;)

Popped into Thai House recently and had a nice overall experience. The place was clean and had a cozy, welcoming vibe, the decorations definitely gave off an authentic Thai feel, which was a nice touch. The staff were friendly and helpful throughout our visit. We tried the Pad Thai, Tom Yum, Garlic Snapper, and Sizzling Duck. The Pad Thai was tasty, but the portion was on the smaller side for the price. The Tom Yum was full of flavor, while both the snapper and duck were a bit too salty for our taste, but still enjoyable overall. One heads-up: finding a car park nearby can be a bit of a mission, so plan ahead. Still, if you're after a warm, authentic feeling spot with kind service, Thai House is worth a visit.

My spicy seafood noodles was very tasty with large juicy prawns, squid & scallops. Priced a bit higher than street food/takeaway joints, it’s to be enjoyed seated dining inside the cosy traditional thai decor… Reminds me of how Thai restaurants used to feel… nowadays trendy canteen vibe is more common! Service is always casual & warm family style.

Delicious Thai House cuisine and wonderful service! Our dear friends gave us a voucher to their favourite Thai House. Although we were a day over the expiry date of the voucher, the owner was very happy to accept it which was very kind and gracious. We tried the money bags, prawn curry, beef and oyster sauce and the chicken massaman curry. The dishes were delicious, full of flavour and filling. My family and I were extremely delighted. Thank you Thai House. We will see you soon!!
Really nice and flavoursome food! Plenty options on the menu and sweet staff👌🏻
Loved the atmosphere but unfortunately the Chicken Pad Thai was way too sweet. The wait time for meals was almost about an hour. :(

Loved the vegetarian pad thai. They added tofu which I'm not a fan of but just easily put it aside. Normally I can eat prawn but I've been put off from other places. Therefore, if you are a picky seafood person and cannot eat other meat then best to go with veg. We got in without reservation but the place was packed. Some larger groups were very loud and we couldn't even talk. Overall good experience.

We had our Marriage reception here and had our own room in the restaurant without extra fees. The manager was very in detail on what we want, told us everything we need to do prior to our reservation. They only have a BYO drinks for only $1 per person. Their food were delicious. Definitely one of the best Thai food in Auckland City. Definitely will recommend to my friends and will come back here.

An absolutely Heavenly thai cuisine I had after long long time. been to many Thai restaurants in Auckland but this one was special one cause had more varieties than others. Service was also fast & friendly. Must try their spicy Prawn starter & Mains if u really a Seafood lover. Money bag is my all time favorite. icecream lover must try their millions of option. thank you Team De Grand.
Great place for lunch, friendly staff, good food, good coffee will be back

Disappointment. This place raised a few questions, starting from the entrance through an ice cream kiosk. We sat in a wind tunnel and asked a waiter to close the door. After a few minutes of intense consultations they closed another door. The wind was unbelievable. The weather didn't know the prices for the fish, asked around, and brought a receipt for all the fish dishes. The food arrived quickly. I was expecting a nice spicy snapper that would justify $42 - not this time. The dish was plain and small. Well, knowing when not to go next is also insightful.

Lovely cafe with a little garden and play ground for kid at the back. Phở is customised to nz style with big portion of noodle. My kiwi husband love it but I hope it has more broth, or less noodle. In general really fulfilling bowl. Nice flavour with chopped ends of spring onion. Banh My was really nice with pate! Prawn bao bun was great. You gotta try salted coffee here - star! We had some other things for the kids - which are okay. Banana bread is a must try! Us 2 and 3 kids come to $105. Pretty good for auckland.
Very tasty Banh mi and Pho, I just wish there was a bit more soup in the Pho, but overall it was delicious!

I may have just found my new favourite cafe. I loved the courtyard out the back. Perfect space for kids and well behaved dogs. The Vietnamese Pho, fresh spring rolls and Banh Mi were amazing and, for me, 100% why I’d return and recommend this place to others. $9 Saigon lager - perfect on a hot day. Just loved coming here. Friendly staff, fantastic food and comfortable seating indoors and out.

This cafe is a true gem with a hidden garden that’s both beautiful and peaceful. The coffee is amazing, rich in flavor and clearly made with care. It’s the perfect spot to relax and enjoy a great cup in a charming setting!
An absolute gem! This is my favorite cafe in the Ponsonby area. Their Banh Mi and Bao Buns are incredibly delicious—the best I've ever had.

We have been here before and happy to report our second visit did not disappoint! We wish we could dine here every week! The intrigue of the blacked out slide door entry, makes you feel like you’re entering a private club. The staff welcome you to your plush and intimate dining area. The view of the sky tower and city is wonderful with floor to ceiling windows. Each exquisite dish was plated with such artistry, so beautiful and tastes just as divine! Each morsel was flavour explosions, tastebuds dancing and awakened! Even the plates are fun and playful elegance -the chef informed us they are created by locals, this added to the dining experience,. After dessert, the kitchen also served a lovely chocolate with candle for our birthday celebration. It was a brilliant experience highly recommended from start to finish! Thank you Sidart!

I had an amazing experience dining at Sidart with my partner. The waiter and waitress were attentive and the food was served at a very good pace - not left too long between the courses. The food itself was absolutely delicious, one of my favourite out of all the degustation meals I’ve had. The flavour combination was unique and finely balanced, and the amount of food did not left me too hungry or too full by the end of the night. Would highly recommend this restaurant to others and will be sure to come back soon :)

Had their tasting menu, wonderful service and very creative dishes. Would like to note the beef we had had a slight chew and noticed other customers leaving chewy part out too. But overall great experience
Had my birthday dinner here through first table. I would say overall great service and great food. Food was quite unique and carefully prepared by the chef.

Review from our visit in June 2024 Sidart’s tasting menu presented a visually stunning range of dishes, with a few standouts and a couple of misses. The mushroom and beef snacks were particular highlights, offering rich, well-balanced flavours. By contrast, the fish and chips snack leaned too salty, and the meringue felt a bit too soft. Fortunately, the mains and dessert courses were executed more consistently, leaving a positive overall impression. The owner and executive chef, Lesley Chandra, was very warm and hospitable.

Will be one of my new favourite Japanese restaurants! Fan favourites were the salmon sashimi and the chicken teriyaki skewers. Everything was so fresh and cooked to perfection. It's a smaller restaurant so dining felt more intimate - would definitely come back!

Overall it was good. Sashimi was so fresh!!! Yakitori was also yummy! We ve got chef selection and chicken heart. The chicken heart was real good !! Chef selection was good deal for what you get but next time, we would prefer to order individual yakitori as we can pick what we want. We added karrage chicken in the end. I felt the chicken didn't have enough seasoning. a bit blend to me. We will definitely be back to have more yakitori!
Really good king ora salmon sashimi! So fresh! Love the pork belly skewers, aburi salmon!! 🍣 😍

First thing you notice at this store when you walk in is the open kitchen which the chef does the BBQ skewers in, the open kitchen is surprisingly quiet as you could not hear it at all. The presentation and aesthetics are one of the better ones compared to other Asian dinning I've been to in Auckland. However this brings me to the next part. The price is well, shall we say... Expensive. Pictured below, is a dish of "chef special" skewers which sell for just south of $30 of which while looks good, is ultimately disappointing as the taste is average and portion abysmal. You're looking at spending $70-80 for 2 people if you want to have a full stomach. But as the location is up market, the price is understandable.
Great food and plenty of choice, all the Japanese staple fare. Not cheap but not too expensive.

I have had multiple problems with their night shift staff, I reccomend ordering from another mc donalds at night because it seems like they may have issues with the management of their night shift and may have trainees at this time. Will not be ordering from here at night from now on.

Ordered dinner for two through uber eats, one drink was missing and the other just half the size of glass. When I connected with the employee in store through phone, he simply closed the conversation by telling that- just reach uber, you will get refund.

Close to my house, when they’re good they’re amazing, but when they’re bad oh my lord is it garbage. Redeemed a mcsipicy bout a month or two ago, gave me the most driest, dense, basically cardboard chicken. Other times they’ll give you whatever fries are there, soggy or not. Another time I asked for a Coke no ice, they gave me no sugar Coke WITH ice 😭 like one or the other is fine but bothhhh. Then recent one had me and another guy wait in the lobby for 30 mins for our meals watching our burgers go to new drive through orders, and the photo above shows how this place can be 😂 Also their aim accuracy putting sauce on Big Macs TRUST ME are -100% 😭😂 it does the job, but GAWD DAYMN
I have never eaten a burger that smells like sulphur!! And if I could rate this place as a ZERO it would be at it's best. Never going there again, high in food poisoning and very poor service!

I recently visited McDonald’s Grey Lynn and was disappointed by their misleading advertising. They have a sign stating that after completing a survey, you will be rewarded with a Cheeseburger, an Apple Pie, or a Small Sundae. However, after completing the survey and approaching the counter, the duty manager informed me that I wasn’t eligible for any reward unless I had accumulated points first. Good atmosphere, the food is great, dinning feels like a izakaya 🏮 nevertheless the food options on menu are just perfect…

Had dinner with a couple of my friends the other day and it was such a cute vibe. First time visiting Yuzu, been wanting to try here for a while and it definitely met expectations! We had the Wafu beef, teriyaki tofu, salmon avo sushi and crunchy prawn sushi. Would definitely recommend!

Damn where do I start. Entree. Wow. One of the best. Actually no. THE BEST miso soup I’ve ever had. In my life. I’ve had a fair share of miso soup in my life. I wanted more omg. Just so good. Next. The deep fried tofu starting with the Yuzu Bento - WOW flavour bomb. Absolutely delicious 😍 tofu has never been so flavourful. Smokey. Sweet. Salty. 10/10. The bento itself was definitely worth ordering. A taste of everything at your fingertips 8/10 The teriyaki chicken was nice. But was missing that Smokey flavour. 7/10. Beef Tataki at $21 was coming in steep for a skinny slice of meat. It was definitely delicious but not worth $21. I would price it around $15-18 for that size. Overall 100 recommend this place. I will be back. Definitely an Auckland iconic restaurant.

We ate a boat in Yuzu! 😂 Opening the door for years of history, it is one of the Must Go in Ponsonby. Small Japanese style venue, but it's actually run by a Korean family. By reading the certificates on the wall, you know the chef has been well trained in terms of the Japanese cooking skills. Great atmosphere, great hospitality, great good this is what you are asking for on a Friday evening!

Absolutely loved this place! The atmosphere was perfect for a relaxed evening with friends. The staff were attentive & friendly. We tried several dishes, and each one was packed with flavor. The karage was crispy and perfect.They also had a great selection of Nama Beers which reminds me of japan's izakaya. Prices were reasonable for the quality. Definitely coming back！ありがとう😊また来ます。

Absolutely loved the experience at Pizza Hut Grey Lynn! The staff were super friendly especially samdeep, and the service was quick and efficient. My order was ready on time, and the food was piping hot and delicious. The pizzas were perfectly made – generous with toppings, great crust, and full of flavour. The garlic bread and wings were also spot on. The store was clean and well-maintained, making pickup smooth and hassle-free. Highly recommend this location if you're looking for tasty food, great service, and consistent quality. Will definitely be coming back again!

The place and the pizza are awesome! Especially a staff member named SAM* — he has an amazing personality. I believe he works only night shifts. I've been dealing with him for a long time, and honestly, I buy pizzas only from here because of him.
Sam deep Tnxx you much . Pizza Hut grey Lynn has some of the best pizza around. 🍕🍕🍕

Coming from Australia that Pizza Hut is way better and I was excited to go. Personally I can't complain about the price and the service was nice mostly. If I were going to complain it would be that the Kit Kat dessert thing was pretty lame.

People often say, - and I’ve certainly echoed the sentiment myself, - that franchise food tends to lack depth. Built on over-processed meats, mass-produced ingredients, and a kind of frozen predictability, it rarely dares to surprise. My most recent order, the Hot & Spicy vegetarian, was a near-perfect embodiment of that stereotype food-snobs chant to be bouchée, doughy, with an over-proofed crust puffed full of oversized air bubbles more about volume than flavour. The capsicum, cut in eerie symmetry and shaded an offset grey-green, offered nothing unexpected. It was exactly what you’d anticipate from a chain, -and therein, oddly, lies the revelation. Because then came the lightbulb moment: this is why people return. Not despite the uniformity, but because of it. There’s a strange comfort in the familiar, a nostalgic pull in the ritual of the unchanging. It’s reliable, almost soothing in its predictability, - flavour that never strays too far from the blueprint, at-least this explains my weekday experience, 7.30pm, ordering from a flirty Bollywood sexologist, palpably sinister energy, deprived & longing for some processed meat, sausage if you will. “Welcome to the, Mt Albert branch, what order is what you expect”. Grey Lynn store has me questioning my food ethics cause there’s something almost alchemical about the Pizza Hut in Grey Lynn. Yes, the recipe is standard, the branding global, but something intangible shifts the experience here. The pizza somehow tastes like it’s made with love, - or at the very least, light flirtation. Perhaps it’s the man, the only man behind the counter: smug in the way only someone who knows he’s mastered the crust can be. Charismatic, inexplicably handsome for someone holding a cheese ladle, he brings an unexpected kind of swagger to the process. The toppings don’t feel tossed on—they feel chosen. The result is familiar, yes, but with an edge of something more intentional, more alive. I find myself going back. Not just because it’s open until 5am (a time of questionable decisions and odd cravings), but because Grey Lynn’s Pizza Hut offers something rare, - a fast-food experience with personality. It’s less like ordering pizza and more like participating in a low-key romance between nostalgia and nuance. In the end, if you’re after something mildly mysterious, possibly inconsistent, and unexpectedly charming, this spot is worth the detour. Whether it’s dusk or dawn, Grey Lynn’s Pizza Hut delivers more than just a meal. Just don’t ask what makes it different, - some things are better left unsaid… or left in the sauce.
4-5 workers are having loud chats at the back and leaving the kid alone at the front to deal with all the customers. Service is non existent, shouldn’t have to wait 30 minutes for a burger

The KFC branch in Ponsonby was great! The staff were all very friendly. My partner and I ordered the Hot and Spicy boneless chicken and a set menu with wicked wings and supercharge sauce. The crispiness was a bit below my expectations, but overall, it was clean and satisfying. We both enjoyed our second dinner date here. A recommended spot for anyone keen for wicked wings!

Old, almost totally cold chips… again. And no extra seasoning (requested… ignored). This is not the first time, when are you going to pick up your game and standards, and care just a tiny little bit? Disappointed. Again.

Less than a star, The last 2 orders proofed the quality isn't matter for the staff. An order of 3 pieces chicken were as hard as rocks. I couldn't believe that was chicken. The second order spicy chicken pieces. They weren't warm. A staff member hang off the call when I called to complain, rude.

Very disappointing experience at KFC Ponsonby. The service was extremely slow.I had to wait over half an hour just to get my order. There was no proper communication from the staff during the wait, and it felt like complete chaos behind the counter. Clearly, the team is not trained to handle busy periods. If you’re hungry and in a hurry, this is definitely not the place to go. Needs serious improvement.

Highly recommend booking an outdoor table – perfect for photos and enjoying the vibe. The coffee is smooth and ‘beautifully presented’. The prawn spaghetti is spicy but full of flavor – absolutely yum! Don’t order it if u can’t have spicy food 🤣

Queenies has a lovely cozy energy, staff were kind and welcoming, and the prawn spaghetti had the perfect kick for a cold winter’s afternoon. My friends and I are already planning our next brunch date there, thank you!

A delightful eatery tucked away in Freeman’s Bay that serves delicious meals and coffee. I did not realise until now that I had ordered the same thing every time I went, which was their delicious Chicken Caesar Salad. I would certainly recommend their food. Will be retuning!

Found this cute hidden gem in Freemans Bay. Loved the food and coffee, I had the creamy mushrooms which were delicious and presented beautifully. Service was friendly. Cabinet food looked great, will give it a try next time.
I visited in a late sunday afternoon. Such a cute little cafe, really enjoyed the vibe there. The egg benedict was good. Wonderful place to sit down and relax with a coffee.

Tonight was an absolute disappointment, and I can't shake the feeling of having wasted my money. I honestly can't find a single positive thing to say about the food. First, the wine was corked, sour, and unpleasant. The squid was tough and chewy, served with wilted salad and loads of balsamic vinegar—no care or effort put into the dish whatsoever. No respect for a delicate seafood which should not be dawned in vinegar. And don't even get me started on the carbonara. Adding cream to carbonara is an unforgivable sin in Italian cooking, and what I was served was basically overcooked pasta drowned in cream and parmesan with almost no meat. It was clear that the pasta was store-bought, and the dish was a sad excuse for one of Italy’s beloved classics. The pizza was no better—I'm pretty sure the dough was pre-made, and the toppings were barely there. It felt like a mockery of authentic Italian cuisine. The only saving grace of the evening was the live music, which, at least, gave us something enjoyable to listen to. However, that alone wasn’t enough to salvage the experience. This place completely disregards the respect and tradition that Italian cuisine deserves

Disappointed….. Ordered the squid rings, sausage carbonara and small prosciutto pizza. The $20 squid rings weren’t prepared properly. Leaving the membrane on made them chewy and the mushroom sauce (which tasted more like vinegar) was the wrong choice for squid. The $33 sausage carbonara was over cooked packet spaghetti in a cream sauce with half a dozen bits of sausage cut up into it. Don’t get me started on the store bought pizza base on the $22 Prosciutto pizza…….. Poor overpriced food (for what it is)….. but a great atmosphere…..the lady playing the accordion was brilliant.

Great pizzas and pasta here. They also have steak and other meals that I haven't tried. Had a Combination pizza that has chicken, beef, lamb and peppercorns. Smaller place but there always seems to be lots of available seating, not sure why. Family business where they're always friendly. Update: in a new location in Herne Bay, even better in every way and finally seem to be getting the volume of diners you'd expect at a restaurant with this quality of food and service. Friendly family business. Have been twice since they moved to Herne Bay and found parking down side streets pretty easy both times.

It's an authentic Italian restaurant and the waiters are very hospitable. There are plenty of options for pasta, but I ordered the beef lasagna, where the rich texture of the cheese and the flavour of the tomatoes counterbalance the greasiness of the cheese and meat. The dried fruit in the rum ice cream seemed to have been soaked in rum beforehand and was delicious

Bono is one of my husband and I favorites places to eat. We absolutely love their carbonara! Chef special garlic bread is great too! We tried other dishes too like fish and ravioli and they were also super nice. The owners and the staff are friendly and we always feel super welcome there.

I went to Grey Lynn Kebab on my way home after a pretty tough day. I just wanted a snack, so ordered a few felafels. The kind man in the shop also gave me some salads, hummus and garlic yoghurt. The food was superb, but what really impressed me was the kindness and generosity of the man who served me. I will definitely go back to try their kebabs next time.
Turkish word kebap is derived from the Persian word kabāb, meaning roasted meat...

The falafels are the best I’ve ever had! Amir makes them himself, using fresh parsley etc - and you can tell! You can taste the days of work that he puts into them! They have so much flavour - they are really delicious! I will definitely be back. 3 of us went there together, and I had a falafel kebab, someone got the chicken on rice, and someone got a lamb kebab. We were all very happy with our dinner :)

Great experience here - just went in to try the place and I said I was getting a side of chips for my wife. Was kind enough to give my wife some salad, hummus and dips to go with it. Man who works there was very kind - definitely worth a try

Great guy Good chats while we waiting with the guy My mum's hand was bleeding so he helped give tissue to stop it bleeding We could get as many sauces as we liked in the kebab. We got a bag for the takeaways. Reasonable prices

I’m at the front end of a three month journey through New Zealand. I’m staying in the Grey Lynn neighborhood and stopped at this wonderful veggie burger restaurant. I ordered the Wise Boy and it did not disappoint. I highly recommend you stop by, roll up your sleeves, and have one of their delicious selections and enjoy their wonderful hospitality. “Make burgers, not war” as their sign encourages!

This vegan Cafe has done fabulous food options but there's room for improvement. Be prepared for a wait when ordering food online. Bunless burger served with lettuce, was flavorful but it was very messy to eat. Overall its a good spot to eat if you're patient and don't mind the mess.

I was pleasantly surprised by this plant-based burger place! As a first-timer to plant-based burgers, I ordered the Spicy Mex, and it was delicious. The burger itself was well-made and flavorful, a testament to how far plant-based options have come.

Thank you!!! This is the best vegan burger I've ever had. Felt like I wasn't eating a token vegan burger and settling. I had the chick'n deluxe, it was massive. Nice bit of crunchy fresh salad, yummy salsa, their own vegan chicken patty that wasn't dense and dry, yummy cheese and vegan bacon! Plus a SOFT gluten free bun. Sooooo happy I'll be back! NZ if finally catching up ❤️

On Friday, we ordered two burgers—one of them was the “dirty boy”, and we were really looking forward to trying it. We placed the order through the website for take-away, and when we got home, we realized they had given us a different one instead of the “dirty boy”. So, we decided to call to see what solution they could offer, but they just told us, "We'll call you back later," which never happened. This small issue, which had a very quick and easy solution, ended up ruining the whole experience for us.

Nice little vegan bakery that is good enough to fool any non vegan. They have a wide variety of sweet and savoury options. They have some basic outdoor seating I loved everything, highly recommend the biscoff cheesecake!

We tried the chicken and mushroom, Spanish, and tofu pies for breakfast. The chicken pie was really nice and quite unique because they marinated the chicken, making it soft, unlike the typical chicken pie.

Just popped in here for a little sweet pick me up! This place has the best treats, and everything is vegan. Staff are lovely, smells delicious in there. Definitely recommend :) Jess, Hospitality Specialist Kakapo Business Sales
Lovely food, on the more expensive side for some items but kinda expected in today's economy. Very delish food, I tried the cream bun

Best vegan pies I had in New Zealand! I got the creamy chicken and mushroom pie and it was amazing. They have a wide selection of other pies as well. Will definitely come back when I visit Auckland again!

Nice decor. Staff not overly friendly but sufficient. Beef chilli/mince burrito and taco were okay. 2 wrong orders given and meat was terribly dry and not tasty at all. Not impressed at all!!!! Don't recommend eating here at all

Was going to give 2 star if food was good, it was cold. Asked the staff to toast, she said wrap was pre-toasted. Discrepancy between food item on the board, menu and price. Not a friendly service, food knowledge was low.

I ordered takeaway loaded fries and burritos today, and everything was excellent! The young woman working there was absolutely lovely, friendly, kind, and very accommodating in preparing the food just the way I wanted. Everything was ready really quickly, and the food was fresh and delicious. Thank you so much! 😊
Good quality food for a reasonable price. There's a cool vibe inside. They are open late compared to the other food places in Ponsonby. The Whiskey bar nearby is a great place for a drink.

This is one of the best mix of collies in the country the food is always fresh because of the high turnover you know that the stock is always being refreshed. They have a great team in place and I’ve had many late night orders from here and have always been impressed even when getting it from uber. Sterling Arnet Kakapo Business Sales

Good service, the waiter let us sit on a table for 4 after ai asked even though there were only my friend and I. The food was very tasty, my friend is a chef and he tried the salmon and said it was fresh caught. Nice and quiet environment, probably also because we got there after 3PM. Anyway, very nice eating experience.

I'm very disappointed in the grilled bento box. Bland meat and not worth the price. Usually, a bento box would have a combo of a few things. This box only had salad and bland meat. There is nothing special in the box that you can't cook at home. Could have done this at home if I'd known. Over $200 was spent for 4 people. Could have bought a lot of groceries for this amount. On a +ve, the service was good. Just need the chef to be a bit more creative with what they are serving customers.

Amazing experience! The food was incredibly fresh and flavorsome, especially the sashimi and Karage chicken. The atmosphere was warm and authentic, and the staff were friendly and attentive. Every dish was beautifully presented, and you can tell they care about quality. Definitely one of the best Japanese restaurants I’ve been to—highly recommend!

I’m a regular at this place—the sashimi is insanely fresh, and the scallop sashimi is an absolute must-try. The miso sauce on the grilled eggplant is simply out of this world; once you start, you just can’t stop eating! Every dish is authentically prepared, and you have to finish off your meal with a daifuku dessert.
Had a good lunch at Tokyo Club in Ponsonby. Was impressed with the portion sizes and the value for money. Only criticism would have been the cook on the beef. Will be back though. Thank you 🙏

Service was awesome!! Our server was really lovely and the food and drinks came out very fast. The pink tofu toast was really awesome and new to the menu definitely a great cafe that can cater to all allergies ☺️

Had a late breaky here today! Absolutely love this café. It’s always full clearly very supported by all the regulars around Hearn Bay :) When you walk in, you’re always greeted by the friendly staff, super attentive, and honestly always lovely to deal with. I sat down today and had the chili eggs breakfast and you won’t be disappointed. Huge portion absolutely delicious! I’m already regular, but you know I’ll be back. Thank you so much to the staff! Jess, hospitality specialist Kakapo Business Sales

Dear Jervois is a lovely spot for breakfast, offering delicious food, great service, some impressive cabinet foods, and a lovely atmosphere. The breakfast menu is diverse and satisfying, with a variety of options that are both flavorful and beautifully presented. The staff is attentive and friendly, making sure you have everything you need for an enjoyable start to your day. The ambiance is warm and inviting, perfect for a relaxed morning meal. Whether you're in the mood for a classic breakfast dish or something a bit more unique, Dear Jervois provides a wonderful experience that makes it a top choice for breakfast lovers.

Located at Herne Bay. They have dining inside and outside on bench tables. The team are friendly and service is good. The food is Mediterranean feel, lots of spices and sauces with the meals. Tasty, fresh and a decent sizes. They are not the cheapest, prices match the suburb and fellow cafes. Coffee was well done and decent size cups. Nice casual environment.

This was the first place we are after relocating to Auckland and a 12.5 hour flight. Our server was the sweetest person ever. She was delightful. My pesto mushrooms and lentils dish was excellent! It was by far the tastiest mushroom dish I’ve eaten in the last 1.5 months of living here. The avocado toast and waffles were not nearly as good. They were alright, but nothing special. Our server recommended the eggs cooked in tomatoes. I’m keen to try this next. So far this is our favorite place to eat on Jervois.

Cute little sushi spot - they have fresh flowers which is a lovely touch. I wasn’t a huge fan of the food options - lots of saucy, deep fried, westernised style sushi. Some of the more traditional maki and nigiri is very good though, such generous amounts of avocado. The staff are nice and keep the cabinets full.
My son loves eating here. The sushi is fresh and the owners are very welcoming. A great spot for a quick meal.
For me, it’s the best sushi in Auckland, I tried so many places before and there still my number one for years!! Not the cheapest but totally worth it on my opinion, and the owner is very friendly!!!

The quantity and quality are great, and it’s a perfect place since there are no other options nearby for group orders. The service is friendly, and the food is delicious, so I should become a regular.
The teriyaki chicken and salmon is absolutely amazing, very friendly service and large selection of food and drink. Highly recommend!!!

I recently visited Boy and Bird and had the pleasure of trying their crispy chicken, and it was absolutely delicious! The chicken was perfectly cooked with a golden, crispy exterior that gave way to juicy, tender meat inside. The seasoning was spot on, providing a nice balance of flavours without overpowering the natural taste of the chicken. The service was also friendly and efficient, making for a great overall dining experience. Highly recommend Boy and Bird if you’re craving some top-notch crispy chicken!
Nice cosy atmosphere. We had the half chicken and the fried broccoli and cauliflower. Tasted decent and I especially liked the gravy that came with the chicken.

We were searching for food on New Years Day and Boy & Bird were open! We were pleasantly surprised with just how good the food was! The Korean chicken roll was great - the chicken was crisp and the roll very airy, the kimchi on top really sealed the deal. Couldn’t recommend it more!

We went there for dinner and it was not very busy, our drinks came out fast. The meal took about 20 minutes -we ordered a half chicken, a buttermilk fried chicken main (must try !) And a side salad. Everything tasted good and my little one enjoyed it. We even got a free bar of choc for the little one, it was a surprise and thanks to the team for making it a bit special in this ordinary day.

I had a wonderful experience at Boy and Bird. The atmosphere was cozy and welcoming, with friendly staff who made us feel right at home. Every dish we tried was delicious. The presentation was beautiful, and the flavors were well-balanced.

The restaurant was very busy and loud. The dinning area is quite tight. The staff who served our table wasn’t very friendly and professional. He can’t recommend us any dishes and when we showed him the dish photos on the google he kept saying “I don’t know what is that.” When we seek staff for help and when we saw him he also avoided eye contact with us and walked away without showing interest to help us. Only the manager was able to look after us and every table was all under his control. He’s very friendly and professional. If possible the staffs definitely needs more training by him. Food wise the pizza was amazingly delicious! The veal we ordered was dry and too sweet. You needs book a table online.

I enjoyed my time here. The food was good and I like that they balanced flavours really well. Nothing was to overpowering which I quite enjoyed especially when it came to the ceviche. To add, the service I had was exceptional and the person who served me was knowledgeable when I had questions and also very kind.

Farina is hands down serving up some of the best Italian food I've ever had. The burrata was creamy perfection, and the cone pizza was genius. But what really stole the show was the pasta - it was like a taste explosion in my mouth. The pizza was also life-changing (no exaggeration!). Every dish was expertly crafted, and the service was top-notch. If you're looking for solid, authentic Italian food, Farina is the place to go. 5 stars isn't enough - I'd give it 10 if I could!

Decided to celebrate my wife's 61st at Farina after having come across them during the Auckland Italian festival earlier in the year. Great ambience, attentive, knowledgeable, and humorous staff. Fantastic food. We started with a platter of olives that consisted of different varieties, plus pickled garlic. The osso bucco on risotto was one of the evening's special dishes and I had to have that and paired it with the Chianti. Suffice to say it was delectable. The wife debated between the parmigiana, gnocchi or a meat platter... and settled for gnocchi and she loved it. Topped off the meal with dessert - panacotta with almonds, cannoli with pistachio cream, and an espresso. Overall, a great dining experience.

Came to Farina's for a work dinner for our small team. Firstly, due to traffic, we were quite late, Farina's moved things around on a very busy night to make sure our experience wasn't cut short by the 2 hour limit - So a huge thanks from us. We had a variety of starters and different meals on the table and every single one of them was completely finished and very much enjoyed. The Burrata and fresh bread was a top on everyones list. The restuarant has a busy, homely and joyous feel to it - Stay clear or book on quiter days if you want to avoid crowds and overall noise. Sorry for the bad photos! Low light and lack of paying attention made it difficult

My experience at Tinted Rose was really exciting. It’s nice to have a cocktail spot that feels a bit tucked away. It has that cosy, intimate vibe you want in a cocktail bar, without the noise or chaos you sometimes get in the city. We visited on a Saturday around 6:30 pm and were seated straight away. I reckon this could become my go-to for drinks and catch-ups in the city. They’ve also got blankets and heating in the outdoor area, which was a nice touch in the cooler months. We had wines and cocktails, and the staff were great at recommending drinks that matched what I was after. Top-notch hospitality.
Great place, lovely vibe and decor. Drinks were excellent and well made

Chill vibes with a touch of tattooed opulence in this pokey little drinking hole. Leather, dark wood and a little veranda out back under hanging vines. The staff are cool - I can’t speak to the cocktails… yet.
Wonderful place for a first date! Nice upbeat atmosphere. Service is amazing not over tentative! Highly recommend it.
Popped in for the 1st time last night for a glass of wine, and ended up having two. Can not comment on the food, but intend to eat there soon. Great bar, good service and a chilled vibe.

Miann has been a longtime favourite of ours since its early days on Fort Street, and it continues to impress. Today, I tried their Vietnamese Iced Coffee, which struck a perfect balance between robust coffee flavour and just the right amount of condensed sweetness-not overly sweet at all. The service was warm and welcoming, and the pastry cabinet was beautifully presented, showcasing Miann’s signature creativity and flair for innovative desserts. Although we didn’t sample any of the cabinet treats this time (we were simply too full), the tempting display ensures we’ll be back soon. The atmosphere is inviting, making it an ideal spot to relax and indulge. Convenient parking is available on the main road or in nearby public lots, so popping in is easy. If you love inventive desserts in a lovely setting, Miann is a must-visit in Auckland.

Such a wonderful find at the end of an evening out for dinner. We had hot chocolates - there were 8 different types of mint, chilli, white...and the desserts were beautifully crafted and delicious. I've never tasted such a smooth chocolate mousse.

Just tried two hot chocolates. I had the chilly hot chocolate and my friend had another dark hot chocolate drink. Both with marshmallows. Delicious. The chilly hot chocolate had the right amount of chilly. Great marshmallows on the side.
Loved the mocha and choc chip cookie. Desserts are impeccable, have had a fair bit of their selection in the past. Polite courteous service by Yan. Great spot to unwind after a day's work.
Magnificent and very good, Perfection service, The tea gelati is pefect.

A cozy nice place to go for a coffee and yum donuts. I had a cappuccino and a pastry from the shelf which looked good, they added coconut cream on to it, it was good, the donut was very good with filling which you can pick from or even give you the toll to add it yourself. It's a nice place to enjoy a coffee and a good pastry. We went there on a Sunday morning and it was full of customers, but found a sit quickly. Not much to worry.

We were wandering around the Ponsonby Centre looking at the options, and were attracted by the size of the pies. The price was increased to match of course, but they were delicious. I almost got a pastry to go with it, but on hindsight, may not have finished it. The service was friendly and cheerful and the place was very busy, which is always my benchmark.

*Updated 2/11/23: Very good. *Updated 17/4/22: Food and coffee are still awesome, however becoming expensive for what you get in comparison to other cafés. The menu can be misleading and didn't have prices for eggs on toast etc. (Photo provided). Great little cafe, music good, staff friendly and efficient. Coffee was very good and cosy atmosphere. Only complaint is the rickety seating and tables.

Well here is another breakfast review or brunch if you fancy it. We were lost in the city (near Ponsonby) looking for a spot to eat before heading home and we were fortunate enough to stumble upon Foxtrot Parlour. Oh you never heard of it? Neither did we but so glad we did. I mean if you need to feed several picky eaters this could work. From breakfast burritos to pancakes to muesli. There something for everyone, even the kids. All types of baked goods, they had cinnamon rolls on our day (delicious) and coffee. Yes I know what place doesn't have coffee, but it's good coffee! Get there early if you want a seat though they got fairly busy on our day. They also have both indoor and outdoor seating, to keep in mind if you fancy sitting in the sun. The staff was pleasant and quick with our food and even got my takeaway coffee ready in a jiff as we were leaving. (Did I mention the great coffee). So to recap: Lost (check); Hungry (check); Want some great food with great atmosphere (check, check and check). Find your way here, you will not be disappointed!!

How can I express this hidden jade cafe in Ponsonby. Started my day with great coffee made by lovely staff. Had just made beautiful cinnamon bioche. Will tryout their huge pie next time! Highly recommend to visit.

A cozy spot with great vibes. The food is amazing, stumbled upon this spot back in 2020 and was amazed by the food. Came back again recently and it was what I remembered. Perfectly cooked meat, amazing sauces. I would say it is a carnivores dream to just have all that amazing meat! The service is great and the staff were friendly, just as I remembered. I would definitely recommend getting the platter with multiple meats to share!

Wow. First time here. What a treat to end the week. Went for first table on an Auckland Friday. Outstanding food, drinks, and service from Tomas and the team. Great atmosphere as you’d expect in Ponsonby. Beautifully fresh salads and buns and incredible coal bbq’d meat. Perfectly cooked steak. Sumptuous, all round! Cheers

BBQ! I recommend the chorizo. The pork belly was also good, but the beef steak was quite tough (maybe due to the meat quality?). I liked that plenty of side salad was served with the main dish. When I visited, there was only one chef and one manager working, but they were professional and friendly even in a fully packed and busy situation – true superstars! It's a great place to stop by for a drink with the chorizo.
Almost perfect. Everything has high quality. Meat, bread, salads. The beef was slightly rough and salad was over-salty. But lamb was perfect.
Have been wanting to try this place for ages. Got the lunch special Great food! Will come back to try that amazing looking short ribs

Best authentic French crepes in both sweet and savory! Their crepes are so soft and tender, the batter is thin. The must try has to be the smoked salmon and creamed cheese, my absolute favorite!! Crepes ranges around $15-22

This place was a fantastic find! The crepes were light and flavourful, packed with fresh, generous fillings. What really made the visit special was the service was warm and welcoming, It’s clear the team is passionate about what they do and truly values their guests. I’ll definitely be returning!
Their crepes have been really awesome. I love their caramel and chocolate one. I enjoy it with ice cream and whipped cream. I also love their staff, helps me practice my french.
The waffles and dark chocolate crepes were so delicious. Vibrant atmosphere too

The crepe place my partner and I visited after a delicious pizza dinner date nearby was excellent!! It is located inside Ponsonby Central, making it easy to find. This might be one of the few dessert spots in Ponsonby, and I really enjoyed it. Firstly, they offered a wide range of crepes and waffles, with options to serve with bananas and ice cream based on your preference. Secondly, the staff was kind and friendly. Although only two ladies were working that day, they were exceptionally welcoming. Additionally, there was a large teddy bear that added to the charming atmosphere. My partner adored it, which made me a bit jealous. Lastly, the crepes were delicious, and the peppermint tea we ordered complemented them perfectly. For anyone searching for a great dessert place that offers more than just ice cream in Ponsonby, I highly recommend this spot.

A restaurant located on the quieter end of Ponsonby Road. Delicious Asian fusion food and the restaurant has a really great vibe. The curry was delicious and so were the dumplings. The only letdown was that the drinks ordered (mango tango) did not taste like it had any mango in it. Thanks to the server for giving us a mango gelato serve to make up for it.

some of the best Asian fusion food I have had in a while. Raw fish and the market fish and sticky pork were standouts. and the almond tart with salted caramel icecream.. wow. perfectly balanced. staff really fantastic.

Fantastic all round - communications when I changed the number coming - greeting when we entered - bar tender - table upstairs - waiter - service - food was delicious - made for a great night! Highly recommended. It had been a long time since I had last been and it did not disappoint, everything was on point, well done to all at Mekong Baby!

Mekong Baby is the most perfect dinner spot for family and friends in Ponsonby. Service was great. the food came out super quickly and was very filling. Our server recommended the mango salad and it was a table favourite!!

Mekong Baby is always a great experience! Delicious food, nice atmosphere, great service - fast, friendly and efficient. Have been to this restaurant many times over the years and it never disappoints. Highly recommend. Pictured is the popcorn prawns, pad see ew, crispy lamb ribs, green fish curry, roti and rice, rose and lychee martini. All delicious!
It was so amazing having the chefs bring your food directly to you after watching them cook it too. The amount of meat in each meal was amazing and the quality of meat is so good too!
Beef Brisket rice bowl was epic! Best rice + meat dish I’ve had in some time. The venue is very cool, seating around the bar is cool.

The brisket ramen was good! Delicious broth and the beef was slow braised and melted in your mouth. The crab bao was really average tho, had no flavour in the salad or any sauce so it was pretty meh. Needs work.

Not a place for me - both beef brisket and cobra kai super mega ramen were so so. The corn fritter gave me a mouthful of flour-ish feeling, didn't bother to finish it. The only good thing was the dishes came fairly quick and in good temperature. Never again.

My husband and I eat here at least once a month. Chop Chop is always consistent. The food is amazing, the service is great and we’ve never had any issues! Highly recommend trying it if you haven’t already. In my opinion, it’s the best place to eat in Auckland :).

Popped in very close to closing time without a booking and they kindly let us dine. We felt like something light and fresh so we got the wontons, kimchi and a couple of the salads - all the ingredients were so fresh and delicious! I have been to Blue Breeze Inn many times over the years and it has never disappointed. Yummy food, lovely atmosphere, exceptional service always. Highly recommend.

The meal was good but the steak was a bit disappointing. They didn’t have ribeye but T-bone instead and there was not much meat for the price, and it tasted dry and overcooked for my liking (I realised afterwards that they didn’t ask how we’d like it cooked). The smashed cucumber is not smashed but eggplant dish was crunchy and tasty.

I have always loved The Blue Breeze Inn. Their staff has always been welcoming whenever we come visit, sometimes without a reservation, but we’re always made comfortable and welcome. My favorite is their pork bao bun, andntheir crispy wagyu salad. I try to come back at least once a month here. Love their food 🥰
Great vibe! Mood from lighting, music was great. Food was so good, especially loved the Fried rice with truffle mushroom. Service was on point 👌 highly recommend to have dinner here with friends.
Great food, great portion size, extremely flavoursome and the staff were super friendly. Also child friendly as we had our little one with us
A good selection of different cuisines and a friendly vibrant atmosphere. It’s a food court which I very much enjoyed 🥰❤️
Very nice FOOD COURT, Good food.

Lots of options, mostly overpriced, but I would imagine their rent is high. It's all a bit contrived. Better to support a small business local joint.. But this is a fine option for a get together with some friends.
Great place for food. Very authentic restaurants and good service. It is very much international cuisine and the quality of restaurants are very good. Expensive though.
Arrived too early. Only two cafes opened for breakfast. Tried the homemade pie. It came with some greens and tomatoes salsa. The taste is good and the pie portion is a bit large to me.

Absolutely beautiful place to stay, highly recommend! Our room was gorgeous, all refurbished and very spacious. The bed was so comfy. Super handy location. Staff were very welcoming and lovely. Only negative was my car mag being scraped with valet parking, but it has been handled very professionally from the Hotel Manager. Would definitely stay again.

In a great location. Was a short walk to the ballet, the art gallery and k road, and a very short uber to the viaduct. The staff where polite and helpful. The restaurant served great tasting food with a wide range of breakfast options but a limited dinner menu. Nice clean rooms and comfortable beds. Would stay here again

What a gem! Great location, absolutely stunned by the value for money and the level of service. We receive free upgrade to the Signature queen with view on Sky tower. We were welcomed in our room by a very cute card and chocolates. Room and common areas was very clean, modern and spacious. We had 2 smart flat screen TVs in our room!! Definitely recommend this hotel over more expensive ones. We opted for breakfast, no buffet and it was just ok but then the 2nd morning we got it delivered to our room! Lovely!! Thanks guys

I love staying here. So close to entertainment venues and a short walk to good eateries. In-house service fantastic especially reception. Nothing is too much trouble. Very reasonably priced and great to have onsite restaurant and bar too. Very happy to highly recommend Airedale Suites.

Husband and I started our journey here for a 2 week trip in NZ and the staff were incredible. The room was incredible, staff was very kind and helpful. And it’s across the street from a fun venue! We stumbled upon a comedy show!

Really enjoyed our stay. The bath was deep which was perfect. Spacious rooms. Super Comfortable bed. Fantastic mini bar spread. The restaurant had fantastic food. And we were given two complimentary drinks upon arrival.

Highly recommend this hotel. Perfect location, lovely clean room, bathroom with both tub and shower. Breakfasts wee wonderful and the one dinner I had in the restaurant was excellent. Feels historic, but with all modern updates and conveniences. I would stay here again without hesitation.

I am a regular at this hotel for both business and personal stays and there's a reason it's my favourite Auckland hotel... For a start the staff are always amazing and just can't do enough. Being a smaller hotel it has a personal friendly vibe. The food and beverages are always high quality and the best thing is the large, quiet rooms with divine beds and THE BEST HOUSEKEEPING IN AUCKLAND! Totally recommenced :)

If you’re coming to Auckland, the DeBrett Hotel is great! The rooms are clean, the beds are very comfortable and have nice linens, and blackout curtains. The staff are very friendly and helpful and the location is great. BritoMart, the Pier, and everything else you want to see in Auckland is within walking distance. Ponsonby is a short 8 minute Uber ride from the Hotel. We would absolutely stay here again!!

My wife and I really enjoyed our stay in this delightful downtown boutique hotel. We recommend a corner street facing room where possible. Sound proofing is so good, there is no noise. The room is really comfortable and we like the cool contemporary design throughout the hotel. Staff are so welcoming and friendly. The corner bar is a fantastic place for a drink on the sidewalk. Breakfast is delicious. Could not fault anything and will certainly return one day. Thank you Hotel DeBrett for a perfect stay.

BEST THAi RESTAURANT IN AUCKLAND Stepping into Red Elephant after reflexology derive in the same building at Grafton Auckland on 5/6/2025, my husband and I were fascinated by the romantic ambience of the restaurant. The food that we ordered were very tasty. As my husband is a vegetarian, we tried the vegetarian curry puff and vegetarian fried rice. We had the pleasure of meeting the owner who reported that the Red Elephant Restaurant at Khyber Pass Road has been here in the past 32 years non-stop. That alone speaks for itself! ADVICE: Highly recommended to give it a try if you want to taste the best cooked Thai food.
Amazing space and place Great customer service and the owner is the coolest guy. Friendly and welcoming. The food is superb! Everything we had was top notch and tasty.

I choose this venue for celebrating special occasions, and my recent visit with family reaffirmed its excellence. The service was outstanding. the waitresses knew exactly what my parents preferred and were exceptionally friendly. The cuisine, highlighted by dishes like the red curry and both roasted and steamed snapper, was superb. The flamed chicken provided an exciting experience that never grew dull, and its taste was exceptionally satisfying. This visit was as delightful as my previous ones. The combination of exquisite food and impeccable service ensures that my family always has a fantastic time here. I genuinely love this place!

Red Elephant Restaurant comes highly recommended for a memorable dinner experience. We celebrated our birthday at this esteemed establishment and were impressed by the exceptional cuisine. Their red curry was a personal favorite, and my companions relished every bite of their Pad Thai, which was brimming with flavors. The atmosphere was serene and picturesque, making it an ideal venue for families and those seeking a peaceful ambiance.

I spent my birthday with hubby here and had the most amazing experience. The service is fantastic, the food is packed with flavour and served with beautiful presentation. All the staff take pride in what they do. I will definitely be back very soon to try some more of their delicious menu options.

I had the crispy mushrooms Dorado's and Caesar salad, and both dishes were absolutely delicious, fresh, perfectly seasoned, and full of flavor. The highlight for me was definitely the cinnamon churros for dessert warm & crispy on the outside, soft on the inside, and just the right amount of sweetness. What made the experience even better was the service. Our waiter was incredibly well-trained, attentive, and genuinely interested in our feedback. It’s always great when staff check in and actually care about your dining experience. The service was also impressively quick, no long waits, just good food and good vibes.

Visited the newly renovated Mexico with a friend on a busy Friday, and the place just kept filling up as the afternoon went on. Despite the rush, the service was flawless—every staff member was attentive, and not once did the hostess seem overwhelmed. It was a complete transformation from my last visit before the renovation, when the space felt empty and lifeless. The difference was like night and day. Now, onto the real stars: the food and drinks. We stuck with their margaritas, and they didn’t disappoint. As for the food, we tried their famous fried chicken, but it fell a little short of expectations. Surprisingly, the standout dish of the night was the Crispy Mushroom & Cactus Taco—completely unexpected and absolutely delicious. Who knew a vegetarian taco could be that good? I could’ve easily eaten five more. We also tried a few other dishes and wrapped up with churros for dessert. While tasty, the churros were a bit too sweet. But honestly, nothing could top that taco! I’d go back just for that and a few margaritas.

What an amaizing flavours!! My favourite this time was the beef nachos. OMG!! I was dissapointed by The horchata, does not taste like horchata and it super sweet. The staff was very kind and welcoming.

We booked the margarita masterclass with the set menu and oh my word, what an awesome experience! So much fun mixing the 3 cocktails and the food was incredible, to say this is value for money is an understatement!! Highly recommended!!

Maxico Restaurant Auckland. Highly recommended by the locals. I am glad to visit this place at lunchtime. It was busy and created good vibes. Services are amazing and friendly. Good selection of drinks. The food was so fresh, it came out very quickly. Reasonable price too. I love pork tacos. The pork was so tender and melted in your mouth. We ordered a combination of pork, chicken and fish. I tried the mixed platter with prawns. Highly recommend. Please give it a try!

This place is a hidden gem! The food is delicious and well presented The service is polite and professional The atmosphere is relaxing and clean (and they have olive trees growing inside!) and the music isn’t too loud so you can still have a conversation without shouting at each other! Definitely recommend for big or small meetups (the place is very big). Recommend: burrata, gnocchi, BRAISED SHORT RIB (it’s sooo gooood) Also, they take allergies seriously.
