Our kids have 4 food allergies between them had no issues and the front of house staff always double checked with the kitchen. Well done to the staff there for being accommodating.
The food here is sooo good! the flavours were nice and presentation was great. overall would recommend !

This place was a wonderful find! Me and my Mum were looking for a nice place to grab some food after our flight and came across this place. There was no one else there but it was 8pm on a Monday. The ambience was so lovely it felt so relaxing and warm. Both our waitress' were so lovely and kind even though we might have been keeping them there later. The food was incredible, me and my Mum had a few snacks and starters to share and they were all great, compliments to the chef! I definitely recommend the crumbled stuffed jumbo olives.

We had the most amazing experience at La Zeppa! The place was beautifully decorated and had a relaxed ambience that made our experience feel very special. Plenty of parking available right outside. We were served by the lovely Tamsyn, who was thoughtful and professional. Her great service only further improved the atmosphere, helpful recommendations and a good balance of checking in and leaving us to enjoy our meal. As for the food, it carried on the theme of exceptional standards. Beautifully presented, and extremely tasty. We all had no complaints and couldn't help but compliment every plate we received. With a range of taste buds within our table we all thoroughly enjoyed our drinks and food. This was even more evident when it came to dessert and we all had a favourite that yet again we could not stop complimenting. We're so glad we chose to celebrate at La Zeppa and I cannot speak more highly of them. We truly had a great experience, to the point where I could not wait to get home to pass on our appreciation. Thank you for a wonderful meal and service 😊 🙌

This, is the place to be! La Zeppa has been metamoprhised into a chic, Mediterranean tasting and visual journey, and should be on everyone's bucket list to try out!! Benjamin and Elena took such good care of us when we ate with them here, serving such delicious flavors (the 1/2 chicken was insane) and perfect wine pairings. Best part is, the place isn't even fully finished, and everything looks and tastes so bloody beautiful already. Can't wait to see the full venue reveal when the last little touches are done!

Came here with a friend recently for dinner. The food was nice and well presented if a bit small in price. The servers were nice but the bartender was rather indifferent and dismissive to me when we first entered and inquired about dining options. The price of the food here is also quite high but for a fine dining experience its nice. Good for a one time try or if you enjoy fancy food but I won't be returning anytime soon.

Pasta was so so sooo yum. Sorry the pic is not doing it justice but I ordered the spaghetti and meatballs and woooow absolutely blown away either I’m impressed easily or that was the most perfect plate of pasta ever.

Dined at 5pm (HH) on a Weds, hence lower atmosphere rating. Banging pasta though, and was offered to try the red options when I inquired on which wine was better. Small gesture that I always really appreciate and respect from an establishment. Cheers guys - see you soon!

I would say the pasta here is the best that I have ever had in Auckland. Love the spaghetti with meet balls - the meat balls should be home made which are big and tasty. The pasta with duck is very delicious as well- the duck meat is tender and savory.

Had a impromptu brunch here with a friend. Firstly, every single staff member was one of the friendliest bunch I have seen, so welcoming, funny and kind. 10/10 customer service! When we tried the food, we fell in love with the place even more. We tried the vegan options and loved every single thing! Definitely coming back!! 😍

I can only rate the bar and the meal, as we didn't stay at their accommodation. Although the restaurant was closed, we were able to order at the bar. The bar was very busy, but the staff took our order and brought our drinks promptly to us. We both ordered the chicken parmigiana and were very happy with it. The serving size was more than enough, and we felt the wait really wasn't that long at all, especially considering how busy they were. I'd be happy to return again the next time I'm in Auckland.

A Timeless Treasure in Auckland – The Shakespeare Pub! (I did not stay in the hotel, just enjoyed the wonderful Pub). Nestled in the heart of Auckland’s bustling city centre, The Shakespeare Pub stands as a testament to classic charm and enduring hospitality. Housed within a striking red-brick Victorian building at 61 Albert Street, this establishment seamlessly blends historical allure with modern comforts. Upon entering, guests are greeted by an ambiance reminiscent of traditional British pubs, complete with stained glass windows and a grand portrait of William Shakespeare himself. The inviting atmosphere is further enhanced by the friendly and attentive staff, ensuring every visit feels both special and familiar. Culinary delights abound, with a menu that elevates classic pub fare to new heights. From handcrafted pizzas to gourmet burgers, each dish is prepared with care and served in generous portions. The Thai beef salad offers a lighter yet equally satisfying option for those seeking variety. Beer enthusiasts (like myself) will revel in the on-site brewery’s offerings, where a selection of delicious beers is crafted to perfection. The opportunity to savor these brews amidst the pub’s historic setting adds a unique dimension to the dining experience. The Shakespeare Pub delivers with grace and style. It’s a place where history and hospitality converge, inviting patrons to create their own stories within its storied walls.

Can't review the hotel as we were only there for dinner and drinks. Pro: excellent beer on tap! Cons: everything else. Ordered fish and chips (the special that night) and a burger. Despite there only being a dozen people there, it took 35 minutes for the food. Once it finally arrived, huge disappointment. Burger was huge but had little to make it special. Crazy amount of spring mix on there for some reason (seriously, one normal piece of crunchy lettuce would work!) Had to eat with a fork to avoid the soggy bun. The fish and chips, my partner said: "some of the worst I've ever had". But yay for the beer.

The location can’t be beat. Steps from the cathedral, a block from the SkyTower, right on the Main Street and just a few blocks from the harbour. However check in ( at least in the off season) was at the restaurant m, when it is open. They only have a few rooms so understandable they don’t have extra staff. I had to cart my luggage around until the restaurant opened. There is no elevator

Great pub. Amazing selection of beers; all pretty good. The good is good pub food; not fine dining but pub food. I had ribs which were very tender and great quality but the rest of the plate was useless collateral. Definitely worth a visit and a great place to grab a few.
The sweetest place. Such tasty food - good selection, and such kind staff! The staff even noticed we were dining for a birthday and went out of their way to create a dessert plate. Highly recommend!

A best kept secret, don't be fooled by the simplistic first impressions of the menu. We have been here a few times and never been disappointed. The food is delicious, well priced for the portion sizes. Always fresh and beautifully presented. Cater for GF with GF dedicated menu and GF Soy Sauce made ordering very easy, lots to pick from. 10/10 for Japanese food Atmosphere is pretty authentic not refined but comfortable

Quite sad.. We use to go here every couple months and happy spending hundreds due to the portion size and pricing. It was delicious, filling and worth the money. Back in 2023, the sushi slices were thick and juicy. With the aburi platter.. It use to $54 and had x3 of each selection. I think there were x16/17 pieces for $54. I use to have to take two bites per sushi cause of the size. We've recommended so many people and have taken so many people here before. Started noticing the quality in 2024.. Thought perhaps it's just a one off. Today. Prices have gone up. Understand inflation. Happy to pay for more if the quality was the same. Portion sizes have been cut in half. Sashimi medium platter $46.. Thin slices. Aburi sushi now only 12 pieces for $60. Tempera.. Veges were cut so thin and small. On a good note, service was great. Very quick. Food was fresh. Wishing this business all the best! 😊
Second time I went there.Freshest sashimi, nice sushi, great spicy chicken wings.Perfect service.Highly recommend.

Absolutely incredible. The sashimi was insanely fresh, the Zen roll with truffle aioli was next-level, and the miso black cod just melted in my mouth. Cool vibe, great service—this place is a hidden gem. Will 100% be back.

Came here with my daughters to teach her about pizza. Was recommended by colleagues. Service is great and helpful, and the atmosphere is traditional, warm, and cozy, now to what's important! The pizza has an amazing dough, and the crust is impeccable, thin, but not floppy, with a nice undercarriage. We really loved the chunky tomato sauce and salami, not greasy but just quality ingredients and love for pizza here. If this way one bite, I would give it an 8.4. It's worth traveling for if you love great authentic pizza. Nice work, team !

Very great Italian restaurant - small but nice, that also applies to the menu. I had the BOSCAIOLA pizza. Very, very tasty - I can't remember ever having a better pizza with a spinach topping. Very good service, nice staff. Only the music volume was a little too loud for me, but everyone feels differently. But the music itself was always right. I would love to come back.
Got some pizzas delivered for a work event and they were a great hit! Good flavours, good crusts and obviously good sizes with those 1 meter pizzas!
Nice experience with the 1m long pizza. The pizza crust is good. We tried margherita pizza and it had nice flavour. The price was on the high side but was worth the experience.

Terrible. Not authentic italian food. At 7pm on Friday evening they were already closing and took only take away order, for pizza only. Boscaiola pizza was soaked with this spinach pesto, mozzarella and too oily/liquid/fatty It's a pity because the base was not bad. Tiramisù: no marsala, no mascarpone, soggy savoiardi, small size. Too sweet, it should be bitter cocoa on top, not sweet one

Completely average experience and I expected more from Savor group. We went on a Monday night and while it wasn’t packed there was still a good several tables there. It was super loud and hard to have a conversation without near on shouting. We did ask to move tables but got denied, even though there were several tables free, and by the time we left, the same tables remained available. The highlight of this meal was the season greens. This was stir fried broccolini and beans so this should tell you enough about the rest of the meal. Karaage chicken was lacking flavour and the salmon was extremely basic, right down to its presentation. We weren’t checked on once which was disappointing. I’d give Ebisu’s cold atmosphere, uninterested staff, and average food a miss. Play it safe with Amano down the road or Azabu in Ponsonby/Mission Bay.

Booked in for the Oki No Saturday buffet. We were seated near the windows which was quite warm with the sun shining in. There was a great range of food and it was top quality. They’re a bit slow with replenishing some of the hot food such as the fish. I found the dessert selection very delicious especially the glutinous rice ball and matcha tiramisu.

A great place for a cozy dinner - the atmosphere is dark and dimly light which is nice. We ordered quite a bit with the duck breast being the favourite of the night followed by the ebi mayo roll. Service was great and the food came out quickly. It was more on the expensive side but for my first time, thought it was a good dinner spot!

Recently visited Ebisu with a group of friends to experience their Oki No Saturday Buffet. The selection was truly generous- fresh sashimi, sushi rolls, shrimp, udon and miso soup as well as hot dishes like salmon, braised beef brisket. And many delicious desserts. I have to say the sashimi was beautifully arranged and fresh. The service was friendly and attentive throughout. Our group wholeheartedly enjoyed the Oki No Saturday Buffet. I will recommend it without hesitation to anyone if you are looking for a relaxed Japanese buffet in Auckland.

The seafood tasted very fresh and we truly enjoyed how the buffet is presented. We loved the options available, and choosing food wasn't overwhelming because there weren't excessive options. I would love to have an opportunity to come back again... EDIT - We returned to Ebisu on 21 February 2025. This is my second time in Ebisu, and I apologize for saying this, but the buffet felt underwhelming. I brought my sister with me because I had such an amazing first experience. It was such a big difference even though I went only 4 months ago or so. The Sashimi and prawns were still bomb, but the salads on offer were not as exciting. The Braised Beef was so tough, which I informed the crew and manager of at least 3 times. I believe that if an item on the buffet could not be eaten with chopsticks (which is the basic "cutlery" provided) it might not be appropriate for the buffet. While I did feel that the Manager listened to my concerns, I think it was unfair to receive a response where they said "It might have just been the pieces you got". I took 4 pieces from 4 different parts of the beef, all of which I returned because it was very tough for "braised" beef. They did inform me that they will be checking the food that comes out that day before serving. Unfortunately because of this experience, I will no longer be returning.

I had an absolutely great dinner here, it is a wonderful place, friendly staff, great food, entertainment . I look forward to going back and I would recommend going here to anyone. Come by yourself, on a date, bring some friends, bring the family.

I brought my overseas friend here for the experience, as I was really impressed during my previous visit. Unfortunately, this time was quite underwhelming. The chef seemed disinterested, offering little to no effort in creating an engaging experience—just a quick flame for a couple of seconds. While the food wasn’t bad, some of the steak pieces weren’t great either. Overall, we left feeling quite disappointed.

Awesome restaurant. So rare to experience teppanyaki in Auckland with so few restaurants doing this nowadays.Chef was great!!! Prawns and yum yum sauce perfect. Steak and lobster so good and perfectly cooked.

Excellent Japanese restaurant set in a traditional ambiance. The restaurant has an A grade by Auckland Council. The food was very tasty and the staff very friendly. There’s also a bar in the Japanese style.

Excellent teppanyaki experience that is accessible and open during lunch. The experience is as good as when I first ate here 10 years ago. All the chefs provide a fun atmosphere providing a unique table side cooking experience. Food itself is also very good quality would recommend 10/10.

Quick lunch, great deals, efficient and very friendly service. What more could one want. Victoria definitely welcomed us and even gave up her spot near the fire where she was working on some admin stuff. Thanks to the crew at the Empire.

The easiest 5 stars I have ever given. Our jaws dropped upon seeing and tasting both our mains (lamb rump and pork belly) and desserts (apple crumble and brownie sundae). The food and service far exceeded our expectations. Empire Tavern is part of the Star Group, and you can get great deals like the Monday 2for1 mains we used simply by downloading their app. However, my friend and I would happily pay full price for these mains in future, and we decided to order dessert based on their quality and were so glad we did. I can't think of a single thing that could be improved. Thank you to the waitstaff and kitchen team who made our night one to remember and hopefully repeat again soon! Everyone should try this surprising gem in the CBD, which had a lovely positive and peaceful vibe on a Monday evening and no doubt has something great to offer any night of the week.

Merek was a star! Very helpful & accommodating with my many questions. My beef schnitzel was a bit dry & cud do with more gravy. My friends had chicken schnitzel & I tried that! Yummy! I’ll have that next time. Huge meal! Well worth it. Thanks.

Super friendly and welcoming staff. Merek was really the best helping me choose a delicious wine for only $10 a glass. Reasonable and extremely tasty food. Great selection of drinks at reasonable prices
Gemma was super friendly and hospitable - such a cosy place and great wine. The food was amazing - can't fault it at all. More than just your average pub.

I just arrived in Auckland this Wednesday and chose this restaurant as my very first dining experience — and wow, what an unforgettable choice it was! As someone who is absolutely obsessed with oysters and cocktails, this place exceeded every expectation. The freshness, the flavour, the variety — every dish was beautifully presented and incredibly delicious. The cocktail list is creative and well-balanced, and every sip felt like perfection. But what truly elevated the night was the outstanding service from Silvana. Her warmth, professionalism, and attention to detail were simply the best I’ve experienced this year — on par with Vinesmith in Melbourne, which is saying a lot. Silvana made me feel genuinely welcomed, looked after every little detail, and her passion for hospitality truly shines through. From the food to the drinks to the ambiance and especially Silvana’s incredible service, everything was absolutely spot-on. I’ll be recommending this restaurant to everyone I know visiting Auckland — and I’ll definitely be back!

Absolutely fantastic fine dining experience at Oyster and Chop in Auckland. From start to finish, everything felt top-notch, and this quickly became one of my favorite spots in the city. Let’s start with the tiger prawns — without exaggeration, they were the best I’ve ever had in the world. Perfectly grilled, juicy, and full of flavor. They had just the right char on the outside while staying succulent and tender inside. If you’re a prawn lover, this dish alone is worth the visit. The oysters were another highlight — incredibly fresh, clean, and briny in the best way. You can really taste the quality and the fact that they’re sourced daily. A great variety as well, with options for every palate. The lobster bisque was rich, creamy, and bursting with depth. Every spoonful had a lovely, warming seafood intensity — clearly made with care and proper stock reduction. Service was efficient, friendly, and knowledgeable. The staff knew the menu well and offered great pairing suggestions. The location is also a major win — sitting right by the harbor with beautiful views, especially at sunset. It adds a classy, relaxing vibe to the entire experience. Highly recommended. A must-visit if you’re in Auckland and want top-quality seafood in an elegant setting.

Very nice location and really really good food, had whitebait fritters, lamb and salmon. Would have loved dessert, but our waiter forgot we existed at all, so we asked for him after half an hour and finally left 15 minutes later. All tables next to us were served by other waiters regularly several times so we felt forgotten, other waiters didn't want to help out.

Food was excellent. We loved the natural oysters. So fresh & creamy. Our waiter Louis was awesome - down to earth, funny and genuine. Can't fault our experience. Our table enjoyed their cocktails, too.

$2 per oyster during happy hour 3 - 5pm daily! This is the cheapest big oyster I found in New Zealand. It is so fresh and sweet. We even came back for the second time! The lamb loin is extremely tender and juicy. There are three different sauces on the plate and they are all perfect matches with the lamb, very unique and refreshing. The poor belly is not to my liking, for the texture is a bit chewy for me.

Coming from Texas, my family and I were looking to have a nice steak lunch and this place did not disappoint. My son (7yo) had the kids petite steak, wife had the steak sandwich, and I had the T-bone steak. Along with that we had the garlic loaf, salads, and seasonal vegetables. Steaks were all seasoned well and grilled to a perfect medium rare. Highly recommend getting the Cafe de Paris butter with the steak. Drinks came out quickly and the waitress was incredibly friendly. We’ll definitely come back next time we’re in Auckland.

I don't hand out bad reviews often but this place didn't come up to scratch for us. Firstly, we waited 70 minutes for our food. The table next to us ordered at the same time and received theirs 25 minutes before ours came out. Yes, the steaks are big but that doesn't mean they're great. I ordered MEDIUM and it was more like RARE (see pics). It was also quite tough to cut and chew. Finally, the fact that steaks do not come with any sides is a rort. $54 for a steak and then wanting to charge $12 for chips and another $7 for a "jus" (that was extremely watery and had no flavour) on top of that? No way - not on as far as I'm concerned. At least the service was friendly but definitely won't be back. There's better places for a steak in Auckland. (I also notice that the management don't seem to reply to reviews here, so that is disappointing and shows a lack of customer focus/care).

Had a great time catching up with some legends here! Generous portions and the steaks were spot on 🥩. Only downside was the service — the waitress didn’t really pay attention to what we were saying, which was a bit disappointing given the overall vibe of the place. Still, good food and good company made it worthwhile.

Very poor experience, from start to finish. Everything seemed to be relying on history and past glory. The waiting area was made up of an odd jumble of different seats, with walls showing off past "celebrities" who have visited and newspaper articles. Names such as Billy T James, and the guy off the telly, with the hair. I can't remember his name, it wast 40 years ago! Update or get rid of them, drag this place into the 2020's. The service was mostly made up of a guy showing us to our table, taking our order and then bringing our food some time later. The staff were moving around a lot, I could tell because they hit into the back of my chair every time they went past, despite there being ample room behind me. Some around us were served their food fairly quickly and others, like us, waited a long time. There was no effort to clear away our drinks once finished or check if we wanted more. We had to ask for some water for the table as well. We ordered two steaks and two sides, but one of them arrived as a starter, despite it not being listed as a starter. The other side - a baked potato - was terribly dry and overcooked, and had the sour cream all over the outside of the foil. The steaks weren't cooked very well, both rare despite one being ordered medium rare and one medium well done. Luckily they are served on a sizzle plate so we could slice and finish cooking them ourselves. The beef was pretty tough, about as tender as a brick. Plenty of signs around telling us they are the biggest and best steaks in town, and there were large but there was a fair amount of gristle left over. The place looks like it hasn't had an upgrade in decades, there didn't seem to be any air conditioning other than an old fan and the signs looked far more dated than retro. Poor food, poor service, very high prices and no atmosphere make for a memorable night for the wrong reasons.

I can recommend the beef steaks here. I wouldn’t recommend the oysters. They were kind of small and quite expensive for 6 oysters (24 NZD). For the steak, we had the lamb rump and eye fillet (beef). Eye fillet beef was delicious, ordered medium and received medium-well but that was fine for my taste. At first the lamb tasted good, but in the end it tasted like it came straight from the barn. So I would not recommend lamb. It was a bit loud and the air was not good due to the steak grilling within the same room as the restaurant. Sides (fries and wedges) were good, salad had less dressing, hence it was bland.

We had lunch at Fortuna last April 5 to celebrate our friend's birthday. I wasn't able to take pictures of the food, not even the ones I got for myself. I only managed to take a photo of my favorite, seafood and salad. The food was delicious and definitely worth it.
It's been 10 years since I've dined at Fortunas and I must say the lunch menu, service and interior much better than before. I enjoyed it very much 🥰
The food was ok, service was good, nice staff and atmosphere was brilliant! Overall mid! I really recommend trying the butter chicken curry 🍛

The food was great but there is always room for improvement. Good selection. The one off payment for the unlimited fizzy drink is good too. Service was very pleasant and felt like we were looked after amazingly by stuff. The price is very good for the location, Auckland City. Especially for a restaurant dinner. Don't understand why people talk down abput this buffet when leaving a review. I have been twice and both times were great. Side note: They played the All Blacks vs France on their TV so that was a bonus.

I came to Fortuna Buffet for Mother’s Day lunch. It was a lovely outing, and as expected for the occasion, the restaurant was quite full and lively. The lamb shanks were definitely the standout for me. They were tender, flavourful, and perfectly cooked. I really enjoyed that dish. The rest of the buffet was enjoyable, with a good variety of options. Given how busy it was, the staff did well to keep everything running smoothly, and I appreciated their efforts. I would love to return on a quieter day to take in the atmosphere and flavours in a more relaxed setting. A nice spot for a special occasion with family.

Overall 3/5 stars. The food was good, the BBQ chicken/pork (half half) doesn't come in the sizzling plate anymore which is a shame, the place has gone smaller compared to when I use to go here all the time. The portion sizes for the sides have significantly gone down in quantity and prices have gone up. The meat wasn't seasoned like it use to either! :( I like how they have a lunch menu now though. I wouldn't go here again and spend that much.

We had a small mix-up with our order, but the staff handled it so well—they gave us the incorrect order for free and quickly prepared the right one. Everything we tried was absolutely delicious, and the team was incredibly friendly and accommodating. The atmosphere was also really nice, making the whole experience even better. Definitely a place worth visiting!
We have been eating here for over 10 years. Have not been back for over 3 years. The food still taste the same. Recommended!

We ordered their specials $29 each and asked if we could takeaway. Staff said yes. When we got home, this was all we got. We called to ask why we’re missing the soups and they said they don’t usually do the soups for takeaway since it’s hard for them to pack. They did offer for us to go back and pick up the soups but they can’t guarantee that they won’t spill. Very disappointed that we had to pay full price for this little amount of food and weren’t informed that soups aren’t for takeaway.
Nice Korean restaurant. I really liked the beef and tofu soup. Everyone at the table thought the kimchi soup was excellent. Would come again.

Grand Harbour is probably the best place to come to have Yum Cha. If you’re entertaining family or friends or just want to come to the best place in Auckland for Yum Cha, Grand Harbour is the place. Massive selection of dishes, perfectly complimented by hot jasmine tea. Fully licensed if you’d prefer a beer or glass of wine. Comfortable seating - whether you’re one person or a small group. Want great Yum Cha? Look no further
The food is nice 😊, kids love the roast peking duck with pancake. Lobster with fried rice must try too. 😙
Great Cantonese food place! Seafood is fresh and yummy! Black Gold Abalone is the best!
I I have been visiting Grand Harbour for over 25 years, and this restaurant consistently delivers amazing food. The yum cha here is likely the best in Auckland. I highly recommend!
Still good, Beware even if you tell them about peanut allergy!!!
Had meatballs and wedges. Delicious. Other person has steak, mashed potatoes and fries. Steak cooked perfectly. Took some away. Nice to be able to buy jug of soft drinks. Will be going back.
Excellent food. I ordered gluten free and they are very helpful. Can be slightly drafty due to people walking past the automatic door. Otherwise it is quite comfortable atmosphere

I have not been back here since 2004! It was a regular place for my group of friends back than because the food was great. Unfortunately even though the service was exceptional the food was average this time especially the seafood chowder which was more like a soup and no seafood my husband was very disappointed. Overall 3/5 for the food, service was very good and price was reasonable.

It's been 2 decades since last in Parnell but great to see good food & great hospitality hasn't changed. Greeted & seated immediately, friendly staff, varied menu range, very generous portions. We found our server attentive though she struggled a bit with dietary options. Master 6, enjoyed his pizza 🍕 surprisingly wasn't wood-fired but still very tasty incl the garlic bread & the wedges was bang on beautiful! Enjoyed the relaxed dress- code atmosphere. Highly recommend, we will be returning. Merci

Food was amazing and the portion sizes were so good I was shocked. Only downside was the size of the tables, not the best for big group bookings. Other than that, food was 1000000/10, service was great and the bar lady even let me fill up my bottle with cold water as I was feeling unwell (not from the food). Would recommend this place 100% and will definitely come back in the future.

Had a wonderful meal here! The atmosphere is nice and lively but not so much that you can’t easily have a conversation with your table mates. The service was exceptional. Be sure to ask your server for recommendations - I’m glad we did bc there were so many good things to choose from. Definitely recommend starting with the bruschetta - it was wonderful! We loved everything we had and also made room for dessert - which was awesome as well. Just go. Your won’t be sorry.

Went here for a nice dinner and was not disappointed. Food were of satisfying portions. The fried squid and fried mushrooms entrees are great. Recommend the gnocchi for pasta. Pizza had the perfect base. My choice of dessert was the dark choc, peanut tart which was rich and delicious. Service staff were great, despite it being a busy night. Overall, highly recommended.

The staff at Vivace are amazing and there is a whole vegan menu which is great. The attention to detail from the staff was incredible. My dining partner ordered me a drink without me knowing it had Prosecco and the waiter came back before making it to advise me the Prosecco wasn’t vegan. I was extremely appreciative. The vegan risotto was quite nice, not spectacular but it was good. The cocktails and the staff were the best part about this place

Italian-style cuisine with a NZ twist. The entrees are great for sharing, and there is a nice selection of pastas and risottos. Love the beer on tap, and the lovely, friendly service. Great for a business gathering or a date night.

Service was good, with the exception of a difficulty splitting a pizza into a number divisible by 3 for 3 people and processing the splitting of the bill for the pizza. Food was well-made, but tasted more like fusion food rather than authentic Italian food. Environment was good. Will be open to coming back again

Visited for dinner and had a pleasant experience overall. The ambience is warm and inviting, creating a comfortable setting for a relaxed meal. While the space isn’t very large, it’s well-utilized and doesn’t feel cramped. The service was above average - prompt and courteous, though there’s always a room for improvement. That said, the staff were genuinely warm and welcoming, which added to the overall positive vibe. The food was flavourful and lived up to its reputation for authentic cuisine. However, if you prefer your dishes on the spicier side, it’s a good idea to mention that while ordering, as the default spice level leans towards mild. One downside was the lack of a high chair for kids, which could be inconvenient for families with toddlers. All in all, they offer a satisfying dining experience with good food and a cozy atmosphere. Worth a visit for those looking to explore traditional flavours in a comfortable setting.

We had a lovely dinner at Oh Calcutta on a Sunday evening. We tried various entrees, mains and desserts. The food options offered are all exquisite and flavorful. I personally tried the butter chicken and the beef madras. But the goat curry will always be my favorite. The spice level is adapted on a per customer basis, so everyone can enjoy the amazing dishes. It is worth noting the excellence of the staff. Food is promptly served, the staff is always kind and regularly checking if you need more water or any additional rice and naans. I also really appreciated the large selection of both alcoholic and nonalcoholic drinks, with a particular emphasis on the great selection of wines. I definitely recommend to anyone looking for a flavorful and authentic dinner in Auckland.

Absolutely loved our experience here! The food, drinks, and service were all outstanding. You can really feel the warmth of a family-owned restaurant in every detail, from the friendly staff to the thoughtful atmosphere. It’s the perfect spot for a family get-together or a relaxed meal with loved ones

A beautiful vibe/atmosphere, fantastic and friendly hosts, and amazing food. Couldn't have asked for more. Honestly, one of the few Indian food places, where I feel you can taste the authenticity; Home away from home experience.

Visited oh calcutta for dinner. The staff was welcoming, the atmosphere was amazing but the food quality and quantity needs to be improved as compared to the price. Too expensive. Does not taste as authentic Indian food at all.

We stopped in for a late dinner since my friend was craving Indian. It's a small, cozy space with ambient lighting. It gives family-owned vibes, and the staff are really friendly. We had small dishes to share. Everything tasted great!
Loved the taste, could better the portion size. We ordered Cauliflower crisp (must try) Mysore Masala dosa Masala dosa Matka chai (must try) Veg noodles

Amazing place ! A bit tricky to find as name isn't outside. But food was delicious, service was great. Authentic Indian restaurant...coconut rice, cauliflower and paneer especially good. Dishes arrived straight from pan ..one at a time . Music was different, interesting and made a great vibe. Also good value for money Thanks for having us.

Didn't book but luckily got a table after a short wait! 100% recommend booking before hand as the restaurant is small. The decorum and the food match really well! The staff members didn't really dress/look like staff which was the only confusing thing; they were all in streetwear. Ordered 6 course feed. Efficient and friendly service! What a taste palate adventure, nothing was under seasoned and everything was cooked so well. Couldn't even choose a favourite (it was that good). The Masala Chai is not something you want to pass up. Served in a ceramic cup, as were all the dishes, the intensity of the Chai flavour was just spot on.

I had an incredible dining experience at XO Mangal last night which was a pop-up restaurant, located in Auckland's K-Road area. It offered a unique fusion of Indian and Middle Eastern-inspired cuisine running out of Satya Chai Lounge. My partner and I were thrilled with our choices from the menu. The Hot & Numbing Buttermilk Fried Chicken was my favourite dish - every bite was packed with flavour, and I devoured it down to the last bone. The Crispy Eggplant with Szechuan Pepper and Black Vinegar was also a standout - it was delicious and incredibly flavourful. The Masala Fries were another highlight and a must-try; the kebab spice mix, harissa, and garlic yogurt were a delightful combination. The Corn Ribs with Curry Leaf, Coconut, and Masala Rub were cleverly cut into quarters to resemble ribs and were full of flavor. I also appreciated the spice in the Lamb Kofta. The Pork Belly Vindaloo - it was so spicy, but I loved it. To balance the spices, we enjoyed the Watermelon Chaat Masala, which was refreshing and tangy. The Basmati Rice was an excellent side that complemented the main dishes perfectly. To end the meal, we indulged in the Smashed Baklava Sundae made with Baklava, Candied Nuts, and Salted Caramel. It was the perfect sweet treat to cap off a fantastic meal. The service at XO Mangal was exceptional - our servers were quick, attentive, and friendly. The only constructive feedback I have is that the dishes came out too quickly, leaving us little time to savour each course. However, this could be because we arrived earlier, and the kitchen had the capacity to get the dishes out quickly. Overall, I highly recommend XO Mangal to anyone looking for quality and tasty food in an easy and moody atmosphere. Their pop-up menu changes weekly, so it's worth returning to try new dishes. Don't miss out on this limited-time dining experience!

Had a fantastic dinner at Wildfire! The service was top-notch — friendly, attentive, and welcoming. The chicken and lamb were absolutely beautiful, perfectly cooked and packed with flavour. I definitely overindulged, but it was worth every bite. Can’t wait to come back!

Wide collection of meats Must go with the premium one as it gives great extra meat options and includes dessert The food was a tad salty for my taste The servers were excellent They have live music from 7pm onwards
The welcome was great. The manager (?) had a great sense of humor. The staff were all friendly. The food was very good. The place is classy. The menu has a terrific variety to choose from.

Been to Wildfire several times and always had the Churassco experience, tonight we tried the A LA Carte Menu. The food and service is always exemplary, Reuben our waiter was really geared towards excellence in customer service. Our steaks were done to perfection.

Haven’t been in sometime but not as great as it use to be however still good. Good variety of meats except the sirloin which you had to specifically ask for multiple times which I didn’t like. Cocktails were way too sweet. Staff were faultless and attentive.

Really nice bar. I can’t comment on the night life but for a Sunday lunch it’s chill and comfortable. I was lucky enough to get a spot beside the fire to read my book. The Caesar salad is top notch and the staff seemed very friendly.

Every thing is 5 star and beyond!! From the moment we walked in we felt a comforting atmosphere and it kept getting better as the night went on. The bar staff are super polite and friendly which makes them approachable. Low and behold, our dinner arrives and the live band begins. What can I say, a superb pub with delicious food and amazing people.

Great spot right in the heart of Wynyard quarter, bustling and vibey! Ordered the steak based on the recommendation from the barman… was not disappointed! Cooked just right and great portion size. Fine balance on enjoyable music and it being slightly too loud… but at least it was good music and old school! Would definitely recommend 👌 oh, BTW, $25 jugs is also a total winner

I have only ever been here for a drink and some dancing, this was my first time eating there and wow! Firstly the service as you walk in, amazing! Staff are wonderful. Food was so so sooooo good we had the rump steak and cheeseburger and OMG was it just packed with flavour. There was awesome live music and overall just a lovely experience. Everything was reasonably priced! We will absolutely be back 🥰

Beware that staff will take advantage of you if you're intoxicated. 4 beers will be charged as 6, 5 tequila shots will be charged at something like $140.00. If you leave your jacket around the staff will help you find it and empty the pockets on their way to you. Have someone dedicated to taking care of you in this bar, the people who go here are great, the people who work here should be engaged with as little as possible.

We saw this Penang restaurant ok the Google map with a high rating so decided to give it a try. It was a late lunch, we arrived at the restaurant at about 2-ish and was greeted by the friendly lady boss. As we were looking undecidedly at the lunch menu, she offered us the dinner menu to see if there something that we would prefer instead. We ended with the curry chicken with steamed rice and Penang fried kway teow, both were really good, especially since it was our last day in Auckland after spending 10 days in NZ! The lady boss recommends that we must try their beef rendang the next time and if I come back to Auckland, that would definitely be on my to-eat list! I would highly recommend this place for their authentic Malaysian fares, especially the Penang dishes! It's walking distance from Queens Street and is in this eclectic neighbourhood filled with thrift stores and an Asia food court and supermarket. A nice neighbourhood to stroll and to look for hidden treasures.
The best Malaysian restaurant in city by far. Have been coming here for last 18 years and have never been disappointed. Angie and her team are awesome. Keep up your great work.

Silky and rich laksa broth. Good quality ingredient. Very helpful and generous staff that does everything to make you feel taken care of. Good crowd. Nice vibe. Space is simple yet just the kind of hole-in-the-wall that makes it that much better—and think about keeping to yourself.

Been wanting to try this for ages, and finally we did and it did not disappoint! Service was great, we even got an off the menu milo drink. Lovely Aunty the owner and equally amazing staff. Loved every single meal we had but probably our fave is the entree Roti Curry. Roti is flaky and cooked to perfection! Very good portion and quality of food for the price you pay. We’ll be back for more.

Been wanting to try for a while now and so glad I finally did! It exceeded expectations and topped one of my other favourite, and similar Auckland Malaysian restaurant. We managed to get a table without booking (though Monday night) and the lady that served us was also super friendly. We got 3 dishes and an extra rice between 2 people and it was more than enough - we got sambal kang gung (malay veggie not on the menu but we asked if they had stock!), rendang beef, and stir fried spicy squid. Everything was super delicious and even my partner who is Malaysian said it was really good. 100% recommend.

Absolutely loved my visit to Tanpopo Ramen in Auckland! The ramen was incredibly authentic, with rich, flavorful broth and perfectly cooked noodles that tasted just like the ones I’ve had in Japan. Every bite was comforting and satisfying. The toppings were fresh, the portion generous, and the atmosphere warm and welcoming. Highly recommend to anyone craving true, authentic ramen in Auckland!

We had Ramen for lunch. When we arrived we were greeted by staff and they were absolutely lovely and very accommodating and polite throughout the whole time we were there. We ordered a creamy based ramen and a chicken base ramen. Both of these were yummy, not the best we’ve had but still a very delicious lunch dish. The noodles were very delicious and so was the pork although we found some slices of the pork were a little dry and chewy. We also ordered some dumplings which were average, the filling was quite mushy but it did have flavour and the dumpling pastry and the way it was cooked was on point.

I've been here multiple times and have never been disappointed. It's a humble establishment that focuses on one thing: making great ramen! For the price, it's absolutely worth it. The broth is sublime, and the portions are generous. They’re also very generous with the toppings. Definitely a solid choice for dinner if you're in the area! It's also a safe bet if you're dining with picky eaters—there's something comforting and satisfying about a well-made bowl of ramen. The staff are great, and service is quick. Wait times aren’t too bad—worth it anyway!

Tanpopo Ramen was my first-ever ramen experience, and I couldn't have asked for a better introduction. My brother is a huge ramen fan and told me I had to try this place — and he was absolutely right. I was blown away by the flavors, quality, and care in every dish. I'll definitely be back the next time I visit Auckland. A true gem for anyone looking to discover (or rediscover) the authentic taste of ramen.

I was so happy to find delicious ramen in Auckland made by a Japanese owner. As someone from Japan who loves authentic Japanese ramen, I was really excited to enjoy such great ramen here in New Zealand. The staff are also Japanese and kindly spoke to us in Japanese, which made me feel even more at home. I went with my vegetarian friend this time, and I was impressed that they even had vegetarian ramen and a wide variety of menu options. I’ll definitely stop by again next time I go to the CBD🍜🩵

September 2022: Hmmm... this time was very different. The 🍣 was probably fresh but it definitely didn't taste this way. So lucky to wonder into this place. First of all, it is great that you can have a small udon. The chicken was delicious and tender as a newborn. Surprise surprise: it wasn't enough. So I went for the sushi. It wasn't extraordinary, but you felt the freshness in every bite.
I like to stop in from time to time for their potato croquettes, have some sushi and miso, great little spot.

I don't usually write reviews, but i've had a lot of Chicken Katsu Donburi before, and this is the first time I've been disappointed. I paid $18 for Chicken, egg and rice. No salad, no greens, Nothing. Do not recommend!

Teriyaki beef donburi here is awesome, as are the katsu curry donburi. Delicious sushi too. They also have the most tasty mayo onion and herb sauce I've ever tried - it's beside the self service wasabi/sauces. Free self-service green tea if you are dining in :)

Some interesting options of 🍣 sushi. What I really like about the place is you can pick and choose, so you literally have 6 pieces of sushi and all of them can be different. I would definitely like to add a note on the wasabi, that stuff is really strong, compared to a whole bunch I have had in Auckland. All on all definitely a must-try place for sushi
Great dinner at Portofino. Service great. Meals were delicious. Service really quick. No wait as mid Winter, Summer queues can be long.

Had a fantastic meal at Portofino! The service was excellent — warm and attentive. Enjoyed a lovely glass of wine and an outstanding pasta dish. The highlight was definitely the dessert — the cheesecake was absolutely delicious. Highly recommend for a quality Italian dining experience!

Beautiful restaurant right on the water front. Service was amazing and very attentive! My partner and I ordered two different pastas and both were amazing! Full of flavour. Definitely recommend coming during the day as it’s not so busy.

I had the NYE dinner here, and the service was fantastic despite being totally full. The food was good, not amazing but good. The restaurant is very nice and well located. For us, it was perfect. The cost was very fair.

Decided to have dinner here on New Years Eve. Called in at 6.30 and got a table immediately. We had a choice of still or sparkling water already on our table when we were seated which was nice. We ordered our food but weren’t sure on the best wine to have so left that to the waiter to recommend. We only waited 20 mins for our main to come out and the wine the waiter chose for the meal was superb. We had 3 courses, a bottle of wine and two cocktails and the bill was $223 for the two of us. The seating was very comfortable looking out across the marina. All in all a very nice evening prior to NY celebrations. Georgio, our waiter was exceptional. Thanks for the fab dinner and atmosphere for the last evening of 2024 Portofino!

I’ve been a regular patron of this exceptional restaurant for several years, but tonight I finally tried the Rack of Lamb, and it was absolutely impeccable. Expertly cooked to perfection, it’s a dish that truly must be experienced. I can’t wait to return and indulge in more of their outstanding offerings.

8/10 Review for Tony's Lord Nelson Restaurant, Auckland From the outside, Tony's Lord Nelson looks like a modest little shop—but step inside and you're instantly immersed in a warm, historic atmosphere that makes you feel part of something special. The ambiance is inviting, with a classic charm that sets the mood just right. Their drink menu is impressive, and the steak selection is massive. I went for the 5-bone steak, which was incredibly tender—some parts could be cut with just a fork. I ordered it medium-rare but it came out closer to medium. Still enjoyable, though the flavor was a bit flat and could’ve used a touch more seasoning or spice. Overall, a solid experience with lots of character. Would definitely return.

Such a beautiful spot for a cozy dinner. The steak was cooked to perfection—juicy, flavourful, and paired so well with the crispy fries and fresh slaw. The wine pairing recommended by the friendly staff went perfectly with the steak. I also really enjoyed the seafood chowder it was creamy, warm, and comforting. The plating was elegant and made everything feel that little bit extra special. The ambiance was just lovely—candlelight, elegant decor, and a really welcoming atmosphere. Plus, the service was absolutely top-notch: friendly, attentive, and thoughtful throughout the evening. Highly recommend for a date night or a quiet dinner with friends. I’ll definitely be back!

Went here for dinner and the food was absolutely stunning. The waiting staff were very nice, even when my partner wanted a slight change, they were very quick to help. The steaks themselves were very delicious and tender, and loved the 1970~ esc vibe of the restaurant. A very authentic finish to this restaurant in the CBD! Will definitely come again.

Not going to lie, we are serious meat eaters in our house so my suggestion for dinner was quickly ignored once the Favourite Husband honed in on the “TOMAHAWKS” sign ahead, like a heat seeking missile. It was like stepping back in time as we entered the restaurant and were seated in a booth and surrounded by brick walls and leather seating. I love all things retro, it’s why I married the Favourite Husband, so I was down for it. And the menu didn’t disappoint. There was pate and prawn cocktail and so many mains I was overwhelmed with choice. The super friendly staff immediately offered to take our drinks order which is a big hit with me. Nothing worse than sitting around waiting for a drink. We went full retro and ordered the pate and the prawn cocktail as we both fancied both so we could share. (Loosely translated as I wanted both and couldn’t make my mind up so the Favourite Husband appeased me!) I also liked that we were able to order the entrees and then order the mains afterwards which helped stretch the meal out for us. We eat lots and at pace, so this is a good way to slow down and enjoy the evening rather than just the food. The pate was nice, although the toast could have been a little crispier with a bit longer in the toaster. The prawn cocktail was absolutely delicious. Very generous on the prawns and a nice hint of heat in the sauce. Then it was on to the steak. The greedy man Favourite Husband went with the tomahawk steak and a side of vegetables and I went with the fillet bernaise and some onion rings. (I really need to go on a diet come Monday …) The steaks were cooked to perfection and had a lovely, tasty char to them. The bernaise sauce was silky and full of tarragon flavour. The onion rings were hot and crispy and not too greasy. The service was friendly and we felt it was good value for money considering the standard of the steaks in particular. If you want simple food, done well, this is the place for you.

I’ve been to Java Room a few times now and always enjoy it. Highly recommend! This time we tried the whole fried snapper, and it was absolutely amazing if you enjoy spicy . The ginger beef was really tasty too. We also had the Pad Thai and Bakmi Goreng , both were delicious, but the Pad Thai was my favourite. A great spot for consistently good food!

Had the most delicious dinner and experience here tonight. From the warm welcome you get when you enter, to the stunning view from the outside dining area to the sumptuous pan Asian cuisine, everything was five star. Highly recommend the duck curry and the snapper curry. Will definitely return soon

The food here is absolutely amazing! Every single dish made you want to try more. The staff were so friendly. And the seating area out the back is such a cool space with an amazing view and atmosphere. Highly recommend and will definitely be back!!

I enjoyed the Indo tea but the food was okay but not as flavourful compared to other Asian fusion places, the desserts were not up to par - specifically the texture of the creme brulee which was lumpy (overbaked custard). We were almost overcharged $40 on the bill when I checked the receipt and the server didn't listen when I said the total amount was incorrect.
love this place so much!! been a few times and it’s always a delight. the owner is SO incredibly lovely and welcoming and the food is delicious here! thank you :)

Definitely a must try. Food is good and tasty with decent portion size. The atmosphere is very relaxed and casual. Love tge decor and mostly the charcoal bbq they bring to your table. And, Yes there is Korean beer.
A perfect dinner once again. Faro is by far the best Korean BBQ restaurant in Auckland. Fresh meat and good service. Thank you again for the great meal.

A great experience for Korean BBQ if you know how to eat it ;) The restaurant has a nice setting and attentive Staff. Quality overall is good and the service is fast. It can get "Smoky" if all table order the BBQ but it it's worth it Reservation up front is recommended

Stunning meal with family! The atmosphere was lovely and so welcoming. The food is speechless, genuinely the best KBBQ in Auckland (view photos below - we finished it all…) highly recommend the GALBI meat on charcoal grill. Thank you for the service!
Tastes just like the bbq I used to have back in Korea! So fresh and delicious — I keep coming back for more.

We had a really great experience at Sun World Restaurant. We ordered quite a lot of food, and everything was delicious. The portions were generous, and we were very happy with the quality and the price. Big shout-out to the manager and his team. They were calm, professional, and handled everything smoothly, even though the restaurant was busy. We truly appreciated the great service and warm atmosphere. Highly recommend and will definitely be back again!

Hong Kong atmosphere. The pricing was disproportionate to the dishes. The duck and noodles was good value and good wok hay. Salt and pepper prawns with shells had a good flavour. The stewed pork dish with taro had good flavour. The combination noodles was a bit pricy relative to the duck noodles. They could’ve flavoured it more and had more ingredients in it. Solid!

Enjoyed my first yumcha in New Zealand here and it’s worth coming back. We ate at 3PM so it was quiet but everything we ordered was superb, specially the siew mai, chee chong fun and BBQ pork pastry! Service was quick, no hassle.
Was delicious food. Really enjoyed the duck. Was perfectly crispy with beautiful sauce. Delicious! Great service, was able to request some special dishes too.

Have been here a number of time. Just had lunch with my family a couple of days ago. The restaurant was pleasant and sitting was comfortable. Not too crowded this day. The service was friendly and efficient. Good portion of food and taste was good. A good place for yum cha. Recommended if you are around the area and looking for a place for yum cha.

We had an amazing experience at Pearl Garden. The atmosphere was lively and welcoming, perfect for a relaxed brunch or a casual catch-up with friends. The dim sum was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. Service was prompt and friendly, with staff always ready to recommend something new to try. I also appreciated the variety of options for both traditional and modern tastes. Unlike the traditional approach where a cart is brought around, the ordering process is now more streamlined—you simply mark your selections on the menu, and everything will be served to you at once.

The Yum Cha ordering system has changed since I last visited. You mark the items on a printed menu and then they deliver to you which seemed to work well. Food was delivered quickly and steamed dumplings were fresh and hot which is a must for me! The egg tarts were a bit blonde, dry and lacked flavour. Stand out dish was the eggplant stuffed with prawns. Prices are on the high side $9+ per dish and most had only 3 pieces. Recommend booking.

The food was good, but unfortunately the service let the experience down. The young lady at the reception was quite rude to us, which made us feel unwelcome. Even though we enjoyed the meal, we don’t plan to return.

text: As soon as I walked into the restaurant, it felt like I had stepped into another country. The food was delicious, and the overall service was very satisfying. I think I’ll be coming back again.

An old favourite in Auckland. We first started eating at Pearl Garden about 26 years ago when they were still on the ground floor, and it now just brings back lovely old memories of a different time in our lives. The food is always delicious and it’s a multi-generational family business, which is so lovely. The owners have been seeing us for years, and are always so warm and welcoming. The service is attentive and it’s really just one of the few restaurants in Auckland that transcends the times. Highly recommend.

I usually come and order large peri peri pizza and usually they give me good amount of the peri peri sauce. Today I came in and I ordered at family size and the guy that was working gave me half the portion of the the large. I told him I ordered many time here but he was trying to rip me off by saying that I have pay more for the sauce it I want more. This is terrible customer service . They are soo cheap I could not enjoy my peri peri pizza because this employee has a ego problem. I ate half the pizza and already finish the sauce. Also if u look at the photo the dough is bloated on one of the slice and before I ate it 3 of the slices was bloated and cheese was not covering the whole pizza. Terrible customer service exoerience no wonder this store been getting 1 star recently . The employee claims that he was the manager lol.. if your the manager you should not be arguing with a customer about a 50 cent worth of sauce when the customer just spent 22 dollars. Bad business choice .. just loss a regular customer over 50cent amount of sauce. Good job buddy

Lucky if you get half the advertised toppings. If you bother to ask why it's missing, they very rudely respond with "What did you expect?" and then say all their pizzas shown on the menu are fake and not real. You have better chances winning at a casino than getting what you came for.

TERRIBLE The delivery was fast, fast enough to bring the wrong order. The manager « tried » to call me, but I didn’t receive any call, or missed call. they even didn’t leave a message to tell me my order will be replaced bc they don’t have my things anymore. They were rude and laughed (phone call recorded btw) they say it’s not possible to refund you (even if it’s not my fault) I think this is unfair, after 2 months of backpacking, travelling on budget I just wanted to eat something already made. And even don’t ask for a refund. They bring the pizza I ordered, burnt.

They either have employed untrained, incompetent or very lazy staff members in recent times. Cheese volcano and pizzas get made very sloppy. Often with little to none filling / toppings. Unfortunately I cannot recommend this place anymore.

What a best service of driver. He said name was ringky? He just sent me a gesture to hold his bike without saying. I asked you want me to hold your bike? He answered me very annoying. Thanks for sending me a good delivery guy and my appetite all gone after meeting him
Good choice of food and staff were friendly and attentive.
Loved this place! Close to Spark Arena. Great service fantastic food. Would love to dine again and few drinks again soon
Went with a couple of mates for pub meal. Good service and friendly staff. If worked in the area would definitely be the regular.

We came here for our evening meal twice during our short visit to Auckland. The food is excellent value for money. There's a 'special' each day, which makes it even better value. The service was always friendly and with a smile, and there's a great beer selection. The only slightly negative point is how quiet it was on both evenings. We arrived at about 7.00-7.30pm and there was hardly anyone else there. Do people go out to eat & drink early in Auckland?
A great pub, nice cozy environment. Friendly staff and good pub food. They do great lunch specials, thursdays are what keeps me coming back.

Great location for a lunch in Newmarket. Lots of options for $20 lunch dishes and they are absolutely delicious. Duck risotto is packed with yummy flavors and the crispy shallots provides more texture in mouth. Also enjoyed creamy chicken fettuccine and steak pizza. The service is great and attentive.
One of the best steaks in Auckland! Everything about this dish is perfect. We also tried other dishes and their drinks; all were delicious! Highly recommend them.

Great little spot really enjoyed the vibe and the friendly team. The food was really enjoyable, not amazing, or anything to rave about just good food. Thanks to the team for being so amazing we had a really good team dinner.
5 stars. Great food and service. Highly recommended ⭐️
The food is so GOOD!! The staffs members are also so nice to me and my friends!

This place was very good! The food tasted amazing and the dessert was even better! Highly recommend trying the fried ice cream. The atmosphere was nice and cozy and I loved their decorations. The food took a while to arrive but it was worth the wait. They played good music in the background and I would definitely come here again! And bonus it was all halal :D

Absolutely delicious! Hands down the best Thai food I’ve ever had in New Zealand. Every dish was full of authentic flavors, perfectly balanced, and made with fresh ingredients. The staff were friendly and welcoming, and the atmosphere was cozy and inviting. I’ll definitely be coming back and recommending it to friends. If you’re craving real Thai food, this place is a must-visit!

We always passed by this restaurant everytime we go to newmarket central and notice usually filled with customers and we would one day come by. This time we came for mother’s day dinner as walkin and we almost didnt get the seating due to late notice. They dont disappoint to its authenticity and freshness. Highly recommended dishes!

Authentic and mouth-watering Thai cuisine! The Tom Yum soup was spicy and sour, The green curry was creamy and rich, with tofu and crunchy veggies. Friendly service and cozy atmosphere. Highly recommend! Delicious and flavorful Thai dishes, more spice options for those who like it extra hot!

Had dinner on 14May2024 around 7pm. This was a Tuesday so the restaurant was not busy at all, although on Fridays and on the weekends they tend to be busy. I recommend coming on weekdays that they are quiet. Food was really good. Price is per normal now a days, although there are other Thai restaurants that have cheaper prices. The cocktail that I had was nice too. The service was really good, the owner and waitress were friendly & did check on us. The atmosphere was lovely & cozy. I will come back to this place again. This place can be good for bigger groups and sharing food as well.

Have been visiting this restaurant for years now, and there’s a reason I keep going back. Very generous food portions, the taste is always consistent, and the staff are always polite. Personal favourite is the seafood pasta, prawn linguine and the beef salad. Pizzas are always cooked to perfection. The owner is personally there often and his passion for the restaurant is undeniable. Keep it up!

Came here for lunch on a Saturday and booked a table just in case. It was fairly busy when we arrived at 12.30pm. We ordered 2x Pizzas, a Fettuccine and a Resotto to share between 3, Adults and 2x Kids. The food came out fast and the portions are a good size. Excellent value and authentic tasting

Walked in for family dinner. This place is AMAZING! Food portions are good. Great value for money. Staff are attentive and we didn't have to wait too long for our food. One of the best Italian places to try. Don't forget to order their amazing cocktails too!

Absolutely amazing experience! We visited Archie’s in Newmarket for our parents’ wedding anniversary and had an incredible time. The staff were so welcoming and attentive, and the food was outstanding. We ordered the Prawn Linguine, Mediterranean Pizza, Fettuccine, Medium Rare Steak, Prosciutto e Funghi Pizza and Seafood Risotto—every dish was full of flavour and beautifully cooked. We loved the Mediterranean Pizza so much we ordered another one as a finale! Highly recommend this place. We'll definitely be back. Thanks, Archie’s team!

We came in on a Saturday night for dinning in, i wanted to order Mediterraneo but they were out of some ham, so they made a Meat lover for me, they also cherished it with more then enough chicken i’ve ever seen in my life on a pizza… tbh it tasted okay … also the staff was good but the service was slightly slow as we waited slightly over 10mins past an hour… and yes the corner table had a lot of flies, would recommend restaurant manager to please check with it… Taste was good for all other meals

We came to Sushi Train to celebrate my sweetie's graduation from his toddler rugby class...it was his special request. We didn’t make a booking, but arrived about 10 minutes before opening and queued outside. One of the staff, who happened to be walking past on their way in, kindly invited us to wait inside, which was such a thoughtful gesture. Every staff member we interacted with was warm, friendly, and attentive; the level of service really stood out. As for the sushi itself, it was as close as we’ve found in New Zealand to authentic Japanese-style sushi. That might not be to everyone’s taste, but if you’re after something that reminds you of the real thing, this is the only place I know that truly delivers. It’s not just the usual crowd-pleasers;there are options that would definitely appeal more to Japanese diners.

Was in the mood for sushi. This was the easiest to get to by foot from my hotel. The staff are friendly enough but not happy when I paid in cash but didn't leave a tip. It's smaller and outdated to what I'm used to in Australia. The menu is hard to read but circling what you want with a texta is the only way to order anything not on the conveyer belt. There are not enough labels on the train naming dishes. Servings are about half the size of what you get from the same price both in Melbourne and Adelaide Australia. There is way too much flavourless mayonnaise "foam" on some dishes. Overall flavour and atmosphere was lacking. Glad was only there long enough to choose items for takeaway.

Ice-cold beer in a frosted glass, fresh gourmet sushi 😋😋as good as we had in Japan, and great, affordable prices. Live their loyalty program. I could eat here every day. It is a clean place with a relaxing ambiance. The staff was friendly and attentive. The bathroom was well-kept and maintained.

What a treat this place is, the atmosphere is great and the food is so fresh. For the three of us, we spent $84, which included drinks. Parking can be difficult to find and pay and display needed. This place did not disappoint though!! Highlight was the takoyaki 😋
We came here for our daughter’s 6th birthday. The staff were amazing and helped celebrate her birthday which I’m sure she will never forget ❤️ Thank you for the gumball machine suprise at the end.

🌯 Little Turkish Kebab. Where Kebabs Come Stuffed Like They Owe You Money Small, cozy spot on K Road serving up kebabs and woodfired pizzas. Haven’t tried the pizza yet, but their kebab game is STRONG. Easily one of the best I’ve had in Auckland. They don’t skimp either, this thing was stuffed like it was smuggling flavour across the border. Paid $16 for a chicken kebab (no combo), and honestly? Worth every cent. Portion’s big, flavour’s big, and I left with both hands full and a happy stomach. Place looked a little busy when I walked in, but the team was fast my order came out quicker than my parking meter countdown. Staff’s friendly and the shop’s clean, no sauce stains on the tables, no mystery smells. Parking? Bit of a nightmare during the day. At night after 7PM, if you get lucky, you can grab a street spot in the bus lane but good luck on Fridays and Saturdays when K Road’s packed with more people that can't walk up a straight line. Dine in or takeaway, both work fine. Will be back to finally try that pizza, and probably to test if the kebabs can get any bigger without breaking city by-laws. 🌯 "Logan was here, kebab so stuffed, I needed a seatbelt."

This is the spot. Maybe its because its 2am and who doesn't love a naughty kebab at the end of the night. Think mainly its because event though its 3am - its fresh- its hot - service is efficient and polite. 5 stars.

If you are a lover of Turkish Cuisine, then when in Auckland this Cafe delivers. Huge selection and Kumar fries are a real hit. From lamb souvlaki on chilli sauce to chicken satay kebab rice. Pizzas and kebabs the choice us yours

For dinner, I tried their Chicken Skandar Kebab. The crispy bread and hummus side was delicious, but there was no grilled tomato as listed on the menu. Unfortunately, the chicken itself lacked the charred flavour I was expecting. Chocolate baklava was also disappointingly not sickly sweet and sticky enough.
They wrote on the table little but there is enough to eat Turkish dishes. I tried margarita pizza very delicious. I like this place and it is very pleasant for finding open here until 4.00 am.

I went to a team lunch, and it turned out to be pretty nice. I had a delicious cheeseburger and it seems like a fun spot to catch a game—you can really feel the energy there. The staff were super friendly, and the place was clean. Getting a table was easy, though it can get a bit busy in the evenings.

Four of us dined at The Fox Lindon Pub, drawn in by the enticing roast dinner advertised at the entrance. Unfortunately, we arrived at 7pm to find the roasts had sold out – a significant disappointment given our primary reason for choosing this restaurant. However, this setback didn't overshadow the rest of our experience. The service was friendly and efficient, the atmosphere was lively and welcoming, and the food we did order was excellent. While the sold-out roasts were a letdown, the overall quality of food and service, coupled with the great atmosphere, made for a lovely evening. We'd definitely return, perhaps arriving earlier to secure a roast next time!
Fantastic place, great atmosphere. Sports Bar, Live music, Quiz nights & much more. This is one massive English Pub. Very cool.

I’ll admit, I’ve never been much of a pub enthusiast. My past experiences with pub food have been less than stellar, and the thought of having lunch surrounded by boisterous sports fans with drinks in hand isn’t exactly my idea of a good time. But this pub? It completely shattered my expectations—in the best way possible!! From the moment I stepped inside, I was struck by the welcoming and laid-back vibe. It didn’t feel like the typical loud, sports-centric pub. Instead, it had a cool, relaxed atmosphere that made it easy to settle in and enjoy. The food was the real highlight. My Coronation Chicken Salad arrived promptly, and let me tell you—it was a game-changer. The portion was generous, the ingredients were fresh, and the flavors were incredibly well-balanced. It was one of the most satisfying salads I’ve had in a long time--really yummy! It wasn’t the cheapest meal at around $30, but the quality and taste made it worth it. The friendly and attentive staff added to the experience, ensuring everything ran smoothly and making me feel genuinely looked after. If you’re like me and hesitant about pubs, I highly recommend giving this one a chance. It might just change your perspective, too!
So many restaurants to choose from but very glad we ended up here. The chicken, brie and truffle pie was the most delicious meal I've had travelling around NZ in the last three weeks.

This charming Irish pub * Father Ted * boasts a beautifully designed interior that reflects both Irish and British heritage. The menu features a delightful selection of delicious dishes, making it a must-visit destination in the heart of Auckland. The staff is exceptionally welcoming and friendly, ensuring a warm atmosphere for all guests. If you find yourself in Auckland's CBD, don’t miss the opportunity to experience our authentic Irish and British cuisine and beverages."

Sad excuse for an Irish pub. Really just a thrown-together dive serving Guinness and Kilkenny Red so apparently that allows it to be called an Irish pub. It was decently busy and the reviews seemed okay so we stopped in, might be a haunt for locals though. This place gives people the wrong idea of what an Irish pub is like. Very dirty tables, chairs, and countertops. Our beers were barely cold. The seats in the back corner are torn up and had a swarm of small bugs flying around. Wouldn’t recommend to stop here even for a quick drink. Can’t comment on the food.

Overall your classic casual Irish pub. Menu is small but isn’t too shabby, however would like more traditional types of meals to be on offer. Food specials change daily which is nice. Staff were lovely. Venue could be spruced up a bit and tables weren’t wiped down from previous patrons. Good range of drinks behind bar and on tap

Food is okay. But as an Irish person, this has absolutely nothing to do with the very famous TV show of the same name. It's just a cheap, blatant attempt at a cash-grab by the owner. Slow service at the bar too. As far as Irish bars in the city go, Danny Doohlan's is far better.
Was a great night the husband & wife team were fantastic. She's super talented. Great vibe from all ages. Definitely returning when in Auckland next.

Great stay! The upgraded rooms are wonderful and made my stay even more comfortable. Location is great, good walking distance to the city. Face to face service a little meh, could easily improve this with a bit of friendly interaction and smiles. Otherwise very good stay.

Perfect location close to both the city and the bay suburbs with a view overlooking the rose gardens with water glimpses! Must be one of the most underrated places to stay in Auckland as the price was incredible for such a beautiful place. Super comfortable beds, really lovely staff, and the recent renovations and upgrades give it that something special. Brand new, modern and very clean bathroom (far superior to when we had stayed there a couple of years ago). The restaurant was ideal for dinner so we didn't have to travel anywhere to eat out. We had the place to ourselves and the staff were great. Delicious food and well priced. Far exceeded expectations for our one night stay. Will return!

The price was good for such a great location. The Lovely young girl at the desk was welcoming and very clean rooms. Towels folded beautifully and toilet rolls stamped with a seal shouldn’t tickle my fancy as much as they did.. but it did. Oooh and f red plentiful parking is always the best. No hidden thirty dollar fee on top of each nights cost.

We had an awesome time, all facilities are clean and well kept. We found all staff to be friendly and helpful. We ate at the restaurant and enjoyed the food both for breakfast and dinner, our waitress went above and beyond to help us with a fussy diner. Thank you to all for an awesome weekend so handy to downtown Auckland City.

Very clean quiet room. Very much appreciated the breakfast included offer. The raised shower, not level with the floor could be a hazard. The shower itself was very nice. The chairs in the dining area need better feet, perhaps some quietening material as any sliding movement on the tiled floor created a loud grating noice. The breakfast was good as was the evening dinner option. Lovely views out over the rose park.

One of my favourite places to lunch in Auckland. They have fresh, tasty, mostly organic food. The service is great and the prices are not too bad either. It’s quiet enough that you can have a proper conversation. The best thing is that they have plenty of low carb, low GI options. I had the smashed avocado on wholemeal

I enjoyed this cafe very much. Passion fruit and lemon cake with a hint of salt was intriguingly delicious. Pies was priced with salad. Service was outstanding and even gave us a chocolate fish for my boy and toys to keep him busy Highly recommended for a cozy chat
Loved it ! The salmon Benedict was awesome, and the kids loved the 20 minute pancakes - which looked amazing - and tasted so good ! great coffe and friendly staff :)

I’m amazed! Such beautiful dishes and they are delicious as well. Not to mention averagely priced for being much nicer and visually enthralling than in most places. Highly recommend this place, specifically the creamy mushroom rostis and the fluffy pancakes (have never eaten something so fluffy). The macchiato coffee and iced chocolate with almond milk were great as well. Free water, which is great. Nice place, chill atmosphere, friendly service. Very happy to have gone here! Will come again, especially for special occasions.

June 2025: Such a cool place for the weekend. The vibes if this cafe are amazing. I had my bd muffin, apple and cinnamon. Thanks for the recommendation, enjoyed it so much! August 2022: We really like this café for healthy choices. Many things are not overly sweet and not too big. 25 June 2021: Another breakfast with the famous pancakes. Very special, airy, and eggs. Takes 20 min but quite an experience. Just had a very nice breakfast there today. Good long black, tasty vegan blueberry muffin, and a nice croissant. The place has a pleasant vibe.
