They made a delicious pasta out of simple ingredients, which was impressive. The Prosciutto Crudo pizza was generously topped and really tasty too. The calamari could’ve been a bit crispier, but dipping it in the tangy mayo balanced out the richness and made it quite enjoyable

Our number one go to place in Parnell. Awesome Italian food from appetizers to main to dessert. You just don’t wanna miss any of the courses. It would be otherwise incomplete and short changing ourselves from a perfect dining experience. Wait staff is super friendly and attentive. The Courtyard is cherry on top. Thank you non solo team!

Absolutely delicious food and decent service. The food couldn’t have been better absolutely chefs kiss as always! Service was good though was a bit disappointed that when the waitress poured our water she spilt quite a bit over the table and said she’d be back to clean it up but never did so we ended up using a serviette. Atmosphere was nice. Overall a really good experience. Definitely recommend if you want good food! Just bear in mind that it is pricey
Love NSP. Delicious food and when asked if they did a risotto which was not on the menu, the chef very gracefully obliged. Excellent friendly service, our guy was outstanding and great vibe.

The staff really worked hard to make our evening a great success. 11 of us for dinner, seated inside for a birthday celebration and the food was excellent. Highly recommend all the Savor Restaurants we have tried....just one to go now.

This place is easy to miss so keep an eye out on their red sign. The food tastes really good but not a big fan of their misi soup. I got the Unagi dragon roll, tempura veggies, and seafood ramen soup. It was worth my money.
Great cozy atmosphere & table, friendly staff. Best ramen Ive had and wifey Bento Box was legit! Will def be back.

One of the best Japanese restaurants in Auckland! It has such a cozy atmosphere, and the staff are incredibly lovely and friendly. Everything on the menu is delicious, but I highly recommend the sushi rolls and bento boxes:)

We ordered one mild Tempura Udon (22$), one mild Beef Teri Udon (20$), one spicy Tempura Ramen (22$) and one California Roll (16,90$). The portions are very generous and the toppings are really good. The soup is so rich on flavor and not too overpowering at all. They served us everything within 10 minutes and we enjoyed the sushi as well. So chewy and tasty! We would definitely dine here again! ☺️ The ambiente is cute, not too big, but cozy! You have to go down some stairs to get to the restaurant, so it's not really easily accessible for handicapped people.

Moto Sushi Bar on Parnell Road serves decent ramen, but the real highlights are the crispy tempura and juicy Chicken Karage. The tempura is perfectly light, and the Chicken Karage is flavorful and tender. A great spot for authentic Japanese comfort food!

No matter where you are in nz. You bound to come across a KFC outlet. I had driven out to Kumeu, a town or suburb if you wanna call it that; north of auckland. From the ordering of food, mode of payment available, to service assistance, to location and setup inside is well thought of. Hygiene wise, very clean although some tables were not wiped down until we decided to go upstairs BUT it was attended too eventually. For the washroom, TP and hands soap in the form of foam are well kept for customers use. Spacious i must say in terms of movement within the toilets. If one is planning to dine in or if you prefer an outdoor feel, this one has that option Very convenient for location and cost of food is reasonably cheap depending on quantity and your budget. So yeah, all in all. I'am impressed since we dont have KFC in fiji - for whatever reason it maybe, idk and will leave it at that!! Food was tasty and the place has a cozy vibe to it. Recommend for a quick lunch stop over, meet up with friends or family lunch/dinner. Anyways thats my 2cents on it after visiting

Spent $50 on dinner for 2, expect better. Order was missing our 2 reg x coleslaw. Chicken was dry, Didn't realize until we arrived home.. Fifty dollars is alot of money to first have to check the order is correct and then check the quality also! Unbelievable. Called store, no answer.

Stopped by KFC Quay Street for a quick bite and went with the classic Zinger Burger and Wicked Wings—and they did not disappoint! The Zinger Burger had the perfect crunch, with that signature spicy kick balanced by the soft bun and fresh lettuce. The mayo was just the right amount, making every bite satisfying. The Wicked Wings were crispy, flavorful, and had just the right level of heat. They were cooked well, juicy on the inside, and packed that signature KFC spice that keeps you coming back for more. Service was fast, and the food was hot and fresh. Overall, a great spot for a quick and tasty fried chicken fix.

stop hiring people who cant speak of understand basic english. i should not have to dumb down my sentences for your workers to understand that i want a burger. lady told me to wait, left me at the speaker for 5 minutes and came back forgetting everything i told her, and rushed me when i wasn't even done.

Very disgusted, the toilet has crap all over it and the tables weren't even wiped. Honestly the place was filthy. As for the food it was probably the only good thing, it was hot and and pretty good but everything else is what ruins it. You'd like to sit and enjoy your meal where it's hygienic but that was just taking the piss. Yuck!
The best Japanese in Auckland. Food is so fresh and incredible. It does not get more authentic than this. Also service was so lovely! We will definitely continue visiting Gion☺️🤍

I hadn’t been here for many years but I was presently surprised when I popped in a couple of times lately that not much has changed. They are still as lovely as ever, the dining room is authentic Japanese and the food is delicious! Sashimi quality is awesome And the presentation is great!
Gion is my favourite Japanese restaurant in Auckland. Authentic Japanese with excellent friendly service. Chef Akira is extremely talented and always consistent.

This is absolutely my favorite Japanese Restaurant in Auckland. Authentic Japanese food in high quality. Price is reasonable. The owners has run this Restaurant more than 15 years. You must try. Recommend: Jumbo Salmon Sushi Roll; Ell Bento. Yummy

Came here again for my wifes birthday celebration. We ordered the hamachi sashimi, the large sashimi and sushi platter and the sukiyaki beef. The sushi and sashimi quality here is definitely one of the best you can get in NZ. The hamachi sashimi is the first time I have tried it and it is kinda have a texture of salmon but is a white fish sashimi. Sukiyaki beef was also not too sweet. All the dishes came out staggeringly so you get to enjoy each dish one at a time. Also thank you Gion for having a wonderful birthday celebration for my wife too. Was a big surprise on what they offered us. 😇 Overall high quality, price is on the expensive side but is a wonderful place for a special occassion.

We had the most wonderful experience at Di Mare for dinner last night. The owners are the ones running the whole operation, from cooking the food to serving it. They are such lovely, hospitable people. The food was absolutely DIVINE! We had the garlic bread, calamari, fruto di mare with pasta and the rack of lamb with mint sauce. We also had incredible deserts like the panacota and the fried bananas with ice cream. The atmosphere is so cozy and reminds you of being at Nona’s house. All together, we had an incredible time and would recommend this restaurant to anyone!

I had the loveliest meal here tonight! The food was absolutely delicious—every dish was full of flavor and beautifully presented. What made the experience even better was the incredibly friendly staff. They made me feel so welcome, and I truly appreciated how comfortable they made dining alone feel. It was the perfect spot to enjoy a great meal with my book, and I’ll definitely be back. Highly recommend!

A great little find off the main road on Parnell. It was very quiet which was nice for us as a family of 5. Had really generous sized meals packed with lots of flavour. The drinks were nice and cold I enjoyed the passion fruit mojito. Our children loved their meals just a bit large for them. The lunch specials were delicious and very lovely service from the hosts. Reasonable pricing for quality meals.

My partner and I celebrated our 10th anniversary with a celebratory dinner at this establishment. We were thoroughly pleased with the service and cuisine, as it lived up to our expectations. The dessert was a particular highlight of the evening.Definitely will come again!

Came here with friends tonight and enjoyed absolutely top class food, wine and service. My wife’s gluten free Chicken Pasta was excellent as was my Venison. Our friends had the Fireball Pasta and the Lamb Rack. They were impressed. The lamb rack was exceptional. We finished with the chocolate cake dessert which was great. The restaurant is intimate and warm and the service was friendly and professional. Value for money was excellent too. We’ve been to plenty of overpriced over rated restaurants in the city, driving past Di Mare on the way. We won’t be making that mistake again - Di Mare is now going to be a regular haunt. Can’t wait to go there again.

Waited over 20 minutes for two coffees and felt the drive through and deliveries took priority. Ordered extra hot coffees but got warm. Staff were friendly and did apologise for the delay. Internet didn’t work.

06-07-2025 @9.00 pm I went into the restaurant and placed an order for one Hot chocolate, kiosk didn’t issue the receipt due to internal error. Waited for 10 minutes and asked twice, the attitude of the crew trainer was very bad. After paying money, after waiting for 10 minutes, I went away without the item I paid for. McDonald’s standard and service has gone down. The toilets were locked out for customers use, both downstairs and upstairs. The current franchise owner is not customer focused. Best regards Ilango

As someone who rarely eats takeaways, it's always a treat and looked forward to. I really think McDonalds has taken the respect out of their product, and the days of McDonald's being a clean toilet stop and snack now seem a distant memory. I know individual stores will be different, but today Quay Street looked tired and in need of a good clean from top to bottom. The food is always what you expect and that was the case with this visit.

This place is so disgusting and disappointing. me, my friend, and my little 4 year old cousin came to this McDonald’s for lunch, my little cousin needed to use the bathroom really badly. I walked her to the bathroom and there was a worker standing there saying that we were not allowed to use their toilet unless we have a receipt. My friend was currently ordering at the time and i explained that he would have our receipt any minute but this little girl really needs to go toilet. She started tearing up and even asked the worker herself. The worker was so rude and told her to hold it in until we had a receipt. Not long after the worker got our receipt so she could finally use the toilet, after she’s done her business we come to realise there’s no toilet paper! we ask the worker for some, he sighs and walks super slow to get some. We are waiting in this toilet for over 10 minutes. My little 4 year old cousin had to just pull her pants up with no toilet paper as this worker hadn’t come back until we had already gotten our food and are really to leave. This place is horrible and I will never be going back there.
I have ordered 3 choc cluster pies and they didn’t give us. Plus the drink they gave us is also wrong…Terrible experiences, definitely need to be improved

I live close by this area, so i always pass by this sushi shop. I went inside one day but it was too early - the selections were too limited. So i went out. Another day, i went inside again to check the sushi out - it was too expensive - small - and not much selections for me. Hence, i left. On the way out, she rudely said dont come back. Shockingly, i replied why? She said dont come in and look but not buy anything. HOW RUDE. She even accused me of spying! I was like why is ure mind so negative!! Never coming back here! No Hi or hello's either! Hospitality ZERO!

I bought three sushi from there, but the owner told me : it’s too less, I have to buy more, otherwise she will charge me more. the attitude is terrible, she also spoke Korean to me, I guess it’s bad words. I feel not good. won’t go there anymore，by the way, I didn’t use her chopsticks and napkins

I have been eating here for the last 2 years since I started work in Parnell, and honestly the best tasting sushi, or any other bowls. I sometimes go close to the closing time but the quality/taste of the sushi are still so delicious.

I've been coming here regularly for over 5 years and the service/food had always been fantastic - hence why I went back so often. The woman who ran the shop always had great customer service and the effort that went into the food and presentation was always very clear. It's a shame to say that because of the new manager running the shop, I will not be returning. The new manager is always quite rude but today he misunderstood what I was trying to say about my loyalty card, so he stood out from behind the counter and (in front of a full shop of customers) proceeded to yell over to my table at me in a very belittling and misogynistic manner. It was incredibly inappropriate and embarrassing so I got up, told them what I thought, said I wouldn't need my loyalty card anymore and left. Also- they no longer cater vegetarians as well as they once did either with only one non meat/fish option. Please don't support companies like this.
Love their sushi and Donburi bowls. Very fresh and delicious. The place is always clean and tidy. I regularly buy my lunch here.

Every time I visit this Subway, they’re consistently out of stock on multiple items, which is frustrating. I’ve never had a great experience here. Today, they packed my order directly in the wrapping paper without using parchment paper, which was disappointing. This location never fails to disappoint with its service and stock issues.

With the prices of your combo's as in meals gor $26 when ordering online it would be nice to get all my cookies like the cookies that come with the meal. We pay money for the food. Also is it me or you guys are very stingy with the protein that goes into a footlong. Need to do better and make the food to the price of the miney you guys charge for ..
Young man with glasses who was working Sunday evening, was very polite and friendly. Good service, clean shop, nice food. Will be back 🙂
For $22 you get burnt bread and limited veges pretty disappointing

When it comes to food, specially prepared live to customers' preference, the staff need to make some suggestions and show some willingness to serve. Sorry to say that I didn't experience any of these.

Pizza is great! no doubt. Delicious for the price you pay. Cant fault that. While saying that one of the female staff members were a little bit rude. Should be a bit more welcoming or at least smile a bit. Still a good pizza shop. Would recommend.

This was my first time trying Sal’s. So yum and the meal deals they have are good, especially for those who don’t want to commit to the price of a whole pizza. The buffalo pizza was def the winner! Great service too.

This Sal's Pizza place is special because of the lovely service we received from the lady behind the counter. She sounded middle eastern and was so so kind and lovely to us. The pizza was made to perfection and we even ordered more to take home. We often go to the one in Takapuna but this one is so much better. The atmosphere was also beautiful with lots of seating outside and inside too. It is set back from the road so you don't really feel like it's a great food joint. The kids loved it .
Lady was really nice buffalo chicken was so good and the music was vibessss

Whenever I crave buffalo wings and American-style pizza, my top choice is always the Parnell location of Sal's. Their dishes are consistently fresh, delicious, and never fail to impress me. Despite having other Sal's branches to choose from in Auckland CBD, I always opt for this particular one. I typically place my orders through Uber Eats, and I must say that this Sal's branch is the best when it comes to meeting my expectations. Given the nature of using a delivery service, it's crucial that the order notes are not missed. Fortunately, Sal's Parnell is quick, efficient, and attentive to order notes, making my experience seamless and enjoyable.

Think I've found my favourite café but I did visit during the week when it was relatively quiet and parking was easy, which might've affected my opinion somewhat. The service was friendly and efficient. When I arrived they gave me the menus and told me to sit where I liked, and that I was to order at the counter. After I paid, they explained that I could help myself to cutlery, water and condiments, and pointed out where they were. I love places that explain stuff and don't assume that you'll automatically find everything. Had the Eggs Benedict for a bargain $18. It doesn't come with any other protein but you can't complain for that price. Since they were in the Entertainment Book, I splurged and got a side of smoked salmon and a side of hash browns. The dish was delicious, with the eggs poached PERFECTLY and the English muffin being a posh artisan-type, plus it came with a salad. The plate it was served on was so pretty, and that just added to the whole lovely experience. The setting and the view of the the Domain is relaxing and makes you feel very content with life. The super duperest thing was the condiments you could help yourself to: HP sauce, Tabasco sauce, and Worcestershire sauce were the ones that caught my eye. To me this shows a café that cares for its customers. The other touch that I loved was that the seating at the windowside counter were comfy stools that my short legs could easily get myself into.

Wintergarden Café in Auckland offers great food, friendly service, and a stunning location by the duck pond in the Domain. Perfect for breakfast dates or afternoon coffee breaks, it’s a peaceful escape with a lovely atmosphere that keeps visitors coming back.

Food was well made. However, portion size is smaller for the price that they charge. We ordered eggs Benedict, Crayfish pasta, cumin lamb cutlets, beer battered fish and chips, and mushroom pasta for 6 people and some ice cream. It was really good and loved it. Service could be better and faster. If I am in the area, I would visit again.

This could be such a beautiful place, but the café has unfortunately lost control of the pigeons and other birds. The animals not only bother the guests on the terrace, but also come into the café and pounce on the tables that have not yet been cleared. You can see from the reactions of the staff that they don't care anymore. For me, this is a no-go and extremely unhygienic.
We often go to the Auckland Domain for walks, and it is great to have the Wintergarden Cafe there. The staff is friendly and the food and service very good!

BurgerFuel Parnell offers a great dining experience. The customer service is friendly and efficient, making for a smooth visit. The atmosphere is relaxed and well-maintained, creating a comfortable space to enjoy a meal. Whether dining in or taking away, it’s a consistently good spot.

Ordered and picked up on the burger day. Lots of customers but we ordered it thru its app. So, we did not wait long. Always get the burger we like. The quality is always on top and they are made fresh.
Excellent service every time we dine with BurgerFuel Parnell 🍔 Food 5🌟 Service 5🌟 Atmosphere🌟 keep up the great work team.
+1 point to the guy who served us at the front, he really added a touch of personality to the place

Used a Flex fitness voucher there at 10:30pm and they accepted it, real cool and helpful staff there. And the kitchen is really clean, 10/10 would recommend this place to anyone looking for a late night meal. Clean, friendly and delicious

Ordered the Smash from their egg’d menu - was very disappointed. The avo was not mashed at all, I only got two small pieces of avo. I ordered fluffy scrambled egg but I got this weird egg crepe situation. Also did not get the hash brown I ordered. Not worth going back.

This dude is so cool !!! opened the kitchen for me and my partner when he was just closing and made us everything we wanted. Always so nice and catering whenever we come here too ! He’s always so polite ! He needs a pay raise ! we love this pitapit so much. We will always come here whenever we want pitapit because the service and kai is just top notch EVERY TIME ! Thank you so so so much buddy ! You’re the best

I ordered catering for our corporate office on Monday the 12th to be ready for collection at 11:30am on Wednesday May 14th. Catering was for wrap platters (15 wraps total). When I arrived at 11:28am to collect the order they were aware I was collecting at 11:30am. They did not advise that they had not yet started preparing the order, no apology or communication as to why. This was for a catered team meeting which I needed to have in the office by 11:40am. I then had to wait 20 minutes for the order to be made and no communication or apology was made. If you cannot offer catering services I would suggest not offering the service as this is not the first time I have encountered issues. We order a lot of catering and reliability is crucial when you are working around tight time schedules. Very disappointing, although the food we received tasted good it is just not a reliable service.
Chicken bacon crunch wrap, was anything but crunchy. It was soggy, way too much mayo and lettuce and it was cold.
Just went in at 2:26 to be told they close at 2:15. Another place that closes early to suit them no the customers .

We saw emes thru social media and wanted to try out. We ordered egg bene, bacon carbonara and matcha French toast. All food was great but we weren’t happy with the matcha drinks as it came out as frap/slushie and our oat and fresh milk drinks were mixed up. Apart from that staff was nice.

This is a nice cafe with plenty of indoor and outdoor seating. A few friendly sparrows outside are hoping to get some crumbs. Even a dog bowl for your walking buddy. The service here is very very good. The staff are very attentive, bring water to your table and check to ensure that you are well looked after.
Warm welcome! Amazing staff! Love the matcha latte!!! Must try💖💖

Food was tasty and presented well. The mushrooms on toast was very different from what I had tried before and I loved the poached egg 🍳 we ordered some kid sized waffles (wanted some but not a whole meal) and they were very tasty. Will definitely try the fun size next time! Alai really enjoyed my hot chocolate l.

Great brunch and got the coffee that is my fav! All press! New owners have a sharp looking operation going on with some great cabinent food to boot. I love the new colours Sterling Arnet Kakapo Business Sales

Great food with generous portions. Service was excellent too—even though we were seated outside at the last corner table, it was still attentive. The only minor downside was that the food wasn’t served as hot as I’d prefer. Otherwise, a great experience

Great restaurant serving Spanish meals. We had the paella, charcoal grilled scotch fillet, gnocchi, wood fired sourdough & brussels sprouts. All the dishes were very tasty & nicely presented. Staff were very attentive & accommodating in terms of dietary requirements. Would definitely go again to try their other dishes.

This place is very good!! We got the burratta, grape cheese board which was tasty. Roasted grapes on the bread was SOOO good. The Croquettas... I'd eat them every day! The best I've had in NZ. The sirloin was flavourful and, holy moly, those potatoes were unreal - perfectly crispy. Brussels were delish, slightly dry but great when mixed with the sirloin red wine jus And the carrots, tasty pesto bit and perfect ablmount of crunch. Spanish wine is always a winner too! Only markdown is because the price of the cocktail vs how much cocktail you get is upsetting, and the sirloin was a little rare for our liking and how we requested but still ate it and tasted amazing 👏 we'll definitely be back

Had a birthday dinner and the food is just AMAZING. I especially loved their Paella which had fresh seafood, so delicious. Good vibe, lots of parking places in a quiet neighbourhood. Just one thing I want to point out is lack of professional serving. Two of us ordered two tapas as entree and two mains with a side, I was expecting we get food slowly to enjoy these but unfortunately they were all served almost at once which was not very ideal as we had to just jump into the paella as I didn't want to miss that hot paella while we still have a lot left for our entree. Also when we were waiting for our dessert, the server never wipe the table (like veges and fish still on table) until we actually ask for it when dessert was served. Because their food is amazing I would definitely come back but it would be better if servers are more professional.

Barulho is an absolute gem nestled in the heart of Parnell, Auckland, offering an extraordinary Spanish dining experience. From the moment you step inside, you're greeted with a vibrant ambiance that perfectly complements the authentic flavors awaiting you. Their menu is a culinary masterpiece, showcasing the best of Spanish cuisine with an array of tapas, paellas, and other traditional dishes. Each bite is a symphony of flavors, meticulously prepared with fresh, high-quality ingredients that transport you straight to Spain. The service at Barulho is exemplary, with attentive staff who are passionate about ensuring every guest has an unforgettable dining experience. They're knowledgeable about the menu and eager to provide recommendations, making you feel right at home from the moment you arrive. One cannot overlook the exquisite sangria, a must-try beverage that perfectly complements the rich flavors of the food. And for dessert lovers, the sweet treats on offer provide a delightful conclusion to an already remarkable meal. In summary, Barulho is a culinary treasure in Auckland, offering an unparalleled taste of Spain that will leave you craving more. Whether you're a seasoned foodie or simply looking for a memorable dining experience, this restaurant delivers on every front. I can't recommend it highly enough and can't wait to return for another culinary adventure

Came to this area with a friend to eat at Di mare. Unfortunately Di mare was closed. We were going to leave but a waitress from the neighbor restaurant asked us if we wanted to try Crown Range Lounge instead. Initially we were skeptical because we were set on eating at Di mare but eventually just said ok we’ll try Crown Range Lounge. We had a great time, food was amazing, and our waitress, Amanda, recommended all the best food options. Had the pork belly appetizer with the course meal (lamb rump and salmon). Overall would come again! I’m sure it can get busy so reserving a table in advance is probably the way to go.

We had the best time here with my small family and friends from Dubai. We wanted them to try the local wine in NZ and we live nearby so we chose to come here. They have delicious tapas and fine wine to pair with it. The interior and exterior are both stellar. The waitress was patient to our little one. Will come back here next time for sure.

How we do love this little gem. Been there twice and won't be our last. All the food is amazing, especially the beef and the salmon. As they are a cellar they also have their own wine! Live bands and some dancing if you're keen.

Such a beautiful space I just discovered in the heart of Parnell. Food was delicious and the cocktails were amazing. You could give a flavour profile you love and they would whip something up for you. I had someone turn up with a dietary requirement which wasn't noted and they accommodated it no problems! I would recommend this place for anyone wanting to host an event. The place is also gorgeous and gives you very South Island vibes.

I had my 60th birthday at Crown Range Lounge. From the first meeting with Sam I knew I had found the right venue for a private function. The whole process of pre event details was dealt with professionalism and nothing was a problem. On my birthday I arrived to everything as we planned. The venue oozed cool atmosphere and the staff were lovely and warm to my guests. The whole experience I couldn’t fault. I would 100% recommend Crown Range Lounge as a venue.

Great experience of Persian food. Loved the 3 meat Rumi special kebab. The ground lamb was very unique and will come back for this. Lamb rack and lamb shank were also bangers. Yogurt fermented drink was not my thing as it was bit bitter. The starters were okay. Mains were a lot better.
Had lunch here with a friend. To be honest I cannot remember much about the meals aside from the gorgeous decor and the bottle of fragranted spice to add flavor. It was a pricy lunch.

A Taste of Persian Perfection Rumi in Auckland delivers an exceptional Persian dining experience. The food is outstanding, with exquisite kababs that are perfectly seasoned and cooked to perfection. The saffron ice cream is a must-try, offering a delicate and authentic taste of Persian cuisine. The service is impeccable, with friendly and attentive staff who make you feel welcome from the moment you walk in. Whether you’re new to Persian food or a seasoned fan, Rumi is a culinary gem that you shouldn’t miss. Highly recommended!
Such a cozy and colourful spot! The traditional details and warm atmosphere make it feel really special. Loved my coffee here ☕💗✨

Upon stepping inside, warm smiles and a cozy ambience greeted us. The restaurant's decor and soft background tunes immediately set a tranquil tone, making us feel at ease and right at home. Every dish we sampled surpassed expectations, showcasing the rich and diverse flavours of Persian cuisine. Each bite was a culinary delight, meticulously prepared and brimming with flavour. The meat dishes were exceptionally juicy and tender, while the saffron rice boasted a perfect balance of flavours. Despite some of us being mindful of carbohydrates, we couldn't resist indulging in the irresistible allure of the fragrant rice offerings. The service was outstanding. Attentive service from the owner-operators ensured our dining experience was flawless from start to finish.

Absolutely loved the berry skin glow bowl which I paired with a banana protein shake. Delicious, nourishing, and great for the skin! With fresh berries, creamy yoghurt, PB and crunch granola it really is the perfect symphony of flavour. Enjoy! Hamish Dorrington Kakapo Business Sales
I do love their bowls but the service can be varied… today there was a lot more focus on their own conversations rather than the growing number of customers.
The banana choc toast was delicious, but the ice chai latte was too sweet and too much milk.
These smoothie bowls are so refreshing! Love the options. Great spot!
We ordered via uber eats and very impressed with how much care was put into our bowls, even as delivery! Delicious and wholesome.

Delicious lunch at Biskit Cafe & Kitchen today. Service was good, food was served promptly, and staff were very friendly. Seems to be a favourite as the store was packed even on a weekday. As for the food, everything tasted fresh and thoughtfully prepared. Portions were great. We had the Thai chicken salad, Seoul beef burger, and fettuccine. Overall, it was a delightful experience. Would definitely be coming back in the future. Would recommend if you're in the area.

Lovely staff and great food. Food was awesome, was so hungry forgot to take photo of it but also pretty smoothie and coffee was good. I only have one suggestion. Charge little more and have two eggs with smash avo. Dog friendly(curb footpath seating)

The food was very tasty, and also because I love Bagel. It didn't say it clear on the menu so I had to order another egg and found out that I had two....Yet, the matcha latte is like a 6.5/10. Very cute painting on the wall~

Wow! A great cosy cafe for chilly mornings like today. First time trying earl grey matcha and we found that the bottom had some clumps, but that didn’t get in the way of the earthy and rich flavour. Coffee, food, and service were great overall.

I don’t even know how many times I’ve been here. It’s not one of those flashy viral spots. There’s a reason I keep coming back. Everything looks amazing and tastes even better. If it’s too busy, I make sure to at least grab some cake to go. Thanks always, Biskit!

I used to really enjoy the Classic Caesar Salad from Tank in Parnell. Yesterday I was disappointed because (a) the packaging has changed from a simple, convenient box to a round container with a clear lid and (b) instead of putting all the ingredients in a large metal bowl and mixing it thoroughly so that the Caesar dressing covers everything, the salad was made in the takeaway container, not mixed and a just small amount of Caesar dressing was put on top. I wonder if it’s a cost cutting exercise, if so it’s a shame because they have lost me as a customer.
Its been the same woman each time I visit, usually around closing time. Super patient with my fussy orders and honestly makes the best wraps I've had from any Tank store. 11/10

Unfortunately, my experience wasn’t great. I really felt for the poor lady serving - she was clearly under a lot of stress, and it wasn’t pleasant seeing her so overwhelmed. We went in just before 12pm, and she was so busy she asked if we could come back later. It might be worth considering adding another staff member during peak times to help ease the pressure.

I’ve been to this tank a couple of times but today was severely disappointed the salad container was only 1/2 full and there were hardly any noodles normally the container is full and there are more noodles, when you are paying $16 for a salad you expect the container to be filled up!
Average drinks - all depends on time of day and how busy the shop is to how good your drink is

I read the reviews and thought I’d try it. Excellent service but expect 3 star food. Lovely phone and store manner but disappointed with the Mixed meat kebab and fries. Food was Lukewarm and fries tasted like they had been under the warmer. Kebab was “airy” and lacked a variety of ingredients except for large cabbage and onion. I work nearby and was looking for a regular lunch spot so I may try the meat on chips, but will look elsewhere for kebabs.
First time I have tried salmon kebab. It was delicious. My son tried meat and chips. Is heavenly delicious. Definitely will recommend to friends and family.

My original review for Kebab King Parnell was "Kebab King Parnell is absolutely amazing the food is super delicious and the service is just as great the girl who works there that wears a scarf is so kind who genuinely cares about her customers. Highly recommended 5 stars" now after my second time visiting Kebab King I was very disappointed I ordered one chicken kebab for $11 and it honestly wasn't worth the money the carrots were cold very very cold and just made the entire food yuck! Clearly it's a hit and miss type of takeaway. Will I be back? Definitely not!

Used to be a pretty decent spot for a quick feed but have lately increased all their prices a few times and is now insanely overpriced for what it is - really taking advantage of how expensive all the other eateries in Parnell have gotten 🫠
The fish and chips where quite nice actually. And also a great price at $6.00 and I had it two nights in a row. And the owner is quite nice.

The Mediterranean Chicken and Falafel salad is excellent! Has a variety of veggies not just lettuce. Also has beans, feta cheese, and avocado. They even grill the chicken in the restaurant. It’s a damn good salad compared to the crap at some other similar chain salad shops and even most of the kebab shops! If you’re looking for a decent salad and it’s a weird hour of the day when the boutique salad shops are closed, this might be the place to go!
If your missing this bolt, don’t worry, I have it.

I don’t understand why adding bacon when it not in the instructions. I ordered in the uber eats with clear instructions saying chicken with the salads. How hard is it to follow a written instructions.
Usually when I get pita pit or egg’d, I’m excited as I was when I ordered this. However, this is near inedible. It’s cold and undercooked and the service was subpar and slow. Very disappointed

Usually I am a fan of Pita Pit - their pitas and their salad bowls - but Parnell Pita Pit is just sad. Service was slow and what you finally received was usually a small pile of lettuce with some sauce if you were lucky! One person didn’t know the menu so had a tablet in front of her reading it between adding pinches of each item, once done she was told the bowl was too empty so added a handful of lettuce to the top to fill the space. If it was just once it might be ok but it was 4 times! It wasn’t worth my time or money - thank god I’m on a diet so remaining hungry is the point.

Had a delicious breakfast here yesterday! I am fairly boring, I always get the eggs on toast. The had a big beautiful menu of loads of different things, as well as cabinet food. The staff were super friendly and welcoming I could see they are a local favorite. Great outdoor street seating as well as loads inside. Would highly recommend :) Jess, Hospitality Specialist Kakapo Business Sales

We went here for a quick bit and drink on the way back to our hotel. It was a nice place to stop at. The staff were friendly and helpful. It was clean and tidy. It was quiet, making it pleasant to sit down to eat and drink. I definitely recommend trying this cafe.

My family and I dined in here on Sunday morning during a weekend away in Auckland. We drove past and thought we'd take a chance. Glad we did! They had really great options to choose from on the menu, and easily accommodated changes to the Pancake breakfast (smaller portion for a child). The service was great, the food came out quickly and tasted amazing. I ordered the energy breakfast and the portions of everything was perfect 👌 They also double-checked with me if the eggs were cooked okay as I am pregnant, which I thought was kind of them. Prices were good too! Overall, all four of us (two adults and two kids) enjoyed our breakfast and we definitely will be returning the next time we are in Auckland.

Really enjoy coming here. The coffee is consistently full of flavour — a proper caffeine hit. The cabinet food always looks fresh with a good range of options, making it easy to find something to go with a drink. Staff are friendly and the atmosphere has a nice local vibe, perfect whether you’re grabbing a quick takeaway or sitting down for a break.
Great food Excellent service Friendly team Very clean rest rooms Very happy client. Extensive menu.

First, this restaurant vibe and view was so amazing. Staff also so kindly, we had been 1:30pm. It is good time for get Sunshine outside. Second, food quality is great. Very tasty and beef noodle salad looks like Vietnamese food. I will definitely come back

Just had cabinet food but was some of the best we've ever had. The coffee was as good as you'd expect from anywhere decent, and the Moroccan chicken baguette was fabulous. Nice friendly quick service too, there were a lot of people eating at peak lunch hour and was still nice and fast. Excellent.

I've been here several times as I have classes in the jubilee building. They have good coffee, nice food and a good atmosphere. It's a busy place but there is plenty of seating. They are quick to bring food out.

Came here for breakfast this morning the service was great the waiter that served us was very attentive and polite. The food not so much, the ricotta hotcakes were very disappointing. I didn’t even eat them. The manager still made us pay for them despite not eating them I will not be coming back here.

Awesome food and excellent service. It's the type of place where you feel warmly welcomed (and the staff know customers by name). Had the cheese scone, toasted sandwich, sausage roll and a cheese cake - all were yummmm and so was the coffee!!

Weekly Chinese takeaway.👌🏼 bang for your buck, generous portions. The wontons are massive and tasty! I recommend the wonton noodles soup, beef fried rice and the deep fried wonton. Not a fan of the kway teow but I’m hyper fussy about the way my kway teow should be. I’m still working my way through the menu.

Very affordable price for a big portion of each menu.. Me and husband bought kung pao chicken n stir fry tofu on rice, only $15/portion. Delicious food, staff is friendly, and clean take away shop.. Recommend for you who looking for big portion but not making your wallet empty.. :-) Cheers..
Bought the vegetable Singapore noodle, Taste like something you would buy at countdown, staff were Algood and quick but food is gonna be an 3 out of 10 for me tonight.
Ordered the seafood special fried rice, no problem at all very tasty. Xiexie to the chef for our dins tonight! Very good service too so thankyou again😊

Ordered the phad Thai with just chicken as I'm allergic to prawns. Arrived with heaps of prawns mixed in. Only saw them after a few bites. After calling the store with this info the guy just hung up on me

Pizza plank disappointing. I have ordered here in the past (pickup) and generally satisfied with the service and food. Today I saw the promotion for the pizza plank and decided to give it a go. I was in the mood for pepperoni but maybe not a full pizza. Promotional image shows full coverage pepperoni. I got maybe half that and a much flatter "plank". Huge expectation vs reality moment. Should've gone with a pizza.
Gluten free pizza base was good! But 2 star for the lack of base sauce and their was a hair inside my pizza
i ordered 6 pizzas for a party, they all were so amazing. best pizza i ever had. i specially called this branch and asked who made these. it was Mr. Tushar. thankyou

Ordered online but when I reached the store one of the staff member asked me very rudely to wait for at least 30 minutes or cancel the order. Lucky I didn’t had the pizza from store as i could see the kitchen was so unhygienic and messed up😤. Worst domino’s store I’ve ever seen.

If I could give zero stars, I would. We ordered through Uber Eats and honestly, it was the worst pizza I’ve ever had. It arrived super cold, barely had any ingredients, and just tasted horrible. Really disappointing.

I’ve realized how much I enjoy these casual neighborhood spots. The staff exude an easygoing kindness, and as a newcomer, I feel like a welcomed stranger. Most of the regulars don’t even need to place their orders— the servers already know their favorite drinks and dishes. I hear this is what they call Kiwi style. The food is simple yet far from boring, with layers of rich flavors. Today, I tried their new summer special—refreshing and delightfully light.

I've been coming here for my coffee and cheese scone combo for a few years now. I must say, they make the most delicious cheese scones I have ever eaten. And yummy coffee to match. The coffee is always consistent across the team, I always enjoy every sip. Jackie (owner) she's very thoughtful, shows kindness and empathy in every conversation, not only to me but all her customers. Shout out to the team as well for their wonderful, warm and kind service! I'm about to relocate out of town and I will miss this place for their wonderful service, coffee and of course ... cheese scones!
Excellent coffee, but the takeaway for a long black is served without a skeeve, which makes holding the ucp a challenge (being too hot)

Coffee is coffee right? Not at Good Day, greeting is warm and genuine, scones are delicious and freshly made, coffee excellent... good to this point But then I was hit with the WOW factor! As soon as I was seated, a small carafe of water was placed on the table, coffee arrived with a delicate (super delicious) Christmas mince pie to accompany it curtsey of the cafe .. unexpected! the thoughtfulness and generosity were absolutely appreciated and valued. THe cafe was full of very relaxed and happy diners... Certainly would have no hesitation recommending this Cafe and their lovely staff...

A small cafe in the beautiful suburb of Ōrākei. We only went there because the cafe is very highly rated and rightly so. The staff is super friendly and considerate. We went around lunch time on Sunday when the cafe was packed but we managed to secure seats outside in the cold and our drinks order was taken almost immediately. Outdoor seaters are provided with blankets to keep warm. Looking at the jaunty crowd and aromatic smelling food, we were ready to battle the cold to try it out. Little did we know, that the staff would request us to move into a table inside when it became available, even when we didn’t request for a table inside. So thoughtful! We ordered 2 coffees( flat white & Cap) both were very well made and we also got the green smoothie, which was delicious. For mains, we got the doorstop toastie was so scrumptious, the bread was crispy but not oily and jalapenos were spread evenly inside. So every bite had the perfect balance of crispy bread, melted cheese and jalapeños. My partner got the Chorizo scramble and rated it a 5/5. He has been reminiscing them from his trip in the States and so finally, he got lucky to enjoy this delectable dish at this cafe. We also ordered the soup of the day, pumpkin soup. I wouldn’t recommend this soup as we felt it was quite a heavy dish to share with two others main ones The consistency was very thick and is immensely filling. However, the soup also comes with 2 slices of well toasted sourdough bread and butter, which we were incapable of neglecting. So we had one each with an overload of butter on top and happily stuffed ourselves. The table next to us ordered the avocado toast and the French toast of which a morsel wasn’t left. Therefore, for next time we are sure to get them two.

Always a great atmosphere for after work cocktails or a beer in the sunshine! Easily the best place to enjoy a sundowner - one of the only places on east side of the city that gets that all-afternoon sunshine. Also, the food is consistently great - the curly fries with truffle - to die for! And there’s plenty of gluten free goodness on the menu.

46 and York is an awesome place to meet friends for drinks and a bite to eat. They have heaps of unique cocktails and a range of beers/ciders on tap. The food is great and ranges from bites to share (chicken sliders are my all time fave) to yummy meals. There's a lot of parking directly outside which is unheard of for a bar in Auckland city and is a great after work spot as the tables outside have sun until late in the evening. Can't fault it, one of my favourite bars in Auckland

46&York was an awesome venue for my 30th birthday party. They handled catering food and drinks for ~90 people with ease. Staff were friendly and responsive and the deposit was refunded quickly. Thank you so much for the great service Jarred and team.

A great find Iin Parnell. Nice building, with a variety of seating options, including outside. Friendly staff who were happy to create me a drink with the pomegranate gin. Nice food, reasonably priced.
Food was delicious, it came out in good time, nice big bowl of fries for $10, heaps of dietary options. The broccoli salad was sooo good 👍

Have spent over 25 hours on aircraft and 22 hours extra travelling, it was great to get a nice welcome and good home style cooking, after being given airplane food . The staff were and are superb more like your mum or dad, the food was good quality, nicely cooked and tasty, have eaten two main meals and one breakfast, which is all you can eat and lasted me till tea, so worth the money, I know some have complained in the reviews ,and would say before complaining in a review, complain to the people, give them a chance to put things right, anyway I enjoyed my meals and am enjoying my stay in this great country of New Zealand 😁

We were staying at the adjoining hotel and ate here due to flooding in Auckland making it unsafe to drive elsewhere. We had tomato soup with white beans, a Thai beef salad, and gratin potatoes as a side. The soup was quite good, and the potatoes were pretty good. After having had a fantastic Thai Beef Salad at another restaurant a few days earlier, I chose that here, and it paled in comparison. It was on the small side and seemed minimal, with just a few bites of beef, and the dressing didn’t taste like what I’ve had on other Thai Beef Salads. It’s my fault that I didn’t notice until I finished that the peanuts had been left off completely. The chef apologized and sent some that I took to my room as a snack. We had the pecan torte and the chocolate torte for dessert. These were ok. Our server was very nice, and he did a great job, but the overall experience was underwhelming — a forgettable meal in a place lacking much atmosphere in a dreary rainy evening.

I have celebrated two christmases there so far, enjoying their Christmas lunch. Although the restaurant doesn’t have fancy decor, the atmosphere is wonderful, with families all there to have a sensible and good time. The food was amazing, the service was spot on, and it was incredibly good value for money. We all had the carvery, and the beef steak was delicious. This last time we came with my mother who said she had such a great time and would like to have our Christmases there from now on!

Rustic atmosphere and fine if you just wanted a burger and chips. The Thai pork belly and prawns was underwhelming and not tasty. The pork was dry and had been frozen and recooked. The prawns were dry. My partner had a steak sandwich and the beef was fatty and full of sinew. Someone else had chicken parmigiana and it was dry and served with rice. It repeated on him all day. I used to come here 40 years ago but felt it was no longer a place I’d seek out again

Was busy, but managed to fit us in without a reservation. Fantastic & professional service from our waitress. Kids meals were good, nicely cooked and value for money. Son very much enjoyed his burger. Hubby enjoyed his pork belly, but my steak although cooked to perfection, was under seasoned and a little bland. Potato gratin was good. Quite a long wait for dessert, but dessert was exceptional. Apple tart tatin was out of this world. We would return to both the restaurant and the hotel again.

Busy cafe with lots of customers coming from the pools so this is super handy to have a coffee or meal after swimming. We were in the area looking for Sunday breakfast after mass and this cafe did not disappoint! Delicious mocha made to my liking as I’m very fussy being an ex barista in my early 20s which is a very long time ago. The pancakes, aqua big breakfast, French toast and porridge were just amazing generous portions and lovely service. Excellent pricing for quality food. Will be back another time and highly recommend!

Food was nice. It was a bit quiet when we visited. As soon as we got our menu on the table, two staff started to do the cleaning like vacuuming and mopping even if it was just around 1p.m. Disappointed 😞
Loved the cozy atmosphere and friendly staff at Aqua Cafe! Their breakfast was delicious and filling, and the coffee was perfectly brewed. Highly recommend!
Some cafes the food is such you say what can I eat. As there is so little appealing food. This place it is what shall I eat as the shelves are pregnant with delightful options
Always a great coffee from the cafe! The staff are so friendly and they make you feel welcome. We normally try to come as a treat after the pools,. Keep up the great work team!

My friend was recommended this restaurant to me a while ago, just have a chance to visited. Love the food especially spicy crispy pork. A bit hard to find but absolutely worth it. Will definitely be back.

The food is amazing! We ordered a lot for five people, around nine dishes, and even got a free dessert. The Thai papaya salad and fried chicken are truly recommended. I had been craving authentic Thai food for so long, and I'm glad I finally got to experience that flavor in Auckland.
Just ordered takeaway for my dinner. LOVE IT! Spicy Crispy Pork dish and Chicken Pad Thai, the food were flavoursome ,and good portion size.
Excellent restaurant for any occasion. Best Thai we have had in a long time.
Being a Thai food lover, this place is a hidden gem. The presentation, taste and authenticity of the food is amazing. Must try.

Unfortunately,I went to this restaurant with my wife, mother-in-law, and daughter on Valentine’s Night, and I had a terrible experience. English: After 55 minutes, our food arrived, but it was extremely cold and inedible. Even the carrots, which were supposed to be cooked vegetables as a side dish, were completely raw. It was clear that for such a night with so many reservations, this restaurant and its management were too small to handle it. Additionally, in one of our dishes, which was a pizza, we found a hair. No matter how many times we told the waiter, he kept insisting that it wasn’t from them. I have no way of knowing whether the hair in the pizza came from me or from the restaurant. I’m disappointed with the management of this branch because other branches of this restaurant are nothing like this. I have visited most of their locations, even in Taupo.

We have been dining at this restaurant for the last 30plus years - sometimes with years in between visits - today was the first time in at least 11 years and yet again did not let us down - food great - service friendly and great left with the contented feeling you get when you have had great food - just like you remembered - well done see you next visit

This used to the favourite go to when we were dating in the 90s. It has been a delight to come back today with our loved ones and surprised to meet everything still tasty and hearty like how we always remembered.
Such an amazing, welcoming restaurant! The managing family environment is exceptional! We went twice today it was so great. Well be back again next time we're in the area!

I have ordered from and dined at this place a few times, and while the food is generally decent, there is definitely room for improvement. The garlic bread could be softer and more enjoyable, and the cheesecakes, which were once excellent, seem to have recently lost some of their flavor. The customer service has the potential to be great with just a few adjustments. A warm and welcoming attitude from the staff, including the owner, could make a significant difference in creating a more enjoyable experience for customers. This place has so much potential to shine with a little extra care in both food preparation and customer interactions. With these tweaks, it could truly become a fantastic spot!

Amazing little dessert eatery for a Sunday afternoon treat for you and loved ones. Prices are decent and they really make amazing belgian waffles & coffee!! 😋 will definitely come back to try more options on the menu.

The waffles were ok. Presentation was a bit poor, especially the chocolate/banana waffles. You couldn't even see the bananas. You'll love it if you have a sweet tooth. It was waaaay too sweet for me. The toilet was disgusting. Men's toilet didn't have a seat, which was not hygienic and made it difficult for my son to use.

I went to Oko with my friend for the first time lastnight to get some dessert. I was very disappointed in the customer service I received from the lady who served us. She was unsure about what we were ordering and said she couldnt do waffles which we were confused about because it was on the menu. We asked for ice cream instead and it took her over 10mins just to serve 2 small bowls of ice cream. Another man came in part of the staff and we asked if theyre doing waffles he said yes we told him what the lady had told us that no they’re not doing it tonight. His excuse was she had just started working here. And? Whats that got to do with the fact she has no idea about serving customers or giving the wrong information about what we can and cant get. We then ordered 2 waffles and it took the guy over 20mins to do it they we were so close to leaving and getting a refund. He put too much ice cream on top of the waffles just way overdone. I do not recommend this place at all, terrible service.

Just want to say a big thank you to the staff that closed on the 23rd of May, Friday. I misplaced my bag and I called the closing staff that day I misplaced my bag and he was so patient on the phone and even looked through the camera footage to check that I in fact left the place with my bag. This person, sorry I forgot to get his name was so kind and patient and just the best customer service ever! Thank you! Even if I haven't found my bag yet just want to say thank you for trying and being super patient!

I have been to a few dessert places in the past already. I think the waffles here are the best of them all. We had the berry and the s'more waffles. The waffles are crispy and the s'more that I had was fluffy and was really good. However I think their drinks are below average compare to other places like house of chocolate. I had the 70% dark chocolate but it just doesnt feel right. The gimmicky aspect was nice but I think it is lacking in flavour. My partner's ice cream mocha was better but just average. Overall will try other waffles flavour but probably opt for just a plain coffee instead.

⭐️ 1/5 – Totally Misleading and Just Awful I ordered the 5 BBQ Tenders from Pizza Hut via Uber Eats and what I received looked nothing like what was advertised. The image shows glazed, juicy-looking tenders fully coated in BBQ sauce. In reality, what I got were pale, dry-looking strips with a few streaks of BBQ sauce lazily squeezed on top. The tenders themselves were undercooked and had a weird rubbery texture. They didn’t taste fresh at all and were honestly disgusting. It felt like no effort was put into preparing or presenting the meal. Whoever prepared this should look into a new occupation and feel absolutely ashamed! Extremely disappointing. Wouldn’t order again.
We ordered the limo pizza for a function. Really enjoyed the food, everything was fresh and packed nicely. Highly recommend for a big group of people. More than enough.

I recently purchased a pizza from pizza hut ( quey street), and it exceeded my expectations in every way. The pizza was incredibly delicious, with a perfect balance of flavors and a crust that was cooked to perfection. I really loved and enjoyed every bite, and the quality of the ingredients was evident throughout. I highly recommend pizza hut ( quey street )to anyone looking for a great pizza experience. The service was also excellent, making the overall experience even more enjoyable. I'm definitely looking forward to ordering from them.

If you're a pizza lover, this place is an absolute brilliant! We make a special effort to come here because the food is always delicious. No matter how many times we’ve been maybe 4 now, the quality and taste is the best. Highly recommend it!
I received Rocky Pizza not actual pizza. The manager said the Validation Code was sent to me by Pizza Hut is worth less. The codes usually aren't working. She hang off the call. Less than one star
Amazing for take aways and to buy fresh seafood to cook at home. We had snapper and chips and went back the following week to order it again, because it was just so good! Highly recommended!

Amazing service, very clean and tidy place with affordable prices. I got the fish of the day, kumara chips a spring roll and 2 mussels. Was cooked perfectly Highly recommend. Fish of the day was huge and the mussels were so tasty. My go to fish and chips spot from now on. Thanks guys
This is about as good as fish-n-chips can be. SO incredibly delicious, affordable, and the family that runs it is very kind. Support small business owners like this one!

A friendly, nice owner operated fish and chips shop. They were friendly, attentive, accommodating and patient. The fish is moist but the batter is really crunchy. Perfectly cooked fish and chips. The place is tucked away from the road, so make sure you pay attention on when to turn as this shop is a must try. Their lunch pack also come with a sausage.

Great service. Even took my order before their midday opening time. Well cooked and plenty to eat. Fish was delicious. Had the family pack $29 Punnet of sauce was an additional $2.50. Great value for an inner city fish and chip shop.

To experience the Japanese style of cooking food this way was absolutely rewarding. 4 of us had dinner served by the most friendly chef who was happy to explain and chat as he prepared our meal. The waitress was kind, friendly and very welcoming. The small restaurant was cosy and the decor was very well done to provide a Japanese setting. Thank you for being a wonderful host. We have lived here for years and yet this is the first time here. However, we will return for more of your hospitality.

We ordered Taste of all for 2. And added fried rice. Started refreshment with Salmon sashimi, Yum Yum Prawns, continues all tepan grill taste ( vegi, fish, Salmon, squid. Chicken, sirloin & eye steak, at last desert ! Rice, miso soup, green salad included, too. I am so happy to order this menu as I explored all taste and find out what taste like. Would help future visits. Yum yum prawns were so good, I will recommend choose prawns and squid each. We chose both squid but should each as my opinion. As Japanese point of view, I feel home and nostalgia Showa era. I love this place.

We returned last night to our favourite teppanyaki restaurant, and once again, it did not disappoint. Takeshi-san’s exceptional culinary skills remain consistent, with every meat and vegetable cooked to perfection. As always, we chose to sit at the counter, where we could fully appreciate the craftsmanship and attention to detail. Compliments from other diners were endless throughout the evening. We enjoyed the “Taste of All” menu, which I highly recommend. It offers a delightful sampling of Heizo’s signature dishes and concludes with an outstanding yuzu sorbet ice cream, the perfect finish to what was easily the most satisfying meal of the month.

We had an incredible experience at HEIZO Teppanyaki. Starting with the friendly service of the owner, chef, and his wife, they provided quality products and great conversation. We were privileged to be the only ones in the restaurant, so we received personalized attention and were able to chat and learn more about the chef and the history of the restaurant. Excellent food and experience, very traditional. Recommended!

Lovely traditional Japanese Teppanyaki. Whilst food won't be thrown at you like at Daikoku. But the quality certainly makes up for it. They have a number of options to suit most budgets. Highly recommend giving it a go. If you want you to have seating in front of the Teppanyaki grill, you will need to book ahead of time.
Lovely little shop with some delicious sushi and friendly staff. Great vibes here. Sushi was gluten free.
I wish they had options that didn't involve plastic, as all their products are pre-packed. But apart from that, it's excellent sushi.

While the staff working here is very friendly I would stay away from the raw fish selections unless it’s freshly made due to the fact that the cases are not refrigerated. Picked up a salmon/avo roll and it was definitely off. They should be refrigerating raw fish per NZ health codes.
Great fresh options all afternoon. Miso is awesome
lovely Local sushi place, fresh and yummy! great customer service as well.
Chips were way overcooked, fish was overcooked , had to ask for our drinks twice
lovely, great ambience and excellent food and service, highly recommend.

We visited here after seeing this on First Table. On entrance, it was very empty we were the only customers for the entire hour and a bit we were there. There were only two staff working, one looked like the manager and the other was the chef. The gentleman that served us was friendly and checked in on us during our meal and there was only about a 10min wait for our food. The ambience of the restaurant was unfortunately non existent. The decor was very confusing and lighting was very dim and created a gloomy uninviting environment. The water jug was quite dirty which put me off drinking the water or using the cups. The food however was actually quite decent. The waffles were delicious and fluffy despite the chicken pieces being very small. My fiances burger was flavoursome and big. Overall experience wasn’t bad but could definitely do with some interior improvements and maybe price review as some items on the menu were quite dear.

Accidentally purchased GrabOne voucher (paid $35 towards $60 food) so gave it a shot. The worst place ever. I am not sure if the owners are aware of how bad it is. Quantity is so low for the prices. Quality is just less than basic. Paid $25 for a chicken waffle l, finished it because the quantity was too less and I was hungry. Chicken chipotle bowl was disappointing, could finish only half. I still don’t know why I paid $10.5 for the baguette. I generally give my honest feedback after meal but there was no one at the counter and no one came to check in while we were served. I won’t be surprised if the place shuts down in a couple of months.

Good food, nice service, great location. Dine in with my family, we were in hurry but the owner was so nice to serve us fast. Kids loved the korean chicken and chips. We had a good quality time and food.

Had a very poor experience earlier this evening, and was motivated to leave a review to hopefully deter others. Food is outrageously expensive for what it is. Shamefully small portions of salad and chips accompanied a 3/4 chicken that I paid full price for (the staff member said he had only a 3/4 chicken left, but I presumed he was making up the full chicken with another portion as I had pre-paid for it in advance with the kiosk tablet). Still, it could have been worse. I could have been dining in. The double doors at the Parnell restaurant were open, meaning it was cold inside the restaurant. Ambience was frankly disappointing too, some Indian pop music was playing which was a trifle odd but harmless, but didn't help the restaurant overcome the overall feeling of being soulless and cold. Capitalism, being what it is, will probably ensure this restaurant goes under in due course. That could only be described as fair, because with the terrible portion sizes, lack of value for money, bad faith operations and soulless interior I can not think of a single reason why I would try this restaurant again. (Pictured is the 3/4 chicken I received as opened and untouched by my family, that I paid full price for)

Although excited to have an eatery in the vacant bar at the top Parnell, the food was just ok. Too small and average for the price. My 7yr old got the fried chicken meal which he enjoyed but my burger had too much sauce. Spending $52 ($26 each) on two ok meals means I won’t go back.

So happy to discover this wonderful place has reopened! And way more convenient to get too also. Service is top notch, attentive staff, food was great and loved that they had items made by their own fruit trees. I got to try the Thai Chili Pesto Chicken as recommended by the staff and it was tasty!

Tried this café for the third time and was pleasantly surprised! I ordered the green curry salmon and it was absolutely delicious — the salmon was perfectly cooked, tender and flaky, and the curry sauce was rich, creamy, and full of flavour with just the right kick. Portion size was generous and beautifully presented. The atmosphere of the café was warm and relaxed, with friendly service and great attention to detail. Would definitely come back again just for that dish alone. Highly recommend!

Just discovered the cutest little spot with amazing gluten-free food! Vivi and Vernon welcomed us with so much warmth and served incredible dishes made with ingredients they grew themselves. Totally recommend it !

I am so happy that I found this place that I can feel safe to eat without worrying about my gluten intolerance. My husband and I were so impressed the quality of their foods, everything we had was super delicious! You can feel their dedication and love in each dish. Thank you ♡
I was here about a week ago, it was amazing the couple who run it are so very sweet and welcoming. We had a nice conversation and the pancakes were awesome. Thanks you for a lovely breakfast

I had an absolutely fantastic experience at Ohmiya Japanese Cuisine! First of all, there are heaps parking spaces which is rare find in this location. The food was exceptional—fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. The staff were incredibly warm and attentive, making the dining experience even more enjoyable. The ambiance was cozy and authentic. I can’t wait to return and highly recommend Ohmiya to anyone craving top-notch Japanese cuisine!

This is hands down the most amazing authentic Japanese restaurant I’ve ever visited—chef’s kiss all the way. The service was warm and made us feel truly welcome, while every dish blew me away with its incredible flavor, freshness, and stunning presentation. There’s plenty of parking available here, which is such a plus. Definetely coming back soon！

The staff were exceptionally warm and welcoming.The vibe of the restaurant is traditional, with a cozy, Japanese atmosphere that transports you straight to Japan. As for the food, the Dragon Roll was a standout—fresh, flavorful, and expertly crafted. The Chicken Katsuwas crispy on the outside, tender on the inside, and absolutely delicious. Don’t miss out on their plum wine.
Love the vibe and the food. A warm and happy lunch with some friends here. Amazing view to see sky tower. The dark Cho cake is my go-to dish today 👍Love the Sukiyaki too.

Had dinner with friends on Friday—everything was super fresh and tasty. The vibe inside was great, and the Sky Tower view from the window was amazing. Highly recommend it, and I’ll definitely come back next time we hang out!

Everything was perfect. The food was hands down bar none the best I had in Auckland in my week’s visit. The food was incredibly balanced. The Lassi was a very refreshing beverage. The staff was so kind and welcoming and the ambience was relaxing and inviting. I highly recommend this place.

@flavourandcuisine Insta handle follow for more such review. Last week we dined at @3nutmegsnz — the service was warm and welcoming, which we truly appreciated. The overall flavour profile of the food leaned more towards the subtle and mild side. Here’s a quick rundown of what we tried and how it fared on our taste scale: 🥘 Curries (Paneer Saag, Kadhai Paneer, Prawn Butter Masala, Mix Veg, Malai kofta): 2/5 🫓 Breads (Garlic Naan, Laccha Parantha, Tandoori Roti): 3.5/5 🥟 Appetisers (Dumplings, Tamarind Mushrooms): 2.5/5 💧 Paani Poori: 4/5 . 🍨 Dessert (Cassata and pista kulfi) 1.5/5 Do note — this was based on our personal experience and preferences, and taste can vary for everyone!

We ordered the Lamb Rogan Josh and Bengali Fish. I personally liked the Lamb Rogan Josh — the flavor was rich and aromatic, though the lamb texture was slightly dry for me. My partner really enjoyed the Bengali Fish — flavorful and well-balanced. Both dishes went really well with the Garlic Cheese Naan — definitely a great combo! The environment was really comfy and felt high class, making the whole dining experience even more enjoyable. Definitely recommend to everyone! If you’re thinking of trying some Indian food, this place is a great choice.
We had such an wonderful evening here. The food was amazing and the service even better. The staff was so kind and friendly, would definitely come here again. Forgot to take any pictures :)

Had an amazing meal at 3 Nutmegs on a Monday night. Beautiful cozy spot with super tasty and fresh food! We were there for a birthday and they made a complementary dessert and little celebration too!! Would definitely recommend and will definitely be going back!

We recently gathered a party of twelve at Mazaj Café for farewell dinner, and from start to finish, the experience surpassed every expectation. The team thoughtfully prepared a set menu that felt like a culinary journey through Lebanon, Jordan, and Syria each dish bursting with authentic flavors. Their shawarma in particular was phenomenal: tender, perfectly spiced, and wrapped just as you’d find in the heart of Beirut or Amman. Beyond the incredible food, the hospitality was second to none. The staff greeted us warmly, anticipating every need and ensuring our glasses were never empty. They even surprised us with complimentary tea at the end of the meal a delightful, aromatic finish that showed genuine generosity. Throughout our evening, they accommodated dietary preferences and seating requests with a smile, making us feel like honored guests rather than just another reservation. Mazaj Café strikes the perfect balance between casual comfort and true Middle Eastern culinary craftsmanship. If you’re craving authentic shawarma that tastes as though it was flown in straight from Damascus, paired with welcoming service that treats you like family, look no further. We cannot recommend Mazaj Café highly enough!
Best shawarma in town, and hands down best Shisha! A highly recommended hidden spot in Parnell!
The best customer service ever the food was amazing so fresh and yummy best shawarma ever in nz I will come again and again best restaurant ever

We absolutely loved this little hidden gem in Parnell! Real middle eastern experience ! The kebab was so delicious with Jordanian flavours, amazing service and such fun music and atmosphere! 💃 We will definitely be back 👍

Share plate not quite as the one on the menu (no rice at all, all replaced with fries and not announced before), and salad was only one tipe, not a mix as on the photo. But mixed kebab was really nice and tasty.

We got recommended to The Beach Club through First Table and made a booking, but the system only allowed us to book for 4 people, even though we had 5 in total. So we called The Beach Club directly to inform them, as we wanted a table for 5. They were happy to accept the booking and let us know that with the First Table system, the fifth person would be charged at full price, which we completely understood. The food was absolutely delicious, and we loved the warm and cozy atmosphere inside the restaurant. The 50% discount on all the dishes we ordered was amazing—we’ve never had such a generous offer at other restaurants, where discounts usually apply to only the main courses or selected items. But here, everything was included—so go for it! We highly recommend The Beach Club. If you love oysters, though, we suggest not using the First Table system to book, as the discount doesn’t apply to oysters.
Family enjoyed a yummy lunch here. Really nice atmosphere. Good service. Can't go wrong really. Will go back again

We recently visited this restaurant with high hopes, but unfortunately, our experience fell a bit short of expectations. One issue we encountered was with the bacon we were served—it appeared noticeably burnt. When we raised our concern, the staff member assured us that it wasn’t burnt, which was a bit surprising given its appearance. They did bring out freshly cooked bacon upon request, and we appreciated the willingness to address the issue. That said, we’re still left wondering why the original serving was considered acceptable. In addition, we found that the overall flavour of the meal was somewhat lacking, which impacted our overall dining experience. While the service was polite and responsive, the quality and taste of the food leave us very hesitant to return.

We came here on a Saturday night and it was good. We got the fish with savory oats and the pork belly. The food was good though my food portion was quite a bit smaller than the pork belly my partner got which was huge and tasted good. I didn't get to try the oysters as that wasn't a part of First Table but ill be back here in the future.

The best creamy mushroom I've ever had! I’ve tried creamy mushrooms at so many cafes, but this one truly stands out as the best. The sauce was rich, creamy, and perfectly balanced :) P.S. The egg yolk in the photo isn’t part of the original dish—I added it as an extra. Totally worth it! 잘먹었습니다♡

Tried Hainan Chicken, fried spring roll and sweet and sour fried tofu. Authentic Malaysian Cuisine. Exceed my expectations. Large portions compared to the price. High recommended! A beautiful view during sunset. Take your best seat before it's too late.😁
Amazing food and great service! The flavours were authentic and bold—especially loved the Ba Gu De and curry fish head. Cozy spot with a welcoming vibe. Can’t wait to come back again!
The food is excellent, very authentic Malaysian food!!! Every dish has its own unique flavour. The boss and his wife are also awesome people!!! Would come again for sure!

I never a lover of a Laksa, but did fall in love with this one from this shop, very fresh soup and seafood I could taste it is make from love at least passion probably hahaha. Highly recommend the Laksa noodles and I like how they listen that we said spicy hot!! 😻
With its elegant setting, impeccable service, extensive selection of delicious and authentic dishes, and affordable prices, this restaurant provides an outstanding dining experience.

One of the best Seafood Chowders I've ever had, worth every cent $19.90. Was nice n quiet, I was a bit apprehensive to begin with. But with such a vast selection of venues, i wasn't too worried. Took me 19 years to call in here, I'll definitely be back😋😋😋.

I have no words for this place as nothing will describe how much me and my husband love it. The food is to die for and I have tried everything on the menu lol. Not even joking as we go their every Saturday around 2 and our table is all set up for us in our one and only seat that we have. And the service is Fantastic. Can't wait for tomorrow .

Overall, pasta tasted good. We asked for abit more cheese as our pasta didn’t have enough cheese on it - as seen in the 5th photo, size reference - we got charged $3.50! First time ever being charged for extra cheese anywhere! This was abit of a let down. They do a 15% surcharge on public holidays! These two dishes with redbul and cheese costed us around $81 in total. Don’t think I will return as overpriced and just lacking that Italian vibe!
One of the best restaurants. Went around 1pm on a weekday. Food was excellent. 💯 Service was so professional. Very clean and tidy. Nothing but high praise for this place. 🙌

10/10 absolutely blown away clean today no dust anywhere . Nice clean tables (not sticky like most) the service is just out of this world made me smile made me laugh warming welcoming. Suggestive. Not to mention the food was just incredible every single dish was perfect !!!! I took some photos just irresistible
