One of the best woodfire pizzas we’ve ever had! We are a group from Singapore travelling from Auckland to Christchurch. Stopover in this town for 2 days and chanced upon this restaurant for dinner. Really love the food and the owners are very friendly. We had Hawaiian, Margherita and Marinara. All were delicious! Took the photo after almost finishing the food 😂

My partner Ivan and I have been getting takeaway meals from here for years. Pasta or pizza, always yummy, and perfect to enjoy watching the sun set on the beach. In reference to the review from the person thinking he was ignored because he's Maori... my partner's Maori and the owner treats him like a mate. Always friendly, always welcoming. It's our favourite little Italian *watch the sun set takeaways night*.
One of the best Italian restaurants around! Tasty pasta and especially delicious deserts. Highly recommended!

I think the "most Italian" place you will be able to find in East Auckland. Very close to the beach, low-key simple (exactly how Italian suppose to be) honest good restaurant. Portions are big, we all couldn't even finish our meals. Prices very reasonable for the location. Great wine. Better to make a booking.

First time at Mamma Rosa and it definitely won’t be the last! Cosy atmosphere, warm service, and absolutely delicious food. Everything felt homely and full of flavour. A perfect spot for a relaxed night out — will definitely be coming back!
In my opinion best pizzas you can get in NZ. The Kohi branch is so reliable, the quality is always flawless and the staff keep up well with the demand. Love this place

Terrible experience were ordered delivery with Hells Pizza Kohimarama to lrave at front door. The delivery person came and was pounding aggressively on my front door and I heard it at back of house through many closed doors. This frightened my dog who was then upset and barking. I asked who are you with through the locked door and he wouldn’t say and then I asked what’s your name as there have been cases of people coming to my door. He said none of your business and I said I can’t open the door then and he ok then and dropped the food down. I complained to the store and they gave me a $15 voucher. Next day I see the front door has been damaged and complained and they said not their responsibility. Won’t be using the voucher nor will I ever buy from Hell’s again.

Pizza was great. Pizza is always great! It’s pretty hard to do bad pizza. The salads….. Everyone’s doing salads, and for those trying to lo-carb it, that’s a good thing. Subway do bunless, salad options, Pita Pit OBVIOUSLY, but then someone said “Did u know Hell do salads?”. So we gave it a go. Pretty lack lustre. They really just stock some sushi styled plastic containers, to which they throw in woteva options you choose. So it means you get a layer of rocket, a layer of coleslaw-ish stuff, a couple of Olives, and 11 small bits of chicken. And here’s the problem: we specifically asked for EXTRA chicken, to boost the protein. Mate, if that’s extra chicken, she must be a dwarf chicken! That was a pathetic amount of chicken, even for a standard serve. Nevermind. Done it. Tried it. Will we try it again- probably not

Kush Gupta is the most amazing employee that I have ever seen. His kind manners and efficiency with his work were just superb. I will definitely come again thanks to his kind words and spectacular service.

Had probs in the past with pick up orders being incorrect. Told daughter 5 pizzas... She asked them to check order, & was told all good. 30/11 - We got 5 pizzas but 1 was not correct. I emailed that night, filled out a problem ticket in the feedback form, 3 more emails + phone call. Crickets! I'm not letting it go I want a refund. Premium pizzas aren't cheap so I'm keen for my $28.50 back. Check your own order!!

The pear French toast was incredible! And the views, aesthetics, staff and atmosphere were amazing. Such a great spot for a walk in Auckland. They catered for dietaries and intolerances. Highly recommend. @kirbystaltari

The Asian lady in the cashier and the barista was rude on 21 Jun Saturday 25. Was taking my parents from overseas to enjoy this coffee shop and had a really bad experience from these 2 ladies. Never coming back. There are plenty of coffee shops with friendly staff, definitely don’t need this experience. The only person was kind was the the ice cream lady
The chicken and the lamb were so tender and well cooked. We also loved the ceviche. Lovely atmosphere, just off the beach, and great service.

Stopped by for brunch one rainy Sunday as it is a dog-friendly cafe and both staff and customers were happy to side-step to accommodate my daughter’s dog. We were well sheltered and they had several heaters to keep us nice and toasty. Food and service are EXCELLENT. Will be happy to return.

Kohi Beach Eatery – A Delightful Beachside Treat Stopped by Kohi Beach Eatery for a relaxing treat and enjoyed every moment! With a stunning view of the beach, this spot offers the perfect setting to unwind. I ordered a matcha latte and a gluten-free muffin, both of which were absolutely delicious. The matcha was smooth and well-balanced, while the muffin was moist and flavorful—a great gluten-free option! One of the highlights here is the wide variety of ice creams, making it a great place for a sweet indulgence. The staff were friendly and welcoming, adding to the warm atmosphere. Whether you're after a refreshing drink, a tasty treat, or just a place to soak in the beach vibes, Kohi Beach Eatery is a fantastic choice! Will definitely be back. Maria Chueva . Meadowbank . Founder of Avacontents.com Video content for local businesses.

Friday night dinner, small dining area but not busy at all. Food came out relatively quickly. Liver appetizer was cooked perfectly with lovely onions bacon and sherry sauce. Volcano pizza and chicken and mushroom fettuccine, portion size for pasta was decent! Super creamy though but still ate it all. Pizza was large size, but put in whole olive with pit, which is probs only negative. Good crust on Pizza. Would come again

Perfectly good place. Small but nice, service was good. 3 of us had their specials, which isn't on the menu. I had the Penne Blue cheese, didn't taste the blue cheese, and tasted like a normal bacon carbonara. My partner loved the Fegatini spaghetti - it was really good. Our two friends enjoyed their meals as well. Will we go back? Sure... although there's some other italian restaurants we'll try out first.

Not recommended at all! The owner is super rude and has no respect for families with kids. The ambiance is very poor and food not that great. We had a very bitter experience with this place and realised that not many people visit here as we were the only one during peak lunch time.

$25~30/person The seafood chowder was a bit more watery and runny than I am used to but they were generous with the seafood and it was quite yummy. Unfortunately the salmon pizza was far too salty and we were unable to finish it. The first slice is nice but your lips start pruning from the salt soon afterwards The feta and capers were spread unevenly so some bits had 2-3 capers and a large chunks of feta and smoked salmon whereas some bites had only the salty cheesy base. It made eating the pizza a bit of a russian roulette, so I think a more even distribution would have made it very nice. Service was very friendly and the atmosphere was cozy and warm. The restaurant is quite cramped so people with mobility aids such as wheelchairs or canes may struggle with getting around.

The food at Toninos is always above expectation. The restaurant itself had a cozy and inviting atmosphere, and the staff were very friendly and helpful. I appreciated the attention to detail and the overall quality of the food. I'd highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great pizza experience!

It's been a year since I've been in New Zealand! I've tried different types of burgers at different stores, but this shop is something else. Not only was their food great, all the employees were very friendly and joyful. My friends and I had a long chat with them (it's basically my hobby to talk with different people). Awesome taste with an absolutely welcoming environment. Highly recommend this place; try their burgers and other items as well!
Team here are awesome. Only reason for the 4 star is the chips are never filled up. Always missing a few, I don’t mean to be picky but cmon corporate people let them eat chips!
Great tasting food, and very fresh, our Barbados tourist enjoyed it too. :)

Right across from Mission Bay. Great choices of flavorful burgers. Has seating inside for about 7 parties of 2 and the 4 larger tables that are inside and outside. No pic of food as it was devoured before I thought to take them.
Right across from a large beachy area at Mission Bay Park. Similar to Canada's 5 Guys Burgers, fresh meat, large burgers, hefty price. Tried a shake and would eat here again if visiting NZ.

Fresh and Delicious fish. I was lucky to be there when there wasn’t a queue. Owners were so friendly and welcoming, they took time to explain the types of fish available that day. I ordered two portions of orange roughy deep fried in crumbs, absolutely delicious. Will definitely visit when I’m back.

I recommend this place ! Best Fish and Chips in Auckland in my opinion. We always get take out and eat on the beach since it’s just next to it. We always take the snapper. We usually take our own sauces and drinks but there is everything available in the store. It’s great cause you can also buy your own fish filet.
The fish is generous size and tastes very fresh from here (snapper). Chips are tasty and above average, too. Staff are friendly, thank you

A long waiting queue was already there when I first got there From the outside looking in, the locals had already placed phone orders in advance to avoid any waiting time But definitely was well worth waiting in line for 30mins on my 1st visit 🤙 Friendly/kind staffs 👍 Very flavourful and really well deep fried battered/crumbed fish, oyster and scallop which of these all were off the charts
Snapper & Chips. Satisfied my craving perfectly 👌 Fresh & delicious

Happy to have found this authentic German restaurant, just a stone’s throw from the beautiful Kohimarama Beach. The menu offers a great selection at reasonable prices including kids menu, and the portions are generous—both my husband and I could only finish half of our dishes! Lovely decorations, nice indoor and outdoor seating, friendly service, and convenient parking available at the rear or on the street. We’ll definitely be back to try more dishes!

Wow, what a night. We went for a birthday dinner . The atmosphere was great, the food was exceptional, with huge portions, the service was excellent. We wanted for nothing. We'd certainly go back to Der Metz. Highly recommend
Reasonable price range. Authentic feel and atmosphere. Large portions if you order schnitzel dishes. Order double and take home some left over or share the dish. Great german beer served.

Der Metz feels like a little slice of Germany. The decor here invokes a humble, cozy abode, and the service is very good as well. In terms of the food, the portions are absolutely huge and are very tasty. The desserts were equally as large, and very filling. Finally, there is a great selection of beers to choose from. I’m personally a fan of Hofbräu.

Fabulous food, enormous portions !!! Fabulous service from the loveliest German girl who just made the whole experience with her friendly service. Would come back here in a heartbeat, our whole family enjoyed it.

This is a restaurant I’ve loved for many years. Every time I feel like having a beer and mussels, this is the first place that comes to mind. The tap beer is my favorite, and the mussels are always fresh and delicious. I had a great time on Mother’s day here again. Highly recommended!

Horrible service today . I arrived with my two young daughters ages 4&5 with 2 little cheeseburgers each from an outside store . I myself planned to order a decent meal and drinks from this restaurant myself and was told to put my daughter’s food away or leave . Even though I had just ordered food from the restaurant. I understand having a no outside food policy . But to be so strict against 2 little girls with cheese burgers well the mother was about to spend big $$ herself on your food is insane .no empathy for my girls or myself who was alone with them , read the room buddy. Absolute idiots . Will never come back that’s for sure . Went right next door to Bodrum Kitchen and had the best experience and food , they were nothing but understanding and accepting of my two girls and gladly took us. Highly recommend. Rules are rules but being a decent human is better lol - Photo is my yummy pasta from Bodrum Kitchen Mission Bay. :)

The atmosphere was great ! Beer was great as well. Crisp and fresh taste of the Panhead charger !! You have to try this ! The only disappointment was the mussels - the mussels were very old and barely no meat left in the shell. Hopefully this is sorted soon by the executive team. Despite this, overall I will give it a 4 star experience!

I visited this restaurant yesterday (02/08/25), thinking it would be a lovely spot to enjoy lunch and the beautiful sunny weather. We ordered food and beers — I chose a Steinlager Classic and my friend had a Corona. When the drinks arrived, I poured mine into a glass and immediately noticed it was not cold at all. I politely approached the bar to ask for a replacement. The bartender, wearing a pink shirt, was rude from the outset. She insisted the beer had been stored in the fridge, to which I replied it likely hadn’t been there long enough to chill properly. Her attitude was confrontational, sarcastic, and unprofessional throughout the entire interaction. At no point was she courteous or empathetic. She eventually said she could offer a replacement — but only if I paid for the original warm beer. Despite my polite tone, I had to raise my voice to defend myself from her aggressive behavior. It was my first visit to this restaurant, and sadly, it will also be my last. Based on this experience, I would advise others to be cautious when ordering, as their response to customer concerns is deeply disappointing. Some people simply shouldn’t be in customer-facing roles — and she is one of them.

Great spot for a meal- eclectic pink exterior, beachy interior. Was a little breezy for the upstairs outdoor seating but the birds wander in like they own it connecting you to nature! Great food, excellent drinks.
Pizzas were great, crusts were nice and thin, good size. Toppings were good quality. Fries were insanely over-salted, to the point of being inedible.

Super friendly staff, every time I visit. They treat kids like VIPs. Feels very family-oriented. We have always received a nice, balanced amount of salt and garlic topping which even the children enjoy, and the pizza flavour combos are fun and delicious. If I asked for extra olives or something special for the kids, they will always give me the courtesy in a friendly way. This place is worth supporting local!

Best pizza in town! I love the Frango and the banana with caramel (if you're not Brazilian, you just need to trust me on this one and I promise you won't regret!). Try the guarana drink as well for the full experience.

Sorry for the photo of the half eaten pizzas but we were hungry! Very impressed by the pizzas we ordered, The Prosciutto and The Delhi Chicken. Great tasting classic pizzas. All 5 eaters were very happy.

Amazing pizza and above and beyond services as well. My husband has a shellfish allergy and they went above and beyond to make sure he won’t get affected by cross contamination. We’ve been twice already and will definitely be back again.
Good portion food and yummy. Hot choc wasn't overly sweet so that was good. Eggs Benedict and potato rosti version were equally good. Salmon was smoked nicely. Reasonable brunch place.

There was a huge fly in the cabinet where the staff tried to shoo it after us advising them of this. Took him a while to get rid of it so was already off putting being here. We had no choice but to order from the menu as we were not eating cabinet food. Ordered the big breakfast and the potato hash with salmon. Although the hash with salmon was not too bad besides the egg being over cooked and potato tasting old.. The big breakfast was not so big. The sausages tasted like pre cooked sausages, onion rings were a first with breakfast and did not go, mushrooms were burnt and bread was way too hard. We did see the reviews and were hoping for a different experience, however, experience was the same as others. Toilets available on site. We will not return and possibly prevented us from going to another coffee club. We will stick with other smaller cafes which do not disappoint.

I stopped by The Coffee Club in Mission Bay and was really impressed. The location is unbeatable—right across from the beach with a beautiful view and a relaxed, welcoming vibe. The staff were friendly and attentive, and the food came out quickly despite it being quite busy. I had the eggs benedict and a flat white—both were spot on. The coffee was smooth and strong, just the way I like it. It’s also a great place to catch up with friends or just sit and enjoy the atmosphere. Definitely recommend if you’re in the area and craving good coffee and brunch with a view!
Great spot by the beach! Coffee and Tacos was perfect, and the staff were super friendly. Loved the outdoor seating

We were supposed to go to the restaurant next door for my birthday dinner with my family when my 7-y.o. daughter saw the big picture of burger and fries outside Coffee Club and immediately said, "Daddy, I want that!" Good thing our sudden change of plans did not disappoint us! Service was superb. The server (sorry, I forgot his name) was very friendly and accommodating to us, making sure we were comfortable from the moment we were seated until our orders arrived. The food was superb! It might be that servings were quite big or we just have small appetites so we took away our leftovers to finish at home. Their coffee and other drinks were a perfect way to finish the meal. I would not hesitate to go back to Coffee Club when I'm in the area!

Have been visiting for years and the coffee is always excellent and the staff are so lovely and friendly. Recently diagnosed coeliac and would love to see more GF options as it's very, very limited currently and I miss being able to enjoy some of the cabinet food too!

Well, well, well, after reading the rave reviews online, we thought we’d drop by while out running errands - what a disappointment. Despite reading a review about “the world’s greatest Lamingtons”, they indeed proved to be “elusive”! The server not only professed to never having heard of a Lamington but also needed to be told they were a cake! When this had been cleared up, she informed us that they needed to be ordered in advance…I think we’ll pass. When the coffee arrived, it was pretty decent, but I prefer my coffee to start off hot - this was decidedly lukewarm. All in all, the experience, coffee and staff were, like the coffee, lukewarm and, like the Lamingtons, we’ll be conspicuous by our absence at this particular coffee shop.

ordered a large frozen lemon soufflé for our christmas dessert and my whole family was absolutely blown away! incredible with some fresh raspberries and cream 🤤 for a special occasion, I cannot recommend enough!

Off the main road, this feels like a hidden gem. Ulliana and Andreza go out of their way to make you feel welcome. The coffee is consistently good and reasonably priced and there's always feel good tunes playing. And that peanut butter fudge!
We had the most delicious meal tonight from Forbes Kohimarama. So inexpensive for two people. Ample serves. We will be back whilst visiting from Australia.

Perhaps not the best subway but definitely one of the better subways around. It is nice to see that they are now using decomposable bowls for their salads. They also pay attention to the small details, which make a big difference. Tomatoes are flavourful and ripe, cucumber is crunchy and thinly sliced, and their iceberg lettuce is firm and fresh. One thing I would prefer is for them to pack their salads in a bit more generously so it’s not so airy inside - especially for a 'large' serving. Sandwiches are great and perfectly toasted, doused with a good amount of sauce.

Great subway!! Ladies were very efficient and super lovely. The location is a bit small but that doesn’t matter as you have the whole beach to sit at. This store is also great as it’s connected to a dairy/juice bar.
Nice and fresh burgers. The timing have now changed to 8.30. Start. They do have small mini shop to buy chocolates or other snacks you want.
This is my favorite subway store. They’re always consistently good with their sandwiches. You can count on hem to always serve you fresh food :)
This would be one of my favourite subway stores as the food is constantly fresh ,Staff are friendly and great customer service always and nice outdoor seating over looking Mission Bay ! Big thumbs up

Had a fantastic brunch here while visiting Mission Bay! The food was excellent—fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. The cocktails were just as impressive, perfectly crafted and refreshing. The atmosphere was relaxed and inviting, and the service was absolutely top-notch—friendly, attentive, and welcoming. If you're in Mission Bay, this is definitely a must-visit. Can't wait to come back! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Absolutely stunning food. Service is great too, the young team do a remarkable job. The place is always bustling and they are very attentive and work fast. The female shift supervisor or manager (I presume) could do with less berating and pointing at staff and more hustling tables herself, like the waitresses.

Great location for brunch and a stroll along the Mission Bay beach ⛱️ The restaurant is right next to the road through and lots of cars are passing through this road so it was quite noisy if you want to sit outside. The menu offers wide selection 😋 The shared platters are really nice if you are here with your friends or on a date 💕
Great location in heart of mission bay. Was very popular. Staff friendly and attentive. Chicken kebabs had a good variety of things. Fish was way overcooked. Tartare sauce was delicious.
went there recently and had a really good time! the portions are worth every $$, plenty of seating and the service was very fast and friendly :)

We had an absolutely lovely and delicious dinner! We were seated promptly, our food delivered fairly quick, and the portion sizes were perfect, if not a little big. I ordered the Louisiana chicken burger and it was fantastic. Hubby ordered chicken tenders, mac n cheese, and loaded fries. We washed it all down with thick shakes. Could not be happier and will absolutely visit again next time we're in New Zealand!

My friend's and I decided to come here (for the first time) for a late lunch. We were somewhat in the area and it was also raining. I ordered the Biscoff shake, fries with cheese and gravy and fried chicken with blue cheese sauce. Total came to NZD50.50c so don't expect diner pricing. I wouldn't order the cheese and gravy fries again - the gravy and fries were fine but the cheese because it wasn't a curd style cheese once it goes cold it becomes rock hard. The fried chicken did have good flavour but the pieces needed to be consistent in size so cut into strips which would make them easier to eat without cutlery. The sauce was good. Liked my shake (NZD12.50c) and the décor of the diner was interesting. Good customer service and location.

Ate here with our 3 kids and our friends who have 1 child. The owner was extremely helpful and friendly. Menu is extensive so easy to find something for everyone to eat. It came out fast. Their standard cheeseburger was really tasty and at $18 good value. Their curly fries, milkshakes, fried chicken and waffles were really good. The chicken burger was nice but felt it needed some pickles in it to give it a bit more taste as was a little bland. Food don’t take long and everyone was happy. Would definitely return 😊

OMG.....went to the Bald Eagle for a Sunday lunch; I absolutely LOVED this place! Pure sensory overload from the moment your foot crosses the door. Walls completely covered with retro Americana, jukebox smashing out American rock n roll tunes....then there's the food. I ordered a traditional hotdogs with standard fixings, a basket of fries and an espresso milkshake. The hotdogs was a satisfyingly cheese and sauce drenched and very tasty. Fries with aioli and ketchup were demolished in quick succession... But both pale in comparison to the absolute decadent symphony that was the espresso milkshake....not sickly sweet, good scoops of ice cream inside it and plenty of whipped cream. I loved it. Service was extremely good and cannot be faulted. I cant wait to go back there, my beady little eyes already fixated on the southern fried chicken waffles because I'm not shy....and will I care if I need a forklift to remove me from my seat next time? Absolutely not.

Bald Eagle Diner at Mission Bay, New Zealand, is a fantastic spot for a casual meal with great value. The food is reasonably priced, offering generous portions that ensure you get your money’s worth. With a variety of options on the menu, there's something for everyone, from classic diner fare to local favorites. The food itself is delicious, with fresh ingredients and bold flavors that never disappoint. The diner’s warm and welcoming ambiance complements the hearty meals, and the hospitable Filipino staff add a personal touch to the experience, making you feel right at home. Perfect for a relaxed meal by the bay!
Nice place in MB to enjoy Sal's Pizza. We even ordered ice cream ☺️. It would be nicer if they have another brand of sodas...

Sal’s is hands down the best spot in Mission Bay if you're into real New York-style pizza. The slices are big, foldable, and super satisfying—just how they should be. The crust has that perfect mix of crunch and chew, and the toppings are always fresh and loaded. The vibe is chill, the staff are cool, and it’s an easy place to stop by whether you're grabbing a quick slice or hanging out with friends. Definitely try the pepperoni or white garlic slice—they hit the spot. Oh, and the garlic knots? Crazy good. Go here. Eat pizza. Be happy.
The pizza is amazing and the delivery was very fast. Thank you

The pizzas are not that great for the price in my opinion. The store is clean, well maintained and presented. Staff members are kind, welcoming, friendly and helpful which makes their customer service good. I was recently offered a full size large pizza for half the price as the store was almost closing late at night and there were two lovely guys to help out.
Pizza was amazing! 🥰 The staff was super friendly.

Saw the Mamma Mia specials outside and planned to dine in here with my friends. Turned out to be an amazing experience and extra amazing food. Highly recommend the Warm beef salad, Snapper fish and Lasagna. Staff is super friendly and goes extra mile to celebrate any special occasion. Will visit soon again with my family.

Delicious food and great service! They happily adjusted the dishes to our taste. Loved it! It’s not always easy to find a place that’s both flexible and consistent in quality, but Mama Mia delivered on both fronts.

Beautiful and classy location. The restaurant environment was superb. Gave an Italian accent to the outlook of the interior. Had soft music playing on the background, which allowed us to talk to each other privately without screaming. Lol. Staff were super! Professional, respectful, courteous, and gave attention to detail in our preferences and choices of our selective meals. The food was superb, garlic bread shaped as a pizza was scrumptiousand tasty. Pizza was great too. Mussels were a favorite! The door was opened for us upon entering and exiting as well... felt like royalty. Thank you so much to the hard-working staff (counter, servers, and most importantly, the chef). Kudos to the team for going above and beyond with their exceptional service. We did spend a bit on the entire meal, however, we don't mind spending at a place such as Mama Mia at Tamaki Drive. Highly recommend! Would give a 10/10 for service, food, and environment.

Mamma Mia in Mission Bay is an absolute gem! My family and I enjoyed one of the best dining experiences here. It truly felt like a treat and a celebration. The pizza was perfectly cooked with rich flavors, the steak was tender and full of taste, and the oysters and seafood platter were the freshest we've ever had. The quality of the food was outstanding, and the prices were surprisingly reasonable for such a high standard. If you're in Mission Bay, this place is a must-visit for an authentic and memorable Italian meal

Had a wonderful dining experience here. The service was excellent—friendly, attentive, and welcoming. The staff gave great recommendations, and I absolutely loved what they suggested. The food was delicious, fresh, and full of authentic Italian flavors. Definitely a place I’d return to and highly recommend to others!

Enjoyed our breakfast. The bacon and eggs where great although they didnt have baked beans. The pancakes where abit thin, almost like crepes. Coffee tasted a little weak but we still enjoyed it. Great customer service and lots of parking.

Quiet little coffee shop with yummy breakfast food and sandwiches. We had French toast with banana and the apple crepe! Also enjoyed the flat white and a berry banana smoothie with a carrot cake to go!

What a great little cafe I visited today as Ziggy the dog and I walked past on the morning stroll. The cafe gets all the morning sun and is a great spot to enjoy your flat white outside. I opted for a bacon and egg muffin that the lovely owner heated up, the coffee was fantastic as well, highly recommend! James Ashwin Kakapo Business Sales

Nice little cafe near Madills Farm and not too far from Kohimarama Beach. Seems to be popular with locals and has a great set up for dogs both in the side and the front. I would avoid the scrambled eggs but the cabinet food is great. 😊
Great place for breakfast I tried the ham and cheese pastry. Very tasty! My friends tried a crepe and Bevan fritata they both ate every bite

Dining at Jewel of India was a wonderful experience that combined authentic Indian flavors with warm hospitality. The ambiance was elegant and welcoming, featuring traditional Indian decor that created a cozy and cultural atmosphere. The menu offered an excellent variety of dishes, from flavorful curries to aromatic rice dishes and freshly made naan. I especially enjoyed the chicken korma, and the fish madras was the best dish I have ever tried—both were rich in flavor and cooked to perfection. The spices were well-balanced, and the presentation of each dish was appealing. The staff were attentive, friendly, and happy to explain menu items or recommend dishes based on our preferences. Service was prompt, and the overall environment was calm and relaxing. I left feeling satisfied and impressed with both the food and service. Jewel of India truly lives up to its name—it's a gem for anyone who enjoys authentic Indian cuisine. I would definitely return and recommend it to others.

We absolutely love our local Indian restaurant! It’s a warm, family-friendly spot with a clean, relaxed atmosphere that makes you feel right at home. The service is always excellent—staff are incredibly friendly, attentive, and go out of their way to make sure you have a great experience. The food is consistently delicious, full of flavour, and very well priced. It’s no surprise that it’s quickly become one of our family’s favourite places to eat. Highly recommend!

Absolutely delicious! This place has quickly become my go-to spot. The flavors are authentic, the portions are generous, and everything is always freshly made. The butter chicken is rich and creamy, the naan is soft and perfectly charred, and the samosas are packed with flavor. Staff are friendly and the service is always prompt. Highly recommend to anyone craving top-quality Indian food!

Absolutely Fantastic! JEWEL OF INDIA, MISSION BAY is hands down the best Indian restaurant in AUCKLAND! The food is authentic, flavorful, and perfectly cooked—definitely some of the finest Indian cuisine in New Zealand. Their premium selection of dishes is impressive, and every bite is a delight. A special mention to CHETAVEER the fabulous host, who made our experience even better with warm hospitality and top-notch service. The staff is friendly, attentive, and makes you feel truly welcome. If you’re in AUCKLAND, this place is a must-visit! Highly recommend it to anyone looking for delicious Indian food and an excellent dining experience.

The decor is lovely, featuring beautiful paintings, and both the food and service are excellent. However, the ladies' room could use some refurbishment. We enjoyed the masala chai, chole bhature, and samosa chaat, all of which tasted fresh and delicious.

One of the best restaurants I've eaten in my life period. It was simply amazing! Thank you so much for the experience. I got the wonton in chicken soup and dan dan noodles in spicy soup (medium spice with added shredded chicken and wide noodles)

Eden Noodles in Mission Bay exceeded all expectations, amazing food and such a good addition to the Eatery at Eastridge. Order it mild if you don’t like it nice and spicy, highly recommend! James Ashwin Kakapo Business Sales

I'm not one to usually complain, but I have to say that the dishes we ordered for pick-up were a bit off. Three of us ended up feeling a bit uncomfortable until the next day and we also realised the order was wrong. Gotta hand it to them, they were pretty busy.

I arrived at the restaurant 15 minutes before closing and tried to place an order, but a guy acted like I was a bother just for being there. He seemed impatient to close up, even though there was another customer besides me, so it wasn’t like I was the only thing keeping them from closing. In the end, I decided to leave without ordering to let them finish their closing tasks. I hope they were happy to lose a customer.
We ordered 2 of the popular noodle dishes, after a few bites there was a terrible after taste, something was clearly wrong with the dishes, was very unwell the next day! I would steer clear

Ordered the “Vibrant Shoyu Beef” salad as a takeaway tonight. Menu promised it would come with kale, edamame, radish, shallots. Couldn’t find any of these ingredients unfortunately even after some digging (see photos). And it definitely wasn’t “vibrant”. The beef had a decent flavour but the salad looked and tasted more like a supermarket coleslaw pack. Feeling a bit ripped off after spending $18.80 on this, but maybe that’s my punishment for not ordering a burger at Burger Burger… my partners fish burger looked much better!

Unfortunately even though the food is great their ability to clean the tables (used plates etc sat on tables for over an hour) and make the environment welcoming is dismal. The staff are slacking and have no sense of pride in the brand.

I recently visited Burger Burger at East Ridge, and it was a fantastic experience. The burgers were made to perfection—juicy, tender patties packed with flavor, fresh ingredients, and just the right balance of sauces. The head chef clearly knows what they’re doing, ensuring each bite is just as good as the last. The atmosphere was great, and the service was friendly and efficient. Definitely one of the best burger spots in the area!

My favorite branch so far. Always loved the fish tacos, potato skins, and vanilla milkshake combo! The chefs are generous with their servings and the atmosphere is great. Shout out to the team for the outstanding service!

This really seemed to lack (the normally amazing) look and feel of most burger burger sites, but the food was still fantastic. Our burgers were ready in just over 10mins from ordering, big fan of the McFly burger.

The Eatery at Eastridge is a lively dining spot with a great mix of cuisines. The atmosphere is modern and relaxed, perfect for casual dining. There's something for everyone – from tasty Greek wraps to crispy Korean fried chicken. The variety is impressive, and the food quality is top-notch. Parking is easy, and the space feels welcoming. It's definitely worth a visit for a laid-back meal with friends or family.

What a fantastic eatery, so much choice, all the staff were lovely, had ana amazing salad from the Greek place, with huge amounts of the most tasty and crispy Halumi, YUM! Will definitely be making this a regular lunch stop.

Went to the Eatery at Eastridge shopping centre. The place itself has a pub feel about it with dark wooden interior and an outdoor area that looks on to the carpark. You order at the bar, the staff is friendly, and the food is surprisingly good for a pub meal. We had fish tacos and curly fries, and loved it. Will definitely come back.

The Eatery is a collection of food stalls located within an area similar to a food court. Each place have their dedicated space but there is also a main indoor and outdoor dining area which is shared. It can be an interesting place to grab dinner due to the variety of places here.
Wat tar ho and lamb Briyani are most delicious. Great service and great food, once again.

Been here two times and the food alway cheer me up after long day work!!! Food has the magic! Service is also great cos they always serve you water as soon as you get seated. Today I tried the spicy salmon temakeria and it’s another surprise! Cos it’s every texture of the rice roll mixed so excellently well! Great balance in your mouth!!!! Chicken curry…pls next time give me one more piece of chicken 😂
Fast becoming a fav place for lunch/dinner, very good fresh food cooked to perfection 👌
Beautifully designed space—warm and inviting. The bibimbap was fresh, flavourful, and beautifully presented. Exceptional food and great vibes. Can’t wait to come back!

Loved this place. Food is so tasty. The owner is super friendly and welcoming. I was over visiting New Zealand and he was made sure I had a great meal. Fantastic service and again the food is delicious. Located at East Ridge Eatery which allows groups to choose from different restaurants but still sit together.

First time to the new showcase of pop ups at Eastridge. TEMAKERIA for dinner delights tonight. I had a couple of starters - the Tofu and Crab Shack cones, however i know to turn up with a empty stomach in future - i just wanted to taste it all. Great atmosphere and really nice and welcoming staff. You leave with a big smile 😀

Absolutely loved my experience at Zero Greek Kitchen! The food was incredibly fresh, flavorful, and authentic — every bite tasted like it came straight from Greece. The atmosphere is cozy and welcoming, and the staff are friendly, attentive, and always smiling. I tried the souvlaki and the Greek salad, and both were simply amazing. Definitely one of the best Greek food spots in town. Highly recommend it to anyone looking for delicious, high-quality Mediterranean cuisine. I’ll definitely be coming back!

the best spots for Greek food in Auckland. The flavors are bold, fresh, and truly authentic — you can tell they use high-quality ingredients. I tried the Hades wrap and it was packed with perfectly seasoned meat, and that house-made aioli Absolutely addictive. Service was fast and friendly, even during the lunch rush. The space is clean and modern, with a welcoming Prices are fair for the quality and portion size. I’ll definitely be back — already craving it again!

The staff were very kind. There were so many types of salads and dips that I wanted to order them all. The nutritional balance of the salads was perfect, and the presentation was beautiful. I will definitely come again

My Experience at ZETA Greek Kitchen – New Zealand 🇬🇷 With Special Thanks to Chef Hisham 👨‍🍳 ZETA Greek Kitchen isn’t just a restaurant — it’s a full experience. From the moment I walked in, I felt welcomed by the cozy atmosphere, elegant decor, and great attention to cleanliness. But what truly elevated the experience was the incredible food, crafted with passion and precision by Chef Hisham. Every dish I tried was flavorful, fresh, and beautifully presented. You can tell that Chef Hisham cooks with heart. His attention to detail and deep understanding of flavor balance made every bite memorable. He doesn’t just prepare food — he tells a story through each plate. Whether you try [insert specific dish if you want], or any other item on the menu, you’ll notice his signature touch in every element. The staff was friendly and attentive, service was smooth and quick, and the overall vibe of the place was perfect for a relaxed night out with friends or a quiet dinner.

I ordered the salad bowl and was served vegetables that tasted old, as if they had been sitting out for a long time. It was completely inedible and left a horrible aftertaste after just one bite. To make sure I wasn’t overreacting, I had my friend try it, and she had the same reaction. It seems like the salads on display have been sitting there for quite some time. I was really looking forward to a fresh, delicious salad, but instead, I’m left with a bad taste in my mouth and $20 wasted

came here with friends and the food was so good! we all shared our meals and we liked every one. the burgers were good and they have chunky cut chips, i reckon you can skip the mac and cheese as it’s just a bit plain. the restaurant is kind of like a food court, there are other places sharing the space so keep that in mind if you have a larger group of people. the drinks were great too :)

I keep coming back to this Korean chicken spot, and it never disappoints! Ayu and the team are always warm and welcoming, and their food is simply outstanding. I've recommended them to all my friends and family—and I’ll keep spreading the word!

The all-you-can-eat chicken we ordered was absolutely delicious! It satisfied cravings I didn’t even know I had until I took my first bite. The service was amazing, and the relaxed atmosphere made the experience even better. Definitely a TikTok-worthy spot for incredible food!"
Food was hot and fresh. The mash potato is delicious 🥰 The seating area is quite small and cramped, but will definitely come again.

The chicken was fresh, tasty, and always served hot. I liked that I could keep ordering more without waiting too long. The customer service was also excellent, Mika, filipina lady who served us was very friendly, welcoming and attentive.
My first Uncle Mann’s experience will definitely not be the last! Love their authentic Chicken Laksa taste with Sambal 💕
Authentic Malaysian food. Always well cooked! Always look forward to going there.

We love this place. We regularly get the mee goring or roti canai. I’d be suspicious of the few one star reviews by people who have placed no other reviews. Yes it’s a food court and it can get busy. Yes some of the staff look like they would rather be anywhere else but our food is always delicious, huge portion sizes and very good value for money.

WARNING!! Please avoid going to this place. They give you a VERY SMALL portion of meal. I paid $45 and the portion I received was shocking. I have to go somewhere to buy more food because unfortunately a very small portion on a small plate is not enough yet I paid $45. Highly recommend the K'Road store.
Don’t normally order the wan tan hor but thought I’d give it a try - could have used more protein but maybe thats just me. The teh ais was pretty good though. Would come back to try other dishes.

This place started off really good but the last two times I’ve been the sushi made me feel pretty ill after and today, the chicken katsu is pretty burnt. I hope it gets better because I really enjoyed the convenience of this place!

Well presented food, fish was fresh, and was a largely satisfying lunch given it is a sushi bar in a mall. What prevented 5 stars was that the pieces were rather small and the Inari were all undefilled (not enough rice)... which for the price was a bit disappointing. Nice to have a small seating area. Server was bright and professional. He was generous with the ginger and wasabi which leads 4 stars in total. Image of meal below: $16.70
I always stop by &SUSHI whenever I shop at Eastridge. Their sushi is fresh, delicious, and feels like a little treat to bring home. Great quality for a fair price — it’s become a part of my routine.

Really delicious - not your ordinary sushi, lots of different pieces! Bought 7 pieces for $18.60 so around $2.60 for one piece. Some of the rice was a little hard/stale not sure why but everything else was perfect. I recommend if you’re in the area.

The most expensive SUSHI in new Zealand. I dont mind paying for something expensive and worth. 3 prices of SHSHI cost me $7.20 thats crazy plus the taste was rubbish. Definitely this one is the worst place ive seen.
Amazing! The pizza was the best I’ve ever had. Top quality ingredients and very friendly customer service. Tiramisu was yummy. Will be back to try some more dishes.

Hands Down the Best! Dante's Pizza in Eastridge is absolutely amazing. The sourdough pizzas are perfect – crispy, flavourful, and just delicious. The spaghetti bolognese is a big hit with our family – my 11-year-old son says it’s the best he’s ever had in Auckland! The Dante’s Montanare is a must-try too – so tasty and unique. The service is always excellent, and the staff are super friendly. We’ve been here multiple times and every visit has been fantastic. The kids love it just as much as I do. Highly recommend!

Indulged in the magic of pizza perfection at this top 50 global gem. Every bite was a revelation of deliciousness, from the flawless texture of the crust to the flavors in the amazing sauce. The friendly staff added warmth to the experience, making it a delightful culinary journey. The tomato sauce and cheese are exceptional. This pizzeria not only lives up to its world-class reputation but exceeds it with a symphony of taste and service. A must-visit for any pizza connoisseur, where each slice is a testament to their mastery in crafting a truly exceptional and memorable dining experience.

Absolutely hands down my favourite pizza place in Auckland so far. The freshness of the sauce and the char flavour of the crust is amazing. I love the toppings and this is good value, classic pizza Napoletana at its finest. 👌Even straight after i eaten here the next day I want to go back for more. Thanks team, great work 🙌

Had an amazing experience here tonight! Ordered just a simple pizza and pasta. We asked for the pasta without mushroom, another lady came back and kindly explained that taking out this ingredient would make the pasta bland, but offered to add a couple of other ingredients to bring the dish to life. Safe to say she was not wrong and the food was amazing! We walked away completely satisfied and stoked with the service - you don’t always get that in hospitality these days!

The staff was very friendly and helpful. To my surprise, the shop also featured a touchscreen ordering kiosk and a website that allows for online orders. However, I did notice a few typos in their paper menu. :D
Excellent, exactly what we wanted, meat was crispy and tender, everything as desired, well done. Very easy to order on the phone and pickup was smooth.

Absolutely delicious, fresh ingredients and great portion size. Everything we had was awesome, but I recommend the yang zhou fried rice. Next time I want to try the wontons and something spicy. We got 3 dishes and had enough for dinner and tomorrow's lunch for two hungry adults. The two people behind the counter were really friendly, too, and there's a cute frog mural on the wall.
Grabbed this on the way to Kohimarama, this Chinese takeaway is great stuff. Get the lemon chicken, the medium portion is generous and the meat was crispy and juicy.

They close at 9 the lady took my order at 9.15 without fuss and with efficiency. That takeaway shop is clean and the food (I've had 4 different dinners) is very good, far more flavour than any other I've tried. Huge serving size . I wouldn't bother going elsewhere . What a lovely family the owners are .
Delicious fresh ingredients and great service, best kebabs in Eastern Suburbs. Got chips tonight - hot , crispy and salty - best chips we’ve had for a long time .

We received a warm greeting from the moment we walked in & asked about our day, lovely customer service is greatly appreciated. Lovely people! We got mixed & lamb kebabs. The best kebab I’ve had, very authentic, fresh & delicious! That’s what a kebab should taste like. Thank you!
This is an excellent Kebab shop. They always cook with care and the food is always fresh. Their opening hours are good too.

The care that goes into the Super burger is nek level. The buns, I dont know what they do with them but I have never had a urger bun like that before. The fried chicken is soooo gooood!!! Lovely staff. Highly recommend.
Omg the best burger I've tasted in a long time...God Bless you brother...made my night...
Amazing food best sushi I have had in my life 🙂
Amazing sushi, best in the area. Always fresh and tasty but sells out quickly after lunch.
Eat it Carefully. They are not cooking it Carefully. I found pin in my food
Best teriyaki chicken sushi I’ve ever had, highly recommend this place
Stopped in just passing through.. I am sad I don’t live out these parts, this is the best sushi I’ve tasted and great value!

This is my second time dining in at this shop, and I really enjoy their pork dumplings. Although they may not be authentic dumplings, I appreciate the unique concept of the food and would recommend trying it. However, while I was dining in, I noticed that the tables were quite sticky that day, and I would like to suggest that they pay more attention to hygiene. Additionally, the trash bin near the counter was left open. Since this area is at the front of the shop, I recommend relocating the trash disposal to a more suitable spot. When it came to service, I found it challenging to get information about the ingredients in the vegetarian dumpling, which is the green dumpling shown in the photo. The cashier was unable to explain the details. Overall, I recommend ordering the pork dumplings and fries!
Dumplings tasted great! Super quick service and an awesome location, perfect for grabbing food and enjoying it by the beach. Great spot for a casual and tasty bite.
There were only a few roughly chopped bok choy and mushroom inside, mostly just dough. I was expecting dumplings with more finely chopped, filling-packed ingredients. $18 for 8 pieces.

I really appreciated the service on 19/10/24.The lady that was taking orders was friendly, attentive, and genuinely seemed to care about our dining experience. She kindly explained that they had run out of the OG and suggested to go half and half with something else. She brought our food to the table and made sure we got our food fresh and hot. We were even given an extra dumpling! Highly highly recommend this place on a Saturday night.

This has been on my list of Auckland eats to try for a while and it was well worth it!! Me and my friends were warmly welcomed by Victoria who recommended different dumplings and sauce pairings which was great. We ordered 4 different dumplings and our favourite was the Three Spice Prawn which had nice heat and were very juicy (all the dumplings were). I also loved the Monk dumplings with the chilli sauce, they had fresh and clean flavours. I'll definitely be back!!

Tacos were poorly put together, quite average. The Calamari rings were not crispy but was soft & very oily. The Burrata cheese was solid & did not split with gooey goodness as expected esp for the price 🙈 & the pasta dish lacked flavour but looked pretty. Staff were very friendly & our meals were served quickly. The lemon, lime & bitters beverage was lovely. Access to the venue would be quite difficult for mobility impaired patrons as there are quite a few steps to go up leading to the venue.

Very famous spot to enjoy specifically beer, from a wide variety to choose from, and a meal too in Mission Bay. I score my beer here 100, one of the best beers I've had in Auckland, pilsner was a little better than "little creatures" in terms of hops and the taste it leaves in mouth, chips besides it is very recommended, it's a super crispy chips well cooked. The IPA was also a super tasty beer we've had. We ordered pizza as well, brisket, superb, I can score it close to "Master & Margherita" which was one of the best pizzas I've had in Auckland. Well behaved staff and bringing your orders quickly even in pick hours. Pleasant country music was being played and they have live music on Fridays and Saturdays, at night I guess. Very upbeat atmosphere and lots of light during the day. If ended up in Mission Bay I recommend give this place a go.

It is not often I do reviews but I felt the service has been so great at Good George and generally a great place that I would put pen to paper. I travel a lot and I'm sick of scanning for food and getting no personal service but this place does it old school still. If I new the blond waitress name I would call her out and it is twice we have had her service. One of the most important aspects of being a waitress is constantly subtlety checking on the table and do they want any more and happy with the food etc. Not done well by many other restaurants.

We had our joint 40th birthday party at Good George Mission Bay Tap Room and couldn’t be happier! Frank was great to deal with in the lead-up, and Jess the bar manager on the night was fantastic — really accommodating and made everything run smoothly. Food and drinks were excellent, and everyone had an amazing time. Highly recommend for parties and functions — we’ll definitely be back!

We brought a group of 50 to Mission Bay Tap Room last night, and they absolutely nailed it! AK was a standout — juggling orders with ease, keeping everything moving, and somehow staying incredibly personable and lovely through it all. The rest of the team were just as impressive: warm, attentive, and clearly well-prepared for a crowd. Drinks were spot on, food was delicious, and the whole night ran like clockwork. Couldn’t have asked for a better vibe or a more smoothly managed experience. Huge thanks to the team!

This small, cozy restaurant exceeded my expectations. The food was fresh, flavorful, and clearly made with care. The portions were generous, and the service was warm and attentive. Despite its size, the atmosphere felt inviting and comfortable. A must-visit spot for anyone looking for a delicious and authentic meal. I’ll definitely be back!

We first visited Miku Asian Eatery in March and returned today—just as impressed as the first time. Every dish packs a serious flavor punch, and the consistency is remarkable. From authentic Japanese flavors to a nod to Asian street food, and even a proper Indian chai on request, Miku nails it every time. The team clearly knows their craft, and the menu reflects both creativity and authenticity. Easily one of the finest eateries in Auckland—highly recommend!
The food is so good and tasty, overall our eating experience is nice. Also the staffs are nice!

Absolutely fantastic dining experience! From the moment we walked in, the staff were warm and welcoming. The food was fresh, full of flavor, and beautifully presented. We’ll definitely be back. Highly recommend this place if you’re looking for quality food and great service!

We don’t often sneak out for lunch in winter but we were glad we did. Mission Bay on a cloudless warm/cool winters day is a great place to be. Miku was tasty and and fresh. Serving size was great and the owners/staff were so friendly and attentive. We could have got the meal to go but it was nice sitting there people watching. If you like Japanese then pop in!

2 person operator. 2nd customer after opening. Clean & quiet shop. Waited 30min for my order to be cooked. Snapper & chips @ $15. Portion of chips is small & fish length size of takeaway paper box. This is below normal fish & chip takeaway size. Chips were cook just right ie crunchy on outside & soft inside. Oily batter & shrunk + non fresh fish underneath coating. Picture shows a thousand word. Competitor on other end closed down serves better F&C

Stopped in for a little lunch on the go, and while there were several fish selections listed in the board, the only option available was the Trevally. We did get it, and it was a great sized portion, and tasted great, along with the perfect amount of chips. Also had a couple of Scallops that were very nice. Only gave 3 stars because I wasn't able to order anything but Trevally.

This place although the service is good doesn’t suffice for the low quality food. I got a the gourmet burger the patty was very oily and didn’t taste very nice the lettuce was brown. The only good thing about it was the bun which was nice.
Best Fish'n'Chips at Mission Bay! Very delicious for a good price. Everything made from fresh fish. The staff is very friendly. A real must have at Mission Bay. Gladly again at any time!
Fresh and delicious fish and chips and seafood platter! Tasty and reasonable price.

Disappointed to find out today that LA Veranda will be closing its doors. Luckily for us it was a first and last time to try this establishment. Glad we did. Everything was amazing from service, food, environment etc. Enjoyed every part of today from service through to succulent, tender, perfection cooked starters and mains. Hoping in near future this establishment comes back if not in mission bay somewhere in auckland.

We had an incredible experience at La Veranda! We ordered the shrimp mango salad, T-bone steak, and ribeye steak—everything was absolutely delicious. The flavours were fresh and well-balanced, and the portion sizes were very generous. The shrimp mango salad was refreshing and light, and both steaks were cooked perfectly. The staff were also friendly and attentive, which made the night even more enjoyable. Highly recommend this place for a great meal and warm service!

Tucked away on the second floor with a stunning view of Mission Bay, this restaurant is a delightful find. Just when I was about to give up on finding a good spot in the area, I stumbled upon this gem. Every dish was perfectly cooked, and the portions are enormous- think American-sized! We ordered the beef burger, lamb rack, seafood platter, eye fillet, seafood pasta, and spaghetti bolognese, poached pears, crème brûlée. Everything was 💯 While there’s no dedicated kids' menu, the staff were incredibly helpful and offered kid-sized portions of several dishes. The only downside was the slightly long wait time, but the quality of the food made it absolutely worth it. We loved it so much that we’ve already booked a second visit. Thank you for the wonderful meal—can’t wait to return!

It was my father’s birthday and we truly enjoyed the dinner we had here tonight. We received lovely service, they were very attentive throughout and explained the menu and wines to my parents. For 4 people, we bought the seafood platter as a starter and it was definitely generous (as it says it is for 2 people). In particular, my father loves his fresh seafood. The ceviche and oysters were a highlight to start off with. We bought the T-bone and new york strip steaks and they were beautifully cooked to our liking. Also got the beef short ribs which was deliciously tender and my brother enjoyed his fish and chips. We also got the two desserts pictured available which were sweet and rich. I wish I could put more photos up. Overall, the experience was great. I definitely recommend this place. Help yourself to a bottle of wine or two (I ended up buying another one to take home) as it is definitely worth the experience. Thank you La Veranda for making my father’s birthday dinner a memorable one!

We dined here today. We started with appetizers which were nice. But the highlight fir me was my main which was fish catch of the day snapper. It was superb. The others had Surf and turf which they said was ok and another had the lamb cutlets which she enjoyed. Meals came out quickly. Service was splendid. We had a lovely dinner here.
Attentive friendly service, food was a flavor bomb. Thoroughly enjoyed the seafood chowder, chicken breast and surf and turf. Looking forward to returning to try the rest of the menu.

Quality food, seafood pasta was delicious along with the fungi pizza we had. The wine complimented perfectly and the waiter was very enthusiastic and also quite knowledgeable. Great prices too with nothing over $25 menu for a Sunday. Highly recommended
Amazing wood fire pizza and wine. I was so impressed with the quality of food and how affordable it was in such a great location. Highly recommend this place to all the pizza & wine lovers!

1st visit - Thoroughly enjoyable, beautiful fresh food so tasty. Staff are lovely couldn't do enough to help. 2nd visit- Absolutely outstanding. I've been here once before for a small meal, so it was great to return and explore a more fuller sample of the menu. Every single dish was simply outstanding. Thoroughly enjoyable and definitely recommend.

This restaurant has lots of wines with reasonable prices. And manager’s recommendation made my dinner perfect. Foods are delectable and you have to pair with wine. You can see a Mission bay with your meal, that makes you comfortable. Wonderful place!

This is my first Fish & Chips in NZ, but I can tell this is the best F&C in my life 👍 I'm not sure what kind of fish is on the menu, as English is not my first language. However, the staff kindly recommended and explained the menu item (snapper). It was so kind. I tried Snapper which was battered. The fries were really well salted and it was really crispy. And the fish was really soft and there was no fishy smell. I wish I could bring my family and eat again. The staff told me he made the sauce by himself. The food was really good. I highly recommend it👍

We were very impressed with our meals at The Seafood Collective, seafood chowder was hit, beautiful, hot and full of seafood, I could have easily eaten two bowls, snapper was beautifully cooked with a light crispy batter, salmon was cooked perfectly and served with a lovely tasting buttery sauce, fries were crispy and seasoned well. All n all a lovely little seafront restaurant.

Dining at The Seafood Collective in Mission Bay was an absolute delight. The menu boasts a fantastic selection of fresh, sustainably sourced seafood that’s expertly prepared to highlight the natural flavours. I especially enjoyed their salmon and chips—it was delicious and perfectly cooked, capturing the essence of a great seafood meal. The presentation was appealing and each dish was full of flavor. The staff are friendly and welcoming, enhancing the overall experience with their attentive service and thoughtful recommendations. Coupled with a relaxed, stylish atmosphere and a prime waterfront location, it is a must-visit for seafood lovers.
Delicious seafood, especially the grilled prawns. Delicious garden salad. Crispy fries. Big portion size. Good service. Seating is a bit limited. A bit pricey. Great location near Mission Bay Beach.

First time trying this. We ordered the battered snapper and the seafood basket. The snapper was fried quite nicely and tasted good. The seafood basket was served on a plate and was above average. Quite like the scallop piece but the fries could be better. Overall the food place good but not outstanding. Service here is great and the seatings were comfortable. Had a pretty good time here.

The food was absolutely delicious. Every bite was full of flavor! The staff were very friendly and accommodating, making us feel truly welcome. Such a lovely and relaxing place to dine. Highly recommended!

This small restaurant had pretty good Google reviews. The place isn’t very big, but it looked warm and inviting. After a walk on the beach, we decided to have dinner here. Unfortunately, it turned out to be a bit disappointing. We ordered the Seafood Salad — the onions and celery were chopped very roughly, the dressing was overly salty, and the portion was quite small. We also ordered the Spicy Raw Prawn, but when I complained at the counter that there were only two prawns and the flavour was off, they told me it was actually a different dish called "Love Boat" that was served by mistake. Although the staff were polite, we paid $62.80 for just two dishes and a bowl of rice, which felt overpriced for what we got. I wouldn't recommend it.

Very nice food, I had the Egg Fried Rice $10 & Tom Yum Soup $11.50 for lunch. The soup was delicious & so was the rice, nicely presented & full of Thai flavours. Only problem is the toilet was yuck & had no loo paper, plenty of serviettes on the tables. Plenty of outdoor seating.

So far best Pad Kow POW in NZ! All the other dishes are nice but bit of sweet for us and I don’t think the size is good enough…but it’s okay! Pad Kow POW I got the spicy one with stir fry pork mince and a beautiful fried eggs. So I personally recommend you guys if you want something authentic Thai, choose the high spicy option!! All in all, we love the food and atmosphere, we laughed a lot and will come back!

This is not the first time I fine here. But this dish wasn't on the menu before and I am not sure how long it will stay. I hope it stays forever. This is the stewed beef pho. They used beef ball and slow cooked beef shin. The meat has been cooked so gently it is super tender and so juicy. The broth is full of flavor. Love it.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ "Absolutely loved my experience at Jalsa Restaurant! From the moment I stepped in, the warm and inviting ambiance made me feel right. The staff was incredibly friendly and attentive, ensuring every need was met with a smile. The menu offers a delightful mix of flavors — each dish was bursting with authentic taste and beautifully presented. The standout for me was the Jalsa Special Drink and Curries, which was perfectly spiced and cooked to perfection. Whether you're looking for a cozy dinner or a lively gathering, Shisha & bar at Jalsa Restaurant is the perfect spot. Highly recommend for anyone craving delicious food and exceptional service. I can't wait to return!

Absolutely loved our experience here! The restaurant offers the perfect combination of delicious Indian cuisine, a stunning beach-facing view, and a lively atmosphere. The bar is well-stocked with a great selection of drinks, and the live music sets the perfect mood for both relaxing evenings and celebrations. The place is spacious, beautifully maintained, and ideal for families as well as parties. Service was warm and attentive, and every dish we tried was fresh, flavorful, and authentic. A must-visit for anyone looking for great food, great vibes, and unforgettable memories by the beach!
Great food and service. Awesome sheesha. Had live singing aswell. heaters placed well. good vibe.

One of the best Indian Restaurants. Mostly busy during the weekends yet the food is amazing and the staff is super helpful. They do live music on the weekends which is like a cherry on the cake and makes your experience even better! must visit and will back soon!

Great food , absolute perfect service! Everything was great but the new live music wasnt that good like before. We enjoyed much more during Kartiks performance. There was a musician also I really don’t like.

WOW WOW WOW !!! We have been twice now and will 100% be back again. We have had the special platter, the sheesh kebab platter, the chicken shawarma, the jalapeño poppers and the prawns and we were in love with the flavours and the quality of the food 😍 The lamb is my absolute favourite meat along with the bread and dips! It has to be one the most delicious meals I have ever had ☺️ The service is also great. Friendly staff and clean amenities! Do yourself a favour and check this place out - you will love it 🎉 Five stars from us ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

4/5 food. Lamb and chicken shawarmas excellent👌 (I presonally enjoyed it over the kebabs) 5/5 atmosphere. (very spacious upstairs seating with a fantastic beach view. Quiet and viby) Got to take a walk up the stairs to find the hidden spot. Give it a go. Recommended Thank you staff🤌🤌
Amazing food experience! Can really taste the authentic middle eastern cuisine. Presentation and quality is great! Also really decently priced cocktails which is hard to find in Auckland.

Came across this place while strolling mission bay for somewhere to get some dinner with my gorgeous 😘 fiance ... Nothing was serving food anymore and this was at 930pm come on NZ this is pathetic boring place .... We had a few cocktails which were delish, then ordered a sharing platter🤗. Wow the food was so good the meat was yummy and tender the dips are scrumptious and the salad's were crisp and fresh. And a perfect accompaniment... From walking in to leaving the staff were very friendly and attentive and made sure we had everything we needed .. Restaurant was really great and the view from the deck overlooking mission bay was amazing, also very clean with a nice ambience even with a band playing in the other bar .... Would definitely go back here whether it's with my fiance or a group ... Also if you're into shisha they had them as well out in the smoking area... Thanks for the great evening and delicious food 😍😍... Cheers Jasey...
Amazing food, probably the best shawarma ive had in a while. Large space and good view out to the sea upstairs. Very nice service too.

The food was very nice and the atmosphere of the venue is lovely. Great wooden tables and benches, although the layout is a little strange. The portions were fairly small for the price, and rice with the dishes has to be ordered separately but the servers were very polite and helpful, although we did get over charged for one bowl of rice we didn’t order. Good experience and very accommodating for our party of 9.

One of the main reasons why I keep coming back to Mission Bay is actually to eat here. I’ve always come back to that very fresh fish with pepper sauce. They also have the best Tom Yum soup, and for sure, crab fried rice is soo delish. Commending all the staff as well here as they’re really nice and helpful.

The food were tasty only the waitress's English is hard to understand even for Kiwis. And she can't fully understand what we said as well, other than that, good food with enough amount and nice environment for dinner.

Everytime me and my little family come here it's always so amazing service and food. My other half is thai , and apart from his mums food honestly it's one of our top 3 thai restaurants we go to all three are very on par with eachother. very authentic. We order medium to thai hot in all our dishes were always very happy when we come here. As you can see we order alot of food and leave feeling full but very light ✨️ at the same time so thank you mission in thai for the amazing food.
The raspberry lemonade was so good! The ribs were tender and had such a beautiful flavour. The service was also impeccable.

Absolutely phenomenal! The Pork Lychee Chinese burrito was an explosion of flavors. crispy pork, juicy lychee, crunchy veggies, and a perfect drizzle of sweet-savory sauce. The toasted housemade flatbread base added a satisfying crunch to wrap all the amazingness of the dish. The staff here were absolutely wonderful—inviting, friendly, and made the entire experience feel homely and relaxed. Their warmth and excellent customer service really stood out and added a personal touch to our visit. On top of that, the dessert was a perfect, beautifully presented and delicious. Highly recommend!

🍓: If you can't tell by the photos, the feast we had was absolutely mouth-watering. Every single dish was rich with flavours, beautifully presented, and left us full but not feeling bloated. ✨️: A stunning restaurant with such wonderful staff. We had such a lovely time here and so can not wait to come back. Truly an insta worthy establishment! Follow Foodie Mama NZ on Insta for more reviews.

It’s a pleasant surprise dining here. The food was delicious and well presented. Chinese food not like your normal takeaway. The price is reasonable. The chicken was a bit smaller than I thought.Will try again soon.

Nice food, we tried 3 meals, everything was good, big portions, and I would definitely recommend the dumplings, those were the best I had here in NZ so far. Family atmosphere, the waiter was nice and chilled, however, I really don't like people who take dogs in restaurants (there were 2 Chinese ladies who shouted to each other (talked) over the whole place + the dogs barked, omg)

I didn't think I would be writing a review again but this place has got to be one of the biggest underrated places in all of Auckland on both taste and value for money. This is specific to the Mission Bay branch, but the Duty Manager confirmed that the beef, lamb and chicken were halal, which is a very nice plus. Overall Rating: 9.7 / 10 (S Tier) Food: 9.5/10: The food was some of the best I've had in a long time. I love chinese food, and the servings here bring me that lovely taste that I hardly find anywhere else around Auckland. They also cater both for halal and vegan options which makes this quite possibly the safest place to bring anyone for a feed. The best part is that the serving sizes are very huge. The only fault I can give on a broad basis is that the food is not as spicy as you'd think, the double spice rating feels normal to me. Maybe I'd prefer an even spicier option. I've ordered the following below: 1. Fried Squid - 11/10 I would highly recommend 2. Popcorn Chicken - 9/10 Great volume, make sure to add sauce 3. Sizzling Cumin Lamb - 10/10 I would order this every time if I could 4. Chicken Skewers - 8/10 Good flavour but slightly hard to get off the stick 5. Sichuan Spicy Chicken - 10/10 Oooh boy this is nice and authentic 6. Deep Fried Cream Puffs - 9/10 The guilty pleasure snack, and so well prices 7. Assorted Baked Goods - 9/10 They somehow also have incredible almond crossaints Price: 10/10 For what you get in terms of taste and amount, this is probably the best place in Mission Bay. The Duty Manager says they make everything from scratch inside, which helps them keep prices like that. Atmosphere: 11/10 Look at the photos, I didn't expect this place to be at the price range it is with how well decorated it is. Service: 10/10 Honestly a very nice bunch of guys there. Food came quick, they offered blankets to us if we were cold, and are really easy to talk to. I'd highly recommend this place to anyone. I've eaten in too many overpriced places with sub-par food, this one is an outlier

The food was very delicious and amazing. The steak was also perfectly balanced and cook medium rare. But the pizza was the best part since the cheese was stretchy ,although it says it’s spicy for some pizzas it’s not deeply. Overall the service was great. The pricing was very reasonable.😊👌🍕

Really lovely spot. The staff were super friendly and made us feel right at home. The vibe was warm and cosy, with just the right lighting and music, perfect for a relaxed evening. We had cocktails to start (highly recommend), had chicken and fried and the delicious pasta dish with a lovely red sauce and both were honestly fantastic. Everything hit the spot, looking forward to enjoying more evenings and dining here :)

Love the covered al fresco dining area with gorgeous views of mission bay and chic seaside ambience. Service was amazing and consistent with all the servers. Food was a little underwhelming though. The seafood platter was pricy with over-boiled tasteless mussels and fried fish pieces resembling fish fingers. The chips served on the side were super good though. Crispy and not greasy. Will come again for the ambience and drinks but not the food.
Great staff and service, delicious food, lovely environment. We loved it so much the first time so have returned. Another fab experience.

Amazing dine in experience. Newly opened restaurant with fresh renovations spear headed by three amigos who are the owner operators. Each interaction with the wait staff was very pleasant as they were genuinely interested in the customers having a great experience. We had overnight cooked beef short ribs and mushroom risotto. Combining these two dishes was a match made in heaven!! Recommend to try out this place on first table if you're unsure about giving it a go. They have only been open 2 months, but already have a band of regular customers as both their service and food is great.
Gang owned. Wish the police would patrol their parking lot because the gang crowd hangs out there at all hours. I don't consider it a safe place.
It’s a nice bar and delicious cocktails they made.
Always go here with my family Friendly place to be
Loving the new menu here burgers are 🔥🔥 &the new layout! It's got a more homely vibe
Lovely service! The barman was so attentive and fun. We’ll definitely come back as soon as we can.

We had a groupon deal for here to get the Peking Duck banquent. The duck was pretty good and we got a lot of meat. However, we were only given six pancakes to wrap the duck in. That wasn't even close to enough for the duck we were given. We were told it would be extra for more. Overall though, it wasn't a bad experience and with the deal, we certainly good a good amount of food. I'm not sure I'd pay full price for it though.

Lovely, friendly and attentive staff with efficient service. Had the pecking duck groupon deal, and added chicken nibbles and fries. Food is fresh and deliciously tasty. My husband loved the food so much he informed the staff how amazing the food was, which is extremely rare for him. Only recommendation is that they freshen up the decor, doesn't bother us though, we will definitely be returning in the near future - 31.01.19, 7.00pm.

Great service from booking to the dining experience. We had the duck banquet via a Groupon deal. Good value for money as it included two drinks, duck served two ways and soup. Meat serving was generous and delicious.

Basic decor, but food was delicious. We came in for the Groupon Peking Duck and found it good value for money as it came with a drink each. Duck was moist, warm, and skin was crisp. No wasted calories here.

Newish restaurant from first time restaurant owners. Seating and decor basic but the food is really good. The broccoli is an absolute must try maybe the best I have ever eaten. Unlike many Asian restaurants they are using great ingredients and no msg. Seating on the terrace is basic but it is fun and enjoyable. Reasonable drinks menu. Recommended
Not bad. We brought food but no sauce. 4 chips pack but no sauce. Extra .50 c for sauce each sauce. Staff should train more to give the best service. I'm not happy at all. Wouldn't come back again.
Top food good prices for around here and good people even gave my sauce for free cause my card was playing up.

Absolutely loved my experience at Paradise Kebab & Fried Chicken. From the moment we walked in, the warm and involving atmosphere made us feel right at home. Also, the parking is available right outside the restaurant made the visit even more convenient.
