We were so impressed by the kindness of the staff, especially Ani KC whose warm attitude truly made us feel welcome. Each dish was beautifully presented and packed with flavor. I especially recommend the kebab, which was too-notch. Can’t wait to visit again and again🤤🤤

Great spot for a quick and tasty meal! The kebabs are flavorful, and the fried chicken is crispy and delicious. The service is friendly and efficient, making it a perfect choice for a casual bite by the beach. Highly recommend for a satisfying food stop in Mission Bay!
BEST HALAL CHICKEN EVER tender juicy and atmosphere is great nice music and hygienic. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED

Amazing quality - great price, recommended- I come from Wellington where top Fish n Chip shops in NZ would dominate - this is up there! My crumbed snapper had lemon pepper which went with the generous portion of crinkle cut chips - perfect fish, so juicy and fresh, I was really impressed.

Very underwhelming. Charged $66 for dry frozen packet crinkle cut chips that were cooked in what tasted like old oil. $9 for a piece of fish smaller than my hand, very thin fillet and also tasted frozen and not fresh. $13 burgers that were average too. This place needs sort it out, honestly don’t know how they can keep open with prices that high and food quality that low. Sad it’s the only fish and chip shop in that area.

Crispy, golden perfection! The fish was flaky and tender on the inside with a satisfying crunch on the outside, while the chips were thick-cut, nicely salted, and utterly addictive. Paired with creamy tartar sauce and a sprinkle of lemon pepper, it's a timeless comfort classic. Simple, hearty, and delicious — a must-try for anyone who loves no-fuss, feel-good food. And the fish burger? Absolutely unmissable. It's everything you'd want between two buns — crispy, flavorful, and gone before you know it. 10/10 would come back for more! and I did. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ (5/5)

Can't believe how much we paid $76.50 for it. Ordered before hand and still had to wait 20mins So disappointed- would never go again or recommend it Called them to complain and they said if we returned all the food they would give a refund or we could go back and get more food. Said the snapper was 100g per piece. There was no way we had 500g of fish.

This place was called sea cow 4 or 5 years ago, the new owner charges extra for paper cups and forks, which is quite annoying. Their food is just regular fish and chips takeaway style , average quality and quantity. You have to pay extra for sauce, even more annoying. We paid $47.5 for a combo. The upstairs dinning area is closed. So no more good view. Very simple, low operating cost, you sit by a sticky table, eat from a piece of paper, with a 50c disposable fork. Only good thing is you can still sit outside.

The food was tasty, but nothing that really stood out or left a lasting impression on my palate. While it was enjoyable, I was hoping for something more unique or bold in flavor. On the other hand, the cocktails were excellent, well-crafted and full of flavor. The ambiance of the place was beautiful, with a stylish and inviting atmosphere that made the experience pleasant. Overall, it was a nice visit, but the food didn’t quite live up to the expectations set by the setting and drinks.

Stopped in for quick lunch that turned into a fabulous long lunch due to the most exquisite food and cocktails. I was initially dubious about the Peruvian -Japanese fusion but I needn't have been. Everything worked in ways I could never have imagined. The seats were comfy, the music was just the right volume, the staff were there just the right amount and the outlook was lovely. I'll definitely be back

Having lived in Auckland for 22 years, I’ve always wanted to dine here whenever I visited Mission Bay. Today—Mother’s Day 2025—I finally stopped by for a meal. The tune of ‘Mamma Mia’ welcomed me ‘Mama Mia’ arrival. Gentleman Agung provided warm and attentive service, the food was perfectly seasoned, and the architectural design was uniquely stylish. Truly a wonderful experience.😊

Wonderful restaurant with great ambiance and layout. Went here with a group and enjoyed our time there. The food was great, and the staff were accommodating (though a little rushed off their feet). It's definitely worth a visit for special occasions.
A very convenient location in Mission Bay. The food is good especially the Snapper. One thing though is the bathroom is a bit untidy, hence the rate for atmosphere.

If I could give a 10 star rating for each service I would, The establishment itself is neatly decorated and I enjoyed it. Although I don't smoke or vape there is a nice seating area outside with heaters. The staff gave everyone the same attention, The locals are also very friendly as well. The food and cocktails were heaven I cant wait to go back and visit you will not be disappointed!!!
If you have plenty of time, this place has a great intimate vibe. However, if you want food, there is a decent wait but the pizzas are worth the wait as they are really well made.

Hey guys what’s going on. This is how you treat your nice customer with $12 waffle fries??? Is it worth to give so less fries to have a bad comment? Very bad experience. Please fix this, otherwise you gonna lose more customers.
The atmosphere and live music service were good. But the food was the worst. The pizza was made with the dough from the supermarket and was small. $25 is too expensive.

**Compact Bar Disappointment** **Cramped Atmosphere:** Enter this cramped bar, offering underwhelming pizza and drinks in a tight space. **Underwhelming Experience:** Overall, the experience failed to impress, with several aspects leaving much to be desired. **Meager Portions, Steep Prices:** Prepare for disappointment as the pizzas arrived in meager portions, accompanied by prices that felt unjustified for what was served. **Sauce Overload:** An overwhelming reliance on commercial sauce dominated the flavor profile, lacking the homemade touch expected from a bar of this caliber. **Crunchy, but Unsatisfying:** While the base boasted a satisfying crunch, it couldn't salvage the lackluster dining experience. **Tasteless Alternatives:** Unfortunately, the other pizza options failed to deliver on taste, further contributing to the overall disappointment. **Uncomfortable Seating:** Adding to the woes, uncomfortable seating arrangements detracted from any semblance of ambiance. **Friendly, but Inadequate:** Despite friendly staff, their efforts couldn't salvage an otherwise underwhelming visit.

Chef is skillful and nice. Staff and manager are great and have such a service mind. Both sushi and sashimi are fresh and tasty. For someone who wanna try sweet sake, I would recommend a second one from the top (sorry I forgot its name) It was strong but well balanced, pairing with fish is the best. Also homemade dessert is wonderful

I would like to rate this place highly but was let down by my recent experience. Used to visit this place 5-8 years ago but haven't been back in the recent years. I've heard good reviews recently so I thought I'll give it a go again. It's way overpriced for the quality we were served on the night. I ordered the $46 for 9 pcs nigiri set. The nigiri form was rough (see image). Reminds me of the foodcourt sushi standard or sushi train at best. I was expecting a higher standard for this price point and for what Masa "should" be. Ikura gunkan is $18 for 2. Price is on the very high end yet the ikura itself is soggy A standard small cup of Chawanmushi. Going for $21 is way overpriced. Apparently I was told by someone else that the sushi chef I had that night was not their usual older chef. The overall customer service was great. But either way the experience was not good and I don't think I would visit again.

We went to Japan and always loved our time and experience at their restaurants. The menu has a lot of options, we ordered half portion of grilled A5 wagyu, kingfish sashimi and tuna onion pot for a light evening eat. Our chef curated the meat beautifully and the cuts were art pieces to be enjoyed, the grill was perfect as well. The soy sauce to the hot pot the flavours were just right, which I can’t say for every sushi restaurant. I read about these small hidden shops in Japan that holds their own, Masa might well be one of these we are lucky to still have in Auckland. This restaurant has no fancy talkative chef or IG grabbing dish, but it grabbed our taste buds like very few restaurants managed to in Auckland, it brought us back to Japan. I saw some negative posts about here, I think the expectation could be reset before coming in that you are here amongst people dedicated to top quality food and low-key satisfaction.

Authentic Japanese cuisine made by a Japanese chef. The quality of the food was great, the atmosphere was genuine. However, the service staff might need to pay more attention to details. Overall, the experience and quality were fine, but I sense the prices were a little high considering the location and offerings, etc. A solid 4-star restaurant and worth a visit.

Sushi was amazing, authentic Japanese food, prawns tempura was great, very satisfying experience, also the black sesame ice cream is so nice too! Highly recommended this restaurant. Will definitely visit again.

I had a really disappointing experience at Spring Kitchen takeaway. The food quality was poor — it tasted stale and lacked freshness. On top of that, the girl at the counter was rude and dismissive, acting like serving customers was a burden. There was no smile, no greeting, and she seemed impatient the whole time. Customer service is just as important as the food, and unfortunately both were below standard here. I won’t be coming back.

Overpriced and average taste! The fish slice on the rice is far far too thin and small compared with the photo shown on the menu. It is like three pieces of salmon on the rice equal to one regular slice. A salmon bowel like that in food court of Sylvia Park is far far better than this and far cheaper than this. Avoid!

Very beautiful, yummy food, and the service the lady gives is amazing. So very polite and friendly, explaining the dishes, and watching her make the food while singing to her music was lovely. Highly recommend 🙏🏻
Wonderfull service and amazing food. Loved the hot chips and will most definitely be Comming back.
The lady is always so helpful and friendly. My daughter loves coming to the store. I'd definitely recommend - good food & fair price

Highly recommend! The pasta, steak, and garlic pizza were all delicious — full of flavor and freshly made. The owner was super friendly and welcoming, and the atmosphere was very family-friendly. My child was really happy and comfortable the whole time. Great place for a relaxed and satisfying meal. Will definitely come back!

As soon as I stepped foot into this restaurant, my mood just instantly lifted! There was a lovely staff member to greet us and bring us to our table, incredible first impression. Not only that, the food was incredible! My personal favourite was the snapper risotto. There was warm jazz in the background and fairy lights, and much more. The staff, food, and atmosphere was just so fun, warm, and cozy. They even let my siblings watch them make pizza! 5⭐️'s

Nice vibes, bit packed on a Friday night as with the other restaurants around. Unfortunately the bar nearby had overpowering music spilling into the area. Food is OK, thin pizza base, cannelloni was heavy on tomato sauce, scaloppine marsala was nice. Wait staff were amazing. Unfortunately, we finished our meal before the pineapple juice we ordered was served, even with one reminder for it. Cancelled it on payment.

Really don't understand why there are so many harsh reviews. Food was incredible. Service was great and and there was a pleasant atmosphere with lovely Italian music in the background. My wife and I had the soup of the day (which was seafood) and the King prawns as starters. Both were delicious and the flavours worked really well in both dishes. For the main we had the fish of the day, which was snapper on a bed of risotto with Basil sauce and lime. It was really a wonderful meal. We were both too full to do dessert. - Special shoutout to the friendly and humourous waiter we had, he made sure we had a great time. **the pictures have empty tables because we were the last in the restaurant, not a reflection on there being no customers ** A couple of tips: 1. Use First Table. We got 50% off our bill. Made the value even better! 2. It is BYO wine. Will be back again!

Went there with a few friends on a weekday. They have two for one pasta. We ordered the pizza and our friends ordered the pasta. Everything was very delicious. The staff were friendly and attentive. Can get a bit noisy when it's busy but everyone seemed to be having a great time.

Beautiful spot right by the beach in St Heliers. Love coming here for brunch, but dinner was a whole new level – fresh tiger prawns, perfectly cooked eye fillet and market fish, and the most amazing light tiramisu with strawberry sauce. Great food, romantic atmosphere, and stunning sea views!

Our lunch at La Vista Cafe was OMG delicious. The reviews are very complimentary about the cafe and I 💯 % agree. We had Tapas to include smoked fish cakes, patatas bravas, lamb and chorizio dumplings, albondigas and pizza focaccia. All fabulous and super generous portions (we actually brought some home so we could enjoy it again later). Service was excellent and a lovely feel to the cafe. I actually like all the nice lighting arrangements!

100% recommend this wonderful café! We had an amazing time there with my wife, drinking some NZ's finest wines with super tasty fresh market fish! I also had a perfect steak! Dessert tiramisu was a top notch as well - the best we tasted in Auckland so far. The personnel were so lovely and served us well - Tanya is the best! Here I say it - this is the best place in St.Helliers and the Mission Bay area ❤️❤️❤️

Always a great experience at La Vista. Highly recommend the breakfasts, tapas, fries, and sticky date pudding. Cozy, relaxed atmosphere. Nice for a sit-down meal, a breakfast/brunch and coffee, or a drink and tapas.

Chose Huevos rancheros for lunch, choosing the added meatballs. My wife had the lamb burger lunch deal with drinks. Both meals were excellent with my Huevos rancheros the best I have had in years. It was served in a generous pot, steaming hot and delicious. The accompanying coffee was perfect. The restaurant atmosphere was perfect for a Spanish eatery and was very comfortable. The eatery looks out onto St Heliers Bay with the view sometimes blocked by buses. Staff are very pleasant and helpful. Will be returning to try other menu items.

This Sunday morning, we savored a delicious breakfast at this location, although the wind occasionally blew outside. Upon entering, I observed the cafe's elegantly adorned interior, where patrons maintained a courteous distance while enjoying their food. One should appreciate that the washrooms provided are tidy and comply with the standards. We intend to enjoy another meal here.

We went to Annabelle’s in St. Heliers recently and while the setting is stunning — right near the water with a lovely ambience — the food was shockingly bad. We started with five pieces of wontons, which came out within five minutes. That should’ve been the first red flag. They were half-burnt, greasy, and completely bland. No salt, no pepper, no seasoning of any kind. It tasted like someone just dumped them in oil and sent them out. My partner ordered the pork belly, and although it was cooked well in terms of texture, it was also completely flavourless. Just plain, soft meat with nothing to bring it to life. I asked for the pork belly bao to be swapped with fried chicken bao — the server was very kind and said yes, which I appreciated — but what came out was a boiled piece of white chicken that had been lightly dunked in oil and shoved into a bun. It wasn’t fried, it wasn’t seasoned, it looked awful and tasted even worse. I have a photo to prove I’m not exaggerating. We paid $90 for this, and not once did the owner or anyone ask how the food was. They didn’t care. The only redeeming things were the location, the nice vibe, and the friendly man who served us. But that doesn’t make up for how bad the food was. If you’re going for drinks or just the view, sure. But if you’re hungry and expecting good food, do yourself a favour — don’t go.

My family went there a month ago for dinner. We ordered a duck spring roll, bimbimpab, duck leg risotto and grilled fish. The food there is not very fancy but fulfilling taste. I love the brownie dessert and crumble. Service was very nice, will be back!

Fabulous family lunch, brilliant menu with a lot of options of dietary requirements. We had entrees, mains and desserts. The snapper special was a great light lunch option. The open air front was lovely enjoy the sun and seaviews. Our service was personal, efficient and discreet. Throughly enjoyed our afternoon lunch.
One of the best restaurants on Tamaki Drive. Excellent food and wine, with helpful caring staff. Always a pleasure to brunch, lunch or dinner there. No garlic in most dishes.

Got an opportunity to try their new menu. Lamb Wontons lacked a bit of zing but the lamb filling has been like I've never seen before. Very full wontons. Try it with the hot sauce on table. Romesco with the prawns is to die for. Try finishing not while it's hot though. Lastly the risotto....one of the best I've had. Creamy and full with perfectly done fish. Definitely a hot item on the menu. Shout out to Mercedes for making sure our orders came out ok time and we were looked after during dinner.

Our server was amazing however our fries were half frozen , my eggs Benedict had no presentation, vegetables or garnish and sauce straight from a tube (pictured .. for $25+ this was insane and tasted of plastic) — as well as this we had to return two coffees as they were made with off milk and were obviously curdled. We instead ordered Coke zeros as replacements to be on the safe side and were still charged for all four beverages. I’ve been coming here for years and felt utterly ripped off. Even more dissapointing when bringing a friend from overseas to show off beautiful st heliers .

Had a great brunch here for my friends birthday. Delicious food and coffee, presentation is beautiful, and the menu has great and unique options. Service was prompt and friendly too. Will definitely be back :)

Celebrated a major birthday and Alyce happily volunteered to take group photos. She was very attentive and gave us excellent service which went well with the delicious food. Well done to the management for having such high expectations. Will definitely return

By far, the best roast I have had in Auckland! The service was great. Staff were very attentive and welcoming. The red wine jus on the roast was just too blood good. Overall, I'm really happy with my visit . I will definitely be back

I had dinner here 3 weeks ago with friends and we were all incredibly disappointed. We arrived at 6:25pm and only got our drinks at 7:07pm, after having to ask multiple times. The waitresses did not appear to have been trained properly as we had to ask multiple times for water, tables that arrived after we ordered drinks we getting their food before we got out drinks, and another table had to go to the bar to order food as they were not checking on tables. One of the lights was flickering and hurting our eyes, the tines on the forks were all bent, and the spring roll entree appeared to be straight out of a freezer packet. They couldn't make Mimosas, they were out of pork, and there was a bone in our entree. The main dishes were nice and cooked well, but lacked a lot of flavour - if there was some spices or salt used it would have improved the dishes a lot. The main didn't come with rice which isn't unusual, however we didn't get told this until we had to ask after our dishes were served, this should have been made clear when our order was being taken - as they do at every other Thai restaurant I've ever eaten at. The "spicier" dishes had less flavour than one of the mild dishes. All four of us agreed that we would never eat here again.

After reading some of the recent reviews I was worried about staff being rude to customers and having a bad experience. I decided to go to this restaurant last night and I was amazed how well they have served us. They even asked if we would like to change our table to be closer to the window view. They clearly have done something because we had a great night. We ordered the green curry and the Pad see ew that were incredible and delicious. I will definitely come back!

Rather overpriced for tiny servings. We ordered 2 soups for $10.50 each and they arrived in the smallest size takeaway containers. For a serving so small I'd expect to pay $4-$7. Also one of the soups was advertised as containing tofu but arrived with just chicken in it. And the tofu in the tom yum wasn't deep fried (just silky) as it usually is which made the texture less enjoyable. Though the broth tasted good the servings were much too small to ever be worth ordering from here again
Food were nice， just the main doesn't come with rice and the price is around $30 to $40 for each main meal. the average cost is $50 at least. Maybe the location? Thats why the price is higher?

The best Thai food I have ever had. Nice serve and great decor. Can’t recommend enough. Pricing good to if you take into consideration the location and the serving size. Order a main each, and take home what you can’t finish in a container.

Honestly it’s been my go to food for me and my little family. My kid said “dad! I love this! Please always get it!” So yeah, it has to be one of the best kebab restaurants in Auckland. Great food, service and good value for what you pay. Yummy flavours. Highly recommend!!

First time visiting the store in St Heliers, so good experience. The staff name Raj is totally awesome. So friendly nature and kind attitude towards the customers. Giving 5 staff because we were so impressed by the staff gesture and the food the too Oishi(Very Tasty). Love to visit again☺️☺️

Found this place years ago, and to this day it's still as delicious! When my daughter comes for dinner she always picks Kebabs on Maskell. We order in store. Always easy. Always fresh, plentiful and yum. Thanks guys!

My Habibi literally ripped open the paper bag out of my hands to eat his super mixed kebab. Hence why we didn’t have a picture of his super duper meal! This is now my 4th time here & I’m in love with Kebabs On Maskell! Surely these guys are the best tasting kebabs in Auckland. They’re a bit pricey but well worth your money. Chips are full to the brim & the kebabs are so well compacted with beautiful lamb or chicken as well as falafel & great tasting hummus, garlic & other juicy sauces. If you have hummus sauce on your chips it taste even better! A special mention to the two young lovely people who work at this store. For my first time I had a lovely young Afghan gentleman & tonight I had a lovely young Kiwi lady. Both had exceptional customer service & were polite & respectful at all times. Always serving quickly with a smile. Thank you both!

Hands down the best kebab place I’ve ever been. I’ve travelled around AUS and NZ trying all the local kebabs, and nothing comes close to this Kebabs on Maskell. The staff are friendly and food is fresh. I highly recommend the chicken on rice

The food was AMAZING. I visited so many Japanese restaurants, but this one is excellent. Taste, service, cozy atmosphere, literally everything was perfect 👌 thank you Musashi for unbelievable hospitality See you soon again 😌

A tiny jewel hides in lovely St Heliers neighborhood. Booking is super easy - online or phone call. Parking is easy as. Quality, freshness and quantity of dishes achieved a great balance. Clean and tidy - toilet too (and not wet). Try and you will keep coming back.

I had dinner there with my two young children. They loved the food, I loved the food. Portion size was generous and food presented excellent. Service was great (fast), and polite too. They came and brought pens for colouring in. Great place to eat. Highly recommend.
Some of the best chicken skewers I’ve ever had….

We had an exceptional dining experience at Musashi Japanese restaurant, a true gem for lovers of Japanese cuisine, from the time we walked in, the ambiance minimalist décor, soft lighting, and calming traditional music set the perfect tone. The sushi was incredibly fresh, with the tuna and salmon practically melting in my mouth. The staff were warm, attentive, and knowledgeable, taking the time to explain the dishes and offer thoughtful recommendations. Service was prompt without feeling rushed. Whether you're a sushi enthusiast or new to Japanese food, Musashi offers an authentic and memorable culinary experience. I’ll definitely be returning soon!

These people don’t care about what they serve you, we ordered sweet and sour pork, one fish of the day (batter) and a wonton noodle soup total cost 48$ The sweat and sour pork was pretty much all rice with three tablespoons of pork that had the texture of jerky and two small pieces of pineapple. The wonton noodle soup with a silent cause there was no soup due to the amount of noodles they put in it. We had a spoon out of the pork dish and ate a few Wontons from the soup. First and last time going there for us, shop was empty which makes sense now.

My last visit to this place was October and we ordered fish and chips. Was good. But this time I got Wonton Char siu nooodles. With only 18NZD I cannot expect more but it really cheered or warmed me up by the soup. Good portion. Maybe the Char sui pork was not very fresh but Wonton and noodles are okay. Will come back to try the fish and chips again.

Terrible !!! ordered hoki tarikihi snapper mussels sausage the fish was sliced so thin it was mostly batter and oily the mussels weren’t fresh probably frozen.. the chips were glassy and see through dosed and dripping in oil 40 bucks later very disappointed..i know my fish snd chips and these are a waste if money theres marsics and melanesia rd do yourself a favour drive a bit further out

At 5.20pm on a Wednesday this place was on a roll! The wait time was 25 minutes and they were churning out so many orders, anyone would think it was Friday. $5 chips was plenty to share between two, nicely cooked, crispy on the outside and soft in the middle. My panko crumbed snapper came with lemon wedge, very fresh snapper and cooked to perfection, so delicious!

Been here a few times now and each time the food has been fresh and nicely cooked. It's in St Heliers so prices are slightly higher than in some parts of the city although worth the extra. We went there on a busy Saturday evening so there was a 20 minute wait for our order. The staff were friendly and informed us of the delay. We look forward to going there again. If you are from out of the area then we recommend taking your food up the hill to watch the sunset from above Ladies Bay looking back over the Sky Tower.

Best Thai in Auckland Try Chef Special Duck!!!! Best kept secret It has been consistently excellent for 10 years I have been regularly dining in with friends after our swims at GI Pool Complex nearby. The owner Lena is a busy lady- cooking and running the restaurant- has very high standards- sometimes she is a bit flustered and can be a bit short- but always very accommodating and friendly. '-) Great menu and top quality food. '-))) YUM
Some of the best Thai food I’ve had in Auckland! The staff are super helpful and friendly. Will definitely come back!!!
The food was great and the staff were so lovely and helpful!! Will definitely be coming back.

I came here after a recommendation that this was the best Thai takeaway. Emphasis on takeaway. To the hostess that was there on Friday Nov 25th, find a new job that is NOT in hospitality. There are openings at the women’s prison where your skills would be better put to use. To be clear the food was pretty good. But I haven’t been treated like pond scum in a while. I went there with my six year old daughter and wife after a school event. We were the only people eating in the restaurant. Literally no one else there. It was 5 pm. First customer of the day. We were there to feed my daughter and my wife an I had a late lunch. We ordered the fried rice, money bags, two glasses of wine, and a ginger beer. Not the biggest bill, but $56 they were not going to get otherwise. The woman came over to repeatedly ask us if we wanted more food and would give a grunt when we said we were not going to order more. When I asked for a take away container since my daughter didn’t finish, instead of giving us a takeaway container right next to her, she went into the back and got a dirty broken container to give to us. I hope saving $0.15 on a clean container was worth the negative review. Honestly, I feel bad for this woman. She’s human and very miserable at her job. She should not be in hospitality. I feel bad for the other staff there too. We could hear her putting the young staff down. It’s sad that the chef is putting out a good product only to have that work sabotaged by the front of the house staff. My wife and I had eaten a late lunch

If I could give it half a star, I would. The food is TERRIBLE, mushy boiled veges, no crunch. Worst Thai I’ve had to be honest. The flavours were bland, all I could taste is soy, none of those zesty refreshing flavours Thai is known for. And I wouldn’t have even left a review if it wasn’t for the absolutely insane behaviour from the lady who (manages?) there. Angry outbursts out of the blue from the moment we sat down to order. Read the other reviews before you dine here…

Terrible service - don’t order from this branch. We ordered four pizzas through the Domino’s app, however they then outsourced our order to UberEats for delivery. Pizza showed up stone cold and inedible 45 minutes after being “ready in store”. Spoke with the manager who initially agreed to refund but then later decided it wasn’t his problem it was Uber’s. The large pepperoni pizza that was ordered turned out to be a mini - also not their problem (no reason given - just not their problem).
Staff could benefit from additional customer service training and ensuring that orders are cooked thoroughly and prepared as you have advertised.

Order online the process takes ages put my card details in 10 minutes later they call me and tell me there are no delivery drivers. Now I'm out 20 bucks for up to a week before I'm refunded. Shitty location shitty service don't order online. I'd like my money back now, you shouldn't have had the website accepting orders if you weren't going to go through with them. Some kind of compensation or interest would be nice.
Quality is way much better than GI branch. Honest. Good food, hot and fresh always, reliable. Even in large amount of order, they make each pizza good. Always go to St Heliers Domino.

Waited for a pizza here, dough was still soft when consumed and gave me horrible vomiting and diarrhoea. Plus stood there no was around waited 5mins until one coworker came into the store and served us

I went in here tonight as in the area killing time before an appointment, and needed dinner. Discovered it on a drive, and went in and explained I wanted something chicken, crunchy and spicy, in the end I heard them say they had porkbelly and got that, it was real good, and spicy and came with prawns. It was something different than your regular offering at thai places, so will go back again :)

We have tried quite a few different Thai takeaways across Auckland and this by far is the best. The food is delicious and every time order we are extremely impressed. Some of our favourites include the massaman curry, duck curry and pad see ew. The portions are generous too. Cant wait for our next takeaway night, YUM! (Price range selected based on feeding family of 6)

Ordered the pad thai, sweet and sour chicken, duck curry, crispy pork & shrimp wontons, and the curry puffs. Portion size was huge and all the food tasted amazing. Was really nice that the duck curry doesn't have bones you have to pick out and the curry puffs were really out of this world. Definitely will be coming back to try more things off the menu
This place has the best takeaway food in the eastern suburbs. Fresh, flavourful, spicy, reasonably priced and great sized portions. My favourite.

Ordered food from here not only did we wait 45 minutes for an order that we where told would take 20 minutes I specifically asked for no tofu in my chicken pad thai when I rung to have the problem fixed the first offer was to replace my meal for next time I order it would be on the house. I then got another phone call back stating the owner would rather me waste my gas to drive back and take the food back in order to get a refund.. after waiting longer than expected and the problem not being fixed accordingly. We will not be returning..

Ordered on website for delivery to ours.. Lovely lovely food including my favourite Saag Gosht ! A seamless and totally fulfilling experience - thanks team Curry Village St Heliers.. Susan and Barry 🤙🤙
Great value for money $12 for lunch. Tasted pretty good, authentic and wasn’t too sweet. Service was friendly

Incredibly delicious food. Highly recommend this little gem. Great bite-sized pieces of meat. The Rogan Josh is cooked to perfection, as the lamb is succulent. I take it to my Dad who very much enjoys it. My Mum loves the Butter Chicken. We love everything. Wonderful service. Arrived early one day to pick up my food and the team kindly did earlier. Thank you.

I ordered a main and a cheese and garlic bread for takeaway. It was unfortunately very disappointing. I have eaten lots of Indian food throughout Auckland and that might be the worst naan bread I have ever had. First of all I received a garlic one as opposed to cheese and garlic, and it also tasted sweet like a crepe… Furthermore it was $8 which is expensive. The main itself wasn’t bad but nothing outstanding.

My butter chicken (mild) was amazing, perfect mix of sweet. If you want curry without the spice, or you're being taken here, would highly recommend butter chicken (mild), I'm not a curry person but this was amazing. The service was great too, the lady was checking on us, and making sure we had enough rice. Very accommodating. There was nobody else there surprisingly. Looking at the other reviews, it seems dining in is the way to go.

We ate here 4 years ago and the food and atmosphere was great. Today came back and brought our friends to have a nice breakfast in St Heliers. Disappointed ☹️ Bacon was tough, salty and particularly burned. Avocado was spoiled but the chef argued that the other half was eaten by other customers and they did not complain. Everything else was average. Their coffee was still good.

We love weekends and wanted to make our breakfast special, so we were looking for a good place to eat and found this one. We loved the food and the good service. However, we were quite sad because our child is very picky with food and can only eat chips and porridge for breakfast. Since chips are served only after 12 noon, we would bought them somewhere else, but we were told that this is not allowed. As a result, we didn’t enjoy our breakfast together because we had to eat in a hurry so our child could have her chips outside. We hope that you may consider this kind of situation in the future

We went on a public holiday so it was quite bustling but we were fortunate enough to get a table without waiting. The food came out relatively quickly as well despite them being busy. Staff were friendly. The food was overall delicious and good portions except the market fish (not photographed) which was a bit underwhelming. The soufflé pancake was a stand out, crispy exterior and fluffy interior. The shakshuka was really well flavoured and seasoned, perhaps a little too well as it got pretty heavy by the end of the meal. The restaurant looks out to beautiful St Heliers Beach, lovely place to enjoy a coffee and food. Would recommend.

Came here for dinner and absolutely stunning. Every dish was delicious and hot. Pictured are the fish n chips, rib eye, pulled lamb, curry and market fish. The cocktails were yummy and the service was pleasant.

I had oysters and a glass of bubbles, and honestly, the oysters were some of the best I’ve ever had, incredibly fresh and full of flavour. The mignonette sauce paired perfectly and brought everything together beautifully. Our server, Dayne, was amazing! So sweet, and super helpful with all her recommendations. I’ll definitely be back! $3 oysters during happy hour and $10 glasses of bubbles? Such a steal. Highly recommend and ill def be back!

Went for the Weekend Sessions menu ($79pp) and left pretty disappointed. We were seated by the owner, who didn’t exactly offer a warm welcome, but things seemed to improve when we were served by a lovely, friendly waitress who did a great job throughout. I actually thought the place had changed for the better since my first visit. But it all went downhill when we asked to takeaway our leftovers. The waitress—clearly uncomfortable—told us we weren’t allowed to take food home because they want patrons to “drink responsibly.” That sounded questionable, so I asked for any documentation or policy to back it up. She couldn’t provide anything. Then came another excuse: apparently, we weren’t even supposed to be offered the Weekend Session because it’s “for groups of 4+.” Again, this is nowhere stated on the menu. As a “consolation,” they said they’d only charge us for two people—but because we “ate enough for four,” we still couldn’t take the leftovers. Seriously? That’s fat-shaming at a whole new level. We asked to speak with the owner—who had no problem seating us earlier—but he refused to come over. When the manager finally did, he blamed everything on the waitress, which was just spineless. She was the only person there who handled the situation with any grace. To be clear: The menu didn’t state the Weekend Session was for 4+ people. It didn’t state that takeaway wasn’t allowed. Saying someone “ate too much” to justify not allowing leftovers is outrageous. The food was lovely. The waitress was great. Shame it’s run by someone who clearly doesn’t value customer service.

The staff were welcoming when we arrived and very hospitable. We were given a table for two and had exceptional service. The food was delicious prawn cutlets, crispy pork belly and especially the burrata we really enjoyed the recommendation. Our drinks were nice as well as a lovely dessert coconut & kaffir lime panna cotta which we squeezed in because why not! Highly recommend this vibrant restaurant.
The food is mediocre, and the service is great, but nothing stands out about this restaurant.

Highly recommend. We ordered the Bang Bang Chicken, Lamb dumplings and pork belly. Everything was absolutely delicious! One of the best Asian fusion meals I’ve had in 2023. The lamb dumplings in coconut were insane! A must try, you will not be disappointed! I will be back 👍🤤

Came here with my coworkers. They have a nice mood, a great location to see beautiful beach. But food was salty in general and served very slowly. Considerated services, though. Anyway, dessert was magnificent! Display was incredible.

It was such awesome food and night for us. The owner was so lovely. The food was so yum. I love my butter chicken and garlic naan!!! We had butter chicken, chicken tikka masala and paneer makhani with garlic naan and garlic and cheese naan. So so yum!!

Came here for First Table and glad we picked this spot - the food was so good! The naan was so fresh and both curries were a hit. Service was great and they were very attentive. First Table only gave us a discount on the curries and didn't include any other food items so the rice and naan were paid at full price. Their in store deal ($25) includes a curry, rice and naan so we think the First Table deal was okay - would rather just come in and have their in store deal!

🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 I had an amazing dinner. The Malai Kofta was absolutely delicious – rich, creamy, and perfectly spiced. The flavors were authentic and comforting, and the portion size was just right. The service was friendly and the overall dining experience was excellent. Highly recommend for anyone looking for quality Indian food.Will surely visit again

Amazing Indian food and dining experience brought by Anurag and his brilliant chef Gautam. We started with the Vegetable Samosas which came with a delicious housemade Tamarind sauce (we asked for a refill, and it's good enough to drink!) followed by the Vegan Koftas to whet palate. For our mains, we went with the Saag and Rogan Josh. All of their mains are served with basmati rice, and a choice between plain / garlic naan or 2 poppadoms -we went with garlic naan, and it was all served hot and fresh and paired perfectly (we had already started eating before taking photos) The atmosphere was very relaxing and Anurag's accomodating service was a warm welcome after a long day of moving homes. The pricing is fair for the quality and quantity that you get. 2 entrees, 2 mains (+free sides) and 2 drinks for about $50 per head. Absolutely stunning, can't wait to be back again! **UPDATE 26/06/25 Want to add that we went again last night and it was superb! 3 different curries with complimentary rice & garlic naan for only $25ea served hot and fresh within minutes! Can't recommend this place enough for lovers of great quality Indian food 😁👍
Excellent masala chai. Cauliflower florets were super crisp & flavorful, cooked perfectly. The chicken wrap was also nicely done. Very friendly and hospitable owner.
Excellent lovely Chinese food plus they have great options in Thai also. Portions are great too.
Fish and chips were yummy. Fish was fresh with crispy batter and big pieces. Chips were nicely cooked soft on the inside and crispy on the outside. Reasonable prices. Good value for money.

Small portions and expensive for what you get. Also got a stir fried chicken dish which tasted funky (like seafood) after a few bites so didn’t want to keep eating. Tried giving feedback over the phone they said they never had any complaints before.

St Heliers Takeaways on Maskell St is awesome. They do some of the best Thai, Chinese and European Takeaways in Auckland. The Gai Sam Ros dish is exquisite. In fact I’m yet to have a meal from here that hasn’t been 100%. If you want top quality food at a decent price this is where you need to come.
I have order beef Pad Thai and got something completely different with 3 shrimp and fat beef with extra pepper! Be in mind that I am allergic to pepper…

The Kobbideh n the ch kebabs were just amazing. Broiled to perfection I tell U. The service was really quick n people there were pleasant to talk to. Definitely a 10/10. I'd personally would like it if it gave more of my Persian heritage feel. Need to add more to the decor. A must visit guys ...

We ordered the royal for our main meal this evening. The portion was large it can actually be shared by 2 people - if you're not too hungry! The steak was cooked just nicely done it was tender when served. the chicken was also good-they were tender and still juicy. But the best is actually the lamb kebab, which was really, really good. it was perfectly seasoned, juicy and tender. We finished our meal with a $10 banana split, which our kids devoured. Overall, it was a really good meal. Even the salad on the side didn't disappoint. Will come again soon!

Traditional places are often the best, and this is one of them! At first glance, it might seem like just a small snack bar or shop. But once you’re greeted with kindness and served a feast—one that is both deeply cultural and incredibly generous—you can’t help but be amazed. The warmth of the service is truly captivating. A traditional dish easily serves two people. Delicious food and top-notch service—absolutely outstanding! 🫶🏼

What a beautiful restaurant, we drove 40 minutes and it was worth every second. The service was quick and amazing, we got our food so fast, And the food was perfect! Prices are reasonable and worth every penny. Servings were the right amount, brought us back to the times in Iran with all the delicious food. People there were so nice, always checking up on us and giving us the best experiences. The restaurant itself is so beautiful and clean, it really embraces the Iranian culture. Shiraz has become my number one favourite Persian restaurant in Auckland. If you think about going I 100% recommend this, you wont be disappointed.

Shiraz Restaurant offers an incredible Persian dining experience! We started with their eggplant dish, which was rich, flavourful, and a fantastic way to begin the meal. Alongside, we enjoyed their pitted olive dish, a tangy and delicious side that paired beautifully with the starters. For the main course, the chicken kebab (joojeh) was the star—juicy, tender, and perfectly seasoned. To finish, the Persian saffron ice cream was an absolute treat—creamy, aromatic, and just the right amount of sweetness. The combination of authentic flavours, warm atmosphere, and excellent service makes Shiraz Restaurant a must-visit!

Not a big fan of rice or sushi, to be honest, but will definitely be going back for more of this. The chicken teriyaki salad was amazing, so fresh. The red/purple rice that came with it, a taste sensation.
Best sushi in Auckland!! Always fresh and the woman is lovely 🥰 great service and delicious food!!

Amazing service and delicious sushi! We ordered 2 platters for a party and the presentation and quality of the food was excellent! Everyone loved the sushi and commented on how pretty the platters looked! 10/10 would recommend to anyone who’s looking for a quality and stunning sushi platter.

I stubbled across this wonderful sushi place after a medical appointment. They were due to close in 30 mins but they couldn’t have been happier to make me the most amazing fresh chicken sushi that I’ve ever tasted then also offered me a miso soup. It really made my day and can’t wait to go back. Thank you.
This place is adorable! Minn and the team are amazing! We always make the drive there from out west because it is so worth it! Food is delicious! Chicken katsu curry is a must try for sure!!

Best sushi in my list!!! Lucky that I discovered this takeaway shop when I moved here :) Salmon pieces are big and thick, so satisfied! Udon amazed me and katsu pork is tender. Curry is bit too sweet for me tho it’s still good with rice. Highly recommended!!!

Min and her team catered for my son's 21st, for more than 80 people. The food was fresh, delicious, plentiful, and very well presented. She helped me to select the right menu, and it was ready to serve on time, making it easy and stress free. I will definitely return for my next event.

Pretty cool spot in Saint Heliers... Food are amazing and the restaurant looks great. The reason why the services is a 4 stars is the vendor advised me that it's Taco Tuesday so 3 Taco is $18 instead of $22. I ordered according then found out that the restaurant is actually changed me full price without discount... 🤔🙄

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Best Tacos Ever! These are hands down the best tacos I've ever had—super tasty, very filling, and totally worth it! They were absolutely slammed when I went, crazy busy, but the boys behind the counter were hustling hard and doing their best to manage the rush. The wait was a bit long, but honestly, the food made it more than worth it. Highly recommend if you're craving something delicious and satisfying!
Holy moly! Freaky Burgers & Tacos has some of the best lamb tacos I’ve ever tried, top quality tacos and burgers. Highly recommend everyone tries this place soon. James Ashwin Kakapo Business Sales

Wow look no where else. My partner and I came down here to change it up not realizing what a treat we were in for. The tacos were one of a kind, crunchy, fresh hot and the meat so tender. The Pulled Pork nachos were of a way bigger portioning to what we expected as a Large and FULLY LOADED with flavour, crunchy fresh and large portioning of all ingredients to make up the spectacular Nachos. Now I'm not one to go for a change in burgers as normally always a beef or a chicken person but I have found my New Favourite being the Impossible Burger (Vegan). I was not expecting the taste to be so amazing. The flavors of sauce combined with the ingredients blew me away. Highly recommend this place to anyone who is after a change from your standard Fast Food places. Thanks Freaky Team

Tried the lamb and beef tacos and wow—absolutely delicious! The meat was tender, juicy, and full of flavor. Perfectly balanced spices and great texture in every bite. Easily some of the best tacos I’ve had. Highly recommend if you’re craving something bold and satisfying!
Best fish and chips I've had in Auckland, fish burger is especially good and fresh, chips are not skimpy in serving and always good too

I felt like Fish and Chips for a change and didn't know this place was just around the corner. Ordered 2x Hoki, 1 Chips and 4 onion rings, everything was great! Batter perfectly fresh and crispy. They could have thrown in some lemon wedges but I had some at home. Will come again.
Don’t let the outside fool you! Great burger and chips for SO cheap! Would return
Always exceptional food. Lovely owners that take a pride in the food they serve. The burgers are awesome and the chips are some of the best in Auckland.
The restaurant might look aged but the food coming out of there is awesome. For $9 the burgers are delicious and absolutely worth the price. Great chips too. Very nice couple that run the place

GENKI Sushi might be a small store, but it delivers big on quality. We stopped by for a quick bite and ended up with a crispy fried chicken katsu bowl with rice — everything was freshly prepared, flavorful, and felt like such a treat for the price. It’s the kind of spot that’s uncomplicated and efficient, perfect for a quick lunch that doesn’t compromise on quality. Clean, affordable, and delicious — what more could you ask for? Would definitely come back next time I’m in the area! Samirah 🍱🐟✨
The spicy chicken was nice and smokey. Owners were friendly, and lots of quick sushi and Japanese cabinet snacks readily available.

Wow! What a little hidden gem! We had the katsu donburi and it was so yummy. Loved the generous portion size, beautiful presentation and fresh ingredients. Sometimes you get very dry cabbage salad at Japanese restaurants, but theirs was so good. Their service was so kind and friendly too. Will be back to try the Korean fried chicken options!
Delicious sushi, lovely ladies! They also have mini sushi which is great for the kids, and summer rolls. Your favorite sushi in st Heliers!

Hands down great and flavourful spicy chicken katsu with lots of salad. Prepared with a lots of affection, the hardworking ladies know what they are doing. The detail in taste and presentation is immaculate. Keep up the great honest effort...it really shows in your food.
Loved this cafe so much we went back for dinner. Great coffee and pastries. Delicious pasta and desserts.

Can I give more than 5 stars? My husband said it’s the best pasta he’d eaten. Our waitress was super attentive and had impressive knowledge of the menu. I loved how full the restaurant was but the tables weren’t packed too close together. Great atmosphere, amazing food, superb service.

Simply put - one of the most flavorful and tasty breakfast experiences I’ve ever had the enjoying. The Nduja scrambled was absolute perfection and the pancake was the perfect amount of sweetness and flavour.

An unforgettable coffee and breakfast experience awaits at this lovely spot. Our coffee was crafted to perfection and had an amazing flavor. The presentation and texture of our meal were outstanding. Courteous and professional front-end service. We give this place our highest recommendation. ♥️

Very friendly, accommodating staff. Sat upstairs which can be loud if there are other guests being too loud. Otherwise the food was surprisingly good. Great balanced flavours, well cooked. Ordered the Chicken Marsala, and Lamb Pappardelle. Both quite different, but were cooked well and delicious. Recommend this place, will definitely come back. Compared to some other restaurants in this area, the prices are reasonable, and better quality.
This was delicious! I love how you can just choose one piece at a time so you're not stuck with an entire roll of one flavour. Every piece I chose tasted so fresh and well seasoned.
Very good sushi👌🏻

Great food, nice service and overall a quaint little place to go. The sushi is great, with a myriad of flavors to pick from ranging from salmon sushi to kebabs! Totally recommended if you're on the run or just need a quick bite. Overall very pleased with this place. Keep it up!
This is undoubtedly the best sushi place. Extremely fresh and huge choice that will suit anyone. Can't fault them at all. And the staff is amazing too.
My granddaughter loves to have sushi from Bay Sushi. The people are very nice there. Sushi is amazing.

Located in the heart of St Heliers Beach township, a small local business that has the most amazing soul food. I have been here 3 times now and everytime it's been amazing with a family hospitality vibe. Check them out with there menu also attached, they also have massive family boxes available. Call them to arrange your next big family shared box, worth every dollar.
they do amazing platters/ share box, very good value, very tasty too! great spot to do takeaway and sit and eat at the beach across the road! highly recommend!

I recently purchased a family box, and while the food was delightful and provided ample portions for a family of five, I did find the chicken pops to be slightly dry. Nonetheless, it was certainly excellent value for the price.

Food are very nice. We ordered tiger prawns with rice, sirloin steak with chips, and 500g pork ribs. The store is takeaway only, we arrived 12.25 today/Friday, 5 minutes earlier than store open, but staff told someone already made orders before us and we have to wait until 1pm to pickup our order, what a busy!

Reasonable priced foods in the current Auckland priceline. Creamy garlic mussel has great flavour, you can just have anything with that sauce! Prawns were well cooked, the shell was crisp enough to eat with peeling, and the rice underneath was soaked with the sauce and juice from the prawn. Ribs was great in portion size, though can be very saucy and sweet, I guess some people will be very happy with that... Mushrooms are also very good, though can be a bit hard when it's cold...
Koru Oceans Fish and Chips delivers big servings of fresh, hot, and tasty food. Perfect for a satisfying beachside snack or an easy takeaway meal. Crispy, delicious, and hits the spot every time!

Probably one of the more over priced takeaway shops I have been to. $11 for a piece of snapper, and if I recall correctly, $8 for a piece of plain as hoki. Decided on a cheese burger, hot dog and 2 potato fritters. Lets start with the good things. The potato fritters were good, and crispy like I like them, not thick with potato, but this is what I like. The hot dog was dreadful, The cheese burger, well it tasted ok, bun was ok, everything was ok, except the meat patty, was just a processed rubbery piece of rubbish. and the price. I was never expecting 5 star gourmet for the price, but even a piece of lettuce would have made this look better. Staff were friendly, but overall disappointing and wont go back.

everytime went to st heliers, always craving fish and chips, and my friend recommended this as have change new owner and its beer battered fish and chips im so imprese, lovely services and of cos fish are damn good. definitely recommend this new.shop

Pretty disappointing experience. We paid $55 and barely got any food the portion was tiny, especially for the price. The fish was soggy and the chips were minimal, not even enough to share properly. The quality was average at best and definitely not worth what we paid. Won’t be coming back.

First time trying this takeaway!! Food is 10/10!! Sweet & sour fish, salt & pepper chicken, chicken chow mein! The chicken balls are so good! Flavourful and made with love. Ordered through a delivery app and the food was still hot will definitely be returning

Ordered on uber eats as there was a deal. Green curry and Phad Thai $10 each down from $27. They were both delicious, very tasty some of the best Thai I have had in Auckland. My only complaint is that the portions were very small. The phad Thai was half a container and was not even a proper amount to feed one person. The green curry was also a small amount but looked like more but majority of this container was just liquid. Rice portion also extremely small for the price of $5, it was also cold. I understand I got a good deal on uber eats but if I had paid full price I would not be happy. Even if they changed the portions to reflect the price on uber eats - you should not be offering special deals for something that one would assume would be a decent portion. Overall I really enjoyed the food and I will be purchasing again 🙂

We had the absolute best Thai food here, by far the most authentic we have tried here in NZ. The portions were a generous size, and every dish was flavourful and delicious. Everything tasted very fresh. The staff were very friendly, the food came out very quickly. I highly recommend visiting Chim Chim.

Really great food and a lovely top floor view. Fun entry as well through the red door on street level so it doesn’t look like much from the outside. Prices were good and service was friendly - great spot!

The setting was perfect for a really nice night out. The food was exceptional and well priced, and the service was what really set this restaurant on the bays apart from every other. The waitress, Amelia. that served me and my family was some of the best service I’ve received when going out dining. 10/10 experience

I came here for dinner with my family. The service was amazing, we had a young blonde girl serving us and she was very helpful and polite. The food was amazing and fine cuisine, we will definitely be eating here again soon.

We went there to try the pizzas, we ordered and only then we were told that they had run out of bases so no pizzas were available, none. It means that more than half of the menu had been wiped out. Very embarrassing for an Italian restaurant. It was 7pm on a Wednesday so not that late... We asked for the menus again and we ordered the seafood risotto and the gnocchi. A bit slow service as it took nearly 45 mins to get the food but it was good. We'll try again and see if we are lucky and can try a pizza.

The different Pizzas offered are all named from Greek mythology; I recommend that you clearly enunciate and/or confirm with your server when ordering "Ares", "Iris", or "Eros". The Chef quickly replaced the god of war with the god of rainbows and the food was excellent. Time for food arrival seemed adequate given the type of restaurant and how busy it was, and sitting out the front was fine under the heater, even in winter. The only disappointment was the unavailability of a Zucchini dish for lack of ingredients. The staff were friendly and attentive.

The One and Only! Absolute BEST pizzas in the Bays. I dream of those bases, but everything on their menu is scrumptious. No matter what day you’ve had, you know you can walk in and always be greeted like a family friend.

I had the absolute pleasure of dining at The Hood, and it was nothing short of amazing! From the moment I walked , its warm, inviting decor and authentic vibe. The food was exceptional—each dish was a masterpiece! I was seated front of the kitchen because I didn’t made any booking 😀The seafood risotto was amazing, even tho they were super busy and I had to wait little longer they offered complementary dish that blow my mind 😀 😉 The staff were friendly and very accommodating. Whether you’re a fan of Italian cuisine or just looking for a memorable dining experience, I can’t recommend The Hood enough. I’ll definitely be back to indulge in more of their amazing dishes!

What a gem! We’ve been looking for a nice restaurant around east Auckland and we’re so happy we found them! It is such a cozy place with an amazing service… and their food is absolutely fantastic! We had pizzas and desserts tonight and we are absolutely sure we are coming back for their pasta, too! 100% recommended!

Second visit — mixed experience. This was my second time dining here. I had a great first experience, so I brought along two friends who also enjoy Thai cuisine. Unfortunately, the consistency of the food was disappointing this time. The beef in the Thai beef salad was quite tough and dry, which made it difficult to enjoy. The jungle curry was surprisingly watery — quite different from my first visit, where the curry sauce was rich and thick. That said, the flavour was still pleasant. We all enjoyed the stir-fried noodles — well-seasoned and nicely cooked. Given the inconsistency between visits, I’ve decided to remove this place from my personal must-visit list. I hope the restaurant can work on maintaining more stable quality, as their potential is clear.

Really good local thai with some nice touches of authenticity. Affordable and fast enough for a weeknight when you don't want to cook. Really, really good and punchy tom yum soup, and good curries & sides. Surprising for a local place. As ever at a thai restaurant, there's real trouble dialing in the spice level. The spicy tom yum had a real kick, but the medium red curry appeared to have very little spice at all. This place appears to cater for a mostly white market. Tell them you like it authentic and just go hot everything and order medium next time if you overload. 🫠😛

Neat little restaurant in a row of stores that accommodates for around 30 seats. Seems very popular for getting takeaways, not so much dining in; although if you do decide to dine in, the presentation of the premise's aesthetic is thematically there as a Thai establishment. Food is okay, very small portions to the cost ratio, tastes okay though - not outstanding, and it's understandable if the main clientele is for takeaways. The owners of the business seem to be delightful, cheerful people. Theres an odd choice to have a storage cabinet directly in front of the toilet door so only half of the doorway is actually accessible so larger people may not be able to squeeze through.

This restaurant was a convenient spot after a training. The menu has standard Thai food. Nothing extraordinary. We had garlic pepper chicken and the deep fried fish in tamarind sauce. Both dishes were sweet. Their service was slow. They seemed to focus more on Uber orders.

This place was a feast and delight for someone whose favourite cuisine is Thai. The restaurant is cute & cosy decorated with decadent Thai furnishings. Friendly owner with fabulous sense of humour. The food was exceptionally tasty and authentic. I ordered my go-to dish Larb Gai and can honestly say it’s the best flavour outside of Thailand I have ever tried. Good portion size and attention from waiter to the spice level which was perfect. I went with a friend from out of town who enjoyed the experience too… A must if you appreciate genuine Thai food!!!

WOW what a beautiful restaurant. Called in here today Tuesday 18 February 2025 for Black Barn Wines tasting. Thanks Dave, loved the Chardonnay 🙏❤️, the cheese 🧀 table was fantastic too, I'll be back to try the seafood chowder.....

We had a friends and family lunch at The Terraces today. It was to celebrate the birthday of my aunt who is a resident at the lovely retirement community in which The Terraces is located. I had never eaten there before so had no expectations. If I did have expectations it’s fair to say that they would have been exceeded. The service was gracious and unobtrusive. The food was excellent. My brother and I both had the fish and chips. Sounds unglamorous, sure, but it was the best fish and chips I’ve had in years. Portions were generous, food presentation was great, and prices of our meals was eminently reasonable. The view across the water is beautiful. If I had a quibble it would be that the vegetarian options for one of our party were perhaps a bit limited. The quality of the food and service were equivalent to most top standalone restaurants, so given it’s within a retirement community makes it even more meritorious. Thoroughly enjoyed it.

From the moment we walked through the door we were met with warmth, elegance and attention to detail. This continued through out our ladies lunch with elevated, attentive service. Our meals were a mix of classic favourites with a creative twist. An extensive range of wines on offer made for a delight experience. We can’t wait to go back again Easily recommend this restaurant.

Dining at The Terraces today was such a lovely experience. The food service & atmosphere was top notch. The round tables are great for a larger party too. The staff are so friendly, patient & accommodating especially Jay who is such a helpful young gentleman, look forward to having this experience again soon, thankyou.
Lovely place and lovely staff. Good food as well!

Quick coffee break at this contemporary venue. Two cappuccinos served at the table. Service was polite and friendly and for that time of day a few patrons around having lunch. This venue clearly geared for weekends and events. Two thumbs up!

Lovely to return to dine as our daughter and her husband live 5 minutes away and we have been here many times. On this occasion, we booked a First Table so getting 50% off food( only) was a bonus as the food was sadly very disappointing on this occasion. The service was friendly however so helped to make up for the poor quality of food. My pizza was missing olives and had very little tomato sauce as a base and cheese as well. My daughter's eggplant was sadly small and therefore the price seemed too high for the amount ( Musashi, the local Japanese restaurant has a far better eggplant dish for 1/2 the price). We have been here so many times because of the excellent food in the past and reasonable prices but sadly this occasion has made me consider going to the local Japanese restaurant instead.

I feel like this place is having an identity crisis. A confusion between what was Meadow and now The Glen. The food is not great, the service is a bit all over the show, no-one really know what they are doing, bathrooms had nothing to dry your hands with. I would have loved for it to be good, but unfortunately it wasn’t.

Second review: Came down for Mother’s Day breakfast. Ordered a big breakfast. Eggs sunny side up. Received one incredibly overcooked egg, and the other with a big piece of eggshell on it. Unreal. Ordered a $10 smoothie and received a regular size tumbler that was basically half filled with ice. Asked the staff and was told this is not the first complaint about it, and they unfortunately have to follow a specific recipe. Feel a bit cheated to be honest. Clearly all about the bottom line here. And a bit extreme in terms of portion size. Charge less for the drink or make the recipe bigger. Not really a community vibe standard.
Cozy and quiet when we arrived. The staff was attentive and the portion of the food was quitr reasonable. They also cater for functions and a breakfast menu.

Went to this restaurant for the first time today for an 8pm dinner. Ordered the Kadai Chicken, hot, which came with rice. The curry was good, however, I have had better kadai chicken a couple of other restaurants. The curry was a thick consistency with pieces of capsicum and thin strips of ginger, which I thought was enjoyable. Overall, I was happy with the dish and would eat it again. I also ordered a Mojito. The flavour of the Mojito was good, however, it needed to be properly strained after being muddled (and I saw it was also lightly shaken). There was a lot of lemon pith, seeds, and pulp, and the muddled mint leaves. I didn't mind the lemon pulp. However, the rest didn't leave a pleasant drinking experience as I kept getting bits in my mouth and it was clogging the straw. The atmosphere of the restaurant was okay. It was empty aside from one other table, who left by the time I ordered. However, I did notice a handful of takeout orders. The music also stopped playing halfway through my meal which left a dead silence in the restaurant. The server was friendly and checked in throughout my meal, which I appreciated.
Very delicious, authentic and yummy, Fav place for curry in the neighbourhood. Lovely service, very fast. Would recommend to anyone.

Wow! Absolutely phenomenal dining experience! My family absolutely loved every dish we ordered at Curry Palace.The soya chap was bursting with smoky, spicy flavors, the paneer was perfectly creamy and rich and the garlic naan was golden, fluffy, and just divine. Every bite was a delight and the staff’s warm hospitality made the evening even better. Hands-down a 5-star 💎 Gem! Highly Recommend to everyone.

Beautifully cooked food! My husband and I have eaten here a few times now, and the food is wonderful every time. Good value also. The staff are so friendly and sweet, and tend to you promptly. My husband particularly loves the chicken lollipop dish, which is one of the things he's ordered each time we've been here. I love the paneer dishes, personally. There is an array of vegetarian options to choose from. The only reason I've given a 4 star instead of 5 is due to lack of ambience - everything else is great, but would love to see a little more of a cosy set up here. Will definitely be back for more meals here though :)

Lovely atmosphere and incredibly fast service - food arrived within 15 minutes roughly. Butter chicken was delicious, and garlic naan paired perfectly. My favourite Indian restaurant in the neighbourhood - do takeaway as well, although I do recommend dining in as makes for a nice family night out.
Good simple food, nicely done. Great price. Nice coffee ☕. Generous helping. Friendly staff and they know how to clean a table. Would come again! 👍 Thanks.
The loveliest people! Didnt stop to eat but they lent me tools to help fix my bike! So refreshing that there are people so helpful!
One of the best coffee & mocha we have had in months. Muffin was warmed properly and came with butter, knife & fork. Hamburger was amazing! Highly recommended
Visited twice! Great coffee, great pizzas and great service both times. If in the area a must visit for food and a amazing coffee.👍
Great little place, good coffee. Inside you step right away alongside the coffee machine and till, no wonder the owner seems to know all the regulars so well.

A friend David sent your owner who owns surf n snow a message about the manager of the hostels bad behaviour and arrogance . David mentioned he had a friend who stayed there & got bed bugs ,when he complained he was kicked out for no reason. David warned you that you would be in the news in less than three months but instead you blocked David, well congrats you made the news front page this morning for bed bugs and being forced to clean...you had to be forced!!! This is disgusting and shows neglect . Muhammad the manager has kicked several people out for simply voicing concerns.

One of few authentic Japanese owned and operated restaurants in Auckland. If you’re expecting large portions that’s not really what the Japanese dining experience is about. You should go get a steak at the Lone Star instead. The restaurant is small but intimate with a great menu. A perfect place to dine with a group of foodies.
delicate food, friendly service, homely atmosphere.
This Restaurant is small, has a loyal following, the food is really tasty, good for takeaways.

Excellent food, friendly staff and quick service. One of the best Japanese restaurants I've been to in Auckland. Highly recommended! Only caveat is that it's quite a small venue, so if it can get a little loud. Not an issue for us though!

Exceptional Service & Welcoming Atmosphere! Stopped by this evening with my son for a cheeseburger and fries, and we were genuinely impressed by the hospitality. Even though it was a busy Friday night, the staff were warm, professional, and upfront about the short wait time. The restaurant had a great energy—efficient, well-organised, and welcoming. We took a quick stroll on the beach while waiting, and when we returned, our food was ready, fresh, and hot. The team checked in to make sure we had everything we needed, even offering a little something extra to make our experience even better. It’s clear they truly care about their customers and take pride in what they do. Great food, friendly service, and a place that genuinely makes you feel welcome—we’ll definitely be back!

Don’t order online because even though you have to select a pickup time they’ll just make it a lot earlier if they can. I arrived 8 minutes before the pickup slot and the food had been sitting around for ages. We had to microwave everything when I got home with our order. Burger buns and lettuce in the microwave don’t go well together so the food was very disappointing. When I walked in 8 minutes early on a Sunday night there were no customers and the staff were sitting at one of the tables so I’m sure they had just made the food when the order popped up. It was my first time trying Downlow but my husband had it before and thought the food turned up cold previously because of it being an Uber eats order but now we know it doesn’t make any difference. It appears the only way to ensure your food isn’t cold is to order in person😒

Had the HANGRY chicken - perfect amount of sauce, hashbrown, cheese and very juicy chicken. - great value for money! Very impressed and eager to try some of the other burgers on their menu. 10/10 will go again!

We got takeaways tonight and it was very disappointing. We had 3 different burgers and chicken and chips. The photo of the fried chicken burger says it all. I have included a photo of what is advertised on the website for comparison. None of the burgers included lettuce or onion, just a few bits of fried chicken and a pickle in a bun. We will not be coming back again.

Very disappointed. First time I've been to Downlow and I was very much looking forward to it. Very quiet night, not many customers, but it took over 45 minutes to get out burgers. It seemed like the Uber Eats customers were massively prioritized over us, which was a shame. I'd think you'd prioritize the walk in customers. Anyway...burger was good. Loaded fries were yummy, but I had to eat it with my fingers - no fork. We ordered six burgers , 4 kids' meals, drinks, and kids' meals. Only rating them down because of the service, not the quality food. Hopefully they improve.

Over an HOUR my uber order took. The driver was waiting in the restaurant for over an hour! I tried to call the restaurant several times and no joy. This was for just dumplings- not a massive order at all. Saturday 9 August, unbelievable.

I eat at DumpleWing a lot, usually through UberEats. Pay no mind to the bad reviews, bordering on review-bombing which I can't really figure out. This is a family business, top quality fresh and excellent food, awesome dumplings, fresh chips, excellent cornflake-crusted fried chicken. DumpleWing deserves your money, your respect, and your appetite, they're doing a fantastic job and have done for a while now. Good on you guys!
Amazing food, with so much attention to detail! Taste is just above expectation! We thought the first order qas a lucky night, but even with more orders, AMAZING!

This is a “virtual restaurant” for online ordering, their physical restaurant is Spring Kitchen. We had pork bao buns (good), fries (not good) and a tofu bao bun which had a tiny piece of tofu inside. Not quite as impressive as the ones in the menu photo!

I am unsure why this facility has so many negative reviews as in Uber eats they are sitting on 4.8 stars. Our family love this place great fresh and extremely tasty healthy food. Lovely people doing an amazing job. Only issue is the wait is getting longer as word continues to get out to the community as to how great the food is here.

had the mixed on rice today and it was a good portion as to be expected, no scrimping and scraping and being cheap, the food was well presneted with a good balance of rice, veg ans meat. its just nice to get what you pay for !! defintately you'll be back for more.
Hands down the best kebab shop in Auckland! Portion size never disappoints. Highly recommend the chicken fillet burger and chicken on rice!

This place is awesome!! The food is handmade, burgers are fresh, and the lamb is to die for. I am extremely impressed with Ahads friendliness and service. Everytime I come here, the quality is always superb and never changes!! I believe he has the best Kebabs you can find in Auckland in this little gem. Thanks, Ahad!
One of the tastiest kebabs I've had. I got the chicken kebab on rice and it was fresh, yummy and big portioned. The owner is super nice and friendly would recommend toya.
I love Ahad’s Kitchen!! Mean portion sizes and great prices which is hard to come by around this area. Thanks for all the great food ❤️

I had a lunch meeting earlier in the week when I snacked on the squid tentacles which were simply brilliant, tender and a balanced dressing. Accordingly I resolved to return for dinner at the earliest opportunity. The position and ample picture windows allow a terrific view across the Tamaki. Parking is ample and free. Bucks is under new ownership and the new fit out impressed me with the artistic and comfortable treatment totally in tune with its waterfront beachside location. A few days later my teenager daughter, also a foodie, and I returned. A Friday night arriving at around 7:30 and were lucky to get a table as the Bistro was almost full. We were promptly attended to by the young friendly staff and chose a selection of entrees and mains: house made flat bread and baba ghanoush; Burrata tomatoes with basil balsamic and hazelnut praline; Spiced Lamb Roti; Tagliatelle and Truffle shoestring fries with Parmesan . All the dishes were well balanced and innovative and thoroughly enjoyed by both of us. I accompanied my meal with an on tap Tuatara pale ale one from the extensive range of beers. The barman specialises in a wide range of cocktails made with appropriate panache. The atmosphere was pleasant with a live DJ and the music while audible not conversation drowning. The patrons all seemed to be enjoying themselves. Service was prompt and friendly without being obtrusive. I will certainly be returning.

Such an awesome dining space pretty much on the water at Bucklands Beach. Great quality food with a well thought out menu, a great cocktail and wine list to match too. Service was professional yet friendly making it feel like a very relaxed experience. It was a Friday afternoon into evening and there was a background DJ playing which set the mood really nicely ✨

Warm winter evening in a gorgeous restaurant like this is absolutely phenomenal. Greeted and seated with the most kindest waiter.
