The dinning area is warm with the fire place going which gives a perfect temperature where it wasnt too overwhelming, it was very comfortable. Food was delicious, starters I chose Duck Patte, trufle fries & seafood chowder, the duck patte was amazing, the seafood chowder was excellent and I love fries - these were def yummy too! For mains, I tried the beef cheeks and spiced lamb roti, both delicious, beautifully cooked, and melts in your mouth - generous portions as well. Highly recommend.

Service was slow the night we were there, however the food made up for it. We couldn't fault our meals, I had the pork belly and my wife the lamb roti. The staff were great and very apologetic for the slow service. Prices are generally on the higher end and you may need to order sides on top of the main to have the full meal experience, however all in all I'd recommend this place for the food and the location

Second time back and still love their meals especially the entrees. Recommend the arancini, soft shell crab sliders and the burrata. Mains wise the tiger prawns tagliatelle was good with Tabasco sauce, not so sure about the brussel sprouts risotto. Also recommend the lychee cucumber mocktail. Was expecting the maple bacon brussle sprouts side to be more dry and nicely seared with maple drizzle on top but we thought they’re a bit overcooked and slightly too sweet, bacons were amazing tho. Overall, recommend for the food and the vibe.

Pretty terrible customer service. Got charged twice for $55. went back the next day when I saw 2 separate charges on my account. No one wanted to know about it, took my phone number and have just been given false promises. Should be a simple refund for one of the charges… wouldn’t buy from here again.
Lovely staff, excellent service, pizzas are great! Store is clean and orderly. Highly recommended.

What a joke. Ordered pizza to be delivered. The driver kept repeated calling me asking for the address then hanging up (we suggested he used google maps). We tried to call the place itself and got told “I’m too busy to help” . Unfortunately when it arrived 25 mins later than it should have we got told “your mailbox isn’t right” Horrible and Rude.
Domino's Pizza at Massey is the best 😍 I always order here because the food is tasty and the service is top notch. Highly recommend ordering here!
Good pizza, quick service, only briefly lost my order lol

The shop already closed when we got there. But the staffs were very friendly and still let us in. We paid $5 for 5 fried bread but we got 10 in bag！❤️ We didnt know it until we got back home. It was a big big surprise for us after we got home.❤️ Thanks so so much. The bread are so tasty. 😊😊😊

Overall oily to the days like they put the basket straight into the paper disappointing chips soggy not to what I ask crispy ,fish batter fishy bland,sausage very bad taste awful who ever was on shift today 5/04/24 id rather drive out to go mangere bridge or idlewild out south for good fish n chips this place wouldn’t recommend it gutted killed my love of having fish n chips

Bought $25 whanau pack supposed to come with 5 fish it looked like 3 fish all squished together, batter was soggy and stuck to the paper, so much grease I could cook a roast with. Another lady brought her kai back coz the lack of fish and the lady cooking got in a crappy mood and said out loud she's not cooking anymore and went to the cash register. If you can't handle criticism and you can't put love into the kai that's being bought from you then I suggest you find a new job. I love tobys but the state of the massey store is sometimes really great kai and most times soggy, stuck to the paper food.

Absolutely glad we visited & purchased a variety of fresh seafood, seafood pies & fried bread. Beautiful island lady welcomed us and served our takeaway food. Fresh indeed and absolutely delicious! Definitely recommending this hidden gem!

Have had fry bread, raw fish salad from all 3 locations in Auckland. The west Auckland branch by far beats the rest in food presentation, the atmosphere and service. The food all tasted as expected - it was delicious.
Kids said it was the best pizza they have ever had！👍😆 They almost finished the whole pizza. The staff was quite thoughtful, and enjoy the chill and fun vibe there! Highly recommend 🥰

Sorry Sal's, but I have to share my frustration with my "Very Expensive" order so you have a chance to improve. Cheese pizza - VERY LITTLE TOPPING, ALMOST NO CHEESE, WHOLE PIZZA TASTED CRUST BUT NOT CHEESE MANY SPOTS MISSING THE TOPPING AND ALL I WAS SEEING WAS THE CRUST. Chicken pizza - ALMOST NO CHEESE, THE WEBSITE MENU SAYS CHICKEN BREAST, BUT IN REALITY IT IS CHICKEN NUGGETS! NOT FAIR FOR A $52 PIZZA. VERY SAD, now I'm $100 short and hungry still 😢. Pizza went to freezer, will give to unwanted visitors when they turn up.

I love sals but super disappointed tonight, I ordered food online at 4:39. Confirmation said order would be ready at 5. They hadn't even started cooking the pizza when we arrived. Took another 25 minutes from then with an empty shop. Went straight home to find all of the garlic knots were completely raw and pizza had next to no cheese and was stone cold... Called up and got a couple of free garlic knots for next time... Big whoop

Great experience at Sal’s Westgate! We ordered the Fire Island and Chicken pizzas, both delicious, and they even gave us free garlic knots! The staff was super friendly, making the visit even better. Highly recommend!

I’ve tried so many pizzas in Auckland, but I always prefer Sal’s westgate, just not because of food quality but they’ve best staff, i took my order yesterday evening, there was an indian guy who was serving food, he is very nice!!! Will definitely visit them again

The downfall of this restaurant is appalling. Been going here for over 3 years, suddenly I was told the menu had changed. Not in a good way. The picture below showed the before and after of the Burrrrito (chicken), both cost $26 except now it comes in a metal tin instead of a proper plate and lacks chili rice and coleslaw (extra $8) They also swapped out everything for corn chips and guacamole... What happened? I am saddened because this is my favourite restaurant and I'm afraid I cannot come back anymore. We usually sit right behind the reception, and are served by lovely waiters. But this change is unacceptable.

Family and friend times are very memorable moments. An outing becomes more memorable with good food and surely better service. It was our first day as a family and Sapphire made our time shine with pleasant and friendly service. Cheers to Lone Star Westgate.....!

We came here for dessert and were not disappointed! Highly recommend the milky bar pudding 🔥 also the best mocktails in the game! Massive shout out to Lexi for the best service too 10000/10, will definitely be back!
Malsha was our server tonight and she was super bubbly, thanks for making our experience enjoyable. Food was great and the drinks were yummy. Ribs, steak and kiwi fruit based drinks.
Lexi went above and beyond to make our hens night dinner enjoyable. She was polite, helpful and sweet. Shes definitely great at her job.

Went late hours but absolutely amazing service! Thought they won’t be welcoming because we went close to closing time. Very friendly and kind. Been to so many different Subways - the best customer service 👍
Love the fresh salad in sandwiches, service has been great when I was there.

Handy location, great services and tasty food as you would expect. Fast service too. Clean and tidy. Plenty natural light come through the shop front windows. One of the favourite local shops. Highly recommended for a visit.

Staff friendly and try to oblige whatever you ask for. Owners children at store play in public area and very boisterious climbing over seating and loud but young and bored cooped up in small area. Asked for extra cheese ( maybe couldnt hear because noise level from her children) got extra mayo instead and inedible as turned to slop. Had to throw away. Food usually really nice .Be prepared to pay more as prices are more expensive than other subway outlets. When queried told franchises can pick own prices. Meatball pots advertised online as 6 meatballs per pot. This subway only gives 5meatballs and was charging $2 more than other subways who put 6 meatballs in the pot.
Great service good management as they are always very hygienic and clean very friendly 👍 😀

We ordered a hot & spicy boneless meal and a deluxe three-quarter pack meal. However, we were informed they had run out of regular coleslaw, so we requested crunch slaw as a substitute. Upon receiving our order, we noticed that the hot & spicy boneless pieces were relatively small and consisted mainly of batter. Additionally, one of the gravy potatoes was overloaded with gravy, leaving us with a tiny portion of potato. The crunch slaw was also only half full. Furthermore, the staff did not pay attention to whether we were dining in or taking away, despite our order being specifically for takeaway.

Stopped by KFC today and was really impressed. The staff were welcoming and worked efficiently to get orders out quickly. The dining area was spotless and well-organized, with comfortable seating and a relaxed atmosphere. It felt like they really care about customer experience. The music wasn’t too loud and the whole environment felt calm and pleasant. Will definitely visit again!

I had a great experience at KFC this store. The food was fresh, hot, and delicious – especially the crispy chicken! The service was fast and the staff were friendly and helpful. Everything was clean and well managed. I will definitely come back again. Good food and good service – highly recommended!
Mould or paint? I showed to store manager the burger is moulded but he told me this is paint! The red color might be paint but the green I think is mould! Check before you eat!

Always a great experience at this KFC! The service is friendly and quick, and my order is always spot on. Really appreciate the accuracy and consistency. Love coming here — feels like my go-to comfort spot. Keep it up, team!

Service was great! Guy at the cashier and serving our food was friendly and polite. Food was delicious. Our family of 5 enjoyed eating here (including a 2 y.o. toddler) and were treated well. It's our favourite fast food place 👌🏽

I always order a burger with chips and aioli. Used to be good but the last few orders I did the chips box has been half empty its very frustrating when you get home and see that they did not fill it up. For $6.90 you think theyd at least fill the chips up to get your moneys worth but noooo.

The bro that works here 8.44pm Thursday, 15th may needs a raise. Good customer service, good atmosphere fast working and thinks fast in his feet, works under lots of orders and still puts a smile on there face when they leave.

I ordered the mitshufishi feed combo to takeaway and absolutely regret it!!!! Worst burger ever, over cooked & burnt, lots of yellow lettuce. The fries were cold & rubbery. The shake was nice. Will never go here again. Updated Review- I was sent a voucher for a free burger and side's from Burger Fuel. (see last two pics). I ordered an American muscle double burger that was fresh with juicey beef patties & sweet delicious pickles. This was an awesome meaty burger! Very big & I could not finish in one go. The side I ordered was smashed brown's with aioli & damn they were tasty & crispy! Thank you Burger Fuel I will be back for these delicious morsels! Thank you!

I had been visited last year and it was terrible. I did order two hamburgers. Staff was taking ordered and started cooking my ordered. Same time a customer came in for ordered his food and paid cash. I was quietly watching over the staff. Staff was handling cash then back to cooking my orders with touched cashes... he touched beef patties and veggies to makes my ordered. I felt sick after what I saw how he does.. OMG. I quickly called him(staff) and canceled m6 orders. And explained why. Then he,went to inside corner to spoke with manager. Manager came out to me and refunded the costs. I never go back to burger fuel since that matter. Never trust their food.

I thoroughly enjoyed my experience here. I was served by Garry at Westgate hells pizza. He was very helpful when I was indecisive to order a side with my pizza. I received my food very fast and someone even brought it over to my table. It’s the small things, going above and beyond for customers. The atmosphere was great! Vibey, fun, great music & energy from the staff. All working hard. I was then greeted by a lovely lady who helped me out (she knows who she is and what she did) thank you guys for your awesome service. I will always be back, here specifically 🫶🏼

We recently dove into a Hell Pizza feast, and wow—it was flavor straight from the fiery depths. From the crispy crust to the bold toppings, every bite was temptation in every slice. We didn’t just eat it… we sinned gloriously. 😈 Their spicy selections were hotter than the devil’s dancefloor, delivering a mouthful of mayhem that we couldn’t get enough of. 💥 Chaos, crunch, and unapologetic deliciousness? Yes, please. If this is what dining in the underworld feels like, sign us up for eternity. 💀 The last meal you’d request—again and again. We highly recommend Hell Pizza to anyone looking for food that’s as daring as it is divine. 🍕

First time having Hell’s pizza, came because I wanted to try the lamb shank which was delicious. The pizza I ordered was nice. Tried the desert pizza was delicious, had the crumb Camembert was delicious the garlic bread ok. Definitely be back to try other items.
Their pizzas are always fresh, loaded with toppings, and full of bold flavour.
Great pizzas, never disappointed!

Not only was the drive thru empty, they took a long time to give us our order, when we got home this is what my McChicken looked like, they didn’t bother to put in the mayo & lettuce 🤦🏽‍♀️ waste my time and money.
So how many peppers do you guys need to put in my burger? 90% Pepper 10% Burger.

Horrible service! They always forget things - I got a combo with a sundae and, no surprise, they missed the sundae. When I went back to get it, one staff kept me waiting forever, walking around after I reminded her twice. She promised 'be right there' but then vanished. It's just a sundae - how complicated can it be? Another staff finally noticed me waiting and got me my sundae in one minute. So frustrating!

This store really needs to be looked at. I came in-store to give the store a chance as I’ve experienced pretty slack drive thru before.. I purchased a McCafe Flat White from the kiosk and stood right next to the McCafe area. A lady called out my flat white from the register on the other side. I asked where the coffee was made, she said we have a coffee machine in the back. I asked if it’s from the machine or did a barista actually make it, which she responds “they’re all the same beans”. I asked for a refund and left. I don’t think this site understands the value in service. Blows my mind we’re in 2025 and this store just has bad experiences weekly. Who the heck is running the joint? I’d be reviewing all staff from the top to bottom, ain’t no way a franchise will tarnish an international name.

Just walk in and order a Mac Spicy combo + 20 pcs chicken nuggets and the boss burger. Take away and open the bag when home. no boss burger and there is no chicken thigh fillet instead of a MAC chicken . I don’t know what to say…

This sushi train spot in Westgate is always busy, especially with families and groups - it’s clearly a local favourite. I came here today with my parents, who love this place and already know all the best things to order. We started with the fried chicken nuggets, they were super crispy and a great way to kick things off. Ordering was easy with the QR code on the table. We got a good mix: some fresh salads, a sushi set, a sashimi set, and a big bowl of udon to share. The sashimi was probably the highlight - really fresh, nicely presented, and the pieces were surprisingly generous. We enjoyed every bite. The udon was also a perfect way to wrap up the meal - warm, hearty, and satisfying. The vibe here is really friendly and relaxed. It’s a bit pricier than some other sushi train places, but the quality makes it totally worth it. Definitely recommend if you're looking for solid sushi in West Auckland.

First timer here, quite a big place with a sushi train but not much on it during lunch time. The wasabi and pickle ginger is packs I would expect from a restaurant it would be dished. The sashimi platter we had was fresh. Total 2 person we had 11 pates, the sauce plate had to grab it from the back sitting tables and it shouted be round sauce plates as its annoying to add the soya sauce and wasabi and mix. Deco not bad. Not much of a service. Overall very average.

Looks like they cheap out on the coveyor belt's sushi selections. At least 6 chefs in the kitchen but the conveyor belt looks bare like nobody is trying to fill the belt with food. Saw this repeatedly on my weekend dinners (usually on busy hours 7pm) there recently. It feels like they deliberately avoid putting good variations of food there. Sure you can order for your table but we are there for the sushi train experience with non stop food grabbing from the belt. So sad, this place has been my favorite since they first open. I will go elsewhere for sushi train experience

The food is amazing but unfortunately they don’t commit to the hours said on google. There has been times that we arrived at 7:30pm and were able to dine in and the kitchen closed at 8:30pm, then there were times the kitchen was already closed at 7:30pm even tho it says 9pm everyday. It’s one of my favourite places but the timing puts us off sometimes as we never know if we will be allowed to dine in or not.

Honestly, this was one of the most lovely dining experiences I've had for a long time! The service was lovely, super friendly and attentive (even though it was a little busy!) Food - amazing and priced well in my opinion! The only minor thing I would complain about, and complaint is said loosely, would be the volume of the music. It was a little loud, but that's mostly for my own preference. Overall, 5 stars and would definitely recommend if you want a lovely lunch out!!

Me and my wife had Lunch Last Tuesday @ Good Brothers Westgate. It was Raining and we really enjoyed their Pizza and pasta. Specially the service. It was Amazing Service by “VAL”. He is very gentle person. Loved his service. Definitely Recommend.

Had the pasta making class with the lovely chef Logan and Marissa was showing us how to make cocktails. Such a fun experience and you get bang for your buck with all the food, cocktails and your gift when you leave. Highly recommend it for date night or a group outing.

Love the decor in this place. Not too busy for Sunday lunch. Service was A+ excellent. Portion sizes were massive. Brother enjoyed his Classic Seafood Marinara but the star for him was the Mango Sorbet. Perfect end to his meal. Daughters Loaded Pepperoni Cheeseburger meal was tasty with a fresh soft bun and lots of saucy goodness. Tiramasu was massive, she couldn't finish it. Scotch Fillet was cooked perfectly medium rare - super juicy and tender. Warm Bourbon Peacan Pie was absolutely delicious. Thanks to First Table booking for making this even more affordable.

I hadn't my breakfast and wasn't planning for lunch, so I thought why not to have brunch at Goode Brothers, I ordered mushroom burger, onion rings and pineapple juice for me. The taste were amazing, it satisfied my cravings for carbs and suger. I enjoyed it with lovely sunny and windy weather bcz I was seating outside. If you are vegetarian and don't know what to order, try this mashroom burger at Goode Brothers. It was lovely experience to have brunch there. Highly recommend. The staffs were very friendly and helpful. Everything was 10/10.

First time coming to Goode Brothers, and gotta say the vibes were immaculate! Nice and tidy, tables all set up really well too. Food came out in a super reasonable timeframe as well, and the portion size is super generous! The food was absolutely delightful, I got the fish and chips and the batter was light and crispy, and the fish was buttery but not in the heavy way. The service and staff was probably the best part though, everyone was SUPER sweet, and very attentive to our table. Big props to the crew, you made our experience a solid 5 out of 5! (:

I've been to this Nando's a few times, and it's pretty decent. It can get quite busy, so occasionally, some sauces or napkins might not be restocked in time, but it's easy enough to ask for them at the counter. The atmosphere is great, especially with the nice outdoor seating area. The food always delivers, making it a reliable choice for a group lunch when you're feeling lazy or indecisive.

Consistently disappointed, but I live in hope! The Mediterranean Salad with chicken was swimming in salad dressing! It’s not a lo carb option when you feel the need to rinse your lettuce again! And brown ugly lettuce tucked under the fresh. I rarely post disappointing experiences, but last time’s meal wasn’t prepared with pride either.

Popped in for lunch, food came out quickly and the food was great! Staff were nice, I def recommend the hummus with Peri drizzle and pita! The cheesy garlic pita was also very nice! I tried the peri harvest bowel with chicken and added extra chicken as a change, really enjoyed it and would order it again! would def be back

We had 2 whole chickens 2 bowels of chips Garlic Bread and a salad plus soft drinks for four adults . The food was just ok .below Average service , we ordered online via Nandos website . We ordered at the counter for extra items such as another round of drinks . - The staff did not check our meals were correct or if in fact we were enjoying the meal . Atmosphere was ok with tables available outside but there were few tables taken either inside or outside felt like a slow night despite being a Friday night at 6:00pm
The chicken was absolutely delicious. 100% recommend this place. Can you please open one in Orlando, FL?

Really delicious and healthy smoothies that are great for all ages. However, the prices are a bit steep for what you get. The staff are friendly and service is ridiculously quick which is awesome. Nice clean well laid out shop and located in a nice central are of the norwest mall which has lots of parking.

I always enjoy having a refreshing juice from Tank - menu does expand beyond just juices with smoothies and something to eat - all health based of course. May be perceived to be a bit pricey. Xtreme C with an extra shot of ginger is always a winner (full tank - don't mess about). Staff are friendly, you often find trainee's behind the counter), gets busy and could lead to longer than average wait times but worth the wait. Be clear on what you want and repeat your order to prevent any misunderstandings.

I first went to the tank outside the mall, to walk in and have signs up saying they ran out of salad boxes. A bit annoying but just drove over to the mall to the other tank. The girl took my order, a classic tank salad and tank mango. After 10min she tells me they don't have bacon and that I can replace with carrot or other veggies. I said to just add more croutons as I was put on the spot. Then I didn't get a sorry and was given my salad and my tank mango without a lid?! Eating the salad the lettuce pieces were rotting and discolored at the stalk and croutons were stale. Very disappointed, not worth over $20

Kudos to Arama Savage for making my Carribean Smoothies a dream and silky delight. It's the next best thing to a pina colada and it transcends me back to the Pacific Islands 🏝🇼🇸🌺 Love your mahi, Bro 🫶🤙 @AramaSavage @TankNorthwestMall @TankMassey

We've come here a lot frequently, and it's always been alright. Yesterday, however, there was only one staff member on her own, and heaps of orders coming through. The order machine also was not printing receipts or letting you put an order name etc in so it was telling you a number and then what came out of the machine on the staff end/once the drinks were made there was no number? It was extremely difficult to figure out who's drink is who's when there's more than 10 people in a small room and one staff member, and no one knows whose order is done and other customers are arguing with you and their order is tailored/has extras :/

Usually go to the noodle canteen in east coast road and absolutely love it. This time I went to the one in westgate and was absolutely horrible. Got the honey chicken fried rice and not only was the chicken raw but it tasted like old fish. Tells me that the wok isn’t cleaned. My partner got the chicken noodles and the chicken was also raw and it tasted of nothing but old fish.

I have ordered here a few times I get the Honey chicken noodles and they are pretty average compared to the one in The peninsula which is way better and priced better its worth travelling to from west harbour. Id say they could add some extra veggies and sauce aside from very tiny amount of carrot and 1 piece of brocoli I got given was no cabbage either.
Definitely wouldn't go here again, Henderson noodle canteen is way better Underseasoned food, tastes half cooked, no flavor at all to the sweet and sour.
Ordered a hot box and it tasted like fish unfortunately, have given them 2 trys while Henderson branch is on holiday. Ended up throwing food away will not return

I was excited to have found Noodle Canteen in Auckland and couldn’t wait to try it. Unfortunately it’s a disappointment, food is below average. It didn’t taste fresh at all especially the vegetables. I’m not sure if it’s just the Westgate noodle canteen that doesn’t have nice food. I’ll try the other ones in different areas to see if there’s any difference.

Always satisfied coming to Katsubi, friendly staff even when they are busy and what i appreciate the most is they pack the bowls with meat. Cant appreciate it enough. I was also 20c short for my drink and was happy to pay on card but they were nice enough to not worry about it. Totally addicted to how yummy katsubi is!

Ordered a donkotsu ramen and it was served in a disposable container. The disposable bowl was so thin that it folded when I picked it up spilling all the hot soup in it. I ruined my clothes and shoes. The thin pork meat in the soup tasted dry and terrible too.
Great place for a well filling lunch, only downside is you have to eatbthrough the meat to get to the vegetables at the bottom, but it doesn't really matter as it is all so good anyhow

I have never complained about the service attitude of a restaurant before, but this experience really shocked me. The service was terrible. When I tried to ask her about ordering, she deliberately turned her head away and ignored me. I was truly surprised to encounter such an attitude
To call this Japanese food is a misnomer. It's bland overcooked and tasteless. There is no pleasure to be found in eating this. I certainly don't recommend it to anyone.

These guys didn't hike their prices up like the rest of the take aways around in west Auckland. The food is legitimately good, I can feed a family with three adults and two children for $50-$60 and have left overs. It's tasty, and they're lovely. No complaints.

First time trying this place. I would not recommend. First all of very stingy with chips. Their fish is so thick and the flour is thicker 😳 their chicken nibbles.. disgusting!! If the below photo rows your boat, go ahead. I would recommend you are seen by a Dr because that batter falls right off and will leave you with a very white texture and flavour like of a boiled chicken. Never going here again so yucky. Disgusting fish and chips. No flavour, bad quality meat, only chips tasty but no good. You pay $10 chips you get 1 scoop!!!!!
Shop is run down. Chowmein not great. Fish and chips has no spice or lemon. Spring rolls had a weird after taste

It's a F&C shop so hard to give it atmosphere but it is our favorite for both F&Cs and Chinese meals. The service is always friendly. It's my once and sometimes twice a week fast food. They never disappoint.
Fish and chips were both undercooked which was very disappointing and chicken burger was very average
Was recommended this place. Very yum. Had the seafood curry. Asked for a bit hotter then medium and was perfect. A large serving definitely enough for two, but left overs for me.

Prawn Pad Thai (only got 4 prawns) with extra Chicken & 4 x Spring Rolls $23.00 all up, maybe a little pricey for what you get. Fast & friendly service. Tasty food. Spring Rolls come with Sweet Chilli Sauce. Portion size (2 people) was on the small side & if we hadn't also had the spring rolls we would have been wanting more.

This is our GO TO Thai place! We love it! We've been going here ever since it opened & it's delish! We have gone here A LOT of times! We have nearly been happy with every meal. We've tried lots of different dishes, e.g, Pad Thai Chicken/Prawn, Chicken Pad Peanut Sauce, Gai Pad Med, Pad Khing, Spring Rolls, Chicken Satay Skewers, Pad Se-ew, etc. It's all tasted super tasty. And all the dishes I've gotten have been loaded with veggies & yummy sauces & meat which is what I love. Prices have gone up over the years which is a shame but everything is going up so I guess it's to be expected. But definitely recommend! We always recommend to family & friends! :) - Pictured is the Chicken Pad Peanut Sauce!

Bro I had the chicken Larb this afternoon and it was it was a kicker🤣🤣🤣🤣I had stuffy nose before dinner…. Clear as a whistle… really tasty but I don’t recommend hot for the fainted heart…. Love my dinner #16 I think

Aweosme thai food. Small little shop but they pump out some beautiful dishes. Lots of vegetarian options. No dining in. A couple of seats to wait for your order. Best to call and place your order. English is about 70% so make sure to be very clear with your order.. no alcohol served. Dairy right next door to purchase your drinks. Tight parking outside

I usually go to Amana Butchers and found their products are reasonably priced compared to other butcheries in the market. Also they have wide verity of products and everything is halal certified too. Their customer service is above the par. I’m really glad we have such a great butchery close to us.I would anyone seeking fresh meat products to visit this store.

I visited the store today as I was looking for a local butcher. I arrived at the store and it was filled with unpacked boxes piled on top of each other. There was barely any space to walk through. There was only one guy at the counter attending to a customer, not sure if there was anyone else in the store. They barely had any meat on display, barely any options. The meat that they did have on display didn't look very fresh. They were only a small butcher, i'm sure they have better days, but I was quite dissapointed and will not be going back.
I visited Amanah butchery last week the quality of meat is amazing always fresh.They have great stuff
Always buy meat from Amanah butchery. The owner is so kind and friendly. The meat is always fresh and of great quality. Highly recommended!!

I recently visited Amanah Butchery and was blown away by the service and quality of the meat. The owner, Zach, was warm and welcoming and answered all of my questions about the halal meat. The store was clean and organized with a wide variety of meat options available. I purchased some lamb chops and beef skewers, and they were some of the best I have ever tasted. The meat was incredibly fresh and tender, and the flavors were perfectly balanced. The pricing was also very reasonable and competitive compared to other butchers and the supermarkets. I also appreciated the fact that they offer a delivery service for those who are unable to visit the store in person. The delivery was prompt and hassle-free, and the meat was still incredibly fresh. Overall, I highly recommend Amanah Butchery for anyone looking for quality halal meat. The service, quality, and pricing are all exceptional, and Zach is a wonderful owner who truly cares about his customers. I will definitely be back for more meat in the future!

Ordered a large mixed roast meal and got 7 huge pieces of potato to take up most of the container, got no chicken no lamb just a few small slices of beef, a couple tiny pieces of pork too much gravy wasnt nice. The potatoes are not tasty not crunchy taste stale.. Ordered a pork roll, it's completely cold and the delivery was only 3minutes away.. ordered crackle it's like a rock.. Ordered a large snack box, more yucky potatoes the only nice part was the 2 drumsticks.. feeling completely ripped off. This is sad you knew what you were doing sending this food away, What was supposed to be a treat for my family became $60 down the drain. How are you still in business. Shocking.

Has this place changed hands lately? This was my go to for many many years but tonight was so disappointing I will not be ordering from here ever again. I used Uber eats and I ordered 1 roast chicken meal, 1 roast lamb meal, 2 pieces of chicken with 1x potato, kumara and pumpkin. My order arrived completely missing the roast chicken meal. I called the store and the owner answered. He told me he did not get the roast chicken meal order only the extra pieces of chicken on the side and my lamb one. He told me to check my order. I did and sure enough I had ordered the chicken meal he just forgot it. He told me on the phone your order is cancelled now, I'll check it tomorrow. I told him that was unacceptable and I wanted it resolved now. He repeated himself over and over to the point I had to hang up on him. Luckily I could request a refund thru Uber. Next the quality of my lamb meal. Oh my God it's terrible. Its drowning in dark brown gravy which tastes more like some kinda Asian sauce then a gravy, the peas and carrots are watery, the lamb is just a bunch of off cuts with fat and chewy skin. It was terrible and pretty much in edible. Maybe my husband was lucky his meal didn't arrive because I wonder how good his one would have been if my one was to go by.
Real, old-school, unprocessed food. Great value. A generous roast dinner for the cost of a Big Mac & fries. Horseradish is great on the roast beef.

A really great spot with delicious crackling, yum cuts, perfectly cooked potatoes and good burgers (lettuce, tomato, gravy, meat). Solid price and solid portions. Guy who runs the store is very friendly and kind, adds a great vibe to the place and makes it feel like a welcoming environment. No pushy at all, lets you take your time ( :

We ubered our food and what a disappoint it was. Asked for no gravy we got a soggy lamb roll that our dog enjoyed lol. Drinks that were hotter than a coffee. Sadly I have still have angry hungry children. Please follow simple instructions as it can make a major difference. In saying that the apple crumble was divine but more crumbs please 🙏

With the amount of crap that this shop along with the other shops on this strip have to deal with each day in people - a 5 star is due as part of. Sushi is of a very high standard, especially around the lunch time mark when it's coming out fresh to replenish the lunch time demand. Staff here are lovely, even when people are stealing from them! do try the hot stuff, they have some lovely dinner dishes that are well worth getting stuck into. I think it's location doesn't do it justice, so don't expect to be walking into a Sushi bar that should have the same look and feel as in Epsom, with the same sort of personal space. This is Massey, and it's a very busy set of shops. They have huge foot traffic throughout the day through here. You can also order over the phone. They do make sushi to order too. Awesome for a quick feed of Sushi, probably the best around here. Have a great little hot press too with crumbed prawns etc. Lovely staff - always happy and smiling!
Would be yum if you like your katsu chicken over cooked with a soggy outer coating. Tasted and looked like it had been made in a microwave. My partners teriyaki chicken was well overcooked aswell.
The best sushi store with the best selection and the best service. Always a happy customer 😊
Such delicious Sushi. Staff are friendly and always happy to make fresh sushi to order. So good. Massey is lucky to have such a good sushi option.
Extremely good sushi. I was pleasantly shocked

The hygiene situation at Pizza Club Massey is worse. A cockroach is what was found yesterday in our fries. Might as well rename them "Roaches Masala Fries." Do not order from this anymore untill you see a complete change.

Ordered using Doordash. We got two small butter chicken pizzas for $25 Unfortunately the “butter chicken” portion of the pizza didn’t really taste like butter chicken, but rather than a very sugary tomato sauce with a bit of spice thrown into it. Hardly any chicken also All we could really taste was the cheese on the pizza. The base was well cooked, very crunchy so that was at least a somewhat redeeming factor.

Update Oct 2024: #NotHalal: Got to know that they have no halal certification. 🧨 This time the guy (Bunty) made us this special pizza with Tandoori chicken. Love it! The coriander 🌿 with the Tandoori chicken was delicious! Absolutely 💯 Our usual order is Chipotle Pizza and Beer Fries! Love them both! ❤️

Pretty average pizza with lots of pineapple, I could barely taste chicken in it I was a great fan of Chapel road branch but this one was not up to the mark. Also lasagna was too saucy and potatoes wedges were pretty dry.

i was buy 2 pizza both pizza was really spice my son eat half pizza bites and leave it whole pizza. do not think i want free pizza or any voucher but to be honest i am not happy with your meal because we are come in your pizza club because always buy from avondale brach and they make nice pizza. i dont know why they put lt lot of bleck paper on my pizza.

So yum and cheap. 13 dollar small meal is easily enough for dinner. The potatoes are my absolute fav, I cant stop eating them. The lady is so nice and kind and always generous with serving size. Thank you so much 🙂

Fantastic. In regards to The roast, I have had better, little pieces rather than nice big chunks of meat, but maybe thats just my preference. it was still a good roast though and a Decent size serving for $20 (large) the golden potatoes are delish! the thing that will keep me coming back though is the service. I Was greeted as soon as I entered and was served by the loveliest, most friendly lady. A very pleasant customer experience.

Arrive at 6:30 and only Lamb left. How do you stay open till 9 and have no food. Disappointed, the potatoes actually looked really nice, so did the last piece of fried chicken the guy in front of me managed to nab. Wont consider this place the next time I want a roast meal, no point coming if you can't actually supply customers the meals you say you offer.

Just moved to the area and have visited this roast shop two nights in a row now.. best roast shop in Auckland easily in my personal opinion. the way the lady was cutting the fine selected meats had me in a daze while waiting in line and delivered with flavour when devoured. Keep up the good hustle
Best roast potatoes in West Auckland! Always friendly service and decent sized portions.

**Cleanliness and Ambiance** This Japanese restaurant is clean and exudes oldie vibes, offering a warm and cozy feeling. **Service and Staff** The staff are lovely, contributing positively to the overall dining experience. **Food Quality** The food is of good quality, ensuring a satisfying meal. **Pricing** Prices are reasonable, making it a good value for the quality offered. **Space** The space is actually good and surprisingly big from the inside, despite appearing small from the outside.
Everybody working at Nari sushi is always so kind and friendly to interact with. When you order hot food, its packaged perfectly and has always been packed full.

Everything was good. Nari sushi deserve the best of food They have lovely staffs and very friendly for customers and very clean restaurant. Also the restaurant offer cheaper price than other restaurant and very delicious I highly recommend this restaurant to eat food
Super friendly staff. Will make it fresh. Such a bright colourful store. Great flavors and an A grade
Very sweet caring owner, values their customers with kind gestures, always friendly service and delicious food every time.

Consistently delivers delicious pizzas with fresh ingredients and a crispy crust that I really enjoy. The staff are friendly, and the service is generally prompt, making it a reliable choice for a tasty meal. They often have great deals which add excellent value, especially on their extra-large pizzas. Overall, Pizza Hut remains my go-to spot for satisfying pizza cravings with good quality and flavor
Customer service is very good, pizzas are very good, and I am enjoying myself with my family and friends.

the cheese on my pizza was overcooked! the heat in the oven was probably too high because the cheese obviously bubbled too much then it became rock hard :’( the pizza was not even cut properly too, I just can’t enjoy my stuffed crust i just wasted money on this branch. unfortunately worst pizza ever!I don’t even want to give this rating any star!
Today i ordered my pizza ,it was incredible absolutely pizza was hot as fries fresh n crispy 😋 👌 Services was excellent with smile and farewell too.

Order a pizzas online and made payment - the payment went through but the website timed out. Called the store which I was told the order was not received, and refund would be processed. Placed another order - only to find an email saying the order had actually been processed. Tried calling the store to cancel over 10 times without success. Both orders arrived, but we turned one away and asked for a refund due to the glitch. It’s been 5 days and haven’t had a reply and out of pocket $70. Pizza was also stuck to the box. Update: I have already filled out that feedback form twice about this with no reply.

Here for the lunch combo on Thursday. Ok so i don't usually give 5* but these stars are worthy because it is clean, has tasteful enough decor ... Comfortable seating and cool tables, even nice serveware. My butter chicken though was the best I've had. Not kidding here. Sauce, chicken and naan were all 😘👌 There's no music playing, outside noise is not too loud and some banging from the kitchen but that usually means an active kitchen. I've gotta bring hubby back here

Came to Moon Knight for a spontaneous dinner tonight as we were in the area and wasn’t sure what to expect as we have never been. Ordered two butter chicken combos and an onion bhaji, the onion bhaji was great value for money, we were expecting a few big pieces but got a huge portion that we had to take home in the end. The butter chicken was one of the best I’ve had in a while, if you’re looking for a good “kiwi style” butter chicken. The naan was honestly my favourite part so buttery and fresh, we will definitely be making the trip to eat here again.

I ordered butter chicken which is in my opinion a neutral dish for non Indian. Taste and volume is good, I forgot to ask if it has milk though. Will go back and try other dish in their menu next time.

One of the best restaurant of around massey area. the butter chicken, lamb roganjosh, goat curry and kadai chicken, chilli chowmein and momos were amazing. I spend great time in there. Highly recommend.oh one thing there is also available any curry+ rice +Naan Brade just 14.99 😱
This takeaway is great. One of the best chilli chicken I ever had highly recommended. Food is worth the price. Great service I would definitely buy more from here.
Phoenix BBQ Eatery serves tasty food, especially the duck on rice. The staff are friendly, but service can be a little slow. The place is clean and nice. It's a good spot for tasty Chinese BBQ.
Nice lunch and dinner place. Good portion sizes and good value for money. Friendly owners and they roast all their own meats. Roast duck is amazing and their beef brisket on rice is a must try.

I ordered and paid money, I’ve been waiting for 30mins then they sent other customer food, I asked them where’s my food, then found out they did not cook my food, what’s the point I’ve been waiting for 30mins?! Refund does not solve problem!
The staff are nice and the place is clean and tidy. The food tastes okay, but the dish is 95% rice with a few small pieces of meat and veges. I wouldn't go again

Beef brisket rice noodle soup was delicious. The soup was flavourful. Noodles a bit broken up into small fragments though. There were a few dirty dishes left at tables even though it wasn't busy. I waited a while to be served. Service not their high point.
Best chicken burger in Auckland. I have no idea how they can make it so juicy, while keeping the full flavour intact. My colleague and I are addicted. I will go back many more times.
Me and the bros were eating outside and owner gave us some free chicken shoutout to the bro

Wow, So first of all I haven’t tried this leave cause you know…. It’s not KFC but is better. Twice as good. Like. I comparison. Great service , brilliant product, value for money. Get this over the chains from now on .. converted

♿ A nice clean store .rating of "A" good variety of chicken selections to choose from. I bought the snack box and the chips🍟 were crispy and tasty as it complemented the chicken pieces🍗 Table seating if you like to dine in. Also you can order online. Wheelchair accessible I took a photo of the store. If I am passing by I would definitely stop in.
These guys have the best chicken burgers in Auckland.

Staff and place is great, but noticed the chicken fried rice, it would be more tasty if the chicken is stir fried instead of steamed, chicken has no taste. Hoping the fried rice has more green peace, bean sprout and extra ingredients. I also ordered chicken soft noodle, it has only chicken and noddle, i would appreciate if it has other ingredients like carrots and cabbage, cooked in stir fried.

I have to say this was my life worst experience ordering fish and chips, and fish burger. The food was not eatable at all. Me and my husband tried to eat it but was completely oily, beef taste because of the overused frying oil. The kumara chips was too soft and oily... I think when anybody wish to eat fish&chips none of us wish to get beef patty taste and overused oil taste. Very disappointed with it as based on reviews we expected a better food.

First of all the takeaway is so clean and always up to good standard. The owner is especially so so friendly and lovely to talk to, his staff are as well. The food, I would say the best takeaway I have experienced. Their fish n chips are so good 👌🏼 Food is so fresh !!! Best customer service !!!

This place is very clean and the service is great but I can't rate the food too high. My friend liked the fish n chips and said it's great but the Singapore noodle was not that great. $21 for a massive amount of gluggy noodles and little meat is just not acceptable. The dish was very dry and tasteless.
Always love going here, best fish and chips in NZ

Absolutely delicious Indian food! PotaLove offers rich, authentic flavors that truly stand out. Every dish is full of taste and clearly made with care. The spices are perfectly balanced, and the portions are generous. Friendly service and great value – highly recommended if you're craving real Indian cuisine!
We are really delighted to have such a great Korean restaurant in our neighbourhood now. The food was delicious, the side dishes were really tasty and service was great. We'll definitely go back

Had an amazing experience few days ago. The ambiance of the restaurant and the food was so good. We got the Chicken Sizzle and the Pork Sizzles. They came with side dishes as well. The food was served quickly with little to no wait time. I highly recommend this for anyone who wants to try Korean food or good experience.

Come and support these guys! We had a great Korean meal. I ordered the sizzling spicy pork ($24) with soju ($18). Delicious! The meal size is decent (it filled me), great flavors, great sides, great value and it took me back to Seoul and Busan. The service was also fantastic. I highly recommend! We will be back!

Just visited this place for the first time today and wow… I think I’ve found the perfect spot to wrap up a long day! From the flavor of the food to the service and even the interior vibes—everything was on point! The owner and the female staff were incredibly kind and welcoming, which made the meal feel twice as delicious! 🥰 The stylish interior and super clean environment really stood out too. It’s clear they care about every little detail. I’m definitely coming back—200% sure! And with such a wide variety on the menu, I’ll be recommending this place to everyone! Don’t sleep on this gem!!
First is the service- it was just splendid. 2nd the food - it was so delicious 😋 I highly recommended this place! Thanks guys, will come back definitely.

I had a positive experience with this food truck. The staff members were neat and friendly, creating a good impression. They offer a nice variety of Maori dishes, perfect for takeaways. My only suggestion would be to use a bit less salt in their preparations.
Everything is delicious and made with love
Best supermarket sushi. They always provide fresh sushi everyday and every time I do my weekly shopping I would buy a pack. My favourites are the salmon and prawn.
Amazing sushi 🍱! Their plater had so many amazing choices ranging from vegetarian to seafood! Tasted so great, I think this would have to be one of my favourite sushi places!
Always my fave sushi whenever I went shopping here. Great service, professional staffs and sushi is the best in West.
Easily my favorite sushi, heaps to choose from & fresh! Love it.
Fresh and delicious ! I wish I could have it more often for lunch
For the food ordered it cost $74 for chicken teriyaki, chicken udon and sushi packet. Absolutely robbery 🤦🏽‍♂️. And the portions were less than normal. What a ripoff and that’s been kind.

I just started working in the area and didn’t bring any lunch.. I wanted something warm and comforting so I walked myself into the restaurant. Young mi greeted me and helped me what to order I got the chicken katsu.. the portion was huge! I was soo happy. I will be back :)

I wish I could rate lower stars! WORST JAPANESE I’ve ever had!!! Will NEVER be back again, rang up and placed an order for 2 chicken katsu Yokisoba which they told me they could do and a side of mix vege tempura. Got there and they had only made one dish and not chicken katsu only chicken they said they don’t do chicken katsu yokisoba so I asked if they could do another chicken and I get a chicken katsu on the side. Charged me $10 for the smallest chicken katsu side I’ve ever seen! Got home they missed out giving me the miso soup, the chicken yokisoba was not chicken it was beef (even though they argued on the phone they don’t do beef? But was deff beef), the mix vege tempura was all pumpkin in tempura even though they told me I was wrong as there was carrot and kumara as well (it was definitely ALL pumpkin). They are rude, Absolute rip off place $$, no apology other than I was wrong, food was flavourless and not tasty at all and the service was terrible!! Don’t waste your money at this restaurant!!!
My favorite place to visit. Delicious food and amazing staff! 🥰 And just look at the serving. Really aesthetical. Definitely recommend to visit this place!❤️

Not been here for a while. Expected higher prices for the hot food but the serving sizes are now smaller. The flavours have also changed and not better. There are better Japanese food places out there with reasonable prices.

My partner and I dropped in here for a quick meal before visiting family. Food was tasty and the restaurant was a nice decor, the same as what I was used to seeing while growing up. I live in Hastings now and our BK interior sucks 😞 Love the cushion seats and the booth settings. Pity they don't have the memorabilia on the walls anymore or the jukebox but there's still some originality in her and it was a nice nostalgic little visit.
It’s a huge place to seat around, friendly for family gatherings, meals comes quickly but front lady was in rush I think, she couldn’t repeat my name when i confirmed order.
Love this branch. Big, clean, efficient. Plenty of space and parking. Good deals too.

My friend ordered and paid for meals and we both saw the order numbers, but after 10mins still nothing showed in their system, it is really disappointing for big company, please take photo of your order otherwise you have to show bank transfer information to prove your payment also no paper receipt is a bad experience.
It was very messy and the service wasn’t the best. There were other peoples rubbish everywhere and they haven’t cleaned it up yet almost like they were waiting for the day to end.

We have been consistently coming here regularly in the last few years, from when they were still named as Hansan to later re-named to Golden Viet (although still under the same umbrella group as Hansan). We always order the raw & cooked beef pho. At least in the last couple years or so, I found they have changed the type of cut for their cooked beef as it's always very fatty. Most of the cooked beef pieces have a big chunk of fat on them and I usually bite those off and just eat the rest. On our visit today however, ALL the cooked 'beef' in my bowl were all fat. Pieces and pieces of just fat, couldn't eat any of it. My partner's one wasn't that much better neither. We got a separate small bowl to put all the pieces of fat that got picked out and it was full. When I went to pay, I said to the lady (an older lady) I wanted to give some feedbacks. Explained it but she didn't understand it so she got a younger girl to come and talk to me. I explained it again and said I just want you feed this back to the kitchen/chef. Instead of taking it onboard and say something like 'thanks and I will let the chef know', she got a little bit defensive and said something like 'oh we buy a big piece of cut, we can't control what meat we get'. Yes but you can control what you serve and you can choose not to serve something that is not up to scratch. You can portion out the fat rather than serving all fat to one customer. What struck me the most was her response and attitude to my feedback. Just remember that as a business, every feedback from the customer matters

Their egg yolk steam bun is the bomb. Get that, it's really good. The staff are polite but not too attentive. They are not on a break rotation, so if you come in for dinner you may find the floor staff and the kitchen staff all seated together at the back of the restaurant eating dinner and find yourself not getting greeted at the door. Furthermore, if you do get seated you're basically invisible to them and will get no table service unless you stand up. The rice noodles soup dishes came with quite small broken bits of noodles like they were spare, off cuts. Quite disappointing.

i believe is part of the Hansen chain, just had the Pho and mushroom green pastry dim sim here and was bloody delic. Should of had the yum char special but i was on my own, oh well maybe next time eh. See pic

Original is Hansan. Even is change name. Chinese own restaurant and making vietnamese dish it no good. Except spring roll and Bún bò Huế Give thumb 👍. Phở lack of lemon grass and herbs. Taste blanc. Dimsum is ok. Never go back there.

Used to be Hansan, changed to Golden Viet.. We booked 30mins prior and we got a table right away. Food is amazing, fresh and very tasty..The kids enjoyed and love the food. Though they are understaff, they managed to serve well, quick with a good attitude and a smile.. Highly recommended!

Food is delicious and fast service too didn’t have to wait long for our food to come out probably because we went in when it wasn’t to busy in the evening we ordered: - Prawn fritters entree 10/10 crispy & fresh - Springrolls entree 10/10 - Pork & Rice cinta special this was delicious ! the pork has a hint of sweetness to it but not too overpowering with flavours which makes you wanna eat more of it - crispy duck never tried duck before so wanted to give it a go it came with sauces on the side but for me the duck itself was good enough to eat on its own - sizzling chicken with coconut rice this had a lot of flavour that worked well together and doesn’t taste like bland cooked chicken , whatever sauce and spices they used for this meal enhanced all the flavours perfectly. - Malaysian Chicken on rice my partner loved this meal he ate it all in one go! we are both fans of food that have flavour in it but it’s a bonus when the chefs know how to balance those flavours perfectly for each meal so it’s not overpowering but also not bland as well . All the food was 10/10 for us especially for the kids who enjoyed it too their portions for a small dish is a lot bigger than the usual it’s worth the price. Drinks : Lychee & coconut mocktail if you like lychee as much as I do this drink was yummy ! Bartender is a young bought our drinks out fast & made my mocktail Customer Service: All the staff including a man who I assume is the owner here were very friendly, attentive and welcoming ! the young Māori/polynesian girl who served us was also the bartender she was fast with our orders came back to check on us a few times I think she was the only bartender on at the time probably because it wasn’t a busy night so of course we didn’t mind waiting, the young girl who served us was also helping another friendly attentive waitress with the orders they both did a good job handling it all with a professional and friendly attitude. Atmosphere: Beautiful setting , indoor and outdoor don’t need a booking to walk in. Kid friendly and family friendly too Would we recommend to family , colleagues and friends ? Yes we would Only had photos of the mock tail and caramel cheesecake desert below ❤️ food was already being eaten by the time I remembered to take photos

I came here with my colleagues to celebrate. Very friendly. Food was delicious. Service was great. Only downfall, I waa the first to order (by 10 minutes) yet I was the last to receive my food (by 10 minutes).

I highly recommend this place. They accommodated us even without reservation. Ambience is nice, with low soft music that enabled us to talk. And food is good and has huge servings. I ordered Nasi Lemak Beef Rendang. Amazing!

The restaurant looks great — stylish and nicely decorated — but that’s where the positives end. The food was below average and definitely not authentic Malaysian. On top of that, it was overpriced for what you get. The service didn’t help either — the server didn’t smile or make us feel welcome. If you're after real Malaysian flavours, you’re better off going to Kampung Style or Uncle Man’s. Much more authentic, better value, and a friendlier experience.
Favorite Malaysian fusion restraunt. Greens are always fresh, food is tasty. When you feel like something different with that authentic taste and vibe.

Uber eats for the first time, chose Slate as their food looked delicious. They did not disappoint, my god the food was amazing! I ordered the pulled pork burger, man that was the bomb. The pork was moist and juicy. Soooo good. And it came with steak cut fries. Tryna eat the burger the sauce was running down my arm haha. It was $26.50 and I'd definitely get it again. I also ordered the Roti chicken tacos. They have a good little kick of spice to them. Chicken is tasty. And I ordered the salt and pepper calamari. Learnt my lesson with this one, nothing against them but I didn't take into account the distance travelled and so they were a little rubbery by the time they got to me. But that's on me, I was 20mins away. But I'd love to try them again but at the venue. Overall my order came to $70, was my first time having food from SLATE and I was very pleased with it. In my eyes the food is worth the price. Would 100% recommend.

Our waitress Emma, was incredible. She bent over backwards for us to serve us our delicious food. Her customer service was impeccable, felt like I was at home. Was extremely friendly to us and catered to our every needs, even recommending to us the best options for food. Definitely a superstar worker.

Great staff members, awesome customer service and very polite. Welcomed us warmly. Food was very delicious and fantastic "I must say please try the Calamari and Aioli "and great size jugs for soft drinks saving us to buy individual glasses. Servings are very filling and prices are great. A big acknowledgment to Hose and the Chef. Fabulous place would recommend it.😊

I was not expecting much when I first visit the place. Thought it's just another pub restaurant. Yes the place doesn't look that upmarket and I would probably say the dining space requires a little touch up and R&M. However, it's a pub and bar restaurant so not an issue for me. Most importantly, the food is amazing good and tasty. Hearty and servings portion is very reasonable with the price. The service was attentive and welcoming. BTW, their pull pork loaded fries are amazing. The pull pork is full with flavour and tender.

Came here as a duo & ended up calling my other siblings for a munch! We got tha buttermilk chicken burger w fries & a margarita pizza. Atmosphere was beautiful, music was great and the meals were so good for tha price! If you’re looking for an affordable place to eat out west would definitely recommend Slate. Customer service was beautiful too, thanks team 🤍
Nice and cozy place to have morning coffee and breakfast Spinach and feta scones must try !!

Quite disappointing. Just had breakfast here on a Sunday morning and my partner and I have been having a nice morning until the lady that served us at the til ruined the mood for us. My partner is currently strict dietary restriction so only I could eat out and he’d just accompany me. He just wanted to have a look at the cookies at the register so he lifted the lid but didn’t come closer to sniff or anything, but the lady snapped at us. She was already unfriendly to begin with but she told us off twice rudely so it ruined the mood for us. Please do better in your service as people come to cafes for a nice morning and staff service can affect that.
I went to get a coffee and I couldn't drink it. It was the worst coffee I've ever had in my life.

Visited this place today—never knew Robert Harris had a shop in Westgate until now. I went in for a snack but, after looking at the menu, ended up having a decent breakfast. I ordered the Eggs Benedict with smoked salmon and smashed avocado. The portion size was generous for the price, and the eggs were perfectly cooked. The dish was generously covered in hollandaise sauce, which is quite rare these days, as most cafes only serve a small amount. I personally prefer it this way, though I know others may feel differently. The portion of salmon was also good. My partner ordered the smashed avocado—good portion size as well. The combination of avocado, sautéed onion, beetroot hummus, ricotta, and dukkah worked really well together. We didn’t get a chance to try their coffee, but we’ll definitely be back for that.

I came in for brunch with my friends on a Saturday morning. The place was quite busy but the line at the cashier was short. I have been to other Robert Harris before so I know I will always get good food. My friend ordered peach iced tea and really enjoyed it. She was almost finished with her drink when she noticed there was a big black ant in her drink. She returned the drink to the staff and the staff just said 'eww' and threw the drink away. When my friend went back to our table we asked if she was offered to get her drink replaced. She said nothing of the sort was said. We must have talked about it too much and too loudly that eventually another staff approached us and asked my friend about her drink. The staff then asked my friend if she wanted a new drink or a refund so my friend said a refund. The staff refunded her and apologised. We told the staff we appreciate her gesture. It was a good save. Appreciate that staff for her very good approach. I loved my bacon and egg croissant by the way.

Bubbly staff, great place to relax and unwind in a convenient spot just outside of the mall. Coffee has a strong kick, parasols are set up for sunny days so you can enjoy outdoor coffee without getting burned, nice breezy hallway-esque street. Small venue so some mornings you'll find that it has no vacant seats left. Coffee cards available, every tenth coffee is free. Some specials pop up here and there so come back frequently. Enjoy your stay, it's a good one.
Charming place to have a snack and a coffee. Friendly staff. Friendly to breastfeeding mothers. Nice selection of counter food. Skilled barista.
Best coffee place in the area, if you want a coffee get it here. Excellent coffee Yummy food Great service

I wanted to try and different cafe as I wasn’t too impressed with the one I have been visiting. I looked at google reviews and decided based on this to choose Orra. Upon entering Linda had such a warm welcome, genuinely interested in what I had to say, she showed me the yummy baking they had available, followed by fast service. The blueberry muffin is by far the best muffin I have ever had! ❤️😁 and the coffee was perfect too. To top it off she poured a glass of water and brought it to my table. If you could have a best friend as a cafe it would be this. The best way to start my morning. Thank you for the best food and the best service! 🦋❤️❤️❤️🌈💕 To make people feel good, seen and valued in your role is absolutely amazing. I had goosebumps. Thank you thank you thank you!
I came with my mom to this cafe, though it is small, the cafe is an awesome place to go to, it has a relaxing environment, awesome staff members and delicious food.

Where are my chips?? And the staff (glasses guy) had the longest face and zero patience. Didn’t greet us, cut me off mid-sentence, and just pointed at the screen like I was wasting his time. Bro, did you wake up on the wrong side of the bed? I was just picking up my order—no need for the attitude. Chicken was dry but the hot spicy sauce was decent while the spicy level was way too high. A kind reminder: a little courtesy goes a long way, and attention to order accuracy and food quality would make a huge difference.

I enjoyed a delicious seasoned chicken bowl that absolutely hit the spot! The owner was super friendly, and the chef made the amazing chicken. And I personally Big thanks to them. The chicken had the perfect balance of crispy and juicy, paired perfectly with rice and salad. It was a satisfying meal that left me wanting more. If I lived nearby I’d be a regular. Gonna miss it when I’m back in Korea. 👍👍👍
Unfriendly service. Old pieces of chicken covered in sauce to disguise the average cuts. One peice tasted super weird and funky. Made me feel sick. No wifi for customers.

We ordered online and it was our first time ordering from here so we didnt know what to expect. We got fried chicken and regular chips. The staff forgot to give us our chips so we had to call and drive back to pick them up. They werent cooked in the first place so we were told to wait 7 minutes. Takeaway is not very convenient as the surrounding streets were busy and there were no nearby free parks. Our chicken was cold by the time we managed to get home again but the flavour was fine.
Chicken made really fast, so probably not fresh fresh. They missed out the sauce. It's a food hall, so atmosphere is meh

Not proper Pho and a weird gummy Tang Soo (sweet & sour). Pho lacked depth and flavor ……and wrong noodles were used. The Tang Soo was tasty but the batter/coating was gummy. The sweet and sour plum flavors were good though. Disappointing and over priced for what it was…. Staff were very friendly and service was great.

Owner alway kindly and taste also great. They doing special price on Mon-Tue. Big black plate only $29. I ordered Prawn plater. come with rice and kind of radish and carrot pickles. Vegetable was so fresh and when sh e serve to me sound like rainy ☔️it means just cooked and so hot. That is why picture look like that.

Happily stumbled across Pho Heaven recently under a dark cloud of hangry. I ordered the Pho with beef & wonton and nourished myself... I've been back twice - just to be sure, and in my opinion, the broth is amazing. I can feel my body rejoicing as I eat/drink/devour it. Soooo good. Lovely people. Clean dining area. Very fair price. I'll see you next time 🙂

Located in Westgate shopping complex. My new go to. happy to find this place. can’t say it’s authentic Vietnamese food but flavourful enough to suit my palate. Particularly their beef pho is to die for. Lovely staff, fresh ingredients, clean atmosphere, plenty of parking, plus royalty cards which can give you a discount.

My husband and I enjoyed our dinner at Pho Heaven Vietnamese Restaurant on 19/4/2024. My husband loved the vegetarian fried noodles and vegetarian spring rolls. I loved the shrimp fried rice. The owner is a lovely lady from Korea and she works so diligently in the restaurant as there are lots of customers at dinner time. We highly recommend you to have a lovely lunch or dinner there if you happen to live in Massey or visit there.

First time I have been here, and I'm so glad I did! What a hidden gem! I can't believe I haven't been here before. Had a delicious brunch with my granddaughter. Service was awesome and not too long a wait for food to be brought out nice and hot. We had a giant pancake with blueberries and a chicken & bacon club sandwich with fries. So yummy! Big portions, we could only eat half of it, so we took home leftovers. My white hot mocha was perfect with a side of marshmallows. Staff were attentive, bringing water with glasses to the table on arrival. I will definitely be going back! Thank you!😊 Update: after my visit 3 weeks ago I have been dreaming about the pancakes! Today's visit was amazing, great customer service and delicious food.

I really love getting breakfast and brunch here! The food is always really nice and hot, and the servings are quite large, so I feel like I get my money's worth. There's quite a big selection on the menu as well. The service is always great too, the team are lovely and fast. Sometimes it gets quite busy, but we're always seated quickly and our order is taken just as fast. At worst, you might have to wait a few minutes for the food to come out, but that's to be expected especially during a lunch rush! The vibes are great too, though it can be a bit noisy when busy since everyone's quite close together. The tables are always nice and clean, and the decor is cute. Would recommend for breakfast dates!!

The food was delicious and in nice big portions. Nice and cosy atmosphere, perfect for a nice Sunday breaky.. Not sure if it was just a bad day for them, but the service was extremely slow and not the friendliest as expected.
Their chefs must be great because the Food was very good
I had breakfast here this morning Eggs Benedict with extra mushrooms. A coffee and an orange juice Very nice . The service was Good and the atmosphere was excellent I was able to eat outside

Lunch menu starts from $22 per dish. A little pricey but understandable as they serve complimentary Chinese tea and soup and the portions were huge! One dish can actually feed two people but we wanted to try both the roast duck and roast pork. Roast duck was delicious and duck oil coated the rice, making every bite a delight. Roast pork was tender yet had a wonderful crunchy skin. Admittedly, towards the end, it got a bit cloying as it was quite rich but the Chinese tea helped in refreshing our palates. Unexpectedly the restaurant is bigger on the inside and looks like any typical Chinese restaurant. Service was fast (don't blink) - received our food within 15 minutes. Staff were pretty welcoming upon our entry into the restaurant and assisted promptly when we needed anything but otherwise left us to our meal, which we appreciated. They also sell various ingredients at the cashier - chilli oil, peanuts, salted fish, duck wings, duck feet etc. May need a translation tool though. A whole roast duck for takeaway is $50 and they very kindly entertained my request to have the bones separated. Would happily recommend and return.
Lunch special around $22 and the portion was huge. My fav was the fish fillet and tofu on rice. The complimentary soup was tasty too.

SCORE: 80 Came here for lunch, very affordable with massive portions. Value for money here is amazing. Highly recommend. Food tasted great, and it came with free tea and soup. Will definitely come back here again. I saw other review badly on service, I will agree they do the bare minimum, but I won't complain.
I ordered lemon chicken, but there was barely any chicken to be found – it was mostly just the batter. In the end, my family tried a little, but we all gave up on eating it.

Been coming here years and usually really enjoy it, tonight I went and it was just ok, the server wasn’t very helpful and I also found a fly in my prawn ball which was not very appetizing 😳 all they said was sorry

The worst butter chicken I have ever had. The sauce is so diluted it has no taste; the chicken was overcooked and dry to a point it's rubbery. The garlic and cheese naan was staled and again no taste to it. Won't go back again and do not recommend.
I was not expecting a small indian place in a food court to be this good. The naan was great and our butter chicken and mango checken were very tasty. Highly recommended
Paneer kulcha was yum! Made fresh and spicy too. Loved it. Naans are always good too.
Cold Butter Chicken, turn your warmers up!!! Stale Naan bread, seemed like it was sitting there for ages. Curry wasn't great either!! Won't be back.
Chick pea curry is runny as. The worst tasteless curry ever I had in Auckland.

Incredibly overpriced. Asked for a sushi to be swapped out from cucumber to avocado and said I was happy to pay extra but yet they refused to make it. This was at 10:30 in the morning when they had no customers. $14.50 for an eight piece sushi with no avocado in itis outrageously priced.
Quick and easy, everything goes well with wasabi. The disposable chopsticks and paper trays harm the experience but that's to be expected from a food court meal.

Ordered the salmon teriyaki donburi for $17 and received the beef teriyaki donburi ($15.50). It was delicious so could not complain. It was prepared quickly and the server was friendly. I’ll probably go back to try the salmon. I hope I get it next time.
Do not buy the $17.90 Prawn and vege tempura which consists of 1 battered onion ring, 1 battered pumpkin, 1 battered prawn and bowl of noodles. So disappointing
Tofu Donburi is consistently delicious, been several times. Staff & service are always great Highly recommend
The chicken they serve here is spectacular. Its always juicy and fresh and are generous with chicken. Fantastic place, I reckon they beat KFC by a landslide with their golden chicken blend!

We've always ordered the 15-pc meal and always get a good mix of the different parts.. always hot and juicy. Today, we ordered the 15-pc meal again.. we got 11 breast, 2 drumstuck and 2 wings!!! They were dry... not happy

Texas by far has the best fried chicken. The staff is friendly too. But, I am not sure why they are busying mopping during lunch hour when they just opened the restaurant less than 3 hours ago since morning. The floor was so wet even with my sports shoes on, a little child fell. It left distinct soap mark on the floor even after it's dried. If you are going to make the floor so wet, please put some fan to dry the floor faster, it was so hazardous. The staff was busy pushing tables around so they can mop. I then saw the staff cleaning the table using his bare hands sweeping away the crumbs from the table onto the floor so he could sweep it. I am shocked. Where is the management ensuring staff hygiene is looked after as well? Were they paid to make sure the restaurant is fit to open before official business hours? I have not seen a restaurant like this my whole lifetime, leaving me very shocked. Texas, please look after your people and the atmosphere when people are dining, and make sure the place is fit to be a proper eatery place.

I came in store for a quick meal with my parents as it was quick and easy. The food was barely warm and was ok…. The restaurant itself was disgusting….empty boxes of food left on tables, spilt drinks on the floor and generally dirty throughout the dining area. I definitely will not be back

We had a wonderful experience at Texas Chicken thanks to Maninder, who went above and beyond with her customer service. She greeted us warmly, handled our order efficiently, and made sure everything was perfect with a genuine smile and professionalism.

Came in on Saturday night, food took nearly an hour to be ready. Yes it's not technically "fast food" but I wouldn't wait an hour at a restaurant either. Chips were uncooked but the seasoning was nice. I had to cook them in the air fryer at home. The kebab was nice. The fried chicken was quite bland, needed some salt at least. Overall, not terrible but definitely needs some improvements (maybe extra staff on the weekend).

Had a great experience at this kebab shop! The food was fresh, tasty, and full of flavour. A special shout-out to Suresh for providing the best customer care — friendly, polite, and always going the extra mile. Highly recommend this place for anyone craving a good kebab and excellent hospitality!
Best kebabs in Auckland! On par with HSP in Australia (which are pretty damn good).
Grabbed a kebab and it hit the spot. Meat was cooked perfectly, salad was fresh, and the sauces tied it all together without being too much. Simple, tasty, and filling. Will be back for sure.
Even tho it took a while lov that our food wasn’t rushed! Made with love Ngl such a great first experience food was 10/10 definitely recommend
Fresh tasty beef Pho, the squid is so good & the fresh spring rolls are yummy 10/10 cannot stop ordering from here
Best beef Pho I had for a while, pho was soft, soup was very tasty. Not 5 star because a bowl of plain cooked rice was $5, which is quite steep otherwise the food was very good.

Each time when I go to northwest food court. Buns N’ Rolls is always my first priority. In my opinion I think they provide the best Vietnamese food. U can tell how much I love their food. Even I Uber food I order food from Buns N’ Rolls too!
Pricy for an average quality Asian cuisine. Especially when served with disposable cutleries, overall experience is poor. The crispy chicken or pork buns are, however, really nice.
The best customer experience ever. The most delicious food! Thank you for having vegan options. And especially thank you for all the nice compliments from the staff. Will come again

Some would say the kebab is perfectly portioned here. Great taste and fresh ingredients. Hygyne is an issue. Watching the young guy go from till straight to my kebab without sanitising his hands is concerning. Try at least sanitising your hands b4 touching my food. The owner was lovely.
