He asked me why I didn't order a combo and quickly said his chips were the best, and he ordered special seasoning that only his store has. He then proceeded to season a chip and gave me a taste test. They were delicious. Next time im here, I'll definitely try out the combo. Passionate and lovely guy. Thank you.

Food tasted like it was reheated from day before. This is the 2nd time I have eaten here after having a bad experience 1st time and it is still same. Definitely not going back after another bad taste in my mouth!

Super friendly! Huge portions! We had Medium Chicken on Chips and Large Low Carb option with mixed Meat and extra Cheese (already ate a bit before taking the image). One of the best Keto Lunches I had in a while.

We’re from South Auckland and this is by far the worst kebab I’ve ever had. The owner is so arrogant and rude which made us feel so uncomfortable. we ordered 2 meat on chips and 1 rice on meat with 3 drinks. And the total was $85. 00. This price is unbelievable for what they actually serve. Meat was so cold, rice was so hard. He claims it’s the best kebab you’ll ever have. I hope one day you can live up to ‘ the best you’ll ever have’
Wonderful owners,friendly and fast service. Great kebabs and reasonable price, similar to most other Turkish establishments.
If you’re in the food court looking for a snack that’s different from the usual McDonald’s and katsubi etc than give king pao roti a try It tastes good and it’s only $12.50
The lunch dish that everyone can refer to is Beef stew with Bagnette, it is very delicious and suits my taste, it is wonderful, it is the new dish of the store.

Unfortunately this was one of the saddest meals I've ever had. Huge portion of rice, afew vegetables and some overcooked tofu with a small amount of soy sauce chucked overtop. The rice had zero flavor, the vegetables were just steamed veggies, no flavor and the tofu (you guessed it) no flavor. It was over $20. Thought I'd give it a try but won't be going back.
Always very yummy when I come here! The dumplings are always so fresh 👏
Best mall food I have had. Amazing beef brisket Laksa at a very generous price

DON’T EAT HERE! My mum found a hair in her mushroom sauce while we were eating our meals & put us both off straight away. Spent almost $70 here and now we’re too disgusted to eat the rest of our food. My steak loaded fries tasted weird & the cheese sauce was clumpy and too thick. You will be best off getting a meal at King pow! They’ve never disappointed us.
Beautiful meal , grilled steak and chips with salad and sauces ,fresh ,tasted perfect. The lady prepared my meal with perfection. Thanks for making my meal special it may just be the best yet 😋

The 1st meal, delicious. Went back 2nd round, tried 2 different meals! The creamy mushroom wasn't that bad, it lacked a few things. Burger had to much veges for my partners liking, other than that. This place, is a place to explore!! Cheers

Ordered a bun with bacon, egg and lettuce. Arrived very soggy and greasy. I wiped it against the paper it came in, and ate it as I was hungry. Took the paper up to the counter, to show the condition of the paper, the bun was served on. I was told maybe it was the egg at fault or too much mayonnaise. Wow! Do not recommend….

I think a lot of people forget that this is a fast food grill and not a resturant =). The food was cooked perfectly to my liking and every bite was goodness. $20 for steak, 2 eggs and plenty of fries how could you go wrong. Definetly a great place to stop if you want grill on the go, yes they may not cook exactly to ur specofication but they do there best and deliver exceptional grill fpr the time it take, staff are grea and everything is clean. Definately a go to when im in a hurry. Thanks Kiwi grill team =).

Ate here yesterday with my sister and we absolutely loved it! The service was awesome and the food was even better! We didn’t even mind the wait as the atmosphere was so welcoming and warm! The food was absolutely delicious and would recommend to everyone who will listen!

Popped in here for the first time for breakfast. There were quite a few tables vacant but covered in cups and dishes from the previous diners. There didn't seem to be anyone clearing them while I was at the counter waiting to be served. I placed my order and asked if anyone would be clearing the tables soon as I'd like to dine in. I got a death stare from the lady taking my order and another lady asked me how many people. I said just one. Paid for my omelet and waited. No one commenced clearing tables so I just moved cups from one table to another myself. Omelet came out. Very overcooked and dry. This place was a disappointment and I wouldn't bother eating here again. Unfriendly service, poor presentation of food. Spend your money elsewhere.

I was there with my husband at lunch time on Friday. Pros: Food was made very quickly 3 free tables inside Nice and smiling staff Free tap water Just FYI: Kind of self-serve Bacon in mixed grill is not crispy Cons: The Almond and custard bun was too hard to cut and we asked for a steak knife. The grill mixed came with warm, melted butter :( The staff didn't ask for feedback and I was too shy to ask for a butter replacement 🤷‍♀️ The tomatoes in the beef burger and mixed grill were not juicy and tasty. To sum up: From my point of view, this place is not fully bad, it’s 4/5. In general food was okay. I was expected to get a better-quality dishes.

Came here for a quick breakfast before browsing the mall. Ordered a french toast and a mocha which both didn't disappoint. The french toast tasted very fresh, flavourful and delicious while the mocha was great. The atmosphere was very welcoming as the worker at the front provided amazing customer service.
Had a late lunch at the Food Crew and thoroughly enjoy my quiet meal. Flat white came quickly and the omelette was cooked just right, not greasy at all and full of flavour. Will be back again.

I’ve had two bad experiences at this McDonald’s that make me not want to come back. First, I ordered a Big Mac combo and it had no sauce or lettuce. When I told them, the person (who seemed like the manager) picked up the whole burger with their bare hands, no gloves and just gave it back to me like it was fine. That’s really unhygienic and not okay in a food place. The customer service was also poor. There were a bunch of teenage-looking girls just standing around talking while people were waiting for their orders. They didn’t seem to know what they were doing and weren’t helping anyone. It felt really unprofessional and frustrating
Very good service and food is neatly served. Usually less greasy than other McDonald's nearby. We have a preference to visit this McDonald's over the others.
Ordered a large triple cheeseburger meal & I was served by the manager I assume customer service was amazing lovely service and food was done in about 3 mins McDonald’s northwest is the spot!!❤️
Order a Double Quarter Pounder with no sauce and THREE extra BEEF PATTY, the burger I got which has no extra beef patty but fortunately the staff didn’t put any sauce in the burger😂
The India lady is not that nice, didn't even bother to Swap the toys for my kids. Don't recommend

We ordered fried rice and chow mein. The rice was really yummy, a bit like the soy sauce fried rice I had as a child. The chow mein is packed with fresh veggies - a pleasant surprise. Portions are great, enough for our whole family! So lovely to have a nice takeaway in our local area :)
Yummiest Chinese takeaways around. We get the share platter often and it's always so so good, great value. Super friendly service too 100% recommend.

So I read all the reviews being knew to area, was impressed by the reviews. Ordered chicken fried rice and chips. Chips are ok but well the fried rice is the most basic fried rice Iv ever had literally has chicken rice egg and some bits of spring onion and onion and not very much at all. So safe to say wont be back. Was Good service however efficient and polite.

This place never dissapoints, we drive from Mairangi Bay to get standard takeaways here. Burgers and Toasties are great. They have THE BEST chips. Their wontons are delicous too. Have tried a couple chinese dishes and they didn't disappoint either. The owners/staff are really nice too. Definitely worth the drive.
Excellent fried fish at Tony's. I like crumbed snapper.

I ordered chicken fried rice. As allergic reaction, we can not eat peas carrots celery. None of these safety rules were followed, I also mentioned extra garlic and onion to be added, that was not added either. Spring roll was burnt and it was not worth the price. I paid $54, it should’ve been $34 for the quality it was. For how much you pay, the service is careless and ignorant. All we could eat was sweet and sour which was not good without the rest.

⸻ The fried fish and chicken wings at this takeaway are absolutely delicious – crispy on the outside and full of flavor. The wonton soup is also amazing, with a rich broth and tender wontons. The lady owner is very kind and provides excellent service. Hands down the best takeaway in the area. Highly recommended!

I was highly impressed this evening with Royal Heights Takeaways. The customer service was lovely, and they were quick with cooking the order. The sweet and sour pork was amazing. It was crunchy, not too tangy and not drenched in sauce. The combination fried rice was lovely and smoky, filled with lots of meat and egg. The chow mein was flavourful and not too salty. I look forward to coming back again
Absolutely impress with the food/ customer service, and I would definitely go again with my family,

Food is unfortunately tasteless without salt. The cost is extortionate for what you get. The staff are friendly enough, but the amount they charge for their menu is really unacceptable for the products used.
Very nice bakery. One of the nicest steak and cheese pies I've had for awhile. Will definitely be coming back. Been back a few times and hands down the nicest pies.

Such an amazing bakery. The couple are so friendly and the food is priced pretty decently. Very clean and tidy and I love how they have healthy lunch options and not the dairy kiddies lunches that are full of sugar. The location is close to Colwill school, the laundromat is right next door and royal heights shopping center and easy access to motorway, northwest mall, pak n save countdown, westgate shopping center that has outlet stores and Costco. Their Vienna bread is to die for and she makes a nice coffee too. All their food though is pretty good. EDITED: So this place has new owners from January 2024. And the food selection is even now more bloody yummy!!!!
Best bakery out there, so underrated, always a blessing to go. Service is amazing, love the food, the pricing is reasonable.
New ownership now does sushi! Teriyaki chicken was top notch! Lots of bakery options too!
Has 6am open on Saturday went there not open waited a bit and now 7am still no one, they need to be there or change opening hours not happy at all
Lovely birthday cake for mother. Delicious and beautiful 😍

the service was amazing but i cant say the same about the food. it tasted old, and it was inedible. We went awhile ago and spent a lot of money, just for the food to have to be thrown away due to the rice being hard and inedible. again i am very disappointed even though the service is good the food was not great.
Not recommend corndog, it’s like a joke the little one bite sausage. The lady at the counter was nice.

Yummy food! Good prices. They also sell fresh kimchi. Sweet lady serving. We bought teriyaki chicken on rice, takoyaki, cabbage kimchi and taiyaki (shaped pancake). I recommend the sweet kumara one, the red bean was ok. Highly recommend trying this place out and support your local.
Wonderful experience. Royal for sure ,the kindness ,the food. Just amazes me.
Went at 1pm, and the sushi was old - it was dry and inedible

Overall the restaurant is worth it. Maybe my dish didn't taste as I expected but I will definitely give it another chance because overall everything was a pleasant experience. Good service, good atmosphere And good prices, the restaurant has parking and is accessible for people with disabilities. I will definitely return.

I loved my overall experience! Enjoyed their side dish and the soup is really great, served steaming hot(literally boiling) and tender chicken! an entire chicken on my stone pot/bowl. Friendly staff despite a busy lunch rush. Ginseng Chicken soup is highly recommended, will definitely comeback.
Lovely service and I enjoyed my chicken ginseng soup. Meat falls off the bones. The side dishes were yum, too. The gamjatang needed a bit more spice, I think.

My partner and I really enjoyed our food here! We had the spicy chicken wings and honey soy chicken wings! The side dishes were also so yum! I think they only thing that could be improved was the chips, they were stale and overcooked

10/10 for Kangnaru! Best Korean food in town! The fried chicken was crispy and delicious. Perfect spot for our family farewell. Thank you to the lovely owners for making it so special for us & for the great service !!! I will definitely be back 🙂

Tried their fried chicken and potato wedges — seriously SO good!! Super crispy on the outside and juicy inside, just the way I like it. The wedges were perfectly seasoned too. Heard from the owner that they’re bringing out some new items soon, can’t wait to come back and try more. Highly recommend if you're craving something fresh and tasty!

Ordered their chicken nibbles and roast combo for takeaway — really impressed! The meat was cooked just right and stayed warm all the way home. Loved the crispy texture and the seasoning. Also got some roast veggies on the side — fresh and tasty. Great for a quick dinner, will be coming back soon!

So rank! I never leave reviews but this was shockingly bad. The fried chicken literally tasted off! It was sour and absolutely soaked in grease. Gravy was so sweet and foul. $40 for genuinely some of the worst food I’ve ever had
yummy yummyyyyyy：） Love the food here
Ordered the lamb roast and was genuinely impressed. The meat was super tender and juicy. Portion size was generous and price was very reasonable

Disgusting customer service, I asked for a menu and was told “ too much money” take a photo. I made a phone order and clearly stated 2 kebab combos and 1 other kebab, I went to grab my drinks and the rude lady at the counter said “ NO JUST DRINK NOT DRINKS” , I told her I ordered 2 combos and she told me “ no you never say that “. May as well have ordered vegetable kebabs as there was about a teaspoon of meat in each of the 3 kebabs. Dry as a paper towel, no flavour. My 2 minute chicken noodles have more flavour than what I was served tonight. I will never buy food from here again. Chips tasted like they were in the frier for 2 minutes max. Chicken looked and tasted like it had been recooked and reheated 3x

When an order is placed 20 mins beforehand to get it cooked and ready to pick up at 6:30pm, don't just start cooking it once the customer gets there and making excuses. It was 3 large chips. It wasn't a big order. Edit to reply to below: It was an extra 13 mins, almost double the time, not an extra 3-4 mins as they claim. I got there at 6:32pm and left at 6:45pm.

If you're after the most authentic Persian cuisine, Arum is where you'll find it. There are a few Persian restaurants in Auckland, but can't be compared with Arum when it comes to authenticity. The kebabs are juicy and delicious with decent portion sizes. The prices are reasonable as well. The owner usually comes and ensures that you're enjoying the quality and taste of your meal. His delight in receiving your appreciation tells how much he cares about the quality of the food and his customers.
Got the $13 chicken burger, chips and a drink combo. It's yummy and really good value. Chips are delicious and cooked perfectly! Staff were friendly. Baklava is a great price at only $5!

Good experience at Arum. Nice size chicken/lamb mix on rice with a selection of salads. I thought they could put a bit more salad in there! $17 for the large size is on the expensive size but it tasted pretty good. Only issue was the lamb was a bit grizzly. I will probably return if I feel like a kebab again

Friendly service. Nice people. Burger left a lot to be desired; bun was a bit stale, chicken was tough and mayo was drenched onto the bun. The chips were pretty good, though nothing I would rave about. I think it'd be a good place to go to if you're hungover or just want a relatively cheap burger fix not expecting a Burger Fuel or Velvet Burger-like burger EDIT: I am increasing my review to 4 stars. A member of my household bought their chicken and chips, it was delightful.

Staff are friendly. I ordered a chicken burger. It's decent (chicken, lettuce and mayo). Bun is warm, heaps of lettuce, good amount of mayo and the chicken is cooked well (not dry). The chips are yummy, I'd definitely get the chips again. And the baklava is delicious!

Ordered a chicken Supreme burger. The bun was very fresh but also very cold. !!! ( doesn't anyone toast hamburger buns anymore?? ) chicken was good. Could 🏊‍♀️ swim in the mayo. I will try again but I'll have to tell them how I would like my burger. Not a unpleasant experience. Staff were also friendly
Great food great service. Beautifully clean. It's a Shame more people don't know about this spot
Great halal meat
Wonderful roast dinners, generous sizing and absolutely delicious!

Hearty and satisfying roast meal. Their crisp baked potatoes are perfection, and the roast lamb, beef, and pork are all juicy and tender. The meats are dipped in flavorful gravy, and vegetables are crisp, adding a refreshing balance to the meal. The crackling on the meat is crunchy - so good. This is a classic roast dinner, and Roast Express Takeaway is a great choice.

We were really disappointed with our meals tonight. Both myself and my husband purchased a roast pork meal and were disappointed to see when we got home that neither of us had any meat in our meals but carved up fat.
They never dissapoint...always a great meal, gravy to die for!
Great service, very clean premises, very good food and generous portions - This is now our go to shop for roast dinners - Overall very good value for money
Good service. got sweet and sour pork no meat all batter not recommended
I can’t speak for any of there other food, but there chips are the best chips on the peninsula
Unfortunately I had a mountain of crispy noodles with a handful of protein n veg I paid extra for combination too.very disappointed
Have ordered Chicken egg foo young and BBQ pork egg foo young. Both times very little meat in it but they charge a lot for it. I get better from a cafe with an omelette.

Can't believe these guys only have 4.2 stars at the moment? I have been a customer on and off over the last two years and they are consistently great! Awesome snapper all the time, amazing cheese ball, perfect squid rings EVERYTIME. 🥳😍 Even the friends I know agree!

Best eggs Benny I’ve had in a long time. Ordered with bacon and the creamy mushrooms as an extra. Had to try that too. Was more on the plate than i thought I could manage. I came in late, so was quiet, coffee was good too. I thought I’d give it a go with the new owners and am looking forward to going back.

Amazing food and warm hospitality from the new owners at Neil Cafe! The beef burger is delicious, served on a brioche bun that’s just perfect. The big breakfast has its own unique flavors and twists, definitely keeps us coming back!

Neil cafe is the perfect neighbourhood cafe in Te Atatu. The perfect place to enjoy a cold beer in the courtyard and let the kids play! They also do a great breakfast menu, and good coffee. Sterling Arnet Kakapo Business Sales

Wow new chef makes the best pizzas, would highly recommend this place if you’re looking for some really good quality pizza! I haven’t had a delicious pizza like this in a long time🙂 My family just had a beautiful meal here, thankyou to the lovely chef, lovely service☺️

I really wanted to love the beef cheek because it sounded so good. Unfortunately there was something in the seasoning that I personally didn’t enjoy. Without it, I think it would’ve been great because it’s a nice combination. The flat white I had was good at least!
DnB were fantastic in Catering our wedding day. Efficient, reliable, professional On-site catering and the food was outstanding! Mike & Racheal out did themselves and nothing was too much.
Great service. Succulent food; Melt in your mouth brisket😋 Made out Christmas Day a breeze. Thanks so much D n B BBQing - Michael and Rachael 👍🏼

DnB BBQing Catering provided an outstanding experience! The food was delicious—perfectly grilled and full of flavor. The service was top-notch, with a professional and friendly team that made sure everything ran smoothly. Highly recommend them for any event!

I went to an event where these guys catered. This truly was amazing. Tbh I wasn't really expecting this level of delicious, it's simply out of this world and despite the BBQ connection, it's the sort of level I'd expect at at very high-end restaurant but served in a way that helps you relax and enjoy the experience. Mike and Rach know their art and skilfully prepare and cook the different meats and side dishes to absolute perfection. Wow!

I recently attended a BBQ hosted by Racheal for an Easter lunch, and it was fantastic! While I’m not a big meat lover, I absolutely loved the lamb—it was tender, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. The vegetarian options were also a highlight!

One of the best Mexican food spots in Auckland. The location is a bit out of the way and inconspicuous, hidden amongst an industrial area near the motorway on-ramp, but what you’ll find is the most delicious authentic tacos. I make my way here every time I crave tacos, burritos or quesadillas as it’s worth it every time.

Honestly, nothing comes closer to the real home cooked Mexican meals than this place. We absolutely love their nachos, chicken or beef, we simply rotate when we are craving it. Food tastes fresh as always and the guacamole is always on point (we always add it in). Happy to support this family run business as they are friendly with fast service regardless of busy times. Come on through! Always worth it. --- Update, went back July 2025. Still really good!!!

If you're looking for authentic Mexican food in New Zealand, this small restaurant is a hidden gem. Run by Mexicans and decorated in a way that transports you straight to a taquería in a neighborhood of Mexico City, you'll find genuine flavors and traditional dishes made with passion. From tacos to aguas frescas, every bite is an authentic experience. The place is small, but its cozy atmosphere and the warmth of the people make it absolutely worth the visit.👏😎🥳🍻
Pretty decently priced and serving size. Shocked how tasty everything was, will need to return with a bigger appetite next time! Very authentic, unlike any other Mexican place I've been to.

What an awesome gem of a spot! Authentic and casual dining. Best Mexican I’ve had in Auckland. I got the Horchata + taco combo. The cactus was bitey, the brisket was savoury and lamb was tender. The salsa was legit 🔥

I loved the chunky s’mores crookie a lot! 🥐 The croissant tasted buttery and freshly baked, and had a slightly cookie-like/firmer texture on the outside, which was unique and worked well. The toasted marshmallows made it soft and mochi-like in some parts. It was so delicious 😋 Even though it was a bit pricey, it was a good portion and I enjoyed every bite. I’ll definitely order again and also try out some other items when I want to treat myself to something sweet! The whole menu looks so good 😊
The cheese cake and chocolate are amazing My kids love the desserts from here .100% recommend 👌 👏
Best Thai in the West 🌟 great delicious portions, you legit can’t beat the prices here! Friendly, lovely service + great easy to get to location.

Great value for money and always fresh ingredients! Veges are crunchy, duck and meats are always juicy and everything is so yum! The only things I wouldn't recommend is the tofu tord and the roti. The roti was homemade but small portion, hard and tough to chew. The tofu with peanut sauce is a little bit cardboardy because they slice it thinly and fry it but it goes super dry. The peanut sauce is Yum and it would be a really nice dish if they used cubed tofu or even puffed tofu. This is our go to place now when we want Thai food for the whole whānau. Pictured is a chicken pad thai, duck green curry and cashew chicken. All YUMMMM!
Very welcoming staff , service is always awesome , very good value for money for a very tasty dinner.

Over 2 year as a customer, always ordering THE SAME FOOD, SAME COMMENTS and they CANCEL MY ORDER!!!! you have just LOST A CUSTOMER, will NOT come back, EVER neither recommend EVER AGAIN!!!! STAY AWAY FROM THIS RUSSIAN ROULETTE!!!
takeaway here many times, fresh food, great service, good price, great value,

We often get Pizza landing and love it, the pizzas are great and they have a wide range. The burgers are also some of the most delicious burgers around. Unfortunately due to their popularity, the wait times can be high but this is not overly their fault, you just have to account for that in your planning. We have also noticed lately that the chip portions are getting smaller and smaller even with the high price. (The picture shows the portion of chips we received) If they can sort out their stingy chip portions and ensure they are fresh and hot everytime then this would easily be a 5 star review.
The margarita pizza and smash burger were the best we have ever had. Perfect flavors with a delicious burger sauce that takes it over the top. Will definitely return!

Ordered some food tonight. Wait time was like 25-30mins but partner came to pick it up at actual pickup time but they still waited 15mins longer. Came home and son was trying to grab a piece but wasn’t cut properly. So we had to slice our pizza. We love the cheeseburger though.

We had the double double burger and beer battered fries. The burger was fresh and juicy with a lovely soft tasty bun. Dan the owner was friendly. I highly recommend it and will definitely come back to try other things on the menu.
Pizza was yum! But be prepared for a long wait time.
Beautiful food !!! Good price to I live in West harbour and the and travelled to the penninsula to come to this store based on someone elses review! And I am not disappointed at all.

Ordered over the phone and could barely understand the lady, asked for extra prawns & they were saying it was $4.50 for ONE extra prawn - so just asked for extra shrimp instead. She attempted to repeat the order, didnt understand her yet again but gave her the benefit of the doubt. Got to the place and was standing out the front for 5 mins before someone came to me, as they still have covid screens preventing you from coming in. The guy finally came over, barely spoke english and tried charging me $155 for 7 noodle dishes. Added the price up myself and it came to $120. Confronted him about it and they were having a go at me saying i asked for 2 extra shrimp over the phone when i didn’t - but regardless of the extra shrimp price ontop of the $120 it still wouldn’t add up to $150. They changed the price back to $120 and the lady made a comment saying “oh are you happy now, we’ll do a discount for you even though you made the mistake & we added 2x shrimp anyway” Just a bunch of irritable, unwelcoming and argumentative people. Even though the food was great wouldn’t recommend dealing with these people.

We do like indulging in some Noodle Canteen whenever the opportunity arises. At this specific store the food is consistently well-prepared, and the serving sizes are generous. However, it's worth noting that this particular branch continues to operate with COVID-related precautions in place, including a plastic window at the entrance and a table. While it may seem unusual, it appears to be their chosen method of running the store.
Wonderful meal for a birthday. Hot, tasty and a good size. Value for money and staff are so friendly.
Satisfying flavoursome hot meals! Price is quite good considering the large portions and fair mixture of vegetables, seafood and meat. Can get quite busy here but they always try their best to cater!

I've been coming to John Chan since I was a kid, and it still stands as my favourite Chinese takeaway. No one does it like John Chan! The food is high quality, and has remained consistent throughout the 20 years I've been coming here. My favourite dish is the Shanghai fried noodles. Other dishes I recommend are the chow mein, fried rice, fried soft noodles, egg fu yoong, sweet and sour pork, and of course, their fish and chips. You won't be let down by John Chan! Much love to the amazing owners for all the work and love they put into their food. Really amazing people
This place is Soooo delicious!! I'm a kiwi and I know great TAs when I encounter them 😂☺️... yum yum yum... Highly recommend. Lovely people, cooking with ❤️.

Having sampled all the sea dogs on the Te Atatū peninsula we can say with veracity that John Chan’s is truly the best. Toasty bun with grilled cheese, robust batter on the surimi stick, onion, and of course a lavish amount of sauce. Truly the crème de la crème de le chien, the top of the dogs for us.
Fabulous food team as always thank you made the trip to Auckland even more enjoyable ❤️

Got fish and chips and was hands down the worst fish and chips I had ever eaten. Or not eaten. Soggy, oily chips and the fish was rank. The batter was crispy but the fish inside absolutely smelt so terrible. I had to open the window in my car when driving with the food. The fish was not off but it felt like it was dug from the bottom of the freezer after being frozen for 3 years. Never again! But the couple serving us were really nice

Unexpected gem we found in Te Atatu Peninsula. We were craving for a fish dish, so we ordered one from here tonight. It comes with tamarind sauce on top. It's not too spicy. The fish is fresh and yummy to be eaten with the sauce and vegetables that come with it. You can taste that it is still crunchy, as long as you eat it while it is still hot. The pad thai is great. One of the best we have tasted. The entree: prawns wrapped in egg noodle are special too. Would definitely go back to try out other food on the menu. It's a great cafe restaurant with warm settings and definitely an excellent choice for a quiet date night, too.
Most wonderful and morden touch, very clean food but well done, not overly rich. Omg that green chicken curry is sooooo green and the snapper is top mark! And BYO wine 🍷 all the ticks
I highly recommend this restuarant. The atmosphere is great, and the service is excellent. I've tried Beef Massaman, Pad Thai and Entree Combination, every plate are delicious.

Best Thai we've eaten in NZ (and we frequent Central AKL). Excellent service and food. Worth every dollar. Welcoming to families. Note: Thai for dinner, Western cuisine at other times. Beautiful tableware and attention to detail in table settings and meal display. Extremely clean including toilets. Meal and venue photos in other reviews are accurate. Highly recommend.

We had the pleasure in having breakfast here this morning, this is our regular local Thai restaurant for dinner but thought we would give brekki a go as dinner never disappoints! The food was absolutely delicious and the service was second to none! Thanks guys, we will be back again soon. Regular Sunday morning spot! 🙂
Snapper fresh and chips cooked just right. Squid rings crumbed and really light and tender. We have tried a lot of chippies in the area and Tat Sth but this is by far the best
Honestly ! The BEST and freshest Snapper I have had for a long time! I no longer need to go into the city and get fish and chips ! I’ll be coming back here and eating local ! 😁😁
Good local for fish and chips on a Monday (when others are closed). Don’t spent the $5.50 for the “super dog” photo attached

Beautiful golden chips, lovely crunchy batter on gunard. Not greasy, light and crunchy and more than worth the price. Will definitely be my fav fish and chip shop from now on. I went without calling and even though it was super busy, i got my meal in less than 10 minutes. Kudos to the owner, who was a one man army that day
You get classic tasty old school Kiwi fush and chups at a reasonable price. If you want something else, you're in the wrong place.

Have been here just twice before and their roast pork meal was really nice, brought one tonight, small one for $15 and it was tasteless. The gravy was watery with no flavour, the potatoes and kumara had a weird taste and even the pork had no flavour. The only tasty part was the crackle, wont be going back.

Their chicken nibbles are the best iv tasted so far, has that sweet taste to it which makes its finger lickin good....they have deals displayed on their shop window. Would try their roast meal next time when im in the area again.

This used to be the best roast dinner place on Peninsula. But O MY goodness Just have just paid $21 for the roast pork meal. The pork was cooked well but with no love whatsoever. It was absolutely tasteless. We got one and one half small pieces of crackle as limp as. The gravy was thickened water tgat the apple sauce dissappeared into with no taste. 1piece of Kumara and piece of pumpkin that was too small to share. And honestly about a small desert spoon of peas. It was appalling

This is the best place to go on Te Atatu Peninsula! We've compared it to the place next door and Peninsula Roast was definitley by far the best. We've tried the lamb and pork so far and both were so tender and delicious. We would aways come back to this place whenever we crave a roast meal.

Just gave these guys a go and I have to say the chicken nibbles are not bad. I enjoyed, although it could be a little bit crispier. The chips were seasoned just right. Loved it! I think I know where to get some wings for our games night next time.

Originally found Sama on Google and saw the great reviews. Have been here a few times now , and the guys are always friendly, meals are decent prices and larger than you think! This will be a standard rost place of mine from.now on.

The best roast meals!! We've tried the beef, the pork and the lamb meals, all have been superb with generous portions and lots of flavour. The golden potatoes and pork crackling are top quality as well.
Just had the best Roast pork meal I've ever had , It was rolled pork and the cracking was Devine! Just the care the man took placing the meal was also entertaining! This is a destination A+

Partner and I had dinner while doing laundry- had roast lamb roll and this was delish - watched owner ladle sauce and prepare rolls and he does take pride in the quality of his food... Thank you ( I liked the fact that roll was soft to eat as you can really savour every bite) will no doubt go again.

Was in the area and I thought I'd give these guys a try. Bought the wings and chips and opted for roast potatoes instead. I would say it's pretty good. The roast potatoes needed a little bit more seasoning. The crumbed wings is one of the better ones out there. Keen to try their other dishes.

We’ve made it a bit of a tradition to visit Chunky Chook weekly or at least fortnightly. It’s truly become our go-to comfort food spot. Their fried chicken is the ultimate treat: super juicy on the inside and perfectly crispy on the outside. It reminds us so much of Jollibee’s Chicken Joy, which is why we’ve been raving about it to our fellow Filipinos who are missing that nostalgic flavour from home. What makes the experience even better is the warm hospitality. The owner, is hands-down one of the friendliest people we’ve come across. He’s always so pleasant, welcoming, and genuinely kind. You can tell he really cares about his customers. Our favourite combo is the Dinner Meal (fried chicken with rice and mayo). If you’re craving a taste of home or just love properly done fried chicken, Chunky Chook is an absolute must-try.

Wow. This place truly was so so wonderful. I was visiting from out of the country and was unsure what to order. The owner was so helpful and kind. Truly a wonderful experience. In addition, the food was delicious!!! While in new Zealand I visited Auckland, Christchurch, Rotorua, Wellington, and Dunedin, and this was one of my favorite places I stoped to eat. Wonderful family owned restaurant. Definitely try the donburi.

By far the best chicken in Auckland! The meals are a good size and really great value. Tank is awesome! Def worth checking it out. I've been slowly trying everything on the menu and can't decide on a favourite as everything is just too good.
Delicious takeaway shop for fried chicken! Tastes good but doesn’t make you feel sick like some fried chicken. Enjoyed takeaway to nice Te Atatu peninsula view for dinner.

Google searched "chicken and Chips" near me while partner and I were out and about in that area, decided to stop in, didn't regret it. Got 2 dinner boxes and the chicken stayed hot and crispy all the way to Mairangi Bay! Fresh, and delicious! Will definitely be going again when I get the craving for some good chicken!

The shop was clean as it always is . The keepers always offer a superb customer service. I only ever order $23 fish n chips special and a extra scoop of chips $4.80 the chips have gotten less and less and I dont think that your the only shop but portion for price please

Hoki battered fish was very good. Crisp and light. Best I have had in a long time. Hot chips have been consistantly good. Tasty not smashed in salt. Really nice people and service is top notch and business is always clean. Been a few times before making this review. Will try out rest of the menu. 🙂 Have tried some other items on menu. Delicious.

I ordered $7.00 worth of chips over the phone to have chip sandwiches to feed four of us which should have been enough. I opened the wrapping paper to what is about $3.00 worth of chips and undercooked, the potato in the middle is doughy and the chip itself is unsalted. I called the takeaway store and they claim that the prices of chips have gone up. $4.00 for one scoop of chips. Safe to say I am never returning and I 100% do NOT recommend this take-away selection. Do better Golden Star.
Chicken was raw. Disgusting. Spent over $20 for dinner to not have any of it. Called them to let them know. No apology. Just blamed the oil that was used. Would stay away.
Lovely people.good food. Fried rice was yum and big portion.

Had snacks here the other day. Chicken and garlic bread were lovely. Calamari was average and the nachos were definately not a hit. The fake cheese used was terrible. Service was good although have to walk to other side of pub to order. Atmosphere always good here.
We lovd it. Excellent experience. Remember us a travel in Edinburgh! Why the scottish people always eat nachos? We like it!
I love sitting outside with my family having weekend lunch here. Vibes are immaculate, and staff are friendly and prompt.

Came in for Saturday lunch. Had beef nachos. And a coffee. Then again on Wednesday night trivia. Had cheesy garlic ciabata, beer battered fries. Seasoned wedges, lemon pepper squid, dumplings. Nice food, and generous portions. Service was professional, easy going, very friendly and efficient. Served at the food counter by a lovely worker named Izzy, she also brought our food out. An approachable and helpful girl. Watched her multi task between tables maintaining service throughout the venue. Also friendly bar worker named Janine, too was helpful and approachable and quick with bringing the coffee out. Thank you, visiting from overseas, next visit nz - we'll be back.
Lovely roast dinner. The beer I had, Lion Red may have been the first one out the tap, have had a better drop. But the rest was fine.

Posting for a few reasons. The fish n chips here are some of the best ive had in the city so far and i go out of my way for it. Cripsy crunch and always fresh. And portions are always generous. I like my chips well done too and its also somewhere that understands that when most ignore the request and just give soggy chips. The customer service is above and beyond. We are always greeted warmly with smiles and friendliness. This alone is a reason to revisit, i dont understand why other shops don’t understand the value of quality customer service. And lastly, there arent any photos of the fish n chips in the pictures above so...here are a few.

Polite service from a very friendly couple. I highly recommend the Battered Snapper, which is easily among the best I have ever tasted. I enjoy their food so much that I drive halfway across the North Shore for their delicious fish'n'chips. I definitely recommend them.

Genuinely the most unsatisfactory meal my household has ever had from a burger/fish & chips place. Chicken was undercooked and chewy, burger was mainly lettuce and bun. Onion rings were mushy and all thick shakes were basically powdered water. Fish burger had hard skin still on it and wasn’t chewable (had to pull it out of mouth with each bite) The most overpriced meal I’ve ever paid and the total cost I was told on the phone was different to when I picked up the food up. Am never coming back again and hope others consider this too.

I am quite disappointed. We ordered three burgers takeaway. Two of them were burnt on the top bun, and since we ordered takeaway, it wasn't worth driving back. I will probably try the food again, as the other items we ordered were nice. See photo of the burnt burgers, I cannot believe that they would actually serve that to a customer!

Really good fish and chips! Had a piece of battered snapper (fab) and a scoop of chips. The chips were good and crispy which is hard to find! My partner had the fish burger and said that was tasty too. We had 2 scoops between us and it was a very generous serving.
Love the quiet & cosy atmosphere, most importantly, they play my favorite jazz music. 😁😁 Enjoyed my egg Benedict today, friendly service and attention to details, will be back for sure. ☕

Little, cozy and clean cafe. Beautiful location, friendly service, good stuff. Being vegetarian, I could find enough variety to choose. Soothing decor, tasty food, elegantly served. Check cafe hours if you want to spend quality time.

I just visited Woodside for the first time in several months. I was blown away when Isha remembered my usual order, my name & noticed that my hair was different from when I last visited! Isha & Deepak were both so super friendly & welcoming & made me feel like I was an old friend who had stopped by. I had the French toast which was simply delicious, as always, & the coffee was great. I really can't recommend Woodside highly enough. It's everything you could want in a cafe & it definitely won't be long before my next visit. 😊

White clean healthy cafe! I can feel kind regard of menu thinking about caring ingredient. There is a lot of menu that GF DF even cane sugar free! I tried cocoa cake GF DF sugar free and that was delicious even more than other sugar desserts I will visit here often :)

Beautiful food with huge range of gluten free options. The Korean fried chicken is the best I’ve had - will be back soon. Unsure what the other recent reviews are on about - very good value and the staff clearly put a lot of effort into presentation too.
After enjoying the food after many years I have to say the recent takeaway experience was poor. Small portions and a very flat and too crispy naan which cost $6

I went to Thai Isaan a few times last year and the portions were decent sizes. Yesterday it was disappointing as food prices went up and portion sizes down. One portion is not enough to feed one male and it was just enough for me (I am a small girl). I also think there was not enough vegetables in the food. The atmosphere and service were good. The food taste was good but definitely not value for money.
Prompt service. Delicious food. Entree, mains and puddings all divine. Stand out deep fried banana pudding, and noodle dish which I've forgotten the name of. Overall great place and will be back

$10 for two roti, small portion of red curry against the yellow curry. Disappointed in price for the size of serving. Yellow curry had potatos in it but didnt say in description, red curry lacked basil. The noodles tasted fishy and was inedible because of this was meant to be vegetarian.... Ordered via uber eats believe it or not this cost me $75.

After spending the afternoon with a friend, we decided to have dinner together before dropping her off at her home and we stopped at Thai Isaan Restaurant. I have to say we could not have been happier with our decision. It was still early evening therefore the restaurant only had a few customers. We were greeted at the door by a friendly gentleman who showed us the table. From that point onwards things only got better. The food (Chicken Satay to start with a glass of wine then Chicken green curry and Prawn Red Curry) was amazing. This was one of the best Thai food I had in a long time. The service was very good too. Thanks a lot for everything and I will come back.
A great venue for a dinner. Great food, and the hosts supplied their own wines. Lots of trophies, including the Americas Cup. Beautiful venue for an event. Lots of parking , easy to access.
Truly a beautiful sight, I've been here at night, I still enjoyed the experience

Great views of Auckland bridge. Different bars, good atmosphere. Restaurant has good food. Lots of improvements. Lighthouse cafe, with cabinet food, coffee, tea and drinks. Tables outside to seat and enjoy views of the harbour. Restaurant food is better, more variety. Service still needs to improve, quite slow.

First time sailing on the MRX. The coach was awesome, made learning fun & safe. Thank you putting the online courses together too. I am so happy & looking forward to my next lesson. :-) Lunch was delicious with beautiful sea views. Highly recommended.
A surprise guest at my friend's 80th birthday 🎂 a very special place⛵

There’s something about the food here, it just hits different 😍. Their rotis and naans are always spot on. The team’s super welcoming, and they really know how to use spices just right. It’s never too much unless you ask for that extra kick. Chef Kuber (pronounced - Koo-bayr,) who runs the place, keeps the quality consistent every time. One of my all-time favorites is their chole bhature for a brunch . Seriously if you haven’t had it yet, just walk in, order it and eat it there while it’s hot. Trust me on this🥹. Get a chai on the side , make it extra sweet or if it’s summer, go for a cold lassi instead. Perfect weekend cheat meal. This is the kind of food you want on a lazy Sunday afternoon, right before a good nap. You’re honestly missing out if you haven’t tried it yet. Here is a pic of their crispy and fresh naan with butter chicken. I like to have one right there and take the other for lunch next day. Been going here for years and will keep going 💯 .

We tried 3 things , chicken lollipop, veg Manchurian and the methi malai chicken with a garlic naan. The food was good! Was a pleasant surprise but it was really tasty. Great to have a good Indian restaurant in the neighbourhood, wish I had taken better pictures.
Loved the food, 10/10. Authentic, made the meals at the spice level as requested (extra hot goat curry was absolutely loved thank you!) Family also appreciated the small freebies so thank you 😍

I have been eating from here ever since we moved to Birkenhead, and surely this place never disappointed us, my all time favourite is chicken madras and my kids absolutely love butter chicken with naan, I have also tried their starters and also other curries, good amount of chicken in the curries and I love how they use boneless chicken thighs not chicken breast, the food is soo good here, fresh and hot! also I love the Gulab jamun after that spicy food. thank you for making real authentic food please keep it this way!
Had the Paneer malai methi, and was exceptionally good in taste , the chef listened to my requirements carefully and prepared it accordingly.I never had so yummy Indian curry in a long long time .

We had an absolutely amazing dinner tonight! The food was fresh, full of flavor, and beautifully presented. The Truffle pizza was a solid 10/10—perfectly made and incredibly delicious. A huge shoutout to Chef Vini for the incredible food, and to Manager Harsh, who made us feel so welcome and even brewed a fantastic spicy Chai. The atmosphere at the restaurant was warm and inviting, making the whole experience even better. Thank you so much for a memorable evening! We’ll definitely be back.

We chose this local cafe this week for our family brunch. It’s been 3 months or so since I was last here solo. I believe it’s changed ownership since my last visit. A familiar face, Ethan, still works there and as friendly as always. He ordered an omelette with herbal tea. And said the omelette lacked flavour. She ordered eggs Benedict with bacon and wasn’t overly impressed. She definitely didn’t like the smoothie which I agree with. I had French toast with pears, strawberries and blueberries and bacon on the side and enjoyed every morsel. Also had a turmeric latte- delicious 😋 Busy cafe with steady flow of patrons. Popular cafe. Off street parking. Table service is offered except we couldn’t remember and I went to the counter. Exceptional duty manager. Cabinet food available also. ❤️

So good to see a favorite eatery pumping these days. The pizza I had was fabulous, great simple wine menu, fast service as we told them we were going to a movie. Highly recommend. High ceilings but they have installed baffles so easy to hear even though it’s busy.

We dined there for lunch and it was excellent. We were a tad late for our reservation and they kindly kept the kitchen open an extra 15 minutes to accommodate us. We were greeted with a warm & friendly expectant smile and ushered to our table knowingly. Service was efficient. Quality of the food was excellent Pricing was very good. They were one of the few quality places in the Northcote/Birkenhead area that was open on Monday daytime. Highly recommended.

Great evening experience for a Monday night. Staff were polite and professional and the meal was excellent. The pork belly and sweet potato were both done really well. Burger was so big that it made the bun almost redundant. Reasonably priced and a great ambience. Surprisingly busy for a Monday too which created a nice atmosphere to enjoy. Will be returning.

The portion is large and very delicious. The owner is very welcoming and the environment is good. The wraps are very crispy. I ordered lamb and fish, both of which were very good. It was the first time I saw chocolate-flavored Baklava, which was delicious, but the original flavor is more classic and is worth a try! Will try other more traditional delicacies next time!

One of the absolute best restaurants in Auckland serving kebabs. Owners obviously very passionate about hospitality & make the establishment a very nice place to visit to enjoy a meal. Their food is delicious, presented beautifully, made from beautiful fresh ingredients. A asset to the surrounding area. Highly recommended!:)

We tried super kebab it was delicious and tasty 😋. Also we ordered chicken shish the chicken was cooked perfectly, marinated with delicious sauce. The staff were very friendly and welcoming. The environment was great. I couldn’t take more photos my kids ate it quickly.
This was such a delightful meal, we really enjoyed all the food we got here. Highly recommended the baklava and Turkish coffee if that is your thing 😊

▢ Food Quality The lamb, unfortunately, did not live up to expectations. The meat was dry and had an unpleasantly aged taste, making it a disappointing choice. While the sauce was passable, it did little to elevate the overall dish. On the plus side, the bread was fresh, providing a slight reprieve from the otherwise underwhelming meal. ▢ Portion Size The portion sizes left much to be desired. Despite the reasonable pricing, the serving was insufficient, prompting the need for an additional order to feel satisfied. This diminished the value of the meal. ▢ Presentation Though the food's flavor didn’t impress, the presentation was visually appealing, offering a more refined look than its taste could support. ▢ Ambiance The space is decent but lacks some essentials, such as a toilet, which could be inconvenient for diners. The atmosphere is pleasant enough for a sit-down meal, but it doesn’t quite make up for the shortcomings in the food. Parking was pain ▢ Service The staff were friendly, and the hospitality was commendable. Despite the food’s shortcomings, the service added a positive note to the experience, making guests feel welcomed and comfortable.

I went to First Made Last Laugh last Sunday for a birthday dinner. There were about five of us in the group. The food was great, and the atmosphere was lovely—nothing to complain about, except that the food arrived a bit late. But some of the staff gave me a free dessert for my birthday, which was a nice surprise. The staff were really friendly and welcoming. I had an amazing dinner here—absolutely worth it!

Amazing lunch experience today. They menu is terrific and ticks all the boxes for us. Japanese flavours mixed with South American and you can’t go wrong. The taquitos were simply magnificent. My favorite was the salmon red onion and kimchi, but they all rocked. Scallop sashimi was on point as was the salt & pepper calamari. But the star of the show was the incredible spicy salmon with kaffir lime and coconut cream. Dip your sour dough bread into that sauce and it’s heaven on your palate. I won’t forget this dish in a hurry. And will be back for sure! The service was fantastic too. Big thumbs up!!

Absolute hidden gem in the harbour. The menu was anything but boring, which was such a nice change from the usual seafood spots around here. Everything sounded so good, it actually took us a while to decide what to order (in the best way). And the food? Delicious across the board. Even the kids’ mac and cheese was next-level—rich, creamy, and clearly made with a blend of cheeses. Definitely something adults could enjoy too. The ice cream was real vanilla bean ice cream, which was a nice touch. I’d happily come back with my parents next time. It’s a great spot for families. The only downside was that they only had two high chairs available, which could be tricky if you’re dining with little ones.

This is an absolutely outstanding restaurant. The staff are warm, enthusiastic, and full of energy. The South American–Japanese fusion menu is both exciting and well-executed. Whether you’re after a luxurious seafood platter or refined small plates, the menu offers great variety at reasonable prices. The wine list is extensive. My wife had a glass of Chardonnay—elegant, smooth, and bursting with fruit. The interior design is stylish and thoughtfully done, striking a perfect balance between modern sophistication and comfort. The seating layout caters to all kinds of diners, whether you’re here for a romantic date or a group gathering. The bar feels like a stage, with the bartenders as its charismatic performers. Every dish is made with fresh ingredients, and you can almost feel the sea breeze in the air. The Hiramasa Kingfish Ceviche was an explosion of flavor—the dressing danced on my palate. The Fresh Salmon Taquitos were refreshingly inventive. All showcasing the chef’s maturity, restraint, and artistry. Even the diners around us added to the vibrant atmosphere—everyone seemed genuinely happy to be there, as if sharing in a collective experience. I wouldn’t be surprised if this place lands in the top three of this year’s Metro Top 50. Personally, it’s my number one. A perfect score in every way—120 out of 100.

Vibrant Waterside Dining with a Miami Beach Twist This sleek, contemporary restaurant captures the energy of Miami Beach, offering a top-tier seafood menu, exceptional service, and a lively atmosphere. We visited for Friday lunch, and the place was buzzing – the perfect backdrop for a relaxed yet vibrant meal. The menu is designed for sharing, but there are also larger plates for those who prefer a more traditional main. We started with a trio of tostadas (tuna, salmon, prawn) and plump Bluff oysters – both fresh and full of flavor. For mains, the whitebait fritter was a standout, paired nicely with a crisp garden salad. To wrap things up, we couldn’t resist the feijoa and licorice ice cream – a surprising yet delicious finish. Special thanks to Philip, our friendly and professional server, who made the experience even more enjoyable. Add this one to your must-try list!

Great food. Great service. Great environment. Great people! Delicious flavors on pizzas that come straight from a beautiful woodfire oven. (Sorry, I forgot to take a photo of the oven tonight, so using a photo my partner took couple of months ago during the reno). IV

The atmosphere was amazing and the pizza was absolutely delicious! 👍🏻👍🏻 It was honestly the best wood-fired pizza I’ve had in NZ Highly recommend the Spicy Prawn 👍🏻 I am so glad I found best pizza close to home. I’ll definitely be coming back

Best pizza in Birkenhead! That real real wood fire flavour is infused into every bite for the ultimate authentic pizza experience and flavour!! Best to eat in to have the pizza fresh out the oven - tho no issue ordering takeaway. Great service

One of the best pizzas in town! We have the chance to talk a bit with the chef Nico, my congratulations for the food! Also the vibe of the restaurant is cool and the place is way bigger than I expected. Highly recommended!

Went there for lunch, today, after raving reviews from a community fb page. We were not disappointed. We could not fault anything. I was offered a lap blanket without asking…the waitress was that sharp. Needless to say, the pizzas were very tasty. The tiramisu to die for. And the service was top notch. We’ll be back!

Worth Trying. I was craving takeaway fish/chips - this was the only place open after 8pm. Amazing - really solid chips. Fluffy, crisp and a good amount of chicken salt. Cant fault it. Good price/portion as well.
Friday night Chinese! Golden Bridge Special Fried Rice - extra roast meats Wontons with sweet & Sour Sauce Sweet & Sour Pork Egg Foo Yung Prawn Crackers BOSH!!!
1x chips was perfect size for 2 people, along with other bits.

Tried the Lemon Chicken, Sweet and Sour Pork, GB Special Rice and Wontons. Both the Lemon Chicken and the Sweet and Sour Pork were exceptional.. Super crisp, easily the best deep fried we have tried from a takeaway. Enjoyed the lemon sauce, plenty of punch without being overly sweet.. The wontons were also very crispy.

Update: Review star rating dropped as they are now not open during the daytime for lunch orders. Got combination fried rice from here, very quick service, although was the middle of the day, and very tasty fried rice, i will be back

Service was quick and good. Every single dish was prepared perfectly! Beef was tender, seafood was fresh and well seasoned! So good that i was too focused on eating, i didn’t get to take a picture of everything we ordered! Will be back to try their desserts next time :)

I dined at Osteria Uno last Friday with some friends. A short wait to get our table and the vibes were immaculate! The wait staff were amazing, and my dairy allergy was taken seriously by the waitress and chefs, everything I ordered was totally dairy free and safe for me to eat, which anyone with allergies will know is a big relief. I got the lamb parpadelle (minus the cheese), and the carrots. It was absolutely delicious, I will definitely be back, worth every penny. Thank you!

Was lucky to get a table at about 8:45pm with their entire menu still available. Ordered the limonata soda (great!), beef tartare and foccaccia with balsamic butter. The beef tartare was great, an unnecessarily large amount of mayo/aioli? on top which I scraped off and added back in in much smaller increments. Foccaccia was nice, something about the balsamic butter was odd. Service was great and food came out super fast, plus the atmosphere was buzzing and very nice. Would overall recommend!

Unpretentious Italian with a Modern Twist This little gem delivers outstanding Italian fare – simple yet refined, like something straight from nonna’s kitchen, but with a touch of sophistication. The service is excellent, and the beverage list impresses, spanning classic Italian wines (the Soave Classico from Veneto is a standout) to Italian-inspired cocktails with a local twist – their Negroni is a softer, more aromatic take on the classic. We started with the steak tartare, a rich and perfectly balanced opener, followed by the prawn tortellini, which was simply outstanding. If you appreciate high-quality food in a relaxed, unpretentious setting, this spot should be at the top of your list. Highly recommended!
Had the beef cheeks was so soft and tasty. The Foccacia pudding absolutely stunning. A place to try.
I ordered my big meal at the counter and the employee suggested I get the autumn special and he threw in the cheese fries for free. Amazing service! The burger was amazing! Would recommend to anyone!
Really great smash burger! The hot honey chicken tenders were very yummy too
Absolutely love this place! Had it for the first time last week and had to come back for a second time! The smash burger + shoestring fry combo is perfect. Definitely check it out!
Food is really good. Addicted to their milkshakes. Burger buns are soft which is good. Keep the consistency.

We tried the sliders (one beef/one chicken), grilled cheese, fries and mango shake .. omg it was all amazing! Need to go back when I’m more hungry!! Great service, primo location and superb atmosphere 🙏🏼

Good selection, decent quality ingredients and good service. It’s a fish and chip shop that just happens to have a pretty well stocked sushi cabinet. Impressed by the range. Definitely more of a westernised lunch-joint style “sushi” but still - one of the better options in the area. They are generous with the avocado (unlike St Pierre’s) and the prices are fair. It’s a great spot for a quick bite.

The lady in front she is very friendly and don’t know why some customers had bad experience but for me as a first timer, the experience was good. I ordered 3 pieces of Sushi and fish of the day with fries. Guess what? Only cost me 19dollars which made me ask her how can you make money in Herne bay?? The lady she is always smiling and I can see she is really a hard worker and makes the place clean than most take away place. Fish are very fresh and fries have a good portion. Sushi is yummy but I know maybe it was nearly the end of the day so the look not very fresh but I can still taste the quality is good. What should I ask for more??? Sometimes customers should also be nice or at least don’t be a nasty racist.

Good quality fish and chips . We ordered snaper battered fish and Kids burger . Both items were excellent, freshly made and the homemade aioli was better than any professional brand. It's our regular spot after a busy, hot summer day.

We ordered a Tarakihi meal which includes fish nd chips and coleslaw. We also order x2 battered oysters but got muscles instead and x3 battered pineapples and got x4. Presentation was shocking.. Service by the lady was just as bad. We called the stòre and at first they questioned our concern and then admitted to making the mistake offering to make us 4 batterred oysters for the next day. Totally over priced and not worth the price we were charged of $37.

Delivered fast. Delicious fish, chips, chicken burger and hot dog to share between two people. Seating available to enjoy beautiful sunset and sneaky view of the sea past Sentinel Road. Been here before and will definitely come back again. Grateful they close at 8.30pm.
Had a fabulous meal with crumbed fish of the day! Delicious fish and great chips!

Fish tacos = outstanding. We arrived right on opening time and people had already queued outside before the door had opened. We shared the battered fish tacos and an order of crispy calamari between two. The fish tacos are generous in size and the calamari is a decent portion. I found the calamari too greasy for my liking, but the fish tacos are worth the visit.

This has always been my go-to fish and chips shop, and they consistently make some of the best fish and chips I've ever had in Auckland. The fish is always fresh, and the batter is always perfectly crispy and flavourful, and the chips are always crispy and fluffy. The staff are extremely friendly and they always care about what they're serving.

We had todays catch but server didnt mention What it was, battered oyster n haloumni cheese and everything was Perfect. Chips was average. Could put out more seats or bar stools as there was only 1 big table outside.

We wanted to eat the best fish and chips in Auckland and this came in the top list so we give it a go.. Well you will not be disappointed, we got 2 Supper salmon meal, kids fish & chips Meal and a fish burger.. and they are so yummy! My son loves the crispy crumbed salmon, he prefers mine and he ate half of my fish 😅 comes with fresh greens and large portion of chips.. wish you can get more of the sauce, as it is just too small for a supper meal.. But definitely will come back!

Beautiful food and we had a really kind and friendly staff who served us. Good portions for each. I got a roast duck curry and my friend got a pad Thai and it was so authentic and delicious!!! Totally recommend to all friend who loves Thai food. This is the one!!

We had a delicious meal here. We started with a larb gai salad for entre, which was refreshing and spicy. Mussaman beef was just wonderful, and the pineapple fried rice just made it. We will be back next time we are in Auckland.

Nice spot in town. Service was good, slightly forgetful at times. Very delicious food and they serve you quite quickly too. Will definitely be back here at some point as I was struggling what to decide to order as it all sounded so good.
Great service, very polite and accommodating. The food is fresh and has a nice flavour. A neat little find.
Good Thai restaurant, excellent services well priced menu. Four Stars

We were staying in a small hotel a 5 min walk away. We happened on this place and boy were we happy! Outside of Thailand this was the best Thai food we have had the pleasure of eating. We ordered too many dishes but we are happy we did because the green curry was soooooo tasty. I loved the cashew chicken and my husband stole half of my last spring roll! We would stay another night if we could just to eat here again! Price was good, portions were decent.

I’ve been all over Thailand for months and can say with my whole heart this is by far the best Thai food you can actually get in Auckland, the taste is authentic and precise. I’ve been disappointed with a lot of Thai food in New Zealand but this has finally made me content. A must try.
It seems like a newly opened Thai restaurant. I tried ordering takeout and was really satisfied — the food tasted pretty good too.

Ordered from Uber Eats on a whim, knew from the first bite there was a connection to Mae Nam Khong. Have been a frequent patron of the New Lynn branch for over 5 years - the new venue is providing equally great quality food. Very happy to have a location closer to home and couldn’t recommend the place enough for both lunch and dinner.
Yummy food and friendly staff. We got the crying tiger and pad kee mao a bit salty
Delicious food. Food took a long time to come out - but when it did, it was delicious. Unique flavors, Devine. The only thing they can improve is speeding up food coming out.

Such a nice place , loved the pasta i had along with the bread . Our waiter he was so very accomodating , very kind and professional, It was busy at the time and he was definitely top man . Very happy with him and the food thank you .

Loved the ambiance at night. Just like dining at a hole-in-wall in Italy. Service was very good. Not sure if we had to wait to be seated, but we didn’t mind. They were understandably busy when we arrived. Our maitre d’ was on point! Cheerful gentleman who was not shy to engage with our humor. Food was great! The vegetarian pizza, even better. I wanted to taste everything on the menu. Although, my vegetarian lasagna got a bit dry too quick, (I am a fast eater), and the bottom was really chewy. Almost tasted like cardboard? I was wondering if I was meant to eat it, but ate it I did. Haha It was good lasagna though, considering it was vegetarian. Nice place with great food! Must give it a go if you are a foodie or just want to try good Italian food.

One of our favourite local …..‘go to’ Atmosphere and service excellent. Food is even better……absolutely delicious! Great wine menu, great service, great food. Excellent. Not on the menu but always available as ‘a special’ is their mushroom ravioli……so bloody good!! Lovely team, excellent value and seriously good food. They do everything so well!

Go here a lot - sitting in - taking away - sometimes just to say 'hi' - definitely one of my faves. Beef Bourgeon ROCKS - so does the Gnocchi, Prawn Risotto - and the 20 buck takeaway window? ... can't lose.
Friendly owners, fantastic sushi and great value. My favourite local sushi shop!

Spectacular place, excellent and friendly service. One of the best ramen I've ever tried. You can tell there's a great deal of effort put into its preparation. Prices are down to earth. P.S.: I'm the guy who asked for the Tonkotsu Ramen 😂
We had a meal here as a family and I had the deluxe salmon bento . Also came with miso and salad. It was an excellent meal served by friendly people.
Best sushi I’ve ever had, I’m not saying that lightly. The quality of the salmon is INCREDIBLE.
Great food at a good price. Very tasty and well made. I bought some to try....finished it before j got back to my car...so turned around and bought more to take home to the tribe.
Best chicken I have had ever, absolutely yummy. Taco great too. Will be getting lunch from there regularly. Please support these people, they come from Palmerston North.

Up there with the best chicken burgers we have had , Crispy chicken avo burger was amazing, Mango chicken burger delicious, chips well seasoned and the Women who served me was very polite and cheerful. 👏
Hands down the best vegetarian burger I’ve had on the north shore.
Good bun and ok burger but if you are charging gourmet burger prices, it is fair to expect better quality meats and condiments..
Highly recommended this place. Best burger in town

WONDERFUL CAFE!! Nice SCONE & LATTE'. (Today I tried the muffin and it was actually disgusting so don't choose feta and spinach muffin.... inedible. Owners should really be trying what their selling !! )

The coffee is great. I used to get a toasted scone with my coffee and it was easily the best scone experience you could have. Cut in half, toasted with butter... Yum. For some reason, the last few times, even if I ask for the scone to be toasted, it comes in a bag, whole not cut and no butter. Both times when I find this is the case it dampens the experience. I ask each time for it to be toasted and thought this would mean the norm of butter etc but I guess not. Maybe the ownership has changed. Coffee is still excellent.

My partner had a great experience here a few years back but we were disappointed when we visited recently. Service was friendly and helpful and the cabinet food looked really good, but the croissant and cinnamon brioche we ordered were ruined when they heated them up by microwaving them. Also, the coffee was good but not nearly hot enough.

Really great guys, roast their own coffee blends so nice and fresh and really smooth. Tried some sweet treats, cinnamon scroll was deli sh. Also a chocolate crush slice, really really sweet and chocolate flavors. Also they sell pods for nespresso of their blend, As well as bags of coffee. The place was warm and cozy and very clean. Will return many more times.

Great coffee. They have some nice cakes too including gluten friendly options. It’s a socially responsible coffee. The coffee beans are ethically sourced and organic without any comprises to the taste. They roast their own beans so a good place to pick up beans and aero press.
Really good value. A lot of chicken for $23
Had this on my final night in Auckland, DID NOT DISSAPOINT. Highly recommend.
Tasty Fried boneless chicken. Good service extended by the staff. Would highly recommend this restaurant.
The food was awesome and was great value, place was pretty and clean
Great value for money - wonderful food, and wonderful service!

Taste of India has good food, decent service and a nice outfit. Good to see a nice Indian place on the North shore. I wouldn’t say it’s a stand out or unique place than a lot of other Indian restaurants in the neighborhood but it’s definitely better. Tandoori platter was awesome, curries were authentic. I would suggest for the naans to be cooked longer as they tasted undercooked. The mango lassi was way too sweet and definitely didn’t seem worth the $9, adjust the sweetness and some nice edible garnish on it would lift it up. Servers were very pleasant and polite but seemed to be lacking experience. I would encourage the management to put tap beer on the bar or serve beer with smaller glasses, it’s funny to see half empty glass after you have poured whole bottle in. We will definitely go back and expect to see some improvements.

Taste of India Birkenhead is an absolute gem in the heart of the neighborhood! The restaurant beautifully combines a warm, welcoming ambiance with authentic Indian flavors that are simply unmatched. From the rich curries to the perfectly baked naan and delicious biryanis, every dish is a burst of flavor. The staff is incredibly friendly and attentive, ensuring a great dining experience every time. The location at 261 Hinemoa Street is convenient, with plenty of parking nearby, making it perfect for both quick meals and relaxed dinners. Whether you’re craving spicy, savory, or sweet, Taste of India Birkenhead delivers it all with exceptional quality. Highly recommend giving it a try – it’s truly a must-visit for Indian food lovers!

Very accomodating staff, clean place, tasty dishes! Serving size was good. Recommend to give it a try. 👍🏻 Love everything especially mango lassi, lamb chop, and curry! First time to try saag paneer too. It tasted good. 😊

We had a great dining experience at Taste of India, Birkenhead. We ordered the Lamb Chop Mixed Platter, Butter Chicken (Delhi style), and Chicken 65 – and everything was spot on! The lamb chops were perfectly grilled and flavorful, the butter chicken had a rich and authentic Delhi-style taste, and the Chicken 65 was crispy and packed with spice. Great portion sizes, fresh ingredients, and friendly service. Definitely worth a visit if you’re craving quality Indian food!

This place is borderline a disaster. I ordered chicken tikka masala for the first time on delivery. The curry was sweet, like someone had dumped a whole cup of sugar in it. I called to ask if that was how it was supposed to be, and they told me I should have asked for Indian spice. What? So my curry is sweet because I didn’t ask to have it made the Indian way from an Indian restaurant? I decided to give them another chance and ordered the chilli chickens few days later. (As you can see on their photo, it was supposed to be a dry dish served with rice.) I got no rice with my order, and the chilli chicken looked nothing like what it supposed to be. It might as well be a completely different dish. The dish was far too salty even if there was rice. Can not recommend this place to anyone.

Went there to catch up with a friend over dinner. Primerose was clean and tidy. Owners were friendly and welcoming. I ordered the seafood trio, it was super delicious. Crispy seafood bits with a sweet and sour sauce. Not too sweet which is good for me. Generous helping. My friend had the soup with chicken and coconut and money bags from entree. The soup smelt fragrant and it was delicious! I'm looking forward to going back again.
A fantastic little place with very lovely owners. Food was hot and fresh and could not fault it.

Beautiful ambiance and decor! Love the mirrored room. Exellent service!!! Was good to try the varieties of entrees on one plate!! Enjoyed the satay chicken , cab have vit more peanut sauce but the money bags and Puffs were yummy homemade!! The two main courses we had was prepared betyer than we remembered when visiting Thailand!! Awesome Chef that knows her Thai flavors when cooking!! The seafood Green Curry was delicious and had enough prawns. I could not decide which Curry was the best ...this or a Massaman Curry we tried. Next time want to try other dishes as this Chef sure knows her cooking.

The restaurant ambience is amazing but the food was average . The main thing I will have to mention is about the receptionist who took the order. She was looking serious and unfriendly. I would appreciate if the restaurant receptionist / waitress was friendly and sweet. Thanks

Disappointing Experience Overall. Unlike most similar establishments, this place fails to mention that main dishes don't come with rice—an unfortunate surprise right out of the gate. The phone customer service lacked professionalism and courtesy, which didn’t help the situation. Portion sizes were on the stingy side, and the food quality was thoroughly average. Nothing stood out in a positive way. Unfortunately, this was both the first and last time I’ll be ordering from here.

Second visit to The Conservatory, why because the service & food is great . The staff are all so friendly especially so on a wild winters Monday night. Shout out to Ante the wait staff, he was very personable, and a joy to chat to. Keep it up team and thank you. x L

First time dining here. The food was astonishing, every bite was perfect. We were looked after by Mikaela, she has the most extraordinary customer service skills and I hope everyone has a chance to be served by her. You made the experience absolutely fantastic. I’ve been in the service industry over 35 years and extremely fussy about customer service, you were incredible and I wish you great success. Thankyou for a memorable evening.

This place is awesome for a corporate event or just a cheeky lunchtime beer. Beautiful view of the harbour. Ante is one of the best servers I have ever been lucky enough to have! Really cool guy and walked me through the menu with recommendations. Keen to go back and visit!

I come to this restaurant every couple of months because it really has everything I like about a restaurant... good food and service, nice atmosphere and plus it comes with a view. My review will be based on our experience on Saturday 1st March. We came here to have food and drinks prior to attending a concert. We ordered the conservatory pizza, Truffle fries, 2 espresso Martinis, 2 mocktails and 2 proseccos. The pizza was a decent 18" inch pizza perfect serving size for 4 people.
