It was a really nice pizza packed with flavour and enjoyed by the whole table! I highly recommend their Truffle fries (i get this every time I come here)... it's an absolute hit and so morish. The espresso martinis (also another staple I order everytime I visit) does not disappoint. A special and big shout out to Mikayla who waited on our table. Not only did she provide us with the best table service, she was very pleasant, friendly and attentive. The place was quite busy during the time we were here which was mid to late afternoon and she never neglected the tables she waited on, pro-actively made her rounds and still came over a number of times to check on us even after we finished our meal. These are the very reasons why this is my favourite go-to restaurant on the Wynyard strip. And our dining experience on this day was a very pleasing 10/10 experience thanks to Mikayla, bartending staff and the chef!

We only planed on having a drink or two but after seeing the pizza’s ended up coming back and eating here. Unfortunately due to supply issues we didn’t get basil on the pizza and it wasn’t buffalo mozzarella but it was still good. The hero of the night was the parmesan truffle fries highly recommend !! The staff were very friendly.

Great dinner at Botswana Butchery. 2 Steaks cooked to perfection, 1 was too rare for medium but the restaurant employees got it sorted super quickly and did not hide but came forward until we were happy. Great example of excellent customer service. Restaurant is very well staffed and the decor and ambience was excellent! Highly recommended.

Fantastic as always. Definitely a top shelf venue that is consistently good. We shared a few entrees which were all delicious. I had a wagyu steak which good to my liking. Dessert was a real mix of flavours but very nice also. Definitely add this to your list and go if you haven’t been already.

Disappointing Experience at Botswana Butchery – restaurant month $65 each. I’ve always wanted to try Botswana Butchery, so when I saw it was participating in Restaurant Month, I suggested to my husband that we go. The menu looked promising, and while it did say it was designed for two people sharing, we were completely unprepared for just how insubstantial it would be. Sharing usually indicates the portions are big enough to share, not that you will be sharing one portion between two people. First tip: if you’re hungry, eat before or plan to eat again afterwards. The service was on the slower side, but I want to be clear — I don’t fault the wait staff or chefs. What really let the evening down was management, in a big way. Things started to go wrong when the “filet mignon” arrived. It was two tiny skewers with minuscule pieces of filet sandwiched between large hunks of pork. When I queried this, the waiter explained that “filet mignon means different things” and that “in Europe, it often comes with bacon.” As someone who is from Europe and has travelled extensively across France and Italy — the very places where filet mignon originates — I can confidently say I’ve never seen filet mignon served this way, let alone with pork. To make it worse, the skewers came with a disproportionate side of duck-fat potatoes and barely any sauce. The potatoes were dry, and without enough sauce or meat to balance them, they were a chore to get through. Next came two lamb ribs each (yes, only two) with another serving of potato. Thankfully, we had ordered a side of Brussels sprouts, recognising that the set menu had a glaring lack of vegetables. We still held out hope for dessert, thinking it might redeem the experience — but that was the final straw. We were given a single serve of chocolate mousse to share, far smaller than what’s usually served as an individual portion (confirmed by photos on their own website). I mentioned this to our waiter, who understandably looked uncomfortable but kindly took our concerns to the manager again. When he returned, he relayed that we’d normally pay $70 just for the lamb, and that they “needed to recover costs,” which is apparently why we were served pork instead of beef and such a small dessert. He added that management would discuss the menu at the end of the night. I really felt for the waiter — he shouldn’t have been left to explain these decisions. That should have come directly from the manager. To add insult to injury, the payment machine at our table wasn’t working, so we had to go to the front to pay — where the manager, Shaun, was taking payments. He casually asked how the meal was, and when I told him we were unhappy with our experience, he didn’t say a word. No apology, no acknowledgment — just pushed the bill and payment machine toward us. I pointed out that leaving the waiter to deal with complaints was inappropriate, and that as the front-of-house manager, it was his job to speak to customers directly. His facial expression and body language made it clear he didn’t care, and he continued to push the bill toward us. I finally said we wouldn’t be returning, his indifference only confirmed what we suspected: they don’t care about retaining local business — they’ve got enough traffic from cruise ships and tourists. I’m a petite woman (5’3", small build) — it doesn’t take much to fill me up, but even I left hungry. In the end, the only thing Botswana Butchery truly butchered was my bank account: $146. On the other hand I highly recommend Beast & Butterfly across the road, consistently great food, adequate portions, appropriately priced, great service and atmosphere. And I'll guarantee you won't need to visit Gelatimo (best gelato just like in Europe) to compensate. P.s I didn't get a photo of the skewers, that's how taken aback we were.

Our waiter was brilliant, young South African guy. Food really good steaks great. Chips were just overcooked. Only thing that lets it down is the decor (needs a refresh) and plates utensils very dated, and where we sat just had guests walking past constantly
We had an absolutely lovely experience. The food, service and ambiance is just top notch! So glad we decided to visit the place for our special celebration

Fresh seafood, we ordered the oysters, sashimi and fried fish and they were all delightful. Love the theme of the restaurant and overall the staff were all friendly and attentive. A perfect restaurant for a nightout with friends and family, I like how they have different areas for cozy vibes or drinking vibes. Would definitely come back again.

I definitely recommend the pirate platter. It’s full of fresh seafood and the portion is big. The only thing I don’t like is the teeny tiny shrimps. They are more like filling up the empty space of the plate. Both of the desert, tiramisu and brownie, are very good. The texture is creamy, smooth, and rich. They are the perfect ending to this meal.

Parking was somewhat limited, all full when I arrived at 1:15pm Sunday. Parked at next door car park, paid $8 for 2 hrs. (1 hr $4, or $3.50 using their app. Can’t be bothered). Food was awesome overall (except a few prawns slightly off from the platter) Great customer service, took recommendations from the lovely lady serving us. Booked a few days in advance as they are always full for dinner or lunch 🤭 Will be back!
Not often you can say a meal was flawless but this truly was a MASSIVE 10/10. The prawns and oysters and tuna were amazing. Compliments to the chef
Nice experience, Great platter, Great meal and wine choices. Robert and his blonde female colleague have been very kind!

Service was incredibly friendly and beer selection was great. However, we were really disappointed at the size and quality of the bowls of chips we received. At $11 each, we anticipated a little more than a small handful of frozen fries chucked on a desert plate. Very poor value.

Looking for a place to eat and Brew on Quay caught my eye as we passed on the bus. We walked back and were not disappointed. The staff was great and the food was tasty. I had the beef meat pie and it was wonderful. The meat was tender and very flavorful and the top crust was light and flaky. I paired that with a local stout and I was in heaven. Our meal and drinks were reasonably priced, but the staff made dining here very pleasant. They were patient in answering our questions and made us feel very welcomed. Seek out this place for a relaxing good time.

Amazing staff! Such great people. Friendly, knowledgeable, professional and bringing the chill vibes. The range of drinks is outstanding- great pints and they even have our fav; Morning Cider. The building is beautiful - old world solid wood with plenty of intriguing curiosities gracing the walls. There are cozy spots hidden all round the venue so it can feel intimate even when crowded. Decent food - we weren’t big fans of the wings ‘cause we like them classic-style with crispy skin, but we’re from London so we get picky when it comes to fried chicken, these are American Buffalo style as stated on the menu. This is, however, the best pub on the waterfront. We go here whenever we’re doing a shoot in town and the team are brilliant hosts. Thanks guys!

We were a party of 6 and wanted a quiet area to talk. The staff couldn't have been more helpful. We were placed in a semi private area which was perfect for us. Visually interesting. The staff were fantastic, helpful and friendly. The food very tasty with generous portions.The drinks selection was impressive. Highly recommend this place. Thank you for a great evening.

The bar staff were awesome! The young guy that served us looked after us very well. The brews were numerous so we had plenty of choice. The menu was short and sweet but it take a wee while for it to arrive. The Parmi was HUGE! the steak was nice. The footy was on so there was a bit of atmosphere and then when that finished the music played. Thanks for a great night.

Steak was amazing, cooked as asked, vegetables were fresh and tasty, the pie was ok, not quite what I expected, no issues with the no alcohol service. Sat outside and had the clear plastic sheets dropped to stop the wind which was great. Staff were great to deal with. Would return and try other items in the menu.
Service was absolutely amazing! The food was extremely average…. Some things on the menu were all good - like the pizza. But I would not recommend the platters, it is not worth the price.
Lovely waterfront location . Only downside is they don't serve alcohol. I ordered the lamb cutlets and they were delicious. Friendly service as well.
The place is a tranquil one with good view on the wharf if seated outside. The food is of good quality . I had the seafood platter with passion fruit mocktail . The general experience is satisfaction

Had dinner here without a booking. Staff were extremely accomodating, friendly and helpful. Water views were immaculate. Ordered a seafood paella and the market fish of the day. Both dishes were very delicious and well worth the price. Would definitely come back here again.

The ramen is authentic but too salty for me but it’s still delicious and the rice with teriyaki chicken is not what I’m used to but it’s really tasty too! The soup is great my first time to have this type not your usual miso soup!

The service was absolutely amazing and the staff were super kind, the food was out of this world and the broth was perfectly umami and the noodles were cooked to perfection. I would highly recommend the Ramune Lychee Drink with your order.

I was in Auckland on a work trip for a couple of days and craving ramen. I found Ramen Daikoku just a short walk from my hotel at the M Social and decided to give it a try. The owners were so welcoming and helpful. The Ramen was very flavorful and reasonably priced- Tonkotsu with won tons. The portion was generous and filling. It was just what I was looking for after a long flight.

Had dinner with a colleague here for Restaurant Month and I ordered the karaage chicken, tonkatsu char siu ramen and mini beef curry. Dinner was yummy but atmosphere is lacking and the wait staff were basically chatting with their friends throughout our entire meal. I have been here in the past but years ago so this was my first time eating here in a very long time. Location is parallel to the train station.
Undeniably the best ramen on the planet. I dream about the seafood ramen when I’m back in LA, and this is always my first stop whenever I come back to Auckland. Best best BEST!
We have the dinner on weekday. Booked the first table at 6pm. The staff was so welcoming and friendly. The market fish and Lamb were both excellent, yummy and lovely presented.

I have been twice to their High Tea, the place is nice, the table was setted beautifully, staff were nice too but it comes to their special dietary selection, they need to work more on it and make more options to present and make sure the flavor is good too. We had all the finger sandwiches were taste same, scones were dense same flavour and no spread to put on only jam. Dessert was ok but we didn't like the one in the glass jar and I think it was a creamy chia. Their normal high tea menu which I had for first visit was amazing, many voraites and all taste amazing only the fried mussels I didn't really like it. Will come back again.

Went for breakfast buffet. Not much of a variety. Very limited choices. I come from Sri Lanka and compared to Sri lankan buffet this buffet is nothing. However, I did like their hashbrowns and sauted mushrooms. You can also order your choice of omellete. Generous amount of smoked salmon and cheese ;)

It took some time for the meal to arrive but the wait staff were nice, they gave us a free drink for the wait. Unfortunately the mains were a disappointment, my wife's chicken was very dry and over cooked and her salad was wilted and undressed. I ordered the Eye filet medium rear and it was quite rare. Review Edit... the next day. Returned the following evening as it was part of our 2 night package in the hotel, this time our meals were cooked perfectly.

I’ve never been so upset with a waitress as I was during my experience at Knights on Albert. My table and myself were all made to feel incompetent by our waitress as we ordered and she corrected us on small pronounciations and if we did not reply quickly to a question she asked about how we would like meal prepared, she would then talk to us in a childish voice as if we were unaware of what a sauce is or what the difference between medium rare and rare is. Needless to say we were upset and her treating us like children. She then bullied us into starters by saying our mains would take a very very long time and then said she did not think we had ordered enough starters, even though we had gotten plenty for only four people. We were asked 3 different times if we wanted to order more drinks even though or current drinks were very clearly still full/half full. I was also disappointed with the waitresses lack of menu and food knowledge, when asked for a sauce recommendation she said she did not know and that she liked one sauce on anything but that it was spicy, when I told her I did not like much spice she then continued to try to tell me it was still the best sauce and that I should order it. The waitress also misheard one of my guests orders for something completely different and did not repeat the order and unfortunately my guest is too polite to send a plate back, so she was upset for her meal. The waitress also spilt water over 3 of my guests and the table and then did nothing to clean in up, so all of our napkins were wet before the meal arrived. The waitresses name was Deepali, I am only naming her so that hopefully she can get the further training that is required for a restaurant that is supposed to have a higher standard. I would like to comment that another of your waitresses, Ashley, was absolutely lovely and professional as she seated us and got us drinks and that was the quality we had expected to continue through the night that failed.

Excellent food for this cool winter in late July. 1st impressions of the place were terrible due to a rude staff who spoke to us when we asked if we could be seated. (Have taken a 📸 of her). But overall experience of the food 🥩+🥤and the service by the sweet Korean waitress made up for that bad experience with tat rude staff.

I'm not sure if this message will be seen, but I wanted to write this for all the wonderful staff and the manager at The Occidental, especially the Korean staff member who served us. Let me briefly introduce myself — I’m a nurse working in Whangarei. I recently became a New Zealand resident, and I’ll be starting my postgraduate studies next month. To celebrate this special moment, my father took time out of his busy life in Korea and came all the way to visit me for a few days. My father has issues with his knees, so I was looking for something special to support his health — that’s when I found out about the mussel dish at The Occidental. I made a last-minute booking on the day, and I was so grateful to be given a lovely table. The manager kindly arranged for us to be served by a Korean staff member, which made the ordering experience much more comfortable for my father. The staff asked what we were celebrating, and I mentioned that it was my father’s 60th birthday and that he would be flying back to Korea the next day. After our meal, to our surprise, the staff brought out a small cake and sang happy birthday to my dad. It meant so much to me — I’ve always wanted to give him a special memory as a thank-you for all his sacrifices, and this truly made the moment unforgettable. Thank you again to all the amazing staff for making such a meaningful memory for us. I’ll definitely visit again if I have the chance.

Tuesday special was great. We walked in here at around 3p.m. All staff were kind and many seats were available. Steamed mussel was absolutely delicious. But I wanted it to be more like soup, not too thick.

Winter is the best Time to have green lip mussels , better make reservation before heading down for groups larger than 3, else come before 6pm. $88 for 2 large kilos and 2 beers, comes with fries for mussels

Every food I took was just amazing. I’ve never seen this big mussels in my life! Sauce was so good as well. First time drinking Cherry beers and it was so yum!! Wanna visit Auckland again only for this🙌
Restaurant set up as NYC pizza. Simple menu, but the taste was extraordinary. My favorite was the 5 boroughs. It was juicy and flavourful, nice and moist.

Love Sal's pizza but unfortunately my last visit was very disappointing. Customer service is non existent & the staff that served me was rude. I ordered two pizzas online on Sunday 10/02/25 for a 21:15 pick up but when l arrived l was given only one pizza. When l asked the staff where the other pizza was he quickly checked the receipt then realizing his mistake said oh yeah it would be another 5-10 minutes wait as has to make it. No apology nothing. I told the staff this was the second time they've messed up my order and that l couldn't wait as there was no parking out front. The staff told me well what you want me to do??? lm here on my own & there's nothing he can do! I walked out and two other customers waiting in line followed me out the door saying they don't want to eat there after witnessing how the staff treated customers. Anyway l returned after 10 minutes and the order was complete although the heart shaped pizza had the wrong toppings on it lol.

Regret coming … there’s better pizza else where. On their menu, there’s pirce for one single slice, but when we tried to order, they said they can’t just do one slice … ridiculous … why do you offer one slice on the menu then …
Worst pizza I’ve ever had. I can’t believe I paid 50 nzd for this terrible pizza. The basil looks so old. The taste was terrible, I had one bite and couldn’t continue eating.

Haven't had sals in a while so I forgot how good it taste!! Came in here last night pretty quite with no line at all. Staff was so nice and friendly, and place was well kept. Only had 3-4 booths to sit on. Pizza was as good as always (pepperoni and buffalo chicken). Will definitely come back again :)

Have read some reviews here that say this place is under new management, which would explain the completely different experience we had to some of the less complimentary reviews. We visit many Coffee Clubs and there are definitely differences in quality when it comes to food and service. Our experience here was outstanding. The tables were clean, so too the cutlery, plates, glasses etc. The service was prompt and very friendly and professional. The coffee was made by someone who truly knew how to serve it at the right temperature and the milk held its form right to the last sip - true Barista skills. The food was delicious - feta mushroom omelette and the maple pumpkin salad, seriously a 10/10. Maximum flavour, just perfect. Both of us agreed it’s now the new benchmark for what the other Coffee Clubs will be held against. Will definitely be back again - thank you.

Best coffee club location! Came here twice, once for coffee and once for food and both experiences were fantastic. I don’t usually have high expectations of good coffee from coffee club but this particular location has a talented barista who can make lovely latte art and make wonderful coffee. The food portions are incredible too, they actually resemble the promotional photos. I had the shrimp taco and didn’t expect a lot but when I received my dish, the tacos were overflowing with shrimps and I thought it tasted amazing. The best things about this location is the service. The big man (gives off big boss vibes) is warm, kind and honest. He asks you how everything was as he clears your table, he greets you with a smile. He pointed out that we were getting a discount that we were completely unaware of- the kindest gesture. Hope he and the chef and this location thrives, they deserve all the recognition

MY Husband and I cycled through the city and we were able to sit outside at this location with our bikes. New owners have brought a new energy and vibe to this Coffee Club. The food arrived hot and in good time. Service was prompt and given with a smile. It was clean and no hint of a fly anywhere!

Went for lunch with family and accidentally spilled my drink which was completely full. They were kind enough to clean the spill with lovely smiles and even served me a new one. Thank you to the staff on this Saturday!

I’ve always liked going to Coffee Club but this particular location was very disappointing. Very unclean and had to fight flies off my food the whole time. My partner and I got water glasses for our table that genuinely had lip marks still on them. The food took unusually long despite the location being fairly empty, and the burger we got tasted like a frozen patty from Woolworths. I don’t recommend this location.

Was looking for something very authentic, found this place in Auckland. There is good authenticity taste of the food that they prepare, pretty reasonable. There are couple of other Indian restaurants in and around this same area, compared to Raviz’s, I would still recommend Raviz’s ! There are places that offer less in cost, please don’t be fool by that it’s not worth it, because I experienced it. I Love their, Chicken Hot and sour soups, Chicken biryani delicious and kheema Naan.

Was really disappointed for, the food served for table of 8 with a friends family visiting for the first time in Nz we were served aloo paratha with no potatoes and more dough that was raw as well Was even shocked to find raw chicken pieces by in a chicken Saagwala that was a takeaway. We decided to go back to Ravi’s after 3 long years hoping for a good time. But got even worst as my friends family in having a bad few next days in NZ.
While in Auckland, we visited this restaurant for dinner, the owner was very friendly, we had rotis and a veg gravy along with onion pakodas -which was very good and tasty. Highly recommended.
We have loved their Delhi style butter chicken masala more than other dishes biryani was just ok

This is where you go in Auckland for indian food that will blow you mind, tender delicious. Clean spotless, excellent service. I’m a chef my mates a chef we are both highly impressed and we are hard bitten fussy old blokes. This is Professional recommendation not just a Joe blow.
Enjoyed our Xmas lunch here. We went there looking to order some dishes but ended up taking up the 4 options with rice or noodles for $19.50. Staff service was amazing. Would recommend and return.
Great lunch time choices, quick fix and nominal prices. I am a regular here and highly recommend Cinta!

Staff and presumably owner were friendly however the food was below par. The crispy chicken was extremely dry with burnt grilled skin and the butter prawns were disappointing as frozen de-shelled prawns were used. 😞 The butter batter was overly sweet as well. Nice people but I'm not going to go here anymore.

Quite possibly the second worst Malaysian restaurant. Other than serving condiments on ashtrays, the service was rude and confronting. Many more other better options out there. Wouldn't go back again.
Great food at great value. Lovely staff.

The service was wonderful, as soon as we walked into the place the staff were super friendly and welcoming! We got the steak and the cheese burgers and they were perfectly done! Beautiful flavours - Also definitely recommend the bucket of chicken! It was a nice side to add to the table and the chicken was delicious - Payment was easy. one of the staff members were training someone new while we paid and they were both great ☺️ definitely coming back next visit
Excellent service. Excellent food quality. Everything here went above our expectations. Ribs, Chicken Buckets, Chicken & Waffles and Steak meals were all perfect! Outstanding jus with the steak.

Food was good. Tad expensive for what it was. No pork ribs the Saturday night I turned up. Service was average. Not great not over the top. Zero atmosphere. Unless you like listening to Adele's album all the way through.

Beautiful location on a sunny day. The food is wildly overpriced for what turned up. What really let it down was the service. It was like they were over run and it’s not even summer yet. I know they can’t control the seagulls being around, but cleaning the tables promptly will stop them going mental over food left behind. Maybe attempt to clean the bird poo on all the tables?

Service was very slow, had to ask a few times how much longer but did get a complementary bowl of hot chips. The kids were kept occupied with an activity coloring sheet. The waitress seemed in a hurry to leave work and the manager took over the table and was excellent. I ordered the Honey ribs, was disappointed as it wasn't cooked in a honey glaze, just sauce poured over it. The Honey chicken waffles was also disappointing, very small and dry. I have tried this place twice, don't think I will try again.

Feriza’s Turkish/Greek food is a flavor explosion—fresh, vibrant, and downright delicious! The service is warm, attentive staff. Cozy ambiance, perfect for any occasion. From succulent dishes to top-notch hospitality, Feriza’s nails it. A must-visit gem for a memorable dining experience! Five stars!

This elegant Turkish restaurant was a fantastic choice. I visited with my colleagues for a Friday lunch, where we ordered their signature dishes and some nibbles to celebrate. I had the Adana Shish, which included a lamb skewer and a variety of vegetables - the combination was excellent, making for a truly delicious meal. My colleagues ordered different dishes, and judging by their happy expressions, they thoroughly enjoyed their meals as well. The service and ambiance were outstanding, creating a great dining experience. I’ll definitely bring my wife next time. Highly recommended!

I went to this place for dinner tonight and the food and service were absolutely sensational. I ordered the mezze platter with extra lamb and the grilled octopus. The mezze platter came with a generous variety of dips, cold dishes, and breads — it was such a fun and delicious experience trying all the different flavours, and everything was outstanding. The grilled octopus dish was equally impressive, with tender octopus, grilled vegetables, and a fresh, tangy salad that really brought the plate together. Highly recommend checking this place out if you're after top-quality Turkish/Greek-style food!

Been past this restaurant many times in the past (on our way to our favorite Wynyard Grill). Today we decided to have lunch here. We were pleasantly surprised. We thoroughly enjoyed our meals, delicious Turkish food. The Tiramisu was on the dry side. Gave 4 stars as toilet could have a bit more attention.
Friendly staff. We celebrated one of our close friend's birthday here and it was amazing.. love the food options.. very yummy and delicious 😊

Our group had the $45 per person banquet meal, and it was well worth it. The food was delicious — the highlights for us were the money bags and the massaman curry. The only letdown was the dessert; it was a mix of ice cream, sticky rice, and whipped cream, which felt underwhelming. We would’ve much preferred classic mango with sticky rice instead.

Went here last night. Been disappointed with many of the restaurants in Auckland, but this meal was just FANTASTIC!! Super fresh and so tasty. Authentic with great service. Best Thai I’ve had in a long time. Had the chicken pad Thai and a stir fry beef dish which was the perfect amount of spicy! I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend this place. ENJOY!
Tom Yum soup is delicious and feels like authentic Thai taste - a lot of prawns and spicy. My favorite! Papaya salad is not tasty as I expect. Crab Fried rice - DELICIOUS!

Excellent food and service from Thai Street. Papaya salad was nicely seasoned and prepared. Tom yum soup is actually huge for $32.5 and good to share for four people. Pad Thai and beef was fantastic too.

Wow, the lunch menu is inexpensive and tasty as well! We spent $15 usd per person here at lunch, shocking good value (we are from $$$ Hawaii..) We walked in right when they opened at 1130 and immediately loved the indoor outdoor partially covered seating, sunny brisk autumn day and felt so nice to be half in the sun. I LOVED my chicken pad Thai, it even came with some plump little shrimps. Noodles were well cooked and not drenched in sauce, sauce has that slightly sweet tamarind flavor and tangy fish sauce zing that i love. Bean sprouts and scallions were fresh and crunchy and the egg and chicken was tender and flavorful.... 5/5! Husband got the lunch menu pad see ew and though his noodles had great dark soy sauce color, the flavor wasn't as good or strong and he tried to eat my pad Thai instead. He enjoyed the vegetables in the pad see ew though, and he liked his Thai ice tea with whipped cream. We would totally come back for lunch again before we leave Auckland, next time we'll skip the pad see ew but order the pad Thai again! Someone else ordered a stir fried beef with jasmine rice dish that looked great, we shall try that next time

7 of us went to the restaurant on friday (06 Jun '25) dinner and we had a very hard time to communicate as no one speak English there, We used Google translator to order what we need and extra Bits n pieces, Paid $860.00 and checked the receipt once come home and realized many items are not in English, We are living in New Zealand and this is a restaurant in Auckland CBD, but ??????? see attached photos of the receipt.

We ordered the live abalone, which was prepared thinly sliced with vegetables, clams with vermicelli, sweet and sour pork and fried flat noodles with beef. Overall well presented and tasty, but only if you don’t allow the dour mood of the manager to seep into your lunch. Not a food destination, only if you’re around and have tried everything else.

The food is nice but quite expensive. There’s a minimum requirement of $600 if you need to use the small chamber. Anyways the food are fresh and portion size is okay. The chef has performed good standard in preparing the dishes. My fav are the Paua and steamed fish, tender, soft and a lot of flavor. The oysters are jumbo size and are super crispy and fresh.
Except the fresh seafood sashimi and blue cod, other dishes were pretty average. The crayfish were over fried and too salty. There was too much corn starch in the clams dish.

I called in before asking if there was vacancy. The lady at the phone told me to just come in and cut the phone before I could say anything else. Luckily, I understand Chinese because she answer the phone in Chinese and replied in Chinese. When I got there, the lady immediately recognise me probably because I’m only one that arrives in one person. I’m okay with my Chinese but not too good and the people in service don’t know too much English they should really hire someone that knows Chinese and English. The cheese lobster was great. Lots of cheese. The oysters were super fresh with the vermicelli noodles. Just a lobster with the spring onion didn’t have too much flavour. I had a really hard time cutting up the lobster legs so I eat most of it and packed away the ones with shells. Go home and slowly crack them open.
Came here for brunch and it was alright. They only had machine coffee so recommended we go to the cafe next door. Was nice in the sun watching the boats

Be aware that the “anchovy dressing” on the Caesar salad has whole anchovies that aren’t blended like in normal Caesar dressing so it’s VERY fishy and unappetising, especially on top of huge, unchopped lettuce leaves including the thick and inedible stalk. Very poor for $28. Staff were nice and the restaurant is gorgeously decorated but the food was a let down, also got the potato skins but they were far too salty. Didn’t eat either dish and still paid full price because no one asked how it was or why I didn’t eat it. Wouldn’t recommend.
Great pizza, the rest, not so much. The mains were average and the desert below average. Had high hopes.
Had a fabulous bottomless Mother’s Day lunch today with superb service from Christian. Enjoyed the food, great view sitting on the deck and service that makes me want to go back again.

The Lula Inn is a tropical oasis that offers an unforgettable dining experience. From the moment I walked in, I was greeted with warmth and enthusiasm. The vibrant decor and lively atmosphere immediately put me in a buzz. The cocktails were expertly crafted, and the food was bursting with flavor. But what truly stood out to me was the exceptional service, especially from Jordan. His sincerity and attention to detail made our evening even more special. He went above and beyond to ensure we had everything we needed and made us feel like valued guests. The Lula Inn is a must-visit, and Jordan's outstanding service is the cherry on top!

I ordered the crispy fish burger and chips, coming in at just over $22. It didn't take too long to come during the lunch hour rush, but the price made me wince. My polystyrene tray of said burger - a small snapper portion in a sad, dry bun with lettuce and tartare sauce - and seventeen (yes, I counted) chips was deeply underwhelming. Finally, while not the fault of the establishment, halfway through a gull shat in the middle of our table. It felt like some kind of commentary. I would advise an indoor table.

Had a seafood platter for $120, great selection and better value than buying each separate dish for 4 people. Basically all you need to order as well as a few drinks from the bar right across the tables on the other side outside. Nice to enjoy the sunshine and even a Waitangi Day show with dancers and drummers

I like the ambiance of this place. There was three of us in the party having an early dinner. The seafood was very fresh, but quiet pricey for the amount that was served. This is one of the places where you come to eat and have to eat somewhere cheaper to be satisfied.
Cheap and fresh seafood. Nice oysters & sashimi

I was blown away by how expensive this place is. Seems like take advantage of tourists. I have been shopping here buying fish for 30 + years. I moved out a bit further so haven't been here for 45 years. Last trip for sure. $62 for 2 160 gram pieces of fish, I plate with chips the other with a simple salad. Expensive cabinet fish. Tables so sticky clothes stick to them, and skin. People can do way better than this.

Just looking for a little place. Just got into town in New Zealand at the pier. Like for some Asian food, something with flavor. We stumbled upon this place. The food was excellent. Service was good. Staff was prompt on all their items. The food is brought out as it's ready instead of waiting for everyone. Kind of nice. They're just small little dishes that we ordered. Everything tasted extremely fresh. Everything tasted the way it should. And met all our expectations. Me and Agnes were both please. Atmosphere sitting on the water. Relaxing. Eating good food beautiful scenery. Even though we're a little tired from our 13-hour flight. Still was nice to sit down. I have quality food. Another week or so here. Can't wait to try many more restaurants.

Loved loved loved it here. My waitperson (Ima was her name I think, so sorry if I'm remembering that incorrectly) was super sweet. She explained a few things I was confused about being new to the city. She was very kind and mentioned she was also a bit confused when she first moved. The food was also spectacular with *very* generous portions. I was seated with a beautiful view of the wharf. I'm trying a new place every day but so tempted to go nack. Really excellent
Food was great. We enjoyed our dinner. Great place for a family. 😊

As always, your tastebuds are flooded with scrumptious Asian flavours, and beautifully cooked food dishes. Your eyes feast, your tastebuds feast, your tummy feasts, and you leave replenished, dreaming of your next visit. Well worth a dining experience.
Great dinner at White and Wong’s Auckland. Service great, food was served really quickly. Every dish was super tasty and plenty for sharing.

I stopped by Gourmet Burger and Brew Kitchen for a quick coffee break and had their latte, priced at $5.50. The coffee was decent, smooth, and well-made, though nothing extraordinary. The ambiance was cozy and casual, making it a good spot for a brief stop. While the latte was a bit on the pricier side for its quality, the overall experience was pleasant enough if you're in the area and looking for a comfortable place to relax for a while. Would come back to try their food, but for just coffee, there might be better options nearby.
This used to be a Friday lunch favourite. Burgers not so big these days. Buns are smaller but thicker and content is much less. Not serving beer due to no liquor licence so the name is misleading.

20/12/23 The waitress had no care for customer service, her attitude and tone was a reflection of that. Unfortunate for us food was really bad, old bun, burned and dry burger patties and no sauce on one of the burgers. For such a convenient place to grab a quick bite, the food waiting time is really long.

I thoroughly enjoyed the gourmet burger experience. The portion size was generous, and the combination of the burger, beer, and fries was a culinary delight. The flavors were well-balanced, making it a tasty treat. What impressed me most was the reasonable price, making it a fantastic value for money. Highly recommended for those seeking a satisfying and affordable gourmet burger fix.

Awesome spot for a cold Mexican beer after a long day (I'd hiked from north to south across New Zealand's narrowest point) and a delicious burger - I had the cheeseburger - with ample fries. Sit outside with the locals and watch the world go by while you take in the impressive skyline of downtown Auckland. A much better option than the expensive and jam-packed places along the Viaduct. Highly recommended.
Good food and great service by Sree. Loved her! This was our first time here and she made us feel welcome.. definitely coming again. Food was awesome! So fresh 🥰

If youre looking for some top notch food, great night life, or just a night out of fun, this is a really cool place to check out. All of the staff were very friendly and would stop around early so often to make sure I had what I needed. You can watch all your food get cooked, depending on where you sit as well. The margarita pizza was pack full of flavor along with the cevetchie.

Great location and waitress camille was super lovely, she gave great service (would def be only a 3 star review if not for her) . Good place for a drink. I didn't enjoy the food much, pizza average. First one came out with the chicken cold in the middle, impressed at how they fixed this promptly and was better second time around but unfortunately overall not a great tasting pizza. I saw someone else order a burger and that looked much nicer. They advertise their app everywhere so downloaded as it promises $10 credit, however this is only if you order via the app. Do not bother if you've already placed an order as they are not able to link your order with the app (outdated system for sure as just next door at rosie's they encourage you to use their app and no problems to use after you've ordered).

Located upstairs via the escalators from the Viaduct area or via the pedestrian bridge straight from downtown carpark side. Great views and atmosphere. Good selection of food and drinks. They have large tables too for big groups as well, so popular on any day of the week

Stopped here within an hour of getting to town. Great deck with view, place was packed in part due to a private party. Bar staff extremely attentive. My Veggie Bliss Bowl (plus chicken) was tasty. Only negative was the annoying music with the extremely repetitive beat that just wouldn't stop! To be fair, I don't think it started playing until 8:00 p.m. Probably will visit again before heading back to Sydney.

This place was good. It was one we included as a quick stop for a drink and small bite. So glad we did. Mushroom cocktail was good. 10 dollar bo buns was such a great deal and taste great. Service was fantastic. We will go back next time we are eating and drinking at the via duct.
Great rooftop bar for happy hour. Smash burger is perfect! Good drink specials, snappy, friendly service and tremendous views. Check it out!

We had a great experience here with the cocktails and service. Our group of 20+ came in for a Friday afternoon booking and casual drinks with mixed seating/standing and everything ran smoothly (we stayed for hours). We were served mainly by Luke who was incredibly friendly, taking orders and payment, bringing out the orders, keeping everything tidy etc. While we mostly stuck to drinks, we did share some fries, jalapeño poppers, and fried chicken which were all great to nibble on. Stress free experience for a corporate leaving-do and would definitely come back again.

My sister ad i had an amazing evening here , Cocktails and Dinner.. staff was amazing , veiws at night spectacular.. the crowd was buzzing it was a lovely vibe. (apologies for the previous fat fingered review re the 8pm reference that was not intended for this Bar )

What a night at Parasol & Swing! The cocktails were next-level—creative, delicious, and beautifully crafted. The vibe was on point with a great crowd and an incredible live DJ who kept the energy high all night. We had a fantastic time sipping on their signature drinks and then dancing it all off. Such a fun, classy spot for a night out in the Viaduct. Can’t wait to go back! The crew was awesome.

Wow I didn't know this place existed in the centre of town. The grand kids loved and we all had a blast. Cafes to eat and drink at if you like. Neat place to visit, with interesting people all around you.
Great place to catch up, have a beer & bite to eat while watching some sports on the big screen. Very good for casual weekend brunch.

Nice place to sit and enjoy the viaduct, enjoy the view of the boats you will never afford, or look at the restaurants around where you will only visit once in a year or listen to the drink people sing Wagon wheel at O'Hagans
The staff were friendly and efficient food was good pleasant atmosphere, situated on the viaduct basin
One of my favourite hangouts for people watching. Spot the rich and famous spending money like crazy

Came for my Dads Birthday lunch! Was an amazing experience!! Service and food were perfect! 10/10 recommend!! Shout out to our waiter ( wish I got his name ) who organised a special desert for my Dad!!

We visited this place and were absolutely delighted with every dish that was served to us. The flavors were exceptional, and each dish was prepared with the utmost care. From appetizers to main courses, everything was not only delicious but also beautifully presented. The service was top-notch, the waitstaff were professional, polite, and incredibly attentive. They took excellent care of our group, making sure we had everything we needed at all times. We truly felt special and well looked after throughout our visit. This place deserves the highest praise, both for the food and the service!
One of the best meals I ever had in Auckland! Celebrated my birthday here and the waitress was extremely friendly and helpful! Really recommend! Trust me!
Food was very well presented and tasty. Service was prompt, polite and engaging. As a result we ordered additional food. The anniversary platter at the end completed a very enjoyable experience.
Service was lovely (friendly waitress) . Food was ok. Quite expensive for what we ordered(half crayfish was disappointing sadly). View was lovely though. Was our 1st time. Don't think we will be back
Great breakfast stop. Coffee Allpress which is a good blend. We tried a range of different items and they did not disappoint. Friendly staff.

It is to my shame to say I hadn’t visited Baguette and Co in years, and that is going to change, I plan to be a regular. Walked past and saw they were doing a daily soup special for winter, the leek and potato soup coupled with the perfect baguette did not disappoint, best soup I’ve had in a long time and couple this with the $12.90 price, I felt like I should be paying them more haha. Service was friendly and efficient. A great little spot with delicious food.

Picked up the Bastille today, two lovely girls served me today and the owner is always so lovely and a great customer service person. Let me tell you about this bad boy. Think fresh baguettes made on the day, crisp rocket and a Cheddar that will make you want More tied together with a generous amount of salami and my favourite gherkins that I just love. Great for a grab and go lunch when your on the road!
Very cool place, amazing food, the perfect lunch on the go!
Great food (authentic French bakery goods), great coffee (Allpress) and great service! I've been a regular customer for years and always enjoy coming here for either breakfast, lunch or both.

We had dinner at Frida Cocina Mexicana at Auckland’s Viaduct Harbour. The setting is casual and unpretentious — more of a laid-back lunch spot, but it worked fine for a relaxed evening meal. Service was friendly and very quick, which we appreciated. The frozen margarita was refreshing, and the food was tasty and came out fast. Overall, it’s a nice place if you’re looking for a simple, quick, and satisfying Mexican meal in a central location.

Prime location, food is so so. Suitable for work gather or groups. It’s a little pricey but understandable due to location rent and costs etc but you will be sitting right in front of water which is nice. I won’t go into detail about the food because it’s somewhere between acceptable and not bad…, will leave it to your own judgment.

My go to Mexican restaurant in Auckland! I am originally from Texas where Mexican food is amazing so it’s really difficult to impress me but Frida tastes amazing every time! I usually get their carnitas tacos. They are also the only place I’ve found so far that actually has a margarita machine! Love their frozen watermelon margaritas. Only thing that I don’t enjoy there is their rice, but that’s fine by me!
The food was amazing!!! Packed with flavour and culture it really felt like I was on vacation. Dessert and drinks were also just as amazing and staff were all friendly and attentive!!!

Food was amazing, coming from Latin America and living in Australia this is so far one of the best Mexican restaurants in this side of the world I have tried. The pork belly was beautifully cooked and birria tacos were made with corn as promised. Actually quite surprised it doesn’t have better reviews, maybe people is not used to authentic Mexican cuisine and are more into the tex mex stuff???
It was my first time trying Filipino food, and it was really nice to experience different flavors. I recommend the pork blood curry.

(April 12 Dinner) After being disappointed by the other place on Queen St., this Pinoy restaurant truly redeemed the experience! Food: The food was SO GOOD! I can’t even describe how happy we were dining here! Every single dish we ordered tasted above average, truly exceptional Filipino food! Their chef must be top-tier! Ambience: Felt just like home in the Philippines. Service: The servers were very friendly, especially Brenda! Thank you for the extra yummy bagoong for my delicious Kare-Kare!

Boracay Garden Restaurant exceeded our expectations! The Pancit Canton was flavorful, the Crispy Pata perfectly crunchy and tender, the Fresh Lumpia refreshing with a tasty peanut sauce, and the Leche Flan creamy and delightful. Great food, friendly service—highly recommend!

We found this restaurant while walking the viaduct. We love the food so much that we went back after a day. They serve delicious authentic filipino dishes. They servings are plenty and could be shared. Service is quick and they people very pleasant
Authentic Filipino cuisine!!! Worth the travel, busog sarap to the max! Taste the real Pinoy food and hospitality! We will surely visit again.

My regular Hello Mister spot. Always come here for a banh mi which hasn't disappointed so far - crispy but fluffy bread, plenty of pickled veges and heaps of Viet mayo. The crispy pork one is my go-to. Really friendly service for such a small and lunch busy spot!
Best crispy pork baguette in town! I’ve tried a few Hello Mister branches, but this one nails it every time. Perfectly cooked pork and an unbeatable baguette. Highly recommend

Bought 2 madam mi (beef lemon grass and roast pork) last Thursday and was so dissapointed. More than half of the filling were carrots. Barely meat in it. And almost 1/4 of the roll had no meat at all. No soy sauce so it's quite plain. Not worth $10 at all. Won't come back.
Authentic Vietnamese cuisine. Feel like home. Especially Bánh mỳ and fresh rolls..
Found amazing secreat vitenam food spots! Reasonable price, Taste was amazing. Lucky I found this place🍜

I have ordered from here a few times. I always get the small size meat on chips, mixed. Chips are always yummy, hot and cooked to perfection. Meat is delicious. Although the most recent time I ordered, there was more beef than chicken, there was hardly any chicken and was covered under the beef so I wasn’t sure whether the cashier heard me correctly say ‘mixed’. Despite that, I’d still order from here again. It’s delicious

The man is a cashier about 45 years old, bearded, bald, slim frame glasses and thin, has a rude attitude towards Japanese women. Also, he didn't give me the coffee I had paid for, so I asked him how about the coffee? then he went to make it, but he didn't apologize to me at all. He does’nt like Asians in general. The meal taste was good, but the lamb was a poor quality frozen product and was tough, so maybe the lamb isn't from New Zealand? The quality of the rice is poor and the price is too high.

Bought a snack pack for $10, and the chicken and chips were crispy and okay, but the portion size of chips was ridiculously small. I've been to another place that has "Country Fried Chicken" and their snack pack has so much more chips at the price of $7.
We ordered large mixed rice with a little hint of spice for $19. tastes very good and service was fast. portion of meat with rice is ok too. we enjoyed the meal👌

I was too hungry so I grabbed a large chicken jebab there. The chicken were very salty and savory. In case you are too hungry, you can try. Otherwise it's not that "large" with regard to its price. Even going to supermarket and having something prepared are better than this.

Lovely location to have dinner followed by a stroll on the viaduct. Staff were super friendly and accommodating. Big variety of options to choose from. Highly recommend the muscles and the steak and the fries. The desserts are a must try too the flavours all complemented each other. Overall great spot for dinner with friends and family.

Kingfish crudo was super fresh, yum!! lobster ravioli absolutely mind-blowing, 😍 Wiped the bowl clean of that lobster bisque 🦞I love it!! Mains were just as impressive, lamb loin perfectly pink and juicy, paired with Jerusalem artichoke 👌 Asked for medium rare scotch, but it was slightly rare, still delicious 🥩

We went on a summer evening. The opted to leave all the doors and windows open instead of turning the AC on. So it was a bit hot and stuffy. The food was ok. A bit of a hit and miss. We enjoyed the short ribs, but the duck breast and tuna were average.

My wife and I had the pleasure of dining at La Marée restaurant in Auckland recently, and it was truly an exceptional experience. From the moment we walked in, the warm and inviting ambiance set the tone for a delightful evening. What truly stood out for me was the attention to detail and the evident passion that went into every dish. The chef's creativity and skill were in the unique flavour combinations and the impeccable presentation. It was evident that only the freshest and highest quality ingredients were used, resulting in a truly memorable dining experience. We noticed that the restaurant was quite busy that night and the service was a bit slow in clearing our tables and attending to us. However, I would highly recommend La Marée restaurant to anyone looking for an exquisite dining experience in Auckland. The combination of exceptional food, friendly service, and inviting ambiance truly sets La Marée apart. I eagerly anticipate returning to create more cherished memories there. Thank you very much for the wonderful experience!

La Maree is overall a restaurant that gives a unique dining experience, however, I feel that it's uniqueness is unable to shine through the already saturated Auckland Restaurant Scene. Service was good, attentive and friendly. Just what you expect from a Sofitel Location. Food on the other hand was a mixed bag. Starters (Octopus, Scallops and Crudo) were "okay". Out of those starters, I think that the Crudo had the best blend of complementary flavours. I appreciated that the sweetness and tanginess was perfectly balanced with the Crudo. Another good point was the cook on both the Octopus and Scallops, these were cooked perfectly and had the perfect texture for these types of protein. The flavours on both of the other starters were quite subtle and did not have a bold punch compared to the others. The Duck Breast was okay. The puree was a good touch to enhance the flavours of the Duck Breast. The Jus was also quite subtle as I expected something which was strong enough to cut through the puree vice versa. Dessert was good, the chocolate brownie was not overly sweet and provided a good balance. I enjoyed the different textures with the dessert and the creative plating. Overall while the food here okay and acceptable, personally I think that with the wide range and options available in Auckland, La Maree is not memorable enough for me to visit again. Note: Accor Plus was used for this dinner.

Great little spot in the city with a cozy vibe. We tried the hearty beans and mince absolutely delicious and full of flavour. However, the Korean chicken burger didn’t quite hit the mark for us; the chicken was a bit dry and lacked the punch we were expecting. Still, it’s a solid cafe and worth a visit for the right dish

Great cafe! A group of us popped by on Good Friday. The service was excellent. We bought a variety of savory and sweet cabinet items, all of which were very tasty! The coffee was great too! The outdoor scenery adds well to the experience.
Great little place tucked away. The establishment is very clean and well presented. The staff were friendly and approachable. It’s very small, but you don’t need anything more.

Had a good hearty breakfast here. Loved all of the flavours and textures in the Melba Breakfast plate especially the bratwurst but the eggs and bacon were also cooked perfectly - just right Coffee was excellent, made with a lot of care by the owner / barista Service was warm, friendly, attentive and timely

I’ve tried a few things here now and have really enjoyed it. The sandwiches and cabinet cakes are absolutely delicious—super fresh and full of flavor. Definitely keen to come back and try more. The iced chocolate is smooth, not overly sweet, and really easy to sip on. Recently had the chicken burger—so good. Could've put a bit more chips and dipping sauce tbh. Would still happily order this and from here again tho.

I know this is junk food, but junk shouldn’t be laying all around a restaurant… I mean seriously, I get that fast food workers are paid like misery and as someone who’se been through it, I know they don’t really out passion into their job, but this is beyond disgusting. Rubbish absolutely everywhere, on the tables, on the ground, it’s absolutely unsanitary.
Visited Saturday night. Busy and very long prep time (15 minutes) Seated area being locked (despite having plenty of space). Overfilled rubbish bins.

The fries were cold on requesting to change as its for my kids the Lady on shift changed the fries and threw the bag towards me. The staff on duty require some serious training. Their attitude towards customers is terrible. I know ur busy but we all paying customers. The same service in Philippines and south asian countries is even better for a fast food joint as busy as this one. Hope you improve and treat customers with respect.
Very good meal. I could try a sandwich that it is not in my country!

I mean it's a maccas. The food is gross but delicious - I only ever eat the nuggies and soft serves. Guy at the till was nice enough and was very quick (I paid with cash). I don't like how they just give 2 tiny little packets of ketchup I with 10 nugs like I'm pretty sure the packets never used to be that small.

Memorable experience at Custom Lane Coffee. Fresh and delicious pastries, great vibe. Great service from the barista, super friendly and attentive. Definitely made the time feel extra special ( sorry! I didn’t ask for your name but a Vietnamese. Definitely coming back!
A blink and you miss our cafe. Coffee is comparable to any other cafe, but, for the live of God, the doughnuts are AMAZING!!!
lovely hot chocolate by mövenpick friendly staff
Strong, organic coffee with service that’s friendly and kind. Ordered long black with cream.

Read about their croissants so decided to try it out, they were out of croissants and pain au chocolat before 8.15am.. They didn't seen busy but the service was slow and people were left waiting for a takeaway coffee while others were served first. I ended up getting a brioche swirl, it was average (I didn't realise it was savory, not a fan but not their fault!). Wouldn't come back again just not a good experience here
Really delicious food and great service. Also love the interior, feels warm and such a relaxing vibe. Highly recommend the Cacio e Pepe! It was delish!

Very sadly did not enjoy this one though I had high hopes. The staff weren't very attentive we had to wave them down a few times to place an order. We had the piadina and the pane frito. The sauce for the piadina was just.. not good. It tasted very strange and the flavours just weren't good together. Couldn't have more than a bite. The pane frito was drowning in too much cream - though thankfully the flavours were palatable (unlike the piadina). Given the price and food, it's unlikely I would return.

I've dined here on numerous occasions, and despite menu updates per season, the quality remains consistently high. I also appreciate the fresh juices and their creative, healthy, and delicious combinations.
The seafood risotto is sooooo yum! Top 3 I have ever tried 🔝 . Broccolini is a bit disappointing because it’s too dry. Love the vibe and service here too

Such a special place to us! Ortolana hosted our wedding reception and they did an incredible job. People couldn’t stop raving about the food and the service was wonderful. They were so organised and personable, plus it’s the perfect space for a small gathering. Thanks for making our day one to remember! From Lydia and Jay 🩷
Just left Rangitoto Island and was looking for a spot to shut my hunger, and what a lovely place I found! Amazing burger! Will definitely comeback in another opportunity!
Thickshake was actually a milkshake and too much syrup flavouring was used, size was also rather small for the price. Bio Fuel Burger was however very good!

Delish, all incredible options and loving the gravy and fries! Service is always great. Atmosphere lower ranking just cause it feels basic, once interacting with staff it changes, but when eat in it's like any other fast food place.
No complaints, food was good, served hot, and mango shake was tasty.
Quiet and calm like I needed. As always the food is amazing plus they are the only store I can get Gluten free chips. So when I walked in I was feeling down and when I walked out I was Very Happy

We did have some doubts after booking with the negative reviews that we saw before actually staying. But I am glad that we did. It may not be glamorous but it’s still a great place to stay. The location was brilliant, the staff helpful and informative, and easy to deal with. I have already advised them of the one negative, which I am sure that they will sort out. Nothing major by the way.
Lovely old world hotel with great atmosphere, comforts and stunning views over the harbour. Really helpful and considerate service. We will be back.
Quirky character filled locals dive bar with some great history. Service seems really good. Manage your expectations and you’ll probably have a good time. Beautiful views and a screen to watch sport.
Gorgeous old hotel, oozing with history. Room 210,nice big room, simple and practical. Totally central to Devonport and ferry if you need to go to downtown Auckland.

Was an OK experience. The seating mostly suited the younger generations, whereas those of us who are interested in the history of the building and town had minimal seating around the fringes. It was a shame the staff had no idea of the history and only showed minimal interest in the info I was imparting, having found a few references within the room that I had a personal connection with. Such a shame.

Ordered the Simple Steak for $36. What a disappointment at that price point. I asked for medium rare and it was cooked perfectly but for $36 got a steak with gristle, very plain looking chips, a fried egg and aioli. I should have checked the menu more closely. No sauce, no salad and presented like a $20 pub steak. Maybe the salmon would have better value at $31.50

The waitress who greeted us seemed a bit grumpy but we sat down anyway because we were all dying from hunger. The mussels we ordered were cooked well but the sauce was a bit strange, had a strong white wine flavour. The fish pie and chowder were average. The kids pizza was a bit pricey. Overall, the food was ok but nothing memorable. The restaurant has a nice interior and was comfortable to sit in..

My first time with this lovely restaurant. The atmosphere feels like you are at your best friend's home and having a catch-up with your love or friends. I love how the menu is simply explained. The name might look simple but the taste! So amazing. The duty manager is lovely and the same with the staff. They are friendly and smile. We walked in without booking but there were plenty of seats that were not reserved (recommend calling and booking, we are just lucky ) Notes! There are lovely dessert menus so please make sure you have some extra space on your tummy. We don't have it cause we are too full.
Don’t buy icecream here. The scoops are so small you’ll need a microscope to see them. But the price is over 10$ for two scoops. We feel scammed.
Great friendly service, menu, tables etc are a bit tired but the view of the harbour from the street tables makes up for it.

My family and I had a wonderful dinner at Portofino to celebrate the Lunar New Year, and it was an experience to remember! The restaurant offers a beautiful view, creating the perfect setting for a special occasion. The food was absolutely delicious, each dish crafted with authentic Italian flavors that we truly enjoyed. Beyond the amazing food, the warm and welcoming atmosphere made the evening even more special. The staff were incredibly friendly, and the owner’s generosity left a lasting impression on us. They also treated us to two glasses of Limoncino liqueur, which was absolutely refreshing and the perfect way to end our meal. We highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for an amazing dining experience. Great food, lovely ambiance, and excellent service—everything you need for a perfect night out. We will definitely be coming back again! Thank you, Portofino, for making our Lunar New Year so special!

We discovered Portofino by accident while visiting Devonport, and we’re so glad we did! The restaurant is run by a wonderful couple who are incredibly kind and welcoming. The food was amazing—fresh, authentic, and full of flavor. The atmosphere was so inviting, it felt like being on a holiday in Europe. We loved everything about this place—the food, the service, and the vibe. We’ll definitely be coming back and highly recommend it to anyone in the area.

Great service, from warm and friendly staff. They are willing to alte a meal to suit dietary requirements. If major allergens are an issue, as with most restaurants, by prior arrangement, meals can be changed to suit. Always a classy dining experience

Went with my 13 year old son for a Sunday dinner and the food was amazing as normal. Generous servings, great classics everyone loves including the best steak and cheesecake plus great service! We’ll be back before too long.

Exceptional dining choice for anyone seeking quality food, expertly mixed drinks, and a stunning wharf view, making it an ideal spot for romantic dates. The restaurant's ambiance is elegant yet welcoming, with attentive service that enhances the experience. Will definitely come back again.

I thoroughly enjoyed a lovely lunch here! The staff were incredibly attentive, offering excellent customer service from start to finish. There was a good selection of food on offer, with something for everyone. The ham, mussels, fish, and beef were all delicious, with a range of salads to choose from, and the dessert selection was the perfect sweet ending. The view was the cherry on top. Just a beautiful place to sit back, enjoy good food, and unwind

We were a group of 28 (adults and children) celebrating my parent’s wedding anniversary. They had excellent service - very attentive and not at all frazzled by our huge group. They had a lovely, warm atmosphere with a great view of the beach.

I had an amazing experience at Mchugh’s From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere was warm and inviting. The staff was incredibly friendly and attentive, making sure we were comfortable throughout the meal. The food was absolutely delicious — every dish was beautifully presented and packed with flavor. I highly recommend the chicken mushroom it was cooked to perfection. The portion sizes were generous, and the prices were very reasonable for the quality. Overall, a fantastic dining experience. I’ll definitely be coming back and recommending this place to friends and family!

Went here for lunch on Saturday, great selection of delicious mains for lunch. The service was amazing, the 2 main staff members were very patient, accommodating and friendly. In our group, several people were gluten free; there were enough mains that were gluten free, but unfortunately, from the good selection of desserts, the only gluten free dessert was fruit salad. This was very disappointing as we had let the restaurant know we had several gluten free people and we were told we’d be catered for but we weren’t. (Lunch was booked at least 3weeks in advance with GF information). This place also has fantastic views! And we were at a big round table which is always better than a long rectangle table! Thank you!

Service was flawless — attentive without being intrusive, with staff who genuinely care about your experience. It’s rare to find a restaurant that excels in food, service, and atmosphere, but Mchugh’s gets it all right. We left happy, full, and already planning our next visit. Truly a top-tier dining experience!
Came here for a friends birthday. Delicious food with amazing service! The ambience of the restaurant was very welcoming. It’s also BYOD ($8).. very lovely & I highly recommend

Great night, outside, Devo buzzing with slightly drunk people from the wine festival parading by. A perfect setting for an entertaining dinner. And food...... Delicious!!! Service? Great young crew looking well after us. My husband would like a few more dishes without tomato.
Delissimo! The freshly made pasta is a match made in heaven, superb! Very reasonable pricing! Ciao

Food was good but they told us we had 2 min to order, bought out the wrong food, poured a glass of water down my back and over my clothing and still charged us full price. We finished and left before the posted closing time. You could tell they wanted to get out of there early. Never been treated so badly. (2 May). There was 4 of us

Beautiful gem in Auckland! Easy ride from the ferry from CBD (adds to the experience) and fabulous food! Authentic Italian with generous servings. We were in a bit of a hurry and after explaining our situation we got served very quickly!

The most delicious food with amazing service with the bonus of being dog friendly outside so the whole family can come. Shashi looked after us the whole night and his advice on what to eat was perfect and catered to everyone’s needs. Can’t recommend this place enough!

Sigdi was amazing. The food was incredible and somehow the service was better. I’m dairy free and they were very helpful and offered any of curries to be substituted with coconut cream and was thorough to check if it was an allergy and pointed out all traces. They made sure that all changes were welcomed and you don’t feel like a pain which was really refreshing. Super accommodating and then amazing food means we will be back plus our food was made very quickly.

First time I ordered, the food was great. However, the second time, my order was lacking in taste a bit and was the texture was slightly off. The staff are friendly and are sometimes willing to have a little bit of a chat if they're not too busy. You shouldn't be disappointed with your order, as others seem to be having mostly good experiences :)

BEST VEGAN CURRY! These guys are amazing for vegetarian and vegan curries and if you are looking for something made to order they'll surpass your expectations. Really good service at a decent price and you can taste that everything is freshly cooked. Since going plant based 2 years ago i've not come across a better curry !

Wonderful service, attentive and kind. The food here is a cut above most other Indian places, with home made samosas, perfect onion pakora, and a traditional tandoori oven that they preheat during the afternoon and make lots of dishes in so they're smokey and flavourful. Their breads are SO yummy. Highly recommend.

Had dinner at Curry of India with my parents. Food was absolutely divine. I had the onion bhaji, matar paneer and gulab jamun, all of which was 10/10. My parents also had an excellent experience and we will definitely be back.
We were looking for anywhere to eat at 4pm on a Sunday and stumbled onto this place. The food was delicious and reasonably priced. I will definitely be coming back.
Extremely poor quality food! I ordered the butter chicken and butter paneer. They tasted like a sugar pot had been poured into the gravy. The chicken tasted like cardboard. Waste of $50!
Recommended by a friend and the food does taste good with a high price-quality ratio.
Absolutely amazing food and service. The staff are always so friendly and this is my new favourite eatery.

We were excited to have authentic Thai food but not many choices of Thai food. They had Indonesian, Indian, even hot chips and chicken nuggets. Food was very average,seafood Basket seemed just frozen squid ,battered Surimi and others. Pad Thai with parsley (not corianders) That kind of Thai food.. Not for us.
We had a lovely dinner here. The food was tasty and well priced.
Absolutely delicious meals here and the service was fantastic.

I've been living out here for five years now and I don't know why I hadn't come here sooner. Food is fantastic, not drowned in sauces like many other Thai establishments and has a very wide variety of dishes. This certainly is a gem in the heart of devonport for authentic Thai food.

Food was excellent and the service very congenial. It was very quiet though, with few diners. Maybe that's just a Devonport on a Wednesday evening thing. There were a lot of people coming in to collect takeaways so the food is obviously popular and of consistent quality.

Something needs to change here. Get managers that care or staff who want to be there, maybe pay them more, the girl I saw, a short Indian girl was super rude to me as I had my service dog and she kept telling me.to put it outside. Another taller Indian girl served me who was slightly better. She still looked worried bit served me. Need some training about service dogs. He's allowed with me! Unfriendly and ordinary subway. In a great village. Look at the low reviews here. Something needs to change. Wake up!

Pretty average service most days. There's one lady that does her job very well. One of the more expensive branches around, but that's standard for devonport. The main issue is that the menu is buggered. I genuinely couldn't tell you the difference between a sub-box and a combo, because I've asked for both, and seem to get 0, 1, or 2 cookies with my sub at random regardless of what I ask for. Secondly, whether an energy drink is an upgrade to the combo/sub-box/whatever is up in the air. I've been given it at no extra charge, been charged extra, or just straight up denied it coming with the deal at all. There's other issues with discount codes not working, and other things. Most of this can be avoided if you order using the app, but if I have to order using the app while I'm standing inside your store, you need to update your menu to be clearer. I understand that this isn't the stores fault, but I also don't have this issue at any other subway, so there's clearly just something this store is/isn't doing, that it needs to alter. I love that one of their menu screens says "Choose your combo and we'll do the rest" because evidently, they won't lol.

I can’t make it negative but if I could will do it since the guy took so much time he was on his own and terrible this Indian guy had no idea about hygiene!!!! So DIRTY He was receiving cash and didn’t change the gloves even when I asked him he didn’t say anything!! And he didn’t understand English and we couldn’t understand what he was saying so better staff who can speak English please !!! And clean !!! If I get sick I’ll post it back !Hope I get the manager !!!
my subway looks sad and has no filling and is burnt and taste bad and the bread is yuck i do not recommend.

I just ordered a teriyaki sub, at 5pm they only had 3 types of bread left. Worst was the fact that this is the stingiest amount of meat in a sub I have ever see, around the world - maximum half of what they are supposed to put on. Same goes for the salad and sauces. Customer service and friendliness isn’t their strength either and they top of off with an above average price $12.90 for a footlong!

Popped in for lunch. Food was very good. Table servers were pleasant. Bartender seemed in a "mood". Reuben sandwich was too large to finish. Chicken burger very tasty. Guiness meat pie excellent. Soulvaki meat was very nice.

This is my first time at this place and it was really good I just stopped in to have lunch the vegetarian nachos we're good and very filling it was great sitting outside devonport is a lovely place to be you meet some cool people and the architecture of the surrounding buildings adds to the ambience Of this really nice establishment

Quaint old building with Irish pub. Regular pub food that wasn't bad. Steak and Guiness Pie was good, burger too. Schnitzel was average, felt like the oil was tainted and I'd prefer lemon instead of gravy on my schnitzel. They had a band playing, which was pretty good. It was an enjoyable evening .

Fairly standard British style pub. Menu is OK. Food was reasonable. Desert was 1 option and didn't even get it as kitchen closed at 9. No port options. Nothing like Baileys or a desert wine. Pretty limited. But otherwise good. Staff were friendly and helpful. No issues with the food and big servings.

The food was quite delicious. The fish and chips were nice and hot but yet not greasy. Of course a nice cold Guinness with a good head tops everything off. Service was actually quite good. I did order at the bar, pay at the bar, and the food was delivered fairly quickly. The more I eat here in Auckland the tradition is to order and pay at the bar in the food gets delivered to your table. This was nothing different. I would definitely return again as their menu looks quite delicious

Decided to take my lunch at this lovely place when I visited Davenport, and I think I made the right choice. The Salmon on the toast I had was lovely, but a bit pricey tho. The great thing is that they also have gluten free and dairy free options available for those who have dietary restrictions. The staffs and the owner (a guy with that lovely dog?) were also nice and friendly. It was a lovely afternoon surely.

Great taste and happily so much veges. Piano was too much for us but kind service though a bit slow. We did not really get the pricing as fishtaco dish was most expensive but smallest portion we had. Thanks!

Came to visit devonport and picked a random place to have lunch, this place was the lucky one ☺️. Staff are very welcoming, and there are many seats inside as well as options outside. The food is definitely enough to fill you up. I enjoyed the burger and wedges.

The Vegan Avocado Smash was the best vegan brunch I have ever eaten. Delicious and interesting new textures and flavours including with the vegan bacon bits. Exceptional. Delightful and quick service. Love the dog friendly ambience; especially due to the owner’s beautiful, relaxed dog. Look forward to going back.

The atmosphere was lovely. Service can be good or average depending on who manages your table. Unfortunately I wasn’t quite happy with their food.
