The menu sounds interesting and can tell they try to be different ( much of Korean influence eg their sauce) but the results didn’t meet my expectation. A bit pricey for what you get. I visited two times but both I felt underwhelmed.

Absolutely loved my experience at Devon On The Wharf! This boutique Mediterranean spot is a hidden gem with an unbeatable atmosphere. I sat at the bar and had the perfect view of Auckland City and one of the most stunning sunsets I’ve ever seen. The vibe was relaxed but stylish, and the service was top-notch—friendly, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. There’s a fantastic variety of drinks and food on offer; I went with an Asahi Super Dry, one of my favourites, and it hit the spot. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a scenic, laid-back evening with great food, drinks, and vibes!

I visited Devon Wharf for the first time, hoping to enjoy a traditional Turkish breakfast experience, but left feeling underwhelmed by the food quality—though a few items did stand out. I ordered the Menemen, which is usually a rich, flavorful egg dish in Turkish cuisine. Unfortunately, this version was extremely watery and lacked the characteristic texture and taste of eggs entirely. It felt more like a runny tomato sauce than the hearty dish it’s meant to be. The flavors were flat, and I couldn’t identify any of the comforting spice or depth that usually defines Menemen. Another dish I tried was what was described as a Turkish breakfast with sujuk. While the plate looked good visually, it didn’t live up to expectations in terms of substance. It mainly consisted of scrambled eggs served over Turkish pide (flatbread), with just four small pieces of sujuk—which was surprisingly sparse. Many of the sides and accompaniments seemed like they came from tins or pre-packaged boxes rather than being freshly prepared, which took away from the authenticity and freshness one would hope for in a Turkish-inspired breakfast. Overall, I would rate the breakfast elements a 2 out of 5. That said, not everything was disappointing. The baklava was crisp, sweet, and well-balanced, and both the coffee and mango frappe were enjoyable. These items showed care in preparation and delivered on flavor, helping to redeem the overall experience. So while the mains fell short of expectations, the drinks and dessert were pleasant enough to justify a 3-star rating. I might return for a sweet treat or coffee, but would likely give the breakfast menu a miss next time.

Very overpriced and the dishes were flavorless, not worth it in my opinion. The fish lacked spices and the steak was very underwhelming. The sound of the waves was nice but the loud music is distracting and we had the ask the staff to turn it down a bit. I wouldn’t recommend going there since there are much better options with tastier dishes.
great place, food is ok, can be better, price is no to bad, but is expensive if the taste is not the best, can be much better

Has great potential but sadly needs a few tweaks. The restaurant was empty but tables all booked. Said I would be gone in 30 minutes but wait staff said not sure when bookings would come in. (As per photo restaurant still empty when I left) The floor staff were busy, but the bar staff just kept ringing the bell for 1 drink to be collected as he learnt against the bar on his phone. The food was over priced for what it was and the chef has obviously not thought how someone would eat the food. The Turkish breakfast over priced scrambled eggs. The one small piece of bread covered in scrambled eggs and nothing then to eat the over sweet mascopone or the beetroot realish. (A small spoon would have helped). And sadly back to the bar tender, to busy playing with the ice then offering water to any guests. Has potential as great location and lovely outdoor space.
Great value.❤️Tasty food 😍and crispy chips. 😘Hopefully the sign is a big bigger easy to find 🤗

Wow. Don't know what's happened to these guys. Used to be a staple, reliable go to f and cs place. Now the prices are up the quantities are down and the quality is poor. Fish was dry and small - both the crumbed and the battered. Chips were soggy and quantity was meagre. The burger was small and dull and forgettable. Embarrassing to have friends with us for this experience. Squid rings were good though. Come on guys - you used to be so good - what's happened.

Fish is always fresh the batter crispy and not greasy. The owner is very nice and accommodating. Sweet and sour chicken is very good. I get the sauce seperate which makes it less soggy. My favorite takeaways.
It’s a takeaway however you can walk to Cheltenham Beach and soak up the atmosphere. Good customer service, the BEST Fish and Chips we have had in a very long time!
Nicely crumbed fish tasted fresh and my boys loved it! Chips were standard - what you'd expect. Tasty Pineapple fritter.

This fish chips is really good! The fish is super fresh, perfectly fried-crispy on the outside, tender in the inside, and no fishy smell at all. The chips are hot and crispy, soft in the middle, and the portions are generous, which is great! What I love the most is how generous they are with the seasonings! Everything is so flavorful and satisfying. I’ll definitely come back again!
Nice fish burger. Sushi platter with amazing price. Quality is good. Absolutely will back again！
It used to be good, unfortunately the chip scoops are getting smaller. My son’s burger was made without gloves, and now we don’t want to return.
Their fish and chips are so good. Must’ve the vegetable croquettes, you won’t regret!
Litterally the best fish and chips around they do everything + Japanese food and they always grill the fish if you ask so no gluten yay! 10/10 always fresh would reccomend.

We had such a beautiful meal here for two, restaurant is very authentic and service was great. The vegetarian lasagna was amazing and best I have had in Auckland also my husband had the meat lovers pizza which was very good! We finished off with the baklava for dessert which was lovely. I would definitely recommend.
The food was amazing the Greek special pizza was one of the best I’ve had! The atmosphere was lovely and the staff were so kind! 10/10 recommend
The food was amazing, everything so delicious and good service
Nicolinos offers lovely service , food and atmosphere. The food is done fairly well and the prices are reasonable. Overall a lovely experience😊

Beautiful food! Beautiful vibe created by the lovely staff. The wide range of vegetarian options were delicious and very fresh. The cleanliness of the plates, as well as the restaurant interior was also highly admirable. No regrets after going to this wonderful local restaurant

Absolutely amazing food! So fresh and tasty! Snapper and chips the best we’ve had ever… Very clean wiping each table as they left, friendly staff and even got a real fork to eat with! Well priced would highly recommend 😆

I had the pleasure of enjoying fish and chips from Riba fish&chips. It was absolutely delightful! The chef, who is also the owner, did an incredible job—frying the fish to perfection. Unlike many other places where the batter is often soggy, here it was wonderfully crisp, light, and golden. The chips were equally impressive—fresh, crispy on the outside, and fluffy on the inside. At other places, I’ve often felt like the chips were fried yesterday, microwaved, and then refried, leaving them dry and unappetizing. But not here! Everything tasted fresh and spot on. This is easily one of the best fish and chips I’ve ever had. Highly recommend!

We ordered 2 Hawaiian burgers & nuggets and chips for the grandson. Old school fresh as, normal size burgers with fresh lettuce and decent thickness mince patties. Chips really fresh oil used and very tasty. Absolutely recommended. Just like the takeaways of the 80's. And one nugget is all that's left...
Reasonable price!! Yummy fish and chips !! I would definitely come back for burgers next time.

Update to the review below. This place used to be great, and now it's mediocre. Undercooked chips. Redundant breaded potato slices. Thin, pale fish. Perhaps they changed owners, or gave up on life. I hope they get their sense of mission back. The atmosphere is very standard kiwi fish and chips, which may or may not be to your taste, but it was perfect for us. The snapper fillets and battered oysters were nicely cooked and not at all greasy. The chips were a perfect golden hue, and just the right mixture of more sturdy chips and crispy smaller ones. Tomato sauce in a bottle instead of a pottle would have been slightly nicer, and free tap water would have been good, but overall a fantastic lunch for two for less than $30. We left half the chips behind, and not because they weren't delicious, they were, but because we were full.

Corelli's is a hidden gem in Devonport, and one of my favourite cafes. The staff are so nice there and the Kids French Toast is amazing- such a good size. I left something special on the table, and when I came back to get it, the staff had put it behind the counter instead of chucking it away. Thank you, Corelli's!

A little bit of a mixed review. (Mothers Day) The food was pleasant and portioned well. Tiramasu didn't have any sponge or espresso in it, quite a disappointing dessert. The venue is lovely. However, it was loud with the bussel and movement of the staff and bar and other patrons. It was very hard to hear our party of people. The staff were lovely, very friendly and accommodating. Very attentive to help the disabled people and those who need help. Would come back again, maybe on a quieter day.

A great eclectic cafe with a contemporary menu and healthy dishes. The atmosphere is great, it especially opens to a summer vibe. Staff are friendly and offer great service nothing is too much trouble. The Earl Grey tea was one of the best I've had. ♥️
Lovely experience at this cafe They have a special menu during Matariki, so ordered the pork belly burger and it was delicious!! Highly recommend 😊

Corelli's Café in Devonport serves delicious, well-prepared food in a warm and inviting atmosphere. I ordered the Big Breakfast and the Eggs on Toast, and both were fantastic. The Big Breakfast was hearty and satisfying, with fresh ingredients cooked to perfection, while the Eggs on Toast were simple yet flavorful. The portions were generous, and the quality of the food was excellent. Combined with friendly service and great coffee, it made for a wonderful dining experience. Highly recommended!

This restaurant is a hidden gem. Service by Doreen, Jose and Blake was exceptional. The food is so delicious and tasty. You can taste the Goan flavour in this delicious yet homely cooking. I highly recommend this restaurant. You will definitely keep coming back. See you soon guys 😊🙌👍👌🥂
Great food and friendly, attentive service. A lot more peaceful than eateries on the main road. Thanks!
Great no frills Indian restaurant near ferry terminal in davenport . Good service , great food , spacious dining room . Great place for a quick casual Indian meal .
Lovely people here. I ate the big breakfast and it was filling, my friends got the fish and chips which was superb.

A rear find, a 5⭐️ cafe with heart & soul. The food says it all, genuine homemade baked cakes, cookies, pies & samosas, and meals made fresh on the premises. The pies have been my favourite pies for many years, the pastry is authentic, thin and buttery. The fillings are meaty and tasty. There is always a vegetarian option to choose from too & the pumpkin tarts I recently tried were another delicious taste sensation full of flavor. The flavors really speak for themselves, the food is always made with such care that you can taste the love 💕! So much more than meets the eye.

Oi, Asahi Japanese in Devonport? Say less — it’s a total gem! Popped in for a feed and left with happy tums and big smiles. I smashed the Salmon Sashimi Don — fresh as! Like it just jumped outta the sea and straight into my bowl. Smooth, buttery, and melts like a dream. No cap. The missus got the Ebi Don, and honestly, the veggies were next level — kinda like cap cay but with that Japanese twist. Crunchy, tasty, and cooked to perfection. She was stoked! Place is cosy, staff were sweet as, and the vibes? Chill and comfy. Felt like a little Tokyo corner in the middle of Devonport. We’re defs coming back. Might just make it our new regular. Arigatou, Asahi — you beauty!

Fantastic! It's been consistently good apart from a short stint we found it a little grungy (grubby) but seems it has its MOJO back. Woo-hoo. And the gorgeous woman on till, could be the owner, lovely service thank you. Also liked the chef in his smart work jacket - very professional!
Absolutely delicious food.A great selection of vegetarian options.

It's my 1st time eating Japanese food in Auckland, teriyaki chicken rice (3 rice.), it taste good and delicious, I wish you have wifi, but why you close at 4pm? It's so early and you close at 4pm? The sun hasn't set yet, 5 to 6pm is the closing time normaly for some restaurants.

If you want some amazing sushi, head to Asahi Devonport. Collect your (plant-based) sushi tray amd a pair of tongs and get ready to choose some delicious sushi. There are hot and cold options, and fish, beef, chicken, pork, and vegetable variations. Each piece is priced from around $1.30 to around $3 each. There is indoor and outdoor seating, and car parking on the road-side or in a parking area nearby. Also very close to public transport. Friendly service, fast and fresh lunch option.

Going back after a long time for what I thought was the best chicken burger in Devonport. When I came home looking forward to my chicken burger, I was very disappointed after the first bite. The chicken was dry overcooked and tasted like an old rotisserie chicken, and very salty 😔 I am so disappointed ☹️ also considering the price …. Will not be coming back…..

Burgers were unpleasantly salty and one was soggy, our gluten free buns were prepared on the same toaster as normal buns, and dairy free patties cooked on the same fryer as the cheese, so I cannot recommend this location for anyone with allergies. Beyond that, though, they added cheese to our dairy free, without-cheese bacon burger, talked so loudly that we could hear them about doing so, overcharged us, and drew a Nazi Swastika on the burger box and told each other that we wouldn’t notice. Not recommended.
Very friendly owner who turned on seperate frier so I could have some fries with my gluten free burger. Good portions and price. Would recommend! Burger tasty 😋

Great burger joint, awesome friendly service and more importantly delicious burgers. Next time I visit devenport I'll surely be back here. Seen in my photos is the Jala beef burger and a cheese beef burger with fries. The cheese burger is double the size of Macdonalds

Really tasty burger and chips and sooo big portion for a really good price. The meat was juicy, bun crispy and all sauces good. We have to wait for a little time, but it was worth it and we enjoyed food near sea. Also my vegetarian fiancé liked the falafel option to every burger! So if you are in Devonport, definitely stop there for food!

We decided to have a day out in Davenport on Christmas Day and happened upon this quaint place which was not too far from the ferries. We ordered the chicken biryani, chili prawn, butter prawn, naan, and fries; all of which was super delicious. I would visit again, and would recommend this place for both solo and group meals.
The lunch special was perfect. Great size and the Dahl Makhani was so good. The Masala tea was heavenly. Very quiet at lunch, but I’ll definitely be back

I always enjoy eating here, the food is really good and the service is warm and friendly. They even made my indian tea with extra ginger when I felt a bit under the weather and I actually feel quite a bit better! 😄 The food is very reasonably priced and they are open all afternoon which is ideal for me as I sometimes have to have a late lunch at eg 3pm or 3.30. Can definitely recommend Indian Hub 😍

We made a reservation to have dinner with our child and were pleased to see our table marked with the reservation name, setting a positive tone before the meal even began. The restaurant was well-prepared, and we enjoyed a variety of dishes including coconut prawns, chili chicken, sesame chicken, butter chicken curry, and prawn curry, along with three types of naan. The cheese naan was outstanding. The staff were all friendly and treated our child with warmth. Everything was perfect.🩷 The sesame chicken and chili chicken had somewhat similar flavors. Next time, we probably won’t order both at once. 😊
Everything was delicious and the service was wonderful. Especially the pakora was quite a spectacular sight and very good!

Highly recommend this spot! Food is AMAZING & reasonably priced. We ordered the Sliced Beef Soup, Egg Fried Rice, Beef and Broccoli and Lemon Tea. All were really good serving sizes too. Servers was friendly and meals were prepared super quick. Very kid-friendly space too with high chairs and plastic cutlery for little ones. Would definitely come back if we’re in the area again ☺️S

Disappointed, as highly rated... Beef Brisket Noodle Soup tasteless meat & soup with unnecessary & pointless additional ingredients... Claypot Rice not enough 'Fire Air' cooking using that toy gas ring... Shrimp Fried Rice OK... Mango smoothie good...
Delicious. Sweet and sour chicken, Yang Chew Rice, beef and brocoli, deep fried tofu and steamed dumplings.
Hong Kong style cuisine in the heart of Devonport. Delicious and authentic. Highly recommended. Can take a stroll along the beach after a sumptuous meal. Will come again

A Chinese restaurant located in the heart of Devonport. Friendly service nice environment. Food is expected, price reasonably. I don’t live in the shore so prob won’t be back but I do recommend everyone to come and have a taste
Very oily chips, small fish with tons of batter. Grab fries at any of the wonderful cafes around. Sun 1pm.

Chicken and sweet corn soup = one of the best I’ve tried (and I’ve tried ALOT). Fish and chips = ok. Maybe we should have eaten it straight away while still hot instead of waiting an hour when it was cold and not so crisp anymore🤣
Their fish & chips never fails me! Having tried fish & chips in London, Perth, Melbourne, Sydney & Adelaide, this is still my favorite!
Beautiful, friendly service, nice chips and fish not greasy at all, well worth it
yum but batter are much than fish portion.

This place really is the best. It’s our local and the place is always packed out with many other locals, they do a great takeaway trade too. I would suggest booking to make sure you get a table. The food is absolutely delicious, thanks to the chefs for their hard work, I have my faves but it’s a great place to try something new. And the service, well the staff are just wonderful, they are also very kind and considerate to my elderly dad who is very deaf. Support this wonderful local business, you won’t be disappointed.

The chicken lollipops were fried to perfection and seasoned very well. They give you a few dipping sauces that bring even more flavor to the plate. Lamby madras was very flavorful and you can ask for the spice level to be to your liking. Nice and clean inside but small oven so if you’re ordering a lot of food or if it’s very busy you’ll be keen to have a beer while you wait.

The restaurant was comfortable and clean. The menu and service were good. We started with the chilli chicken for our entree which was ok. For mains, we had the butter chicken, the Chefs Prawn Special Curry. with Pranthas and Garlic Naans. Both dishes were delicious. Washed down with a couple of Kingfishers. Prices were reasonable.

This place has been our family favourite for a while. They have the best Indian food in Auckland, the most attentive, welcoming and generous service and an all-around warm and pleasant atmosphere. We’ve never tried a dish we don’t like here, as all the curries are super flavourful and well balanced, the naans are soft, chewy and delicious and the onion pakora and samosa are some of our favs. The owner always takes really good care of us and is so generous and helpful. Even though it’s a 45 minute drive for us, we keep coming back regularly because it’s worth it every time. :)

A great curry as always! Our go to place for Indian food in Devonport. This time we ate in but also come here if we want a take out curry. Food is always good, friendly staff and they never try to rush you out of the door at the end of the evening.

I had the pleasure of dining at this exceptional Japanese restaurant in Auckland, and I can confidently say it was one of the most authentic and memorable Japanese meals I’ve had outside of Japan. From the moment I walked in, I was struck by the warm, welcoming atmosphere and the quiet elegance of the space, which set the tone for an outstanding dining experience. The quality of the food was truly top-notch – every dish was beautifully presented, expertly prepared, and rich in flavour. You could taste the care and precision in each bite, from the freshness of the sashimi to the perfectly balanced broths and delicately seasoned vegetables. It’s clear that the chefs are deeply committed to traditional techniques and high-quality ingredients. What stood out just as much as the cuisine was the service. The staff were courteous, knowledgeable, and genuinely kind – attentive without being intrusive, and always ready to explain a dish or recommend a pairing. Their hospitality added a personal, thoughtful touch to the meal, making it feel not just like a dinner, but an experience. If you’re looking for authentic Japanese cuisine in Auckland, this place is a hidden gem.

This place is awesome! Having just moved to Devonport I was very glad to see that there is a Japanese restaurant here as it is my favourite cuisine. We ordered oysters, agadashi tofu, salmon, sushi and a few other things. It was all beautiful and perfectly prepared. A little old Japanese lady was our waitress and she was delightful, very friendly and funny. My wife is vegan and there was a good selection of options for her. Along with a couple of Asahi’s and some warm sake it was an outstanding meal. I highly recommend this restaurant and will definitely be returning.

Sushi is so fresh and we loved it that it’s traditional Japanese, it’s an absolute delight to eat here! Staff could not be friendlier and the chef is a true artist. Do treat yourself and step into this place, you won’t regret it!

Trying this place first time changing my whole experience about Japanese food in Auckland. I'm very impressive how attentive the chef putting into the food, seeing him making and plating is like an art, not mentioning how remarkable the taste is. Me and my partner we love every details about it, the staff also provides excellent service and make us feel very warm-welcome and looked after. We just got back an hour ago and can't avoid the fact of wanting to giving them the review. Thank you both of you making our night memorable and special. Arigato gozaimasu 💖

The food here is incredibly fresh, and the quality is outstanding! My friend and I were blown away—not just by the amazing dishes but also by the wonderful service. The staff were so welcoming and attentive, making the whole experience unforgettable. I love that they offer seasonal dishes, and I can’t wait to come back to try more. Thank you for such a wonderful dining experience!

We wanted to go to a small restaurant with good gluten free Vietnamese food and that’s exactly what we got. We ordered the Beef Pho, lemongrass chicken, pork belly bao and the fries. Everything had so much flavour and really good portion size for what we paid. The fries were definitely a surprise they had a sweet seasoning on them along with the rosemary. Our server was very lovely and she was working by herself with a full house during dinner service on a Friday night. Hard off to her for still smiling the whole time.
We enjoyed the food (see before and after photos). Good Location too, near the port.
We ordered deep-fried spring rolls, bánh xèo, and pho. We enjoyed everything. Especially, the soup of the pho was great. We are happy to visit again❤️
Very tasty and good portions food. The space is a bit small so if it’s busy can be a bit cramped and hot.

We booked for Mother’s day dinner but unfortunately the restaurant noted down the wrong time and had crossed us off their list without informing us so when we arrived, there was no table available for us. The staff weren’t apologetic at all and tried to blame us for not providing a time even though the emails show we did. They made us wait on a small table and didn’t clear the drinks or wipe the table down until we asked and we had to wait until a suitable table was free. The food itself was good but the service was terrible and we felt very unaccommodated for so we wouldn’t recommend the place if you’re looking for good service and if you do make a booking, it would be a good idea to call and double check to make sure they’ve got the right details down.

The place was lovely, but the crepes were quite pricey. I also asked for gluten free and dairy free sweet crepes, and they said they could do the vegan version for me which I did appreciate. However, it tasted like it had dairy in it (very buttery), so I asked the staff to make sure it was dairy free. She said “didn’t you ask for vegan?” I mean vegan shouldn’t have dairy in it anyway, right?

I'm so glad we stopped in here for lunch...this is a busy authentic French Cafe and it's so cool to hear the french language spoken while dining on French cuisine... We ordered off the Galette and Crepe menu, which was absolutely delicious 😋 ... The Bacon and Brie Gallette, a stunning package of molten goodness in a crispy parcel was so yummy, and the crepe was equally Devine. Absolutely reccomend!

For lunch mid week, it was delicious. The only issues were they sat us back near the clothes shop, instead of near the cafe itself. This meant we didn't get food for 40 minutes, and that was a bummer. At least the music and food was good. I had the peach berry iced tea, and the mozzarella salad and it was delicious.
Worth the visit! This place is so amazing alongside the food, staff and service 😋😋
Crepes and coffee are nice. Staff is friendly too.

The food was just spectacular. Every bite was another indulgent flavor to experience. I personally enjoyed the Lemon Leek Risotto, it was tangy and perfectly cheesy. The service was so nice and friendly. I sure felt welcome to have the delicious food. The setting is very cute if you enjoy two spaces coming together nicely. If not such a fan of the bar there is a more divided section of tables not visible to the bar. Both settings were very enjoyable. The walk into the restaraunt was very cute and gave me a good feeling, and the feeling was right! Enjoy your food and place at the same time. I really recommend it!

Great food and atmosphere, seems to be a popular place, so best to book a table in advance if you want to get good table, we were greeted as we arrived and the serving lady was very friendly and helped with the specials etc, food came out quickly and large portions.

Over priced for what you get. Order was mixed up. $30 for 6 mussels and udon noodles ( strange combination ). Mussels weren’t cleaned properly ( still beard in them ) Portions were tiny. Wait person was quite blunt. Overall pretty disappointed unfortunately.

We had a lovely time here. Very nice waitress and good atmosphere. Bit shocked to only get 3 scallops for a dish, but once it was explained by staff that scallops are very expensive at the mo, we took a different approach and mindfully ate the scallops. They were truely delicious. Their famous triple baked potatoes are yummy. To make up for the price of the scallops the house shouted us some tasty chocolates. A very pleasent experience.
Couldn't fault. Great size meal. Delicious food and lovely atmosphere. A great spot on a sunny afternoon. Would visit again.

Everything was perfection. From the atmosphere, to the service, top tier and such delicious wholesome and large portions of beautiful authentic Persian food. I’d recommend this place to anybody. The saffron ice cream was so divine, the owner really cares about his craft and has great conversation. The restaurants ambience is perfect for date night, or even to bring the whole family. We love this place and will be regulars. 💖 Bonus, everything is served so beautifully in amazing dishes.

We had a meeting in Devonport the other day and decided to have some Persian food at Akdeniz afterward. When the food was served, I was surprised by the size of the Koobideh and Barg kebabs — they were huge! I’m pretty sure the dish could easily serve two people. The service was very good, and the food was really delicious. Thanks 🙏

Absolutely loved our visit to Akdeniz Persian Restaurant. The food was so tasty and authentic, especially the Koubideh kebab, with generous portions. The staff were friendly and made us feel right at home. Overall a fantastic experience, will definitely be back when I’m next in Auckland.
First time trying Persian food, and we loved it! Even coffee was good!! Safron ice cream was new for me - it was addictive. The staff were very attentive. Worth a visit!

A charming Persian restaurant with vintage, traditional decor — my second time trying Persian cuisine, and it was a delightful experience. Shahi (1 skewer of Joojeh & 1 skewer of Chenjeh) – 2.5/5 This set includes one beef filet skewer and one chicken skewer. The beef was tender, juicy, and soft, with a subtle sourness and rich BBQ-smoked flavor. It was good. However, the chicken skewer was a bit dry and overly chewy. The seasoning overall was too mild to bring out the flavor of the meats. The salad and saffron rice were just average. Saffron Persian Ice Cream – 5/5 Absolutely perfect! This ice cream had a unique, herbal flavor unlike anything I’ve had before. The saffron taste reminded me of a blend between ginger and mint — incredibly refreshing and perfectly balanced with the creamy vanilla base. Baklava – 5/5 A must-try traditional homemade Persian dessert. It was incredibly crispy and bursting with the aroma of roasted nuts. A perfect way to end the meal.

One of the best Thai meals I’ve had in New Zealand recently! The place has a super local Thai vibe, the staff were friendly, and the food was amazing! — especially the deep-fried soft shell crab with creamy curry and the somtam. The prices aren’t that cheap, but the portions are generous so it’s definitely worth it!

My first visit to Sai Rung and what a great experience 👏 SO much choice that I’ll definitely be returning. Settled on Massan Duck curry which had the perfect amount of spice and was enough for dinner the next night. Service was excellent and despite all the take away collections, our food arrived swiftly. Highly recommended 👌

Really loved this little Thai place in Devonport! I had the chicken satay, sunny chicken, and green curry—everything was super tasty and felt really homemade. The flavors were just right, and the portions were perfect too. The staff were super kind and the atmosphere was chill and welcoming. I’ll definitely come back again!
Great authentic Thai food, and friendly staff. Highly recommended for anyone wanting an awesome dining experience!
Had a lovely dinner here on a quiet Monday night. Food was amazing and staff were so nice. Great little hidden gem

FANTASTIC! I recently moved into the area and this was the first time I had visited the cafe. Everything was perfect. I had a big breakfast and it was probably the best big breakfast I’ve ever had. The waiter was very friendly and helpful. My wife is vegan and they happily catered to her requirements and she loved her meal also. I also ordered an iced mocha which was delicious. I was already loving Devonport and this was the icing on the cake. I highly recommend this cafe.

The food here is AMAZING. Every single dish we ordered was perfection and the smoothies are to die for. We ate so much food as it was so delicious! The service was impeccable. Even though the cafe is not near where we live, we will definitely return regardless as our experience was perfection. Highly recommend!

Wow stunning flavors in this Cafe, the Beef and Shiraz pie melted in our mouths so tasty, decent crust, no leaks, melt in your mouth meat with distinctive Shiraz, I brought 3 extra to take home for dinner tonight - was assured plenty out the back if I wanted more :) but in the cafe, was served with the optional side salad, fresh n crisp, with lovely dressing with hints of sesame oil. We shared a carrot and apple muffin, no shortcuts in this cafe, they have made everything to be nourishing and tasty, little layer of cream cheese icing, nuts, and a wee bowel of tart natural yoghhurt made a melody of perfect flavor combinations. We sipped our delicious coffee's, made by a very experienced barrista to finish. We will be back!!! Thank you for the beautiful energy in your food, it tasted even better than it looks, and it all looks wonderful. So hard to find food that tastes loved these days!!! Staff were friendly and attentive to boot. We watched a huge ship leaving the Harbour, with the sun on our backs around our meal, (Pie photos in my kitchen with my own vegies at dinner later).
Excellent cakes, coffee and omelette. Cakes were moist, light and flavourful. Coffee was full flavoured but not bitter. Omelette was perfectly cooked and full of flavour. Totally recommended.
Delicious food, lovely staff and very reasonably priced. Highly recommend!

Hubby and I went to The Kestrel for our anniversary dinner and it was delicious! Hubby got the fish burger and said that was the best fish hes had in a long time; i got the steak sandwich and it was BEAUTIFUL! Awesome portions - couldnt finish all my chips though they were perfectly cooked and seasoned. And our server (sorry we cant remember your name 🤦‍♀️) was fantastic - attentive and bubbly even with all his tasks. Will be back again one day!
Me and my friends favourite place. Yes it’s pricey, but for the amount of good food you get and it’s delicious, worth every penny. Love the sea vibes, fish and chips and service. Love coming here.

Came in for a quick lunch. My partner ordered the fish and chips with mushy peas Gluten free and I had the pork tacos, beef brisket lollipops and the chips. Atmosphere was nice and chill. Quiet for a Saturday lunch time but there was a lot going on outside. Service was quick and easy. The server helped my partner who had a bee sting which was much appreciated. Food came out fast and was temperature hot. The chips were the best thick cut pub chips I’ve had in a while. Good amount of salt and perfect amount of aioli. The fish was cooked well and wasn’t dry. The brisket lollipops had great seasoning and flavours were sweet and fragrant. The corn tortillas on the tacos did fall apart more than I’d like but everything else for the taco was delicious. The salsa and mole were delicious with the pork. Haven’t had a bad meal at The Kestrel to date. Thanks team

Hubby and I are on a quest to find the best steak sanga and this one was up there. Started our conversation over a drink or two that this could indeed be a public service. If you want a great feed, friendly service with a view, make sure you stop here!
Excellent gluten free fish and chips! Lovely staff. We were there super early for dinner so not many other diners but got a great seat. Recommend!

A pleasant little place located inside the viaduct/pier of Devonport. Beautiful view of the bay outside. They have some outdoor seating which would be perfect on a nice day. We got the onion and white creamy sauce fried chicken, the rice cakes and fries with onion powder. I liked that there was no additional cost to having our chicken boneless. The chicken was well seasoned, crispy and not dry. The rice cakes were in a red chili sauce, which had quite a kick and the heat did build up. There were some fish cakes in it as well, tasted great but I wish my heat tolerance was better to enjoy it more. Fries were decent, too but the onion powder tasted slightly sweet which I found a bit odd. All in all a very affordable and lovely place for a quick meal. It was quiet compared to the other cafes around which I prefer.

As a professional big back, I've been to maybe 4 different Kokodak branches. This branch is by far the worst one. I ordered a rice bowl, and there was barely any rice or chicken. Every other Kokodak I've been to stacks the bowl to just below the lid line. My bowl was maybe half filled at most. Also ordered a chicken burger, which I was excited to try since I didn't know Kokodak did burgers, but then it came out and I thought I was being pranked. Normal size bun, but small/tiny piece of chicken on the side. No sauce, just a bit of coleslaw for flavour (the only flavour was the vinegar in the coleslaw). Only giving 2 stars because the music was good. Hoping it was a one off, but based off other reviews it probably wasn't.

Not good cuts of the chicken. They were chunky ones and had less sauce, quite dry. It’s very different from the one in New Market coz they have bite size, crispy, and saucy chicken. Waste of money. Only the location is good.

Last night, I tried Kokodak Chicken in Devonport, and it was fantastic ! The staff were accommodating and the chicken? Juicy, perfectly seasoned, and packed with rich flavor. The portion sizes were generous for the price. I was surprised because the negative Google reviews seem completely misleading. My experience was nothing like that. If you're in the area, I highly recommend Kokodak Chicken.

The lady who was manning the shop was friendly and polite. We ordered the soy garlic and spicy chicken rice bowls, which were in a good portion and reasonably priced ($16 each). I am glad that the spice level was not mellowed down, which gave a well deserved fiery kick to the freshly deep fried Korean chicken on top of a bed of fluffy pearl rice. A side of herb salad cleanses the palate perfectly. She was not stingy with the sauce too, which I appreciated. It is situated just beside the piers for the Devonport-downtown ferry, and is a great option to have a meal while waiting for your ferry, or after returning to Devonport from the Auckland CBD.

We've enjoyed lots of Indian food in north India, the UK and all over the world and the food here really is up there with the best. If you want an authentic curry with great flavour and spices, give them a try. Also plenty of options for vegs and vegans. 5 stars
Been looking up for a restaurant with Thali menu. Very nice ambience. Service was fast . Food was awesome. Had the best rogan josh of my life. 💖
We went in for a sudden dinner. Ordered malai kofta and pahadi chicken. Food is much better then the other restaurants around. 5 stars for customer service and cleanliness 🫶

Popped in to the restaurant during the week as noticed it had had a revamp and new owners, Was greeted by friendly staff and the lovely smell of tandoori items cooking. Onion bhaji were some of the best I have had, main Chicken masala and a nice and garlicy cheese and garlic naan good flavours and impressive portions. Will be back soon.

Came to Khana after being recommended by a local. I'll definitely be recommending it to others! My mother and I each got the $20 Thali meal. Incredible value for money, the flavours were great and presentation beautiful. Ended it off with the Mango ice cream which was perfect - fruity but not too sweet. You couldn't fault the service. Friendly, professional and educated on Indian cuisine. The atmosphere and environment was vibrant but chill. Lovely acoustic music playing - not too loud which can happen a lot at restaurants. Overall, would come here again in a heartbeat!

Ordered a large "Capricciosa Pizza" at the counter and asked for delivery at home. The pizza arrived promptly, far before the average 30min, and the delivery guy was very polite. However, the pizza was the worst I have eaten in NZ. Flat at as a host wafer, with a "veneer" of cheese and tomato, and extremely salty. The olives were "miniature black dots" and the capers were not rinsed and full of vinegar. The overall taste was poor and unappealing, giving the impression that was a "frozen & reheated" pizza rather than made by order. If you not pedantic and are happy with a flat bread topped with whatever, this place is for you. If you would like a real pizza, there are lots of better options...

Wanted pizza and never had been here before and glad we did. Ordered a half half margarita and New Yorker pizza. Seasoning and sauce is flavourful. Not too salty. Could do with more base sauce as it was a little dry but could easily fix with extra sauce option. The dietary options of cheese and gluten free bases is better than I expected. Vegan cheese options. I liked the multiple options of flavours which covered traditional and gourmet flavours. Didn’t get a milkshake but I will next time I get a pizza there.
Great pizzas, and awesome catering service. This was organised for our business after doing a local beach clean. The range was great, heaps of flavour, and plenty of toppings.

Ask the staff what is the best seller and he recommended this :( without explaining the ingredients, did not expect the new york pizza to have a strawberry jam. Jam is better with toast and not with a pizza. Damn! Destroyed our sunday family night

I've been here twice now, and this is one of the local businesses that I will support. Things I liked: You can order online. Toppings were generous. Price was reasonable. You can dine in, plenty of seats available. The pizza was simple but delicious. I tried the New York and The Calimero Special. I would love to try other menus, too, in the future. Standard size was big enough for me alone. Things that needed attention or could improve on: The base was quite thin, and I think it would be better to be slightly thicker. The toppings on the pizza keep falling off the pizza as I lift up the slice. I think this is because the toppings were too heavy, or the base was too thin to hold the weight of the toppings. I get them in pizza boxes, and every time the inside of the box looks like the grease from the pizza is leaking or flooding across the box and it can get messy if you leave the pizza in the box for long time. I believe this might be the grease from the cheese or other ingredients. It wouldn't be a problem if I dine in, but since I always get them takeaway, I think this is just a minor issue for people who don't want to get things messy. The thickshakes were ok, but it's not something that I would go out the way to order it Overall, if you want something delicious and affordable, I would recommend this place.
I needed breakfast, lunch and dinner. They served, even with a smile!
The most aggressively eatable "food" this side of the tunnel.
I ordered a takeaway via Door-dash. It was so fresh, still nice and hot. The portion size was excellent and it was really tasty. Happy to say I’ll order again.
Delicious authentic Thai food in the North Shore. Excellent balance of flavours. The meat and salad are fresh and tasty. This is our family ‘s favourite.

🔥 The Busy Spot That’s Worth the Hype! 🔥 Every time I walk into [Restaurant Name], it’s packed—and now I totally get why! This place has earned its reputation as the go-to hotspot on the North Shore, and the constant buzz of happy diners speaks volumes. The vibrant atmosphere is electric; you can feel the energy the moment you step in. Despite the crowds, the staff handles the rush like pros—friendly, efficient, and never missing a beat. The menu is a crowd-pleaser, with dishes that justify the hype. I’ve tried [specific dish, e.g., "their loaded nachos" or "signature burger"], and it’s clear they prioritize fresh ingredients and bold flavors. Yes, you might wait for a table during peak times, but grab a drink, soak in the lively vibe, and trust that the food will make it worth it. Perfect for groups, date nights, or when you’re craving a meal that’s guaranteed to impress. Pro tip: Come early or book ahead if you can—this gem is no secret! 🌟🍴 Highly recommended for anyone who loves great food with a side of infectious energy.

The best Thai food I've had in a very long time. Full of flavour. Great balance of sweet, sour & salty. The best massaman lamb curry I've tasted in a long time. The ingredients taste fresh. The duck melted in your mouth. Curry puffs were perfection. This is definitely my new go to.
The fried rice is really good and the coconut jelly given by the staff is also great.

Batch Winery is one of the most popular vineyards on Waiheke Island, and you can quickly see why. The views are absolutely amazing from here. The staff is very friendly and the food looked absolutely delicious. Too bad we already ate before, but next time we would love to try the food.

A Perfect Day at Batch Winery – An Unforgettable Experience! Jax Burger presents a compelling case for a top-tier burger experience, particularly for those who appreciate quality ingredients and meticulous preparation. While the pricing leans towards the premium end of the spectrum, the culinary output undeniably justifies the investment. The standout accompaniment to their well-crafted burgers is unequivocally their chips, fried in beef tallow. This method imparts a depth of flavor and an unparalleled crispness that elevates them far beyond standard fry offerings. The savory richness of the tallow provides a truly gratifying textural and gustatory experience, making them a highlight of the meal and a compelling reason to visit Jax Burger. Regarding the burgers themselves, the consensus holds that they are "worth it." Each component, from the patty to the bun and toppings, appears to be carefully selected and assembled to deliver a cohesive and satisfying bite. While the cost is a factor, the quality of the ingredients and the overall execution shine through, ensuring a substantial and flavorful burger. The question of whether Jax Burger surpasses competitors like Burger Fuel is, as noted, inherently subjective. Both establishments cater to a discerning palate within the gourmet burger segment. However, Jax Burger certainly carves out its own niche, particularly with its distinctive tallow-fried chips. For those seeking a high-quality burger and an exceptional side that truly complements the main event, Jax Burger is an unequivocally good option and highly recommended for a culinary exploration.

Taco Bell in Westgate is a relatively new addition to the area, having opened its doors within the last few years. As someone who enjoys the occasional fast-food indulgence, I was excited to try this location. Overall, my experience was a mixed bag—there were some highlights, but also a few areas that left much to be desired. I’d give it a solid 4 stars, as it’s fine for a quick bite but definitely has room for improvement. Let’s start with the positives: the food. The tacos, as always, are the star of the show. They’re flavorful, satisfying, and hit the spot when you’re craving something quick and tasty. The Crunchy Tacos were perfectly crispy, and the fillings were fresh and well-portioned. I also tried the Cheesy Gordita Crunch, which was as delicious as I remembered from other Taco Bell locations—soft, cheesy, and with just the right amount of crunch. The Baja Blast, a Taco Bell classic, was refreshing and exactly what I needed to wash down the meal. The menu offers a great variety of options, and the prices are reasonable for the portion sizes, which is always a plus. However, the experience was dampened by a few significant issues, the most glaring of which was the cleanliness—or lack thereof. When I walked in, I noticed that several tables had trays left behind from previous customers, and it didn’t seem like the staff were in a hurry to clear them. I ended up sitting at a table that still had crumbs and a bit of sauce residue, which wasn’t the most appetizing start to my meal. For a newly opened location, I expected better upkeep. The floors also looked like they hadn’t been swept in a while, with a few stray napkins and food bits scattered around. Cleanliness is a big deal for me, and this aspect really needs massive improvement. Another downside was the parking situation. The lot outside is quite limited, and during peak hours, it can be a bit of a hassle to find a spot. I ended up parking farther away and walking, which wasn’t the end of the world, but it’s something to keep in mind if you’re planning to visit during busy times. A larger or better-organized parking area would make the experience much more convenient for customers. One quirky feature of this location is the “happy bell” near the exit—a bell you’re supposed to ring if you’re satisfied with your experience. I didn’t pull the bell. While the food was good, the overall experience didn’t leave me feeling particularly thrilled. The cleanliness issues and the parking situation were enough to make me hesitate. That said, I appreciate the effort to engage customers and make the experience interactive. The staff were friendly enough, though they seemed a bit overwhelmed during my visit. The line moved at a decent pace, but there was a slight delay in getting my order, which I didn’t mind too much since the food was fresh and hot when it arrived. Still, a bit more efficiency and attention to the dining area would go a long way. In summary, Taco Bell in Westgate is a decent spot for a quick, tasty meal, especially if you’re a fan of their classic menu items. The tacos are yummy, and the variety of options ensures there’s something for everyone. However, the cleanliness of the dining area and the limited parking are notable drawbacks that prevent this location from being a 5-star experience. If they can address these issues, it would make a world of difference. For now, it’s a 4-star experience—good, but with clear room for improvement.

Thank you for the most enjoyable trouble free MOTHERS DAY celebration! No dishes or cleaning up required! Oh it would pay your team to water blast the signage it top front of your premises, my only fault! Arthur C. Charlton West Auckland NZ
Quaint lovely restaurant with excellent, tasty food. A must visit again place for us.

We celebrated this year's Mother's Day here one day earlier due to other commitments tomorrow. This place has a very nice outdoor gazebo sitting area at the back surrounded by a large well-kept garden. We were served by a very friendly waitress who went the extra mile to make sure we feel comfortable as we had an elderly with us. We ordered a lot of food including Fish and chips, Tandoori chicken salad, Pulled pork and chick pea salad, Creamy seafood chowder, Pumpkin soup of the day, Bread and dips, Lemon citrus tart and Chocolate trilogy. All our meals were very yummy, well cooked and nicely presented. There are also a lot of parking space in the front so you don't have to worry about parking. All in all we had a great family time here - hope to come back here one day :-)

The Brigham is a hidden gem with beautiful gardens to add to the vista of our function. Thank you Raj and Amanda for having us at your lovely Venue and I just want to say your staff were very accommodating and very friendly and the service was 100%. Family enjoyed the venue with positive feedback and how everything flowed on the day from the start to the end. Thank you for working with me to make this day memorable. Highly recommend to anyone who want to have a private function. Food on point and delicious also another perk was also bringing in food with no extra cost.
This is my favorite local Indian takeaway shop in Hobsonville. I recommend trying out the Chicken Biryani. Order the single for $16. If you're not too hungry, it's good for sharing.

The staff at Cilantro are very friendly, and the food was superb. The Chicken Biryani and Butter Chicken was flavorful with perfect spice balance, and the portions were generous. Highly recommended for authentic Indian cuisine.
Food is very nice. Always fresh and portions are generous My husband and I love the curies. Lovely staff.

Staff are nice, Unfortunately we were disappointed with the chicken Manchurian some of the chicken was so hard and dry we couldn’t even eat it, it was meant to have gravy but very dry. I also asked for plain naan bread but when packing they put butter on it I saw and luckily stopped it being put on one as my partner can’t have butter.

Ordered online for takeaways and by the time I got to the restaurant they said the order wasn't put through so had to wait for a while for them to get it ready. When I got home, I noticed the packaging was opened and half of the food was wasted. Food was okay. Wouldn't go back.

I am a regular tank customer and usually at every branch apart from this one, staff have been lovely and drinks are amazing. The Hobsonville branch however, has some members of staff that are ridiculously rude and drinks are awful/ often watery and unblended chunks in- I’ve tried about 5 times and won’t come back here anymore. Which is a shame because it’s the one closest to me- DO NOT RECOMMEND to come here literally any other tank is better- or you’ll waste your money on a lumpy, watery smoothie every time where the staff are insanely rude as well.

Had the most positive experience this morning at Tank Hobsonville. I had ordered a salad and dropped it after I picked it up. The lady working was extremely nice about the situation and remade my salad for me

I can't do it anymore guys. I've tried. I've kept coming here since it opened and in the last few months the service and quality has just gotten worse and worse . Today I waited half an hour for a smoothie. One staff member working on a busy Saturday, no salads or Wraps available. When I got back to my car the drink wasn't blended. Has to find a spoon to eat it. You've been getting this feedback for months. I'm done

This is the worst Tank in Auckland. I love Tank and frequently buy it. However every time I've tried at Tank Hobsonville I've gone way frustrated. They've run out of chicken or one of the other ingredients. The last straw was refusing to put the dressing in a separate container. Ever tried the salad with dressing 3 hours later!

Constantly cancels online orders despite being open and online on Uber Eats. When you can get your orders, they are always well made. However waiting 20 minutes on the app for my order to then be cancelled really isn't acceptable

I went because it had the highest rating among sushi places. Best Fresh Salmon! I tried their donburi (rice bowl) it was so fresh and delicious. Combined with hot miso soup warms me up. There were many people for takeaway lunch. The kitchen seems so neat and clean as well. I am really glad I found this place.

Small shop. Limited indoor seating. Some outdoor seating. Fresh sushi and a menu with more to offer. Delicious sushi. Ramen was ok but the 2 minute noodles could be switched out. Poached egg, rather than a boiled egg was different.
Sushi never tastes good or fresh - visited twice. Second visit was because I thought I'd give them another chance. Regrets.

A great place with tasty and fresh food. I needed a party pack of sushi on short notice and they were able to accommodate me. It had a good variety of flavours and was very well presented. The extra garnish was in the right amount so everyone got a great serving of sushi. Definitely recommend the food and service!
We ordered a chicken teriyaki and chicken katsu donburi. Both were really delicious and great value. The chicken teriyaki sauce was nice and sticky. The katsu was crispy
Friendly people. Best fresh fish burger I’ve had in years. Super generous size and good price. ( I asked for no tomatoes) hot and crispy goodness
Great food and reasonably priced. The large pork was plenty for dinner and lunch the next day. Staff were very friendly.

It's a terrible picture, but I've been coming for a while now and this place is great because, as a lifter, I appreciate the amount of protein you get in roast shops for the price, and when the meat themselves is excellent, whoa baby you got yourselves a spooky combo. I come here a few times a week to get my protein and can't think of another place other than Nandos (overpriced as hell) or some random roast that pisses me off due to the cheap gravy or veggies being under. Oh, their fish and chips are great, too. 👍 It just seems to me that they care about what they do, and it's pretty apparent since I cook a lot as a hobby, and I can tell.
Everything was good until I have stumbled upon a piece of some sort of plastic bit in my fish and chips =\ PS. definitely not a fish bone, have eaten a few fish in my life!
I think they put fat into cooking oil when frying a chips. Taste is terrible. Why don't you simply use pure sunflower oil for that?

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ – Excellent Experience at Domino’s Hobsonville! I had an amazing experience with Sunny at Domino’s ! The service was super friendly and efficient, and my order was ready right on time. The pizza was absolutely delicious – hot, fresh, and packed with flavour. I ordered the Pepperoni and a Cheesy Garlic Bread, and both were perfect. The store was clean and well-organized, and the team seemed really on top of things even during the busy dinner rush. It’s clear they care about quality and customer satisfaction. Definitely my go-to Domino’s from now on. Highly recommend to anyone in the area looking for a quick, tasty meal with top-notch service!
The worst pizza I've ever had. Dude got grumpy when I told him it was rubbish! Not much of anything...just a lump of bread!

When I went to place my order, Daler and Nima were working at the store. I ordered 4 pizzas, but also had some custom requests on top (for the pizzas), that both the staff members were kind enough to help with. Daler was quite thorough and ensured that I will be able to handle the level of spice. Pizzas were ready on time, fresh and made exactly the way I was hoping they would be (with the custom requests I had). Very satisfied with the experience at this store 🙏

We have been buying Pizza from hobsonville Domino's for many years now and out of all of the pizza we have tried so far, they are by far the best. Very consistent with their quality. The staff are also extremely friendly, kind and honest. Very nice people. Always feel welcomed whenever I go there. Would highly recommend to anybody looking for a good pizza. 👍 Shane Pound.

Ended up waiting more than an extra 10mins past what the latest time was. Turned up and the screen and app said order was ready, but it wasn’t. After getting the pizza, was disappointed to find my “mega pepperoni” had the expected toppings you would see on a normal pepperoni…. false advertising at its finest. Similar issue with my pepperoni pizza plank, on the entire plank, 3 spots of pepperoni. Was just a cheese bread. Haven’t been to dominoes in a while, won’t be rushing back due to disappointment

Both kids and adults loved the design of the cake. it tasted just as amazing as it looked! The staff were kind and welcoming, which made the whole experience even better. It’s hard to find beautiful and delicious cakes in the area, so I’m really happy I found this place. Highly recommend!

I ordered my special occasion cake from JM Cakery & we loved it so much. The flavours were perfect and they had done an amazing job at creating a cake that met all my expectations. Super fresh & delicious. Thanks to the team.

Literally the softes and tastiest cupcakes in Auckland. Our box of 6 signature cupcakes were 10/10 for freshness and taste, massive fan of the chocolate caramel and the white chocolate raspberry. Highly recommend you try JM Cakery next time you’re in Hobsonville. James Ashwin Kakapo Business Sales

I ordered 24 mini cupcakes. They were a lot smaller than I expected after checking the photo on the website I realized it’s the photo of regular cupcakes not a mini ones. I wrote to her but didn’t even get a reply. Was also going to order a birthday cake there the next day but changed my mind. The cupcakes also tasted very average. For the price you paying and the lack of communication not worth it

Best cake place! I made a mistake with the booking date and they helped me out without any issues at all. Couldn’t recommend them more! And the cake is absolutely delicious, we always get our birthday cakes from here 😊

Great food and service! We were warmly welcomed by (possibly) the owner or manager — very respectful and friendly. The waitress was polite, and the service was excellent. Delicious food, good vibes — we went home happy and full. Highly recommend to friends and family. Will definitely come back! Thank you!

If you are looking for a place where it is clean, food great and has impeccable service its here. The owner is super friendly and knows how to run a restaurant All of there rice noodles are delicious - I usually always go for the Lemongrass chicken or pork 👍🏻 Also has lots of alcohol options as well which is a bonus

I would give it 3.5 stars. It is definitely vietnamese food with a korean twist. Great service. Lots of parking in the weekend. We had grilled lemongrass pork with vermicelli noodle salad ($22.00), stir fried beef noodles ($22.00) and meat combination rice noodle soup ($21.00). The noodle salad was the best dish. The stir fried beef noodles was sweet which must have been the korean twist. The soup had a very strong seafood flavour which tainted the meat, not our cup of tea. It was busy with lots of Koreans after 1pm.

At first, fast service but then I realize I am not being treated the same as the other customers in the restaurant. No one came to check on my meal satisfaction during service but I could see other tables were being well taken care of by waitress. I am local and would have come back if it was good. Food and drink came out fast. Drink was sickly sweet with too much strawberry syrup, I did not drink it and they did not make me pay for it, so I am grateful for that. That gets the extra star. That shake is definitely not worth $10 as it started separating within 10mins. The complementary pickled radish was yum but I had to call them back to ask what it is, they just put it on the table without saying anything. The chicken fried noodle was very oily and no refined flavor, big potion but not worth $22. Very plain.... Spring onion, onion and mung bean sprout were the only vege. Not really Vietnamese, to be honest. It was mostly just noodles. It is better to go to the Chinese takeaway for cheaper and get more vegetables the meal. I took the leftover noodles home and added my own vege, which made it a lot better. I was trying to get the waitress' attention for a takeaway box but she was standing by her station out of sight from the boss, playing with her hands for a while. Finally, she noticed me. The owner (?) seems friendly but he should ask "how was your meal?" when customer goes to pay. If I didn't complain when he billed me the full price, even though he saw the drink still full... I would have given 1 star if it wasn't for that.

Pretty decent pho place. Good portion and friendly owners. I also like the complimentary corn tea. Pho quality not bad, we had the lemon grass pork which actually comes within the broth instead of separately like other stores. The pork still tasted with lemongrass flavour and the meat quality itself was fatty like a pork scotch which was good. Broth itself was quite average flavoured and not too outstanding. Spring roll was also quite nice.

Food was reasonably tasty. The serving of the curry was generous i couldn't finish it was so full thank you. Service is fantastic thank you again. Venue is reasonable and could use a bit more sprucing up. Overall thumbs up.

Honestly the best experience I have had dining out with a toddler. My daughter is 3yrs old and at the "I can do it my self stage." The staff all greet her and treat her well always waving back and saying hi as they pass. They have colouring books and toys for while you wait for the food. The kids portion is perfect for her and feels well balanced with veges. Just amazing I love this place. And the overall atmosphere is calm and quiet.
Most were delicious, well made fresh food. Only problem was my shyo pork Ramen. Plain broth and three thin slices of pork for $23. Pork isn't that expensive so not sure why so scarce on the meat

Our second visit. We booked a table of 8 (6+2 kids) for a family birthday dinner. Venu was warm and friendly, food was very authentic endorsed by two Japan experienced members in our group. Location is easy. We added Peko Peko to our go to dine in's. See you again.
Came for a late dinner after work, staff was super friendly and welcome. My ramen was nice and flavorful, hubby’s chicken rice was amazing too!! Definitely a good spot to check out in the area

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ An absolute gem tucked away in Hobsonville! From the moment we walked into Amore Italiano Restaurant, we felt like part of the family. You can instantly tell it’s a family-owned business — warm, welcoming, and full of heart. It’s the kind of place where you’re not just a table number, you’re truly looked after. We started with the calamari on the grill and garlic pizza bread – and when I say 10/10, I mean it from the heart. The calamari was tender and full of flavour, and the garlic bread was perfectly crisp with that melt-in-your-mouth texture. It was the kind of start that makes you excited for what’s coming next. For mains, the beef mince tortellini was absolutely divine — tossed in a creamy white sauce with mushrooms, garlic, and a touch of olive oil, then finished with fresh rocket. Comfort food at its finest. I had the “Agnello” – NZ lamb cutlets with a rich red wine shallot sauce that was so good, I could’ve licked the plate clean. The lamb was cooked to perfection and paired beautifully with seasonal vegetables. And then dessert… wow. The house-made profiteroles were light and creamy, covered in velvety chocolate. And the tiramisu? So fluffy, so balanced, and clearly made with love. Everything about our experience was top notch — the food, the vibe, the genuinely kind people. You don’t just eat here, you feel here. Can’t wait to come back.

Came for lunch, good parking spot right outside. Our server was very polite and friendly. We ordered filetto, risotto e fungi, and tagliatelle bolognase. Nice big portions and absolutely tasty! Eye fillet was cooked as requested. For dessert we had cheesecake and profitroles which were nice. Very nice and clean restaurant and toilets, nice moody ambiance. Definitely will return.

@flavourandcuisine insta handle Follow me for more such reviews. Had a lovely dinner at Amore Italiano. We ordered cannelloni, vegetarian soup, vegetariana pizza, tiramisu, and profiteroles—each dish was well-prepared and delicious. The flavors were comforting and authentic, especially the pizza which had a nice thin crust and generous toppings. The desserts were a sweet finish, with the tiramisu being rich and creamy, and the profiteroles light and satisfying. The place had a warm, cozy vibe that made the dining experience even better. Definitely a spot I’d recommend for a relaxed Italian meal.
Tried a light meal here. Garlic bread was very fresh and tasty. Tiramisu was a great dessert to end the day with.

Had a beautiful lunch here, food was divine. Everyone was very happy with their lasagna/pizza and my insalata de mare was gorgeous, seafood on it was warm. Friendly service too. Would recommend this restaurant
The pizza was really great, full of flavor and perfectly cooked. The service was also excellent—friendly and quick. Will definitely come back.

Absolutely amazing customer service, very well greeted and served in a excellent way and also asked if I need to order something else and food was hot and cheesy garlic pizza with buffalo sauce and mayonnaise was just mouth watering and tasty as I wanted as well as veggie pizza as well.

Best pizza place out west. Amazing service and Great Pizza. 20 pizzas, chips and garlic bread were a hit. I will always go to this store. Best service and I even got to chat to a lovely customer while waiting. She made my day. Charlotte that goes to Dunedin for Uni your grandmother is a superstar. Thanks Pizza Hut Hobsonville you guys rock

I can’t remember his name, but the staff member whose name starts with “M” really stood out. He’s tall, has a handsome face, and wears a nice turban. He’s always so friendly, welcoming guests with a bright smile. Truly one of the best! Thank you for the wonderful service :)

I had a great experience! The pizza was absolutely delicious—fresh, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. The service was excellent as well. *Mamta*, the staff member who assisted us, was very polite, friendly, and helpful throughout. Her warm and professional attitude really made the visit enjoyable. Highly recommended!
It was very juicy and delicious Japanese fried chicken. I would like to tell everyone about this taste.
Finally, a karaage place that gets it right! Taiyo's version, found on Uber Eats, is incredible. Perfectly cooked, flavourful, and tastes like you'd get in Japan. Will buy again.
Some of the best chicken, if not the best chicken ive ever mas

We really liked the pizzas and the guys were so friendly. Parking can be limited because it's in the parking lot of the RSA but there is road parking. I would have liked my pizza cooked a little longer for a crispier crust and the ham and truffle would have benefited from some hot honey. Otherwise they were delicious and I would definitely visit again. Price wise, these are an average price for a wood fired pizza, good for a treat on a cold weeknight.

Second time this week having their Neapolitan wood fired pizza! soooo good! If you’re a pizza lover, this place is a must! Super fresh ingredients and the flavor is just next level!We’re obsessed and for sure gonna be regulars!

Sometimes you drive past a food truck and you just know that you need to give it a crack. For me it’s usually when said truck has the words “wood fired” and “pizza” on it. These guys really know what they’re doing. We had the ham and truffle and the Diavola and they were both as good as they look. One of the best I’ve had in Auckland. Looking forward to going back again one day.
Absolutely delicious pizza, so fresh and full of flavour. Will definitely be coming back here for our woodfired pizza fix!

Super super delicious pizzas! We ordered mushroom pesto pizza, margherita, diavolo, and tiramisu. My sister (who visited Naples 10months ago and went to the top pizza place there) verified these are truly authentic Neapolitan pizzas. Really high quality ingredients, friendly staff, super speedy service (picked up literally within 7 minutes). I would say the pesto mushroom pizza might need some more seasoning but was still very yummy. Also, YOU MUST ORDER TIRAMISU!!! Their tiramisu is soooooo much better than ones I've tried from reputable restaurants in Auckland. So grateful to have access to such authentic Neapolitan pizzas in Hobsonville :)

Ordered the beef double delight burger, meat was raw, extremely messy to eat, definitely would not recommend. Desi chips were too over seasoned definitely not how they're done in India. Hopefully with some constructive criticism this place would get better. Maybe use homemade patties, better buns and ingredients. I can spend less at Jax burgers and get an absolutely amazing burger. This place needs to charge less until they get it right.
We ordered the Chicken Pesto and Cheese Lovers pizzas, and both were delicious! Even our picky children happily ate them, which says a lot. Will definitely be ordering again!

Whenever I read a positive review on Google, I often wonder if it's genuine. The food quality that I experienced with Beach Pizza Hobsonville meant that I had to leave a review. I ordered Meat Supreme, Spicy Lamb, and Chicken Peri Peri pizzas. The bases we're great, the sauces were amazing and the toppings were plentiful and really tasty. I could not be more pleased with the quality of these pizzas. The pizzas were delivered hot and in the specified time. Our group couldn't be more a pleased with the experience and the quality of the food. Highly recommended.

I have been a regular customer, ordering pizzas almost every weekend through DoorDash. Unfortunately, this time I am disappointed to say you have lost a loyal customer. When I called regarding my order, I was served by an unprofessional and rude staff member. Instead of offering an apology for the issue, their attitude made the situation worse. Such behaviour not only reflects poorly on the business but also drives customers away. I have always ordered regularly because of the good quality of your pizzas, but this time both the service and the quality of the pizza were below expectations. I hope the management takes this feedback seriously and addresses the matter, ensuring staff are trained to handle customers professionally in the future.

Great pizzas, such a bliss to now have this option of halal pizzas in our area, called them before ordering as our family has different spice level tolerance and I was rightly guided by the team. Ordered Pesto Chicken and Chipotle (less spicy) and Zesty Chicken (spicy). We all loved our pizzas.
Good Sri lankan food
Amazing Kimchi! And absolutely the best Gochujang! I lived in Jeonju, Korea for a while- the Gingers pantry is still the best I have had
10/10 delicious food! Friendly and efficient service

Malu Fish & Chips truly lives up to their tagline “Hooked on Freshness.” Whether it’s a rainy day takeaway or a weekend treat, their fresh, hot fish and crispy chips provide a satisfying bite every time ￼. Highly recommended for classic Kiwi fish & chips lovers!

As all other reviews suggest: Awesome food, service, portion, quality, and people. The fish was on point, can taste its fresh. Generally picky, quite the self proclaimed saltwater sme but happy as with them outcomes. Best fish burger I had this year. Strongly recommend.

Malu Fish and Chips never disappoints. The quality is always consistent and the portions are just right. The fish is fresh, the batter is perfect not gluggy at all, other burger ingredients fresh, and the chips are never too oily. Simple food done right and definitely a go-to spot.

I’ve been missing home a lot lately and I got some fish and chips from these guys at the Takapuna Sunday Market and it really filled up my cup, with a warm welcome and a big smile this couple really made my day, the fish was devine, the first bite got me hooked, it was the perfect crunch while also being nice and flavourful, the chips were well seasoned and the perfect amount of sauces on the side, I also got their famous Dubai chocolate rose and it’s a must try!!!! Thankyou so much for making my day!

Malu – Hobsonville I had the best fish and chips at Malu in Hobsonville today! From the moment I walked in, everything impressed me — especially the food. The fish had a beautifully crispy golden coating and was light, flaky, and bursting with flavor. The chips were hot, perfectly seasoned, and just the right thickness. Portion sizes were generous, and everything tasted absolutely fresh. Plus, the service was warm and welcoming, staff really seemed to care about making my experience great. Between the delicious food and the friendly vibe, Malu has quickly become my go-to spot for fish and chips around Hobsonville. Highly recommend it to anyone in the area looking for top-notch Kiwi-style fish & chips!

This place is so so good. Incredibly tasty food, consistently top quality and always served with a smile. The BBQ Pork on rice or noodle is mouthwatering, fresh ingredients, just the right spice. The home made dumplings are the best, perfect every time. Give them a try, you won’t regret it.

Had the chilli BBQ pork and rice. On special at $16. Really delicious and full of flavour. So great to see Korean food in Hobsonville. Will be back to try everything else. Give them a go on your way home and support our local.
Wonderful gem of a place, owner is lovely and the food was fast and tastes amazing! Had the Beef Fried Rice, Squid Pancake and the Fried Dumplings. Will definitely be back :)

Food was so good , however I asked for jjajangmyeon and I didn't get that rather I got japchae... algs cause it was so good but I really want jjajangmyeon next time pls Edit: the lovely lady gave me yum jjajangmyeon today ! Thank you!
We ordered the K BBQ, Bulgogi, Prawn Fried Rice & Steamed Dumplings. Loved all of the dishes; full of flavour, very fresh tasting and reasonably priced. Will be back for sure

Food we got tasted so homemade and delicious. The portions were also very generous for the price we paid. Their service is top notch too, very friendly and professional. Would recommend everyone who wants to taste real South Indian home made cooking.

I recently ordered from Neeru’s Indian Kitchen, and every single dish blew me away! The Chicken Biryani and Goat Biryani were absolutely delicious – full of authentic flavors, tender meat, and perfectly spiced rice. Truly one of the best biryanis I’ve had in Auckland! The Chicken Curry and Goat Curry were rich, flavorful, and tasted just like home-cooked comfort food. The starters were amazing too – the Chicken Pakora was crispy and packed with flavor, and the Chicken Majestic was perfectly spiced with a beautiful texture. Even the Chapathi was soft, fresh, and paired so well with the curries. You can really tell everything is made with love and care. Highly recommend Neeru’s if you’re looking for authentic, homemade-style Indian food. I’ll definitely be ordering again!

Phenomenally delicious home made food!! We Moksha Base band had our band rehearsals in the weekend in Hobsonville and Neeru's Indian Kitchen was recommended by the locals. Everything we ordered tasted exceptional. Especially the mushroom pulav and paneer starters. Thank you for your friendly service and incredibly delicious Indian food. We loved it :)
Very flavourful food, the quantity was very good. The food was available for pick up on time, very keen to try more dishes!
Fabulous food and quick delivery

SCORE: 78/100 A fantastic Chinese food option in Hobsonville. I’ve visited twice in the past week and can confidently say the food quality is excellent, with great flavors, and the staff is both friendly and accommodating. The only downside is that the prices are a bit higher than expected for the portion sizes, but the superior food quality makes it worth the extra cost. I’ll definitely be back.
Just back from dinner. Albert the owner was so welcoming. Took time to explain the menu and made suggestions for first timers. Food and portions was awesome. Highly recommend and will be back.

First time here, Sunday night- were the only ones. The place was clean and inviting; pleasant atmosphere. The waiter ( Jeremy) was so engaging and helpful in explaining all the recommendations. He was attentive too and offered us some sweet entree on the house for us to try. They were new and exciting and gratefully received. We ended up having fried spring rolls ( standard cocktail ones), black pepper beef ( so, so yum- tender beef, crunchy onions and capsicum with the right amount of sauce), cumin lamb (excellent! Dry fried which complemented the black pepper beef so well) and braised spicy eggplant ( was a bit sweet for my liking). Will deffo return to try other dishes.
