My first time although hubby been many time! Nice early dinner, food amazing, service sooooo friendly, George is so nice. So clean and I recommend the prawns in wasabi and egg plant - delish . Oh and generous portions !! Thank you 🙏🏼!

We visited as a family of five, on a week night, without a booking. We got an upstairs table. The owner, Albert, treated us like friends. Very welcoming. We let him help us choose. We tried a multitude of dishes. The menu includes a portion of very non Western (authentic) food, so there is a risk. I can honestly say that there wasn't a single dish that wasn't loved by someone at our table (quite proud of my kids ability to enjoy a wider variety of food than me). After the meal Albert asked us a few questions, possibly in response to these reviews. It is a new restaurant trying to work out how to best cater to its local customers. Our verdict was a definite YES and i am looking forward to going back, with a larger group, a booking, and a better idea of how much to order. I am looking forward to showing our friends and family our new local asian restaurant!!! (Sorry I was too busy enjoying the night to get good photos).

Really nice asian fusion. We shared lots of small and large dishes. Cocktails are very tasty. All the dishes pack a massive flavour punch. Staff are friendly and accommodating. The decor is modern and warm. Very high quality food. Would recommend.
Great food, very well put together menu I really enjoyed it! Would definitely come back again

Ordered pork and prawn pad Thai. It was not like the usual pad Thai I've tried before. The rice noodles were not separated and mixed through the dish, it was served in rolled up pieces which I didn't like. The pork was cooked well. But I felt the dish was too spicy and intense in flavor. Ask for no chili jam if you don't handle spice well. The dish was quite overpriced, in my opinion. Great atmosphere and staff are friendly.

It's a very recommended place. The food was very delicious and satisfied with the eyes and mouth. The spacious interior space was very beautiful and it was a luxurious atmosphere that would be great for entertaining guests. The staff are kind, so I'm planning to visit again next time.

Deceiving good. Have driven pasted multiple times and never made it there. We did on the weekend and it was more plesent then expected. Nice restaurant, good service and a tone of dishes to choose from. We got a bunch of sharing dishes (definitely a recommended way of eating) which where all quite nice. Would recommend trying it

Had one of the most satisfying lunch experiences at Kneads All Day with my wife, and honestly, this place just gets it. From the cozy, welcoming vibe to the top-tier service, everything was on point. The owner personally made sure we were well taken care of—talk about hospitality done right! Now, let’s talk food. We went all in on some vegetarian delights, and here’s the verdict: • Avocado Smash – Fresh, creamy, and packed with flavor. If you love avo, this is a no-brainer. • Beans Sandwich – Simple yet chef’s kiss delicious! Every bite was perfection. • Curly Fries – Crispy, golden, and just the right level of addictive. • Strawberry-Plum Tea – Refreshing, slightly tangy, and the perfect drink to wash it all down. And of course, no meal is complete without dessert: • Carrot Cake – Soft, moist, and packed with that classic homemade goodness. • Lychee Cheesecake – A game changer. Creamy, subtly sweet, and absolutely divine. What made it even better? The people. The staff was friendly, the service was smooth, and the whole place just had the vibe. They even seemed to know my kind of energy—now that’s next-level customer care! If you haven’t been to Kneads All Day yet, do yourself a favor and go. Trust me, your taste buds will thank you.

Went to Kneads today with my wife and mother in law, the food was nice, a little pricey for the portion size and taste, but no complaints, except for the strawberry matcha, which just tasted like strawberry milk, no hint of matcha. The staff were nice, however we noticed some patrons getting table service while we were asked to come to the counter with our orders. Overall a very nice atmosphere and good tasting food.
We tried the biscoff fresh toast and K-style chicken&waffle which was new on their menu. The food was perfect and the service was good. We’ll definitely be going back!!

Luxurious Ambience, Amazing Food & Best Coffee in NZ! Kneads All Day Café is an absolute gem! We had brunch here, and everything was perfect. The avocado smashed toast, creamy mushroom, and blueberry cheesecake were incredibly delicious. The flat white with oat milk was the best coffee we’ve ever had—smooth, perfectly balanced, and made by a skilled barista. The café’s rich, luxurious interior creates a cozy yet upscale vibe, making it a perfect spot to relax. The staff were outstanding—kind, polite, and exceptionally helpful. If you’re looking for top-tier food, amazing coffee, and a stunning ambience, this place is a must-visit!

I recently visited this café and had a really nice experience. The food was fresh and tasted great, and the quality was consistent in every dish we tried. The staff were friendly and made us feel very welcome, which added to the overall atmosphere. On top of that, the prices were quite affordable, making it a great option for a casual outing. Definitely worth a visit!
Had the mayo burger, nice taste and very filling with the chips + drink. Awesome guy that served me, very friendly and hospitable. Thanks team.
We love K Chicken Hobsonville, always such delicious burgers, fries and chicken. Such a treat!

Very average. We had the crispy boneless hot spicy chicken and the honey garlic soy chicken ($24)…..with a side of pickled radish ($3). The chicken wasn’t as crispy and it wasn’t piping hot (like you expect when it comes fresh out of the fryer). I suspect it was cooked earlier and re-heated as it was also very dry chicken. The hot spicy sauce was average…. the honey garlic soy was more Chinese flavours than Korean. The pickled radish was poor (and expensive for what it was). Having had loads of Korean Fried Chicken in Korea…..this is just disappointing.

Friendly staff. Food is great. We had 3 type of the chicken and there fries 🍟. Was very happy with the food. Best chicken and fries around. Only downside, parking can be bit difficult and you might have to park around the corner. If they have few big orders you might have to wait a little bit extra for yours to be done. However it it worth the wait.
Best food I’ve had in Auckland over the last few days visiting. Mayo chicken burger - add coleslaw to the burger. Delicious! Beautifully cooked chicken. Highly recommend.

I ordered their chicken on rice meal and as i was waiting i noticed their salad station infested with flies! The server also knew this but she didnt do much about shoo-ing them away. I was grateful my meal was being cooked fresh and not sitting around. The service wasnt great, she looked like she didnt want to be there. The whole vibe of the place was off. This seems to be the case of most(not all) kebab places.. which is a shame because i quite enjoy kebab shops. Theres only a few in auckland I can name that are great! The food was average. So expensive for what you get.

It is not the best food I have to say the chicken in my chicken avo kebab was not fresh the chicken tasted stale and not flavourful. The sales were ok fresh but not the best but the food is good portioned and definitely fills you up quickly.

This is not a good kabab! It doesn’t even taste like a normal kebab. Raw vegetables, cold, bland and lacking any hint of flavor in the meat. Please heat it properly before serving, as it was hardly warm. The portion size is SMALL for the price. Compared to Arum Takeaways up the road, it’s probably half the size for the same price. Crazy. Only came here for convenience but certainly won’t make that mistake again.
Fresh, Tidy, Very decent portion, Balanced sauces and quickly served. Highly recommend. Meat is Halal
Fantastic food, lovely and fresh, and always fast service.

Pretty good chicken, well fried but could be more flavourful. K Chicken just around the corner has great marinaded chicken that you can taste even beyond the Korean sauces, this is just chicken. Some of our chicken wasn't coated with spice on the bottom. They always have new flavours and I'll try it again, the XL Dark Chicken looks interesting.

My friend recommended this place to me and my wife and I must say we were definitely not disappointed. The food and bubble tea here is fantastic! We had the Dirty Mango Shake, Peach Light Oolong, Plum Kumara fries, Fried Chicken Jimi Bun and Plum Fried Chicken. They were all just absolutely delicious. The plum with the chicken and kumara fries tastes sooo good! And the Jimi Bun I've never had before so I was very pleasantly surprised. It was so yum. The bubble teas were top notch as well. We are definitely coming back here.

Just wanted to share our experience from this branch. We showed by the time they were closing the shop but still let us ordered milk tea. Thank you so much Joyce! It was very nice of you. Very accomodating and friendly.

Thought I’d try the XL plum chicken to see what the place is like and was pleasantly surprised! Good size - It’s like a large chicken breast butterflied, so sort of like a schnitzel. Quite sweet with the plum but a little spice there too. Nice and juicy!

I was dreaming of a succulent portion of chicken but upon indulgent I was shot down like a dog in the street. Dry Bland Bitter A few to describe what I endured I am shocked and confused and will not be back
Went here for brunch, was great, food and coffee was nice, service was fast and staff friendly, plenty of outside tables so could sit and enjoy food without having to leave the dog in the car

Hi. I called and made the order for the loaded fries as I have done many times (the fries there is a negative review about). The owner answered the phone, took the order and handed the fries to me. I had to sent it back twice as there was 3 pieces of bacon and no mayo. Then a 3rd time I was assured the spring onions were under the fries. They were not. This has happened every time we have come here. We try to give them chance after chance but it continues happening. They don’t seem to know what comes on their dishes. Below shows what the fries are supposed to look like, what they did, the burnt bits under the fries, the raw bacon, the transaction proving it was Hobsonville coffee club (even though the owner said it wasn’t) and it shows the phone call I made to them today. Also showing it was Hobsonville coffee club. It’s definitely worth it to extend the drive and go to the Northwest branch, unless you like raw bacon of course. A second review wouldn’t have been made had you just been honest in the first one and owned up to it.

Absolutely beautiful! From the amazing service, delicious coffees, flavor packed food... this place is an all rounder! They are always accommodating and do everything with the kindest heart and biggest smile! No coffees can compare to how good these are (believe us, we have tried many)! The food value is out of this world! The portion is large, fresh and full of yummy flavor every time! Lastly, with myself being vegan, their menu offers a variety of choice which is so humbling to know I won't be missing out or ever need to go through the struggles of modifying a dish. Their range is fantastic, highly recommend!

Came here for lunch and ordered the spaghetti meatballs dish they had. waited a unusual duration of about 30 minutes for the food to come out of the kitchen. I had high expectations for the food to be well-done in relation to the duration it took to make the food. first thing, the food did not look appealing at all, assuming the food was microwaved because the cheese on the spaghetti was hardened with little stretch to the texture, the meatballs were unusually hot apart from the fact that one meatball was extremely cold on one side, like it was microwaved. the tomato paste sauce looked and taste dry, the noodles were soggy, not fresh. overall the meal was unwelcoming, and not fresh at all. miserable to eat. It is upsetting to return to this TCC in hobsonville as my first time was better, disappointing experience and ruined my thoughts towards this place. the money is definitely not worth the food, i will not return.

Came into coffee club today. Service was horrible. I was waiting around to order and not a staff member to be seen for a long time. I even had to go into kitchen area and yell “does anyone work here”. Staff member finally came out and did my order. However she was in the back laughing extremely loud when she should be focusing on the front. The manger needs to train there staff properly. I get if there’s nothing to do but should be watching for customers. This is hospitality!!! Whole point of the job

I am amazed, We were welcomed so warmly in tue Thai style. The food is simply amazing, so flavourful with ample amounts of meat. We both had Pad Thai, my roast duck and cashews earned a 10 out of 10! We were even given a beautiful gift, a gold elephant as a sign of good fortune, I can not speak more highly of this restaurant. Thanks more a wonderful meal. Oh and on a side note be very careful when trying their Chili Oil! It will blow your socks off!!!!
The food here is rich in flavor. The service is enthusiastic and attentive. The space is comfortable and clean. Parking is right in front. We will be back!

First thing that greeted us here when we came in was a friendly smile. Outright fantastic service from the start. The entree spring rolls was really good. The fried rice surprisingly delicious. The trademark pad Thai held its ground among the best ones we've tasted. Gotta say we were pretty full when we finished. Some left over takeaways too. Lovely 😍 thank you!
authentic food, thai interior but i would love to give more than five stars on their exceptional service. They made me feel like travling Thailand! Must try Thai curry here!
0ne of the best Thai restaurants in Auckland. Pop and his staff are exceptional - the food is amazing, always make sure you ask for thai hot! Dont be a pussy!

I BOUGHT AN APPLE SLICE AND I WAS SO EXCITED TO EAT IT FOR LUNCH AND I WAS SAVING IT ALL DAY AND THEN I OPENED IT AND IT WAS MOLDY AND THERE WAS HAIR . Also the blueberry muffins are from costco (steak and cheese pie is yummy tho)

Food here is mouldy and disgusting I was charged $6 for a custard cream donut that had mould on it I don’t know how this bakery/takeaway store is still open. Where is the food standards!!! Someone needs to shut this place down.
Read the reviews. 1 star would be generous. Stale old pies cold. Sandwiches are old soggy stale. Really only eat here if food poisoning is somehting you are into 🤢🤮🤢

Very poor quality of food and overpriced. Pie was stale/hard and falling apart, had to throw most of it in the bin. Sandwich was dry and bit of mold on the bottom of the chocolate donut. Would not recommend this bakery.

Way over priced. $6 for a steak and cheese pie, $4.50 for a cream donut. The pies taste like they've been sitting in the warmer for days and the meat is just fat and gristle. Go to Luckens Road bakery for top quality bakery food.
Super friendly staff, cooked food to order. Presented the food well. Food came out in a timely manner and was cooked very well and filled with flavour. Highly recommend the Sunday lunch CTO.

Imagine this you get lasagne and you find 2 layers of beef mince and 1200 layers of pasta that are undercooked, culinary experts. Best part they put the prices up and the portion size down, bloody day light robbery,
I just spent 3 days not eating on a course, and I still wouldn’t eat the mince.

ESS Combined Mess is a bit hit or miss. Probably more miss than hit. While some dishes are edible, others fall flat in terms of flavor and presentation. The service can be slow, with some long queues around peak times. The ambiance is lacking, with a dated decor and awkward seating options. Overall, it might not be the best choice if you're looking for a memorable dining experience.

Had blood all through the chicken, got told it was “just the veins”. Would advise being near a toilet after going here. Would give 0 stars but the Onion Crumble served for dessert was quite delightful. (Also the water seemed to be free of Giardia, which made up for getting campylobacter from the chicken).
Lovely and warm inside with a quiet community feel. Wasn't sure why there was a big dog inside but it was well behaved! Simple cabinet food available. My friend was shocked to pay $7.50 for tea.

had a chill lunch over there, good location, variety of car parks, no need to worry about where to park your car. limited selection for food (personal opinion). There seems like isn’t much main course selection. Had their crispy chicken and wedges, overall still not bad. good atmosphere there, I kinda enjoyed.😎

Lovely place to have meals with family and friends. I didn’t expect that presentation of Creamy mushrooms though. It was sad. Smells good with Truffle oil. Unfortunately Egg Benedict were not runny poached eggs… Fish and chips was good.

Nice cafe plenty of space and has an outdoor area with good parking. Burger presentation was nice but the bun isn’t that good (flaky and should not be used for a burger instead should be for jam and butter) meat patty more of a processed meat instead of real beef way. Coffee was ok.

First time visiting as a local, and unfortunately, I wasn’t impressed. The coffee was weak and watery, and when I asked for a kids' menu, I was told they didn’t have one but could still prepare something. I requested nuggets and chips for my child, but we were only given nuggets. To make matters worse, when I went to use the women’s toilets before leaving, both had feces smeared on the seats. It was very unhygienic and gave the impression that they’re rarely, if ever, cleaned properly. Really disappointed overall — not the experience I was hoping for.

Indian Summer was one of the best Indian restaurants I’ve been to in Auckland! It’s such a cute and intimate restaurant with insanely delicious meals, drinks, and desserts! We had a big group and tried a mix of all different types of meals! The staff and owners are all so extremely friendly and kind. 10/10 Definitely recommend!
#Indian restaurant# Authentic cuisine，especial the curry. Strongly recommend cheese naan and beef，amazing👍

Complimentary papadam to start while you look at the menu. Great selection and equally great results when the food arrives. Staff are extremely polite and genuine people. Usually plenty of space as most people do takeaways, by the looks of it. Venue is moody but underlit in my opinion.

I have heard about this place from colleagues. They speak rev about the place since it is owned by their Co worker. I have read the reviews online and knew that it was not a worth place to visit. Unfortunately, due to work circumstances, l found myself sitting in this place for the first time. I must say that my time here was awful. I arrived at 1745 hours, we had a glass of water and after about 20 minutes of being here the owner came to ask what we wanted. I ordered goat curry medium. It arrived later and when l told him it was very hot he snapped 😳 at ne and said , " you ordered medium. ' Common, l do cook Indian food at home and l know what medium should taste like. That was unbearably. Later a friend suggested l ask for yogurt which was served for the sake . My other friends enjoyed their food as they ordered mild. I just had to eat the meat and impress my friends who know the owner. On my way home l just wondered 🤔 why should l use $36 on something not worth it. Next time l will not support such behavior or place. A very awful time . Will not recommend this place to anyone. Thw tables are also very small. A table that can be use dby 2 people was used for 4 people. Ridiculous. If l am paying my money, l want food worth my money.

This restaurant is definitely exceed our expectation much!! We went to there prior to our booking time, the staff were so nice and making very favorable juice call mango lassi while we waiting for our dishes. Of course the dishes were so yum! They keep very transitional Indian cuisine instead of fusion where we all prefer to have. This place won our thumbs up - 14 thumbs with 14 of us 👍
Really nice food will be back again soon
Delicious, budget-friendly food recipes
Great food at reasonable prices. Try the China Doll for a different style eggs benne. The French toast is also very visually appealing if you are a sweet tooth!
This is truly the best café — we simply can’t live without it. The food is top-notch, and the coffee is outstanding.

The pad thai that I always order is so delicious. I ate half of it and then remembered that I didn't take a photo. It's large in quantity and delicious. The boss is also very nice. I was in a hurry to pick up my child today, so I could only take it away. The boss specially expedited it for me. Thank you!

This charming cafe nestled in a residential area offers a cozy, welcoming environment despite its compact size. When I visited, it was bustling, but the attentive staff quickly helped us find a seat. We tried their Asian fusion dishes, including the beef salad, chicken salad, and Pad Thai. Each dish was absolutely delicious—the beef was juicy and flavorful, the chicken salad was fresh and satisfying, and the Pad Thai was perfectly balanced. We also ordered fries, which were crispy and tasty. Don’t miss out on their cacao smoothies; they’re a great choice for anyone seeking a healthy option. Highly recommend this spot for a delightful meal!

The food had so much flavor! We got the sweet and sour pork filo and the crispy chicken in Turkish bread both were incredible! (I also got a bacon and egg pie that wasn't the best but the filo had so much flavor I couldn't deducted a star for just the pie)
I enjoyed walking into this shop, very warm family owned feeling, very friendly lady behind the counter. Sushi tasted fresh, support your local and give them a go!

The building is the least bit conspicuous and it’s hard to spot as it blends in with the neighboring townhouses. Once inside, it’s pleasantly quaint and clean. Sushi pieces were actually very nice - the sushi was firm and moist, the pieces were on the larger end and crammed with fillings. I thought the prices were reasonable; $1.10 per piece is slightly below the market average for suburban sushi. Salmon can be hit and miss with sushi, but it was definitely a hit here. Will be returning.
Just moved to Hobsonville,had sushi a couple of days ago - excellent,had a teriyaki chicken hob box tonight also excellent,great price too 😊
Consistency, quality, friendly. Great food. What more can you ask for?

I enjoyed the rice but my partner found it dry and lacking flavour. The fish was pretty thin and this is compared to sushi pac which is only 20¢ extra but the fish and other fillings is like 5x thicker! They should provide the little soy fish so you're not forced to drown your sushi in soy sauce or go without. Also the ginger was not as good as the pink stuff which is my jam. It was just disappointing.

Visited 4 times, it’s always amazing! Best homemade tasting Chinese around for sure :-) Absolutely love the sweet and sour pork! The Malaysian tofu is great, the braised pork belly is good! Mapo Tofu is great.

The diligent and humble uncle and aunt from Shanghai have some dishes that are classics from 1990s Shanghai restaurants. Even in today's Shanghai, it’s hard to find such authentic flavors. Peanut crisps and spring rolls are my two favorite delicacies.

The pork fried rice is delicious, and my daughter loved her chicken fried noodles. I also had the lychee soda, which was really refreshing and not too sweet. Portion sizes are generous, we had enough leftover to have as lunch the next day. I’m definitely keeping 77 Taste as a go-to for takeaways!
Amazing Chinese food (Shanghai restaurant)and Nice staff,we always go there for our lunch or dinner,best food best price,$20-25/person
The food was awesome. Home made dumplings and braised pork on rice. Delicious! Service was quick and friendly. Definitely recommend.

The weather’s getting colder, and it’s the perfect time for soup. I had my favorite chowder here—and it was amazing! Packed with seafood, it was full of rich creamy ocean flavor. Absolutely delicious. I’ll definitely be coming back just for the chowder!👍🍲

Food was really good and it was a generous portion. I ordered the Big Brekkie to share and it was enough for two adults and one little one to share. I must admit that I initially did not want to leave a positive review as our order was forgotten. I had to go over and ask because our order still hadn’t appeared after 30 mins. However I changed my mind after seeing how their staff handled their mistake. I wasn’t expecting anything but they gave us a slice of cheesecake as an apology. The owner also brought over some home made marshmallows to help calm my toddler down when he was having a meltdown. I appreciated the extra effort to make us feel welcome. Great service recovery.

A very nice dog friendly cafe. Excellent menu, which our large family group was able to use to find something to each one's taste. I thought the chicken and chips kids menu item was great value and was loved by all that had it.
Super friendly team serving up tasty drinks and home made food. Good selection on baked goods. There is even Vietnamese coffee options for those looking for a real kick start!!

What a great breakfast we all had - all were enjoyed and no complaints at all! Great portion size, tasty and a fair price. Will definitely be coming here again. There was also an assortment of cabinet food for people preferring a muffin or scone. Staff were very friendly and conducive to an enjoyable morning.

Ordered Pizza at 1:33 pm in the afternoon with a pickup time of 6:55 pm. They hadn't even printed the ticket off. Had to wait for them to make the pizza. The taste of the pizza was off too, as it was done in a hurry. We ordered that type of pizza few times before, so knew what to expect. Disappointing experience.

Don’t bother coming here. I was disappointed with my experience this evening. I ordered one pizza online 30 mins in advance, in order to get to my dinner plans in time. There were only two people operating and in spite of the low demand (being a Monday evening), I ended up having to wait another 30 mins after the order was due and consequently was late to the dinner. There are no prices on the menu board, probably to entice people to upsize without knowing the actual cost. The staff seemed friendly enough but the store lacked the authenticity of a local pizza parlor and felt more like a national chain. The excess oil caused the toppings to not adhere well to the base. I won’t come back. Came back another week later to order chips - $5 per small box of soggy and partially cooked chips was beyond disappointing. Go to a fish n chips shop for any sides.

Generous toppings, and the flavors were delicious. We bought 2 pizzas, one with a gluten free base. My gf was the best pizza I've ever had, and hubby said the same about his wheat-based one. Pic is of my gf apricot chicken pizza. Hubby also said the chips were excellent too. These are, unfortunately, not gf.
Friendly staff and the best pizzas in the area. I was recommended this place by a friend and have been back non stop ever since. Love it.

Great huge range of pizzas, the dessert pizzas are amazing plus huge.. This is the first place I've had a cranberry and chicken pizza that beats hells version of it. Oh and the prawn pizzas they aren't cheap on the prawns and will have heaps of prawns on each pizza. Cannot understand how people can say these are 1 star and alike, I'm one of the biggest pizza lovers out there and if u want a mid range price pizza..skip pizza hut and dominoes high price pizzas and pick up one of these...or if you want sals size pizza but with tons of toppings then come here.

We dined here on Mother’s Day. The food was amazing—especially the Pad Thai, the best I’ve ever had! However, the 1 hour and 15 minute wait after ordering (despite being told 30 minutes) was frustrating. When we arrived, we were given high chairs and a high table, which we weren’t told about during the reservation call—though they claimed they did. Thankfully, the Filipino bartender and Filipina service crew were incredibly helpful and arranged a better setup for us. Their service made the experience more pleasant. Great food and friendly staff, but the long wait time really needs improvement.
Loved the pad Thai, veggie tofu noodles and the salted fish crab rice (must try). Great atmosphere with attentive and kind staff.

Went there last night to celebrate my husband’s birthday. The food is a lot tastier and visually attractive than last time I visited (two years back). The staff were very attentive and the atmosphere was on point. I would highly recommend this place for a date night!

What a great place to eat. Had not made a reservation. They happily seated us, had a toddler with us, no issue. Service was great, waiters were attentive, polite, patient. Water was topped up throughout dinner, empty plates removed from table promptly. The food was divine, very impressed with the level of service issued. A must go place, near the waterfront. Prices very reasonable given the excellent quality of food and level of service provided. Definitely will go again.

Welcoming establishment.With a great atmosphere. My video got cut. Great food, well presented .If you get Jay as your waitress she is amazing. She make great recommendations on what to have . If you want a romantic evening a great place to be . It has a romantic feel about it . Want a party they have a spot for that too. Also make sure you tell them you heat levels in taste .I went medium and it was perfect for me . Check them out . Thank you for great night.

I recently ordered from this Domino’s branch and I was really happy with my experience! The pizza was fresh, nicely baked, and full of toppings. The crust was crispy on the outside and soft inside, and the cheese melted really well. Also, the staff were friendly and the order was ready quickly. I know this place has had some challenges before, but it’s clear the new management is working hard to improve. I’ll definitely be ordering again!

Yah overall good, usually get delivery from the dominos app but decided to pick up after a grocery run. I don’t bother with Uber etc it’s a waste of time when shit goes wrong from past experience. So Just order directly from store or pick up. Simple. We ordered a few mini boxes tonight to share as family and customised the sides and pizza toppings. Nice staff cheers.Pizza always best when it’s hot. Thanks

The new management doing really well . Both pizza was absolutely fantastic! The crust was perfectly crispy, the sauce is tangy and flavourful, and the cheese was melty and gooey. Every bite was a delicious experience, and I highly recommend it!

Just wanted to say a big thank you to the team at Domino’s! Every time I order, the experience is consistently smooth,from the easy-to-use app, to the fast delivery, and of course, the food that always hits the spot. The pizzas are fresh, hot, and loaded with flavor. I really appreciate the attention to detail, like the right amount of toppings and a perfectly baked crust. Shoutout to the delivery driver too ,super friendly and always on time. It's little things like that which keep me coming back. You guys make those pizza nights extra special. Keep doing what you're doing!
Rainy day today and too lazy to cook or leave the house.ordered Domino’s delivery on the app this evening, after a while. Hot yummy pizza delivered . Fast and the guy was friendly 👍🏻
Never had a bad meal from here. Fast service and staff are all lovely and polite. Would definitely recommend

First time trying Sun Ma, it is a very busy and popular joint. Ordered, combination fried rice, fish burger, fish and chips. The fish and chips are great, no complaints - drained very well, chips were fresh and crispy. Fish and crab stick and a nice thin batter, and the chicken wing was good. Fish burger was also good. Fried rice was great, you can tell their wok is well seasoned. Definitely will come back again. I had no problem with the phone ordering and picking up as I can see other reviews had that problem.
Great local take away. Reasonably priced, while being better quality than local competitors. Will come back again soon

Not great atmosphere to go and spend your money. No decency serving food with no salt or sauces being overpriced as extra charge with wontons alone not serving any drinks available atall. Felt quiet sickening 🤮. Doesn't deserve it has A+ rating

Good people. Quality food. Always given with a smile. Clean A Grade premises. Why wouldn't you chose here as your takeaway business of choice. Keep it up guys. You have my vote. 2 years later and still consider Sun Ma a top quality takeaway place. Nice crispy crumbed oysters & snapper. Yum yum. Even my dog Boss likes the food here. 😁 2 years & 3 months later. Check out the crowd The only thing wrong with the crumbed oysters here is when you drop one on the ground. Dammmit!

Don't waste your money, drive one minute down the road to Sunma, where the food is FAR better for the same price! Out of desperation (when Sunma was closed), we tried this place a few times, ordering something different each time, but always ended up throwing most of it away. Wouldn’t recommend it AT ALL!!!🤢. Plus, the service at Sunma is much friendlier too.

Bought meal for family tray for a good price very surprising. The staff were attentive and welcoming, and the food arrived fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. Portions were generous for the price, and the menu had something for everyone. Perfect for a casual meal or small gatherings. Will definitely return! 🌟🍴 4/5 stars

1. Clean out your dirty deep fryers 2. You food tastes bad, because of this 3. Portion size is ridiculously small 4. To misable to bother to put sauce on the hotdogs 5. You're busy because everything else is shut 6. Never again
We love their chicken nibbles and chip packs 👌 guarantee we always come here if we are in the area , never a let down

Was in the neighbourhood and they’re well rated so thought we’d grab some takeaways. Ordered chicken in black bean sauce and beef with ginger and spring onions (i asked for this one to be made spicy). Both dishes ended up looking and tasting identical, which was bland. The beef one had chillies which was the only difference. Full of broccoli and cauliflower and not much else. Haha, not even a single spring onion in the beef and spring onion dish! Might be an idea to let people know if you are out of key ingredients. This was a disappointment, will stick to our local. 2 stars for making the dish spicy.
Feels a little lazy. Naan was not fresh. Did not ask about the spiciness, and the curry was too hot. Food has a strange aftertaste so we thought it's safer not to finish it. Not enjoyable.

Looks are deceiving but it's really well priced and the meals are so tasty! I got the butter chicken and it had the perfect taste that I love. My new go to Indian restaurant for sure! 5 years later and I thought I would update my review. Mint Leaf remains my favourite Indian takeout on the shore by far. I have tried all the local places as I have moved around the North Shore and they still can't compare to the taste, affordability, and portion sizes here. Even now that I live near Devonport, I will still make the trip over for Mint Leaf's butter chicken. The Naan is also fantastic, I often have the garlic and cheese Naan. I hope to keep coming here for years to come!

Mint Leaf is great value and good quality, they give you a larger curry than most places. Lamb Korma is my go to and consistently good. The lady sometimes comes off as a little rude on the phone but it's not her intention (maybe just limited English), they are nice people. For the price and quality, this place really is great value.
We had dhal makhhami and nano bread the dhal was very plain and bread is going to the birds. Most unusual previous were great. They need to fix this.
Awesome as always. Lots of flavour and generous serving. You can also place your orders via phone and then just pick it up on your way home if you want.
Amazing staff, extremely convenient location for all those in the valley. Cute little shop caters to all needs etc seats, cold drinks and napkins. Nice discounts before closing
Such a gem for Beach Haven this sushi shop. Excellent sushi, heaps of choice and lovely service. Deservedly popular place!
Best sushi around. Friendly service and plenty of variety. My go to snacks: spicy chicken chicken skewer grilled salomon sushi 🍣 Teriyaki Salmon Don Baby salmon sushi pack Baby katsu sushi pack
Big fan of Haven Sushi. Prices have gone up a but but the quality is still high. Fun, pick your own, type deal and the donburi is very nice.
Beautiful but a bit pricey. Love the katsu bowls
Same price as St Pierre’s, but the quality OMG! Is like to have a sushi in Tokyo. Plus, front of house lady very polite and friendly.
Amazing menu all round, vegetarian options are all delicious, tasty tofu, awesome kakiage, spring rolls, dumplings & nigiri very satisfying
A family favourite, we have come here occasionally for years The staff are kind and helpful, food is tasty and price is decent

This is now the main sushi place in Birkenhead shopping centre since the great little place in the mall closed. It's OK. The selection is excellent with a good range of options. Size and price are good, too. So, if you're hungry and just want to grab something healthy for lunch, it's fine. The sushi is very loosely wrapped and roughly cut. There are a couple of tables where you could sit and eat in the midst of customers coming and going but this is primarily a place relying on large numbers of people in and out, not a restaurant. If you're in a great hurry, be aware that there's a surcharge for paywave. (Which is perfectly fair for a small business with many small transactions and facing the associated bank charges)

Great little sushi place my husband eats here all the time , my first time trying tho was unfortunate… order the teriyaki donburi impressive portion for price but sadly completely bland no teriyaki at all just tasted and looked like boiled chicken on rice, I assumed as this is my go to at any sushi spot it would be like everywhere else a nice thick coating of teriyaki sadly I was mistaken . Might be a personal preference as it’s not what I’m used to getting , but was disappointed.

If you're craving an exceptional dining experience in Birkenhead, look no further than The Mediterranean Restaurant. From the moment you step through the door, you're greeted with warmth and hospitality that sets the tone for a truly memorable meal. Eduard and Jessica are the heart and soul of this establishment, and their passion for hospitality shines through in every interaction. Their friendly demeanour and genuine care for their guests make you feel like part of the family from the moment you arrive. And let's not forget about the food—oh, the food! Each dish is a masterpiece, bursting with flavour and crafted with care. From traditional favourites to innovative creations, every bite is a delight for the senses.

I am very impressed with the service and food at this place. If i had a gold star here i would reward this here with my comments. The owner has obviously done an awesome job to keep his customers happy & pleased. I have been here 3 times and the hospitality is top notch all the time. The staff are all friendly & polite. We dine one evening for 3 people and we had a complimentary entree (stone oven pita breads with dips), and because it was Tuesday they have free desserts for ever main meal you order. We love dinning here and we think the price is fair for the quality from their menu and hospitality from their staff. We will be back again for more. Compliments to the owner & chefs, including the waiters. Thank you for the wonderful time at your restaurant :-) ♡ ♡☆☆
Amazing food, the meat is excellent. Would recommend to anyone!
This place has a very nice aura and relax feel. Meat was fresh and delicious, will definitely be back again. The skewers were yummy and large portions, enough for two!

Fantastic food! Highly recommend. The Continental Chilli Calzone, the best I've had. Flavorful, the right amount of spice (not too much but not too little). Service was amazing and made sure everything was ok. Great choice of desserts. A fantastic night out for dinner, thanks Eduardo and Jessica. Appreciate how kind and hospitable you both were. When I'm back in Auckland next I'll know where I'll come back to.

Amazing place, grateful for its recognition on google reviews! I went here today and was happy that the prices aligned with the quality and quantity of the food. Great experience, standard wait time for a $33 meal for 2. My bf is a big kebab fan and said their kebab wrap was really really good. Thank you

Recommended by my son who raved about the meals at Lazeez when they first opened I’ve returned a few times. Each time the meal has been delicious, excellent value and no lengthy wait times. Burgers and kebabs recommended. The chips are perfectly well made and huge portions. So pleased to have this great local takeaway

Great meal for the price. We ordered two large meals both with mixed meat and it came to $33 what a bargain! Delicious chilli sauce that looks to be home made. Would love to buy the sauce by its self!

I was thrilled when Lazeez Kebabs opened in my neighborhood. Their food is outstanding, with exceptional flavors that never disappoint. The value for money is unbeatable, especially in Auckland, where it's rare to find a proper meal for under $18. I'm a loyal customer, visiting at least twice a week, and the variety on the menu is impressive—yet the quality remains consistently top-notch every single time.

Lazeez is such a great takeaway shop to have close by to me. Not know what to cook on a weekend night when all the food in the pantry had been raided from Monday to Friday, Lazeez is a fresh and quality option for weekend dinner. Working only 10 minutes away from it also gives me a lot of time during my break to go to Lazeez which is highly worth the drive, time, and effort. If you were to first try Lazeez I personally recommend the ‘any’ kebab with chips option with cheese ($2 extra). They give you a variety of sauce options and whatever you order I 100% garantee the food will be made fresh and with care.

A hidden gem in birkdale. The taste of the fry rice was so great and only $16. That’s exactly what people want. The owner couples are very friendly, the rest is very busy at lunch time. Thanks so much, we don’t come here often but if we can we will be back!

If the menu uploaded on Google is not up to date, you should add up-to-date photos of your new menu prices. They charged me $18 for vege fried rice (not $16).It's mostly just rice. If I knew that, I would just get the steak one for the same price. There's not even as much egg as the reviewed photo previously posted. I'll rather go to the one closer to my house than drive all the way here again to be charged more than expected and be treated rudely. False advertising, even the guy who took my phone order didn't say "that's going to be $__" at the end of my order and the woman at the cashier was very rude, glaring at me when I pointed out that meat is far more expensive than vege in the grocery stores. Can't believe you are trying to trick people like that!

Our family love Golden Ye. Best fish’n’chips ever. Always decent serving sizes AND their burgers are awesome! Staff are friendly & always working hard in the kitchen while also managing to execute great customer service. They always answer their phone. It’s our regular Friday night takeaway shop.
I had a fish and chips special meal. The portion was a bit small for the price I paid for (compared to other takeaways I've been to). But overall, the food was cooked well and it tasted great.
Would get hot chips with sauce between 5 -6 kids after swim , was 1-2 bucks

I sometimes get takeout from here. Since I usually visit after 3:30 PM, there aren't many items left, but they're usually discounted. Last time, I went in the morning, which was rare. There were so many varieties, and the sushi looked beautifully decorated. There were plenty of fried foods and sushi rolls, and a few traditional Japanese sushi options like salmon, shrimp, and egg. I love the inari sushi topped with mushrooms, and the chili prawns are also a favorite. There's always a smiling woman at the cashier. With so many options, I'd love to try everything. Thank you always.

A small sushi shop in Birkdale, which is not a popular area to visit or to stop by. The taste of the sushi is amazing and it’s beyond my expectations. Pricing is very good as well. Thanks for being local.
Honestly one of the best places for sushi in Auckland! They have a huge selection, great value for money and always the freshest ingredients. Super tasty and you can taste how fresh the seafood is.

Fantastic sushi and a rare quality find in the suburbs! We drive across the North shore to stop here. There's a lot of variety and novelty themed sushi for holidays. Get in early on a weekend to avoid disappointment. I have shared the level 3 menu from last time.
Best sushi on the north shore everything is so fresh and they have a huge variety of Sushi. They cook Bento bowls on demand and really great prices
All the food very yummy. This Thai restaurant is my favourite place now.All the food is tasty and in side restaurant very clean.the owner are very friendly.
We ordered Pad See Ew and Thai spicy vermicelli salad, and both dishes were delicious and authentic. The owner was lovely, and we’ll definitely be back!

We dined in and had the prawns pad thai and massaman beef curry – both were delicious and packed with flavor. The portions were generous, and the place was clean and welcoming. Will definitely be one of my go-to places in North Shore!
Ordered Tom Yum soup and by far the most disappointing tom yum I ever had. The soup look so pale straightaway and there’s no depth of flavor. A very very sad soup
The beef massaman is absolutely delicious and the pad thai is very tasty. Both generous portions and great customer service. This will now be my go to!

Had a chicken pot pie. To be honest, I was a bit disappointed. It was ok but I found the pastry a bit thick and didn’t think the pie filling had much flavour. Chicken wasn’t very tender. Like I said, I thought it was ok - 5/10. $6.50 so a fair price for an ok pie.

I bought a steak mushrooms pie, a steak bacon pie and a custard tart. Pies tasted okay-ish, at least average. However, a little bit disappointed about custard tart. It was underbaked. Pastry was too fregile to hold and filling was not great either.
A great go to bakery for me. They always have some new flavour too. Good pastry and tasty filling and good quality steak.
I loved the burger and wedges. Very good food. Good customer service and very reasonable price.
Sorry but the sausages have to go no one wants to pay $3 for those disgusting little sausages that come in a big bag and are mostly processed s*** food please bring back real sausages

We chose to dine at this restaurant, despite its considerable distance from our location in Auckland. The service was prompt and courteous; our orders were taken efficiently, and our meals were beautifully presented. The kingfish crudo showcased exceptional depth of flavor, subtly spiced and complemented by ponzu sauce and prawn crackers. It's a must-try for crudo enthusiasts. For our main courses, we selected the snapper with udon noodles and fish broth, a refreshing and flavorful dish, and the braised lamb shoulder, artfully presented with paratha and pickled green chilies. Both mains were outstanding, with the green chilies providing a delightful accent. The burnt butter cake with chai ice cream was a superb conclusion to our meal, the ice cream's sweetness perfectly complementing the cake and poached pears. The beverages were also excellent. We thoroughly enjoyed our lunch.

The best thing abt this place was the corn. One of our friend was a vegetarian and ordered for a vegetarian burger and they gave her beef burger and it wasn’t even busy so not recommended. Slowest service I’ve seen. Oo and they even charged us for the cake like it was a small cake not something too huge and I get the cost but $10 per person for cake we bought from outside made it more expensive than the cake price 🤣 just something to be aware off. 0% recommended for vegetarians. Presentation of food good steaks weren’t so great. It’s better to get water and cutlery yourself Cz the staff will forget and your food will get cold.
It’s my first time at this restaurant. I ordered three main courses—they were beautifully presented and delicious. Definitely worth visiting! I really like the unique large windows.

Had such a great experience at Ohui yesterday! The chef is super talented and the dishes we had were so so delicious! Highly recommend this place - especially their Fish of the day and Paua tortellleni. It is to die for!😍
Nice to have a local quality restaurant. We had two generations eating here and we sat out the back and enjoyed a nice sunset. Staff were friendly and attentive and food was delicious. Check it out.
Food was absolutely delicious, every one must try lots of options available
Authenticity reflect in the food. First time I tried it and feel like home cooked with tons of spices the way you like it.
Nothing has changed apart from the name. See reviews under Birkdale Indian takeaways to get a true picture. The food is not good, it's like food hall offerings: mass produced and bland.
Great delicious food. Chaat option is great
Delicious Indian chaat options available here. I tried bread pakora and Golgappa. It was so delicious

It was so good we came back the next day! Went here with my significant other two days in a row past midnight thanks to their late opening hours, we got butter chicken and their special which was the chicken biryani! The food was incredibly delicious right after it was made, I would get the butter chicken 10x again. My significant other also loved the chicken biryani! After the first day we kept thinking about going back all day, and then when we realised they were open until 2am we got so excited to go again 😊

I initially had a great experience with Birkdale Takeaways starting last year. However, my last three orders have been disappointing due to hygiene concerns. The first two had hair in the curry, and the most recent one contained a housefly in the curry and an insect in the rice. I reported this to the staff, and I hope they take serious steps to improve cleanliness and food safety. While the food itself has been good, hygiene is a top priority, and I believe regular checks by food safety officers would be beneficial to ensure proper standards are met."

We ordered a biryani, but what we received was nothing more than bland fried rice with chicken—an outright scam. Disgusting and completely intentional fraud. When we called to address the issue, the so-called “great chef” who prepared it not only refused to acknowledge his mistake but also insulted us, suggesting we didn’t know what biryani was. To make matters worse, he even questioned whether we were intoxicated. The food was absolute garbage, and the staff—especially that chef—clearly have no idea how to handle complaints, let alone provide decent customer service. This was not just bad food; it was a deliberate rip-off. Caution to everyone: Don’t waste your money or time here, whānau.

Got the lunch special, and for $15 I thought it was extremely good value. Curry was good with some chicken (not heaps but not bad). Naan and rice were great and a can of drink included. With the cost of everything right now, this was a great deal.

The food was absolutely disgusting, and the service was terrible. They claim to serve Indian food, but what they’re actually selling is completely deceitful. We ordered mutton curry, and it was a disaster—an overwhelming amount of oil, barely any goat pieces, and a pungent, unpleasant taste. To make things worse, the next day, our entire family fell ill after eating it. This is completely unacceptable, and we are raising the issue with Auckland Council to ensure no one else has to go through this experience.

* HONEST R3V13W 2025 * This is my local pizza 🍕 go to place when I'm too lazy to cook. Well I tell you something, their pizzas are cooked to profession, the service is excellent and to top it off , I'm leaving with my hot pizzas for home... its flavors are yum! Very affordable, too. Be returning for more soon. Thank you!

Domino's in Beach Haven delivers exceptional service with consistently delicious pizza. Their staff is friendly, and the quick, efficient delivery ensures you get hot, fresh food every time. A reliable choice for a satisfying meal. Highly recommended!
First time order this cheese garlic scrolls and is this meant to look like this ? Do they even check before it serve to customer ?

Some small guy working there said that he was going to jab me because I asked for pineapple on my pizza. Like I know that might weird to some people but that is terrible service. I can’t believe someone would actually say that to a customer. This is so disrespectful to say to a customer and I felt threatened when he said this to me.
Its delicious food im always ordering pizza for this store and always delicious.

Tried this place for the first time tonight and i am blown away. The portions were huge! Everything we ordered was high quality and super tasty. Staff were so incredibly lovely and kind. Definitely will return
Great taste and better prices. Have tried this restaurant multiple times and their flavors come through better than most. Ordering some tonight...

What a hidden gem in Beachhaven. The food was delicious. We ordered the butter chicken, Dal Makhani, rice and cheesy naan. Reasonably priced and the loveliest lady, (I guess the owner) topped off a wonderful meal and experience. Thank you so much for the extra onion bhaji, which was also so tasty and unexpected and appreciated. We will be back and highly recommend Mahi Kitchen 🙏

With a 4.8 google rating I had high hopes for this takeaway…We liked the onion bhaji and garlic naan. But my veg jalfrezi was dire and the worst I’ve ever been served. Just a pile of oily onions without sauce. I didn’t even bother eating it.
Absolutely love coming here! The owners are so lovely & kind. Best cheesy garlic naan out!! Highly recommend, very lucky they are our local
My go to roast place. Would recommend the potato and gravy dish and the roast pork meal.
Ordered delivery and lamb roast meal and fried chicken were all cooked perfectly. Will be going there again soon
Very good food and very delicious. My bolognese was amazing 👏

Best roast around, the potatoes are so good. Really good sized to choose from. They also do a great deep fried chicken almost like KFC. Nice selection of deserts as well, like hot apple crumble and moose.. picture after we ate them.
Just brought a roast which was good but the chips are a dirty soggy brown color. Never going to buy the chips, they are not meant to be like that. Picture attached
There on bro! My wife's a vegetarian so finding a place we both like to eat at can sometimes be hard but kebabylon makes great burgers and the best falafel kebabs!!! 5/5 ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

We ordered a satay chicken wrap kebab and a lamb wrap kebab, plus chips. They were TASTY! The chicken was really tender and the veges were fresh. The chips were fresh too. Friendly service. Thank you, looking forward to another kebab

Always buy kebab here but today I was just pulling tendons and fat out my lamb kebab, never had this before in any kebab. Someone’s been cutting corners this weekend. If that happens again I won’t be coming back. Please keep your high standards and don’t slack. Update: today I purchased again and the experience was much better! The food was excellent this time and the service was great as always. Thanks, a much better experience today. I’ve upgraded the rating.
Great kebabs, bit concerned there was no kebab burner on, nor any lamb on it but overall a good kebab.

I have been coming here for 10 years now. It never, ever fails on quality, flavour, portion sizes and of-course the wonderful service. Lamb is the best quality here for a takeaway place. Better than in some restaurants. Hannah and Amy, you're awesome!

I tried the butter chicken from this restaurant, asking for an Indian spicy style, but it turned out to be very sweet and chicken also tasted under cooked. It was not what I expected. It wasn’t authentic North Indian taste. I wouldn't recommend it if you're looking for true Indian flavours.

Had our usual Butter Chicken tonight. Had the Double wrapping of all our food items, ensuring none of our food spilt. Plus it was a beautiful curry. Hot and delicious well seasoned and not shy on the chicken. Thank you team. We will be sure to come back!

I’m not one to write reviews but it’s criminal this place doesn’t have more of a google stamp. This has been my absolute favourite curry of choice for over two years. They’re rightfully called the butter chicken palace cause no other place in Auckland I’ve gone to can compare to their kiwi style curry. Admittedly I haven’t had their Indian butter chicken yet and it’s in my list (I swear) but every time I go to get it…that kiwi style curry pulls me right back in. This is my celebration curry. This is what I order when I’ve had a 15 hour shift and I haven’t eaten all day. Had a bad day? This curry has you. I love this curry. It’s one of the few things that will genuinely make me sad about leaving this city. Good. Curry. By all the old gods try this curry.

This place was great a year ago (under previous ownership) and has gone downhill significantly. A real pity as it would be great to have a decent takeaway option in the neighbourhood. Note they are under google maps as two different names (showing on maps as side by side) but in reality it’s a single restaurant.
UberEats pricing is broken - one curry combo $31 base +$23 for every curry choice - $50?? Something programmed very wrong across all prices, can't get hold of them to fix
The food was very nice here. Bought a butter chicken and goat curry on rice combo. Customer service was nice.

I tried the butter chicken from this restaurant, asking for an Indian spicy style, but it turned out to be very sweet and chicken also tasted under cooked. It was not what I expected. It wasn’t authentic North Indian taste. I wouldn't recommend it if you're looking for true Indian flavours.

So happy I found North Indian Cuisine. I live in Birkdale and usually travel to Sandringham, pick up takeout and bring it home. Little did I know, this gem was hidden in my locale. Got the goan fish curry and it was very nice - also love that there are so many clearly labelled dairy free options, so rare for Indian restaurants.

Samosa was cold on the inside. Probably came straight from the freezer. It was supposed to be a chicken samosa but was full of potato with the smallest hint Ong chicken. I wish I could give zero stars
Very nice butter chicken, had the chips with butter chicken sauce and then tasted so nice so had to get butter chicken with rice and nan bread. DELICIOUS 🤤 YUMMY 👍

The service at this place was amazing. I had a complementary choc cake for my birthday. Complementary muffins while waiting for our meal and a free iced chocolate. The staff were super friendly and attentive, we were blown away as we do dine out a lot. Will definitely be back, highly recommend this business, the locals are very lucky 😊 Thank you, you made my birthday special xox

My partner and I enjoyed a breakfast here last week and I cannot fault this establishment from the attentive staff to the brilliant food! I will definitely be a regular customer. We both ordered the signature haven breakfast and it was delicious, from the house made bread to the creamy mushrooms (I seriously want the recipe they were divine) everything was great! We then tried the pizza on Friday night and enjoyed it immensely all fresh ingredients, great taste and the best value around with pizzas from $8-15 you cannot beat it. I highly recommend having your next meal here. The manager was proud to tell us all ingredients were fresh and locally sourced which is always a bonus. I can't wait to try their french toast. Check it out for yourselves 😁

The Haven was a great place to have breakfast. My parents and I were warmly welcomed and the food was delicious and were great serving sizes!! My parents really enjoyed their meals and coffee. I had the egg bene and it was delicious. The cup of tea was brewed just right and as a bonus it was leaf tea. Parking was no problem at all!!

Went back to The Haven to try more of their burgers. Had the crispy chicken cranberry last time, and today had the beef burger. Both were delicious and tasty with lots of flavour. Good service and had a great time.

Came to try our local eatery since it has changed hands and seen some good reviews about the food on our community page. At first glance nothing has really changed in terms of the look of the place. Service will require improvement as I had to ask for the menu as well as napkins and water. Ordered the big breakfast which sounded great on the menu but came nothing close to it. It had half of a tomato which was crushed, three tiny sausages, two round pieces of some sort of bacon which wasn't good, overcooked scrambled eggs and at the bottom of the plate was a pile of reheated frozen vegetables. Taste was bland and under-seasoned. I expected much better for $25. I also ordered an ice latte which is an espresso with milk with ice but somehow they made it with cream and turned out to be some kind of shake instead. Food is nowhere to standard however I'll still come back for a pint of beer on occasion to support the local.

Toliets are absolutely feral, looked like they havnt been cleaned in weeks prehaps months. Dead insects and rubbish everywhere, no toliet paper - just nasty. Told the staff their but they didn't seem to care.

This is my local Wild Bean Cafe and they do a pretty good job overall. Generally my coffees are well made and served quickly. They do occasionally get busy and that shows things down but this is to be expected in this situation. The baristas do vary and sometimes when they make my Mochachino they don't stir the chocolate in properly and it called in the bottom of the cup but most of the time they are well trained and don't do this.
Fuel up the Car, get a car wash, Grab a good Barista Coffee and a Muffin or Pie. A good BP Garage.
It's just another bp station
👍 . good.

I ordered my meal through the Uber Eat yesterday. Felt nice that driver delivered quickly. I highly recommend the sweet and spicy chicken which I had ten pieces but it turned out it wasn’t enough 😂And thanks for offering the free spring rolls! It was so sweet of you. Definitely will visit again.

Ok so we never ordered from this place before so read reviews and thought ok lets try it. The chicken tasted old and dry! Some were raw so i couldnt eat it. Sorry but i dont agree with the other reviews!
could've been nice if the fried chicken wasn't burnt. ordered through uber and delivery was super duper quick but the color of fried chicken is almost the same as soy marinated chicken.
Chicken is too smelly and taste really bad. Didn’t notice it was smelly until my partner told me. Its my first time trying their chicken and we don’t like it at all.

Chicken is delicious every time. Fresh, made to order and all the staff are lovely. It's the go-to for my teen boys and we have never had a less-than delicious batch or flavour. If you pick up at dinner time, they even often chuck in a freebie. Highly recommend.

A local favourite! Delicious pizza and pasta that never disappoints. Best chicken fettuccine I’ve ever had. Friendly staff, quick and efficient service. Pictured is the chicken fettuccine, Greek salad, chicken cannelloni and beef lasagne. Highly recommend.

Absolutely delicious pizza! My colleague and I popped in here today for happy hour some great prices on both pizza and wine :) We were not disappointed the pizza was fantastic, we both had a glass of Chianti, sat in the back area and had amazing service. Everyone was super friendly. The place is warm and welcoming. Can’t wait to pop back and try the rest of the menu. Thank you Blitza! Jess, hospitality specialist Kakapo Business Sales

The manager tried to make the waitress charge me $13 for a cake we bought in for my son's birthday that we asked them to keep in the fridge and then bring out when we were ready. At no point did they inform us prior about any fee for their service. The two waiters on the other hand were very friendly and had great customer service.

Consistently great tasting food with exceptional service. We've been going to Blitza Pizza in Birkenhead for years because you get what you expect to get - a great meal!! PS: Regarding the comments below from this family, just one observation: they should be more respectful to both staff and other customers. Our dinner was ruined by their behaviour — it honestly felt like a herd of cattle storming into a paddock.

Disappointing Experience, Wouldn’t Recommend. I rarely leave bad reviews, but the food here was honestly terrible. I ordered the chicken parmigiana and it came out lukewarm, overly salty, and the chicken tasted like it had been reheated from the day before. My friend got the steak medium-rare, and it arrived well-done and dry. The vegetables were soggy, like they’d been sitting under a heat lamp for hours. Even the fries, which are usually hard to mess up, were limp and greasy. For the prices they charge, you’d expect fresh ingredients and some care in preparation, but this felt like cafeteria food at best. Definitely not worth the money. We ended up leaving most of it on the plate and grabbing something else afterward.

Very good food, at very reasonable prices, with professional and friendly service We also appreciated the small details, such as the artfully folded napkins, chilled cups, and heated plates. Will certainly be coming back.

Dined in, having been told the food here was good. It was not. The ambience and service were fine but the food awful. Ordered Onion Bhaji as a starter. What arrived was a ludicrously large portion which was all batter, no onion. The mains were poor imitations of the real thing. Tandoori roti served was dry Naan bread coated in butter.

Had dinner last night with family of 7. Food was amazing. Great customer service. Curries portions were good. Affordable prices. Free drinks given by owner. Overall great experience will come back again.
This is genuinely the best butter chicken in the whole of New Zealand.. I’ve tried so many other places and nothing compares to Sagar. 10000/10
I had the butter chicken and it was tasteless, and seemed watered down. I phoned the restaurant and down and they were very disinterested. Won’t be going back unfortunately.
We came around 1 pm and I had a great time with my husband. The food tasted really good and we definitely would come back and bring some friends over.

Cozy local pub with surprisingly good food! I wasn’t expecting much at first, but ended up really enjoying the meal. The highlight for me was their Pina Colada – creamy and refreshing. Must try you will be surprise.It is one of the best I’ve had in a long time! Friendly staff and relaxed atmosphere. Great spot to chill if you’re in the area.

Super cute bar that feels like you’re walking into someone’s fancy living room dinner soirée. The chefs and staff and so accommodating, patient and sweet. There is always a server nearby if you need something and they always have a smile on their faces😇 would recommend for a casual or tasteful night out. Thanks everybody at Good Home

Terrible service, over priced & everything stunk of fish. With a reservation, waited 20-30 minutes & had to ask 2 different staff just to get our orders taken. $18 for a few lettuce leaves (“wedges”) & a tiny bit of sauce. Beef pasta smelt & tasted like fish, we couldn’t eat it. Had a birthday cake in their fridge - again waited 20 minutes & had to ask 3 different staff to get it, just for it to come out also smelling like fish. Nice spot for a beer but we’d never go back for dinner.
Great job team! Today we had a steak, cooked perfectly, girls are always super welcoming and a smile! You made this place beautiful! Thanks Charlie and Anna! You are superstars ⭐️

First time trying Thai food as a Canadian in New Zealand. It was highly recommended you me by a local here as 'the best place for Thai food in Auckland'. Overall the food was good and they were able to accommodate to my spice levels (haha). I ordered the beef black garlic, chicken pineapple fried rice, tofu drunken noodles, and shrimp red Thai curry with a side of rice (at an additional cost of $2 NZD), to try to get a variety of food. My favorite was the drunken noodles, which was a very Thai classic mix of spicy, salty, sweet, and sour. I found the red Thai curry a bit too runny and watered down for my liking, but it was very flavorful otherwise. Overall, I would go back again when I'm craving some Thai food! PS: Parking is quiet limited at this location.

I was recommended this place! OMG its true!! Best pad thai ever! I can't explain how or why just try it. Trust me!! I'll be back definitely and I'm going to pass the word around!! Thanks guys!! Keep doing what you're doing! A+ highly-rated and highly recommended!!

Vegan friendly if you ask. Would be nice to see some vegetarian and vegan options on their menu though. Meal was delicious. Good range of veges and well balanced flavours. I had the green curry with tofu, served Thai hot ('Pet!').

Had food from here a few times previously and it was good. Tonight ordered 3 dishes and all of them were watery and tasteless. If I was eating in and would send this back. Actually tempted to drive back and request money back.

The best Thai food we have ever had! We have ordered off Uber eats the Pad Thai, Thai red curry and spring rolls multiple times and it has been just as delicious as the first. You can tell this is made with love and this is definitely my top #3 favorite places to eat.

Another fantastic Cantonese cuisine in NZ. Lobster with shallot and spring onion is so yummy!!Sweet sour pork is the best in town! Great portions and reasonable price range! Good vibes! Great services as well as plenty of staff around the restaurant for service.

I'm not usually one to five bad reviews but...... The food was alright the 扬州草饭( Yan Zhou Fried Rice) and the 咕噜肉 were the only good foods. We ordered 海鲜豆腐包(Fish and Tofu Stewed) was so wet (especially the fish) the tofu was alr. We also ordered (屁啊爬豆腐) Looks like Fried bollocks and tastes disgustingly greasy, looks even worse than it tastes. We waited 2 whole as hours to get our food. People after us were receiving all their food minutes after they arrived. They also had 2 people on front of house and 2 people in the kitchen during dinner service on mother's day..... The restraunt was not just horrible, slow, unorganized and unaware of our order, but it also expensive as hell. What a way to end a mothers day Last time ever coming here, I hope they hire more staff for the front of house and ESPECIALLY the kitchen WITH 1 CHEF On the bright side the service was good, waiters were nice and kind.
Wasn't supposed to go to this place for lunch but we did anyways, and I was pleasantly surprised. The food is very good and the service fantastic. The servings generous to justify the price .

This restaurant truly impressed me with its **excellent value for money** and **generous portions**—a rare combination in today's dining scene. The **silky-smooth rice noodle rolls (cheung fun)** and **juicy, perfectly textured siu mai** are absolute highlights But the surprises don't stop there! Their **Peking duck two-way preparation** deserves special mention: **crispy skin** **succulent, flavorful meat**. The creative pairing with **stir-fried shredded duck and bean sprouts** adds wonderful texture contrast. Other standout dishes include: - **Yu Xiang eggplant clay pot**: A masterful balance of spicy, sweet and savory notes - **Seafood tofu hotpot**: Creamy tofu swimming in an umami-rich broth - **Golden-fried shrimp balls**: Crispy exterior giving way to bouncy, fresh shrimp filling What truly sets this establishment apart is its **skillful execution of both regional Chinese cuisines**—from Cantonese classics to Northern specialties. Every dish showcases **quality ingredients** and **traditional cooking techniques**, yet remains accessible through **reasonable pricing**. Perfect for family gatherings or casual dining, this is the kind of place that keeps you coming back to explore more of the menu. Already planning my next visit to try their other dim sum varieties!

My new fav yum char and i have been to loads of top ones in Auckland. Such great flavour, choose from menu and they cook to order so its super fresh and hot. Its in an old building with great views over the city. It's definitely a great spot for a bunch of people to yum char together.

Absolutely delicious epic burgers! We got takeaways, as there's only a small amount of seating in the store. The atmosphere doesn't really matter a whole lot, because the food was absolutely on point. I wish we had one of these local to where we live, because I wouldn't even bother with other burger joints. The burgers are generous in size, delicious, and taste like actual meat/food! Not ultra processed, not overly salty, not sugary, like other chain brand burger stores. The sides were perfect too. Highly recommend! Would absolutely love one out West! My husband is a burger lover and he was not disappointed. Keep up the good work, making delicious, good honest food. Yum!

Top notch burger. I had the Three Fat Pigs. Great flavour with the various pork elements. My photo doesn't really do it justice. The chips were OK, probably 3/5, nothing too special. $29 for burger, chips and drink. On the high side, but it was a more expensive burger choice, so it could've been cheaper with other. Not great for dining in, clearly setup more with takeaway in mind. Overall, a great burger, and solid all round experience, so I'll definitely be back.

I recently tried their burgers and it was seriously the best I had so far Taste: The patty was juicy and full of flavor — cooked perfectly to a nice medium. The seasoning was spot-on, and the melted cheese added a rich, creamy bite. The fresh lettuce, tomato, and pickles gave it a nice crunch and balance. Bun: Soft yet sturdy! It held everything together without getting soggy, and it had a light toast which added a nice texture. Extras: I added bacon and onion rings — no regrets. The smoky crunch from the bacon took it to the next level. Fries & Sides: The fries were golden, crispy, and not too salty. A great companion to the burger. Service & Atmosphere: Friendly staff, quick service, and a clean, relaxed environment. I’d definitely go back.

I LOVE THEIR ONION RINGS AND HAVE FOR SO MANY YEARS NOW. So glad they are still open. Great burgers, some choices have a very creative combination of ingredients. Always fresh if you pick it up yourself. I've never had a hot uber eats order come through, though. The value family meal was perfect for a pregnant me and my hungry as partner. They made sure my cheeseburger with an egg added was well cooked and had no mayo on it (I can't eat anything raw at the moment). It was the first time we had the loaded fries, the meat on the fries was SO TASTEY.. I would definitely order that again. The place was filled with smoke when we walked in, they forgot to turn on the extraction fan. It's just a small shop but it would do well with an upgrade to the atmosphere, especially since the burgers are so awesome, the shop should match!

Ordered on Door dash. Quality did not disappoint. Was probably the best burger I’ve ever had. I got the Slap It on Burger. Only critique would be to have the choice of one beef Pattie instead of two, as I feel two lessen the taste.

We went there for dinner last month on a weekday, tried to order chicken but was surprised to learnt they don't have chicken or porkchop available. The food quality was so so. Lack of communication between kitchen and floor team, that caused some hiccups when they served the food. It was a strange and awkward experience.
Always delicious and authentic. Can be super busy so book in advance

Delicious food, but can be busy. Sweet n sour pork was awesome, peking duck and prawn stir fry was spot on. Staff were helpful. Decor requires a refresh as its lacking the authentic Chinese vibe, very tired but the food speaks for itself. Birkenhead parking is a challenge as there's not much parking out front.

It started off with the Peking duck. Flavour was OK but the skin wasn't 'crispy' and can see hair/feather on it. The cut was too thick with too much meat. Then came the Claypot bean curd.... found a bandaid in it. 😬 but not after eating a few pieces of the bean curd. Lost my appetite. Lady boss was apologetic and offered to take away the cost with 20% discount. Fish was under cooked. Garlic pork rib was a bit tasteless. Blackbeans round beans was OK but not great. Overall wasn't a good experience for me.
A quick place to have Cantonese cuisine at Birkenhead. Can be better if the food amount is enhanced a bit. Just one thing to bear in mind, if you can't enjoy salty food, think twice before you go.

Really disappointing experience, I usually go to the Noodle Canteen in Windsor Park and it is much better there. Considering the Birkenhead branch is more expensive you would expect the same or better quality but that’s not the case unfortunately. I ordered the same thing I usually do (#32) and it was really not good, I have had to leave it as I don’t even want to eat it. The chicken is chewy and the coating is not crispy at all, the rice is goopy as opposed to being like fried rice and there’s next to no vegetables in the rice. Really wish I had just gone to my usual one.

Quality not the same as it was a few years back. Food has gone expensive but the quality has gone down, missing basic flavour and you can tell the ingredients used aren’t fresh. Very disappointing unfortunately.
Highly recommend Noodle Canteen in Birkenhead. Best sweat & sour pork iv had. Good portion, perfect balance of sweetness and tang, on a bed of stir-fry style rice.

we were hungry and we wanted some quick soup around Birkenhead and we found this shop..very clean, many options of Asian soups, fresh vegetables, cooked right after you order and serve hot..only that the food is small portion for a 11.50 dumpling soup, few pieces of small slice carrots (you can count)..hope you serve more veggies, but overall the soup is tasty.
So much to choose from, always yummy as! Thank you for another scrumptious dinner A+
