Owned by two old couple, if you want a home-style, comfort meal, you will like Pine House. You won’t get restaurant level service, be kind to the owners! We ordered the Galbi ribs, seafood pancake and the rice cake kimchi soup, bibimbap. Galbitang for takeaway. The servings were generous, the complimentary side dishes were diverse. Food taste is above average. Well seasoned and Ajuma pumps it out pretty quick. They took care with takeaway, packing some side dishes and rice with the soup. Highly recommend.
Absolutely beautiful food. Really fair prices. The BBQ beef and kimchi fried rice was so good, we will be back to try more of the menu.

Edited rating as 4 years ago I had noted a less than favourable meal but tonight was much better food wise. Great variety and tastiness of the banchan which I did like last time, but I think the apple and pineapple sweet and sour pork was not only good but a generous sharing portion. The corn pancakes were also significantly large, chunky, and easily enough to share and take home. Wife liked her beef rib soup. The faded photos and old, smokey yellow walls still don't make you feel like you want to hang around, but the food made up for it today.

My first (and definitely not my last) Korean Cuisine dining experience at Pine House Korean Restaurant, Mokaia Rd, Birkenhead. The menu was vast with so many share options we decided to hit several mains and a couple of entrees. Price was excellent and so was the food, very happy crew of 5 celebrating one of the teams birthdays! Keen to revisit with an even more bigger crew! Awesome service and authentic atmosphere.

Passing by after attending a business meeting. Decided to give it a try. Second day Auckland under red traffic light. No one dine in the restaurant. Very quiet. Decided to do takeaway as well. Acceptable food. Not fancy. Place look old and need some improvement. Operate by two old couples. Friendly. I think some restaurants need time to recover from the COVID outbreak.

First time coming since new menu and prices went up. I’m currently finishing cooking the fish at home as the batter is very thick and undercooked, and chips are chewy. Very disappointing given prices have gone up. Hope things improve on the fryer for next time.
Very good food, generous serving- good value for money.

Personally I think a lot of these reviews are false. I live in the area the last 3 years use them almost weekly, have never had a bad meal!!! seems like there are a lot of trolls out here everywhere!!!!! I get weird reviews on my Google pg.. that are complete crap and I've never seen the people in my life, so read reviews but take it all with a Grain of salt, until you've had your own experience of their food. I'm on my way there now.

Local and our First time trying as our usual Sunma Takeways (amazing) was shut. Below average food. Chips were soggy and no salt. Honey chicken didn't have a hint of Honey, tasted like chicken wrapped in wet flour. Extremely disappointed to say the least.
They're not in a rush, but they make great food at a decent price :) They also let me bank transfer the cost as they dont do paywave. Lemon chicken on fried rice, fed 2 of us for $18.50 - delicious!

Formal Complaint Regarding Poor Service and Incorrect Order Fulfillment I am writing to express my dissatisfaction with the service I received at your KFC Birkenhead on both Tuesday, February 4th, and today, February 5th. I had an unpleasant experience which I feel requires immediate attention and resolution. On Tuesday, I went through the drive-thru and ordered potato gravy, which I was charged for but did not receive. I called the store to address the issue, and I was assured that the matter would be resolved. The staff member who spoke to me, noted my name and phone number, and promised to provide a Lage-sized potato gravy and a snack burger as compensation during my next visit. I confirmed that I only wanted the regular-sized potato gravy and snack burger, which was agreed to. However, when I returned today, February 5th, to pick up my order, I asked to have supercharged sauce added to the snack burger. To my surprise, the sauce was applied in the smallest quantity — just a drop, and it was not spread evenly, which made the meal far less enjoyable than expected. I called the store to express my concerns, and I was connected with a staff member named Aashish, who had previously served me. When I explained the situation and mentioned that the supercharged sauce had been poorly applied, Aashish showed no remorse or willingness to correct the issue. Instead of offering an apology or a solution, he simply told me to lodge my complaint online. I find this response unprofessional and unsatisfactory. If the supercharged sauce would have incurred an additional cost, I would have been happy to pay the difference. However, the lack of care and poor service I experienced does not align with the standards I expect from KFC. I would appreciate it if you could look into this matter and take appropriate action to ensure this type of issue does not occur again to any other customers.

KFC Birkenhead Review I had a great experience at KFC Birkenhead! The service was excellent—friendly, fast, and efficient. The staff was welcoming and made sure my order was accurate and served fresh. The chicken was crispy, juicy, and full of flavor, just as expected from KFC. The restaurant was clean, and the overall atmosphere was pleasant. Whether you’re grabbing a quick meal or dining in, this location does a great job of maintaining quality and service. Definitely one of the better KFC spots around! Rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (5/5)

New building which is extremely user friendly, carpark, drive 🚗 thru and dine In available. Friendly staff especially lady On drive thru . Would recommend. Entrance is only on Highbury bypass use Same entrance as Highbury mall.

The food can often be fresh and delicious, but this is not consistent. Same with the food preparation time. This store has somehow created a terribly inefficient operational flow such that it feels bad and creates additional hurdles to deal with. It's overcomplicated a simple concept and bloated it with costs. Often if I place an order online and then go to collect I have to track down a staff member ( they don't attend to customers who come to the desk ) and then often they have not started to prepare the order yet. They have introduced a system which is terribly counter intuitive.
Worst ever customer service experience. Made an online app order. Rude and lazy staff. Meat was still raw and not cooked properly.

Went here for dinner and got their butter chicken. Honestly someone needs to give their chef a little kiss on the head and a raise because OH MY GOD WAS IT GOOD!!! The best butter chicken we have EVER had. The garlic Naan we got with it was incredible too, there was a liberal amount of garlic on dat thang and it was chunky and beautiful. 5/7, better than toy story 2. The staff we talked to was lovely and very friendly, made the whole thing smooth, easy, and really pleasant. Super welcoming and generally just a great feel to the place. Trust, you can smell it from a street away and it's heaven. We will be adding a trip here to our monthly budget but will think about it constantly until then.

Bland lamb Rogan Josh with dry lamb and not spicy at all. Onion bhaji was soggy, not at all crunchy. Roti was thick and felt like cardboard. Edit: Picture now attached with the review, since the owner insists that it's fake.

First thing First , This is based on butter chicken I have tried several restaurant in Glenfield , Northcote and nearby. I think your butter chicken is way too sweet. I am not an Indian so I cannot justify if this taste is meant to be authentic taste but again it is too sweet in comparison with other nearby restaurants I have been .... The portion of food and the price are reasonable by the way.

I’ve frequented Curry Master both dine in and take away for several years now. The service is friendly and quaint, however it’s the flavour and uniqueness of each dish has always been the drive behind our return. With a pallet for hot/spicy food, personal favourites are the Palak Paneer , Chicken Malabari, Lamb Kadhai and the Chicken Tikka Masala. If you’re looking to get out of the comfort of the NZ standard butter chicken or chicken korma, I’d highly recommend giving Curry Master a go. Thanks for the consistency over the years team 🤙🏽
Absolutely lovely experience here! The staff are extremely friendly are attentive - food tastes good and is great value for money, I am new to the area so definitely found my new local spot!

I have the Pie, and I've never been happier, The pie, chicken has a really nice pastry, the gravy could win awards and the vegetables were very generous. The Service is great and this is a really pleasing and pleasant venue with great knowledgeable staff.
Our favourite local! We’ve started visiting a couple times a week now as we love the friendly environment and amazing food and drinks. I’d highly recommend visiting you’ll become a regular too! ☺️

Such a great pub! Sunday roast is excellent, perfectly cooked and very big portions! Beers are the best around and the team are friendly, knowledgeable and very welcoming. Family friendly and highly recommended, we’ll be back! 🍻🍻

Wow thank you guys for making our day so special. We enjoyed a lot me and my husband had lot of food and craft beer. amazing service and staffs are excellent no doubt. Well done this place and it’s atmosphere simply breathtaking

We had a party of 10 plus one friendly well behaved dog. The service and food was excellent and all thoroughly enjoyed the experience and atmosphere. Totally recommend this restaurant especially for the very friendly service. Even the other dogs were well behaved.

Used to go to this Pita all the time but lately they have been messing up every order. I normally order online for pickup and when I get to the store on my pick up time they haven’t even started making my order and are all sitting in the back. My latest order they put all the wrong and some missing ingredients into my flat grill - they also gave it to me all cut up which isn’t how they normally serve it. The wedges are never cooked properly and half raw. These employees need proper training.
Ordered 2 CHICKEN Caesar pitas. I received 2 pitas with carrots and corn. Meat and other vegetables almost nonexistent.

Tried to give this place the benefit of the doubt when seeing the recent reviews....Please dont make the same mistake I did. Not only were the staff rude , they got my order completely wrong , made me wait a very long time, and I ended up throwing it out because they STILL got it wrong . Avoid this place to save your anger and frustration .

Walked into Pita Pit Onewa Road. There are flies all through the salads, she prepared our salad bowel and 2 flies landed on it. I asked for a refund, the ladies were really lovely. But wouldn’t recommend unless flies are your vibe.

Paid $33 for loaded Wedges and an eggd burger. Waited half an hour for it even though I was only one in store. Wedges soggy and minimal cheese. No sauce even though I was asked what sauce I wanted. Will not be returning

My partner and I had an amazing time at Abruzzo! We ordered the “Abruzzo Pizza” & a cheeky Peroni (best combo), and it was absolutely fantastic! perfectly cooked and bursting with flavor. If you're a fan of blue cheese, this pizza is a must-try! The customer service was top-notch—10/10. You can really feel the passion they have for both their food and providing exceptional service. More reason to come back ;) Another highlight was watching the pizza being made and cooked in the wood-fired oven. Who doesn't love a good wood-fired pizza?! The whole experience was a perfect blend of great food and friendly service. Highly recommend it!
Delicious. Would go back just for the desserts. Very friendly attentive staff.

Had a wonderful Sunday night just my partner and me in a cozy, quiet setting. The homemade pasta was the best I’ve ever tasted. I had the 4 cheese gnocchi. It was creamy, cheesy, and bursting with flavor (photo: This might not be to everyone's taste, but I love my pasta with lots of sauce, so this was perfect). My partner had a chicken cooked in a delicious marsala sauce that was pure comfort on a plate. The staff were incredibly kind and welcoming. Highly recommend!

the spaghetti bolognese - mince was in huge chunks may as well of been spaghetti and meatballs so quite disappointing - sauce was lovely in taste. I’ve been here before and ordered the bolognese and they have made it properly- slow cooked mince in bolognese sauce where it melts in your mouth The calamari - main dish is about the same size as the entree with a lot more greens, calamari was luke warm when placed on table but batter was nice and tasteful. For $29.00 you’d want to feel that was money worth spending. Maybe this was a one off but I’m hoping they take their feedback well and apply to their service and food.

The family and I enjoyed another lovely meal at Abruzzo last night. We were warmly welcomed, seated immediately, received just the right level of service throughout the meal. All four dishes were hot, tasty and the perfect size. The restaurant was almost full, which was a nice surprise for a Tuesday night. Really nice family atmosphere. Thanks team for another great meal.

I visited here for the first time. The staff was very friendly and kind, which made me feel comfortable! I had a mushroom pizza. He heated it up after I ordered, which made it taste even better. The store was also clean! I’d love to come back again. Thank you so much!

Got the pepperoni rolls and they were full of salami and salty! Needed a balance like sauce or something sweet. It’s $3 for ketchup when asked which was so ridiculous so has the salty roll. They do have cheese, chilli flakes and herbs on the table which was handy for us! No toilet on site but it is just within the shopping center area.

TERRIBLE TERRIBLE TERRIBLE DONT WASTE YOUR TIME THEY WILL JUST GIVE YOU COLD LEFTOVERS !!! The pizza was hard like cardboard, dry chewy and absolutely cold! You can tell they literally grabbed the cold cardboard pizza straight from their display and chucked it into a box . How can you tell you may be wondering???? Well look at the box!! Moved the pizza to the side as evidence there is no pizza oil residue / cheese stickiness that a freshly made sals pizza leaves OR ANY PIZZA IN FACT!

We had a great experience 2 weeks ago when we went and ordered pizza and sides, the service was great the pizza was so yummy and so we decided to have it again today. Today's experience was completely different the service and timing was bad, the pizza was burnt and pretty much cold when we got it home.

There was a lovely chap called Luke, who gave us an amazing authentic Sal’s pizza experience, not only did he help us when we needed extra condiments, he was extremely friendly and helpful. He made me happy and made me and the party of people I was with smile. We left the store satisfied and glad. Luke was the true carry of the team, with his looks, voice and hospitality.

We ordered the puzza due to the “Wednesday “ free Garlic Bread, and upon pickup we were told that it hasn’t come through. I explained that I had ordered due to the garlic bread and the email hasn’t come through yet, and if the store person can help us - the person at the store outright refused to assist me and said he cannot do anything and we will have to order it again. Moreover, the pizza was soggy and watery, the cheese was bad and overall the flavour was not good. Their wedges were decent, but overall not worth it. Never ordering again
Paid $25 for a pizza just for there to be pieces with no sauce, cheese, or toppings. We come here somewhat frequently and the standard has been dropping recently. Pretty disappointed.
Very small little Place..pizza was good
Did not get corn nuggets. When spending over $25 on Wednesdays you are supposed to get free corn nuggets. I asked the guy in store for the corn nuggets and he told me no. What a joke....
Pizza did not come with sauce that was ordered. Indian guy was pretty rude tbh.
Prompt service and yummmm
The girl who serves always seems to be angry, it is not nice to go where they look at you badly and do not want to serve you.
I absolutely love the food here, and the staff is fantastic. It's now one of my go-to spots for a satisfying meal.
Delicious food!! Super friendly staff. Tried the Milano and was sooo good, 100% recommended!
Delicious and very generous portion! Can't recommend enough

Been here at night after 10pm most of the time. I have found this branch always prep things fresh to order (Fries for example) , unlike another one at Sunnybrae !. To me, waiting for your food to be fresh finished is much better than a quick terrible one. I am not sure if I just have got a random good meals here , hope this is a standard here. By the way, the custard and Choc pie is way better than the previous pie, I also recommend to stop selling the apple pie; its smell is so artificial 😅

Ordered a Filet-O-Fish from Birkenhead McDonald’s on Thursday, March 13, 4pm and was really disappointed. The cheese slice was only half the usual size, making the sandwich feel incomplete. The tartar sauce was sloppily applied, and overall, the presentation was lazy. For the price, I expected better quality control. McDonald’s, please do better—this felt like a rushed, careless assembly.
Everything was very clean, the service was fast, and the staff were very kind

Four eyes blondie that’s supposedly the manager needs to be fired. Worst customer service towards customers it’s not the first time she’s treated us with disrespect. We let the first time slide but tonight she pulled the last straw. Told her we were going to lay a complaint and she says in her own words that ‘she doesn’t care’ I feel bad for the employees that have to put up with her. Absolutely pathetic.

Came here for the $10 meal which is only available certain day only specifically for the Big Mac to then be told “sorry we out of Big Macs?? That is something you should say at the very start before we redeemed our codes so we could’ve went somewhere else! Also the lady serving and handing us the food completely ignored me when I asked her a question. Absolutely disgusting!

It was so delicious, the staff was super friendly, and the ingredients were really fresh! The prices were also very reasonable, which made it perfect for our kids’ birthday meal pack. We also ordered the Korean fried chicken separately—it was incredibly fresh and absolutely delicious!”

Great value, friendly neighbourhood sushi with relaxed small seating area. I enjoyed my options with a pot of hot green tea for $3 :) 🫖 salmon was fresh. Roll sushi is about $1.8 - 2 and fancier options for around $2.2 - 3. They also have donburi options.

I just felt like reviewing because I’m so grateful to live close to such a well respected sushi place. The taste is divine, the size is just right and fairly generous. If you come to eat here you will not be disappointed. It’s run by a lovely woman who is so welcoming and friendly. Whenever I order of delivery apps the sushi still comes perfect! Thanks for being awesome guys! I wish you loads of success and thanks again for making such wonderful sushi!
One of the best katsu bento boxes I've ever had was absolutely delicious. Very fresh and tasty. Misu was delicious. Wi be back.

Alright everybody, in my opinion, this is the best sushi in Auckland. I’ve been going there every week, and the sushi is always super fresh and delicious. Honestly, I’ve tried lots of sushi spots around Auckland, but this one is hands down the BEST in the city.

We paid $38 for two of us. We had the four taco combo at $26, added sour cream and avacado to 2 and just avacado to the other two for an extra $4, and had cheesie fries at $8. The menu is simple and uncomplicated. Free filtered water on tap. Tasty and affordable. Premises clean and tidy. Great to have this food place in the Birkenhead village. ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️
I bought four tacos and they were really good. The people working there were nice and friendly. I would go again.

4th time buying tacos. 2 times in Mt Albert. Food was great.. Quality good and a good mix of ingredients. They had massive lines when they first opened. Tried the new stored that opened up in Birkenhead yesterday. What a joke. Brought 6 supreme tacos and all I got was tacos full of meat. If this is what they are gonna be serving from now on I sure as hell won't be back. The avocado and sour cream costs extra 🤣 Like they just dunked a knife in a wiped it on the taco. Dissapointed to say the least. All that hype faded away pretty quickly.

I had the BEST service by a young woman here. I didn’t get her name but she was tall and had short black hair and piercings. Really made sure I had a good time and was so helpful with all my food allergies. Would definitely come back!

I am not a foodie as im always scared to pay for food that I might not like as it has happened before. HOWEVER when I tried Broke Boy tacos it was like a food org*sm honestly. They just melt, taste so damn good, hit every spot and my soul. When I get a cheat meal it is always BB TACOS!!!!!

Definitely not a fan of the smashed burger. We were looking for the best cheese burger in town and I guess this was the closest. It tasted like the life was sucked out of it. Too salty. Too flat. No flavour. Not good value for money. I have read good reviews of other items on the menu so will try that sometime soon. Restaurant is nice and clean with plenty of natural light.

I come here all the time and each time they have been consistently great. Which i feel is a rare experience with burger places nowadays. 100% recommend Food: great balance of crispiness and juiciness, great flavour Service: Friendly, helpful

*HONEST R3V13W* Just pulled up quiet late looking for somewhere to eat ...stopped by here the other night , my 1st time ever. Oh my goodness! The fantastic service at the counter through to receiving my food, just wow! The burgers were very tasty and delicious 😋.. Check out the pic I took. They are huge! I couldn't finish the whole thing! Totally recommend this awesome place to you!! Get over there and go hard! Thank you to them, chefs . As Arnold Schwarzenegger says ,"I'LL BE BACK!"
High recommended, this business doesn’t surcharge. 100% would go back. Really good chicken burger, good flavour, fries tasted good, would definately go back.

Order: double real combo. Burguer: the beef paddy was crispy on the borders but tastefull on the middle. Well seasoned. Vegetable ratio was very good and non of the veggies overpowered the overall flavour. Sauce was enough to taste without it being the center of attention. Bun was toasted perfectly, and it kept is form with each bite. Service: very nice no complaint. Armoshpere: its good. Clean and organized.

One of my favorite spots for breakfast or lunch! Their pies and sandwiches are always fresh and delicious. I stop by regularly for a quick bite. The prices are very reasonable, and the service is consistently friendly and efficient. Highly recommend!

If I have to explain to your staff regarding my "Paywave security". For example, if I use my corporate-standard phone to make payment using Paywave, I need to enter my "8 digit pin number". If the staff don't understand why I need to enter my pin and was rude to me because of my security procedures. Don't go crying to our community if you get hacked!!! I'll shop somewhere else!

Great fresh food! after trying different options from pies to muffins, I'm very pleased with the quality of food and prices, they're very convenient compared to other more expensive options in the area. Staff are really nice and willing to help you 🎉
Very good service and Pie very yummy Fried Chicken and chip they make fresh and good price and Sandwiches as well
Visited here today to pick up some pies and Sammie’s for lunch. 10/10 and well priced! Definitely recommend. Staff very friendly too ☺️

I had delivery service. Had a friendly note on the lid of my food and it felt really nice to be acknowledged with gratitude. The food was sensational 😋 I really loved all the flavors and cooked to perfection. Thank you so much VN Express I wanted to ring and tell you and you don't have a number online. Robyn from Woodside Ave.
The Pho Soup is absolutely delicious
A little Vietnamese place for lunch awesome food 5 stars

If you're local or nearby, this cozy little Vietnamese restaurant is definitely worth a visit. It’s small but super accommodating, with charming decor and lovely, friendly staff. 😊 We ordered the Saving Combo — Pho (Beef Noodles) and Fresh Rolls — and added some Lemongrass Chicken. Everything was incredibly fresh and flavorful. Perfect option for two people to share! ✌️ Highly recommend!😋

I'm a person who rarely gives 5 star on a review but I found this place by pure chance while walking around lunchtime and looking for places to eat. We order Beef pho+spring rolls combo, bahn mi and salted coffee. Got the pork and prawn spring rolls and to be honest it was nice but nothing extraordinary so dont get your hopes up. Bahn mi was quite bigger than i expected and had lots of fillings and it tasted quite good 👍 Salted coffee was also quite nice but i can see some people wont like it due to salty flavor. Now my favourite, pho. This was AMAZING. broth was so good we drank it all literally emptied the bowl. I would say this is one of the nicest pho i had in northshore area so i would recommend pho if you come here. And i just want to point out while i was reading some old 1star reviews left by other customers. I can guarantee you that you dont need to listen to some of them because they are talking nonsense. The customer service is amazing, the ladies who were working there were kind to us. The only downside is this place is quite small if you compare it to other restaurants. And there are no toilets available. The water and bowl and cutlery and napkins are self service so thats not a big deal. Overall, I will come back again soon 😄

Love the pho/noodle, the decor and the welcoming owner/staff. We’ve been here a few times, always order the same, because they are so good :) I like codo noodle, it is very different from the pho you got from other viet restaurant. It is located right next to the bus stop, everytime daughter always say she’s craving for pho because it smells so good!
It's a little gem in the middle of Birkenhead village. Lovely design and atmosphere and delicious food that tasted very authentic to me. I loved pho and traditional ice coffee.
Our family’s favorite Vietnamese restaurant! We absolutely love their pho 💯 Got takeaway tonight and found a lovely little note inside. Such a sweet touch! ❤️

Had butter chicken here and it was honestly really good – super creamy and full of flavour without being too heavy. The owner was a really nice guy too, gave us some extra rice and a couple of extra dishes for free which was a cool surprise. You don’t get that kind of service everywhere these days. Would definitely come back.

The butter chicken was rich, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. The naan bread was soft and fresh—great for scooping up the sauce. KAAF Indian Cuisine really delivers on quality and taste. Highly recommend!

We tried the Chicken Masala this time round and it was very tasty indeed. An a very good portion size for two adults, indeed. We would highly recommend trying there Indian takeaways, you won’t be disappointed 😋🍽️

One of the best places to eat Indian food in Hillcrest, North Shore, Auckland. I had a Kaaf Indian Cuisine Special curry, it was awesome. The good thing about this place, is that the pieces of chicken are from the breast, real tender and big. Not like other places where they put you even pieces with some bones on it. The curry was really creamy and tasty. The owner was generous and offered me a little treat for free as a courtesy. Amazing place with amazing food. Definitely I will go back soon.

I had a fantastic experience at Kaaf Indian Cuisine! The butter chicken was absolutely delicious—creamy, flavorful, and perfectly balanced. The owner was incredibly friendly and down-to-earth, making us feel welcome from the moment we walked in. The service was great, and the atmosphere was warm and inviting. If you're looking for authentic Indian food with excellent customer service, this is the place to go. Highly recommend!

Please just try ‘mandu’ at this place! Fillings are just so well made. Sweet black bean paste is exceptional! But, meat and noodle one is also sooooooo good! Gotta have them both, when you’re there!! I live in south part of AKL. But, I drive all the way up there just for these!!! Should try them out especially like in these chilly days~👍👍👍💯

Located in taiping supermarket, all about mandu sells very tasty steamed buns among other things. The red bean bun as well as the one with meat are so soft and they do not skimp out on the fillings!! Want to go back to try their other stuff on the menu. The worker was so nice and friendly too. 팥찐빵이랑 만두찐빵 둘 다 정말 부드럽고 쫄깃하고 맛있어요.
Super friendly staff and delicious food. Highly recommended :)

Mandu, soboro, red bean steamed bun, and sweet and sour chicken. Everything was delicious and I didn't regret anything. The red bean paste was made in-house, so it was full and not too sweet, and very tasty. I could really taste the red bean flavor, and the dumplings were made with steamed bun skin, so I didn't expect much, but they were really, really delicious. It reminded me of the memories of eating them in the middle of winter in Korea while blowing on the wind. The soboro and sweet and sour chicken were also delicious. The price for this taste is crazy. I highly recommend it~!

I ate soboro bread, red bean steamed bread, and a hot dog, and it was really delicious~ All of them were filling, and the various textures of the soboro made it a delight to the mouth. I don't like steamed red bean buns sold elsewhere because they have a lot of crumbly parts, but this steamed red bean bun was delicious. Above all, the price is reasonable ^^ The staff are also very friendly. The name of the store is Daebak Dumplings, but I didn’t eat the dumplings haha. Next is dumplings. I hope you have great success~

Great restaurant, great service. I had the spicy Korean fried chicken ($34). The food was average. After traveling to South Korea and having some amazing fried chicken, I always use Kyochon as a baseline. Unfortunately Lok Green’s fried chicken falls below this baseline. The sauce was tasty …but not spicy. The chicken was dry, a little chewy and lacked that crispy fried crunch. It was more a $15 dish than a $34 dish. The waitresses were very friendly and the service was great.

We came specifically for the beef tartare and it was really good. The mini self bbqs were great, good quality meat used. although next time I want to try more of the korean dishes and soups. It is a bit expensive but is reflected in the quality. Free refillable sides too Service is friendly and efficient.

The restaurant is beautiful and welcoming. I've ordered the beef bulgugi, which I've had so many times at different Korean restaurants and this wasn't the best I've had. The meat wasn't marinated properly and it was pretty tasteless. The side dishes were delicious and the service was absolutely superb.

We all five people were satisfied with their professional service, outstanding food presentation, good quality of food. Also we liked the atmosphere. We definitely going back for trying the others on the menu. We felt well treated.
Welcomed by the friendliest staff, really nice romantic atmosphere. Beautifully plated and delicious. Loved the iced sphere for my peach drink.

We stopped in around 6 to get some dinner. There wasn't much sushi premade, but we just told them what we wanted, and they made it for us and put it in the container we brought! Great customer service and it was delicious

They're always friendly and their sushi selection is yummy. It would be great if the selection available on their Uber Eats menu (which has a lot more variety) was also what's available in person - in person it's mostly chicken and salmon but there's a lot more to choose from online.
They make good sushi. Fresh, not dry. And it's very worth it the price.
Always great and fresh! I love the salmon rainbow platter, amazing value for money and delicious!
YUM! Just had the Salmon poke bowl. Delicious, fresh and generous size for the price. Definitely recommend! Yum yum yum.

They recently started a $5 steamed dishes. I tried a variety of options, we spent $35 for 7 dishes (total 8 dishes as they gave a free extra broccoli dish, 2 dishes came later hence why less in photo - for those detail oriented people) this was enough for 2 people (though we are small eaters). Very good value and tasty dishes. Some were a but spicy for me but for ones that like spicy food it's definitely worth a try. My favourites were the sliced pork belly and pumpkin. There were tofu pieces under the fish and chicken, I liked the tofu. Both these were spicy.

Hometown’s flavour. Sticky tofu is very nice if you know what it is back in china. We also ordered beef rice noodles same as what you could look for in Auckland. Sweet sour pork is a bit strange, just sweet and sweet. Good luck. We will come back soon.

We saw their lunch special and tried - we loved it! (2 meat on fried rice but no photo) Pics are from our 2nd, 3rd, 6th, ..th visit. We love our sweet and sour pork as you can tell, just a wee improvement would be making it a bit tender as it can be hard sometimes. Since we're regulars now, staff have been giving us complimentary sides which we very much appreciate! Solid Customer Service as well ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
What an awesome and hidden gem inside the Highbury mall. The lunchtime $5 selections per bamboo steamer is really good! Quick, convenient and yummy lunchtime bite.

Your Google Maps Information** ⭐1/5 I want to share a frustrating experience my party had at Mi Xiang Restaurant on today. We arrived at 8:00 PM, fully aware that your Google Maps listing states closing time as 8:30 PM. To our surprise, the staff informed us they were "already closed" because they needed to handle delivery orders. While we understand the demands of food delivery, this does not justify closing 30 minutes earlier than advertised. What truly upset us was the lack of accountability. If your actual closing time is 8:00 PM, it is your responsibility to update this information publicly. Driving all the way from 15 mins only to be turned away due to inaccurate business hours is both time-consuming and disrespectful to customers. I kindly urge you to either: 1. Adjust your Google Maps hours to reflect the **real closing time (8:00 PM)**, or 2. Honor the posted 8:30 PM schedule for dine-in customers. As a restaurant that prides itself on service, transparency should be a priority. I hope this feedback is taken seriously to prevent others from experiencing the same disappointment.

As a Mexican living in New Zealand, I’m pretty picky when it comes to Mexican food. But this place? It’s different. The flavors are so authentic, they actually made me think of my grandma’s cooking — and that’s not something I say lightly. It’s not just that the food tastes good — it tastes like home. You can tell the people behind it know what real Mexican food is supposed to be. The service is also great — friendly, fast, and warm, just like you'd hope. If you’re Mexican and miss home, or if you just want to try what real Mexican food tastes like, this place is 100% worth it.

We had a wonderful time dining at Provecho. The staff was so friendly, the atmosphere was relaxed, the decor was beautiful, the food arrived quickly, and it was delicious and filling. The Rumchata cocktail was great as well. We will definitely visit again.

The staff are so friendly and welcoming. Food came quickly and was absolutely delicious. We had the guacamole with corn chips and the birria beef tacos. They were both incredible. The guacamole is seasoned well and pairs great with the corn chips, not too oily or salty. The birria beef was so deep with flavour, along with the consome we basically drank it. The corn tortillas are great and everything is gluten free which is so inclusive and helpful. Everything is reasonably priced and absolutely worth it. Will definitely be back to try more of the menu!

Went here for dinner on a date. The food was great, and customer service was amazing. The staff were very entertaining and kept everyone happy. The place looked clean and tidy. The price was a little bit expensive.

Today I went for dinner for the first time with my husband and our 4 years old daughters. I was truly amazed by the place! It's spacious, the service was incredible, and the food was absolutely delicious! I 100% recommend it and would definitely come back to try more dishes from the menu. Congratulations on the excellent service and the amazing quality of the Mexican food.

An excellent meal. I had the Nash (chicken) and it was very good. A bit of spice, but not so much that it's overwhelming. The chicken was moist and tender. Not a very big portion of chicken, but good for the price. I had a combo, which was a good deal at $25. The chips were excellent. Up there with the best, which is great as some places overlook the importance of good chips. A standard can of drink, and also a dessert as well. So definitely good value. Overall, it was really good and I'll definitely be back.
This burger was sooooooooooooooooooooo good! Yummers! I did eat it already BUT just imagine there’s a burger and it’s real good. Prices are GREAT too! Orgasmic experience 11/10.

The portion size was impressive in both the chicken in the burger 🍔 and the chicken strips. Burger had a nice tasty sauce, bun was nice a soft, chicken crispy, balanced well with the coleslaw and pickles. The only negative critique was it tasted like old oil after taste, masked by the sauce, but sometimes you can take it coming through. The chicken strip, huge portion. Super impressed. But same with the oil taste, maybe need to change the fry oil. Otherwise nice tender succulent chicken strips, a sauce would have been good to semi mask the oil after taste ? Would give the beef burgers a try next time, maybe one more try for the chicken strips too!

This is my second try on Burger Geek. We ordered chicken and beef burgers; the portion was very generous, and they were tasty too. Fried chicken was tender and juicy. Beef patty was smashed pretty well. Everything else was aligned with sauce perfectly. Everything was balanced, not to mention bun was fresh and soft.

Heard a bit about this place and was pleasantly surprised. Halal option right on the menu and great kitchen system is brilliant and convenient. The open kitchen on to the food court is really cool too - adds to the vibe where you forget you're in a food court. Burgers were great the the bread was fresh and soft with the smashed patties done to a medium. Wouldn't mind a bit more crisp though but also might've made it drier. I'm a fan of mustard so the Krabby had a healthy dab of the good oil. The chicken burgers were good but were over shadowed by the beef burgers. Well done team. Definitely on the halal burger list.
One of the best delicious ramens!! Very fast service and the price is cheaper than other places!!

So glad they’re now on the Shore! I ordered the Special Shoyu Ramen and Gyoza. The soup had just the right amount of richness, the chashu was nice and tender, and it had kikurage (wood ear mushroom) – my favorite! The gyoza tasted just like homemade Japanese cooking and were packed with filling. The Spicy Miso Ramen was a bit too spicy for me, but my husband, who loves spicy food, really enjoyed it. The prices are very reasonable. We’ll definitely be back!

If there’s better ramen in New Zealand, I haven’t found it. And I’ve looked. Tucked away in Birkenhead, this little spot isn’t trying to impress you with neon signs or hype. It’s run by a couple from Yokohama the husband’s a trained ramen chef, and you can taste the years of obsession and craft in the bowel of Ramen which they made for me. He’s making the broth and noodles from scratch. No shortcuts. No frozen bags. Just honest, hard-earned flavour. The noodles? Fresh as hell springy, with that perfect chew that tells you someone still believes in craft. The broth? Deep, rich, almost dangerous. It doesn’t just warm you up it stays with you. Clings to your bones in the best way possible. Everything in the bowl feels deliberate. The kind of deliberate that only comes from love and repetition. One bite and I was back in Japan, hunched over a counter in a ramen bar I never wanted to leave. This place is a hidden gem but not for long. Get in while you still can. Because when word gets out, good luck finding a seat.
Popped in for lunch, and wow the Ramen is to die for. Best in Auckland. Will be back again soon.
The spicy miso ramen was delicious. The best I’ve had in Auckland. All side dishes were also good and the staff were very friendly. Definitely my new casual Japanese go to

Everything was extremely greasy, inedible and gave the whole family nausea. Fish was drenched in oil and the batter felt uncooked, fish wasn't that fresh and the blood wasn't cut out properly making it taste quite fishy. The staff was impatient and rude when I tried to ask any questions and left to serve other customers while we were still placing our order. Food came out quite fast, and I suspect that’s reason why they did such a poor job at cooking and preparing the ingredients. We did lots of research to find the “best fish and chips locally” however despite the overwhelming amount of recommendation we got on the internet and the 4.7 star google review this place is a total letdown.
Amazing friendly service, delicious food! Snapper was so fresh and cooked so nicely, good batter, not heavy and oily. Fav fish n chip shop on the shore
Awesome quality fresh fish. Perfect batter. Whenever I'm in the area I always stop in for fresh fish and the traditional fish n chips
Good fresh fishes. They also sell fish and chips. Good find.

A family member got trevally fillets today and the fish was old smelling, didn’t taste fresh. This isn’t the first time we’ve had this experience with fish fillets not tasting fresh from this place, with the same experience with trevally and kahawai previously. The staff are nice however.

Such good Mexican food, definitely a sleeper restaurant. My partner and I got the burritos (beef and veggie), and they were delicious. You can tell they’re made with care, and the flavours were spot on. They don’t skimp either, portion sizes were generous and the food was super filling. The owner was also really friendly and provided great, efficient service. Would definitely come back!

Great experience for our first time here. Customer service was excellent and the food even better. We got the beef nachos and chicken burrito and we were very satisfied. The food was very flavoursome and hit all the right spots. Flavoursome, generous amount of meat and cheese. Great portions, so great that we couldn’t finish the nachos and that’s coming from 2 Samoans (lol) Overall lovely experience.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Family-Friendly Gem in Birkenhead! We had lunch yesterday at Burrito House Birkenhead, and it was such a great experience! The food was absolutely delicious — fresh, generous portions, and full of authentic Mexican flavours. We tried the tacos, nachos, burrito, and sides — everything was tasty and beautifully presented. What I really loved was how kids-friendly the place is. The staff were welcoming and patient, and the relaxed atmosphere made it easy to enjoy our meal while the little ones felt comfortable. Highly recommend this spot for families or anyone craving good Mexican food in a cosy, welcoming setting!!

The food has improved immensely since it's transformation with the simplified menu. We ordered the chicken taco and beef quesadilla. Big generous portions, we had to take one of the quesadillas home. The sides like the rice, beans and salad are wasted on us, but will fill up a big eater I imagine. Great flavours (good balance of heat), fresh ingredients, crispy shell/tortilla. Hopefully with more business they can invest in the decor 😊 Price is based on 2 dishes and 2 beers approx $35 pp. Good value for the size of meals.

Absolutely the Best Mexican Food Ever! We visited this restaurant for our anniversary dinner, and it made our special day even better! The food was incredibly delicious—honestly, the best Mexican food I’ve ever had. I’ve tried nearly every Mexican restaurant and fast food chain in Auckland, but nothing compares to this. Every bite was bursting with flavor! A special shoutout to the owner (Ravi)—he was amazing! His friendly and attentive service made our visit even more enjoyable. 😊 We couldn’t stop talking about how incredible the food was while we were eating—it was that good! I couldn’t even finish my meal because the portions were so generous. Additionally, the pricing is very reasonable. This place has officially become my go-to for Mexican food. I highly, highly recommend it to everyone! 👍
Small place, easy for 2-4 peoples. The fried Kuey Teow are expertly seasoned, offering a harmonious blend of savory, aromatic, and slightly smoky notes.

We found ourselves in Birkenhead again, and after having a great experience at Ala Turca, we decided to try something different. That’s when we came across Chef Rasa Sayang, a Malaysian restaurant I had seen recommended on Reddit. At first glance, the place didn’t look particularly inviting, and I almost considered switching to the Korean restaurant next door. But my craving for Malaysian food won, so we gave it a shot—and I’m so glad we did! The menu offered a great variety, and I chose the slow-cooked prawn chili on rice. The rest of my family ordered chicken nasi lemak, beef rendang, and prawn assam. We’ve had nasi lemak and beef rendang at other Malaysian spots in Auckland, but this was our first time trying these other dishes. When the food arrived, we were amazed at the portion sizes—huge servings, and all for under $20 each! The slow-cooked prawns were absolutely divine, and the beef rendang and chicken curry were packed with flavor. The richness of the curry and the depth of the spices were incredible. I’m so glad I didn’t give up and head to the other restaurant. Chef Rasa Sayang has easily become one of my favorite spots on the North Shore. From now on, I’d happily choose Birkenhead over Takapuna for a meal. Highly recommend!

We ordered Ling Collars Tom Yum Soup to take away, and after one bite, I completely lost my appetite. It was the most watery Tom Yum Soup I've ever had in Auckland, there was barely any of the signature Tom Yum flavour. The difference compared to when the previous owner ran this restaurant is huge. The standard has dropped so much, and I am very disappointed. This restaurant used to be one of our favorites, but after the change of ownership, everything has changed. Although the menu remained the same, the taste is completely different. We won't be coming back again.

*** Owners changed = Taste has changed *** This WAS our favorite Malaysian restaurant but not anymore. Taste has definitely changed. The sauce was way too salty and the ingredients didn’t seem to be balanced. We know how it tasted before but it’s not how it used to be. Also the food didn’t came out in balanced time of order. We did go on a busy time, but our food took 30 minutes while the order of the next table who came in about 20 minutes later than us came straight after ours as well as other customers orders. Our order wasn’t even complicated, just two single plates. We were very frustrated but no word was said. We would not be visiting again.

This restaurant is very average. The food is passable, neither impressive nor disappointing. While the prices are somewhat more budget-friendly compared to other similar restaurants, the overall experience leaves much to be desired. The service, particularly from our waitress, lacked responsiveness and warmth, failing to create a welcoming atmosphere. Our initial plan for a light snack took an unexpected turn when we discovered a minimum charge of $16 per person, which was surprising and not aligned with our expectations.

One of My Favorite Korean Restaurants This place has become one of my go to spots for Korean food. I always order their ox bone soup — the broth is incredibly rich and full of flavor, just the way it should be. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, and the owner is genuinely friendly, which makes the dining experience even better. Definitely a spot worth revisiting!

I ordered the marinated pork set, which came with rice and four side dishes. As soon as I tasted the kimchi, I instantly knew—it was so good! Before I left, I asked the uncle about it, and he told me they make their kimchi in-house—and they even sell it! The prices are fair, the food tastes amazing, and the uncle and auntie running the place are super sweet. The whole place just feels warm and welcoming. This is now one of my favourite Korean restaurants, and I’ll definitely be back again. Highly recommend! 🇰🇷🔥
I’ve been coming here every so often for a few years. Exceptional service. Food is served quickly and hot. Always tasty. Always worth the stop. ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️
I love the food sooo much. I missed the couple who gave the excellent service to customers. I can’t find another similar taste of Korea food in Auckland after I moved away from Birkenhead. Sad;(

Absolutely best Korean I’ve had! All dishes are made with care and have so much flavour, I love all the sides that come with it too! The staff are so sweet and make you feel at home. Highly recommend, our favourites are the rice hash (bibimbap) and sizzling squid! Kimchi is also delicious!!!! 10/10
One of our favourite go to spots. Great food and customer service. I ordered their mix on salad 10/10

“My experience at Kebab Serai was truly excellent. The kebabs were delicious, made with fresh and flavorful meat. The restaurant was clean and had a pleasant atmosphere. What stood out to me the most was the respectful and friendly attitude of the staff – they served the food with a smile and great attention to detail, making the customer feel genuinely welcomed. Many thanks to the professional team at Kebab Serai – I’ll definitely come back and recommend this place to my friends.”
Worst Kebab every had, rude server, super drafty cold place to eat, go elsewhere
5⭐️ my go to! i order chicken on chips w salad! so good, one of the only places ive found too that do salad & the chips ive found other places is either one or the other
i love this little place so much!! i highly recommend the mix on rice, love supporting local family businesses like this one! the service is gorgeous 🤩
First time at Sushi-Ya and have to say this is the best sushi I have had in a long time! Incredibly fresh, and the pieces are huge and loaded with fillings! Great value for money.

This place used to be our favourite sushi place. However, they have become stingy. I bought 14/ over $30 worth of sushi and got two soy sauce in my container. Also, ask for your chopsticks because they won’t give them to you.

Disappointed with the price hikes recently. Sushi used to be $1 but now they’re all $1.50 and $1.70 for salmon pieces despite the quality of sushi falling over the years. Staff were very quick to move onto the next customer before we were finished transacting even though it wasn’t busy. Felt very rushed and a bit rude. Won’t be returning.
Great sushi at a very reasonable price!! Huge portion of salmon sushi, expect a queue during lunch time.
This is my favorite sushi shop in Auckland. Lots of options for vegetarian sushi and very yummy
What is this ?
I got the caramelised onion apple sauce and pork belly pie. I've been to so many different bakeries all over New Zealand and this one has the best pie.

My only experience is with the pastries, but they are awesome. The caramel coconut slice, the caramel brownie, and the other chocolate pastries are amazing. You might not expect such delicious treats at a humble neighbourhood bakery, but I highly recommend you try them!

We went here on a whim after coming back from Chelsea Sugar Factory. The Sausage roll tasted like one I used to have a long time ago from a bakery in Royal Heights. The mince and cheese pie is VERY GOOD! Also the egg sandwich has a unique flavour. Next time I'm in the area, I'm stopping by and getting more pies.

Today 12/05/2025 2.15pm your sausage roll is the best I have ever eaten so far. The meat is soft , tasty (not too salty and tough dry like other stores' I have been) and it s freshly cooked and the puff as well. Please keep this taste and standard !! . I would buy this roll here time to time if this standard is still the same. Cheers

Very friendly staff and a wide selection of pies for a small shop. I have been multiple times and have consistently been served fantastic pies. The steak cheese and Jalapeño is my favourite!.. one of the best I have had in New Zealand :)

Wow! I was blown away recently with the best Indian food I've had, and I've eaten in many places over my adult life! I decided to try a dish I'd never had, and I was thoroughly impressed, well, blown away actually, as I don't remember having such a reaction to food as this dish, one of such joy and wonder at the flavours, and the "Indian hot" spice was perfect! The dish is called Chicken Chettinad, a Southern style. I had a delicious garlic Naan and it comes with rice, so I had enough for two main meals, great value for money, and they even add complimentary papadom! They are very friendly, and because they are open til around midnight, it's such a great late night option for shift workers etc. I am happy to recommend getting your next Indian meal here!

Wow!! I’m so impressed! Just got some takeout, samosa chaat was incredible, one of the best I’ve ever tried and the chicken chettinad, like a spicy, tastier version of butter chicken, such a flavour bomb! Everything was fresh and great quality, We’ll be coming back for sure. Unfair of someone to leave a 1 star review, personally I think this place is serving really amazing food.

Opened in the last couple of weeks! And WE are SOOOO lucky this place is 450 metres from our house! We watched and waited as Indian Heritage was being established! OMG! Soooo worth the wait! Sorry not sorry to all other Indian food places! Bye Bye! We have fallen in love with Indian Heritage! Our new local. He had chicken khadai (Indian hot), she had butter paneer (mild) and I had fish malbari. Very flavourful and aromatic. Delicious is an understatement. The best Indian food we’ve had in a long time. The menu is extensive. Although it is a takeaway, there’s seating inside. YOU need to try Indian Heritage. I’ve told a lot of people already. Our entire street buy from here now 😂. How lucky are we. Oh… and the naan bread are so generous in size…. Bigger than your face 😂 ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️

Unfortunately, I didn’t have a great experience at this restaurant. I was drawn in by the reviews mentioning authentic Indian cuisine, but that wasn’t what I found. I ordered the Chicken Jalfrezi and Chicken Kadai, and both dishes were overly creamy — which isn’t typical of authentic preparations. While the pricing and combo options were reasonable, the flavor of the curries didn’t meet my expectations for traditional Indian food. I personally wouldn’t recommend this place if you’re looking for an authentic Indian dining experience.

We ordered the family pack to be delivered (75 dollars plus about 8 dollars delivery), and it was EXCELLENT! Super friendly delivery team, and AMAZING value for the price, we got Lamb Kadai, Chicken Jalfrezi and Chicken Madras, each of which were lovely flavours, the Lamb being my favourite. Got heaps of leftovers so we reckon this could have easily been shared 4-5, we look forward to eating here again!! 😋

Booked this hotel for a colleague and am absolutely embarrassed. I wish I had read the reviews. Firstly, there's no restaurant or bar. They offered "heat and eat" options via microwave for $25. The whole hotel is tired, dated and underwhelming. The lobby is unkept and the staff weren't overly welcoming but were okay. The room wasn't serviced once during the whole 4 day stay and when I went into the room I was embarrassed. The furnishings were basic, the carpet was nearly threadbare. The towels were average at best. To be honest, I was so embarrassed that I offered to move my colleague to a real accommodation venue. When we offered our feedback directly to the hotel they didn't even care enough to respond which reinforces the late of care and hospitality. Avoid at all costs. Only benefit is the location. Just to clarify we booked this directly via your website.

Great location in Takapuna, 5 mins walk to the beach and close to several eateries. Our third stay in a family suite. The apartments are somewhat dated, though they are spacious, well kitted out with a dishwasher, separate washing machine and dryer, and the communal facilities are excellent - large outdoor spa and pool, gym and tennis courts. Staff at front desk are helpful and friendly. Will be back.

The best you can before getting into the luxury hotel prices. We were there for a few days at the start of our honeymoon. It was the perfect place to settle in while we adjusted to the new time zone. Just few minutes walk to restaurants and entertainment, and grocery store nearby too. View of the beaches and island was amazing. I appreciated the water, cookies and tea and coffee in the lobby. Kitchenette and laundry/dryer was convenient. Pool, hot tub, tennis court and gym were clean and had all the amenities needed. I took one virtual international meeting and wifi connection worked well.

I only went to pick up a friend, didn't book a room there, but first impression, right at the entrance...terrible! Outdated furniture in the lobby, damaged timber floor, dirty, used and abused carpet, air was heavy, with a smell of old...everything...and, to top it up, an unwelcoming receptionist. I am not rating the rooms, because I haven't seen one but the tennis courts, the gym and the roof top pool are amazing! Same is the view from the pool!

Spending 12 weeks a year travelling and staying in hotels all over the world, never have I come across a "hotel" in which my room was not cleaned on a daily basis. Furthermore, to charge $35 per clean, more than 10% of my total day room rate is simply out of this world unacceptable. How does a "hotel" not have an on-site kitchen or bar in 2025? This is not a hotel; it is a rundown accommodation that should be operating as an Airbnb! How in 2025, when a windy night comes to town, the pay TV fails and leaves the hotel with no in-room entertainment. The iron has rust falling out of it, causing damage to my white business shirt. Staying in room 907.
Great sides but pizza disappointing - they hardly ever put much cheese on the pizzas, I’ve been going here for a few months now and there’s never much cheese :-(

I don't even know where to start with this one. Got a snack size gluten free pizza with dairy free cheese. Normally it is the best gluten/dairy free pizza but this was yuck. They chopped two thin slices of salami for the whole pizza so I had two tiny pieces on each piece. Sauce was poured all over the pizza that it made it sticky and soggy that when I pulled a piece, it was stuck to the box and fell apart. I always get the same pizza from Hells but this was the first and last time from the Takapuna branch. I will not be coming here again. I will continue to get it from the Glenfield branch though. I know everything is expensive but come on , I paid $14 , surely you can put more meat. Overall experience, too stingy, too messy, too sticky. P.S - Photo look way better than how it looked in real.

I visited hell pizza Takapuna last week. We got very warm welcome by Jaspreet. she is amazing , she made a lovely great pizza for us. Thank you Jaspreet for such a great customer service. We would love to visit hell Takapuna back again.
Cold, hardly any cheese and cold upon delivery. toppings a bit light and pizzas x4 were cold. This family of 5 will NOT be back! Goodbye $120!!!
Our first time with Takapuna Hell 🍕. It was Halloween and yes they set store and we had fun while we waited out Pizza.

Really good. Really affordable. Not many places do egg curry and if they do they usually don’t fry the hard boiled egg which is not authentic. These lovely guys cook an amazing egg curry the right way. Rich tomato gravy with slithers of ginger. Their Nahn is great with the right kind of stretchy greasy buttery feel. I ordered Tandoori paneer aswell and I was pleasantly surprised with the generous portion size. If I was you and you were choosing between here and Big Tika, I would choose here. It has better nahns and much better vegetarian options. I am going to bring my friends to hear the first opportunity I get.

This is our regular Indian restaurant to eat with our friends but not any more the service and meal tonight the worst I’d ever had and the response from the staff unbelievable ! 4 of us ordered. I ordered mild Tikka masala goat meat, with cheese naan and mango lasse. I got medium dish of bones with little meat even the sauce was poor with onion and capscium uncooked and large slices. My mouth was on fire. Thank goodness I had the Lasse. The goat curry was more expensive than other meats. There was no indication on menu it was on the bone and the waiter said nothing. I would not have had it if I had known. When it came to the table I noticed it had a large storage looking something in it I asked the waiter what it was as none of us knew. He just said give it to me. I asked what it was as I poked it he said meat I tried to cut it and said this is not meat and then he told me the truth he said it was fat !, he took the piece away on his hand. I looked forward to the rest of the meal, unfortunately not to be there was a hot sauce full of bones with very little meat. I wish I had photographed it. Even the rest of the table tasted it and said it was hotter than theirs and one had medium spice. They also could not believe the amount of bones some so small I almost swallowed them. The waiter came to collect the plates and asked about the meal I informed him of my displeasure and why. All he said was I’ll have to make it better next time. He asked how the Lasse was I said fine. When we came to pay I asked what the chef had said he just said we will have to have a word with our suppliers. There was no apology for the awful meal or even an offer of any discount or have the Lasse on us or the like. Customer service Nil Meal Nil Did they care if I enjoyed it or not NO. Not Interested and could not care less attitude. My advice plenty of nice curry houses GO find one that does care about how their food tastes and is served and have some kind of pleasant customer service. We as regulars will not be again we will find some where that values our custom. I’m now put off of curry. Expensive for bad food.and don’t care attitude. Remember Kabana it’s your customers that keep you in business.
Good customer service by BJ. Awesome food. I wanted to have garlic parantha so they made for me which was not in their menu. Really recommend it.
100% the best Indian food we have had so far service was amazing. It was clean and tidy. 10/10

Well you can’t please everyone. But I’m telling all the British people in Auckland... In the 23 years I’ve been in NZ, this is the best Indian Restaurant I’ve been to and the British people know what good Indian food is. It’s not the fanciest place but it’s definitely great food. Give it a try!

I went with my family the other day, but unfortunately we all had diarrhea after coming home. I suspect it might have been the marinated pork, possibly expired. It was really disappointing, especially because I had eaten here once before and always thought this was a reputable, long-established place.

This meat buffet is highly recommended! I visited with my wife and her family on a Saturday evening, and the place was packed. We tried a variety of meats, and none of them disappointed us. We especially loved the pork belly and ribs, I loved shrimps, and they were outstanding. We ate a lot! The side dishes were also delicious and paired perfectly with the beef and pork: pickled radish wraps (쌈무), napa cabbage (배추), spicy rice cakes (떡볶이), sweet rice punch (식혜), and pork bone soup (감자탕). We left absolutely stuffed. Definitely a place worth visiting!

It's been my third time to eat at this place. It's always been a satisfying experience for me. You can just call to book a table. I love the choices of meats and seafood. My son loved the lamb slices. I love their sikhye. It's refreshing especially if you have been eating with the spicy sauces. Their choicea of cooked food is also great. Place is always packed regardless of occasion. Toilet is clean. Current price per person is $43.50. I think when I first came here it was just $37. Will still be back.

A really great Korean BBQ place! Would love to come again! Been to a few K-BBQs and this is among the most memorable! The meat and food were presented nicely, and the venue was very clean. A good selection of meats, great for a group setting! Was also really pleased with the Sikhye (sweet rice punch), perfect to balance the food! They also offer a wide range of hot foods which includes fried chicken, spicy rice cakes (tteokbokki), and traditional Korean Japchae noodles, in case you get hungry while cooking the meats! The service was really quick, and the staff are quick to clear plates and change the grills. We visited on a Monday evening and it was still busy, so it’s definitely worth booking just to be sure! Pricewise, it’s might seem a little steep ($43.50 per person) but the quality, and all-you-can-eat nature makes it stand out against other K-BBQ places. Parking in front of the venue is limited, but there is free public parking on the opposite side of the road. Takapuna also has decent public transport options.

Minimal air ventilation and no above table air extractor so prepare for your clothes to smell like meat. Service was rude and condescending when seeking to change from the hot pot to a stir fry grill. We were told it would cost $10 (when a previous staff member told us we could change it without a problem and didn’t mention any surcharge), to which we said that is fine. We waiting 20 minutes and no one came to change the grill so I went to the counter to ask it to be changed again to which the rude waiter said “yeah we can change it but like I said before it will be $10” to which I replied “yes we said we are okay with that when you were at our table, if you could please change it that would be great”. Then they changed it after some time. Also a tip: when catering to larger groups of people (5+) or even to smaller groups it is in your best interest as a restaurant to make extra patrons welcome especially when there is plenty of space in the restaurant (on a Sunday). We invited 2-3 more people to dine with us but they made it seem like a chore to accommodate more people and we had to move all of our plates and grills ourselves. The young man who refiled our water could use some more training in hospitality as well as the rest of the staff which had an overall demeanor of hating every second of working there. Grill was okay, as they put some kind of material between the meat and the grill itself expect the meat to be boiled with black pieces of this material to be stuck to the meat. All night we could not get a piece of meat to have a nice char like we get at other Korean BBQ places. Alcohol selection is good, meat selection is great and wide range of meats. They ran out of Milkis after we ordered once which is not great (especially at a Korean restaurant ordering KOREAN drinks) Average experience, won’t be back in the future if I have a say in it.

I must say I come to this restaurant once a week at least, and it of top quality every time. Burgers Always hot and fresh, fries sometimes bad for better or worse, but 99% of the time the food is very good and well put together, better than a lot of other maccas out there. Good management.

Drove here for a late evening drive through, got what I needed, food was as expected from a maccas, no particular highlight but the burgers were well assembled, fries were hit and miss, no complaints though. Shout out to a good drive through experience.
Less than 60 seconds to get 2 large frozen cokes and an apple pie from order to deliver y at the counter. Excellent. Mon 11am.
The cars parked. Are. Starff cars. So be careful. You will get a ticket.

For one, their staff are useless and cannot get an order right, service slower than a sloth with MS- AND THEY NEVER HAVE ANY VANILLA ICE CREAM. GET A GRIP. Photo for reference on how quality their ice creams are
Amazing menu with lots to choose from. Food tastes clean and less oily than other places and staff are super friendly. Def worth the trip over the bridge for some good food.

While staying in Takapuna recently I bought fish and chips from this centrally located business. I’d have to say they were right up there in quality, presentation and taste. In addition the service on a fairly busy evening was fast and friendly. Nice operators, nice food.

Very popular place in takapuna, and generally, when I see faded food photos on the wall, they've been here for a while. The touch screen at the door is new and easy to use, but for a first timer, you'll be scrolling through for a while to see what you want. Combination fried rice 9.5/10 Everything about this dish is near perfect, but i noticed there was no fried egg through the dish. Must use a decent wok to get that amazing smoky char on the rice, and the meat is a nice sized piece. I'll be coming here again I the future. A staple takeaway In takapuna, and it's not going anywhere.

Our family shared takeaways on Sunday night which was absolutely delicious! There were 3 mums and we received a lovely bouquet of two roses each wishing us a happy Mothers day, such a lovely gesture Flying Horse, thank you!
Ordered 10 hot dogs, 4 fish and 5 servings of chips for $79, thought this was a very good price. Food was great and plenty of chips to share between 12 kids and a bunch of adults.

Beautiful place and food was outstanding all are vegetarian friendly and kids friendly place.my 1st time visit for my friends wedding anniversary treat and it was awesome and amazing. Staffs are so friendly as well.

Not great, to be honest. Staff were welcoming and friendly, however the food want great, the burger seemed to use minced meat rather than a patty and the pizza was basically a cheese pizza with a few slithers of meat and the fries were generally over cooked. For the price you pay a bit disappointing, maybe its better at dinner time rather than lunch. The shishabar does look like it would be fun though.

Barely a locals bar based on recent visit on a Friday night, with less than 16 people there over a three hour period. Food was mediocre and overpriced compared to other local places, and the kitchen closed without staff doing a last call for food. The very worn pool table also located in an inconvenient location with columns, door, and tall bar table all blocking 60% of the angles you might need to actually play a round.

Disappointing. The chips were the overcooked dregs so I asked for another lot. They were better but not great. Veggie burger was coleslaw with too much mayo a slice of egg plant and dried up falafel. Wine tasted old. For $91 for 2 meals 3 drinks and hot chips it was a waste. Very quiet on a Friday night. I guess I know why. We won't be coming back.

Here’s a straightforward and honest review I recently dined at Backyard, and unfortunately, it was a disappointing experience. The food was subpar—bland, poorly prepared, and definitely not worth the high prices. For what they charge, I expected much better quality and flavor. On top of that, the service was lacking. The staff seemed uninterested, and the wait times were longer than they should have been, even though the restaurant wasn’t particularly busy. Overall, I wouldn’t recommend this place. There are far better options in the area for the same or even lower prices. Save your money and dine elsewhere.

We chose the Gourmet BBQ catering option by Free Range Chef for our Summer garden wedding which was held at my parents property. Everyone was blown away by the delicious canapes and dinner. The wait staff were superb, and ensured everyone was well fed & watered. They didn't need any direction on the day, and did a great job cleaning up afterwards. The leftover steak and salads were given to us, which my parents appreciated while I was off on my honeymoon. I definitely recommend Free Range Catering for your next event! Photo credit: Ryan Watts
Pleasure to work with Stephen! Great Chef and amazing service ! Highly recommended !!

We can't recommend Free Range Chef enough! They recently catered our wedding and did the most incredible job. From start to end, the staff were easy to communicate with, adaptable to our needs and budget and just so professional. On the day I knew there was nothing I needed to worry about and we were blown away by the food. We requested a grazing table during the reception and I had so many of the guests say it was the best grazing table they'd had. The main meal was also a 10/10. We went for the Salmon and chicken and both were incredible, again all we had all the guests raving about the food. If you're looking for professional and organised caterers who also make incredible food then definitely get these guys on board!

I had the Free Range Chef cater for a 30 people gathering and I’m so glad I did! My day and night hosting was made so much easier not having to worry about the food. The grazing table was beautiful, and the food was delicious. The ham was outstanding! There was plenty of food for people to graze all night long . The guys setting up were lovely, super friendly and did a great job presenting the food . I can’t recommend them enough. I’ll definitely be using them again !

We had Stephen and his team cater for 200 guests at a luncheon last week. I could not fault it. We had an alternative drop so that adds to the planning. The chicken was still super moist, and it was a punt to go with his suggested vegetarian dish but the guests loved it. I can't wait to work with these guys again; it was a pleasure from start to end.

Lovely cafe with a great vibe! This place has a warm, welcoming atmosphere that makes it perfect for catching up with local friends. The selection of organic options is impressive—plenty of choices for health-conscious diners. Highly recommend for anyone looking for quality organic food.

A must visit! Street Organics of Takapuna is already legendary. It is an established Institution, known for its delicious healthy eats and absolutely fantastic service. It’s definitely worth a visit. Nicky the owner is often seen on the floor, quality checking everything and always greets you with a smile- her staff are so lovely as well, loads of healthy quick options to pick out of the cabinet or stay a while and order of the menu. I did- see my photos for one delicious salad options. Thanks Nicky always great to see you! Jess, Hospitality Specialist Kakapo Business Sales

Local place that is actually organic. Made from scratch, tastes great and looks beautiful. And you feel beautiful too because the people are so friendly and happy to serve. Thanks team! See you next time!
Smoothies are delicious and the food is flavourful! The staff are also super friendly! Also dog friendly and one of the staff asked if my dog was allowed a treat which was so lovely of them🙂

5 Stars 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 Street Organics in Takapuna is an absolute gem! From the moment you step inside, you're welcomed by a warm, inviting atmosphere and a team that goes above and beyond to make every visit special. The food is simply outstanding—fresh, nourishing, and made with so much care. You can feel the passion behind every dish, with ingredients that are wholesome and delicious. Whether you’re stopping in for a coffee or enjoying a meal, it’s always a fantastic experience. A huge thank you to the entire team and the owner, Nick, for your dedication and hard work. Your attention to detail and genuine hospitality make Street Organics more than just a café—it’s a community hub where people feel connected and cared for. Keep up the amazing work!

Delicious food and a fantastic atmosphere! I visited with a group of friends and expected some wait time for our meals, but was pleasantly surprised by the quick service and high-quality dishes. The ramen was a bit salty for my taste, but every bite was warm, flavorful, and comforting—perfect for an unexpectedly chilly evening.

Best Ramen I have had to date. Full of flavor and well presented. The service was exceptional with extremely polite staff who were accommodating to our needs Highly recommend visiting this restaurant for good quality food and a great dining experience
Yummy ramens as usual and friendly staff. Spacious store suitable for groups and gather. We came at 5PM when it’s just open so no reservation needed.

We had the pleasure of visiting this establishment on Ajisen Day (02/22), and it was truly a delightful experience. The ambiance was warm and inviting, creating the perfect setting for an enjoyable meal. The staff were exceptionally courteous and accommodating, ensuring a pleasant dining experience. Moreover, the food was served promptly, allowing us to savor every dish without delay. A big thank you for the wonderful service and memorable experience! P.S. I absolutely loved the mirror selfie!

Haven't tried Ajisen since Melbourne and really found a great one at Takapuna. The kids had their kids meals which were substantial! And they hadn't yet received their ice creams which were included with the set. I tried the spicy ramen with spicy karaage chicken. So good! Highly recommend it. It was very busy but I used the Magic eraser to remove the patrons from the photo of the inside of the restaurant.

Best dandan noodles in the city. Very authentic. Have to be careful with the heat, as the medium is quite spicy already - especially if you're not get used to Asian spicy level. Their portions are quite generous. Their dumplings and cold appetisers are quite good too. The place is very small, and can be quite hot in the summer. Parking are on the street which can be quite challenging in Takapuna. A definite must try.

My partner recommended this restaurant for its dry noodles with peanut sauce, so we decided to visit for dinner on Sunday. We ordered the dry noodles with peanut sauce and dumplings (dandan noodles), kkwobarou, and shrimp fried rice. The noodles were delicious as expected! The peanut sauce paired perfectly with the dumplings. We loved it. The fried rice was quite good and generously portioned. Lastly, the kkwobarou, fried with a layer of glutinous rice, was incredibly tasty and sweet. I really enjoyed it! Overall, we had a great dinner here and this place is highly recommended.

The boiled dumplings here are incredible. The filling is rich and flavorful, and the dipping sauce adds the perfect touch.
