The girl at the front desk provided excellent service and handled any issues promptly and with a great attitude. The food came out quickly, tasted fantastic, and the restaurant was very clean. I highly recommend this place and will be coming back regularly.

Love the dan dan pork noodles here. The whole gang and I come here for these noodles almost every other week. They are traditionally spicy noodles, so even their “mild spicy” is your average medium spicy. Definitely recommend it! Dumplings taste average. Small casual place with limited seating.
my favorite Dan dan noodles!!! I love both hot and cold one. Dumpling and other salad is also awesome! Because all food is fantastic, others don't bother me at all!

I was a regular at this place since 2017 as a chippy at Jutland Rd till now. Throughout I had always enjoyed the wok fried taste. However, around 2020, The Gospel of the Nazarenes (dispelled as a recent work, of course, lies upon lies) came to our awareness and in it, it spoke of "Jesus" being kind to all animals, no, really, even fish. Our family favourite dining place. Nice food and reasonable price. The shop even has a big table for a big family lunch/dinner/special occasion (pre-book). Owner Jason and wife Jessica are nice and friendly. They even serve dishes out of the menu upon request. Living in South AKL and would frequently go there for a meal. Highly recommended.
Tried the soy sauce chicken on fried rice. Was really yummy and so full of flavour. Paired well with the chilly oil. Lots of other tasty dishes as well so will definitely be back to try more.

This is best place to enjoy authentic Cantonese cuisine (some call it Hong Kong style). We have been have great meals since 2014 or so. Jason is a very cheerful host and always smiling when serving the customer. The price is a classified as "affordable" for poor Uni student like me. Food here are serviced warm and quick, the restaurant have ample seats and table. On top of that, this place is always clean and tiny. I highly recommend you all to tray out some of the yummy Cantonese dishes at Noodle Canteen, Takapuna. Cheers and take care Jason and crew members!

We’re not new to noodle canteen.Werv tried many many noodles canteens. we usually always get the same “honey chicken fried rice & laksa “ mine always being the laksa! This was by far the Worst laksa iv ever tried anywhere!!!.waaay too much fish sauce or what ever it was because my kids said it smelt “rotten” soo disappointed because this place had good reviews! The honey chicken was burnt aswell and the sauce was very glugy. I had to write a review because we spent nearly $60 at this place and unfortunately couldn’t eat it! a waste of money!!

I would not consider to come back for a second visit. The bento they offered for 18.8 dollars would worth no more than 6 dollars in my point of view. The rice is so badly cooked, too soft and sticky and lost of all its chewing taste. Chicken Katsu is so over cooked, kept in heater for too long and competely lost its crunchy feature. Even the source given is not in a good amount to satisify the entire meal. The only good part is the vegs which is fresh and good to eat. I DO NOT recommand this restaurant to anyone who have any little requirement of food. Especially it DOES NOT worth what it costs.

Seriously they are so rude. Things I experienced today was worse. We tried to order a sushi boxes with Chicken on the rice there the chef who was cooking we made our food in the morning we have no rice. They obviously cooking for other customers they said no rice no cook how rude that was. They not respectful talk with finger pointing obviously they can't even speak English. I'm also in food industry work if one of my staff talking like this to customer I wont be happy. If they were someone who cares about the restaurant they wouldn't act like this to customers. They basically don't wanna cook food and I don't wanna sell the food . They point out the food they made in the morning asked ask to buy them we said we want hot food for our children. It was worse customer services ever. People who goes to kyoto sushi in takapuna mall. I'm highly recommended don't. And they not even know how to cook teriyaki chicken because they are Chinese I will not gonna go here and I'm going to tell all of my friends not to. Waste money and bad quality. They should start learning English if they are actually want to sell the food in food court. That's the basic for people who is working on Auckland. They don't have basic even.

Be careful of this place, found fly in food staff member tried to downsize my bento cause ei had eaten like 3 peices of vegetables. Then I told them I dont eat seafood so she then proceeded to take the chicken off another product to place ok where the fish was.... they clearly dont care about food safety. Would totally avoid
What you'd expect from remade mall food. The bento comes with a bonus miso soup so that's pretty good if you want something quick and warm to go.

Food not as advertised. Selected meal from menu to be made fresh, took a while for it to be made, but the rice didn't taste fresh, salad wasn't a garden salad like advertised, asked for Katsu Chicken, was served on curry sauce. Took it back an said it is horrible, for them to just steer blank back at me. I ended up walking away. Waste of $20 !
Yummyyyy Tank is always great and delicious, lots of vegan options! Had the Start Me Up and Mango Zest and it was really tasty and refreshing. So great for a hot day!
Food was good but the store front was the dustiest place I have ever been. Every surface apart from the table tops had a thick layer of dust on it

Hey Vegans! Tank is a good place if you are on the go and want to grab something quickly. I had the Wild Child wrap with a small The Kale Ale juice. The wrap is not huge but a good size and loaded with nutritious veggies. Thanks for the cranberry it has a nice sweet taste and almond also makes it very unique. With a juice your meal become complete. Very refreshing and fulfilling!
Poor girl trying to make everyone’s orders plus door dash. Wait time 15min for a salad on a Sunday afternoon. Get more staff please

I regularly order from tank takapuna on hurstmere road . I ordered gorilla greens large size an hour ago and asked for no ice in there but there was ice in it. I understand it was extremely busy and that girl was doing very well. I appreciate her service but I’m disappointed of having ice in my smoothie which spoiled the taste of it and ice doesn’t suits my throat.

I work for tank and ordered a life force. Usually have this drink or the nutra blast every shift. When I received my drink it had no whey, no chia seeds and no oats… not THAT bad. Just tastes like a classic banana with almond :/ but not what I ordered..

I don't know why they accepted my order twice on uber eats, only to then cancel both times. The second time the driver actually went there as it said it was ready and I had to contact uber to amend this.
3 staff on site no customer but still took extra long for 2 juice order. Ordered and they waited 5 minutes just to read the order. Very insufficient service.
They close before the closing time. Personal was still there but they didn’t want to sell a juice. I rush to get there on time. So disappointed
Came in and ask for a smoothies but ended up with a slushy. There aren't many customers waiting but just look at how disgusting it is. Definitely not recommend

Visited Mr India for the first time and their flavours are truely authentic. We got the Malai chicken, lamb seekh kebabs and their special lamb curry. You could tell the food was freshly cooked and the service was amazing!! We also got to try a new dessert which was delicious!! 🤤 HIGHLY RECOMMEND

Best butter chicken I've ever had. The flavor is phenomenal, sweet, tangy, spice levels on point. my partner loves the biryani. All their food tastes immaculate, well and carefully crafted. I've never had to wait long for food either. Only complaint is that they're too far away from me.

If you’re after great, authentic and flavourful Indian food, then this is the place. While the ambience and service are nothing to rave about, the food beats it all! Absolutely loved the fish Amritsari, which interestingly and sadly is a rare find in Auckland. The lamb seekh kebab and biryani are fab too. Sure will be back

Expect lengthy time to have your meals served when there is only one table in the entire restaurant. Perhaps due to lack of staffs? Food was fairly average too. Hope they will improve. Good location though.

I had some Ubereats from here, and even the vegetarian was nice, so thought I would eat in today. The food was really delicious, but it lacked spice. I had the medium and it was barely mild, let alone medium. The drinks were warm. Would it kill you to keep the coca-cola in the fridge or add some ice to it? Overall, I enjoyed the food, but it's nothing to rave about when there are better options nearby.
The worse customer service I’ve experienced at a subway. Asked to ensure the chicken was very hot it was barely warm felt not safe to eat.

I’ve been here twice now and both times the customer service was awful. First time I was waiting to order and the two ladies were just talking and laughing behind the counter and waited 5 mins before serving me. Seccond time they guy had put the wrong meat into the sub when I wasn’t looking, when I politely told him to change it he rolled his eyes and didn’t even change it he added the meat I wanted on top and didn’t talk to me for the rest of my time not even a thank you
Very thrown together sub, tomatoes and cucumber were old tasting and the staff member who was at the register didnt have her hair tied back or a uniform. Unprofessional.
The food was nice. Ordered footlong meatballs. Nice customer service. Only 1 staff member working here and it's a big line. The subway inside the Mobil. Table and chair inside.
Good portion of salads and vegetables. Sausages are decent in texture and flavor. Fresh salads and vegetables. Generous selection of sauces and drizzles.

So I actually really like their steak schnitzel with mushroom sauce and am a regular for it but today I ordered spicy chicken which is supposed to have peri peri sauces, salad and rice. I did tell them to leave out the salad but even if there was salad this is not a $22 meal. There's barely any sauce for the rice. Even taking into account the labour, this seems like a total rip off.
Ordered in uber and gave me raw lamb. Very bad experience 👎🏽

I came here 4 times over a duration of 3 months and they always take a long time to make up the orders. It's a kebab, all the ingredients are ready, it should take no more than 15mins. The meat that they use always has cartilage, not good quality meat. I thought after they changed owners a while back things would improve. And what's with the extra charges for sauces on Uber? I liked that this place was close but now I much prefer traveling to Birkenhead for my kebabs.

Food is good, flavours are nice. Staff do not conform to covid regulations however. 2 times I've been in since auckland went into red light and didn't see any staff wearing masks at all, even though they are serving foid yo the public as well as working in close proximity to each other. I wonder about their vax status.

Not only was the food fantastic, the lady at the counter was so extremely friendly - I liked just standing and chatting for a while. I know she wasn't having a good day, but she was all smiles and was happy to recommend the best for me. Worth checking out if you are in the area!

Opted for the cauliflower side which I believe was on special, and that was super tasty. The chicken burger was fine by comparison but I've certainly had nicer more flavourful burgers elsewhere. The waitress that served me did a great job guiding me through the menu and offering suggestions.
Do not recommend especially for the price. Dry/stale buns and the patty was way too underdone for a medium. Ordered 6 burgers and many sides between us and no one really enjoyed anything at all
Delicious and great service. Have gluten free burger and fries options for my coeliac partner. A bit more pricey than burger fuel, but you get a lovely atmosphere and great service.

Awesome burger joint with a good bar! What an awesome combo that makes! The burgers were really nice and juicy! We got asked how we like our beef cooked, in our beef and cheese burger which was new as other restaurants just make it without asking. We also ordered the mc fly (chicken) burger, so succulent. The potato skin chips were also amazing! The fact they have takeaway boxes in on standby so we can take left overs home is a bonus! The customer service was spot on, not too much in our faces and did not ignore us. Thank you!

On holiday from nelson and came to Takapuna for a break from the city. Called into burger burger for lunch...the food and atmosphere were great..you could have a conversation with having to yell over loud music..the guy that served us was extremely polite and guided us through the menu..when the burger arrived it was just so wow...I'm a fussy eater and there ingredients in it I'm not fussed on but when put together I ate them ...i must say that it was one of the best burgers I've ever had in a long time...the chips were lightly seasoned and not to salty Overall we'll be back.. 10/10

First time coming here, the food was amazing the meat was nice and juicy. Food was cooked to perfection. Although it was busy during our stay the staff made sure to check up on our tables along with other tables. We were grateful that one of staff members explained how the menu worked so we had a better understanding. Overall I had a good experience here and look forward to the next time I come.

This place never disappoints when it comes to fire-grilled BBQ! One of our top go-to restaurants for that smoky, on-fire flavour. The salad surprised us — so fresh and that dressing is crazy good! Should’ve gone for the big bowl! 🥗 And the dessert? Absolutely mind-blowing — soft, rich, and unforgettable. A must-try every time! 🍮✨ Only one small thing — the beef ribs, which are usually super tender and juicy, were a bit too chewy this time. Hope it was just a one-off, because we really love them when they’re done right!

First, The food is super yum😊😊 it’s the place I wanna go once a week☺️ The owner is kind and the staff are attentive It’s not just the food, the ambiance really makes the experience special! Plus, the staff who has blue eyes is cute

First time visiting this restaurant tucked away in Takapuna. Glad I had my local son with me to guide me to parking and then the restaurant. Our waitress was wonderful. We started with chicken skewers and the pork belly. Both delicious. Mains were a t-bone steak and costillas (beef short ribs). Portions are generous and came with a side and a sauce. Everything was cooked to perfection and delicious. So much food we had to ask for containers to take food home. Our waitress brought us separate containers for the salads so they didn't wilt. She also provided tongs to pick the salad up. Just felt she went the extra mile for us. Highly recommend although someone told me earlier in the day it was expensive. This carnivore mum was delighted with the meal and thought excellent value for money.
Love the meats. They are well cooked and served. (I swapped out the fries with salad.) The beef ribs were so tender and yummy with the sauce. These food fed us full.

If you're a pizza lover, Dante’s is an absolute must. The pizzas were outstanding—crispy crust, rich sauce, and seriously fresh toppings that hit the spot. You can tell they put care into every slice. What really stood out, though, was the staff—super attentive, friendly, and made the whole experience feel warm and welcoming. Highly recommend for a casual night out or a relaxed dinner with friends. Will definitely be coming back!

been here many times throughout the years, always a great experience! last night we arrived without a reservation and it was full house, we were directed to the sitting by the walls with the tiny tables, we asked to be sitted at the proper table once become available and service were amazing! food is delicious, authentic Italian pasta and pizza. overall great vibe.

Ordered 2 pizzas and 2 pastas. Staff were aggressive, especially the lady. We asked for regular Coke after seeing cans in the fridge. The bartender served Coke Zero but was corrected by the lady, assuring us it was regular. The drinks tasted off—flat and like Coke Zero. When we asked again, the bartender seemed unsure. We requested cans but were given glasses again. The lady claimed it was “restaurant law” not to serve cans at the table—ridiculous. Pretty sure we got flat Coke from an old bottle. Disappointing service—won’t return. Pizza was good. Pasta was okay. — A Coke Enthusiast.

Dante’s Pizzeria is a really sweet and slightly hidden spot in Takapuna! I love going there and the pizza is always amazing! They have a big variety of pizzas and offer small sides, appetisers and pasta dishes too! Their mocktails are delicious and look great! I definitely recommend this restaurant to everyone searching for an authentic Italian treat!

Amazing food! Loved the starters, pizza, pasta, and dessert. The owner was extremely friendly and helpful. The other staff were also very nice and efficient. They definitely deserve all the prizes they’ve won for their pizza! I’m more of a pasta gal, but my husband was on pizza induced cloud nine. Probably the most authentic Italian food we’ve had since moving to New Zealand!

The food was exceptional—not cheap, but very good! Even though we didn't make a reservation, the staff was incredibly friendly throughout the evening. It was my daughter's birthday, and the staff came over to ask if we wanted ice cream with happy birthday on it to make the night special.

The waiters in this restaurant are very polite and made me feel very comfortable when dining in the store. They will ask you carefully if you need more water? Still need some service? It's been a long time since I've tasted such delicious Japanese food. The vegetable tempura is not greasy and the ingredients are chosen just right, so it tastes delicious. The most surprising thing is that I didn’t expect the portion size of KIWI DINNER to be so big, so I think the portion size for two people is just right. A Japanese restaurant that is worth visiting again.

Came to this place and tried the katsu here for $32. However, the taste was just average nothing particularly stood out. The portion of rice was quite small for the price, the portion of sauce is similar to the rice 🥲 The restaurant itself is clean. Overall, just wanted to check out a different restaurant

I went to a Japanese restaurant this evening. I really enjoy the udon noodle soup; it's perfect for cold weather. However, the grilled salmon was not crispy and turned out to be very soggy. I wouldn't recommend trying that dish.

Among our party of six people the Spinach gomaae and dinner boxes were adult favorites. The child's plate was a big hit with our very picky 5-year old. The restaurant was empty when we arrived at 6 o'clock. In the short time it took to serve our dinner every table was full and we no longer received any service without going in search of staff.

Great food and coffee. Had the St Paul Galette which was very nice, good size serving and quite filling for me. Set in a nice place overlooking the lake. Good, friendly service. Will definitely be back.
Had a wonderful lunch with my sister and colleagues. The food was nice, costing us around $30 per person for coffee and savory scrapes with sausage and mashed potatoes.

Traveled from South Auckland to bring our son here for his birthday based off the great reviews and his love for crepes. Specifically only came for that one dish, the crepes, and man they didn't disappoint! The crepes were flavorful! Very tasty! Price is reasonable I spose. Service was great, She always had a smile, kept water topped up, greeted and farewells us. Made us feel comfortable being Hori's in a boujee environment lol Atmosphere is calm and relaxing. Beautiful view. Going back to try the meals on the menu. Highly recommended the crepes!!

Exceptionally great food and service. If you have ever enjoyed the cuisine of France then you must visit this Restaurant and enjoy the dinner menu. Pate, Duck for main course and the Profiteroles are better than Lorettas,,, Thank you for a brilliant evening, we will be back.

We went today for lunch, sunny Sunday afternoon we ordered duck spring rolls and received 2 orders duplicated, we ordered croque monsieur also duplicated and bread was spongy wet not toasted. We ordered Duck breast Coin Coin chef requested medium it was served rare not rested with blood oozing out the chef came out to explain why the bread was not toasted and why the duck medium wasn’t possible, as it would be dry. An unfortunate experience beautiful setting the cuisine is stuck in the 90’s and staff language barriers were an issue not even understanding the word bill please… “faulty towers” Thank you for the reply I have experience in Michelin star owner shareholder and global restaurants 30 years experience as they say the proof is in the pudding and to express professionalism the galette and duck spring rolls were fantastic!

This off-the-beach sake bar is a true find. Stepping inside feels like being transported to a bustling Japanese street – the atmosphere is vibrant and welcoming. The staff are incredibly friendly and helpful, adding to the overall charm. The menu offers a fantastic selection at reasonable prices. We sampled the yakitori shishamo, teriyaki eel on rice, and spicy tuna rolls – all were delicious and authentically Japanese in flavour. Whether you're looking for a quick drink or a celebratory meal, this sake bar is a perfect choice. Highly recommended!

I’ve been to here twice a few years ago and had a decent experience, but my visit tonight was a complete disappointment. The kingfish sashimi was not fresh, lacking that expected quality. The sushi was a letdown as well, as it had Korean Gochujang sauce which completely ruined the authentic sushi experience. The odd combination just didn’t work at all. We order salmon wings but what we got was salmon head without any prior notice. Overall, it felt like a far cry from the Sakebar Nippon I remember.
Apart from the menus being sticky, I love this place. From the sushi to the pork skewers, it's a nice place to come with family. Came for the sushi, stayed for the cheesecake

The restaurant has a genuine Japanese vibe, and the staff are exceptionally gracious and welcoming. The food is delicious—especially the takoyaki and sashimi, with the sashimi being particularly fresh. Everything was just outstanding!

First time trying the Takapuna branch. Have been to the Epsom branch before and that was great. The inside was really nice and we got sit in one of those 2 people pods which was actually really comfortable. We ordered the grilled squid, vege tempura, yakisoba, tonpeiyaki and salmon wing. The vege tempura was perfect, the batter didnt feel too oily and you can taste the individual ingredient that is inside the tempura at their natural flavour, which is hard to make. The grilled squid was awesome as well. Yakisoba I felt was too salty and not super big fan of having mayo on the noodles. The salmon wing was nice, even though it had an eye. Tonpeiyaki was yummy but I think next time I might order rice with some of these dish as it was quite flavourful. Overall was very delicious and I think it beat the Epsom branch actually. Will come back definitely

I’ve consistently experienced very slow service at this KFC location, regardless of the time of day. Additionally, the quality of the food often falls below expectations. This store could greatly benefit from improved service standards and stronger operational oversight to enhance the overall customer experience.

Not only the quality is time to time bad - I have ordered Bucket Head with original chicken changed to hot & spicy, but I have got originals! This happens far too often than it should and really sucks when you waited so long for hot & spicy to come back out. Really hope they train their staff properly and have better quality management system. Can't believe I need to gamble that my order comes correctly when I order from a restaurant this much. Horrible horrible experience.

The KFC was very delicious. Nice and fresh fried chickens. Awesome customer service. Wasn’t busy when we went there. You can eat downstairs or upstairs. Sink for washing hand after eating. Toilet there. Sometimes very hard to find parking…

I don't like KFC. The chicken is always way overcooked and dry. You would think professionals would know just how long to cook chicken 🐔 for, so it stay moist. I do. Unfortunately we have kids that like KFC, so as much as we avoid the place, occasionally we try it to see if it's got better. It hasn't

They completely messed up our order, and we had no way of calling them to tell them. The app could not provide immediate contact information and they were not answering their phone from the number that is online. We ended up just eating what we were given. We got 6 pieces of chicken instead of 8, and two large potato and gravies and a small coleslaw instead of one large potato and gravy and one large coleslaw. Also they only sent us one chips instead of 2. We expect better from KFC.

It was my first time trying the Pepperoni and Manhattan pizzas at Sal's Pizza Takapuna, and I was impressed! The base was thin and crispy—just the way I like it—and the flavors were amazing. Their potatoe chips were delicious too! The staff were super friendly and welcoming. Highly recommend Sal's Pizza Takapuna! You made my movie night super easy and completely fuss-free. Thanks so much!

I love Sal’s Pepperoni pizza, and the Takapuna branch has become my favourite. I’ve tried other Sal’s locations before, but this one is the best! The dough was perfectly thin and crispy, just the way I like it. The flavour of the pepperoni is rich and satisfying without being greasy.

Food is excellent as always but special compliments to the guy working the till. I didn’t catch his name but small guy working on Saturday night, was so nice and excellent customer service. Made the the experience that much more lovely.

I have been grabbing pepperoni by the slice At Sals Pizza Takapuna for over a decade and you can’t beat it. The pizza bases are so thin and crispy, the pizza is consistently good and the staff are super friendly. Highly recommend the pepperoni and buffalo chicken pizza by the slice. James Ashwin Kakapo Business Sales

Absolutely love the atmosphere here! The staff are amazing and really friendly - you can tell they go out of their way to show aroha and manaaki to everyone who steps foot into the store. The store is extremely tidy and welcoming + the pizza tastes amazing. Thank you so much for making my night!

Have been eating at the Mt Eden branch for years, and it's always been amazing. Didn't realise this branch has opened. Ordered two different duck noodles and ate in complete silence for 15 minutes straight because it was just too good for any distractions. Generous portions, ballanced flavors. Food came out very quickly, and the staff is lovely. It's a small space, but it's clean, warm, and has a cozy atmosphere. Can't wait to return.

10/10 for everything. The Wok n Noodle specialty was exceptional - can’t think of a better noodle based Asian dish I have recently had. Prawns and calamari perfectly cooked - very impressed at how tender the generous sized pieces of calamari were. Owner is a super friendly guy. Comfortable seating, nice view to the outside street. Definitely worth coming to to get your noodle fix! Looks like they have all sorts - exactly what you’d expect from a noodle based eatery.

I did like tbis place and would go back, even though I gave it 3 stars. It's a cute little joint with rustic exposed brick walls. Nothing fancy but seems clean. They make a big effort to provide healthy options. There's loads to choose from on the menu. But they may be falling into the trap of being master of none. Husband got tom yum start and whisky duck main and loved it. I git pad thai and it was nothing special, bot bad, not great. It came with no vegetables at all so I had to order extra at $5. And it was missing that sour tang that pad thai should have. I wish they'd serve it with a wedge of lime but you always get lemon, it ain't the same. I've definitely had better from a food court. But the people were nice and it wasn't expensive.

The food was absolutely delicious! Every dish was bursting with flavor, and the presentation was beautiful. I loved the ambiance of the restaurant, and the staff were friendly, welcoming, polite, and professional, making us feel right at home. Thank you!

SO YUM! We ordered the Seafood Laksa, Crispy Pork Belly with rice, Chicken Satay and they were all so flavourful! Everyone’s dishes in the restaurant all looked amazing too! It’s been my favourite place I’ve eaten in quite a while now and I will be back to bring all my friends and family 😍
Decent food and used to be my preferred Friday lunch spot, but I won't be going back anymore. Even though they advertise their meals, they will rudely decline making them.
Had a "mini date" it's good for uni students or staff
Food for thought 🤔...good customer service
Great customer service
Affordable and fresh

The lady who works Monday nights has the worst customer service, the sandwiches are always made sloppy and she is rude. She refused to let me order a sandwich and meatball pot at the same time and said I’d have to line up twice if I wanted both. This is ridiculous considering I’ve had to wait (multiple times) well over 10 minutes while she’s in the back. Need better training for customer service and more attentiveness preparing food.

I often stop by the Subway at North Campus for a quick, healthy meal, and I couldn't be happier with the experience, as a staff member at AUT. The staff are always so friendly and professional, making me feel welcomed every time I visit. Thanks heaps :) They take great care in preparing my salads. I highly recommend this Subway to both staff and students – excellent service, fresh ingredients, and always a pleasant experience! Well done girls!

As a staff member of AUT, I often get my lunch from Subway AUT North Shore. The customer service is exceptional—staff are always friendly, welcoming, and efficient. The food is incredibly fresh, with high-quality ingredients. They really pay attention to detail and ensure everything is made just the way you like it. It’s always a pleasure to get my lunch from here. I highly recommend Subway AUT North Shore. Keep up the great work!

Ordered a smoothie and was so nice, manager was so incredibly rude to his staff especially what seemed to be a trainee. swearing at her and just being awful and i could see she was getting so upset and was genuinely confused. do better!!!

In 20 years of going to Subway this is my worst experience. Got a Tuna wrap, and literally only a tiny spoonful of Tuna. When I questioned this, I was told it’s the same amount of tuna as for a six inch sub. Given I buy one of these almost every week I’m well aware of the subway standard. I asked for extra and said I was happy to pay. For another 2.60 I got another tiny spoonful of tuna - still far less tuna than a normal amount. Very rude, very unusual. I highly recommend you avoid this Subway branch.

Good place to drop by and get a tasty pie and some homemade soup. Friendly staff. The place is a bit rundown but has comfortable cushioned chairs, and bench seats looking out onto the road. BBQ table outside. Got the steak and cheese pie. Pretty good as far as pies go. Probably would give it a 7/10. Enjoyed the homemade chicken soup out of the crockpot at the counter. Random thing to find at a cafe these days! Really hot, needed a bit of time to cool down. Affordable - pie and generous serving of soup came to $10 Not much parking …
Good ole classic steak and cheese pie! Yum!

These are not gourmet pies. Always hunting for a good pie at reasonable prices. Didn't have potato top, customer before took last pepper steak, so I got the steak and cheese ($6), didn't have double happy, so I got the "sausage roll" (can't remember price but wasn't great - $2.80 maybe?). Also got spring roll ($3.50), thought they looked greasy. I was asked if I'd been there before, I said no and that I was looking for a new go-to pie place. Fellow stuck a wee tong pinch of hot chips in the bag with the spring roll, which I thought was a nice touch but ultimately, those chips were very crunchy and so oil soaked they were getting that thick, translucent layer in the outside, like we're twice cooked, but prob shouldn't have been. Took big bite of pie, got mouthful of pastry and flavoured gel - don't know if it was my bad luck for that one pie, but "gourmet" pies shouldn't have that little meat - not for $6. Pretty sickening feeling to take such a bite of a steak pie and not get *any* meat, right? Dissected pie, found 3 pieces of meat in whole pie, 2 of them were quite small (see pics), rest of pie was over-thickened gravy; jiggles when piled up and shaken. Was hungry and gravy didn't taste too bad, so threw away 2/3 of gravy, broke the pieces of meat up and reassembled somewhat to fill my stomach a bit more. "Sausage roll" seemed to be made of puff pastry, not flaky, making it look bigger than it is, with a sprinkle of sesame seeds. Took a medium bite of (before pic was taken, sorry!), was filled with a thin strip (2cm wide) of what seemed to be a thick paste that tasted distinctly of luncheon sausage; interesting flavour for a sausage roll, but with the tricky, poofy pastry, the pastiness of the meat (not enough sausage in sausage roll?) and general size - not worth it and generally unappetising to me. Spring roll was crunchy, but a little over soaked with oil (I definitely accept a bit of that though - I saw what I was buying) flavour was good, but the soggy cabbage mixed with the gooey/slimey sauce was turning me off a bit. Maybe if I grabbed a fresher one, they would be better, but I won't be returning, unfortunately. :( Friendly service was nice, decor was definitely meh, but it doesn't need to be good in a commercial zone lunch bar - I'm all about the food and price.

Had the mexican pie (6NZD), seems to be kind of chille con carne inside. Simply lovely taste, especially liked the slice of cheese ontop of the filling! Put it in the microwave for a minute and sadly enough the top came right off… oh well still delicious. Service was good! Kind ladies there! The place itself felt a bit rundown, yet cosy. Apparently, they have been there a long time though. Good place to sit if you want to but mostly take-away.

The customer service was good but unfortunately the pies were not that great. To top it off, the eftpos machine don’t work or work take any overseas cards. If you don’t have a local card, make sure you have cash on you
Must be the best poke bowl I’ve had so far!!
The delight to tastebuds with prime food quality.
Every dish was divine. The menu is super vegetarian and vegan friendly and the staff are welcoming.
Great dumplings and soups. The best I ever had.

Our favorite restaurant to eat at with the family. Lovley fresh dumplings. Filling is amazing and flavourful. Beef noodle soup is incredible. Customer service, the best I've ever seen. Best dumplings in Auckland, possibly the whole world. I would give 6/5 but it's not an option. This restaurant is a family favorite. If anyone askes for a recommendation we tell them Dumpling Ace. -Dumplings Aces biggest fans

Possibly one of the most authentic Chinese food places. Everything here is done by hand and is absolutely incredible, no shortcuts taken whatsoever. I have tried all their dumplings and what's even better is that they sell them for taking away!
One of the best cheap eats I know, epic dumplings and noodles. My go too is N8 with extra vege. This place has become a once a week stop for me. Well done Ace, you’re Ace 🙌

An authentic, family Korean restaurant, wooden interior, spacious, self-service water, tea and coffee Ttukbaegi bulgogi with rice An abundance of ingredients including a variety of veges and dangmyeon (glass noodles), great portion of bulgogi which was so tasty, honestly so perfect when you can’t decide between noodle or rice dish haha The soup was delicious too! My go-to dish when I can’t decide between the soup dishes Sizzling plate with pork and rice Unique, came with egg as this dish normally doesn’t, good amount of spice, good portion Love the range of side dishes, especially the jeon/korean pancake! I remember coming with my parents quite a few years ago (like 8yrs?) and really enjoying their soup dishes during winter too!! Their quality and service is still so amazing!

First time here, came especially for the mandus, they were nice. Had randomly selected side dishes. The manduguk (dumplings in soup) came with egg, beef, onion and leek in sesame oil. Very filling, will definitely come try something else next time. I preferred the steamed dumplings!

Thank you so Much for having us, our Family really Enjoyed it! I love the kimchi pork soup, Bulgogi is the best and number 40 beef with rice my kiwi husband love it, First time coming to this place and the food is just amazing, 🥰

Such an awesome place, kiwis need to get behind these amazing Korean food outlets. Such tasty and quality cuisine. I was fortunate enough to have Korean friends. Go and try this company’s amazing spicy pork dish. You won’t be disappointed.

Best Korean restaurant that I ve been to in Auckland! Amazing Kim chi dumplings and soups! I go there with my husband and friends almost every week (and i rarely eat outside from home). Service & food excellent! I started to like Korean food thanks to this restaurant!

Delicious and cheap takeaway option. Easy to order and pay online. Friendly staff. Quick and efficient service. Pictured is the hand stretched beef noodles, lamb cumin burger and cucumber salad - all very yummy. Highly recommend.

If I could rate this place a zero, I absolutely would. I ate at this place recently - I ordered the Cumin Lamb noodles and Cumin Lamb burger, having paid upfront when ordering. After getting to the table, I heard a microwave (huge red flag) being set to heat up the food, and the tables and dining area were also quite messy. I thought I would commit and continue given I already paid. The food itself was "OK" at best - nothing to write home about, and you could tell it was reheated. However, in the couple of hours following, I ended up feeling unwell, and later in the day realised I had picked up food poisoning from this place. I ended up projectile vomiting and had pretty bad diarrhea. I was out of commission for a couple of days. I would recommend avoiding this place at all costs. The hygiene and food safety standards appear to be seriously lacking.

We ordered Hand-pulled Noodles with Stewed Pork Soup ($14) and Hand-pulled Noodles Soup with Braised beef ($14.5). Both of them were so tasty. Hand-pulled Noodles was boiled perfectly. The portion was very generous. Beef and pork were tender. Soup had balance of sweet, acid, spicy and savory flavour. It tasted so good.

This is perfect for takeaway, very quick food, normally a ten minute turn around. I always get the same thing, number 37, other things on the menu are hit and miss. Super reasonably priced. Portions are much better and the food is nicer than the Dominion Rd counterpart. The restaurant inside is not that nice so would recommend takeaway.
Hand pulled noodles with vetebale., $14.50. Filling and very tasty. My first time here. I came because I wanted to try something different to my usual haunts in this strip. I am glad I came.
Friendly owner 👍🏻 Love the buns, the noodles etc. Healthy and delicious
Delicious BBQ pork buns!!
Very delicious beef brisket rice and kung pao chicken rice The buns are great Braised Beef Brisketon Rice ,😋 Yummy Sweet and Sour Chicken on Rice 😋 Yummy 😋 Buns are awesome
I like their products very much, they taste good and are affordable👍👍👍

Not sure where you'd find better, bigger and fresher sushi than here in NZ. Also well priced. Very friendly owners. Very fresh wasabi. So pleased it's close to my workplace! Only wish they were open Mondays! 😃
Sushi was good but I thought it was a bit overpriced. The sushi etc in the picture came to $19.90. Nice place for a bite to eat, but there may be better value options.

Yummy, delicious and fresh sushi for affordable price located in North Shore area. Staff is very friendly. One my most favourite sushi places in Auckland. I have been there many times and I have never been dissapointed. I would recommend to go there earlier as the parking spaces are limiteded. However, it is good that the parking is free.

The best sushi I ever had including Australia! And I’m a sushi lover. The selection of sushi is stunning and the taste even better!!! With the variety on display I could eat here daily and never get bored. The service is excellent as well. They welcome every single customer walks into the shop with warm hear. You wouldn’t want to miss this place.
Best sushi shop ever. The owners of the shop are very cheerful and kind, which makes my visits happy all the time. Foods are so delicious.

The food here is clean, light and delicious. The side dish portions are really generous. If you go at a very busy time there might be a bit of waiting, but I think it’s worth the wait. The owners here are friendly too.

First time visiting this Korean BBQ restaurant tonight. We ordered two types of meat, one beef and one pork, and both were marinated to perfection. They were so flavorful that you could almost eat them straight after grilling. Additionally, the restaurant provided fresh garlic slices to accompany the meal, enhancing the taste with the delightful pungency of garlic. The variety of side dishes was abundant and refillable, which was a great bonus. The owner kindly assisted us with grilling the meat, making it even more enjoyable as we didn't have to worry about burning it. The final bill averaged $38 per person, not exactly cheap, but the portions were generous, and we left feeling completely satisfied. The restaurant's ventilation was also excellent, as we didn't carry any unpleasant barbecue smells on our clothes. I highly recommend this place to everyone. It's definitely worth a visit!
The charcoal Korean BBQ is amazing. Love it.

Love this place so much! It’s our go to for a very chill date night on a Sunday or Monday evening. The scotch fillet or marinated pork are our favourite proteins there, along with some rice and usually one of the soup pots while everything is being prepared. One thing is I always leave having eaten ALL of the little side dishes they give you because they are that delicious. If you’re looking for a chill place to have a KBBQ that isn’t loud or packed then this is the place to go. Already looking forward to the next bbq!
Amazing food and great side dishes . Never disappoints.
The 2 people set is really yummy. Chicken was tasty. Nice clean place.

We came here for dinner yesterday. One of the best places in Northcote to get dinner and I regularly attend. The price is great and the serving sizes are really big. Delicious food and attentive service.

The owner is super kind and friendly!!! We ordered set menu for 4. Delicious food great service. We haven’t been anywhere else since discovering this gem. Price is resonanle and portion was perfect 😍 Thank you 😊
We ordered a set for two. Good for value. The texture of the noodles was amazing. Very tidy with warm service. We enjoyed the meal a lot 🤤

Our family comes here at least a few times a year I feel and it's always been good plus had something for anyone. Me, in particular, I naturally love any of the sweet n sour or spicy fried chicken or pork. First time I had 백세주 baekseju too! Guess I'm living to 100 now 😁
Dan Dan noodles not too bad

Really enjoyed dining in for dinner. The portion size is quite large, and the pandan chicken is excellent; the size of the chicken is substantial and well-marinated. The fried tofu is bland and not tasty 😂

Amazingly delicious authentic Sarawakian food! Wish I could try everything on the menu but so far the kolo mee, Sarawak laksa and CKT have been perfect. Have never had kolo mee this authentic outside of Kuching before. Just unpretentious tasty hearty meals. Complimentary soup is a great starter.

My parents told me about this place and said they serve my childhood dishes from when I was growing up in Malaysia. The KOLOMEE is by far even better than back home! The food today bought back so many happy memories associated with the taste. I’m so glad to have finally made my way to come here to eat the food, I’m Wellington based but drove to Auckland for work, in hindsight I drove basically 9hours for noodles haha

Even though Taisumyun is famous for their kolomee, their mie goreng is way better! The mie goreng is bursting with flavor, packed with just the right amount of spice, and infused with that irresistible wok-hei. It’s the closest we've tasted to the kind of mie goreng we usually have back in Malaysia. The place is pretty small—just two people running the show when we're there—so service can be a bit slow. But the steady queue when we were there says it all. When locals are willing to wait, you know the food’s legit!

The food was just okay - the CKT lacked spice and the Malaysian fried rice was underseasoned. The service took forever (over 30mins for the CKT to come out and then the fried rice came out a good 10 minutes after that). Was disappointed in the lack of condiments available also.

We ordered Paneer Tikka Masala (Mild) and Mughlai Curry (Hot) + Samosas. We used Uber Eats. Ill start off with saying the food was absolutely delicious, 5/5 flavour etc. However, firstly, we did not receive the Samosas and instead recieved something else we didnt order (not quite sure what it was). Fortunately it was tasty but still not good enough to receive different items. Secondly, the "Mild" Paneer Tikka Masala was hotter than the "Hot" Mughlai, being a genuine issue as my partner can't eat spicy foods due to Esophagitus and can be very painful for her. Thirdly, you need to work on your packaging for delivery orders, as it was leaking and we had to clean everything up before eating. If you fixed these few simple to fix issues I would be rating 5 stars as the food was delicious. Edit: Chandras has reached out since and apologised for the small issues, so I have changed my review to 5 stars as this shows they care about their customers! Will be ordering again from there. :)
Expensive, and not a very large portion. My $9.10 garlic cheese naan was also a normal naan.
very tasty and friendly staff! :)
Nice foods
Had lunch here with a few friends and enjoyed it. The food was good, the staff were friendly and welcoming, and the place had a nice ambiance. It was a great spot to hang out and catch up.

Went to a Thai place. Had the beef Massaman curry. It was... incredible. I mean, properly good. The beef was so soft I thought it had been bullied into submission. Just lay there... gave up. Like Piers Morgan in a spelling bee. The sauce? Creamy. Nutty. Complex. Like Karl Pilkington, if he was edible Now — Tiger Beer. Good. Actually really good. Crisp, cold, refreshing. But let’s not get carried away. It's not Chang, is it? Chang’s the big boy. Chang’s like the Liam Gallagher of beers — slightly unhinged, full of character, possibly banned in some countries. Tiger’s more like the bloke at work who’s decent at quizzes. Reliable. Pleasant. But you’re not thinking about him when you go to bed, are you? So yeah — curry: incredible. Tiger good, not great. Changs the king. The Mufasa of lagers. Tiger’s more Simba... still good, just needs to grow up a bit.

Absolutely disappointing experience at this restaurant after booking through First Table. I called well ahead to let them know we would have one extra person, and we were happy to pay the full price. However, upon arrival, we were met with a rude greeting, being asked if we wanted to order drinks or leave. It set a negative tone right from the start. Things didn’t improve from there. After ordering, a staff member approached us in a stressful and rude manner, repeatedly insisting that we pay full price—something we had already agreed to. It made us feel incredibly uncomfortable. The food itself was equally disappointing. We were served raw chicken, which we had to send back. When it was returned, it was overcooked to the point of being inedible. To make matters worse, the dishes we ordered without spice (due to our friends' allergies) came out ridiculously spicy. The Pad Thai was a disaster—watery, flavorless, and the prawns tasted terrible, like dirt. All in all, it was a very frustrating experience. Poor service, rude staff, and food left a bad taste in our mouths (literally and figuratively). Given the poor treatment and quality of the meal, we won’t be returning and certainly wouldn’t recommend this restaurant to anyone. If you can’t provide decent food and good service and make clients this uncomfortable, you shouldn’t be on First Table.
Booked it through First Table. Absolutely beautiful atmosphere and the service was amazing. After a long time we had good Thai food! Will definitely visit again.

Had an awesome experience at Xo! Loved the warm hospitality and friendly staff. The food was amazing !! fried rice was so good, I’m already planning my next visit. Jungle Curry was super yummy too! I tried the chili margarita, which came with fresh chillis, and wow… hands down the best I’ve had, but definitely not for the faint-hearted! Bonus: parking at the rear makes it easy to stop by.

Amazing catering from Kanto! I’ve not tried them before but took a gamble and ordered food trays for a birthday celebration. The food was a hit with family and friends!! We ordered kare kare (def a must and my fave!), lumpia, pork bbq, sweet and sour fish, palabok and chop suey. All delicious! So convenient for parties with big groups and so easy to order via sending messages in IG. And all the food was packed neatly to survive the ride home. I definitely recommend! Will need to head back for a halo halo :)

Authentic Filipino food in Northshore! Flavor, quality, and serving are accurate! If you are looking for a quick takeaway or comfort food, you should head over to Northcote’s Food Centre and grab the most comforting Filipino food. They have a variety of options and some Filipino desserts available. It is worth a visit when you’re in Northshore.

Craving for a taste of the Philippines? Kanto is a must visit or simply order through UberEats. The PALABOK is an absolute delight cooked perfectly, bursting with umami, plus the toppings took it to the next level. LUMPIA has just the right crunch and the filling is moist and savoury, creating a right balance. SISIG is a true flavour bomb! Served sizzling hot with a perfect combination of crispy and tender pork bits seasoned to perfection. Don't miss the HALO HALO (MIX MIX) for dessert! A colorful and refreshing treat thats a perfect end to every meal👌 Affordable and worth every penny. Their generous portion ensures you leave with a full stomach with a happy heart🫶

Well blow me away! I have only eaten Filipino food from food sharing in the workplace. So when I had lunch here yesterday I was totally taken by surprise! Call it ignorance but I really did think palusami (taro leaves cooked in coconut cream) was an island dish. How wrong am I?! Can’t remember the name but boy it was delicious! Taro leaves and coconut cream and spices with pork and rice at $18 was totally worth it! I’m hooked on Filipino cuisine and can’t wait to try the other dishes ❤️

If you want the best bang for your buck, consider trying out Kanto. They offer a good variety of Filipino food that tastes like home. While most restaurants' menu ranges from $25-$30 per dish, Kanto is the most "sulit." Busog for under $20!! Don't get confused with the location tho, it's literally in the kanto😉
Fresh and delicious summer rolls, refreshing Vietnamese iced tea, and fast service. There is plenty of seating and great customer service.
Nice fresh bahn mi - we tried the pork and the chicken. These had pate, meat, mayo, carrot and coriander but didn't seem to have pickled vegetables or any chilli, still tasty.
Such an unassuming little spot; I didn’t expect much walking in, but the pho was so satisfying.
Don’t have nice photos to post, but they have a nice and crispy spring roll. I found them at a food truck event, and I’m not sure where to find them again, but it’s worth a try.
Delicious big meal, had the pork noodle salad bowl and loved it.

A real hidden gem offering great value meals. We hadn't been here before so didn't realise each main dish is about 2 or 3 meals worth! We spent $65 for 3 of us and could only finish less than half. Importantly it tasted good. Friendly staff and a busy spot clearly popular with locals.

I ordered the rice and curry lunch as takeaway, and it was absolutely delicious! The portion was generous more than enough for two people. I also tried some of the short eats, and they were just as tasty. Everything was fresh and full of flavor. Highly recommended!

We always have an amazing food experience from Kolombo! The chicken fried rice was flavorful, perfectly cooked, and packed with tender chicken. The mix kottu was the highlight—deliciously spiced, with a great mix of textures and rich, authentic Sri Lankan flavors. Generous portions and top-quality taste made this a fantastic meal. A big thank you to the whole Kolombo team for the fantastic food and great service!

The best Sri Lankan restaurant in Auckland. I recently tried their newest addition to the menu, rice and curry, and it was full of authentic flavours. Their chicken kottu is also the one of the best I’ve tasted ever.

Kolombo in North Shore serves some of the best Sri Lankan food around. We had the chicken rice and curry and black pork curry—both were packed with flavour, generous in portion, and beautifully cooked. The black pork was especially rich and tender. They keep the standard consistently high, and for the price and quantity, it’s excellent value. Highly recommend!

Writing after I became a regular customer of the wraps. Love the consistency of quality. Perfectly cooked juicy chicken, and lot of veggies, love it. If you like spicy try out the chili sauce, chef’s special.

Delicious! Can’t go past the zucchini and feta fritters on chips - super tasty and crunchy. Portion sizes are really generous too so excellent value for money. The garlic bread is also possibly the best garlic bread I’ve ever had. Fantastic service too! Would highly recommend the Turkish Gem :)

Absolutely the best Turkish wrap I’ve had in New Zealand! I ordered the beef wrap, it was packed with plenty of meat, perfectly cooked and full of flavour. Every bite was so delicious. The whole wrap was really well balanced, with all the ingredients coming together perfectly. Highly recommend, I’ll definitely be back for more
Tried chicken wrap The chicken was very tender and fresh .wrap portion was very good even though I ordered the small portion. Also the sauces they prepare are homemade so enjoyed the wrap.
Turkish Gem has fresh chips and friendly service. There are lots of tables and chairs in the food court. A good place for a quick kebab.

Hidden on the second floor of the food court, this rice noodle shop offers very affordable prices and delicious flavors. I ordered the Red Sour Soup Tofu Noodles and the Tomato Beef Rice Noodles—the red sour soup base was rich, tangy, and refreshingly spicy. The only downside was the noisy and somewhat rundown dining environment.
Accidentally found this place and fell in love with it. The sweet and sour soup is really delicious, not too spicy, in my opinion.
I have tried fish slices with green peppercorn broth today. That s delicious , i will come back 👍
Nice foods Nice services
My kids love the tomato beef rice noodle. The chili in the tofu rice noodle is so fragrant. I highly recommend the spicy tripe. I will come again next time.

Budget Friendly Rice Combo🔥 Just tried a spot that serves affordable rice combos and honestly, not bad at all! The set comes with rice, braised pork (tender and flavorful), stir fried veggies, and a half boiled egg. The best part? Free rice refills! 💯 They also have a self serve station where you can help yourself to egg soup, various chilli, kimchi, and pickles. perfect for adding your own twist.
Food portion is huge, taste is awesome and pricing is cheap!!
Good bargain when it comes to the price with the quality of food. But I think it is a bit saulty overall and most of the stewed meat tastes similar.
Great meal at a bargain

The food was very nice. I ordered red curry and rice. The big dish of red curry can't finish. The lady was very nice. The sitting place needs some maintenance. They make wonderfully authentic Thai cuisine at affordable prices. They produce quality food influenced by the best Thai street vendors that you can enjoy on the premises or take home..

OMG 😲 the best Pad Thai I have tasted ever, it's delicious, spicy, yummy 😋 & mouthwatering 🤤 😋 😍 love their food. Next time, I'll try Red Curry & Rice. Highly recommend this food & takeaway. 5 stars 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

Authentic Thai food by Thai people. I had so many Thai food from everywhere in NZ and from Thai! I'm so happy I found this Thai restaurant!! Thank you for the amazing food. The atmosphere was a little cold 🥶 but plenty to sit on 😁

Love this place!! The chef is so lovely and friendly and the food is always delicious! My flatmates and I come frequently! Never any issues! Go to: chicken pad Thai, Thai green curry and Thai red curry!

Had to wait 45 mins for 1 dish, Beef Nam Tok. No one else waiting. They should have mentioned long wait time if they were busy servicing Uber eats tickets and phone orders. The beef tasted old/off and looked like it had been boiled, not grilled. The least they could have done was make an effort to make a good meal after making a customer wait so long. I didn't notice until I got home that I wasted $19 on rubbish. Too late to go back. I use to come here often, but I won't be back.

Today might not be my best day when it comes to dining out. We visited a restaurant that was completely packed with customers. We waited around 30 minutes just to get our food, which already set the tone for a less enjoyable lunch. We ordered the Combination of 2 Meats: Duck and Crispy Pork. Unfortunately, the portion of duck was very small, barely enough to enjoy. To make things worse, the crispy pork came with too much fat, which made the whole dish feel overly greasy and heavy. In the end, we couldn’t really enjoy our meal

It's very disappointed. Sorry to say that the quality of the food is not as good as it used to be. We visited before 1pm for lunch. Four tables have no customers but dirty plates. Definitely short of staff.

Consistently amazing Roast Duck! Probably the best on the shore. I always order their Boneless Roast Duck on rice, saves the hassle of spitting out bones and retains the amazing flavours. However, the other menu’s are a hit or miss. Roast Pork is too salty and the foul taste of pork is sneaking out at the end of every bite. Barbecue Pork doesn't taste well marinated, the unique sweet and savoury flavours are not apparent, it can taste quite bland especially towards the centre of the meat.

So disappointed as I’ve been a customer for the last several years now and slowly the quality has been declining ever since they moved from the food court to the store front next to it. Last time, it wasn’t very good (Roast pork was so unbelievably salty and not crispy but rubbery and the duck was dry and hard) thought okay must of had an off day. Went back today and now I wish I didn’t. The service was probably one of the worst I’ve experienced. The young man was so rude and unhelpful plus seemed generally annoyed to be there. No greeting, just stares at you quite intimidatingly until you order and gets irritated when you take too long to order. He just replies with a grunt or one worded answers if you have questions or modifications. I have experienced this with him before but try to look past it because the food is worth it. However that is not the case today. Rice was old and stale (as it was hard & clumpy in parts which I left because it was inedible) Duck was cold and chewy plus I did ask for boneless and I did have to pick out several small pieces and it was mainly skin and not much meat. What topped the cake for me was when, I asked for the spring onion and ginger oil on the side and chilli oil. He persisted to charge me extra for it and when I questioned why it has always been free before and is complimentary instore why I had to pay for it if I was taking away. He replied “I dunno ask the Boss” & I guess he did because I wasn’t charged in the end. Such a shame but this experience today has really put me off going ever again! I do have to travel a bit to eat there so for me it’s not worth it now. I just recommend they train someone more accomodating and approachable out front to take orders and to also tighten the reins on their quality control because I’m certain there is other customers who feel the same.

We used to be regulars here under the old name Love a Duck. Have not dined in since just before the change of name. I ordered via Uber Eats duck/crispy roast pork on rice and deep fried wontons. The price has definitely gone up and the portions still the same- generous. Probably best to eat-in. Arrives warm on delivery. Food is as good as it ever was.
first time to go there. yummy food but some dish was bit salty for me.
Highly recommend that soup and wine chicken. Enjoy the flavor. It makes me feel like back to China.
tried Shanghai style meat ball and soybean sauce lamb ribs, taste is good .
We love coming to this restaurant for Shanghainese food. The best dish is the prawns fried with salted egg yolk. The portions are large and the food is good
OMG! So delicious and the portions are huge. I like bamboo shoots and jellyfish dishes.

My favourite morning stop. When you step into the cafe it’s colorful warm and inviting. The small decorative details, blankets and pillows create a homey feel. The owners are eager to please and staff always friendly. I think their best items are their soup, mushroom quiche and slices (perfect way to breakup midday brain fog)! Sage and Brew has something for everyone!

The food here is amazing! The staff members are very helpful and friendly 😊 we ordered their Autumn/winter menu, SO GOOD! Also, this place is dogs friendly cafe, thank you for accomodating, I highly recommend you to visit this place ⭐️

Absolutely lovely breakfast. The eggs were poached to how I like them, and the add ons of bacon and halloumi were generous portions. They have Alpro coconut milk, and the coffee was yummy. Delicious looking slices in the cabinet. Staff were lovely, and the outdoor section is really nice looking.

Divine! Hubby was on the phone, and I was hungry, so I just grabbed two menus from the counter as a lovely man from behind the counter greeted me, and I sat down to look through the menu before going up to order. Well, I didn't need to go up, just as we had decided, i turned around to see this gentleman again standing next to us and ready to take our order! How lovely of him! We ordered our drinks and food at the same time. Within 5 minutes, we had our delicious coffees. 7 minutes later, we had our food delivered! Talk about fantastic fast service! Quality and quantity were certainly not lacking either! Hubby who is usually fussy, had absolutely no complaints at all! Our food was absolutely delightful, the staff were very kind, the tables were all very clean along with the floors. 10/10 recommend stopping in for brunch!
Top marks for this place. Coffee on point. Omlette cooked to perfection. Friendly owner : host. Highly recommended

Hidden Gem Worth Visiting This is one of those restaurants we always enjoy coming back to. The food here is really worth it — both in taste and price. Their lemongrass chicken is a standout. It’s moist, full of flavor, and seasoned just right. The broth they serve is rich and comforting.

I had the raw beef pho it was absolutely amazing. Huge portion and complimentary spices on the table side to mix things up. The staff had friendly service and I have already started recommending to friends and family. Thank you for running such a great place.
I got takeaway. The food was very nice and still hot. It was packed well. I liked it and will order again.

Real Review : Today, I decided to give this place a go ... settled in nicely! Serviced on target! Tea was served! "Oh, thank you!" I said... the food .. sweet & sour pork..very delicious 😋. I'm happy with the outcome. I will return soon. Pics included! Thank you so much.

2024: What a hidden gem, huge menu and amazing flavours. The Vietnamese Styled Noodle Soups are sure to please, with the brisket option packing huge chunks of tender meat in a massive soup bowl being my choice. Will need to try other dishes, but the noodle soup's a high recommendation.

This McDonald's in Belmont offers a bit of a mixed bag. On the plus side, the crew members were notably friendly, which always makes a difference. A real bonus for parents is the kids' play area, allowing adults a chance to enjoy their meal while the children are occupied. The ordering and serving process was smooth and efficient during my visit. However, there are a few drawbacks. Compared to other McDonald's locations in Auckland, this one is quite small, and consequently, parking is limited. Finding the entrance can also be confusing; the signage isn't very clear, and it's easy to accidentally try entering through the exit if you're not paying close attention. Another area for improvement is table cleanliness. On this occasion, tables weren't cleared promptly after customers left, meaning leftover cups and tissues remained when new customers were looking for a seat. Finally, be aware that exiting the location can be challenging during busy traffic times, potentially adding a bit of delay to your journey. Overall, while the friendly staff, play area, and efficient service are positives, the small size, parking limitations, confusing entry, cleanliness issues, and tricky exit detract from the experience. It's decent for a quick bite, especially if you have kids, but be mindful of the potential inconveniences.

Last night 02/06/22 popped out for some late night snacks at around 9 pm. We asked for 2 x fillet of fish meals (fresh chips) & a cheese burger. Looks like the burgers were lazily made up here in Auckland North Shore. Fillet of fish was hard on the sides but cooked in the middle & how difficult is it to place cheese in the middle of a bun? We asked for fresh chips but they didn’t bother to salt it. Lazy packaging too, they might as well just have dumped everything together..oh wait they did.

Worst experience ever, serious health risks. They gave me the wrong order, the burger was old and hard to eat, worst burger i've ever had. Even worse, there was hard black rocks in the burger and fries that may have broken my teeth. When i told them they said they took a picture of the rocks and will show manager, no apology, refund or offer to replace it. Will see dentist soon and seek legal action for the dental damage caused. Will report this place to police or health and safety authority as well. I can't believe such a well known brand would serve unsafe food that breaks your teeth. I will make it my personal mission to bring you to justice for your abuse of unaware customers.
We just drove through and half the order is missing, I have tried calling and no answer
Every time i come to this place their drive through is always close

Best Dominos pizza I ever had in NZ. Staff is very friendly and was quick to make my order. I ordered 5 pizzas here including some healthy options with thin base and gluten free base. Everyone in the family loved the pizza. There is plenty of on-street parking. They offer fast delivery too. Their on going special deals can also be very useful to get huge discounts on the whole order.
Churro is ok. Pepporoni pizza is too crispy and dry

I ordered my pizzas through door dash, which was never delivered. The dominoes customer service were incredibly unhelpful, not completing the undelivered order in which it was then difficult for us to receive a refund from door dash. Very disappointed and poor customer service. Will never order from here again after this experience.

I got a pizza from this shop and found a hair stuck in one of them. I told the manager about this and the instant feedback was 'isn't this your hair? There is nothing'. Obviously, it was not cuz it was 'stuck' inside the pizza. This accusation made me upset so asked for a refund but he said no and offered another pizza with such attitude. Was my favourite shop, but never again.
Have you eat paneer pizza without paneer? 🤔.that was last time. To give second chance I revisited Belmont Dominos and this time there was actual paneer in paneer Pizza 🍕.🥳🙂. Kudos to Domino's

I love this service. The restaurant was going to close but they make order for us at last minute, where they finish everything, but the guy name”logee” he said yes and he made a pizza for us. On that night I felt he is a hero for us. “”Logge””🫡🫡🫡

I got 1 meter Limo pizza and two sides from Pizza Hut Belmont on Sunday, and absolutely loved the experience. Super friendly staff, the guy even helped me to put the huge pizza inside my car. The taste, the size everything perfect. Will definitely get back there.
Haha, Pizza Hut Belmont never lets me down! Pizzas are always hot, fresh, and full of flavour. The friendly service makes it even better. Perfect spot for a quick and tasty bite!

I preordered 8 pizzas for a small family party and by the time i went to pick them up ,pizzas were ready. The staff were very friendly and helped me to carry out all the pizzas outside. Pizzas were yummy and had generous amount of toppings as well.

We ordered 2 pizzas, Buffalo chicken pizza was served without cheese and other sauces (first time I saw a pizza without a cheese). No taste at all... whenever we request additional toppings, they forget it... ruined the weekend mood... I understand they were too busy with orders but that's not the justification.

We tried the salt & chilli chicken, Shanghai noodles, and of course, the donut. The chicken was packed with flavour and the portion was super generous. Most of the dishes here are around $21–$22, which is pretty good value considering how much food you get. The Shanghai noodles had a nice mix of meats. The lady owner who served us was so lovely and friendly.

I got a sweet and sour pork $18. No rice, no veges, only pork pieces in batter with sauce that was very strong vinegar. The last owner used to be really good, the new owner seems to get worse and worse everytime I try it. No more.
Beautiful service. Kind workers and the food is really good. Fried wontons were so yummy and big. Fish was lovely too. Thank you 🤩

We ordered take away tonight Chicken chow mien which was flavourless, chicken was slimy and not like chicken …. Noodles were hard, sadly it was inedible, as was the pork and prawn fried rice flavourless minimal protein of prawn and pork We called the takeaway shop before deciding to write this review to share our feedback and were told to (and this is a quote) “ask for more flavour and freshness next time” - excuse me ??? Ask for more freshness next time ….next time - there won’t be a next time . Disappointed is a understatement We will not return
Beautiful chips and great wonton!!. If I am ever in the area again, I would definitely be happy to grab dinner from here. Very friendly service too
Nice little local bar with pleasant surroundings, friendly staff and interesting friendly locals. Carlsberg on tap, dart board pokies and plenty of screens for the big game.
Stopped in for a few drinks. Good service and fun place to stop at when bar hopping in the neighborhood.
Great place for drinks & food

Friendly enough staff, but a smokey, pokie machine drinking hole for middle to later aged! (mainly men!) And the food or snacks were supplied by the Turkish cafe next door! No kitchen on-site? Very small tubs of aioli or tomato sauce served with the wedges! Not what I was expecting just before seeing a play at the Rose Centre on a Friday night. But hey, it looks like the locals enjoyed it there! Just not our 'cup of tea'.

Love the Belmont Bar met some very lovely people a couple of whom recently found out we are cousins 😊.MJ is the bomb digidy always smiling happy to help when needed too. So I give 5*s actually 10*s. Recommend to everyone😊

Not giving 2 stars, food is usually decent. However this was different today. Prices are pretty bad, $18 for an average burger and chips were bland (again overpriced at $7 for a little box) - definitely needed salt and were overcooked. Hate to put in a negative review, kebabs are good

Tasty chicken satay kebab Good seating and outside too Took a little bit long but is was a sat 4pm ish. Not too bad and could sit in the sun to wait. Guy was funny...I asked for no onions and when he gave it to me he said "chicken satay kebab with extra onion" 😆 I panicked for a split second then realized he was joking! Easy parking Reasonable prices

We had a pretty average dinner here. The food wasn’t bad, but it wasn’t great. Either the aioli with the Kumera fries was the smallest tub of aioli I’ve ever been served, but everything tasted adequate, however they could do better. Will not likely return.

Service needs alot of improving, no customer service skills at all, came of rude and seemed like he was rushing us to order yet he had no customers. After ordering i was looking at the menu and he kept looking as if i was going to steal a drink from the fridge hha, yeah right!!! ...we purchased x3 of the $7 lunch deals, was ok not great, was missing abit of salt. Wouldnt come back here again.
Love it! Always try to make the owner Crack a smile and the food and service is great! Very tasty food.
Super fresh ingredients and clean. Never had stale sushi here. Also owners are kind and lovely. Take out recommend as they have a limited seating option.

Only take away due to it's a small store. Different variety of sushi available to choose from. Price are somehow friendly, not that expensive as expected. And the rice are cooked nicely so it tastes good. They have different branches throughout North Shore, boss is friendly and staffs too.
lovely people working there, and great sushi very fresh, some of the best in the north shore area!

Really good sushi and donburi. The staff are the owners and they're very friendly and accommodating. The ingredients are fresh, the food is freshly prepared and very vibrant and tasty. It's way ahead of of the average sushi joint!

Great sushi, the staff are always so lovely! There isn't really seating as its more takeaway, and they offer plastic containers or for an extra few cents a paper container. I always pay extra for a recyclable paper container as the sushi is so affordable that my total barely comes to anything anyway.

Sooo many Korean chicken joints could be found now days AND This is EASILY one of the top tier K chicken joints in Auckland; extremely crispy batter and seasoned very well both in and outside along with great service Have had it 30mins after a pick up/takeout and STILL crispy and hot as if right out from the deep frier; NO sogginess nor oiliness could be found!! Also very very MEATY Gotta try this place on the way to Devonport/Belmont/Bayswater beaches

My daughter really love the cheese ball here. Fried chicken taste so good and fresh, kumara fried was also nicely seasoned. We go back to every week 😊 Especially, the owner very lovely 🥰 she always give my daughter bonus

Last time I had the signature menus and today I Ordered Honey soy and butter and it tasted amazing 😊💞 Very quick services, and the food quality is consistently good! Highly recommended for everyone as you won't be able to find a better option for K fried chicken around the area 😋
Chicken is very crispy and delicious. Nice and friendly staff in the restaurant.
Best fried chicken in Northshore Auckland 😍😍 it was super crispy👌👌 soy garlic chicken was so nice!!!

We ordered the spicy basil crispy pork and the spicy fish dish which came with 2 rice. The mains were quite bigger portion than I expected. Both dish full of flavour and the spice level was lower than expected since we ordered medium. The snapper was really good texture, not too dry as well, slight crisp on outside. The sauce on both dish definitely needs to pair with rice as it is quite strong in flavour. Fish dish was slightly better than the pork but both were very good. Service is very good, owner is nice and refilled our water before we even finished it. Must try if you love Thai food and happen to be in the area
Excellent restaurant, I’m a regular and these guys are consistent every time! Very good portions and very tasty. Lovely people as well, highly recommend.

Just thought I would write a quick review – had a delicious Thai meal last night from you, appreciate you were busy and we did have to wait a wee while, however it was worth the wait. The service when we came to pick up was so friendly and the food was second to none. We love to have our Thai takeaway from you. Until next time, thank you!

Every bite was yum!! We been visiting the Thai At- ta-rote restaurant for our dinner. The staff is friendly and attentive. The food is consistently good, We are very impressed with brilliant Thai food!

Very friendly thai girl at counter who is a credit to the store. A welcoming and classy, genuine thai interior. Last time I had a pad thai & it was delicious. No issues. Last night I had a stir fry. Due to my lateness in ordering I guess they gave me something that had been in the wok for ages as it seemed it, the tofu looked old & I sadly got gastro as a result. Unfortunate. Otherwise, as good as any thai restaurant.

If you’re craving tacos with a warm, homey vibe — this place hits the spot. The staff feel like homies, super chill and welcoming. as soon as you walk in. It’s got that cozy, local feel that makes you want to come back. The food was solid. Flavors were enjoyable, and while not mind-blowing, it definitely satisfied the taco craving. Tortilla is very good quality.I’d give the taste a 3.75 out of 5 — tasty, but there’s still a bit of room to level up. Overall, a yummy spot worth checking out if you’re nearby. Great for casual eats with a side of good vibes. Plus there are so many gluten free choices and many options of hot sauce as well.

Needed a quick dinner and man this was better than most of the option around Belmont. Ask for 3 tacos and some guacamole and it was done in no more that 5 minutes. Almost everything was able to be gluten free and the chef explained that very clearly so all goods. Idk what char, smoke and seasoning is on the chicken but I want it everyday.
