Im not usually a hard shell taco kind of guy but this swung me especially the chicken taco. The tortilla chips were that extra bit crunchy with a charred taste which made them taste way better. The guacamole was a little over tangy for me but guacamole always runs a fine line when in the fridge. I seen the wing Wednesdays so I’ll be back for that reminds me of this place in Canada I used to go to. Lovely person working there would love to see more people in here showing some love

I have been meaning to try this place since we saw it open and by chance found ourselves here for dinner. This is without a doubt our new favourite local! The resaturant itself has a chilled, homey vibe - the perfect fit when you're looking for something affordable, fast, and relaxed (that isn't just take aways). The menu is divided by pricing which makes it easy to select what fits within your budget. The service and price point were good, but the food, nothing short of excellent. We had the BBQ wings & breakfast burrito. Flavour was on point, the amount of food we received exceeded expectation, and we left feeling satisfied both that we'd eaten enough and got what we paid for.

Best Quesidilla I have ever had. Try the brisket one. So tasty and definitely use the little lime wedge which adds a great flavour twist. Kids burger was also yum - nice big homemade patty. And perfect Tater Tots - who knew they could be so good.

They have a lot of gluten free options and were great about catering to celiac dietary requirements. Didn't have any adverse reactions so appreciate the care in avoiding cross-contamination. Fryer isn't GF but tacos, nachos, etc are safe. Very tasty food! Will be back.

Friendly owner, and nice meal. I go there at least once a week. “Butter chicken” and “Tikka Masala” are the normally I choose, but I want to try others. They also do lunch set, one is “Curry+rice+nann+soft drink” for $10 and the other is “Curry+rice”. You should try one if you pass by this road!
You can bet these guys can conjunct a beautiful butter chicken meal - the naan, the rice and curry are delicious. (I tend to ask them to make the mild butter not too sweet)

Amazing vegetarian curries every time. Have been going here fortnightly for the last year and it never disappoints. One curry and naan last me two meals. Can’t beat the value or the taste for the price anywhere in Auckland. 5 stars.

Was really impressed with my dishes. Goat curry was really good. The layers of flavours and spice show some great cooking. I do think the chicken curry would be better with thigh instead of Breast meat. I will be back!
Delicious, authentic - great value for money. The lamb was actually tender (falling apart), the Malabari Chicken had a charcoal smoked flavour. Would recommend.
Great fish and chips. Lady is running it by herself and does everything so efficiently. Will definitely be back - great mahi!

At first I thought lady was grumpy but she is just busy. She is a bit brusque to the server helper giu but the food is good and she is pleasant enough to customers. I guess it comes back to the fact that she is very busy.
Great quality and service. Made a phone order as I don’t think they’re online. We enjoyed the original batter fish (tarakihi) and chips. Also got two hot dogs. Would definitely come back again.

We moved to the area late last year and a few months later this chippie which is brilliant. The lady is very obliging, the fish is delicious, not dry and the batter light and not overdone. I have the pineapple fritters and I can actually taste the pineapple which isn't often the case elsewhere. The chips were excellent, not soggy and our battered sausages were very nice too. I forget about the potato fritters - there's actually a large pice of potato in the batter, which is clearly visible, which again is not the same in many other chippies. Well done, we'll be back for sure. The atmosphere is average, a bit tired but clean :-)
We placed a large order and the fish was beautiful and fresh. Everything was hot and tasted amazing. Highly recommend

Really good coffee and service. Love that they have alternative coffee options as well like matcha, matcha berry etc. Ordered an XL flat white, XL latte and Small matcha latte - all made and tasted great, prepared real quick and the server was friendly. Would def stop by here again if in the area ☺️
Burn the coffee so much that your tongue goes numb when you have some and your taste buds are ruined for the day -> after letting it cool for like 5 mins
Worst coffee in years. Completely undrinkable.
Great place to fill up and get a brew
Burnt mouth twice, have talked to staff but they just don't care and refuse to accept

Wining and Dining at Mudbrick: A Delightful Experience We arrived at Mudbrick, driving up the picturesque driveway, which at the end - welcomed us with trimmed hedges and fragrant lavender and rosemary bushes surrounding the venue - so serene and beautiful! Their restaurant is a stunning blend of sophistication and charm, with meticulously set tables upon rustic brick floors, offering a breathtaking view of Rangitoto and the glistening sea beyond. We decided to indulge in the two-course à la carte menu. I started with the dry-aged duck, which was for sure a treat. The dish came with a crispy croquette of pulled duck, duck topped with prosciutto, and a luscious korma sauce that added a depth of flavour. The Pav was a stunning work of art: crispy meringue, cream, and gorgeous flowers garnishing the top – the dish was almost too pretty to eat (spoiler alert: I ate it and thoroughly enjoyed it). We enjoyed two glasses of wine each. I opted for the Mudbrick Chardonnay and Pinot Gris, and both were delightful. What truly elevated the experience, though, was the service. The staff were attentive by taking the time to explain the menu and each dish/wine with such care and detail. This really made the whole experience feel even more special. I can’t wait to return to Mudbrick – the sunset bar and the cellar door are definitely on my list for next time! If you're looking for a beautiful spot to wine and dine with a stunning view, I highly recommend this place.

We just had the most incredible 2 night stay in Olive Cottage at Mudbrick. From the moment we arrived it felt like home. All of the staff, from the waitstaff in the restaurant to Anita from housekeeping to Karen in admin, were so welcoming to us and our toddler and went above and beyond. The cottage itself was beautiful, spotlessly clean and perfectly equipped. We loved the views and the comfy beds and particularly loved having our own private path to dinner. We had a car with us so it was a very quick 5 min trip to the local village where we quickly found the best coffee and fish and chips. Mudbrick is truly magical and if we ever find ourselves in NZ again we will definitely be returning!

We had a dinner after our elopement wedding and the service and quality was second to none. It was quiet being a Tuesday, and the younger guy who served us was amazing and attentive (can't quite remember his name possibly Lesley?) He finished his shift before we had finished dinner, so we mentioned to the FOH how great he was when we left - turns out he is usually behind the bar but made our evening one of the best ever!! Absolute legend and great food and wine.

This is a beautiful winery with some of the most stunning landscape trees I’ve ever seen and breathtaking, picturesque views of Waiheke Island. It’s the perfect place to relax and enjoy a glass of wine—I had the $23 red, which was similar to a Shiraz and absolutely delicious. The staff were also very friendly and welcoming, adding to the overall great experience.

Did the Waiheke tasting, 5 wines for $30. All of amazing standard, loved them all. Great service and chat with the young American lady (sorry didn’t get her name), you’re a credit to the wine industry. Great knowledge and friendly as to boot. Great views too, highly recommend

My wife and I went here as part of a Waiheke Island wine tour at several places, with Cable Bay Vineyards being the first stop (mid-March 2025). The property itself is absolutely gorgeous, and the views are breathtaking, overlooking the ocean from the hills. It was our sommelier’s 2nd class ever, but she was totally engaging, charming and professional. It made the experience that much more enjoyable. We sampled various different wines. The quality was good, but I admittedly had better for my personal tastes at other spots on this tour, as well as throughout our entire trip. Would still recommend if you’re making a day-trip ferry to the island!

Had a great time at Cable Bay! We did the wine tasting and it was definitely worth the money, got to try almost 8 different wines and they were all sooo good. The cheeseboard was delicious too. Loved the ambience: relaxed, beautiful, and perfect for enjoying good wine.
I went to the restaurant the last weekend, lovely place, very good food, same for the margaritas and the wines. And the staff is super cool. I recommend !

This vineyard restaurant in Waiheke is simply the best! Incredible sunset views, delicious food, amazing wine, and outstanding service. Every dish was packed with flavor, and the atmosphere was pure magic. A must-visit when you’re on the island!

Restaurant Review: Cable Bay is one of the few staple vineyards in Waiheke, potentially in the North Island. First, the wine was terrific. I had a reserved 2021 Chardonnay, which tasted great. I skipped the starter menu and ordered my favourite, the truffle fries. Small black truffle bits were used, which were like small crunchy flavour bombs. For my main I had the duck and it was exceptional, cooked to perfection with an amazing sauce that paired so well. Service was fast and concise. Absolutely great experience.

Took a group of 10 to celebrate a milestone Anniversary. We were fortunate to be there on a bluesky day with spectacular views over Auckland and the islands of the Waitemata . We had guests with particular dietary needs which were addressed fabulously by our wait staff , cocktails were delicious and other beverages were promptly delivered. Entrees and Mains were also delivered promptly and were of the highest order . We have already made a date for our next visit .
Stunning views, fantastic food, great service and the ambience was amazing! A must visit when visiting Waiheke Island! 👍

Review from our visit in June 2024 The Archive offers excellent flavors - the crudo of the day was beautifully fresh and the snapper bisque was rich and velvety. However, despite their top-notch taste, both dishes arrived in very small portions, which felt steep for the price, even as entrees.

Perfect spot for dinner. The sunset views were next level. The cocktails were so well crafted and delicious, and the food was beautifully balanced - strongly recommend the fish! So quiet and serene. Nature lovers will have the best time here!
Great place for lunch. Amazing atmosphere and great views of CBD Auckland. Food was delicious and service very friendly.

Had two amazing pizza dinners while staying at Waiheke Island. The lady owner was gracious and helpful. She advised me of the recent conversion of buses to accept card payments. Made it so much easier to get around on the short stay. Vegetarian pizza piping hot and made fresh. Recommend to anyone visiting the island.

Last night on the island we decided to pop down the road to a quiet resturant in Surfdale for a quick meal. The resturant wasn't busy so our expectations were low, however the meals were spectacular!! The pizzas are made up of super crunch thin base with loads of prawns, that were fresh and huge. I had a Malaysian beef curry which was delish!! Salads were fantastic too... pizza bread just delicious 😋. This resturant is family owned and we were really looked after. Great pricing, huge meals but also great qaulity.

Went here after moving into our new place and couldn’t be bothered to cook! Wife went for the goat curry, whilst I opted for ribs. Goat curry was out of this world and accompanied by some great Naan bread. Ribs fell off the bone and a massive amount of them accompanied with a plate stacked with slaw and chips! Absolutely loved the food and service and will certainly be back!

Overnight traffic diversions meant we had the whole place to ourselves. I'm sure the atmosphere would have been great had other dinners been here. Food was incredible and enjoyed by all in our family group.
Good beef curry, very suitable for a heavy taste lover
Great place to eat
“Live Saturday” music consists of Spotify and a mic. Owner is not friendly at all and very bad service.

Live Saturday night music...well if that isn't fala advertising, I don't know what is. The owner is rude, and clearly doesn't care about customers at all. We walked in on a Saturday night as a group of 20, the pub was empty, and we were treated very poorly. First time we were there and we will never go back. While curiosity doesn't kill the cat, trying Malones out may kill your vibe....

This place is a complete joke. The owner is clueless and unprofessional. Closing at 9pm on a Saturday is ridiculous! I can't believe I wasted my time and money here. I hope they go bankrupt soon so someone competent can take over. Avoid this bar at all costs!

DO NOT COME HERE, terrible service and closes at 9pm on a saturday, owner is lousy and doesn’t care about their customers. They’re probly nearing bankruptcy which would be a blessing because any new owner would be better than the current one. DISAPPOINTED
Genuine Irish pub, central location. Wine was expensive and the mixers were cheap 90c fizzy. Fine to hang out in for a while.
Best bakery I’ve went to in a while. The workers especially the cashier is nice and friendly. The food tastes amazing, flavourful which suits my asian taste buds. Not too much, not too bland.

Best spring rolls ever!!! So fresh and delicious every time. The wedges are also amazing. Great flavours. My son rates the pies 10/10. Great bakery in the island. Always our go to. Thanks for great food and great service.
From all my visits to Waiheke this place has the best pies 🥧 on the island.
Amazing pies I absolutely love this place definitely the best bakery on waiheke. I especially recommend the butter chicken pie 👍
Affordable , good range fresh food nice service
I just had the special tonight - caprese salad with prosciutto followed by dulce de leche cake. Amazing food and fantastic value. And they packed it for me to have at home. So good!!

"We dined at The Social at Waiheke’s Bowling Club last night, and wow, what an amazing experience! The menu was packed with delicious options, and we were spoilt for choice. I went with the slow-cooked beef ragu pasta dish, and it was an absolute delight—flavorful and generous in portion. We were a group of six, and everyone thoroughly enjoyed their meals. The mushroom risotto was another standout dish! The food was excellent, the service was friendly, and the prices were super affordable. As a visitor to Waiheke, I didn’t know what to expect, but this restaurant exceeded my expectations. Highly recommended—give it a try, you won’t be disappointed! Best of luck to the team; I wish you continued success!"
The lady suggested that I try the Mint As burger since it was my first time here. Delicious burger with a generous portion of chips! Highly recommend
Had the most amazing food here. 10/10 highly recommend. Definitely going to have to bring the family here. Such awesome food and service. Don’t hesitate to give it a try!

friendly, fast & amazing food...what more is there to say? everything was cooked there and then, the crunch on the chicken in the burgers (ordered the blackbird) was insane, buns toasted to perfection (may I add they didn't charge extra for gf), sauce was heavenly and didn't feel the usual need to add something more (usually that underused seasoning people forget about called SALT!!). chips with accompanying sauces were yum too - fresh, hot and crunchy. these guys are legends and a definite must.

beautiful burger, perfectly balanced flavours, and no extra cost for gluten free bread! The lady who owns it is super nice and genuinely cares about her food which is always the best! Thank you for your service!

I should have taken a photo, but I didn't because the fabulous smell caused me to get into the cheeseburger immediately! Without a doubt, it was the best burger I'd had that I could remember. Generous, awesome flavor, and a lovely atmosphere in the location. Without a doubt, I'll be back!

I decided to give this place a try after reading the Google reviews, and I’m so glad I did! The fish and chips here are one of the best I’ve ever had! The batter was perfectly crispy, while the fish inside was tender and flavourful. The fries were also amazing. The portions were generous, and everything was just so satisfying. The owner was incredibly kind and friendly, which made the experience even more enjoyable. If you’re in Waiheke island, I highly recommend stopping by. You won’t be disappointed!

AMAZING!!!!! The owner feels like the executive chef of a 7-star hotel and is very friendly. The fish was the best I've ever had♡♡♡ They use fresh ingredients and the price is very reasonable.Thank you for selling delicious food at good prices on Waiheke Island, which is expensive. It's amazing that a piece of such delicious fish costs $6. Next time I will try fried mussels😊 Yum~~~

Found theses guys through a google search for best takeaways Waiheke, the reviews were great and they didn’t disappoint, fish burgers were out of this world and my battered Gurnard was fresh and crispy. They are about to close for a well deserved holiday so my only disappointment is that when I’m back on the island in a few weeks they’ll still be on holiday!. I highly recommend 3 Fishes.

We went to the 3 fishes for lunch and had the best experience ever! The owner explained everything about the different fishes he got and then we got to try the fish & chips and also the calamari which were literally the best I ever had! Thanks again for the nice talk, the extra mashed peas and the curry and the delicious fish & chips! I’d definitely come back 😍

The best fish and chips I have EVER had!!! Hands down amazing!!! Curry sauce was unbelievably good, same with the gravy and the prawns. Batter on the fish was so crispy and brilliant. Crumbed fish was equally excellent. Very generous on all items as well. Spread the word, these guys deserve it!!!

Dumpling Mania is a great little dumpling stall. Fresh and delicious. The ‘Momo’ Nepalese dumplings were fantastic a slightly dryer and more tomato than any other dumplings I’ve tried from Asia. I forgot to photograph them and I could eat another 30….ok 50! 👍😀

Wow! What a find on the island! This place is SOOOO good. I had the fried noodles and dumplings, both amazing. Nothing like the home made taste of a juicy delicious dumpling. The sauce was also incredible. Hunt out this spot, take a seat at the cute outdoor table and indulge in a hearty meal you won’t regret.

Absolutely delicious! Dumpling Maniac is a hidden gem on Waiheke. Every bite was packed with flavor, and the dumplings were perfectly cooked—crispy bottoms, juicy fillings, and so many creative options to choose from. The staff were super friendly and welcoming, and the vibe was laid-back but full of heart. You can tell there's real love behind the food. Don’t miss the handmade chili oil—it’s next level. A must-visit spot whether you're a dumpling lover or just craving something comforting and fresh. We’ll definitely be back!
The owner is Nepali and very friendly.The dumplings are also very delicious. I highly recommend 👍👍

I’m literally at home still eating after having said wow 20 times. My son and I order the the chef’s recommendations and it was great. I’ve been here 15 years and this is one of the best things on the island.

Absolutely amazing food here. The beef brisket was cooked to perfection. So well that the fat was even soft. Amazing loaded fries. Friendly as service and hardly any wait time. 100% would recommend going here!
Best burger to grab before catching the ferry, juicy and finger-licking good! What impressed me most was the exceptional speed of service. Don’t miss out if you’re in the Ostend area!
Absolutely delicious food!! Very good customer service and friendly owners. Nice space outside to sit and enjoy your food. Very good value for the price. Highly recommend!

Let me tell you, Smokeland BBQ isn’t just a meal—it’s a life-changing experience. Forget all those pretentious fine dining spots on the island where they serve you a drizzle of sauce and call it a masterpiece. Here, you get real food that tastes so good, you’ll wonder if the chef made a deal with the devil. First off, the wedges. These aren’t just wedges—they’re golden chunks of crispy heaven. They’re so good they deserve their own national holiday. Perfectly seasoned, crispy on the outside, fluffy on the inside—I was tempted to write them a love letter but figured eating them was a better use of my time. Now, let’s talk about the pork belly burger. Juicy, flavorful, and so stacked it looked like it was doing squats in the back before hitting my plate. Every bite was a party in my mouth, and everyone was invited. And here’s the kicker: I got all that—wedges AND the burger—for just over 20 bucks. Twenty. Freaking. Bucks. That’s not a meal; that’s daylight robbery… but Smokeland is doing the robbing, and we’re the lucky victims. The chef? Absolute legend. Friendlier than your nan at Christmas, but with skills in the kitchen that would make Gordon Ramsay cry tears of joy. You can tell he loves what he does, and it shows in every bite. So, if you’re on the island debating between Smokeland BBQ and some fancy place where the waiter calls you “sir” and the bill makes you weep, do yourself a favor—go to Smokeland BBQ. It’s better food, better value, and I promise you’ll leave happier, fuller, and maybe even questioning why you ever settled for anything less. Smokeland, you’ve set the bar so high it’s practically in orbit. Bravo.
Genuinely the best most succulent ribs I've ever had and the atmosphere was amazing awesome music choice and very friendly staff. Would recommend to everyone everywhere.
Awesome bistro! Chef's homemade pasta is delicious. Ragu and ravioli? Phenomenal. Can't wait to go back!

Delicious fresh pasta and really good portion sizes (especially for a hungry male). We got the creamy mushroom fettuccine and short rib Ragu - both were yum. We also got the Oreo tartlette which was insane and huge (no complaints)! Definitely an asset to the island

So tasty, you can tell the pasta is homemade! Cooked to order, it was a great dinner after being at work all day 🏆🍝🤤 I had the prawn garlic and chilli spaghetti, my friends had the carbonara and the chicken fettuccine ⭐
Fantastico! Beautiful handmade pasta, perfectly al dente and served with utterly delicious sauces. Come for the ragu or the carbonara 😋
Great pasta, fresh, good quantity serving, varied menu, good vegetarian options too.
I ordered beef korma but the meat is not real beef :( waste of money… i also tried the fish curry but they used frozen crumbed fish which was tasteless.. the only good options are chicken meals.
Absolutely the best Indian takeaway in Auckland - worth the trip to Waiheke just for a meal at Kiran's!

I wish I could give Kiran’s 100 stars. His food is spectacular, the best Indian food I have ever tasted. His Goat Curry is absolutely to die for, everything is so fresh and flavourful. You get so much for what you pay. The staff are friendly, approachable and helpful. I wish I could eat here every day of my life.

I cannot recommend Kiran’s Indian kitchen enough, every single thing we have tried on the menu has been utterly divine and the service is second to none! Great value for money & very flavourful food. Kiran has a heart of gold as well, I saw he offered his help to a community member who was struggling with their baby on the ferry. What a beautiful, local, family business to support!
The lamb saag, the naan bread, even the rice, are all super delicious! So happy and satisfied!

I always come to visit for some relatively cheap, yummy pizzas with my mates! Quick, easy to order, and lots of variety. They do takeaway which is great if you wanna take it and eat in a park, compared to having to wait in a restaurant and eating there. I took mine to the skatepark today!

Ostend Pizzeria isn’t just a place to grab a pizza—it’s a quiet savior in the dark hours of culinary desperation. On a night when Waiheke Island had seemingly packed up and gone to bed, leaving me stranded in a foodless limbo, they stayed open. Not just open, but welcoming, like a lighthouse guiding a weary sailor to shore. The pizza? A masterpiece. The base had that perfect balance of crispness and chew, a reminder that simplicity executed well is its own kind of luxury. The toppings were thoughtful, abundant without excess—each bite a symphony of flavor rather than a chaotic jam session. This wasn’t fast food; this was care in every slice. But what truly set them apart was their quiet heroism. They could have closed. They could have gone home, leaving me to forage for scraps like some tragic protagonist in a Victorian novel. But they didn’t. They stayed. And they delivered—on all counts. Ostend Pizzeria doesn’t just make pizza; they make moments. And on a night when all seemed lost, they reminded me that a good meal isn’t just about sustenance—it’s about connection, care, and maybe just a touch of magic.

Unfortunately, this place has taken a bad turn. Used to be the best takeaway spot on the island with good portions and good value. Now, the quality of food has dropped dramatically, the portion sizes have decreased, and they have bumped up their prices to reflect this? As a local who has ordered many times from these guys, unfortunately, I can't justify going back. The last portion I bought was partially burnt and partially uncooked which is impressive, literally tasted bitter. They have gotten greedy and neglected what made them a busy spot in the first place
Not Italian pizza. Really weird taste / spices. Maybe you could call it fusion? Super disappointed. Never again.

It's a takeaway pizza shop, much like domino's. There are tables out the front, we decided to stop and eat our pizza there. We got spicy meat ball, couldn't see the meat balls, but the overall flavour was great. Definitely would buy it again, Definitely will be back to try different pizzas.

Food was just incredible, I enjoy whatever I try, hardest thing is decide what to get, there is regular menu and as well special of the day. Will come back whenever I am on the island, thank you guys for great work!

We went there for a womens section event on a market day. Great atmosphere lovely people both staff and patrons and overall had a great day. Always enjoy going there and looking forward to the next one 😁
Food was delicious . Kitchen didn't open till 5:30. But lady still cooked me steak and eggs with chips. Thankful 🙏.
Very nice dinner, very friendly with prompt service 😀 👍
Immaculate presentation, friendly staff and personalized food preparation- thanks for the "custom" burger😁

Take a Bite Cafe and Bakery is a delightful little spot on Waiheke Island. We stopped in for coffee and a croissant, and both were absolutely amazing—fresh, flavourful, and comforting. The couple who run the place, I assume, were very warm and welcoming, making the experience even more enjoyable. It’s the kind of café that makes you feel at home right away. A perfect stop for a relaxed morning treat with genuine island hospitality.

We used their delivery service and ordered brunch / lunch for 20 people for the morning of our wedding while everyone was getting ready. Everything was absolutely delicious, and each dish exceeded our expectations. The food was fresh, beautifully presented, and packed with flavour. The delivery was right on time, which made everything stress free on our big day. Highly suggest the ham and cheese croissant!

Found this cafe by chance at the back of Waiheke Speciality Food store in Ostend. It's a great little cafe with excellent fresh food and nice, friendly service. The new owners took over 2 months ago. We bought fruit custard tarts to take away which were absolutely delicious. Highly recommend this place and will go back when I'm next on Waiheke Island.
Hidden little gem in Waiheke. We were very impressed with the food and coffees, at reasonable prices. Quiche and savoury tart were delicious, wholesome and fresh.
Best Ham & Cheese Croissant I’ve ever eaten!! So good! Special mention also to the cinnamon bun, and the breakfast calzone. Washed down with a lovely coffee. Highly recommend. :)
The best sushi I’ve had outside of Japan. Brilliant little takeaway spot and super friendly service. The Nami bowl was packed full of flavour and amazing value. Can’t recommend highly enough.
Food is amazing. She gave me a spicy soy sauce for free and it was delicious 😋❤

The Nami bowls are absolutely delicious! It’s great how you can choose your base, protein and sauce to customise it just to your liking. Thought the portions were very generous, especially when it came to the fresh salmon! Loved how there were so many different vegetables and pickles, kept things interesting. Also the service was top notch. If you’re after healthy takeaways, this place has you sorted. 🥒

I LOVE Nami!! It's so delicious and packed full of goodness. They are so friendly and well priced. It's a great little lunch spot and they also did some platters for my husband's 40th, which were a huge hit. YUM 😋
Very friendly staff and I really like their sushi and Asian salads

Did the 4 wine tasting for $30. The wines were of great quality and all very enjoyable. The Scottish lady’s (sorry didn’t get your name) service was very knowledgeable and engaging, thank you. I still reckon it’s more than a 7 min walk up the hill though!! 😉

I had a wonderful lunch at this restaurant! The starter—lamb ribs—was a bit of a surprise, but everything else absolutely delighted me. The highlight for me was the fish ravioli. I highly recommend ordering some focaccia on the side because not a single drop of that delicious sauce should go to waste. I was craving some rum baba, and this is definitely the place to find exactly what you’re looking for. It was incredibly tasty. The wine selection here is also top-notch, making the dining experience even better. The staff is friendly and attentive, always ready to recommend both food and drinks. Definitely a place worth visiting!

Absolutely fabulous food in a magical setting, and really great service too (thank you Holly). Would go so far as to say this was our best meal so far since arriving in Auckland several days ago.. such a fabulous, foodie city but this place takes it up to another level. That lamb! Those vegetables! Huge compliments to the chef

We thoroughly enjoyed the wine tasting experience at Te Motu Vineyard. The staff were fantastic storytellers and answered all our questions about the winery and the wines with great enthusiasm. The only criticism I have is that getting to the venue can be a bit of a hike (about 15–20 minutes) if you don’t have a car. While it wasn’t much of a problem for us, it’s something worth noting! Thankfully, the weather was lovely, so we got to enjoy the beautiful views along the way.

This place was by far the highlight of our waiheke trip! I have no idea why this place is not #1 on the winery list. Not only was the wine fabulous, the food was amazing. The chef deserves a Michelin star. Each dish was absolutely delicious. Definitely try the lamb ribs and the ceviche! It was so good! Service was lovely and they had a DJ set up for late afternoon. We had a baby so we left beforehand but it looked really fun! You can also take photos of the vineyards nearby. It truly was so great! I will definitely be back!!

This was the second winery I visited during my trip to Waiheke Island, and overall, it was decent. If you're catching the island tour bus, be prepared for a decent walk from the bus stop to the winery. The walk does come with some beautiful scenic views, though. When I visited, the winery appeared to be undergoing renovations, which limited access to certain areas and likely affected the overall experience. I did the $25 red wine tasting, which included three red wines that were quite enjoyable. I liked one enough to buy a bottle to take home for $65.

We dropped by Stonyridge Vineyard and were warmly greeted by their accommodating staff. The surroundings were absolutely beautiful—lush greenery, peaceful views, and a tranquil atmosphere that made us want to stay longer. We picked up a bottle of their popular red and took a moment to soak in the natural beauty around us. A lovely and relaxing stop that truly captures the charm of Waiheke Island.

We did visit a couple of vineyards during our day trip to Waiheke, and we loved Stonyridge. It was a bit less crowded than other major vineyards, but it has so much character. It is very peaceful, and the scenery is so beautiful. Highly recommended!
Highly recommend. Everything was super good! The stunning view from this place, wine and cheese 🤌🏻 Especially a stuff, Valentina. Her service was amazing! Definitely we will come back again.

An Unforgettable Experience at Stonyridge Vineyard – Waiheke Island I recently had the pleasure of visiting Stonyridge Vineyard on beautiful Waiheke Island, and wow — what an unforgettable experience from start to finish. To be honest, I’ve never really been much of a wine drinker - but that may have changed forever after this visit. From the moment we arrived, we were captivated by the stunning surroundings and relaxed, welcoming atmosphere. The vineyard itself is absolutely picturesque, like something out of a postcard. Shout-out to Ella for the warm welcoming as we went in! Your a star! Our wine-tasting was taken with Gary, and it was truly exceptional. His knowledge of both the wine and the vineyard’s rich history brought a whole new appreciation to the experience. He was passionate, engaging, and made learning about wine feel effortless and fun. After tasting a variety of wines and learning how to truly appreciate the flavors, I think I’ve officially converted! Pinot Gris may just be my new drink of choice! Gary, if you’re reading this - thank you for making it such a standout experience! 10/10 recommend Gary for your tastings! Now, let’s talk about the food… incredible!!. Every dish was bursting with flavor, beautifully plated, and perfectly paired with the wines. From rich, savory mains to delicate fresh starters, each bite felt thoughtfully crafted and elevated by the wine it was served with. But the real showstopper? The cheesecake! Hands down, 100/10. If I could eat it for breakfast, lunch, and dinner, I absolutely would. Creamy, dreamy, and melt-in-your-mouth delicious—it was the perfect sweet ending to a flawless meal! Thank you Chef Sam and Chef Arnaud! The staff were warm, friendly, and attentive throughout our visit, and I have to give a special mention to the Manager - Jaden - who was absolutely wonderful—approachable, professional, and clearly loved what they do. You could feel the positive energy flowing from the entire team. To the incredible team at Stonyridge - Chefs Sam and Arnaud, the staff (S/O to Vale, Kiki and Mathis), the wonderful manager Jaden, and of course Gary....THANK YOU for such a memorable day. I came in as someone unsure about wine, and left as a total convert with a new favorite drink and a full, happy heart. I’ll definitely be back!

Amazing location. Coupled with a winery with a lot of outdoor seating and activities to do. Food was excellent and the beer selection was good - both from the Waiheke brewery and other New Zealand breweries. The staff were wonderfully pleasant and polite. Very hospitable and welcoming. Definitely worth a stop.

I really enjoyed touring the entire island. I took the fuller ferry ⛴ from Auckland downtown area and then took the hop on and off bus 🚍. There are 15 stops on the island. It is the best way to go around the entire island stop number 11 has the best views. I highly recommend it.
Brontë and harry - running the archery and laser shooting are amazing instructors and very friendly! Would highly recommend to this place - great place and servers! Good food too!
Super cool place, really lovely here! Just got unlucky with our waittress.
Great spot! They close at 6pm on Saturday and we arrived just after 5om so a short visit but we can't wait to return. Beautiful spot and fun atmosphere. Beers and ciders were delicious.

We had an incredible experience at Wild Estate on Waiheke Island! The food was absolutely phenomenal – we ordered the roast for two, and honestly, it could’ve easily fed three or four people. Every bite was delicious and beautifully presented. The wine was equally amazing, with a great range to suit all tastes. What really stood out was how family-friendly the whole place is. We have three children, and the staff went out of their way to engage with them. Between archery, clay shooting, the playground, cornhole, and more, the kids were constantly entertained, which meant we could relax and enjoy the experience too. A truly fantastic day out for both adults and kids – we’ll definitely be back! Highly recommend to anyone visiting Waiheke.

We stopped by due to the delay of the ferry. Unexpectedly, it was such a wonderful experience. We even came back for a second round! Harry & Bronte were so nice to us. They guided us so carefully, kindly and funny even XD They are always so full of passion

Such a cool place. Wine is good. Bites are yummy and the staff working there are so cool! I had an awesome time doing archery today with Mahani. Definitely recommend checking them out. Such good vibes there.

Just steps away from the Hop On Hop Off drop off, Wild had so much to offer. We came in for a wine tasting, and since hubby doesn't drink wine, he had a cocktail, which they offer a wide variety as well. The wine tasting was nice, the description and knowledge of the server was educational. We left to try other wineries, but returned a short while later to have lunch. The food was amazing, and since they are also a brewery, I tried one of their beers (also good!) They have a ton of fun lawn games including archery and skeet for those interested! Such a fun and beautiful place to spend an afternoon.

Honestly, I was not impressed with this winery. It was super crowded and noisy (way too many kids), and the service was pretty abysmal, it took forever to get our order in. The wine also wasn't anything special. Would definitely recommend walking down the street to Postage Stamp Wines instead!

A Rainy Day Delight at Casita Miro 🍷⛅️ Despite visiting Casita Miro on a rainy day, the experience was nothing short of wonderful. Nestled on the slopes of Waiheke Island, the restaurant offered a cozy yet elegant ambiance, with our table affording a great view across the vineyard— atmospheric in the drizzle. We opted to share tapas for lunch, which included Croquetas de Queso de Cabra, Patatas Bravas, Gambas al Ajillo, and Ensalada de Tomate. Each dish was thoughtfully prepared, perfectly complemented by a glass of Rose wine. The standout dish was the Croquetas de Queso de Cabra—goat’s cheese balls drizzled with honey—a combination that was irresistible. The service was warm and efficient, adding to the overall relaxed and enjoyable vibe. Casita Miro proved to be a memorable lunch destination, rain or shine. A highly recommended stop if you’re exploring the delights of Waiheke Island.

Choosing Casita Miro as our wedding destination was the easiest decision of them all. We already knew we loved their food, wine and relaxing atmosphere, so getting to celebrate our special day at our favorite Waiheke vineyard was a dream come true. Liza our Event Manager was incredible (kind/patient/experienced/like a cool Aunty), and the team hosted our day from start to finish without a hitch. All our guests have since raved about the food, service and ambiance of our wedding and that’s all down to the epic team at Casita. We couldn’t have asked for a more perfect day. We look forward to celebrating each and every anniversary dining with you guys! Thank you all. Much love from the Lewis’.
A stunning place full of delicious food and beautiful surroundings. We tasted so much of the fantastic menu, and drank amazing wine. Highly recommend - looking forward to returning

This place is located on Waiheke Island and is a hidden gem serving great casual Spanish Tapas food. Highly recommend their Goat's Cheese Croqueta and the Patatas Bravas - which is Crispy Potatoes paired with their own dressing. Excellent views of the nearby Vineyard and has a very relaxed environment if you sit outside. Great spot to visit while on the island.
The ambience was absolutely amazing, striking just the right balance between cozy and elegant. Warm and friendly staff. Food was just excellent !

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ We had a wonderful experience at Tantalus Estate! The atmosphere was warm and inviting, and the service was exceptional. What impressed me the most was the restaurant’s consistency in delivering an outstanding menu. We first visited a year ago and were blown away by the delicious food. Coming back this time, we were thrilled to find the same high standards—every dish was amazing! It’s rare to find a place that maintains such excellence over time. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a top-tier dining experience!
Fantastic experience doing the chefs tasting. Unique flavours. Adaptable to dietary requirements such as gluten free. Great wines and beers.

Came here for a brunch and it was good! Appreciated that it's pet friendly as we bought our dog and he was able to sit in the shade with a bowl of water. Truffle fries were a hit and the cheeseboard was a good size to share within the group. Recommend the pork belly and beef fillet!

We had a really pleasant dining experience for lunch with family. When we arrived at the restaurant, we were 10 minutes early, which seemed to upset the general manager. After we entered, he locked the restaurant door behind us, so we decided to take a stroll around the grape vineyard while we waited. When it was time to be seated, he asked us to sit outside, but he still looked unhappy. However, it started to rain, so we requested to sit inside the restaurant instead. Luckily, we met Orlando, who truly made our day. He explained our order and drinks very well, and thanks to him, we ended up having a great time. We were fortunate to have him there to ensure we had a pleasant dining experience.

Stunning tasting room! Really beautiful atmosphere. We enjoyed our time wine and beer tasting here. Very much appreciated that they had beer as my husband doesn't like many wines (he was more than happy to come tasting with me)! Thanks for a wonderful visit.
Indy is a pleasure to know and experience and the Sri Lankan styled food and themed restaurant was by far the best Indian food I’ve had in my life. I can’t wait to go back for more of this.

Maybe the most authentic Sri Lankan cuisine in NZ. Took us right back to being in Lanka. Indy's got plenty of talent showcased by an impressive CV working in Auckland's top restaurants. Glad he's following his passion and representing SL cuisine so well. Some highlights to try are the devilled squid, mutton rolls and seafood kothu. Mostly a takeaway spot but there is a small table to sit down and eat there if you need.

Found this place randomly on Maps and given all of the good reviews, we wanted to try it out. We were very happy that we did! They only do take-away, but they were kind enough to let us eat at the counter. The fried chicken was juicy and the curry was really tasty and lighter than most curries. It’s not made with ghee, so it doesn’t make you feel too full. But the best thing we ate was the kotta! I highly recommend it! The owners were very kind and welcoming!
One of the best meals I had lately. Delicious, authentic, fresh and great portion size
Some of the most authentic Sri Lankan food I've ever had! Delicious, the chicken in the lumprais was so tender. Goat + fish curry were fantastic too. Generous portions to top it off!

Accidentally walked into this cafe after getting off the bus at an unplanned stop. Glad that we did. Awesome pies! I like my beef and cheese. So, I ordered more - mince and potato top. The beef/cheese pie is the best of them all.

We were surprised at how cheap the menu was — way more affordable than most places, especially on Waiheke! Pies were delicious and filling, and the kids absolutely loved the chips. Great value, friendly vibe — we’ll definitely be back.

Best cafe on the island! No doubt! Food is amazing, pies are Devine, and always a huge range, coffee is fabulous and it’s personal! They get to know ya! I highly recommend coming here if you are in the area, or make the trip to it, it’s worth it! It’s also cheap! Truly a lovely cafe!

Stopped in for lunch and bought one of the vegetarian pies. WOW! Full of large chunks of mushroom and other tasty goodies with a very light and delicious pastry. Highly recommended if you are going here. Sadly I didn't get a photo of it before I devoured it, but it looks like a pie should. I even went back a few days later and had another one, they are so good.

My daily breakfast combo fix! Just love it at Carpark cafe! If your just wanting a cold drink and pie this is your place to go! Or even a beautiful Thai chicken curry!!! Oh man I could share the whole menu I love it all!! Thanks jenny and team ❤️😍 highly recommended visiting if you haven’t!

Visited the Heke brewery and kitchen on day trip to Waiheke. The location is beautiful (and the weather was perfect). We started with Whiskey tasting in the brewery. Knowing our whiskeys and asking the right question turned our visit into quite a drinking experience. Well beyond what we just paid for. It was a great hour. The local distillery does punch above it weight. Do try! We followed with beers and meal at the restaurant. Beautiful food and friendly staff Great unforgettable afternoon.

The Heke is a must-visit on Waiheke Island. We enjoyed a relaxed atmosphere, friendly service, and great food. We ordered the lamb curry, chicken burger, and the whiskey truffle. Each dish was full of flavour and beautifully served. The highlight was scoring one of their renowned whiskey bottles to take home. With its kitchen, brewery, and distillery all in one location, The Heke offers a well-rounded and satisfying experience for food and drink lovers alike.

We had the absolute best time here! We went to have a whisky and beer tasting and Myron was so knowledgeable on the processes for all of the spirits and beers with so much background knowledge. He was the best! We had lunch afterwards and the chicken and cocktails were so delicious with nice quick service. The waitress we had was also super sweet! Highly recommend for people that love whisky, beer, great food and a nice gin. Great views to top it all off!

My Mum had a wonderful Mother's Day thanks to The Heke, flowers on the table for her. Lovely friendly staff, delicious food and a not to be missed glass of their own "Jardim Botanical Gin". The dishes chosen were Grilled Pork Ribeye cooked to perfection, beautifully tender Roast Duck with Asian Salad and a very tasty Leek, Egg & Parmesan Crumble, wasn't a perfect match with our mains but it was our choice and we loved it. Great outdoor play area for kids too. Keep up the good work!
Awesome vibes and delicious food! Had a great lunch at the Heke. Loved the ease of using the QR code to order and food came in good time.

Great cheap feed. Excellent portion sizes that are hot, freshly made, and delish. The fish burger is so yum and so is the veggie burger which has a potato fritter, a fried egg, cheese, and veg. Insanely good value, especially for the island. Never disappoints for what it is.
Cute little Island takeaway. Fish burger was ok, but the chips were outstanding. Recommended.
Delicious food! Really big portions and good prices. Coming back again!

Egg foo-yong was burnt quite badly. Could not have anymore as it tasted really bad. Sweet and sour chicken barely had any sauce or flavour. The chow mein was watery and again had no flavour. Very disappointed by the quality of the food. One star from me purely because of the service.

This has to be one of the best takeaways on the island. This is a dedicated family that know how to cook with flavor and flair. Well priced, quick even when under pressure. We'll worth the trip to see them for a takeaway of your choice. There is a park over the road if you want to sit and eat close by. Close to plenty of public transport to get to a beach for a picnic.

This is a solid spot for pizza and pasta, offering good quality dishes made by an authentic Italian chef. While the location right next to a busy road might not make it the most inviting place to dine in, it’s an good choice for takeaway.

Delicious, authentic Italian pizza and pasta at reasonably priced pricing! We highly recommend it and would love to return when we next visit Waiheke. We also love their homemade Gelato nice treat for the summer. 💕

We loved eating at La Dolce Vita! Thank you so much for being happy to make vegan friendly food. The pizza with eggplant and vegan cheese and the pasta with olives were super delicious! The lemon gelato was also particularly refreshing. We also got the pasta marinara, carrot salad and mango, vegan chocolate and passionfruit gelato, which were yummy.

Had a small family dinner for the five of us. We love pasta as a family and I cook pretty decent pastas myself with homemade sauce. This was out of this world. Particular loved the October special and the three meat ragu.
Delicious authentic Italian pizza and reasonable prices! Highly recommend and we are definitely coming back when visiting Waiheke next time.
Best fish burger that there is, highly recommend, lovely staff and perfectly juicy and delicious. Good crispy chips and nice little spot. Really reasonable prices
What can I say? The picture speaks by itself. Lovely man cooking with so much love on his kitchen, delivers this massive and fresh fish burger, so good I felt on a food come afterwards!

Fantastic service, good burger but not a smash burger. On our occasion ordering a double beef burger the patties were thick and chunky cooked medium rare, then set side by side. If smashed properly to be mm thin and stacked upon each other the burgers would have been perfect. Good sauce and cheese ratios.

Ordered chips and battered hoki. I didn't love the hoki, felt it was slightly overcooked and had an odd aftertaste, but the battery was light and lovely. Decent sized hoki fillet, easily fed 2. Generous scooping of chips, and have to say the chips were cooked and drained to perfection. Crunchy chips, not greasy, and really well seasoned.

The fish tasted like bait. Had a lot of pepper to mask the scent of the fish.The chips and onion rings were nice but the crab sticks weren’t very good either. Went and told the owner about the off fish and he denied it and took a bite out of it and carried on denying it was off, he was quite arrogant about it and unfortunately the 7 of us were very disappointed about it. DO NOT GO HERE!

Great spot on Waiheke Island. We went for a quick trip and felt hungry. We decided to give the restaurant a try and oh boy - did we made the right decision. Food was absolutely incredible. Super friendly staff and overall great experience.

Located right at the beach, this restaurant offers amazing views all over. The staff seemed very rushed and did not really welcome us nicely unfortunately. The food made up for it, as the fish and chips were great. The price is on the higher side though.
We had the ice cream, very average and served half melted. The ice cream tasted good but a bit too sweet. Hope they can improve on that.

Had no idea where to go on the island but stumbled across this place and it was very busy, we managed to get a table outside, which was brilliant on a sunny day to enjoy the Seaview. We were advised when ordering, there would be a wait of approx 40 mins which was appreciated. Had the fish and chips, and it was a big meal. The fish was tasty, not greasy, and the chips were crunchy. I would definitely go back if I make back to waiheke. Staff were very attentive drinks delivered fairly quickly and price wise it was very reasonable one for being on an island but also the size of the meal as well.

This was the best fish I've ever had, Asian style and the perfect level of spice! We also had the wagu burger which was amazing. They have an app to order drinks to the table, the place overlooks the beach and ocean, overall it was an amazing experience!

My husband, friends and I had an exceptional time. The service was very attentive without being overbearing. The atmosphere (right on beach) was enjoyable. Food was delicious. There were so many flavors and textures. We had creamed paua, rotolo pasta, fried eggplant, braised goat shoulder and crispy potatoes. We liked them all and couldn't pick just one as a favorite. Highly recommend!

Interesting and delicious meal. Sharing dishes are generous (we had plenty for 3 people). The smoked fish was wonderful as were the crushed roast potatoes. Wine available by the glass. Service friendly and attentive. Ideal location facing the spectacularly long beach front of Onetangi.

Had lunch at Three Seven Two as part of a Waiheke Wine Tour and I could not have asked/wished for a better spot! The location right by the beach is beautiful and the food exceptional! Service was friendly and efficient throughout, I hope to be able to return.

This place was so good we went there two days in a row. Probably the best potato’s I’ve had! All the food was stunning and very well priced. Staff and service was incredible. Worth a trip to Waiheke Island just to eat there.

My wife & I were here for lunch as part of a Waiheke wine tour (mid-March 2025). Right on the water/beach, beautiful outdoor dining, great drink selections (especially for wine), friendly staff and the food was outstanding. Would highly recommend to anyone visiting the Waiheke Island area, especially for a beach day 🍷🏖️😊
Lovely meal on the beach. Great views. It was pretty quiet so service was attentive. The food and wines were extensive. Good seafood selection. Very classy set out inside so not your pub grub

We had a great Easter Sunday dinner at Ki Maha. The lamb and eye fillet were next-level tasty, and don’t even get me started on the olive bread. We had the Otiake Pino noir which was terrific. The staff were absolute legends, nailed it all night. Thanks guys 💯

We had an amazing dining experience at Ki Maha restaurant as well as the view was extraordinary. The food was absolutely delicious. each dish was packed with flavor and perfectly cooked. What really made the experience special was the service.. The staff were attentive, friendly and made us feel like valued guests. They went above and beyond to ensure we had everything we needed. We'll definitely be coming back for more great food and top-notch service.. Highly Recommend !

this restaurant has the best location on the island! the food, the service everything was top notch! and the scallops are to die for. we tried most of the starters and i would recommend to do the same! special thanks to the bar for the delicious guava chili margarita and violette dream✨

Impeccably fast and friendly service, the food was out of this world and the environment was beautiful. Spent a lot of money but so worth it and service by Hasitha and Tom was absolutely brilliant. You can tell they put time and care into every single customer and even personalised the experience to you. It was our anniversary and they took the time to write happy anniversary on our dessert plate and put a candle on it which was so kind and thoughtful. Best customer service I have ever experienced! Must go spot on walheke if you want food made with love and exceptional customer service. Thank you so much, Eden and Miles ❤️
The fish burger here was so good! I didn’t have high expectations but it was so much better than I could have expected! I would highly recommend eating here!
Fish burger, toasted Reuben sandwich and coffee in the winter Waiheke sun. Delicious.

Lovely little spot for coffee and I had a sensational caprese sandwich. The Turkish toast was super fresh as were the filings. Even though probably not meant to be toasted I asked for it toasted and it was delicious! Awesome view as well.

Amazing sandwiches and cabinet pastries - including a pretty darn good cheese scone; soft and fluffy on the inside, crisp on the outside. Delicious. High reconmend to the great fish burger, and very good coffee too.
What a delicious meal we had here. Fish and fries par excellent 👌 so tasty and incredible portions. Friendly smiling service, what more could one desire. Be sure to stop here on your way through.

As a wedding photographer, I've had the pleasure of working at Settlers Country Manor many times. The venue offers a elegant backdrops, with stunning gardens, historic architecture, and beautiful lighting throughout the day, perfect for capturing unforgettable moments. Abigail and her team are professional and accommodating. Always a joy to return here!

We booked a table for Sunday lunch for four people. We two arrived slightly later than our lunch partners and were greeted with a very friendly "pleased to see you" smile by one of the staff. Informed our friends were already seated the 'greeter' casually asked if the lunch was celebrating anything in particular and, equally as casually, we replied it was a small birthday lunch. The food was excellent, all of it - without exception - the staff were so very efficient, smiling and friendly, despite having three separate very large groups to contend with at the same time and were very attentive. Service was excellent and we were able to linger without being hurried. The portions were overly adequate and so very well presented. At the end of the meal arrived a plate with Macaroons, chocolate fudge cake with a lit candle and 'Happy Birthday' cleverly written in chocolate on it for the Birthday girl. This was without it being requested, they just remembered the original conversation. We had not been to Settlers for some 20 years and it was such a pleasant surprise to see just what an excellent restaurant it now is. We could not fault it and will certainly visit again .... next week in fact! We can highly recommend it.

We celebrated our wedding on March 8, 2025, at Settlers Country Manor, and it was an unforgettable experience. After visiting several venues, we instantly fell in love with Settlers Country Manor. The venue is stunning, with its unique character and beautiful gardens that are perfect for wedding photos. Abigail gave us a tour, and we immediately decided it was the perfect place for our special day. The venue offers multiple outdoor spots for the ceremony, as well as indoor options in case of bad weather. The Luxe Bridal Room upstairs, which we hired as well, is spacious and beautiful, providing a perfect setting for the bride and bridesmaids to get ready and take those first "getting ready" photos. We also hired the honeymoon suite, which was a great decision as it allowed us to relax and enjoy the day without worrying about driving afterward. Abigail was incredibly supportive throughout the planning process, always responding promptly to my numerous emails. On the day of the wedding, the friendly Settlers Manor team greeted us and helped with all our bags and boxes. The venue opens at 10:30 am, and our ceremony was at 3:30 pm, giving us plenty of time to get ready in the Luxe Bridal Room. Any requests we had were promptly attended to, which greatly reduced the stress of the day. The venue offers both set menu and buffet options. With around 100 guests, we chose the buffet, and it was a fantastic choice. The food was amazing, and there was plenty for everyone. Abigail even arranged a special meal for our 2-year-old daughter and ensured her food was heated and served at our table. Later in the evening, they even provided a bottle of milk for her, which was a thoughtful touch that I greatly appreciated. We had the venue until 11 pm, but when some guests stayed longer, the Settlers Manor team graciously allowed us to continue enjoying our time by the fountain until midnight. This extra hour was invaluable, as it was the only time I could relax and chat with our guests after a busy day. After the wedding, we received countless compliments from our guests about the beautiful venue, delicious food, and friendly staff. It was an amazing experience, and we are so glad we chose Settlers Country Manor for our special day. Thank you, Abigail and the team, for making our wedding day truly memorable for us and our guests.

Me and my husband got married at the Settlers in early May 2025. I fell in love with the venue- it was love at first sight! haha Abigail was very supportive and always responded via email very fast. The food was AMAZING, the atmosphere of the venue is fantastic and makes you not want to leave! The whole wedding was like a dream and I would definitely highly recommend this venue for anyone who would like to experience a 'princess in a castle' type of wedding, it was just superb!

Me and my Husband celebrated our wedding at Setters last Saturday. It was by far the most perfect day, we couldn’t have asked for a more beautiful venue and wonderful team at Settlers. Abigail is amazing she was so kind and caring through the whole experience. From the first meeting until the day she was always prompt in her helpful replies and of making our vision come to life. The ceremony area is stunning, we chose the below garden ceremony area and it was perfect on the summery day with nice shelter from the trees. Cocktail hour was so much fun in the upper lawn and we were looked after with canapés and drinks getting brought to us by the team. Though the schedule went right out the window the team rolled with everything and it turned out to be the most amazing day. All our guests are still raving about the wonderful place and food!

This pizza shop is a hidden gem! The crust is perfectly crispy, the toppings are fresh, and the cheese is just the right amount of gooey. The service is friendly, and the atmosphere is cozy. Whether you’re craving a classic Margherita or a loaded meat lover’s pizza, they never disappoint. Highly recommended!

Have seen this place the last few times that I’ve got gas and decided to give it a go tonight… they have such a variety of options and honestly all sound amazing. Took about 10 minutes to order. Crazy good price for what you get and the quality of food is unreal… I grabbed the kiwi supreme and would definitely recommend, with a garlic bread and drink for only $20... Hopefully they get good support from the area because they’ve got to stay! Definitely my new local spot.
Amazing dough, heaps of yummy toppings. Lovely staff. Tastes better then hells pizza while being cheaper! Bravo guys!

That was a pleasant surprise! I wanted to try pizza from the recently opened shop just across the road, and my expectations were pretty low. We ordered two pizzas—Meat Lovers and Chicken Cranberry—and wow, these guys did a great job! A good base is 50% of success, and they nailed it. Toppings were delicious, making this my new favorite pizza spot in the area. Be mindful when ordering during peak hours—it might take longer than expected. But trust me, it’s better to wait a bit and get a perfectly cooked pizza than to settle for undercooked dough!
One of the best "Cheesy Fries" I have ever tasted. Drove there multiple times just to get this!

I have food intolerances - gluten, dairy, egg, and corn - and the staff asked the cook to come out to speak to me about which dishes I could eat. She heard gluten free and cleaned down the kitchen so she'd be prepared for cooking my meal! She was happy to make the meal as hot (or not!) as I liked it. Perfect meal, perfect handling of my intolerances, and fantastic service! I highly recommend.

First visit here and will definitely be back! Crisp fresh veges in the sesame pork stirfry, plenty of chicken and a good smoky wok taste in the chicken fried rice. And, best of all, really delicious pad Thai, with huge juicy prawns.
We've been to Sen Doe several times now. The food here is delicious and the service is friendly. They went out of their way to make Khao Soi for us, which wasn't even on the menu, and it was superb.

We recently moved to the area and were excited to try our new local Thai place. However the peanuts in our pad Thai were so stale we couldn't eat it, and the chicken did not taste fresh either. Preferring to go to the restaurant first, we politely called them to let them know, but were rudely brushed off. Definitely won't be back sorry.

Can not give enough stars for how amazing this restaurant is. The food is insanely delicious, everything is reasonably priced and the family style atmosphere and service is outstanding! We come here every chance we get, the take aways are also just as fantastic!

Stopped by to grab something quick from the shelves. It wasn’t busy at all and plenty of staff onsite. Took them 15 mins from order to pack a frittata that was just sitting there. It looked like they were using the same baking paper to toast everything and my frittata seemed like it had the sauce from the beef enchilada they were toasting before.
Great portion, consistent with great tasting food, very spacious for family and gatherings

Full Moon Café and Eatery – A Must-Visit in West Auckland Nestled just off the main road, Full Moon Café and Eatery is a fantastic little spot that punches well above its weight. The coffee is top-notch, made with care and precision, while the bakery selection is simply outstanding—especially the custard squares, which are to die for! The food is both delicious and reasonably priced, making it a great option whether you're after a quick bite or a leisurely meal. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, perfect for a relaxed break or a casual catch-up. What truly sets this café apart, though, is the exceptionally friendly staff who add to the charm and make you feel right at home. If you're in West Auckland and craving great coffee, fantastic food, and friendly service, Full Moon Café and Eatery is absolutely worth a visit!

12/1/25. First time here. Ordered a nice organic juice and their bacon eggs Benedict which was nicely cooked and had lots of flavour. This place is a great place to bring families kids friends or even yourself. Great selection of food and drinks. I would recommend this place and no doubt I would be back here in the future.

I can honestly say that this cafe is the best we have ever been to. This isn’t your typical cafe this place is seriously outstanding. The food and service and the atmosphere is amazing. Lovely staff, extremely welcoming owners. Nestled in the heart of Waimauku Village. You haven’t lived unless you have been to this wonderful place

The ambience was lovely, with a cozy fireplace adding warmth to the dining experience. Service was also excellent, attentive and friendly. We started with the cauliflower bites, but they were a letdown. The crumbs were overly thick, hard, and greasy, while the cauliflower itself was undercooked and unpleasantly tough. The flavor was decent, but the texture ruined it. The squid tasted alright, but like the cauliflower, it was far too oily. For mains, we ordered the pork hock and lamb shank. The portions were huge, but the tastes were disappointed.

Hosted my 60th birthday celebration here with several family members. Communication in advance with reservations staff was excellent. Requested table ready for us on arrival. Excellent, timely service. Delicious food. Highly recommended!

A beautiful place with nice young people trying their best to offer you a nice experience, but food was average without any wow factor...and one dish in particular, was beyond ridiculously small portion on a big plate...menubshould be revised, in my opinion...reduced (far too many pages!) and improved!

My mother and I had a lovely lunch at Gamekeepers at Settlers Country Manor. It was a rainy day, but the warm fire made it so cosy and inviting. Each dish was beautifully presented and delicious, and the attentive staff made us feel genuinely welcome. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a relaxing and memorable dining experience. We'll definitely return soon! Thank you again to the entire team! Warm wishes, Celia

Haven't been back since we had our wedding here. We ordered the escargot for starter, crispy tofu salad and the whole quail. The escargot was not what I expected. It was actually like a salad. The escargot itself didn't have the usual taste of how French prepared, it is more neutral flavour. The salad that the escargot sat on was actually very refreshing and tasty. A lot of flavours, olive oil, vinegar, red pepper corn, capers. Next was the quail. The quail was not too seasoned but more natural flavour which sat on creamy corn with some caramelised onion with some pomegranate. Interesting dish which served on a crazy looking plate. The tofu salad was very good, quite filling and have good char taste. Vegas cooked very well. Overall the menu is very unique here compare to a lot of other restaurant. Flavour and service both are good here. A bit pricier but good experience.

absolutely amazing food . One of their staff member Raj made our experience very enjoyable and pleasant, always made sure we were happy with everything which made of our visit a very pleasant experience. Thanks again, highly recommend it!

Place seems to not get as much attention as it deserves. We got mango lamb and butter lamb with potato stuffed naan and plain naan with 4 mango lassis because they were really good. Definitely recommend coming here. Forgot to take a photo before eating.
Very nice food great service by nice lady there , food was very nice and fresh.I recommend their special vegetarian curry.

We hosted a party there and all I have to say is - "We had an amazing time" . The staff was just superb. They were very accommodating, helpful and the service they provided was just awesome. Food was very tasty and fresh. All of our guests gave lots and lots of compliments about the venue and ofcourse food. Thanks a lot team for making our party a memorable one, will definitely host another!
Curry leaf is a beautiful restaurant and has a beautiful interior. Their food is delicious, it’s a 10/10. The people are really nice there!
Absolute gem!! Stopped while passing through, but would eat here every day if we were closer. Friendly staff, fabulous food, great service.

Best Japanese restaurant in Auckland!!! We love this place food is always so fresh and beautiful, service amazing and lovely atmosphere and very accomodating for our young daughter. Food is so delicious, highly recommend. We can’t wait to be back again soon.
By far the best Bento I have ever had. They know what they’re doing and the portions are very generous, great service also. Highly recommend!

Excellent spot lovely people. It's good having a blend of kiwi cafe fare with Japanese stuff as well at this place in kumeu. Will definitely be back. Destroyed the gallery breakfast on a bright but crisp northwest Auckland winter morning.
Lovely service, made my weird off the menu request for tuna on rice and tasted amazing!

Six years on, and nothing else compares to this place. The ambiance remains exceptional, and the food is even better. With an extensive selection of wines and drinks to perfectly complement the meals, and authentic flavours that transport you straight to their roots, this spot truly stands out. Hats off to Sunil and the team for building such an outstanding experience.

Been to a family party for dinner. The whole restaurant was booked out. Firstly the staff were really amazing. Their service was fantastic and the food (buffet) was awesome. Lovely ambiance and lighting. Thank you

We need to support local business more people! Had a good butter chicken with a really good peshwari naan and a cold kingfisher. Great modern restaurant with a really awesome well equipped bar …with cocktails at really good prices! Go and support them!

Hosted a baby shower and the experience was amazing. From food tasting till the event, everything went smoothly. Sunil sir was very accommodating and the overall service was fantastic. Goat curry, veg munchurian, veg pakodas, gulab jamun were some of the highlights from the food menu. Highly recommend Tandoori for food and hosting events.
Fantastic local Indian restaurant. We regularly get takeaways & recently dined in. Food is delicious & staff are friendly. Definitely our go to Indian restaurant

Unplanned visit to this cute family run cafe in Huapai. Tried the orange date scone which was delicious and the coffee was great. The staff were friendly and very accomodating - made last minute change to the order and they were willing to change it. Thank you!
Dined in today for breakfast and coffee - Great food/coffee, great atmosphere. Came out timely and the presentation was on point. Thank you for the experience!

Awesome little breakfast out in Huapai at The Food Vault. My partner went for the french toast which she couldn't stop raving about and I went for the salmon scramble which was beautiful. Santos coffee on the grinder which I am a big fan of, be sure to come and check this place out next time you're nearby. James Ashwin Kakapo Business Sales

AAAAA+++++ BEST coffee in Auckland / NZ. If your passing Kumeu drop in the staff are AMAZING - Great Laugh. Awesome Plumbers breakfast.....SOOOOOO BIG, love chorizo sausage & fresh sour dough toast. Yum Yum. See you when you open in 2025

Great little cafe, make there own goods, the pies looked great but I did not have one.. I had a coffee and friand and they tasted great. If going in winter don't sit under the roof window as it funnels cold air straight down. Staff were nice and friendly.
Via Uber Eats quick turnaround, food was terrible, took wrapping off and all the bread and filling fell apart never ever had this before also requested toasted and it was not, so disappointed

This place used to be one of the worst in Auckland. What a turn around! It's now the BEST and our go-to Subway. So clean and bright and that SMELL! I honestly can't get enough of it. The staff are so friendly too, and really stuff your Sub with veggies. Cannot recommend this place enough!

Well it's Subway innit?!? While your car is getting a WOF or if your at the barbers or maybe you fancy a pedi and mani from Ruby's, pop into Subbies and grab yaself a sexy lil' sub before you leave. Tell em MMXIII sent ya to get a 10% discount. Use my code: 10erOff You're welcome lad.

Man I love me some subway but boy oh boy what I love more is being able to walk in and not even really need to tell them what I want. The staff there get to know what you order pretry quickly even if you don't go in there often and always serve you with politeness and a smile. Hands down one of my favorite subway spots.

Wonderfully friendly gentleman served my sandwich today. He went out of his way to help me out and did so with a smile. The sandwich was tasty but the great customer service is what really stood out! Thank you so much!
Nice vibe, called in Thursday 7 August 2025 for a Guinness on tap $13 500ml, & the bar maid knows how to pour a Guinness ❤️ Nice fire going 🔥.

We love this place as our local.- the beers are cold the atmosphere is great. I cant complain about that. The only thing I hold as a negative is the price of food. The menu for pub food is bloody expensive. It was tasty and well cooked. I didn't particularly like mince on the meat lovers pizza. That didn't belong there. Overall we will be back often.

Good pub, friendly. Has live music on certain nights. Meals nice, good menu choice…a negative was the pepper sauce, it looked like a curdled blob & not appetising also it swamped the steak, was expecting the pepper sauce to be a gravy..disappointing & the steak was only average, other meals ok. Hope the sauces improve. Despite this, would still recommend.
Came here for lunch 1st time loved the taste of the kai but not the size/ portion. Would definitely return though surf & turf- steak was delicious

Good old local pub. Good food, good service, and good old range of drinks. Nothing fancy but that is reflected in the prices. Nothing like sitting on a stool at a leaner with a good pint of beer and a plate of fries!

We ordered dinner for family of 4. Sweet n sour pork, 2 battered sausages and a "$12 deal" of 2 fish, 2 potato fritters and a portion of fries. How disappointing the whole meal was. The pork was chewy and over cooked (reused?). The "deal" was a shameful small portion and cold fries too, not to mention there was only a very small amount of chips too. . The fish tasted old :(. I'll never go back here.

Usually love getting our takeaways here but ordered two mussel Fritters which my partner confirmed when picking up our order, only to have two single deep fried mussel when we opened it at home😔 not worth driving back out from Muriwai

The worst fish and chips I have ever had. Paid $7 something for the tiniest overcooked snapper, the “cheese” and potato balls actually had no cheese (not an over statement..) the kumura fries were dry and stale and the corn fritter tasted like raw dough with corn garnished in it. NEVER AGAIN! Do yourself a favour and don’t go here. We all feel sick after eating this food. Never have I ever felt conned by food before. This is unacceptable..

I bought this special fish and chips for $11 dolars and one nibles and fries for $22 dlrs And all these fries are the ones they made me, this is a shame and a scam!! It seems like a bad joke, I don't recommend this take away at all. I still can't believe that only that portion is put 🥲😤

This place is a bit hot and miss, if your desperate for just hot chips for a sandwich they not too bad although on occasion I have had chips that tastes like they had been microwaved. I wouldn’t recommend anything else they serve, my mum got fish and chips from them today and ordered snapper and we were given hoki we eat a lot of fish and bought up fishing so we can tell the difference. I got a potato fritter and it was mostly batter with a very thin piece of potato that was barely cooked. Hot dogs aren’t bad but not great. As I said not bad if your desperate as January most fish and chips shops are shut but if you have an option of somewhere better I wouldn’t bother.

60 min parking. Just long enough to get your meal. Really? Not even busy. Too few staff I guess. Hot chocolate was warm... apple pie was cold outside but warm filling, so I guess every has been waiting when I got sick of waiting and went to check that the restaurant was actually open. Really, they have a McDonald's traing school. Don't the owners need to go? Poor service reflects poor leadership, and that is the owners and the Corporation. Shut this place down as a way to protect the McDonald's brand.

Absolutely disgraceful service. Ordered at 7:17 PM with table delivery. My wrap came quickly but was clearly a kids’ size, absolutely not what I ordered.
