Had to walk it back myself—staff admitted the mistake and replaced it. Meanwhile, my husband’s order never arrived. We waited 30+ minutes. He went to the counter and was ignored for 5–10 minutes. Eventually, a woman in a black jacket (possibly the manager) told him his burger hadn’t even been made. When burger finally arrived. It was 7:51pm! Aside from that one staff member in the black jacket. It seems everyone else in the back making the food was disorganized, incompetent and seemed like they couldn’t care less. This is some of the worst service we’ve ever had at a McDonald’s. Unacceptable. Do better.

I don’t usually eat at McDonald’s, and I understand the stressful work behind customer service because I worked in it years ago. However, please make it clear in the system if the iced latte comes with sugar syrup or not. From my experience in New Zealand and Australia, a regular iced latte doesn’t contain any syrup. For someone who doesn’t regularly buy from McDonald’s, guessing that you need to press “customize” to remove the sugar is not easy, especially for someone who has never purchased coffee here before. If I came across as rude to the manager, she was even worse, as she failed to understand the customer’s point of view despite being a worker.

Decent maccas, but it really depends who you get making your food as to the quality unfortunately. The shakes are usually good but there is one staff member who makes them 3/4 full and are extremely runny, nothing like what they’re supposed to be. Chips are usually way too salty or hard and cold. One newer employee they have on the drive through has very basic English and you can’t really understand them or they can’t understand you. The worst part is the drive through though, it is basically impossible to manoeuvre around with a larger vehicle and I have no idea why they have added more bollards to make it even harder to get around??
A clean and quiet place, even the restrooms have no unpleasant odors. The atmosphere is very pleasant, and the service is incredibly fast

We had a medium roast lamb and roast beef dinner. This was my first time here after my husband had been the week before, and I must say I was impressed with the size of the meal. The roast potatoes were delicious, pumpkin and kumara also tasty. Peas and carrots along with a generous amount of gravy. The Service was friendly and prompt. Definitely a 5-star dinner
Bought two roasts, lamb and pork. Both very tasty and good proportions. Meat was well cooked and not too fatty. Friendly staff. Will go back again.

Was recommended to come here for dinner as it really nice food and it didn't disappoint, I had the roast pork meal with roast veggies.The meat was so tender and tasty along with the veggies and crackling. The meals were decent sized well worth the price.
Definitely our go to for roast meals and dam the chicken and roast potatoes are the shiz highly recommended 👍😁
Juicy and delicious meat. Must try their golden potato’s.

I ordered the vegetable noodles and was genuinely impressed — easily some of the best I’ve had in ages. The dish was loaded with a generous amount of fresh, crunchy vegetables, cooked to perfection. What I really appreciated was that it wasn’t greasy at all, just full of clean, balanced flavors with the right amount of seasoning. You can really taste the quality and care that went into making it. Whether you're a vegetarian or just love a good noodle dish, I’d highly recommend giving this a try. I’ll definitely be coming back for more!

We stopped here on our way to Piha . Small joint, great prices, friendly staff. I liked the Indo Chinese dishes the most. Also the lamb Rogan Josh was great. I could go there just for the Indo Chinese dishes.

I ordered a take away today and the food was authentic Indian taste . I ordered their special paneer and Veg Biryani and both of the dishes were yum . A must visit place for authentic indian food lovers in Kumeū
The food was good I’m both terms quantity and taste..that too in less price. totally worth it. They even gave free papadh as well.

Came away more than satisfied with our meal tonight! The food was brilliant. Everything tasted great. Highly recommend the paneer 65 for something different. Even threw in free pakoras and we had asked if they could swap our rice to coconut rice and they did that complimentary. We did order delivery and it was a bit later than expected, maybe that's why it was complimentary but still nice nonetheless! Kids loved their chicken korma ❤️ thank you so much! Looking forward to next time 😀
Super delicious pizzas, great price ($10-$15 ea) and awesome customer service. Large variety to choose from and sides and drinks are ample. Highly recommended
Love the food, great service. would definitely come back 😁

This place is a little gem of the best quality food hidden in small town NZ. The kebabs are just downright awesome with all ingredients fresh and you can tell the meat is actually really good quality. Free range chicken for the win! I've had the pizza's about 4 times now and each time I get a new flavour. The Hawaiian pizza with chicken is juicy and fresh and the chicken and Camembert makes christmas come early. Sometimes I even take the 25 minute drive from the city just to get food here. Definitely stop here at least once in your life when heading out to the west :)

The Falafel Kebab is just beautiful. Very tasty self made lentyl falafal and all the chicken meat, offered here, is free range too. On top of that the prices are very fair. Highly recommended for everyone who's looking for a good kebab!

Amazing food and its extremely well priced!! $12 for a large Hawaiian pizza... Everytime Ive got a clay oven pizza its been a minimum of $19! Ive also had the chicken and rice which was well priced as well (actually the cheapest and yummiest in the kumeu/huapai/waimauku area)

Come and support these guys! The food is absolutely amazing!! I highly recommend and rate this place. We ordered the Numbing Chicken. It was soooooooooooo good! It’s Sichuan Fried Chicken in this amazingly delicious coating……my mouth is watering for its deliciousness 1/2hr later while writing this review! Definitely coming back to try everything on the menu! I thought the Sichuan chicken I had in Taiwan was great….this Numbing Chicken from Captain Chicken Huapai Takeaways was even better!! Try them, you won’t be disappointed! *****UPDATE***** We went back again…….amazing!! We ordered the Numbing Chicken again because it’s sooooooo good, the sweet n sour pork and we tried the crispy fried boneless chicken. This chicken was INSANE!! The most crispiest fried chicken I’ve ever had…..and the chicken was moist and succulent! If you love crispy fried chicken……you have to try these guys!! You will not be disappointed!!! 👍😊 Well done and thank you Captain Chicken 👍❤️
Very very good 👌👌👌 One of the best numbing chickens I've ever had. For a little takeaway shop they are absolutely amazing. The place was super clean and food was really delish

Absolutely delicious! Chicken burger is really big but good, just the right amount if crunch with succulent chicken inside. My dad tells me the fish burger and kumara fries were Devine. Highly recommended.

Staff are friendly and dishes are super full but unfortunately the fried rice is just like boiled rice with some mixed veggies. It doesn't seem fried and no soy sauce etc? So it is super bland. The cashew stir-fry was also very bland. The Sweet and sour chicken was good pieces of chicken but just super average in taste. I gave 2 stars (instead of 1) for the first two points. Better options for flavour in the area in my opinion (I've tried them all).
Lovely little chip store. Got the burger because it's called captain chicken. Great burger. So so yum. Get the spicy sauce not that spicy but yum as.

I recently had the chance to try this pizza, and I have to say, it was absolutely delicious! The crust was perfectly baked—crispy on the outside and soft on the inside—and the toppings were fresh, flavorful, and generously portioned. The cheese was rich and gooey, and the sauce had just the right balance of sweetness and tang. You can really tell that care and quality ingredients go into every pie. The overall taste and texture were excellent, and it’s clear this place takes pride in delivering great food. It’s easily one of the best pizzas I’ve had in a long time. The variety on the menu also makes it easy to find something for everyone, whether you’re a fan of classic margherita or loaded meat lovers. If there’s one thing I’d suggest, it would be to make the prices a little more affordable. While the quality definitely justifies the cost, slightly lower prices would make it easier to enjoy this amazing pizza more often. That said, I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a satisfying and flavorful pizza experience—you won’t be disappointed!

Came to pick up my order—felt like a VIP because the food was hot and ready like it knew I was coming! Staff were super friendly (maybe they could smell my hunger), and parking was so easy I thought I was dreaming. 10/10 would let Domino’s ruin my diet again! “Logan was here. And hungry.”

We ordered a pizza and some chicken wings. Although we were trying to be nice and polite, we didn't receive the same back. The Indian lady at the till was rude and unfriendly. When she gave me the 2 boxes at the end, I said thank you and she didn't even acknowledge that with any gesture. A total poker face if you will. What's the problem? Does she not like to work there? Did she have a problems with us Asian? We can't understand the issue but we think we don't deserve that attitude
Cringe. $19 for a pizza the size of my hand?! Completely disappointing and not worth the money you’re paying
Added extra wedges and cheese. Cheese was fine but I got this small amount of wedges, makes me think what just a regular amount of wedges are….. very disappointed

Awesome service and even better food. Oysters fresh and crunchy fries burgers were yum been looking for a good fish n chip shop out west for a while now. They even gave their phone holders for my kids to be hands free while they eat. ( yes we needed the peace and quiet) Would definitely recommend and we have now found our regular fix of fresh Fish and chips.😁

Gold standard fish n chip shop. Excellent variety. Fresh tasting fish. Like straight from the sea fresh. No kidding. Chippies are bangers. Crispy AF. The burger needs some work but if I want a good burger I'd go to a burger place not fish n chip so no real judgement. And the owners or lady is so sweet and very friendly. And even have a selection of sauces!! You wouldn't find that anywhere else

Visiting Miriwai and decided to get something to eat and felt like fish n chips! This local shop (according to a local Kumue friend) has been around for years apparently and the snapper and oysters were so so so fresh and yummy!!!! Literally the best fish and chips I’ve ever had in my life. Owner/staff were super attentive and shop is so clean. The battered snapper was so crispy and oil used was real fresh too… Absolutely exceeded expectations. So happy to be supporting local businesses in Kumue. Will definitely come back soon
Absolute legends great quality and friendly staff!! Found a couple of returning customers here. Such fresh food.

Thought I'd try the new Big Carl Burger - WOW. What epic value for money, a burger which tastes better than some of those big chain takeaways... 100% recommend for anyone after their "burger fix". 10/10

We drove 30 minutes to buy food from their HQ and I tell you, after you taste their food, you'll forget you had to drive farther than usual to get good food. Their food makes me feel like I'm in cloud9. The flavors are bang on and just explodes in your mouth in delicious harmony. Affordable good food, rich flavors, awesome customer service, you cannot ask for more. 5 stars all the way. Check their socials for their food truck schedules too.
The limited menu options enhance the food’s quality. My assumption is the chefs really focus on perfecting each dish 😊. Great customer service. Their signature dish is exceptional.

Had their Spaghetti and Fried Chicken special. I love it! Felt like it was by birthday Siomai and Lumpia are the OG Hapunan Must try modern Filipino place out West Auckland. Call to pre-order, if needed, and no dine in space!

Hapunan is a hidden gem! The ambiance is cozy yet stylish, making it perfect for both casual dinners and special occasions. Every dish we ordered was thoughtfully prepared—flavorful, fresh, and beautifully presented. I especially loved the Diablo Adobo , Shanghai and Calamares —definitely a must-try! The service was warm and attentive without being overbearing. It’s clear the staff takes pride in what they do, and it really elevated the dining experience. I’ll absolutely be coming back and recommending Hapunan to friends and family. Ps: The spaghetti and chicken combo was super yum—comforting, flavorful, and perfectly cooked

Really tasty food, well balanced flavours. Love the ratio of meat, rice and salad. My partner doesn't eat salad so I happily had his share. So glad they had a pop up at Smales Farm but wished they could stay longer. The spaghetti and chicken was tasty too! Highly recommend the adobo, lechon and inasal.

The most beautiful staff & yummiest food! The best won ton soup I’ve had in forever!! I order one at least twice a week 😍 Their donburi is top tier & always cooked perfectly & so tasty! Highly recommend & lucky to have as one of our locals!!
Our favourite sushi spot, the owners are absolutely lovely and very accommodating to orders. The food is always fresh and delicious.
Purchased some Katsu Chicken, plenty of meat and way better than St Pierres. Good Value at $10

I'm not sure about all these 5 stars tbh, what we got was average at best. I also wouldnt usually write a review too, but I was so pumped for this when I read them, so potentially we had an off day? The dumplings were soggy and kind of expensive for what they were. As hubby said the best thing about the Laksa was that it was hot. The chicken was stringy and fatty at the same time? We ordered the chicken katsu curry, but didn't get the curry part. Ideally I should have checked before we left, but I did clarify when I ordered it. Overall just a bit meh, and we wont order from there again.

Real friendly owners that work hard to provide Huapai with fresh & flavourful food. My personal favourites are this Katsu chicken curry (below 👇) ,teriyaki tofu nigiri & the pineapple cream cheese sushi. Worth every cent.

Great food and service. We ordered a fried rice, Thai green curry noodles and the spring rolls. The spring rolls were delicious said handmade and the rice and noodles very yummy. The staff were happy and had great service. Will be back again

Garlic potatoes are a must have. Crunchy and flavourful...that's a no-fail right there. Everything else on their menu is a standard Chinese takeaway option. Nothing out of the usual...we tried their chicken noodles and satay noodles. Massive portion size, decent taste.
Their $10 deal is a must, 3 fish and chips

Fried rice very average - need more of/add soy source, oyster source and MSG Combination veg undercooked veggies Noodles - plain needs more seasonings Egg - good cooked well ( needs salt and pepper, yes I know most places don't add to eggs but needs it. ) Overall okay. However would not make the trip down again from helensville again.
I love their steak and egg toasted sandwiches and the fillings are always full nice to have a chap to them as they are cooking Great service Great prices Friendly staff Cheers

Gavin's the man. Had the best veggie pizza tonight since I've been in this country. I am a pizza fanatic and have been regularly eating at different Hell stores but tonight was something extra ordinary. The crust was crispy, abundance of toppings, just the right amount of cheese and sauces. My mother in law is travelling from overseas, she was blown away by the quality of pizza. The only downside to this is that she feels all the places in the country do similar pizzas. This store has set the standard immensely high for others to follow. Gavin knows his shit.

Worst experience to date, our order was cold and we waited over 30minutes. When I asked for an update on my order all staff were unsure and confused to who knew what. So unprofessional and I am absolutely disappointed with the overall experience. Our pizza had minimal toppings, far too much sauce which made the base was soggy in parts and our pizza was stuck to cardboard box on left side. When advise hells kumeu, No one wanted to try to resolve the issues or re do our order.
Went there for a pizza with my friends. Great prices, amazing service. Would highly recommend to everyone.
We have ordered a pandemonium and a brimstone and chicken wings We absolutely loved the pizzas and my kids loved the chicken wings Topping were in perfect amount and service was great.

Very very average pizzas. Lacked seasoning and flavour. The burger pizza tasted nothing like a burger. The Pandemonium pizza was bland and the Mischief pizza was super underwhelming. Pizza was made on time but there was no smile with the service. I won’t bother ordering from here again, it’s not worth the money.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ One of the best local spots around! Kumeu Bakehouse never misses — the pies are always hot and fresh, the baked goods are top-notch, and the coffee hits just right. It’s the kind of place you go to once and instantly become a regular. Shoutout to Brittany, always welcoming and super efficient. Friendly, fast, and always happy to help — can’t ask for more. If you’re in the area, this spot is a must. Great food and even better service.

Very impressed! Very busy with locals, truckies and tradies, always a sign of good food and service. A real value for money place to either stop and eat or pick up yummy, tasty cabinet food. Keep an eye out on the main road for it, especially if you have the kids with you. Good old icecreams and milkshakes too. Spotlessly clean, as are the toilets.
The baking is tasty, filling and an excellent price! The service was top class. Definitely recommend 🤗

Great little Bakehouse. Friendly staff, really good food. Very big menu and variety to choose from. Good Cornish pastry’s and my go to is the vanilla thickshakes. Get one every time I pass by haha Good clean and well looked after toilet too.
Consistently good food with quite a good selection definitely value for money been coming here for many years
Love your new Chicken Katsu look ! I’m drooling for one now. Super Yummy !!! 😋😋😋😋
Excellent sushi! I enjoyed their salmon avocado a lot, the salmon tasted really fresh. Would come again for more. Such a lovely place to get some yummy sushi.
The best & freshest sushi that I've ever eaten. Highly recommended. 👌👍
Fresh and beautiful array of sushi. Staff are very friendly and welcoming. Will definitely be coming back for more.
Yummy Sushi - Great staff. Thank you
We arrived slightly after peak lunch time but the staff were still welcoming and the food prepared well and super yummy. Many choices on menu. My vegerasian guests were delighted with their food.

Randomly chose a place for lunch during a work day, and it was a good choice. The employee was welcoming as well. Royal fried rice 9.2/10 What a dish. Had king prawns and shredded crab meat on top of the rice. Right balance of Veges and eggs through the rice, and the chili sauce that came with it had a nice heat. Must try if you come here.

Food was delicious. The curry was good but not my favorite the pumpkin was a bit undercooked and too watery for my liking and coconut flavor was too strong. This is my personal opinion but if you love coconut and soupy curry this one would be for you. Chicken strips was okay. The Pad Thai was the best. Would probably visit again yo try their other dishes.

Golden Silk Thai is a special place where very good food can be found. I am not unfamiliar with Golden Silk as the family have been getting take aways there for years. They provide a very authentic menu and is well worth spending time in the restaurant too as some of the best dishes are only served in the restaurant. Highly recommended
Had one of the best Penang Red Curries ever! Highly recommend Golden Silk Thai!

Great spot for lunch, the food was exceptional. Didn’t realise it was so close to Auckland CBD. No need to take the ferry to Waiheke with great local wineries like this one! We did a wine tasting too and the team were knowledgeable and friendly. Will definitely be back. Bonus that it’s dog friendly so will take my dog next time, plenty of outdoor seating.

We live near the Auckland CBD and it took less than 20 minutes to get to this beautiful estate. The food was beyond delicious. I’m not a very experienced wine drinker, so I went with one of the wines the server recommended (pinotage) and it was a great choice that paired well with what we ordered. The service was excellent and the venue was lovely. Would absolutely recommended to any couple looking for a great lunch to be enjoyed outdoors (as we did) or indoors if the weather isn’t as nice as it was today.

Had high tea for friends birthday. Chose the option with the bubbles. Service was good and staff friendly. Highly recommend the pot of Paris tea, very fragrant. My only issues was the sausage roll overcooked, burnt pastry on the bottom and overly dry meat and the basque cheesecake burnt on the bottom but everything else was lovely. The sandwiches were very tasty.

Four of us had the pleasure of "High Tea" today, to celebrate a very special double-numbers birthday for our sister/sister-in-law. We suspect that each of the 4 of us had quite different expectations, but all of us had a wunnerful time. The food provided was a spectacular array of mini delights (more than we could eat), and the two attentive people who served/waited on us were delightful. And it is always a plus to have a glass of bubbles at lunchtime. Thank you so much.

Stopped there today for lunch. Not disappointed. Place is beautiful. Very friendly stuff. Sun was shining which was great to have some food outdoors. We ordered the chicken breast and fish and chips. Chicken breast was outstanding. For myself I felt the portion wouldnt be enough but having some chips was the right amount for a person. Tasted amazing. Fish and chips was great. Massive shout out for the mayo with a bit of citric flavour. That thing was YUMMY. Changed the whole experience. Dessert was not that great though. Appearence was amazing but the chocolate brownie cake was very dry. It needed something to go together. The cake portion was too big for the ice-cream which finished first so eating the cake by itself wasn't the best experience. Overall the desert didn't ruin the great time we had there. Defs a place I would go again and try another plates.

These guys mean business and always deliver top quality food. I have eaten here countless times over the years and have never been disappointed. I always tend to order a chicken burger with fries and a soft drink. It works for me just fine, and what I love most is the freshness. Everything is freshly made, prices are good and I cannot fault them. Service and atmosphere are terrific as well, and as Kumeū continues to grow I hope they get even more customers.
Best value for money. Delicious moist chicken. Generous portion size. Courteous and happy bunch of people working here. Will be back again! Thank you.
Awesome Place. Was very accommodating. Got burger patty on salad with egg.
The best take away in kumeu, try the beef burgers they are lit! All the wraps are lit too!

The burgers we had were the perfect example of a traditional takeaways. Fresh buns lightly toasted, crispy lettuce and a homemade meat patty. My wife got the chicken burger and it had a large piece of breast meat.

We had an awesome night dining in. Table of 4. Staff were very attentive and on the mark. Jalapeño poppers were good... not too hot. We asked for dipping sauce after the entrée arrived, and this was quickly accompanied. I ordered the pork belly for my main and it was so super scrumptious! Pork strips were melt in the mouth and the crackling was on point. My husband ordered the Eye Fillet Steak and he was impressed also (which is rare haha) Tables were cleared fast. Really happy with our visit. Thanks so much to the team.
Service from wait staff was quick and Attentive. All the food was cooked perfectly, especially the steak! I ordered the surf n turf. Absolutely amazing thank you team 😁

Had the lamb shank, absolutely delicious, so soft and tender, just fell off the bone and finished with the sticky date and an affogato Bree and Cam were amazing servers Such a great place to have dinner and a few beers
Great revamp! Food was amazing (lamb shanks!!) And very friendly attentive staff. Can not be faulted. Shania and Aroha are fabulous waitresses, as were everyone there tonight.

A true local gem where everyone feels welcome. We absolutely love coming here; the food is always amazing with such a great variety of options to suit everyone. What makes it even better is how family-friendly the whole experience is. Our kids not only enjoy the delicious and well-portioned kids’ meals (the icecream is a great add on!), but they also look forward to the fun colouring activities available while we wait. It's the little touches like that which make all the difference. The atmosphere is welcoming and relaxed, and the owners are just lovely. Karina is warm, kind, and genuinely great with children. My kids absolutely adore her, which says a lot! We always leave happy and full, and it's become a go-to spot for our family to have a meal and a beer. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a great meal in a place where everyone, big and small, is made to feel right at home ❤️

We visited this spot in Kumeu with high hopes, as it's local and we absolutely love supporting our hard working local businesses. This place has a lot of potential to be a great Italian restaurant. The atmosphere was welcoming and had a good vibe, which definitely set the tone for a fun meal. The staff were friendly and provided great service throughout our visit. However, when it came to the pizza, it was a bit of a letdown. While the amount of cheese was spot on and satisfying, the quality of the meat was really not good. It was very processed, similar to what you’d find on a Domino’s or other cheap chain pizzas and didn’t live up to the authentic, high-quality flavors we were hoping and paid for. Overall, we really hope they reconsider the ingredients and improve the pizza so we can come back and enjoy it as a proper Italian dining experience. The place is very tired but has great potential, and with a few changes, like a nice music and good quality ingredients, it could definitely become a favorite in the area. We really need a nice, quality restaurant in this area and this could totally be the one.

Come and support this business!! A quaint retro, step back in time, family owned pizzeria in Kumeū….that’s not a foreign owned USA chain. We should be supporting more local businesses!! The service was brilliant…we had a young waitress who was bubbly and attentive, she made our experience even better. She was fantastic. We ordered the meat lovers pizza, the chicken peri peri pizza and the fries. The fries were brilliant….probably some of the best I’ve had from a pizzeria. Recommend. The pizza bases were great. The dough was proofed and cooked very well……but the quality of the toppings needs improving. The only thing on point was the cheese. The meat lovers pizza was good, but the quality of the meat was poor (if they used a different ham, it would have elevated it more). The chicken peri peri pizza was just ok. I feel the ratio of capsicum/vege mix was off (it wasn’t measured) so this unbalanced the pizza and the chicken flavors were lost. Maybe more chicken as it was more a vegetarian pizza. We had a great night dining in at Zac’s…….come and support this great business! I’m looking forward to their improvements and to trying them again.

Ordered a Fungi pizza (3/10) so bland I added salt to every slice I ate which Is something I’ve never done. Honey prawns - overcooked and rubbery. Flavour nice though And the star of the show- lasagna. One mouthful was enough. Drenched in tomato sauce it was basically swimming. Foul. The chefs need to have a look in the mirror

We have been a frequent customer at Zac’s Pizza, mostly ordering takeouts, but we decided to stop by for a dinner this time, and it did not disappoint! We started with the cocktail shrimp, which came in a generous portion and was absolutely delicious. The salad was fresh and vibrant, complemented by a unique and flavourful special ingredient sauce that really set it apart. For the main course, I had the steak, and it was everything I hoped for—tender, juicy, and perfectly cooked, with a rich and savory mushroom sauce. The service was excellent, and despite the restaurant being busy, we only had to wait around 20 minutes for our food. The staff here are always so friendly, with a smile on their faces, making us feel right at home. Plus, there’s plenty of parking out front, which makes everything even more convenient. We’ll definitely be back again soon!

Had a great experience here tonight. Yummy pizza! Fantastic atmosphere and loved the Italian background music. Thank you to Jess for being so helpful and providing a great service waiting on our table. Definitely recommend Zaks!

Loved our visit to Morepork. Something different but delicious. We were three adults and ordered the pulled lamb, the pork belly, potato salad, deviled eggs, spring rolls, a house salad and the best chips in Auckland, if not the country! The Mac spring rolls were very disappointing, tasteless, wouldn't recommend these. The portions were a good size. The salad, though, was big enough for four people! We came home with boxes of leftovers. The staff was very friendly and we were well looked after. We were celebrating a birthday so we pre-ordered a cake. It was a yummy chocolate cake and our friend was very happy with it. Only thing I would highly recommend is they need to place big signs on the road on both directions (coming from Auckland as well as coming from Kumeu center) as the entrance to this restaurant is easily missed. Good experience and will come back again.

We really enjoyed our visit! The grilled meats were delicious. The fries were crispy and satisfying, and the portions were generous. While the barbecue sauces and potato salad didn’t quite suit our table’s taste, we appreciated the variety offered. Overall, a great spot for a hearty meal with friends—just a few small tweaks like better sauce could make it even better!

I ordered the pulled chicken burger, not great. The bun is not nice, maybe it's the American soft style bun, and I didn't particularly like the BBQ sauce. The chips were good but very salty. Coleslaw is good. Hubby had the ribs. Which he liked, but at $67 plus the $10 side I felt it was pricey. The green bean salad was nothing special $10 for tinned /frozen beans. The pecan pie dessert is very sweet and the base too hard to cut, and for $3 extra you get a small squirt of cream which wasn't enough to balance out the sweetness. The atmosphere is average. The music a bit loud and heavy. The staff we encountered were good. It's definitely a restaurant suited to meat lovers, but for me sorry I was underwhelmed.

We tried the brisket, pulled pork, and mac & cheese, and every bite was spot on. The brisket was juicy with a beautiful smoke ring, and the pulled pork melted in my mouth. Their house made BBQ sauces add just the right kick especially the spicy one. Can’t wait to go back and try the ribs next time!
Great smoky flavors and very soft meat. The brisket was lovely but had a bit too much fat (at least in my order). Pork ribs had lots of meat 🍖

My wife got a mixed Shawarma and said it was good! I got a Lamb Doner over rice and it was good! We're Canadian so we base things off of our experience with our Canadian experiences. In my opinion, it's good. It's ideal. Nothing extraordinary, but good. Actually it's better than most places we've been here in NZ flavor and portion wise to the cost. And it felt clean! That's always important.

Great food and charming service. The quality of the Lamb and Chicken is exceptional. Even my fussiest daughter loves it! Order in advance because they are very popular. A friendly family run Kebab shop.

Goodness, I thought I was back in Melbourne. Such great food and service. Fresh and super tasty. Will definitely be back. Need to try the delicious looking felafel next time. We had chicken and lamb kebabs and chippies (which were still crispy when I got them home). A+
Great kebab place! Great service generous portions of food, we got the mix on rice added extra falafel which was awesome! I highly recommend coming here!

Such a long wait, only two staff on a busy night. No gloves worn. Bare hands going from taking telephone calls, writing orders, receiving money , touching food! Young female very stressed. Large kebab but fell apart. Meat was crunchy and tough. Very dissapointed 🙁

The food was so so so good, one of the best Indian food I've ever had in Auckland. Service was a bit slow, the restaurant was busy though, took pretty long for anyone to take our orders and took nearly 2 hours for the drinks and the dishes to come to the table Nevertheless We will definitely go back and highly recommend 👌
I ordered the food looking at all these reviews. But the food is terrible. Naan is so hard like a rubber and the chicken curry is terribly sweet.

We highly recommend Sangam, its the best Indian restaurant in the region - you won't be disappointed! The restaurant owners and staff make you feel at home and are very welcoming. There is a varied menu that caters for many dietary requirements - being vegan ourselves - find that they are very accommodating. The food is fantastically flavourable (main and sides) and as a regular have never found it to be lacking with ample portion sizes. There is loads safe parking and is easily accessed from the main road. Try it!

I had the spicy Himalayan prawns and vegetables and my friend, a spinach curry with rice. Both delicious. Very pleasant customer service. The only thing we requested was that staff changed the background music, from 90’s pop to traditional Indian music, which they did immediately - ‘ambience’ was then fine.

Highly recommended. Any new Indian restaurant I go to, I always ask for a hot butter chicken. This is how I benchmark. Sangram came in with one of the best butter chickens I have had in a long time! I always order a Peshwari Naan as well. Even though the Peshwari Naan was not on the menu, they made one for me! Impressed. The butter chicken and the naan were the highlight. What they can improve on….the mixed platter. It was a mixed review. The chicken tikka very tasty, samosa was ok and lamb was good. The onion bhaji was rock hard. Overall a $13 dish not a $26 dish. Come to Sangram for the butter chicken and a peshwari naan! You won’t be disappointed!

"Loved my Pizza Hut experience! The crust was perfect, toppings were generous,The pizza was piping hot, cheesy, and absolutely delicious. Will definitely order again!" and flavors were amazing. Great service and ambiance too. Highly recommend for a satisfying meal, "Pizza Hut exceeded my expectations! The online ordering process was seamless, and the delivery was super fast... thank you guys..

“I had a great experience at Pizza Hut Kumeu recently! The staff was friendly and attentive, and my order was ready quickly. The pizza was delicious—fresh, hot, and packed with flavor. I especially loved the stuffed crust, which was perfectly cheesy. The restaurant was clean and had a comfortable atmosphere, making it a nice place to dine in. I really appreciate the consistent quality and service. Keep up the great work!”
Earlier, my cat harassed by Louis, a few weeks ago, so to cool off, I came here. I got a pizza from here. The pizza's not that bad to be honest but what needed work was the cleanliness.

Pizza Hut Kumeu is a go-to spot for many pizza lovers, but my recent experience left a lot to be desired. I was really looking forward to a hot, cheesy slice, but what I got was barely warm. The lukewarm temperature made the cheese stiff and the toppings less flavorful. It just didn't have that fresh-out-of-the-oven appeal that makes pizza so satisfying. While the ingredients were okay, the lack of heat made me question the freshness. Pizza should be served hot for both taste and safety reasons. Another disturbing trait to the small joint was certain flavours of reverse Michael Jackson's had a distinctive pong to them, one that couldn't be concurred by the naked nose alone. Many were aware of the secret essence that lingered throughout the air while I was patiently waiting. It was a scent so unique, so unmistakable, emitting an aroma so potent that it could make your nose curl. Like a pungent concoction of musty gloves and a unique diet of spices, onions, garlic, etc Overall, Pizza Hut has served up some tasty pies in the past, but this time fell short. Hopefully, they can heat things up a bit for future orders and don't just buy axe body spray.
Great pizza, large Pizza hut and a nice clean and tidy work place. The staff were amazing and very friendly bunch.

The Chinglish Food is great. Have been coming here for several years never disappointed. I really like the Singapore Noodles. They're on the speciality menu. They're closed on Wednesdays , it catches us out every so often.
Worst fish & chips ever. Fish was soggy, plus heavily salted. Burger patty was barely cooked Scoop of chips was not even a handful size. Won't be returning here as quality doesn't equal price charged

Terrible! $59 worth of the worst takeaways ever. Couldn’t even get my order correct, and a $4 scoop of chips that I could hold in one hand. Phoned straight away, didn’t care and it was my fault. Wouldn’t go here again for all the money in china!

Yum!! Order over the phone, good communication order was done early! Got a combinations chow mein with crispy noodles $20. Great portion sizes of meat and veggies, noodles were on the side so they didn’t go soggy. Also got a hamburger $5. So worth the price! Good meat patty, good quality buns. Definitely recommend this place!!
Great local Takeaway. Have a great selection of Chinese and western foods. Daily specials
Sushi here is amazing! Fresh and tasty

I went to Mrs Sushi to get 2 party platters to cater for a photoshoot we were doing in Riverhead. They were easy to deal with, prompt with timings and the food was amazing! We had some very happy crew. Thank you Mrs Sushi.
Very nice, she didn't have what I wanted pre-prepared, so she made some up. I went at lunchtime, still very quick service, excellent Sushi Usual good selection.
The freshest and best sushi to go, in the area.
I got a salmon and avo 8 pack, which i thought had a generous offering of ingredients. Very fresh and delicious.
First time trying this takeaway shop it did not disappoint, the nasi goreng and sweet and sour pork with rice was good Will be back
I bought $25 seafood cashews. But it was rubbish tastes. Too cheap oily and disgusting food. They are not very kind as well.

$45 of rubbish!! We got 1 fish (batter soggy and raw), 1 crab stick (wet batter), 1 scoop of chips (over cooked & over salted), sweet & sour wontons (pork uncooked) and beef Shanghai noodles (all cabbage & noodle, a few bits of beef).The photos show all!! The food went in the bin. Absolutely appalling that a fish n chip shop cannot properly cook anything! Never going back!
This is $2 chips that you get when you buy the A family deal…. Burgers a yummy, fish is hard. Disappointed about the chips…

Absolutely disgusting, from the dirty and dated shop to their tasteless and awful food. This was the most horrible Chinese takeaway I've ever tasted, the steak shanghai noodles didn't even have meat in it. The fish is soggy and horrible. Yuck yuck yuck
Have roast meals here which are very nice but never hot enough, always luke warm ,why is this? Would buy more often if food was hot !!!

FAR TOO MUCH SALT! It's not healthy and makes the food inedible. We've tried many Ready Roast places and they all use excessive amounts of salt. Why is this? Time to give up now. Care too much about my heart. Meat was tender, which was the only redeeming feature.
Lovely staff, amazing fried chicken sandwich. Only $4.50, packed with chicken, fresh white bread, salad and gravy. Can’t ask for much more than that.
Disgusting, the snot they call lamb should be fed to the dog. Potatoes were nice but not worth this feeling to vomit after seeing what they serve people and call it food.
Great roast meals and chicken and fried spuds. The pork was amazing!!

Sahi Indian Restaurant is a must-visit! From the moment we walked in, the service was exceptional - they truly go above and beyond to make you feel welcome and ensure you have a great experience. The food was delicious, and combined with the outstanding service, I highly recommend this place. Plus, it's got a convenient location and ample parking, which is always a bonus. We'll definitely be back!

Life is too short for bad food. So, if you want really great fantastic fresh authentic Indian food with good portion sizing, this is the place to go. Have been here on many different occasions and the food is always excellent. The added bonus is how friendly and genuine the staff are. Highly recommended.
This place is legit, best chicken masala and one the best chicken briyani I’ve had, great work and compliments to the chef and staff
We had Apollo Fish, Reshmi Chicken Kebab and Goat Biryani..All were very Yummy..Especially Apollo Fish and Hyderabadi Biryani👏👏 and their Mirchi Ka Salaan was best in Whole Auckland..

One of the best Indian Restaurant in west Auckland. You don’t find the authentic Indian taste everywhere in Auckland but Shahi is a must visit for all the food lovers. Amazing food with great service from the team . The owners are very welcoming. It’s my go to place every weekend . You must try the Palak Paneer/Veg Kofta /Veg Biryani and Momos they are very good . I am a vegetarian but my friends have tried lamb biryani and curry and they like it a lot.

Was excited to eat burger king but was very dissatisfied with the food, fries tasted very stale no flavor, onion rings was soggy and the burger was so bad the chicken was so hard! The staff is really nice just not the food!

If I could give less than 1 star I would. Our order was wrong. Burgers ordered not what we recieved. No straws given for our drinks & no napkins for the overly mayonnaised SLOP that this store considers a burger. We spent $88 to be fed crap. Do NOT recommend
Food was nice and fresh. Service was very slow. Staff were friendly but, lots of waiting around to be served.
Hot food , clean. Chips cooked nice as was my burger, young freindly staff ready and willing to give the real tase of what BK stands for.

A BIT OF A LET DOWN..Dirty tables,all greasy and covered in food scraps from previous patrons. The floor is brown in places ,looks like it gets cleaned once a week. No napkins on offer, you have to ask for them. The Burger was ok. Chicken tenders were overcooked and hard. No sugar on offer either for your coffee. At 9.28 pm the door was locked although it says the resturant is open til 10pm on google. No lit up signs out side, hard to tell if they are even open for business til you look inside

Lovely couple, great tasty choices and reasonably priced, not that I've ever had a bad crepe/pancake before, still a delight finding places that provide it... I've included the menu since they haven't uploaded one online yet, they're a small stall so don't expect your order to be too quick but I came on a quiet time so I can't help but give them a 5/5. 😊

The sweet one was ok. But the savoury ham and cheese was a disappointment. As per the photo, it barely had filling inside and the crust has a burn taste. Definitely overpriced for what I got. It was so unfortunate, I was really looking forward to having some French food.
Glad to have found this place as the crepes were awesome! Tried the banana/salted caramel and the lemon/sugar/butter options and both were yummmmmm

Crepe was really good though it needs to be faster waited too long in the sun for my food. Theres not a lot of places to wait out of the sun. As constructive feedback as a service worker myself who works in food trucks they can be faster and more efficient watching from afar. If you want a crepe be prepared for longer wait times.

One of my fav finds on Ubereats!! I wish I had taken photos but I finished the crepes so fast!! The Nutella banana was absolutely STUNNING!- the sauce so moreish and the banana complements it to the tee. Generous portions with a generous slathering of nutella 🤩🤩🤩 so dangerous haha! The ham cheese mushroom and egg savoury crepe was beautiful with really good quality cheese and ham - perfectly wrapped in the crispy buckwheat crepe with tasty herbs. Next time will visit the place so I can get to thank the chef in person! Highly recommend!

This is a new food truck by the driving range. They sell Korean light meals (janchi-guksu, bibim-guksu, kimchi-jeon, korean-style hot dog) as well some kiwi classics & coffee sorts. Nice vibe, feels like an escape from busy Auckland. It’s a yellow food truck, you can’t miss it.
Kooksoo soup is so tasty
Best chicken out west

One of the best beer spots in Auckland, where you feel like you’re really on a pacific island. Fantastic home brewed beers, unique snacks, great pizza oven, dog friendly, amazing outdoor atmosphere in all weather, staff were superb! Can’t fault it and highly recommend for groups, beer lovers, or anyone looking for a casual weekend afternoon chill out in the beautiful north of Auckland.

Ali & Grayson made my mate Dan & I, a great afternoon long lunch; we filled our boots with a couple of beer paddles (me on the larger finding their "Italian" my favorite), accompanied by delicious Jalapeño Poppers, Crumbed Pulled Pork & Skirt Steak Skewers, chips & finishing with 2 Guinness compliments of Brewmiester Killian. Fantastic friendly service, great atmosphere & highly recommended; will definitely be back. 5/5

Great atmosphere, was well into ordering off app when server told me not to, wish I’d ignored him as it was a while before he came and took our drinks order and equally as long before the food came out. The white anchovy pizza was not as expected, but then looking at the picture on the app, it was obviously taken under a red light, as no tomatoe and devoid of flavour and impossible to taste the anchovy over the creamy sauce that was too rich, the chimichurri sauce taste more like oily pesto, with little flavour too. Having said that other food was ok. You order the beer by the pint for $13 and the glass size was tiny, definitely not a pint and not even filled to top, poor effort. Dog friendly but watch the floor , full of napkins and other stuff.

Hallertau Brewery is such a fantastic spot! The atmosphere is wonderful, with greenery all around that makes it feel so relaxing. We tried a tasting paddle with five different brews, and each one had its own unique flavor—so much fun to sample them all! There’s also a spacious play area for kids, making it comfortable for families. The place is big and open, the music is great, and overall, it’s a perfect spot to unwind. Highly recommended!

Very enjoyable experience with friends. The food was excellent (from the jalapeño poppers and fries as starters, to the snapper, steak and smoked venison pizza for mains, to the apple cider (the best I’ve ever had). The atmosphere was excellent and felt like you’re on an island somewhere in the Pacific… will be coming back.
Steak was fantastic, service was good, a good local pub. Amazing sticky toffee pudding too. Oysters smelled a little fishy and obviously aren't shucked fresh but they actually tasted perfectly fine.

Bit of a mixed bag today. The waitress asked us for our preference of water as we were seated however never returned with our water at all. We had to get the attention of the staff in order to place orders. They were very cheerful though. Our Entrée and Mains were served in a good timely manner and were lovely. Entrée was Vegatbale Dumplings which were good. Would order them again. Husband had the Beef Cheek and Smokey Bacon pie, and I had the Lamb Ragu. The pie was nice, bacon wasn't Smokey though. Ragu was cooked well. Both meals had beautifully presentation.

Went there for a solo lunch with my book and sat by the fire. Ordered the peach tea, Caesar salad with chicken and the petite cheese platter. Had a lovely time, and the young waitress was very kind and made sure to ask if everyone was alright with my meal and if i needed anything more. Always a treat to drive all the way out here from the city.

We had a table for 2 in the covered deck area overlooking the river. The service was friendly and prompt. The beef cheeks and the ribs were very tasty. We shared the petite dessert plate, which had 4 little delicious morsels. It was just enough sweetness at the end of our meal. We arrived early after kayaking from Herald Island, and we were able to bring our booking forward, which was great. We highly recommend the Sunday lunch at The Landing restaurant at The Riverhead tavern.

Cool place with a beautiful view over the river! Nice candle lit dinner. Food was extremely tasty! Would recommend it for people wanting to have a nice romantic meal. The only part that let it down was the dessert... i got the 4 bite sized dessert expecting to have some of the menu items that are "homemade" these were not homemade and were frozen. For 14 bucks you'd expect something that's been made in house. Not a defrosted finger food.

I booked a dinner at The Landing and wasn’t sure what to expect as I knew the area as riverhead tavern and expected the classic pub food . I was wrong , and the food was really good, I travel a lot for work and eat in many restaurants and this was one of the good ones. It was a nice quiet cosy warm atmosphere with enough privacy to be able to talk to each other and not too much noise . I had the confit pork as an entree which was probably the most tender pork I have ever had and the maker fish which was really good too. As for desert km a sucker for sticky date pudding so went with that, Service was super friendly and attentive , but not annoying in your face alll the time , and food arrived very quickly for each course . I would definitely go back again.

visited the Riverhead Tavern again yesterday after almost a year and I’m so glad I did. Last time I came, I left disappointed, but this visit was a completely different experience—in the best way possible. The staff were super friendly and welcoming, and the service was great from the moment we arrived. I was especially happy to see that the Scotch filet steak is now served with both salad and fries again, just like it used to be. It was cooked perfectly and tasted just as amazing as I remembered. I brought two friends from overseas with me and they were really impressed with the food and the atmosphere. Everyone was happy, and it felt good to enjoy a meal here again. Big thanks to the owner and team for listening to feedback and bringing back what made the place special. I’ll definitely be back soon for my favorite steak.

Met friends here for an early lunch, lots of space for big groups. The food, the service, the wine pairing was superb. Thanks for making our time enjoyable. It was raining so didn’t get to enjoy the outside area but will return a sunny day for wine and cheese by the river. Recommend the Pan fried dumplings & beer batter fish n chips.

We had a perfect sitting today. Our waitress was lovely and attentive. I ordered the Venison Pie, which was absolutely scrumptious. The Venison was so succulent and tender. Pastry was perfectly made also. My partner ordered the Rib Eye steak, which came with winter vegetables at the moment. He's a hard steak eater to please. However, he said the steak was cooked to perfection! Thanks for the hospitality today everyone

Went there for lunch yesterday with my daughter and her dad. We walked in off the street and was approached from the loveliest young lady that worked there. She greeted us with a friendly welcoming warm smile and led us to our table. After reclining at the table, she left us to ponder through the menu to decide what we felt like eating. (All the dishes in the menu made it difficult to decide, as they were all appealing to the imagination). The waitress approached our table and was asked if we could have 5 more minutes to decide. After 5 minutes, she quietly returned to take our orders. My daughter ordered the Chicken burger, her dad ordered the fish and chips and I ordered the Open Steak Sandwich. I will say this; my steak was cooked to perfection, with the right amount of searing on all sides and the the tenderness of the meat melted in my mouth with every bite. My chips were cooked nicely, not too dry or overly saturated in the fat they were cooked in. There was the right amount of salad on my plate that made the whole experience of eating this fine meal enjoyable. But the highlight of the dish for me was the cute little dish of the aioli, that I could dip my knife into and swipe a gorgeous dose of sauce on my fork, or dip the ends of the chips into, or to break off tiny pieces of the focaccia bread and dip that into it. Every bite was as good as the one before. Overall this place has really exceeded my expectations, very warm and humbling atmosphere, comfortable surroundings and at an affordable and reasonable price. Thank you everyone at The Malt. This place I highly recommend 10+ stars.

Katsubi is a great fast food restaurant that specializes in Japanese-style cuisine. Located in Glenfield mall, it's the perfect place for a quick lunch or dinner on the go. Positives: - The food at Katsubi is both delicious and filling. Their cuisine is always fresh and made with high-quality ingredients. If you're looking for a healthy and satisfying meal, Katsubi is a great option. - The service at Katsubi is quick and efficient. Even during busy lunch hours, you can expect to receive your food within a few minutes of ordering. - The mall itself is maintained and clean, modern, and well-lit. Whether you choose to dine in or take your food to go, you'll feel comfortable and relaxed in this space. Improvement Points: - Although the food is tasty, the menu at Katsubi could benefit from a little more variety. Some more vegetarian or vegan options would be appreciated by customers who don't eat meat or seafood. - The pricing at Katsubi can be a little steep. While the quality of the food justifies the cost, it might be more accessible to a wider range of customers if there were some more affordable options on the menu. Overall, Katsubi is a great choice for anyone looking for a healthy and delicious meal on the go. With a little bit of variety and more affordable options, it could become an even more popular destination for hungry shoppers in Glenfield mall.

Updated post! Always a treat to come to this Nando’s food is always amazing! Always a treat coming to this Nando’s! Staff are super friendly, restaurant has a great atmosphere and the food is always fresh! Our go to Nando’s

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5 Stars Nando’s Wairau has seriously stepped their game up — must be under new management! The service has been consistently great and super friendly. As a student whos extremely careful with their budget, and although this isnt the cheapest burger place out there... The quality of the burgers, the ingredients, the sauces, are all perfectly balanced to create an amazing burger worth their cost. Couldn't recommend this place more if you're looking for a real, solid, homemade burger. Do not order the petite burgers though, they're VERY small and extremely expensive for their size. The staff are friendly and the owner is quite generous too, which is always nice to experience. Wish they dropped the price a dollar or two for their burgers... if this was the case I'd be here every week. 😅 Regardless, give this place a taste and experience what a real burger should taste like!

Recent experience at Burger Wisconsin Ordered the Great American Burger combo today, but unfortunately it didn’t quite live up to its name. The patty had an unusual, off-putting odour that made it difficult to enjoy. Additionally, there was a noticeable body odour coming from the staff member (or possibly owner) taking orders, which was rather distracting. The kitchen area also didn’t appear as clean as one might hope for a dining establishment. While I appreciate the effort that goes into running a small business, I don’t think I’ll be returning based on this visit. A bit of a shame, really - was hoping for better!

Such a good take away burger! Everything was made fresh and was full of flavour. There was options for every dietary requirement! The vegan burger patty was delicious and a great replica of meat! The halloumi burger was delicious as well. The meat burger was a great size and juicy! All the burgers were generously sized! The chicken tenders were cooked perfectly and were very crispy! The donut fries are a must try! They are absolutely incredible! The caramel sauce makes them even better! Overall a great place with lots of options to chose from and friendly staff that will help accommodate your dietary requirements!

We've frequented Burger Wisconsin franchises for many years now, but since we discovered Wairau branch we never go anywhere else. We actually cross the bridge to eat there! The food is next level and the staff are all super friendly and accommodating. We like to dine in and Wairau branch has hands down the best dining room, with proper tables and chairs and the music is all over the place - something for everyone! You will not regret eating here.

Friendly lady staff member but that was about it, curly fries were average over cooked, burger was a mess to eat and not alot of flavor and it should come with an option of a burger holder to help eat it so its not so mess, The buns I feel are are bigger than the actual burger so it tricks you to thinking its a big burger when its not really, buns are also tasteless, left feeling like I was still hungry to be honest, $72.00 for two burgers and few sides definitely not worth it, wish I went to flaming onion instead or big Js takeaways in mt wellington they are good value for money!

Worst service I have ever experienced ordering food. The server mucked up my salad bowl, and when I went back to add the missing items, I was yelled at by the owner. Realise that people pay a lot of money for healthy fresh food, the least you could do is provide good service. Do better.

My pita had barely any meat, even paid for extra protein. Added too much salt & pepper… it also took longer than usual. I think this is the best Pita Pit in Auckland. Normally, I don’t go to food courts in malls but this one is the go-to in Glenfield. Friendly staff here too, they are kind.
Nice staff nice lunch in glenfiled thanks guys

The uncle who serves is a one man army, who serves and cooks by himself. We loved his food both ramen and sushi. It’s a nice spot to grab a good meal

Very tasty food, good quality and fresh, which is very important in sushi. I really recommend going there. In addition to being very fast and friendly service. I ate at the restaurant, which is clearly more designed for take away, but I still recommend it, because the important thing is the food.
Nothing fancy But super delicious and well made sushi
Absolutely amazing! Super kind and helpful staff, price and quality is great! Highly recommend 👌
Best tempura chicken ball I've ever tasted.

Excellent service by Arpita. I have been to this store so many times but this time I really like the sub that she made for us. “Loved my experience the girl was by herself she had a great attitude the sub stayed together. I admire her work ethic will be back again. Good job.

I regularly enjoy the Veg Pattie from Subway in Wairau Valley – it’s always fresh and delicious! I’ve been coming to this Subway for a few months now, and VJ always makes my sub exactly how I like it. He’s friendly, quick, and pays attention to the details. Great service every time.
Went here for yum char lunch, and it's my new favourite chinese restaurant in NZ. Service was very fast, plenty of variety, and omg the pineapple buns are so delicious, easily 10/10.

This dim sum restaurant offers a pleasant and roomy atmosphere, ideal for hosting family and friends for birthday, wedding or event gatherings. With fast service and reasonable prices, it's a convenient choice. We visited to sample their dim sum but were a little disappointed by the BBQ Pork Bun, which lacked filling. The filling of the steamed egg custard bun (流沙包) was disappointing as it didn't flow as it should have. Overall, other dishes were good, and some were merely average. We hope for better experiences on our next visit.

Authentic Cantonese yum chai! Everything we tried were came with high standard! Deep fried Salty dumpling has thin crust with yummy filling! Shumai tasted homemade with big prawn. Service is also quick. Definitely will come back!

Glad to have found another yumcha restaurant in Auckland. Air conditioning made it very refreshing inside, food tasted good and it wasn't too expensive like the other places around town! The fried dumplings in the photo were huge! Highlight must be the pork polo buns, limited item for this store!

Came in here for yum cha and ordered 2 extra dishes from the menu, (blue cod fish and fried lamb shanks). Very disappointing that a fully established restaurant would dare to serve days old food to customers. When we approached the staff member, she neither acknowledged or apologized but instead just offered a small jelly for free - which doesn't atone for the leftover food they serve.
Great tables. Good pricing. Super nice hot chips. Lots of tables.
Great space! Recommend deserving a pool table when going there on a Saturday. Drinks and food were well priced and delicious. Excited to go there again soon :)

Such a relaxing and aesthetic place. Food and drinks are served for a reasonable price, and lots of tables to occupie. This is my fourth time coming here with friends and definitely not the last, overall great place to hang out and have fun!
Very relax, fun and reasonable price. Nice place

Go to place for some friendly yet competitive pool game sets. Can be well complimented by some beer and nibbles. Friendly and efficient staff ensuring a good experience. Well laid out facility with more than a dozen tables available. Recommend to make a booking to get a table without waiting.
Fresh tofu and cheapest in town - $1.90 a block. Nice lady serving. Yummy vege pancake too

Great, just hot. Some fans would be cool, or air con, most subways are this way though. Otherwise, a nice little subway to hide away & have a feed in before or after a movie across the road!

Great Value at this Indian. Naan cooked fresh every order. Always lots of food for a decent price. Rice was a bit undercooked but couldn't fault anything else. Definitely reccomend this for a cheap Indian meal!

We have been slowly trying each food store in this international food court, and tonight we chose 'Eat Indian'. We were greeted and served by a polite man who appears to run the store. The butter chicken was very nice. Naan was fresh cooked. Awesome customer service.
Below average food and cleanliness. Slightly overpriced. Served by a friendly staff who served good portion. The owner came out and took some food from your plate back to their pots. Won’t be back.

Got the butter chicken, and while it's different to what I'm used to, being sweeter than what I'm used to, it still tastes really nice. The man serving me was nice and the food came out really quickly as well

There's a sign outside that says they sell Butter Chicken... who cares about Butter Chicken when you can eat Lamb Saagwalla, drink a Kingfisher, nibble on poppadoms while you wait for a takeaway.. or dine in of you like. The Atmosphere is pretty hard to spice up when you're a restaurant in a strip mall next to a roundabout BUT the food does all the talking! Delicious 😋, and plentiful!!

The food was amazing, and my friends and I had a memorable day. We went there for a late lunch, and everything was delicious. I will never forget the cheese naan; it was my first time trying it, and I highly recommend giving it a try!
Authentic punjabi food !! One of the best Amritsari kulcha I have had in NZ.
If only I could give 5 stars every time I have been. Consistently delivering delicious quality food at reasonable prices. Hope they maintain it long term unlike other establishments.

The pizza was nice. Ordered from phone and picked it up. Customer serves nice.

Ordered a three pepper Chicken foot long. The schnitzel looked fresh.. the veggies seemed a little dead but benefit of doubt can be that it was almost closing. The staff are professional, patient and effective, even though there was queue, not waiting for long. Environment is clean and cozy :) Highly recommend!!!

This shop is clean and the staff there are fast and efficient. Watching the 3 staff making the the subway rolls was awesome so in sync. Also they genuinely listen to you. Foot-long with the cookie and drink is well worth it. Support this store!

Amazing! beautiful customer service. Fish was cooked perfectly 🥰 mussels were sooo delicious 😋 will definitely visit again ❤️ Visited again and again the meal was amazing, this become our once a week main spot for breakfast.

Uber delivery - cold on arrival. The amount of oil is phenomenal and off putting. My husband and I ordered due to good ratings. Don’t be fooled, fish is not fresh!! Just had the Hoki, salad and chips meal for dinner. So fresh and very tasty. Great portion sizes. Would recommend.

Every time I go to Glenfield Mall with the kids, we always order this meal. It includes every type of food they love—fries, mussels, fish, and prawns. The staff's service is also very warm and friendly. I hope their business continues to thrive!
Spicy snapper so good, freshly cooked not oily.

Well what else you need when a family of three can eat good amount of food in just 18 dollars. Above all delicious Pav Bhaji and the fabulous masala dosa that too very authentic and yummy. Both husband and wife work together to run this place and I can say these guys are just there to fulfill your taste buds. A must visit place at least twice a week. Enjoy guys, All the best.

They weren’t ready to serve well past their opening time. What made it worse is that we called before coming to check if they were open. They didn’t bother mentioning that it would be a while before they could serve. Food was good.
Excellent little food truck. Lot of items to choose from and very quick service. We will visit again. Must try: Chicken Pakoda
The best place to have Indian Food in New Zealand! Loved It!
Mirchi Buji 😋😋

Genuinely delicious every time and I've tried quite a few of their dishes,always friendly and decently priced
Best fresh cook tandoori chicken and super vale for lunch deal and amazing Briyani Rice and now have new dish and been there almost 100 times over pas two years super reckoning india

-Very yummy food -Big portions -Reasonable prices -Prepared in 10 min -Easy parking (right by the store) -Nice and respectful staff -Lovely music (I was sitting there while my food got ready) I’ll definitely go back there! The photo is: Vegetable Korma with rice and naan bread Thank you :-)
Absolutely loved the food here. The tempura was super crunchy and the udon was delicious. Friendly service too — will definitely be back!
The sushi topped with mayonnaise looks and tastes delicious. The rice is slightly hard, and the sushi is a bit small, but the price is affordable, which makes sense.

Fancy and clean space! The kind of sushi looks like to be made with fresh. Also, I bought eel don that is including salad, fried dumplings, prawn, and rice. It was nice to my taste. Staff kind outstandingly.
Best sushi I’ve tasted! Quick served and prices are very reasonable. And the owners are very warm and friendly:) Definitely recommend this place to everyone👍

Wow! The best sushi we have ever eaten! We walked in after 6pm nd the owner very graciously made us 20 peices of teriyaki chicken/avo/capsicum sushi. noodle were perfect and plenty of toppings. If too spicy, add the ginger of the pickled cabbage. Waiter saw that it was too spicy for me and took out a bowl of non-spicy soup. Overall, this place is great
Honestly soooo good. Owner is so kind and warm too. Will be coming here a lot

The most authentic rice noodles I've ever had in Auckland, bar none. Free refills, all you can eat. I usually come and enjoy it with my kid.
Their boneless chicken tastes really good.

This place has the best Korean food!! Staff are really friendly and helpful, and oh my gosh the FRIED CHICKEN and the KIMCHI!! Apparently this is the only place that has organic Kimchi it seems? Beef gimbab is so good!! Perfect rice, prrfect seasoning and really packed with ingredients❤️❤️

The first time we attempted to eat here they were closed during their normal hours, so I left a 1 star review in spite of being really hungry and excited to try the fried chicken. We however went back yesterday, and as a man from Kentucky, I must say it was exactly what I was hoping for. The entire experience eating at Ogane feels very authentic, almost as if we were in South Korea itself. The chicken was fresh, crispy, and all around delightful. Dakogi in Highbury being our normal stop, the experience pales in comparison to this sweet spot. Pretty metal chopsticks, food displayed beautifully, decent price, free kimchi and radish, and a wonderfully sweet staff. Upon telling the staff of our first experience they stated they would update their hours to be more precise as well. For all reasons stated, five stars. Will be back. Excited to film a comprehensive video review of Ogane this Sunday. youtube @justwo

Love these guys for their lunches :-) Yummy, good portion and affordable. They are super friendly and provide good service. I am glad you are my local because I can come everytime I crave for Korean food. Thank you so much
Comes highly recommended, very busy during peak should come early if you want a table. Food is amazing and on point, side dish with great selection. One of the better korean restaurants in wairau.
The food was nice here. Bought some soup and other stuff. The soup was delicious. Feels a bit overpriced. Customer service was nice. It gets very busy inside. Heaps of parking outside.
#Korean restaurant# Small restaurant with great Korean food！ Strongly recommend the soups，such as fish roe、beef、pork and tofu. Reasonable price and generous portions.
They are just the best Korean Food in Auckland. Period.

Needless to say this place never disappoints. Authentic Korean food and soup. It was crowded with Koreans so yunno this is the right place to dine to get the experience. Has been back often and each time still the best.
Authentic Thai cuisine cooked to perfection !!! We ordered 5 dishes and all of them are amazing. Very reasonable price and super friendly staff 😊😊 100% highly recommend

May be the most delicious Thai meal in north shore. Also great to have small portions so that i can try different food with my partner at a time. Highly recommended. (Was a bit confused when seeing most reviews were about burger, so i was quite surprised that it was such an authentic thai food)

Great little corner stop, warm and “Authentic welcome” appreciate the small yet impactful menu. This is my first order from here, and I'm very happy! Generous portions, I love that the chicken is fried for the meal I got, and it tastes good! Friendly staff too. Thank you, I will be back for sure!
Absolutely delicious food with awesome vegan options, and generous portions! Very fresh and tasty, with authentic sauces all made from scratch by the chef! Highly recommend 🍃💚🍃

Wok wok a authentic chinese dine in food court oh god the bowl of soups which is my personal favourite with different choices of proteins…. And so many choices of food that will blow your mind taste yummy what else to say its just too good …… love it definitely recommend

KAN PUN GI - Recommended dish. Generously portioned and the highlight being that it is served with some nacho chips in-between. This added an extra crunchy texture. Overall this place takes on some amazing twists to traditional korean styled Chinese cuisine! Also enjoyed the Corriander Jjajangmyun, the corriander look away some of the usual greasiness of this dish. Also the sundae jjampong, had a generous at least 12 pieces inside, which is unheard of here in Auckland! Overall highly recommend this place!

The best Jjampong in New Zealand! The broth is rich and bursting with a beautiful umami flavour – absolutely stunning! The portions are generous, and the overall experience is top-notch. Without a doubt, the best Chinese-Korean restaurant in Auckland. Hands down 😋!
In most cases Korean Chinese restaurant dishes have quite strong taste, but this one is different. Not that strong but still has good flavors and tastes, which I love them!

This place truly masters the art of great Korean food. Their 탕수육 is brimming with tender, succulent meat, and the portion size is wonderfully generous. The spicy noodle dish is a revelation: the noodles have a perfect texture, the broth is warm and soothing, and the meat is abundant and flavorful. I rarely write reviews, but this meal left such a lasting impression that I can't stop thinking about it. I'll be returning soon, hungry for more.

The spicy seafood soup (Jjamppong) was sooo good the broth was super comforting. The black bean noodles were super amazing to slurp and super Korean mukbang worthy! And the sweet and sour pork was soooo yummy! And I don’t even like pork like that! Soooo it was soooo good! Definitely come back here! Wish they had a set where you can grab all three of these things which I’ve seen in other Korean restaurants! 🫶 thank you!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Great food, friendly staff, and affordable prices! Kebabs on the Shore Glenfeild is one of my go-to spots. The food is always fresh and full of flavour — you can really taste the quality in every bite. The staff are super friendly and welcoming, and the service is fast and efficient. Prices are very reasonable for the portion sizes and quality you get. It's great value for money, and I always leave satisfied. Highly recommended if you're in the area!

Kebab was cold, beef tasted like the smell of dog roll. Hummus was watery ....double meat was questionable. Not fresh order was wrong. Service person presented a solution, I'll never eat there again so what's the point of a store credit. Wanted mt money back and they could have taken the food back... DON'T WASTE YOU MONEY.
The food is amazing i normally eat mix on chips even twice a week and staff is very friendly aman and mandeep both very cooperative and friendly even other staff members are also very nice

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ "Best Kebab in Town!" Last week, I visited Kebabs on Shore, and I have to say—this place is amazing! The food was incredibly tasty, fresh, and packed with flavor. The meat was cooked perfectly, the sauces were delicious, and the portion sizes were just right. The staff were friendly and welcoming, making the experience even better. If you’re looking for a great kebab spot, this is the place to go. Highly recommended! Would you like me to add anything else to your review?

Discovered this place near our house today. Great service and great quality kebabs. Generous portion sizes, they wont hold back on ingredients. The staff was very friendly which was a huge bonus. Will definitely go back :)

Nice people and equally nice food. Ordered Chicken Chow Mein and Sweet Sour Pork with Fried Rice. Well received by the family. Appreciate them making close to their closing time too. Prices are fair also. Very good!

Had the fish and chips at Chartwell Takeaways and it really hit the spot! The fish was crispy on the outside, tender and flaky on the inside — just how I like it. Chips were hot, golden, and well-salted without being greasy. Portions were generous and service was quick and friendly. A solid, satisfying Kiwi takeaway experience. Would definitely come back again!
My family's favourite takeaway in the Shore. Even if we moved out from the Glenfield area, we still get our food here. Service is efficient. Food is yum!

Have been to a number of takeaways on the North Shore but this one stands out. Dishes tasted home made and not overly seasoned or greasy. The special dishes combo provided excellent value. Will be back!
First time trying Chartwell takeaways tonight. What a treat,all the food is top notch. Fried rice with extra chicken,amazing Chop sui beautiful . Scallops delicious. Recommend.
The best sushi in Auckland, amazing service aswell!
Love this place great value for money, great food and good service

Myself and my workmates all think very highly of this little gem. The staff are friendly, the sushi servings are larger (not bite size), we happen to like them this way. We have been having awesome lunches with loads of variety from this little shop. Highly recommend and look forward to a dine-in experience at this restaurant. Big thumbs up from us. Thank you

We had an evening farewell party on Wednesday 30 November 2022. We had never previously bought anything from the Sushi Factory but thought of giving it a try with a Party Platter B. The ordering was easy and the friendly staff helped us to make another, better choice. Very friendly service and the platter had a beautiful presentation. That evening everybody loved the Sushi, fresh and appetizing! Needless to say, the platter was finished, despite there being many other finger foods available. Our "first-buy" risk with Sushi Factory was a great success. We will buy there again - and highly recommend their sushi platters.

First time tried this place and will never again will, ordered a Box 1 chicken teriyaki, was hardly any chicken mostly soggy rice, everything tasted over poweringly sweet. 1 x piece of salmon shushi, mostly cabbage Salad...yea fair to say was not impressed at all especially since they charge a premium price of $21!!!

Absolutely loved my experience today! Been watching the TikTok lives and had to go and try in person! It's everything they say it is! Delicious food, great service, upbeat and happy atmosphere, just an all round great experience. The dumplings we so yum! We got the deal with 6 dumplings, chips and drink. Honestly that was enough for a lunch but we wanted to try another flavour so got a 6 pack of the OG ones. Couldn't finish them as so full but have them for later. One lunch deal was the Great White dumplings with the siracha mayo, and one was the beef and cheese with sesame sauce. Highly recommend the beef and cheese!

- Three spice prawn 7.5/10 I think you definitely need sauce with these, without they're pretty bland. The peices of prawns are nice size chunks. I've always wondered what there will be like with traditional wrap opposed to wholegrain wrap, but with the sauces, they're all good. - Great white 7.3/10 Same situation here with the sauces being needed.
