A box of these are ideal for lunch.

Great. Loved the dumplings, perfect place to drop in on the way past or for lunch. Got the OG dumplings, really liked them. 6 certainly hit the spot for me, may not be enough if you’re hungry! I like the comfortable seating and the record player - nice selection of some older hip hop style records on the wall. Definitely worth coming to.

A great selection of sauces ranging in spice intensities. The chicken was moist. The wholemeal wrap (dumpling exterior) was thick and strong in flavour. The mushroom 🍄 with chicken is a tasty pairing. The garnish was good.

Sumthin Dumplin is definitely sumthin! Hands down the best dumplings I’ve ever had – so good, I briefly considered moving in. The shop is spotless, like they’re expecting a health inspector to pop in any second. The service? Top-notch – friendly, fast, and great recommendations for flavours when we didn’t know what to choose. 5 stars all round – would dumpling again.

Yesterday we had the pleasure of experiencing their catering service for an event. The fried soft noodles and fried rice were packed with flavor, despite the large volume. The 100x chicken nibbles were gone literally in seconds! Our guests couldn't stop raving about how delicious everything was! The speed of service was impressive and their efficiency made our event a huge success. Not one left with an empty stomach 😉 We can't recommend this takeaway shop enough for their exceptional catering services. Give them a ring they won’t disappoint you!!!
Bestest Chinese food ever. Chicken fried rice very very spicy and 4 nibbles is my all time favourite order here. Wish I could live close by. Whenever I visit north shore, this is must visit place

For a simple kiwi order of burger and chips, they do a fantastic meal. Burger was a fantastic meal in itself, full of flavour!! I asked the guy behind the counter to take the attached picture before he put them into bags, to show the height of them. Burgers are $14.00, beats any fast food joints on the shore!!! Actually, 2pm today (20/01/25) and I hadn’t had lunch so I grabbed a large nasi goreng on the way home to share with my wife. For $18.00 it was fantastic, a spicey meal with enough food for 3 people’s lunch. Thanks guys, a lovely meal with plenty of meat and vegetables! The store is always very tidy and service very quick!

Though I found a takeaway I could enjoy, it turns out I don't think their hygiene or food is great. I found a hair on a few chicken nibbles, which is gross. There's no way I'm coming back. Look at the person cooking looks so dirty 🤮 stay away

Our go-to takeaway store at the North Shore. Friendly and fast service, food is always served hot. We've been to others, but we keep on coming back as they have some good deals, and the location is also centrally located from we live and where our work is. Keep up the good work, guys.

The fish and chips were very nice but the fried chicken was very oily and it's very hard to eat. Customer service was nice. There are no tables and chairs here to eat. Only takeaways here. The shop looks clean and tidy.

2 scoops for 9 dollars and this is what I get. I got the same scoops yesterday with twice the sound of chips. Either your ripping people off or your ripping people off. D9nt go to this place. Instead go somewhere else. Your more better off going to paknsav and buying 2 bags of chips for 8.50 and deep frying them yourself. Total rip off.
Best fish and chips on the shore so far. Not a place to dine in at though...
Best fish and chips in Glenfield. Recommend the fish in fish burgers and fish meals. Snapper pricey but its the same all over the north shore. Totally worth it, yummy and succulent.
Chips very undercooked would be better if they were cooked for longer. Also is this really $5 chip?
The food was really delicious and plentiful. The shop is clean and well ventilated, which is always a bonus. I'll definitely go back and try some other food from their menu.
Massive servings with great quality food! Really happy will be a repeat customer

Surprisingly really good fish ! Really enjoyed the batter and the hoki just flaked off nicely. Chips were average. Pineapple fritter was average. Not bad a takeaway. The Chinese food is also not bad, but definitely not the same as a chinese restaurant kind of standards.

Cheesy Wezzy are the best. That is all I buy. 💯 recommended to all. Also, the fries are high quality best I have ever had. The only thing I recommend to the owner is packaging because the sauce and cheese sticks on the paper, and it is such a waste and ruins this for me. I haven't tried anything else.
For the fast food and take away, it’s top of the class. It’s not easy to find who separates the chips oil from fish one and filter oils often. Good potion and taste. All the best.
Nothing special. Taste not bad but like eating vegetables burger rather than chicken burger.

ABSOLUTELY NEVER AGAIN... i don't recommend. 2ND time ordering burger at this store, 2nd time I have been disappointed. Service is poor you are not acknowledged, seems to be no counter service. The menu is difficult to navigate $6,99 to make it a combo Wagyu burger pattie in pieces chips limp cold and pale. The pattie was in four pieces (not sure it was the right order I received) dry meat dry bun. The Chips were rubbery and watched the cook put pre fried chips into the fryer for 2mins. Last purchase was much the same, burger was disappointing and chips were refried... I DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS BURGER SPACE. DON'T waste your money, go to the horrible McDonald's across the ROAD.

Yum what delish burger, beef bacon and cheese can't wait to go back to try some more items...........2nd visit got the pulled pork burger and wow this was so good, lots meat and a delicious siraca sauce.

SAVE YOUR MONEY! yuck Burgers were COLD AND SOGGY! Was hoping for a delicious burger and something tasty. This was so disappointing! Fries were rubbish. Buns were literally soggy, pattie was cold! Salad was soggy! Didn’t even eat it. One big sloppy cold mess.
Horrible burger! They were OK when they started but really bad now. Bun was soggy, meat pattie overcooked and had absolutely no flavour.

Prawn laksa was super yummy, portion is so big. So many prawns inside, vegan dumpling were delicious too. Service is 5 star😊 also recommend to try Vietnamese unique watermelon tea, taste so good and I love it. Definitely will come again and one of loyal customer.

New shop and liked that they had pad thai which overall I really liked, I just wish the noodles were a little firm but maybe because pre-made for fast service - the chili jelly sauce stuff was great to mix in. Their beef noodle soup also had a good flavour that was too sweet for my partner but good for me. Overall, there was some noodle aspects that could be better like in the soup too, but nice new addition to the mall.

Dumpling Monster is value for your money without cutting corners. Big portion of yummy Thai Salad and monster filling in dumplings. (Other eateries have small fillings). The lady who served me Dumplings and Thai Salad was so kind and caring. Money wasn't her only goal. Customer satisfaction was. She gave me a generous serving of pickled carrots to go with my Dumplings as she wanted me to have the best experience and she also checked to see if I was allergic to nuts before sprinkling nuts on my salad. Will be back as they deserve my support.

I had the beef brisket noodles here. The broth was a bit on the sweet side but the dish had good flavours. The beef brisket was tender and the portion size was quite big. Staff were nice and friendly. Overall, it was good value and good experience.
Very good brisket noodle soup, I enjoyed it! And a lovely friendly lady serving. Recommended.

I ordered karaage chicken here today, but it was undercooked. When I informed the staff, their response was, “We are following the recipe.” Even visibly, the chicken was pink and looked undercooked, but they kept insisting it was fully cooked and safe to eat. I’m really curious—how can chicken that still has a bloody appearance be considered fully cooked?

The ramen at this place is absolutely amazing, and the side dishes are just as impressive. The service is excellent too. It’s a great spot to come alone and enjoy a beer—this one in particular is incredibly delicious!
“ramen and gyoza are always highly recommended. The chicken karaage would be even better with a bit more seasoning—especially a touch more salt.

Nestled in the heart of the city, Tanpopo Ramen offers an authentic and cozy Japanese ramen experience that warms both the stomach and spirit. From the moment you walk in, the aroma of slow-simmered broth fills the air, and the minimalist yet inviting decor sets the tone for a satisfying meal.

The best local ramen spot, especially in winter time. Despite how busy it can get, the staff are always so efficient & friendly. When ordering takeaway, it is always packed with love. Even a hand written note, love this place so much.

I had an amazing experience at Chicking! The food was fresh, flavourful, and perfectly cooked. The chicken was crispy on the outside and juicy on the inside — just how it should be! The staff were friendly, and the service was quick even during peak hours. The place was clean and had a nice atmosphere for dining in. Definitely one of my favourite spots for a great meal. Highly recommend to anyone who loves good food and great service!

I love their milkshake! They've got five incredible flavors to choose from. Personally, I cannot get enough of the caramel and vanilla milkshake. It's just the best! The staff are friendly and kind. The service here is super quick, and the place is really clean—such a pleasant atmosphere! I had a great experience with customer service! I only had to wait about 9 to 11 minutes, which wasn't too bad at all. I truly enjoy their chicken burger and wraps. The chicken patty on the burger is really crispy, juicy, and perfectly cooked. You should definitely check out their different flavored burgers, milkshakes, and wraps.

Burger was very cold and look at the state of the chicken. One side hasn't been touched because it's just dried up and nothing there, the other side I tried but it was so dry and old, like it had been found at the back of the cabinet? Look at the "burn" marks, been sitting around for a long time. Won't be back.
Chicking Glenfield never disappoints! Always friendly and the chickens are very delicious - fresh and juicy. Highly recommend and we will go back!

If you're craving crispy, well-seasoned fried chicken, Chicking Glenfield is a solid choice. The menu offers a variety of options, from their signature spicy chicken to juicy burgers and wraps. The chicken tends to be flavorful with a satisfying crunch, though spice levels can vary—opt for milder sauces if you prefer less heat. The service is usually prompt, especially during off-peak hours, though weekends can get busy, leading to longer waits. The staff are friendly, and the branch maintains a clean, casual dining area suitable for quick meals. Prices are reasonable for the portion sizes, aligning with typical fast-food chains. Highlights include the Korean-style fried chicken (if available) and the garlic mayo dip, which adds a creamy kick to meals. However, consistency in food temperature and seasoning can occasionally waver during rushes. For a reliable fast-food fix, Chicking Glenfield delivers, but check recent local reviews for the latest updates on quality and service.

Lovely people, gorgeous food, great price, easy parking!! What else can you say?? I bought a steak curry pie and you could taste a rich curry flavour in the meat and gravy!! Thank you for a great, reasonably priced lunch!

We ordered 10 chicken vogels, 5 ham vogels and 5 beef vogels from this lovely bakery a week ago. Just want to pop in to give them a five-star review for our order. Sandwiches are yummyy!! The meats filling is balanced, not much and not less. Highly recommended

Have loved this bakery for years and certainly miss the old owners, but the new ones are also lovely! :) Can't go wrong with their items. I wish they sold a Spinach & Feta Quiche because that's my favourite, but otherwise it's an amazing bakery.
Steak&Cheese Pie... Steak & gravy very dark & salty, could not find or taste cheese, pastry so-so...
Never been here before today even though I live locally, this was THE BEST coffee I have had in Auckland in a very long time! WOW!! Will only be getting my coffees from here from now on!
I bought chicken kebab and the meat is raw, so I swap it with a new one, and it’s the same. RAW CHICKEN MEAT! Disgusting. Health & Safety Concern. Will never buy food from this shop again.
Went here multiple times, the sushi is great and is fairly priced, chicken kebab also tastes amazing. Great service, the owner is very kind, overall pleasant experience every time!

We made our choice of food, went to the counter to pay, the staff member was too busy on her phone, even calling out twice HELLO! She didn't noticed us. I said your phone texting is more important by the looks of it, and we left.

When I went to Glenfield not too long ago with a buddy, we happened across a Japanese restaurant because we were really hungry after our long drive. We were drawn in by the remarkable array of selections and the welcoming atmosphere. I finally settled on a smaller bento after some deliberation, and the young woman who worked as the cashier was small but friendly and gave excellent service. The circular bento box contained a delectably presented selection of steamed rice, shrimp, chicken, veggies, and yummy sauces. While the chicken was moist and delicious, its rich sauce nicely complemented the golden and crunchy shrimp that were melting in my tongue. It was a wonderful culinary experience, one of the most excellent dinners I had eaten in a long time.♥️

Please don't take this review lightly. This is the worst sushi in Auckland (probably NZ). Please go to the other sushi place in the mall (downstairs). The teriyaki chicken sushi was inedible, there was bone and gristle. Overcooked and tasted very odd, my stomach is now churning a few hours later. So, so bad

Butter Chicken; Rice was uncooked, chicken had lots of cartilage, as you can imagine it was a very crunchy meal, not what I signed up for. The server was also talking on the phone through his AirPods while serving and not friendly, poor service. Over all do not recommend, clearly little care if given to the quality of their food and their customers

I rarely leave reviews, but the customer service here was so disappointing it needs to be addressed. The staff member with glasses and AirPods was shockingly rude and aggressive over a simple question. His tone made it painfully obvious that he didn’t want to be there but somehow he is there. There was zero professionalism — just attitude and an unwillingness to listen. It felt like I was being scolded for even speaking to him. Customers deserve basic respect, and this kind of behavior shouldn’t be tolerated in any workplace. Based on how I was treated, it’s clear that customer service is not a priority here. Avoid…

I love this fast food Indian place. I love the sweet butter chicken and the great portion size you get a load of meat in it. My wife said the her paneer ( spelling ) is the best she has. I would say this is not for Indian People as its not super authentic home country flavors. Butter chicken combo with Nan and Coke for $15 does me for two meals. Service is always great here as well. Been my local for 7 years and never had a bad curry yet.

Had a butter chicken combo the chicken was uncooked look like chicken cooked separately and wasn't cooked enough have smell inside. The rice wasn't cook some Part of the rice was still rice. In total it was hard and chewie. Sauce was and coke was tasty..
The food was alright. Customer service ok. Heaps of variety of meat and veggies. Butter chicken was nice and sweet.

We went in with a low expectation as the place didn't look great from the outside. However, the good smell of food and the smile on the face were inviting. The lamb biryani was very good. Prices were reasonable and service was very good. We could hear a baby crying inside, which is a sign of a hard-working family running a business. We always take children as a positive sign. We will go back again as it proved to be a good Indian shop to revisit.

Basic little place with great food and great chai. Prices are excellent too, $3 for a masala chai (masala tea on the menu) is crazy and it’s so good. The curries were delicious. The service and atmosphere are good, I had an issue with my order and it was resolved very easily. Also! The street food! Well worth trying the street food.

A hidden Gem in Auckland! Curry Corner is a must-visit for delicious, affordable Indian cuisine! We tried their chole bhature, dosa, and curries, and everything was fresh, flavorful, and perfectly prepared. The chole bhature was light and fluffy, the dosa crisp and paired with vibrant chutneys, and the curries were rich and aromatic. Generous portions, outstanding quality, and unbeatable prices make this place a true gem. You can also Dine in and enjoy your meal straight out of kitchen. The staff is very friendly, cant wait to be back. Highly recommended!🤌

I really love the curry at this place. I was in search for a good Indian restaurant after moving to Glenfield recently and found this place on Google map. There were many other options but after trying the food here just once, I decided to stick to this restaurant for my weekly doses of Indian curry. Prices are good, staffs were kind and friendly too. Definitely will come back and tell my friends about this awesome place. Thank you!!

What an incredible place! Well kept local secret. Beautiful surroundings and delicious food! Excellent and attentive service.Highly recommended. Great Customer Service by Navdeep. Must Try Desi Chicken Chicken 65 Chicken Biryani

Went here with my family for my birthday lunch. The place was clean and had a nice, welcoming atmosphere. I ordered the lunch special, which let me choose between chicken, fish, or beef, great to have options. Portion sizes were reasonable and everything tasted fresh. Overall, a pleasant experience. Will definitely return.

Fabulous! Came here with the family for teppanyaki dinner for our sons 17th and what a great night it was! The guy who cooked our food was amazing, what a showman and what skills! He was so entertaining and funny. The food was gorgeous and they even brought our son a mini cake with a candle! Absolutely loved it and will definitely come back. Highly recommend 👍👌🍜 ❤️

We are a big fan of teppanyaki and have been to different Daikouku restaurants in Auckland many times and they never disappoint. To me, Daikouku is more than just a restaurant, it is a place where you can get great food, entertainment and service under one roof. It's Mother's Day so the restaurant is very busy. The food was very delicious as always. Unlike past experiences, our chef today seemed like he was rushing off to do other things. The cooking was done in a hurry as if he was racing. There was no interaction with the customers at all. He even forgot to give us the ginger and mustard sauces. We felt very rushed and couldn't really enjoy the food. Not the typical great Daikouku dining experience we have had in the past.

What a fantastic dining experience at Daikoku Takapuna! The environment is warm and inviting, with a sleek, modern design that adds to the relaxed vibe. The chef was exceptionally friendly—taking time to explain menu highlights and even sharing a few cooking tips! The salesperson assisting us was sharp, attentive, and made great recommendations tailored to our preferences. Cleanliness here is top-notch: tables were spotless, and the entire space felt immaculately maintained. The food was delicious, with fresh ingredients and bold flavors in every dish. Whether you’re craving sushi, ramen, or grilled specialties, this place delivers quality and hospitality in spades. Highly recommend for a memorable meal with friends or family! 🍣✨

Disappointed with the service, the staff asked if we finished the food, we said not yet, and she stood there to wait until we took the last piece, and she immediately took the place, we feel very uncomfortable. At the end, my sister was giving rice to her son, the staff poured the cleaning washing product on the hot cooking kitchen, so the smoke came all over and smelt very bad, right in front of our face, very rude! We will never go back. Restaurant manager/ owner, please have more training for your team.
The meal itself was good and the food tasty! The restaurant is clean and tidy, only problem is that we waited for an extremely long time to get our order taken and for our food to arrive.

Fingers lickin good authentic Indian food, greatly improved under new management in terms of food and service. Was impressedly served by young man Eugene at lunch today, he's so polite, welcoming and attentive. Will definitely return more often...

The new management of this restaurant has made a huge difference! The food has always been great but the service wasn't too quick. We were very impressed after a group of 10 of us went last week. The staff were super friendly and food was great.

Myself and my family have been going to Anokha since it was called Kashmir many years ago and have always enjoyed the food, but the service used to be pretty average. However, after recently going after hearing about new owners we were really impressed with the service and thankfully the food is just as good as it always has been!

I had goat curry with cumin rice 16/05/2025, and butter naan it was an excellent meal. The goat was tender and flavorful, with spices that were well-balanced and rich without being overwhelming. The curry had a deep, aromatic taste that showed real care in preparation. The cumin rice was light and fragrant, pairing perfectly with the curry. The cumin added just the right touch of earthiness, making each bite more enjoyable. Overall, it was a delicious and satisfying dish. I’d definitely have it again. Thanks so much chefs

Our gratitude goes to the team for an exceptional dining experience we had at the restaurant tonight. We decided to try our luck without a reservation, and despite the restaurant being packed, the lovely server offered us a table outside under the heaters, which we gratefully accepted. They even offered blankets!!!! 👌 Despite how busy it was, our orders were taken within five minutes, and our food was served within 20 minutes. The pizza was superb, the chicken was tender, and the kids' portions were generous. We discovered Al Forno by chance, but we'll definitely be back the next chance we get—this time with a reservation!

This our first time trying this resto. We could feel the vibe when we were at the front door. Amazing food. Excellent service. Specially by one of the waiter who tried to convince us to take the outside table. They provide the blankets and heater has been there to keep us warm. Some suggestions from a beautiful waitress including the dessert have made our night last night. Special warm greetings that we believe was from the owner has made our night even more wonderful. Thank you so much for your hospitality Al Forno 🙏🏻😊

I booked Al Forno for a friend's bday 🎂 it just so happened to be on an evening when the Takapuna Mid-Winter Light Festival was happening ✨️ so glad we booked as the restaurant seemed very popular. Gorgeous intimate setting with a lovely candlelit ambience. Wood-fired pizza 🍕 classic pasta dishes alongside favourite mains. The staff were all super warm and friendly and the smell from the kitchen was mouthwatering 🤤 There was a huge variety of beautiful Italian reds and whites 🍷 to accompany and compliment your meal. We chose the creamy chicken cabonara 🍝 and the filetto aglio 🥩 both dishes were amazing and cooked to perfection 👌 will have to come back to try the dessert as we were too full this time but they looked delicious 😋 thank you for a stunning experience, highly recommended for a romantic dinner for two or a special family meal out. We will definitely be back! ✨️

What an absolute treasure this place is. This was my final night in Auckland before flying back to Sydney the next evening .My friend whom I was staying with, made a dinner reservation for 7:30pm on the Friday evening in early May 2025. But, when we got there they never had a booking for us. We were a bit upset but they were so lovely and suggested we might like to sit on an outside table and see if a table came up soon....we did have a fab heater above us and they gave us the warmest blankets for our legs! It is the start of winter in NZ at that time of the year. Well, about half an hour...ish later they said there was a table inside but the 3 of us were so busy chatting and drinking, wrapped in our toasty blankets that we were very happy to sit outside. It was actually quite noisy inside. I hadn't seen one of my friends for many years so we were chatting for ages before we actually ordered, but our waitress was super friendly and never hassled us. Now the pizzas....they were absolutely magic!! The crust was so delicious and even the sides of the pizza were so soft and chewy. Unfortunately I forgot to take photos of our fab food, only a location shot. Definitely another visit is on the cards when I go back to Takapuna, fab service and fab food and ambience.

Excellent experience! We took gnocchi which were 10/10, taste and texture. We also took a prosciutto pizza which was so good that we had to come back again. Staff was attentive and kind and answered all our requests.

We visited here for a quick bite to eat before a movie - their pizza and garlic pizza/bread were pretty decent. Not as seasoned as I expected, but it was decent for the price. There was live music in the other side of the venue which was nice. Great staff!

New Year’s Eve dinner. We made a reservation online, but received no confirmation. On arrival, we were told they were fully booked, but we were seated after about 15 mins. The place was full. It’s relatively small, so it’s like an Italian family restaurant. Given how busy they were, the service was fine. We had starters, mains, dessert and wine throughout. All courses, including the risotto (lots of fresh shellfish and prawns) and pizzas, were great, except I was disappointed with the tiramisu: it was deconstructed, served in a champagne glass, over vanilla ice cream.

I am currently posting from at my table at this restaurant. Do NOT come here if you are expecting upscale or calm dining. By the time our food had gotten here, mind you we ordered at 8 and it got here an hour later, a group of thugs had dined and dashed and a gay couple spilled their entire table all over each other. 0/10 DO NOT COME HERE. The food was good
Great local family run Italian restaurant in the heart of Takapuna Regular diners here and have never had a bad experience The veal is very special - highly recommended The pizzas are also fantastic

The night we went there was a lovely jazzy band playing next to the bar but it meant all the other tables and chairs were crammed really close. Good food as per photos. Personally I like my pizzas with more chunky toppings but these tasted great and the pizza base was just as I like it

Fatimas Takapuna is amazing. Firstly, the staff are very nice, and secondly, the food is absolutely delicious. When you taste the pitas, the bread already tastes out of this world. The potato koftas are crunchy and full of deliciousness. I really recommend this place!

We had the lamb salad, which was nice and fresh. Didn’t like the chicken chawarmas. The bun was too thick and couldn’t have a bite with out the stuffing falling out. Yogurt/sauce was way too tangy. The fried potatoes / tatter tots were good, and came with a nice dip.

LOVE the Fatimas Favourite with the Impossible Koftes. Also love that they use Free Range Chicken. Wish it was easier to swap sauces when ordering through the app and ubereats. I love the garlic sauce. I wish the veggie options were cheaper, it feels pretty steep when you compare it with the lamb.
$23.90 with only 5 pieces of lamb. This is appalling! Usually Chawarma are good but now it seems like they're cutting cost with add more lettuce and less lamb!
The falafels were homemade and decent, the lamb in the pitta was cooked and seasoned very very well

Had one of the most unpleasant experiences recently in this store. My husband bought a veggie 6 inch sub. It was burnt toasted with the blackness around. The fillings were not packaged properly and literally falling apart. I called the store and raised the issue but no acknowledgment or help. I raised a ticket to the Subway customer service and they pretty much self resolved the ticket. Feels like going to these well established food chains is no longer catering to the customer like they used to. On top of that the store also refused to honor any deals offered by subway using their app too. It’s such a pain when you go instore to get the food and it’s terrible service like this

The Takapuna (North-shore)Subway is hands down one of the worst fast food experiences I’ve ever had. The food is absolutely revolting from the moment you walk in, it’s clear that quality and care are nowhere to be found. I ordered a footlong sub with three pepper chicken, expecting a warm, flavorful meal. Instead, they slapped cold, flavorless chicken on dry bread that crumbled all over me with every bite. The texture was awful, the taste was worse, and it honestly felt like no effort went into making it remotely edible. To make things even more frustrating, the customer service was terrible. The staff barely spoke, didn’t bother to heat the sandwich, and skimped on every topping. They gave me a sad handful of lettuce, no pickles at all, and barely any vegetables, the bread was more visible than the fillings. For a place that supposedly lets you “build your own sandwich,” it felt like they were rationing ingredients. It’s a complete waste of money and I wouldn’t recommend it to anyone. If I could rate it a zero, I absolutely would. 🤢🤮

Disgusting 🤢 expensive fake food. This was supposed to be a Southern Chicken wrap. This is not even chicken. It’s absolutely disgusting fake processed rubbish that I would not give to my dog. Add to that the tiny portions and the outrageous price of $13.50…NEVER AGAIN. Shame on the franchise Subway as a business is clearly on the way out in NZ….bye bye to this rubbish.

I went there to get something to eat while my wife was in hospital. The staff ignored me serving the people in front of me and behind me but takling no notice of me. When I tried to raise this with a staff member she just shrugged and moved on to another customer behind me. I had not been drinking or said a single word before then. I can only think the staff regard older people as not being worthy of service. Eventually I politely told them where to stick their subway and left. Don't go there!
the only subway ive been that limits me to only 3 salads when its time to pick them. Never going back again

The venue was quite elegant, offering delicious food and a delightful atmosphere. The ambience was romantic and tranquil. We thoroughly enjoyed the pasta dishes. I would highly recommend that you try this particular venue.

Not a bad place for food, portion wise it was a bit small than other Portofinos I have been to, other than that could do with more front house staff, the waiter was lovely but working alone while it is lunchtime is a bit too overwhelming, especially for some other diners who had to wait patiently. Nice clean place.

Food was amazing, large portions, and came out very fast even though it was a busy night on Valentine’s Day. The service was great, you never had to wait to get the servers attention. The drinks were made quickly and they didn’t leave your table with anything empty to clutter it. The atmosphere is very cosy and inviting. This is now my new regular Italian spot!

It may seem low but even though the staff were lovely a couple of them could have done with a bit of training on pouring the wine, wine knowledge, food knowledge etc. not their fault, all the staff were absolutely lovely! But I think management need to invest in training. A good selection of wines and we tried some nice Italian reds. The wine waiter knew his stuff. Food was very nice. A good cheap and cheerful midweek or before a show kinda place.

Pretry average across the board. Foods OK, staff were fine, though not particularly attentive considering it wasn't very busy. We had to follow up on where drinks were multiple times. Food quality just doesn't justify the price. It's 3 star food at 4 star prices.

Absolutely blown away by our visit to BurgerFuel Takapuna. Alex was outstanding — friendly, attentive, and made the whole experience a pleasure. The burger? Hands down the best BurgerFuel burger we’ve ever had — fresh, perfectly cooked, and packed with flavour. Great service, great food, great vibe. We’ll definitely be back.

Love this Takapuna branch. Always consistently good, both food and service. Awesome staff who are really on to it. Would be nice to have some water though, especially if we sit down at the restaurant to eat.

Good burgers and fries. The beef was juicy and tender, and the fries were well cooked and tasty. We all also enjoyed the thickshakes and fried chicken pieces. Only thing to note is that it does get very warm inside the shop, so maybe try and snag one of the outdoors tables if possible.

Double Muscle Is The Meanest Burger Anywhere. Fastest service ever and friendly service. And that's hard to beat Westgate 😜 Cheers guys keep up the legendary work 💪 Be back for sure !! Highly Recommended !!

love a place that has dairy alt milkshakes 🥰 I had the strawberry (it was soooo good!) the v-twin burger can be made with the vegan cheese and the fries were bigger but still had a perfect salty crisp. (practically a spiritual experience) 😋

🌟 3/5 Great Pitas, But the Store Needs Attention Dropped by Pita Pit Takapuna recently. The pitas were very good — fresh, tasty, and satisfying. Definitely a solid 7/10 on taste. Service was okay (6/10). The one staff member behind the counter did their best to manage everything alone — not their fault, but the result was a lack of customer engagement and slow service. What really brought the experience down was the store ambience and cleanliness — I’d give it a 2/10. The place looked unkempt and a bit neglected, which is not what you expect when you're grabbing a meal. It clearly needs better staffing and some management attention. Overall, good food, but the dine-in experience is let down by the state of the store. A little effort from the owners could go a long way.
Great pita. What really stood out was the staff member that served me. He was absolutely lovely. Didn't get his name, but whoever was working tonight at 1810, the best customer service.
Walked in and was told the store was closed at 1 pm. on a busy Saturday, 29th March!???? Terrible!

it was almost a 30 minute wait to get our bowls amidst about 10 other orders which was not fun. pita pit is one of those coinflip places where quality changes every visit so don’t let your expectations up. this time i was pleasantly surprised by the quantity of vegetables in the bowl- definitely more value than a pita or subway. our bowls costed $15.20 each which i think is quite fairly priced in this day and age. taste was decent, wished there was a bit more meat. UPDATE: yep. very much a coinflip place. ordered the same chicken caesar bowl and there were like no toppings compared to last time. like why do employees act like giving you enough/more toppings is coming out of their own pocket 😃

I love the food just notice that they are under staff. When we got there we saw only 2 boys. We didn't complain about how long we waited but would be much better if there were more staff so that would help it faster.

Great looking shop in a great location, but food is terrible, expensive and service is below average. I ordered bacon and fried eggs on toast (white, plain). I received 2 slices of ciabatta bread instead, two eggs (thick, cooked in egg rings and dry as a nun on sunday) and a single slice of burnt bacon, which cost $7. Yes, SEVEN dollars for a single slice of bacon. Never mind that it was burnt or that I should have gotten two for my two eggs and two slices of wrong toast. After a complaint they cooked up another slice of bacon that was good, but they didn't leave the other one (lol) and they weren't happy about it either. On the plus side, my partner got the chicken and bacon club sandwich, which was actually really good. But we won't be visiting coffee club again, not the first time they've been really disappointing for the price.

Good service and the staff were happy to help. The Mushroom omelette was hot and tasted very good. The club sandwiches were very good too, actually better made than other coffee clubs. But they spoiled the presentation but dumping the chips on top. The iced chocolate was way too sweet.
Fast & friendly service👌 Great coffee too! Love their recent relocation & setup opposite Greens, fruit & vegetables🙂
The meat, salad/vegetable and sauce ratio is bang on. Chips are crispy and tasty. A bit expensive...$30.40!
I really enjoyed my lunch at Milford Coffee Club last Saturday. The meal was very tasty and the staff were friendly and helpful.

The owner was very nice and welcoming. We didn’t know that we need to order the kebab the day before so it might need to be easierfor others to find. He explained it was because they always serve their food fresh. The dishes tasted so good and it was so rich in flavor and it luved to my expectations. The vegetables on the side were also fresh. I would definitely go there again if I was near Takapuna.

Delicious! Highly recommend Shahrzad Kebab. Placed a large order for 30 people and they delivered fresh, tasty kebabs and at our agreed pick-up time. Great communication and friendly also, I can't fault them. Thank you, we will be back :)

Very nice owners. Thought I had forgotten y wallet, no problem to them. Food was great; fresh and tasty. Very filling and good quality. Nice to sit outside and just watch the world go by. Kids didn’t want a kebab so ran to subway. No problem letting them eat at the table outside the shop. Really appreciate the customer service which is top notch. Defo come again.
The food represented what you'd expect for a kebab, great quality food however not the biggest kebab around. Bang for buck is decent though. Highly recommended.
Where else can you find a 13$ chicken kebab in Northshore with such a great taste. Yogurt Garlic sauce is great. The owner is friendly and welcoming.

We had a great dinner tonight, prompt service, friendly staff and lovely atmosphere. They brought a special birthday cake for my son, thank you for making our dinner even more special :) highly recommend to everyone, their food excellent and they just updated their menu set.
Love this place. I’ve been 3 times and am always impressed by the quality and quantity. Few places can compete with them.

Our favorite Japanese restaurant in Auckland! Every dish is perfectly cooked to suit our palate, and we love the generous selection of vegetarian options. A wonderful birthday surprise for my hubby—thank you for making it so special! 🎉😊🍣

We had the best experience at Musashi Milford last night! I included that it was a dinner for my friends birthday in the booking note, and without prompting or any discussion on site they surprised us with a beautifully presented cake with a candle and song! Such a lovely surprise and made my friends night, thank you to the lovely staff for making that so special. The food was amazing as usual, and incredible value for money - so much food we were full before the main came out! Thank you guys, we have been coming for years but just keeps getting better.

It's been a while since I have been to this restaurant although I have had some good takeaways from it. The meal last night was of an excellent quality , with good friendly service. I continue to rate this as one of the best Japanese restaurants around. I will be back.

Had a great dinner here! The service was warm and attentive, and the food really impressed us. The beef tataki was tender and flavorful, and the yaki soba was cooked perfectly with a rich, tasty sauce. Everything was fresh and well-prepared. Definitely a spot we’ll be coming back to — highly recommend!

my colleague and I needed a quick meal at lunch time, and as newbies in town, we walked into Arigato as it looked like a family owned business. Service was perfect, really patient and attentive, and the food was fresh, and simply yummie. I definitely recommend the chicken bento box, great value for money.

Wednesday night early dinner. It was not busy and I didn't need to make a reservation. I would say that you should make a reservation if possible as it picked up pace during our visit. Staff were friendly and helpful. Our main server came to us verbally offering vegetarian and vegan options, they were mindful of our dietary requirements and gave relevant options. Food came within 10-15mins. Enjoyed the meal overall and would go back again.

🍤 The prawn and vegetable tempuras are delicious! Everything tasted very fresh. 🍣 The sashimi platter had a variety of 3 types of fish, although slices were on the thinner side. 🍱 The teriyaki eel and salmon were nice, although the portions were quite small despite prices of bento sets being in the upper $20s range. It was balanced with lots of tempura in each set. ⭐️ Lovely service, beautiful restaurant and lots of menu options to choose from :)

Overall the service, atmosphere is good, However I do have a couple of criticisms of the food on the night. Gyoza, prefer mine cooked traditional in a pan, fry and steam. NOT deep fried. My wife had the salmon box I had that eel box . In both cases the fish had been "drowned"!! in far too much sauce which ruined the fish because all you could taste was the sauce. I / we have dined at Arigato a number of times, and will probably go again. BUT I do hope owner /. Chef will make note of the above comments . Domo Arigato.
Typical Malaysian restaurant. Comparatively cheap price. Good portion on each dish. Special dishes each day. Enjoy the chicken rice and Fish vermicelli soup.

I recently dined at Langkawi Restaurant in Auckland and had an absolutely fantastic experience! The food was bursting with authentic Malaysian flavors, and the service was warm and welcoming. I ordered the **Hainanese Chicken on Rice** and the **Banana Prawn Laksa**, and both dishes were outstanding. The **Hainanese Chicken on Rice** was a standout – the chicken was incredibly tender and juicy, perfectly paired with fragrant rice cooked in chicken broth. The accompanying sauces (ginger, chili, and soy) added layers of flavor that made every bite a delight. It’s a simple dish, but Langkawi executed it flawlessly. The **Banana Prawn Laksa** was equally impressive. The broth was rich, creamy, and packed with a beautiful balance of spicy, sweet, and tangy flavors. The prawns were fresh and succulent, and the noodles had the perfect texture. Every spoonful was a comforting explosion of taste – it’s easily one of the best laksas I’ve had in Auckland. The portion sizes were generous, and the presentation was thoughtful, making the meal feel special. The restaurant itself has a cozy, inviting atmosphere, and the staff were attentive and friendly, adding to the overall great experience. If you’re craving authentic Malaysian cuisine, Langkawi is a must-visit. I can’t wait to return and try more dishes from their menu. Highly recommend the Hainanese Chicken and Banana Prawn Laksa – you won’t be disappointed!

Had an excellent lunch on a Monday at Langkawi. Very good service, the meals came quite quickly, and very good pricing for the daily specials. It was quite busy but we walked in and had a table for 4 straightaway. Roast duck curry laksa for me, but someone else really enjoyed their fish curry soup. Recommend.

The food is very delicious, authentic Malaysian and so affordable. Service is great too. It's sad that we stay too far to visit it frequently. I recommend to visit before or after lunch time peak to avoid crowds.

After a rough day at work, a comforting meal at an affordable price made my day so much better! They provide free WiFi too which is perfect for someone that dines in alone, great food, kind owners & chill atmosphere. Thank you! Tried the Singapore fried Meehoon, don’t be fooled by the picture (chicken pieces and big prawns are hidden within the noodles)
Everything was delicious. Steak don, salmon don, yakitori combo etc. was all quite good!

I visited this restaurant at lunch time today with my friend. I ordered Lunch special. Food is good. Service is good. Staff is kind and smiling. Space is not big. I recommend this place to have a meal.
Best curry chicken katsu I've had in New Zealand. Rice, curry and chicken are all perfect 🤤

Disappointed. The servers were polite, but the overall service felt unpolished. One server attempted to take our plate before we were finished, which was unexpected and a bit awkward. Later, another server hurriedly cleared our dishes while we were still talking. She tried to stack the plates in front of us, creating distracting sounds that disrupted our conversation, even though there was no wait for tables. The seating was also too close, making it difficult to have a comfortable conversation due to the noise levels. With the prices they charge, I would expect a more refined dining experience where space and privacy are considered, and the staff is better trained in service etiquette. And the food... very overrated. Nothing special.

Very busy restaurant, we went around 7:30 and it’s nearly full house on a Wednesday night. Food was great and authentic as usual. You have a lot to choose from on their menu. Portion size is great, I won’t say it’s pricey.

I had an unforgettable experience at this sushi restaurant! The sushi was incredibly fresh and delicious—each bite was a burst of flavor and beautifully presented. What truly set this place apart, though, was the staff. Every member of the team was exceptionally kind, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. They went above and beyond to make sure we felt comfortable and taken care of throughout our meal. It’s rare to find such a perfect combination of outstanding food and warm, friendly service.

Sushi here is really good. We eat here with my sister earlier everyone is welcoming even the cashier but .. the one thing that I don’t like is the lady who’s cleaning I’m not sure if she’s Indian or Sri Lanka. It’s nice if she can wait to finish us eating like both of us before she snap my plate and rubbish that I opened. I understand that she needs to clean it but my sister still eating and I’m still waiting on her while I’m opening the items that I buy and show it to her. She asked if we’re finish but obviously NOT and just take my plates and my things, for me it’s disrespectful cuz not every customer has same etiquette and for that cleaning lady she should have manners and commonsense.
sumptuous Japanese Bento meal located inside Milford shopping mall.
Lots to choose from! All looks very appetising. Vegetarian options available. We grabbed 3 boxes for a potluck. They were a hit!

I feel like this place has the best sushi in Auckland. Rice is tender and ingredients are fresh. I especially love the crab meat one. My husband absolutely enjoyed their salmon. There is just the right amount of mayo in it which is delicious. All the rolls have just enough rice and generous fillings, unlike other sushi place. Price is wonderful too - 14 sushi for around $20. People were lining up for lunch even on a Sunday! Service is also fabulous too. Quick and friendly. Will love to visit more often but it is quite far from my place :(

I have been curious about Nanam's menu as I have seen several social media posts about the food. The place's decor is very Filipino. You are also warmly welcomed as you come in. Our server Jel is very attentive. We booked for a high tea menu. The food was both savory and sweet. There was unlimited Jasmine and Pandan tea. The choux pastry and slider buns can be better improved.I loved the panna cotta. I suggest you order calamansi tea. Very good. I also make it a habit to look at the toilets when visiting restaurants. The cubicle I was in did not have a toilet seat. I think the management need to do something about it. Overall it was a good experience. They have cultural presentation and they serenade you as well which add to the Filipino atmosphere.

Overall, it was a pleasant dining experience. We ordered mocktails and we were very happy with both of our drinks. The cauliflower had good flavour. The sisig was definitely a favourite - very lovely pairing with the fresh lettuce pieces on the side. Wasn’t too sure on the roast chicken - while the flavours were good, it wasn’t as tender as we’d like and didn’t have a crispy coating like your typical roast chicken. Halo halo was amazing- great medley of Asian dessert flavours. Staff were very friendly and the decor was lovely.

I can't believe I only found out about this incredible restaurant now! Everything from vibes, service, food quality and portions, to drinks and dessert was fantastic and we'd definitely dine here again. You must get the iconic pork lechon and the wagyu sausage tacos. Takapuna is so lucky to have such a great establishment in its neighbourhood.

Loved how tender the pork belly & beef cheek was. Tacos were also on point, melted in our mouths. Appreciate the awesome service too. So kind and took the time to answer our questions on what the dishes were. Worth the drive from south auckland.

We have been wanting to try Nanam for a while, and I’m so glad we made the drive from West to Takapuna. Worth it! 👍 From the moment we arrived, the staff was warm, attentive, and incredibly accommodating. Everyone in the restaurant made us feel welcome. The ambiance leaned to a slightly fine-dining vibe with Filipino design touches here and there.. very comfortable and relaxed 😊 The food was fantastic 👩‍🍳 I’ve been craving calamansi juice for a while now (which i’ve taken for granted back in the Philippines because calamansi was just everywhere!) and their version hit the spot - so refreshing, and the right balance of sweet, tart/tangy. We started with the Wagyu Tacos. Personally would’ve loved the more garlicky and less sweet longganisa version.. but nevertheless, it was so perfectly cooked and tasty, plus the sauce that came with it was also spot on. We also had the Roasted crispy Pork Belly - crispy skin, juicy meat, and a really tasty apple sarsa. I couldn’t quite pick up the truffle oil that was mentioned on the menu though, but still overall it was delicious. We were slightly still hungry after all that and everything just tasted so good, so we decided to order one more - the Beef Cheek caldereta.. and just wow 🤩 The meat was incredibly tender and the dish was so rich and full of flavour. Again, super glad we got the chance to dine here! It really brought a taste of home in such a thoughtful, elevated way. Will definitely be back and highly recommend! 😋
So lucky to have Taylors close by. Great staff, delicious food, and cool cocktails. Stephen and his team are awesome hosts and make you feel at home.

We were pleasantly surprised by this little gem. Dont be fooled by the size of this restaurant. We tried a few options on the menu and WOW! Yum food, exceptional friendly and fast service. Definitely recommended
Southern fried chicken was dry and overcooked. The meatballs were also overcooked. Pate needed seasoning. The service was excellent and a busy place gave a good ambiance. Wine list excellent.
What an excellent little spot, good food and service is friendly. Not a lot of space but we can usually get a seat outside for a wine and a couple of small plates after a walk.

We had our daughter's 21st party there with around 32 people. The organisation was efficient and everything went extremely smoothly. The food and service was amazing. The venue was perfect and luckily the weather played along perfectly and we could utilise both the inside and outside section of the restaurant. Thank you so much for an amazing evening!!

Footlong meatball sandwich and 3 cookies costed me like 19 bucks? It's about 13 bucks for the foot long and on the extra sides, 3 cookies is said to be like 3 bucks. Guy who served me refused to refund the extra amount and just went on serving other customers?? No sorry, no trying to amend the issue just said thats the price.

Ordered 3 pepper chicken this morning at 8am , 21/12/23 and so disappointed with the food I received. Chicken was hard and chewy and didn’t looked fresh at all. Complained at the counter but the gentleman acknowledged that it’s not made fresh but so adamant to proof that he followed the cooking instructions and it’s not his fault. Total waste of time, money and energy.just putting me off from subway. The bread was hard too as if they definitely not made fresh but also not stored well. No refund offered!
Worst subway I have had. two times this week. So little filling and dressing, even when I asked for more. No accessible serviettes on counter and they wrap one for a 12 inch sub! Last time I will go.
Its always so freezing in here, please turn the heat up especially in the winter. Being warm def makes a difference on a cold day.
Messed up my order and tried to sell every single extra possible 😐. Gave my friend 3 leaves of spinach and like 2 small pieces of onion for his vegetables.
My boy loves his teriyaki salmon. That is only highlights of this dinner. Some piece of paper out of our udon. Gyaza was cold in side!
Tempura was nicely cooked, udon noodles were fresh and not too soggy. The bento set was good and not too pricey.

Renkon is one of my favourite Japanese restaurant franchises, and I was glad to find one in Takapuna. My partner and I went there for dinner. I ordered the Kaarage Chicken Don, while my partner ordered the Egg Chicken Katsu Don. We also ordered takoyaki. The food arrived quickly, and the flavours in our bowls were delicious but a little less than my expectation. The portions were generous, and overall, it was a satisfying dining experience. Water and hot tea were self-serve. On my visit today, the table wasn’t cleaned thoroughly, and the overall indoor lighting was a bit dim. However, we enjoyed our meal and had a wonderful time at this restaurant and recommended for anyone seeking Japanese rice and noodle bowls.

Every time me and my wife come to Takapuna, we spend about 1 hour wandering around looking for somewhere to eat. Everytime we end up here, the food is always spot on, bento boxes and awesome chicken (better than next door) It's supper fresh, super quick and there is tea on tap.

We had Renkon cater a corporate lunch at our premises and they did a fantastic job! The staff were raving about the food for days after. Organizing the menu and options was super easy with the team and Renkon. I can't recommend them enough!!

Great food, great service. We had a really good night. I’ve been here numerous times before, very consistent and delicious food. I had the popping prawns, kaffir lime chicken, papaya salad and the sweet and sour pork. The sweet and sour pork was next level, highly recommend…..as with all their dishes!

Good Dinner here. Had a starter and a main between two people. Also extra rice and Roti. Great flavour with the curry however the meat was quite fatty. Roti is amazing. The tacos were also nice and quite large for a starter. Service was good nice staff. Atmosphere was average, very quiet and big tables for couples.

Very busy on a Friday night, so booking is essential. They do have Banquet meal options, but we ordered our own. We had the Crispy Half Duck, Sweet 'N' Sour Pork Belly, Wagyu Beef Pad Seuw, Popping Prawns, Beef Cheek Curry and Green Papaya Salad. Lovely selection of Drinks. Parking around the corner.
The atmosphere was cozy, and the staff were friendly. Overall, great food and service. I’ll definitely go back!

Great place! The food was absolutely delicious, and it's perfect for sharing dishes so you can try a variety. The service was impeccable—friendly, attentive, and professional. The host truly stood out—knowledgeable, welcoming, and clearly passionate about what he does. Highly recommend
Popped in for a coffee and a scone. Small, slightly dusty scone for 7.50. A bit expensy. Good coffee. adequate experience but nothing special

Yep quite a nice little stop for lunch, coffee was great. Maybe a tad burnt but that could just be the bean I’m not used to. I had a toasted wrap the Mexican chicken and avocado one and that really just hit the spot. Perhaps could do with a bit of heat and spice but that is just personal preference it is a good choice for anyone the way it is. Thanks team

I need to warn the people. Please know I am not usually like this, I don’t review negatively but I need to warn the matcha lovers of Takapuna. I just had the worst ice matcha latte of my life. Do not get ice matcha from here. To be fair I ordered it around 3pm, and they had to ask the kitchen if it was still possible to make, but I didn’t expect to be served a matcha full of hate. Every sip left me straining unblended matcha powder blobs through my teeth. Was lumpy and not blended at all. The only thing that made it drinkable was the seven sugar packets I used. Yes, I drank it out of spite. All that for seven dollars or something idk.
Ordered two matchas which they forgot. Had to ask for them and then go two small cups whereby the matcha was not properly mixed which made it very bitter.

Dropped in on Saturday morning to grab some breakfast. It was raining and was fairly quiet. Grab 2x bacon butties, pancakes, and some smoothies. Price was fairly reasonable for the location (nzd20 per persons). Bacon can be done as you like it. Staff were great and really helpful when you need them and don’t hover around the table which I dislike personally. No bad stares when I asked for some tap water which came refrigerated which was a plus. Food tasted great. Service was super fast.

I had a really disappointing experience at this restaurant. Despite there being only three occupied tables, we had to wait over 30 minutes for our food, which was unreasonably slow. The prices were quite high, yet the portions were ridiculously small—especially the oysters, which were tiny, barely half the size of a thumb. The worst part was the service. When we asked a blonde waitress how much longer the food would take, she responded rudely and dismissively, simply gesturing towards the back without a word, as if she had no interest in communicating with us. On top of that, we ordered a medium-rare steak, but what we got was well-done. When we mentioned this at checkout, the waitress just coldly said, “Oh, sorry about that,” with no real apology or attempt to fix it. What made the experience even more frustrating was that she seemed much friendlier to white customers. I can’t say for sure if it was racial discrimination, but it certainly felt that way. Either way, the poor service and overpriced food make this place not worth visiting. Would not recommend.
The view never gets boring. The beach is spacious, close to shops and cafes and has a playground. You can walk for an hour, swim or watch the boat ramp. My favourite Auckland beach.
I have travelled from the UK, the staff are amazing and food wow. I ordered a Wagyu Burger and it's the best burger I have ever had. Would definitely recommend this place.
Im sorry but . Spend more time to train your staff. Good location with poor service.

Atmosphere really good - but service not awesome. Lots of staff standing around talking and we had to come to the bar to order. Not water given to us at all! Staff also had hair down which isn’t great when your dealing with food.

We thoroughly enjoyed our experience at Regatta Bar And Eatery Takapuna today. Our party of two were well taken care of by Bella! She ensured we were looked after, rescuing us from the cold outside, and allowing us to be seated early. The food was delicious. Thank you so much to her and the team. We will definitely be returning again someday soon. Ngā mihi nui.

Had a fantastic Mother’s Day lunch experience, with a nice sea view and a pleasant ambiance complemented by good background music that doesn't overpower conversation. The food was decidedly tasty, but a bit pricey for what it is. Overall, Regatta is a good choice if you're looking for a spot with a great view and a pleasant vibe for lunch, and are prepared for a slightly higher price point.

We attended a private function here. It is a lovely beachside setting with a variety of indoor and outdoor seating options. The atmosphere is airy, with a nautical themed decor. The reason I would come back is for the food. I had chicken with creme brulee for dessert, and my husband had the steak followed by a cheese plate. I rarely order chichen out but was tempted by the description and not disappointed it was tender, and the flavour was incredible. I would return based on this dish alone. Service was great, efficient and friendly but not intrusive.

We had the best seat in the house! Beautiful views of Takapuna beach and Rangitoto. Great attentive service and the food was delicious. Steak and frites for me plus pan fried snapper with crispy skin for my love! Wonderful desserts, must have a great chef. Great wine list too. Highly recommended!

Restaurant has a nice setting with a great view of the ocean, restaurant music wasn’t too loud either. The servers were very prompt and professional although the menus were a bit old and tatty. Restaurant was clean and had a nice indoor outdoor flow, we sat on the threshold on a Tuesday night and it wasn’t too busy, there were a few groups dining. Our starters were fantastic, the lemon pepper squid was perfectly seasoned and everything came with plenty of sauce. The broccoli was good. The wagyu burger patty was a bit dry, but good balance of ingredients in there. I found the fish a little tasteless, but the chips and salad were nice for both. Also got a mango colada mocktail which was very good.

Had an omelette with salmon, the ingredients were fresh and high-quality, and the colors were so vibrant it looked delicious even before the first bite. The staff were all super friendly and welcoming. Definitely want to come back again!

This has become our favourite cafe. The staff are thoughtful, attentive, extremely pleasant and friendly. We like to sit in the outdoor garden area and we take our small dog with us, which is a bonus. The outdoor area is pleasant and so enjoyable. The staff recognise us, remember our orders from previous visits, they remember our names and make us feel welcome every time we visit. I highly recommend Plumm cafe! The food is delicious too. Some of the dishes we’ve tried: eggs on toast sometimes with bacon, the big breakfast which is large so make sure you bring your appetite for this one, eggs Benedict, smash avocado, creamy bacon mushroom. Great options available for vegetarians as well. Try them out when you’re in the area! You won’t be disappointed.

What a delightful start to the day. My family of four had such a great breakfast experience that we came two days in a row while visiting the area and to be honest, we will probably be back again tomorrow. The food is delicious. The service was intuitive and pretty quick even with a bit of a crowd. Service was very friendly and they seemed to know what I needed before I did! I was curious about the creamy mushroom toast, wasn't sure if I should veer off my usual rotation of tried and true breakfast orders but I'm so glad I did. It was savory and hit the spot on our first visit. I was wanting something sweet today and tried the French toast. Delicious. Wrangling two kids at meal times can be tricky but this spot was great. They had a kids box they brought to the table with some coloring books, Legos and play doh which kept the kids busy the whole meal was a dream for a tired mom. I noticed a couple highchairs to the side if you have little ones. There was space to the side to store our strollers. Bathrooms were clean and close to wash up. It's the simple things that really make this a special spot. My latte was made well. The food is presented beautifully, edible flowers really add to the dishes and are a nice visual touch. I know it sounds silly but all these little things make or break a place when you're spending money and Plumm Cafe really made us feel fancy and special. Cheers to the staff who went above and beyond. Also whoever is in charge of produce I would like to know the secret. Everything was perfectly ripe and full of flavor. Thank you for taking such good care of us. I highly recommend making a trip here if you have a little time to enjoy yourself or want to impress a friend/date/family etc. Social groups need to have this space on the radar.

What a delightful little hidden gem in the heart of Takapuna. Don't be fooled by the tiny area at the front, there's a hidden garden area down a side passage. We had a girls' lunch and I enjoyed an Asian Prawn Salad with extra avo, a large yummy flat white, a pot of ginger tea and a Biscoff cheesecake (which I shared) and my bill came to just over 50 bucks. Well worth it! Explore this Takapuna treasure for yourself

I had a fantastic experience at this cozy café! The staff were incredibly kind, welcoming, and attentive from the moment I walked in. You can really feel the warm and friendly atmosphere—they make you feel right at home. The food was absolutely delicious! Every dish was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. I especially loved the breakfast which was perfectly made and full of taste. Whether you're stopping by for a quick coffee or sitting down for a full meal, this place is definitely worth a visit. Great vibes, great service, and amazing food—what more could you ask for? Highly recommend! ☕🍰😊
We love the pad Thai. Owner is very friendly and always offer kids some little treat before and after meals

My ex- restauranteur friend ( chef / baker ) took us here to celebrate a special occasion. So we shared entrees and mains between 4. The quality (healthiness) & variety are superb. The expertise with which meats were cooked world class !! Recommend highly.Service & spice level choice a breeze.From Denmark to Germany or here ..this was the best I have experienced.Stunning.

The owner is so nice and a very polite gentleman. My family and I have been loving and coming to this restaurant for over 3 years. This place has very delicious food and the atmosphere is very calm and inviting. The service is impeccable and the food never ceases to amaze me. Thank you so much!

A rip off , We ordered the sizzling pork hotplate and a single rice (2 dining) and menu shows very clearly the cost was $30 each for the pork . Therefore bill should have been $63 but when we went to pay the amount was $79 . When questioned the waitress who could barely speak English we where told additional cost was for the large portion. The menu makes no mention of any large portion at all. The restaurant had people coming and going so a limited challenge was made but not wanting to make a scene and not being able to "Get through" to the waitress we settled the account , We and now many of our friends will not return which is dissapointing as we have been a client for ten plus years
BRILLIANT service and very good meals. All cooked within reasonable time and super high quality. Highly recommend. 👌😁

We recently held a media event and had to find a new venue for 120+ people, at very short notice. Luckily for us the Cruising Club was available. They were brilliant to deal with, nothing was a problem, communication was fantastic, and they bent over backwards to accommodate everything we needed. A floor plan was created so we knew what to expect, and it was all set up exactly as agreed upon. The food was great, lighting was lovely, and all the catering and bar staff were super helpful on the night. I highly recommend them for any kind of function.

Absolutely fantastic venue for an event! We hosted over 250 guests, and everything was seamless. The staff communication was outstanding—from the initial planning stages right through to the day of the event. The space was clean, well-maintained, and fully equipped, with breathtaking views as a bonus. The food was also excellent!

What a relaxing and nice place to be out with friends or family. It is very family vibe. There are volleyball net and one basketball 🏀 for the family. Plenty of space for family. It is close to the beach and a public toilet where you can shower after swimming. Just the car park is very limited.
Great setting just across from Milford beach with happenings @ the Milford Cruising Club not to mention a delicious menu Thursday nights & the weekend too 😋 🥂
Excellent venue for social events. Wonderful staff

8.30pm looking for food after visiting gma at north shore hospital. Not much open monday night but drove past this place so stopped in. Glad we did. Even though it was close to closing they seated us. Very nice gentleman served us and took our order. Spring rolls and curry puff tasted freshly made and were delicious. Green curry, pad med ma maung and pad thai mains were really good. Oldish environment but dont let that stop you. Highly recommend this place. Great staff service and food. Will happily go back here
Got the yellow curry, chicken satay skewers and spring rolls. Food was enjoyable but lacked flavor, and the small portion of rice was a big let down - why skimp on the cheapest part of the meal??

Customer service was excellent! Seated immediately and once we ordered food was to us in about 10 minutes!! Tasted fantastic and price was a lot cheaper than we were expecting and again quality was fantastic!! Most definitely will be back again ❤️❤️
A nice place to have Thai food. Environment is relaxing, service is nice. Food is delicious, very authentic.

I will let the photo do the talk! ❤️ The presentation is stunning! The taste is irresistible! We love the food here, and we can be difficult customers when it come to hunting good food! They are well deserve the compliment!

Both the ganjajang and jjamppong were delicious. I ordered the large portions, and the servings were so big it was almost overwhelming. At first, I thought the place was closed because the lighting was so dim, but I realized it was open after taking a closer look. The staff were also very friendly. However, the atmosphere felt a bit gloomy, which made it seem like the staff were lacking energy, and I felt sorry about that. I hope you stay strong and continue serving your delicious food.
We love the jjamppong very much!! Coz the soup with noodles is really nice delicious seafood taste. You may also ask to adjust how spicy you like, really nice service!
Best Jajangmyeon and jjamppong I've had here in Auckland. We also had spicy chicken (Kanpungi) which is also amazing! Great service too! Will definitely come back to try other food on the menu
As korean, this restaurant is selling exact same taste of korean chinese food. Jjambbong was seafoody and Jjajangmyun was savory not too sweet. Sweet sour pork was descent. Highly recommended.

Fairly decent especially when going with your Korean family. Ordered a ton of course which came out with good timing, but wish they had a few extra bowls and plates as we switched like 3-4 different dishes. Was still a bit chilly inside especially near the toilets. About 5 private group dining rooms and then 10 or so tables and booths in the main area.
Excellent sweet and sour pork and traditional sour pork. Crispy out and soft in loaded with impactful flavour.
Pot-stickers (not to be confused with your usual dumplings fried) are very very gooooood! And so is the hand-torn pancake! Fabulissimo
This place was extremely chaotic, 3 waitresses managing around 60 people. Food took over 1 hour for everything to arrive.
I have been here three times ! The food is super authentic and even my kiwi friends are loving it !

First time trying the new restaurant in Milford. I had Kung paw chicken on rice for lunch. One of the best kung paw chicken I had. Very generous portion and great service with a smile I also given a side dish for free to try
Stop at you food truck at the Silverdale night market and really enjoyed the food. It was tasty the right mix of crunchy, fresh, mild heat and easy to eat. Will definitely eat again.

I cannot recommend this place more highly. As a local on Waiheke island we are very lucky to have many amazing restaurants/wineries to choose from. Yet it’s the ones with exceptional service, food, wine lists and views… this is what draws us back. This place really spoils guests. The staff are exceptionally trained, personable, knowledgeable and deliver the best local cuisine fresh from the island. My dream spot to bring friends at every opportunity. Thank you oyster inn for creating this amazing place to enjoy.

Four of us dined at Oyster Inn last night, a Sunday. Most of us were there for the roast and I was lucky enough to get the last beef portion, the other two wanted the pork. My wife nearly always has fish and she did again, having blue cod. It was a quiet cold night outside but very cosy inside. The staff were attentive and obliging. We all enjoyed our meals and we'll be back.Thoroughly recommend the roast though -$45.

We had a corporate group of 22 guests enjoy dinner in the private Pearl Room and the feedback on the food, service and ambience was extremely positive. So thank you for making this event such a success for our client. Karen Webb, Managing Director, Destination Waiheke Island

Went to the Oyster Inn for the Easter long weekend. Ended up coming there twice. I went there initially once but left my umbrella there and ended up dining there again. Props to them for finding and keeping lost things safely. Their food was so delightfully tasty. If you come on a weekend, please get their tuna tacos. A waitress also recommended that we should get their cod, and man was she right for recommending that. The seaweed butter sauce it came with was divine!

Had a lovely dinner here! We loved the oysters and everything else we had off the menu, so much so that we immediately booked dinner again for the following night. Good thing too, because we accidentally left our umbrellas behind at our table when we went home. Thankfully, the staff at the Oyster Inn held on to them and gave them back to us the following night. And yes, our second meal here was equally delicious! Haven't stayed at the Oyster Inn, so I cannot speak to that experience, but I'd definitely recommend the food! Just be safe and book a table, especially during the summer months.

Wow what a great idea to come to this restaurant. We forgot to take pictures because went obsessive over the food and to finish them asap. Even the atmosphere is fabulous. Bali has done an amazing job by serving us. We’ll visit again. Thank you
Visiting from Australia. Came here for dinner on our first night. Dinner was exceptional. Service was lovely and the staff were so friendly to our little kids. Thoroighly enjoyed it.
Good Indian food on the Waiheke Island in Oneroa village

Ordered the dhal fry and malai kofta curry. Waited 30 minutes for the food to arrive but staff were apologetic and the meals were tasty so it was worth it. Portion size of the rice could be bigger as they only gave us a medium sized bowl of rice to share. Prices are on par with every other Indian restaurants.
Ordered takeaways online for 4 people, all the food was really good and the spice levels requested were catered for perfectly. I would definitely go back. Thank you 🙏

We had an amazing experience at this restaurant! The food was absolutely delicious and everything we ordered was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. The service was just as impressive. The Dhannajaya (DJ) added a great vibe to the atmosphere. We especially appreciated that the owner came over to check in with us personally. it really made us feel welcome and valued. Highly recommend and we’ll definitely be back!

I saw all the good reviews then we picked this restaurant. Sorry that we were very disappointed. We ordered seafood chowder, not creamy at all, very watery and the bread was cold. (I had to asked them to toast it) My husband ordered BLAT that made by burger bun and not fresh. I knew we came in just before 11:00am, but we expected a good food at that price. However, the views were good and stuff were friendly.

We stopped in for a quick snack and were not disappointed. Very quaint atmosphere with a great view of the beach, but it was rainy when we were there so we didn’t get to see as amazing at others have. The food was quite tasty and they were accommodating with our timeline.

Amazing restaurant to have a romantic dinner. Must visit and enjoy the atmosphere and THE VIEW this was an eye catching location and spectacular vista. Good food and very friendly staff. Strongly Recommend!

I ordered the pasta of the day (which on the day I visited was a basil-based pasta with almonds and goat cheese),and it was the best meal I had during my 17-day trip to New Zealand! The beautiful view of the ocean right in front of you and the friendly staff made the experience even better. If you visit Waiheke, I highly recommend trying this restaurant!

Wai Kitchen is a great spot—easily accessible with free parking nearby and a lovely view of the sea. The staff were warm and accommodating, which made the experience even better. We had the pork belly poke bowl and eggs benedict—both were tasty and well-presented. The hollandaise was a bit too buttery for my taste, but that might just be me. Overall, a relaxed and enjoyable brunch stop on the island!

Great spot with the best view and light room. Menu isn't extensive or as traditional as other but the team are more than accommodating. We had a a great waiter who was attentive, funny and warm - tall grey haired man (didn't catch his name). Coffee was really good as well. Would come back.

Fantastic service, great food and beautiful views! Lovely experience all around! Really tasty juices were a highlight but breakfast is yum too with great presentation. Justin was really patient and friendly when answering tourist questions on best vineyards to access on the island!
Amazing place with a great view over the ocean ☺️ plenty of seat and amazing and friendly staff. The COFFEE was GOOD ( and I work as a barista ) Worth a visit! :)
Good service getting offered a table further up with a better view as it became available. Waiter with the moustache was funny. Eggs benny and pancakes were great. Food came fast. Views were 10/10

We were supposed to have lunch at a winery but after reading reviews and seeing photos of their burgers I cancelled our booking and we are sooooooo happy we did. Quite honestly it was the best burger we have ever eaten, ever. We both had the Big Beefy (I had bacon as an add on)… wow. Just wow. Every single 5 star review is 100% bang on. The freshest ingredients, juiciest meat, prepare to get messy.in a great way. The chips were fantastic although we only needed 1 serve not 2! We are so full, fat and happy.
