It cost us $85 each to come over on the ferry and get the hop on hop off and this was the highlight of our day. It’s very easy to see how they’ve won so many awards. The owner is an amazing human being and his passion for sourcing local produce and creating brilliant food is evident from the second you arrive in the alley situated groovy cafe. I want to eat here every day for the rest of my life.

This is our Friday night go too and they never fail to be amazing! Always fresh ingredients and so delicious!! I have the gluten free bun and it’s so good! Couldn’t recommend enough if your visiting the island

By far the best burger ever. I had a Big Beefy Bun with Swiss cheese and my wife had the same burger but with bacon and blue cheese. We both were blown away by the freshness and amazing flavors. If I am ever passing through NZ again, I will make the effort to come here again.
One of the best burger I have tasted recently. I should've gone for the bigger one not the small one I am coming back for man bun next time cheers :)
Possibly the best burgers we’ve ever had! Friendly staff and great price for the food!

Met one of my favorite chefs on the island here. It’s the one of two places I’ve eaten out at on the island and after hearing the head chefs story one night of living and growing up on the island, I was happy to put my money behind this. I like to know where my money is going. I am very conscious spender. The food was excellent and prepared right in front of me. I had the best seat in the house I like to believe.
One of the best I’ve been so far in Waiheke, staff is very friendly, proactive and kind. The food was absolute heaven. Thank you for the experience.

Delicieux! May not suit everyone's needs but it did ours! The chicken was fantastic. The portion was massive. The snapper/prawn pasta was tasty. Broccoli on the side was great. Staff were great and bubbly despite being busy. Had to have dessert and stay longer... An amazing cheesecake/creme brulé! And a rich chocolate tart. Everything delivered.

We were told this is a good place to eat and ooh la la we loved it! Creative menu, excellent cook on everything. Every dish has heaps going on but you can taste every ingredient. Really enjoyed the vibe too, homely, and a very nice touch with the wine on display.

Possibly the best prepared steak I’ve ever had. Fried crispy on the outside, perfect medium rare on the inside, simple butter sauce. Delicious. Friendly and speedy service. Great atmosphere. Highly recommend!

I went here for lunch today and it was honestly one of the best fish and chips I’ve ever had. I got the beer-battered snapper, which had a perfectly light and crispy batter, and the snapper itself was tender and full of flavour. The chips were the real standout — soft like mashed potatoes on the inside, crispy on the outside, with little crunchy crevices that made them irresistible. The salt and pepper squid was also fantastic. The lovely couple who run this place, along with their big friendly dog Andy, were warm and welcoming. Highly recommend!

If you're looking for a place that serves up incredible fish and chips, this restaurant is a must-visit! The fish is perfectly battered and fried to golden perfection, with a flaky and tender interior that makes each bite a delight. The chips are crisp on the outside and fluffy inside, complementing the fish beautifully. The burger is also a standout – juicy, flavorful, and served with all the right toppings. It's clear the kitchen takes pride in sourcing quality ingredients and crafting satisfying dishes. Beyond the food, the restaurant itself is adorable, with a cozy and welcoming atmosphere that makes it a pleasure to spend time in. The staff are friendly and attentive, adding to the overall positive experience. Whether you're in the mood for classic fish and chips or a hearty burger, this spot delivers in both taste and charm. Highly recommended!

Perfect little spot to enjoy NZ authentic fish and chips (and fish tacos are great too!) while enjoying the beautiful view of Oneroa Beach. Has nice little vibe and the owners are nice and humble as well.
Absolutely delicious fish n chips! Get the snapper n chips and you won’t be disappointed! Wonderful back views and Andy the house dog is the best front of house staff you’ll find!
If you want fresh fish n chips with amazing view in Waiheke Island, this is the perfect place!
Loved our lunch at Aperitivo! The guy front of house was great and the food was delicious. Really lovely spot
Pretty happy with everything. The service was very attentive, food was on point and the music and view just gave it some extra pop.

The food, drinks and dining experience was fantastic, but the service is what made the night spectacular. One server in particular Dan. Show stopping. Incredible. Mind blowing. Waited on us hand and foot. His extensive knowledge of food and drink has opened a whole new world of taste for us.

An excellent place for food in Oneroa. The menu is mostly smaller plates that are great for sharing so there is an opportunity to try many different dishes. Across two meals we ended up having 8 out 13 dishes on the menu (excluding desserts) - hard to say what was the favorite but I would call out the pork belly, gnocchi and oysters were wonderful. In addition service is friendly and attentive, the views are beautiful, and the drinks are interesting with some local flavor twists. On Friday evening there was live music as well!
Amazing and very well prepared dishes. Atmosphere is super and a must visit

If you're in the mood for authentic Thai food, you should check out this place that offers not only excellent cuisine but also a stunning ocean view! The ambiance is great, and the food is unbelievably delicious—truly a must-try if you’re hungry for Thai flavors. I highly recommended

Beautiful view of the ocean from our seat that we had. The pad Thai tasted extraordinary. I enjoyed every bite of it as it was superb in flavor and spices. The pad see ew on the other hand was lacking flavor and wasn’t as impactful as the pad Thai. It was a little bland but still good enough to eat. Overall a good place and I would return.

The Red Crab is our go to for a Friday night. Food and drinks are always awesome - the Pad See Ew is a must! Guy and Yam are always so hospitable and remember our drink order every time we go in. Absolute must if you’re on Waiheke :)

Nice Restaurant and Bar with view at the sea. Between 12 and 3 PM was Lunch Special. I took Pad Thai for (Rice with Chicken) 15,50 NZD. It was delicious. Common prices are around 25 - 30 NZD. The possibility to sit outside is great. Smart, there is quite a lot green including some smaller trees to hide the houses in front. This works fine. In this way you can enjoy the wonderful view. Clear recommendation.

Paid NZ$39 for 2 persons lunch. The fried rice and pad thai were tasty. However, the chicken was slightly too hard and bland. Service was friendly and efficient. I paid in cash as there was a surcharge of 2.5% if pay by credit card.

We had a lovely breakfast at Café Fenice Italia to start our day on Waiheke Island. The food was delicious, the coffee was great, and the atmosphere was warm and welcoming. A charming spot to enjoy a peaceful morning before exploring more of the island.

Enjoyed a breakfast here on a Monday morning in an outdoor seating overlooking Oneroa township. Monday is a relatively quiet day on Waiheke without the weekend xrowds. The menu for breakfast and brunch was reasonably comprehensive and well priced. The restaurant was busy and frequented by locals which was a good sign

Had a great meal at Fenice. We tried the Margherita pizza, calamari, buttermilk waffle, and iced coffee, everything was delicious, especially the iced coffee (so gooood!). The staff were super friendly and made the experience even better. Will definitely be coming back.

A decent spot for brekkie on Waiheke—Fenice is conveniently located on the main street and is easy to find. Their menu offers safe, classic options, making it a great choice if you’re dining with picky eaters or looking for something familiar. From the breakfast/brunch menu, we tried a few classics: eggs Benedict, sausages, and muffins. The eggs were slightly overcooked for my liking but still decently runny. I felt the sausages could have used more flavour and seasoning to stand out. It’s a lovely spot with a good vibe near the beach, offering pretty good food. I’d love to return and explore their dinner options.

A little slice of Italy on Waiheke! 🇮🇹☀️ Fenice is the perfect spot for anyone craving Italian on Waiheke. The atmosphere is perfect for a cosy lunch. The pizza? Amazing! The base is perfectly crispy and the toppings are quality. We paired our pizza with a lovely Prosecco rosé. The staff are super kind. Highly recommend! Can't wait to come back one day!🥂

Lovely authentic crepe stall. It feels authentic that you see French people made the crepes for you. Portion is big, a bit too salty to my liking. A few tables for seating under big umbrellas beside the main road. It Can be a bit too hot at Summer but overall a good experience and decent crepes. Gluten free and organic options available.

Knowing it's Waiheke Island doesn't justify the exorbitant price for a below-average crepe. $14 for a plain European crepe is simply insane. Are you really going to charge over $20 if a customer wants toppings? ======================================= Reply to the owner's response: I appreciate the owner's sincerity and understand the challenges small businesses face, especially post-COVID. However, I had a concerning experience that I feel warrants this review. Last weekend, around 3 PM, my three-year-old son was hungry after missing lunch, so we stopped for an afternoon tea for him. I carefully browsed the menu, trying to avoid items with excessive chocolate or syrup for my son. I settled on the "European" crepe, as it was the only one without those toppings. The girl behind the counter even confirmed I didn't want any toppings, which I affirmed. To my surprise, I was charged $14. I immediately questioned this, as the menu clearly stated the "European" was $12. The girl's immediate, unhesitating response was that prices had increased and the menu simply hadn't been updated. She then offered to give me $2 back, which felt like an afterthought. This experience left me questioning the value of a $14 crepe in my original review, but more importantly, the transparency of your pricing. The girl's quick reply suggests this isn't an isolated incident, and it makes me wonder how many other customers have been overcharged due to that. I'm keeping my rating as is. Until your menu reflects the price matched what's I was charged last weekend, I believe cheating customers, even if unintentional, is a more serious issue than an overpriced crepe.

Crepes is very good. Actually one of the few savoury crepes I really like. The service is very slow though. Over 30 minutes wait for 1 crepe, so if they can improve on that, it will get a 5 stars from me.

Came here twice during our 4 day Waiheke island escape, both experiences were exceptional. Had savoury crêpes on both occasions, which we had never tried before, and have to say they are delicious. The owner treated us to sweet crêpe which was beyond amazing. Customer service, great conversations and exceeding expectations. We will definitely be back again!

This ain't your average flour-and-water flapjack joint. I Love Crêpes battered brilliance, slings out crêpes so good, they'll have you questioning your entire life choices (mostly involving the questionable crêpes that you've thought have made you "worldly" in the past). Put it this way... It's worth swimming across the Hauraki Gulf for. Onto the crepes themselves. Let's just say they're the Beyonce of the breakfast world. They strut onto your plate, all golden and glistening, with toppings that range from the Dolce de leche (think caramel, banana and cream) to the seriously compelling savoury range (hello, smoked salmon, hot sauce, avocado, and everything else). I devoured that bad boy, and let me tell you, it was a one-way ticket to flavourtown. So when on Waiheke tell your grandma to put down her paper-thin or paper ream thick, floppy a-s-s pancakes aside and get to the Creperie. One thing I would say, is make sure you are not in a rush, as good things take time and hes as busy as a one armed brick layer in Baghdad. Ei-ffel in love with this creperie 🥞
Great place to get breakfast in the morning after a day at the wineries! We got the dusty brekkie and coffee and everything was fresh and made quick! Nice people who own the restaurant

My husband and I came here three times in two days and tried to order as many things as we could because everything was amazing - the food was unbelievable and much cheaper than a lot of other places, the coffee was the best we've have in a long while, and the owner was the loveliest Frenchman! We wish we could have stayed longer to try more dishes but it will have to wait until next time. What a gem of a spot, start here so you don't need to go anywhere else. Favourite dishes: everything we tried was fantastic but my favourite was the dusty breakfast (filled homemade ciabatta) and the coffee, and my husband's favourite was the fish tacos.

This is easily the best breakfast I’ve had on Waiheke. I wish I had found it earlier. French toast to die for. Best and simplest B/E roll with really fresh Cibatta. But best of all it is priced so fair.

Fantastic little place by the bus stop, just far enough away from the busy main street of Oneroa. Both staff were very friendly and and user friendly. Our food (bacon and eggs) were made super quickly and tasted amazing. It was enough to keep us going through the morning. The cabinet French toast was fantastic and worth a try! Coffee was definitely needed, the mocha had the perfect balance of chocolate and coffee. Plenty of outdoor seating and a nice vibe.

The best place for breakfast & lunch on Waiheke Island! Lovely spot with few seats outside, offering stellar breakfasts with REAL french patisserie goods (only place we got a like-in-Paris croissant in weeks...), as well as yummy sandwiches & burgers around lunchtime. Prices significantly lower than rest of the island while the food is better here. We came back twice during our three day-stay on the island!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Fantastic spot! The service was warm and welcoming from the moment we walked in. The food was absolutely delicious — fresh, full of flavour, and beautifully presented. Loved the relaxed atmosphere and stunning views too. A perfect place to unwind with great food, drinks, and friendly staff. Highly recommend and will definitely be back!

I had a delicious breakfast at Nomads, I ordered the waffles and a coffee. The staff were very friendly and efficient, the music was lovely and the view was just sensational. I highly recommend. If I was a local I would be here everyday!

The breakfast was delicious, and the view was amazing. I highly recommend both the brekkie burger and the waffles, hard to choose which I liked better. And while you eat you can see a great view of the water.

I was quite disappointed by my experience here. I ordered the Nomad Slaw, which unfortunately fell short of expectations—it lacked flavor and was difficult to enjoy, even though I typically love salads. The dish was supposed to feature kaffir lime, but I couldn't taste it at all. The sauce was thin and flavorless as well. I also tried the rib taco, which was disappointingly small, just two bites, and lacked any real flavor. I eat out frequently as I travel, and I was really let down, especially since I was recommended to try this place. My client had the fish and chips, which looked decent but I can't comment on the taste. Overall, while the view is beautiful, the food didn’t live up to the location.
Sitting area outside has an amazing view of the sea and smell of stone oven pizza. Great espresso and beer.

One of the most delicious wraps I’ve had! Lost of yummy flavours, staff are incredibly friendly and it’s a nice spot to dine in on a good day. The brownie was so good too!! Will definitely be coming back.
Best lunch in the island! Food is excellent and tasty, using the freshest ingredients and herbs. You can ask for keto meal if you want. Friendly service and a peaceful location. Highly recommend!

Lets start with WOW. Presentation is amazing, please see photos. It jumps off the plate. Taste is got to be some of the best vegetarian on the island. Fresh, aromatic, vibrant and not bad on the wallet. Very popular place so you mite have to wait but exceptional 👏 5 + stars from me.
Delicious food, delicious vibes. The perfect epitome of what a local food shack should be. Thanks Tibby and Viola.
Tasty food, amazing service, and wonderful people. Will come again when visiting New Zealand in the future. Highly recommend!

Split the sesame fried chicken and sage fries after a long day of hiking. Absolutely the BEST chicken sandwich I've had in my entire 21 years of life! ESPECIALLY if you like pickled ginger!! The combo of the seasame breading on the chicken, the soft brioche bun, and the flavor dimensions that the coriander created, INCREDIBLE! The fries were so crispy too and seasoned to perfection! Amazing with the jalapeño mayo too! Owner is super nice and great music and atmosphere to enjoy this amazing meal on this beautiful island. Might have to come again for lunch tomorrow... it was THAT GOOD!!!
Amazing Burgers at Nippy Bites!! Highly recommended. We had pork belly burger and wagyu smash burger. Both absolutely delicious 👌 Thanks

Had the chicken burger, scotch fillet burger, and plan to make my way across their whole menu as their burgers are amazing. Best I've had on the island so far. Great eating area and a healthy serving size. Thanks NB team see you for the next one!
Unbelievably good pork belly burger!! Myself and two friends got burgers, they had the crab and loved it! Can’t wait to try the rest of the menu, thank you 🍔
Great place for a bite to eat. The buns are soft and silky, small menu but packed with flavors. Tots are awesome and large and the dip with them is divine. Would definitely recommend.

Absolutely amazing food! The sashimi was incredibly fresh and expertly prepared. The chicken sando was the standout for me — soft, fluffy bread with just the right amount of sauce. The owner was so warm and welcoming, which made the whole experience feel personal and homey. I’ll definitely be coming back!

I ordered a salmon bowl. While waiting, the owner lady gave me a complimentary miso soup 😋. The owner is very nice and kind, the rest of the staff also treated me with warm smiles 😊. The salmon was delicious and the freshest I've ever had. The salad and the sauces really compliment the salmon. Miso soup was very refreshing cuz It was cold n pouring outside ☔. Overall, the food is good and well worth the price.

Yummy!!! The owner was very friendly and the seasoning of the sushi is just right, not too strong.I like it! The rice and salmon are both fresh and very delicious. I’m thankful that I can eat such delicious sushi in Waiheke.

Been a frequent visitor/ semi local to Waiheke for over a decade and always thought the Island was missing some sushi. Couldn’t be more delighted that Oneroa Sushi on the Main Street took the chance. Cool and calm atmosphere, extremely kind customer service and excellent sushi. Half the price of most chain places and double the quality. Plus the lovely owner was willing to give us complementary house made iced tea as it was a hot day. New must-stop lunch spot!

How lucky is Waiheke island to get the best Sushi spot just before summer?? Super fresh, high quality ingredients, great service. Get there before they sell out! Best, Jess, Hospitality Specialist Kakapo Business Sales

Do not recommend coming here and wish we had left. I’m usually very lenient, but this is by far the worst place I have eaten at. Menu was limited and photos look nothing like what we got after waiting an hour. I Wish I had taken photos, but all the dishes looked dull, were worse than making it at home, and did not taste fresh for the price. It is difficult to mess up simple breakfast staples, and yet I could not finish my meal. Music was also too loud and made it difficult to have conversations.

0 Stars. Never write reviews but had to for this one. Don't recommend! 1 hour wait time, Food looked & Tasted Awful. The menu has photos different from what is served. For the first 30 minutes Imagine Dragons Demon on loop, then the music was turned off replaced with a buzzing sound. Ordered: Fish Burger(Very Oily & Dry bun), Avocado Toast(On the verge of browning & heavily tasted of lemon juice on stale bread) & Bacon & Eggs(looked awful).

We had a wonderful first experience at Zayn's The Coffee Man's new coffee/icecream/waffle shop here in our tourist village on the west coast of Waiheke Island. Zayn brings heart to everything that he does. We are feeling so spoiled by his $1 coffee 'new business promotion'. A highlight for me is the brightly coloured powders that can be used to make each drink memorable and rather delightful! I recommend the charcoal and honey : D. Notice Zayn's personal branding which features him being adorbs with his hefty dog (37kg!) Braulio (Spanish for 'shining'). Looking forward to visiting Zayne time and time again (I cannot resist his 'deep shade' classy black umbrellas over his outside seating) to enjoy the vintage jazz tunes while sipping coffee made with heart. Dogs (and kids) are welcome and can be tied up to the sturdy umbrella stand poles. I am hunting out a really cool tips jar plus dog bowl combination for this coffee entrepreneur...

This used to be our go to place when on holiday. This time we were never greeted, shown to a table or given menus. I went up to the counter and searched for menus, I had to go back up to order. I was then told they had no tap beer (with taps at the bar), no blended iced coffee and the first meal we ordered wasn’t available! Another large group of customers walked in, after no greeting they were eventually told there were no vegetarian options so they left. The menu was extremely limited, basically it was just burgers. We couldn’t really find anything that appealed so we left, too. We had wondered why there were so few customers at lunchtime on a busy sunny day, it became obvious pretty quickly.
Beautiful coffee and the sandwiches are a full meal. Casual enough as we needed a minute tonrelax

Lunch meal portion is small but tasteful. Yet it was delivered onto our otherwise empty table: the drinks we had ordered had not been delivered; we were provided no utensils. Had we not had the best table overlooking buildings toward the water, this experience would have been fully disappointing

Worst Service on Waiheke, the owner is constantly staunching out men with an alpha male trip and being rude and aggressive towards women. My partner was rejected so heavily shes now crying. Ive witnessed this 5 times.

We came with some friends from Australia and had a wonderful time. Well appointed room and great facilities. Parke and his team and the most wonderful hosts and really go that extra mile to make your stay perfect. Great food and beverage selection and the Saturday night music was awesome. Thanks team Waiheke!
Very satisfied overall with their friendly and attending staff and the location/views of this property. We would love to go back there again. Good atmosphere at the restaurant bar as well.

We were upgraded from the Short Stay room to the Scenic Studio which was such a lovely start. Check in and checkout super easy. The pool and deck area is lovely to sunbathe in. Our room was quite nice and comfortable. Only negative was the cleanliness which could be improved slightly. Some brown marks on the ceiling and dust bunnies hanging around, the cutlery and cups were a bit dusty and water stained. Overall though, the room was nice and we loved the balcony.

Me and my partner stayed here for one night for my bday. It was a beautiful view of the ocean. Room was luxury and perfect romantic ambience. The only thing was the pool closed at 9pm and the swimming pool looks beautiful at night with the lights so would have been amazing to use at night, otherwise it was 10/10
Great experience and value during the colder months! Stayed in late May and the room rates are reasonable. Restaurant food was excellent.
Nice pizza and garlic bread, on the small size though. Would have been lovely to eat outside but gulls were too aggressive and took the pizza off our hands! Nice playground for kids.

Delicious build-your-own pizza in woodfire oven! No seating, but with a great location by the beach you get a nice takeaway meal to enjoy either on the sand or grass. Great staff as well. A must-do meal in Oneroa!

I find this is one of the best pizzas around the country! Had the Margherita with pepperoni and anchovies. A bit on the smaller side but perfect size for one hungry person. Wood fire pizza establishments are rare in general, but conventional pizza bakeries just cant compete on taste!
Great service and lovely little pizza place at little Oneroa. Recommend if you’re looking for a yummy spot for something to eat! Really like the garlic bread
incredible lovely people and such yummy food in a stunning beach location, what else would you wish for :) organic and vegan options :) very local

I found the fish wasnt fresh, the chips & crabstick tasted stale, $7 chips seemed like $3 scoop, a total rip, the sausage wasnt that bad but overall based on the positive reviews it wasn't really an enjoyable experience.

Friendly service. Smell of old oil whenever chippy fired up was gross. Small portions of chips for the price and they were dry and didn't taste fresh. Fish didn't seem fresh and batter was chewy. I suspect that because our visit was in mid March that the oil was not getting changed enough at end of tourist season. Great location. Burger underwhelming.

Stop in at Little Oneroa Takeaways for a meal; they offer reasonable prices and a good menu of options. There are seats outside while you wait, and then you can choose whether to eat there or take your fish and chips to Little Oneroa Beach, which is less than one minute's walk away to enjoy the view. The food is good - the chips and fish batter are crispy, and everything is nice and hot. Don't forget your favourite sauce! The service is good, but it is quite popular, so expect a wait, especially if you are with a group. Photos show the view of Little Oneroa Beach.

Wonderful little fish and chip shop on Waiheke. Food is always lovely and fresh & staff are super friendly. For the island, good value for what you pay and I would 100% recommend the fish & hotdog on a stick. Burgers are not too bad.
Prefectly cooked chips and fresh fish. The best I've had in ages. Service with a smile too!

Very nice food and spot to eat. Can sit outside in the sun near the beach (no real view of beach), indoors, or in their garden courtyard out back. Menu had a few gluten free options but wasn’t labeled.

Wonderful delight to have stumbled upon. Fast friendly service. Best long black coffee I’ve had in a long while. Shades outdoors area as well as spacious indoor dining area. Thank you for a memorable experience.

We were gifted a voucher for Arcadia as we were spending a few days on waiheke. Wow it was so good, perfect setting, great food and drinks. No rush and we had a lovely evening So good we went back for morning coffee the next day Thank u so very much 😀
This was quite a little gem! My partner and I were both in agreement, this was the best beef cheek we have ever had! Well done guys.
Beautiful restaurant with delicious food. I highly recommend to visit. Great selection of wines. Great costumer service makes this place truly enjoyable. Kids friendly too.

The Hunting Lodge is such a beautiful wedding venue. As a wedding photographer, I always love shooting here. The grounds are stunning year-round, and the sunsets over the vineyards are next level. There are several ceremony options, including right at the edge of the vines or beside the iconic Barn. I also love the vintage caravan bar, it adds such a fun, relaxed energy and looks amazing in photos! With their in-house wine, relaxed vibe, and versatile indoor-outdoor flow, The Hunting Lodge is one of the best winery venues in Auckland :)

The red wine tasting and the aromatic wine tasting were both amazing but the aromatic has one of the nicest wine wines I've had in New Zealand, soft and mild that isn't over acidic. Then there is the Creme Brulee, 10/10, basic done really well. Same can be said about their pork and cheese toasty, just simple but done so well.
Beautiful space and good service. We had wine and nibbles. Highly recommend.
Stunning! Brilliant service. Lovely country side location. The food was delicious. Highly recommended. Will be coming back
Reviewing the Restaurant only where we had 31st Dec lunch. Good food and fantastic location. No bread or vegetables with meat was odd and for the price they charge it would have been good to get it.

They were super busy when we came in but still accommodated and gave us a lovely spot out the side! All the staff were incredibly kind and service was quick despite how busy they were. Food was incredible!!

Tried this new(ish) cafe today. Really lovely atmosphere, food was artisan and delicious. Pricing matched the good quality food. Would recommend they put menus on the tables as it was a bit unclear as to whether you order at the counter or wait for someone to come to your table. Will come again for sure.
Such an awesome new cafe in Riverhead, relaxing vibe, attentive service and amazing food. Another great cafe, done well.

A great find in Riverhead! Superb breakfast, scrambled eggs were next level, the bacon had great flavour but unfortunately was chewy. Coffee was spot on. Took away a raspberry tart from the cabinet which was unbelievably good! Sadly, the chai was far too spicy. Friendly service and a great vibe overall.

Our first visit to Miss Riverhead and we were really impressed. This building used to be the Kauri Gum Cafe (quite some time ago) and it was quite dark and run down. Walking in now, it is so bright, open, fresh and has an awesome vibe. Feels super clean and fresh. The staff were super lovely and helpful. The cabinet food on offer looked absolutely delicious. My daughter had the Pain au chocolat, which looked amazing, but I didnt get to try it ha ha. I had the Roasted Vege Salad off the menu, which was done absolutely perfectly, such a wholesome wintery treat with all the vegetables cooked spot on. My aunty had the Chicken Avocado Salad which looked fantastic and she rated highly. My Mum had an Orange & Date scone from the cabinet, which was generous in size. Lucky for me, she accidentally left half of it in my car when I dropped her home. I actually can't believe how much beautiful flavor was packed into a scone! Wow. The ambiance is nice. It was really busy when we arrived, so indoors it was quite loud, as it's a very open space with hard wood. Once it was a bit quieter, it was so nice sitting in there, cozy seating etc. I had a coconut milk hot chocolate, it was yummy, not the best ever, but still good. I was also impressed when we arrived and sat down, that the staff bought my daughter over an activity sheet and colour pencils. It's always nice when places think about these little details. The one thing I'd like to see here is disability parking outside the cafe to make it more accessible for everyone. There is plenty of street parking available for able bodied people, so that's not an issue. All in all, we will definitely come back here. What a great, fresh, delicious addition to the area's eateries.

Had a chicken curry pie, full of gelatine, hardly any chicken that was soggy from, it appears to have been microwaved. No Apple Cidar, when I politely informed the staff member, I got shrugged shoulders. It was disappointing.

went for brunch today and lovely service! unfortunately there was no mango on the french toast (i understand sometimes ingredients dont come in) and there was rice bubbles all over the french toast? looked like maggots lol, super weird to me but other than that taste was great once i moved all the rice bubbles off haha

5 stars :) We had the loveliest Mother’s Day dinner at The Beekeeper’s Wife. The food was delicious, the atmosphere cozy and welcoming: A huge shout out to Taposh. It was a special evening in the company of some amazing people, and we’ll definitely be back ☺️

Lovely rustic atmosphere and good service. I ordered the omelette - visually very appealing and the flavours were all there but I found the omelette to be on the dry side. It was served with a portion of bread, which I found made the overall dish a bit dry... Good coffee!

Good taste but small portion. I always have big breakfast when I go cafe. But this dish was smallest compared to other cafe. So I expected better taste but taste very normal. Good location to have cold beer and nice hot coffee.

We came here to celebrate our best friend's Birthday and Farwell Dinner at Caffe E Cucina tonight and was serve by 2 lovely and friendly staff member name Paris & Nikayla. They are absolutely wonderful and excellent service. The food was amazing incredible delicious. We will definitely coming back. Highly recommended to all AAA+++++

I went to Caffe E Cucina for a tinder date (which went pretty well, I think she likes me!) for lunch, and had a great time. We ordered different kinda small plates from the prima section of the menu and shared those which worked well as we weren't super hungry. The service was good, and prices not toooo bad. The food was definitely the highlight (after the company) with everything cooked to perfection. Seared tuna blew my mind.

Ordered delivery, pasta Carbonara, and fish of the day for a birthday treat. Pasta serving was so small, it wasn't even a full meal.. The fish on risotto was overcooked, the risotto was gluggy, it said it had prawns in the risotto, there were 2 small prawns, the fish flavour wasn't good. Disappointing as previous orders were much better quality. The pasta left me feeling hungry, and my husband couldn't eat all of the fish as it was overpowered with garlic. The price being charged $30 and $40, does not match the low quality. Revolting food. You've lost 2 customers.

Very good place for a Kai & a chill. Like all places, it may have it's days as depicted in some other reviews, but we had/have had a great time there, and the food was pretty top notch. Very friendly table staff, and a nice flow and atmosphere, very tidy, quite flash. Only gripe is the time taken for the kai to get out to you. Had garlic bread, pork, a pasta dish, and chips on the last visit. This may have just been us, only been here 3 or 4 times so far so not really sure overall. The last time though, it did seem to take quite some time and that was a Sunday. I think it might have been only 1 chef on which may be why. But it's a nice setting so the time factor isn't really an issue unless time is a factor for you. Highly recommend the pork belly dish, had a really nice dressing on the salad which was awesome, when you hate salad. Ate it all up. Nice. Otherwise, definitely awesome food, lovely place. Easy to get in and out, plenty of parking, has wheelchair access. Cheers.

Hi Team, I ordered through Uber Eats today and understand the order got delayed to x1 item that was unavailable and the system was not working. Just wanted to say thank you so much for going the extra mile by upsizing my pizza size and for the complimentary chocolate dessert ❤️ thank you so much for your kindness and we appreciate it. Food is amazing!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ We went here for a team-building dinner and had a great time! The food was very good, and the atmosphere was perfect for a fun night out. It’s also a great spot for karaoke — everyone had a blast. Highly recommend for group events or casual get-togethers!
Loved the atmosphere here! Came for a comedy night and had a total blast. Food is top! Real good, and plenty of variety for drinks as well. Lots of room to have seat. Highly recommended
Espectacular !!!! Was amazing lunch with my family. If you looking for nice people yummy food and perfect atmosphere is there !!! Thank you Julian and Vero for make our lunch perfect!!
I just wanna say great food great atmosphere and love the music here, very great place for a chill night out with the fam.

Loved this Cafe Restaurant. Great welcome with an awesome friendly host. Food was plentiful and delicious.. very good prices as well.. Went with a group and we were well looked after. Great place to go to enjoy a Sunday lunch .

Absolutely love this place – I’ve been coming here for decades! The food is consistently great, and the staff are always lovely and welcoming. If you’re after good value, I highly recommend checking out the discounted food available after 2pm – it’s a fantastic deal. The children’s menu is excellent value too, and the meals come served on the most adorable little plates – such a thoughtful touch! I often go for the bento box – it’s always filling, fresh, and delicious.

We hadn't been here for over 6 years due to moving locations. Being back in Albany we came to Tokyo for dinner. So pleased we did. The food was absolutely delicious and beautifully presented. We ate do much more than normal only to have all the lovely food. The young man doing the service told us it was the same chef over all this time. It feels authentic. Friendly staff, great food at a fair price. They also do sushi to takeaway. Try Tokyo in Albany. I don't think you will be disappointed.

We came to this restaurant by coincidence and it was a lovely place. The staff were very friendly and welcoming. The food was delicious, we ordered Chicken ramen it was tasty and full of flavor . Karage chicken was delicious 🤤, the best for me is the prawns & veg. tempura I will have it next time. Bento box was very good and tasty, the portion was very good and rich in flavor. Highly recommend this restaurant
We had such an amazing experience! Everything we ordered was awesome. Definitely gonna come back again.
So fresh, so relaxing it’s our go to for a date night

Lovely staff and great food and coffee menu. If you love coffee then you must visit this place! The food we ordered was so delicious - very happy with how the mini breakfast was seasoned. Nothing was overly salted and ingredients were fresh. Really good prices too!

Had a Granola bowl, friends had some fish and chips and a Creme Brulee Pancake this morning! The bowl had too many bananas in it otherwise was great. My friends loved the fish and thought was the best out of all the three things ordered! Pretty spacious cafe and very friendly staff.

Altura has been my favourite cafe for years, I also sometimes take my elderly parents to the cafe as well, food are always amazing and beautiful presented and service is great from every staff. The girl called Emily even provided us with hot water whenever mum is with me as she heard Asian likes hot water especially elderly people , Thank you Altura!
Great atmosphere and coffee. Awesome service and friendly staff.
The food was very good. The fries are cheap for the big portions they give. Amazing staff

The sushi was out of this world. When my wife told me she had ordered sushi from Albany I was annoyed that I had to drive 20ish minutes to pick it up especially if there are a lot of other sushi places nearby. My wife had just given birth and the first thing she wanted was sushi. It is pricey but quality is top notch. For two of us we ordered quite a bit. I think best money well spent on sushi!
Amazing food! Some of the best in Auckland. Not too pricey as well. Staff were very nice.
Helpful staff prepared and got our sushi ready before pick up time. Looks and tastes amazing.

BESTTT SUSHI IN AUCKLAND! The teriyaki chicken is actually perfection, I’ve never tasted such good teriyaki chicken before. The staff are all so efficient especially in such a busy store. The store is always so busy, as expected with how good the food is. So I would recommend coming in earlier before things start to run out before closing!

What a place, actually make other sushi shops look basic. Top-tier sushi. I decided to go for lunch to show how much they sell, as they constantly bring out sushi to keep up with demand. Between 11.30 am and 1 pm is very busy, photos were taken around 12.30 pm. Favorite is the scallop and grill salmon sushi, brilliant combo. If you're going for the elevated salmon sushi to pay around 25-30 dollars for around 8-9 pieces. This is justified if it's within your price range. Overall. This place will recieve a 9.8/10.

We read mixed reviews but decided to try it anyway. Everything we ordered was yummy ,service was super quick , portions were generous, prices were reasonable, will definitely be back to try more dishes.
Dishes are delicious. Service is quick and friendly. Toilet is clean. Parking is easy. Price are reasonable.

I have chosen this restaurant many times and all of the experiences are good! The cooking is especially nice and the taste beats any other Chinese restaurant (that I know of). The staff were great, although they’re not fluent in English, they speak great. They ask politely for our order and delivers our food as fast as they can (depends on how many people are there). They also gave us complimentary rice cakes (I don’t know what they’re called), with different filling each time we come. I recommend this restaurant to Albanians and Rosedale residents!

Great place for authentic Cantonese food on North Shore. Taste is good, serving portion is large and very reasonable price as well. Went lunch on Thursday but there was a huge crowd. Expect small dining space and make reservation for dinner to avoid disappointment!

BBQ Noodle House offers a fantastic dining experience. Every dish we ordered was delicious, with authentic flavors and generous portions. Service was quick, and the staff were friendly and welcoming. It’s a great spot for tasty food, fast service, and good value!
A very good shop.

Katsubi Rosedale has started selling beautiful and delicious baked goods - including scones, cakes, cookies, and more! Everything looks amazing and tastes even better. I highly recommend trying some of their fresh bakes when you visit. It’s also a great spot to enjoy a coffee with a cupcake or treat on the side. Don’t miss it!

bad quality. wont buy it from this store any more. been happening so many times. not fresh at all and its cold. feel like im eating a jerky dont know how old this is. vegs are not evenly served, too much carrot and tiny bit of cabbage? waste my money

Came to try the lunch buffet. For $19 there is quite a selection but nothing spectacular. Would be great if there was more variety of sushi - like the real traditional ones in Sushi stores everywhere, instead there were only 4 varieties of miniature ones with too much sauce hardly any seafood. Also, there was a lot of chicken dishes and other “Chinese-ish” cuisine. Still, it is worth the money and you get what you pay for! Very nice ambience though. Will be back to try the dinner buffet sometime!
Nice friendly staff, good service and yummy food. A bit on the pricy side for what you get so not a regular for me but defs enjoyed it :)

Big glass windows out the front looks like not much from the outside but opens up to quite a big area. You can choose from a $19 lunch buffet to food ordered off a menu, plenty of chicken as you would expect, vegetables, rice and soup also options. Really good and professional service.
Just look at how much salmon and avocado there is in the sushi — they’re so generous. It was fresh and delicious.

I would strongly recommend this sushi shop, the lady and her husband are so friendly and nice to customers. Sushi is big and good quality inside. Very very yummy, we can not miss such yummy food if you are in albany!

The sushi was pretty good pretty average like other sushi places, but their staff members were so friendly! They had a smile on their face full time, and I was the first one in the store and when they saw me coming in they all greeted me and because I was the first one not all the sushi were on the shelf. Once I started choosing they immediately started to make more sushi to put on the shelf!

I come here for the salmon teriyaki don. It is always loaded with fresh salmon with tasty sauce not heavily seasoned or sweet. The serving size is perfect for me. I love their sushi choices too generous fillings and fresh. Love the generous fill of miso. My go to whenever I am in the area.

Dennis & Kim are so lovely, and their sushi is fresh and delicious! They make anything on the spot, esp good re allergies or dietary needs, and they take great care with food hygiene (plus give generous portions!). 100% recommend 🍣🍤🍢🍙

First time customers, ordered sweet and sour pork,honey chicken, combi rice, combi chow mein and eggfoo young $59, I thought thats a good price. What got was plain fried rice,sweet and sour no sauce dry and taste, plain noodles(which I didnt order,no chow mein,honey chicken so dry stuck on the roof of mouth,the worse Chinese I have had.
Great tasting food, quick service and well priced. Impressed.

Ok, so I thought when you order a meal you are supposed to get what you asked for? I ordered a garlic prawn meal with extra prawns, not only is it dry and have no flavour, there are NO VEGETABLES!!!!! Service was good, but a bowl of literally nothing but prawns and noodles is NOT WHAT I ORDERED.
Got Uber eats here, the wontons are just a joke
Amazing people and amazing food! I am always excited to come here as they bring a smile to my partner & I faces!! ❤️

Bought a footlong sub combo, and this is what I got. Barely any meat in it (literally like 2 small pieces and I paid almost $30 for this) let alone the staff just acts like you’re not there - no greetings and reluctant to communicate. absolutely disappointed and will never visit this branch ever again. Not recommended.

Asian lady with glasses was very rude today. She finished making my sub and I asked what the price differences are with and without the combo as all prices seemed to have a slight difference. She then went on saying everything is on there and told me to find it myself. Its her job to serve the customers not tell them what to do. Very rude but at least the food was good

Terrible hygiene and customer service. Lady making the sandwich sneezed into her glove while putting the salad in i asked her to change her gloves and she argued she didn't sneeze in it, ask her to remake the sandwich again she was rude and argued. She then went to the side of the shop and spoke in her language while steering at me, the owner then argued with me saying she sneezed in her glove even though he didn't see as he was serving another customer. Never experienced such discussing hygiene and customer service before.

Love Subway for their fresh ingredients and customizable sandwiches! The staff is always friendly, and my sub was made exactly how I wanted it. Quick, tasty, and consistently great—definitely a 5-star experience!

We got this as a work lunch in the past week. Each person (only 5) put in their orders online and our manager went to pick it up therefore I cannot comment on the atmosphere. We were missing two cookies and a drink, the sandwich was also not good, few toppings and very little sauce. Not to mention the southern style chicken bites which tasted like they had been microwaved to reheat them. Overall I was very disappointed with the quality of the food and service.
Generous portion, good service, a great range of varieties. You won't regret it. Highly recommended.

Shaolin Noodles on Albany Highway is an absolute gem! I placed a pickup order here and was blown away by the warm, welcoming vibe from the moment I walked in. The chef lady behind the counter radiates joy—she greets every customer with a bright smile, chats warmly like an old friend, and ensures everyone feels right at home. Her customer service is top-notch; she’s attentive, patient, and genuinely cares about delivering a great experience. The food? Incredible. The aroma of freshly cooked noodles and spices hits you as soon as you step inside, and my order was handed over piping hot, clearly prepared with care. Every bite was bursting with flavor, and you can taste the authenticity in each dish. What truly sets this place apart is the chef’s infectious positivity and the way she balances speed with personal touch—even during busy times, she manages to make every interaction feel special. If you’re craving delicious, soul-warming noodles served with a side of stellar hospitality, Shaolin Noodles is a must-visit! 🍜🔥 Highly recommended!

This Noodle Canteen Takeaways is really good for a fast food place. When we arrived it was wickedly busy. Phone orders, UberEats, plus, like us, walk in orders, we still only had to wait 10 minutes. Not a bad wait time at all. The menu is the same as any other Noodle Canteen, which is great. The food was very tasty and exactly how it was described on the menu. We bought 5 different dishes for the group of us, and everyone was impressed. I recommend Noodle Canteen to most of my family and friends, but this Canteen I feel, needs recognition for producing Great and flavoursim food. I recommend it very highly.

I recently tried the noodles at this place, and overall, it was a fine experience. The noodles themselves were cooked well, and the service was adequate. However, I have to admit that there was nothing particularly surprising or exceptional about the meal. It met my expectations, but I was hoping for something that would truly stand out. While the food and service were satisfactory, I believe it's always exciting to discover unique flavors or unexpected elements in a dining experience. Nonetheless, if you're looking for a decent meal without any surprises, this place might fit the bill.
Decent Chinese restaurant, no cold water only hot water? Fried noodles w/beef tastes good but not Fat Boys quality, soup is okay, fried rice tastes great!

Today we ordered the Double Taro Signature, but honestly, a bit disappointed this time. They gave so little grass jelly shaved ice, really not like how they usually serve it. On the bright side, the Strawberry Bingsu is still the best—refreshing, well-balanced, and worth the price. We also tried the Mangoberry Shaved Ice, but it was just okay. For $24.80, it felt a bit overpriced. Overall, for both taste and value, I’d still go for the bingsu rather than the shaved ice. Bingsu wins in both flavor and portion.
super fun place to take friends & family to share a tasty dessert! portions are good for sharing & the atmosphere is always bustling ⭐️
Great place for an after dinner hang out. Decent desserts, I love the waffles tho, soft and fluffy, would go again. Atmosphere wise, quite popular but not overly crowded.
The shop is clean, though not very large. The grass jelly has a pleasant taste with a mild sweetness.

#Dessert house# Every dessert is full of stuff，including red beans、taro、pudding、sweet potato and so on. The price is reasonable，but the size is a little smaller than the city one. The service here is really bad，almost no service，and sanitary conditions are not good.
Most amazing Gimbap (Korean Sushi) made when you order (super fresh) for an incredible price.
Good. I have been there twice. Once right before close, which was not as good; once at noon, which was very good.

Wow, this place was awesome. Pretty fair prices. A massive dinner for 2 guys with big appetites, all kinds of food + 2 beers came out to 80 bucks. This is the exact kind of food my office mates in Guangdong china take me out for when I head to China for work. Chinese beer drinking food!

We were waiting for 30 minutes when we made our order. Asked a guy about our order and didnt respond and went to the kitchen. Didnt come back We understand that its busy but lets be honest it wasnt the fact that they were busy they literally forgot. The fact than when we said we were leaving they didnt even mention our order being on the way. This place is terrible and the tables were grimey. Would recommend if you want to just starve.
Great food, awesome selection of so many different types of cuisine and they all taste great!

털보네 순대국 is a well-known restaurant specializing in traditional Korean blood sausage soup, or "sundaeguk." This hearty dish, beloved by many, features a rich, flavorful broth filled with pieces of sundae (Korean blood sausage), pork, and a variety of vegetables. The restaurant is praised for its authentic taste and generous portions, making it a favorite spot for those seeking comfort food. The ambiance of 털보네 순대국 is casual and welcoming, perfect for a relaxed meal with family or friends. The service is friendly and efficient, ensuring a pleasant dining experience. If you're looking for a place to enjoy a delicious bowl of sundae soup, 털보네 순대국 is definitely worth a visit.

Heard about their speciality, blood sausages. While I enjoyed it, definitely an acquired taste. If it gets cold it's not as nice when it's warmed up and sitting in the warm soup. Good amount of side dishes as well and well worth the price for 2 people to share.

Really delicious pork offal soup! They have special request type if you wan more meat or less meat. The service is good, they offer more side dishes (the kimchi is super duper good! I even feel wan to eat 5 more plates haha if I could) and soup without our request. The portion is big enough and both of us feel super full and warm to have this in a rainy day! Love it.

Great food but on the expensive side. Blood sausage and meat platter is $70. Soup is $25 ish. We are 4 people and even out to just right on the fullness. Service is average , didn't get it bad like some other reviewers here although hard to find a staff, they are always busy and not many people to work. Toilet is broken so cannot wash hands before.

The best Korean restaurant in Auckland. Always loved this place years ago and still do. The best pork soup and sausages. Portion is great too unlike the other ones around Albany and Auckland in general

Had my 50th Birthday party here last night. Perfect venue for any party, the food was great and the owners so accommodating and lovely to deal with. We had a great time and I would highly recommend it for an event.

Our Ladies group had our monthly catch up lunch , Bar Africa was the chosen place this month. Lovely day , the sun was out ,so we sag outside. We were looked after very well by the staff . All our lunches were lovely.

I went on a Monday afternoon, so it was very quiet. It looks like a lovely place, where people can hang out and catch up. There's TVs everywhere, pool tables, and a designated smoking area. There are two big outdoor areas, which is lovely in summer. I did think that $10 was quite steep for a beer, even if it was imported. I also thought the food menu was a bit dear, so I didn't order food. I asked the one lady if I could take some photos, and she said yes. But then the (I think owner) got upset and asked why I was taking photos. It's still think it is a nice place, which somewhat reminds me of home (South Africa). The decor was a bit typical and generic "Africa".
Really nice place with lots of lovely lighting, perfect atmosphere. Staff is super friendly and welcoming, food is also amazing. Definitely recommend trying!

Love entertainment was okay, wooden benches and tables are outdated. Bar Lady walked around handing out glasses of Champagne for mother's Day, but the boss saw her and instructed her to charge us - $10 per glass. Why should patrons pay for their mistakes? The new owner can hardly speak English... Disgraceful!

We ordered the Italian Buffalo Mozzarella pizza, chicken wings, corn nuggets for takeaway. I was severely disappointed with the pizza and the wings. The pizza had no salt or taste... I had to sprinkle some salt to make it palatable, the chicken wings were steamed and tasted so bland and tasteless. The only saving grace was the corn nuggets. I don't normally place negative reviews but their food was very disappointing. The Glenfield Hells branch still does better food.

Sick in bed on my birthday, and not only did they upgrade my pizza as a gift, they also wrote a birthday greeting inside the box 😭❤ The delivery person was so kind too - thank you for making my night!! And the pizza was delicious and hot 🍕🍕🍕

Just had half and half buffalo/beast pizza from this store. Worst pizza ever, doesnt fit with description at all, no mozerella cheese no tomato base, just pizza base with basil pestro and pepeeroni. Im just glad i didnt pay full price 28 dollars on this pizza, even with 20 dollars, this pizza is a true disappointment.
Loved the new Tandoori chicken pizza!

had the morning after pizza and got the two free ice cream sandwiches wednesday deal. the pizza was great and the ice cream sandwiches were good and are also dairy free which was nice. price was good and server was sweet.

I visited The Buffer with my family yesterday for the first time in years, hoping for a pleasant meal. I started with one of my favourites — cold soba noodles — but was shocked by the strange, fizzy and sour taste of the broth, almost as if it had fermented or even had carbonation in it. I quietly asked my family, and they all noticed the same thing. We were the first customers of the day, and I found it odd that the soba broth container was already only half full. I discreetly informed the staff, who replaced the container without any explanation or apology — which I found quite disappointing, especially given this is something people are putting into their bodies. I told my family I was sorry for bringing them here and that we would never return. We quietly finished our meal, paid, and left without making a scene. Later that night, I woke up with a stomach ache, and I couldn’t stop thinking about what had happened. Any restaurant serving food should take product safety and freshness seriously. If they can’t manage that, they don’t deserve to be in business. To those living in Auckland — I strongly recommend avoiding this place. Some things are just not worth the risk.

Great Korean BBQ at The Buffet in Albany! I had a fantastic experience at The Buffet. The self-grill option was so fun, and the food quality was excellent. There’s a great variety of meats, seafood, and Korean sides like Bulgogi and kimchi. Everything was fresh and constantly replenished. The staff was friendly, and the atmosphere was modern and comfortable. It’s perfect for family and friends. Highly recommend this place for great value and delicious Korean BBQ!

The variety of meats and side dishes here is amazing! Everything is fresh, and the grilling experience is so much fun. It’s perfect for groups looking to enjoy a delicious meal together. The all-you-can-eat Korean BBQ is truly top-notch, and the meat quality is exceptional. Don’t forget to try their kimchi and dipping sauces – they’re the perfect complement to the meal. Highly recommend!
My daughter and I have been here 10 years ago. We are very grateful that this restaurant has been providing good food to the family for 10 years.

There’s a delightful variety of food options to choose from, all served with a balanced taste that’s not too sweet or salty! Bbq and other dishes. Plus, you can enjoy all sorts of sauces and dips. The staff was super friendly, which made the experience even better!

Nice and clean store, friendly staff member and well made Pitas. Nothing really to complain about here. Everything looked hygienic. They accepted my discount coupon with no hassle and the pitas ended up tasting really nice.

Delicious high protein salad bowl. The staff here are really hard workers. I know from experience how difficult it is to work with Uber Eats and I watched the team do an amazing job under the stress of lunch rush hour.
Fresh and good quality wraps and salads, chicken was a little less but overall nice.

Very rushed, asked for mushrooms on the grill yet it was not even cooked. Same as the chicken. I am regular since the first owner however this Pita Pit is no longer up to the standard of the previous owner. The taste of the chicken salad is not even the same as the other Pita Pit branches. You long regular customer.
The guy who serves and makes your order is rude... no greetings no amswers just full of attitude

This was our second visit to this place, and we tried their Reunion Dinner—it was absolutely delicious! Their dim sum breakfast is also incredibly authentic. Highly recommend it if you're craving traditional flavors that you’ve been missing and longing for. And best of all, their prices are incredibly reasonable!

Came for dinner at 6pm, not that busy on a Sunday. Menu has lots of options. We had the cumin lamb, salt and pepper squid, special tofu, meat platter, mixed veges in soup and beef ho fan. Food came out at a reasonable pace. Good service and they gave us a plate of sweet polo buns for dessert

I enjoyed my visit here for lunch and dinner. Very good prices for the quality of food and portions too. I was lucky in that I had a friend who had been here before and knew more about what each dish was, so that’s certainly a bonus. The dinner menu was quite lovely. Their lobster was really well cooked and fresh too. The Peking duck, tofu, and greens also made for a balanced meal. All the dishes came with plenty of rice too. Don’t be afraid to get a bit messy when eating with your hands (especially when getting into the lobster)- it’s worth it! I think ChowFoo is better suited for slightly larger groups (we had a group of 8) and this meant we could try more dishes and share. We did book, but it wasn’t too busy. Although, afternoons seems to be quite busy so could be worth trying to book.
Recommend the red rice roll with shrimp. The service is fine, refill the tea for us frequently. Top yum cha I have in North shore

How could I give out negative rate?? I would love to give out negative stars if I could. They have messed up our simple order, we ordered five dishes and they missed one. The first dish was fast, only took 10 mins to chop the duck off. Then we have been waiting for a whole hour with one dish. We would hate to rush the kitchen but it was definitely very annoying. After one hour, we finally got the second dish, Kyoto pork, it was so greasy just like the pig drowning in the oil pool. The paua tasted very odd. It was obvious that it has died in the fridge for ages. The last dish was the stir-fried vegetable. It was fresh and I bet they were grown from the scratch, where they were hand-picked from the farm. That’s the only reason I could think of why they served the dish with such a slow speed.
Great value for money! Lovely service and super quick. The meat was all super tasty and the takoyaki was delicious. Definitely coming back :)
Very nice food. Wonderful service.
Amazing first experience here! We absolutely loved it and tried the BBQ set menu for 2 and can recommend 100% will be coming again soon
Absolutely love every bits of time i spent there foods amazing!

"Please telling to the chef that the food was deliciuos" Is the very first time that I've said that, and I've been eating a lot in new places with my parter. We enjoy a Soup Udon With chicken katsu, a Beef & onion dumplin, an Oyakodon (chicken & egg rice w/ miso soup), a 660ml beer and a puddin for a good $78 !! Totally recomended
Really good portion sizes, family liked the Korean Chicken burger. My special burger had half a chook in it. Chips were ok. Basic level of service and fit out. Overall really good takeaway option.

The food here was excellent, some of the best Taco's I've had. They were full of flavour and the price is reasonable. The burger was great too. This is clearly more of a takeout restaurant however as the atmosphere is not great and all the cutlery is wooden and everything is served in takeout boxes. Still worth it tho, will be going back again.

We got takeaway burgers and chips. The food was incredible and as advertised. We were hyped and it lived up to expectations. Honestly, one of the best burgers I've had. The service was in contrast, I watched four others walk in and not a single person was greeted, a couple standing confused until a staff member simply pointed at the self-service screen. Weird!

I tried the double birria burger in combo with fries and soda and I may say: 100% Tasteful! So happy with my choice, juice meat, well cooked, tender, balanced with a green sauce, and of course, you receive a generous portion of birria to pour and/or dip in your burger and fries. The combo is big enough to feed a big fella or a sharing couple. Overall: Totally recommended, next time I'll try the birria tacos.

Came here on the weekend and ordered a bunch of goodies! My favourite by far was the beef birria tacos! So meaty and cheesy which is perfect for me! The staff are very welcoming and the restaurant is nice and clean! Definitely will be back to try the beef birria burger for sure! Definitely recommend!

Came for kumara fries and they weren’t ready. But luckily just right after we finished the beautiful pastas the owner brought us the kumara fries to try. It was delicious! Highly recommended and will be back soon. 老板人很好，生意兴隆！

Food was really nice ! Really liked the chewy texture of fresh pasta. Loved the burger sauce with quality beef patty. Very generous portion. Would be great if they offer pickle or hot sauce as a side. It was more like a quick meal and go -kind of vibe than proper dinning restaurants.

We love the fresh pastas here and difffent type of topings and sauces. I think the pasta here is more like fusion Asian-Italian. We had the Chicken Bacon penne and the Pork belly Reginette - it was really yummy. The chicken bacon is very fregrant and a bit smoky. the Pork belly was crunchy on the outside as they are deep fried. The portion is quite big too.

Been wanting to go here for a while now, and it absolutely lived up to my hype! Quaint 80s/90s American Diner type place and that vibe is immaculate, combined with the feeling of being in a busy little eatery in Japan. Runs like clockwork, too. Their "Dr Pepper" burger is unbelievably good! Already packed with so many good quality & some interesting ingredients... and then the jus they top it off with is so flavourful and much in quantity, makes this burger unlike any other. Bit messy to eat but thoroughly enjoyable and super filling, especially with the plenty of very well seasoned fries you get for $3 extra. Their handmade Creamy Chicken and Bacon pasta is also fantastic - simple ingredients, perfect cook and exactly what they say they are; nothing more or less. Very reasonably priced, just considering the quantities of the servings and quality of ingredients & cook, but the flavour especially stole the show and made it well worth the cost!

This small restraunt is a little gem. Nice chill, background music and love the simple setup of a place. Had the Mushroom puree chorizo and parmesan risotto and it had so much flavour. Well balanced ingredients. Owners are a lovely couple that take pride in their food. Highly recommend if you want a relaxing environment with affordable pricing. Mushroom and chorizo risotto 9.4/10 Cheeseburger 8.9/10

Actually really good food! I've frequented the city one for years. First time at the Albany one and it really didn't disappoint. Everything was cooked really well. Seafood pancake, kimchi stew, fried chicken, cold noodles all delicious.

Great Korean place for groups or even a hearty date for two. There's lots of options and food is always good. Lunch & dinner menu are different. If you prefer a quiet meal, lunch would be best or a weekday dinner. Their Fridays & Saturdays are always busy- party, fun vibes, so best to get a reservation.

Spoiler Alert! This place has to be one of the best Korean Restaurants I have been to here in New Zealand. The pork was melt in your mouth tender and the butter beef was just 😋 delicious. The service was next level and fast. No mucking around waiting for service. It might be a tad much for 2 people but if you have more friends, you'll be able to explore their fantastic menu. Can't wait for my next trip for the Chicken Wings 😁

Pocha, the popular Korean restaurant I have visited many times in Chancery, has opened a new branch in Albany. My partner, friends, and I recently went there for a big dinner featuring famous Korean dishes. We ordered a variety of dishes to share: the popular Korean Army Soup, two plates of fried chicken, a spicy Korean rice cake plate, and a few rice bowls. The portions were enough for the six of us and were absolutely delicious, especially the fried chicken. We added soft tofu to the soup, but it made it too mild for our taste, so we'll skip the tofu next time. Overall, we loved the soup. Despite the restaurant being nearly full, the staff was kind and provided excellent service. The lively atmosphere added to the experience, and I loved the vibe and feel of the place.
I come here often and the staff are always incredibly friendly and kind. The food is absolutely delicious and tastes just like authentic Korean cuisine. I’ll definitely keep coming back!
Ordered 2 special platters for a family night. Beautiful sushi and taste so nice. The fried prawn and grilled salmon ones are my favorites. Will definitely come back next time.
Amazing tase!! Really nice flavour and fresh sushi, love it 🫶
Lots of options-fried food and sushi, friendly Korean boss, offers $1 sushi on limited selections like beef sushi, salmon nigiri tasted a bit funny.

Our new fave spot. We are always greeted as soon as we enter. The food is fresh and store is clean. Great prices for sushi and if your wanting a bit more they have delicious noodle dishes. They use TOB coffee and they make it perfect so if you like a perfectly made delicious coffee then this is the place to drop by. They have some parking out front, tables and chairs inside to eat in. Very happy

What a fantastic find!! Excellent customer service, sushi was delicious and very reasonably priced and coffee was great. Nice ambience .super impressed, will definitely drop by for lunch next time we are up this way
The coffee remains consistently good, served in the same size cup, unlike other shops and brands.
It's not 24hrs cafe

Probably the best Japanese cuisine I've had in a long time! Made fresh to order, genuine Japanese chef. He was lovely but would have to get the waiter to come translate for us. Wh9ch the waiter did with a bubbly attitude and wide, welcoming smile. The service was impeccable! We felt very welcome and very special. They even gave us a complimentary entree ontop of all the delicious things we ordered (edamame, katsu chicken donburi, salmon and avocado sushi roll, with Asahi and a super yummy Choya wine!) I'm gonna have to get my Auntys and cousins who live in Auckland to make this their sushi place from now on! Highly recommend! Arigatō Tao Sushi for a lovely lunch experience! 💯

Had a great meal at this sushi spot! The beef and chicken stir-fried noodles were tasty with good portions, and the fried rice was spot on. The sushi was super fresh. The boss were really friendly too. Definitely worth checking out.
Such a lovely place! The crab sushi warship roll was amazing!!! Every single dish was awesome! Such a nice ambiance on a nice sunny day!

The reviews definitely sold me on my visit. Unfortunately the food was completely average. Shore sushi is less than a minute away and serves far better food and a much wider selection for the same if not less money.

This is my family's new favorite, the sushi is so fresh and made to order. Customer service is exceptional and it's very reasonably priced. In my opinion this is the best sushi on the Northshore, I highly recommend it to all.

Customer service was absolutely amazing! The guy explained everything in detail telling us if it would be good if we would like the food or not. We felt very welcome here and respected. Food was mouthwatering and the best part was the crawfish and the BBQ’d lamb! Would recommend coming here if you like Asian food or wanting to try something new better tasting and different. 100% coming back
Came here with family for lunch for the first time yesterday and we all loved the food so much! The soup was very flavourful and the meat was delicious. Staff were very friendly too ☺️
Best hot pot in Auckland without a doubt. The dipping sauce bar is top quality. Literally come here every week for over two years and it still amazes us.
The hotpot at this place is super tasty. A bit pricy but otherwise everything there tastes amazing.
Great food, and really friendly staff. Atmosphere could be improved a bit. Would visit again!

I used to come here often when I lived nearby. The sushi is bigger and more reasonably priced than at other places—and of course, it’s delicious! The gracious owners are incredibly kind and friendly. Although I’ve moved about 10km away and don’t visit as often as I used to, this is still the only place I come to when I’m craving sushi. Even if I’m headed to a shopping mall, I make sure to stop by here and get sushi to go. Thank you always. I hope you stay healthy and continue your business for many, many years to come!

Best sushi place on the Shore – you get good size rolls with plenty of filling, and the proper strong wasabi (not that play-dough stuff you get at St Pierres). Wonderful variety too, just get there before the lunch rush if you want the prawn, crab, or beef rolls!

Perfectly cooked and flavoured rice. Had chicken sushi, was super tasty! Only downsides are the sushi isn't labelled on meats; but there is a vegetarian section. There is also no water for dining in customers. But overall super duper tasty! Definitely will come back
Have been coming here nearly everyday for a long time, Sushi is Always Fresh & Yum, Good service too, they also give you plenty of Wasabi/Soy sauce & Ginger without charging extra. Thank you Team! ❤️
Always a great place to eat. Sushi is so good

Have been here four times now trying new dishes each time, the noodle dishes in particular we have really enjoyed and the dumplings are better than a lot I have tried elsewhere. The portions are very large and the food is inexpensive. There has never been a disappointing meal.
Best northern style chinese food in town, really tasty and price is reasonable. Free appetizers and friendly staff, rice can be refilled 🍚 It’s a must try in Rosedale
Friendly staff. Reduced salt for kids dish. Lovely people. Highly recommend. Fresh and gourmet food.

Excellent place for authentic Chinese food. If you want authentic Chinese flavours and something that will give your taste buds a real experience and work out, do come here! I've been here many times with my family for Chinese banquet dinners or just simple dinners. Really authentic well done see Sichuan style or Chinese style food with portions that are great for sharing. The tables and settings are prosaic, but the food and company makes the ambience!
Very tasty authentic taste. The eggplant dish on the wall menu was very good.
Best Chinese I've had for a while now. Very quick service, priced well. Definitely will go there again.
Tastes good and typically northeastern cuisine. Big dishes and good value.

Hands-down the best authentic Chinese cuisine in Auckland! The owners are super down to earth, easy-going folks! The food is absolutely delicious, especially if you like spicy dishes! The place is small, but the vibe is great! As soon as you step in, you get this Sichuan street food vibe! If you in the area and looking for some really good value, and awesome food, this place is perfect! 正宗东北菜，新西兰自驾3周了，一直想家乡菜今晚过瘾了！川菜也是一绝！
This place is great! Food tastes very good and fairly priced! Definitely recommend!
Food tastes good. Fried rice was just a typical taste from any other chinese cousine but crispt slice pork and spicy chicken knee was so nice! It seems quite clean in the restaurant.
Simple dinner, Cantonese cuisine, a combination of stuffed tofu and roasted meat, as well as lamb pot and spinach in soup, all tasted very good, all service are good!

I went to a really great Chinese restaurant in Albany today. The food was really good and I especially loved the Peking duck with pancakes. The restaurant was clean, the staff were super friendly and there was plenty of parking. I highly recommend this place. They also have Yum Cha and it's really yummy.

Have been here several times. Just back for lunch 3 days ago. We still like their dim sum. The quality was consistent with a good portion. Seating was comfortable and service was friendly. If you are around the area and looking for yum cha, I recommend you to try this place. I think you will not be disappointed. 25 March 2022 Came back for dinner recently. The food was just as tasty. The quality remain consistent. Will be back.
Delicious food!!! Specially Beijing duck with pancakes, steam fish, BBQ lamb ribs, fried Tofu. Dessert tofu.... So awesome. Real canton Kejia style
Been a regular customer for years, for both dim sum and dinner. Menu for Lunar Chinese New Year 2025 is out 🤩

Just discovered Mina Lee , and wow—every bite here feels like it’s straight out of a K-drama feast! Must try: Braised beef short rib- so tender and flavoural Seafood topu soup– Spicy, silky, packed with fresh seafood Meat dumplings– I love kimichi dumplings Every dish was bursting with flavor, and the portions were generous. Service was warm and attentive, adding to the cozy vibe.

I would recommend this place. Everything was delicious. We thoroughly enjoyed everything. The oxtail soup was very flavourful. You could tell there it was densely flavoured and not watered down. The short ribs were quite sweet and very tender. Kimchi was fresh and generous portions. As were the reddish kimchi. Very cool small pressure cooked rice hot pots. Over all everything was great. Service was friendly and made really good recommendations. I would travel 30+ mins just to eat here.
Great place! Hearty satisfying meals and really liked they give both kimchi and radish Price is fair and good portion sizes. Worth the trip if you don't live on the north shore!

All the food was really good! The seolleongtang and Suyuk were especially tasty. The restaurant had a nice atmosphere and you could tell the owner put effort into every detail. The staff who spoke Korean were super friendly and professional too. I’d definitely visit again

I come here for the kimchi and the radish, the portion size for the galbi and the mushroom bulgogi was a bit steep $27 for what it was but todays goal was for the kimchi lol so if that’s you too then yes go try if not then as long as you don’t mind the cost you’ll enjoy it here! I usually order the yukehjang id def get that next time instead of the other dishes

I came here to try out the all-you-can-eat buffet for $115pp. It is such good value for money. The food was incredible! Highlights include the sashimi platter, which was so fresh, the grilled eel (unagi) was tender and sweet, and the saba fish was seasoned perfectly. And you get unlimited drinks, including alcohol too! The plum wine tasted amazing. I wish I had taken more pictures, but the food looked so good that we devoured everything pretty much immediately haha.
