Best of all, everyone working there was super warm and friendly - especially the boss himself. I highly recommend visiting this restaurant!
Loved my meal at Kita Foodhouse. The sukiyaki came with a generous portion and full of flavour. The salmon noodles were fresh and tasty. Friendly staff and service. Will definitely be back.
A very cost-effective restaurant — clean and tidy, with fresh ingredients in every dish. The flavors are excellent, the presentation is beautiful, and the service is attentive. Highly recommended!

Makes us wonder how does the owner make profit!!!! Good quality food and the most important thing is the price! Only 115pp you can have literally everything! We are well fed here❤️Definitely will come back!
$85 per person. Fresh fish and authentic soup base. Recommend to anyone who likes sashimi and Japanese hot pot

We had such a wonderful time at DayNight! The customer service was truly excellent—every single staff member was so lovely, kind, and comforting. They made us feel welcomed and the vibe was immaculate. The food was absolutely delicious and came out fast, we got fried chicken with 3 flavours and the instant spicy rice cake. The chef offered to make the instant spicy rice cake for us and she was super nice. If you're looking for a place with great food and even better hospitality, you should definitely visit DayNight. The staff here is so genuine and caring—it’s rare to find such warmth these days. I will definitely come back!
Amazing food very fresh and yummy! Great fried chicken and seafood hotpot. Highly recommended!!! Nice and friendly owner!!!

Sooo yummy! New favourite Korean fried chicken spot! I tried their fried chicken for the first time last week and had to come back again today! This time we dined in, and the lady was super nice! Highly recommend the spicy flavour—just a heads-up, it’s really spicy, so maybe ask for the sauce on the side!
Always enjoy their fried chicken! Good portion and best boneless chicken I ever had!

This chicken? A must-try. Insanely crispy outside, juicy and tender inside, no grease, just flavor. Perfect for lunch or anytime you crave proper Korean-style fried chicken. Once you take a bite, you'll be planning your next visit. Don’t miss this spot!
Food was literally so authentic and yummy but we waited for half an hour to get our food.
Super value set meau only 68 for three big yummy dishes, spicy chicken, ma po tofu and fish .also with two bowls of rice. Be honest can be enough for families of 4 or 5 .

Dakeyi Hotpot is an exceptional buffet restaurant that offers a remarkable array of delights. From the flavorful Northern China cuisines such as 锅包肉 Guo Bao Rou which is a classic dish of crispy deep-fried pieces of pork that are coated in a sweet and tangy sauce, 酱大骨 Braised Pork Ribs in Sauce, 麻婆豆腐Mapo Tofu and the unexpected pleasures like grilled salmon head, it was an experience to remember. What truly amazed me was the inclusion of 小米粥millet porridge which is a traditional Chinese dish made from millet grains simmered in water or broth until it becomes a comforting, creamy consistency. Millet porridge holds great significance to Chinese people as it is often considered a symbol of nourishment and health. It has been a staple food in China for centuries, known for its easy digestibility and rich nutritional value. The inclusion of millet porridge at Dakeyi Hotpot adds a cultural touch to the dining experience, making it a place not only to savor delicious food but also to connect with Chinese culinary traditions. The ambience of Dakeyi Hotpot was equally impressive, providing a cozy and inviting atmosphere that enhanced the overall dining experience. The friendly and attentive staff added a personal touch, making me feel welcomed and well-cared for throughout my meal. Dakeyi Hotpot has succeeded in creating a dining experience that beautifully blends tradition and innovation, making it a must-visit for anyone seeking a unique and flavorful journey.

This is by far a nice place mixion surfing vibes good service and a delicious menu. If you like hot food or not they will have something for you. There is a good mixture of seating available.

Rude, disrespectful and arrogant staff. Despite three Visits over four weeks, staff have shown multiple times they are simply too busy to stop what they are doing to acknowledge the customer. To be dismissed by three staff members today was rude and disgusting behaviour and im sure it falls short of any customer expectation. I could accept it as a one off but three times in a month is beyond a joke and highlights the culture behind the counter. They simply don't care and I highly reccomend to go elsewhere

For the last 2 days, they have received my order and sat on it for 20+ mins before cancelling it. I could have ordered from elsewhere instead of wasting my time. After reading their past reviews, I can see that this is something that has been happening for months.

I do love tank, however disappointed in the massive chucks of bits in my smoothie today.. was really disappointing, this has happened a few times now. Sadly wasn’t enjoyable because i was getting big slobbery stuff
The best Tank Juice in the city. Great fast and friendly service. Got this one to take with me as I set sail to Fiji I’m sure the smoothies taste best from Constellation! Love this place.

The salad portion is too small. One guy slowly making ur meal like a snail. Looks like he is not in a good mood. Not many customers, But one salad took nearly half hour to make. Another concern is the guy using the same gloves on the computer keyboard and making salad. That is disgusting. Will never go back to this tank. So disappointed.

I had such an amazing experience thanks to the exceptional customer service I received on July 17 at 8:50pm. After a long evening at work, I was really looking forward to a good meal and arrived about 10 minutes before the store was due to close. It looked like the kitchen and till were set to close in just couple of minutes, so I honestly wouldn’t have minded if I’d been turned away. But the staff member warmly welcomed and took my order without hesitation. His kindness and willingness to serve a customer right at the end of the closing truly stood out and made a lasting impression. This thoughtful gesture turned my night around and made me feel genuinely valued. Because of this experience, I’ll definitely be returning to this branch. Thank you Agam (sorry if I got your name wrong) for such outstanding service. You are a star of this store!

The attendant was not happy working there as he kept the toasties which I ordered out of the oven for 5-7mins before he even started to do anything about it. Also their prices are very high. Please compare prices with other stores before buying from here.

Me and my daughter wanted here for 25 mins... just for 2 toasteis and 2 cookies 😡 The food is good but the service is horrible. There were 2 people working on a very busy day with the lone out the door. My 2 year old daughter was almost in tears.
Great sitting area in this subway. Very good service by Agam. Food was too good.
It's ok, but had to wait 15mins to be served. They need another person to help at lunchtime!
Love the small PHO cheap and tasty! and the Pork Ngohiang! Coffee is 10/10. Would love to come back :)

I tried a sandwich with a baguette that they make themselves, the brownie and the flat white were delicious, the service was fast. I think they just need to be more organized, keep the tables clean and have more cutlery and napkins. Good job.

We planned to visit the café next door, but it was closed, so we came here instead. The coffee was fine. Unfortunately, the barista noticed where we came from and started mocking the other café and even laughed at me for not knowing the beans I was drinking. He came across as arrogant and dismissive of people’s preferences on the cafe next door. I bought two flat whites, but the attitude made the whole experience uncomfortable and embarrassing in front of my friend.

One of my favourite routine eatery’s! Not to mention, delicious, and has a great variety! I HIGHLY recommend the ube latte, I get it every time and it’s so amazing. Pork belly is also out of this world 😊 The atmosphere is awesome, decoration is the best! Lots of dried flowers and duck themed decor, it’s so lovely. Staff are really kind, definitely gotta come try this place! It’s a bit far from where we usually go, but every time we’re in the area it’s always worth stopping by. A large parking area, usually isn’t a problem 😊

I recently discovered this delightful cafe in Rosedale, and it’s quickly become a favorite spot! The cozy ambiance creates a perfect backdrop for enjoying their delicious desserts. I visited in the afternoon and almost missed out on their mouth-watering treats, so I’d recommend arriving early if you want to ensure you get a taste. The atmosphere is warm and inviting, making it an ideal place to relax and savor every bite.
Chicken teriyaki is amazing. 🤩 will come back fore sure.
Clean and tidy lovely staff amazing sushi

One of the best bang-for-your-buck sushi places in the Shore. I always go here for lunch or even a snack to get me through the day and it never disappoints. The staff are very nice, and know you by name if you are a repeat customer! Shout out to Jiji and team.
Amazing place, kind staff, brilliant sushi, dons and bento boxes. The price is extremely fair and the sushi is big and tasty. Will come here again!

nice and fresh glass display of food! well prepared and yum tasting! bento box also well packed and a few minutes wait and it was ready! thank you! keep up the good work. well done. will surely recommend!

We ordered the Jajangmyeon and sweet and sour pork. The texture of the noodles was phenomenal. It was soft and chewy. I never had anything like it before. It now lives rent free in my mind🤤. The sweet and sour pork was crispy indeed but too sweet if eaten on its own, however, its perfect if paired with the jajangmyeon as it compliments each other. I can’t wait to try their jjamppong next time!

It was good to have a late lunch at 3:30 p.m. on the last weekend. Even generous at reasonable prices. Sweet and sour pork is crispy and smells like cinnamon. Rice with noodles is a bit spicy but okay. It would be nice if the hall was more brighter.
There are many other options you should try first. The jjamppong was far too spicy and I have had many. You will be lucky to avoid an Ajima who brings down the atmosphere. Sat 2pm.

Called in to book a table for dinner and it was ready. Food came out relatively soon, we enjoyed our OG jjamppong, seafood jjamppong, jjajangmyun + a M sized sweet+sour pork dish. We might add thay the seafood and og jjamppongs were not very different so og is good if you're on a budget. Service was great!
taste alright. staffs need to improve service. if you are after korean chinese food, try ha rim gak in wairau park, takapuna.

They have authentic and unique menu. We ordered the Beef Bone Soup (seollgatang) and Pork Sausage Soup (seundaegeuk). High quality meat, tender and thinly sliced. Hearty broth, my wife says it’s one of the best blood sausage she had. The seafood pancake was crispy with tender squid and shrimp. They gave us freshly cooked lotus roots. The other condiments were delicious, including the black bean tofu skin. The staff were friendly and helpful. We will come back to try the other menu.

I got the pork cutlet for takeaway. It was still crispy at home, and the portion was generous. Personally, I like to have the sauce on the side. That way, it goes even better with kimchi!! Highly recommended!

I ordered bibimbap as a healthy meal. The combination of fresh vegetables, just like the ones I had in Korea, was well-balanced and neatly presented. The bulgogi was served separately, allowing me to fully enjoy its own flavor, which made the dining experience more enjoyable and enhanced my appetite. I would love to visit again.
Our party of 16 enjoyed a wonderful evening at Happy Chef! The food was absolutely delicious and the friendly service was excellent.

Worst of worst. Served with uncooked food. No apologies from the owner at all. Disgraced and disgusted in terms of their service and the owner’s attitudes towards customers. Used to be one of my fav restaurants in Auckland but turns out to be the worst now. Seriously the owner needs to learn how to listen to the feedbacks from customers. Never going to come back and will never recommend this place to anyone I know.
I used to love their honey chicken on fried rice but we just ordered two today and they need to rename it honey batter on fried rice as there was close to no chicken inside each piece 😕
Ordered 2x honey chicken noodle last night. More like honey “donut” noodle. Not a bit of chicken to be seen! Won’t be back again

So disappointed with my sweet box! 😭 Not sure if its because theyre closing soon, or bad stock, but the flavour is missing its sweetness!!! The pineapple is flavourless and had no juice to the TWO pieces I could find amoungst my meal.... I hate to waste food but this is definately NOT what i paid for =(

EAT HERE OFTEN BUT JUST RECENTLY FOOD QUALITY HAS DROPPED. flavors and sauces not as good as one month ago. Had fried rice sweet chicken very druy rice was clumped May not go back anytime soon shame i used to go v reg ularly
Well here we go again 15.50 for a bowl of noodles hunt the meat for a combination meat this is a joke never again

Good curry, generous portion, kind staff. I've tried butter chicken and chicken biryani and both were really nice. Biryani portion was huge, I took it to work for lunch the next day. Can choose the level of spiciness for curry. Overall very satisfied. No more mall foodcourt curries!

We always have the butter chicken, tikka masala or beef vindaloo, and I can confidently say this is probs the best curry place I've had in NZ. Consistently very good tasting curry and food, good portions/fair pricing and lots of meat that is very good.
Always good curry, lots of meat and rice included in the price. Hard to beat the quality for the amount you get and the price paid.

Overall this has been reliable however tonight the Chicken Sagwala was dreadful. Bitter frozen spinach. The sauce was awful, actually not edible. The Butter Chicken and the Samosas, as always, was very good but the Sagwala not up to standard and is going down the waste master. I have ordered this dish before and it was delicious but certainly not the awful version served tonight.

Ordered Lamb biriyani with plenty of lamb. Butter chicken and lamb Rogan was good and asked for very hot and we couldn't handle it. So don't go for the very hot option if you don't know what you asking for. Overall not bad with decent amount of food for the money spent. We got the uber 25% discount so worth the money spent. Without discount sometimes around $60.

Super affordable for the quality and quantity. $9.90 rice bento box for 2 meats, 2 vegetable options. You don't get to choose - it's a fixed box that changes every day. Friendly staff. The music is kinda loud, though. A lot of orders and people are coming in and out, but the number of people dining in isn't much.
This eatery is famous for its affordability. The food is okay. You can’t go wrong with $9.9

$9.90. Let that sink in for a moment. With such a incredible price point, this establishment checks all of the boxes for dishing out some amazing food at this price point. Amazing mix and portions of meat, vegetables and rice which is punching way above its value. I personally think it's almost impossible to have so much value compared to a home cooked meal. While I haven't been to many $9.90 establishments, I can say that so far, Smart Kitchen has the most in depth and complex flavours. Overall, highly recommend cheap eats lunch box in Albany. Great value and great flavours to make a dent in the saturated $9.90 market.

Highly recommended 😃 The true northern Chinese food flavour. Fresh ingredients. Their bento dishes change daily. It’s honestly to find something this tasty and healthy at such an affordable price 💖 For 9.90, you get 2 veggie and 2 meat dishes. Score!!
Unbelievable price at $9.9 for this whole box in 2024 Auckland! It actually tasted good too, unlike some other $9.9 places we tried that were tasteless or just full of carbs with little meat/vege…

Had my first visit to Good Horse Takeaway recently and was pleasantly surprised by the overall quality and portion sizes. If you’re after a solid fish and chips experience, this spot definitely delivers on quantity and taste. The fish was fresh and well-cooked, with a flaky interior and a golden, crunchy exterior. My only critique is the batter, which was quite thick—more than I’d prefer. It slightly masked the flavor of the fish and made the bite feel a bit heavy at times. A lighter, crispier batter would have really let the quality of the fish shine through. The chips were excellent—generously portioned, crispy on the outside, and fluffy on the inside. They were well-seasoned and not overly greasy, which is always a bonus with takeaway. Service was efficient, and the food was packed thoughtfully to keep it hot and fresh by the time I got home. Everything arrived in great condition, which made for a satisfying meal overall. I’d definitely return for another round of fish and chips. While the batter could be improved, the freshness, portion size, and overall value make this a reliable go-to for a classic Kiwi takeaway meal.
Best Chinese takeaway in Forrest Hill! Food always fresh and tasty, plenty of veggies and meat, generous portions. Highly recommend!
Best sweet and sour pork I’ve ever had in my life! It’s crunchy inside and the sweet vs sour ratio is perfect.

Used to be an excellent Asian & European takeaways, however over time it's gone down the drain due to quality decline and price increases. I mean they've even removed the carrots, corn and peas out of the chicken fried rice and the sweet and sour chicken is basically sweet and sour batter, yet the prices increase. Don't get me started on the fish and chips. Service is a mixed bag. Would only spend my money here if I had no other option and starving.
Average, food looks really good, but fish batter is very crunchy and dry and same with the chips

After moving to Central Otago, I have missed a Wendy's meal. Coming back to see some family and swinging in, it was great. Great value. Quality food. These days I dont expect much from a take away place. But Wendy's was perfect. The chips were AMAZING and the burgers tasty and fresh. Way better than I remember them! Definitely the best fast food burgers iv ever had. Whatever you're doing... carry on doing! And maybe open a Wanaka/Queenstown/Cromwell/Alexandra branch please. Youd be printing the $$ with this with litteraly no competition.

Really clean inside, lots of seats available and seld service easy to use. Three different meals just over $50, quite a few low carbon options which is cool to see. Toilets are locked so you need to ask staff for code to access wharepaku.

"I had the best Wendy's burger ever at the Constellation Drive location! The patties were cooked perfectly and tasted incredibly fresh. It was the most amazing burger I've had in a long time. Definitely recommend this place if you're craving a delicious Wendy's meal."

One thing about wendy is that the patties are always fresh, but they're not seasoned. I understand that there is salt n pepper available, but i would rather have the patties seasoned when prepared. Also, probably the best buns for burgers, I do like these. Employees brought the food out to us which not often for a burger joint, that was nice to see. I came here with my workmates, so we got a couple of different burgers. - 3/4 Triple burger 7.1/10 Big and beefy. Lack of seasoning. Probably won't need fries for it being this size, it's OK. - Baconator mushroom melt 7.2/10 Same here with the patties. Mushroom sauce bland too. It's OK as well. -Chickenator 6.5/10 Needs more bacon. Patties were ok size.

Floors in dining area were EXTREMELY slippery and entrance way is very very difficult to use with wheelchair. Doors do not stay open long enough to bring wheelchair through without them closing on us. Food and service was good. We like coming but, for those with mobility concerns, either think again or, take extra care please.

Change of ownership since I've been back, different vibe. All tables are reserved, and a few tables in front that can be shared. Cramped seating area. - BBQ bacon burger 3.6/10 Stacked to the point where it's way too high. Actually, I had to dismantle it as it is a poor attempt to be way too fancy. Pattie is like a meatball, and removed all the hard, low budget coleslaw.

I dropped by not too long ago to inquire about their poker games. Based on the sign, I know that it starts at 6:30pm-7pm. But I wanted to know more details like re-buy costs, how many rebuys are allowed, if so, at what price, time-limit per rounds, roughly how many players play, etc. So I went to the bar to ask for more info as the signage suggested. When I asked the guy at the bar about the game, he quickly answered with "the game starts at 6:30pm" without giving me the chance to get my message across. I told him, "Yes, I know the game starts at 6:30pm but I wanted to know more info." He then pointed at a guy who was watching the game and drinking and said "you can go ask him." What's the point of the signage if the staff is not open to hearing my inquiries. He spoke in a tone as if I was interrupting his work or that he was annoyed with me just wanting to ask a simple question. He could have just apologized if incase he knows little about the details of the game and just escort me to the guy who knows. I was planning on staying and buying drinks till the poker game started but that interaction turned me off, unfortunately. Such a shame.

Great place to watch the sport. Martin's (Frenchman) customer service is outstanding. Anything you ask him for is not a problem eg closing the doors because it's cold, volume on the big screen etc. He knows what we like to drink. Thank you Martin for making our experience so enjoyable. We will be back as long as you are there🤗
The Chef is a legend . Food was outstanding. Staff are friendly and go the extra mile

Arrived at the end of service and was treated to some attitude when coming to ordering of food regardless of snacks or main meal, as well as little help in guiding us to what we could order. However after the ordering process the food was great. Tasty not oily and rather large portion sizes, great atmosphere.

All I ordered was a strawberry milkshake, and someone clearly made a mistake and started making a chocolate one. But instead of fixing their mistake, they filled up the rest of the milkshake with strawberry. This was the most utterly disgusting tasting concoction I've ever had the all deal of tasting due to someone's utter laziness to re do the drink.
There are images of fries where the fries should be. Virtual food! Quarter pounder resembles a cheese burger and half filled fries. Won't come back.

Awful hot chocolate! It was half full! My husband asked for a new one and said it has no milk in it and the man refused and said that is how our machine makes it.. definitely not true! I have had the machine hot chocolates for years and they are always full and creamy. This tasted like water! Not happy and won’t be returning. Especially because of the awful service!
Always missing items. Hawaiian with no pineapple, now missing prize tickets!? Who’s in charge? What prize do you have?
Poured a cold milk in a hot latte and explaining its normal? Did the manager forget to teach their employees? Please, if you are the manager in this store, stay until the closing time.
A perfect place for a fast lunch or light dinner. It offers both dine-in (with indoor/outdoor seating) and takeaway—plus delivery—making it super convenient
Make me clear , the chicken n fala ,chicken teaser we ordered were delicious. The shop man Chen , was keeping awesome service. Recommended !!!
Heaps of parking and well made salads with lots of filling! Also FREE Avocado and pineapple unlike some other sandwich chain.... :)

Great food, kind service, and excellent online ordering system. Isn’t the most inviting to eat at but I’ve only ever picked up my pita pit to take back to the office. They also have great smoothies. Thank you!
Very tasty and great service

A Korean restaurant offers generous side dishes: eight dishes. And they are all yummy. Affordable price, good amount on each dish, calm and relax atmosphere. It's very busy during lunch time, might need more staffs.

Great place for Korean food - we loved it! You get a really good variety of sided served with your dishes too which was nice. The service could be a little more friendly but still would reccomend. Good quality for the cost.

The best Korean restaurant on the North Shore, with reasonable prices, great tastes and big portions. Side dishes are amazing, way better than those at other Korean restaurants. Be there early if you can, as a queue will always be outside, even on a stormy day.

The side dishes were the highlight of the experience - I wish I got a photo, but I really liked the little pancake dishes, the kimchi, potatoes, garlic shoots... however I have to say that the stir-fried pork (pictured) was only okay and the portion was not that big for the price. The flavor was good but the texture so-so. The service and vibe was fine, no problems.

SCORE: 76/100 Had sizzling pork and seafood soup. Sizzling pork came out dry unfortunately but had some decent flavour. Wasn't the best I've had. The soup was great though and would recommend. They gave a lot of side dishes with large portions. Very surprising and generous. I would give them the benefit of the doubt and try it again. Do note, you cannot book and need to show up and wait for a table or hope one is free.

Buy 1 get 1 deal has convinced me to not come back! Even at half price, I’d rather have my $8 back. Greens were turning black. 1 tiny red onion. 2 tiny tomatoes. Bacon amount was the only good thing here. Not really a deal if I’m getting less than half the burger I expect from paying full price.
Toby was awesome! Super friendly and made ordering easy. Great service with a good vibe definitely made my Saturday better! As well as Shelby who made my shake. She was lovely to talk to!

If you’re searching for the ultimate burger experience, stop what you’re doing and head straight to Windsor park burger fuel seriously, this place is a game-changer! From the moment I walked in, I was greeted with the kind of genuine hospitality that instantly makes you feel like a regular. Front-of-house star Oliver deserves a serious shoutout. Not only was he warm and welcoming, but he also guided me through the menu with the kind of enthusiasm that tells you he actually loves the food here and for good reason. The burgers? Absolutely next level. I went for the signature Bacon Backfire and it was a perfectly stacked tower of flavor — juicy, tender beef, just the right sear, a soft toasted bun, and toppings that actually complimented rather than overpowered. Every bite was balanced and bold, with a smoky kick I’m still thinking about. And let’s not forget Noah, who I caught working the line it was clear he takes pride in every plate that leaves the kitchen. The care and consistency coming out of that kitchen? You can taste it. These aren't just burgers; they’re crafted. Whether you’re a burger purist or you like yours piled high with extras, Windsor Park has something special — and the service from Oliver and the team just takes the whole experience over the top. Can’t wait to come back. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I had a great experience at this restaurant, I got the bastard burger which tasted amazing!!!!!! I specifically had a great experience with Toby as he was extremely helpful as I was having trouble finding a meal, he deserves a raise!

Had an extremely pleasant, calming experience and blasting time last night being served by a young boy/man named Toby who helped us pick the best suited burger for me, my child and his friend (Antony & David B) Toby always had a cute smile on his face and was very eager to give us the best experience. Atmosphere was amazing. Would definitely recommend for future customers.

Excellent bbq meat. Highly recommend the picanha. We got the pork belly and sausage too but they felt a little too much towards the end (they made for great fried rice the following day though). Definitely get the beef and flan dessert and Brazilian snacks. Very warm and attentive service. Parking is free but remember to validate at the reception.

I absolutely love this place! Been there twice, I have had Reich such a good time that I honestly forgot to take photos and videos. The staff is so kind and attentive. It can get REALLY busy tho! So make sure to get there with enough time to order and not be starving! I love the fact that they have a sharing plate for 2 or 4. It is really topped! Meat taste it's just delicious and the dessert it's mouth watering. You really get a run for your money there. It's a must!

Finally trued Kika's and went to the North Shore branch. Great restaurant with amazing food, especially if you're a carnivore. Simple, easy to understand menu and excellent wait staff who were very attentive and made sure our little group of 5 were taken care of. I think the shared platters are value for money (which is hard to say about many places lately) and the meat was cooked to perfection. Would definitely visit again.🙏🏼🙌🔥

Had a lovely experience here. The staffs were lovely and the food was excellent. we had a platter to share for four and was surprised by how big the portion was. The cocktails were delicious and complimented the food well. The dessert pudding was delicious as well. will definitely come again

Have been a long time fan of Kika's West and finally got a chance to experience the North Shore branch and could not be happier with the experience. That charcoal flavour and taste on the picanha is just out of this world and the mushroom sauce is such a treat too. I didn't expect anything less from these guys as every single time we have dined at the West Branch the experience was flawless! North shore was no different and they truly delivered. Staff were beyond friendly and restaurant was clean to a very high standard. Extremely impressed and will be back very soon!

Upgrade from coffee club. The food compared to most cafes is def top in the current market. Don’t often focus on the flavours usually at a cafe, but here you can notice the difference in quality. Everything is what you expect, clean tidy friendly tables chairs, the normal. But when it comes to the food it’s great. Came here on 1st table and had a blast. Will be back again 👍🏻 Service: 4/5 Presentation: 4/5 Food Quality: 5/5 Food Quantity: 5/5 Environment: 4/5 Price per person: $20-$40

Amazing 🤩 We went for dinner and it was great! Ambience: The place was quite quiet, so it felt very nice and intimate. The area was very clean and the tables were spacious. It gives a quite classy vibe overall. Perfect for a small or intimate celebration within the North Shore Food and Drinks: The drinks were great. We all had cocktails and we all liked each one. The food was also really good. The price was a little steep, but for the thought and care they put into the food, it was understandable. We did book on first table to get a discount though, which was really helpful. Staff: The staff were super good. Service was speedy. They were super polite. They ensured that everything was clean and tide. Even the chefs looked like they were having a good night.

Excellent brunch here this morning. We were seated right away due to having a booking and it being relatively empty that time of the morning. The decor was clean , comfortable and had a good variety of seating options. The wait staff were friendly and provided great service. I liked that there were a few vegan options and even a couple vegan dessert options which isn't common. The fresh juice was delicious, as was the soy latte with caramel shot. Our meals were prepared quickly and they arrived well presented. My favourite was the vegan sticky date pudding which was light and moist and yummy. I wasn't sure how the banana and passion would pair but it was just right and the cashew cream on chocolate crumb topped it off. I wouldn't call the Tofu Bruschetta 'crispy' but the flavours worked well together and I'm glad I chose that as my main. My 11yr old decided on a medley of kids meals - Chicken & Hash, Junior French Toast and Chocolate Toast. I was impressed as it was clear to see the same effort and care had been given to the kids meals as the other menu items so anyone who isn't up to a full meal would be more than satisfied with these smaller options. The hash sticks were delicious and she loved the fried chicken as well. She preferred the French Toast over the chocolate toast but both were good in her opinion. All in all an enjoyable time, good sounds and chill atmosphere. We'll definitely be back.

Another outstanding dining experience at Town Tonic, Constellation Drive. Recently came in for brunch with a friend. We were so impressed by the overall experience...first class food which was every bit as delicious as it was visually stunning, amazing hospitality and front of house staff, beautiful decor and outlook. For our second visit we booked a three course dining experience for two...once again, our meal was an absolute delight from beginning to end. Will most definitely be recommending to everyone we know.

A bit upmarket. Quiet and the food was delicious & well presented. It was a bit cold, but after talking to the staff, they turned the temperature up a bit, which was great. Staff were fantastic and good parking right outside. Quite pricey, but we were there on a deal, which made it good value.

I ordered Judy's kitchen catering for my small house party - everyone at the party found it delicious! Great portion considering the price and very good quality. Easy ordering and smooth pick up too. Would definitely order again next time! Thanks very much for the lovely experience ❤️

First of all the staff are lovely and their service is top notch. There are sushi’s available when you walk in but the real gem here are their food on the menu which needs to be ordered in advance. Tried majority of the menu and my favourite are Korean vege mini kimbab with spicy cold squid & pork hocks ♥️ The exterior look of the building is very old but dont let that fool you. Inside is refurbished and very clean!
Judy's is really genuine about their food. Good portions, high quality korean food. Highly recommended. 🤌
I have ordered some caterings for the Christmas dinner. The foods were perfect portions for people to share and of really something you can feel a taste of Korea! Highly recommend catering place!!
Such fresh sushi we really enjoyed. Super yum and cute presentation. I’ve had spicy squid mixed with vege before. Those were to die for 😋 Highly recommend to all

This sushi restaurant offers fresh and beautifully presented sushi with a great variety of rolls and nigiri. The ingredients taste high-quality, and the sauces add a nice balance of flavor. The portion sizes are satisfying, and the presentation is visually appealing. The crispy items are well-fried without being too greasy. Whether dining in or taking out, the quality remains consistent. Highly recommended for sushi lovers looking for delicious and creative options!

I absolutely love this sushi place! Their keto sushi is hands down the best in Auckland. The salmon is super thick, fresh, and packed with flavor. The staff are really lovely and friendly too. Definitely worth a try – you won’t regret it!

I am always impressed by the large-size salmon sushi at this shop. It is one of my top three favourite sushi restaurants in Auckland! This time, I tried keto sushi for the first time. It was healthy and filled with plenty of shredded eggs and vegetables. The prawn sushi featured plump prawns! The female staff is friendly as always.

Such delicious sushi! The rolls are packed with filling rather than too much rice. The ingredients were full of flavour and fresh. Generous portions and a great amount of condiments provided. Highly recommend, this will be our new regular!

This is most definitely the best sushi I’ve had in New Zealand. I am always impressed with their salmon sushi which has massive chunks of salmon. The sushi is just so delicious here and their prices are very good too. I would highly recommend this place!!

We got ubereats from this place, our first time. Me and my partner ordered the Katsu curry, 2 bao buns, katsu don and two drinks. Salted caramel bubble tea and HongKong coffee. Drinks were good!! And my pork bao bun was nice. However, our Katsu curry and don were just stuffed into the containers, looking nothing like the photos we saw on ubereats. My Katsu don was soooo salty that I couldn’t even manage to eat it all. The katsu curry didn’t have much curry sauce either. My partner was highly disappointed in the Korean spicy fried chicken bao bun. Hardly any chicken and super dry. We paid over a $100 for this order and we’re left feeling ripped off and disappointed. Will never be ordering from this place again.
A bit pricey, but I enjoyed my pineapple bun and HK style drink. I got takeaways and also delivery on another occasion. The staff were very friendly.
AWESOME PLACE KEEP WORKING HARD ❤️

text: Management treats staff poorly
Good food, very affordable, lots of choices. My family always eat here. Don’t forget to order the coconut milk sago as well! They also offer free hot soup.
Food was delicious especially the buns, generous size soup heaps of meat, well worth the price. Only thing was dining in was tight not much space or tables.

Lovely place to dine in with homemade chilli oil, soy and vinegar at each table to have with your Kai. They also have drink dispenser and cups to help yourself. Great variety of food with lots of in-store promotions which make it such good value. Staff were lovely and friendly, talking me through some of the menu options. Will definitely come back 😊
Lovely experience! This is definitely a hidden gem!! I recommend this eatery if you're into saving money for a good quality in taste 👌 We got the hunger box 😊
Enjoyed our meal here the first and 2nd time hence why there's a 3rd time .. Great promos and combos. Yummy buns and the rest for a quick bite off busy Lincoln. Satisfying 😌

I visited around 2pm, well after the lunch rush, but everything still looked incredibly fresh. The variety of toppings and the quality of the ingredients were impressive—especially considering how affordable the prices are. It’s the perfect place to enjoy a meal that’s both healthy and delicious. The staff were super friendly as well. If you’re a student or a working professional who struggles with lunch decisions every day, this spot is an absolute must!

Amazing place to eat, fresh seafood and fresh veggies. Great portion size. You feel full but not bloated. Their miso soup is so good and also in winter when they make their home made seafood chowder- chefs kiss. Been going for years and the quality hasn’t ever changed. I would recommend double protein though as single protein isn’t enough.
Absolutely my fav lunch place! Healthy, yummy, cheap 💕

Blu Poké Shed makes consistently tasty bowls of goodness. The ingredients are always fresh and an amazing number of choices and toppings. The sauces add to the magic! The staff are friendly and efficient. Definitely recommend a visit to eat in or takeaway.

Love the chicken poke bowl, the ingredients are always fresh and delicious. Really generous sizes and decent prices. The staff are friendly and helpful. I don't usually eat in but you can, there's a few tables. It's usually hard work to find a park around there at lunch time but it's worth the walk!
Ordered the beef noodle soup, delicious！ Noodles all fresh made by a machine behind the counter. Interesting！ Service really fast but also very friendly. Great choice for a quick lunch.

I loved the beef noodle soup, very authentic Chinese food. It’s a local gem for noodles with a range of flavours to choose from. The noodles are freshly made and the kitchen is so clean and tidy and the price is very reasonable for the quality of food. Would definitely recommend to everyone who live and work locally :)
Had Beef ribs Noodles and Pork & Prawn Tacos - they were YUMMM ☺️!! Awesome service, cosy and clean. Definitely be back and will be trying other items on the menu 👍🏼
Taste good. Classic Chinese noodle. Delicious~

Although the place is very clean and staff friendly. The dish I had was not good. He noodles were think and powdery and the shredded chicken was almost all skin and no meat. I will be trying another dish in the future and will hopefully be impressed.
I go one or two times a week. My daughter loves the soup there, and the noodles are super delicious. Very authentic Shanxi food.
Still thinking of the biang biang noodles the day after *chef's kiss*
Literally addicted to these noodles! Now my go to place for food as I work around the corner. Not too bad for price, and their portions are very generous

Got their biang biang noodles with beef tomato egg and their paomo (flat bread) soaked in lamb soup. Flavour is good, noodles are made really well, service is friendly and fast. Didn’t see their liangpi on the menu which I really want to try, hopefully next time!
Very delicious food, kind service and tidy atmosphere. Highly recommended!! We definitely coming back!! Thanks 😊

The best sushi - beautiful selection of freshly made sushi with a great selection. The staff are lovely and the restaurant is always so clean and tidy. The food display is immaculate, this is our go to for lunch!

Like most of sushi places, this one was Korean owned and operated. Very well decorated, they make their sushi like an art gallery, well displayed and incredibly tasty. Apart from sushi, you can also order hot dishes and other varieties of Japanese dishes. Great place to have a nice meal.
Great service, sushi was fresh and tasty. Staff very friendly. My new favourite sushi place.

I almost tried everything on their sushi cabinet, plus I also ordered their Chicken Teriyaki bowl on the menu. The quality and taste of their food are excellent! I liked how I got a clean atmosphere and a good vibe inside the restaurant. Considering it was lunchtime, all staff were very attentive and accommodating. I liked how the male was so focused on the counter when I was checking out. They are all helpful and ready to serve you! What a fantastic experience and definitely not the last. Thank you!
Clean, very tasty, awesome staff Best sushi I've tried 👍🏾 Strongly recommend to try 'rice bowl' from the menu

I absolutely love Uncle Tetsu’s Japanese Cheesecake! The cheesecake is so soft, fluffy, and delicate — it just melts in your mouth. I also tried the cheesestars, which were delicious too. The crust is perfectly crumbly and buttery. Yum! Highly recommend for anyone who enjoys light and tasty desserts.
I expected a real authentic Japanese cheesecake, but it was just an egg taste cake. lol Not worth it $27.50 I felt Unfriendly staff too. A bit disappointed

I came at 10:40 and it was supposed to open at 11 but they were so kind they allowed us to come in early I ordered the chocolate tart for my daughter and we both ADORED it was very delicious would try again!

Pretty nice original cheesecake, with a rather dense texture. A tiny bit pricey for the size. I just miss the raisins in the cheesecake, like Uncle Rikuro’s does in Japan 😉 Give a go to the original cheese tart and the pudding, they are delicious as well.

Authentic Japanese cheese tarts, love their madeleine too. They have different flavors occasionally, I’ve tried taro and green tea, both are good. But my favourite is still the original one. At $5.5 per cheese tart, the price is very reasonable and aligns with the prices overseas. Their cheese cakes are good too, you can eat them cold or slightly warm them up for a softer (slightly melting) feel.

This is hands down the BEST Korean restaurant I’ve ever tried! Not only do they serve 8 kinds of unlimited banchan (side dishes) — each one fresh, flavorful, and perfectly balanced — but their Special Katsu is a game-changer! Crispy on the outside, tender on the inside, and packed with umami goodness. 🍛 Also highly recommend the fresh crab 🦀 The value is unreal, the service is warm and attentive. If you love Korean food (or just amazing food in general), this place is a MUST-VISIT. 10/10 would recommend to everyone! 🤍🤍🤍💗💗💗

First timer here, managed to bumped into this nice Korean food, food is really nice and fresh with side dishes that are also really good and still warm. The tofu soup is Amazing and the soya beef is full of flavours. Will definitely come next time.
Wonderful service and super yummy meals, definitely a 5-star top recommended Korean restaurant！ Surely coming back next time 👍🏽

This restaurant may be small, but it offers some of the best food around! We had the Bibimbap and Pork Cutlet, and both were outstanding. The Pork Cutlet came with generous, tender slices, and the side dishes were equally delicious. If you’re looking for top-notch flavors and a memorable meal, this spot is a must-visit!

This is special place serving an amazing Pork Tomahawk Fried Steak with salad and rice. Never had anything like this before and it's truly amazing. The pork was so tender it almost melts in your mouth. We also had the hot plate squid which was just as delicious. This place is a must travel 😊

Literally the best Korean fried chicken I had in Auckland, a small family owned takeaway store that offers the best juicy Korean fried chicken. The garlic soy was the best, very tasty and the portion is huge for $22! Highly recommend

Nice litte fried chicken restaurant in North Shore. I love the family business atmosphere and they are very nice and fast too. Their fried chicken is DELICIOUS. The crispy fried chicken is indeed CRISPY. There is much crunch, and the soy garlic is not too salty, which was perfect for me. It's definitely a must try if you're in the area.

Great spot for Korean fried chicken lovers! The food is crispy, flavorful, and always fresh. Staff are friendly and provide excellent service. There's plenty of parking, making it super convenient. A solid go-to for tasty fried chicken and a smooth dining experience!

If you’re looking for a quick and tasty lunch, this is the perfect place to go. They offer both medium and large-sized boxes, each packed with rice, meat, and salad. I tried the spicy chicken and honey chicken, and both were incredibly flavorful. It’s a great spot for a satisfying and delicious meal on the go!

Love their food! Lots of salads and yummy cooked meats/poultry. Customer Service is excellent! A young Korean girl at the counter is always friendly and very helpful! Thanks for your hard work in running this place!! 10/10 stars
Pretty busy place. Food is the usual same. More expensive than other places especially their extras. Nice staff.
Aut subway is so far the nicest subway we have been..... clean, handly location, staff r nice !!
Venkat had exemplary service and was very kind. He should be the Subway CEO
I am allergic to tomato’s. Ordered off uber eats. Double checked I didn’t make a mistake. I was right. Called the store. They didn’t seem to care.

I ordered online and had to wait 30 minutes for my Subway. There was only 1 staff and he served people who came after me, who did not even pre-order. This has been happening for the last month. They used to be so fast and friendly before when the owners were there working. Now there is long waiting times and the manager’s attitude is not even sorry. I have been going to this branch for the last year and a half but will not go again.
Pretty good sushi for supermarket brought. Have had rice do but I with vege tempura which is good and the Inari with seaweed. Very good
Not good at all. Salmon smelt pretty bad and overall, just not well preserved. Very disappointed & Will be taking this up with new-world.
Pre packaged sushi Limited range Limited choices

We love going to five star restaurant the owner is very mannered & polite and always care for customers, had a hot pot today was delicious with a hearty portion. All the ingredients are well cleaned and fresh! Never had any allergy issue with their hot pot soup/noodles:) (assume they use less msg/less salt) cant wait to have their hotpot again :)

I had an incredibly disappointing experience with this restaurant. I was told they would honor a voucher I had, and I even went as far as sending a copy to their address in Fairview Heights as requested. Despite following up multiple times via email, they ignored all communication and never acknowledged the voucher. This level of disregard shows a clear lack of professionalism and personal integrity from the owner. It’s not just poor service—it’s dishonest. I wasted both my time and money dealing with this establishment, and I strongly advise others to stay away. There are far better places that treat their customers with respect and follow through on their promises.

Have had hotpot dinner at this restaurant many times now and I can safely say that it lives up to its name of being 5 stars! The service is so warm and hospitable. The staff is very attentive and accommodating. The food is fresh and tastes amazing! Especially the fried chicken - it makes you keep wanting more.

If you love Korean food, Vietnamese pho, and hot pot, you must try this place! They offer a buffet at night for $38 per person, featuring a variety of vegetables, meats, and cooked dishes. The fried chicken and rick racker are absolutely delicious. The beef slices are perfect for the hot pot—juicy and tender. The owner even adds hot pot sauce to enhance the flavor. The soup for the hot pot is tasty, well-seasoned without being too salty. And don’t miss out on the bubble tea; it’s the perfect complement to the meal. Highly recommended!
A Vietnamese restaurant run by Koreans. The beef noodle soup was a bit too salty but the cut of the beef rib was really good. The service was exceptional too.

Best Chinese spot I have found in Auckland, I got the Chinese vege fried noodles and it was absolutely delicious, they were extremely generous with their portion sizes, theveges were super fresh and noodles were full of flavour. We also got the hot chips which were incredibly crispy but juice and soft, I will 100% be going back and could not recommend them enough!

We were pleasantly surprised by this new take-away shop. The food was reasonably priced for the portion sizes, super tasty and the meats were good quality cuts. Very friendly owner. Will get more take aways here in future for sure.

Brand new to our Tonkin Road shops in the old New HongKong takeaways. I tried this place for the first time on Sunday, Ordered by phone a Special A, extra scoop of chips,pork fried rice and mini spring rolls. I arrived and the Special A & Extra chips were almost ready,once I got the special A, I was told the Fried rice was comming, 10 minutes later I got the fried rice and was told the mini spring rolls were comming, 2 minutes later I got the mini spring rolls and my order was complete. The chips were very soggy and bendy, The fish was cooked good but had a slimy texture to the fish similar to Basa Fillets, The mini spring rolls were overcooked and very dark,the Pork fried rice was lacking soya sauce and was very lightly coloured,reminded me of home cooked fried rice done in a pan and not a Wok,The fish batter was very nice.but,that's where the compliments end. The timing and cooking of our meal was very poorly executed resulting in the special A going cold and having to wait for the other items was not ideal.This store is very New and I hope this was just a one off bad run and it improves with experience and repetition,because it's local to us and I'd like to try it one last time. Plenty of free car parking in the front of the store, right next door to Maggie's diary and a stone's throw away from a park and playground for the kids.
I had the fish and pork fried rice. The fish batter was thin and crispy, and the portion was good. The pork fried rice had a nice home-cooked feel to it with a mild flavour and not drenched in oil.

First time visiting our local since Mr Li moved in, pleasantly surprised by the menu and staff. Ordered egg fried rice, sweet and sour pork, vege noodles, rice and chips. Good portion sizes which were tasteful. Whole family enjoyed it. Staff were super friendly, took a menu away for next time! Glad to have a good local back, thank you 😊

I really hate leaving bad reviews when the service is good, however, to ensure there is improvement people need to be made aware. The fried chicken was covered in donut-like batter and tasted nothing like Korean fried chicken, I would not recommend coming here if what you're looking for is Korean cuisine. The sauces for both rose and cream were completely bland and watery, the only reviving thing was the fries which were great.
Super friendly stuff, cozy vibes and authentic korean street food. Highly recommend! Super yum!!!
The ham kimbap and honey fried chicken was so good and flavourful definitely recommend! Also staff were so friendly and restaurant was clean
Great food, lovely store and kind welcoming! Been there many times and is definitely a place to recommend!
super friendly staff and yum food!! the rose tteokbokki and snow chicken are amazing!

Such a gem! Loved the detailed interior and the delicious food, which delivered a fantastic palette of tastes. Very satisfying. The suitably impressive coffee was a great bonus. A definite recommendation. Saturday 12pm.

Stumbled across this little cafe quite by accident while searching for caffeine to get us up the coast after making it across the bridge. Initially just going to do a quick travel mug fill and run but after a squiz at the menu was intrigued by the options not normally seen. So ordered eggy meals and cuppa tea each. What was delivered did not disappoint. First the teas - they always come on a little service board and as pots. I had the citron tea (it comes in a mug with a pot of hot water and base 'jam' so there is enough for 2 good size cups). Our food was also delightfully presented. Hashbrown control - golden and crispy! Alas our first visit did attract the 15% PH surcharge being Easter Monday however this was soothed by the gift of an easter bunny (which despite being accidently left in my pants pocket for a period did not melt instantly with my body heat = good chocolate content & a tasty treat later that day). We stopped by again on our return trip from the Northlands - this time trying a little pistachio 'mousse' cake treat - very cute with a mild favour profile. I have the loyalty card ... I think it is very likely that we'll be back next time we find ourselves on that side of the bridge.

This restaurant is highly recommended for those looking to enjoy a relaxed lunch or dinner with a group of friends or family. The menu offers a variety of options, including Korean fried chicken, hot noodle soups, rice dishes, and more. I visited this restaurant with a group of friends for a special celebration. We had a wonderful time in a spacious room with a large table that comfortably seated all six of us. We ordered their specialty menu, which included White Jjamppong (백짬뽕) and Sweet and Spicy Fried Chicken (깐풍기), along with two beers. Additionally, we tried the Spicy Pork Bone Rice Balls (오돌뼈 주먹밥). The Sweet and Spicy Fried Chicken was crispy, delicious, and mildly spicy. The White Jjamppong, served in a large portion perfect for 3-4 people, was packed with fresh vegetables and mussels, and the soup had a rich, savoury flavour. The Spicy Pork Bone Rice Balls were great with the flying fish roe adding a delightful pop of texture. The seasoned pork filling was flavourful and complemented the rice perfectly, but you should be a little careful before you order it because the pork did include tiny pork cartilages you may not like. The restaurant itself was spacious, which was especially appreciated on a windy day. Although we didn’t have many drinks, this place is also ideal for enjoying a variety of beverages. If you're looking for a spot to gather with a group and savour authentic Korean cuisine, I highly recommend this restaurant.

NaB Cafe & Korean Restaurant offers an interesting fusion concept, positioning itself more as a modern cafe with Korean influences rather than a traditional Korean restaurant. Their standout fried chicken hits all the right notes, while their unique take on pasta dishes adds an unexpected but welcome twist to the menu.
This is my favorite cafe. They make really good coffee and the meals are always great. Strongly recommended.

Service was a little slower, but probably to less staff working late at night Food tasted good, for our large group there happened to be one hot hot hot pot which had beansprouts inside even though it wasn't ordered Large menu with a variety of items, surely something for everyone! Not the cheapest but food tastes good!

A little bit busy sometimes during weekend nights, but overall, good food and awesome staff!! Keep up the good work, guys.. will come back!! 👍 ⭐️👌 The latest visit update per star - (🌟 30) Still love this place. 😊

A Chinese mate invited me here for dinner. After reading the online review's (from the last year) I was nervous to say the least. The bbq food was great though, really enjoyed it and I’m a big fan of the chicken/potato/pasta dishes and always order them. There was so much food for the two of us, we were there for a couple of hours to get through it and couldn’t. I really enjoyed it. I don’t speak Chinese but could muddle through with pointing on the menu. I’m presuming it’s changed a lot of the last year.

So this place is actually really nice. Very nice LED lights. Service is so great. Food is yummy. -Sayf 10 years old The food was good, the service was good but they have to add dumplings. 9/10. -Saleem 7 years old

This restaurant exceeds expectations with its impeccable service and inviting atmosphere. The staff's warmth and attentiveness elevate the dining experience, complementing the delicious cuisine perfectly. Whether you're seeking a cozy meal or a celebratory gathering, this establishment consistently delivers excellence on all fronts. Well recommended and personally goes there onece every one or two weeks. :)
Went on Thursday was very quiet. LOVE the interior. Black beer was so tasty I will def go again.
Very delicious food!
The best Chinese BBQ in Auckland. You won't regret it!
Everything is fkong boiled

The shrimp in the shrimp is the best I have ever eaten in AKL! The fried shrimps are great 👍🏻 Crispy on the outside, tender on the inside and full of flavor It feels like salted egg yolk, and the shrimp shells are delicious😋 And when the shrimp is broken open, there is still shrimp yellow! I really want to ask the boss where he got such excellent shrimps! The chef also thoughtfully opened the shrimp back The only two shortcomings are that the shrimp threads are still there and the pork trotters have too many bones. But since the shrimp is so delicious, I can forgive you. And the barbecue is delicious too! How can it not be popular! rush!

One of My Favorites . Signature Rice Noodle with Braised Bone In & signature Chicken Steak The braised bone in meat is incredibly tender and full of flavor. The broth is rich and delicious, making it very comforting to eat. The chicken steak is perfectly cooked ,juicy on the inside with a nicely seasoned, flavorful outer layer. Highly recommend both dishes if you’re visiting. These two are definitely must tries ☺️☺️

Loved the new small pot dishes at Dagu Rice Noodle (North Shore, Auckland)! The Braised Beef Brisket with Potatoes was tender and flavorful, with rich sauce-soaked potatoes. The Spicy Squid Tentacles were chewy, perfectly spiced, and packed with flavor. Portions are just right, ingredients are fresh, and the taste is authentic. A great addition to their menu—highly recommended for a hearty meal beyond rice noodles! Will be back!
I’m sort of a regular in botany and now having seeing one staff member (Sophia) who actually remembered me from there was sweet! I’m so happy with the service always delighted.
Very friendly staff and food is sooo good.
There were a variety of noodle choices in there. It was very busy and the food was served very quickly. Will definitely recommend

"If you're working or looking for a place to eat in Albany, New Zealand, Modu Eatery is a smart and great choice. 😁👏♥️ The pasta, crafted by the chef couple, is full of deep flavors. Personally, I recommend the risotto for delivery. I visited with my 3-year-old, and even my child loved the risotto!👍🍝 I also had the salad, and the basil pesto in particular was incredibly delicious—it really suited my taste. 🥗 Without a doubt, this is the best restaurant in Albany, and a choice you won’t regret. I highly recommend you give it a try. It's a place where you can enjoy fantastic food at a reasonable price. 👍 The high ceilings in the restaurant make it feel spacious and atmospheric." This should convey your thoughts clearly and positively!❤️♥️💚👏👏

This place is a hidden gem! Their food is full of rich, savory flavours and super fresh! The staff are friendly, and parking is really convenient. I absolutely love their grilled sandwiches, and the Korean-style spicy chicken is amazing!!! - perfectly balanced, not too spicy, and just the right amount of sweetness. I’ll definitely stop by again whenever I’m in the area😊

While other dishes are also delicious, our favorite is the seafood tomato pasta. The portion is generous, and the smoky flavor in the sauce is exceptional. The fried chicken is slightly spicy and tasty as well. Friendly service and excellent food♡

Loved all the foods we had! Everything was really good and such a hit. We had the bulgogi pasta, chicken white pasta, and the yorkshire pudding with pulled pork. Food came out really fast, absolutely delicious, all the seasonings were on point. Definitely recommend everyone to come and try! They have plenty options of pastas, salads, sandwiches and other small bites. Really convenient if you want to have for takeaway as well. Really great service and the people working there are really friendly as well. Overall, 10/10 and will definitely come back again!

I am so impressed by the tastiness and quality of the food. I have ordered from Modu a few times now and every single time the food is so delicious and fresh! I cannot recommend this restaurant enough! The Bolognese and Garlic Butter Sourdough are my go to!

Always find their service is friendly. Their scallop nigiris are my all time fav! They make them fresh if they run out of them which are the best and I love them when they are freshly made. Also a free miso soup for purchase of more than $10 is available here which is a very nice touch.
A little gem in the area! The sushi is always fresh and delicious, and the service is warm and friendly every time. Highly recommend!
The best sushi I have ever had. Food there is so good and the service is also brilliant.
Fresh quality sushi, great service. Pro tip, Ask for a 10 pc roll of your fav flavour and they’ll roll it fresh on the spot.
Delicious sushi, lovely friendly service and free stickers/ cards to keep the kids entertained.

Had such a warm and pleasant experience at Korean Spicy House! The owner was incredibly friendly and welcoming. I accidentally ordered the wrong dish and later asked to switch to a more expensive one — she kindly agreed and didn’t even charge me extra. Her service was thoughtful and attentive the whole time. The food was delicious too. Will definitely be coming back!

My partner and I visited this place on a Wednesday evening for a hearty dinner after our pre-wedding photoshoot in the CBD left us starving. We ordered two mains: Spicy Fish Roe Soup and Grilled Beef Small Intestines. As meat lovers, these dishes were the perfect choice, offering both satisfying meat and a warm, spicy soup. As shown in the photos, the portions were generous enough for two hungry people. The staff were very kind, helping us grill the beef intestines and cutting them into smaller, easier-to-eat pieces. The food was delicious. The place was lively with people, but a table behind us were very noisy that kinda disturbed our table, but that was okay. It's been a while since we last came here, but they still deliver excellent intestine dishes. Highly recommended for anyone who enjoys this type of meal!

Food is good. But portion of meat is really too little vs the price to pay, especially think how cheap the stripes and entails are in this country. We ordered 3 portions of mixed meat, the photos shows how much meat it is...

Ordered takeaway today as I was craving for a Boneless chicken feet with rice balls. Even though it was a takeaway, It was still warm and sooooo delicious! No one can do better Chicken feet than them!
The food was great but sadly the portion wasn’t that generous. Recommended if you want to feel some authentic Korean Bar vibe.

It was my first visit, but I was so impressed that I wanted to share my experience. The broth of the pork bone soup was incredibly rich and full of flavor. What stood out the most was the generous amount of tender meat on the bones—it was so soft, it practically fell off. I asked the owner, and they told me they only use chilled (not frozen) pork, which really made a difference in taste and texture. On a cold and damp day, I went in just looking to recover from a rough morning, but I ended up leaving with a warm heart and a happy stomach. Great flavors and even better vibes I genuinely recommend this place!

I went almost at around closing time but they were still very welcoming. I ordered the signature spicy pork bone soup and it was the best I’ve had in Auckland! The side dishes were also really good. I would definitely be going back :) They even gave me an apron to protect my white top which was really nice!

I tried the spicy pork bone soup, and it was the best I’ve had in a very long time! There was so much meat on the bones i recommend you really dig in with your hands—thankfully, they provide plastic gloves for convenience. The broth was rich, deeply flavorful, and tasted just like authentic Korean pork bone soup.

I was excited to hear Korean Backbone soup restaurant has opened up in Albany so made the trip from the opposite side of Auckland to try them out and honestly the food could not have been any better. Back bone had soooo much meat on it and the soup was full of flavours with a slight spicy kick to it- perfect for the coldness right now! We ordered pork katsu for the kids and two huge pieces came out with a star shaped rice! Kids absolutely devoured it! We will be making another trip soon :)

This restaurant exceeded my expectations. The interior was clean and had a cozy atmosphere, making it a great place to enjoy a meal with friends or family. The food was fresh and delicious, and you could really feel the care put into each dish. The staff were also very friendly and attentive, which made for a pleasant dining experience. I would definitely like to visit again if I get the chance.

Clean restaurant. Noticed two male staffs running the place. While the food itself was excellent, the service was *slow* despite me being the only customer at one point. They seemed a bit unorganised, which impacted the overall experience. No printed menu, only ONE digital menu at the kiosk (& for ordering). Off and on there’ll be a queue. One toilet 😅 That said, the fried dumplings were absolutely spot-on-crispy on the outside, juicy and bursting with flavor inside. I tried both the pork & coriander dumplings and the pork, prawn & chives dumplings, and they were fantastic! Plus, the price point is a win—12 fried dumplings for just $7.99 is great value. Will definitely be back for the dumplings, hope the service would be quicker and smoother next time.
Really nice food, prices so low! Incredible value. Can have a bowl of noodles for lunch, 10$, prices are from 15 years ago
Dumplings and all other main foods are good and inexpensive. Everytime when I was dining there I feel I was living in the 10 years back because eating out was not that expensive.
Fantastic dumplings, we got the fried pork and chives . So delicious !
Best CP value for quick Chinese noodles and Dumplings, good portion size and yet does not break your wallet, highly recommended!!

My family, partner and I visited Paper Moon last night (with a reservation) and we were given the honour of being served by Lucy. Lucy was a great server, she was friendly and didn't talk as if she was reading off a script. We'd all 100% go back just to be served by her. She also recommended that we moved tables as the table we were on previously was tiny for the 4 of us. Not long after switching tables (roughly 5-10 minutes) the table was properly sanitized and cleaned by another server. So cleanliness was a 10/10! Onto the food, we got the Grazing Board appetizer to start and there was such a wide variety of samplers and everything was extremely well made, tender and flavourful. Great starter; 9/10. But along with the appetizer we ordered, I got a chocolate milkshake. I had my expectations high, maybe a bit too high. To everyone it just tasted like milk with a very VERY slight hint of chocolate. 5/10; you're better off with a soda or water. My partner ordered the Scotch Fillet and they loved it, though I felt as though it was too charred on the top. Overpowering the taste of the steak. But the steak fries that came with it were perfectly crispy on the outside and fluffy on the inside. Overall; 8/10. My mum ordered the Grilled Salmon with Risotto, the salmon completely melted in your mouth, vegetables were perfectly cooked, not too hard, not too soft. This would make a perfect 10/10 dish, but I think the risotto was a bit too salty. Which kind of made anything that was touching it have a distinct saltiness taste. I'd give this another 8/10. My pop ordered the Beef Wellington, which we were told would take 30 minutes, but it came out with almost everything else. Everything tasted amazing. From the pastry down to the sauce. The beef was perfectly rendered and the pastry had a small amount of cheese separating it from the pâté. Even the mushrooms in it were extraordinaire. The only complaint he had with it was that it was a bit too small, but I give it a 9/10. And finally, I ordered the Salt & Pepper Squid Salad. Which at the time I was surprised that it took the longest, everyone's food had already come out and it took maybe an extra 5 minutes. I didn't expect much from a salad but when it came out I understood why it took longer. This was by far the best and biggest salad I have ever seen and ordered. We also thought the squid was going to be small cuts of squid but it ended up being multiple big tender-sized chunks of squid that were perfectly tender and fell apart in your mouth. The salad itself was a bit flavourless but if you incorporate the sauce/dressing that's given with it, it becomes a whole lot better. This, in my opinion was the best dish of the night. 10/10. Now, onto dessert! When we were thinking of what to order we had asked Lucy how big the desserts usually are and instead of her telling us some fancy wording on why it's small, she told us straight up, which we loved. We ordered the Tiramisu and the New York Cheesecake, both were quite small but it was a good portion for the 4 of us considering we were all full from our mains. The Tiramisu wasn't the best I've had, but it was definitely a sight for sore eyes. Looking at it I felt like I had travelled to Italy! The mascarpone was pretty good but the lady fingers were too hard and crunchy. It was as if I was eating a scotch finger. I give it a 7/10. And as for the New York Cheesecake, it was amazing. It was moist, flavourful and the base was a perfect texture and consistency. Though it was a bit too flavourful. The berry and passionfruit compote was very overpowering. If you put them together all you can taste is the passionfruit, but if you try it separately it just becomes too much, so try the cheesecake with a small pinch of the compote. Overall I give it an 8.5/10. We just want to give a big thank you to Lucy for an unforgettable night and we will definitely come back just for you! This is a great place for a family dinner, a date night or just drinks with your mates. Come give this place a try! (All pictures hopefully in the same order)

Went in for breakfast this morning a classic steak meal and a salmon egg bene. We are big eaters but we couldn't finish these plates. Egg bene was packed with salmon. Steak had the beautiful grill flavour. Portion sizes are massive. Price well worth it. Only downside was one of the eggs were over cooked. Fantastic atmosphere, lovely music and staff. Would definitely recommend 👌 💯

Amazing restaurant find! The food presentation was stunning and the taste was outstanding. I lived in Chicago for 9 years and ate at a few Michelin-star restaurants and this little gem compares in food quality and presentation. I had the lamb and it was seasoned perfectly and cooked to perfection, medium. A little crunch on the outside and juicy in the center. The accompanying sides were delicious as well. My favorite was the potato fritter with a mint sauce for dipping. And I had to experience the chocolate bomb. Note: it takes about 15 minutes to prepare this dessert but it is so worth the wait. Yes, it blew my mind with the combination of flavors. The service was good as well. It's a relaxed dining atmosphere with a bar and a few televisions. It looks like it has a good selection of breakfast items as well. I definitely recommend this restaurant.

Tbh this place was on my list for a while and turned to be a disappointment. First off the wait staff are judgy like oh let me help you order like hey we aren’t kids we got it. It’s a Monday arvo we’ve worked and have the money to spend so don’t look at a book and start judging. I’ve never been so disappointed at wait staff on the North shore as much as I have been here. Learn to at least make decent coffee my double shots weren’t even added maybe they were but didn’t feel like it. Only the food looked good and needed to keep getting up to get salt and pepper at least have the basic on the table if you are going to be judgy.
A lovely cafe with a wide variety of meals. Been coming here for years and always got good food served with a friendly smile.

HORRIBLE EXPERIENCE. I went there this morning(10am) and there were multiple things that were just purely disappointing and GROSS. First of all, I found a hair in my food.(as shown in the pic) Secondly, the spicy pork sushi I had was OFF(didn’t get to take a pic cuz it went straight in the bin) Like before biting into it, it smelt FUNKY. I thought maybe it’s just the sauce but no. I took a small bite, and had to spit it out because it definitely had already gone bad. There was no way that was made this morning. The lettuce in it was already starting to ROT. And it really tasted like something that would make me sick. It’s an awful experience for sushi that costs a little more than other choose your own sushi places. Other than those two that just really not meet the bare minimum in health and safety, the other sushi was not too bad. Not the best out there, but alright. The other things just really ruined it for me. I give the service 3 stars just because the guy at the cashier made me wait a few mins for him to finish getting off his phone call(which could have been important but still…)

Food: personally I think when the sushi is fresh, their sushi is really good. Absolutely delicious. BUT If you're going to get sushi from here though, you're going to want to go early. If you go past 11.30am, the sushi is no longer fresh and you can tell from the rice. The grains are no longer soft and can tell its been left out for a while. They seem to make the sushi in the morning in bulk and keep containers beneath where they display the sushi. I know because iv seen when they restock the necessary sushi rather than making sushi throughout the day. The miso isn't anything special and isn't worth buying to be honest. Also my partner says the bento bowls they make also arnt worthing spending money on as you can make a tastier one from home. Staff: guessing its a family buisness. The son runs the counter and the mother with an aunty do the food out back. The son instead of providing as good of a service he can, seems to prioritize playing chess on his phone. I had to stand and wait for him I guess to make the right move on his chess game instead of prioritizing me giving payment, I'm guessing leading me to have a disapproving face because when this happened his mother walked out from the back noticing my face in which instead of telling her son to focus on the customer and not his chess game, she started looking at me like I'm a rotten customer which became her constant look towards me whenever I arrived. Oh well 🤷‍♂️
The sushi is soo good here, as well as all the other food. The staff are friendly and there is usually a lot of selection of food. Also the location is very convenient.
Great Food, lovely staff. Best Udon !! amazing !
We regularly eat here as a heathy takeaway option. Standard of food is always very good. Sometimes a little slow with preparation but at least it’s all thoroughly cooked. Staff are lovely.
Love their $25 weekend (12pm-4pm) pizza specials! Recommend the Aussie and the Texas pizzas 👍🏾

We drive past Taksim often and have been meaning to try it out. Our wedding anniversary was this week so perfect opportunity to go out for dinner. The staff were very friendly and the service was good. We ordered the Mezze Platter and a seafood pizza. The platter was very nice although seemed to be a little heavy on the bread ratio. The wood fired pizza was delicious. I had booked in advance but seemingly no need as the restaurant was empty when we arrived at 630pm on a Wednesday. Very nice local restaurant with a relaxed atmosphere

Food has really gone down hill. 7 of us for dinner, only one of us finished our meals. 6 of us had a couple of bites and left the rest untouched. We told the waitress the food was bad, manager didn’t even front, no apology or discount. Very disappointed. This place used to be great. Won’t be coming back.

Great food from a local turkish-style restaurant of the type we dont have enough of. Proper charcoal grill makes it special. Especially lamb rack is amazing!!!!!! 🍖 also hummus & salad are fresh and perfectly harmonized with meats 👍 Good sharing platters and small bites. Good for families, couple or groups.

Hit & miss. The skewered meat dish was great, but everything else was bland, average, or tasted weird or stale. For the price they charge a main, you'd expect better. The prawn salad was salad mix leaves bag you'd get from the supermarket - the carrot and cabbage slices were old and stale. And the dressing tasted like from a supermarket bottle too. There was nothing original or fresh. The avocado dip in the pide + dip tasted off.

Disappointed in last nights service and food 2 items were burnt so badly we couldn’t even eat them and the 2 melts were so oily the leaked through the box.
