I have submitted a form online and tried to contact the store directly. I just wanted to share our experience on here so that others are aware of the level of service and quality of food they might receive. Hopefully the owner has a chat to the staff about quality control. We understand mistakes happen but last night was disgusting and disrespectful to us as consumers.
Ordered garlic bread today saw the hair. Worst service ever.It was cold when I got the delivery at work

- Delivery was pretty quick but team member completely ignored the delivery instructions I specifically requested - Found a nail / a screw in my pizza (see pictures). I was in the middle of chewing it when I noticed there was something rock-hard so decided to spit it out just to find out it was a nail / a screw. I’m just glad I didn’t end up swallowing it

When I went there to pick up my customer order, he told me it would take five minutes. I waited for him. After waiting for ten minutes, it still wasn't ready, and I told him how long it would take. He said it was coming. While he was talking with another Uber Eats driver, a lady gave me the pizza. When I was about to take it, he asked for my Uber bag, and I said I had it in my car. He rudely asked me to bring the bag when I had already seen him not ask for an Uber bag from another Uber Eats driver who came before me. What is going on? He was so rude and didn't know how to value others' time. I had other orders too and couldn't waste more time waiting for it. I had already asked him when I came insi de how long it would be; if he had said it would take more than ten minutes, I would have canceled it. Anyhow, I canceled the order because of his rude nature and bad behavior.

Nice friendly staff, value for money when you order using a coupon..A delicious cheap meal to feed a large group of hungry people. My order was prepared accurate,fast and tasted yummy.recommended to all,limited free parking Next to the store plus a liquor store and diary beside it.

The gyros were incredible. If you are visiting here, then you need to give it a try. The flatbread is beautifully chewy and hot. The lamb tastes amazing and is perfectly cooked. The starters were delicious and summed up what makes Mediterranean food so good. Just really simple dishes cooked well. The service here is exceptional. Everything is done with a big smile and very friendly. The only thing that held it back from being 5 stars for me was just some consistency in the food. The pizza was OK, nothing particularly wrong with it but we've had a lot better. The chocolate cake we had for dessert tasted like it was pre-bought and wasn't worth the price we paid for it

It is a must-try restaurant on the north shore and the hospitable boss and lovely staff always bring you happy hours. My friends and I really enjoyed the yummy food (calamari and tiramisu are our favourites), warm music and cozy photos. Thank you for helping us unwind every time!

Enjoyed this place, lots of seafood variety and other tasty dishes if you want something more conservative. I’d recommend the dry marinara pasta, lamb cutlets, scallops and lamb gyros. The local gin also paired really well with all the dishes. Good service as well!

We had a generally positive dining experience at this local restaurant. The portions are incredibly generous, and the prices are very reasonable. It was our first visit, so it would have been helpful if the waitress, who appeared to be quite young, had taken a moment to introduce the menu. My husband ordered the signature dish, which was impressively large but could have used more vegetables for balance. Overall, a great spot for those who enjoy hearty portions and good value.
I have not had such good food and such excellent service for some time in Auckland. I will be a returning customer. Well done to the team if they see this message.

From the moment I stepped into Pattaya, I was greeted with a welcoming atmosphere that made me feel right at home. A smiling female staff member welcomed me at the entrance with such warmth and friendliness — truly living up to Thailand’s reputation as the “Land of Smiles.” The service throughout the evening was absolutely exceptional. The male staff were courteous, respectful, and genuinely attentive, always ready to assist with a gentle tone and a kind demeanor. Whether it was offering recommendations, refilling water, or checking in on our table, everything was done with grace and care. The food? Authentic and delicious — bursting with traditional Thai flavors that brought comfort and joy in every bite. But what made the dining experience truly unforgettable was the hospitality. It felt like being hosted by people who genuinely care about your experience. If you're looking for more than just great Thai food — if you want to feel the true heart and soul of Thailand — Pattaya is the place to be. Highly recommended.

We thoroughly enjoyed the set menu this evening. Set in a quaint and tasteful authentic setting, Pattaya Thai does a great job of bringing delicious Thai food to Auckland. The entrees and mains were very tasty and I appreciated that rice is included and provided when needed, rather than tiny little pots that other restaurants provide. The hostess was lovely, knowledgeable and had a wry sense of humor. Price-wise, at $29 for a full entree, main and dessert, we really felt like we were getting a good deal. Thanks guys!

First time trying this place after moving into the area. Ordered a hot red duck curry takeaway. Took about 15 minutes. It was so good! Lots of vegetables, a whole breast cut up on top and actually spicy! Came with rice so very well priced for $24, especially for the duck serving. Woman on counter super friendly. Will be back!

NEW OWNERS Although I have always been satisfied with the food at this restaurant. In my opinion the new owners have definitly improved both the quality and presentation of the food being served. The serving size of the meals are now very good value. Certainly recommend you give this place a try. I like this Thai restaurant. Been here many times and have had takeaways . It has a very good menu. Food is good The eating area is basic but OK. Th7e staff here without exception have always made us very welcome. I think a little overpriced for the size of the meals. But I definitly think its worth a try. 1
We have been for dinner there that was great.So amazing how to cook very delicious you. We will be back again love Pattaya thai cuisine Mairangi bay

Terrible today. Oil is too old, saving money by not replacing it when due? So the potato fritters and fish batter were just thick oily and brown, and full of oil. I couldn't even taste the fish due to the oily thick brown batter. Makes me feel sick a bit. Fish was small, doesn't bother me, potato fritters small, but cheap, that's ok, hot dogs small, a bit rubbish but ok, chips were ok, But when you are being served oily brown batter that's thick and full of oil that's dominant and taking away the pleasure of having fish and chips, it's truly awful. I've had so much better from this shop in the past. What is going on? Is it that they are trying to save money by not changing the oil and using it way beyond when it should be changed? DaveH, Mairangi Bay.

Judge for yourself- one lot of chips ($5) and one snapper ($8) as pictured. Portions (in my opinion) on the smaller side for the chips, but the fish was well portioned. The shop was nice and clean, very open- open kitchen lots of space to sit or stand to wait for your takeaways. Overall good experience. And the beach being just across the road.

We placed an order over the phone, they said it’d be 20 mins until the food was ready. We arrived 20 mins after the call, waited a few mins and asked where our order was. They hadn’t started it yet and it was at the back of the cue. They said they were going to prioritise it. We left and went back after 10 mins, asked again and they still hadn’t started the order. When I asked they said maybe another 20 mins. Once we got the food, we left, got to our destination to find a few items of our order missing and ‘replaced’ with other stuff, without communicating it to us. The fish were very nice but the lack of communication was very disappointing. I understand that they don’t want to turn customers away but just be honest and say a realistic time.
Nice takeaways if you want fresh fish! Nice vibe, good food, friendly service. Can't complain. Over all very nice takeaway shop.
Very delicious fish & chips 🤩 asked for grilled & they ask flour or not, catered well for my wheat allergy. Aioli is delicious. Highly recommended. Chips perfect size for 1 hungry belly 😁

Nice service and friendly staff, didn’t have to wait very long and it was dinner time so that was awesome. VERY tiny shop fits 3 sitting and 2 standing so not wheelchair accessible. Beautifully cooking and AMAZING size pieces of fish. Yummy salty, crunchy chippies. And good chip scoop sizes. Definitely would go back, I’m keen to try the deep fried Mars and Moro bar. Nice and close to the beach.

Great chip portion sizes, the fish and chicken fried rice were great. For $26, we got 2x fish, 2x scoops of chips and a decent size fried rice... pretty damn good if you ask me! The store front is tiny so people are often squished in and then wait for their orders outside. Kitchen area looked clean and the cashier was very friendly. Will come here again.
Delicious . Hotdog. Good . Sweet and Sour prok. So good. CHip good . WAY Better than fishieries Lol . Peter Chicken seal of approval. Best eats in Mairangi Bay
I ordered the combo. It was quite salty.

So busy tonight, being a public holiday, many other takeaways closed. I have been here many times. Great stuff, fresh and yummy. They did great under pressure. They were prepared and did really well. Way faster than thought it would take.

“Located right on East coast Road, Royal Indian Cuisine is a gem! Their goat chicken is absolutely fabulous, full of flavor and perfectly cooked. The staff members are very friendly and have a great nature, making the experience even better. A must-try for anyone who loves authentic Indian food!”

Extremely disappointing experience. This was the worst chicken curry and garlic naan I’ve had in New Zealand. The curry had barely any chicken pieces, and the naan was undercooked and doughy. To make things worse, the customer service was terrible—unhelpful and indifferent. I wouldn’t recommend this place to anyone.

Chef Chandra’s butter chicken was delicious! The chicken was tender and well-cooked, and the sauce was rich, creamy, and full of flavor. You could really taste the spices without it being too spicy. A great dish, highly recommended!

Ordered pizza, briyani and curry. Service was spot on and the food was really good. Extremely tasty. My family thoroughly enjoyed our food. We will absolutely be back again. Highly recommend people try their food.

I used the buy one get one deal from Doordash today and ordered 2 Butter chicken portions ($47) + 2 garlic Naan ($11), and was charged for $37.40 after the discount. Only ONE garlic Naan was delivered, then I called and checked with the store and was told there was only one Naan ordered! Attach the screenshots of orders here as evidence. Not only that, the portion SIZE was super disappointing. There were a few piece of chickens in one portion as if it was 1/2 of normal size. We usually buy takeaways from your store and we pretty know that your normal portion size is really decent. Please if you wanted to make it economically, don't do these kind of promotions like this. It's going to badly affect your business if cutting down the portion size and making the wrong order!

The food here was absolutely delicious, and the staff were very attentive and friendly. The only small downside was that the meat portions could have been a bit more generous, considering the price. The Pina Colada was slightly bland and lacked the creamy texture I was expecting. That said, this place is still one of my top Indian restaurants. If you’re in the area, it’s definitely worth a visit!

Had a great experience dining here and enjoyed the authentic Indian food. Customer service was also decent. Portion sizes were a bit on the small size but everything was so delicious and would definitely come back.

Zero stars! Basically it was a deconstructed or “put it together yourself” wrap. My husband thought we had the wrong order when he received it from the delivery person at our door because it was weightless. The foil and cardboard tray it came in weighed more then the contents. The bread was hard, the chicken raw and the salad was horrible. Waste of $37.70 (excluding the delivery fee) It was inedible and went into the bin. Why do these guys have such a high rating? Most people trying out new places go off of ratings, as I did, and most times the experiences are good but these guys are shocking. Come on peoples…be honest! So, I am going to do you all a favour and say “For the love of God… look elsewhere” Your welcome.

Waitress was lovely. Ordered the $35 steak medium rare. It came out rarer than rare. Pretty much just thrown on a grill for a few seconds. Told them that was not medium rare and they came back with overcooked steak. I was with a young child who was getting impatient so couldn't wait for attempt 3. Don't have steak on the menu at $35 if your chefs have no idea how to cook steak to order.

Something went wrong with our order... the Butter Chicken sauce was like a bad tomato soup. Highly acidic and absolutely no spice that resembles a curry. So disappointing and a waste of money. We have ordered from this place before via Uber Eats and the quality was way better!
Food was fresh and cooked perfectly. Price-to-plate ratio was balanced. Generous portion of the wagyu eye fillet. Service was efficient and staff were friendly too. Spacious dining environment.

I recently dined at Mairangi Japanese Cuisine and had the pleasure of being served by Hannah. Their service was exceptional! Friendly and Attentive: Hannah was incredibly friendly and attentive throughout our meal. They were always there when we needed something, but never intrusive. Hannah was clearly knowledgeable about the menu and was able to answer all of our questions with ease. Service was efficient and professional, ensuring our dining experience was smooth and enjoyable. While the food was delicious, it was Hannah's excellent service that truly made our dining experience memorable. I would highly recommend requesting a table in their section. I was so impressed with Hannah's service that I had to ask for their name to include it in this review.
Always a great meal here. The lunch Bento box's are amazing, the Sesame Broccoli and the salad are equally good. Quiet spot but always impresses.
Extremely fresh sashimi selection, yum!
Nice & quaiet restaurant. Small and cozy. The food quality was great. Portions are enough for 2 people if order rice on side. Just a bit pricey

Thanks to my children’s school, we got to know about this pizza place and I’m so glad we found it, even if a bit late! From the very first bite, we could taste the freshness of the ingredients, with their delicious aromas standing out beautifully. The crust was soft and chewy, giving it an amazing texture. We truly enjoyed it with our kids. 👍 I highly recommend this pizza place! Wishing you continued success and hope you stay around for a long, long time!

My favourite place on the shore to get pizza from, and arguably their best branch! The pizza is always incredible, they use the freshest ingredients and I love the bases. The best staff, service and my go-to takeaway spot. I’ve tried almost every flavour and you can’t go wrong. 5 stars always!!!

Calimero Pizza is a hidden gem! The pizzas are absolutely delicious — thin crispy base with fresh, flavourful toppings. You can tell everything is made with care. The staff are super friendly and the service is quick. It's a great spot for a relaxed meal, whether you're dining in or grabbing takeaway. It's one of the best pizza places on the North Shore for sure!

Pizzas are great! Great selection to choose from and always popular on our house. Service is good too - can be a bit of a wait. Not really much of a dine in establishment, vibe a bit too small & restrictive for that - but great for takeaways and convenient that you can have them delivered too.

The staff was super friendly and gave me a solid recommendation when I wasn’t sure what to order. The pizza itself was really good, especially for the price I paid. Super value for money and I'm definitely coming back again!

I was in a rush and I called them first to ask them to cook my food in advance before I arrive. They accommodated me well. When I ordered, I asked for the sauces on the side. Due to a miscommunication between the staff, they put the sauce on my food! I called about the issue, and they immediately apologized, explained the situation and offered to remake the food for me. I appreciate them caring about the satisfaction of their customers. The food was good.
Smells delicious walking past so had to go in. Tastes amazing and awesome staff and very friendly. Tastes as good as it smells and would eat it all day every day

My to go place on my lunch break! The food is always fresh and delicious. I do love their kebabs. The owner and the lady are the nicest too which make it enliven more enjoyable. Highly recommended, you won't be disappointed! Thank you Bay cafe and kebab
Incredible food! I had the chicken on rice and my mum had the falafel kebab. Both were so fresh, fast, and yum. We’ll definitely be back.

Really really delicious lamb kebab wrap . Great flavours . Beautifully tasty lamb. Delicious outer wrap . Well done . We will be back... and back...and back . A really welcome addition to the Mairangi Bay food scene that deserves every success. Spotlessly clean and great people . A fair price too.

I’ve eaten here several times now and the food has been consistently excellent. The staff seem genuinely passionate about what they do, and it’s always a really pleasant experience visiting. I just wish more people knew about this place.

Authentic, tasty , good value . Another outstanding lamb kebab wrap tonight . I hear the burgers are pretty damn good too . World class in Mairangi Bay and a real asset to our local food scene. Lovely people and immacutately clean food prep areas.
Really nice mixed meat on chips. Service 5 star. Great food. Great cx service. Worth a visit

Lively little cafe with a bougie crowd, really lovely staff, decent coffee and an interesting selection of Vietnamese and European food. We had the Vietnamese pancakes, the flavours were good but I found mine to be far too greasy. I love Vietnamese pancakes and have been on the hunt for a good one - these were just so oily I couldn’t eat mine. The staff kindly refunded me. I felt bad about it but you gotta be honest.

Perfect way to warm up on a chilly morning with a delicious pho noodle soup, the pickled garlic and chilli was a treat. Delicious coffee. Service was amazing, friendly helpful staff. Busy vibrant little place that I highly recommend.
Great kids corner, fantastic coffee and lovely service. So welcoming and clean
Food was good, though I've had better Pho elsewhere. They have a small kids area which was ideal for our kid. Staff was friendly and welcoming. Was very busy.

Absolutely love November Cafe! Their delicious food is authentic Vietnamese, and service is always outstanding- warm, attentive, and with a smile. A huge shoutout to Daniel, the owner, who brings such a vibrant, friendly energy to the place. He always makes us feel welcome and chats with genuine warmth. It’s also super kid-friendly, which makes dining out as a family so easy and enjoyable. November Cafe is hands down one of our favourite spots—highly recommend!

We had fish, chips & potato fritters with wontons - it was superb. Fish was moist and fresh and the batter was light and tasty. Wontons were delicious, and the chips & fritters were golden & crispy. The portions were also huge, so much so we couldn’t finish it all! We will be back!
Absolutely love the food,not greasy like other places great service and atmosphere is good and they are always busy.
Ordered a bacon and egg toastie it was burnt and uneatable and 2 hot dogs were ok
The twin brothers are always watching. Beware! No paywave or credit available. Amazing fish and chips. Bit of a wait but worth it
The fried fish and chips r so fresh and delicious! We ordered the special pack~ Better to call and order first!

Always wanted to come here, and I really wanted to try their beef wellington bit it's only available during dinner times. Gorgeous restraunt, love the layout. Customer service is excellent, really separates.other restraunts with service like this. Chicken and bacon linguine 9.2/10 The ratio between chicken, bacon, parmesan, and sauce is spot on. Great balance and a great lunch. A slice of toasted garlic bread on the side would have been a good addition. Overall, I am very happy to pay for this again. Must try. Chocolate cupcake 6.5/10 Sweet tooth would love this. Cupcake was moist, and icing was too sweet for me. Next time, i will come back for the beef wellington. Love this place.

Visited the café for lunch on Saturday for the first time, and we had to wait sort time to get the table. It is a big cafe with large outdoor areas, both covered and uncovered. The staff is very friendly and helpful bit we had to wait a bit longer to get the food. The food was great and worth the wait. When going that way, this would be a place to stop for a meal.
Lovely coffee & wide range of choices for food and drinks! The restaurant has great seating options :) pictured is the chilli eggs and the Buddha bowl

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ “I checked this restaurant; everything is okay. Give it a go—5 stars! ⭐ But if you want to know more details about my experience, read my extended comment below.” Extended Review 📍 Location & Ambience – ⭐⭐⭐⭐☆ (4/5) The inside of Black Cottage Café is beautifully designed, with a warm and cozy feel. The china plate wall decoration adds a unique touch. However, the exterior of the café doesn’t quite reflect the quality inside—it looks a bit messy, which slightly affects the first impression. 🍽️ Food Quality & Taste – ⭐⭐⭐⭐☆ (4/5) The food was above standard—tasty, well-prepared, and visually high-quality. I had a bacon and egg panini wrap, and I appreciated the way they prepared the egg: the white was fried separately and placed on top of the bacon, while the yolk was placed underneath. The cheese was perfectly melted, and the bread quality was good. The coffee was decent—good, but not outstanding. 👨‍🍳 Service & Staff – ⭐⭐⭐⭐☆ (4/5) The staff are not the most outgoing, but they are responsive and attentive. Each section of the café has its own attending staff, and overall, they did a great job. I worked there for about an hour and a half, and they maintained good service throughout. Free water was provided, and I could see that they were well-organized in their roles. 📜 Menu Variety & Pricing – ⭐⭐⭐⭐☆ (4/5) The menu offers a good selection, and the pricing is reasonable. I spent $18 for a coffee and a bacon and egg panini, which felt fair for the portion and quality. ✨ Cleanliness & Facilities – ⭐⭐⭐☆☆ (3/5) The café itself is clean, but the toilets, which are located outside, could definitely be better. By New Zealand standards, they are acceptable, but they could use more attention to cleanliness and maintenance. 🐶 Dog-Friendliness – ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (5/5) A big plus is that this café is dog-friendly, making it a great choice for pet owners who want to bring their dogs along. 💡 Final Thoughts Black Cottage Café is one of the nicest cafés in the area. If you’re in Coatesville, Riverhead, or Dairy Flat, this is probably your best option. The café has free internet, making it a great spot for catching up with friends, family gatherings, or working remotely. If I’m in Coatesville again, I’ll definitely visit this place.

What a splendid eatery this is. Having a great selection of food combined with friendly staff always makes for an enjoyable time. The fact that your pooch can join you during lunch makes it easy going. Well done, Black Cottage Cafe.

One of the best Thai restaurants in Albany, having its own parking. 😁 Went for lunch and had a chicken lemongrass, and crispy pork belly. Both dishes were very good...Tastes quite authentic. The place is very spacious from the inside, and has got a good fine dining arrangement. Pretty affordable as well. Highly recommended.

My 85th birthday celebrations took place here, very busy restaurant, service was very fast, I was astonished, we all enjoyed our delicious food that was hot and tasty! I would recommend the Khun Pun as a place to go for a nice quick meal, lacked a romantic setting and more family oriented! As the kids loved it! Thank you Khun Pun very enjoyable. Arthur C Charlton west Auckland NZ

Our recent visit to this gem was made even more special as our friends, who have been dining here for over two decades, chose it as the perfect place to reconnect. The atmosphere is warm and inviting, with just the right balance of authenticity and comfort. It’s clear that Kun Pun has perfected the art of creating a welcoming space where every visit feels like a celebration. We started our culinary journey with the Chef’s Special Combo Starters, which were a delightful medley of flavors and textures. Every bite was perfectly crafted, showcasing the chef’s skill and creativity. For mains, we couldn’t resist trying: • The Snapper, cooked to perfection with a crispy skin and tender, flavorful meat. • The Squid, which was fresh, tender, and seasoned beautifully. • The Chicken dish, bursting with rich, aromatic flavors that left us wanting more. • The classic Pad Thai, a standout dish with the perfect balance of sweet, savory, and tangy notes. Every dish was a symphony of flavors that highlighted the restaurant’s commitment to quality and tradition. The presentation was impeccable, and the service was attentive without being intrusive. To complement this feast, we had Cold Thai Tea, which was refreshingly sweet and smooth—truly a perfect way to round out the meal. The service was attentive and friendly, and it’s clear why this restaurant has such a loyal following. Kun Pun Thai is more than just a restaurant; it’s a place where tradition, taste, and hospitality come together to create unforgettable experiences. Highly recommend this spot for anyone craving authentic Thai cuisine in a welcoming atmosphere. We can’t wait to return!

Nice Thai restaurant with a good range of different dishes. However, food was a bit disappointing. Tom Khan Goong was OK but not outstanding, Mhon Thong was very average and bland. We ordered the Hot Basil with Prawns and the Snapper with Ginger and Garlic as mains and they were both bland. Service was fantastic. We will go back for a second chance.

Kuhn Pun Thai is our favorite restaurant. Staff are great, host is delightful and the food is absolutely fantastic. Always trying hard to find another local restaurant to go to but end up here time and again as we know it will be superb.

Hi there, as you do not have an email address for communication, I would like to check with you on the price of vegetarian butter paneer. It's $20.50 on your menu but I paid for $5 more. Was there a mistake? I hope to receive a reply from you soon. Thank you.

Went last Sunday first time for Buffet breakfast. Food was good and fresh. Service reasonable as it was empty but would have still appreciated the staff to check in on dosas and puris. Considerably expensive $25 for the food options available. More like a south indian buffet. Other buffets elsewhere have a lot of variety for that price. 2 chutneys Dosa/idli/vada sambhar 1 potato vege 1 chole Rice 1 Dessert (was supposed to be kheer I believe but we didnt like it as it was runny) They dont do alacarte for lunch and that was disappointing but again it was our first time there.
I had a great meal with my friend. We enjoyed the food a lot. The owner was very friendly and accommodating, and the food was served quickly. I would definitely go back here again in the future.

I have come here a few times now, and everytime the staff is extremely friendly, and the service is excellent. the food always comes out so quickly. I wish I could rate this this place higher than 5 stars because the food is just amazing. I definitely will be a regular here!

We are sharing our disappointment with the service we received during our visit tonight. We had originally placed an order for takeaway via phone, as we had travelled from over three hours away. However, when we arrived at The Spice Rack we decided to dine in, unaware that there was a price difference between takeaway and dine-in orders. Instead of handling this matter discreetly or explaining the policy politely, the owner abruptly stated — in front of other customers — that we couldn’t dine in due to the price difference. We found this approach to be unprofessional. We understand that policies may exist, but the way the situation was handled left us feeling uncomfortable and unwelcome. We expected a higher standard of service and communication. We can always pay the difference if it was explained to us nicely.
Food was delicious, especially the dumplings. Relaxing quiet atmosphere nice decor/setting, toilets could be cleaner with an automatic fragrance spray.

Got food from them last night and it was truly disgusting. The quality of the ingredients was so low, it was actually ridiculous that they charged money for it. It was like something a drunk student would cook from the lowest quality ingredients. I am ashamed of myself for buying this.
Great vibe, food is delicious! Language can’t describe how good the dumplings are - we’ve finished them before taking the photo!

Food is ok but extremely slow to come out. Not worth the wait you have to endure. The establishment is super clean, looks amazing and has a great atmosphere. Their slots room is also top notch with a variety of games, 3 main jackpots and 1 SuperGrand. Hence the 5 star atmosphere.
Bit surprised when after buying a jug of Tokyo Dry for $38 between 2 people, you don't even get 2 glasses each. Now bear in mind, buying by the glass is $8 each. Do the sums...

It was okay, the people were nice but unfortunately when my friend and I went there today the cucumbers were mouldy and makes you question the sanitary conditions there, as you can see with the picture that was the cucumbers today.

Not the best of rolls. Very soft and the whole process was so rushed that the subway ended up bit of a mess. Very minimal of the salad toppings. The quality and quantity is just not there. Certainly doesn’t look anything like the advertisement on TV. Same as the last few times. Very disappointing. They need to be retrained.

C’mon Subway! This was my first and last time ordering food from this branch. I felt like I owe something to the girl who was taking my order. She barely listened to what I ordered. I had to tell her that I want my salad to be spread evenly. She didn’t put all the salads I asked for and I had to repeat what I want three times. She was so angry that I felt I owe her something. I am sure you have no idea how to run a business here. Please hire some one with a little bit of customer care skills. Horrible experience. Poor quality. Please do not ruin your day with this guys. It was 13 Feb at 2:40 pm not even late!!!! C’mon Subway.

It's a great experience. The ambiance is very welcoming & charming. Amazing service with fresh salads . Staff are extremely knowledgeable & make great recommendations. Their catering option is great . Had mine ordered couple of weeks back and my guests loved it .

Such a bloody rip off!! Last week I ordered a wrap , the wrap and the wrapping paper somehow merged and could NOT be pulled apart so I only had the inside of the wrap. Left to to forgive and forget , today I just wanted something nice and this is what I got, pathetic.

We had a table of 5+ and they were able to accommodate for all of us and bring food within a reasonable time frame, staff were friendly and patient. Atmosphere was welcoming, cozy, woody atmosphere. Everyone seemed to enjoy their Meals from margarita pizzas to pork belly bites. I on the under hand decided to test my might and have the chili oil noodles(spice warning) although delicious and well seasoned, it’s not for the faint of heart haha) the food portion sizes were not my favorite choice, but maybe that’s just me being used to bigger portions. recommend coming here if you want a chill dinner

I really like the ambience and the service, however the sashimi dish wasn't nice, the tarakihi wasn't fresh and the combination of flavours put me off. The shared platter also had a weird mix of flavours also. But I did enjoy the Rosebud cocktail, Id give it a 9/10

Just had a lovely date night out. Our food was delayed, The order was taken promptly, but for some reason the order on the iPad never made it to the kitchen. Obviously, this can happen! We were very surprised when we were comped a side order of fries and drinks to make up for the wait. The wait was worth it, the food was amazing 👏 and we will definitely be back. Highly recommend 👌🏽 Thanks The Merchant Pub Co keen to try other dishes on your menu.

Nice spacious restaurant located in Westfield Albany mall. Seating arrangement available both indoor and outdoor. We ordered two items from the mains, for lunch - lamb rumps and pork ribs. The pork ribs was pretty good (well cooked), and the sauce was decent as well. The Lamb rumps unfortunately looked amazing, but were not properly cooked at the core. The meat felt quite raw at the centre, to be honest. Among drinks, the long island iced tea was pretty good and refreshing. The hazy pale ale was also quite decent and felt mouthful with a bit fruity flavor. Have visited this place earlier as well; will definitely visit again. Good vibes

I met a friend of mine for lunch. First time visiting this pub. Loved it. Fantastic customer service. Relaxing, environment with well thought out decor. Bathrooms worth a mention, very clean and lots of stalls. Loved the food!!! We shared a pizza, mac n cheese bites and truffle fries. I'll be back!!

Absolutely love this place! The burgers are always fresh, juicy, and packed with flavour — definitely one of the best burger spots around. A special shout-out to Joel at the counter — super friendly, efficient, and made the whole experience even better. You can tell he genuinely cares about great customer service. Will definitely be coming back again. Highly recommend!

We came on a Sunday night at 9pm and it was a clean and a cozy atmosphere. The restaurant was clean and we were greeted promptly and a few friendly voices. Joel and Vincent looked after us and were friendly and polite and very helpful Our two boys aged 14 and 13 enjoyed the food which was excellent and would love to come back to the Albany outlet again You have a great team at Burgerfuel Albany We will see you again Thank you for your excellent service

Great Service & Delicious Burgers! Had an awesome experience at BurgerFuel today. The food was fresh, tasty, and perfectly cooked — exactly what you'd expect from them. Shoutout to Cameron who served us — super friendly, helpful, and made sure everything was spot on. Great customer service makes all the difference, and Cameron definitely delivered. Will be back again soon!

Haven’t had a sit down meal at Burger Fuel for ages but decided to chill at the Albany store. The staff were fantastic. Service was very good without being too in-your-face. Food is always good at Burger Fuel as well.
Great food and service from Noah and Cam! Always greeted through the door will a smile and good energy. Must be a hotshots with ladies! Will definitely pop back in soon.

Food:(4/5) It’s rare to find an authentic Shanghainese restaurant in Auckland, but this one truly delivers. The pan-fried buns were a standout: crispy on the bottom, juicy inside, and so good that my partner couldn’t get enough. Don’t miss the Yellow Croaker with fermented Cabbage Noodles, the fish was tender and packed with umami, though the broth could’ve been richer. The Pickled Mustard Greens with Pork Tripe Noodles were a knockout: tangy, savory, and deeply satisfying. Braised Beef Offal with Radish, an absolute winner! The beef tendon was melt-in-your-mouth tender, and the broth was rich and aromatic. Service: (3.5/5) Friendly but slowed down during peak hours. A bit more attentiveness would’ve elevated the experience.

Very very good 👌👌 What a wonderful restaurant with so many beautiful dishes and a great atmosphere. Very fast, friendly and efficient service too. Every single dish served hot, fresh, all the meat were super tender and full of flavour. The portions are huge and very reasonably priced. We will definitely go back

DON’T GO! Not worth it. The place was almost empty and the food was really bad. My family ordered a nearly $30 ribs dish and it was basically just flavoured bones with barely any meat and came in very tiny portions. Definitely not coming back.

Great food, great service! We ordered the sliced beef in chili oil, the stir fried chicken in kung po sauce, salted egg yolk shrimp and sweet and sour vinegar pork. All the food was tasty and delicious. The highlight was the sliced beef in chili oil. It was a large dish with glass noodles on the bottom, sliced beef with sichuan chillies in a chili oil broth. Soooo good and mouth numb spicy! The salted egg yolk shrimp was a highlight as well as the sweet and sour vingar pork. The pork was tender and tasty. The chicken kung po was cooked well and tasty. Overall, I highly recommend PinYue Shanghai Style. I’m looking forward to our next visit and to trying more dishes!! Superb!
This place is always packed, so better book ahead! The food is still good, but watch out—two out of the four dishes we got had hair in them. Not the best look for hygiene!

Dear The Owner of Kohinoor Indian Restaurant, I visited your restaurant for dinner with my boyfriend yesterday and was very disappointed to witness inappropriate behaviour from your kitchen staff towards a delivery driver. We saw that the food was already prepared and sitting on the counter. The driver politely asked one of the chefs to hand it over, but the chefs refused, stating that it wasn’t their job and that he would have to wait for the waitress—who was actively serving us at the time. One of the chefs even yelled at the driver, telling him to either wait or cancel the order. It was shocking, especially since the food was already ready and right in front of them. This kind of behaviour is completely unacceptable in our community. We try our best to support local businesses, but we cannot support a business that treats people—especially hardworking delivery drivers—with such disrespect. I hope you will look into this matter seriously and take steps to ensure this doesn’t happen again. Sincerely, Justine

The food is always delicious. Every dish is a new experience. I gave 4 stars because both the lamb Breyani’s that we bought felt like we were only eating rice. The meat is always on the sparse side when ordering takeaway. We lived in Albany for 10 years & supported this business from the beginning . We now moved South so this meal was a supposed to be treat for us. Feeling disappointed.

We order curry from them all the time and it’s never been anything but amazing! Tonight I accidentally ordered pick up rather than delivery and they helped me rectify it over the phone with ease! They also generously gave me a free side of Papadums due to the confusion! I wish I could give them more than 5 stars! A very reliable and delicious stable for our household!
Have been coming here for 10+ years, great food every time
This is our absolute favorite Indian restaurant in Albany and the local area! Our family have been coming for two decades and never had a disappointing meal. Delicious food and lovely staff. 10/10!
Service was good, drinks came out quickly, food not long after. Steak could have been a bit hotter but was perfectly cooked and tender. Didn't have space for dessert this time but we'll be back.

The staff were friendly but the service was slow. Husband and I made a reservation, were sat with no problems. Given menus, waited maybe 10mins after water was brought to us for a waiter. Ordered drinks and a starter (Garlic bread). Garlic bread, for the size of the loaf I expected more garlic. Bread was soft with crispy outside, was good but not enough butter and garlic. Ordered our mains, waited over 30mins. Asked about our food wait time, to be told 5mins but ended up waiting a further 15mins. I could fully understand if the restaurant was packed but the inside was practically empty. Husband ordered Lasso Hog (something like that), uh that was disappointing. It was dry and crumbled on his plate. Meat is not supposed to crumble. The portion was big but the meat was a let down. I ordered New Porker. Was supposed to be a pork belly with crispy crackle, pumpkin mash with a pine nut crumble. What I got was a pork belly with a burnt dry crackle and no nut crumble. The pine nuts were under the mash. The dish lacked flavour. There was no seasoning on the dish. The staff member we had was apologetic, he gave us complimentary chips. The one dish I did enjoy, was the salt and pepper calamari. That I would order again, the other two dishes are a no from us. We would come back to Lonestar but order something else.

My 10yo son and I love coming down for dinner every now and then, he always has the ribs and loves them every single time! My chicken was slightly burnt on the outside and would have loved more of the mushroom sauce but overall it was good! Our waitress was awesome, timed the food perfectly with my sons being faster than mine. Always a lovely experience, thank you ❤️

A go-to spot for casual birthday dinners and overdue catch ups. A nice variety of seating options from booths, to half booths + chairs and covered outdoor dining. The food here is never a let down! The best garlic loaf in the whole city and I’m quite the garlic bread connoisseur 😂 although it takes some time, the steaks are always perfectly cooked and the ribs are delicious and never skimping on portion size. Good selection of steak sauces and it’s ideal that you can always ask the waiter/waitress to swap out any sides as I’m not the biggest fries person and usually prefer a soft creamy mash with my meats. Have yet to try the desserts but have heard very good things about them! Quick tip: download the Lonestar app and make sure to collect your receipts as you pay the bill. Scan the receipt code on the app and get rewards such as credit towards your next meal.

Staff were very attentive, food came out very fast and it was amazing, a great selection of drinks and very easy to follow the menu at a fare market price. It has a really nice indoor outdoor flow and they played great music to match the scene of the restaurant, would definitely recommend this place.

The best value for money place for a quick bite and most importantly it's healthy and nutrious. This is my first visit and I have been referred by one of my friends who is highly talking about Sunny and her quality fodd. Really happy for the food and great service. See you again

I didn’t have high expectations for the Eggd burger, but it completely blew me away. The buttery, pillowy brioche bun was perfection, slathered with a generous amount of rich sauce. The egg was cooked flawlessly, with a gorgeous runny yolk that tied everything together. Absolute heaven in every bite!
I go to Pita Pit, Oteha Valley on a regular basis. Sunny is warm, polite, professional and always provides good service. Her food is of a high standard, and always tastes good.

First time having Pitapit - walked in just before closing and was greeted with a smile, the staff member made me a delicious wrap and asked about my day. Service was fast and friendly and food was very super tasty. Fresh ingredients well presented store clean and tidy
Food is always fresh and the Pitas are always well made. I would rate this the best Pita Pit in the country (I have gone to many).

Horrible service, the maori lady at the service counter kept doing other orders.when asked she rudely responded I have so many orders to do.the Asian girl kept washing dishes. Nobody took our order for 10mins. We were not told about wait time. When asked I was told you can have refund. What a pathetic service. They should be serving customers not doing whatever. Definitely not coming back!!!!

You guys need to employ more staff honestly feel so bad for the girl working here, she’s working her ass off while atleast 10 people are waiting for their order. She looks stressed, as I would be too. Not a good place to work especially if you are the only one rostered on for the busiest day of the week. I don’t mind waiting over 20 minutes for my smoothie but some people might, just employ more then one person and then that’s the problem fixed

Went during a quiet time(Saturday morning 10am). Service was pleasant and efficient. Ordered two beef Thai salads and two juices and all was ready within 10 minutes. Taste of salad was fresh and well seasoned. Juice was also very tasty. Worth a go if you are after a good meal
Pretty easy to order, kiosk screen, although only 1 of 2 kiosks was operating. A few chairs, parking, not crowded at midday Sunday.
This is our go to place for fresh juice. As always they are clean and fresh. Not much to say about them!!

Had an awesome first-time experience at Daikoku Albany with 3 adults and 2 kids. The whole teppanyaki setup was super fun – the chef was entertaining, and it made for a really memorable night out. The food was delicious and freshly cooked right in front of us. The kids absolutely loved the whole experience and were fully engaged (and even tried new things – bonus!). We do feel it’s a bit on the expensive side, but the overall experience, quality of food, and great service made it worth it. A really cool spot for something a little different.

Daikoku Albany, even with its largely expensive menu, provides a favourable quantity of food for any given meal - making it easy to over order in price and in amount. Even with this, the quality being put out by highly specialised chefs is phenomenal and definitely superb as a different taste of Japanese food in Auckland. Since everything is served in front of you, they provide quite a spectacle in the making with large maintained fires that char perfectly your order. Therefore cuisine provided by this establishment are worth a second or multiple visits to try its different culinary offerings that are equally satiating. That is, however not to say this restaurant went perfectly for us. We found service for water very slow even if we were the only customers at the time, as we constantly needed to be topped up due to how the food is made which makes a desire for water perpetual. Additionally, we found the sides such as sashimi and edamame underwhelming comparing to the quality being served everywhere else. That is not to say that the rest wasn’t fantastic because it was, if not too much food for us. As a whole however a fantastic restaurant to try, which works best with large groups in which you can fill up a whole table for yourself. Booking is recommended.

Hi guys, Very impressed with the food... I tried fish, steak and chicken as well as scallops and they were all GREAT. The theatricals of our chef was not over the top and the flavour was spot-on. The restaurant atmosphere was great, the staff were very polite and friendly and the prices were ok for the experience you are getting. I Highly recommend it, check out the pics and videos.

We came here for lunch. Booking was easy via their website. The floor was greasy from all the open plan cooking and posed a slip hazard. The staff were all so polite and friendly. We enjoyed our two lunch sets and the different courses. Thank you
Always amazing. Chefs all have their unique performance while cooking. A huge amount of food with the entrees included in every meal. Recommend the prawns as they are fat, juicy, and delicious

You guys suck. I was there on Saturday. I parked there and bought food from you. I got a parking ticket for $85 for staying 11 minutes longer than said parking time. I was there supporting you, buying your food, eating your food, and still you want to fine me for 11 minutes. You won't see me again.

After three times of disappointment of order finally writing review. We really enjoyed this place and people are so friendly. This is our most visited MACD and we never have any dissatisfaction of food or quality served before. Sorry guys you need to be careful about wraps and burgers specially night time you may tired we too and we are spending money coz we need little rest after our late night dinner. Giving food with love and care is most important we can’t accept what we saw past three times. Before never happened like this. We love Macd Albeny and we need our community shop grow more and get more business.
Very disappointed to the quantity of this Mc Flurry. Such a huge difference comparing the real product to the advertised virtual product.
Clean bathroom, fast service, and friendly staff. There was even someone celebrating a birthday — such a nice atmosphere!

I come regular to this Macdonalds and every time is very good. Miriam the cleaning girl is a delight! She makes sure everyone is happy and cleans everything. From the top to the bottom I’m happy with staff and service. 😊

Such a disappointed experience. We went to KFC to get dinner, asked the staff can we get 3 drumsticks in each box, the staff said yes. Once we got the food, we double checked with the staff, he said yes, drumsticks are inside. We drove away and checked the food. There are not even one drumstick. We went back to ask, the staff refuse to exchange and was very rude. The staff blame on us held up the queue, as we just asking for the food we ordered. Eventually they exchanged, thanks for the car behind us helped us to talk to the staff. We got home, see what we got with $52, scummy chicken pieces, broken oily box, the food is so disgusting, we can't even eat. We went all the way back to the store, wait in the queue again then got the refund eventually. The manager is very nice, apologize and refund The money. However the whole experience is so bad. The staff who taken the order and handed over the food do need more training and just give cx what they order, it's not that hard right? Not going to KFC albany anymore, ruined our whole night.
I visited last night. Albany branch's staffs are always friendly and smiling 😊 I feel good every time I go. The food is also delicious. Thank you🩷

I had a Sunday takeout from Albany store - and this time the wicked wings packed were all burnt and tasted weird. Since my loyalty lies - like a sane human I do not open the order to check (trust kfc for their quality) and to my surprise the wicked wings here just “bad quality”. I have attached the images - they were brown, tasted burnt and the krispy texture was just falling out. I am not sure if they re-fried the stock lying around or what. But due to this I had to sleep with half filled as this was my bad dinner and money to waste. Please consider a compensation!

16/8/24 Tonight we went through Drive thru, the service was horrible, the worst I’ve even had. The servicer took her sweet time taking one order at a time and she was rude. It took us 30mins in line to get to the speaker to place our order then when we reached the speaker to place our order she said we had to wait again because she could only take one car at a time. Finally placed our order and then went to pay, I asked “why is it taking so long?” She said again “I can only do one at a time.” She walked away and come back my order no smile, no thank you or sorry about the wait, just here’s your order. After waiting about 50mins for our food. I got home (20mins away) and the chips and zinger had been tampered with as it was salty AF!!! The burger just didn’t look right, either!! The prices for KFC is ridiculous and to have our food tampered with and to wait so long…. Of course I was pissed me off!!! DO BETTER KFC. MANAGERS DON’T PEOPLE WHO CANNOT HANDLE THE PRESSURE OF FAST FOOD SERVICE ON DRIVE THRU. Give your staff proper training!

Food is good, but service was very disappointing. Cashier was unfriendly and made us wait a long time for our food with zero communication. Items were also forgotten- they have forgotten items three times (and twice in a row), which shows the lack of care they have.

not overly busy but have to wait more than 20min for my 1burger 1fries meal. i asked stuff to check where is my order. it took 3 people to find it, 2 of them went to do other things instead. it eventually comes, but in a bag, the staff seams never care about what has been ordered. the chip is old and soft. i should have go kfc instead.

The lady on the drive thru window was really bubbly and lovely to chat to. Food was great, not greasy, nice hot chips and didn't have to wait long. Downside - my drink wasn't very good. Their drink machine needs calibrating I think

Ordered a cookie dough milkshake - was given an Oreo milkshake. I told the staff of the mix up and asked if we could get a cookie dough one. Staff insisted the milkshake I had was the cookie dough one. But it was white with black specs and the photo of the cookie dough milkshake is a tan brown with no black specs at all.

I don't know what it is with this brand but they have always just run out of something. I was looking forward to trying the bacon and truffle sauce burger. Had the portobello burger instead. Food, great for it's genre, Service was great other than the mentioned issue. Atmosphere, loud. Turn the music down a notch. We were yelling at each other seated.

Filipino guy is absolutely useless, I always order the deals and upgrade fries to cheese chili. Every other carl jnr I been to have had no issues doing this. This guy wouldn't and told me they only upgrade fries to regular or large with combos. Utter rubbish, I could see his level of understanding wasn't worth my time explaining to him. Get better staff with a can-do attitude to minimize simple requests made difficult. Won't be back here for sure.

Just a heads up to any Vegans, this is how much cheese that extra $1.70 will get you. Also, the extra beans I paid for was maybe 1 tablespoon. I'm not sure why they would be so stingy on ingredients when there is an extra cost for it.

I always enjoy my meals at Zambrero Albany, the food is always very tasty - their selection of meats and sauces are awesome. The staff are also exceptionally kind and friendly. Would definitely come here again. 🙂

Used to love it a lot. It has been multiple times a lady messes my bill and charges for what’s already included twice. That was when I didn’t forget to check. Not accurate wrapping and overall food handling lately. Come on guys, you can do better.
Great place. First time visiting. Loved the nachos (yes, they're Gluten Free), with beef. We're really delicious and the small size was perfect. I'll definitely go back.
Cecilia makes the best burritos in Auckland! The team is always so cheerful and friendly. Quality and cleanliness never fails to impress! 10/10

Salad was dryer than the desert! I asked for more dressing and showed them how dry it was and they asked if I looked in the bottom of the bowl and refused to give me another drizzle without paying for it! Absolutely ludicrous and the manager was so rude about it!! See nothing at the bottom of the bowl 🙄

Sometimes the smoothies here are awesome! Unfortunately today’s smoothie felt like a very watered down and icy power plant…. Why is it they nail it sometimes and don’t other times? This in particular made me think that if this was my very first tank smoothie - I would never order tank again.

Visited tank for my daughter, waited 25 mins for a single smoothie. Oddly, people who ordered later got served before me. My Caribbean smoothie was more like a banana shake, and the cup was only half-filled. When I raised this, was told they're short-staffed, but noticed 3 people inside, and only 1 was working. Disappointing experience. Hope for improvements.

Unfortunately, I couldn't find an option to give a zero-star rating; otherwise, that's what I would have chosen. I'm genuinely shocked by the poor quality of the salad. It didn't resemble the wrap I typically enjoy for lunch at all. Frankly, I feel like I wasted my money. I couldn't even taste a hint of chipotle. I had to return the wrap after a couple of bites, and the replacement was even worse. 😂😂😂 I ended up tossing it in the bin after just two bites.

This branch of Tank is so disappointing. I always get Gorilla Green and they made something else this time! When I reported it, they refused to admit the mix up. This is my regular drink and I am sure they forgot green shot in it. It’s disappointing how they behaved in response. Avoid this branch! Big No from me.

On Saturday, February 8th, my daughter and I dined at your restaurant around lunchtime. We both ordered teriyaki rice meals and sushi. Everything was fine until we were almost finished eating. My daughter suddenly became shocked and upset. She had discovered a dead fly/bug inside one of the soy sauce dispensers. I was very surprised and disturbed, as I certainly didn't expect to find an insect in a condiment container. I brought this to the manager's attention. She stated that the condiments are regularly changed and cleaned. However, the soy sauce bottle appeared to be quite old and in poor condition, with numerous cracks and a discolored, whitish lid. My point is this: company management needs to be much more mindful of health and safety standards, especially when it comes to food handling. It's unacceptable for customers to receive food, or in this case condiments, that are below standard. This incident raises serious concerns about the restaurant's hygiene practices.

The sushi was very nice and tasty. St Pierre’s Sushi in Albany is a reliable spot for fresh and tasty sushi at an affordable price. They offer a good variety, from classic salmon and tuna rolls to teriyaki chicken and vegetarian options. The service is fast and friendly, and the sushi is always well-prepared. Whether you’re looking for a quick takeaway or a light meal, it’s a great choice for sushi lovers in the area.

Today at noon, I visited this sushi restaurant with the intention of ordering a bowl of ramen. When I asked if they had ramen, the Asian male owner responded with a visibly disdainful expression, stating that they never serve ramen or udon, and even suggested that if I wanted ramen, I should go to another restaurant. Left with no other options, I ordered two boxes of sushi. While I was eating, I noticed that at the table across from me, an Indian man and a white woman were enjoying steaming bowls of noodles. This situation made me feel quite uncomfortable and led me to wonder if I was being treated differently because of my background. While I can't definitively say if this was racial discrimination, I certainly felt unhappy. I won't be coming back to this restaurant again.

Was charged double but was promptly refunded the next day after I found out and spoke to them. They apologise very sincerely too. I just need to double check before I paywave in future. Lesson learnt. Both salmon and chicken sushi was fresh and yummy.

Clean restaurant with friendly staff. Lots of options to choose from including chicken, fish, and veggie options. There is a fridge of beverages to purchase and additional seating in the back. The sushi I wanted was not available but they made it quickly for me and it was delicious. No complaints here. Additional notes.. limited parking on site, may have to park in the garage around the back .

Really impressed with the quality at Pizza Hut Albany. The pizza came out fresh, hot and just how I like it crispy base, generous toppings and great flavour. Staff were friendly too and the service was quick. Definitely one of the better Pizza Hut experiences I’ve had. Will be back!

This is a regulation Pizza Hut franchise store selling the signature Pizza Hut menu items. The location is easily accessible. Parking can be an issue on busy times and days due to being shared with other shops in the complex. The service times are normal and one has to wait for 10-15 mins for picking up the food. Delivery is available too. The staff are nice and welcoming. Limited seating is available in the shop and one has to prefer a takeaway and sit elsewhere. Well recommended overall.

Have had pizza here couple times and have always thoroughly enjoyed it but today received a pizza where two and a half slices had no toppings?? Fairly disappointed makes you wonder if it went by unnoticed or just didn’t care

I had a great experience ordering from Pizza Hut, Albany ! I called to place an order, and the staff were super friendly, patient, and helpful over the phone. The pizza was delicious and arrived just as expected. Great service and great food — highly recommended !
Ordered Vegetarian got pepperoni...Pizzahut Albany branch. Not happy at all.
It's one of the best BKs I've ever been to very clean and well managed. Food was prepared well and served really quickly. Great staff.
A couple bites into our food and ugh honestly so bad. We thought oh just a bad bite but nooo! Tasted like fish. Absolutely foul! Off to the compost bin it goes.

Possibly the best in Auckland thanks to the staff. Sat 12.30pm in particular a polite young man working hard alone on the counter under busy conditions. It is amazing the quality difference between branches my Rebel Whopper seemed to have lots of ingredients and tasted great.

Fake promo, they don’t allow customer to use the voucher and blaming their head office. And left the customer at the counter without providing any solutions. Keep telling me to redeem the voucher online which they cannot find that option in their own app. Update: I’ve emailed their customer service, waited for a week then they just simple replied “We did raise this with our digital team who have been fixing issue with the app when they arise. Our apologies for your experience in store and thanks for letting us know.” Great customer service, good job Burger King.
One of the best BKs I have ever been to. Didn't have high expectations. However the food was served quickly an even was still warm. Absolutely fantastic

Took my wife for Mother's Day with our two kids. We had to seat ourselves. Zero service. My kids had to get us water and menus (it was not even busy at that stage, 12pm). We eventually had to order on the app as no Coffee Club staff even acknowledged we were there. Drinks came relatively quickly to be fair. But the food took - literally - hours. And only came after I complained. We had to sit and watch 4 x new groups come in and get their food before us. Including having to watch the Coffee Club staff sit and have their own lunch. So bizarre! When our food eventually came, my wife's came last - very late (we were all just about finished ours) - on Mother's Day! Food was ok. Staff told me that I "need to understand that different food takes different amounts of time to cook". Really? Hours? For a starter calamari for my wife? Pancake for my son. Burger for my daughter. And omelette for me. All standard items and no doubt pre-prepared to some extent anyway. Terrible service Coffee Club Albany. Zero acknowledgement of being slow and unresponsive. Zero effort made for moms on Mother's Day to make them feel special. And - unless there is some sort of recourse - zero chance of getting us back to a Coffee Club based on this!

Grade A!! Ordered Smoked Salmon Eggs Benedict $24.50 But upgraded to the Potatoe, Garlic and herb Rosti for extra $2.50 Love love loved the Hollandaise Sauce and Rosti was delicious! Eggs were perfectly poached and was super fulfilling. Staff was great and the place was super clean.

Went there 2 weeks ago for a afternoon snack, was really good, the place was quiet and staff was friendly. Good quality food aswell as their iced coffee is very good aswell. Had the Gluten-free Tacos with cheese, very tasty. Anytime again also nice sitting on the sheltered balcony. Cheers

A very bad experience. When my partner and I waited 40 minutes after ordering, I had to get up and go to the kitchen to ask if the food was ready and ask for a refund. The response I got was that it was cooking and needed another five minutes to finish. Ten minutes later I was disappointed to get a stick together of chips and a cold boiled egg.
What are these? Not as advertised and not what I have received at other Coffee Clubs. Supposed to be the chicken tenders. They were so greasy that i could only force one down. Waste of $25.

We always order the dumplings with spicy sauce – they’re soft, tasty, and one of the kids’ favorites! The noodles are also really good. The broth is flavorful, the noodles are chewy. Definitely worth a visit if you love noodles and dumplings! 🍜🥟

Great price for what you get- in flavour and portions! Spice is their game, ergo, choose your hotness level wisely! A confined space, so not really ideal for big groups. Parking and toilet are available. They have on-hand & online menus. Each table has a QR code when you're ready to order. You choose and pay online.

Eden Noodles is a must-visit for spice lovers, especially during the chilly winter months. We tried the pork noodles and dumplings, and both dishes delivered a perfect punch of heat and flavour. The bold, numbing spice left our tongues tingling in the best way possible. If you’re a fan of authentic, fiery Sichuan-style food, this spot hits the mark every time.

Excellent food. Probably the best wonton soup I have had. Good staff and very accommodating to our needs For a Monday lunch the place was extremely busy. A sign for me they are popular and a to place to visit
Fast service and super good food, so many flavors and a wide range of options. I've been here once a week for the past month and they never disappoint.

The place is not that big, if there is a couple people it can seem a little crowded. The famous dish all-in-a-pot seafood is great, love it, although hard to eat when all the prawns and scampi needs to be de-shellled, but they've cut one side of it to make it easy for customers. Not much side options on the other hand. Recommend the Fried pork on a stick, very tender and tasty~
Choice of seafood pots that cook in front of you. Also choices of rice dishes such as black pepper beef,kang po chicken. They were out of pork sticky buns and of a main. Needs air con in summer

The main dish of this small but well lit restaurant is the seafood platter in a metal tub about 1 meter long. There are different styles like steamed and spicy to choose from. Total of 12 types of seafood including fish, crab, prawns and shells. Best to wear the gloves provided to prevent the fishy smell from staying too long. Reservations recommended.
Nice seafood and friendly service, very impressive!
Nice seafood,great taste

Amazing food, absolutely top staff. Easily the best coxinha I've had both in NZ and in Brazil! Beef pastels were perfect, so so good! Live music was good, and wasn't too loud. Plenty of different options in the menu so we have plenty to choose from next time!

What a hidden gem in Albany! Absolutely loved our visit - everything from the warm vibes, live Saturday music to delicious authentic Brazilian foods! Highly recommend this cafe and we can't wait to come again:)
A hidden gem! The food was well-seasoned and the waitress did an amazing job and recommending what to get. Definitely coming back again to try the other menus!

Was really excited to come here and try Brazilian food given the good reviews but ended up really disappointed and feeling scammed. I ordered the feijoada and for $32, the portion size was tiny. There was one little piece of rib in the soup and a few pieces of sausage, other than that, three half slices of orange, a little bit of salad and some pork crackling that was too tough to eat. I was looking forward to the award winning coxinha and ordered both types to try but both arrived cold and the filling was so dry that it needed to be slathered in sauce. My partner got a sandwich and said it was just ok, nothing special. The whole meal ended up costing $76, which was way too much given the size and quality of the food and after trying Brazilian food here, my partner thinks he doesn’t like it. The service was also not the friendliest. We sat down and weren’t served so I thought we had to order at the counter but the owner(?) seemed annoyed and told me to sit back down and wait till we were served. It was also extremely busy with people at the tennis centre that day and it just wasn’t a relaxing or nice environment to be in. Definitely will not be going back.

Friendly staff, get ready to be served well - no nasty looks or attitude when you ask for some accommodation or change - it feels like the entire team LIKES and are proud to work there, it’s hard to explain. You got to experience it. The food is divine, great prices, hearty and nourishing- a typical Brazilian experience. I totally recommend it!

A Culinary Experience Beyond Compare! From the moment I stepped into The Albany, I knew I was in for something special. The ambiance was warm and inviting—an effortless blend of elegance and comfort. Every detail, from the soft lighting to the vintage setting, set the perfect tone for an unforgettable evening. Starting of with the food which was absolutely divine. Each dish was a masterclass in flavor, presentation, and creativity. Every bite burst with bold, balanced flavours that danced on the palate. I got incredibly generous amounts for everything I ordered. The steak was a standout, but truthfully, everything we ordered was phenomenal. Service was impeccable. Our server was attentive with great knowledge and recommendations about the menu, and genuinely passionate about making our experience exceptional. Even the drinks exceeded expectations. The wine selection was impressively curated. And don’t even get me started on the dessert. The Chocolate Mud Cake is definitely a must order. The chocolate cake was pure bliss, deep rich chocolate melting on my tongue creating a sweet ending to a perfect meal. Five stars aren’t enough to express how great this restaurant is. Highly recommended!
Our group loved this place. Every dish was a winner. The staff were great. The place itself is nice inside, but a bit too small.
The Albany is the quintessential kiwi pub, but with next level food. I had the surf and turf on Turkish bread. The 200g scotch filet and real calamari, muscles and prawns melted in the mouth.

Big sprawling relatively traditional pub. Great outdoor seating area, good tunes, nice staff. The food is on the expensive side - I went in to eat and could not bring myself to park with $30 for a pub pizza. It’s got your classic sticky floors, sticky menus, furniture that’s seen things… but a lot of history and heart. I wouldn’t trust a cocktail here but a lovely pint of Guinness and a good chat in the garden - bang on.

We went to this place for a meal and thoroughly enjoyed it. The service was so good. The food was beautiful. The seating was bar stools on high tables. Okay, for younger customers. But that is not their fault. Lovely all round.

Absolutely love the food here! I always get the quesadillas and eat it all up every time. The service was also great, the staff were attentive and fast. The interior is nice and clean, just in the day there are a lot of wasps inside especially in the sunny areas near the windows.
Dined here on a Sunday night. Was a quiet spot to have a decent feed. Ordered the variety of frozen cocktails and small share platter as pictured.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Our recent visit to Mamaloco Mexican Restaurant in Albany was an absolute delight! From the moment we walked in, the vibrant atmosphere and warm hospitality set the tone for a fantastic evening. Our servers, Tahjai and Marovot 🤍🙏 were nothing short of amazing. Their genuine smiles, attentive service, and infectious enthusiasm made us feel right at home. They went above and beyond to ensure every detail was perfect, from recommending the best dishes to keeping our drinks topped up without missing a beat. The food was bursting with authentic Mexican flavors—fresh, zesty, and perfectly spiced. The mamas fried chicken were highlights, and the quesadillas were spot-on! Tahiti and Marovot’s personalized touch elevated the entire experience, making it one to remember. Mamaloco Albany is a gem, and with servers like these two, it’s no wonder why. Can’t wait to return!

Writing this review before I leave the restaurant. THE BEST mexican food I have had in so long. Ordered jalapeño poppers and jackfruit tacos. The filling in the tacos was amazing, the jackfruit was very well flavoured. Definitely will be regular here now.. love it!
Great vibe. Friendly staff, Margot served us today and was able to accommodate us warmly :)

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ I always have a great experience at this Domino’s! The staff are friendly and welcoming, and they prepare the orders quickly without compromising on quality. The pizzas are always fresh, perfectly cooked, and loaded with toppings. The store is clean and well-organised, and pick-up is always smooth. Definitely my go-to spot whenever I’m craving delicious pizza. Keep up the great work!

Sarum * apologies if I spelled that name wrong but the man provided a great respect while preparing my food. 5/5 ⭐️ He was operating by himself so during busy times it would help having more people on deck ! Respect

I recently ordered pizza from Domino's in Albany, and I wanted to give a special shout-out to Sarabjot. The pizza was absolutely delicious! You can really tell the care and effort he puts into making it. Great job, Sarabjot—keep up the amazing work!

This place used to be decent but I see they have changed owners recently. Won’t be coming back. A bunch of kids laughing/joking around. One even coughed while dealing with someone’s pizza! No effort put into making the pizza what so ever! They taste so average. I asked for thin crust and didn’t get it. Also there was no pizza sauce on the base of my supreme?? The other pizzas we ordered were drowned in sauce and some parts burnt. None of them were properly cut either. Please train your staff how to make pizza! Waste of money

Shoutout to Sarb, So sorry if I misspelled the name but always amazing service from this guy, always kind n pizzas always slap idk if he’s making them specifically but yk hahaha. This store used to be a bit rubbish a few years back but their new roster of staff fixed all those issues. 10/10 guise
The food was great and so fast. The waitresses seemed overwhelmed at times, but cared well for all of their clients.

5 stars all round. The atmosphere is beautiful and relaxing. The service was quick and efficient. The food was AMAZING, this is my second time eating at this restaurant and I will definitely be coming back! I have tried the pad Thai, Tom yum, green curry, squid tentacles. The portions are massive and the prices are very cheap. I make the mistake of ordering entrees and can’t finish my main. The pina coladas are genuinely the best iv ever had and only $10!! I live on the coast but make the journey to Albany because it’s worth it :)

Love Thai Rain Forest! Food 10/10, Service 10/10, Experience 10/10, Prices 10/10. You really could be in Thailand when you are in this place. Been with the hubby and kids many times and will always be back. Highly recommend 👌

We got takeaways tonight and safe to say this place is a hidden gem! It was quiet in the restaurant but it was lovely and cozy and I'd definitely dine in next time. We got the pad thai, penang curry, roti, and curry puffs. Everything was delicious and authentic and not overpriced! Super happy and will be back again.

Great service. Did not have a booking on Valentines Day. However, they got us a table within 5 minutes. The restaurant was quite busy. Drinks and food were delivered promptly. Great menu with selection. Portions were good size and well priced. Excellent attention by staff. Will visit again

The food was really good. I got the butter chicken combo, and it tasted nice. The staff were friendly and helpful. There are lots of tables and chairs, so it’s easy to find a seat. You can order veg or non-veg food.

Absolutely loved the food here! The flavours were authentic and everything was fresh and well-prepared. The staff were friendly and made us feel welcome. Definitely one of the best Indian food spots on the North Shore. Highly recommend the mango lassi! Will be back for sure. 😊

For lunch today, I enjoyed Lamb Madras and Chicken Tikka Masala, and it was fantastic. The flavors in the curry were perfectly balanced. Whenever I'm in Albany, I plan to try every dish at least once...

Typical don't give a shit service So it's been a few months since my last, I thought I would give it another chance. Sadly, service is still shit, prices up dramatically. Servings have got smaller All sauce, no chicken.

Honestly this place has gotten so much worse with its portions but when the lady is having a good day she will fill up your little bowl to the brim! They’re pretty generous with rice, but the little bowl they put the curry in is a little small and pretty shallow.

It's a brunch therefore less people during weekdays. Great costumer Service, the lady is friendly and accomodating with a smile. Food is scrumptious too for my brunch. I did choose 2 selections, how I wish that big bowl of 2 selections will be 3 selections then the medium bowl will be 2 selections. Overall food is great. I highly recommend this branch.

Well taken care of when ordering, pretty easy process with nice helpful staff when choosing what goes into your bowl. Food is pretty good but all pre-made stuff so it's as good as quick mall food will get.

It was my first time having katsina today.. the steps to order was very simple and very creative. I was able to create the perfect bowl I wanted with salads choices, rice and meat choices.The food was stunningly delicious! The best chicken I ever had. And the staff was very friendly and patient. Love the work environment! Definitely recommend and will be a regular customer!!! 😍😍🤤🤤

Tried Katsubi for the first time at this store and I wish I had it sooner. The food was fresh and deliciously prepared. The serving size (with toppings) was perfect for a quick and filling lunch. The staff were all genuinely friendly and helpful. 10/10 can recommend!
The chicken teryaki tasted like sugar, and the crispy spicy chicken was way too bland. The portion size is good, but it’s not something I’d like to buy for myself ever again.

I wasn’t expecting the best, but I believe doing your best is the least you can do. I didn’t make a complaint because I understood it was a busy time, but what should I have done differently next time?

Online order machines were occupied mine malfunctioned so I waited for service over the counter! Staff saw me but failed to acknowledge my presence as I attempted to advise them machine doesn't work may I place my order. Got tired of waiting no one came to assist!
