Resulted in my buying food elsewhere! Short staffed & letting customers walk off is unacceptable & serves no purpose other than loss & disappointment! Despite this unfortunate situation I trust establishment will improve customer service best experiences practices 🤔

The lady today on the tills was awfully rude. She was standing around as no one was in line. There were quite a few people so weird she wasnt doing anything. I had been waiting TWENTY MINUTES for a frozen coke which was insane and eventually i had an appointment which was about to start so i said could you please make it super quick im super sorry and explained my situation and she gave me a dirty stare and said wait like everybody else was hich i found rude anyways she kept standing there doing nothing while the drink person was on his phone texting. Terrible service.

Ridiculous service…i waited more than 20 minutes yesterday because the guy in the grey shirt and the girl in the red shirt at front were too busy laughing and walking here and there ignoring all the customers standing at front to order. I was standing near the coffee machine and there was a weird guy who was laughing so loudly (hurted my ears) was so unprofessional i am assuming he was one of the worker..Mate focus on service not laughing we’re waiting from last 20 minutes..ridiculous service never coming back here…i wish i could give no stars

The meal was slow, because the child loved Minecraft, so he bought the children's meal, but the toys were not Minecraft. I asked the staff and said no, but there was no announcement in the store that the toy was gone, and if I had known, I would not have ordered the children's meal at all.

I placed an order on the official website for **12 Chicken Classic sandwiches** with **home delivery**. However, due to staff negligence, only **6 Chicken Classic sandwiches** were delivered. **Additionally, I paid for a double portion of Tuna sandwiches but received only a single portion. The entire order was incorrect**, resulting in significant overpayment. My family was waiting for the meal, and after communication, the store refused to either deliver the remaining items, issue a refund, **or compensate for the errors**. Instead, they insisted I pick up the remaining items myself. The delivery fee was significantly higher than pickup, yet I ultimately had to collect the order myself, and they provided no resolution to the issue. **I urge the manager to contact me immediately to resolve this matter fairly.**
My family and I visited your store today; we found it clean and well-maintained. Avani provided excellent and helpful service, demonstrating a positive and welcoming attitude. 💙🤩💙

This Subway has really bad service and really bad food. When I got home I opened the subs and realised they weren’t even toasted as that is what I asked for. Not only it wasn’t toasted, the meat was frozen and was not enjoyable especially for spending a bit of money there. The cookies are also stale. The lady there obviously doesn’t like her job as her eyes were rolling the whole time. I even said “have a good night” when I got my food but no reply and a cold attitude. I’m never going there ever again.
I regularly drop in or order Uber Eats and the team here are really consistent. Food always tastes great and the service is quick efficient and friendly :)

Service from the lady serving us was sub par. She wouldn't let me choose my vegetables and rushed the interaction even though we were the only customers in the store. Also they've shrunk the bread to fit less ingredients. This is not the subway I grew up loving.

Best taste of Taiwan that I know about as a Taiwanese person. It would be good if they cleared the tables as soon as people finished rather than left them there, but other than that I like coming here. The stinky tofu is very authentic.

Overall, I had a great experience here. The family who owned and worked it were great and they had a passion to serve and connect their food to the Albany community. I had hit out and find it good. It was unique flavors and spices as I am used to Sichuan style. This was much more mild and tame in comparison. The ingredients were good and fresh. I would return.

Come and support these guys! Great service and some good wholesome Taiwanese food! We had the stinky tofu, traditional Tainan braised pork on rice, braised beef noodle soup, 3 sauce chicken and the soy bean paste with mince noodle dishes. The stinky tofu was tasty and was served with Taiwanese pickles and a side of chili oil sauce. The traditional Tainan braised pork was delicious. Great flavors. The 3 sauce chicken (3 cup chicken) came out in a sizzling pot and was also delicious! The braised beef noodle soup is one of their signature dishes which was flavorsome….as with the soy bean noodle dish. Highly recommend, come and try some great Taiwanese dishes!

This restaurant has so much potential and honestly they should be so busy. The service is great. The food was pretty tasty, they have this chilli oil to die for its so delicious. They should jar it and sell it 👌 My only suggestions, the restaurant was a bit cold and the music was more suited to a spa than a Taiwanese restaurant. We highly recommend this restaurant and we will definitely go back again

Had such a lovely experience dining here. If you’re craving classic Taiwanese dishes, this is the best by far, in Akl. The stinky tofu was similar to the night market offerings in TW. Other classics we tried were beef noodle soup, 3 cup chicken, pork braised noodles etc. Delicious! Service is great too. Will be coming back again!

The lady was very snappy on the phone, but she seemed to be a little friendlier when we got there in person… Took a photo of the updates menu because damn have their prices gone up! Was not expecting to pay $75 for the amount of food we got… And the fish pieces were less than impressive

Aright, it was my own fault as should have turned round when I saw the paint job on the front door. Taking pride in how a business presents itself is a fairly good indicator of quality from my experience. However I entered and ordered chips and sausage. Customer service was horrific, there was no thanks, the look from behind the counter was one like “you are bothering me, go away!” It was unbelievable. If the door was bad the inside was even worse. Adding up the cost, I could not work out why I was charged so much. Did not want to say anything incase something happened to my order. Food was ok but I now know why the only fish and chip shop in Albany is vacant for much of the time, even on the weekends... be warned, do not walk through that overly painted door....
Does this photo look like gurnard and chips for $10.50 to you?! AND asked for a spring role but got given a curry role! Called to complain, got told "no way, I write down!"... useless

They used to be good. Tonight the chips were soggy brown and awful and the fritters were way over cooked. It tasted like an old order had been re fried. The chips were so soggy we threw them out. We started eating them in the car as we drove home, so its not like they got soggy because they were in the hot parcel. If it wasn't heavy traffic we would have taken them back. Truely awful.

My favorite tucked away fish & chips shop in Albany Village. Family run business, and the owner knows me by name since I've been there so many times over the past 6 years. Can't go wrong with whatever you order from here! And also love the drink options from here too.

Very poor quality meat - this was the lamb salad and it looked like dried up pieces of tinned dog food. Definitely not fresh, and very disappointing to get old, processed squares of chewy "meat" when expecting tasty, melt-in-the-mouth Turkish lamb! The salad was nice, not sure about the sauces as they didn't all match what was ordered. I hope they improve the food quality as they're in a great location with friendly staff.

Food is tasty and the guys are nice there. Large size is a real large. The homemade desserts at the counter are satisfying (especially the chocolate flavour ). We took a long time to order the first time and the guy at the counter was patient. Little space neat and clean.

I ordered Chicken AND Chips, but was given chicken on chips – not what I ordered or expected. It was processed chicken bits dumped on unseasoned fries. When I politely asked for a refund and reordered the correct meal (which cost me another $21.47 on top of the $18 I’d already spent), the response was, “Take a cold drink to compensate.” She also kept trying to force me to take the wrong order, even after I clearly said I didn’t want it multiple times. As for the food, the chips were okay but needed more seasoning. The chicken was very dry and lacked flavour. Really disappointing experience overall, especially with the way the mistake was handled. Won’t be coming back.

Just had my second visit to Juicy Grill, and I'm absolutely blown away! I've frequented many kebab joints, but today's mixed kebab on rice was simply outstanding. The portion was substantial, tasted beautifully and the addition of two breads and the side mix was a delightful surprise—I've never experienced anything quite like it. Working local, I can confidently say Juicy Grill will now be my top choice. Plus, the owner is incredibly friendly! Thanks a bunch, mate! See you again soon

Disappointed :/ maybe all the good reviews are for other staff and/or food items? Ordered the vege burger, onion rings and a thick shake ($28.50) The guys English isn’t great so hard to understand what’s happening. I pointed out a pricing error programmed into the till that gave me a $1 discount so he cancelled the payment, fiddled around on the till for a while and then charged me the extra $1 🤦🏼‍♀️ you’re welcome! Didn’t take long to get the order but I’d say that’s mostly as I was the only one there. The menu has no info like what’s in the burgers and ordering was hard enough so wasn’t going to bother asking. The burger making starts in the microwave 😬 the patty seemed nice (except soggy in the middle) but couldn’t taste anything over all the sauce on the top and bottom buns (some kind of clear goopy relish 🤷🏼‍♀️) that just dripped everywhere as soon as I bit into it - I’m all for a messy burger but this wasn’t pleasant. There’s not much to the burger at all (patty, lettuce, tomato, red onion and the same goopy sauce top and bottom). Doesn’t compare well to other takeaway shop burgers (ie BurgerFuel’s V8 vege is only .90c more or Northcross Takeaway does a great vege burger for $10 and it’s huge and way tastier!) Onion rings ok but just the generic processed frozen kind you can get at the supermarket. Shake was pretty good. Overall wouldn’t try again - the burger was unpleasant to eat and overpriced for how basic it was :/

Very disappointed and utterly unacceptable. Their Facebook advertises that they open at 7am. I sent a message to confirm that they open at 7am and it was confirmed. I was there today at 7:15am and they were closed. There is no update or notification on their Facebook to say their hours have changed. Google Maps say they open at 10:30am, but sometimes this information is wrong and I got specific confirmation from the owner about opening time being at 7am. I came 40 minutes (one way) just to find their doors shut. I don't know why they would lie to their customers and falsely advertise their hours.
The kothu was delicious + my parents went in for the buffet and couldn't stop raving after about how it was some of the best Sri Lankan food they've ever had. Would highly recommend!

Visited DishCo at Dairy Flat Highway and had an amazing experience. The food is truly authentic – it really felt like eating back home in Sri Lanka. Every dish was full of flavour, and the service was warm and friendly. Highly recommended for anyone craving real Sri Lankan cuisine in Auckland!

Lovely little gem that provides all the tastes and flavours of Sri Lankan cuisine. They are family owned business that has just started with reasonably priced dishes ranging from meals, beverages and desserts. Have try of their lovely range of dishes and even their buffet menu.

Me and my husband went for a late lunch yesterday and they had a wonderful Sri Lankan Buffet. Food tastes amazing and they had a typical Sri Lankan menu which we both loved. It felt like a hearty home cooked meal which transport you back to your roots in Sri Lanka. It’s a family owned business and the hosts were very lovely. Definitely recommend and will go again with friends ❤️❤️❤️

Terrible service. We had one of the worst dining experiences here. We ordered pork leg soup, but the waitress brought us chicken feet instead. When we asked about the mistake, she blamed us for not using the exact name from the menu—despite the order being clear. The most ironic part? The owner was training her on how to take customer orders at the very moment we ordered. Definitely won’t be coming back.

This is our first time eating at this Chinese restaurant, and the experience has been terrible. We were served spicy food, and none of us were able to consume it. We literally tried to finish it, but we couldn't. We enjoy spicy foods, but what we were served was inediblely spicy. The staff even told me that in their Chinese culture, this food is not at all spicy, and they REFUSED to refund us the money we paid, so it was a total WASTE of money. Another thing is that we literally removed the other meat food from the bowl because it was submerged in oil, which we literally can't eat. However, they should have been more knowledgeable about how to filter their customers, regardless of nationality; they should have informed customers that their type of spicy may not be suitable for other customers. We were offered SODA as a courtesy, but due to a lack of better communication, we do not drink soda and instead opt for water. Definitely not a recommended dining establishment. Value for Money - 1 star Staff & chef - 1 star Food - 1 star

My wife and I have always been fond of their food. The consistency between their different shops (both Dominion Road and Albany) is great. Their authenticity of Sichuan taste is incomparable. Friendly and efficient staff providing excellent customer service. Highly recommended if you haven’t tried. Dinning in taste even better than doing take aways.

We discovered this restaurant few months back. Most of the food we ordered were very authentic. My favorite is the knife cut noodles (刀削麵). We try to go there every week. It's our new favorite. Thank Ms Hu (the owner) for her warm reception everytime we visited.

Awesome family, meals and honestly cleanest take away in roskill by far, very organized kitchen highly recommended, food is top notch I ordered dumplings soup, and honey chicken noodle and kids chicken wings and chips chicken burger it was yummy fresh and delicate.
Food is average but big portion. Why I’m give a one star because I found a piece of foreign object in my takeaway noodles tonight. Very disappointed

[Update] Came here several times, although the restaurant owner increases the price a little, I am never disappointed. ================= I'd say this is the cheapest eat in Auckland Northshore ever! We ordered a roast lamb (small) $12NZD and Thai sweet chilli beef (small) $10.8. The portion is so generous, and staffs are friendly and helpful. Food tastes okay. You will need to expect the long waiting time in the busy hours though.

You can't make an assumption based on the Google review. We went to this takeaway place and tried the food. It's good. It's worth the price for sure. Roast and Twice cooked pork are always my favorite orders. Not a fan of fried chicken. BTW, sry Cruise, like your smile. Again, you can't make a judgment just by the review. Go there, try it, love or hate, your choice.

Best Value Lunch... Limited seating... Prices went up by $2 since we were here last time in Jun2019... Wol Tol Kol Yook Farn... Bor Lor Gay Farn... Beef & Scallions on Rice... Kung Pao Chicken on Rice... Pickled Fish on Rice... Mushroom Chicken on Rice...
Two dinners and two pieces of fried chicken and four potatoes for under $40. The portions is good and price is very reasonable.

Visited the second time. The flavours were tasty overall — the grilled fish was fragrant and the guo bao rou had a nice crisp. The crab roe noodles, however, weren’t quite as nice as the first time I tried them. Portions were decent and service was friendly. Cozy spot to enjoy a variety of Chinese dishes.

Super yummy! The grilled fish hotpot was awesome too, full of veggies, and all the good stuff. The broth was rich and super satisfying. Big portions, great for sharing with friends. Staff were really friendly. Will totally come back again!

We ordered the Daily Handmade Noodle with Pork Belly (Too dry), Egg in Japanese Soy Soup (Too sweet). Fried Jasmine Rice with Italy Black Truffle (Can only taste the truffle flavour), Daily Handmade Noodle Crab Meat with Scallop Paste (Too oily) and Steamed Prawn Dumplings (Pastry too thick), as they ran out of the Xiao Long Baos. Overall, the portions are big, the flavours are unique but it may not be to everyone's taste

The food here is delicious. The xiao long bao are the best I've had in NZ, juicy with a handmade shell. The special sauce for the duck is excellent, well balanced sweet and savoury flavours. It was also nice for them to serve us so close to their lunchtime closing time of 2:30pm. made up for their annoying ordering system of scanning a QR code. Still well worth going back for.

The people sitting next table is closer than people sitting in front at your table. That is how uncomfortable it’s. we were not that lucky that one of people from next table talking so loud nonstoply, complains after complains about his life. Those negative feelings flowing into your face and you could taste his sour soul. Food from this restaurant is around normal level. Crab source noodles tastes okayish, just a different from the menu a lot. Cold dish veggies is submerged in oil, refreshing however can’t take much. Boiling fish is really average, we are expecting many types of chills and spices which could enhance the flavours, however nothing more than a home made pot. I like the deco of this restaurant, big bamboo chairs and spacious table and abacus!

Really good food with some flavors that are on point. The owner is a great guy who likes a good laugh and connect with his customers. I did order Indian hot and after finishing the meal, he asked me what I thought. When I told him that I think it could have been spicier, he told me that he gave me kiwi hot. We laughed back and forth and made a whole joke of it. This food is great and the owner rocks. Give it a try!

I have made this my new regular spot for authentic Indian cuisine. The owner is very friendly and polite. I have tried a variety of the dishes and have not been disappointed in the slightest. Very affordable and most definitely bang for buck. I recommend anyone after affordable quality Indian cuisine to try Royal Indian Cuisine.

We ordered butter chicken, two naan breads, and a couple of drinks. The food was just okay—about a 7 out of 10—which was a letdown considering all the great reviews on Google. I get that people have different tastes, but it was still a bit of a bummer. What really bothered me was that our table was a mess with curry stains and crumbs, and I had to clean it myself with some napkins. What really got my attention was when the guy who seemed like the owner or manager overcharged me. (It's not hard to work out the total when we've only ordered few items) I noticed him hesitating and staring at the POS machine, which made me suspicious. I was in a rush, so I just paid the overcharged amount and didn't say anything, but it's really frustrating that this kind of behaviour happens so often. A lot of people don't check their receipts, and they end up paying more than they should. So, if you're going to this restaurant, make sure to ask for a detailed itemized receipt and double-check the charges before you pay. It is not the amount, it is the principal. Hope the owner gets to see this and rectify the issue so that other customers don't end up experiencing the same. Food was definitely above average but the service is just as important. Thank you.

Update - I believe this is the best Indian food I have had after a second order from them. We did specify garlic and more garlic on the naans and the mains were delicious. Got to be my favourite eatout at the moment. Delicious mains but unfortunately ordered 2 garlic naans and only got one that may or may not have had garlic and the other no garlic. They were completely different. Very generous size though. The other Indian restaurant close by knows how to do garlic naan! All in all a good experience and food tasty. Rice came with the curries, but couldn't find that on menu. Would have given 5 stars if naan was garlicky.

The most deep, rich and nuanced Tikka Masala I’ve ever had. Unlike other restaurants where the sauce is thin/watery - or a single note - this one was so thick you had to eat it with a spoon and the flavor was very robust and had many layers. Absolutely wonderful. I’ve eaten Indian food across the globe - California where I’m based; Bali; Iceland; and all over New Zealand. This was by far the most interesting take on Tikka Masala and Chicken 65 I’ve ever had. The garlic naan topped things off and was also excellent. The location is tucked away and unassuming, but don’t let appearances fool you. Highly recommended.

The taste of foods was just amazing. Stunningly balanced flavours. Perfectly cooked. Descent sized portions. We had to wait a bit longer than what we were expecting to get our order ready in a busy Saturday night but it was worth it. Music playback was not a perfect match with the ambient but still okay. Friendly staff. Definitely will come back.

7 adults had a fantastic bottomless lunch and bottomless drinks. Service was great food continuous nice atmosphere and food. Recommend. Edamame, dumplings, pad Thai, chicken nibbles, pork bao buns, and more continuously, desert was donuts and mochi. Drinks Mimosa, blue lagoons, lagers and quality fruit juices our table was very full and satisfied.
Delicious food, service was amazing and the atmosphere was great 💯 had the Bottomless Brunch and went with my family! Thank you for a lovely time ☺️

Gao is now officially my favorite place in Auckland. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Their bottomless brunch/drinks are superb! From the starters, everything in between up to the desserts. We enjoyed the variety and the choices. I highly recommend to get the cocktails with the brunch. The staff are all so lovely and attentive. The ambience is relaxed and the is interior pretty cool. It can be pretty noisy but i would expect that given the place is packed. Such a lovely experience, the food was divine and the friendly staff was the cherry on top. We are definitely coming back for more. :)

6 hour drive from Palmerston North was worth it with these scrumptious food. Fell in love with the place. The staff were very friendly and accommodating especially Janet and Amiel. From starters, mains, and desserts definitely hits every spot with good and generous portion of food. Cocktails and drinks were superb too! Compliments to the team…. Definitely will be back… Worth the visit 😍

We were invited to a preopening sitting. We ordered the Southern Dinner for 2 with a side of spicy chicken wings. We weren't expecting so much food! Was definitely value for money for just the two of us. The potato and gravy was so creamy and delish. We both enjoyed the Mac Cheese also. The chicken wasn't greasy and have a real nice crunch to it and those biscuits! Definitely different from KFC that's for sure. The staff were busy setting up and becoming familiar with their new roles. They were friendly, welcoming and excited! Overall we enjoyed our meal and experience at the first Popeyes restaurant that we have been to. We ended up taking half our meal home with us. All the best for the grand opening Monday guys!

Place was busy but clean. We got one incorrect item in our order but the staff fixed it quickly. Food was delicious. Apart from small details that need ironing out, it was a good experience. I feel like some of the reviews were a bit harsh. It’s a great fast food place for fried chicken and we’ll come back.

Spicy chicken sandwich an absolute standout. The chicken was fried to perfect crispiness, with a well-seasoned, juicy interior that packs just the right amount of heat. The sauce was creamy, slightly tangy, and irresistibly flavorful. The biscuit was another star—rich, buttery, and baked to perfection. The edges were delightfully crisp, while the inside remained soft and fluffy. And let’s not forget the classic Buttermilk Fried Chicken, tender, juicy, and infused with a savoury, milky richness that sets it apart from other fast-food fried chicken. The crispy coating locked in all the flavor, making each bite incredibly satisfying.

The service was shocking, we had to wait for over 20 min to be able to pay and at the end the forgot my fries. I got home and realised they didn't give the fries but they charged me for it. Burger was delicious. The spicy wings were delicious. The mac n cheese was yuck and original chicken was meh.
Terrible service, quite average chicken. The burgers are better than the fried chicken. Extremely slow service for lunchtime. All customers were just waiting and no one was getting any orders.

The beef in sour-spicy broth is **absolutely delicious**—tender, flavorful, and perfectly balanced. The seafood is super fresh, especially the shrimp and clams. The rich, aromatic soup base is the star—tangy, savory, and addictive! Plus, the price is very reasonable for the quality.

#Special hotpot# Roast fish and duck hotpot are quite tasty，not too spicy，with potatoes and vegetables. Chicken wing is the kid’s favorite one. Every hotpot is suitable for three persons and the price is reasonable.
Had a good dinner here food portion is not bad at all, best for 1 table of 10 max. Needs some Reno at the back side area as windy and rattle noise during windy days.

A very tasty shop, I love their creamy shrimp the most. It's a pity that I forgot to take a picture. This fish is especially recommended for its unique taste. love this restaurant. I will be back again.

Had their chicken with pork stomach hotpot and it was delicious! Very generous portion, a hotpot is enough to be shared between 3 people and can add vegetables and other sides after the chicken is eaten. Also loved their salt & pepper chicken wings, and was only $18.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Absolutely delicious experience at Flying Burrito Albany! We had an amazing dinner here last night. The tacos were packed with flavor and super fresh — each bite was a treat. The jalapeño bites were the perfect combo of spicy and cheesy goodness, and the chicken fried was crispy, juicy, and cooked to perfection. We also tried the Patata Bros, and wow — those crispy potatoes with seasoning were such a satisfying addition to the meal! The vibe of the place was chill and welcoming, and the staff were friendly and attentive. We’ll definitely be coming back again soon. Highly recommend this spot if you’re craving bold Mexican flavors done right! 🌮🔥💚

Service was lovely, very nice waitresses. Ordered a Chicken Chimichanga, Beef Nachos, guacamole 'n' nachos, colada and a cranberry juice. The food in both portion and taste does not match the price, lots of "store-bought" flavours. Left disappointed. Try for yourself and see, this is was just our experience. Edit: Elaboration to "Store-bought Flavors", am sure that the chef's work very hard, this was just our experience. Simply try for yourself and you'll see, especially for that portion to price comparison.
The food was AMAZING!! Traditional and flavoursome. The pineapple and braised beef tacos were next level. Staff and atmosphere beautiful. Highly recommended. 🌮🍹

Came here with my family for a Sunday lunch. The staff are very friendly and our server was lovely. Atmosphere of the restaurant is always so fun and lovely. The food came out quickly and was delicious. Portions are great for a fair price. Everyone enjoyed their lunch and midday desserts.

Took my nephews out on his birthday Valentines Day, was busy being an special event. Did get our food late, but the restaurant did extended there closing times which is good. When the food came out it was very tasty especially the Chili Con Queso cheese dip I recommend. Also the cocktails are great too, you should try it.

It’s so delicious, so delicious, so delicious. The food is served very quickly. The food is full of color, aroma and taste. The craftsmanship is really good. I’m back in Shanghai as soon as I finish eating. This is the BEST food I’ve EVER had in Auckland!!
The service attitude is extremely poor. The food is also very unpalatable. The cook has no sense of taste at all. Everything is probably pre-made.
It’s cheap and delicious. Friends in Shanghai and Nanjing say it’s authentic.

This new venue is a great addition to the area! The place is clean, everything is brand new, and I really liked the open kitchen concept. Portions are generous, the food is delicious, and prices are very reasonable. Definitely worth a visit!
Ordered some dumplings and hot and sour soup through Uber eats just to try this new place out, turns out even better than expected. Will order from here again. Yum yum.
Good taste

My favorite is the clay pot pepper pork belly soup. I always order it when I'm here; it's so warming in the winter! The wontons are also generously filled (the shrimp and pork are both excellent!). The huoshao are also generously filled and delicious. 😋 The owner is very welcoming, and the place is very clean. The prices are really reasonable, and you can tell they're a real family.
Very delicious, delicious and tasty! Affordable price, ordered vinegar pepper tofu, potato beef brisket

Tried here for the first time, the food is really nice and packed with flavour. Menu done via QR code which is a nice thing to try, unfortunately I don't read of speak Mandarin but the waiter was spot on, help me pick some nice dishes. Will go back again soon.

Came here for lunch and only us one table so service was pretty fast. The stir fry pork belly with chillies was so yum but a bit pricey for the portion. The deep fried crab with salty egg yolk was legit so delicious and I couldn’t stop eating. Will definitely come again to try other dishes.

Had sweet & sour pork, which was laid out on ice...amazing. The outside was crispy and cold, and the pork was hot, never tried it before, but recommended by the server. Also had chicken/chilli, not too hot and very tasty with prawn fried rice. Only down side was the menu was in Chinese only, but the server did a great job of explaining dishes...😋

Try out this new Asian restaurant on the north shore and really enjoy the dishes. Two of us have ordered two dishes and those are all excellent. We can tell the shortage of staff and the customer service hopeful will be upgraded.

I was extremely disappointed with the service attitude of this restaurant. When I tried to ask questions about the menu or make some inquiries, their responses were dismissive and made me feel unwelcome. To make matters worse, they seemed to have no concern for my experience, telling me that it would take two hours to prepare my order, even though there were only 1-2 tables of customers in the restaurant at the time. When I expressed my dissatisfaction to the servers, they simply responded with a forced apology and made no effort to rectify the situation. Overall, the service attitude of this restaurant was truly disappointing. I will not be returning for another meal, nor will I recommend it to others.

Cakes are horrible. They are not even tasty. I have tried Russian cakes a lot, but here Kievsky cake is dry, honey cake is not even sweet. So many times I came here before and it was delicious, but the quality of your cakes has become worse than before.

**Exploring a Russian Bakery:** **Introduction:** Discover the delights of a local Russian bakery, where traditional treats await. **Warm Hospitality:** Experience the friendly atmosphere created by the welcoming staff, who are always ready to assist. **Fresh Ingredients, Authentic Taste:** Indulge in pastries and desserts made from the finest, freshest ingredients, ensuring an authentic Russian flavor. **Highlight: Russian Honey Cake:** Delight in the signature Russian honey cake, though some may find it a bit too sweet for their palate. **Assorted Pastries:** Explore a diverse selection of pastries, each offering its own unique taste and texture. **Mini Market:** Browse through the mini-market section offering a variety of Russian products, adding to the authenticity of the experience.

Russian bakery!! Honey cake is blowing my mind…. Light and not as sweet as I thought… Pistachio cake is the one you have to try!! It’s basically dacquoise with crunchy pistachios instead of almond, cream filling.… I have tried chicken liver pie, it also delicious. Nice combination with liver and veg, well seasoned. In general everything is above my expectations. I will definitely come back soon for other choices of pie!!

What a gem! Visiting from Australia, stumbled across this place and stopped in for some dumplings. They make their own sour cream and cottage cheese which ensures authenticity with the dumplings. Other traditional dishes such a herring salad and homemade kvass. Staff were great.
This spot’s a hidden gem. Lovely owners who bake some delicious treats. She even talked me through the history behind Piroshki which was interesting! Thanks Hamish Dorrington Kakapo Business Sales

Their pot is basically just hot water mixed with ingredients, which is completely tasteless. The radish in the appetizer was actually rotten and spoiled The sweet and sour pork looks like pre-cooked, everything was stuck together. I paid $98 for a pot — no, definitely half a pot of hot water with some pickled vegetables and pork bone and it had absolutely no flavor. Totally not worth it. If there were a 0-star option, I wouldn’t even give it 1 star.
Lots of flies in the restaurant. Saw the free soft drink promotion on social media and went but they didn’t let us know until we ask. Food was mediocre. Bits and pieces of meat with lots of onion.
Good atmosphere and service . Food is not bad - only that the pork intestine could have been processed better . Special price Crayfish with noodles is nice.

First time visiting and would absolutely recommend! The food was fantastic, portion sizes were great and it all came out so quickly. The staff were lovely - they were super attentive and made us feel welcome. Thank you for an awesome meal - will be coming back soon!
awesome atmosphere for group gathering, very patient and nice staff 💓 menu has whole lots of choices, giant pot was very unique
The taste was average overall, and there weren’t really options suitable for kids. Portion sizes were decent and service was fine
#Dongbei style# Big pot is really nice，especially the pork one！ Sweet and sour pork is also delicious. Recommend to make reservation on Saturday.

They have been doing great in the Newmarket so I have high expectations to the one in Albany. The traditional DongBei big steel pot cuisine is not only delicious but also the portion is huge!🤣 They have the best Harbin Russian style sausage, GuoBao pork..... anyway, they are simply yum!
Foods are delicious. Staff was friendly. I wish there were more soup in the pot and it was easier to get the noodle out of the pot.
A friendly place. Food was generally good. Must try the North Chinese style hotpot. It looks great. Had it before in China and it is my style of hotpot

The Century Egg & Meat Ball Clay Pot Soup was incredibly delicious and rich—highly recommended! The Stir-Fried Pork with Chili was also flavourful, making it a perfect dish to pair with rice. The Nanchang Stir-Fried Rice Noodles had that fantastic aroma, and the fresh chilies added a delightful kick. Overall, the dishes were absolutely delicious! Highly recommended!
The rice noodles are my favourite food! Like the spicy food!!! It’s not only delicious but also not expensive. The service is great! So highly recommended!

Highly recommend the combined hotpot at this restaurant! I chose the spicy and tomato broths, and the tomato flavor was intense - you could taste the tomatoes in every bite. The portion sizes are generous, and I especially recommend trying the 1-meter beef slices. You'll be surprised by the size of the dish! Don't forget to mix your own dip sauce, and I highly recommend the sesame sauce for an added burst of flavor
Very tasty jiangxi food, very authentic. A must go place if you like spice and tasty chinese dishes!
#Hot pot & Chinese dishes# Spicy chicken and intestine are nice. Dishes are some kind of small，especially the lamb. You can make the reservation from first table.
It was a great experience, amazing food, super cool staff
Great food, great service. Awesome place to meet with friends for a night out for dinner
Nice place and food but hard to get parking some days , just got to be patient

Not sure I would classify this area as a shopping mall. More so just a small gathering of shops. Still though, a good variety of shops. Parking can be a problem for surrounding restaurants. Other than that pretty good
Great but needs booking and also long wait times and you might be sitting with other people

The sushi's were exceptional, the staff attentive, and the ambiance was perfect for a cozy evening. Highly recommended!” “We enjoyed everything about our visit to sushi lab. Floor n food area were very clean n tidy aswel. My order. Tempura prawn Grilled snowcrab Grilled salmon Teriyaki chicken Tuna sushi Crab salad Avocado 🥲 $55 in total Full of flavors and very well presented. 💯 Great work team 👏
Super delicious sushi with great amount of filling❤️
Wow we finally have good sushi in Albany. I’m pretty picky with sushi and this hit the spot. Not often I review anything but I’m keen to support them so they stick around.
Best sushi I have had in years
Tired it today, so good, very fresh, tasty flavour and good variety, big piece of tuna, salmon and even prawn tempura has large and fresh parwn, very good, loved it

Sum Made is hands down one of the best Chinese restaurants I’ve experienced in Auckland. From the moment we walked in, we were welcomed with warmth and genuine hospitality. The interior is elegant yet inviting — perfect for both casual lunches and special occasions. The food? Absolutely phenomenal. Every dish was beautifully presented and bursting with authentic Cantonese flavour. The dim sum was delicate and fresh, the seafood cooked to perfection, and the Durian Chicken Hot Pot was a bold, unforgettable highlight. You can really taste the quality in every bite. What truly sets Sum Made apart is their attention to detail and impeccable service. The staff were attentive without being intrusive and happy to recommend dishes that matched our tastes. You can tell this place is run with heart. A true gem in Auckland’s North Shore — I’ll definitely be coming back (and bringing more friends next time)!
A wonderfully friendly restaurant with amazing yam char menu. We arrived early as we heard the place can fill up quickly and it did. Service was great. The food came out warm and fresh.

By far, it is the best authentic Chinese restaurant in Auckland! Each dish is packed with incredible flavours, and you can truly taste the quality in every bite. We’ve been dreaming of coming back ever since our visit! The restaurant also offers a private room, perfect for intimate gatherings or special occasions. Whether you’re celebrating or just enjoying a delicious meal, this place is a must-visit. Highly recommend it for anyone looking for a memorable dining experience 🤗
Great food. Had a lovely breakfast. Many options to choose from and all are unique and interesting. Highly recommend the noodles, scallops and the jelly looking cakes! Staff are super friendly too.

Took us back to China. I felt like I'm back in China having an amazing meal. Super generous portions, very friendly and attentive service and very tasty dishes. It's loud, it's vibrant, full of families having a great time over round tables. A great great vibe
So yummy! I had to take a photo before we finish them so quickly. Great texture, firmness and taste which means they are amazingly fresh!

This is the best sashimi place in Auckland. The chef is very experienced and the food is a piece of art. Very well priced for the amount of sashimi served. I highly recommend this place for anyone looking to indulge in probably the best sashimi in Auckland.
After knowing this place, I only buy sashimi here. You can get fresh and large amount of sashimi at a reasonable price. Recommended!!!

To begin, the taste was exceptional. Having XL Sashimi, I can confidently assert that this place stands out as one of the premier sashimi takeaway spots in the North Shore. Moreover, despite a slight mix-up in the order, the owner demonstrated remarkable professionalism in resolving the issue. I truly appreciated the level of professionalism exhibited throughout the experience. Highly recommended
Don't bother ordering. When you arrive to pick up your order they tell you I don't have time for it. Great service...
Best Breakfast I’ve had from Chinese cafe, very delicious Chinese Pancakes and Porridge Rice Purple. I will try all of them and this is my second time. So fresh and super quick service!!

The shop in Albany is takeaway only. I love it so much and feel lucky to finally see more of these specialty shops around where I live. Ordered twice within a week. It’s so hard to find specialty food shops in Auckland let alone a tofu specialty shop which is genuinely authentic. My favorite is the Gravy Tofu Jelly - it is so light and smooth. If you can handle spicy (like real spicy) then the sour and spicy tofu jelly is delicious as well. I would order their soft steamed buns and braised pork Chinese burger (add tea egg). They come in good portion and are always really flavorful, but not in a sickening salty way. Highly recommend!

I ordered delivery through an app and they sent me the wrong items. I called them and they just said ‘sorry no english’ and hung up on me 3 times!! I know they understood me because I heard them in the background saying ‘what do we do’ and laughing. Unbelievable.
Food took way too long to be named express and was bland and not worth the wait
Good service and great food Love the fried dough and soy milk Very good pork burgers and Boasa Coffees good too!

It is a fun place to eat. Sushi comes on a moving train, and there are lots of choices. You can also get hot food like noodles and soup. It’s a happy place for families, and the food tastes fresh. Prices are a little higher, but it’s worth it for the fun.

Meh.... there is much better sushi available on the shore. Selection at 2pm was lacking. No energy, no selling or explanation of what is available. Green tea from a packet. Ginger is a chargeable extra. Nothing would drive me to return. The bill was over $33 - a complete rip-off.

Really amazing place to go to. Went here with my friends once and it was really fun. It is a great place to go to for dinner however do not eat too much sushi because me and my friends ate too much and it ended costing over $200 I think. However sometimes there is not much food on the conveyor belt but a good thing is you can order food normally just like you are in a normal restaurant.Still a nice place to go to with lots of friendly staff.

Took the family here for lunch. The selection was not very good while we were sitting there, however the quality was pretty good. Fair warning - the green tea was scalding hot. It barely cooled enough to drink half of it before we left.

Pretty decent conveyor belt sushi place. First of all, the staff was really friendly and the restaurant was clean. On to the food, the sushi were pretty good, decent variety and some you would not normally find anywhere else (in NZ anyway). You can order other food on the menu as well, like udon. Would love to visit regularly, but the price is quite steep so I'll probably come back on special occasions.

I came here for dinner based on recommendations from a friend. I was very pleasantly surprised by the portions and flavors. Had the beef pho, the small portion and it was very generous in size. Also ordered the fresh spring rolls which had prawns and marinated lemongrass beef in it, fresh and yummy! Prices were reasonable. Great value for a dining experience!

I had the beef pho, and the portion was really generous! The broth was rich and flavorful, and the beef was tender. The seafood pho was also very fresh and delicious. The staff were friendly and welcoming, making the dining experience even better. Plus, the restaurant has a beautiful and cozy atmosphere. Definitely a great place for authentic Vietnamese food!

Disappointing Pho - Bland and Lacking Flavor I recently visited this Vietnamese pho restaurant, and unfortunately, I left quite underwhelmed. The food was, in a word, mediocre. I ordered the shrimp and crab roe pho, expecting a burst of seafood flavor, especially the distinct richness of crab roe. Instead, it was completely devoid of any crab roe taste whatsoever. It was incredibly bland. The beef marrow pho was equally disappointing. There was absolutely no depth of meaty flavor that you'd expect from a well-made beef broth. Honestly, I've had pre-packaged meals that tasted better than what was served here. Overall, the experience was very underwhelming. I cannot recommend this restaurant if you're looking for authentic and flavorful Vietnamese pho.
I had a lot of memories here. I miss that happy time. Enjoy the food and the atmosphere.

We are Pho lover and have been trying different Vietnamese restaurants in Auckland. This one is so authentic and the size is great too. I am so satisfied with my lunch with a classic Vietnamese coffee!

The taste was good, the room was open and clean. But the price was not really friendly for purely a bowl of rice noodles (approximately $20 per person ) They shared the same pot to cook all the noodles as well. So I also tasted the flavor was kind of mixed up.

Absolutely thrilled to see Gui Rice Noodle open on the North Shore! During my time studying at AUT, I frequently enjoyed their Guilin rice noodles, Laoyou noodles, and Luosifen. However, after graduation, I went less often due to the inconvenient parking in the city. Now, with locations on the North Shore, it’s so much more accessible. The taste is still the same, bringing back fond memories. I was lucky to arrive early yesterday and got my order quickly, but there was a long line afterward. For authentic Liuzhou flavors, this place is unbeatable!
Tasty foods, clean space, and affordable prices.

Quite possibly one of the best, unique and most well balanced beef noodle soup I have had. Their Chilli Pepper Sauce at the self-service station along with the pork bone broth is out of this world. Elevated the taste of everything. Perfect balance of flavours, and even though the helpings look massive, the rice noodles make the dishes lighter - polished off the entire bowl. Will definitely be visiting again!

Excellent value for money. Delicious and authentic Chinese noodle dishes. Large portions with a great selection of fresh ingredients providing great flavours. Not too salty. Quite noisy and no bathroom and no decorations. Poor atmosphere, but clean and tidy.
Extremely positive experience here. Very polite and friendly server, with a calm and relaxed atmosphere. Food was very much well worth the wait. I must visit for some traditional English grub :)

A very nice pub. It wasn't one of those places where you have to shout above the music to be heard. We had a nice dinner, wife had the salmon and chips, she said the fish was fresh and tasty but the batter could be bit more crispier. My steak was perfectly done (medium rare) with massive amount of mushroom sauce which was greatly appreciated. Mash potatoes was a bit smallish portion but it had lots of butter in it and was delicious. Goes well with a Guinness. Will definitely come back again.

A must visit! Delicious, well priced food and drinks and it has a real English/ European pub feel with a relaxed friendly atmosphere. The fire was going and the menu special of German style pork hock and sauerkraut dish and desserts were spot on. Uwe the owner is very accommodating, he knows and loves his food & drinks. Thanks Uwe, we will be back!

I couldn't rate the food as I never had any, but the Guinness is ice cold and tasty. Atmosphere is what you'd expect from the name. Beautiful pub with loads of character. Uwe is the bartender, and he's a real joy. Happy to help and very friendly. Overall high score and would definitely recommend and come again.

Came here for a birthday meal with my whanau and thoroughly enjoyed it! Food servings are huge and great quality, the service was epic, genuinely the best on the North Shore, so attentive and welcoming. Thanks so much, we will definitely be back! Even got given a Guinness glass that I’ve been wanting for ages 😁😁

Authentic Flavours and Warm Hospitality! We had an amazing dining experience at Flavours of India! From the moment we walked in, the staff was incredibly welcoming and attentive. The ambiance was cozy and inviting — perfect for a relaxed meal. We tried a variety of dishes and each one was full of authentic Indian flavours. The butter chicken was rich and creamy, the biryani was perfectly spiced, and the garlic naan was soft and fresh from the tandoor. You can really tell they use quality ingredients and traditional cooking methods. The portion sizes were generous and the prices were very reasonable for the quality of food and service. Highly recommend this spot for anyone craving genuine Indian cuisine — we'll definitely be back!

It’s great to find a new place for the monthly curry club. Flavours were welcoming, happy and provided great service to us all. However the best was the food. Amazing dishes served incredibly well with great portion sizes. The Kemma Naan is worth the visit alone. The lads in the curry club will be back again very soon.

Hands down the best Indian food and also the loveliest people. It’s been my Dad’s favourite restaurant for 15 years and we celebrated his special birthday there last night. The Friday/Sat night singer is an added bonus. She has a beautiful voice ❤️. But the food - we’ve tried a variety of dishes and nothing ever disappoints
The chef made us some special Chicken Manchurian and it was so yummy and crispy. We also had Somosas and they were also crispy and packed with flavour.

We had an amazing dining experience, trying a variety of dishes, including chicken tikka, reshmi kebab, shahjahani chicken, paneer tikka masala, tawa prawn, and chicken 65. Each dish was served in generous portions and packed with incredible flavors that truly tantalized our taste buds. To finish, we indulged in gulab jamun with ice cream—an absolute delight! The highlight of our meal was the refreshing mango lassi, which was so satisfying that it made it almost impossible to get up and leave! 😂 From the flavorful food to the vibrant ambiance, everything reflected the richness of the cuisine and culture. Highly recommend for anyone looking for an authentic and delicious experience! ❤️

One of my favourite little places in the Bays! LOVE their “special” pizza (even on a gluten free base it’s delicious!). The place feels so authentic, the staff are friendly, and the food delicious. Highly recommend.

I've lived in Browns Bay for a number of years and somehow never tried Buon Venuti until today. I will definitely be coming back! My wife and I had a standard sized pizza to share as a starter, which was the perfect size and delicious. Mains came shortly after and really hit the spot. Staff were friendly and attentive. The atmosphere is cute and cozy. Portion sizes were more than enough for us. Only snapped a pic of the Special Pizza and Banana Delizio.

I have been coming Here off and on for 30 odd years. Had a beautiful dinner but no veggies, 3 little cubes of potatoes and not even a whole piece of brocolli or cauli. For $38 dollars per meal it let my meal down and my family. What a shame but couldn't fault our lovely new waitress.

Not impressive. Mediocre chicken alfredo spaghetti that was extremely bland. My partner and I asked for the pizza bread with cheese starter and got the pizza bread with aioli and oil instead. The tiramisu was chocolate flavored whipped cream on top of a couple of a couple bland lady fingers with a side of plain whipped cream. Very bland and disappointing. Very expensive for the quality of food you get. The waitress was kind, friendly and helpful which is why I gave the service portion 4 stars. Atmosphere was pleasant and nice.

The food here overpriced for what you get. I ordered two pasta dishes for $24,50 each wow what an overprice meals they were if you like more sauce then pasta that's what you get here. Definitely not worth that price look below the only tasty thing was there pizza with the lot. Spent in total $94.50 yet again the pasta dishes a big let down.. small amounts of pasta with an overdose of sauces..

Got a lovely warm welcome yesterday from the gentleman at the counter. Highly recommend the curly fries with meat on chips! The lamb was tender and the chicken was well seasoned. Definitely going back (maybe even today 🤫)

We've been to 3 kebab places in and around Browns Bay, and I will say that all three are amazing, but Premium Kebab wins. Super fresh food. Of course. But, they make their own falafels (not those icky Gilmours things). Their lamb is actual pieces of lamb...it's epic! We had their premium kebabs (lamb, chicken and falafel all in one) as well as lamb on chips and lamb on rice. Everything was superb and the folks running the place were warm and welcoming. If you're in the area and have even half a hankering for middle eastern food, please consider Premium Kebab. You will not be disappointed. Seriously, best falafels.

Wow. Been here twice, once for a kebab, another time for lamb on chips. The lamb is insanely good, I've never had lamb this good at a kebab place. It's so meaty,juicy, tender, and soft... I need to know how they do it lol. Delicious

Amazing service and food! Visiting from Christchurch and this is now my favourite place to eat. A day of shopping and beach-gazing is not complete without a delicious kebab on turkish bread and a home-made chocolate baklava 😍

It is great to continue having your favourite kebab, more especially when there are lovely and welcoming people who work in the store! Great distance from the gym. Glad that it is still open after a late night workout session to have a delicious dinner. Along with delicious rose turkish delights to top it off as dessert. 😋

It was a weekday night around 8pm and most restaurants were already closed. A local friend recommended this spot for its beers, and we’re glad they did. The beers were excellent, the food was great, and the service was friendly and efficient. Although it was too dark to see the view, the sound of the waves in the background was incredibly calming — a truly therapeutic experience. Highly recommend!

Great spot by the beach with a relaxed vibe! Cocktails were reasonably priced, and there’s a solid variety of beers to choose from. Perfect place to unwind with some tasty snacks and drinks. We'll definitely be back!
Used to be Deep Creek Brewing... Work Team Lunch... Ribs, Ribs, Ribs, Ribs! Chased with Buttermilk Fried Chicken, Truffle Fries & Browns Bay Double Goats IIPA...

What a great spot. The food is always epic... the beer is sensational. You just can't beat the Ribs. I have travelled around the world and have NEVER found anything close! But... I don't just go for the food. The selection of Andrews brewed beer is unbeatable. He has won so many awards for his brews. It is a real pleasure to pop in and try out his recent... and to be honest... his past craft beer. They also have a wide selection of "normal" beer for the less adventurous. The team are local and friendly.

The food was absolutely delicious, and the setting was beautiful—but best of all, the staff were incredible. They were attentive, friendly, and always had a smile on their faces. It's rare to find such a perfect combination of great food, ambiance, and genuinely welcoming service. A truly fabulous experience.

I had a great experience at Fartze Fish and Chip Shop! The fish was perfectly cooked, tender, and flavorful. The batter was crispy and light, giving the whole meal a delightful crunch. The chips were just the right balance of crispy on the outside and soft on the inside.
I can highly recommend Farteze for fish and chips on a Friday night. Generous potions of both. They get busy so consider placing an order and pick it up.

The scent of spice hangs in the air, A promise whispered, beyond compare. Farteze Takeaway, a beacon bright, Against the Kumeū fading light. From crispy rolls to curries bold, Stories of flavour, waiting to unfold. The sizzle and pop, a kitchen's happy sound, As culinary magic can be found. A taste of comfort, a quick delight, Banishing hunger with all its might. In paper containers, warmth held tight, A perfect ending to the day or night. So let the aroma gently tease, And carry you over with effortless ease. Farteze Takeaway, a local's sweet art, A delicious treasure held close to the heart.
My favourite fish and chips shop. I love this place so much it is epic. Super cheap as well. Super epic super yummy 😎🤤🤤 $12.20 per person for a full meal 1 fish, 1 chips, 1 hashbrown.

Ordered 3 battered Snapper fillets $9e 👍 Took 10mins on top of other orders 👍 Parked out front, was delivered to car 👍 5min to home still hot, crispy, min oil res 👍 Fresh, flaky & no fishy or old oil smell 👍

We’ve been getting take away for years and Olivia is a big part of why. She always makes us feel welcome and remembered. Her care and attention, especially around gluten free, is something you do not see often. She takes it seriously, clearly checks everything, and genuinely wants people to feel safe and looked after. She clearly trains her staff well as they're also very aware of allergens. It is rare to find that kind of consistency and kindness. We are so lucky to have her on our doorstep!

Been going here since it opened and our family loves the food from here. Some of the best Chinese takeaways I've ever had, even catering for dairy & gluten intolerances, and always cooked with the freshest ingredients. Even if you do have to wait during their busy dinner hours, it's totally worth it.

I visited from East Auckland today, and it was worth the drive. Olivia's kitchen staff are so welcoming. They reassured me and helped me several times to pick the right options for gluten-free options. The person behind the counter was extremely helpful. The food itself is amazing. Our items were of great quality and I have not had good GF Asian food in so long. Thank you so much, we hope to visit again. :)
Delicious food, friendly staff and quick service. We've just moved to the area; this is definitely going on our list of takeaway places! 😋

I have edited due to response. What I saw Warsaw beef, raw chicken, cooked prawns and cooked pork picked up with the same tongs from different containers and placed into the one container before being put in the wok. I know it was this as I thought it was our order of special fried rice which is why I watched so closely. I also wasn't the only person in the store that witnessed this. Tried Olivia's Kitchen last night for the first time. Placed order and whilst waiting watched the gentleman cooking put raw meat into a takeaway container, transfer raw meat to the wok, add other ingredients to the wok and then return the cooked food to the same unwashed container that had the raw meat in. Neither women serving/cooking looked shocked when we mentioned this but did look bewildered that we had asked for our order to be cancelled and our money back. Money was refunded in full and we will not be returning again due the blatant disregard for basic food hygiene. And yes, they did package the container up for the person to collect their order as if nothing had happened. Hope no one got sick.

Grade A!! Ordered Chicken Kebab combo with cheese $22 + $1 (cheese) Mixed Kebab combo with cheese $22 + $1 (cheese) Was a fulfilling kebab with heaps of meat only minor downfall was you couldn’t taste the sauces (added 3 sauce flavours) the filling was overpowering the flavours so it became dry on every bite after the first three bites. Had to stop eating half way through to add some sauces in my fridge. Also fries weren’t fresh as you see in the photo it was a darker brown and dry so was either recooked in the frier or overcooked so was pretty bland. Good little spot and a good dine in area inside. Friendly staff and greets you straight away when you walk in. Just think quality of the food can be a bit better.
Average flavours, got a mixed on rice and Donna kebab. Found the satay sauce way to sweet

Best kebab shop , if you know better let me know. Rice good, meat good, wrap good, chips could be crispier or more seasoned. Desserts are too small but fking tasty. Service is great. Shop done renovation this year looks more clean and modern. Very good.
Wow!! What a choice meal for a Friday night. My first time, and wow, I'll definitely be back. Great friendly staff, short wait, but what a delicious takeaways!! Definitely bang for your buck!!

Pleasant service but unfortunately the food was sub par. The chips were super hot but soggy and undercooked, almost felt microwaved although I'm sure they have deep fries. The chicken kebab wrap was also soggy, it seemed like it had been sitting wrapped in foil for quite a while but we picked up the order within 10 minutes.
Definitely not butter chicken, overly sweet and watered down. Absolutely do not recommend.
Best Indian takeaway in North shore. The food is delicious and generous portion size. Very good value for money 🤤
The food at Cuisine India Northcross is delicious! Consistently good week after week - our whole family loves it! 10/10 every time 😋

Food is good and tasty. Price is okay for the quantity and quality served. Staff members are friendly and helpful. This is primarily a takeaway branch which is pretty clean and well maintained. The only area for improvement in my opinion could be the waiting time. Overall a decent Indian takeaway pretty much covering all major north Indian cuisines.

Best takeway in the north shore. The staff and owners are really kind and courteous to our requests. Love the biriyani, nice quantity and taste. They have bunny chow and other combo offers which are really good. Must try - Chicken chilly, lamb masala, chicken tikka,fish masala. And their chicken lolipops are yummy. Would definitely recommend. Very affordable price with good quantity and the best indian restaurant i would recommend.

Are you guys for real? On a Friday night peak Dinner time I did wonder why the place was empty. The staff serving was so focused on trying to up-sell I think she forgot half the ingredients, minimal ingredients, chicken was dry and the bread seemed a bit stale. Unsure why I paid $24.70 when the same combo was $22 in Hamilton 2 weeks ago. Also perhaps the guy mopping could wait for the only customer of the evening to move before skimming my shoes with with the mop! Come on guys do better 🤣

I was really disappointed with the sandwich I purchased here. For the price I paid (around $16.50), I expected a lot more in terms of quality and portion. The amount of vegetables in the sandwich was very minimal, so much so that all I could really taste was the bread in every bite. Unfortunately, it didn’t feel worth the cost.

I ordered the Veggie Patty sandwich and was very disappointed with the quality. The sandwich had very little sauce and barely any vegetables, making it dry and flavorless. The overall preparation felt careless and far from the standard I expect from Subway. Definitely not worth the price or the experience.
Ordered a footlong tuna sub, no tuna, couldn't speak to anyone when I called as phone service busy 🙃 😑

This used to be one of the best subways, must be under new management, I have never seen such a pathetic amount of salads put into a subway before. I got about 3 leaves of spinach and 5 olives, the rest of the veggies I asked for were pathetic too but I stopped counting, the lettuce barely even covered the surface.
We have found our favourite Thai restaurant we ordered chicken pad Thai, duck curry, Tom Yum and drunken noodle. They are all delicious. Highly recommended

The worst Thai food I have had. The portion is small and the price is high. The taste is so bad that I quited eating after several bites. I was wondering why there were so many good reviews until I saw this cheating trick on the table. It is a waste of my money and time that I had to leave my first negative review on Google.
Nice food and lovely service. I love it you should come guys ❤️ I recommend PAD SE-IEW so so yum😋

Very good food. Probably the most authentic Thai food I've had in New Zealand. The owner is also very friendly and lovely to deal with. She's also able to prepare food that's off the menu if you request it and she's able to. Will come back soon!
Back to Thailand! Though I didn’t find sticky rice to have with salad ~ but the taste still saved me from my Thailandsick💕

Worst baklava i have ever had. Both pastry fingers were without filling of chopped nuts and fully empty. I am eating baklava from many years and had from your other branch in Napier aswell which was perfect. Don’t try to fool the customers.

Wow what an amazing place! First time in the staff Greeted me with a welcoming G'day. Unfortunately I'm gluten free (celiac) However this wasn't a problem as they had a few different opinions. The Kebab came out before I could sit down, To say the service was outstanding is an understatement. My first bite left me wondering if I should get up & order a second (the portion to price was definitely correct) it was absolutely delicious. This little store almost hidden away beat my expectation right out of the ball park, I will promise you one thing I will definitely be returning for more... Kind Regards, One very happy customer

Have been a regular since they opened up but value for money has gone down significantly. Portion sizes reduced and prices almost doubled since 2021. Food is hit and miss depending on time of day. Owner has responded with incorrect claim? Meat on chips was $10.50 it is now $16.99 and $18.99? And they have also changed from (Regular to Large) sizes to (Small and Regular) which is deceiving. The old regular containers used to fit more that the current Small ones and were fairly priced. This is why I choose sensational chicken now.

What is great about getting food from Anatolia's is that the staff are very helpful and friendly. As the meals are freshly prepared, you have a waiting time, and even when they are very busy, your waiting time is not excessive. The portions are big and the food is yummy. Please come out and support our local small businesses during these tough times and enjoy the great food that they prepare.

I've been a regular customer for several years. I often buy the $6.50 bag of chips which is good for 2 people. But now they have changed the amount to 1/3 for the same price. I won't be coming back. Plenty of other Turkish cafes to choose from.

Grade A!! Love the Sushi of the day deal. Friday’s are Smoked salmon & Avocado $7.99 for 8 pieces. Great value for your money. They ran out but team was happy to make me teriyaki salmon and Avocado on the stop for the same price. Staff is very inviting and greets you when you walk in. Shops is very tidy.
Today I bought sushi from your shop for myself and my friends. It was so fresh and delicious! The staff were very polite and friendly. Thank you

Always great to deal with! We had a problem with the last cater order and the store is resolving this soon. Trust will get sorted otherwise highly recommended. Friendly and easy to deal with this store. Thanks again!
Very good place to get a wide variety of quality sushi and seafood. Spotless venue and plenty of parking.

I'm not sure if this store is under new ownership, but cutting costs on the amount of ginger you put in a pack of sushi is a bit ridiculous. There is never enough ginger to cover all pieces and if you ask for more (so I can cover all my sushi) they charge extra. It's not a big cost but but it's not the point. If your going to sell something, put it all in there. It's like selling shoes with short shoe laces, you can make it work at a stretch but not going to lace the whole shoe.

Waiting for 1 hour just for chicken strips, only 1 FOH and 1 Chef working. Nothing has been prepared for customers order at all and it’s Friday night, many people were waiting for 2 hours. I warn you…if you want to order for your dinner you’d phone them in the morning otherwise you might need to wait for tomorrow to pick up.
I had higher hopes based on the reviews the store had. The flavour of the sauce on the ribs was nice, but otherwise it was pretty dry and chips were average. Wouldn't rush to come back.

Came here after seeing someone's tiktok and it DID NOT DISAPPOINT 🤤 Bestie and I got the $76 share box - YES we ate it all, NO we didn't share 🤣🤣 it took us two sittings though (before Kehlani's concert and after) so portions are legit. We were WELL full after both rounds lol Tasted just as good the second time too.. chicken quarters are so juicy! (Lemon Herb sauce we chose on it was divine) Every chip and onion ring was crisp and flavorsome to perfection - even after sitting a bit / when cold they were still surprisingly crisp and not soggy at all despite most of them being smothered in sauce(s). Customer service was pleasant, took 20mins to prepare but well worth the wait. Also bought and devoured 4 x chocolate mousse that tasted just like KFCs o.g recipe👌🏾 Overall great value for money and will be back again to inhale more food/try other flavors.
Took about 20 minutes to be prepared but well worth the wait, massive portion size, and delicious, amazing place
Had the 1/2 rack pork ribs sith onion rings and a side of mushroom sauce. It was so yummy specially the onion rings dipped in the mushroom sauce. Would definitely go again.

5 Stars – Amazing Food & Even Better Service! Dragon Horse Takeaways has quickly become my go-to for a satisfying, delicious meal. Every time I visit, the food is hot, fresh, and full of flavour—the portions are generous, the menu has great variety, and everything is cooked just right. From the crispy chips to the perfectly seasoned fried rice, I’ve never had a bad order here. But what really makes the experience special is the staff, especially Sascha. She’s honestly such a highlight to see whenever I come in. Always welcoming with a big smile, super friendly, and makes everyone feel like a valued customer. You can tell she takes pride in what she does, and it really lifts the whole vibe of the place. She brings positive energy and genuine warmth that keeps me coming back. Highly recommend Dragon Horse for the food and the service. If you stop by, hope you get served by Sascha—she’s a star!

Dragon horse? I'm trying to imagine what a dragon horse would look like. However, I'm here for the food. - Dragon horse special fried rice 8.7/10 Normally, I love fried rice with some char on the rice. However, this is an exception - it's really good. This doesn't have chicken and beef, but it doesn't need it as it's not sold as a "combination" fried rice. Rice has such a tasty flavor, mostly from the well seasoned egg and spring onions, and a good handful of cashews to top it off. Something that will probably be the staple dish to get next time I come here. Love it. - Scallops 8.1/10 Ordered 3, gave 4. Crispy batter and nice size Scallops.

Me and my family been coming here since I was a little girl, also worked here part time during my high school years. I love the food and love the owners - They are genuinely kind and caring people, really cares about the food (and their customers) and its integrity. We still get takeaways from here after 20 years!

The most wonderful European Chinese food! This family have been serving the best food for over 20 years. I’ve grown up eating their food over that time and they always recognise me, cook delicious dishes and I could t recommend them enough!

Dragon horse always a reliable local takeaway spot. Had the fried rice, sweet and sour pork, Mongolian chicken, wontons and spring rolls all were tasty. Lovely staff who always greet you with a smile!

Food was bland, boring and uninspired. Spaghetti bolognese tasted like Watties out of the can. There was no flavor, no meat. Doesn’t have anything to do with Italian food. From my heritage and experience, I have eaten many cevapi and I was looking forward to these ones as they are the only place in Auckland selling them. But I was so disappointing. They just tasted like bland minced beef sausages, no spices, no flavor. The garlic “sauce” as side was more of a garlic water. Salad was the best dish
They didn't peel the skin off the salami so the salmi pieces weren't cut properly when the pizza was cut into slices. Also having to pick out the skin when eating the slices. Pizza is OK otherwise.

Small but humble restaurant. Warm environment. Tasty food. Pictures featured are mixed grill and penne creamy chicken and wild mushroom pasta. BYO available with no corkage fee. Generally well presented and tasty. Nice atmosphere. Small and cosy.
Great food and service! And Ainsley, our server, was terrific! I would highly recommend Bella Cucina!!
Fantastic restaurant with amazing food and the most professional and the friendliest customer service ever! Would highly recommend to everyone.
Harrison delivery driver was brilliant, along with his gorgeous golden locks. 10/10. Pizza tasted so much better knowing he delivered it. However........pizza was cut questionably.

Stars are for delivery as he was very nice. Unfortunately the pizzas didn’t have cheese on many slices and some had none at all. We really don’t order takeaway often so really disappointed. Running low on cheese??

I had a system error that was not pick up properly when it printed the receipt for my order. I was met with hostility from the employee and blame by the manager when I submitted my experience. They both gaslit me into telling me I never checked removed bbq sauce from my order. My receipt had in big bold letters NO BBQ SAUCE, but didn’t have anything about the base sauce. The employee took the receipt and threw it out so I couldn’t use it on my argument. My app order only mentioned the base sauce. Luckily my confirmation email had both add pizza sauce and remove bbq sauce. This type of blaming the customer is appalling and unacceptable. Will not be returning. See the photos for proof of purchase and for exchange with manager who could not even take the time to spell my name correctly when responding.

The person who attended the call was unable to understand the customer name. Physically meeting at the counter after spelling it clearly still he was not registering it right.. The service is courteous. But the point a customer name you cannot get itself is a turnoff… Moreover the pizza was not done well. We could compare the taste as we tried the same from Devonport dominos and it was Awesome. By Recipetailorashu follow or DM for any queries on IG and FB
Dominos pizza browns bay fell off The pizza isn’t properly cut, the crust is uneven and the half n half pizza is merging with the other half.
Place is mint. The happy fella with the sort of long brown hair and backwards cap was very friendly and provided great service. Bought the big thing of buffalo wings and it was mad good.
The staff was very kind and pizza was warm and delicious ♡♡
One of many SALS over auckland, so they produce the same product. I got the $21 combo, and I feel like it's good for value. Customer service was good, didn't wait too long for the food.
Pizza quality is too good recommended to everyone. Staff did good customer service. Thanks Bikram for making nice pizza really appreciate.

Pizza is nice but service is consistently terrible. Today's example - Placed online order was informed pickup was 8.20pm. When I arrived on time, I was told by staff it would be another 7-8 mins. At nearly 8.40pm was told it would be another 5 mins, when I questioned the reason for the extended delay I was told there was an Uber eats order??? When spending a premium on pizza I'd expect better service than domino's.

Wow, very disappointed. Asked for southern chicken salad. 5 pieces of chicken, overheated so had a rubbery texture, a handful of lettuce, 2 slices of tomatoe, 3 slices of cucumber, some pickles and jalapeños. Oh and 2 triangles of cheese. Not worth it at all. The only thing they were generous with was the sauce as thats all i could really taste. Waste of money and certainly will not be returning to this branch.

Very bad service. Would not give me a cup for a child to drink out of after charging me for a full size drink in the combo because they didn’t have and Sprite Zero in the small size. Other subways give out kids cups. Avoid this place 😡
Really lovely service with a smile from the lady that served me today. I ordered a meatball sub and she was just lovely. Thank you :)

This place is so bad. I went there and ordered a six inch. best believe they did NOT give me a 6 inch. They like gave me a 3 inch sub it was so small. When I go to all the other subways they give me good portions but this place just cheaps out. Go to the Northcross Subway instead

To say I’m disappointed is an understatement. The lady who served me appeared to already be in a foul mood before placing my order. I had simply asked her the options of which wrap they have and she told me I was on the wrong side when I was not ready to order yet. When I told her the meats, cheese etc she just slapped it all in with zero care. She then proceeded to ask which salads I wanted then proceeded to ask my partner what she wanted.. at this point I was a little confused as she kept getting distracted from the oven or trying to complete my partners order so she proceeds to say “anything else” I said to her “yes but you keep ignoring me” to which she rolled her eyes and huffed. After this she continued to have zero care and was full of attitude and because I didn’t want to make a scene I started to ignore her to which she removed her gloves and went out the back to tell the other worker to serve us. I explained to the other worker I didn’t like the way she served us and her attitude was horrible. Later on as we finished at the beach the same worker came out with rubbish and was rolling her eyes at me and my partner. By looking at these reviews it seems to be a common thing for bad service and attitude maybe a review into your workers would be a good start. I will never go back here.

They were amazing my mother was having trouble with order however they helped us sort it all out with no problem. The food was hot and delish, the pizzas base was crisp and soft with the right amount of toppings. Thank you browns bay pizza hut you made our night.
