this will be the last time we order from Brownsbay pizza hut. They clearly dont care about customer service or quality of the food. all 3 pizzas were burnt and didnt make it to the order that we paid extra for i dont even know how they could serve it really??? Do better 😡

*To Browns bay pizza hut* *Pizza Feedback:* - *Crust*: Loved the crispy crust! - *Toppings*: Perfect balance of flavors, generous toppings. *Team Feedback:* - *Service*: Friendly, attentive, and efficient service. - *Communication*: Clear and prompt communication throughout the order process. - *Overall Experience*: Enjoyed the experience, would definitely recommend! **Browns bay pizza hut*,❤️
Awesome service and highly recommend and the best pizza I have ever had

The guys at Pizza Hut Browns Bay are outstanding! On a busy night with people queuing almost out the door, they handle everyone with a respect and a smile, and get great food out to all clients efficiently, even though you can see they’re handling a lot! We regularly get pizzas and sides, and have never had a fault with the service or the food. Keep it up, it’s great to see you in action :)

Went for dinner here. Food was average. Still quite nice but nothing spectacular. Got the Japanese dinner Bento. Forgot to take photo of sushi and sashimi but was okay quality. Nothing special. Service was good however some confusion with ordering. Atmosphere is nice as it's quite a small niche venue.
Food was fresh good value and delicious! Fish super fresh. Sadly they didn’t refill our tea or check up on us so the service wasn’t amazing but food great

We love this spot! Very fresh, clean and delicious flavours. The menu is extensive and offers a bit of everything in terms of variety and price. Haven’t had a bad dish here so far. The team are very friendly and warm. The interior is full of Japanese theme with a homely feel. Yaruki for life!

Beautiful Japanese restaurant located in Browns Bay. The interior gives you a comfortable Japan style vibe, excellent services too! A bit crowded and noisy as tables are located quite close to each other. The sashimi dishes are fresh, cooked food is what you would expect from a standard Japanese restaurant.

Havnt been to Yaruki in many years and WOW has it changed ! For the BETTER ! Exquisitely delicious food - beautifully presented - great variety - something for everyone & very well priced . We LOVE Japanese food & we were MORE than impressed with Yaruki ! The Sashimi is DEVINE 😋Very friendly & attentive staff too - everyone that works here looks happy & engages with you in an upbeat , positive & professional way . We felt very welcome to your lovely restaurant & we thoroughly enjoyed our evening ! Thank you Yaruki - we are already looking forward to our next visit 😋😍

I love going to Northcross Takeaway! I ordered beef fried rice and chicken and prawn rice noodles. The meat wasn't dry and the food was reasonably portioned. The prawns were a bit bland to my liking. I also found the fried rice a bit salty. Overall, I recommend coming to this place :)
Have been here regularly, love the new katsu on rice deal

Used to be my favourite chip place before they switched to crinkle cut fries. Feels like a cheaper alternative to keep up with rising costs, but you lose quality. Disappointed with this one as they used to have the best chips

$12.90 container for smorgasbord. Looked great but everything tasted like fish. The chicken and cashew...fish. Black bean beef... fish. Taste like they forgot to clean the wok between meals. First time there so hopefully a one off but not sure based on other reviews.

This is the second time Ive been to this shop - 1st visit food was fabulous and good portion size this time not so happy. Oily batter on the fish, chips over cooked and overpriced for the portion. Wontons dry and overcooked with no sweet & sour sauce...I will not be back. Yes I know its only fish and chips BUT my expectation is that a meal no matter the price should be enjoyed regardless.

Used to be great, lately has tasted pretty plain butter chicken with no spices. Last time we ordered it was like it was just a canned tomato soup base with barely any spices or flavour. Pretty disappointed considering we spend $150-180 each time we order with the other dishes we get, but butter chicken usually a favourite with Dad and the kids. Will reconsider our options for Indian food now :(

It’s a great restaurant, food is delicious, service is amazing. Would go back again, absolutely!! The space is a bit tight with furniture. They could make minor changes and it would be the place to go for Indian food!! Despite the layout - great food, great service, you won’t be disappointed that’s for sure!!!

This is a great place for beautiful Indian food. My meal was great, service was good for a large group. Loved their serving dishes. I ordered the Balti Chutney Chicken which was my first time that I have eaten thus particular dish.....it was divine......my new favorite Indian dish.

Brought butter chicken with a cheesy garlic Nan. Half way through my meal and I find something too hard to eat and it looks like a stable or something metal, how it got into the meal I have no idea but not going to risk it again. What a shame
We had the pani puri and tikka masala curry. Both were great, however two of the pani puris had already broken making it a bit difficult pouring the liquid into.

Attentive staff. We were offered a booth in a smaller area - will try to get a table in the main area next time. Enjoyed the food. A little bit more expensive than expected but we haven’t dined out in a while!

Absolutely amazing! The tonkotsu ramen was rich, creamy, and full of flavor. Easily one of the best I’ve ever had. The service was just as impressive: warm, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. The atmosphere made the whole experience even better. Cozy, vibrant, and perfect for a relaxed meal. Can’t wait to go back!

I love this place! Really good food and service. Prices are reasonable, too. There's not really a downside, but if you're seated in the separate booths in the hallway, you lose some of the atmosphere, but if you're looking for some privacy, that's the spot. 5 stars!!
Amazing in all areas. Great food, brilliant sake, and wine options. Friend and attentive service and prompt food ordering and receiving.
My favourite is the Nagoya Chicken Don. I love the ramen but I can't resist this dish. Just make sure to ask for mayonnaise since it can be a bit dry otherwise, but they don't charge extra!

- Sun horse special friend rice 9.5/10 When I order this i always get consistency. Cashews go well with this dish and happy with the price for the combination you get. Kiwi style rice done right. - Scallops 3/10 They were overcooked. They were quite small, and the roe was tiny. Bit of a shame. I'll just come here for the rice dish, which Is very popular.

Just been there for the first time and loved it! Good portion, fresh ingredients:) & friendly delicious authentic chinese takeaway :) easy parking - will definitely be one of my favourite take aways 👍
Here is the best taste and worthy price take away shop in my experience! Will order again next time. Normally call them before 15-20mins before pick up!
First time customer and happy I tried them. Lovely people greet you on pickup, food was filling and delicious, and price and meal size was quite reasonable. Very happy to return again.
Ordered an Egg foo young with BBQ pork, Paid $16.5 only getting this much? I'm not sure if this is a joke or they priced it wrong? It doesn't come with rice in. A total disappointment overall.
Chicken pies tonight. Staff seemed a bit grumpy and food took ages to arrive, also was forced to share a table with a strange little man.
Lasagna tonight, home made and delicious, kitchen staff were in a good mood too!

One of the best deep fried fish I have tried and still good up until this day! Just grab the fish of the day. No fishy smell, batter is crispy without greasy taste (probably due to using clean oil?) they are nice & hot! Goes well with cold ketchup from the fridge. You feel me? Go on, give it a try! You won’t regret it!

The hot dog had a LOT of sauce put onto it which is so satisfying. And the fish of the day? So good and very large in size furthermore, good quality salt. I took like 2 bites from the photo and I ate the hotdog, couldn’t help it. Overall: very delicious AND reasonable for its price

The fish and chips were ok but the rest of the food was terrible. The steak on the burger had a chemical smell. No one could eat it. The entire burger went to the bin. The russian wasn’t appealing either. Won’t go back there.

Your listed hours state 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM, but it’s now 11:45 AM, Saturday, and you’re not open. Why are you wasting your customers’ time? I’ve seen other people complain about this too, yet you don’t seem to care. 1 STAR rating for your pathetic service!
Closes I got to South African russians and chips. Salt and vinegar were perfect, and chips were fresh. Will definitely recommend 👌 💯
Neo Vape. Awesome service . Thank you
If you like quality products use Pine Hill butchers excellent
Love this place, been coming here since I was in year 7 am now 19 and still continue to shop here on a regular basis, great variety, great prices and Johnny is very friendly
The staff are amazing and they have some amazing international products.
VERY GOOD convenience store. Very good variety of groceries. Now also has a LARGE VAPING store for ALL your vaping needs. OPEN until 8h30pm. VERY happy customer.

Really good korean food. They're always jampacked with people willing to wait for 30 minutes during peak hours. Us included! We've tried so many dishes from their menu and everything we've tried was great. If you are willing to wait, you can walk around or do some window shopping in New World or Chemist Warehouse nearby. There are benches across the road too. There's Browns Bay Library too if they're still open.
Altang probably is the best I have in Auckland area, the fried chicken is also quite nice, and all the side dishes are very fresh. Highly recommended!

Been on a bit of a Korean craze these days for some reason. This is another gem. Why don't we have more good Korean restaurants in central :( Everything here is delicious. Please try it all. You won't regret it.

A Late and Deeply Disappointing Review: On Saturday, 5th of July 2025，my female friend and I each brought our daughters to dine at this restaurant. It was raining outside, and I entered the restaurant first with the two girls. At the time, there were no four-person tables available—only two small tables for two. I informed a male staff member that we were a party of four. He told us to wait a moment as a four-person table in the corner had just finished and would be available soon. I let the two girls sit at one of the small tables while I looked through the menu. About two minutes later, my friend joined us after parking the car. So, two adults were standing while the two kids were sitting, waiting for the table to be ready. Suddenly, the same male staff member came over and asked us to wait outside. I thought I misheard him and asked again, and he repeated, "Please wait outside." I asked why, and he replied, "Because it's too crowded inside." It was raining outside and we had two small children with us, yet he insisted we leave and wait outdoors. We were shocked and confused. It wasn't until we stepped outside that we truly felt how uncomfortable and unwelcome the situation was. Since we were hungry and with kids, we decided to leave and went to another nearby restaurant, Zero Japanese Ramen, where the staff were incredibly warm, professional, and welcoming. The contrast was stark. The service we received at 88 SongDo restaurant was unprofessional and felt discriminatory. As two women with children, we were treated in a way that was both dismissive and inconsiderate. If the restaurant was truly too crowded to accommodate us, we should have been informed at the door—not after waiting inside. I will not return to this restaurant again, and I cannot recommend it. Instead, I highly recommend Zero Japanese Ramen nearby. The young female staff there were polite, kind, professional, and hospitable. The environment was great, and we had a lovely dining experience.

Loved the backbone soup, it's my go-to place for it on the shore. The soup is rich and flavourful, the pork backbone is well chosen and prepared, no foul pork taste and no unnecessary fat, they give a generous serving of tender and meaty pork backbone.

Double Roast Fried Rice Combo – A Must Try! This place serves a seriously delicious fried rice combo — topped with juicy roast duck and your choice of BBQ pork or crispy pork. We also tried the deep-fried soft shell crab — crispy on the outside, soft inside, and full of flavor. Just a heads up, this spot is more for takeaway. There are only two small tables if you want to eat in, but for some of their dishes. it’s actually better to enjoy them fresh on the spot

Having grown up in Hong Kong, I often crave HK food, and JC Roast has been my go-to spot for takeout Chinese food. I’ve been happy with their roast meat as well, but I had to write a review about their Singaporean Fried Noodles. This was the best I’ve ever had, with the perfect amount of wok hei and curry seasoning. The noodle portions are so generous too, enough for two meals… except the Singaporean Fried Noodles I had today were too good that I finished them all in one sitting. Definitely recommend!!

Big fan of bbq pork, hoping I got a good meal out of this place. The workers were friendly though, even though english was very limited apart from 1 person. - Caramel black bbq pork on rice 6.1/10 Caramel had flavor, seeped into the rice, which was nice. Watch the chef pit my meal in the microwave to heat it up, which is kind of lazy. I wonder if he would have done the same thing if I got the roast pork, too. Average. - Shrimp Dumplings 4.6/10 Exteremely tiny. It's not worth $12 for 4. Well overpriced, and could get a bigger meal for that. Disappointing. - Sticky rice 0.0/10 Inedible. Was told it had pork and peanuts in it. When I cut in half, there was other stuff in it that was dehydrated. For $9, it was pretty disgraceful, and no doubt it was on display for a very long time.

One of the best Chinese takeaways my partner and I have had so far. We have been coming and trying different dishes and they always win us over. My partner and I have big appetites yet we think one dish is good for two people. The serving is really big and the food is delicious. I highly recommend the roast pork on fried rice and the roast duck. 💗
Extremely friendly staff and great service! Thank you to the kind staff for bringing water for my puppy. 🐶 I highly recommend this place!

This place is a buffet filled with very Korean-style dishes, reminiscent of homemade food just like mom used to make. I'm extremely grateful for the affordable price of $27. Of course, the food is also very delicious. I particularly enjoyed the red bean porridge and hard-to-find delicacies side dishes called 나물 (Namul). There are plenty of ingredients to make a great bibimbap, and the homemade-style sweet rice drink is truly the best. For dessert, there's fruit, bread, ice cream, and coffee available. It's of great value. Highly recommended.

Excellent authentic Korean food at affordable prices. Good servicesm serving size is large. The food is so yummy, highly recommended you give them a go. Plenty seating inside and lost of Korean customers so this means the food are great. Also the food and hygiene grade is "A". Alp the venue is family friendly. Staff are working fast and hard to keep customers happy. We had a great time there.

It's my third time visiting here, and the price is affordable $27(really happy with) for all day and there are many kinds of Namul dishes, so we can eat barley bibimbap with bracken(Gosari), radish, vegetables etc.. I can feel the sincerity of the owner from every foods. It's like reminiscing food. There are stir-fried pork and beef bulgogi which are good. We live in the east, so it's far away, but if there's something to go to north, we'll stop by this place and feel the taste of korean food. The bracken is so soft and delicious, and red bean porridge is the best. Sikhye also. If you think of a food you've eaten in Korea, make sure to visit this place. A very ordinary mother's taste! It's a buffet restaurant that reminds you of Korea. You will never fail. daughters of owner are pretty and kind. We recommended all.
Saturday 6ish. Meat dishes were all empty for like almost 30 minutes. Other food was ok but had to have other stuff while we waited for those dishes.

Personally I really like this place because it has one of the dishes that I crave for from time to time - marinated crabs! This dish isn't that common in most Korean restaurants here, glad this place has it and has done it quite well. When I miss marinated seafood of my hometwon, I come to this restaurant.

I’ve been coming to this shop for many years. Fish and chips used to be top-notch under the old owner, but the quality’s really slipped. Fish and oil don’t taste fresh anymore. In the past, two combos wouldn’t be enough for the family, now we can’t even get through one. Disappointed feedback from your neighbour

Snapper is fresh and well fried, decent size for the price. However they did forget to give us the crumbed snapper. Squid tentacles weren’t well fried, batter was soggy and came off completely. Sausage and Samosas were average Kumara chips tasted a little burnt.

Wow 🤩 wow wow… 1st time here…customer service incredible from the friendly young & knowledgeable lady on the counter to the gentleman that took my order all the way to my car outside who I think may have been the chef (don’t quote me on that) but we are soooo impressed. We are a very particularly fussy family when it comes to dining out… and I can’t rate this place enough… from the generous servings beyond what was ordered to the quality! Beautiful fish and chips (not oily), full proper fish fillets and the quality of chips were superb, not to mention the best pineapple fritters ever. Thank you very much and we can’t wait to return.

I recently ordered fish and chips and I can said the texture of the fish tasted more like jelly rather than fish and the fish so thin that I can only tastes the batter but not the fish, the batter is hard as rocks and the oil is dirty as well. Very disappointed I will never go back again.
The best and the freshest sashimi cut you can find in Auckland! Nice staffs, very helpful to choose what is best for you. You can even buy chunk of meat and bone yourself to have sashimi like I do 😊
I’m shocked - this coffee is better than most on the North Shore - only $3.50! Highly recommended, fast and hassle free. Location: inside laundromat, next to sushi. 24/7
Best coffee and soup , I highly recommend it 👍

You aren’t there for atmosphere, but food is awesome and service is super friendly. They make it for you if it’s not already made. And open late!! Whoop!! Have been back many times and will again. Great place for good sushi or cooked Japanese food.

food is good but service is sooooo bad. I stood at the bento cashier for over 5 mins but the 2 ladies just sit on the seats chating so I had to ask help from the sushi cashier. And I ordered tarayaki upon and they gave me crunchy chicken udon.

Paid $16 for an instant noodle, kids portion. Can not recommend it at all! The ramen they serve is literally an instant noodle, u can get it for $3 at the supermarket. Worst experience ever! Don't get scammed.
Cold and soggy chicken in karaage bowl. When requested new chicken got rude impatient service. Will never go back What a shame as Onehunga St Pierre’s is 5/5 everytime.

19/04/2025 -Oteha branch -The senior Asian female staff really needs to learn how to talk to their customer properly, the buzzer was ringing a little bit longer as I had to put my kid's shoes on. The way the staff talked to me was very impatient and it showed on her face. I was the only customer at the time around 16:40,First and last time visited.

Absolutely loved the food from Sapid – Authentically South Indian! We ordered takeaway last night and honestly, every single item was just mouth-watering. We got the Egg Fried Rice, Masala Tea, Paneer 65, Medu Vada, and Rasgulla — and we couldn’t stop eating! Everything was packed with flavor and tasted so fresh. What really impressed us even more is that they’re open until 12am, which is a blessing for people like us who finish work late. It’s so convenient and rare to find places that serve such good quality food that late at night. Definitely coming back for more!

Authentic South indian cuisime place. The dosas are too good. Tried Egg kothu parantha. A myst try. Amazing vegetarian options and also indo chinese cuisine. Something for everyone. We were a big group and everyone was happy for what they ordered. We went for theseconds too. The staff was really polite and helpful.I had the authentic filter coffee for the first time. Just yumm.

This place is great!! I’m so happy to have found it! I live in the North Shore and it’s difficult to go to Sandigram or other places in Auckland for good Indian or South Indian food and I was so amazed when I went to this place for the first time today and ordered mysore masala Dosa! It was really good. The chutneys were really nice, especially the mint chutney. The coconut chutney could have been better and The dosa could have been a bit bigger but otherwise really great first impression and I will come back.

I had the Biriyani, and Idli here and they tasted so good and authentic. Space-wise you have a few tables here but nothing to complain about as it's more like a takeaway. Also, remember that orders might take a while but are worth waiting for. Finally had the mango lassi and it had that wonderful taste. Will be back here again Food : 5 star and Excellent Customer service: Ok Ambience: Good

First time trying food at Sapid new restaurant in my area. Food was amazing. Best tasting and the flavour really got me with the fish dish I tried. Curry was very authentic and one of the best tasting butter chicken curries I've had. Service was great, greated and all questions answered being new to trying South indian Food. I will definitely return. Highly recommend 👌💯✨️

Kitchen is not well organised, we waited for about 90 mins but there were only 3 tables in the restaurant. Poor quality and quantity of food. Meat was too soggy, not taste like BBQ but stewed food. And I CANNOT believe they just split Taiwanese sausage into two slim pieces. And charge $3.5 for only half sausage. That is ridiculously stingy. Strongly not recommend if you do not want to waste your money and be upset.
The food was absolutely delicious, friendly service and the waitress were really kind. It worth to drive all the way down here even if there are many BBQ in central area
Good food but the serving took like 1 hour 15 minutes when I went.
Good service and delicious food.

The food is delicious and very cheap, but the lights in the store are a bit dim, which makes eating a bit depressing. The service attitude is also very good. Two people were full in just a few dozen. The taste is very good and the people are very nice.

It started out as a wonderful Saturday but unfortunately it ended badly with the worst takeaway dinner ever! Never have I ever experienced such horrible food. This was truly taking it to the next level. It almost felt like was given someone else's leftovers. The cost of the food was definitely over priced. Everything tasted bad and the quality was way under par. It is a shame how a restaurant like this can get away with this type of quality. Worst of all was the garlic shoots. Please have a look at the pictures. I thought the delivery driver ate. The portions were unbelievable. This entire meal cost about $89.00 This was a complete Ripoff! Save yourself... Never again! 😢

Came here with some friends since they were recommending it. Food was really good! The bbq skewers are a bit more expensive than the other similar bbq places but it's worth it. Bigger and better meat! Overall it was great and we'll be back again.
5 star taste! Fresh food. Don’t be fooled by the look of the restaurant. If you miss chuaner from China, this is the place.
First time i had chinese bbq in Auckland and wasn’t disappointed. All of them were nicely coated and just a delight in my mouth.
Unassuming location on top of a tyre company. However great food and open very late. Will be back.

May Eatery and Bar is a wee gem. Staff were welcoming and attentive. Good selection of wines on the menu. Our dishes were divine, perfectly balanced with flavour and freshness. The ambiance is equally impressive - chic, cozy and ideal for a memorable dining experience. Would definately recommend.

I had my 40th birthday dinner here and it was perfect. We booked out the entire outside area. Food was delicious and the service was amazing. All the staff are so friendly and welcoming. Such a pretty venue with the lanterns lit up on the ceiling and the cocktails were so good. I would highly recommend this restaurant for a birthday with a large or small number of guests.

Food was great. Favourites were the eggplant and chicken satay but everything was very nice. Staff were lovely and atmosphere is very cool. Would be good to have this place a bit busier as it is very good.

My partner and I have been to this restuarant on numerous occasions and we have never been disappointed. Last night the table was candlelit, music enjoyable, service spectacular and most importantly the food and drinks were delicious. Could not recommend this restuarant enough!

Lovely ambience and attentive service. However, food itself was a total letdown. Maybe it's just us as everyone else seems to think the food is wonderful. We didn't, as the dominant note in all the dishes ordered was sugar/sweet. Duck curry was sweet, shaking beef was lacked salt, and it was more sweet sauce vegetables with a sprinkling of beef, and the eggplant was also sweet. We ordered a small platter that had some redeeming options, i.e., the rolls were good as well as the salad. We couldn't taste any salt egg in the calamari as it was laden with sweet mayo type sauce. We were really disappointed. To be fair, it was probably catered to the Kiwi palette rather than the Asian palette. If you do want to try, please inform them of your preference. However, we won't return. Sorry.

I am shook I got this butter chicken it was so sweet like a dessert I am so upset had to drive 10 mins down the road to get me a butter chicken from my local Indian place and throw this in the bin it’s so watery like soup this is disgusting and the chicken is hard overcooked
Food here is fantastic and well priced god portions do yourself a favor and branch out the real currys (not butter chicken) are absolutely amazing

This place is a gem! I love their Indian food here Yesterday was the first time for me and my bf. We decided to try this place. We drove passed many times but couldn't help but notice there were always many car parks. I am a big fan of goat curry and my other half loves butter chicken. It is very tasty. Naan bread feels like real Naan bread. They put heaps of hearts and garlic! Try and share with me what you think of this place but for me, I am going back for more.🙂🥰

This is one of the best Indian restaurants I’ve been to in the North Shore and probably Auckland. The foods flavour was really good. My friends got a variety of dishes; and all tasted perfect. The meals were very reasonable priced, the portion sizes were large. During the meal, the kind lady (owner I’m guessing) asked us multiple times if we needed more rice or extras. There was a few other people coming in and out, as they were picking up their takeaway meals, which proves it’s popular with the locals. I have seen some of the other reviews and this place is deserving of them all. I definitely would eat here again!
Pretty good curries. I got palak paneer and the aloo naan (potato filled naan). Good vibes and service. Get a poppadom if youse never tried it before.
Man the food is so good here. The guy is super friendly and kind always. I am a regular and highly recommend. Quality meals and super fresh. I had a yummy crispy kebab tonight and it was good.

Rice is sticky and overcooked. Hummus smells a little old. Chicken and lamb are moist. Lightly seasoned and lightly sauced. Coleslaw isn't saucy it's just a salad. Overall, an average place for a kebab fix.
Amazing service & food! The workers were so kind and gave us complimentary sweets 🥰

I was suspicious about the number of 5 star reviews they had and thought it seemed fake but they are all well deserved. You get a crazy amount of meat and it's delicious. Be aware that you will get a lot of sauce on it, they happy to put on less if asked so ensure you say saying if you want a bit less. This is my go to kebab place, its reasonably priced, good value and delicious
Boss man is him. Great meat on chips. I like to put my meat on chips

Very nice pizzas, they taste just like what you would get in Italy, which is a rare find in NZ! They also have a vegan cheese option and the dough is vegan, as it should be. The owner is friendly and it was nice chatting to him. Highly recommended!

A very solid Spaghetti Bolognese. The service was great, as I called him in advance as I was on my way after work to have the food prepared. He did everything I had wanted and I'm very pleased with the food.
You can tell there's a real Italian in that kitchen somewhere. Beautiful pizza! Edit: I had to come back and mention the tiramisu. Don't share buy two.

Every time I passed by, the owner was so happy making dough and smiling while serving the customers that I was impressed, so I had to go there once~ and finally today~! When I said I was going to eat outside, the kindness of the staff even brought me tissues, and the fresh and delicious handmade pizza Highly recommend 👍

So happy to have found an authentic pizza place in Auckland/ on the Shore!! Thin base pizzas with fresh cheese and delicious topping options. Recommended for authentic pizza lovers, a taste of Italy ❤️

Clean store with plenty of free parking. Tried majority of the dumplings on the menu and my personal favourite was the Pan fried Pork Bao Bun 🤤 super juicy and lots of flavour. Noodles + other side menus were all delicious. The only downside to this place is the food is a bit slow to be served but the taste is worth the wait 👍🏻

Discovered this gem when visiting Woolworth's next door. Their freshly made dumplings are next level. The fresh dumpling skin is thin, meat well marinated and most importantly, the dumplings were incredibly juicy. The same goes with their Xiao lung bao and fried shanghainese dumplings, incredibly juicy inside. Just need to be careful not to burn yourself when you eat it. Other side dishes were average compared to the dumplings. It is a store that knows how to make authentic dumplings, whether it is steamed, fried or in soup. If you are craving for nice dumplings, then Sue's dim sum will not disappoint. Highly recommend it 🙂
very good soup bun and pan fried bun and pancakes! wish the shredded potato had more flavour (might be just the other carbs dishes were too good).
Best xiaolongbao I've ever had. It's really nice, I love it 😋 😋 Staffs were kind and food was very fresh. I left my umbrella but the staff kindly kept it for me. Thank you.
The Dimsum was tasty 😋😋 the restaurant was clean and service people are good.

We were first skeptical about ordering food as we had to do a lot of customisations to the existing food from menu, they were fine with serving us according to our need. Mexican chicken salad, and eggs on toast are hands down the best we’ve ever had. The lovely staff also recommended biscoff iced frappe to us, seems to be a new one, very thick and creamy. The portion amounts are so filling that we had to take leftovers, will definitely come back!

Always have great service here, food is amazing whether it's from the cabinet selection or from their menu. I love their alternative milk options being DF and enjoy how much options they have. Photo of French Toast and an iced coconut milk latte.
Absolutely loved the coffee and breakfast! Warm vibes, great service, and everything served with a smile. A perfect start to the day!

**⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Amazing Coffee & Great Vibes!** I absolutely love **Coffee Club Pine Hill**! The coffee is consistently delicious—rich, smooth, and always made just right. Their baristas clearly know what they’re doing! The food menu is fantastic too, with plenty of fresh and tasty options. Whether it’s a quick breakfast, a hearty lunch, or just a sweet treat with my latte, everything is top quality. The **TCC Big breakfast**are personal favorite! What really sets this place apart is the **friendly staff** and **cozy atmosphere**. It’s the perfect spot to catch up with friends, get some work done, or just relax with a great cup of coffee. The service is always warm and welcoming, making every visit enjoyable. Highly recommend **Coffee Club Pine Hill**—definitely one of the best cafes around! Can’t wait to come back. ☕️💛

Didn’t know that there is a cafe with good ambience and friendly staff nearby home this long! Anyway, I had a blueberry pancake today and it was a yum! It was actually melting in my mouth especially with that mascarpone on the top and no words about the sweetcorn rosti stack, double choc frappe and strawberry deluxe frappe. Definitely would be back to try variety other items!

One of the best sushi places on the Shore. Such an impressive selection of sushi, lots to choose from. Ingredients are super fresh and are of highest quality. Service is super friendly, so if you're looking for great sushi, try U Sushi, you won't regret it.

Tried the spicy chicken ramen and chicken skewers, both were really good. The ramen had a nice spice to it, and the skewers were cooked well. Also enjoyed the sushi with cream cheese, it was a nice touch. Would definitely come back again.
Our neighborhood and lovely asian ladies I support all my local business at all times AsDSM

Stumbled upon this little place, so glad we did! Staff were lovely, very welcoming. Sushi was great, so fresh (although I wish it was slightly more chilled, but this may only be because we went at 3pm and they close at 4). Great deals and good variety! Will be back

Some of the best sushi I’ve had in a long time. A wide variety of sushi and other dishes. Teriyaki chicken and beef get special shout out. Tastes different to St Pierre’s and other big sushi chains but taste homemade with no additional flavourings and colouring.

Hi all, we grabbed two Hell pizzas for lunch the other day – takeout, of course. It's definitely not Italian, don't even try comparing it! Honestly, it's way better than Pizza Hut or Domino's. Yeah, it's that American-style pizza. I ate a bit more than I planned (four stars for the American style, though!). Service was quick and easy, no problems. The Northcross one's just a takeaway place. Hope it was helpful, cheers (:

I recently visited Hell Pizza Northcross for a takeaway order and tried their new Tandoori Paneer pizza. I specifically requested that no meat be included, as it is currently a very holy month for Hindus—Shravan—during which many refrain from consuming any form of meat. The lady working at the store, who was also the manager, was incredibly understanding and respectful of my request. She assured me that she is vegetarian herself and personally prepared the pizza for me. The result was a delicious, perfectly made paneer pizza. I truly appreciated the care and attention she gave, and I highly recommend this place to anyone who prefers vegetarian options or avoids meat. Excellent service—thank you!

I had a really disappointing experience at this location. We placed our order online, but the website gave us an error message while we were ordering. So, we reloaded the page and ended up placing the order again by mistake. When we arrived at the store, one of the staff members noticed the duplicate order and kindly asked if we had meant to place two. He was understanding and seemed to get that it was a mistake. However, the situation quickly escalated when the manager stepped in. Instead of trying to help resolve the issue, he bluntly said, "That's your fault, you ordered it twice." When I asked him how many other people had placed the exact same order two minutes apart, he just repeated that it was "our fault" and refused to refund the duplicate. The order was $58, and we didn’t want two of the same meal. I even offered to accept store credit as a solution, but he refused that as well, stating it was "too big of an order" to refund. In the end, he just said, "Do whatever you want with the second order" and walked away. This was not only frustrating, but it also left us feeling dismissed and unappreciated as customers. I understand mistakes can happen, but the lack of customer service and empathy from the manager was disappointing. I hope this review helps others decide whether they wish to do business here and makes the store consider better ways of handling similar situations in the future. TLDR: Website error led to a duplicate order. Staff were understanding, but the manager refused to offer any solution, including a refund or store credit, despite us offering to work with them. Very disappointing customer service.

I'm extremely disappointed with my recent experience at Hell Pizza. As vegetarians, we ordered a paneer pizza, but to our surprise, they served us a chicken pizza instead. This was a major mistake, especially since we specifically asked for paneer. To make matters worse, when we brought this to the manager's attention, instead of taking responsibility and apologising, they started making excuses and shifting the blame onto the pizza maker. The manager was quite arrogant, even going so far as to say that "9 out of 10 pizzas are chicken, so mistakes happen". This attitude was not only unhelpful but also alarming. Their comment about most pizzas being chicken raises serious concerns about the risk of cross-contamination, especially for people with allergies. This is a major red flag for us, and we would be very worried about eating there again. We actually checked the pizza before leaving their premises, and it looked like it had paneer on it, so it was hard to distinguish the mistake at first glance. This just highlights the severity of their error and the need for better quality checks. As vegetarians, this mistake placed a massive burden on our conscience. Consuming non-vegetarian food unintentionally goes against our values, and we were really upset by this experience. Given the gravity of this error, the manager's unhelpful and arrogant attitude, and the concerns about cross-contamination, I feel compelled to give Hell Pizza the lowest rating possible. Avoid this place at all costs. Where team doesn't show leadership and take responsibility for their actions is an alarming signal of their culture and work practices.

This branch is great with making sure your order is correct and that you get generous toppings. Also very impressed with the gluten-free dairy-free garlic bread - so fluffy and just the right amount of spread to make it tasty but not greasy! When I thanked the duty manager for the customer care, he made sure to credit his whole team 👏🏼👏🏼👏🏼 Definitely recommend Hells Pizza Northcross for service and taste - thanks team!
Great hipster cafe, the staff were super and food delicious. Had the French toast that tastes great. Coffee was nice too
Amazing food and service! Beef cheek on Toast was amaaaaazing!! Started eating before I took a photo but hope it does the meal justice!!

Great dog friendly place, can go both outdoor and balcony seating. Nice and thoughtful staff and great food. The place is always busy during weekend, esp. their covered balcony, hard to find a seat if you pop in late.
My favourite cafe in Auckland - I come here every time I'm in NZ. Great coffee, light and space, nice range on the menu.
All the food we ordered was delicious, without exception. Staff were friendly and food came out very quickly and hot. Highly recommended and will be back again!

Ordered the lamb iskender meal. The pita was very salty and it only had cabbage, lettuce and carrot for the salad. I was expecting more salad such as tomato etc to be apart of the meal. The lamb was nice but I wouldn’t order this again
This place is mint, Large chicken on chips is the go to hangover meal after a big night on the piss. Great service and the workers are so friendly

Had an amazing experience at Even Kabab! The food was absolutely delicious, with great flavors in every bite. The place was spotless, which really impressed me, and the atmosphere was just right for a kebab shop—relaxed and welcoming. The service was super quick, and the staff were incredibly friendly and attentive. If you’re looking for a spot with tasty food, a clean environment, and fast, friendly service, this is the place to go! Highly recommend!
Really good and authentic tasting kebabs. Quick service and friendly staff. Easy access and lots of parking Some place to sit but not a lot.

We ordered 2 chicken on rice with extra meat. What we got was 98% rice. The amount vegetables and meat would have fit into the palm of your hand. Upon opening the tray my wife said “they can’t actually be serious”, it was that obvious. It was a total rip off & was beyond ‘taking the piss’. We wont be returning. Terrible business practice. You squeezed a few extra dollars profit from us, well done. But you’ve lost a returning customer & possibly a few more sales as a result of this review.

Nice little place I dicovered one late night and was very hungry. I left really datisfied after 2 of us ordered 3 dishes, and it was so good that we finished it in no time. I will definitely go back again. The Korean staff was really friendly and nice.

Very bad experience, we ordered large sashimi expecting at least three kinds of fish, it came up with thinly sliced ONE type of fish. We soon called the owner, his reply was: the bad weather, no fresh fish… you could of tell us when we order… who is going to spend $69 for just one fish. and the fish soup was spicy which did not state on the menu. will never go back again

Been waiting to try this restaurant out, and they certainly did not disappoint! The chef recommended us the prawn and kumara tempura, and they are so yummy!!! The prawn is very crunchy and chewy and I just couldn’t get enough of it! We also ordered a beef tartare to go, and it’s still really delicious after the long way back home. Really really love this place, the chef is really nice, would come back soon!! 🥰

Rude. I asked if there is any seat left and the answer is “no no no”? Excuse me? Update: Yes I came back for a meal when here is nobody, see photo for what I got for 15 dollars. Its even smaller than a 6 dollar fish&chips lmao
$20 corn cheese,half as much as any other restaurant…too small too little

Just moved to the area and tried the butter chicken last night. The flavour was amazing and there is so much chicken in the sauce! Cant wait to try more off the menu. Got 2x mild and 1x medium - the medium wasn't as warm as other I have tried. But still very tasty! Staff are super friendly! Price is excellent.

Curry is absolutely amazing! Never ever disappoint with the flavors and spice level. So friendly and accommodating when we wanna customize our order. And have thrown in extra things for free on multiple occasions. Not to mention they are so fast and have even brought out our ready food when we are waiting. Would highly recommend them to everyone!

Not only the best value but tastiest Indian I’ve had in New Zealand. As good as any Bradford/Birmingham curry house in the UK. Lunch deal is incredible value at $13, you will leave satisfied every time.

I'd highly recommend Handi for their curries, the biryani was not to the same standard, and that's somewhere they can improve. I have eaten at most curry joints in Auckland, spreading to far west and east, Tiffin is another great place but I'd say Handi actually surpasses the Tiffin standard. The curries are fragrant, balanced, packed with real ingredients to achieve an incredibly satisfying and familiar flavour. Lamb Bhuna, Butter Chicken, Tikka Masala, all highly recommended.

Definitely caters more to the Western palate and not exactly authentic, e.g. the 'spicy' options were very mild - however the food was tasty and definitely value for money + the service was v friendly.

Delicious meat and veg. Pork belly was very tender and had a good crunch on top. The roast potatoes are really good as well. Would definitely go back. Shared a medium roast and a roll between two and it was plenty of food.
Live roast shops. Meat great. Root vegetables would have preferred cooked a touch longer, but definitely worth coming back to.
It is my go to Roast dinner shop. I have been three times. I love the food
Dry pork belly, unfriendly unhelpful service and small portion sizes. Owners must have changed as they used to be OK. Workers are fine, manager/owner is piece of work. Avoid.

This is absolutely the best roast I’ve ever had in Auckland and hamilton. The lamb is so tender and juicy, potatoes crispy and soft on the inside, they choose the best kumara as well. Highly recommend this place! Also BYO containers to get $1 off!

Absolutely loved the Creamy Mushroom breakfast at 21 Grams. The mushrooms were so flavorful and the creamy sauce was incredibly rich without being too heavy. Everything was perfectly balanced, and the sourdough toast it came on was fantastic. Easily one of the best breakfast dishes I've had in a long time. The cafe has a great vibe too!

Absolutely delighted with our experience at 21 Grams! A hidden gem that’s both kid-friendly and seriously satisfying for the grown-ups. From the moment we stepped in, the warm aroma of freshly baked pastries mixed with rich coffee was simply irresistible. The menu offered fantastic dietary options, which made it easy to find something for everyone — even the picky eaters. My kids loved their meals and drinks (yes, they’re still talking about them), and I was genuinely impressed by the quality and flavor in every bite. If you’re looking for a spot that delivers on taste, comfort, and family-friendly vibes — this is it. A must-visit that we’ll definitely be returning to.
This corn fritter breakfast was delicious and beautifully presented, also only $20! I will be back x

A nice find in Albany. Self service french style pastries that look wonderful and taste great too. Brings back memories of the self service bakeries in Japan! Apparently everything is made fresh every day and they don’t put out anything left over - GREAT! Really rate the coffee too! Service was fantastic :-) Concrete floor and ceiling means it’s a little loud but I think that it’s worth it for the lovely breads. They do have a full menu which is an eclectic mix of classics like French toast and eggs Benny along with bolognese and chicken soba noodles. Prices aren’t cheap but quality is great. A great place to bring kids I think!

This is one of the BEST cafe I’ve tried in Albany area. Their flat white is amazing, the texture is so silky. Great food and dessert as well. Their lamb shank is a must try! Absolutely stunning❤️ Merry Christmas and happy new year. See you guys next year!
Cantonese Food in Northshore. Happy with the staff explaining with the menu. 5 of us dine with smile. Need to try the raw seafood if you don’t like raw staff take a bowl of soup :)
We only had the steamed rice dishes and they were pretty average compared to the other Guangzhou restaurants. But will try the signature raw seafood dishes next time. Service was good tho.
#Raw seafood# Chinese restaurant, famous in raw seafood, you can have crab, shrimp, sea snail which is served with different sauce. Recommend raw shrimp, especially the chinese style, a little spicy.
Cantonese style food. The food is below average I’d say, a bit expensive too.
Highly recommended their clay pot chicken with rice. And Great soup recipe.

Highly recommend this little gem! First time had Ga Ba Cai which was so yum. The pancake was pretty delicious and huge. The lady at the counter she’s very nice service is spot on! Will come back try other dishes.
The youtiao here is fantastic! Super crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. It’s not too greasy, and tastes just right. Perfect for dipping in tofu jelly. Highly recommend!
I ordered the wrap, which is pretty oilly. Soy milk is good, but just the size is too huge that I have to take it away.
Despite the language barrier, we were provided a traditional Chinese meal fit for a king. The dumplings were fantastic. If you leave here hungry, it is your fault!
Food is great but it's a little bit pricy all things considered.

Been to Speakers Corner and ordered a medium rare steak. Asked if the steak is pre-cooked, as I have on previous two occasions got steak that was not done to order (over). Got a medium done steak, at it's best. Asked to have it redone or money back. Manager says it's at least medium and cannot refund or give new steak! He absolutely refused to budge! This is the third week in a row and I didn't complain previously as a medium done steak is generally not bad. I really like this pub, but very disappointed with this .

Great place, loads of bars in browns bay but this one has a bit of character and the prices are the best around . Really nice friendly staff. Propa decent bit of food and portions are massive especially the hake and chips I think. If your just passing through I honestly recommend coming here for few beers and food.
Went here for the first time last Friday was a really good night great live band and good food and drinks look forward to next time

This my most visited place in Browns Bay. We always have same welcome and smiles on even all staffs are different. Well done guys you made us proud to be our best community Bar and restaurant and we appreciate your efforts and contributions towards us.

Just down the road from us. Had the mussels and calamari a few times and they rarely disappoint. Good atmosphere and live bands if you're into that. Had the tiger prawns tonight and unfortunately they were way overcooked. Could hardly get the meat out of the shells. I would also recommend their calamari special (calamari rings) over the one on the menu (calamari strips) as it's much more flavourful / tasty. Had you guys down for 5 stars but you lost a star for the nuked prawns.

Decided to come here after the Brown's Bay market on Sunday at about 11.20am. We were greeted by friendly staff and seated straight away. Tea was served straight away & it was good! Food trolleys started to arrive & wow did they deliver!!! Everything we ordered was hot, fresh & packed full of flavour! The best yumcha I have had in Auckland. It's awesome that they have prices on the menu, such a great price point too. The restaurant itself is so clean, spacious with a nice vibe. All of the servers were friendly and helpful. We each paid $30 and were so full after our meal. Will definitely be back. Thank you!😊

The taste of the food was OK but we suspected the oil they used wasn't too fresh; like those being reused many times. The free range chicken which was quite pricey, at $38 for half a chicken, but we suspected they used the free range old chicken, selling at around $10 for a whole chicken in Chinese supermarkets.
Best Yum Cha in Auckland. We've been going to this restaurant for years and it remains our family's favourite Yum Cha spot.

Every dish here is outstanding. We’ve been here so many times and tried a variety of dishes, and the consistency and quality always shows up! Shout out to Boss Jin and the crew for their hospitality - they do such a good job making everyone feel welcomed! Our top dishes: peking duck, steam blue cod, sweet and sour blue cod, lemon chicken (so good no pics obviously cuz we got busy), lobster noodles, salt pepper prawns, salted egg prawns etc

The best dim sum restaurant I ever had in Auckland! Tried many different restaurants but their foods were not as good and not as fresh. Asian wok is located in a good location with lots of shared parking spaces. The restaurant is clean and has a good layout. Their food carts were really fast. We were surprised after we sat down the food carts were already lining up to offer their hot foods. I am really impressed. Keep it up! The foods were hot liked coming out of the kitchen just for us. Baos were made perfectly soft and spongy. The fillings were lava liked. One of the best! I will definitely return for a great treat. You saw me. You will see me again and again. Lots of items for me to try. 'The Best'

I visited this gyukatsu spot with my wife for an unexpectedly special celebration. The place had a cozy, warm, wooden interior that felt very inviting. Surprisingly, it wasn't crowded for a Friday evening. We got a nice window seat tucked behind a tree, which added to the relaxed atmosphere. We ordered their popular 180g gyukatsu - it was tender and really reminded us of the kind we had in Japan. The dipping sauces were great, and everything came with a good variety of sides. We both loved it. It was more than enough for my wife, who had been feeling hungrier than usual. I went with the tonkatsu, which was a solid, crispy pork cutlet. I especially liked the nutty flavour of the salad dressing that came with it. As a starter, we shared the spicy cauliflower, which was just the right portion. The gochujang-based sauce paired nicely with it. Overall, it’s a great spot for a date - definitely recommended for couples or anyone looking to enjoy an authentic gyukatsu experience in Auckland.
Had dinner here and the steak was absolutely divine. The lovely staff guided us with how to prepare it and the saké pairing was just perfect. Would definitely go back again

I normally don’t write reviews, but I wanted to share some honest feedback with the chef. I ordered a few set menus which cost over $250+ and was really surprised by how extremely small the portions were. For each set, it was just three pieces of sushi, two rolls, and a few small entrées — with an overly sweet salmon served as the main, without rice. On top of that, they were out of dessert. Honestly, it didn’t feel worth the price.

We come to Ichigo Ichie regularly. If you value quality ingredients, a warm welcoming atmosphere then I highly recommend eating here. We normally take a Tapas approach and order the small plates, have draught Asahi each, and maybe a cheeky Sake to share. But Saturday we decided to try the Gyukatsu steak dish. Personally I don’t think it’s expensive. It’s an experience and a fun dish, as you cook your beautifully prepared steak on the hot stone. There are side dishes of pickles, rice and a crunch salad with delicious sauces as an accompaniment. Times are hard for small local restaurants. These guys have kept their standards, quality of ingredients and continue to offer fabulous service. Support local, so we can continue to be able to have these great local restaurants. Highly recommend. 🙏

First time visiting last night, and oh my! The food was absolutely beautiful. I went for the set dinner menu which is $75-85 per person depending on your choice of protein. Every dish that came out was beautifully presented and so fresh and tasty! The staff were very friendly and approachable. I will definitely be returning in the future!
Best Currie on the North Shore and I absolutely love indian. So that says a lot. Thank you for the consistency, great service and delicious food.
Very delicious food everytime we visit, great location and service. One of my favourite places to visit.

We were welcomed by friendly staff that was informative of the menus. Meals are on the large size. Our platter for 2 was more then enough but we had ordered a goat bunny chow as well as Chefs choice of curry Lamb Bunny chow had to take mine home. Food was well presented and bunny chow full of meat. Will definitely go back good value for money and beautiful food and friendly staff. If in need of a good curry Chicken Beef Lamb Goat Fish Seafood Vegetarian please go see Monsoon in Brownsbay

This place is by far the best indian restaurant in North Shore - curries made beautifully (from real stuff) and naans are to live for. If I got the death sentence, this will be my last meal - good portion - good price - yum
The best Butter Chicken I had! Lunch was very cheap and delicious. The staff were absolutely friendly too.

This restaurant is definitely one to not pass over. We've always wanted to try to eat here since it opened and finally we got the opportunity to! We ordered their mix appetizer which was a great offering, you get to try 4 different kind of appetizers so you'll know which one you'll like best. I personally loved the So Good Bread and pillow puff. We also ordered the Pad Thai, Roasted Duck Curry, and Honey & Almond Chicken Katsu. The Pad Thai was great, the roasted duck curry was bursting with flavor, and the chicken katsu was a lovely combination of sweet and sour sauce with an accent of almond. I definitely recommend this restaurant if you want to try Thai food with a fusion twist. The restaurant itself is quite lovely and the service was good. Definitely make a reservation if you're a group of 3 to 4. Lots of parking around as well.

such a hidden gem in Browns Bay! Very delicious Thai food, we tried the duck delicious, honey pork rib, kid chicken and noodles, green curry with chicken and roti with peanuts dip. No rip-off~ highly recommend

We had the most delicious, authentic dinner here last night 6 of us. The food was sensational with excellent service. We all had the mixed starters, beef brisket masam and beef and chicken cashew. The kids had an adults meal Bangkok fried rice ( enough for lunch next day for school). Was delicious!!! I only discovered this after reading the amazing reviews! Get out there and try it does takeout too!! Will definitely be back! Thank you for a truly tasty Thai!
All So GOOD!!!! I love how flavorful this Thai food is and the good vibes in Browns Bay, With sincere recommendations, a unique menu, and high quality, come with a reasonable price.
Found this little gem!! Was at the beach felt like thai. Googled thai near me. Was 2mins from my location! Glad I found it!! Amazing. Definitely try It out.

I was pleasantly surprised to find a highly-rated Thai restaurant nearby on Google. Though the restaurant is quite small, it's exceptionally clean. We ordered pad Thai, fried squid, and green curry - all of which were absolutely delicious. The food was fresh and beautifully presented. I'd particularly recommend it to locals; you won't be disappointed.

We had such a wonderful lunch at Osha Thai! Every dish we tried was full of flavor and beautifully presented. We ordered the Tamarind Duck with Rice, the Tamarind Pork Ribs, and Pad Thai, and each dish truly stood out. The tamarind duck was crispy on the outside, tender inside, and paired perfectly with the rich tamarind sauce and fresh vegetables. The rice served with it was perfectly cooked and fragrant. The tamarind pork ribs were fall-off-the-bone tender, coated in a tangy, sweet sauce that was absolutely addictive. Served over a bed of stir-fried vegetables, it was a perfect balance of flavor and texture. Although not pictured here, the Pad Thai was also amazing – classic, comforting, and well-balanced, with just the right touch of sweetness and zest.
Incredible food. By far the best Thai food in Auckland. The staff take so much care and attention to make the experience perfect. You must try it!

Osha Thai specializes in takeout, but we dined in their 3-table restaurant. We are renting an apartment in the neighborhood and it was highly recommended to us. The food is up to the highest standards. We really enjoyed Calamari, Duck Salad and Spicy Fish Salad. Finished with Mango Creme Brulee. All excellent. Very reasonable prices. The staff is nice but not attentive. Next time we'll just call ahead for takeout.😆
Wonderful meals. Friendly service. Lots of parking. We left with huge smiles and warm tummies

This Katsubi is always a favourite spot! Their vegetables/ toppings are fresh, the staff are friendly, portion sizes are amazing and food is so delicious! I always get value for money here, and love the relaxed ambience of the store. I strongly recommend for anyone looking for healthy, fresh and affordable meals. Hope to be back again soon!

Katsubi is always a favourite go to place for food. The ladies are smiling and have good attention. The brown rice is so yum, and has more choices of chicken, but the price have become expensive, $20 now for a regular bowl.
Generously portion size and so tasty. Also great service from a lovely lady!! Keep it up will back back!

I have only had Katsubi from the Albany Mall in the past which was good, so a couple of weeks ago I ordered the sweet and sour chicken and teriyaki chicken bowl on Uber eats. Most of this was thrown down the sink as the chicken was all small bits and hard as though it had been sitting for hours in a warming tray drying up, or the leftovers for the day. At 3am the following morning I was very sick for the next few hours with food poisoning, so luckily I had only eaten a little of the meal. The fried vegetables were pathetic raw slices of carrot, onion and beans. Never again will I order from here.
Simple stress-free healthy fast food. What’s there to moan about? Just go get your fix and support your local small business.

Discovered this fantastic Chinese restaurant tucked away in Browns Bay! Every dish I tried was outstanding. The **Guo Bao Rou** (sweet & sour pork) had the perfect crunch—thinly coated, crispy, and just the right balance of tangy and sweet. The **La Zi Ji** (spicy fried chicken) was a standout starter—succulent with an addictively crispy exterior. Also loved the **Dry Pot Cauliflower**—full of wok hei (that smoky stir-fry flavor) and packed with umami. And the *spicy beef with chilli oil? Generous portion with incredibly tender beef and a well-balanced heat—spicy but not overwhelming. Service was friendly, and the flavors felt authentic. Highly recommend if you're craving real-deal Chinese cuisine! Will definitely be
Good service by man. Ordered the Energy for the day smooth which is like a strawberry and banana shake $10 and a bubble Caramel $8.50.. amazing presentation and flavor.
#Chinese restaurant# Hot pots are really nice！There are lots of choices，pork、fish、or beef，each one is suitable for two persons. The whole blue cold is perfect！

I recently ate at this place with my family, hoping to get some good Northeastern Chinese food, but I was really let down, especially by their so-called signature dish, Guo Bao Rou. The meat had this weird taste—like, not every piece was bad, but every now and then, you’d bite into one that just tasted off. It’s not something you can ignore, and it totally ruins your appetite. On top of that, there was barely any meat! The slices were so thin that you could hardly tell there was meat in there; it was mostly just batter. Some pieces were so thin you wouldn’t even know there was supposed to be meat because it was all breading and no substance. I don’t know if I should be impressed by the chef’s knife skills or just disappointed in how little meat they use. All in all, it wasn’t a great experience, and I definitely didn’t get the authentic Northeastern Chinese food I was expecting. Not recommend!
Amazing pork dishes! Outside crispy and tender inside! Must try it!

The food was fresh, delicious and came in generous portions. The service includes ordering your meal via an app so that’s a little less personable, but the food came out quickly and the counter staff were friendly. Looking forward to going back and trying out more of the menu. The mapu tofu and the dumplings were very tasty!

Delicious Northeastern cuisine with a large portion. When ordering, the waiter reminded me that it was enough to eat, and the price was quite reasonable. The steamed pork buns were moderately sweet and sour, which was more suitable for my taste. There was a lot of Maoxuewang ingredients, and I really couldn’t finish it.

Very clean, the side dishes are exquisite and taste really good. I recommend their grilled fish, Maoxuewang, pickled cabbage and big bone pot, pot-wrapped pork and braised pork. They are all delicious. Will not step on thunder

I recently had a Vietnamese meal Bún Chả, Phở, and some deep-fried dough sticks. Bún Chả Absolutely the highlight of the meal! The broth had great depth sweet, salty, and tangy all in one. The grilled pork was tender, juicy, and packed with smoky flavor. Phở The pho was also really nice. The broth was light but rich in flavor, and the noodles were silky and smooth. It had that comforting warmth that makes pho so beloved. Deep-Fried Dough Sticks The only thing I was a bit disappointed with. The dough sticks were just okay—not quite the taste or texture I’m used to. They felt a little off compared to the ones I usually enjoy

A really beautiful restaurant, took me back to Vietnam The pho wasn't the absolute best I've had but it was pretty good. It was lacking the smell of star anis and that depth of usual spices. The beef noodle was delicious

We had two dishes, a char-grilled pork baguette and duck confit shiitake mushroom congee, and both are delicious! The baguette was crispy but not too hard, filled with pork, vegetables, and sauce, making it delicious without being overwhelming. The duck congee was unexpectedly tasty. I appreciated the ingredients inside, including shiitake mushrooms, dates, lotus root, and duck leg. It was rich in ingredients and reflected the care put into the cooking, feeling both healthy and delicious, providing a warm sensation when eaten. Additionally, the restaurant had soft lighting, creating a calming and cozy atmosphere, resulting in a pleasant dining experience.
Hidden gem for some delicious Vietnamese food. Super friendly staff and the meal came out fast and full of flavour.

One of the best Vietnamese restaurants in North Shore, offering an authentic Northern Vietnamese dining experience. The flavors are rich and true to tradition, making it a must-visit for Vietnamese cuisine lovers. Be sure to try the Egg Yolk Coffee and Pho.

Celebrated my son’s 11th birthday there with a large group. Everyone loved their food and the staff went to so much effort to make our evening perfect. Service was 5 star and the food was delicious. Had sizzling beef sirloin, pad Thai, red duck curry, tom yum soup and satay chicken - everything was delicious! It was BYO and we took our own cake. The brought the cake out with ice cream! So lovely and so reasonable. Thank you
Nice & Quite Thai restaurant in Browns Bay , very friendly staff ,food was excellent, best sizzling duck I ever tried.

Thai food that is incredibly tasty, genuine, and amazing, with the perfect balance of flavor, quality, and affordability. All of North shore's fantastic Thai eateries have warm, inviting service. I would strongly suggest this restaurant for lunch or dinner on a daily basis, especially for events of any kind.

Amazing Thai food!!! Kind and welcoming staff that will give great recommendations. Highly recommend the chefs specials, we got the sizzling pork belly and it was so delicious and good portion of pork belly and vegetables. Tom Yum soup is very flavourful and good meat portion. Overall, getting very good value and quality for money!

This is a little gem in Browns Bay - best, fresh, tastiest food with excellent service at good price. It's our go to, at least once a week. Favourites are the Satay chicken, red chicken curry, prawn curry - can't remember the name C7 but truth be told everything is amazing. And byo too if you fancy.

We celebrated our 40th wedding anniversary here, last night. The food, the service and the atmosphere were top notch. They made us a ‘dessert’ plate, to wish us for our anniversary. Which we really appreciated. Hubby had the pork belly, I had the fish. The desserts were yummy too. Highly recommend this restaurant for any occasion. Thank you.

Really love coming here with the hubby and teenagers for drinks and snacks and sitting at the high tables at the beach end. It's the kind of place you can dress up a bit more and not feel overdressed or stupid! Service is generally ok, the Chinese waiters are so nice and friendly. Snack food is super yummy. The decor is nice, really like the led lighting that changes colors and the bathrooms are nice. The screens are also great for the sports fans! The restaurant is lovely too and goes without saying the steaks are incredible. Love the relaxed but stylish vibe. Highly recommend 👌

Great place to enjoy steak, pricy with worthwhile come to try this for the first time. Kids meal portion is quite good and the steak tasted great. We had the T-Bone and had it medium well as we don’t like the blood and it was cooked to perfection. Staff are really nice the location is just next to the beach which the back entrance with the bar inside. Front entrance is the main dining area with the open kitchen. Recommend to book in advice as it is very popular.

Had a delicious dinner at 21 Days in Browns Bay! We had the Savannah eye fillet and beef rump. Both were cooked perfectly, super tasty and full of flavour. The eye fillet was so tender and the rump had a great sear on it. We got sides of mash, crumbed cauliflower and broccoli. All were really good, but the crumbed cauliflower was the star. So crunchy and yum! Awesome service and a chilled vibe too. Definitely keen to go back!
This has got to be on steak connoisseurs lists top 5 in Auckland. By far the best on the North Shore and surrounding. Consistently amazing.

We love this little restaurant! We've been a few times. The portion sizes are quite amazing for the price. One jianbing (savoury crepe) is actually enough for two people to share, especially if you order one with a meat filling. The bubble teas are delicious as well. Our favourite is the mango sago, but the other flavours are great too. It's nice that you can opt for different ratios of sugar in the teas - we get 50%. The people who work there are so friendly! Great value for money and great service. For those who have commented that the food takes a while, this is to be expected as each crepe is made to order - if you watch the process it's quite cool!

Ok, first off, this is FAST FOOD, however we waited 30 minutes for the preparation. We ordered 3 crispy chicken crepes and they make them one at a time, so if you are with a group, you cannot eat together. The crispy chicken was served with weird raw potato 'noodles' and lettuce. It was flavourless. We eat out all over, every type of cuisine and this was by far the weirdest lunch we ever had. None of us ate it. We all tried to pick the chicken out and threw the rest away. Waste of time and money. Definitely not for us.
Cute little spot that serves large tasty crepe sandwiches for a reasonable price by the beach

I recently visited Crepe Time and was thoroughly impressed! The crepes were absolutely delicious—full of flavor and generously filled. The portion sizes are large, so you definitely get great value for your money. Despite the big portions, the prices are very budget-friendly, which is a huge plus. On top of that, the staff is incredibly friendly and welcoming, making the whole experience even better. Whether you’re craving something sweet or savory, Crepe Time is the perfect spot. Highly recommend!
This little gem of a shop makes such yummy crepes. I visit probably too often, they are that good
We had a great dinner here! The food was amazing, some of the best we’ve had! Really cool vibe too, love love the sparkly picture on the wall - thanks so much
The best Indian food I've had for a long time the staff were attentive but not pushy .Nice atmosphere with background music.Plenty of parking but neds signposting. A most enjoable evening all round.
Hidden gem! Best Indian I’ve ever eaten. Super affordable, nice big generous portions and lots of delicious options! Couldn’t recommend this place more. Definitely check it out!

Recently got a combo deal from here and it was really good value. The butter chicken had a nice balance of cream and tomato, definitely one of the better ones I've had in a while. The food was ready in about 10 minutes, and the staff were friendly. A solid five stars from me. Also good price combos online, also available in store.

We have visited the restaurant under its former name, generally to eat in, which has always been a great experience. Decided to satisfy our mid-week curry craving with a takeaway, free delivery! We don’t live far from the restaurant but glad the meal was delivered with 20 minutes or so. We were ready for it! The mango chicken was amazing and plentiful, butter chicken was equally generous in size and flavoursome, the peshwari naan one of the best I’ve tasted, sweet and savoury in equal measure. Plenty of rice. Cost was not one to break the bank either. We would have no hesitation in ordering again and revisiting for a sit-down meal. It’s been a while! Thoroughly recommended and delighted to be able to support a fine local restaurant; can see why it’s five stars all the way guys.

Crunchy Crunch, Browns Bay – A Must-Try! I recently visited Crunchy Crunch in Browns Bay and had a fantastic experience! I ordered a burger pizza, and the taste was absolutely savory – a perfect combination of flavors. The pulled pork and beef were especially delicious, cooked to perfection, and packed with flavor. It’s definitely something I’ll be coming back to. My daughter ordered a corndog, and she loved it as well. The mozzarella was great, and I was impressed by the crispy fries slices that came with it. The chips are always freshly made, adding to the overall experience. They offer a wide variety of meals, including combo options that are perfect for family dining. If you're looking for a place that offers great food and a friendly atmosphere, this is a must-visit. You won’t regret it!

A top notch eatery. Super friendly and squeeky clean. Food came out fast and was delicious. My two vegetarian friends said the veggie burgers were delocious and for me the boneless chicken pieces were super yummy. Chips were fresh and crispy. Highly recommended.

First time trying this place and got Ubereats. I'm normally generous when it comes to the quality of food that's been delivered but had to write a review. I got the half and half potato corn dog and the batter was not fully cooked. You can see in the photo the liquid batter and it's definitely not cheese. My wife ate the first half with cheese in it and now we are worried she might get sick from eating raw batter while being pregnant. Never had this issue eating corn dogs anywhere else and I feel like they rushed cooking it because they were closing the store soon. Even the yangnyeom chicken had barely any sauce on it. Edit: changing to 4 star because of their response of taking responsibility. I dont require any compensation thanks.

super friendly staff members and the food came out pretty quick. we even got free sundaes! The fries and the corn dog was superb and would definitely come back for them. cute atmosphere for a quick bite with friends

5 Stars – A Sweet Crunchy Dream Come True! Crunchy Crunch absolutely deserves it! From the moment I walked in, I was hit with the amazing smell of fresh treats and sweetness in the air. The vibe was warm, clean, and super inviting—the perfect mix of chill and fun. Now onto the best part: the ice cream and toppings are next-level. I tried their signature combo with honeycomb and caramel popcorn and WOW. The texture was perfect—creamy, smooth, and balanced out by the perfect crunch in every bite. It wasn’t overly sweet, just super satisfying. The staff were also amazing—friendly, welcoming, and clearly passionate about what they’re serving. They gave great recommendations and were patient while I took forever to decide (because let’s be real, everything looked fire 🔥). It’s clear they care about quality here—fresh ingredients, generous portions, and everything is super well-presented. Even the packaging was cute! Whether you’re treating yourself or taking your friends, Crunchy Crunch is the spot. Can’t wait to come back and try more flavors. Easily one of the best dessert places I’ve been to in ages!

French Delight in Brown’s Bay! This adorable café brings a touch of France to the heart of Brown’s Bay. The croque-madame is delicious, the coffee is smooth, and the atmosphere is warm and welcoming. Friendly owner, charming décor, and authentic home-made French flavours make it a must-visit spot. A perfect little escape for anyone craving a taste of France!

Wandered in after browsing around the market today. Never been here before, but will definitely be going back again next time we’re out this way. The food was fabulous. Loved our meals; cheese omelette, mushroom croque and beef dish. Coffee was full-bodied. Big pot of tea for my mother in law (made her very happy) and the banana milkshake was fresh and yummy. Service was faultless. The couple on the table next to us were “complimentary regulars”. Perfect experience, thank you. 10/10 :-)

Food here is delicious!!!! I had the avocado toast with smoked salmon and an iced coffee and it was all perfection. Sat outside in the sunshine and enjoyed our meal. Service was quick and friendly, dealt directly with the owner/baker. Would definitely recommend stopping here for a quick coffee and breakfast/lunch if you’re near Brown’s Bay!

This is an amazing place to have your coffee and waffle with friends. We tried Belgian waffles with salted caramel it was delicious 💖and yummy . The coffee also was delicious. This cafe gives you a very nice and warm feelings from the owner and the staff member. The prices are very reasonable. Highly recommend this amazing place
Great intimate café. Had a really good coffee and treated myself to something sweet — absolutely delicious. Friendly vibe and a lovely spot to relax.

We came in as lots of 5 star Google reviews. No one at the rest when you sat down. Ordered quite a bit of food cost $74. Service nice, food was not that much. Milkshake is melting and too sweet, burger was cold, meat patty was burnt, the t bone was also burnt. The 3 chicken was the best but it didn’t balance the whole meal. $74 was expensive too. Sorry I can’t give more than 2 stars honestly as the photos below tell a thousand words. Hopefully this place can improve otherwise it’d sad to see it goes….

Super delicious & fresh! Great prices, Highly recommend stopping in for a real burger that will actually fill you up! Worth a visit, definitely be back. Don’t mind the half eaten picture, got too excited!
We had caramel milkshakes (which were lovely and thick - kids loved them), maple fried chicken and chips. Generous portions, freshly made, nice and tasty.
I had a chicken burger and mozzarella sticks. The burger was delicious, chicken was juicy with a crispy coating. Yummy mozzarella sticks and lovely customer service. Looking forward to coming back 😁
Chicken was okay - the sauce was a bit too sweet for my taste. The service was excellent!
