Located on the second floor. Appears like a typical Chinese restaurant with a lovely view of the sea. Complimentary Chinese tea. Fish soup and claypot brinjal were great. Maybe I'm used to stronger flavours but I thought the fish soup could do with a splash of XO. Ordered the chicken rice (just the rice) to try. It was tasty but people who do not like ginger may not like it.

"Delicious Food, Great Atmosphere—Fish Noodle Soup is a Must-Try!" We recently visited Sri Ahkota in Browns Bay and had such a wonderful experience that we had to share it! This restaurant is a sister location to the Sri Ahkota in Epsom, but we found this one even better in many ways. Located right in the heart of Browns Bay, it’s super convenient if you’re in the area, and the restaurant itself is much bigger, offering a more comfortable and spacious setting to enjoy your meal. The seating is great, and there’s plenty of room, which made for a more relaxed and enjoyable dining experience. As for the food, it was just as delicious as we’ve come to expect from Sri Ahkota! The flavors were spot-on and consistent with what we’ve enjoyed at the Epsom location. The fish noodle soup was the absolute highlight of the meal—an absolute killer dish! It’s incredibly flavorful, rich, and just hits all the right notes. If you’re a fan of noodle soups or looking for something comforting and packed with flavor, this is the dish you can’t miss. We would come back just for that alone! The rest of the menu was great too, with solid options across the board. While the other dishes were fine and enjoyable, the fish noodle soup really stood out and made the meal memorable. It’s clear that this is their signature dish for a reason. The service was friendly and efficient, and despite the restaurant being a bit busier than expected, the staff handled everything with ease, ensuring we had a pleasant dining experience from start to finish. Overall, we had a fantastic time at Sri Ahkota Browns Bay, and it’s definitely a place we’ll be returning to whenever we’re nearby. Whether you’re a local or just passing through, we highly recommend stopping by to try their incredible fish noodle soup and enjoy the comfortable atmosphere. We’re looking forward to coming back again soon!

The best Malaysian in North Shore. Been looking for a nice authentic Malaysian restaurant and I think I have found the right place! Every dish we ordered were all authentic & delightful. This restaurant has an inviting ocean-view seating area outside, a perfect backdrop for your meal. The staff are prompt and friendly - they will kindly give you recommendations if you ask. Highly recommend :)

Authentic tasting Malaysian Restaurant in Browns Bay. You enter on the ground floor and up some stairs. There is some view of the sea from the terrace. They have big tables, as well as smaller ones. The food came out fast and is really tasty. Good atmosphere and decor
large portion good taste nice friendly staff plus Seaview. 👌

I'm from London and had this on the beach , honestly best sushi I've ever had . Better than Soho places and so much better than itsu. Massive pieces, very flavorful especially the chicken teriyaki one. I was very impressed and I'll definitely have this again on my travels.

I’ve unfortunately only gotten the opportunity to go here once while I was traveling for work, but i’ll forever be grateful for this experience. Not only is the food amazingly mouth watering but the customer service and atmosphere are incredible. I was going through a very rough time in my life and if it wasn’t for this lovely place I probably wouldn’t be here. Much love❤️

always lovely to come here and get my suishi. The lady at the counter is very accommodating to my allergy to gluten and tells me which ones are gluten or not. Also provides gf friendly soy sauce. Great customer service as well always a smile to see when walking in.
Best Sushi period. Don’t go anywhere else. Bay Sushi is where it’s at.
My favourite sushi place in browns bay. Well made, great prices, and kind staff

It was recommended by a friend. Great service and lovely atmosphere. This restaurant is one of the best dining restaurants I’ve had in NZ. We ate Chef’s recommendations and enjoyed all our selections. The food tasted great. You can tell that the chef is very passionate about what he is doing. Food great, service great and environment is clean making the experience really special and really memorable.

This place was great, surprisingly! The Dandan noodles, in particular, were outstanding – served generously and at an affordable cheap price. I opted for the dry noodles, and the sauce, neither too salty nor too mild, was quite addictive. The thick noodles blended perfectly with the sauce, creating a delightful taste. As a fan of Chinese food, I thoroughly enjoyed this dish. The dumplings and 锅包肉 (guōbāoròu) (I wasn't sure its English name - it is sweet and sour pork crispy version) were also yummy and satisfying. Highly recommended to those who love Chinese food and in Browns Bay.

We packed some food to take home for Friday night's supper, and it was absolutely delicious. The crispy sweet and sour pork was perfectly crunchy without being greasy. The Sichuan-style spicy pot was flavorful but not overwhelmingly spicy, and the dumplings, as always, were our favorite staple. Having such a delightful supper on a Friday night was truly satisfying

I used to go to the Basu lounge a lot. Now they changed the owner. The waiter isn't very friendly with a little kid. When I placed the order without paying in advance, the staff just gave me a strange look without saying anything. I don't think it's very polite, as it used to dine first and pay later. Even the surveillance cameras work over there, I don't think they could record what the staff said to me. I won't go back anymore as I've never been treated like that before.

Amazing Sichuan style noodles and dumplings. Food was served with a generous portion and inexpensive price. Relatively low wait time as well if you are after quick Sichuan style lunch/dinner you can not go wrong with this place. Must try the beef noodle and chicken dumplings. Do be careful with the spiciness level because it was even mild was HOT.

I was surprised that the sushi was very big and had a lot of fillings, but the price was so cheap. Thank you for selling such delicious food at a reasonable price. Yummy!! The staff was also very friendly.

The salmon sushi was so fresh tasting. It was nicer than some expensive sashimi I've had at some other places. I ate it all so quickly and went back for more pieces... Very affordable, tasty and extremely friendly staff. Thank you!
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐Hands down Biggest! most crispy fresh ! and crazily best priced sushi in Tamaki Makaurau excellent selection friendly service with a smile I highly recommend
This is a fantastic sushi shop. Fresh great tastes with good pricing. The salmon is awesome and the owner clearly takes pride in his little shop and food quality.

Yum! I love Neco Sushi :D The sushi never disappoints. They have an abundance of fried foods in the cabinet. Plenty of vegetarian sushi as well. The nigiri nearest to the paying counter is the best! It's seasoned well and the rice is well cooked. Really friendly staff.

Delicious food! We keep coming back and my ultimate favorite would be the Soto Betawi. Creamy soup with the softest beef chunks was just a dream to devour. All of the dishes we've tried were really good and such a treat to your taste buds. Customer service is great too, the restaurant is clean, plenty of parking around, and very close to browns bay beach.
Price is a bit too high regarding the taste. Food looks nice in the plate but not good enough for the price. The people there is very nice though.

my 3rd time coming here and this time, i brought my husband’s family. i was so sure that they would love the foods here and my instinct was correct! they all loved the foods a lot. they kept saying that the meals were awesome when we went back home. this restaurant has been my fave one everytime i feel homesick and they never disappoint me with the taste! :) i would love to recommend the mie goreng, satay and meatballs with rib. if you like spicy foods, sambal is a must!

A must-try for anyone looking to explore Indonesian flavours! We had the spring rolls, crispy chicken, beef rendang & mie goreng dish 😍. Absolutely enjoyed all of them right down to their chillis. Definitely be stopping by again when in the area. The staff are very friendly as well & thank you for the free desert 🤩 LOVE IT!

The most delicious and authentic Indonesian Restaurant in Auckland. The staff were friendly and welcoming. We enjoyed every meal we tried especially the Mie Goreng, already planning our next visit. Don’t give this local gem a miss
Order a salmon egg bene and a omlette. Bene was great, omelet was pretty bland in terms of presentation. Beautiful views of Browns Bay beach

Grade A!! Nice little water front spot and prices have increased from the last time we were there few months ago. Enjoyed our meal and coffee was delicious. Parking: you’ll be lucky to get one close by, took a while to find one and nearly gave up but found one just as we were about to drive off. Ordered Salmon Eggs Benedict $28.50 Bacon Eggs Benedict $27 Ice Coffee Frappe $8 Ice Chocolate Frappe $8 Mochaccino in a bowl $7.50 And soft drinks for $3

**View and Space** This coffee shop offers a good sea view and a spacious environment, making it a pleasant place to relax. **Coffee Quality** The coffee is average, nothing extraordinary. **Service and Staff** The staff are friendly, contributing to a welcoming atmosphere.

Highly recommended! Today, I took my family to visit The food is delicious, the quantity is very big, the staff is very enthusiastic! Ingredients are purchased fresh every day, and the delicious sauce is cooked by the chef himself. great coffee! BROWNS BAY's must-see cafe is the perfect place for a small lunch break.

unless you want a trip to the dentist don’t get the eggs bene as the bread is hard enough to chip a tooth. The whole point of eggs bene is for the eggs to be runny and they were the complete opposite, they were so hard and overcooked that it literally bounced off my plate. The service was also terrible, we waited 30 minutes to be served to the point where we had to go up to the counter to order where the waitress said “oh yeah, are you guys ready”. do not recommend this place.
Thoroughly enjoyed this cooking class and definitely recommend! Noriko was absolutely sensational and lovely. The food was amazing and all the pottery was very beautiful/cute.

Had a really lovely time with Noriko today making very tasty sushi. Was such a pleasure getting to learn how to make sushi and having traditional Japanese tea. Noriko's cooking class was a fantastic way to spend the afternoon making amazing food! The workspace has a lovely feel to it, making it a great environment to cook, eat and enjoy good company. If you haven't checked out the classes at Washocook already I'd definitely recommend it! :)

I had a wonderful time with Noriko learning how to prépare and cook Japanese food. My husband and I recently returned from a 3 week holiday in Japan. We so loved the food that I decided that I should learn how to cook it. WashoCook was the answer. Highly recomended.

Their step by step instructions along side the detailed handouts are well designed and easy to follow. Add on to the delicious meal prepared is also the knowledge of three different types miso ( I originally thought there were only two of them!) Great learning experience for me thank you so much!!!

My teenage son and I had a wonderful experience learning the art of Japanese Home Cooking with Noriko. The techniques, tips and explanations around product ingredients and the links to the Japanese culture made the evening really interesting. The dishes we created were varied and delicious - we can’t wait to take another class! Noriko is a great teacher and the venue feels like you’ve been transported to Japan for an evening. Highly recommend.
Food was incredible.

Service should be in order no matter how busy for fairness and customer satisfaction. Slow service followed by very quick plate cleanup is not appreciated. Coffee and cabinet food was good however. Sun 11am.

Come here often for my daily caffeine fix. The place is always busy with a good atmosphere, which is no surprise given the excellent coffee and drink variety. Staff are great and the food is good too!

Amazing restaurant, totally recommend! I came to this restaurant earlier this year and oh my was it amazing! First of all the atmosphere is very clean and well cared for, and the staff were very polite and good at their job. The food tasted amazing, especially the syrup chicken! The pasta also tasted great. The only complaint I have is that the wait was too long for the food! Overall please give this restaurant a try, it's worth it!

We originally planned to visit another café, but it was closed, so we spontaneously ended up at Common Ground nearby. Let me just say, we were absolutely blown away! The portions were generous, the ingredients were incredibly fresh, and the flavours were out of this world. Honestly, this was one of the best breakfasts I've ever had. The service matched the food—warm, attentive, and inviting. In the photo: a shakshuka that's not your traditional Middle Eastern style but is absolutely delicious. We'll definitely be coming back!
Ate Breakfast here. Bacon and egg roll was good however in need of some sauce. Coffees and hot chocolate were both great. All in all good experience with lovely staff.

Great location. You can sit outdoors and see the sea. Excellent coffee and friendly owners. This our favourite place for coffee while out for a walk. It’s the best nearby. The breakfasts are good. I get the omelette which has good fillings.
I had a flat white and French toast there this morning, and both were amazing! The staff were super friendly, and the flat white was one of the best I’ve had. Highly recommend this spot!

A very cozy and relaxing cafe! 👏👏 The outdoor seats provide a close view of the sea. Coffee and food are delicious. Several parking spaces are available in front of the cafe. Great location, just across the bay.
Friendly staffs and tasty coffee! Best flat white and latte that I've ever had.
My first time been there, their pumpkin soup surprised me, delicious! their decaf coffee is amazing! plenty of carparks, Murrays bay just across the road, Highly recommend and I will be back again.
Without a doubt the best Indian cuisine I've ever had. The atmosphere is excellent!. The husband and wife owners really make you feel part of the family. I will keep coming for another 15+ years

Amazing Restaurant!! The owners are the most loviest people you will ever meet! The restaurant has a warm homely feel to it and the food is incredible!! We loved everything that we ordered and we highly recommend the honey cauliflower and the tikki chaat as a starter, you have to try the butter chicken it was the best by far compared to other restaurants! And the chicken vindaloo was perfect! Everything had an amazing flavour and the spice levels were perfect! We look forward to dinning in again very soon !

I am a world traveler, you can see my other reviews and I don’t say this lightly when I say that this place is the best Indian I’ve had outside of India. You really have to give the Chicken Tikka Masala a try. The owner is so friendly and can tailor the flavors and spice for your own needs. I can’t recommend this place enough!!

The two indian brothers that run this place are very attentive and professional, and service is top-notch. I've been a few times and rate it as one of the best Indian cuisine (& Thai fusion mix) curry houses on the north shore. Food is outstanding, has a very tasty and subtle blend of spice and melt-in-your mouth meat and crisp veg, and is now our favorite place to relax and have a kingfisher on tap. There is also another place upstairs, above them thats always quite busy, which I don't rate at all. Right next to the sea, good for a walk off them superb and delicious calories afterward.
The food was delicious! We had the Chicken Mango Curry and Fish Madras Curry, they had so much flavour! Would highly recommend. 5++ stars. We didn’t take any photos because we were too busy eating!

Shop: open, spacious, clean Staff: friendly and patient to explain the different options and self-service system Sushi: There are plenty of options from fresh salmon and tuna to inari pockets and fried chicken nigiri Personally, I don't eat raw fish, so this place is great with their different cooked fish/fried chicken/fried shrimp options. There's also a fried food snack cabinet if you're craving a little something extra minus the carbs. The tamagoyaki sushi was absolutely en pointe, and the tuna inari pocket was a burst of flavours - sweet, salty umami all at once! Price: it depends on what sushi you get. They have a pricelist available. (Photo -$6; huge tasty sushi!) Wheelchair accessible and available on 4 delivery apps! They also have a platter option if you're planning for a party. I highly recommend it and would definitely be back for more!

Lovely sushi spot! 😊🍣 Wide range of inventive and well made maki, nigri, gunkan & inari 🍙 It’s a small place with a hot & cold selection, great staff, nice decor and relaxed vibe. I was impressed with the quality of the rice, avocado & chicken. The portions were big but well balanced.

My first time eating this sushi and it is absolutely delicious! They very nice portion sizes and use high quality, flavorful ingredients ~ I recommend the Sushi Tacos - such a nice treat, nicely packaged, delicious, SUPER crunchy they absolutely nailed the texture, and it's super easy to eat. I would give you more stars if I could for the food, this is the best sushi I have had in New Zealand for the price, and I've eaten at michelin restaurants. I hope that your chefs and ingredients stay the same for a long time because I'm going to be eating here a lot. Thank you for the amazing food today!
So delicious and fresh! The best sushi! Grilled salmon is just wow🤩😍 We have a tradition to eat there on weekends and it’s always so good!
Yummy and crisp fried prawns. This is not proper sushi rice and is favoured. The rice is too soft and does not stick.

I went here last night with my friends, and we all loved the food. The seafood pasta 5 stars. We were shocked at how everything tasted so high-end, yet the food was actually affordable. Now I understand why this place is so popular their food is incredibly delicious!

Had a fabulous dinner for 3 at La Spiaggia on Friday evening. Great setting, great vibe and amazing food. Few smaller things that could be done better but overall a delightful experience. Would definitely recommend. Would definitely be back...still plenty of items on the menu to work through :)

Our all-time favourite spot - amazing food and such a chill vibe. Maria, Stef and all their staff are fabulous, always making us feel super welcome and taken care of. Every time we go we have the best experience. Sunday night was no exception with a new snapper dish to indulge in - absolutely delicious!

The best Italian restaurant I have eaten so far. Went there last Friday night at 8:30 with 15 mates. It was full packed - which just shows that people love the place. We tried to order different dishes so we could try them. If I were to mention the best among the pasta and pizzas that we had, for the pasta, it would be the Linguine Marinara (ugh the best!) and for the pizza, I enjoyed the Pear & Proscuitto, but everything I ate/tried was delicious. Happy with the serving sizes - suits the prices. Well done, chefs! Special mention to Chef Kim! Wohoo

Excellent staff and service. Very accommodating to our late arrival for a quick dessert Maybe one of the best creme brulee around. Tiramisù was equally as good and not a cheap knock-off I am looking forward to having a meal there soon

This is my new favourite restaurant in Auckland. They have the best quality skewers ever. We have been coming once every week for the past month and always leave with full, happy stomachs. Quality of meat is so good - highly recommend getting the beef and pork belly skewers - and the prices are so cheap! Look at that seasoning! Spicy dumplings and scallion pancakes are our go-to sides. Have yet to try the XLB or noodles so will get them next time. PLEASE don’t ever change!!

New fave Chinese restaurant in Browns bay. Skewers were moist and delicious. Xiaolongbao was surprisingly very good (much better than many north shore places) but the scallion noodles was the best. Highly recommend
The xiao long bao (soup dumplings) were excellent, as was the service. The atmosphere was really pleasant and welcoming too. Will definitely be back to try more of the menu

Super yummy food, great service and vibes! So stoked for $1 bao buns!! Everything is really well priced and well made- thank you so much 😍🥰 Sometimes they sell out of specific dishes in the afternoon so book ahead or get in early
Really good Chinese noodle and bbq place. Friendly staff and affordable prices. We will definitely be back soon
Wow ..had a amazing delicious food.. and great atmosphere in side the restaurant.. guys come and check this out place
Fantastic food, friendly service with a smile. Will definitely dine here again.

Came here for dinner and the laksa was completely delicious. The Thai green curry and Thai red curry that my friends ordered won though they were so flavourful and delicious! The service was fantastic and we even got a complimentary dessert. Love the plants and decoration, the only downside is that not enough people were in here enjoying the fab food and service. Will come again 100%

Called in for a late afternoon coffee with friends. The lady taking my order did not know what Earl Grey Tea was so I ordered a Cappuccino with trim milk. My friend ordered a Green Tea. We were pleasantly surprised when the table was give a complimentary cheesecake and icecream to share. However we weren't so pleasantly surprised to find that we were charged a dollar extra for trim milk and $10.50 for a pot of Green Tea.

Went for coffee and ordered off the brunch menu - also ordered chips for hungry kids. The wait was so long - after asking where the food was it came out minus the chips. When we had finished still no chips we told them to forget them and they refunded the money for those. The cafe wasn't busy so don't know ehat the problem was.

A BIG shoutout to Lily’s asian fusion. I would totally recommend this place! The owner Farah was so humble and went way beyond to give an amazing experience & service right from the time we entered, seated, served and while leaving. Food was Fantastic and is value for money. Presentation & ambience is like you are at a high end. Thank you so much and we look forward to visiting you guys again :)

Finally made it into this beautiful little restaurant. First of all, the interior is beautiful. So relaxing, well lit. The staff is so sweet and helpful, I really felt like there was a happiness about them and that they enjoyed their work. Then the food - OH MY. Roast duck, Peking duck, soup dumplings, Sichuan pepper squid - everything was beautiful, flawless and so yummy! I will definitely be back. House wines are gorgeous also. My partner and I are so happy with our experience! I wish this business a long and successful future ❤️
Highly recommended! I went to Lily’s Fusion restaurant recently for the first time and will definitely go again. The quality of food is great with very warm and friendly staffs. Don’t miss it:)

Good choice for family and friends catch up. Taste: 5 stars, portion and taste are proper Environment: 5 stars: clean and tidy Service: 5 stars, friendly and welcomed Recommendation: Fried rice/ Spicy beef / Paper deep fried chicken nuggets/ sour and sweet pork with pineapple

Here is the new gem I have found recently for Chinese food. The place looks clean, tidy and feels very cozy. Food here is among the best Chinese food I have ever had in Auckland. Will definitely come back!

We were the only group on a Monday at 7:30pm. Service was friendly. The food took a while to come out, but the drinks were fast so that helped. We each enjoyed our dish. I had the Lamb Kofta Charcoal dish. It was tasty and very filling.

Fabulous dining experience at Brother’s Bar and Eatery!! The food was so delicious and I thoroughly enjoyed trying the multi cuisine. We ordered the special lamb shawarma and the charcoal special platter for two. The food was excellent and kept us full and satisfied. The coffee was a bit interesting as I’m unsure if it’s a middle eastern type of coffee? Wouldn’t really recommend coffee. The service is great and I’d really recommend this eatery!
Experience was so great came out the next week. You won’t be disappointed if you order the eggs Benedict, avocado smash, chicken and waffles, or crème brulee French toast!

*5/5 Stars* I'm absolutely hooked on Brothers Bar and Eatery! Their coffee is top-notch, and the atmosphere is so serene and relaxing. The staff are super friendly and always greet me with a smile. The interior is lovely, with nicely laid tables and fresh flowers that add a touch of warmth. Their menu is awesome, especially the fresh date scones with real butter - absolute heaven! Whether I'm grabbing a quick breakfast or meeting a friend for a casual coffee, Brothers Bar and Eatery is my go-to spot. The service is always great, and the staff know their regulars by name. If you're looking for a chill spot to enjoy a cup of coffee in the morning or early afternoon, look no further.

My kids wanted breakfast out. Their menu was exactly what my kids felt like. The coffee was lovely and my breakfast was delicious! My daughter said it was the fluffiest pancakes ever! And my son LOVED their bread, even asked for another slice! We'll be back to try other dishes.
The ramen is always amazing here @ Zero. Great atmosphere and service. The Chicken Karage super crispy and juicy. Truly amazing. Give it a try whenever you're around Albany or Brown's Bay.

I came here with my family, and each of us ordered a different type of ramen, along with a sashimi platter to share. The sashimi was very fresh the thick-cut tuna, sweet shrimp, and salmon were all delicious, especially with a bit of wasabi on the side. I had the Hell Ramen. The flavor was good, but personally, the spiciness didn’t quite reach the “sweat-dripping” level I was expecting from the name it was more of a mild heat that most people could enjoy. i think？ The pork slices looked few at first, but they were actually quite thick and satisfying. The tofu was especially tasty soft, tender, and full of flavor. Definitely worth trying! The staff were attentive and polite, even giving us a heads-up about the last call for extra orders. The restaurant was clean and had a cozy atmosphere.

The soup broth was delicious - may have been the best I've ever had. Good size portion and very filling. Noodles has a nice bouncy soft taste to it and really complements the soup. Gyoza was great too! Service was excellent. Extra noodles at $4 is a good size portion. They also have a kids area. Highly recommend!
It was my first visit. Tonkotsu ramen was so~ delicious. I loved the menu with lots of eggs. Restaurant was spacious and the staff was very friendly. I will go again. Thanks for the great food♡
Kids were screaming which made me quite uncomfortable and their parents were annoying. Noodle soup had a very salty taste but overall was good. Tiramisu was good.

You can eat fresh and delicious chicken as they fry it right when you order it. The owner is very kind and the store is clean. The seasoned chicken is not spicy so kids can eat it too.Yummy😋 The cheese balls are also very delicious. Highly recommended.

Food Quality & Taste The restaurant is often praised as one of the best for Korean food, though, to be fair, it feels more like average fast food, comparable to KFC. The chicken itself was well-prepared—tender on the inside and crispy on the outside. However, the sweetness level was higher than expected, which might not suit all palates. Ambiance & Space The dining area is quite small, which may affect comfort, especially during busy hours. Service The staff is friendly and welcoming, contributing positively to the overall experience. Value for Money Prices are on the expensive side, which may not align with the fast-food-style experience.

This is and always has been my favourite Dakogi store, the workers are always very kind and have even remade one of my orders due to it having peanuts (which they no longer include by default now). The tables sometimes might be dirty but even if you ask to wipe it yourself they will beat you to it. Food is cooked very fresh and fast as apposed to other Dakogi stores. Pricing is pretty average for fried chicken being around $15 - $25 per person.
Korean fried chicken. It's delicious, it's protein, and I love the crispness of the tempura. I highly recommend it as a tasty restaurant.

One of my favourite places to eat in Browns Bay, I’ve been a regular customer for quite some time and always get the same order. The chicken is always fresh, never dry and super tasty. I always add onion powder to my chips as it gives so much flavour. The store is always neatly presented, very clean and the owner is super lovely. Good prices and great portion size. Highly recommend Dakogi! 10/10

Beautiful family owned restaurant that delivers an unforgettable dining experience. The service is lovely and the food is exceptional. Honestly they must do the best chicken korma in Auckland. Unfortunately, I have moved away from Auckland so only get to experience it once in a blue moon but it's always a highlight of my trip when I return.

Chands is a family-owned Indian restaurant that delivers an exceptional dining experience. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, making it perfect for a cozy meal. The food is absolutely delicious, with authentic flavors and fresh ingredients in every dish. Plus, the prices are incredibly reasonable for such high-quality cuisine. The owners are absolute gems — highly recommend!

The food was amazing. Full of flavour. We ordered a mixed platter for two, butter chicken, and paneer palak which is a creamy spinach dish served with 2 garlic means. Definitely recommend. First time eating here too.
Went to a band for my son’s birthday dinner as he wanted his favourite Butter chicken. As usual the food was great, really tasty full of flavour. Friendly and helpful staff
Great prices, delious food, great atmosphere

Second time I’ve ordered from here and this time they have done a better job. First time I ordered a year ago and I said I would never go back but today we felt like takeaways but all our vehicles were not home so I thought to give it a go again since it’s our local and walking distance. Noodles I think were over priced but food was good this time. $10 chips was way more then the last $10 chips I ordered. We were happy and full. Also they allowed me to pay internet banking while I was at home and my son just walked over and picked up. Great stuff love seeing improvements and will definitely be going back. See photos…. Ordered $10 hot chips 2x Cheeseburgers at $6 each Chicken Fried soft noodle $17 Fish and Egg burger $8
Great fish, good chips, a bit pricier than my local but reasonable. Fish was a good size and tasty, chips were solid and just what you hope for, although chip portion was on the small side.
Back in the day me and my mate would come here and get there hamburgers. Great place
Surprisingly very good, unsure if new ownership since I've last been. But was on par with other great fish and chip shops.

Very disappointing indeed! We bought chicken satay and beef and black bean - absolutely tasteless! Can't fault them for the veggies which were plentiful however both sauces lacked any taste whatsoever...we will not be going back!

If I could give 0 I would. Ordered and got confirmation email. Then never any contact again for 25 minutes until they declined my order. It’s also at someone’s house so I’d be very wary as this seems like a scam, or likely unlicensed food sales.

One of the worst fast food I ever bought. Look at these baby chicken nibbles, it’s just a joke guys. I specifically included wedges to show you the size. I don’t even know where I can find such mini size chicken nibbles. The pizza is cut recklessly uneven, that’s fine I can do it myself, but the pizza base is freaking cold guys!! Are you selling cardboard or something? Not even want to mention your potato wedges are not fully cooked!! They are still soft and soggy like overnight food! Disgusting!!

Service was absolutely atrocious when I tried to get a refund or get a new pizza. All they did was roll their eyes and tell me they couldn't do that. The reasoning was because the pizza base was cold and uncooked, like it just came out the freezer. There were very few toppings and flavoring. Definitely won't be coming back again.

Ordered through uber eats tonight at 6pm and took almost 2 hours to arrive to our place which is only 5 minutes away. No apology and ended up getting our order wrong as well, pizza came cold, dry with no flavour. I understand having busy nights, but 2 hours is not acceptable for a service thats meant to be quick and efficient. If this is a problem for you, why not hire more staff? There’s plenty of people looking for jobs out there, also, it’ll be great if you train them to have proper customer service skills and communication. Never ordering from this branch again so disappointing and a waste of $30.

A Frustrating Domino's Delivery Experience: I placed an order through the Domino's app, as I always do. The app notified me that my order had been delivered, but I hadn't heard a knock or the doorbell ring. Given the heavy rain, I initially thought the driver might just be delayed, and I hesitated to call the store, not wanting to cause trouble for the driver. About ten minutes later, I called the number from the delivery text message. To my surprise, it connected me with an Uber Eats driver. This was the first time my Domino's order had been passed to an Uber driver, as I'd ordered directly through the Domino's app. The driver informed me the food was left at my front door. I was shocked to learn my order had been sitting outside, getting soaked in the rain. The driver then told me to contact Domino's Long Bay to resolve the issue, which I did since my order was placed through their app, not Uber. However, the store manager at Domino's Long Bay insisted I call Uber customer service for a refund. This was incredibly confusing, as my order had no connection to Uber. I explained that I didn't want anyone to get into trouble and simply asked for a fresh order so my kids could eat. The manager very firmly refused, reiterating that I needed to contact Uber Eats. I'm at a loss for what to do. After ordering from them once or twice a week, I'm definitely not coming back.

There was a lot of standing around and waiting for one of the items I had ordered. This resulted in the rest of my order being just barely warm instead of the usual hot pizza I'd grown to expect from Dominos. The item I was waiting for was a Cheese Volcano. I was very disappointed as once I got home ready to tuck into my feed the Volcano was half the size it usually was.

Exceptional Indian cuisine--yum! Nikhil and staff were very welcoming and helpful in accommodating dairy free options. We had several dishes from the vegetarian side of the menu, all of them delicious. The mushroom palak had an amazing depth of flavor as did the namesake Dal Bukhara was something special. The naan and roti were also among the best we've ever had. Outstanding food, great people, so lucky to have Bukhara in Long Bay!

Bukhara Indian Eatery and Bar in Long Bay Village has only been open a week and I am already a huge fan. The staff were so welcoming and friendly and the food was superb. The butter chicken was rich and full of flavour with tender chicken breast, and the garlic naan was fresh, fluffy and perfect for mopping up the yummy sauce. Such a great addition to the area. A solid 10 out of 10.

Hands down the best Indian restaurant on the shore. We tried the chicken tikka masala and the lamb korma. Spices were fresh, flavourful and well balanced. Well worth mentioning that they use quality meat unlike the dry and tough cuts that you get from some other places. Great service too. Great addition to the village, highly recommended!
From the starters to the desserts, everything exceeded our expectations. Highly recommend this place for anyone who loves genuine Indian cuisine and great hospitality. I’ll definitely be coming back!

An absolute gem of an Indian cuisine restaurant! Their unique recipe of Bukhara is simply outstanding – rich, flavourful, and truly a mouth-watering experience. You can tell every dish is made with passion and expertise. It’s great to see the owners personally managing and operating the place at such a high standard. The serving style is authentic and adds to the charm of the dining experience. The environment is eye-catching, warm, and family-friendly, making it perfect for any occasion. Highly recommend to anyone looking for exceptional Indian food!

Food was nice recieved food promptly , service and environment was great. Good to have it open at 7.30-8pm made dinner easy. A lot of salt on chips was the downfall but overall great. $70 for x4 fish x2 scoop of chips , 2-3 mussels and 1-2 potatoe fritters. Was grateful to see a little extra inside thanks girls. Recommend.
Delicious takeaways and our go-to after time at Long Bay. The Fisheries is clean, the service is lovely and it’s located only a minute away from the beach. Very convenient!
One of my favourite fish and chip shows! Reliable, and always good!
I love their Chicken burger and wedges. The simplicity in their recipes makes it taste like homemade. Shop is nice and tidy. Very friendly staffs; seems they are the owners.

Beautiful food, friendly staff & very clean premises. I ordered 1 piece of snapper, 1/2 scoop of chips & a potato fritter. The chips were golden, crisp on the outside & fluffy on the inside. Fish & potato fritter were cooked to perfection & also crispy.
Now Long Bay Village is the secret gem hidden in Hills of long Bay. A great place for a meal or just a coffee.
Not much of a shopping mall, don't have a lot to say really? Th bakery and the sushi shop round the corner from new
Great place, a loads of shops and variety of shops.
Nice coffee, tasty food 😋
Very tidy supermarket bars and cafes.handful of shops not far from sports grounds and beach similar neighbourhood to hobsonville.

I had an incredible experience at the Japanese place! The customer service was top-notch, with a friendly and attentive staff. The variety of dishes, including the delicious ramen, sushi, and don, surpassed my expectations. The cozy and clean atmosphere added to the overall enjoyment. Definitely a 5-star experience!

Fabulous sushi and don buri selection, lovely staff and service. Good value for money and beautifully presented especially when dinning in (on trays and brought to the table, twas awesome). Calm and relaxing atmosphere, good lighting and open - like the wood decor touches. Very nice 😊 defs be back again.

Great to try some sushi in some new places around. This one is quite nice, rice was well seasoned and I like very much the spicy sushi version. It was clean, friendly staff including the owner, great variety of flavors and amazing combinations. Located in an area in constant development, certainly this newly opened restaurant will shine even more.
Really well priced, clean and tidy. Plus good sushi! Would recommend 😊
Delicious fresh sushi and very friendly staff. Also good variety of choices.

Amazing place! The owner and all the servers are always friendly and interested in you, they ensure you have a personal experience and are enjoying yourself. They turned on heaters for us and had blankets, and came a few times to ask how we were doing. It was so lovely and such a relaxing and enjoyable experience. Thank you to the staff at November!

The service was mostly good , my coffee was great. I loved that they had a play area for kids. When they brought out the food I wasn’t given any cutlery which was odd and there none on the table either. Sadly the food was such a disappointment. I ordered the morning pancakes and kids cheese toastie. The pancakes had been precooked so they came out dry and stale. I sent them back and they cooked them fresh. I find it very odd that they precooked them in the first place since they do t take long to cook. When I got the new ones they were swimming in syrup and then had another sweet sauce plus all the fruit. It was so sickly sweet I could barely eat it(I did have some as I was starving) . My son’s cheese toastie was just plain bread with a slice of processed cheese like you get from McDonald’s. For $8 it was an absolute joke! They refunded me in full though so that was good (I had initially not realised there was a $20 in their sorry) But I would never come back here for food again. Which is a shame because everything else was great.

The rating reflects a really mixed experience. Let's start with the good. They have a kids area and so my 19 month old girl had a place to explore and play which was really handy. We got the table right beside that area which was even handier. I had the Big Breakfast which, whilst not as big as many big breakfast's, was big enough. It is very nice and the pick of the meals. Which leads me to the bad. My partner had the open omelette which was very plain, small and, in her words, boring. My mum had the pancakes which, whilst nice, were small and came only with fruit pieces. My mum is into whipped cream and sweet things with her pancakes and they didn't have any. The cost was ok and they ran like a Cafe so you order at the counter rather than being served at your table. The place was quite busy and lively though, so the locals must like it well enough. I don't live close by and will not be coming back to Long Bay to eat there such was the mixed experience.

Beautiful service and gorgeous food! We went in for a birthday dinner, the service was wonderful they were so quick to service the food and very attentive and so so friendly. Thanks for the birthday cake with candles and easily flowers, what a lovely evening! My favourite dish was the prawn.

Dinner is now open! I had an incredible duck curry—guess what? It even had lychee as an ingredient! The taco was a delightful surprise, bursting with fresh flavors. The staff and owners were so warm and welcoming—what a fantastic experience!

Went here for a very special birthday lunch. They were quick to respond to an email request about Peking Duck availability for lunch. Great. Thanks. A very beautiful restaurant with great decor service and food. The quality matched the price. The Peking Duck was exceptional (although personally I would have liked a bit more meat / thighs and drums. Seems its the breasts and skin only but still exceptionally tasty) The Egg Plant with stuffed pork mince delicious. Thanks for a lovely birthday experience for me and my 3 guests

My review is limited to trying out two dim sum dishes, swan durian and shrimp rice roll. Was mid hike and couldn't eat much. The novelty and beautiful presentation of the swan durian was amazing, especially since the swan neck itself is an edible biscuit like thing (tasteless biscuit.. Maybe add some sugar?). (4/5) Note for improvement: Durian taste could be much stronger. Durian pastry tarts I've ordered elsewhere usually have much stronger durian flavour. Warning for people who haven't tried durian before. You either love it or hate it. It's supposed to have a super strong smell and taste. So durian lovers will be disappointed with the current flavour. The rice roll was delicious, texture of the rice roll and shrimp were some of the best I've had in NZ (5/5). Note for improvement: maybe eg add another offering of fried dough with shrimp, peanut / hoisin sauce combo which some places offer. That would take it to the next level. Presentation of teacup/ plate/ ambiance nice and modern. Highly recommend, will definitely return and try out some other dishes.

Really nice atmosphere! Amazing services and really good food. Highly recommend. We ordered egg tarts, the best I’ve ever had!! One of them didn’t look so good so they gifted us an extra!! Extremely good service! Definitely will come back!

During our visit to Long Bay over Easter, we had the pleasure of dining at Birds of a Feather, which is conveniently located nearby. Our experience was exceptional, highlighted by the following dishes: We thoroughly enjoyed the crispy Peking duck, aromatic wind-sand lamb chops, delicious crispy sweet and sour pork, and the raw beef piece (apologies for not recalling the specific name). The restaurant's ambiance was superb, featuring a modern and inviting atmosphere that enhanced our dining experience. We highly recommend the wind-sand lamb chops and the beef dish—we will definitely be returning to savor these favorites again! Overall, Birds of a Feather left a lasting impression with its wonderful food, ambiance, and service. We look forward to our next visit.

I absolutely love the food at this restaurant! 🦆 The Peking duck is especially amazing - it tastes so authentic. And the dry-fried beef hor fun is my all-time favorite. 😋 The atmosphere is really nice too, very romantic and perfect for a date night. 💕 Highly recommend this place if you're looking for great Chinese food and a cozy vibe!

Beautiful service and beautiful food . It's one of my favorite places on the list . Well done of how professional of thr crew both days and night shifting. They always have a smile on the face and check at the table to make sure everything is good. Keep it up. Love this place.

If I could review higher I would! Despite being a busy Tuesday night with Quiz night happening, we were sat outside yet felt like we were indoors! It was so warm! The food is delish! The sliders in particular are constantly on my mind! Will definitely be back for everything again!

It's a place where you can stop by and drink cool beer while taking a walk Long Bay. The bar is spacious and you can sit outside if you want sunlight. The food is decent. The staff of girl with blond hair was so kind.
First time here and we loved it. Great food and atmosphere and fantastic friendly service. Really nice buzz to the place with loads of different spaces to sit and enjoy.

Atmosphere and energy warm and inviting. DJ was good. Staff friendly and responsive. Food came out quickly. Menu a bit limited we ordered burgers and sliders, good value, delicious. Preferred original tap beers selection. Overall a great night out, we will be back.

A Taste of Turkish Warmth and Flavour at Troy I had the pleasure of dining at Troy in Torbay, Auckland, and what a delightful experience it was from start to finish. From the moment we walked in, we were welcomed with genuine warmth and hospitality that instantly made us feel at home. The ambiance of the restaurant is cozy yet vibrant, blending modern touches with the rich cultural vibe of Turkey, perfect for a relaxed evening out. The food was the real highlight, beautifully presented, full of flavor, and clearly made with love. We started with a hearty main that featured perfectly tender meat nestled among roasted vegetables, all topped with crispy shredded garnish and herbs. The sauce brought everything together with a savory depth that left us wanting more. For dessert, we enjoyed traditional baklava served with a scoop of creamy vanilla ice cream, lightly dusted with cocoa. It was the perfect sweet finish, crisp flaky layers soaked in just the right amount of syrup without being overpowering. Paired with a warm pot of tea, it felt like a comforting hug in a cup. The service was exceptional, attentive without being intrusive, and the staff made sure we were looked after every step of the way. You can truly feel the passion the team at Troy has for creating not just a meal but a memorable experience. If you're looking for a place that serves authentic Turkish-inspired cuisine in a setting that makes you feel like family, Troy in Torbay is a must-visit.
Warm, welcoming staff and incredible food! Every dish was full of flavour, and the baklava was a perfect finish. Highly recommend Troy for a delicious, generous meal 😋

Hidden gem in Torbay. Tucked away in the corner, the atmosphere really comes out during the evening with the coloured lanterns. I had a fabulous meal and experience. The Georgian chicken and stuffed cheese bread (Khachapuri) blew me away. Taste was phenomenal! I'll be back here for sure!

It's a special thing to find an absolutely passionate chef & owner of a local restaurant with a magic atmosphere & incredible Survice . Every single meal is clearly cooked & presented with passion & total consistency. The flavours , generous portion sizes & prices makes Troy Torbay a absolute stand out. Hugely appreciated.......thanks guys.😊😍

Highly recommended. Had our mother's 90th birthday dinner here. 40 guests, every meal was outstanding. Generous portions, and everyone said their meals tasted amazing! Great service and lovely atmosphere. Thank you so much Troy

Perfect for when you suddenly crave meat and want to grab something on your way home. It's quite good. I'm surprised I never noticed this place before. The fried chicken is the very dry type, wouldn't really recommend it. The roast beef is incredibly tender, very juicy, and delicious. The roasted pork skin is absolutely delicious (though quite greasy, of course).

Best Roast on the shore hands down, my go to order is roast roll,chips and a piece of chicken which comes out to under $18, everything is amazing to flavour to portions. As a chicken hunter chicken is my go to and this is a lovely place to satisfy my hunger for poultry-C.H

Clean inside. Well priced. Meat roll was big in size and good value. Nice pork crackling and crispy potatoes. I was disappointed that the mashed potato wasn’t even made from real potatoes considering it is a roast shop. The gravy doesn’t taste real in my opinion and all the food was slightly cold.
Ordered the roast fried chicken meal, and it was lovely! Really filling meal for one. The veggies with the gravy were tasty as well. If I get an opportunity then I will surely order again.
Been shopping there for years. Effortless service and very tasty food . Take out great. Good portions
Best sushi we've had in Auckland. Real Japanese food. Lovely service and people.
portion and presentation was olay. but the pork had that old pork bitter taste stuck to it

One of the best sushi places I have been to in Auckland. Always fresh with great variety. Cardboard trays and a place to sit and eat if you're not 'on a quick visit'. Plenty of parking and service with a smile.
Best miso soup, sushi were fresh and they have cardboard trays! Great place!
Service is great and sushi is tasty and fresh!

If I could give 10 stars, I would! Taj and Tonic is not just a restaurant it’s a full-blown experience! I literally drive from Pukekohe to Torbay just to eat Chef Dev’s food, and every single kilometre is worth it. This man is an absolute wizard in the kitchen. The flavours, the balance, the presentation everything is next level. You don’t just eat here, you feel the food. Now let’s talk about the service absolutely on point. The lady who served us (I wish I got her name!) was so warm, friendly, and professional, it felt like we were being welcomed into someone’s home. Her attention to detail, calm energy, and genuine smile made the whole experience even more special. The kind of service that just makes you want to come back again and again. The vibes? Immaculate. The food? Mind-blowing. The team? 10/10. Chef Dev you’ve built something truly extraordinary. This isn’t just Indian food, it’s a spiritual connection. You’ve raised the bar for Indian cuisine in New Zealand. Trust me, if you’re reading this, stop scrolling get in your car and head to Taj and Tonic. You’ll leave full, happy, and already planning your next visit. 🔥🙌

We missed this place how we don’t know it is so close to our home and we saw lots of post on Facebook. My daughter birthday her special request we made it finally. Quantity, quality and atmosphere is A+. Thank you making my kids day special with your amazing food and services.

We had such a great lunch at this little Indian spot in the middle of Torbay. Super cosy and welcoming — perfect for a relaxed family meal or an easy weeknight date. The food was honestly amazing. Everything was full of flavour, super fresh, and tasted like it was made with a lot of love. The curries were rich and perfectly spiced, the naan was soft and fluffy, and everything just hit the spot. I’m still thinking about the Chicken 65 — so tasty and just the right amount of spice. The samosas were also a winner. Loved that they had a great wine list too — really nice options that went well with the food. Affordable, delicious, and just an all-round great vibe. Will definitely be going back!

Hidden Gem in the North Shore! It’s not easy to find great Indian food on the North Shore, but this place absolutely delivered. The flavours were authentic, the portions generous, and the service warm and welcoming. From the curries to the naan, everything was spot on. A must-visit if you’re craving real Indian food without having to head into the city!
Everything was perfect and tasty. Service was great everything was as served on time. Good flavours cooked to perfection. One of the best India restaurants in Auckland for sure.
The pizza tasted so fresh! I could simply taste quality! The price point is also very reasonable despite the excellent quality
Best pizza in Auckland, takeaway from real wood fired oven on street side stall. Two options Margarita or special, which changes weekly. Highly recommended!

About to come back for the second time ever, (this time with my family) it’s been a long 5 months without their pizza and I can hands down say I’ve never had any pizza that is better and I’ve been unable to find a pizza that can even come close to being as great! So Very excited to be back on this side of Auckland! 40 more mins and they’ll be open
Yum best pizza I’ve had in nz if not anywhere, including Naples ;-) Boys prefer it to others “tastes like real pizza Dad”. Pls keep making such great food and keeping it real 🙌
Love their pizza! It would be great if they could cut it for us, though. We ordered takeout to eat at the beach, but the pizza wasn’t sliced, which made it hard to eat.

only popped in for coffee and a snack but was a great experience! got a very delicious spinach feta and sun-dried tomato brioche. the chutney in it wasn’t too sweet and the brioche was nice and soft. the matcha latte wasn’t too flavourful but was nice all the same. will definitely be back to try the menu!

Good food, with above average prices. Went for breakfast about 25pp. Ordered their big breakfast version, the kid version of it was very similar even though it cost 30% less. Adequate place to go to. Good place to go to if you have dietary preferences. Service was wonderful.

A very chic, fresh eatery on the North Shore, Scout seems to tick all the boxes. The interior is invitingly decked out in contemporary pastel shades and light wood with a sprinkling of greenery throughout. And one cannot ignore the startling number of pretty pink accents from the menus to the table vases. The menu is a cafe-hopper’s delight, classics aplenty along with signature twists to invite exploration, to say nothing to say nothing of the tempting treats in the cabinet which were demolished by the Saturday lunch crowd in the time we dined. My two companions enjoyed brunch from the kitchen while I had a chicken bagel. Their breakfasts were stunningly presented, although a request for no hollandaise seemed to have been forgotten. The bagel was generously filled and just right for the morning. Service was friendly, but not as efficient as it could have been. A lengthy wait for our coffees and we witnessed the waitress having a chat while our drinks stood getting colder. Our second round of drinks we had better luck with. Coffee definitely good enough to enjoy seconds. I tried a matcha latte. Very on-trend and made with coconut milk, a little sweet for my own taste but worth a try. I ventured in for a second visit on the morning of my departure just as they were opening. Again, a lack of efficiency in service but the salmon bruschetta was absolutely stunning. If the youthful staff just recieved a touch more training in service, this would be a 5/5 destination for sure.

Good service and coffee but unfortunately food was underwhelming. Ceaser salad barely dressed so quite flavourless and had one single anchovy. Butter that came with the bread tasted off. Overpriced for what you get, could do with a menu overhaul.
Great ambience, nice food/coffee (noticed they are using best organic beans in the town). Overall fantastic experience.

Friends and I had a beach day at Long Bay and we decided to call in and order dinner from here. My friends picked it up and brought it back to the park at Long Bay so we could dine picnic style. I had crumbed fish (as usual) and a sausage and they were both good with the hot chips that were salted well. Not sure what the total cost was but there were 4 of us. The Definition of Sunday Vibes ☀️ We visited The Butcher Baker in Helensville for a relaxed coffee and breakfast, and were genuinely impressed—not just by the quality of the food and coffee, but also by the welcoming atmosphere and friendly staff. As you arrive, you’re greeted by a charming quaint courtyard that sets the tone. Inside, the lovely scent of woodsmoke from the open kitchen fills the space, and you can see the chefs working with care and focus, which adds a great authentic touch. The interior and exterior are both beautifully designed—thoughtful, inviting, and cosy. A small detail which I really appreciated: the dishware. Beautiful, well-chosen plates and cups that subtly elevated the whole experience. We shared a toasted scone with burnt whipped butter, which was surprisingly so delicious—not your average scone. The sourdough toast with preserve and burnt whipped butter was also excellent, with high-quality ingredients that shone through in every bite. Who knew you could elevate scones and toast like that? Definitely impressed. We paired everything with flat whites, which were well-made and smooth. I don’t get out to Helensville often, but I’ll definitely be making a point to return to The Butcher Baker. It’s a place worth coming to - highly recommend!!!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Amazing Experience at Area 51 - Auckland Adventure Park Our recent visit to Area 51 at Auckland Adventure Park was nothing short of fantastic! From the moment we arrived, the staff were incredibly friendly and helpful. Check-in was seamless, and the staff efficiently sorted out our wristbands. We appreciated that each type of pass was color-coded, making it easy to differentiate between different activities—such a thoughtful and organized system! The food at the reception was surprisingly good and well-priced. There was a great selection for both adults and kids. We especially loved the kids’ meal options, which came with drinks—perfect for families looking to grab a quick bite before heading off for more adventure. It wasn’t just about convenience; the food was delicious too! From the reception, you can either head down to the lower part of the park, where there’s a fun kids’ playground, or make your way up to the bus stop for the ride up the hill. The Mitsubishi Rosa bus ride was comfortable, offering a scenic route to the upper part of the park. Up there, the real adventure begins—luge rides, the exhilarating zip line, and the thrilling Shooting Star! One thing that stood out to us was the atmosphere. Right outside the reception, there’s a luge car on display along with a price list for each of the activities, which really adds to the excitement and anticipation. Plus, there’s a huge screen showcasing all the activities the park offers. It’s a clever way to get everyone hyped up and makes it easy to plan your day. The park is well-organized, clean, and full of fun activities for everyone. Whether you’re with family or friends, there’s something for every age group. We’ll definitely be returning, and we highly recommend Area 51 at Auckland Adventure Park to anyone looking for a thrilling adventure!
