Nearly empty yet the wait time was around 15 minutes... for a combo meal, tables had crumbs and papers/receipts lying all over the floor. The food looked pathetic, I understand its a fast food restaurant but even the maccas on queens does a better job.

I was quite surprised to see so many negative reviews for McDonald's Silverdale because every time I've been, I've had a really positive experience! It’s probably a lot to do with the time of day—I've mostly visited on weekends during the day when it’s moderately busy but very manageable. I love that this is one of the newer McDonald’s locations, so the fit-out is modern, and the playground is fantastic. Every time I’ve been, it’s been really clean, and I’ve had no complaints at all. The staff are always friendly, and the food has been hot and fresh. I have seen comments about cleanliness, but honestly, it’s McDonald’s—it’s a fast-food chain, and the staff work hard to keep up. People should be realistic about where they are and what they’re paying for. For what it is, I think this location is excellent. Given that this is one of the only fast-food places in the area, the drive-thru probably gets slammed at peak times, which might explain some of the mixed reviews. But overall, I think very highly of this location and will definitely keep coming back! Also, I LOVE the app and deals!

I was disappointed with my visit to McDonald's Silverdale. The coffee was weak & watered down. The cups were half full. Additionally, the chips was not fresh and stale. Won't be visiting this branch again. P.S. This is one of the smallest McDonald's I've been too. 1 STAR RATING.

It just happened tonight. I am extremely disappointed and shocked by the poor customer service and the incredibly rude attitude displayed by the manager at Silverdale MCDonload’s drive-through. We redeemed two offers via the mobile app and placed our order at the reception window. However, when we reached the pickup window, the manager claimed he could only see one order on his screen. We politely asked him to check with the reception, but he refused, insisting he only goes by what appears on the screen. Even after we showed him the screenshots of the two redeemed offers on our phone, he dismissed our request and refused to verify the issue with the reception. It was late at night, and there were several customers in the drive-through queue. Despite this, the manager finally, and very reluctantly, gave us the second order. To our surprise, he then rudely told us, “DON’T COME BACK HERE AGAIN,” which was completely unacceptable. This has been the worst experience we’ve ever had at a McDonald’s. The behavior was unprofessional, unfriendly, and utterly disappointing. I hope this issue can be addressed, as this is not the level of service we expect from a brand like McDonald’s.

This place is clearly short staffed and badly managed. 30 minutes for a double cheeseburger, was running late hoping for "fast food" cheesburger had no pickles so I had to wait for them to remake it for another 10 minutes.

About two weeks before Valentine’s Day (yes, we did book for the big day! 😉), we were exploring the Whangaparāoa area, just wandering around to see what we could find. And guess what? We discovered an absolute gem! 💎 From our very first visit, we fell in love with their food. We ordered the Satay Chicken and Window Fried Rice—oh my, it was so good that I immediately booked a table for Valentine’s Day! The food is authentic, and the view is beautiful. You can even see Rangitoto Island from here. Highly recommend booking in advance rather than walking in, as it gets busy. We’ll definitely be back to try more dishes.🥰
Had takeaway Pad Thai and Red Curry. Soooo good!! Best I've had in quite a long time. Order was ready very quickly as well. We'll be going back!
Great Thai food with an awesome view! I had the Thai window curry, it had great flavours and spice. Looking forward to my next visit. 😁

Holy freaking yum and the view?! As someone from Southeast Asia and as someone who has visited Thailand numerous times.. What a SPOT. The view and atmosphere take me right back.. The food is absolutely divine.. The staff are so lovely.. 10/10 reccomend.

I really like this restaurant, been coming here for a decade every opportunity I can. The lae time I was here to review they got our orders wrong...which they quickly fixed. The view here is amazing, best at sunset. Highly recommended!

New owners are much better!! The last 5 times we have received food it has been perfect. No more soggy food thank goodness!! We always get a pepperoni stuff crust, a hot and spicy veggie pan with pineapple, and fries. Sarah and Sean

I recently visited Pizza Hut in Whangaparāoa and was thoroughly impressed by the experience. The staff were exceptionally friendly and attentive, ensuring that my order was taken promptly and prepared to perfection. The restaurant maintained a clean and welcoming atmosphere, making it a comfortable place to dine in. The pizza itself was delicious—hot, fresh, and generously topped. It’s evident that the team takes pride in delivering quality food. Compared to other outlets, this branch stands out for its consistency and customer service. Whether you’re grabbing a quick bite or planning a family meal, Pizza Hut Whangaparāoa is a fantastic choice. Highly recommended!
Just got a order in shop, asked for no bbq drizzle, as shown on the receipt, as you will see from the pizza, there is bbq drizzle. Uneatable

The Pizza Hut Whangaparaoa shop is very clean and tidy, the staff there are extremely friendly and professional. They make pizzas fast and delicious. Our family always comes to this shop for our pizza nights and it’s always a delightful and memorable experience. 😁👍

★★★★★ "Fantastic Experience at Pizza Hut Whangaparāoa ! I ordered the Meatlovers Pizza on a Stuffed Crust and a side of Boneless Bites for pickup last night. The pizza was absolutely delicious – hot, packed with flavourful toppings, and that stuffed crust was perfectly cheesy and chewy. The Boneless Bites were also crispy and well-sauced. My order was ready exactly on time, and the staff member who served me at the counter was incredibly friendly and efficient. The store itself was clean and organized, making for a smooth pickup. Overall, excellent food quality and service. I'd highly recommend this Pizza Hut location and will definitely be back for my next pizza craving!"

Honestly everyone reviewing here needs to visit literally any other subway in Auckland to understand that what we have on the coast is essentially the gold standard. Every time I have visited this subway it has been top notch. The staff is friendly, fast and every sub I have purchased here looks like the photo off the board. Subway isn't the cheapest fast food option out there so I expect to get what I pay for. I can honestly say that you get more than what you pay for here. Please keep up the great work team and thank you for setting the standard for everyone else.

As i odered at subway at 637 whangaparaoa road, whangaparaoa, auckland . I just saw what i received There is no proper salad stuffing. 1. There is no onion, no spinach and no pickles in my order in subway and barely 4 slice tomatos and 4 slice cucumber 2. When i call there regarding to my order one the staff member pick my call her name was NEHA .she denied to accept her mistake and she told me that she followed all proper process to made my ordered which is not correct because what i paid for everything but i didn't received correct food. 3.Staff member's behavior is not good as specially NEHA and her service is really worst everytime and she is not adding proper vegetables all the time and trying to cut it down in order. 4- When I asked her for refund or another order she said NO straight away very rudely which is not right.

This Subway really doesn’t live up to its coastal location. The customer service is consistently poor, the salads are stale, and once again, my bread was old and rock hard. I’d rather make the drive to Orewa, where the staff are friendly, welcoming, and always greet you with a smile. The bread and salads there are fresh, and the overall experience feels positive every time. Until this store gets a serious overhaul, I won’t be coming back. Do yourself a favor and head to Orewa instead.

Two times in a row, we have had botched orders when booking online. Mixing the ordered salads and breads etc between two subs, and having the wrong sizes. It's quite frustrating, convenient to have deliveries, but when the orders are mistaken and there's no time to fix it's not ideal.

Visited today at lunchtime and waited about 10 mins in line while the two staff served a couple of people before us. Gets to us finally (group of 3) and serves my husband first, they finish with him and then continue to ignore the remaining 2 of us to make online orders as they had huge lists of orders. By this time we had probably been in the store 15-20 mins without service. Uber driver also arrived to pickup an order and also got told to wait another 10+ mins. Sort your online ordering out, stagger the wait times or something so your staff can actually handle them and also the walk ins! Don’t really blame the two young staff members working that day, they were simply trying to keep up with the poor systems and planning at this franchise.

Was so disappointed to get all the way home and see that the food i got was incorrectly labelled. I usually love this place but looks like someone mucked up and now i have to eat something i didn't want in the first place. I got katsu chicken only to get home and see its normal chicken. Very disappointed !!

For a sushi chain, this place is excellent. Sushi chef is ready to make to order, he and the team provide a friendly service too. Lovely seating area. Plenty of parking. Lots of options to fit your tastebuds. Make sure to pickup chopsticks though, they don't assume you want them so you need to pack them in yourself.
Amazing food and so very yummy. I go to bento bowl when ever I go past 1. Thanks guys. I love the crunchy chicken

Got there at closing time so I could park the rig outside 😆 Always very nice staff and fast preparation of your order. Great place for fresh fish sushi for when you haven't got a catch going out fishing 🎣
Absolutely great. Always happy and friendly to help even if we ask them for gluten free sushi they are always taking extra care to make sure it is done right. Best St Pierres I've been to

it was entertaining. the pickles are cold and there's no sauce. plenty of staff. I have returned - we put pepper in the sauce and it took 25 minutes before the lady said did you start the order yet? the atmosphere has gotten interesting. Not sure how they could afford it. Philosophical Question: do they not cut corners, or do they actually cut curves??? nobody knows. Their motto is we don't cut corners but they definitely don't cut time. we our food tomorrow. edit: burnt my mouth on the frosty.

Their burgers were bland and the chips were too salty, lots of salt sprinkled in it. A coronary waiting to happen. There was no frosty dessert as well. When it's one of the trademarks of Wendy's. The place was not busy yet the tables was not wiped down. Really puts me off having Wendy's again. Really sad to see this chain falling in standards.
they don't know how too cook there chicken patties there always not fully cooked other then that good

Ordered The Splash meal and yes there was a 4 minute wait time but WOW it was worth the wait the fish tasted incredible, and the rest of the burger was perfect for 15 bucks for 2 burgers, chips and a drink you can't go wrong, will definitely come back 10/10

Taco salad never fails to impress and my deluxe cheeseburger is always yummy. The Chicken nuggets were hot and moist, the staff were friendly and helpful and the premises clean so we were happy diners.
I met Vaughan Skinner here. He was a very nice person to deal with. Very helpful and friendly. Highly recommended Best on the coast.
Only popped in here for a quick drink. Nice atmosphere.

This is how a sports bar should be. Clean, and well-presented with no drama. It's part of the community and several local groups hold meeting there. There are raffles and a fishing club. Even free bread from the local bakery on occasion. The beer is very well priced and although the menu is none existent you can bring in food from other establishments.

Just moved to whangaparoa and happy to find the stables right on my doorstep. Friendly welcoming staff, good selection of drinks and a loyalty cart also.. happy days. Locals really friendly and welcoming. Happy to make it my new local

Must be 1 of the cleanest bar and toilets around with great staff and lovely to have a flutter on tab or pokies and winning great prizes on a Thursday night with their own spin n win game. Everyone welcome and great coverage of all live sports events on many big screen TV's, gotta check it out!!!
Had wonderful experience here tonight. The food was delicious, the staff were attentive and kind. We booked via ‘First Table’ and found the pricing incredible. Will be back, thanks team 🩷🩷

I ordered from here as I am currently on a mission to try all local cuisine in the Hibiscus Coast area. I ordered: Butter Chicken, Lamb Saagwala and Garlic Naan. #1 Butter Chicken - The Chicken was tender. Could’ve used more time marinating to get that beautiful flavour enriched to the core. The sauce was beautifully creamy and had a lovely thickness to it. Perfect balance of spice, saltiness and sweetness. #2 Lamb Saagwala - The lamb was magnificent. Melted in your mouth. You could pull apart each individual strand. The sauce was beautiful and fresh, Perfectly salted and a lovely hint of sweetness without compromising the savoury flavours of the lamb and spinach. #3 Garlic Naan - Light buttery and flakey. Perfect balance of garlic and not overpowered with herbs like other places often do. One of the best naans i’ve had Very impressed with the food here and the staff were very friendly. Will definitely be back to try more items on the menu!

Just had a meal with my husband and it was delicious.. The flavour and quality of the food was spot on. We ordered mild curries but could have gone for hot spice level. The waitress had just started at the restaurant and she was doing a great job.

Best Indian we've had in a long time (maybe ever). We had a wonderful meal tonight. The chilli prawn entree was exceptional! We also loved the lamb cutlets, mango chicken and lamb vindaloo! Every dish was delicious and the service was great. Very friendly and yummy, highly recommend! We will be back ☺️

Seriously the most delicious Indian food I've ever eaten! If I could give 10 stars I would. The cheese garlic naan is a must! Went in for lunch with friends and we ordered a variety of food, everyone agreed it was so delicious. Will definitely be going back!

We have been to Picador several times and have never been disappointed. They have $20 Sunday Roast which we think is the best Sunday Roast we have ever had. We have also tried their steak and was very pleased with it. Service was excellent. The apple crumbie pie was delicious too! All the staff were extremely pleasant. Highly recommend.

Had a meal with friends , service was good. Décor was suitable to the name of the restaurant, even though the chairs were looking a little tired. A little difficult to leave the carpark due to road works. It will be better once road works are complete.

A delightful restaurant offering fantastic food and exceptional service. The staff are both friendly and highly professional, creating a welcoming and relaxed atmosphere—ideal for a family dinner or a date. We ordered several dishes from both the kids' menu and the regular menu; portions were generous, and there are always appealing specials available and there always a special between $20-$25 need to check online for the specails, the price of the main menù can be more higher, between $30- $50, but the quality of the food makes it worthwhile. The kids' menu is priced at $15 and includes a scoop of ice cream. Service was prompt and efficient throughout our visit.
Lovely restaurant with delicious food! The waiters were friendly and had fast service. We ordered the rump special for $25 and it was so yummy! Will definitely be coming back!

We went there for dinner. Ordered scotch fillet and the baby back ribs. The scotch was cook to perfection, medium rare. Melts in the mouth, didn't need sauce at all. The flavour of chargrill and garlic butter was a combo made in heaven. The baby back ribs was super juicy and falls off the bone and the sauce was not over powering and too sweet. Can't wait to go back again. The price was very reasonable. Good service!

We won't be getting Domino's again especially from here. The garlic bread was squashed flat. The pizza smells funky and we are going to throw in rubbish as it's not edible.A frozen pizza tastes nicer. We have no idea why this happened and why the quality was so bad.
The pizza was hot, fresh, and loaded with toppings. Super fast delivery and great customer service made the experience even better!

4 Pizzas took an hour to deliver. Contacted the store - they didn’t know or care where the driver was. Pizza arrived cold. Left feedback on the website. Got 1 measly pizza voucher to replace the 4 that were awful. Never again.

Spent $89 on pizza for my daughters birthday and 5/6 pizzas were burnt. Previous to this I have ordered here and those ones were undercooked. I don’t understand how they get it so wrong?? Got response back from the owner they would give me 2 pizzas and 2 sides to reimburse me for the experience which is fine (sort of… not really representative of the value I spent which went in the bin) but honestly I just won’t spend my money here again.

Tonight I witness the staff being rude to other customers which wasn't great. I was made to feel like I was being a hassle ordering pizzas so clearly they are short staffed on the shop floor. In addition they don't take care while making the pizza. My pizza was burnt, poorly constructed and with toppings only making on the otter edge and in very minimal amounts nothing like the photos. Not impress with the lady on tonight or the delivery drivers who don't wear helmets. Staff need to be retained in educate.

Hands down one of the best fish and chip shops around. The owners are lovely, food comes out fast and is super delicious. They are happy to swap the fish in their burger for crumbed and is totally delicious. The real secret is that their handmade wontons are absolutely amazing. Also of note is their chicken burger, fish burger, lemon pepper chips and the spring roll and curry roll is tasty as.
4 stars because most of it was good, but the steak toasted sandwich I ordered was a real letdown and not eaten. $5.90, and I got 2 pieces of lightly toasted bread with some dried up strips of steak

So while recently visiting family back home here in Stanmore Bay I decided to get some dinner. I went down to brightside takeaways. Firstly they told me they had no menus I could take to look at, then when I rang up and ordered kumara chips, this is what $5 got me! Like I get the cost of living has gone up but this is pathetic.

Order placed via phone, the worker did not discribe the food properly then the worker got very aggressive when we went to pick up the order realising it was wrong. Would not recommend unless you want to be shouted at in a rude unprofessional manner.

Lovely friendly service, I was thankful to be able to order a yummy quick meal for the kids while I walked my dog at Stanmore bay. The price was so low and the lovely man serving was happy to adjust ingredients for us with no problem’s. Thanks guys
Been here about half a dozen times now, and love it. Food is fantastic, pricing is good. Online ordering is great option, and never had a problem with it.
The best Kebab and Shish prepared on charcoal in the Hibiscus coast. Really nice atmosphere and service. Our family love it!

Good variety of food. Decent amount of toppings for the pizza, and quality was also good. Not too much cheese, and salami wasn't too salty. Customer service is excellent. Lose a star as the thin crust was slightly burned - I prefer a fluffy crust that's slightly less cooked.
Very consistent with their food and reasonably priced. Dylan served me recently and I appreciated his friendly welcome.
I had really good turkish food for last night!!! It was quick and tasty. Look forward to back there again. Thanks for your service.

Not had a bad trip here before but i must say i was very disappointed to find once id got home that there was no bernaise sauce on my lust deluxe , pizza just wasnt the same without it very sad to say , my suggestion to all is to do wat i will be doing going forward - check the box before u leave….

Fantastic pizza, very kind employees, quick service. My family got four individual “snack size” pizzas which were the perfect size for a hungry teenager. Each pizza was very different, each one delicious. The Cajun potato wedges were really good too. There are a few tables in the front for customers, but as a tourist passing through, it seemed they are really not set up for dining in. There were a few large bottles of soda in a fridge available for purchase, but no cups. There were no garbage cans in the dining area either, however a kind employee said he could dispose of the empty pizza boxes. I totally recommend the pizza, but would plan on take-out.
Placed order was ready when I got there 🙌 and pizza was delicious
Had to wait ages after due time and had to chase the crew about the Order. No compensation offered. Haven't ordered again since then

Used to be such a great store and I used to order from them all the time now you're actually better off getting dominos as bad as they are it's still better then the burnt cold pizza this place charges you alot of money for and they refuse to give out refunds so don't waste your money

Great food at value pricing for the locals. I had the $9.99 lunch special, as of writing. Tasty and still a lot of food. There is also the $14.50 All Mains Special which would be good come the evening.

Absolutely love my butter chicken from here. Have been buying for many years and always land up back here. Have tried some other places but really enjoy how thick and creamy the sauces are here. Also love the poppadoms always super crunchy and not oily. As for atmosphere only been couple of times normally deliver or pick up. Keep doing a great job with lovely service 😊

Very unique interior design made of coir ropes. Loved the mango lassi and vegetable pakoda. Moghal Murgh was okay and Fish curry was too sweet. The aloo roti and paneer roti were good. The itemized bill wasn't given - not sure why. The service was good.

You know when you have a lazy day at home, and you just want to get some nice butter chicken to fill that craving? We had one of those days so we decided to give Spice & Soda a shot. When we got there at 11:30AM the store was closed, lights off and tables were still stacked inside. This was quite confusing as even the hours listed in front of the door states that they should be open. We decided to hang around a bit and about 15 minutes later, someone eventually said that they will be open in about 10 minutes. Finally, we sat inside and we were ready to get started. Interior: The decor is a bit old in appearance and run down. The space is also a little bit tight but you can still move around without having to squeeze through other tables. The service: We did not really see much staff, there was only one waiter who was running the front, taking orders and then going to the kitchen to help prepare the food. The staff member who served us was nice. The food: We both ordered the Murgh Makani $9.99 lunch special, which is basically your butter chicken. The special comes with rice, naan bread and the curry itself which is a pretty good deal. All combinations were cooked well and tasted great. Overall, our experience at spice and soda was above average. If you are in the local area then I would highly suggest checking this place out.

Generally a good Indian restaurant. When ordering takeaways they are very stingy on the rice. Barely enough for 1 curry. Considering this is the cheapest part it doesn't make sense. If dining in all the meals are about $5-10 more than ordering online for takeaway... never seen this at any restaurant except Indians... just saying... anyway its good curry just need to not be greedy money hungry Indians.
Came here for lunch on the way. Amazing coffees!!! Served by a very lovely friendly barista, good food with reasonable price 😋👍👍well done

This café is a real gem! The staff are absolutely lovely—always friendly, welcoming, and happy to help. The food is lovely, with a great mix of classics and exciting new dishes to try. There's something for everyone, with influences from a variety of cuisines. The atmosphere is cozy and inviting—perfect for a casual meal or a quiet coffee break. Highly recommend!

We are weekend regulars and as usual this weekend the coffee and hot chocolate and our breakfasts were delicious. Always love sitting for a while enjoying our morning, they don't rush you out the door. A great way to start Sundays!

The iced mocha/chocolate/coffees are really great. Used to have really beautiful food but has steadily gone downhill over the past few years. I bought a steak and cheese pie and it smelled so awful I couldn't eat it. I also wasn't sure what the black mouldy looking area was on the pastry. The chicken salad used to be my favourite item to order a few years ago but now the recipe has changed and it is not good anymore. The free range chicken/bacon/eggs good to see. Hope they have a refresh and go back to how it was.

Delicious food and massive portions. It was very busy the day we went but the lady serving was doing a fantastic job rushing about. Very polite. Food came out fast and was very tasty. We also had a protein smoothie which was very filling and tasty. Would highly recommend.

I visited this newly opened Mexican restaurant today and tried the beef burger, pork tacos, and hot dog — everything was absolutely delicious! The flavors were rich and authentic, and each dish was cooked to perfection. On top of that, the staff were incredibly friendly and welcoming, which made the experience even better. I’ll definitely be coming back soon. Highly recommended!🫶🏻

Fabulous food - fresh and tasty, highly recommend. It’s tucked away but definitely make the effort as the food was super tasty. The fried chicken burger and prawn/chorizo taco were particularly delicious

Great new taco place. Every taco on the menu sounded good and the three we tried were all delicious. I will be back plenty more times to try them all. They also have burgers and other non-taco items plus a kids menu. Lots of space in a nice atmosphere and good quick service. This could be a new cult favourite on the coast.

New favorite taco spot in town! 🌮 Prawn &chorizo taco, beef birria, and even the vegan buttercup taco were all bursting with flavor. Great vibes, friendly staff, and seriously good food. Will definitely be back!
The taco was amazing! So fresh and full of flavor. I loved every bite. Can’t wait to have it again 10/10 ❤️

Had a beautiful Large Pork Roast. The staff asked me if I wanted the gravy in a seperate container which I did. The large size was plenty for my wife and me. 5 huge potatoes, 2 kumara, pumpkin and carrots and peas. Meat was well cooked and juicy. Gravy was tasty as well. I put the veges in an airfryer when I got home to crisp them up. It w as a great meal. Suggest you try them out. The shop is super clean and there are a couple of tables outside if you can't wait until you get home 😉. This is going to be our Saturday night regular. Will try the beef next.
This place is fantastic. The food is top-notch with very generous servings. I recommend having your Sunday roast cooked by someone else for a change. You will be impressed.

I'm very pleased we now have a roast shop in Whangaparāoa! Generous portions, tender meat, crispy potatoes, perfect crackling and tasty gravy. The staff were friendly too. There's only one thing missing from their menu - Yorkshire puddings.

Sunday is always roast day for me, so I decided to stop by Sunny's Roast, and I was pleasantly surprised! The place is bright, clean, and the team is incredibly friendly. I ordered the medium roast pork meal for $20, and it was fantastic. While the vegetable selection was limited to carrots and peas, the roast vegetables potatoes, kumara and pumpkin were packed full of flavor, and the portion of meat was huge. The meal was delicious, and I even had enough leftovers for a great lunch the next day. I’d highly recommend Sunny’s Roast for a hearty, tasty meal! 🍖🥕✨
Had a medium roast pork, perfect sunday roast, wife had beef, fantastic, huge portions, have to get small next time. Absolute Best in area No need to go to Silverdale.
This place has gone downhill. I normally love a good feed of fish and chips but tonight's offering tasted like it had been deep fried in old engine oil. Yuck
Ordered and paid for two pieces of gurnard. Was definitely not gurnard - probably shark. No email or way to message the store to ask.

Snapper $7.50 the size of your sunglasses. Probably not the bang for your buck. Needed to use translator in the shop to communicate. Disclaimer: My reviews reflect my genuine experiences: good, bad, or exceptional. Five stars are for service that exceeds expectations. With over 400 reviews and 7000 contributions, as well as 522 restaurant reviews for The City Guide weekly, I don’t sweat small stuff like a $5 overcharge or bitter coffee. My feedback is solely about the quality of the experience.

This place dropped its previously high standards fot the past year or so but recent fish and chips were excellent. It seems they have returned to serving fresh, high quality, non greasy fish and chips. They again have no peer on the Hibiscus Coast.
BUYER BEWARE. Sold me half a hoki fillet (clearly cut down the middle) and refused to see the issue with that. All their fillets are a standard 80g. Most other takeaways double that.

New owners unfortunately don’t make it like the OG ones did. Rice was very hard seemed old and had hair stuck to the bottom of one of my sushi’s also when we arrived owners were just sitting on the ground outside the door vaping which wasn’t really a good look
My favourite Sushi and only sushi shop I got too 😁 been amazing for years. BEST SUSHI EVER!!
Very high-quality sushi and the salad cabbage with rice balls is amazing the sauce is incredible
I'm from Korea, so I missed food made from rice. I ordered the chicken katsu don. It's the taste I wanted.

Best sushi place on the coast period. Nice selection and great value, staff are friendly and they keep the place very tidy. My only gripe is that they tend to stop making fresh sushi around about 3pm, Fair enough but would be great if I were able to get sushi after that time

Amazing team with great commitment and the right attitude! Thanks so much for doing a perfect on Beach delivery for our group event on the weekend. Great service and very high quality delicious burgers and fries.

Food was delicious. best burger fuel I’ve ever been too, I will definitely be coming back. I felt so welcomed by the staff. I had to get the names of the staff to leave this review. Jacques, Jacob and olive. 10/10 for me

Love it at Whangaparaoa Burgerfuel, the food is delicious, fresh & hot. The deals they offer are awesome and the staff are so professional. Olivo is the best. Everytime we come he is always friendly, happy and extremely helpful. He creates the best atmosphere. Love this place.

I mean, come on!!! Are you kidding me?!?! Look at this thing. Gorgeous! Been a long time burger fuel fan but boy oh boy, Burger Fuel Whangaparaoa is on another level. Without fail, every single time they serve the freshest food. Buns, veggies, meat, sauce, fries!!!! On point. Not sure what they’re doing over there, maybe it’s the fresh sea breeze or the chilled coast lifestyle, but do yourself a favour and go try find out.

My absolute favourite burger fuel restaurant the staff are always so lovely and the foods outstanding. Didn't even have to say my name tonight when I picked up, I don't even go super super often so I'm gonna say that's another win for the BF staff at the whanga store and their customer service skills for remembering me! Keep being you! 🌟
Typical fast asian, pure takeaway, but good. Good prices and range of dishes. Pre order for the quickest turnaround
Good quality noodle and rice dishes to take away. Owners nice and helpful

The people were friendly and patient. I have 2 small kids and I generally get a very "annoyed" vibe when they are rowdy and I did NOT get that at all. I love it. The food is fantastic. My family and I will most certainly be back.

I've had decent food from here in the past, but today we thought we'd get something other than a sweet and sour dish. Ordered beef Thai green curry and Singapore noodles, AVOID!!!! Both were practically inedible. Their interpretation of these dishes was so far from anything I'd ever consider "Thai" or "Singaporean"! Was just noodles and rice with a ton of pepper... you guys need to try your own dishes, somethings wrong in your kitchen! I may as well threw $40 in the bin...
Have been going to Star Kitchen for 10 years. The best takeaways. Always good food and friendly staff. Do not have to wait to long for food.

I'm quite disappointed with my experience tonight. I ordered a chicken rice bowl and specifically wanted it with salad. However, when I got home, I realized there was no salad included. I called the restaurant, and while they did apologize, there was no attempt to offer a solution or alternative. I had made a special trip because I’ve been before and know the food is usually good, which makes it even more disappointing that the issue wasn’t properly addressed.

Best Korean Fried Chicken in Town! Dakogi Chicken never disappoints! The flavors are authentic and the chicken is always cooked perfectly—crispy on the outside and tender inside. Loved the soy garlic and spicy glaze options. Portion sizes are generous, and everything tastes freshly made. Great for takeaway or a casual dine-in. If you're a fried chicken lover, this place is a must-visit!

Absolutely Delicious Korean Fried Chicken! I tried Dakogi Chicken for the first time and it was amazing! The chicken was crispy, juicy, and full of flavor – just the right amount of spice and crunch. Their Korean-style sauces are next level. The staff were friendly and the service was quick. Great vibe and super clean place too. Highly recommend if you're craving something crispy and different. Will definitely be coming back! 🍗🔥

Absolutely disgusting that I paid $10 for a cup of bonless chicken and it had only 4 pieces in the cup. Your charging me $2.50 per peice. A rip off! Filled cup 3/4 of the way. Definitely gone down hill since new owners have taken over. Taste is good , service was average.

Just got the feast box! We got to try four flavours and each one was better than the last holy cow. Fries are 10/10 too. Mainly leaving this review though as the shop is so clean and well presented and the lady who served us (owner? Only staff member we saw!) was so lovely and welcoming!

Had aclovely time chilling, singing and dancing. Lol pool tables are good. People friendly and karaoke operator sure has some one liners on him. Lol. Overall a small but pleasant staff, and very satisfied. Thanks for having us...
all-round great experience highly recommend for a good night out on Thursdays Fridays
The staff are brilliant, very relaxing atmosphere and good food

Lured here to see a singing duo on a Saturday night. This is an upstairs bar with restaurant, two pool tables, outdoors area and views over Whangaparaoa. A pleasant evening with my partner dancing, but only a small social crowd of perhaps 20 people. Bar selection lacked some premium spirits, but generally bar prices were very reasonable as was restaurant food. I'm likely to return, as this bar is in my wider neighbourhood. We felt safe and had good interaction with locals 👍
Happy atmosphere excellent location

A bit grim inside, but can't complain about the food. I had my first ever deep-fried moro bar there and it was delish! I would recommend 687 for sure. But when I asked if ice cream goes with a deep-fried moro bar, the guy didn't know. He'd never tried one. I would strongly urge the staff to taste all the food that they're cooking at least once. It should be a given in the food industry that you know what you're cooking, even with fast food.

Wonderful little shop with great prices, tons of family packs, good fish, and bubble tea as well! Their fish are a bit on the small side, but most packs come with several so it doesn’t really matter. Very good soups as well! Haven’t tried most of the Chinese menu but we will soon.
The best chinese food I've had. Really good.
Great food. great prices.
Lovely family and great food from the old classic fish and chips to amazing Chinese. Well priced too

Great food & service. Visited for the first time as part of a baby shower & was impressed by the bar menu & service for a large gathering. Of the neck of that we celebrated my wife's 42nd there two weeks later & again excellent service looking after a large table with lots of adults & kids. The food arrived together & was beautiful (medium rare Scotch Fillet delicious). Bravo to the Archer team 👍

Went and had dinner here. I had lamb ribs, and my wife had Salmon. We both enjoyed our meals, with them being perfectly cooked. We finished off with the Apple and Pecan pie which was lovely to finish with. We will be back just for the dessert. Had another lovely meal here, had the Chicken Schnitzel and it was nice and tender and thick. 100% better than some we had on the Nirth Shore.
The food and service quality was truly exceptional, I can't wait to come back. My order Calamari $23.50 and pizza $34 Full of flavors and very mouth watering 😋 Keep up the great work 💯

Overall it was pretty good, been there before, hardly anyone there & somewhat cold. Good waitress, fish & chips very nice but who the heck puts cinnamon (and really strong cinnamon at that) on tiramisu? I think it even said chocolate on the menu. Totally ruined it & hour or so later still belching up cinnamon.

I cannot rave about this place enough! After suffering through the pandemic Danny and his team have pulled through and are still here. They are always bright, bubbly and make you feel like a long lost friend every time I walk in. The food is off the charts - fresh, hot and always reliable and consistent, great value for money. This is now our local, come on everyone support local and get out there and lets keep our small businesses alive by showing our support.
Highly recommended this place. Good food with good taste . I really like that secret herbs 🌿 touch on chicken on chips. Keep it up guyz . 10/10

First time here, I had the kebab and my partner the meat on chips... omg both amazing!!! My kebab fresh full of fillings yum as. . The meat on chips was full of meat like next level... unbelievable value for money. The man serving friendly and the place spotlessly clean. This is going to be our new go to takeaway for sure. Highly recommend.
Tried the chicken Shawarma, authentic taste and generous serving. Definitely coming back.

Delicious 100% recommend! I ordered chicken on rice now feel like im on a balcony in greece looking over the blue ocean. They add details best Kebab shop on the coast! Great value too! No photo because I inhaled it.
Great team who are great with communication and service. This is my go to takeaway. Best made in store Hummus, awesome meat on chips. Give it a go, 10/10

I wanted some sushi pieces with No Avacado it became a language barrier when I was trying to tell them I’m allergic. It was back and forth “do you have no avacado” …… “yes here avacado” Only to be told no they don’t make on request.
The best sushi on the Hibiscus Coast. Always have a good variety of fresh sushi and very friendly staff. I also appreciate the non-plastic packaging. Overall, just a fantastic little establishment.
LOVE the option of wasabi mayo on your sushi! Great food.

This is an amazing lunch spot! The Sushi is really well made and VERY tasty for the price. The fried chicken that they have in their sushi is TO DIE FOR!!!!! The employee that served me was very kind and gave me some miso soup to go with my meal! Also the store itself is small but very well presented and has a very cool vibe. HIGHLY recommend! I will most likely be a regular.
Fresh sushi, great prices and really friendly owners. Recommend!!

I brought a Large flat white coffee order number:154 and took 6 small sips and it's gone! it wasn't a large coffee as ordered but more like a small in a large cup! It was also a warm coffee and not hot.! I felt cheated! Now I wish brought one from Mobile I went in to tell her but got no where. Normally I love buying coffee here and it's always hot and to the top and takes least 12 sips before gone not 6! So now on I don't trust them and will have to open the lid when they hand it to me to make sure it's not a small in a large cup! I wouldn't trust them again and if half full they should do right thing and top it up! If this happens again

My daughter and I have stopped in this evening and we are from central Auckland. One of the first McDonald's that we have been to in years that is clean, the food it's amazing and the customer service is great. Thank you the great experience 🙏☺️
Ordered Quarter Pounder. Slice of cheese very dry crispy edged pattie and 1 cherkin in centre of pattie. No salad... Blimen awful. Don't go there very often even less now.

McDonald’s Whangaparaoa is a great spot for a quick, reliable meal. The restaurant is clean and well-maintained, providing a comfortable environment for dining in. The service is fast and efficient, ensuring that you receive your food promptly even during busy times. The staff are friendly and attentive, always ready to assist with any requests. The menu offers a wide variety of classic McDonald’s favorites, all prepared to the high standards you expect from the brand. Highly recommend McDonald’s Whangaparaoa for its convenient location, excellent service, and consistent quality. It’s a perfect place for a quick bite or a casual meal with family and friends.
This restaurant is very clean — we come here often!
Great coffee
Great coffee and food
Best coffee ever!!
Got petrol
Great food

What can i say.... first it's good to have a Chinese rest in Tau, and the 2 combination rice looks good. However I must confess that the BBQ pork tastes too sweet and the roast duck is a bit hard. I hope there can be some improvements.
I ordered bami goreng, and this came with a curry noodle. Also other food qualities are horrible. Please visit Manly Take away.
Love the Kumara chips & sweet and sour pork, overall, pretty good among the Chinese takeaways.

Hello, Chris stephenson,Because I haven't registered with the manager when I took over this business, I can only say sorry to you in this way. It closed at 8 o'clock in the afternoon on Thursday. Great venue, great views, great drinks, great staff, great times. Of all the various Beer Spots I've been to, this was definitely the nicest looking inside and out. Great arrangement with the food trucks directly outside too. And, I'm happy to say that after thirty something years wondering how to play Backgammon, we finally looked up the rules and had multiple games before closing time.

The manager Marie is so welcoming and friendly. The atmosphere is great and the selection of craft beers and wines from around NZ is vast. Marie is happy to offer her opinion and a taste of whichever lagers or ales you want to try before you buy. A fab venue, great staff and a different food van each week to keep the menu's exciting. Would definitely recommend 👌 There is also a really nice terrace with a sea view which adds to the appeal

Everything was awesome, except the food. We got some skewers and coleslaw salad from the truck. They were terrible. They used slow cook meat for skewers and the salad was not dressing, just cabbage rough sliced.
Great joint. Plenty of beer selection and frequent changes to keep it interesting. Good banter from the bar staff as well which makes all the difference.

***Under new management*** And you can tell it from the moment you walk in! Greeted by a big smile and a wonderful choice of cocktails 😊 Surprised by new cocktails yet to go on the menu by the owner and amazing daughter. 🍷 🍻 Lucky to have you on the coast! 🍀 See you guys soon! 👋

The burgers from here are delicious! I ordered the chicken burger which had some really good chicken in it. Another highlight of the menu was the epic fries which had lots of toppings. Having wrapping around the burgers was also a nice touch as the burgers didn’t leak sauce or anything.
Ordered online. Food ready when it was meant to be. Service quick and friendly. Prob the best veggie burger I have had ever. Chips also really nice.
Got a double cheeseburger for $23 and the burger was pretty good besides being quite tangy, and the fries were also nothing spectacular. got the meal quickly though

Came in tonight to order a promotion advertised on the back of a bus - the lovely lady on shift said they weren’t aware of the promotion, but she honoured it anyway. Very friendly staff, and the burger was delicious. Thank you ❤️
Love Better Burger Whangaparaoa. Worth downloading the app to get some good deals. Consistently fresh, delicious burgers and fries. Kids love it too.

Umi Restaurant is an absolute gem for sushi lovers, especially for families like mine! Located conveniently near the Whangaparāoa Library, it’s the perfect spot for a weekend outing with the kids. The sushi here is not only delicious but also incredibly affordable. Despite the low prices, the quality and variety are impressive, making it a fantastic value for money. The service is excellent too—friendly, efficient, and welcoming, which makes dining here a pleasant experience every time. The proximity to the library is a bonus. It’s a great way to combine a fun and educational outing with some fantastic food. My kids and I always enjoy spending time here, and Umi Restaurant has become one of our favorite weekend spots. Highly recommended for anyone in the area looking for tasty sushi, great service, and a family-friendly atmosphere!

Awesome sushi right in the plaza. It’s great because it’s affordable, delicious and you’re able to customise your order to pick and choose which pieces are your favourite. Staff are really kind and welcoming. I highly recommend

Out of all the sushi places around Stanmore Bay and Whangaparaoa, Umi has to be up there as possibly the best. Great selection of fresh sushi with good prices, quality, and variety so theres something for everyone.
The sushi was so delicious and fresh. It's a lovely restaurant with friendly staff.
Very cute and delicious shishi

We came as a couple for a quiet dinner and really enjoyed the food. The best rated restaurant on the coast, and the food lived up to it! The service was great too, very friendly and kind. Authentic butter chicken, rich sauce, and not too sweet with perfect spices. Highly recommend.

We loved our dinner at Sir Ji's today. I tried the vegetarian dishes, and they were fresh and delicious. Best Indian restaurant on the coast. Highly recommend!

If you haven’t tried it yet, you have to. Whether you love indian food, or you haven’t tried yet, this is a must restaurant to go. The food is amazing with fresh ingredients, cooked on the spot and portions are above generous. I love indian food and this one of the best indian restaurants I’ve been to i a very long time. Also the atmosphere is nice, calm with a super friendly staff. Thank you!
great little spot just down the road! nothing like this in the area. great service and great quality pizza - super cheap too! 🍕 thanks team xx

Dropped into the beerspot for a quick beer and I was very happy to see Amoremio pizza truck parked up there. We had a couple of super yummy pizzas highly recommended 😋 super yummy. Thanks team keep up the the good work.
The pizzas we ordered turned out to be bland, it felt overpriced for such a lack of flavour. Maybe it was an off day but overall it was dissapointing.

The food is very yummy, great pulled lamb pizza with a generous amount of topping, and the chicken karange tacos were also delicious. They had a good selection of items on the menu, short wait time for food, and I loved that they had heating on in winter so it wasn't cold. The place is also nice & spacious. Will be coming back :)
Friendly staff and delicious food. We met with the chef, and he was very enthusiastic, and it shows in the food he creates.
Have been to a few live music events here. Great atmosphere and staff are friendly. Lots of options re beverages and meals. The mural wall is a highlight and always enjoy our time

The Local Café has literally become our local. Reasonably priced, well presented tasty food. Plenty of Gluten Free options and these guys actually know how to make a really nice Chai Latte.
Popped into this very sweet cafe very early in the morning! There are plenty of manly regulars popping in and out and I can see why! They have a solid menu and good vibes.
Really friendly and efficient staff. Quick service and food well prepared.

Certainly one of the best cafes on the Whangaparaoa peninsula. Their coffee is great and their caramalised plum muffins are delicious! Great breakfasts too! The staff are always friendly and efficient. There are about 40 seats inside and about 16 outside covered seats.

I had a really good experience at Manly Bar and Grill. The MBG drink was amazing and very yummy. The service was exceptional and all the staff was incredibly friendly. I had the fettuccine and wood grilled pizza and both were to die for. They were accomodating to vegetarians as well. I would definitely reccomend going.

I went to this restaurant with my family the same day I arrived to Auckland. Owner and manager were very warm and welcoming. The restaurant itself is very cozy and nicely decorated. All food and wines we tried were just incredible. We had the Scotch fillet in garlic butter/jus, macadamia crusted lamb rump, pork belly in sweet chilly sauce, garlic cheese pizza, sticky date pudding and chocolate lava cake. It's our first visit. We enjoyed food and tab 🍺. Great service. Thank you for being kind to my kid.
We enjoyed a fantastic dinner at Manly Bar and Grill last night. The food was incredible and the service excellent. We'll def be back to try some different meals. Great work team

Absolutely beautiful food ... lovely atmosphere.. and wonderful service, the chefs are amazing here. I have held several big events at this restaurant and everything ran so smoothly I can't recommend enough! 5 stars 🌟
Beautiful meal and good atmosphere and chef Roger is a very nice guy and good service l
2 x plant based curries. Mushroom Mater Masala and Vege Madras. OMG out of this world flavour. Have rated atmosphere as 5 even though I had takeaway because the guy cooking in there was so friendly
Always a very good meal. Delicous reasonably priced and always enuf to take home. Just love it!

I ordered the caramel and raspberry cream layered cake for my daughters birthday. The service was amazing, I was provided with recommendations and it was ordered on Wednesday evening and was picked up Saturday. Everyone LOVED the cake! No pieces were left over.

I have tried several of their cakes, particularly delicious flavors 😋 Both girls are great I met Sophie at the Silverdale Market I tasted her cookies that she kindly gave me to test.
Thank you Dani and Sophie for the beautiful selection of sweet treats. Wonderfully light, melt in your mouth delicious!

Maison Thai was a fantastic surprise—an awesome Thai restaurant that delivered on flavour and atmosphere! If you’re in the area and craving authentic Thai food, this spot is definitely worth checking out. The food was honestly delicious. The curry was rich, creamy, and full of bold, traditional Thai spices. The Tom Yum soup had that perfect balance of tangy and spicy, and the sizzling plate was an absolute standout—hot, flavourful, and super satisfying. Every dish came out fresh and well-presented, and it’s clear the kitchen knows what they’re doing when it comes to Thai cuisine. One of the things that made the experience even better was the atmosphere. The decor and vibe of the restaurant really did feel like a little slice of Thailand—warm, colourful, and inviting. It made the whole dining experience feel that much more authentic and memorable. Service was another big tick—friendly, prompt, and attentive without being overbearing. The staff made us feel welcome from the moment we walked in, and the food came out in good time even though it was a busy evening. The only minor downside was the rice portion. For the price, the serving size was surprisingly small—especially since rice is such a staple with Thai food. A bit more generosity there would’ve made the meal feel more complete. That said, everything else made up for it, and it wouldn’t stop me from coming back. Overall, Maison Thai is a great spot for a flavour-packed, authentic Thai meal, with lovely service and a setting that transports you straight to Southeast Asia. I’d definitely return—and next time, maybe I’ll just order an extra bowl of rice!

Historically, we have always enjoyed the food at this restaurant, however, we have found recently that value for money and taste are severely lacking. We also found that the containers were only filled half full and for 24 and 21 dollars a meal (which did not include rice) this made the entire experience very disappointing. Additionally, there was only 7 small prawns and about 4-5 cashews and very little chicken in the other meal. Will not be ordering here again.
Got take aways for six people. Yummy food with a great range of spice levels. Was ready on time and a great temperature. Will definitely be getting taken away again!

Very yummy food with affordable price.. Been here with my husband for grab something for lunch. And it was delicious.. The guy who is serving us is really friendly... Also The place is clean and well look after.. First time come here but we will definitely come here again.. Cheers..
We normally do take out but the food is always very good. The staff are super friendly. Great food!

I've been here a few times and this has been my favourite Italian restaurant since my first visit. I'm more than willing to drive the 50km 1-way drive just to visit this place again. 👍🏻👍🏻

Delicious! The ingredients are very fresh. The food is beautifully presented. The portions are large enough. The service is very professional and makes you feel comfortable.

Brilliant place to come. Food is delicious.
Great refurbishment job. Awesome food and well worth a trip to check it out.
