Amazing taste! Felt like being welcomed into a friend’s home—warm and inviting. Every dish had a homemade touch with comforting flavors that filled both my heart and stomach. The owner’s kindness made me want to stay longer. Highly recommended!

We popped in today for lunch. First time so didn’t know what to expect. It was awesome, food was delicious and the staff did that awesome thing of bringing in out the kids food as soon as it was ready!! Lovely environment, great service and food and drinks are better than just good pub food! All with family feeling hospitality. We will be back!!
Such a great spot for amazing food and welcoming atmosphere with friendly staff and chatty customers. Highly recommend to book in advance as this has quickly become popular in the community.
Amazing spot! Kids loved the play area and music. Food is yummy! Our new gorgeous local 🤗

Such a great atmosphere, everything inside is so beautifully done with modern rustic feel 😍 family friendly, have plenty of high chairs and a great outdoor space for kids to burn everything off. Staff were amazing and super friendly. I had the ribs, flavour was out of this world, smokey, tender, sweet, sticky, with the smallest hint of spice, definitely will re order. Thank you Shed 16 🥰

SI highly recommend supporting local businesses. This was a truly wonderful experience. It's always delightful to discover a local gem during an evening stroll. G.O.A.T. lives up to its name. It is undoubtedly one of the best establishments in the area. The food was delicious and fresh. The service was excellent, with noticeable effort made to ensure the order accuracy. The overall atmosphere was beautifully presented and impeccably clean, boasting an A-grade food safety rating.

Absolutely delicious! Everything is super fresh and full of flavour. One of the best Chinese takeaways in Auckland by far. Even my 2-year-old absolutely loves it, he keeps asking for more!! Highly recommended.
Best stirfry noodles I've had in a longtime ❤️ beautiful well presented atmosphere and lovely owners. 10/10 thankyou kindly
Fantastic! Fresh, tasty food that hits every time
Very good!
I highly recommend Pizza Hut Milldale!! Friendly staff, very clean, fast service and delicious food!!!! Always a pleasure ordering from them. Thank you.
Very clean store I have been to, best Pizza Hut experience and quick service
Massive shout out to these guys! Best Pizza Hut around!!! Pizza toppings are right to the edge and full of flavour. Fast and efficient!! Thanks guys 👍
Best Pizza Hut around! The staff are always super friendly and the pizzas are good. Would definitely recommend!

What amazing service! Thank you so much! I really appreciate it! You would not believe me, I walked out a boom the wind pushes the pizzas right out of my hands. He came running out to help cleaned it up and made me a new pizza, absolutely so thankful! Man deserves a raise😉
I needed to get my last fix of fish and chips before I headed overseas for a few years. This was the place to do it for sure! Soooo good. Great size. Really tasty. Friendly service .
The snapper burger was so good! Clean and tidy, service was excellent Great little seating area inside to enjoy Will be back Highly recommended

Had their snapper burger, chips and crab stick. And OH MY GOODNESS 😍it was the best! I really had an amazing experience at Ocean Eats! The snapper burger was absolutely delicious—perfectly seasoned with a fresh, crispy finish. The fish in the burger was huge!!! My dad had to take half of it out of the burger so he could get a good bite. But I wasn’t complaining because on its own, the fish was also soooo good! The chips were golden and perfectly crunchy, and the crab stick was the perfect complement to the meal. Everything was fresh, flavorful, and cooked to perfection. Great service and a relaxed atmosphere made for an unforgettable dining experience. Highly recommend for anyone craving tasty seafood! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
We’ve been here today had blue cod fish & chip! First time trying blue cod deep fry it’s really crispy and fresh! Will definitely come back again 👍👍👍
Bought blue cod today. Can taste the freshness. Best local fish shop.

Absolutely delicious Ribs. Highly recommend Rib n Roast to everyone. Will certainly be a regular. Super friendly staff. 🙂 Below scores are out of 5 ⭐️s 😉 Customer Service 5 ⭐️ 🧑‍🍳 Food Quality 5 ⭐️ 👌 Atmosphere 5 ⭐️ 🙂 Presentation 5 ⭐️ 🙂 Products 5 ⭐️ 📍 Location 5 ⭐️ 💰 Price $ (rated between 1 - 5 $) 🅿️ Parking: Lots of free parking available Overall 5 ⭐️

We passed thru enroute from Queenstown to Whangarei around 7pm .. on a Weds evening.... No wait and the SMALL roast meals were simply excellant both in meat and food quality but volume... As long term local Queenstowners.... The pricing was considerably less than were we live...... Well done guys... we wish you all the best for the future....

Unfortunately it’s been like this the last few times we’ve ordered, it tastes like retirement home roast or worse because it’s tough as well as bland. Watery gravy, undercooked pumpkin, tough meat and everything bland. All three of us agreed. Each time I say let’s not eat there again but then we end up coming back hopeful this time it will be different. I still hope for that, it could be improved, hence why I’m providing this feedback. Maybe ask your most honest friends to do a taste check on everything. Maybe some more recent (a few months ago) changes to recipes need to be reviewed again. I’d love to enjoy your food and I’d love for your business to always do well. Put three stars because you clearly work hard and are good people. Sorry to be a downer.
One of the better roast places we've tried across Auckland! Food is cooked properly and well seasoned. Their desserts are a must try too. We will back for their ribs which is available only from 4pm.

Love this place. Will never go to another roast shop after eating their food. Roast Pork I find is the best. They also serve pork ribs which is also real good. Brisket is served on Fridays. Roast beef is good. Rolls are very manly. Just meat, gravy and a roll. No salad and it's better that way. Potato scallops are 👍🏽. If you haven't been you must go. Would do real well if they opened a store out south and out west.

Went for lunch on a Friday. Located in Silverdale, and this is probably the best gastro pub one can find on the coast. Had a hazy panel ale and another Jameson with coffee liquor and cream (was really a good one). The lamb shank in Mains was awesome - soft , succulent and slow cooked. The meat on the pork rack was very soft and tasty (could have put a bit more sauce on it though 😉). Comes with coleslaw and a bucket of fries !! Good big portions, and justifies the cost. Will definitely visit again, and highly recommended!

Just called in here for a late lunch. Wednesday deal 2 for 1 pizza. Absolutely delish pizzas. Grabbed a Jug of beer too & biggest jugs ever!!! Great friendly young lady at the bar..plus game of pool outside & fantastic music that you can hear & actually get a good vibe going. Highly recommended coming here!!!
Great vibe and delicious food. The deck is still warm on a cold night. The chicken Parma was great and the kids liked their meals. Only criticism was the Mojito was without mint and not good
Northern Bistro is awesome – food’s spot on, staff are super friendly, and the vibe is buzzing. Loved it! And great pub quiz!
Excellent customer service + the Pizzas were soo good ! Highly recommend!

The best pizza I have ever had! The crust is thin and crispy, and the toppings are always fresh and flavorful. I especially love the vege pizza and Buffalo chicken pizza. The staff is also very friendly and accommodating. Bit pricy but still worth it Buffalo chicken $52 Vege pizza half $25.50 Mozzarella sticks x2 $14 each pack

Very hit or miss… it’s always a gamble any time you place an order here as to whether the food is going to be any good. Shocking prices for what little amount of toppings you get. At roughly 8 dollars a slice, you’d expect more than a pittance of chicken on a slice of the buffalo chicken blue cheese pizza. You are mostly paying for flour and water… I know it’s the same price across the country but come on, that’s taking the piss.

Such a delicious pizza 😋🍕 . The variety of pizza is fabulous. Authentic test of ingredients they use. If you are vegetarian, try their 5 boroughs and nanno.Moreover guy who serve us was great person himself ( Dalilo ). Thank you for the free zeppole ( dessert ).

This particular time it was not a good, or even okay pizza, and it wasn’t worth the price I paid for it. Overall a very ‘chewy’ pizza, and definitely didn’t taste anywhere as good as the ones I’ve had at other Sals stores. Also a free garlic knot, it was way undercooked - had to throw it away. Zeppolas were great though, best thing on the menu in my opinion.

Not worth the price. Not cooked enough. Big droop even with folding the slice. No leoparding of crust. Dough has ok chew. Pepperoni greasy and no spice at all. If you want to pay $33 plus for a pizza go to a restaurant

I recently ordered from burger fuel Silverdale and was delighted to find my food perfectly crisp and immaculately cooked. The young Ladie, Sienna, behind the counter was very polite and caring toward me and was willing to help as I struggle to read and couldn't quite read the menu with my old eyes. To sum up, the food was good, the staff (especially sienna who served me), and the overall environment made me feel welcome and glad to be there.

The service was impressively swift, getting us our meal in record time. As usual, the food was absolutely delicious and satisfying, making us very happy. The upbeat music playing in the background created a fun and lively atmosphere. We always enjoy our time when we come here, it's a great experience!
I loved the burger! It was so yummy and definitely exeeded my expectations for burgers and the service was top tier. Impeccable atmosphere and definitely felt like home😊😊😊

Expectation vs reality. 7 bucks for half a pack of chips/Kumara fries is pretty steep. Not to mention we actually asked for 2x kumara but got one... usually don't have an issue here but always a first...

A friendly welcome on arrival. My order was ready on time - fresh and hot. It was a cold night and I was dining in so wanted the warmest seating area, so I was directed to a table near the heater. Great service and a tasty, juicy burger!!

Ordered spicy chicken and they gave me original. What's the point in the 40c more if you're not going to serve as paid? Also missed giving the Zinger burgers when we ordered the Zinger Stinger and then I needed to wait in at the counter for 10 minutes to ask for them. If you need more staff, advertise. The pieces of original recipe chicken had half of the skin missing and were tiny pieces. As far as KFC experiences goes, this was one of the worse ones.
Always a good place to eat some fried chicken, especially after a long day at work. Drive-through was busy, but I was able to get my chicken fast
Staff was very friendly and helpful. I got my food quickly and everything was there. Just an experience I will remember.

KFC offers tasty fried chicken, but service can be slow at times. The food is usually hot and fresh, though orders are occasionally incorrect. It's a convenient spot for a quick meal if you're not in a rush.

This is the third time we've had a disappointing experience at the KFC in Silverdale. We ordered a bucket meal, and the chicken pieces were ridiculously small. All the wings were about half the size of a teaspoon, and the other pieces weren’t much better. For a $60 meal, this was absolutely not worth it. To make matters worse, no one answered the phone when we tried to lodge a complaint.

Absolutely disgusting to eat there not one surface is clean at all bird poop all over the tables and chairs, next a bird flys in and lands on my sushi. Absolutely disgusting staff didn't care much at all
Tried Sushi Donburi made to order, well rated. Regular sushi goer at St Pierres AKL-wide.

Haven’t had from here in awhile but it seems that as the sushi’s value of the day increases in price the quality and quantity of the value sushi decreases drastically. Had the Friday salmon and was met with the smallest piece of salmon that wasn’t even that great in taste.
The best St Pierre's! Got 3 packs of sushi all fresh and tasty, very friendly staff and good price, very recommended!
We had some miso soup and the mikando platter of different types of sushi. Loved it and loved it more with wasabi and soy sauce on top!!!
Amazing! It exceeded my expectations. As a Sichuan native, I never expected a Cantonese restaurant to make such delicious Sichuan cuisine.
The Best Take-away in the area! Great value for money. Kind and friendly staff.

Simply the best Chinese food - all the dishes you normally get at your average Chinese take out but restaurant quality! Lovely people - very friendly and happy. And although we haven’t dined in yet, the restaurant side atmosphere is great. You won’t be disappointed.

Wanted to try this place out since it’s closer than our usual at 687 takeaways and I was rather disappointed with the quality of the vegetable fried rice. Not terrible but next time I’ll take the longer drive over to Whangaparāoa

Been going here regularly for years, best Chinese restaurant north of Albany. Plenty of dishes to choose from, portion sizes are very large (the photo is of a nearly complete portion, as I forgot to take the photo before eating,) and the owners are very friendly. They are also very accommodating for special requests from customers such as extra sauce, less salt ect. The quality of the food is excellent, the skin of the sweet & sour pork is crispy so it was made fresh and not microwaved.
amazing amazing amazing. free drinks. good selection. easily accessible. fast delicious food. 100000/10 wouls recommend!!!!!😻

I’ve had consistently good experiences with Pizza Hut Silverdale in the past, which makes this recent visit all the more disappointing. Our order arrived thirty minutes late with no communication or apology, and unfortunately, the pizza itself reflected the delay—it was cold, soggy, and lacked the usual quality we've come to expect. My children, eager and hungry, kept asking, “Where’s the pizza, Dad?”—a question I was increasingly embarrassed not to be able to answer. I understand delays can happen, but a simple acknowledgment or even a warm pizza would’ve gone a long way. Hopefully just an off night, but certainly not up to standard this time around.
God this service makes me so warm and fuzzy inside, triple cheese is so delish would recommend.💦💦💦

My friend and I went to a restaurant and ordered The Limo 1 Metre Pizza with 3 flavors and 2 sides. Despite the busy time, the staff was very friendly. They were handling both pick-up and delivery orders, but we decided to dine in. The staff members were still smiling and our order was prepared quickly and served fresh. We enjoyed our meal, although we couldn't finish the entire 1 metre pizza. The staff kindly provided us with a small box to take the leftovers home. We appreciate the excellent customer service and delicious pizza. Keep up the good work!

Terrible! Waited 1.5 hours at the store for our order. They had obviously been sent for delivery by mistake by the time we got them. We said they were cold and hard and they refused refund! So many unhappy customers there tonight all in the same boat as us. Disgusting service and a total rip off. Do better Pizza Hut!
This used to be my morning coffee fix but lately it became inconsistent with the taste.

Best fish and chips in the region. Nothing in Orewa or Silverdale can match the quality of this place. They are fussy about your food experience and genuinely care about making good food for you. Look at the pictures. I watched them cook this lot and noticed they cooked different items for different periods of times. The squid rings are freakishly good. The snapper, thick and generous. The scallops are very good with a thin batter and cooked, just so. The chips are near perfect and come in two sizes. I'm happy these folks have arrived in the neighbourhood and lifted our spirits with good fare.

I recently tried the vegetarian burger from Milldale takeaway and I was really impressed! The patty was tasty and cooked just right — not dry or bland like some veggie burgers can be. The fresh toppings and soft bun made it even better, and the sauces tied everything together perfectly. On top of that, the customer service was great — super friendly and quick, which made the whole experience even better. Highly recommend if you’re looking for delicious options and excellent service. I’ll definitely be back for more!

**BEST FISH BURGERS** we have ever had!! Wow! Honestly worth the drive from Whangaparaoa! Great customer service, very clean and presentable premises. Thanks Milldale Takeaways - So great and rare to have an awesome family fish and chip experience! You crushed it!

I recently tried the Mango Creamy drink from Milldale Takeaway, and it was an absolute treat! The balance of fresh, sweet mango flavor blended perfectly with the creamy texture made every sip indulgent. It wasn’t overly sweet, which is a huge plus for me, and the creaminess gave it a smooth, rich finish without being too heavy. It’s the perfect refreshing drink for any time of day. I highly recommend trying it—Milldale Takeaway has nailed it with this one! I love their menu huge variety and the customer service was great 🙏⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I don't usually bother writing reviews but this is the best fish and chips we've found in this area. Really crispy and great value for money compared with competitors - much more generous scoops of chips. Yum!

Great value and really tasty—especially for my little boy, who’s been enjoying Japanese food since he was 6 months old! We loved the sushi, tempura, ramen, and of course… more sushi! We’ll definitely be back!

Brand new sushi restaurant Now My favorite restaurant in Milldale 🍣🍱🍜 Fresh salmon 🍣 big size salmon and sushi !!!! Also Love Otsu ramen 🍜 Simple, clean and friendly staff! Thank you Tomas😉 I love it here😍❤️
So happy that this is my new local! The food is so fresh and delicious, highly highly recommend!

Best Indian food we’ve tried! The owner of the newly opened restaurant welcomed us with a friendly greeting and was very accommodating. We ordered the butter chicken which was so creamy, the chicken was very juicy, and it paired well with the crispy, freshly made, garlic and cheese naan! We also had the chicken tikka appetiser which my husband and I loved and to top it all off, the mango lassi that was not too sweet, the perfect balance and best we ever had. I’m glad we discovered a new Indian restaurant that we’ll keep coming back to!

I had a fantastic dining experience at Kasuri - Indian Eatery & Bar! The decor was minimal but welcoming, creating a cozy and comfortable atmosphere. We tried Paneer Tikka, Vegetable Biryani, Samosa Chaat, Special Naan with sweet stuffing, and Dewaani Handi (a spinach-based curry). Every dish was absolutely delicious, and I loved all of them! The flavors were rich and authentic, with each dish prepared to perfection. The Vegetable Biryani stood out the most—it was hands down the best I’ve had in Auckland! The Samosa Chaat was also a highlight, and to our surprise, it wasn’t charged since our bill exceeded $50—a thoughtful touch that made our experience even better. Service was excellent—friendly, attentive, and efficient. Even though the restaurant wasn’t busy, the staff made sure we felt welcomed and well taken care of. The 40-minute drive was absolutely worth it, and this might just become my go-to place for Indian cuisine! Highly recommend Kasuri to anyone looking for authentic and flavorful Indian food. I’ll definitely be back!!!!!

Absolutely incredible meal! We were delighted. From the moment the samosas hit the table, we knew we were in for something special. Perfectly crisp, packed with flavour, and seriously moreish. The mains were just as impressive. The butter chicken was rich and creamy, the lamb rogan josh was beautifully tender with just the right amount of heat, and the chicken kadai was full of bold, punchy spice. The naan was soft, fluffy, with perfect crispy edges. Every dish felt thoughtfully made and packed with authentic flavour. We left full, happy, and already planning our next visit. Couldn’t recommend it more!

We visited this newly opened Indian restaurant in our neighbourhood and ordered Kadai Chicken, Lamb Biryani, and garlic naan. We went with medium spicy for everything, and we both agreed that if you can handle some heat, this spice level is a great starting point. Our favourite was the Kadai Chicken– the chicken was tender, the gravy was rich and full of flavour, and the capsicum in it added a fresh, vibrant taste that blended perfectly with the spices. It paired beautifully with the garlic naan. The owner and staff were also wonderful – we could feel their passion and enthusiasm for this new restaurant. We had a great experience and can’t wait to come back!

Amazing food, great atmosphere and super friendly service. We booked for 4 and dined in, and very much enjoyed our experience. Standout dishes were the Stuffed Mushrooms, the Goat Curry and the unique Kasuri curry which i haven't had anywhere else in NZ. Highly reccomend this place.

Flabbergasted by the quality and service I received, a sensational concept. They had fries that were curled into spirals, they called them “curly fries.” Seriously ravishing! A genuinely ingenious idea which must be a winner amongst the large number of customers. Could not complain.
Burger is big , fresh and hot. Definitely will go back. Order online more than $15 got curly fries for free. This is nice deal. Food is like a fine dinning restaurant. Thanks team.
Great food, fast and friendly first. Love the concept and the fact that it supports our local rugby club.
absolutely abominable and horrid egg’d burger, doused in sauce and smoothie tasted like it was rolled in dirt
The meal i devoured was very delishous and i liked it, thanks to the workers behind the scenes for making my meal xx

Loved it, very cool place! First time here with hubby and teenagers for dinner in June. Booked a cushion booth online. Great website with easy booking system. Recommend booking to get the type of table you prefer, especially if it is a Friday or Saturday night. Fabulous theme and decor, service very good. Open kitchen which is always great! Great ambience which is rare in Auckland restaurants. We had quite a wait for our meals to arrive, but didn't bother us and was worth the wait as we all enjoyed our meals and they were all a really good size. Joe's kumara chips & aoli were gorgeous 👌Hubby's steak was a bit chewy but still enjoyed it. Joe's Caesar with grilled chicken and anchovies was delicious 😋 Butcher's Window Pizza and Beef Burger were also very good. Loved the service buttons on the table, haven't seen that anywhere (in the world) before, great idea! HIGHLY recommend 👌 we will definitely be back 😀

We had got Uber eats for dinner from here several weeks earlier and really enjoyed the salads, burgers and fries so booked in for a family birthday breakfast for one of the children. The staff were fantastic going out of their way to set up for us. The place is really well decorated with lots for the children to look at and colouring provided at the table which is great. The coffee was excellent (we all got seconds). The food was really tasty - the only complaint I had (and I checked with the others later quietly too but didn't want to make a scene at the time due to the occasion), was that so many things on the breakfast menu said "smashed spuds". Well I'm a spuds girl so if I see that on a menu I'll be ordering it. Sadly there were no smashed spuds in sight. Merely cubed. They weren't great. Everything else was good though and I'll happily go back for sure, I'll just readjust my expectations before ordering.

New year's day and our first feed of 2025. Mmmm coffee and the local from the menu please. Service and delivery of food near perfect. Food good value for money and tasty. More bread would have been nice is my only complaint. I'm fussy. This place is very close to five stars for all but, perfection is very rare. Eat here. It's good. Coffee is excellent. Fast service. Kids welcome. I'll be back.
Had my 17th birthday in the function room last Saturday and the food was scrumptious, the room was a perfect space to accomodate my group, and the staff were super friendly and attentive ☺️

First time there. Great big spaces so we could sit near people but not feel too close. Lovely staff. I ordered the Gorgeous George. Food was plenty, though I wouldn't say it was a very cohesive meal. It was good for the sensory sensitive who like to have their foods separate on the plate! Love that they have a menu for dogs :)

Outstanding Pizzas and Service! I recently ordered pizzas from the Silverdale Hell Pizza store, and I was thoroughly impressed. The pizzas were delicious—with a generous number of toppings, a fresh base, and fantastic presentation. The flavours were spot on and really well balanced. What made the experience even better was the exceptional service we received from the staff—friendly, efficient, and professional. Highly recommend this store for anyone looking for top-quality pizza and a great customer experience. Thank you!

We recently ordered from Hell Pizza and were blown away by how delicious everything was. The crust was perfectly crisp, the toppings were generous and full of flavour, and the whole experience was just next-level tasty. Every bite was a delight—we genuinely enjoyed it from start to finish. If you’re craving pizza that hits the spot and leaves you wanting more, Hell Pizza is a must-try. We highly recommend it to anyone looking for bold flavours and quality ingredients. Trust us, it’s worth every bite! 🍕😋
Quick service, hot food, and everything exactly as ordered. Great value for the price — simple, tasty, and satisfying
Had the Lust Deluxe and Greed pizzas – both were really tasty! Staff were super friendly and the service was great. Will definitely go back again
Pretty decent pizza. Very long wait to get the pizzas made. Plenty of flavor options with lots of unique combinations.

1 Star – $38 for this?! Never again. I honestly don’t even know where to start. I paid twenty-seven dollars expecting something halfway decent, and what I got looked (and tasted) like leftovers scraped off a buffet tray at closing time. The “stir-fry” was a soggy pile of confusion—rubbery squid rings drowning in oil, wilted vegetables that tasted reheated three times, and a mussel that looked like it crawled out of a swamp. The noodles were limp and flavorless, like they’d been sitting in a steam tray since yesterday. Whatever sauce they used was a mystery sludge of soy and despair. And those wings? Don’t let the picture fool you. They were dry, bland, and somehow managed to taste both overcooked and underseasoned. The tiny plastic cup of sweet chili sauce couldn’t save them—it was more like a sad afterthought than a pairing. Presentation? This came wrapped in tissue paper like a butcher’s mistake, shoved into a black plastic tray that made everything sweat and stew in its own sadness. The whole meal looked like it had given up on life before it even reached me. Save your money. Go anywhere else. Or just eat cereal. It’ll be more satisfying.

The location and atmosphere were great, creating a pleasant ambiance. However, the food was quite underwhelming. They charged $2.50 for a tiny portion of chile sauce, which felt overpriced. The complimentary spring rolls were super oily, I couldn’t bring myself to eat them. The quality of the food just didn’t match the setting, leaving me a bit disappointed overall.
Been here multiple times and still love this place. Really yummy, fresh and decently affordable Thai place with great options. They also have nice drinks too. Would come back again for sure!

The food was absolutely delicious. Every dish we tried was a hit, and the service was excellent. The staff were incredibly friendly and attentive, making us feel right at home. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for Thai food.

Randomly came in and tried their lunch. Was very happy. Decided to get takeaway tonight and did not dissapoint! Really tasty. Ordered hot and was happy with the level of spice. Will try "thai hot" next time.. thanks team

Overall, an average takeaway spot. I ordered a meat on chips and a chicken lunch box with an extra drumstick. The service was good, and it's a tidy and clean looking shop. It is a bit pricey for a takeaway spot, the food was average and overwhelmed by sauce. I was disappointed to pay an extra $4 to receive a drumstick that was not much larger than a finger (see photo). Some positives, some negative, average experience

Finally went im after living up the road for a while now. Now when I go to a kebab shop i don't go for a burger or fried chicken, I go for why you would go to a kebab shop. Kebabs and Rice dishes. The staff are friendly and welcoming. The restaurant is clean and tidy and smells good. I ordered a medium lamb rice dish combo. Price is $24.00 which pretty standard for a rice dish these days. Maybe a little bit on the pricey side. The lamb is the whole meat style of lamb and not the mince kind which I preferred. The salad tastes fresh and the portions are pretty standard if not a little on the generous side. Overall yes I'll be back. It's a kebab shop that does exactly what it's supposed to. It makes a good kebab slathered in hot Chilli sauce with a side of crispy hot well seasoned chips

Shoutout to the folks at Kebabs on Shore Silverdale! We've been eyeing up their store for ages, and they finally opened right before we headed off overseas. Went along without any hesitation and I was obliterated with the friendliest and most enthusiastic customer service, which can often seem a rarity these days. Attentive, super considerate and immediately apologised as there was going to be a bit of a wait due to how busy it was at the time (but honestly, good for them - no qualms at all). Our family ordered a multitude of items and I have to say they were incredibly generous with the portions and it was as wholesome as they were. Loved the flavour too. We headed back today aswell, and I got the Super Doner Kebab. Man, that was packed, so juicy (is that the correct term?) and it was so full of flavour. My soul is also full. I ate so fast I forgot to take a snap of this one, but know that it hit the spot. Service with a smile, and even a written message in the wrap itself. The little things right? Highly recommended! Keep it up, team. Stellar quality, and it's about time we had a goodie on the coast!

I’ve never write reviews but felt like I had to cause your guys food is so good and all the staff are genuinely so kind. My fav place to go on my lunch break def recommend the kebab, shawarma and chips!!! My fav kebab place on the coast, the meat has a real good flavour, and the salad to meat ratio is perfect🤩as lots of places on the coast put wayyy too much salad and barely any meat and taste so dry. Again the staff are so nice which made me want to put up a review as they deserve all the recognition!
This food is amazing The service was nice and even got a free drink. As well as saying thank you on all the food coming here again Thx

I was served by really lovely people, their food was yummy, good amount of chips and nice sized fish in my burger. Perfectly cooked chips. They held my food for me briefly while I went to another store during the cooking time.
Chicken cashew pineapple was the TOP!!! Wonton never fails to impress me, it is my go to take away.
This is a classic. Epic fried rice. The vibe of this place take me back to being a kid. Just OG
Lovely store and delicious food at a very reasonable price, my new local for sure
Owners are super friendly . They have a huge menu and the food was yummy. Easy parking nearby.

Today, I visited a Mexican restaurant on the Hibiscus Coast, and I must say — it was one of the best dining experiences I’ve had! The food was absolutely delicious, and the hospitality was truly heartwarming. We tried the guacamole, nachos, and tacos — everything was fresh, flavorful, and made with love. The owner was incredibly kind, and the staff made us feel so welcome throughout. I highly recommend this place to anyone in the area — they’re honestly the best on the Shore! 🌮💛👏 #SupportLocal #MexicanFoodLove #HibiscusCoast

WOW!!! What amazing service, lovely gentleman welcomed us in and even assisted mum with her wheelchair. Getting really nice service and really good food. It was super fast. And man tasted amazing! Highly recommend!

Staff was friendly. The tacos had so much flavour and the lemonade was delicious. Atmosphere was pleasant. The photo is of a wine cocktail my friend necked back as it was delicious. I don't known the name of the drink but I'm sure the staff could assist you with that

I'm a fan of the King's Choice selection... not a huge fan of digitally ordering and waiting for my number to be called, but it is the modern way of doing things. I spent nearly $30 on a large combo expecting a decent fast-food meal. What I got instead was lukewarm food, undersized portions, and a side of food poisoning. The value for money is laughable—small burger, half-full chips, and a drink that felt more like filler than refreshment. But the real kicker? A few hours later, I was violently ill. No one expects gourmet from Burger King, but basic food safety shouldn’t be too much to ask. I’m not the type to complain over minor issues, but when a $30 meal ruins your night and your gut, something’s gone very wrong. Whether it's poor handling, bad storage, or just careless prep, this was unacceptable. Burger King Silverdale, lift your game

I was informed that photography without permission was not allowed, a claim that took me aback. Despite my polite attempt to seek permission, the response was discourteous and unaccommodating. Pizza Club Silverdale is a delightful pizzeria that offers a wonderful dining experience for pizza enthusiasts. Nestled in the heart of Silverdale, this restaurant has carved its place among the local food scene with its exceptional offerings, and their Butter Chicken pizza stands out as an absolute must-try! Upon entering Pizza Club Silverdale, the warm ambiance and friendly staff made me feel welcome. The menu presented a wide array of pizza options, ranging from classic flavors to innovative combinations. As a fan of Indian cuisine, my curiosity led me to choose the Butter Chicken pizza for takeaway, and it turned out to be a fantastic decision. When I received my order for takeaway, the aroma of the spices and the tantalizing combination of colors on the crust immediately captivated me. The pizza was neatly packed and ready for me to enjoy at home. Back at home, I couldn't wait to savor the flavors of the Butter Chicken pizza. The crust was cooked to perfection – crispy on the outside and delightfully fluffy on the inside. The generous layer of creamy butter chicken sauce served as a perfect base for the toppings. The pizza was generously topped with succulent pieces of marinated chicken, cooked to perfection and bursting with flavor. Slices of fresh bell peppers, onions, and tomatoes added a vibrant touch, infusing the pizza with a delightful medley of textures and tastes. The expertly melted cheese binding all the ingredients together made each bite an absolute pleasure. What impressed me the most was the delicate balance of flavors. The butter chicken sauce was rich and velvety, boasting a harmonious blend of Indian spices that perfectly complemented the traditional pizza elements. It was a unique fusion of two beloved cuisines, resulting in a symphony of tastes that danced on my palate. Though I didn't have the opportunity to enjoy the pizza at the restaurant itself, the experience of savoring the Butter Chicken pizza at home was just as delightful. The portion size was generous, making it an ideal choice for sharing with friends or family. However, I must admit, it was so delicious that I couldn't resist indulging in every last bite. In conclusion, if you find yourself in Silverdale and have an adventurous palate, I highly recommend giving Pizza Club a visit or ordering their Butter Chicken pizza for takeaway. The flavorful fusion of Indian and Italian cuisines will undoubtedly leave you craving for more. Their excellent pizza, coupled with friendly service, ensures a memorable dining experience, whether you dine in or take away.

Pizza always cooked to perfection and always consistent. Service is very straight to the point, however, I have noticed new staff working here who are much nicer to deal with than when the store first opened. This is always our go to branch kn the Hibiscus coast and I would highly recommend it.

Consistent and delicious. Perhaps it’s the new store but it’s probably the best dominos I have had. Below scores are out of 5 ⭐️s 😉 Customer Service 5 ⭐️ 🧑‍🍳 Food Quality 5 ⭐️ 🙂 Presentation 5 ⭐️ 🙂 Products 5 ⭐️ 📍 Location 5 ⭐️ 💰 Price $ (rated between 1 - 5 $) 🅿️ Parking: Lots of free parking available Overall 5 ⭐️

The pizza was made wrong and when I brought it up with them, they ignored me for 5 minutes before offering to put the vegetables that were missed raw on the pizza and the remaining vegetables they told me were unavailable. The staff were non responsive and seemed very disinterested and rather rude. There was a sign saying to leave a review for a free garlic bread hence this review.

Online delivery order was placed at just after 8 with deliver time between 8.20 and 8.30. At 8.40 we rung the store to follow up, when the staff member told us that he only had one delivery driver and the timing of our delivery was "not his problem". Pizzas were warm when they eventually at 9.11pm, over an hour later. Needless to say that we won't be supporting this store again.

Just picked up my pizza. Completely ignored while they answered the phone more than once. My pizzas were ready, just had to be handed them. I paid for extra meat, which there was hardly any. Taken pic as might post on FB. Very disappointed.

Best Malaysian/Chinese on the Hibiscus Coast by far! Staff is so lovely, atmosphere is relaxed and friendly. Food is out of this world fresh, flavourful, and the portions are large for the cost! 10/10 Please give it a try!

We absolutely love this place! The food is always fresh and full of flavor, and the service is top-notch. The staff are super friendly and welcoming, making you feel right at home. The chef is amazing—not only talented but also really kind and engaging. You can tell they genuinely care about their customers. If you're looking for great food and a warm atmosphere, this is the spot to go. Highly recommend!

I’ve given this place multiple chances, but my recent experience really pushed me to leave a review. I ordered laksa and received a strange, careless mix of yellow egg noodles and random rice vermicelli—which isn’t how laksa is meant to be served, and certainly not how it’s shown or described. The dish looked slapped together with zero attention to detail. As someone who orders regularly, it’s frustrating to be treated like quality control doesn’t matter. When nearly every second order I receive from this place has some kind of issue, it stops feeling like bad luck and starts to feel like they just don’t care. If you’re going to charge full price, the least you can do is make the dish correctly. Disappointed and definitely rethinking future orders.

Great dinner, huge portions and delicious. We had entrees and my Beef Rendang was great, perfect flavour. Also had Indonesian Fried Rice and Sweet & Sour Chicken, all delicious. Service was very good very friendly and nothing was too much trouble. Had a great dinner and will definitely go back.

Quality food, had the Mongolian beef on a hot plate, vege curry puffs and a fish dish I can remember what it was called lol, and everything was delicious, cheap too. Highly recommend To follow up, I've been here a few more times and the kung Pao chicken is excellent 👌🏻💯💯🔥🔥🔥

Very tasty food, friendly service and nice atmosphere, will definitely be back! Had the dahl, chicken vindaloo and chicken sagwalla and all were flavoursome with a nice spice and a good amount of chicken. Highly recommend!
My usual indian takeaway was closed last night so came here and Im sorry to say the butter chicken was too watery. Wouldn't normally leave a review but was disappointed. Hopefully just a once off.
Had a lovely dinner with my partner tonight, lovely service food was amazing! The lamb samosas are a must try! As well as the butter chicken and chicken vindaloo! Can’t wait to come back

Took my family of 6 there to try the newly opened Indian restaurant and was not disappointed. We ordered 4 dishes of food and 7 pieces of bread and were all super satisfied by the deliciously flavoursome cuisine. Amazing + friendly customer service as well. Great restaurant - definitely recommend it!

Easy parking around the back of the restaurant makes dining in or takeaway easy. There are many GF/Gluten-free options and a whole section of vegetarian/vegan curries. There's also an indo-chinese section of the menu. Friendy but professional staff and a good range of wines/drinks are available.
My partner and I are regulars here. We love the food, never disappoints us. Good prices, full of flavour. Our favourite Indian restaurant within an hours drive of home

Ordered $15 special meal, I had Chicken Tikka Masala and rice, very good portion. The chicken taste very tender, sauce contains rich flavor. Can’t wait to go back and try others on the menu! Highly recommend to you all~

I would say one of the best Indian restaurants in WA. The food is awesomely good, my favourite was the Bombay Anu a savoury and not so spicy potatoe curry. The beef vindaloo was melt in your mouth tender and the saffron rice light and fluffy, all very delicious. The wait staff are great and seem to anticipate your needs making for a wonderful meal. Second time there will definitely be going back.

Where I live, I'm spoilt for choice for high quality Indian food. Unfortunately the good folk of Red Beach do not have such a luxury. We were the only people in the restaurant, though there were quite a few takeaway orders coming in. Admittedly the Curry Hutt was clean with one member of staff who was working quite hard managing the till, orders, takeaway and service. Unfortunately he didn't seem to have a great grasp on the menu when we questioned some dishes. Overall the food failed to impress, very generic, bland sauce and rice. The most impressive thing about the Curry Hutt was fitting a 650ml beer into a 400ml glass. Questioned this twice to receive a smile and a nod. I believe in magic.

Very bad experience. We ordered chicken biryani. They sent lamb biryani. No taste at all. Just some spices mixed with boiled meat. Ref to the picture. Would not recommend this place at all. Not worth the price you pay.

Good view and nice atmosphere. It's not over the top. Pad Thai was good and so was Satay. Laksa was okay. I'd skip fried rice if I were you. It's quite bland and needs a bit of flavor. People are friendly. Overall it was good. We'll come back.

We're looking for the best Thai place on Hibiscus Coast, sadly this isn't it. Peanut Sauce and Red Curry were both lacking in flavour, looked like some frozen veg thrown in. Tofu was ok though. Totally edible but can't wait to find something better.
Stunning Thai restaurant! Excellent menu and everything we had was really well presented and delicious!

Our 1st visit here and it is now one of our go to places for dining out. It has spectacular views and the service is good especially the young waitress we had she is very efficient. The food is nice and good value for money. It has a homely atmosphere, you can dine in casual attire and feel right at home. We met brown bear who is one of the restaurants frequent patrons he is a loveable character and is an avid fan of their food and so are we. I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone. 👌👍

We had a wonderful meal there last night. The views were fantastic, all the wait staff and the hostess were lovely and very helpful. We had someone who was GF and she was well looked after. Everything was made fresh and we couldn’t fault it. The massaman lamb was delicious and the money bags were the best we have eaten. The prices were reasonable too. Will definitely be back!! Thanks for a great night.
Our favourite! My family have got these takeaways every Saturday for the past 10 (or more) years and they have never let us down! Consistently delicious food, and fast and efficient service.

Best takeaways I have ever experienced. We just moved into the area and have had dinner from here four times in the last few weeks. Fish and chips are crunchy and fresh. Chinese food is full of flavour. We have been happy with every meal from here! Service is always fast just 15-20min even on a Friday/Saturday night.
Best Takeaway on the coast always fresh I've had bad experience at a few places but this one is the best been going here for 2 years Have told friends about this takeaway they say it's the best 👌
Bloody good fish and chips. Good value and good portion size. Best I've tasted up here!

I had been led astray by some of the bad reviews that were left about this place. Until someone I know recommended it to me, I went yesterday and bought a special dishes... Let me tell you that it was a very pleasant experience in every sense, I had never eaten this food and the person who served me guided me to help me in my choice. The food was very tasty, filling and also had a spectacular seasoning. My whole family liked it and we will definitely come back to try one of their menus, which are 100% recommended.
Good food & generous portions. Nice! I've been here a few times & generally things are good. There's also a small discount if you're an RSA member.
Great place for good food, great staff and great music. The RSA hosts some excellent live music that everyone can dance to. Awesome venue.
Attended a fund raiser for Cancer. Well Done!!
Awesome people, lots of fun playing pool on Wednesdays
Really good food here, nice large space, friendly staff.

😍😍 I think it's the best restaurant in the area. Everything is good, the shawarma tastes very delicious. They take care of cleanliness very well There is outdoor and indoor seating I highly recommend it to try🫶🏼🫶🏼❤️

I recently visited Red Beach Kebab Shop for lunch, and I must say, I was thoroughly impressed! The kebabs were incredibly flavorful and cooked to perfection. The variety they offer is fantastic, and the quality of the meat was top-notch. The staff were friendly and provided excellent service. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for delicious kebabs in the area!

LOVE THIS KEBAB SHOP! The food is good especially the chicken so crispy, juicy and tasty. Kebab was very delicious lots of choices for sauce too. Friendly staff with good humour and clean shop. Highly recommended!!!!
Very friendly people and delicious food, always amazing quality and never disappoints. My go to and comfort spot for kebabs 👍
Very Dissapionted with my chicken on chips tonight. A lot of chewy chicken skin fat in my portion

Fairly plain bar dominated by too many gaming machines. Very poor selection of beers and the staff are either disinterested or grumpy. I wouldn't go there if it wasn't the only bar in walking distance from my house.

Nothing short of meeting all your biggest expectations from a pub nested between a petrol station and a fish n chips shop in a quiet neighborhood, it ticks all the boxes. Having recently moved to Red Beach I was initiated to this local institution by two mates. Waiting for our take aways beer in hand I am introduced to their lawn mower guy and other local celebs hitting the pokies. The tap runs at the hands of a salty sea dog with fading navy tattoo sleeves. I'm this house of Ale, The almighty cricket plays on the tele hanging from the ceiling, catching the eyes of patrons like the pulpit on the Sunday mornings of their distant youth, religiously sipping beer. And next to it, a sign. "Tabs must be paid at the end of each day". All hail Couttas Bar & Grill. Somehow I missed the grill side of the place. I could be mistaken but please note, on week days the dress code is hi vis all around.
pretty good place, I don't know about the food and drink as only went in there to gamble on the slots. staff seem pretty happy and friendly. the place always seems clean and tidy.
This is a great local pub. Been drinking here around 9 years now. Handle club and regular karaoke make this my only Friday night destination.
We went there for Karaoke night. We enjoyed it very much. Drinks, stories, laughs, and dancing.
Very nice Fish and Chips
Chips were the best!
Very nice dinner, it was fresh and chips were perfectly crispy. After reading reviews saying the fish was smelly it made me think that it might not be nice but the snapper we had was good.

Used to be the best takeaways on the coast. Sadly, just a total ripoff now with new ownership. Food is average, but the biggest disappointment is the price increases weighed against the pathetic portion sizes! Owners claim portions are by weight but this is untrue as I weighed $5 chips (625g) once home at 275g which was barely enough for my 4 year old! Owners claimed an error had occurred but this is untrue as all recent visits have been the same. Also not happy that when I called to complain they did nothing but argue. Eventually offered a $5 store credit. Such a shame, sadly will never be going back.

Food ordered through Uber eats spent more than $50 on this overcooked meal, like they recooked all it by the burnt colour shown in the picture. Chips were so hard and crunchy, the fish didn’t taste real and the chips was not enough for the bundle. flavour less. Not worth the trouble

When you guys first took over the store, the food wasn’t bad at all, but now I'm not too sure whats going on but your chips are always well over fried and same with the rest of the food that we have ended up with extremely dry food the last 3 times. We thought it may have been a one off but have realised it isn’t anymore sadly. Hopefully this review helps you guys get it sorted. :)
Very nice fish and chips, lovely chicken burgers. Hope they can do fried rice as well.

First time for me to try out SA food but I was amazed with the Flavour, aroma, and the after taste ! Every item we ordered tasted very rich, delicious and the portions were festive ! Staff are very friendly, they gave me complementary Chow, Samousa and Koeksister. They sent me home with food enough for the rest of the week 😃 very generous and friendly. Here are some pictures of the menu, and the tasty food. Bear in mind Barbecue and Potjie are only served on weekends and need to be preordered, best to ask the staff about it.
Absolutely delicious food! First time trying the cuisine and it did not disappoint 😊 Our two year old demolished the Gatsby and loved the mild chicken curry. Will definitely be back!

I just knew when I pulled into the car park and could smell those amazing aromas this place was going to be good. Friendly owners greeted with warm smile and great convo. The food is next level good. Ordered the slap chips, vetkoek and mince, boere roll, samoosas and of course the lamb bunnie chow. Everything hit the mark and probs the best bunnie chow I’ve ever tasted here and back in SA. Super generous portion and good spice kick exactly how it should be. Can’t wait to be back to try the great gatsby 🔥

If you are missing home or just looking for a good feed, this is the place to be!! The samoosas are on point, crispy and fresh! Also had the curried mince, perfect amount of spice! Salt and vinegar slaap chips were awesome! Keep it up.
delicious lamb bunny! friendly team, good price. we got the 1/4 bunny ......highly recommend
Food was amazing and delicious, staff were so friendly and helpful and a lovely atmosphere, reminds me of Thailand.
Perfect place to eat Thai food. Tasta are great, and for me the portion is just right. They also have kids menu.
One of the best Tom Kha soups I have had! The green curry was fantastic too and the carrot salad was morish. Love it and definitely recommend it. It’s a hidden gem in Hibiscus coast.
Nice decent Thai food but felt that the curry sauce was not thick enough. Generous portions.
Amazing food, excellent service, and great prices. If you are local to the area, this should be a regular place to stop, and if you are just passing through, then it's a must!

Ever since they took over from Drunken Crayfish the food has had an enormous upgrade. All ingredients are nice and fresh, the servings are BIG and its just so tasty. Super shoutout to the Sweet and sour chicken - probably best one ive ever had. Completely unexpected how massive the serving is. Last time we had sweet and sour pork and thought that was absolutely delicious but the chicken might top it. Burgers are fresh and tasty at a great price point. Look forward trying the ramen next time and the kung pao chicken. Staff is also friendly and took the time explaining what is on each burger. Definitely recommend.
Always nice food and fair prices we are moving but I’m going to miss our local!
very good food and service, good price as well. Will be back

really disappointing. tonight was the third time I’ve order a burger from them and the mustard has been non existent every time. The previous time asked for extra sauce and they charged us extra just for the same result.. non existent mustard. The patty is dry, and if you are lucky you’ll get a beetroot that’s been broken in half. last week we got one of those self server dishes they do now and we found hair in our food. im all for supporting local but tonight was the last time I’ll be going there.
Food was really gross. Very greasy and mine (Bami Goreng) had a hair in it! My father's fish was really overcooked. Portion of chips was tiny and my husband's sweet and sour chicken was tasteless

Recently became a local to gulf harbour and already feel like a regular. Wontons are amazing, the customer service is amazing, some of the kindest staff I’ve met. My partner and I love coming here and will keep coming to support their amazing business!
As a local I had a tarakihi and chips last night, hadn't been for a while and it was amazing. Lovely fresh, light crispy batter. I look forward to the next time.

Dropped in just before lunchtime yesterday and ordered some fried rice (with combination meats) and an Egg Foo Yung. The staff member that served me was very polite, and my order was cooked in a little under 10 mins. The rice wasn't too oily and there was a generous amount of meat included in the dish which was nice to see as many others tend to skimp out on this with rice etc. Portions were standard size as I have had elsewhere and priced competitively. Very happy with what I ordered and will definitely be back to try out more from the menu.

Today My beautiful daughter and Grandaughter walked around the remains of GULF HARBOUR COUNTRY CLUB! As it was now lunch time we visited the village and decided to eat and have refreshments at “ THE WATERFRONT” Asian Fusion Restaurant! SUPER WOW! service, outdoor and indoor seating, absolutely the best fish and chips and other very tasty dishes including lunch time specials, great value and delishiness! So impressive! Our waitress was especially charming, even poured my zero alcohol beer! She came and checked on us to check if we were all fine! We certainly were! Best time ever and sunny even. I would recommend The WATERFRONT to all discerning diners wanting a beautiful place to refresh, quite romantic good place to impress on a big date! Arthur C. Charlton west Auckland NZ

Loved this place… such a hidden gem , great range of cocktails and Asian fusion food is absolutely gorgeous. Lovely and friendly staff great view if you choose the right table. Anyone wanna enjoy water views with great food and drinks should definitely come here.

Takeaway last night and both meals were very small portions. The free rice with each meal was pathetically small. I mean if you are doing a tiny main portion add a bit more free rice. The "crispy" pork belly in the Naughty Pig was very very dry and tough. The Famous Chicken was OK but a tiny portion. When you spend almost $50 for 2 takeaway meals more is expected. It is a rare occasion when my wife can finish a whole Asian takeaway on her own.

The view is beautiful. Right in front of the water. The crispy chicken was definitely crispy, however, I did not like the sauce as much. The hot and spicy dish was excellent. So was the crispy fried eggplant,and TomYum soup.

This is a great little place in Whangaparāoa. The spicy calamari is amazing the flavour with the little bit of added chilli works really well, the duck taco works really well on the roti and has very good flavour. Pad see ew was delicious and you can't go wrong with a banana fritter and ice cream. Location is really good right on the little harbour and is quiet and relaxing. If in the are definitely worth a visit

Great restaurant and bar overlooking the water. Menu is varied with good choice of starters, mains and drinks. Also specialise in Indian food, we both had curries which were delicious. Great vibe and buzz on a Saturday night. Indoor and outdoor seating. Make a reservation. Good pricing and generous portions.

This place just gets better every time I come to Gulf Harbour. They make great curries and I was also amazed at how good the Steak was. The food is very well priced for the portions and the quality. My wife even got a craft beer for $10. The service was also very good. I definitely recommend this place.
Had a wonderful walk and then shared a pizza. The service were super accommodating making our pizza half and half. The mango Lassi was yum!! Will be back!

Great location especially on a sunny day. Food was good. Our waitress Hayley was smiley, friendly, very attentive and thoughtful.she knew what we needed before we did plus she gained points for the tomato sauce refills.

Absolutely love this place! Amazing view and The food is consistently fresh, flavourful and beautifully presented. As someone who follows a low carb diet, it's always a challenge to find places that offer tasty, satisfying options, The grilled meat platter and cauliflower rice is my go to at Mainsail. Highly recommend for anyone looking for delicious food with health- conscious options.

My daughter and I just adore this gem! Fabulous outlook, service, drinks and food are presented wonderfully well! And super delicious! I would have no hesitation to recommend to my discerning friends and family to go for a drive to Gulf harbour, take in the surroundings and relax and enjoy you refreshments and food at the CHERRY CAFE you will be suitably impressed! Arthur C. Charlton west Auckland Recent visit 21/06/2025, my beautiful daughter and I dropped in for lunch after exploring the now defunct Gulf harbour country club and ruins, quite emotional! However the Cherry cafe with absolutely excellent service and food cheered. the both of us. We always get ROYAL service from the delightful staff, drinks perfect and we always have fish, chips with fresh salad! Super tasty and delicious! The views from outside area and deck are outstanding! This would be my recommendation to take a partner for a inspirational meal, mixed with a bit of romance, if so inclined XXXXX

An awesome cafe with great food and coffee. This is definitely our go to cafe in the area and we are never disappointed. The friendly, cheerful service matches the high standards of the food and drinks.
Really delicious food, great quality and super tasty. The drinks were tasty, no complaints! The ambience here is really nice, great view as well.
My favourite matcha latte (quite sweet), perfect foam, plus it's only 5$. Food looks good, atmosphere is nice and has good chill music. Server was nice too and food came out quick :)

Good food, good price, good vibes!! After visiting Shakespear regional park, we decided to have lunch before heading back Auckland CBD. Staff are friendly and food was tasty ! Value for money. Lots of customers but not crowded.

Great food and service. We had the wagyu burger and the snapper fish and chips for lunch .Both were delicious and well presented. Relaxed atmosphere with views of the marina. Small menu that is done very well. Must try when in the Gulf harbor area

Long time since I gave a review here. It is a weekend favourite of ours. Beautiful peaceful views over the marina, consistently fabulous food and top notch friendly service from the staff. Sunny garden area and in winter heaters and blankets. Seriously what more would one need! Shhhh don't tell too many people. It's a hidden gem! This time we had warm bang bang chicken salad. Parmesan and truffle fries, and chicken avo and bacon burger.
Snapper and chips were great! They do a great range of cocktails too and frozen margaritas 🍹 😋 👌 nice view. Great spot for a chilled lunch over looking the gulf harbour

On a Friday after work, soooo lovely to go have 'time out' in such a beautiful setting. The service was tops!!! You girls sure made us feel welcome with the children. The food was delicious and your prices were reasonable! Will be back for the Calamari! Yum, on the slaw with the sesame!!

Purchased 2 pizzas, standard fries and 2 drinks. Both pizzas were a let down due to both bases being undercooked. One of them had an extremely bitter underside due to the flour burning before cooking the base through. The prosciutto pizza had a sorry amount of meat, I’m talking 2 slices broken into 50c size pieces spread across the whole pizza… topped with way too many greens. The ratio was all wrong. The bases have so much potential! The fries were great!
Bought a mince pie was great. The lemon slice was not that great as I got the end slice and tastes a bit burnt and dry. I could not finish this. Chai was awesome. Many different food to choose from

We were a group of 16 and we pretty much took over the outside area. The food was delicious and arrived very fast. The service was awesome by all the ladies that were working, service with a smile. Thank you so much for making our Easter Monday extra special. We will be back again for sure.

well good is just McDonald's, but colder than other, wasn't busy but anyway, just update place been like that for many years now, service no quite the best, always bad faces and rushing you with your order, it's a shame many tourists from overseas stop there after visiting Auckland

We stopped on our way out of Auckland...about 10:30...just wanted 2 coffees and 4 new custard and chocolate pies...they were not available to order on the self service machine, so I kindly asked someone behind the counter; the answer...in an almost empty store, "after 11"...seriously? We bought 2 muffins instead, which were TERRIBLE! Coffee was decent! The floors were greasy, didn't look like they had a PROPER CLEAN in a very long time! Next time we'll get our coffees and goodies from our local bakery- where everything is fresh and delicious - and will not stop!
Lovely spot. Beautiful space to relax and enjoy a coffee. My long black was piping hot and friendly service. Definitely check this place out when you're in the area.
Let down. Disgusting strawberry matcha . They used strawberry jam instead of syrup . Tasted like ice water and with jam . Should have asked for a side of toast with my order
Great spot and super attentive staff. Food is tasty, well presented and portions are a good size. Coffees were great and served hot too - great work guys, will be back!
Had a very good experience. We visited for the first time today and the food was amazing. The customer service was exceptional and staff were very welcoming and friendly. Will definitely go back 😊

Love this bar and restaurant! The atmosphere was always so warm and welcoming. Had a few date nights and family dinners here. Staff were on point and very friendly. Food was delicious, especially loved their pizza! Great place to take friends for catchup over beer and great food with a game of pool or if you're into slot machines.

Can't believe this beautiful historic building & my number one stop over eatery when heading south is going to be knocked down for another shitty fast food outlet & Gas station.😬 Such a crime have enjoyed our meals there for years. Many thanks to all present & pass staff for the excellent service good times & meals.
Tasty food. Authentic taste. Friendly service and a good price. Also a lovely decor and ambience in this new restaurant.
I went to Curry and Craft Indian restaurant with my family members and I enjoyed their food and service. Their food quality was exceptional and very yummy😋. Price was very affordable.
Very nice Curries, Very Delicious Starters. The staff is super nice. Prices are affordable as well

I recently visited this Indian restaurant and it truly exceeded my expectations. The dishes were rich in flavor, the atmosphere was vibrant yet relaxing, and the staff made the experience even better. Definitely worth a visit and highly recommended!

New kids on the block. Had to try this out, it's just around the corner. When we sat down we got a swerving of poppadoms on the house. Then we got some Mixed Pakora, also on the house while waiting for our mains to arrive. I had the Lamb Vindaloo, hot to extra hot. Was pretty hot, spicy and very nice. My partner had the Butter Chicken, Kiwi's don't do hot 🔥. Butter Nan on the side. Loved the food. Service was good. Will be back for more one day l.
I order from the app as that way you knew u get ur nan bread with your combo can still do a pick up from it as well as delivery if u live near by

My special fried rice $21.50 had next to no bbq pork,chicken,beef and absolutely NO prawn -there were a couple of shrimps but this is not what the new ruby was like with the previous owner and is a big disappointment to Papakura- won’t be bothering to try again after more than thirty year in Papakura. Won’t be recommending them either

I have been going to The Wild Orchid for 10 years and the food has been amazing. Last night we bought a takeaway and it was really awful. ENTREE: The spring roll never tasted like a spring roll, the chicken was dry and the sauce did not taste like a satay sauce. It had a horrible rubbery fish cake and the samosa was not cooked properly. MAINS: The chicken and cashew did not taste nice and it was drowning in a salty sauce. The sesame dish did not have any flavour and was also drowning in a salty sauce. RICE: The rice was jammed into a small container and when I finally managed to get it out it was so "gluggy" we could only consume a small amount. A very disappointing experience when we have had nothing but excellent meals in the past. Certainly not worth the money we paid, so will not be going back. For that meal we deserve a refund. A shame as we try to support local businesses.

A Hidden Gem! ✨ We had an great experience at Emerald Thai! From the moment we walked in, we were warmly welcomed by two lovely ladies who delivered outstanding service throughout our meal.We ordered the chicken satay skewers, prawn toast, gang panang with chicken and king prawns, prawn pad Thai, and freshly made rotis. The dishes came out hot, fresh, full of flavour, and beautifully presented. A special touch was when the chef came out to explain that they grow and source fresh produce themselves, and you can absolutely taste the difference! 😍🪴😋 We will definitely be recommending Emerald Thai to our friends 👍🏼 🇹🇭 🍲🍚

Dont go on the misleading reviews food is below average. I ordered penang thai curry the curry was bland and beef was chewy as a rubber. It's hard to muck up a thai curry that too penang. I was expecting jasmine rice with my thai curry but ended up getting broken every day rice. Bad experience.

This Burger Joint is always so GOOD! We have never been dissatisfied. The staff make the burgers very fresh and we often leave very satisfied. The burgers arrive quick and the chips are always FRESH! We would rather drive 25 minutes to come to this Wendy's rather than eat at our local McDonalds or Burger Fuel as Wendy's in Papakura is so so tasty. A Plus to the team who always makes good burgers!!
Foods nice and came out pretty fast shout out to randeep for helping me do my order.

Requested coleslaw instead of potato & gravy, charged $1.20 extra for coleslaw, no P&G either. Never get orders right, dreadful 'food', greedy pricing. This time I wont forget, KFC you permanently lost a customer.
Mmmm good chicken. Freshly cooked. I like the chips. Didn't have to wait long

Basic convenience store essentials. Nothing fancy. Home made pies at dairy are o.k. I'm a pie lover, try the bakery on claude rd in manurewa, or pennys bakery in onehunga. Best pies ever. Z and mobil r pretty good too actually. Zs better.

Had Super Nova Pizza this evening along with their garlic bread—highly recommended! Incredible value for the price, generous portions, and spot-on flavor. Easily a 10/10 for taste, size, and overall experience. The staff was super polite, and the hospitality made it even better. Thanks, Naresh, for such a great recommendation! Definitely coming back!

I got the Chicken Wet noodles ( super delicious loved the flavour), prawn fried rice ( was my Favourite the prawns were cooked to perfection)and got some Prawn twisters and spring rolls chucked in there. I didn’t realise how Yummy the prawn twister are they are so delicious highly recommended!! Also I don’t like spring rolls but once I tried the spring rolls from satay noodle house it was so good I was flabbergasted lol. Thankyou Team will defs be back for some more. :)

Had the most amazing breakfast here today, it was a special for fathers day, smashed avocado with apricot baked salmon on rosti. Fantastic! Coffee was great too, highly recommend, will be back. Best breakfast I've had at a cafe for a long time. Thanks!!
Great coffee, good quality ingredients used for meals at very reasonable prices. Very clean and staff are awesome.

My husband & I tried this spot today, it's nestled between the laundromat & Fale de Keke, the bright signage drew our attention from outside & I could be wrong but I believe this is a Muslim eatery. That's not an issue at all. It was my husband who happily pointed that out because he chooses not to eat pork but not for religious reasons. We ordered a mixed doner kebab combo each & because we liked the look of the chicken burger, we decided to order that too so we could share it. That's where things started to go downhill. Perfectly toasted according to my husband. To me, I would've enjoyed a slightly toastier kebab BUT in saying that, the veges were still perfectly crisp & fresh & perhaps any longer in the press might've affected the veges so I'll go with what husband said. We thoroughly enjoyed our wraps. They were both generously filled with meat & veg which we loved too. The chips were well seasoned, freshly made & I'm fussy with hot chips but these were a hit for us too. We ended up ordering another chicken burger combo for our daughter too. The worst thing ever about this experience is that we live so, far, away.... but my husband cheekily said he doesn't mind. Of courde he doesn't mind, he works down the road in Takanini which means, he can grab us some dinner on the way home! LESSGOOOO! 😉 Thanks for the yummy kai! Taste & Texture Chicken: Crispy, golden, and not too juicy inside, the kind of fried chicken that delivers crunch on the outside and less tenderness inside. Cheese Sauce: Rich and gooey, but also overpowering, after a few bites, it leans toward overwhelming. It’s one of those “good at first, too much by the end” kind of elements. Waffles: Sweet and fluffy, but the sweetness plus cheese plus fried chicken takes the dish into “decadent heart attack vibes” territory. Not bad, but definitely heavy. Balance: Very little balance here, it’s designed to be indulgent, not refined. Service & Atmosphere Staff were friendly, and the space matched the dish’s vibe: casual, fun, and not trying to be fancy. It’s the kind of spot you go to when you’re in the mood for over-indulgence, not light dining. Verdict This chicken-and-waffle skillet is cheesy, fried, and unapologetically over-the-top. It’s satisfying in that guilty-pleasure way, but far from subtle or balanced. A dish you enjoy once in a while for fun, not something you’d order regularly unless you’re chasing food coma vibes. ⭐ Taste: 7/10 (comforting, but one-note heavy) ⭐ Portion: 5/10 ⭐ Presentation: 7/10 (hearty skillet appeal) ⭐ Health Factor: 2/10 (this one’s dangerous 😂)

Ardmore Café, situated within the Ardmore Airport complex near Papakura, Auckland, is a charming and unique destination that combines great food and drink with an aviation-themed experience. Guests can enjoy freshly prepared breakfast and brunch options, including eggs benedict, omelettes, pancakes, and freshly baked scones, all made with quality ingredients and served in generous portions. The café is especially popular for its coffee, with expertly crafted flat whites, iced coffees, smoothies, and specialty shakes. Both indoor and outdoor seating are available, allowing visitors to relax in a cozy, welcoming atmosphere or watch planes and helicopters take off and land on the airfield, making each visit a visually engaging experience. The staff are friendly and always smiling, attentive service, adding to the overall inviting environment. Whether you are an aviation enthusiast, a local resident, or simply passing through, Ardmore Café provides a memorable spot to enjoy a satisfying meal, a great cup of coffee, and a unique setting that sets it apart from typical cafés in the Auckland region.
