Very warming staff members, food was great and a good selection of Asian dishes, they had a lunch special meal deal. Will definitely be going back.
Worse than hospital food and I didn't even receive half the items I ordered. Yuck.
Sky Cafe is truly charming with authentic service and omg delicious food! The hot drinks were their own kind of special.. we loved them! A great space to enjoy lunch ♥️
Best bubble tea ever and you get to watch planes while you sip Dairy Free options here which is not common!

Unfortunately upon opening our salad on the plane (when it was too late to do anything about it other than incompletely remove), we found it contained feta despite getting vegan chicken and CLEARLY multiple times clarifying that we did not want any dairy, egg or fish products in it, and feeling silly for asking as they assured us they knew our request. Fortunately for all, no known allergen to dairy.

Staff busy chatting away. No one manning the counter to take orders. When my juice was ready, it was just left on another counter while I was waiting at the counter where I placed my order. I get the impression that customer service is not a thing here.
I’m a regular customer at the tank domestic airport always great being served by rajvir and the bestest smoothies thank you

Went to Tank @ 7:33 pm and was told they are closed for service. So went elsewhere and then at 7:40 they did an order for someone. Also online it said that they are only closing at 8pm. So please update your hours.

We ordered 2 tank juices tonight from tank domestic airport. And this is how much we got when I checked it. When the customer is paying you the full price you are supposed to serve them with a full cup of juice but not the half cup. Can you take a payment for half price for half cup? No you won’t. Then you need to fill the cup as per the quantity. Total rip off from customers to save money on juices. Shameee. Customer service is average. Disappointed. Never recommend a tank to other customers.

One of the World's best Coffee shop. Trust me I've travelled the world but coffee tastes phenomenal here. It's super cheap and tastes too rich even the guy from LA in line ahead of me was shocked. Keep it up. Good job. Highly recommended.

Middle one is ok but the corner one was not. 29th August morning, She didn't even say hi. Ordered oats milk flatwhite but got normal milk Cappuccino. Taste awful. One sip and threw away. Be nice at least.
Exeptional customer service by Lotu. Very nice coffee with greeting.

Misleading prices - $6 for an iced coffee but there’s an extra $0.50 for the ice - I would have preferred to have the price incorporated in rather than this pay extra for ice absurdity. Coffee is alright nonetheless, hence not a 1 star review.
Get my daily coffee there every day. Brutus is the boss 😁. Always greets with a smile and SUPER quick making the coffees. And they taste great too, every weekday!!

I normally don't have problems with the staff but on Thursday april 10 at 8pm I asked for a japanese chicken katsu the usual and it was way less than any other time I wish I didn't make this review cause I like the staff but it wasn't busy and he knows I can wait for my order if there's another order on the grill I was this close to throwing the whole thing very disappointed with the service today

What a rip off! I got a make your own chicken salad bowel and the amount of chicken given was barely half a palm size chopped up. Such a rip off! Scant on the salad items and just a total rip off for the high price we pay when in an airport. Do better! Add more chicken. At least Tank measures their chicken out. This place just throws whatever on the grill. A total rip off and lacklustre service. Do better

I ordered chicken katsu bowl which tasted nothing like it should. Rice was not cooked and the chicken was chicken nuggets. You are at Auckland International Airport and your food should be much better

The employees here do not know their own menu. I ordered the loaded wedges and they did not put sour cream on them although that's what the menu said. I also got a combo with a drink, chips and dip but they insisted it didn't come with dip even though their menu says it does and displays the dip. The food itself was good but you are not getting what's advertised or what you pay for. They said they couldn't do anything because "the manager isn't here". Yikes. Wouldn't eat here again.
I ordered a burger The Ol Smokey and Immuni tropical Smokey costs $14.5 Tropical costs $6.5 (it contained pineapple juice) The burger is smell Smokey And eat delicious . But is

I've brought this numerous times never have I ever seen chunks of lumps of milk the manager and the barista tries to justify their actions by getting angry at me for pointing out their mistake😡 don't know how to do your job please seek more training. I am speaking from experience. If you look at the pics below you can see the difference. Okay thanks for reading. Bye! McDonald i will be making a compliment to akl airport to review your health and food standard policy I could have been in hospital today.

The service here is so bad! I visited on Friday morning and got a Big Mac combo. I asked for fresh fries and the girl who serviced me (Indian girl where mccafe uniform) said no, that’s the only fries we have. I asked, are they fresh not soggy? Then she turned around to another girl (Samoan, you can tell by her accent. she maybe a manager or something because she was wearing a shirt and not the standard uniform) and said “aye the fries are fresh.” The Samoan girl who was in the middle of talking to another manager, I know she is a manager because she was walking in and out of the office (mind you these two were standing right in front of the food warmer talking about another staff member and I could hear the whole conversation! So unprofessional) She literally turned around and screwed her face and pretty much yelled and said, yeah the fries are fresh! I can tell you right now the fries were not fresh, the has browns and the fries had been sitting there for a while! I just cannot get over how rude the workers are!

This place needs to be shut down. Worst experience at a McDonald's I have EVER had. Me and girlfriend decided to eat something while waiting for our plane. We got 2 cheese burgers each which were both raw (Undercooked would be an understatement). My girlfriend who does not have McDonalds much informed me they taste weird but I didnt think much of it and neither did she as she assumed that was normal. When I opened my burger I took one bite and spit it out and realised it was completely raw. I realised my girlfriend had started her second burger, I had a look and yes completely raw. I then informed the manager and requested a refund, of which he informed me he would not be giving a refund for the burgers we had eaten, including the ones we had taken a bite from. Not only did we get raw burgers and the manager didnt care a single bit, he refused to give a refund. I even showed him the burgers and he just threw them away without looking at them. The worst manager ive ever met, this guy doesnt deserve his job. Could have ruined our trip feeding us raw burgers before our flight. Do not eat here its not worth the risk of ruining your trip.

The order machine ran out of paper. I asked one of the staff members to clean up a table, as you can see from the pictures, all were like that. The staff member came and cleaned the table but she was not happy about it, probably because the place is understaffed and it's beneath her. I should have apologised to her majesty for bothering her with menial tasks. They don't give you napkins, wet wipes anything to wipe your hands with. The floor is somewhat sticky from all the grease that nobody bothers to clean. The bins were overfilled and nobody bothered to clean the tables. Food was OK, but not that great. If you ever think about eating at this McDonald's, probably avoid it and move on.

Horrible experience. My husband forgot to grab water after he purchased the tasteless burgers. I had to go back to the counter and was told I cannot get a glass of water with ice as the cashier is not allowed to serve ice --- Afterwards I slipped on their highly unmaintained floor - see photo. And it is only 7am now after travelling for two days in a row to get here. Rather starve then purchase anything from them in the future. Untortunately their service and maintenance is way below the usually high New Zealand standards.

Felt like I HAD to come here and leave a review after today I received excellent service when I purchased a dozen donuts and a coffee here today I was feeling very tired and the service here was so great the coffee was delicious and it was all very well priced highly recommended.

Softness upon first bite into the original glazed donut which I've never experienced in all my pak n sav donuts, so I guess I've realized is what I've been missing out on! Super great to munch on, not overly sweet and a good snack. Original glazed is definitely a goodie to try, and recommend the tiramisu. Tiramisu had the perfect amount of filling and the taste was decadent! Also had the apple custard crumble which I thought would be the best, but was left under whelmed-crumble wasn't anything special, couldn't taste much apple and the custard to dough ratio was not plentiful. 7.5/10 Also note the location is definitely not the best (it's past the food court and down by air New Zealand kiosks) as I had to do quite a bit of running to find it (from jet star end) but the determination for doughnuts pulled me through! And it was an experience worth the search hahah
Great staff, helpful and friendly. Charney remembers customers and even what they order. Top bloke

Great coffee! Friendly and efficient staff. Be aware it is on the far eastern side of the domestic terminal and not in the food court where most food outlets are. Also this store only accepts electronic payments.
Had a couple of donuts. Not the greatest I've tasted. Ice cream coffee was a little bit to sweet
Wonderful food and kind staff, good value especially considering it's in an airport and cute bags, I like the bags
The staff was helpful and the options of food were great although I only got a drink

Nice little spot. Is it incredibly fancy, no, but definitely worth stopping for a quick coffee/bite. The falafel wrap (lone plant-based offering) was surprisingly tasty. Oatmilk latte tasted smooth and got the job done

Rude front of the house or barista . The way she spoke was belittling and I honestly felt unwelcome buying two coffee and toasts. It’s my first time feeling like I didn’t want to buy anything here before paying for my drink and food
This score was for food alone Great pasta salad
Terrible sandwich. I had toasted but chicken was still cold. Lettuce was brown and not enough dressing. Hope I don't get food poisoning!! I Will never eat there again

Fantastic service from the gig with the awesome moustache. After totally exhausting long-haul flights from Vietnam back to NZ, I bought a foot long veggie subway. The veggie food on the plane was dire! So I was really looking forward to this sandwich. Unfortunately half way through I dropped half on the floor. The staff member gave me a replacement half - what a fantastic gesture. All the people around me also thought that this was a great gesture. This team member made my day.
$12.70. For a 6 inch tuna sub. Which had hardly anything in it. Absolutely disgusting! 😡

I ordered vege patty and girl was preparing ham.. she just started with my order as well.. i asked her to change the gloves but she only changed from one hand not from other. It was very disappointing and unhygienic. You can not use the same gloves to serve the other requirements customer… when i asked the girl to change the gloves… she was staring at me as i said something wrong to her…. Very poor customer service and very poor hygiene….

I wish i could have given them zero star for the service i recieved. There toaster is not working, but she wanna charge me for packing it extra. Charged me double for avocados whereas the price listed was half. On top of that an arrogant attitude that shows she doesn’t want to be there. The subway near macdonald is way better.

The sushi platter is located in the domestic terminal. You can get sushi on the go or dine in (foot court style). We ordered their Donburi options - teriyaki chicken and salmon sashimi don. The teriyaki chicken was great, with lots of chicken, sauce were yummy! The salmon sashimi don was average, there were lots of rice but not enough salmon fish as it was quite thin. They are all around $21.9 per donburi.
The same place as Hikari, so you can order ramen as well. The fish was great. I do wish the rice was better, but it was pretty good for an airport option.

Surprisingly great Japanese food for an airport spot! The Chicken Katsu Ramen was crispy, rich, and comforting, and the sushi was really well-made. Fast service and clean space — perfect for a quick, tasty meal before a flight.
One of my go to shop everyday when working at the airport. The food is amazing the staff are chill too. Fast and easy order. Highly recommend
Limited options at the terminal so this one is the best option among others! Food, service and ambience could be better considering their prices!
I dont understand all the low reviews the food was very good and filled with lots of flavorful tastes would definitely recommend.

Had an absolutely great McDonald's experience! Came here to get dinner before my flight, and WOW, I was amazed. I ordered the Hawaiian beef burger large combo, which was excellent. The burger was cooked perfectly, with the pineapple being a delicious touch. The chips were also cooked to perfection and up to McDonald's high standards. I also ordered the Hot Cross Bun pie, which was breathtaking. You should definitely try this before they take it off the menu. The service at this McDonald's was really good with my meal being ready in less than 5 minutes, which is impressive considering how busy they are at the dinner time peak. Will definitely be back at this McDonald's next time I am flying out of Auckland airport.

Went to this Mcdonald’s today, service was revolting! ordered a big mac with extra pickles and not one pickle was provided. asked for a knife and fork with the rest of my meal and the worker with a gold tooth and claw clap threw it on the table at me. When I went back to ask for my extra pickles the same worker asked me “what do you want” I very nicely asked for the pickles that were not on my burger and she asked for my receipt even though the pickles are free. Even if i didn’t order extra pickles I still didn’t get the ones that already should have come on the burger. Also ordered 8 ketchup packets knowing they don’t often give you all 8 of them and not a single one was in my bag when i got it. Would like to add chips tasted like workers had been breathing on them all day! Will never be returning to this mcdonald’s and I am truly disgusted by the way staff treat their customers. Mcdonald’s do better!
The Filet-O-Fish was created in 1962 & still consists of a fried breaded fish fillet, a steamed bun, tartar & pasteurized American cheese...

I waited 7mins for an ice cream. I was thinking to get my ice cream and finish it before my bus which is leaving in 7:30. However, NONE of the staff is going to to the ice cream machine. I can see the staff is cleaning the counter, cleaning the kitchen table, through the rubbish, walking pass the drink&ice cream area, but nobody was walking there to make the ice cream. Everyone was ignored it, I saw the screen has about 7 or 8 order on waiting, but nobody care. So, after all I have to take the but that's leaving at 7:45 as I get my ice cream after my bus gone. Overall what I can see is your staff is either have bad work attitude, or they are untrained.

plain and simple fare. japanese curry w chicken katsu on rice: pretty decent. 7/10. spicy beef ramen: came with corn, beansprouts, tough lean thinly-sliced beef, and yellow noodles. spicy enough. 6/10.
It’s the same store as The Sushi Platter, so you can order the sushi and ramen at the same place. The ramen was pretty good.
The worst beef Ramen I have ever had. The only good thing was it was warm. The beef was thin slices of organ and grisly. Terrible. I couldn't even eat it and I was starving!
Food was great and service top notch. Great place to eat if you are at Auckland Domestic airport
Super friendly staff and the yummist sushi! My favourite place at the airport

I rated at a five star because there are several reviewers on here who are maliciously reviewing this restaurant - the chicken was very good - can I help you? Can I help you?the cole slaw was solid and the wings were good - they have draft beer and this amazing peach sparkling - loved this lunch

Surprisingly good for a domestic airport. Ordered the chicken waffle with bacon ($28) and the curly fries ($12). The food was really good. The chicken waffle came with creamy slaw. The waffle definitely needed the bacon. Delicious! The curly fries were crispy and fresh.
WOW awesome almond croissant and cappuccino. Delish warm and buttery croissant and perfectly barista made coffee. Plenty of seats too and looks like great food menu to order cooked items too.

Surprisingly for an airport restaurant this actually was a nice meal. The only improvement could be, crisper waffle and a bit more spices on the actual chicken. Other than that, this was a pleasent meal

I ordered the orleans fried chicken with curlies and the bacon bbq smash burger and 2 softdrinks came to $71. The waitress gave me glazed chicken wings instead of fried chicken and through a massive attitude when I said I ordered fried chicken not wings and blamed the whole thing on me. Food was rubbish. Do not reccomend

The pizza deserves a 3.5-star rating. It wasn’t bad, but it lacked seasoning, and in my opinion, the cheese used wasn’t mozzarella. As for the Eggs Benedict, they were prepared correctly, but unfortunately, they were served cold. The sauce had a slightly sour taste, which wasn’t ideal, though the rest of the dish was decent overall. I’d give it a 3.8-star rating.

Pathetic service and do not deserve even 1 star. I was informed that the eftos machine is not working and you have go to the next shop to pay by card. At the next store, the lady was randomly scanning the items like water and chocolate to make up the price. Was not provided with a correct invoice which was useless to me. The staff rather than being apologetic was extremely rude and didn’t cared for the customers. The quality of the pizza was also not great so nothing good about this place. Avoid if possible.
Pizza was undercooked, egg was raw. Tried to eat it and couldn’t. They refused to refund and we had to leave to catch plane, no time to argue with poor attitude staff

Terrible pizza. Do not be fooled by the sleek design of the restaurant which makes you believe that you are about to eat an authentic wood fire pizza as this could not be further from the truth. I ordered a margherita with pepperoni and aside from the fact that they don't use real mozzarella, they put the pepperoni slices under the cheese rather than on top which means that the pepperoni does not cook at all. The end result was a terrible pizza worse than those frozen ones you buy at the supermarket!
I wish I had read the reviews before ordering. Most of them are spot on. It was some of the worst pizza I’ve had.

Its been a while since we last had Mexico so unsure if this outlet is a fair representation of the current standard. Chicken was very dry both in the taco and the fries chicken and everything lacked the flavours we were expecting. Set your expectations low and you might think it's ok 3 starts because portion sizes were ok, things could have been better with some sauce
Fried chicken was not the mexico famed fried chicken but some bland chewy monstrosity. Chicken tacos were microwaved soggy soupy mess. No Bueno.

Below average visit to this establishment. First off, when I approached the counter to order, there was none there. After 5 minutes an employee that had been serving at the neighboring cafe came and took my order. The food took a long time to be prepared and come out to me at my table. Once it arrived I was disappointed at what my $20 got me. It was a small cabbage salad with 4 small pieces of fried chicken with some sauce drizzled on top. So many areas for improvement here.
Stale AF NACHOS very mid taco. NZ airport please replace these guys with a business that cares about Mexican food. That will maintain higher quality and taste better.

As everyone knows, international flying is both stressful and exhausting. This place was a perfect little escape. The decorations and music were lovely. The food was perfectly tasty, all be it a little bit dry. Yet, for an airport it was definitely above average. The margarita I had was very tasty. Especially for the prices. Shoutout to Kohli who served me, he’s got a great vibe and made my drink swiftly. A great conversationalist, brightened up my travels. If you stop at Auckland International, this is definitely worth checking out.

An honest tasty burger! It’s always my go-to at the international terminal and it never disappoints! Today, the person taking the orders was extra awesome! He was friendly, thoughtful, and attentive. Even with the fast-paced environment, he took the time to understand and pronounce people’s names correctly and noticed I needed napkins without me having to ask. Thanks, Lance! 😍

So, it’s been a few years since I tried b better Burger. I find their quality has declined considerably since they first took the burger scene by storm. But a bad experience a few years ago turned me off and I haven’t been back since, until I visited the one in Auckland International Airport while waiting for a flight. I should have passed on this one too. The burger was ok, but the fries, once one of their signature items was cold and stale. I’ve had oven fries that have been better. Do yourself a favour and give this one a miss too.

I had high hopes despite my wife’s doubts. I wanted a burger but didn’t want McDonalds. Ordered a classic cheeseburger, but had to wait 10mins for it. When it did come, the burger was presented neatly and nicely wrapped for eating. However, wife said it tasted just like McDonald’s. Doh! 🤦🏻‍♂️ Patty on the small side, but I would add it came with generous servings of lettuce, and was slightly more sophisticated than maccers! But better? Jury’s still out.

Of all the places available, this is the Go-to place to get food. Cheap, fresh and soo delicious. The crisp fresh lettuce, actual lettuce leaves, not the usual shredded fast food lettuce crap! Tomato & onions both fresh too, complimented the beef perfectly. $12 for the cheeseburger, which at an airport for a freshly cooked burger is a bargain. Service was friendly & fast. This will be my spot anytime I'm in the NZ international airport 😊

We ate here before our flight, ordered just 10 minutes before closing time. Guy who took our order was okay, lady that gave out our food was really nice! Fries were totally okay, burgers too. Obviously, you shouldn't expect a gourmet/artisan burger, but its much better than mcdonalds!

The selection here is incredible! I got the spicy pork ramen and it was divine! For $24 it was a great experience, the noodles were wonderfully chewy, the broth deep and complex, the toppings delicious! Cannot recommend it enough! The sushi is pretty decent as well. Service was prompt and easygoing. Not a lot of options for seats, but travellers tend to eat quick, so it's not a real worry. If you find yourself wanting some great Japanese food on your way to an international departure, I highly recommend!

The BEST airport food I have ever had! It's hard to remember you're at an airport and not in a traditional noodle house in Kanagawa, Japan. The veggies are deliciously fresh, the egg perfectly jammy, and the broth is light and flavorful. Pro tip: ask for a side of chilies and your inner spice lord will thank you!

Ramen surprisingly decent for airport food, the noodles had a good bite and weren't soggy or clumpy. Soup base was tasty. I got the spicy base soup and even though it isn't red, it was veeerry spicy. I think they mixed in birds eye chillies. I would say it was a "Kiwi extra spicy" level of spicy. A pity the egg is just a plain hard-boiled egg half, not a soft-boiled marinated ramen egg.

I had such a great experience at this Japanese spot in Auckland Airport. The food is incredibly fresh, full of flavour, and beautifully presented. The staff are warm and genuinely friendly, making the whole experience feel welcoming from start to finish. Prices are very reasonable for the quality you get, which is a real bonus when dining at an airport. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a delicious and relaxing meal before or after their flight.

Would not recommend the Vegetable ramen. Very bland and tasteless. Only plus was that Noodles were cooked reasonably well, would somewhat be salvaged with many tablespoons of soy sauce. Service was good.
Probably the best airport meal I’ve had anywhere. It’s genuine cafe / restaurant quality. Excellent coffee, and a nice burger and smoothie too. Thanks to Cecilia for her friendly service!

Had a quick snack before a flight. Such a 10/10 experience. The staff were very friendly and cheery in general, and happily explained what each menu item contained and if it was okay for me to eat based in my dietary requirements. Checkout was easy and the staff at the bar helped me sort out the nzd currency which I was yet to get used to. Would 100% return whenever I'm in Auckland Airport! Tasty food, awesome service and a clean, aesthetic place!
Jayden was our server, she was very nice and friendly. Great customer service. My Korean Chicken, I would say is not Korean Chicken and for $20 is a bit much for 6 wings, grilled 🤔. Not happy.

Casual and friendly environment, welcoming and courteous service, delicious and properly cooked food! — yes this restaurant cook the dishes on order, which is really rare in airport restaurants around the globe! Definitely enjoyable - even comparing to restaurants in the cities!

Hardeep gave us a warm welcome, and the entire crew did a fantastic job. The food was absolutely delicious, and enjoying a cold beer felt like relaxing on a beach in Havana. A special shout-out to Alfred, who served our table with impressive skill—like an octopus, he managed to attend to all five of us at once with incredible ease and coordination

Good service! We ordered Beef Rice Noodle and Prawn Summer Roll. Reasonable price considering their generous serving. Taste good even though there’s not much of cilantro on it, which is actually great for people that aren’t a fan of that herb.

Just had an incredible meal at Halong Bay and I’m still thinking about those perfect flavors hours later. I ordered their beef rice noodle soup (pho bo) and fresh spring rolls, and both dishes exceeded every expectation. The pho was absolutely sublime - the broth had that deep, complex richness that only comes from hours of slow simmering beef bones and aromatic spices. You could taste the star anise, cinnamon, and ginger working in perfect harmony. The rice noodles had that ideal tender texture, and the beef was sliced paper-thin and cooked to perfection in the steaming broth. Fresh herbs, bean sprouts, and lime on the side let me customize each spoonful exactly how I wanted it. The spring rolls were a revelation - translucent rice paper wrapped around the freshest prawns, crisp vegetables, and fragrant herbs. Each bite delivered this amazing textural contrast between the soft wrapper, firm prawns, and crunchy vegetables. The peanut dipping sauce struck that perfect balance between sweet, savory, and slightly spicy that made me want to keep dipping. What really impressed me was the authenticity - these weren’t watered-down versions for Western palates, but genuine Vietnamese flavors prepared with obvious care and skill. The presentation was beautiful, service was attentive and friendly, and the atmosphere felt welcoming and comfortable. Halong Bay has definitely earned a regular customer. Can’t wait to work my way through more of their menu - if these two dishes are any indication, everything here is going to be exceptional. Highly recommend for anyone craving authentic Vietnamese cuisine done right.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

We had such a fantastic meal at Halong Bay Vietnamese Restaurant! I ordered the beef pho and spring rolls, and both were absolutely delicious. The pho was rich, flavorful, and comforting — just the way it should be — and the spring rolls were fresh, crisp, and packed with flavor. What truly made the visit special was the kind gesture from the staff: they surprised my son with a free jelly cup, which absolutely made his day! It’s the little touches like that which show how much they care about their customers. The service was warm and welcoming, the food came out quickly, and the entire atmosphere was cozy and inviting. We’ll definitely be coming back again soon. Highly recommended for anyone craving authentic Vietnamese food with genuine hospitality!
If you want to enjoy delicious Vietnamese food inside the airport, I recommend this place. The portion and the taste are both great.

Very refreshing food. I ordered two meals and both were amazing. The food was fresh and with the chilli oil the experience of broth and noodles reaches to another level. Highly recommended before you get on flight to try this especially if you dont like food served in plane. Very honest and friendly staff, however i asked to refill my water bottle with tap water and they refused.

I would agree with a number of other posters- it’s not the same standards that BUB has in other locations. It’s a pity- it’s one of the last things visitors and locals in NZ will eat (and drink) before leaving Aotearoa. I believe it’s not easy operating an outlet at an airport but reckon it could really be improved with especially a better focus on service and prep
If you’re charging $9 for a coffee, at least make sure the barista knows how to steam the milk properly and not burn it.

As the name suggests these are the best bagels but I would change it to best good looking bagels because they look as good as it tastes. Love these ones. We got the humdinger this time and it was sooo good. The bagels are on but sweeter side with hummus tomato, feta and basil giving it a great twist. The staff are super friendly and courteous. The store is clean and tidy. Parking is at the airport and you can only access this store if you are travelling overseas. Plenty of seating area.
Typical airport seating in a cafe, but great customer service. Warmly greeted. Decent bacon bagel but on the dry side. Coffee good but nothing special.

Sloppy when compared to the OG in Newmarket. First pic was ordered at the airport, second is the same order in Newmarket a week earlier. Chewy, hard salmon was lumped on top in one pile. Far from fresh and lots of silvery bits. The pic is after I moved the toppings around to make it look somewhat presentable. Soggy bagel and basil. $25 bagel and presented in a dirty card box. As an OG Best Ugly customer, this is not it guys…

This cafe is always good, near the international departure gate, but a bit pricey since it is in an airport. Before my partner went on a trip, we had the $25 meal called "Light Breakfast" with bacons, hash browns, and poached eggs, then added avocado extra. We also got two croissants and two coffees. The food was okay, better than other places at this airport. The staffs were kind, and the cafe has a nature-friendly vibe with green views. Fortunately, the cafe wasn't crowded, so we got served quickly. This is my regular spot whenever I'm at the airport.

Favourite place to come when I just feel like going to the airport and being there. Right opposite the foodcourt upstairs in the international terminal. Coffee is always strong and wakes me up. Pastries are quite high priced but it’s an artisan bakery so worth it. Highly recommend the English muffin with spinach, egg and cheese. One thing to note is that it’s a collaboration with blue marble lane so while your alcoholic drinks may come from BML, the food is lovingly crafted by the chefs at Oma.

If you want coffee and some baked goods then sure stop here Else you will be better off at McDonald's. The service is a shocker. I thought maybe it's just me when they helped us but we were sitting close to the counter and the way the peeps talk to clients are so transactional. I watched so many older people also buying and not even a smile from the staff. Just what do you want, is that all, pay here. Often they couldn't even care to make eye contact. The burger I ordered at almost $30 is so much worse than even a McD burger. I dont mean this in context of value I mean it's literally just worse. Two small slices of tomato, tiny piece of chicken fillet that is about as good as McDs, lonely single piece of bacon. At $30 it's a shocker. Get better at half the price at McDonald's The Coffee is ok though.

Their cinnamon roll is the best, quick snacks are yummy too. 3 start because the customer service can be improved. Took 25mins just to toast our snack. But the atmosphere is amazing and the interiors cum decor is eye catching which attracts many customers.

When waiting for an early morning international flight, Oma Artisan Bakery & Cafe is the place to visit for an espresso hit of goodness. My soy latte was wonderful and just what I needed at 4 am! The service was great and they had many freshly baked items to accompany the coffee. Highly recommended!
The coffee was extremely hot but really good. The service was friendly and much faster than at the café across the way. The place is comfortable.
Vanilla cronut was very yummy Matcha was no good since they blended ice with the drink instead of making normal iced matcha Salad was alright

I left my wallet there and the member of the staff handed it in at the airport security and the manager was extremely helpful!! Very honest and decent people, thank you so much! (Also, had a very good sandwich there and a delicious custard donut).

Sitting here ordering some dumplings across the soul origin store where they display a lot of chicken but shaft you by filling the bowl with only salad. I paid $15 for a small bowl with 2 servings. So I opted to get the buffalo chicken slaw for both servings. Instead of packing my salad from the display with lots of chicken, the worker packed a heap of salad from behind the counter and proceeds to just give me 5-6 pieces of chicken from the cabinet. Would be better off buying a burger with decent protein 💪

FOOD ALLERGIES ALERT. You need to train your staff about food allergies. My wife just purchased a coffee and a muffin. She asked if the muffin contains nuts to which the staff member said no. Upon biting into the muffin it contained walnuts. She is now having a medical episode in the airport. The first thing the staff suggested was another food item. You need to do better.

I ordered a Happy Meal with a cheeseburger, but unfortunately, the cheeseburger was undercooked. This was quite disappointing, especially as it was meant for a child and our flight 18 hours from Auckland to Doha. I hope more care is taken with food preparation in the future. It’s disappointing to see this shift, and I hope management looks into improving consistency and staff training again.

Pretty average as far as a Maccas experience goes. Crazy expensive for what you get too. Service was incredibly slow and the McCafe coffee was meh. For what you're paying you'd be better off going anywhere else for a bite to eat.
The staff here needs to learn how to carry out customer service. Also need to learn how to make hot chocolate. Crap service. Wouldn’t recommend.
The food was nice. Food came very fast. Customer service was nice. It was very busy mcdonalds.

Terrible Mocha far too much chocolate too sweet. A few delays as very busy. Scanners don’t work but you can type in your app codes. No sundae options for daughter but they came up for my son on the same machine!?

What a great space in the Auckland International Airport! Located in a mezzanine area above the main departure hall, where most of the cafes, shops, and bars are, the Glamp Grounds is a surprisingly large area to go to before you fly out! The restaurant is a wonderful space for families, groups, and even just the average solo traveller (like myself!). I had about 30mins or so before my gate was open so I decided to pop upstairs for a drink and was so charmed by the place I also ordered the Bok Choy and Mushroom dumplings as a snack - they were so fresh and flavoursome, I wish I had time to order a full course! The space is so open, fresh, and has a cool summer/beach camp vibe. There was heaps of families there enjoying the play spaces and free games. But also quite a few young solo travellers, who like me we're making use of the numerous charging outlets, and cute tables with great views to people watch. There was no queue for food or drinks. The staff were super friendly and efficient. It's now going to be my go-to hang before I fly 🙌🏽

Awesome bar/restaurant at AKL. I had the crumbed snapper and was not only the price great for an airport but very good and huge portion (2 fillets of fish - I eat a lot and I couldn’t even finish it). My waiter Seema was so lovely, polite and smiling the whole time. All her colleagues I interacted with were also very nice. Keep up the amazing service, you girls are doing a great job! Also good to note that the space is big and was not crowded at all unlike other options at the airport 😉

First saw this place under construction a year ago and now getting to have a walk through and a brew; Tuatara on draft along w basic Monteith's and such. The atmosphere is themed throughout which is pretty nice, and extremely spacious. Nice vibe. Too late to try the food
Looks nice area, I have Pint Black Dog is good but Beer Battered Fish just average, by the way the french fries is great~

The Frozen Margarita was excellent. Its a nice, spacious, place with a view outside. The international departure screen inside the venue is supper helpful. Nice staff too :) thank you. Will definitely be back.
Excellent service and friendly staffs. Food is hot and good. Nice to have before the flight back home.
Dumpling and XLB wrappers super thick; no soup in Xiao Long Bao… don’t be fooled by the high rating!

Wonderful service, and the food was even better! I got the dumplings and bubble tea and they were fantastic! Condiments came free and some of them looked and tasted like they were made in house (as someone who frequently makes their own) Came back for seconds and they were just as brilliant. Loved it and would highly recommend!
I had a great bao bun that was good quality and service was friendly, food came out quickly aswell.
Ordered Chicken Dumplings with Taro Bubble tea. Got these sad dumplings with three pieces of Lettuce. The tea cup was half full of ice.

Went to Blue Marble Lane for breakfast and ordered the Eggs Benedict with crushed avocado and the Crushed Avocado on sourdough. The meals were okay, but there was way too much raw onion, which really overpowered the flavor and left a strong aftertaste. For drinks, we had a long black and a flat white with almond milk. Both were fine, just not the best. Service was quick, and the staff were okay, though not particularly accommodating. The atmosphere is nice and quiet, which makes it a good spot for a relaxed breakfast. Overall, not a bad experience — the setting was lovely, but the food and coffee could use a bit of improvement.

Ordered a sausage roll which was meaty and delicious and arrived long before the rest of our order of fries and eggs Benedict which was rather disappointing. The soy latte and moccha arrived hot, as expected but we could not hold the glass as it had no protective sleeve or handles and by the time we were able to handle the heat, the drinks were quite cool. I suggest decent cups for hot drinks, at the very least.

First time we dined in for breakfast, the stereo was a little loud when we came to have a looked at the menus, but it was turn down when we came back after an hour to dine in which we were glad. The foods we ordered were very satisfying, the lattes were not as hot as we wanted to but very nice. Overall, we enjoyed our breakfast, price wise wasn't too bad in considering its location. Reading some of the reviews, maybe we were just lucky on who was serving & cooking on the day.

Pros: Attractive, open, natural light ambience; nice music playing; great staff and fast service, excellent coffee, my hubbie liked the Chicken Caesar Salad from their kitchen. Cons: Horrible Katsu Chicken from the deli (couldn't eat it, so processed, weird consistency and flavour), the floor looked like it had never been cleaned and uncomfortable chairs particularly for poor travellers with long waits. NB. People will write reviews here because they're usually waiting around😉
Cold mornings in NZ calls for a nice hot (or iced) cuppa coffee w an extra shot ☺️ Yummy chilli mince on toast, compliments to the female chef this morning 08/08. Thank you!!!

Great experience at the airport. The chicken was hot, crispy, and full of flavor, exactly what I was craving. The staff was friendly and efficient, making sure my order was ready quickly despite the busy environment. The whole process was smooth and hassle-free, which made my wait time very pleasant. Definitely would come back next time I’m traveling through!

Went to KFC at the Auckland International Terminal. Located upstairs next to the International departures. The food court also had a McDonald's, Asian food and cafes. The KFC has self service terminals as well as ordering at the counter. Got a Zinger Stinger which contained 1 wing, 1 chicken, chips, bread roll, gravy, drink and a Zinger burger for $17. Burger was nice and chicken was fresh. Chips were well seasoned. Plenty of tables and chairs to sit around but can be hard to find a clean one available. A lot of noise but it's expected at an airport. Would order again.

Last stop till I headed back to Oz. Ordered a Zinger meal in the hopes of getting one of the key rings. Politely asked if I could get one of the key chains - Was rudely told the ordered meal had to be a “Zinger Stinger” to get the key chain. And “Ha Ha, we’re all sold out..” Big grin on the server’s face.

If I could give this a zero i would. Absolutely disgusting with the way they handle things. No gloves, no hair nets being worn and touching the face or body and then dealing with the food. First and last time dealing with this place. Management needs to step up big time. Auckland airport do better.

Redefining fast food. Over 30 mins to get items. Front desk had one relatively incompetent person. 99% of people use the self service so it's not overwhelmed with people. Really a poor undertaking by KFC or their franchise who really have zero customer facing service. Was there at 1230 which is peak time but there wasn't staff to do the job. The food was usual KFC, no issues there but if you go to one of many other places, you would be fed n watered by the time you even saw your meal.

Portion is so small. Why are the two meat options mixed rather than divided by the rice in the middle. Rice is so stale, so as the chicken. They’re always like this. So expensive for something so bad. Do not recommend!

I had the Tom yum soup and it was probably the most delicious & comforting Tom yum I remember having for years & years. It’s the only thing I’ve tried there but if I went back I’d have to get the same thing because I loved it that much.
Nice ambience to relax and enjoy my meal before checking in. The Chicken dish combo was reasonably priced and really good. Highly recommended.

Food is over price by far. The beef fried rice had hardly any beef at all, low quality as well. We ordered a large fried chicken, extremely expensive for what we got. Wouldn't recommend it at all. Even for airport food was disappointing.

What you might expect for airport food offerings. Quite underwhelming and overpriced. Food has the distinctive flavour of a pre-made frozen meal heated in a microwave oven. How this restaurant receives a 4.8 rating at the time of writing this review is beyond me.
Very good food, feels like home ❤️ Recommended the beef and broccoli 🤤🤤

Had the noodles with ginger beef, the meat was tender and flavored deliciously, it was also sweet with a bit of a soya sauce taste to it. The dining space has a nice decorative screen that is visually pleasing and provides privacy whilst waiting at the airport.
Love the yummy food and the ambiance, clean and tidy resto plus the friendly staff they’ve got! 😊😍 Excellent staff communication.
The food are amazing, especially the Pad Thai! Staff are very accommodating and friendly. 😍
The chicken curry is simply the best. Add plenty of chili oil and youre sorted. Give it a go.
The McDonald's upstairs in the departures area before security (landside) is actually open 24 hours. Note menu items are more expensive and app deals doesn't work with the kiosks.

Wait times are extremely long, never provide any napkins, waiting area is cluttered and small, self-ordering machine always out of printer paper, and seating is always packed and as well as being basic and uncomfortable. I enjoy the busy airport scene but this McDonald's is the worst and messiest. They do get my orders right though. One star sounds about right.
It's sucks. I thought it had happy meal for Pokémon cards, but only get Yu-Gi-Oh toys after i ask.

It's decent fast food. Don't confuse this with the McDonald's post-security! This location is in the food court before you go through the international terminal. I ordered at the counter so cannot speak to the quality of the machines but they got our orders mostly correct (there was an extra patty on our spicy chicken sandwich but I am not complaining) Had the chicken sandwich and the spicy chicken sandwich; while not as good as my favorite Chick-fil-A grilled spicy deluxe it was a decent sandwich at a decent price. I got confused by the Google reviews but there are actually two McDonald's in this airport: one before and one after security.
Oh boy, this was the worst Cheeseburger I ever had. The cheese wasn't even melted and there weren't any pickles in it. Just eat somewhere else. I hope I don't get any disease.

All the food I have ordered has been excellent, no exception. Very fresh, high quality items, well prepared and beautifully served. The service is very friendly and helpful, and the waiters & waitresses are welcoming and always check with you for any food allergies the chef may need to be aware of. The atmosphere is pleasant and relaxed. My favourite spot to sit is at the front of the restaurant on the bench, at the little tables. The cushions make it cozy and comfortable, and it is quieter there. Thank you for all the delicious food and care, THIRTEEN50! 💛

Xmas day lunch was excellent. Food was the highlight with extensive range of food from traditional Xmas ham & turkey through to seafood. Desserts were very good with trifle, pavlova & steam pudding being the highlights. Staff were friendly but found it curious that our dishes were not collected which created clutter on our table. Overall a pleasant experience and one I’d recommend.

A great meal to start our holiday. We enjoyed the calamari, although deep fried it wasn't oily and was tender. It would be nice to offer a pan fried version. Caesar Salad with great and the lamb was succulent and full of flavour. Service was excellent. As always had to indulge in the fries and were great. Suggestion, please dim the lights as it creates more of an ambiance. All in all a great evening.

We had a very enjoyable meal at the THIRTEEN50. Warm and friendly welcome from Marianne (apologies if not spelt correctly), who sat us in a very comfortable booth. We were then welcomed again by our excellent server Olive. We are both vegetarians and were pleased to see several options. We enjoyed the Superfood Bowl, Roasted New Season Vegetables, plus a side of Steamed Broccolini and some Warm Focaccia. The food was well presented - and the vegetables cooked so well. Too many restaurants overcook veggies, but these were firm and well seasoned. Only slight negative was the size of the Broccolini side portion - we could have eaten a bucket-full! Olive was terrific - so polite and charming and she made time to chat with us. Food is obviously the reason we go to restaurants, but it’s the service that sticks in the memory. The service we received really made our evening. We’ll definitely visit again when next travelling from Auckland airport.

Second dinner in 2 months and food doesn't seem as good as it was. Had the club sandwich, which was about half bread with 3 slices of focaccia. Chips were good. Service really good - friendly and responsive even though they're busy. Nice atmosphere. Getting such that you have to book for dinner which is less convenient for an airport hotel.

Thank you so much Hop Yuen Takeaways. Always worth the drive from Papakura- a family favorite since always 😊 Everything was perfect and non-greasy. We also love what you did with the curry- yay a bit of extra spice? 🔥 Nice! And soon much food, we always have leftovers- like boilup, even better the next day. Excellent customer service as usual. Keep up the great work. Every blessing from our family to yours 💛 🙏 Slay
They have a wide range of takeaways available 5$ gets you 3 choices
great service, common atmosphere however, their portions are stingy compared to other chinese takeaways

The food is ok and we normally go there for our takeaways, but the young lady was very rude to me today. She was trying to save money by serving you lots of vegetables (chow mein) and noodles and rice. When I asked for more eggs, she said no take it or leave it. I was not impressed.
Food here is very meh at best but hey at lease they give you lots of veges lol that ill keep the vegans happy i could smash a plate of sweet n sour carrots

Whether you’re popping in for a quick drink after work or planning a fun night out with friends, this bar never disappoints. The staff are super friendly, the drinks are cold and well-priced, and the atmosphere is always welcoming. There’s a real sense of community here – you feel like a regular even if it’s your first time. Live music, themed nights, great food, and unbeatable service make it a top spot in town. Highly recommend for anyone looking for good vibes and a great time!

Our first time dining at our local tonight and DEFINITELY won't be our last.. The steak meal was delicious 😋 and the serving was huge.. If your a big eater you'll leave feeling full and content.. Lu looked after us and had awesome customer service.. I'd highly recommend our local for a nice hearty filling meal 💯
Totally unexpected experience! I loved the atmosphere, the service was great and the food was delicious! We ordered the pasta and lamb meal with variety of appetizers. Would definitely recommend x
We had a great time at Our Local! Awesomely generous servings of great tasting food.
I really enjoyed our time and the service and food was really good, The music was a little too loud and there was a bit of a fly problem but it's that time of the year so I can't fault it for that.

Ordered chicken and chips, also fish n chips. Way to oily. The chicken also taste like cinnamon coating. We threw it in the bin. Also got pork sandwich, Basically 3 very thin but small pieces of pork and alot of lettuce. bought milk shake it is Basically 95% throth bubbles and 5% milk shake at the bottom. The lady there is a little sketchy tbh. Don't recommend
My reason for giving one star was because the kids were eating fish and found hair attached to the fish. There chips were crispy and golden though 😁

Wish I could give zero stars, I went there earlier today. As I was about to order I noticed a COCKROACH 🪳 crawling around on one of the packed food packets in the warmer. I pointed it out and the worker just swatted it away and started speaking in her language to the other workers. I walked out. Hope they sory out the problem.
Fish was nice & fresh fries were crispy & not salted … Very good could recommend for occasional meal on the run as I was passing by.
Raw fish smelt off, and kina pots were opened on the side. Not happy. Only got 6 kinas out of the punet.

I’m absolutely blown away by the chicken nibbles at Chinese Malaysian Takeaways—crispy, golden, and bursting with flavour! Every bite was the perfect crunch, followed by juicy, tender chicken inside. It’s the kind of snack that keeps you reaching for more.

Average food with premium price tag. Somehow Chips were very Dry and seems like they from the day before. Chicken was no better. Don’t even ask about customer service. When asked food looks off she replied rudely that food is fresh. Very disappointing. This is second time in a row food was bad. Don’t buy food from here
Cook my own rice, then get one container of sweet and sour pork and another container of chicken chow mein from these guys for $32. Could fill up a rhino with the result. Delicious
Great service positive energy Top crispy chicken nibbles & chips
Great price and good food. Updated prices in pics

First time buying Chinese food from here. Not bad at all. I ordered the chicken fried rice, beef chowmein, deep fried wonton and a fish. All meals were very nice especially the fried rice. The beef chowmein was lacking greens but overall was very yummy. Definitely would like to try more dishes from the menu.

Fish was the same size as a potato fritter , 28 dollar special with extra chips ddnt feed 2 adults and 3 young children , food was tasty and cooked well but i havent seen a peice of fish that small since i had a pet goldfish
Have been coming to this family owned business for years now and it's still the best. The sweet n sour pork, chicken chow mein and wontons are our go to.
Chicken Fried rice, Pork Chow mein, Chicken Egg fu Yong and Deep fried Won tons our go to munch here. Everything else not that great. Lovely owners.

I use to love the fried rice from this place not anymore. I recently bought my regular fried rice but it was different this time i always put it aside because i like it cold but this time when i went to eat it the entire rice was mucussy all slimy and fermented i thought it was where i stored it and remembered my sis had one for work so i rang her to check her rice and she was disgusted at it hers too was slimy and fermented so the conclusion i come up with is they have replaced the normal yummy rice for that cheap unhealthy plastic rice. I will tell everyone i know not to ever buy there so disgusting yuck.

I went looking for goat curry and struck Gold! The owners were welcoming and accommodating. Combing Inidian cuisine with their takes from Sri Lanka and Indo-Fiji. Clean environment. Ample parking. Fantastic discovery. Forget the fancy places and foodcourts - this place gives you better quality and service. Even if what you're looking for is not on the menu, if you're dining in, chances are they will whip it up for you🫶. Try it out. Only 5 mins off the SH20 and SH1 in Manukau. Will go back next week.

Beautiful and lovely owners. Food was just amazing.. authenticate and full of flavours in their main dishes.. chicken curry , lamb curry are just to name a few. They even have yummy smoothies... Their samosa's were just yum 😋.. kids loved the chicken and chips and butter chicken with naan.... so reasonably priced as well. 11/10 rating. Our family Will definitely be stopping here for more on our next trip to kiwi land

Pleasantly surprised by how affordable this place is.The food was so delicious and the service was really great. Food is excellently prepared and very good value for money.. By far the best curry I tasted. We will certainly return and will recommend to friends and family.
Regular Customer. Happy and satisfied with their friendly service, great quality as well as quantity in serving food 👌. Highly recommend all the curry's. best curry place in South Auckland ☺️

Wow! The food here is absolutely delicious, ordered butter chicken, biriyani & a naan bread. I could taste how fresh and authentic everything was down to the dough and the rice. Made with real authentic flavors it's amazing best curry I have ever had. Owners are very welcoming and make the food to your spice tolerance. Thank you very much 😊

Aliiz Kitchen is a gem! The food was full of flavour and beautifully seasoned. The owner was so friendly and made us feel right at home. Loved the range of food options, the welcoming vibe, and how family-friendly it is — even wheelchair accessible! We’ll definitely be back for more kai. Highly recommend! Ngā mihi Aliiz Kitchen — keep doing what you do! 🙌🍴

Chiilli prawn meal very good!! The $13 packs are good too. Love the lasagne, and chicken curry. Good price, good portion. Very clean and tidy shop at a home. Great service. Fresh food, good price for portion size.

My first time here after seeking nearby recommendations whilst in the area and I'd be sure to pop by again. Enjoyed both dishes that the family cleared them quick before I could snap a pic of the chicken curry. The large chilli garlic prawn was a tasty change from my usual indo chinese meals. Cheers team, til the next time!🙌🏽
Excellent customer service and delicious mouth watering Meals. Awesome location no parking problems especially Trucks no hassel. Fast and Reasonable price.

I ordered Chilli Chicken, Mongolian Lamb & Chicken Fried Rice 🤤 Literally the BEST and most delicious meal I’ve had 👌 5 stars are not enough for their food and service!! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Keep growing and shining guys 🥰
Food is always fresh and fast.

Got the fried chicken and burgers and they were so delicious! Good amount of chips for the price. Love the batter on the chicken and the seasoning and the burgers have juicy Patties! Owners are super nice and friendly. Hella busy at peak hour times! Love it!

Very good take away! Worth spending money there , must try the Steak with runny egg burger, one of the best Burger have tried so far, very good customer service, fast @ efficient and prompt. Tried it you won’t be Dispointed?! I can guarantee it
They’ve got boba! Decent pricing too, food is always yummy. My favourite go to for hot food and boba. The taro milk tea with boba pearls are my favourite.

Rowendale Takeaways has improved immensely. A Rated and their Fish & Chips and spring rolls are fresh & delicious with a good sized piece of battered fish. Although a little more expensive their food is well worth a few extra $'s and I Highly Recommend them 😋

Phnom Penh Restaurant & Cafe – A Local Favourite That Never Misses! If you’re ever in Manurewa and looking for a reliable spot that hits the mark every single time, Phnom Penh is the place to be! This gem has become one of our many go-to spots – and for good reason. We kicked off with their Eggs Benedict, which is always a winner – perfectly poached eggs and velvety hollandaise over fresh, toasted bread. Then came the Satay Chicken – tender, juicy pieces covered in their insanely delicious peanut sauce. That combination? Absolutely addictive! The Prawn Twisters with sweet chilli sauce were crispy, golden, and packed with flavour – the perfect starter or snack if you’re sharing. And we couldn’t resist the Fish Burger, served with a generous side of fries and their homemade sauce that ties everything together so well. For something hearty, the Steak Meal was spot-on – cooked to perfection and served with fries and eggs for that classic, satisfying combo. The Kids Meal, extra fries, and Kumara chips were also a hit, especially with the little ones (and let’s be honest, the adults too!) also had a little treat of a 2 scoop ice creamed waffle coned 🤫. We left feeling like we’d eaten a full day’s worth of deliciousness – happily full and already planning our next visit. Thanks Phnom Penh for yet another satisfying meal. Highly recommend for families, casual catch-ups, or anyone who just loves good food done right! 😋

Amazing Restaurant Space! Excellent Counter Service! Sensational Tasting Food! My wife ordered to go, a Seafood Masi Fride Rice and I ordered the Laksa Soup, I ordered an extra Wong Tong Soup because I always need extra 😋 Each and every dish tasted amazing! Well seasoned and perfect 👌🏾 but the Humble Wong Tong Soup won the day!!!!! The cheapest dish we ordered was the most soul fulfilling and most impressive!!!! See you guys soon! So happy to are in our neighborhood! Thank you Team ❤️

Food is always on point for us, only thing is there’s never enough aioli lol. Great variety & haven’t had a problem. Staff are always friendly & accomodating, need to buy out the laundromat so we can have more carpark space lol

This morning had a beautiful and delicious brunch. This was our first time here and this was the best decision to come there as we were trying to figure out where we should go to have brunch in Manurewa. I 💯 recommend this place to everyone and will definitely come back again with my family. The young island lady that served us had great customer service…Food was DELICIOUS. Very spacious restaurant nice and clean it’s located on the main road of browns road next to traffic lights.
I had chicken pad thai. It was nice, portion size was generous and filling. I also got a coffee frappe. I’d go back and try something else. Premises were clean and tidy. Parking is a bit of an issue

Awesome Little tucked away Kebab place. Really great tasting food and awesome service. I tried the chicken and chips meal, it was very fulfilling. Definitely recommend anyone in the area to support our local businesses and give it a try.
Love the freshness of their food, chicken chips and kebabs, good flavor of everything, their service is honest with time. Love this place.

Love this place!** The kebabs here are amazing—juicy, flavorful, and packed with fresh ingredients. Great prices, big portions, and fast service. The chicken zinger burger and garlic fries are must-tries! Perfect for a quick, tasty meal. Will definitely be back!Love this place!

Hands down the best kebab I’ve had in ages! The meat was juicy and full of flavour, the sauces were spot on, and the wrap was fresh and perfectly grilled. Fast service, generous portions, and friendly staff – this place is a must-try!
I had Lamb kebab and my son had mix with rice food was tasty. Healthy not too much sodium. Amazing service. Thanks will recommend it. I’m happy to have a near by kebab shop 😊

First time trying this pizza joint and it was well worth it!!! My daughter is the most pickiest eater yet she enjoyed her meal! I was even surprised on how tasty the pizza was. They’re also not stingy with the sauce which I appreciated. Definitely worth trying and I will be ordering again!!!

Had to get pizzas for a staff function organized. The lady who served me was knowledgeable and very helpful in explaining all the options I had to cater to the different ethnic groups in my workforce. When I returned later to pick the 60 pizzas up, the other worker there was very helpful and was even happy to help me load the car, even though I had to park down the road. A minor gripe would be that after spending over $800 in one hit, that a free garlic bread or something would have been offered. Other then that, I had a great experience here.
I ordered a pizza with a thin base it was good but lots of sauce on top ..which one I don’t like .

We ordered the same exact pizza when they first opened and it was soooo good!! 💯💯 but today I’m so disappointed, why would they even give it? Couldn’t another pizza be made? This pizza was burnt and dry! You could even snap the crust 🤦‍♀️ I would’ve been happy to wait for them to make another one, clearly they would’ve seen it was burnt. Didn’t realise the state of our pizzas until we got home 😞

Today’s open @ manurewa and I ordered chilli chicken pizza 🍕 to review and giving my feedback, really lucky am so close to this shop. Fully loaded pizza, ready on time and same taste carry over here at Manurewa

Saturdays Burger is truly the place to go. I’ve been a regular for some time now, and the meals especially the burgers are on another level. The food is consistently amazing. What I find myself coming back for almost daily is the iced mocha absolutely unbeatable. I genuinely can’t get enough of them! Over time, Salina has come to know my usual order, and whenever I call ahead, she prepares it perfectly and ensures it’s ready for me to pick up. The exceptional customer service is another reason I continue to return. Thank you for consistently delivering such great food and service. xx
Really clean and the atmosphere was great. Appropriate price for great quality burgers. Definitely recommend, will come back!👍
The Saturday’s mushroom burger with double patties is delicious and very filling. Chicken nibbles are juicy and tasty. Loaded fries are creamy and well seasoned😋

Been 3 or 4 times on our way through the area. Service is great, very friendly. The chicken is always big and juicy. The standard fries, while there's plenty, each time they've not been great, like not fresh - and we're eating as we drive so not left for ages. Will try a burger next time since they have better reviews.
Love the chicken burgers here! The sauce is delicious and the brioche buns are so good. Kumara fries are my fav as well. Friendly service and always freshly made couldn’t recommend enough!
Such a great app to use. Super easy and great prices! Won't be using uber eats again!
It's not flash but I like this little place. Surprisingly good coffee (most places like this don't make good coffee). Basic food at a fair price.

Pie cravings were definitely satisfied with this purchase! Such a lifesaver during level 4 lockdown when you've run out of things to cook already :P Love supporting small businesses :) would definitely order again. Also, the matcha cookies were yummy too!

Hospitality is 10/10 cashier always has a smile and a pep in her step with interacting with customers,food is yummy,steak meal is always my go too,some times steak has a weird taste but other times is delicious,.
Pie and muffin purchased and both of pretty poor quality though price was OK. No a particularly appetizing display.

My favourite lunch bar, best in South Auckland. Have gone for many years throughout uni and and work. Has been consistently great and filling with amazing service. Coffee is decent too. Great value for money. 6/5 stars

Beautiful Kai, lovely service, freshly cooked hot seafood boil with an amazing flavoured butter sauce. Wow. Fish and chips was a large portion and worth it but those s&p squid where definitely something else, cooked to perfection, tender and just damn to good. hands down the best in Auckland. Can't wait for that Creamy Chowder and Paua, see you Saturday..🤩
Just had their half dozen mussels with spicy sauce and wow. INSANE. Support local with their food truck. These guys are doing really well. All these best, team!
Very yummy dinner, enjoyed every bite thank you for such a great service

Oh, and PLEASE, SWITCH TO PLASTIC BAGS for takeaways! That’s my advice. Following my experience tonight, I certainly won’t be back anytime soon, and perhaps not ever. Good luck with your future business.
