The wedges also are really well seasoned. I highly recommend ordering from Pizza Inn and trying them out if you haven't before. One thing I will say is that the olives on the alfredo pizza were unnecessary and it'd be nice if there were a few more mushrooms. Other than that though, I will definitely be happy to order again and support another small, local business. Mauri Ora!
Beautiful food made with love. I had the kebab with sweet chili and mayo, butter chicken and baklava; all ON whānau. Trust and try it!👌🏽

The behavior of the Asian lady worker is deeply concerning. Witnessing an elderly European gentleman, aged around 80-90 years, being overcharged $60 for a $10.60 meal is indeed distressing. Such actions are unacceptable and reflect poorly on the establishment. It's my hope that appropriate measures are taken to address this situation swiftly.

Delicious food, warm and friendly service, and a relaxing atmosphere made it perfect for our intimate family gathering. Every dish was generous in size yet so tasty that we all finished everything. We left happy and full. Thank you for a wonderful time.
After a very long time I have found true authentic Indian taste food. Every dish tried was awsome

We came here on a weekend and it was busy. I'd definitely recommend making a booking but we still got a table and some blankets to keep us warm. Between two of us we shared a plate and it was more than enough, especially since we got what is arguably the best cinnamon bun in I've ever had for dessert (and five more to take home!). It's a bit out of the way but it's worth the trip and the cost.

This place was buzzing when we arrived, it's a lovely cafe and the farmhouse setting is very charming. People were queuing to be seated as it was a Saturday and very busy so we decided to get take out. There were all sorts of goodies in their cabinets. We tried the cinnamon rolls and my goodness they are the best we have ever tasted, the bun was not dry like some can be, it was moist and full of cinnamon, plenty of cream cheese frosting and a delectable topping. We are going back soon to be seated and try food and coffee from their delightful menu. It's a dog friendly cafe as well which is always a bonus.

Absolutely love this place! The service was top notch and the food, simply amazing. There were only two of us, but we couldn’t resist trying so many delicious options. Highly recommend and can’t wait to return!

This café is one of those rare hidden gems tucked away in the peaceful outskirts of Auckland. The food and service are exceptional—every dish is thoughtfully prepared, and the staff are warm and attentive. There's plenty of seating available, both indoors and outdoors, with options for covered and uncovered areas to suit any weather. Parking is abundant, and the café is pet-friendly, making it a perfect spot for a relaxed outing with furry companions. The meal portions are generous, leaving you satisfied and smiling. I truly can't recommend this place enough!

Wasn’t expecting much while ordering as not many places make good veggie burgers but surprisingly the food was fresh and delicious. Great coffee and very friendly service. Loved the vibe of this cute hidden cafe in Huia.

Stayed overnight and opted for an upgrade to an Executive Suite for a small additional cost — absolutely worth it. The suite was well-equipped, spotlessly clean, and very comfortable. The bed and bedding were exceptionally comfortable, and the room was beautifully quiet. Overall, a thoroughly enjoyable stay and would certainly book again.

The staff were exceptional from the front of house, restaurant staff to the shuttle drivers. Convenient to the airport, excellent shuttle service and the ability to leave the car in secure storage which was great. Will definitely be staying again in the future.

Our room was booked via a travel agent. The free shuttles were awesome, driven by friendly staff. We were arrived early and room wasn't ready but they took.our bags and we headed back to the airport to get a bus to the city centre. Once finished in the city caught the bus back to.the airport and picked up again by the shuttle. Room was great nice and clean. Didn't eat on the restaurant but had asome snacks from the cafe which were nice. Caught a lift to our room and the housekeeper staff were in it, they were laughing and smiling. (Took that a sign of.the hotel.being a good employer) Bed was comfy. Got the shuttle early in the morning. Had a nice time...apart from the person in our room snoring. Friendly staff and would recommend staying here.

Had a very enjoyable meal and a few bevies during happy hour 😊 My twice cooked pork belly was excellent and the veg so delicious. The staff were happy and efficient too. PS. Was nice and busy for a Tuesday night.

Extremely busy mcdonald's being so close to the airport, so takes a while to get your order. Staff were pleasant enough and the burgers ordered were fine. Coffee was really well made. The restaurant it's self was clean, overflowing rubbish bins. I'm not sure if they need more staff but the wait time was really long inside the restaurant, but it is what it is.
Advertised as open until midnight but staff were closing at 10pm. Maybe advertise the actual opening hours and don’t mislead your customers?

⭐☆☆☆☆ I was really disappointed with my recent order. One item was completely missing, and the drink I received was not what I ordered. It’s frustrating when you look forward to your meal and it’s not right. I hope the service improves and orders are double-checked before sending.
We come here for years. The eggs benedicts have improved incredibly and are absolutely delicious. Very friendly and professional staff. The gluten free bread is yummy. Thank you!

Got my order wrong and no apologie . Then when they fixed the order but clearly rushed so was a mess. Said it had hurbs but it was drowned in it . Worst I have had in a long time. Poor serive bad food . Rest of the food was not much better. Won't be returning

This is the second time I have ordered packed lunches for a business meeting to be delivered. The lunches were fantastic, great sandwiches, yummy snacks and treats that were well balanced - no sugar crashes at 2pm. Wonderful value for money and great friendly service. Totally recommend The Orchard Juicery catering.

Discovered this gem while in AKL on business, staying at the Heartland Airport Hotel. 5 min walk (free off street parking available side of cafe) extensive menu, clean & tidy. Everything made in-house except the pies. I ordered from the cabinet “to go” a large savoury scone, raspberry lamington, low carb vege frittata with side salad & coffee. Covered lunch & dinner all for $25! Tasty food, good coffee, all staff welcoming & delightful service from Morris - will return on my next business trip.

I used to come here a lot and always loved their Egg Benedict. A few weeks ago, I visited again and ordered the same dish, but it was horrible — no original taste at all. I thought maybe the old chef was on leave, so I gave it another chance today. Unfortunately, I found out that the ownership has changed, and it’s a complete mess now. Poor customer service, below-average food, and I even had stomach issues right after leaving. The only positive was seeing the same hardworking Asian lady from the previous ownership, still giving her best despite everything. Sadly, this will be my last visit. I truly miss the old Sierra food and vibe.

Popped into post office bar on my first night in New Zealand (1st of August) and I did not regret it. Had the most incredible feed and cocktail for happy hour! The service was timely and the atmosphere was exhilarating with the NRL in the background! Would highly recommend their food and cocktails if you're in need of a good pick me up!
We had our papa’s 65th birthday party last night Wonderful service Lovely team Appreciate the support and assistance from Manager Manoj in making this event possible 😄

“The service was very poor. I am a petite woman, and of course I cannot finish a large portion. They served me a large size without even asking what size I wanted, and refused to change it even though I hadn’t had it.” I won’t come back why
The food was amazing. Staff we sensationally. Sadip was very kind and very friendly.

Got the burger and the fried chicken. The burger was good but the portion size was tiny. The fried chicken was the dryiest most tasteless I've had in a long time. Overall below average food. Choose somewhere else if you're looking to feel full for a decent price and you like fried chicken.

Pork belly bao from this place is a must. They call it an 'ugly burger' which I found confusing at first but it is a steamed bao bun. They also have a selection of dumplings which are freshly made to order or an 'ugly bowl' which is basically a bento bowl where you choose noodles or rice, a selection of salads and 2 meat/toppings. Everything I have tried has been super nice and reasonably priced and there are plenty of tables inside.
My favourite Vietnamese place in Auckland! The chicken or pork noodle salad is a must try! Very tasty and totally worth the price as the portion is massive. Can't get any better than that.

Was all good until I got to the last piece of sushi. A "fried" chicken item. Bit into it and it turned out to be raw chicken. Outside batter was cooked but they hadn't cooked it for long enough. Took it back and was offered a refund of $1.50. Yeah fair enough, that's all they legally have to do. Staff didn't really care or wanted to know about it. They even kept selling the same items I had just returned and a customer overheard the exchange, but they didn't stop the sale. Won't ever be back...back to St Pierres which is down the road 2 minutes.
The food is not too bad. And the service staffs were nice too. Food came pretty quick and there’s ample parking outside.

They gave me a little more food than I ordered 😁 thanks for the bonus! Overall, it was good. The only downside was that there wasn’t much understanding when I asked about nuts. Having an allergy information sheet available at the ordering area would be really helpful.

JazakAllah bhai jaan Naushad for your efforts and the delicious food you and ur staff prepared for my son's 21st. May Allah (SWT) reward you abundantly for your kindness and hard work. Everyone truly enjoyed the meal, and it added so much barakah to the celebration. JazakAllah khair for being a part of this special day.i have never seen the owner of the company going and helping customers taking their groceries to their car especially in newzealand. Only person does that is Naushad bhai jaan. Bhai jaan u r very kind, respectful to each n everyone. Our blessings will always be with u. Naushad bhai is always there to help each n everyone. Thank u Naushad bhai. Humble request to each n everyone pliz keep supporting Getfresh Group of Companies especially to Naushad bhai jaan.

Ended up here due to a flight cancellation and for a place that could easily just dial it in and serve junk, this was surprisingly good. They use the robot to help serve which definitely helps them serve a sudden crowd. The steak was actually cooked perfect too. Servers kept the water full. Overall a great experience for a meal at a location I never planned on.

Bloody brilliant Banh Mi here. I visited on Saturday specifically to try out the crispy pork (only served on Tuesday and Saturday) and found out that the lemongrass banh mi has won an award and people are now flocking here bright and early to procure some. Their Vietnamese ice coffee was also delicious, with a nice level of sweet. Sounds like I’ll need to revisit at some point in the near future 😁

This is all that's left before I remembered to take a pic. The pork was so beautifully flavoured, and the baguette is perfect - crispy on the outside, fluffy on the inside. Both pork and bread stayed crispy for ages. Service is great as well! Polite and engaging :) Wait time has ranged from 5-15 minutes but you have to expect it if they're an award-winning eatery. Daughter said Ngôn quá, it was the highlight of her day 😂 Cám ơn 🙏

Lowest food quality and quantity. The chowder tasted like something a 10yo would make and $18 for two tiny mussel fritters with a cold charcoal bun was ridiculous also there’s only one steak out of 3 was available. None of the dishes showed any thought or care. Service was just as disappointing, slow, inattentive, no water until requested, a forgotten wine order, and only one waitress seemed capable of looking after customers. I’ve worked in hospitality, and this is simply not how a restaurant should be run. We wanted a nice meal to end our New Zealand trip but this is just so disappointing.

Me and my family came here tonight as we are traveling from New Plymouth to Brisbane, we had the most wonderful waiter Easter who was so understanding of my preferences and helped everyone with suggestions. She was incredibly kind and accommodating. I enjoyed that the menu was in Te Reo, and I loved the Karakia at the back. I had the pork belly boil up and it was INCREDIBLE the broth was very rich and flavourful, the pork melted in my mouth and the watercress (which was recommended to be boiled with the broth great choice thank you Easter!) was just the cherry on top of a beautiful main!! The change I asked to make was to swap kumera for potatoes which they couldn't do (which was all good!!) so instead we just removed them. Thank you so much for such amazing, kind, and attentive service Easter!!! 100% would recommend coming here if you ever stayed at the Pullman!

Friendly service. We eat CFC here and overseas and normally we love it because it's great value and great taste. Unfortunately this place wasn't any good. We got take out and the chicken and the chips had been sitting in the warmer for far too long, to the point that it really should've been offered at a (hefty) discount, or offered to cook a fresh batch. Chips had gone soggy and stale and the chicken was very dry and tough. Chicken nuggets were cooked fresh, but not properly - outside was slightly overcooked (dark brown) but the inside was a bit under cooked. Not recommended.
The best sushi place. Specially the rice is perfect.

My auntie and I have been here on Monday. We got a welcome from the staff. They were very friendly, enthusiastic, and good at taking care of the customer 🥰 Plus, the food and beverages were very delicious, and the taste was almost the same as Vietnamese ❤️ Highly recommend ❤️🩷🩵💜
First time trying food from here today, I loved it everything was fresh! Amazing staff. Definitely coming back here again.
Love it 😍 thank you ladies! Definitely coming back 🙌🏾

Delicious, fresh, and full of flavour! The banh mi was packed with goodness — a perfect mix of pâté, butter, meat, and veggies. I love that they offer all kinds of meat options, and every one I’ve tried has been delicious. The salad bowl was fresh and tasty, the drinks were refreshing, especially cold drinks of any kins. The staff were friendly with a cosy vibe. I highly recommend!
Delicious bread I bought roast pork bread + egg bread, both are delicious The coffee is also delicious :D

Probably the best takeout place I’ve ever been to, being near my house my family comes here when we aren’t feeling to cook. The chicken nibbles are so juicy and the chips are so crispy but nothing hits harder than the STIR FRIED NOODLES🤤🤤🤤 the owners are so nice too! The place is quite tiny and a bit dull but the vibes and the aroma makes up for it. Overall it’s a wonderful place and you should definitely give it a try!
Delicious! Salty Lassi is the best! Recommend tandoori chicken, aloo Nan especially. Great value.
Lovely clean rooms, staff were helpful and couldn't do enough to help. Lift available for elderly people. Restaurant was top-notch, lovely food, clean and tasty.

My children and I have been here for a few hours now. If you want a place to kick in some depression, just come here 😔 Permanent residents (I assume from WINZ) will blast their music and make sure you and your children can't sleep. There's holes in the walls. The room stinks of cigarettes and my baby has asthma 😔 dirty towels left in the wardrobe and not replaced for you upon arrival. THE ROOM STINKS OF CIGARETTES AND MY BABY HAS ASTHMA 😭😭

I’ve just picked up my little sister from there as she was staying there for 1 night she came from a school in Wellington, in the bathroom theres a hole in the wall, dryer had hair already in it when the girls went in to the bathroom, the ceilling had a crack and it had a leak in the ceilling also the bed under it was wet. Also meter had no cover and it’s dangerous.
The Pizza is different from other pizza. You can really feel the taste of it totally different from other places. I like it very much and worth trying it. I really enjoyed it.

I ordered the korma curry with rice, naan, and a bottled soft drink of my choice, and it was definitely a filling meal. The portion was big, more than enough for me, I think it was $26, yes it’s pricey for me. The curry was rich and creamy, the rice paired well with it, and the naan was soft and nice for dipping into the sauce. Having a drink included made the whole set feel complete. Overall, satisfied. Just the price.
RIP OFF FOR TAKEWAY. $23.00 for a half container of rice and curry, and a crunchy Nan. What a joke!

placed an order for the 3 Pizza Combo Deal and the 3 Sides Deal. For the sides, I specifically ordered one garlic bread and one cheese garlic bread, and I paid an additional $1.50 for the cheese upgrade. When I went to collect my order, no staff member informed me that the cheese garlic bread was unavailable. I only discovered this after returning home and opening my order, where I found that I had been given two regular garlic breads instead. I immediately called the store for clarification. Unfortunately, instead of receiving an apology, I was spoken to in a rude and dismissive manner by a staff member named Dilpreet. He stated that “all Domino’s in Auckland” had run out of cheese garlic bread and questioned me about “what I wanted now.” His tone was argumentative and unprofessional, and he even suggested that I could file a complaint if I wished, as it did not concern him. He also justified his behavior by saying the store was very busy. I want to make it clear that the issue is not about the $1.50 charge—it is about the lack of communication and the poor way I was treated as a customer. A simple apology at the point of collection and notification of the unavailable item would have resolved the situation. Instead, I felt disrespected and frustrated by the response I received. I kindly request that this matter be addressed, both in terms of customer communication (informing customers when items are unavailable) and staff training in handling customers with professionalism and courtesy.

On first Delivery One pizza had a massive hole in it the size of a cup, store replaced this pizza but both had extra cheese on order and appeared to have very little cheese on it at all. Pizzas were over cooked and I cannot believe pizza was dispatched in the state it was in. Regret ordering and not worth $46 value. Should have made my own or got Hell pizza at same price. Photo is as delivered.

Came here after a very long time. The cabinet looked great with the savoury and sweet items. We ordered Scrambled Eggs with Ciabbatta with Hash Browns, Cream Cheese and Jam Bagel, Mango Match Smootie and Snickers Smootie. The eggs on ciabbatta was blend and basic. The tomatoe relish has to carry the burden of introducing flavour into the whole dish. The Bagel with cream cheese and jam was good. The Snickers smootie was good too. But blending lacked conviction. Lump of peanut butter sat at the botton due to neglect. The Mango Match smootie was good. Hash browns were a huge let down. At $7 for a pair, they were stuck together due to neglect when frying. Had to pull them apart and lesser cooked regions were there. Need to get better hash browns for this price tag too. Atmosphere was food, though the place needs more attention to deep cleaning. Corners visible with a cumulated dirt, black marks on furniture. Not expecting the place to look brand new however the lack of an detailed eye on cleaning is very obvious.

I love this place, I always go for the same dish cause I really like it alot 😂 buttermilk chicken on 3 cheese waffles or smething like that. Its so nice😂😂😂 ive had it like 5-6 times nothing else 😂😂👌 Anyways.. enviroment is clean, peaceful, warm n welcoming, presentation of food is just amazing, the wait on food isnt long, nice place to have a catchup, food is yummy and filling ❤️
Great meal and busy spot - funny how both go hand-in-hand. Visiting NZ family and this was deemed in the middle, and was pretty darn good. Great service and meals.

Atmosphere was great. The waiter who brought our food was very friendly and welcoming, awesome job to you. The guy at the cashier was alright, didn't say good morning at first when I approached the counter but only after I said good morning that he said hi to me. But it's alright, understandable that not every one will greet you first hand. Food on the other hand was great. One other thing to note, no waiter is going to take your order, you'll have to go back to the cashier to order your food. I think it would've been nice to be informed how they operated their service as it was our first time there. However, thank you Urban Soul for a wonderful brunch this morning.
Cheeseburger Combo from App...
Unbelievable! Ordered $13.59 katsu Chicken on rice with missing chicken. I wonder have they took some for themselves. Botany or Ormiston way better than them. Never ever come again.

One of my fav cafes to go to for a brekky/brunch fix. Located in Manukau. The servings are generous, presentable & delicious! Have been going to this place for years & the meals have always been consistent. The mocha was nice & HOT & strong 🙈 just how I like it 🥰 They have a HUGE range of meals to choose from. I always recommend this place, satisfaction guaranteed 👌🏽

Food was not that great. We ordered Tandoori platter and gorkhali chicken. Then entire tandoori platter did not have fresh meat, you could see that the meat was of different color, just like when you cook bad meat. I did highlight it to the owner and he placed the item. Generally the meat is not fresh and really old meat that should not be served. Would not recommend.
Just a sad experience today. Man who served us didn't have the will to live. This showed in his ability to make a sandwich and was just rude. Sad amounts of toppings and really not fresh.
Fast service, great staff, small but cozy place
Amazing authentic biriyani and great customer service. This place will be my go to 🤘spot love the flavours ❤️

This place has gone downhill. The quality of the food has dropped significantly. The staff have all changed (unsure if new owners) and the food just tastes old and off, especially the buffet station food. Lamb biryani is not even worthy of calling a biryani. The chicken 65 tasted like it had been reheated numerous times. Disappointing

An absolute flavor revelation! The butter chicken was impossibly creamy, and the chicken biryani very tasty and perfect. Service was warm and attentive. This is authentic, soul-satisfying cuisine at its best. i can't wait to return!
I have been to this restaurant many times now, I liked all their food, so I recommend everyone should try their food Atleast once and you will not be disappointed.

Thankyou so much to the Beautiful Aunty, Tongan Queen for serving me and my husband today. It's been a long time since I've experienced good customer service. Appreciate it so much. Food was good as always. Keep shining your light.

My family and I have been visiting Coffee Club at Manukau for many years now. We often have lunch at the St Luke's branch, only because their food is amazing. Although the Manukau branch as great staff, good customer service and coffee, their food could be better. There is such a difference in the way their menu is prepared and served from one branch to another. I personally think this should be looked at as at the end of the day you are representing Coffee Club and there should be a certain level of consistency. I ordered the Southern fried chicken ciabatta, the portion of chicken was so small, lots of coating, we were eating mostly bread. It was also quite dry, not enough sauce.The Calamari dish had such small portions of calamari and the salad, well let's just say there was so little that you might as well remove it from the plate. No tomatoes either. The seafood platter was good and shrimp popcorn tacos a must try, nicely prepared. When you are visiting different locations of the same franchise, customers not only expect good service but consistency in providing excellent food.

Had a very good time there 😍 for a Polynesian, their portion are very good. I had fish and chips and that was delicious. My partner had the coffee club breakfast and he loved it…finished his plate too 😂 the onion rings was $15 or $18 I think, they’re really good. The staff and service was amazing too, very friendly and tidy place. I would totally go back especially they have one cafe near my work at CBD 2 minutes from the sky tower.

Bought large chicken tikka on online order a meal site for $19. Upon pickup after 45mins i was informed they did not get my order. After showing them proof of purchase they said they would make my order in 2mins which took 15mins. Got my order,surprised looked so small in quantity. With nowhere else to waste time ,ordered another same meal at counter and was told its $22. They said they forgot to change price online. Attached pic for quantity.
A very cozy place for eatery, friendly customer service and the meals that we ordered was absolutely delicious 😋

Came into this Melba last week on Tuesday and had a great experience. The atmosphere was really nice - big airy space and filled with light. It was sunny and there were nice outside tables for us. Our server Marley was great; she was super friendly and helpful. The food was also really good, had the fried chicken waffles and creamy mushrooms. Would definitely recommend and come back :)

It was a great experience for our family when we visited Sal’s! It came recommended by our family here in Auckland and it did not disappoint! The pizza dough was commendable - tasty, crispy crust on the outside but light and chewy inside. The sauce was my favorite. Dont expect too much toppings though. The Pizza Wheels was a burst of smoky pepperoni flavors. Before we left we decided to add the Zeppole too and the staff was very kind to give us all 3 flavors of dip. The pastry was so light and airy. Overall great score for this pizza place! Id recommend to everyone who will visit the nearby outlets.
Was skeptical about Sals being authentic NY pepperoni pizza, but was pleasantly surprised. It was really good. Had half pepperoni half manhattan. Great job and friendly efficient service!
so much different foods, i LOVE it!

Was a kiwi kinda version of a hawker centre. We bought fried seafood kway teow and roti from the Taste of Malaysia. Enjoyed it! Also had sweet n sour chicken and pork and chive dumplings from Yummy Wok... also delicious. Would go back again if in the area.

Ordered takeaway food , Kadai chicken, Kadai paneer , Manchurian and quite few garlic naan breads on Friday night, 8/08. It was terrible and most of the naan bread and Manchurian was burnt and we have to throw it away . We had guests from Wellington we were so embarrassed bringing the food from chawla thinking it was a good restaurant. Never ever, we had to make the food at home because every other was closed. Not recommended for family and friends

The staff were super friendly and courteous to suggest a few dishes and drinks .Hands down, some of the best food I’ve had recently! The freshness of the ingredients and the unique flavors in the( dry goat and chilli chicken) were unforgettable. Highly recommended for food enthusiasts

Had a wonderful dining experience at Chawla’s Indian Restaurant, Manukau. The food was absolutely delicious, authentic, and full of flavor. The service quality was excellent – a big thank you to Vivek and his team for being so welcoming, attentive, and ensuring everything was perfect. Highly recommended for anyone looking for great Indian food with warm hospitality. Will definitely be visiting again!
The pizza was half-cooked. Seems like Manukau branch want customers to cook the food at home. Head office needs to work on this issue. Food quality is not consistent.

I placed an order for 2 pizzas and was told it would be ready in 15 minutes. I ended up waiting 30 minutes, and when they finally brought my order, it was the wrong one. After another wait of about half an hour, I received the correct pizzas but with no apology or acknowledgment for the mistake or delay. Very disappointing service.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ I had a wonderful experience at Subway today. The employee named Sunny did an excellent job preparing my meal. He made it with great care, and it turned out absolutely delicious. I was very impressed with his friendly attitude and attention to detail. Thank you, Sunny, for providing such great service and a tasty meal — keep up the good work!

[First time leaving a one-star review] Upon arrival, the staff member already seemed disinterested and unengaged, like he didn’t want to be there. My partner placed an order for two sandwiches and to avoid mistakes, he tried to explain one order at a time … Instead, the worker insisted on taking both at once. Despite my partner being clear and patient, the worker appeared annoyed by the details he gave. The worker rushed through the order and ended up getting both sandwiches completely wrong. What makes it worse is that I’m allergic to olives — which my partner specifically asked not to be included in one of the sandwiches — yet he added them to both orders (which we were both unaware about until we began eating) This felt careless and inconsiderate, as if he was more focused on getting back to whatever he was doing out the back than preparing our food properly.

Look, here’s the thing… can’t expect much from a fast food place, 10pm on a Sunday evening but respectfully… the mess in this place was kinda wild. Rubbish bins over flowing, floor was filthy and tables were left uncleared and uncleaned for god knows how long. Also… its smells really funky, a very unsanitary smell for a fast food restaurant. However… the food came out pretty much fresh, hot fries and hot burger. The renovation was a great idea but it does pay to keep it clean and tidy 😅

Went through the drive through around lunch time (30/08/2025) and was very happy with the service. The staff were very friendly and kind with their delivery. The food was great but we were very taken aback with the service. It’s nice to talk to a person and not an AI assistant. Great job team.

Food is good and place is good just one request please don't allow brggers or homless indside the restaurant they always ask for food inside nd sometimes feel unsafe. Make strict action no homless until they buy if they r roaming bothering customer so this ia not right.
Spicy or regular crispy fried chicken with fries n soda, you can refill everytime ya like. Very delicious 😋

Excellent experience! I had a burger from Burger King and it was absolutely delicious – fresh, juicy, and full of flavor. The staff were friendly, helpful, and made the visit even better. Great service and great food, I’ll definitely be coming back!

Every single time there is something wrong. And I can’t claim anything back from uber eats. I’m always stuck with burgers I didn’t order or missing items. Don’t bother ordering unless you go in yourself and check that the order is correct. Nothing is ever done when complaints are lodged either. Waste of money. Management contact you and still nothing is done.

The big guy that serves rude and inconsiderate laughed three times on the phone and I said it’s not a laughing matter shame on you.

3 stars and im being generous! They are VERY stingy on toppings compared to other subways and I was shocked at how little seasoning is on the bread. Picture for reference, this 'garlic bread' is coated in the pictures, here is just white bread! Very dissapointing and hope they will improve

I had a great experience at Subway today. The staff(soina and veerpal )were very friendly, welcoming, and professional. They prepared my order quickly and exactly the way I wanted, with a smile the whole time. The service was excellent, and the place was clean and well-organized. It’s always nice to be served by people who genuinely care about their customers. Keep up the great work!

The only reason to give them a 1 star rating is because the quantity they serve compare to other Subways are relatively less. Unless you are attentive and look at how they are preparing your meal, you would end up having a bad experience. Most of time their veggies are finished which is understandable as prices are going up. No, they wont apologise if they commit a mistake, which make you feel like disappointed.

When I arrived, the lady was busy with another customer. I wanted to place an order and went to use the bathroom first. The lady serving me, an Indian woman, was very disrespectful and told me the store was closed, even though other customers were still ordering food. I also saw another person use the bathroom, yet she refused me. I felt very disrespected by the way I was treated and left the store immediately without placing an order. I do not recommend this location, as there are many other Subways where staff are polite and respectful. The staff here need to learn how to treat customers with respect.

Very bad experience here. Twice it happened with us. First we were missing items which we took as a human error,Today we went and ordered a veggie burger. Came home opened the order only to find out they gave us bacon and chicken burger. Very disappointed as it was for my pregnant wife

If I could give 0 stars, I would. I gave this place two chances to improve, but the food quality is consistently disappointing. On 6th September at 6:20 pm, the manager on duty promised me better quality and even a complimentary burger after my previous complaint. Neither of those promises were kept. The burgers here taste awful, never fresh, and honestly feel like zero effort goes into making them. I’d rather go to another Carl’s Jr. where they actually know how to serve a proper burger.
I ordered veggi burgers first time today and i found hair in my burgur. I am not happy.

We ordered a large lamb for $26. The meat was scarce (probably less than 100g) and only came with 4 potatoes, one tiny bite of kumara and pumpkin. Not recommend, not worth the money. Spoke to the owner and she explained the meat is $85/kg?!? Definitely not going back.

Ordered from Uber eats Took forever no fault of the Uber driver Food was Terrible dry chicken and potatoes were like Rocks the custard on the apple crumble was thin and tasteless don't waste your time

**30 aug 25- update Shake out Uber eats order Cheese burger, double cheeseburger, double royale (this reminded me of the Denny's millennium burger, back when it was good 😊👍), chicken burger, chicken bites, x3 fries, X1 cheesy fries, X1 choco shake and a coke. Didn't realise it was burger fuel, prefer this over last order. Fries were crunchy and well seasoned (my only critique is really a preference for the regular burger fuel fries as less oily) and burgers appear small and simple but are cooked (patty seared) and prepared well (not overly dressed). Shake is always yummy and the best. 😊👍 Found our meal over-all fulfilling. Will order from here as opposed to regular burger fuel menu going forward. 20/12/24- update** Ordered through the Uber eats app- -the spud fries w/ lemon aoli & kumara fries w/ aoli, the Ford freakout & v-twin vege burgers, oat thickshake & organic apple & feijoa. Apart from it taking ages to get to us from close by and arriving cold ❄️ 😔 (could be down to the Uber being out of sync & dual care undertaken in making our food) I enjoyed my vege burger more than my usual fave American muscle double & the choc oat shake, although I don't feel like it tastes as good as the reg dark choc thickshake. Spud fries were not a hit cold n couldn't tell which aoli was lemon infused.. Ordered the American muscle double & C n cheese burgers, kumara & spud fries, choppers & choc thick shake. All in all good, quite greasy. No aoli/serviettes supplied, which's pretty slack when it is meant to come with our side orders if fries & considering the overall money spent
100/10! Hands down the best Burger franchise in NZ with better and healthier ingredients. It's always a treat -favorite is the American Mussle (HINT add some bacon into it- you're welcome:) )
Probably one of a few places that can make a delicious vegetarian pizza ! Absolutely delicious! And the jalapenos cheesy bites 🤌🏻🤌🏻💯 i have tried other flavors and they are good

I dined alone and stopped in for breakfast while searching for a gift. I had the TCC big breakfast and was happy with the size and quality. Washed it down with a nice flat white coffee. Overall very good.

Coffee club Manukau are is one of our favs! The food and coffee were just what we needed, and the staff were friendly and welcoming. A big bonus is the little play area for kids at the front, it kept our little one entertained while we enjoyed our meal in peace. It’s such a thoughtful touch for families and makes dining here much more relaxed. Definitely a nice spot to stop by whether you’re with kids or just catching up with friends 🥰

⭐ The Worst KFC Experience Ever! We gave this location two chances—both were a disaster. First visit (11:30 PM): They close at midnight, but we were told they barely had any chicken left. So we ordered burgers instead—over 10 burgers for a family outing. When we got home, we realized they had pre-heated them. They were soggy, falling apart, and completely inedible. A total waste of money. Second visit (9:30 PM): No cars ahead or behind us, yet after placing our order, we were told to park and wait. No mention of a delay or that they were cooking a fresh batch of chicken. We waited over an hour with zero communication. I went inside twice and was told “5 more minutes” each time—only to keep waiting another 15 minutes. We didn’t leave until 10:30 PM. Unacceptable. If they had just communicated the wait time, we would’ve gone elsewhere. This kind of service is beyond disappointing. First and last time visiting this branch.

A great Manager makes a great team. Fast service with a great atmosphere. Greeted with smiles. Food was fresh. Burger bun was soft as. I'll be coming back a great experience. Don't change the team Keep up the great work team. 🫶 * please pass on the the team. They deserve the great compliments. Go get em Amaar🤙
Sushi loving Miss 9 and I throughly enjoyed our Sushi lunch together. Miss 9 even said “the best sushi ever”
Best sushi in town ! Love this place and I return to this spot often!
Too good to not lick clean. Found a new favorite food spot.

Good fish and chips. The fish was fresh and it was a pleasant surprise to have been able to buy some fresh mussels too ☺️. I go to Manukau to the Cavendish BP and get my car washed and this is just down the road from there. The fish was cooked well too and not overcooked.

Ordered for fried dumplings and told the person that we are having here not taking away. He served hot dumplings in this plastic container not on a serving plate. This is the condition of the plastic container, all melted. I believe some of the plastic went in to in our tummy with the food and if we get sick because of this I am coming back to you 💯 we didn't noticed this in the beginning and found this at the end 🤮 I'm soo guilty about having food at this place and angry as well. Cheap service never recommended 😑

Good, but expensive, and the burger filets have recently changed to the point where they are not Oporto burgers. Weird coating totally changes flavour and taste to the point that, while objectively still OK, doesn’t look or taste like true Oporto burgers. Chicken is as good/great, as are chips, but overall very expensive, and not hard for 1 person to spend $35+.

Customer service was good and friendly! Very accomodating. Asked for sauce for fries and was not charged. The jalapeño bites were delicious as well as the fries. Unfortunately the burgers lacked flavour. The lamb burger was not pleasant to eat. Ended up dipping it in tomato sauce for some flavour. Chicken burger also lacked flavour. Was left unsatisfied. Very clean restaurant and toilet located next to coffee club so it is abit of a walk. Good location of the restaurant in the heart of the manukau supa centre.

Customer service was so poor! Her attitude was appalling. Our food reflected her poor customer service 🤢 Portion was tiny for the price. Never coming here again. Do not recommend at all! Overpriced for low value meal.

The matcha was soooo good, and the service was the real treat! Greeted with gorgeous smile, order taken faster than we could decide, and everything was spot on. Can’t ask for more—except maybe another cup! ☺️ Food wasn’t in the photo are; Tiramisu cake and carbonara. The matcha tea was suggested by the lady assisted us, Kay was her name if my memory doesn’t betray me. Hands and mind were well coordinated. Got our order right in a flick of a finger. 😲 Pistachio and Brulee cake fell short with its taste. For sure it can do better. So, will def visit again.

Went to Kreem yesterday (04/09/25). Arrived around 10:20am-10:30am. - Customer service was lacking in customer service. The server at the till seemed distracted and looked flustered. - Food came, received the wrong tea twice but settled on a different tea on the third try. Ordered the Kreem Big Breakfast: toast was under the scrambled eggs which became soggy because of this. Grilled chicken was grilled but marinated in a sauce, wasn’t made aware by the server and it wasn’t specified on the menu. Also ordered the open wrap but it was missing the garlic sauce and they gave a small punnet of tomato relish to compensate instead of the garlic sauce. - Tables weren’t being cleared nor cleaned down fast enough so other customers were having to flag down the only two servers on the floor to clear and clean them down so they had somewhere to sit. Mind you, these two young men that were on the floor were also the only two running drinks and food orders. Have been here a few times before and was always happy with the service and food because it was consistent. Hesitant to return after this overall experience.

The staff were wonderful, and the lady who served us today was incredibly helpful in assisting us with our sushi choices. She recommended the vegetarian sushi, which we were initially hesitant about, but we’re so glad we took her suggestion. It was absolutely delicious, with a fried vegetable pancake or something similar inside that added fantastic flavor. The service here is always excellent, and we highly recommend this place. A big thank you to the lovely lady who served us—she truly made our day!
Took way too long.. Food was oily.. fried rice was burnt.. fish was missing the fish! Had batter but. O fish!!.. Had to throw away potato fritter was overcooked..

Uber eats on a great deal these guys have Buy a kebab($21.50) and get in free and add $5 to make a combo. This meant I got two combos for the price of one. saved on $21.50 I think. I got mixed meat ( chicken and lamb) Delicious for a late night dinner. The contents was fresh and sauce delicious. Chips were hot and fresh and not soft and mushy,the crunch was just right .just take it easy on the salt please, because the sauces in the kebab gives enough flavor 🤗. Mint sauce for the lamb 😋 and 🤔 I think I got garlic yoghurt and sweet chilli which is lovely with both chicken and lamb I reckon. The greens inside were fresh 🥙. You can get a deal also for meat on chips too. Support local guys and get this great deal Beautifully packed ( I moved the napkins) and fresh and hot for Uber eats.

Absolutely terrible Turkish food! The worst chicken on rice I’ve ever had. The meal was bland, my sauce choice garlic yogurt & hummus was missing, very disappointing, and overall it felt like a complete waste of money. Service was just as bad the woman behind the counter was too busy juggling Uber orders to care about customers in store. If this is how they treat first-time visitors, I can’t imagine it getting any better. Save your money and go somewhere else – this place is simply not worth the visit. Honestly shocked it has a 4.4 rating 🤨
I'm Uber driver good service and also good work and also good food.

I recommend this place if your looking for a good burger place I haven’t even ordered yet and I’ve had the man behind the counter show amazing service and kindness can’t wait to try there food - Kind regards Luca

Huge gratitude and respect for the two gentlemen who is always on shift when I visit. They are always polite, calm and composed despite how crazy busy it is. The last time I visited, it was almost 8:30pm and they happily welcomed me. I always receive my order in a timely manner. Portions and quality are definitely worth every cent. Thank you!

Just a word of warning, the portions are enormous! Couldn’t finish the meals. Had to take them home. Portions are priced well. Loved the curly fries. Heaps of tables, no need for reservations but recommended for larger groups.
Dry pizza and not much toppings, it's like they ran out. UPDATE. We ordered this week, September 2025. There was no improvement, one of the pizza smelled funny like ham was off or something.

We recently tried the new menu and were really impressed! I especially enjoyed the new style of chips, as I was never a fan of the thicker finger-cut ones. The updated plating was also a nice touch – it made our meals look and feel extra special. Even though we booked at short notice, we were able to get a table without any hassle. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, with dim lighting that gave a cozy feel. The staff greeted us warmly and provided great service throughout the evening. Our family of six tried a variety of dishes – the house special lamb shank, ribs, prawn main, lamb roast, and burrito with corn chips and avocado dip, along with kids’ meals of burgers, chicken tenders, and hot dogs. Everyone thoroughly enjoyed their meals! We skipped dessert this time as we had a birthday cake waiting at home. The kids were also over the moon to receive free Lonestar shirts – such a fun surprise and a nice touch for us as regulars at the Manukau Lonestar resturant. Thank you for your service.

Loved the chicken madras and the garlic naan. The lamb was tender and pairs well with the roghan josh flavour. The owner/manager was friendly and accommodating. Service was quick, they knew how hungry we looked. And more importantly they are affordable! $18 each with good portions

We had such a wonderful experience here! From the moment we walked in, we were greeted with a warm welcome by Alpana who was genuinely friendly and attentive, as were all other staff we had met. The service was excellent without ever feeling rushed. The food was absolutely delicious – everything tasted so fresh and full of flavor. You can really tell the care that goes into the preparation and presentation. It’s also very family and kid friendly, which made the whole experience even more enjoyable for us. Overall, a fantastic dining experience. We’ll definitely be coming back and highly recommend it to anyone looking for great food, great service, and a welcoming atmosphere!
This Place is Amazing! The Food is Delicious! Definitely would Recommend Coming Here!
Great value and affordable and the food is really good lasagna was on point and the loaded spuds aka loaded fries.. worth 5 stars in my book

I visited on a Wednesday morning and was warmly greeted at the front counter by a lovely team member named Karmen. She welcomed me with a big smile saying “Good morning,” which I really appreciated—especially since I was having a bit of a stressful start to the day. Her friendly attitude genuinely lifted my mood. I ordered a 3-piece Quarter Pack (large) with Hot & Spicy chicken. The service was impressively quick—I was honestly surprised at how fast my meal was ready! I tried the chips first and they were perfectly crunchy and fresh. Before leaving, I said to that girl Karmen have a a great day and walked out feeling much better than when I arrived. Excellent service, tasty food, and a positive experience overall. I’ll definitely be coming back!

I had a great experience at KFC Manukau. The food was tasty, served just the way you’d expect. The restaurant itself was neat and clean, which made the visit even more enjoyable. The staff were really friendly and welcoming, adding a nice touch to the overall service.

I ordered a bucket of spicy chicken and even paid extra to switch from regular to spicy. However, instead of receiving the proper bucket, I was given just a small box (like a quarter pack) with only regular chicken legs. This is misleading and disappointing, especially since I paid more for something I did not receive. Please address this issue, as customers should get exactly what they pay for.

Pizzas we bought was dry and hardly tasted flavours. Looked like Dominoes but expensive. Had previously bought from Milanos from Papatoetoe and that was epic, chunkier chicken and flavour explosion. Manukau branch need to up their game drastically. However staff were friendly and store neat and tidy. Burger was good, like we make at home. Fries were good.

Found cockroaches in the toilets Not real italian pizzas. They put pinapple and mayonnaise in the pizzas, and they don’t have normal pizza like margharita pizza. I should have order curry, it looked better. The servers were very nice. The prices are verry affordable.

Best pizza I’ve ever had! 🍕 The team is amazing, very friendly and welcoming. Service is top-notch – fast, efficient, and with a smile. Highly recommend Milanos Pizza for anyone looking for delicious food and great service🤩

Just got my order thru drive-thru at manukau mcdonalds which I thought their food standards have always been excellent. well my double fillet burger was dry, not fresh at all. Probably if I had asked for extra cheese would they have made it fresh or just slapped on an extra piece of cheese like they did with the fillet-o-fish. Seems like cavendish mcdonalds looks like my go to now since the food here was terrible. NOt to mention fries , no seasoning on them at all. and tasted like they've been in warmer for more then 10 mins. Disgusted customer.

This Maccas is a nice place to sit and catch up with friends. There's a playground inside. There's a small birthday party room. You have to order on screen and the staff call out the order number on the receipt. You can still scan your Maccas app deals.

Given this place a third, fourth, fifth chance trying to find something that's worth buying but it's all rubbish. Doesn't taste fresh and seems like it's all smothered in oil and salt to disguise the flavours. Quality of everything is bottom of the barrel and the prices are relatively high

I’d suggest you check your bill closely had them try and overcharge me and even as I am showing Them their own menu prices they still having a hard time with it Decided to give them another try yet again they screw up I buy crumbed sausages they sell Me bartered sausages that’s a completely different thing
Chinese takeaways. OK pricing. There is no other Chinese options nearby so this has been my local for some years. Food is OK. Sometimes good and sometimes not.
Always guaranteed the best food and service when we come here. The staff are so incredibly kind and accommodating. Highly recommend

I been here for a while I live next to you guys and your food is amazing idk why people are complaining about how "fatty the meat is" I usually order the crispy pork on rice and I don't mind it at all. like brother if you don't like the fat on the pork then go somewhere else. anyways leaving 5 stars cause your food is 🔥
Diorella fish n chips is the yummiest in Auckland. Beautiful fresh fish, slim lined golden crisp chips and very affordable specials. 5/5 star rating. Highly recommend.

22 August 2025 “Bridal Shower” The boss/owner was very hands on and made sure we got the best of everything and had also ensured to make sure our event was within our budget 💸💸💸 The staff were amazing and got every detail right (right down to the table cloths, center pieces and set up of the venue). We could not thank the boss and his staff enough for the amazing night we had. Food came out in time. May I add, all my guests were quite amazed at not only the set up but the food 🤤. Texas Smokehouse exceeded our expectations and did an exceptional job from the beginning to the end of our night 🥰 We will definitely be coming back for more events 😍🤝 Job well done to your staff and yourself for hosting such a grand event. We will be forever grateful as my sister enjoyed her bridal shower.

We are a family visiting in from Sydney. We drove past it earlier in the day and decided we would have dinner here. As we were deciding what to get the kids, my partner and I were still quite full ftom our late lunch and we were opting for the pork bbq skewers (pictured 4 in the menu), we would have 1 each and then the beef rib to share whe we did notice the big sign that kids eat free (conditions apply) We discussed if kids were free then we would get kids their own meals. Order time came, waiter said kids are not free, to which I answered it was fine but was curious to know what the conditions were. Waiter said it’s for an upcoming promo, in my head “like what theF?” I told him, why have it up now when it’s not actually offered. So the original orders of pork bbq was back on. However, 3 skewers only came out. I told the waiter there is supposed to be 4 which he responded, he will get another one only to cone back later to tell me it’s only 3. False advertising much? So i started to rake photos of the kids eat free sign and the bbq pork skewer menu item in plain view of the waiter. We were about to finish up when i was approached by what I assumed was the owner because of how hw spoke to me. The said person asked me if everything is okay and he understands I an not happy (must have been dobbed in by the waiter). So we walked away from our table. I simply told him why have 4 skewers pictured in the menu when you are only giving 3? and the menu depicts 4 and does not explicitly specify number of skewers and one would use the picture as reference if no other information is presented. He offered to have another skewer cooked up to which I reply no to worry as we were fiinishing up. I also brought up the kids eat free confusion, to which he said that they are starting a promo soon and asked when do i expect to have the signs up. He quckly added and asked me “if you want free food, I will give you free food or $12-15 off? WHAT AN INSULT TO A CUSTOMER I told him, thats not what i am after, im merely pointing out confusing adverts, misleading menu items and incompetent staff. (We also had ordering issueS, not discussed). To assume your customer is only after free/discounted food and tell it to their face is another level. I tolld him we were visiting and simply brushed me off and told me lets not argue about this, just enjoy your stay.

​The chicken was delicious, perfectly cooked, crispy on the outside, and incredibly juicy and tender on the inside. You could tell it was fresh and high-quality. ​The staff were also fantastic; they were friendly, welcoming, and served me with a genuine smile. It made the whole experience that much more enjoyable. The prices were very reasonable for the portion sizes and quality of food.

Great variety of cooked food on buffet. Great variety of meat n seafood like prawns n fish to be barbacued on the hot plate while you dine for 2 hours. Affordable to eat all you can. Go n check it out!

Food is authentic and fresh. Great variety especially Rajasthan and Amritsari. Also certain South Indian varieties. Also fresh savories and sweets. Good parking area. Polite and good service. Pure vegetarian. Vegetarians Can visit if you are in Manukau city centre.

I had Rajasthani thali here in the lunch today (i.e. 31 Aug 2025). The thali contained 2 Bazra rotis, Gatte ki sabji, kadhi,one more sabji,rice,salad and one more item(Probably sabudana khichadi). I had Rasmalai also but it was not part of thali.All the items were very tasty. After a long time, I have found an authentic Indian veg restaurant in a foreign country. During my stay in Auckland, I had food at Sarvana Bhavan, Times of India restaurant, 1947 Eateries etc but the food at this restaurant is the best. The price here is the cheapest among all the above restaurants. You will find all sorts of Indian sweets, golgappe, chat etc here. Just too good indian restaurant for vegetarians. You get full value for your money.

Drove past a few times but didn’t get around to eating here until today. Definitely worth it, the veggie burger was delicious with nice crispy onion rings and a good patty. Excellent choice for fellow burger enthusiasts.

The staff, ambience and the food was just superb. We've never tried their desserts so it was quite hard to decide, but the kind lady at the desk took the time to explain each dessert dish and recommended a couple to us to try that was close to what we were looking for. Unfortunately I didn't note down the name of the 2 dessert dishes but 100% highly recommend you try them all lol. Will definitely eat here again. Love Filipino food, beautiful like the people 😍

I had high expectations after looking at photos of the food on Google and the cafe didn’t disappoint. It is a lovely relaxing environment to have brunch and the coffee tasted lovely. I was very pleased that the Chicken Eggs Benedict came was roast chicken instead of fried and the hollandaise sauce was delicious. The whole experience was fantastic and I will definitely be back soon!

I ordered vegetarian fried noodles which super super delicious. My family also enjoyed the foods. This was my 3 time to Uncle Man's never disappointed. Always super good food. Thank you Uncle Man's Manukau teams

Manukau Uncle’s Mans is a real warm comfort! The dadar gulaung was soft, fresh, and perfectly balanced in sweetness. Generous filling is so satisfying. The service was warm and welcoming, and every bite felt like comfort food made with love. Highly recommended!

Had the lamb biryani.... Malaysian style. I really enjoyed it and was surprised to see how different it is to the usual biryani found. This biryani is a large lamb shank served on a bed of well seasoned rice. A must try if your hungry.
Just called in here for a Kai and I have to say it was the most beautiful butter chicken I’ve ever had. Massive serve of Naan as well. Good service! Thank you

Today I called for my dinner at around 8 pm and I also told to him who receive my ordered that i will pick my order at around 8.45 pm I reached here at 8.50 pm when I was going to pick up my order then there are 5 to 6 employee who are gossip with each other and use their mobile phone and laughing alot andr they have no concentration on work when they see me then order was not ready and I received my order after 15 minutes and I ordered Fanta can which is not inside and I asked to him especially to cut the garlic naan into pieces but not did this and food is so salty and customer service was very disgustingThey make more arguments when I want to ask something I will never go there
Quick and easy Indian food that was really good! The staff was super friendly. We got the butter chicken and chick pea with Naan. Would recommend

It made me sad that I ate here. The display food is an up sell and inaccurate compared to what arrived. Didn’t kill us. Soup dumplings and pork was better than the tofu and pork mince. Bins in the eating area. Real basic.

Rude or no customer service at all, ordered meal and wait for 20mins, but nothing happened, so went and ask about it, but seems like no one knew anything about my order... Wait for another 10mins and finally ready... No communication at all... YOU WON'T SEE MY MONEY AGAIN..
Had the runs after eating at the stall set up at the African Bizarre in Ham on Saturday 13th Sept. It was a popup according to my eftpos record. The main office/house is in Auckland

Came in for lunch on a weekday, a relatively quiet period. The setting was nice enough, and there was plenty of room inside and out. The food - dumplings - was average; not bad, but certainly nothing to tell any more stories than this about. It also came with just a fork, which is not a big deal in a country pub but still rubbed me the wrong way. Friendly service though.
Fish was fresh, batter crispy, and chips perfectly cooked. A bit too oily though. Friendly service and generous portions made it even better. Great spot to grab lunch after exploring the area.

We tried the fish and chips here, the snapper was cooked beautifully and so were the oysters and scallops. Fresh and delicious. The oysters and scallops were small and so was the portion of chips. The milkshakes were creamy and thick and the real fruit ice cream was one of the best we have tried.

One of the best fish and Chips dine in or take away joint in the South. The service was quick, their portions and price are apt. Though we ordered for 7 people, it was served on plates- good presentation.
Used to be awesome Chinese food with good servings, last 3 times it's got worse and more expensive. No more after tonight, soggy chips, hard chewy fish and small helping

Dropped in for a quick bite to eat. Awesome service, attentive & friendly staff, yum food and a great range of beers. Atmosphere was relaxed and welcoming with a DJ playing easy-listening music on a Sat afternoon. We could've stayed for ages if the rest of our day wasn't so busy. We'll be back again soon!

The food was excellent — especially the vegetarian burger, which was absolutely delicious. The only downside was the coffee — it was way too hot and served in a paper cup, which burned my tongue a little when I took a sip. Also, I think there was a little mistake when we ordered — we were charged for an extra coffee. 😅

We had dinner one evening here at about 7PM. The place was busy, so service was a little disorganized (and not too friendly...), but we got our order in about 15 minutes. The restaurant is a counter order carry-out style place adjacent to the southern parking area for Piha Beach with some limited covered and uncovered outdoor seating. There is not really a view of the beach from the sitting area. You place your order at the main building counter, and then pick up your fries, fried food, drinks or ice cream at that counter. The rest of your order (tacos, burritos, etc) are picked up at a second counter further back. I did not like it that our order was separated like that. Our fish tacos were ready first, (they forgot the guacamole that I asked for on them...) and they were cold by the time our fries were ready. The fish tacos were fairly good, but small. (Especially for the price of $8 each). The fries were crispy and very good. Overall, this is a convenient and nice little place next to the beach to get carry out and the food is fairly good, but it does seem significantly overpriced (especially for the small portions) To give you a reference, our order was 4 fish tacos, a large fries, and one ice cream cone - (no drinks!)- and it cost almost $50! So, I doubt that we will be motivated to return anytime soon or very often in the future. On one positive note- they do accept credit cards, debit cards, and Paywave transactions

Came to Piha beach and decided to get some food. Popped into the PihaBowling Club. Ordered the fried chicken burger. It was the bomb. Portion and price was on point given the location. Definitely worth driving down there just for that and to enjoy the views. Great location to enjoy a beer and burger.
Great hidden spot with very nice vibe. The cold press juice was the best thing I drank this year 😁. Extremely welcoming staff. I love how small the menu is so you know everything is fresh as it gets!

They have two operator machines for the checkout, only one person taking orders, they need two people on the speakers. Then we waited 20 minutes for a happy meal and had to park up. And when the lady came to hand it over she said “really” and sighed at me. If these people hate their jobs they should quit and not take it out on the customers.

Occasionally get the wrong order, and for a mother of 2 autistic children this is a worse case scenario. It's easy to say come back and get the right order but once my kids can't eat at their routined time it's the end of the world in my home. There's no point picking up the right order. It pays to double check.

Today's order Pizza's were not hot. Look like it was cooked long time ago Garlic bread was not cooked properly, even the butter was not melted inside. Last week order In Last week order we found hair inside the Pizza photo attached
Great mess. I had a huge problem in receiving order. I had to ask multiple times and finally received a box that was lying on the shelf for many minutes.

As a Bar/Restaurant Manager myself, I can’t help but point out that this place needs a lot of work. The drinks menu is very limited for the prices being charged, and if you’re going to price your spirits high, at least pour a proper 45ml into the mixes. On top of that, my wife found the toilets in a very unpleasant, dirty state — clearly not being checked or cleaned regularly. Lastly, to Eekay — please stop asking customers for reviews every time they order at the bar. If you want good reviews, focus on creating a good customer experience. The constant reminders came across as pushy and annoying, especially when the basics weren’t being delivered. Overall, very disappointed.

We recently used the Hunter Inn garden bar/function area to host a farewell party. The space itself was lovely — airy, comfortable, and the outdoor feel made it great for those who vape or smoke. The presentation of the food was below standard — bar snacks are usually plated nicely, but here it felt careless. More concerning, the chicken we ordered was undercooked and raw in several pieces, which made it completely inedible and unsafe. The drinks service was also disappointing. Their selection of RTDs, wine, and spirits was limited, and drinks were oddly served on dining plates rather than trays. Although there was a bar booth in the private area, it wasn’t in use, so we had to keep going back to the main bar to order. Even then, drinks were repeatedly given to the wrong tables, causing confusion. On top of that, it would be appreciated if staff could relax on repeatedly asking for reviews while we were just trying to buy drinks — it came across as pushy and took away from the experience. Overall, while the venue itself is a nice spot, the food and service need serious improvement before I’d consider hosting another function here.

My partner and I really loved the taste and food. The service was the best and fast. I totally recommend this food stall. We'll be back again. 😋💯

“Hidden Gem “. Best indian restaurant out of all i have visited. Pure Vegetarian. Amazing food Super cheap. Value for money. Must try Aloo tikki chat,Noodles Paratha and chole kulche. Must Visit. Wasnt busy at all when i visited. But can get busy sometimes with a table waiting of 10-15 minutes.

Love their Samosas,Excellent Customer service by Sardar jii..

Absolutely recommend, when you have tried authentic yellow and green curry in Thailand, you have high expectations. These curry are authentic as it's gets. The staff are lovely and the atmosphere is relaxed and peaceful. Loved it! We grabbed two meals and soft drinks.total came to $53. Very much in line with tye quality of food, service and atmosphere.
A family friendly Thai restaurant with delicious food at a resealable cost. Staffs were nice and friendly. Dining atmosphere and environment were comfortable and relaxing.
Amazing food and great service. Love their green curry, and sizzling seafood, finish with mango sticky rice dessert. Love our time at Spices Thai. Joc

Just hosted an event for 100 people at the restaurant and had a great evening with immaculate service. Thank you Dilraj for your patience and knowledge in helping us sort out this event. The food was great as usual!

Thank you, thank you, thank you for making our stop in coffee such a pleasurable experience. Coffee for our group and a slice of chocolate cake for my son's 31st birthday. I asked if they had a candle and they accommodated our request with such ease. You were so great. Thank you.

I dined here recently with my sister. I had the Fish Roe Stew, while she went for the chips and fried shrimp. I found my dish quite delicious, though my sister thought hers was a bit too salty, as she's used to low-sodium meals. Overall, it was a pleasant dining experience. The staff were welcoming and attentive, which added to the atmosphere. Prices are slightly higher than other spots in the area, but the quality of the food makes it worthwhile.
We came here for dinner and enjoyed it. The staff were friendly and always smiling, which made us feel comfortable. The food was good and the atmosphere felt cosy.

Looks like under new management so there was different staffs and it looked to me they were strictly told not to even put anything extra in terms of quantity they even put good amount of sauce. I had to ask them please add more. Even the greens the staffs didn't wanna add. Quantity was reduced. I go here very often as I leave near by so I so pick up the difference.
The pizza tasted fine, but the toppings and cheese were very less this time. The base felt too plain and dry. Quite disappointing compared to usual domino’s standards.

Very disappointed to domino pizza today… i alway order garlic bread for my son every single time i order pizza And this is the first time that received old garlic bread like that.. and end up my son couldn't eat it and start crying because the garlic bread is very hard and garlic also his favourite as well. When i called them up to make a complaint they told me it should be the frozen garlic bread and then they put in oven .. and come out like that.. .. i said i order garlic bread all the time i know how it look like and how the old garlic bread and new garlic bread look like.

I always come to this Domino’s branch because the pizzas are consistently excellent. They never overload the cheese—it’s always the perfect amount—and the toppings are fresh and well-balanced every time. The quality is reliable, and I really appreciate the effort. Thank you to the team for doing such an excellent job!
There was some kind of strange piece in sausage pizza, my husband found it while he was eating. The food safety and hygiene is very low on domino's. Even our kids were eating. Never ordering again.

My family and I love this place! We normally get the Full island plate and can share it between 2 of us. The reviews are surprisingly different but we love this place. When we feel like splurging this is where we go!

I had the dosa at this restaurant and it was absolutely delicious! Perfectly crispy, with just the right amount of softness inside. And counter staff lady I don’t know the name but she is really good and so professional and best staff
Yesterday I bought Desi Style Chicken and honestly, the taste was terrible. The food was really disgusting, and after eating it I even had stomach pain. I would never recommend this place to anyone.

The value for money here is unreal, two curries, rice and a massive garlic naan for $34 will feed me and my wife for two days. I have lived in the area for 18 months, can't believe we just found this place.
Very freindly staff and awesome food, loved there tandoori chicken and garlic naan, 100% Recommend.
So peaceful and relaxing. The shop has a variety of Chinese food and things. The sculptures are amazing, and the volunteers are so nice and helpful.

I've been around to a few McDonalds, and everytime I visit the Ormiston store I am not disappointed. Food and drink standard has been consistently great. Servers were also courteous almost every visit

This place screams new ownership I've been coming here since it opened and the standards have recently definitely dropped, less ingredients (chicken non existent in burger) Prices up, 50c if you want tomato sauce for your chips when you've already paid $20.50 for a small combo, Ok? Used to be beautiful oven baked fillets in the chicken burger which were filling each time. 2x now and it's been the same both times, save your money and go elsewhere.
Best Flame Restaurant in Auckland. We travel 12km each time and bypass local branches as this store has the best tasting Pizzas and Best service.

Had to say, so far the most unpleasant, disgusting pizza I've came across, I lost my appetite just by looking at it, soaky, the chicken is like mashed and dry not sure if that was chicken or something else yuk!, it went straight to the bin. The Dawson rd Select Pizza must be shut down for health issues, period. 🤢🤮🥵🤧😡😡😡🤬🤬

I’m so glad not many people know about this place, the Pablo burger was freaking delicious especially the crunchy melted mushroom cheese mixed with the juicy Angus beef, bacon.and fresh salad. The fries were coated with crunchiness and the Biscoff banoffee milkshake wasn’t a shake it was an amazing thick liquid dessert. Fantastic service by Eddie and the team.

Went on a Sunday night. Place was busy and the service was slow. The waitress gave us a bottle of water, but forgot the glass. We had to get it ourselves and gave some to the people next to us too, since they were not given any cups yet. The noise level was ok, but all of a sudden the employees were VERY LOUD. They were yelling at each other, maybe a banter. However, I was off by it. Nothing wrong with having a yarn or banter, but make sure it’s not loud enough to disturb the customers. The menu is very typical, nothing special, just another Filipino restaurant. You get enough serving for the price you pay. We ordered the adobo rice and tapsilog. The adobo was soft and has a distinct vinegar flavour, the rice is soft and seasoned with soy. It was ok and nothing really. The tapsilog comes with garlic rice, which was not very garlicky. I wish it had more of the garlic taste to match with the tapa. The beef was nicely seasoned! I am not too sure if I would go back here, I reckon there are better Filipino restaurants out there.

I recently visited chicking ormiston and was pleasantly surprised by the quality of the food and service. The chicken was crispy on the outside, juicy on the inside, and seasoned just right. I tried the tandoori bites and spicy chicken and both were packed with flavor. The service was quick and friendly, and the place was clean with a relaxed vibe. Highly recommended for anyone craving good fried chicken without breaking the bank.

Been coming here for a while and the food was great from the start but the two orders I made today, the burgers were cold,only thing hot were the chips..not the first time this happened two orders previously that burger was also cold. My previous order the burgers were hot..so there's abit of inconsistency there and for that it's my last time coming here

Stumbled across this place when visiting east Tamaki on a weekday. Staff were extremely friendly and accommodating. We had the lemongrass pork, chicken pho and duck with fried rice. The duck was a bit dry and salty but the other dishes were well balanced. The dining space was large and comfortable.

**sept '25 update Ordered the kfri chicken, rice. The bibimbap could've been it. Happy w Portion size, disappointed that I had to cook my own egg.. considering I paid $6 extra to get the beef bulgogi. I tip my hat off to the chef. The 3 dishes ordered paired remarkably with each plate. The dishes were presented beautifully. Highly recommend making a booking ahead during the lunch rush hour. The ambience was perfect. Noise level was good. Highly recommended

The food at Kao Hom Thai Kitchen was outstanding, fresh, and full of flavour. Every dish tasted delicious. My favorite would be the SomTum soo good. The service was good with staff who were genuinely friendly, kind, and willing to take constructive feedback. Just one small suggestion would to be have tissue available on table The atmosphere.., I enjoyed the music in the background and the beautifully designed interior that looked modern. For a resturant that just recently opened, they are already doing an amazing job. Overall, it’s a place I’d happily return to and recommend to anyone craving great Thai food. 👍🏼🇹🇭✨️😊

My overall experience was really good. We had three dishes: raw prawn salad, pad Thai, and nam tok. Everything was delicious, and it reminded us of our trip to Thailand last year. The food was fresh and lovely. I’ll 100% be coming back!
Authentic Thai foods in Auckland! We visited on Grand Opening day. Their signature dish, Fish crispy garlic, is crispy and genuine. Delightful Papaya Salad set, Flavourful Pad Thai also excellent.

I was excited to see a new Thai restaurant in the area and wanted to support the local, especially after hearing they had Khao Mun Khai (one of my favorite dishes that I usually have to drive into the CBD for it). The place looks modern and nice, but unfortunately the service was poor and not very organized. A staff member brought us to the table but left without giving menus or water, and went to take another table’s order instead, leaving us waiting until another staff noticed and brought the menus without informing us anything about the menu. To my disappointment, the Khao Mun Khai was already unavailable at 6:10 pm. We ordered fried rice and pad see ew noodle instead. The fried rice was plain and more onto sweet side, while the pad see ew tasted okay but nothing special. No one checked up on us or refilled water(my cup was dried), and even when paying, there wasn’t a thank you. Overall, service felt disorganized and food was average. It’s just another average Thai restaurant. I hope the team takes this feedback on board and improves.

I’ve always been a loyal customer and really enjoyed this place, but recently something seems to have changed the food just doesn’t taste as good as it used to. I hope it can get back to the quality I’ve come to love.

I had a lovely dinner, the food was fresh and delicious.The tempura prawns were excellent, and the teriyaki salmon bento box was delicious with a nice variety of sides. The service was warm and friendly. I definitely recommend it

This used to be my favorite, now it's a rip off. $25 for tasteless garlic veg, see photo. Hair or eyelash in the homemade tofu. It's happened before but one mistake is ok. Now it's twice. Very offputting.
Thanks for good service and polite behaviour for Maninder kaur

Visited this restaurant first time with my family and tried the noodles. Unfortunately, the quality was very disappointing — the noodles had a strong unpleasant smell.
