Delicious food! Maybe its newly open but definitely room for improvement on customer service side, need more floor staff to begin with. Will be back in future.
The lamb is super tender and the garlic sauce is absolutely an unforgettable delight - smooth as cream.
Good customer service. Good venue for small gatherings.

Of all the Indian eateries in Auckland where we have been, this place had the best quality of Paneer Tikka. The taste of the food and its quality was overall very nice. My children liked it and so did my wife. Made my day.

I had such a great experience at Melt Soul Food! The food was absolutely delicious, full of flavor, and cooked to perfection. The service was warm, friendly, and made us feel right at home. The atmosphere was cozy and welcoming, the perfect vibe to enjoy a meal with friends or family. Definitely a spot I’d recommend and one I’ll be coming back to!
Everything was fantastic! Great atmosphere good foods and wonderful customer service. Thanks my kitchen in Auckland!!! Until next time!

Ordered the pork roll and the chicken and chips combo. Had it takeaway, Enjoyed my meal and roll was flavourful. A lot of mixed reviews in here but my personal experience it was algood 👍🏽 Like the saying goes don’t knock it before you try.

Amazing service at Dosa Plaza Today I visit around 4pm with my family The Nepali staff was kind, and professional. They made great food and we felt welcome throughout. Their warm hospitality made the experience even better. Highly recommend visiting for both food and service

Cheese and baked beans on a spud = perfection every time! One amazing guy running the truck, super friendly and efficient. Haven’t tried the tacos and nachos yet, but for now, it’s the spuds that keep me coming back. Hungry? I know a spot! 🤪

If you love baked spuds, you'll love this business SpudFull. Been waiting for an NZ version of UK's SpudMan. Plenty of toppings available to customize your meals. Baked Potatoes, Nachos and Tacos. Tried the Baked Spud with pretty much all the toppings. Was delicious and will be returning. Lovely owner, full of energy and pride in his business. Show some love to local business owners. Heard a rumour that corned beef may be added to the menu as a topping. Fingers crossed Great portions. Great food. Great business. Highly recommend to all Pictures loading....

Had an amazing experience at Spudfull; their customer service and engagement were top-notch. I would definitely recommend their food. Shout out to Spudfull for taking care of us as customers and for sharing this experience. Wishing you all the best!

Absolutely 👍🏻 🥔 spud! Tried creamy chicken and chilli beef con carne! Both were so good, can’t choose either one. Depends on the mood of the 😛 Another thing to mention, MUST go with crispy onion topping with the creamy mushroom; give extra crunch when you bite.

Best Spuds, perfect for a cold night. My partner and I have passed many times and finally decided to stop in for dinner. Thank you for the great food. Everyone loved it. We ordered 2x big trays, fish, chips on tuesday evening for our birthday function.

Ever since the change of ownership, their food has gone below standards. greasy and tasteless, like they havent changed their oil. We ordered $5 chips, which looked like $2 worth of oily chips. Dont waste your time and money here.
I tried the creamy, steake & paua burger + chips combo. It was really flavourful and deliciously creamy. Please try it, you won't regret it 👍

I would not even give one star. I order vegetarian dynamite roll with 2 extra soy sauce and a veg dumpling which is cold as hell and chewy with another extra soy sauce . No i have order before my extra sauce comes on the side in small packets. This is disgusting and waste of money . Not recommended botany bruce li sushi.
Great place for lunch. Food is excellent and good value for money
Worker called sandy terrible service hung up twice on the phone when trying to fix an order

Very disappointing customer service – I would give zero stars if possible. When I arrived with my four-year-old, we had to stand at the counter waiting for someone to even notice us, as all the staff were inside the kitchen. Eventually, one person came out, but while I was in the middle of placing an order for sweets, he put down two items and then stopped to answer the phone. I was left waiting and watching as he continued his call, touching his arms with the same gloves he was using for food, wiping surfaces, and even wiping the glass counter – all while still on the phone. It was clear he intended to use those same gloves to serve me, which was unhygienic and unprofessional. After waiting far too long with no acknowledgement, I lost patience and walked out. This experience reflects very poorly on their customer service and food handling standards.
Customers compare what they pay to what they receive. Overpricing, or feeling that prices have risen without improved service or quality, causes dissatisfaction.

“I had channa bhatura here and it was absolutely delicious – fresh and authentic in taste. The customer service was excellent, the staff were friendly and welcoming. Overall, a wonderful experience and I would definitely come back again.”

If you're craving a taste of Hong Kong, look no further! This cafe nails the authentic experience. The steam rice rolls were perfectly executed, the milk tea rich and creamy, and the lemon coke exactly as I remember it from my trips to Hong Kong. Beyond the food, the staff were incredibly friendly and welcoming, the menu offered a great variety, and parking was a breeze. All this at reasonable prices – highly recommended!

I had a very disappointing experience today when I came to this place with my family. I ordered at 6:50pm and i got served at 7:20pm. The wait would have been worth if the food was served properly. My son have to eat in the plastic container's lid as we only ordered two portions. Shame....

Just placed an order online to pick up for karahi chicken. So disappointed with the quantity of food we got for $21. Was looking forward to our dinner and this was just so sad. Not even enough for one person. Won't be returning.
Popped in to get pizza and was pleasantly surprised by how good pizza was. We got double cheese set and kids enjoyed a lot.

The bestest restaurant I have ever come across in NZ!! What an awesome customer service!! Cleanliness and the soo soo authentic food!! The taste of food just takes away my heart!! Highly highly recommended!!

Came here for my birthday dinner and really enjoyed my meals. The beef scotch filler cooked to my perfection, lamb shank falling off the bone & in the garlic prawns so Devine! Overall everything was amazing will defs be coming back! My daughter loved her chocolate milk shake & I enjoyed the Nutella freak shake. Thanks for the efficient service team
The staff is really nice and the food is pretty good too! If you take your gym tag or student ID in on a weekday they have some good deals. Looks like I’ll be coming back for my post workout feed!

Love you guys! I’ve been here so many times I think I am now a burrito. Always fresh, made quick, and the staff are super friendly. Better than some of the fancy sit down Mexican restaurants in the city. Probably see you guys next week 😂 🌮 🥑 🧀

This is my first time ordering from Pizza Boys for an office lunch. I will definitely be their regular customer. It's not halal, so I didn't eat any pizzas, but all my co-workers were so impressed. recieved really good feedback. Thank you, Pizza Boys. keep up the good work. And on time delivery was just superb!

Better Burger is basically burger paradise. 🍔✨ Fresh food, and buns are so soft, and sauces that deserve their own fan club. The fries? Crispy little golden legends. Staff are super friendly. you walk in a customer and leave feeling like a VIP. The place is spotless too, like they hired ninjas to keep it clean. 🧼⚡ Honestly, if you’re still reading the reviews instead of ordering, just order it. Now. Thank me later. 😋

This Better Burger is absolutely worth the 5 stars! The food is always fresh and tasty — you can really tell nothing is frozen. The sauces are delicious and take the burgers to the next level. The staff are super friendly and welcoming, and the place is kept really clean, which makes the whole experience even better. Definitely my go-to spot when I’m craving a great burger!

Lots of seating inside and outside, service was great. I would recommend eating food straight away as the fries get soggy and cold quickly but the burgers are amazing and they have refills on drinks. Great job Better
Really enjoyed our breakfast here, the eggs bene with fried chicken is definitely worth it. Service was fast and kind. Would definitely come back. The coffee was nice too, really good presentation.

Love Journal Cafe, best of my favourite around in East Auckland. Always have the best coffees. Great food selections and they never miss with the taste. Super friendly staff, overall very nice place to either grab a coffee or breakfast.
The hot dog at this place are absolutely delicious — crispy and perfectly topped! The staff are friendly and welcoming, which made the whole experience even better. Highly recommended!
Friendly staff with great service attitude. The hotdog was tasty and came in generous portions – definitely worth it!

Nice food,love the lemongrass chicken salad,especially they have no sprouts in it,that’s really good to me ,cause don’t like the raw sprouts test .Worth for the price Will definitely come back again for some more.

I tried it for the first time today, and it was really good. What I ordered was a Chicken cup - Hot spicy. It was a really reallllly delicious spicy taste. It was so delicious that I ate it up in an instant. Of course I'm willing to go there again and eat chicken next time. Next time, I will try all kinds of flavors. I'm looking forward to the other flavours. 😋

Moo Moo Smokegrill definitely lives up to its name — you can literally taste the smoky flavour in the meat, which was rich, delicious, and clearly cooked with care. The food was the highlight of the experience: flavourful, served in generous portions, and arrived promptly since it wasn’t a busy time. The ambience was great too — relaxed, inviting, and perfect for enjoying a good meal. However, a couple of things did bring the experience down. The drinks were underwhelming and didn’t quite match the quality of the food. More noticeably, the service was disappointing. Although the waitress was polite in speech, she came across as grumpy and unapproachable. We had to make multiple attempts to get her attention — and being ignored when the place wasn’t even busy was frustrating. Overall, Moo Moo Smokegrill offers excellent food and a great atmosphere, but the service and drinks need some improvement to make the experience consistently enjoyable.
Ordered a salmon sushi, when I closely look at it, avocado look like not the fresh one. And it is expensive tbh. I rather go st pierre's Cheap Price and value

Great portion size and older lady serving was very nice. Food tasted very good and couldn't even finish it in one sitting. The only downside is that I had to wait a little bit, but it was worth it. Thanks team!

I love Katsubi but this has to be the worst branch. Customer service is terrible. The food options is absolutely RUBBISH. No katsu chicken no broccoli no bean sprouts they hardly have anything and yet still want you to pay full price! This place branch in particular is the worst. Manukau is way better has more options.

We went for lunch at Bollywood Indian Restaurant and absolutely loved the experience. The food was fresh, flavorful, and delicious — every dish was cooked perfectly. For drinks, we tried the Faloodah, which was refreshing and tasty. To our surprise, they served us complimentary sweets — rasgullahs that were simply mouthwatering! The staff were very welcoming, friendly, and attentive, which made the experience even better. The atmosphere was warm and inviting, perfect for a relaxing meal. Highly recommend this place if you’re looking for authentic Indian flavors with great service.

I had an amazing dinner. The food was not only tasty but also creatively presented, adding to the overall experience of the place. The ambiance was delightful, and the service was exceptional. I highly recommend this restaurant for anyone looking for a unique and enjoyable dining experience in Auckland . Can't wait to visit again!

Sautéed pork and egg with chili is yummy. Great texture and lot of flavor. Steam pork belly is too thin, but the bun comes with the pork is good. Overall excellent value as they are doing special promotions in the month.
The worst customer service I have ever experienced. 100% will never support this business again.
Great atmosphere in and around the temple. Food is tasty and comes out super quick.

We ordered a variety of dishes from Sweet and Sour Chicken, Combination Egg Gravy with Rice Noodles, Salted Fish and Chicken Eggplant, Crispy Pork Chop with Garlic, Crispy Tofu in Sweet Chilli Sauce and Deep Fried Maggi Fish Fillet. The portions are big and good value. The food came out fast and was delicious
I’ve been coming here for meals for several years. For a Chinese restaurant, it’s impressively clean. The portions seem to have gotten a bit smaller, but every dish I’ve tried has been delicious
The food is awesome, but it's a little pricey, and it gets noisy in there since it's a small place.
The pizza is delicious and the people are very kind with customers, and always on time. They don’t make mistakes with making pizza as well. Overall the food is 10/10
Absolutely delicious, wholesome and fulfilling. Took the recommendation of the miso tofu udon, don’t think I’ve ever had anything like it but boy will I be back for more!
So crispy and juicy😄 i will come again
katsu was crispy even after hours and tastes good! gozen set was a really great meal
very nice

We chose the Waitakere Resort for the venue of our daughter and son in-laws wedding high tea. The staff were easy to communicate with and made planning very easy. On the day our guests were wowed by the scenery, views and how secluded and private the resort was, as they arrived. The staff greeted us warmly and made the whole event easy. The tūī room was light and warm with magnificent views over the ranges and out to the city. The serving staff were friendly, efficient and super helpful without being intrusive. The high tea was delicious. There was something for everyone and the special dietary requirements were catered to beautifully without fuss. The bride and groom thoroughly enjoyed the event and enjoyed their stay there that night. Some of our guests also stayed at the hotel and all had positive feedback about their rooms and the service they received. Now that we have seen the resort for ourselves I am keen to stay the night sometime too!

Hidden gem in Waitākere! Our stay was absolutely wonderful. The room had a rustic, old-school charm that made it feel cozy and unique. The facilities were top-notch, and the spa service was simply amazing, the crew went above and beyond to make the experience relaxing. The manager, reception, and restaurant staff were incredibly warm and welcoming, delivering outstanding service with genuine smiles. Dinner was delicious and beautifully prepared (though the portion size could be a little more generous). Breakfast, on the other hand, was absolutely spot-on: fresh, hearty, and truly delicious. All in all, a perfect stay in every way. We can’t wait to return!

The hotel is starting to look it's age with some wear and tear on the rooms. This is more than made for by the amazing view and service provided by the staff. The beds are comfortable and the premiere room is massive. We had an amazing time taking a break from the city for a few nights. The restaurant, as noted in other reviews, is a little slow - but the food is amazing and worth the wait. The fire was lit and warm and welcoming for our arrival and my partner loved his spa treatments

I tried the winter package, which includes a three-course dinner, continental breakfast, and a one-night stay. Here’s a quick breakdown: 🍽️ Food Taste: 4/5 Food was alright, options are very limited 🍟 Food Quantity: 2/5 Portions were very small, and the dinner was noticeably low in carbs, which made it feel incomplete and left us hungry. Definitely order extra sides—fries helped! 🛏️ Room: 5/5 The room was clean, comfortable, and had a stunning view that really elevated the experience. While the body wash packaging was a bit awkward (think ketchup sachet), everything else felt well-kept and pleasant. 🥐 Breakfast: 3/5 Limited selection in the open buffet, the pastries were tasty, 👥 Staff: 4/5 Very nice and kind especially the restaurant staff. Special thanks to the receptionist who made an extra effort to speak slowly and clearly—as if we didn’t speak English 😅. We found it funny and appreciated the kindness, though it might come across differently to others. For the record, we do speak English—just maybe don’t look like it! 🌄 Overall Experience: The remote location is a highlight—peaceful, scenic, and full of fresh air. The hotel style leans old-fashioned. The mulled wine was delicious.

Lovely high tea and amazing staff! The high tea was beautifully presented, with delicious treats and a great selection of teas. The staff were warm and attentive Jibin and April were especially amazing and made the whole experience extra special. Highly recommend!
Very nice vibe and beautiful views of Waitakere ranges, delicious food + warm & hospitable staff!
Went for a high tea with my girls. April was our server, she took good care of us and ensured that our needs are met. Jibin also welcomed us warmly. Overall we had an amazing time!

We came across this restaurant’s poster while visiting the Arataki Visitor Centre and decided to give it a try. The place has a cozy charm, and the servers are warm and welcoming. We opted for the three-course set lunch. The grilled prawns were plump and juicy, pairing perfectly with the aioli. The beef moussaka was hearty and satisfying, while the baklava’s sweetness was spot on. Overall, the dishes were delicious, well-balanced, and offered great value for money.
They were awesome as always, second time coming here and I can’t wait to come here again! Awesome team and awesome food
best burgers I’ve had in a long time

Pizzas are good quality, not stingy on the ingredients and plenty of options. The salads here are nice and fresh too and a decent portion. Pizzas and sides were made quickly too so not a long wait. Thanks team!
Best turkish food in Auckland, if not the country I would say. The lamb in particular is succulent. The cocktails were amazing too. Highly recommend!!

Excellent quality Chinese Food. Really superior quality with plenty of fresh meat and vegetables. Very generous with the cashew nuts and other bits that most other competitors are skint on. I've ordered a family sized meal a number of times and my family has always been overjoyed with the quality, taste and generosity provided in each dish. The price is also lower than my old usual. I used to frequent a competitor for over 20 years but Golden Bridge has won me over and now they are my favourite! Also, they make food very quickly and service is polite and easy to communicate with. They have a very efficient and hard working team. P.S the pineapple fritters are perfect. Beautiful batter, well fried and dusted with cinnamon sugar! Perfection 😁
Best takeaway in the area. Highly recommend their Sweet and sour pork

Amazing cafe and the customer service made my day!! Very friendly and good vibes, me and my partner we're latinos and they put Spanish music for us, nice chat, there are details that we really appreciated, i definitely will come back✨
The food was very yummy. Good price too. The waiter was lovely, businesslike and friendly. An A plus experience all round. We were there late morning 29/08/25
Delicious pizza! However, gosh the base was so thin :( I couldn’t even pick up a slice without everything slipping off.

Kids menu and cute activity packs that kept them well occupied. Staff were extremely friendly and welcoming, they went out of their way with our kids. We had such a lovely meal and experience. Extra bonus points for food that came quickly and baby changing facilities. If they had a play area for the kids it would be the dream cafe.

Deco Eatery is an absolute gem! From the moment I walked in, the warm and inviting atmosphere made me feel right at home. The decor is stylish yet comfortable, creating a perfect backdrop for a relaxing meal. The menu is diverse, with a fantastic selection of dishes that cater to various tastes. I tried their signature brunch options, and they were delicious! The flavors were vibrant, and everything was beautifully presented. The staff was friendly and attentive, making sure my dining experience was top-notch. Overall, Deco Eatery exceeded my expectations. I can't wait to go back and try more of their amazing offerings! Highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great meal in a lovely setting.
Great Kiwi Asian Takeaway. Beautiful service and amazing crispy chips.

Never had a problem here. Good food. Excellent service. It is clean, neat and tidy. Looking for decent takeaways? Then this is the place to go. Huge variety of food, black bean vegetables are delicious and I highly reccommend.
Best brunch I’ve had in a while. Super delicious and lovely service.

The staff are iTi are fantastic. I booked the Bottomless Brunch on Father's Day so we could cheers our Dad's that are no longer with us. I tried the Southern Fried Chicken Tacos this time & they were soooo good. Other dishes ordered were Bacon Benedict, BBQ Bacon Beef Burger & Fish Burger. Everyone enjoyed their meals. The Bottomless Brunch is great value for $55.00 per person. The atmosphere is great with the lights & the view from the covered deck area. Definitely recommend.
Really friendly and great chicken!

Eaten here once when visiting friends, and a couple of times we've gotten takeaways. Each time has been excellent, and with several vegetarians and a vegan in the group, there's enough variety for everyone to have at least a few options. Very friendly staff who took the time to double check that they had everything in a pretty complex order correct each time.

Some of the best Indian food I’ve had in such a long time! The service, the food, the quality, everything, just fantastic, and very well priced! I’ve slept on this place whilst living in titirangi, I’m going to have to make this a weekly meal!

"Absolutely delicious food at a very reasonable price! I was pleasantly surprised to receive free papad, and with every curry they served a fresh green salad – such a nice touch. The flavours were authentic, portions generous, and the service warm and welcoming. Great value for money – I’ll definitely be coming back!"

Loads of delicious fresh felafels on salad and a lamb kebab. Well presented and cooked with care. Great service - attentive with cleaning the outdoor table we sat at which nature had blown some tree bits on. I loved our experience and will return soon for more off the huge menu.

I love the mixed lamb falafel wrap and would like to be able to get that on rice as well. Although the rice dishes can be a bit small. They are friendly but I would like them to learn how to wrap a wrap better so that is easier to eat on the go. At the moment everything spills out.
I have taken out once and eaten in once. Both times the food was excellent. Tonight I had a burger and it was really good and not to expensive. The two guys who work there are really nice guys.

Absolutely disgusting 🫣 food stone cold wrong burger given over priced. Stale tiny buns. I ordered this ORIGINAL DOUBLE - COMBO $35.90 Double Grass Fed Beef Patties, NZ Cheddar, Fresh Onion, Iceberg, Tomato and Jo Bro’s Original™ with Shoestring Fries and Karma Soda And got this BASIC SINGLE - COMBO $26.49 Grass Fed Beef Patty, NZ Cheddar, Fresh Onion and Jo Bro’s Original™ with Shoestring Fries and Karma Soda Avoid at all cost don't waste you're time or money.

Very disappointed with food today ; used to love this place but the burgers today were trash compared to what they used to be - very rare and I felt I couldn’t approach the man working as he barely interacted during the pick up process and had his headphones on the entire time . My partner had a good go at them as they’re grotesquely expensive

Ordered off uber eats. The Mrs burger was good. My fried chicken burger with mango habernero sauce was complete rubbish. Skinnier than schnitzel and smaller than the bun and about a cup of sauce. Her chips were also half decent, mine had no salt and were stone cold. Will never try you guys again

First time eating here, the food was very tasty and quite affordable however several hours later I've got food poisoning from the sweet and sour pork. I know it was the pork because my partner didn't have any and she is fine. Won't be going back again..

Their smorgasbord every Thurs, Fri and sat is what we love. A small try is $30+ and a big tray is $50+. The small tray happily feeds my fams of 3 ladies and a baby but with my son I have to buy the big tray. If you fully load it up you'll be good.

Not many places Around that still make spring rolls and curry rolls from scratch.. they’re too good! Spring and curry rolls 5/5 - these are gold. Snapper crumbed 5/5 ( they do great crumbed fish crumb is is really good) Wonton soup 5/5( wontons are delicious! The soup might not be that flavourful but the wontons in the soup are just perfect) Fried Rice 5/5 ( chicken is good, the steak is good and the combination specials are good too) Chow mein 5/5 ( all combinations are good, whether chicken or mixed) Sweet and sour pork 5/5 Chips 5/5 ( and generous portions in this day and age) and cooked just how we like it! We love this place, it’s got to be the best all round in the area with so many options, hard to see how you would be disappointed with anything that’s offered up. Not keen on: I don’t love the normal batter for fish. I think certain batters with thick fish cuts don’t work, etc but the crumbed fish is absolutely 💯 .. best in the Area!
I rate this place 10/10 Everything we had was tasty hot and delicious!!!

Great dinner ever for my Mom and Dad who are from another country and first time try Nepali authentic foods. Everything is perfect and so delicious. We are invited for a special dinner and the dinner was beyond my magination as Mom and Dad enjoyed the food so much. Start your culinary adventure with momos, tandoori chicken, chicken dumpling, chicken sekuwa etc… delicate parcels of joy bursting with flavor, a traditional Nepali staple that satisfies both body and soul. Each dish is crafted with care and attention to detail, ensuring that every bite is a revelation. Definitely recommend for the warm and cozy dinner! Best food in town!

Hands down, one of the best Nepali restaurant in Auckland. We ordered their highly recommended chilli momos , steam chicken momos, manchow soup and Chicken biryani. We simply keep going back, it’s that good!
We had lunch here recently, the Beef and Salmon Don are highly recommended. The man who served us was friendly, and although a small place, the atmosphere was good.
Best fish n chips ever. Crispy batter delicious fresh fish. Great value for money. Very popular business.

Have ordered uber eats from this amazing place twice now and LOVE LOVE LOVE the food. Always on point, tasty, super hot, correct!!, actually amazing! Super impressed. We recommend the chicken nibbles and loaded dumplings! Also the miso pork noodles and Beef bulgogi delicious. Happy and full!

What an amazing experience! The vibe here is just perfect – cozy, lively, and full of energy. The hookah was so smooth and enjoyable, and the live music really lit up the whole atmosphere. It made the night feel special and memorable. The food was absolutely delicious – every dish was packed with flavor and beautifully served. On top of that, the staff were super friendly and attentive, which made the whole experience even better. If you’re looking for a place with great food, amazing vibes, and that extra touch of fun with hookah and live music, this is the spot. I’ll definitely be coming back and highly recommend it!

I had a fantastic dinner at Ricksha today ,the cozy atmosphere and attentive staff made it a memorable experience. The staff were incredibly friendly and gave great recommendations, our server checked in often without being intrusive . The place was warm and welcoming, with soft lighting and relaxing background music. For the quality of food and service, the prices were very reasonable. Highly recommend if you’re looking for a relaxed night with great food. We’ll definitely be back!

A truly fantastic dining experience! Our group of 10 visited Ricksha Indian Fusion Restaurant & Bar and we had a fabulous time from start to finish. The service was top-notch, and the food was absolutely delicious—every dish was a winner. A huge highlight was the awesome live music from Neel Patel. He was so kind and even took our song requests, which made the evening extra special. My only minor suggestion would be to have cauliflower rice available as an option next time. We can't wait to come back!

This guy serves up an awesome meal that is so very affordable for that weekend treat! The kids love this place! I would recommend buying by the packs they offer rather than individually, they work out cheaper. Doesn't diminish the food quality and it tastes just as scrumptious 😋. Cheese burgers are amazingly yummy, according to my daughter lol! But my favorite would definitely be the fish. They are sizable, juicy everytime done in a crispy golden batter with a hint of lemon flavour!!! Looks like I'm not cooking g tonight... Bon Appétit Peeps! Stay loved and be safe out there 💞💯😊 Please note: this is a takeaway not a restaurant, although if I'm not mistaken there may be one table with two chairs and also a bench for while you wait. But hey, if you don't mind Tom Jerry and Aunty May sitting in on your meal, Go hard! Enjoy Peeps 😉
Got a fish and chip pack was excellent fish tasted lovely chips were nice and crispy sausages were really good too

Ordered pad thai chicken with mild spicyness! I was on a hurry and couldnt decide properly but I shouldve gotten a bit more spicyyyy, as the “mild” spicy for padthai isnt spicy at all So worth it for the price? The serving is so hugeee!!! Will come again next time ::) Also serving size for that pad thai is around 2 ppl? If you eat a lot, this is a perfect serving for you, if you dont eat as much this could last you til dinner, (if you eat this as lunch) really big serving

The staff were extremely nice and they said it was halal. I can't even describe how good the food was it was better then anything I've ever had. The portions were a great amount and it's reasonable priced. I will be returning here for more.
great food! very friendly service from the staff and the owners.

I visited Bay’s Kebab & Coffee around August 19, 2025, and had a very negative experience. The older gentleman behind the counter, who I believe is the owner, looked visibly unwell and was not wearing a mask or any protective equipment while handling food. I ordered the salad with falafel, and shortly after eating I became very sick. It seemed like basic health and safety standards were not being followed, and I felt that my food may have been contaminated. Unfortunately, this experience ruined a big part of my trip. I was visiting from Canada, and instead of enjoying my vacation, I spent the following week in bed with body aches, coughing, sneezing, and a runny nose. Food handling should always be sanitary and professional, and I would not recommend this restaurant to others.

A couple infront of me ordering inside. I order one burger. Staff having lunch inside the diner. It is empty and lots of staff. The guy the orderd after me got his food first. The staff member that had her lunch only order my burger after she was done. No servace at all.

The food was absolutely delicious! Every dish was full of flavour and clearly made with care. You can really taste the quality of the ingredients. Compliments to the chef — everything was fresh, well-balanced, and beautifully presented. I’ll definitely be coming back and recommending this place to others 😊
Amazing food and great service! The daal makhani here is absolutely delicious – creamy, rich, and full of flavour. It instantly reminded me of the authentic taste of Delhi. A must-try!!!
The food was ok and the staff were friendly. However, it should be made clear that the Monday–Wednesday special price applies to takeaway only. Customers don’t appreciate unexpected charges.

⭐ 1/5 Very disappointed with my experience at Subway. The staff were unprofessional and the customer service was very poor. My food was not packed properly (photo attached), which made it a complete mess. Honestly feels like a waste of money. I expect better standards from a brand like Subway. Definitely not happy with this service.

Love coming to the Lynfield store! The staff are really considerate, service is always quick, and they even remember my order which is such a nice touch. Makes the whole experience super easy and welcoming every time.

I have been on a journey to find a tasty kebab spot in Auckland ever since i saw Spanian's videos on kebabs. I came across Waikowhai kebabs and decided to order a large mixed meat kebab on rice with garlic aioli/mayo/bbq sauce combo. The service was great but feel the spot has a lot of potential to give you more "food truck, hidden gem" vibe, but the food is what matters most! The chips with chicken salt were actually very good and would go back because of the chips! The kebab on rice was tasty, but was a bit small in portion for the price you pay compared to others. If you are watching your food intake, this would be the spot to go to, but if you're super hungry and wanting QUANTITY, you may be left a bit disappointed. All in all, tasty but may find yourself on ubereats ordering more food.

Ordered a dinner for two on ubereats. The burgers tasted off, the chips were stale and we didn’t get our sundaes. We didn’t get any refund or compensation either. I am very disappointed with this service hopefully these workers step it up.

Went through drive through tonight and it took long to wait for someone to take our order but wasn’t busy compared to the one in MT Roskill, ordered our food to only get the stale chips like it’s been sitting for hours and my nuggets were cold 🥲 disappointing because it hasn’t been 24 hours since it opened. Staff was amazing tho
i ordered off uber eats, mind you i only live a few streets away... my coffee is burnt, my chicken mcmuffin came with no mayo and the fries were hard and cold. absolutely disgusting
I so badly didnt want to give a low rating but this mc donalds needs heaps of work. I'm not sure why they cant get the food fresh. I think maybe the opening has been difficult on staff.

Took ages to get our order via drive through this evening. It wasn't that busy so not sure why. Food was cold and even the coke tasted weird. Thought with the delay getting the food it would have been freshly made and somewhat hot. Nope. Not a great start at all. I guess I should be happy it was open?
Excellent service, kind staff. Highly recommend.
It's a well maintained pub, pleasant staff and drinks are well priced. Love this place, come here. $14 wedges

Ordered just 3 large ones. Had to wait more than 30 mins to pick up, and no "sorry" or "thank you". REALLY! 25,000 small and medium businesses just had to close out there and you think you can treat your customers like that and survive! Absolutely not coming back and not recommend!

I placed an order in store and the staff just didn’t look they knew what they were doing. I ordered 4 pizzas, the toppings on the pizzas was very minimal and barely any cheese. Not only that but all of the pizzas were burnt to the point it was fully black on the edges. Do not recommend.
The pizza tasted great, did a last minute takeaway order, seriously thought it won't be good as it was last minute prefer, but it turned out great,

I recently visited Pizza Hut at 570 Hillsborough Road and had the pleasure of being assisted by Navin. I requested an extra spicy Hot & Spicy Veggie pizza, and I must say, Navin nailed it perfectly! The pizza was just the right level of spice and tasted amazing – exactly as I had imagined. What really stood out was Navin’s helpful and understanding nature. He took the time to ensure I was satisfied with my order, offering great recommendations and genuinely listening to what I wanted. It’s rare to find such attentive and friendly service, and it’s clear that Navin goes above and beyond to make customers feel valued. Thanks to his excellent service, I felt compelled to leave a review. If you’re in the area, definitely stop by – and if you’re lucky enough to be served by Navin, you’re in for a great experience!

Surprisingly found this great fried chicken place, crispy outside, juicy and tender inside. I ordered spicy flavoured it was yummy. Only, they make the chicken upon your order so you need to wait for 15 mins, but definitely worth it.

Bought a takeaway burger meal box from here. It was absolutely delicious and really enjoyed it. The burger was huge and tasty the chicken and peri peri chips were crispy and delicious. The service was friendly. Highly recommended!!

Brilliant staff and great chicken wings - crunchy fresh fried. The kebabs are amazing - exactly what I asked for with succulent chicken and specific fresh salads. We are really picky and annoying with our “no sauce extra hummus half the chicken double salad” - and the “meat box only onion and lettuce with less chips box” - but these guys are so cool and kind and every time I am so excited to get take out. Biggest respect. Massive thanks.
Second visit and they are still awesome ! Check out the portions !!! Just for 18 bucks its value for money.
Best potatoe fritters and sweet and sour pork. Chicken wings, fried rice, eg foo yung delicious. Good serving sizes - highly recommend 👍
Super convenient, quick fast service been going here for years can’t not recommend the barbecue pork fried rice
best indian restaurent in area food is delicious i saw it on uber eats and gave it a try and now its my everyday dinner restaurent they cook your food as you want and never disappoint you

Tried to go to slow lane but the wait was over an hour, came to Elleslie and found this cafe on the main strip. We ordered at the counter and sat a table straight away. Drinks arrived fast, our food came quickly too. I got the eggs benedict with bacon on potato rostie, absolutely delicious! My friend got the mince with toast & enjoyed it very much. Plates were cleared from our table as we finished which was nice. Very clean cafe with awesome service and a steady stream of customers. Thank you!🙌
Good venue for your seafood delicacies. Very efficient and fairly priced. Enjoyed their fish & chips today 😋

Im a regular here and their battered fish is always fresh! Very affordable. Im giving 3 stars based on my last meal there last week which unfortunately was very very greasy, as they did not let the fish and potato fritters drain off excess oil before serving. Otherwise i would give them a 4 star normally. Cheeseburger for $4.50 wasnt bad either. Fish burger also ok if your fan of sweet mayo. Their $1 container of aioli is also delish. Service is a little so so. Photos are of fish burger combo with an extra piece of fish, potato fritters, cheeseburger. They also do grilled fish of the day which is $2 per fillet.
Nice fresh fish of choice but the chips a little oily. Can have the chips with no salt.The price is suprising low. Top marks

Arrived at 10:00am; lots of space, twelve other customers seated and eating/drinking; see through canvas keeping the cold out and there was a cold wind outside. I've eaten here before; good menu with good variety; unfortunately the food comes out on cold plates, so too the pot of tea so after 2 minutes, the tea was not steaming hot. When my meal arrived (big breakfast) after five minutes, the tea was now warm and the plate being cold, the breakfast wasn't as nice as I was wanting it to be. Spoke to the staff and got a 'thank you' but I don't think they really took it in. Not sure if I'll go back again as there are other shops close by that do better.

Ever since I drank Armageddon and Hop Zombie for the first time nearly 10 years ago I knew I would not be able to go to Auckland without stopping by Epic. Finally got here and it was definitely an interesting experience. Taphouse itself had a very clandestine/underground feel to it… if you didn’t know where it was you would probably not stumble across it and I loved that. Was happy to finally drink all their beers on tap but sadly… I don’t know if something was going on with the fridge but the beers were not ice cold, not as cold as I like my IPAs to be anyway. Other than that had a wonderful night and will definitely be back.

“Easily the fastest Subway experience of my life — and not in a good way. I ordered a cheese toastie, but apparently salt and pepper were considered luxury add-ons because they never made it anywhere near my food. The lady behind the counter was rushing like she had a line of a hundred people, when in reality I was the only customer. The speed didn’t help the quality though — the taste was average at best. Customer service? Below average. Cookies? Below average. Even the toastie itself? Below average. Basically, if you’re looking for a masterclass in mediocrity, this Subway has you covered.” I will give zero stars.
The good, service and atmosphere was amazing. Staff checked in with us and were very friendly. The food was so delicious and came out fast. Live music was an extra treat

Beautiful setting, lovely area. The food is amazing, so delicious and full of flavor. The staff are friendly. The service cant be faulted. It is my go to place for sure. And passion fruit martini is a MUST TRY

Embark on a gastronomic adventure at this Thai restaurant, where every dish is a meticulously crafted masterpiece. Thai cuisine, boasts a captivating interplay of flavors. The robust chili heat, the zesty burst of lime, and the aromatic lemongrass create a harmonious symphony that dances on your palate. Moving on to the Pad Thai, the chef's expertise shines through in the perfectly balanced amalgamation of sweet, savory, and tangy elements. The stir-fried noodles, adorned with fresh shrimp or tofu, exemplify the art of Thai culinary finesse. The restaurant goes beyond traditional offerings with innovative twists on classic dishes. An exploration of the menu reveals culinary creativity, seamlessly blending authenticity with modern flair. Whether savoring the aromatic curry or relishing the richness of a red curry, each bite unveils layers of complexity that speak to the chef's dedication. Beyond the delectable dishes, the ambiance complements the dining experience. Warm hues, reminiscent of Thai landscapes, create a welcoming atmosphere. Attentive service enhances the overall enjoyment, ensuring a memorable day. In conclusion, this Thai restaurant stands as a testament to the richness of Thai gastronomy. Every dish, from the traditional to the inventive, tells a story of passion, precision, and a commitment to delivering an unparalleled dining experience. For those seeking a culinary escapade, this establishment promises a memorable rendezvous with the flavors of Thailand.

Was with a friend & decided to have a subway feed, ordering food went well, but drink fridge is BEFORE begining of ordering, my friend showed me a bottle of juice 1st. then put it BACK into fridge as we decided on other drinks, unbeknowen to me receptionist had ADDED this also to our order, which i haden't checked at the time. Before i paid she went out the back & asked a person(male) something, who told her (in their lingo) to which she then looked a bit perplexed, (probably to do with the XTRA drink) & maybe was told to just CHARGE for it anyway. Photo supplied!

Food selection not that much but it’s all delicious and big portion. Their scallop wrap in bacon is a must try dish! Tried their weekly special seafood medley and they are really generous with the seafood as well. Overall very good experience, would definitely go again.

Come here for lunch a lot as I work nearby. The food is always fresh and the prices are great. Definitely some of the best sushi in the area. The staff are always super friendly as well, and they often do promos so you can get a free miso after spending $15

This place is amazing. They have a great selection of food, and everything I've tried is legit. My only complaint is that you guys aren't open on the weekend, which is 90% of the time I want to demonlish all your tastey food.

Dislike the rubbish offcut meat soaked in the juice and then added to the bottom of the roll making it soggy, then they cut up pieces from the pork and put on top of it to make out it’s full of meat. Crackle was horrible, chicken thigh flavour was good but semi warm

The food is okay here, not so great but they do have plenty of options to choose from. The food is very cheap as well so if You are in the area and looking for a cheap food, This is the shop to go to. Few seating area but mostly take aways. A bit slow service I felt.
Don’t bother. Waste of money. $15 for whatever this is! 😂🤔

Ohhh my goodness the baked mac and cheese SLAPPPS I ordered this lastnight going off another review saying it was creamy and she wasn’t lying this is so delicious I’ve tried so many elsewhere and was so dissatisfied guys if you want a really delicious creamy Mack and cheese 🫕 this is your sign to order it and it also comes nice and hot 😍 thank you so much I’m yet to order different pastas now amazing highly recommend 🤏🏽

I Got a baked mac & cheese & Salsa Di Pomodoro Creamosa through delivereasy, it came steaming hot with 2x mini garlic breads. Mac & cheese: was soooo creamy & cheesy & the Elbows were cooked perfectly 😍 Salsa Di Pomodoro Creamosa: was sooo delicious loved the fresh olives & the tomatoe sauce was delicious tangy with a hint of spice, superb 🙌🏼💯
My chicken Marsala was so sweet, They must have used same sauce as butter chicken, definitely a zero point for authentic Indian food.wont be going back.
Reasonable pricing, tasty curries and good combos!
Best Indian biriyani in the town
Always delicious and the staff are poilte

Great food and quick service. We stopped here for lunch on a Saturday and it wasn’t too busy. We were able to eat inside at a booth (the seats definitely need vinyl replacing but that’s my only critique). The food was fast and fantastic. The burgers taste like a home barbecue. (Nothing like a fast food flat patty). I had the cheeseburger with cheese fries and my partner had the double mushroom burger with loaded bacon fries. Both meals were perfect. I would recommend using the paper wrapping to hold your burger as they are juicy and fall apart easily! Definitely coming back for another burger soon.

When your favourite takeaways start to feel like home ! Been coming here as a kid and the flavours have not changed one bit! My favourite roast potatoes ever ! My favourite American hot dog and thick shakes that still taste like back in the days. The service is always great & efficient. This place is a gem in Mangere Bridge !
OMG! It’s ABSOLUTELY very good. The tables are clean and the service is very nice. The most important thing is that the food is very delicious. I hope everyone can come and have a taste.😝

Absolutely AMAZING fried chicken (definitely some of the best I have ever had), super juicy, crispy and succulent tender goodness! Staff were super friendly and nice alongside an immaculately clean shop. The boxes and packaging they used were also super cool, unique and gorgeous. 11/10 highly recommend!! Amazing dining experience and I 100% will be back soon!

Lovely little eatery, Good portions and love the outdoor area for the kids to play, the eggs Benedict with the hash was so yum!! The big gaff is so filling, the tacos were really yum, will definitely be back again
The Gaff Cafe Eatery is such a gem! The food was incredibly fresh and absolutely delicious, and the staff were so warm and welcoming. A wonderful experience all around.

This place used to be good around 15 years ago, but unfortunately it is running down. The lady at the casher is very unwelcoming and has attitude. If you want to do business you have to educate yourself how to deal with people. Apart from that, it is very expensive compared to similar shops.
Wonderful food, especially the Chicken/Avo Wraps😛👷‍♂️🚛👍👍👍👍👍 friendly service too! 10 out 10😃

Not consistent the shrimp cocktail (they're prawns btw) are sometimes good sometimes watery the other day my prawns were frozen. Also sometimes the chicken on rice is too salty. There were two people being immature over the intercom don't know what was going on there it was very annoying. I like that it's drive thru.
Drive thru is super fast. Food is always good. Keen note - Friday's sushi value of the day is no longer smoked but cooked salmon.
Delicious food and amazing customer service from the ladies there!

Very good value Chinese food. I go here at least once a week at lunchtime. Always ordered BBQ pork and roast pork on rice ($16 at the time of writing) - never disappoints. Picture has my hand in it for reference on their portion size. I feel that the portion has shrunk a bit since I first went here but it's still good value.

We were surprised on how huge their serving size is, yet affordable and their dishes are tasty too. The corn and egg soup is a plus point. I highly recommend to try their roasted pork and duck. The restaurant is not fancy but clean and tidy. By far one of onehunga’s best chinese restaurant.

Very fast, maybe cause we went in during public holiday. Friendly owners. You get served tea and corn soup for free. And refill for tea. Which is really nice service. We ordered salt and pepper squid, fried green beans, and wok fried veges… and pork on rice. Yes all very good flavor :)

First time trying Kongs Kitchen! We ordered a wonton noodle soup and duck on rice. Wow. Everything was beautiful! So affordable and delicious! Wonton noodle soup: the best in Onehunga. Period. Broth is clear as it should be and tastes like something that will heal your soul. Slightly peppery and full of depth. The wontons were delicious! Very fresh porky flavour and the noodles were super bouncy and chewy, not soggy at all!!! Duck on rice: absolutely delicious. Duck was served with white rice, cabbage and drizzled over with a beautiful sauce. I wish I had taken a photo before I ate but i literally inhaled the food as soon as it arrived My new fave spot! I wish I knew about this spot earlier!!

We were surprised on how huge their serving size is, yet affordable and their dishes are tasty too. The corn and egg soup is a plus point. I highly recommend to try their roasted pork and duck. The restaurant is not fancy but clean and tidy. By far one of onehunga’s best chinese restaurant.

Fast service, good quality food, decent portion size, extensive menu and reasonable prices. It is cafe decor rather than restaurant but is always clean and tidy. It's only 30 minute parking on the mall but plenty of free parking on the side streets.
The price is reasonable and the portion is generous. It's a big box full. The fries are also very delicious and the service attitude is good. I often come here for meals. Highly recommended!

Wasn’t impressed as much as the 4.9 review TBH. But the chicken indeed tender inside crispy outside, I tried the flaming hot sauce but not too hot for me though! Lunch pack is good value in terms of size! Nice cozy deco in the shop~ will try their JP style food next time 🙂

Tasty, Delicious well portioned korean bbq chicken with flavour sauces. Restaurant near train tracks and no parking avaliable more than 30 minutes. I ordered the mini pack with fries $8 and the soy garlic crispy chicken bowl $16.
Love the sushi, always fresh as and made by lovely Japanese girl.
Very friendly people, ordered 3 meals and they came out fast. Place is abit run down in some areas of the restaurant but the service made up for it and the food.
Ordered through door dash. Loved my fried chicken hoagie. The chicken had a kick, very juicy. The fries were average. As you can see, ordered far too much.

My friend saw this restaurant on social media so we booked it for our last dinner in Auckland before going home. Turns out to be another great meal we had for our trip. It’s quite a small restaurant but everyone in that packed restaurant were really enjoying themselves. We ordered a medium lobster tail tray that had lobster tails, prawns, mussels, crab with potatoes, corns and eggs. A very tasty fulfilling meal. All the seafood were fresh and delicious except for the crab which was not too fresh. The star of the meal is really the sauce. It’s a dip that goes well with all the seafood and the potatoes, corns and eggs. Super yummy delicious dinner. Saw that they are opening branch soon. Good for them.

We ordered the Large Platter to share among four adults, and the portion size was just right. The food was absolutely delicious! 😋💖 We didn’t have to wait long for the food to be served, which was a big plus. 👍🏻 The Mango Otai 🥭 is a must have! For $7 it’s good value for money. The staff were friendly and super helpful throughout our visit. Although it got a bit messy with sauce splashing everywhere, it added to the fun and made for a unique dining experience. We’ll definitely recommend this place to others and look forward to coming back again!

Definitely seafood cravings satisfied 🦞🦐 Been here many times and it has always met our expectations. The sauce is superb as always! Reasonable price too! Recommendations: Book ahead of time as tables are limited. Although walk-ins are welcomed but it will depend on the availability. Don’t eat them with rice at first — if you want to enjoy it. You may have it halfway through. Oh, don’t drink too 🤣 Feel free to have add-ons or extras. Whichever you prefer. Prices are reasonable. You can also do takeaways. Good for parties and/or special occasions—- whole fam would enjoy for sure…

Had an amazing experience with my colleagues. Friendly and welcoming staff; family friendly atmosphere; fresh seafood, well cooked and packed with flavor --- sauce is so delicious. Definitely worth checking out; I will be back for sure!

Second time ordering from Manaia and it’s great. They put a generous amount of sauce to cover everything. The potato was boiled to perfection, very soft. The corn tasted fresh (not like the frozen ones). Some mussel beards were still intact, you have to remove it yourself. The lobster tail was yummm. Will definitely order again. 😊

First Impressions I have seen great reviews and i said i must try it. The slice arrives with that appealing, Detroit-style square shape, airy, golden base with crispy edges and a rich layer of sauce and cheese. At first glance, it feels like a premium, bakery-style pizza Taste & Texture Base: The highlight of the slice — light yet substantial, with a tasty, well-seasoned crumb and crisp outer edge. Toppings: The tomato sauce is bright and tangy, and the cheese melts nicely, but the meat is on the short side, leaving some bites feeling under-topped. Overall Bite: Flavour balance is good when you get a bit of everything in one mouthful, but uneven topping distribution means not every bite hits the same. Portion & Value While tasty, one quarter-slice like this doesn’t feel enough to be a standalone meal, especially at the higher price point. It works better as part of a shared order rather than your main lunch Service & Space Friendly staff add to the experience, and the space is comfortable enough, though nothing particularly standout.
Really good pizza and excellent service. He even recommended us to take a different option to save some money. Really appreciated. Hope your future Road trips are a blast as well mate!

Came in and didn't know what to expect. Arrived and we were served by the nicest guy ever. We tried most flavours and found out the OG flavour was hard to beat with an extra sauce on top. Highly, highly recommend. Pizza tasted so good and the atmosphere and the worker just made it an even better experience! Worth the hype.
Always such nice food and a super friendly team. No matter what I grab on my way to work, it never fails to surprise me and puts me in a good mood to start my day.

Firstly, it was like walking into a different world, we liked the decorations and garden scenery, beautiful and calming. The customer service were very friendly and helpful. The even helped us take pictures for our anniversary. The food was delicious, fresh and a variety of meals to choose from spiced foods and main meals from pork, beef etc. with plenty of fresh salads and tasty sauces added to the main meals. Food prices were reasonable. The desert was tasty, as well. Thanks! STG, for the amazing experience.

Hands down the best curries in Auckland. The yellow curry is my favorite curry ever and this restaurant does not disappoint. Curry puffs are the best I have ever tasted. Welcoming, friendly service, lovely atmosphere and the walk down to the restaurant is picturesque and very beautiful. Would gladly dine here again.
We love the pretty setting. The quiet but fabulous service. Authentic thai. Red curry duck and pork curries were a big hit.

Quick and friendly service. Venue is nothing to write home about but the food is delightful. We typically order the deluxe pho (everything you'd want in a pho, fragrant umami goodness - their new beef short rib variant is devine), spring rolls (light and crispy bundles of joy), chicken wings (fried goodness - pairs well with siracha) and a smoothie or coffee. I am yet to experience a bad plate of food from here.
New menu, excellent taste ,large potion still affordable and not expensive. Must try if you love Vietnamese food. Same shop same people for more than 25 years.
Yummy i cant find anyother veitnam outside auckland can compete here . Always best food
Not the premium experience that you’re expecting but deliver the correct vietnamese (southern I guess) cuisine. The iced coffee (nâu đá) is absolutely authentic
I waited 15 minutes for my coffee, and only 2 cups were made, and the coffee was wrong. The staff training is really poor.

Went there last night after the Warriors v Dragons game and they forgot my fries. Couldn't be bothered going back to correct it so will vote with my wallet and never return. Check your order thoroughly if going to this place
It was a great option when I realised we had a shared lunch at work and wanted yo buy some finger food to share very quickly :-) No waiting time at all even at noon!

Was very annoyed with the staff here, it was 7.45pm and they said they were close, website says they close at 9pm. If you want an early close so maybe you shud put on the web, no point standing and laughing away and telling customers it’s closed, I also tried calling before heading to they store but no one seemed to pick phone, they were not busy but standing and laughing away I will never go back !!!!

Find this under-the-radar gem tucked into Ōtāhuhu, where Fijian‑Indian curry craftsmanship turns a humble storefront into a feast for the senses. The goat and lamb curries arrive with meat so tender it gently falls apart under the spice-laced gravy, rich with cumin, coriander, that whisper of deep comfort. Paired with that silky herbs dhal, a smoky potato-and-eggplant curry, and soft roti—with each bite anchors you in the moment. Don’t skip the vada and bhaji—crispy, fresh, with a satisfying crunch that sets your palate ablaze (in the spicy best way). The focus here has been totally on the food and it shows, I'll be back....

Very tasty pakora. Love it. Wow That’s what people after when they are tired and need refreshment. First time I have visited this place. The smell took m above and make me purchase more stuffs than only pakora.

I have suffered food poisoning from eating halal tasty food.l try to explain to him but he said his food is always fresh nothing is fresh here if you keep on heating the same product and serving it to the people.He is very nasty man as l would suggest to people beware then sorry.
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Look at these 3 bowls each one was perfect. Super fresh loaded ingredients, packed with flavour, and quick service. This is why we keep coming back to PitaPit Otahuhu!
Excellent food served at a reasonable price in 2025. Enjoyed alot.

I found this great little Thai spot in Otahuhu. They have delicious food, especially the curry puff, fish cake, and chicken satay. The Penang curry and Seafood Pad Thai were really tasty too. The place is really clean inside, and the staff is so friendly. I will definitely be going back to try something new next time.
The best Duck curry in Auckland. Comes with Dahl, Rice & we ordered 2 Roti each. Perfect combo! No need for knives and forks, use your hands for a great Fijian curry experience. Vinaka vaka levu

This "salad" with this quiche cost $2.50!!! And no dressing! Overall quality of this cafe is very average and very expensive. There is no "perceived affordability" you charged $2.50 for a piece of lettuce and a rating of carrot... and your food is generally average at best.

Great service demands a 5 star review, keep it up... However all the breakfast orders we had, we all commented on how bad the bread was and was surprised that some red powder was on the scrambled eggs, personally if I want to put salt, pepper or whatever on my eggs I would. Maybe consider the butter automatically placed on the plate on the side, it's a great touch but possibly having the devondale or other sealed ones on the plate or side table to save money.

Honestly wasn’t expecting much, but this branch absolutely delivered. Chicken was hot, juicy, and perfectly crispy — like it just came out the fryer 🔥. Fries were fresh, not soggy, and the staff were super chill and friendly. The zinger burger? Chef’s kiss. Didn’t even need extra sauce — it was that good. Clean store, quick service, and no missing items (rare win 😂). Will 100% be coming back — this KFC actually gets it right.

Really good value roast, BBQ pork and roast duck meals. Very good taste, good size portions and tasty spring onions on rice. A good solid, satisfying and tasty meal. Will be back again. Highly recommend.

Absolute favourite Chinese local takeaway! The portions are so large and they really don’t skimp out on the meat and veggies. Freshly cooked on the hot wok every time. Their lunch specials are such great value too!

Wouldve given 5 stars however if you order over the phone they tend to give you the food thats been in the warmer all day, noticed the sweet and sour pork i ordered went into the microwave when i arrived. Definitly not the same when made fresh which is what you would expect. Disappointing given this place is usually pretty good. Make sure you are there when you order or else expect below standard food.

First time here for dinner, my family are locals & I wanted to tag along, great atmosphere, excellent customer service & friendly staff, thanks Moe for signing me up as a member ($5) & for giving me the details (very informative), I definitely enjoyed dinner, pork chop combo with egg, salad & chips, the other orders were the hamburger & chips, fish & chips, dessert was nice too, cheap prices & humble food, I will be returning back very soon, thanks again!

Staff is well trained and works exceptionally well, providing great customer service and atmosphere. Will come again, as the food quality and service time is efficient compared to other fast food outlets nearby.
It was amazing food. I ate rice with salads.
Very tasty food and kind service and i would love to visit again. This was a great experience.

Such yummy Fiji style Indian food! The curries are incredibly tasty and the roti’s are so soft. They make the simplest roti rolls taste sooooo good. The lovely lady that owns it has such a warm and kind nature. It’s my go to for authentic Fiji flavours.

That kind of kindness and dedication truly speaks volumes about their customer service. It's not just about the food here, but about how they treat their customers—with care and consideration. Had a mixed wrap with all the fillings, garlic aoli and satay sauce. What a way to finish the day. If I'm in the area again I will surely drop in again. Till next time 😜 P.s. untill the 16th of August you get a free 330ml soda with your meal, even if you arrive late 😄
Its a great place to take the family and have a munch! We'll worth the money spent here, food is high quality and service is lovely..thanks Robbers burgers
Was surprised to find this. Took a wrong turn and ended up here. So nice, sushi was affordable, store was cozy and owner was lovely

The food was sublime. Crunchy baguettes and the pho, I had the chicken, was flavourful and yummy. This is a nugget of a place. Highly recommended 😊

Churr my toko just wanted to say this is one of my favorite late night places to eat after work or after a church service, if I eat by myself it's very cheap could spend $30 and it will make me full, I have known the people that also run the store since I moved to otahuhu 9 months ago, they are very kind and polite when they speak to me and are also fast to cook up my meal, not only the quality but the quantity of the food is amazing, 10/10 would 💯 recommend.

It is the best shop. I had a wonderful experience. Staff is too friendly and have best food deals.

First time trying food here after hearing lots of good reviews. We ordered Singapore Hokkien Prawn Mee and Squid Nasi lemak. I personally love the noodles with big juicy prawns and lots of prawn flavor. Nasi lemak is a little too sweet for me as I do not have a sweet tooth. Will definite go back again to try other dishes.

“Where the food’s so Malaysian, you’ll forget you're in NZ until you get the bill.” Stepped into this joint and boom instant teleport to Malaysia, minus Malaysia's sweaty weather and screaming aunties. It ain’t a palace, but they’ll squeeze you in whether you come solo or with your entire badminton team. Just don’t expect to stretch your legs too far, space a lil' tight, but hey, the food’s worth it. The dishes? Certified makan sedap vibes. Real Malaysian taste none of that ‘fusion confusion’ business. Service fast too; I blinked and my food was already flexin' on the table. Portions? Enough to leave you full. Price? Typical Auckland city rates won’t break your wallet, but also not your 90s mamak stall prices. Parking's easy, street and public lots at the back. They shut in between hours like they taking naps or something, so check the timing or risk staring at a closed door like a lost tourist. And yes they serve alcohol. So if you’re the kind who likes to sip a cold one while smashing nasi lemak, this your playground. Overall: Authentic taste, no nonsense, good vibes, tight squeeze. Would I go back? 100%. Might even fake a homesick moment to justify it. “Logan was here, walked in hungry, rolled out happy.” 🚶‍♂️

Honestly, this place beats every other place in town. You know when food just hits? That’s what happens here. Every single dish was packed with flavour—like this is proper Indian food. Just enjoyed some the nicest Naan bread I've ever had. We ordered Mango Chicken with Butter Naan, Lamb Korma with Garlic Naan, all came with rice. A 400ml Kingfisher and a Mango Lassi. The server was so pleasant and well mannered.
Very spacious place, kids friendly, plenty car park at the front. Although salmon egg Benedict is probably the worst I’ve had - salmon and spinach are way too salty. Lunch bowl is okay.

Will be back to try other meals too! ☺️
The diner was clean with a relaxed atmosphere. Food was delicious. I would prob rate Taco Bell food as nice than McDs. Staff were very friendly.

Went here 2 days in a row to try different things on the menu Our First visit I tried the garlic prawns with ciabatta & it was 10/10 (just wish it was available in bigger portion ) ate it & forgot to take pictures 😭❤️ & for our 2nd visit we tried the kiwi style butter chicken , pan fried fish meal with potato mash & sautéed veggies & beef burger with added bacon & egg Kiwi style butter chicken was 10/10 ( right amount of spice , restaurant quality ) Pan fried fish meal was definite 11/10 , definitely a MUST TRY , - ( veggies are soft & flavourful , mash potato is soft & creamy & the fish isn’t chewy it’s cooked really well ) Beef burger - 9/10 ( no complaints , I would just love abit more sauce in the burger ) Pattie is full of flavour , fresh tomato’s & lettuce , toasted buns with my add ons of bacon & egg was all well done Definitely after trying so many meals I can safely say it’s a place that’s food taste just as good as it looks . A hidden gem ! Will be coming back until they decide to relocate , definitely don’t wanna miss this place,

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Flava Master’s Food Truck is hands down one of the best food experiences I’ve ever had! The flavors are absolutely out of this world – every bite is packed with freshness, seasoning, and pure passion for food. You can truly tell that the team puts their heart into every single dish. Not only is the food incredible, but the service is just as outstanding. The staff are warm, welcoming, and make you feel like family the moment you step up to order. The portions are generous, the presentation is top-notch for a food truck, and the taste will have you coming back again and again. If you’re looking for a food truck that delivers restaurant-quality meals with unbeatable flavor, Flava Master’s is the place. Highly recommended – an absolute gem and a must-try for anyone who loves great food!
Best roast duck in auckland. I've looked. First takeaways ordered out of L4, no regrets ❤

My extended family and I dined in on Friday night. We felt so welcomed from the get go. The food was hot, fresh and delicious and the staff were friendly and inviting. The best place for Pacific food; all your favourites in the one place! We are from Australia and this was definitely the best place we dined at during our time in NZ. We will definitely be back!

First time coming here and it was such a beautiful experience loved the atmosphere especially the gospel music playing front man was good spirited the women working in the kitchen had great service with always clearing the plates on the tables well done ladies 🙌 I tried everything on the menu to test it all out and everything was hitting there's also dessert I think its a good range not like heaps but it's still a good amount and they also have coffee and tea as well you can make yourself . 9/10 only thing it was to cold but anyways thanks god bless 🙌
The food looked dry in the display cabinet around 7.30pm... however, we tried the meals and they were delicious with very generous servings. The Asian lady that served us was very helpful and happy.

I usually don’t eat Lu Sipi as I prefer Lu Pulu but randomly stopped over at this shop cos I was craving Lu Sipi 😆 and it did not disappoint!! Taste, portion size and meat texture 10/10!! My new go to for Tongan food 😍
Location is good, however pies need more love. Pies were not nice and kebab on stick was hard.
Not good. Close before 10 minutes of closing time.

Food was absolutely waste of money bought two mixed kebab combo lamb gives so much smell the bread got all soggy until reached home… Charging so much money and giving out burnt chips disgusting whole dinner spoilt customer service zero… Due to recession businesses are closing down there is no jobs or income if you getting customers you are blessed so please don’t give them whatever comes across we have paid nearly $60 for my meal I can make better wraps then yours but reason to jump in today was I was tired so thought to grab something quick to lessen my burden but you guys …. I couldn’t chew those fries it was literally burnt an dry as hell… Improve your service guys…

I work in South Auckland. Once when I didn't get to pack my lunch, I looked for a place to get noodle. Eden noodles came up in the recommendations. This is around the 5th time I'm getting noodles from Eden Noodles. Their noodles are flavorful, tasty, filling and reasonably priced. They have around 5 different types of noodles to choose from, multiple flavors, different spice levels and add ons. Apart from noodles, they also have serve hotpots, wontons, dumplings, rice dishes, milk teas etc.

We have tried their famous butter chicken and literally this is the best butter chicken I have tasted in Auckland so far, I have tried so many restaurants and takeaway but not this good. It was authentic Indian taste, the spice level was perfect, We enjoyed the flavour in each bite. 100% Recommend, Must try

Outstanding Recovery & Excellent Service A few weeks ago, we had a very disappointing experience with service at Goode Brothers Botany. I raised the issue with management, and to their credit, they acted immediately to address the situation and make things right. We were invited back for a complimentary dinner — and wow, what a turnaround! The service this time was absolutely outstanding. Gabriel, our waiter, was extremely professional, knowledgeable, and attentive throughout the evening. He checked in regularly, ensuring everything was perfect. Thank you also to duty manager Michael and regional manager Haman, whose problem-solving skills and customer care truly stood out. This is exactly how service should always be — consistent, attentive, and warm. I will definitely be returning and look forward to seeing if this high standard continues. Well done to the entire team for turning a negative experience into a very positive one!

We recently went to Goodie Brothers in Botany and had such a great time that it deserves a proper shout-out. From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere felt welcoming and lively, with a nice mix of modern décor and a relaxed, casual vibe that makes you want to stay a while. We started with the margarita pizza, which came out with a beautiful golden crust that had the perfect crunch on the outside and a soft, chewy bite inside. The tomato sauce tasted fresh and vibrant, and the mozzarella was melted evenly across the base with just the right balance of cheese and herbs so it wasn’t too heavy but still full of flavor. The fettuccine pasta followed and was just as impressive, with perfectly cooked al dente noodles coated in a creamy, well-seasoned sauce that felt indulgent without being overly rich, and the portion size was generous enough to share or enjoy on its own as a main. For dessert, we couldn’t resist the tiramisu, which ended up being one of the highlights of the night — light, airy layers of sponge soaked with just enough coffee, topped with creamy mascarpone and a dusting of cocoa that tied everything together beautifully. Alongside all this, we had a few drinks that were made well and complemented the food nicely, and throughout the evening the staff were attentive, friendly, and genuinely seemed to care that everyone was enjoying themselves. It’s clear the team takes pride in both their food and service, which really makes a difference. Goodie Brothers feels like the kind of place where you can go for a casual catch-up with friends, a relaxed date night, or even just to treat yourself to a good meal, and leave satisfied every time. We’ll definitely be back and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a spot in Botany with great food, good drinks, and a welcoming atmosphere.

My 2nd trip to Botany Town center Nando's and man what a change since my last time at the same venue in 2023. Great authentic Nando's prepared to your request,great service and awesome atmosphere.

For a whole chicken order you get half of each breast cut and taken out. You end up with three quarters. Practically, this is order theft. Check your takeaway order before you go. They have been warned before, but still recurring.

Japanese cuisine is always my favourite. It’s the first time I have dined at Daikoku at Botany Town Centre on 16/11/2023. The Japanese manager who greeted me at the entrance of the restaurant was very friendly and hospitable. As I can speak some Japanese, we could have a lovely chat. The Japanese Chef was also very professional and attentive. There were only three of us on the same table so there was not much noise. Food was delicious and I would like to take my husband there some time later. I highly recommend you to come there and enjoy their lunch special if you happen to get near Botany Town Centre.

This is the first time we have been to Daikoku, and walked out feeling SO disappointed and let down. Our chef was SLOPPY from the word go. Messy, food everywhere (and not in the good way we are used to), the veggies that we LOVE were totally raw and undercooked with little to NO flavour. The steak was nice (its hard to get that wrong, right), the rice was bland with again little to no flavour, and where were the veggies (i'm sure they are meant to have veggies in them), and the prawn set we ordered, were BARELY cooked, the sauce had not even melted, and overall the food tasted like crap. The servers at our table were very nice (2 ladies) however the manager was also very quick to NOT apologise for the terrible food, and did not take our feedback on well (when you are spending over $350 dollars on a meal, take the feedback to do better, or people won't return). Overall, terrible management (thanks for the menial discount, but it didn't really help the experience), lovely wait staff, shocking experience with the food, and if we get that chef next time we book, I'll happily walk out. We have come to LOVE going to Daikoku botany for MANY years, and never have we had this poor quality of service. Do better, please.
