Kohkoz are among the best eats in Auckland. First came across them at Clevedon Farmers Market and started ordering a lot from them during the lockdowns from 2020 to 2022. Am truly addicted to their food and dips and was pleased and surprised they were taking the next step and opening a bricks and mortar store. The food here is just as fantastic as ever and Natalie (the owner) is incredibly friendly. It’s not on my side of town but I will always stop by whenever I’m in the neighbourhood. 😇

Very tasty Lebanese food! Not surprised, because it’s made by Lebanese chefs who give you the original taste of Lebanon. Finally, I can enjoy food in New Zealand that’s just like back home. I especially love the toum (garlic sauce), the fresh pita bread, and the amazing spices on the meat and chicken. Excellent customer service and such a clean, welcoming restaurant. Thank you for bringing authentic Lebanese flavors to NZ—highly recommend!

Had a fantastic experience at KOHKOZ - Real Lebanese Cuisine! Peter was incredibly nice and friendly, taking the time to recommend dishes that suited our tastes. He was especially helpful with my friend who's lactose intolerant, patiently explaining the ingredients in each recipe to ensure everything was safe. The food was authentic and delicious—definitely coming back for more of that genuine Lebanese flavor. Highly recommend!
One of the great buffets, had a really nice lunch here plenty of food on selection the restaurant was clean tidy and excellent friendly service Highly recommended

It's an affordable buffet hence the 3 stars. Plenty of food when we first seated at 6pm. Delicious japchae and numerous side dishes, the rest I must say were underwhelming. The meat were chewy and almost had a waxy texture; I do wonder if they were understaffed because there were only 2 service staff on the floor while there were at least 10 table of diners By the time we left, a big group of 10+ people arrived and pretty much wiped out the entire cook food section.
Kamila served me today and she was lovely. Always willing to make changes to our order at the last minute😊

Very disappointing experience. Halfway through eating my sushi, I found a hair inside. When I went back to the store, the manager showed no apology at all – just asked, “Do you want another one?” and tossed the sushi straight into the bin without even checking. Absolutely ridiculous service and lack of accountability. I expected much better standards of hygiene and customer care.

Really happy with the Nice big portions they dont skimp out on the sizes /meat n veg!! But the flavors are very bland if the flavors were not bland man this place would be the go to in botany!!either way I will still go to them in fhe future but hope they can put more flavors to really top it off and i would probably be going here 4 times a week for sure

Not recommended. The number 8 only 6 pieces of meat. 2 big pieces of beef. 1 big piece fatty chicken. I adked for more pork and extra beef. Hardly any veges. 90 percent noddles. Too much sauce with flavorings. I'm was hyperactive for many hours. For the same price you can get better food at McDonalds. Also bought the number 12 which was perfect. See photo.
A regular customer. Order is always prepared on time, good food and friendly service.
So good honestly worth the money I got bruised beef and noodles my favorite

Food was so-so, but the service was terrible (0 stars). Staff got visibly annoyed because I took a moment to decide my order. They overcharged me, and I had to ask twice to get a refund. Very rude attitude, like it was my fault. Not coming back.

I stopped into Tank Botany store to get a Vietnamese salad and a mega greens tank drink. The salad was delicious and so was the drink. However I really did not expect to find a big lump of unmixed frozen yoghurt at the bottom of the drink. So even though it's not a big deal, I reckon it should have been mixed properly to ensure there's nothing left at the bottom.

Lovely spacious restaurant in the heart of Botany Town Centre. The food was delicious, the mussels in white wine and garlic cream was so good. The pork belly was tender and the crackling cooked to perfection and the potato bake complimented the whole dish. The longhorn cheesecake was yummy with subtle flavors of kaluha and moro bar, very nice. A really enjoyable evening made even better by the polite and attentive staff. We would gladly dine here again.

The food was absolutely fulfilling and worth the price. The burgers were juicy and flavourful, and the quesadillas were just delicious. The service provided by the worker named Rachel was very welcoming, she nicely transferred my group to another table with a beautiful view, with no sign of hesitance. She is truly a wonderful person.
We went there for a family lunch today. Thank you Tyler for giving the recommendation. He was very kind and throughly asking our preference. Jonny Stash was very delicious as he said. Thanks again!

Stop overcooking my meal 😭 could be decent if you STOP OVERCOOKING MY MEAL xD. Also the floors are sticky sometimes and can you tell the parents to control their kids running and screaming everywhere oml xd. GREAT STAFF THOUGH! :D Good pricing as well :).

SUPER COOL TEAM AT BOTANY BRANCH... Really welcoming and they even went out of their way to ask if we wanted the heater on. Food was delicious and fresh and did not wait too long at all. A+ for everything. Loved the energy and vibe from the team there. Way to end our Fathers Day.

Peking duck here is very nice very thin wrap also the lettuce second course is one of the best i ever tasted. it has perfect amount of flavors with no weird smell and the size of the meat and vege is perfect.

Went on a Sunday without booking, got a table pretty fast (about 10-15mins) the atmosphere was good, obviously upgraded since I came here last. The best thing they do differently from other yum cha I’ve been to is that it’s made to order! Which ensures that your food is always fresh and hot We got rice bbq roll (would recommend), shui mai (I don’t like shui mai but this one was filled with juicy prawns, very tasty), pan fried dumplings and fried tofu are so good too. Would definitely come back
Fantastic team from the Dannemora branch! Always on time Pizza delivery or pickup. Yummy and Fresh Pizza 🍕 😋 😍 Highly recommend to all my friends and family members, cheers 🍻 👏🏼

Botany subway is best subway spots I've ever visited! . You can really tell they use fresh, high-quality ingredients because each bite is a perfect blend of gooey cheese, crispy crust, and savory toppings. Whether you’re a fan of the classics or love trying something new, their menu has something for everyone, and it never disappoints. But what really sets apart is their exceptional customer service. From the moment you walk in, you're greeted with a warm smile and a welcoming atmosphere. The staff goes above and beyond to ensure that you have a great dining experience, paying attention to every detail and making you feel like a valued customer. They're always friendly, attentive, and willing to accommodate special requests without hesitation
Pricing is insane $12.20 for the cheapest 6 inch, it is $4 cheaper at any other subway. They also don’t do sub of the day. I would avoid this subway

Great place for a coffee and a break. Nice friendly staff very helpful. Clean and tidy with really nice food. They even do art on your coffee for the gram, not only does it look good but tastes great.

Cool little food joint hidden amongst the industrial East Tamaki area. My partner & I ate in for dinner. Food we tried included… (Gyu Beef) added fried egg, Slaw & melted cheese 10/10. (Corn Cheese) Sweet mayo cheesy oniony flavour 10/10 (Curry Cheese pie) Crunchy Panko outside with cheesy mozzarella + curry sauce inside 10/10 (Choco Pie) Same as above except chocolate filling 10/10 (Spicy Rice Cake) little inconsistent some nice & chewy then some a bit hard 6/10 (Prawn Dumplings) Nice sauce but pretty standard 6/10 (8 Piece Wings 2 Flavours) Spicy + Honey Butter. Batter was a little heavy. Quite pricey $18 5/10 (Original Milk tea) 6/10 Unfortunately they forgot to give us our complimentary Friday waffle fries but no biggie lol We definitely enjoyed this Food Spot & obviously enjoyed some things more than others but everybody has different taste buds & this is just our experience. We would recommend to others for sure though. Overall Rating 7.5/10
New owners are great and give you a lot for your money

I had such a fantastic experience at Maru Sushi! The udon soup was rich, comforting, and full of flavor, while the salmon avocado was fresh, perfectly balanced, and absolutely delicious. The staff were superb—friendly, attentive, and even greeted me on Father’s Day, which made it extra special. It was so good we had to come back and bring the whole family with us. The kids really love it here too, which says a lot. A wonderful spot that we’ll definitely keep returning to!
Affordable prices compare to other sushi place. They always have a warm welcome for customers
Lovely business, friendly and affordable with a nice range of yummy food.

I do recommend that you try their beautiful meals with so much flavour, they will amaze you and make you happy. The staff are very kind and polite, and we feel welcome. I can't wait to go there again soon!
Decent portions Rice has a bit too much cumin. It’s good food but nothing to write home about like they show on social media though. Maybe I just had very high expectations.
Nice and clean place, spacious. Variety of food. They serve the most delicious short rib stew ever! Would definitely recommend. Friendly staff and awesome customer service.
Had a great time here. Lovely service, tasty dishes, and easy for families with kids.
Lovely restaurant with great service! The Asian food is delicious. My family loves it.
Beautiful food! Unlike no other. Very good price for a large group too 👌🏽

The ingredients are fresh, the taste is great, and the sanitation and service are excellent! You can even sing in the VIP luxury rooms! The hall is perfect for banquets! Highly recommended! ! A very good Chinese restaurant, a taste of China 🇨🇳🇨🇳🇨🇳🇨🇳 Friends, remember to book a private room in advance so you don't have to wait, otherwise it depends on whether there are any vacancies on the day!
We had a wonderful Friday here. Food and vibe is really good with exceptional singing and music. One room for improvement is Accoustics could have been better, lot of noise

Hi Nina, yesterday Jignesh, I and my friends enjoyed every bite of amazing food. It was beautifully presented. The fine dining experience with the live music made the evening more special. It was a lovely atmosphere. I would like to say thank you to your staff to arrange our sitting inside at the last moment. See you again. We are planning to come to a big group next time.

This place has officially stolen my heart and my wallet — but honestly, worth every cent! 😄 The vibe is always on point, the staff treat you like royalty (or at least like someone who tips well), and the food? Pure happiness on a plate. Drinks? Dangerously delicious — one sip and suddenly I'm telling strangers I love them. 🍹💃 I'm here so often they might start charging me rent... but hey, best money I spend all week!

Raja Indian Restaurant truly delivers on flavor and hospitality. The chicken lollipop is an absolute standout — crispy, flavorful, and perfectly seasoned. Their curries are well-cooked, rich, and aromatic, offering authentic Indian taste in every bite. The staff are warm and friendly, making you feel welcome from the moment you arrive. The atmosphere is quite good — cozy yet vibrant, adding to the overall dining experience. A great spot for anyone craving quality Indian food.
Most tasteless kabab ever tried. I pay for 3 sauses on top of kebab but he just use one. He just put all letus istead of mixed salid. O taste ,spend $20 worth less than $2

Excellent,excellent Customer Service Ordered at 11:30am ish Fish had alot of batter some chunky bits to cut in to Eggs were cooked ok Chips were'nt fresh oil might need to be changed Salad was ok it looked fresh in cabinet seemed a bit mushy Improvements need to be made on quality of food. Excellent,excellent,friendly customer service :)

Giving it a 3 stars as I felt the food was average for the price. Service overall was good. I felt they had a good enough amount of staff for a busy night. We had the gochujang and kimchi burger served with fries for $29.95; big mac bowl for $24.95; sticky date pudding for $16.95. The burger and the chips were average nothing too exciting. The big mac bowl was reasonably priced. The pudding could have done with a larger portion of ice cream. It was a yummy pudding and I would order again.

The atmosphere is lovely and has such a welcoming and great vibe. The decor is so nice and suits the restaurant so well. The service is amazing and all of the staff are very friendly and kind. The food is amazing - it tastes great and the proportions are huge!! It is well worth your money. We work in the food industry in botany as well and Stephanie and her team always look after us. You should definitely go here and try it out.

Had an amazing birthday dinner here. Both cocktails I had (Strawberry Kiss & Pink Gin Spritz) were so delicious. Cheesy Garlic Pizza Bread was so yummy, and my sirloin main with truffle parmesan fries, peas, & gravy was one of the best meals I’ve had out in a while. Staff were very friendly too, & food & drinks all came out quickly (was a Monday night though!). Will definitely come back.

Absolutely awesome…the reviews are a full reflection of how good this place is. I had the half chook in garlic butter and fries, the chicken was super succulent with that gorgeous charcoal flavour and that GB sauce was delicious! The fries were crispy crunchy even the side of coleslaw was great!! The lady that served me was lovely too and suggested I upgrade to a meal which save me $$. I’ll definitely be back!

Recently tried the pho, after being disappointed in the past but was pleasantly surprised by how much they’ve upped their game. The flavour and portion size has gotten a lot better, broth was so flavourful and meat was so tender. Only critique would be to add a few more pieces of meat.

The corndog was absolutely delicious! Crispy on the outside, soft and fluffy inside, with a juicy sausage and a perfect cheese pull! On top of that, the male staff was really friendly and helpful, which made the experience even better. Highly recommend!
Ordered a bacon deluxe mccrispy chicken and they have me regular and only filled my chips half way on a large. On a slow Monday understandable if busy but it wasn’t.

Horrible experience, on a road trip so stopped for breakfast. Got hotcakes and a quarter pounder combo (cost $25) so tried to use points only to find that the kiosk wouldn't take our codes. When food came out, I got 1 and a half hotcakes, it looked like it was eaten. Very disgusted and won't come here again, looking at their reviews- I'm not the only one who thinks this !!!!
Everything we ordered were delicious. Pot of mussels with garlic bread was our favourite! Would love to try the other seafood menu next time. 10/10

I have bought Grand Americans from a few BWs and I just came here to say BW Botany has the yummiest burgers and greatest service. They go out of their way to make sure you leave happy. And thank you so much for honouring my VIP Perk even though it failed to register in the online order 🙏🫶 I will visit again sometime soon!

!!BE AWARE OF FAKE PROMO!! Walked in on 5th Sept and saw the August promo poster. I asked the staff member what’s that, she said it’s $45 for large chicken and large combo. I read the menu and saw large flavoured chicken is $33, add large combo is another $9, so a total of $42, which is $3 cheaper than the promo. I asked how’s that a promo. The staff couldn’t explain. I wonder how that promo was on wall the whole August. The food was average, classic chicken were quite small. Let’s say in this price range, there are quite a number of better choices.

We ordered via Uber eats. Presentation was a little bit sloppy and the wings were smaller than what I was expecting based on pics from other reviews. -Chicken was great! Juicy and crispy with great flavor. -Rice needs salt or seasoning so didn't have much flavour but had a great texture and stickyness to it. -Salad was limp and not enjoyable. We will try again but in person next time.

A little pricey on individual pieces of sushi but the lunch boxes are too due for and well priced. The sushi tastes great, and they often have offerings a little different to the standard options elsewhere.

First time back in a while, and I was pleasantly surprised. Portion sizes are good for the price. The rice servings were huge, we couldn't finish. All our meals tasted nice and it was a pleasant place to dine.

PappaRich Botany Worst Experience PappaRich Botany was a very disappointing experience. The food was delivered cold, which was odd for such an esteemed place. If that wasn't enough, the drink we ordered was missing the components that included its description. The only positive is that they were willing to exchange it with us, but the poor service made it much worse. The amount they charge is by no means worthy of such portion size. Food quality was mediocre; it simply wasn't up to the mark. And to top the insult, the music was way too loud, which made it rather hard to enjoy the meal or have a conversation. We left disappointed and will not return. It seemed like a complete miss regarding both food and service.

Customer service was a little slow on ordering food, however increased by the fact that they gave us a little discount. Chicken was little overcooked but was not dry, still tasted good with the sauce. Gave us loads of fries, and was good. only complaint is that there is not enough sauce for the fries. Definitely better for the money than Mc Donald’s.

My partner and I visited here for the first time. It wasn't busy and I found the service and the atmosphere pleasant. I was keen to purchase some "drink da milgy" milkshakes but they only had the one size in chocolate. It was nice just like any ordinary milkshake. I was going to order some king prawn dumplings but they contained pork (so disappointed that there wasn't the option to have some without pork) so I went with the "beef and cheese dumplings instead and a side of chips. The decor on the walls was interesting, if not a bit outdated. And I wasn't too impressed with the 'shoes & basket balls' overhead. It just didn't appear appropriate especially as we were planning to eat there. And we waited for ages for our order. The table and chairs were uncomfortable. I didn't like the surface of the table and I was worried that my bottle of drink would tip over due to the fact that you couldn't place the bottle casually flat like you could with a normal table, without worrying that it might tip. It is a small store with only two benches available either side of the walk through area so it won't offer much of a pleasurable dine-in experience. The dumplings were very salty and overdone at when I cut through the dumplings the meat fell out leaving a big empty pocket. The chips were over cooked and the sauce they gave us with the chips was runny. And then we saw the guy server pour oil which had over flowed onto the grill bench back into the vat to be reused. Is that standard practise? I have to give a generous 1 star rating.

First time at better burger, wasn't too sure, all I had heard was good things The first thing that I noticed was the atmosphere, the decor is modernized 50s-60s American diner sort of feel, thinking of Wendy's but less glam, more minimalist Service was fantastic, the man at the counter greeted me and was very polite and energetic, made me feel welcome, there's also electronic kiosks if you want to take your time through the menu, price points are about average with the likes of Wendy's or Burger fuel, my meal cost $22.99 for instance There's a self service space for sauces, salt and pepper, napkins and straws, the food came out hot and the serving size was more generous than the other chains providing a open tray of fries about the size of a third of a dinner plate, the burger stacked high was a mess to eat but very enjoyable, ingredients were fresh, the chicken was coated and cooked nicely, I can tell quality is their goal when it came to the burger There was one disappointing part with the drink, so they have a self serve system with a syrup carbonated water mixer, when I got my drink it did fizz up however upon drinking some it was not as fizzy as you would expect Bathrooms are available, nothing to write home about, they weren't terrible, but they weren't great either

Just want to commend Caitlin for doing a tremendous job on 04 September around 4:15 when I came thru drivethru. Was having some trouble with the app and she sussed it out for me and gave me top level customer service. I wish all staff could be like her. She is a champion!

I can't believe we bought McDees, now knowing what crap they are made of. BKs is our choice, 100% Nz beef burgers that are huge, good amount of filling and you can taste all fresh crispy ingredients. Yum we love your specials.
Small Vietnamese Restaurant 🇻🇳 sitting inside the enterance of Woolworth Supermarket. Nice foods and good service. Will come again.

I ordered 2x double crispy chicken taco today (Sunday afternoon) and halfway through my first taco, I found a piece of hair mixed in with the lettuce. It definitely wasn’t mine, and it completely ruined the rest of my meal 🤢🤢🤢🤢🤢🤢 I usually order from this place and haven’t had any issues but now I completely put off 😭

Seats are super uncomfortable, sauce in the tandoori burger is way too overpowering and you cant really taste anything else, the photo speaks for itself, the fries were not very good and the only good thing about the chicken was that it wasn’t dry. Update: coincidentally got food poisoning too lol

DO NOT ORDER FROM CHICKINGS BOTANY. Absolutely disgusting and tasteless food, the coating was coming apart and was cold despite we reached there before the given time. On top of it, the boss and staff are big liars and very rude . Ordered kings meal and got 2 onion rings instead of 4 and were supposed to get 3 packets of French fries got two instead.On top of that food was cold and disgusting and they said “ we gave you everything “ what they gave us is a bag that was less than what we ordered yet they didn’t accept. Disappointing service and attitude. Only order if you want to waste your money and still go hungry. Pathetic service and attitude.

Love this place. Delicious and large variety of sushi and other options in the menu. Caters to all age groups. Kids love the train whistle when they get their food delivered, adds a lovely unique experience.

Lovely spot beside the mangroves in Whitford. Waterside seating. The steep ramp to get inside might be a struggle for some mobility users but the friendly staff seem like they'd be willing to come out to take orders. Some toys for kids. There is parking for 10-12 vehicles down a steep drive. My only negative would be the whiff of cooking oil from deep fryers. Flat whites were ok.

Relaxed and spacious restaurant, friendly staff, good hearty food. Was a very cold & wet night so the place wasn't busy like it usually is. A popular place with the locals and a great place to meet for casual after work drinks, small or large group gatherings. Highly recommended!

Being seafood lovers we had to stop here, we ordered the natural oysters, tempura oysters, oysters sliders and curly fries and it was so good. Everything was served beautifully with lemon and condiments. The tempura batter was light and crispy, oysters were large and juicy. Large portion of curly fries which were tasty. The two girls serving were lovely and helpful. It was busier than what we expected but the service was excellent. If your passing through here or want to make the visit, I highly recommend it.

The best Thai in Glen Eden, we have been visiting them for the last 2 years and this year has been weekly takeaway, so tasty and that we can not get enough of it, Pad Thai, Fried Rice, Chicken Cashew Nuts, Vegetarian dishes we get Thai Hot.
The food here is really tasty—flavorful and well-prepared, definitely worth trying! 🍽️

Had an amazing experience at Pizza Hut last night! The food was incredible - the Spicy Veggie Pizza and Veggie Lovers Pizza were both delicious, and the Cheesy Garlic Bread was to die for! The Onion Rings and Fries were crispy perfection. But what really made the experience stand out was the friendly staff at the front desk. They were super welcoming and made us feel right at home. Highly recommend Pizza Hut for great food and excellent service!
Nice hot and delicious pizza in the town. Always top-notch taste and great service. Special thanks. Always smiling to Mr . Naidoo for the warm experience

Pictured are the pakora (potato smothered in chickpea batter and deep fried), chicken lollipop (chicken wings marinated with lemon juice, egg, ginger, garlic paste, flour and deep fried) and goat curry (bone in) cooked in Nepali style with spices, ginger, garlic, tomato and onion thick gravy and free boiled rice). Pakora was well cooked, with a spicy kick to it. The chicken lollipops were crunchy on the outside and beautifully presented. The goat curry (bone in) was cooked with love, with a depth of flavour that hugs your stomach. Highly recommend night out with friends to catch up after a long time between visits or a quiet contemplative experience. Friendly staff who have immense pride in their food. I always come in when I feel like having the best goat curry in town 🌺❤️

Beautiful food and beautiful people. I come here often, fave dish is fish masala! The 2nd smaller plate was complimentary as inwas their first customer to eat in of the day. I will always reccomend eating here.always good and the service is always happy and lovely. Thanks kathmandu team!

We've been here countless times at Kathmandu Kitchen and the food never disappoints. The portions are generous, the prices are fair, nice and clean interior and the customer service is consistently outstanding. One of our absolute favorites - highly recommended! :)

Was in there today service was alright to start with then she fingers me over like a child telling me my transaction didn't go through that it says no money!! I told her that's rude the two separate transactions I did both showed paid!! She still went on re her receipt which I am surprised she could read!! Then I went to my BNZ app and showed her the two transactions paid/also saw my everyday a/c balance!! I don't remember her saying sorry.... just asked me if my card was a credit card to which I told her it's a debit card it's my own money the bank puts credit on it so I can buy things online!! I also told her she should look to fixing her machine (than loudly trying to shame me as there were a few people there eating who can all hear)!!!! Food was bad not tasty just looking you can tell the snapper more a child's size than for adults and my steak tough egg undercooked (I specifically asked well done) not much chips or salad!!! Rather mean for $18 meals!! Worth throwing away!! 👎 Only bite to taste had to go elsewhere for decent food!! I know she heard me saying that was the last time I will be going there!!! 🙄👎 I don't do reviews on food now I had to ...this is NOT on!!!!

Heard this was a good old fashioned fish n chip shop. We ordered snapper and chips. Fish was tiny and the chips were generous. Both fish and chips needed more cooking time. The batter was soft not crunchy as if it had been sitting for a while and the chips were undercooked. You could taste that not quite cooked taste, so was a big disappointment. We wanted a smoked fish fritter and a seafood fritter but we're told these were sold out. Won't be rushing back here again. Will continue with our local takeaways. At least they are fully cooked.

The burger was soggy and didn't taste nice. I got the most expensive burger The server was polite I will never shop here again after the soggy burger I tried the burger not long after you opened. I cannot reply to your comment through the google app
Had some takeaways for the family . Green curry was delicious and the pad Thai should be award winning meal!!! Total taste bud sensation :) loved it
Forgot part of my order - average food. Curry puffs not crispy at all. Chicken skewers super sweet sauce. The soup was all right. I wouldn’t go again but overall was all right.
Food was amazing! We had an amazing experience. Waiter provided good service, chef was really kind. Would again drive 40mins to eat here.

I absolutely love Bombay Kitchen’s food. I first heard about them through a family referral—they told me about their clean, professionally organised kitchen, and I’m so glad I listened. Whenever I feel like enjoying a neat, homely meal with authentic Indian flavour, Bombay Kitchen is always my first choice. The taste is consistently delicious, and their delivery service is prompt and reliable. For my housewarming, I chose Bombay Kitchen for catering, and they truly delivered beyond expectations. They prepared a wonderful spread with starters and main dishes, all tailored to my requested menu and budget. The prices were affordable, the food was outstanding, and the presentation was beautiful. Their customer service is warm and professional, making the whole experience even better. I genuinely appreciate both their food and their service. Thank you, Bombay Kitchen, for making every meal special.

Delicious food and great service! I got the Zinger Crispy Kebab - good crispy chicken but unfortunately missing the 'zing'. But still very good! Would definitely get it again. Thank you to the kind gentleman for your service and sense of humour! It was a good laugh to end a long day! (Sorry I forgot to ask your name).
This is one of the best fish n chip shop veggie burgers I’ve had. Love the beetroot and mayo, very nostalgic kiwi vibes. My husband said the fresh snapper was amazing. We’ll be back!

Highly recommended, tried this place for my first time a few years back and I would honestly say I've travelled just to come eat here. Best value and portion sizes but definitely will have to say come try for yourself you will not be disappointed. Nestled right in the heart of Glen Eden Township this is definitely a place that's not going anywhere anytime soon.
Veggie burger is delicious for its price. Will order again will try different food on the menu. Yummy the food is fresh ,you can tell plus the aroma of the burger. 😀
Wasnt bad but its changed owners there now not like it use to be , fish in the fish burgers were quite thin
The Chinese style fried chicken and chop suey are highly recommended!!!

Ordered the beef pho, teriyaki chicken sushi, garlic korean chicken, and vege dumplings. The pho was amazing (added the garlic myself so not included) but very tasty. All the sides were amazing quality too. Everything was packaged and delivered with such care and quality. Payed attention to the preferences I wrote in the notes and even added a lollie in my delivery bag too. You can tell the staff are very kind and take pride in care and quality :) Thank you team.

This store is one of our local, there’s a good selection of chicken choices from burgers, toasted sandwiches to grilled chicken. On many occasions the staff have been friendly and informed about the wait times. Damini has served our family before and she is really good 👍🏼 customer service.
KFC has some pretty close competition I reckon! The flavours were there, the crunch, everything. However, the burger was a little dry but the taste made up for it. Will definitely be ordering again!

Warm and inviting atmosphere. Lovely prompt and efficient customer service. Food is delicious , definitely one of my top favourite Italian food restaurants. They also have a lunch special that would be worth checking out. Look forward to a return visit.
Beautiful kai prepared by Yummy Sushi. Colourful presentation, huge portion sizes and so fresh. I bought two platters to feed 8 adults. Still some left over! Great value.

Let's start my setting the scene... two high school girls hungry and ravenous hear about a place called kchicken that sells their favourite Korean hot dogs. So alas they make their merry way over to glen mall on a Tuesday after school. It was a treacherous journey would it be worth it??? The girls order hot dogs and crispy chicken mmmmm. They choose a table in the vast expanse of k chicken and shit down patiently. Nerves rising and heart rate spiking. The kind worker comes over and greets them. The chicken and hot dogs come. Taking bites in sync the hot mozerlla in its crummed blanket hits their lips. Tasty but could be better. Devoured. Next the anticipated chicken... the reviews weren't good. They dig in with their forks and to their dismay find a chicken as pink as salmon. Trying to scavenge for safe pieces they come across other colours... black, brown PURPLE? No white. Sadly the girls do not eat the chicken as they have exams tomorrow and don't want diarreha. Would not recommend this place unless u want some time of school 😊😊

If you’re craving something filling, THIS is the place to go. Got myself the mixed lamb and chicken loaded fries as well as the mixed kebab lamb and chicken. It was so filling and delicious (chef’s kiss) portion sizes are great too. Also if you’d like a little spice, have your food with the chef’s special sauce. Definitely going back for more ! Customer service was amazing and food was made fresh. I swear, this place is a hidden gem. Don’t walk, run.

Food was delicious and service was great. Decent price too. Not really room to dine in more of a take away. Only minor issue is I ordered a standard chicken kebab and it was far too spicy for me, not sure if they accidentally gave me the Cajun chicken or that’s their standard seasoning. Still yum if you can handle a bit of spice
I recently ordered two pizza from this store, and both were absolutely delicious. I was also very impressed with the excellent service provided by the staff. Highly recommended—200% satisfied!

Ordering directly online via their website for pick up is easy, great prices. We love the desi fried, tandoori chicken pizza and cajun chicken pizza . But for people who love spicy highly recommend the spicy tandoori bites also a great high protein option on its own. Food is consistently good
Got takeaways late afternoon. Very fast service with a smile from the staff. Well done. Food always great.
What's the point of upsizing to large when you only fill it up like a medium? Bit of a scam it seems. Would not recommend going to the Kelston McDonald's. Find the next closest one.

Well?where do I start,the decor needs a revamp or a up date,it hasn't changed since the early 2000's, dust on the picture frames the lights along the walk way where the upper booth are blown, probably the staff hasn't noticed it? I ordered the ultimate omelette, been having that for years but this time half the ingredients wasn't in it burned onions and sausage, not sure if I'm going again, my partner order a latte and told the waitress and she still said (a flat white)daaa, open your ears , very disappointed!👎

Had other dishes here too but everything was either salty or dry. The rice, was like plastic. The initial service in showing our table was like having menus and dishes and cutlery slid across the table at us. Waiters need to give better service training or be fired. Not happy with the food or service here at all. Not worth the money spent here.

Nice large family restaurant suitable for large groups. Food is good but not spectacular but it's also reasonably priced. Our large group was looked after very well. Manager great to deal with. 3.5 stars is a fairer rating.

This is a nice and delicious Thai restaurant. I tried the slow cook beef cheeks and it was fantastic. A bit spicy but nothing I could handle (I’m Mexican). The side of Jazmin rice was very good and helped with the spiciness. They have Tuatara and Tiger beer on tap.

Wow who would have thought New Lynn could have such good food. Family owned business. The food is so Tasty and Interesing. So many Thai stores all taste the same or are just heaps of liquid. Not his place. Best Thai we have had in Auckland in 10 years. Doesn’t look like much from outside but nice and intimate inside with good vibes. Good service but the winner is the food. Well worth a try, you will be back for more.

This restaurant is amazing! They are super accommodating for people with dietary restrictions (Vegan), the host was awesome and food absolutely delicious. I got the stuffed chicken and wooooow, the flavours were just perfect. Everyone else enjoyed the food also. Will definitely go back!
I made order online as below and they didn’t put large coleslaw in my bag. I only opened bag at dinner time and found it missing. Not good service to miss out part of someone’s dinner.

Great place to get a decent meal at a reasonable price. Lemongrass chicken on rice, beef pho, crispy pork on rice all around 21 dollars. Drinks are good too - I had coconut nectar which is not too sweet. I liked it.

Very friendly staff with great customised topping suggestions. My kids loved it and they rated it highly delicious pizza from outside. Thanks to the friendly team for making a special experience in an ordinary working day!! Much appreciated!

Terrible service from the three men working tonight. No greetings from any one of them, just a blank stare and then they went back to chit chatting between themselves. Had to initiate the conversation which is never a good start and from someone who’s worked in customer service for 5 + years I would recommend some professional training in serving customers and especially in hospitality. Please do better Hell pizza
The veg pizza was delicious, fresh toppings, perfectly baked crust, and good balance of flavors. Could be a bit cheesier, but overall very satisfying!”

I came here for dinner on a Wednesday evening as a group of three and had a great time! The food options all seemed mouth-watering. We got pork & prawn toast and crispy squid as starters, and drunken noodles, pad thai, and pad see ew for mains. The pork & prawn toast was quite a lovely surprise, the toast was super crunchy and both meats were balanced in flavour. Very delicious and easy for sharing! The crispy squid was also excellent, cooked perfectly, and served with spicy mayonnaise on the side. The batter was flavourful enough as is, but great with the mayo too. My noodles (drunken noodles) were really fantastic. A slight kick, and a rustic profile from the basil. The portion seemed a little smaller than the other dishes, but I loved how delicious it was!
For the Lynmall Mc Donalds. Burgers great. Large fries was only ¾ full.
Food was well-seasoned but a bit too salty for my liking. Delicious coffee. Overall, good food but very expensive.

This branch of Noodle Canteen is still the best in terms of their cooking. However, the size of their bowl keeps getting smaller and the prices keep going up. I think they are ripping off the customers.

Flavourless & stale Not worth the money

I love Asian food and we’re always looking for places nearby to have a favourite so that we don’t have to travel so far away. This place has potential, but I think the quality of food can be better.. for example I love fried round beans either garlic or black bean flavour, but when we ordered it it was too soft. It doesn’t have that crunchy texture that it usually has. Then we got the promotion fried pork., but I realised it was just full of fat and not much it was a meat. And that feels a little bit overwhelming, too much fat to meat ratio. I hope that they get better at the quality of food, there is a lot of competition out there with Chinese food anyway.
Ordered large, got small Sauces were not enough to mix with rice n chicken giving no flavors at all. Adding on my no order list. Order was made through Uber eats

Lamb and Chicken Shawarma's were on point and hot chips were a great side with it. Very lovely, friendly staff. Shop is small and homely but clean. Will definitely come back. Happy customer with two thumbs up😁

@theaucklandbuzz insta/ tiktok handle Follow me for more such reviews. We recently visited Settebello Italian Wood-Fired Pizza, and it was such a delightful experience! We had a couple of their signature pizzas and the gnocchi in pesto sauce — every bite was full of flavour. The pizzas were beautifully wood-fired, light yet filling, with a perfect crust that didn’t feel heavy at all. The gnocchi pesto was creamy, aromatic, and cooked to perfection. The ambience was warm and welcoming, and the service was genuinely lovely. Highly recommend this spot for anyone craving authentic Italian with great vibes.

I have been there for my birthday and it was awesome! Enjoyed the quality of pizza and my Italian friends and I loved the atmosphere and food! Highly recommend it. Also, prices are honest! Alberto and Lorenzo are great hosts☺️Calzone with Nutella is a must ☺️
One of the best authentic Napolitan pizza/calzzone you can have in Auckland. We ordered the Diego Armando pizza and a Napolitano Calzzone. AMAZING. 10/10
Best pizza in Auckland, I felt like being home for a moment. The dough was excellent and they use fresh good quality ingredients. Staff was very kind and helpful, I will definitely come back again

I absolutely loved my experience at this Japanese restaurant! The food was outstanding—fresh, beautifully presented, and full of authentic flavors. Every dish tasted amazing, from the sushi to the hot dishes. The atmosphere was just perfect: warm, relaxing, and elegant, making it a wonderful place to enjoy a meal with family or friends. The staff were also incredibly friendly and attentive, which made the whole experience even better. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for delicious Japanese food and a great dining experience. I will definitely be coming back!
Rocked up no reservation, they made us feel welcome found us a table no problem 😊 but you should really book because Musashi is very popular 😉

Best pizza and service ever! My partner and I live further away from this location but make the drive out here every time because the service is great and the pizza is the best. Thank you to the lovely girl who served us 😊

Frequent visitor here. I've only had the noodles once so this is for the food menu. Favorites are the sliced pork with egg and vegetables, beef Curry and braised beef with potatoes. Always consistent, always delicious. Food usually comes out pretty quick and the owners are friendly.
Fish and chips are always soggy and oil tastes old.

We were looking for a quick dinner fix a couple of weeks ago so stopped here. Had the most insanely delicious pork hock and crackling that my partner had. I had the pork roast small which was ample enough for me, gravy peas carrots kumara roast potatoes a very tasty roast meal. Would definitely visit here again if in Auckland again. Also very quick service at about 4pm in the afternoon on a Friday.

Service was great, the female waitstaff was lovely. The lamb shank was yummy and good portion, the other food was okay. Loses a point as the mussels were extremely fishy (some of them tasted off) & almost every single one had crabs and shell inside. Otherwise a nice ambience to the place and good music playing.

I had the absolute pleasure of dining at Black Salt, and I have to say the food and service were nothing short of outstanding. From start to finish, the experience was seamless, and a huge credit goes to the chef Naveed for creating dishes that were bursting with flavor and perfectly balanced. The spaghetti with meatballs was hearty, rich, and cooked to perfection—the kind of comfort food you can’t stop thinking about. The burger was juicy, full of flavor, and put together with real care, every bite satisfying. The green lip chowder was an absolute standout—creamy, indulgent, and showcasing fresh New Zealand mussels beautifully. And the Caesar salad was crisp, fresh, and elevated with just the right amount of dressing and crunch. Beyond the food, the service tied everything together. Attentive, warm, and genuinely welcoming, the team made us feel completely at home. If you’re looking for a place where every dish is cooked with passion and delivered with a smile, Black Salt is the spot. Compliments to chef Naveed and the service staff for such a memorable meal—we’ll definitely be back!

Took my grandfather here for his birthday, on recommendation from a friend who works there part time. Did not disappoint! Good food, good value, lovely staff! Was quite filling and very satisfying, the waitresses were friendly. All round good vibes, they even gave my grandad a special little treat for his birthday.
very good food and the spice they make is very hot really nice lamb vindaloo but the fact your paying so much money for curry and charging for rice good lassi but be warned

Chill little cafe with really lovely staff that’s been a corner of the community for decades. Seems like a great place to hang out - if a little well worn. I wasn’t really a fan of the coffee - the roast wasn’t to my personal liking - but it’s worth a visit for sure.

Parish was absolutely amazing, if I could put 10 stars I would. Had such an impression that he ran the restaurant on his own. He was lovely, friendly, gave us choices and recommendations, checked on us all the time and at the same time the area was all clean from fishes and tables set for new customers . It was a great experience and thanks to Parish. Well done , definitely deserves a pay rise and a promotion. Will definitely recommend and come back. Thanks 🙏

Pizza Hut never disappoints when it comes to comfort food. The pizzas are always fresh, with a good balance of toppings, cheese, and crust options. Delivery is usually quick, and the staff is friendly. The variety of sides like garlic bread and wings makes it a complete meal. A great choice when you’re craving classic pizza flavors.

I always come here when I crave fried rice . They make the best fried rice I have had. Absolutely delicious! And the price isn't bad at all . Solid portion too! Highly recommend. My go to is spicy chicken fried rice .
Love the noodles - super friendly staff too!

The whole family loved our meal at Mumbai chef and everything we ordered was delicious and reasonably priced. The waiter was very friendly and thoughtful and there is parking right outside the restaurant. We look forward to going back!
Had a beautiful dinner here. I would 10/10 would recommend this place for anyone wanting to taste authentic Indian food. Definitely will be coming back

We found this place when our usual spots were closed this evening. The curries were good, my daughter enjoyed the mild butter chicken, and I had a medium-spice Saag chicken. Although the "medium" spice was a bit too mild for me. We also enjoyed the cheese and garlic naan's, and my daughter especially loved her mango lassi! The service was friendly, and the atmosphere was warm. We got takeout this time, but it looks like a nice spot to dine in too... Give it a go if you're in the mood for Indian and in the Glen Eden, New Lynn, Titirangi area.

These ladies provide authentic pacific kai that is affordable and made with the best ingredients and alofa ever! I would highly recommend 3 choices ...I had chop suey, stir fry vegetables and chicken curry, Yum 😋

This is honestly Auckland’s best chicken burger. It is so moist. Had to go back twice, and we will be going back multiple times in the future. Even though we took about 20 mins to get home, it is still held up its structure and still warm. The smashed burgers are so good, very thin and crispy with lots of cheese. Alongside this, the staff is so friendly and the place is decked out with cool little trinkets.

Right off the bat the atmosphere and service in this place is awesome, they guys there are really cool and the decor is excellent. I had the Avondale secret burger, and while it was tasty, I feel like it didn’t quite live up to the hype. The bun was great and it was perfectly sauced, just the right amount of juiciness. Great place and will probably go back and try another burger. (Disclaimer I don’t typically go for smash burgers, so take with a grain of salt). Presentation of the burger was great and the prices were pretty agreeable. Nice fries. The food came out quickly and there was a great selection of sauces on the tables.
Tasty lunch of freshly made bahn mi and chargrilled pork w vermicelli. The dressing/soup had a nice chilli kick and worked well with the noodles and salad. Basic cafe with very friendly service.

I’m a big fan of banh mi and have tried them from many different places, so I was really looking forward to trying one here. Unfortunately, this was a huge disappointment. When we opened the sandwich, we honestly thought they forgot to put the pork in. After checking, we found it was there but sliced so thin (thinner than bacon) that you couldn’t even taste it. The sandwich was completely overpowered by carrots, cabbage, and coriander, making it more like a veggie roll than a banh mi. Part of what makes a good banh mi special is the balance fresh herbs and pickles paired with generous, flavorful meat. At other places, I’ve had sandwiches so packed with pork or chicken that you could barely close the bread. Here, it was the total opposite stingy on the protein, no flavor balance, and not worth the price at all. Really disappointing experience, especially for anyone who actually knows and enjoys what a good banh mi should be.
Dear Customers, Hello, please find our latest menu prices in the images attached to this review. Thank you!! From Bamboo Garden Takeaways
Was good the first time I had it. Both times I’ve had it after that the quantity of meat to rice went down significantly. Meat was less than half of what it was and the amount of rice was the same
Tried their Chicken Wrap and Chicken Shewarma... Best wraps and Sharwarma I ever had in Auckland. Good quality and decent amount of meat and veggies. Chicken wrap is juicy and delicious. Must try

One of the best kebab on rice in town I've tasted. Meat and veges are very fresh all the time
“The chicken and lamb mix wrap at Kebabista Grill was amazing! Juicy, full of flavor, and perfectly balanced. Definitely one of the best wraps I’ve ever had — highly recommend!”

We had a team building dinner here. Very clean restaurant. Fresh variety of meat and seafood. Great selection of sauces and pairing descriptions. Nice buffet alternative range. Lots of room. Can’t emphasise the cleanliness enough ❤️ Probably gets busy throughout the week. We were there on Monday. Lovely engaging staff. Will definitely go back! ❤️

I tried many Indian eateries here in Auckland and found the pure real Indian authentic taste. Their papdi chaat and pav bhaji was really good, as expected. Overall value for money with great service and cleanliness. Special thanks to the owner, sort the tables out for us for dine-in! This will be our go-to place.
Simply amazing out of this world samosas. A bit expensive, but totally worth it. Dhokla too was excellent. Thepla again amazing. All in all super food. Highly recommend.
Beautiful food, amazing atmosphere. My friends and I popped in for a bite to eat and left immensely satisfied!! The staff are so sweet and kind.

"Amazing experience! The service was top-notch - friendly, attentive, and efficient. The food was delicious and exceeded my expectations. Highly recommend this coffee shop for a great cup of coffee and tasty treats.

I've been coming here for years especially for their lunch special and my granddaughter absolutely loves their butter chicken. Last night was awesome as I saw they were open 9:55pm and called them and no problems and cooked perfectly! Great people! Great food!

Delicious ribs with a good amount of smokey flavour. Abundant range of sauces to choose from. Delicious Mac n cheese. The only let down: we ordered the full rack (12 bones) and were only given 10 :( otherwise 5 stars!

The place is spacious, with both indoor and outdoor seating. They have a massive smoker onsite, which was really cool to see in action during our visit. Service was excellent—staff checked on us regularly and were super friendly. We got the 2-person platter, and both the brisket and pork belly were incredibly tender, just melted in our mouths. The slaw was crisp and refreshing with a nice dressing. There are also arcade machines, which add a fun touch. One of the staff even brought over some toys to cheer up a kid at the next table, which was such a thoughtful gesture. However, as they feature sports on the TV, it could get quite loud especially when the games are on.
What a great restaurant! The best in Auckland with family and friends for sure! Love the foods, love the staffs and love being inside the atmosphere.

I recently visited Hansan, a Vietnamese eatery, and had a good experience overall. The food was delicious, with a wide range of options to choose from. I would rate the food a 4 out of 5, with the only downside being that the soups could have done with a bit more seasoning. The service at Hansan was okay, although it wasn't quite as exceptional as the food. The staff were friendly, but there were a few minor issues with the service that detracted from the overall experience. Overall, I would recommend Hansan for anyone looking for tasty Vietnamese food. The prices are reasonable and the food is delicious, although the service may not be quite as exceptional. That being said, it's still a great place to visit for a tasty and affordable meal.

We went to a date there. We got Greek Meatballs, fish and chips and for the cocktail I got "Black Beauty". Outstanding food, fresh and very tasty. The dish is bigger then I expected. Everything feels fresh and made just for this dishes. The fish was juicy and the thickness kinda amused us. The cocktail was very nice, gin,fresh mint ,a little but bitter ,but I actually very enjoyed it with the food. The bathrooms are nice and clean and they have also a baby changing station,very convenient. The atmosphere and service was really good. Good job overall. Will definitely come back.

Had an enjoyable family lunch. The food was beautifully presented, good size portions and delicious. The staff were friendly and very accommodating. Great food and fantastic service. We will definitely be returning.
Nice local place to head to for dinner in the evening, good food, staff were lovely 😄 thanks for a great mid week dinner!

We popped in for an afternoon pie time to try out the bakery’s award winning pies. Tried the classic mince and cheese and potato top pies and they were delicious! Will be back to try their other Pie Award winning pies. The prices are reasonable given how they have fared at the Pie Awards. There’s limited seating at the venue.

Taste Cafe & Bakery in Avondale is an award winner and home to some of the best pies in West Auckland. The steak, bacon and cheese pie was amazing, perfect pastry! Highly recommend trying next time you’re nearby. James Ashwin Kakapo Business Sales
Steak fried rice was flavorless and the chips felt as if it wasn't fried long enough not good at all

Friendly and cheerful couples working hard and dishing out high quality baked pork, lamb and beef western food. Our favourite is the baked pork with crispy pork lards, have been visiting them for pass 3 months. Highly recommend!

Enjoyed taking my nephew out for lunch here as food & service is great. We were amazed at how wonderful staff working here are so positive & helpful. A great experience!😊
Lovely brunch today very reasonably priced, very friendly, obliging staff 😀
Great food from super friendly staff. The food was delicious and satisfying. Exactly what I hoped for. These guys are worth visiting.
Loved the food. They are helpful and provided the food very fast. Recommended
Food was just slopped together. Very basic salad. Dissatisfied given the price.

The Char Kway Teow here is a must try. smoky, tasty, and full of wok hei. The Salted Fish & Chicken Fried Rice is another winner, super flavorful and addictive 😋 They cook with plenty of pork lard, so you know it’s gonna be extra tasty. The curry chicken was just okay. not bad, but nothing special

Hawaiian, Garlic lamb & Pepper and garlic butter cheese kids loved it

I brought this into the notice of Mr.Ravi Aggarwal at the Shop and he promised to sort it out which was the only consolation and I would strongly recommend dine in.
Best Indian food I've had in 20 years of living here. Can't believe I've only just discovered it.

@theaucklandbuzz (insta and tiktok handle) Follow me for more such reviews We recently dined at Narmthong Thai Restaurant and had a great experience. We ordered Thai red curry, fried tofu with peanut sauce, spring rolls, and another Thai curry. The food was full of authentic flavors—especially the red curry, which was rich and aromatic. The tofu was perfectly crispy and paired so well with the creamy peanut sauce. While the prices were a bit on the higher side, the taste and quality made it worthwhile. A solid spot for Thai food lovers!
Loved the food, was quick and good portion size. We arrived after 9pm and had a good dinner. Highly recommend.

The staff was nice, the food service and the pizzas were also good but I felt like that I eat spicy so the food there was not the best for my taste but nonetheless it was still an amazing experience. I occasionally eat out there whenever I am craving for pizza.
Best pizza in town and staff very friendly and helpful in recommendations. Great experience overall

Last night on Friday 29/08/25 I bought the 42b egg burger special that consist of 4 egg burgers 4 fish 4 sausages and $4 chips and extra I got 5 x pineapple fritters. When I got home to sit and eat I bit into the fish and the batter was not cooked properly in the inside and too thick I understand battering half a fish fillet to make it look the full size. Other than that the fish itself was tasteless. The sausages you served I recognize as the mad butcher plain. Those that come in a 60 per bag lot. They have a very sour smell taste and it gives customer sore stomach and heartburn cause of the preservative and sulfuric acid ingredient to prolong expiry. The chips could be better and tasty and the sauce in the burgers is a water down version to save money try the hot dogs. ** If it ain't watties it's not sauce ** Although the family Owners and Sons are nice people I strongly recommend that the cooking practice is perfected. When you take our money we expect quality food in return and not to expect that what you cook is always gonna be highly rated. So to summarize what I'm asking is to change the batter to a thinner consistency, flavour the fish or change the species, change the sausages to hellers sausages or a suitable non sulfuric acid tasting but a good quality sausages that taste of quality. I don't have any photos to show as I binned half the order. but when I return on my next order I hope quality food is served and I get what I payed for.
Excellent takeaway! Highly recommend fast & efficient always freshly cooked food plus friendly staff! 💯☝🏽 Always on point keep up the great work!

Just had dinner at this Tianjin restaurant and wow 🤩! The food was AMAZING — the steamed buns were so juicy and the crispy pancakes were seriously addictive 😋. Every dish felt super authentic, like a little trip to northern China. The vibe was cozy and the staff were super friendly, which made the whole experience even better. Perfect spot to enjoy with friends or family 🥟🍜. Highly recommend if you want to try real Tianjin flavors. Definitely coming back again! 🙌

Ordered food online last night. Food was not fresh or looked appealing. It was buy 1 get 1 free deal. Tried the first 2 and didn’t bother with the second meals. Pizzas dough was not fresh at all it was very chewy. Loaded fries were not fresh meat wasn’t fresh either. The beef or lamb looked like it was luncheon. Won’t be ordering back here again. Disappointed

I came to give a review as I’ve just visited this place for the first time - Had a Greeka pizza (pepperoni, olives, fresh red onion & capsicum and plenty of cheese) - it was truly delicious! Fries a bit average. We ate in so had no problems with delivery being cold etc. Atmosphere is what you’d expect, service was fine. I’d go again.

I have tried their HALAL 💕 bbq beef pizza '9 delicious, beef n cheese burger delicious, meat lover '9 delicious, cheesey garlic '12 soo good, tandoori chicken pizza '9 loved it, butter chicken pizza '9 disappointed tasteless 😢. Staff were friendly and helpful 😃 Thank you.

It can be busy, but if you catch it during a lull it’s a decent pitstop for a snack, been a few times and the dining area’s always clean which is the first thing we always check for when eating out. Had a slight issue with one piece of our sushi, Jennifer was very apologetic and quick to offer a replacement - so nice to see businesses (people) still making an effort to rectify issues quickly & with care, thank you Jennifer!
If you are looking for generous portions, value for money this is the place to go to in Mt Roskill. Plenty of parking as it’s in shopping area with free parking all around. Taste is pretty good too!

Very generous servings. I ordered meat on chips, and this was stacked so high but it didn’t sacrifice any flavour. The person who served me (I’m assuming is the owner) was very friendly and warming. Highly recommend- best turkish in Auckland that I’ve had.

I had a really bad experience at this Subway. The service was poor and the staff member serving us wasn’t listening to what we were asking for. On top of that, the food made me feel very sick afterwards with an upset stomach, which raises serious concerns about hygiene here. I do not recommend visiting this location.

This is the only subway, that doesn’t have a sign where the cookies are that say 6 for $6. I told her 6 for 6 dollars right, then when I went to pay it showed up $7. Then I told here it’s 6 for $6. She said no $7. Then I went to other subway the next day, sign next to the cookies 6 for $6. I asked him he said everywhere $6 for 6. I feel that these workers in Mt Roskill take advantages of us island people.

Do not buy food from this McDonald’s. They will rip you off. Half filled large sundaes and big air pockets plus bad customer service and no satisfactory resolution or goodwill. The managers all need to be retrained.

Went today at 11:30pm and went drive thru, they forgot our soft serve. We went back to go ask and for it at the front, the worker in a grey shirt said rudely* “oh youre, missing an ice cream cone? Thats not possible. Come back to the drive thru, we cant give it here.” Like the hell? We asked politely for it very rude service.

So we were ordering food from this McDonald's, one of the waitress is really good, and wanted to help us with switching a cup if possible. And then, this Garry guy comes over and say something like, no we dont do this, if you dont want these cupa, you can return it, so we return everything.

Great food, felt like I was back in the Middle East. Loads of food in a eat all you can buffet.for $30. Food was fresh and tasty, was very busy but they squeezed us in on a Saturday night. It's an eat and go type place, you godforsaken the food rather than the atmosphere. Would recommend for those who love Lebanese.
Went to the buffet dinner with the family and was amazing. Lots of great food options which where all fresh and hot. Highly recommended.
Overall okay. $30 buffet is cheap but food selection and taste wise is what you pay for

I ordered the ribs and corn from Select Pizza in Mt Roskill and was blown away. The ribs were tender, juicy, and full of flavour — cooked to perfection with just the right amount of sauce. The corn was sweet, fresh, and perfectly grilled, adding a nice balance to the meal. Great portion size, friendly service, and you can tell they put real care into their food. Highly recommend!

Chaat! It’s a word which makes my Mouth water wherever and whenever I come across it. And had two within a week. How Dan you spoil chaat? Very easily it seems. But the chaat and Kachori at this small shop just off Sardingham road in Auckland restored my faith. Had Pani puri and loved it. Just one tip. Avoid the tamarind chutney. It’s from a bottle and not very good. And for the first time I saw they gave a green mint chutney too. Mint with pani puri? Maybe a Auckland tradition

I had a very disappointing experience at this restaurant. I politely requested my food without chilli due to personal taste and dietary reasons. However, the staff member responded quite rudely, saying, “This is not India, so you can’t order anything according to your own taste.” I found this comment unnecessary and disrespectful. Every customer has the right to request food the way they prefer, especially when it comes to spice levels. A little courtesy goes a long way in hospitality, and unfortunately, that was missing during my visit. I hope the management addresses this kind of behaviour so other customers don’t have to go through the same experience.

Got the Veg Noodles and asked for extra spicy. Turned out really good! Perks for being so affordable. Ended it with some rasmalai goodness. Would recommend :) Really friendly staff, we served by Ramsingh. Try the bread pakora while you’re at it.
Very poor service. Milkshakes were warm. Food lacked taste. Order was wrong even though assistant read back to us several times what we had ordered

We come here mainly for their dessert. It was a very small restaurant. Typical of a Chinese Restaurant but pretty crowded at times. There were different types of dessert. They tasted good. We like it especially after a meal. We still come here occasionally.
I would say this restaurant treated my family with a lot of respect!!! & with 3 stuff on shift, on a busy night, they showed kindness & love towards everyone around💕 so highly recommended!!!!
The cost is $40 pp now. This place is not bad but some sauces and some dishes don’t have labels and are cold. The plates and the stove are not clean enough.
I order snapper fish and chips most Friday nights. Batter on fish is yummy (not too fatty), fish is deliciously cooked. Chips are super yummy.

so last time i went to there. the chips are crispy and gold. i ordered one dollar tartar sauce for the fish. so good. the foods are cheap and yumm. service is good too. love it. i haven't the photo of the foods cause i even forget it. but it's amazing

Owners are lovely and nice folks. Great portions, affordable prices, cooked fairly fast. I think it might've been because I was ordering so late (old oil?) but my fried food tasted a little off and I began to feel dizzy after my meal, unsure why (nothing bad happened ultimately). If it weren't for the slightly off taste and weird dizziness it was completely delicious and a great spot!

Not a fan of their promotional menu - Gravy chicken burger. Essentially its the original chicken strips in a burger with cheese and gravy on the side… coffee club should really change their chicken burger meals to actual patties not the strips. Slowish service but friendly team

Expensive. Very slow service. When it wasn’t even busy. Very average avo on toast. I could make better myself. My guest had popcorn strips. A piece of egg shell was found on the tortilla. Needless to say. Won’t be going back.

The burgers are extremely tasty, with fresh and juicy beef. The kumara fries and chips are highly recommended. Service was top-notch, and I only waited a couple of minutes. Definitely coming back again!

Small warm Indian food restaurant with excellent customer service. I ordered a delicious dine in fragrant Lamb Biryani single $20. This delicious meal was served hot with one tasty cool sauce and one spicy sauce with complimentary free water at the table. Warm Bollywood Indian themed restaurant. Authentic spicy Indian restaurant.
Noodles tasted yummy, however, just too oily!
Great bhuja selection. Noted for their tasty samosas. The premises aren't really open to clients in general. You would need to ring the bell located on the outside to get someone to allow you in.
They make the best samosas ,lamb ,chicken , vegetarian highly recommend !

Nana’s Fish House is a true local gem! Uncle, who runs the place, is from Turkey and serves up some of the freshest fish around: perfectly cooked, not greasy at all, with a golden crunchy batter. The atmosphere is a simple, no-frills local joint, so don’t expect anything fancy, but the food is absolutely delicious. Please support Uncle and this wonderful spot. We’ll definitely be back!

A humble outlet run by a gem of a person, tasty food prepared using fresh ingredients I have visited the outlet many times tried hoki and snapper with chips. In addition, I have tried squid and sausages. The food here is delicious and I will keep visiting this place periodically. Great place serving scrumptious food.

We came here for a late night snack and these guys MORE than delivered. The special spice they put on their chips (which are super crunchy yummy thick boys) is so tasty and their burgers look insane!! My partner had one - I’m a gf gal & sadly no burger bun options for me, but I loved my potato dinner 🥔
The food is amazing! Especially the anda shami burger 😋 Also the owners are very friendly. Customer service is top notch!

Update - had a really good dinner with good service. Food came out quick and was delicious. The seekh kebabs were amazing. Previous review The only authentic Pakistani food serving restaurant in Auckland. Service has been up and down for a while but really enjoyed the breakfast buffet even though we were a large group. The paye are nice but the channay reminded me of Lahore which is such a treat.
Suuuuch underrated fries! The kebab was also really good.

Absolutely loved The Egg & Herb! Their egg and paneer dishes are spot on - especially the Paneer Gotlo, which was bursting with flavor. The Paplet and Angur Rabdi are absolute must-tries. Great taste, great vibe. Highly recommended!
I have been craving and searching for papri chaat for so long. Man, this did not disappoint! Cravings definitely satisfied. Tastes absolutely amazing. Now I know which spot to go to. Hands down 5+

If you’re craving authentic Indian street food, ‘Taste Bites’ is the place to be! Just launched, this food cart delivers a true taste of India with unbeatable prices that make it a must-visit. The menu is packed with street food classics however my favourites are chinese samosa, dahi bhalla and weekend special rajma rice. 😋😋 The food is not just delicious but also incredibly affordable, making it perfect for both a quick snack or a hearty meal. Whether you’re an Indian food enthusiast or new to these flavors, Taste Bites is a hidden gem worth checking out. Great taste, excellent value for money, and a fantastic location—this place is a winner! 🏆
First Class food. Reminds me of the streets of Delhi! Very nostalgic 😊

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Absolutely delicious and authentic Indo-Chinese food! Bade Miyan & Chote Miyan is a hidden gem for anyone craving that perfect blend of Indian spices and Chinese flavors. Every dish bursts with authenticity from the fiery Schezwan noodles to their yummy chicken lollipop and juicy chilli chicken, it’s clear they know exactly what they’re doing. The atmosphere around the cart is lively and full of good vibes. You can tell the place is run with passion the food is made fresh to order, and the aroma alone will have your mouth watering. What really makes the experience stand out is the staff. They’re incredibly warm, friendly, and always ready to recommend something tasty. You feel genuinely welcomed, like you’re part of a food-loving family. Highly recommend this spot for a quick bite that hits the spot every time. Whether you’re a local or just passing through, don’t miss this cart it’s authentic, flavorful, and full of heart.

We finally stopped at the cute little van on Stoddard Road Mumbai Dosa Express’ after driving past it multiple times, and it did not disappoint. I tried the dahi bala, which was an explosion of flavors, and the balas were the softest I’ve ever had. The friendly and passionate chef, Pooja, recommended the Mysore masala dosa, which was cooked to perfection with just the right amount of spice, as we requested. While takeaway is available, enjoying authentic Mumbai street food right there, sitting on the cute little chairs, was an experience in itself. Fully vegetarian and absolutely delicious, I highly recommend giving it a try. I have to admit, I was so eager to dig in that I forgot to take any pictures of the food!’
Great food cart! Fresh, tasty food with good portions at a fair price. Service was quick and friendly — will definitely come back again.

They are Reliable, they focus on what they do well and they serve quality product. Ollies is still an absolute stalwart in the Auckland scene, so therefore it is no wonder why the restaurants foundations have stood the test of time. If it ain’t broke don’t fix it. Come to Ollie’s and support a local business.
Lovely space and team were awesome. Love the ice cream and service there 👍

A regular spot for us to dine in or takeaway. The food quality is good and they are consistent. However, we had a rather strange and rude customer experience which has put us off. I placed a pick up order via Uber on my way home. By the time we got there the wait time on the app increased by 20minutes so I thought to ask if we can dine in. There were only 2 other people in the restaurant. We asked the lady at the counter if it was okay to dine in as the food was still being prepared. She went into the back to ask the ‘owner’ we heard a lot of yelling and were told no. Uber orders cannot dine in. We have to takeaway and leave. This made no sense to us as the restaurant was basically empty and the food was still being prepared. We asked the lady to check again or if we could speak with the ‘owner’. Again we heard a lot of shouting with ‘Uber’ being said multiple times and were told no, we cannot consume their food at their restaurant. While we waited for the order all we heard was yelling from the kitchen with Uber being mentioned several more times. When we finally got our food I asked for some reasoning as to why we were unable to dine in as this situation made no sense. I was told that we had to takeaway because then they would’ve had dishes to clean. Stunned by this response we left. Considering we are regulars this felt really rude and left us very confused. We have supported this local business for many years but will not be going back any time soon.
Niamh looked after my table and I tonight. Her service was exceptional, sweet girl and was very friendly! :) Food was great! Looking forward to coming back

Under New Management – Restored to Past Glory!!!! Was amazing ages ago but gone downhill last few years. Decided to try again and found out it’s under new management. New extended menu with more ethnic Thai dishes. Large portions for an upmarket restaurant. Friendly and Attentive customer service. Relaxed home-like atmosphere. Very spacious restaurant – great for large work parties, banquets and gatherings. Interior decorations and framed pictures provide a great immersive experience. Highlight is the Pla Rad Prik (Deep Fried Whole Snapper with vegetables and Thai Sweet Chilli Sauce), Pad Thai Goong (Prawn Pad Thai), Duck Kata (Roasted Duck cooked in spices,grapes, pineapple and vegetables served on a sizzling hot plate) Amazing Dessert Menu includes the ever popular Thai Tea with its own unique beautiful dark orange color and smoky-creamy taste. Love the little Thai Archer statue at the counter. Exceeded my expectations. Wish I could rate 6 out of 5. Edit: Yummy new sets: 1. Larb and 2. Deep fried fish cake
It was great. I would give it 10 stars. Only those who have eaten the food can tell how good it tastes.
Shame they no longer give RICE with their main dishes. Crazy! After all these years supporting this restaurant we get curry with no rice. Be warned! What is curry without rice?? Seriously!

Relaxing ambience, friendly team on the Wed night we dined. Food was tasty and well-spiced, meats were tender and flavoursome. A little bit surprised when we had to ask the staff to clear our empty entree plates when they were trying to squeeze the main dishes onto our table. Other than that, the special main dishes pricing on Mon, Tues & Wed and BYOW makes it well worth the visit. The little carpark in front of the restaurant can get a little busy but plenty of street parking with a quick walk.
The owner is very friendly and welcoming. Every time I come to the store, we have a great chat 😃 It’s always a happy shopping experience.

i went to the store for dinner and ordered hot and spicy pizza. when i asked for reciept the employee denied to gave me. this is my first and would be my last visit at royal oak pizza store. I had worst experience, pizza was flavourless and topped with uncooked vegetables.

I ordered the chicken curry rice — the portion was a bit small, but it was really tasty. My friend had the udon hot pot, and the broth was rich and delicious. You can tell the owner puts a lot of care into the food. We were truly satisfied 👍

Date of Experience: 09/08/2025 Time: 11:39 PM I ordered food from this restaurant through Uber Eats and was extremely disappointed. The food was completely tasteless and not worth the price. I decided to call the restaurant to address the issue, but the experience got even worse. The phone attendant was rude and unprofessional, misbehaving with us instead of listening to our concern. Shockingly, he even told us to not order from this restaurant again. This is unacceptable customer service and a terrible way to treat paying customers. Definitely not recommending this place to anyone.

I visited this Subway just now but I would never go there because the lady serving don't have ethics of customer service at all. She was asking in a very low voice that I was unable to understand and asked her a few times to repeat again please. She did not properly put veggie pattie in the bread and roasted. I would suggest Subway to take action on this otherwise at least this branch will be famous for bad customer services.

“I had a great experience at KFC! The food was fresh, hot, and delicious. The staff were very friendly and served with a smile, which made the visit even better. The service was quick and the restaurant was clean and comfortable. Definitely one of the best KFC visits I’ve had — I’ll be coming back again soon!”

I had a great experience at KFC Royal Oak! The food was fresh and tasty, just what you expect from KFC, but what really stood out was the service. The staff were friendly, efficient, and made sure everything was perfect with my order. The store was clean and well-organized, and even during busy hours, they handled everything smoothly. Definitely one of the better KFC branches around – I’ll be coming back!
When I only bought two pieces of original recipe chicken for my two kids. I got a tiny piece. Please stop slaughter baby chicken, let them grow up!
