Really disappointing. Good menu choices but the food quality was pretty bad. It was extremely salty & lots of msg. I don’t mind msg but this bit over the top. Honey chicken was too doughy & barely taste the chicken. Ordered Tom yum and honey chicken.
Good customer service, order was ready on time. The food was delicious 😋 honey chicken noodles were good 👍 some of the wontons had a funny taste, otherwise it was a good experience.

Royal Oak Store. Ordered wedges of which there are two size options , had to wait for 10 mins while on the hotplate which I can tolerate but when presented with the $7.50 offering ( the larger of the two options) I was shocked at the portion size, the amount of wedges could easily fit into the small container. When I queried this I was laughed at. I will never return and pita pit is definatly an apt name, it is truly the pits! Untrained staff , poorly managed processes and completely out of touch with thier customer satisfaction delivery.

Little Jimmy never disappoints! From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere is warm, lively, and welcoming. The staff are genuinely friendly and attentive without being intrusive, making the whole experience feel personal and relaxed. The food is absolutely outstanding – every dish is bursting with flavour, beautifully presented, and made with clear attention to quality. Whether it’s a casual night out or a special occasion, Little Jimmy delivers a perfect balance of great food, excellent service, and a buzzing yet cozy vibe. It’s the kind of place you keep wanting to come back to – highly recommend! Dishes I personally would recommend would be their mushroom risotto, seasonal vegetables and sticky pudding for dessert.

Little Jimmy exceeded expectations. It was pretty busy on a Saturday lunchtime but it was surprisingly quiet and comfortable. Service was friendly and extremely quick. Great menu, and the food was lovely. I ordered the chicken schnitzel and couldn't fault any aspect of it. Good wine list and excellent coffee.

Have been enjoying food here for several years, ong, how can I miss giving reviews here!! Great location Great venue Great food Great drinks Great hospitality You simply can't find any chance to feel Not-Okay here. A little bit salty if you are a light taster you can ask for less salty seasoning. To book for a table in advance is highly recommended.

Loved the food n simple ambience. Had ordered artisanal meats, kale salad, pepperoni n roast garlic pizza n wagyu short ribs and drinks. Was quite disappointed with the service as it was really slow esp with the A meat order that came after 30-35 min. I guess under staffed being a Monday. But still I'd recommend this place as food was top notch ☺️

We were a family group of 21 for a 75th birthday celebration. We were given the use of a private function room and chose a set menu. The service and food and ambience were all amazing. Nothing was any trouble for the staff and communication with any requirements prior to the evening was excellent. We would thoroughly recommend this place.

Popped in with low expectations but needing a coffee. Very pleasantly surprised to find excellent coffee and delicious pastries. Beans are roasted on site with their own signature blend, pastries come from their bakery down the road and are wonderful! Need to add a bit more to the interior decor - it’s a bit bare and functional - but worth it for the coffee alone.

We had a gorgeous array of food at our table, all very well priced and amazing positions. The salad was super fresh, pancakes came out piping hot and the eggs Benedict came with perfectly poached eggs. Highly recommend 💫
Delicious Satay lamb stir fry noodles $22. Excellent customer service. Prodominately Chinese themed menu and restaurant. Large portions, delicious hot temperature food.
Good portions and value, flavour OK, but have found hair in my food twice now.

Just tried Kairali, the new South Indian spot in Royal Oak, and it was absolutely worth it! 🌟 I had their Chicken Roast, which was packed with authentic Kerala spices, perfectly cooked and bursting with flavour. Paired it with soft Kallappam and fluffy Appam — such a comforting and delicious combo. 🥘🥞 The taste really reminded me of traditional home-style cooking from Kerala. Definitely a must-visit if you’re craving real South Indian flavours in Auckland!

This place is newly opened under new management and very tastefully renovated.Person (sorry forgot to ask his name)serving us helped with selection of dishes . Topclass from taste to presentation.we had their Mango fish curry with Apam n Parotta Prawns in coconut curry for starters. gheee dosa . Also served Onam pickles with poori .Their Mango coconut jackfruit drink is yummylicious.Payyasam for dessert. Will definitely recommend to try out if you lukin Kerala style (south India)food. visiting again is on my list
Loved the taste of authentic kerala food. Good customer service even though there is bit of a delay for your order to be served.

“I ordered chicken biriyani from Kairali yesterday, expecting a satisfying meal, but instead received overcooked, mushy rice, chicken dominated by leg pieces, and an utterly bland taste that made the whole takeaway experience completely disappointing.”
Ordered Onam Sadhya for takeaway and I must say everything tasted absolutely amazing. Even better than some of the sadhyas I have had in kerala. Have recommended this to anyone and everyone.

We recently had my son’s birthday celebration catered by Bhojan Indian Restaurant, and I must say it was an amazing experience from start to finish. The food was absolutely delicious – every single dish was rich in authentic Indian flavors and loved by all our guests. Many of them personally complimented us on the catering and asked about the restaurant because they enjoyed the food so much. The pricing was very reasonable for the quality and quantity provided, which made it even better. The staff, along with the owner, were extremely helpful, attentive, and made sure everything went smoothly throughout the function. From setup to service, their professionalism really stood out. If you’re looking for authentic Indian cuisine with excellent service and great value, I highly recommend Bhojan Indian Restaurant for any event or celebration. They truly made our son’s birthday memorable.
Food was amazing 9/10!! Meat was abit spicy but other than that it was good. The workers were really friendly too, would definitely come back for more 🤩 I highly recommend!!
The traditional hand -made Chinese Bun, yummy lunch with family. Free soup is so nice!
It's newly opened, so it's clean and nice. The food is delicious and good. The free egg soup is perfect for a cold morning.
Seen it open on my way to post office, stopped for a quick bite. Dumplings were pipping hot, came with soy sauce and chilli sauce, delicious 😋. Will be back for more, thanks.

Lovely bright place that they've made for themselves. We got a steam bun and soy milk combo, delicious and the milk hit the nostalgia spot. The ladies in there were super nice also. Good value for money
Very nice dumpling, be careful of the chillies oil.

Came on a Sunday night at 6.30pm and the restaurant was starting to get full. It pays to order early, as we waited more than 30 mins for the first dish to be served. They do provide you with an entre soup and dessert after dinner. The portions are massive, hence the price. Great taste but service could be faster

The restaurant offers a great selection of authentic Indian dishes with rich flavors and aromatic spices. The staff is friendly and attentive, and the ambiance is warm and inviting. The food is well-prepared and satisfying, making it a good spot for both casual meals and special occasions.
That was honestly the worst food I’ve ever ordered. It had absolutely no taste, no effort, and I can’t even put into words how bad it was. I wouldn’t recommend it to anyone.

So many options it was hard to pick, We went for breakfast at 9 am on Saturday, served our food and coffee within 10 minutes, and it was hot and delicious. The staff were lovely, it was clean, well laid out, and not loud considering how busy it was. Best Cafe we have visited hands down.

Nice place for catching up with friends but I can imagine this place gets packed on peak hours. We arrived at around 11:30am on a Saturday so it was pretty quiet. Parking was a bit of a challenge. Food came in relatively quick. The food was good, we ordered mince on toast and creamy mushroom. They were above average, can be better! But overall, we liked this place. Their cabinet foods are also inviting!

What a lovely local gem! The staff were really friendly, attentive and patient (while I struggled to make a decision on what to have!) We had wagyu mince on toast and creamy mushrooms (with truffle oil yum!). Both dishes were nice. Oh and the coconut latte was very yummy, which I thoroughly enjoy! Will need to try their dessert section next time! 😋

Just Like Martha is a hidden gem in Auckland! The atmosphere is warm and inviting, and the staff are friendly and attentive. The food was simply outstanding—beautifully presented and full of flavor. The fish was tender and perfectly paired with fresh vegetables, while the slow-cooked lamb was rich and melt-in-your-mouth delicious. Even the sides, from crispy potatoes to vibrant sauces, were thoughtfully prepared. This place is more than just a restaurant—it’s a must-visit for amazing food and great vibes. We’ll definitely be back!

Popped in here for a coffee and snack this morning! The lovely Khash was working, she was great served my colleague and I super friendly - she is very good at what she does! Beautiful cafe, big menu, delicious cabinet food and coffee highly recommend to anyone in the area! Nice outdoor terrace as well :) Thank you will be back! Jess, Hospitality Specialist Kakapo Business Sales

It was an excellent and amazing experience, I had never thought being in a Cafe can be so dazzling and also so calm. Their overall service and ownership has shown prestigious quality, thanks for having me and my friend!

Just had this burger and man did it hit the spot! The bun was soft but held together perfectly, the cheese had that amazing stretch and melt, and the stack of fillings was on point. Great value, and by the time I was halfway through eating it, I was already full.
Although the owners have changed over, the food still remains fresh and tasty with great portion sizes.
Great value burger super juicy and filling Highly recommend bacon and egg burger

Terrible service. Took over an hour for delivery even though the place is just down the road. They kept changing the arrival time and when I tried calling, they just hung up on me. Their excuse was that they’re “busy with lots of Uber Eats orders” — that’s not a good enough reason to make paying customers wait over an hour for a meal. Paid top dollar for this. If there was an option for 0 stars, I’d happily give it. Never Ordering from here again.

We visited this place on Monday and were absolutely blown away by the quality of the food. Every dish was incredibly delicious. The staff were exceptionally polite and gladly catered to our specific requests. The place itself was spotless and well-maintained. It’s an easy 5/5 after our first visit, and we’re already planning to come back!
Love this place. Easy to get parking, staff are friendly, food is good.

I ordered a chicken burger that was putrid and made me sick. I went in there for a refund and the manager said no and didn’t apologise for the quality of the food or my feeling sick. Eventually she gave me the money but just gave it in cash and walked away. It was a great place until this exchange. Not coming back because of rotten food. GAVE ME FOOD POISONING AND DID NOT APOLOGISE!

Apparently, this place has been running for a long time and we’ve only found this place because our friends used to come here. And their fried chicken is very popular. They have really good selections. They have soups different meats rice and good serving sizes. I can fill you up and it’s cheap.

First time trying this place about 20 minutes ago and the butter chicken was delicious! Everything was fresh, the naan bread was crunchy and soft & the meal itself was divine! Even the pricing is awesome, very cheap yet still filling! Customer service was amazing aswell, will be coming back here again ☺️

Really poor service, the woman at the front counter was far more interested in typing on her tablet to even acknowledge we were standing there. It didn't get much better with a very curt "anything else" immediately after each item. Our food was delivered some time apart, my partner had almost finished by the time mine had arrived. It was pretty average food, not worth the poor attitude or wait. The server who brought our coffee and food was great, but far outweighed by the negatives.
Good selection of food. Great tasting and fresh.

The $25pp Chat Buffet (vegetarian) is such a great deal. The food quality and variety of dishes were excellent. We tried everything on the menu: pani and dahi puri (not shown in photos), papdi chat, dahi vada, aloo tikki chat, vada pav, and chole bhature. You put your order in with the staff member for most of the dishes. For the pani puri and dahi puri, you go up to the bar and they are made fresh for you. The restaurant is great for a casual catch-up with friends/family and cheap eats. We would definitely go back again.

I've never been happier to part with my money in a lonnnngg time. Two guys chicken burger is food made with love, and every bite is a testament to that. Don't expect quick service, this isn't a normal fast food joint where you can enjoy (I say that loosely) a mediocre meal in seconds. I ordered the macaroni and cheese, and the 'famous donut burger' each bite was fresh, tasty, a joy to eat. These guy"s know what they are doing and won't compromise on quality. Next time I will try the newly added banana pudding but for now I would recommend this place in a little food hall in Royal Oak to everyone. 10/10.
I had a nice Prawn Japanese Curry. It was fresh and well cooked.

Four of us landed in this place a little late for lunch, hence the 3 stars for Atmosphere. Were frequent patrons eons ago when it was called Frolic. Years later the name changed a couple of times but the quality hasn't. The cabinet food was lovely, soup delicious and coffee excellent. Recommended.

My favourite Cantonese hangout if im starving in the Oak area. Just had the beef hor fun rice noodles soup here, even though its not listed on the menu they still cooked it for me yay eh. Bloody fast dishes too. They will do anyting for your custom and listen to yor dietry needs.

10/10 food and service. Can speak English and chinese very fluently. Don't let the amount of Chinese spoken here bother you. Any western people are more than welcome to eat here. Food felt incredibly healthy with the way they cook food here. Service was superb. The atmosphere can get a bit noisy but that depends on the customers. Other than that 10/10 place would recommend for anyone to visit. And price is reasonable.

I loved everything about it. Service was amazing. I’ve been coming here for the past 3 Years and I couldn’t find a chinese cuisine restaurant better than Happy Cafe. Genuinely it’s in my top 3 best tasting and overall restaurant! Thank you.
It was okay, the spicy-sweet chicken had too much sauce. It was sweeter than expected. The corndogs are interesting and reasonably priced.

This place is awesome! Highly recommend! We were given cups for our drinks for free! Super polite, they put on a great show while making our pizza, the man there was super kind and helpful, us 6 kids had the time of our lives! If I could give 6 or more star I would! They also turned the TV on what we wanted, and we didn't even ask. Also the pizza is top quality.

Sals Pizza Royal Oak - have had them twice since opening. Once eating in and once through delivery app. Both times were great! Pizza comes out hot and fresh and tasting delicious. Will definitely buy again from them!
We got the pork katsu curry and the tempura udon noodle soup and they were amazingggg, best meal we've had in Auckland so far, definitely coming back here. The corn tea was so yummy too!

Friend ordered a $135.2 stew soup and the pictures shown are all they got…. Ridiculous. Definitely overpriced, and very little ingredients in the soup. Just some chicken meat, mushrooms and chicken feet?? Tasted very fishy also. Friend argued for a refund but the restaurant only offered $10 gift voucher… but “luckily”, friend got 30 bucks back at the end LOL. See it for yourself

Disappointed this Buddha Jumps Over the Wall. The dish looked nothing like the photos—mostly broken mushrooms and chicken with just tiny scraps of abalone and sea cucumber. The soup was extremely fishy and hard to swallow. Definitely not worth $135.

Rogue and Josh culinarily transported by the bold flavours of Curry Leaf Onehunga! Dinner for two as a treat, in the booming hub of Onehunga Mall. Dinner was really made easy tonight by the wonderful customer service, timeliness and gentle vibes in this spot. We got a Rogan Josh (medium) and a chicken curry - we forgot the name. Both were flavourful and rich 🤑 Poppadoms upon seating (can’t complain!) and a lovely Lassi / Kingfisher combo for the big lad. We will definitely be returning and letting all our curry loving friends know ! Love you Curry Leaf xx

The Curry Leaf is always reliable for excellent food and a lovely atmosphere. Always topped off with incredibly friendly service. It’s my go-to for both easy to order takeaway and dining in - and open on a Monday! Great with dietary restrictions too.
Was welcomed as soon as I stepped inside the door. Owner gave me time to review the menu before ordering. My meal came out, beautifully presented & food was fresh & hot.

I live in Sydney and have done so for 15yrs. Before then I lived in Auckland and about once a month would get Burger Wisconsin for dinner. There isnt a burger place in Sydney like it and for years I've been craving burgers from here. While recently in NZ, Burger Wisconsin was a must visit. Good news it lived up to my expectations and fond memories! I ordered the California Burger that has beef, bacon and avocado and added satay sauce. Yum! Burgers were as large as I remember them and the fillings were plentiful. Satay sauce is a MUST and was my favourite I used to always get... was exactly as it was before, nutty and slightly spicy. The Burger was messy but I didn't care. My 10yr old daughter is now a big fan and loved her smaller Burger. The curly fries were crisp and flavoursome. We ate in and I met a friend there who hadn't been to Burger Wisconsin before. We sat by the window and didn't rush our meal. In fact, I think we stayed to near closing and didn't get chased out. Highly rated experience...!

Great burgers but the website does t work for getting delivery. Kept pushing complete and it wouldn't go to next page. Uber eat options were so different we had to make big compromises to get those delivered.
Burger and fries were delicious and customer service was very good too.

Worth waiting in the crowd . Crispy Chicken Nibble far beyond any experience. 30 mins after take away home, no lost for crispy feel and most of all still keeping the meat texture inside I fresh and juicy taste , cook to just right! Dropped in at this first time passing by and discovered this great place. Well , also thanks for the plenty easy parkings at shop front.
Nice little shop, received good customer service. The food tasted well apart from the broccoli and cauliflower had a weird off taste to it but overall was good, thank you.
Good food and service Try to add more vegetarian options.
It’s okay
Brilliant local pub with fantastic community feel. Great pub food for sure!
Good ambience. Lots of different spaces where you can relax. Service is efficient and friendly without being over-bearing. Haven't tried food there yet so can not rate.

I used to be a regular here in 2003. Yup, I’m old. After almost two decades living abroad I’m again an Ellerslie local and pleased that Union Post is again a local destination for me. The service is impeccable - welcoming, friendly, professional. Good selection of tap beers, fellow patrons are amicable, and the decor is tasteful and attractive. Haven’t eaten here in 22 years but I plan to rectify that soon enough. Great place with great staff. Highly recommended.

Had an excellent meal at Union Post last night – the food was really good. Unfortunately, the service and experience let it down. We ordered pizza and were offered a second one free as part of the night’s deal. However, it was never mentioned that the second pizza had to be eaten on the premises. When we asked for a doggy bag to take the leftovers home, we were told we couldn’t because of the two-for-one deal. Instead of being able to enjoy it the next day, we were told the pizza would be thrown away – which felt wasteful and customer-unfriendly. Service was clearly understaffed. I had to go up to the bar to order more drinks, and when our table became cluttered, I moved some empty plates and glasses to another unused table. A staff member acted like THE MATRON then came over and told me not to do this as it was “inconveniencing her,” which didn’t sit well. Overall, the food itself was great, but the service and rigid policies really affected the experience. A bit more flexibility and customer care would go a long way in encouraging people to return We did place the pizza in a normal takeaway box and was told by THE MATRON not to do this again. Weird service. We also didn't receive our 10% discount as we stayed at the La Quinta in Ellerslie and I did mention this to the server when we placed their initial beverage order
Food tasted ok.

Unfortunately after spending $30 To Uber there at 10:30pm when there opening hours state they are open to midnight we were told they are closed. Bar tender very unapologetic to say the least and non helpful on to where to go to find somewhere open when asked . Very disappointing and a little shameful when visiting with a tourist in tow makes nz hospitality look like a second rate joke. I am sure they are a good place to drink at when open asked bartender to tell the owner to update opening hours on google so doesn’t happen to others but I wouldn’t bank on it so maybe ring before going after 10pm is my best advice to those looking for a drink. So yeah not impressed and quite frankly embarrassed for us kiwis.
Great little pub in Ellerslie. Laid back spot with a great beer garden and plenty of beer on tap. Shout out to all the staff especially, you make it great.
Fun neighborhood vibe. Good service. Backyard bar could do with some embellishing! Greenery and so forth!

I’ve had lunch a few times here recently (my apartment is a few hundred metres away). Both times the food has been good quality cafe-style fare, and prices are reasonable for the post-COVID environment. I like the place and food and expect to eat here two to three times a fortnight. Happy to recommend to locals, people visiting Central Park for business, and anyone else who doesn’t have small noisy offspring.

Located in the center of a number of business offices. Its a cafe/restaurant and a variety of pasteris and food to choose from. Coffee was great as well. The seating arrangements was quite nice as well. Price was a bit high though but overall, would definitely recommend to have a visit.

Excellent food here all week round. Selection of cabinet and menu food is very wide to cater to any taste. I got the Dutch cocoa hot cakes and egg Benedict, and both dishes were deliciously creative and impressed me. Good coffee too. Only downside is that it is hard to find parking so we had to park on the street, but is better if you work nearby and can walk where
Pork buns, sweet and sour pork (i added the bell peppers) and breaded shrimp (tempura) was really nice that much sweet and sour for only $15 really nice 😊

The pizza was dry cold & hard. Almost like it was from the day before? Even tried warming it up in the microwave but that didn’t help We’ve had the margarita before & it was pretty good so not sure what’s going on -5 stars 👎🏼

We ordered from Hell Pizza Ellerslie recently and the food was reliably tasty, as expected. The pizzas had generous toppings, the bases were crisp, and the flavour combinations were bold—especially the gourmet options. The kids enjoyed their mini pizzas too, which is always a win. Service was decent, though the wait time was a bit longer than expected. The staff were friendly but seemed a little stretched during the busy period. The store itself is clean and has a cool, edgy vibe that fits the Hell brand. One thing to note is parking can be a bit tricky around Ellerslie Village, especially during peak hours, so plan ahead if you’re picking up. Overall, Hell Pizza Ellerslie delivers on flavour and creativity, but a bit more speed and smoother service would make the experience even better.

Highly recommend one of the best restaurant, the food we order have great spice and aroma. We love the food especially know they don't use cream on the dish we order good size portions. The service is the top especially waitress Samya (Hope didn't spell her name wrong) great personality. Parking is great !

Used the drive-thru, was asked to park in the waiting bay, car before got food, cars behind me got food, after 5 minutes I went inside to staff that all had their backs to the counter then acted confused while they remade my order... Mistakes happen I get that but the atmosphere inside the store was horrible, zero customer focus, they make government departments seen proficient and customer centric by comparison
Surprisingly one of three best maccas visit that I’ve ever had. Service was fast, fries were fresh, burgers tasted good. I hope this is the status quo of this maccas. Ka pai!
Best Pizzahut I’ve ever been too, has quality pizzas and nice and amazing workers. have always gotten my pizza fast and always on time

Really happy we decided to dine here, we LOVED our food, we had the lunch specials which were delicious. They had plenty of options to choose from and our food left us feeling full. Would definitely recommend to anyone looking for good food in Onehunga.
I always order the kids butter chicken on uber eats as it very mild for me the chicken is so moist the rice just perfect the kids portion is just enough 👌 this is my 3rd time now thank you 😊

Spice Trade consistently delivers exceptional food quality. The dishes are prepared with evident attention to detail, using fresh and high-quality ingredients. The flavors are authentic, well-balanced, and showcase a refined use of spices that enhances the dining experience without overwhelming it. Each meal is served at the appropriate temperature and presented with care, reflecting the restaurant’s commitment to excellence. I would highly recommend Spice Trade to anyone seeking a memorable dining experience defined by superior food quality and professionalism.

I travel VERY FAR to enjoy not only food, but the welcoming personalities of Smarilca and the Chef Deepalc. They make you feel like family and not just a customer. So everyday for the last Three Years I have come here and each visit is ALWAYS a GREAT VISIT!!!! A++++++ Timmy Lou

I think this Subway location needs a change in ownership. The staff here consistently push customers to add extras at every stage of making a sandwich, from the bread selection all the way to salt and pepper. It seems clear they’re instructed to do this, making customers think the add-ons are kinda generously recommended, when in fact they come at an extra charge. Unless you’re careful, you’ll end up paying more without being told upfront it will cost. But that’s not even the worst part. The owner, who is usually at the counter, repeatedly tries to charge the full price when I order the “Sub of the Day.” On three separate occasions, I had to point out the mistake, and each time she responded with doesnt-make-sense excuses instead of an apology, only then adjusting the price. When she should have adjusted the wrong price for three different times, it has been obviously attempted to charge with wrong prices, and I don't understand why she still stands in her position to bring up some excuses to explain her logic. After the last incident, I decided not to return. This shop was the closest to my workplace, so I used to go almost daily, but now I’d rather walk a bit further to another Subway. I do not recommend this location.

10am Sun 31/8. NO ONE WOULD COME FROM BACK TO SERVE ME.....TOO BUSY! LOST SALE - Went to Subway Ellerslie. After reading reviews Im glad I didnt get service from Penrose Subway. Wont be back anytime soon.
Strange to say, but they actually took great care to lay out the ingrediants in with care. Was nice having it toasted so well, most places take it out too soon. Thanks!
Subway here are pretty dry they dont put enough sauces even after asking this is my last time and i would prefer to go somewhere else instead

Extremely Rude customer service from the owner, at their caravan at the Greenlane Showgrounds today. All because I asked to view the eftpos machine before I tapped my card to make sure she wasn’t overcharging me. The kebab itself was worth $17, and had minimal meat in it. Honestly, don’t waste your money or time. Also, look at all their other reviews, they speak for themselves.

Had high hopes, arrive at 830am. Ordered mince and cheese pie and a scallops and prawn Mince filling and texture was excellent 5/5, unfortunately warm and uncomfortable to eat. Scallop and prawn was horrible and potato texture was sandy, very fishy and stale unedible, could not have more than a mouth fill , felt as if it had been in pie warmer for days. Pastry on top was excellent and nice base. A big selection of pies.. Very sad start of the morning
Great pies and pastries. We tried the creamy paua and the steak and cheese, both were really good. We also had the pistachios mini croissants, a very filling lunch. Will definitely visit again.
Super friendly staff. The lamb samosa are my favourite. Little things make a big difference. Like the chicken mayo sandwich. These guys actually season the chicken unlike most others.

Could be lovely as location & atmosphere is great - right by one of the Cornwall Park car parks (though difficult to find parking at peak times) with a wide ranging menu and an indoor-outdoor feel. No wi-fi. When I arrived (around 2:30 pm) it was counter food only (savoury and sweets, but the team very kindly warmed my pesto roll up for me). Hot chocolate was OK-ish. The pesto roll was average (felt microwave warmed ... as not very crispy and quite doughy) ... but what let the place down was the dirty tables and incessant pigeons! Surely a health/safety issue with all the droppings all over the table? I can understand the pigeons are hard to control (though table cleanliness shouldn't be) but I couldn't actually finish my snack in peace .... and wanted to stay longer but sadly had to leave as the birds literally swooped down taking food off the plates and trying to flap them away (without any help from the staff) was unsuccessful.
Chicken skewer with a dash of a sweetisg glazing. $5. A generous offer of sushi.

We had a group of 23 and went with the Set Menu option. It was perfect! Plenty of food, all delicious, unexpected added little extras for vegetarians and they made me a different type of taco because I didn’t like mushrooms. Was above and beyond service. The drinks were delicious. I’ve been a big fan of Mexico since it first opened but hadn’t made it in for a while and was so pleased to see it still has the high calibre of food, drinks and service I’ve always experienced there. Right from booking until finishing up the meal it was a super smooth process and I felt like they were extremely accommodating.
Excellent! Great service, solid good, very clean rest rooms. Family friendly.
The least amount of salad in a foot long ever.. never eating here again. Literally where is the salad?
Quick fill and good food options inside. Just the toilet was unavailable which sucks! Friendly staff at this gas stop

Rooms are fairly modern, spacious and well equipped. Comfy beds and very good bathroom amenities in the rooms. All the staff are super friendly and helpful. The restaurant does great food too, particularly the buffet tea and breakfast. Enjoy coming here for work

We recently stayed at Waipuna and while our stay began with a bit of a mix-up — we were initially placed in the wrong room, completely different from what I had booked — the way the situation was handled made all the difference. The receptionist and the manager were absolutely amazing. They listened with genuine care, reassured us, and worked quickly to resolve the issue. By the next day, everything was sorted, and we were moved into the right room, which made our stay so much more enjoyable. Things don’t always go perfectly, but what really matters is how a hotel responds when issues arise. The kindness and professionalism of the staff turned what could have been a disappointing experience into a positive one. We truly appreciated their warmth and effort, and it left us with a great impression of the hotel. Would definitely stay again, knowing the team goes above and beyond for their guests.

I recently enjoyed the High Tea at Waipuna and it was such a lovely experience. The food was fresh, beautifully presented, and there was a great balance of savoury and sweet treats. The scones were warm and delicious, and the selection of teas paired perfectly. The staff were friendly and attentive, which made the whole afternoon feel really relaxed and welcoming. It’s also excellent value compared to other high teas around Auckland, without compromising on quality. The setting was comfortable with a nice atmosphere – perfect for catching up with friends or celebrating something special. I’d happily recommend Waipuna’s High Tea and look forward to going back again.
The rooms were very clean, but in desperate need of updating. Great position

One of my absolute favorite burger joints in Auckland! I’ve been coming here since 2017, and it has never disappointed. This place always delivers with juicy, flavorful patties, fresh ingredients, and perfectly toasted buns. The quality has remained consistent over the years, which is why it has become my go-to spot whenever I want a kickass burger. Highly recommend it to any burger lover!

Got the cheeseburger, super steak burger and chimichanga from here. Everything was super delicious and fresh, and the burgers were the best I’ve had in a while😍😊 Really good value for money and an extra bonus is the sauces are amazing paired with the crispy hot chips. It’s great how you can choose your seasoning on the chips, and the service in store is great the people are really friendly. Overall a really satisfying meal and can’t wait to return and try out some of their other food. 😁💯🍔

Beautiful atmosphere when walking in especially when it’s 930 at night very pleasant . service and food 5/5 greeted with a beautiful smile. i was able to see this service consistently with customers after me . Keep up the great work this shift well done 👏👏

Waited for almost 20-30mins as we are to celebrate a milestone birthday for my son here...but quite a shocker when one of the food attendants came up to our table to say " I noticed you were sitting and waiting for sometime now, but just to let you know guys we dont have chicken...Watdah! A chicken house without chicken is rather disappointing. 😞 Then the guy continues to explain " due to chicken shortage we dont have whole chicken, half or 1/4 chicken. We only have chicken thighs, chicken ribs and chicken tenders. OMG not on my son's 25th birthday, what a nightmare. Our birthday celebrant was apologizing to us since this was his choice for his birthday dinner. But Nah, I told him he doesn't need to apologize, just need to look at the bright side of things despite this disappointment - tbh can't find one especially when we had to wait for our orders and look at the photo of the chicken thighs that was served, pretty lousy, you be the judge and they were not even busy. Nando's reality check - step up!

Unfortunately, the quality of the food, service and overall experience was pretty average compare to the last time I was there a year ago. I was super hungry but I haven't even finished the meal. The salad was noticeably old. Not coming back.

Staff were all friendly but service was so slow despite there being 4 chefs - understand it was probably busier than usual with Fathers Day however it wasn’t overly packed tbh. We were seated at 6.30pm, had to approach the waiter at 7.30pm to take our order and food came out at 8.30pm - not even our 3 y/o kids meal came out earlier? Appreciate we were given a 15% discount in compensation without asking which was great, however the food was underwhelming and cold. Garlic butter wasn’t melting on the Steak but didn’t want to send it back as it would then be cooked well done (this happened to one of our other steak meals). Focaccia bread was burnt and Cheese Fondue was cold. Disappointing after waiting 2 hours to eat and having great meals here in the past.

Dil Takeaways is an amazing place, to get delicious meals at an affordable price. However Im kindly letting you folks know that I arrived at your place at 12:18 today, as google said the restaurant opens at 1100. But the restaurant was closed. So please update your open amd closing times, or else it would have a negative impact on your place. Wish you all the best.
Paper thin salmon pieces. Never had this problem in other branches such as glen innes or newmarket. Best to avoid this branch. Ladies serving were nice though hence two stars.

Been coming here for years, they never disappoint. Ordered the garlic prawn pizza, portions are great. However, some prawns did still have their shells, and the garlic bread had margarine instead of butter which was a bit disappointing because I am usually use to the buttery garlic bread from other Pizza Hut restaurants. Maybe it was just the garlic bread I recieved that only had margarine instead. Other than that, enjoyed the meal and will be coming back. :)

I've been coming here everyday for lunch for the last few months because of the friendly service and delicious subs. Especially big thanks to Nikita who puts alot of care and effort into giving me the best sandwich everyday. If I could give 10 stars I would!! Will continue coming here for the foreseeable future!

I really rate this subway 5 star. The team are super friendly and give excellent customer service with Big smile on their face always when you walke in. I have been going there for few months now and they never dispointed me so far. Keep the good work guys.
Really hats off to the lady works morning shift by her own name Niki ,always smiling and knows her customers what they want . She really deserves pay rise and promotion .

Recently visit subway sylvia caltx. All the veggies look fresh. Store was neat and clean.Great customer service by staff. I read batch name of staff member (Rupan) who work on that time. She handle alone customers and online orders on same time. Really appreciate.
Service was very friendly and kind. Satisfied customer. Recommended to all. Fav Tank for awhile. Never fails to impress, thank you Tank Mt Wellington

Food is tasty and I initially thought that the prices were a bit high, but given the portion sizes it's very reasonable. Quite a few options for the health conscious as well. Service is always good here too. Would recommend the big version of the signature burrito, it's huge!

I used to enjoy getting burritos here but my last three have been very soggy and lacking vegetables. I have tried all three burrito types with different meat and sauces each time and each one has been disappointing
Great place, I just remember that the rice they made at my kitchen was better 8 years ago. Everything else was lovely, great to come back to. Staff were very welcoming as well.
Fast friendly service and a genuine desire to make you a good sandwich. The new management and refurbished premises are definitely making a difference!

Ever since the place has either changed hands in management the service has dropped. Staff don’t listen to the orders properly. No greetings either when serving. Simple Hi would go a long way - staff working there no smiles either. Feels like they are being forced to work there and we are the problem asking them to make our sub.

I recently went to Pappa Rich at Sylvia Park and ordered the Wat Tan Hor. When I asked to swap out the prawns for some vermicelli, I was told it would be an extra $1 because "vermicelli are expensive." Like, really? Okay, fine. The real tragedy, however, was the food. The dish was a dark, sad brown—nothing like the menu picture. It looked like it had been through some stuff. The egg seemed to have been plopped in at the very last second instead of mixed into the sauce. I'm not a chef, but I know good food when I see it, and this wasn't it. Hopefully, they'll get the food right because the place was packed, and I'd hate to see so many people eating... that.
Very good spot above the bustle of Sylvia Park. Wude selection to choose from - Malaysian and Western. High chair for tots available. Friendly and efficient service delivery. Will visit again.
We had the Chicken Laksa and Chicken Curry with roti. The curry was nice and the service was friendly, but I wasn’t a fan of the okra in the laksa. Overall, the experience was good.
It was worth spending money on this burger and loaded fries.I enjoyed visiting this place.👌👌😋😋

RAW CHICKEN. Yesterday 22/8 I got a grill r plate chicken schnitzel which they cut into tender like strips. I got to the last strip to find it completely raw. It was pink inside. I returned it to the counter were I was greeted to looks of disbelief and an offer of recooking the raw food. I left the food and walked away. As I suggest you do unless you want food poisoning.
Order a regular Tropical Tank and it wasn’t filled to the top. When I informed workers they didn’t apologise just said that there was nothing they could do about it. Won’t be returning.

Brought same food last week. It was really nice and the service was great. Ate this week and all rice, rude, smaller portion (smaller container) and less food. I'm never going again . $16 for white rice and tiny bit of meat. I got ripped off. Don't go there is my recommendation.
Ordered chicken and beef pizza $15 and it was very bad, just look at the photo. Quality of this fast food pizza in auckland just keeps getting worse

I had an amazing experience at Domino’s. The pizza was absolutely delicious, perfectly baked, and full of flavour. A big shoutout to Arshdeep for making it with so much care—it really made a difference. Definitely coming back again. Highly recommend!

I had an 18 year break from Wendy’s. An involuntary one. I spent that time living in Australia, where Wendy’s finally returned in 2025 (thus far only to the Gold Coast, which I wouldn’t go to again if you paid me. Ugh.) after I had left. So when I came back to NZ one of the first things I wanted to do was have a Wendy’s burger. Which I did, at the Lynfield store. Food was excellent. More recently I dined at the Ellerslie/Panmure store. Food was poor. Think McDonald’s level. Most annoying thing is that one store can make tasty burgers and another in the same chain can make the same burger poorly. I only eat fast food roughly once every two months so one negative experience is a high percentage of my “can’t be bothered to make my own meal” year.

Everything about this cafe is beautiful from the smiling welcoming face of the staff, tasty and refreshing food and coffee. I love how the owner (Indian:Punjabi) was so humble and helpful. For person like me who is very hesitant to coffee I felt best and confident while ordering as he helps with the best combo. I would love to mention the Blueberry and Cream Cheese Muffin, OMG it tasted like heaven. But if I don't mention the date scones it will be unjustified. I had Mocha with wonderful Muffin and he packed us Date Scones and Blueberry Cream Cheese Muffin. Next time, I know the spot when I visit Sylvia Park where to get my coffee.. Thanks.

Usually I enjoy a good coffee here, but my experience last week was very disappointing. The new young staff member (looked Indian) showed a complete lack of communication skills, no sense of customer service, and carried a surprising amount of attitude. Honestly, he seems to be in the wrong field. This kind of behavior really puts customers off

We had an absolutely wonderful dining experience at this Mediterranean restaurant. From the moment we walked in, we were greeted with warm hospitality and a welcoming atmosphere that set the tone for the evening. The food was outstanding—fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. The platter was a highlight, offering a delicious variety of textures and tastes to share. The prawns and calamari were cooked to perfection—tender, juicy, and bursting with authentic Mediterranean flavors. The service was attentive without being intrusive, and the staff had great knowledge of the menu, offering helpful recommendations for both food and beer. The ambiance was cozy, making it a perfect spot for both casual dinners and special occasions. We also loved the thoughtful touches, like freshly baked bread and house-made dips, which made the meal feel extra special. Overall, this restaurant is a gem—authentic, high-quality Mediterranean cuisine paired with excellent service. We’ll definitely be coming back and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a memorable dining experience.

Excellent Mediterranean restaurant in Sylvia Park. Breakfast, Lunch or Dinner. There's something to sample all day. I ordered an Express Lunch with Chicken and the portion was just right. The food came out fast and the service was awesome too

The food was so delicious, but I think it is overpriced - just slightly. We spent $54 for two meals, no drinks. The eggs in my shakshuka was also over-cooked and rubbery, sadly. Other than that, the food was really good! Great vegetarian options too.

Nice place, plenty of seating and space. We ordered eggs benedict, one with halloumi and one with mushrooms. Loved the decor. Staff were pleasant but quiet and vibe would have better with some background music.

Very nice perfect snacks during rainy season. We ordered the spicy and soy honey both were delicious. Quiet place to enjoy the chicken. Portion was good for boneless. If you plan to order the spicy chicken bring your own drinks because they didnt provide water in house. No menu for drinks either. We brought ours so it was fine.

I love chicken and am very picky where I choose to eat it. My husband late one night (1am) bought me some, Its made to order so it’s always hot and cooked to perfection. Not under or over cooked and dry. I now eat here at least 4 times a week now. Like I said I LOVE chicken and this is now my go to place for perfectly fried chicken. You won’t be disappointed highly recommend.

Tried their chicken recently and honestly, it’s one of the best I’ve been to 🍗🔥. We had the Nibbles which was super tasty – way better than most other places we’ve tried 😋. Also had the loaded fries, which were full of flavour and really juicy 🍟🤤. You can even ask them for extra sauces of your choice – nice little bonus 👍. The staff were really friendly 😊 and the whole vibe of the place was great. I also had the Spicy Leg (my favourite! 🌶️) and tried the Chipotle Burger, which was packed with flavour 🍔💥. Overall, everything we ordered was delicious. Great combos, good portion sizes, and perfect for a family dinner 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦🍽️. Definitely recommend giving this place a try! ✅

Workers got our order wrong and then proceeded to make us pay the people behind us in the drive-thru. They then said we didn’t pay for our food, but we repeatedly said we had already paid and were just waiting for one drink. They still didn’t listen. I pulled up my transaction, and I hope they do better next time. Also, please speak up when you’re on the mic and speak properly.

Service 3 out of 5. Ordered and paid online for the dinner box. Got a call 10min after that they had run out of gravy, and would it be ok to sub out for chips which was all good. Got there almost 30min after the order was made and the chips that I got a call about was still not ready. Taste of food 2.8 out of 5. There was a burnt scent from the chicken. The chicken itself was not burnt but the scent was heavy. The chips were crispy but no fluff on the inside. I think this place has great potential.

Food is pretty good but 3rd time today coming in at 5-5.30pm on Sunday and it’s already closed. Rang beforehand earlier on what time they close and was informed that they close 6pm. Maybe fix the time on google. The lady is there doesn’t give proper portions of the food.
I purchased a teriyaki chicken and rice which had no chicken
they just opened so they have many deals, i got 2 large chicken katsu donburi for only $7.50 each! the normal price is $13
Highly recommend this place one of the best spots to get authentic India food . We have been visiting this place almost from last 2 years . Team never let us down . Great taste great food .
I love butter chicken and this place does it really well!

I ordered a takeaway from them and was extremely disappointed. The food quality was the worst I’ve ever had it was neither fresh nor tasty. Based on my experience, I would strongly advise others not to waste their money here

Love the food. My wife had the chicken BBQ and she thought it's a bit salty but I think it's ok. The mini brownie is very good too. Saw a lot of people are buying take away. 😁 looking forward to come back to try more.
Nice staff with lovely smiles on a wet day. We had Taco's and coffee. Coffee came very quickly and was nice flavour. Taco's were tasty.

Toast to toast is the place to go if you want to try something different as a snack or a decent feed. All the sandwich options we chose (simply egg, garlic butter bacon and sesame chicken) were an absolute hit; the brioche bread that contains the sandwich fillings is generous but rich. The eggs are cooked well, and the chicken sandwich was a refreshing change to the usual fast food options. Check them out; you won’t be disappointed.

Been wanting to try this place for a while and got the opportunity today. Glad I did, it was so good. I had the ham and egg toastie, and it was stuffed with egg and a delicious sauce. Definatly going back again :D
Absolutely love their Dabelhi burger and it’s easy after work treat if you work or near by Sylvia Park

I am very selective when it comes to chai and don’t prefer drinking it from outside. I have to say I have been super impressed with the taste of chai, I do work at Sylvia park so I look forward to my chai every day now. Great service, food yum and consistently freshly made. I have only tried vada pau and chai (guilty I have it almost everyday) If you are at Sylvia park definitely recommend you to try!!

Came on a weekday lunchtime for Yum Cha. There were available tables when we arrived. You select the dishes you would like to order on a piece of paper and hand it to the waiter. The dishes are brought out once ready. The food was pretty good and you get 12% discount during weekdays.

Do not eat here unless you want super bad indigestion and food poisoning! Ate at the food court location, tried their prawn, tuna and salmon sushi's and all gave super bad indigestion. Food is not fresh at ALL. Not sure how they are passing health safety tests when so many people in the reviews have said they have bad food poisoning from here. Waste of money

Saw them there while waiting in line for the new Vietnamese Rolld. Offering buy one get one free deals. Finished my Pho to get dessert. Churro is soggy and full of oil, ice cream from Much Moore 4.49 quality on top. Shake and dog, the dog is so hard being on the grill for so long I would say the texture is chewy. When I say butter spread I don’t need margarine full of trans fat. Need some serious change here to compete with so many options here in Sylvia Park.
The ice cream is awful and over charged and it costs more. Would rather go to the local diary and get a better ice cream for half the price. Utterly dissapointed

I had a great experience at Goodie Brothers Sylvia Park Our waiter, Virginia was very friendly and helpful. They greeted us with a smile, took our order quickly, and checked on us just the right amount during the meal. They also gave good menu suggestions and made sure everything was just right. The service really made the meal better. I would definitely come back and hope to be served by Virginia again! Also not forget the duty manager Callum went out of way to arrange a table on a busy day

Highly recommended!! Such an awesome place!! We went here for Brunch this morning - the food was amazing, so flavourful and so delicious!! One of the best breakfasts I’ve ever had. We also enjoyed our coffee & hot chocolate. Our waiter was great, friendly and he took good care of us! The atmosphere and cleanliness was also great. We really loved our experience at Goode Brothers Sylvia Park today, really impressed & we’ll definitely be back. Thank you so much team!! 5 stars all round. 😊
Great Angus burger, absolutely delicious with great pricing and friendly service. Would definitely go back
Amazing burger, I tried mexican burger it's best in Newzealand, mango milkshake is too sweet for me I don't like it...but the burger is out of the world 💘

Nicely decorated Vietnamese restaurant with lots of nostalgic posters and photo. Food was very nice and refreshing. We had the Roast Duck Orchard which was very good and refreshing. We ordered the rice noodle as a add on, came separately but would have been better if it was added into the salad. Banh Mi was nicely done too with freshly baked bread. Summer roll was refreshing but portion was a bit small for $16. Vietnamese ice coffee was really good! Bitterness and sweetness really blend well.
Absolutely fantastic. Flavourful, fresh and well executed. Highly recommend the slow cooked ribs, prawn dumplings, banh mi, and calamari with hot green chilli sauce!

A great place to eat after a long day of walking around the mall! We ordered several dishes to try, and we weren't disappointed! I really love the portion sizes and the presentationof the food. Our favorites were the Calamari, the Grand Master Get Ducked, and the prawn and ginger dumplings, although we enjoyed everything we tried. One thing to note is that the Kung Pao Chicken was a bit salty, but it would probably taste good with plain rice. Definitely coming back!
Great service! Food is delicious! Love the atmosphere and how they treat customer. We absolutely love this place and will be back. Gochisousama!

First time coming to Better Burger. Had a cheeseburger, was quite yummy! My partner had a double cheeseburger & he ate it all! Burgers were much nicer & much fresher than fast foods! & made with bit more love! As I saw one of the employees making sure each burger was perfect! & they sure were! The customer service, didn’t have much interaction but everytime did, such as when grabbing our orders the employee’s were always smiling & very nice! :) we also tried the loaded fries, spicy ones, the sauce was quite nice & chips were nice! Pineapple on chips never would have thought of that combo but didn’t mind it ahaha! I think they were only 9 bucks aswell n I think it’s pre decent portion for price nowadays! but definitely will be coming back to try the other loaded fries😋 but also the drinks are refillable so I think it’s definitely worth it for just 5 bucks as you normally pay that for ONE drink at fast food n restaurants etc. Definitely will be coming back! Thank you Better Burger! 🍔
The staff were lovely & friendly and we all really enjoyed our burgers, fried chicken and fries today! Delicious!!

We had a truly lovely visit to Baci Eatery at Sylvia Park. My flat white was exactly what I needed - smooth, well-balanced coffee and my friend’s hot chocolate was excellent. We shared arancini starter, then moved on to the linguine which was an outstanding dish: vibrant flavours, perfectly cooked prawns, and the crunch from the panko was a great contrast. The chicken and Brie pizza was also amazing- perfect crust, great topping, and baked just right. Service was impressive- friendly, attentive, and very fast. We felt well looked after throughout our meal. The restaurant’s decor is beautiful, warm, and welcoming. Great atmosphere, whether you’re there for a relaxed catchup or something more special. Highly recommend for both food and overall experience.

Atmosphere was amazing and food was delicious. A Filipino staff helped us chose the right Pizza as we were confused between two. I told her either it will be on the house or you pay for my pizza if its not good and she didn’t hesitate at all. Great service I must say. Must try their Veg pizza. All staff were very friendly. Great food. Highly recommended. Visiting again to try another dish.

Taco Hell is better than other mainstream fast food places like McDonald's. The food is very cheap and does fill the stomach. My boys asked what Taco Bell food was like as they never had it in their 13 years of life, we decided to let them try. They only liked the crispy tacos supreme.
The staff here is amazing and friendly. The made us feel so welcomed. 10/10 would recommend them. The place is extremely clean too
Food is always fresh everytime i buy, usually clean and people are always nice when i get my order

Fast to take your money and slow as service. 20mins for a steak burger and a soup of chips. Ask them not to put salt on my order, then they go put salt on the order. Not only this my order was sitting there ready and no mention of order ready, i had to ask if it was ready.

I just brought $147 worth of takeaways on Uber eats from this place. The food was so oily it made almost everything soggy. The fish was underdone on top of being saturated in oil! Crabsticks stale, mini spring rolls soggy, big spring roll oily. Over all not happy! My dog was happy though! Just paid an expensive amount for dog food and rubbish to take up my bin space. Rice and sweet and sour chicken average, not horrible but average.

Ordered via uber eats and looked online to find the measurements of the pizzas. I thought surely for $25 it’s a decent size. The pizza taste great…But $25 for a small pizza the size of my hand is outrageous. For reference a slice is about the same size as my 2yr old nieces hand.

Pizza Club is absolutely fantastic! The pizzas are fresh, loaded with flavor, and made with high-quality ingredients. The crust is perfectly cooked – crispy on the outside yet soft on the inside. Their menu has a great variety, from classic favorites to unique specialty options, and everything tastes fresh and satisfying. The service is quick and friendly, and the staff make you feel welcome every time. Portion sizes are generous, and the prices are very reasonable for the quality you get. Whether you’re dining in or grabbing takeaway, Pizza Club never disappoints. Highly recommend it to anyone who loves good pizza – definitely one of the best in town! 🍕👌

Been coming here for many years and the food is still just as good. The restaurant is spacious and well laid out. Lots of variety on the menu. From curries to stir fry, pad thai to delicious entrées. They also have a kids menu, just ask. Excellent service.

Good Vietnamese food. Service was ok. But was a bit busy and good took a while to come out. The robot waiter was cool but the music it plays is annoying. I prefer the real person over a robot. We wanted to order desert and we had to approach the reception desk for assistance.

We've been eating here for thr past 2 years, each time we leave full and happy. The peking duck is a great value at $60, but you do need to order it 1 hour in advance. They serve the best salty egg yolk green beans, and the homemade pancake is huge and a fantastic value at $8. We brought my parents here when they visited NZ and they loved all the dishes we ordered. Highly recommended! Update: came back again and the food was excellent! The chef is very consistent in his cooking which we appreciate, as not all chinese restaurants are consistent and you never know what you're gonna get. Not here! The free jasmine tea is enjoyable as it's not too strong, not too weak (the owner says she buys the tea leaves from a specialty shop). The 20% off promotion is still available!

A chef sliced a duck right in front of us, which was great because we could clearly see what we were eating. The price was reasonable, and the food was absolutely delicious. Highly recommend this place!

I found the staff to be quite friendly, especially the lady who I assume to be the manager at around 7pm on Saturday the 6th. She deserves credit for being very nice and friendly during a busy time of day.
Look at the state of a Mr Wedge pizza these days. 5 wedges. 8 slices. Not even a wedge per slice. Unreal
This little gem provides a while heap of food for very little money. You probably won't get your five a day, but you'll be super full and won't break the bank.

I ordered Fried rice combination no beef & the rice was very soft and looked old, however I still ended up with beef in my fried rice…. did not taste like beef and the chicken was really thin it felt like it was the skin from the chicken being used. We love our meat and tasting the beef and chicken tonight it was not great at all… there was only one piece of prawn inside the fried rice I rushed and threw the whole thing in the bin. was not satisfying. Very disappointed
I was surprised at the taste that greatly exceeded expectations, and very satisfied with the sweet and sour pork made different from my image and the green curry that has been changed to mild spicy.

Friendly and informative staff who create a relaxing atmosphere for all. Kai was piping hot, tasty and fresh!! A+++ Service! Amrit & Art are super welcoming, big smiles & obviously love their job!! Totally recommend Burgerfuel Pakuranga to all 😊

Went to this subway, got two sandwiches and paid, I wanted a single extra slice of cheese for my 1 year old daughter and was willing to pay for it. They said they couldn't do that. In America not only would they have given it but it would have been free for a small child. Strange culture

Went to this place on a first table 50% table , it was amazing!! The service and the food was exceptional, left a tip to our waitress I wanted to leave more but ran out of $$ lol , not once did I feel uncomfortable being on a first table deal. Will be back.

Drove in for a meal 4-49-pm exit 6-10 pm as it was dark didn’t notice car plates cameras in operation notice so was issued an $85 infringement for over parking by one minute in the mail . Was hungry so to buy some time as traffic usually busy driving out west Auckland. Will never stop anywhere and drive straight home to avoid fines , will tell my family and friends about this establishment as they were not busy at that time and I did wondered why , according to reviews meals were not great , maybe parking in evenings not a good idea to go out for a meal, because it’s dark can’t see signs will never go out again for a meal avoid places not familiar with and just drive through if I have to
New automated voice at drive through is a mint idea. Would be good if my order matched what I've requested though.

Actually we have been frequenting this place for a while now .. not to dine but for their crispy pork and BBQ pork (char siu) to take out. It's the best in the area .. so juicy and tender and of course the skin was crackling! We only dined there for the first time a few weeks ago when we took visiting family out for dinner. We weren't disappointed either. There were 5 of us and a child and it worked out to around $30 per per person. We had a very early dinner at 5pm so was pretty quiet around that time.

Ordered the Roast Pork Bahn Mi. Excellent sandwich, bread super soft with a slight crunch. Loaded with filings and meat great value at under $10. Would recommend. Also tried the snow ice mango. Very good as well. Kids loved it. Go out and support your local.
This place is super yummy & super affordable & they also do generous portions.. I had the BBQ Pork Banh MI & the Char Kuey Teow Beef noodles!! Both were absolutely delicious!! Thank you 🥰
Recommended place for a quick bite. The BBQ and chicken bahn mi were very good. Definitely recommended.
Amazing food at an amazing price they can customise to your liking so you get exactly what you want ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Quite an amazing Korean restaurant owned by a Korean couple (I believe, may be wrong). I live around here and was unsure why I put this restaurant off for so long but wow is it amazing! Had the sweet and spicy chicken burger combo and it was amazing, better than every fast food joint and for $15 this was an absolute steal!! The chicken stayed crispy and was so tender, 100% recommend. Food only 4/5 stars because the fries were good (fresh), but man were they salty… almost like the after taste of injecting sand 😓; their ketchup somehow amazing though, tastes like McDonald ketchup 😂 Went in for second visit, got a combo with spicy chicken soy with coleslaw, kimchi and rice. Chicken was amazing as always, kimchi was definitely on the sour side (more power to you if you like sour), but I prefer crunchy and sweet kimchi 🤷 definitely would visit frequent (as a fast food restaurant, not daily basis, fried foods aren’t healthy to eat regularly anyways 😅) The lady and who I assume to be the chef is so nice and friendly, the guy is also very friendly and very caring (always asking how customers are doing, I found it a bit ‘strong’ at first but it’s actually quite nice, haven’t seen hospitality like this in a while I must say; down to Earth, raw energy but also friendly!) Overall 5 stars ✨

My gf and I get their combo A set all the time, recommend the honey soy, sweet and spicy, creamy onion, and crispy chicken. Great value for money. Much better than chain chicken spots such as Nenes...

My partner and I absolutely LOVE Ok Chicken! We treat ourselves often to their delicious food. Our faves are the honey soy and the creamy onion. The service is wonderful, they’re always so sweet. Top quality chicken for great prices!

I was passing by and discovered a new Chinese restaurant with a rather unusual name. It looks like it serves Northern Chinese cuisine, but it's actually Cantonese. The owner mentioned the golden dumplings as a specialty, but I didn't try them today. I was surprised by how authentic the stir-fried beef noodles and garlic kale were. The owner was very friendly, and the restaurant was warm and welcoming. Highly recommended. It'll be another takeout option in the future.

We celebrated father's day with a wonderful dinner at the restaurant. And the food and staff were amazing. Food portions and the price was perfect for us. Thank you golden dumplings canton restaurant. We will definitely be back❤️

Well this is a new restaurant in Pakuranga and wow the food was fantastic as well as the service. The dishes were large and very tasty and hot. Very helpful staff. If you are in Pakuranga this is the restaurant to go to. I know we will be going back to try more of their menu. Thanks for a great night at the Golden Dumplings Canton Restaurant.

The dishes were big and tasted amazing! We ordered oysters, beef brisket, beef noodles, beans, dumplings and the buns to share amongst 6 of us. All plates were cleared 👌 Super friendly staff :) Got carried away and didnt get to take a photo of beef brisket

Every dish was absolutely delicious 😋 , and the staff provided excellent service. They even prepared a pot of hot milk tea for us to enjoy, free of charge. We’ll definitely be coming back! Perfect for families who prefer not to cook at home. 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻

This is a newly opened Chinese restaurant. I ordered takeout twice, hoping to give it a try. The food was excellent, with a genuine flavor. I recommend the tomato and beef rice and the stir-fried pork rice. The handmade dumplings are also worth trying, especially the clay pot dumplings, which are a warming treat in the winter.

Ordered the prawn, pork and chives dumplings alongside sweet and sour pork. Great service and friendly atmosphere, was even served a free drink whilst waiting for the order! Both dishes were delicious! Dumplings were crispy and juicy, the sweet and sour pork has a unique sweet flavour to it and remained crispy despite being covered for a period of time! The only note I have is that the portion size of the sweet and sour pork could have been better for the price of $21. Definitely worth the visit though!
Amazing fresh pitas with tons of filling. Not many places where you can get a huge meal and smoothie for these prices! Highly recommended, support your local!
Great food, good for a quick bite. Friendly staff. Their 小籠包 Xiaolongbao are so good.
Food and pricing is pretty standard. I will pass on the Naan next time - Wasn't authentic. Butter chicken, chicken korma, biriyani, 2 x naan - $75. Curries had a nice flavor. Rice was good.

The biriyani here is absolutely delicious – full of flavour and honestly the best biriyani I’ve ever had! The portion is generous and more than enough for one person. Highly recommend for anyone craving authentic taste.

We bought food from a grocery store, realized it was broken, went back to the store, talked to the store owner to return it, but he didn't return it, and treated us with disrespect, rude behavior, and loud voices. He said, "Get out of my store." That wasn't fair at all. ):
There are nibbles or boneless chicken which is specific for the flavors, so better to ask. The boneless one is crispy. Sauce is okay. The place is not well-decorated (looks empty).

The food was alright but took a little while to arrive. Nevertheless, the atmosphere of this restaurant was great, with many lively patrons. However, their advertisements weren't very accurate when stating their deals and specials which is quite a scam. Overall, the place could have been cleaner, including the ground and area near the window sill, but I wouldn't recommend it to anyone.
Great food, a little pricey ($25-$30) per meal, but worth it.
Absolutely fantastic coffee 11/10! Great value, wholesome, and tasty food options. The homemade cookies are a must try!
All the things proposed by the owner are great ! They are very proud of their food. They are very cool and friendly. I recommand you this place it’s perfect.
Best coffee and my delish sandwich omg yum it was a fab day sitting on the table provided the owner operator was lovely in fact went twice in one day thx again I’ll be back

We had such an amazing meal with the family! 🥘🍴 The food was super tasty, full of flavour. The portions were spot on and we all left happy and full. Service was really friendly, which made the whole experience even better. Definitely a place we’d go back to again! 👌✨

Chef and owner Vikash and chef Raju never disappoint. I always have a conversation with Vikash to understand the vaste choice of dishes on the menu. His recommendations are always a winner and he will customise your dish to your spice tolerance. The food is very reasonably priced and portions generous. Our family on the go favourite is the succulent tandoori chicken, amazingly fresh tasting chips and fresh salad with the green chilli and herbs sauce. Guess what? The lamb tandoori has no equal... Best tandoori in the country, seriously. As for other dishes and special bread/roti etc. too many to mention. We tried a lot and have never been disappointed. It is a must to visit and eat at Tandoori Grill. You will get hooked like my family and friends did. Give it a try even if you have to drive a bit. It's definitely worth it if you care about taste, value for money and exceptional attention from friendly Vikash and his team.

This restaurant is truly a hidden gem and without doubt one of the best Indian restaurants in New Zealand. Trust me, coming from the hospitality industry myself, it’s not easy to impress me—but this place absolutely delivered on taste and authenticity. The food was packed with flavour, every dish felt well thought out, and you could tell real passion went into the cooking. If you’re not sure what to order, I’d highly recommend asking for suggestions based on your palate—Vikas, the owner-operator, will be more than happy to guide you. The ambience was okay, nothing fancy, but the service and food were top notch, which is what truly matters also the portion size are really good. ✅ If you’re looking for genuine Indian flavours, you won’t be disappointed. Definitely worth a visit!

This has been a great addition to the takeaway scene in Panmure. Super fast (orders in under 20 mins), tasty food every time and lovely people. Also really affordable with curry, naan and rice for under $20. We feed a family of 4 comfortably for under $50 with some leftovers for lunch the next day. I only marked atmosphere low because you can’t really eat in.

As a Vietnamese person visiting this restaurant abroad, I was really happy! When I walked in, the cozy vibe and yummy smells of Vietnamese food made me feel at home. The staff welcomed me with big smiles and took great care of me during my meal. I tried the pho, and it was amazing—rich broth, perfect noodles, and lots of fresh herbs and meat. Each bite was so flavorful, just like the street food in Vietnam. The spring rolls were also delicious, crispy outside and full of fresh ingredients. What I loved most was how the staff shared their favorite dishes with me and made great suggestions. Their love for Vietnamese food showed, making the experience even better. I highly recommend this restaurant for anyone who wants authentic Vietnamese food. I left super satisfied and can’t wait to come back. Give it a shot!
Extremely delicious and I loved it. I tried Cha kway teow. I enjoyed every bite of it. Took less than 10 mins to prepare. Portion is also good. Pretty and nice lady 😍

Hot Nash Burger combo was absolutely bangin'! Perfect crunch and season on the chips. Nice level of spice, crispy, juicy chicken, lightly toasted bun with coleslaw the master stroke was the dill cream cheese sauce.
Whenever I crave for Malaysian food, here is where I come! Malaysian approved restaurant ! My local 饭堂 hahah

We recently had a chance to visit Walawwa during our short time stay in Auckland. Great atmosphere and food was amazing! 🥰. We tried hoppers, spicy chicken fried rice, string hoppers, egg rotti and lime juice. Loved the authentic flavours. Every dish was a complete meal which was worth for the price. Excellent and friendly service as well. Definitely a visit next time too.

This was my first time in here . Good vibes . Friendly service . You must hoppers combo meal which includes meat curry , egg hoppers and plain hoppers . One of the Sri Lankan fine dining restaurants in Auckland . Hope to go back soon.

Me and my partner came here on a gloomy Saturday morning, and the food truly brightened up my day. The signature Mr Banh Mi with lemongrass chicken was absolutely mouth-watering. Perfectly seasoned, fresh, and packed with flavour. The spicy beef noodle soup lived up to its name, with a rich, fragrant broth that was both comforting and satisfying. To top it all off, pairing the meal with a hot flat white was the perfect finishing touch. Smooth, well-balanced, and just what I needed. Delicious food, warm atmosphere, and a great start to the weekend. Highly recommend!

Absolutely delicious. Was craving a banh mi and this hit the spot. Do yourself a favour and make sure you get the pate added. Spring rolls were so good. Crispy, light and flavourful. The dipping fish sauce was nice and savoury sweet - the perfect accompaniment.

I visited Mr Banh Mi in Panmure expecting a solid lunch and walked away genuinely impressed. the Bacon & Eggs Benedict on a hash cake—and it was honestly spot-on. The dish was plated beautifully and cooked to perfection. The hash cake was crispy on the outside, soft on the inside, serving as the perfect base. The eggs were perfectly poached with a golden, runny yolk, and the bacon was just the right balance of crisp and chewy. Topped with a rich hollandaise sauce, The service was very fast and friendly staff. Definitely coming back for this one!
Been here twice, food was yum! Ordered the Pork Banh mi was fresh, crispy and delicious. Hot chocolate was great, enjoyed it with the yummy almond croissant.
Lovely setting and great value for the money. We had the lunch buffet and found the selection reasonable and the food fresh and enough of everything. Service was very good.

UPDATE: The weirdly cooked shrimps have given me the worst food poisoning i've ever had. service is always good however, idk whats happened in the few months since we were last here but it definately feels like they are cutting costs. 1. The shrimps in my surf and turf were tiny and they were quite dense, not springy and light. Half the steak was overcooked the other half was cooked perfectly. 2. My fudge cake is half the size it useto be. 3. The kids sundays didn't even have sprinkles on top and was a small scoop of vanilla ice cream with oreo crumbs. However, they did give a $10 voucher which is good i guess.

Absolutely LOVE Homestead café!! The view here is simply unbeatable – perfect for relaxing and taking it all in. It’s dog-friendly and great for families, making it a spot everyone can enjoy. Whether you’re on a date or catching up with friends, this place sets the perfect vibe. The service is warm and welcoming, and the food is both delicious and beautifully presented. My favourite is the BLAT – so fresh and flavourful! BIG THANKS to the staff for the amazing food&coffee, you truly made my day. Highly recommend!

I tried the creamy chicken pizza with beef cubes from Pakuranga Pizza Club and it was absolutely amazing! So delicious and full of flavor. I was served by Kiran, who was just lovely – friendly and amazing service. Overall a really great experience, I’ll definitely be back!

Absolutely love this pizza store! The pizzas are always fresh, full of flavour, and made just right every time. The store is clean and welcoming, and the service is quick. A big shoutout to Krish, who is always friendly, so professional and goes the extra mile to make sure customers leave happy. Highly recommend!

I come on Monday evening, the pizza served by two girls was so delicious. Both of them are so humble and friendly and give us advice on pizza selection and it was great experience, love to come again and have same pizza. Thanks

I’ve been on your drive thru for four times now. The other three times were really good. Service was great and the food wasn’t so bad. All three times were early morning. First time I got a B&E combo with a water as my drink. The second time I ordered from the app so was the third time. Very respectful and I never had any problems with my order until this morning. I ordered from the app as the other three times before and I ordered the same thing. Take on the morning and two has browns. Two seperate codes. I asked for water because McAfe didn’t open until 6.
