The guy that took my order said ‘It’s okay I ca. give you a coffee’ so i asked for a full cream latte with 2sweetners. Got to the window paid then i proceeded to the pick up window. I got handed my order and he said to me ‘I put your coffee in a medium cup as we don’t have small cups’ to wish I said ‘yeah it’s fine’ So drove off. Got to work and I discovered that not only he gave me the wrong muffin but the coffee tasted like filter coffee. Trust me when I said that I worded at Maccas for 6 years so I know the difference between filter coffee and a mcafe coffee. The one I got was so watery and no froth. It tasted burnt. I was very disappointed because last night I was going to give 5star review. The food that I got the first three time for so good compare to the food that I was given this morning. While I can understand that it’s early morning and your crew were probably tired and wanted to go home. That doesn’t mean you neglect your duty of serving fresh food to your customers. Do better please
Guy drops of wrong pizzas I managed to stop him and get our correct order but it looks like he used it as a booster seat, very disappointed.

Was in the neighborhood around 11am and decided to check out the hype. The place filled up pretty quickly with lots of takeout orders. I Ordered 3 meats (roast duck/charsiu/roast pork) on rice. It was tasty but have had better in newmaket - the duck pieces were a bit sad, only 2 pieces were meaty the rest were mostly bones. Definitely enjoyed the soy sauce and the duck sauce that I can say. Also the service was fast and friendly - the lady at the till was super efficient.

The best BBQ duck in Auckland! My boyfriend’s family always buys BBQ duck & roast pork, they love it. He took me here & I love it so much, plus it’s cheap price 😭🥰 I wish I live in Botany so I could eat here everyday until I start puking from getting sick of it xD I love it!! This is seriously good since my bf family Malaysian/Hong Kong and they have high standards when it comes to food 🤣
New owner rubbish with the price they charge not enough food chicken is very small.
Excellent little fish n' chip takeaway. Good food and good value for money. Under $13 for the combo in the photo.

KFC you have missed the mark calling your Katsu Bowl just that. It is a bowl of rice with a tiny chicken fillet with some spicy daily dumped on top. Not worth it guys. It’s a terrible meal and ware of money.

The best KFC branch in Auckland. Food is always hot and fresh, chips are properly seasoned and staff are friendly and polite. Never had any issues with this branch. Drive thru moves fast and the service is great. Thank you KFC Pakuranga.

Uber eats, why am I paying $30 for a few wicked wings???? $24.99 for 8 wicked wings???whoever is coming up with these prices Is well above middle class. Despite this. Why is my food always cold with NO SEASONING. Even when I ask numerous times I get no seasoning despite asking for extra???? What's the sting on KFC? GIVE US MORE SEASONING = MORE CUSTOMERS

Cold soggy fries and a cheese burger that felt like it had just come out the fridge with a burnt bun, didn't even know till I was driving home and by then was to late to turn around, i even went inside instead of drive though at 930pm on a Wednesday night and still took 5 mins to be served. Dissapointed over all and will not be visiting you franchises ever again. Ended up throwing out the whole meal in the end.

I had a very disappointing experience at Burger King. My order was given to me without ketchup or tissues in the bag. When I tried to ask the staff at the drive-through window, they closed the window right in front of me instead of helping. This is very poor customer service — customers shouldn’t have to drive away without basic items or be ignored when asking politely. Definitely not the level of service I expect from Burger King.

We’ve only just left the restaurant and the food was so good I had to do a review in the car on the way home! I cannot fault a thing, my favourite was the samosas. My four year old loved the rice best (lol), husband ordered the noodles which he thoroughly enjoyed. We will definitely be back!!

Haven't been back 20 years. Mandarin Palace still the same. Food is amazing delicious. Good yumcha. A few new dishes. Love the deep fried taro dumplings. Stir fry thick Ho fun. Good place to a big groups and big round table. Foods to share.

Service was really slow, on a Sunday afternoon around 2pm which is when yum cha is about to end. Food was alright (not the greatest or the worse) Waiting to be seated and waiting to pay for the bill was my main issue.

Would give 0 stars if I could! ordered subway for my colleagues and I as we normally do once a week online, we asked for it to be ready at 1pm, we arrived at 1.06pm to find a line of over 6 people waiting and the staff were sitting in the back mucking around, my order had also not been made yet, we order 4 subs, 2 paninis and 2 teriyaki chicken subs, the paninis were falling apart (couldn't even pick it up without getting overly dirty, and without filling falling out) and burnt, one of the teriyaki subs was great however the other came with absolutely no meat and no extra bacon as we asked for and again, was burnt so much that it wasnt enjoyable. Furthermore I emailed to complain and the manager rudely replied basically calling me a liar, I have Photo proof of each sub, we spend on average $60 per week there, and I definitely will not be returning.

Food safety is my top priority, so unfortunately I need to leave a one-star review. As a regular customer, I’ve generally been OK with the pizzas, though sometimes (about once in every 4–5 orders) we have mild stomach upset afterward. However, this time was far more serious. After our order on 11th Sep at 5:30pm, my son vomited three times the following morning, and both my wife and I developed diarrhea within a few hours. We strongly suspect the ham on the pizza had gone bad. Food safety is the absolute bottom line. I hope the message is delivered. If this happens ever again, we will have no choice but to stop ordering.
my go to for Vietnamese food!! beef pho is always tasty and flavourful! tried their chicken broth and its equally tasty!

What a great place to socialize in.. I really admire the staff that serve you, young, smart and so courteous, so hard to find this calibre of students anywhere who work with such integrity. I will become a member of this place👌🏼. Food is just awesome.

Just a quick meal with a friend. The people were great and friendly. The atmosphere was almost no existent due to not many customers, however it was a Wednesday evening, I feel certain on a weekend it would be buzzing. Food was fine.

Though it's not the most attractive store, the food was spot on. We ordered one of the specials for $62, for 4-6 people. it had mixture of rice, noodle, deep fried food. My partner was impressed with both the Fried rice dish and their Chicken chow mein. Great value. Will definitely go back
The only downside is the parking are limited. The food is good. Busy on Sunday.
Incredibly hospitable staff who make wonderful authentic Vietnamese food! Have tried many different menu items and they're all fantastic. My new go-to spot for delicious Vietnamese food 🥰
The lady boss and man boss so down to earth! The teas they have are sooo yummy

I am not a person to complain but when you spend a lot of money on food that that is so bad. Bought drywors looks like a raw sore. Really vulgar. Bought original biltong so spicey burnt my mouth. The chutney biltong was so soggy made a hole in the packet. Need to realise this meat can actually make you sick. I see in general there is a lot of issues with your biltong in not being so good. Also the people employed there when you take it back don’t want to taste it guess due to religious purposes understandable. This is not the first time I had an issue with your biltong. You will need to step up your game when it comes to food safety.

Great food, service excellent, friendly family run business even the 3 young children help out, so cute, love the fish and chips and the battered oysters are always very fresh tasting which is important thank you. Just went there now to get dinner, fish and their lovely chips...unfortunate that the portions of chips are now much less for the same price

If you're craving authentic Malaysian flavors, [Restaurant Name] is a must-visit... but be prepared to wait! This bustling restaurant is always buzzing, a clear sign of its popularity. While everything on the menu is delicious, the standout dish is undoubtedly the Fish Head Rice Noodles. The broth is rich and complex, the fish is fresh, and the noodles are perfectly cooked. A true taste of Malaysia!
Food is ok, and special promotion only $9.9 is worth to try.
I have eating in this place for quite a while. The atmosphere, service and foods have been good. Mostly eat curry chicken and chicken rice. The chicken are always tender and the portion are large.
We tried the brisket burger and all for one, one for all. Both are really good and i highly recommend it. Support a local business. Staff are great. Thankyou for the drinks. Will be back.

A hidden gem. I always get the smash burger and loaded fries. Their burger is literally the best one I have ever had. And the prices are unbeatable. Make sure you come early on weekends, as they do sell out. Super friendly staff too!! 🙂

I ordered savoury items, but I’m very disappointed. The chicken roll tasted only of potato with no chicken at all. The fish roll was the same – just potato filling, and they had used puff pastry, which tasted raw. This is very misleading and not what was expected. I will not be ordering food from this place again.
Legit best lamb curry of my life 👌 incredible. Treat yourself to the dosa 🙌 can't wait to come back
Special 2 for $12 2 x fish 2 x potato fritters $3 chips Hot tasty and filling
My husband and and I loved the big fish and yummy chips also. We felt it was well worth the money.
They are the BEST 5 star service I have a disability and when my order is cooked staff deliver to my vehicle 🙃 lovely 😍

Love their side dishes and the flavours are amazing. The squid has a chargrilled taste which is really yummy. The Korean fried chicken is tasty too. Lots of food for 2 people, definitely enough for 3-4people if you are not big eaters. Great little place to eat in East Auckland

So I bought a Boba milk tea drink from this restaurant and tell me why it came without ice when on the Uber app they have the taro milk tea under cold beverages but it was warm and a quarter of my drink was missing making it seem like the person forgot ice. But yeah, that's all I wanted to say a refund or a discount for my next purchase will be greatly appreciated
Good service and tasty fry rice. Gyoza was nice too. Cook as you order so have to be patient when it’s crowded.

Japanese owned and run place. Excellent in quality and quantity on most of their major food items. Ramen stock is tasty and thick (may be an acquired taste for some, but we like it). Donburi and bento boxes are really filling.

Ramen House MEN-ICHI is amazing! The food was absolutely delicious and authentic Japanese flavors that hit every time. The staff are incredibly kind and welcoming, making the whole experience even better. Highly recommend for anyone craving top-notch ramen!
Got brisket beef noodles beef so soft and tender flavors are good my go to noodle spot now yumm

We had a lovely experience here. The steak was perfectly cooked, juicy and full of flavor – definitely a highlight of the meal. The garlic bread and grilled corn were also delicious starters. However, the pork belly was a bit too fatty and felt quite heavy – I could only manage a few bites. It would be even better if there was less fat and more lean meat. Overall, friendly service, nice presentation, and worth a visit.
Went for dinner here with my partner - food was okay, but the vibe and service was top tier. We enjoyed our time even though we didnt rate the food.

Really Enjoyed the Friday night platter with 4 house drinks. Fantastic, Warm service provided by Phynley. A little noisy but this was to be expected as the warriors game was playing - great atmosphere! We will definitely be returning and look forward to enjoying more of your special deals.

After reading a few other one star ratings I totally think my experience was not a once off. Having travelled all the way from the Northshore to Howick, a friend recommended this restaurant. I had my 1 and 3 year old children with me and walked in around 11am (not busy). I asked the woman at the front if there was a high chair. She said no so I asked if I could bring my pram in. She then said that there’s going to be other diners… mind you the restaurant was half empty and my pram would not have taken up much space. I decided to walk out and dine at Eden Noodles which is 20m away from this place. Their service was a 180 degree difference. A smile, highchair bought to my table, answered all my questions politely. Some people aren’t really cut out for being front of house. You lady are doing your restaurant a disservice.

Such a good cheap eat! Great for sharing because the individual portions are actually massive. The place is busy at peak hours and staff don't offer the best service but the food is worth it. I would recommend the honey pork cutlet on rice, the crispy sweet taste is amazing.

Well, I'm giving these guys 5 stars. Especially, the tall young guy who takes the orders. We accidentally had some miscommunication with our order, but he quickly fixed that problem without any hassles. Great customer service, and great food. 💯 Will be coming back again!
author_name: 二千十九ゴ ハウクス!

text: Due to the price we don't often go to Burger Wisconsin, so when we chose to go last Friday, we were very disappointed with the range on offer. Then were further disappointed and disgusted when we saw a staffer that handled cash remove fries from someone else's order with her fingers (no gloves) and put then back into the cooked chip pile (and no she did not wash her hands in between). To top it off our burgers were distinctly lacking in toppings with one huge lettuce leaf, 2 bits of onion and 2 very thin slices of tomato. Save yourself some money and get your burgers from the local fish n chippy.

Real authentic tasting Hong Kong style food. We ordered some classics like Beef Brisket Noodle Soup, Soy Chicken (Whole leg) with Rice, Spicy Tomato Rice Vermicelli Soup, Pineapple Bun with Butter and Peanut Butter/Condensed Milk Toast. Good value for money and decent sized portions
This place made me go to a whole different restaurant just because we booked our table and they ended up having a full restaurant. They made us wait and it was extremely upsetting.

This is my 3rd visit. This place has been always busy, needs to prebook table. Overall is great experience, service tradition Northern Chinese food such as red sausage and smoke chicken. The team provides fantastic service in time manner, also keeps toilet tidy and clean. This restaurant has A grade hygiene certificate. Food service in large portion, on average $30+ for a each main course. Taste is really depends on personal preference, it is pretty good on my order. In case, you may not know certain dish. Don't worry, team members explain them in detail. There are plenty of parking spaces available. Be aware, you may still not get any during weekend evening. The only downside is atmosphere that is aged facility. One recommendations, avoid peak hours.

OH MY GOSH I HOPE THIS PLACE SHOULD NOT BE CLOSED PERMANENTLY!!!!! Well I do like the pumpkin buns and the beef leeks here and some kinds of seafood here well I hope there’s still the same food here but maybe it changed the name of the restaurant???

Love love love this place 🤩 Have been here a couple times with my family and the food is just so good. Theres a really good amount which always leaves us full. The service there is super good as well. They’re always really welcoming and friendly. I love how hygenic the place is as well. I honestly think they have the best black bean noodles in the area 🫶

Customer service is excellent, always warmly welcomed by the lady here. My partner and I often order the Jajangmyeon and Samseon Jjamppong, for us it was delicious. Since we live close by, we'll go there once they open, no wait times then :) Thank you for the lovely service.

Pizza not cut through and some not cut at all, the customer service was terrible no communication, no welcome, no what’s your order, rang up the order and walked away before payment I had to ask them back to pay, the staff was disconnected. No effort was shown. This is what to expect in the future for sure. Plastic found in my pizza.
Terrible chicken peri peri pizza, I counted 5 tiny pieces of chicken on the whole pizza! What a rip off! Never using this store again!

I see why this place is always so busy. Went in today being 1st customer of the day (2 of us), the place is run well and the kitchen delivers! Cannot fault them, service, food and atmosphere. We had Bao Buns, Pork Belly, Green Curry Muscles, Pulled Pork Loaded Fries and beverages...on tap beer is fresh and good! Will definitely go in again, highly recommended.

I visited Urban in East Café in Howick for the first time and was met with sarcasm and a dismissive attitude from a staff member. The lack of basic manners was disappointing, especially in hospitality. There are plenty of great cafés in Howick with friendly service - unfortunately, this isn’t one I’ll return to.

My family and I had such a wonderful birthday dinner here tonight! The food was absolutely delicious and the service was fast too even on a busy Tuesday night! The atmosphere was warm and welcoming - and the owner and team went above and beyond to make us feel special. Great vibes and amazing hospitality - highly recommend! We will definitely be back. Thank you so much for making our night Minos!!! What a bunch of legends! Definitely worth trying and please go support this amazing business!!

Ordered two standard size pizzas, a Bacon and a Chicken one. As well as a Lasagne between two adults and a child. The pizzas were really tasty and had ample amount of filling on a thin crust. The Lasagne was spot on and the sauce was delicious. Great atmosphere with music playing in the background. There were lots of people ordering takeaways, as well as dining in

The pizzas were perfect size and beautiful. Full of flavour and impact. The tiramisu was the perfect size and full of flavour. My son and I enjoyed every single bite of everything. He ate both Lollie’s that he was given too lol, we will definitely be back for sure!

What a wonderful rebirth of this Howick institution. I felt like part of the family from the second I walked through the door. Food on point. Service quick, considered and remembered. Screams of the local you want to make a weekly favourite. I love it when it all comes together. Just get there! (Minos special featured and just wow 😋)

Hasn’t had Minos since there last location thought we would give it a go but it’s been hit and miss for the last few orders. Moussaka is ok, but overpriced for the size of the portion, not enough for a single serve. Last order was just some pizzas which were really bad, not even the kids wouldn’t eat them. Pizza will ether be exceptional, average or horrible.
Best Fish and chips in NZ, possible Kohi Takeaways matches them. Chinese dishes very good too. Vege fried rice noodles a family favourite for us.

My chicken fried rice wasn't Chinese fried rice! There was some chicken, but rice was basically only a a step up from boiled rice and wasn't very nice in flavor!! Very disappointed in this!! My fullness of this chicken fried rice wasn't a pleasant feeling

Beautiful sushi! Always freshly made! This has been our go to for the past 18 years! My family and I have moved to Brisbane, but whenever we are in Auckland, we always make sure to come to Howick sushi! Lovely owners! 100/10
Love this little sushi shop in howick! A real gem, the tuna triangles are to die for! 😛😛

This is one amazing place for a good meal and some really well made cocktails. We ordered for a meat pizza and 2 cocktails. It was really well made. The waitress also helped us in selecting what to eat. Clean bathrooms.
Good relaxed vibe nice selection of food and drinks. The seated restaurant side is also perfect for a slightly quieter experience

Very fine cooked food. Very juicy beef, duck and salmon with crispy outside. And the sauce are wonderful and unique. But need to wait quite a long while so the restaurant served a big bowl of chips for apology. Service and environment are good. Will come again.

Amazing Authentic Food! I had a great experience at this restaurant. It was my first visit, and I went with two friends. There’s plenty of parking right next to the restaurant, and the place is spacious enough for more than 20 families. The restaurant has beautiful decor, and the service was excellent. I’m a vegetarian, but my friends, who eats non-veg, also really enjoyed the food. The portion sizes were good too. We ordered: • 3 Lemon Lime drinks • Green Salad • Murgh Biryani • Paneer Lababdar • Daal Makhani • Masala Papad • Lachha Parantha • Kadhai Chicken • 2 Butter Naan The total bill was around $140, which was worth it for the quality and taste. We loved each item and will definitely visit again. Highly recommend trying this place!

Biggest issue is the lack of staff. On Mother's Day weekend, there was a group that just sat down in the nearest table and didn't get any acknowledgement until one of the group members finally had to stand up and call someone to take in their order after 30 minutes. They forgot items a lot. That is understandable when it's busy but being greeting and seated is so important at a restaurant.

An improvement from the previous restaurant, however the owner/manager needs to learn customer service is important. Under staffed with 3 servers only, taking orders, pouring drinks and cleaning. After spending well over $200 on dinner I was refused a cup of tea because "they were too busy".(The restaurant was half full) I have seen many restaurants come and go from this location. I hope the owner does not let his current success cloud his decisions. An enjoyable evening spoiled by the refusal to take an order for a cup of tea. When asked about this he said he was not bothered by my disappointment.
Owners are lovely! Quantity and quality is for sure better than the fish and chip shop on Vincent and Wellington!
Reasonable price, comprehensive menu for Guangdong congee and other signature dishes. Clean and tidy.

The bases I bought on Taobao tasted better than the ones in the store. The sauces were limited, with only soy sauce, vinegar, and peanut butter, and they cost me two yuan each. The ingredients were expensive, not fresh, and smelled rancid. It really changed my perception of hot pot.
Staff is friendly and welcoming! Great food, prawn laksa, penang curry, crab fried rice and wok dishes are all delicious. Will be our go to place for thai food. Highly recommend.

Outstanding Thai cuisine. The best I have ever tasted 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 I wish I could give 6 stars, TEN stars. Bright spice, delicate layers of authentic flavours and just the most perfect produce. 🥘 The Tom Yum soup was rich yet light and spicy as all hell - and amazing 🌶️ The portions are generous, the dishes delightful and the people are fast efficient and lovely. They are sadly not licensed, I would have loved a beer, but the food is profoundly delicious and affordable.
Noodle broth was a little bland but the BBQ pork and duck was cheap and delicious. Next time I'll get the rice or lettuce. Yummy
Always a go to for skewers and they are so reasonably priced.
The lamb skewers were so good and the price was only $1.5 per one skewer. Definitely I am coming back!
Amazing food and amazing service. Highly recommend this place. First time here. The staff was kind and guided us to the best food. A must try! We will certainly be back.
It's okay. I mainly went for the clay pot, and the food was okay. However, I did feel there was a bit too much MSG. The dining environment is nice.
Very nice food here. Recommend!

With its beachfront location and upscale decor, Windross sets a high bar, in such a family-oriented local area. The Italian menu is creative, but deviates from traditional expectations, notably lacking pizza – a potential drawback for families with children. The prices reflect the ambiance and location, but may not align with the overall value. The initial greeting could have been more personable, which is something families often appreciate.
What a gorgeous idyllic and quaint beach spot .. brilliant service from the lovely waiting staff food prompt and tasty Thanks 🙂 Will definitely recommend to others We will be back for more

An enjoyable eating experience in this villa style setting nestled nearby a beach front. The food is exceptional and is well complimented by the service. There's a special vibe in this place as it attracts all the locals and curious wanderers from other suburbs. They don't have to advertise much because most of the clients come in via word of mouth and reputation alone. Excellent experience for couples to birthday group celebrations. The restaurant offers a special room upstairs for small party dinners. Wonderful dining experience at Windross House Restaurant.

Very nice experience. Nice large rooms on or close to golf course. Pretty views. Apparently dinners are nice there but we included buffet breakfast which was very good for the price. The rooms are clean and the TV worked okay. The bath used the hot water up but the bath and shower were good. Overall great. It is close to lovely drives in all directions and not far to travel from Auckland to feel as if you have really gotten away.

While the spaciousness and cleanliness of the room was good the lack of maintenance was very sad and neglectful. Paint pealing off window frames.. chipped plaster.. large screw holes where things had been removed and holes never filled. A great setting with the potential to be impressive like we felt it once would have been.. There was a holder but no toilet brush... asked for one as we were there 4 days, but were told ..not sure why but they dont supply them!?? Badly managed!!
We had a great Father’s Day lunch experience at 19 restaurant. Love the classic steak, egg and chips 😋 Thai beef salad was our favourite ❤️

Really enjoyed our stay here! Some of reviews did make me question if I would enjoy it but I was pleasantly surprised. Room was great size, well kept and I enjoyed sitting in the dining area watching the gold and enjoying a few cocktails. There IS a lack of niceties in this place (you can tell there is no major investment going into it) however it’s priced very well for what you get

Never ordering food from here as I got FOOD POISONING . Food was flavourless, and under cooked, it looked like it was just heated up and thrown in the container. Wondered why the service was fast, it’s because the food was under cooked. Had to throw majority of the food away because of the quality. Very disappointing.
Exceptional service, delicious food! Nachos add pork is my fav!!!

we ordered kadhai chicken, kadhai paneer and chicken biryani. worst ever we had taste like this. paneer curry was just having spices taste nothing looks like kadhai paneer, kadhai chicken curry was just water, chicken and curry was looks apart from each other. coming to chicken biryani which was having small 4 pieces of chicken counted and having abnormal smell and taste like …. only drinks and naan was good enough. thanks and if you see this review, please close the restaurant and get back to training.
Ordered $10 hot chips, was a generous amount and everyone loved it.
The best hospitality and amazing food. Thank you for staying open for us!

A little gem in the heart of Henderson. A family owned restaurant that serves some of the best Italian food in the West. Simple, delicious and flavoursome. The pana cotta and gelato were homemade, with their own special flavour. Friendly and helpful staff. A must visit!

Food was OK. Service was OK. Interesting we got Garlic bread in the basket but no bread plates.⭐️⭐️ Had 2 mains 2 drinks 1 Garlic Bread $88.82 for 2 ppl for dinner.⭐️⭐️ At another Italian Restaurant the next day we got 4 Garlic Breads 4 Mains 6 drinks Excellent Food and Excellent service $110. Say no more.⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ The first pics was our dinner from Adriatico The Lasagna and Pizza's were just an example of 2/4 dishes we got for Lunch from the other Italian restaurant.

I’ve eaten at many Italian restaurants. This one competes well with La Rosa in Glen Eden. My first time coming and we were received by a girl who was on her first day of the job. She did splendidly. The staff were friendly. The place was clean. The service was quick. I ordered the “Alexander”. Medium rare steak in mushroom sauce. Brilliant. My only complaint would be the price. But with the cost of ingredients honestly it’s fine. If you want a cheaper experience at the cost of taste quality reduction go to La Porchetta. If you’re feeling a little fancy and want something delicious - head here!

Discovered this place by complete accident stopping to get petrol. Had the pork roll. Absolutely delicious! Equally as good as some of the Bahn Mi I’d sampled on a recent trip to Vietnam. Tasty, fresh, really really good. And the customer service was great as well. Recommend.
Amazing place for families to play and relax. Good food, amazing staff especially Hine and Rachel. Thank you for making our family birthday's and special occasions so memorable
One of the worst subways I ever had. The amount of tuna (or lack of it) was shocking. Even after reminding the staff to add more tuna he has only using the knife to spread it like butter.
The food was very bland. We requested the fiji style and there was nothing fiji about it… Chilli chicken had two different types of chicken in it

Ordered Indo Chinese Chicken and Egg fried rice and chicken Manchurian through Uber eats. Totally disappointed with the quality of the food. Mainly the rice used looks like big in size like third grade quality. I spoke to the restaurant. They said it's basmati. But it's not. You can see that in the picture. Hope they will improvise.
Got a scotch steak with mushrooms prawns and an egg chips were delish steak was cooked well. Cheaper than other places in the area. Great friendly service. Food was good

Had Tuk Tuk thai for lunch today, we got chicken Satay, Prawn Satay and Pork Rolls for entree then Tuk Tuk Duck and Cashew Duck fo the main courses. The portion sizes are not large but with the supplied rice it was ok, The duck was nice but could not taste any mango sauce at all in the Tuk Tuk Duck, Pictures attached

Bad experience here. First the Gull payment app is not supported for all the pumps (only Pump 1 & 2 why?). Second there's a service fee for wave payment at the counter which I never encountered before at other petrol station like BP, Z or Mobil.
I've visited this spot twice, and the service has been fantastic both times! Quick service, generous portions, and affordable prices. Highly recommend!
Best takeaway and I enjoyed it a lot like their fried rice and their chow mein is so good I would be living through it all

The staff is so unprofessional, they talk too much while working while there are many customers. They don't even wear masks while working. I think it's inevitable that saliva will splash on the food and I waited for more than 30 minutes to get a dish while the person who came in later got it first.

RIP OFF!!! Ordered a extra large thin based Hawaiian pizza with extra topping & chips. $19.00. Pizza Ingredients; tomato base, cheese, pineapple and luncheon sausage. The pizza,half cooked looked like it had been dropped. Wouldn't recommend to anyone.

Easily the best fish and chips we’ve found in a long time. I have a gluten intolerance so struggle all the time with food options, so I really appreciated a grilled fish of the day with option for salad & rice (instead of chips all the time) Partner had hoki & egg burger with chips & coke, he’s a fan also. Egg was perfect, chips were perfect, bun was perfect. So happy with the customer service and felt so welcomed that we stayed and sat down to eat, when usually would run away with takeaway. Thank you LJs Henderson, see you again soon
Good quality and location. A favorite for those who work around here.
Easily the worst McDonalds I’ve come across in ages. Placed my order and people who had arrived 15 minutes after me and they were getting their orders before me

Their wrap service was amazing just like the photos. Must be very angry as they were working on Sunday. They missed chips and toys. My kids were waiting for 5min to ask the toys. I called them nicely twice but no one answered. When I shouted, one staff finally reached me with sucked face " are you alight?" "No, I am not." I dont expect the great service but they shouldve given us the right food as I paid. Horrible Sunday morning.

Such a great spot, especially being local, but the food over the past two weeks has been disappointing. The taro was drenched in coconut cream and undercooked, and the povi masima was so salty it seemed like it hadn’t been washed before cooking. Overall, the food has lacked flavour lately, which is a shame because this used to be our go-to place. Hopefully things improve soon.

I believe this place is now called 'The Grounds'. It still has the spectacular playground, though the restaurant side has changed. Great place to go for meeting up with friends, corporate and functions. Unfortunately not as suitable as previously for my granddaughter
Went there for lunch on a Sunday. Food, service and coffee were great. Plenty of space and the kids loved the outdoors play area. Will definitely be back

We were able to visit for the first time over the weekend. My 5 year old son absolutely LOVED the playground, he also gobbled up his dinner and said "Yum!, I give this place 1 trillion stars!". Sure enough, he was back yesterday (teacher only day) :)

Have tried a few options here over the last couple of years to give it a fair go. But average quality sushi for the price, at this particular branch. And very rude staff. Average pieces of sushi with small filling (even when you get the Jumbo option). Rice doesn’t seem very fresh even when we have ordered earlier in the morning. Customer service is generally rude. Head office handled it really well on one particularly bad occasion though, which is great because it’s a good franchise generally speaking and other branches seem to have a higher standard. Not the best of the Auckland branches and other better quality sushi options nearby with friendlier staff.

Came her by myself and just had to bring my partner back the next day. The service is lovely,food is great and the atmosphere is warm and calm. This is going to be a regular for us from now on. Thankyou!

Ordered the Easy 2.0 burger combo along with the tenders from RE Burger in Henderson. Everything was packaged really well. The burger itself was really flavourful, and the chips were decent. The tenders were a little on the dry side. I wasn’t a fan of the Re sauce – there was a flavour in it I couldn’t quite enjoy, though that might just be my taste. Overall, a solid experience and I’d consider ordering again!

Feedback from us two forgot to take a photo of second burger, but will describe. So we ordered Jack'd vege burger which is loaded with Plant-based Jackfruit 'Chick'n' Pattievg, Nudairy Cheesevg, Lettuce, Tomato, Aiolivg, Toasted Milk Bun with combo fries and drink. Jack'd burger tasted devine all toppings blended in very well. Best vege burger that have ever tasted honestly better then burgerfuel dont get me wrong burgerfuel is good but this restaurant wins. Chips were cooked perfect very tasty adding ketchup gives extra flavour got sparkling water with the combo which helped washed the burger/chips down. Bonus is that when you finish your meal you dont feel bloated and you will be very full. Second order was Pitmaster double loaded with Double NZ Beef, Double Cheese, Streaky Bacon, Caramelized Onions, Mustard, Aioli, Smoky BBQ very juicy cooked perfectly very delicious be prepared you have to open your gob to shove it in. Recommend if you are looking for a good delicious meal stop in! Ordering very easy look on ordering machine and pick your meal then pay grab a beeper and wait once you beeper flashes and vibrates head up to counter and your meal will be ready for you to eat. Customer service is the best quick no mucking around

The customer service could do with some work. The young girl was quite cold and could tell she didn’t wanna be there. However, we got mango chicken and butter chicken both with naan and it was delicious ✨

Felt sad that they closed, but let me give honest feedback so it may help in the future. The customer service was very cold and neutral. The Lomi was the best and priced fairly and I could come weekly on my day offs to dine but I rather skip this place and get Mee goreng noodles in Malaysian in the traffic lights or sushi from the friendly Korean guy in the bus stop outside the mall as their staff are warm and friendly regardless of the value and price of what I order.

I've come to this pita pit a fea times. This time the food was taking a long time.much longer then usual at the time of this we are still waiting and its been around 1/2 an hour. As I was waiting I noticed the AA friends with benefits thing they are running as shown in the photo. When we got to the shop the guy was busy and did not approach us so we used the machine. At no point does it mention this promotion or did the staff member come and tell us about it. So I asked him after when I has seen it. He said I have to present the card before I make the transaction otherwise I cant get the free reward. This is really cheeky and pretty frustrating as the promotion is out of sight then you have no way of knowing. I only knew because we have been waiting so I long I started reading it from the seating. This is pretty disappointing from pita pit not to inform the customers of this. I recently purchased the $15 burger, fries, and beverage combo. The staff's interaction was minimal, with limited communication observed. The food was prepared within eight minutes. The fries were of the extra crinkle-cut variety, exhibiting a crispy texture and served hot. The burger, apart from the sauce and size, closely resembled a McDonald's Cheeseburger. The provision of napkins would have been a welcome addition. I noticed of the staff behind the counter roll their eyes when I requested napkins. Comfortable seating and atmosphere though all of the tables were unclean.

Overall pretty disappointing, missing items on our order, overpriced or undersized… fries were soft and had a strange oily flavour. My burger although tasted fine barely had any lettuce - I felt like I’d paid $16 for a deluxe cheeseburger from Wendy’s.

As my wife and I, have been having Breakfast here for years, always good service and always delicious breakfast, as I always ask my bacon to be lightly cooked. And always just how I like it. My wife's favorite place to have Breakfast.

Popped in for coffee with wife and daughter. Had long blacks and flat white both were excellent. Very cool pattern on top of the flat white. We also had a double blueberry muffin and apple pecan brioche which was very tasty. Staff were friendly and service was fast.
Freindly service, lots of options, clean & tidy with Fresh food being refilled often . It's a go to which most people were returning to . Excellent portions
so much more expensive even though food quality is so bad food isnt super bad tasting but most not good
First time here and Very tasty burgers and fries. Very generous portions for the prices and the staff are friendly. Seeing the N64 in the corner was cool too! Will try to come back every now and then
Amazing food, very cheap, great service. Was my first time eating there and now it’s my favourite sushi place.
Sushi was good, price was reasonable.

We've been here three times, as we are very close and like to support local. The first time, we had a delicious pork banh mi -- I ordered just regular pork, but it was filled with what looked like homemade pork sausage and it was excellent. We went back the next day to order the same thing, but received a more standard pork banh mi, which was fine but nothing like the first one. It's been months but today I stopped by and saw on the menu they have a "sausage" banh mi. I said to the guy that we'd had a lovely pork sausage one there before, asked him about it but there was a language barrier. I ordered it, excited, and got home to find it's like... Terrible grocery store sausage? With ketchup. Not at all a banh mi. So disappointing! And the iced Vietnamese lattes we ordered were delicious, but so small. The photo is as we received them. $8 for a half filled cup of mostly ice! Maybe their pho is good, but I will never be going back to try it based on my other experiences. Would not recommend.

I was looking for a restaurant that’s serve fast with delicious food and found out this. The food here is amazingly delicious and at reasonable price. If you are looking for a place to eat in vibrant environment , this place is for you!!!
Good price $15 on rice meals. Big portion, nice staff. Yummy. Do support!
Very delicious, and the owner provides excellent service! I will definitely visit again.
Impressed with the Tofu Banh Mi - very generous with the tofu & such lovely customer service. Only reason I didn't give 5 stars is I thought it would be great to have some other sauce options.

I ordered corndog (korean hot dog) at not busy time. When I got this food, it was not crispy and hot. I know Ofc they just cooked. But inside uncooked and a little bit cold. I thought that was frozen food. Anyway I did complain to them. They doing explain to me about food. They say it was potato something. I was not order potato corndog.. btw they remake for me and ami Ask to them How long did you cook normally this food? They said 7min. I request 8min. Finally I got new one. Still not crispy but it was cooked. Ummmm even when they explain she take latex gloves and she touched my food🤣 ha… they kind and cook again for me , but I’ll not comeback

Stood there for a while waiting to be served. Was looked at by multiple staff but they continued on their conversation, no acknowledgment or being told one second. Just looking at me like I’m disrupting their fun. Walked away as I will not give my money to people who don’t even have the decency to acknowledge me when it’s literally their job. Not like it was busy either. New Lynn branch has much nicer workers (nice meaning they serve you and talk to you) do better and teach your staff to talk to customers and take their order.
Katusbi has always been my got to go food at Henderson mall. Never disappointed me. Just a little overprice but that will never stop me from buying it. All the staffs have been amazing.

This must be umpteenth time I've been to Ziggle Henderson in a short space of time. I ordered the Snowy Cheese this time round. I left this as the last flavour thinking if there's any flavour I might not like, it would be Snowy Cheese. To my surprise, it's super yummy too (pardon the photo, I was so hungry for Ziggle I dug into it and didn't take a photo before I messed up the presentation)! I have now tried every flavour (except the maximum spicy ones) of fried chicken and to my surprise, every single flavour was top notch. I can now confirm Ziggle is hands down the BEST fried chicken in all of New Zealand. It's the ONE fried chicken to rule them all! THE BEST FRIED CHICKEN IN MIDDLE EARTH NEW ZEALAND! Try it if you haven't - highly highly recommended!
Ordered for a family of four and the meals were ready in under 2mintues !! Super cool very delicious and flavourful
One of the best food I had in New Zealand. Test great, fresh, high quality meat. Check peas and meat was my favourite, highly recommended

Recently opened taking over the site of the beloved Ziba’s café. They have a blend of Afghani and Persian dishes. Stepping inside the décor has the warmth and charm of the Middle East with pillows, rugs and eclectic brass fittings. Their name might suggest that they are only a kebab shop but they have a diverse menu full of outstanding good value dishes. These dishes include succulent chicken karahi (chicken thighs marinated in a special sauce served with rice or bread), Kabuli palaw (tender lamb shank nestled amongst steamed rice, raisins and carrots) and mantu (flavourful traditional Afghan dumplings with onions, leeks and spices). There are vegetarian options include borani-e-bademjan (bursting with the goodness of eggplant with tomato, peppers and garlic sauce served with rice or bread) and bolani (crispy grilled flatbread stuffed with leeks and potatoes). They also have quite possibly the best shawarma in Auckland. Full of freshness and flavour. Available in lamb, chicken or falafel. All meals are halal. Drinks to accompany the dishes include the tangy fermented yogurt drink, doogh. They also have saffron tea and other soft drinks. Kebab Joint also have traditional Afghani and Persian bread available daily 9am to 2pm.

Henderson has a new restaurant, and I'm thrilled about it. As soon as I walked in, the friendly staff greeted me warmly and helped me choose a dish. They offered me a taste test of all the flavors on the menu, and I was impressed with each one. It was difficult to pick just one, but I ended up choosing the original dish. I'm definitely planning to go back and try all the other flavors as well. I'm completely satisfied with everything, from the food to the service, and I'll definitely be returning. 10/10!

Nice little place. It feels like hidden gem. Food was great, they had chickem laksa on special so check it out! Curry was little watery than what I used to be that could be Malaysian style. Large amount too for the price!
Such a nice and small shop, very friendly staff and love their wall of notes -where you can write down positive words. Such a cool place to take your kids to be honest. They loved it .

Best sushi!! Delicious, affordable, amazing atmosphere- small amount of seating (two low tables and a bar style seating area). Most people come in and select their own sushi, but they also have a really good menu you can order from, really recommend if you have some time!! The people who run this are incredibly kind and hard working, very polite and helpful. The space is on the smaller side, so most people pop in and out for lunch. Absolutely love it here- very cute and cozy, one of the best spots for sushi in Henderson.

Honestly! Where in Auckland can you get a delicious, filling, balanced, unlimited meal for just $15? I'm so happy I saw an add for Biryaniwala Henderson's weekend South Indian buffet. They open at 9am, which is so convenient for people who want to have breakfast first, before starting the day, instead of waiting until 11am (like so many other places). The flavours in each dish were perfectly balanced, and the ingredients tasted incredibly fresh and on point. I could not decide what I liked more. Each bite was my new favourite. The pongal was just perfect. The vada was fluffy and just perfectly balanced with the soothing coconut chutney and spicy tomato chutney. The sambar played on all my taste sensation. I tasted the sweetness from the jaggery, the saltiness from essential spices, the sourness came from the methi and lemon, and the tamarind provided that unique umami taste. The dosa was crispy and delicious. The puri was only slightly oily. The halwa was the perfect ending to an incredible meal. (You have to pay separately for the tea, but even then it's still a bargain). The staff were also very friendly, effiecient, and attentive by providing water, cutlery, and serviettes throughout service. You have to pay first and then help yourself to whatever and however much grabs your fancy. Living locally, this will definitely be my new favourite.
Ordered through door dash. Chicken chippies were tasty and quantity was so big. Ice chocolate was good too👍

Popped in today :) Always have a great experience here, friendly service, the place is spotless and always has a full cabinet of delicious food! I had the prawns off the menu today, will definitely be back they were amazing. Great option for a light healthy lunch. Thanks for having me team! Jess, Hospitality Specialist Kakapo Business Sales

We went to Ryders last night for a 65th birthday gathering. We had the most delicious meal cooked in an authentic coal range. What an awesome experience to eat n then go to a movie of our choice. Highly recommend this venue and wonderful chef. Thank you.

Yum kai and good value for money. Ordered via UberEats. Will definitely order again if out west. Smash burger - 4/5: Yum burger. Think they use the Costco brioche buns which are so soft and pinchy. Lots of sweet gherkins, fresh lettuce but our burger was missing tomato. Fries - 3/5: Were cold when we got them but can tell they'd be nice fresh. Mystery box - 3.5/5: We ordered a mystery box and the item they gave us was popcorn chicken. Flavour nice and chicken was chunky, meaty pieces but it steamed up in the packaging and got really soggy (pic shows the water droplets in the box). Chicken sticks - 5/5: So yum! Great flavoured crumb, well seasoned, crunchy and still juicy.

Second time getting from The MilkTea Shop via UberEats and they are so quick and efficient, the drinks are delicious and so much variety. The staff give amazing service and a warm atmosphere, in addition to having really good prices! Best believe I have found a new favourite place for getting a drink! Thank you so much for the free V as well!
We ordered Sadhya for 20 people for our Onam celebration, but the quantity provided wasn’t even enough for 10 . Very disappointing service that spoiled our special day.

I find that this branch of JFC is pretty good. One of the better Korean Fried Chicken I’ve tasted. Love the sauces, better than the og no sauce ones. A bit on the higher price end compared to its surrounding shops. Kind of hard to find and no seating area. Good to go/takeaways though. And open until late.

We ordered the Smashed double cheese burger which is really tasty, their buns is soft and beef pattie is not dry, it's moist. We also like the boneless Maple soy 👍🫰. The owner were nice, since we are a regular customer they had given my son free pancake. Chocolate pocket is also nice for dessert it looks like a donut, not too sweet
Affordable price, fast service but food was not so tasty. Ordered the chicken fried rice and it had a weird after taste, the fish burger was okay but the tartare sauce isn't good.

Schnitzel was tough and rubbery and everything tasted pre-made/frozen and just not fresh overall. Pork knuckle was alright, not amazing. At least the pretzel tasted good and liked the side salad we got at the start.

I went for the breakfast buffet, which I had been looking forward to since they were based in the city. When I told them I'm only one person, the owner got really rude and said no, no, no, I can't do one. I can't give one person a whole table, no. No. We are too busy. You have to ask someone to sit with them. At first I thought he was joking, but no, he was dead serious. At that point I felt extremely unwelcome. If I hadn't already paid, I would definitely have left! He huffed and puffed away and said he will look and see. In the meantime I started dishing. The set up is extremely disorganised. There is a bottle neck at the door. There's one queue where you first have to pay, then to the left there is a queue where you find the warm food and bread. Then you have to fight your way through the waiting-to-pay queue to get to the coffee and pastries queue. I stood waiting like an idiot for the owner to come back, feeling extremely vulnerable and standing in everybody's way. That's when a customer in the queue asked if I were OK. I said they are not willing to accommodate a single person, and I have to go beg someone to adopt me for the next hour. They were 3 gents and said I could join them at table for four. They were very friendly and tried to include me in conversation, but it was very awkward for everybody, and I could not enjoy my meal, eating in front of strangers. The food was fine. It wasn't outstanding or incredibly memorable, but it wasn't bad. Mine had gone cold because I stood around waiting for the owner to come back. At the hot selection there was cut up sausages of different kinds, bacon, scrambled eggs, cheese grilled mushrooms, courgettes, fried tomato, two types of baked beans. Then they had different types of bread butter and two types of jams. They had croissants and some apricot jam pastries, cocktail sausage rolls and hash pops. There were also mixed fruit, sliced cold cuts, cheese, two types of sweet/slices, panna cotta, and a chia seed dessert. All of this is served with apple or orange juice, tea, and coffee. It's a fairly big selection of food. So there will be something you will find to like. I did like the courgette, mushroom, and apricot pasty. If I wasn't sitting with strangers, I would have liked another helping, but I was too embarrassed to go and dish more. Unfortunately for me, because of how I was pretty much chased away and forced to sit with strangers, the food got stuck in my throat. It was a very disappointing experience and I definitely won't be back. If you're single, or widowed, or a new immigrant in a strange country, don't bother coming here.

Quintessential German cuisine 🇩🇪 It doesn’t get better than this outside of Munich for a Pork Knuckle! Coming here for business meetings is a guarantee to seal the deal over some excellent food and of course a Bavarian beer 🍻 Try the shared platter for a nice variety and order the German noodles „Spätzle“ as a side. And definitely finish it off with a warm Apfelstrudel with cream and vanilla ice cream or a piece of Black Forest cake for dessert. Highly recommend you try this little gem hidden in Avondale on Rosebank! Thank you very much / Vielen Dank Mike & Hu!

If you're looking for a brekky buffet under $25 a head then you've found it. They have all your favourites such as sausage, bacon, scrambled eggs, baked beans etc. etc. and more. Welcoming staff in a friendly atmosphere and tasty food. Worth the visit. 👍🤙👏

Fantastic food, big portion for a good price, staffs are friendly and welcoming. Authentic Vietnamese food, the best Phở so far:)) and the Vietnamese coffee… it’s just so much better than other restaurants, it’s strong with perfect amount of condensed milk, it’s just like how Vietnamese people would have back home ❤️ and their rice dishes come with lots of salad and good portion of meat and the egg cook to perfection. 100% recommendation and definitely will be back to try more dishes, the vermicelli, the spring roll, and their handmade pie!!!! They even have sushi and breakfast menu. And their Banh mi too, lots of meat, salad, their pickle carrot and daikon is just like home, the banh mi itself too, the crustttttt!!! . ( forget to take photo cuz we were too hungry :))) !!! Everything is just so enjoyable!!!! 💯 💯 💯 thank you team!!!! Well done!!

A comfortable atmosphere inside cosy feeling..🚻..I just ordered a hot chocolate to go. It was nice with a chocolate fish to go with it. It seems to be a popular place as a few people dropped in. It's a cosy feeling inside. A couple of table seating out side. Not sure if I would sit there a bit close to the car's going in and out with their car fumes. A few parking spaces at times outside the store.

Best take aways in Auckland!!! Little hidden gem. Just like the take aways you used to get as a kid! The owners were so kind and fast cooks. They have some great cheap meal deals. Definitely recommend.

Pretty appalled. I ordered through door dash and got a chicharron and packaging full of oil. Didn’t even eat one whole one because I started to feel sick . Use to be awesome now lacking in a lot of areas

I love hunch munch - but I have to say slipping. Im not sure how the two pics below are meant to be the same but the sticky sauce was way too intense tonight. But I still ate it cause underneath the sauce the pork belly was melt in my mouth .

This place is really the best!! yummy birria tacos and chicharron at a good price with super big filling portions. Owners are very friendly and hard working people working long hours. Will always come back here :))
Just bought pizza tonight, it was delicious, it had full of flavors, the food was fresh and hot. My family didn’t even speak because it was that good we just enjoyed it. The service guy is friendly.
Really nice burgers and chicken nibbles! Option of fried chicken skin is also tasty. Highly recommend!

My partner and I frequent this place. It’s great bang for your buck. Kind and fast service. They will even add spices to your taste if you request. Haven’t found a place yet that has better value here in NZ. We’re from Canada and constantly on the hunt for good food and good deals.

I had the pleasure of trying the restaurant's special – butter chicken with fresh naan bread – and it was truly a memorable meal! The butter chicken was incredibly flavorful, with tender pieces of chicken simmered in a rich, creamy tomato sauce. The blend of spices was spot on, providing a burst of flavor in every bite without being too overwhelming. It was comfort food at its finest! The fresh naan bread was equally impressive. Soft, warm, and perfectly baked, it had just the right amount of crispiness on the edges. It was the perfect companion to the butter chicken, soaking up the delicious sauce beautifully. Recommendation: If you're visiting the restaurant, I highly recommend trying this dish. It’s a must-have for anyone who loves a well-executed classic. The combination of the buttery, aromatic chicken and the fresh, fluffy naan is simply unbeatable!

Such a great surprise find in Westie! The smoked squid, scotch fillet, and spicy spaghetti were all spot on — tasty, good quality, and really good value. The entertainment is a bonus and makes the place even more fun. If you’re looking to chill after a long day or just hang out with friends, I’d highly recommend giving Westie Bistro a go!
Nice and crispy fish and chips. Oil seems fresh
Super Burgers were great n filling, left almost no room for the fish n chips 😊

Highly digusted.
Very big portion as compared to other takeaways around. The container does not lie. Food not bad fresh meat and vegetables but hoping to get a stronger wok taste on my Chow Mein.
I love the $14 for 12 chicken nibbles deal. Does my work lunch for 4 days easy. Great takeaways if your not wanting too spend too much for a good feed also....
Their fried noodles are very nice and good portions as well. Little to no wait time.
I have no time to cook myself, but yours turned out great. And thank you for the apple sauce.
Very good food cooked quickly with good ingredients. I’m a big fan of the fish and vege burgers. The best for miles. 😸

Seriously amazing food. The hospitality was amazing and the food was as I remembered visiting Myanmar. A must try is their chicken biryani. That chicken thigh was something else. Only small criticism is that their tea tree salad may require a bit more lime. Apart from that will be visiting this place again for sure

What a lovely place to eat, the food was lovely and very tasty, and trying Myanmar 🇲🇲 dishes for the first time. I have already chosen what I am ordering the next time I go!! The Myay Oe Mee Shay was amazing the flavours delicate and balanced, the quail eggs cooked.to perfection. The tofu Jyaw was delightful, crisp and delicious, the tamarind sauce was a perfect balance to dip it into!!!! Definitely try this place it is a great place to eat !!!

Trinity has a wonderful atmosphere run by a very kind funny and friendly couple who make you feel very comfortable at the Cafe. Food can be catered for special diet’s and they make the most beautiful Cakes, my favorite is the Orange and Almond cake that is super delicious and vegan friendly 🤘 a great local cafe to come and eat drink coffee and relax 😎
We been following them from K’rd. Sizzling Prawn is always my favourite! My hubbie like their Pad Thai!
I received a fly in the cookies. I have a pack but they didn't seem fresh anyway 😕
Great Chinese food, good taste, but the portion size is a bit small, and the boss seemed to see through this and complained to us about the soaring prices.
This spot is very legit. Had the beef curry broth. It was out of this world. Perhaps my favorite dish in auckland in my few days vacationing here

Interior is superb wooden furniture ..organized waiters serving at tables and good cleaning up ready for next patrons. My gosh the yummy milk shakes .. can get busy quickly . Good for children groups or couple's. Also Uber service is available Everything is good on the menu My favourite drink is the pineapple yogurt There is a ordering panel before you go in if you like to order there or inside. Parking can be difficult street parking

This place has very good service. The food is served to you from ordering to the tables within 10mins, its unbelievable. Don't believe me try it for yourself! Every time I've been here, this is maybe my 4th or 5th time, and it's always the same thing with timing, a few different dishes may take a bit longer, but your not left waiting and waiting for your food like to the point your entire group is hungrier than before you arrived like Denny's for example. Definitely worth a try if you haven't been to Momo Tea Mount Albert. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Keep up the great work guys!

I wish I took photos. The wings were fried to perfection and the buffalo sauce was tangy n spicy. I’m thinking about it at night hence this review and I will be ordering again tomorrow to see if it’s consistent. I was so impressed!
Online orders. Delivery service is good. The Pizzas and chicken tenders has always been tasty. Awesome work guys!

We decided to try out the new Nomad with some friends on Friday night and it didn’t disappoint! The menu was interesting and the dishes executed beautifully. Highly recommend the perfectly cooked lamb skewers, duck breast, pork belly, and the surprise star of the cabbage! Pizzas were wood fired and delicious too. Great spot for a fancy Friday night out or dinner with the kids :)

From the moment I placed my order through their seamless app, I could tell this was going to be a top‐notch experience. The pizzas arrived piping hot and on time exactly as promised. What blew me away were the toppings. They pile them on with reckless deliciousness with spicy meats, gooey cheese, and inventive flavour combos that actually work. Beyond the food, the service really impressed me, friendly delivery, and you can tell they value consistency. If you're after bold, flavorful pizza with generous toppings and smooth service, Hell delivers in spades. Already planning my next order bring on the heat and creativity, Hell!
Tried Hell Pizza for the several time and was blown away! 🍕 The pizza was delicious, packed with flavour, and the staff were super friendly and welcoming. Definitely coming back for more!

Delicious BBQ, Exceptional Service I recently visited Tonight BBQ Restaurant and was blown away by their delicious food and exceptional service. The meat was cooked to perfection and melted in my mouth, and the sides were equally impressive. The staff was incredibly friendly and knowledgeable about the menu, and the atmosphere was cozy and inviting. I highly recommend trying the Malaysian stir fried noodle chicken- it was easily one of the tasty dishes I've ever had. Overall, a fantastic experience.
One of the better Takeaways around Auckland. Well known for their good fish & chips, and in recent times they’ve expanded to include the usual meat on rice dishes.
Really great coffee and sando spot for Avondale. Quickly become our local and dog friendly too!
Lovely food and service. The guy gave my wife free jalebi as well. Would highly recommend 👍🏻
Great burgers we had the double cheeseburger and fries, loved the pickles! Juicy but crunchy smashed beef pattie and soft bun. The fries were awesome! Crispy and salty yum!
We came in looking at the reviews but found the food disappointing. The fries were over cooked and the chicken looked really old and terrible. It was very dry. Had to throw the food out.

Wow. $14 for 2x Large Chicken thighs and 1 thigh with chips - Huge amount of hot chips - Chicken pieces are really large. Huge meal. Nice and Hot. Chicken has a currish taste to it. But you really get value for money. Food not sitting in hot food warmers. Made on the spot. Large portions.

Very disappointed, I asked if they could replace the mussels for extra chips and they said yes, only to get a handful of chips. I was being polite too when they charged me wrong for the order, their food and service has changed.

They have all my favorite foods here .. Suafai is one of them a combination of ripe bananas sago & coconut cream, Chopsue & Taro & Green bananas wrapped in coconut cream yummy. So many foods & sweets to name. Come check it out for yourself You won't be disappointed! Friendly Stuff always smiling ready to greet & serve you! Hardworking stuff behind the scenes .. This is my favorite & only samoa shop I go too.. Nearly forgot my otha favorite is pagipopo/coconut buns yum 😋 come on , go check it out if you love island 🏝 food!
If I could give a -0 I would. Elo service, elo food and elo staff. Either the servers dont get paid good but basic customer service is needed the matalemus

Ordered 2 pizzas – the Paneer and Potato pizza with extra chicken and mushroom. Honestly the best sourdough pizza I’ve had! Highly recommend Frat’s Pizza if you’re looking for quality, taste, and great service!

We’ve been here twice since recently moving to the area. Once ax a family then a few weeks later for our child’s birthday - their choice as they think it’s a cool vibe. Great pizzas with interesting topping option as well as classic favourites. Amazing service as they are juggling online orders, walk ins and eat in orders - and still managing to be attentive and quick.

Delicious!! I tried the lemongrass beef banh mi and iced coffee. The sandwich was tasty with a good amount of beef, crisp veggies, and fresh bread. I asked for spicy, and it had a great kick to it! The coffee was strong and sweet. Prices were very reasonable, and the lady in the kitchen was so nice. Thank you for the food!!
Our go-to for Filipino comfort food

I’ve been taking their food for over two months now and it’s consistently excellent. The weekly plan is great for busy professionals who still want proper home-style meals. Everything tastes fresh and authentic, and their biryani is honestly one of the best in Auckland.
Authentic taste of India in a burger! Tried their Masala paneer burger and chicken tikka burger, both were amazing 🤌

Tokos Tacos is unreal. It’s the best combo of amazing food, service, and atmosphere. The staff are always friendly and will explain how their take on tacos works and is best enjoyed. Come on Thursdays for a special $15 for 3 chicken tacos or try their fish tacos, best I’ve ever had. Make sure to order a combo so you get consommé and salsa (to die for). For an extra add-on, try their Elote as well (sweet corn goodness). PS: don’t forget to ask for a loyalty card because YOU WILL BE BACK 😇
Had fish tacos, birria beef tacos and the corn cup with mango juice. The food was really good!! I highly recommend this place!

I’m from Arizona so I know a thing or two about tacos. These tacos were the best I ever had 🙌🏽. Crunchy where it needed to be but yet the meat so tender and juicy. Chef Ben had the secret white sauce dripping over the fish tacos so disrespectfully 😩 that it maybe my cheat meal for life. I was even impressed that they had low carb options which of course I didn’t get cause it’s big back 🦍 bulking szn baybeeee! Tokos Tacos is a Lock definitely did not disappoint.
Been coming to this place for years, the only Xi’an noodle restaurant I trust. Consistent flavours and solid food hygiene.

Had takeaway, and it is as good as i remembered it. Had lamb on chips, so much meat per ratio. Unique meat flavour, with cheese sprinkled on chips before the hot meat went on. Just different experience
We bought a lamb kebab, mango lassie, baklava and brownie. The food was delicious and very filling. Will definitely buy there again.
Delicious food, clean and beautiful set-up. Faster and five start service. Recommend for all foodies.

Consistency is really very poor. Service is worst one soup served after waiting almost 70 minutes. Delay is too bad so is there service and specially food. We came second time our last experience was better in regards to food though service was anyway slow but tonight was terrible. I will never ever come for dinner at this place. They don't respect customers. Table just next to us have to stand and go to counter to order naan as there was no one to attend. Such a poor thing to experience in hospitality business. Waiter came and said chef are busy doing online orders so dine in customers are sacrificed.Such a shame.
Good food - traditional hong konh food Friendly staff

Papa's pizza was such a vibe! We had our team bonding dinner here. The food, vibe, ambience and drinks we're amazing. The owners and staff were super friendly and awesome hosts. This is my third time and it gets better every time. I highly recommend Papa's 👌

I used to come here as a kid more than 20 years ago and thought it would be cool to come back. Sad to say i was disappointed in the food, the pizza was good but they got the order wrong initially and the mussels were bland and lacked flavour. While the staff were friendly they didnt check in once to see if our food was okay and cleared plates while we were still eating. At the end of the day it was overpriced for pretty average service and food.
Service was lovely, ensured we have a big enough table to accommodate a baby, a pre schooler and 4 adults. Food was tasty and fresh, very well priced for the area.

Bit of a mixed experience. Great menu with range of options. Slightly pricey but portions are a decent size. The food we ate was delicious. The service on the other hand wasn't great. We were served all our dishes one at a time over a period of an hour, which made it impossible to enjoy the meal / experience.

Very busy place specially on Friday evenings. You won't get a place without booking. We had good time as a group and everyone loved the food. Ice cream was very good. Plenty of paid parking and a free parking also available nearby in the streets.

There is no 3.5 stars so giving 4. Ordered and picked up for delivery - Chicken Tikka Masala(Super Hot), Tandoori Chicken and Garlic Naan. I would have given 5 stars but hugely disappointed with Garlic naan and tandoori chicken. Common guys you are better than this. All Naans were very thick and flat and more like uncooked thick paratha with garlic butter on top. I think the dough was not set before cooking or it wasn’t cooked properly. Next Tandoori Chicken- It looked and delicious but did not have that yummy taste was missing from the Tandoori chicken. Chicken Tikka Masala- this dish was bang in as I requested it to be super hot and it met all expectations in terms of spicyness, salt and other spices were well balanced. 5/5 for Chicken tikka masala. Will I order again? I would definitely order again as I know they do read all reviews and work on it and moreover this is one of the best restaurants in Auckland. I think it was just about wrong time or rush hours they had that day. But hey... that’s how popular restaurants need to run fulfilling expectations of customers even when they are super busy as your customers choose your restaurant over others.
Delicious food! Must try Spicy Garlic Udon stir try!!

Amazing… everything! We had the grilled eggplant, tempura prawn sushi, prawn udon noodle miso and the beef curry udon noddles. We also had some yummy sake and beer. Even thought it was a busy night everything was timed perfectly and the service was outstanding! Definitely coming back!

We enjoyed a lot our dinner at Cazador, the food was excellent, as well as the service. The staff were very friendly and they introduced ingredients and stories of each dish at serving. The interior design is very interesting, created a unique vibe for the dinner. We’d love to go again in the future.

A lovely small cafe with 3 high tables inside and a few outdoor tables. High chair also available. Lovely pastry, sandwiches, and excellent coffee. Flat white's milk was velvety smooth, coffee itself has a good chocolatey taste. At night this cafe (entrance is next door) becomes a restaurant.
The food here is amazing. The menu is curated well and each dish is prepared with care. We had a wonderful server who took the time to explain each dish. A wonderful experience :)
Delicious flavor, good portion size, and affordable price. Quick service too!
A group of six of us had a superb meal, followed by the live music which is a regular feature on a Wednesday night. We all agreed that it was a great evening out.

I saw this place already sooner and I wanted to visit it. The atmosphere inside is very lovely, nice and relaxing. We got such a surprise seeing Ryan here! Just because of his excellent customer service, we use to go to L’affare in Newmarket, now certainly this place will be our go-to 😊 Coffee was so good. Tick all the boxes! Customer service, ambience, food quality and obviously welcoming hospitality 💯

I ordered a latte and the milk foam was super smooth. The barista made different latte art each time, which was so cute lol. The only thing was that the desserts were a bit pricey one madeleine was $7
Always a nice experience and never had any complaints about the noodles! However, could work on the taste + presentation of their drinks 😊
Fair price for big portions of food. Im happy with the taste and made me remember my trips to Thailand. Great that you can request for chilis too if you are leaning to the spicier side. 🌶

Ver nice experience in Taiko Kingsland. Sashimi is fresh and the portion is great. The prawn on the hot plate tastes very good!! The mayo sauce melts in the mouth with tender prawns… a must try dish here!!
Super nice food and atmosphere, Red approached us with a great smile all the time, excellent service! Will come here again:)

Gave wrong orders twice so pissed off . Being a disabled person my Support worker took me to the mall, i was with the hair dresser so my support worker went to buy shushi. I had a fantastic experience with Tank Juice’s customer service! The team were super friendly, welcoming, and genuinely helpful. They took the time to answer my questions and made great recommendations based on what I was looking for. It’s clear they really care about their customers and go the extra mile to make sure you’re happy. Fast service with a smile.It’s rare to see such a well-led and genuinely caring team.Highly recommend❤️❤️👍

Absolutely ridiculous. 1. Ordered it toasted and it came cold. 2. Came wrapped horrendously. 3.Didn’t even wrap tightly in the tank wrapping but gave in the baking paper. Do better, why pay $17 for an overpriced wrap for underpriced service.

been coming to st lukes tank for 2 years, the service and quality has always been great. the ladies who work there are passionate about their job, and provide great customer service. this spot is my number one for drinks

Tank St Luke’s is my go to place . We order a lot for our office and the staff is very quick and friendly . They always keep the order ready before I visit since I order on the app. The service and juice quality are excellent.

Ordered more than an hour before closing time. Service was rude. Barely any sauces were available - were told they had runout (but a coworker brought the sauce bottles from the back after I had just paid). No explanation was given. Additionally, salads on sandwich were very very sparse. Bread was stale. Disappointing when Subs are so expensive now. Do not recommend this place at all, spend your many elsewhere.

This cafe is such a great place for coffee and and Korean fusion food!! I really enjoyed the dumplings and the soup, the flavor was so good!! The bao buns are a great size and super tasty, perfect if you're not that hungry, and their coffee was spot on. The girls were so helpful with ordering as I can't tolerate certain ingredients, they were very helpful in advising what I could order. It's a nice spot with parking near by and they have these nice big tables outside with cover which is great for big groups!! They had yummy cabinet treats as well which i didnt try but they looked delicious!

We love Geeks on Sainsbury, we’ve been coming here for years but today, we brought Biscuit, our 3month cavoodle puppy, along for her socialisation and Ellie - who was part of their team - was amazing with her. Despite not being able to run around the park across the cafe, Biscuit stayed calm in her “backpack den” and we enjoyed our usual coffee, Pokeno Bacon Benedict and creamy mushrooms.

I read a review that said "I loved my pork but my wife didnt like her lamb" your wife is a whinger mate. This is your classic Kiwi Roast shop as good at it gets. Chef don't need to speak English perfectly when his food speaks the language of the Satisfaction Gods. No fuss, no frills, just a full belly of all the goodies that gets you through a tough week. 10/10 Top shop, give it a stop. You won't be disappointed.

The BK pie is the bomb and it is only $11!! Best pie so far! The staff are very welcoming and I love how the family pictures who owned the place are hanging on the wall. Will definitely come back and try the other pies.

What a lovely place for the perfect brekkie on a Friday morning 🥰 this place had a very homey vibe, and it made the experience much more heart warming. So thank you! The eggs on toast were so delish! And the smoked fish pie was phenomenal! Definitely coming back to try the rest of the pies… and the rest of the menu!☺️
Yummy home-cooked food. Staff is so helpful and friendly. If you are craving good quality homecooked food then highly recommend.

I was a regular customer of the shubh restaurant but I don’t think now we I or any one should trust them anymore for future how come you guys can be so careless while cooking food for customers really you people are playing with customers life will complain to Auckland food and safety officer about the experience about it I will attach a photo in it please check it out my toung got cut by it really horrible experience from your food

Had a wonderful family dining experience at Bawarchi Sandringham! The food was full of authentic flavors, portions were generous, and the service was warm and welcoming. A great spot for anyone craving delicious Indian/Mughlai cuisine—definitely coming back!

Staff definitely could use more attention to details on order. I ordered a vegetable biriyani family pack via ubereats for shared staff lunch at work. However, I received chicken biriyani. Someone had already ordered a chicken biriyani from Paradise hence ended up with 2 chicken biriyani and no vegetable biriyani.
