Lucky as we had more non-vegetarian people so food didn't go to waste but paying $85 and receiving a completely wrong order was extremely disappointing also that vegetarian staff did not have their biriyani at all, which they were quite excited for. As mentioned in one another review they ordered chicken biriyani and received vegetable biriyani. Hence, this seems to be a recurring issue, certainly lost trust on Bawarchi to be able to deliver correct order. On a good note, order arrived on time and chicken biriyani was delicious. However, the whole experience turned out to be shameful for me in front of others and did leave a sour taste in my heart.

I had a very bad experience here. On my recent visit, I was paying with my credit card. There was no sign anywhere saying not to use credit cards. The cashier, an elder man, hit my hand while I was paying and then yelled at me for doing so. This is ridiculous. He got mad just because they have to pay extra fees. I’ve been coming to this restaurant for a very long time, but no more. For few dollars, they’ve lost a regular customer.

I have been wanting to visit this place for a while to have their famous roast and was worth the wait. I also like the atmosphere. Very good bar and a fantastic place to watch sports. Update: Normally I always go for the amazing Sunday roast dinner, but on my last visit I noticed the updated menu and saw they had Gammon, Egg, and Pineapple with hand-cut fries. I haven’t had that in years, and it’s rare to see on a menu these days. The nostalgic taste was absolutely amazing! Highly recommended. I would highly recommend booking in advance for a table in the weekends as this places gets busy and I can see why. Still fantastic service and great staff.

Solid takeout spot! The portions are massive, and the food is packed with flavor. The BBQ Duck Fried Rice was a standout—perfect balance of smoky and savory. Friendly staff, quick service if you call ahead. Definitely adding this to my go-to list!
Today we ordered Drunken noodle 2dishes one with pork and one vegetarian it was delicious Thank you very much 👍🙏❤️

Great wee cafe! Lots of options for keto or just clean eating. The protein bowl was amazing and one of the best coffees I've had in Auckland this trip. Looking forward to when they open in Wellington (hint, hint 😉).

I went for a tour and tasting at Ubernaut Brewery and Taproom. We got an up-close look at the craft of brewing, learned about the brewing process, discovered why craft beer has transformed the industry, and what makes their brews stand out. During the tour we tasted a pilsner from the one of the ice cold tanks. It still had a lot of sediment and a lot of yeast. It tasted like liquid bread. We saw how beer is made from barley to bottle (can actually) and how the East Indian Company influenced the use of hops and how Indian Pale Ale (IPA) was born. The canning and labeling process was also very interesting. We had a very knowledgeable and passionate guide, which made the tour very engaging. There is an amazing variety of interesting beers, ales, stouts, sours, and ciders. My favourite was the salted caramel stout, strawberry sours, and blueberry cheesecake IPA. It was rounded ofd with some bacon chips (if you book through Grab One). It's the perfect tour for people who enjoy beer or even if you don't, because these flavours are very interesting and tasty, there's sure to be something to tickle your fancy. Side note: I was very impressed with their extensive vegetarian and vegan menu items

As first timers into this business, I found it quite uncomfortable knowing what we needed to do. We had to often ask service people what to do, and they did help, but I think they need to ask customers if they have been there before so that customers can ask questions... not just assume they know what they are doing. The place sort of works like a YumCha, you order lots of bits and pieces to make up a meal, or you order full sizing. Quite reasonable pricing... $1.80 a kebab, $14-20 for meals... Cost $95 to feed both my Husband and I. Also... only come here if you like Cumin... everything is flavoured with Cumin
We came in late at night on a Friday (10:30) It was quiet, and we ordered and got our food quickly. The food was really nice.

Came in on a Friday night, ordered brown sugar shaved ice and received the item. As soon as we received the shaved ice my group thought it was shaved odd, like the letter “n”, while it usually is shaped like an upside down letter “v”, a lot more natural looking. We were given paper spoons which is fine, but the problem was that we couldn’t eat it comfortably with the spoons we were given because the ice was so packed down. I looked over the counter to see one of the staff packing the shaved ice in with a knife to make it shaped as it was, instead of letting it form shape naturally and so it remains soft. I first asked for a metal spoon at which point I had gotten a bit of an attitude for not wanting to eat with a paper spoon, which was fine. We still couldn’t eat it and found it really hard to eat it as it felt like we were just chewing on ice. Asked for them to remake it without packing it. Idk if it was the manager but the person I talked to (same as the spoon guy) gave me attitude for wanting it remade and said something along the lines of “it’s shaved ice what do you expect. I talked back mentioning I’ve been to several other branches and it’s never been this bad at which he finally decided to change it for us. Later on, another staff came to talk to us about the situation and why they pack the ice, but my mood was already sour from the attitude the first staff member gave me at two separate times. Service: BAD Attitude: BAD Food: same as other branches Atmosphere and noise: loud but expected on a Friday night Would I come again? Hell to the no. Video: first shaved ice Photo: second replacement snowflake ice (which is not well presented either)
Nice and clean setting. The food was served fast and it got busy quickly. The dishes were delicious and the menu is extensive including a variety of dumplings.

Drawn into this spot by pure luck but so glad it’s where we landed! The food was absolutely scrumptious. The fish (second down on menu) was to die for, a bit hard to battle in the broth but we made sure we got it all. Pepper beef, roast duck, cucumber salad and dumplings all hit the spot. The surprise winner was the eggplant, crispiest that I’ve ever had 👌🏼 Cheap eats that hit the fricken spot!

This is an absolute gem on Dominion. Located upstairs with the perfect menu covering all fronts. All the classics are done so perfectly. 100% my favourite spot of all. The Sichuan spicy dry chicken is a must !

These clipped lid takeaway containers need to go. Please get something that CONTAINS the food. I packed my bok choy in here with the sauce and drove home and the liquid went everywhere. It opens very easily what’s the point of them? please provide regular containers for takeaway. Also the spicy food we ordered was not spicy and the store is called spicy house? Fried rice lacked flavour. Chicken in the chicken fried rice looked like it was boiled and it was very dry. We spent well over 200 dollars dining in and we did not get our moneys worth. Service was excellent, food is not as good as before. You might be better off crossing the road to flavour house.
Tried the free steak taco today outside Onehunga 4square. Loved it. Chipotle hot sauce topoed it off. Ended up buying some products for dinner.

Kiss Kiss was an awesome place to meet, chill and farewell one of our dear friends. The food was delicious. I highly recommend the chicken bao and the crispy pork!! The ginger fizz was nice too! A lovely place to dine, staff we're fantastic and friendly too.

The food is decent here. It's a nice change to have Thai food in an area that is otherwise dominated by East Asian cuisine. I enjoyed it. The decorations and atmosphere in general was vibrant and made this restaurant stand out compared to others in the area. Kiss Kiss is a nice place for a date dinner with your partner or a group of friends. Lastly, the service from the staff was excellent. All of the team was efficient at their work and polite to my friends and I. In particular, I would like to mention Quinn who was very hospitable to us. Thank you.
Supreme, Spicy Lovers & CheesyGarlic... Fries & Wedges Sides...

This is the worst Domino’s branch I’ve come across. They don’t get the orders right, and the staff are very unprofessional. Communication is poor, and instead of helping, they argue with customers. The place is not clean and doesn’t have basic things like tissue paper or hand sanitizer. I strongly suggest avoiding this branch.

Incredible food made with love. I especially loved the basboussa so fresh! And the cardamom tea 🤤 it's a family business and they are just the loveliest we had a nice conversation with the mum Shukran jazila I can't wait to come back again & again😊

Absolutely delicious food and super friendly service! You can feel the love in the food. Had hummus and pita, kibbeh, falafel on rice and lamb mandi between two and it was perfect. Love the fresh salad as well.

We recently visited this place and tried their Chicken Mandi. The portion size was quite good, the rice and chicken were quite flavourful. We loved it. The absolute star on their menu has to be the freshly made Jordanian Kunafa, it was so yummy and cheesy, you got to try it!! Moreover it is a family owned business hence the service was top notch. Would definitely recommend this place and be a regular visitor.

The service here was fantastic, on a very busy day, post All Blacks game at Eden Park, they were very busy but were so polite and accommodating. Our group of 6 had lovely meals and the Kanaffa is the best I have ever had, just delicious. Highly recommend.

Lady behind the counter was very lovely to deal with and the food was delicious. The vegetarian spring rolls were well made with great flavour, good crunch and clean finish (not super oily). The drunken noodles were delicious and well seasoned.

A nice Thai restaurant introduced by my friend. The staff is friendly. I went to eat it twice, the first time it tasted so good, but the second time it didn't taste as good as the first time. The price is very reasonable.

Kiin Thai in Mt Eden might serve fresh food, but honestly the whole experience left a sour taste. First off, the prices are steep – you’re looking at $25 or more for a single dish. The food itself was nice and fresh, but nothing so extraordinary that it justifies the cost. What really ruined it though was being told we had to finish within one hour because we didn’t have a booking. For a restaurant that charges that much, rushing paying customers like that is pretty shocking. Dining out is meant to be enjoyable, not a timed race against the clock. We felt pressured the entire meal, which completely killed the atmosphere. On top of that, the tables are crammed so close together that you can practically hear every word from the next table. It feels more like sitting in a noisy cafeteria than a proper restaurant. Parking around Mt Eden is also a hassle, which just adds to the frustration. So yes, the food is fresh, but between the high prices, rushed service, cramped seating, and parking headaches, I honestly wouldn’t recommend Kiin Thai unless you enjoy paying a premium to be hurried out the door.

We had a great experience at Kiin Thai Kitchen! The Seafood Tom Yum was absolutely delicious – full of flavor, perfectly balanced, and so satisfying. The Pad Thai was amazing as well, definitely one of the highlights. We also tried the Satay, which was tasty, though I wasn’t the biggest fan of the peanut sauce – it could use a little improvement to match the quality of the rest of the dishes. We were really looking forward to trying the Mango Sticky Rice, but unfortunately it was only available in durian during our visit, so we had to skip it this time. Overall, a wonderful spot for authentic Thai flavors, and we’d definitely come back!

Merci🥰🇫🇷Ok whanau when you are not sure what to have but feeling a little brace to step outside of the usual Sausage Muffin Combo from Maccas - you’ve got to pop into this cute Cafe. The staff are so friendly & the cabinet and Menu kai to die for. Everything made from scratch with delightful tastes leaving your stomach and soul feeling wholesome and satisfied. My Chai Latte was just perfection. Thank you to the lovely Tristan (Waiter) - who was just the best. He made our random stop in the greatest with his amazing service.

Bought a combo with chicken legs in it - received chicken tenders instead. Asked the staff member about it, they glanced at me like I killed someone and immediately called the manager. The manager rudely told me that it was exactly what I ordered and turned around. Worst customer service I’ve received in my life. The staff is rude and unprofessional. The french fries were nice though.
Management and the staff had such an amazing work ethics. Appreciate all the hard work.

@theaucklandbuzz (insta and TikTok handle) Follow me for more such reviews. We visited Restaurant and loved the experience. You choose fresh ingredients—vegetables, meats, sauces—and watch skilled chefs cook them on a sizzling grill right in front of you. The interactive cooking made dining fun and unique. Refreshing cocktails paired perfectly with our meals, and everything was fresh and flavorful. The lively atmosphere added to the charm, making it a great spot for both casual nights and special occasions. A must-visit for anyone who enjoys tasty food with a twist!
Came in for dinner. Food was very fresh, Mongolian bbq was very nice. Staff very friendly and welcoming. Price is reasonable considering this inflation. Thanks for having us
The best Thai food ever!! I love sharing a pad Thai, Panang curry and fresh spring rolls with a friend. You’ll have to be rolled out of the restaurant but it is so delicious.
Super fresh ingredients, rich and flavourful. Lovely staff that make you feel really welcome. Can’t wait to go back and try the other menu items

Parking’s super easy, and I come here every time I’m craving dim sum. The dumpling skins are nice and chewy, and you can really taste each ingredient in the filling. The only downside is that even with a weekend reservation, you might still wait a bit. It’s pretty noisy inside, and even though I told them I’m not Chinese, they still keep speaking to me in Chinese

Incredible energy the moment we stepped through the door. The staff were so incredibly lovely and the service was top notch. Plenty of options on the menu too. Food came out quite quickly and it was INSANE. Cooked perfectly and so flavourful. A highlight was definitely the yum yum scallops. Would highly recommend this place!!

Amazing service and food! I would highly recommend this place to anyone who loves authentic Japanese cuisine. We tried the Salmon Avocado Salad, Sashimi Platter, Tonepoiyaki Prawn, and Chicken Karaage – and every single dish was a 5/5! Fresh, flavourful, and beautifully presented. A huge thank you to the Epsom branch team for making our visit such a memorable one. Everyone we engaged with was an absolute vibe and made the experience even better. Arigato! 💙

We live in the West and have a Hansen in New Lynn as I was meeting my family tried the Newmarket branch, typical Hansen great food and service, the best Jack Fruit shakes and Thai pancakes, generous portions and fairly priced compared to many of there competitors. Thanks for such beautiful food.
Amazing service, amazing food , very good price the lovely lady who served us did an amazing job recommending sake hot and cold! Will definitely be coming back! 100/10 rating

A favourite cafe for us to visit on weekends. They have a new menu/makeover and there’s still plenty for us to enjoy from the menu. They also have lots of delicious cabinet food options. I recommend their French Toast, they do the toast really well, very light and perfectly done, plus well balanced with the banana and berries. Honestly I think it’s in my top 3 French toasts. We also had the Classic Breakfast which they do really well with good quality ciabatta. This place is well worth stopping at if you’re looking for a good place in Mt Eden. There is also plenty of parking on Fairview Rd.
The mixed berry sauce is sour and sweet, and paired with a cup of long black, it is a great dessert after the meal.

My favorite Malaysian restaurant. Special mention, and you should not miss for sure there prawns and tofu. I can eat them forever. I’ve also tried some fried stuff and fried rice and they didn’t disappoint. They have the best servers too, very friendly and nice, and also will take care of you. It isn’t the best looking restaurant out there, for sure not your IG worthy resto, but will def be your go-to shrimp restaurant.

I ordered Fried Kuey Teow and Mummy Ribs. Since I don’t like coriander, I asked if they put coriander in it. The staff then replied angrily, “No, this is Malaysian food.” I didn’t know at that time and just waited for my food, but in the end, my order was canceled while my colleagues had already received theirs. I had no choice but to order again, and honestly, I found it quite ridiculous.
The service so cute, enjoy the environment and the food. Will to try next time.

I am very disappointed with the service this time. We placed an online order with a ready time of 6:50 pm. We arrived late at 7:40 pm. My order was still not ready. No one said anything or apologised. Only after waiting did one person come and say it would be another 5 minutes. We always order from this store, but this time the service was very poor. There were 5–6 employees working yet no one informed us about the delay until much later. Even when we finally received our order, we only got a quick "sorry" at the end. This is not the standard of service we expected.

So on father’s day, they didn’t have enough food and didn’t adapt their menu. This was a pie, mashed potato and 25 peas!! 🤣 we could count them! What a joke There were short of staff, waited 40 minutes to get a drink. But one staff DID have time to talk on her phone while delivering food with only one hand, taking double time!! Unbelievable! We just laughed at the experience of the 25 peas pub from now on!

Burgers performed very well. I ordered two burgers- one kiwi and the other one is Full Monty. I prefer Full Monty. Kiwi is way too sweet because of the unnecessarily overpowering BBQ and tomato sauce. It would have been better if it's not that sweet. Overall, I still enjoyed the food.

Good average. The burger was alright, the meat patty was quite dry (I probably should have asked for a normal juicy medium beef patty). Overall normal average – nothing exciting, nothing particularly bad – 3 out of 5.
Afghani burger is the best , by eating that I went back to Kabul so yummy 😋

Gina’s Kitchen offers a pleasant dining experience with a menu that mixes homestyle comfort food and international favorites. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, making it a good spot for a casual meal with friends or family. Service is generally friendly and attentive, with staff making an effort to keep things moving even during busy hours. Food-wise, it can be a bit hit or miss. Some dishes really stand out, such as the pasta carbonara, which is creamy, flavorful, and well worth ordering. The portion size is generous and the seasoning feels balanced without being overwhelming. Unfortunately, not every item on the menu lives up to that same standard. A few meals like pizza feel overpriced for what you get, lacking either in flavor or presentation, which makes them fall short of expectations.

On Saturday night, we celebrated a friend’s first home purchase with dinner at Gina Restaurant. From drinks and entrées to mains and desserts, everything was absolutely delicious. Our waitress was wonderfully attentive, moving effortlessly between tables with a warm, contagious smile. Thanks to the entire Gina’s team, we enjoyed a truly joyful celebration. We’ll definitely be back!

Abraham our wonderful waiter looked after our party of six superbly. The food was excellent and arrived in timely manner; every dish delicious and generous. Superb vibe in the dining area. Will highly recommend at every possible opportunity.
A hidden gem in Newmarket. Have been in Auckland for years, been in multiple pub and I did even know this Irish pub exist. Fantastic atmosphere. Great staffs Good for a good company with friends.

Had an awesome experience at Rice Kitchen in Epsom! The food was fresh, full of flavour, and really well presented. Portions were generous, and everything tasted authentic and made with care. The staff were friendly, welcoming, and quick with service.
Fast service, on time Beautiful kai, we had Nasi Goreng Xtra hot with cashew, perfect 👌 Sweet and sour pork 😋 Had to order another NG to take away on my trip Highly recommend 👌 👍 Highly recommend

“I ordered pride pizza and it was absolutely delicious! The base was perfectly cooked, the toppings were fresh, and the flavors were spot on. The service was quick and friendly. The guy who served me was really polite and helpful. Definitely recommend this place if you’re craving great pizza!”

I had a great experience at Domino’s! The ordering process was quick and easy, and the staff were friendly and welcoming. My pizza arrived fresh, hot, and loaded with toppings — exactly how I ordered it. The crust was perfectly baked, the cheese was generous, and the flavors were spot on. Delivery was also fast and right on time. Domino’s has really improved in both quality and service, and it shows. Definitely one of the best options for a quick and tasty meal. Highly recommend! 🍕

Came here and loved it! The sushi was a bit pricey but worth it and I asked for teriyaki chicken on rice and was not disappointed. The staff were very friendly and looked like a true family run business. I definitely would be back if I’m in mount eden again.
Great bento and sushi in town! Generous portions and dedicated customer service. Many vegetarian options. Thank you!

Ordered over a month ago hoping for a reply before leaving a review and still yet to receive. Ordered an extra large chicken cranberry and received this abomination. No where did I state extra sauce in my order. Lad almost emptied a bottle on it. Inedible by the third bite as it’d gone completely soggy. Still yet to hear back
Had an absolutely amazing experience ordering from Pizza Hut Newmarket. Staff is polite & the order was perfectly cooked. recommended

The Indian Lounge Mt Eden is a real gem! Despite the cold, rainy night, the restaurant was incredibly warm and cozy. We were a group of 10 with all generations represented, and everyone loved the food. It was absolutely delicious, and the staff were super friendly and hospitable. Off-street parking was a huge bonus. We'll definitely be back!

We booked a table for 6, but the table reserved couldn’t fit 6 adults and the seat covers were saturated. We waited for dry seats, it took us 30mins to be served once we managed to flag someone down, and then waited 1hour for starters/meals. After 20mins we were told there’s no fish n chips and to choose other options. The food was hellishly over flavoured, inedible by some. The lamb was dried out and like straw topped with a very spicy sauce and nothing in the menu indicating to expect this. The ribs meal didn’t resemble the pictures online. The cocktails were either far too sweet or bitter. There did not appear to be much experience within the staff making cocktails or in the kitchen and we joked they might be ubering the food in after we waited so long on what was a quiet night with very few patrons. And incredibly disappointing and expensive night for what was received, with most of us more excited about the take out we’d now be getting and needing on the way home. I do not recommend

We had a great time there, the food was delicious, and the service was fast and efficient. The inside was well decorated, bonus points for the restroom. If I had to be picky, I'd say that the noise level could be somewhat high during peak hours, but otherwise our dinner was really enjoyable. Thank you

The lunch was good, had the shared platter that was plentiful and the squid starter that was the highlight. The service was attentive. Sat inside for lunch as weather was not conducive to sitting outside. But still felt like as I was in the village as was able to enjoy the goings on in the street. Only negative was the acoustics, can imagine if the restaurant is full it would be difficult to hear.
The services is pretty great and the food is tastes good! This place is good for studying, work or even catching up especially they have great spacious in upstairs! They provide the wifi on menu! ☺️

Delicious freshly made pasta in a beautiful Gorgonzola and walnut sauce. A lovely glass of wine to go with it. The salad was less inspiring, but it is the middle of winter. Thoughtful, friendly staff made for a pleasant meal for one.

Best matcha in the neighborhood, and the latte art is next level. Really friendly staff, yummy Asian-inspired and kiwi items, and good seating options inside and on the sidewalk. They brew Rocket coffee, if that's something you're interested in knowing beforehand.

A beautifully presented brunch food menu featuring some Asian fusion food, love their matcha and omuai rice with Kimchi fried rice inside, the customer service was great, they even serve green tea instead of just tap water😊
They left two meatballs and sprinkled in some salad and called that a sandwich. Cold and not toasted even after asking for it to be heated. Disappointing…
Oh, boy was I glad to see their sign while I was next door doing my laundry 😅 I was famished.

I don’t usually write reviews, but Pizza Hut definitely earned this one. From the moment we walked in, everything was on point the staff was friendly, the restaurant was clean, and the aroma of fresh pizza was mouthwatering.

I have never seen a child in a workplace, especially in a kitchen like Pizza Hut or Frenchies, where it can be extremely hazardous for an infant or toddler to be present. This is not only against workplace regulations, but it also creates a dangerous and unprofessional environment for the other employees working there. It’s completely unacceptable. I wish I could have taken a photo, but since it's outside my responsibility, I chose not to get involved. However, I can say for certain that I won’t be buying pizzas from there anymore. Thanks, but no thanks.

My partner and I were visiting from Melbourne and had the best burgers and wings from Ralph’s! You can tell the kitchen makes everything from scratch and take their food very seriously. We joke all the time about flying back for a day just to eat there again. Really cool vibe to the place too and lovely service - relaxed and friendly people. Cannot recommend enough!

Love everything about Ralph's - food is top tier, atmosphere is always lovely, service is next level. They even provided a blanket for my little boy when he was a bit cold. The ranch is also crazy good.. on everything. 11/10!
Delicious Scotch Fillet Steak meal $34. Famous venue view at restaurant area on ground floor. Atmosphere may be cheerful chatty and busy at times. Complimentary free water.

Best kebab wraps ever! Super flavoursome chicken & rice & crunchy fresh salad was amazing! Great service fast & healthy food after a night out. Highly recommended 100% great value for authentic cultural Turkish experience. Home cooking at it's best so yummy & amazing place to support as love & passion lives here! Owners Seyad & Miriam are truly wonderful sweet couple who both make you feel welcome & prepare your meal with love 😍
An authentic Thai restaurant with excellent service and a warm atmosphere. Prices are a little high, but the quality and experience make it well worth it.— Ideal for a special evening.

Had the Chicken Laksa and Sambal Sweet & Sour Chicken with rice – both were packed with flavour and so delicious. Great portions, friendly service, and a really tasty meal. Definitely worth coming back!
Why have Papa Rich when you already have Mama Rich? The food here is absolutely delicious, perfectly seasoned, and I’ll definitely be coming back. Deserved the wait.

I've been visiting this McDonald's since I was a little boy. Today, I ordered the cheeseburger combo with a nice Coke. I highly recommend this place because there’s always parking, it’s a great spot for meetings, and the food comes out quickly. This is a flagship store and one of the best ones. Thanks, Sterling Arnet Kakapo Business Sales

Very friendly staff, roast duck noodle soup was awesome for it's price and their beef noodles are to die for. For those complaining, maybe don't order fish and chips from a Chinese restaurant and you'll a better experience

Ordered from Uber Eats tonight. Absolutely delicious. I had lost hope that Auckland had any good fish and chip shops, but my opinion has changed! The snapper was cooked perfectly and tasted amazing, the hotdogs on a stick brought me back to the good days and the chips were also cooked perfectly and very tasty. Couldn't recommend this fish and chip shop enough! So glad I found them, will be my go to from now on!
nice delicious burger with a reasonable price. good atmosphere, friendly staffs. their blue cheese burger doesn't have strong flavour but still like it. fish burger on the photo.

Went to Sahana for the very first time for their Onam sadya and absolutely loved the place! The food was spectacular and the management and staff were warm, friendly and Welcoming. Will come back soon!

Had an espresso and some bagel’s to take away. The bagel was awesome. It was simple, with a nice sesame seed taste but the texture was perfect. Both soft and chewy at the same time. Coffee was really nice too. I bought some Eskal spicy gherkins as well, they were average; not nearly as good as McClures, but better than Sunlong.

Very Disappointed with Quality Ordered from KFC today and was extremely disappointed. The food looked unappetizing and the oil quality seemed poor — greasy, heavy, and with an unpleasant taste. After eating, I started feeling uncomfortable, which is very concerning. For a brand like KFC, I expected better quality and freshness. Please stop serving such poor-quality food immediately and conduct a proper quality check in the store to ensure customers’ safety.

“Absolutely loved my experience at KFC! The food was fresh, crispy, and delicious as always, but what really stood out was the fantastic customer service. The staff were incredibly friendly, attentive, and went out of their way to make sure my order was perfect. They handled everything with a smile, even during a busy rush. KFC, you’ve got a winning team—keep up the great work! I’ll definitely be back!”

Really good experience at KFC Greenlane. The staff were super friendly and welcoming, which made the visit nice. Food came out fresh, hot, and tasted great – exactly how you’d want it. Service was quick too, no long wait times. Honestly one of the better KFC spots I’ve been to.

I've been twice to this Greenlane kfc and I've got two completely different experiences Last week I went in Monday afternoon for lunch and the team were incredible with the customer services and I remember the staffs were serving me and my wife in the front counter (Seef, Manju and Lisa I hope I got their name correctly). The food was tasty and they were very lovely. Then I went again Friday night the same week through drive-thru. I wanted boneless spicy chicken only 10 pieces but I got 6 boneless and 4 tenders I asked for large plain gravy and they gave me large potato gravy and the man taking my order I believe was Dove was rushing me and kept saying 'anything else' anything else' made wanna stop ordering when I want to add more.

I would give them a zero if I could. Ordered $80 worth of food for a work lunch just for them to cancel the order 40min later. No phone call to tell me. Pathetic service. Explains why their review rating is so low

We ordered on uber eats! Must say they are no where close to authentic Indian food! They sell some coloured spicy fried rice under the name of biryani. The mint chutny/ dip is sweet!! You can actually have it for dessert. Who makes sweet chutny!! We had 2 types of kebabs, only the tangri kebab was good. I am so disappointed with the quality and taste of food. Not Recommended.
there was a time in my life when I ate fish and chips once a week pls dont judge me

If I am able to rate zero star, I will. Rushed churros tasted like just defrozen and soggy (it is brightened with the light tbh, actually more plain), missing chocolate sauce. Same for the new introduced puff roll. I can understand high demand and low capacity during this tricky time, but that does not justify the not fully cooked food. Would never order from this branch again.

Pretty average, I was looking forward to a nice, fresh hot whopper unfortunately I got a luke warm, thrown together, no effort burger. Love the free refills and flavour shots for the drink though. Staff didn't interact at all with customers (except the one girl - who came to the counter because she thought we were ordering at the counter, she was pleasant)

Absolutely 💯 recommend this wee gem of a restaurant. Quiet but busy on a fathers day .I had the crayfish and the spinach pie and some champagne. that was so yum.worth every dollar spent and shout out to the waiter who was bubbly and friendly funny and great hospitality all rounder.didnt get his name but he had glasses lol also the manager was such a good boss to watch work with his crew on this day.

We moved from Singapore to Auckland about a year ago & are so happy to have discovered Wakuwaku near our home! The food here is consistently delicious & comforting. We especially enjoy their set lunch — great variety & good value. The sashimi is fresh & nicely prepared too. It’s such a treat to have an authentic Japanese spot nearby. Highly recommend!

We had a good time here with good food and drinks. Tempura prawn lunch set was good and fresh. The entrees is a bit on the small side with just one sushi and 3 Sashimi. Side dishes for the main course is also on the small side. Tonkotsu Pork is very nicely done with tender pork. The yakiniku beef is a little tough.
A+

We went for lunch looking for proper pasta and we found it at Spiga. Lots of Black Truffle shaved on top of our Pizza Fungi, Taglatellia and Scarpinocc. The Beetroot Salad was refreshing and perfectly dressed with Spiga Extraordinary Olive Oil. Kind service and a cool atmosphere made for a memorable lunch. Thank you.

Great quality. The vegan Creamy mushroom pie was the best I've had in New Zealand. Really enjoyed the buttered cabbage side. Service was excellent from a lovely French waiter. Will definitely be coming back to try the rest of the menu.

Beautiful little cafe. Really good food. The hash cakes with the eggs Benedict were amazing! The only downfall is the location... hard to get a park, quite loud from the near traffic and cramped inside but it is worth it! Lots of yummy food to choose from. If you’re in the Remuera village, check this one for sure...

One of the best burgers I’ve had. Ordered the ‘royal big smoke’ and had our food within 10minutes. The burger was delicious, only thing I could fault was maybe a little bit less BBQ sauce, but other than that I could not fault it. The chips were also great, crispy on the outside and very well seasoned. Staff were very welcoming and friendly and even gave us dipping sauce free of charge. Highly recommend to anyone, get a lot of excellent food for excellent value.
First time at Re Burger and it did not dissapoint. Staff were great, burgers were delicious and the loaded fries were impressive. We will be back!

Great modern and clean interior in a good location. Squid and chicken appetizers were great however rest of food was average. Bacon over cooked in salad and Sunday was mostly cream. Staff were however super friendly and attentive. No issues with parking.

OMGGGG I can’t with how things are here!! 😍😍 Best customer service by staffs working today, the meal were just on fire especially my Mexican chicken salad, the best one I had so far. Atmosphere was super friendly, both interior and exterior of the building is super clean.. WOW just wowwwww, will be my GO TO PLACE 🔥🔥

This is one Branch that is consistent with great service, tasty food & a diverse team who are all happy whether they’re clearing tables or serving food. The male Barista (possibly the Manager too) leads politely and also gets in to help with services Loving the Chefs Choices options for the humans but extra cool to see them care for all shapes and sizes of furbabys constantly refilling their water bowl and the added extra Pat here and there🌟 Definitely “my happy place” Well done Lunn Ave team, I’m a proud local for over 40 + years and it’s great to have your team serving up not just great food but sharing some amazing Maungarei community love & service🌺

First time with the family, introducing Hokkaido to them as we had just climbed Mt Wellington. We were very impressed with the speed and quality of the food. Tried a wide range of food from beef tataki, beef tongue, soft-shelled crab, to the 12 piece sushi and grilled squid. We will be back.

I've never left a negative review in my life. Unfortunately I have to share my experience tonight so they can hopefully improve. I ordered the fettuccine con pollo for takeaway. I drove home after picking it up, had a few bites and had to drive all the way back and get them to remake it. Ive been having the same chicken mushroom fettuccine from over a dozen restaurants around auckland regularly for over 3 years. Its my favourite meal hands down and ive definitely grown to learn whats good. This one had no garlic, tasted as if it was just flower mixed with water, stewed chicken and stewed mushrooms, No cheese and no herbs and spices. It also sat funny my stomach. They had great service there and promptly remade it, unfortunately when I got home and tried the second one, It was very much the same, I sure have a big appetite, but I couldn't even force myself to eat more than 1/3 of it. Feeling rather sick after eating that 1/3 of the second one too. Crossing my fingers the feeling of being sick goes away and doesnt progress. I was very polite when I came and asked them to remake it, and their service was great but sorry guys, I hope when reading this review you can take the necessary steps with your chefs to fix this.

Definitely the worse Nando's I've eaten from. Chips were over spiced I had to use a napkin to wipe them down. Also the chicken on the burger was almost non existent...it felt like I was eating a bun with tomato and lettuce.

I was served by this young man Mark His customer service was excellent. He was wearing wonderful smile and guiding me so patiently. I didn't had to wait for long for my order. Mark has very good customer servicing skills. Good job Mark 👏

Normally I get good service when I dine in but I ordered web order. Order no 125. I paid for whole chicken and 3 sides. Went home and there were no large chips in the order. The guy who served me needs to pay more attention and his body language and customer service was also so bad. I asked him clearly is everything in the bag. He said yes. Disappointed. Please check these orders properly next Time. Customer’s trust you and don’t let them down. I will never order web order from Here again

If you want something to fill your stomach then stay clear. Almost $20 for this burger. The angle made it look like there was somewhat a decent amount of chicken on it. They were smaller than kfc nuggets. Stay clear. Average service. Average environment and far below average amount of food. Apparently its more important for the staff to walk around in packs to chat than to do any serving. Spent almost $60 here. Disappointed and won't return.

Needs more sauce on chicken. Makes it a little dry when there not much on there. Food on the floor. My son was standing on it and had to keep him in his seat to prevent him from playing with it. Other than that always good eating here.

This is exactly the place to be .. Experience-wise, Meadow is truly elevating the dining experience, and I applaud the new management and team for their exceptional attentiveness and outstanding cuisine. The food was a game-changer, with a flavor profile that was nothing short of extraordinary 👌💯 Strongly recommend for a great experience 😊..
Best Curries I have tried to date! Please prove me wrong! Been coming back here for years. Owner has got a magical voice and loves to sing while cooking🙏 10/10 experience

Ordered my son's and my food from here through doordash it was not good to receive burnt!! dry noodles not enough meat at all more vegetables then meat no fork or spoon or tissue very bad first experience
Amazing little food shop in Ellerslie with really kind and friendly staff, spectacular All-Day Breakfast plates and a SUPERB Hot Chocolate! 🤤 Highly recommend trying out this little spot.

Great experience at Charlie & George! The service was warm and attentive, and the food was excellent. The chai latte hit the perfect balance of sweet and spicy, while the hot chocolate was rich and comforting. For breakfast, the Creamy Mushrooms were packed with flavour, the C and G Granola was fresh and satisfying, and the Buttermilk Banana Pancakes were beautifully fluffy. The Kid’s Cheese Burger Meal was a hit, and the House Breakfast was generous and tasty. Portion sizes were large, prices were reasonable, and despite the busy Father’s Day crowd, staff made guests feel welcome and well looked after. Plenty of parking outside. Highly recommended!

Charlie and George is one of those cafés that just gets everything right. The atmosphere is warm and inviting, perfect whether you’re catching up with friends, having a family brunch, or just grabbing a coffee on the go. The staff are always friendly, attentive, and genuinely make you feel welcome.
Popped for a macchiato—so good! ☕️👌 Smooth, strong, and just the right kick. The café has such a nice atmosphere too, perfect spot to relax and enjoy a coffee. I’ll be back!

Great food and a friendly atmosphere! The steak was seasoned perfectly and cooked to a flawless medium rare. Dessert was the perfect way to end the night, and the servers were warm and welcoming. Can’t wait to come back!”

Enjoyed our stay at this lovely place in Stonefields. Clean and great customer service. Food is yummy. We have mango margaritas which we really enjoyed. Had brownie and calamari, perfect 👍. Though Warriors lost, it was still a fun night well spent at this place. Highly recommended 👏

Best experience in my life. My rice feeding function became a successful and best experience. Very good atmosphere,friendly staff and great service. My all guests became so happy and impressed with the function because of service, atmosphere. I m waiting for again next function hopefully coming soon.
Beautiful chicken saagwala dish! But on the pricey side ($27 for chicken saagwala) dine-in price. Next time I’ll just do take-away! But I loved my curry and naan dish!

This Thai restaurant is absolutely amazing🇹🇭🇳🇿 Every dish I tried was full of flavor, especially the "Tom Yum soup" (my fav)👍🏻✨ which was perfectly balanced with spicy, sour, and creamy 🌶️✅ All the other dishes were equally delicious, made with fresh ingredients and authentic Thai flavors⭐️ The atmosphere of the restaurant is really warm and inviting, making it a perfect place to enjoy a meal with family🙋🏻‍♀️🥰 The service was friendly and attentive☺️which made the dining experience even better🙏🏻 I’m definitely come back and trying more dishes 🥰🥰

Customer service was really bad. The 30-40 year old asian woman & asian man working there were really weird about how much of each thing they gave and had 0 flexibility. I couldn't even get tomato sauce with my wedges! Every other pita pit I have ever been to have allowed it. Even after arguing with them about it, they still would not budge. Just makes the food taste sour when its served with such attitude. I don't usually bother writing reviews on places, but they kinda ruined my night so thought it'd be worth writing this review in the hopes that they'll change their ways. And until they do, don't go there. Cheers.

Got the chicken kebab for takeaway. The lady servicing was very kind and also helped make the other Kebab in the order costumed to fit everyone’s preferences. There are lots of good options. This was absolutely delicious, nice and flavourful. Not dry at all, the prefect size too. Enough to finish and be satisfyingly full. They also make a traditional dessert, over all this stop is great and very convenient. Close to us with easy street parking right outside, and a hidden car park as well behind the buildings down a small driveway. Our order was made and packed with such care. And the time was very short, extremely quick and excellent service. Highly recommend.
This is my second time to have my Tank C at Lunn ave, came in a busy time but I get my juice quick and fresh! I love the atmosphere of the store and the service is great as always!

I had the caesar salad and a smoothie at Tank and really enjoyed both. The food was fresh and tasty and the smoothie was spot on. Mary, who went above and beyond to make sure everything was just right. Her friendly smile and genuine care really made the visit. Definitely coming back!!

I don’t know why I ever come here. The one on lunn Ave is literally the worst of all tanks. Came here on Wednesday the 3rd of September at 2:45pm and order 2x salads and 3x smoothies.. after waiting for 20mins I get told that sorry they have no bowls left to put the salads in! And needed to refund me the salads 😑 thanks for having me wait for 20mins before telling me I won’t be getting my food. So instead I’d rather get refunded the whole thing and go somewhere else. Absolutely useless. Although generally I’m never happy with the service at this specific tank. Service terrible.
Our go to for the best sushi in the area... lots of sushi options, great tasting hot meals and friendly staff. Definitely worth stopping in, best time would be between 11am and 2pm

We love the Sushi&Don. Always friendly and kind service. The food is consistently good. We highly recommend the katsu udon and miso ramen - delicious flavour and fresh ingredients. Highly recommended!
Hygienic place to visit. Had a lovely father's day lunch with family. Was our second time. Food was yummy. Kids also enjoyed cheese dog and chips. Highly recommend 👌. Will definitely visit again.

Great place with a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The staff were really friendly and made us feel comfortable from the moment we arrived. The food was very fresh and nicely presented, which I really appreciated. Personally, I found some dishes could use a little more flavour to suit my taste, but everything was still enjoyable and prepared with care. Overall, it’s a lovely spot that’s worth a visit, especially if you appreciate fresh ingredients and great service.

Excellent service and tasty dishes! The BBQ pork on rice, grilled chicken, and vermicelli rolls were full of flavour. Clean restaurant, fast service, fair prices, and plenty of parking. Highly recommend!

Have been twice, food is good, service friendly and attentive. The bahn mi buns are great, light and fluffy yet crispy with fresh vegetables and ingredients. The pork on the crispy pork one is indeed crispy

Taco Bell Lunn Ave is always a great experience! The food is fresh, tasty, and served quickly, and the vibe of the place is fun and welcoming. A special shout-out to Moni, who was so friendly and helpful—her great customer service really made my visit extra enjoyable. Thanks Moni and the team for making Taco Bell one of my favourite spots! 🌮✨
Very nice restaurant, lots of space and design is cosy. love their katsu, very crispy and juicy. Will come back for sure
Best udon I’ve ever had! Best salad and the service was fantastic 🙌🏼🔥

Bit of a wait for the food but it was fresh and very nice. The bit that got me was even though the store was quiet at 11:50 am the lady literally threw my order across the counter to me with zero eye contact or have a nice days. Even more astonishing is she was right in front of a crew trainer. This is New Zealand, respect your customers and you will be astounded how nice we are !
The customer service was good. The Angus burgers were delicious.

A sneaky stop in with the teenagers & what a choice call to make. Took advantage of the Back to School Buy 1 get 1 free Promo🙌 Pizza toppings were well proportioned, great value for money, definitely tasty with a Base that was cooked to perfection. We ordered online which was quick paid in store given a 20min window but it was ready well before this. Loved the friendly staff who greeted us with his happy welcome - the store looked clean and felt clean on entry. Looking forward to coming back being a local of Mt Wellington for over 46+ years, it’s nice to support local business that aren’t part of a huge chain who have that community whanau feel with their pricing and quality of food. A good hit with the growing teens😅 All for under $20 - See you again soon Pizza Inn Lunn Ave 🌟

Highly recommend this store and the Webber cooking class is absolutely fantastic. From entree to dessert every bite was to die for. I highly recommend the classes, we got ours for a father’s day gift. Best 3 hours - knowledge and experience. Highly recommend, thank you Wendy and Jason.

Fantastic evening at the Weber BBQ cooking class. Jason & Wendy did an amazing BBQ from starters, main meat & veges and sticky date pudding...wow sooo full!! Learnt heaps and can't wait to give it all a go. Thanks heaps 😋

I love coming to Meadowbank Roast. The gravy and cheese sandwiches are moist and delicious. The potatoes in the roast meals are unmatched, so big and fluffy. And I love the roast meals, I've tried the pork with apple sauce (delicious) the beef (my favourite) and also the lamb (so good),. I highly recommend a trip to this spot in Meadowbank, if you have too much food they have boxes for ease of carrying it. A classic over the years. x

I'm so glad that I finally tried this spot! We had takeout after driving past many times. It smells so delicious when you walk in the door - I knew I was onto a winner! The team are very knowledgeable and accommodating for vegan / plant based meals. I will definitely be back!

Friendly staff, clean restaurant and fast service! Highly recommend because wherever there is good and friendly staff food is always made to the best quality. Thank you Pizza Hut Meadowbank for my pizza.

I had a great time at Pizza Hut today. The pizza was hot, cheesy, and full of flavor. Deep was very polite and provided outstanding service, making sure everything was perfect. Thank you for the wonderful experience.
Delicious puzzas and deserts and hreat customer services x thank yous veryuch

Fresh Fish n Chip, many choices about fish and you can also choose your chips. About Burger, is it a good place to test it - it was gorgeous and excellent! For the service, the people are very kindly and friendly, I recommend 100% 😊

Whatever you do. do not waste your money purchasing from this eatery. Peas and carrots raw, Kumara been boiled not roasted. Roast Beef had no flavour and tasted like boiled meat. I complained they didn't want to know. The worse meal I have had anywhere.
Great quality sushi! Consistent each week we go for prawn and salmon sushi 🤌🏼 The Team working there is very friendly and helpful to make anything you need.

The staff are super friendly and incredibly welcoming. In my opinion they have by far the BEST PIZZA in Auckland. If you are looking for savory they have got you covered with one of the largest range of pizzas to choose from, and if you're in the mood for something sweet they have you covered aswell. I highly recommend you give them a try.

I ordered five dishes of Thai food, but unfortunately, it didn't taste authentic. The tom yum soup was very watery, and the fried chicken was extremely salty—so much so that we couldn't eat it. The pork stir-fry with vegetables was burned, as you can see in the photo I took. The pad Thai and beef salad were acceptable, but overall, the experience was disappointing. I won't be eating there again. Also, make sure to bring cash because their card machine was broken, and we couldn't pay with our card. Fortunately, I had some cash on me and had to quickly run to a nearby ATM to withdraw more. The shopkeeper even seemed to think I wouldn’t pay. It was truly a terrible experience.
Delicious food, friendly owners and super clean

Quite a nice bakery in Stonefields. They have standard bakery treats, both sweet and savoury. Their pie flavours are also quite interesting. They do have some tables inside to wat from otherwise it is easy enough to eat on the go. The curry lamb pie was nice.

Secret....shh... don't tell anyone about this hidden gem! Hot, delicious, flavoursome entree sized meals for 9 people for my mums 75th birthday who is a 42 year veteran chef, who loved the food - said "it's like her cooking flavour some, hot & healthy food". Hit was the succulent mini baby ribs, delicious California sushi, salmon with rice meal & sashimi. Rahul the owner was pleasant and conversed with us after dinner on Sunday 6pm 28/8/25. Will be back for date nights & book my 45 th birthday in December. Thanks Rahul, chef & will spread the word to my large contact list. You made mums 75th Birthday so special. God bless your restaurant🙌🌻Cheers from Lem family

We recently dined here as a group of 10 and had an absolutely wonderful experience. The set menu offered plenty of delicious food, with generous portions and a great variety to suit everyone’s tastes. The service was exceptional—friendly, attentive, and well-organised throughout the evening. It was the perfect setting for a group dinner, and we left feeling very satisfied. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a great dining experience with excellent food and service!

Fabulous neighborhood restaurant. Food is consistently excellent and the service is top rate. It's our go to for a quiet meal for 2, somewhere to take friends and family, a takeaway meal and have also had a large special birthday gathering there. Excellent local.

I had such a great experience at The Chosen Bun! As someone with celiac disease, I’m always a bit nervous about eating out, but this place is a gem. Their gluten-free options are fantastic — I tried the GF Hot Chic Burger and the Golden Phoenix, and both were absolutely delicious. What really stood out was the staff — they were knowledgeable about gluten-free requirements and took the time to answer my questions, which made me feel really comfortable and confident eating here. Highly recommend this spot to anyone looking for tasty burgers with safe gluten-free choices. Definitely coming back!

Despite having coffees and food at Beanee for years, have not managed to find a fault. The best and most consistent coffee in the area . There is a reason why the place is so often full of us regulars. All staff are great, one always feels genuinely welcome. Even our doggies are well looked after - Roger often offers used tennis balls and Nancy even knows names of regulars (doggies and humans).

These guys have been consistently performing and providing an amazing Cafe experience in the heart of upland Road. The Barista is always nice to me and has good conversation! Sterling Arnet Kakapo Business Sales

Overwhelmingly disappointing. The staff was lovely and polite but the meal... Chips had no salt whatsoever - at least the birds got a feed. Chicken breasts were bland and dry, but the drumstick was what really got me - honestly not sure about what the meat was like but the bone smelt very strongly of urine once bare. Unfortunately I only noticed after I've eaten the meat... Is this because the chickens are raised in a mudpool of urine and feces so even their bones smell like it by the time they get to the table? If so, that's despicable. I can't be sure exactly what it was that caused that smell but I'm never going back to KFC again.

Utterly the worst KFC I’ve been to & also had food delivered from. Ordered through ubereats, paid over $127 worth of food. We received our order an hour late, cold & plenty of missing items. Missing 2 large chips, large gravy, wicked wings in the feast combo & our large coleslaw. So my husband then drove out to KFC in Panmure & bought the missing items as we put a complaint through to ubereats. Have a look at the difference in the two large gravy’s bought at KFC Panmure & KFC Glen Innes. KFC Panmure made their gravy’s smooth in consistency. Now have a look at KFC Glen Innes - there’s like chunks of kaka in their gravy’s.

Finally had a really nice experience at this McDonald’s! A lovely Asian lady served me, and she was super friendly, patient, and made me feel very welcome. It’s not always easy to get genuine service at fast food places, but she really went the extra mile. Thank you for making my day a bit brighter!
Literally bite taken out of one of the patties on my Big Mac, tried calling them 5x to get a new one, never answered the phone. Disgusting

Locals know this is the place to go for fresh fish & seafood. Have been in the same Croatian family since its inception. They offer a great selection in both smoked & fresh catches. Fish & Chip packs are reasonably priced & you won't be disappointed. Highly recommend for a tasty treat.
i am sorry i have to be honest, the food was disgustinng , it was greasy, overcooked and even the seagulls wouldn’t eat it . w won’t be back 🤮
Got a seafood rice combination...bro no flavors at all very disappointed I had to ad salt and pepper in to taste any flavor..
Better than expected. Was shopping next door at Mad Butcher and popped in to grab a quick bite. Service was top tier. Lamb and cabbage is so good. Hot chips as well.
Whoever keeps writing the cute notes with a smiley face on my delivery - Hello and thank you! :)

This has become a regular place for us and cause we've moved in the area. I highly recommend them. My favorite is the roast pork meal and it's fully packed in the container with all the trimmings 👌🏾 There are lovely to the customers and do a great job in service. They're fried chicken is 😋👌🏾on point too.
Foods good! But the customer service of the lady is appalling, always grumpy and rude.

Have offers on uber and then don’t deliver what was ordered. Had multiple buy one get one free offers on many dishes, yet only deliver one. Called them as I thought it may have been a mistake and they said since I only paid for one, I’m only getting one. They shouldn’t advertise on uber if they have no intention of honouring the offer.

Amazing Korean fried chicken in the heart of Glen Innes shops. The burgers are amazing and prices reasonable compared with other burger joints in the area. After years living in the area I gave it a go for the first time last week and now I'm in love with the place. Totally recommended!

Butter chicken on chips, amazing ! Snack box prices, amazing! Handling the food with bare hands, not amazing. This place has delicious, affordable food but their hygiene and sanitary practises need work
Food is okay but very poor customer service. No smile or greetings. Lady behind the counter looked very angry and turned her back on me. Very unwelcoming atmosphere.
I loved the butter chicken it tasted soooo good but the cashier does not speak much English but 10/10
They make very tasty food, literally like Indian restaurants. Well done Thank you so much
Great place great food chicken was crunchy and moist and juicy butter chicken was amazing highly recommend this place

The AI drivethru is simple & accurate! Making service at the window so swift and efficient. Seems to allow the team inside to optimise their time, very friendly too! Thanks for a pleasant experience, and yummy food!

We came here last weekend Sunday and OMG! It was so yummy. Butter chicken was freshly cooked, with a nice flavored sauce. And the service was the cherry on top. I will be coming back for more and to the public, please support your locals. They are awesome🔥🔥🔥

We got some food from Uber Eats, and it was pretty good, like a real test of Indian food. I just wish the Noon was a little more cooked, but maybe it personal. The rice was good, though. Very fast delivery.

The portions here are really generous, which is always a win. I’ve tried their sirloin steak plate and it was an amazing, balanced meal. The only issue is that the steak is always cooked close to well-done, and if they focused on improving that, it would take the dish to the next level. I’ve also had the BBQ mix plate, which was perfect overall. The lamb chops tasted and chewed beautifully, the chicken wing sauce was really nice, and everything else was solid. My one gripe? They used normal fries, and they came soggy — which I can’t stand. Most people seem to enjoy them, but for me, soggy chips are the worst. That said, the sirloin plate always comes with super crispy crinkle-cut fries, seasoned with a really nice salt, and they’re absolutely spot on. Overall: 4/5. With just a couple of small improvements (steak doneness and fries on the mix plate) this place could easily be a 5/5. And honestly, if they dropped the prices just a touch (I get Uber Eats adds their own fees), this could easily be my everyday go-to for dinner

A great pizza looks appetizing but an amazing pizza has an aroma ! And once I opened that box, it was game over! Not a fan of thick base but the ratio of toppings as well as sauce balanced the pizza! Delicious and super filling Might have to try them all to find my favorite 😀 Thank you for treating my tastebuds !

Ordered a kebab, they had no hummus or yoghurt. Then they said the kebabs were with chips or salad. I was actually expecting a wrap but ok that’s my bad. I said salad. Came home and my kebab was chips lol. Useless service and a waste of money. Ended up taking off all the meat and making my own salad at home

My first time trying Indian food. The flavor was truly excellent—far better than I expected! The curry was definitely much tastier than store-bought. The kitchen was spotlessly clean, and the owner was incredibly friendly and patient.

Highly recommend, first time stopped by today and wowwwww service, food price to delivery 1000%, you asked for mild and the twist of your order taste flavour wowww will come back for more the 19.99 deal awesome, nani garlic bread, freshly cooked curry yummy.
The BEST curry and affordable too. Loved the butter chicken! Im quite fussy with takeaways but this was so good. My favorite onion bhajis I've tasted. Will be back, thank you!
Got the mini combo butter chicken which was surprisingly big and delicious. Ordered it spicy and damn it was 🔥🔥. Was so full afterwards, would definitely be coming back to try the other curries!

I tried Paneer Dilkhush with rice and butter roti at Makahani Takeaway in Panmure, and it was absolutely delicious. The paneer was soft and flavorful, the gravy rich and perfectly spiced – just the right balance of creamy and tangy. The rice was fluffy, and the butter roti was fresh, warm, and buttery, making it the perfect combo. Great portion size, tasty food, and really good value. Definitely a spot I’ll be coming back to for authentic flavors!

My favourite sushi place ever. Small and sweet that it's a small business and literally the best quality sushi I've ever had and such good portions for the cost. I recommend this place to any and everyone as much as I can!

I usually get the charcoal chicken on rice and it never disappoints. The chicken cubes are massive, juicy, and packed with flavour – easily one of the best protein hits you can get in a meal. The portion size is perfect: hearty, filling, and always consistent. I eat here at least once a week and it’s hands down always delicious. Highly recommend!

One of the best chicken charcoal & my favorite most lamb racks. I would rate the racks as one of the best I have ever tried. Being there many times & never disappointing, the empty plate tells the story
Khanz Panmure is analyzing, very good and clean kitchen - the food is absolutely a delicacy.

I visited Giant Burger today and was served by pavinder, who is a staff member there. His customer service is absolutely next level, and the burger he made was incredibly delicious – honestly one of the best burgers in Auckland! Because of pavinder, I always enjoy coming here. The food is amazing, and his friendly service makes the experience even better. Highly recommended
We got the camembert burger, looked plain but it was actually really tasty. We also got the chicken wings and salad which was delicious. Only one person working but she was friendly and quick.

I had an appetite for burgers, but not the usual chain fare. I found this place on Google, and decided to try it as it was nearby. And ended up going for the grilled chicken. It was very good, well cooked and delicious. My flatmate did go for a camembert burger and reported that it too, was great. Only one person on duty tonight, but the service was great.

Have come here quite a few times recently, good coffee and food, big and warm outside area with awnings down especially when the raining or windy days, nice to sit outside with your dogs, stuff are friendly and good service, and they are open 7 days a week now

We went to this cafe yesterday 16th April and ordered the chicken burger meal and the fish and chip meal. The chicken burger was really dry and bland and the bottom of the burger bun was hard. The fish and chip meal - 1 fish was cooked and the other not so much. The salad was cut up lettuce with 1 cherry tomato cut in half an 2 really thin sliced small radish. Loved the Smoothie. Staff were nice.
Great food and the owners were super friendly and generous. The chef came out and gave my friends child a free plate of corn chips, so he could have his own dish. Giving his parents a (small) break 😂
Can’t beat the wings. Best around Auckland
Best chicken nibbles in the E 💯 highly recommend 👌

Crap food and service. I ordered our food and gave specific orders not to put cabbage in the egg foo young but yet they over powered it with cabbage and everything. Asked for extra sauce in the fried rice came as white as with barely nothing. The snapper was overcooked instead of half cooked as asked. Got there to pick up order and asked for a milk shake to get a oh no can't do it to busy. Usually they are pretty decent for the price but tonight was an epic fail and most of the food ended up in the rubbish will never go back.

We have traveled to Thailand many times, and this is the best Chicken Sartay and Prone Toast we have ever had. We would highly recommend this place, there are a number of renovations going on around it currently, but don't let that put you off 100% worth a visit. Ulf Fuehrer
A lovely little cafe. The staff are very friendly. I had the cinammon apple crumble muffin and a hot chocolate. Highly recommend. Nice atmosphere.

I am posting this review because I was shocked that a ciabiatta filled roll was $15!!!! It tasted really nice. But $15!!!! Next time I'm out for a walk I'm just going to buy a picnic lunch from Fresh Choice, which is only a few metres away. Cafe is very ordinary looking. BTW in response to the owner's response, there was no price on the Ciabiatta filled roll. I am guessing that's because it was so expensive. All items should have visible prices. I should have just said no and chosen something else, but was to taken aback I didn't do so.

Very enjoyable cafe with an amazing pier view in half moon bay. Large space, both outdoor and indoor seats. A good selection of food, from cabinet to the menu. Seafood chowder is yummy. Great and efficient service adding on some Asian hospitality, a great place to chill over the weekend.
I came for lunch and all I can say is that place was beyond my expectations. Great service, delicious food and the place is so welcoming. Highly recommend! 🤤😋🥳
I went out for pizza tonight, the service was friendly and the pizza was really good. This chicken chili pizza was especially good!

The food here is amazing. 5 bucks for a MASSIVE slice of pizza! The worker here is so nice that he even gave my friend a discount. Food was served very quick and the vibe is great. Honestly, this is one of my best pizza experiences.

Sals pizza is such a wonderful place and I would recomend it for everyone out there. Out of all the times i have been there I would like to specifically mention Dil, who was reserving for another manager. He has really good manners, very professional, and provides such good service even when he got our order wrong(if I there was a 6 stars option I would choose it for service).

Delicious authentic Tianjin breakfast food. Really cheap prices too, lovely fresh steamed buns only $2 each and Jian bing $8. The wonton soup for $12 is a huge serving, would recommend getting that for a nice light soothing soup and a couple of buns etc to share.

I've only come here during breakfast time, which starts from 7am. The Chinese doughnuts and soy milk are nice and good value for money. I would recommend you to takeaway if you do not have all day, as the wait can be really long when they are busy. My experience eating it at home is 4 🌟, if dining in, only 3

We were looking for a place for lunch, and came across this place. Friendly staff, good food and a great atmosphere. The place was pretty busy, and the service was just the right amount of attentive. I had the fish and chips, which were very nicely done.

This was our first time at Zabr'one and it was fantastic! The staff were friendly and quick with their service, and the food was delicious. We were a party of 4 and we all had pizzas and loved them (photo of the Moroccan Lamb pizza). The calamari entree was tasty as well. We will be back to try more of the menu. It's a lovely location as well, across the road from Buckland Beach. Thanks to first table we saved $86 on food, so after the $12 booking fee, its still a great saving.

Zabr’one in Bucklands Beach, Howick, Auckland, is a gem for families and foodies alike. Our family of three had a great experience. Our son raved about the pepperoni pizza and his orange juice, perfect for kids. The vibe is family-friendly yet upscale, with a few boujee patrons adding a touch of class. My wagyu beef burger was satisfying and packed with flavor. My wife’s bang bang chicken entree, while tasty, felt overpriced for the portion size—our only gripe. The drink menu impresses with beers, cocktails, and more. The views, especially from a good seat, are stunning and elevate the experience. Highly recommend!

Was expecting more to be honest. We ordered three pasta and they are like home cooked pasta (not the Italian Nana home cooked). We had the bolognese which was a bit watery, same with the maninara. Carbonara was not too bad. We also ordered the fries - frozen supermarket fries and the seasonal vegetables, not impressed as well.
Since 2005 in Freemans Bay, Auckland, now in 3 locations in Auckland & 1 in Melbourne...

A Friend and I Dined here Friday 15 August '25 via First Table. Made Prices very affordable, which felt like a Treat!!! A lovely, wide open space. Delicious Food!!! Served promptly 😋 And extremely comfortable chairs!! Wow!!! I wish every Restaurant had those chairs!!! 😂 We Really Enjoyed Our Catchup!!! Definetly will be back with My Husband for him to enjoy also!!! 🤩

The ambience of the old cottage is awesome, sit inside or on the verandas or out back. The food is always superb. We always find our eyes are bigger than our stomachs here. Today we arrived hungry from a gym workout - shared a ham on sourdough and couldn’t finish it! Loads of ham and butter and cheese, wow!

I was extremely disappointed to witness the behavior of one of the managers during my recent visit. The manager was yelling at a young staff member in front of customers, which was both unprofessional and unacceptable. This kind of conduct not only creates a hostile work environment but also leaves a very negative impression on customers. Staff deserve to be treated with respect, and such behaviour is simply disgusting and inappropriate for a workplace.
It looks fantastic i can not what 7 years to go until Ian 65 and I can Jone the howick r s a club

1sr time visit this takeaway Lovely service by female Ordered scoop of chips and Fish & Egg burger Chips were over cook fish & egg burger was nice different batter on the fish was crunch but that's cool Nice piece too the only thing was the after taste of the fish in the burger and chips wasn't nice maybe needed to change the oil but hey I would give youz a go again try you guys fish and chips and rolls next time

Great theme, great value for money. I took the kids and they loved the nachos. We shared a massive platter between the three of us and there was still plenty left. Service is prompt, food presented well and venue well decorated. Will definitely go there again.

First time at Daisy chang and it was delicious! 2 people - 2 Duck hawker rolls & 2 entrees, 1 peach bomb (so tasty) = $77 We ordered the duck hawker roll, which was yum but nothing amazing but i would recommend, the prawn toast was also very tasty with 3 large pieces it was delightful - the crunchy chicken unfortunately was the one to bring this rating down, it was a bit too hard and was not fresh - however once i told the server about this she apologised and asked whether we’d like a new one or to be taken off our bill which I really appreciated! Lastly the salmon tartar was the star of the show and was to die for definitely was my favourite dish of the night! It was light and fresh and the crackers it’s served with were so tasty! I’m interested in coming back to try more on their menu!

Such a cute little restaurant! Staff were lovely and the food was amazing!!! Highly recommend! Definitely going to go back! Piggy, their sister bar, was also very cute, we had a delicious cocktail there before 🫶🏻

Lovely welcoming service from the front of house ladies. Prompt order taken and amazing to watch the pizza being prepared and cooked right in front of you. Awesome vibe and the pizza oven keeps the place nicely warm! We had Margherita and spicy salami pizza with fries. Fries can easily feed 3-4 people! So delicious a fantastic local spot.
Staff are super friendly and efficient. Always know my order and special needs. Makes my meal ordering an absolute pleasure. Food is always great.

Eight local ladies went there for dinner. Most ladies were really disappointed with their meal. Despite discussing the heat of each dish with the waitress 6 out of 8 found the heat was way excessive. Dishes that were acceptable were the well known Butter Chicken. My Chicken Tikka Marsala which I often choose, at an Indian restaurant, and love was very short on meat. Sadly 8 local ladies now will not return. May I suggest that our waitress be more helpful and knowledgeable. Really big missed opportunity.

I have been always a fan of indian restaurant and i love all the spices it has to offer! Oh well, this is a first time to eat here since it was a venue for a friend's 1st birthday. It was a great place to be! Friendly staff, food was authentic and has all the checks on my list! Would be happy to come back. Their mango ice cream and goat curry was a hit!

UPDATE: I REALISED I PUT THE WRONG CAFE NAME IN. THIS REVIEW IS FOR HOMESTEAD CAFE, AR HOWICK HISTORICAL VILLAGE Stunning, delicious food, reasonable pricing and such a gorgeous setting! Having the (small) marble run and skate park / pump track right next door was an absolute win!

Exceptional Dining Experience with Outstanding Service Last night, I had the pleasure of celebrating a small birthday gathering at this fantastic establishment, and it was nothing short of delightful. Our group of six was warmly welcomed and well taken care of throughout the evening, thanks to the incredible staff who ensured everything was seamless. Highlights of the Experience: • Food: The cuisine was outstanding! Highly recommended dishes include the chilli chicken, chilli fried rice, and fried squid, each bursting with flavor and perfectly prepared. • Service: The staff went above and beyond, providing exceptional hospitality. A special mention to the lovely lady who served us—her constant smile and positive attitude truly enhanced our evening. • Ambience: The restaurant offers a fantastic atmosphere, making it an ideal spot to relax and enjoy quality time with friends. Kudos to the chef and the entire team for making the evening memorable. This place is a must-visit for anyone seeking great food and remarkable service. Cheers!

Had to stay here for a long time since logistics with a toddler was hectic today. We ordered coffee, lasagna, spanakopita, and their breakfast meal. I kid you not everything was delicious and with an affordable price tag, too. And then sometime after our meal, in between our meetings and while waiting for the rain to be gone, they served us another coffee for free!! What a delightful customer service really. Honestly made our day. Thank you for the great food and service
Nice little cafe in the heart of Howick Village. Food is good at afordable price. Recommending this place.
Amazing service, great food, fresh and filling and very good prices! Would definitely recommend this place!
The best ever Sushi I had in NZ!!

Great foods with terrible service. Always packed of people, better to make reservation before you come. Have been there couple times, this time only allow us to stay from 6:15pm-7:45pm(1.5 Hours) Confirm with us again our dinning time slot once we seated. Foods are always nice n yummy, fresh n authentic. Just found that the pizza is a bit salty this time. Want to share about their terrible service this time ( our previous experience is pretty ok) Just want to point out the waitress is not professional as we expected, not refill the water until the dessert time ( actually we already called out twice ), not checking up the foods. Have to call out couple times for dessert menu.... very disappointing.

Seems like Adam, the bar manager at Barrel Inn, makes up his own rules about who gets served, especially if you’re a woman. I wasn’t intoxicated, yet he refused me multiple times. If you’re looking for fair treatment and a good night out, this isn’t the place.

I have been going to Yoshi Sushi for years. The sushi is the best sushi in East Auckland. I also love that everything is made fresh on the spot so I am still able to eat this sushi while pregnant, The owners are so accommodating around this as well. I absolutely recommend!

Fantastic dinner this evening with family in the restaurant. As always fantastic food, reasonably priced. Owner is a great host, and goes out of his way to ensure that you are having a great night. Definitely recommend, and as always will go back again. Thanks for a great night.
Was in the mood for some Garlic Bread. Gotta be the best garlic bread I have had in Auckland..buttered with herbs and parmesan..Match made in heaven.. From PICKY EATER HOWICK.
The longestttt spring roll that is freshly fried, golden crispy with the best flavourful filling🥰, love the Japchee and other flavours like the Korean bbq pork, can’t wait to come back!
