Highly recommend. Jeff was so sweet, 10/10 customer service. Absolutely loved the japchae, bananamars and the corn cheese spring rolls. Have never had a spring roll so long before. Will definitely be back to try the other flavours!! ❤️❤️

These rolls are so good!! A real bang for your buck too. My fave ones are the japchae & corn/cheese - super flavourful and tasty. You should also grab one of their house made cordials, so refreshing!! Will be back again!!
Have tried every one of their rolls and they are AMAZING! Such good food and always meet with a massive smile from Jeff, would absolutely recommend Rollin to anyone keen to try it!

Not a frequent customer, but I've always felt the owners are quite rude. However the food wasn't completely trash so I would sometimes still support locals. Until today, I will never go there again. I ordered my meal, as it was on their menu to them. After 15 or so minutes, they gave me the wrong item. There was no apology from them, they just told me to wait for longer. I originally thought, a mistake is a mistake, if it wasn't something my daughter didn't wanted, I didn't mind just taking the item off them to save time. All I asked was what was the wrong item, instead of explaining, she screamed at me to look at the window myself outside, and just buggered back into the kitchen. So I was waiting in there, and another frequent customer came to the store. She gave the original wrong product to that customer saying how it's a freebie since the other customer didn't want it. Right in front of me. I would never step back into this place again, their food isn't even that good but what's trashier is their attitude, and the other takeaway place has much better customer service than them. RESPONDING: Then you should really go back and look at your CCTV, Saturday 7 ~ 7:40pm. Have fun. Won't be responding to your delusional response anymore.

Today was my first time here and it will be my last. I usually go to the Roast Kitchen on Moore Street. They were closed today so I thought I would try this takeaway. Service was hurried and he was not attentive. Even though there was alot of lamb left, he tried to fill up my container with the tiny little pieces that were left over from the last serving. I also had to ask for a bag, fork and serviette.

First time we tried and we didn’t regret it! A lovely rich sweet and sour sauce over the pork. A packed black bean beef with tasty green beans and chunky veges. But the surprise was the Nasi and Bami goreng… It has potatoes in it! And wow did that make it pop! Looking forward to going back. We have meals for several days. 😊
Always get combo E very good food
First time there, the food and service was good on a cold night, would be nice if they did uber delivery.
I ordered a lamb biryani. You can choose spicy level. Large portions and Good taste! It's worth it. Highly recommend.

Stellar kebabs!! 🙌🌯🔥 Kebab roasted then fried meats with generous, juicy fillings, plenty of fresh salads, perfect hummus and bangin’ tabbouleh. The sauce range is good and the spicy jalapeños are a magic touch. The staff are super kind and professional. Special shout out to the lady who remembers everything about my order and always delivers on all the extras I love. She is an absolute gem and really understands customer service and looking after your regulars. This is an excellent addition to the local scene and I hope they get enough business to keep the fires on and meats spinning all day! Open until 10pm daily.

I ordered though the online app and came to pick it up. I began to pay when my card had declined and told one of the staff that I was going to check. He then, quite rudely, told me to "hurry up" even though the store closed in 10min. As someone who works in hospo, it doesn't take much to be kind and/or patient. My pizza also had toppings in which I didnt asked for. I'll see myself to Pizza Hut from now on
Great service and delicious pizza😊😊 Well done Pizza Hut Beachlands 👍👍
So lucky to have these bunch of friendly staff serving yummy pizza in our pice of Paradice. Thin and crispy is our all time favourite.
AMAZING food. I have tried alot of Korean fried chicken and this one is unmatched. The staff are incredible and friendly and their food is consistently good. I am definitely a repeat customer
Beautiful burgers as always, thanks team ☺️
Best flavours ever. I've been eating ther my whole life and still not sick of it
Good quality food. Well cooked

Ambrosia is such an understated gem. The food and service are always excellent, and the prices are very reasonable for the quality you get. Portions are generous, which is always a plus! My family and I especially love going for their Sunday roasts — only $25 and it even includes a drink of your choice. Always delicious, great value, and consistently a wonderful experience.

Restaurant way busy which is a clear vote of confidence in these difficult times. Food was good. Nice portions that are priced competitively. Wide range of food from pasta to curry. Nice cabinet food for quick bite and coffee.

Ohhh DELICIOUS food here. I had the cashew and prawn stir fry which was so tasty, fresh and perfect size. My husband ordered massaman curry. The iced chocolates are really special. I look forward to going back. The view of the marina is super pretty.

If you ever go to this authentic Italian restaurant- Italian owner and chefs! You should definitely try the truffle and mushroom tagliatelle! It’s amazing! The Rice Ball starter is also appetizing! They also have great Italian pizzas of a rich variety and shapes! Beautiful food and beautiful culture!

Excellent food, great staff and awesome atmosphere. Burger and chips is great! Try the garlic and cheese bread, the loaded fries are awesome but ask for extra cheese sauce. Awesomeness!!!!Kapai Everyone!!!!
Great local fishn chip shop, try their potato fritters. yum!

Came here for dinner from out of town while visiting a friend and it was worth it! Food was so full of flavour, good sized portions and a great menu to choose from. Service was excellent and the staff were so friendly and welcoming. Will definitely make the drive out to dine here again.

We had excellent Lunch over there yesterday. Awesome experience, nan and curry was excellent. We ordered butter nan, hundi chicken all are freshly prepared. Taste was so nice. This much taste actually I didn't expect. It's must try resturant if you comes to this place.
Had my husband's birthday there last Saturday. Awesome staff, special thanks to Jane, Russell and David for working so hard and making it a very memorable event
Good freindly people. Great food. Safe atmosphere.
Real meat pies (plus vege options) with great pastry. Steak bacon and cheese my favorite so far.
The best Italian fast food.. Made with love, and true flavor. Great service and worth every dollar. Thanks team!

Have been here a few times and found quality good so didn't mind paying a little more. Chips have always been a very meagre serve. Last time I went the portions were all small and it was swimming with grease. May have been a one-off but it was a very disappointing meal and the last one to be purchased from there ☹️

Great food, service and price. This family owned business has been around for many many years. A loyal customer of this store. Definitely a great option xx Sorry food was soooooo good. Pics show how hungry we were haha!!! 😀😆🧡💯
Six dollars chips what a joke , I know its hard times but no reason to take it out on customer's.
Awesome place. Cheap feed! Perfect food
Such an unprofessional staff arrogant and stupid customer service .wrong pizza deliver and blaming customer that his fault .staff name Shubham is such a rude and arrogant staff in store

Having lived in India for a few months. I got to try really yummy authentic Indian food this place has been my mums fave for years. This is my new go to now!! The food is so authentic and made with love you can tell with every mouthful! Everything we ordered was exceptional. The owner was lovely and we chatted about many things. He was also very kind to my 4 year old son which I adore. We were able to relax and enjoy our meals and go home completely satisfied ate the lot and took nothing home!!

If I could give this 0 stars, I would. The service at this place is disgusting. The staff here have no customer service skills. Don’t waste your money here, go to “ten on ten” a few doors down where you are welcomed.
Always super kind and friendly, with honestly some of the best Indian food I've ever had
Best kebabs out west! The large sized kebabs are huge and packed with heaps of meat. The salad is fresh and the chips have the best seasoning. The food is super flavourful, would highly recommend.

Finally found a halal shop Aalaa Keba! I went there for the first time and was really impressed. The food was fresh and tasty, just the way I like it. The part-time engineer guy was super friendly, and since it was my first visit, he even offered me a free drink, which was a nice surprise. He made sure everything was okay and checked in to see if I was satisfied. It’s rare to find such great service in a fast food shop! I’ll definitely be coming back and recommending it to others!

Such an awesome spot with amazing food.Yesterday I finally tried their chicken on chips, and honestly, I was kicking myself for not trying it sooner especially since I live so close. The guy at the counter (who’s actually an engineer!) was super friendly, and we ended up having a great chat. I’ll definitely be coming back, not just for the food, but to support a place that really deserves it

Silver Bell has been our go to for years for chinese takeaway. Food is always fresh and the lady is always good to us. Only issue was finding an updated menu online. Took a few pics of the menu when I picked my order up.

I feel uncomfortable leaving a negative review because the staff was very polite, but unfortunately, the food was not good. I ended up with a really upset stomach after eating the chicken, lamb, and taro. I believe the food I recieved was re-heated. The pre-packed sauces also had an unpleasant taste and smell. To be honest, everything smelled off, but the lamb probably smelled the worse. I prefer the smaller golden potatoes, I never finish the ones from here because they are too big and most times unevenly cooked.

Always a great experience at Seasonings. Great service, great food for the price, and always something new on the menu! The acai and vanilla soft serve is so good after a kebab! 🤩🤩 The granola is also sweet and the right amount of crunchy.

I use their website to make specific orders especially if Im sending someone else to take my order for me. So I don't complete the online purchase but use it to specify exactly what I need then (photo provided) because I found that ordering online is a different price from ordering in person. Even when I provide a screenshot of my specific order with this method, they've managed to get it wrong both times. The first time I used this method, they added all the salads despite my clear request to leave some out. The second time, I ordered a large combo but only received a kebab without sides. I had to return 2-3 times to get it corrected, and the staff member even questioned if we knew what we were doing. They also added onions, even though I did not request them, and the screenshot showed exactly what I wanted in my kebab. They ask questions about size, sauces, salads and drink when the screenshot already provides what they need to know. I'm unsure if they are just lazy to read the full order because it seems like a 1 second look at the screen and a nod. They confuse the person I am sending in with their questions. A few years ago, I ordered through Uber Eats and received a falafel kebab instead of the lamb kebab I ordered. While the portion sizes are generally smaller compared to other places, they were surprisingly generous this time around. On a positive note, my family really do enjoy their specialty drinks.

Great service by the 2 guys that served us. Genuinely interested and tried to make sure we had a good experience. Tried their new viral Dubai smash burgers. Both spicy and regular was very tasty. Good value for $10. Enjoyed their Acai bowl as well. Happy to see the Acai bowl is not over priced. Would go back

The shop was having some promotion where you order via text and pre-pay via bank transfer. They had many options for only $5. What a deal! I ordered the kadhi pakora, channa, veg korma, dal makhani, tardka dal. I work night shift and sleep during the day. I told then to pack and get ready, and I will be there at whatever time. They said no, this cannot be done, I must give specific time, so they can prepare. I said OK 3pm. I had to set my alarm, to wake me up from sleeping, to be there at 3. I get there at 3:15pm and nothing is ready. The guy is packing Uber, and walk ins, and still previous pre-paid orders. Maybe 6 people are waiting and he tells me it will be 20 minutes! I had to wake up to be here at this specific time, and now I must wait?! I was very upset about that. Finally I got the food. I noticed what I ordered is not on their menu list. Hopefully I can order again if I like it. There are food in the hot cabinet which included chicken and lamb, one veg and one paneer. The goat curry looked very tasty, so I ordered that as well. The rice was very overcooked, clumpy, and no taste (need salt). For $5 I am happy, but would be upset to pay full price for this rice. The actual subzi was so good! Really tasty. The channa is a bit dry, but I mixed it with a bit of hot water and it was fine. The goat curry with the naan was amazing! It's a bit of a hit and miss. I hated to wait, especially since I had a specific arrangement, but most of the food was brilliant, which made up for the long wait and inconvenience. The rice is really bad, but the price and good taste of the curries made up for that. There is an option to buy without rice, so I will do that in future. Overall the food was more good than bad, but the experience was more bad than good.
Located inside gas station. Honey fries is the high light and must try item!! Look forward to trying the cheesecakes and other types of chicken next time. Flavours look so good!

I came to Pocha Chicken in Henderson this afternoon and had such a great experience. The service was excellent, and the lady working at the counter was incredibly friendly, welcoming, and made the whole visit feel so pleasant. You can tell she really cares about the customers. I ordered the large combo, garlic butter boneless chicken, and the cheese dog. Everything was absolutely amazing. The chicken was perfectly cooked, super flavorful, and the garlic butter sauce was delicious. The cheese dog was also a standout, crispy and cheesy in the best way. You can really taste the quality in every bite. I’ll definitely be coming back again. Highly recommend if you're looking for delicious food and genuinely great service!
Best chocolate and snickers frappes around - allways really good - the staff are great AAA++++ EXCELLENT

Came in for lunch on 3/09/2025, our table ordered the Chicken parma with mash and veg, Garlic prawns with chips and salad and a garlic bread to share. Breathed my parma in it was beautiful, very tasty! Veg and mash were well seasoned. My Mum ordered the garlic prawns, beautiful plating .. just a little mishap with the sauce it was dark, burnt and bitter .. she ate it bc she didn’t want to wait anymore, there was another big table ofc. Kind woman in FOH did ask how the food was, mum was too kind to say anything (or for me to say something bc I would have) and didn’t want to hassle. It’s not always that I leave with something to say about La Porchetta, my family love this place 🫶🏽 Just a little more love with the sauce 🤌🏽 Excellent service from FOH.

We ordered the Polo E Funghi which is a creamy chicken and mushroom fettuccine pasta, A half in half hot & spicy and the lot pizza, and 2 desserts; the lava cake and the apple crumble. All there food was delicious and we will be coming again.

A wonderful restaurant with delicious food, great value for money, and very friendly staff. Well, I know this is a family-style restaurant, but can some people take care of their kids!😅They may be too young to know better, but shouldn’t the adults know?
I don't eat Sirloin, but I have to say that my steak was cooked to perfection (MR) As an ex- chef, I was impressed with the quality of the service and the restaurant

*Updated 4/8/25: Not good. Fish and chips were good however my partners Seafood Chowder was basically a soup and very salty, so even as a soup was inedible. Shame because The Hanger used to be awesome. *Updated 11/11/23: Turned up same time on a Saturday and was offered a "Late night menu" instead of the regular menu which was basically bar snacks for no reason. Very odd that they couldn't accommodate a full house assuming there was a private function of sorts. Good Sports Bar & Restaurant, where the food is always yummy and staff friendly.
The food was delicious 😋 I liked the service—laid-back and not overbearing. Great atmosphere too: clean, with awesome music 🎶
We ordered 2 kids cheeseburgers meals to take away. We did not receive the cheese burgers and were very disappointed to find only the chicken tenders and fries.

It's been a while since we've been to Wendy's even though we have always been satisfied with their food in the past. We were pleasantly surprised by the lovely assistant's service and our choices of burgers, sides and drinks which did not disappoint. Well done Wendy's. Your standards haven't slackened!! We look forward to our next visit!!

Who ever was serving drive through 6th of September 12ish pm - sounded like they didn’t want to serve at all and their tone was condescending and rude. Being in customer service myself, it’s sad when you see others in similar roles and just miserable.

Went with work colleagues. The food is very awful. Place is starting to smell of dampness and uncleanness especially crickroches. The food is nit nice and pricey. Pay for rice, the pad Thai and some curries were just made from box then diluted with lots of water with lots of sugar added onto it. I will not step my foot in this place again . Then l ordered cocktail which was also watered down. It is not authentic at all . Hence 2 stars from me. After 2 years, l have decided to visit this place again. Looks like they might have changed ownership. It was clean and the food was better than 2 years ago. I enjoyed my meal. 27 June 2024.

It's a perfectly comfortable family run restaurant. I wouldn't rave about the atmosphere but the food is Wonderful. Worth driving out here from the city just for their paneer. And the Dosa look incredible! Very delicious stuff.

Have been here several times and the food has always been amazing. Authentic Indian cuisine with a wide variety of options - and all vegetarian. Food is always fresh, and the prices are also pretty reasonable. The Indian sweets are on the pricier side though. I had the chole bhature, which was freshly made, the chole had a good spice level and the bhature was fluffy and hot! My favourite! The service itself is just alright and they now have mechanical carts delivering food, so it takes away some personal touches in my opinion.

I came into your location last week, Sunday, around 5. I had a horrible experience with one of your staff - a blonde girl, unsure of her name. I had an extremely bad experience with her, was very rude whilst taking my order and it seemed as though it was a chore for her to do her job. Would not recommend this location, will not be coming back

went in on tuesday around 5pm lovely girl efficient. delicious smoothie. no issues preordered a smoothie today Thursday 430pm as i had to be somewhere. i arrived 15 mins after id ordered it. she was only just starting to make it. i had to wait a further 10 mins. i saw my cup was first out of three drinks but she still gave the person after me their drink first. didn’t acknowledge anyone in the shop or let us know when anything would be ready. my full smoothie was not full. could clearly see that when she was emptying it into cup but didnt have time for an argument i was late as was due to 25 mins it took for her to make it. when i said i ordered it 25 mins ago i thought it would be ready for me she just said “nah, i only made it now.” 730pm and i have just had diorreaha. cant explicitly say it was from tank but i have not eaten anything else since i drank the tank.

I wasn't sure which protein smoothie to have that would satisfy my breakfast graving and keep me feeling full until lunch, the helpful and friendly Sruthi recommended the Nutra Blast because it had blueberries, banana, oats, lite milk, ground almonds, whey protein and yoghurt. Once I had a sip, it ticked all the boxes. Thank you, Sruthi you know your smoothies. Keep up the amazing work 👏🫶
Came in at 5pm to order - about 3 people in front of us. Waited 45 mins to get our drinks. So slow and ridiculous at the long wait!!

The saddest , sorriest, most disappointing sushi I've EVER had , much better off going to a small sushi business as st Pierre's is just bulk bland muck and that's the honest truth

Great selection of cabinet and menu items. Pretty decent coffee. Wife ordered the salmon quiche but got a tuna one. She was already 1/2 way through when she realized so just ate as much as she could. Otherwise overall not a bad spot for a quick bite and chat with friends and family.

Kreem is almost always my go to cafe. Meetings, sweet treats, quality kai. Staff are always lovely. It gets very busy and tables inside almost always get snatched up. Overall, top tier. Pictured here is the Kreem Big Brrakfast - eggs, toast, bacon, hash bites, creamy mushroom, fried cherry tomatoes, and TOMATOE relish

This was our regular place but not any more. We buy 3 footlongs weekly.It’s the 3rd order they have stuffed up in a row by putting wrong ingredients on the footlongs. They also miss out ingredients on others. Then they write the wrong details and numbers on each one. Not nicely made either with very lean on all ingredients. We will now be going elsewhere in future.

Very poor customer dealing. I ordered a vegetarian patty and the Chinese guy no have any name on his shirt, he start preparing my order but suddenly he started doing his online non vegetarian order at the same time touching the beef and fish bowls and when i requested him that i am vegetarian and don’t mix up things then he start shouting on me and start abusing me for no reason. That type of store operator or store person will shut down the subway soon. I Got argument then i leave the store.

Had CJ last night, got Mr Jimmy in the drive through and he is a legend. Cracked my kids up, excellent customer service and a pleasure to deal with. Kid's asked me to put a review as they liked him. Very professional

I haven't been to a Carl's Jr. For at least 10 years, maybe more. Not because I have any issues with them, mostly because I don't go to fast food places often and there isn't one close to where I live. I was pleasantly surprised. I liked the beef and cheese burger but found the chicken burger very bland. Maybe that is because they aren't using a sugar sauce like the other places and so that is good, in my opinion.

Not too happy about my visit for dinner couple of days ago.. ordered a 3 piece for takeaway. 2 pieces were fresh and hot but 1 piece was dry and cold. I think they are in the habit of doing that just I get rid of the pieces that were sitting around for sometime. People notice. Don’t think we don’t
It's very bad. In the door it's say closed at 10 pm but we were there at 9.30pm. Customer service was very bad. Bad communication.

Great customer service. Second time coming here after finding out they had the best fried noodles and 2nd time they didn’t disappoint! Soo yum! And I love the plate of bbq pork you can get for $10 as a snack too. So delish!

Bought a pricey roast duck takeaway today, but the skin was completely burnt. The person who cut it clearly saw how burnt it was, yet still chose to cut, box, and hand it over. We didn’t check at pickup, but when we got home and started eating, it tasted burnt and bitter. This was our first time trying your takeaway — and it will be our last.

Cute cafe nestled amongst the busyness of Lincoln Road shenanigans. Service was lovely, orders were taken swiftly & we didn’t have to wait too long for our orders. I ordered a mocha but extra hot, temp was warm . The Big Deal was average, creamy mushrooms were delicious, would prefer that instead of baked beans. Nice cafe to dine at if you like simple, close to made at home meals.

Father’s Day 2025 celebration was had here, the place was bustling with diners enjoying themselves with food and drinks served by wonderful wait staff, prices are reasonable and quantity is satisfying as is the presentation and taste. We had a small wait which was acceptable, due to the number of happy clients! I would wholeheartedly recommend Cafe Lincoln for a nice friendly experience! Arthur C. Charlton west Auckland NZ

Feedback from us two food was very delicious, Creamy mushrooms on the side added to eggs bendict had all the toppings. Iced hot chocolate lots of cream and chocolate went down the hatch well. Best eggs benedict that have ever came across perfectly cooked and layout on plate is top notch superb customer service/chef! Bun Dau Gf Vegan very delicious flavours and toppings blended in well with the noodles & tofu honestly best dish I have had then any other cafés! Spicy chai tea very delicious tasted all the cinemon/spice perfectly made 😋 Keep up the superb service 👏 👑 👸 🤴 We rate 10/10 👌
Best Sal's pizza branch in Auckland. The overall experience is superb. The food and service are consistently awesome. Thank you everyone.

The lady this morning was so rude with a attitude. If you dont like your job then your in the wrong occupation or if your having a bad day, dont rub it off on your customers. Definitely wont be returning to this store.
Very rude service this morning. Felt unwelcomed. Definitely won't be coming back.

The food is very consistent and tasty but unfortunately the service let us down with our pick up order. We watched it get packed, watched our number get displayed to say our order was ready, then waited another 10 minutes with our food just a couple of meters away, while busy staff rushed around packing orders, taking orders out to the carpark, but no staff member available to acknowledge us standing at the counter to pass us our meal.

Always a great experience at KFC Lincoln Road! The food is fresh, hot, and tasty every time I visit. The staff are friendly, quick, and get the orders right, even during busy times. The place is clean and well-kept, and the service feels welcoming. Definitely my go-to spot for a good meal on the go. Keep up the awesome work!

Not too stoked. Ordered what we usually ordered awhile back (lust delux). Thought it’s been awhile so decided to get hells. Pizza was stale. Looked dehydrated, sauce could be peeled off like a face mask. Was awful. Not sure what happened to the pastry of the pizza either, wasn’t full like usual, just a little thicker than a thin crust? Cold, almost no toppings. Not impressed. Waist of time, waist of money.
Truly delicious coffee! Also really friendly staff and a nice buzzing atmosphere. It was clear many of the customers were regulars which so testament to the quality and service.

I went there with a couple of people and we all ordered a range of different things. Every single dish was delicious with the perfect amount of herbs and spices. I ordered the Hot Basil Prawns which was spectacular, definitely get nothing higher than medium spice because it does give quite a kick. Would recommend trying this place when you feel like a hot meal.
Kanaka was a wonderful help whilst serving me. Best worker out.

We often come here because its affordable and has food everyone in our family likes. Sometimes it feels you are too squished together next to other families tables, but thats the only negative I can say about this place.

I have never been disappointed ordering a meal tray from here. Everything is delicious but my family favourite is the sweet & sour pork - the best in Auckland. Great service from staff. Comes highly recommend
Great prices! Great food! Great service! Thanks Shen Team!
My #1- Wonton soup $13.00 - humungous serving bowl is worth it and delicious. The owners and staff are great people. The food is value for $$$ guaranteed. Huge servings. Ps, ignore the chilli - me

Went on a Saturday to taste the Gold award mince and cheese pie - was not a fan. It was salty and overpowered everything. HOWEVER, the chicken and Mushroom pie was AMAZING 🤤 It taste like fettuccine in a pie and I loved it which made up for the rating. Wouldn't drive there again but if in area would definitely stop for the chicken pie only. Was busy in shop when we got there but was still able to get served fast.

I ate for the 2nd time and was again very impressed. They will load your kabeb with meat, salads n sauces, and justify the price they ask. Very good and kind staff. Love the food and owners. Highly recommended Chicken Kebab
Ordered by Uber , always get amazing taste, highly recommend. So many times I have ordered from here, always like and enjoy the experience.
This store is awesome!! The staff are very friendly. The service is prompt. The food is excellent. Can't recommend enough. This is always my go to store for a great pizza.

The best Vietnamese restaurant in Auckland! The food is absolutely delicious — full of flavor, authentic, generous in portion sizes, and very reasonably priced. We dined here today for my husband’s birthday, and from the moment we walked in, we were greeted with cheerful smiles and a warm welcome from the staff. The service was impressively fast and efficient. We ordered a variety of appetizers including wontons, spring rolls (both deep-fried and fresh), stir-fried noodles, and fried chicken. For the mains, we had their famous pho — we tried both the beef wonton and seafood versions, and they were outstanding! We also loved the iced coffee — so refreshing and perfectly balanced. What really sets Pho Bien apart is not just the incredibly delicious food, but also the exceptional service. The staff are genuinely attentive and always smiling, making you feel right at home. The owner even gave my niece complimentary cookies, which was such a sweet gesture! There was also no corkage fee for the cake we brought, and they kindly offered to keep it refrigerated. They even played a birthday song so we could all sing and celebrate together — we truly appreciated that thoughtful touch. If I could give more than 5 stars, I absolutely would. We will definitely be coming back and recommending Pho Bien to all our friends and family. Thank you for making my husband’s birthday meal so special! :)

Absolutely loved the food at this Vietnamese restaurant! The food was fresh, authentic, and full of flavour. The soup was rich and aromatic, and the wontons, chicken, omelette and vegetables were perfectly fresh and crisp. The service was friendly and attentive, and the atmosphere was warm and welcoming. A great place to enjoy a delicious meal with family or friends. Highly recommend and will definitely be coming back!

Location: In a retail park with plenty of free parking. Spacious seating with counter service. Visit: Noted the previous mixed reviews (especially around delivery and staleness of items) but I popped in for a masala chai which was excellent & fresh. Took a little while to be served initially despite the place being quiet. The menu looks extensive, would expect their Punjabi dishes to be their specialty and would definitely come back for chai (& consider coming back to try some of the food).

I had a fantastic experience at Chicking! The food was fresh, flavorful, and served hot. Their fried chicken was crispy on the outside yet juicy inside, and the variety on the menu meant there was something for everyone. The staff were friendly, attentive, and made sure everything was perfect. The restaurant was clean, well-organized, and had a welcoming atmosphere that made dining in very enjoyable. Overall, Chicking delivers great taste, quality service, and excellent value for money. Highly recommended for anyone craving delicious fried chicken and a satisfying meal! 🍗✨

The food is sooo delicious, big serving too. We had the spicy beef noodles and the chicken sweet and sour. The taste is on the spot. We went there while waiting to our laundry, and we crave Chinese food and we did not disappoint. 100% recommendable. Definitely our go to Chinese food from now on.

Disappointing Experience – Not Fresh, Handmade as Advertised I was really excited to try this place after seeing they advertised "handmade" bun. Unfortunately, my experience was far from expectations. What I received were clearly pre-made, frozen buns that had been microwaved—resulting in a tough, rubbery texture. By the time I got home, they were so hard they were nearly inedible. For the price paid, I expected freshly steamed, authentic handmade bun as promised. It’s misleading to market food as handmade when it’s just reheated from frozen. I hope the shop improves transparency or, better yet, starts offering truly fresh baozi. Until then, I can’t recommend it.
Highly recommended! Thank you team for your gracious hospitality, efficient service and delicious food! I cannot stop thinking about Mama's Fish Tacos! Definitely a must have!

We ate here for lunch and I cannot believe we didn’t know about this place despite living out west for years!! This place is a true GEM, the noodles are authentic and bouncy texture delicious broth and large portions, lamb skewer soo yummy and fried rice was great too! The service was great, staff were friendly and we were seated right away the place is also very clean and overall such a great spot and I’m glad we are locals! Price wise super affordable! This will definitely be our new “go to” noodle place!
Kuet Teaw(number 8) is one of the best I have ever had. I have had it in Malaysia as well. And honestly I prefer it here. Amazing service and friendly people.

Tried their $25 Large pizza deal with 2 sides. Ordered chicken tandoori pizza with Onion rings as side. Pizza is very good in size, fully loaded. Good quality and quantity pizza. Good customer service. Gonna try other pizza ranges for sure.

Honestly one of the best pizzas I’ve had in Auckland. Everything from the base to the toppings tastes fresh and made with care. The crew is friendly too. If you’re in Henderson and craving pizza, this is the place.

Bad customer service. Food unlike advertised. Go to their Mt Eden branch, great service and food there! Ordered the same dish "Rice noodle with fish fillet and pickled cabbage" for $16.50 and both came out at different times. We were the only customers. The portion is nothing like the picture, i asked the staff where all the fish was and in the end they said they could do nothing about it and walked away. Also the cabbage wasn't pickled. This is worse because you have to pay before ordering. Only after did i see another person wrote a similar review to this. They decided to clean the store while we were here so i attached a photo of a mop leaned next to my seat and the staff brushing and mopping the whole dining area right next to our table. Go Mt Eden store, or elsewhere...

Ordered takeaway from Shahi Dawat last night and it was spot on! Everything was fresh, hot and packed with flavour. The naan bread was soft and buttery, and the lamb rogan josh just melted in my mouth. Highly recommend this place if you want authentic Indian food.

The food is delicious. We've been going to Shahi Dawat for a long time and have always loved the food. Normally, we get takeout, but tonight, we decided to dine in. The dine-in menu is priced $2 or $3 more per item. We ordered two meals and two drinks, and the bill was $77 (that's $39 per person for one curry and one drink)! When our food came to our table, they only brought our one rice. When we asked for a second rice, they charged us extra for it! My partner politely inquired about the extra cost for the extra rice, and the woman at the counter raised her voice and started arguing. I will never dine in at Shahi Dawat ever again.

Just ordered a combo and the fries were stale and disgustingly hard… if you’re in a rush please do the job properly, I don’t come often but when I do they’re food is usually pretty on but tonight wasn’t it. Otherwise everything else was okay but the chips were fricken shocking, tasted like they’d been over cooked early this morning and then pulled out.
Nice and tidy shop. Always delish food!
Best and I mean best crinkle cut fries in the Auckland area. And you cannot beat the price for a full, hot cup of chips. Always stop in for chips when I'm in the area.

Woah! First time trying this bakery and I am hooked! I don’t always eat bakery but when I do, I want a nice and crisp pastry pie and that’s exactly what I got today! Also bought donuts and this fish roll. And the fries! FYAAAA
Good spot in Te Atatu. Home made cabinet food looks temperature but I didn’t mange to try as I dropped by for coffee only. Will definitely come back and try the food.
So yummy! Big portions, good flavour and quality. Definitely recommend

Great fish & chips. Amongst the 5 of us we had Snapper and Tarakihi and both were good, decent sized fillets with batter that wasn’t too thick. Chips were the star and were some of the best f&c shop chips I’ve had. Price was pretty good too. Probably got too many scoops of chips as they were quite large.

Had classic kiwi burger and chips. Both were absolutely delicious. Best burger I’ve bought for a very long time, so tasty. The chips for money was too small even though they tasted the best chips ever the quantity was way small.
Been here before and love the burgers and onion rings
Food and customer service was excellent. I did takeaway so can't really judge on atmosphere. Definitely recommending them

Food was delicious; we ordered the squid, chips, cheesy garlic bread and onion rings for appetisers and they did not disappoint. The fish tacos were amazing. The staff were very friendly as well; great service and we will definitely be back.

Had an amazing dinner at Et Tu Bistro. From the moment we walked in, the staff made us feel so welcome – warm, attentive, and genuinely friendly. I had the beef cheek, which was melt-in-your-mouth perfection, and my partner went for the pork belly – crispy on the outside, tender on the inside, and packed with flavour. Both dishes were outstanding, beautifully cooked, and plated with care. A great spot with fantastic food and lovely people – highly recommend. We’ll definitely be back!

Absolutely delicious! Three of us had different main dishes - pepper beef, chicken parmigiana and the market fish. All were beautifully presented and tasted divine. The calamari entree was fresh and delicate too. We didn’t need it but made room for the rhubarb and apple crumble and sticky date pudding to finish - no regrets. Great friendly service and nice local vibe. Thoroughly recommend.
The "Supreme Hotdog" the reckon. It was basically a sauced long bun with the sausage on the side inside the paper bag. I didnt think i would have to check it, i left and drove home.
Milkshakes and thickshakes always seem to be icy, flavour what you expect but please sort out the texture. Got a potato fritter and the potato wasn't cooked through.

Today was a joke. Spent $12 for a burnt flat toastie and a tasteless banana fritter. Small proportions, the cheapest supermarket bread. Not impressed. Won't going back. These people offering free food which tastes like it hasn't come from a take away store, it amuses me they are still up and running!! Change ownership immediately! How you got such a high rating is shocking and disturbing to say the least.

After years away, we've ventured back. With an A grade, food is exactly as you'd expect - fresh, clean & 😋 delicious. The hot chips are a hit in our household, made just how we like them - clean oil, small crusty bits in amongst the range of softer & crunchier chips 🍟. Good job 👏 Golden Key.

Chicken Chow Mein - Chicken pieces were thick and dry and barely had any noodles which I find is the best part. This dish was Literally all vegetables, nothing else. Hot Chips - old oil, lacked crisp even though chips arrived hot.

We really enjoyed coming here on Sunday. Omelette beautiful with my choice of 3 filings, hearty flavorful mince + muesli with fruit. Friendly staff. Bonus was the coffee was perfect! Exactly how I like it - and I am fussy! Thank you
Coffee was delicious and the food was presented so beautifully and it was incredible. Best eggs Bene I’ve ever had! Service was great, super friendly staff. Will definitely be back again soon :)

Absolutely the worst Roast Chicken meal I have ever had, and I buy them all over nz when travelling, potatoes kumara pumpkin were almost raw and cut to tiny tiny pieces, total toilet shop and owner should close it immediately and ask GORDON RAMSEY For HELP HELP HELP!! CLOSE THE SHOP BOY NOW.

I’m lost for words honestly… my 16 year old daughter went through the drive thru and was met with the Indian manager who was working at the time. She ordered as usual and came home feeling upset, after asking what’s wrong she told me that the manager said “I added a little something special just for you” and winked at her while biting his lip and tried to caress her hand as she tried to grab the food.

Came here a month ago, order the hot and spicy chicken and it was raw. Exceptionally pink inside, rang them up and the bloke who I spoke to was nice, offered a free meal. However, the free meal consisted of more raw chicken that was burning hot, clearly had a raw batch and tried to reheat it so it seemed it wasn’t raw. Absolutely appalling.
Love these guys! Especially the Curry Puffs to start. Always have to get the Pineapple Fried Rice with Pork……. Even better on the second bowl.
Honestly, the best Thai I have had in a while. Found this place by chance and am so impressed not just by the delicious meal I just had but also the lovely service. Thank you!

Honestly this is top tier pizza in Auckland super fresh with great ingredients, we got the Pulcinella and the Francesca’s choice both were great but I did like Pulcinella the best. We also got the Tiramisu and the Chocolate Lava cake, don’t skip the lava cake this was super good. Check this place out! I also took a photo of the menu cause it was hard to find a good copy.

Great service and delicious pizzas! The team at Domino’s Point Chevalier is always friendly and efficient. Orders are ready on time, the pizzas are fresh, hot, and loaded with toppings. Definitely my go-to Domino’s – highly recommended
These are the fries I got from the large combo. I don't know how the employees in this store are trained before they are hired. LOL😂

I’d like to share my experience after several visits, not as a complaint but in the hope that it helps improve service. From my experience, the drive-through burgers are often served cold, even when there isn’t a long line or crowd. Because of this, I usually avoid the drive-through and order inside, where the food quality is mostly good. However, during my recent takeaway order, one of the items was incorrect. I ordered a Bacon Crispy Chicken, but instead received a regular Crispy Chicken. Again, the store wasn’t busy at the time, so I was surprised by the mix-up. I really appreciate McDonald’s overall, and I hope these points can help improve consistency in both food temperature and order accuracy.

Had a misunderstanding there earlier today at the drive thru. Probably seemed like I was being a bit mean to the Asian girl at the pay window but I wasn't, I was just a bit frustrated about my reward points not being used on my order.. I know she was trying, and doing her best with me, but after quite a few minutes of going back and forth, she eventually had to ask her Co worker for help in the situation and she helped clarify how to 'redeem' the points on the app. So actually the Asian girl didn't do anything wrong (apart from misquoting the price from 18 to 19 dollars) and I'm sure she was just trying to solve a problem the best way she could at the time, but the mixup started from the drive thru speaker when I mentioned the accumulated points to the first person there, then thought I'd have to sort it at the pay window, (but didn't actually end up happening).. Sorry to the Asian girl at the pay window for the confusion and thanks to the girl who eventually stepped in to take over a difficult situation. Well done.. I know you guys are working hard, and doing a good job! 👍 I thought I'd write a review here, instead of trying to ring and apologize over the phone lolz.

“I had the chicken burger and it was absolutely delicious! The burger was fresh, juicy, and halal, with amazing flavor. The place is clean and the service is great. Highly recommended, and I will definitely come back again!”
I ordered kiwi bagel it was amazing . Nice foodtruck 🥰

Review of The Greek House Mediterranean Cuisine The Greek House was our third stop of the day, chosen especially for a sweet treat to finish things off — and we had our hearts set on their Kunafa. We arrived at 5:10pm and ordered two small Kunafas, expecting a short wait. Unfortunately, we ended up waiting over an hour, and just as we were about to leave at 6:16pm, our order finally arrived. Thankfully, the Kunafa was absolutely worth the wait — warm, cheesy, perfectly sweet, and beautifully presented. It really hit the spot. We also enjoyed their Freez drinks, which were cold, refreshing, and paired nicely with the dessert. While the food was fantastic, the long wait definitely took away from the experience. To their credit, the staff did apologise and offered us a little treat for the delay, which we appreciated. The space itself is also beautiful and inviting. Overall, the food and presentation were great, but the slow service on this visit left a less-than-ideal first impression. I’m open to giving it another try — hopefully next time, the service will match the quality of the food.

Food was yummy, refreshing mocktail and good portions. Shisha was okay as well. The only downside is the toilet area is like few minutes walk outside/around the building and you need to take a key for it. Service can be a bit slow depending on how busy the place is but they were nice.
Popped in for brunch, had eggs on toast, with Haloumi, lovely ingredients, well cooked, great coffee. Vibe-y local cafe☕️👍

The girls working here are always so warm and super kind! Give these girls a raise! (Nothing against the guys! I just haven't had a chat with them, also I'm a woman so I get that other women are more likely to talk to me.) When you walk in a cafe and the baristas/FOH quickly compliment you or talk with you I get the feeling that they're happy/feel comfortable in the work environment (can't guarantee, its just a good impression.) If I lived closer I'd be so pumped to have this as my local!

Loved the ambience, food, cocktails and service. A charming little spot that does it right. Our top two dishes were the duck tacos and the eggplant. We were too full to order desserts so I’ll have to come back to give the sweets a whirl.

mainly about tacos and were impressed by the creativity and bold flavors – the raw fish and duck options were especially unique and memorable. That said, a few dishes were overwhelmingly salty, particularly the beef nuggets and lamb, so we’d recommend choosing those with care. T bone steak source was tasting, however the meat has a bit overcooked could taste bitter. The service was friendly and attentive, and the cozy atmosphere makes it a nice spot for a casual catch-up with a couple of friends. The restaurant is on the smaller side, but there’s plenty of street parking nearby, which is a plus.

Heard really great things about this restaurant so had to try it out for myself. We ordered the octopus tostada, duck tacos and smoked lamb. Such amazing flavours the duck tacos are a must try and also got the sticky date to top it all off.

This is my 3rd time at Ragtag and I don’t know how each visit is better than the last. Truly one of the best restaurants in Auckland - they know how to make dishes that have the most beautiful flavour combinations but keeps it simple at the same time. The octopus tostada has to be one of the best things i’ve eaten this year. Of course the duck tacos are a must too! Also drinks are so yum I ended up having another kaffir lime margarita Even their sticky toffee pudding was perfect - with a generous amount of caramel without being overly sweet Amazing stuff!!

I highly recommend the octopus tostada, duck carnitas tacos, and sriracha carrots — they were so delicious, I was genuinely impressed! My friend recommended the T-bone steak, but honestly, I found it a bit underwhelming. I requested medium rare, but it came out more like blue rare, which was a bit disappointing. Still, I would definitely come back again — their tacos are absolutely top-notch!

The food is Always amazing and so consistent in how they make it- it’s always hot and fresh and you’re never disappointed when you order what you want like at other places. So many people drive so far just to eat here, including from Tauranga lol Not only is everything on the menu yum, Michael is the man and always so pleasant and such a good guy! We always come here cause of the service and food 🙌🏽
The food was so delicious. The service was outstanding and I especially loved the egg fried rice. It took me back to my childhood.
Nice pub with really friendly patrons. Great mix of people and a homely pub atmosphere. Bar staff are lovely!
Found another nice burger and fried chicken place in Auckland! The texture of their Ugly Donuts really surprised me, soft and bouncy at the same time😋
Friendly staff, very reasonable prices and the meals are good

We only went to the restaurant, so not entirely sure what rooms are like. The restaurant - Delicious meals. We had the steak, the burger and the lamb shanks which were all perfectly cooked. Service was attentive and friendly. We were the last table so not busy. Great place to go as a group or to relax and enjoy a sports match on the large tv in the lounge area. A nice discovery.

Contacted in advance to ensure we would have access to heated pool and on arrival we were told it isn't going to be heated for another 2 weeks. If I'd known that I'd have booked elsewhere. Other guests were very loud
Great place but isn't as cool as when Shaven was there. That guy ROCKED!
Awesome place to go, especially during the week for lunch $20 steak doesn't go a miss and it was a decent feed too quick service, ordered lunch, ate and left in 25mins, perfect for a lunch break

We’ve had an amazing catering experience with Ripe Deli. They were accommodating to our needs and preferences. The website showed a lot of food options and good photos for reference. It is on the pricier side, but you can’t beat good quality and presentation.

They offer burger and bites with ginger, which is different from other burger store. Not too delicious but fine. very polite and energetic staff and dirty tables and sofas like other fast food stores.
Very good experience - tried a beetroot and ginger juice and enjoyed that. My friend purchased the porridge which was a delight to see. (I felt a little hungry watching him eat it 😢)
Very rarely review, however this cafe deserves a mention. The menu is just the right size. Simple ingredients done to perfection. Incredibly tasty food. Highly recommend.

I've lived in Herne Bay now for sixteen years, and another couple of years whilst I complete postgraduate studies, becoming a world published Author, whilst settling too long overdue legal claims before immigrating to Europe and marrying first time in my early 50s. My worldrankìng University of Auckland Arts degree included papers: Chinese contemporary media Grade A Hong Kong Cinema B plus Going to this exceptional Empress Garden Restaurant is applying my University degree to everyday life. I've yet to travel to China on a small Wendy Wu tours. The main dish I recommend here is: Shredded duck with combination vegetables $28.50. It us simply the most delicious, freshly cooked main Chinese meal I've eaten. The Empress Garden Restaurant collective theme:"served Emperor", and I met Chinese Revolutionary Chairman Mao in most recent past lifetime visiting China from Russia. Chinese ancient wisdom, history, astrology and Feng Shui is not to be underestimated. A lot of small groups regularly dine here as the lunch and dinner Buffett is scrumptious food, freshly cooked, exceptional staff, atmosphere. Highly recommended.

Food was amazing but he service was shocking. Forgot my partners meal and we were with a group of 4, so she shared my meal due to time length of food getting to table. Tried to charge me more then what I stated, only saving grace was the food

Wonderful friendly bustling café. Wonderful welcoming staff. Our walking group adore it here, every Monday and we are greeted each time. They make THE best Macha late, divine. Beautiful fresh juices also. Can't comment on the food yet as nothing vegan in the cabinet, hopefully that will change soon, and I will one day try a meal from the menu... You guys are awesome!
Love the atmosphere. Even though we had to wait over 30 minutes for our meals, it was definitely worth the wait. Every steaks were cooked to perfection.

Super nice steak if you want to treat yourself. I found the service was a bit slow but the food was top notch. They show you the cuts before you order which is really handy as if you are not an officialdo then it is not clear what you are going to get. Order you mains, sauce and then side. You are talking about $100-$150 per person by the time you include drinks and sides. The meat was super tender and glad we came. We went on a Thursday and it was busy, with people sitting outside. Well worth a visit and the food quality of food is excellent.

Love the food and atmosphere. The wait staff were charismatic and friendly. We got margaritas, burrata, calamari, crudo, risotto, cotetta and mac and cheese. I need their Mac and cheese injected in my veins!! Will be coming back again :) x

Andiamo was an absolute delight! The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, perfect for a relaxed dat out. The food hits all the right notes — fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. Great service topped it all off. If you’re after a tasty meal without breaking the bank, grabbing a First Table here is a no-brainer!

Lovely restaurant. Family friendly with the best children's menu that I have come across including gluten free options available. The menu has sharing plates and individual meals. They are all delicious and varied. The fire on a cold night is a real bonus. Definitely a great place for a special night out.
Simply the best time had at Gigi, best service, delicious food, the cocktails are to live for and the atmosphere is just perfect! Thank you for bringing a place like this back to Ponsonby Road. 💕👌🎉

It’s been 25 years since my first visit to Nishiki, and I came back to New Zealand and visited again—it’s just as delicious as ever. The eggplant dish is slightly smaller than before, but the taste is exactly the same. It has also become a favorite restaurant for our daughter. You can even bring your dog, which makes it an absolutely amazing place. We’ll be coming often. Love you, Nishiki!
Reasonable price and good toppings. The pizza is fresh and done in a reasonable 15 minutes.

Pretty terrible service & very disorganised team. Picked up two orders for our household. They should have been ready by the time I arrived. Unfortunately only one order was ready and the other took TWENTY minutes! The first order meanwhile was cold. The staff member handed over the second order and did not even apologise even though I had let them know my order should have been ready 20 minutes ago. Unacceptable. Sort it out! Won't be ordering from this store again.
Great value for money with generous toppings. The pizza was fresh, tasty, and ready in just 15 minutes — definitely worth recommending!

Delicious food, great price and portions and they are always happy to add olives on request which I love. Service is always really friendly. Whenever I get lunch from here I always have people comment on how good it looks.

The service and food are exceptional. We ordered a selection of shared plates that included sour dough with some delicious spread, chilly prawn, eggplant, buttermilk chicken and lamb ribs with lemony tiramisu for dessert. Each dish was beautifully presented and tasty. We could not fault anything. The best part was we were going to sit outside as we had our little dog with us but were told that he could come inside. A water bowl and a treat was presented promptly. Our server was amazing and all the meals came out in a short space of time. Oh and the cocktails hit the spot. Loved this place and can't wait to go back if we're are ever in the area.

Cute little bar and restaurant for a casual early evening dinner. Good variety of delicious food options with sharing plates or individual meals. We had booked but quiet at 4pm. Parking difficult as 60 or 120 min time restrictions at that time of day

Used to be quite good but really disappointing now. The delivery driver didn't even try to attempt contact less delivery eben though I left instructions. Just called and said you have to meet even though I explained I'm isolating. Then left the bag with spilled foodon my stairs that by then already ripped due to the liquid spilled from the containers because they were not properly closed. Not only wasted food but also left me to clean up. Absolutely unprofessional. Order RO3OVD

Had one of the best cocktails of my life here… the Banana Cake, literally lit on fire at the bar. The service was outstanding, super friendly and the whole atmosphere was warm and welcoming. You can tell this place puts real care into every detail. I honestly couldn’t recommend it highly enough.

I forgot to leave this review in June but I just had to say that I love this place. I asked if I could reserve a table for a group of my friends for a suprise birthday dinner. Despite the day being on a Monday, when they'd usually be closed, the owner and staff were happy to open the bar to serve us. Everything went to smoothly and my friends had such a great time. Perfect space for dinner and drinks. Nice intimate space, lovely staff, and also has some fun board games 😊

How did I not know the best cocktail bar in Auckland was right under my nose. We wandered in last night, the atmosphere was cool as was the music. But that was before we met the talented bar keeps and their outrageously fabulous cocktail menu. I went with the banana cake cocktail, followed by the Plantain Curry cocktail. I had never had anything like either of them before. All four if us were blown away by how delicious and spectacular our drinks were. The service and complementary homemade spicy nuts, bought back memories of days when bars were cool and intimate, and the drinks were made with passion. Thankyou fabulous bar people, can't wait to come back. Such a great place, I had my birthday party there.
Cute little cocktail cafe with an amazing team! Had the best conversation here from my trip, while sipping on a delicious Garden of Eden cocktail. Highly recommend this place!

I had my birthday party at Cafe 39 last night and it was a great experience! Rene and his team were amazing—really friendly and made sure everything went smoothly the whole night. The cocktails were excellent. They also have amazing food options, the fried chicken was great. The vibe of the place was fun and relaxed, which made it perfect for celebrating. This bar is a great spot for hosting birthday parties or any kind of event. 10/10!

I think the photos speak for themselves. It was quite hard finding a place to eat at 9 o’clock on a Sunday; However, luckily Murder burger was open. The service from the get go was flawless, burgers delicious and vibes immaculate. Could not fault this place.

Generous portions, inviting flavours & high quality meat & veg. The tofu was well prepared but I wanted more in the container. The prices are quite high (paying $33.80 for a tofu and veg dish was a bit of a shock). I did enjoy the meal but a big issue is an inability to select a spice level on Uber Eats, so our dishes were quite bland - no heat whatsoever. I love bright, hot spice and this was very mild. We had mainly noodle dishes; they were a little too oily and saucy for my tastes but I feel like that’s how they are supposed to be. I loved the little touches - scrambled egg, perfect amount of peanuts in the Pad Thai, wide Pad See Ew noodles. For once there was that amazing wok hei flavour!

Dining at 3 Tigers Ponsonby was an unforgettable experience from start to finish! The food was absolutely amazing every dish we tried was bursting with flavor, beautifully presented, and made with such care. The menu offers a fantastic mix of modern and traditional flavors, and everything we ordered was fresh, delicious, and perfectly seasoned. The staff was exceptional friendly, attentive, and genuinely passionate about making our visit special. They went above and beyond to ensure we had a great time, offering great recommendations and checking in just the right amount. The atmosphere was vibrant yet cozy with a stylish interior that made the evening even more enjoyable. From the food to the service to the overall vibe, everything was amazing! If you’re in Auckland and looking for an outstanding dining experience, **3 Tigers Ponsonby is a must-visit**. We can’t wait to come back! **10/10!** -

Served by Pho she was so accommodating, very great service. Kept coming back to check on us as we enjoyed the meals. The food was so good, definitely be going back. We did first table so very good service. Super kind. Drinks to start with.

Absolutely loved our experience here. The food was delicious, but what really stood out was the exceptional service. The staff were warm, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. The manager in particular was incredibly friendly — checking in on every table with a big smile and making sure everyone felt right at home. It’s rare to find such hospitality these days. Highly recommend for both the food and the fantastic atmosphere!

Lovely mixture of foods on the menu and food beautifully presented. Lots of vegan/gluten free options and the coffee is superb! I had the wild rice bowl, was delicious and the Kim chi really lifted the meal and tofu was full of flavour, the salad did need some kind of sauce or agent to make it less dry otherwise meal was great. I requested avocado with it and it went so well with the dish. The salmon bagel was perfect, was hearty with the proper salmon fillet and swapped out the cream cheese for avo. French toast, was a ten, presentation spot on and lovely bits of fruit to add some lightness to the meal. The full breakfast was impressive and the pork and fennel sausages were the star on that plate. I recommend to try their freshly pressed juices,specially the green juice, great way to start the day. This place is great for litte ones as their is a Hidden courtyard at the back where they can be less restricted and enjoy the outdoors. This place had some lovely Vietnamese options on the menu and I can't wait to go back and try the pho!! Oh and duck fat potatoes must try, they are delicious!!!
So incredibly delicious every time! Love the Cheese Mi, Sashimi 3 Kinds and Scallops and Bacon ❤️ The sashimi is so fresh!!!

I visited McDonald’s Grey Lynn recently and had a decent experience. The staff were friendly and the service was fairly quick, even during a busy time. The restaurant was clean and well-maintained. Food quality was consistent with what you’d expect from McDonald’s — tasty and satisfying
Beautiful meal with fresh ingredients well price with lovely service atmosphere. Thank you

I ordered two pizzas and the cookie. The pizza was so incredibly dry, I had no moisture left in my mouth after the first slice. It was very clearly overcooked and also had no base sauce. The slices were as stiff as a board, despite being fresh and were extremely disappointing for their price. The cookie was even drier, the bottom was completely burned. It was even drier than the pizza and consumed the remaining moisture my mouth would have had, if the pizza had been any good. Overall, spent $37 and they didn’t even give us a receipt. I’m guessing so we couldn’t leave a bad review, but that won’t stop me. Don’t bother with this place, just go to dominos down the road.

What a disappointment !! I ordered the Garlic Shrimp Deluxe - what a joke - it would be the worst pizza I have ever had. The very few shrimps on the pizza were tasteless. The entire pizza was totally devoid of flavour. Squirting some very average pesto and not too great allegedly aioli over the pizza does not make a garlic shrimp pizza. Bland, bland, bland. Never again!

Ordered the OG bucket to takeaway, asked for no breast. The cashier and the guy who prepped the food clarified that they can't give me all thighs/drums, but acknowledged that I don't want breasts. Another lady came (maybe the store manager), she emphasised that they will give me a mix of chicken pieces. Came home and lo and behold. There are a couple of pieces of chicken breasts in the bucket. Idk why it's so hard to replace it with something else. Other KFC stores can accommodate. Not usually someone who gives bad reviews, but somehow this just irks me.

This little cafe is on a quiet street in Ponsonby and has a really cute vibe from the outside. The staff were super friendly. It was full inside when we arrived, so we sat outside, and they kindly turned the heater on for us which was really nice. The coffee was great, and we ordered the Turkish Eggs and the Tiramisu French Toast. The Turkish Eggs were amazing, full of flavour and looked beautiful too. I’d definitely get them again. The Tiramisu French Toast was very different from your usual French toast. My partner loved it more than I did, but it was still enjoyable. Overall, I’d happily go back. It’s a lovely spot if you’re after something a bit different and tasty.
Good atmosphere and great staff. However, I found the food prices are bit expensive. This sourdough avo is worth $26! 🫣

This is my favourite burger in Auckland - big fan of the classic cheese and I’m not even vegan. Fries are also cooked to perfection but often have a bit too much salt. Super lovely owners, at peak times they get busy so expect to wait a bit - so worth it ! Have heard the onion rings are good so I’ll try those next time.

Decent brunch spot in Herne Bay! Busy for good reason and we enjoyed the food; the staff were also lovely. Heads up about the iced strawberry matcha latte in case it helps anyone: it was nice, but very sweet from the strawberry syrup and overall tasted like cinnamon (which is admittedly a frequent letdown not exclusive to this place). If that sounds like your kind of thing, absolutely go for it, it was still good — just wasn't my personal preference!

Ordered a kids sushi platter for my sons 3rd birthday. It was a hit, the sushi was lovely and fresh and yummy with the option of choosing 6 different flavours. The staff were also super helpful and allowed me to collect at 9am (before normal opening) as our party started at 10. Highly recommend and as locals will be back again.
Had a few mates around the place and the gentleman behind the bar who I suspect was the owner was absolutely brilliant. Thanks for being a top host
Awesome service, beautiful desserts. Creme brulee is a must! So light and not too overly sweet as some other desserts might be. A cup of tea w dessert at Miann is ✨ The Smores are a fun treat ~

We come from a freezing cold day outside craving for a warm cup of coffee and some crepes and we asked to the waiter if we could bring our crepes from the next shop and he said yes, so we did it. The service it’s wonderful and the espresso and vanilla latte delicious. We definitely come back to try the hot chocolate and the ice cream!

We are falling in love 🥰 The best Crème brûlée ever 💯 🌟 We start eating with our eyes, and then you are sure how amazing it is. It's a wonderful and perfect pastries that you fell sorry to eat and destroying that art 🤭 I highly recommend and for sure we'll go back and not just for the pastries but cause of the nice and friendly service, even if we've been there 9pm (close to the closing time).

Massive regret paying $16 for this pie (even when I know Ponsonby Central is supposed to be expensive). It was in their pantry window which had no prices for their pantry foods. It was a beef & mushroom pie. Beef was extremely dry. Sauce too salty with some kind of curry (?) rather than gravy flavour. I also had difficulty understanding what the male waitor behind the counter was saying, which I think is unusual for a hospo customer-facing role. He was nice, but it made the whole experience a bit weird.

Yummy crepes. I ordered the Nutella with bananas. The location is more of a food court setting rather than individual restaurant. This time they added a huge teddy bear which was cute and great for photo op. I have been here about 3 times this year, love the place.

Thank you Ladies for always making such a great experience at Ponsonby Crepes! They are simply delicious, a must to have when in the area. And today you made it even more special with this birthday gift :) Merciiiiii!

Our friends took us to this amazing place. We went all out with the Nine Dragons Delta set menu. Every plate had its own unique flavour, beautifully balanced and well thought out. Every cocktail came out perfect. The ambiance was pumping and the service was attentive with a unique polish personality. On top of this, each table had smiling faces and great vibes. 100% recommend

The vibes were super chill and the food did not disappoint! prawn dumplings that were fresh and flavourful. The spring rolls and vegetarian options were great as well. The bao bun was a good size with a generous, tasty filling. Overall, a great spot for a relaxed meal with solid food across the board. Just the chicken dish from one of the dishes in mains wasn’t that great chicken wasn’t Cooked properly.

This is one of few places I wholeheartedly love and crave to go to. Attentive and professional service, very short wait time for food, exceptional meal quality and flavors - it is truly everything you can wish for. The dishes are prepared with a high level of skill that is hard to replicate at home. I love the interiors and vibe of the place itself - it has a fireplace, very tasteful lighting and colour accents,and it is not loud there despite it being a very busy place. Very friendly staff. Special metion to pork belly which is the best I have ever tried in Auckland and the overall food quality and vibrant flavors. It was so good that we finished half the belly and the entire duck salad before I remembered to take photos

Amazing kai - the chicken ramen bowl was super tasty, I could have just had a bowl of the broth it was so flavoursome! Really generous portion sizes, had to take the rest home in a takeaway container. Friendly and fast service, highly recommend this spot if you're in the area!

wow. This is my ‘go to’ for a Ramen, but I’m doing it a disservice as there are so many other excellent options. My fav is Pork Ramen, but today tried the Eggplant tempura. Who doesn’t love deep fried food!

First time and we went to 5 different places all but one were outstanding a particular mention goes to Tokyo Club which was so so good. A great place to go if you love good food and all in one spot. We will definitely be back!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ – Excellent Stay at Legacy Airedale Hotel I had a fantastic experience staying at the Legacy Airedale Hotel in Auckland. From the moment I arrived, the staff were warm, welcoming, and incredibly helpful, making check-in a breeze. The hotel has a stylish, modern feel while still being comfortable and inviting. My room was spotless, beautifully presented, and well-equipped, with a comfortable bed and thoughtful touches that made my stay extra special. The location is perfect, right in the heart of the city, making it easy to explore Auckland’s attractions, shops, and restaurants on foot. I also appreciated how quiet it was at night despite being so central. The service throughout my stay was outstanding, with every staff member going above and beyond to make sure I was happy. It’s clear that guest comfort is a priority here. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend the Legacy Airedale Hotel to anyone visiting Auckland, whether for business or leisure. I’ll definitely be staying again!

Really cool decor and rooms were immaculate. Dinner menu was varied and I really enjoyed the snapper dish. The creme brulee was superb! Thomas in the bar listened really well to how I liked my drink served and made some good wine suggestions. Breakfast was tasty and came out quickly. Location was perfect for my conference at the Aotea Centre. Would definitely stay again. Would be a great place to base yourself for a romantic Auckland weekend - easy walk to all the key sites but nice and quiet at night time.

We only had a one night stopover here in Auckland but it was fantastic after a long days travel. Quiet and very comfortable room, friendly and helpful staff. And a well stocked bar with a great wine list. Highly recommend if you're staying in Auckland.

I had a one-week stay at the hotel and absolutely loved it. It felt like home. It is very unique in character with personalized service. It is a small hotel, so it doesn't feel institutional at all like many modern hotels. The location cannot be beat, especially after the road works on the corner are completed. The restaurant has a lovely afternoon tea once a week and their morning breakfasts are varied with several options for vegetarians. I absolutely loved my room other than an overly soft mattress. It is very quiet as the rooms are soundproofed. I was in room 2.2, a standard one.

Very much enjoyed our stay and if you are looking for accomodation in Auckland, stay here! The rooms and very quirky and fun and the bed is very comfortable. The bathroom is fantastic and the deep bath is so good. We were given complimentary drinks on arrival and the included breakfast was fantastic. Easy checkin and staff were very helpful. Highly recommended.

Flavors and presentation amongst the best in Auckland. Very friendly service. Beautiful decor. One of the very few to have lasted through covid and cost of living crisis. Support local! These guys are worth it.

Astounding Thai restaurant, the decor is elegant, plush and traditional, the ambience is warm, inviting and cozy. There were six of us dining and service was friendly, courteous and efficient from all staff. The food is flavorsome and authentic. Plenty of menu choices. We all absolutely loved every dish we ordered. Sophicated fine dining, this restaurant leaves a lasting impression that goes beyond serving great food. Exceptional experience and great night out. I highly recommend.

If I can give an extra star for the service then I would have! 10/10 ,the owner was very friendly ,the lady waiting on us was extremely helpful & super nice , the restaurant itself is elegant, food was excellent, we will definitely come back.

Really enjoyed the beef loaded nachos. The portion was quite big and well balanced. Service was really fast since it wasn't really busy. The interior looked quite new and pleasant. Staff also was friendly and attentive.

We had a truly excellent dining experience. It's a French restaurant with a lovely, cozy ambiance, making it ideal for get-togethers. We tried their special fish and chicken of the day, and they are both incredibly flavorful. The apple cider was also delightful.

This is our second visit and I wish I had more to complain about but that isn’t happening the food was great for most of us so I have to go with the majority. My only concern was the stake was overcooked I wanted rare and got medium rare. Still tasted great. The service is faultless just need to reduce the times they ask you how the food is. They should listen and know it’s great. I do wish I could give a truly negative but I have to admit I can’t. If you visiting Auckland you must visit the food we have had is great and the service if not the best one of the best we have had when visiting. Please do not take the this the wrong way but if you have checked out my reviews it’s very hard for anywhere to be as good and I wish I didn’t have to travel to the other side of the world to find this. Please give a go and let me know

Cool French music playing. DELICIOUS! Quaint atmosphere with wonderful, friendly waitstaff. Jerome helped us translate and pronounce some of the things we might like on the menu. Amazing everything from start to finish. Can’t wait to go back for crème brûlée

The crepes here are amazing. The goats cheese and sundried tomato crepe is such an amazing combination. The dijon mustard sauce in the dijonnaise crepe is delightful. A nice creamy sauce with lovely warmth from the dijon mustard and not too overpowering. Goes perfect with sausage and potato. Service was really quick and incredibly friendly. Perfect for a short lunch visit
Authentic French food in Auckland. Perfect for weekend brunch spot. We enjoyed savoury galettes, croque monsieur and eggs benedict. Dinner menu looks great too.

This spot is right next to my home, but I never had the chance to sit down for a proper meal until recently. The front has a cozy dining area, and there’s also a lovely outdoor terrace at the back that’s perfect for good-weather days. In the evenings, it turns into a lively bar with great vibes. I honestly didn’t expect much from the food, but it completely exceeded my expectations! We ordered the market fish and the beef bavette—both were absolutely delicious, fresh, and generous in portion size. Definitely high quality and well worth it. The restaurant itself is beautiful and very Instagram-worthy. On top of that, the service was amazing—the staff member who looked after us was so kind and attentive. Highly recommend this place!
Food was amazing!! And we had a lot. Atmosphere was warm and inviting. Service was outstanding, we will definitely be back, if you haven’t been here yet it is a MUST try!!

Was recommended to visit Coco’s by a colleague of mine who’s an Auckland local. And it did not disappoint!! The service and atmosphere is great and the food really delicious! Can see why the locals love this place.

We hired out the courtyard area for a birthday dinner and had an amazing time. The service was phenomenal, the staff went above and beyond to make sure we were catered for and always checked up on us despite it being a very busy night. The food and drinks were also delicious and everything came out just at the right time. We were very impressed by the quality of service and would definitely recommend this place. The space was also very nice and they decorated and set up the tables beautifully.
