Loved the feature of being able to order for yourself through your phone, so our guests were able to order any time and we never had to leave our area. Will absolutely come back!

Comforting food and genuinely kind service We came here for dinner with my grandma, and it turned out to be one of our favorite meals in a while. I had the chicken risotto; the chicken was perfectly cooked, incredibly tender, and full of flavor. The dish was rich and comforting, just what I was hoping for. My grandma had the lentil soup, and she said it tasted exactly like how it’s made back home in Turkey, which is a huge compliment coming from her, since she’s very picky with food. In fact, she’s been craving that same soup ever since, and we’ll definitely be back for it. A little recommendation would be to add some red chilli flakes /chilli oil for a spice kick for the soup. The staff were so friendly and welcoming. They went out of their way to make sure grandma was comfortable, even bringing her hot water (she doesn’t drink tap water), which we really appreciated. The atmosphere was also lovely warm, and relaxed. Would absolutely recommend for both the food and the heartwarming service. 💛
It was a nice treat finding this ambient place in the city. We had mezze lamb burger and ceviche, which are both delicious! Paired with a cocktail and beer was the good choice.

This place had been on my list of places to go to for a while. Finally got around to it yesterday with my wife and we absolutely loved it! My lamb burger was the best lamb I’ve ever had. So soft and flavourful, and surprisingly filling. We really enjoyed the tortillas española and my wife loved her Greek salad. The chicken on it was fantastic. I would absolutely love to come back again and would order the burger again in heart beat!
Outstanding desserts and great service. On a Friday evening, it was crowded and noisy, but still got a seat and got the Berry Cream cake for dessert. Outstanding like all their desserts.

I'm sorry to say that the food quality was not worth the $80 we paid for. The Moroccan Lamb Tangine was extremely sour and gave me a tummy ache. I loved how moist the lamb was but the sauce was appalling and I gave it back to the waiter. I tried my friend's Risotto and it tasted like the flour was not cooked properly so it had a gritty floury bitter flavor. I wish that the food didn't taste so bad but unfortunately my honest review was it was not up to par.

We went for dinner and restaurant was closed. It was busy so not ideal eating in the bar with the table/chair format and the pool table. Not the biggest space but we were there and hungry so chose to order. Anyway getting to the food - it was awful. I feel like i ended up in a different place after reading the reviews but was definitely The Shakespeare. I ordered the lamb burger and kumara fries. The three other people I was with ordered the chicken parmigiana, and x2 potato wedges, paying extra for bacon and cheese. The lamb burger was extra dry, overcooked/burnt and tasteless. The kumara fries were burnt and inedible. I asked if I could get a replacement to be told that was how kumara fries are. Hmmm no they are not, I make them all the time and eat them when out. They ended up giving me a $5 cash refund for the fries as I'm assuming they didn't know how not to burn fries. Or understand how to cook good kumara fries. The chicken parmigiana was burnt and dry to the point you couldn't cut it with a knife. Salad was ok. Chips were good apparently. The wedges - overcooked (hard to believe I know, given they are potatoes!). The extra paid for the cheese and bacon was a waste of money as barely any of either. Lots of food left on the plates so hopefully that was a sign to the chef..... Really disappointing meal and would never return. Should have asked for a refund for all meals. Gross!

Pretty bad service on delivery. I placed an order for office party with pizzas and 4 portion of appetisers. They delivered only the Pizzas stating they ran out of appetisers the very last moment due to big order coming through. My order was placed two days in advance. No one informed us before hand or had the courtesy to call and apologise. They have assured a refund but the party did suffer.

We were probably too early and the restaurant wasn't letting people eat in, which was ok with us. Staff was really friendly. There was nothing wrong with the pizza itself, except I didn't really taste the olive oil. The greens (rockets, I think) were really bitter and overpowering. The best part was the crust, not too thin, well-balanced with the crunch and chew. Would like to try out the other flavours but I wouldn't go out of my way for it.
We stopped in and had a wonderful meal. I would highly recommend the dumplings and the salmon 🍣 sashimi - the soft shell crab roll was also amazing - would definitely come back

Loved this experience - very entertaining and extremely delicious food. This was our first time and would definitely come back. We took their restaurant month offer for $118 which included 3 entree (tuna carpaccio, miso soup & salad, yumyum prawns & vegetables, salmon & scallop, wagyu beef from japan, chopchop egg fried rice and matcha cheesecake) all was outstanding. Would highly recommend!

Walked in late off the street to enquire if dinner was still a possibility. No problem at all. We were mightily impressed with the food: prompt, hot, very tasty. The chicken schnitzel was perfection at 14" long.

The staff were welcoming and the service was great. I appreciated the detailed explanation of the day's special. The food was both tasty and satisfying, with good quality and generous portions. A great dining experience overall!
Awesome meals. So much food! Really great friendly service from Victoria and others. We keep coming back as it’s our current favourite place

This place offers both seafoods and meat meals. Our party opted for seafoods today. Everything they served was super fresh and delicious. The place is spacious with good ambiance. You also get the beautiful view of the bay while dining. Our server was fantastic and fast and the price was just right for us. Bathroom is super clean too.

Second visit for Happy Hour on the terrace of Oyster and Chop on this occasion we ordered some food of the Bar Menu for the terrace. Happy Hour is from 3-5pm where the house Oysters are $2 each min order of 6. Comes with red wine vinaigrette and lemon. Lovely best value Oysters I’ve ever had. The fish and chips were ok and the fried chicken’s coating was nicely seasoned. I just sensed some attitude from one of the male wait staff so they lost a star for that otherwise the rest of the staff are great. Friendly and warm. One bad apple….. our spend was high because of the drinks we ordered as we people watched the afternoon away on the quayside. Yet to dine in the main room Oyster and Chop restaurant. Looking forward to it.

Awesome steak selection and well cooked to our preferences. Jacket potato was great to share between 2 and the salads were nothing special compared to the steak! Would recommend asking for longer cooked onions as this was how they came out.

The ambiance and atmosphere at Fortuna buffet are truly amazing. They have a great variety of dishes and desserts. It is one of the best buffet restaurants in Auckland. We had a fantastic time over there for dinner and would love to visit again. Think it would be a romantic place for couples. Cheers!

Even though we were late, they still accommodated us which I appreciated so much. I didn’t specifically state on the reservation that was it was birthday the following day but they still went the extra mile to do a little something for me! Excellent customer service, good music, great selection of food and delicious margaritas! Must have come at the right time of year as the buffet was $8 cheaper than usual and parking was free when spending more than $40. The car park building was a bit of a labyrinth but nonetheless we made it there in the end. The lamb shanks were superb! Definitely the highlight for me. The worst thing I tried was the bolognaise but everything else was great. Maybe try meatballs instead of mince meat? Desserts were excellent and a good variety was available. Service was great. Waitresses will collect your plate if you look done so you can go and try something else at the buffet. There’s water and hot drinks available, $6.50 unlimited soda as well as toothpicks at your table! Follow up from staff was great and we will be back! Thank you.

Our (My wife and I) experience at The Fortuna was a welcome return It had been ages since my wife and I had been there and last time was not so good... we're glad we came back Staff were friendly and welcoming especially Denise our server. She was extremely polite and very friendly. The food was absolutely delicious and fresh, unlike last time, definitely a huge turnaround. We don't know what has changed , but definietly keep it up we. cannot wait for our next visit. We've told our family and can't wait to tell our friends.

Clean and authentic Korean food! Every dish comes with rice, soup, and side dishes like a proper hansang. We had the pork cutlet($26) and bossam set($29)—both tasty and good value (bossam a bit small, but fair for the price). Pork cutlet was thin but crispy and delicious. Lunch special rice bowl is only $17!
Delicious Korean food. Recommend if you want authentic K-food (more traditional with side dishes). Staff can speak English and Korean. They were helpful.

This Chinese restaurant has been here for a long time and one of the more popular ones. I was here some years ago, the food was good and now, still as good. The steam fish we had was the blue cod. It was like the 'ikan hantu' or 'soon hock' we called back in Malaysia. The blue cod meat here is softer than the soon hock. The long beans was just deliciously fried with minced meat. I love the braised tau foo with pak choy and seafood, it was nicely done. The four kinds meat platter was surprisingly good too. Not forgetting the seafood fried rice, it was yummy too.

Grand Harbour mistreats the seafood they serve, keeping lobsters and fish crammed into small, poorly maintained tanks with little regard for the animals themselves. The sight of it alone makes you question how fresh or ethical the food can be. On top of that, the prices are outrageously high for what’s offered—tiny portions that hardly justify the cost. It feels like customers are being charged premium rates for poorly treated animals and disappointing meals.

My first time at La Porchetta and it was the best experience. Food was delicious and service was excellent. I would highly recommend this place as it’s cozy and warm. Thank you team for your hard work. God bless you all 🙏🏻
always a excellent place to eat, pizza or pasta, well seasoning and great flavor, service is wonderful, pizza are excellent, price are good

Had a fantastic meal at Oh Calcutta. The food was full of flavour and clearly made with care — the Butter Chicken was especially standout, rich and perfectly spiced. The garlic naan was fresh, soft, and addictive. The atmosphere felt welcoming and relaxed, and the service was warm and attentive without being overbearing. You can tell this place takes pride in what they do. It’s rare to find a restaurant that gets both the food and the experience so right. Definitely planning to come back soon.

Great ambiance and great food ! Recommend coming here with friends to chill and yarn, order appetizers with friends and share instead of coming here for a meal. The only thing I was not a fan was the small tight tables, hence recommend coming here for snack food / lounge experience over an actual meal.
We had an amazing time dancing the night away to the live music. The bar staff were friendly and the crowd was really nice. Everyone was dancing with everyone. 10/10 - would go back.

Sri Pinang is a true gem for authentic Malaysian food in K’d road for over 34 years!! The dishes are full of flavour, generous in portion, and bring out the richness of traditional spices without being overwhelming. The roti is light and crispy, perfect with their rich curry sauce. Service is warm and friendly, making you feel like a regular even on your first visit. A must-visit spot in Auckland for anyone craving real Malaysian comfort food. Very affordable price. Will definitely come back again.

A friend recommended this place as she had been before, so i decided to check it out, and I’m glad we did! The ramen that i had was rich, creamy, and absolutely delicious. The food was super filling and a god portion size. The service was quick, the staff were friendly, plus the atmosphere was warm and welcoming. I’ll definitely be back!
Service was fast and friendly. Ramen was incredible! The chef greeted every customer with a lot of enthusiasm haha. Would recommend 10/10!

Vietnamese fusion restaurant. The window seats with a view of Galway Street create a nice atmosphere, with paper lanterns hanging from the ceiling. The service was friendly and professional. I would recommend the kingfish crudo and tiger prawn entrée. However, I found the main dish a bit disappointing. The pork belly reminded me of Hong shao rou from Chinese restaurants, but it didn’t have much depth of flavour and was quite sweet. The soft shell crab salad was also served in a sweet sauce, which might not be appealing to those who aren’t fans of soggy fried food. On a positive note, the use of lemongrass was a nice touch compared to other Vietnamese fusions that rely heavily on coriander.

We had dinner with my wife's family In cafe Hanoi a few weeks back and it was amazing. The food was delicious, the staff was really engaging and the dining setup was impressive. The food standout for the Taste, presentation and Verity of different dishes. I would love to come back again next time while we are staying in Auckland.

Hanoi Cafe in the city is an excellent choice for your next date night. It’s a little more upscale than many other Vietnamese restaurants in the area, which makes the experience feel a bit more special. I was impressed with how well the venue uses its space, featuring two main dining areas and a seated bar. We had an 8:30 pm booking on a Saturday night for two, and we were promptly seated. Our server was friendly and walked us through both the food and drink menus. While it was different from what I typically expect at a Vietnamese restaurant, I was genuinely excited to try a variety of the dishes. We each ordered a cocktail. I had the Landing Dragon, which was zesty yet light. The blend of fine filtered vodka, elderflower, green tea, and vegan foam made it refreshing and unique. The other cocktail we tried was also tangy and very fresh (I can’t remember the name!). For starters, we shared the Phở Gà and the crispy rice flour and coconut milk pancake with lettuce wraps, soft herbs, and nuoc cham (with roast duck, shiitake, basil, and red chili). Though listed as starters or sharing plates, the portions were very generous and could easily be meals on their own. The Phở Gà had a warm, soothing broth with a deep chicken flavour. The pancake was a highlight. The rice flour shell was crispy, the duck was tender, and the mixture of herbs and lettuce wraps made for a fun and fresh way to eat. The nuoc cham dipping sauce added a perfect sweet, tangy balance. For mains, we had the pork belly. I was expecting it to be crispy, but the soft, slow-cooked style was still very tasty. A bit more sauce would have been nice, but it was easy enough to scoop some from the bowl. Overall, we really enjoyed our experience at Hanoi Cafe. It’s a bit busier and pricier than other Vietnamese spots, but it’s a fun and flavourful option, especially if you’re looking to elevate your usual Vietnamese dining experience.

Another great restaurant. If you love Vietnamese food or would like to try Vietnamese food then this is the place to go. Food was delicious. We had the set menu and were seated upstairs in a private room as it was a company function. The service was great. Nothing was a hassle and the atmosphere was good too. We had a few people with dietary requirements and that was no problems for them. The cost is above average. Highly recommend. Pic is of the delicious dessert.

Come for take away, but let me tell you this place is luxury and crowded so prepare your clothes and make reservation! Prawn fillets with young rice battered is the star (I was surprised with the sauce - a bit thai sour and spicy flavour which brought a nice balance to the deep fried dish). Fresh paper rolls were okay. Good tight rolls with a hint of pine apple - very south Vietnam flavour. Good choice. Banh Hoi, on the other hand, was not as expected. Beef skews were bit too chewy, and not much bánh hỏi. Good side it had good fish sauce and good amount of veggies. 3 dishes for $76 - can't complain when you choose fine dining in auckland cbd, so prepare your wallet. Staffs are super nice. Crowded but they all move smoothly and fast.

​I had a great experience here and will definitely be back! The food was fantastic, with a great selection of quality food. The restaurant's theme is fun and consistent, and the comfortable seating and great atmosphere made for a very enjoyable evening. The only minor critique is that the service felt rushed amd pushy. I'll definitely be back

We've been here before a few years ago, and we were pleasantly surprised to see it still going strong. Our concierge at our hotel suggested it as a fantastic restaurant for steaks, he was right! The decor had a historical feel, and it gave a sense of intimacy with ample room between tables and booths. Our entrees of paté shrimp cocktail, calamari came out quickly and were a fantastic start. Our mains were steaks - cooked to perfection. One was a carpet bag steak, the other a sirloin. Desserts were chocolate mud cake and Hoki Pokie ice cream with caramel sauce. Finished our meal off with a Lord Nelson coffee liqueur, after sipping a long Island iced tea throughout the first two courses. A wonderful meal, very tentative staff, and only a 150-metre walk from Sky City. Our evening here was fantastic and we'll definitely come back again.

Sensational food/ every single dish (Best Tom Yum Soup ever!) Wonderful warm welcoming by the kitchen chefs and our host was so so friendly. The outside dining area out the back is lovely and so warm with ceiling heaters. We will definitely be back and often!

Had work lunch here and was very quiet, I think we were the only ones there. Great atmosphere, and service was okay. Ordered their sundubu and was pleasantly surprised. It came a in smaller bowl than other soups they offered, so there wasn’t much soup to each rice with. However, flavour was still 10/10.

We have been going here for years and it’s always consistently good. Particularly seems better in our recent visits. The staff and owner are lovely and the restaurant is unpretentious and old school. Most of the prawn dumplings are excellent and pork shumai is delish. Pork and or prawn rice roll is divine. It’s always packed so clearly they are doing something right! V reasonably priced. A favourite.

I had such a great experience at Domino’s! The pizza came out hot, fresh, and loaded with toppings. The crust was cooked perfectly—crispy on the outside but soft and chewy on the inside. The staff were friendly, fast, and made sure everything was right with my order. Delivery was quick, and the food arrived still piping hot, which is always a win. Domino’s never disappoints when I’m craving something tasty and convenient. Definitely my go-to spot for pizza nights!

I’ve been a Domino’s customer for years, but my recent experience at this particular outlet was hands down the worst I’ve ever had.. not just with Domino’s, but with any food service brand. What unfolded was a complete failure in customer service, basic hygiene accountability, and respect for customer concerns. Let me get into the details. I placed an order for two Value Range pizzas for pickup.. one Pepperoni and one Bacon & Aioli. Upon returning home and giving the pizzas a light microwave reheat (barely 10 seconds), I was hit with a foul smell coming from the Pepperoni pizza. Concerned, I asked a few friends to check as well, just to be sure it wasn’t a personal perception.. and unanimously, the pizza was off. The smell was unmistakably bad. I immediately called the outlet and was asked to bring the pizza back in for assessment.. which I did, expecting a basic level of understanding and professionalism. Unfortunately, I was met by the staff member named Vicky, whose behavior was beyond disappointing. Despite the strong odor and the clear feedback from me, Vicky outright dismissed my concern, claiming the pizza was “fine.” What was even more baffling was his refusal to taste the pizza himself (stating he doesn’t eat pepperoni), instead calling a kitchen staff member to assess it. That person visibly reacted to the smell and initially suggested issuing a replacement. But then.. after Vicky returned from the kitchen.. the story changed. Suddenly, both staff members claimed the pizza was fine, saying they had “tasted it” inside. Strangely, when I asked them to taste it in front of me, the colleague barely took a pinch (not even a bite), and Vicky declared the issue closed. At that point, it was clear there was no intention to listen or help. It wasn’t even about the pizza anymore. I wasn’t chasing a free meal. I came back to report a possible issue with a product that could have affected someone’s health. The least I expected was to be taken seriously. Instead, I left both pizzas at the counter and walked out, deeply disappointed and frustrated.. not because of the food, but because of how I was treated. To Domino’s Management: This is not how customers should be treated. I genuinely hope you take a long, hard look at how some of your frontline staff interact with people.. especially when there’s a legitimate concern at hand. If someone like Vicky represents your brand, then sadly, you’ve lost more than just a customer today. You’ve lost trust.

Lovely sunday 24th Aug for brunch . Lots of options for food. Waitress was patient. Half of our table was late, and we took a long time to order but the two girls were very patient and accommodating. Definitely recommend.

Good atmosphere and service. It was just a shame that the quality of food was poor. The chips were as though they had been dipped again after a few hours. Steak asked for medium, and it came well done. Second time Ive had food and been disappointed

AMAZING FOOD. Such a beautiful place! Gorgeous lighting, big brick walls, so gorgeous. Smiling service. Definitely want to go back again! Great menu too, so hard to decide as it all sounds soo good! I had the holoumi salad with smoked salmon it was delicious!!

We used the First Table half price deal. I love that the menu isn’t flashy—just simple, straightforward, delicious food. The duck risotto was amazing, and unlike most Italian spots that I find too salty, this one was perfectly balanced. The portions were generous, the staff were super friendly, and I’d definitely want to go back!

Perfect spot from brunch to date night or when u feel like 'anything'. Foods always on point with the best customer services. I can't wait to go bk to try different menus! Also, everyone must try their apple raisin pie with vanilla ice cream. I'd die for tht dish.
Everything’s just awesome. Paella and the steak pizza are so delicious! Must-order edit: enjoyed the experience so much I went for a second time in less than a week
The food at Nikkies is always super delicious and the best service. Great family environment, fresh delicious food and fantastic drinks.

Amazing food, service and atmosphere! The pad thai is simply exquisite 👌 drinks were also very tasty and for desert: the fried ice cream was the star and didn't disappoint. We'll come back shortly for more delicious food!

Always delicious as usual, whenever we come to nmk, we come and eat But today's carbonara was bit overcooked, the sauce had thickened, and the steak was a bit too rare. But, still, it was tasty as always

This is the best pizza I’ve had in New Zealand! The flavors were amazing and the service was equally impressive. I really appreciated the refreshing lemon drink while waiting for my takeaway — such a thoughtful touch. Highly recommended

So much fun with the kids, we were there really early, so plenty of families also in. Huge welcome at the door and we were straight into grabbing plates. Got a couple of custom made plates too. Overall great food and experience. I’d go back again and the kids would to.

On arrival last night, a fab welcome and lots of Christmas wishes from all that work there. We got to sit near the pond, which was lovely. Service was amazing, just so knowledgeable, friendly, and had a cheerful vibe. The food was delicious. We certainly tried all we could. No complaints from anyone in our group. The cocktail selection is also on point, especially that ginger crush. All food sampled is shown in photos. Over the years, I have gone here now and then, and Cibo never has never let me down. Thank you

Food was so delicious especially duck meal on my entree was so refectory assembled. Plates were all nicely plated sophisticated. The restaurant atmosphere was clean , light elegant. Waiters were very attentive but no over done . I enjoyed this special day with my friend. Thank you for lovely experience.

Cibo is a really warm, embracing space and it is easy to see why it is a popular wedding and corporate event space. Service is warm and relaxed. It was nice to see many returning customers being embraced by people running the place. That warm, personal Cheers-like feeling is what many of us treasure. Food is well prepared and generous. For me personally, there were small opportunities for refinement. I really enjoyed the fact that the set menu was not overloaded with carby fillers. Overall, a pleasant experience in a lovely setting.

E X C E L L E N T! We went for the 4 course set menu, scallops for the appetiser - delicious! The pork bell and the chicken were our entrees, and it was great. For mains, we chose the fillet and the duck, and oh my soul, it was divine. The dessert was great! The service was excellent. Just great! It's probably our new favourite restaurant.

It has been a few days since my visit to Cibo and I am still reeling from the amazing service of everybody working there. They made our special day even better by going above and beyond. Thank you, Cibo team!

Saw this London Pub in Auckland when we just arrived. Came in for our late lunch and Guinness and were not disappointed. Very smooth and creamy stout. Ordered the seafood platter to share. There were squid, prawns and fish with lots of fries. All of them were good. May come here for lunch again before we drive to elsewhere.

We stumbled across this great English pub last night in time for the All Blacks v Springboks game. Fantastic atmosphete, great food and the service ...despite the huge crowd ..was brilliant. Hats off to Xavier our amazing barman who spared us having to negotiate the queue at the bar witb my 90 year old wheelchair bound dad to provide us with food and drink make it a night to remember, so impressed we came back tonight and were blown away that he remembered us and our drinks order. Incredible memory. Highly recommend it.

This pub has great food, all of which was value for money. The tables and chairs were clean. Staff were very welcoming and quick to serve. Around $20 per person for food, $5-$10 for drinks, decent price. Good drinks on tap and more behind the bar. Couldn't ask for more, I'd recommend for a meal or a quick drink.
Last time I was here: 17 years ago. Not much changed. First Location I could remember being back in Auckland. Thanks for the memories 😎.

Lovely rooms with all your need for a 2 night stay. Bathrooms are newly refurbished with a spacious layout with step-up tiled shower. Room was immaculate on arrival. We arrived earlier than check-in time and asked if we could access the room earlier, but it seemed like our request was an inconvenience to staff.

Lovely hotel, fantastic meals at restaurant and great service from the waitress we had both nights.She was so friendly and efficient. Bed very comfortable. Only had one concern we had asked for a 6am wake up call but it was 6.20 before the man on reception rang! Luckily we had woken up before as we had a taxi pick up at 6.45am. Great to have bus stop out in front as we didn't have our own car. Definitely recommend this hotel.

We love staying at the Rose Park Hotel The rooms are very modern clean spacious and comfortable The bed is very comfortable and clean crisp sheets. The ensuite is pleasing and great water preasure in the shower. The team at the Rose Park Hotel provide great customer service. We enjoy the breakfast buffet in the restaurant. Food from the restaurant is exceptional.

I had an amazing experience at KFC Quay St. The food was fresh, hot, and tasted absolutely perfect. The service was quick, accurate, and very friendly. A special mention goes to Dhinesh, who provided excellent customer service with a warm and professional attitude, he really made the visit even better. Highly recommend this location for both great food and outstanding service.
Me and my family go there almost every 2 weeks. The food and the staff were pretty good but the downside is, there are some trash on the tables and the restrooms are not THAT clean.

’m a staff member of KFC and im very disappointed with the customer service at this KFC. I came in on Saturday last week at day time served by all the morning staff, i went to get a wicked 6 but what i got was a bunch of lies and horrible customer service. No offence but I was told by the staff (Indian lady) that i needed a student ID to get the wicked 6???? I asked multiple times to confirm and kept saying yeah. restaurant was not clean when I came in with my family. Your staff need more training.

Highly recommended, value for money!!! Food was superb and everything was very fresh. I was a bit cautious in regards to the services, having read the previous review. However, I found the entire dining experience very pleasant. The owner was actually very nice and accommodating. She is more like a "GTO" style character, if you know what I mean. The price is very fair for the quality of the food. The A5 beef sukiyaki was amazing! This is one of the best geniune Japanese restaurant that I have tired in Auckland. My first choice of Japanese food from now.
Gozen (御膳) is a traditional set meal with rice, a main & various sides...

Di Mare has been my go-to restaurant for ages, and it never disappoints! The cooking skills here are top-notch—every dish is bursting with flavor and made with such care. which is why I keep coming back. Plus, the service is always so warm and friendly. The staff and owners treat you like family, making the dining experience even better. If you’re after amazing food and great service, Di Mare is the place to be. Can’t recommend it enough!

My partner and I visited for lunch, and we were absolutely blown away. What was initially just going to be a bite to eat very quickly turned into starters, mains and desserts. Every bite was fresh and melted in your mouth. Service is incredible and so warming and welcoming. Will absolutely be coming back.

Quick service. The maccas app has good deals. This store has great space with 2 floors and a friendly staff. The ice cream serves are better than other stores, bigger ice cream cones and more fillings on McFlurry. Time and time again I noticed that. The only downside is the bathroom. It needs a deeper cleaning or even a revamp to get it on shape. Update: The bathroom requires code now, remember to ask when ordering.
I was served by a lovely man, and he made the best sub I have ever had. He packed the sub with so much care. This was one of the best experiences I have had at a subway, I definitely recommend.

Beautiful setting for a daytime bite. Busy on a Monday afternoon! Noted the mixed reviews for food/coffee/service - but honestly had a great brunch experience here. Only tried the Eggs (didn't get a drink) but it was nicely presented with very friendly, quick service. Loved sitting outdoors with the sound of the water overlooking the Domain.
Excellent food & service at BurgerFuel Parnell—special mention to Martin who went beyond to accommodate us. I love the packaging, it makes eating the burger less messy.

Very unhygienic. One member suddenly came to our seat to have his food with his friend. And not even apologetic about that when we asked for our table number. The same guy was eating with hands and then went back to the open kitchen and did something with his dirty hands.

Absolutely loved this burger spot! The burgers were incredibly juicy, flavorful, and cooked just right. You can really tell they use high-quality ingredients, and there’s a great variety of options on the menu to suit all tastes. The atmosphere was relaxed and welcoming, with friendly staff and quick service. Everything from the buns to the sides was fresh and delicious. If you're a burger lover, this place is definitely worth checking out. I’ll definitely be coming back for more!

What a disappointing place for breakfast. When I walked in, there was no greeting or acknowledgment. I spent nearly five minutes calling out before the worker finally appeared, wearing headphones. As I looked at the menu, he walked away without saying anything, forcing me to call out again for several more minutes. When he did return, he still had his headphones on and was talking on the phone while taking my order. The lack of basic customer service was frustrating and unprofessional. With so many better cafés and restaurants along this road, I would strongly recommend choosing one of those instead.

Had EGG'd through UberEats this morning for breakfast and was absolutely stunning!! Brought "The smash" combo with scrambled egg patty and avocado on the most softest gluten free bun I've ever had in my life!! Keep up the good work guys! ❤

We had a great impression of Barulho when it first started as a little tapas & drinking hole. Always gave us an impression where we can find great (and authentic) Spanish-ish cuisine we love so much. Been a while since, and while the service is relatively attentive, I was kind of bothered being served what seem to be a “white wine” glass when we ordered a bottle of red (we referenced other table’s red wine glasses!). We were so looking forward to reminiscing what we had in Portugal/Spain and so it didn’t live up to it- Charcoal grilled octopus comes with a few rings of calamari in the plate… not sure what’s the point?! Is it to fill up the plate or fool the customers ?! What’s your intention? While I did enjoy the generous Pimenton-olive oil sauce, I don’t quite understand the purpose of the bed of marinated olives served with it, over-powering the grilled octopus. Cos lettuce salad dish, which traditionally (the Spanish version) had the cos lettuce charred, served with manchego cheese and anchovy dressing, an absolute delight. But this salad is simply raw & cold, and without a hint of anchovy in its dressing, if any… so I can only describe the dish as a normal lettuce from fridge, tasteless, though with cheese & green apple stripes.. totally under-seasoned! Then the grilled rack of lamb, well, nothing Portuguese/Spanish about it. If anything, it’s simply drowned in sweet marinate. It says “charcoal grilled” on the menu and I see them using the Josper charcoal but nothing smoky nor grilled; again, disappointed- simply drowned in some sweet marinate. So overall, well, if you have not been to Portugal/Spain or had any knowledge of what the cuisines are about, maybe it’s not too bad, just another restaurant serving some fancy food.

I’ve been to Rumi before, but I must say the food quality and taste have reached another level with the new chef. The difference is noticeable, every bite felt fresher and more authentic. The hospitality and customer service were also outstanding; the team truly made us feel at home. The ambience was warm and inviting, with a truly Persian feel, and the classic Iranian music created the perfect atmosphere to enjoy the meal. We ordered the Shamshiri and Momtaz, and both dishes impressed us with their taste and generous portions (enough to take some home, which was a bonus!). Rumi was the perfect choice to celebrate my friend’s new job, wonderful food, genuine hospitality, and an experience we’ll definitely return for.

This was one of the best Middle Eastern kebab I’ve ever had—the seasoning was spot on and it stayed really juicy. The only downside is the price; if the portion were a bit bigger and came with more veggies, it would’ve been perfect.

One word-OUTSTANDING! ok, so we put quite regularly and enjoy good food. We had a party of 4 people, each meal looked fantastic. The food was absolutely delicious, beautiful and tender, very good spice flavours and a good amount. Atmosphere, brilliant with traditional Rumi music, food outstanding, service was friendly and efficient, price was absolutely worth it, and quantity was bang on. We got tempted to try the Persian icecream, and I'm glad we did, very delicious. Thanks so much guys what a little gem of a restaurant.

I've been to this cafe a few times before, but I stopped coming because I felt like the portions were getting smaller and the staff seemed unenthusiastic. I recently heard it changed owners and wanted to check it out. I wasn't disappointed. The staff were very warm and friendly, the ingredients tasted fresh, and the portion size was generous—I usually can't finish a plate this big. Of course, this is a new start with the new ownership, and I hope they can keep it up. All in all, there are so many cafes in Auckland, and not every one makes you want to go back.

On arrival we were greeted by a very friendly female staff member who recognised me & my friend from one of their other eateries, Howick Village Cafe and Hello Stranger. From that moment on we knew the service and the food would be top-notch. Ordered Seafood Chowder which was creamy & tasty and packed with good-sized pieces of seafood (and not typically bulked out with veges). The Buttermilk Fried Chicken Benny was beautifully presented and delicious. Coffees were hot & strong. A good selection of sweet & savoury cabinet food. This eatery is dog-friendly and everyone is well looked after by the staff.

Hidden gem alert. Mum swears it’s the best fish and chips she’s ever had—light, crispy & delicious. Service was warm and accommodating, and the space is spacious and inviting. No idea how it’s still under the radar—thank Google for the tip-off.
Today was my first time having lunch with friends here. The service was extremely friendly, the food was amazing, and the environment was great. I highly recommend this place.

The staff here are very friendly, kind and helpful and the food was pretty amazing with various spices being used in them. Loved the Iced Chocolate beverage as well… The prices were reasonable and the scenary surrounding is pretty good.
Always great service and yummy açai bowls!

Extremely disappointed with the service I received this morning. At 9:05am on September 12th (today), I was served by a woman with glasses and poorly done makeup. I had placed an online order under the name Dreyden for two Tropic Tonic drinks, scheduled for 9:20am. I arrived outside at 9am and entered the store at 9:01am, as the store was open. Instead of being greeted professionally, the staff member acted visibly annoyed that I had ordered and proceeded to lecture me about “prep time” and store opening hours. This is unacceptable. What happens before 9am is not the customer’s concern, nor should I be made to feel like an inconvenience for entering when the doors are open. Why open the store if you don’t want customers? If this reaches the owner or upper management: I strongly suggest you review your security footage and retrain your staff on how to treat paying customers. Telling customers not to enter a store during open hours is completely inappropriate and unprofessional. Because of this experience, I may be advising our entire workout class to stop coming here and to take our business to the Elliott St Tank instead. The service I received today was disgraceful, and if this is how you allow your staff to treat customers, you will continue to lose loyal business.

Wow! Such generous portions - loads of delicious & tender chicken & all the salad is hand cut! The hummus was delicious & loads of sauces to choose from. And as for the kumara fries…! Would recommend for a down-to-earth meal - especially when you’re hungry & looking for high-protein/low carb!
Bloody delicious and generous size! Definitely be a repeat offender when I have the craving for a kebab. Thank you Sha

+ The Korean chicken salad was tasty and fresh + upon request, provided extra disposable bowl for sharing food. - wedges were undercooked, after a long wait, no other customers in shop. When I pointed this out they put them on a hot grill plate to cook, rather than a deep fryer, which took a long time with no such great result. - not one but two LED ceiling lights were in strobe mode (end of life) making the atmosphere quite uncomfortable

Today I was really hungry and went to Pita Pit for a wholemeal falafel wrap. Gurpreet made my wrap and I have to say, he did an amazing job – the amount of fresh vegetables and sauces was just perfect. The taste was spot on and so satisfying. I really appreciate Gurpreet for making my day with his effort and attention to detail. It’s small things like this that make the experience special. Definitely one of my best visits to Pita Pit, and I’ll be coming back again!❤️🙏🏻
I had the falafel regular pita at Pita Pit, and it was awesome! Gurpreet made my lunch, and he did an amazing job—fresh, tasty, and great customer service. Highly recommend!

Great atmosphere, with live jazz music on the Sunday we went. Thai chicken salad was delicious (see the EDIT below), the pancakes were pretty average, would try something else next time. Good coffee and smoothie. Service was fast, slightly impersonal, order at counter and pay first. EDIT : after discussion about the Thai chicken salad, apparently it was only good while the chicken was stil hot, after that it was very average...

Cosy cafe on a corner with large windows and al-fresco seating available. Very kind server, who took me in just before closing time - thank you! Reasonable pricing. Decent hot-chocolate and wifi available. Opening times: 0700-1700 daily
The food was very pretty and tasteful. The service was good. Best to book as they get very busy. If you go on a Saturday there are markets next door.

Had a special family lunch of 17 people to celebrate my daughter’s 21st at the start of August. We enjoyed fantastic service, great food (that’s a bit different from everywhere else) and a warm welcoming environment on a winters day. Absolutely recommend Foundation. We will be returning 🎉

Today at 12:16, I ordered a beef and onion pizza. Unfortunately, when I received and tasted it, the quality was very disappointing. In the past, my experiences at this pizza shop have been very good, but recently the quality seems to have declined. I hope this can be addressed, as I would like to continue being a customer.

Can’t order pizza before 4pm with cash as they have cut costs and won’t hire a delivery driver and now hand their orders to uber eats or deliver easy so shit!!!!! Hungry and should be able to order pizza for lunch

Open early - friendly smiles and great service. Try the gingerbread- it's simply out of this world! Breakfast bagel with fried eggs - hits the spot! And coffee served as you like it! Early mornings see lots of walk ins and foot traffic. Streetside parking- seating indoor and out. - well worth the visit if you're in the area. Two thumbs up!

46 & York offers a nice place to grab drinks away from the main road in Parnell. We came here for drinks and really enjoyed the selection of cocktails and wines they had available. We got the ‘Better Late Than Never’, ‘Take it Sloe’, ‘In No Rush’ cocktails, and the Oystercatcher Pinot Noir. We also got a garlic bread as a nibble to go with our drinks. The cocktails were brave and used some really nice mixers and liquors. My favourite was the ‘Better Late Than Never (Spritz)’. As someone who prefers gin, this was a good way to expand that to incorporate something sweet with a bit of tang to it. The cheesy garlic bread was excellent, a good amount of garlic, and lots of cheese. The only downside to our experience was that there was a large amount of cigarette smoke coming in from the outdoor seating area out back, which was quite pervasive indoors too. Even with the doors closed this was still quite strong, which was a shame. Other than that, 46 & York is a fun place to stop by for some drinks.

Excellent food. Good Service. Just don’t try and eat the skin like I did with the smoked fish. It was so delicious that I was like, “ I’m going to eat the skin “ next thing I knew I was chewing on a bunch of scales. My fault? Hmmmm maybe. In general very nice and the steak was cooked to perfection and a nice size to let me carry on with my night.

The atmosphere at Aqua Café is actually really nice – the space feels relaxing and inviting. Unfortunately, that’s where the positives end. The coffee was honestly terrible – bitter, watery, and nothing like what you’d expect from a café. To make things worse, the lady making the coffee was extremely rude, which completely ruined the experience. A good vibe can only go so far when the service and coffee are this bad. Definitely won’t be coming back.

Have had the whitebait omelette twice now, it comes with hollandaise. Cooked beautifully! You’ll also get a good coffee here and lovely service. Their menu covers varying tastes as well as appealing cabinet food.

First time trying a Portofino chain and found it to be quite enjoyable for a work leaving dinner. Portions were quite generously sized and the dishes were quite tasty overall. Just a bit hot sitting inside though and couldn’t really feel any air con on a warm summer evening.
Nice place for cool desserts and stays open until late but some desserts were pricey and underwhelming.

What a great and tasty pizza! Couldn’t ask for more – delicious pizzas, excellent customer service, and super friendly staff. If you’re in the city or nearby, you must try Pizza Hut Quay Street. 🎉🌼 So yummy!”

I went in today And I just wanna save a customer service was 10 out of 10. Amazing the food where do I start? The pizza was cooked to perfection. Very cheesy and lots of meat the bread was very soft and then had a crispy crust. Highly recommended. I’m definitely coming back. Thank you
My first time trying Pizza hut in New Zealand. Surprisingly delicious. Cheap too.

Love this place. Ate here several times while on trip. Service was fantastic. Very friendly and very helpful. Great selection of fish. Fresh oil. Perfect cook. Talked to several locals that come here often. Can't go wrong here, we liked everything we tried. You need to stop by...then walk a couple minutes to the rose park and have a picnic.
Lunch set is worth to eat, recommend😊. It’s included salad & miso soup.

This was my first time eating at Bird on a Wire in Parnell. I found out that the one that served us was the owner of the other cafe we had eaten at previously at another Addy. She was Kind and Attentive. Our food was Most Delicious exactly like our previous times before. It was a Most Lovely Atmosphere,and also Nice Surroundings. I loved how we did not have to pay for parking,because it's already enough buying lunch. Thank you to the Lovely Owner.

I was looking for a keto breakfast and the Japanese omelette was fabulous. All the vegetables are from their home organic garden and she makes her own soy sauce. The chef had a lovely chat and gifted me one of her organic lemons. A lovely way to start the weekend.

It’s my first time visiting here! I ordered muffins, biscuits and they were so good👍 It was fluffy and the chocolate was little soft and chewy 🥰 The staff were very kind and attentive. I’ll definitely visit again! Thank you for such a happy time!

Ohmiya in Remuera is a fantastic new spot with breathtaking harbor views and top-notch food. Loved the fresh sashimi, juicy wagyu steak, and crispy tempura. The cocktails were great too—try the peach one! Super convenient parking and excellent service. Perfect for dates or group dinners. Highly recommend!

Celebrate friend‘s birthday here and it was a fantastic choice! The ingredients were so fresh, and the sakura drink in a cute bottle was special. The service was excellent from start to finish. The owner, a very friendly lady, made us feel so welcome and recommended many delicious dishes that we absolutely loved.

@theaucklandbuzz (insta & TikTok handle) Insta handle follow for more such review. Last week we dined at @3nutmegsnz — the service was warm and welcoming, which we truly appreciated. The overall flavour profile of the food leaned more towards the subtle and mild side. Here’s a quick rundown of what we tried and how it fared on our taste scale: 🥘 Curries (Paneer Saag, Kadhai Paneer, Prawn Butter Masala, Mix Veg, Malai kofta): 2/5 🫓 Breads (Garlic Naan, Laccha Parantha, Tandoori Roti): 3.5/5 🥟 Appetisers (Dumplings, Tamarind Mushrooms): 2.5/5 💧 Paani Poori: 4/5 . 🍨 Dessert (Cassata and pista kulfi) 1.5/5 Do note — this was based on our personal experience and preferences, and taste can vary for everyone!
Went to Mazaj cafe for shisha and drinks and it was such a good time. Blown away by the exceptionally attentive and friendly service. Looking forward to coming back, would highly recommend.
Very nice food and staff they were very welcoming and approachable. I recommend this place to anyone who wants to experience authentic Middle Eastern cuisine.

Sambal Station in Parnell is a hidden gem for authentic Malaysian food at very affordable prices. We tried the Satay Chicken, Nasi Goreng, and Beef Rendang – every dish was packed with flavour and was absolutely delicious. The host was very friendly, and kindly guided us in choosing the best dishes, which made the experience even better. Highly recommend this spot if you are looking to enjoy amazing Malaysian cuisine in Auckland! The resturant is also well placed , some seats have views overlooking the road.

We absolutely love the pizzas, the base is so crispy and not doughy. The flavours are beautiful. The Quattro is my favourite. Hands down the best pizza in Auckland. The smoked chicken pasta is also really tasty and authentic. Nice work team!

Avoid like the plague. Treated ourselves to dessert. Brownie was so nuked it was caked to the aluminum foil tin and inedible. Plastic on lid was melted. Cheesecake was frozen solid and it still could not be penetrated with a metal fork after we took it home. It was frost burnt with ice attaching it to the container. We dined in and had to request a spoon or fork. Had no spoons and after some searching by the servers we were given wooden forks. These were inadequate given the state of the food.

⸻ ⭐☆☆☆☆ Very Disappointed I ordered Cajun Wedges with tomato dip from Hell Pizza – 295 Kepa Rd, Mission Bay, Auckland 1071, New Zealand, but the food was not up to the mark at all. The wedges were undercooked and had no Cajun seasoning on them. I returned to the store to raise my concern. A Punjabi girl who made my order came to speak with me. While I was waiting outside, I overheard her speaking in Punjabi to her manager, saying things like “she ate the wedges and brought some back.” As an Indian, I understood everything — and I found this comment very disrespectful and unprofessional. When I asked to speak with the manager, I was told they had my number and would call me back in seven days. This is not how customer complaints should be handled. I’m extremely disappointed with both the quality of the food and the service. Definitely not the experience I expected from Hell Pizza Mission Bay. ⸻

I had such a wonderful dining experience at Kohi Beach. The atmosphere was warm and inviting, with a beautiful view that made the evening feel special from the very beginning. The food was excellent – everything was fresh and well prepared, and the steak was absolutely delicious, cooked perfectly to my liking. What truly stood out, however, was the service. A big thank you to Zoey and Denise, who looked after us with such kindness and professionalism. They were attentive without being intrusive, always checking in at the right moment, and they made us feel genuinely welcome even when the restaurant was busy. Their positive attitude and friendly smiles added so much to the overall experience. Kohi Beach is definitely a place I would recommend for both the food and the service. I’ll be looking forward to coming back again soon!

Four of us came for dinner, and the food was absolutely exceptional! The steak was cooked to perfection, the saffron chicken was succulent and full of flavor, and the rib was melt-in-your-mouth delicious with the best chips on the side. For dessert, the pavlova was delightful, and the apple crumble looked just as tempting. We’ll definitely be coming back
Best Rib Eye I had so far in New Zealand. Very polite, and proffesional service. Great work my friend, thank you..Will be back hopefully.👌🏻🌷

The manager was very considerate as I eat only halal food. So he offered option to be cooked in separate pan. Which made me delighted to hear that. And was attentive to our requests and checking on us every time. Definitely recommend the service there. Thank you from Morocco شكرا من المغرب

Good location, got the seafood fettuccine and Thai chicken salad with two non alcoholic food costs us just under $80. Cost is average across Mission Bay. My fiancé loved the salad, however the seafood fettuccine had way too many small pieces of shell, it felt like I almost chipped my teeth so this was a let down. The toilets are a shared facility with Borderum next door and not hygienic, it’s smelly and unmaintained so both facilities need to step their clean game up as restaurants are clean but not the toilets? Might return to try other meals on the menu.
The food was absolutely delicious, beautifully presented, and the service was excellent. Every detail was thoughtful and well-executed. Highly recommended

Love this place. Have been many times and it always feels like a beautiful homely meal. A nice classic checkered table cloth restaurant. Very fair prices and generous serving sizes. Always leave full. The Arrabbiata is my favorite.

Great food. Me and my family ordered 3 special pizza's, 1 meatlovers, 1 lasagne, and 1 cannaloni. So Devine. We also ordered desert, can't remember what we got but it was so fabulous, nothing to complain about from us. Staff were very friendly and kind with great service! We all really enjoyed it.
The order taker was very rude, he was just ignoring us, no greeting, didn’t ask dine in or take away. Leave attitude at home if are working for hospitality services.
Delicious and tasty burger pattie. I forgot the name of the burger I had beets, avocado, lettuce, tomato garlic aioli and sweet potato fries. Not yam but yellow sweet potatoes

biggest little fish shop in Auckland!!! Wait times can be long on Friday evenings because the food is SO GOOD. Popularity issues can be sidestepped by ringing in an order ahead of time. The Snapper filet is excellent.

Food quality amazing. Portion sizes generous. Came back twice during my stay in Auckland. Highly recommending this place to any hungry local or traveler. Place done up well, you can surely feel the german presence.

Amazing service from the waiters. Restaurant atmosphere was so good, nice and classy. I ordered seafood chowder with garlic bread but it tasted more like garlic cream with tiny, tiny pieces of seafood.. .. beers was wonderful and cocktails were tasty. food rated down below. Steak and mash was -1000/10. Mash is powdered mash. Not tasty at all. Cherry beer 10/10. Burger with fries 2.5/10. Burgers tasted old. garlic bread 4.5/10. Seafood chowder 1.5/10 Cocktails 10/10

What is disgraceful food service. We order steak with red wine sauce. The sauce was very bitter. We did mention to the staff. What did I get different sauce but same steak. They don’t event change the meat. The gave us the same meat. Please check with food hygiene and food service rules Thank you

Extraordinary service and pizza. It was a quiet time so she came to my car with my order! And even reduced the amount of tomato sauce for me! 🍕 Also one of the best chocolate milkshakes I’ve ever had. Highly recommend!

We ordered a quattro stagioni with extra artichokes. We got a pizza that we can't describe. No shrimp. No artichokes. Anchovies everywhere. Intense! Horrible and not at all what we have received in the last 4 years. It was a birthday meal so not good.

Great service and attentive care. Got two coffees here for a 'sundowner' (aka to-go) on the beach- served to our specifications. Extensive menu.. several cakes and sandwiches on display. Good spot for a quick bite or a more substantial meal. Cheers!

My favourite go-to place for best coffee, best Hot chocolate and amazing food options in Mission Bay and Auckland. Staff is very friendly and always remember my order. Best cabinet food as well and amazing view of beautiful Mission Bay.
Great atmosphere 👌 and lovely service from the staff. Awesome view 😎

A hidden gem and such a delightful spot! The coffee is rich with aroma, the bakery is always fresh, and the staff greet you with warm smiles. I love coming here for special little dates with my daughter — it’s always a joy

Looked better than it tasted. The colourful dish had a sauce so overpowering and rich that I couldn’t eat it, so I swapped with my friend who had fish and chips - which was terrible. The fish was one of the worst fish I’ve had… sorry guys. My other friend was super happy with his kebab meal. I probably should’ve chosen this dish. Staff friendly and efficient.

I went there to celebrate my mom’s birthday, and it was absolutely worth it. Spending time here was such a great experience. The food, the people, everything was fabulous. The seafood platter and feast were especially delicious, and the place has a really nice view. If you have a party coming up, I would definitely recommend this place!
Delicious food with friendly staff. Their kids options were fantastic with lovely activity bags. The food was fresh and well prepared. Had to go back again!
Loved it! Incredible, tasty food. Great service. Awesome kids menu with an activity set included! Comes with colouring in crayons, stickers and also activities for older kids

Below review written by a 14 year old that I mentor: Have you ever wanted to go to an American Diner? But you can't because you're in New Zealand? Well you're in luck! Bald Eagle Diner has the best food known to Mission Bay! With their cheesy burgers filled with flavour and their crunchy onion rings. The prices are great! And the drinks were phenomenal, their freak shake was my favorite!

Classic diner atmosphere. Extremely friendly staff. Helped take group photos with a lot of enthusiasm. They also helped set up a birthday cake with much more care than I would have expected. Food tastes good as well

Retro American Diner with all the neon, chrome and vinyl you could visually muster! The menu covers everything burgers, fries, shakes and sodas with a few surprises extra. Seating allowance at either booths or table and chairs. Portion sizes are large and certainly worth every scrumptious calorie. Gender neutral WC on site. Pay as you order at the counter and take a seat. Two tasty thumbs up!

The pizza was so good!! I got the pepperoni pizza, and it came out in like 10 minutes. I was so satisfied with the service. The chinese boy and the indian man were so kind and friendly. I definitely recommend.

What an incredible experience at Mamma Mia in Mission Bay! From start to finish, everything was absolutely perfect. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, with that authentic Italian charm that makes you feel like you’ve been transported straight to Italy. We ordered the lasagne, pizza, tiramisu, and a gelato waffle, and every dish was simply outstanding. The lasagne was rich, hearty, and full of flavor, easily one of the best I’ve had in Auckland. The pizza had the perfect balance of a crisp base, fresh toppings, and that signature wood-fired taste that makes it unforgettable. For dessert, the tiramisu was light yet indulgent—just the right amount of sweetness—and the gelato waffle was a dream, crispy on the outside with creamy gelato that melted in perfectly. The service was attentive, friendly, and genuine, making the whole dining experience even better. You can truly feel the passion they put into both the food and the hospitality. If you’re in Mission Bay and want authentic Italian with a beautiful setting, this is the place to go. Highly recommend and can’t wait to come back!

The open steak sandwich was nice and filling ($28 special), and included caramelised onions, fresh cucumber, lettuce and tomato. The bread was delicious and tasted like the restaurants pizza base. I highly recommend the tiramisu. Will definitely be back to try the rest of the menu.

$6.15 for a small 8oz takeaway flat white is an absolute rip off. I feel that might even be too much but sent my daughter in to get it and maybe was ripped off by the staff. I don’t see that price in their menu. Won’t be going back at that price.

We visited Jewel of India today to celebrate our friend's anniversary, and it was an absolutely wonderful experience The food was incredibly delicious and full of flavor every dish we tried was cooked to perfection. We were all very happy and satisfied with the taste and quality of the meal. What made the day even more special was the amazing staff. They were so sweet, friendly, and welcoming they truly treated us like family. Their warm hospitality made our celebration even more memorable. We are so glad we chose Jewel of India for this special occasion. Highly recommended for anyone looking for great food and heartfelt service. We will definitely be coming back again Thanks 😊

The food was delicious, authentic Sichuanese noodles and appetizers! And the staffs were so helpful, one time my daughter left her purse behind, the staffs went out of their ways to find it and hold it for safekeeping for collection later. It’s comforting to know the business looks out for the community!

Disappointed, take your money somewhere else. So stingy with their portions. Thought to give them a second chance with dessert but they barely even gave a scoop… Kapiti they are ruining your brand name (guy also didn’t wash his hands or wear gloves, and no tissue on the cone or anything).
Some great restaurants there like Zeta, Uncle man, Temeria,... But avoid burger burger at all costs.

The absolute best food in Auckland, the “Olympus” is the ultimate kai! 🙌 salads are beautiful but that lamb just falls off the bone is something out of this world! The chef here is incredible ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ highly recommend dropping in here to try their amazing food 😎

Don't leave all those huge salads sitting around uncovered for hours or days. The ingredients get limp n dry and actually can harbour bacteria. Think listeria. Use the cabinets for prepackaged meals. Do your mise en place at the start of each shift and make salads to order or at least at the beginning of the shift. I feel sorry for people ordering deliveries of that food to get ageing salads grabbed from the counter not freshly made food. This is very unappetizing and an insult to Greek food. Your dry old olives and sagging capsicum slices look like ancient Greek ruins!

Awesome service & great good. It's no easy feat accommodating for 12x hungry Samoans but My Fried Chicken Mission Bay certainly delivered! SIDE NOTE: Trust the server when she says that you don't need to order additional sides with the Endless Chicken Menu. It's more than enough. 💯 Recommend for big or small groups.

Came for a bottomless dinner on Saturday. Definitely different as it’s in an eatery. Really enjoyed it though, Food is really nice. The drinks are nice but they get a-bit too sweet by the end. Awesome service will be back.

Ordered a wat dan hor and was very disappointed with my meal. Most of the noodles were vermicelli, with only a third being the flat hor fun. I asked the server if they usually use vermincelli and they said yes, and that if you wanted only hor fun, you need to ask for it. But the menu (and all other wat dan hor I've had) says "fried flat rice noodles." Please, if you make substitutions from the menu, let your customers know, I wouldn't have ordered it if I had known. The noodles themselves were white, broken and hard. The gravy was very watery with little egg, and tasted only like sesame oil. Disappointed because I've had other dishes from here in the past that have been good (mee goreng, nasi lemak). Teh Tarik was good.

For me Uncle Man’s in K’road is still the best. The satellite restaurants don’t seem to get the flavours as good as the mothership. Had the nasi lemak with the beef rendang add-on. The portion sizes were average and there weren’t many pieces of beef in the rendang. I thought the value for money was poor. That being said the up market food court experience is good for group catch ups as everyone can get whatever they want.

I had a very sad experience today. After i bought sushi for my daughter and myself had requested no wasabi in one of the box and additional wasabi in the other. Also mentioned that i d like to have extra soy sauce as the amount of sushi we bought will not be as tasty with only one soy sauce as they usually serve. What we got: in my daughter’s box had no ginger at all, only one soy sauce. In my box very little wasabi and ginger with only one soy sauce. Please can you make sure to listen when the customer requests any specific changes?
You can not find better pizza in Auckland , so far I had the best one ever . Highly recommended

Really enjoyed our dinner from here, the prices are affordable, portion sizes are very good and the staff were very friendly and welcoming. I’m happy to order from here more in the future and make it our new local spot. Had the sweet sour pork and BBQ pork fried noodles both were so tasty.

Went in to pick up my order 15 minutes after getting my order confirmation. Got told they didn’t receive my order. I showed my order confirmation. They said not their problem they won’t give me the food I ordered. I said that I would wait for my order. They said they can’t make it because the haven’t received the order. I said that I would review them online. The guy followed me out of the store and screamed at me through my car window. About 15 minutes after leaving he calls me to say he has now received my order. I told him I don’t want it anymore as I don’t feel safe picking it up. My card was still charged for the order.
Really nice place for veg dumplings! They taste great, but it would be even better if the stuffing could be a bit more generous for the price. That would make it perfect

This is my go to Dumpling joint, have been ordering from here for as long its been open, the consistency in the food that Shane & his team put out is second to none, I’m more than happy to support this local business & glad to see it doing so well!

We used good George’s function room for a baby shower, and it was a phenomenal experience! The team were absolutely amazing, so accommodating, we ordered the food from the venue and it was delicious! Highly recommend their venue for any event and will definitely rebook for another event

We pulled into Good George, having never been there. What a treat. Customer service was quick, fun and very welcoming. The atmosphere was buzzing and we felt looked after from start to finish. The food was fantastic. Decent portions, well presented and flavourful. We will definitely return!
Was the Best Japanese food ever, great service and very friendly staff. Thanks for the great meal
Warm feeling, amazing staff, food taste exceptional, clean and fast services. I recommend this authentic Asian flavours

Absolutely loved our food, the service was great, and atmosphere very ambient, we ordered the ceviche and polenta squid to start, they were both amazing! We liked the squid more it was soft and not chewy or rubbery, then hubby ordered the rib eye and he said this could possibly be the best steak he's ever had! And we dine out quite a bit. I ordered the seafood hot pot and I seriously thought it was the best, the flavours and the amount of seafood was super generous, I was disappointed when it was all gone! We'll definitely be back here soon
This is a cute little place. Lovely, friendly staff. The food was nice but both dishes we had were very very sweet! Next time I'll ask for it to be cooked without added sugar!

@theaucklandbuzz (insta & Tiktok handle) Follow me for more such reviews. We visited Jalsa and had an amazing experience. The ambience was vibrant, enhanced by lively music that set the perfect mood for the evening. The hookah was smooth, cocktails were crafted beautifully, and the starters were packed with flavor. Every dish we tried was delicious, making the whole dining experience truly enjoyable. Jalsa is definitely a place to relax, indulge, and have a great time with friends.

We visited the restaurant for my husbands birthday. Unexpectedly it wasnt much crowded because it was midweek and the staff made us welcome and gave great service. We had the amritsari fish tikka chilli paneer methi matar malai and naans. Honestly their food never disappoints. Ive had their butter chicken before and its been the best in whole auckland with hot naans. We had our child the staff treated us really well and gave us great service. Yuvraj is the manager there and he really gave a great surprise to celebrate my husbands birthday to end with gulab jamuns which were amazing. Amazing service

We recently celebrated our baby shower at Jalsa Indian Eatery and could not have asked for a better experience. From start to finish, everything was top-class the service was attentive, the food was absolutely delicious, and the overall atmosphere made the event truly special. It was the perfect venue for a small gathering, and the team went above and beyond to make sure everything ran smoothly. Highly recommended for anyone looking to host a celebration we were very happy with both the customer service and the quality offered.

Great atmosphere, great food. The service was just impeccable. We got the red curry with Duck (tonnes of meat, and packed full of flavour) Fried rice with chicken, also super tasty. But what makes me want to go back is how attentive, helpful & nice the waitress who served us was. I missed her name but she is just amazing. Def give this place a go!!

5/5! Finally found a place with a great Pad Thai. The flavours were balanced and delicious, perfect texture and the portions are good. The atmosphere is very nice, sea view and a terrace. Staff was very kind. Thank you for a great experience!
Food had amazing flavor with gracious serving size. Highly recommend the Lycee fried chicken! The bao bun had great taste. I wasn’t a fan of the orange and coconut but the apple one was amazing!

This spot is a slice of joy in the neighbourhood. Delicious, fresh food prepared with care; excellent service - you feel like you’re truly at home and welcome, amazing cocktails, noodles made in-house and the dumplings are incredible. Funky chill atmosphere, great vibe, I will make a point to come back here and the board games are a neat addition. What a gem 💎
Took my dad here for Father’s Day and found the food super delicious. Portions were quite substantial and even the salad was tasty. Sirloin could be better though - that was quite mediocre.

I tried Azzurro Mission Bay through a First Table booking. The food itself was nice and flavorful, but the portion sizes didn’t feel worth the price. Service was quite slow, which was a bit disappointing. That said, I wouldn’t mind giving it another chance to see if it improves.
Nice drink, and nice staff, the young fella very friendly.

This is a great Japanese restaurant that’s nearly beachfront. You get beautiful views of the beach and a nice breeze while enjoying some great tasting food. The highlight of this visit would be the Tuna Tostada for us. The volcano roll was pretty good too. The cucumbers were okay, a bit thick and a little bitter so not as enjoyable as I would have liked.

Absolutely incredible dinner experience. We walked in with no reservations, and they were able to seat us quickly with no issues, in the spacious outside area with a fantastic view of the ocean. I recommend making a reservation though, as we were lucky! The food itself was absolutely incredible. For two people, 6 plates was the perfect amount! Any more and we would have been unable to move afterwards. Our server, Rory, was incredible! So deeply attentive and really made our dining experience extra special, Thank you!

The food was delicious and we enjoyed the flavors. However, the dishes came out quite slowly, we were there from 7 to 9. We were a group of four, and the portions were just enough to feel satisfied. Overall, a nice experience but the service speed could be improved.

This place is the worst Japanese food I ever had in Auckland. The Sashimi is not fresh at all. The price is rip off. It costs over $300 for 2 of us for 7 dishes! Look at the sea urchin in p1, it looks like shit!
The food is tasty and good environment 😋 I like the environment. It is a good time had dinner at there.

I ordered a full size tsuyu salmon and karrage donburi on uber eats. I’m disappointed not only with the portion of full size of salmon but also the single tablespoon of rice in the bottom of the bowl for $21.90. The karrage donburi also said 10 pieces of chicken and we we got 9 pieces.

We went there to celebrate our anniversary. Before going, I checked the Google reviews. The rating was 3.9, so I wasn’t sure how the restaurant would be. However, I really wanted to try it, so we went on Tuesday night. Although it was a weekday, the place was quite busy with people enjoying their meals. We ordered an anchovy pasta (can’t remember the exact name), a seafood risotto, and a steak with cream sauce. The flavours were amazing, and for me, it was the perfect choice for our anniversary dinner. I even said it was the best Italian food I’ve ever had in my life. I like home-style cooking, and the food here really felt like Italian home food, the kind an Italian mum would cook. The owner of the restaurant was humorous, kind, and welcoming. I’d absolutely love to go back and try more dishes from the menu next time.

We had such a wonderful experience thanks to Michael’s warm and welcoming service. He was friendly and made everyone in our group—from the youngest to the oldest—feel special on our Father’s Day outing. The food was delicious, and the live music made the atmosphere even better. A big thank you to Michael for quickly finding us a table—this is exactly what true hospitality should feel like!

I had a good time at here and lovely to had lunch at this beautiful place. I feel energetic for my work. Thanks for the owner providing me a cup of drink. I am really homesick recently 😞 feel so touched. Thanks for the lovely smile, that's the amazing part of Auckland.

Good authentic Spanish food. We enjoyed the rich flavours in the Squid dish - main sized. Really good - recommended! The paella was rich and delicious, full of seafood and great flavours. Large serve. Good garlic and cheese bread pizza. Leafy salad with olives and feta good too! Cheap drink 3pm - 6pm 8$ wines and beers Enjoyed the Seaview from a table near the front of the restaurant. Only downside was the tables are very close - so the conversation of you and your neighbours are not private…

La Vista is such a lovely spot with amazing food and a beautiful sea view. We ordered the pork ribs as a starter and they were perfectly grilled and flavorful. The highlight for me was the Paella Del Oceano, packed with fresh seafood and full of flavor. The Beef Wellington was also outstanding – tender, juicy, and cooked to perfection. 👍 We finished with a warm sticky date pudding that was just the right amount of sweet. Great service, cozy atmosphere, and definitely worth visiting!❤️
We ordered My Breakfast and Aussie Breakfast and they taste really good. Service and location were great. Will definitely visit again.

Great service and delicious food. The layout is confusing and causes congestion as those wishing to pay block the entrance. It was quite busy when we went and the gentleman at front of house, seated us, took our order, delivered our meal and cleared the table. He did this both indoor and outdoor. It seemed he was doing the work of at least 3 people.

It was my first time at Moretons St Heliers and i really had a great time. We went on a Friday night - The food was good, the ambience was great. But what made it even more perfect was Banjo’s service even when the restaurant was packed, he attended to us really well! Would definitely come back!

My daughter and I had a wonderful lunch, little miss 5.5 was not only all smiles but very well looked after including sneaky chocolate delivery from the lovely Emilie who expertly serviced our needs. Attentive, friendly and anticipating our every need, this girl needs a bar tab from the owners or at the very least a juicy slab of meat loaded with truffle butter!! A true pleasure of an experience with delightful food, service and even better views!

All you need to know is these are some of the best kebabs in Auckland if not THE best on consistency alone. Great prices, fresh, flavours are fantastic. Support your local, make the trip, have some banter with the team. Worth every dollar.

The best Japanese food I ever had. Musashi made me like Japanese food. The flavours were well balanced and soothing. Great customer service too. I thank my friend,Gabi who introduced this small Japanese restaurant in St Heliers. I wish if the restaurant was more spacious.

I used to go a lot - great food, good price and familia staff. But then for a period, the price went up a lot and food quality dropped. But recently, with the new chef coming, it has gone back to the good old neighbourhood restaurant again - even better. Lunch offers really good value for money, dinner offers a more comprehensive and high quality set. And even some familiar staff comes back. Highly recommended.

Stopped in for some fish and chips and it was the best I’ve had in a while! Friendly, quick service, tender fish cooked to perfection and served with a lemon wedge (bonus!!!) and crispy, perfectly salted hot chips which you can tell were cooked in fresh oil. Not to mention, super affordable prices, especially the lunch specials! I really recommend this place :)
Ordered 2 snapper and chips. The fish was dry and only half covered in a thin layer of batter. Chips were also dry but ok. The server though was polite and friendly.
Very delicious and good portion size. Really enjoyed the Red Curry and Tom Kha. Will be returning again :)
I wished I'd read the reviews first. Terrible service, pizza, doughie and prawns were not fresh. Avoid like the plague. Definitely dont recommend
