I brought a 3x pizza and sides last night for our work function and by the time I went home I noticed they made my pizza wrong and gave me a different dessert. I paid extra $5-10for new pasta pizza with chicken and it didn't come with any pasta bits. So rang them and said i would be contacted but recieved no response. I also ordered chocolate rolls but recieved a small lava cake indtead without warning. We are all very disappointed at the service and won't be ordering here again

We went there in the weekend for a family get together. We really enjoyed the friendly and pleasant atmosphere. The food was authentic, very tasty and the service was friendly. Will definitely go again. Highly recommended!!

This place used to be a favorite, but it's clearly gone downhill. Our food took so long that tables seated after us were served first, and while the waitress apologised for kitchen delays, it didn't make up for it. The portions were small for dishes that are almost $40, my Gnocchi at $36 looked like it belonged in the small/starter section of the menu and tastes like 8 small pieces of fried potato hash cakes. It was also bland and forgettable, much like the coffee. The view is still lovely as always, but it's no longer enough to make up for the lackluster food and slow service. Disappointing overall, and likely our last visit.

Great location. We had our lunch and the view from our seat seeing the beach was amazing. Our dishes were tasty, Asian fusion food. I recommend to try their pork belly, sashimi - king fish dishes. Their dessert for a small group was awesome - mix ice cream, pavlova, panna cotta, pudding and chocolate. Their coffee was also good. Highly recommend this place. Definitely will come back and try other dishes.
Best takeaway curry I have enjoyed in Auckland. High quality food, great taste, amazing service. It is our go-to for Indian food in Auckland, so happy to have them in our neighborhood!

Nice and cosy place, food is delicious, waiters are mindful. Good atmosphere and overall satisfying experience. Kebabs are a must, mezze is full of flavours, and safran ice cream is definitely worth trying.
Really nice sushi and love the cozy vibes

We have bought food from here 3x in the last 2 weeks! That’s how good it is! AMAZING burgers - forget about Burger Fuel. I wished a took a photo so you guys can see. Their tacos will give Broke Boy a run for their money. They are tasty and come with consommé too. The chips are perfectly cooked and seasoned well. I’d come here just to buy the hot chips. We were pleasantly surprised to find this little gem of a food place in suburban St. Heliers. An absolute must try! Run don’t walk. 18th June - Got dinner here again tonight, and I'm sad to say that I'm hugely disappointed. We got chips in our burgers. To be fair, kids burgers so I was not expecting anything wow BUT the chips were a mix of freshly cooked and reheated portions. So disappointed with the drop in standard. I received a free portion of chips for the above review as well. That lot was all hard and old chips. Gutted.
Thank you for beautiful fish and chips tonight. Really good servings and fresh light oil. Best we've had in a really long time. Will definitely be back

Fish was really good. Chips were OK. But using generic store bought onion rings is not acceptable. Especially as they were crumbed and not battered. Which is what I would expect from a fish and chip takeaway

Seriously some of the best food in Auckland. The calamari was so well balanced and delicious, completely melt-in-your-mouth, not rubbery at all. The nduja and lemon pepper salt paired very very well and cut the richness of the squid ink mayo perfectly. The lamb pappardelle was so smokey and delicious. Pasta was cooked perfectly, and was very good quality. The porcini pasta (mushroom), was so umami forward and rich, but perfectly seasoned. Super flavourful. Portions were perfect, we left happy and satisfied. All the staff were very friendly and informative, and the atmosphere is cozy and peaceful. Well done!!

We were a table of 8 having a set menu. The food was tasty and plenty of it - absolutely great way to try a bit of everything! Service was a wee bit slow - half the table placed their drink orders whilst the other half didn’t. We had to ask them to take our order and then it took 20mins to get a G & T. That said - great local restaurant and great menu

Out go-to for bbq ribs and roast chicken. Small menu, amazing selection nonetheless. So far we've tried ribs box, roast chicken (spicy - periperi I think), ribs burger and panko chicken burger. Their ribs are fantastic, chicken is brilliant, esp the sauce. Love the Brioche bun burgers - pork rib burger is everything you wish McRibs was 😂. My favorite however was the panko crumbed chicken breast burger. 2 cutlets and their signature spicy sauce 🙌🏻 Absolutely love their spicy periperi sauce. The staff is very friendly. Must try when in St Heliers. Fantastic location, just across the beach.
Fish is not fresh! Beef burger is soggy, and beef is not good quality ! Can not finish the portion due to the bad taste. Not good experience ! Not recommend to eat here!!!
Best fish and chips around! The fish is always fresh and crispy, the chips are perfect, and the service is great. Highly recommend Koru Oceans Fish N Chips Chinese!

I had an excellent experience at this restaurant. The service was warm, attentive, and made me feel truly welcomed. The food is outstanding – each dish is creative, beautifully presented, and full of amazing flavours that really stand out. You can tell a lot of thought and passion go into the menu. It’s the kind of place that leaves you excited to come back and try more. Highly recommend to anyone looking for both great food and top-notch service. We’ll defining come back again!
Excellent food and perfect ambiance. I had the best green curry with crispy chicken ,Very creamy and delicious. Cocktail was fantastic.I’ll definitely be coming back. Highly recommend!
Came to know this place through friends. The staff are super nice and patient, the dishes are served quickly with pretty presentation, the background music is lighthearted. Highly recommended!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ The food here is absolutely amazing! The pizza is sensational , fresh dough and high-quality ingredients that taste so fresh. The pasta dishes are incredible, my favorite is the beef ragu with their fresh pasta, which is just perfect. Desserts are also outstanding. The atmosphere is super cool and welcoming. Highly recommend!!!! Definitely one of the best restaurants in Auckland!

This is by far the best restaurant in Auckland. The dishes were full of flavor, beautifully presented, and the staff were so friendly and attentive. A wonderful dining experience from start to finish. Highly recommended!
Delicious Neapolitan pizza with the perfect crust and fresh toppings, paired with crispy, flavorful arancini. A cozy spot with warm service and a true taste of Italy

The staff here are usually very kind. Unfortunately, during a recent visit I experienced very poor treatment from a staff who told me I was “not welcome”, questioned me about my job and office, and should not use my laptop in the restaurant. There is no written policy about this, and I had already ordered food and drinks while spending time there. I was even told that I could only stay for one hour from now on without laptop. This experience was extremely disappointing and damaging to the otherwise wonderful reputation of St Andrew’s Village. I hope management will take steps to ensure all guests are treated with respect, fairness, and consistency.
My husband and I always spend a great quality coffee time here, We had most satisfaction with those healthy and yummy foods

Good price for the chicken burger I've paid tonight. The person who served tonight was me very nice 👌. The burger was good and tasty and delicious I had keep some for later. Definitely my place to go to for next time and I highly recommend the place if you are really hungry 😋

Incredibly underwhelming. Chicken burger was bland, the "smash burger" is not a smash burger and lacked flavour, the double thick shake was as thin as a chocolate milk but not as tasty. Waste of money. My 2 year old enjoyed the chicken and chips though.
My wife and i get a chicken salad almost every weekend. Sometimes twice a week. They are GOATED! Highly recommend!

Food is really expensive for what you get and pretty basic. I had roasted beetroot and feta salad and it tasted like not enough feta and lots of plain beetroot (tasted like canned beetroot) with some spinach for $16. I also had another $16 duckfat potatoes, which 3 of them were really dark, so didn't eat. The standard should be very high for those prices. Beetroot should be roasted and there should be a good amount of feta. Stringy fries weren't many for the price either. Seafood chowder looked the winner for value. So, nice location and atmosphere. Had to really get the waiters attention for ordering, despite only having 1 other group there. It could be a lot better, more generous for the price you pay. I want to feel like I'm really having a treat and it felt basic. You want people to want to come back, so be generous with your helpings and quality.

1st time in this gorgeous restaurant it was absolutely phenomenal. Greeted with the door being opened for us and seated right away. Atmospherewas very much local favorite, warm and cosy but with top tier service. Food was delicious!! That seafood chowder 🤤🤤 is a must!! As you could tell the mains were soo good we dove in right away without me taking a photo. The Fried chicken was cooked perfectly and the mash that went with it was 100/10 🤤🤤 would definitely Highly recommend!!
Never had problems with them others had though but in my experience all good

What a disappointment! Snapper for $6 not even the size of my hand! Batter was horrible and oily, chips were ok but absorbed a lot of oil, fry bread had a weird chemical/metallic taste, was in the area but won't be coming back.

Staff are super friendly, really easy to deal with. Great value for money. Chips are always freshly made. Came home and noticed they slipped in 5 fried breads. They’re absolutely delicious. A nice surprise for our family take out night today.

Massey. Brought a pot of “fresh”oysters, to get home and see the best before date, was the same day. Definitely not fresh oysters and this is not the first time. Toby’s need to put better processes to uphold quality. Disappointing
Great pizza. Gentleman working needs some training on cleanliness as he would go from handling the trash can to his phone and then to food products without gloves or washing his hands.

Thank you all for the wonderful evening and wonderful food. This is an old school lone star that has kept to the original brand standards, with exceptional customer service/satisfaction, beautifully perfected food & drinks. It’s not our local but we will always make the extra trip for this location as they put the rest to shame. Special shout out to our waitress Kaiya - she was very attentive to not only our table but all in her section. Regularly checking in for drink top up’s, making sure everyone was happy with their food and that there was nothing missing for our experience. Thank you! See you in a few weeks for the next birthday dinner.

Saphire was absolutely amazing tonight, got straight to the point and made our experience truly unforgettable, I brought my brother for the first time and we both enjoyed the food and beverages provided, appreciate you Saphire for making our experience truly exceptional,
The service I received from the women on September 9, 2025, at approximately 8:20 p.m. was truly exceptional. The overall experience was enjoyable and hassle-free.
This place is great for dine in as well. Staff was kind and polite, great food and service

I hit the drive thu tonight and was served by Renee. She was cheerful and helpful and just really nice :) our meal was ready at the window as soon as we pulled up and it was hot and tasty and the fries were perfectly seasoned! Best KFC I've had in ages :)

Just finished up a great meal at KFC. The food was excellent—my chicken was cooked perfectly, juicy on the inside with that signature crispy crust. The service was equally impressive. The team was super friendly, and they made sure my order was right and served with a smile. It's great to see such a dedicated crew. Thanks for a great lunch 😋

Love Bacon Backfire! & Fries😊…..And i have had really good experiences which i have reviewed and had a reply from owner. But unfortunately I couldn’t do new post it only let me edit previous So this visit not good! No 🍅 no brie cheese and the chicken was so thin….so disappointed when i sat down and open box☹️ this is not a Bacon Backfire! Ball of Lettuce,Bacon,Chicken and a Splat of sauce.
Customer service was fantastic and I was given a decent rundown of the options available to me. Food was excellent as always and I'll be returning religiously.
We had top tier customer service from a worker named Jah! The food was amazing too. Someone give that guy a raise 🤌🏽🔥
Big Mac with no bun on top... I Called the Westgate Maccas and was adviced they will check and call back????

Tried this place over the weekend, and it turned out to be a good spot for the family. They have a nice variety of sushi, and ordering is really easy with the QR code system. The katsu was a standout – you could tell the meat was good quality. The main dishes came in generous portions, just right for sharing. There’s also a little freezer by the counter with Korean ice creams, which made for a perfect treat after our meal. Such a good place for lunch if you’ve been at the nearby library or mall with the family.

This sushi train spot in Westgate is always busy, especially with families and groups - it’s clearly a local favourite. I came here today with my parents, who love this place and already know all the best things to order. We started with the fried chicken nuggets, they were super crispy and a great way to kick things off. Ordering was easy with the QR code on the table. We got a good mix: some fresh salads, a sushi set, a sashimi set, and a big bowl of udon to share. The sashimi was probably the highlight - really fresh, nicely presented, and the pieces were surprisingly generous. We enjoyed every bite. The udon was also a perfect way to wrap up the meal - warm, hearty, and satisfying. The vibe here is really friendly and relaxed. It’s a bit pricier than some other sushi train places, but the quality makes it totally worth it. Definitely recommend if you're looking for solid sushi in West Auckland. + visited again and had a fabulous dinner (added more photos)

♿Found this place through Google search. Amazing place as you enter in. The first thing that caught my eyes👀 was the sushi dishes on a moving conveyor contraption. As I came in a waitress took me to a seating place for 2. We were given a menu to order.📋. Which you can order off menu and also the sushi is on a conveyor belt . Also order off code from your table. Now if you haven't been here before like myself I asked staff how the food items🍤🍙 on the conveyor belt worked🤔. We were told the price of each dish was colour coded according to each plate. Have a look at the video clips I shot.📲 The price tag was sitting on the coloured plates .. if a cheese cake slice was on purple plate then you would pay 💳for that amount when you leave to pay your bill. I ordered the sweet soy chicken and crunchy chicken platter. Delicious to the taste. There is a toilet there. #Wheelchair accessible venue. And definitely coming back.

We booked this place for my son’s birthday and had a great time. Yummy food and beautiful atmosphere. Whole staff were amazing. Always with a smile. Special thanks to Val. He made this so special moment for us. Thank you Val and all the staff. We will definitely come back soon and will recommend this place for everyone. Thanks again to all.

I attended a group pasta making class, which I can highly recommend. Our teacher/servers were Marissa and Rylee. The service was fast and efficient, the food excellent and the class so much fun. Excellent value and worth a visit.

Nice layout and food was delicious. I wasn't used to trying to order on my phone by scanning a QR code which I had to download an app for, but I got there in the end. Once you know how these things work I guess it gets easier. Would happily eat here again.

1st time tried the chicken and guacamole wrap (toasted) really like the taste, best wrap so far for me. Feels very light after you have it. Also combine with pineapple paradise juice. Really amazing combo, it costs me around $23, I think it's quite expensive but it's fine, if you want a healthy food you should pay a healthy amount 😉, but everyone should try this wrap, it also comes with salad bowls, there were 5-6 options of meal which either you can have it in a wrap or in a bowl. The staff were friendly and quick with their services, there were also options for allergies means if you have any kind of allergies you can mention to them. Hygiene level was top notch. Overall experience it really good. This store is inside the Northwest shopping mall with alot of parking options.
Would like to make a serious complaint… we were eating our take away, and my wife cut the inside of her mouth as there was a rasorblade in the food…. Don’t go there, they try to kill you!

I had Kimchi pork tonkotsu ramen for $20. Hardly any pork. Half an egg. Some kimchi. Just instant ramen with a tonne of raw sprouts. Not Japanese food at all. Soup base is pretty much instant noodle stuff. Pretty bad..
Terrible service. Lady serving was not nice at all. Not going back to Katsubi Northwest. Buns and rolls across had better service.

The woman running the counter seemed angry, was short and snappy with one word remarks, angrily demanding what I wanted, and then flicking my bowl across the counter and walking away. Because of this service, I won't be back.

This was our go to Thai place, Don’t get me wrong the food is very nice, I pretty much get the same thing every time, Yellow curry with no capsicum, and was usually correct and yummy. But they have gotten our order wrong 3 times in a row now. It’s really disappointing and inconvenient. Sometimes it’s the wrong curry and sometimes it’s wrong dish altogether. It seems there is a new girl on the phone orders and it’s been a struggle to get her to understand my order correctly. Tonight, they somehow added on a lot of extra food that I didn’t order and then they even tried to charge me $38, even when I said I just wanted one curry. They were not very nice about it either. It’s gotten so frustrating we are going to go elsewhere from now on unfortunately. I recommend not ordering on the phone and actually ordering inside the restaurant to make sure they actually have your order correct.

Wonderful service and food every time here. They have great sized meals, are accommodating to me being gluten free and are always so lovely on pick up. Definitely a staple for those take out nights ☺️

Yesterday, I stopped by this shop late in the day. The potatoes had already sold out, so the owner served pumpkin instead—and it turned out to be a real delight. It was pure roasted pumpkin: simple, wholesome, and absolutely delicious.
Great sushi, good environment and friendly staff.

Save your money and go to Pizza Hut instead. We got 2 x large butter chicken pizzas tonight and the base was super dry, tasted old, not fresh at all. The butter chicken flavouring isn’t what it used to be, feeling like our pizzas were thrown together last minute or perhaps reheated? Pretty disappointing considering you pay more at this place for a “decent” pizza, will go to Pizza Hut next time for guaranteed freshness.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 10 Stars! Best Roast shop out West. Delicious food, Generous portions, Beautiful service. The lovely owners are so sweet and friendly. We were the last customers and my young daughter wanted the crispy bits 🤭 they gave her all the ✨️ crispy bits ✨️ We've all had our dinner and the large pork meal that we got is still full and looks like it hasn't been touched 😂 second time here and we'll definitely be back for the sweet vibes xxxx No faults at all, the gravy could be a bit thicker but it's still delicious! Definitely give this place a try if you're thinking about it 🤤 worth every dollar spent. Sorry the photos don't do it justice, I was just too hungry to serve it up properly lol.

The pizza here has mostly been great at this branch. I’d like to especially commend the staff that worked tonight (Aug 22) for their service and quality of pizzas they make. They’re the reason people come back 👌🏼

Edit: (old review below) checked regularly and they now always have the base, thanks for taking the review seriously! Pizzas are nice and tasty and great value for money also like the deals! They are honestly ALWAYS out of San Francisco Crust, always. I regularly check other Pizza Hut stores around this location then and they always have this crust it’s just the Massey store that doesn’t seem to be capable of, I don’t know, ordering the right amount for the store or whatever the problem is. Very disappointing.

I do not post reviews but this was third and last time I ordered from this store. First time order arrived 50 minutes late, second arrived 20 minutes late with one of the pizzas just plain with no toppings and never received a email reply. Third time delivery been 55 minutes late, called the store multiple times to see if it's left the store with no one answering the phone. Three times I'm not going back do not recommend unless you go pick up from this store

First time I have visited Moon Knight. We ordered Butter Chicken rice and naan. Great service! Our meals were ordered to takeaway, very thoughtfully the containers (with lids on) with butter chicken were wrapped with glad wrap...thereby avoiding any potential leakage. The rice was divine, light and fluffy 👍 the chicken lovely and tender. $42 for two, great value.

Sorry but you guys have really dropped the ball. Used to be reasonable but now I see why you guys are always quiet. I got BBQ pork fried rice and all I got was a few dices of pork, very disappointing and dont think I'll be back. What do you call this?

I ordered to takeout the wait was a bit but the food wasn't too bad. Service was a little slow but maybe under staffed at the time. Not too sure. It's nothing like other chicken places such as KFC or Chicking but it's chicken. Try it at least once.

Food is tasty, store is clean and spacious. Not a fan of the gravy it tastes like the rich gravy you get in sachets from the supermarket. Such a shame because the chips are really good and a yummy gravy to dip them in would be awesome. The chicken burgers are nice but only had a tiny slice of tomato and a tiny slice of red onion in my chicken deluxe burger, I would've loved a decent portion of each it would've really made a huge difference and took this burger to the next level. The chicken is delicious! So is the coleslaw. The nibbles taste crunchy and fresh but lack in flavor in my opinion. Despite this I still love this store and will keep coming back. The owner seems lovely. Lots of parking and plenty of options for drinks. Oh and my kids are dying to know, what does TNC stand for ? 😅 The Nicest Chips? The Nicest Chicken? Please let us know 😂
Delicious food and generous portions! My takeaway was fresh, flavorful, and perfectly spiced. Highly recommend!

Delicious meals, filling portions for women, but for men , still hungry. Had to buy extra sushi, to fill my appetite, although half of the sushi may have been sitting there for a while, a bit stale. Unfortunately, don't like giving bad reviews. But no hurry to go back.
Ordered a Hawaiian BK chicken burger & it was missing the pineapple & the bacon, night team must’ve been lazy as drive through was empty.

Good food and good portions, although a bit on the expensive side. I found it interesting how some of the cuisine was southern Chinese and the menu translation was all in Mandarin, so unsure about how Vietnamese this place is? Nevertheless, we had a good experience. Keep in mind that condiments are all self serve and you don’t have much interaction with your waiter/waitress - they hand you a sheet and you write the numbers down for which meals you want. Highly efficient but some patrons might not like that format. The meal in the photos was $45. We did not get any drinks
Delicious food and very friendly staff! We didn't have to wait too long for our food to come and it was worth the price.

Portions are on the smaller end. Service is pretty quick considering how many customers can be seated at once. Staff are attentive and friendly, good service. I recommend the Chicken Laksa Noodles dish.

Really great pool hall, extremely well priced to play pool, the food is a bit on the pricier side, but it is really high quality and tasty. Had the $31 burger which was never going to be the best value, but it was very nice. Had the ribs last time and the pizza too, all very nice. Some of the best thick cut fries I’ve had. Really great place, a local favourite.

I ordered a bowl of fries and a sprite, Daym I must say those fries were crunchy and soft in the inside. My food came out piping hot and my drink came out almost instantly even with the pub being full with 30+ people. My server Charlotte was also very nice and helpful.

Coffee a bit sour, froth notlr stable neither fluffy. Srevice slow, pastry a bit overpriced, for the size and taste. Seems that their coffee machine lacks cleaning or tuning ans staff needs trainig on how to work with milk. Owerall it's below average expectations.
A very cute cafe at Westgate. The staff were super friendly and welcoming, great vibe and the coconut mochas were delicious! I’ve found my new coffee spot when i come to westgate now ☕️🪴
Hot chocolate & caramel latte was tasty 😋🤌🏻 very kind service and caring!

A nice comfortable coffee shop you can enjoy to sit and order a breakfast or lunch ..takeaway or eat in. The food is fresh and delicious to the taste. Table seating indoors or out. Toilets available and wheelchair accessible also to the bathroom. Parking is out side store or street parking
Vibrant customer service by the team really felt welcomed by the lady serving us ... great atmosphere good background music and wonderful crowd...

A friend recommended Kokodak to me so I thought I'd check it out. It's pretty solid! I ordered the chicken burger combo. I got the honey soy flavor of chicken which is soo yum, chips, and a drink for $15, pretty good price for a combo. You can order either using the online kiosk tablet or in person with the employee. Personally I'd go in person to eat/pickup my order, that guarantees proper hot food. I did check the reviews before coming and they're right, be prepared to wait. There was only one member of staff when I was in. They were doing both online and in person orders - so being a little patient goes a long way. I waited maybe 15m before my order was served, which I think is a pretty standard wait time for cooking and preparing meals. The chicken itself is amazing, really juicy and generous with the flavoring too. The chips are just normal, not really seasoned, but a fair portion so I'm not complaining. My burger bun was a little burnt on the underside, but with the lettuce and generous sauce it wasn't noticeable taste wise. Pricing is something to consider though- if you want to order two or more items you're looking at $25+. It's good if you're just popping out for a lunch for yourself. Atmosphere is ok- there's both cushion and chair seating, but it does lean towards a smaller, cosier vibe. I'd say theyd be able to seat about 10 or so people in the space max. Overall, the chicken is well worth waiting for!

Kokodak Chicken is basically KFC for Korean Fried Chicken. I ordered a Soy garlic Chicken Combo($17.99). It comes with boneless chicken, fries and a 420ml bottle of drink. The restaurant is tiny, so I ordered takeaway and ate it at nearby Northwest Shopping Centre. Ordering + It’s your usual KFC/Macca’s experience. Order at the kiosk, get the recipe, wait for your number and pick up at the counter. Picking your autistic seat + I ate at nearby Northwest Shopping Centre food court. This food court is pretty chaotic but the window seat is pretty nice. Check my video. Water & Napkins + Mall drinks are all horribly overpriced. That’s why I ordered a combo. + Napkins and utensils are all self-service. If you order takeaway don’t forget to take them. Food - 8.5/10 + Portion is okay. Chicken is fresh and flavourful, better than KFC. Service - 9/10 Overall I will give this restaurant 5 stars. 🤓👍

Very nice Korean fried chicken. Had boneless Seasoned Chicken (양념치킨) and Honey Soy Chicken. (couldn’t take photo coz too busy eating them lol) My whole family enjoyed them including 8 & 10 year olds. Would love to try other flavours next time. The staff was friendly and the environment was good.
Can’t even complain the best Pho I’ve ever had and all the other food was top tier as well. If I could I would give this place 10 stars lol. The lady was very kind too and the food came fast😋
The food was really good and good portion, so tasty. Matcha latte is good 👍 lovely manager

We hadn’t been to the Westgate Coffee Club so just stopped in for breakfast. Had the big breakfast and an ice coffee. As usual generous servings at TCC franchises so it was good to see the consistency at different locations. They had a meal deal which was a bonus second meal half price. Service was great had a friendly server. Food came out hot and presented well. Good to see TCC didn’t disappoint.

Great food, great friendly service, highly recommend. Had the crispy pork and the spicy sizzling chicken. The crispy pork was juicy and crispy, perfect. The spicy sizzling chicken was well balanced, tender and tasty. We met Hong (his kitchen), he will tailor the food to your spiciness. You also get a free/complementary pot of green tea. Try Hong’s Kitchen, you will not be disappointed.

Great food and exceptional service. The crispy pork was tender and crispy. The sizzling spicy chicken was really delicious, it could have been spicier and also too much onion in it. The taste was delicious though. This restaurant in on the expensive side but the portions were really generous. We would definitely go back again to try the rest of the menu. The service was really really good 👌

Food: by far the worst sushi I've ever had in Auckland. Totally overpriced for the quality and quantity. Think again especially if you are after nigiri (refer to the photo, super thin salmon and ugly shaped rice) or their order-to-cook meal. Price: totally overpriced for the quality. I think their 30 percent off discount at the end of the day is right price. Service: it's located at the foodcourt. not expecting a restaurant level of service so okay It's shame that they don't have other competitor (sushi restaurant) in the mall. It's not worth a trip to have a pack of sushi here. I hope they will improve in the near future.

Flame who served us at Smart Sushi was absolutely amazing. She went above and beyond for us to help us get the sushi we needed and was so kind and helpful to me and my kids. Thank you for such amazing service Flame.

Omg if I could give 0 stars I would!! Just came here with my husband and kids through the drive through and ordered a large loaded fries combo and a large spicy Tex wrap combo with a small 3 piece tender combo. We confirmed with the lady twice before the window and at the window that we wanted large combos except for the 3 piece tenders and she said yes. She gave us our food but started filling our drinks with small cups and my husband asked her “didn’t we order large”? She then says no you ordered small after we just confirmed with her twice that it was large?? Then she asks what drink I wanted I said raspberry she fills both with coke??🤨 I would’ve corrected her if my baby wasn’t crying but how can you do the exact opposite of what we’ve ordered and confirm aswell? We also get home and the loaded fries combo was not complete! We didn’t get any chicken with it and the tex wrap wasn’t spicy and was filled with mostly chicken crumbs and salad😂 it was also all small😠🙄 might aswell have just asked you what we wanted to have for dinner lol

We ordered the Mexican burger combo, but the bun was cold and the honey bun had no honey or syrup. There were no straws at the drink station, and the store itself was quite dirty. The atmosphere felt very cold and unwelcoming, with no proper heating facility. Disappointing experience overall.
We ordered no spicy at all but they still serve as spicy They said its only put a wrong sticker but when we took a bite its still spicy

First time and pleased with the friendly greeting. Placed my order and throughly enjoyed our chicken on chips & my sons snack box. Just look how crispy the chicken is. So good will be back again. Thank you again

The lady serviced me with homemade old chicken drumsticks with chicken skins in it. The chicken was hard to chew and tastes terrible. I wish I was able to make a u-turn to take the food back to the shop. Anyone goes Costco never ever eat from this shop. Waste of money and their food is bad for health.

My second time coming here and both times have been amazing. Lovely customer service very friendly and welcoming and the food is fire! Very saucy and yum. The baklava is something I Love as well as a sweet treat, it’s a good balance with a yum meal. I Will definitely always order each time I come to Auckland 🤌🏾

Ate here couple weeks ago and haven't stopped thinking about it since. I ordered a kebab which was very well portioned meat/salad which was fresh.. oftern find the meat dry at most kebab places unlike this one! Service was lovely and chatty, a shame it's in the food court because it would benefit more stand-alone atmosphere wise.

I had a chicken laksa yesterday at Harbour Eats and sadly was disappointed. I love a great laksa but the broth lacked flavour , depth and was quite watery. Perhaps a bad day hopefully they will improve the broth.
Really nice food here! Recommended pork ribs, yummy! The meal was huge, so much meat that it couldn't even be eaten.

Food: your usual local McDonald's. The overall quality of food especially fries are below average. Fries are usually soggy or overcooked. Service: the store manager and other frontline staffs need a serious training on people skills. Happy Meal: Don't expect to receive a current toy as usual. They have heaps of "wash up" stock and will give you an excuse of "while stocks last".
Food was amazing but the customer service was terrible and they told me to hurry up and stop wasting

Prices are good. Food is good. Male has good service, tries to serve fast and he is kind and apologetic, but the coffee making can slow service. Female doesn't serve but just cooks. Really good bakery overall.
Got sushi from here this morning. It was absolutely crap! Seemed old and soggy. I wouldn't waste my money here again.

LOOKING FOR ONE OF THE BEST KOREAN RESTAURANT OUT in WEST AUCKLAND? Look no further. Actual photo of the food that was served to us. Super good. Taste amazing plus the service was THE BEST! The owner is very nice and friendly. Youll leave the place happy and satisfied. Thats for sure.
Beautiful Ck, potato delicious, I supervise we have such good roast shop in this area. Good price , good food and good service. My soon love it since first bite. Fire chicken is my favorite.

Ordered 2 pork roasts and asked for extra gravy and apple sauce. He said "pay extra"! OK then. Get it.home and there were stuff all gravy and sauce. Also no kumara and only cou0le of potatoes which tasted old. Never ever going back! A waste of just under $40

It's okay I've been a few times not to often so this review is not based on a one time experience. The $8 dollar special with either chicken on rice or chicken on chips is good. I got the mixed chicken and lamb on rice today, was nice. I still think portion sizes are not the best, the lamb always tastes hard not soft and tender like it should be. I feel the old guy here tries his best but at times he gets tired and you can see that in the way he talks and serves. He's nice and friendly otherwise. All in all it's okay but I'd rather go to the kebab place inside Northwest mall they do a decent feed for the price as well.
Very disappointed with the lamb roll ,hardly any lamb or gravy, and the meat was super dry. Definitely not worth the price, and I won’t be returning.

I ordered 1 chicken and 2 potatoes, and I was also looking at ordering some nibbles. I already knew the price because it was written there, but the guy who was waiting for me looked a bit annoyed. Just as I was about to ask him something, without even listening, he suddenly told me the price. He looked and sounded irritated, so I felt uncomfortable asking anything. I was debating whether to buy $5 or $8, but then he suddenly put them all into one bag. I was watching, and then he said, "That'll be $11.80." I was stunned, and he told me to pay together with the chicken and potatoes I had ordered earlier. Even after paying, I was still in shock and just left. He was extremely unfriendly and I was really taken aback. I think they should ask how many pieces a customer wants instead of basically forcing them to buy more. On top of that, the drumsticks I bought were disappointing, and the nibbles were way too small.

I’m giving it 4 Stars cos it’s beats all the other local eateries selling fish and chips and Chinese takeaway in the whole TAT Peninsula. We are new to the area and this is the best we have tried so far! Thank you 🙏🏽
Burgers and chips are alright. Sweet and sour anything is 1/10. Very little meat, batter undercooked. Not worth the price.

I recently visited Neil Cafe and bar and was truly impressed by the outstanding quality of my meal also a very reasonable price especially considering the quality of the ingredients. I had a slow cooked pork belly on mash with fresh salad. The meal was very generous in size and I was sorry when I had finished despite being unable to eat anything else cos I was very full! Seriously it's my favorite place to eat now.

I really don’t recommend the corn fritters. They’re not actually made of corn but mostly a mix of vegetables like carrots, peas, and cabbage. So why advertise them as corn? I even found a piece of cauliflower or broccoli stem that was impossible to chew. I couldn’t finish it - very disappointing and a waste of money. The random sauces didn’t help either. We used to love this place, but not anymore..

I discovered this amazing dessert shop, and honestly, it’s one of the best I’ve ever tried in my life. The first thing I had was a financier topped with yakgwa (a traditional Korean honey cookie). It had the classic rich, buttery flavor of a traditional financier, perfectly balanced with the unique flavor and chewy texture of the yakgwa. And guess what? They even sell the famous Dubai chocolates that went viral in Korea last year — they make such a perfect gift! Lastly, I bought their Basque cheesecake for my friend’s birthday recently, and wow… it was even better than any “famous” cheesecake shop here in New Zealand. So rich, so fresh, and just unforgettable. My kids are absolutely loved with their “Chewy Cookies,” so I always make sure to keep a stash at home. I really hope this place stays around for a long, long time.
The sides are delicious, the fish cakes are a definite favorite, the lady who works there is an angel ,

Hands down our favourite local takeaways. The quality of food is brilliant (burgers are my favourite) and the staff are lovely. They are really busy on Fridays at peak times (because it’s so good) but staff are always super friendly and helpful. We make sure to order around 5pm on a Friday for shorter wait times. We’d prefer to enjoy dinner from an owner-operator place like PL rather than a chain restaurant any day!

Burger and fries were genuinely delicious. Think this place has the best burger and fries I've had in Auckland. Pizza was really good too but the burger and fries were just really standout. Really awesome staff too! Thank you so much :)
I have tried every fish and chip place on the peninsula and I yet keep coming back to John Chans , the chips are golden and tasty , the hot dog on a stick are good too!

Amazing addition to Te Atatu Peninsula! Great coffee, awesome food. I had the waffles with fruit and the fruit was so fresh and juicy. Service was prompt and friendly. They were eager to help when needed. They have really hit the floor running! Will be back again 😊

I would not recommend their battered fish. Went there on 2 different occasions hoping for a good battered fish, because my regular takeaway was closed. Unfortunately same old watered down battered mixture and not crispy. Chips 5/10. Place needs a hygiene inspection.
Beautiful fresh fish. Staff helpful. Yum kumera chips.

Chunky Chook makes some of the best crunchy fried chicken in the West! Reminds me of other chicken places in town, but closer to home (and just as good, if not better!). Their chicken is really juicy and tender, with a really crisp battered crust. I do enjoy the flavours they bring to both the chicken patties (especially their spicy chicken burger) and the chips. Subtle but noticeable. Always a great choice for lunch or dinner, and the amazing team there make it worthwhile.
The food was good. Staff were friendly. Big garden to sit outside. Inside is cozy. Heaps of parking outside.

Mulan is the go-to spot for authentic Singaporean and Malaysian flavours. Their Char Kway Teow is perfectly stir-fried with prawns and Chinese sausage, capturing that signature smoky wok flavour. The Mother-in-Law’s Mee Goreng is tangy and packs a punch, while the Chicken Satay is tender and comes with a rich peanut sauce (we had two servings)! Owner Carol is hands-on and incredibly accommodating, creating an almost fine-dining experience with a personal touch. The ambiance is comfortable yet refined, making it a great spot for both casual and special occasions. Love how the whole restaurant sang a birthday song for a cute kid who’s turning 8 at the time of our visit. Make sure to reserve in advance! The restaurant fills up fast due to its tasty menu. If you're craving authentic Southeast Asian cuisine, Mulan is a must-try!

Last night my friend and I went to Mulan for dinner. I have eaten here several times when I used to live in New Zealand, but I moved away and I am currently here visiting. It wasn't a question of "if" we would have dinner at Mulan, it was "when" we would have dinner at Mulan. The ambiance at Mulan is cozy with a variety of seating options ranging from chairs, stools or the bench seats with plush cushions to sit back on. Aesthetically, the decorations are beautiful and inviting and the service feels genuinely friendly and relaxed. I ordered the market fish, which looked and tasted amazing with the green mint infused sauce. My friend ordered the chicken curry which looked and tasted fantastic. As a starter we had the spicy pork bun. All of the food was delivered in a timely manner and tasted delicious. The owner of the restaurant came to talk to us at the table. She is a friendly, relaxed, personable woman who has established a unique place to have a meal whether it is a family with kids, an evening out with friends or a dinner out alone.

I had a great meal here last night - their Nonya chicken curry with extra roti and a nicely spicy sambal. The curry was delicious, with plenty of tender chicken and a few small pieces of potato. They have a few craft beers, so I had a McLeods Paradise Pale Ale (one of my favourite beers) on the side. The restaurant is nicely appointed with attentive staff. A wee girl was in for her birthday - the staff coopted the diners to sing her happy birthday. My present to her was remaining silent.

Lovely spot. We were seated quickly and the staff were very friendly and we were served without delay. Menu was extensive and great options. Food came quickly and for the lost part was great for the price point. The penang was excellent and roti was the best I've had! And we are very fussy. The prawn salad was good, but not amazing. Overall a lovely experience

We went there quite early as we didn't make a reservation. First time visiting this place. The spicy level was just right for me. Dishes were rich of flavours and not salty. The place was getting busy when we were about to finish.

I loved this place a few years ago returned after a long time and was very disappointed. I ordered a whole steamed snapper. it tasted as if it had been reheated in the microwave several times. it was dry, not nice to eat at all waste of $39. I won't be returning.
02/09 ordered seafood Tom kha gai... Nearly two hours later... Food had not arrived (just one dish) had to call and say don't worry as was so late but had still paid with delivery $34.00
A great yacht club premises. Has everything: history, trophies, photographs, cafe, restaurant, meeting rooms, bar. A must visit. Mostly for members only, but Lighthouse Cafe open to public.

Was very easy to place an order online and pay through that. Food was made in time with the pickup time, though it was a little disappointing to see AI pictures on the wall. Definitely could have just added photos of your food. The food itself the butter chicken curry was really nice, sizing was amazing considering the price being on the lower side. Garlic naan also tasted really nice with the garlic coming through nicely. Overall 9.5/10 just please replace the ai photos you’ve got up, it’ll definitely make it look 100x better.

We celebrated my grandmother’s 88th birthday here for lunch, and we couldn’t have been more impressed. From start to finish, the meal was full of thoughtful touches that made the occasion truly special. Our waiter was exceptional - kind, attentive, and caring - even while the restaurant was short-staffed. He checked in regularly and responded thoughtfully to all our needs. My grandmother had ordered a small plate, expecting it to be enough, and the waiter had kindly warned us it might be too little. When we mentioned the possibility of ordering something extra for her, he soon returned with a small bowl of chips, made especially for her, on the house. The care extended to my sister, who has a disability. The waiter remembered her name and served her meal with extra attention, making her feel valued and acknowledged. He also went above and beyond with the desserts, pairing a suitable liqueur for my grandmother and giving her a generous serving, all while being warm and attentive without ever being intrusive. The food itself was delicious. Everyone enjoyed their meals—my dad especially loved the pork Milanese—and I highly recommend the chocolate mousse for dessert. Overall, it was scrumptious food served in a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere. We will definitely be returning!

Thank you to the wonderful staff who made this the go-to lunch spot for my grandma and I on our weekly catchups. We appreciate you so much for always being so kind and welcoming to us, having a chat and a laugh each time we came in, and not to mention shaking up the best margaritas. 5 weeks without pay for renovations, you’ve lost some really great people Wishing them them the absolute best with their futures, and we will find a new place to have our weekly lunch and cocktails

We dined at First Mates yesterday for Fathers Day and it was exquisite as always. The service and ambience was incredible and there was some delicious food on offer. We tried some of the Father’s Day special including the yummy Seafood Chowder pie. Highly recommend the sushi/nigiri too, some of the best ever. Will be back again soon!

Great pizzas!! I’ve already been back twice just for their mushroom and salami pizza. I keep telling myself I should try something new, but honestly, it’s so good that I’m happy to order it again and again. Side note: the drinks are just as impressive!

Cozy vibe, pasta was al dente, flavorful and rich. The beef cheek and mushrooms were pack with umani. What a savory delight. The aranchini was good as well but nothing to rave about. Would definitely go again to try the other items on the menu.
Really delicious burgers, soft buns and tasty smash patties. Friendly and fast service. Decent serving of fries. Zachary is a legend 🤙🏼
This is the best value place for Chicken katsudon. Chicken on rice. At $10 for a small size (more than adequate for most people) its the best value lunch.

We were on our way home to the North shore and decided to stop into this place for a follow up visit. Oh my gosh, the fish tacos and fried halloumi at Fishsmith are absolutely amazing! They really know how to make fish and chips shine.

Beautiful dinner spot for your Friday. The service was excellent, with our server being super attentive and accommodating. The food was also delicious. We had the burrata, crudo and calamari to start -- all great starters. For the main we had the fish of the day risotto which was the star, along with the venison dish, also a winner. We'll be back for sure

Super cosy dinner spot with lovely and accommodating staff. The food was genuinely faultless. Highly, highly recommend the Crudo… turned my raw fish hating friends into believers. It was so good I had to order another plate of it. My main was a Carbonara which was excellent. My friends thoroughly enjoyed their pizzas too. Would come here again in a heartbeat.
Been going here for awhile, and it’s by far the best sushi I’ve ever had, and the owners are so nice! Really incredible small business I highly recommend supporting!

Had the yummiest Udon Noodle Soup today! The teriyaki chicken was cooked perfectly and full of flavour, the soup was delicious and the perfect thing to warm me up on a winter day. The sushi is good too.

Authentic fresh and super tasty Indian food. Me and family loved the service provided by Aleena who was friendly and attentive. We all loved the Hot N Sour Soup, Chicken Lolly Pop which is so hard to make at home, followed by delicious Chicken Triple sczhuan. One of my favorite Indian place in Auckland. Even the one in Mount eden and 3 kings are great.

I went here with my family and we were very pleased with the food and the cleanliness of the restaurant. They got the spice levels right and it tasted delicious. Big thanks to the team and especially Mahak for great customer service checking up on us throughout our meal. The garlic naan was lovely.

I ordered spicy stir-fried spaghetti with chicken. The first time, they forgot to add the chicken. The second time, the chicken was undercooked. They apologized and said they would make it again. Honestly, the proper service should have been not to charge me for that dish at all. But I waited to see how the restaurant would take responsibility. In the end, their solution was just to remake the dish. It turned out to be a meal that completely ruined my experience.
Picked up a takeaway for $41, half a plastic of chicken and a rice dish. Kinda disappointed for the money.

Large table arrangements make it a great meeting spot for a dozen or more people. Great staff serving the tables. Plus it’s dog and kids friendly! McLeod’s Paradise craft beer on tab & very large sized pizzas with excellent crust and topics, all make it an excellent choice to come here for leisure or business. Only downside is the parking in the area, depending on time and date can be challenging, lots easier when you come by foot, ferry, bus or scooter ;)

Saw this restaurant on the ground floor of Ferry Building and thought it’d good to try it. At the end of the dinner we felt it was a great choice. From the entree to the mains it was a great feast all the way. We had the French onion soup (which was almost like a stew) mushroom soup (which was authentically mushroom soup not canned type) and the wagyu beef tartare (which was SO different from what I had before. It was served on a bone with a potato fritter. Yum! Then the lamb platter came and we had a feast of tender and delicious lamb ribs, rump and loin! 😋😋😋 If I have a say to return I’d do so when we leave Auckland. 😆
Received the best service in recent years. Food is also quite good. $30 a dozen of oysters, what a steal.

Our party of 9 had the set menu here and wow, very impressed. Quality and friendly service from our waiter Nadia and all other servers was prompt and knowledgeable, especially with wines. To finish we had the cheese platter which was a nice finish.

We had a good time here and would definitely recommend the desserts and beer paddle. As for my burger fans I’d rate the Wagyu cheeseburger with added bacon ⭐️⭐️⭐️ It was yummy, but missing something and the bun disintegrated before I could finish the burger. Top tip: book this place on FirstTable! Not a member? Sign up with the code: rebeccaa264 for $5 free credit towards your first booking.

When my mom said she wanted seafood for her birthday dinner...we immediately thought of Neptune, and again they did not disappoint. Food was amazing, service immaculate and the owner Peter was an absolute joy to deal with. It's always a winning combination. We'll definitely be back again and again.

Our last night in Auckland we wanted “Fish & Chips” for dinner for 3. As we were staying in the apartments above we decided to dine here as the weather wasn’t the greatest but the restaurant looked welcoming. I’m not a seafood eater but will have fish (Battered). After 9yrs since I’d been back in NZ and (probably can count on one hand how many fish I’ve had in that time)…well I have to say..AMAZING!! absolutely AMAZING!!.. 3 mains cooked to perfection and “melt in your mouth” with the perfect batter and accompanied with the perfectly cooked chips and fresh green salad. Also ordered a creamy fettuccine dish and a pizza as well and they also were mmmmmwahhh. Thank you Peter for an outstanding dinner and high compliments to the chef. Highly recommended from Kel & Suz of Coochiemudlo Island Oz.

AAAs all round Melt n your mouth battered fish , Chicken and mushroom creamy pasta is YUM , the pizza and espresso martini ! Great service from the owner , one pleasant lovely Man . Waterfront, looks over towards the harbour bridge . On our fav list in Auckland and that’s from Australian Family also! Highly recommend *
Came here twice during my trip to Auckland, everytime its so good, price affordable and food is really tasty, boss is very friendly too
Delicious, generous portions, incredibly quick and very friendly staff!! And they gave me free miso soup! Will be back

Had a great dinner celebrating my friend’s birthday there. The atmosphere was superb-quiet, cozy, and with the perfect ambiance for a relaxed evening. We tried the Restaurant Month August 2025 menu, and the prices were reasonable for such a fine restaurant. Our three different entrées all looked beautiful and were thoughtfully presented. The eye fillet was good. What really stood out, though, were the desserts. Each one was delicious, which makes me think they have a good pâtissier on their team. Would definitely love to go back!

What a excellet find, I saw online they are now dog friendly. So Edie and I checked it out at 9am on a Saturday for breakfast.... it deserved to be packed, but there was plenty of room, with relaxed sofa area, booths and tables. Lot's to choose from for breakfast.. I got a classic style breakfast and it's one of the best i have had for a long time.

Absolutely amazing dining experience at DeBretts Kitchen. The lamb rump was one of the best I’ve ever had—perfectly seasoned and cooked to perfection. The portion size was generous, and the couscous complemented the lamb beautifully. The staff were incredibly friendly, and the customer service was top-notch. Highly recommend this place for a fantastic meal.

Last night, after dinner was done, we went on a wild goose chase to find the holy grail of coffee and dessert spots - and boy, did we hit the mother lode with this place! The coffee was off the charts and the apple crumble was so divine it should have its own fan club - the chef is a culinary rock god! We also fell head over heels for the staff's super friendly vibes, especially Pranav, who's probably the nicest human on the planet. We ended up coming back for breakfast today and it was totally worth it - we can't recommend this place enough and we're already counting down the days until our next visit!
Just popped in, but plenty of tables available. I had slow cooked beef cheek, very tender nice meals. Staff were friendly even though they got 1 dish wrong

Came here early to get their fry up, black pudding again meant this was an awesome win. No alternative milk for coffee but did say he was happy to go next door and get a coffee and bring it back Large menu, great atmosphere in an old hotel that’s 130 years old. Food wise, great big plate. Sausages were amazing and the hash browns luxurious.

Nice restaurant in the heart of Auckland. Food was good and personnel were attentive and fast. Not very easy to find a table but worth it. Drinks are good too. Definitely a must for a night in the city
Huge , juicy and delicious NZ Green Mussels. I Still love it after 36 years. Check out their daily specials too. Friendly staff too.

Would say it is the best Sals experience I've had in Auckland, got really great customer service even tho it was late and close to closing, the pizza was cooked perfect and had a great crust that some places don't have since they rush it and give it to you before it had been in the oven long enough but not this place. Definitely recommend this place over Queen Street where we had to wait around 5 minutes to even get our order taken

Went in for a quick bite to eat on my lunch break. Ordered 1 slice and a pepperoni pinwheel. I was forgotten about and when I finally did receive my order pizza slice was hot but the pepperoni wheel was cold on the inside and the 2 complimentary garlic knots were cold. Ran out of time on my lunch break and had to get back to work quickly so didnt have time to raise another point of dissatisfaction Disappointed - won't be back. 😔
Perfect coffee and food, I enjoyed my two breakfasts during my stay in Auckland! And the staff here is super nice 😊 love the vibe 👏👏👏

Been a favourite of mine consistently for over a year! No one does a citrus tart or a chocolate cake as well as them! And lets not even get to the signature club sandwich!!! Always have a good time in whichever coffee club i go to, in fact we plan our drives according to the locations of coffee clubs as they make for ideal pit stops!

So bad. Checked online for the $10 curry available on Saturdays and Sundays so we came to the restaurant for dinner. The owner came and said they don't do $10 curry in the night time but he will make one for us which would be half rice and half curry which was good. Reached home and the curry was not even half the container, it was more rice and less curry. The preparation time was 10 mins for 2 curry and 2 roti and it was ready in 2 mins as if it was just out of the fridge and heated and given, roti was uncooked. The quality of food has dropped significantly in these years. Also sharing photo of curry and roti. Sorry won't be back!

We been there for dinner and food looks it was yawn and they served us in less than 5 min after we ordered. The starter taste was like they microwaved and served us. We ordered 4 curries and all of them taste like same recipe. Sorry not going there again. 👎
It’s 2:30 p.m., and they refuse to serve customers even though they claim to close at 3 p.m.

Felt that as pakeha we weren’t welcome as 4 tables of Chinese who came after us ordering were served first with steaming food and then we waited over 1/2 hours to get one vegetable dish and quarter of an hour later our meat dish then a quarter of an hour later our rice dish. The food was nice but we could have gone to the night market across the road and got similar food without the feeling we weren’t welcome. Sad really.

Georgia was an absolutely incredible host, we loved her so much. Bottomless was a great experience with her and we reccomend you book your experience with her. She made us feel welcome and was very hospitable. Thanks to all the other staff who helped out too! We loved bottomless brunch here! 🫶

The food was nice here. Customer service was ok because I wanted sit outside but the manager said not allowed to sit outside. Can see the customers sitting outside. Very bad. Atmosphere was nice. Customer service very slow here. The lady at the front just talking and doing nothing.

Amazing Asian fusion we ordered Korean fried chicken and got recommended some belly pork bao buns for starters and kung pao chicken and pad kee mao ‘drunken noodles’ for mains. All the food was fantastic.
Loved the place , great view,nice variety of food selection,all was great , service was a bit slow though.

Super quick service, the place was over half-full yet food & drinks came much quicker than expected. Great portion sizes for price. Food was absolutely delicious & flavoured well, not bland. Highly recommend this place, me & my partner had an amazing time, staff super friendly & professional also. Recommend; - Pizza - Smash Burger - Chicken Parma ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Booked a table here for a catch up with friends on a Saturday afternoon. I'd recommend booking in advance as tables always get snapped up because who doesn't love a rooftop on a sunny day. Best spot is on the deck area - enjoy the view with a beverage or three and some nibbles. The menu was okay but we just wanted some light nibbles and ordered the cheese pizza, calamari and the cheese board. Would get the cheese board again for sure. For dinks, I had my usual (CC&Dry with no ice). I used the QR to place all my orders which is quite handy and does have a field for customisations/notes. Music got a bit boring in the end so my friends and I left. Stools are quite uncomfortable but that's the story with all stool seating. Wait staff are very nice and the location is excellent.

Came in early and was allowed to sit down and relax before ordering, beautiful assortment of drinks available and the food was lovely. Food is priced very well and the location is just perfect. Our server was very welcoming and tended to our needs. Food came out pretty quickly and was lovely and warm. Definitely worth coming back !

Choose this restaurant near the harbour for our first dinner in Auckland. It’s a bit pricey especially for their wines but the food is great. From the oysters to the dessert of petite four they were all good and tasty. The ambience is excellent as it’s just next to the harbour. Though it’s a seafood restaurant the braised short rib we had was very tasty and tender. When we return to Auckland before flying home perhaps we’ll return for other items.
Decent service. $10 Champagne and $30/dozen oysters no regret

Went here with a colleague for dinner while we were in Auckland for work. I enjoy Mexican so we thought we would give this place a try. Lovely staff - all really attentive. The wine was nice and we got served a lot of food the price really - however the flavour did lack a little for a Mexican restaurant if I’m honest. I did enjoy mine to an extent, it was all fresh and served very quickly which was good - but I likely wouldn’t dine here again unfortunately. Located in a great spot for people watching though and the cocktails did look good!

Hola (hi), we went out for dinner with another couple and ordered some entrees to share plus our main dishes. The service was great and also the restaurant has a nice atmosphere. The food presentation is appealing, but the flavour/taste is okay. Nothing outstanding. Good place to be around the Viaduct, but don't expect a fancy and tasty dine-in.

I was so excited to learn about a Filipino restaurant in Auckland that has gotten good reviews, and so I couldn’t wait to eat there. The experience was disappointing. It did not meet my expectations. My husband ordered the pork spare ribs and he said it was so dry and overcooked. I ordered the Java rice - it tasted okay. I also ordered the pork liempo- it was bland. It was supposed to come with a side of atchara but that was absent. When I asked the server, she simply said they were out of it. If she had informed me that earlier then I would’ve ordered a different dish. The only dish that tasted good was the laing, and this is the only reason I’m giving the restaurant 2 stars. Service was poor. Once our food was served, the server didn’t check up on us to see if we needed anything, or to refill our glasses with water. I had high expectations of this restaurant based on recent reviews. Unfortunately it fell short which is too bad.

Masarap yan! Great location and atmosphere. Beautifully decorated and fun music always playing, the food and service were amazing! Great for big groups or celebrations, highly recommend ordering the family group meals-- worth every penny! Staff was so lovely and accommodating. Perfect place for a birthday dinner with friends, if you're craving Filipino food, this tastes just like home. The beef lumpia made me tear up, tastes just like my Mama's and Lola's! So many options too, something for everyone and every dish we had was delicious. What are you waiting for???

We were lucky enough to have Celestia as our bartender. She is incredibly talented!! We have found our new martini bartender in Auckland, and our new favourite cocktail spot. I also couldn’t fault the food or the service either. This would be the place that I would bring a discerning group of diners.

On the evening of 16 September 2025, I visited McDonald’s Britomart with my father, who urgently needed to use the restroom. I explained it was an emergency and that I would purchase food immediately. The manager (female, ~160cm, Asian, wearing white glasses) was rude and impatient, refusing to give us the code and only reluctantly tearing off another customer’s receipt. I later realized the restroom code is the same for everyone and easily accessible. I still purchased food as promised. This was the first time I have experienced such cold and inhumane customer service in New Zealand.
Coffee is strong, but chocolate syrup used in mocha is sour and not very enjoyable
Absolutely delicious!!!! The foods, the wine & cocktails, the staff, the deco and vibes, excellent! Love everything about it!
Good burgers. The music is a bit loud for talking, and it's a bit expensive, but perhaps not compared to other burger places these days.

The menu impresses with its variety. Everyone will find a burger to their liking here: from classic beef variants to author's masterpieces with unusual combinations of ingredients. Vegetarians will not stay hungry either, for them there are burgers with vegetable meat and vegetables.

Cafe on main road through Devonport. Friendly host, prompt service and most importantly the food was great. We had the NZ fish 🐟 and chips which was served with veges and tartare sauce. Chips were crunchy and fish was cooked spot on Only downside was tables are a little too close alongside, so wouldn't go if you this isn't to your fancy. Parking is limited by there is plenty down by the ferry wharf and in surrounding streets
Pizza was average. The chicken on the Cranberry Chicken pizza was grey… Calamari salad was amazing. Server was great and patient. Seems like a busy spot and prices of most meal reflect that.

I'm giving Portofino 5 stars all around as we absolutely loved the food, service, and atmosphere during our holiday in New Zealand. It was so good that we visited them again before we left...twice in one week for dinner! I definitely recommend dining at Portofino. All of the food we ordered were great from the Lasagna Al Forno, Fettuccine Di Pollon, Vegetarian Fettuccine Vegetarian, Cannelloni Casanostra. The staff were very friendly and accommodating. They even offered and opened the window and had fresh air while enjoying our meals. We forgot to take pictures of our food the first time we dined in...that's how great it was! The pictures below are of what we ordered on our second visit!

I visited this place with my wife on a Sunday for the lunch buffet. They arranged a lovely table with a beautiful sea view. The buffet was small but reasonably priced. The service was excellent, the atmosphere romantic, and the staff were very friendly. We were even offered a complimentary glass of wine. I recommend this place to anyone looking for a unique vibe for their celebrations.

Great place to celebrate our wedding anniversary with family. Great views. Light and airey. Buffet was good - sliced ham great. Were flexible with menu for our grandchildren and corkage for our own special wine. Peter (?) the manager was friendly and helpful. Good value for money.

Great views and friendly staff, but the food was a letdown. The Father's Day menu online was different from what we got—prices were higher and there was no squid and garden salad or dips for the bread, which was disappointing.

Been there with group of people celebrating Father's day but a bit dissapointed. Price being raised from $48 to $55 per person and not following as advertised. Pork belly with noodle is tough. Crumbed fish & squid but squid was not served. Fresh garden salad slaw with citrus mayo was not served as well. Basket of bread rolls was served without any dip. Other than food dissatisfaction, customer service was good and all staffs are friendly.

Not one to leave bad reviews unnecessarily but this was a rough experience. Poor customer service, as it seemed like an inconvenience that we were there. Subs were not very well made and were light on everything, even something cheap like lettuce. And there was basically no bread left, had to choose from rye or garlic. Not much more to say then that as we just grabbed our food and left. Wouldn't recommend.

What a great find! My first time in Auckland and I stumbled across this restaurant in Devonport. The food was absolutely delicious! Been raving about it to my colleagues. The staff were also super knowledgeable about dietary requirements and were very welcoming!
A spacious and cosy cafe located by the Devonport pier. Great food and coffee with excellent service. It also has a small takeaway bar for simple pastry and ice cream.

This place was a cute authentic Indian restaurant in Devonport suburb of Auckland. The service was so nice, especially the host welcomed us with a good smile and service. Highly recommend this place the Indian food lovers!

Check this out. Made me fresh sushi at 8.30pm. Teriyaki chicken 8 pieces for $7 it was so delicious and their service is great! i'll definitely be back. The store was clean and ive been there a few times now and i always leave very happy. They have catering options and i noticed they also have uber eats so what are you waiting for! Wedges are delicious, fish was perfection. Been back here today again and it's still great!

Nicolino has become one of our traditions when visiting Devonport. The food is fresh, hot and authentic. The seafood risotto is one of my favourite meals ever! We had excellent service on each of our visits and the atmosphere is cozy. We are looking to return in the near future!

Lovely snapper, great chips, lovely squid rings, potato fritters probably skip ( thin and oily) but the rest of the meal was lovely. We are very fussy with fish, and we do recommend this place, sweet fish, not strong, lovely thin crispy batter. Recommend.

I visited alone on September 28th. I went in because I liked the atmosphere and I tried the avocado toast based on the staff’s recommendation, and even though it was my first time having avocado(It tastes even better with added bacon!), it was incredibly well-balanced and delicious. And most of all, that day was my birthday, so when I mentioned it, they beautifully plated my dish, put a candle on a brownie cake, and sang me a birthday song! It was such a wonderful surprise!🎉 I received the best gift during my trip to New Zealand. I want to sincerely thank the owner and both staff members💞 Thank you so much 💕🌼
Amazing food…! Feels like we were back in Goa. Authentic Goan food and very nice customer service.

Beautiful burgers. The specials are always incredible and so original. The fries are definitely the best in town. Not to mention you can order from the bar over the road and they deliver to your table!!! 100% recommend.

We came to Devonport for a day trip and had a late lunch at Devonport Indian Hub. The staff greeted us warmly and even entertained our kids with snacks and balloons, which was such a thoughtful touch. The food was absolutely delicious — we ordered the deal of 4 dishes for only $75, and it was great value as wecwere 4 adults with 2 kids. Their customer service is outstanding, and the team is very friendly. They even let our kids play around, which made the experience even more enjoyable. We loved the people here and highly recommend this place!

Visited Devonport once again after 4 years and we didn’t initially know where to eat. We’ve been walking around for a few minutes and have passed through this restaurant a few times and boy what a right decision to choose to eat here! The staff was super friendly, knew a bit and talked to us in our local language which is always heartwarming 💕 we ordered the Chicken Tikka Masala with Garlic Naan, Lamb Madras, Basmati rice, Lamb Seekh Kebab and sweet Lassi. Everything was just SO good, authentic and cooked to perfection. I wish they open a branch nearer Auckland CBD (of maybe in the West? Lol), but in any case I now know where to eat in case i find myself in Devonport again 😉

Great service, delightful atmosphere and amazing food. Got the sweet and sour pork with rice, it was very juicy and the Wonton Soup had really nice broth. The lemonades were also very refreshing Awesome experience :)

Today we went to this cafe and ordered curry beef noodle, it was amazing. We also ordered a pot rib on clay pot rice. The milk tea there was over our standards as it tasted like authentic Hong Kong food. Overall left a heart impression, would recommend.

I highly recommend this place for anyone looking to enjoy authentic Indian food. The ambiance is cozy and clean, perfect for a relaxed meal. The food was absolutely delicious, and the customer service was great!

We celebrated our sons birthday. The lovely hosts decorated our table for his birthday and even had a little surprise 🥳 The food is absolutely fantastic and delicious! It was the best Japanese food I ever had. Definitely a must go. Thanks for the fantastic service!

Absolutely gorgeous what a remarkable way to spend my birthday in a beautiful restaurant like Signal Hill. The staff were next level, kind, assertive and generally lovely to be around. The food was supendandance and so were the cocktails. Couldn't fault it, thank you for a beautiful evening.
Booked a first table, really good value. The food was excellent, but the restaurant was a bit too crowded and noisy. Happy to see the place doing well though. Will definitely visit again.

Excellent dining experience. The young lady who served us was absolutely delightful, super helpful and very knowledgeable with every item on the menu. The food was enjoyable and the dining area was very comfortable, with a lovely decor reminiscent of its heritage home past.
Amazing dining experience, great customer service, staff was so lovely and attentive. Food was spectacular, delicious flavour and original Thai food! 🤤😍

Delicious meal at the new Thai restaurant in Devonport tonight! The place is clean, bright and cosy. The service was friendly and helpful - with smiling, helpful staff. The food was delicious! Fresh and very tasty; plenty of it and simply but nicely presented. This is an ideal setting for a casual meal and/or family get- together. It could be our new regular. Highly recommend!

Absolutely horrible experience. Clearly recently went through an ownership change because this place USED to be amazing. The restaurant now was unhygienic they were SO many flies and mosquitoes surrounding the kitchen and rubbish bin. The service was atrocious and NOTHING like the other kokodacs?? They sold kebabs and iced chocolates and what not??? The people working there had no clue about anything or how the food is actually served at other locations? They were just confused and wanted to charge for things that i’ve never been charged for at any other locations. The portions are also absolutely terrible.

We had the most amazing meal at Taupo Indian Cuisine in Devonport. We had 4 young kids and the owner who served us was so kind and hospitable. The food came out piping hot and was so flavoursome. This restaurant cannot be missed. Best Indian around!! We will be back!

Dulcie – A Must-Visit in Devonport! What an incredible spot! Dulcie is an absolute gem—beautifully designed with a cozy, welcoming vibe. The food was amazing—fresh, flavorful, and clearly made with care. The smoothies were an explosion of flavors—so vibrant and refreshing, like a tropical escape in a glass. And to top it all off, the view of the ocean is just stunning. Sitting there with great food and that incredible view was the perfect experience. Can’t wait to come back. Highly recommend!
Excellent staff and service. Coffee and matcha were great. Food, including cabinets and main dishes are also super nice. Great view looking towards Torpedo Bay. A must try if you are in Devonport.

Amazing food, great atmosphere and outstanding service. The team were so onto it. Efficient, courteous and very friendly, making our brunch visit a highlight of a visit to Auckland. Worth taking the Ferry over. Our waitress, Poppy, made the experience 5 stars. A great asset to the team. Great work, Dulcie! Sure to be back
Excellent place for a brunch! Loved the food, very attentive service, quick turn around and great food selection! Lots of people of different ages, families, students, lovely view! Great all around!

Had the best, creative salmon toast & beautiful iced chai latte. I’ll be back for just the butter itself (muffin YUM). Obviously a glass of bubbles, too. Efficiency & personality from lovely staff; plus, the most aesthetic & buzzing eatery I’ve been to in ages. Great spot in Devonport!

Beautiful way to spend a few hours in Waiheke. We did wine lasting then lunch. Had a fabulous table by window with magnificent view. Lunch was relaxed which was wonderful as we didn’t feel rushed. Highly rate!!!

We found ourselves at Batch on a very wet and windy Saturday afternoon after a recommendation. Despite not having a booking and the restaurant being full, the staff suggested we do a wine tasting , and in the meantime they would see if a table became available. Luck was with us , we got a table by the window and then met our server Grace. Grace was everything you could want in a server ,knowledgeable,warm ,friendly , up for a laugh ...a true asset to Batch.it's clear she loves her job and enjoys people. The food was outstanding, oysters , fish of the day , the duck , finished with apple strudel. And of course the wine was superb. Look forward to dining again in sunny weather where we can really appreciate the beautiful setting and views . Thankyou Batch for a memorable lunch .
We find ourselves coming back here time after time. The freshest sushi spot in Westgate, delivering quality ingredients, and fast friendly service. Highly recommend.
