I don’t know why I still go to this place even when I don’t have another option but today was definitely my last time buying from any of St Pierre’s they are the worst place to get a sushi. Today I tried a large chicken rice ball (salmon) and honestly wheredafakiii was the salmon? There was only few little pieces of salmon on it and the whole middle none…no salmo at all. Extremely disrespectful with customer. Never again 👍👍👍👍

Everything — the atmosphere, the food, and the staff — was fantastic! The staff’s kindness really touched me. I’m so happy I could have such a lovely memory before going back to Japan. Thank you from the bottom of my heart.

Love the vibe and the entire team is so warm and helpful. One of the best coffees I've ever had. Cabinet food is also delicious. Chicken and beef are halal. Just let them know your dietary requirements when ordering.

We ordered the Classic Hamburger, American Cheese Burger, and a side of fries. The fries were honestly the best I’ve ever had! They had a rich buttery aroma, were perfectly crispy, and seasoned with just the right amount of salt. As for the burgers—the patties were full of flavor, and the sauce was well-balanced. The only letdown was that both the patty and the bun were a bit dry. Without that issue, it would’ve been a perfect meal. And also the restaurant could really do better with cleaning. Our table and chairs were covered in leftover food crumbs

Right, so Jax Burger Shack. Where do I even start with this place? First visit? Absolutely brilliant. I'm thinking "Finally, someone who gets it!" The burgers were perfect, everything was spot on. I'm telling everyone about this hidden gem, feeling like I've discovered the holy grail of burger joints. Second visit? It's like they hired completely different people. Or maybe the original chef got abducted by aliens. I don't know what happened, but something definitely went wrong. The wedges though - and I cannot stress this enough - the wedges are phenomenal. Fried in tallow like God intended. Crispy outside, fluffy inside, proper old-school flavor. These wedges are doing more for my happiness than most relationships I've had. If they just served wedges, I'd give them 5 stars and come back weekly. But then we get to the burgers, and it's like someone said "You know what this needs? ALL THE SALT. Just dump it on there." Look, I like salt as much as the next person, but this is like they're preparing me for winter hibernation. I can't taste anything else! It's drowning out whatever decent ingredients they're using underneath. The pricing? Well, we had a voucher, which made it bearable. But full price? Are you having a laugh? For oversalted burgers that used to be good? That's like charging premium prices for a Ferrari that's been in a crash - sure, it's still technically a Ferrari, but it's not what I signed up for. Here's what really gets me - the potential is there! Those wedges prove they know what they're doing. The first visit proved they CAN make great food. So what's the excuse now? New management? Staff turnover? Someone having a midlife crisis in the kitchen? I want to love this place, I really do. But right now it feels like dating someone who was amazing at first and then just... stopped trying. Maybe they'll sort themselves out, maybe they won't. I'll probably give them another shot in a few months because I'm a hopeless optimist and those wedges are still haunting my dreams.

Cute little deck area to eat at, outside of a seafood distributor company. Limited parking lots available, recommend to come during off peak or do a takeaway. Fried chicken and fish were okay, chips were well seasoned. Shrimp could be spicier. Best thing was actually the complimentary fish soup. If they sold rice or noodles, I'd happily eat here every week (with fried fish). Lady boss was very attentive and helpful too. I planned to takeaway what I couldnt finish on plates. She saw and offered takeaway boxes.

Pulled in after work for fish n chips . I chose gurnard and it was so fresh and delicious. Fries were nice too. I tried the free fish soup and that was flavourful. Nice clean eating area, good friendly service and not too long to wait. If you do come here be mindful of the heavy traffic between 3-6pm

Had an amazing meal at Ocean's Best. Everything was delicious, and the mussels were a definite highlight – so fresh! The restaurant has a lovely vibe, making it a perfect place for a nice meal out don’t for get to try the fish soup
My fav Asian Market hands down! I went to get some fresh Kimchi from the $10 stand! I could shop there for hours!
Inside Foodie Supermarket...

I ordered a Cheeseburger Star Box at this establishment. Both meal portions were so undersized, the fries were unseasoned. The girl working at the drive through on this Friday night was rude and not friendly at all responding to our meal requests with “Huh?” and “What?” I was taken aback by this appalling experience and it honestly makes me question what’s happening to hospitality if they can’t teach their workers basic manners. I WILL NEVER BE BACK HERE. it’s a waste of money. No wonder there is no one in your store whenever I drive past. Horrible horrible service.
I oreder new Nashville cross cut fries and this is so disappointed no sauce or anything just wasted $8… this is ridicules…
Hadn’t been to a Carls Jr for a while thought I’d try it out again. Atmosphere was fine. Food though nothing special. They short change you on the sundaes -Barely fill even 3/4 of the cup for $5.

Should have read the reviews. We hardly go to KFC and today was a reminder why we need to keep it this way. This KFC is the worst KFC I've ever been to. Ordered the bucket meal. The chicken, both original and Hot & Spicy was tasteless. I kid you not.. it feels like they forgot to add key ingredients of the secret receipe or something. Brilliant menu, starter were the tastiest samosas iv EVER HAD & both mains were soooo mouth watering tender & sauces were perfect. Definitely going back & highly recommend!

Had a lovely meal at Curry Leaf, Prawn Malabari and Butter Chicken, nice light and crispy naan and complimentary poppadoms. Good service, friendly staff, well priced and decent portions. Thank you Curry Leaf!
Absolutely lovely couple running this place and the food was so yum. It’s a shame I live so far away or I’d want to come here way more than my waist line would want me to.
10 out 10 lovely hardworking owners an the food is always delicious my personal favorite is the roast pork but everything I have eaten has been delicious

Last night I had a not so pleasant experience but I am pleased to tell you they have an excellent manager, he redid my entire order. And I'm very impressed with their customer service satisfaction. Well done guys, I am a happy customer. Thank you. Will buy from here again.

WOW, we have just moved to hobsonville about a week ago and have always ordered Pizza Hut living in Torbay for 11 years as that store was always great with their pizzas unfortunately the dominos in long bay and browns bay are awful. Long story short, we called as it was taking ages (nearly an hour) to be told they were waiting for the uber. He checked, and confirmed they were getting cold. Every cake I have ever got from Jenna has been amazing. She always delivers exactly what i envisioned and more. She is soo talented and her cakes make the day so much more special. The staff here communicate really well🩷

We were greeted by the owner, who promptly brought us to our reserved table. The food was served very, very quickly. It was delicious, and for our group of 7 was more than enough. I highly recommend this place!

I've finally found the best Japanese restaurant in Auckland! Every dish I've ordered has been absolutely delicious and the generous portions have left me more than satisfied. The service is also top-notch - friendly, attentive, and efficient. Highly recommend!

I’ve eaten all over the world, at places ranging from down to earth and fancy. This is easily one of my favorites—there is a perfect blend of restaurant food and a home cooked meal vibe, all in a reasonable price. We eat here regularly and it is the highlight of the work week. Highly recommended to everyone!

@theaucklandbuzz (insta & TikTok handle) Follow me for more such reviews. Had a lovely dinner at Amore Italiano. We ordered cannelloni, vegetarian soup, vegetariana pizza, tiramisu, and profiteroles—each dish was well-prepared and delicious. The flavors were comforting and authentic, especially the pizza which had a nice thin crust and generous toppings. The desserts were a sweet finish, with the tiramisu being rich and creamy, and the profiteroles light and satisfying. The place had a warm, cozy vibe that made the dining experience even better. Definitely a spot I’d recommend for a relaxed Italian meal.

The delivery was surprisingly fast, and the pizza arrived hot. I appreciate that. The stuffed crust itself was great—cheesy, garlicky, and a definite highlight. The toppings, when you got them, tasted fresh and the sauce was the classic sweet, tangy flavor I remember. It’s exactly what you expect from a Pizza Hut pizza, which can be a good thing when you're looking for that specific comfort food

The customer service here is absolutely outstanding! The staff are so genuinely lovely, they’ll even hold the door open for you, or bring the order to your car (when I've had kids in the car). The buffalo chicken wings are hands down my favourite, always a hit! Most people don't know about the chicken wings, so please do yourself a favour and add them to your next order!! Every visit has been nothing short of perfect. Honestly, I don’t have a single complaint. Highly recommend!
best pizza i had. way better then dominoes and the team is very friendly

I had such a great experience with Pizza Hut today! I accidentally forgot to select the mozzarella crust option when ordering my pizza, and I only realised after I’d already paid. I called them up straight away and asked if it was possible to add it, and told them I’d be happy to pay cash on delivery. The staff were so kind and helpful, they said they’d take care of it. To my surprise, the pizza was delivered in just 10 minutes, and not only did they add the mozzarella crust, but they upgraded me to an extra-large pizza at no extra cost! They didn’t even ask me for the additional payment I’d offered. Such an unexpected and thoughtful gesture. Amazing service, delicious pizza, and truly kind staff, thank you Pizza Hut for going above and beyond! You definitely made my night. 🍕

#wood fired pizza# This is my second time ordering their mushroom pizza. The ingredients are fresh, and the truffle oil aroma is strong. I like it. The staff are friendly. However, the flavor isn’t very consistent — the first time it was a bit too salty, and this time it’s too plain.

I've ordered their pizzas a number of times now and it's hands down the best pizza in Auckland - honestly better than some of the pizzas in Italy. The pizzas are cooked to perfection - chewy, flavoursome crusts and the toppings are so delicious, not to mention such good value for money. My fave flavour is the Boscaiola, but all of them are amazing. The team are so friendly as well. Don't forget to order one of the traditional tiramisus!
They offer the best rice & curry in Auckland. It's tasty because it's homemade. They offer a generous portion at a very reasonable price.

It was so good! First time trying it, and it’s definitely going to the top of my list of fish and chips takeaways in Auckland. I loved how the fish and squid were covered in batter—just the way I like it—and served with homemade mayo dips and ketchup. Did I forget to mention the lemon? And oh, the pickles—yes! They made it even more special. It’s a 10/10 for me. Highly recommend Malu Fish and Chips!

The food from Neeru’s Indian Kitchen is beyond words every bite was a burst of authentic flavors that reminded me of home. It’s not just food, it’s comfort, love, and tradition beautifully served. Truly heart-warming

Food is absolutely delicious and big portions, I highly recommend this place, the customer service was awesome, especially from Albert, he was very welcoming, had a lovely, happy personality and highlighted a few options on the menu for us which was above and beyond what you normally get when you eat at a lot of places these days. It does have more of a casual /family type vibe than somewhere to go out for a date /romantic meal for a couple but other than that it's a great Chinese food option, would definitely visit again. Thanks again guys!
Food is delicious and yummy. Customer service is excellent and atmosphere is great with spacious space.

We’ve been to Tok Tok Takapuna before and enjoyed it, but this was our first visit to the Hobsonville restaurant. It was a Tuesday night, but the large space was fairly busy. Despite this, the service was excellent and the food outstanding. Between the 6 of us we enjoyed most of the small plates menu and a couple of the big plates. All the food was excellent, only the beach rolls were disappointing. It’s worth leaving room for dessert. We will return!

Kneads All Day is such a lovely café! The food is always fresh and tasty, the staff are warm and welcoming, and the vibe is perfect for any time of day. I’d definitely recommend trying their Veg Burger, the Avocado Smash, and their creamy pasta dishes – all absolutely delicious. Definitely a favorite spot!

Knead All Day has always been a great café, and now that they’ve started serving burgers at night, it’s even better! I tried the Impossible Veg Burger and it was absolutely delicious – fresh, flavorful, and perfectly made. The service was amazing too – really friendly and welcoming, which made the whole experience even better. Definitely recommend stopping by in the evening for a tasty burger and great vibes!

Kneads All Day is fantastic! The food is top-notch, the staff are super friendly, and their Big Brekkie is easily one of the best value meals around. On top of that, they’ve just started Burger Nights every Friday and Saturday, which we can’t wait to check out. Definitely a spot worth visiting again and again!

Delicious and quick feed that pleased the kids (9-12 y/o’s) after a day filled with activities. Boneless seasoned and honey soy is the way to go. Easy service, ordered on the phone and was able to devoured them no more than 10mins later

Esme is the sauce queen, no one does it like her. Every kebab she makes is loaded with the perfect amount of sauce, wrapped with love, and honestly tastes like heaven in a cardboard box. If Esme made all my meals, I’d never cook again.⭐️😇
Great bunch of lads behind the counter, huge portions, fresh salads. Highly recommend, not your average Turkish establishment
just ordered meat and chips off doordash. Disgusting. Uncooked meat. Terrible fries. Sauce was non existent. Never ordering here again
Ordered a large mocha, got a small black coffee with a lot of froth on the top instead, not only that only half of it was coffee. I feel kinda ripped off.

From the moment we walked in, we felt very welcomed. Service, selection of food and atmosphere is great. The food itself is fantastic, we had the red and yellow curry. They also accept the restaurant gift cards, we had no issues whatsoever.

One of the best coffee place in town, I have always loved their iced mocha, have been my go to place for 2 years now, always welcoming and friendly staff, calm ambience and spacious. Food is delicious with a thumbs up from my little miss 4, she always finishes all her orders here (fluffy, bread and fish and chips).😂 It is very kid friendly with toys and coloring stuffs that she absolutely love.

Coffee was great. Bit of a barn like atmosphere. I ordered scrambled eggs, which were average, nothing special!. Unfortunately, my meal came out after my friend had nearly finished her meal. Shame not to be able to eat together. Prices are very expensive for what you get. My friend paid $27.90 for smashed avocado. Horrendous price!
Great authentic curries here! We come here every week and really enjoy the food, atmosphere and nice people who work here. The paneer dishes are excellent!
Place does not exist.

25 Ml café is a local spot which is loved by many. The cafe had been renovated and got a much needed face lift that adds to the overall nice experience. The food is always served with flair and there are different dishes to choose from , some with Asian influence. Overall, a cute place to eat and have a good cup of coffee.

Fabulous cafe. I have tried 70 percent of their menu and everything has so far been on point! Tasty and well balanced flavors, fresh ingredients. The chef knows how to do fusion cuisine very well and all my eggs have been consistently cooked to perfection! Friendly service, lovely atmosphere.
The dumping and fried rice taste amazing! New owner and restaurant, good to see some new choices for lunch in Hobsonville.

These guys are awesome. Found them as a suggestion for a Google maps Cafe near me while driving through Hobsinville. Lovely service, super kind, friendly, and really yummy, good quality food. We had their Thai prawn salad, Beef salad, and Peking duck burger with chips (for three of us). Wow, great portion sizes and very quick service. Seems like they have developed a really lovely community and regular customers who come and visit this cafe. Please consider going to see these guys if you're in the area. Great outdoor seating if sunny.

Ordered $16 buffalo wings, there was 9 wings in the advertisement and the box looked full, when I got it it was 5 tiny wings, barely any meat on them. I paid $16 for 5 small wings…… I also got the cheesy bacon on chips and it was mediocre at best.
Realised I hasn't rated you guys, service is amazing and the kai is 🤌 every time. Never waited extra time for it

Went there last night to celebrate my husband’s birthday. The food was a lot tastier and visually attractive than last time I visited (two years back). The staff were very attentive and the atmosphere was on point. I would highly recommend this place for a date night!

The view and atmosphere are gorgeous. The food is super eco friendly, the chips are milky colour, cooked by the microwave, so make sure you don’t have too much oil or fat. The top of the cake is black, super burnt, BUT upholding eco friendly standards, how could they just throw it out of the kitchen, so the customer must eat it. The waiter wrote what you ordered but never key in the system. Orrrrr the waitress can never seen anyone came or sit down. It does not matter the cafe is busy or not. Eventually an Asian lady served us, she is very kind. Others can not see me, perhaps I have super power - I am invisible.

Food was so delicious, they serve the most delicious fries crispy, yummy and seasoned perfectly with parmigiana cheese 🧀 on top and aioli sauce on side . Also we ordered the chocolate tart it was so delicious 🤤 but the slice is too small and pricey The staff were so friendly. We had an amazing time . The vibes were amazing , the area is stunning and the view was incredible . Highly recommended to visit with your family and friends.

Highly recommended — and dog- and baby-approved! We had such a fantastic time at Fabrics in Hobsonville! A special shout-out to the incredible gentleman who seated us. His warm attitude and friendly accommodation set the tone for a relaxed and enjoyable visit. The ambience is just stunning — stylish yet cozy, with a great vibe that makes you want to stay longer. We paid $84 for two dishes and two drinks but the experience, service, and setting really do justify it. If you're looking for somewhere to treat yourself or take visiting friends, Fabrics is definitely worth checking out.
Lovely atmosphere right by the water. Great on a sunny day. Food wasn’t bad but nothing special or that stood out.

Fabric Cafe Bistro is a fantastic spot right here in Auckland that I absolutely love, primarily for its incredible views. Seriously, you get some truly stunning scenery while you're there, making it a feast for the eyes as well as the palate! The food is pretty good too, definitely solid and satisfying, providing a decent complement to the surroundings. However, what truly makes this place shine and keeps me coming back is the overall vibe. It's perfectly set up for chilling out, having a leisurely chat, and just slowing down to enjoy the moment. Whether you're catching up with friends over coffee or simply want to unwind and take in the beautiful surroundings, Fabric Cafe Bistro nails that relaxed, unhurried atmosphere. Just a heads-up though, finding a car park around here can be a bit tricky, so it’s wise to factor that into your plans or consider public transport/rideshare. Despite the parking challenge, it’s still the ideal place to escape the city bustle and soak up some peaceful, slow-paced enjoyment, making it a highly recommended spot for anyone in Auckland looking for a scenic and relaxing cafe experience.
finding a carpark at busy peak times was a lil hard but algoods. Food was great and staff was nice
Ordered $11 special, egg burger & mushroom burger. The service was good, didnt wait long. The chips were cooked very well, burgers tasted good but could've been better.

Honestly, I was in the area & in past conversations with some family members they highly recommended trying their burgers. I wasn't disappointed, that's for sure. *Fish and Chips may not be the fanciest meals, but its definitely a Kiwi classic go to! It's hard, fast, usually fulling, good value for what you spend and an easy feed for family gatherings/larger groups when you don't feel like cooking
Disappointed about the $55 tray. Amount of food is small compare to the tray.
Supporting Local! Sushi and Miso from Heavenly Sushi Beach Haven was so good! 😋 #HeavenlySushiBeachHaven #BeautifulBeachHaven #BeautifulAotearoa #supportinglocal

We visit here regularly, the owners are very friendly and accommodating, always willing to make up orders for you on the spot if they have run out. A great array of sushi and other options, freshly made and tasty. Great chicken katsu, crumbed prawns, sushi and the miso soup is always top draw. The owner is happy to make up small sized sushi for the kids and often adds a little treat for them which they enjoy. Very well priced too.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ The Mediterranean – A Gem of Lebanese Cuisine From the very first bite, it was clear this place takes pride in serving truly authentic Lebanese flavors. Every dish was beautifully crafted — full of depth, balance, and the unmistakable warmth of Middle Eastern hospitality. • The mezze selection was outstanding: fresh, vibrant, and perfectly seasoned. • The grilled meats were tender and infused with rich, smoky spices that linger just right. • Even the smaller details — the freshly baked bread, aromatic herbs, and thoughtful presentation — showcased the chef’s dedication to authenticity. It’s rare to find a restaurant that delivers not just food, but a complete cultural experience. The Mediterranean does exactly that: it brings the heart of Lebanon to the table with finesse, generosity, and passion. If you’re craving exceptional, well-created, and truly authentic Middle Eastern cuisine, this is the place you’ll want to return to again and again.
Hummus and salad were fresh and tasty. The meat, however, was burnt, dry, and unseasoned. The rice was okay. The hot dog sausage tasted old.
Best potato fritters by far. Standard scoop of chips was a good serve and delicious crunchy chips. Look forward to trying the fish and Chinese menu also.
I have never given a 1 star rating before, but this was a the worst chips and burger I've ever had.
Buffalo chicken wings & sour cream was delicious. Food is very yummy. Wish they can give rice instead of chips but otherwise it's delicious. 5 stars 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
We dined here last night and thoroughly enjoyed our meal The wait staff were attentive but not over the bearing. The food was excellent as well. Would recommend Ohui without hesitation

The dining experience at Ohui was average. We were very exciting for the dining experience. The highlight was the entrée chicken tikka, it was well cooked and flavorful. However, it was quite spicy and should have been mentioned on the menu. We had to have icy drinks to cool down. The famous paua tortellini was disappointing. The pasta wrap was dry and a bit hard in the parts not covered by the sauce. The sauce and the tortellini felt disjointed, as if they didn’t come together as a dish. The sauce itself is quite nice - creamy and coconuty. The fish of the day, which the waitress described as having a texture similar to blue cod, turned out to be much softer and less firm. It was also overly salty, and about a third of the cabbage was burnt. The burger buns were served cold, as if for takeaway. We also tried to order a mocktail, but were told it was not available. The brown butter cake had a nice mix of flavors, and the ice cream that came with it was excellent. However the cake itself was average.
it's not flash, but it's clean and customers can see their food being prepared. this is a local kebab shop and it does a good job of being that. the staff are helpful and pleasant.

Amy, as me, is uncompromising on sourcing quality. She & her team serve up superior kebab rice meals - I always get my fave hot spicy Lamb Souvlaki rice meal, with garlic yoghurt atop. I’ve enjoyed supporting her & her superb food & engaging insightful conversations, we often have, since she started out. We are so fortunate to have Kebabylon in the village & I do hope people support our local business when ever they can & have the means to do so. 🙏💓🙏✊Simon L.
A really great little burger (etc) shop. The Buffalo burger is beastly - and maybe unbeatable. Plenty of character seating, and friendly service. We'll done team!
Been going here for a number of years and absolutely always great food, great service and great prices. A local gem.
I regularly have their chole bhature and aloo paratha, and the taste is just like authentic Indian food. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for delicious Indian flavors.

Food was absolutely delicious, particularly the Turkish eggs. The sourdough was some of the best we’ve ever enjoyed in Auckland. Unfortunately, the cafe was late opening (8.10 rather than the advertised 8am), the chef didn’t arrive until after 8.20am and our meals were served 30-40mins after that. The orange juice was overly sweet - tasting like it was mixed with cordial, and the coffee was burnt. Service was friendly, but unfortunately the lack of organisation and finishing touches lets the experience of dining here down.
Had an awesome brunch today at North Haven. Great coffee and very generous eggs benne. Pretty reasonable price too. Thanks!

I really enjoyed the service that even though I didn’t had made an appointment in advance, but luckily I got seat with my friend. Lovely food and friendly service, no rush, peace and love. Definitely recommend all people to go.

Lovely little Italian place, the staff are always so friendly to me and my family, food is always incredible, cannot recommend enough. It’s our go to for any occasion. The smoked chicken salad and all of the pizzas are absolutely incredible
Great family friendly service. Generous serves and tasty curries. Great to support local!

Local friends took me here for dinner. The lamb shank is tender and falling off the bone, but the flavor is just plain, only savory taste and nothing else, which makes it less interesting after a few bits. The seafood and chips are okay, dried fish tasted better than the fried shrimps.

When we arrived on Sunday as part of our Kauri Glenn experience to find that there was NO space for a family of 5 to dine either inside or alfresco styles outside There was no warm welcome to encourage us to stay and place an order. It appeared that they were hosting their family and friends as they were engaged in harmonious conversations in their home languages. We're from Mangere Bridge and was looking forward to their burgers and loaded fries after our walk through the Kauri Glen Reserve. Can not guarantee our return as it was only spontaneously decided to there for Father's Day lunch

Food was amazingly delicious 😋 I ordered the fish burger 🍔 ingredients were fresh probably the best fish burger Ive had 😁 Son had the beef and cheese which he really enjoyed 🤗 Partner had the boss which was also amazing 🤩 Kumara fries are also a favourite 🍟
Definitely one of the cleanest N.C I've been too. Honestly nothing bad to say. Overall pretty decent 👍🏽

As far as KFC goes I like this one. It's still KFC after all but I get what I expect to get here. Been multiple times as it is local for me. They had a total rebuild a year or two back and it looks much improved for doing so. Staff at the drive through window have always been friendly and I've not had any issues with order items missing. It's service one at a time so the queue can be a bit sluggish and not suitable for those in a rush. Also I find the carpark easy to get into but painful to exit due to no longer having exit out onto onewa road. That's down to Highbury mall though not KFC.

Been going here for years. The calamari is by far the best in Auckland. Have tried nearly everything else on their menu and you can't go wrong. Drinks are reasonably priced, service is top notch and welcoming, staff is knowledgeable about their food and drinks. The music and atmosphere has never disappointed either.

I’ve just had an experience with this pita pit on onewa road, i’ve had multiple experiences at other locations, but this one has had me absolutely devastated at the service and the food, the white old man manager was extremely rude and not patients whatsoever the atmosphere was overall a negative experience. The smell of the store was absolutely unappetising made me not want to eat there. NOT TO MENTION there PRICES are extremely steep and you can barley understand the cashier who seems like they speak hear minimum english.
The best pizza place I know ! People are very kind and always with the smile. The food is amazing, perfectly cooked and generous. And it’s fast serving. I highly recommend this place !

It’s the most expensive and the worst pizza. We’ve ordered twice from Birkenhead - the first time the base was burnt to a crisp. We foolishly decided to give them a second chance and we paid $10 for extra cheese, must have accidentally ordered ghost cheese as I can’t tell the difference. Nothing like the amazing pizza Sals used to sell - the price goes up and the quality goes down. Edit: Updating the review to 1 star as I’ve spent the entire day sick 🤢 thanks Sals.
I found the chicken is raw in the pizza I ordered 🤮🤮, unfortunately no time to back there , just throw , tooooooo bad experience 🤮🤮🤮🤮🤮🤮
Base seems undercooked. Super disappointed for the price. Dominos down the road is better at 1/3 the price honestly. Won’t come back.
Amazing meal. I had the pizza schnitzel and it's absolutely massive, could probably have just had half but it was so tasty I had to finish it. Would definitely go back.
Loved the Pizza Schnitzel!

Just want to give the team especially the manager on the morning shift 13.09.2025 a massive shout out!! I ordered breakfast before i started work, for my family to be delivered via door dash. I unfortunately was missing one of my teens quarter pounder. I rang back our door dash driver who couldn't help so rang McDonald's. She was very apologetic once realizing the mistake and immediately offered to make it, for my husband to pick up. We were surprised to find not only our missing item but another burger, 2 hash browns and a 10pack of chicken nuggets. Our 4 children were ecstatic!! Not only did the manager on at the time quickly resolved their mistake but went the extra mile for the inconvenience!! Thank you from our family to your team for this effort. Well done!! Will continue to support this store 100%
Definitely was one of the best tacos I’ve ever tasted ! Coming back for more of that deliciousness next time keep it up boys !!! Yous are onnnn !!!’ 🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥

It’s my first time to order Banh Mi at this Vietnamese restaurant in Doordash. The bread is perfectly crispy, the fillings are fresh and flavourful, and the taste feels truly authentic. A must-try if you love Vietnamese food! The note from restaurant is so cute.

Oh my! What a gastronomic experience ❤️ He had sweet and sour chicken and rice and I had sunshine (can’t remember exactly the name) pork and rice. Condiments included garlic vinegar, and two types of chillies sauce. Generous portions that are filling. My second time here and his first. He was impressed! It’s a small place, in the middle of Birkenhead. Easy to get to by car or bus (from the city) with plenty of parking. You simply have to come experience authentic Vietnamese cuisine! So delicious. ❤️

I live locally and this will be my new Indian takeout spot! I ordered a butter chicken (comes with rice) and garlic naan and they gave me poppadoms on the house 🥰 great service and excellent food for the price. Give these guys a go if you haven’t already!!
Love the curries here, my favorite indian takeaway place, Madras and Korma are great, vindaloo is awesome as well. Super friendly owners.
Great new place to visit in Birkenhead area. The staff are really friendly and food are great too. My kids also enjoy the food and drink from here. Highly recommended 👍
Came here for a work lunch, such a cute spot! The dumplings are super generous and delicious. Also enjoyed the sweet and spicy chicken. Lovely friendly staff 😊

All About in Birkenhead is a gem for Korean street food, serving bold, delicious flavours that feel both authentic and comforting. The friendly service and generous portions make it a spot I’d happily return to again and again.
A different Korean restaurant… pretty cool experience. Food was pretty neat and clean. Want to try something new next time I visit. 👍 a little pricey~ but, quality was good.

Provecho offers authentic Mexican cuisine! These are the real flavors and the real ingredients. The atmosphere is lovely, and it feels like a beautiful family house in Mexico. It's very spacious and perfect for many people. Highly recommend. Pura calidad!

This cozy noodle shop, owned by a charming Japanese couple, serves up authentic ramen that truly hits the spot. We tried the shio and miso ramen, and both dishes were delicious. The noodles slid down effortlessly, and the rich, flavorful broth was the perfect complement. I am already looking forward to going back and trying more dishes from their menu.

Look no further..this place is an absolute diamond of a find. Having lived in Japan I can say this is the best Ramen I have had outside of Japan...it's exceptional value and so fresh and the broths have such deep flavour. The "just Ramen" broth is outstanding. The donburi bowls are also amazing. The curry katsu 11/10. Just go.

This is the authentic ramen taste my family have been waiting for. They are the real japanese legendary noodle chef. My family ordered 3 different kinds of broth- spicy miso, bonito, and basic bone. They are made uniquely for their own flavor. We really love the thickness and hot taste of the spicy miso. We love spicy! The bonito soup is so flavorful. I think it fits those who have a weak tongue. Easy to find parking under the nearby mall. Btw, i found many japanese customers. That means it is the real japanese cuisine. Gyoza is packed with meat and I believe they are hand made there. Yumm.

I used to visit this shop many times when it was located in the CBD, but it closed due to the COVID-19 pandemic, which was a real shame. However, it has since reopened and is even more delicious than before, and I was so happy to be able to eat the ramen I've always loved! I'll definitely visit again.
Very fresh fish and friendly owner. Salmon is sashimi grade which is shipped fresh from Bluff on a daily basis. Highly recommended.
One of the best Mexicans I have had for a while. They provide good service and you can get a lot of food for your money. I'll definitely visit again.

Found this place on TikTok and it is seriously good😭 I ordered the chicken burrito with some sides and OH MY LORD SO YUMMY. The portions are really well and good prices. The guy who was working there was very nice and the service was 10/10. So underrated I reccommend.
One of the best Malaysian restaurants in Auckland. It’s a small place & not really fancy, but the quality of food is excellent. I love their laksa noodles.
Great food, great service. The bibimbap was perfect

I have finally found it. After years of searching. This is the best kebab place I have eaten at, hands downs. The lamb is some of the best I’ve ever tasted, and the passion the owners have for food is incomparable with any others. Seriously try this place, it’s amazing!
Hands down the best sushi on the North Shore So fresh and clean.

The food is amazing very fresh. They have just started making a garlic prawn pie, it is to die for. The family is always very positive, friendly and remember who you are. I love this bakery it also has really decent prices and is getting incredibly busy. I am happy for them they are such hard workers.

Always enjoy staying at the Spencer. It’s a great location and the rooms are comfortable. The hotel no longer days daily room servicing and the restaurant is replaced with a menu of pre-prepared meals

This place has a nice spa, but they keep turning it off - it’s only worth visiting when the spa is open. Staff are pretty unhelpful and there are issues with the fact that some of the rooms are privately owned. Rooms are ok, location is great

Service was not tested. The hotel is tired and worn out. Dirty carpets and worn floors. A disgrace of a hotel in the heart of a great area. It needs a complete refurbishment. Parking of $30 per night is a rorte. 4 star rating are you kidding.

The best Korean BBQ in the North. Very good and quick service, lovely staff. Meat and vegetables are fresh. Plus they are refilled timely. The grill tray is cast iron, and they a chimneys at each table, so it is not too hot inside. Pretty busy so it is recommended to book a table in advance. Also parking is limited, so plan your trip.
The barista, Kit is one of the kindest people I’ve ever met. He treated me with kindness and has made the best coffees I’ve ever had at a McDonald’s branch. Props to him!! Amazing worker

I ordered a couple coffees and hot chocolates from this McDonald’s and I saw that the workers name was Kit. He had exceptional service and was quick to make our drinks and was overall a great guy. He seriously deserves this review

This was by far the worst service I’ve ever experienced at a McDonald’s. The lady at the drive-thru was unbelievably rude, disrespectful, and completely unprofessional. She spoke with a harsh, angry tone, snapping “What?” and “OMG” at me like I was bothering her just by ordering food. It was shocking and completely unacceptable. If this is how staff are allowed to treat paying customers, it’s a disgrace to the McDonald’s brand. Management should seriously reconsider who they put on customer service, because this behavior drives people away. I will not be returning to this branch
Bad bad cooking style. No one cooks this way fried rice. So disappointed

Popped into the Backyard Bar in between netball games tonight. We ordered at 555pm and our meals (two burgers) took just under 30 minutes. We were the only people in the place. When our meals arrived the chicken burger had a portion of chicken thigh the size of a small chicken tenderloin. It coveted less than 30% of the bun. There was also a portion of coleslaw on the bun and half a piece of tinned mango. For a burger costing close to $30, the portion was tiny. I can understand why the place is empty. They did offer to cook another one but we didn't have another 30 minutes to wait...
Thank you to Rahul and Gagan who were our bar staff on Saturday night at my nephews 21st. You 2 were so lovely towards our whanau. Highly recommend you both Nga Mihi Regina Kahaki

The team at Free Range Chef are outstanding! They catered our wedding, which was in a private venue and not only delivered an unforgettable selection of canapes and meal but brought everything with them and packed it down after, as if they were never there. We never doubted that Stephen and Rachel could deliver incredible tasting food but what really made it memorable was the amount. Unlike other wedding meals I've previously had, this was far from plain and so bountiful guests managed to top up. We chose the family style gourmet bbq and salads which was a hit with all our guests, some are still talking about it! Thanks again Rachel and Stephen! You guys are amazing.
Great food and service highly recommend. I’ve eaten here many times and also been catered for an some events and the owner is great and the food is yummy

The waitstaff were efficient and welcoming. The food came out very quickly, I was surprised it came so soon after ordering. The portion was good and it was delicious. I ordered the seafood ramen and a coke and was very happy with my choice. The broth was also delicious, the seafood was tasty, the veges were fresh. The seating area had a nice and calm ambiance and I felt no pressure to leave when I had finished eating so I was able to sit comfortably for a while to let the food settle before heading out. Very nice experience, would recommend and would come again for sure !
The restaurant had a cozy atmosphere,Ramen so yammy.I love it.❤️

Horrible Dan Dan noodles. Literally just slapped peanut butter onto some noodles which gives a really odd consistency. We did not know until we got home as we ordered takeaway. The girl at the counter when asked about the food did not know what the dishes were either. The cucumber salad and kung pao chicken also were pretty grim. Very disappointed.

Have ordered the vegetables in oyster sauce to go with the chicken I have prepared at home. For $15, I've received cabbage in oyster sauce. Pretty disappointed as I was expecting a mix of fresh veggies and not this sadly looking cabbage pile. Taste of the oyster sauce is good, though but yeah, definitely not what I expected.
Disappointed! The store closed earlier than working hours - 04.40pm

What a waste of money , ordered coke , ginger beer served from used bottle no gas nothing , chicken under cooked tasteless, lamb seek kabab taste like more then week old , paneer tikka masala was sweet , customer can differentiate bbtwwen butter chicken sauce and tikka masala sauce very sweet , and mr india special nan was actually special worst nan , never visit again 76$ hard earn money in bin
Got a couple of kids meals for my daughters and they loved them! The girls’ had the burger and fish kids meals. Good portion sizes too. The curly fries were super crispy.
Best burger joint in Auckland. The double beef and cheese is the go to. Mega portions and mega good food. The atmosphere be staff are always so welcoming. Couldn’t recommend it higher.

Had an awesome experience at BB Takapuna last night, had a friendly greeting at the door. Unfortunately I couldn’t order with the QR code as I had a voucher but the worker who came over swiftly took our order and immediately came back with our drinks, shortly followed by our food. Service time was incredibly quick and the food tasted great.

It is not often that I come across a place that is as remarkable as this. The food was exquisite, and the atmosphere was inviting and vibrant with genuine care and passion for their culture. The staff was friendly and welcoming, and the chef is truly a culinary master. Thank you to the entire team for making this an exceptional experience and for becoming my new favorite restaurant.

Wonderful Japanese restaurant in heart of Takapuna. Delicious food, great atmosphere and a friendly team. Very authentic Japanese cuisine. Below scores are out of 5 ⭐️s 😉 Customer Service 5 ⭐️ 🧑‍🍳 Food Quality 5 ⭐️ 👌 Atmosphere 5 ⭐️ 🙂 Presentation 5 ⭐️ 🙂 Products 5 ⭐️ 📍 Location 5 ⭐️ 💰 Price $$ (rated between 1 - 5 $) 🅿️ Parking: Lots of paid parking available Overall 5 ⭐️

The food was excellent — fresh sashimi and perfectly cooked beef. However, the service was disappointing throughout the evening. One server in particular seemed visibly unfriendly and began clearing our table while we were still eating, which felt rushed and disrespectful. I've dined here many times over the years, and it's especially disheartening considering the high standards of hospitality typically found in Japanese restaurants. Unfortunately, this experience has made me decide not to return
ordered combination lunch set with katsu and sashimi. Sashimi was nice but the katsu was overcooked and very dry. The portions are quite small and I left hungry.
Just amazing, tasty great location. Looking forward to coming back.
Magnificent food and great service. I love Pupuke salad, duck mousse , and galette (cheesy and some much flavour). Highly recommend if you are looking a hiden place for your date.

We love Sake Bar. The atmosphere is brilliant, relaxed Japanese dining. The food is fresh and delicious! Fast service. Friendly staff. Fun dinner. Great for birthdays (make sure to tell them and order desserts, at least for the guest of honour).

This is Marshall my dad took me to this restaurant I feel like it was a great atmosphere. The food was amazing and the people were really nice and there was barely any wait time to do anything. They were just getting straight onto it.

I purchased a veg burger combo for my child on Tuesday, 2nd September 2025, around 9 PM. Unfortunately, the patty in the burger was extremely rubbery and hard to chew — my child couldn't eat it at all, and we had to throw the food away. This was very disappointing.

This is the best Sals by far that I’ve been too in New Zealand, staff are lovely, efficient service and food was excellent. 10/10 experience, the best thing that’s been in my mouth is the garlic knots and mozzarella fries they went down my oesophagus like a dream (so smooth) I can feel the love and dedication you guys put into making those delicious knots. first of all they are affordable and so fresh and most importantly tasty.

Best place in Takapuna. From day one wok n noodle became our favourite and we have been quite a few times now and every single time is delicious. The turn around time is so fast your food will be with you within 5min and piping hot. And really amazing value for your money. Staff are such gems.
Needs to advise a more accurate closing time. Why does it close at 1:45pm on a Saturday? Peak lunch hour!? Management needs to advertise correct business hours to stop wasting people's time.
Very nice people and food (paratha rolls). Cheaper than other places. I wish they open resturant.

Travelled all the way from Central and visited this restaurant randomly. Didn't disappoint at all. Best Noodles and Chinese cuisine I have ever tasted in Auckland. This really felt authentic chinese food. Food comes warm and quick. Soup is delicious.

Enjoyed the food here! I had the cumin lamb hand-pulled noodles, and they were delicious. The noodles were perfectly chewy and bouncy, beautifully coated in a rich, cumin-spiced oil sauce that was full of flavor. We also tried the pork and chive dumplings in sour soup, which were equally tasty. The soup had a pleasantly fragrant sourness, flavourful without being overpowering. Delicious food at a great price.

Ordered Chicken Chow Mein, I got fried noodles in heaps of soy sauce, with onions and sprouts, along with 1 medium size piece of chicken, 2 small pieces and 3 pieces about the size of a 10cent piece, all for $18. Tasted bland. No vegetables in sight. Would never recommend at all
A great place to have chinese buns. Tasty, great place to dine.
Delicious beef brisket rice, Kung Pao Chicken rice The buns are awesome Braised Beef Brisketon Rice, 😋 Yummy Sweet and Sour Chicken on Rice 😋 Yummy 😋 Buns are awesome

I have been going to Sushi House & Donburi for many years and it's been my favourite spot to eat on the Shore. The sushi is always fresh and consistently delicious, with a wide variety to choose from. Their prices are extremely fair and among the most affordable for sushi. The staff are incredibly friendly, welcoming and kind. Over the years they’ve remembered me and treated me with genuine warmth. Their service is efficient without feeling rushed and offers exceptional hospitality. Highly recommended.

Absolutely amazing service, I’ve been coming for years and the staff are always the most friendly and helpful! Delicious sushi, nice and fresh and such good prices compared to other places!! I legit drive 30 mins from my house just for this place it’s great and a must come spot!!

Holy wow! I knew it would be good just by the look of it, hands down the best sushi I have ever had, I was going to go to a spot to eat it but found myself to excited and scoffed it down outside, it was better than I already thought it would be, the two staff were super kind and genuine, good energy to start the day off to, please, if you want sushi and you want good sushi, go to this place, I’m still eating it as I speak with a massive grin on my face

This cozy little Malaysian restaurant serves authentic and delicious Malaysian cuisine. I tried the chicken laksa, a fried noodle dish, and a tofu dish, all were full of flavor and truly satisfying. You're welcome to help yourself to water and soup here. The place is quite small, so consider yourself lucky if you manage to find a table.

Second Visit, Second Chance. And Worth It! This was my second time here. The first visit? Honestly, the food felt pretty average and just didn’t click with my taste buds. But this time, I decided to give it another shot and lucky me, everything we ordered hit the spot! The Sarawak Kolo Mee was delicious, with great texture and flavor. The Fried Kuey Teow had that wok hei aroma that makes it extra satisfying.

Excellent food, wonderful prompt service and great decor! We ordered the mango chicken curry and pork belly special, with roti and rice. Delicious! So flavoursome! Highly recommended to come with a group so you can try more dishes

I really liked this place! The food was authentic Sri Lankan, the portion sizes were huge, and the owners were super nice. The kitchen looked really clean too. A bit spicy for me, but still fine. I’ll definitely be back!
Exquisite Sri Lankan food. Can truly taste the difference in the food made by people that love what they do. Highly recommend. Very generous portions, absolutely worth every dollar.

This place is definitely a gem! The service is really great and quick. I absolutely loved the food, I got a chicken doner wrap and everything tasted just spectacular. Would definitely recommend anyone to come here for a bite to eat, prices are cheap compared to other Turkish places!
The only place in NZ where you can get good green szechuan pepper (flower pepper) soup. They also give free fresh chilli and flower pepper oil.
Very good value. Nice and spicy. Self-serve rice and sauce station is great.

I am half thai and love the food here. It's super authentic and tasty. Not only this but these guys are the absolute friendliest, and always so helpful with my UK - thai accent and will even run to the shop if they are out of stock! The food court looks a bit abandoned but it's worth venturing into to eat at thai noodle. The food is great!👍🏼

The roast duck was very tasty. The staff were okay, but the restaurant was very noisy. The staff were shouting a lot, so it was a bit hard to relax. Even though it was noisy, the food was good and worth trying.
Never ever have I been severed wonton sheets as wontons I paid $9 for wonton sheets not even a teaspoon of meat crazy never again

Delicious food at very reasonable prices. The lady boss is extremely friendly and helpful. I’ve read some comments saying the restaurant wasn’t clean or organized, but in my opinion, the owner has been taking very good care of the place. They took over from the previous restaurant, Love a Duck, which was honestly terrible. Since then, the improvement has been huge. For me, there’s no doubt this is one of the best Asian cuisine spots in the area.

Nice Lil tucked away place in Takapuna. I had the mushrooms it was so creamy and delicious. Strong cheese flavor. My partner had the waghu burger not sure he was impressed however the service was amazing and good price to size ratio. Wheel chair accessible and has a nice large outdoor area.
Asked for a McCrispy with extra cheese. Got no lettuce and no cheese. Also asked for a strawberry thick shake and got banana. Happens ALL the time at the Belmont McDonalds.

Staff were rude and disorganized rolling in after the advertised opening time and rudely refusing entry with no good explanation. The advertised opening time is 6am, do not trust this as they are lying. Not a reliable source for a hungover feed(spent 4 hours walking here whilst under influence and have been severely disappointed, heading to the trusty highbury maccas)

We ordered a supreme minus Italian sausage and a few other things. They sent what I can’t even call a pizza or supreme as per the photos. Do not order this for the price they charge. HIGHLY DISAPPOINTED not even any vegetables.

**Amazing Pizza & Outstanding Service!** I recently ordered from Pizza Hut in Belmont, and I was blown away by the quality and taste of the food! The pizza was fresh, hot, and loaded with delicious toppings—just the way I like it. The crust was perfectly crispy, and the cheese was so gooey and flavorful. What really stood out was the **fantastic customer service**. The staff was friendly, efficient, and made sure my order was correct. The delivery was super fast, and everything arrived in perfect condition. If you're craving great pizza in Belmont, **Pizza Hut is the place to go**! I’ll definitely be ordering again soon. Highly recommend!
From the moment I walked into this establishment my senses were heightened, what an experience! Would recommend to the whole family

It's been nice to feel welcomed and humbled - buying from this clean and uplifting takeaway store.. The staff are easily approached and fun to order with and be served by.. The food is quality and cooked within' good timely fashion.. The prices are competitive and with it's broad menu and exceptional customer service.. You turn up hungry and leave feeling like a friend.. A++
Good food and service. Reasonable price for the huge portion. Definitely recommend and will come back many times
That always be my favourite place to taste！Nice and taste food ！Well Down！

I was able to try the Hong Kong style fried noodles and wontons and really enjoyed both. I loved how the fried noodles wasn’t too oily, but was really taste and also had a variety of meats. The wontons were very hearty and size wise were quite large. Both foods reminded me a lot of home ☺️
Order a $10 chicken on chips and you get chicken on rice instead I asked for mayo sweet chill And got it on rice , Like bro that's disgusting 🫣
We have, on several occasions, ordered takeaway, and the Thai food has been very delicious! 💫✔️😋👌🏼
HIGHLY RECOMMENDED. We ordered 9 different meals. They were all yum! $10 meals for the kids? Such a great deal! And the service? Fantastic!

Curry’s are AMAZING! PLENTY of meat in a serving. So many different options from across North and South India. Great flavours. Great pricing. The staff are always so friendly and happy to answer questions and provide recommendations. Always love going to Cuisine India Belmont.

Absolutely amazing food!! Always plenty of meat and the taste is outstanding!! The best curries I have had. Always go here for curry and never ever disappointed. Staff are amazing and the service is second to none!! 10/10 and always recommend
Good portion, really savory

From the moment we arrived, Mudbrick completely exceeded expectations. The food was absolutely exceptional — every dish was thoughtfully prepared, beautifully presented, and bursting with flavor. The service was just as impressive: warm, attentive, and genuinely welcoming without ever feeling overbearing. And the view? Simply breathtaking. Overlooking the vineyards and the ocean beyond, the setting is nothing short of magical. The combination of stunning surroundings, impeccable service, and world-class cuisine makes Mudbrick a truly special destination. We’ll definitely be back — it’s a place that stays with you long after you leave. Thank you.

We visited the winery as part of a bus tour - the view and gardens were to die for, so beautiful and iconic. The wine tasting experience was awesome and we regret not buying a bottle of the Chardonnay. Would return - we had a great time.

The views and seating at Mudbrick are absolutely epic. Easily some of the best on Waiheke. Caroline was amazing: warm, attentive, and made the whole experience feel special. The food was fine, but it’s the setting and service that truly make it worth visiting. Hiring people like Caroline really makes the difference, turning a beautiful location into an unforgettable experience.

The cocktails and pizza we had were incredible—definitely the best gluten-free pizza I've ever tasted! The service was top-notch, although the calamari was a bit rubbery. They were really apologetic about it and took it off our bill, which I appreciated.
Food brilliant, service exceptional, servings generous! Especially the pork belly. And when Mud made an appearance, topped off a wonderful birthday celebration! Thank you

11 years in service for Waiheke, the proof is in the pudding. The atmosphere and venue is cozy. The service is amazing. The food is even better. The baby back pork ribs-the meat literally falls off the bone. The spicy chicken wings- your nose runs in a good way. The slow cooked Lamb shank, Scotch fillet and if youre like me wanting to try something different-wild Goat curry are absolutely delicious. Kids are catered for too so makes for a good family outing.

The smoked baby back pork ribs were absolutely incredible — tender, juicy, and packed with flavor. The smoky aroma hit as soon as the food landed on the table, and the meat just fell off the bone. Perfect balance of seasoning and sauce without being overwhelming. Easily some of the best ribs I’ve had, and I’ll definitely be coming back for more!

Tried to dine there tonight after looking at menu that said they cater for allergies and had build your own pizza etc. We arrived and once I asked what I could eat off menu as a ceiliac person all the food I asked if it was safe for me the answer I got was IT SHOULD BE. I asked her to check with chef and that's when she came back saying that he not want to serve me and can be 100% and he not sure what I can eat. If your going to offer food options and you offer gluten free if would be a good idea to actually have food safe for me to eat. We had ordered a drink and once they realized that I was Har to cater to there was no more service for 20 minutes and when we decided to leave and pay for drinks she then asked if I still wanted to order. Sorry but I need to say they are poorly equipped to run or understand food requirements.

Everyone has a Malone's story on Waiheke. It can be a lively place where the number of eyes a person has outnumber the remaining teeth they have on display but the main issue here is the owner. The first time I went in I ordered a Guinness and the owner left my pint behind the bar for ten minutes while she was finishing her poker game. She then huffed and puffed when I ordered a second pint as it was apparently an imposition for her to do her job. Another time we were in there at 5pm and were drinking for 90 mins when she came over said "there's a band on at 7 so if you want to stay we will have to charge you a cover charge to see the show." We said we didn't want to see the band so could we sit outside and free up these seats for paying patrons to marvel at the local talent. She said we could still hear the band from outside and therefore we would need to pay. So, we went elsewhere and never returned.

Best spring rolls ever!!! So fresh and delicious every time. The wedges are also amazing. Great flavours. My son rates the pies 10/10. Great bakery on the island. Always our go to. Thanks for great food and great service.
Only eaten from here a few times but each one was great.

Hands down one of the best burgers I've had in a long time went to waiheke for the day to deliver a shed and got stuck waiting for the ferry back so went to this place and topnotch will definitely stop in here again when over.

This place was amazing. Best chips I have ever had, hands down. I wish I bought the fish too, however I am sure it would be just as good. All the trimmings, a variety of sauces, and a great man. Thank you!
Tried the Angus beef brisket today. Favourite part of the meal is the fatty soft part of the brisket! Really nice atmosphere as well. Will be back for more :)

Not much atmosphere in the shop itself but Kiran and his wife do the most amazing Indian food on the island. Great to see that his business has taken off and been embraced by the locals who know him so well.

I have been here multiple times since it first opened the quality of food has just gotten worst and worst and worst. Last night i wanted to order adjadz because they never disappoint. I was left with no choice so i ordered butter chicken the chicken was dry and chewy and the sauce was watery and tasteless last week i order a dal and samosa and the dall was watery and tasteless aswell!! i was not impressed with the samosa either adjaz always gives me free popadoms

Got this vegan pizza with alternative Chicken and Bacon and was very surprised by the amount of toppings. Was delicious, perfectly cooked, and the sauce was great. Nice guy behind the counter too. If this place was in AKL it would be my new go-to. Well done, thank you.

A genuine Waiheke experience. Want to see terrible karaoke or quiz teams want to kill each other? Want to see a man spend all of his money on the pokies and drop his trousers? Want to get cheap beer? If the answer is yes, then give the RSA a shot as you won't be disappointed. The chef has changed over the years and sometimes this can be great. Sometimes not so much.

We get breakfast delivered for our builders every few weeks - usually the Twisted Cinnamon Bun Box and the Calzone Box - they are always hugely appreciated and apparently devoured in minutes - as they are so super tasty. Thank you for always making online ordering so easy - I can place an order at 4.45pm one day and the goods are delivered hot and fresh to site at 7am the next morning. Very impressive
Incredible! Worth the trip to NZ alone! Food was one of, if not the best meal I’ve ever had and paired with the wines just made the whole experience memorable! Thank you!
Delicious food, gorgeous view, great wine and awesome olive oil. I bought two bottles of olive oil from here as it is rich in flavour. If I have to go to Auckland again I will go back to this place!

The roast for two was a win for me. Very good pork crackling. Also loved the hands on experience when we ordered the lemon meringue very fun. The venue was gorgeous aswell loved the choice of decor and ambiance. Staff where also very friendly and helpful.

We loved the little balcony overlooking the vineyards and the wine/beer was wonderful. We lucked out that the brewery was open till 8pm because we took the bus out around 4 not realizing that almost all of the wineries on the island close at 5pm and thought we'd be stuck out in the country with nowhere to go! Thank goodness for this gem, it really saved our evening. If you run into the same problem - look up Alibi Brewing at the same location for later hours.
As always, an excellent lunch on Father’s Day. Great food, wine options, service, ambience. You won’t be disappointed!
Warm service and delicious food made me fall in love with this island.We came from Oakland. This is the first one I found.The Ice mocha is so beautiful, love it

My partner and I were looking for a place to hold a small ceremony for our marriage and the staff at The Heke could not be more accommodating to us. They set up a lovely area outside for us to hold our ceremony and they went above and beyond to make sure it was perfect and it was! We had lunch after the event was finished and was delicious! We even tried their Whiskey and beer and that was so good too. Thank you so much for an unforgettable day, we will be back to try out more of the menu in the future for sure!
Cool Service. Very friendly 😀
Pretty standard Chinese food really but they do use some MSG in the food. The staff seem fairly friendly but it depends on who you get and if they know you.

It’s an amazing place to eat. The best pizzas I’ve ever had, made by a genuine Italian chef. The gelatos are incredible — amazing flavor and texture. Even the vanilla ice cream, which is usually simple, has an outstanding taste. Top-notch cuisine and very friendly staff. Great job, guys!

Casual atmosphere across from the beach at Onerangi Waiheke Island. Somewhere you can mingle with the locals. Food is good, more casual bar meals. Drinks are cold and team are polite and helpful. Can bring the kids and also Dogs. Only thing that could be improved is the toilet area is real small. Place is clean and tidy.

My wife and I had lunch at Three Seven Two today and loved it. I ordered the Whole Flounder, which was deftly prepared, tender and tasty. My wife ordered the Duck Breast, which was very flavorful and enjoyed immensely. It should be noted that our dishes were preceded by a plate of bread with olive oil. The bread was wonderful and the olive oil was good. The ambience in Three Seven Two is calm, clean, bright and comfortable. Service was excellent. I highly recommend Three Seven Two for quality food in a wonderful atmosphere.

Excellent food, warm service, and a cozy atmosphere made our dining experience unforgettable. Every dish was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. The staff was attentive and friendly without being intrusive. The ambiance was perfect for a relaxed evening out. Highly recommend for anyone looking for quality dining and great service.

Perfect place to take my mother for her birthday lunch. We had a wonderful time and the food was divine - including the On-e-tangy cocktail and the 'Happy Birthday' dessert. And it was lovely to be able to sit with a wee dog on the enclosed deck. Highly recommended

Dined here for dinner and cocktails with my husband. Excellent service. Amazing cocktails. Great food. Beautiful atmosphere. Very smart casual. Price wise at the higher end but very well worth it. The best dinner views on the island. Highly recommend.

One of the best meals we’ve had in a long time! Highly recommend dinner here, stunning views and food is exceptional by Chef Vicky. Especially enjoyed the croquettes, lamb and tagliatelle. We’ll be back!
Always excellent (Allpress) coffee and delicious food. Tulas the barrista is a treasure. Highly recommended.

It's a beautiful place that I'm glad I found about when attending an event celebrating a new skincare line in NZ. The entrance is enchanting, well manicured gardens and the place inside is very grand with huge gorgeous chandeliers. See for yourselves in the photos.
Ordered green curry with prawns and chicken cashew nut stir fry. We were so impressed with the freshness and quantity of the prawns, chicken and vegetables. What a great meal! Very happy!!!

Salmon quiche was excellent creamy with avocado yum! But the lamb filo definitely disappointed reminded me of the rsa I should of asked if it was tender lamb my fault for expecting that but it could definitely do with a modern update as u would expect with a lovely modern cafe like moon

Mix review . BLAT was very good Coffee was nice but small Brownie was a dry mess but reason for low score is how is a big breakfast $32 and a bowl of chips $12 . Says premium but yet is just a bag of frozen chips . Big breakfast 2 min down the road is 22 and chips 7 and very good and not oven chips. Such a shame. Staff are very good though .

Lovely English style restaurant. Easy parking and access. Consistently good food and attentive staff. Good choice of menus and drinks. Nice wood fire for chilly days/nights and inviting outdoor area too. As you can see one plate did contain scallops on it - yummm

A beautiful place with nice young people trying their best to offer you a nice experience, but food was average without any wow factor...and one dish in particular, was beyond ridiculously small portion on a big plate...menu should be revised, in my opinion...reduced (far too many pages!) and improved!

Went here for lunch and it was absolutely amazing !. Not a huge fan of eggplant but I always like to choose something different/or a dish that im not a big fan of, hoping the chefs can change my mind...and did they this time !!!Wow...had the eggplant starter and it was incredible, literally the star of the show. From the flavour- texture to presentation. It was just delicious. Had the Maple BBQ beef burger and Chicken Parma. Tasty- fresh. Portions size were huge. Staff attentive and atmosphere was perfect. Highly recommend and will definitely be back !!!

Rather than ordering a takeaway from our favourite Indian restaurant, the wife and I decided to dine in, hands down the best Indian experience we’ve had ever. Amazing service and even better food, outstanding!!
Absolutely the best food ever. Generous portions. Amazing flavors. Highly recommend this wonderful restaurant for either dining in or takeout.

It was our first time coming to Tandoori and I needed to say how amazing the customer service was by Arsh? (Apologies for getting the name wrong) Also the owner I think, took our leftover dishes for takeaway instead of handing us takeaway containers which was a lovely touch, not many restaurants do this nowadays so thank you. Arsh went above and beyond for us and was a nice guy. We loved the Kerala beef fry ! First time seeing this on an Indian restaurant menu and we were glad that we tried it. Great to see some authentic Indian dishes !

We ordered catering for 40 people...the food was awesome and the service was really good as well. Staff was very easy to communicate. Should really try their food, especially mutter paneer, dal makhni. and chicken curry.Thank you Sunil and all the staff good work.👍💯
Tasty Creamed Mushrooms for me and Scrambled Eggs and Bacon for him. Great presentation and both served with plenty of sourdough bread. Good coffee too.

Haven't tried the food, but in terms of vibes this might be my favourite place I've been in NZ. It's not fancy, it's just lovely. The staff are incredibly friendly, it seems to be busy whenever we go on. I love this place.

A cosy and warm tavern with a very friendly and attentive bar tender. Glen makes everyone feel welcome and happily shows interest in his patrons. Fire was roaring and the food was delish. We ordered Surf and Turf along Smoked Chicken with Bacon and Crispy Noodles. Both dishes were scrumptious. Complements to the chefs!

After hearing and seeing nothing but good things about this place, I was highly disappointed last night. Ordered a mussel fritter - got served a corn fritter… This was quickly corrected but then I was met with essentially a batter fritter. I don’t think there was even one whole mussel in the fritter… about 3 specs 🤣 1/10 will definitely NOT be ordering from here again

Terrible coffee, bitter and barely warm. Had i the patience and time to go back and complain i would have done so. I think because they are understaffed, the coffee in takeaway cups is already pre- brewed and waiting some place. I didn't even see anyone make my coffee as I was observing them. Spoiled my nice apple pies. Stores is New though.

This place is an absolute disgrace to the McDonald’s name. I ordered a Chicken & Bacon combo and got a dry, depressing chicken patty slapped between two buns no bacon, no lettuce, no sauce, nothing. It looked like a half-finished sandwich made by a toddler during a power outage. The Bacon & Egg McMuffin? No egg. Literally. Just bacon and muffin. At that point, I was almost impressed by how consistent they were at being incompetent. The double cheeseburger looked like someone sat on it and then thought, “Eh, good enough.” It was completely flattened, crumpled, and had an actual handprint embedded in the bun ,no exaggeration. Every item was in the wrong wrapper. Fries were cold, soggy, and thrown in like they were being punished. No napkins. No straws. No care. If you're thinking of visiting this location don’t. It’s not even “bad fast food” levels of bad. It’s actively offensive. You’re better off eating literally anything else including the paper the food was (incorrectly) wrapped in. One star feels way too generous for this dumpster fire of a restaurant. This McDonald’s needs a complete staff overhaul, better management, or just to be shut down entirely. Pathetic.

Really disgusting. The burgers were dripping in grease, see photo attached. I can't believe it was given to us like that, considering we had to park up and wait so long. This McDonald's lacks basic standards, they just never improve. Don't bother wasting ur time here, place needs to be shutdown.

Absolute terrible experience on the 18/09/2025 at 8pm by an young female employee. We went inside to order food. I ordered a mcflurry and a combo, when my order was ready, the lady slid my food across the counter and didn’t give me a spoon or straw. I took one scoop out of my mcflurry and the whole of the inside was missing, when I asked for a full McFlurry she just looked at me, snatched it out of my hand and walked off then returned with extra on top. Not a single word from her, no sorry, not a peep. I get it’s only mcdonalds but it’s not cheap anymore, we’re paying decent money for shit food and the workers can’t even say a simple hi or thank you, nor a single smile. Customer service since Covid has just been shocking. Sort it out Mcdonalds in Kumeu!!! Outrageous

As a busy mum, I really want to like my local Maccas. It is indeed a nice new facility. However they just cannot get their drive thru orders right. There is always something that is different from the order they took, or they take the order wrong although everyone in the car has heard me mentioning it several times. I always ask for no sugar syrup in my coffee. 4 out of 5 times the coffee comes with syrup. I always ask for extra pickle (which I pay for), there are only 2 pieces or there are no pickles at all or if I am lucky I get then all but they are placed in one giant stack. A few times they gave me a totally different burger. I remember waiting 10 mins for a softserve, I was eventually handed a refund for, after waiting another 5 mins... NO apology! When they were new I though may be give then time and they will get it right but this might just be my last sugary coffee from them 🫠
Lovely tasty good sized meals. Recommend A+
The food is superb and very reasonably priced. Service is great, they missed a dish from our order but arranged to get it delivered straight away , can’t fault their service. Thanks guys

Absolutely terrible customer service! They got our order wrong, sent us a small instead of a large size pizza, and then proceeded to argue/yell over the phone instead of any offer to resolve the issue. Told us we were wrong but when we checked the order/receipt, we paid for a large. They then put us on hold for ages before hanging up on us. All they had to do was send us what we ordered/paid for. Be warned, we will never order from this Domino's again.

Saiyad, what a bloody legend he deserves a promotion absolute homie does a great job even by himself he’ll give motivation and confidence, customer service was absolutely amazing out of most businesses I’ve been to, wish him the best of luck in future.
Visited first time today. Honestly, best fish and chips in Auckland. Fresh fish, perfect crispy well cooked batter, and chips. Very kind and friendly service. Thank you, will be back soon 🌼
Food is bland and is missing seasoning, can taste the fact its not made with love. Very disappointing & i wouldn't recommend. Good view takeaway kumeu is much better

We drove all the way here to get the original garlic potatoes, but the staff was rude and refused to make it before 4pm. The service was unfriendly. The new owners are certainly not employing good staff
This is only take away, but excellent pizza. Love the plant based vegan options.

Omg! The best pie ever! My son and I stopped for a chicken Cranberry and camembert pie .... so good I had to return for another the very next day. And their cornish patties are to die for 😋. Been going there for a while with partner and every time we are delighted by the food, service, and overall great presentation. Thanks team for a great dining experienceYOU ROCK! 😃

I come from a country where we truly value a good charcoal-grilled chicken with fries, and this is the best I’ve had so far in New Zealand. Unfortunately, I moved from Kumeu, and my heart broke thinking I wouldn’t have them close anymore. But I still come all the way from Paremoremo to buy here. God bless your chicken, the owner of the place, and the wonderful team who serves!

Great atmosphere. Food is really delicious. The only reason for 4 stars is that the steak was a little bit over cooked, but luckily still pink. The stuffed chicken was fantastic, the peppercorn sauce the star of the show! Friendly staff and prompt service. Great restaurant with good variety. Today, I couldn't fault anything. And the 2 girls that served us were SO amazing!! It felt like home! Thank you so much!

Delicious. Better then any other American BBQ place we've been to! The sides were all delicious, especially the Mac n cheese. We got The Full Monty and it was superb! Only bummer is how far away it is from South Auckland lol But we'd definitely return on another special a occasion. Oh and service was amazing, from the moment we first walked in the doors.
First timer here, loved the food! The portions were really big and we had a lot left over to take home. Great value for money and a perfect spot for meat lovers. Will definitely go back again.

After visiting Muriwai me and a friend popped in to have the amazing brisket burger along with a spicy chicken burger also. Comes with fries, pickles and coleslaw the perfect amount to fill us up. Aashi there was nice and cold and really refreshing also. Highly recommend keep up the good work.

We came here to celebrate Father’s Day, and us being foodies - we ordered the FULL Monty Platter for a variety of choices. If you’re gonna eat somewhere for the first time, why not go all out. All meats were so tender and falls off the bone. The kids loooooved the Mac n cheese. I had to order the house salad to kinda break ALL DAT MEEEATY GOLD!!! So Devine. The platter is served for 6-7 but in Polynesian language that’s 3-4 lol we still took so much leftovers home. It was also my very first time trying American styled smoke bbq. So worth every coin - very kid friendly environment, gutted I forgotten my go pro to vlog. Highly recommend. 11/10 for me and my aiga.

Ordered via the app they direct to and food was speedy and delicious!! Only problem for us as two people was that we had to order $80 worth of food to get delivered - but more than happy with our leftovers!
