Very disappointed in the food quality. Ordered 5x pizzas and sides. Husband picked up only to get home and discover the ingredients were minimal and the crust very overcooked almost inedible. Absolutely wasted our money on this meal, The ingredients were more in the centre and nothing on the outside. Didn't taste nice at all. We won't be returning nor will our other family members who usually order from here. Our dog wouldn't eat it. This is not the first time we have ordered from here, we're hoping they had improved.
This is a decades-old store. Every time I go to the Bird Island, I come here to eat. The food is very delicious and the portions are generous!

Cold roast. I live 5 mins from here and had to heat it up in the microwave when I got home… No flavour, lacking a lot seasoning and they really struggle to understand basic English. The pork crackle wasn’t crackled it was soft. The atmosphere is very old and run down. Would not recommend

We get Naan from here every week but for a special birthday dinner recently, we asked if they could cater for 11 people and just give us an Indian feast... it was absolutely AMAZING! Platters, curries, Naan, samosa, raita, chutney, kebabs, biryani, dipping sauces, a special bread and butter pudding, an off menu special curry, some things I didn't even know what they were but they were delicious, seriously WOW! They were so happy that we chose them to cater our special event and put so much care into the food and presentation. They really care about the food they make and it shows. Best Indian food in Auckland, and run by the absolute nicest people! Customers for life.

You guys have the best team and food in New Zealand! There is nothing better than Shahi curries. Been going here plenty times and these guys never disappoint. Always super friendly even when super busy; they have the best manners and we appreciate you guys so much. Their quality of food is always beyond other places and their fresh naan that comes out their tandoori oven is to die for! If you haven't been here life hasn't started!!!

The food was good, especially the momos, which were tasty and well-cooked. However, the experience was let down by some unexpected extra charges. They charged extra for additional momo chutney, which was surprising since most places usually offer that as part of the dish. They also charged extra for takeaway boxes for leftover food without any prior notice. This wouldn’t have been a big issue if the food was reasonably priced, but the prices were already on the higher side. When you're paying a premium, these small add-ons should either be included or at least clearly communicated upfront. If it were a budget-friendly place, such extra charges might be understandable. But at this price point, it just feels like poor customer service.

10/10 tried the sweet banana & Nutella crepe!, and the beautiful savoury ham cheese & mushrooms. These crepes are aaaawesome, could be for having lunch or just killing a crave! Prices, size, everything really good!
Great food great taste i'm gonna come back soon 😁😁😁

Met up with some long lost friends fo lunch. This place is awesome. Great setting, great food, great service. Yep everything was great. I dont very often give 5 stars, but in this case they earned it. 👍
Great place for family and group dinning. A bit nosy inside with loud music. Tesla fast charger available in the parking area.

I booked this venue for a birthday party group of 24 and was really impressed by the quality of the venue, open space and seating catering for diverse groups. Neve was extremely friendly and the whole team took amazing care of us making the whole experience extremely gratifying. The quality of the food coupled with the range and quality of drinks makes this venue a must. I will definitely be returning and so many of my friends were also impressed by this wonderful brewery!! Thank you for making my birthday that much more special!!
Wow the food is immaculate! Today was our first time visiting and it was so good. Way more than what we expected. We will definitely be back for more and with more family.

The Landing was recommended in response for my request for ‘REALLY good pub food’ with a great atmosphere for my birthday lunch, and they did not disappoint! The menu is perfect, something for every taste without too many options, and everything was delicious! The service was fabulous, they have a great team, and the atmosphere was absolute bliss by the riverside. Highly recommend!
Had the seafood chowder, it was awesome! Friendly service and relaxing atmosphere. Coffee was nice as well.
Loved the cute lil cafe. Got a french toast, and it was absolutely delicious. The coffee was on point. The service was friendly, and the atmosphere was super nice.

Nice pub in Greenhithe with a good pizza oven and that nice wood fired smell! I went for the Tandoori pizza this time but have tried other things on the menu didn’t disappoint. Good selection of drinks with friendly staff it’s a family favourite.

Great food and service. Been coming here for nearly 20 years but haven't been since 2019. Was just as great as it's always been. Amazing to see the charter map on the wall from my grandfather (Rod Oehlers).

Staff were very attentive and accommodating, food came out quickly but was also extremely tasty. We ordered the tandoori mixed platter followed by Chicken tikka masala and Chicken achari. Will definitely be back

I had a wonderful experience at The Red Fort Indian Restaurant & Bar. The food was absolutely delicious, full of authentic flavors and beautifully presented. The staff were warm, attentive, and made us feel very welcome throughout our visit. The interior is elegant and comfortable, creating the perfect atmosphere to enjoy a meal with friends and family. Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for great Indian food with excellent service and ambiance. I’ll definitely be coming back.

I had a fantastic experience at Red Fort Indian Restaurant. From the moment I walked in, the warm and welcoming atmosphere made me feel comfortable. The staff were incredibly friendly, attentive, and professional, ensuring everything was perfect throughout my visit. The food was outstanding – full of authentic flavors, perfectly spiced, and beautifully presented. The curries were rich and aromatic, the naan was soft and fresh, and every dish tasted freshly prepared with high-quality ingredients. Portion sizes were generous, and the menu offered a great variety for both vegetarians and non-vegetarians. What stood out most was the balance of excellent service and delicious food at very reasonable prices. Red Fort truly delivers a memorable dining experience, whether for a casual meal or a special occasion. I would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for genuine Indian cuisine in Auckland. I’ll definitely be coming back!

Great food! Not just boring butter chicken, they have several interesting dishes that we've not come across before. All the food was cooked well and tasted great, and wasn't just gloopy brown sauce. The portion sizes were good and the price was reasonable. I think they should screen the door, as it let in a big chill draught whenever someone entered - next time we'd try to sit in a different spot. Overall though, it exceeded expectations, and we'll go back.

Quality Chinese takeaways, with generous portion sizes for the price. As a regular patron I have found their options to be flavorful and fresh. The meat cuts used are decent and well prepared. Highly recommend the sweet and sour pork.

The food was nice. When to celebrate my uncle's birthday. Was great. Customer service was very nice. Staff running around collecting dirty plates. The seafood is very yummy and seafood chowder. Good for coming with your family and friends. There's a pokie machine in there and ATM. Nice and clean place. Toilets there...
Since 1989 in Pakuranga, Auckland, grew to 18 locations in NZ but now only this one & Manukau left...

We went for dinner for a birthday. The staff were lovely, they were actually the highlight, they interacted with our toddler - she got three replacement balloons after popping them, cleaned tables promptly. Was a nice evening, and the food was nice too. We'll be back!

Visited BurgerFuel late at night around 11pm and was really impressed. Raj provided amazing service – super friendly, welcoming, and took the time to ask about my dietary requirements, even offering alternatives, which really impressed me, Even that late, the food was fresh and great. Really appreciate the effort and hospitality, Excellent late-night experience and great service from Raj!will definitely come back!
Delicious burger + really helpful and friendly staff! Easy to park as well. Great dining experience will definitely come back again!

I have been coming here for 15+ years and the last few times I have come for dinner, the food has been almost inedible. The food is flavourless and it does not taste fresh whatsoever. The food used to be so good, but now I will never come here again.

Narita - Wairau Valley. First Japanese restaurant that lacked in service big time compared to what I’m use to in the city and out south. I have been here years ago and service was great. That’s why I revisited while I was in the area, but sadly this time it wasn’t as welcoming. I had to initiate everything because I wasn’t sure if my order was going to be taken at the table or if I needed to go up to the counter. Waited a bit too long while looking at the menu and decided to go up instead. I get annoyed if you ask if I’m taking away when I place an order. Like EXCUSE me SIR, I’m obviously here to eat in 🤦🏽‍♀️ + paid straightaway. Haha maybe it’s because I’m a big brown gal lol 😂. An Asian couple walked in and was greeted + menu was given with order taken not long after at their table. Sigh!. Anyhow, interior is nice and clean. Food is okay, miso was bland. Everything else was enjoyable. This Unagi meal set was $36.90.

I’ve always been a fan of Denny’s and especially loved the hot fudge cake, which is why I keep coming back. However, to my surprise, the one served to us tonight was very disappointing. It had less chocolate syrup, no ice cream, and no cherry. How could that be? Even a simple explanation would have been appreciated, but unfortunately, none was given. Truly sad and not what I expected from Denny’s.

the hot fudge cake is the best dessert in auckland. been coming to dennys for years and the dessert selection has never missed. our server jo was very accomodating and friendly as well, overall a great experience

We order most weeks for pick up from this store and the food quality is always great with the lust, wedges and chicken tenders that we get. The guy who is always working there (possibly the manager?) is always so cheerful and kind, can't help walking out with a smile each time! Thank you!!!

Dirtiest McDonald’s in Aotearoa! I was so shocked to have witnessed this myself. I’ve had so many say to NEVER go to Glenfield McDonald’s because it is the most disgusting place to dine in. I had to pick up my son from this place after his sports match because they ended up grabbing a feed with team mates. I walked in to get me some dinner while I wait (which I decided not too after what I saw🤮) The photos don’t really show you how filthy this place was. But it was so filthy the floors and tables look greasy and needed a really good mop & spray/disinfect and wipe down. All bins were over flow and rubbish was hanging out of the bins. Rubbish everywhere on and under the tables napkins look like it was thrown around the room. How does it even get to this state and would only be because no one’s come out to the foyer area and cleaned for hours or maybe since lunch time. What is so hard of sending 1 or 2 people for 5-10 minutes to change the bins and clear the tables? It wasn’t busy and no one was in the dining area. I don’t get it but they should definitely rethink the manager on the 10pm shift Weds 13th.

Had dinner on a Sunday night. The restaurant was not overly busy. Ordered the food and it came out fairly fast in regular intervals. We did have to check on our last dish, which seemed like they had forgotten until I asked about it. The free soup was lukewarm. Overall, the food was pretty good and tasty. Have been for yumcha in the past and it can be quite hectic.

The food is good, probably the best in the mall. However, the service really needs improvement. On several occasions, I was left standing at the counter waiting to be served. A staff member from the kitchen saw me but didn’t acknowledge me, call another staff, or even say hello. She just waited until another staff member came, which meant I had to wait unnecessarily before being served.

NEVER AGAIN! After I ordered 2 Zinger combos on 14 Oct. 2025, I got this with 2 warm cans of coke. I asked the server (Mo) where is the glass and ice as per advertisement, but she said they dont have glases neither do they have ice. When I start drinking the Coke, it was not cold at all, and then my order was ready, but back at the table i found that in both combos dont have any chicken. I took everything back and complaint to the supervisor who told me that the can feels cold to her. I said well, if you look at the fridge behind you, fully stock then this could mean that if this was stocked an hour ago the cans may feel cold outside, but the drink is not! I then ask her where is the chicken and again she was trying to bullshit me by telling me that they unfortunately swopped the wrong orders BUT, there is no order in KFC where you get bread rolls without chicken, unless my order was meant to be for a vegetarian. When she then started to argue with me in order to prove some point, I said that I want to return everything and get a refund. We did not start eating on anything. Due to this kind of customer experience, and this is not the first time, trust me, KFC Glenfield Mall will never see me again.
Ordered Chicken Wing, no wings and all thighs

Best curries! Lamb is always cooked to perfection. Naan bread is so fluffly it's like eating a buttery, garlic-y cloud. Yum!! Best food ever. Service when I picked up was awesome. The guys there are hilarious and up for yarns. So excited to know that they deliver themselves, so no more uber-eats. I'll be supporting their business directly from them now. Prices are amazing, especially for quality of food. Literally a Gem of India in my neighbourhood. Keep up the delicious work! 😍
Workers randomly left midway through order. Started handshaking the public instead of making my meal. 5/5 stars will come again.

Went to burger Wisconsin tonight and I can't say I was happy with my experience. Food was supposed to be ready for pick up at 6.30pm but wasn't ready until 7pm. Once the food finally came out it was cold and the quality of ingredients was extremely poor. Burger had no flavour like it should and was a sloppy mess. The Restaurant was unclean and kitchen looked greasy and dirty, (not the standard you would hope for such a well known establishment). The only positive thing I have to say was that staff were at least kind of friendly. Wouldn't recommend going here unless you wanna waste your money on a terrible burger. Go to McDonalds instead lol it will honestly be better and cheaper.
Excellent burgers. Gluten free available. Update: super nice staff let me in a few minutes after closing time to satisfy my hunger. Great attitude team! Another tasty burger too :-)
We use VJ and his team every Friday for staff lunch. Food and service is always exceptional. Would highly recommend for your catering needs.
We had a 2 day work conference and ordered multiple platters for lunch on both days. The food was delicious and the service was brilliant! Fantastic job guys! We really appreciate your helpfulness!
We ordered a few dim sum dishes and one 'Young Chow Fried Rice'. The dim sum were up to standard and the fried rice was good and the portion was decent.
Cool place, good service, quality tables, cold beers, what more could u want? My only complaint would be that the wings we ordered were rather small. But na cool place, will likely go back

Wouldn’t recommend ordering online. I ended up waiting just as long as I would have if I’d ordered in store. The staff first told me they never got my order, then later found it sitting on the other side of the counter by the door. On top of that, I got wrongly blamed for being 20 minutes late to pick it up.

Dinner for 3 tonight, guys were great at explaining each different dish. Best Butter chicken I’ve had in a while. Must try Chilli Chicken if you come here. Its a shame store was quiet on a Saturday night, these guys deserve the business.

Ordered via DoorDash, the Lamb Biryani was a scam and the worst I’ve tasted in Auckland. It looked, smelled, and tasted like a mixture of lamb curry and leftover or separately cooked rice. This suggests that all their biryani might follow the same standard. And it’s not cheap either—$24 for this scam! No wonder it was ready for pickup just seven minutes after ordering.
So is this what we call large onion rings is crazzyy the amount of how much you get is absolutely crazzy

My favourite dominos by far!!!!! Just grabbed a dessert pizza to try tonight but have been a couple of times before and the staff are always so lovely and the pizzas are always made with love. Would write 1000000 good reviews if I could!!!!
Ordered via Uber Eats. Cookie had a hair baked into the bottom of it which I almost ate 🤢

Dish Grilled fish with yellow rice and side salad Taste Fish was fresh but very plain, rice simple and very tiny and unremarkable, salad fresh but basic. Felt more like canteen food than a proper meal. Portion & Value Light and not filling for the price. Service Staff were friendly and the service was clean and efficient. Ambience Casual food-court vibe, nothing special. Score ⭐️⭐️ (2/5) – Clean but bland, not worth a repeat visit.
The seafood platter was tasty, enough for two or three people, and the staff was super friendly.
Every Friday we get the Lamb Madras special and six chicken nibbles. The food is delicious and tasty, the lamb is always tender. If you want a yummy curry, this is the place to go!!

I love to come here during my days off work to get a feed. The older guy who works there is always a pleasure to have a chat with. At this point i'm almost a regular haha. Helps that I live nice and locally.
Aloo Gobi (vegan) + garlic naan. This place is underrated and really good with custom orders, cheers.

Went at lunch but was served very quickly! The place was very clean and the staff was welcoming. We has some sushis from the cabinet which were very fresh. We also ordered the udon and pork don which was very nice. Highly recommend!!

Jang Teo is one of my favourite spots. They offer a wide variety of Korean dishes, which is their biggest strength. The portions are generally generous, though it can depend on what you order. Today, I had yeongyang-tang (nutritious soup), and my partner had donkatsu. The yeongyang-tang was quite good with a nice bit of spice that worked well. I finished the whole bowl. My partner’s donkatsu was tasty too. All the side dishes were delicious, and we both enjoyed the meal. Whenever I want Korean food but can’t decide what to get, I come to this restaurant. It’s a cozy, small place that I really like. I recommend it to anyone who enjoys Korean cuisine. They also offer takeaway, which adds to the convenience.
We were hungry in the afternoon and decided to find something to eat. Saw great reviews about this place and tried the small portion green curry chicken. It was really yum and great value too!
Very friendly staff very welcoming. The food is 10/10 and fast service. Green curry and the fried beef balls are to die for

Lady is rude, she kept on looking at me as I piled as much as I can on the big plate because there was no signage saying that you can't do this. I can feel her death stare. I know she wants to say something to me, but I don't know if she didn't know what to say, or whether she's waiting for me to drop food onto the tray. There is a sign that said no food on the takeaway lid or the tray next to the counter and I made sure that no food ended up on the tray, so what's the problem? I also made sure I finish everything on my plate. When I was there, there were no one else in line and there were still plenty of food in the metal containers.

An unexpected place to get food for dinner due to the unfamiliarity about the precinct. However, the food quantity is pretty good for the price tag despite the quality still has room for improvement. The taste of food is acceptable and definitely can be better. However, after reaching home and see what’s put on the takeaway package (photo attached), it’s very heart warming and definitely the first time seeing any eatery staff member showing such a kind gesture to the clients. For this reason, I personally will try to go back some other time to taste their different food items on the menu!

Best Kebab on the Shore in Auckland. The highlight of my visit was definitely the exceptional service provided by Sahib. His attentiveness and genuine friendliness made our meal memorable, ensuring that we felt well taken care of throughout our visit. The kebabs themselves were grilled to perfection, with a good balance of spices and fresh ingredients. Great food!! Must visit 🤩

Prawn fried rice: 5/5!! Fish&chips: 5/5 Sweet&sour Pork: 3/5 Honestly it's been a while since I had a yummy Chinese takeouts. Couldn't get over how fresh everything was & that fried rice omfg!!! To die for! Definitely recommending this to my family. Would of been a five stars rating if the chips was more 😂 that's $4 worth btw 😱
Lovely people and great food, today’s lunch, yummy! Highly recommend
The best dumplings I’ve ever had! They’re perfect! Top-notch customer service! The only thing is, for anyone wanting to dine in, the volume inside the place is way too high!
good value of money, nice chicken wings . Will definitely visiting again!!!!

It’s an authentic Korean restaurant where you can try Sot-bap (Korean hot stone pot rice). I’d recommend it to anyone looking for a warm, healthy meal. Good vegan/vegetarian options too. The staff are friendly, and the place is super clean!

Delicious and amazing sotbap experience! The rice was perfectly crisp at the bottom and the ingredients were fresh. I tried the seafood sotbap and ttukbaegi bulgogi - both were absolutely delicious and packed with flavour and umami. There were a variety of side dishes that came with each menu item. A must-visit restaurant for anyone craving authentic korean food! I'll definitely be back for more. Highly recommend!!

Absolutely delicious and satisfying! I ordered the galbi sotbap, and it was amazing! The portion of galbi was so generous. It was super tender, and went really well with the spring onions. I also tried the grilled mackerel, and it was perfectly seasoned — not too salty, just right. The staff were friendly and overall I was really satisfied. I’ll definitely be coming back again!

Tried sotbap for the first time . was curious what it tasted like. It basically felt like drinking soup with soft, slightly crispy rice. Nothing really stood out for me. Maybe it’s just not my kind of dish. For the price, I felt it was a bit expensive considering what we got in terms of flavor and portion size. The side dishes were also really small. Probably wouldn’t order it again, but glad i tried it once

Saw review of this place and was excited to try. We got the salmon sotbap and the option one sotbap with grilled fish as a side. We also got another tteok galbi to share. The idea is ok, and the rice that you scooped into the bowl didnt taste bad with the little bit of sides they offer. The instruction to add the water into the pot and cover is not good at all. It is just tasteless rice and I see no one else in the restaurant finished theirs. The salmon was the only good thing but something that can be made easily under $30 spending close to $80 for 2 is very underwhelming. Also they need to add some black curtains to block the sun. The tables have a sun glaring straight at them... Im so angry that I had high expectations of this place.

Been a local and frequent customer since the owners have been running the takeaways. Clean oil and great quality food and service, always! The family that run and own the business, are also members of the community and are great. Nothing but good to say about this Fish n chip shop. Try it out, and let the food speak for itself.
Yum! Great food at a great price. One of our regular go-tos, love this place!!

Beef and egg burger absolutely delicious it was nice and runny that's how I like it as for the chips the seasoning to die for. $21 very well spent i highly recommend you go and try one of there burgers with and side of fries and drink
Nice wontons and bouncy noodles (I asked for no bean sprouts). The broth was stronger than expected as a classic Cantonese wonton broth is more clear but it was still a very pleasant lunch for $16.99
Super cosy vibes that felt like a mini trip back to Japan. Ramen? Delicious. Karaage chicken? Giant portions for the price. Left stuffed, happy, and already planning my return. 🍜🐓💯
Recommended by a chef friend of mine, I love their ramen and perfect for this Winter Season. All time favorite Karaage and Butter Corn Ramen will always be on our order from the menu.

The service is fast and reliable, the food is always fresh and delicious, and the atmosphere is perfect for a family meal or casual catch-up. A special mention goes to Duty Manager Sam, who always serves with a big smile and ensures everything runs smoothly. Great food, great service, and a great place overall – highly recommend!

First time trying out Chicking. I wasn't sure if I'd like it or not. The food did not dissapoint. The flavours were just amazing. Meat quality was great as well since I'm very picky about my chicken. My daughter got the kids meal and she loved the chicken as well. I will be coming back here more often from now on. Highly recommended.

At Chickening, you’ll get to taste the crispiest, juiciest, and slightly spicy chicken—just the way I love it. They have amazing offers in-store, and the staff are super friendly. I’ve also heard that their chicken strips and wings are really good, so maybe I’ll try them next time.

Chicking never disappoints! Great variety from fried and grilled chicken to burgers and wraps. The flavors are tasty, the portions are good, and there’s something for everyone. Always a satisfying meal.
I got the Thai chicken pie and my son got the butter chicken pie. The pastry and taste were good, however the lack of chicken pieces and abundance of Jelly let the pie down.
The food was alright. Customer service ok. Heaps of variety of meat and veggies. Butter chicken was nice and sweet.

Would not eat here again. Possibly the worst foodcourt butter chicken I've ever had. Rice was almost crunchy and was brown on edges, chicken was too chewy to eat and sauce was very thin. Garlic and cheese Naan was doughy. Would not recommend :/
Fish Tikka 10/10 Gobhi Chilly dry 12/10 Alloo Gobhi 10/10 Biryani 10/10 Cholle Bhature 10/10 Over all a good place to eat. Staff is very friendly and humble. Only wait time is a bit of an issue.
Daikoku Takapuna has moved downstairs. The food, service and atmosphere as just as epic as always

We visited Aubergine for Saturday lunch. The staff are very welcoming and helpful. We booked a table in advance, but there was plenty of space that day. I'd say the price per plate is a bit on the high side, but the food is delicious, with good portions, and even the kids' portions are generous. The atmosphere was good and the staff were attentive. The food came to the table fairly quickly. Overall, we had a pleasant time there.

What a delicious meal! I got the calamari for starter and the duck main, honestly that meal touched my soul and I definitely recommend it. The meat was cooked perfectly and the orange sauce went so incredibly well with it. I thoroughly enjoyed my time there and would absolutely dine again

The place looks so nice, great atmosphere to enjoy your meal. Some of the waitresses don't look too happy to be working on that day, Asian lady behind the bar looks grumpy behind the bar. I wanted to order drinks but not with her grumpy face there. One of the waitresses who was not from NZ, didn't catch his name, was amazing. The food presentation was good, I had crispy pork, but sadly it was too dry and tough. But the sauce flavour was nice.
Outstanding place for a great meal. Food was exceptional with service and atmosphere to match. Is a bit on the pricier side but, worth every dollar.

We celebrated my husband's birthday here last night and had a lovely evening. The choices for the $72 3 course menu were excellent. The calamari was yummy and a very generous portion. The steak was sizeable with scrumptious potato croquettes. I asked for my steak to be medium, it was slightly overcooked but very tender . Two of us had to change our dessert choice due to shortage but that was fine. Excellent friendly service, we didn't get our water refilled until the end and we had to ask for a bucket for our white wine, otherwise good service. Recommend.

Will recommend this restaurant, We had a dine in Birthday dinner for 10 people. Very yummy food, clean and spacious environment. Good service by staff and management. Own wine was allowed at no extra charge which was a bonus. Thank you Anokha

Absolutely amazing experience! We ordered a couple of courses and every single dish was incredible – full of authentic flavor, perfect consistency, and beautifully prepared. Hands down the best Italian food I’ve had in Auckland. Highly recommend!

We had the most beautiful dinner. We had pizza and seafood crepe for starters. Eye fillet for main and creme brulee and Tiramisu for dessert. Everything was on the spot, fast service and lovely Melanija serving us. True Italian experience with authentic food, wood fire . Big recommendation

Have been before - recently and it was beautiful, but made a last minute call on Fathers day as we made last minute plans and surprisingly were told yes that's fine. Arrived only to find no booking and on showing number I called it was the owner & she hadn't informed the restaurant! A bit of panic from the staff but they got us seated. Place was empty but apparently was going to be fully booked. Server was new and didn't know the food or drinks. Went away to ask questions - didn't return for ages. Food was a huge disappointment this time. Pizza dough tasted stale, toppings did not look fresh (last time was beautiful). Drink order completely forgotten - had to ask almost 15 mins later. Drinks turned up finally and were definitely not correct (very very weak aperol spritz - looked like tinted sparkling water) Owner arguing with staff in front of customers waiting to pay (and could be heard from the tables). Another group walked in with an online reservation & confirmation from over a week prior but no table reserved for them! Then to top it off most was wrong in the till with our order & owner had to delete it all and then calculate on paper... quite a messed up night. Yes accidents happen, but DON'T be rude to customers when they query something legit like the drinks (and even showing you a pic as proof). Unfortunately for you guys there is an incredible Italian eatery just a few doors up... so you know where we are all going from now
Visited this subway today and shocked that the 3 women there are even employed. Zero customer service skills, super scarce on the sub salad ingredients and a lot of negative attitude. Won’t be back.

This is a restaurant that has grown on myself and our friends, well worth visiting it’d a lovely seating atmosphere, just a really good Menu selection and fabulous foods, Always go back there staff are friendly and professional. We go back now on a regular basis and always happy. Thanks to the staff making it a good experience.
Great team on board on Friday 29th August. They were working sooo hard. Created a really energized vibe, didn't wait long for our 3+ burgers and staff were friendly and helpful.
The guys taking my order was handling my food after touching screens without washing hands or wearing gloves! Will see how my tummy goes tonight…..

Food is not bad at all but service leaves A LOT to wish for. CJ is amazing but one female staff member during wednesday lunch was extremely rude. You can tell she hates her job and doesn't want to be there, but makes it feel like its your fault. She refuses to engage or acknowledge you and can't even answer a single menu question without being condescending. Her hygiene was also disgusting. Saw her pick her nose and wipe her mouth with the same hands she cooks food. Lastly, tables were sticky and not taken care of, which made dining in very uncomfortable. If this is how staff treat their customers and prepare their food, then it says a lot about the standards here. Absolutely shameful.

Takapuna Pita Pit advertises on Uber Eats and online that it is open until 8:00PM M-F. It rarely is. I have experience on around 7-8 times where my order is simply cancelled through Uber Eats even though it is 15 or 30 minutes before the close time. Very unprofessional and stressful as it leaves customers in a predicament of what else is available to order online at the last minute. (As customers are expecting to order and enjoy Pita Pit). Being disappointed 7-8 times is enough, so I am posting a 1 star google review on this matter in the hopes that others may be informed.

Coffee is always great here. Lots of seating. Vegetarian eggs benedict is average and standard. Would recommend asking for hollandaise on the side. The bread is crispy though and the eggs were running. Feels under staffed as the water station lacked cups and filled bottles of water.
Great chips, exactly what I needed on a cold Saturday. Owners were really nice and welcoming, great service.

Just a family dinner out. A change of numbers from 4 to 5 was swiftly accommodated. Staff were efficient & friendly, but not overly so. Food was delicious & well presented, and all gone at the end! Definitely recommend and will be back. Drinks were 2 soft drinks, 2 beers & a sake that we squeezed in during happy hour. 2 starters & 5 mains.

No wonder this place is packed on a Monday night! The hainanese chicken rice tastes divine with a shockingly low price. The chow kuew tiao was massive, i had to take half home and there’s a few more deals. Not to forget the BYO option as well. Love!

By far one of my favourite Filipino restaurants in Auckland! The staff were super friendly and introduced each dish to us, giving the best recommendations. I went here with my boyfriend for our anniversary, and the chef even made us a special dessert, which was absolutely delicious. By the end, we were so full and satisfied from all the dishes. I honestly can’t pick a favourite since everything was amazing. Highly recommend and will definitely be coming back! ✨

A palate experience! Had such a fantastic time at Nanam in Takapuna! The food is absolutely delicious—every dish feels creative but still comforting. The wagyu longganisa was a standout, packed with flavor, and the beef cheek was melt-in-your-mouth good. The vibe is modern and welcoming, perfect for a night out with family or friends. The staff were so warm and attentive, which made the whole experience even better. If you’re looking for something a little different, with bold flavors and a fun atmosphere, I can’t recommend Nanam enough. We’ll definitely be coming back!
We went to Nanam to celebrate my son's 16th birthday. We were greeted like friends, the food was amazing, friendly staff. Valve for money. Will definitely recommend this place and go again.
Loved the service atmosphere and wine list with good food choices and portions tapas style

I went in today to grab my lunch about are hour ago there was a lady working she is totally unhygienic. Never greeted, She was handling til and cash and came back to put salads on my sub she never bothered to change the gloves after touched everywhere. This is truly unacceptable in the food industry. People do get sick with unhygienic practices. Please be mindful when working in the food industry. Never wanted to go there. Did not bothered to say thank you at the end too..

We had an outstanding meal at Tok Tok in Takapuna tonight, amazing service and the dishes we had were 10/10! Big fan of the salmon summer roll and the popping prawns. James Ashwin Kakapo Business Sales

We branch late morning. It was clean tables inside. I had Mushroom toast. It was tasty. And friend had Beef on salad (not sure name) big salad. Most of food menu under $20 we can find. We were happy for price. We will come back some time.
Best breakfast of this trip. Service was great and staff were friendly.
Amazing fresh food. Friendly service with smiles. Great views. Perfect vibes. Good prices. Left with a full tummy and a full heart!

Today, I visited Tokyo Bay Restaurant for lunch with my coworkers. We ordered a variety of shared dishes, including drinks and desserts. Each dish was exquisitely prepared, and I could tell through sight, smell, and taste that it was made with fresh ingredients. I also ordered the winter special dumplings. The homemade dumplings were unique, bursting with flavor, unlike anything you'll find anywhere else. Even I, who doesn't usually like dumplings, really enjoyed them. As always, the staff's customer service is top-notch. I'd like to express my gratitude to the chefs for their fresh and delicious food, and to the staff for their bright smiles and friendly service. Thanks to them, I had a truly enjoyable meal. I'll be back soon. Thank you!!♡

Me and my little family had dinner here to celebrate my son's birthday. Food was excellent and service was too, as my son was turning 23 they decided to give him a plum wine instead of cake, that was hilarious. We had a great time and I highly recommend it 😊

We visited Tokyo Bay in Takapuna to celebrate my husband’s 40th birthday, and it was nothing short of exceptional. Having travelled to Japan, we’ve experienced authentic Japanese cuisine—and I can confidently say this is the best Japanese food we’ve had in New Zealand. Every dish was exquisite—fresh, beautifully presented, and full of authentic flavour. The sushi and sashimi were top-quality, and the grilled dishes were cooked to perfection. Even the mocktails were thoughtfully crafted and complemented. What truly made the evening special was the service. The staff went out of their way to make my husband’s birthday feel truly celebrated with thoughtful touches and warm hospitality. The restaurant has a beautiful ambiance with ocean views, making it an ideal spot for special occasions. Thank you, Tokyo Bay, for making our night so memorable. We’ll definitely be back and recommending you to everyone
Foods are beautiful with good quality services. Atmosphere is pretty good feeling cosy while enjoying the food. Reasonable priced.
Amazing food, excellent staff and beautiful surroundings. Would definitely visit again.

We sat in the rear garden, enjoying the sunshine and listening to the birds singing. The staff were super friendly and welcoming. The coffee was lovely, and the Plumm Bene was great — especially the crispy hash browns with herbs, which added an extra tasty touch.

Such a cute and cozy cafe! There are more seats in the hidden garden at the back which is so peaceful! And the best thing is that it’s dog friendly!!! I’m always on the hunt to find dog friendly food places!! We had the creamy bacon mushroom which was so good!! One of the best creamy mushrooms I’ve had!! So flavourful and perfectly balanced! The ratio of bread to sauce was perfect! The service was also great! They were so friendly, lovely and accommodating!

An absolute delight! Such polite service, food was very tasty and fresh and overall a great experience. Will be back for a sit down dinner for sure. Such a pleasant end to a busy day and put a massive smile on my face with the kind service!

Just tried this place for the first time and wow! We will definitely be back!!! We got the green curry with chicken, pork thai fried rice, money bags and roti and it all came to $50 which was extremely affordable. The portion sizes are very generous and the food was absolutely delicious. The owner was super sweet and gave us a chocolate with our takeaway too! Best experience 🙂

Great place to dine, food was delicious and came out quick. I liked it was a smaller venue as you could talk to everyone at the table without all the background noise of larger restaurants. Staff were very helpful and friendly. Couldn't fault it and will be back!
#Chinese cuisine# Many choices of dishes， I recommend the sweet and sour pork，really crispy！ Fried bun with pork mince is also tasty. There are some parking spaces on the street.

We loved our stay at the Oyster Inn. The rooms are very few and are right next to each other which is perfect for our family. It was easily accessible for my father who has mobility issues. The rooms are clean and modern . The restaurant is lively and the staff are super engaging and friendly and the food is delicious. I’m so glad we opted to stay right in town so that we could walk around, enjoy the beach and the cuteness of Waiheke Island!

Best Oysters I have ever had not sure I can eat any back home in the States again. Super fresh and good size. The shrimp toast was excellent too. Highly recommend stopping here for a snack and a drink.

Eating in is a great experience but most of the time we just do takeaway. The portions are generous and staff are awesome. Even though the previous boss left to start his own venture, the quality has been maintained.

We got takeaways- amazing food at a great value. Our only negative was that the delivery was 20 minutes late. A phone call to say that the order would be later than expected would have been great. However, I would recommend the food.

My wife and I were on Waiheke Island and decided to have breakfast at Vino Vino. My wife had 2 poached eggs with Bacon and toast. I had the Vino Vino Big Breakfast with 2 eggs, potatoes, bacon and creamy mushrooms. Everything tasted great! I do not generally order bacon, but this bacon was perhaps the most flavorful bacon I've ever had. Service was quick with ready refills of a bottle of cold water for us. We sat outside with a view of the water. While we had breakfast, the lunch and dinner menu look quite good. I recommend Vino Vino for anyone looking for quality food while visiting Waiheke Island.

Overall a nice experience - a couple of things were unavailable due to the fryer being out of action which limited the menu. The food was nice, seafood chowder was nice for an entree but I wouldn’t say it’s what you expect, but still a nice addition to a light lunch. The view was beautiful and it’s a great location. Good service

Wow !! What a wonderful surprise today when we randomly selected Vino Vino for lunch on our day trip to Waiheke. Our random choice was due to the incredible views. From the start to the end the service, meal and attention was first class. We have been fortunate enough to eat at some incredible restaurants throughout the World and would have to rate this establishment right up there. The food was faultless with a perfect combination of ingredients.Connie and staff…congratulations.

Great place to get brunch and have a view of the bay. They had some amazing eggs Benedict. The prices weren't bad either. Also, the service was great, our waiter gave us some fun tips of things to do around town.

One of the best fish and chips I haven't had for a long while. Pork belly pop corn is a must try🍿. Very friendly staff and Andy the dog. Kids loved it. If you are here on Waiheke island. Make sure you pay them a visit.
We've had some amazing food here over the years and though the quality has gone up and down we keep going back. The atmosphere, especially on a Friday night, is always great.
Great lunch and amazing sevice, view to die for.

Our family took a trip to Wiheke island and we came here for lunch in the early afternoon. The staffs were friendly and the view was absolutely beautiful! As they serve very small plates, we tried several dishes, and most of them were very delicious! I really loved the pork belly soy glaze and polenta chips!! They were so amazing! Highly recommend to visit here, sit outside and enjoy their food, drink and the view at the same time. 😘😘

I usually prefer to do takeaway from here as the restaurant itself has an odd atmosphere and seems geared towards tourists. That being said, it is generally quiet! The food portions are good and though they don't always have prawn crackers, the spring rolls make up for it.

We took refuge from the rain here and had a lovely meal and drinks. It was so nice to sit underneath the mini patio roof and hear the rain patter above. The food was delicious! Absolutely exactly what we were looking for and didn’t even know it.

Please delete your false believe in your recent edited response and review with your daughter and tell the truth to the public. Knowing it's Waiheke Island doesn't justify the exorbitant price for a below-average crepe. $14 for a plain European crepe is simply insane. Are you really going to charge over $20 if a customer wants toppings? ======================================= Reply to the owner's response: I appreciate the owner's sincerity and understand the challenges small businesses face, especially post-COVID. However, I had a concerning experience that I feel warrants this review. Last weekend, around 3 PM, my three-year-old son was hungry after missing lunch, so we stopped for an afternoon tea for him. I carefully browsed the menu, trying to avoid items with excessive chocolate or syrup for my son. I settled on the "European" crepe, as it was the only one without those toppings. The girl behind the counter even confirmed I didn't want any toppings, which I affirmed. To my surprise, I was charged $14. I immediately questioned this, as the menu clearly stated the "European" was $12. The girl's immediate, unhesitating response was that prices had increased and the menu simply hadn't been updated. She then offered to give me $2 back, which felt like an afterthought. This experience left me questioning the value of a $14 crepe in my original review, but more importantly, the transparency of your pricing. The girl's quick reply suggests this isn't an isolated incident, and it makes me wonder how many other customers have been overcharged due to that. I'm keeping my rating as is. Until your menu reflects the price matched what's I was charged last weekend, I believe cheating customers, even if unintentional, is a more serious issue than an overpriced crepe. ======================================= WOW. I noticed that the owner edited their “official” response into something completely misleading. So here is my reply to set the record straight. Now I fully understand why the overcharge happened to me. As the business owner, you are not reviewing what happens with your staff, and instead you quietly edit your response after the fact to mislead the public and cover up another falsehood. That is unacceptable. Your claim that nothing was sold on that day can be easily disproven. This makes it clear that the issue is not just with one staff member — it reflects a wider problem with the business’s integrity. I only discovered this because I saw the altered reply being discussed elsewhere and came back to verify it myself. Attached is the photo — please explain how this is not from your business. And to claim you offered me a free crepe? That is not true. It is deeply disappointing to see a business present such a fabricated story to the public.

Lovely people , I really enjoyed my fish taco , thank you ! They have too some pastries, we did try the canell which was delicious 🤤 Update : we kept visiting the place all days during our holidays since the food was the best that we try on the island, loved the beef salad , and the loaded nachos with pork belly was sooooooooo gooooodddd, we try too the almond croissants , and my partner loved his bacon roll. If we come back this will be the place to go for us , we did try most of the island restaurants and take aways and this is our fav so far

This place will not reach the level even of the Sol Bar that was previously 😑 Ater it was took over by Nomads, its food quality dropped dramatically. Quality of food does not match to it prices. If they want to be honest, they either should reduce priced at least 3 times, or change those who prepare it AND use not that cheap and low quality ingredients. I still have a "brick" in my stomach after the breakfast. It was my mistake to go there. Food was not enjoyable and aftermath of such meal as well. I really hope that someone who has better integrity and who cares about customers but not fast money will buy that business. We don't need such junk places on the island.

Absolutely incredible burgers 🍔 🤤HIGHLY RECOMMEND! We got the smashed burger and the sirloin steak burger. Both are delicious and possibly the best burger we have had in Auckland itself. Flavourful and so juicy. You will NOT go wrong with this place! $22 a burger Plus the outside space is so nice to sit and eat (as long as there is no rain!)

I really love this place. Everything about it; the taste, the price, the atmosphere, and even the style of the ingredients was perfect for me. I don’t usually write reviews, but I just couldn’t resist this time. Thanks to you, I had the best day. Thank you!

We for the first time came to this place and decided to go crazy and try beet root latte and pink Pitaya latte with dragon fruit. AMAZING! The beet root latte was my favorite! Would definitely recommend trying something fun and new here!

Go somewhere else. The food does not look at all like the photos. I ordered the waffles which shows berries on the side. Instead it was served with Pam’s granola. I am fairly convinced the waffles are prepurchased. Iced coffees overpriced. No menus on show. The locals stay away for a reason.
Drinks and food were awesome. Staff are really friendly, seems like the owner is really caring 🦞🎈🤩

Such a gem! One of the best meals we had in NZ. The ceviche will change your life. We were basically licking the plate. Cocktails were fantastic. Doesn’t feel as touristy as other spots on the island which is nice as well. We were only stopping in for a snack and it was so good we ended up doing full blown dinner here. View of the ocean down the road from outdoor seating. Thank you to the chefs and wait staff for a wonderful meal and time!!!

✨ Had the pleasure of dining at The Hunting Lodge with a friend, and what an experience it was! The atmosphere was absolutely beautiful – relaxed yet refined, making it the perfect spot to unwind and enjoy good company. The food was simply divine – every dish was full of flavour and beautifully presented. Paired with the stunning surroundings, it made for such a memorable lunch. Highly recommend if you’re looking for a place that delivers on both food and ambience. 🌿🍷🍴

Such a special Father’s Day brunch at Miss Riverhead Cafe! Friendly welcoming staff made us feel at home. Amazing service and absolutely delicious food-so full, but we couldn’t resist taking home the flaky pastries filled with custard and fresh strawberries. Highly recommend!

Visited today. Friendly staff and nice atmosphere. The coffee was bad and was pipping hot. Wouldn’t return for the coffee… However, the spicy chicken burger with waffle fries was really good. A great mix of awesome flavours. Would return for the burger!

Came in for a late breakfast/lunch for our first visit. Have been driving past here for several years but not stopped in till today. Delicious food, prepared quickly, and very good service. Will definitely be back.
Had a fantastic dine-in experience at The Beekeeper’s Wife in Riverhead. The interior is cozy and laid-back, and the service was warm. I’ll definitely be back for another browse of their menu.”

My family loved this restaurant. My girl was devastated when we found out it has closed down. We used to go to this restaurant to celebrate birthdays, kids moving up a swimming class etc. Hope it will reopen soon somewhere in the shore and we will definitely visit it again.

Was that frozen Costco chicken served in the Chicken teriyaki? Because it tasted so bad, borderline rancid and with zero texture that I suspect they are just freezing bulks of costco chicken and serving it with a small coating of teriyaki sauce (which they hope will mask the taste) and a serving of rice. It did not taste like a fresh chicken breast with the texture expected. It was an absolute letdown, almost an insult to serve that. They want to cut costs to alleviate their overheads, but instead all you do is have a sub-par, unappealing experience with customers that will NEVER come back. Not a good strategy. Pay a few extra dollars on your ingredients and uphold a decent standard and maybe the place will be busy 7 days a week. Nice environment, good potential. But basically serve dogfood level chicken which has a rotten aftertaste.

You can’t go wrong to visit Altura. I cannot think of any time that I didn’t receive friendly, fast and professional service from all the staff. Their food is excellent and their coffee even better. Whether you sit down to eat or pop in to grab coffee beans and a takeaway coffee, the experience remains top notch. Well done Altura for always making my visits memorable.
Been eating so many times! Very delicious food and always can customize for us. Also very friendly reception and chef. The best Chinese food in Albany.

usually enjoy subway, but today i got one of their hot dog footlongs. the picture looked good but ended uo being very. decieving. it showed a hotdog in an actual hot dog bun but instead i got it in a normal bread. it is okay overall but the hotdog itself is very tough and there was barely any sauce added, like one drop.

Very good. Love the shaved noodles with beef. Skewers are good as well. [Update] Not good anymore. Used to be one of my favorite joints. Now no more. Down from 4 stars. Very disappointing last 3 visits. 3 strike out for me. I'm never coming back here again. Shrinkflation - switched to using lower-grade meat and shrunk the portion. The bowl of cleaver beef noodle soup only had 6 small pieces, 2 of which were just fat. This coupled with intimidating staff/ owner who pounds on his cashier while taking your order as if he's having a bad day makes you want to turn around and walk out the door.

Meet fresh is always amazing. Never fails. We got the mango berry (mango and strawberry) shaved ice, and it was soooooooo good. A bit big between two though. The plate was also smaller than at other Meet Freshes despite there being a similar amount of ice. Ours toppled over, but thankfully it didn't spill out too much. Also, I'd definitely recommend bringing a jumper or two to avoid your body temperature dropping too low. Unlike other Meet Freshes, there's a wall where people have been writing notes over the past few years. It's a really interesting and entertaining read, and a great group activity. You can come prepared with your own pen, paper and sticky tape to add to it. Staff were nice.

Went with my family on Sunday. order a warm grass jelly, served cold one with loads of shaved ice on the bottom. Informed to the girl who took the order, first reaction is “ah”, there is no apology, there is no offer to change the order. Staring at me like I put through the wrong order and I have done something wrong.
The lamb skewers were a bit spicy

The best SundaeGuk restaurant in Auckland !!! I’ve been to 4-5 places with sundaeguk & hardly ever write a google review, but have to say Tulbo Ne in Rosedale Rd is the best place you can get sundae soup. Cant recommend enough to others !!!
“Outstanding service and vibrant atmosphere! The bartenders are skilled, friendly, and attentive making every visit a pleasure. Highly recommended for a quality night out.”

Amazing night. Great layout, awesome service, brilliant atmosphere, outstanding food. Went this evening with a group of 8. Everything was amazing. Our seating area was nice and semi private, staff and service was fantastic. The food was just amazing. Thank you team, we will be back again soon.

Disappointing. I had been craving Pita Pit all day. Unfortunately there was just one employee and he was very overworked as he rushed to fulfil Uber Eats orders. My Pita tasted bland and just fell apart.

The few servers simply couldn't handle the busy lunch rush, and their customer service was unsatisfying. The dining environment was also quite noisy and crowded. I can only say—if you want to eat at this restaurant, try coming before 11 am when it's less busy.
I love this place. They have such delicious food, there are lots of options and the staff are so friendly. I ordered their Japanese Oyakodon and it makes my mouth water.

The menu looks like a novel but everything is made perfectly. I have been here a few times now and tried different food each time. Everything is fantastic and I cannot recommend it enough. My favourite restaurant. They are open late so perfect when you are hungry at 9pm and every other restaurant has closed.

First time trying these guys food and it was yuuuuummmmy!!!!!!!! I love there beef tacos.I ordered 3 of the same tacos (beef tacos) for $22 and comes with a dipping sauce and a lemon and woah it was so delish.The tacos are not too hard or too soft they are just right and the beef is beautiful and full of flavour.we also got the birra beef burger combo and it was so spot on.we will definitely be back in the future. Thanks for the best tacos ive ever eaten

#Fried chicken and hot pot# Some kind of Korean food，including rice cake、chicken、soup and grilled meat. Recommend the almond chicken，it‘s crispy and juicy. The cold noodle is also tasty. But the grilled pork belly isn‘t fried enough and the sauce is a bit plain. The price is over the average level，but the atmosphere is great.

Saw the reviews and wanted to try here. We got the mini seafood pancake, the rice cake skewer and a spicy beef soup. Mini seafood pancake was crispy, but not the best one I had. The portion also very small for the price and din't have much seafood in it. The dipping sauce was not bad though, felt like it has some fruity flavour inside. The rice cake skewer was also just ok, the sausage was good. The spicy beef soup was mostly bean sprout flavour and chili. The broth taste no beef at all, the beef chunks was cooked well though, that was the best part. This place offer only a small kimchi side dish per table, which is very little compare to all other Korean restaurants. Overall food was below average, however service was good and the place has a nice comfortable environment for quiet chat and just relax.
Delicious, authentic, inexpensive, friendly, and clean. Must try. My go to restaurant.
One of the best places to have cray fish, not because of the price but their experience in cooking them. We had them in sashimi and with yee mee noodles. At $260/kg you dont want anyone to mess up!

It WAS a good Korean restaurant before, but not anymore.. unfortunately. We went there many times before as it was the best Korean restaurant for us.. Actually, we are very sad with negative changes in the foods. Dumping's size shrinked to nearly half size compared to the past, and their soybean soup, which is a new dish is tasteless and not delicious at all. The serving staffs are friendly and kind. Just the foods are not good anymore and quite expensive compared to the food quality and taste. Unfortunately, today was the last day to visit there. No more visit sadly till they do better job with improvement. We just miss the food we had in the past there.

Went for the buffet and was really impressed. Great value for money with such a wide variety of seafood on offer. Everything was fresh, and the oysters were perfectly cleaned – no grit at all! Sake is also included too. Definitely worth it. Food came out quickly, table is a bit small to fit all the dishes though.

Don't think I want to say how good it is...then tooooo many people will go and it's already hard to book a weekend evening as it is.... 5stars is not enough ... The food is delicious and the choices are many...and for the great value for money you can actually try to order and eat every dish on the vast menu..and to top it off ...drinks..Sake, wine beer, soft drinks and others are included. The staff are very happy, friendly and attentive...the owner works there as well and is a character... Mingling with eaters and ensuring you are enjoying your time.. My only concern now is my partner now wants to eat there all the time now. We will definitely be returning...on a regular basis.

We made a reservation for a dinner for four, excited to try the all you can eat buffet. The price was $115 per person. At first, the sashimi we ordered came out quickly and we were satisfied, but from the next order, the pace of the dishes slowed down so much that we ended up ordering things we hadn’t even planned on eating just because we were hungry. The slow service and the fact that the regular menu prices are quite high make me think I probably wouldn’t return once the all you can eat promotion ends. But since sake is also included in the all you can eat price, it could be great value for those who like to drink a lot.

We tried eat all you can at $115 with my family , very generous serving of japanese foods,sushi and sashimi platter was great! Sukiyaki is very tasty and unlimited plum wine is amazing. Grilled australian prawn is a must try! Chawanmushi,takoyaki,grilled oysters, cheesy scallops,wagyu beef is real yum and a lot more! Staffs are very nice and friendly. And we did came back for the 2nd time coz this buffet is worth it.
One of my favorite place to have spicy and yum food, tastes like hometown.
Had a solid fish and chips here. Nothing special, nothing bad. But exactly what I wanted at the time.
I just spontaneously ordered here after overlooking it many times. The braised pork was delicious and great value. Will definitely be back to try their other offerings.

The buffet food variety is about 8-10 dishes to be chose, all the foods taste quite nice and my favorites are the chicken soup and pork with potatoes. The price also very reasonable in Auckland area, $9.99 for one meat one vege and one soup / $12.99 for two meat two vege and one soup. The $12.99 portion is quite big and i can split into two meals. Highly recommended!
Family went there for dinner Food was expensive and small portions. $9.9 was out. It was not good at all. Would not recommend !!!

We tried their House Special Pho and the Banh Mi Combination, and both really hit the spot! The banh mi came with perfectly crispy bread that had just the right crunch, filled with a tasty mix of meats. The spread of butter tied everything together, making every bite satisfying. The pho had a comforting broth rich, fragrant, and well balanced. Overall, both dishes were on point simple, authentic, and full of flavor.

The banh mi and vietnamese coffee deal is very good value. However there was a bit of cloth?? fluff?? that was stuck on the bread. I still ate it all after removing it as the banh mi tasted so good haha Would still recommend!!
Excellent Pho, one of the best I’ve had in Auckland. Got the Vietnamese coffee and that was excellent too.
Love their lunch sets! Only $18.8 for a big portion nice taste set. Can’t beat that

Nice and quiet corner with absolutely friendly shop services. It is always good to be able to sit away from busy street or cafe and enjoy some sweet. The pancake is very tasty. The red bean cake will be a must try item if you visit.

First time trying No.1 Pancake today following a hockey tournament nearby and seeing the positive reviews. I had the cheese & pineapple + jalapeno while my sons both went for a sweet option with ice-cream. OMG so delicious! Will be returning for lunch tomorrow before heading home to the BoP. Highly recommended!
A firm lunch favorite. Delicious savory and sweet pancakes. Reasonably priced and service with a smile. The mince and cheese is my go to!
Mmmmm it was a good mouthful. You'd think the cheese made it too greasy but the bulgogi sauce shines through wonderfully. Will eat again and highly recommend. Super smiley and cheerful staff too.
The best. No need to say anything else.
Yummo will definity be back
Bacon egg hash brown muffin is god sent

Ordered on Uber eats and it took them 1 HOUR to make the food, then another 20 minutes for the driver to deliver 3 kms away. Don't buy from here food isn't even good it's just bad. I called them and the guy answered said 5 minutes then hung up and it still took another 20 minutes for chicken and chips

We ordered 8 pizzas and sides for a kids birthday party. It was delivered almost an hour late and by this point the kids were so hungry that we had to provide alternative food. I contacted the restaurant to lay a complaint, but was told the manager was "away" and there was nothing more they can do except provide a $10 voucher, which I didnt want as I never want to go to the store again. I continued to follow up for about two weeks afterwards and was told the manager was "still away" and there was no alternative contact person. Absolute terrible experience and staff service. Worst dominoes ever.
Really nice environment, excellent friendly staff service attitude, and beautifully presented food.
Such a fantastic local Japanese restaurant. Very high quality food, lovely service and all for a decent price. Dinner bento was $23 each and well worth it

We accidently discovered this place 3 weeks ago and have already visited 3 times. We're very happy with the food, especially the teriyaki chicken. It’s a hidden gem on the North Shore - we only wish we had found it sooner! I’m sure their business would be even more successful if it were on a main road or easier to find.

Nothing princely about my experience at this place, I'm afraid. Truly some of the worst and most disgusting Indian food I have had in a very long time. The samosas and pakodas in my order were burnt to a crisp, as though they were condemned to be executed in a bonfire.

They serve most authentic Korean BBQ and cold noodles(the best in New Zealand) which they make it in the shop (not the one ready-made noodle purchased from retailers) in Auckland. I am sure you can have excellent K-food experience as same as restaurants in Korea. Highly recommend if you are looking for an authentic Korean restaurant. Down side is the price tag which is higher than other Koreans restaurants.

After my work finished, I came here for the dinner. And I tried Simya’s new menu which is called pork belly donburi and it was absolutely delicious! The atmosphere was amazing too—I highly recommend it!

I've been a regular at Burger King's drive-thru, and they never disappoint! My orders are always accurate and come out quickly, with friendly service every single time. It's a reliable spot for a hassle-free meal!"

Not sure what it is with BK but they seem to have quite the reputation for mucking up orders/forgetting food. We visit this store regularly and the food is always good but I couldn’t tell you how many times we have got home then had to drive back because something was wrong or missing. Tonight I ordered a long beef rodeo and get home to realise I’ve been given a chicken burger? No other fast food chains seem to have such an issue. Really wish you would fix this because we love the food but it’s so disappointing.

The food was fine. I met an old friend for lunch on Friday August 29. We spent about 1 hr and 10 min there. What really pissed me off was that I got a $65 ticket fine for parking there. It said I overstayed at the car park or not validating my car. What a crab experience with this parking bullshit! Nobody should come to this restaurant if this is how they treat their paying customers.
A shell of what it once was. Tired interior, confusing menu, average staff. Still playing the same surfing loop on the tv from 10 years ago. Sadly not my fav mexican any more :(

Not a great experience, the food didn’t match our order. We had two foot longs ordered. They got labeled incorrectly Then my husband didn’t want any jalapeños in his one, but it was given with jalapeños and hardly any sauce I have attached the order details and the photo of the food we got. Not very useful staff either. This is our first time click and collect from this store. We had no idea we had to take our drink and no one told my husband. When we called and asked, we were told that we should pick up. How can we solve this? Then we called them about the wrong ingredients in the subway. The bread was swapped without letting us be informed. And when I complained, the store staff tells me to retain it and bring it in tomorrow to swap it. The whole idea of a takeaway is to sort that meal. So if I can’t have this for my dinner, why did I even have to place this order in the first place. Will never be back at this shop 😞

We stumbled upon this place by chance and decided to give it a go. The owner was incredibly friendly and welcoming! We absolutely loved the banh mi and coffee. The owner even took the time to explain the coffee-making process, which was such a thoughtful touch! Definitely worth giving this local gem a try!

I came for the Vietnamese breakfast and was treated to a complimentary coffee experience showcasing the full range of Vietnamese styles. Willy’s service was exceptional, delivering the personal touch only an owner could provide. Skip coffee Shop next door one day and give Duck Duck Goose a try—you won’t look back. I’ll definitely be bringing the family next time. 5+ stars!
Yummy Jjangmyeon!! Staff are very friendly too🫶🏻

I had a great experience here! The food was delicious, especially the beef soup (Seollongtang) - it had a deep, comforting flavor. The side dishes were fresh and varied, adding so much to the meal. On top of that, the owners were incredibly kind and welcoming, which made the experience even more enjoyable. I’ll definitely be coming back!

I’m deeply disappointed by the lack of basic compassion I experienced at Noodle Canteen in Windsor Park on Wednesday. I wasn’t there to buy food — I urgently needed a plastic bag because my son was suddenly feeling very sick and about to vomit. I explained the situation to the lady at the counter, and she told me I had to pay $0.20 for the bag because they buy them from supermarkets. I understand there may be costs involved — that’s not the issue. The issue is: is 20 cents more important than a sick child’s immediate need? I said okay, I’ll pay — I just needed the bag right away. But instead of helping, she answered a phone call and made me wait for several minutes while my son was clearly in distress. When I finally got the bag, I gave it to my son and then asked for a water bottle. But honestly, after that display of inhumanity, I didn’t want to support them any further. I rushed next door to Boss Sushi — not only did they give me a water bottle, but also another bag, completely free, within 30 seconds. They were kind, caring, and told me to run to my son. That’s the New Zealand spirit I believe in — empathy and humanity over profit. Noodle Canteen might serve food, but they clearly lack heart. (Both of the businesses have staff from the same country.)

Mann butter chicken was BOMB!!! Cheese naan & garlic naan BOMB!!! And most importantly their MANGO drink was just AMAZING!! definitely the only place I would go back and buy my butter chicken from thanks guys KING OF INDIA FOR SURE 💯💙
Really great lunch box deal, still only $9.90. Plenty of variety and a big portion too. Will definitely be back. Great flavors, crispy breading and the veg had plenty of crunch.

Delicious fresh tasting food. Potentially the best chicken sweetcorn soup I’ve ever had. Generous portions, we spent $17 per head on the meal deal and we’ve got heaps of leftovers for tomorrow’s lunch. Highly recommend!!

Ordered the chicken salad, arrived with no utensils, went back and was given a cardboard fork, which would have been fine for a salad, but the salad had a whole piece of chicken on top, not sliced as pictured in the menu. Trying to cut chicken with a paper fork was not fun. Unfortunately their kiosk was also very confusing when ordering the chicken salad, I did not click bacon bits (I do not eat pork) but still recieved bacon, so now confused was it asking if I wanted extra or was the bacon optional and someone didn't pay attention. Would not order again.
The staff were great, fast and efficient service. The food was delicious, reasonably priced and very generous servings. Highly recommend the ribs and the mixed grill.

I’ve been to constellation maccas a lot of times, and for the first time I couldn’t finish the fries nor the burgers. The fries were old, cold and very dry + no crisp, so it tasted horrible which is unusual for maccas fries. But the real problem was the pickles in the burgers, which tasted completely OFF, so I had to spit them out as you can see. Same off taste for both burgers that I’ve ordered, up to an extent they were inedible. Don’t know whats happening inside, but will never come back here on Sunday midnight

Really bad service, especially coming from someone who works in the fast food industry themselves. Not only did they forget the collectable. But it also took them 20 minutes to give the food, then told me to have a good night while still waiting for my drinks, what a waste of money.

Staff stood chatting while ignoring waiting customers. No engagement with customers. Fries were served cold and when I the customer said thankyou when receiving my order, none of them stopped talking to even acknowledge my thanks.
My nice was at dance class 2014 and always good 👍

Burgerfuel Windsor Park is my BF of choice. Why? Because their consistency in service, quality, and food is always reliable. Store always looks like it has too many staff working, which only helps to ensure you get great service. I find the burgers are always very well constructed and presented and taste great. My only gripe can be whether the chips are hot or not… I know it’s tricky to get supply and demand right, but I’d prefer to wait to ensure hot chips, especially as they aren’t cheap. In saying that, if I feel that the chips need replacing, the staff are very accommodating, not raising any issues. Highly recommend this store for a great BF experience. I’ll be back…
Awesome food! Really enjoyed the platter. The sausage was my favorite. Parking was okay. The restaurant can be quite crowded. Would recommend making a reservation

Absolutely worth a visit! We had the sharing platter for 2, which has four meats and two sides. We chose the garlic picanha, pork belly, lamb, and Brazilian sausage with chips and fried cassava. It was huge and by the time we had eaten it all we were stuffed. It's great value for the price! The staff were very friendly and hospitable, and all seemed just really happy. There was nice music playing and the restaurant had a nice vibe. We were really impressed and will definitely go back!

We had Judy’s for our wedding reception. The food was amazing!! Our guests enjoyed it so much that they took the leftover food away. The decorations were marvellous as well. We strongly recommend Judy’s!! We hope to ask Judy’s again for any future catering events.

If you are looking for delicious quality sushi options, this place is worth the drive. This is some of the best sushi in New Zealand. Large menu for full rolls, donburi, lunch box, and party platters too. Next time you need sushi, head to Crazi Sushi and you will be glad you did.
Beautiful Food, have come across this place on Tiktok and glad I did! Excellent service, fast tasty fresh, Dumplings and Buns. Had the spicy Beef noodle and was so Tasty! 5/5
It's newly opened, so it's clean and nice. The food is delicious and good. The free egg soup is perfect for a cold morning.

This has to be a great stop. Sushi Break is great, I had salmon, tuna, shrimp, fried shrimp, chicken, and katsu chicken. It was all amazing and the portion sizes are worth the cost. I recommend coming to try this great sushi place!
Excellent place for lunch. Super clean and superb quality. Friendly staff and plenty of tables to sit down at.

4.5 stars - great selection of korean dishes. Very authentic Korean flavours, good selection of side dishes and generous portion sizes. Very quick turnaround time for food after placing order, but the restaurant wasn't full when there. First time I've seen soy marinated raw crabs being offered on the menu as a main dish so had to try this, and was not disappointed - wonderfully marinated and delicious over rice. Their ox bone soup was also very good, loved the soup but thought there was a lot of meat that was a bit tough in the soup. Overall a great korean restaurant

Came with my wife for lunch and we loved it. Read all the good reviews for buffet so we came back to try. We even love it more. Varieties of proteins and veggies are great. Plus they got Korean dishes. Great atmosphere, great owner and staff, and great place. Parking on weeknights and weekend is good. We found our local hotpot buffet to go to now.

How to ruin your Friday night- start ordering fried chicken from Mr. Li Undercook chicken wings with not crispy batter, only 3 chicken wings with some disgusting fries cost 16.5 I believe I am not the first customer say your deep fried food is not good. Instead of criticizing my review, don’t you use this time to review your deep fried food ?

I recently visited Cafe Na B with a couple of friends for a late breakfast we had a wonderful experience. The atmosphere was vibrant and perfect for our catch-up. We ordered from the main menu and everything was delicious and clearly made with high-quality ingredients. The coffee was also fantastic perfectly brewed and rich. A really cool bonus was discovering they run a lucky draw for customers! It was such a fun and unexpected surprise that just made the whole visit feel a bit more special. It's clear they really value their customers. The staff were friendly and the service was prompt. Combined with the great food, coffee, and that extra bit of fun, Cafe Na B is a definite standout in Albany. We will absolutely be back!

This is honestly one of my favorite places to study or just hang out with friends. The food is always great, the staff are super friendly, and the whole vibe of the place is really comforting. The music is chill and never too loud perfect for focusing or just relaxing. The coffee is really good too. I love coming here to read, study, or just take a break. Plus, they’ve got Wi-Fi,

This place has a really nice ambiance as soon as you walked in. Really gives you a relaxing and chill vibes. We ordered the kimchi fried rice with bacon and also the hot and spicy tteok bukki. The fried rice has a nice char flavour and not too salty. The tteok bukki was not bad, rice cake was nice texture but it wasn't outstanding. We also tried their kumara latte and it looks really nice and the taste was like a nice kumara aroma. It was quite milky though, so not sure how much coffee there was. Overall not bad, portion size a bit small but im willing to come back to try other things.
