I often come here for coffee and I always enjoy it. The staff are super friendly and welcoming, and the atmosphere is cozy. The drinks are delicious and beautifully presented – I especially loved the latte art! Definitely one of my favorite cafes in Auckland.

The shrimp in the Hoof Flower Prawns are the best I've ever had in AKL! They're fried perfectly 👍🏻, crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, bursting with flavor. They have a salted egg yolk-like texture, and even the shells are delicious 😋 And when you break the shrimp apart, you'll find the roe! I really want to know where the owner gets such excellent shrimp! The chef was so thoughtful and even opened the backs. The only two downsides are the shrimp thread still being present and the pig's trotter having too many bones. But considering the shrimp are so delicious, I can forgive those. And they're delicious grilled too! How could it not be a hit? Go!

At noon today, I ordered a set meal for one person with sour soup, fat beef and rice noodles from Panda Takeaway. After it was delivered, the Boba milk tea had no taste at all, and the rice noodles were far worse than the last time I ate in the store. I'm really a loyal fan of Dagu rice noodles! I'm really disappointed this time 😭 Moreover, there are fewer small ingredients in the rice noodles than usual. I remember that there are two pieces of chicken fillet in the rice noodles, but this time there is only one piece. The taste of sour soup fat beef rice noodles is also much lighter. And the takeaway I ordered before was also a set. This time, I was only given a pair of ordinary disposable chopsticks. I hope the store can solve the problem effectively. Thank you

This is honestly my favourite spot on Apollo Drive. I’ve had the seafood cream pasta and the seafood risotto so far, and both were really good. The pasta isn’t your standard cream pasta – it’s got chilli in it, which gives it a nice little kick and keeps it from feeling too heavy. I actually liked it better than the usual version. The risotto was tasty as well, with the nuts adding a bit of crunch, and the seafood was so fresh. You can tell they put a lot of effort into the food. The portions are big too, so it’s easy to share. I’ll definitely be coming back to try more of the menu – it feels like one of those places you just can’t get bored of.
Got the party pack for my co-workers and it was gone in seconds! Sushi was great and everyone loved it.
Warm atmosphere and very good service. Looks like a typical family restaurant. Will come back again for sure.

Tried their signature backbone soup and the pork belly soup. Both were so good! The broth was super rich and flavorful from the bones, not spices. Definitely coming back. Haven’t seen any other Korean place do these.
Hidden gem! Stumbled upon this place for lunch and was pleasantly surprised by how delicious the dumplings are - and affordable! Will definitely be back.
good food portion and very affordable prices. If you are looking for a good feed and without breaking bank then this could be one of the contender
The restaurant was great! It's perfect for kids, and they have a good wine and drinks selection. The food was tasty, and the portions were a good size for the price.
Quite a spacious cafe/restaurant with a warm atmosphere. There is plenty of seating. Ordered the matcha latte and eggs on toast. It was tasty and would come again.

it's my second time coming coz last time I had a cup of beer with my husband after brunch and I was wondering why there's no one order food in such a busy lunch time.And I grab my girlfriend come last weekend and now I know. BBBBad quality and quantity of food BBBBut nice staff to serve with good price BBBeer.
Food was good as always. Service was fast. Will be going back! Not much seating area as it is mainly a pickup store.

Amazing atmosphere and people. Generous portion sizes and food tastes out of this world. There is a range of dishes to cater for all needs. I need to come back and try the dishes my tummy didn't have room for!!! I had the aubergine dip and the souvalaki with a cheeky bourbon!
Amazingly tasty cocktails! We felt so welcomed. All the food we ordered were superb!

The Thai Yellow Curry at this restaurant is simply unforgettable. From the moment it was served, the golden color of the curry looked so inviting, rich, and comforting. The aroma of coconut milk blended with delicate spices filled the air, making it impossible to wait another second. The very first spoonful was a burst of flavor—creamy, mildly spiced, and perfectly balanced. It’s rich without being heavy, fragrant without being overwhelming, and truly one of the best yellow curries I’ve ever tasted. The meat was tender and fresh, cut into just the right size, and it soaked up the curry beautifully. Every bite with warm jasmine rice—it was pure comfort and satisfaction. What makes this curry stand out is that it has a depth of flavor that’s hard to find elsewhere. It’s smooth, aromatic, and simply addictive. I have to admit, before coming here I had read a review claiming someone found a strand of hair in their curry. Honestly, I didn’t believe it, so I decided to try it with my family to see for myself. The experience turned out to be the complete opposite—everything was clean, fresh, and absolutely delicious. My whole family couldn’t stop praising how good the food was, and we all agreed we’d definitely come back again. The restaurant itself has a warm and welcoming atmosphere, with staff who are attentive and always smiling, making the dining experience even more enjoyable. If you’ve never tried Thai Yellow Curry here, you absolutely must. Don’t let rumors or doubtful reviews stop you from experiencing the real thing. Once you taste it, you’ll understand why I fell in love with it—and why I can’t wait to return.
Very cozy place. You can enjoy local artist's works. Their roast lamb is really good. The staff are very friendly and caring.

Montrose Cafe offers fabulous food and coffee. The staff are incredibly friendly, but the service could do with some improvement. Despite having plenty of employees, many seem idle. The decor is outdated and the space feels overly cluttered, which detracts from the overall dining experience.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ I had an amazing experience at Montrose Cafe, Bistro, and Bar! The coffee was delightful, and the server, Bruce, was exceptionally friendly and welcoming. The atmosphere and ambience were perfect, creating a cozy and inviting environment. The selection of food and drinks was impressive, catering to various tastes. Highly recommend this place for a great dining experience!

I visited Montrose for the Feast Coast Bays promotion and had the pleasure of trying their featured dish — the New Zealand Salmon Wellington with dill gremolata mousse. The salmon was perfectly cooked: tender, succulent, and bursting with rich, balanced flavors. As always, Bruce and the team provided exceptional service and made us feel truly welcomed. A consistently outstanding experience!

Where to start. The service is always impeccable. The chef’s creations are delightful and sumptuous. The Swedish meatballs: incredible. The jambalaya: desirable even if you don’t do well with mild/medium spice. The pork belly: just fantastic. Our friend with celiac disease was able to eat here with no issues; she had a side of fries as a starter and then the pork belly.

Was craving for some fish and chips, googled and came to this place due to the good reviews. Experience was disappointing. Firstly, was put off by the mediocre and unhelpful service rendered. Price is not as cheap as other reviews suggested. Lastly, taste wise, definitely not the best fish and chips we had throughout our trip in NZ. Will not come back again.
I guess mini combo is perfect for one person. Really yummy 😋
Butter chicken was terrible. Sauce was watery and bland. The chicken was dry. It was almost like it had been frozen and reheated… We used to go here a lot so this drop in quality is so disappointing.
Great Japanese food selection and delicious food. Will definitely come back again!
Excellent pizza. It still tastes good when you're on your final slices when it gets cooler. You can really taste the ingredients and their freshness.
Fast and delicious food. Good size portions. Friendly staff. Very happy with our first order of vegetarian kebabs and salads.

Awesome kebabs with great flavour! Made using quality lamb meat not the sausage meat like a lot of places give you these days. Can't speak for the burgers but will definitely give them a try soon. These guys care about the food they are serving you. I am writing this review after eating here about 5 times.
Very nice service and food.

Stopped in for a morning coffee and returned for lunch because it was so great! Cool atmosphere, buzzing with people. Fabulous service. Great coffee - amazing Spring rolls, fresh quiche. Great staff & I’d love to go back to try more of this menu!!
Fantastic fish n chips. So rare to get a decent lot of crispy chips which are not greasy. The place is takeaway though, so realistically do not expect 'atmosphere'.
Quite nice fish and chips! Scallops are so tasty!

We don't understand the hype of Crown Hill fish and chips! We are new in the area and decided to give them a go we ordered the $20.00 special and we enjoyed it apart from the small portion of chips, Went back a second time ordered the same thing as we liked it the first time but thought we would order an extra scoop of chips to go with the $20.00 order which was $5.00 but to our surprise the portion of chips was still small and was left wondering if they even added more chips or not, on top of that everything didn't taste the same as the first time we ordered so I guess it's just luck of the draw some days it's good some days it's average no consistency! Forgot to mention we also ordered Wantons and they would have to be the smallest wantons in the world, where is the meat?!...

Great place for lunch, dinner and a hot beverage! I have had all three on separate occasions and have not been disappointed. It's really hard not to drive past or be going for a walk around Coatesville Hall without stopping by and getting an Iced Chocolate for the road. Thank you! Highly recommended.

Consistently a great experience. I dine here often and every time, the food is tasty and freshly prepared. The restaurant is very clean and well designed, with an inviting, warm aesthetic and sensible seating layout. Impressive wine list and drink menu, as well as daily specials. A la carte menu style but still reasonably priced for the portions and quality of food. Try the Garlic and Pepper Scallops main — it’s a personal favorite. I also really enjoy the Chicken Satay entree. I will definitely be back.
Nice and friendly staff. Kids menu available as well. Delicious Indian Cuisine. Highly recommended for the whole family. Plenty of carpark. Namaste :)

We had a fantastic dining experience at The Spice Rack Indian Kitchen. The food was fresh, flavorful, and perfectly spiced — every dish was a treat. The staff were very friendly, attentive, and made sure we were comfortable throughout our meal. The restaurant has a warm and inviting interior that adds to the overall experience. A great spot for authentic Indian cuisine with excellent service — highly recommend!

A restaurant that doesn’t know how to fill their boxes. We like the food from here, but they never fill their delivery boxes fully, like other restaurants do. Same gravy which is 20.50NZD in other restaurants is $26 here and yet they can’t fill their box full.. That too after giving personal feedback to the restaurant. The ones who try to profit by dishonesty, can’t flourish in a business. Be genuine, be kind, build the customer’s trust not loose it. Only if you care. You at least lost 1 regular customer forever. We only ordered from here because food wasn’t bad and it’s closest to us with smaller delivery fee for us. I would rather pay more delivery fee from now on, rather than have half filled boxes of food 🤮

Went there for dinner. The atmosphere was very comfortable and the food quality was very good, however, the quantity of food were quite small and didn’t match the price charged. Be prepared to spend more for less. It's just my personal opinion and may differ from person to person.
ordered on uber eats and this is one of the best subs i have ever had, loaded it up with veggies and sauces and tasted fresh and amazing. super happy with my order thank you!

The Merchant Pub Co offers a delightful blend of modern New Zealand cuisine and a welcoming atmosphere. The interior design is thoughtfully crafted, featuring warm wood accents and a spacious layout that creates a cozy yet vibrant setting. The expansive outdoor courtyard provides a perfect spot to enjoy meals and drinks, especially on sunny days. The menu boasts a variety of dishes, including well-executed pizzas, hearty mains, and flavorful sides. The pizza stands out for its crisp crust and balanced toppings. Other popular items include mac and cheese bites and truffle fries. The drink selection is equally impressive, featuring a range of local and international beers to complement the meals. Service is attentive and friendly, contributing to a relaxed dining experience. Whether you're visiting for a casual meal, after shopping, or a night out, The Merchant Pub Co. provides a versatile venue suitable for various occasions. Overall, The Merchant Pub Co. in Albany is a commendable choice for those seeking quality food, a pleasant ambiance, and excellent service.

I had ordered a burger through the app to the nearest location and it sent my order to another store that was quite the distance away. The team jumped into canceling the order and remaking mine after looking into it. Great customer service and solution based thinking while they were flat out.

Long bao are nice, top of its type. Mushroom chicken are also good with mid spicy and strong flavour, Chickens are pre fried and crispy outside and soft inside. The duck and bamboo soup is filed with MSG, materials are not fresh at all. This is the deal breaker of all. Expensively not well cooked. Restaurant is small packed with tables. It’s not easy to move around comfortably. There are a lot good dishes at 50-60mark. From my experience those should be cooked by an experienced chef. Maybe I will come back next time if there is no other choice for dinning.
They have The best 焦烧肉条and熏鱼 in Auckland. Great taste. BEEN coming here. For years, my daughter loves the meat they cook lol

Their stir-fried dishes are absolutely delicious, with generous portions and very reasonable prices! Recently tried dry noodle with spicy beef and loved it so much! Will definitely return for the 4th time!

I got a good takeaway meal from Kohinoor and will go back again. I always test out a new place with the lamb biryani, which is a favourite of mine. Theirs is very tasty. Good balance of lamb and rice. Lovely spice flavour too. I ordered medium and it was just right. The staff were polite and pleasant to me and I didn't have to wait too long. Price was reasonable too.

Came with my family for a nice dinner and encountered two lazy chefs who didn't want to give food to a delivery driver, where the food was behind the counter, while the only waitress was taking our order. We heard and saw the whole thing. The big chef wasn't even cooking and just standing there, and asked the driver to wait for the waitress. I have a family member working as a delivery partner with Uber and DoorDash. They got paid by the minute they delivered the food, not by the hour, like the chef. And the distance between the big chef standing to the counter is less than 7 steps. If he didn't want to do the easiest "extra mile", the owner should find someone else. Give respect to the waitress and delivery drivers. It's not hard to walk and pass on the food. Thank you for ruining our night, lazy chef.

The only reason I am giving a three for service is because we had a 75th birthday celebration that we told management about when we booked but they were so busy that they forgot about it. The food was delicious and we went early so did not have to wait long for it. The later it got and the busier they got, some people waited long for their food. So some advice, if you go on a Saturday evening, go early as this place is good and therefore popular. Will definitely go again.

I came back from Australia and was excited to enjoy a nice meal at Lone Star, one of my favourite restaurants back in 2017. We were late for our 8 o’clock booking (I tried to change the time, but there was no email confirmation). When we walked in and asked for a table, they said, “Don't tell me you were the 8 o’clock booking?” and we said yes. Sophie then accused me of hanging up the phone on her. I explained that I hadn’t even received a phone call. She replied, “Well, someone hung up on me!” ??? I realised it was because I had used my Australian number (which I flagged as Australian in my booking). I told her that might have been the reason. Too which she brushed it off with no apology. Really loved the warm welcome—thank you, Sophie. The food was subpar and nowhere near the level it once was. The Dixie Chicken was served like pig slop, and that’s putting it nicely. We added extra chicken, and what appeared to be packet coleslaw with no dressing was served alongside. There were hardly any chips on the plate, and the whole thing was drowning in soup… or sauce?? Dixie Chicken used to be my go-to—this was very disappointing. The rest of the meal was mediocre. Here’s a lone star for your Lone Star.

While the food is usually pretty good without many complaints, it always seems like they are understaffed either on the floor or in the kitchen. We got there at 12:45pm - ordered drinks about 5 minutes after arriving, then ordered our food another 5 minutes later. The starters came quickly but the mains came out at 2:05pm, not sure if what we ordered was supposed to take that long (nachos and pork) but if we had known they needed about an hour to make these, we would've gone with something simple like the burgers. Not the first time we have dealt with a very long wait time and it probably won't be the last. We also noticed many times that the wait staff were all standing together either by their station or in the kitchen having a yarn while no updates on wait time we're provided.

Great experience all around! The service was quick, and friendly. The food was delicious, and I really appreciated the extra care taken with my order. I requested a wrap without onions, and the staff member was incredibly thoughtful, proactively suggesting they could cook the onions separately if it was just raw onions I didn’t like. It was a small gesture, but it showed genuine great customer service. In my case, it was a definite no to onions, but I really valued the effort. 10/10 I’ll definitely be back.
Great service from Ruth! I came in after work wanting something easy for dinner after a long day at work.. Ruth was friendly, kind and very helpful. Great Pita pit! Will be back 🙂

Great chef who cooked some amazing food, the servers on the other hand were unhelpful. Was our first time at a place like this and they did not explain the process at all, one server opened a door to outside and when I asked if I could close it because of the cold breeze disturbing myself and other customers he told me to wait a minute. Had a drink order taken at the start of the meal but no offer of another drink, not even offered water, bit disappointing.

Wheelchair parks NOT avail. but it is a HUGE car park, so not an issue to find a space, even on a very busy night. However it's an issue (& was for me) if you need a spot very close to the restaurants, we had to park a good 10min walk away & for myself, who suffers from multiple chronic illnesses, including severe fatigue, my husband had to drop me at the door before finding a park & then come back to pick me up once we'd finished dinner. Wheelchairs have access along the footpath & into the restaurant, however, the hallway down from the very small waiting area to the tables inside is quite narrow, with a large table taking up the entire waiting area, purely designed to sit & drink at. Our party chose to stand as I was the only one that HAD to sit due to my fatigue, so all 7 of us took up all of the waiting area by the cashier, this would be an issue waiting for your table, then having to get down to the seating area, and get around once seating especially and/or if you needed going to the bathroom as the tables are very close together It's quite a spacious restaurant, meaning a lot of tables not area, as they have an indoor and outdoor seating area. No smoking at all of course, that's to be expected, but also no vaping in the outdoor area which I find odd since new vapes give off barely any steam at all. I've had better experiences in terms of more flair from the chef, but of course the chef was very polite/friendly, may not have spoken much English as no matter what you said or asked he just smiled and nodded... Of course as part the Yeppan, he did the flaming onion which I don't get as part of the onion always gets burnt and mostly not cooked, however, this chef cut the onion and cooked it properly. There was of course throwing food to diners to catch in their mouths (or not haha) only 2 people at our table and only 1 from our party of 7 (I actually hate this, so of course declined as I always do, as I prefer to eat my food not have it thrown at my face, though it was entertainment seeing egg on my Bro in laws face hehe) Otherwise food was extremely well cooked and the meat was juicy, even the chicken which at some Teppan places can be quite dry, my Chicken was moist which was a pleasant surprise. Hubby got the steak and chicken set which he said was really well cooked. Everyone else said food was good. Not great but good. Special fried rice tasted like all the "special fried rice" at other Teppan places . I got the chicken and Prawn set.. For the price I was mildy surprised that you get 2 as part of the "set" however for the $20 extra I paid, I got 6 prawns, so $5 each, not sure I would get again even though they're pretty juicy and nicely cooked. Just enough yum yum sauce but since we have that at home we don't find it as "special" as it's a common sauce we use a lot. Though we booked a table for 8, they managed to squeeze 2 more onto our table!! Thankfully for them as I was about to make a HUGE complaint, our party ended up being 7, but it was definitely an 8 seater table!! Yet they squeezed 9 in??! The 2 woman told us how they desperately wanted to eat Teppan there that night, BUT, knowing Our table was for a 60th birthday with best friends it was quite rude to Pack another 2 people in with us and the table was squished & we're not large people either, more on the small side. Thankfully the other 2 were lovely & didn't expect to join in on conversations or as part of our party (I booked for our best friends & my sister + Bro inlaw) I found it interesting & a little odd that the 2 woman said they accepted their booking, BEFORE I even told them that one of our best friends couldn't make it as he only told us last minute. So would they have packed us onto an 8 seater with 10 people?! Out of all the Teppan places in this area.. I would definitely NOT recommend this place, purely due to how quite rude the staff were not just compared to other places but also as they knew it was a significant birthday. Quite disappointed, only upside is they didng charge extra for cake I brought with us.

Sept 4 2025 while making an order thru kiosk me and my wife who was carrying my 6 month old son, one of the staff approaches and offered to assistant my wife in taking her order and a sit that she cleaned prior. She looks having a handicap but she was very nice and a hard working person unfortunately we forgot to ask her name. We really appreciate her service support and will come back to this place.

Dear McDonald’s Customer Service, I am writing to express my dissatisfaction with a recent experience at your restaurant. My wife purchased a special color-changing cup, but unfortunately, the cup does not work as advertised. She sent me a photo of the defective cup, and since I was passing by your store after work, I went in and asked to exchange it for a new one. However, when I showed the photo to the staff, they refused to help and insisted that I must bring the actual cup back. I explained that our home is quite far away and that my wife had already provided me with the photo as proof. Despite this, the staff declined my request. I found this response very disappointing, as I had both proof of purchase and clear evidence of the defective product. I believe the situation could have been handled with more understanding and flexibility. As a loyal McDonald’s customer, I kindly request that McDonald’s consider replacing the defective cup without requiring me to bring it back, and I also hope that staff can receive better guidance in handling such situations in the future. Thank you for your attention. I look forward to your response.

I've had a few disappointing experiences here. Despite placing my order directly through the self-service machine, where everything is clearly written, the staff still manage to get it wrong. I’ve paid for additions I never received one too many times, so I felt it was necessary send feedback. The staff need better training and should be more attentive to orders. On top of that, the first two machines we tried to use were out of broken .
The food was nice. I had a katsu bowl and some other food. You can get free drink refills. The staff were friendly. But the place was dirty. People had to clean their own tables and the bin was full.
Mia at the Carl’s Jr. drive-thru is great, super friendly, always on point with the order, and just has great energy even when it’s busy. Always friendly whenever I pick up food.

We visited Zambrero Oteha Valley today and had an excellent experience. The service was outstanding, the staff member who served us (team member with arm sleeve tattoo, sorry I didn’t catch their name) was genuinely friendly, caring, and took the time to have a great conversation with us. It made the visit feel really welcoming and enjoyable. My wife and I both appreciated the effort and the positive vibe. Keep up the awesome work, I’ll definitely be back next time I’m up from Hamilton! 🙌😁

Would definitely give this place a pass the servings are well undersized and very stingy for what you pay. Keep getting smaller each time I have been. Very inconsistent! Asain lady there insists on putting the smallest servings of everything she can insisting she's just doing her job.
Not bad. Small portions. More nachos than meat. Tasty meat and vegetarian selection. Fresh guacamole. Yummy salsas and sauces. It's definitely better than Taco Bell. See the freshness!
Bought a Caribbean smoothie from here. The smoothie was delicious and healthy. Customer service was nice but little bit slow. The place looks clean and tidy.

i just got a salted caramel smoothie from here a few hours ago and it was so thick and unblended and had chunks of dates in it. i couldn’t even drink it through the straw, if i hadn’t already left the mall i would’ve asked for a new one.

It's a chain store, but this is the worst one I've ever eaten at. The boss is very stingy—he cuts the meat very thin and even reduces the portion. They only give a tiny bit of ginger slices; I've never seen such a small amount before. They just want to cut costs to increase profits. The fried chicken isn't fresh either, as if it's been left out for a long time. I think this boss is a cunning businessman, especially since there are so many tourists here!

I came here in he morning and my sushi was made to order. I got the jumbo salmon lovers. It was so fresh and absolutely delicious. You can never go wrong with st pierres salmon 🍣 their tuna and prawn options are also very nice :))

Extremely slow service, especially at the drive-through. No smiles, no greeting – it honestly felt like the staff didn’t want to be there or didn’t know what they were doing. I waited 20 minutes in a drive-through with only two cars ahead. Unbelievable.

Unhygienic and overpriced! Went here for my boyfriend’s birthday, and spent ages waiting for a single bowl of chips and smoothie to come out despite the fact that very few people were coming on and everyone had been served bar two tables. $15.5 for the smallest unsalted bowl of chips. Had to buy a second lunch elsewhere - this was pathetic for the price. Our salt and pepper didn’t work as they were rusted through, went to another table to get salt and pepper and same issue and one of them had a hair inside! Our smoothie as shown looked great, we ordered a large only for it to taste like milk and water, no mango flavour at all! Was also overpriced. The outside area where we sat clearly needs some help as you can’t see outside the clear windbreak it’s so dirty and there seems to be rust everywhere. Will not be coming back.

Update Review : This used to be my favorite dish here , the dumpling with spicy sauce. Unfortunately, on my recent visit they changed the dumpling skin, and it’s just not the same. The new skin is thicker and chewy, which really change from the overall taste. I definitely preferred the old version. A bit disappointed, since this was the dish I always came back for. We always order the dumplings with spicy sauce – they’re soft, tasty, and one of the kids’ favorites! The noodles are also really good. The broth is flavorful, the noodles are chewy. Definitely worth a visit if you love noodles and dumplings! 🍜🥟
I ordered braised beef on rice in the store. When I got home, there were only 5 pieces of beef and 1 piece of broccoli, but I was charged $15. I feel like I’ve been ripped off.
“I came here after seeing so many good reviews from social media and I’m glad I did! The food is really delicious and definitely lives up to the hype.

Had no idea this restraunt existed until Ila Brazilian colleague told me and suggested the Coxihna. I had no clue what he was talking about, so I had to go. Top rated in auckland, and I felt like I had to try a few things. - Fries 7.4/10 They weren't burnt. They looked like it, but they're weren't. Nice size fries, steak cut. - Coxinha de frango 9.7/10 1st time having this. The owner said it was shaped by hand, and it looked like an egg. Filling was chicken and cheese, I was suggested to have cream cheese on the side and turned out to be a really decent starter. Just wish it was a bit bigger. - Vatapa de norte 8.4/10 The salad was OK, and I had extra pepper. The yellow curry like dish was made from oil from a special palm tree and had a unique flavor. There was a decent amount of prawns in it, and it was very enjoyable. - Brazilian truffles 7.7/10 Nice little sweets. Preferred the chocolate over the white one, but they were both good. Brazilian lady came out to me and explained how the business has been open for 11 years and is still going strong, even giving me extra rice for the dish. Very friendly service and overall love the place. I'll be back.

Went for the Sunday roast for Father’s Day. I am 55 years old and had a few roasts in my time. Some good, some bad. This was the worst I have ever had. Inedible rack (supposed to be a shoulder) of lamb. Burnt vegetables. Stir fried onions (what ???) and a pot of gravy in a plastic pot. 30 bucks? Are you joking? One of us had a pizza who didn’t fancy a roast. Might have been nice if the base was cooked. I usually can’t be bothered to log in to google and give a review but this was next level rubbish. Shame because I have eaten there at night a few times a few years ago and it was ok. Maybe it’s changed hands. We had a burger too that was pretty average and when we turned up it was like they didn’t know we had booked and we waited a long time to order a drink. Oh dear.
Very good food and had an authentic Mexican dining experience. 5 stars would def recommend coming here.

Mama NO-no Came to Mama Loco hoping for a Mexican fiesta... left feeling like I got robbed with a side of lime. We ordered the Adobo Tacos $18.90 for TWO tacos that tasted more like “I-don’t-know” than adobo. If you’re going to charge that much, at least let my taste buds travel to Mexico, not... confusion. Then came the chicken burger for around $20. Bland, basic,nothing special. Even the chicken seemed like it wanted to escape. The fried chicken was the final slap $21 for 4 sad pieces. FOUR. That’s over $5 a limb. Was it massaged by angels? Raised on classical music? No? Then explain the price. Honestly we got all chicken and they all tasted the same. Only thing that slapped was the frozen margarita, the drink was the real MVP, probably because it numbed the disappointment. Proceed with caution (and maybe a flask)
I had the apricot chicken pizza, and it was really delicious! The indoor seating was clean and comfortable. The staff was friendly, and the food came out quickly, so it was a very satisfying meal 👍🏻

Seafood Tom yum soup… One mussel, one piece of calamari, one prawn and one piece of fish which was totally undercooked. Plus a huge piece of shell from the mussel (as big as my thumb nail) which almost broke my tooth. Pad Thai. Bland. Almost no flavour. Green curry was actually quite nice. Happily finished this dish. Not a great experience for what we paid. Probably won’t return.
I got their butter chicken. Naan was freshly cooked. Generous portion!
I had Rogan Josh and taste was soooo gooooooooddd. Even my husband loved it 😊

Just returned to NZ from living overseas for 2.5 years. I had to go and have my favorite Butter Chicken with a garlic cheese naan bread. I have eaten at alot of different Indian restaurants in NZ and Australia but Shamiana Albany is the best by far 10/10
Tried the standard bowl. Was great and the veges were fresh. So nice to have such a good change. Tried other Katsubis and not the greatest but ok.

I was just in today (08.09.2025 Monday) in the afternoon (about 1pm) and saw that there was a big lady up front bossing around this shorter guy (sorry didnt get any names) who honestly seemed like he was boosting away to get all the drinks done, while she was walking around fiddling with the order tickets, pretending to be busy. Seemed like she was moving around heaps to make it seem like shes doing lots of work while everyone else was actually working. Im not expecting much from a McDonalds nowadays but this just made me feel bad for the legend working up front. This review is because I overheard the lady saying “finish all the coffees then move over to the rest of these tickets”. In which the guy started to do. Not long after someone complained about people who ordered after her getting their orders done first. She then proceeded to tell the other guy off for doing coffees and do the other drinks WHEN SHE TOLD HIM TO DO THAT. No hate to her tho, she seems like she might’ve had a bad day… or bad week. Just feel bad for the homie working up front. Shout out you bro.

I bought a foot-long chicken and bacon ranch sub from this Subway outlet and it was the worst one I've ever had. ​I asked for the garlic bread to be toasted, but the employee only put it in the microwave for a 5 seconds and took it out. When I asked for more salads and jalapeños, the lady at the counter was counting the salads and then only put on two jalapeños and two slices of onion and carrot. I definitely won't be going back to this outlet. I highly recommend the Subway on William Pickering Drive instead.
Ordered 1 regular chicken on rice and 1 large, somehow regular has more rice and meat, with little bit less salads. Also meat was dried.

Taste amazing, authentic sri lankan food. The best coconut sambal, reminds me of indonesian food. Found this randomly on maps, but turns out good😋 The lady is nice, serving us fried rice and jelly dessert (thought that the buffet is only in the display). $25 per pax for buffet
Amazing and tasty Sri Lankan food for a reasonable pricr
Amazing food and staff, the cheapest place to eat in auckland! The 10$ small meals are bigger then most large meals.

Really tasty food! The crispy pork was light and flavorful, the veggie stir-fry fresh and crunchy, and the spicy chicken noodles were full of flavor. Good portions and authentic taste — will come back again!
The food was absolutely delicious and the service was warm and welcoming. Every dish was fresh and full of flavor. Definitely one of the best spots I’ve tried recently — I’ll be coming back for sure!

The owner made me the best dairy free chicken korma and naan I have ever eaten. Was very accommodating with my dairy intolerance, and made sure I was fine with all of the alternative ingredients. I will keep going back!

Below average food overall. The portion size was surprisingly small. I ordered noodles — the vegetables were still cold, which suggests they weren’t cooked properly. The momos had a foul smell, likely not fresh. Disappointing experience; it feels like the food isn’t made fresh.
Absolutely amazing, delicious flavoursome food. We did trust the chef & it didn’t disappoint. Staff were super friendly and polite, the art work on the walls is also super cool.

My wife and I had heard and read good things and very pleased to say, the good things turned into excellent things, in all aspects of the 90 minute dining experience. Reasonably busy Sunday evening, although not to the point of recent experiences at other eateries, where the fully allocated tables meant an impact to service. On that point, the service at Gao is fantastic. Not overly intrusive, but attentive enough. Just how we like it. The Peking Duck pancakes had a different spin on the usual ‘do it yourself’. These came in a kind of roti, surrounding the succulent crispy duck: sesame, cucumber and a generous dash of plum sauce, of course (I’m a poet). This dish is poetry in motion. My wife had the bao buns. She’s had a lot of bao bun previously and the complements flowed on this offering. Reminiscent of KFC, well, yes. Three nicely presented buns, crispy and filling. Definitely a highlight! As for my main, the Koji Aged Steak with a miso and sweet potato puree, wasabi - the latter in smaller quantity which pleased me - beer battered fries were a great accompaniment on the plate. Some salad would have completed the picture so a suggestion to consider maybe, but this is a minor point. Was delicious. We were pretty full at this point, but this celebratory dinner demanded a complete three course, so I went for the dessert banana spring roll. An adventurous mix of ingredients and flavour: banana, jack fruit (I felt like trying something I had never indulged in before), chocolate, which I believe is the best - Whittakers - and bourbon caramel with a hint of coconut. Such a melee of flavour could have meant each competing with the other too much, but have to say, the end result is subtle and balanced. Will be my ‘go to’ parting course I think. I like the menu headings, Something Small, Something Large and more besides. Vegetarian and vegan friendly too, just to note. Decent wine selections to accompany the dishes on offer. I would put Gao in the upper ranks of Asian fusion in terms of restaurants we have tried in Auckland. Maybe even number one, in fact, yes, premiere spot! A credit to the staff, thank you for a great dining experience. P.S. the toilets are definitely a point of note. Photo attached. Is this a cunning way of keeping patrons in the restaurant longer? I almost didn’t find my way out 😆

This was our second visit to Gao and once again, we really enjoyed the food. We always go for the set menu, which is consistently wonderful. Each time we booked for 4–5 people and had a great experience. The mood lighting was much better than on our first visit, making the atmosphere more pleasant, and the added heater inside was a nice touch. The only downside was the background music, love that it's upbeat and while it was fine at first, it eventually got too loud, (bass music thumping) making it hard to have a conversation and a bit irritating. Overall, we love the service, love the food, and appreciate that parking is available.

Food was just ok. We ordered chicken wings off the kids menu but they were so spicy the kids couldn't eat them. The burger is just a piece of chicken and about 2-3 slices of cucumber, very underwhelming. The place was clean and the food arrived quickly
The food here was excellent. We had the sizzling fajitas and loved them. We had some questions prior, and the staff was extremely helpful answering our inquiries. We'll definitely be back

First time here. Ordered Pork Rib Clay Pot and Dumplings. All very delicious, the dumplings are currently my favourite in Auckland. Great value for money! Highly recommend, just be patient on the language barrier. Will become my regular when in Albany.
The only place in Auckland that makes beef noodles is also the best. I go there twice a week. People from Hebei really miss home. This is the taste of home.

Very disappointing. The food we received was totally different from what was shown in the pictures and promotions. They use bloggers to advertise large portions and good value, but in reality the portions were very small and the food overly salty. We also ordered a standard chicken dish, but it was served with very low-quality chicken drumsticks and mostly onion. Definitely not worth the price, and nothing like what was promoted.
Quick food turn around in quite a spacious sittings. Good value for tasty authentic Cantonese style food. I will definitely go back again for more.

We are long-term customers. Unfortunately, in the past few months the quality has dropped so much that we will likely not shop here again. Clearly there is a lot of cost-cutting going on, and it has a direct impact on the quality. Pelmeni now have maybe half of the filling that they used to. Napoleon used to be made with evaporated milk, not anymore. Pistachio cake used to be truly delectable, now it is barely edible. So sad to see this establishment deteriorating
Every dish was absolutely delicious 😋 I’ll definitely come back again.recommend

It was so lovely having dinner here tonight. The boss was so kind and the quantity of the food was above our expectations. Most of all, it was so yum! Highly recommend 👌 FYI, I had blue cod soup and the fish was big enough 😋
One of the best sushi around Albany. Very nice staff that accommodates any requests even after sushis are sold out. The scallop and salmon one is my favourite.

A must try! Great food! A great Canton Chinese restaurant….it felt like we were back in Guangzhou/Guangdong! We ordered the deep fried eggplant (delicious), the sweet & sour pork (the fresh pineapple elevated it), the shrimp balls in salted egg yolk (delicious, it needed a sauce), the ginger duck (delicious) and the canton meat selection. The crispy pork was amazing, the bbq pork delicious. The bbq roast duck was average, not the best I’ve had……. The meal portions are big and are made for sharing…..we did over order, but it was worth it and we took home food. Sun Made is a great restaurant, great food and great service. Come try them!
Owner is very very rude on phone. Make you feel sick.

My partner and I chose this sushi go-round for dinner today, introducing her to this type of dining experience. As a sushi enthusiast, I found the overall quality of the sushi to be average. It is obvious but important to say a variety of sushi options circulated well on the conveyor belt, and also ordering from the menu ensured a good service. The two hand rolls we tried were still brilliant, and we concluded our meal with delicious udons. While the prices have become relatively higher, the restaurant maintains a good reputation as a sushi train restaurant in Albany. This place is still a good choice for those seeking a sushi train experience near Albany.

Came out a few months ago to grab a curry. Hadn’t been here before but my partner had. Since then we’ve been back every couple of weeks. The food is great, but for us it’s the service. They are so amazing and always remember my name, (which as someone who can never remember names myself I always find super impressive) we usually sit and have a glass of something while we wait for the food and the food itself is always bang on. The singer is also fabulous! (Give her some applause if you go, she deserves it!) Definitely one of our favourite places.

My partner walked into this place last minute. I was craving something like ramen noodles. But we had already eaten out at a Korean place the night before. Anyways, we were instantly welcomed in and set at a table by a young fellow. This waiter was very lovely, polite and patient. He let us settle in, he asked us politely if we were okay with the table choice. He then asked if we wanted a litt candle on our table. This was super cute as it was Valentine’s Day but we weren’t really there for that. But it totally set the mood.😅 He kept us informed and allowed us to sit while he went grab us water. In the mean time we had a think about what we wanted to eat on the menu. At the right time he was back to check on us and we ordered. The food didn’t really take that long to come out either. The food was delicious though! We had calamari and prawns for entree. They were both great with the great sauces they were marinated in😍 For our main, we had Rack of lamb and an Alfredo fettuccine with ham and chicken. The fettuccine sauce was delicious with everything in the pasta. 😍 My partner had the rack of lamb and he said it was lovely but just a little too “tomatoe-y”😅 Then again, he doesn’t really like tomatoes. So for that I’m sure it was still great cause he ended up eating it all! Hospitality and customer service was GREAT, from the start til we walked out the door! Big ups to the Buon Venuti Ristorante & Pizzeria! Your workers make it more comfy to sit there and talk whilst eating food😍 That last minute turn up ended up being our fave part of the night! We will definitely be back to try the pizzeria😍
WOW. This is the NICEST kebabs I have EVER had. Oh my goodness, the way they plated up the food was outstanding. I LOVED the staff. SO kind and generous. 10/10 food. THIS IS A MUST

Had a lovely family dinner here and just had to try the ribs which was recommended by a friend who had visited recently. They were fabulous! The service was good, but not outstanding. Live music started up and wasn't too loud. It was still easy to have a conversation over a large-ish table without having to shout. We'll definitely be back!
One of my favorite fish and chips shop! Would definitely go back

Dropped in a couple of days ago and bought a Samosa-Coke combo at lunch time. A colour photo of the combo shows two Samosas and a coke, among photos of other combos on offer. When it was ready, I was told to select any drink from the fridge but I've got only one Samosa, contrary to what is shown in the colour photo. Is it a case of misleading and deceptive practice contrary to provisions in the Fair Trading Act?

This place has consistency in the taste, have been going here for decades. Naan is always soft and can stay same until next day( just a trick to warm for 1 minute next day with an ounce of water in a bowl next to it while heating to retain moisture) . Highly recommended and service is great, they do remember their customers. Curry is yum.
Bunny chow order for a group lunch. Eight orders was easy to order and pick up on the day. Fresh soft loaf of white bread toasted with a generous filling of the curry. Happy team. Would do it again.

I visited this subway today. As I sat and ate my food the owner of this location began abusing his two female staff while I was in the store. He yelled at one of the female workers until she cried and he continued to yell at her. When I told him he can’t yell at a female like that he told me to mind my own business. Never going here again
Very poor customer service. Not worth it, putting very very less salads seems like they are counting the leaves

OMG, I have seen a lady named Suruchi on many times, and I’m very dissatisfied with her behavior. She always speaks rudely to the staff, which is both unprofessional and concerning. To better understand the situation, I even approached her directly ... unfortunately, her attitude was just as disrespectful.

I’ve given 1 star because I had a special request for my son, but unfortunately it was denied. On top of that, the pricing feels unreasonable — a 3.4kg bag of boba pearls costs $42, yet the staff at the counter told me if I wanted that amount, I’d have to order it myself. They make so much profit by just adding 30ml of flavour, one spoon of boba pearls, and water, then selling it for $10. It’s disappointing when a business can’t accommodate a simple request and still can’t manage to satisfy the customer.
The service in the store is excellent and the food is delicious. I like eating pork riblets with chips.

Missing spring onion on a pizza that only has 5 "toppings". Not a lot of chicken for a chicken pizza. Crust uneven and quite large on a couple pieces. This on a pizza they think is worth charging $15 for. Honestly get more consistent pizza from other branches on their $7 value range. Would not recommend giving them your business. Shouldn't need to ask for them to provide the service they promised, its kinda expected. Disappointing experience.

5-Star Review Had an amazing experience here today after my kid's basketball game! We came for the buy one get one free pizza deal, and the staff was incredibly nice and friendly. Instead of just the free pizza from the deal, they offered us a new pizza flavor to try—and it tasted absolutely fantastic! To top it off, they even surprised my kid with a free mini basketball—such a sweet and thoughtful touch! The warm hospitality made our post-game meal even more enjoyable. We’re definitely becoming regular fans from now on! Highly recommend!

The guy behind the counter Aidan (hopefully thats spelt right lol) Guy was a hero, went in on Fathers day as per tradition and he let us know there would be a slight wait due to Oven issues, no stress at all! It looked like he was working a solo shift which is bananas for a sunny Fathers Day! Dude never crumbled under the pressure and knew how to prioritise orders, my family and I placed a pretty sizeable order so we were expecting a long wait time since it was just him doing it all, he managed to get the small orders out fast so customers didn’t get upset, he slipped us an extra few garlic knots as an apology for the wait (hopefully I dont get him in trouble for that) Just solid, cool calm and collected service! - matt

Just had the Meat Lover's Pizza from Pizza Hut last Saturday and it absolutely hit the spot. This pizza is exactly what it promises to be: a glorious, indulgent celebration of meat! The foundation was perfect—their Pan Crust. It was golden brown, buttery, and had that signature crispy-on-the-outside, soft-and-pillowy-on-the-inside texture that soaks up all the flavors without getting soggy. It's the only crust robust enough to handle the mighty lineup of toppings. And what a lineup it is! A hearty portion of pepperoni, Italian sausage, ham, beef, and bacon on every single slice. Every bite was a deliciously different combination of savory, salty, and smoky goodness. The pepperoni was nicely crisped at the edges, the sausage was full of flavor, and the bacon bits added that perfect crunch. There was no skimping here—this is a seriously loaded pizza.100% would recommend for any meat fanatic!

I had a great experience at Pizza Hut! The pizza was fresh, hot, and loaded with toppings. The crust was just the right balance of crispy and soft, and the flavors were delicious. Service was quick and friendly, and the online ordering made everything super easy. Perfect place for a quick and satisfying meal — will definitely be coming back!

Super friendly staff, helped me and a friend out with an order even though they were getting ready to close and to top it off it was one of the best Pizza Hut pizzas I have had. They definitely put a bit more effort in at this store compared to other Pizza Huts I've been too. Thanks heaps, will be back!

The kitchen lady (one of the owners) is very disrespectful to their employees, treats them like absolute garbage. She often talks bad about some customers while looking at them from the kitchen. Overall, their food is WAY TOO OVERPRICED for the quantity and overall quality. IF I WERE YOU I WOULD AVOID THIS PLACE AT ALL COST. SAVE YOUR COIN FOR ELSEWHERE THAT’S WORTH YOUR TIME. Thank me later. 👍

Best fish and chips. Snapper and chips is what I got. I have eaten a lot of snapper, fish that is and it was the best, great batter. The chips were also amazing. Quick and professional, get down there people and get a feed in ya

I got the take it your self option, it was tasteless bland 18 dollers waste of my time type deal . There was hardly any noodle , And you have to pay 10 cents to buy a fork or chop sticks to eat this garbage. Sorry but I won’t be back sorry guys
Supreme Indian food. Quality to the last. Nice service. I asked for their best Chicken dish they delivered. Miles ahead of places like Bollywood. Very Authentic. Do it tasty as ....

Nice food and very cozy atmosphere. Friendly staff and cool seating arrangement. The kaaagw chicken was very pricey at $19 for 5 pieces. I probably wouldn't have that again. But the ramen was good, and we'll definitely be back again another day.

Authentic tasting Ramen Restaurant. The Tonkatsu Ramen is highly recommended. The karage chicken and gyuoza were spot on and good size portions. Ask for the Kid's menu, choose a main plus a drink or dessert. Excellent service and the food came out fast, although it was a busy lunchtime

Was very disappointed upon receiving my combination egg foo yung, paid more than I would normally and the container was only half full. Would normally eat half and have half left over, not this time... Also ordered won tons which where very dry and no dipping sauce was provided....however the staff were very friendly.

I had made this review before and for some reason it’s been deleted ? Obviously a red flag and you should take full accountability. Absolutely appalling. I had ordered a chicken burger and this is what the patty looked like. Honestly so disgusting. Look at the fat still raw. I have never had a burger with fat still On it? Every time I go pass the place I am disgusted at how they can serve food like this? Please do better.

We recently discovered Songdo Restaurant in Browns Bay through Uber Eats, and wow, were we in for a delightful surprise! After sampling nearly all the Korean fried chicken in Auckland, we decided to venture into their stir-fried pork and bibimbap. The pork was incredibly juicy and packed with flavor, complemented perfectly by the sides. The beef bibimbap was rich and had the perfect blend of sweet, sour, and the extra heat I craved – truly one of the best I’ve had. On our second visit, we placed a pick-up order directly from the restaurant. The place was spotless, cozy, and beautifully lit. The owners were warm and inviting. I stuck with the bibimbap, while my husband ordered the stir-fried beef bulgogi. The bulgogi was tender yet chewy, bursting with flavor, and made with the freshest ingredients. My second round of bibimbap didn’t disappoint – it was consistently delicious, with well-cooked rice, perfectly balanced flavors, and just the right level of spice I had requested. Portion sizes are generous, and their kimchi is also a standout. If you’re a fan of Korean cuisine, this place is a must-try!
Generous portion. Value for money. Three tables. Can seat maybe 6-8 diners Will return to try their duck.

Authentic Korean food at a very reasonable price. First time visiting this place in years and first time since it became a buffet, but very impressed with the quality of each side dish. This is what you’d expect a decent homemade Korean meal to be; it partly reminded me of my late grandmother’s cooking and it’s the kind of stuff I’d expect to find in Korea. The lady is also super friendly. This place is a gem and it’s highly recommended to those looking to get homestyle Korean food in Albany.

Impressive range of reasonably priced seafood - live, smoked, grilled/battered, etc. Got the fish and chips with an assortment of fried additions. Easily some of the best fish and chips I've ever had. Have also previously tried the grilled snapper which was also delicious.

It was amazing. Honestly very delicious fish, very very tasty, we took crumbed fish. Reasonably price. Big portion. The atmosphere was great, the kids love looking at the live sea creatures. We sat outside and really really enjoyed it. They had real fruit ice cream which we wanted to try but was closing time and it was Reasonably priced as well. Highly recommended.

This review is for the Bento Bowl Oteha Valley. I ordered the katsu curry chicken (large size, paid $20.90). Food: Overall the food was cold, the curry portion was extremely small, rice was over-cooked, and the chicken was very tough. Overall rating, I would give a 0.5/5 Service: There are two self-service kiosk machines. The two ladies working in the restaurant were extremely unfriendly. It felt like there was no such thing as “service” at all. If you’re hungry, just buy sushi next door. This was the No.1 worst-tasting bento bowl I’ve ever had in my life.

Of all the disappointments in the Auckland food scene, my recent experience at Bento Bowl Oteha Valley stands out for its sheer audacity. The primary offender? The Karaage Chicken. Anticipating that satisfying, shatteringly crisp exterior giving way to juicy meat, I was met instead with a limp, greasy, and tragically soft piece of chicken. The coating had the dismal texture of a wet paper bag. The most frustrating part is that this is such an easy fix; even a quick 30-second re-fry at home would have transformed it into something craveable. It’s a fundamental failure of kitchen execution. This leads to the second gut punch: the price. For what they charge for a single bento bowl, you are well within the territory of a proper, authentic Japanese restaurant. Why would anyone settle for this subpar imitation when you could have a truly memorable meal elsewhere? For the same investment, you could be enjoying impeccable, fresh sushi at St Pierres without the lingering taste of regret. The entire meal felt like a cynical transaction, charging premium prices for a product that demonstrates zero pride or understanding of the cuisine it’s attempting to emulate. You’re not just paying for food; you’re paying for the profound disappointment of what could have been. My advice is simple: save your money and your palate. Go literally anywhere else. At least at St Pierres, you know you’re getting what you paid for.

Amazing South Indian Flavours! Had a great experience at Sapid Restaurant! The South Indian food here is truly authentic, especially the Tamil Nadu-style biriyani – absolutely delicious and full of flavor. You can really taste the traditional spices and homemade touch. Highly recommended for anyone craving real South Indian cuisine. Will definitely be back!

★★★★★ We had an absolutely delightful dining experience! The food was bursting with authentic Tamil Nadu flavors, and every dish was a hit with our entire family, including the kids. The boys’ treat was a particular standout—such a crowd-pleaser! It’s rare to find such genuine South Indian cuisine here in Auckland. The team was fantastic, and we’re already excited to visit your new, larger location. Highly recommend! Warmest thanks to the amazing staff!

The cold noodles are super delicious, and I take them away every week. The lamb rib sugar cakes and baked sesame cakes are all delicious. The vegetarian food is also very good and very clean. A must-eat every week

What a phenomenal family experience. If you like a hearty spicy meal the carmalised salmon is for you. Lots of options for spice lovers and many for gluten free/coeliac people. The most friendly and polite staff. Per photos, drink is raspberry frozen margarita, carmalised salmon, pork belly, pad thai and prawn with rice noodles.

Had a lovely dinner here tonight, the food & service were both fantastic, our waitress Hannah was very attentive and took great care of us. We had the sticky pork ribs, lemongrass chicken, caramelised salmon, popcorn prawns and the crème brûlée to finish. There were also plenty of drinks to choose from with a good range of beers, wines, cocktails and mocktails. Beautiful interior of the restaurant and a very warm and cosy vibe. Would highly recommend !

Kebabzone is absolutely amazing. I ordered the meat on chips mixed grill and was blown away the portion. For only $17.99, you get a meal that’s packed with enough food to keep you full for ages. Places like this are rare nowadays. Other places would have charge you 23$, with less portions . This place stands for value and quality. Definitely one of the best spots Ive stumbled upon in while.
Went here many times afterwork. Food is amazing, everyone is welcoming and friendly.

My sister and I had a fabulous lunch at the Black Antler yesterday, 16th August 2025. The staff were very friendly and helpful, the atmosphere is great and the food is delicious and generous in size. I would recommend going there, it's a great experience. Angela

I ordered a large four cheese and mozzarella sticks and it was handed to me just ten minutes later. Service is not only fast but very friendly too. Ripped into the pizza once home and it was superb… delicious, creamy cheeses complimented perfectly with a lightly spicy salami and set on terrific doughy base. Loved the Mozzarella sticks too. Highly recommended if you want proper pizza made with real fresh ingredients. Superb

If you’re looking for authentic Italian pizza in Auckland, this is the place to be! The dough is light, perfectly cooked, and the toppings are fresh and full of flavor — just like in Italy. You can really taste the quality and the passion behind every bite. The chef is not only highly skilled but also very kind and welcoming, which makes the whole experience even better. Definitely one of the best pizza spots in Auckland if you want the real Italian taste!
Friendly staff quickly had us seated and took our order. Love the decor inside. The seaweed and smashed cucumber dishes were very tasty and the pork belly bao and pork dumplings were amazing.

This café always catches my eye, spotless every single time I visit, with clean tables and friendly staff who even managed to seat a group of five within minutes during rush hour. This time I came alone and tried the grilled halloumi salad with vegan chicken, absolutely delicious! The coffee was perfectly frothy and full of flavor. A must-visit if you’re nearby!
I recently dined here, and it was a truly delightful experience from start to finish. Yummy Food, great service and nice atmosphere. Definitely revisiting worthy.
Enjoyed an enjoyable breakfast with good friends. The food quality and presentation were outstanding. Service was great and fast, ample parking available behind the restaurant.
Been here enough that they know my order the second I walk in the door. Aneela & Raman are awesome. The chicken and mixed on chips are super filling and yum for the price. 100% recommend

Had a mixed on rice. Definitely not authentic Turkish food. Humus was terrible and runny, meat had no taste and extremely salty and rice was lumpy. Threw the food to the birds. Will never buy there again . Total waste of money!! Galata in milford is way way better.

Have used Handi about 4 times now. Tonight 2 butter chicken and one lamb mango. All really good. Just be safe I asked for NZ spicy which was great but next time I'll prob go for their hot as I think it would be fine for me. Def would continue to use Handi as our go to indian takeaway. Look forward to trying other dishes.
One of the best Indian cuisine restaurant in Auckland. Their hand made naan bread is the BEST!, must try. Customer friendly staff. Cheers to Balwant.

As soon as you walk in the store you smell the amazing food! They weigh the meat so everyone gets the same portion. PACKed it with vege and gravy!! They even have mash potatoes 😍 super friendly. Nice and clean. We got the pork belly and my goodness was it good! Pork cooked perfectly and the crackle done right. Will definitely be going back!

By far one of the best Roast places in Auckland, there's only 2 that I rate highly, is this one and the Silverdale one. Carvery Roast, portion is big, food is fresh, gravy is perfect (not too watery or too thick) just right. They go over and above with the potato portion. Just all round great roast and service is ALWAYS friendly! Highly recommend!!
Very delicious and good price. Forgot to take a photo of all the food because it was too delicious to wait
As a Chinese, I love that restaurant and staff. It’s a good experience in Su’s food which is really amazing Chinese’s northern tradition food tastes. Hope so you can give it try in the Su’s food :)
Great place - excellent service, friendly staff. Busy nights/quiet night - caters for all. Great quizmaster on a Tuesday night (but don't tell everyone - feet teams mean less competition!?!). 😉
Great staff, an awesome view across Browns Bay beach to the ocean, and great prices on a wide range of beer served in real pints! Live bands are often on, too... What's not to like?
Great vibe! Very friendly staff members. The food was good too. I’d recommend the beef main.
First time dining here and i highly recommend Beautiful food and friendly staff Dishes in my opinion are affordable Will definitely be back

Monsoon in Browns Bay serves the best Indian food on the North Shore, hands down. Their naan is simply unmatched, and every dish is bursting with authentic flavor. It's a must-visit for anyone craving top-quality Indian cuisine

Tried out this new Thai spot today since they’ve got a $15 lunch special 👌 We had the Pad Thai and the Tamarind Duck (Ped Ma Kham). Both were pretty good. flavors hit the spot! The place is small and cozy, perfect if you’re coming with just a few friends. Plus, the owner and staff are super friendly, which makes it even nicer to eat there.

We usually have a great experience at Katsubi and we have it at least 1 in 2 weeks. But today I have to say not happy at all. My bowl is not full and my partners bowl also. For the price you pay you expect to have at least what you always get. Don't think I will be visiting Browns Bay Katsubi again.

Very disappointed with the service. I placed an order online for pick up and expected it to be ready at the time given. Instead, they ignored my order and decided to serve other people first. Completely unprofessional and a waste of time. Won’t be coming back. Please fix your service. We waited like half an hour for to get our food ready.

Delicious food and great service at MamamYen in Browns Bay! We had pho, crispy pork belly, pork spring rolls, and brown sugar bubble tea; everything was amazing. The pho broth was perfect, the pork belly had the crispiest skin, and the bubble tea was just right. Friendly staff, fast service, and a beautiful interior. Definitely coming back to try more dishes!

Had dinner for the first time last night what a cracking surprise! ,lovely staff, food surpassed all expectations, ambience lovely, every table was full. We had the pork mince spring rolls which were fried and tasted so light..Pho broth to follow was delicious and my partner had the recommended chicken dish which was so flavourful. We will definitely be back!

Starter - Chicken satay skewers 8.1/10 These were actually really good entrée for $10. Chicken is grilled really nice, and the peanut sauce is decent. Main - beef pad thai 8.6/10 Surprisingly, a lot is going on here, and I like it. Chili, peanut, lemon, bean sprouts, fried onion, and egg. Delicious noodles with very nice slices of beef. I felt for $20. This was definitely worth it.

Today's dining was a little disappointing ONLY due to the waitress processing the costs incorrectly. The food presentation and taste was amazing as always. The waitress was actually very attentive during our lunch time sitting. However, when I paid the bill, I was charged double for our order. The waitress had entered our orders twice into the computer. Was easily fixed by staff once I noticed. We had to get our desert as take out as we were too full! Haha We love dining at 21 Days and will continue to do so.
Love the crepes, big and yummy, very filling, we normally share one between two people.Drinks are great too!

Flavours can be enhanced & Service was slow on a Saturday evening with no crowd in the restaurant. Plenty of space inside which is good but wait time for the entree to be served took close to 20mins and we were one of the few people who seated to dine in. We appreciated the lamb mince samosa because it only had meat filling without potatoes (however it does need a lil more flavour, and salt) Chicken Rogan Josh tasted like a mix of butter & tikka chicken gravy. We ordered hot but it still was slightly on the sweeter end. Balti Prawn curry was 👍🏽 The fish tikka on sizzler lacked flavour, but the dipping chutney made it taste better. Basa fish was served, if we knew prior we wouldn’t have ordered it. Good lesson to ask type of fish next time and options to change it. The girl who assisted with taking orders was courteous and apologised for the delay and checked in if we needed anything. 👏🏽

Great costumer service. Cozy vibe. Love the food. The Pizzawich mix was the best . Absolutely loved the chips. We also got the ice cream in two flavours vanilla and chocolate. Liked the taste but texture wise it could be creamier. Generally recommend to try the sandwiches

I highly recommend this place. They serve authentic Malaysian food and one of the best Wat Tan Hor in Auckland, which is the family’s fave! The staff is amazing, from giving you options to customise your orders depending on your preferences to explaining what the dishes are. The servings are quite generous too so you get the value for money when it comes to taste and price To top it all, the service exceeds expectations and always comes with a smile. This will be our new fave for Malaysian food cravings!
Love this place. The staff are welcoming and sell the freshest and best tasting sushi and miso in Browns Bay. Plus their prices are very reasonable.
Loving Bay sushi, best Sushi in Browns bay , always fresh, super friendy service and lots of selection.

Hands down favourite dumplings in the whole wide world has to be the pork and chive in spicy sauce. Their ‘hot’ is not to be underestimated, but even though it burns a little for me it’s well worth it. Dan dan noodles a nice accompaniment to the dumplings but not a must. Portion sizes are huge so always go for the Small if in doubt. Fell in love with the original Basu Lounge in Takapuna but I really rate their Browns Bay location more.

I’ve been a regular customer here, and this time I tried catering. It was a huge hit—fresh, delicious, and beautifully presented. Everyone complimented it, and it made me feel proud to have ordered from here. Thank you so much to the owner for the wonderful food and care
This is a really good place for sushi. And the owner is so nice. There are many choices here and they are very affordable😆 Highly recommended
Delicious fresh sushi 👌 Friendly staff 🤗 Good pricing and large portions 👍

Was craving for Indonesian food since so long (may be 5 years). Finally found this place in the shore 🇳🇿 Had a couple of Nasi Kunings and Hot Tea’s as recomended by the staff. Flavours were familiar for what I’ve tasted earlier from a different place, so assuming thats authentic flavours. The food was tasty and the lady at the counter was really nice and friendly - will be back again

Nice workers and the atmosphere. The view is stunning. We never received any cutlery had to borrow from another table. Paid $22 for creamy mushrooms and extra chorizo. Never received any chorizo lol You can rate those “pouched eggs” yourself :/

I recently had the pleasure of attending a sushi making class at WashoCook in Browns Bay, taught by the incredibly talented Noriko. The immaculate cleanliness and professional standard of the cooking tools immediately impressed me. Noriko's calm and precise instructions made the experience educational and truly Zen. It's a hands-on class where you're involved in every step, truly embodying the art of Japanese cooking. Noriko's depth of knowledge, stemming from years of teaching in Japan, enriched the class immeasurably. I left not only with a full stomach but with a profound appreciation for the art of sushi making. This hidden gem in Browns Bay is a must-visit for anyone looking for an authentic Japanese cooking class. As someone from London just visiting family, I highly recommend WashoCook to locals and visitors alike. It's an experience I'll cherish and bring back to London, inspiring me to continue making sushi at home. Thank you, Noriko, for an unforgettable class! I have no affiliation with WashoCook; I simply appreciate giving a sincere review for a place that provided me with such a fantastic experience.

I am the biggest coffee snob, particular about service, atmosphere, consistency amongst the staff and I have to say these guys are amazing overall. Def the place to go for coffee in browns bay. I go in at least once or twice a week and have done for a couple of years now and they even take the time to remember my order. Food and smoothies is also great also👌 Def highly recommend, thanks team x
Very lovely staff, food and coffee. Right on the water front
Great for classic Italian flavors and generous portions,the wood fire pizzas are fantastic! Great place to eat.Excellant staff and service.
What are wonderful experience , food , staff ,atmosphere, everything was great , the only down side was the parking,it was hard to find one.

A hidden gem in Browns Bay:) This cosy, family-friendly Chinese restaurant has friendly staff and a quiet, tidy setting. The food tastes fresh and homely, rather than like a typical skewer shop, and the flavours are balanced and delicious. The xiaolongbao were just right, not too salty or oily, and the meat and veggie skewers tasted so fresh, with a sauce that wasn’t too strong but still really tasty. I brought the kids and ordered only the mild ones, and they enjoyed every bite. I also like that it’s an open kitchen, so you can watch them cook while they keep everything spotless. I’ll definitely be coming back to try more from the menu.
Delicious food and great attentive service. The three of us ordered the lamb shank and 2-person sharing platter - so much food! And very tasty. I highly recommend.
I find this store can be a little hit or miss at times and not as good as the Albany store was (now closed) but it's still decent/never bad. I'd just prefer that the chicken was crispier.

The quality and flavours of Chand food is sensational and second to none. Great service as well and a restaurant that is modern, fresh and clean. For this review we got takeaway but the last visit we dined in. It was quiet so it lacked atmosphere… no fault of the restaurant though!

I’ve always had the best experience with my local dominoes for years!! Family was feeling like wings last night so we got two orders BBQ and Ranch wings they were perfect!! I order online and pick up times are always accurate, when I show up it’s ready, quick service and friendly staff.. pizzas always perfect with the right amount of toppings packed with flavours, never disappointed! Shout out to the team for keeping the standard and quality excellent!! Our go to for quick dinner or family game night. Highly recommend Domino’s Long Bay 🍕👌

Ordering online is the way I choose, and the given pickup time is very accurate, accept on the very odd occasion when they have an extreem busy night, which is understandable. Friendly hard working staff, gets my order right every time. For me, this is the place I trust and always return to.
The menu was excitingly different. We tried the exotic sounding starters and they turned out to be delicious 😋 The main course was absolutely scrumptious 😋.
We had the most delicious dinner tonight at Bukhara Restaurant in Long Bay, Service exceptional and flavours just superb. Highly recommend 😊
Had the best dinner experience at Bukhara this evening! We had the Lamb Madras and Butter Chicken, both the nicest curries we’ve had in a long time. Will be back!

Visited this restaurant on Sunday evening. Ordered Bukhara chicken tikka masala and Bukhara chicken ghee roast! Both were absolutely delicious! The staff were so nice and polite. Can’t wait to go back!
Delicious authentic flavours of India 🇮🇳 Very attentive staff & service. Would recommend for lovers of spicy layers of vegetarian goodness.

Maggie and team made this a very special event held at their large private functions room next to the restaurant. Great service and excellent selection of finger foods for a group to share plus top class dumplings ! Highly recommend this place for group meetings and dinners with extended friends and family members. Amazing looking bar selection on the shelves and Jägermeister on tab - or so it seems - something left to try next time 😄 Thank you very much for being great hosts!

Had an impromptu lunch here, this afternoon. It’s a lovely spot. Staff were very welcoming and friendly. We opted for the small/sharing plates. We loved all of it. We chose the salt n pepper squid, beef sliders and fries. All very tasty 😋 Will definitely go back there. Thank you!

Did an early Sunday dinner. Great to see a family run business, the food was delicious, like actually amazing! Would highly recommend. We have been driving past for the last few years and never stopped, will be back again.
$3.90 nice piece of chicken too :)

As I selected my sushi the man behind the counter coughed. Both my son and I who ate here are the only ones in a household of 6 have colds. Please wear a mask. Expensive sushi i very small selection and not very fresh.

Absolutely outstanding! We had dinner at Taj and Tonic and the whole experience was nothing short of amazing. From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere was warm and inviting and the service was friendly and attentive. The food was the real star every dish was bursting with authentic flavors, beautifully presented and cooked to perfection. Hats off to the chefs for creating such an incredible dining experience you can truly taste the passion and skill in every bite. This was easily one of the best dinners we’ve had in a long time. Highly recommend Taj and Tonic for anyone who wants a top-class meal with impeccable service. We’ll definitely be back again soon!

As traditional of an Italian pizza as you can get in Auckland. Cooked in a wood fired oven, each pizza is cooked magnificently with a beautiful aroma. You know the food they make will be extremely tasty and made with love when their menu is limited to 4 items: 3 pizza flavours (Margherita, Marinara and a weekly special) and their delicious tiramisu. Highly recommend a visit for pizza and tiramisu lovers alike. Pizza $20-25 Tiramisu $15 Note: they do not cut their pizza so bring your own cutter if you decide to take it to the beach.
