So disappointing to see how this place has gone downhill from its heyday. Could not believe the service and the attitude of the staff. Besides the poor young girl behind the counter running the coffee and clearing plates and doing everything, there were 2 older servers blatantly ignoring everyone and sitting on their phones and one looked absolutely pissed off to be there. Food was presented nicely but lacked flavour. We honestly thought maybe there had been a death or something because the dismissive and negative behaviour was probably the worst we’ve ever experienced. I know you never know what people are going through but the vibes were OFF. Scowling at customers is a bit unnecessary. At least we know why the place was empty.
Great food, great service. There’s a coffee loyalty scheme so get your card stamped and leave it there so you don’t forget next time ;)
Consistently amazing crispy chips and light crispy battered fish. I normally sneak in some delicious potato fritters as well. Staff are charming and so helpful.

I had such a great time sharing amazing food with my friends. The service was amazing and staff are so friendly. I could write a whole essay about the food as it was so delicious. Definitely recommend!

I had a fantastic experience ! The crust was perfectly crispy, the toppings were fresh and plentiful, and the service was excellent. The atmosphere was cozy and inviting. I highly recommend trying their specialty pizzas—they're truly delicious!

The chef is super helpful and accommodating and his curries are the best in the Helensville Parakai region. He now knows just how spicy I like my food, super hot with lots of fresh chillies. Most places don't believe you when you ask for an Indian Hot curry, they think you can't handle it, but this chef has you sorted.

The best Garlic Prawn pizza I have ever had, in fact, it is so good I travel from Greenhithe just to come here! Flavoursome, juicy, lots of fresh prawns and they're not stingy with their toppings, the crust is the best pizza crust I've had, worth every cent. Love the chips, they too are always well seasoned and cooked just right. Highly recommend this awesome place. Well worth the trip.

Great pizzas that have plenty of toppings and are flavoursome and delicious. The butter lamb and burgers are great too and fill you up. A local resident recommended this place and we were not disappointed.

If you live near this takeaway - lucky you - If your going past it’s definitely worthwhile to make a stop-off with an empty tummy. This time we are getting their best Salmon Pizza I’ve had it before and it’s delicious- generous amount of Salmon with lots of other toppings and a wicked swirl. I’ve had their Goat Byrani and that’s why I’m getting it again because it’s so darn good! We are also getting another Goat and lamb Byrani. I’ll post a photo shortly
If you love curry, this goat curry sets the gold standard – unforgettable taste!

We got 4 pizzas and fries. The fries seasoning was superb and the pizzas were joy in each slice. The paneer butter chicken pizza is a brilliant idea. The cheese it's qoulity and stretchy. Very pleased 😊
Took just under 2 hours to get delivered, food was average and very cold. Was extremely disappointed. Travel time was less than 15min so wasn’t acceptable.
The smorgasbord is great- (my new favourite actually), however the fish and chips were not so good.

I am not much of a 'Takeaway Fan' so to speak but i treated myself, my sister and her husband to dinner from this place last night and it was absolutely delicious. I got kumera fries and a pineapple fritter and they were really enjoyable. My sister and her husband really enjoyed their Loaded wedges and chips aswell. Overall friendly staff, good service and decent quality and prices. Keep up the good work Garfield Takeaways I would definitely recommend you to people. 😊
Another mucked up order. Gave this place a go again. Have had a couple of ok meals. Tonight had a messed up order. Rung to try and remedy it and the lady on the phone had no idea what was going on.
Food was great, lovely little spot. Curry puffs are the bomb.
Passed this place and absolutely love their food. The crispy Thai bread is amazing! Main meals are also nice.

They accidentally gave me pineapple on a ham pizza when I didn’t order that, I took it back cause I’m allergic and told them this. They simply took off the pineapple rather than remaking it and now I can’t eat it without risking dying. This is horrific service and extreme laziness. This is so messed up they could have killed me. Never ever go here, Pizza Hut so much better.
Lovely place, nice people. Really good for a rrlaxed meal and we love Wed night quiz.
fresh snapper battered in front of your eyes. nice chunky fish meat and crispy batter. A good find. we’ll be back.

First time stopping in and was really impressed. We ordered two lamb kebabs with spicy sauce and two sides of chips. The kebabs were packed with flavour, and the spicy sauce had just the right kick. The chips were spot on – crispy, not soggy at all. The café itself was very clean and well presented, and you could tell it was run well. There was a few people before us but the food came out quickly, and the staff were friendly and welcoming. Parking right out front made it super convenient too. All-round great experience. Definitely a place I’d go back to.

We have Turkish about once a month, i usually have the mixed kebab 👌😋 My boys luv the burgers so tonight I thought I'd try one and omg "The Ville" burgers are off the hook. I always think they just look too big, but I managed to deal to it....... the patties, are they homemade? coz m8 theyre nice n tender, everything in that burger was onn 👌👌 thanx heaps Turkish😋😋😋 full as a bull now 🙈🙈🙈

Beautiful place, great design. Lovely atmosphere during the day with plenty of natural light ; I’m curious to see how it feels in the evening. The food was delicious and beautifully presented. Compliments to the chef for his art. Approved!
We ordered a takeaway pizza + fries, they were delicious! Service was quick 😃

We stopped in for a quick bite and was genuinely impressed. The staff were friendly, efficient, and got our order out quickly even though it was busy. The burgers were hot, fresh, and perfectly made, and the chips were nicely salted. The restaurant appeared to be clean and tidy and well maintained. There was plenty of seating available for the whole family. Definitely one of the better BKs I’ve been to in New Zealand. It was such a welcome relief to relax and recharge the car before the final stretch home. Highly recommend this spot if you're passing through!

I had an excellent experience at Burger King today! The customer service was outstanding Arshdeep was incredibly friendly, polite, and helpful. They made sure my order was accurate, served fresh, and even checked in to see if everything was okay. It’s rare to see such genuine care and professionalism, and it really made my visit special. Thanks to Arshdeep for making the experience so enjoyable. I’ll definitely be coming back!
I like the food and the service is also nice. They provide good hygiene food to all customer. Also, the staff is very friendly and helpful.

Outstanding service! It was our first time today. I was particularly impressed by the Manager—she was exceptionally accommodating and understanding. Her warm and attentive approach truly enhances the overall experience and makes the place feel welcoming and worth returning to.

Came here for a very late lunch on Saturday. The lamb shank is delicious - and a large portion size for the price. I was very impressed with the customer service - they gave around 15 people food at the same time, and it was not even a long wait. They also were very friendly when I wanted to modify my order. Will definitely come back, and try to try something sweet also :)

Awesome atmosphere,very spacious beautiful cafe,clean sorrounding delicious food great coffee love their coffee as a coffee lover ,friendly staff efficient and great service ,great that it's open for public not just exclusive for people who lives in Botanic,definitely will come back. Overall everything is awesome vibe!

Disappointing overall! The Thai fish cakes looked pretty but had absolutely no thai flavours, or any flavour actually; more like bland fish cakes with barely any fish. The passion fruit slice was tasteless. Also they are cashless!? Nowhere on their website does it state this, not to mention its illegal not to accept cash. No thanks.

Restaurant service is here always extremely slow as they seem to prioritise their drive through customers. They always appear short staffed, and the staff they do have, try to avoid serving you at all costs. I always have to request fresh fries as otherwise they are served lukewarm. Today my cheeseburger had a thick smearing of grease or something on both buns, which made it inedible. The fries had no salt and were tasteless. Overall disappointing experience all round.

Went on this Wednesday mid night, there was a huge rush with a number of vehicles lined up at drive through and a couple of guys at delivery. As far as I could see there's only 2 female employees working tirelessly. Kudos to them for their hardwork and patience. Fully tired clearly visible on their face yet greeting every customer with such a nice smile. They definitely deserve a high recognition for their level of professionalism. Totally forgot about the food and it's taste. Actually it didn't matter.

The drive-thru system at McDonald’s Silverdale is fundamentally broken. On one visit, I witnessed the cashier take two consecutive orders from the same lane, leaving customers in the other lane, who had arrived earlier waiting far longer than necessary. To make matters worse, the second car in that favored lane had even arrived later than us. On another visit, I patiently waited while a customer in the other lane took an excessively long time to order and pay. By the time the cashier was finally able to take my order, it had just ticked over to 11:03 AM. I was told that the breakfast menu was no longer available. This was especially frustrating given that the customer before me, who was still ordering when the cutoff passed, was allowed to order from the breakfast menu. This is completely unacceptable. If McDonald's enforces a strict breakfast cutoff, then the system should account for customers already in the queue before the deadline. It is unfair and frankly disrespectful to deny service to customers who were clearly waiting in line before the cutoff, simply due to inefficiencies in your own drive-thru operations. This experience has completely undermined my trust and loyalty as a long-time customer. Do better, McDonald’s Silverdale because you’ve just lost someone who used to come regularly.

This was the first time i have been here. I had the green curry and pad thai, it was absolutely delicious , both full of flavour and lots of chicken. The lady serving im guessing the owner was very friendly and definitely had me leaving thinking you now have a new customer I can't speak more highly of this place, highly recommend

New owners are incredible! Have ordered here many times in the last 6 months and not once been disappointed. Plus they aren't mean on the CHEESE which is the most important thing by far! This is our go to pizza shop on the coast now 😋
Absolutely loved Pizza Hut! The pizza was hot, fresh, and packed with flavor. Great service and a cozy atmosphere. Definitely a 5-star experience!

This is my go-to Subway! The food is always fresh and affordable. The staff, including the owner, are incredibly friendly and make every visit a pleasant one. The food’s always good, the service is quick, and they nail it every time. I definitely recommend this spot if you want a friendly place that serves consistently great sandwiches.
Lovely franchise chain located in Whangaparoa. Very clean and nice service. Recommend to try the Tofu Teriyaki rice bowl!

Lots of parking outside and lots of seating inside. First time having Wendy's in a very long time and the staff member was super helpful, especially with sizes of combos. Burgers were perfect sizes and not greasy. Flavourful and satisfying. Tried the chili, which is delicious. An enjoyable experience.
Best bar to grab a cheap jug and do some punting

This used to be the Big Tikka Indian restaurant, bought out and under new management for a while now. I’ve been coming here on and off and always found the food and service reasonable. However, our group’s experience last weekend was well below average. The service was very slow, staff giving preference to uber eats deliveries than serving loyal customers who’d taken the time to come in for a dining experience. We waited 40 minutes between our entree and main course and when served, we wound up with cold curries and after 10 minutes of not receiving our accompaniments of rice and naan bread called the manager to complain. We weren’t the only one’s who had issues, the table next to us had a similar experience, also loyal returning customers. The food was also very average. To add insult to injury, the management then tried to fob us off with a 5% discount voucher next time we came. Will not be going back.

First time visiting Picador and it was lovely. Lighting is a bit bright and it lacks ambiance, but that really is a minor detail. The serving team is friendly and prompt providing service with a smile. The meals are generous and priced well. The steak was cooked exactly as ordered and delicious along with perfect prawns and tender calamari. The chips were crispy, the salad was fresh and the gravy was full and rich. Just a lovely family dinner all round. We will definitely be back.

WATCH OUT STAFF DRIVES INTO CUSTOMERS CAR DO NOT GO HERE. Went back here recently to check if they have upgraded services. No still disgusting. They offered me a refund that I never got. Donut is a waste of time, it's disgusting looks like they sat on it. See photos. Rude staff. And pizzas that were incorrect were cold. Incorrect order, missing ingredients like mayo you have to pay extra for and its not there, AGAIN. food that doesn't reach right around the pizza, and half a pizza with nothing on it. I should have gotten that photo somewhere. This place should have gotten shut down along time ago
Staff was super friendly. Pizzas have improved dramatically in the last few months. Great value and super tasty
Always fresh, hot, and ready on time. Friendly staff, good deals, and consistent pizzas. Best spot in Whangaparāoa when you’re craving Domino’s! 🍕

Been eating here a while, foods usually been ok and service from the girls is great. Went recently a few minutes after 7pm, and the service from the two guys there was shocking. Outright rude and acted like we weren't welcome. Won't be going back. My advice... Do takeaway or only eat in if the girls are there.

I had a medium butter chicken takeaway. It was far too sweet. Completely ruined by the added sugar or whatever made it so sweet. The Naan wasn't soft and puffy it was flat and tough to tear. Wouldn't buy from here again

Tacobebe is a hidden gem in an unassuming block of shops. I chose to eat here based on reviews of other customers and I was not disappointed! I have already shared this place with others saying they have to go! The flavours are intense and the menu is varied. They offer fruity Mexican soda and gave me great recommendations for my meal. Presentation is en pointe. This is a place to be experienced with others for sure! The service was fantastic too. You have to try this out - it’s fun & colourful - a bit like their food!
Got a medium roast lamb. Im a big eater and this was more than enough for me. Potatoes were delicious and crispy. Definitely recommend and will definitely be back

I waited in the line behind a couple and then a young girl to get served. When it was my turn the male behind the counter waved me aside and started to serve the man behind me. I said politely, I was next, but was ignored and had to wait again. The man behind me was apologetic even though it wasn't his fault. I ordered a large roast meal, for two of us, and asked for mint sauce and gravy. No mint sauce and a minute amount of gravy. It was all pretty tasteless. The two cheese cakes were terrible. The base at the bottom was like eating a mouth full of flour, and although they were frozen when I got them, once they were thawed, they tasted a bit off. They were ineatable. I'm taking them back today to get my money back. Cost us $50 and was by no way worth it. Will not be back and will be going to silverdale next time we feel like a roast meal takeaway.
I get my sushi from here every week. It is super fresh and absolutely delicious. Best on the coast by far. The staff are lovely and friendly. Try them out - you will be happy you did! 😘
Really enjoyed the burgers, fries & thick shakes we ordered - happy with the high standards that have returned! Thank you Adam & co.
very welcome good pricing happy face all over really enjoyed come after a swim very skilled chief . I would recommend to friends an family . also can not forget fresh kai to

Delicious and super crispy chicken but soooo expensive! 3.5 pieces of chicken in a regular takeaway cup for $9 is too steep My chicken was ready but I needed a receipt so my chicken sat waiting for me while the staff tried to fix the machine. I finally got my chicken once the receipt printed. I couldn’t bring my family here because it would cost too much to feed them.
Hands down one of the best chicken shops around! The chicken was crispy, juicy, and full of flavor. The portions were generous, and the service was quick and friendly. Definitely my new go-to spot.

Day Staff on Saturday must have been having a bad day as, she refused to drop the music and play the rugby, we were told in an aggressive manor to wait until 6pm, that was when the night shift started, really, this place is normally fun, but it's not happening for me anymore, whole place needs a revamp.

EDIT: Food is great when served and is the only good part of this place. Won't be returning here and it has gone completely downhill... atmosphere is horrible, feels dingy. Not family friendly at all. Overpriced drinks. Pool tables are okay but no good cues. Wouldn't recommend. Much better places to frequent on the coast.

Been coming here literally for years, best takeaway place on the coast, excellent customer service, delicious food and fantastic prices! There's literally nowhere else I've ever been to that will do a burger, potato fritter, chips and a can of drink for $6! And the people who own it are really good people, whom I'd describe after being in business so long as pillars of the community. This place isn't just a business, they're an establishment!
What a fantastic restaurant! Very friendly staff and yummy food. You won't be disappointed. The owner, who is always doing the rounds making people feel comfortable, is a genuinely nice guy, too.

We were looking forward to this roast so made a booking for 12.30. When we arrived and ordered we were told unfortunately this is only available after 5pm. When we said the waiter didn't tell us that, cos if he had we wouldn't have booked! The lady said that she was there when we booked and check with him if we knew. We said no we weren't told! After mentioning, No where on the notice does it say after 5pm. It was explained that our concerns would be passed on. Just letting others know so they don't make the same mistake as us.

I visited your restaurant recently and unfortunately, I was quite disappointed with my meals. The food was undercooked and lacked freshness, and the samosas had very little taste. The portion of salad served with rice also felt very small compared to expectations. I really appreciate the excellent customer service from the staff member who served me—he was polite and welcoming, which I value a lot. However, after spending around $60 over two visits, I feel the food quality did not match the price. I genuinely like the service, but I hope the food portions and taste can be improved.

We had an incredible dining experience here. Ordered mixed meat on chips and chicken on rice and it was perfect - fresh salad, flavourful meat and yummy sauces. It was a hit with kids so one more reason to visit it again :)
Excellent food! Tasted delicious, well presented. Staff just need to be more engaged and friendly for the perfect score.
Really exceptional meat on chips like others have said very good value and great homemade sauces it seems.
Delicious sushi, nice staff. Overall 5 star experience.

Title: Poor Management and Unpleasant Atmosphere I have visited this McDonald’s several times, and unfortunately, the environment here feels very negative compared to other McDonald’s franchises. The owner often comes across as rude, not only towards customers but also towards staff and delivery drivers. Shouting seems to be a regular occurrence, which creates a very unpleasant atmosphere. It is noticeable that staff turnover is quite high, as there always seem to be new faces. The team members do not look happy, and it makes me wonder why there isn’t a system in place to monitor staff wellbeing and turnover within the franchise network. I have been to other McDonald’s locations where the environment is far more professional and welcoming, both for customers and employees. Sadly, this store falls well below that standard

Great food, always come on a Thursday night or others and will go out of my way to come here for Chinese food. Tonight I came at 8pm, doors open, lights on, and was told we're closed get out with a filthy horrible look until we were out of eyesight. Went next door to the bar for a drink, when we were finished at 8:30pm, we came out to find multiple people had just ordered and were waiting for food. Was then told we could come order, at which point i said, "We will never come back as this is absolutely disrespectful". Will never be going back and do not recommend. As a side note I've also had diarrhea from here before. EDIT: Still going here and it's still great, was maybe just a bad day for the chef. We all have them, so can't hold one bad experience against the place

Ordered through a delivery and got less beef patties than I ordered and there was so much salt that it was the main taste for the burger by far. Not bad, but really hit me with the average/below this time around. The beef can hold out if it wasn't so salty.

Absolutely fantastic experience! The new management has made such a difference, the food is fresh, authentic, and full of flavor. The service is friendly and attentive, and the atmosphere is so inviting. Every dish we tried was delicious, and you can tell they really care about quality and customer satisfaction. This is easily one of the best Indian restaurants around now. Highly recommend to anyone looking for great food and a great dining experience!
Seriously good Indian food on the coast. Heaps of vegetarian options too and their curry wraps are great. Consistently great food, thanks team.
Kant wait to come back when there's Event going on food was yum service was grate and the place is really big and really cool set up and very clean

Very friendly staff here. Great selection of Locally brewed Beer. They don't do tasting puddles/Tasters but can surely provide taste if you ask. Very big place with good seating area. We loved the drinks. Food was pleasent but okay. Overall nice experience.

As usual, the food was fantastic, the French toast the best ever. The staff and service are first class. And did I mention the coffee - just perfect. Thank you. 13th September 2025 Still as good as ever - the coffee still the best on the peninsula!!

Lovely couple new management I think. We all enjoyed our food and the atmosphere was warm and relax. Kids love their food didn't even ask for ipad! We ordered eye filet, seafood pasta and calamari with salad and the portion was good with quality ingredients. Definitely coming back again!
The steak and blue cheese pizza is absolutely unreal. Highly recommended to us and definitely delivered. Lovely staff and an all round amazing experience. Wouldn’t look past this hidden gem!!
author_name: S O P H I A C L A I R E

text: We had an absolutely wonderful dinner at Manly Bar & Grill last night! This is a perfect spot for families and groups. We ordered the Mixed Grill Platter to share, and it did not disappoint! It was a massive plate of deliciousness. A huge highlight was the Kids Meal. Our little one loved it! The portion was just right, and it was a proper, balanced meal (which we really appreciate—it's so much better than just nuggets and fries!). It even came with a little treat at the end, which made their night. The service was friendly and attentive, and the atmosphere was relaxed and welcoming for families. We never felt rushed. We will definitely be returning and highly recommend Manly Bar & Grill to anyone looking for great food and a good time!

I had such a wonderful experience here! The new management has truly elevated everything, from the warm and friendly service to the delicious food and welcoming atmosphere. You can really feel the care and attention they put into every detail. Everything was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. I’m so glad I came in, and I’ll definitely be back. Highly recommend!
Owners of India Village Restaurant were very kind. They accommodated us, even though full service did not start, made special bread for our baby, and were friendly. Great place!
Fabulous food. A hidden gem with a $24 menu. If you like Indian, this is the place. The kitchen is A class rated......! Highly Recommended.

We loved their fungi pizza! Love the addition of the truffle oil. Staff was friendly, and energetic, but I dislike when the service has an overly sell orientated energy. They checked on whether we wanted a drink or dessert a few too many times. I recommend one server per table so you don't have to fend off the same question so often. Good atmosphere and great selection of food.

Haven't been since it opened some time ago. Revisited last weekend and I must say, super pleased. Atmosphere was good, buzzing. Great front of house service although it took some time to get someone's attention as it was very busy. Best of all, the food was amazing. Had the Fettuccine and the buralla pizza. Quick service, quality was amazing. Great experience, especially from someone who has traveled and at all around Italy. Couldn't ask for more. I'll definitely be back. I recommend booking! Well done to the team at Due Amici! Thank you.
I love how spacious this cafe is and that the tables are not all so close together. The vibe of the cafe has a nice feel with all the decor ☺️ nice to support local!
Nice tasty curries, very authentic. Huge servings. Have been trying all the locals since Spice and Soda closed down. These guys are the best so far, by far.

Hubby and I just had our meals delivered to Stanmore Bay. It was our first order from Goa to Bombay. The flavors were beautiful, and we look forward to left overs for lunch tomorrow and will definitely be ordering again. 😋
Love to support a local family business. Had a Chicken Bhuna and a Samosa Chaat. Both were super tasty and delicious.
Best Butter Paneer I have ever had and I have had it at least 4 times over the last 3 months and every time it's been amazing.
Beautiful flavors, fresh meat, lovely curry, tried at least 6 different meals now, best on the coast hands down.

Last night I ordered the $30 special and 3 mussels the batter on the mussels was bearly cooked very underdone it was like eating a ball of dough the fish in the 30 special tasted rancid my kids and my wife and I found it actually disgusting would not recommend anyone eating that fish manly takeaways once was one of the top fish and chip shops on the hybiscus coast it is very disappointing where there headed.
Busy but very well organised, so not much of a wait for good kai. Quite traditional range of 'kiwi' faves, with lots to choose from. Staff are super polite and just know what they're doing.
Lovely new owners. Nice food, but $18 for 2 drinks is expenny for my tight ass. Loved the kiddy area too just wish it wasn't so sloppy, I nearly slipped over with my baby boy :/
Fantastic looking pub done up really well inside

The best burgers ever! Served with a welcoming smile by very pleasant staff. The burger was delicious, filled to capacity with a juicy pattie, generous amount of bacon and everything else that goes into a burger. A tad pricey but worth every cent. The premises was neat and clean and definitely worth another visit!
Well seasoned food. Fresh. But need bit more smile on lady owner’s face :)

Highly Recommended! Found this place on Google today, and it's so close to home! They are truly dedicated to making great food. The ingredients were very fresh, and the portions were generous. The owner provided excellent and friendly service. We will definitely be ordering from here again！

Always a great experience at Pizza Hut! The food is fresh and delicious, the service is quick and friendly, and the atmosphere is perfect for a casual meal. Consistently tasty pizzas and sides — definitely my go-to for a satisfying treat.

The best freshest Kinas Oysters Fish ever. I've been to a lot of Fish and chips shops and I'll always travel 40mins to come here. Never been disappointed always a value for money. Highly recommend everything. Very clean and tidy
Best Roast in Auckland. They are hot, fresh, and have desserts available. Super friendly staff, very quick service.
We visit the N.U. many times ( especially for Rugby tests and League games ) and Ryan and his wonderful team always deliver in terms of a top notch experience - in simple terms GO THERE !

Nice atmosphere but some of the food needs work. A lot of work. I do realise the pizzas are good though. Its an open kitchen so you can see everything. The chef was eating with one hand and preparing food with another. The Nachos were absolutely terrible. The paper they were served on top of devolved and by the time we realized we probably ate some of it which is disgusting. Below scores are out of 10 Customer Service 7 Food Quality 5 Atmosphere 7 Presentation 7 Location 8 Parking: Parking available. Overall 7 Again everyone I don’t like to leave negative feedback. There is a lot of positive in the Northern Union Pub but guys we need to do better.

We ordered a half/half pizza and two slices of another pizza. We got one half that was correct and the other half which was not what we ordered and not good. The extra two slices we ordered turned out to be just one slice! Incredibly poor service!!!

We tried the American Muscle Double and the Vegetarian B Twin, and both were absolutely delicious! They were gluten-free, and the buns were soft and super tasty. The service was great too, friendly and fast.

Has to be the best KFC iv had was fresh chicken was crispy and not to oily chips were well seasoned and crispy. I ordered a burger with all the extras nothing missing and fresh. Staff were lovely and fast service,building and toilets were clean and tidy. 10/10 on this one best KFC iv ever been to out of my 40 years

I only use the drive-through at this location. The hot and spicy chicken was crispy and delicious with lots of batter. I love KFC coleslaw, it is the best. The service was quick and easy. I can recommend this KFC. It is run by Kiwis at the time of my visit.

What a pleasant Breakfast. Fries were hot and fresh. Best Crispy Chicken I had from a KFC so far. Really. Everything was on point. Fresh, No soggy Oily Chicken, Hot and Tasty. Really good, I was well impressed. Good JOB!!!
Legendary cuts by Legend👏 Salute 🫡 you fella Time : Monday around 8pm

Not a fan of giving low ratings. But here I go. Bought a Limo Box last Friday. First of all delivery app said order was delivered when it was still in route. Had to call to confirm to make sure it was not delivered to wrong address. Giving 3 star for service only because the lady who answered the phone was polite and professional, app alone would have got one star. Pizza was subpar, toppings were for name sake, it felt like eating bread with sauce, very little sauce. This store did a decent job in the past. Sad to see the quality going down.
Excellent service and efficiency of the staff, pizza hut emphasizez maintaining high quality ingredients.
Not bad fish n chips, good portions and prices, fish was a bit oily though. Maybe just needed to drain longer after cooking. Vege spring roll the highlight, yum as. All in all 4/5 imo.

The worst sushi I've tried. Second time buying and instant regret. Every lunch time they have like no chicken sushi.. ive asked them about it & they say yeah this is it..Literally walking distance to my house and you'd think they dont know how to make sushi but no.. I bought 6 peices and not 1 peice is closed together. Such a mess , doesnt taste right, the rice/chicken (some very odd coloured). So disappointed. Will drive to millwater/silverdale in future. Also priced higher. Not a Karen but wow..
Absolutely fantastic sushi. Affordable, tasty, nice and helpful staff. Tried in many places, this one is defo in my top. I wish you guys all the best with your business.

We’ve been coming to Joe’s Garage since they opened, and it’s consistently amazing! Even when times are tough if we could go out this has always been our first choice as a family with children. The food is always delicious, and the kids—and honestly the whole family—love colouring in while they eat -this is always a highlight. The kids actually eat their meals, making it our favourite place to eat out. After seeing the amazing owners working so hard today on Father’s Day, we just wanted to say how much we see and appreciate their dedication. They also always support local schools’ fundraising efforts, which makes us even prouder to support this wonderful local business. The staff are incredibly friendly—highly recommend! Big love from The Taylor’s!

Thanks so much for the super hospitality and help sorting out our end of season party for my daughter’s netball team. Your help and communication throughout the booking process though to the end of the event made the party a huge success. The private function room was ideal for the kids and made for a fun space without interrupting other diners. Again a huge thanks to the team at Silverdale Joe’s Garage for their efforts making a fun end of season party so memorable for the girls and their families.

We had the most wonderful server called Hannah! Dark hair. She was awesome! What an asset you guys have as now days you don’t get many young people that amazing and friendly! Thanks so much Hannah for making our night!

The very first pizza I ordered a few weeks ago was amazing. It was a regular pepperoni, thin crust. It had ben ten years since I ordered from hell and I was really impressed by my pie. It had heaps of cheese and pepperoni. And it was very affordable! 5 star. Then unfortunately I ordered a ham and pineapple pizza that was supposed to be double cheese, I can't remember the name, I'll check the menu.the ham was decent quality but a far cry from the chunky way they used to do it 10-15 years ago. It used to be these huge chunks, like you get from the leftover Christmas ham. That wasn't the real problem, I understand that was a bygone era, when food used to be affordedable. I understand that there are crazy costs in hospo now. The real problem was the fact that there was less cheese than the pepperoni pizza. This pizza was supposed to be double cheese. That's what caught my eye on the menu. The regular cheese on the pepperoni was more than the supposed "double " cheese from this menu item.after I type this I'll find the name of it. It is a Hawaiian type pizza, with ham and pineapple and supposed to be "double" cheese. This was glaringly obvious the lack of "double" cheese on this pizza. Does that make sense? Needless to say I was gravely disappointed. I wish I had done the review a few days ago, but I wanted to calm done a little bit and wait a couple of days so I would be a bit less disappointed and not come off like a raving lunatic.😊 It was called a "Greed". Very disappointed.

Kia ora everyone, I stumbled across this as I knew there was a kebab shop in this block & i couldn'tbe botheredcooking I had three dishes. The tempura work on the entree was sublime, the Stock Standard Red Curry absolutely spot on , really good. The server was super cool & chill. 10/10 100%. Great kai, great find M.

Love the people and food here. Always great service from the owners and just all rounds great kebabs. Pricing is very reasonable and portions are quite large. Would highly recommend checking them out.

I have always loved Mexico. It was always my favourite restaurant to go to despite working there for 2 years in the past. Recently, the past few times I’ve visited have not been as enjoyable. The atmosphere doesn’t feel as warm and welcoming, the outside area could use some TLC and the service is very slow! As someone who works in the industry I’m usually very understanding with slow service as there could be many reasons but it was a quiet night with not too many guests. We sat outside and felt forgotten pretty much. The tortillas were stale and the quesadilla was dry on all 3 of my recent visits. The fried ice cream was a huge let down. I really don’t feel the high prices are worth it. Glad to say the fried chicken is still delicious. It’s sad to see an establishment like Mexico fall downhill!

During my visit it was after lunch nearly afternoon tea time, not too crowded. Fast service and lovely staff. My query was answered when I ask about wifi password. The place is clean and I highly recommend it , I ordered super chocolate drink boost and it's very creamy. My cravings were satisfied. It has comfortable chairs and sits besides there are available extensions for charging laptop or phones. You can work here in your own laptop or phone while waiting for your order

Came for a late dinner after coming back from the airport with my partner. Got the BK chicken, a cheeseburger and some fries. For the price (paid $20 for us both) it was not worth it at all. Food was horrible. Haven’t had BK is a long time and definitely won’t be having in again. The staff was nice and gave us a cup to get free water, drink fountain was cool but that was about it.
Classic bk beef with crunchy lettuce, crispy fried onions and sauce is subtle but yum almost like sweet don't mustard.

I ordered a burger and it came with rotten onion rings. The smell was foul and the taste was worse. When I pointed it out, the staff brushed it off and told me it was the BBQ sauce. Having owned a café, I know the difference between spoiled food and sauce, and this was rotten. They did offer to make another one, but after experiencing food that far gone, I wasn’t going to risk their standards again. Also service is non existent you do everything yourself apart from cook the food,

Crap i thought in NZ English was the language not engwish or what ever the exceptionally unhelpful person was Seems customer service no longer important just some dumb pre order till utilities to follow the masses i asked if i could order and pay but got some kind of jiberish from the person on the grill probably best if she didn't understand me quite likely i world have got nothing edible Shame was once a great store and i hope the rest has not followed suit Sushi next door as usual perfect

Good portions. Juicy! Crunchy! Would try again but… I called up and placed an order over the phone. I was wanting spicy chicken, and they recommended the seasoned on. I asked if seasoned was a dry rub or saucy, and she replied with its spicy. Definitely not spicy, which was disappointing. Also got the rice cake and they were okay. I would have been more satisfied with Katsubi. Chips had good seasoning, but were a little dry.
Yummy👍🏻 Large portion and taste so good. I had Roast Duck Rice and Fried beef noodles with “wok qi”, haha. I will visit soon, push👍🏻👍🏻

Great Indian food, best garlic naan in the universe. Staff are polite and attentive. Good value. We went in for a takeaway but decided to stay - so welcoming. Could do with dimming the lights and the authentic Indian music Definitely become a regular Friday night curry.

I had the buguer chips . The chips were nice they offer chicken salt was nice . The patty could had been a bit bigger for the size of the bun . The staff were really cool ! Good work good business you have here !
Love the snack shack! Always getting my coffees from here and great food!
Great new restaurant on the coast. Super fresh Chinese food that was super flavourful with cheap prices. Will definitely return again.

Very huge portion of noodle. You can see the size of bowl by the length of chopstick that we left on top. We ordered signature beef noodle soup and fired mince pork minced noodle. The flavour is quite good. The brisket beef noodle soup can add more spicy if you prefer. They have an option to customized noodle. Spring roll is good flavour but a bit oily tho. We paid at $16.90 for each noodle. Very very full tummy at the end. We will go back definitely 👍
Nice customer service and tasty garlic bread
Ordered pizzas here today and went to give a slice to my 4 year old only to find a metal filament stuck between base and toppings quite scary to think it could have been injested!
My meal of Lamb Korma meatballs made with mashed potato in a Vege curry sauce was very delicious!
The Sweet and Sour Chow Mein is extremely questionable, unsure if you can even call this Chow Mein? Really disappointed
Always fresh, great price, fast service and a clean environment. Definitely the best takeaways I've been to. Feeds my family of 4 for 40 bucks

I love Katsubi, and go to many different locations but Silverdale is by far the best. Always great sized portions, good selection of meat available and friendly staff. Consistent - big ups to the management of this location
I'm so sad about almost people order only chicken. Noodles was so great and perfect. Smoky flavor in soup and meat was so yum. In addition, they were so kind.
Every flavor is delicious. I love the service and the pizza.

Used to be my go to. Went in today, paid $11 for 5 pieces which was fine and said i'd eat them in house. Found out later that they without my knowledge charged me more on my card for sitting down to eat. If they had told me prior I could make a choice of whether to sit in my car or at their table. Very devious. Will not visit again and they have lost out on probably $600 revenue a year for my weekly visits
Ordered online and wontons arrived so burnt they were rancid. Roast had 5 peas and 2 cubes of carrot, more of a garnish than an ingredient, pumpkin was raw in the middle. Fail.

Ordered the chicken curry and fish soup and chicken curry. Both were delicious, the fish broth was very flavoursome, and the chicken was juicy and not overcooked. The portion sizes are massive for the price, and the atmosphere is very relaxed and friendly. Will be back :)
Nice food, highly recommend! The portions were amazing and the Pork Rib Soup tasted great. We’ll definitely be back next time.

We have moved house twice in the last few years, once to diary flat and once to silverdale - we’ve tried other curry restaurants but we have always gone back to curry Hutt. We definitely think it is the best curry on the coast 100%. Also has good family deal which many don’t! Highly recommended!

Visited my local curry house for the first time today. It was a very quiet Wednesday with only one other table taken. Chicken Balti, rice and naan. Probably the best naan in the area. Good balti too, although the medium spice level was hotter than other Indian restaurants.
Great flavours, lamb was soft and tender to eat, maybe a little less sauce than we would have liked but on the whole very delicious
Best sweet & sour chicken I’ve ever tasted & they always add an extra potato fritter in when I order them which is a nice touch.
Great RSA with great events and friendly staff.
Very nice dinner, it was fresh and chips were perfectly crispy. After reading reviews saying the fish was smelly it made me think that it might not be nice but the snapper we had was good.

Used to be the best takeaways on the coast. Sadly, just a total ripoff now with new ownership. Food is average, but the biggest disappointment is the price increases weighed against the pathetic portion sizes! Owners claim portions are by weight but this is untrue as I weighed $5 chips (625g) once home at 275g which was barely enough for my 4 year old! Owners claimed an error had occurred but this is untrue as all recent visits have been the same. Also not happy that when I called to complain they did nothing but argue. Eventually offered a $5 store credit. Such a shame, sadly will never be going back.

When you guys first took over the store, the food wasn’t bad at all, but now I'm not too sure whats going on but your chips are always well over fried and same with the rest of the food that we have ended up with extremely dry food the last 3 times. We thought it may have been a one off but have realised it isn’t anymore sadly. Hopefully this review helps you guys get it sorted. :)
Very nice fish and chips, lovely chicken burgers. Hope they can do fried rice as well.

We had the (not so) fresh Tarakihi, it smelt fishy once we got in the car. We assumed it was ok, and it tasted ok, but unfortunately 3 of us were quite sick after it. Extortionately priced at over $9 for crumbed fish considering it really cant of been fresh.

We had the (not so) fresh Tarakihi, it smelt fishy once we got in the car. We assumed it was ok, and it tasted ok, but unfortunately 3 of us were quite sick after it. Extortionately priced at over $9 for crumbed fish considering it really cant of been fresh.
Absolutely loved the food! Lovely atmosphere. 100% will likely come again. Though one of the servers seemed disgruntled.

We read the reviews and I really don’t understand how those customers can be satisfied with this take away restaurant? We ordered three meals payed around $60 and we couldn’t eat it. It was absolutely terrible !!! The worst Chinese take away we ever tried. I will start with the chicken and corn soup. It was so thick I couldn’t get it out of the container or my spoon. It was thickened with flour !!! The sweet & sour pork was dry , over cooked and tasted like fried in burned oil. Was lacking pineapple, all we got was two tiny pieces. Very cheep tasting meal. The kung pao chicken was sooooo salty I couldn’t eat and swallow one single mouthful. I had to actually dilute it with water and strain it so I can at least have a small dinner. We have given up after only a few mouthfuls and had Vegemite toast for dinner. It all ended up in rubbish bin . Such a waste of food !!! And our money ! It was our first time and only went there because we read the good reviews. We are shocked !

Awesome place!. Really good food at the best prices I have seen in a long time . I was so impressed I told all my friends now they are buying from here because of the quality and price . Best on the coast!.
We pop in once in a while and always get a lovely meal. The children have burger and chips, sometimes crab sticks or fish and chips. Great value and always good quality.

I love this place! The servers are lovely and accommodating, the food is always delicious (especially the Thai green curry and the Waterfront mussels!) The menu is reasonably priced and the atmosphere is amazing - it feels like a little escape from Auckland. Highly recommend.
Great service! Beautiful food and very welcoming to dogs. Would totally recommend for food, atmosphere and a lovely view.
Cocktails 11 out of 10 ! 🍸 Food 11 out of 10 ! 🍜 Sensational 🫰🏼 we will be back Thanks from Frame Racing 🏁

Great selection of food in the menu with generous portion. Prices were very affordable, almost pre-inflation prices! They also offer Vietnamese inspired dishes as well as your typical cafe menu like eggs benedict, french toast.
Fabulous for a walk

Zero star for this, I had a very disappointing experience at this shop. I went to get my baby’s photo clicked for an online application, and the photographer charged me for the service. However, when I tried to upload the photo, it was rejected due to the wrong size. When I called to ask about this, instead of offering a solution, the photographer told me I needed to crop it myself. If I had to do it myself, what was the point of paying for the service? On top of that, he was extremely rude and unprofessional, claiming he was the “owner” of the shop and speaking in a disrespectful manner. This is not how you treat customers. I would not recommend this place to anyone looking for professional service.

I had a terrible experience at Papakura Photo Image Centre. The person taking the photo was extremely rude and unprofessional, claiming to be the “owner” while speaking in a very disrespectful manner. They are not professionals and clearly do not know how to take photos properly. I went to get a photo done today, but when I tried to upload it, it was rejected due to the wrong size. On top of that, the service was awful—very, very rude and dismissive. This is not how you treat customers. Save your money and go elsewhere! I would not recommend this place to anyone looking for professional service.

No star they should have, experience with " Papakura Photo Image Centre" was extremely disappointing. Not only they charge double the price more than warehouse stationery for the printout, but the quality of the printout itself was a complete nightmare, Apart from that, they can not take passport photo as well. they won't follow the instruction. last year photo took from there can not be use. and the print out this time can not be use aswell. The person assisting me seemed incompetent and uninterested in providing good service slow and horrible quality . Regrettably, this encounter reflects a lack of care for quality and customer satisfaction. The overall service and product were far below acceptable standards.

Want to start your day off in a foul mood? come here! Arrived with ID in hand and said “Good morning, I believe I have mail here” (this is a drop off point for some courier services) he didn’t take my ID and just responded “No” I went away to get my phone and came back to show the email saying it was there. He goes on to say nothing had been delivered, asks my name then turns around to a moderate sized stack of packages and pulls my one out. I show my ID to prove it’s mine, he hands it over and that’s the end of it. What a way to treat ppl, if you can’t be bothered servicing ppl, don’t offer the “service”

Had passport photos done. Paid $8 more than what my family member paid for at the mangere pharmacy at the town centre just a week apart. Photo service no different to that of my fam member, only the price.
Awesome little shopping village. Can't wait for the butcher too open tomorrow. 31/03/2021
Nice shops. Only half full at the moment, I'm sure Covid hasn't helped because people are nervous to open new business. Could use a dairy.
Just checked out new butcher's awesome friendly customer service and large range of meat I have been looking for a good butcher closer to home I have found it yay just filled up my freezer thank you
Hexing Takeaway healthy fresh chinese cuisine...
Clean, good selection, reasonable prices
They don't even answer the phone or to any of my emails. So its probably happen to everyone else. Not a cheap company to deal with. I need my balance and all I get is nothing.

Not a good company to deal with - They even tried to get someone else to come around and sell something else, totally ignored the fact, i had a (No sales personal) policy sign on both doors. Don't deal with these people, no return policy applies, if product is broken, and you get charged double the amount.
Geeze my boombox speaker is meant to have been paid beginning of March and they still taking $35 a week out. Waste the time ringing them they never answer the phone.

I was paying for years and they have finally stopped the payments now i want a balance of what i paid as i might be in credit they were good at first now they don't answer calls or anything how can we get in touch with these rip offs please
This place was good until a few months ago now I've lost all number for them can't get ahold of them does anyone have a number for them please
No greetings and all standing at the desk talking to each other nd the other fella singing away didn’t provided assistance.
Wonderfull service, waited a bit longer at checkout but it's understandable being a boxing day sale, A+
Terrible service, Won’t be returning

Thank you to lovely Donna for helping me at 645pm lastnight. Appreciate you helping my 10 year old daughter sort stuff for her new bedroom while I was busy tending to my crying baby. I was able to keep both kids happy all while getting things checked off my list 😊

I rarely leave reviews, but I felt compelled after my visit. The customer service was disappointing—no greeting and not even a thank you when I purchased item. I felt completely unwelcome. A simple “hello” or acknowledgment would’ve made a big difference. Won’t be returning.

Came in for Xmas shopping and purchased a few items. One of them I couldnt find a certain colour of in a bulk bin. Isabelle at the counter was really unpleasant to deal with, had no intention of helping and seemed to want to be as difficult as possible. Her colleague stepped in and found the product for us to resolve the issue. If she wants to work with customers in retail, an attitude adjustment is very much needed.

I have been to the store twice and I am disappointed with the lack of customer service provided. The manager and shop assistant do not care and I will not be returning to this store after this experience.
Lovely and helpful staff, had a very pleasant experience shopping :)

Two ladies seem to be the only staff present and check out extremely busy obviously. Perhaps this store is short staffed and should consider hiring more people for the sake of smooth operation. I requested for specific sizes for the kids fleece they confirmed that they have in stock, they’d grab them from the back for me then the next 20 minutes or more they kept looking at me and prioritised people paying at the counter. I was going to purchase the fleece pullovers once one of them grab them from the back but that never happened. In the end I hopelessly left after seeing staff on the left stopping the other staff from helping me and gave her sign to serve the customer in the line first instead. By the way, my enquiry came through way before that person even lined up. Probably 3-4 people that joined the queue after my enquiry got served when I still patiently waited. I understand you guys were busy but service could’ve been more professional for example first come first serve (duh) and providing a genuine apology? Also considering how big the brand is in the country it was shocking to see none of them were wearing a name badge.Terrible macpac store experience ever.

★★★★★ Had an excellent shopping experience at Macpac in Manawa Bay! Jass welcomed us with a warm smile and took the time to explain the ongoing sale in detail. She was incredibly knowledgeable and provided great insights about the product we enquired about. Her friendly and helpful attitude made our visit truly enjoyable. Highly recommend visiting this store—great service and great products!

Served by Manish the store manager. Absolutely delightful, respectful and patient man - he was. I couldn’t get the things done I needed but he directed me to the right source and problems are being solved. Grateful for Manish!
Very good price n service. I planned to just have a look around, and ended up buying many quality stuff with only a $140 bill!

Not an issue I have had with this specific store but the macpac online purchasing. Made an order...received a confirmation email...then no further communication or delivery. Tried contacting through the website form and sent several emails asking for an update or clarification. Still nothing. Terrible customer care....as others have mentioned in reviews....customer care really doesn't seem a priority for macpac. So here I am leaving a one star review in the hope of actually generating a response and some action to resolve the issue

love shopping here and walking around to get some steps in lol. The fence of playground I really like as its safe, however it definitely needs an upgrade. Hopefully the playground will be updated soon as there's alot of parents who love to take their kids here

I just love this place. So many stores in one area including at least 2 factory priced clothes boutiques. Kmart is open 24hours and there's even 2 coffee shops. Very enjoyable. The car traffic can get a bit full, literally bumper to bumper but it's always moving. Something for everyone here!
Great customer service. Very helpful. App is especially useful. Can find what product snd which aisle it's located at. Simplicity at its best
Great place to shop, good parking space spacious stores

Me and my family's go to for anything electronic related devices and appliances. The staff are nice and really helpful. Lots of deals everyday. Easy return or replacement for faulty items or change of mind.
Went to check shops here and buy some Dumbbells from here. Great place for getting few of the things one may want or like.

Inside the mall, there’s a solid selection of food outlets catering to different tastes, from local favourites to takeaway options. Whether you’re grabbing a quick lunch or sitting down for dinner, you’ll find something that hits the spot. The restaurants are clean, welcoming, and usually not overcrowded. In terms of essentials, the mall includes a Countdown supermarket which is well-stocked and makes it easy to grab your groceries in one go. There’s also an ATM on site, which is convenient for quick cash withdrawals. Other services include a barber shop that’s reasonably priced and does a good job, and dolloar shop is good too. It’s a great stop for locals or anyone passing through Manukau who wants hassle-free shopping, dining, and services all under one roof.

The Adidas store in Onehunga offers a fantastic shopping experience for anyone looking for quality sportswear at great prices. Located in the heart of the Onehunga Dress Smart outlet precinct, the store is spacious, well-organised, and easy to navigate. From the moment you step inside, the clean layout and clear signage make browsing a breeze. The store carries a wide range of Adidas products, including performance gear, casual streetwear, sneakers, and accessories for men, women, and kids. It’s a great place to score high-quality Adidas gear without breaking the bank. The stock turnover is frequent too, so there’s always something new to check out on each visit. Customer service at the Onehunga store is consistently strong. The staff are friendly, knowledgeable, and always willing to help with sizing, availability, or product advice. They strike a good balance between being helpful and letting you browse in peace. The fitting rooms are clean and spacious, and the checkout process is fast and efficient—even when the store gets busy on weekends. Overall, the Adidas Onehunga store is well worth visiting, whether you’re a die-hard Adidas fan or just looking for a good deal on top-quality sportswear. With its strong product range, outlet pricing, and excellent service, it’s one of the best stops for athletic wear in the Auckland area.

The Arcade – A Hidden Gem in Devonport Nestled in the heart of Devonport’s charming village, The Arcade is a boutique retail and wellness hub that blends heritage character with modern-day comforts. Just steps from the ferry terminal on Victoria Road, it offers a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere, perfect for both locals and visitors. Home to a curated selection of businesses, The Arcade is known for its high-quality, personalized services. Arcade Day Spa provides eco-conscious beauty treatments in a peaceful setting, with everything from facials to lash enhancements delivered by experienced professionals. Nearby, Arcadia Hair Stylist is a favorite among locals for precision cuts and styling, led by the talented June Sun, formerly of Servilles. Set against Devonport’s scenic seaside backdrop, The Arcade offers a uniquely local experience—whether you're in need of a little pampering, a fresh new look, or simply a stroll through one of Auckland’s most picturesque neighborhoods.
